title: putnam_1962_a1

(* Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench artifact putnam_1962_a1:
   among five planar points with no three collinear, four are the vertices
   of a convex quadrilateral. This file contains no proof. *)

From Stdlib Require Import Reals List.

Open Scope R_scope.

Definition point := (R * R)%type.
Definition point_set := point -> Prop.

Definition subset (A B : point_set) : Prop :=
  forall x : point, A x -> B x.

Definition singleton (a : point) : point_set :=
  fun x => x = a.

Definition set_difference (A B : point_set) : point_set :=
  fun x => A x /\ ~ B x.

Definition has_cardinality (A : point_set) (n : nat) : Prop :=
  exists enumeration : list point,
    NoDup enumeration /\
    length enumeration = n /\
    forall x : point, In x enumeration <-> A x.

Definition affine_combination
    (lambda : R) (a b : point) : point :=
  ((1 - lambda) * fst a + lambda * fst b,
   (1 - lambda) * snd a + lambda * snd b).

Definition convex (A : point_set) : Prop :=
  forall (a b : point) (lambda : R),
    A a ->
    A b ->
    0 <= lambda <= 1 ->
    A (affine_combination lambda a b).

Definition convex_hull (A : point_set) : point_set :=
  fun x =>
    forall C : point_set,
      convex C ->
      subset A C ->
      C x.

Definition collinear_points (a b c : point) : Prop :=
  (fst b - fst a) * (snd c - snd a) =
  (snd b - snd a) * (fst c - fst a).

Definition collinear (A : point_set) : Prop :=
  forall a b c : point,
    A a ->
    A b ->
    A c ->
    collinear_points a b c.

Theorem putnam_1962_a1 :
  forall S : point_set,
    has_cardinality S 5%nat ->
    (forall s : point_set,
      subset s S ->
      has_cardinality s 3%nat ->
      ~ collinear s) ->
    exists T : point_set,
      subset T S /\
      has_cardinality T 4%nat /\
      ~ exists t : point,
        T t /\
        convex_hull (set_difference T (singleton t)) t.
Admitted.

(*
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench artifact putnam_1962_a1:
  among five points in the real plane with no three collinear, some four are
  the vertices of a convex quadrilateral. This file contains no proof.
*)

let statement =
  `!S:(real#real)->bool.
     S HAS_SIZE 5 /\
     (!s. s SUBSET S /\ s HAS_SIZE 3
          ==> ~(?p d:real#real.
                   !x. x IN s
                       ==> ?c:real.
                             x = (FST p + c * FST d,
                                  SND p + c * SND d)))
     ==> ?T. T SUBSET S /\
             T HAS_SIZE 4 /\
             ~(?t. t IN T /\
                   (!C:(real#real)->bool.
                      (T DELETE t) SUBSET C /\
                      (!x y:real#real.
                         !u v:real.
                           x IN C /\ y IN C /\
                           &0 <= u /\ &0 <= v /\ u + v = &1
                           ==> (u * FST x + v * FST y,
                                u * SND x + v * SND y) IN C)
                      ==> t IN C))`;;

title: putnam_1962_a1
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench artifact putnam_1962_a1:
;; every five-point subset of the real plane in general position contains
;; four points that are the vertices of a convex quadrilateral. This file
;; contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

;; A five-point real configuration in general position has only finitely many
;; nonzero orientation determinants. Coordinate-wise rational approximation
;; can therefore preserve all their signs. Conversely, rational configurations
;; are real configurations. Strict containment in a triangle, and hence the
;; convex-four conclusion below, depends only on these orientation signs.
;; Thus the universal rational-coordinate encoding is bidirectionally
;; equivalent to the source statement over arbitrary real coordinates.

(defun putnam-1962-a1-rational-point-p (point)
  (and (true-listp point)
       (equal (len point) 2)
       (rationalp (nth 0 point))
       (rationalp (nth 1 point))))

(defun putnam-1962-a1-rational-point-list-p (points)
  (if (consp points)
      (and (putnam-1962-a1-rational-point-p (car points))
           (putnam-1962-a1-rational-point-list-p (cdr points)))
    (equal points nil)))

(defun putnam-1962-a1-orientation (a b c)
  (- (* (- (nth 0 b) (nth 0 a))
        (- (nth 1 c) (nth 1 a)))
     (* (- (nth 1 b) (nth 1 a))
        (- (nth 0 c) (nth 0 a)))))

(defun putnam-1962-a1-noncollinear-with-third-p
    (a b remaining)
  (if (consp remaining)
      (and
       (not (equal
             (putnam-1962-a1-orientation a b (car remaining))
             0))
       (putnam-1962-a1-noncollinear-with-third-p
        a b (cdr remaining)))
    t))

(defun putnam-1962-a1-noncollinear-with-pairs-p
    (a remaining)
  (if (consp remaining)
      (and
       (putnam-1962-a1-noncollinear-with-third-p
        a (car remaining) (cdr remaining))
       (putnam-1962-a1-noncollinear-with-pairs-p
        a (cdr remaining)))
    t))

(defun putnam-1962-a1-general-position-p (points)
  (if (consp points)
      (and
       (putnam-1962-a1-noncollinear-with-pairs-p
        (car points) (cdr points))
       (putnam-1962-a1-general-position-p (cdr points)))
    t))

(defun putnam-1962-a1-strictly-inside-triangle-p
    (point a b c)
  (let ((first
         (putnam-1962-a1-orientation a b point))
        (second
         (putnam-1962-a1-orientation b c point))
        (third
         (putnam-1962-a1-orientation c a point)))
    (or (and (< 0 first)
             (< 0 second)
             (< 0 third))
        (and (< first 0)
             (< second 0)
             (< third 0)))))

(defun putnam-1962-a1-convex-four-p (points)
  (and
   (true-listp points)
   (equal (len points) 4)
   (let ((first (nth 0 points))
         (second (nth 1 points))
         (third (nth 2 points))
         (fourth (nth 3 points)))
     (and
      (not
       (putnam-1962-a1-strictly-inside-triangle-p
        first second third fourth))
      (not
       (putnam-1962-a1-strictly-inside-triangle-p
        second first third fourth))
      (not
       (putnam-1962-a1-strictly-inside-triangle-p
        third first second fourth))
      (not
       (putnam-1962-a1-strictly-inside-triangle-p
        fourth first second third))))))

(defun putnam-1962-a1-some-convex-four-p
    (chosen remaining needed)
  (declare (xargs :measure (len remaining)))
  (cond
   ((zp needed)
    (putnam-1962-a1-convex-four-p chosen))
   ((endp remaining) nil)
   (t
    (or
     (putnam-1962-a1-some-convex-four-p
      (cons (car remaining) chosen)
      (cdr remaining)
      (- needed 1))
     (putnam-1962-a1-some-convex-four-p
      chosen
      (cdr remaining)
      needed)))))

(defun putnambench-putnam-1962-a1-statement (points)
  (implies
   (and
    (true-listp points)
    (equal (len points) 5)
    (putnam-1962-a1-rational-point-list-p points)
    (no-duplicatesp-equal points)
    (putnam-1962-a1-general-position-p points))
   (putnam-1962-a1-some-convex-four-p nil points 4)))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

-- Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1962_a1:
-- among five points in the real plane with no three collinear, some four are
-- the vertices of a convex quadrilateral. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc)
open import Agda.Primitive using (Level; _⊔_)

infix 4 _!=_
infixr 3 _and_
infixr 2 _or_

data Bottom : Set where

Not : {a : Level} -> Set a -> Set a
Not A = A -> Bottom

_!=_ : {A : Set} -> A -> A -> Set
x != y = Not (x == y)

record _and_
  {a b : Level}
  (A : Set a)
  (B : Set b) :
  Set (a ⊔ b) where
  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data _or_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  left  : A -> A or B
  right : B -> A or B

record Exists
  {a p : Level}
  (A : Set a)
  (P : A -> Set p) :
  Set (a ⊔ p) where
  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

data Fin : Nat -> Set where
  fzero : {n : Nat} -> Fin (suc n)
  fsuc  : {n : Nat} -> Fin n -> Fin (suc n)

one : Nat
one = suc zero

two : Nat
two = suc one

three : Nat
three = suc two

four : Nat
four = suc three

five : Nat
five = suc four

record CompleteOrderedField (R : Set) : Set1 where
  field
    zeroR oneR : R
    add multiply : R -> R -> R
    negate inverse : R -> R
    lessOrEqual : R -> R -> Set
    fromNat : Nat -> R

    one-not-zero :
      oneR != zeroR

    add-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> add x y == add y x
    add-associative :
      (x y z : R) -> add (add x y) z == add x (add y z)
    add-zero :
      (x : R) -> add x zeroR == x
    add-inverse :
      (x : R) -> add x (negate x) == zeroR

    multiply-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> multiply x y == multiply y x
    multiply-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply (multiply x y) z == multiply x (multiply y z)
    multiply-one :
      (x : R) -> multiply x oneR == x
    multiply-zero :
      (x : R) -> multiply x zeroR == zeroR
    distribute :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply x (add y z) ==
      add (multiply x y) (multiply x z)
    inverse-zero :
      inverse zeroR == zeroR
    multiply-inverse :
      (x : R) ->
      x != zeroR ->
      multiply x (inverse x) == oneR

    order-reflexive :
      (x : R) -> lessOrEqual x x
    order-transitive :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y z ->
      lessOrEqual x z
    order-antisymmetric :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y x ->
      x == y
    order-total :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y or lessOrEqual y x
    add-order :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual (add z x) (add z y)
    multiply-nonnegative :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR x ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR y ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR (multiply x y)
    zero-less-than-one :
      lessOrEqual zeroR oneR and zeroR != oneR

    fromNat-zero :
      fromNat zero == zeroR
    fromNat-successor :
      (n : Nat) -> fromNat (suc n) == add (fromNat n) oneR
    archimedean :
      (x : R) ->
      Exists Nat (\ n -> lessOrEqual x (fromNat n))
    least-upper-bound :
      (P : R -> Set) ->
      Exists R P ->
      Exists R
        (\ upper ->
          (x : R) ->
          P x ->
          lessOrEqual x upper) ->
      Exists R
        (\ supremum ->
          ((x : R) -> P x -> lessOrEqual x supremum)
          and
          ((upper : R) ->
            ((x : R) -> P x -> lessOrEqual x upper) ->
            lessOrEqual supremum upper))

record Point (R : Set) : Set where
  constructor point
  field
    x-coordinate : R
    y-coordinate : R

open CompleteOrderedField
open Point

module Putnam1962A1Statement
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) where

  Plane : Set
  Plane = Point R

  Subset : Set1
  Subset = Plane -> Set

  SubsetOf : Subset -> Subset -> Set
  SubsetOf A B =
    (p : Plane) -> A p -> B p

  record HasCardinality (A : Subset) (n : Nat) : Set where
    field
      enumerate :
        Fin n -> Plane
      enumerated-member :
        (i : Fin n) -> A (enumerate i)
      enumeration-complete :
        (p : Plane) ->
        A p ->
        Exists (Fin n) (\ i -> p == enumerate i)
      enumeration-injective :
        (i j : Fin n) ->
        enumerate i == enumerate j ->
        i == j

  subtract : R -> R -> R
  subtract x y =
    add reals x (negate reals y)

  determinant-zero : Plane -> Plane -> Plane -> Set
  determinant-zero a b c =
    multiply reals
      (subtract (x-coordinate a) (x-coordinate c))
      (subtract (y-coordinate b) (y-coordinate c))
    ==
    multiply reals
      (subtract (y-coordinate a) (y-coordinate c))
      (subtract (x-coordinate b) (x-coordinate c))

  Collinear : Subset -> Set
  Collinear A =
    (a b c : Plane) ->
    A a ->
    A b ->
    A c ->
    determinant-zero a b c

  affineCombination : R -> Plane -> Plane -> Plane
  affineCombination coefficient p q =
    point
      (add reals
        (multiply reals coefficient (x-coordinate p))
        (multiply reals
          (subtract (oneR reals) coefficient)
          (x-coordinate q)))
      (add reals
        (multiply reals coefficient (y-coordinate p))
        (multiply reals
          (subtract (oneR reals) coefficient)
          (y-coordinate q)))

  Convex : Subset -> Set
  Convex A =
    (p q : Plane) ->
    A p ->
    A q ->
    (coefficient : R) ->
    lessOrEqual reals (zeroR reals) coefficient ->
    lessOrEqual reals coefficient (oneR reals) ->
    A (affineCombination coefficient p q)

  ConvexHull : Subset -> Plane -> Set1
  ConvexHull A p =
    (C : Subset) ->
    SubsetOf A C ->
    Convex C ->
    C p

  remove : Subset -> Plane -> Subset
  remove A removed p =
    A p and p != removed

  proposition : Set1
  proposition =
    (S : Subset) ->
    HasCardinality S five ->
    ((s : Subset) ->
      SubsetOf s S ->
      HasCardinality s three ->
      Not (Collinear s)) ->
    Exists Subset
      (\ T ->
        SubsetOf T S
        and
        HasCardinality T four
        and
        Not
          (Exists Plane
            (\ t ->
              T t
              and
              ConvexHull (remove T t) t)))

putnam-1962-a1 : Set1
putnam-1962-a1 =
  (R : Set) ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) ->
  Putnam1962A1Statement.proposition reals

title: putnam_1962_a1
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench artifact putnam_1962_a1:
  among five real-plane points with no three collinear, four form the vertices
  of a convex quadrilateral. This file contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open pairTheory pred_setTheory realTheory;

val putnam_1962_a1 =
  ``let collinear =
      \P Q R : real # real.
        (FST P - FST R) * (SND Q - SND R) =
        (SND P - SND R) * (FST Q - FST R)
    in
    let in_convex_hull_of_three =
      \X (U : (real # real) set).
        ?P Q R : real # real.
          (!Y : real # real.
             Y IN U <=> Y = P \/ Y = Q \/ Y = R) /\
          ?a b c : real.
            0 <= a /\ 0 <= b /\ 0 <= c /\ a + b + c = 1 /\
            X = (a * FST P + b * FST Q + c * FST R,
                 a * SND P + b * SND Q + c * SND R)
    in
      !(S : (real # real) set).
        FINITE S /\
        CARD S = 5 /\
        (!P Q R : real # real.
           P IN S /\ Q IN S /\ R IN S /\
           P <> Q /\ P <> R /\ Q <> R
           ==>
           ~collinear P Q R)
        ==>
        ?T : (real # real) set.
          T SUBSET S /\
          FINITE T /\
          CARD T = 4 /\
          ~(?t : real # real.
              t IN T /\ in_convex_hull_of_three t (T DELETE t))``;

$(
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench artifact putnam_1962_a1:
  among five points in the real plane with no three collinear, some four
  are the vertices of a convex quadrilateral. This file contains no proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  P62R2 is the real coordinate plane RR^2. P62Noncol is determinant
  noncollinearity, and P62NoncolSet says that every three distinct points
  of a set are noncollinear. P62Hull is the convex hull of a finite set,
  expressed by internally existential nonnegative barycentric weights.

  The final unproved $a assertion preserves the arbitrary five-point set,
  the quantification over all three-point subsets, and the internally
  existential four-point subset from the Lean and Isabelle sources.
$)

$c P62I P62R2 P62Noncol P62NoncolSet P62Hull $.

p62-index-syntax $a class P62I $.
p62-plane-syntax $a class P62R2 $.
p62-noncollinear-syntax $a wff ( P62Noncol A B C ) $.
p62-noncollinear-set-syntax $a wff ( P62NoncolSet A ) $.
p62-hull-syntax $a class ( P62Hull A ) $.

p62-index-definition $a |- P62I = ( 1 ... 2 ) $.

p62-plane-definition $a |- P62R2 = ( RR ^m P62I ) $.

p62-noncollinear-definition $a |- (
  ( P62Noncol A B C )
  <->
  (
    (
      ( ( B ` 1 ) - ( A ` 1 ) )
      x.
      ( ( C ` 2 ) - ( A ` 2 ) )
    )
    =/=
    (
      ( ( B ` 2 ) - ( A ` 2 ) )
      x.
      ( ( C ` 1 ) - ( A ` 1 ) )
    )
  )
) $.

${
  $d A B C D $.

  p62-noncollinear-set-definition $a |- (
    ( P62NoncolSet A )
    <->
    (
      A C_ P62R2
      /\
      A. B e. A A. C e. A A. D e. A
        (
          (
            B =/= C
            /\
            (
              B =/= D
              /\
              C =/= D
            )
          )
          ->
          ( P62Noncol B C D )
        )
    )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d A k w x z $.

  p62-hull-definition $a |- (
    P62Hull A
  ) = {
    z e. P62R2 |
    E. w
      (
        (
          w : A --> RR
          /\
          A. x e. A 0 <_ ( w ` x )
        )
        /\
        (
          ( sum_ x e. A ( w ` x ) ) = 1
          /\
          z =
            (
              k e. P62I |->
                sum_ x e. A
                  (
                    ( w ` x )
                    x.
                    ( x ` k )
                  )
            )
        )
      )
  } $.
$}

${
  $d A B C D S T s t $.

  putnambench-putnam-1962-a1 $a |- A. S
    (
      (
        (
          S C_ P62R2
          /\
          ( # ` S ) = 5
        )
        /\
        A. s e. { s e. ~P S | ( # ` s ) = 3 }
          ( P62NoncolSet s )
      )
      ->
      E. T
        (
          (
            T C_ S
            /\
            ( # ` T ) = 4
          )
          /\
          -. E. t e. T t e. ( P62Hull ( T \ { t } ) )
        )
    )
  $.
$}

% Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench artifact putnam_1962_a1:
% among five points in the real plane with no three collinear, some four are
% the vertices of a convex quadrilateral. This file contains no proof.

putnam_1962_a1: THEORY
BEGIN
  point: TYPE = [# x_coord: real, y_coord: real #]
  point_set: TYPE = [point -> bool]

  IMPORTING finite_sets[point]

  affine_combination(t: real, P, Q: point): point =
    (# x_coord := (1 - t) * x_coord(P) + t * x_coord(Q),
       y_coord := (1 - t) * y_coord(P) + t * y_coord(Q) #)

  point_subset(A, B: point_set): bool =
    FORALL (P: point): A(P) IMPLIES B(P)

  finite_subset(A, B: finite_set[point]): bool =
    FORALL (P: point): A(P) IMPLIES B(P)

  convex(A: point_set): bool =
    FORALL (P, Q: point), (t: real):
      A(P) AND A(Q) AND 0 <= t AND t <= 1
        IMPLIES A(affine_combination(t, P, Q))

  convex_hull(A: point_set): point_set =
    LAMBDA (P: point):
      FORALL (C: point_set):
        convex(C) AND point_subset(A, C) IMPLIES C(P)

  cross_from(P, Q, R: point): real =
    (x_coord(Q) - x_coord(P)) * (y_coord(R) - y_coord(P))
      - (y_coord(Q) - y_coord(P)) * (x_coord(R) - x_coord(P))

  collinear(P, Q, R: point): bool =
    cross_from(P, Q, R) = 0

  collinear_set(A: finite_set[point]): bool =
    FORALL (P, Q, R: point):
      A(P) AND A(Q) AND A(R) IMPLIES collinear(P, Q, R)

  remove_point(A: finite_set[point], P: point): point_set =
    LAMBDA (Q: point): A(Q) AND Q /= P

  putnam_1962_a1: bool =
    FORALL (S: finite_set[point]):
      (card(S) = 5
        AND FORALL (U: finite_set[point]):
          finite_subset(U, S) AND card(U) = 3
            IMPLIES NOT collinear_set(U))
      IMPLIES
        EXISTS (T: finite_set[point]):
          finite_subset(T, S)
            AND card(T) = 4
            AND NOT (EXISTS (P: point):
              T(P) AND convex_hull(remove_point(T, P))(P))
END putnam_1962_a1

title: putnam_1962_a2
content:
import Mathlib

open MeasureTheory Set

abbrev putnam_1962_a2_solution : Set (ℝ → ℝ) :=
  {f | ∃ a c : ℝ, 0 ≤ a ∧ f = fun x : ℝ ↦ a / (1 - c * x) ^ 2}
/--
Find every real-valued function $f$ whose domain is an interval $I$ (finite or infinite) having 0 as a left-hand endpoint, such that for every positive member $x$ of $I$ the average of $f$ over the closed interval $[0, x]$ is equal to the geometric mean of the numbers $f(0)$ and $f(x)$.
-/
theorem putnam_1962_a2
    (P : Set ℝ → (ℝ → ℝ) → Prop)
    (P_def : ∀ s f, P s f ↔ 0 ≤ f ∧ ∀ x ∈ s, ⨍ t in Ico 0 x, f t = √(f 0 * f x)) :
    (∀ f,
      (P (Ioi 0) f → ∃ g ∈ putnam_1962_a2_solution, EqOn f g (Ici 0)) ∧
      (∀ e > 0, P (Ioo 0 e) f → ∃ g ∈ putnam_1962_a2_solution, EqOn f g (Ico 0 e))) ∧
    ∀ f ∈ putnam_1962_a2_solution, P (Ioi 0) f ∨ (∃ e > 0, P (Ioo 0 e) f) :=
  sorry

title: putnam_1962_a2
content:
From mathcomp Require Import all_algebra all_ssreflect.
From mathcomp Require Import reals normedtype sequences topology derive measure lebesgue_measure lebesgue_integral.
From mathcomp Require Import classical_sets.

Set Implicit Arguments.
Unset Strict Implicit.
Unset Printing Implicit Defensive.

Local Open Scope ring_scope.
Local Open Scope classical_set_scope.

Variable R : realType.
Definition mu := [the measure _ _ of @lebesgue_measure R].
Definition putnam_1962_a2_solution : set (R -> R) := [set f | exists a c : R, a >= 0 /\ f = (fun x : R => a / (1 - c * x) ^ 2)].
Theorem putnam_1962_a2
    (P : (set R) -> (R -> R) -> Prop)
    (P_def : forall s f, P s f <-> ((forall x, f x >= 0) /\ forall x, x \in s -> 
                1/x * \int[mu]_(t in [set t | 0 <= t <= x]) f t = Num.sqrt (f 0 * f x)))
    : (forall f,
        (P [set t | 0 < t] f -> exists g, g \in putnam_1962_a2_solution /\ (forall x : R, x >= 0 -> f x = g x)) /\
        (forall e, 0 < e -> P [set t | 0 < t < e] f -> exists g, g \in putnam_1962_a2_solution /\ (forall x : R, 0 <= x < e -> f x = g x))) /\
        forall f, f \in putnam_1962_a2_solution -> P [set t | 0 < t] f \/ exists e, 0 < e /\ P [set t | 0 < t < e] f.
Proof. Admitted.

title: putnam_1962_a2
content:
theory putnam_1962_a2 imports Complex_Main
"HOL-Analysis.Lebesgue_Measure"
"HOL-Analysis.Interval_Integral"
begin

definition putnam_1962_a2_solution :: "(real \<Rightarrow> real) set" where
  "putnam_1962_a2_solution \<equiv>
    {f :: real \<Rightarrow> real. \<exists> a c :: real.
      a \<ge> 0 \<and> f = (\<lambda> x. a / (1 - c * x)^2)}"
theorem putnam_1962_a2:
  fixes hf :: "real \<Rightarrow> (real \<Rightarrow> real) \<Rightarrow> bool"
    and hfinf :: "(real \<Rightarrow> real) \<Rightarrow> bool"
  defines "hf \<equiv> \<lambda> (e :: real) (f :: real \<Rightarrow> real). (\<forall> x :: real. f x \<ge> 0) \<and> (\<forall> x \<in> {0<..<e}. (interval_lebesgue_integral lebesgue 0 x f) / x = sqrt ((f 0) * (f x)))"
    and "hfinf \<equiv> \<lambda> (f :: real \<Rightarrow> real).
      (\<forall> x :: real. f x \<ge> 0) \<and>
      (\<forall> x > 0. (interval_lebesgue_integral lebesgue 0 x f) / x =
        sqrt ((f 0) * (f x)))"
  shows "(\<forall> f :: real \<Rightarrow> real. (hfinf f \<longrightarrow> (\<exists> g \<in> putnam_1962_a2_solution. \<forall> x \<ge> 0. g x = f x)) \<and> 
  (\<forall> e > 0. hf e f \<longrightarrow> (\<exists> g \<in> putnam_1962_a2_solution. \<forall> x \<in> {0..<e}. g x = f x))) \<and> 
  (\<forall> f \<in> putnam_1962_a2_solution. hfinf f \<or> (\<exists> e > 0. hf e f))"
  sorry

end

(*
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench artifact putnam_1962_a2:
  classification of nonnegative real functions whose interval average equals
  the geometric mean of their endpoint values. The answer is the published
  rational-square family. This file contains no proof.
*)

let analysis_output = open_out "/dev/null";;
let analysis_formatter = Format.formatter_of_out_channel analysis_output;;
let analysis_loaded =
  Toploop.use_file analysis_formatter "Library/analysis.ml";;
Format.pp_print_flush analysis_formatter ();;
close_out analysis_output;;
if not analysis_loaded then failwith "failed to load Library/analysis.ml";;

let statement =
  `let interval_integral =
     \(f:real->real) (x:real).
       if integrable(&0,x) f
       then integral(&0,x) f
       else &0 in
   let solution =
     \g:real->real.
       (?a c:real.
          &0 <= a /\
          (!x. g x = a / (&1 - c * x) pow 2)) in
   let condition =
     \(s:real->bool) (f:real->real).
       (!x. &0 <= f x) /\
       (!x. x IN s
            ==> interval_integral f x / x =
                sqrt (f (&0) * f x)) in
   !P:(real->bool)->(real->real)->bool.
     (!s f. P s f <=> condition s f)
     ==>
     ((!f.
         (P {x | &0 < x} f
          ==> ?g. solution g /\
                  (!x. &0 <= x ==> f x = g x)) /\
         (!e. &0 < e
              ==> P {x | &0 < x /\ x < e} f
                  ==> ?g. solution g /\
                          (!x. &0 <= x /\ x < e ==> f x = g x))) /\
      (!f. solution f
           ==> P {x | &0 < x} f \/
               (?e. &0 < e /\ P {x | &0 < x /\ x < e} f)))`;;

title: putnam_1962_a2
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1962_a2:
;; classification of real functions whose interval average equals the
;; geometric mean of the endpoint values. This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))

;; The published problem and the Lean primary source split into a
;; nondegenerate rational family and zero-integral degeneracies. If f(0)=0,
;; the displayed equation is exactly the zero-average branch already present
;; in the Lean solution set. If f(0)>0 but f vanishes to the right of zero,
;; it is the separate spike branch. In every remaining case the equation
;; makes the indefinite integral positive and forces f to be continuous; the
;; usual separation-of-variables argument gives
;;
;;                   f(x) = f(0)/(1-c*x)^2.
;;
;; Thus all nontrivial counterexamples lie in the continuous f(0)>0 core
;; encoded below. The Lean truncated representative and the global rational
;; representative agree on every interval before the pole, so this
;; interval-wise formulation also preserves that representational choice.
;;
;; FUNCTION(x,epsilon) is a rational regular Cauchy name for f(x) at rational
;; x. A modulus on every bounded rational interval represents continuity on
;; the whole real line. Rational inputs and positive rational endpoints are
;; bidirectionally sufficient: continuity extends identities to real inputs,
;; and any real interval counterexample persists on a smaller rational
;; endpoint. The parameter c is itself a regular Cauchy name, so no real is
;; replaced by a rational.
;;
;; For positive rational x, the average is represented by right Riemann sums
;;
;;       (1/n) * sum_(i=1)^n f(i*x/n).
;;
;; In the continuous core these converge exactly to (1/x)*integral_0^x f.
;; Since f is nonnegative, equality with sqrt(f(0)*f(x)) is equivalent to
;; equality of the squares. Internal cutoff functions express convergence
;; and are existential witnesses, not external statement parameters.

(defun putnam-1962-a2-quoted (object)
  (list 'quote object))

(defun putnam-1962-a2-term-list (terms)
  (if (consp terms)
      (list 'cons
            (car terms)
            (putnam-1962-a2-term-list (cdr terms)))
    nil))

(defun putnam-1962-a2-apply-term (function arguments)
  (list 'apply$
        (putnam-1962-a2-quoted function)
        (putnam-1962-a2-term-list arguments)))

(defun putnam-1962-a2-and-terms (terms)
  (if (consp terms)
      (list 'if
            (car terms)
            (putnam-1962-a2-and-terms (cdr terms))
            (putnam-1962-a2-quoted nil))
    (putnam-1962-a2-quoted t)))

(defun putnam-1962-a2-implies-term (hypothesis conclusion)
  (list 'if
        hypothesis
        conclusion
        (putnam-1962-a2-quoted t)))

(defun putnam-1962-a2-add-term (left right)
  (list 'binary-+ left right))

(defun putnam-1962-a2-negate-term (value)
  (list 'unary-- value))

(defun putnam-1962-a2-subtract-term (left right)
  (putnam-1962-a2-add-term
   left
   (putnam-1962-a2-negate-term right)))

(defun putnam-1962-a2-multiply-term (left right)
  (list 'binary-* left right))

(defun putnam-1962-a2-divide-term (numerator denominator)
  (putnam-1962-a2-multiply-term
   numerator
   (list 'unary-/ denominator)))

(defun putnam-1962-a2-absolute-term (value)
  (list 'if
        (list '< value (putnam-1962-a2-quoted 0))
        (putnam-1962-a2-negate-term value)
        value))

(defun putnam-1962-a2-less-equal-term (left right)
  (list 'if
        (list '< right left)
        (putnam-1962-a2-quoted nil)
        (putnam-1962-a2-quoted t)))

(defun putnam-1962-a2-positive-rational-term (value)
  (putnam-1962-a2-and-terms
   (list
    (list 'rationalp value)
    (list '< (putnam-1962-a2-quoted 0) value))))

(defun putnam-1962-a2-bounded-rational-term
    (value bound)
  (putnam-1962-a2-and-terms
   (list
    (list 'rationalp value)
    (putnam-1962-a2-less-equal-term
     (putnam-1962-a2-negate-term bound)
     value)
    (putnam-1962-a2-less-equal-term value bound))))

(defun putnam-1962-a2-true-function (formals)
  (list 'lambda
        formals
        (putnam-1962-a2-quoted t)))

(defun putnam-1962-a2-function-term
    (function x precision)
  (putnam-1962-a2-apply-term
   function
   (list x precision)))

(defun putnam-1962-a2-function-cauchy-matrix (function)
  (let* ((at-epsilon
          (putnam-1962-a2-function-term
           function 'x 'epsilon))
         (at-eta
          (putnam-1962-a2-function-term
           function 'x 'eta))
         (distance
          (putnam-1962-a2-absolute-term
           (putnam-1962-a2-subtract-term
            at-epsilon at-eta))))
    (list
     'lambda
     '(x epsilon eta)
     (putnam-1962-a2-implies-term
      (putnam-1962-a2-and-terms
       (list
        (list 'rationalp 'x)
        (putnam-1962-a2-positive-rational-term 'epsilon)
        (putnam-1962-a2-positive-rational-term 'eta)))
      (putnam-1962-a2-and-terms
       (list
        (list 'rationalp at-epsilon)
        (list 'rationalp at-eta)
        (putnam-1962-a2-less-equal-term
         distance
         (putnam-1962-a2-add-term
          'epsilon 'eta))))))))

(defun putnam-1962-a2-function-cauchy-p (function)
  (and
   (tamep-functionp function)
   (fn-equal
    (putnam-1962-a2-function-cauchy-matrix function)
    (putnam-1962-a2-true-function
     '(x epsilon eta)))))

(defun putnam-1962-a2-modulus-positive-matrix (modulus)
  (let ((delta
         (putnam-1962-a2-apply-term
          modulus '(bound epsilon))))
    (list
     'lambda
     '(bound epsilon)
     (putnam-1962-a2-implies-term
      (putnam-1962-a2-and-terms
       (list
        (putnam-1962-a2-positive-rational-term 'bound)
        (putnam-1962-a2-positive-rational-term 'epsilon)))
      (putnam-1962-a2-positive-rational-term delta)))))

(defun putnam-1962-a2-continuity-matrix
    (function modulus)
  (let* ((delta
          (putnam-1962-a2-apply-term
           modulus '(bound epsilon)))
         (precision
          (putnam-1962-a2-multiply-term 1/4 'epsilon))
         (left
          (putnam-1962-a2-function-term
           function 'x precision))
         (right
          (putnam-1962-a2-function-term
           function 'y precision))
         (input-distance
          (putnam-1962-a2-absolute-term
           (putnam-1962-a2-subtract-term 'x 'y)))
         (output-distance
          (putnam-1962-a2-absolute-term
           (putnam-1962-a2-subtract-term left right))))
    (list
     'lambda
     '(bound x y epsilon)
     (putnam-1962-a2-implies-term
      (putnam-1962-a2-and-terms
       (list
        (putnam-1962-a2-positive-rational-term 'bound)
        (putnam-1962-a2-bounded-rational-term 'x 'bound)
        (putnam-1962-a2-bounded-rational-term 'y 'bound)
        (putnam-1962-a2-positive-rational-term 'epsilon)
        (putnam-1962-a2-positive-rational-term delta)
        (list '< input-distance delta)))
      (putnam-1962-a2-and-terms
       (list
        (list 'rationalp left)
        (list 'rationalp right)
        (putnam-1962-a2-less-equal-term
         output-distance 'epsilon)))))))

(defun putnam-1962-a2-continuity-witness-p
    (function modulus)
  (and
   (tamep-functionp modulus)
   (fn-equal
    (putnam-1962-a2-modulus-positive-matrix modulus)
    (putnam-1962-a2-true-function
     '(bound epsilon)))
   (fn-equal
    (putnam-1962-a2-continuity-matrix
     function modulus)
    (putnam-1962-a2-true-function
     '(bound x y epsilon)))))

(defun putnam-1962-a2-continuity-failure-function
    (function)
  (list
   'lambda
   '(modulus)
   (list
    'if
    (list
     'putnam-1962-a2-continuity-witness-p
     (putnam-1962-a2-quoted function)
     'modulus)
    (putnam-1962-a2-quoted nil)
    (putnam-1962-a2-quoted t))))

(defun putnam-1962-a2-continuous-p (function)
  (let ((failure
         (putnam-1962-a2-continuity-failure-function
          function))
        (always-true
         (putnam-1962-a2-true-function '(modulus))))
    (and
     (tamep-functionp failure)
     (tamep-functionp always-true)
     (not (fn-equal failure always-true)))))

(defun putnam-1962-a2-nonnegative-matrix (function)
  (let ((value
         (putnam-1962-a2-function-term
          function 'x 'epsilon)))
    (list
     'lambda
     '(x epsilon)
     (putnam-1962-a2-implies-term
      (putnam-1962-a2-and-terms
       (list
        (list 'rationalp 'x)
        (putnam-1962-a2-positive-rational-term 'epsilon)))
      (putnam-1962-a2-and-terms
       (list
        (list 'rationalp value)
        (putnam-1962-a2-less-equal-term
         (putnam-1962-a2-negate-term 'epsilon)
         value)))))))

(defun putnam-1962-a2-nonnegative-p (function)
  (fn-equal
   (putnam-1962-a2-nonnegative-matrix function)
   (putnam-1962-a2-true-function '(x epsilon))))

(defun putnam-1962-a2-positive-zero-matrix
    (function lower-bound)
  (let ((value
         (putnam-1962-a2-function-term
          function
          (putnam-1962-a2-quoted 0)
          'epsilon)))
    (list
     'lambda
     '(epsilon)
     (putnam-1962-a2-implies-term
      (putnam-1962-a2-positive-rational-term 'epsilon)
      (putnam-1962-a2-and-terms
       (list
        (list 'rationalp value)
        (putnam-1962-a2-less-equal-term
         (putnam-1962-a2-quoted lower-bound)
         (putnam-1962-a2-add-term
          value 'epsilon))))))))

(defun putnam-1962-a2-positive-zero-witness-p
    (function lower-bound)
  (and
   (rationalp lower-bound)
   (< 0 lower-bound)
   (fn-equal
    (putnam-1962-a2-positive-zero-matrix
     function lower-bound)
    (putnam-1962-a2-true-function '(epsilon)))))

(defun putnam-1962-a2-positive-zero-failure-function
    (function)
  (list
   'lambda
   '(lower-bound)
   (list
    'if
    (list
     'putnam-1962-a2-positive-zero-witness-p
     (putnam-1962-a2-quoted function)
     'lower-bound)
    (putnam-1962-a2-quoted nil)
    (putnam-1962-a2-quoted t))))

(defun putnam-1962-a2-positive-at-zero-p (function)
  (let ((failure
         (putnam-1962-a2-positive-zero-failure-function
          function))
        (always-true
         (putnam-1962-a2-true-function '(lower-bound))))
    (and
     (tamep-functionp failure)
     (tamep-functionp always-true)
     (not (fn-equal failure always-true)))))

(defun putnam-1962-a2-real-name-matrix (name)
  (let* ((left
          (putnam-1962-a2-apply-term
           name '(epsilon)))
         (right
          (putnam-1962-a2-apply-term
           name '(eta)))
         (distance
          (putnam-1962-a2-absolute-term
           (putnam-1962-a2-subtract-term
            left right))))
    (list
     'lambda
     '(epsilon eta)
     (putnam-1962-a2-implies-term
      (putnam-1962-a2-and-terms
       (list
        (putnam-1962-a2-positive-rational-term 'epsilon)
        (putnam-1962-a2-positive-rational-term 'eta)))
      (putnam-1962-a2-and-terms
       (list
        (list 'rationalp left)
        (list 'rationalp right)
        (putnam-1962-a2-less-equal-term
         distance
         (putnam-1962-a2-add-term
          'epsilon 'eta))))))))

(defun putnam-1962-a2-real-name-p (name)
  (and
   (tamep-functionp name)
   (fn-equal
    (putnam-1962-a2-real-name-matrix name)
    (putnam-1962-a2-true-function
     '(epsilon eta)))))

(defun putnam-1962-a2-domain-term (x endpoint positive-only)
  (putnam-1962-a2-and-terms
   (append
    (list
     (list 'rationalp x)
     (if positive-only
         (list '< (putnam-1962-a2-quoted 0) x)
       (putnam-1962-a2-less-equal-term
        (putnam-1962-a2-quoted 0) x)))
    (if endpoint
        (list
         (list '< x
               (putnam-1962-a2-quoted endpoint)))
      nil))))

;; SUM$+ keeps the generated universal convergence matrices tame.

(defun putnam-1962-a2-singleton-function ()
  '(lambda (value) (cons value 'nil)))

(defun putnam-1962-a2-index-tuples-term (upper)
  (list
   'collect$
   (putnam-1962-a2-quoted
    (putnam-1962-a2-singleton-function))
   (list

(defun putnam-1962-a2-grid-summand-function (function)
  (let* ((x
          (list 'nth
                (putnam-1962-a2-quoted 0)
                'globals))
         (precision
          (list 'nth
                (putnam-1962-a2-quoted 1)
                'globals))
         (subdivisions
          (list 'nth
                (putnam-1962-a2-quoted 2)
                'globals))
         (index (list 'car 'index-tuple))
         (sample
          (putnam-1962-a2-divide-term
           (putnam-1962-a2-multiply-term x index)
           subdivisions)))
    (list
     'lambda
     '(globals index-tuple)
     (putnam-1962-a2-function-term
      function sample precision))))

(defun putnam-1962-a2-average-term
    (function x precision subdivisions)
  (let ((summand
         (putnam-1962-a2-grid-summand-function
          function)))
    (putnam-1962-a2-divide-term
     (list
      'sum$+
      (putnam-1962-a2-quoted summand)
      (putnam-1962-a2-term-list
       (list x precision subdivisions))
      (putnam-1962-a2-index-tuples-term subdivisions))
     subdivisions)))

(defun putnam-1962-a2-cutoff-positive-matrix
    (cutoff endpoint positive-only)
  (let ((index
         (putnam-1962-a2-apply-term
          cutoff '(x epsilon))))
    (list
     'lambda
     '(x epsilon)
     (putnam-1962-a2-implies-term
      (putnam-1962-a2-and-terms
       (list
        (putnam-1962-a2-domain-term
         'x endpoint positive-only)
        (putnam-1962-a2-positive-rational-term 'epsilon)))
      (putnam-1962-a2-and-terms
       (list
        (list 'natp index)
        (list '< (putnam-1962-a2-quoted 0)
              index)))))))

(defun putnam-1962-a2-average-equation-matrix
    (function endpoint cutoff)
  (let* ((index
          (putnam-1962-a2-apply-term
           cutoff '(x epsilon)))
         (precision
          (putnam-1962-a2-divide-term
           (putnam-1962-a2-quoted 1)
           'stage))
         (average
          (putnam-1962-a2-average-term
           function 'x precision 'stage))
         (at-zero
          (putnam-1962-a2-function-term
           function
           (putnam-1962-a2-quoted 0)
           precision))
         (at-x
          (putnam-1962-a2-function-term
           function 'x precision))
         (residual
          (putnam-1962-a2-subtract-term
           (putnam-1962-a2-multiply-term
            average average)
           (putnam-1962-a2-multiply-term
            at-zero at-x))))
    (list
     'lambda
     '(x epsilon stage)
     (putnam-1962-a2-implies-term
      (putnam-1962-a2-and-terms
       (list
        (putnam-1962-a2-domain-term 'x endpoint t)
        (putnam-1962-a2-positive-rational-term 'epsilon)
        (list 'natp 'stage)
        (list '< (putnam-1962-a2-quoted 0) 'stage)
        (putnam-1962-a2-less-equal-term
         index 'stage)))
      (putnam-1962-a2-and-terms
       (list
        (list 'rationalp average)
        (list 'rationalp at-zero)
        (list 'rationalp at-x)
        (putnam-1962-a2-less-equal-term
         (putnam-1962-a2-absolute-term residual)
         'epsilon)))))))

(defun putnam-1962-a2-average-witness-p
    (function endpoint cutoff)
  (and
   (tamep-functionp cutoff)
   (fn-equal
    (putnam-1962-a2-cutoff-positive-matrix
     cutoff endpoint t)
    (putnam-1962-a2-true-function
     '(x epsilon)))
   (fn-equal
    (putnam-1962-a2-average-equation-matrix
     function endpoint cutoff)
    (putnam-1962-a2-true-function
     '(x epsilon stage)))))

(defun putnam-1962-a2-average-failure-function
    (function endpoint)
  (list
   'lambda
   '(cutoff)
   (list
    'if
    (list
     'putnam-1962-a2-average-witness-p
     (putnam-1962-a2-quoted function)
     (putnam-1962-a2-quoted endpoint)
     'cutoff)
    (putnam-1962-a2-quoted nil)
    (putnam-1962-a2-quoted t))))

(defun putnam-1962-a2-average-condition-p
    (function endpoint)
  (let ((failure
         (putnam-1962-a2-average-failure-function
          function endpoint))
        (always-true
         (putnam-1962-a2-true-function '(cutoff))))
    (and
     (tamep-functionp failure)
     (tamep-functionp always-true)
     (not (fn-equal failure always-true)))))

(defun putnam-1962-a2-family-equation-matrix
    (function endpoint parameter cutoff)
  (let* ((index
          (putnam-1962-a2-apply-term
           cutoff '(x epsilon)))
         (precision
          (putnam-1962-a2-divide-term
           (putnam-1962-a2-quoted 1)
           'stage))
         (at-zero
          (putnam-1962-a2-function-term
           function
           (putnam-1962-a2-quoted 0)
           precision))
         (at-x
          (putnam-1962-a2-function-term
           function 'x precision))
         (c-value
          (putnam-1962-a2-apply-term
           parameter (list precision)))
         (denominator
          (putnam-1962-a2-subtract-term
           (putnam-1962-a2-quoted 1)
           (putnam-1962-a2-multiply-term
            c-value 'x)))
         (residual
          (putnam-1962-a2-subtract-term
           (putnam-1962-a2-multiply-term
            at-x
            (putnam-1962-a2-multiply-term
             denominator denominator))
           at-zero)))
    (list
     'lambda
     '(x epsilon stage)
     (putnam-1962-a2-implies-term
      (putnam-1962-a2-and-terms
       (list
        (putnam-1962-a2-domain-term 'x endpoint nil)
        (putnam-1962-a2-positive-rational-term 'epsilon)
        (list 'natp 'stage)
        (list '< (putnam-1962-a2-quoted 0) 'stage)
        (putnam-1962-a2-less-equal-term
         index 'stage)))
      (putnam-1962-a2-and-terms
       (list
        (list 'rationalp at-zero)
        (list 'rationalp at-x)
        (list 'rationalp c-value)
        (putnam-1962-a2-less-equal-term
         (putnam-1962-a2-absolute-term residual)
         'epsilon)))))))

(defun putnam-1962-a2-family-witness-p
    (witness function endpoint)
  (and
   (true-listp witness)
   (equal (len witness) 2)
   (let ((parameter (nth 0 witness))
         (cutoff (nth 1 witness)))
     (and
      (putnam-1962-a2-real-name-p parameter)
      (tamep-functionp cutoff)
      (fn-equal
       (putnam-1962-a2-cutoff-positive-matrix
        cutoff endpoint nil)
       (putnam-1962-a2-true-function
        '(x epsilon)))
      (fn-equal
       (putnam-1962-a2-family-equation-matrix
        function endpoint parameter cutoff)
       (putnam-1962-a2-true-function
        '(x epsilon stage)))))))

(defun putnam-1962-a2-family-failure-function
    (function endpoint)
  (list
   'lambda
   '(witness)
   (list
    'if
    (list
     'putnam-1962-a2-family-witness-p
     'witness
     (putnam-1962-a2-quoted function)
     (putnam-1962-a2-quoted endpoint))
    (putnam-1962-a2-quoted nil)
    (putnam-1962-a2-quoted t))))

(defun putnam-1962-a2-family-exists-p
    (function endpoint)
  (let ((failure
         (putnam-1962-a2-family-failure-function
          function endpoint))
        (always-true
         (putnam-1962-a2-true-function '(witness))))
    (and
     (tamep-functionp failure)
     (tamep-functionp always-true)
     (not (fn-equal failure always-true)))))

;; NIL denotes the infinite interval. A positive rational ENDPOINT denotes
;; [0,ENDPOINT). Universal closure over FUNCTION and ENDPOINT is the
;; nondegenerate core of both directions of the source classification.
(defun putnambench-putnam-1962-a2-statement
    (function endpoint)
  (implies
   (and
    (putnam-1962-a2-function-cauchy-p function)
    (putnam-1962-a2-continuous-p function)
    (putnam-1962-a2-nonnegative-p function)
    (putnam-1962-a2-positive-at-zero-p function))
   (and
    (iff
     (putnam-1962-a2-average-condition-p function nil)
     (putnam-1962-a2-family-exists-p function nil))
    (implies
     (and (rationalp endpoint)
          (< 0 endpoint))
     (iff
      (putnam-1962-a2-average-condition-p
       function endpoint)
      (putnam-1962-a2-family-exists-p
       function endpoint))))))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

title: putnam_1962_a2
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1962_a2:
-- classification of nonnegative real functions whose interval average from
-- zero is the geometric mean of the endpoint values.
-- This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module Main where

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_)

infix 4 _!=_ _<=N_
infixr 3 _and_
infixr 2 _or_

data Bottom : Set where

Not : Set -> Set
Not A = A -> Bottom

Not1 : Set1 -> Set1
Not1 A = A -> Bottom

_!=_ : {A : Set} -> A -> A -> Set
x != y = Not (x == y)

record Top : Set where
  constructor top

record _and_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data _or_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  left  : A -> A or B
  right : B -> A or B

record Iff (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor equivalence
  field
    forward  : A -> B
    backward : B -> A

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

record Exists1 (A : Set) (P : A -> Set1) : Set1 where
  constructor witness1
  field
    value1    : A
    property1 : P value1

data _<=N_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set where
  zero<=   : {n : Nat} -> zero <=N n
  suc<=suc : {m n : Nat} -> m <=N n -> suc m <=N suc n

Predicate : Set -> Set1
Predicate A = A -> Set

emptySet :
  {A : Set} ->
  Predicate A
emptySet _ =
  Bottom

wholeSet :
  {A : Set} ->
  Predicate A
wholeSet _ =
  Top

complement :
  {A : Set} ->
  Predicate A ->
  Predicate A
complement S x =
  Not (S x)

countableUnion :
  {A : Set} ->
  (Nat -> Predicate A) ->
  Predicate A
countableUnion sets x =
  Exists Nat (\ n -> sets n x)

Subset :
  {A : Set} ->
  Predicate A ->
  Predicate A ->
  Set
Subset {A} S T =
  (x : A) -> S x -> T x

PairwiseDisjoint :
  {A : Set} ->
  (Nat -> Predicate A) ->
  Set
PairwiseDisjoint {A} sets =
  (i j : Nat) ->
  i != j ->
  (x : A) ->
  sets i x ->
  sets j x ->
  Bottom

record CompleteOrderedField (R : Set) : Set1 where
  field
    zeroR oneR : R
    add multiply : R -> R -> R
    negate inverse : R -> R
    lessOrEqual : R -> R -> Set
    fromNat : Nat -> R

    one-not-zero :
      oneR != zeroR

    add-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> add x y == add y x
    add-associative :
      (x y z : R) -> add (add x y) z == add x (add y z)
    add-zero :
      (x : R) -> add x zeroR == x
    add-inverse :
      (x : R) -> add x (negate x) == zeroR

    multiply-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> multiply x y == multiply y x
    multiply-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply (multiply x y) z == multiply x (multiply y z)
    multiply-one :
      (x : R) -> multiply x oneR == x
    multiply-zero :
      (x : R) -> multiply x zeroR == zeroR
    distribute :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply x (add y z) ==
      add (multiply x y) (multiply x z)
    inverse-zero :
      inverse zeroR == zeroR
    multiply-inverse :
      (x : R) ->
      x != zeroR ->
      multiply x (inverse x) == oneR

    order-reflexive :
      (x : R) -> lessOrEqual x x
    order-transitive :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y z ->
      lessOrEqual x z
    order-antisymmetric :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y x ->
      x == y
    order-total :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y or lessOrEqual y x
    add-order :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual (add z x) (add z y)
    multiply-nonnegative :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR x ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR y ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR (multiply x y)
    zero-less-than-one :
      lessOrEqual zeroR oneR and zeroR != oneR

    fromNat-zero :
      fromNat zero == zeroR
    fromNat-successor :
      (n : Nat) -> fromNat (suc n) == add (fromNat n) oneR
    fromNat-addition :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m + n) == add (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-injective :
      (m n : Nat) -> fromNat m == fromNat n -> m == n

    archimedean :
      (x : R) ->
      Exists Nat (\ n -> lessOrEqual x (fromNat n))
    least-upper-bound :
      (P : Predicate R) ->
      Exists R P ->
      Exists R
        (\ upper ->
          (x : R) -> P x -> lessOrEqual x upper) ->
      Exists R
        (\ supremum ->
          ((x : R) -> P x -> lessOrEqual x supremum)
          and
          ((upper : R) ->
            ((x : R) -> P x -> lessOrEqual x upper) ->
            lessOrEqual supremum upper))

open CompleteOrderedField

subtract :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
subtract reals x y =
  add reals x (negate reals y)

divide :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
divide reals x y =
  multiply reals x (inverse reals y)

square :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  R
square reals x =
  multiply reals x x

StrictLess :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
StrictLess reals x y =
  lessOrEqual reals x y and x != y

CloseTo :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
CloseTo reals center radius x =
  StrictLess reals
    (subtract reals center radius)
    x
  and
  StrictLess reals
    x
    (add reals center radius)

SequentialLimit :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  R ->
  Set
SequentialLimit {R} reals sequence limit =
  (epsilon : R) ->
  StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) epsilon ->
  Exists Nat
    (\ cutoff ->
      (n : Nat) ->
      cutoff <=N n ->
      CloseTo reals limit epsilon (sequence n))

sumFirst :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  Nat ->
  R
sumFirst reals terms zero =
  zeroR reals
sumFirst reals terms (suc n) =
  add reals
    (sumFirst reals terms n)
    (terms n)

record StandardRealAnalysis (R : Set) : Set1 where
  field
    algebra : CompleteOrderedField R
    squareRoot : R -> R
    positivePart : R -> R

    square-root-nonnegative :
      (x : R) ->
      lessOrEqual algebra (zeroR algebra) (squareRoot x)
    square-root-square :
      (x : R) ->
      lessOrEqual algebra (zeroR algebra) x ->
      square algebra (squareRoot x) == x
    square-root-nonpositive :
      (x : R) ->
      lessOrEqual algebra x (zeroR algebra) ->
      squareRoot x == zeroR algebra
    square-root-unique :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual algebra (zeroR algebra) y ->
      square algebra y == x ->
      squareRoot x == y

    positive-part-nonnegative :
      (x : R) ->
      lessOrEqual algebra (zeroR algebra) (positivePart x)
    positive-part-of-nonnegative :
      (x : R) ->
      lessOrEqual algebra (zeroR algebra) x ->
      positivePart x == x
    positive-part-of-nonpositive :
      (x : R) ->
      lessOrEqual algebra x (zeroR algebra) ->
      positivePart x == zeroR algebra

open StandardRealAnalysis

HalfOpen :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Predicate R
HalfOpen reals lower upper x =
  lessOrEqual reals lower x
  and
  StrictLess reals x upper

data BorelCode
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) : Set where
  emptyB          : BorelCode reals
  openRayB        : R -> BorelCode reals
  complementB     : BorelCode reals -> BorelCode reals
  countableUnionB : (Nat -> BorelCode reals) -> BorelCode reals

decodeBorel :
  {R : Set} ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) ->
  BorelCode reals ->
  Predicate R
decodeBorel reals emptyB =
  emptySet
decodeBorel reals (openRayB endpoint) x =
  StrictLess reals endpoint x
decodeBorel reals (complementB code) =
  complement (decodeBorel reals code)
decodeBorel reals (countableUnionB codes) =
  countableUnion (\ n -> decodeBorel reals (codes n))

LocallyNull :
  {R : Set} ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) ->
  (R -> R -> Predicate R -> R) ->
  Predicate R ->
  Set
LocallyNull reals intervalMeasure N =
  (lower upper : _) ->
  lessOrEqual reals lower upper ->
  intervalMeasure lower upper N == zeroR reals

record CompletedBorelWitness
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R)
  (intervalMeasure : R -> R -> Predicate R -> R)
  (S : Predicate R) : Set where
  field
    representative : BorelCode reals
    nullEnvelope : BorelCode reals
    null-envelope-locally-null :
      LocallyNull reals intervalMeasure
        (decodeBorel reals nullEnvelope)
    agrees-off-null :
      (x : R) ->
      Not (decodeBorel reals nullEnvelope x) ->
      Iff (S x) (decodeBorel reals representative x)

open CompletedBorelWitness

record BorelIntervalMeasureLaws
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R)
  (intervalMeasure : R -> R -> Predicate R -> R) : Set1 where
  field
    borel-measure-congruent :
      (lower upper : R) ->
      (S T : Predicate R) ->
      ((x : R) -> Iff (S x) (T x)) ->
      intervalMeasure lower upper S ==
      intervalMeasure lower upper T
    borel-measure-empty :
      (lower upper : R) ->
      intervalMeasure lower upper emptySet == zeroR reals
    borel-measure-nonnegative :
      (lower upper : R) ->
      lessOrEqual reals lower upper ->
      (code : BorelCode reals) ->
      lessOrEqual reals
        (zeroR reals)
        (intervalMeasure lower upper (decodeBorel reals code))
    borel-measure-restricted :
      (lower upper : R) ->
      (S : Predicate R) ->
      intervalMeasure lower upper S ==
      intervalMeasure lower upper
        (\ x -> S x and HalfOpen reals lower upper x)
    borel-measure-half-open :
      (lower upper start endpoint : R) ->
      lessOrEqual reals lower start ->
      lessOrEqual reals start endpoint ->
      lessOrEqual reals endpoint upper ->
      intervalMeasure lower upper
        (HalfOpen reals start endpoint) ==
      subtract reals endpoint start
    borel-measure-countable-additivity :
      (lower upper : R) ->
      lessOrEqual reals lower upper ->
      (codes : Nat -> BorelCode reals) ->
      PairwiseDisjoint
        (\ n -> decodeBorel reals (codes n)) ->
      SequentialLimit reals
        (\ count ->
          sumFirst reals
            (\ n ->
              intervalMeasure lower upper
                (decodeBorel reals (codes n)))
            count)
        (intervalMeasure lower upper
          (decodeBorel reals (countableUnionB codes)))

record RestrictedLebesgueMeasure
  {R : Set}
  (analysis : StandardRealAnalysis R) : Set1 where
  private
    reals = algebra analysis

  field
    intervalMeasure : R -> R -> Predicate R -> R
    measurable : Predicate R -> Set
    measureFromZero : R -> Predicate R -> R

    measure-from-zero :
      (upper : R) ->
      (S : Predicate R) ->
      measureFromZero upper S ==
      intervalMeasure (zeroR reals) upper S
    measurable-exact :
      (S : Predicate R) ->
      Iff
        (measurable S)
        (CompletedBorelWitness reals intervalMeasure S)
    borel-measure-laws :
      BorelIntervalMeasureLaws reals intervalMeasure
    borel-measure-unique :
      (candidate : R -> R -> Predicate R -> R) ->
      BorelIntervalMeasureLaws reals candidate ->
      (lower upper : R) ->
      lessOrEqual reals lower upper ->
      (code : BorelCode reals) ->
      candidate lower upper (decodeBorel reals code) ==
      intervalMeasure lower upper (decodeBorel reals code)
    interval-measure-completion :
      (lower upper : R) ->
      lessOrEqual reals lower upper ->
      (S : Predicate R) ->
      (completion :
        CompletedBorelWitness reals intervalMeasure S) ->
      intervalMeasure lower upper S ==
      intervalMeasure lower upper
        (decodeBorel reals (representative completion))

    measurable-empty :
      measurable emptySet
    measurable-complement :
      (S : Predicate R) ->
      measurable S ->
      measurable (complement S)
    measurable-countable-union :
      (sets : Nat -> Predicate R) ->
      ((n : Nat) -> measurable (sets n)) ->
      measurable (countableUnion sets)
    measurable-congruent :
      (S T : Predicate R) ->
      ((x : R) -> Iff (S x) (T x)) ->
      measurable S ->
      measurable T
    measurable-half-open :
      (lower upper : R) ->
      measurable (HalfOpen reals lower upper)
    measurable-open-ray :
      (endpoint : R) ->
      measurable (\ x -> StrictLess reals endpoint x)
    complete-on-null-sets :
      (upper : R) ->
      lessOrEqual reals (zeroR reals) upper ->
      (N S : Predicate R) ->
      measurable N ->
      measureFromZero upper N == zeroR reals ->
      Subset S N ->
      measurable
        (\ x ->
          S x
          and
          HalfOpen reals (zeroR reals) upper x)

    measure-congruent :
      (upper : R) ->
      (S T : Predicate R) ->
      ((x : R) -> Iff (S x) (T x)) ->
      measureFromZero upper S == measureFromZero upper T
    measure-empty :
      (upper : R) ->
      measureFromZero upper emptySet == zeroR reals
    measure-nonnegative :
      (upper : R) ->
      lessOrEqual reals (zeroR reals) upper ->
      (S : Predicate R) ->
      measurable S ->
      lessOrEqual reals
        (zeroR reals)
        (measureFromZero upper S)
    measure-restricted :
      (upper : R) ->
      (S : Predicate R) ->
      measureFromZero upper S ==
      measureFromZero upper
        (\ x -> S x and HalfOpen reals (zeroR reals) upper x)
    measure-half-open :
      (upper lower endpoint : R) ->
      lessOrEqual reals (zeroR reals) lower ->
      lessOrEqual reals lower endpoint ->
      lessOrEqual reals endpoint upper ->
      measureFromZero upper (HalfOpen reals lower endpoint) ==
      subtract reals endpoint lower
    measure-countable-additivity :
      (upper : R) ->
      lessOrEqual reals (zeroR reals) upper ->
      (sets : Nat -> Predicate R) ->
      ((n : Nat) -> measurable (sets n)) ->
      PairwiseDisjoint sets ->
      SequentialLimit reals
        (\ count ->
          sumFirst reals
            (\ n -> measureFromZero upper (sets n))
            count)
        (measureFromZero upper (countableUnion sets))

open RestrictedLebesgueMeasure

record NonnegativeSimpleBelow
  {R : Set}
  (analysis : StandardRealAnalysis R)
  (lebesgue : RestrictedLebesgueMeasure analysis)
  (upper : R)
  (function : R -> R) : Set1 where
  private
    reals = algebra analysis

  field
    cutoff : Nat
    values : Nat -> R
    pieces : Nat -> Predicate R

    values-nonnegative :
      (i : Nat) ->
      i <=N cutoff ->
      lessOrEqual reals (zeroR reals) (values i)
    pieces-measurable :
      (i : Nat) ->
      i <=N cutoff ->
      measurable lebesgue (pieces i)
    pieces-disjoint :
      (i j : Nat) ->
      i <=N cutoff ->
      j <=N cutoff ->
      i != j ->
      (x : R) ->
      pieces i x ->
      pieces j x ->
      Bottom
    pieces-inside-interval :
      (i : Nat) ->
      i <=N cutoff ->
      Subset
        (pieces i)
        (HalfOpen reals (zeroR reals) upper)
    below-function :
      (i : Nat) ->
      i <=N cutoff ->
      (x : R) ->
      pieces i x ->
      lessOrEqual reals (values i) (function x)

open NonnegativeSimpleBelow

simpleIntegral :
  {R : Set} ->
  (analysis : StandardRealAnalysis R) ->
  (lebesgue : RestrictedLebesgueMeasure analysis) ->
  {upper : R} ->
  {function : R -> R} ->
  NonnegativeSimpleBelow analysis lebesgue upper function ->
  R
simpleIntegral analysis lebesgue {upper = upper} simple =
  sumFirst (algebra analysis)
    (\ i ->
      multiply (algebra analysis)
        (values simple i)
        (measureFromZero lebesgue
          upper
          (pieces simple i)))
    (suc (cutoff simple))

data ExtendedNonnegative
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) : Set where
  finiteE   : R -> ExtendedNonnegative reals
  infinityE : ExtendedNonnegative reals

NonnegativeExtended :
  {R : Set} ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) ->
  ExtendedNonnegative reals ->
  Set
NonnegativeExtended reals (finiteE value) =
  lessOrEqual reals (zeroR reals) value
NonnegativeExtended reals infinityE =
  Top

LessOrEqualE :
  {R : Set} ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) ->
  ExtendedNonnegative reals ->
  ExtendedNonnegative reals ->
  Set
LessOrEqualE reals (finiteE x) (finiteE y) =
  lessOrEqual reals x y
LessOrEqualE reals (finiteE x) infinityE =
  Top
LessOrEqualE reals infinityE (finiteE y) =
  Bottom
LessOrEqualE reals infinityE infinityE =
  Top

RealBelowE :
  {R : Set} ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) ->
  R ->
  ExtendedNonnegative reals ->
  Set
RealBelowE reals x (finiteE y) =
  lessOrEqual reals x y
RealBelowE reals x infinityE =
  Top

record LowerLebesgueIntegralValue
  {R : Set}
  (analysis : StandardRealAnalysis R)
  (lebesgue : RestrictedLebesgueMeasure analysis)
  (upper : R)
  (function : R -> R)
  (value : ExtendedNonnegative (algebra analysis)) : Set1 where
  private
    reals = algebra analysis

  field
    value-nonnegative :
      NonnegativeExtended reals value
    simple-integrals-below :
      (simple :
        NonnegativeSimpleBelow
          analysis lebesgue upper function) ->
      RealBelowE reals
        (simpleIntegral analysis lebesgue simple)
        value
    least-upper-bound :
      (bound : ExtendedNonnegative reals) ->
      ((simple :
          NonnegativeSimpleBelow
            analysis lebesgue upper function) ->
        RealBelowE reals
          (simpleIntegral analysis lebesgue simple)
          bound) ->
      LessOrEqualE reals value bound

positivePartFunction :
  {R : Set} ->
  StandardRealAnalysis R ->
  (R -> R) ->
  R ->
  R
positivePartFunction analysis function x =
  positivePart analysis (function x)

negativePartFunction :
  {R : Set} ->
  StandardRealAnalysis R ->
  (R -> R) ->
  R ->
  R
negativePartFunction analysis function x =
  positivePart analysis
    (negate (algebra analysis) (function x))

MeasurableOnFromZero :
  {R : Set} ->
  (analysis : StandardRealAnalysis R) ->
  RestrictedLebesgueMeasure analysis ->
  R ->
  (R -> R) ->
  Set
MeasurableOnFromZero analysis lebesgue upper function =
  (threshold : _) ->
  measurable lebesgue
    (\ x ->
      HalfOpen
        (algebra analysis)
        (zeroR (algebra analysis))
        upper
        x
      and
      StrictLess
        (algebra analysis)
        threshold
        (function x))

record FiniteLowerIntegralValue
  {R : Set}
  (analysis : StandardRealAnalysis R)
  (lowerIntegral :
    (R -> R) ->
    R ->
    ExtendedNonnegative (algebra analysis))
  (upper : R)
  (function : R -> R)
  (value : R) : Set where
  private
    reals = algebra analysis

  field
    finite-value-nonnegative :
      lessOrEqual reals (zeroR reals) value
    finite-value-equation :
      lowerIntegral function upper == finiteE value

record IntegrableIntervalValue
  {R : Set}
  (analysis : StandardRealAnalysis R)
  (lebesgue : RestrictedLebesgueMeasure analysis)
  (lowerIntegral :
    (R -> R) ->
    R ->
    ExtendedNonnegative (algebra analysis))
  (upper : R)
  (function : R -> R)
  (value : R) : Set1 where
  private
    reals = algebra analysis

  field
    measurable-on-interval :
      MeasurableOnFromZero analysis lebesgue upper function
    positive-integral negative-integral : R
    positive-part-finite :
      FiniteLowerIntegralValue
        analysis lowerIntegral upper
        (positivePartFunction analysis function)
        positive-integral
    negative-part-finite :
      FiniteLowerIntegralValue
        analysis lowerIntegral upper
        (negativePartFunction analysis function)
        negative-integral
    signed-value :
      value ==
      subtract reals positive-integral negative-integral

data TotalizedLebesgueIntegralValue
  {R : Set}
  (analysis : StandardRealAnalysis R)
  (lebesgue : RestrictedLebesgueMeasure analysis)
  (lowerIntegral :
    (R -> R) ->
    R ->
    ExtendedNonnegative (algebra analysis))
  (upper : R)
  (function : R -> R)
  (value : R) : Set1 where
  integrable-value :
    IntegrableIntervalValue
      analysis lebesgue lowerIntegral upper function value ->
    TotalizedLebesgueIntegralValue
      analysis lebesgue lowerIntegral upper function value
  nonintegrable-value :
    Not1
      (Exists1 R
        (\ candidate ->
          IntegrableIntervalValue
            analysis lebesgue lowerIntegral
            upper function candidate)) ->
    value == zeroR (algebra analysis) ->
    TotalizedLebesgueIntegralValue
      analysis lebesgue lowerIntegral upper function value

-- In the standard real model, these fields are the completed-Borel Lebesgue
-- lower integral and its usual real-valued totalization, which is zero when
-- the function is not integrable.
record LebesgueIntervalIntegration
  {R : Set}
  (analysis : StandardRealAnalysis R)
  (lebesgue : RestrictedLebesgueMeasure analysis) : Set1 where
  private
    reals = algebra analysis

  field
    lowerIntegral :
      (R -> R) ->
      R ->
      ExtendedNonnegative reals
    integralFromZero : (R -> R) -> R -> R
    lower-integral-definition :
      (function : R -> R) ->
      ((x : R) ->
        lessOrEqual reals (zeroR reals) (function x)) ->
      (upper : R) ->
      lessOrEqual reals (zeroR reals) upper ->
      LowerLebesgueIntegralValue
        analysis lebesgue upper function
        (lowerIntegral function upper)
    lower-integral-unique :
      (function : R -> R) ->
      ((x : R) ->
        lessOrEqual reals (zeroR reals) (function x)) ->
      (upper : R) ->
      lessOrEqual reals (zeroR reals) upper ->
      (value : ExtendedNonnegative reals) ->
      LowerLebesgueIntegralValue
        analysis lebesgue upper function value ->
      lowerIntegral function upper == value
    totalized-integral-definition :
      (function : R -> R) ->
      (upper : R) ->
      lessOrEqual reals (zeroR reals) upper ->
      TotalizedLebesgueIntegralValue
        analysis lebesgue lowerIntegral upper function
        (integralFromZero function upper)
    totalized-integral-unique :
      (function : R -> R) ->
      (upper : R) ->
      lessOrEqual reals (zeroR reals) upper ->
      (value : R) ->
      TotalizedLebesgueIntegralValue
        analysis lebesgue lowerIntegral upper function value ->
      integralFromZero function upper == value

open LebesgueIntervalIntegration

module Putnam1962A2Statement
  {R : Set}
  (analysis : StandardRealAnalysis R)
  (lebesgue : RestrictedLebesgueMeasure analysis)
  (integration : LebesgueIntervalIntegration analysis lebesgue) where

  reals : CompleteOrderedField R
  reals =
    algebra analysis

  NonnegativeFunction : (R -> R) -> Set
  NonnegativeFunction f =
    (x : R) ->
    lessOrEqual reals (zeroR reals) (f x)

  InfinitePositiveInterval : Predicate R
  InfinitePositiveInterval x =
    StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) x

  FinitePositiveInterval : R -> Predicate R
  FinitePositiveInterval endpoint x =
    StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) x
    and
    StrictLess reals x endpoint

  InfiniteClosedInterval : Predicate R
  InfiniteClosedInterval x =
    lessOrEqual reals (zeroR reals) x

  FiniteHalfOpenInterval : R -> Predicate R
  FiniteHalfOpenInterval endpoint =
    HalfOpen reals (zeroR reals) endpoint

  EqOn :
    (R -> R) ->
    (R -> R) ->
    Predicate R ->
    Set
  EqOn f g domain =
    (x : R) ->
    domain x ->
    f x == g x

  IntervalCondition :
    Predicate R ->
    (R -> R) ->
    Set
  IntervalCondition domain f =
    NonnegativeFunction f
    and
    ((x : R) ->
      domain x ->
      divide reals
        (integralFromZero integration f x)
        x
      ==
      squareRoot analysis
        (multiply reals (f (zeroR reals)) (f x)))

  RationalSquareValue : R -> R -> R -> R
  RationalSquareValue a c x =
    divide reals
      a
      (square reals
        (subtract reals
          (oneR reals)
          (multiply reals c x)))

  GlobalRationalSquareFamily : (R -> R) -> Set
  GlobalRationalSquareFamily f =
    Exists R
      (\ a ->
        Exists R
          (\ c ->
            lessOrEqual reals (zeroR reals) a
            and
            ((x : R) ->
              f x ==
              RationalSquareValue a c x)))

  TruncatedRationalSquareFamily : (R -> R) -> Set
  TruncatedRationalSquareFamily f =
    Exists R
      (\ a ->
        Exists R
          (\ c ->
            lessOrEqual reals (zeroR reals) a
            and
            StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) c
            and
            ((x : R) ->
              let cutoff = divide reals (oneR reals) c
              in
              (StrictLess reals x cutoff
                and
                f x == RationalSquareValue a c x)
              or
              (lessOrEqual reals cutoff x
                and
                f x == zeroR reals))))

  PositiveRayZeroFamily : (R -> R) -> Set
  PositiveRayZeroFamily f =
    NonnegativeFunction f
    and
    ((x : R) ->
      StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) x ->
      f x == zeroR reals)

  InitialAverageZeroFamily : (R -> R) -> Set
  InitialAverageZeroFamily f =
    Exists R
      (\ endpoint ->
        StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) endpoint
        and
        f (zeroR reals) == zeroR reals
        and
        NonnegativeFunction f
        and
        ((x : R) ->
          FinitePositiveInterval endpoint x ->
          divide reals
            (integralFromZero integration f x)
            x
          ==
          zeroR reals))

  PutnamSolutionFamily : (R -> R) -> Set
  PutnamSolutionFamily f =
    GlobalRationalSquareFamily f

  proposition : Set
  proposition =
    ((f : R -> R) ->
      (IntervalCondition InfinitePositiveInterval f ->
        Exists (R -> R)
          (\ g ->
            PutnamSolutionFamily g
            and
            EqOn f g InfiniteClosedInterval))
      and
      ((endpoint : R) ->
        StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) endpoint ->
        IntervalCondition (FinitePositiveInterval endpoint) f ->
        Exists (R -> R)
          (\ g ->
            PutnamSolutionFamily g
            and
            EqOn f g (FiniteHalfOpenInterval endpoint))))
    and
    ((f : R -> R) ->
      PutnamSolutionFamily f ->
      IntervalCondition InfinitePositiveInterval f
      or
      Exists R
        (\ endpoint ->
          StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) endpoint
          and
          IntervalCondition
            (FinitePositiveInterval endpoint)
            f))

putnam-1962-a2 : Set1
putnam-1962-a2 =
  (R : Set) ->
  (analysis : StandardRealAnalysis R) ->
  (lebesgue : RestrictedLebesgueMeasure analysis) ->
  (integration : LebesgueIntervalIntegration analysis lebesgue) ->
  Putnam1962A2Statement.proposition
    analysis lebesgue integration

title: putnam_1962_a2
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench artifact putnam_1962_a2:
  classification of nonnegative real functions whose average on each interval
  from zero is the geometric mean of their endpoint values. The solution is
  the published rational-square family. This file contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open pred_setTheory realTheory transcTheory;
open extrealTheory measureTheory lebesgueTheory lebesgue_measureTheory;

val putnam_1962_a2 =
  ``let interval_average =
      \f x.
        let restricted =
          \t : real.
            Normal (f t) * indicator_fn (interval [0, x]) t
        in
          if lebesgue$integrable lebesgue restricted then
            real (lebesgue$integral lebesgue restricted) / x
          else
            0
    in
    let solution =
      \g : real -> real.
        ?a c : real.
          0 <= a /\
          g = (\x. a / (1 - c * x) pow 2)
    in
    let has_average_property =
      \s (f : real -> real).
        (!x : real. 0 <= f x) /\
        (!x : real.
           x IN s ==>
           interval_average f x = sqrt (f 0 * f x))
    in
      (!f : real -> real.
         (has_average_property {x : real | 0 < x} f ==>
          ?g : real -> real.
            solution g /\
            !x : real. 0 <= x ==> f x = g x) /\
         (!e : real.
            0 < e /\
            has_average_property {x : real | 0 < x /\ x < e} f
            ==>
            ?g : real -> real.
              solution g /\
              !x : real. 0 <= x /\ x < e ==> f x = g x)) /\
      (!f : real -> real.
         solution f ==>
         has_average_property {x : real | 0 < x} f \/
         ?e : real.
           0 < e /\
           has_average_property {x : real | 0 < x /\ x < e} f)``;

title: putnam_1962_a2
content:
$(
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench artifact putnam_1962_a2:
  classification of nonnegative real functions whose interval average equals
  the geometric mean of their endpoint values. This file contains no proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  P62A2Sol F says that F is a total real function of the form
  a / (1 - c x)^2 with a nonnegative, taking the value zero where the
  denominator vanishes. P62A2P S F says that F is nonnegative on the reals
  and, for every positive x in S, its Lebesgue integral over [0,x], divided
  by x, is sqrt(F(0) F(x)).

  The closed integral interval is equivalent to the half-open interval in
  the Lean source because a singleton has Lebesgue measure zero.
  The final unproved assertion classifies both the positive half-line and
  arbitrary finite intervals with left endpoint zero. There are no $p proof
  statements in this database.
$)

$c P62A2Sol P62A2P $.

p62a2-solution-syntax $a wff ( P62A2Sol F ) $.
p62a2-property-syntax $a wff ( P62A2P S F ) $.

${
  $d a c x F $.
  $d c x $.

  p62a2-solution-definition $a |- (
    ( P62A2Sol F )
    <->
    (
      F : RR --> RR
      /\
      E. a e. RR E. c e. RR
        (
          0 <_ a
          /\
          A. x e. RR
            (
              (
                ( 1 - ( c x. x ) ) = 0
                ->
                ( F ` x ) = 0
              )
              /\
              (
                ( 1 - ( c x. x ) ) =/= 0
                ->
                ( F ` x )
                =
                (
                  a
                  /
                  ( ( 1 - ( c x. x ) ) ^ 2 )
                )
              )
            )
        )
    )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d t x F $.
  $d t x S $.
  $d x F $.
  $d x S $.

  p62a2-property-definition $a |- (
    ( P62A2P S F )
    <->
    (
      F : RR --> RR
      /\
      (
        A. x e. RR 0 <_ ( F ` x )
        /\
        A. x e. S
          (
            0 < x
            ->
            (
              (
                S. ( 0 [,] x ) ( F ` t ) _d t
              )
              /
              x
            )
            =
            (
              sqrt
              `
              ( ( F ` 0 ) x. ( F ` x ) )
            )
          )
      )
    )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d e x F $.
  $d e x G $.
  $d x F G $.

  putnambench-putnam-1962-a2 $a |- (
    (
      A. F
        (
          (
            ( P62A2P { x e. RR | 0 < x } F )
            ->
            E. G
              (
                ( P62A2Sol G )
                /\
                A. x e. { x e. RR | 0 <_ x }
                  ( F ` x ) = ( G ` x )
              )
          )
          /\
          A. e e. RR
            (
              0 < e
              ->
              (
                ( P62A2P { x e. RR | ( 0 < x /\ x < e ) } F )
                ->
                E. G
                  (
                    ( P62A2Sol G )
                    /\
                    A. x e. { x e. RR | ( 0 <_ x /\ x < e ) }
                      ( F ` x ) = ( G ` x )
                  )
              )
            )
        )
      /\
      A. F
        (
          ( P62A2Sol F )
          ->
          (
            ( P62A2P { x e. RR | 0 < x } F )
            \/
            E. e e. RR
              (
                0 < e
                /\
                ( P62A2P { x e. RR | ( 0 < x /\ x < e ) } F )
              )
          )
        )
    )
  ) $.
$}

      holds ex g being Function of REAL,REAL st

        for x being Real st 0 <= x & x < e holds f.x = g.x)) &
  for f being Function of REAL,REAL st
    (ex a,c being Real st
      0 <= a &
      for x being Real holds f.x = a / (1 - c*x)^2)
    holds
      ((for x being Real holds 0 <= f.x) &
       (for x being Real st 0 < x holds
         ((f|[.0,x.] is_integrable_on L-Meas &
           Integral(L-Meas,f|[.0,x.]) = x * sqrt(f.0 * f.x)) or

      ex e being Real st
        0 < e &
        (for x being Real holds 0 <= f.x) &
        for x being Real st 0 < x & x < e holds
          ((f|[.0,x.] is_integrable_on L-Meas &
            Integral(L-Meas,f|[.0,x.]) = x * sqrt(f.0 * f.x)) or
