title: putnam_1962_a2
content:
% Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench artifact putnam_1962_a2:
% classification of nonnegative real functions whose interval average equals
% the geometric mean of the endpoint values. This file contains no proof.

putnam_1962_a2: THEORY
BEGIN
  real_set: TYPE = [real -> bool]
  real_function: TYPE = [real -> real]
  real_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> real]
  set_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> real_set]

  set_intersection(A, B: real_set): real_set =
    LAMBDA (x: real): A(x) AND B(x)

  set_difference(A, B: real_set): real_set =
    LAMBDA (x: real): A(x) AND NOT B(x)

  bounded(A: real_set): bool =
    EXISTS (bound: nonneg_real):
      FORALL (x: real): A(x) IMPLIES abs(x) <= bound

  partial_sum(values: real_sequence, count: nat): RECURSIVE real =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      partial_sum(values, count - 1) + values(count - 1)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  nonnegative_series_sum(
      values: real_sequence,
      total: real): bool =
    (FORALL (index: nat): 0 <= values(index))
      AND FORALL (eps: posreal):
        EXISTS (start: nat):
          FORALL (count: nat):
            start <= count IMPLIES
              abs(partial_sum(values, count) - total) < eps

  interval_cover(
      A: real_set,
      lefts, rights: real_sequence): bool =
    (FORALL (index: nat): lefts(index) < rights(index))
      AND FORALL (x: real):
        A(x) IMPLIES
          EXISTS (index: nat):
            lefts(index) < x AND x < rights(index)

  cover_lengths(
      lefts, rights: real_sequence): real_sequence =
    LAMBDA (index: nat): rights(index) - lefts(index)

  finite_cover_total(
      A: real_set,
      lefts, rights: real_sequence,
      total: real): bool =
    interval_cover(A, lefts, rights)
      AND nonnegative_series_sum(
        cover_lengths(lefts, rights), total)

  lebesgue_outer_measure(A: real_set, measure_value: real): bool =
    bounded(A)
      AND 0 <= measure_value
      AND (FORALL
          (lefts, rights: real_sequence),
          (cover_total: real):
        finite_cover_total(A, lefts, rights, cover_total)
          IMPLIES measure_value <= cover_total)
      AND (FORALL (eps: posreal):
        EXISTS
            (lefts, rights: real_sequence),
            (cover_total: real):
          finite_cover_total(A, lefts, rights, cover_total)
            AND cover_total < measure_value + eps)

  lebesgue_measurable(A: real_set): bool =
    FORALL (E: real_set):
      bounded(E) IMPLIES
        EXISTS (whole, inside, outside: real):
          lebesgue_outer_measure(E, whole)
            AND lebesgue_outer_measure(
              set_intersection(E, A), inside)
            AND lebesgue_outer_measure(
              set_difference(E, A), outside)
            AND whole = inside + outside

  outer_measure_value(A: real_set): real =
    epsilon(
      LAMBDA (measure_value: real):
        lebesgue_outer_measure(A, measure_value))

  closed_interval(left, right: real): real_set =
    LAMBDA (x: real): left <= x AND x <= right

  open_interval(left, right: real): real_set =
    LAMBDA (x: real): left < x AND x < right

  positive_reals: real_set =
    LAMBDA (x: real): 0 < x

  measurable_nonnegative_on(
      f: real_function,
      A: real_set): bool =
    (FORALL (x: real): A(x) IMPLIES 0 <= f(x))
      AND FORALL (level: real):
        lebesgue_measurable(
          LAMBDA (x: real): A(x) AND level < f(x))

  simple_value(
      coefficients: real_sequence,
      pieces: set_sequence,
      count: nat,
      x: real): RECURSIVE real =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSIF pieces(count - 1)(x) THEN
      simple_value(coefficients, pieces, count - 1, x)
        + coefficients(count - 1)
    ELSE
      simple_value(coefficients, pieces, count - 1, x)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  simple_integral(
      coefficients: real_sequence,
      pieces: set_sequence,
      count: nat): RECURSIVE real =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      simple_integral(coefficients, pieces, count - 1)
        + coefficients(count - 1)
            * outer_measure_value(pieces(count - 1))
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  valid_simple_minorant(
      f: real_function,
      left, right: real,
      coefficients: real_sequence,
      pieces: set_sequence,
      count: nat): bool =
    left <= right
      AND (FORALL (index: nat):
        index < count IMPLIES
          (0 <= coefficients(index)
            AND lebesgue_measurable(pieces(index))
            AND FORALL (x: real):
              pieces(index)(x) IMPLIES
                closed_interval(left, right)(x)))
      AND (FORALL (first, second: nat):
        first < count AND second < count AND first /= second
          IMPLIES
            FORALL (x: real):
              NOT (pieces(first)(x) AND pieces(second)(x)))
      AND FORALL (x: real):
        closed_interval(left, right)(x) IMPLIES
          simple_value(coefficients, pieces, count, x) <= f(x)

  finite_nonnegative_lebesgue_integral(
      f: real_function,
      left, right, integral_value: real): bool =
    left <= right
      AND measurable_nonnegative_on(
        f, closed_interval(left, right))
      AND 0 <= integral_value
      AND (FORALL
          (coefficients: real_sequence),
          (pieces: set_sequence),
          (count: nat):
        valid_simple_minorant(
          f, left, right, coefficients, pieces, count)
          IMPLIES
            simple_integral(coefficients, pieces, count)
              <= integral_value)
      AND (FORALL (eps: posreal):
        EXISTS
            (coefficients: real_sequence),
            (pieces: set_sequence),
            (count: nat):
          valid_simple_minorant(
            f, left, right, coefficients, pieces, count)
            AND integral_value - eps
              < simple_integral(coefficients, pieces, count))

  interval_lebesgue_integral(
      f: real_function,
      left, right: real): real =
    IF EXISTS (integral_value: real):
        finite_nonnegative_lebesgue_integral(
          f, left, right, integral_value)
    THEN
      epsilon(
        LAMBDA (integral_value: real):
          finite_nonnegative_lebesgue_integral(
            f, left, right, integral_value))
    ELSE
      0
    ENDIF

  nonnegative_square_root(value: real): real =
    IF 0 <= value
    THEN
      epsilon(
        LAMBDA (root: real):
          0 <= root AND root * root = value)
    ELSE
      0
    ENDIF

  nonnegative_function(f: real_function): bool =
    FORALL (x: real): 0 <= f(x)

  inverse_or_zero(value: real): real =
    IF value = 0 THEN 0 ELSE 1 / value ENDIF

  average_geometric_mean_property(
      domain: real_set,
      f: real_function): bool =
    nonnegative_function(f)
      AND FORALL (x: real):
        domain(x) IMPLIES
          inverse_or_zero(x)
            * interval_lebesgue_integral(f, 0, x)
            = nonnegative_square_root(f(0) * f(x))

  solution_function(f: real_function): bool =
    EXISTS (a, c: real):
      0 <= a
        AND FORALL (x: real):
          f(x) =
            a * inverse_or_zero((1 - c * x) ^ 2)

  agree_on(f, g: real_function, domain: real_set): bool =
    FORALL (x: real): domain(x) IMPLIES f(x) = g(x)

  putnam_1962_a2: bool =
    (FORALL (f: real_function):
      (average_geometric_mean_property(positive_reals, f)
        IMPLIES
          EXISTS (g: real_function):
            solution_function(g)
              AND agree_on(
                f, g, LAMBDA (x: real): 0 <= x))
      AND
      (FORALL (endpoint: real):
        0 < endpoint IMPLIES
          (average_geometric_mean_property(
            open_interval(0, endpoint), f)
            IMPLIES
              EXISTS (g: real_function):
                solution_function(g)
                  AND agree_on(
                    f, g,
                    LAMBDA (x: real):
                      0 <= x AND x < endpoint))))
    AND
    FORALL (f: real_function):
      solution_function(f) IMPLIES
        (average_geometric_mean_property(positive_reals, f)
          OR EXISTS (endpoint: real):
            0 < endpoint
              AND average_geometric_mean_property(
                open_interval(0, endpoint), f))
END putnam_1962_a2

If $\triangle UVW$ is the triangle formed by parts of segments $\overline{AP}$, $\overline{BQ}$, and $\overline{CR}$, prove that $$\frac{[\triangle UVW]}{[\triangle ABC]} = \frac{(k - 1)^2}{k^2 + k + 1},$$ where $[\triangle]$ denotes the area of the triangle $\triangle$.

(* Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench artifact putnam_1962_a3:
   a triangle's three cevian intersection points have the stated area ratio
   when the side-division ratios are equal. This file contains no proof. *)

From Stdlib Require Import Reals.

Open Scope R_scope.

Definition point := (R * R)%type.

Definition affine_combination (t : R) (a b : point) : point :=
  ((1 - t) * fst a + t * fst b,
   (1 - t) * snd a + t * snd b).

Definition closed_segment (a b : point) : point -> Prop :=
  fun p =>
    exists t : R,
      0 <= t <= 1 /\
      p = affine_combination t a b.

Definition point_distance (a b : point) : R :=
  sqrt ((fst a - fst b) ^ 2 + (snd a - snd b) ^ 2).

Definition signed_twice_area (a b c : point) : R :=
  (fst b - fst a) * (snd c - snd a) -
  (snd b - snd a) * (fst c - fst a).

Definition noncollinear (a b c : point) : Prop :=
  signed_twice_area a b c <> 0.

Definition triangle_area (a b c : point) : R :=
  Rabs (signed_twice_area a b c) / 2.

Theorem putnam_1962_a3
    (A B C A' B' C' P Q Rpt : point)
    (k : R)
    (hk : k > 0)
    (hABC : noncollinear A B C)
    (hA' : closed_segment B C A' /\
           point_distance C A' / point_distance A' B = k)
    (hB' : closed_segment C A B' /\
           point_distance A B' / point_distance B' C = k)
    (hC' : closed_segment A B C' /\
           point_distance B C' / point_distance C' A = k)
    (hP : closed_segment B B' P /\ closed_segment C C' P)
    (hQ : closed_segment C C' Q /\ closed_segment A A' Q)
    (hR : closed_segment A A' Rpt /\ closed_segment B B' Rpt) :
  triangle_area P Q Rpt / triangle_area A B C =
  (k - 1) ^ 2 / (k ^ 2 + k + 1).
Admitted.

(*
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench artifact putnam_1962_a3:
  the area ratio of the triangle formed by the pairwise intersections of
  three cevians determined by a common positive side-division ratio.
  This file contains no proof.
*)

let statement =
  `let edist =
     \(x:real#real) (y:real#real).
       sqrt ((FST x - FST y) pow 2 + (SND x - SND y) pow 2) in
   let on_segment =
     \(x:real#real) (a:real#real) (b:real#real).
       ?t:real.
         &0 <= t /\ t <= &1 /\
         FST x = (&1 - t) * FST a + t * FST b /\
         SND x = (&1 - t) * SND a + t * SND b in
   let triangle_area =
     \(a:real#real) (b:real#real) (c:real#real).
       abs ((FST b - FST a) * (SND c - SND a) -
            (SND b - SND a) * (FST c - FST a)) / &2 in
   !A B C A' B' C' P Q R:real#real. !k:real.
     &0 < k /\
     ~((FST B - FST A) * (SND C - SND A) =
       (SND B - SND A) * (FST C - FST A)) /\
     on_segment A' B C /\
     edist C A' / edist A' B = k /\
     on_segment B' C A /\
     edist A B' / edist B' C = k /\
     on_segment C' A B /\
     edist B C' / edist C' A = k /\
     on_segment P B B' /\
     on_segment P C C' /\
     on_segment Q C C' /\
     on_segment Q A A' /\
     on_segment R A A' /\
     on_segment R B B'
     ==> triangle_area P Q R / triangle_area A B C =
         (k - &1) pow 2 / (k pow 2 + k + &1)`;;

title: putnam_1962_a3
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench artifact putnam_1962_a3:
;; the area ratio for the triangle formed by pairwise intersections of three
;; cevians whose opposite-side division ratios share a positive constant k.
;; This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

;; ACL2's exact rational plane is bidirectionally equivalent to the source
;; theorem over the real plane. For k > 0 and noncollinear A, B, C, the three
;; side conditions uniquely give
;;   A' = (k B + C)/(k+1), B' = (k C + A)/(k+1),
;;   C' = (k A + B)/(k+1).
;; The pairwise cevian intersections are then unique rational functions of
;; A, B, C, and k, with nonzero denominators k+1 and k^2+k+1. Consequently
;; every real configuration in the hypotheses belongs to this continuous
;; rationally parameterized family. A real counterexample would persist after
;; a small perturbation of A, B, C, and k and hence yield a rational
;; counterexample; conversely every rational configuration is real.

(defun putnam-1962-a3-point-p (point)
  (and (consp point)
       (rationalp (car point))
       (rationalp (cdr point))))

(defun putnam-1962-a3-square (x)
  (* x x))

(defun putnam-1962-a3-orientation (a b c)
  (- (* (- (car b) (car a))
        (- (cdr c) (cdr a)))
     (* (- (cdr b) (cdr a))
        (- (car c) (car a)))))

(defun putnam-1962-a3-distance-squared (a b)
  (+ (putnam-1962-a3-square (- (car b) (car a)))
     (putnam-1962-a3-square (- (cdr b) (cdr a)))))

;; For collinear points, (P-A) dot (P-B) <= 0 is exactly P in [A,B].
(defun putnam-1962-a3-closed-segment-p (p a b)
  (and (equal (putnam-1962-a3-orientation a b p) 0)
       (<= (+ (* (- (car p) (car a))
                  (- (car p) (car b)))
               (* (- (cdr p) (cdr a))
                  (- (cdr p) (cdr b))))
           0)))

(defun putnambench-putnam-1962-a3-statement
    (a b c a-prime b-prime c-prime p q r k)
  (implies
   (and
    (putnam-1962-a3-point-p a)
    (putnam-1962-a3-point-p b)
    (putnam-1962-a3-point-p c)
    (putnam-1962-a3-point-p a-prime)
    (putnam-1962-a3-point-p b-prime)
    (putnam-1962-a3-point-p c-prime)
    (putnam-1962-a3-point-p p)
    (putnam-1962-a3-point-p q)
    (putnam-1962-a3-point-p r)
    (rationalp k)
    (< 0 k)
    (not (equal (putnam-1962-a3-orientation a b c) 0))
    (putnam-1962-a3-closed-segment-p a-prime b c)
    (equal
     (putnam-1962-a3-distance-squared c a-prime)
     (* k k
        (putnam-1962-a3-distance-squared a-prime b)))
    (putnam-1962-a3-closed-segment-p b-prime c a)
    (equal
     (putnam-1962-a3-distance-squared a b-prime)
     (* k k
        (putnam-1962-a3-distance-squared b-prime c)))
    (putnam-1962-a3-closed-segment-p c-prime a b)
    (equal
     (putnam-1962-a3-distance-squared b c-prime)
     (* k k
        (putnam-1962-a3-distance-squared c-prime a)))
    (putnam-1962-a3-closed-segment-p p b b-prime)
    (putnam-1962-a3-closed-segment-p p c c-prime)
    (putnam-1962-a3-closed-segment-p q c c-prime)
    (putnam-1962-a3-closed-segment-p q a a-prime)
    (putnam-1962-a3-closed-segment-p r a a-prime)
    (putnam-1962-a3-closed-segment-p r b b-prime))
   ;; A triangle's planar Lebesgue area is half the absolute orientation.
   ;; Both source denominators are positive, so this is the cross-multiplied
   ;; form of the stated area-ratio equality.
   (equal
    (* (abs (putnam-1962-a3-orientation p q r))
       (+ (* k k) k 1))
    (* (abs (putnam-1962-a3-orientation a b c))
       (putnam-1962-a3-square (- k 1))))))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

title: putnam_1962_a3
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1962_a3:
-- the triangle cut out by three cevians of a real Euclidean triangle has the
-- stated area ratio when the side-division ratios are equal. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc)

infix 4 _!=_
infixr 3 _and_
infixr 2 _or_

data Bottom : Set where

Not : Set -> Set
Not A = A -> Bottom

_!=_ : {A : Set} -> A -> A -> Set
x != y = Not (x == y)

record _and_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data _or_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  left  : A -> A or B
  right : B -> A or B

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

record CompleteOrderedRealField (R : Set) : Set1 where
  field
    zeroR oneR : R
    add multiply : R -> R -> R
    negate inverse squareRoot : R -> R
    lessOrEqual : R -> R -> Set
    fromNat : Nat -> R

    one-not-zero :
      oneR != zeroR

    add-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> add x y == add y x
    add-associative :
      (x y z : R) -> add (add x y) z == add x (add y z)
    add-zero :
      (x : R) -> add x zeroR == x
    add-inverse :
      (x : R) -> add x (negate x) == zeroR

    multiply-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> multiply x y == multiply y x
    multiply-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply (multiply x y) z == multiply x (multiply y z)
    multiply-one :
      (x : R) -> multiply x oneR == x
    multiply-zero :
      (x : R) -> multiply x zeroR == zeroR
    distribute :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply x (add y z) ==
      add (multiply x y) (multiply x z)
    inverse-zero :
      inverse zeroR == zeroR
    multiply-inverse :
      (x : R) ->
      x != zeroR ->
      multiply x (inverse x) == oneR

    order-reflexive :
      (x : R) -> lessOrEqual x x
    order-transitive :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y z ->
      lessOrEqual x z
    order-antisymmetric :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y x ->
      x == y
    order-total :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y or lessOrEqual y x
    add-order :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual (add z x) (add z y)
    multiply-nonnegative :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR x ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR y ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR (multiply x y)
    zero-less-than-one :
      lessOrEqual zeroR oneR and zeroR != oneR

    fromNat-zero :
      fromNat zero == zeroR
    fromNat-successor :
      (n : Nat) -> fromNat (suc n) == add (fromNat n) oneR
    archimedean :
      (x : R) ->
      Exists Nat (\ n -> lessOrEqual x (fromNat n))
    least-upper-bound :
      (P : R -> Set) ->
      Exists R P ->
      Exists R
        (\ upper ->
          (x : R) ->
          P x ->
          lessOrEqual x upper) ->
      Exists R
        (\ supremum ->
          ((x : R) -> P x -> lessOrEqual x supremum)
          and
          ((upper : R) ->
            ((x : R) -> P x -> lessOrEqual x upper) ->
            lessOrEqual supremum upper))

    square-root-nonnegative :
      (x : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR (squareRoot x)
    square-root-square :
      (x : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR x ->
      multiply (squareRoot x) (squareRoot x) == x
    square-root-nonpositive :
      (x : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x zeroR ->
      squareRoot x == zeroR
    square-root-unique :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR y ->
      multiply y y == x ->
      y == squareRoot x

open CompleteOrderedRealField

subtract :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
subtract reals x y =
  add reals x (negate reals y)

divide :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
divide reals x y =
  multiply reals x (inverse reals y)

square :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R
square reals x =
  multiply reals x x

two :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R
two reals =
  add reals (oneR reals) (oneR reals)

half :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R
half reals =
  inverse reals (two reals)

StrictPositive :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  Set
StrictPositive reals x =
  lessOrEqual reals (zeroR reals) x and x != zeroR reals

record Point (R : Set) : Set where
  constructor point
  field
    x-coordinate : R
    y-coordinate : R

open Point

affineCombination :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  Point R ->
  Point R ->
  Point R
affineCombination reals coefficient p q =
  point
    (add reals
      (multiply reals coefficient (x-coordinate p))
      (multiply reals
        (subtract reals (oneR reals) coefficient)
        (x-coordinate q)))
    (add reals
      (multiply reals coefficient (y-coordinate p))
      (multiply reals
        (subtract reals (oneR reals) coefficient)
        (y-coordinate q)))

ClosedSegment :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Point R ->
  Point R ->
  Point R ->
  Set
ClosedSegment {R} reals p q x =
  Exists R
    (\ coefficient ->
      lessOrEqual reals (zeroR reals) coefficient
      and
      lessOrEqual reals coefficient (oneR reals)
      and
      x == affineCombination reals coefficient p q)

doubleSignedArea :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Point R ->
  Point R ->
  Point R ->
  R
doubleSignedArea reals a b c =
  subtract reals
    (multiply reals
      (subtract reals (x-coordinate b) (x-coordinate a))
      (subtract reals (y-coordinate c) (y-coordinate a)))
    (multiply reals
      (subtract reals (y-coordinate b) (y-coordinate a))
      (subtract reals (x-coordinate c) (x-coordinate a)))

Collinear :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Point R ->
  Point R ->
  Point R ->
  Set
Collinear reals a b c =
  doubleSignedArea reals a b c == zeroR reals

squaredDistance :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Point R ->
  Point R ->
  R
squaredDistance reals p q =
  add reals
    (square reals
      (subtract reals (x-coordinate p) (x-coordinate q)))
    (square reals
      (subtract reals (y-coordinate p) (y-coordinate q)))

distance :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Point R ->
  Point R ->
  R
distance reals p q =
  squareRoot reals (squaredDistance reals p q)

triangleArea :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Point R ->
  Point R ->
  Point R ->
  R
triangleArea reals a b c =
  multiply reals
    (half reals)
    (squareRoot reals
      (square reals (doubleSignedArea reals a b c)))

module Putnam1962A3Statement
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) where

  proposition : Set
  proposition =
    (A B C A' B' C' P Q R' : Point R) ->
    (k : R) ->
    StrictPositive reals k ->
    Not (Collinear reals A B C) ->
    (ClosedSegment reals B C A'
      and
      divide reals
        (distance reals C A')
        (distance reals A' B)
      == k) ->
    (ClosedSegment reals C A B'
      and
      divide reals
        (distance reals A B')
        (distance reals B' C)
      == k) ->
    (ClosedSegment reals A B C'
      and
      divide reals
        (distance reals B C')
        (distance reals C' A)
      == k) ->
    (ClosedSegment reals B B' P
      and
      ClosedSegment reals C C' P) ->
    (ClosedSegment reals C C' Q
      and
      ClosedSegment reals A A' Q) ->
    (ClosedSegment reals A A' R'
      and
      ClosedSegment reals B B' R') ->
    divide reals
      (triangleArea reals P Q R')
      (triangleArea reals A B C)
    ==
    divide reals
      (square reals (subtract reals k (oneR reals)))
      (add reals
        (add reals
          (square reals k)
          k)
        (oneR reals))

putnam-1962-a3 : Set1
putnam-1962-a3 =
  (R : Set) ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) ->
  Putnam1962A3Statement.proposition reals

content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench artifact putnam_1962_a3:
  the area ratio of the triangle formed by three cevian intersections in a
  nondegenerate real-plane triangle. This file contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open pairTheory realTheory transcTheory;

val putnam_1962_a3 =
  ``let collinear =
      \P Q R : real # real.
        (FST P - FST R) * (SND Q - SND R) =
        (SND P - SND R) * (FST Q - FST R)
    in
    let in_closed_segment =
      \X U V : real # real.
        ?t : real.
          0 <= t /\ t <= 1 /\
          X = ((1 - t) * FST U + t * FST V,
               (1 - t) * SND U + t * SND V)
    in
    let dist =
      \P Q : real # real.
        sqrt ((FST P - FST Q) pow 2 + (SND P - SND Q) pow 2)
    in
    let triangle_area =
      \A B C : real # real.
        abs ((FST B - FST A) * (SND C - SND A) -
             (SND B - SND A) * (FST C - FST A)) / 2
    in
      !A B C Ap Bp Cp P Q R : real # real. !k : real.
        0 < k /\
        ~collinear A B C /\
        in_closed_segment Ap B C /\
        dist C Ap / dist Ap B = k /\
        in_closed_segment Bp C A /\
        dist A Bp / dist Bp C = k /\
        in_closed_segment Cp A B /\
        dist B Cp / dist Cp A = k /\
        in_closed_segment P B Bp /\
        in_closed_segment P C Cp /\
        in_closed_segment Q C Cp /\
        in_closed_segment Q A Ap /\
        in_closed_segment R A Ap /\
        in_closed_segment R B Bp
        ==>
        triangle_area P Q R / triangle_area A B C =
          (k - 1) pow 2 / (k pow 2 + k + 1)``;

title: putnam_1962_a3
content:
$(
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench artifact putnam_1962_a3:
  the area ratio for the triangle formed by pairwise intersections of three
  cevians whose side points divide a noncollinear real-plane triangle in a
  common positive ratio. This file contains no proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  P62A3R2 is the real coordinate plane. P62A3Dist is Euclidean distance,
  P62A3Segment is the closed affine segment, and P62A3Noncol is determinant
  noncollinearity. P62A3Hull is the convex hull of three points via
  nonnegative barycentric coordinates, and P62A3Area is its planar Lebesgue
  measure through the set.mm finite-dimensional volume function voln.

  The final unproved $a assertion universally quantifies the nine points and
  the positive real ratio, and preserves all side-division, intersection,
  and area-ratio conditions from the Lean and Isabelle sources.
$)

$c P62A3I P62A3R2 P62A3Dist P62A3Segment $.
$c P62A3Noncol P62A3Hull P62A3Area $.

p62a3-index-syntax $a class P62A3I $.
p62a3-plane-syntax $a class P62A3R2 $.
p62a3-distance-syntax $a class ( P62A3Dist A B ) $.
p62a3-segment-syntax $a class ( P62A3Segment A B ) $.
p62a3-noncollinear-syntax $a wff ( P62A3Noncol A B C ) $.
p62a3-hull-syntax $a class ( P62A3Hull A B C ) $.
p62a3-area-syntax $a class ( P62A3Area A B C ) $.

p62a3-index-definition $a |- P62A3I = ( 1 ... 2 ) $.

p62a3-plane-definition $a |- P62A3R2 = ( RR ^m P62A3I ) $.

${
  $d A B j $.

  p62a3-distance-definition $a |- (
    P62A3Dist A B
  ) = (
    sqrt
    `
    (
      sum_ j e. P62A3I
        ( ( ( A ` j ) - ( B ` j ) ) ^ 2 )
    )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d A B j t z $.

  p62a3-segment-definition $a |- (
    P62A3Segment A B
  ) = {
    z e. P62A3R2 |
    E. t e. ( 0 [,] 1 )
      z =
        (
          j e. P62A3I |->
            (
              ( ( 1 - t ) x. ( A ` j ) )
              +
              ( t x. ( B ` j ) )
            )
        )
  } $.
$}

p62a3-noncollinear-definition $a |- (
  ( P62A3Noncol A B C )
  <->
  (
    (
      ( ( B ` 1 ) - ( A ` 1 ) )
      x.
      ( ( C ` 2 ) - ( A ` 2 ) )
    )
    =/=
    (
      ( ( B ` 2 ) - ( A ` 2 ) )
      x.
      ( ( C ` 1 ) - ( A ` 1 ) )
    )
  )
) $.

${
  $d A B C j u v w x $.

  p62a3-hull-definition $a |- (
    P62A3Hull A B C
  ) = {
    x e. P62A3R2 |
    E. u e. RR E. v e. RR E. w e. RR
      (
        (
          0 <_ u
          /\
          (
            0 <_ v
            /\
            0 <_ w
          )
        )
        /\
        (
          ( ( u + v ) + w ) = 1
          /\
          x =
            (
              j e. P62A3I |->
                (
                  (
                    ( u x. ( A ` j ) )
                    +
                    ( v x. ( B ` j ) )
                  )
                  +
                  ( w x. ( C ` j ) )
                )
            )
        )
      )
  } $.
$}

p62a3-area-definition $a |- (
  P62A3Area A B C
) = (
  ( voln ` P62A3I )
  `
  ( P62A3Hull A B C )
) $.

${
  $d A B C D E F K P Q R $.

  putnambench-putnam-1962-a3 $a |- (
    A. A e. P62A3R2
    A. B e. P62A3R2
    A. C e. P62A3R2
    A. D e. P62A3R2
    A. E e. P62A3R2
    A. F e. P62A3R2
    A. P e. P62A3R2
    A. Q e. P62A3R2
    A. R e. P62A3R2
    A. K e. RR
      (
        (
          0 < K
          /\
          (
            ( P62A3Noncol A B C )
            /\
            (
              (
                D e. ( P62A3Segment B C )
                /\
                ( ( P62A3Dist C D ) / ( P62A3Dist D B ) ) = K
              )
              /\
              (
                (
                  E e. ( P62A3Segment C A )
                  /\
                  ( ( P62A3Dist A E ) / ( P62A3Dist E C ) ) = K
                )
                /\
                (
                  (
                    F e. ( P62A3Segment A B )
                    /\
                    ( ( P62A3Dist B F ) / ( P62A3Dist F A ) ) = K
                  )
                  /\
                  (
                    (
                      P e. ( P62A3Segment B E )
                      /\
                      P e. ( P62A3Segment C F )
                    )
                    /\
                    (
                      (
                        Q e. ( P62A3Segment C F )
                        /\
                        Q e. ( P62A3Segment A D )
                      )
                      /\
                      (
                        R e. ( P62A3Segment A D )
                        /\
                        R e. ( P62A3Segment B E )
                      )
                    )
                  )
                )
              )
            )
          )
        )
        ->
        (
          ( P62A3Area P Q R )
          /
          ( P62A3Area A B C )
        )
        =
        (
          ( ( K - 1 ) ^ 2 )
          /
          ( ( ( K ^ 2 ) + K ) + 1 )
        )
      )
  ) $.
$}

:: Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench artifact putnam_1962_a3:
:: the area ratio of the triangle formed by three pairwise intersections of
:: ratio-constrained cevians in a noncollinear real triangle. This file
:: contains no proof.

environ
  vocabularies TARSKI, XBOOLE_0, SUBSET_1, RELAT_1, FUNCT_1, FUNCT_2,
    NUMBERS, XREAL_0, COMPLEX1, CARD_1, XXREAL_0, ARYTM_1, ARYTM_3,
    SQUARE_1, REAL_1, INT_1, NAT_1, VALUED_1;
  notations TARSKI, XBOOLE_0, SUBSET_1, RELAT_1, FUNCT_1, RELSET_1,
    FUNCT_2, ORDINAL1, NUMBERS, XCMPLX_0, XREAL_0, REAL_1, INT_1,
    COMPLEX1, SQUARE_1, XXREAL_0;
  constructors FUNCT_1, RELSET_1, FUNCT_2, REAL_1, SQUARE_1, COMPLEX1,
    INT_1, XXREAL_0;
  registrations XBOOLE_0, SUBSET_1, RELAT_1, FUNCT_1, RELSET_1,
    FUNCT_2, NUMBERS, XXREAL_0, MEMBERED, VALUED_0, VALUED_1,
    XCMPLX_0, XREAL_0, SQUARE_1, ORDINAL1, NAT_1, INT_1;
  requirements REAL, NUMERALS, SUBSET, BOOLE, ARITHM;

begin

::$P-
theorem
  for xA,yA,xB,yB,xC,yC,xA1,yA1,xB1,yB1,xC1,yC1,
      xP,yP,xQ,yQ,xR,yR,k being Real st
    0 < k &
    (xB-xA)*(yC-yA) - (yB-yA)*(xC-xA) <> 0 &
    (ex t being Real st
      0 <= t & t <= 1 &
      xA1 = (1-t)*xB + t*xC &
      yA1 = (1-t)*yB + t*yC) &
    sqrt((xC-xA1)^2 + (yC-yA1)^2) /
      sqrt((xA1-xB)^2 + (yA1-yB)^2) = k &
    (ex t being Real st
      0 <= t & t <= 1 &
      xB1 = (1-t)*xC + t*xA &
      yB1 = (1-t)*yC + t*yA) &
    sqrt((xA-xB1)^2 + (yA-yB1)^2) /
      sqrt((xB1-xC)^2 + (yB1-yC)^2) = k &
    (ex t being Real st
      0 <= t & t <= 1 &
      xC1 = (1-t)*xA + t*xB &
      yC1 = (1-t)*yA + t*yB) &
    sqrt((xB-xC1)^2 + (yB-yC1)^2) /
      sqrt((xC1-xA)^2 + (yC1-yA)^2) = k &
    (ex t being Real st
      0 <= t & t <= 1 &
      xP = (1-t)*xB + t*xB1 &
      yP = (1-t)*yB + t*yB1) &
    (ex t being Real st
      0 <= t & t <= 1 &
      xP = (1-t)*xC + t*xC1 &
      yP = (1-t)*yC + t*yC1) &
    (ex t being Real st
      0 <= t & t <= 1 &
      xQ = (1-t)*xC + t*xC1 &
      yQ = (1-t)*yC + t*yC1) &
    (ex t being Real st
      0 <= t & t <= 1 &
      xQ = (1-t)*xA + t*xA1 &
      yQ = (1-t)*yA + t*yA1) &
    (ex t being Real st
      0 <= t & t <= 1 &
      xR = (1-t)*xA + t*xA1 &
      yR = (1-t)*yA + t*yA1) &
    (ex t being Real st
      0 <= t & t <= 1 &
      xR = (1-t)*xB + t*xB1 &
      yR = (1-t)*yB + t*yB1)
  holds
    |.(xQ-xP)*(yR-yP) - (yQ-yP)*(xR-xP).| /
      |.(xB-xA)*(yC-yA) - (yB-yA)*(xC-xA).| =
        (k-1)^2 / (k^2+k+1)
proof
end;
::$P+

title: putnam_1962_a3
content:
% Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench artifact putnam_1962_a3:
% a triangle cut by three cevians with a common positive side-division ratio
% has the stated ratio of the inner triangle's area to the original area.
% This file contains no proof.

putnam_1962_a3: THEORY
BEGIN
  point: TYPE = [# x_coord: real, y_coord: real #]

  affine_combination(t: real, P, Q: point): point =
    (# x_coord := (1 - t) * x_coord(P) + t * x_coord(Q),
       y_coord := (1 - t) * y_coord(P) + t * y_coord(Q) #)

  on_closed_segment(P, A, B: point): bool =
    EXISTS (t: real):
      0 <= t AND t <= 1 AND P = affine_combination(t, A, B)

  squared_distance(P, Q: point): real =
    (x_coord(Q) - x_coord(P)) ^ 2
      + (y_coord(Q) - y_coord(P)) ^ 2

  distance(P, Q: point): real =
    epsilon(
      LAMBDA (length: real):
        0 <= length AND length * length = squared_distance(P, Q))

  quotient_or_zero(numerator, denominator: real): real =
    IF denominator = 0 THEN 0 ELSE numerator / denominator ENDIF

  cross_from(P, Q, R: point): real =
    (x_coord(Q) - x_coord(P)) * (y_coord(R) - y_coord(P))
      - (y_coord(Q) - y_coord(P)) * (x_coord(R) - x_coord(P))

  noncollinear(A, B, C: point): bool =
    cross_from(A, B, C) /= 0

  triangle_area(A, B, C: point): real =
    abs(cross_from(A, B, C)) / 2

  putnam_1962_a3: bool =
    FORALL
        (A, B, C, A_prime, B_prime, C_prime, P, Q, R: point),
        (k: real):
      (k > 0
        AND noncollinear(A, B, C)
        AND on_closed_segment(A_prime, B, C)
        AND quotient_or_zero(
          distance(C, A_prime), distance(A_prime, B)) = k
        AND on_closed_segment(B_prime, C, A)
        AND quotient_or_zero(
          distance(A, B_prime), distance(B_prime, C)) = k
        AND on_closed_segment(C_prime, A, B)
        AND quotient_or_zero(
          distance(B, C_prime), distance(C_prime, A)) = k
        AND on_closed_segment(P, B, B_prime)
        AND on_closed_segment(P, C, C_prime)
        AND on_closed_segment(Q, C, C_prime)
        AND on_closed_segment(Q, A, A_prime)
        AND on_closed_segment(R, A, A_prime)
        AND on_closed_segment(R, B, B_prime))
      IMPLIES
        quotient_or_zero(
          triangle_area(P, Q, R), triangle_area(A, B, C))
          =
        quotient_or_zero((k - 1) ^ 2, k ^ 2 + k + 1)
END putnam_1962_a3

import Mathlib

/--
Assume that $\lvert f(x) \rvert \le 1$ and $\lvert f''(x) \rvert \le 1$ for all $x$ on an interval of length at least 2. Show that $\lvert f'(x) \rvert \le 2$ on the interval.
-/
theorem putnam_1962_a4
(f : ℝ → ℝ)
(a b : ℝ)
(hdiff : Differentiable ℝ f ∧ (Differentiable ℝ (deriv f)))
(hfabs : ∀ x ∈ Set.Icc a b, |f x| ≤ 1)
(hfppabs : ∀ x ∈ Set.Icc a b, |(iteratedDeriv 2 f) x| ≤ 1)
(hlen2 : b - a ≥ 2)
: ∀ x ∈ Set.Icc a b, |(iteratedDeriv 1 f) x| ≤ 2 :=
sorry

From mathcomp Require Import all_ssreflect ssrnum ssralg.
From mathcomp Require Import reals derive normedtype topology sequences.
From mathcomp Require Import classical_sets.
Import numFieldNormedType.Exports.

Set Implicit Arguments.
Unset Strict Implicit.
Unset Printing Implicit Defensive.

Local Open Scope ring_scope.

Variable R : realType.
Theorem putnam_1962_a4
    (f : R -> R)
    (a b : R)
    (hfdiff : forall x : R, differentiable f x /\ differentiable f^`() x)
    (hfabs : forall x : R, (a <= x <= b) -> `| f x | <= 1)
    (hfppabs : forall x : R, (a <= x <= b) -> `| f^`(2) x | <= 1)
    (hlen2 : b - a >= 2)
    : forall x : R, (a <= x <= b) -> `| f^`() x | <= 2.
Proof. Admitted.

putnam_1962_a4
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1962_a4:
;; a twice-differentiable real function bounded in absolute value by 1,
;; whose second derivative is likewise bounded by 1 on an interval of length
;; at least 2, has first derivative bounded by 2 there. This file contains no
;; proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))

;; The context below explicitly presents a Dedekind-complete ordered field,
;; hence the real field up to ordered-field isomorphism. Conservative DEFSTUB
;; interfaces represent arbitrary carrier predicates, subsets, operations,
;; and functions. DEFUN-SK keeps all unbounded mathematical quantifiers,
;; including the first- and second-derivative functions, internal to the
;; statement. Differentiation is expanded by its epsilon-delta definition.

(defstub p62a4-member-p (carrier value) t)

(defstub p62a4-set-member-p (set value) t)

(defstub p62a4-unary-value (function value) t)

(defstub p62a4-binary-value (function left right) t)

(defun-sk p62a4-valid-set-p (carrier set)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (p62a4-set-member-p set x)
     (p62a4-member-p carrier x))))

(defun-sk p62a4-real-function-p (carrier function)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (p62a4-member-p carrier x)
     (p62a4-member-p
      carrier
      (p62a4-unary-value function x)))))

(defun-sk p62a4-field-laws-p
    (carrier add multiply negate inverse zero one)
  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (p62a4-member-p carrier x)
      (p62a4-member-p carrier y)
      (p62a4-member-p carrier z))
     (and
      (p62a4-member-p
       carrier (p62a4-binary-value add x y))
      (p62a4-member-p
       carrier (p62a4-binary-value multiply x y))
      (p62a4-member-p
       carrier (p62a4-unary-value negate x))
      (p62a4-member-p
       carrier (p62a4-unary-value inverse x))
      (equal
       (p62a4-binary-value
        add (p62a4-binary-value add x y) z)
       (p62a4-binary-value
        add x (p62a4-binary-value add y z)))
      (equal
       (p62a4-binary-value add x y)
       (p62a4-binary-value add y x))
      (equal
       (p62a4-binary-value add x zero)
       x)
      (equal
       (p62a4-binary-value
        add x (p62a4-unary-value negate x))
       zero)
      (equal
       (p62a4-binary-value
        multiply (p62a4-binary-value multiply x y) z)
       (p62a4-binary-value
        multiply x (p62a4-binary-value multiply y z)))
      (equal
       (p62a4-binary-value multiply x y)
       (p62a4-binary-value multiply y x))
      (equal
       (p62a4-binary-value multiply x one)
       x)
      (implies
       (equal x zero)
       (equal (p62a4-unary-value inverse x) zero))
      (implies
       (not (equal x zero))
       (equal
        (p62a4-binary-value
         multiply x (p62a4-unary-value inverse x))
        one))
      (equal
       (p62a4-binary-value
        multiply x (p62a4-binary-value add y z))
       (p62a4-binary-value
        add
        (p62a4-binary-value multiply x y)
        (p62a4-binary-value multiply x z)))))))

(defun-sk p62a4-order-laws-p
    (carrier add multiply zero less)
  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (p62a4-member-p carrier x)
      (p62a4-member-p carrier y)
      (p62a4-member-p carrier z))
     (and
      (not (p62a4-binary-value less x x))
      (or
       (equal x y)
       (p62a4-binary-value less x y)
       (p62a4-binary-value less y x))
      (implies
       (and
        (p62a4-binary-value less x y)
        (p62a4-binary-value less y z))
       (p62a4-binary-value less x z))
      (implies
       (p62a4-binary-value less x y)
       (p62a4-binary-value
        less
        (p62a4-binary-value add x z)
        (p62a4-binary-value add y z)))
      (implies
       (and
        (p62a4-binary-value less zero x)
        (p62a4-binary-value less zero y))
       (p62a4-binary-value
        less
        zero
        (p62a4-binary-value multiply x y)))))))

(defun-sk p62a4-set-nonempty-p (carrier set)
  (exists (x)
    (and
     (p62a4-member-p carrier x)
     (p62a4-set-member-p set x))))

(defun-sk p62a4-upper-bound-p
    (carrier less set bound)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (and
      (p62a4-member-p carrier x)
      (p62a4-set-member-p set x))
     (not (p62a4-binary-value less bound x)))))

(defun-sk p62a4-bounded-above-p
    (carrier less set)
  (exists (bound)
    (and
     (p62a4-member-p carrier bound)
     (p62a4-upper-bound-p
      carrier less set bound))))

(defun-sk p62a4-least-upper-bound-p
    (carrier less set supremum)
  (forall (bound)
    (implies
     (and
      (p62a4-member-p carrier bound)
      (p62a4-upper-bound-p carrier less set bound))
     (not (p62a4-binary-value less bound supremum)))))

(defun p62a4-supremum-p
    (carrier less set supremum)
  (and
   (p62a4-member-p carrier supremum)
   (p62a4-upper-bound-p carrier less set supremum)
   (p62a4-least-upper-bound-p
    carrier less set supremum)))

(defun-sk p62a4-has-supremum-p
    (carrier less set)
  (exists (supremum)
    (p62a4-supremum-p
     carrier less set supremum)))

(defun-sk p62a4-dedekind-complete-p
    (carrier less)
  (forall (set)
    (implies
     (and
      (p62a4-valid-set-p carrier set)
      (p62a4-set-nonempty-p carrier set)
      (p62a4-bounded-above-p carrier less set))
     (p62a4-has-supremum-p carrier less set))))

(defun p62a4-real-field-p
    (carrier zero one add multiply negate inverse less)
  (and
   (p62a4-member-p carrier zero)
   (p62a4-member-p carrier one)
   (not (equal zero one))
   (p62a4-field-laws-p
    carrier add multiply negate inverse zero one)
   (p62a4-order-laws-p
    carrier add multiply zero less)
   (p62a4-binary-value less zero one)
   (p62a4-dedekind-complete-p carrier less)))

;; An eight-entry context contains the real carrier, 0, 1, addition,
;; multiplication, additive negation, inversion, and strict order.

(defun p62a4-r-carrier (ctx)
  (nth 0 ctx))

(defun p62a4-r-zero (ctx)
  (nth 1 ctx))

(defun p62a4-r-one (ctx)
  (nth 2 ctx))

(defun p62a4-r-add (ctx)

(defun p62a4-context-p (ctx)

       ctx value (p62a4-r-zero ctx))
      (p62a4-r-negate-value ctx value)
    value))

   (p62a4-member-p (p62a4-r-carrier ctx) value)

    ctx (p62a4-r-zero ctx) value)))

   ctx (p62a4-r-one ctx) (p62a4-r-one ctx)))

(defun p62a4-icc-member-p (ctx left right x)
  (and
   (p62a4-member-p (p62a4-r-carrier ctx) x)
   (p62a4-r-less-equal-p ctx left x)
   (p62a4-r-less-equal-p ctx x right)))

;; HasDerivAt in epsilon-delta form:

(defun-sk p62a4-derivative-neighborhood-p
    (ctx function derivative x epsilon radius)

    (implies
     (and
      (p62a4-member-p (p62a4-r-carrier ctx) z)
      (p62a4-r-less-p
       ctx
       (p62a4-r-absolute-value
        ctx (p62a4-r-subtract-value ctx z x))
       radius))
     (p62a4-r-less-equal-p
      ctx
      (p62a4-r-absolute-value
       ctx
       (p62a4-r-subtract-value
        ctx
        (p62a4-r-subtract-value
         ctx
         (p62a4-unary-value function z)
         (p62a4-unary-value function x))
        (p62a4-r-multiply-value
         ctx
         derivative
         (p62a4-r-subtract-value ctx z x))))

       (p62a4-r-absolute-value
        ctx (p62a4-r-subtract-value ctx z x)))))))

(defun-sk p62a4-derivative-radius-exists-p
    (ctx function derivative x epsilon)
  (exists (radius)
    (and
     (p62a4-positive-real-p ctx radius)
     (p62a4-derivative-neighborhood-p
      ctx function derivative x epsilon radius))))

(defun-sk p62a4-has-derivative-at-p
    (ctx function derivative x)
  (forall (epsilon)
    (implies
     (p62a4-positive-real-p ctx epsilon)
     (p62a4-derivative-radius-exists-p
      ctx function derivative x epsilon))))

(defun-sk p62a4-derivative-function-p
    (ctx function derivative-function)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (p62a4-member-p (p62a4-r-carrier ctx) x)

      ctx
      function
      (p62a4-unary-value derivative-function x)

  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (p62a4-icc-member-p ctx left right x)
     (p62a4-r-less-equal-p
      ctx
      (p62a4-r-absolute-value
       ctx (p62a4-unary-value function x))

    (ctx left right)

   ctx
   (p62a4-r-two ctx)
   (p62a4-r-subtract-value ctx right left)))

      (p62a4-member-p (p62a4-r-carrier ctx) left)
      (p62a4-member-p (p62a4-r-carrier ctx) right)
      (p62a4-real-function-p
       (p62a4-r-carrier ctx) function)

       (p62a4-r-carrier ctx) first-derivative)
      (p62a4-real-function-p
       (p62a4-r-carrier ctx) second-derivative)

       ctx function first-derivative)
      (p62a4-derivative-function-p
       ctx first-derivative second-derivative)
      (p62a4-absolute-bound-on-icc-p
       ctx function left right (p62a4-r-one ctx))
      (p62a4-absolute-bound-on-icc-p
       ctx second-derivative left right (p62a4-r-one ctx))
      (p62a4-interval-length-at-least-two-p
       ctx left right))

title: putnam_1962_a4
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1962_a4:
-- a twice differentiable real function bounded by one together with its second
-- derivative on an interval of length at least two has first derivative bounded
-- by two on that interval. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc)

infix 4 _!=_

data Bottom : Set where

Not : Set -> Set
Not A = A -> Bottom

_!=_ : {A : Set} -> A -> A -> Set
x != y = Not (x == y)

record Both (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data Either (A B : Set) : Set where
  left  : A -> Either A B
  right : B -> Either A B

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

record CompleteOrderedField (R : Set) : Set1 where
  field
    zeroR oneR : R
    add multiply : R -> R -> R
    negate inverse : R -> R
    lessOrEqual : R -> R -> Set
    fromNat : Nat -> R

    one-not-zero :
      oneR != zeroR

    add-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> add x y == add y x
    add-associative :
      (x y z : R) -> add (add x y) z == add x (add y z)
    add-zero :
      (x : R) -> add x zeroR == x
    add-inverse :
      (x : R) -> add x (negate x) == zeroR

    multiply-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> multiply x y == multiply y x
    multiply-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply (multiply x y) z == multiply x (multiply y z)
    multiply-one :
      (x : R) -> multiply x oneR == x
    multiply-zero :
      (x : R) -> multiply x zeroR == zeroR
    distribute :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply x (add y z) ==
      add (multiply x y) (multiply x z)
    inverse-zero :
      inverse zeroR == zeroR
    multiply-inverse :
      (x : R) ->
      x != zeroR ->
      multiply x (inverse x) == oneR

    order-reflexive :
      (x : R) -> lessOrEqual x x
    order-transitive :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y z ->
      lessOrEqual x z
    order-antisymmetric :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y x ->
      x == y
    order-total :
      (x y : R) ->
      Either (lessOrEqual x y) (lessOrEqual y x)
    add-order :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual (add z x) (add z y)
    multiply-nonnegative :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR x ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR y ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR (multiply x y)
    zero-less-than-one :
      Both (lessOrEqual zeroR oneR) (zeroR != oneR)

    fromNat-zero :
      fromNat zero == zeroR
    fromNat-successor :
      (n : Nat) -> fromNat (suc n) == add (fromNat n) oneR

    archimedean :
      (x : R) ->
      Exists Nat (\ n -> lessOrEqual x (fromNat n))
    least-upper-bound :
      (P : R -> Set) ->
      Exists R P ->
      Exists R
        (\ upper ->
          (x : R) ->
          P x ->
          lessOrEqual x upper) ->
      Exists R
        (\ supremum ->
          Both
            ((x : R) -> P x -> lessOrEqual x supremum)
            ((upper : R) ->
              ((x : R) -> P x -> lessOrEqual x upper) ->
              lessOrEqual supremum upper))

open CompleteOrderedField

subtract :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
subtract reals x y =
  add reals x (negate reals y)

divide :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
divide reals x y =
  multiply reals x (inverse reals y)

two :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R
two reals =
  add reals (oneR reals) (oneR reals)

StrictLess :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
StrictLess reals x y =
  Both (lessOrEqual reals x y) (x != y)

CloseTo :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
CloseTo reals center radius x =
  Both
    (StrictLess reals (subtract reals center radius) x)
    (StrictLess reals x (add reals center radius))

differenceQuotient :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  (R -> R) ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
differenceQuotient reals function point x =
  divide reals
    (subtract reals (function x) (function point))
    (subtract reals x point)

DerivativeAt :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  (R -> R) ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
DerivativeAt {R} reals function point derivative =
  (epsilon : R) ->
  StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) epsilon ->
  Exists R
    (\ delta ->
      Both
        (StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) delta)
        ((x : R) ->
          CloseTo reals point delta x ->
          x != point ->
          CloseTo reals derivative epsilon
            (differenceQuotient reals function point x)))

InClosedInterval :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
InClosedInterval reals a b x =
  Both
    (lessOrEqual reals a x)
    (lessOrEqual reals x b)

BoundedBy :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
BoundedBy reals bound value =
  Both
    (lessOrEqual reals (negate reals bound) value)
    (lessOrEqual reals value bound)

putnam-1962-a4 : Set1
putnam-1962-a4 =
  (R : Set) ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) ->
  (f firstDerivative secondDerivative : R -> R) ->
  (a b : R) ->
  ((x : R) ->
    DerivativeAt reals f x (firstDerivative x)) ->
  ((x : R) ->
    DerivativeAt reals firstDerivative x (secondDerivative x)) ->
  ((x : R) ->
    InClosedInterval reals a b x ->
    BoundedBy reals (oneR reals) (f x)) ->
  ((x : R) ->
    InClosedInterval reals a b x ->
    BoundedBy reals (oneR reals) (secondDerivative x)) ->
  lessOrEqual reals
    (two reals)
    (subtract reals b a) ->
  (x : R) ->
  InClosedInterval reals a b x ->
  BoundedBy reals (two reals) (firstDerivative x)

(*
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench artifact putnam_1962_a4:
  a globally differentiable real function with globally differentiable first
  derivative has derivative bounded by two on a sufficiently long interval
  when the function and its second derivative are bounded by one there. This
  file contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open realTheory limTheory;

val putnam_1962_a4 =
  ``!f : real -> real. !a b : real.
      (!x : real. higher_differentiable 2 f x) /\
      (!x : real.
         a <= x /\ x <= b
         ==>
         abs (f x) <= 1) /\
      (!x : real.
         a <= x /\ x <= b
         ==>
         abs (diffn 2 f x) <= 1) /\
      2 <= b - a
      ==>
      !x : real.
        a <= x /\ x <= b
        ==>
        abs (diffn 1 f x) <= 2``;

$(
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench artifact putnam_1962_a4:
  a twice-differentiable real function bounded together with its second
  derivative on an interval of length at least two has first derivative
  bounded in absolute value by two there. This file contains no proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  The set.mm class ( RR Dn F ) gives the sequence of iterated real
  derivatives of F. Requiring RR to be contained in the domains of its
  first and second entries expresses the two global differentiability
  assumptions. The final declaration is an unproved $a statement.
$)

${
  $d x A $.
  $d x B $.
  $d x F $.

  putnambench-putnam-1962-a4 $a |- (
    (
      (
        (
          ( A e. RR /\ B e. RR )
          /\
          F : RR --> RR
        )
        /\
        (
          RR C_ dom ( ( RR Dn F ) ` 1 )
          /\
          RR C_ dom ( ( RR Dn F ) ` 2 )
        )
      )
      /\
      (
        (
          A. x e. ( A [,] B )
            ( abs ` ( F ` x ) ) <_ 1
          /\
          A. x e. ( A [,] B )
            ( abs ` ( ( ( RR Dn F ) ` 2 ) ` x ) ) <_ 1
        )
        /\
        2 <_ ( B - A )
      )
    )
    ->
    A. x e. ( A [,] B )
      ( abs ` ( ( ( RR Dn F ) ` 1 ) ` x ) ) <_ 2
  ) $.
$}

% Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench artifact putnam_1962_a4:
% a globally twice-differentiable real function bounded by one together with
% its second derivative on an interval of length at least two has first
% derivative bounded by two there. This file contains no proof.

putnam_1962_a4: THEORY
BEGIN
  real_function: TYPE = [real -> real]

  in_closed_interval(x, a, b: real): bool =
    a <= x AND x <= b

  has_derivative_at(
      f: real_function,
      derivative, x: real): bool =
    FORALL (epsilon: real):
      epsilon > 0 IMPLIES
        EXISTS (delta: real):
          delta > 0
            AND FORALL (h: real):
              (NOT (h = 0) AND abs(h) < delta)
                IMPLIES
                  abs(
                    f(x + h) - f(x)
                      - derivative * h)
                    < epsilon * abs(h)

  putnam_1962_a4: bool =
    FORALL
        (f, f_prime, f_second: real_function),
        (a, b: real):
      ((FORALL (x: real):
          has_derivative_at(f, f_prime(x), x)
            AND has_derivative_at(
              f_prime, f_second(x), x))
        AND (FORALL (x: real):
          in_closed_interval(x, a, b)
            IMPLIES abs(f(x)) <= 1)
        AND (FORALL (x: real):
          in_closed_interval(x, a, b)
            IMPLIES abs(f_second(x)) <= 1)
        AND b - a >= 2)
      IMPLIES
        FORALL (x: real):
          in_closed_interval(x, a, b)
            IMPLIES abs(f_prime(x)) <= 2
END putnam_1962_a4

-- Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1962_a5:
-- for every natural n at least two, the binomial sum from k = 1 through n of
-- (n choose k) k squared has the stated closed form. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality using (_≡_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; _-_; _*_)

infix 4 _≤_

data _≤_ : Nat → Nat → Set where
  zero≤   : {n : Nat} → zero ≤ n
  suc≤suc : {m n : Nat} → m ≤ n → suc m ≤ suc n

one : Nat
one = suc zero

two : Nat
two = suc one

power : Nat → Nat → Nat
power base zero = one
power base (suc exponent) = power base exponent * base

choose : Nat → Nat → Nat
choose n zero = one
choose zero (suc k) = zero
choose (suc n) (suc k) = choose n (suc k) + choose n k

% Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench artifact putnam_1962_a5:
% the binomial sum of k squared from 1 through n has the stated natural-number
% closed form for every n at least two. This file contains no proof.

putnam_1962_a5: THEORY
BEGIN
  binomial_coefficient(n, k: nat): RECURSIVE nat =
    IF k = 0 THEN
      1
    ELSIF n = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      binomial_coefficient(n - 1, k - 1)
        + binomial_coefficient(n - 1, k)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE n

  binomial_square_sum(n, count: nat): RECURSIVE nat =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      binomial_square_sum(n, count - 1)
        + binomial_coefficient(n, count) * count ^ 2
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  nat_subtract_two(n: nat): nat =
    IF n >= 2 THEN n - 2 ELSE 0 ENDIF

  putnam_1962_a5_solution(n: nat): nat =
    n * (n + 1) * (2 :: nat) ^ nat_subtract_two(n)

  putnam_1962_a5: bool =
    FORALL (n: nat):
      n >= 2 IMPLIES
        putnam_1962_a5_solution(n) = binomial_square_sum(n, n)
END putnam_1962_a5

-- Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1962_a6:
-- a rational subset closed under addition and multiplication, for which exactly
-- one of r being a member, -r being a member, and r being zero holds, is the
-- set of positive rationals. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Int using (Int; pos; negsuc)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; _*_)

infix 4 _~Q_

data Bottom : Set where

Not : Set -> Set
Not A = A -> Bottom

record And (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data Or (A B : Set) : Set where
  left  : A -> Or A B
  right : B -> Or A B

record Iff (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor iff
  field
    forward  : A -> B
    backward : B -> A

pred : Nat -> Nat
pred zero = zero
pred (suc n) = n

negative : Nat -> Int
negative zero = pos zero
negative (suc n) = negsuc n

negateInt : Int -> Int
negateInt (pos n) = negative n
negateInt (negsuc n) = pos (suc n)

difference : Nat -> Nat -> Int
difference zero zero = pos zero
difference (suc m) zero = pos (suc m)
difference zero (suc n) = negsuc n
difference (suc m) (suc n) = difference m n

addInt : Int -> Int -> Int
addInt (pos m) (pos n) = pos (m + n)
addInt (pos m) (negsuc n) = difference m (suc n)
addInt (negsuc m) (pos n) = difference n (suc m)
addInt (negsuc m) (negsuc n) = negsuc (suc (m + n))

multiplyInt : Int -> Int -> Int
multiplyInt (pos m) (pos n) = pos (m * n)
multiplyInt (pos m) (negsuc n) = negative (m * suc n)
multiplyInt (negsuc m) (pos n) = negative (suc m * n)
multiplyInt (negsuc m) (negsuc n) = pos (suc m * suc n)

scaleInt : Int -> Nat -> Int
scaleInt z n = multiplyInt z (pos n)

record Rational : Set where
  constructor fraction
  field
    numerator             : Int
    denominator-minus-one : Nat

open Rational public

denominator : Rational -> Nat
denominator q = suc (denominator-minus-one q)

_~Q_ : Rational -> Rational -> Set
x ~Q y =
  scaleInt (numerator x) (denominator y) ==
  scaleInt (numerator y) (denominator x)

zeroQ : Rational
zeroQ = fraction (pos zero) zero

negateQ : Rational -> Rational
negateQ q =
  fraction
    (negateInt (numerator q))
    (denominator-minus-one q)

addQ : Rational -> Rational -> Rational
addQ x y =
  fraction
    (addInt
      (scaleInt (numerator x) (denominator y))
      (scaleInt (numerator y) (denominator x)))
    (pred (denominator x * denominator y))

multiplyQ : Rational -> Rational -> Rational
multiplyQ x y =
  fraction
    (multiplyInt (numerator x) (numerator y))
    (pred (denominator x * denominator y))

data PositiveInt : Int -> Set where
  positive : {n : Nat} -> PositiveInt (pos (suc n))

PositiveRational : Rational -> Set
PositiveRational q = PositiveInt (numerator q)

record RationalSubset : Set1 where
  field
    contains : Rational -> Set
    respects-rational-equality :
      (x y : Rational) ->
      x ~Q y ->
      Iff (contains x) (contains y)

open RationalSubset public

AdditionClosed : RationalSubset -> Set
AdditionClosed S =
  (a b : Rational) ->
  contains S a ->
  contains S b ->
  contains S (addQ a b)

MultiplicationClosed : RationalSubset -> Set
MultiplicationClosed S =
  (a b : Rational) ->
  contains S a ->
  contains S b ->
  contains S (multiplyQ a b)

ExactlyOneCondition : RationalSubset -> Set
ExactlyOneCondition S =
  (r : Rational) ->
  And
    (Or
      (contains S r)
      (Or (contains S (negateQ r)) (r ~Q zeroQ)))
    (And
      (Not (And (contains S r) (contains S (negateQ r))))
      (And
        (Not (And (contains S r) (r ~Q zeroQ)))
        (Not (And (contains S (negateQ r)) (r ~Q zeroQ)))))

SameSubsetAsPositiveRationals : RationalSubset -> Set
SameSubsetAsPositiveRationals S =
  (r : Rational) ->
  Iff (contains S r) (PositiveRational r)

putnam-1962-a6 : Set1
putnam-1962-a6 =
  (S : RationalSubset) ->
  AdditionClosed S ->
  MultiplicationClosed S ->
  ExactlyOneCondition S ->
  SameSubsetAsPositiveRationals S

;; Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench artifact putnam_1962_b1:
;; the binomial addition formula for real falling-factorial polynomials.
;; This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

;; The hypotheses uniquely identify p n as the nth falling-factorial
;; polynomial (with p 0 = 1). The predicate below compares the complete
;; integer coefficient grids of the two resulting bivariate polynomials.
;; Equality of these grids implies the source equality at every pair of real
;; values. Conversely, a real polynomial identity has equal coefficients, so
;; this formal-polynomial encoding is bidirectionally equivalent to the
;; universally quantified source statement and does not restrict real inputs
;; to ACL2's rational number domain.

(defun putnam-1962-b1-polynomial-add (left right)
  (if (endp left)
      right
    (if (endp right)
        left
      (cons (+ (car left) (car right))
            (putnam-1962-b1-polynomial-add
             (cdr left) (cdr right))))))

(defun putnam-1962-b1-polynomial-scale (coefficient polynomial)
  (if (endp polynomial)
      nil
    (cons (* coefficient (car polynomial))
          (putnam-1962-b1-polynomial-scale
           coefficient (cdr polynomial)))))

;; Coefficients are in ascending degree order. This recurrence multiplies
;; the preceding polynomial by X - (n - 1).
(defun putnam-1962-b1-falling-factorial-coefficients (n)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix n)))
  (if (zp n)
      (list 1)
    (let* ((previous
            (putnam-1962-b1-falling-factorial-coefficients
             (- n 1)))
           (constant (- n 1)))

-- Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1962_b1:
-- the binomial addition formula for real falling factorials at every natural
-- index. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; _-_)

infix 4 _!=_
infixr 3 _and_
infixr 2 _or_

data Bottom : Set where

Not : Set -> Set
Not A = A -> Bottom

_!=_ : {A : Set} -> A -> A -> Set
x != y = Not (x == y)

record _and_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data _or_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  left  : A -> A or B
  right : B -> A or B

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

record CompleteOrderedField (R : Set) : Set1 where
  field
    zeroR oneR : R
    add multiply : R -> R -> R
    negate inverse : R -> R
    lessOrEqual : R -> R -> Set
    fromNat : Nat -> R

    one-not-zero :
      oneR != zeroR

    add-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> add x y == add y x
    add-associative :
      (x y z : R) -> add (add x y) z == add x (add y z)
    add-zero :
      (x : R) -> add x zeroR == x
    add-inverse :
      (x : R) -> add x (negate x) == zeroR

    multiply-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> multiply x y == multiply y x
    multiply-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply (multiply x y) z == multiply x (multiply y z)
    multiply-one :
      (x : R) -> multiply x oneR == x
    multiply-zero :
      (x : R) -> multiply x zeroR == zeroR
    distribute :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply x (add y z) ==
      add (multiply x y) (multiply x z)
    inverse-zero :
      inverse zeroR == zeroR
    multiply-inverse :
      (x : R) ->
      x != zeroR ->
      multiply x (inverse x) == oneR

    order-reflexive :
      (x : R) -> lessOrEqual x x
    order-transitive :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y z ->
      lessOrEqual x z
    order-antisymmetric :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y x ->
      x == y
    order-total :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y or lessOrEqual y x
    add-order :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual (add z x) (add z y)
    multiply-nonnegative :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR x ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR y ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR (multiply x y)
    zero-less-than-one :
      lessOrEqual zeroR oneR and zeroR != oneR

    fromNat-zero :
      fromNat zero == zeroR
    fromNat-successor :
      (n : Nat) -> fromNat (suc n) == add (fromNat n) oneR
    fromNat-addition :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m + n) == add (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-injective :
      (m n : Nat) -> fromNat m == fromNat n -> m == n

    archimedean :
      (x : R) ->
      Exists Nat (\ n -> lessOrEqual x (fromNat n))
    least-upper-bound :
      (P : R -> Set) ->
      Exists R P ->
      Exists R
        (\ upper ->
          (x : R) ->
          P x ->
          lessOrEqual x upper) ->
      Exists R
        (\ supremum ->
          ((x : R) -> P x -> lessOrEqual x supremum)
          and
          ((upper : R) ->
            ((x : R) -> P x -> lessOrEqual x upper) ->
            lessOrEqual supremum upper))

open CompleteOrderedField

subtract :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
subtract reals x y =
  add reals x (negate reals y)

data Positive : Nat -> Set where
  positive : {n : Nat} -> Positive (suc n)

oneN : Nat
oneN = suc zero

choose : Nat -> Nat -> Nat
choose n zero = oneN
choose zero (suc k) = zero
choose (suc n) (suc k) = choose n (suc k) + choose n k

fallingProduct :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  Nat ->
  R
fallingProduct reals x zero =
  oneR reals
fallingProduct reals x (suc n) =
  multiply reals
    (fallingProduct reals x n)
    (subtract reals x (fromNat reals n))

sumThrough :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  Nat ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  R
sumThrough reals zero term =
  term zero
sumThrough reals (suc n) term =
  add reals
    (sumThrough reals n term)
    (term (suc n))

module Putnam1962B1Statement
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) where

  proposition : Set
  proposition =
    (p : Nat -> R -> R) ->
    (x y : R) ->
    (n : Nat) ->
    ((z : R) -> p zero z == oneR reals) ->
    ((m : Nat) ->
      Positive m ->
      (z : R) ->
      p m z == fallingProduct reals z m) ->
    p n (add reals x y)
    ==
    sumThrough reals n
      (\ k ->
        multiply reals
          (multiply reals
            (fromNat reals (choose n k))
            (p k x))
          (p (n - k) y))

putnam-1962-b1 : Set1
putnam-1962-b1 =
  (R : Set) ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) ->
  Putnam1962B1Statement.proposition reals

(*
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench artifact putnam_1962_b1:
  the binomial convolution identity for real falling factorials defined by
  finite products. This file contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open arithmeticTheory combinatoricsTheory pred_setTheory realTheory real_sigmaTheory;

val putnam_1962_b1 =
  ``!p : num -> real -> real. !x y : real. !n : num.
      p 0 = (\z : real. 1) /\
      (!m : num.
         0 < m
         ==>
         p m =
           (\z : real.
              REAL_PROD_IMAGE
                (\i : num. z - &i)
                (count m)))
      ==>
      p n (x + y) =
        SIGMA
          (\k : num.
             &(binomial n k) * p k x * p (n - k) y)
          (count (SUC n))``;

$(
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench artifact putnam_1962_b1:
  the binomial addition identity for real falling factorials defined by
  finite products over consecutive nonnegative integers. This file contains
  no proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  The included set.mm library supplies real-valued function spaces,
  nonnegative and positive integers, half-open and inclusive integer
  intervals, finite products and sums, and binomial coefficients.

  The final unproved $a assertion quantifies the original family p of real
  functions, the real arguments x and y, and the nonnegative integer n. The
  half-open range ( 0 ..^ m ) is exactly the source range from 0 through
  m - 1.
$)

${
  $d P x y n m z i k $.

  putnambench-putnam-1962-b1 $a |- A. P
    A. x e. RR
    A. y e. RR
    A. n e. NN0
      (
        (
          (
            P : NN0 --> ( RR ^m RR )
            /\
            ( P ` 0 ) = ( z e. RR |-> 1 )
          )
          /\
          A. m e. NN
            ( P ` m ) =
              (
                z e. RR |->
                  prod_ i e. ( 0 ..^ m ) ( z - i )
              )
        )
        ->
        (
          ( ( P ` n ) ` ( x + y ) )
          =
          sum_ k e. ( 0 ... n )
            (
              ( n _C k )
              x.
              (
                ( ( P ` k ) ` x )
                x.
                ( ( P ` ( n - k ) ) ` y )
              )
            )
        )
      )
  $.
$}

theorem

  for x,y being Element of REAL holds

    (for z being Element of REAL holds (p.0).z = 1) &

title: putnam_1962_b1
content:
% Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench artifact putnam_1962_b1:
% the falling factorial of a sum satisfies the binomial convolution identity.
% This file contains no proof.

putnam_1962_b1: THEORY
BEGIN
  binomial_coefficient(n, k: nat): RECURSIVE nat =
    IF k = 0 THEN
      1
    ELSIF n = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      binomial_coefficient(n - 1, k - 1)
        + binomial_coefficient(n - 1, k)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE n

  falling_factorial(x: real, n: nat): RECURSIVE real =
    IF n = 0 THEN
      1
    ELSE
      falling_factorial(x, n - 1) * (x - ((n - 1) :: real))
    ENDIF
  MEASURE n

  falling_convolution_sum(
      p: [nat -> [real -> real]],
      x, y: real,
      n, term_count: nat): RECURSIVE real =
    IF term_count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      LET k: nat = term_count - 1
      IN
        falling_convolution_sum(p, x, y, n, term_count - 1)
          + IF k <= n THEN
              (binomial_coefficient(n, k) :: real)
                * p(k)(x)
                * p(n - k)(y)
            ELSE
              0
            ENDIF
    ENDIF
  MEASURE term_count

  putnam_1962_b1: bool =
    FORALL (p: [nat -> [real -> real]]), (x, y: real), (n: nat):
      ((FORALL (z: real):
          p(0)(z) = 1)
        AND (FORALL (m: nat):
          m > 0 IMPLIES
            (FORALL (z: real):
              p(m)(z) = falling_factorial(z, m))))
      IMPLIES
        p(n)(x + y)
          = falling_convolution_sum(p, x, y, n, n + 1)
END putnam_1962_b1

title: putnam_1962_b2
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1962_b2:
;; existence of a function from the real line to subsets of the natural
;; numbers that sends strict order to proper inclusion. This file contains no
;; proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))

;; Real numbers are rounded, nontrivial lower Dedekind cuts of the rationals.
;; Natural-number sets and the requested function are tame APPLY$ objects.
;; FN-EQUAL supplies unbounded universal quantification, while inequality with
;; a constant-false function keeps every existential witness internal.
;;
;; Boolean-valued cuts are canonical: equality is extensional equality, and
;; strict real order is proper inclusion of lower cuts. The output function is
;; required to be extensional on equal cuts. Replacing positive naturals by
;; naturals is equivalent through a fixed bijection. Conversely, the standard
;; rational enumeration sends each cut to the natural codes of the rationals
;; it contains, so the tame-function presentation does not restrict the
;; source existence assertion.

(defun putnam-1962-b2-quoted (object)
  (list 'quote object))

(defun putnam-1962-b2-term-list (terms)
  (if (consp terms)
      (list
       'cons
       (car terms)
       (putnam-1962-b2-term-list (cdr terms)))
    (putnam-1962-b2-quoted nil)))

(defun putnam-1962-b2-apply-term
    (function-term arguments)
  (list
   'apply$
   function-term
   (putnam-1962-b2-term-list arguments)))

(defun putnam-1962-b2-static-apply-term
    (function arguments)
  (putnam-1962-b2-apply-term
   (putnam-1962-b2-quoted function)
   arguments))

(defun putnam-1962-b2-and-terms (terms)
  (if (consp terms)
      (list
       'if
       (car terms)
       (putnam-1962-b2-and-terms (cdr terms))
       (putnam-1962-b2-quoted nil))
    (putnam-1962-b2-quoted t)))

(defun putnam-1962-b2-not-term (term)
  (list
   'if
   term
   (putnam-1962-b2-quoted nil)
   (putnam-1962-b2-quoted t)))

(defun putnam-1962-b2-implies-term
    (hypothesis conclusion)
  (list
   'if
   hypothesis
   conclusion
   (putnam-1962-b2-quoted t)))

(defun putnam-1962-b2-true-function (formals)
  (list
   'lambda
   formals
   (putnam-1962-b2-quoted t)))

(defun putnam-1962-b2-false-function (formals)
  (list
   'lambda
   formals
   (putnam-1962-b2-quoted nil)))

(defun putnam-1962-b2-universal-p
    (function formals)
  (let ((always-true
         (putnam-1962-b2-true-function formals)))
    (and
     (tamep-functionp function)
     (tamep-functionp always-true)
     (fn-equal function always-true))))

(defun putnam-1962-b2-exists-p
    (function formals)
  (let ((always-false
         (putnam-1962-b2-false-function formals)))
    (and
     (tamep-functionp function)
     (tamep-functionp always-false)
     (not (fn-equal function always-false)))))

(defun putnam-1962-b2-member-p
    (predicate object)
  (if (apply$ predicate (list object))
      t
    nil))

;; Dedekind-cut presentation of the full real line.

(defun putnam-1962-b2-boolean-value-at-p
    (predicate object)
  (let ((value (apply$ predicate (list object))))
    (or (equal value t)
        (equal value nil))))

(defun putnam-1962-b2-boolean-function
    (predicate)
  (list
   'lambda
   '(object)
   (list
    'putnam-1962-b2-boolean-value-at-p
    (putnam-1962-b2-quoted predicate)
    'object)))

(defun putnam-1962-b2-lower-law-at-p
    (cut q r)
  (implies
   (and
    (rationalp q)
    (rationalp r)
    (< q r)
    (putnam-1962-b2-member-p cut r))
   (putnam-1962-b2-member-p cut q)))

(defun putnam-1962-b2-lower-law-function
    (cut)
  (list
   'lambda
   '(q r)
   (list
    'putnam-1962-b2-lower-law-at-p
    (putnam-1962-b2-quoted cut)
    'q
    'r)))

(defun putnam-1962-b2-rounded-witness-at-p
    (cut q r)
  (and
   (rationalp r)
   (< q r)
   (putnam-1962-b2-member-p cut r)))

(defun putnam-1962-b2-rounded-witness-function
    (cut q)
  (list
   'lambda
   '(r)
   (list
    'putnam-1962-b2-rounded-witness-at-p
    (putnam-1962-b2-quoted cut)
    (putnam-1962-b2-quoted q)
    'r)))

(defun putnam-1962-b2-rounded-law-at-p
    (cut q)
  (implies
   (and
    (rationalp q)
    (putnam-1962-b2-member-p cut q))
   (putnam-1962-b2-exists-p
    (putnam-1962-b2-rounded-witness-function cut q)
    '(r))))

(defun putnam-1962-b2-rounded-law-function
    (cut)
  (list
   'lambda
   '(q)
   (list
    'putnam-1962-b2-rounded-law-at-p
    (putnam-1962-b2-quoted cut)
    'q)))

(defun putnam-1962-b2-rational-support-at-p
    (cut object)
  (implies
   (not (rationalp object))
   (not (putnam-1962-b2-member-p cut object))))

(defun putnam-1962-b2-rational-support-function
    (cut)
  (list
   'lambda
   '(object)
   (list
    'putnam-1962-b2-rational-support-at-p
    (putnam-1962-b2-quoted cut)
    'object)))

(defun putnam-1962-b2-lower-witness-at-p
    (cut q)
  (and
   (rationalp q)
   (putnam-1962-b2-member-p cut q)))

(defun putnam-1962-b2-lower-witness-function
    (cut)
  (list
   'lambda
   '(q)
   (list
    'putnam-1962-b2-lower-witness-at-p
    (putnam-1962-b2-quoted cut)
    'q)))

(defun putnam-1962-b2-upper-witness-at-p
    (cut q)
  (and
   (rationalp q)
   (not (putnam-1962-b2-member-p cut q))))

(defun putnam-1962-b2-upper-witness-function
    (cut)
  (list
   'lambda
   '(q)
   (list
    'putnam-1962-b2-upper-witness-at-p
    (putnam-1962-b2-quoted cut)
    'q)))

(defun putnam-1962-b2-real-p (cut)
  (and
   (tamep-functionp cut)
   (putnam-1962-b2-universal-p
    (putnam-1962-b2-boolean-function cut)

-- Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1962_b2:
-- existence of a function from the real numbers to subsets of the natural
-- numbers that is strictly inclusion-monotone. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc)
open import Agda.Primitive using (Level; _⊔_)

infix 4 _!=_
infixr 3 _and_

data Bottom : Set where

Not :
  {a : Level} ->
  Set a ->
  Set a
Not A =
  A -> Bottom

_!=_ :
  {A : Set} ->
  A ->
  A ->
  Set
x != y =
  Not (x == y)

record _and_
  {a b : Level}
  (A : Set a)
  (B : Set b) :
  Set (a ⊔ b) where
  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data _or_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  left  : A -> A or B
  right : B -> A or B

record Exists
  {a p : Level}
  (A : Set a)
  (P : A -> Set p) :
  Set (a ⊔ p) where
  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

record CompleteOrderedField (R : Set) : Set1 where
  field
    zeroR oneR : R
    add multiply : R -> R -> R
    negate inverse : R -> R
    lessOrEqual : R -> R -> Set
    fromNat : Nat -> R

    one-not-zero :
      oneR != zeroR

    add-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> add x y == add y x
    add-associative :
      (x y z : R) -> add (add x y) z == add x (add y z)
    add-zero :
      (x : R) -> add x zeroR == x
    add-inverse :
      (x : R) -> add x (negate x) == zeroR

    multiply-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> multiply x y == multiply y x
    multiply-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply (multiply x y) z == multiply x (multiply y z)
    multiply-one :
      (x : R) -> multiply x oneR == x
    multiply-zero :
      (x : R) -> multiply x zeroR == zeroR
    distribute :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply x (add y z) ==
      add (multiply x y) (multiply x z)
    inverse-zero :
      inverse zeroR == zeroR
    multiply-inverse :
      (x : R) ->
      x != zeroR ->
      multiply x (inverse x) == oneR

    order-reflexive :
      (x : R) -> lessOrEqual x x
    order-transitive :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y z ->
      lessOrEqual x z
    order-antisymmetric :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y x ->
      x == y
    order-total :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y or lessOrEqual y x
    add-order :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual (add z x) (add z y)
    multiply-nonnegative :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR x ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR y ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR (multiply x y)
    zero-less-than-one :
      lessOrEqual zeroR oneR and zeroR != oneR

    fromNat-zero :
      fromNat zero == zeroR
    fromNat-successor :
      (n : Nat) -> fromNat (suc n) == add (fromNat n) oneR
    fromNat-addition :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (Agda.Builtin.Nat._+_ m n) ==
      add (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-injective :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat m == fromNat n ->
      m == n

    archimedean :
      (x : R) ->
      Exists Nat (\ n -> lessOrEqual x (fromNat n))
    least-upper-bound :
      (P : R -> Set) ->
      Exists R P ->
      Exists R
        (\ upper ->
          (x : R) ->
          P x ->
          lessOrEqual x upper) ->
      Exists R
        (\ supremum ->
          ((x : R) -> P x -> lessOrEqual x supremum)
          and
          ((upper : R) ->
            ((x : R) -> P x -> lessOrEqual x upper) ->
            lessOrEqual supremum upper))

open CompleteOrderedField

StrictLess :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
StrictLess reals x y =
  lessOrEqual reals x y and x != y

SubsetOf :
  (Nat -> Set) ->
  (Nat -> Set) ->
  Set
SubsetOf A B =
  (n : Nat) ->
  A n ->
  B n

StrictSubset :
  (Nat -> Set) ->
  (Nat -> Set) ->
  Set
StrictSubset A B =
  SubsetOf A B and Not (SubsetOf B A)

putnam-1962-b2 : Set1
putnam-1962-b2 =
  (R : Set) ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) ->
  Exists (R -> Nat -> Set)
    (\ f ->
      (a b : R) ->
      StrictLess reals a b ->
      StrictSubset (f a) (f b))
