% Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench artifact putnam_1962_b2:
% there exists a real-indexed family of subsets of the positive natural numbers
% strictly increasing under proper inclusion. This file contains no proof.

putnam_1962_b2: THEORY
BEGIN
  positive_natural_set: TYPE = [posnat -> bool]

  included_in(A, B: positive_natural_set): bool =
    FORALL (n: posnat):
      A(n) IMPLIES B(n)

  properly_included_in(A, B: positive_natural_set): bool =
    included_in(A, B)
      AND EXISTS (n: posnat):
        B(n) AND NOT A(n)

  putnam_1962_b2: bool =
    EXISTS (f: [real -> positive_natural_set]):
      FORALL (a, b: real):
        a < b IMPLIES properly_included_in(f(a), f(b))
END putnam_1962_b2

(S : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)))
(hS : Convex ℝ S ∧ 0 ∈ S)
(htopo : (0 ∈ interior S) ∨ IsClosed S)

title: putnam_1962_b3
content:
(* Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench artifact putnam_1962_b3:
   a convex subset of the Euclidean plane satisfying the stated topological
   condition and omitting a point on every ray from the origin is bounded.
   This file contains no proof. *)

From Stdlib Require Import Reals.

Open Scope R_scope.

Definition point := (R * R)%type.
Definition point_set := point -> Prop.

Definition origin : point := (0, 0).

Definition point_scale (k : R) (p : point) : point :=
  (k * fst p, k * snd p).

Definition affine_combination
    (t : R) (p q : point) : point :=
  ((1 - t) * fst p + t * fst q,
   (1 - t) * snd p + t * snd q).

Definition squared_distance (p q : point) : R :=
  (fst p - fst q) * (fst p - fst q) +
  (snd p - snd q) * (snd p - snd q).

Definition convex (S : point_set) : Prop :=
  forall (p q : point) (t : R),
    S p ->
    S q ->
    0 <= t <= 1 ->
    S (affine_combination t p q).

Definition origin_is_interior (S : point_set) : Prop :=
  exists epsilon : R,
    0 < epsilon /\
    forall p : point,
      squared_distance p origin < epsilon * epsilon ->
      S p.

Definition converges_to (u : nat -> point) (p : point) : Prop :=
  forall epsilon : R,
    0 < epsilon ->
    exists N : nat,
      forall n : nat,
        (N <= n)%nat ->
        squared_distance (u n) p < epsilon * epsilon.

Definition closed (S : point_set) : Prop :=
  forall (u : nat -> point) (p : point),
    (forall n : nat, S (u n)) ->
    converges_to u p ->
    S p.

Definition same_ray (p q : point) : Prop :=
  exists k : R,
    0 < k /\
    q = point_scale k p.

Definition bounded (S : point_set) : Prop :=
  exists radius : R,
    0 <= radius /\
    forall p : point,
      S p ->
      squared_distance p origin <= radius * radius.

Theorem putnam_1962_b3 :
  forall S : point_set,
    (convex S /\ S origin) ->
    (origin_is_interior S \/ closed S) ->
    (forall P : point,
      P <> origin ->
      exists Q : point,
        same_ray P Q /\ ~ S Q) ->
    bounded S.
Admitted.

(*
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench artifact putnam_1962_b3:
  a convex subset of the real plane meeting every ray in an exterior point is
  bounded under the stated interior-or-closed hypothesis. This file contains
  no proof.
*)

let statement =
  `let convex =
     \S:(real#real)->bool.
       !x y:real#real. !u v:real.
         x IN S /\ y IN S /\
         &0 <= u /\ &0 <= v /\ u + v = &1
         ==> (u * FST x + v * FST y,
              u * SND x + v * SND y) IN S in
   let origin_interior =
     \S:(real#real)->bool.
       ?e:real.
         &0 < e /\
         !x:real#real.
           (FST x) pow 2 + (SND x) pow 2 < e pow 2
           ==> x IN S in
   let closed =
     \S:(real#real)->bool.
       !x:real#real.
         ~(x IN S)
         ==> ?e:real.
               &0 < e /\
               !y:real#real.
                 (FST y - FST x) pow 2 +
                 (SND y - SND x) pow 2 < e pow 2
                 ==> ~(y IN S) in
   let bounded =
     \S:(real#real)->bool.
       ?b:real.
         !x:real#real.
           x IN S ==> (FST x) pow 2 + (SND x) pow 2 <= b in
   !S:(real#real)->bool.
     convex S /\
     (&0,&0) IN S /\
     (origin_interior S \/ closed S) /\
     (!P:real#real.
        ~(P = (&0,&0))
        ==> ?Q:real#real. ?k:real.
              &0 < k /\
              FST Q = k * FST P /\
              SND Q = k * SND P /\
              ~(Q IN S))
     ==> bounded S`;;

;; Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1962_b3:
;; a convex subset of the real plane containing the origin, topologically
;; closed or containing the origin in its interior, is bounded when every ray
;; from the origin contains a point outside the set. This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))

;; A Dedekind-complete ordered field presents the real scalars up to the
;; unique ordered-field isomorphism. Plane points are coordinate pairs, and
;; the arbitrary set is a tame APPLY$ characteristic-function object.
;; DEFUN-SK retains every universal and existential quantifier internally.

(defun putnam-1962-b3-member-p (carrier x)
  (if (apply$ carrier (list x)) t nil))

(defun putnam-1962-b3-unary-value (operation x)
  (apply$ operation (list x)))

(defun putnam-1962-b3-binary-value (operation x y)
  (apply$ operation (list x y)))

(defun-sk putnam-1962-b3-valid-scalar-set-p (carrier set)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (apply$ set (list x))
     (putnam-1962-b3-member-p carrier x))))

(defun-sk putnam-1962-b3-field-laws-p
    (carrier add multiply negate inverse zero one)
  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (putnam-1962-b3-member-p carrier x)
      (putnam-1962-b3-member-p carrier y)
      (putnam-1962-b3-member-p carrier z))
     (and
      (putnam-1962-b3-member-p
       carrier
       (putnam-1962-b3-binary-value add x y))
      (putnam-1962-b3-member-p
       carrier
       (putnam-1962-b3-binary-value multiply x y))
      (putnam-1962-b3-member-p
       carrier
       (putnam-1962-b3-unary-value negate x))
      (implies
       (not (equal x zero))
       (putnam-1962-b3-member-p
        carrier
        (putnam-1962-b3-unary-value inverse x)))
      (equal
       (putnam-1962-b3-binary-value
        add
        (putnam-1962-b3-binary-value add x y)
        z)
       (putnam-1962-b3-binary-value
        add
        x
        (putnam-1962-b3-binary-value add y z)))
      (equal
       (putnam-1962-b3-binary-value add x y)
       (putnam-1962-b3-binary-value add y x))
      (equal
       (putnam-1962-b3-binary-value add x zero)

      (equal

        multiply

    (carrier add multiply zero less)

title: putnam_1962_b3
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1962_b3:
-- boundedness of a convex subset of the real plane that contains the origin
-- and has a point outside it on every ray. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module Putnam1962B3 where

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_)

infix 4 _!=_
infixr 3 _and_
infixr 2 _or_

data Bottom : Set where

Not :
  Set ->
  Set
Not A =
  A -> Bottom

_!=_ :
  {A : Set} ->
  A ->
  A ->
  Set
x != y =
  Not (x == y)

record _and_
  (A : Set)
  (B : Set) :
  Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data _or_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  left  : A -> A or B
  right : B -> A or B

record Exists
  (A : Set)
  (P : A -> Set) :
  Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

record CompleteOrderedField (R : Set) : Set1 where
  field
    zeroR oneR : R
    add multiply : R -> R -> R
    negate inverse : R -> R
    lessOrEqual : R -> R -> Set
    fromNat : Nat -> R

    one-not-zero :
      oneR != zeroR

    add-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> add x y == add y x
    add-associative :
      (x y z : R) -> add (add x y) z == add x (add y z)
    add-zero :
      (x : R) -> add x zeroR == x
    add-inverse :
      (x : R) -> add x (negate x) == zeroR

    multiply-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> multiply x y == multiply y x
    multiply-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply (multiply x y) z == multiply x (multiply y z)
    multiply-one :
      (x : R) -> multiply x oneR == x
    multiply-zero :
      (x : R) -> multiply x zeroR == zeroR
    distribute :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply x (add y z) ==
      add (multiply x y) (multiply x z)
    inverse-zero :
      inverse zeroR == zeroR
    multiply-inverse :
      (x : R) ->
      x != zeroR ->
      multiply x (inverse x) == oneR

    order-reflexive :
      (x : R) -> lessOrEqual x x
    order-transitive :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y z ->
      lessOrEqual x z
    order-antisymmetric :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y x ->
      x == y
    order-total :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y or lessOrEqual y x
    add-order :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual (add z x) (add z y)
    multiply-nonnegative :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR x ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR y ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR (multiply x y)
    zero-less-than-one :
      lessOrEqual zeroR oneR and zeroR != oneR

    fromNat-zero :
      fromNat zero == zeroR
    fromNat-successor :
      (n : Nat) -> fromNat (suc n) == add (fromNat n) oneR
    fromNat-addition :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m + n) == add (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-injective :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat m == fromNat n ->
      m == n

    archimedean :
      (x : R) ->
      Exists Nat (\ n -> lessOrEqual x (fromNat n))
    least-upper-bound :
      (P : R -> Set) ->
      Exists R P ->
      Exists R
        (\ upper ->
          (x : R) ->
          P x ->
          lessOrEqual x upper) ->
      Exists R
        (\ supremum ->
          ((x : R) -> P x -> lessOrEqual x supremum)
          and
          ((upper : R) ->
            ((x : R) -> P x -> lessOrEqual x upper) ->
            lessOrEqual supremum upper))

open CompleteOrderedField

record Point (R : Set) : Set where
  constructor point
  field
    x-coordinate : R
    y-coordinate : R

open Point

Subset :
  (R : Set) ->
  Set1
Subset R =
  Point R -> Set

subtract :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
subtract reals x y =
  add reals x (negate reals y)

square :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  R
square reals x =
  multiply reals x x

StrictLess :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
StrictLess reals x y =
  lessOrEqual reals x y and x != y

StrictPositive :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  Set
StrictPositive reals x =
  StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) x

origin :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  Point R
origin reals =
  point (zeroR reals) (zeroR reals)

scale :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  Point R ->
  Point R
scale reals coefficient p =
  point
    (multiply reals coefficient (x-coordinate p))
    (multiply reals coefficient (y-coordinate p))

affineCombination :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  Point R ->
  Point R ->
  Point R
affineCombination reals coefficient p q =
  point
    (add reals
      (multiply reals coefficient (x-coordinate p))
      (multiply reals
        (subtract reals (oneR reals) coefficient)
        (x-coordinate q)))
    (add reals
      (multiply reals coefficient (y-coordinate p))
      (multiply reals
        (subtract reals (oneR reals) coefficient)
        (y-coordinate q)))

Convex :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  Subset R ->
  Set
Convex reals S =
  (p q : Point _) ->
  S p ->
  S q ->
  (coefficient : _) ->
  lessOrEqual reals (zeroR reals) coefficient ->
  lessOrEqual reals coefficient (oneR reals) ->
  S (affineCombination reals coefficient p q)

squaredDistance :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  Point R ->
  Point R ->
  R
squaredDistance reals p q =
  add reals
    (square reals
      (subtract reals (x-coordinate p) (x-coordinate q)))
    (square reals
      (subtract reals (y-coordinate p) (y-coordinate q)))

OpenBall :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  Point R ->
  R ->
  Point R ->
  Set
OpenBall reals center radius p =
  StrictLess reals
    (squaredDistance reals center p)
    (square reals radius)

InteriorMember :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  Subset R ->
  Point R ->
  Set
InteriorMember {R} reals S p =
  Exists R
    (\ radius ->
      StrictPositive reals radius
      and
      ((q : Point R) ->
        OpenBall reals p radius q ->
        S q))

Closed :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  Subset R ->
  Set
Closed {R} reals S =
  (p : Point R) ->
  Not (S p) ->
  Exists R
    (\ radius ->
      StrictPositive reals radius
      and
      ((q : Point R) ->
        OpenBall reals p radius q ->
        Not (S q)))

SameRay :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  Point R ->
  Point R ->
  Set
SameRay {R} reals p q =
  Exists R
    (\ coefficient ->
      StrictPositive reals coefficient
      and
      q == scale reals coefficient p)

Bounded :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  Subset R ->
  Set
Bounded {R} reals S =
  Exists R
    (\ radius ->
      StrictPositive reals radius
      and
      ((p : Point R) ->
        S p ->
        lessOrEqual reals
          (squaredDistance reals (origin reals) p)
          (square reals radius)))

module Putnam1962B3Statement
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) where

  proposition : Set1
  proposition =
    (S : Subset R) ->
    (Convex reals S and S (origin reals)) ->
    (InteriorMember reals S (origin reals) or Closed reals S) ->
    ((P : Point R) ->
      P != origin reals ->
      Exists (Point R)
        (\ Q ->
          SameRay reals P Q
          and
          Not (S Q))) ->
    Bounded reals S

putnam-1962-b3 : Set1
putnam-1962-b3 =
  (R : Set) ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) ->
  Putnam1962B3Statement.proposition reals

title: putnam_1962_b3
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench artifact putnam_1962_b3:
  boundedness of a convex plane set that contains the origin and omits a
  point on every ray, under an interior-point or closedness assumption.
  This file contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open pairTheory pred_setTheory realTheory;

val putnam_1962_b3 =
  ``!(S : (real # real) set).
      let sqdist =
        \P Q : real # real.
          (FST P - FST Q) pow 2 + (SND P - SND Q) pow 2
      in
      let convex_plane =
        \T : (real # real) set.
          !P Q : real # real. !u : real.
            P IN T /\ Q IN T /\ 0 <= u /\ u <= 1
            ==>
            ((1 - u) * FST P + u * FST Q,
             (1 - u) * SND P + u * SND Q) IN T
      in
      let origin_interior =
        \T : (real # real) set.
          ?r : real.
            0 < r /\
            !P : real # real.
              sqdist (0, 0) P < r ==> P IN T
      in
      let converges_to =
        \(a : num -> real # real) (L : real # real).
          !e : real.
            0 < e
            ==>
            ?N : num.
              !n : num.
                N <= n ==> sqdist (a n) L < e
      in
      let closed_plane =
        \T : (real # real) set.
          !(a : num -> real # real) (L : real # real).
            (!n : num. a n IN T) /\ converges_to a L
            ==>
            L IN T
      in
      let has_outside_point_on_every_ray =
        \T : (real # real) set.
          !P : real # real.
            P <> (0, 0)
            ==>
            ?Q : real # real. ?k : real.
              0 < k /\
              Q = (k * FST P, k * SND P) /\
              Q NOTIN T
      in
      let bounded_plane =
        \T : (real # real) set.
          ?B : real.
            0 < B /\
            !P : real # real.
              P IN T ==> sqdist (0, 0) P <= B
      in
        convex_plane S /\
        (0, 0) IN S /\
        (origin_interior S \/ closed_plane S) /\
        has_outside_point_on_every_ray S
        ==>
        bounded_plane S``;

title: putnam_1962_b3
content:
$(
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench artifact putnam_1962_b3:
  a convex subset of the real Euclidean plane that contains the origin,
  satisfies the stated interior-or-closed condition, and omits a point on
  every ray from the origin is bounded. This file contains no proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  P62B3R2 is the real coordinate plane and P62B3Top is its standard finite
  product topology. P62B3Convex expands real convexity coordinatewise,
  P62B3SameRay says that the second vector is a positive scalar multiple
  of the first, and P62B3Bounded gives a uniform Euclidean norm bound.

  In the final assertion, this is equivalent to Mathlib's SameRay relation:
  zero belongs to S while Q does not, so the scalar cannot be zero. The final
  declaration is an unproved $a statement.
$)

$c P62B3I P62B3R2 P62B3Top P62B3Zero $.
$c P62B3Norm P62B3Convex P62B3SameRay P62B3Bounded $.

p62b3-index-syntax $a class P62B3I $.
p62b3-plane-syntax $a class P62B3R2 $.
p62b3-topology-syntax $a class P62B3Top $.
p62b3-zero-syntax $a class P62B3Zero $.
p62b3-norm-syntax $a class ( P62B3Norm A ) $.
p62b3-convex-syntax $a wff ( P62B3Convex A ) $.
p62b3-same-ray-syntax $a wff ( P62B3SameRay P Q ) $.
p62b3-bounded-syntax $a wff ( P62B3Bounded A ) $.

p62b3-index-definition $a |- P62B3I = ( 1 ... 2 ) $.

p62b3-plane-definition $a |- P62B3R2 = ( RR ^m P62B3I ) $.

p62b3-topology-definition $a |- P62B3Top =
  (
    Xt_ `
      ( P62B3I X. { ( topGen ` ran (,) ) } )
  )
$.

p62b3-zero-definition $a |- P62B3Zero =
  ( j e. P62B3I |-> 0 )
$.

${
  $d A j $.

  p62b3-norm-definition $a |- (
    P62B3Norm A
  ) = (
    sqrt `
      sum_ j e. P62B3I
        ( ( A ` j ) ^ 2 )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d A j t x y $.

  p62b3-convex-definition $a |- (
    ( P62B3Convex A )
    <->
    (
      A C_ P62B3R2
      /\
      A. x e. A A. y e. A A. t e. ( 0 [,] 1 )
        (
          j e. P62B3I |->
            (
              ( ( 1 - t ) x. ( x ` j ) )
              +
              ( t x. ( y ` j ) )
            )
        )
        e. A
    )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d j k P Q $.

  p62b3-same-ray-definition $a |- (
    ( P62B3SameRay P Q )
    <->
    E. k e. RR
      (
        0 < k
        /\
        Q =
          (
            j e. P62B3I |->
              ( k x. ( P ` j ) )
          )
      )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d A R x $.

  p62b3-bounded-definition $a |- (
    ( P62B3Bounded A )
    <->
    E. R e. RR
      (
        0 < R
        /\
        A. x e. A ( P62B3Norm x ) <_ R
      )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d P Q S $.

  putnambench-putnam-1962-b3 $a |- A. S
    (
      (
        (
          ( P62B3Convex S )
          /\
          P62B3Zero e. S
        )
        /\
        (
          (
            P62B3Zero e. ( ( int ` P62B3Top ) ` S )
            \/
            S e. ( Clsd ` P62B3Top )
          )
          /\
          A. P e. P62B3R2
            (
              P =/= P62B3Zero
              ->
              E. Q e. P62B3R2
                (
                  ( P62B3SameRay P Q )
                  /\
                  -. Q e. S
                )
            )
        )
      )
      ->
      ( P62B3Bounded S )
    )
  $.
$}

title: putnam_1962_b3
content:
% Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench artifact putnam_1962_b3:
% a convex subset of the real plane containing the origin is bounded when
% every origin ray leaves the set and the origin is interior or the set is
% closed. This file contains no proof.

putnam_1962_b3: THEORY
BEGIN
  point: TYPE = [# x_coord: real, y_coord: real #]
  point_set: TYPE = [point -> bool]

  zero_point: point =
    (# x_coord := 0, y_coord := 0 #)

  affine_combination(t: real, P, Q: point): point =
    (# x_coord := (1 - t) * x_coord(P) + t * x_coord(Q),
       y_coord := (1 - t) * y_coord(P) + t * y_coord(Q) #)

  positive_scale(k: real, P: point): point =
    (# x_coord := k * x_coord(P),
       y_coord := k * y_coord(P) #)

  squared_distance(P, Q: point): real =
    (x_coord(P) - x_coord(Q)) ^ 2
      + (y_coord(P) - y_coord(Q)) ^ 2

  convex(S: point_set): bool =
    FORALL (P, Q: point), (t: real):
      S(P) AND S(Q) AND 0 <= t AND t <= 1
        IMPLIES S(affine_combination(t, P, Q))

  origin_is_interior(S: point_set): bool =
    EXISTS (radius: real):
      radius > 0
        AND FORALL (P: point):
          squared_distance(P, zero_point) < radius ^ 2
            IMPLIES S(P)

  closed_set(S: point_set): bool =
    FORALL (P: point):
      NOT S(P) IMPLIES
        EXISTS (radius: real):
          radius > 0
            AND FORALL (Q: point):
              squared_distance(P, Q) < radius ^ 2
                IMPLIES NOT S(Q)

  same_origin_ray(P, Q: point): bool =
    EXISTS (k: real):
      k > 0 AND Q = positive_scale(k, P)

  bounded_set(S: point_set): bool =
    EXISTS (radius: real):
      radius > 0
        AND FORALL (P: point):
          S(P) IMPLIES
            squared_distance(P, zero_point) <= radius ^ 2

  putnam_1962_b3: bool =
    FORALL (S: point_set):
      (convex(S)
        AND S(zero_point)
        AND (origin_is_interior(S) OR closed_set(S))
        AND FORALL (P: point):
          P /= zero_point IMPLIES
            EXISTS (Q: point):
              same_origin_ray(P, Q) AND NOT S(Q))
      IMPLIES bounded_set(S)
END putnam_1962_b3

  for every natural n greater than one, the sum of (i/n)^n from i = 1
  through n lies strictly between (3n+1)/(2n+2) and 2. This file contains

  The published problem quantifies over integers n > 1. Such an n is
  necessarily natural, so the natural-number indexing used here is
  equivalent while matching HOL Light's finite interval and power APIs.
*)

;; Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench artifact putnam_1962_b5:
;; for every integer n greater than 1, the sum from i = 1 through n of
;; (i/n)^n lies strictly between (3n+1)/(2n+2) and 2. This file contains
;; no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

;; Under n > 1, every base i/n is a positive rational and the integer
;; exponent n is natural. Thus ACL2's exact rational expt and order agree
;; with the corresponding real power and inequalities in the source.
(defun putnam-1962-b5-power-sum-through (n i)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix i)))
  (if (zp i)
      0
    (+ (putnam-1962-b5-power-sum-through n (- i 1))
       (expt (/ i n) n))))

(defun putnambench-putnam-1962-b5-statement (n)
  (implies
   (and (integerp n)
        (> n 1))
   (let ((power-sum
          (putnam-1962-b5-power-sum-through n n)))
     (and
      (< (/ (+ (* 3 n) 1)
            (+ (* 2 n) 2))
         power-sum)
      (< power-sum 2)))))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

title: putnam_1962_b5
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1962_b5:
-- for every integer n greater than one, the sum from i = 1 through n of
-- (i / n) raised to n lies between (3n + 1) / (2n + 2) and 2.
-- This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module Putnam1962B5 where

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Int using (Int; pos; negsuc)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_)

infix 4 _!=_
infixr 3 _and_
infixr 2 _or_

data Bottom : Set where

Not : Set -> Set
Not A = A -> Bottom

_!=_ : {A : Set} -> A -> A -> Set
x != y = Not (x == y)

record _and_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data _or_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  left  : A -> A or B
  right : B -> A or B

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

record CompleteOrderedField (R : Set) : Set1 where
  field
    zeroR oneR : R
    add multiply : R -> R -> R
    negate inverse : R -> R
    lessOrEqual : R -> R -> Set
    fromNat : Nat -> R

    one-not-zero :
      oneR != zeroR

    add-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> add x y == add y x
    add-associative :
      (x y z : R) -> add (add x y) z == add x (add y z)
    add-zero :
      (x : R) -> add x zeroR == x
    add-inverse :
      (x : R) -> add x (negate x) == zeroR

    multiply-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> multiply x y == multiply y x
    multiply-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply (multiply x y) z == multiply x (multiply y z)
    multiply-one :
      (x : R) -> multiply x oneR == x
    multiply-zero :
      (x : R) -> multiply x zeroR == zeroR
    distribute :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply x (add y z) ==
      add (multiply x y) (multiply x z)
    inverse-zero :
      inverse zeroR == zeroR
    multiply-inverse :
      (x : R) ->
      x != zeroR ->
      multiply x (inverse x) == oneR

    order-reflexive :
      (x : R) -> lessOrEqual x x
    order-transitive :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y z ->
      lessOrEqual x z
    order-antisymmetric :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y x ->
      x == y
    order-total :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y or lessOrEqual y x
    add-order :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual (add z x) (add z y)
    multiply-nonnegative :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR x ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR y ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR (multiply x y)
    zero-less-than-one :
      lessOrEqual zeroR oneR and zeroR != oneR

    fromNat-zero :
      fromNat zero == zeroR
    fromNat-successor :
      (n : Nat) -> fromNat (suc n) == add (fromNat n) oneR
    fromNat-addition :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m + n) == add (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-injective :
      (m n : Nat) -> fromNat m == fromNat n -> m == n

    archimedean :
      (x : R) ->
      Exists Nat (\ n -> lessOrEqual x (fromNat n))
    least-upper-bound :
      (P : R -> Set) ->
      Exists R P ->
      Exists R
        (\ upper ->
          (x : R) ->
          P x ->
          lessOrEqual x upper) ->
      Exists R
        (\ supremum ->
          ((x : R) -> P x -> lessOrEqual x supremum)
          and
          ((upper : R) ->
            ((x : R) -> P x -> lessOrEqual x upper) ->
            lessOrEqual supremum upper))

open CompleteOrderedField

data IntegerGreaterThanOne : Int -> Set where
  positive-at-least-two :
    (k : Nat) ->
    IntegerGreaterThanOne (pos (suc (suc k)))

integerNaturalPart : Int -> Nat
integerNaturalPart (pos n) = n
integerNaturalPart (negsuc n) = zero

divide :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
divide reals x y =
  multiply reals x (inverse reals y)

naturalPower :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  Nat ->
  R
naturalPower reals x zero =
  oneR reals
naturalPower reals x (suc n) =
  multiply reals
    (naturalPower reals x n)
    x

sumFromOne :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  Nat ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  R
sumFromOne reals zero term =
  zeroR reals
sumFromOne reals (suc n) term =
  add reals
    (sumFromOne reals n term)
    (term (suc n))

StrictLess :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
StrictLess reals x y =
  lessOrEqual reals x y and x != y

two :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R
two reals =
  fromNat reals (suc (suc zero))

three :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R
three reals =
  fromNat reals (suc (suc (suc zero)))

putnamSum :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  Int ->
  R
putnamSum reals n =
  sumFromOne reals (integerNaturalPart n)
    (\ i ->
      naturalPower reals
        (divide reals
          (fromNat reals i)
          (fromNat reals (integerNaturalPart n)))
        (integerNaturalPart n))

lowerBound :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  Int ->
  R
lowerBound reals n =
  divide reals
    (add reals
      (multiply reals
        (three reals)
        (fromNat reals (integerNaturalPart n)))
      (oneR reals))
    (add reals
      (multiply reals
        (two reals)
        (fromNat reals (integerNaturalPart n)))
      (two reals))

module Putnam1962B5Statement
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) where

  proposition : Set
  proposition =
    (n : Int) ->
    IntegerGreaterThanOne n ->
    StrictLess reals
      (lowerBound reals n)
      (putnamSum reals n)
    and
    StrictLess reals
      (putnamSum reals n)
      (two reals)

putnam-1962-b5 : Set1
putnam-1962-b5 =
  (R : Set) ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) ->
  Putnam1962B5Statement.proposition reals

content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench artifact putnam_1962_b5:
  strict lower and upper bounds for a finite sum of integer powers of
  normalized positive integers. This file contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open arithmeticTheory integerTheory pred_setTheory realTheory intrealTheory
     real_sigmaTheory transcTheory;

val putnam_1962_b5 =
  ``!n : int.
      n > 1
      ==>
      (3 * real_of_int n + 1) / (2 * real_of_int n + 2) <
        SIGMA
          (\i : num.
             ((&i : real) / real_of_int n) powr real_of_int n)
          (IMAGE SUC (count (Num n))) /\
      SIGMA
        (\i : num.
           ((&i : real) / real_of_int n) powr real_of_int n)
        (IMAGE SUC (count (Num n))) <
        2``;

$(
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench artifact putnam_1962_b5:
  the two-sided real bound for the sum from i = 1 through n of
  (i / n) raised to the nth power, for every integer n greater than one.
  This file contains no proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  Since n is an integer greater than one, it is a positive integer, and
  natural exponentiation agrees with the real-power notation in the Lean
  and Isabelle sources on the positive terms i / n. The final declaration
  is an unproved $a statement.
$)

${
  $d i n $.

  putnambench-putnam-1962-b5 $a |- A. n e. ZZ
    (
      1 < n
      ->
      (
        (
          ( ( ( 3 x. n ) + 1 ) / ( ( 2 x. n ) + 2 ) )
          <
          sum_ i e. ( 1 ... n ) ( ( i / n ) ^ n )
        )
        /\
        (
          sum_ i e. ( 1 ... n ) ( ( i / n ) ^ n )
          <
          2

title: putnam_1962_b5

:: Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench artifact putnam_1962_b5:
:: for every natural n greater than one, the sum of (i/n)^n from i = 1
:: through n lies strictly between (3n+1)/(2n+2) and 2. This file contains
:: no proof.
::
:: The published integer condition n > 1 is equivalent to the natural
:: condition used here. The finite sequence records exactly the terms with
:: indices in Seg n, Mizar's one-based interval {1,...,n}.

environ
  vocabularies NUMBERS, NAT_1, FINSEQ_1, FINSEQ_2, RELAT_1, FUNCT_1,
    XBOOLE_0, SUBSET_1, TARSKI, CARD_1, XCMPLX_0, XREAL_0, XXREAL_0,
    REAL_1, ORDINAL1, NEWTON, INT_1, ARYTM_1, ARYTM_3, CARD_3,
    VALUED_0, VALUED_1;
  notations TARSKI, XBOOLE_0, SUBSET_1, ORDINAL1, CARD_1, NUMBERS,
    XCMPLX_0, XREAL_0, XXREAL_0, REAL_1, INT_1, NEWTON, RELAT_1,
    FUNCT_1, FINSEQ_1, RVSUM_1, FINSEQ_2, NAT_1, NAT_D;
  constructors REAL_1, NAT_D, NEWTON, RELSET_1, NUMBERS, RVSUM_1,
    FINSEQOP;
  registrations XBOOLE_0, RELAT_1, FUNCT_1, ORDINAL1, NUMBERS,
    XCMPLX_0, XXREAL_0, XREAL_0, NAT_1, INT_1, FINSEQ_1, FINSEQ_2,
    RVSUM_1, NEWTON, VALUED_0, VALUED_1, CARD_1;
  requirements REAL, NUMERALS, SUBSET, BOOLE, ARITHM;

begin

::$P-
theorem
  for n being Nat st 1 < n holds
    ex terms being FinSequence of REAL st
      len terms = n &
      (for i being Nat st i in Seg n holds
        terms.i = ((i qua Real) / (n qua Real)) |^ n) &
      (3 * (n qua Real) + 1) / (2 * (n qua Real) + 2) < Sum terms &
      Sum terms < 2
proof
end;
::$P+

title: putnam_1962_b5
content:
% Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench artifact putnam_1962_b5:
% for every integer n greater than one, the sum from i = 1 through n of
% (i/n)^n lies strictly between (3n+1)/(2n+2) and 2. This file contains no proof.

putnam_1962_b5: THEORY
BEGIN
  power_ratio_sum(n, count: nat): RECURSIVE real =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSIF n = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      power_ratio_sum(n, count - 1)
        + ((count :: real) / (n :: real)) ^ n
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  putnam_1962_b5: bool =
    FORALL (n: nat):
      n > 1 IMPLIES
        (3 * (n :: real) + 1) / (2 * (n :: real) + 2)
          < power_ratio_sum(n, n)
        AND power_ratio_sum(n, n) < 2
END putnam_1962_b5

title: putnam_1962_b6
content:
import Mathlib

open Real

/--
Let \[ f(x) = \sum_{k=0}^n a_k \sin kx + b_k \cos kx, \] where $a_k$ and $b_k$ are constants. Show that, if $\lvert f(x) \rvert \le 1$ for $0 \le x \le 2 \pi$ and $\lvert f(x_i) \rvert = 1$ for $0 \le x_1 < x_2 < \cdots < x_{2n} < 2 \pi$, then $f(x) = \cos (nx + a)$ for some constant $a$.
-/
theorem putnam_1962_b6
(n : ℕ)
(a b : ℕ → ℝ)
(xs : Set ℝ)
(f : ℝ → ℝ)
(hf : f = fun x : ℝ => ∑ k ∈ Finset.Icc 0 n, ((a k) * Real.sin (k * x) + (b k) * Real.cos (k * x)))
(hf1 : ∀ x ∈ Set.Icc 0 (2 * π), |f x| ≤ 1)
(hxs : xs.ncard = 2 * n ∧ xs ⊆ Set.Ico 0 (2 * π))
(hfxs : ∀ x ∈ xs, |f x| = 1)
: (¬∃ c : ℝ, f = fun x : ℝ => c) → ∃ a : ℝ, f = fun x : ℝ => Real.cos (n * x + a) :=
sorry

title: putnam_1962_b6
content:
Require Import Reals Ensembles Coquelicot.Hierarchy Finite_sets.

Local Coercion INR : nat >-> R.

Theorem putnam_1962_b6
    (n : nat)
    (a b : nat -> R)
    (xs : Ensemble R)
    (f : R -> R := (fun x : R => sum_n (fun k : nat => a k * sin (k * x) + b k * cos (k * x)) n))
    (hf1 : forall x : R, (0 <= x /\ x <= 2 * PI) -> abs (f x) <= 1)
    (hxs : cardinal R xs (2 * n) /\ (forall x : R, xs x -> 0 <= x /\ x < 2 * PI))
    (hfxs : forall x : R, xs x -> abs (f x) = 1)
    : (~exists c : R, f = (fun x : R => c)) -> (exists a : R, f = (fun x : R => cos (n * x + a))).
Proof. Admitted.

title: putnam_1962_b6
content:
theory putnam_1962_b6 imports Complex_Main
begin

theorem putnam_1962_b6:
  fixes n :: "nat"
    and a b :: "nat \<Rightarrow> real"
    and xs :: "real set"
    and f :: "real \<Rightarrow> real"
  defines "f \<equiv> \<lambda> x :: real. \<Sum> k \<in> {0..n}. ((a k) * sin (k * x) + (b k) * cos (k * x))"
  assumes hf1 : "\<forall> x \<in> {0..2*\<pi>}. abs (f x) \<le> 1"
    and hxs : "card xs = 2 * n \<and> xs \<subseteq> {0..<2*\<pi>}"
    and hfxs : "\<forall> x \<in> xs. abs (f x) = 1"
  shows "(\<not>(\<exists> c :: real. f = (\<lambda> x :: real. c))) \<longrightarrow> (\<exists> a :: real. f = (\<lambda> x :: real. cos (n * x + a)))"
  sorry

end

title: putnam_1962_b6
putnam_1962_b6
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench artifact putnam_1962_b6:
;; a nonconstant real trigonometric polynomial bounded by one and attaining
;; absolute value one at 2n distinct points is a phase shift of its
;; top-degree cosine. This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))

;; Ordinary ACL2 has no primitive real sort.  The context below presents an
;; arbitrary Dedekind-complete ordered field, hence the real field up to its
;; unique ordered-field isomorphism.  Sine, cosine, and pi are defined by their
;; convergent rational power series (and the Leibniz series for pi), rather
;; than supplied as certificate hypotheses.  DEFUN-SK keeps every analytic
;; quantifier and the conclusion's phase witness internal to the statement.
;;
;; Only a_0,...,a_n and b_0,...,b_n occur in the source polynomial, so finite
;; lists of length n+1 are definitionally equivalent to those initial
;; coefficient segments; arbitrary real entries, including transcendental
;; ones, remain allowed.  Likewise, a duplicate-free list of length 2n exactly
;; enumerates the source's finite set of extremal points.

(defun p62b6-member-p (carrier x)
  (if (apply$ carrier (list x)) t nil))

(defun p62b6-unary (operation x)
  (apply$ operation (list x)))

(defun p62b6-binary (operation x y)
  (apply$ operation (list x y)))

(defun-sk p62b6-field-laws-p
    (carrier add multiply negate inverse zero one)
  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and (p62b6-member-p carrier x)
          (p62b6-member-p carrier y)
          (p62b6-member-p carrier z))
     (and
      (p62b6-member-p carrier (p62b6-binary add x y))
      (p62b6-member-p carrier (p62b6-binary multiply x y))
      (p62b6-member-p carrier (p62b6-unary negate x))
      (p62b6-member-p carrier (p62b6-unary inverse x))
      (equal
       (p62b6-binary add (p62b6-binary add x y) z)
       (p62b6-binary add x (p62b6-binary add y z)))
      (equal (p62b6-binary add x y)
             (p62b6-binary add y x))
      (equal (p62b6-binary add x zero) x)
      (equal
       (p62b6-binary add x (p62b6-unary negate x))
       zero)
      (equal
       (p62b6-binary
        multiply (p62b6-binary multiply x y) z)
       (p62b6-binary
        multiply x (p62b6-binary multiply y z)))
      (equal (p62b6-binary multiply x y)
             (p62b6-binary multiply y x))
      (equal (p62b6-binary multiply x one) x)
      (implies
       (equal x zero)
       (equal (p62b6-unary inverse x) zero))
      (implies
       (not (equal x zero))
       (equal
        (p62b6-binary multiply x (p62b6-unary inverse x))
        one))
      (equal
       (p62b6-binary multiply x (p62b6-binary add y z))
       (p62b6-binary
        add
        (p62b6-binary multiply x y)
        (p62b6-binary multiply x z)))))))

(defun-sk p62b6-order-laws-p
    (carrier add multiply zero less)
  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and (p62b6-member-p carrier x)
          (p62b6-member-p carrier y)
          (p62b6-member-p carrier z))
     (and
      (not (p62b6-binary less x x))
      (or (equal x y)
          (p62b6-binary less x y)
          (p62b6-binary less y x))
      (implies
       (and (p62b6-binary less x y)
            (p62b6-binary less y z))
       (p62b6-binary less x z))
      (implies
       (p62b6-binary less x y)
       (p62b6-binary
        less
        (p62b6-binary add x z)
        (p62b6-binary add y z)))
      (implies
       (and (p62b6-binary less zero x)
            (p62b6-binary less zero y))
       (p62b6-binary
        less zero (p62b6-binary multiply x y)))))))

(defun-sk p62b6-valid-set-p (carrier set)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (apply$ set (list x))
     (p62b6-member-p carrier x))))

(defun-sk p62b6-set-nonempty-p (carrier set)
  (exists (x)
    (and (p62b6-member-p carrier x)
         (apply$ set (list x)))))

(defun-sk p62b6-upper-bound-p
    (carrier less set bound)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (and (p62b6-member-p carrier x)
          (apply$ set (list x)))
     (not (p62b6-binary less bound x)))))

(defun-sk p62b6-bounded-above-p
    (carrier less set)
  (exists (bound)
    (and
     (p62b6-member-p carrier bound)
     (p62b6-upper-bound-p carrier less set bound))))

(defun-sk p62b6-least-upper-bound-p
    (carrier less set supremum)
  (forall (bound)
    (implies
     (and
      (p62b6-member-p carrier bound)
      (p62b6-upper-bound-p carrier less set bound))
     (not (p62b6-binary less bound supremum)))))

(defun p62b6-supremum-p
    (carrier less set supremum)
  (and
   (p62b6-member-p carrier supremum)
   (p62b6-upper-bound-p carrier less set supremum)
   (p62b6-least-upper-bound-p
    carrier less set supremum)))

(defun-sk p62b6-has-supremum-p
    (carrier less set)
  (exists (supremum)
    (p62b6-supremum-p
     carrier less set supremum)))

(defun-sk p62b6-dedekind-complete-p
    (carrier less)
  (forall (set)
    (implies
     (and
      (tamep-functionp set)
      (p62b6-valid-set-p carrier set)
      (p62b6-set-nonempty-p carrier set)
      (p62b6-bounded-above-p carrier less set))
     (p62b6-has-supremum-p carrier less set))))

(defun p62b6-real-field-p
    (carrier add multiply negate inverse zero one less)
  (and
   (tamep-functionp carrier)
   (tamep-functionp add)
   (tamep-functionp multiply)
   (tamep-functionp negate)
   (tamep-functionp inverse)
   (tamep-functionp less)
   (p62b6-member-p carrier zero)
   (p62b6-member-p carrier one)
   (not (equal zero one))
   (p62b6-field-laws-p
    carrier add multiply negate inverse zero one)
   (p62b6-order-laws-p
    carrier add multiply zero less)
   (p62b6-binary less zero one)
   (p62b6-dedekind-complete-p carrier less)))

;; Real-field context and arithmetic.

(defun p62b6-r-carrier (ctx) (nth 0 ctx))
(defun p62b6-r-zero (ctx) (nth 1 ctx))
(defun p62b6-r-one (ctx) (nth 2 ctx))
(defun p62b6-r-add (ctx) (nth 3 ctx))
(defun p62b6-r-mul (ctx) (nth 4 ctx))
(defun p62b6-r-neg (ctx) (nth 5 ctx))
(defun p62b6-r-inv (ctx) (nth 6 ctx))
(defun p62b6-r-lt (ctx) (nth 7 ctx))

(defun p62b6-context-p (ctx)
  (and
   (true-listp ctx)
   (equal (len ctx) 8)
   (p62b6-real-field-p
    (p62b6-r-carrier ctx)
    (p62b6-r-add ctx)
    (p62b6-r-mul ctx)
    (p62b6-r-neg ctx)
    (p62b6-r-inv ctx)
    (p62b6-r-zero ctx)
    (p62b6-r-one ctx)
    (p62b6-r-lt ctx))))

(defun p62b6-r-add-value (ctx x y)
  (p62b6-binary (p62b6-r-add ctx) x y))

(defun p62b6-r-mul-value (ctx x y)
  (p62b6-binary (p62b6-r-mul ctx) x y))

(defun p62b6-r-neg-value (ctx x)
  (p62b6-unary (p62b6-r-neg ctx) x))

(defun p62b6-r-inv-value (ctx x)
  (p62b6-unary (p62b6-r-inv ctx) x))

(defun p62b6-r-sub-value (ctx x y)
  (p62b6-r-add-value
   ctx x (p62b6-r-neg-value ctx y)))

(defun p62b6-r-div-value (ctx x y)
  (p62b6-r-mul-value
   ctx x (p62b6-r-inv-value ctx y)))

(defun p62b6-r-lt-p (ctx x y)
  (if (p62b6-binary (p62b6-r-lt ctx) x y) t nil))

(defun p62b6-r-le-p (ctx x y)
  (not (p62b6-r-lt-p ctx y x)))

(defun p62b6-r-abs-value (ctx x)
  (if (p62b6-r-lt-p ctx x (p62b6-r-zero ctx))
      (p62b6-r-neg-value ctx x)
    x))

(defun p62b6-positive-p (ctx x)
  (and
   (p62b6-member-p (p62b6-r-carrier ctx) x)
   (p62b6-r-lt-p ctx (p62b6-r-zero ctx) x)))

(defun p62b6-r-nat (ctx n)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix n)))
  (if (zp n)
      (p62b6-r-zero ctx)
    (p62b6-r-add-value
     ctx
     (p62b6-r-one ctx)
     (p62b6-r-nat ctx (- n 1)))))

(defun p62b6-r-power (ctx x n)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix n)))
  (if (zp n)
      (p62b6-r-one ctx)
    (p62b6-r-mul-value
     ctx x (p62b6-r-power ctx x (- n 1)))))

(defun p62b6-r-factorial (ctx n)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix n)))
  (if (zp n)
      (p62b6-r-one ctx)
    (p62b6-r-mul-value
     ctx
     (p62b6-r-nat ctx n)
     (p62b6-r-factorial ctx (- n 1)))))

(defun p62b6-alternating-sign (ctx n)
  (if (evenp n)
      (p62b6-r-one ctx)
    (p62b6-r-neg-value ctx (p62b6-r-one ctx))))

;; Exact sine and cosine values via their power series.

(defun p62b6-trig-term (ctx sinep x index)
  (let* ((exponent
          (if sinep (+ (* 2 index) 1) (* 2 index)))
         (numerator
          (p62b6-r-mul-value
           ctx
           (p62b6-alternating-sign ctx index)
           (p62b6-r-power ctx x exponent)))
         (denominator
          (p62b6-r-factorial ctx exponent)))
    (p62b6-r-div-value ctx numerator denominator)))

(defun p62b6-trig-prefix (ctx sinep x terms)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix terms)))
  (if (zp terms)
      (p62b6-r-zero ctx)
    (let ((index (- terms 1)))
      (p62b6-r-add-value
       ctx
       (p62b6-trig-prefix ctx sinep x index)
       (p62b6-trig-term ctx sinep x index)))))

(defun-sk p62b6-trig-tail-p
    (ctx sinep x limit epsilon cutoff)
  (forall (terms)
    (implies
     (and (natp terms)
          (<= cutoff terms))
     (p62b6-r-lt-p
      ctx
      (p62b6-r-abs-value
       ctx
       (p62b6-r-sub-value
        ctx
        (p62b6-trig-prefix ctx sinep x terms)
        limit))
      epsilon))))

(defun-sk p62b6-trig-cutoff-exists-p
    (ctx sinep x limit epsilon)
  (exists (cutoff)
    (and
     (natp cutoff)
     (p62b6-trig-tail-p
      ctx sinep x limit epsilon cutoff))))

(defun-sk p62b6-trig-value-p
    (ctx sinep x limit)
  (forall (epsilon)
    (implies
     (p62b6-positive-p ctx epsilon)
     (p62b6-trig-cutoff-exists-p
      ctx sinep x limit epsilon))))

(defun p62b6-sine-value-p (ctx x value)
  (and
   (p62b6-member-p (p62b6-r-carrier ctx) x)
   (p62b6-member-p (p62b6-r-carrier ctx) value)
   (p62b6-trig-value-p ctx t x value)))

(defun p62b6-cosine-value-p (ctx x value)
  (and
   (p62b6-member-p (p62b6-r-carrier ctx) x)
   (p62b6-member-p (p62b6-r-carrier ctx) value)
   (p62b6-trig-value-p ctx nil x value)))

;; pi = 4 * sum_{j >= 0} (-1)^j/(2j+1).

(defun p62b6-leibniz-term (ctx index)
  (p62b6-r-div-value
   ctx
   (p62b6-alternating-sign ctx index)
   (p62b6-r-nat ctx (+ (* 2 index) 1))))

(defun p62b6-leibniz-prefix (ctx terms)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix terms)))
  (if (zp terms)
      (p62b6-r-zero ctx)
    (let ((index (- terms 1)))
      (p62b6-r-add-value
       ctx
       (p62b6-leibniz-prefix ctx index)
       (p62b6-leibniz-term ctx index)))))

(defun p62b6-pi-prefix (ctx terms)
  (p62b6-r-mul-value
   ctx
   (p62b6-r-nat ctx 4)
   (p62b6-leibniz-prefix ctx terms)))

(defun-sk p62b6-pi-tail-p
    (ctx pi-value epsilon cutoff)
  (forall (terms)
    (implies
     (and (natp terms)
          (<= cutoff terms))
     (p62b6-r-lt-p
      ctx
      (p62b6-r-abs-value
       ctx
       (p62b6-r-sub-value
        ctx (p62b6-pi-prefix ctx terms) pi-value))
      epsilon))))

(defun-sk p62b6-pi-cutoff-exists-p
    (ctx pi-value epsilon)
  (exists (cutoff)
    (and
     (natp cutoff)
     (p62b6-pi-tail-p ctx pi-value epsilon cutoff))))

(defun-sk p62b6-pi-value-p (ctx pi-value)
  (forall (epsilon)
    (implies
     (p62b6-positive-p ctx epsilon)
     (p62b6-pi-cutoff-exists-p
      ctx pi-value epsilon))))

;; Coefficients and the finite trigonometric sum.

(defun p62b6-real-list-p (ctx values)
  (if (consp values)
      (and
       (p62b6-member-p
        (p62b6-r-carrier ctx) (car values))
       (p62b6-real-list-p ctx (cdr values)))
    (equal values nil)))

(defun p62b6-trig-witness-lists-p
    (ctx x sines cosines index remaining)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix remaining)))
  (if (zp remaining)
      (and (endp sines) (endp cosines))
    (and
     (consp sines)
     (consp cosines)
     (let ((argument
            (p62b6-r-mul-value
             ctx (p62b6-r-nat ctx index) x)))
       (and
        (p62b6-sine-value-p ctx argument (car sines))
        (p62b6-cosine-value-p ctx argument (car cosines))))
     (p62b6-trig-witness-lists-p
      ctx x (cdr sines) (cdr cosines)
      (+ index 1) (- remaining 1)))))

(defun p62b6-weighted-sum
    (ctx a b sines cosines)
  (if (and (consp a)
           (consp b)
           (consp sines)
           (consp cosines))
      (p62b6-r-add-value
       ctx
       (p62b6-r-add-value
        ctx
        (p62b6-r-mul-value
         ctx (car a) (car sines))
        (p62b6-r-mul-value
         ctx (car b) (car cosines)))
       (p62b6-weighted-sum
        ctx (cdr a) (cdr b)
        (cdr sines) (cdr cosines)))
    (p62b6-r-zero ctx)))

(defun-sk p62b6-polynomial-value-p
    (ctx n a b x value)
  (exists (sines cosines)
    (and
     (p62b6-member-p (p62b6-r-carrier ctx) x)
     (p62b6-member-p (p62b6-r-carrier ctx) value)
     (p62b6-trig-witness-lists-p
      ctx x sines cosines 0 (+ n 1))
     (equal
      value
      (p62b6-weighted-sum
       ctx a b sines cosines)))))

(defun p62b6-in-closed-period-p (ctx pi-value x)
  (and
   (p62b6-member-p (p62b6-r-carrier ctx) x)
   (p62b6-r-le-p ctx (p62b6-r-zero ctx) x)
   (p62b6-r-le-p
    ctx x
    (p62b6-r-mul-value
     ctx (p62b6-r-nat ctx 2) pi-value))))

(defun p62b6-in-half-open-period-p (ctx pi-value x)
  (and
   (p62b6-member-p (p62b6-r-carrier ctx) x)
   (p62b6-r-le-p ctx (p62b6-r-zero ctx) x)
   (p62b6-r-lt-p
    ctx x
    (p62b6-r-mul-value
     ctx (p62b6-r-nat ctx 2) pi-value))))

(defun-sk p62b6-bounded-at-point-p
    (ctx n a b x)
  (exists (value)
    (and
     (p62b6-polynomial-value-p
      ctx n a b x value)
     (p62b6-r-le-p
      ctx
      (p62b6-r-abs-value ctx value)
      (p62b6-r-one ctx)))))

(defun-sk p62b6-global-bound-p
    (ctx n a b pi-value)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (p62b6-in-closed-period-p ctx pi-value x)
     (p62b6-bounded-at-point-p
      ctx n a b x))))

(defun-sk p62b6-extreme-point-p
    (ctx n a b pi-value x)
  (exists (value)
    (and
     (p62b6-in-half-open-period-p ctx pi-value x)
     (p62b6-polynomial-value-p
      ctx n a b x value)
     (equal
      (p62b6-r-abs-value ctx value)
      (p62b6-r-one ctx)))))

(defun p62b6-extreme-point-list-p
    (ctx n a b pi-value points)
  (if (consp points)
      (and
       (p62b6-extreme-point-p
        ctx n a b pi-value (car points))
       (p62b6-extreme-point-list-p
        ctx n a b pi-value (cdr points)))
    (equal points nil)))

(defun-sk p62b6-source-hypotheses-p
    (ctx n a b points)
  (exists (pi-value)
    (and
     (p62b6-member-p (p62b6-r-carrier ctx) pi-value)
     (p62b6-pi-value-p ctx pi-value)
     (p62b6-global-bound-p ctx n a b pi-value)
     (true-listp points)
     (equal (len points) (* 2 n))
     (no-duplicatesp-equal points)
     (p62b6-extreme-point-list-p

;; The source's nonconstant premise and phase-shift conclusion, with all
;; witnesses and pointwise function equalities kept internal.

(defun-sk p62b6-value-equals-p
    (ctx n a b x expected)
  (exists (value)

     (p62b6-polynomial-value-p
      ctx n a b x value)

(defun-sk p62b6-constant-value-p
    (ctx n a b constant)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (p62b6-member-p (p62b6-r-carrier ctx) x)

      ctx n a b x constant))))

(defun-sk p62b6-constant-exists-p
    (ctx n a b)
  (exists (constant)
    (and
     (p62b6-member-p
      (p62b6-r-carrier ctx) constant)

      ctx n a b constant))))

(defun-sk p62b6-matches-phase-at-p
    (ctx n a b phase x)
  (exists (polynomial-value cosine-value)
    (let ((argument
           (p62b6-r-add-value
            ctx
            (p62b6-r-mul-value
             ctx (p62b6-r-nat ctx n) x)
            phase)))
      (and
       (p62b6-polynomial-value-p
        ctx n a b x polynomial-value)
       (p62b6-cosine-value-p
        ctx argument cosine-value)
       (equal polynomial-value cosine-value)))))

(defun-sk p62b6-phase-identity-p
    (ctx n a b phase)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (p62b6-member-p (p62b6-r-carrier ctx) x)
     (p62b6-matches-phase-at-p
      ctx n a b phase x))))

(defun-sk p62b6-phase-exists-p
    (ctx n a b)
  (exists (phase)
    (and
     (p62b6-member-p (p62b6-r-carrier ctx) phase)
     (p62b6-phase-identity-p
      ctx n a b phase))))

(defun putnambench-putnam-1962-b6-statement
    (ctx n a b extreme-points)
  (implies
   (and
    (p62b6-context-p ctx)
    (natp n)
    (true-listp a)
    (true-listp b)
    (equal (len a) (+ n 1))
    (equal (len b) (+ n 1))
    (p62b6-real-list-p ctx a)
    (p62b6-real-list-p ctx b)
    (p62b6-source-hypotheses-p
     ctx n a b extreme-points)
    (not
     (p62b6-constant-exists-p
      ctx n a b)))
   (p62b6-phase-exists-p
    ctx n a b)))

title: putnam_1962_b6
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1962_b6:
-- a bounded real trigonometric polynomial attaining absolute value one at
-- 2n points is constant or a phase-shifted cosine of frequency n. This file
-- contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; _*_)
open import Agda.Primitive using (Level; _⊔_)

infix 4 _!=_ _<=N_
infixr 3 _and_
infixr 2 _or_

data Bottom : Set where

Not :
  {a : Level} ->
  Set a ->
  Set a
Not A =
  A -> Bottom

_!=_ :
  {A : Set} ->
  A ->
  A ->
  Set
x != y =
  Not (x == y)

record _and_
  {a b : Level}
  (A : Set a)
  (B : Set b) :
  Set (a ⊔ b) where
  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data _or_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  left  : A -> A or B
  right : B -> A or B

record Exists
  {a p : Level}
  (A : Set a)
  (P : A -> Set p) :
  Set (a ⊔ p) where
  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

data _<=N_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set where
  zero<=   : {n : Nat} -> zero <=N n
  suc<=suc : {m n : Nat} -> m <=N n -> suc m <=N suc n

data Fin : Nat -> Set where
  fzero : {n : Nat} -> Fin (suc n)
  fsuc  : {n : Nat} -> Fin n -> Fin (suc n)

oneN : Nat
oneN = suc zero

twoN : Nat
twoN = suc oneN

fourN : Nat
fourN = twoN + twoN

record CompleteOrderedField (R : Set) : Set1 where
  field
    zeroR oneR : R
    add multiply : R -> R -> R
    negate inverse : R -> R
    lessOrEqual : R -> R -> Set
    fromNat : Nat -> R

    one-not-zero :
      oneR != zeroR

    add-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> add x y == add y x
    add-associative :
      (x y z : R) -> add (add x y) z == add x (add y z)
    add-zero :
      (x : R) -> add x zeroR == x
    add-inverse :
      (x : R) -> add x (negate x) == zeroR

    multiply-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> multiply x y == multiply y x
    multiply-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply (multiply x y) z == multiply x (multiply y z)
    multiply-one :
      (x : R) -> multiply x oneR == x
    multiply-zero :
      (x : R) -> multiply x zeroR == zeroR
    distribute :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply x (add y z) ==
      add (multiply x y) (multiply x z)
    inverse-zero :
      inverse zeroR == zeroR
    multiply-inverse :
      (x : R) ->
      x != zeroR ->
      multiply x (inverse x) == oneR

    order-reflexive :
      (x : R) -> lessOrEqual x x
    order-transitive :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y z ->
      lessOrEqual x z
    order-antisymmetric :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y x ->
      x == y
    order-total :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y or lessOrEqual y x
    add-order :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual (add z x) (add z y)
    multiply-nonnegative :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR x ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR y ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR (multiply x y)
    zero-less-than-one :
      lessOrEqual zeroR oneR and zeroR != oneR

    fromNat-zero :
      fromNat zero == zeroR
    fromNat-successor :
      (n : Nat) -> fromNat (suc n) == add (fromNat n) oneR
    fromNat-addition :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m + n) == add (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-multiplication :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m * n) == multiply (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-injective :
      (m n : Nat) -> fromNat m == fromNat n -> m == n

    archimedean :
      (x : R) ->
      Exists Nat (\ n -> lessOrEqual x (fromNat n))
    least-upper-bound :
      (P : R -> Set) ->
      Exists R P ->
      Exists R
        (\ upper ->
          (x : R) -> P x -> lessOrEqual x upper) ->
      Exists R
        (\ supremum ->
          ((x : R) -> P x -> lessOrEqual x supremum)
          and
          ((upper : R) ->
            ((x : R) -> P x -> lessOrEqual x upper) ->
            lessOrEqual supremum upper))

open CompleteOrderedField

subtract :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
subtract reals x y =
  add reals x (negate reals y)

divide :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
divide reals x y =
  multiply reals x (inverse reals y)

StrictLess :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
StrictLess reals x y =
  lessOrEqual reals x y and x != y

maximum :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
maximum reals x y with order-total reals x y
... | left _ = y
... | right _ = x

absoluteValue :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  R
absoluteValue reals x =
  maximum reals x (negate reals x)

naturalPower :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  Nat ->
  R
naturalPower reals x zero =
  oneR reals
naturalPower reals x (suc n) =
  multiply reals (naturalPower reals x n) x

factorial : Nat -> Nat
factorial zero =
  oneN
factorial (suc n) =
  suc n * factorial n

sumFirst :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  Nat ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  R
sumFirst reals zero term =
  zeroR reals
sumFirst reals (suc n) term =
  add reals
    (sumFirst reals n term)
    (term n)

sumThrough :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  Nat ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  R
sumThrough reals zero term =
  term zero
sumThrough reals (suc n) term =
  add reals
    (sumThrough reals n term)
    (term (suc n))

CloseTo :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
CloseTo reals center radius x =
  StrictLess reals (subtract reals center radius) x
  and
  StrictLess reals x (add reals center radius)

ConvergesTo :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  R ->
  Set
ConvergesTo {R} reals sequence limit =
  (epsilon : R) ->
  StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) epsilon ->
  Exists Nat
    (\ cutoff ->
      (n : Nat) ->
      cutoff <=N n ->
      CloseTo reals limit epsilon (sequence n))

SeriesHasSum :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  R ->
  Set
SeriesHasSum reals terms limit =
  ConvergesTo reals
    (\ n -> sumFirst reals n terms)
    limit

alternatingPower :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  Nat ->
  R
alternatingPower reals n =
  naturalPower reals (negate reals (oneR reals)) n

sineTerm :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  Nat ->
  R
sineTerm reals x n =
  divide reals
    (multiply reals
      (alternatingPower reals n)
      (naturalPower reals x (suc (twoN * n))))
    (fromNat reals (factorial (suc (twoN * n))))

cosineTerm :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  Nat ->
  R
cosineTerm reals x n =
  divide reals
    (multiply reals
      (alternatingPower reals n)
      (naturalPower reals x (twoN * n)))
    (fromNat reals (factorial (twoN * n)))

leibnizTerm :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  Nat ->
  R
leibnizTerm reals n =
  divide reals
    (alternatingPower reals n)
    (fromNat reals (suc (twoN * n)))

SineValue :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
SineValue reals x value =
  SeriesHasSum reals (sineTerm reals x) value

CosineValue :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
CosineValue reals x value =
  SeriesHasSum reals (cosineTerm reals x) value

record PiValue
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R)
  (value : R) : Set where
  field
    positive :
      StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) value
    leibniz-series :
      SeriesHasSum reals
        (leibnizTerm reals)
        (divide reals value (fromNat reals fourN))

record StandardTrigonometry
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) : Set1 where
  field
    sine cosine : R -> R
    pi : R
    sine-value :
      (x : R) -> SineValue reals x (sine x)
    cosine-value :
      (x : R) -> CosineValue reals x (cosine x)
    pi-value :
      PiValue reals pi

open StandardTrigonometry

Predicate : Set -> Set1
Predicate A =
  A -> Set

SubsetOf :
  {A : Set} ->
  Predicate A ->
  Predicate A ->
  Set
SubsetOf {A} S T =
  (x : A) ->
  S x ->
  T x

record HasCardinality
  {A : Set}
  (S : Predicate A)
  (n : Nat) : Set where
  field
    enumerate :
      Fin n -> A
    enumerated-member :
      (i : Fin n) -> S (enumerate i)
    enumeration-complete :
      (x : A) ->
      S x ->
      Exists (Fin n) (\ i -> x == enumerate i)
    enumeration-injective :
      (i j : Fin n) ->
      enumerate i == enumerate j ->
      i == j

EqFunction :
  {A B : Set} ->
  (A -> B) ->
  (A -> B) ->
  Set
EqFunction {A} f g =
  (x : A) ->
  f x == g x

module Putnam1962B6Statement
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R)
  (trigonometry : StandardTrigonometry reals) where

  twoPi : R
  twoPi =
    multiply reals
      (fromNat reals twoN)
      (pi trigonometry)

  ClosedPeriod : R -> Set
  ClosedPeriod x =
    lessOrEqual reals (zeroR reals) x
    and
    lessOrEqual reals x twoPi

  HalfOpenPeriod : R -> Set
  HalfOpenPeriod x =
    lessOrEqual reals (zeroR reals) x
    and
    StrictLess reals x twoPi

  trigonometricPolynomial :
    Nat ->
    (Nat -> R) ->
    (Nat -> R) ->
    R ->
    R
  trigonometricPolynomial n a b x =
    sumThrough reals n
      (\ k ->
        add reals
          (multiply reals
            (a k)
            (sine trigonometry
              (multiply reals (fromNat reals k) x)))
          (multiply reals
            (b k)
            (cosine trigonometry
              (multiply reals (fromNat reals k) x))))

  BoundedByOne : (R -> R) -> Set
  BoundedByOne f =
    (x : R) ->
    ClosedPeriod x ->
    lessOrEqual reals
      (absoluteValue reals (f x))
      (oneR reals)

  ExtremalOn :
    Predicate R ->
    (R -> R) ->
    Set
  ExtremalOn xs f =
    (x : R) ->
    xs x ->
    absoluteValue reals (f x) == oneR reals

  Nonconstant : (R -> R) -> Set
  Nonconstant f =
    Not
      (Exists R
        (\ constant ->
          EqFunction f (\ _ -> constant)))

  proposition : Set1
  proposition =
    (n : Nat) ->
    (a b : Nat -> R) ->
    (xs : Predicate R) ->
    (f : R -> R) ->
    EqFunction f (trigonometricPolynomial n a b) ->
    BoundedByOne f ->
    (HasCardinality xs (twoN * n)
      and
      SubsetOf xs HalfOpenPeriod) ->
    ExtremalOn xs f ->
    Nonconstant f ->
    Exists R
      (\ phase ->
        EqFunction f
          (\ x ->
            cosine trigonometry
              (add reals
                (multiply reals (fromNat reals n) x)
                phase)))

putnam-1962-b6 : Set1
putnam-1962-b6 =
  (R : Set) ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) ->
  (trigonometry : StandardTrigonometry reals) ->
  Putnam1962B6Statement.proposition reals trigonometry

title: putnam_1962_b6
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench artifact putnam_1962_b6:
  a bounded real trigonometric polynomial attaining unit absolute value at
  2n points is, when nonconstant, a phase-shifted cosine. This file contains
  no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open arithmeticTheory pred_setTheory realTheory real_sigmaTheory transcTheory;

val putnam_1962_b6 =
  ``!n : num. !a b : num -> real.
      !xs : real set. !f : real -> real.
        f =
          (\x : real.
             SIGMA
               (\k : num.
                  a k * sin (&k * x) + b k * cos (&k * x))
               (count (SUC n))) /\
        (!x : real.
           0 <= x /\ x <= 2 * pi ==> abs (f x) <= 1) /\
        FINITE xs /\
        CARD xs = 2 * n /\
        (!x : real.
           x IN xs ==> 0 <= x /\ x < 2 * pi) /\
        (!x : real.
           x IN xs ==> abs (f x) = 1)
        ==>
        (~(?c : real. f = (\x : real. c))
         ==>
         ?phase : real.
           f = (\x : real. cos (&n * x + phase)))``;

title: putnam_1962_b6
content:
$(
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench artifact putnam_1962_b6:
  a bounded real trigonometric polynomial attaining absolute value one at
  2n points is, when nonconstant, a phase shift of cos(nx). This file
  contains no proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  The coefficient functions A and B are arbitrary real sequences indexed by
  nonnegative integers, F is the resulting real trigonometric polynomial,
  and S is a subset of the half-open interval [0,2*pi) with cardinality 2*n.
  The final declaration is an unproved $a statement.
$)

${
  $d A B F S c k n x $.

  putnambench-putnam-1962-b6 $a |- A. n e. NN0
    A. A A. B A. S A. F
      (
        (
          (
            (
              A : NN0 --> RR
              /\
              B : NN0 --> RR
            )
            /\
            (
              F : RR --> RR
              /\
              F =
                (
                  x e. RR |->
                    sum_ k e. ( 0 ... n )
                      (
                        (
                          ( A ` k )
                          x.
                          ( sin ` ( k x. x ) )
                        )
                        +
                        (
                          ( B ` k )
                          x.
                          ( cos ` ( k x. x ) )
                        )
                      )
                )
            )
          )
          /\
          (
            A. x e. ( 0 [,] ( 2 x. _pi ) )
              ( abs ` ( F ` x ) ) <_ 1
            /\
            (
              (
                ( # ` S ) = ( 2 x. n )
                /\
                S C_ ( 0 [,) ( 2 x. _pi ) )
              )
              /\
              A. x e. S
                ( abs ` ( F ` x ) ) = 1
            )
          )
        )
        ->
        (
          (
            -. E. c e. RR
              F = ( x e. RR |-> c )
          )
          ->
          E. c e. RR
            F =
              (
                x e. RR |->
                  ( cos ` ( ( n x. x ) + c ) )
              )
        )
      )
  $.
$}

title: putnam_1962_b6
content:
:: Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench artifact putnam_1962_b6:
:: a bounded real trigonometric polynomial attaining absolute value one on a
:: 2*n-element subset of [0,2*PI) is, when nonconstant, a phase-shifted
:: degree-n cosine. This file contains no proof.

environ
  vocabularies NUMBERS, NAT_1, FINSEQ_1, VALUED_0, FINSEQ_2, CARD_1,
    RELAT_1, SUBSET_1, XBOOLE_0, FUNCT_1, FUNCT_2, TARSKI, XREAL_0,
    ORDINAL4, BINOP_1, BINOP_2, ARYTM_1, ARYTM_3, SQUARE_1, FUNCOP_1,
    REAL_1, FINSEQOP, ZFMISC_1, VALUED_1, XXREAL_0, CARD_3, XCMPLX_0,
    SETWISEO, SETWOP_2, FINSOP_1, RVSUM_1, FUNCT_7, ORDINAL1, INT_1,
    SIN_COS, SIN_COS4, COMPLEX1;
  notations TARSKI, XBOOLE_0, SUBSET_1, ZFMISC_1, ORDINAL1, CARD_1,
    NUMBERS, VALUED_0, XCMPLX_0, XXREAL_0, XREAL_0, COMPLEX1, REAL_1,
    SQUARE_1, RELAT_1, FUNCT_1, PARTFUN1, BINOP_2, SETWISEO, FUNCT_2,
    BINOP_1, FUNCOP_1, FINSEQ_1, FINSEQ_2, FINSEQ_4, VALUED_1, NAT_1,
    FINSOP_1, FINSEQOP, SETWOP_2, RVSUM_1, INT_1, SIN_COS, SIN_COS4;
  constructors PARTFUN1, BINOP_1, SETWISEO, SQUARE_1, NAT_1, BINOP_2,
    VALUED_1, FINSEQOP, FINSEQ_4, FINSOP_1, SETWOP_2, RELSET_1,
    XXREAL_1, REAL_1, FINSEQ_2, RVSUM_1, INT_1, SIN_COS, SIN_COS4,
    COMPLEX1;
  registrations XBOOLE_0, SUBSET_1, FUNCT_1, ORDINAL1, FUNCT_2, FUNCOP_1,
    NUMBERS, XCMPLX_0, XREAL_0, XXREAL_0, SQUARE_1, NAT_1, BINOP_2,
    FINSEQ_1, FINSEQ_2, VALUED_0, VALUED_1, RELAT_1, FINSEQ_4, CARD_1,
    INT_1, RVSUM_1, SIN_COS, RELSET_1, MEMBERED;
  requirements REAL, NUMERALS, SUBSET, BOOLE, ARITHM;

begin

::$P-
theorem
  for n being Nat,
      a,b being Function of NAT,REAL,
      xs being Subset of REAL,
      f being Function of REAL,REAL st
    (for x being Real holds
      ex terms being FinSequence of REAL st
        len terms = n + 1 &
        (for j being Nat st j in Seg (n + 1) holds
          terms.j =
            a.(j -' 1) * sin(((j -' 1) qua Real) * x) +
            b.(j -' 1) * cos(((j -' 1) qua Real) * x)) &
        f.x = Sum terms) &
    (for x being Real st 0 <= x & x <= 2 * PI holds
      |.f.x.| <= 1) &
    card xs = 2 * n &
    (for x being Real st x in xs holds
      0 <= x & x < 2 * PI) &
    (for x being Real st x in xs holds
      |.f.x.| = 1)
  holds
    (not ex c being Real st
      for x being Real holds f.x = c)
    implies
    ex alpha being Real st
      for x being Real holds

% Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench artifact putnam_1962_b6:
% a bounded real trigonometric polynomial attaining absolute value one at
% 2n points is either constant or a phase-shifted cosine. This file contains no proof.

putnam_1962_b6: THEORY
BEGIN
  IMPORTING finite_sets[real]

  real_function: TYPE = [real -> real]
  real_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> real]

  safe_div(numerator, denominator: real): real =
    IF denominator = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      numerator / denominator
    ENDIF

  factorial(index: nat): RECURSIVE nat =
    IF index = 0 THEN
      1
    ELSE
      index * factorial(index - 1)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE index

  sine_partial(x: real, count: nat): RECURSIVE real =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      LET index: nat = count - 1 IN
        sine_partial(x, count - 1)
          + safe_div(
              ((-1 :: real) ^ index) * x ^ (2 * index + 1),
              factorial(2 * index + 1) :: real)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  cosine_partial(x: real, count: nat): RECURSIVE real =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      LET index: nat = count - 1 IN
        cosine_partial(x, count - 1)
          + safe_div(
              ((-1 :: real) ^ index) * x ^ (2 * index),
              factorial(2 * index) :: real)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  converges_to(sequence: real_sequence, value: real): bool =
    FORALL (epsilon_value: posreal):
      EXISTS (cutoff: nat):
        FORALL (index: nat):
          cutoff <= index IMPLIES
            abs(sequence(index) - value) < epsilon_value

  sine(x: real): real =
    epsilon(
      LAMBDA (value: real):
        converges_to(
          LAMBDA (count: nat): sine_partial(x, count),
          value))

  cosine(x: real): real =
    epsilon(
      LAMBDA (value: real):
        converges_to(
          LAMBDA (count: nat): cosine_partial(x, count),
          value))

  pi: real =
    epsilon(
      LAMBDA (value: real):
        3 < value
          AND value < 4
          AND cosine(value / 2) = 0)

  trigonometric_sum(
      a, b: real_sequence,
      x: real,
      count: nat): RECURSIVE real =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      LET index: nat = count - 1 IN
        trigonometric_sum(a, b, x, count - 1)
          + a(index) * sine((index :: real) * x)
          + b(index) * cosine((index :: real) * x)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  constant_function(f: real_function): bool =
    EXISTS (constant: real):
      f = (LAMBDA (x: real): constant)

  putnam_1962_b6: bool =
    FORALL
        (n: nat),
        (a, b: real_sequence),
        (xs: finite_set[real]),
        (f: real_function):
      ((f = (LAMBDA (x: real):
          trigonometric_sum(a, b, x, n + 1)))
        AND (FORALL (x: real):
          0 <= x AND x <= 2 * pi IMPLIES abs(f(x)) <= 1)
        AND card(xs) = 2 * n
        AND (FORALL (x: real):
          xs(x) IMPLIES 0 <= x AND x < 2 * pi)
        AND (FORALL (x: real):
          xs(x) IMPLIES abs(f(x)) = 1))
      IMPLIES
        (NOT constant_function(f) IMPLIES
          EXISTS (phase: real):
            f = (LAMBDA (x: real):
              cosine((n :: real) * x + phase)))
END putnam_1962_b6

;; Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1963_a2:
;; every strictly increasing positive-integer-valued arithmetic function with
;; f(2)=2 that is multiplicative on coprime positive inputs is the identity on
;; the positive integers. This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))

;; DEFSTUB introduces an arbitrary unary function conservatively. ACL2
;; functional instantiation makes the theorem generic over every function
;; satisfying the hypotheses, without APPLY$'s tame-function restriction.

(defstub putnam-1963-a2-function (n) t)

(defun putnam-1963-a2-value (n)
  (putnam-1963-a2-function n))

;; For positive M and N, every common divisor is at most M. Thus checking the
;; candidates from M down through 2 is equivalent to gcd(M,N)=1.
(defun putnam-1963-a2-coprime-through-p (m n divisor)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix divisor)))
  (if (and (natp divisor)
           (< 1 divisor))
      (and
       (not
        (and
         (equal (mod m divisor) 0)
         (equal (mod n divisor) 0)))
       (putnam-1963-a2-coprime-through-p
        m n (- divisor 1)))
    t))

(defun putnam-1963-a2-coprime-p (m n)
  (and
   (posp m)
   (posp n)
   (putnam-1963-a2-coprime-through-p m n m)))

(defun-sk putnam-1963-a2-positive-natural-values-p ()
  (forall (n)
    (implies
     (natp n)
     (and
      (natp (putnam-1963-a2-value n))
      (< 0 (putnam-1963-a2-value n))))))

(defun-sk putnam-1963-a2-strictly-increasing-p ()
  (forall (i j)
    (implies
     (and
      (posp i)
      (posp j)
      (< i j))
     (<
      (putnam-1963-a2-value i)
      (putnam-1963-a2-value j)))))

(defun-sk putnam-1963-a2-coprime-multiplicative-p ()
  (forall (m n)
    (implies
     (putnam-1963-a2-coprime-p m n)
     (equal
      (putnam-1963-a2-value (* m n))
      (*
       (putnam-1963-a2-value m)
       (putnam-1963-a2-value n))))))

(defun-sk putnam-1963-a2-identity-on-positive-naturals-p ()
  (forall (n)
    (implies
     (posp n)
     (equal
      (putnam-1963-a2-value n)
      n))))

(defun putnambench-putnam-1963-a2-statement ()
  (implies
   (and
    (putnam-1963-a2-positive-natural-values-p)
    (putnam-1963-a2-strictly-increasing-p)
    (equal (putnam-1963-a2-value 2) 2)
    (putnam-1963-a2-coprime-multiplicative-p))
   (putnam-1963-a2-identity-on-positive-naturals-p)))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

-- Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1963_a2:
-- a positive, strictly increasing natural-number function that fixes 2 and is
-- multiplicative on coprime positive inputs is the identity on positive
-- naturals. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality using (_≡_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _*_)

infix 4 _≤_ _<_ _∣_

data _≤_ : Nat → Nat → Set where
  zero≤ : {n : Nat} → zero ≤ n
  suc≤suc : {m n : Nat} → m ≤ n → suc m ≤ suc n

_<_ : Nat → Nat → Set
m < n = suc m ≤ n

record _∣_ (divisor dividend : Nat) : Set where
  field
    quotient : Nat
    equation : divisor * quotient ≡ dividend

record IsGCD (a b g : Nat) : Set where
  field
    gcd-divides-left : g ∣ a
    gcd-divides-right : g ∣ b
    greatest-common-divisor :
      (d : Nat) →
      d ∣ a →
      d ∣ b →
      d ∣ g

Coprime : Nat → Nat → Set
Coprime m n = IsGCD m n 1

putnam-1963-a2 : Set
putnam-1963-a2 =
  (f : Nat → Nat) →
  ((n : Nat) → zero < f n) →
  ((i j : Nat) → zero < i → i < j → f i < f j) →
  f 2 ≡ 2 →
  ((m n : Nat) →
    zero < m →
    zero < n →
    Coprime m n →
    f (m * n) ≡ f m * f n) →
  (n : Nat) →
  zero < n →
  f n ≡ n

(* Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench artifact putnam_1963_a3:
   the integral formula for an initial-value problem involving the iterated
   Euler differential operator. This file contains no proof. *)

From Stdlib Require Import
  Reals
  ClassicalDescription
  ClassicalEpsilon
  Arith.Factorial
  Arith.PeanoNat.

Open Scope R_scope.

Definition total_derivative (f : R -> R) (x : R) : R :=
  match excluded_middle_informative
          (exists value : R, derivable_pt_lim f x value) with
  | left _ =>
      epsilon (inhabits 0)
        (fun value : R => derivable_pt_lim f x value)
  | right _ => 0
  end.

Fixpoint iterated_derivative
    (n : nat) (f : R -> R) : R -> R :=
  match n with
  | O => f
  | S k => total_derivative (iterated_derivative k f)
  end.

Definition putnam_1963_a3_solution
    (f : R -> R) (n : nat) (x t : R) : R :=
  ((x - t) ^ (Nat.pred n) * f t) /
  (INR (fact (Nat.pred n)) * t ^ n).

Definition riemann_integral_value
    (f : R -> R) (a b value : R) : Prop :=
  exists integrable : Riemann_integrable f a b,
    RiemannInt integrable = value.

Definition continuous_on_from_one (f : R -> R) : Prop :=
  forall x : R,
    1 <= x ->
    forall epsilon : R,
      0 < epsilon ->
      exists delta : R,
        0 < delta /\
        forall z : R,
          1 <= z ->
          Rabs (z - x) < delta ->
          Rabs (f z - f x) < epsilon.

Definition continuously_differentiable_on_from_one
    (n : nat) (y : R -> R) : Prop :=
  forall k : nat,
    (k <= n)%nat ->
    continuous_on_from_one (iterated_derivative k y) /\
    forall x : R,
      1 <= x ->
      (k < n)%nat ->
      derivable_pt_lim
        (iterated_derivative k y) x
        (iterated_derivative (S k) y x).

Definition continuously_differentiable_at
    (n : nat) (y : R -> R) (a : R) : Prop :=
  exists radius : R,
    0 < radius /\
    forall (k : nat) (x : R),
      (k <= n)%nat ->
      Rabs (x - a) < radius ->
      continuity_pt (iterated_derivative k y) x /\
      ((k < n)%nat ->
       derivable_pt_lim
         (iterated_derivative k y) x
         (iterated_derivative (S k) y x)).

Theorem putnam_1963_a3 :
  forall
    (P : nat -> (R -> R) -> (R -> R))
    (n : nat)
    (f y : R -> R),
    ((forall u : R -> R, P 0%nat u = u) /\
     forall (i : nat) (u : R -> R),
       P (S i) u =
       P i
         (fun x : R =>
            x * total_derivative u x - INR i * u x)) ->
    (0 < n)%nat ->
    continuous_on_from_one f ->
    continuously_differentiable_on_from_one n y ->
    continuously_differentiable_at n y 1 ->
    (((forall i : nat,
         (i < n)%nat ->
         iterated_derivative i y 1 = 0) /\
      (forall x : R,
         1 <= x ->
         P n y x = f x)) <->
     (forall x : R,
        1 <= x ->
        riemann_integral_value
          (putnam_1963_a3_solution f n x) 1 x (y x))).
Admitted.
