;; Statement-only formalization of the PutnamBench corpus artifact
;; putnam_1963_a3: the integral formula for the zero-initial-value solution of
;; the Euler differential equation delta(delta-1)...(delta-n+1)y=f on [1,+oo).
;; This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))

;; Arbitrary sets and functions are tame APPLY$ function objects. FN-EQUAL
;; supplies unbounded universal quantification, and inequality with a
;; constant-false function supplies internal existential quantification.
;; The scalar context is a Dedekind-complete ordered field, hence a
;; presentation of the real field. Continuity, derivatives, and the Riemann
;; integral of the continuous kernel are expanded below. The derivative family
;; remains internally quantified, and APPLY$ functions are not finite tables.

(defun p63a3-quoted (object)
  (list 'quote object))

(defun p63a3-term-list (terms)
  (if (consp terms)
      (list 'cons
            (car terms)
            (p63a3-term-list (cdr terms)))
    (p63a3-quoted nil)))

(defun p63a3-apply-term (function-term arguments)
  (list 'apply$
        function-term
        (p63a3-term-list arguments)))

(defun p63a3-static-apply-term (function arguments)
  (p63a3-apply-term
   (p63a3-quoted function)
   arguments))

(defun p63a3-and-terms (terms)
  (if (consp terms)
      (list 'if
            (car terms)
            (p63a3-and-terms (cdr terms))
            (p63a3-quoted nil))
    (p63a3-quoted t)))

(defun p63a3-or-terms (terms)
  (if (consp terms)
      (list 'if
            (car terms)
            (p63a3-quoted t)
            (p63a3-or-terms (cdr terms)))
    (p63a3-quoted nil)))

(defun p63a3-not-term (term)
  (list 'if term
        (p63a3-quoted nil)
        (p63a3-quoted t)))

(defun p63a3-implies-term (hypothesis conclusion)
  (list 'if hypothesis conclusion (p63a3-quoted t)))

(defun p63a3-true-function (formals)
  (list 'lambda formals (p63a3-quoted t)))

(defun p63a3-false-function (formals)
  (list 'lambda formals (p63a3-quoted nil)))

(defun p63a3-universal-p (function formals)
  (let ((always-true (p63a3-true-function formals)))
    (and (tamep-functionp function)
         (tamep-functionp always-true)
         (fn-equal function always-true))))

(defun p63a3-exists-p (function formals)
  (let ((always-false (p63a3-false-function formals)))
    (and (tamep-functionp function)
         (tamep-functionp always-false)
         (not (fn-equal function always-false)))))

(defun p63a3-member-p (predicate object)
  (if (apply$ predicate (list object)) t nil))

(defun p63a3-unary-value (function object)
  (apply$ function (list object)))

(defun p63a3-binary-value (function left right)
  (apply$ function (list left right)))

;; Arbitrary real-valued functions and arbitrary subsets of the real carrier.

(defun p63a3-function-values-function (carrier function)
  (list
   'lambda '(x)
   (p63a3-implies-term
    (p63a3-static-apply-term carrier '(x))
    (p63a3-static-apply-term
     carrier
     (list (p63a3-static-apply-term function '(x)))))))

(defun p63a3-real-function-p (carrier function)
  (and
   (tamep-functionp function)
   (p63a3-universal-p
    (p63a3-function-values-function carrier function)
    '(x))))

(defun p63a3-set-subset-carrier-function (carrier set)
  (list
   'lambda '(x)
   (p63a3-implies-term
    (p63a3-static-apply-term set '(x))
    (p63a3-static-apply-term carrier '(x)))))

(defun p63a3-valid-set-p (carrier set)
  (and
   (tamep-functionp set)
   (p63a3-universal-p
    (p63a3-set-subset-carrier-function carrier set)
    '(x))))

;; A Dedekind-complete ordered field, used as an abstract presentation of R.

(defun p63a3-field-laws-function
    (carrier zero one add multiply negate inverse)
  (let* ((xy-add (p63a3-static-apply-term add '(x y)))
         (yz-add (p63a3-static-apply-term add '(y z)))
         (xy-mul (p63a3-static-apply-term multiply '(x y)))
         (yz-mul (p63a3-static-apply-term multiply '(y z)))
         (neg-x (p63a3-static-apply-term negate '(x)))
         (inv-x (p63a3-static-apply-term inverse '(x))))
    (list
     'lambda '(x y z)
     (p63a3-implies-term
      (p63a3-and-terms
       (list
        (p63a3-static-apply-term carrier '(x))
        (p63a3-static-apply-term carrier '(y))
        (p63a3-static-apply-term carrier '(z))))
      (p63a3-and-terms
       (list
        (p63a3-static-apply-term carrier (list xy-add))
        (p63a3-static-apply-term carrier (list xy-mul))
        (p63a3-static-apply-term carrier (list neg-x))
        (p63a3-static-apply-term carrier (list inv-x))
        (list 'equal
              (p63a3-static-apply-term add (list xy-add 'z))
              (p63a3-static-apply-term add (list 'x yz-add)))
        (list 'equal xy-add
              (p63a3-static-apply-term add '(y x)))
        (list 'equal
              (p63a3-static-apply-term
               add (list 'x (p63a3-quoted zero)))
              'x)
        (list 'equal
              (p63a3-static-apply-term add (list 'x neg-x))
              (p63a3-quoted zero))
        (list 'equal
              (p63a3-static-apply-term multiply (list xy-mul 'z))
              (p63a3-static-apply-term multiply (list 'x yz-mul)))
        (list 'equal xy-mul
              (p63a3-static-apply-term multiply '(y x)))
        (list 'equal
              (p63a3-static-apply-term
               multiply (list 'x (p63a3-quoted one)))
              'x)
        (p63a3-implies-term
         (list 'equal 'x (p63a3-quoted zero))
         (list 'equal inv-x (p63a3-quoted zero)))
        (p63a3-implies-term
         (p63a3-not-term
          (list 'equal 'x (p63a3-quoted zero)))
         (list 'equal
               (p63a3-static-apply-term
                multiply (list 'x inv-x))
               (p63a3-quoted one)))
        (list 'equal
              (p63a3-static-apply-term multiply (list 'x yz-add))
              (p63a3-static-apply-term
               add
               (list
                (p63a3-static-apply-term multiply '(x y))
                (p63a3-static-apply-term multiply '(x z)))))))))))

(defun p63a3-order-laws-function
    (carrier zero add multiply less)
  (let ((xy (p63a3-static-apply-term less '(x y)))
        (yx (p63a3-static-apply-term less '(y x)))
        (yz (p63a3-static-apply-term less '(y z))))
    (list
     'lambda '(x y z)
     (p63a3-implies-term
      (p63a3-and-terms
       (list
        (p63a3-static-apply-term carrier '(x))
        (p63a3-static-apply-term carrier '(y))
        (p63a3-static-apply-term carrier '(z))))
      (p63a3-and-terms
       (list
        (p63a3-not-term
         (p63a3-static-apply-term less '(x x)))
        (p63a3-or-terms
         (list xy yx (list 'equal 'x 'y)))
        (p63a3-implies-term
         (p63a3-and-terms (list xy yz))
         (p63a3-static-apply-term less '(x z)))
        (p63a3-implies-term
         xy
         (p63a3-static-apply-term
          less
          (list
           (p63a3-static-apply-term add '(x z))
           (p63a3-static-apply-term add '(y z)))))
        (p63a3-implies-term
         (p63a3-and-terms
          (list
           (p63a3-static-apply-term
            less (list (p63a3-quoted zero) 'x))
           (p63a3-static-apply-term
            less (list (p63a3-quoted zero) 'y))))
         (p63a3-static-apply-term
          less
          (list
           (p63a3-quoted zero)
           (p63a3-static-apply-term multiply '(x y)))))))))))

(defun p63a3-upper-bound-function
    (carrier less set upper)
  (list
   'lambda '(x)
   (p63a3-implies-term
    (p63a3-and-terms
     (list
      (p63a3-static-apply-term carrier '(x))
      (p63a3-static-apply-term set '(x))))
    (p63a3-not-term
     (p63a3-static-apply-term
      less (list (p63a3-quoted upper) 'x))))))

(defun p63a3-upper-bound-p
    (carrier less set upper)
  (and
   (p63a3-member-p carrier upper)
   (p63a3-valid-set-p carrier set)
   (p63a3-universal-p
    (p63a3-upper-bound-function carrier less set upper)
    '(x))))

(defun p63a3-set-nonempty-function (carrier set)
  (list
   'lambda '(x)
   (p63a3-and-terms
    (list
     (p63a3-static-apply-term carrier '(x))
     (p63a3-static-apply-term set '(x))))))

(defun p63a3-set-nonempty-p (carrier set)
  (and
   (p63a3-valid-set-p carrier set)
   (p63a3-exists-p
    (p63a3-set-nonempty-function carrier set)
    '(x))))

(defun p63a3-bounded-above-function
    (carrier less set)
  (list
   'lambda '(upper)
   (list 'p63a3-upper-bound-p
         (p63a3-quoted carrier)
         (p63a3-quoted less)
         (p63a3-quoted set)
         'upper)))

(defun p63a3-bounded-above-p (carrier less set)
  (p63a3-exists-p
   (p63a3-bounded-above-function carrier less set)
   '(upper)))

(defun p63a3-least-upper-bound-function
    (carrier less set supremum)
  (list
   'lambda '(upper)
   (p63a3-implies-term
    (list 'p63a3-upper-bound-p
          (p63a3-quoted carrier)
          (p63a3-quoted less)
          (p63a3-quoted set)
          'upper)
    (p63a3-not-term
     (p63a3-static-apply-term
      less (list 'upper (p63a3-quoted supremum)))))))

(defun p63a3-least-upper-bound-p
    (carrier less set supremum)
  (and
   (p63a3-upper-bound-p carrier less set supremum)
   (p63a3-universal-p
    (p63a3-least-upper-bound-function
     carrier less set supremum)
    '(upper))))

(defun p63a3-completeness-function
    (carrier less supremum-operation)
  (list
   'lambda '(set)
   (p63a3-implies-term
    (p63a3-and-terms
     (list
      (list 'p63a3-valid-set-p
            (p63a3-quoted carrier) 'set)
      (list 'p63a3-set-nonempty-p
            (p63a3-quoted carrier) 'set)
      (list 'p63a3-bounded-above-p
            (p63a3-quoted carrier)
            (p63a3-quoted less)
            'set)))
    (list 'p63a3-least-upper-bound-p
          (p63a3-quoted carrier)
          (p63a3-quoted less)
          'set
          (p63a3-static-apply-term
           supremum-operation '(set))))))

(defun p63a3-real-field-p
    (carrier zero one add multiply negate inverse less supremum)
  (and
   (tamep-functionp carrier)
   (tamep-functionp add)
   (tamep-functionp multiply)
   (tamep-functionp negate)
   (tamep-functionp inverse)
   (tamep-functionp less)
   (tamep-functionp supremum)
   (p63a3-member-p carrier zero)
   (p63a3-member-p carrier one)
   (not (equal zero one))
   (p63a3-universal-p
    (p63a3-field-laws-function
     carrier zero one add multiply negate inverse)
    '(x y z))
   (p63a3-universal-p
    (p63a3-order-laws-function
     carrier zero add multiply less)
    '(x y z))
   (p63a3-universal-p
    (p63a3-completeness-function
     carrier less supremum)
    '(set))
   (p63a3-binary-value less zero one)))

;; Real-field context and arithmetic.

(defun p63a3-r-carrier (ctx) (nth 0 ctx))
(defun p63a3-r-zero (ctx) (nth 1 ctx))
(defun p63a3-r-one (ctx) (nth 2 ctx))
(defun p63a3-r-add (ctx) (nth 3 ctx))
(defun p63a3-r-mul (ctx) (nth 4 ctx))
(defun p63a3-r-neg (ctx) (nth 5 ctx))
(defun p63a3-r-inv (ctx) (nth 6 ctx))
(defun p63a3-r-lt (ctx) (nth 7 ctx))
(defun p63a3-r-sup (ctx) (nth 8 ctx))

(defun p63a3-context-p (ctx)
  (and
   (true-listp ctx)
   (equal (len ctx) 9)
   (p63a3-real-field-p
    (p63a3-r-carrier ctx)
    (p63a3-r-zero ctx)
    (p63a3-r-one ctx)
    (p63a3-r-add ctx)
    (p63a3-r-mul ctx)
    (p63a3-r-neg ctx)
    (p63a3-r-inv ctx)
    (p63a3-r-lt ctx)
    (p63a3-r-sup ctx))))

(defun p63a3-r-add-value (ctx left right)
  (p63a3-binary-value (p63a3-r-add ctx) left right))

(defun p63a3-r-neg-value (ctx value)
  (p63a3-unary-value (p63a3-r-neg ctx) value))

(defun p63a3-r-sub-value (ctx left right)
  (p63a3-r-add-value
   ctx left (p63a3-r-neg-value ctx right)))

(defun p63a3-r-mul-value (ctx left right)
  (p63a3-binary-value (p63a3-r-mul ctx) left right))

(defun p63a3-r-inv-value (ctx value)
  (p63a3-unary-value (p63a3-r-inv ctx) value))

(defun p63a3-r-div-value (ctx numerator denominator)
  (p63a3-r-mul-value
   ctx numerator (p63a3-r-inv-value ctx denominator)))

(defun p63a3-r-lt-p (ctx left right)
  (if (p63a3-binary-value
       (p63a3-r-lt ctx) left right)
      t nil))

(defun p63a3-r-le-p (ctx left right)
  (not (p63a3-r-lt-p ctx right left)))

(defun p63a3-r-abs-value (ctx value)
  (if (p63a3-r-lt-p ctx value (p63a3-r-zero ctx))
      (p63a3-r-neg-value ctx value)
    value))

(defun p63a3-positive-real-p (ctx value)
  (and
   (p63a3-member-p (p63a3-r-carrier ctx) value)
   (p63a3-r-lt-p ctx (p63a3-r-zero ctx) value)))

;; Natural-number arithmetic interpreted in the abstract real field.

(defun p63a3-r-nat-value (ctx n)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix n)))
  (if (zp n)
      (p63a3-r-zero ctx)
    (p63a3-r-add-value
     ctx
     (p63a3-r-one ctx)
     (p63a3-r-nat-value ctx (- n 1)))))

(defun p63a3-r-power-value (ctx base exponent)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix exponent)))
  (if (zp exponent)
      (p63a3-r-one ctx)
    (p63a3-r-mul-value
     ctx
     base
     (p63a3-r-power-value ctx base (- exponent 1)))))

(defun p63a3-r-factorial-value (ctx n)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix n)))
  (if (zp n)
      (p63a3-r-one ctx)
    (p63a3-r-mul-value
     ctx
     (p63a3-r-nat-value ctx n)
     (p63a3-r-factorial-value ctx (- n 1)))))

;; Unordered closed and open intervals with endpoints x0 and x.

(defun p63a3-lower-endpoint (ctx x0 x)
  (if (p63a3-r-lt-p ctx x0 x) x0 x))

(defun p63a3-upper-endpoint (ctx x0 x)
  (if (p63a3-r-lt-p ctx x0 x) x x0))

(defun p63a3-uioo-set (ctx x0 x)
  (let ((lower (p63a3-lower-endpoint ctx x0 x))
        (upper (p63a3-upper-endpoint ctx x0 x)))
    (list
     'lambda '(point)
     (p63a3-and-terms
      (list
       (p63a3-static-apply-term
        (p63a3-r-carrier ctx) '(point))
       (p63a3-static-apply-term
        (p63a3-r-lt ctx)
        (list (p63a3-quoted lower) 'point))
       (p63a3-static-apply-term
        (p63a3-r-lt ctx)
        (list 'point (p63a3-quoted upper))))))))

(defun p63a3-uicc-set (ctx x0 x)
  (let ((lower (p63a3-lower-endpoint ctx x0 x))
        (upper (p63a3-upper-endpoint ctx x0 x)))
    (list
     'lambda '(point)
     (p63a3-and-terms
      (list
       (p63a3-static-apply-term
        (p63a3-r-carrier ctx) '(point))
       (p63a3-not-term
        (p63a3-static-apply-term
         (p63a3-r-lt ctx)
         (list 'point (p63a3-quoted lower))))
       (p63a3-not-term
        (p63a3-static-apply-term
         (p63a3-r-lt ctx)
         (list (p63a3-quoted upper) 'point))))))))

;; A derivative family maps each natural order to a real-valued function.

(defun p63a3-derivative-function (derivatives order)
  (p63a3-unary-value derivatives order))

(defun p63a3-derivative-value (derivatives order point)
  (p63a3-unary-value
   (p63a3-derivative-function derivatives order)
   point))

(defun p63a3-derivative-family-row-function
    (ctx derivatives maximum-order)
  (list
   'lambda '(order)
   (p63a3-implies-term
    (p63a3-and-terms
     (list
      (list 'natp 'order)
      (list '<= 'order (p63a3-quoted maximum-order))))
    (list 'p63a3-real-function-p
          (p63a3-quoted (p63a3-r-carrier ctx))
          (p63a3-static-apply-term derivatives '(order))))))

(defun p63a3-derivative-family-p
    (ctx derivatives maximum-order)
  (and
   (tamep-functionp derivatives)
   (p63a3-universal-p
    (p63a3-derivative-family-row-function
     ctx derivatives maximum-order)
    '(order))))

;; Continuity within the unordered closed interval.

(defun p63a3-continuity-point-function
    (ctx function interval point epsilon radius)
  (list
   'lambda '(nearby)
   (p63a3-implies-term
    (p63a3-and-terms
     (list
      (p63a3-static-apply-term interval '(nearby))
      (list 'p63a3-r-lt-p
            (p63a3-quoted ctx)
            (list 'p63a3-r-abs-value
                  (p63a3-quoted ctx)
                  (list 'p63a3-r-sub-value
                        (p63a3-quoted ctx)
                        'nearby
                        (p63a3-quoted point)))
            (p63a3-quoted radius))))
    (list 'p63a3-r-lt-p
          (p63a3-quoted ctx)
          (list 'p63a3-r-abs-value
                (p63a3-quoted ctx)
                (list 'p63a3-r-sub-value
                      (p63a3-quoted ctx)
                      (p63a3-static-apply-term function '(nearby))
                      (p63a3-static-apply-term
                       function
                       (list (p63a3-quoted point)))))
          (p63a3-quoted epsilon)))))

(defun p63a3-continuity-radius-function
    (ctx function interval point epsilon)
  (list
   'lambda '(radius)
   (p63a3-and-terms
    (list
     (list 'p63a3-positive-real-p
           (p63a3-quoted ctx) 'radius)
     (list 'p63a3-universal-p
           (list 'p63a3-continuity-point-function
                 (p63a3-quoted ctx)
                 (p63a3-quoted function)
                 (p63a3-quoted interval)
                 (p63a3-quoted point)
                 (p63a3-quoted epsilon)
                 'radius)
           (p63a3-quoted '(nearby)))))))

(defun p63a3-continuity-epsilon-function
    (ctx function interval point)
  (list
   'lambda '(epsilon)
   (p63a3-implies-term
    (list 'p63a3-positive-real-p
          (p63a3-quoted ctx) 'epsilon)
    (list 'p63a3-exists-p
          (list 'p63a3-continuity-radius-function
                (p63a3-quoted ctx)
                (p63a3-quoted function)
                (p63a3-quoted interval)
                (p63a3-quoted point)
                'epsilon)
          (p63a3-quoted '(radius))))))

(defun p63a3-continuous-within-at-p
    (ctx function interval point)
  (and
   (p63a3-member-p interval point)
   (p63a3-universal-p
    (p63a3-continuity-epsilon-function
     ctx function interval point)
    '(epsilon))))

(defun p63a3-continuous-on-row-function
    (ctx function interval)
  (list
   'lambda '(point)
   (p63a3-implies-term
    (p63a3-static-apply-term interval '(point))
    (list 'p63a3-continuous-within-at-p
          (p63a3-quoted ctx)
          (p63a3-quoted function)
          (p63a3-quoted interval)
          'point))))

(defun p63a3-continuous-on-p
    (ctx function interval)
  (p63a3-universal-p
   (p63a3-continuous-on-row-function
    ctx function interval)
   '(point)))

;; HasDerivWithinAt in epsilon-delta form, with nearby points restricted to
;; INTERVAL. Taking INTERVAL to be the whole carrier gives HasDerivAt.

(defun p63a3-derivative-point-function
    (ctx function derivative interval point epsilon radius)
  (list
   'lambda '(nearby)
   (p63a3-implies-term
    (p63a3-and-terms
     (list
      (p63a3-static-apply-term interval '(nearby))
      (list 'p63a3-r-lt-p
            (p63a3-quoted ctx)
            (list 'p63a3-r-abs-value
                  (p63a3-quoted ctx)
                  (list 'p63a3-r-sub-value
                        (p63a3-quoted ctx)
                        'nearby
                        (p63a3-quoted point)))
            (p63a3-quoted radius))))
    (list 'p63a3-r-le-p
          (p63a3-quoted ctx)
          (list 'p63a3-r-abs-value
                (p63a3-quoted ctx)
                (list 'p63a3-r-sub-value
                      (p63a3-quoted ctx)
                      (list 'p63a3-r-sub-value
                            (p63a3-quoted ctx)
                            (p63a3-static-apply-term function '(nearby))
                            (p63a3-static-apply-term
                             function
                             (list (p63a3-quoted point))))
                      (list 'p63a3-r-mul-value
                            (p63a3-quoted ctx)
                            (p63a3-quoted derivative)
                            (list 'p63a3-r-sub-value
                                  (p63a3-quoted ctx)
                                  'nearby
                                  (p63a3-quoted point)))))
          (list 'p63a3-r-mul-value
                (p63a3-quoted ctx)
                (p63a3-quoted epsilon)
                (list 'p63a3-r-abs-value
                      (p63a3-quoted ctx)
                      (list 'p63a3-r-sub-value
                            (p63a3-quoted ctx)
                            'nearby
                            (p63a3-quoted point))))))))

(defun p63a3-derivative-radius-function
    (ctx function derivative interval point epsilon)
  (list
   'lambda '(radius)
   (p63a3-and-terms
    (list
     (list 'p63a3-positive-real-p
           (p63a3-quoted ctx) 'radius)
     (list 'p63a3-universal-p
           (list 'p63a3-derivative-point-function
                 (p63a3-quoted ctx)
                 (p63a3-quoted function)
                 (p63a3-quoted derivative)
                 (p63a3-quoted interval)
                 (p63a3-quoted point)
                 (p63a3-quoted epsilon)
                 'radius)
           (p63a3-quoted '(nearby)))))))

(defun p63a3-derivative-epsilon-function
    (ctx function derivative interval point)
  (list
   'lambda '(epsilon)
   (p63a3-implies-term
    (list 'p63a3-positive-real-p
          (p63a3-quoted ctx) 'epsilon)
    (list 'p63a3-exists-p
          (list 'p63a3-derivative-radius-function
                (p63a3-quoted ctx)
                (p63a3-quoted function)
                (p63a3-quoted derivative)
                (p63a3-quoted interval)
                (p63a3-quoted point)
                'epsilon)
          (p63a3-quoted '(radius))))))

(defun p63a3-has-derivative-within-at-p
    (ctx function derivative interval point)
  (and
   (p63a3-member-p (p63a3-r-carrier ctx) derivative)
   (p63a3-member-p interval point)
   (p63a3-universal-p
    (p63a3-derivative-epsilon-function
     ctx function derivative interval point)
    '(epsilon))))

;; The explicit derivative family is definitionally tied to f: order zero is
;; f, orders below n differentiate within the closed interval, all orders
;; through n are continuous there, and order n+1 differentiates order n on
;; the open interval.

(defun p63a3-contdiff-order-row-function
    (ctx derivatives order interval)
  (list
   'lambda '(index)
   (p63a3-implies-term
    (p63a3-and-terms
     (list
      (list 'natp 'index)
      (list '<= 'index (p63a3-quoted order))))
    (list 'p63a3-continuous-on-p
          (p63a3-quoted ctx)
          (p63a3-static-apply-term derivatives '(index))
          (p63a3-quoted interval)))))

(defun p63a3-derivative-chain-point-function
    (ctx derivatives interval index)
  (let ((function-term
         (p63a3-derivative-function derivatives index))
        (next-function-term
         (p63a3-derivative-function derivatives (+ 1 index))))
    (list
     'lambda '(point)
     (p63a3-implies-term
      (p63a3-static-apply-term interval '(point))
      (list 'p63a3-has-derivative-within-at-p
            (p63a3-quoted ctx)
            (p63a3-quoted function-term)
            (p63a3-static-apply-term next-function-term '(point))
            (p63a3-quoted interval)
            'point)))))

(defun p63a3-derivative-chain-row-function
    (ctx derivatives order interval)
  (list
   'lambda '(index)
   (p63a3-implies-term
    (p63a3-and-terms
     (list
      (list 'natp 'index)
      (list '< 'index (p63a3-quoted order))))
    (list 'p63a3-universal-p
          (list 'p63a3-derivative-chain-point-function
                (p63a3-quoted ctx)
                (p63a3-quoted derivatives)
                (p63a3-quoted interval)
                'index)
          (p63a3-quoted '(point))))))

(defun p63a3-contdiff-through-p
    (ctx f derivatives order interval)
  (and
   (fn-equal
    (p63a3-derivative-function derivatives 0)
    f)
   (p63a3-universal-p
    (p63a3-contdiff-order-row-function
     ctx derivatives order interval)
    '(index))
   (p63a3-universal-p
    (p63a3-derivative-chain-row-function
     ctx derivatives order interval)
    '(index))))

(defun p63a3-next-derivative-row-function
    (ctx derivatives order closed-interval open-interval)
  (let ((nth-function
         (p63a3-derivative-function derivatives order))
        (next-function
         (p63a3-derivative-function derivatives (+ 1 order))))
    (list
     'lambda '(point)
     (p63a3-implies-term
      (p63a3-static-apply-term open-interval '(point))
      (list 'p63a3-has-derivative-within-at-p
            (p63a3-quoted ctx)
            (p63a3-quoted nth-function)
            (p63a3-static-apply-term next-function '(point))
            (p63a3-quoted closed-interval)
            'point)))))

(defun p63a3-next-derivative-on-interior-p
    (ctx derivatives order closed-interval open-interval)
  (p63a3-universal-p
   (p63a3-next-derivative-row-function
    ctx derivatives order closed-interval open-interval)
   '(point)))

;; The closed half-line [1,+oo), the whole real carrier, and open balls.

(defun p63a3-ici-set (ctx lower)
  (list
   'lambda '(point)
   (p63a3-and-terms
    (list
     (p63a3-static-apply-term
      (p63a3-r-carrier ctx) '(point))
     (p63a3-not-term
      (p63a3-static-apply-term
       (p63a3-r-lt ctx)
       (list 'point (p63a3-quoted lower))))))))

(defun p63a3-univ-set (ctx)
  (list
   'lambda '(point)
   (p63a3-static-apply-term
    (p63a3-r-carrier ctx) '(point))))

(defun p63a3-open-ball-set (ctx center radius)
  (list
   'lambda '(point)
   (p63a3-and-terms
    (list
     (p63a3-static-apply-term
      (p63a3-r-carrier ctx) '(point))
     (list 'p63a3-r-lt-p
           (p63a3-quoted ctx)
           (list 'p63a3-r-abs-value
                 (p63a3-quoted ctx)
                 (list 'p63a3-r-sub-value
                       (p63a3-quoted ctx)
                       'point
                       (p63a3-quoted center)))
           (p63a3-quoted radius))))))

;; ContDiffOn of order N on [1,+oo), together with ContDiffAt of order N at
;; 1. The latter is represented by an internally existential open radius.

(defun p63a3-halfline-regularity-p (ctx y derivatives n)
  (let ((halfline (p63a3-ici-set ctx (p63a3-r-one ctx))))
    (and
     (p63a3-derivative-family-p ctx derivatives n)
     (fn-equal (p63a3-derivative-function derivatives 0) y)
     (p63a3-contdiff-through-p
      ctx y derivatives n halfline))))

(defun p63a3-local-contdiff-radius-witness-p
    (ctx y derivatives n radius)
  (and
   (p63a3-positive-real-p ctx radius)
   (p63a3-contdiff-through-p
    ctx
    y
    derivatives
    n
    (p63a3-open-ball-set
     ctx (p63a3-r-one ctx) radius))))

(defun p63a3-local-contdiff-radius-function
    (ctx y derivatives n)
  (list
   'lambda '(radius)
   (list 'p63a3-local-contdiff-radius-witness-p
         (p63a3-quoted ctx)
         (p63a3-quoted y)
         (p63a3-quoted derivatives)
         (p63a3-quoted n)
         'radius)))

(defun p63a3-regularity-p (ctx y derivatives n)
  (and
   (p63a3-halfline-regularity-p ctx y derivatives n)
   (p63a3-exists-p
    (p63a3-local-contdiff-radius-function
     ctx y derivatives n)
    '(radius))))

(defun p63a3-regularity-family-function (ctx y n)
  (list
   'lambda '(derivatives)
   (list 'p63a3-regularity-p
         (p63a3-quoted ctx)
         (p63a3-quoted y)
         'derivatives
         (p63a3-quoted n))))

;; The recursive operator from the formal sources satisfies
;; P_n(y)(x) = x^n y^(n)(x). This falling-Euler identity removes only the
;; definitional higher-order parameter P and leaves the same equation.

(defun p63a3-initial-conditions-row-function
    (ctx derivatives n)
  (list
   'lambda '(index)
   (p63a3-implies-term
    (p63a3-and-terms
     (list
      (list 'natp 'index)
      (list '< 'index (p63a3-quoted n))))
    (list 'equal
          (p63a3-static-apply-term
           (p63a3-derivative-function derivatives 'index)
           (list (p63a3-quoted (p63a3-r-one ctx))))
          (p63a3-quoted (p63a3-r-zero ctx))))))

(defun p63a3-initial-conditions-p
    (ctx derivatives n)
  (p63a3-universal-p
   (p63a3-initial-conditions-row-function
    ctx derivatives n)
   '(index)))

(defun p63a3-equation-row-function
    (ctx f derivatives n)
  (let ((halfline
         (p63a3-ici-set ctx (p63a3-r-one ctx)))
        (nth-derivative
         (p63a3-derivative-function derivatives n)))
    (list
     'lambda '(x)
     (p63a3-implies-term
      (p63a3-static-apply-term halfline '(x))
      (list
       'equal
       (list 'p63a3-r-mul-value
             (p63a3-quoted ctx)
             (list 'p63a3-r-power-value
                   (p63a3-quoted ctx)
                   'x
                   (p63a3-quoted n))
             (p63a3-static-apply-term nth-derivative '(x)))
       (p63a3-static-apply-term f '(x)))))))

(defun p63a3-differential-equation-p
    (ctx f derivatives n)
  (p63a3-universal-p
   (p63a3-equation-row-function
    ctx f derivatives n)
   '(x)))

;; The kernel (x-t)^(n-1) f(t) / ((n-1)! t^n).

(defun p63a3-kernel-value (ctx f n x time)
  (let* ((degree (- n 1))
         (numerator
          (p63a3-r-mul-value
           ctx
           (p63a3-r-power-value
            ctx
            (p63a3-r-sub-value ctx x time)
            degree)
           (p63a3-unary-value f time)))
         (denominator
          (p63a3-r-mul-value
           ctx
           (p63a3-r-factorial-value ctx degree)
           (p63a3-r-power-value ctx time n))))
    (p63a3-r-div-value ctx numerator denominator)))

(defun p63a3-kernel-function (ctx f n x)
  (list
   'lambda '(time)
   (list 'p63a3-kernel-value
         (p63a3-quoted ctx)
         (p63a3-quoted f)
         (p63a3-quoted n)
         (p63a3-quoted x)
         'time)))

;; Tagged partitions and the epsilon definition of the Riemann integral. The
;; source kernel is continuous on every [1,x], so this equals the interval
;; integral used by Lean and Isabelle.

(defun p63a3-last-value (xs)
  (if (atom (cdr xs))
      (car xs)
    (p63a3-last-value (cdr xs))))

(defun p63a3-partition-elements-p (ctx xs)
  (if (atom xs)
      t
    (and
     (p63a3-member-p (p63a3-r-carrier ctx) (car xs))
     (p63a3-partition-elements-p ctx (cdr xs)))))

(defun p63a3-partition-increasing-p (ctx xs)
  (if (or (atom xs) (atom (cdr xs)))
      t
    (and
     (p63a3-r-lt-p ctx (car xs) (cadr xs))
     (p63a3-partition-increasing-p ctx (cdr xs)))))

(defun p63a3-partition-p (ctx lower upper partition)
  (and
   (true-listp partition)
   (consp partition)
   (consp (cdr partition))
   (equal (car partition) lower)
   (equal (p63a3-last-value partition) upper)
   (p63a3-partition-elements-p ctx partition)
   (p63a3-partition-increasing-p ctx partition)))

(defun p63a3-tags-p (ctx partition tags)
  (if (atom (cdr partition))
      (equal tags nil)
    (and
     (consp tags)
     (p63a3-member-p (p63a3-r-carrier ctx) (car tags))
     (p63a3-r-le-p ctx (car partition) (car tags))
     (p63a3-r-le-p ctx (car tags) (cadr partition))
     (p63a3-tags-p ctx (cdr partition) (cdr tags)))))

(defun p63a3-tagged-partition-p
    (ctx lower upper partition tags)
  (and
   (p63a3-partition-p ctx lower upper partition)
   (p63a3-tags-p ctx partition tags)))

(defun p63a3-r-max-value (ctx left right)
  (if (p63a3-r-lt-p ctx left right) right left))

(defun p63a3-partition-mesh (ctx partition)
  (if (or (atom partition) (atom (cdr partition)))
      (p63a3-r-zero ctx)
    (p63a3-r-max-value
     ctx
     (p63a3-r-sub-value ctx (cadr partition) (car partition))
     (p63a3-partition-mesh ctx (cdr partition)))))

(defun p63a3-riemann-sum (ctx integrand partition tags)
  (if (or (atom (cdr partition)) (atom tags))
      (p63a3-r-zero ctx)
    (p63a3-r-add-value
     ctx
     (p63a3-r-mul-value
      ctx
      (p63a3-unary-value integrand (car tags))
      (p63a3-r-sub-value
       ctx (cadr partition) (car partition)))
     (p63a3-riemann-sum
      ctx integrand (cdr partition) (cdr tags)))))

(defun p63a3-integral-partition-row-function
    (ctx integrand lower upper value epsilon delta)
  (list
   'lambda '(partition tags)
   (p63a3-implies-term
    (p63a3-and-terms
     (list
      (list 'p63a3-tagged-partition-p
            (p63a3-quoted ctx)
            (p63a3-quoted lower)
            (p63a3-quoted upper)
            'partition
            'tags)
      (list 'p63a3-r-lt-p
            (p63a3-quoted ctx)
            (list 'p63a3-partition-mesh
                  (p63a3-quoted ctx)
                  'partition)
            (p63a3-quoted delta))))
    (list 'p63a3-r-lt-p
          (p63a3-quoted ctx)
          (list 'p63a3-r-abs-value
                (p63a3-quoted ctx)
                (list 'p63a3-r-sub-value
                      (p63a3-quoted ctx)
                      (list 'p63a3-riemann-sum
                            (p63a3-quoted ctx)
                            (p63a3-quoted integrand)
                            'partition
                            'tags)
                      (p63a3-quoted value)))
          (p63a3-quoted epsilon)))))

(defun p63a3-integral-delta-witness-p
    (ctx integrand lower upper value epsilon delta)
  (and
   (p63a3-positive-real-p ctx delta)
   (p63a3-universal-p
    (p63a3-integral-partition-row-function
     ctx integrand lower upper value epsilon delta)
    '(partition tags))))

(defun p63a3-integral-delta-function
    (ctx integrand lower upper value epsilon)
  (list
   'lambda '(delta)
   (list 'p63a3-integral-delta-witness-p
         (p63a3-quoted ctx)
         (p63a3-quoted integrand)
         (p63a3-quoted lower)
         (p63a3-quoted upper)
         (p63a3-quoted value)
         (p63a3-quoted epsilon)
         'delta)))

(defun p63a3-integral-epsilon-row-function
    (ctx integrand lower upper value)
  (list
   'lambda '(epsilon)
   (p63a3-implies-term
    (list 'p63a3-positive-real-p
          (p63a3-quoted ctx) 'epsilon)
    (list 'p63a3-exists-p
          (list 'p63a3-integral-delta-function
                (p63a3-quoted ctx)
                (p63a3-quoted integrand)
                (p63a3-quoted lower)
                (p63a3-quoted upper)
                (p63a3-quoted value)
                'epsilon)
          (p63a3-quoted '(delta))))))

(defun p63a3-integral-value-p
    (ctx integrand lower upper value)
  (and
   (tamep-functionp integrand)
   (p63a3-member-p (p63a3-r-carrier ctx) lower)
   (p63a3-member-p (p63a3-r-carrier ctx) upper)
   (p63a3-member-p (p63a3-r-carrier ctx) value)
   (p63a3-r-le-p ctx lower upper)
   (if (equal lower upper)
       (equal value (p63a3-r-zero ctx))
     (p63a3-universal-p
      (p63a3-integral-epsilon-row-function
       ctx integrand lower upper value)
      '(epsilon)))))

(defun p63a3-integral-formula-row-function (ctx f y n)
  (let ((halfline
         (p63a3-ici-set ctx (p63a3-r-one ctx))))
    (list
     'lambda '(x)
     (p63a3-implies-term
      (p63a3-static-apply-term halfline '(x))
      (list 'p63a3-integral-value-p
            (p63a3-quoted ctx)
            (list 'p63a3-kernel-function
                  (p63a3-quoted ctx)
                  (p63a3-quoted f)
                  (p63a3-quoted n)
                  'x)
            (p63a3-quoted (p63a3-r-one ctx))
            'x
            (p63a3-static-apply-term y '(x)))))))

(defun p63a3-integral-formula-p (ctx f y n)
  (p63a3-universal-p
   (p63a3-integral-formula-row-function ctx f y n)
   '(x)))

(defun p63a3-equivalence-p (ctx f y derivatives n)
  (iff
   (and
    (p63a3-initial-conditions-p ctx derivatives n)
    (p63a3-differential-equation-p
     ctx f derivatives n))
   (p63a3-integral-formula-p ctx f y n)))

(defun p63a3-equivalence-family-row-function
    (ctx f y n)
  (list
   'lambda '(derivatives)
   (p63a3-implies-term
    (list 'p63a3-regularity-p
          (p63a3-quoted ctx)
          (p63a3-quoted y)
          'derivatives
          (p63a3-quoted n))
    (list 'p63a3-equivalence-p
          (p63a3-quoted ctx)
          (p63a3-quoted f)
          (p63a3-quoted y)
          'derivatives
          (p63a3-quoted n)))))

(defun putnam-1963-a3-statement (ctx n f y)
  (implies
   (and
    (p63a3-context-p ctx)
    (natp n)
    (< 0 n)
    (p63a3-real-function-p (p63a3-r-carrier ctx) f)
    (p63a3-real-function-p (p63a3-r-carrier ctx) y)
    (p63a3-continuous-on-p
     ctx f (p63a3-ici-set ctx (p63a3-r-one ctx)))
    (p63a3-exists-p
     (p63a3-regularity-family-function ctx y n)
     '(derivatives)))
   (p63a3-universal-p
    (p63a3-equivalence-family-row-function
     ctx f y n)
    '(derivatives))))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

title: putnam_1963_a3
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1963_a3:
-- the zero-initial-data solution of a factored Euler differential equation is
-- represented by an explicit integral kernel. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module Putnam1963A3 where

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; _*_)

infix 4 _!=_ _<=N_ _<N_
infixr 3 _and_
infixr 2 _or_

data Bottom : Set where

Not : Set -> Set
Not A = A -> Bottom

_!=_ : {A : Set} -> A -> A -> Set
x != y = Not (x == y)

record _and_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data _or_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  left  : A -> A or B
  right : B -> A or B

record Iff (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor equivalence
  field
    forward  : A -> B
    backward : B -> A

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

data _<=N_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set where
  zero<=   : {n : Nat} -> zero <=N n
  suc<=suc : {m n : Nat} -> m <=N n -> suc m <=N suc n

_<N_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set
m <N n = suc m <=N n

oneN : Nat
oneN = suc zero

pred : Nat -> Nat
pred zero = zero
pred (suc n) = n

factorial : Nat -> Nat
factorial zero = oneN
factorial (suc n) = suc n * factorial n

record CompleteOrderedField (R : Set) : Set1 where
  field
    zeroR oneR : R
    add multiply : R -> R -> R
    negate inverse : R -> R
    lessOrEqual : R -> R -> Set
    fromNat : Nat -> R

    one-not-zero :
      oneR != zeroR

    add-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> add x y == add y x
    add-associative :
      (x y z : R) -> add (add x y) z == add x (add y z)
    add-zero :
      (x : R) -> add x zeroR == x
    add-inverse :
      (x : R) -> add x (negate x) == zeroR

    multiply-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> multiply x y == multiply y x
    multiply-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply (multiply x y) z == multiply x (multiply y z)
    multiply-one :
      (x : R) -> multiply x oneR == x
    multiply-zero :
      (x : R) -> multiply x zeroR == zeroR
    distribute :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply x (add y z) ==
      add (multiply x y) (multiply x z)
    inverse-zero :
      inverse zeroR == zeroR
    multiply-inverse :
      (x : R) ->
      x != zeroR ->
      multiply x (inverse x) == oneR

    order-reflexive :
      (x : R) -> lessOrEqual x x
    order-transitive :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y z ->
      lessOrEqual x z
    order-antisymmetric :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y x ->
      x == y
    order-total :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y or lessOrEqual y x
    add-order :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual (add z x) (add z y)
    multiply-nonnegative :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR x ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR y ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR (multiply x y)
    zero-less-than-one :
      lessOrEqual zeroR oneR and zeroR != oneR

    fromNat-zero :
      fromNat zero == zeroR
    fromNat-successor :
      (n : Nat) -> fromNat (suc n) == add (fromNat n) oneR
    fromNat-addition :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m + n) == add (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-multiplication :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m * n) == multiply (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-injective :
      (m n : Nat) -> fromNat m == fromNat n -> m == n

    archimedean :
      (x : R) ->
      Exists Nat (\ n -> lessOrEqual x (fromNat n))
    least-upper-bound :
      (P : R -> Set) ->
      Exists R P ->
      Exists R
        (\ upper ->
          (x : R) -> P x -> lessOrEqual x upper) ->
      Exists R
        (\ supremum ->
          ((x : R) -> P x -> lessOrEqual x supremum)
          and
          ((upper : R) ->
            ((x : R) -> P x -> lessOrEqual x upper) ->
            lessOrEqual supremum upper))

open CompleteOrderedField

subtract :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
subtract reals x y =
  add reals x (negate reals y)

divide :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
divide reals x y =
  multiply reals x (inverse reals y)

naturalPower :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  Nat ->
  R
naturalPower reals x zero =
  oneR reals
naturalPower reals x (suc n) =
  multiply reals (naturalPower reals x n) x

StrictLess :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
StrictLess reals x y =
  lessOrEqual reals x y and x != y

CloseTo :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
CloseTo reals center radius x =
  StrictLess reals (subtract reals center radius) x
  and
  StrictLess reals x (add reals center radius)

Predicate : Set -> Set1
Predicate A = A -> Set

ContinuousWithinAt :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  (R -> R) ->
  Predicate R ->
  R ->
  Set
ContinuousWithinAt {R} reals function domain point =
  (epsilon : R) ->
  StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) epsilon ->
  Exists R
    (\ delta ->
      StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) delta
      and
      ((x : R) ->
        domain x ->
        CloseTo reals point delta x ->
        CloseTo reals (function point) epsilon (function x)))

ContinuousOn :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  (R -> R) ->
  Predicate R ->
  Set
ContinuousOn {R} reals function domain =
  (x : R) ->
  domain x ->
  ContinuousWithinAt reals function domain x

differenceQuotient :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  (R -> R) ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
differenceQuotient reals function point x =
  divide reals
    (subtract reals (function x) (function point))
    (subtract reals x point)

DerivativeWithinAt :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  (R -> R) ->
  Predicate R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
DerivativeWithinAt {R} reals function domain point derivative =
  (epsilon : R) ->
  StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) epsilon ->
  Exists R
    (\ delta ->
      StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) delta
      and
      ((x : R) ->
        domain x ->
        CloseTo reals point delta x ->
        x != point ->
        CloseTo reals derivative epsilon
          (differenceQuotient reals function point x)))

whole : {A : Set} -> Predicate A
whole _ = Bottom -> Bottom

DerivativeAt :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  (R -> R) ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
DerivativeAt reals function point derivative =
  DerivativeWithinAt reals function whole point derivative

record StandardCalculus
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) : Set1 where
  field
    derivative : (R -> R) -> R -> R
    derivative-correct :
      (function : R -> R) ->
      (point value : R) ->
      DerivativeAt reals function point value ->
      derivative function point == value
    derivative-totalized-at-zero :
      (function : R -> R) ->
      (point : R) ->
      Not (Exists R (DerivativeAt reals function point)) ->
      derivative function point == zeroR reals

open StandardCalculus

iteratedDerivative :
  {R : Set} ->
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R} ->
  StandardCalculus reals ->
  Nat ->
  (R -> R) ->
  R ->
  R
iteratedDerivative calculus zero function =
  function
iteratedDerivative calculus (suc n) function =
  derivative calculus (iteratedDerivative calculus n function)

OpenNeighborhood :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Predicate R
OpenNeighborhood reals center radius x =
  CloseTo reals center radius x

ClosedFromOne :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  Predicate R
ClosedFromOne reals x =
  lessOrEqual reals (oneR reals) x

ContDiffOn :
  {R : Set} ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) ->
  StandardCalculus reals ->
  Nat ->
  (R -> R) ->
  Predicate R ->
  Set
ContDiffOn {R} reals calculus n function domain =
  ((k : Nat) ->
    k <N n ->
    (x : R) ->
    domain x ->
    DerivativeWithinAt reals
      (iteratedDerivative calculus k function)
      domain
      x
      (iteratedDerivative calculus (suc k) function x))
  and
  ((k : Nat) ->
    k <=N n ->
    ContinuousOn reals
      (iteratedDerivative calculus k function)
      domain)

ContDiffAt :
  {R : Set} ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) ->
  StandardCalculus reals ->
  Nat ->
  (R -> R) ->
  R ->
  Set
ContDiffAt reals calculus n function point =
  Exists _
    (\ radius ->
      StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) radius
      and
      ContDiffOn reals calculus n function
        (OpenNeighborhood reals point radius))

sumFirst :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  Nat ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  R
sumFirst reals zero terms =
  zeroR reals
sumFirst reals (suc n) terms =
  add reals
    (sumFirst reals n terms)
    (terms n)

SequentialLimit :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  R ->
  Set
SequentialLimit {R} reals sequence limit =
  (epsilon : R) ->
  StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) epsilon ->
  Exists Nat
    (\ cutoff ->
      (n : Nat) ->
      cutoff <=N n ->
      CloseTo reals limit epsilon (sequence n))

riemannStep :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Nat ->
  R
riemannStep reals lower upper pieces =
  divide reals
    (subtract reals upper lower)
    (fromNat reals pieces)

rightRiemannSum :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  (R -> R) ->
  Nat ->
  R
rightRiemannSum reals lower upper function pieces =
  let
    step = riemannStep reals lower upper pieces
  in
  sumFirst reals pieces
    (\ i ->
      multiply reals
        (function
          (add reals lower
            (multiply reals
              (fromNat reals (suc i))
              step)))
        step)

IntervalIntegralValue :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  (R -> R) ->
  R ->
  Set
IntervalIntegralValue reals lower upper function value =
  SequentialLimit reals
    (\ n ->
      rightRiemannSum reals lower upper function (suc n))
    value

module Putnam1963A3Statement
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R)
  (calculus : StandardCalculus reals) where

  solutionKernel :
    (R -> R) ->
    Nat ->
    R ->
    R ->
    R
  solutionKernel f n x t =
    divide reals
      (multiply reals
        (naturalPower reals
          (subtract reals x t)
          (pred n))
        (f t))
      (multiply reals
        (fromNat reals (factorial (pred n)))
        (naturalPower reals t n))

  operatorFactor :
    Nat ->
    (R -> R) ->
    R ->
    R
  operatorFactor i function x =
    subtract reals
      (multiply reals x (derivative calculus function x))
      (multiply reals (fromNat reals i) (function x))

  OperatorRecurrence :
    (Nat -> (R -> R) -> (R -> R)) ->
    Set
  OperatorRecurrence P =
    ((function : R -> R) ->
      (x : R) ->
      P zero function x == function x)
    and
    ((i : Nat) ->
      (function : R -> R) ->
      (x : R) ->
      P (suc i) function x ==
      P i (operatorFactor i function) x)

  EqOnFromOne :
    (R -> R) ->
    (R -> R) ->
    Set
  EqOnFromOne leftFunction rightFunction =
    (x : R) ->
    ClosedFromOne reals x ->
    leftFunction x == rightFunction x

  proposition : Set
  proposition =
    (P : Nat -> (R -> R) -> (R -> R)) ->
    OperatorRecurrence P ->
    (n : Nat) ->
    zero <N n ->
    (f y : R -> R) ->
    ContinuousOn reals f (ClosedFromOne reals) ->
    ContDiffOn reals calculus n y (ClosedFromOne reals) ->
    ContDiffAt reals calculus n y (oneR reals) ->
    Iff
      (((i : Nat) ->
        i <N n ->
        iteratedDerivative calculus i y (oneR reals) ==
        zeroR reals)
      and
      EqOnFromOne (P n y) f)
      ((x : R) ->
        ClosedFromOne reals x ->
        IntervalIntegralValue reals
          (oneR reals)
          x
          (solutionKernel f n x)
          (y x))

putnam-1963-a3 : Set1
putnam-1963-a3 =
  (R : Set) ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) ->
  (calculus : StandardCalculus reals) ->
  Putnam1963A3Statement.proposition reals calculus

(*
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench artifact putnam_1963_a3:
  the integral formula for the solution of an iterated Euler differential
  equation with vanishing initial derivatives. This file contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open arithmeticTheory pred_setTheory realTheory real_topologyTheory;
open limTheory integrationTheory;

val putnam_1963_a3 =
  ``let solution =
      \f : real -> real.
      \n : num.
      \x : real.
      \t : real.
        (x - t) pow (n - 1) * f t / (&(FACT (n - 1)) * t pow n)
    in
      !P : num -> (real -> real) -> (real -> real).
      !n : num. !f y : real -> real.
        (!g : real -> real. P 0 g = g) /\
        (!i : num. !g : real -> real.
           P (SUC i) g =
             P i (\x : real. x * diffn 1 g x - &i * g x)) /\
        0 < n /\
        f continuous_on {x : real | 1 <= x} /\
        (!x : real.
           1 <= x
           ==>
           higher_differentiable n y x) /\
        (!k : num.
           k <= n
           ==>
           (diffn k y) continuous_on {x : real | 1 <= x})
        ==>
        ((!k : num.
            k < n
            ==>
            diffn k y 1 = 0) /\
         (!x : real.
            1 <= x
            ==>
            P n y x = f x)
         <=>
         !x : real.
           1 <= x
           ==>
           y x =
             integration$integral (interval [1, x])
               (solution f n x))``;

title: putnam_1963_a3
content:
$(
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench artifact putnam_1963_a3:
  the integral formula for the solution of an iterated Euler differential
  equation with vanishing initial derivatives at one. This file contains no
  proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  RR ^m RR is the set of total real functions. P is an NN0-indexed family
  of endomorphisms of that function space. The recurrence uses set.mm's
  partial real derivative with value zero outside its domain, matching the
  total derivative convention of the sources.

  The C^n premises state n-fold continuous differentiability on [1,+oo) and
  on a two-sided neighborhood of 1. The integral uses the documented kernel

    (x-t)^(n-1) f(t) / ((n-1)! t^n).

  Since x is at least 1, the Lebesgue integral over [1,x] is the source
  interval integral. The final declaration is the single unproved $a
  statement; this database contains no $p proof statement.
$)

${
  $d e i t x F P Y n $.

  putnambench-putnam-1963-a3 $a |- A. P e.
    ( ( ( RR ^m RR ) ^m ( RR ^m RR ) ) ^m NN0 )
    A. n e. NN
    A. F e. ( RR ^m RR )
    A. Y e. ( RR ^m RR )
      (
        (
          (
            A. Y e. ( RR ^m RR )
              ( ( P ` 0 ) ` Y ) = Y
            /\
            A. i e. NN0 A. Y e. ( RR ^m RR )
              (
                ( ( P ` ( i + 1 ) ) ` Y )
                =
                (
                  ( P ` i )
                  `
                  (
                    x e. RR |->
                      (
                        x
                        x.
                        if (
                          x e. dom ( RR _D Y ) ,
                          ( ( RR _D Y ) ` x ) ,
                          0
                        )
                      )
                      -
                      ( i x. ( Y ` x ) )
                  )
                )
              )
          )
          /\
          (
            (
              (
                F |` { x e. RR | 1 <_ x }
              )
              e.
              (
                ( C^n ` { x e. RR | 1 <_ x } )
                ` 0
              )
              /\
              (
                Y |` { x e. RR | 1 <_ x }
              )
              e.
              (
                ( C^n ` { x e. RR | 1 <_ x } )
                ` n
              )
            )
            /\
            E. e e. RR+
              (
                Y |` ( ( 1 - e ) [,] ( 1 + e ) )
              )
              e.
              (
                (
                  C^n
                  ` ( ( 1 - e ) [,] ( 1 + e ) )
                )
                ` n
              )
          )
        )
        ->
        (
          (
            (
              A. i e. ( 0 ..^ n )
                ( ( ( RR Dn Y ) ` i ) ` 1 ) = 0
              /\
              A. x e. { x e. RR | 1 <_ x }
                ( ( ( P ` n ) ` Y ) ` x ) = ( F ` x )
            )
            <->
            A. x e. { x e. RR | 1 <_ x }
              ( Y ` x )
              =
              S. ( 1 [,] x )
                (
                  (
                    ( ( x - t ) ^ ( n - 1 ) )
                    x.
                    ( F ` t )
                  )
                  /
                  (
                    ( ! ` ( n - 1 ) )
                    x.
                    ( t ^ n )
                  )
                )
                _d t
          )
        )
      )
  $.
$}

:: Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench artifact putnam_1963_a3:
:: the integral formula for the zero-initial-data solution of an iterated
:: Euler differential equation on the half-line x >= 1.
::
:: Mizar represents the successive Euler operators by a NAT-indexed family
:: D of real functions.  Thus D.(i+1) = (delta-i)D.i pointwise, starting
:: from D.0 = y; this is the prover-native form of
:: delta(delta-1)...(delta-n+1)y.  This file contains no proof.

environ

  vocabularies TARSKI, XBOOLE_0, SUBSET_1, RELAT_1, FUNCT_1, FUNCT_2,
    PARTFUN1, NUMBERS, XREAL_0, COMPLEX1, CARD_1, XXREAL_0, XXREAL_1,
    ARYTM_1, ARYTM_3, REAL_1, NAT_1, INT_1, REALSET1, CARD_3,
    VALUED_0, VALUED_1, ORDINAL1, NEWTON, PREPOWER, SEQ_1, SEQ_2,
    ORDINAL2, SEQ_4, RCOMP_1, FDIFF_1, TAYLOR_1, FINSEQ_1, FINSEQ_2,
    RVSUM_1, SUPINF_2, MEASURE1, MESFUNC1, MESFUNC5, MEASUR12,
    INTEGRA5, SIN_COS, FCONT_1;
  notations TARSKI, XBOOLE_0, SUBSET_1, RELAT_1, FUNCT_1, RELSET_1,
    PARTFUN1, FUNCT_2, ORDINAL1, CARD_1, NUMBERS, XCMPLX_0, XREAL_0,
    REAL_1, COMPLEX1, XXREAL_0, XXREAL_1, XXREAL_3, NAT_1, INT_1,
    NAT_D, NEWTON, FINSEQ_1, RVSUM_1, FINSEQ_2, VALUED_0, VALUED_1,
    RCOMP_1, FDIFF_1, PREPOWER, TAYLOR_1, SIN_COS, SUPINF_2,
    MEASURE1, MESFUNC1, MESFUNC5, MESFUNC6, MEASUR12, INTEGRA5,
    EXTREAL1, FCONT_1;
  constructors FUNCT_1, RELSET_1, FUNCT_2, CARD_1, REAL_1, COMPLEX1,
    NAT_1, NAT_D, NEWTON, NUMBERS, FINSEQOP, RVSUM_1, PREPOWER,
    RCOMP_1, FDIFF_1, TAYLOR_1, SIN_COS, MESFUNC1, MESFUNC5,
    MESFUNC6, MEASUR12, INTEGRA5, EXTREAL1, BINOP_2, FCONT_1;
  registrations XBOOLE_0, SUBSET_1, RELAT_1, FUNCT_1, RELSET_1,
    FUNCT_2, NUMBERS, CARD_1, XXREAL_0, MEMBERED, VALUED_0,
    VALUED_1, XCMPLX_0, XREAL_0, ORDINAL1, NAT_1, INT_1, NEWTON,
    PREPOWER, FINSEQ_1, FINSEQ_2, RVSUM_1, RCOMP_1, XXREAL_3,
    MEASURE1, MEASUR12, SIN_COS, FCONT_1;
  requirements REAL, NUMERALS, SUBSET, BOOLE, ARITHM;
  definitions TARSKI, XBOOLE_0, TAYLOR_1;
  equalities VALUED_1, SUBSET_1;
  expansions TARSKI, XBOOLE_0, RELAT_1, TAYLOR_1;

begin

::$P-
theorem
  for n being Nat,
      f,y being Function of REAL,REAL,
      I being Subset of REAL,
      U being open Subset of REAL st
    0 < n &
    I = {x where x is Real : 1 <= x} &
    I c= U &
    f|I is continuous &
    y is_differentiable_on n,U
  holds
    (((for i being Nat st i < n holds
        (diff(y,U).i).1 = 0) &
      ex D being Function of NAT,Funcs(REAL,REAL) st
        (for D0 being Function of REAL,REAL st D0 = D.0 holds
          D0 = y) &
        (for i being Nat,
             Di,Di1 being Function of REAL,REAL st
           i < n & Di = D.i & Di1 = D.(i+1)
         holds
           Di is_differentiable_on 1,U &
           for x being Real st x in I holds
             Di1.x =
               x * (diff(Di,U).1).x - (i qua Real) * Di.x) &
        (for Dn being Function of REAL,REAL st Dn = D.n holds
          for x being Real st x in I holds Dn.x = f.x))
    iff
    (for x being Real st 1 <= x holds
      ex J being Subset of REAL,
         h being Function of REAL,REAL st
        J = {t where t is Real : 1 <= t & t <= x} &
        (for t being Real st t in J holds
          h.t =
            ((x-t) |^ (n -' 1)) * f.t /
              (((n -' 1) !) qua Real * (t |^ n))) &
        y.x = Integral(L-Meas,h|J)))
proof
end;
::$P+

title: putnam_1963_a3
content:
% Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench artifact putnam_1963_a3:
% the zero-initial-data solution of an iterated Euler differential equation
% on the real half-line is characterized by an explicit integral formula.
% This file contains no proof.

putnam_1963_a3: THEORY
BEGIN
  real_set: TYPE = [real -> bool]
  real_function: TYPE = [real -> real]
  differential_operator: TYPE =
    [nat -> [real_function -> real_function]]
  real_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> real]

  at_least_one: real_set =
    LAMBDA (x: real): 1 <= x

  open_ball(center, radius: real): real_set =
    LAMBDA (x: real): abs(x - center) < radius

  has_derivative_at(
      f: real_function,
      derivative, x: real): bool =
    FORALL (epsilon_value: real):
      epsilon_value > 0 IMPLIES
        EXISTS (delta: real):
          delta > 0
            AND FORALL (h: real):
              (NOT (h = 0) AND abs(h) < delta)
                IMPLIES
                  abs(
                    f(x + h) - f(x)
                      - derivative * h)
                    < epsilon_value * abs(h)

  differentiable_at(f: real_function, x: real): bool =
    EXISTS (derivative: real):
      has_derivative_at(f, derivative, x)

  derivative_value(f: real_function, x: real): real =
    IF EXISTS (derivative: real):
        has_derivative_at(f, derivative, x)
    THEN
      epsilon(
        LAMBDA (derivative: real):
          has_derivative_at(f, derivative, x))
    ELSE
      0
    ENDIF

  derivative_function(f: real_function): real_function =
    LAMBDA (x: real): derivative_value(f, x)

  iterated_derivative(
      f: real_function,
      order: nat): RECURSIVE real_function =
    IF order = 0 THEN
      f
    ELSE
      derivative_function(
        iterated_derivative(f, order - 1))
    ENDIF
  MEASURE order

  continuous_on(f: real_function, domain: real_set): bool =
    FORALL (x: real):
      domain(x) IMPLIES
        FORALL (epsilon_value: real):
          epsilon_value > 0 IMPLIES
            EXISTS (delta: real):
              delta > 0
                AND FORALL (z: real):
                  (domain(z) AND abs(z - x) < delta)
                    IMPLIES
                      abs(f(z) - f(x)) < epsilon_value

  continuously_differentiable_through_on(
      f: real_function,
      order: nat,
      domain: real_set): bool =
    (FORALL (index: nat):
      index <= order IMPLIES
        continuous_on(
          iterated_derivative(f, index), domain))
      AND FORALL (index: nat):
        index < order IMPLIES
          FORALL (x: real):
            domain(x) IMPLIES
              differentiable_at(
                iterated_derivative(f, index), x)

  continuously_differentiable_through_at(
      f: real_function,
      order: nat,
      x: real): bool =
    EXISTS (radius: real):
      radius > 0
        AND continuously_differentiable_through_on(
          f, order, open_ball(x, radius))

  factorial(index: nat): RECURSIVE nat =
    IF index = 0 THEN
      1
    ELSE
      index * factorial(index - 1)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE index

  nat_predecessor(index: nat): nat =
    IF index = 0 THEN 0 ELSE index - 1 ENDIF

  inverse_or_zero(value: real): real =
    IF value = 0 THEN 0 ELSE 1 / value ENDIF

  solution_kernel(
      f: real_function,
      order: nat,
      x, t: real): real =
    (x - t) ^ nat_predecessor(order)
      * f(t)
      * inverse_or_zero(
          (factorial(nat_predecessor(order)) :: real)
            * t ^ order)

  valid_partition(
      points: real_sequence,
      count: nat,
      left, right: real): bool =
    count > 0
      AND points(0) = left
      AND points(count) = right
      AND FORALL (index: nat):
        index < count IMPLIES
          points(index) < points(index + 1)

  valid_tags(
      points, tags: real_sequence,
      count: nat): bool =
    FORALL (index: nat):
      index < count IMPLIES
        points(index) <= tags(index)
          AND tags(index) <= points(index + 1)

  mesh_less_than(
      points: real_sequence,
      count: nat,
      bound: real): bool =
    FORALL (index: nat):
      index < count IMPLIES
        points(index + 1) - points(index) < bound

  riemann_sum(
      f: real_function,
      points, tags: real_sequence,
      count: nat): RECURSIVE real =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      riemann_sum(f, points, tags, count - 1)
        + f(tags(count - 1))
            * (points(count) - points(count - 1))
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  has_interval_integral(
      f: real_function,
      left, right, integral_value: real): bool =
    left < right
      AND FORALL (epsilon_value: real):
        epsilon_value > 0 IMPLIES
          EXISTS (mesh_bound: real):
            mesh_bound > 0
              AND FORALL
                  (points, tags: real_sequence),
                  (count: nat):
                (valid_partition(
                    points, count, left, right)
                  AND valid_tags(points, tags, count)
                  AND mesh_less_than(
                    points, count, mesh_bound))
                IMPLIES
                  abs(
                    riemann_sum(
                      f, points, tags, count)
                      - integral_value)
                    < epsilon_value

  interval_integral(
      f: real_function,
      left, right: real): real =
    IF left = right THEN
      0
    ELSIF left < right THEN
      IF EXISTS (integral_value: real):
          has_interval_integral(
            f, left, right, integral_value)
      THEN
        epsilon(
          LAMBDA (integral_value: real):
            has_interval_integral(
              f, left, right, integral_value))
      ELSE
        0
      ENDIF
    ELSE
      IF EXISTS (integral_value: real):
          has_interval_integral(
            f, right, left, integral_value)
      THEN
        -epsilon(
          LAMBDA (integral_value: real):
            has_interval_integral(
              f, right, left, integral_value))
      ELSE
        0
      ENDIF
    ENDIF

  operator_recurrence(P: differential_operator): bool =
    (FORALL (g: real_function), (x: real):
      P(0)(g)(x) = g(x))
      AND FORALL
          (index: nat),
          (g: real_function),
          (x: real):
        P(index + 1)(g)(x) =
          P(index)(
            LAMBDA (z: real):
              z * derivative_value(g, z)
                - (index :: real) * g(z))(x)

  zero_initial_data(y: real_function, order: nat): bool =
    FORALL (index: nat):
      index < order IMPLIES
        iterated_derivative(y, index)(1) = 0

  satisfies_equation(
      P: differential_operator,
      order: nat,
      y, f: real_function): bool =
    FORALL (x: real):
      x >= 1 IMPLIES P(order)(y)(x) = f(x)

  satisfies_integral_formula(
      f, y: real_function,
      order: nat): bool =
    FORALL (x: real):
      x >= 1 IMPLIES
        y(x) =
          interval_integral(
            LAMBDA (t: real):
              solution_kernel(f, order, x, t),
            1,
            x)

  putnam_1963_a3: bool =
    FORALL
        (P: differential_operator),
        (order: nat),
        (f, y: real_function):
      (operator_recurrence(P)
        AND order > 0
        AND continuous_on(f, at_least_one)
        AND continuously_differentiable_through_on(
          y, order, at_least_one)
        AND continuously_differentiable_through_at(
          y, order, 1))
      IMPLIES
        ((zero_initial_data(y, order)
            AND satisfies_equation(P, order, y, f))
          IFF satisfies_integral_formula(f, y, order))
END putnam_1963_a3

title: putnam_1963_a4
content:
import Mathlib

open Filter Set

/--
Let $\{a_n\}$ be a sequence of positive real numbers. Show that $\limsup_{n \to \infty} n\left(\frac{1+a_{n+1}}{a_n}-1\right) \geq 1$. Show that the number $1$ on the right-hand side of this inequality cannot be replaced by any larger number. (The symbol $\limsup$ is sometimes written $\overline{\lim}$.)
-/
theorem putnam_1963_a4
    (T : (ℕ → ℝ) → (ℕ → ℝ))
    (T_def : ∀ a n, T a n = n * ((1 + a (n + 1)) / a n - 1))
    (P : (ℕ → ℝ) → ℝ → Prop)
    (P_def : ∀ a C, P a C ↔ C ≤ limsup (T a) atTop ∨ ¬ BddAbove (range (T a))) :
    (∀ a, (∀ n, 0 < a n) → P a 1) ∧ (∀ C > 1, ∃ a, (∀ n, 0 < a n) ∧ ¬ P a C) :=
  sorry

From mathcomp Require Import all_algebra all_ssreflect.
From mathcomp Require Import reals sequences topology normedtype.
From mathcomp Require Import classical_sets.
Import numFieldNormedType.Exports.

Set Implicit Arguments.
Unset Strict Implicit.
Unset Printing Implicit Defensive.

Local Open Scope ring_scope.

Variable R : realType.
Theorem putnam_1963_a4
    (T : (nat -> R) -> (nat -> R))
    (T_def : forall a n, T a n = n%:R * ((1 + a (n.+1)) / a n - 1))
    (P : (nat -> R) -> R -> Prop)
    (P_def : forall a C, (P a C <-> C <= limn_sup (T a) \/ ~ (exists B, forall n, T a n <= B)))
    : (forall a, (forall n, a n > 0) -> P a 1) /\ (forall C : R, C > 1 -> exists a, (forall n, a n > 0) /\ ~ P a C).
Proof. Admitted.

  the sharp lower bound 1 for the limsup of a ratio expression associated
  with every positive real sequence. This file contains no proof.
*)

let statement =
  `let term =
     \(a:num->real) (n:num).
       &n * ((&1 + a (n + 1)) / a n - &1) in
   let limsup_at_least =
     \(u:num->real) (c:real).
       !b. b < c ==> !N. ?n. N <= n /\ b < u n in
   (!a:num->real.
      (!n. &0 < a n)
      ==> limsup_at_least (term a) (&1)) /\
   (!c:real.
      &1 < c
      ==> ?a:num->real.
            (!n. &0 < a n) /\
