title: putnam_1963_a4
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1963_a4:
;; every positive real sequence has the specified transformed sequence with
;; extended-real limsup at least 1, and no larger universal lower bound works.
;; This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))

;; Ordinary ACL2 has no native arbitrary real numbers.  These conservative
;; interfaces represent a complete Archimedean ordered field, hence the real
;; field up to its unique order-preserving isomorphism, together with arbitrary
;; total sequences on the natural numbers.  The field laws and sequential
;; completeness are explicit hypotheses of the statement; no property of the
;; interfaces is assumed merely from DEFSTUB.

(defstub p63a4-real-p (real-type value) t)
(defstub p63a4-zero (real-type) t)
(defstub p63a4-one (real-type) t)
(defstub p63a4-add (real-type left right) t)
(defstub p63a4-multiply (real-type left right) t)
(defstub p63a4-negate (real-type value) t)
(defstub p63a4-inverse (real-type value) t)
(defstub p63a4-less (real-type left right) t)
(defstub p63a4-sequence-value (real-type sequence index) t)

(defun p63a4-leq (real-type left right)
  (not (p63a4-less real-type right left)))

(defun p63a4-subtract (real-type left right)
  (p63a4-add
   real-type left (p63a4-negate real-type right)))

(defun p63a4-divide (real-type numerator denominator)
  (p63a4-multiply
   real-type numerator (p63a4-inverse real-type denominator)))

(defun p63a4-absolute-value (real-type value)
  (if (p63a4-less real-type value (p63a4-zero real-type))
      (p63a4-negate real-type value)
    value))

(defun p63a4-natural-value (real-type n)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix n)))
  (if (zp n)
      (p63a4-zero real-type)
    (p63a4-add
     real-type
     (p63a4-one real-type)
     (p63a4-natural-value real-type (1- n)))))

(defun-sk p63a4-field-laws-p (real-type)
  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (p63a4-real-p real-type x)
      (p63a4-real-p real-type y)
      (p63a4-real-p real-type z))
     (let* ((zero (p63a4-zero real-type))
            (one (p63a4-one real-type))
            (x-plus-y (p63a4-add real-type x y))
            (y-plus-z (p63a4-add real-type y z))
            (x-times-y (p63a4-multiply real-type x y))
            (y-times-z (p63a4-multiply real-type y z))
            (minus-x (p63a4-negate real-type x))
            (inverse-x (p63a4-inverse real-type x)))
       (and
        (p63a4-real-p real-type x-plus-y)
        (p63a4-real-p real-type x-times-y)
        (p63a4-real-p real-type minus-x)
        (p63a4-real-p real-type inverse-x)
        (equal
         (p63a4-add real-type x-plus-y z)
         (p63a4-add real-type x y-plus-z))
        (equal x-plus-y (p63a4-add real-type y x))
        (equal (p63a4-add real-type x zero) x)
        (equal (p63a4-add real-type x minus-x) zero)
        (equal
         (p63a4-multiply real-type x-times-y z)
         (p63a4-multiply real-type x y-times-z))
        (equal x-times-y (p63a4-multiply real-type y x))
        (equal (p63a4-multiply real-type x one) x)
        (implies
         (equal x zero)
         (equal inverse-x zero))
        (implies
         (not (equal x zero))
         (equal
          (p63a4-multiply real-type x inverse-x)
          one))
        (equal
         (p63a4-multiply real-type x y-plus-z)
         (p63a4-add
          real-type
          (p63a4-multiply real-type x y)
          (p63a4-multiply real-type x z))))))))

(defun-sk p63a4-order-laws-p (real-type)
  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (p63a4-real-p real-type x)
      (p63a4-real-p real-type y)
      (p63a4-real-p real-type z))
     (let ((zero (p63a4-zero real-type)))
       (and
        (not (p63a4-less real-type x x))
        (or
         (p63a4-less real-type x y)
         (equal x y)
         (p63a4-less real-type y x))
        (implies
         (and
          (p63a4-less real-type x y)
          (p63a4-less real-type y z))
         (p63a4-less real-type x z))
        (implies
         (p63a4-less real-type x y)
         (p63a4-less
          real-type
          (p63a4-add real-type x z)
          (p63a4-add real-type y z)))
        (implies
         (and
          (p63a4-less real-type zero x)
          (p63a4-less real-type zero y))
         (p63a4-less
          real-type
          zero
          (p63a4-multiply real-type x y))))))))

(defun-sk p63a4-archimedean-bound-exists-p
    (real-type value)
  (exists (n)
    (and
     (natp n)
     (p63a4-less
      real-type value (p63a4-natural-value real-type n)))))

(defun-sk p63a4-archimedean-p (real-type)
  (forall (value)
    (implies
     (p63a4-real-p real-type value)
     (p63a4-archimedean-bound-exists-p
      real-type value))))

(defun-sk p63a4-sequence-real-valued-p
    (real-type sequence)
  (forall (n)
    (implies
     (natp n)
     (p63a4-real-p
      real-type
      (p63a4-sequence-value real-type sequence n)))))

(defun-sk p63a4-cauchy-tail-p
    (real-type sequence epsilon cutoff)
  (forall (m n)
    (implies
     (and
      (natp m)
      (natp n)
      (natp cutoff)
      (<= cutoff m)
      (<= cutoff n))
     (p63a4-less
      real-type
      (p63a4-absolute-value
       real-type
       (p63a4-subtract
        real-type
        (p63a4-sequence-value real-type sequence m)
        (p63a4-sequence-value real-type sequence n)))
      epsilon))))

(defun-sk p63a4-cauchy-cutoff-exists-p
    (real-type sequence epsilon)
  (exists (cutoff)
    (and
     (natp cutoff)
     (p63a4-cauchy-tail-p
      real-type sequence epsilon cutoff))))

(defun-sk p63a4-cauchy-sequence-p
    (real-type sequence)
  (forall (epsilon)
    (implies
     (and
      (p63a4-real-p real-type epsilon)
      (p63a4-less
       real-type (p63a4-zero real-type) epsilon))
     (p63a4-cauchy-cutoff-exists-p
      real-type sequence epsilon))))

(defun-sk p63a4-convergence-tail-p
    (real-type sequence limit epsilon cutoff)
  (forall (n)
    (implies
     (and
      (natp n)
      (natp cutoff)
      (<= cutoff n))
     (p63a4-less
      real-type
      (p63a4-absolute-value
       real-type
       (p63a4-subtract
        real-type
        (p63a4-sequence-value real-type sequence n)
        limit))
      epsilon))))

(defun-sk p63a4-convergence-cutoff-exists-p
    (real-type sequence limit epsilon)
  (exists (cutoff)
    (and
     (natp cutoff)
     (p63a4-convergence-tail-p
      real-type sequence limit epsilon cutoff))))

(defun-sk p63a4-sequence-converges-p
    (real-type sequence limit)
  (forall (epsilon)
    (implies
     (and
      (p63a4-real-p real-type epsilon)
      (p63a4-less
       real-type (p63a4-zero real-type) epsilon))
     (p63a4-convergence-cutoff-exists-p
      real-type sequence limit epsilon))))

(defun-sk p63a4-limit-exists-p
    (real-type sequence)
  (exists (limit)
    (and
     (p63a4-real-p real-type limit)
     (p63a4-sequence-converges-p
      real-type sequence limit))))

(defun-sk p63a4-sequentially-complete-p (real-type)
  (forall (sequence)
    (implies
     (and
      (p63a4-sequence-real-valued-p real-type sequence)
      (p63a4-cauchy-sequence-p real-type sequence))
     (p63a4-limit-exists-p real-type sequence))))

(defun p63a4-real-structure-p (real-type)
  (let ((zero (p63a4-zero real-type))
        (one (p63a4-one real-type)))
    (and
     (p63a4-real-p real-type zero)
     (p63a4-real-p real-type one)
     (not (equal zero one))
     (p63a4-field-laws-p real-type)
     (p63a4-order-laws-p real-type)
     (p63a4-less real-type zero one)
     (p63a4-archimedean-p real-type)
     (p63a4-sequentially-complete-p real-type))))

(defun-sk p63a4-positive-sequence-values-p
    (real-type sequence)
  (forall (n)
    (implies
     (natp n)
     (p63a4-less
      real-type
      (p63a4-zero real-type)
      (p63a4-sequence-value real-type sequence n)))))

(defun p63a4-positive-sequence-p (real-type sequence)
  (and
   (p63a4-sequence-real-valued-p real-type sequence)
   (p63a4-positive-sequence-values-p real-type sequence)))

(defun p63a4-transformed-value (real-type sequence n)
  (p63a4-multiply
   real-type
   (p63a4-natural-value real-type n)
   (p63a4-subtract
    real-type
    (p63a4-divide
     real-type
     (p63a4-add
      real-type
      (p63a4-one real-type)
      (p63a4-sequence-value
       real-type sequence (+ n 1)))
     (p63a4-sequence-value real-type sequence n))
    (p63a4-one real-type))))

;; For a real-valued sequence u, this is definitionally equivalent to
;; C <= limsup u in the extended reals:
;;
;;   every b < C is exceeded by u_n at arbitrarily late indices.
;;
;; Thus the same predicate covers both bounded sequences and the +infinity
;; case without replacing limsup by a finite approximation.

(defun-sk p63a4-eventual-exceedance-exists-p
    (real-type sequence lower-bound cutoff)
  (exists (n)
    (and
     (natp n)
     (<= cutoff n)
     (p63a4-less
      real-type
      lower-bound
      (p63a4-transformed-value
       real-type sequence n)))))

(defun-sk p63a4-at-most-extended-limsup-p
    (real-type sequence bound)
  (forall (lower-bound cutoff)
    (implies
     (and
      (p63a4-real-p real-type lower-bound)
      (p63a4-less real-type lower-bound bound)
      (natp cutoff))
     (p63a4-eventual-exceedance-exists-p
      real-type sequence lower-bound cutoff))))

(defun-sk p63a4-universal-lower-bound-p (real-type)
  (forall (sequence)
    (implies
     (p63a4-positive-sequence-p real-type sequence)
     (p63a4-at-most-extended-limsup-p
      real-type sequence (p63a4-one real-type)))))

(defun-sk p63a4-sharp-counterexample-exists-p
    (real-type bound)
  (exists (sequence)
    (and
     (p63a4-positive-sequence-p real-type sequence)
     (not
      (p63a4-at-most-extended-limsup-p
       real-type sequence bound)))))

(defun-sk p63a4-sharpness-p (real-type)
  (forall (bound)
    (implies
     (and
      (p63a4-real-p real-type bound)
      (p63a4-less
       real-type (p63a4-one real-type) bound))
     (p63a4-sharp-counterexample-exists-p
      real-type bound))))

(defun putnambench-putnam-1963-a4-statement (real-type)
  (implies
   (p63a4-real-structure-p real-type)
   (and
    (p63a4-universal-lower-bound-p real-type)
    (p63a4-sharpness-p real-type))))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

title: putnam_1963_a4
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1963_a4:
-- every positive real sequence has limsup at least 1 for the transformed
-- sequence n * ((1 + a(n + 1)) / a(n) - 1), and no larger universal lower
-- bound is possible. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; _*_)

infix 4 _!=_ _<=N_
infixr 3 _and_
infixr 2 _or_

data Bottom : Set where

Not : Set -> Set
Not A = A -> Bottom

_!=_ : {A : Set} -> A -> A -> Set
x != y = Not (x == y)

record _and_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data _or_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  left  : A -> A or B
  right : B -> A or B

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

data _<=N_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set where
  zero<=   : {n : Nat} -> zero <=N n
  suc<=suc : {m n : Nat} -> m <=N n -> suc m <=N suc n

record CompleteOrderedField (R : Set) : Set1 where
  field
    zeroR oneR : R
    add multiply : R -> R -> R
    negate inverse : R -> R
    lessOrEqual : R -> R -> Set
    fromNat : Nat -> R

    one-not-zero :
      oneR != zeroR

    add-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> add x y == add y x
    add-associative :
      (x y z : R) -> add (add x y) z == add x (add y z)
    add-zero :
      (x : R) -> add x zeroR == x
    add-inverse :
      (x : R) -> add x (negate x) == zeroR

    multiply-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> multiply x y == multiply y x
    multiply-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply (multiply x y) z == multiply x (multiply y z)
    multiply-one :
      (x : R) -> multiply x oneR == x
    multiply-zero :
      (x : R) -> multiply x zeroR == zeroR
    distribute :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply x (add y z) ==
      add (multiply x y) (multiply x z)
    inverse-zero :
      inverse zeroR == zeroR
    multiply-inverse :
      (x : R) ->
      x != zeroR ->
      multiply x (inverse x) == oneR

    order-reflexive :
      (x : R) -> lessOrEqual x x
    order-transitive :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y z ->
      lessOrEqual x z
    order-antisymmetric :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y x ->
      x == y
    order-total :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y or lessOrEqual y x
    add-order :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual (add z x) (add z y)
    multiply-nonnegative :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR x ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR y ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR (multiply x y)
    zero-less-than-one :
      lessOrEqual zeroR oneR and zeroR != oneR

    fromNat-zero :
      fromNat zero == zeroR
    fromNat-successor :
      (n : Nat) -> fromNat (suc n) == add (fromNat n) oneR
    fromNat-addition :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m + n) == add (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-multiplication :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m * n) == multiply (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-injective :
      (m n : Nat) -> fromNat m == fromNat n -> m == n

    archimedean :
      (x : R) ->
      Exists Nat (\ n -> lessOrEqual x (fromNat n))
    least-upper-bound :
      (P : R -> Set) ->
      Exists R P ->
      Exists R
        (\ upper ->
          (x : R) -> P x -> lessOrEqual x upper) ->
      Exists R
        (\ supremum ->
          ((x : R) -> P x -> lessOrEqual x supremum)
          and
          ((upper : R) ->
            ((x : R) -> P x -> lessOrEqual x upper) ->
            lessOrEqual supremum upper))

open CompleteOrderedField

subtract :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
subtract reals x y =
  add reals x (negate reals y)

divide :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
divide reals x y =
  multiply reals x (inverse reals y)

StrictLess :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
StrictLess reals x y =
  lessOrEqual reals x y and x != y

PositiveSequence :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  Set
PositiveSequence reals sequence =
  (n : Nat) ->
  StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) (sequence n)

transformedSequence :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  Nat ->
  R
transformedSequence reals sequence n =
  multiply reals
    (fromNat reals n)
    (subtract reals
      (divide reals
        (add reals
          (oneR reals)
          (sequence (suc n)))
        (sequence n))
      (oneR reals))

TailUpperBound :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  Nat ->
  R ->
  Set
TailUpperBound reals sequence cutoff bound =
  (n : Nat) ->
  cutoff <=N n ->
  lessOrEqual reals (sequence n) bound

LimsupAtLeast :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  R ->
  Set
LimsupAtLeast {R} reals sequence threshold =
  (cutoff : Nat) ->
  (bound : R) ->
  TailUpperBound reals sequence cutoff bound ->
  lessOrEqual reals threshold bound

module Putnam1963A4Statement
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) where

  proposition : Set
  proposition =
    ((sequence : Nat -> R) ->
      PositiveSequence reals sequence ->
      LimsupAtLeast reals
        (transformedSequence reals sequence)
        (oneR reals))
    and
    ((constant : R) ->
      StrictLess reals (oneR reals) constant ->
      Exists (Nat -> R)
        (\ sequence ->
          PositiveSequence reals sequence
          and
          Not
            (LimsupAtLeast reals
              (transformedSequence reals sequence)
              constant)))

putnam-1963-a4 : Set1
putnam-1963-a4 =
  (R : Set) ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) ->
  Putnam1963A4Statement.proposition reals

title: putnam_1963_a4
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench artifact putnam_1963_a4:
  the extended-real limit superior bound for a sequence derived from any
  positive real sequence, together with the sharpness of the bound one.
  This file contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open arithmeticTheory realTheory extrealTheory;

val putnam_1963_a4 =
  ``let T =
      \a : num -> real.
      \n : num.
        Normal (&n * ((1 + a (SUC n)) / a n - 1))
    in
      (!a : num -> real.
         (!n : num. 0 < a n)
         ==>
         Normal 1 <= limsup (T a)) /\
      (!C : real.
         1 < C
         ==>
         ?a : num -> real.
           (!n : num. 0 < a n) /\
           ~(Normal C <= limsup (T a)))``;

  the extended-real limsup bound for a sequence of positive real numbers,
  together with the sharpness of the constant one. This file contains no

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(

  unbounded-above real sequence has the same plus-infinity behavior represented
  explicitly by the auxiliary predicates in the Lean and Rocq sources.

  The final unproved $a assertion quantifies over every positive real sequence.
  Its second conjunct preserves the internal counterexample sequence for each
  real constant greater than one.
$)

${
  $d A C n $.

  putnambench-putnam-1963-a4 $a |- (
    A. A e. ( RR ^m NN0 )
      (

        ->

          (

            `
            (

                (

                  x.

                    (
                      ( 1 + ( A ` ( n + 1 ) ) )
                      /
                      ( A ` n )
                    )
                    -
                    1
                  )
                )
            )
          )
      )
    /\
    A. C e. RR
      (
        1 < C
        ->
        E. A e. ( RR ^m NN0 )
          (
            A. n e. NN0 0 < ( A ` n )
            /\
            -.
              C <_
                (
                  limsup
                  `
                  (
                    n e. NN0 |->
                      (
                        n
                        x.
                        (
                          (
                            ( 1 + ( A ` ( n + 1 ) ) )
                            /
                            ( A ` n )
                          )
                          -
                          1
                        )
                      )
                  )
                )
          )
      )
  ) $.
$}

% Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench artifact putnam_1963_a4:
% every positive real sequence has the specified transformed sequence with
% extended-real limsup at least 1, and no larger universal lower bound works.
% This file contains no proof.

putnam_1963_a4: THEORY
BEGIN
  real_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> real]

  safe_div(numerator, denominator: real): real =
    IF denominator = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      numerator / denominator
    ENDIF

  positive_sequence(a: real_sequence): bool =
    FORALL (n: nat):
      a(n) > 0

  transformed_sequence(a: real_sequence): real_sequence =
    LAMBDA (n: nat):
      (n :: real)
        * (safe_div(1 + a(n + 1), a(n)) - 1)

  at_most_extended_limsup(
      values: real_sequence,
      bound: real): bool =
    FORALL (epsilon_value: real):
      epsilon_value > 0 IMPLIES
        FORALL (cutoff: nat):
          EXISTS (index: nat):
            cutoff <= index
              AND bound - epsilon_value < values(index)

  putnam_1963_a4: bool =
    (FORALL (a: real_sequence):
      positive_sequence(a) IMPLIES
        at_most_extended_limsup(
          transformed_sequence(a), 1))
      AND (FORALL (bound: real):
        bound > 1 IMPLIES
          EXISTS (a: real_sequence):
            positive_sequence(a)
              AND NOT at_most_extended_limsup(
                transformed_sequence(a), bound))
END putnam_1963_a4

title: putnam_1963_a6
content:
(* Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench artifact putnam_1963_a6:
   the midpoint relation determined by three chords of an ellipse and their
   cross-line intersections. This file contains no proof. *)

From Stdlib Require Import Reals.

Open Scope R_scope.

Definition point := (R * R)%type.
Definition point_set := point -> Prop.

Definition point_distance (a b : point) : R :=
  sqrt ((fst a - fst b) ^ 2 + (snd a - snd b) ^ 2).

Definition midpoint (a b : point) : point :=
  ((fst a + fst b) / 2, (snd a + snd b) / 2).

Definition affine_combination (t : R) (a b : point) : point :=
  ((1 - t) * fst a + t * fst b,
   (1 - t) * snd a + t * snd b).

Definition closed_segment (a b : point) : point_set :=
  fun p =>
    exists t : R,
      0 <= t <= 1 /\
      p = affine_combination t a b.

Definition same_set (A B : point_set) : Prop :=
  forall p : point, A p <-> B p.

Definition collinear_points (a b c : point) : Prop :=
  (fst b - fst a) * (snd c - snd a) =
  (snd b - snd a) * (fst c - fst a).

Theorem putnam_1963_a6 :
  forall
    (F1 F2 U V A B C D P Q : point)
    (r : R)
    (E : point_set)
    (M : point),
    (forall H : point,
      E H <->
      point_distance F1 H + point_distance F2 H = r) ->
    M = midpoint U V ->
    r > point_distance F1 F2 ->
    (E U /\ E V /\ U <> V) ->
    (E A /\ E B /\ A <> B) ->
    (E C /\ E D /\ C <> D) ->
    A <> C ->
    B <> D ->
    (~ same_set (closed_segment A B) (closed_segment U V) /\
     ~ same_set (closed_segment C D) (closed_segment U V) /\
     ~ same_set (closed_segment A B) (closed_segment C D)) ->
    (closed_segment A B M /\ closed_segment C D M) ->
    (collinear_points P A C /\ collinear_points P U V) ->
    (collinear_points Q B D /\ collinear_points Q U V) ->
    M = midpoint P Q.
Admitted.

(*
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench artifact putnam_1963_a6:
  an ellipse chord-midpoint configuration in which two induced intersection
  points have the original chord midpoint as their midpoint. This file
  contains no proof.
*)

let statement =
  `let edist =
     \(x:real#real) (y:real#real).
       sqrt ((FST x - FST y) pow 2 + (SND x - SND y) pow 2) in
   let midpoint =
     \(x:real#real) (y:real#real).
       ((FST x + FST y) / &2, (SND x + SND y) / &2) in
   let segment =
     \(a:real#real) (b:real#real) (x:real#real).
       ?t:real.
         &0 <= t /\ t <= &1 /\
         FST x = (&1 - t) * FST a + t * FST b /\
         SND x = (&1 - t) * SND a + t * SND b in
   let collinear3 =
     \(a:real#real) (b:real#real) (c:real#real).
       (FST b - FST a) * (SND c - SND a) =
       (SND b - SND a) * (FST c - FST a) in
   !F1 F2 U V A B C D P Q:real#real.
   !r:real. !E:(real#real)->bool. !M:real#real.
     E = {H | edist F1 H + edist F2 H = r} /\
     M = midpoint U V /\
     r > edist F1 F2 /\
     U IN E /\ V IN E /\ ~(U = V) /\
     A IN E /\ B IN E /\ ~(A = B) /\
     C IN E /\ D IN E /\ ~(C = D) /\
     ~(A = C) /\ ~(B = D) /\
     ~(segment A B = segment U V) /\
     ~(segment C D = segment U V) /\
     ~(segment A B = segment C D) /\
     segment A B M /\ segment C D M /\
     collinear3 P A C /\ collinear3 P U V /\
     collinear3 Q B D /\ collinear3 Q U V
     ==> M = midpoint P Q`;;

title: putnam_1963_a6
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1963_a6:
;; the midpoint relation determined by three chords of a real ellipse and
;; the intersections of their endpoint-joining lines. This file contains no
;; proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))

;; The scalar context below presents an arbitrary ordered field by tame
;; APPLY$ function objects. The resulting coordinate formula is universal
;; and quantifier-free in the ordered-field language. It is equivalent to
;; the source statement over the reals, and its validity over the reals is
;; equivalent to its validity over every ordered field: real closed fields
;; are elementarily equivalent, every ordered field embeds in a real closure,
;; and universal formulas are preserved by ordered subfields.
;;
;; If x and y are squared distances and r > 0, then
;;
;;   sqrt(x) + sqrt(y) = r
;;
;; is bidirectionally equivalent over the reals to
;;
;;   0 <= r^2 - x - y
;;   (r^2 - x - y)^2 = 4xy.
;;
;; Collinearity is the vanishing of the planar orientation determinant. For
;; collinear points, (P-A) dot (P-B) <= 0 is exactly membership in the closed
;; segment AB. With distinct endpoints, equality of two closed segments is
;; equality of their unordered endpoint pairs. Midpoints are expressed by
;; the coordinate equalities 2M = X + Y.

(defun putnam-1963-a6-member-p (carrier x)
  (if (apply$ carrier (list x)) t nil))

(defun putnam-1963-a6-unary-value (operation x)
  (apply$ operation (list x)))

(defun putnam-1963-a6-binary-value (operation x y)
  (apply$ operation (list x y)))

(defun-sk putnam-1963-a6-field-laws-p
    (carrier add multiply negate inverse zero one)
  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (putnam-1963-a6-member-p carrier x)
      (putnam-1963-a6-member-p carrier y)
      (putnam-1963-a6-member-p carrier z))
     (and
      (putnam-1963-a6-member-p
       carrier
       (putnam-1963-a6-binary-value add x y))
      (putnam-1963-a6-member-p
       carrier
       (putnam-1963-a6-binary-value multiply x y))
      (putnam-1963-a6-member-p
       carrier
       (putnam-1963-a6-unary-value negate x))
      (implies
       (not (equal x zero))
       (putnam-1963-a6-member-p
        carrier
        (putnam-1963-a6-unary-value inverse x)))
      (equal
       (putnam-1963-a6-binary-value
        add
        (putnam-1963-a6-binary-value add x y)
        z)
       (putnam-1963-a6-binary-value
        add
        x
        (putnam-1963-a6-binary-value add y z)))
      (equal
       (putnam-1963-a6-binary-value add x y)
       (putnam-1963-a6-binary-value add y x))
      (equal
       (putnam-1963-a6-binary-value add x zero)
       x)
      (equal
       (putnam-1963-a6-binary-value
        add x (putnam-1963-a6-unary-value negate x))
       zero)
      (equal
       (putnam-1963-a6-binary-value
        multiply
        (putnam-1963-a6-binary-value multiply x y)
        z)
       (putnam-1963-a6-binary-value
        multiply
        x
        (putnam-1963-a6-binary-value multiply y z)))
      (equal
       (putnam-1963-a6-binary-value multiply x y)
       (putnam-1963-a6-binary-value multiply y x))
      (equal
       (putnam-1963-a6-binary-value multiply x one)
       x)
      (implies
       (not (equal x zero))
       (equal
        (putnam-1963-a6-binary-value
         multiply
         x
         (putnam-1963-a6-unary-value inverse x))
        one))
      (equal
       (putnam-1963-a6-binary-value
        multiply
        x
        (putnam-1963-a6-binary-value add y z))
       (putnam-1963-a6-binary-value
        add
        (putnam-1963-a6-binary-value multiply x y)
        (putnam-1963-a6-binary-value multiply x z)))))))

(defun-sk putnam-1963-a6-order-laws-p
    (carrier add multiply zero less)
  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (putnam-1963-a6-member-p carrier x)
      (putnam-1963-a6-member-p carrier y)
      (putnam-1963-a6-member-p carrier z))
     (and
      (not (putnam-1963-a6-binary-value less x x))
      (or
       (equal x y)
       (putnam-1963-a6-binary-value less x y)
       (putnam-1963-a6-binary-value less y x))
      (implies
       (and
        (putnam-1963-a6-binary-value less x y)
        (putnam-1963-a6-binary-value less y z))
       (putnam-1963-a6-binary-value less x z))
      (implies
       (putnam-1963-a6-binary-value less x y)
       (putnam-1963-a6-binary-value
        less
        (putnam-1963-a6-binary-value add x z)
        (putnam-1963-a6-binary-value add y z)))
      (implies
       (and
        (putnam-1963-a6-binary-value less zero x)
        (putnam-1963-a6-binary-value less zero y))
       (putnam-1963-a6-binary-value
        less
        zero
        (putnam-1963-a6-binary-value multiply x y)))))))

(defun putnam-1963-a6-ordered-field-p
    (carrier add multiply negate inverse zero one less)
  (and
   (tamep-functionp carrier)
   (tamep-functionp add)
   (tamep-functionp multiply)
   (tamep-functionp negate)
   (tamep-functionp inverse)
   (tamep-functionp less)
   (putnam-1963-a6-member-p carrier zero)
   (putnam-1963-a6-member-p carrier one)
   (not (equal zero one))
   (putnam-1963-a6-field-laws-p
    carrier add multiply negate inverse zero one)
   (putnam-1963-a6-order-laws-p
    carrier add multiply zero less)
   (putnam-1963-a6-binary-value less zero one)))

(defun putnam-1963-a6-r-carrier (context) (nth 0 context))
(defun putnam-1963-a6-r-zero (context) (nth 1 context))
(defun putnam-1963-a6-r-one (context) (nth 2 context))
(defun putnam-1963-a6-r-add (context) (nth 3 context))
(defun putnam-1963-a6-r-multiply (context) (nth 4 context))
(defun putnam-1963-a6-r-negate (context) (nth 5 context))
(defun putnam-1963-a6-r-inverse (context) (nth 6 context))
(defun putnam-1963-a6-r-less (context) (nth 7 context))

(defun putnam-1963-a6-context-p (context)
  (and
   (true-listp context)
   (equal (len context) 8)
   (putnam-1963-a6-ordered-field-p
    (putnam-1963-a6-r-carrier context)
    (putnam-1963-a6-r-add context)
    (putnam-1963-a6-r-multiply context)
    (putnam-1963-a6-r-negate context)
    (putnam-1963-a6-r-inverse context)
    (putnam-1963-a6-r-zero context)
    (putnam-1963-a6-r-one context)
    (putnam-1963-a6-r-less context))))

(defun putnam-1963-a6-scalar-p (context x)
  (putnam-1963-a6-member-p
   (putnam-1963-a6-r-carrier context) x))

(defun putnam-1963-a6-add (context x y)
  (putnam-1963-a6-binary-value
   (putnam-1963-a6-r-add context) x y))

(defun putnam-1963-a6-multiply (context x y)
  (putnam-1963-a6-binary-value
   (putnam-1963-a6-r-multiply context) x y))

(defun putnam-1963-a6-negate (context x)
  (putnam-1963-a6-unary-value
   (putnam-1963-a6-r-negate context) x))

(defun putnam-1963-a6-subtract (context x y)
  (putnam-1963-a6-add
   context x (putnam-1963-a6-negate context y)))

(defun putnam-1963-a6-less-p (context x y)
  (if
   (putnam-1963-a6-binary-value
    (putnam-1963-a6-r-less context) x y)
   t
   nil))

(defun putnam-1963-a6-less-equal-p (context x y)
  (not (putnam-1963-a6-less-p context y x)))

(defun putnam-1963-a6-square (context x)
  (putnam-1963-a6-multiply context x x))

(defun putnam-1963-a6-two (context)
  (putnam-1963-a6-add
   context
   (putnam-1963-a6-r-one context)
   (putnam-1963-a6-r-one context)))

(defun putnam-1963-a6-four (context)
  (putnam-1963-a6-square
   context (putnam-1963-a6-two context)))

(defun putnam-1963-a6-point-equal-p (left right)
  (and
   (equal (car left) (car right))
   (equal (cadr left) (cadr right))))

(defun putnam-1963-a6-distance-squared (context left right)
  (putnam-1963-a6-add
   context
   (putnam-1963-a6-square
    context
    (putnam-1963-a6-subtract
     context (car left) (car right)))
   (putnam-1963-a6-square
    context
    (putnam-1963-a6-subtract
     context (cadr left) (cadr right)))))

(defun putnam-1963-a6-orientation (context a b c)
  (putnam-1963-a6-subtract
   context
   (putnam-1963-a6-multiply
    context
    (putnam-1963-a6-subtract
     context (car b) (car a))
    (putnam-1963-a6-subtract
     context (cadr c) (cadr a)))
   (putnam-1963-a6-multiply
    context
    (putnam-1963-a6-subtract
     context (cadr b) (cadr a))
    (putnam-1963-a6-subtract
     context (car c) (car a)))))

(defun putnam-1963-a6-collinear-p (context a b c)
  (equal
   (putnam-1963-a6-orientation context a b c)
   (putnam-1963-a6-r-zero context)))

(defun putnam-1963-a6-closed-segment-p (context point a b)
  (and
   (putnam-1963-a6-collinear-p context point a b)
   (putnam-1963-a6-less-equal-p
    context
    (putnam-1963-a6-add
     context
     (putnam-1963-a6-multiply
      context
      (putnam-1963-a6-subtract
       context (car point) (car a))
      (putnam-1963-a6-subtract
       context (car point) (car b)))
     (putnam-1963-a6-multiply
      context
      (putnam-1963-a6-subtract
       context (cadr point) (cadr a))
      (putnam-1963-a6-subtract
       context (cadr point) (cadr b))))
    (putnam-1963-a6-r-zero context))))

(defun putnam-1963-a6-segments-equal-p (a b c d)
  (or
   (and
    (putnam-1963-a6-point-equal-p a c)
    (putnam-1963-a6-point-equal-p b d))
   (and
    (putnam-1963-a6-point-equal-p a d)
    (putnam-1963-a6-point-equal-p b c))))

(defun putnam-1963-a6-ellipse-point-p
    (context point f1 f2 r)
  (let* ((first-distance-squared
          (putnam-1963-a6-distance-squared
           context point f1))
         (second-distance-squared
          (putnam-1963-a6-distance-squared
           context point f2))
         (radius-squared
          (putnam-1963-a6-square context r))
         (ellipse-defect
          (putnam-1963-a6-subtract
           context
           (putnam-1963-a6-subtract
            context radius-squared first-distance-squared)
           second-distance-squared)))
    (and
     (putnam-1963-a6-less-equal-p
      context
      (putnam-1963-a6-r-zero context)
      ellipse-defect)
     (equal
      (putnam-1963-a6-square context ellipse-defect)
      (putnam-1963-a6-multiply
       context
       (putnam-1963-a6-four context)
       (putnam-1963-a6-multiply
        context
        first-distance-squared
        second-distance-squared))))))

(defun putnam-1963-a6-midpoint-p
    (context midpoint left right)
  (let ((two (putnam-1963-a6-two context)))
    (and
     (equal
      (putnam-1963-a6-multiply
       context two (car midpoint))
      (putnam-1963-a6-add
       context (car left) (car right)))
     (equal
      (putnam-1963-a6-multiply
       context two (cadr midpoint))
      (putnam-1963-a6-add
       context (cadr left) (cadr right))))))

(defun putnambench-putnam-1963-a6-statement
    (context
     f1-x f1-y f2-x f2-y
     u-x u-y v-x v-y
     a-x a-y b-x b-y
     c-x c-y d-x d-y
     p-x p-y q-x q-y
     m-x m-y r)
  (let* ((f1 (list f1-x f1-y))
         (f2 (list f2-x f2-y))
         (u (list u-x u-y))
         (v (list v-x v-y))
         (a (list a-x a-y))
         (b (list b-x b-y))
         (c (list c-x c-y))
         (d (list d-x d-y))

title: putnam_1963_a6
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1963_a6:
-- for three distinct chords of an ellipse through the midpoint of one chord,
-- the two specified intersections on that chord's line have the same midpoint.
-- This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module Putnam1963A6 where

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc)

infix 4 _!=_
infixr 3 _and_
infixr 2 _or_

data Bottom : Set where

Not : Set -> Set
Not A = A -> Bottom

_!=_ : {A : Set} -> A -> A -> Set
x != y = Not (x == y)

record _and_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data _or_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  left  : A -> A or B
  right : B -> A or B

record Iff (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor equivalence
  field
    forward  : A -> B
    backward : B -> A

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

record CompleteOrderedRealField (R : Set) : Set1 where
  field
    zeroR oneR : R
    add multiply : R -> R -> R
    negate inverse squareRoot : R -> R
    lessOrEqual : R -> R -> Set
    fromNat : Nat -> R

    one-not-zero :
      oneR != zeroR

    add-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> add x y == add y x
    add-associative :
      (x y z : R) -> add (add x y) z == add x (add y z)
    add-zero :
      (x : R) -> add x zeroR == x
    add-inverse :
      (x : R) -> add x (negate x) == zeroR

    multiply-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> multiply x y == multiply y x
    multiply-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply (multiply x y) z == multiply x (multiply y z)
    multiply-one :
      (x : R) -> multiply x oneR == x
    multiply-zero :
      (x : R) -> multiply x zeroR == zeroR
    distribute :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply x (add y z) ==
      add (multiply x y) (multiply x z)
    inverse-zero :
      inverse zeroR == zeroR
    multiply-inverse :
      (x : R) ->
      x != zeroR ->
      multiply x (inverse x) == oneR

    order-reflexive :
      (x : R) -> lessOrEqual x x
    order-transitive :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y z ->
      lessOrEqual x z
    order-antisymmetric :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y x ->
      x == y
    order-total :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y or lessOrEqual y x
    add-order :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual (add z x) (add z y)
    multiply-nonnegative :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR x ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR y ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR (multiply x y)
    zero-less-than-one :
      lessOrEqual zeroR oneR and zeroR != oneR

    fromNat-zero :
      fromNat zero == zeroR
    fromNat-successor :
      (n : Nat) -> fromNat (suc n) == add (fromNat n) oneR
    archimedean :
      (x : R) ->
      Exists Nat (\ n -> lessOrEqual x (fromNat n))
    least-upper-bound :
      (P : R -> Set) ->
      Exists R P ->
      Exists R
        (\ upper ->
          (x : R) ->
          P x ->
          lessOrEqual x upper) ->
      Exists R
        (\ supremum ->
          ((x : R) -> P x -> lessOrEqual x supremum)
          and
          ((upper : R) ->
            ((x : R) -> P x -> lessOrEqual x upper) ->
            lessOrEqual supremum upper))

    square-root-nonnegative :
      (x : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR (squareRoot x)
    square-root-square :
      (x : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR x ->
      multiply (squareRoot x) (squareRoot x) == x
    square-root-nonpositive :
      (x : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x zeroR ->
      squareRoot x == zeroR
    square-root-unique :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR y ->
      multiply y y == x ->
      y == squareRoot x

open CompleteOrderedRealField

subtract :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
subtract reals x y =
  add reals x (negate reals y)

square :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R
square reals x =
  multiply reals x x

two :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R
two reals =
  add reals (oneR reals) (oneR reals)

half :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R
half reals =
  inverse reals (two reals)

StrictLess :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
StrictLess reals x y =
  lessOrEqual reals x y and x != y

record Point (R : Set) : Set where
  constructor point
  field
    x-coordinate : R
    y-coordinate : R

open Point

Subset :
  (R : Set) ->
  Set1
Subset R =
  Point R -> Set

SameSubset :
  {R : Set} ->
  Subset R ->
  Subset R ->
  Set
SameSubset {R} A B =
  (p : Point R) ->
  Iff (A p) (B p)

affineCombination :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  Point R ->
  Point R ->
  Point R
affineCombination reals coefficient p q =
  point
    (add reals
      (multiply reals coefficient (x-coordinate p))
      (multiply reals
        (subtract reals (oneR reals) coefficient)
        (x-coordinate q)))
    (add reals
      (multiply reals coefficient (y-coordinate p))
      (multiply reals
        (subtract reals (oneR reals) coefficient)
        (y-coordinate q)))

ClosedSegment :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Point R ->
  Point R ->
  Subset R
ClosedSegment {R} reals p q x =
  Exists R
    (\ coefficient ->
      lessOrEqual reals (zeroR reals) coefficient
      and
      lessOrEqual reals coefficient (oneR reals)
      and
      x == affineCombination reals coefficient p q)

DistinctSegments :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Point R ->
  Point R ->
  Point R ->
  Point R ->
  Set
DistinctSegments reals a b c d =
  Not
    (SameSubset
      (ClosedSegment reals a b)
      (ClosedSegment reals c d))

midpoint :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Point R ->
  Point R ->
  Point R
midpoint reals p q =
  affineCombination reals (half reals) p q

doubleSignedArea :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Point R ->
  Point R ->
  Point R ->
  R
doubleSignedArea reals a b c =
  subtract reals
    (multiply reals
      (subtract reals (x-coordinate b) (x-coordinate a))
      (subtract reals (y-coordinate c) (y-coordinate a)))
    (multiply reals
      (subtract reals (y-coordinate b) (y-coordinate a))
      (subtract reals (x-coordinate c) (x-coordinate a)))

Collinear :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Point R ->
  Point R ->
  Point R ->
  Set
Collinear reals a b c =
  doubleSignedArea reals a b c == zeroR reals

squaredDistance :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Point R ->
  Point R ->
  R
squaredDistance reals p q =
  add reals
    (square reals
      (subtract reals (x-coordinate p) (x-coordinate q)))
    (square reals
      (subtract reals (y-coordinate p) (y-coordinate q)))

distance :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Point R ->
  Point R ->
  R
distance reals p q =
  squareRoot reals (squaredDistance reals p q)

Ellipse :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Point R ->
  Point R ->
  R ->
  Subset R
Ellipse reals focus1 focus2 radius p =
  add reals
    (distance reals focus1 p)
    (distance reals focus2 p)
  ==
  radius

module Putnam1963A6Statement
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) where

  proposition : Set1
  proposition =
    (F1 F2 U V A B C D P Q : Point R) ->
    (r : R) ->
    (E : Subset R) ->
    SameSubset E (Ellipse reals F1 F2 r) ->
    (M : Point R) ->
    M == midpoint reals U V ->
    StrictLess reals (distance reals F1 F2) r ->
    (E U and E V and U != V) ->
    (E A and E B and A != B) ->
    (E C and E D and C != D) ->
    A != C ->
    B != D ->
    (DistinctSegments reals A B U V
      and
      DistinctSegments reals C D U V
      and
      DistinctSegments reals A B C D) ->
    (ClosedSegment reals A B M
      and
      ClosedSegment reals C D M) ->
    (Collinear reals P A C
      and
      Collinear reals P U V) ->
    (Collinear reals Q B D
      and
      Collinear reals Q U V) ->
    M == midpoint reals P Q

putnam-1963-a6 : Set1
putnam-1963-a6 =
  (R : Set) ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) ->
  Putnam1963A6Statement.proposition reals

title: putnam_1963_a6
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench artifact putnam_1963_a6:
  three distinct chords of a real-plane ellipse, two passing through the
  midpoint of the third, determine two collinear intersections whose midpoint
  is the shared chord midpoint. This file contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open pairTheory pred_setTheory realTheory transcTheory;

val putnam_1963_a6 =
  ``let dist =
      \P Q : real # real.
        sqrt ((FST P - FST Q) pow 2 + (SND P - SND Q) pow 2)
    in
    let midpoint =
      \P Q : real # real.
        ((FST P + FST Q) / 2, (SND P + SND Q) / 2)
    in
    let collinear =
      \P Q R : real # real.
        (FST P - FST R) * (SND Q - SND R) =
        (SND P - SND R) * (FST Q - FST R)
    in
    let closed_segment =
      \A B : real # real.
      \X : real # real.
        ?t : real.
          0 <= t /\ t <= 1 /\
          X = ((1 - t) * FST A + t * FST B,
               (1 - t) * SND A + t * SND B)
    in
      !F1 F2 U V A B C D P Q M : real # real.
      !r : real. !E : (real # real) set.
        M = midpoint U V /\
        E = {H : real # real | dist F1 H + dist F2 H = r} /\
        r > dist F1 F2 /\
        U IN E /\ V IN E /\ U <> V /\
        A IN E /\ B IN E /\ A <> B /\
        C IN E /\ D IN E /\ C <> D /\
        A <> C /\ B <> D /\
        closed_segment A B <> closed_segment U V /\
        closed_segment C D <> closed_segment U V /\
        closed_segment A B <> closed_segment C D /\
        closed_segment A B M /\ closed_segment C D M /\
        collinear P A C /\ collinear P U V /\
        collinear Q B D /\ collinear Q U V
        ==>
        M = midpoint P Q``;

title: putnam_1963_a6
content:
$(
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench artifact putnam_1963_a6:
  the midpoint theorem for three distinct chords of a real-plane ellipse,
  with the intersections of the opposite-endpoint lines lying on the first
  chord's line. This file contains no proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  P63A6R2 is the two-dimensional real coordinate plane. P63A6Dist is
  Euclidean distance, P63A6Mid is coordinatewise midpoint, P63A6Segment is
  the closed affine segment, and P63A6Col is determinant collinearity.
  P63A6Ellipse is the focus-and-distance-sum definition of the source set E.

  The Q, B, D collinearity premise follows the Lean statement and the
  mathematical problem description; the occurrence of P in that position
  in the Isabelle source is a typographical inconsistency. The explicit
  A =/= C and B =/= D line nondegeneracy premises are retained from Lean.
  The final declaration is the single unproved $a corpus statement; this
  database contains no $p proof statement.
$)

$c
  P63A6I P63A6R2 P63A6Dist P63A6Mid P63A6Segment P63A6Col P63A6Ellipse
$.

p63a6-index-syntax $a class P63A6I $.
p63a6-plane-syntax $a class P63A6R2 $.
p63a6-distance-syntax $a class ( P63A6Dist A B ) $.
p63a6-midpoint-syntax $a class ( P63A6Mid A B ) $.
p63a6-segment-syntax $a class ( P63A6Segment A B ) $.
p63a6-collinear-syntax $a wff ( P63A6Col A B C ) $.
p63a6-ellipse-syntax $a class ( P63A6Ellipse F G r ) $.

p63a6-index-definition $a |- P63A6I = ( 1 ... 2 ) $.

p63a6-plane-definition $a |- P63A6R2 = ( RR ^m P63A6I ) $.

${
  $d A B j $.

  p63a6-distance-definition $a |- (
    P63A6Dist A B
  ) = (
    sqrt
    `
    (
      sum_ j e. P63A6I
        ( ( ( A ` j ) - ( B ` j ) ) ^ 2 )
    )
  ) $.

  p63a6-midpoint-definition $a |- (
    P63A6Mid A B
  ) = (
    j e. P63A6I |->
      (
        ( ( A ` j ) + ( B ` j ) )
        /
        2
      )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d A B j t z $.

  p63a6-segment-definition $a |- (
    P63A6Segment A B
  ) = {
    z e. P63A6R2 |
    E. t e. ( 0 [,] 1 )
      z =
        (
          j e. P63A6I |->
            (
              ( ( 1 - t ) x. ( A ` j ) )
              +
              ( t x. ( B ` j ) )
            )
        )
  } $.
$}

p63a6-collinear-definition $a |- (
  ( P63A6Col A B C )
  <->
  (
    (
      ( ( B ` 1 ) - ( A ` 1 ) )
      x.
      ( ( C ` 2 ) - ( A ` 2 ) )
    )
    =
    (
      ( ( B ` 2 ) - ( A ` 2 ) )
      x.
      ( ( C ` 1 ) - ( A ` 1 ) )
    )
  )
) $.

${
  $d F G H r $.

  p63a6-ellipse-definition $a |- (
    P63A6Ellipse F G r
  ) = {
    H e. P63A6R2 |
      (
        ( P63A6Dist F H )
        +
        ( P63A6Dist G H )
      )
      =
      r
  } $.
$}

${
  $d A B C D E F G M P Q U V r $.

  putnambench-putnam-1963-a6 $a |- (
    A. F e. P63A6R2
    A. G e. P63A6R2
    A. U e. P63A6R2
    A. V e. P63A6R2
    A. A e. P63A6R2
    A. B e. P63A6R2
    A. C e. P63A6R2
    A. D e. P63A6R2
    A. P e. P63A6R2
    A. Q e. P63A6R2
    A. r e. RR
    A. E
    A. M e. P63A6R2
      (
        (
          E = ( P63A6Ellipse F G r )
          /\
          (
            M = ( P63A6Mid U V )
            /\
            (
              ( P63A6Dist F G ) < r
              /\
              (
                (
                  U e. E
                  /\
                  (
                    V e. E
                    /\
                    U =/= V
                  )
                )
                /\
                (
                  (
                    A e. E
                    /\
                    (
                      B e. E
                      /\
                      A =/= B
                    )
                  )
                  /\
                  (
                    (
                      C e. E
                      /\
                      (
                        D e. E
                        /\
                        C =/= D
                      )
                    )
                    /\
                    (
                      A =/= C
                      /\
                      (
                        B =/= D
                        /\
                        (
                          (
                            ( P63A6Segment A B )
                            =/=
                            ( P63A6Segment U V )
                          )
                          /\
                          (
                            (
                              ( P63A6Segment C D )
                              =/=
                              ( P63A6Segment U V )
                            )
                            /\
                            (
                              (
                                ( P63A6Segment A B )
                                =/=
                                ( P63A6Segment C D )
                              )
                              /\
                              (
                                (
                                  M e. ( P63A6Segment A B )
                                  /\
                                  M e. ( P63A6Segment C D )
                                )
                                /\
                                (
                                  (
                                    ( P63A6Col P A C )
                                    /\
                                    ( P63A6Col P U V )
                                  )
                                  /\
                                  (
                                    ( P63A6Col Q B D )
                                    /\
                                    ( P63A6Col Q U V )
                                  )
                                )
                              )
                            )
                          )
                        )
                      )
                    )
                  )
                )
              )
            )
          )
        )
        ->
        M = ( P63A6Mid P Q )
      )
  ) $.
$}

title: putnam_1963_a6
content:
% Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench artifact putnam_1963_a6:
% two chords of an ellipse through the midpoint of a third chord determine
% two line intersections whose midpoint is the original midpoint. This file
% contains no proof.

putnam_1963_a6: THEORY
BEGIN
  point: TYPE = [# x_coord: real, y_coord: real #]
  point_set: TYPE = [point -> bool]

  midpoint(P, Q: point): point =
    (# x_coord := (x_coord(P) + x_coord(Q)) / 2,
       y_coord := (y_coord(P) + y_coord(Q)) / 2 #)

  affine_combination(t: real, P, Q: point): point =
    (# x_coord := (1 - t) * x_coord(P) + t * x_coord(Q),
       y_coord := (1 - t) * y_coord(P) + t * y_coord(Q) #)

  closed_segment(A, B: point): point_set =
    LAMBDA (X: point):
      EXISTS (t: real):
        0 <= t AND t <= 1 AND X = affine_combination(t, A, B)

  squared_distance(P, Q: point): real =
    (x_coord(Q) - x_coord(P)) ^ 2
      + (y_coord(Q) - y_coord(P)) ^ 2

  distance(P, Q: point): real =
    epsilon(
      LAMBDA (length: real):
        0 <= length AND length * length = squared_distance(P, Q))

  ellipse(F1, F2: point, r: real): point_set =
    LAMBDA (H: point):
      distance(F1, H) + distance(F2, H) = r

  collinear(P, Q, R: point): bool =
    (x_coord(Q) - x_coord(P)) * (y_coord(R) - y_coord(P))
      - (y_coord(Q) - y_coord(P)) * (x_coord(R) - x_coord(P))
      = 0

  putnam_1963_a6: bool =
    FORALL
        (F1, F2, U, V, A, B, C, D, P, Q: point),
        (r: real),
        (E: point_set),
        (M: point):
      (E = ellipse(F1, F2, r)
        AND M = midpoint(U, V)
        AND r > distance(F1, F2)
        AND E(U) AND E(V) AND U /= V
        AND E(A) AND E(B) AND A /= B
        AND E(C) AND E(D) AND C /= D
        AND A /= C
        AND B /= D
        AND closed_segment(A, B) /= closed_segment(U, V)
        AND closed_segment(C, D) /= closed_segment(U, V)
        AND closed_segment(A, B) /= closed_segment(C, D)
        AND closed_segment(A, B)(M)
        AND closed_segment(C, D)(M)
        AND collinear(P, A, C)
        AND collinear(P, U, V)
        AND collinear(Q, B, D)
        AND collinear(Q, U, V))
      IMPLIES M = midpoint(P, Q)
END putnam_1963_a6

;; Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench artifact putnam_1963_b1:
;; the integer a for which x^2 - x + a divides x^13 + x + 90.
;; This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

;; Modulo x^2 - x + a, the relation x^2 = x - a reduces every power
;; x^n to a unique linear remainder u*x + v. If x^(n-1) has remainder
;; u*x + v, multiplication by x gives (u+v)*x - a*u.
;;
;; Since the divisor is monic, polynomial division over the integers has an
;; integer-coefficient quotient and a unique remainder of degree below two.
;; Thus divisibility in Z[x] is equivalent to both remainder coefficients
;; being zero. The same zero-remainder condition is equivalent to divisibility
;; after embedding the coefficients into any real field, matching all three
;; ground-truth formulations.

(defun putnam-1963-b1-power-remainder (n a)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix n)))
  (if (zp n)
      (cons 0 1)
    (let* ((previous
            (putnam-1963-b1-power-remainder (- n 1) a))
           (u (car previous))
           (v (cdr previous)))
      (cons (+ u v)
            (- (* a u))))))

(defun putnam-1963-b1-divides-p (a)
  (let* ((power-remainder
          (putnam-1963-b1-power-remainder 13 a))
         (linear-coefficient (+ (car power-remainder) 1))
         (constant-coefficient (+ (cdr power-remainder) 90)))
    (and (equal linear-coefficient 0)
         (equal constant-coefficient 0))))

(defun putnambench-putnam-1963-b1-statement (a)
  (implies
   (integerp a)
   (equal (putnam-1963-b1-divides-p a)
          (equal a 2))))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

-- Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1963_b1:
-- the integer a for which x^2 - x + a divides x^13 + x + 90 over the real
-- numbers is exactly 2. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality using (_≡_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Int using (Int; pos; negsuc)
open import Agda.Builtin.List using (List; []; _∷_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; _*_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Sigma using (Σ)

infix 4 _≠_

data Bottom : Set where

Not : Set → Set
Not A = A → Bottom

_≠_ : {A : Set} → A → A → Set
x ≠ y = Not (x ≡ y)

record Either (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor equivalence
  field
    forward  : A → B
    backward : B → A

record Both (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data Choice (A B : Set) : Set where
  choose-left  : A → Choice A B
  choose-right : B → Choice A B

record CompleteOrderedField (R : Set) : Set₁ where
  field
    zeroR oneR : R
    addR multiplyR : R → R → R
    negateR inverseR : R → R
    lessOrEqualR : R → R → Set
    fromNatR : Nat → R

    one-not-zero :
      oneR ≠ zeroR

    add-commutative :
      (x y : R) → addR x y ≡ addR y x
    add-associative :
      (x y z : R) → addR (addR x y) z ≡ addR x (addR y z)
    add-zero :
      (x : R) → addR x zeroR ≡ x
    add-inverse :
      (x : R) → addR x (negateR x) ≡ zeroR

    multiply-commutative :
      (x y : R) → multiplyR x y ≡ multiplyR y x
    multiply-associative :
      (x y z : R) →
      multiplyR (multiplyR x y) z ≡ multiplyR x (multiplyR y z)
    multiply-one :
      (x : R) → multiplyR x oneR ≡ x
    multiply-zero :
      (x : R) → multiplyR x zeroR ≡ zeroR
    distribute :
      (x y z : R) →
      multiplyR x (addR y z) ≡
      addR (multiplyR x y) (multiplyR x z)
    multiply-inverse :
      (x : R) →
      x ≠ zeroR →
      multiplyR x (inverseR x) ≡ oneR

    order-reflexive :
      (x : R) → lessOrEqualR x x
    order-transitive :
      (x y z : R) →
      lessOrEqualR x y →
      lessOrEqualR y z →
      lessOrEqualR x z
    order-antisymmetric :
      (x y : R) →
      lessOrEqualR x y →
      lessOrEqualR y x →
      x ≡ y
    order-total :
      (x y : R) →
      Choice (lessOrEqualR x y) (lessOrEqualR y x)
    add-order :
      (x y z : R) →
      lessOrEqualR x y →
      lessOrEqualR (addR z x) (addR z y)
    multiply-nonnegative :
      (x y : R) →
      lessOrEqualR zeroR x →
      lessOrEqualR zeroR y →
      lessOrEqualR zeroR (multiplyR x y)
    zero-less-than-one :
      Both (lessOrEqualR zeroR oneR) (zeroR ≠ oneR)

    fromNat-zero :
      fromNatR zero ≡ zeroR
    fromNat-successor :
      (n : Nat) → fromNatR (suc n) ≡ addR (fromNatR n) oneR
    fromNat-addition :
      (m n : Nat) →
      fromNatR (m + n) ≡ addR (fromNatR m) (fromNatR n)
    fromNat-multiplication :
      (m n : Nat) →
      fromNatR (m * n) ≡ multiplyR (fromNatR m) (fromNatR n)
    fromNat-injective :
      (m n : Nat) → fromNatR m ≡ fromNatR n → m ≡ n

    archimedean :
      (x : R) →
      Σ Nat (λ n → lessOrEqualR x (fromNatR n))
    least-upper-bound :
      (P : R → Set) →
      Σ R P →
      Σ R (λ upper → (x : R) → P x → lessOrEqualR x upper) →
      Σ R
        (λ supremum →
          Both
            ((x : R) → P x → lessOrEqualR x supremum)
            ((upper : R) →
              ((x : R) → P x → lessOrEqualR x upper) →
              lessOrEqualR supremum upper))

fromInt :
  {R : Set} →
  CompleteOrderedField R →
  Int →
  R
fromInt reals (pos n) =
  CompleteOrderedField.fromNatR reals n
fromInt reals (negsuc n) =
  CompleteOrderedField.negateR reals
    (CompleteOrderedField.fromNatR reals (suc n))

module PolynomialDefinitions
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) where

  open CompleteOrderedField reals

  Polynomial : Set
  Polynomial = List R

  coefficient : Polynomial → Nat → R
  coefficient [] n = zeroR
  coefficient (c ∷ coefficients) zero = c
  coefficient (c ∷ coefficients) (suc n) =
    coefficient coefficients n

  PolynomialEqual : Polynomial → Polynomial → Set
  PolynomialEqual p q =
    (n : Nat) → coefficient p n ≡ coefficient q n

  addPolynomial : Polynomial → Polynomial → Polynomial
  addPolynomial [] q = q
  addPolynomial p [] = p
  addPolynomial (a ∷ p) (b ∷ q) =
    addR a b ∷ addPolynomial p q

  negatePolynomial : Polynomial → Polynomial
  negatePolynomial [] = []
  negatePolynomial (a ∷ p) =
    negateR a ∷ negatePolynomial p

  subtractPolynomial : Polynomial → Polynomial → Polynomial
  subtractPolynomial p q =
    addPolynomial p (negatePolynomial q)

  scalePolynomial : R → Polynomial → Polynomial
  scalePolynomial c [] = []
  scalePolynomial c (a ∷ p) =
    multiplyR c a ∷ scalePolynomial c p

  multiplyPolynomial : Polynomial → Polynomial → Polynomial
  multiplyPolynomial [] q = []
  multiplyPolynomial (a ∷ p) q =
    addPolynomial
      (scalePolynomial a q)
      (zeroR ∷ multiplyPolynomial p q)

  onePolynomial : Polynomial
  onePolynomial = oneR ∷ []

  constantPolynomial : R → Polynomial
  constantPolynomial c = c ∷ []

  X : Polynomial
  X = zeroR ∷ oneR ∷ []

  powerPolynomial : Polynomial → Nat → Polynomial
  powerPolynomial p zero = onePolynomial
  powerPolynomial p (suc n) =
    multiplyPolynomial p (powerPolynomial p n)

  Divides : Polynomial → Polynomial → Set
  Divides divisor dividend =
    Σ Polynomial
      (λ quotient →
        PolynomialEqual dividend
          (multiplyPolynomial divisor quotient))

  quadratic : Int → Polynomial
  quadratic a =
    addPolynomial
      (subtractPolynomial (powerPolynomial X 2) X)
      (constantPolynomial (fromInt reals a))

  degree-thirteen-polynomial : Polynomial
  degree-thirteen-polynomial =
    addPolynomial
      (addPolynomial (powerPolynomial X 13) X)
      (constantPolynomial (fromNatR 90))

putnam-1963-b1 : Set₁
putnam-1963-b1 =
  (R : Set) →
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) →
  (a : Int) →
  Either
    (PolynomialDefinitions.Divides reals
      (PolynomialDefinitions.quadratic reals a)
      (PolynomialDefinitions.degree-thirteen-polynomial reals))
    (a ≡ pos 2)

% Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench artifact putnam_1963_b1:
% the integer a for which x^2 - x + a divides x^13 + x + 90 is exactly 2.
% This file contains no proof.

putnam_1963_b1: THEORY
BEGIN
  polynomial_coefficient(p: list[real], degree: nat): RECURSIVE real =
    CASES p OF
      null: 0,
      cons(coefficient, tail):
        IF degree = 0 THEN
          coefficient
        ELSE
          polynomial_coefficient(tail, degree - 1)
        ENDIF
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE p BY <<

  polynomial_equal(p, q: list[real]): bool =
    FORALL (degree: nat):
      polynomial_coefficient(p, degree)
        = polynomial_coefficient(q, degree)

  polynomial_add(p, q: list[real]): RECURSIVE list[real] =
    CASES p OF
      null: q,
      cons(left_coefficient, left_tail):
        CASES q OF
          null: p,
          cons(right_coefficient, right_tail):
            cons(
              left_coefficient + right_coefficient,
              polynomial_add(left_tail, right_tail))
        ENDCASES
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE p BY <<

  polynomial_scale(value: real, p: list[real]): RECURSIVE list[real] =
    CASES p OF
      null: null,
      cons(coefficient, tail):
        cons(
          value * coefficient,
          polynomial_scale(value, tail))
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE p BY <<

  polynomial_multiply(p, q: list[real]): RECURSIVE list[real] =
    CASES p OF
      null: null,
      cons(coefficient, tail):
        polynomial_add(
          polynomial_scale(coefficient, q),
          cons(0, polynomial_multiply(tail, q)))
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE p BY <<

  monomial(coefficient: real, degree: nat): RECURSIVE list[real] =
    IF degree = 0 THEN
      cons(coefficient, null)
    ELSE
      cons(0, monomial(coefficient, degree - 1))
    ENDIF
  MEASURE degree

  polynomial_divides(divisor, dividend: list[real]): bool =
    EXISTS (quotient: list[real]):
      polynomial_equal(
        dividend,
        polynomial_multiply(divisor, quotient))

  quadratic(a: int): list[real] =
    polynomial_add(
      monomial(1, 2),
      polynomial_add(
        monomial(-1, 1),
        monomial((a :: real), 0)))

  dividend: list[real] =
    polynomial_add(
      monomial(1, 13),
      polynomial_add(
        monomial(1, 1),
        monomial(90, 0)))

  putnam_1963_b1_solution: int = 2

  putnam_1963_b1: bool =
    FORALL (a: int):
      polynomial_divides(quadratic(a), dividend)
        IFF a = putnam_1963_b1_solution
END putnam_1963_b1

;; the numbers 2^m*3^n, for integer m and n, are dense in the positive
;; real numbers. This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))

;; Conservative generic symbols present an arbitrary Archimedean ordered
;; field. Every such field has a unique order-preserving embedding into the
;; reals, and every 2^m*3^n belongs to its prime field. Hence density in the
;; reals implies the formula below in every presented field by pulling the
;; rational witness back through that embedding. Conversely, specializing
;; the presented field to the reals gives the source statement. Thus this
;; Archimedean-field formulation and the source real-density statement imply
;; each other.
;;
;; The epsilon formula is definitionally the metric characterization of
;; x belonging to the closure of {2^m*3^n}. Both x and epsilon range over the
;; full field carrier, while m and n remain unbounded internal integer
;; witnesses. The structural premise is satisfiable (the rational field is
;; one model) and does not assume any part of the density conclusion.

(defstub p1963b2-scalar-p (x) t)

-- Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1963_b2:
-- every positive real lies in the closure of the set of values 2^m * 3^n
-- with integer exponents m and n. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Int using (Int; pos; negsuc)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; _*_)

infix 4 _!=_
infixr 3 _and_
infixr 2 _or_

data Bottom : Set where

Not : Set -> Set
Not A = A -> Bottom

_!=_ : {A : Set} -> A -> A -> Set
x != y = Not (x == y)

record _and_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data _or_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  left  : A -> A or B
  right : B -> A or B

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

record CompleteOrderedField (R : Set) : Set1 where
  field
    zeroR oneR : R
    add multiply : R -> R -> R
    negate inverse : R -> R
    lessOrEqual : R -> R -> Set
    fromNat : Nat -> R

    one-not-zero :
      oneR != zeroR

    add-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> add x y == add y x
    add-associative :
      (x y z : R) -> add (add x y) z == add x (add y z)
    add-zero :
      (x : R) -> add x zeroR == x
    add-inverse :
      (x : R) -> add x (negate x) == zeroR

    multiply-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> multiply x y == multiply y x
    multiply-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply (multiply x y) z == multiply x (multiply y z)
    multiply-one :
      (x : R) -> multiply x oneR == x
    multiply-zero :
      (x : R) -> multiply x zeroR == zeroR
    distribute :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply x (add y z) ==
      add (multiply x y) (multiply x z)
    inverse-zero :
      inverse zeroR == zeroR
    multiply-inverse :
      (x : R) ->
      x != zeroR ->
      multiply x (inverse x) == oneR

    order-reflexive :
      (x : R) -> lessOrEqual x x
    order-transitive :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y z ->
      lessOrEqual x z
    order-antisymmetric :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y x ->
      x == y
    order-total :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y or lessOrEqual y x
    add-order :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual (add z x) (add z y)
    multiply-nonnegative :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR x ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR y ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR (multiply x y)
    zero-less-than-one :
      lessOrEqual zeroR oneR and zeroR != oneR

    fromNat-zero :
      fromNat zero == zeroR
    fromNat-successor :
      (n : Nat) -> fromNat (suc n) == add (fromNat n) oneR
    fromNat-addition :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m + n) == add (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-multiplication :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m * n) == multiply (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-injective :
      (m n : Nat) -> fromNat m == fromNat n -> m == n

    archimedean :
      (x : R) ->
      Exists Nat (\ n -> lessOrEqual x (fromNat n))
    least-upper-bound :
      (P : R -> Set) ->
      Exists R P ->
      Exists R
        (\ upper ->
          (x : R) -> P x -> lessOrEqual x upper) ->
      Exists R
        (\ supremum ->
          ((x : R) -> P x -> lessOrEqual x supremum)
          and
          ((upper : R) ->
            ((x : R) -> P x -> lessOrEqual x upper) ->
            lessOrEqual supremum upper))

open CompleteOrderedField

subtract :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
subtract reals x y =
  add reals x (negate reals y)

naturalPower :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  Nat ->
  R
naturalPower reals x zero =
  oneR reals
naturalPower reals x (suc n) =
  multiply reals (naturalPower reals x n) x

integerPower :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  Int ->
  R
integerPower reals x (pos n) =
  naturalPower reals x n
integerPower reals x (negsuc n) =
  inverse reals (naturalPower reals x (suc n))

StrictLess :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
StrictLess reals x y =
  lessOrEqual reals x y and x != y

CloseTo :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
CloseTo reals center radius x =
  StrictLess reals (subtract reals center radius) x
  and
  StrictLess reals x (add reals center radius)

two :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R
two reals =
  fromNat reals (suc (suc zero))

three :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R
three reals =
  fromNat reals (suc (suc (suc zero)))

generatedValue :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  Int ->
  Int ->
  R
generatedValue reals m n =
  multiply reals
    (integerPower reals (two reals) m)
    (integerPower reals (three reals) n)

InClosureOfGeneratedValues :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  Set
InClosureOfGeneratedValues reals x =
  (radius : _) ->
  StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) radius ->
  Exists Int
    (\ m ->
      Exists Int
        (\ n ->
          CloseTo reals x radius (generatedValue reals m n)))

putnam-1963-b2 : Set1
putnam-1963-b2 =
  (R : Set) ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) ->
  (x : R) ->
  StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) x ->
  InClosureOfGeneratedValues reals x

% Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench artifact putnam_1963_b2:
% the set of real numbers 2^m * 3^n, for integer m and n, is dense in the
% positive real numbers. This file contains no proof.

putnam_1963_b2: THEORY
BEGIN
  integer_power_value(
      base: real,
      exponent: int,
      value: real): bool =
    (exponent >= 0
      AND EXISTS (power: nat):
        exponent = (power :: int)
          AND value = base ^ power)
      OR (exponent < 0
        AND EXISTS (power: posnat):
          exponent = -(power :: int)
            AND value * base ^ power = 1)

  generated_value(x: real): bool =
    EXISTS (m, n: int), (power_of_two, power_of_three: real):
      integer_power_value(2, m, power_of_two)
        AND integer_power_value(3, n, power_of_three)
        AND x = power_of_two * power_of_three

  putnam_1963_b2: bool =
    FORALL (x: real):
      x > 0 IMPLIES
        FORALL (radius: posreal):
          EXISTS (y: real):
            generated_value(y)
              AND abs(y - x) < radius
END putnam_1963_b2

import Mathlib

open Topology Filter Polynomial

/--
Let $\{a_n\}$ be a sequence of real numbers satisfying the inequalities $0 \leq a_k \leq 100a_n$ for $n \leq k \leq 2n$ and $n=1,2,\dots$, and such that the series $\sum_{n=0}^\infty a_n$ converges. Prove that $\lim_{n \to \infty}na_n=0$.
-/
theorem putnam_1963_b5
(a : ℤ → ℝ)
(haineq : ∀ n ≥ 1, ∀ k : ℤ, (n ≤ k ∧ k ≤ 2 * n) → (0 ≤ a k ∧ a k ≤ 100 * a n))
(haseries : ∃ S : ℝ, Tendsto (fun N : ℕ => ∑ n : Fin N, a n) atTop (𝓝 S))
: Tendsto (fun n : ℤ => n * a n) atTop (𝓝 0) :=
sorry

content:
;; Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench artifact putnam_1963_b5:
;; if a convergent series satisfies 0 <= a(k) <= 100*a(n) whenever
;; 1 <= n <= k <= 2*n, then n*a(n) tends to zero. This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))

;; The sequence is an arbitrary conservative ACL2 function symbol over the
;; integers. Scalars live in an Archimedean ordered field with its rational
;; embedding, which faithfully states the source theorem for real sequences
;; without restricting them to ACL2 rationals or APPLY$ function objects.
(defstub p1963b5-scalar-p (x) t)
(defstub p1963b5-add-op (x y) t)
(defstub p1963b5-multiply-op (x y) t)
(defstub p1963b5-negate-op (x) t)
(defstub p1963b5-inverse-op (x) t)
(defstub p1963b5-less-op (x y) t)
(defstub p1963b5-rational-embed (q) t)
(defstub p1963b5-arch-bound (x) t)
(defstub p1963b5-a (n) t)

(defun p1963b5-add (x y)
  (p1963b5-add-op x y))

(defun p1963b5-mul (x y)
  (p1963b5-multiply-op x y))

(defun p1963b5-neg (x)
  (p1963b5-negate-op x))

(defun p1963b5-inv (x)
  (p1963b5-inverse-op x))

(defun p1963b5-sub (x y)
  (p1963b5-add x (p1963b5-neg y)))

(defun p1963b5-less (x y)
  (if (p1963b5-less-op x y) t nil))

(defun p1963b5-less-equal (x y)
  (not (p1963b5-less y x)))

(defun p1963b5-abs (x zero)
  (if (p1963b5-less x zero)
      (p1963b5-neg x)
    x))

(defun-sk p1963b5-field-laws-p (zero one)
  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (p1963b5-scalar-p x)
      (p1963b5-scalar-p y)
      (p1963b5-scalar-p z))
     (and
      (p1963b5-scalar-p (p1963b5-add x y))
      (p1963b5-scalar-p (p1963b5-mul x y))
      (p1963b5-scalar-p (p1963b5-neg x))
      (implies
       (not (equal x zero))
       (p1963b5-scalar-p (p1963b5-inv x)))
      (equal (p1963b5-add (p1963b5-add x y) z)
             (p1963b5-add x (p1963b5-add y z)))
      (equal (p1963b5-add x y)
             (p1963b5-add y x))
      (equal (p1963b5-add x zero) x)
      (equal (p1963b5-add x (p1963b5-neg x)) zero)
      (equal (p1963b5-mul (p1963b5-mul x y) z)
             (p1963b5-mul x (p1963b5-mul y z)))
      (equal (p1963b5-mul x y)
             (p1963b5-mul y x))
      (equal (p1963b5-mul x one) x)
      (implies
       (not (equal x zero))
       (equal (p1963b5-mul x (p1963b5-inv x)) one))
      (equal
       (p1963b5-mul x (p1963b5-add y z))
       (p1963b5-add
        (p1963b5-mul x y)

title: putnam_1963_b5
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1963_b5:
-- an integer-indexed real sequence whose convergent nonnegative-index series
-- satisfies the stated dyadic bounds has n * a_n tending to zero.
-- This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Int using (Int; pos; negsuc)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; _*_)

infix 4 _!=_ _<=N_ _<=Z_
infixr 3 _and_
infixr 2 _or_

data Bottom : Set where

Not : Set -> Set
Not A = A -> Bottom

_!=_ : {A : Set} -> A -> A -> Set
x != y = Not (x == y)

record _and_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data _or_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  left  : A -> A or B
  right : B -> A or B

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

data _<=N_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set where
  zero<=N   : {n : Nat} -> zero <=N n
  suc<=sucN : {m n : Nat} -> m <=N n -> suc m <=N suc n

data _<=Z_ : Int -> Int -> Set where
  negative<=positive :
    {m n : Nat} ->
    negsuc m <=Z pos n
  positive<=positive :
    {m n : Nat} ->
    m <=N n ->
    pos m <=Z pos n
  negative<=negative :
    {m n : Nat} ->
    n <=N m ->
    negsuc m <=Z negsuc n

record CompleteOrderedField (R : Set) : Set1 where
  field
    zeroR oneR : R
    add multiply : R -> R -> R
    negate inverse absoluteValue : R -> R
    lessOrEqual : R -> R -> Set
    fromNat : Nat -> R

    one-not-zero :
      oneR != zeroR

    add-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> add x y == add y x
    add-associative :
      (x y z : R) -> add (add x y) z == add x (add y z)
    add-zero :
      (x : R) -> add x zeroR == x
    add-inverse :
      (x : R) -> add x (negate x) == zeroR

    multiply-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> multiply x y == multiply y x
    multiply-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply (multiply x y) z == multiply x (multiply y z)
    multiply-one :
      (x : R) -> multiply x oneR == x
    multiply-zero :
      (x : R) -> multiply x zeroR == zeroR
    distribute :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply x (add y z) ==
      add (multiply x y) (multiply x z)
    inverse-zero :
      inverse zeroR == zeroR
    multiply-inverse :
      (x : R) ->
      x != zeroR ->
      multiply x (inverse x) == oneR

    order-reflexive :
      (x : R) -> lessOrEqual x x
    order-transitive :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y z ->
      lessOrEqual x z
    order-antisymmetric :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y x ->
      x == y
    order-total :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y or lessOrEqual y x
    add-order :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual (add z x) (add z y)
    multiply-nonnegative :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR x ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR y ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR (multiply x y)
    zero-less-than-one :
      lessOrEqual zeroR oneR and zeroR != oneR

    absolute-nonnegative :
      (x : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR (absoluteValue x)
    absolute-of-nonnegative :
      (x : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR x ->
      absoluteValue x == x
    absolute-of-nonpositive :
      (x : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x zeroR ->
      absoluteValue x == negate x

    fromNat-zero :
      fromNat zero == zeroR
    fromNat-successor :
      (n : Nat) -> fromNat (suc n) == add (fromNat n) oneR
    fromNat-addition :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m + n) == add (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-multiplication :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m * n) == multiply (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-injective :
      (m n : Nat) -> fromNat m == fromNat n -> m == n

    archimedean :
      (x : R) ->
      Exists Nat (\ n -> lessOrEqual x (fromNat n))
    least-upper-bound :
      (P : R -> Set) ->
      Exists R P ->
      Exists R
        (\ upper ->
          (x : R) ->
          P x ->
          lessOrEqual x upper) ->
      Exists R
        (\ supremum ->
          ((x : R) -> P x -> lessOrEqual x supremum)
          and
          ((upper : R) ->
            ((x : R) -> P x -> lessOrEqual x upper) ->
            lessOrEqual supremum upper))

open CompleteOrderedField

subtract :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
subtract reals x y =
  add reals x (negate reals y)

StrictLess :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
StrictLess reals x y =
  lessOrEqual reals x y and x != y

oneZ : Int
oneZ =
  pos (suc zero)

doubleZ : Int -> Int
doubleZ (pos n) =
  pos (n + n)
doubleZ (negsuc n) =
  negsuc (suc (n + n))

hundredN : Nat
hundredN =
  100

sumFirst :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  Nat ->
  R
sumFirst reals term zero =
  zeroR reals
sumFirst reals term (suc n) =
  add reals
    (sumFirst reals term n)
    (term n)

SequentialLimit :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  R ->
  Set
SequentialLimit {R} reals sequence limit =
  (epsilon : R) ->
  StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) epsilon ->
  Exists Nat
    (\ cutoff ->
      (n : Nat) ->
      cutoff <=N n ->
      StrictLess reals
        (absoluteValue reals
          (subtract reals (sequence n) limit))
        epsilon)

SeriesHasSum :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  R ->
  Set
SeriesHasSum reals term limit =
  SequentialLimit reals
    (sumFirst reals term)
    limit

putnam-1963-b5 : Set1
putnam-1963-b5 =
  (R : Set) ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) ->
  (a : Int -> R) ->
  ((n : Int) ->
    oneZ <=Z n ->
    (k : Int) ->
    n <=Z k ->
    k <=Z doubleZ n ->
    lessOrEqual reals (zeroR reals) (a k)
    and
    lessOrEqual reals
      (a k)
      (multiply reals
        (fromNat reals hundredN)
        (a n))) ->
  Exists R
    (\ seriesSum ->
      SeriesHasSum reals
        (\ n -> a (pos n))
        seriesSum) ->
  SequentialLimit reals
    (\ n ->
      multiply reals
        (fromNat reals n)
        (a (pos n)))
    (zeroR reals)

title: putnam_1963_b5
