% Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench artifact putnam_1963_b5:
% convergence of a real series with the stated dyadic interval bound forces
% the integer-indexed sequence n*a(n) to tend to zero. This file contains no proof.

putnam_1963_b5: THEORY
BEGIN
  integer_real_sequence: TYPE = [int -> real]

  partial_sum(a: integer_real_sequence, count: nat): RECURSIVE real =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      partial_sum(a, count - 1) + a(count - 1)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  series_converges(a: integer_real_sequence): bool =
    EXISTS (total: real):
      FORALL (epsilon_value: posreal):
        EXISTS (cutoff: nat):
          FORALL (count: nat):
            cutoff <= count IMPLIES
              abs(partial_sum(a, count) - total) < epsilon_value

  satisfies_interval_bound(a: integer_real_sequence): bool =
    FORALL (n: int):
      n >= 1 IMPLIES
        FORALL (k: int):
          (n <= k AND k <= 2 * n) IMPLIES
            (0 <= a(k) AND a(k) <= 100 * a(n))

  tends_to_zero_at_top(a: integer_real_sequence): bool =
    FORALL (epsilon_value: posreal):
      EXISTS (cutoff: int):
        FORALL (n: int):
          cutoff <= n IMPLIES
            abs((n :: real) * a(n)) < epsilon_value

  putnam_1963_b5: bool =
    FORALL (a: integer_real_sequence):
      (satisfies_interval_bound(a) AND series_converges(a))
        IMPLIES tends_to_zero_at_top(a)
END putnam_1963_b5

/--
Let $E$ be a Euclidean space of at most three dimensions. If $A$ is a nonempty subset of $E$, define $S(A)$ to be the set of all points that lie on closed segments joining pairs of points of $A$. For a given nonempty set $A_0$, define $A_n=S(A_{n-1})$ for $n=1,2,\dots$. Prove that $A_2=A_3=\cdots$. (A one-point set should be considered to be a special case of a closed segment.)

(d : ℕ)

(A : ℕ → Set (Fin d → ℝ))
(ddim : 1 ≤ d ∧ d ≤ 3)
(hA0 : Nonempty (A 0))
(hAn : ∀ n ≥ 1, A n = S (A (n - 1)))
: ∀ n ≥ 2, A n = A (n + 1) :=

  stabilization after two iterations of taking all closed line segments
  between pairs of points in a nonempty Euclidean set of dimension at most three.
  This file contains no proof.
*)

     S = (\s:real^N->bool.
            {x | ?p q u.

;; Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1963_b6:
;; arbitrary nonempty subsets of real Euclidean spaces of dimensions one
;; through three stabilize after two iterations of adjoining every closed
;; segment between current points. This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))

;; ACL2 has no first-class function space, so conservative generic symbols
;; represent the real scalar operations and the arbitrary sequence of set
;; membership predicates. The ordered-field laws used by real affine
;; geometry are explicit hypotheses of the statement. Points are genuine
;; d-tuples of scalars, while P63B6-A-MEMBER-P remains an arbitrary predicate;
;; no finite carrier, point enumeration, rational restriction, or external
;; segment witness is introduced.

(defstub p63b6-scalar-p (x) t)
(defstub p63b6-add (x y) t)
(defstub p63b6-multiply (x y) t)
(defstub p63b6-negate (x) t)
(defstub p63b6-inverse (x) t)
(defstub p63b6-less (x y) t)
(defstub p63b6-a-member (n point) t)

(defun p63b6-scalar-member-p (x)
  (if (p63b6-scalar-p x) t nil))

(defun p63b6-less-p (x y)
  (if (p63b6-less x y) t nil))

(defun p63b6-less-equal-p (x y)
  (or (equal x y)
      (p63b6-less-p x y)))

(defun p63b6-a-member-p (n point)
  (if (p63b6-a-member n point) t nil))

(defun-sk p63b6-field-laws-p (zero one)
  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (p63b6-scalar-member-p x)
      (p63b6-scalar-member-p y)
      (p63b6-scalar-member-p z))
     (and
      (p63b6-scalar-member-p (p63b6-add x y))
      (p63b6-scalar-member-p (p63b6-multiply x y))
      (p63b6-scalar-member-p (p63b6-negate x))
      (p63b6-scalar-member-p (p63b6-inverse x))
      (equal
       (p63b6-add (p63b6-add x y) z)
       (p63b6-add x (p63b6-add y z)))
      (equal (p63b6-add x y)
             (p63b6-add y x))
      (equal (p63b6-add x zero) x)
      (equal (p63b6-add x (p63b6-negate x))
             zero)
      (equal
       (p63b6-multiply (p63b6-multiply x y) z)
       (p63b6-multiply x (p63b6-multiply y z)))
      (equal (p63b6-multiply x y)
             (p63b6-multiply y x))
      (equal (p63b6-multiply x one) x)
      (implies
       (not (equal x zero))
       (equal
        (p63b6-multiply x (p63b6-inverse x))
        one))
      (equal
       (p63b6-multiply x (p63b6-add y z))
       (p63b6-add
        (p63b6-multiply x y)
        (p63b6-multiply x z)))))))

(defun-sk p63b6-order-laws-p (zero)
  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (p63b6-scalar-member-p x)
      (p63b6-scalar-member-p y)
      (p63b6-scalar-member-p z))
     (and
      (not (p63b6-less-p x x))
      (or
       (equal x y)
       (p63b6-less-p x y)
       (p63b6-less-p y x))
      (implies
       (and
        (p63b6-less-p x y)
        (p63b6-less-p y z))
       (p63b6-less-p x z))
      (implies
       (p63b6-less-p x y)
       (p63b6-less-p
        (p63b6-add x z)
        (p63b6-add y z)))
      (implies
       (and
        (p63b6-less-p zero x)
        (p63b6-less-p zero y))
       (p63b6-less-p
        zero
        (p63b6-multiply x y)))))))

(defun p63b6-real-coordinate-context-p (zero one)
  (and
   (p63b6-scalar-member-p zero)
   (p63b6-scalar-member-p one)
   (not (equal zero one))
   (p63b6-field-laws-p zero one)
   (p63b6-order-laws-p zero)
   (p63b6-less-p zero one)))

(defun p63b6-point-p (point dimension)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix dimension)))
  (if (zp dimension)
      (equal point nil)
    (and
     (consp point)
     (p63b6-scalar-member-p (car point))
     (p63b6-point-p (cdr point) (- dimension 1)))))

(defun p63b6-affine-coordinate
    (one coefficient left right)
  (p63b6-add
   (p63b6-multiply
    (p63b6-add one (p63b6-negate coefficient))
    left)
   (p63b6-multiply coefficient right)))

(defun-sk p63b6-affine-point-p
    (dimension one point left right coefficient)
  (forall (coordinate)
    (implies
     (and
      (natp coordinate)
      (< coordinate dimension))
     (equal
      (nth coordinate point)
      (p63b6-affine-coordinate
       one
       coefficient
       (nth coordinate left)
       (nth coordinate right))))))

(defun-sk p63b6-segment-step-member-p
    (dimension zero one previous-index point)
  (exists (left right coefficient)
    (and
     (p63b6-point-p left dimension)
     (p63b6-point-p right dimension)
     (p63b6-a-member-p previous-index left)
     (p63b6-a-member-p previous-index right)
     (p63b6-scalar-member-p coefficient)
     (p63b6-less-equal-p zero coefficient)
     (p63b6-less-equal-p coefficient one)
     (p63b6-affine-point-p
      dimension one point left right coefficient))))

(defun-sk p63b6-set-sequence-typed-p (dimension)
  (forall (n point)
    (implies
     (and
      (natp n)
      (p63b6-a-member-p n point))
     (p63b6-point-p point dimension))))

(defun-sk p63b6-initial-set-nonempty-p (dimension)
  (exists (point)
    (and
     (p63b6-point-p point dimension)
     (p63b6-a-member-p 0 point))))

(defun-sk p63b6-recurrence-p (dimension zero one)
  (forall (n point)
    (implies
     (and
      (natp n)
      (< 0 n)
      (p63b6-point-p point dimension))
     (iff
      (p63b6-a-member-p n point)
      (p63b6-segment-step-member-p
       dimension zero one (- n 1) point)))))

(defun-sk p63b6-stabilizes-from-two-p (dimension)
  (forall (n point)
    (implies
     (and
      (natp n)
      (<= 2 n)
      (p63b6-point-p point dimension))
     (iff
      (p63b6-a-member-p n point)
      (p63b6-a-member-p (+ n 1) point)))))

(defun-sk putnambench-putnam-1963-b6-statement ()
  (forall (dimension zero one)
    (implies
     (and
      (natp dimension)
      (<= 1 dimension)
      (<= dimension 3)
      (p63b6-real-coordinate-context-p zero one)
      (p63b6-set-sequence-typed-p dimension)
      (p63b6-initial-set-nonempty-p dimension)
      (p63b6-recurrence-p dimension zero one))
     (p63b6-stabilizes-from-two-p dimension))))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

title: putnam_1963_b6
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1963_b6:
-- iterating the closed-segment hull of a nonempty subset of a real Euclidean
-- space of dimension one through three stabilizes after the second iterate.
-- This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; _*_)

infix 4 _!=_ _<=N_

data Bottom : Set where

Not : Set -> Set
Not A = A -> Bottom

_!=_ : {A : Set} -> A -> A -> Set
x != y = Not (x == y)

record Both (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data Either (A B : Set) : Set where
  left  : A -> Either A B
  right : B -> Either A B

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

data _<=N_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set where
  zero<=N   : {n : Nat} -> zero <=N n
  suc<=sucN : {m n : Nat} -> m <=N n -> suc m <=N suc n

record CompleteOrderedField (R : Set) : Set1 where
  field
    zeroR oneR : R
    add multiply : R -> R -> R
    negate inverse : R -> R
    lessOrEqual : R -> R -> Set
    fromNat : Nat -> R

    one-not-zero :
      oneR != zeroR

    add-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> add x y == add y x
    add-associative :
      (x y z : R) -> add (add x y) z == add x (add y z)
    add-zero :
      (x : R) -> add x zeroR == x
    add-inverse :
      (x : R) -> add x (negate x) == zeroR

    multiply-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> multiply x y == multiply y x
    multiply-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply (multiply x y) z == multiply x (multiply y z)
    multiply-one :
      (x : R) -> multiply x oneR == x
    multiply-zero :
      (x : R) -> multiply x zeroR == zeroR
    distribute :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply x (add y z) ==
      add (multiply x y) (multiply x z)
    inverse-zero :
      inverse zeroR == zeroR
    multiply-inverse :
      (x : R) ->
      x != zeroR ->
      multiply x (inverse x) == oneR

    order-reflexive :
      (x : R) -> lessOrEqual x x
    order-transitive :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y z ->
      lessOrEqual x z
    order-antisymmetric :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y x ->
      x == y
    order-total :
      (x y : R) ->
      Either (lessOrEqual x y) (lessOrEqual y x)
    add-order :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual (add z x) (add z y)
    multiply-nonnegative :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR x ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR y ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR (multiply x y)
    zero-less-than-one :
      Both (lessOrEqual zeroR oneR) (zeroR != oneR)

    fromNat-zero :
      fromNat zero == zeroR
    fromNat-successor :
      (n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (suc n) == add (fromNat n) oneR
    fromNat-addition :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m + n) == add (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-multiplication :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m * n) == multiply (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-injective :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat m == fromNat n ->
      m == n

    archimedean :
      (x : R) ->
      Exists Nat (\ n -> lessOrEqual x (fromNat n))
    least-upper-bound :
      (P : R -> Set) ->
      Exists R P ->
      Exists R
        (\ upper ->
          (x : R) ->
          P x ->
          lessOrEqual x upper) ->
      Exists R
        (\ supremum ->
          Both
            ((x : R) -> P x -> lessOrEqual x supremum)
            ((upper : R) ->
              ((x : R) -> P x -> lessOrEqual x upper) ->
              lessOrEqual supremum upper))

open CompleteOrderedField

subtract :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
subtract reals x y =
  add reals x (negate reals y)

data Fin : Nat -> Set where
  fzero : {n : Nat} -> Fin (suc n)
  fsuc  : {n : Nat} -> Fin n -> Fin (suc n)

Vector : Set -> Nat -> Set
Vector R d =
  Fin d -> R

Subset : Set -> Nat -> Set1
Subset R d =
  Vector R d -> Set

SetEqual :
  {R : Set} ->
  {d : Nat} ->
  Subset R d ->
  Subset R d ->
  Set
SetEqual {R} {d} A B =
  Both
    ((x : Vector R d) -> A x -> B x)
    ((x : Vector R d) -> B x -> A x)

Nonempty :
  {R : Set} ->
  {d : Nat} ->
  Subset R d ->
  Set
Nonempty {R} {d} A =
  Exists (Vector R d) A

affineCombination :
  {R : Set} ->
  {d : Nat} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  Vector R d ->
  Vector R d ->
  Vector R d
affineCombination reals t p q i =
  add reals
    (multiply reals t (p i))
    (multiply reals
      (subtract reals (oneR reals) t)
      (q i))

ClosedSegment :
  {R : Set} ->
  {d : Nat} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  Vector R d ->
  Vector R d ->
  Vector R d ->
  Set
ClosedSegment {R} {d} reals p q x =
  Exists R
    (\ t ->
      Both
        (lessOrEqual reals (zeroR reals) t)
        (Both
          (lessOrEqual reals t (oneR reals))
          ((i : Fin d) ->
            x i == affineCombination reals t p q i)))

SegmentHull :
  {R : Set} ->
  {d : Nat} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  Subset R d ->
  Subset R d
SegmentHull {R} {d} reals A x =
  Exists (Vector R d)
    (\ p ->
      Both
        (A p)
        (Exists (Vector R d)
          (\ q ->
            Both
              (A q)
              (ClosedSegment reals p q x))))

putnam-1963-b6 : Set1
putnam-1963-b6 =
  (R : Set) ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) ->
  (d : Nat) ->
  Both (1 <=N d) (d <=N 3) ->
  (A : Nat -> Subset R d) ->
  Nonempty (A zero) ->
  ((n : Nat) ->
    SetEqual
      (A (suc n))
      (SegmentHull reals (A n))) ->
  (n : Nat) ->
  2 <=N n ->
  SetEqual (A n) (A (suc n))

(*
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench artifact putnam_1963_b6:
  stabilization after two iterations of taking every closed segment between
  pairs of points in a nonempty Euclidean set of dimension one, two, or three.
  This file contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open arithmeticTheory pred_setTheory realTheory;

val putnam_1963_b6 =
  ``let closed_segment =
      \p q : 'a -> real.
      \x : 'a -> real.
        ?t : real.
          0 <= t /\ t <= 1 /\
          x = (\i : 'a. (1 - t) * p i + t * q i)
    in
    let S =
      \B : ('a -> real) set.
      \x : 'a -> real.
        ?p q : 'a -> real.
          p IN B /\ q IN B /\ closed_segment p q x
    in
      !A : num -> ('a -> real) set.
        FINITE (UNIV : 'a set) /\
        1 <= CARD (UNIV : 'a set) /\
        CARD (UNIV : 'a set) <= 3 /\
        (?p : 'a -> real. p IN A 0) /\
        (!n : num. 1 <= n ==> A n = S (A (n - 1)))
        ==>
        !n : num. 2 <= n ==> A n = A (n + 1)``;

$(
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench artifact putnam_1963_b6:
  stabilization after two iterations of closed-segment closure for a
  nonempty subset of a real Euclidean space of dimension one, two, or three.
  This file contains no proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  For a natural number d, RR ^m ( 1 ... d ) is the d-dimensional real
  coordinate space. P63B6SegClosure D B is the set of all coordinatewise convex
  combinations (1-t)p+tq with p,q in B and t in the closed interval [0,1].
  Thus it is exactly the union of the closed segments joining pairs of points
  of B, including one-point segments. The final declaration is one unproved
  $a corpus statement; this database contains no $p proof statement.
$)

$c P63B6SegClosure $.

p63b6-segment-closure-syntax $a
  class ( P63B6SegClosure D B )
$.

${
  $d B D i p q r t $.

  p63b6-segment-closure-definition $a |- (
    P63B6SegClosure D B
  ) = {
    r e. ( RR ^m D ) |
      E. p e. B E. q e. B E. t e. ( 0 [,] 1 )
        A. i e. D
          ( r ` i ) =
            (
              ( ( 1 - t ) x. ( p ` i ) )
              +
              ( t x. ( q ` i ) )
            )
  } $.
$}

${
  $d A d i n p q r t $.

  putnambench-putnam-1963-b6 $a |- A. d e. NN
    A. A e. ( ( ~P ( RR ^m ( 1 ... d ) ) ) ^m NN0 )
      (
        (
          (
            1 <_ d
            /\
            d <_ 3
          )
          /\
          (
            ( A ` 0 ) =/= (/)
            /\
            A. n e. NN0
              (
                1 <_ n
                ->
                ( A ` n ) =
                  (
                    P63B6SegClosure ( 1 ... d )
                      ( A ` ( n - 1 ) )
                  )
              )
          )
        )
        ->
        A. n e. NN0
          (
            2 <_ n
            ->
            ( A ` n ) = ( A ` ( n + 1 ) )
          )
      )
  $.
$}

title: putnam_1963_b6
content:
% Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench artifact putnam_1963_b6:
% iterating the closed-segment hull of a nonempty subset of a real Euclidean
% space of dimension at most three stabilizes after the second step.
% This file contains no proof.

putnam_1963_b6[d: posnat]: THEORY
BEGIN
  coordinate: TYPE = below(d)
  point: TYPE = [coordinate -> real]
  point_set: TYPE = [point -> bool]
  point_set_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> point_set]

  affine_combination(t: real, p, q: point): point =
    LAMBDA (i: coordinate):
      (1 - t) * p(i) + t * q(i)

  closed_segment(p, q: point): point_set =
    LAMBDA (r: point):
      EXISTS (t: real):
        0 <= t
          AND t <= 1
          AND r = affine_combination(t, p, q)

  segment_hull(X: point_set): point_set =
    LAMBDA (r: point):
      EXISTS (p, q: point):
        X(p) AND X(q) AND closed_segment(p, q)(r)

  nonempty(X: point_set): bool =
    EXISTS (p: point):
      X(p)

  putnam_1963_b6: bool =
    d <= 3 IMPLIES
      FORALL (A: point_set_sequence):
        (nonempty(A(0))
          AND FORALL (n: nat):
            A(n + 1) = segment_hull(A(n)))
        IMPLIES
          FORALL (n: nat):
            n >= 2 IMPLIES A(n) = A(n + 1)
END putnam_1963_b6

(hAcard : A.card = 6)

(hdists : dists = {d : ℝ | ∃ a b : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), a ∈ A ∧ b ∈ A ∧ a ≠ b ∧ d = dist a b})
: (sSup dists / sInf dists ≥ Real.sqrt 3) :=

(*
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench artifact putnam_1964_a1:
  among six distinct points in the Euclidean plane, the ratio of the longest
  pairwise distance to the shortest is at least the square root of 3. This
  file contains no proof.

let statement =
  `let edist =
     \(x:real#real) (y:real#real).
       sqrt ((FST x - FST y) pow 2 + (SND x - SND y) pow 2) in
   let pair_dists =
     \(A:(real#real)->bool).
       {r | ?a b:real#real.
              a IN A /\ b IN A /\ ~(a = b) /\ r = edist a b} in
   let is_greatest =
     \(s:real->bool) (x:real).
       x IN s /\ (!y. y IN s ==> y <= x) in
   let is_least =
     \(s:real->bool) (x:real).
       x IN s /\ (!y. y IN s ==> x <= y) in
   !A:(real#real)->bool.
     A HAS_SIZE 6
     ==> ?D d:real.
           is_greatest (pair_dists A) D /\
           is_least (pair_dists A) d /\
           D / d >= sqrt (&3)`;;

;; Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench artifact putnam_1964_a1:
;; among six distinct points in the real plane, the longest pairwise distance
;; divided by the shortest is at least sqrt(3). This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

;; ACL2's exact rational plane is bidirectionally equivalent to the source
;; theorem over the real plane. A counterexample has
;;   max(pairwise distance squared) < 3 * min(pairwise distance squared).
;; Distinctness makes the minimum positive, and this strict inequality is an
;; open condition on the twelve coordinates because finite minima and maxima
;; of continuous functions are continuous. A real counterexample therefore
;; persists under a small rational perturbation; the converse is immediate.

(defun putnam-1964-a1-point-p (point)
  (and (consp point)
       (rationalp (car point))
       (rationalp (cdr point))))

(defun putnam-1964-a1-point-list-p (points)
  (if (consp points)
      (and (putnam-1964-a1-point-p (car points))
           (putnam-1964-a1-point-list-p (cdr points)))
    (equal points nil)))

(defun putnam-1964-a1-square (x)
  (* x x))

(defun putnam-1964-a1-distance-squared (first second)
  (+ (putnam-1964-a1-square (- (car first) (car second)))
     (putnam-1964-a1-square (- (cdr first) (cdr second)))))

(defun putnam-1964-a1-distances-from (point remaining)
  (if (consp remaining)
      (cons (putnam-1964-a1-distance-squared point (car remaining))
            (putnam-1964-a1-distances-from point (cdr remaining)))
    nil))

(defun putnam-1964-a1-pairwise-distances-squared (points)
  (if (consp points)
      (append
       (putnam-1964-a1-distances-from (car points) (cdr points))
       (putnam-1964-a1-pairwise-distances-squared (cdr points)))
    nil))

(defun putnam-1964-a1-minimum (values)
  (if (endp (cdr values))
      (car values)
    (let ((tail-minimum (putnam-1964-a1-minimum (cdr values))))
      (if (< (car values) tail-minimum)
          (car values)
        tail-minimum))))

(defun putnam-1964-a1-maximum (values)
  (if (endp (cdr values))
      (car values)
    (let ((tail-maximum (putnam-1964-a1-maximum (cdr values))))
      (if (< tail-maximum (car values))
          (car values)
        tail-maximum))))

(defun putnambench-putnam-1964-a1-statement (points)
  (implies
   (and (true-listp points)
        (equal (len points) 6)
        (putnam-1964-a1-point-list-p points)
        (no-duplicatesp-equal points))
   (let ((distances-squared
          (putnam-1964-a1-pairwise-distances-squared points)))
     (<= (* 3 (putnam-1964-a1-minimum distances-squared))
         (putnam-1964-a1-maximum distances-squared)))))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

-- Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1964_a1:
-- six distinct points in the real plane have longest-to-shortest pairwise
-- distance ratio at least the square root of three. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc)

infix 4 _!=_
infixr 3 _and_
infixr 2 _or_

data Bottom : Set where

Not : Set -> Set
Not A = A -> Bottom

_!=_ : {A : Set} -> A -> A -> Set
x != y = Not (x == y)

record _and_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data _or_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  left  : A -> A or B
  right : B -> A or B

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

data Fin : Nat -> Set where
  fzero : {n : Nat} -> Fin (suc n)
  fsuc  : {n : Nat} -> Fin n -> Fin (suc n)

one : Nat
one = suc zero

two : Nat
two = suc one

three : Nat
three = suc two

four : Nat
four = suc three

five : Nat
five = suc four

six : Nat
six = suc five

record CompleteOrderedRealField (R : Set) : Set1 where
  field
    zeroR oneR : R
    add multiply : R -> R -> R
    negate inverse squareRoot : R -> R
    lessOrEqual : R -> R -> Set
    fromNat : Nat -> R
    supremum infimum : (R -> Set) -> R

    one-not-zero :
      oneR != zeroR

    add-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> add x y == add y x
    add-associative :
      (x y z : R) -> add (add x y) z == add x (add y z)
    add-zero :
      (x : R) -> add x zeroR == x
    add-inverse :
      (x : R) -> add x (negate x) == zeroR

    multiply-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> multiply x y == multiply y x
    multiply-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply (multiply x y) z == multiply x (multiply y z)
    multiply-one :
      (x : R) -> multiply x oneR == x
    multiply-zero :
      (x : R) -> multiply x zeroR == zeroR
    distribute :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply x (add y z) ==
      add (multiply x y) (multiply x z)
    inverse-zero :
      inverse zeroR == zeroR
    multiply-inverse :
      (x : R) ->
      x != zeroR ->
      multiply x (inverse x) == oneR

    order-reflexive :
      (x : R) -> lessOrEqual x x
    order-transitive :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y z ->
      lessOrEqual x z
    order-antisymmetric :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y x ->
      x == y
    order-total :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y or lessOrEqual y x
    add-order :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual (add z x) (add z y)
    multiply-nonnegative :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR x ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR y ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR (multiply x y)
    zero-less-than-one :
      lessOrEqual zeroR oneR and zeroR != oneR

    fromNat-zero :
      fromNat zero == zeroR
    fromNat-successor :
      (n : Nat) -> fromNat (suc n) == add (fromNat n) oneR
    archimedean :
      (x : R) ->
      Exists Nat (\ n -> lessOrEqual x (fromNat n))

    supremum-property :
      (P : R -> Set) ->
      Exists R P ->
      Exists R
        (\ upper ->
          (x : R) ->
          P x ->
          lessOrEqual x upper) ->
      ((x : R) ->
        P x ->
        lessOrEqual x (supremum P))
      and
      ((upper : R) ->
        ((x : R) -> P x -> lessOrEqual x upper) ->
        lessOrEqual (supremum P) upper)

    infimum-property :
      (P : R -> Set) ->
      Exists R P ->
      Exists R
        (\ lower ->
          (x : R) ->
          P x ->
          lessOrEqual lower x) ->
      ((x : R) ->
        P x ->
        lessOrEqual (infimum P) x)
      and
      ((lower : R) ->
        ((x : R) -> P x -> lessOrEqual lower x) ->
        lessOrEqual lower (infimum P))

    square-root-nonnegative :
      (x : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR (squareRoot x)
    square-root-square :
      (x : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR x ->
      multiply (squareRoot x) (squareRoot x) == x
    square-root-nonpositive :
      (x : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x zeroR ->
      squareRoot x == zeroR
    square-root-unique :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR y ->
      multiply y y == x ->
      y == squareRoot x

open CompleteOrderedRealField

subtract :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
subtract reals x y =
  add reals x (negate reals y)

divide :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
divide reals x y =
  multiply reals x (inverse reals y)

square :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R
square reals x =
  multiply reals x x

record Point (R : Set) : Set where
  constructor point
  field
    x-coordinate : R
    y-coordinate : R

open Point

squaredDistance :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Point R ->
  Point R ->
  R
squaredDistance reals p q =
  add reals
    (square reals
      (subtract reals (x-coordinate p) (x-coordinate q)))
    (square reals
      (subtract reals (y-coordinate p) (y-coordinate q)))

distance :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Point R ->
  Point R ->
  R
distance reals p q =
  squareRoot reals (squaredDistance reals p q)

module Putnam1964A1Statement
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) where

  Plane : Set
  Plane = Point R

  Subset : Set1
  Subset = Plane -> Set

  record HasCardinality (A : Subset) (n : Nat) : Set where
    field
      enumerate :
        Fin n -> Plane
      enumerated-member :
        (i : Fin n) -> A (enumerate i)
      enumeration-complete :
        (p : Plane) ->
        A p ->
        Exists (Fin n) (\ i -> p == enumerate i)
      enumeration-injective :
        (i j : Fin n) ->
        enumerate i == enumerate j ->
        i == j

  PairwiseDistance : Subset -> R -> Set
  PairwiseDistance A d =
    Exists Plane
      (\ a ->
        Exists Plane
          (\ b ->
            A a
            and
            A b
            and
            a != b
            and
            d == distance reals a b))

  proposition : Set1
  proposition =
    (A : Subset) ->
    HasCardinality A six ->
    lessOrEqual reals
      (squareRoot reals (fromNat reals three))
      (divide reals
        (supremum reals (PairwiseDistance A))
        (infimum reals (PairwiseDistance A)))

putnam-1964-a1 : Set1
putnam-1964-a1 =
  (R : Set) ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) ->
  Putnam1964A1Statement.proposition reals

content:
% Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench artifact putnam_1964_a1:
% among six distinct points in the real plane, the longest pairwise distance
% divided by the shortest is at least the square root of 3. This file contains
% no proof.

putnam_1964_a1: THEORY
BEGIN
  point: TYPE = [# x_coord: real, y_coord: real #]

  IMPORTING finite_sets[point]

  squared_distance(P, Q: point): real =
    (x_coord(Q) - x_coord(P)) ^ 2
      + (y_coord(Q) - y_coord(P)) ^ 2

  distance(P, Q: point): real =
    epsilon(
      LAMBDA (length: real):
        0 <= length
          AND length * length = squared_distance(P, Q))

  pairwise_distance(A: finite_set[point], length: real): bool =
    EXISTS (P, Q: point):
      A(P) AND A(Q) AND P /= Q
        AND length = distance(P, Q)

  is_longest_distance(A: finite_set[point], D: real): bool =
    pairwise_distance(A, D)
      AND FORALL (length: real):
        pairwise_distance(A, length) IMPLIES length <= D

  is_shortest_distance(A: finite_set[point], d: real): bool =
    pairwise_distance(A, d)
      AND FORALL (length: real):
        pairwise_distance(A, length) IMPLIES d <= length

  sqrt_value(root, radicand: real): bool =
    0 <= root AND root * root = radicand

  putnam_1964_a1: bool =
    FORALL (A: finite_set[point]):
      card(A) = 6 IMPLIES
        EXISTS (D, d, sqrt_three: real):
          is_longest_distance(A, D)
            AND is_shortest_distance(A, d)
            AND d > 0
            AND sqrt_value(sqrt_three, 3)
            AND D >= sqrt_three * d
END putnam_1964_a1

;; Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1964_a2:
;; no positive continuous real-valued function on [0,1] has total integral 1
;; and first two moments alpha and alpha squared. This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))

;; The scalar arguments present the Dedekind-complete ordered field of real
;; numbers. Function objects are quantified internally. Continuity is the
;; epsilon-delta definition on [0,1], and the three interval integrals are
;; characterized by convergence of uniform left-endpoint Riemann sums. For
;; continuous real functions this is equivalent to the source's interval
;; Lebesgue integral. The benchmark's advertised solution is the empty set, so
;; its set equality is equivalently the absence of a qualifying function.

(defun p1964-member-p (carrier x)
  (if (apply$ carrier (list x)) t nil))

(defun p1964-binary (operation x y)
  (apply$ operation (list x y)))

(defun p1964-subtract (add negate x y)
  (p1964-binary add x (apply$ negate (list y))))

(defun p1964-less-equal-p (less x y)
  (not (apply$ less (list y x))))

(defun p1964-absolute (less negate zero x)
  (if (apply$ less (list x zero))
      (apply$ negate (list x))
    x))

(defun-sk p1964-field-laws-p
    (carrier zero one add multiply negate inverse)
  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and (p1964-member-p carrier x)
          (p1964-member-p carrier y)
          (p1964-member-p carrier z))
     (and
      (p1964-member-p carrier (p1964-binary add x y))
      (p1964-member-p carrier (p1964-binary multiply x y))
      (p1964-member-p carrier (apply$ negate (list x)))
      (implies
       (not (equal x zero))
       (p1964-member-p carrier (apply$ inverse (list x))))
      (equal
       (p1964-binary add (p1964-binary add x y) z)
       (p1964-binary add x (p1964-binary add y z)))
      (equal (p1964-binary add x y)
             (p1964-binary add y x))
      (equal (p1964-binary add x zero) x)
      (equal (p1964-binary add x (apply$ negate (list x)))
             zero)
      (equal
       (p1964-binary multiply
                     (p1964-binary multiply x y) z)
       (p1964-binary multiply
                     x (p1964-binary multiply y z)))
      (equal (p1964-binary multiply x y)
             (p1964-binary multiply y x))
      (equal (p1964-binary multiply x one) x)
      (implies
       (not (equal x zero))
       (equal
        (p1964-binary multiply
                      x (apply$ inverse (list x)))
        one))
      (equal
       (p1964-binary multiply
                     x (p1964-binary add y z))
       (p1964-binary add
                     (p1964-binary multiply x y)
                     (p1964-binary multiply x z)))))))

(defun-sk p1964-order-laws-p
    (carrier zero add multiply less)
  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and (p1964-member-p carrier x)
          (p1964-member-p carrier y)
          (p1964-member-p carrier z))
     (and
      (not (apply$ less (list x x)))
      (or (equal x y)
          (apply$ less (list x y))
          (apply$ less (list y x)))
      (implies
       (and (apply$ less (list x y))
            (apply$ less (list y z)))
       (apply$ less (list x z)))
      (implies
       (apply$ less (list x y))
       (apply$ less
               (list (p1964-binary add x z)
                     (p1964-binary add y z))))
      (implies
       (and (apply$ less (list zero x))
            (apply$ less (list zero y)))
       (apply$ less
               (list zero
                     (p1964-binary multiply x y))))))))

(defun-sk p1964-set-nonempty-p (carrier set)
  (exists (x)
    (and (p1964-member-p carrier x)
         (apply$ set (list x)))))

(defun-sk p1964-upper-bound-p (carrier less set bound)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (and (p1964-member-p carrier x)
          (apply$ set (list x)))
     (p1964-less-equal-p less x bound))))

(defun-sk p1964-bounded-above-p (carrier less set)
  (exists (bound)
    (and (p1964-member-p carrier bound)
         (p1964-upper-bound-p carrier less set bound))))

(defun-sk p1964-supremum-p (carrier less set supremum)
  (forall (bound)
    (and
     (p1964-member-p carrier supremum)
     (p1964-upper-bound-p carrier less set supremum)
     (implies
      (and (p1964-member-p carrier bound)
           (p1964-upper-bound-p carrier less set bound))
      (p1964-less-equal-p less supremum bound)))))

(defun-sk p1964-has-supremum-p (carrier less set)
  (exists (supremum)
    (p1964-supremum-p carrier less set supremum)))

(defun-sk p1964-dedekind-complete-p (carrier less)
  (forall (set)
    (implies
     (and (tamep-functionp set)
          (p1964-set-nonempty-p carrier set)
          (p1964-bounded-above-p carrier less set))
     (p1964-has-supremum-p carrier less set))))

(defun p1964-real-field-p
    (carrier zero one add multiply negate inverse less)
  (and
   (tamep-functionp carrier)
   (tamep-functionp add)
   (tamep-functionp multiply)
   (tamep-functionp negate)
   (tamep-functionp inverse)
   (tamep-functionp less)
   (p1964-member-p carrier zero)
   (p1964-member-p carrier one)
   (not (equal zero one))
   (p1964-field-laws-p
    carrier zero one add multiply negate inverse)
   (p1964-order-laws-p carrier zero add multiply less)
   (apply$ less (list zero one))
   (p1964-dedekind-complete-p carrier less)))

(defun-sk p1964-function-p (carrier function)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (p1964-member-p carrier x)
     (p1964-member-p carrier
                     (apply$ function (list x))))))

(defun p1964-unit-interval-p (carrier zero one less x)
  (and (p1964-member-p carrier x)
       (p1964-less-equal-p less zero x)
       (p1964-less-equal-p less x one)))

(defun-sk p1964-positive-on-unit-p
    (carrier zero one less function)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (p1964-unit-interval-p carrier zero one less x)
     (apply$ less
             (list zero (apply$ function (list x)))))))

(defun-sk p1964-continuity-neighborhood-p
    (carrier zero one add negate less function x epsilon delta)
  (forall (y)
    (implies
     (and
      (p1964-unit-interval-p carrier zero one less y)
      (apply$ less
              (list
               (p1964-absolute
                less negate zero
                (p1964-subtract add negate y x))
               delta)))
     (apply$ less
             (list
              (p1964-absolute
               less negate zero
               (p1964-subtract
                add negate
                (apply$ function (list y))
                (apply$ function (list x))))
              epsilon)))))

(defun-sk p1964-continuity-delta-exists-p
    (carrier zero one add negate less function x epsilon)
  (exists (delta)
    (and
     (p1964-member-p carrier delta)
     (apply$ less (list zero delta))
     (p1964-continuity-neighborhood-p
      carrier zero one add negate less
      function x epsilon delta))))

(defun-sk p1964-continuous-at-p
    (carrier zero one add negate less function x)
  (forall (epsilon)
    (implies
     (and (p1964-member-p carrier epsilon)
          (apply$ less (list zero epsilon)))
     (p1964-continuity-delta-exists-p
      carrier zero one add negate less
      function x epsilon))))

(defun-sk p1964-continuous-on-unit-p
    (carrier zero one add negate less function)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (p1964-unit-interval-p carrier zero one less x)
     (p1964-continuous-at-p
      carrier zero one add negate less function x))))

(defun p1964-natural-value (n zero one add)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix n)))
  (if (zp n)
      zero
    (p1964-binary
     add one
     (p1964-natural-value (- n 1) zero one add))))

(defun p1964-moment-weight (power x one multiply)
  (cond ((equal power 0) one)
        ((equal power 1) x)
        (t (p1964-binary multiply x x))))

(defun p1964-riemann-sum-aux
    (count n power function zero one add multiply inverse)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix count)))
  (if (zp count)
      zero
    (let* ((index (- count 1))
           (n-value
            (p1964-natural-value n zero one add))
           (index-value
            (p1964-natural-value index zero one add))
           (x
            (p1964-binary
             multiply index-value
             (apply$ inverse (list n-value))))
           (term
            (p1964-binary
             multiply
             (p1964-moment-weight power x one multiply)
             (apply$ function (list x)))))
      (p1964-binary
       add term
       (p1964-riemann-sum-aux
        (- count 1) n power function
        zero one add multiply inverse)))))

(defun p1964-riemann-sum
    (n power function zero one add multiply inverse)
  (let ((n-value
         (p1964-natural-value n zero one add)))
    (p1964-binary
     multiply
     (apply$ inverse (list n-value))
     (p1964-riemann-sum-aux
      n n power function zero one add multiply inverse))))

(defun-sk p1964-integral-tail-p
    (carrier zero one add multiply negate inverse less
     function power value epsilon cutoff)
  (forall (n)
    (implies
     (and (natp n)
          (<= 1 n)
          (<= cutoff n))
     (apply$ less
             (list
              (p1964-absolute
               less negate zero
               (p1964-subtract
                add negate
                (p1964-riemann-sum
                 n power function
                 zero one add multiply inverse)
                value))
              epsilon)))))

(defun-sk p1964-integral-cutoff-exists-p
    (carrier zero one add multiply negate inverse less
     function power value epsilon)
  (exists (cutoff)
    (and
     (natp cutoff)
     (p1964-integral-tail-p
      carrier zero one add multiply negate inverse less
      function power value epsilon cutoff))))

(defun-sk p1964-integral-value-p
    (carrier zero one add multiply negate inverse less
     function power value)
  (forall (epsilon)
    (implies
     (and (p1964-member-p carrier epsilon)
          (apply$ less (list zero epsilon)))
     (p1964-integral-cutoff-exists-p
      carrier zero one add multiply negate inverse less
      function power value epsilon))))

(defun p1964-qualifying-function-p
    (carrier zero one add multiply negate inverse less
     function alpha)
  (and
   (tamep-functionp function)
   (p1964-function-p carrier function)
   (p1964-positive-on-unit-p
    carrier zero one less function)
   (p1964-continuous-on-unit-p
    carrier zero one add negate less function)
   (p1964-integral-value-p
    carrier zero one add multiply negate inverse less
    function 0 one)
   (p1964-integral-value-p
    carrier zero one add multiply negate inverse less
    function 1 alpha)
   (p1964-integral-value-p
    carrier zero one add multiply negate inverse less
    function 2 (p1964-binary multiply alpha alpha))))

(defun-sk p1964-no-qualifying-function-p
    (carrier zero one add multiply negate inverse less alpha)
  (forall (function)
    (not
     (p1964-qualifying-function-p
      carrier zero one add multiply negate inverse less
      function alpha))))

(defun putnambench-putnam-1964-a2-statement
    (real-carrier real-zero real-one real-add real-multiply
     real-negate real-inverse real-less alpha)
  (implies
   (and
    (p1964-real-field-p
     real-carrier real-zero real-one real-add real-multiply
     real-negate real-inverse real-less)
    (p1964-member-p real-carrier alpha))
   (p1964-no-qualifying-function-p
    real-carrier real-zero real-one real-add real-multiply
    real-negate real-inverse real-less alpha)))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

title: putnam_1964_a2
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1964_a2:
-- no positive continuous real function on [0,1] can have total integral one
-- and first and second moments alpha and alpha squared. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module Putnam1964A2 where

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_)

infix 4 _!=_ _<=N_
infixr 3 _and_
infixr 2 _or_

data Bottom : Set where

Not : Set -> Set
Not A = A -> Bottom

_!=_ : {A : Set} -> A -> A -> Set
x != y = Not (x == y)

record _and_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data _or_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  left  : A -> A or B
  right : B -> A or B

record Iff (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor equivalence
  field
    forward  : A -> B
    backward : B -> A

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

data _<=N_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set where
  zero<=   : {n : Nat} -> zero <=N n
  suc<=suc : {m n : Nat} -> m <=N n -> suc m <=N suc n

Predicate : Set -> Set1
Predicate A = A -> Set

record CompleteOrderedField (R : Set) : Set1 where
  field
    zeroR oneR : R
    add multiply : R -> R -> R
    negate inverse : R -> R
    lessOrEqual : R -> R -> Set
    fromNat : Nat -> R

    one-not-zero :
      oneR != zeroR

    add-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> add x y == add y x
    add-associative :
      (x y z : R) -> add (add x y) z == add x (add y z)
    add-zero :
      (x : R) -> add x zeroR == x
    add-inverse :
      (x : R) -> add x (negate x) == zeroR

    multiply-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> multiply x y == multiply y x
    multiply-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply (multiply x y) z == multiply x (multiply y z)
    multiply-one :
      (x : R) -> multiply x oneR == x
    multiply-zero :
      (x : R) -> multiply x zeroR == zeroR
    distribute :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply x (add y z) ==
      add (multiply x y) (multiply x z)
    inverse-zero :
      inverse zeroR == zeroR
    multiply-inverse :
      (x : R) ->
      x != zeroR ->
      multiply x (inverse x) == oneR

    order-reflexive :
      (x : R) -> lessOrEqual x x
    order-transitive :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y z ->
      lessOrEqual x z
    order-antisymmetric :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y x ->
      x == y
    order-total :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y or lessOrEqual y x
    add-order :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual (add z x) (add z y)
    multiply-nonnegative :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR x ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR y ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR (multiply x y)
    zero-less-than-one :
      lessOrEqual zeroR oneR and zeroR != oneR

    fromNat-zero :
      fromNat zero == zeroR
    fromNat-successor :
      (n : Nat) -> fromNat (suc n) == add (fromNat n) oneR
    fromNat-addition :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m + n) == add (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-injective :
      (m n : Nat) -> fromNat m == fromNat n -> m == n

    archimedean :
      (x : R) ->
      Exists Nat (\ n -> lessOrEqual x (fromNat n))
    least-upper-bound :
      (P : Predicate R) ->
      Exists R P ->
      Exists R
        (\ upper ->
          (x : R) -> P x -> lessOrEqual x upper) ->
      Exists R
        (\ supremum ->
          ((x : R) -> P x -> lessOrEqual x supremum)
          and
          ((upper : R) ->
            ((x : R) -> P x -> lessOrEqual x upper) ->
            lessOrEqual supremum upper))

open CompleteOrderedField

subtract :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
subtract reals x y =
  add reals x (negate reals y)

divide :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
divide reals x y =
  multiply reals x (inverse reals y)

square :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  R
square reals x =
  multiply reals x x

StrictLess :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
StrictLess reals x y =
  lessOrEqual reals x y and x != y

ClosedUnitInterval :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  Predicate R
ClosedUnitInterval reals x =
  lessOrEqual reals (zeroR reals) x
  and
  lessOrEqual reals x (oneR reals)

CloseTo :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
CloseTo reals center radius x =
  StrictLess reals (subtract reals center radius) x
  and
  StrictLess reals x (add reals center radius)

ContinuousWithinAt :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  (R -> R) ->
  Predicate R ->
  R ->
  Set
ContinuousWithinAt {R} reals function domain point =
  (epsilon : R) ->
  StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) epsilon ->
  Exists R
    (\ delta ->
      StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) delta
      and
      ((x : R) ->
        domain x ->
        CloseTo reals point delta x ->
        CloseTo reals (function point) epsilon (function x)))

ContinuousOn :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  (R -> R) ->
  Predicate R ->
  Set
ContinuousOn {R} reals function domain =
  (x : R) ->
  domain x ->
  ContinuousWithinAt reals function domain x

sumFirst :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  Nat ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  R
sumFirst reals zero terms =
  zeroR reals
sumFirst reals (suc n) terms =
  add reals
    (sumFirst reals n terms)
    (terms n)

SequentialLimit :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  R ->
  Set
SequentialLimit reals sequence limit =
  (epsilon : _) ->
  StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) epsilon ->
  Exists Nat
    (\ cutoff ->
      (n : Nat) ->
      cutoff <=N n ->
      CloseTo reals limit epsilon (sequence n))

rightRiemannSum :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  (R -> R) ->
  Nat ->
  R
rightRiemannSum reals function pieces =
  let
    step = divide reals (oneR reals) (fromNat reals pieces)
  in
  sumFirst reals pieces
    (\ i ->
      multiply reals
        (function
          (multiply reals
            (fromNat reals (suc i))
            step))
        step)

UnitIntervalIntegralValue :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  (R -> R) ->
  R ->
  Set
UnitIntervalIntegralValue reals function value =
  SequentialLimit reals
    (\ n -> rightRiemannSum reals function (suc n))
    value

module Putnam1964A2Statement
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) where

  Qualifies :
    R ->
    (R -> R) ->
    Set
  Qualifies alpha f =
    ((x : R) ->
      ClosedUnitInterval reals x ->
      StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) (f x))
    and
    ContinuousOn reals f (ClosedUnitInterval reals)
    and
    UnitIntervalIntegralValue reals f (oneR reals)
    and
    UnitIntervalIntegralValue reals
      (\ x -> multiply reals x (f x))
      alpha
    and
    UnitIntervalIntegralValue reals
      (\ x -> multiply reals (square reals x) (f x))
      (square reals alpha)

  proposition : Set
  proposition =
    (alpha : R) ->
    (f : R -> R) ->
    Iff Bottom (Qualifies alpha f)

putnam-1964-a2 : Set1
putnam-1964-a2 =
  (R : Set) ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) ->
  Putnam1964A2Statement.proposition reals

(*
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench artifact putnam_1964_a2:
  the classification of positive continuous real functions on the unit
  interval with prescribed normalization and first two moments as empty.
  This file contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open pred_setTheory realTheory real_topologyTheory integrationTheory;

val putnam_1964_a2 =
  ``let solution =
      \a : real. ({} : (real -> real) set)
    in
      !alpha : real.
        solution alpha =
        {f : real -> real |
           (!x : real.
              x IN interval [0, 1] ==> 0 < f x) /\
           f continuous_on interval [0, 1] /\
           integration$integral (interval [0, 1]) f = 1 /\
           integration$integral (interval [0, 1])
             (\x : real. x * f x) = alpha /\
           integration$integral (interval [0, 1])
             (\x : real. x pow 2 * f x) = alpha pow 2}``;

content:
$(
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench artifact putnam_1964_a2:
  no positive continuous real-valued function on the closed unit interval
  has zeroth, first, and second moments 1, A, and A^2 respectively. This
  file contains no proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  F ranges over total real-valued functions. Its restriction to [0,1] is
  required to be continuous in set.mm's native function-space notation.
  Continuity on the compact interval makes F, x F(x), and x^2 F(x)
  integrable, so the three Lebesgue integrals encode the published moments.

  The final declaration is the single unproved $a corpus statement; this
  database contains no $p proof statement.
$)

${
  $d A F x $.

  putnambench-putnam-1964-a2 $a |- A. A e. RR
    -. E. F e. ( RR ^m RR )
      (
        (
          ( F |` ( 0 [,] 1 ) )
          e.
          ( ( 0 [,] 1 ) -cn-> RR )
        )
        /\
        (
          A. x e. ( 0 [,] 1 )
            0 < ( F ` x )
        )
        /\
        (
          S. ( 0 [,] 1 ) ( F ` x ) _d x
        )
        =
        1
        /\
        (
          S. ( 0 [,] 1 )
            ( x x. ( F ` x ) )
            _d x
        )
        =
        A
        /\
        (
          S. ( 0 [,] 1 )
            ( ( x ^ 2 ) x. ( F ` x ) )
            _d x
        )
        =
        ( A ^ 2 )
      )
  $.
$}

:: no positive continuous real function on [0,1] can have total integral one
:: while its first and second moments are alpha and alpha squared. This file

environ

 vocabularies NUMBERS, XBOOLE_0, SUBSET_1, RELAT_1, FUNCT_1, FUNCT_2,
      PARTFUN1, CARD_1, ORDINAL1, VALUED_0, VALUED_1, XCMPLX_0,

 notations TARSKI, XBOOLE_0, SUBSET_1, RELAT_1, RELSET_1, FUNCT_1,
      PARTFUN1, FUNCT_2, ORDINAL1, CARD_1, NUMBERS, XCMPLX_0,
      XREAL_0, XXREAL_0, XXREAL_1, XXREAL_3, VALUED_0, VALUED_1,
      SQUARE_1, SUPINF_2, MEASURE1, MESFUNC1, MESFUNC5, MESFUNC6, MEASUR12,
      INTEGRA5, EXTREAL1, SEQ_1, SEQ_4, PARTFUN2, FCONT_1;
 constructors RELSET_1, FUNCT_2, REAL_1, SQUARE_1, MESFUNC1, MESFUNC5,
      MESFUNC6, MEASUR12, INTEGRA5, EXTREAL1, PARTFUN2, RFUNCT_2,
      FCONT_1, SEQ_2, SEQ_4, COMPLEX1;
 registrations XBOOLE_0, SUBSET_1, RELAT_1, RELSET_1, FUNCT_1, FUNCT_2,
      ORDINAL1, CARD_1, NUMBERS, XREAL_0, VALUED_0, VALUED_1,
      SQUARE_1, XXREAL_3, MEASURE1, MEASUR12, RCOMP_1, FCONT_1, NAT_1,
      MEMBERED;
 requirements BOOLE, SUBSET, NUMERALS, REAL, ARITHM;
 definitions TARSKI, XBOOLE_0;
 equalities SQUARE_1;
 expansions TARSKI, XBOOLE_0, RELAT_1, FCONT_1;

begin

::$P-
theorem
  for alpha being Real holds
    not ex I being Subset of REAL st
      I = {x where x is Real : 0 <= x & x <= 1} &
      ex f,xf,x2f being Function of REAL,REAL st
        (for x being Real st x in I holds 0 < f.x) &
        (for x being Real st x in I holds
          for epsilon being Real st 0 < epsilon holds
            ex delta being Real st 0 < delta &
              for y being Real st
                y in I & x-delta < y & y < x+delta
              holds f.x-epsilon < f.y & f.y < f.x+epsilon) &
        (for x being Real holds xf.x = x * f.x) &
        (for x being Real holds x2f.x = x^2 * f.x) &
        Integral(L-Meas,f|I) = 1 &
        Integral(L-Meas,xf|I) = alpha &
        Integral(L-Meas,x2f|I) = alpha^2
proof
end;
::$P+

% Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench artifact putnam_1964_a2:
% no continuous strictly positive real function on [0, 1] has total integral
% 1, first moment alpha, and second moment alpha squared. This file contains

putnam_1964_a2: THEORY
BEGIN
  real_function: TYPE = [real -> real]
  function_set: TYPE = [real_function -> bool]
  real_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> real]

  in_closed_unit_interval(x: real): bool =
    0 <= x AND x <= 1

  continuous_on_unit_interval(f: real_function): bool =
    FORALL (x: real):
      in_closed_unit_interval(x) IMPLIES
        FORALL (epsilon_value: real):
          epsilon_value > 0 IMPLIES
            EXISTS (delta: real):
              delta > 0
                AND FORALL (z: real):
                  (in_closed_unit_interval(z)
                    AND abs(z - x) < delta)
                  IMPLIES
                    abs(f(z) - f(x)) < epsilon_value

  valid_partition(
      points: real_sequence,
      count: nat): bool =
    count > 0
      AND points(0) = 0
      AND points(count) = 1
      AND FORALL (index: nat):
        index < count IMPLIES
          points(index) < points(index + 1)

  valid_tags(
      points, tags: real_sequence,
      count: nat): bool =
    FORALL (index: nat):
      index < count IMPLIES
        points(index) <= tags(index)
          AND tags(index) <= points(index + 1)

  mesh_less_than(
      points: real_sequence,
      count: nat,
      bound: real): bool =
    FORALL (index: nat):
      index < count IMPLIES
        points(index + 1) - points(index) < bound

  riemann_sum(
      f: real_function,
      points, tags: real_sequence,
      count: nat): RECURSIVE real =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      riemann_sum(f, points, tags, count - 1)
        + f(tags(count - 1))
            * (points(count) - points(count - 1))
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  has_unit_interval_integral(
      f: real_function,
      integral_value: real): bool =
    FORALL (epsilon_value: real):
      epsilon_value > 0 IMPLIES
        EXISTS (mesh_bound: real):
          mesh_bound > 0
            AND FORALL
                (points, tags: real_sequence),
                (count: nat):
              (valid_partition(points, count)
                AND valid_tags(points, tags, count)
                AND mesh_less_than(points, count, mesh_bound))
              IMPLIES
                abs(
                  riemann_sum(f, points, tags, count)
                    - integral_value)
                  < epsilon_value

  putnam_1964_a2_solution(alpha: real): function_set =
    LAMBDA (f: real_function): FALSE

  qualifying_functions(alpha: real): function_set =
    LAMBDA (f: real_function):
      (FORALL (x: real):
        in_closed_unit_interval(x) IMPLIES f(x) > 0)
        AND continuous_on_unit_interval(f)
        AND has_unit_interval_integral(f, 1)
        AND has_unit_interval_integral(
          LAMBDA (x: real): x * f(x), alpha)
        AND has_unit_interval_integral(
          LAMBDA (x: real): x ^ 2 * f(x), alpha ^ 2)

  putnam_1964_a2: bool =
    FORALL (alpha: real):
      putnam_1964_a2_solution(alpha)
        = qualifying_functions(alpha)
END putnam_1964_a2

import Mathlib

open Set Function

/--
The distinct points $x_n$ are dense in the interval $(0, 1)$. For all $n \geq 1$, $x_1, x_2, \dots , x_{n-1}$ divide $(0, 1)$ into $n$ sub-intervals, one of which must contain $x_n$. This part is divided by $x_n$ into two sub-intervals, lengths $a_n$ and $b_n$. Prove that $\sum_{n=1}^{\infty} a_nb_n(a_n + b_n) = \frac{1}{3}$.
-/
theorem putnam_1964_a3
(x a b : ℕ → ℝ)
(hxdense : range x ⊆ Ioo 0 1 ∧ closure (range x) ⊇ Ioo 0 1)
(hxinj : Injective x)
(ha : a = fun n ↦ x n - sSup ({0} ∪ {p : ℝ | p < x n ∧ ∃ i < n, p = x i}))
(hb : b = fun n ↦ sInf ({1} ∪ {p : ℝ | p > x n ∧ ∃ i < n, p = x i}) - x n)
: (∑' n : ℕ, a n * b n * (a n + b n) = 1 / 3) :=
sorry

(* Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench artifact putnam_1964_a3:
   the gap lengths created by an injective dense sequence in the open unit
   interval satisfy the stated infinite-series identity. This file contains no proof. *)

From Stdlib Require Import Reals.

Open Scope R_scope.

Definition putnam_1964_a3_is_supremum
    (S : R -> Prop) (s : R) : Prop :=
  (forall y : R, S y -> y <= s) /\
  (forall u : R, (forall y : R, S y -> y <= u) -> s <= u).

Definition putnam_1964_a3_is_infimum
    (S : R -> Prop) (s : R) : Prop :=
  (forall y : R, S y -> s <= y) /\
  (forall l : R, (forall y : R, S y -> l <= y) -> l <= s).

Definition putnam_1964_a3_left_candidates
    (x : nat -> R) (n : nat) : R -> Prop :=
  fun p : R =>
    p = 0 \/
    (p < x n /\ exists i : nat, (i < n)%nat /\ p = x i).

Definition putnam_1964_a3_right_candidates
    (x : nat -> R) (n : nat) : R -> Prop :=
  fun p : R =>
    p = 1 \/
    (x n < p /\ exists i : nat, (i < n)%nat /\ p = x i).

Fixpoint putnam_1964_a3_partial_sum
    (f : nat -> R) (n : nat) : R :=
  match n with
  | O => 0
  | S k => putnam_1964_a3_partial_sum f k + f k
  end.

Definition putnam_1964_a3_series_has_sum
    (f : nat -> R) (s : R) : Prop :=
  forall epsilon : R,
    0 < epsilon ->
    exists N : nat,
      forall n : nat,
        (N <= n)%nat ->
        Rabs (putnam_1964_a3_partial_sum f n - s) < epsilon.

Theorem putnam_1964_a3
    (x a b : nat -> R)
    (hxin : forall n : nat, 0 < x n < 1)
    (hxdense :
      forall y epsilon : R,
        0 < y < 1 ->
        0 < epsilon ->
        exists n : nat, Rabs (x n - y) < epsilon)
    (hxinj : forall m n : nat, x m = x n -> m = n)
    (ha :
      forall n : nat,
        putnam_1964_a3_is_supremum
          (putnam_1964_a3_left_candidates x n)
          (x n - a n))
    (hb :
      forall n : nat,
        putnam_1964_a3_is_infimum
          (putnam_1964_a3_right_candidates x n)
          (x n + b n)) :
  putnam_1964_a3_series_has_sum
    (fun n : nat => a n * b n * (a n + b n))
    (1 / 3).
Admitted.

content:
;; Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1964_a3:
;; a dense injective sequence in (0,1) yields predecessor and successor
;; interval lengths whose cubic products have infinite sum 1/3. This file
;; contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))

;; The scalar arguments present the Dedekind-complete ordered field of real
;; numbers. Unary APPLY$ objects present the three real sequences. Density and
;; the series value use their epsilon characterizations, while the finite
;; predecessor and successor sets use their greatest/least element properties.

(defun p1964a3-member-p (carrier x)
  (if (apply$ carrier (list x)) t nil))

(defun p1964a3-binary (operation x y)
  (apply$ operation (list x y)))

(defun p1964a3-subtract (add negate x y)
  (p1964a3-binary add x (apply$ negate (list y))))

(defun p1964a3-less-equal-p (less x y)
  (not (apply$ less (list y x))))

(defun p1964a3-absolute (less negate zero x)
  (if (apply$ less (list x zero))
      (apply$ negate (list x))
    x))

(defun-sk p1964a3-field-laws-p
    (carrier zero one add multiply negate inverse)
  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (p1964a3-member-p carrier x)
      (p1964a3-member-p carrier y)
      (p1964a3-member-p carrier z))
     (and
      (p1964a3-member-p
       carrier (p1964a3-binary add x y))
      (p1964a3-member-p
       carrier (p1964a3-binary multiply x y))
      (p1964a3-member-p carrier (apply$ negate (list x)))
      (implies
       (not (equal x zero))
       (p1964a3-member-p carrier (apply$ inverse (list x))))
      (equal
       (p1964a3-binary add (p1964a3-binary add x y) z)
       (p1964a3-binary add x (p1964a3-binary add y z)))
      (equal (p1964a3-binary add x y)
             (p1964a3-binary add y x))
      (equal (p1964a3-binary add x zero) x)
      (equal
       (p1964a3-binary add x (apply$ negate (list x)))
       zero)
      (equal
       (p1964a3-binary
        multiply (p1964a3-binary multiply x y) z)
       (p1964a3-binary
        multiply x (p1964a3-binary multiply y z)))
      (equal (p1964a3-binary multiply x y)
             (p1964a3-binary multiply y x))
      (equal (p1964a3-binary multiply x one) x)
      (implies
       (not (equal x zero))
       (equal
        (p1964a3-binary multiply x (apply$ inverse (list x)))
        one))
      (equal
       (p1964a3-binary
        multiply x (p1964a3-binary add y z))
       (p1964a3-binary
        add
        (p1964a3-binary multiply x y)
        (p1964a3-binary multiply x z)))))))

(defun-sk p1964a3-order-laws-p
    (carrier zero add multiply less)
  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (p1964a3-member-p carrier x)
      (p1964a3-member-p carrier y)
      (p1964a3-member-p carrier z))
     (and
      (not (apply$ less (list x x)))
      (or (equal x y)
          (apply$ less (list x y))
          (apply$ less (list y x)))
      (implies
       (and
        (apply$ less (list x y))
        (apply$ less (list y z)))
       (apply$ less (list x z)))
      (implies
       (apply$ less (list x y))
       (apply$ less
               (list
                (p1964a3-binary add x z)
                (p1964a3-binary add y z))))
      (implies
       (and
        (apply$ less (list zero x))
        (apply$ less (list zero y)))
       (apply$ less
               (list
                zero
                (p1964a3-binary multiply x y))))))))

(defun-sk p1964a3-set-nonempty-p (carrier set)
  (exists (x)
    (and
     (p1964a3-member-p carrier x)
     (apply$ set (list x)))))

(defun-sk p1964a3-upper-bound-p (carrier less set bound)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (and
      (p1964a3-member-p carrier x)
      (apply$ set (list x)))
     (p1964a3-less-equal-p less x bound))))

(defun-sk p1964a3-bounded-above-p (carrier less set)
  (exists (bound)
    (and
     (p1964a3-member-p carrier bound)
     (p1964a3-upper-bound-p carrier less set bound))))

(defun-sk p1964a3-supremum-p (carrier less set supremum)
  (forall (bound)
    (and
     (p1964a3-member-p carrier supremum)
     (p1964a3-upper-bound-p carrier less set supremum)
     (implies
      (and
       (p1964a3-member-p carrier bound)
       (p1964a3-upper-bound-p carrier less set bound))
      (p1964a3-less-equal-p less supremum bound)))))

(defun-sk p1964a3-has-supremum-p (carrier less set)
  (exists (supremum)
    (p1964a3-supremum-p carrier less set supremum)))

(defun-sk p1964a3-dedekind-complete-p (carrier less)
  (forall (set)
    (implies
     (and
      (tamep-functionp set)
      (p1964a3-set-nonempty-p carrier set)
      (p1964a3-bounded-above-p carrier less set))
     (p1964a3-has-supremum-p carrier less set))))

(defun p1964a3-real-field-p
    (carrier zero one add multiply negate inverse less)
  (and
   (tamep-functionp carrier)
   (tamep-functionp add)
   (tamep-functionp multiply)
   (tamep-functionp negate)
   (tamep-functionp inverse)
   (tamep-functionp less)
   (p1964a3-member-p carrier zero)
   (p1964a3-member-p carrier one)
   (not (equal zero one))
   (p1964a3-field-laws-p
    carrier zero one add multiply negate inverse)
   (p1964a3-order-laws-p carrier zero add multiply less)
   (apply$ less (list zero one))
   (p1964a3-dedekind-complete-p carrier less)))

(defun-sk p1964a3-natural-real-function-p (carrier function)
  (forall (n)
    (implies
     (natp n)
     (p1964a3-member-p carrier
                       (apply$ function (list n))))))

(defun-sk p1964a3-range-in-unit-p (zero one less x)
  (forall (n)
    (implies
     (natp n)
     (and
      (apply$ less (list zero (apply$ x (list n))))
      (apply$ less (list (apply$ x (list n)) one))))))

(defun-sk p1964a3-nearby-sequence-value-p
    (zero add negate less x point epsilon)
  (exists (n)
    (and
     (natp n)
     (apply$
      less
      (list
       (p1964a3-absolute
        less negate zero
        (p1964a3-subtract
         add negate (apply$ x (list n)) point))
       epsilon)))))

(defun-sk p1964a3-dense-in-unit-p
    (carrier zero one add negate less x)
  (forall (point epsilon)
    (implies
     (and
      (p1964a3-member-p carrier point)
      (apply$ less (list zero point))
      (apply$ less (list point one))
      (p1964a3-member-p carrier epsilon)
      (apply$ less (list zero epsilon)))
     (p1964a3-nearby-sequence-value-p
      zero add negate less x point epsilon))))

(defun-sk p1964a3-injective-p (x)
  (forall (m n)
    (implies
     (and
      (natp m)
      (natp n)
      (equal (apply$ x (list m))
             (apply$ x (list n))))
     (equal m n))))

(defun-sk p1964a3-earlier-lower-value-p
    (less x n value)
  (exists (i)
    (and
     (natp i)
     (< i n)
     (equal value (apply$ x (list i)))
     (apply$ less
             (list value (apply$ x (list n)))))))

(defun p1964a3-lower-candidate-p
    (carrier zero less x n value)
  (and
   (p1964a3-member-p carrier value)
   (or
    (equal value zero)
    (p1964a3-earlier-lower-value-p less x n value))))

(defun-sk p1964a3-greatest-lower-candidate-p
    (carrier zero less x n value)
  (forall (candidate)
    (implies
     (p1964a3-lower-candidate-p
      carrier zero less x n candidate)
     (p1964a3-less-equal-p less candidate value))))

(defun p1964a3-left-boundary-p
    (carrier zero less x n value)
  (and
   (p1964a3-lower-candidate-p
    carrier zero less x n value)
   (p1964a3-greatest-lower-candidate-p
    carrier zero less x n value)))

(defun-sk p1964a3-left-length-at-p
    (carrier zero add negate less x a n)
  (exists (boundary)
    (and
     (p1964a3-left-boundary-p
      carrier zero less x n boundary)
     (equal
      (apply$ a (list n))
      (p1964a3-subtract
       add negate (apply$ x (list n)) boundary)))))

(defun-sk p1964a3-left-lengths-p
    (carrier zero add negate less x a)
  (forall (n)
    (implies
     (natp n)
     (p1964a3-left-length-at-p
      carrier zero add negate less x a n))))

(defun-sk p1964a3-earlier-upper-value-p
    (less x n value)
  (exists (i)
    (and
     (natp i)
     (< i n)
     (equal value (apply$ x (list i)))
     (apply$ less
             (list (apply$ x (list n)) value)))))

(defun p1964a3-upper-candidate-p
    (carrier one less x n value)
  (and
   (p1964a3-member-p carrier value)
   (or
    (equal value one)
    (p1964a3-earlier-upper-value-p less x n value))))

(defun-sk p1964a3-least-upper-candidate-p
    (carrier one less x n value)
  (forall (candidate)
    (implies
     (p1964a3-upper-candidate-p
      carrier one less x n candidate)
     (p1964a3-less-equal-p less value candidate))))

(defun p1964a3-right-boundary-p
    (carrier one less x n value)
  (and
   (p1964a3-upper-candidate-p
    carrier one less x n value)
   (p1964a3-least-upper-candidate-p
    carrier one less x n value)))

(defun-sk p1964a3-right-length-at-p
    (carrier one add negate less x b n)
  (exists (boundary)
    (and
     (p1964a3-right-boundary-p
      carrier one less x n boundary)
     (equal
      (apply$ b (list n))
      (p1964a3-subtract
       add negate boundary (apply$ x (list n)))))))

(defun-sk p1964a3-right-lengths-p
    (carrier one add negate less x b)
  (forall (n)
    (implies
     (natp n)
     (p1964a3-right-length-at-p
      carrier one add negate less x b n))))

(defun p1964a3-summand (add multiply a b n)
  (let ((left (apply$ a (list n)))
        (right (apply$ b (list n))))
    (p1964a3-binary
     multiply
     (p1964a3-binary multiply left right)
     (p1964a3-binary add left right))))

(defun p1964a3-partial-sum
    (count zero add multiply a b)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix count)))
  (if (zp count)
      zero
    (p1964a3-binary
     add
     (p1964a3-partial-sum
      (- count 1) zero add multiply a b)
     (p1964a3-summand
      add multiply a b (- count 1)))))

(defun p1964a3-one-third (one add inverse)
  (apply$
   inverse
   (list
    (p1964a3-binary
     add one (p1964a3-binary add one one)))))

(defun-sk p1964a3-series-tail-p
    (zero one add multiply negate inverse less
     a b epsilon cutoff)
  (forall (count)
    (implies
     (and
      (natp count)
      (<= cutoff count))
     (apply$
      less
      (list
       (p1964a3-absolute
        less negate zero
        (p1964a3-subtract
         add negate
         (p1964a3-partial-sum
          count zero add multiply a b)
         (p1964a3-one-third one add inverse)))
       epsilon)))))

(defun-sk p1964a3-series-cutoff-exists-p
    (zero one add multiply negate inverse less
     a b epsilon)
  (exists (cutoff)
    (and
     (natp cutoff)
     (p1964a3-series-tail-p
      zero one add multiply negate inverse less
      a b epsilon cutoff))))

(defun-sk p1964a3-series-sums-to-one-third-p
    (carrier zero one add multiply negate inverse less a b)
  (forall (epsilon)
    (implies
     (and
      (p1964a3-member-p carrier epsilon)
      (apply$ less (list zero epsilon)))
     (p1964a3-series-cutoff-exists-p
      zero one add multiply negate inverse less
      a b epsilon))))

(defun putnambench-putnam-1964-a3-statement
    (real-carrier real-zero real-one real-add real-multiply
     real-negate real-inverse real-less x a b)
  (implies
   (and
    (p1964a3-real-field-p
     real-carrier real-zero real-one real-add real-multiply
     real-negate real-inverse real-less)
    (tamep-functionp x)
    (tamep-functionp a)
    (tamep-functionp b)
    (p1964a3-natural-real-function-p real-carrier x)
    (p1964a3-natural-real-function-p real-carrier a)
    (p1964a3-natural-real-function-p real-carrier b)
    (p1964a3-range-in-unit-p
     real-zero real-one real-less x)
    (p1964a3-dense-in-unit-p
     real-carrier real-zero real-one real-add
     real-negate real-less x)
    (p1964a3-injective-p x)
    (p1964a3-left-lengths-p
     real-carrier real-zero real-add real-negate
     real-less x a)
    (p1964a3-right-lengths-p
     real-carrier real-one real-add real-negate
     real-less x b))
   (p1964a3-series-sums-to-one-third-p
    real-carrier real-zero real-one real-add real-multiply
    real-negate real-inverse real-less a b)))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

content:
-- Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1964_a3:
-- an injective dense sequence in (0,1) determines adjacent left and right
-- gaps whose cubic products have infinite sum 1/3. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; _*_)

infix 4 _!=_ _<=N_
infixr 3 _and_
infixr 2 _or_

data Bottom : Set where

Not : Set -> Set
Not A = A -> Bottom

_!=_ : {A : Set} -> A -> A -> Set
x != y = Not (x == y)

record _and_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data _or_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  left  : A -> A or B
  right : B -> A or B

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

data _<=N_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set where
  zero<=   : {n : Nat} -> zero <=N n
  suc<=suc : {m n : Nat} -> m <=N n -> suc m <=N suc n

NatStrictLess : Nat -> Nat -> Set
NatStrictLess m n =
  suc m <=N n

three : Nat
three =
  suc (suc (suc zero))

record CompleteOrderedField (R : Set) : Set1 where
  field
    zeroR oneR : R
    add multiply : R -> R -> R
    negate inverse : R -> R
    lessOrEqual : R -> R -> Set
    fromNat : Nat -> R
    supremum infimum : (R -> Set) -> R

    one-not-zero :
      oneR != zeroR

    add-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> add x y == add y x
    add-associative :
      (x y z : R) -> add (add x y) z == add x (add y z)
    add-zero :
      (x : R) -> add x zeroR == x
    add-inverse :
      (x : R) -> add x (negate x) == zeroR

    multiply-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> multiply x y == multiply y x
    multiply-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply (multiply x y) z == multiply x (multiply y z)
    multiply-one :
      (x : R) -> multiply x oneR == x
    multiply-zero :
      (x : R) -> multiply x zeroR == zeroR
    distribute :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply x (add y z) ==
      add (multiply x y) (multiply x z)
    inverse-zero :
      inverse zeroR == zeroR
    multiply-inverse :
      (x : R) ->
      x != zeroR ->
      multiply x (inverse x) == oneR

    order-reflexive :
      (x : R) -> lessOrEqual x x
    order-transitive :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y z ->
      lessOrEqual x z
    order-antisymmetric :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y x ->
      x == y
    order-total :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y or lessOrEqual y x
    add-order :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual (add z x) (add z y)
    multiply-nonnegative :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR x ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR y ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR (multiply x y)
    zero-less-than-one :
      lessOrEqual zeroR oneR and zeroR != oneR

    fromNat-zero :
      fromNat zero == zeroR
    fromNat-successor :
      (n : Nat) -> fromNat (suc n) == add (fromNat n) oneR
    fromNat-addition :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m + n) == add (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-multiplication :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m * n) == multiply (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-injective :
      (m n : Nat) -> fromNat m == fromNat n -> m == n

    archimedean :
      (x : R) ->
      Exists Nat (\ n -> lessOrEqual x (fromNat n))

    supremum-property :
      (P : R -> Set) ->
      Exists R P ->
      Exists R
        (\ upper ->
          (x : R) -> P x -> lessOrEqual x upper) ->
      ((x : R) ->
        P x ->
        lessOrEqual x (supremum P))
      and
      ((upper : R) ->
        ((x : R) -> P x -> lessOrEqual x upper) ->
        lessOrEqual (supremum P) upper)

    infimum-property :
      (P : R -> Set) ->
      Exists R P ->
      Exists R
        (\ lower ->
          (x : R) -> P x -> lessOrEqual lower x) ->
      ((x : R) ->
        P x ->
        lessOrEqual (infimum P) x)
      and
      ((lower : R) ->
        ((x : R) -> P x -> lessOrEqual lower x) ->
        lessOrEqual lower (infimum P))

open CompleteOrderedField

subtract :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
subtract reals x y =
  add reals x (negate reals y)

divide :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
divide reals x y =
  multiply reals x (inverse reals y)

StrictLess :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
StrictLess reals x y =
  lessOrEqual reals x y and x != y

Injective :
  {A B : Set} ->
  (A -> B) ->
  Set
Injective f =
  (i j : _) ->
  f i == f j ->
  i == j

DenseInOpenUnitInterval :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  Set
DenseInOpenUnitInterval {R} reals x =
  ((n : Nat) ->
    StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) (x n)
    and
    StrictLess reals (x n) (oneR reals))
  and
  ((y : R) ->
    StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) y ->
    StrictLess reals y (oneR reals) ->
    (lower upper : R) ->
    StrictLess reals lower y ->
    StrictLess reals y upper ->
    Exists Nat
      (\ n ->
        StrictLess reals lower (x n)
        and
        StrictLess reals (x n) upper))

LeftCandidate :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  Nat ->
  R ->
  Set
LeftCandidate reals x n p =
  p == zeroR reals
  or
  (StrictLess reals p (x n)
  and
  Exists Nat
    (\ i ->
      NatStrictLess i n
      and
      p == x i))

RightCandidate :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  Nat ->
  R ->
  Set
RightCandidate reals x n p =
  p == oneR reals
  or
  (StrictLess reals (x n) p
  and
  Exists Nat
    (\ i ->
      NatStrictLess i n
      and
      p == x i))

sumFirst :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  Nat ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  R
sumFirst reals zero term =
  zeroR reals
sumFirst reals (suc n) term =
  add reals
    (sumFirst reals n term)
    (term n)

ConvergesTo :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  R ->
  Set
ConvergesTo {R} reals sequence limit =
  (epsilon : R) ->
  StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) epsilon ->
  Exists Nat
    (\ cutoff ->
      (n : Nat) ->
      cutoff <=N n ->
      StrictLess reals
        (subtract reals limit epsilon)
        (sequence n)
      and
      StrictLess reals
        (sequence n)
        (add reals limit epsilon))

SeriesHasSum :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  R ->
  Set
SeriesHasSum reals term limit =
  ConvergesTo reals
    (\ n -> sumFirst reals n term)
    limit

module Putnam1964A3Statement
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) where

  summand :
    (Nat -> R) ->
    (Nat -> R) ->
    Nat ->
    R
  summand a b n =
    multiply reals
      (multiply reals (a n) (b n))
      (add reals (a n) (b n))

  proposition : Set
  proposition =
    (x a b : Nat -> R) ->
    DenseInOpenUnitInterval reals x ->
    Injective x ->
    ((n : Nat) ->
      a n ==
      subtract reals
        (x n)
        (supremum reals (LeftCandidate reals x n))) ->
    ((n : Nat) ->
      b n ==
      subtract reals
        (infimum reals (RightCandidate reals x n))
        (x n)) ->
    SeriesHasSum reals
      (summand a b)
      (divide reals
        (oneR reals)
        (fromNat reals three))

putnam-1964-a3 : Set1
putnam-1964-a3 =
  (R : Set) ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) ->
  Putnam1964A3Statement.proposition reals

(*
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench artifact putnam_1964_a3:
  an identity for the infinite sum of products of the two subinterval lengths
  created by successively inserting distinct dense points in (0,1). This file
  contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open arithmeticTheory pred_setTheory realTheory real_topologyTheory seqTheory;

val putnam_1964_a3 =
  ``!x a b : num -> real.
      IMAGE x UNIV SUBSET {r : real | 0 < r /\ r < 1} /\
      {r : real | 0 < r /\ r < 1} SUBSET closure (IMAGE x UNIV) /\
      INJ x UNIV UNIV /\
      a =
        (\n : num.
           x n -
           @p : real.
             (p = 0 \/
              (p < x n /\ ?i : num. i < n /\ p = x i)) /\
             (!q : real.
                (q = 0 \/
                 (q < x n /\ ?i : num. i < n /\ q = x i))
                ==>
                q <= p)) /\
      b =
        (\n : num.
           (@p : real.
              (p = 1 \/
               (x n < p /\ ?i : num. i < n /\ p = x i)) /\
              (!q : real.
                 (q = 1 \/
                  (x n < q /\ ?i : num. i < n /\ q = x i))
                 ==>
                 p <= q)) -
           x n)
      ==>
      suminf (\n : num. a n * b n * (a n + b n)) = 1 / 3``;

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(

  hypotheses say that X is injective and has dense range in the open unit
  interval. For each n, A(n) and B(n) are the distances from X(n) to the
  supremum and infimum of the earlier points on its left and right, with zero
  and one included as endpoints. The final declaration is the single unproved
  $a corpus statement; this database contains no $p proof statement.
