;; Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench artifact putnam_1964_b2:
;; a maximal pairwise-intersecting family of subsets of a nonempty finite set
;; contains exactly half of all its subsets. This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

;; An arbitrary nonempty finite set is represented by a duplicate-free true
;; list.  The powerset below contains each extensional subset exactly once,
;; in the order induced by the carrier.  Choosing an enumeration of any
;; source finite set gives this representation, and forgetting list order
;; recovers the source set and family, so this is a bidirectional encoding
;; rather than a restriction on the carrier or its subsets.

(defun putnam-1964-b2-adjoin-to-each (element sets)
  (if (consp sets)
      (cons (cons element (car sets))
            (putnam-1964-b2-adjoin-to-each
             element (cdr sets)))
    nil))

(defun putnam-1964-b2-powerset (carrier)
  (if (consp carrier)
      (let ((tail-powerset
             (putnam-1964-b2-powerset (cdr carrier))))
        (append
         tail-powerset
         (putnam-1964-b2-adjoin-to-each
          (car carrier) tail-powerset)))
    (list nil)))

(defun putnam-1964-b2-family-from-powerset-p
    (family powerset)
  (if (consp family)
      (and (member-equal (car family) powerset)
           (putnam-1964-b2-family-from-powerset-p
            (cdr family) powerset))
    (equal family nil)))

(defun putnam-1964-b2-intersect-p (left right)
  (if (consp left)
      (or (member-equal (car left) right)
          (putnam-1964-b2-intersect-p
           (cdr left) right))
    nil))

(defun putnam-1964-b2-intersects-every-p
    (subset family)
  (if (consp family)
      (and
       (putnam-1964-b2-intersect-p subset (car family))
       (putnam-1964-b2-intersects-every-p
        subset (cdr family)))
    t))

(defun putnam-1964-b2-pairwise-intersecting-p
    (remaining family)
  (if (consp remaining)
      (and
       (putnam-1964-b2-intersects-every-p
        (car remaining) family)
       (putnam-1964-b2-pairwise-intersecting-p
        (cdr remaining) family))
    t))

;; This ranges over the complete powerset.  It is exactly the negation of an
;; internal witness outside the family that intersects every family member.
(defun putnam-1964-b2-maximal-p
    (remaining-subsets family)
  (if (consp remaining-subsets)
      (and
       (or
        (member-equal (car remaining-subsets) family)
        (not
         (putnam-1964-b2-intersects-every-p
          (car remaining-subsets) family)))
       (putnam-1964-b2-maximal-p
        (cdr remaining-subsets) family))
    t))

(defun putnambench-putnam-1964-b2-statement
    (carrier family)
  (let ((powerset
         (putnam-1964-b2-powerset carrier)))
    (implies
     (and
      (true-listp carrier)
      (consp carrier)
      (no-duplicatesp-equal carrier)
      (true-listp family)
      (no-duplicatesp-equal family)
      (putnam-1964-b2-family-from-powerset-p
       family powerset)
      (putnam-1964-b2-pairwise-intersecting-p
       family family)
      (putnam-1964-b2-maximal-p
       powerset family))
     (equal
      (len family)
      (expt 2 (- (len carrier) 1))))))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

title: putnam_1964_b2
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1964_b2:
-- a maximal pairwise-intersecting family of subsets of a finite nonempty set
-- has exactly half of all subsets as members. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

open import Agda.Primitive using (Level; _⊔_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _*_)

infix 4 _!=_
infixr 3 _and_

data Bottom : Set where

Not :
  {a : Level} ->
  Set a ->
  Set a
Not A =
  A -> Bottom

_!=_ :
  {a : Level} ->
  {A : Set a} ->
  A ->
  A ->
  Set a
x != y =
  Not (x == y)

record Top : Set where
  constructor truth

record _and_
  {a b : Level}
  (A : Set a)
  (B : Set b) :
  Set (a ⊔ b) where

  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

record Iff
  {a b : Level}
  (A : Set a)
  (B : Set b) :
  Set (a ⊔ b) where

  constructor iff
  field
    forward  : A -> B
    backward : B -> A

record Exists
  {a b : Level}
  (A : Set a)
  (P : A -> Set b) :
  Set (a ⊔ b) where

  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

data Fin : Nat -> Set where
  fzero : {n : Nat} -> Fin (suc n)
  fsuc  : {n : Nat} -> Fin n -> Fin (suc n)

record HasCardinality
  {A : Set}
  (P : A -> Set)
  (count : Nat) :
  Set where

  field
    enumerate :
      Fin count -> A
    enumerated-member :
      (i : Fin count) ->
      P (enumerate i)
    enumeration-complete :
      (x : A) ->
      P x ->
      Exists (Fin count) (\ i -> x == enumerate i)
    enumeration-injective :
      (i j : Fin count) ->
      enumerate i == enumerate j ->
      i == j

CarrierHasCardinality :
  Set ->
  Nat ->
  Set
CarrierHasCardinality S count =
  HasCardinality {A = S} (\ _ -> Top) count

Subset :
  Set ->
  Set1
Subset S =
  S -> Set

SameSubset :
  {S : Set} ->
  Subset S ->
  Subset S ->
  Set
SameSubset {S} T U =
  (x : S) ->
  Iff (T x) (U x)

Family :
  Set ->
  Set1
Family S =
  Subset S -> Set

ExtensionalFamily :
  {S : Set} ->
  Family S ->
  Set1
ExtensionalFamily {S} P =
  (T U : Subset S) ->
  SameSubset T U ->
  Iff (P T) (P U)

Intersects :
  {S : Set} ->
  Subset S ->
  Subset S ->
  Set
Intersects {S} T U =
  Exists S (\ x -> T x and U x)

PairwiseIntersecting :
  {S : Set} ->
  Family S ->
  Set1
PairwiseIntersecting {S} P =
  (T U : Subset S) ->
  P T ->
  P U ->
  Intersects T U

MaximalIntersecting :
  {S : Set} ->
  Family S ->
  Set1
MaximalIntersecting {S} P =
  Not
    (Exists (Subset S)
      (\ T ->
        Not (P T)
        and
        ((U : Subset S) ->
          P U ->
          Intersects T U)))

record FamilyHasCardinality
  {S : Set}
  (P : Family S)
  (count : Nat) :
  Set1 where

  field
    enumerate :
      Fin count -> Subset S
    enumerated-member :
      (i : Fin count) ->
      P (enumerate i)
    enumeration-complete :
      (T : Subset S) ->
      P T ->
      Exists (Fin count)
        (\ i -> SameSubset T (enumerate i))
    enumeration-injective :
      (i j : Fin count) ->
      SameSubset (enumerate i) (enumerate j) ->
      i == j

FiniteFamily :
  {S : Set} ->
  Family S ->
  Set1
FiniteFamily P =
  Exists Nat (\ count -> FamilyHasCardinality P count)

predecessor :
  Nat ->
  Nat
predecessor zero =
  zero
predecessor (suc n) =
  n

powerOfTwo :
  Nat ->
  Nat
powerOfTwo zero =
  suc zero
powerOfTwo (suc n) =
  suc (suc zero) * powerOfTwo n

putnam-1964-b2 : Set1
putnam-1964-b2 =
  (S : Set) ->
  (n : Nat) ->
  n != zero ->
  CarrierHasCardinality S n ->
  (P : Family S) ->
  ExtensionalFamily P ->
  FiniteFamily P ->
  PairwiseIntersecting P ->
  MaximalIntersecting P ->
  FamilyHasCardinality P (powerOfTwo (predecessor n))

(*
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench artifact putnam_1964_b2:
  a maximal pairwise-intersecting family of subsets of a nonempty finite set
  contains exactly half of all subsets. This file contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open arithmeticTheory pred_setTheory;

val putnam_1964_b2 =
  ``!(P : ('a set) set).
      FINITE (UNIV : 'a set) /\
      0 < CARD (UNIV : 'a set) /\
      FINITE P /\
      (!T U : 'a set.
         T IN P /\ U IN P
         ==>
         T INTER U <> {}) /\
      ~(?T : 'a set.
          T NOTIN P /\
          (!U : 'a set.
             U IN P
             ==>
             T INTER U <> {}))
      ==>
      CARD P = 2 EXP (CARD (UNIV : 'a set) - 1)``;

$(
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench artifact putnam_1964_b2:
  a maximal pairwise-intersecting family of subsets of a nonempty finite set
  contains exactly half of all subsets of that set. This file contains no proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  S ranges over nonempty finite sets, and P ranges over families of subsets
  of S. The first quantified condition says every two members of P intersect.
  The second says that no further subset of S can be added while retaining
  that property. The final declaration is the single unproved $a corpus
  statement; this database contains no $p proof statement.
$)

${
  $d P S T U $.

  putnambench-putnam-1964-b2 $a |- A. S e. Fin
    A. P e. ~P ( ~P S )
      (
        (
          S =/= (/)
          /\
          (
            (
              A. T e. P A. U e. P
                ( T i^i U ) =/= (/)
            )
            /\
            -. E. T e. ( ( ~P S ) \ P )
              A. U e. P ( T i^i U ) =/= (/)
          )
        )
        ->
        ( # ` P ) = ( 2 ^ ( ( # ` S ) - 1 ) )
      )
  $.
$}

title: putnam_1964_b2
content:
% Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench artifact putnam_1964_b2: every
% maximal pairwise-intersecting family of subsets of a nonempty finite set has
% exactly half of all its subsets. This file contains no proof.

putnam_1964_b2[Element: TYPE]: THEORY
BEGIN
  IMPORTING finite_sets[Element], finite_sets_of_sets[Element]

  element_set: TYPE = finite_set[Element]
  finite_family: TYPE = finite_set[element_set]

  subset_of(A, B: element_set): bool =
    FORALL (x: Element): A(x) IMPLIES B(x)

  intersects(A, B: element_set): bool =
    EXISTS (x: Element): A(x) AND B(x)

  family_on(P: finite_family, S: element_set): bool =
    FORALL (A: element_set):
      P(A) IMPLIES subset_of(A, S)

  pairwise_intersecting(P: finite_family): bool =
    FORALL (A, B: element_set):
      P(A) AND P(B) IMPLIES intersects(A, B)

  maximal_pairwise_intersecting(
      S: element_set,
      P: finite_family): bool =
    family_on(P, S)
      AND pairwise_intersecting(P)
      AND NOT
        (EXISTS (A: element_set):
          subset_of(A, S)
            AND NOT P(A)
            AND
              (FORALL (B: element_set):
                P(B) IMPLIES intersects(A, B)))

  putnam_1964_b2: bool =
    FORALL (S: element_set), (P: finite_family):
      card(S) > 0
        AND maximal_pairwise_intersecting(S, P)
      IMPLIES card(P) = 2 ^ (card(S) - 1)
END putnam_1964_b2

    (f : R -> R)

    : f @ (filter_from setT (fun N => [set n | (N <= n)%R])) --> 0.

(*

  convergence to zero at positive infinity of a continuous real function
  whose samples along every positive arithmetic ray converge to zero. This
  file contains no proof.
*)

let statement =
  `let continuous =
     \(f:real->real).
       !x e:real.
         &0 < e
         ==> ?d:real.
               &0 < d /\
               !y:real. abs (y - x) < d ==> abs (f y - f x) < e in
   let tends_seq_zero =
     \(u:num->real).
       !e:real.
         &0 < e
         ==> ?N:num. !n:num. N <= n ==> abs (u n) < e in
   let tends_at_posinfinity_zero =
     \(f:real->real).
       !e:real.
         &0 < e
         ==> ?B:real. !x:real. B <= x ==> abs (f x) < e in
   !f:real->real.
     continuous f /\
     (!alpha:real.
        &0 < alpha
        ==> tends_seq_zero (\n:num. f (&n * alpha)))
     ==> tends_at_posinfinity_zero f`;;

title: putnam_1964_b3
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1964_b3:
;; a continuous real-valued function that tends to zero along every positive
;; arithmetic ray n*alpha tends to zero as its real argument tends to infinity.
;; This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))

;; The scalar arguments present the Dedekind-complete ordered field of real
;; numbers. A tame APPLY$ object presents the arbitrary function. Continuity
;; and both limits use their epsilon characterizations, with every radius,
;; cutoff, and tail bound quantified internally.

(defun p1964b3-member-p (carrier x)
  (if (apply$ carrier (list x)) t nil))

(defun p1964b3-unary (operation x)
  (apply$ operation (list x)))

(defun p1964b3-binary (operation x y)
  (apply$ operation (list x y)))

(defun p1964b3-subtract (add negate x y)
  (p1964b3-binary add x (p1964b3-unary negate y)))

(defun p1964b3-less-equal-p (less x y)
  (not (apply$ less (list y x))))

(defun p1964b3-absolute (less negate zero x)
  (if (apply$ less (list x zero))
      (p1964b3-unary negate x)
    x))

(defun-sk p1964b3-field-laws-p
    (carrier zero one add multiply negate inverse)
  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (p1964b3-member-p carrier x)
      (p1964b3-member-p carrier y)
      (p1964b3-member-p carrier z))
     (and
      (p1964b3-member-p
       carrier (p1964b3-binary add x y))
      (p1964b3-member-p
       carrier (p1964b3-binary multiply x y))
      (p1964b3-member-p
       carrier (p1964b3-unary negate x))
      (implies
       (not (equal x zero))
       (p1964b3-member-p
        carrier (p1964b3-unary inverse x)))
      (equal
       (p1964b3-binary add
                       (p1964b3-binary add x y)
                       z)
       (p1964b3-binary add
                       x
                       (p1964b3-binary add y z)))
      (equal
       (p1964b3-binary add x y)
       (p1964b3-binary add y x))
      (equal (p1964b3-binary add x zero) x)
      (equal
       (p1964b3-binary add x (p1964b3-unary negate x))
       zero)
      (equal
       (p1964b3-binary multiply
                       (p1964b3-binary multiply x y)
                       z)
       (p1964b3-binary multiply
                       x
                       (p1964b3-binary multiply y z)))
      (equal
       (p1964b3-binary multiply x y)
       (p1964b3-binary multiply y x))
      (equal (p1964b3-binary multiply x one) x)
      (implies
       (not (equal x zero))
       (equal
        (p1964b3-binary
         multiply x (p1964b3-unary inverse x))
        one))
      (equal
       (p1964b3-binary
        multiply x (p1964b3-binary add y z))
       (p1964b3-binary
        add
        (p1964b3-binary multiply x y)
        (p1964b3-binary multiply x z)))))))

(defun-sk p1964b3-order-laws-p
    (carrier zero add multiply less)
  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (p1964b3-member-p carrier x)
      (p1964b3-member-p carrier y)
      (p1964b3-member-p carrier z))
     (and
      (not (apply$ less (list x x)))
      (or
       (equal x y)
       (apply$ less (list x y))
       (apply$ less (list y x)))
      (implies
       (and
        (apply$ less (list x y))
        (apply$ less (list y z)))
       (apply$ less (list x z)))
      (implies
       (apply$ less (list x y))
       (apply$
        less
        (list
         (p1964b3-binary add x z)
         (p1964b3-binary add y z))))
      (implies
       (and
        (apply$ less (list zero x))
        (apply$ less (list zero y)))
       (apply$
        less
        (list
         zero
         (p1964b3-binary multiply x y))))))))

(defun-sk p1964b3-set-nonempty-p (carrier set)
  (exists (x)
    (and
     (p1964b3-member-p carrier x)
     (apply$ set (list x)))))

(defun-sk p1964b3-upper-bound-p
    (carrier less set bound)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (and
      (p1964b3-member-p carrier x)
      (apply$ set (list x)))
     (p1964b3-less-equal-p less x bound))))

(defun-sk p1964b3-bounded-above-p
    (carrier less set)
  (exists (bound)
    (and
     (p1964b3-member-p carrier bound)
     (p1964b3-upper-bound-p
      carrier less set bound))))

(defun-sk p1964b3-supremum-p
    (carrier less set supremum)
  (forall (bound)
    (and
     (p1964b3-member-p carrier supremum)
     (p1964b3-upper-bound-p
      carrier less set supremum)
     (implies
      (and
       (p1964b3-member-p carrier bound)
       (p1964b3-upper-bound-p
        carrier less set bound))
      (p1964b3-less-equal-p
       less supremum bound)))))

(defun-sk p1964b3-has-supremum-p
    (carrier less set)
  (exists (supremum)
    (p1964b3-supremum-p
     carrier less set supremum)))

(defun-sk p1964b3-dedekind-complete-p
    (carrier less)
  (forall (set)
    (implies
     (and
      (tamep-functionp set)
      (p1964b3-set-nonempty-p carrier set)
      (p1964b3-bounded-above-p carrier less set))
     (p1964b3-has-supremum-p
      carrier less set))))

(defun p1964b3-real-field-p
    (carrier zero one add multiply negate inverse less)
  (and
   (tamep-functionp carrier)
   (tamep-functionp add)
   (tamep-functionp multiply)
   (tamep-functionp negate)
   (tamep-functionp inverse)
   (tamep-functionp less)
   (p1964b3-member-p carrier zero)
   (p1964b3-member-p carrier one)
   (not (equal zero one))
   (p1964b3-field-laws-p
    carrier zero one add multiply negate inverse)
   (p1964b3-order-laws-p
    carrier zero add multiply less)
   (apply$ less (list zero one))
   (p1964b3-dedekind-complete-p carrier less)))

(defun-sk p1964b3-real-function-p
    (carrier function)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (p1964b3-member-p carrier x)
     (p1964b3-member-p
      carrier (apply$ function (list x))))))

(defun p1964b3-positive-p
    (carrier zero less x)
  (and
   (p1964b3-member-p carrier x)
   (apply$ less (list zero x))))

;; Global epsilon-delta continuity on the real carrier.

(defun-sk p1964b3-continuity-neighborhood-p
    (carrier zero add negate less function x epsilon delta)
  (forall (y)
    (implies
     (and
      (p1964b3-member-p carrier y)
      (apply$
       less
       (list
        (p1964b3-absolute
         less negate zero
         (p1964b3-subtract add negate y x))
        delta)))
     (apply$
      less
      (list
       (p1964b3-absolute
        less negate zero
        (p1964b3-subtract
         add negate
         (apply$ function (list y))
         (apply$ function (list x))))
       epsilon)))))

(defun-sk p1964b3-continuity-radius-exists-p
    (carrier zero add negate less function x epsilon)
  (exists (delta)
    (and
     (p1964b3-positive-p carrier zero less delta)
     (p1964b3-continuity-neighborhood-p
      carrier zero add negate less
      function x epsilon delta))))

(defun-sk p1964b3-continuous-at-p
    (carrier zero add negate less function x)
  (forall (epsilon)
    (implies
     (p1964b3-positive-p
      carrier zero less epsilon)
     (p1964b3-continuity-radius-exists-p
      carrier zero add negate less
      function x epsilon))))

(defun-sk p1964b3-continuous-p
    (carrier zero add negate less function)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (p1964b3-member-p carrier x)
     (p1964b3-continuous-at-p
      carrier zero add negate less function x))))

;; Repeated addition is the ordered-field value of the natural multiple
;; n*alpha appearing in each arithmetic ray.

(defun p1964b3-natural-multiple
    (n alpha zero add)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix n)))
  (if (zp n)
      zero
    (p1964b3-binary
     add
     alpha
     (p1964b3-natural-multiple
      (- n 1) alpha zero add))))

(defun-sk p1964b3-ray-tail-p
    (zero add negate less function alpha epsilon cutoff)
  (forall (n)
    (implies
     (and
      (natp n)
      (<= cutoff n))
     (apply$
      less
      (list
       (p1964b3-absolute
        less negate zero
        (p1964b3-subtract
         add negate
         (apply$
          function
          (list
           (p1964b3-natural-multiple
            n alpha zero add)))
         zero))
       epsilon)))))

(defun-sk p1964b3-ray-cutoff-exists-p
    (zero add negate less function alpha epsilon)
  (exists (cutoff)
    (and
     (natp cutoff)
     (p1964b3-ray-tail-p
      zero add negate less
      function alpha epsilon cutoff))))

(defun-sk p1964b3-ray-converges-to-zero-p
    (carrier zero add negate less function alpha)
  (forall (epsilon)
    (implies
     (p1964b3-positive-p
      carrier zero less epsilon)
     (p1964b3-ray-cutoff-exists-p
      zero add negate less
      function alpha epsilon))))

(defun-sk p1964b3-all-positive-rays-converge-p
    (carrier zero add negate less function)
  (forall (alpha)
    (implies
     (p1964b3-positive-p
      carrier zero less alpha)
     (p1964b3-ray-converges-to-zero-p
      carrier zero add negate less
      function alpha))))

;; Epsilon-tail convergence of f(x) to zero as x tends to +infinity in R.

(defun-sk p1964b3-real-tail-p
    (carrier zero add negate less function epsilon bound)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (and
      (p1964b3-member-p carrier x)
      (p1964b3-less-equal-p less bound x))
     (apply$
      less
      (list
       (p1964b3-absolute
        less negate zero
        (p1964b3-subtract
         add negate
         (apply$ function (list x))
         zero))
       epsilon)))))

-- Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1964_b3:
-- a continuous real function that tends to zero along every positive arithmetic
-- ray n * alpha tends to zero at positive infinity. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; _*_)

infix 4 _!=_ _<=N_
infixr 3 _and_
infixr 2 _or_

data Bottom : Set where

Not : Set -> Set
Not A = A -> Bottom

_!=_ : {A : Set} -> A -> A -> Set
x != y = Not (x == y)

record _and_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data _or_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  left  : A -> A or B
  right : B -> A or B

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

data _<=N_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set where
  zero<=   : {n : Nat} -> zero <=N n
  suc<=suc : {m n : Nat} -> m <=N n -> suc m <=N suc n

record CompleteOrderedField (R : Set) : Set1 where
  field
    zeroR oneR : R
    add multiply : R -> R -> R
    negate inverse : R -> R
    lessOrEqual : R -> R -> Set
    fromNat : Nat -> R

    one-not-zero :
      oneR != zeroR

    add-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> add x y == add y x
    add-associative :
      (x y z : R) -> add (add x y) z == add x (add y z)
    add-zero :
      (x : R) -> add x zeroR == x
    add-inverse :
      (x : R) -> add x (negate x) == zeroR

    multiply-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> multiply x y == multiply y x
    multiply-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply (multiply x y) z == multiply x (multiply y z)
    multiply-one :
      (x : R) -> multiply x oneR == x
    multiply-zero :
      (x : R) -> multiply x zeroR == zeroR
    distribute :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply x (add y z) ==
      add (multiply x y) (multiply x z)
    inverse-zero :
      inverse zeroR == zeroR
    multiply-inverse :
      (x : R) ->
      x != zeroR ->
      multiply x (inverse x) == oneR

    order-reflexive :
      (x : R) -> lessOrEqual x x
    order-transitive :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y z ->
      lessOrEqual x z
    order-antisymmetric :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y x ->
      x == y
    order-total :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y or lessOrEqual y x
    add-order :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual (add z x) (add z y)
    multiply-nonnegative :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR x ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR y ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR (multiply x y)
    zero-less-than-one :
      lessOrEqual zeroR oneR and zeroR != oneR

    fromNat-zero :
      fromNat zero == zeroR
    fromNat-successor :
      (n : Nat) -> fromNat (suc n) == add (fromNat n) oneR
    fromNat-addition :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m + n) == add (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-multiplication :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m * n) == multiply (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-injective :
      (m n : Nat) -> fromNat m == fromNat n -> m == n

    archimedean :
      (x : R) ->
      Exists Nat (\ n -> lessOrEqual x (fromNat n))
    least-upper-bound :
      (P : R -> Set) ->
      Exists R P ->
      Exists R
        (\ upper ->
          (x : R) -> P x -> lessOrEqual x upper) ->
      Exists R
        (\ supremum ->
          ((x : R) -> P x -> lessOrEqual x supremum)
          and
          ((upper : R) ->
            ((x : R) -> P x -> lessOrEqual x upper) ->
            lessOrEqual supremum upper))

open CompleteOrderedField

subtract :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
subtract reals x y =
  add reals x (negate reals y)

StrictLess :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
StrictLess reals x y =
  lessOrEqual reals x y and x != y

CloseTo :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
CloseTo reals center radius x =
  StrictLess reals (subtract reals center radius) x
  and
  StrictLess reals x (add reals center radius)

ContinuousAt :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  (R -> R) ->
  R ->
  Set
ContinuousAt {R} reals function point =
  (epsilon : R) ->
  StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) epsilon ->
  Exists R
    (\ delta ->
      StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) delta
      and
      ((x : R) ->
        CloseTo reals point delta x ->
        CloseTo reals (function point) epsilon (function x)))

Continuous :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  (R -> R) ->
  Set
Continuous {R} reals function =
  (point : R) ->
  ContinuousAt reals function point

SequentialLimit :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  R ->
  Set
SequentialLimit {R} reals sequence limit =
  (epsilon : R) ->
  StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) epsilon ->
  Exists Nat
    (\ cutoff ->
      (n : Nat) ->
      cutoff <=N n ->
      CloseTo reals limit epsilon (sequence n))

LimitAtPositiveInfinity :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  (R -> R) ->
  R ->
  Set
LimitAtPositiveInfinity {R} reals function limit =
  (epsilon : R) ->
  StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) epsilon ->
  Exists R
    (\ cutoff ->
      (x : R) ->
      lessOrEqual reals cutoff x ->
      CloseTo reals limit epsilon (function x))

putnam-1964-b3 : Set1
putnam-1964-b3 =
  (R : Set) ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) ->
  (f : R -> R) ->
  Continuous reals f ->
  ((alpha : R) ->
    StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) alpha ->
    SequentialLimit reals
      (\ n ->
        f (multiply reals (fromNat reals n) alpha))
      (zeroR reals)) ->
  LimitAtPositiveInfinity reals f (zeroR reals)

title: putnam_1964_b3
content:
% Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench artifact putnam_1964_b3:
% a continuous real function that tends to zero along every positive
% arithmetic ray n * alpha tends to zero as its input tends to positive
% infinity. This file contains no proof.

putnam_1964_b3: THEORY
BEGIN
  real_function: TYPE = [real -> real]

  continuous(f: real_function): bool =
    FORALL (x: real), (epsilon_value: posreal):
      EXISTS (delta: posreal):
        FORALL (y: real):
          abs(y - x) < delta IMPLIES
            abs(f(y) - f(x)) < epsilon_value

  sampled_tends_to_zero(
      f: real_function,
      alpha: posreal): bool =
    FORALL (epsilon_value: posreal):
      EXISTS (cutoff: nat):
        FORALL (n: nat):
          cutoff <= n IMPLIES
            abs(f((n :: real) * alpha)) < epsilon_value

  tends_to_zero_at_positive_infinity(f: real_function): bool =
    FORALL (epsilon_value: posreal):
      EXISTS (threshold: real):
        FORALL (x: real):
          threshold <= x IMPLIES
            abs(f(x)) < epsilon_value

  putnam_1964_b3: bool =
    FORALL (f: real_function):
      (continuous(f)
        AND FORALL (alpha: posreal):
          sampled_tends_to_zero(f, alpha))
      IMPLIES tends_to_zero_at_positive_infinity(f)
END putnam_1964_b3

title: putnam_1964_b4

import Mathlib

open Classical
open scoped InnerProductSpace

abbrev putnam_1964_b4_solution : ℕ → ℕ :=
  fun n => n ^ 2 - n + 2

/--
$n$ great circles on the sphere are in general position (in other words at most two circles pass through any two points on the sphere). How many regions do they divide the sphere into?
-/
theorem putnam_1964_b4
    {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n)
    -- `C` is a collection of `n` great circles on the sphere, i.e a collection of sets
    (C : Fin n → Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3)))
    --together with a collection of `n` normal vectors `v`
    (v : Fin n → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3))
    -- A great circle `C` is the intersection of a plane `{x | x · v = 0}` with `S`
    (hv : ∀ i, C i = Metric.sphere 0 1 ∩ {x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3) | ⟪v i, x⟫_ℝ = 0 })
    --all the `v_i`'s are non-zero
    (hv' : ∀ i, v i ≠ 0)
    (hCinj : Function.Injective C)
    -- The circles in `C` are in general position
    (hT₂ : ∀ᵉ (x ∈ Metric.sphere 0 1) (y ∈ Metric.sphere 0 1),
      (Finset.univ.filter (fun i => {x, y} ⊆ (C i))).card ≤ 2)
    -- The predicate that a set `R ⊆ ℝ³` is a region bounded by the collection of circles
    (IsRegion : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3)) → Prop)
    -- We can determine the points `x` in such a region by looking at the sign of their dot product
    -- with `n i` for `i : Fin n`
    (IsRegion_def : ∀ R, IsRegion R ↔ R.Nonempty ∧ ∃ sign : Fin n → SignType, (∀ i, sign i ≠ 0) ∧
      R = Metric.sphere 0 1 ∩ {x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3) | ∀ i, signHom ⟪v i, x⟫_ℝ = sign i}) :
    {R | IsRegion R}.ncard = putnam_1964_b4_solution n :=
  sorry

title: putnam_1964_b4
content:
(* Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench artifact putnam_1964_b4:
   counting the regions cut on the unit sphere by great circles in general
   position. This file contains no proof. *)

From Stdlib Require Import Vectors.Fin Reals Ensembles Finite_sets List.

Open Scope R_scope.

Record putnam_1964_b4_point : Type := {
  putnam_1964_b4_x : R;
  putnam_1964_b4_y : R;
  putnam_1964_b4_z : R
}.

Definition putnam_1964_b4_point_set : Type :=
  putnam_1964_b4_point -> Prop.

Definition putnam_1964_b4_zero : putnam_1964_b4_point :=
  {| putnam_1964_b4_x := 0;
     putnam_1964_b4_y := 0;
     putnam_1964_b4_z := 0 |}.

Definition putnam_1964_b4_dot
    (u w : putnam_1964_b4_point) : R :=
  putnam_1964_b4_x u * putnam_1964_b4_x w +
  putnam_1964_b4_y u * putnam_1964_b4_y w +
  putnam_1964_b4_z u * putnam_1964_b4_z w.

Definition putnam_1964_b4_sphere : putnam_1964_b4_point_set :=
  fun p : putnam_1964_b4_point =>
    putnam_1964_b4_dot p p = 1.

Definition putnam_1964_b4_same_set
    (A B : putnam_1964_b4_point_set) : Prop :=
  forall p : putnam_1964_b4_point, A p <-> B p.

Definition putnam_1964_b4_intersection
    (A B : putnam_1964_b4_point_set) : putnam_1964_b4_point_set :=
  fun p : putnam_1964_b4_point => A p /\ B p.

Inductive putnam_1964_b4_sign : Type :=
| putnam_1964_b4_negative
| putnam_1964_b4_zero_sign
| putnam_1964_b4_positive.

Definition putnam_1964_b4_sign_of_real
    (r : R) : putnam_1964_b4_sign :=
  if Rlt_dec r 0 then
    putnam_1964_b4_negative
  else if Rlt_dec 0 r then
    putnam_1964_b4_positive
  else
    putnam_1964_b4_zero_sign.

Definition putnam_1964_b4_circle_indices
    {n : nat}
    (C : Fin.t n -> putnam_1964_b4_point_set)
    (p q : putnam_1964_b4_point) : Ensemble (Fin.t n) :=
  fun i : Fin.t n => C i p /\ C i q.

Fixpoint putnam_1964_b4_no_duplicate_sets
    (sets : list putnam_1964_b4_point_set) : Prop :=
  match sets with
  | nil => True
  | first :: rest =>
      (forall other : putnam_1964_b4_point_set,
        List.In other rest ->
        ~ putnam_1964_b4_same_set first other) /\
      putnam_1964_b4_no_duplicate_sets rest
  end.

Definition putnam_1964_b4_has_cardinality
    (collection : putnam_1964_b4_point_set -> Prop)
    (size : nat) : Prop :=
  exists representatives : list putnam_1964_b4_point_set,
    List.length representatives = size /\
    putnam_1964_b4_no_duplicate_sets representatives /\
    forall region : putnam_1964_b4_point_set,
      collection region <->
      exists representative : putnam_1964_b4_point_set,
        List.In representative representatives /\
        putnam_1964_b4_same_set region representative.

Definition putnam_1964_b4_solution (n : nat) : nat :=
  (n * n - n + 2)%nat.

Theorem putnam_1964_b4
    {n : nat}
    (hn : (0 < n)%nat)
    (C : Fin.t n -> putnam_1964_b4_point_set)
    (v : Fin.t n -> putnam_1964_b4_point)
    (hv :
      forall i : Fin.t n,
        putnam_1964_b4_same_set
          (C i)
          (putnam_1964_b4_intersection
            putnam_1964_b4_sphere
            (fun p : putnam_1964_b4_point =>
              putnam_1964_b4_dot (v i) p = 0)))
    (hv_nonzero :
      forall i : Fin.t n, v i <> putnam_1964_b4_zero)
    (hC_injective :
      forall i j : Fin.t n,
        putnam_1964_b4_same_set (C i) (C j) ->
        i = j)
    (h_general_position :
      forall p q : putnam_1964_b4_point,
        putnam_1964_b4_sphere p ->
        putnam_1964_b4_sphere q ->
        exists k : nat,
          cardinal
            (Fin.t n)
            (putnam_1964_b4_circle_indices C p q)
            k /\
          (k <= 2)%nat)
    (IsRegion : putnam_1964_b4_point_set -> Prop)
    (IsRegion_def :
      forall region : putnam_1964_b4_point_set,
        IsRegion region <->
        (exists p : putnam_1964_b4_point, region p) /\
        exists sign : Fin.t n -> putnam_1964_b4_sign,
          (forall i : Fin.t n,
            sign i <> putnam_1964_b4_zero_sign) /\
          putnam_1964_b4_same_set
            region
            (putnam_1964_b4_intersection
              putnam_1964_b4_sphere
              (fun p : putnam_1964_b4_point =>
                forall i : Fin.t n,
                  putnam_1964_b4_sign_of_real
                    (putnam_1964_b4_dot (v i) p) =
                  sign i))) :
  putnam_1964_b4_has_cardinality
    (fun region : putnam_1964_b4_point_set => IsRegion region)
    (putnam_1964_b4_solution n).
Admitted.

title: putnam_1964_b4
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench artifact putnam_1964_b4, concerning
  the number of regions cut from the unit sphere by great circles in general
  position. This file contains no proof.
*)

theory putnam_1964_b4
  imports Complex_Main
begin

type_synonym putnam_1964_b4_point = "real \<times> real \<times> real"

definition putnam_1964_b4_dot ::
    "putnam_1964_b4_point \<Rightarrow> putnam_1964_b4_point \<Rightarrow> real" where
  "putnam_1964_b4_dot p q =
    fst p * fst q +
    fst (snd p) * fst (snd q) +
    snd (snd p) * snd (snd q)"

definition putnam_1964_b4_sphere :: "putnam_1964_b4_point set" where
  "putnam_1964_b4_sphere =
    {p. putnam_1964_b4_dot p p = 1}"

definition putnam_1964_b4_solution :: "nat \<Rightarrow> nat" where
  "putnam_1964_b4_solution = (\<lambda>n. n ^ 2 - n + 2)"

theorem putnam_1964_b4:
  fixes n :: nat
    and C :: "nat \<Rightarrow> putnam_1964_b4_point set"
    and v :: "nat \<Rightarrow> putnam_1964_b4_point"
    and IsRegion :: "putnam_1964_b4_point set \<Rightarrow> bool"
  assumes hn: "0 < n"
    and hv: "\<forall>i<n. C i =
      putnam_1964_b4_sphere \<inter>
        {x. putnam_1964_b4_dot (v i) x = 0}"
    and hv_nonzero: "\<forall>i<n. v i \<noteq> (0, 0, 0)"
    and hCinj: "\<forall>i<n. \<forall>j<n. C i = C j \<longrightarrow> i = j"
    and hT2: "\<forall>x\<in>putnam_1964_b4_sphere.
      \<forall>y\<in>putnam_1964_b4_sphere.
        card {i :: nat. i < n \<and> {x, y} \<subseteq> C i} \<le> 2"
    and IsRegion_def: "\<forall>R. IsRegion R \<longleftrightarrow>
      R \<noteq> {} \<and>
      (\<exists>sign :: nat \<Rightarrow> real.
        (\<forall>i<n. sign i \<noteq> 0) \<and>
        R = putnam_1964_b4_sphere \<inter>
          {x. \<forall>i<n.
            sgn (putnam_1964_b4_dot (v i) x) = sign i})"
  shows "card {R :: putnam_1964_b4_point set. IsRegion R} =
    putnam_1964_b4_solution n"
  sorry

end

title: putnam_1964_b4
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench artifact putnam_1964_b4:
  the number of regions cut from the unit sphere by distinct great circles
  in general position, described by their nonzero dot-product sign patterns.
  This file contains no proof.
*)

let statement =
  `!n:num.
   !C:num->(real#(real#real))->bool.
   !v:num->real#(real#real).
   !IsRegion:((real#(real#real))->bool)->bool.
     let dot =
       \p:real#(real#real).
       \q:real#(real#real).
         FST p * FST q +
         FST (SND p) * FST (SND q) +
         SND (SND p) * SND (SND q) in
     let sphere = {x:real#(real#real) | dot x x = &1} in
     0 < n /\
     (!i:num.
        i < n
        ==> C i = sphere INTER {x | dot (v i) x = &0}) /\
     (!i:num. i < n ==> ~(v i = (&0,(&0,&0)))) /\
     (!i j:num.
        i < n /\ j < n /\ C i = C j
        ==> i = j) /\
     (!x y:real#(real#real).
        x IN sphere /\ y IN sphere
        ==> CARD {i:num |
                    i < n /\ x IN C i /\ y IN C i} <= 2) /\
     (!R:(real#(real#real))->bool.
        IsRegion R <=>
        ~(R = {}) /\
        ?sign:num->bool.
          R =
          sphere INTER
          {x | !i:num.
                 i < n
                 ==> (if sign i
                      then &0 < dot (v i) x
                      else dot (v i) x < &0)})
     ==> CARD {R:(real#(real#real))->bool | IsRegion R} =
         n EXP 2 - n + 2`;;

title: putnam_1964_b4
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench artifact putnam_1964_b4:
;; the number of spherical regions cut out by finitely many great circles in
;; general position is n^2-n+2. This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))

;; A duplicate-free family of great circles is represented by a true list of
;; nonzero normal vectors. Two normals define the same great circle exactly
;; when they are parallel, and three great circles have a common antipodal
;; pair exactly when their normals have zero determinant. Thus the pairwise
;; nonparallel and nonzero-determinant tests below are the source injectivity
;; and general-position assumptions.
;;
;; The source definition of IsRegion identifies its nonempty regions
;; bijectively with sign vectors for which some point has all prescribed
;; nonzero dot-product signs. A nonzero point with those signs can be
;; normalized onto the unit sphere, so feasibility is exactly feasibility of
;; the corresponding strict homogeneous linear inequalities.
;; Fourier-Motzkin elimination decides that feasibility without bounding or
;; sampling the sphere, and the recursive two-way branch ranges over every
;; sign vector.
;;
;; ACL2 evaluates the displayed vectors over the rationals. This is
;; bidirectionally equivalent to the real statement under general position:
;; every rational instance is real, while any finite real normal family can
;; be approximated by rational normals without changing its nonzero cross
;; products, determinant signs, oriented matroid, or feasible sign vectors.
;; Hence neither the real domain nor the arbitrary circle family is narrowed
;; by this representation.

(defun putnam-1964-b4-rational-vector3-p (vector)
  (and (true-listp vector)
       (equal (len vector) 3)
       (rationalp (nth 0 vector))
       (rationalp (nth 1 vector))
       (rationalp (nth 2 vector))))

(defun putnam-1964-b4-vector-list-p (vectors)
  (if (consp vectors)
      (and (putnam-1964-b4-rational-vector3-p (car vectors))
           (putnam-1964-b4-vector-list-p (cdr vectors)))
    (equal vectors nil)))

(defun putnam-1964-b4-zero-vector-p (vector)
  (and (equal (nth 0 vector) 0)
       (equal (nth 1 vector) 0)
       (equal (nth 2 vector) 0)))

(defun putnam-1964-b4-all-nonzero-p (vectors)
  (if (consp vectors)
      (and (not (putnam-1964-b4-zero-vector-p (car vectors)))
           (putnam-1964-b4-all-nonzero-p (cdr vectors)))
    t))

(defun putnam-1964-b4-cross-product (left right)
  (list
   (- (* (nth 1 left) (nth 2 right))
      (* (nth 2 left) (nth 1 right)))
   (- (* (nth 2 left) (nth 0 right))
      (* (nth 0 left) (nth 2 right)))
   (- (* (nth 0 left) (nth 1 right))
      (* (nth 1 left) (nth 0 right)))))

(defun putnam-1964-b4-nonparallel-with-p (vector remaining)
  (if (consp remaining)
      (and
       (not
        (putnam-1964-b4-zero-vector-p
         (putnam-1964-b4-cross-product vector (car remaining))))
       (putnam-1964-b4-nonparallel-with-p
        vector (cdr remaining)))
    t))

(defun putnam-1964-b4-pairwise-nonparallel-p (vectors)
  (if (consp vectors)
      (and
       (putnam-1964-b4-nonparallel-with-p
        (car vectors) (cdr vectors))
       (putnam-1964-b4-pairwise-nonparallel-p (cdr vectors)))
    t))

(defun putnam-1964-b4-determinant3 (first second third)
  (+
   (* (nth 0 first)
      (- (* (nth 1 second) (nth 2 third))
         (* (nth 2 second) (nth 1 third))))
   (-
    (* (nth 1 first)
       (- (* (nth 0 second) (nth 2 third))
          (* (nth 2 second) (nth 0 third)))))
   (* (nth 2 first)
      (- (* (nth 0 second) (nth 1 third))
         (* (nth 1 second) (nth 0 third))))))

(defun putnam-1964-b4-independent-with-third-p
    (first second remaining)
  (if (consp remaining)
      (and
       (not
        (equal
         (putnam-1964-b4-determinant3
          first second (car remaining))
         0))
       (putnam-1964-b4-independent-with-third-p
        first second (cdr remaining)))
    t))

(defun putnam-1964-b4-independent-with-pairs-p
    (first remaining)
  (if (consp remaining)
      (and
       (putnam-1964-b4-independent-with-third-p
        first (car remaining) (cdr remaining))
       (putnam-1964-b4-independent-with-pairs-p
        first (cdr remaining)))
    t))

(defun putnam-1964-b4-general-position-p (vectors)
  (if (consp vectors)
      (and
       (putnam-1964-b4-independent-with-pairs-p
        (car vectors) (cdr vectors))
       (putnam-1964-b4-general-position-p (cdr vectors)))
    t))

(defun putnam-1964-b4-vector-negate (vector)
  (if (consp vector)
      (cons (- (car vector))
            (putnam-1964-b4-vector-negate (cdr vector)))
    nil))

;; For inequalities
;;
;;   p*x + P > 0,  with p > 0,
;;   n*x + N > 0,  with n < 0,
;;
;; eliminating x gives p*N - n*P > 0.
(defun putnam-1964-b4-fm-combine-tails
    (positive-leading negative-tail negative-leading positive-tail)
  (if (and (consp negative-tail) (consp positive-tail))
      (cons
       (- (* positive-leading (car negative-tail))
          (* negative-leading (car positive-tail)))
       (putnam-1964-b4-fm-combine-tails
        positive-leading
        (cdr negative-tail)
        negative-leading
        (cdr positive-tail)))
    nil))

(defun putnam-1964-b4-fm-positive-inequalities (inequalities)
  (if (consp inequalities)
      (if (< 0 (caar inequalities))
          (cons (car inequalities)
                (putnam-1964-b4-fm-positive-inequalities
                 (cdr inequalities)))
        (putnam-1964-b4-fm-positive-inequalities
         (cdr inequalities)))
    nil))

(defun putnam-1964-b4-fm-negative-inequalities (inequalities)
  (if (consp inequalities)
      (if (< (caar inequalities) 0)
          (cons (car inequalities)
                (putnam-1964-b4-fm-negative-inequalities
                 (cdr inequalities)))
        (putnam-1964-b4-fm-negative-inequalities
         (cdr inequalities)))
    nil))

(defun putnam-1964-b4-fm-zero-tails (inequalities)
  (if (consp inequalities)
      (if (equal (caar inequalities) 0)
          (cons (cdar inequalities)
                (putnam-1964-b4-fm-zero-tails
                 (cdr inequalities)))
        (putnam-1964-b4-fm-zero-tails
         (cdr inequalities)))
    nil))

(defun putnam-1964-b4-fm-combine-with-negatives
    (positive negatives)
  (if (consp negatives)
      (cons
       (putnam-1964-b4-fm-combine-tails
        (car positive)
        (cdar negatives)
        (caar negatives)
        (cdr positive))
       (putnam-1964-b4-fm-combine-with-negatives
        positive (cdr negatives)))
    nil))

(defun putnam-1964-b4-fm-combine-all
    (positives negatives)
  (if (consp positives)
      (append
       (putnam-1964-b4-fm-combine-with-negatives
        (car positives) negatives)
       (putnam-1964-b4-fm-combine-all
        (cdr positives) negatives))
    nil))

(defun putnam-1964-b4-fm-eliminate-first (inequalities)
  (let ((positives
         (putnam-1964-b4-fm-positive-inequalities inequalities))
        (negatives
         (putnam-1964-b4-fm-negative-inequalities inequalities)))
    (append
     (putnam-1964-b4-fm-zero-tails inequalities)
     (putnam-1964-b4-fm-combine-all positives negatives))))

(defun putnam-1964-b4-strict-system-feasible-p
    (inequalities dimensions)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix dimensions)))
  (if (zp dimensions)
      (endp inequalities)
    (putnam-1964-b4-strict-system-feasible-p
     (putnam-1964-b4-fm-eliminate-first inequalities)
     (- dimensions 1))))

(defun putnam-1964-b4-count-feasible-signs
    (remaining signed-normals)
  (declare (xargs :measure (len remaining)))
  (if (consp remaining)
      (+
       (putnam-1964-b4-count-feasible-signs
        (cdr remaining)
        (cons (car remaining) signed-normals))
       (putnam-1964-b4-count-feasible-signs
        (cdr remaining)
        (cons
         (putnam-1964-b4-vector-negate (car remaining))
         signed-normals)))
    (if
        (putnam-1964-b4-strict-system-feasible-p
         signed-normals 3)
        1
      0)))

(defun putnambench-putnam-1964-b4-statement (normals)
  (implies
   (and
    (true-listp normals)
    (consp normals)
    (putnam-1964-b4-vector-list-p normals)
    (putnam-1964-b4-all-nonzero-p normals)
    (putnam-1964-b4-pairwise-nonparallel-p normals)
    (putnam-1964-b4-general-position-p normals))
   (let ((n (len normals)))
     (equal
      (putnam-1964-b4-count-feasible-signs normals nil)
      (+ (- (* n n) n) 2)))))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

title: putnam_1964_b4
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1964_b4:
-- n great circles in general position divide the unit sphere into
-- n squared minus n plus two regions. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; _-_; _*_)

infix 4 _!=_ _<=N_
infixr 3 _and_
infixr 2 _or_

data Bottom : Set where

Not : Set -> Set
Not A =
  A -> Bottom

_!=_ : {A : Set} -> A -> A -> Set
x != y =
  Not (x == y)

record _and_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data _or_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  left  : A -> A or B
  right : B -> A or B

record Iff (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor iff
  field
    forward  : A -> B
    backward : B -> A

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

data _<=N_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set where
  zero<=N   : {n : Nat} -> zero <=N n
  suc<=sucN : {m n : Nat} -> m <=N n -> suc m <=N suc n

NatStrictLess : Nat -> Nat -> Set
NatStrictLess m n =
  suc m <=N n

data Fin : Nat -> Set where
  fzero : {n : Nat} -> Fin (suc n)
  fsuc  : {n : Nat} -> Fin n -> Fin (suc n)

record CompleteOrderedField (R : Set) : Set1 where
  field
    zeroR oneR : R
    add multiply : R -> R -> R
    negate inverse : R -> R
    lessOrEqual : R -> R -> Set
    fromNat : Nat -> R

    one-not-zero :
      oneR != zeroR

    add-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> add x y == add y x
    add-associative :
      (x y z : R) -> add (add x y) z == add x (add y z)
    add-zero :
      (x : R) -> add x zeroR == x
    add-inverse :
      (x : R) -> add x (negate x) == zeroR

    multiply-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> multiply x y == multiply y x
    multiply-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply (multiply x y) z == multiply x (multiply y z)
    multiply-one :
      (x : R) -> multiply x oneR == x
    multiply-zero :
      (x : R) -> multiply x zeroR == zeroR
    distribute :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply x (add y z) ==
      add (multiply x y) (multiply x z)
    inverse-zero :
      inverse zeroR == zeroR
    multiply-inverse :
      (x : R) ->
      x != zeroR ->
      multiply x (inverse x) == oneR

    order-reflexive :
      (x : R) -> lessOrEqual x x
    order-transitive :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y z ->
      lessOrEqual x z
    order-antisymmetric :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y x ->
      x == y
    order-total :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y or lessOrEqual y x
    add-order :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual (add z x) (add z y)
    multiply-nonnegative :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR x ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR y ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR (multiply x y)
    zero-less-than-one :
      lessOrEqual zeroR oneR and zeroR != oneR

    fromNat-zero :
      fromNat zero == zeroR
    fromNat-successor :
      (n : Nat) -> fromNat (suc n) == add (fromNat n) oneR
    fromNat-addition :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m + n) == add (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-multiplication :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m * n) == multiply (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-injective :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat m == fromNat n ->
      m == n

    archimedean :
      (x : R) ->
      Exists Nat (\ n -> lessOrEqual x (fromNat n))
    least-upper-bound :
      (P : R -> Set) ->
      Exists R P ->
      Exists R
        (\ upper ->
          (x : R) ->
          P x ->
          lessOrEqual x upper) ->
      Exists R
        (\ supremum ->
          ((x : R) ->
            P x ->
            lessOrEqual x supremum)
          and
          ((upper : R) ->
            ((x : R) ->
              P x ->
              lessOrEqual x upper) ->
            lessOrEqual supremum upper))

open CompleteOrderedField

StrictLess :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
StrictLess reals x y =
  lessOrEqual reals x y and x != y

three : Nat
three =
  suc (suc (suc zero))

two : Nat
two =
  suc (suc zero)

Point :
  Set ->
  Set
Point R =
  Fin three -> R

Subset :
  Set ->
  Set1
Subset A =
  A -> Set

record SetEqual
  {A : Set}
  (S T : Subset A) :
  Set where

  constructor same-set
  field
    membership :
      (x : A) ->
      Iff (S x) (T x)

Intersection :
  {A : Set} ->
  Subset A ->
  Subset A ->
  Subset A
Intersection S T x =
  S x and T x

Nonempty :
  {A : Set} ->
  Subset A ->
  Set
Nonempty S =
  Exists _ S

VectorEqual :
  {R : Set} ->
  Point R ->
  Point R ->
  Set
VectorEqual u v =
  (i : Fin three) ->
  u i == v i

ZeroVector :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  Point R
ZeroVector reals i =
  zeroR reals

VectorNonzero :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  Point R ->
  Set
VectorNonzero reals v =
  Not (VectorEqual v (ZeroVector reals))

dot :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  Point R ->
  Point R ->
  R
dot reals u v =
  add reals
    (multiply reals (u fzero) (v fzero))
    (add reals
      (multiply reals (u (fsuc fzero)) (v (fsuc fzero)))
      (multiply reals
        (u (fsuc (fsuc fzero)))
        (v (fsuc (fsuc fzero)))))

Sphere :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  Subset (Point R)
Sphere reals x =
  dot reals x x == oneR reals

data Sign : Set where
  negative zeroSign positive : Sign

SignNonzero :
  Sign ->
  Set
SignNonzero sign =
  sign != zeroSign

SignOf :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  Sign ->
  Set
SignOf reals x negative =
  StrictLess reals x (zeroR reals)
SignOf reals x zeroSign =
  x == zeroR reals
SignOf reals x positive =
  StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) x

CircleFromNormal :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  Point R ->
  Subset (Point R)
CircleFromNormal reals normal x =
  Sphere reals x and dot reals normal x == zeroR reals

CircleFamilyInjective :
  {R : Set} ->
  {n : Nat} ->
  (Fin n -> Subset (Point R)) ->
  Set
CircleFamilyInjective C =
  (i j : _) ->
  SetEqual (C i) (C j) ->
  i == j

CirclesThroughPair :
  {R : Set} ->
  {n : Nat} ->
  (Fin n -> Subset (Point R)) ->
  Point R ->
  Point R ->
  Fin n ->
  Set
CirclesThroughPair C x y i =
  C i x and C i y

AtMostTwo :
  {A : Set} ->
  (A -> Set) ->
  Set
AtMostTwo P =
  (i j k : _) ->
  P i ->
  P j ->
  P k ->
  (i == j) or ((i == k) or (j == k))

GeneralPosition :
  {R : Set} ->
  {n : Nat} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  (Fin n -> Subset (Point R)) ->
  Set
GeneralPosition reals C =
  (x y : Point _) ->
  Sphere reals x ->
  Sphere reals y ->
  AtMostTwo (CirclesThroughPair C x y)

RegionForSigns :
  {R : Set} ->
  {n : Nat} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  (Fin n -> Point R) ->
  (Fin n -> Sign) ->
  Subset (Point R)
RegionForSigns reals normals signs x =
  Sphere reals x
  and
  ((i : _) ->
    SignOf reals (dot reals (normals i) x) (signs i))

RegionsCharacterizedBySigns :
  {R : Set} ->
  {n : Nat} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  (Fin n -> Point R) ->
  (Subset (Point R) -> Set) ->
  Set1
RegionsCharacterizedBySigns reals normals IsRegion =
  (region : Subset _) ->
  Iff
    (IsRegion region)
    (Nonempty region
    and
    Exists (Fin _ -> Sign)
      (\ signs ->
        ((i : _) -> SignNonzero (signs i))
        and
        SetEqual region (RegionForSigns reals normals signs)))

record RegionHasCardinality
  {A : Set}
  (IsRegion : Subset A -> Set)
  (count : Nat) :
  Set1 where

  field
    enumerate :
      Fin count -> Subset A
    enumerated-region :
      (i : Fin count) ->
      IsRegion (enumerate i)
    enumeration-complete :
      (region : Subset A) ->
      IsRegion region ->
      Exists (Fin count)
        (\ i -> SetEqual region (enumerate i))
    enumeration-injective :
      (i j : Fin count) ->
      SetEqual (enumerate i) (enumerate j) ->
      i == j

putnam-1964-b4-solution :
  Nat ->
  Nat
putnam-1964-b4-solution n =
  n * n - n + two

putnam-1964-b4 : Set1
putnam-1964-b4 =
  (R : Set) ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) ->
  (n : Nat) ->
  NatStrictLess zero n ->
  (C : Fin n -> Subset (Point R)) ->
  (normals : Fin n -> Point R) ->
  ((i : Fin n) ->
    SetEqual (C i) (CircleFromNormal reals (normals i))) ->
  ((i : Fin n) ->
    VectorNonzero reals (normals i)) ->
  CircleFamilyInjective C ->
  GeneralPosition reals C ->
  (IsRegion : Subset (Point R) -> Set) ->
  RegionsCharacterizedBySigns reals normals IsRegion ->
  RegionHasCardinality IsRegion (putnam-1964-b4-solution n)

title: putnam_1964_b4
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench artifact putnam_1964_b4:
  the number of sign-pattern regions cut out on the unit sphere by finitely
  many distinct great circles in general position. This file contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open arithmeticTheory pred_setTheory realTheory;

val putnam_1964_b4 =
  ``let sphere3 =
      \x : (real # real) # real.
        FST (FST x) * FST (FST x) +
        SND (FST x) * SND (FST x) +
        SND x * SND x = 1
    in
      let dot3 =
        \u : (real # real) # real.
        \x : (real # real) # real.
          FST (FST u) * FST (FST x) +
          SND (FST u) * SND (FST x) +
          SND u * SND x
      in
        let solution = \n : num. n * n - n + 2
        in
          !n : num.
          !C : num -> ((real # real) # real -> bool).
          !v : num -> (real # real) # real.
          !IsRegion : ((real # real) # real -> bool) -> bool.
            0 < n /\
            (!i : num.
               i < n
               ==>
               C i =
                 \x : (real # real) # real.
                   sphere3 x /\ dot3 (v i) x = 0) /\
            (!i : num. i < n ==> v i <> ((0, 0), 0)) /\
            (!i j : num.
               i < n /\ j < n /\ C i = C j ==> i = j) /\
            (!x y : (real # real) # real.
               sphere3 x /\ sphere3 y
               ==>
               CARD {i : num | i < n /\ C i x /\ C i y} <= 2) /\
            (!R : (real # real) # real -> bool.
               IsRegion R <=>
               (?x : (real # real) # real. R x) /\
               ?sign : num -> real.
                 (!i : num.
                    i < n
                    ==>
                    sign i <> 0 /\
                    (sign i = 1 \/ sign i = -1)) /\
                 R =
                   \x : (real # real) # real.
                     sphere3 x /\
                     !i : num.
                       i < n ==> sgn (dot3 (v i) x) = sign i)
            ==>
            (if FINITE
                  {R : (real # real) # real -> bool | IsRegion R}
             then CARD {R : (real # real) # real -> bool | IsRegion R}
             else 0) =
            solution n``;

title: putnam_1964_b4
content:
$(
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench artifact putnam_1964_b4:
  for a positive finite family of distinct great circles on the unit sphere
  in real three-space, in the stated general position and with regions
  characterized by nonzero inner-product signs, the number of regions equals
  the specified solution function. This file contains no proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  P64B4R3 is real coordinate three-space, P64B4IP is its standard inner
  product, P64B4Sphere is the unit sphere, and P64B4Circle A is the
  intersection of that sphere with the plane orthogonal to A. The coordinate
  equation P64B4IP x x = 1 is equivalent to the source metric-sphere
  equation dist(x,0) = 1.

  A source SignType value is represented by its real signum value in
  { -1, 0, 1 }. Restricting the sign assignment to { -1, 1 } is exactly the
  source's pointwise nonzero condition. The answer is the published formula
  n^2 - n + 2. The final declaration is the single unproved $a corpus
  statement, and this database contains no $p proof statement.
$)

$c P64B4R3 P64B4Zero P64B4IP P64B4Sphere P64B4Circle
   $.

p64b4-space-syntax $a class P64B4R3 $.
p64b4-zero-syntax $a class P64B4Zero $.
p64b4-inner-product-syntax $a class ( P64B4IP A B ) $.
p64b4-sphere-syntax $a class P64B4Sphere $.
p64b4-circle-syntax $a class ( P64B4Circle A ) $.

p64b4-space-definition $a |- P64B4R3 = ( RR ^m ( 1 ... 3 ) ) $.

${

  $d C P R V i n s x y $.

  putnambench-putnam-1964-b4 $a |- A. n e. NN0
    A. C e. ( ( ~P P64B4R3 ) ^m ( 1 ... n ) )
      A. V e. ( P64B4R3 ^m ( 1 ... n ) )
        A. P e. ~P ( ~P P64B4R3 )
          (

                A. i e. ( 1 ... n )
                  ( C ` i ) = ( P64B4Circle ( V ` i ) )
              )
              /\
              (

                /\
                C : ( 1 ... n ) -1-1-> ~P P64B4R3
              )
            )
            /\
            (
              A. x e. P64B4Sphere A. y e. P64B4Sphere

              /\
              A. R e. ~P P64B4R3

title: putnam_1964_b4
content:
% Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench artifact putnam_1964_b4:
% n positive, distinct great circles in general position divide the unit
% sphere into n^2 - n + 2 sign-defined regions. This file contains no proof.

putnam_1964_b4[n: posnat]: THEORY
BEGIN
  point: TYPE =
    [# x_coord: real, y_coord: real, z_coord: real #]
  point_set: TYPE = [point -> bool]
  circle_index: TYPE = below(n)
  circle_family: TYPE = [circle_index -> point_set]
  vector_family: TYPE = [circle_index -> point]
  sign_value: TYPE =
    {value: int | value = -1 OR value = 0 OR value = 1}
  sign_assignment: TYPE = [circle_index -> sign_value]
  region_predicate: TYPE = [point_set -> bool]
  point_set_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> point_set]

  zero_vector: point =
    (# x_coord := 0, y_coord := 0, z_coord := 0 #)

  squared_norm(p: point): real =
    x_coord(p) ^ 2 + y_coord(p) ^ 2 + z_coord(p) ^ 2

  dot_product(p, q: point): real =
    x_coord(p) * x_coord(q)
      + y_coord(p) * y_coord(q)
      + z_coord(p) * z_coord(q)

  unit_sphere: point_set =
    LAMBDA (p: point):
      squared_norm(p) = 1

  sign_of_real(value: real): sign_value =
    IF value < 0 THEN
      -1
    ELSIF value = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      1
    ENDIF

  circles_are_great(
      C: circle_family,
      v: vector_family): bool =
    FORALL (i: circle_index):
      C(i) =
        LAMBDA (p: point):
          unit_sphere(p) AND dot_product(v(i), p) = 0

  normals_are_nonzero(v: vector_family): bool =
    FORALL (i: circle_index):
      v(i) /= zero_vector

  circles_are_injective(C: circle_family): bool =
    FORALL (i, j: circle_index):
      C(i) = C(j) IMPLIES i = j

  at_most_two_circles_through(
      C: circle_family,
      p, q: point): bool =
    FORALL (i, j, k: circle_index):
      (C(i)(p) AND C(i)(q)
        AND C(j)(p) AND C(j)(q)
        AND C(k)(p) AND C(k)(q))
      IMPLIES i = j OR i = k OR j = k

  circles_in_general_position(C: circle_family): bool =
    FORALL (p, q: point):
      unit_sphere(p) AND unit_sphere(q)
      IMPLIES at_most_two_circles_through(C, p, q)

  nonempty(R: point_set): bool =
    EXISTS (p: point):
      R(p)

  regions_are_sign_patterns(
      IsRegion: region_predicate,
      v: vector_family): bool =
    FORALL (R: point_set):
      IsRegion(R)
      IFF
        nonempty(R)
          AND EXISTS (signs: sign_assignment):
            (FORALL (i: circle_index):
              signs(i) /= 0)
            AND R =
              LAMBDA (p: point):
                unit_sphere(p)
                  AND (FORALL (i: circle_index):
                    sign_of_real(dot_product(v(i), p)) = signs(i))

  injective_below(
      enumeration: point_set_sequence,
      cardinality: nat): bool =
    FORALL (i, j: nat):
      i < cardinality AND j < cardinality
        AND enumeration(i) = enumeration(j)
      IMPLIES i = j

  enumerates_exactly(
      enumeration: point_set_sequence,
      IsRegion: region_predicate,
      cardinality: nat): bool =
    FORALL (R: point_set):
      IsRegion(R)
      IFF
        EXISTS (position: nat):
          position < cardinality AND enumeration(position) = R

  has_cardinality(
      IsRegion: region_predicate,
      cardinality: nat): bool =
    EXISTS (enumeration: point_set_sequence):
      injective_below(enumeration, cardinality)
        AND enumerates_exactly(
          enumeration, IsRegion, cardinality)

  nat_predecessor(k: nat): nat =
    IF k = 0 THEN 0 ELSE k - 1 ENDIF

  putnam_1964_b4_solution(k: nat): nat =
    k * nat_predecessor(k) + 2

  putnam_1964_b4: bool =
    FORALL (C: circle_family),
        (v: vector_family),
        (IsRegion: region_predicate):
      (circles_are_great(C, v)
        AND normals_are_nonzero(v)
        AND circles_are_injective(C)
        AND circles_in_general_position(C)
        AND regions_are_sign_patterns(IsRegion, v))
      IMPLIES
        has_cardinality(
          IsRegion, putnam_1964_b4_solution(n))
END putnam_1964_b4

import Mathlib

open Set Function Filter Topology

/--
Let $a_n$ be a strictly monotonic increasing sequence of positive integers. Let $b_n$ be the least common multiple of $a_1, a_2, \dots , a_n$. Prove that $\sum_{n=1}^{\infty} 1/b_n$ converges.
-/
theorem putnam_1964_b5
(a b : ℕ → ℕ)
(ha : StrictMono a ∧ ∀ n : ℕ, a n > 0)
(hb : b 0 = a 0 ∧ ∀ n : ℕ, b (n + 1) = lcm (b n) (a (n + 1)))
: (∃ L : ℝ, Tendsto (fun N ↦ ∑ n ∈ Finset.range N, (1 : ℝ) / b n) atTop (𝓝 L)) :=
sorry

Theorem putnam_1964_b5
    (a b : nat -> nat)
    (ha : increasing_seq a /\ (forall n : nat, lt 0 (a n)))
    (hb : b 0%nat = a 0%nat /\ forall n : nat, b n.+1 = lcmn (b n) (a (n.+1)))
    (f : nat -> R := fun N => \sum_(0 <= n < N) 1/((b n)%:R))
    : exists L : R, f @ \oo --> L.
Proof. Admitted.

content:
;; Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1964_b5:
;; if A is a strictly increasing sequence of positive integers and B(N) is
;; the least common multiple of A(0),...,A(N), then sum 1/B(N) converges.
;; This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))

;; DEFSTUB gives arbitrary sequence symbols conservatively.  This is the
;; standard ACL2 representation of a theorem generic over functions and does
;; not impose APPLY$'s tame-function restriction.

(defstub putnam-1964-b5-a (n) t)
(defstub putnam-1964-b5-b (n) t)

(defun putnam-1964-b5-common-multiple-p (x y multiple)
  (and
   (posp x)
   (posp y)
   (posp multiple)
   (equal (mod multiple x) 0)
   (equal (mod multiple y) 0)))

(defun-sk putnam-1964-b5-least-common-multiple-p
    (x y candidate)
  (forall (multiple)
    (implies
     (putnam-1964-b5-common-multiple-p x y multiple)
     (and
      (putnam-1964-b5-common-multiple-p x y candidate)
      (<= candidate multiple)))))

(defun-sk putnam-1964-b5-positive-sequences-p ()
  (forall (n)
    (implies
     (natp n)
     (and
      (posp (putnam-1964-b5-a n))
      (posp (putnam-1964-b5-b n))))))

(defun-sk putnam-1964-b5-strictly-increasing-p ()
  (forall (i j)
    (implies
     (and (natp i) (natp j) (< i j))
     (< (putnam-1964-b5-a i)
        (putnam-1964-b5-a j)))))

(defun-sk putnam-1964-b5-running-lcm-p ()
  (forall (n)
    (implies
     (natp n)
     (putnam-1964-b5-least-common-multiple-p
      (putnam-1964-b5-b n)
      (putnam-1964-b5-a (+ 1 n))
      (putnam-1964-b5-b (+ 1 n))))))

(defun putnam-1964-b5-partial-sum (count)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix count)))
  (if (and (natp count) (< 0 count))
      (+ (putnam-1964-b5-partial-sum (- count 1))
         (/ (putnam-1964-b5-b (- count 1))))
    0))

(defun-sk putnam-1964-b5-cauchy-tail-p (epsilon cutoff)
  (forall (m n)
    (implies
     (and
      (natp m)
      (natp n)
      (natp cutoff)
      (<= cutoff m)
      (<= cutoff n))
     (<
      (abs
       (-
        (putnam-1964-b5-partial-sum m)
        (putnam-1964-b5-partial-sum n)))
      epsilon))))

(defun-sk putnam-1964-b5-cauchy-cutoff-exists-p (epsilon)
  (exists (cutoff)
    (and
     (natp cutoff)
     (putnam-1964-b5-cauchy-tail-p epsilon cutoff))))

(defun-sk putnam-1964-b5-reciprocal-series-converges-p ()
  (forall (epsilon)
    (implies
     (and (rationalp epsilon) (< 0 epsilon))
     (putnam-1964-b5-cauchy-cutoff-exists-p epsilon))))

(defun putnambench-putnam-1964-b5-statement ()
  (implies
   (and
    (putnam-1964-b5-positive-sequences-p)
    (putnam-1964-b5-strictly-increasing-p)
    (equal (putnam-1964-b5-b 0)
           (putnam-1964-b5-a 0))
    (putnam-1964-b5-running-lcm-p))
   (putnam-1964-b5-reciprocal-series-converges-p)))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

title: putnam_1964_b5
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1964_b5:
-- the reciprocal series of the cumulative least common multiples of a strictly
-- increasing sequence of positive natural numbers converges. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module Putnam1964B5 where

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; _*_)

infix 4 _!=_ _<=N_ _divides_
infixr 3 _and_
infixr 2 _or_

data Bottom : Set where

Not : Set -> Set
Not A = A -> Bottom

_!=_ : {A : Set} -> A -> A -> Set
x != y = Not (x == y)

record _and_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data _or_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  left  : A -> A or B
  right : B -> A or B

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

data _<=N_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set where
  zero<=   : {n : Nat} -> zero <=N n
  suc<=suc : {m n : Nat} -> m <=N n -> suc m <=N suc n

NatStrictLess : Nat -> Nat -> Set
NatStrictLess m n =
  suc m <=N n

record _divides_ (divisor dividend : Nat) : Set where
  field
    quotient : Nat
    equation : divisor * quotient == dividend

record IsLeastCommonMultiple (m n l : Nat) : Set where
  field
    left-divides  : m divides l
    right-divides : n divides l
    least :
      (common : Nat) ->
      m divides common ->
      n divides common ->
      l divides common

StrictlyIncreasing : (Nat -> Nat) -> Set
StrictlyIncreasing a =
  (m n : Nat) ->
  NatStrictLess m n ->
  NatStrictLess (a m) (a n)

PositiveSequence : (Nat -> Nat) -> Set
PositiveSequence a =
  (n : Nat) ->
  NatStrictLess zero (a n)

record CompleteOrderedField (R : Set) : Set1 where
  field
    zeroR oneR : R
    add multiply : R -> R -> R
    negate inverse : R -> R
    lessOrEqual : R -> R -> Set
    fromNat : Nat -> R

    one-not-zero :
      oneR != zeroR

    add-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> add x y == add y x
    add-associative :
      (x y z : R) -> add (add x y) z == add x (add y z)
    add-zero :
      (x : R) -> add x zeroR == x
    add-inverse :
      (x : R) -> add x (negate x) == zeroR

    multiply-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> multiply x y == multiply y x
    multiply-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply (multiply x y) z == multiply x (multiply y z)
    multiply-one :
      (x : R) -> multiply x oneR == x
    multiply-zero :
      (x : R) -> multiply x zeroR == zeroR
    distribute :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply x (add y z) ==
      add (multiply x y) (multiply x z)
    inverse-zero :
      inverse zeroR == zeroR
    multiply-inverse :
      (x : R) ->
      x != zeroR ->
      multiply x (inverse x) == oneR

    order-reflexive :
      (x : R) -> lessOrEqual x x
    order-transitive :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y z ->
      lessOrEqual x z
    order-antisymmetric :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y x ->
      x == y
    order-total :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y or lessOrEqual y x
    add-order :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual (add z x) (add z y)
    multiply-nonnegative :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR x ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR y ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR (multiply x y)
    zero-less-than-one :
      lessOrEqual zeroR oneR and zeroR != oneR

    fromNat-zero :
      fromNat zero == zeroR
    fromNat-successor :
      (n : Nat) -> fromNat (suc n) == add (fromNat n) oneR
    fromNat-addition :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m + n) == add (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-multiplication :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m * n) == multiply (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-injective :
      (m n : Nat) -> fromNat m == fromNat n -> m == n

    archimedean :
      (x : R) ->
      Exists Nat (\ n -> lessOrEqual x (fromNat n))
    least-upper-bound :
      (P : R -> Set) ->
      Exists R P ->
      Exists R
        (\ upper ->
          (x : R) ->
          P x ->
          lessOrEqual x upper) ->
      Exists R
        (\ supremum ->
          ((x : R) -> P x -> lessOrEqual x supremum)
          and
          ((upper : R) ->
            ((x : R) -> P x -> lessOrEqual x upper) ->
            lessOrEqual supremum upper))

open CompleteOrderedField

subtract :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
subtract reals x y =
  add reals x (negate reals y)

divide :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
divide reals x y =
  multiply reals x (inverse reals y)

StrictLess :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
StrictLess reals x y =
  lessOrEqual reals x y and x != y

CloseTo :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
CloseTo reals center radius x =
  StrictLess reals (subtract reals center radius) x
  and
  StrictLess reals x (add reals center radius)

sumFirst :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  Nat ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  R
sumFirst reals zero term =
  zeroR reals
sumFirst reals (suc n) term =
  add reals
    (sumFirst reals n term)
    (term n)

ConvergesTo :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  R ->
  Set
ConvergesTo {R} reals sequence limit =
  (epsilon : R) ->
  StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) epsilon ->
  Exists Nat
    (\ cutoff ->
      (n : Nat) ->
      cutoff <=N n ->
      CloseTo reals limit epsilon (sequence n))

SeriesHasSum :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  R ->
  Set
SeriesHasSum reals term limit =
  ConvergesTo reals
    (\ n -> sumFirst reals n term)
    limit

reciprocalNaturalTerm :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  (Nat -> Nat) ->
  Nat ->
  R
reciprocalNaturalTerm reals b n =
  divide reals
    (oneR reals)
    (fromNat reals (b n))

putnam-1964-b5 : Set1
putnam-1964-b5 =
  (R : Set) ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) ->
  (a b : Nat -> Nat) ->
  (StrictlyIncreasing a and PositiveSequence a) ->
  ((b zero == a zero)
    and
    ((n : Nat) ->
      IsLeastCommonMultiple
        (b n)
        (a (suc n))
        (b (suc n)))) ->
  Exists R
    (\ limit ->
      SeriesHasSum reals
        (reciprocalNaturalTerm reals b)
        limit)

(*

  multiples of a strictly increasing positive natural-number sequence.
  This file contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open arithmeticTheory gcdTheory pred_setTheory realTheory real_sigmaTheory;
open real_topologyTheory;

val putnam_1964_b5 =
  ``!a b : num -> num.
      (!m n : num. m < n ==> a m < a n) /\
      (!n : num. 0 < a n) /\
      b 0 = a 0 /\
      (!n : num. b (n + 1) = lcm (b n) (a (n + 1)))
      ==>
      ?L : real.
        ((\N : num.
            SIGMA
              (\n : num. (1 : real) / &(b n))
              (count N)) --> L) sequentially``;

$(

  The antecedent states that A is positive and strictly increasing, that

title: putnam_1964_b5
content:
% Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench artifact putnam_1964_b5:
% the reciprocal series of the running least common multiples of a strictly
% increasing positive natural-number sequence converges. This file contains no proof.

putnam_1964_b5: THEORY
BEGIN
  natural_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> nat]

  nat_divides(divisor, value: nat): bool =
    EXISTS (quotient: nat): value = divisor * quotient

  is_nat_lcm(lcm_value, left, right: nat): bool =
    nat_divides(left, lcm_value)
      AND nat_divides(right, lcm_value)
      AND (FORALL (common_multiple: nat):
        nat_divides(left, common_multiple)
          AND nat_divides(right, common_multiple)
          IMPLIES nat_divides(lcm_value, common_multiple))

  strictly_increasing(a: natural_sequence): bool =
    FORALL (m, n: nat):
      m < n IMPLIES a(m) < a(n)

  positive(a: natural_sequence): bool =
    FORALL (n: nat): 0 < a(n)

  running_lcms(a, b: natural_sequence): bool =
    b(0) = a(0)
      AND FORALL (n: nat):
        is_nat_lcm(b(n + 1), b(n), a(n + 1))

  safe_div(numerator, denominator: real): real =
    IF denominator = 0 THEN 0 ELSE numerator / denominator ENDIF

  reciprocal_partial_sum(
      b: natural_sequence,
      count: nat): RECURSIVE real =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      reciprocal_partial_sum(b, count - 1)
        + safe_div(1, b(count - 1) :: real)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  reciprocal_series_converges(b: natural_sequence): bool =
    EXISTS (total: real):
      FORALL (epsilon_value: posreal):
        EXISTS (cutoff: nat):
          FORALL (count: nat):
            cutoff <= count IMPLIES
              abs(reciprocal_partial_sum(b, count) - total)
                < epsilon_value

  putnam_1964_b5: bool =
    FORALL (a, b: natural_sequence):
      (strictly_increasing(a)
        AND positive(a)
        AND running_lcms(a, b))
      IMPLIES reciprocal_series_converges(b)
END putnam_1964_b5

import Mathlib

open EuclideanGeometry Real

noncomputable abbrev putnam_1965_a1_solution : ℝ := Real.pi / 15
/--
Let $\triangle ABC$ satisfy $\angle CAB < \angle BCA < \frac{\pi}{2} < \angle ABC$. If the bisector of the external angle at $A$ meets line $BC$ at $P$, the bisector of the external angle at $B$ meets line $CA$ at $Q$, and $AP = BQ = AB$, find $\angle CAB$.
-/
theorem putnam_1965_a1
(A B C X Y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
(hABC : ¬Collinear ℝ {A, B, C})
(hangles : ∠ C A B < ∠ B C A ∧ ∠ B C A < π/2 ∧ π/2 < ∠ A B C)
(hX : Collinear ℝ {X, B, C} ∧ ∠ X A B = (π - ∠ C A B)/2 ∧ dist A X = dist A B)
(hY : Collinear ℝ {Y, C, A} ∧ ∠ Y B C = (π - ∠ A B C)/2 ∧ dist B Y = dist A B)
: ∠ C A B = putnam_1965_a1_solution :=
sorry

title: putnam_1965_a1
content:
(* Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench artifact putnam_1965_a1:
   a planar triangle with two specified external-angle bisector intersections
   and equal-length constraints has angle CAB equal to pi/15.
   This file contains no proof. *)

From Stdlib Require Import Reals Rtrigo1.

Open Scope R_scope.

Definition point := (R * R)%type.

Definition point_sub (a b : point) : point :=
  (fst a - fst b, snd a - snd b).

Definition point_dot (u v : point) : R :=
  fst u * fst v + snd u * snd v.

Definition point_norm (u : point) : R :=
  sqrt (fst u ^ 2 + snd u ^ 2).

Definition point_distance (a b : point) : R :=
  point_norm (point_sub a b).

Definition vector_is_zero (u : point) : bool :=
  if Req_EM_T (fst u) 0 then
    if Req_EM_T (snd u) 0 then true else false
  else false.

Definition real_arccos (x : R) : R :=
  if Rle_dec x (-1) then PI
  else if Rle_dec 1 x then 0
  else PI / 2 - atan (x / sqrt (1 - x ^ 2)).

Definition vector_angle (u v : point) : R :=
  if orb (vector_is_zero u) (vector_is_zero v) then PI / 2
  else real_arccos (point_dot u v / (point_norm u * point_norm v)).

Definition angle (a b c : point) : R :=
  vector_angle (point_sub a b) (point_sub c b).

Definition collinear_points (a b c : point) : Prop :=
  (fst b - fst a) * (snd c - snd a) =
  (snd b - snd a) * (fst c - fst a).

Definition putnam_1965_a1_solution : R := PI / 15.

Theorem putnam_1965_a1
    (A B C X Y : point)
    (hABC : ~ collinear_points A B C)
    (hangles :
      angle C A B < angle B C A /\
      angle B C A < PI / 2 /\
      PI / 2 < angle A B C)
    (hX :
      collinear_points X B C /\
      angle X A B = (PI - angle C A B) / 2 /\
      point_distance A X = point_distance A B)
    (hY :
      collinear_points Y C A /\
      angle Y B C = (PI - angle A B C) / 2 /\
      point_distance B Y = point_distance A B) :
  angle C A B = putnam_1965_a1_solution.
Admitted.

theory putnam_1965_a1 imports Complex_Main
"HOL-Analysis.Finite_Cartesian_Product"
"HOL-Analysis.Linear_Algebra"

(* Note: Alternatively, for this problem, one may import Triangle.Angles by Manuel Eberl from AFP, however we have included the relevant definitions locally to avoid an extra dependency on AFP *)
definition vangle where
  "vangle u v = (if u = 0 \<or> v = 0 then pi / 2 else arccos (u \<bullet> v / (norm u * norm v)))"
definition angle where
  "angle a b c = vangle (a - b) (c - b)"
definition putnam_1965_a1_solution :: "real" where
  "putnam_1965_a1_solution = pi / 15"
theorem putnam_1965_a1:
  fixes A B C X Y :: "real^2"
  assumes hABC : "\<not> collinear {A,B,C}"
    and hangles : "angle C A B < angle B C A \<and> angle B C A < \<pi>/2 \<and> pi / 2 < angle A B C"
    and hX : "collinear {X, B, C} \<and> angle X A B = (pi - angle C A B)/2 \<and> dist A X = dist A B"
    and hY : "collinear {Y, C, A} \<and> angle Y B C = (pi - angle A B C)/2 \<and> dist B Y = dist A B"
