;; Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1965_a6:
;; positive tangency witnesses for ux + vy = 1 and x^m + y^m = 1 are
;; equivalent to a conjugate real exponent n satisfying u^n + v^n = 1.
;; This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))

;; A Dedekind-complete ordered field presents the real numbers. Positive-base
;; real powers are fixed uniquely by their rational values and continuity in
;; the exponent, so POWER denotes the same operation as the source real power.

(defun putnam-1965-a6-member-p (carrier x)
  (if (apply$ carrier (list x)) t nil))

(defun putnam-1965-a6-unary (operation x)
  (apply$ operation (list x)))

(defun putnam-1965-a6-binary (operation x y)
  (apply$ operation (list x y)))

(defun putnam-1965-a6-positive-p (carrier less zero x)
  (and
   (putnam-1965-a6-member-p carrier x)
   (apply$ less (list zero x))))

(defun-sk putnam-1965-a6-field-laws-p
    (carrier zero one add multiply negate inverse)
  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (putnam-1965-a6-member-p carrier x)
      (putnam-1965-a6-member-p carrier y)
      (putnam-1965-a6-member-p carrier z))
     (and
      (putnam-1965-a6-member-p
       carrier (putnam-1965-a6-binary add x y))
      (putnam-1965-a6-member-p
       carrier (putnam-1965-a6-binary multiply x y))
      (putnam-1965-a6-member-p
       carrier (putnam-1965-a6-unary negate x))
      (putnam-1965-a6-member-p
       carrier (putnam-1965-a6-unary inverse x))
      (equal
       (putnam-1965-a6-binary
        add (putnam-1965-a6-binary add x y) z)
       (putnam-1965-a6-binary
        add x (putnam-1965-a6-binary add y z)))
      (equal
       (putnam-1965-a6-binary add x y)
       (putnam-1965-a6-binary add y x))
      (equal (putnam-1965-a6-binary add x zero) x)
      (equal
       (putnam-1965-a6-binary
        add x (putnam-1965-a6-unary negate x))
       zero)
      (equal
       (putnam-1965-a6-binary
        multiply (putnam-1965-a6-binary multiply x y) z)
       (putnam-1965-a6-binary
        multiply x (putnam-1965-a6-binary multiply y z)))
      (equal
       (putnam-1965-a6-binary multiply x y)
       (putnam-1965-a6-binary multiply y x))
      (equal (putnam-1965-a6-binary multiply x one) x)
      (equal (putnam-1965-a6-unary inverse zero) zero)
      (implies
       (not (equal x zero))
       (equal
        (putnam-1965-a6-binary
         multiply x (putnam-1965-a6-unary inverse x))
        one))
      (equal
       (putnam-1965-a6-binary
        multiply x (putnam-1965-a6-binary add y z))
       (putnam-1965-a6-binary
        add
        (putnam-1965-a6-binary multiply x y)
        (putnam-1965-a6-binary multiply x z)))))))

(defun-sk putnam-1965-a6-order-laws-p
    (carrier zero add multiply less)
  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (putnam-1965-a6-member-p carrier x)
      (putnam-1965-a6-member-p carrier y)
      (putnam-1965-a6-member-p carrier z))
     (and
      (not (apply$ less (list x x)))
      (or
       (equal x y)
       (apply$ less (list x y))
       (apply$ less (list y x)))
      (implies
       (and
        (apply$ less (list x y))
        (apply$ less (list y z)))
       (apply$ less (list x z)))
      (implies
       (apply$ less (list x y))
       (apply$
        less
        (list
         (putnam-1965-a6-binary add x z)
         (putnam-1965-a6-binary add y z))))
      (implies
       (and
        (apply$ less (list zero x))
        (apply$ less (list zero y)))
       (apply$
        less
        (list zero
              (putnam-1965-a6-binary multiply x y))))))))

(defun-sk putnam-1965-a6-set-nonempty-p (carrier set)
  (exists (x)
    (and
     (putnam-1965-a6-member-p carrier x)
     (apply$ set (list x)))))

(defun-sk putnam-1965-a6-upper-bound-p
    (carrier less set bound)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (and
      (putnam-1965-a6-member-p carrier x)
      (apply$ set (list x)))
     (not (apply$ less (list bound x))))))

(defun-sk putnam-1965-a6-bounded-above-p
    (carrier less set)
  (exists (bound)
    (and
     (putnam-1965-a6-member-p carrier bound)
     (putnam-1965-a6-upper-bound-p
      carrier less set bound))))

(defun-sk putnam-1965-a6-supremum-p
    (carrier less set supremum)
  (forall (bound)
    (and
     (putnam-1965-a6-member-p carrier supremum)
     (putnam-1965-a6-upper-bound-p
      carrier less set supremum)
     (implies
      (and
       (putnam-1965-a6-member-p carrier bound)
       (putnam-1965-a6-upper-bound-p
        carrier less set bound))
      (not (apply$ less (list bound supremum)))))))

(defun-sk putnam-1965-a6-has-supremum-p
    (carrier less set)
  (exists (supremum)
    (putnam-1965-a6-supremum-p
     carrier less set supremum)))

(defun-sk putnam-1965-a6-dedekind-complete-p
    (carrier less)
  (forall (set)
    (implies
     (and
      (tamep-functionp set)
      (putnam-1965-a6-set-nonempty-p carrier set)
      (putnam-1965-a6-bounded-above-p carrier less set))
     (putnam-1965-a6-has-supremum-p
      carrier less set))))

(defun putnam-1965-a6-real-field-p
    (carrier zero one add multiply negate inverse less)
  (and
   (tamep-functionp carrier)
   (tamep-functionp add)
   (tamep-functionp multiply)
   (tamep-functionp negate)
   (tamep-functionp inverse)
   (tamep-functionp less)
   (putnam-1965-a6-member-p carrier zero)
   (putnam-1965-a6-member-p carrier one)
   (not (equal zero one))
   (putnam-1965-a6-field-laws-p
    carrier zero one add multiply negate inverse)
   (putnam-1965-a6-order-laws-p
    carrier zero add multiply less)
   (apply$ less (list zero one))
   (putnam-1965-a6-dedekind-complete-p carrier less)))

(defun putnam-1965-a6-natural
    (n zero one add)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix n)))
  (if (zp n)
      zero
    (putnam-1965-a6-binary
     add one
     (putnam-1965-a6-natural (- n 1) zero one add))))

(defun putnam-1965-a6-integer
    (n zero one add negate)
  (if (< n 0)
      (putnam-1965-a6-unary
       negate
       (putnam-1965-a6-natural (- n) zero one add))
    (putnam-1965-a6-natural n zero one add)))

(defun putnam-1965-a6-natural-power
    (base exponent one multiply)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix exponent)))
  (if (zp exponent)
      one
    (putnam-1965-a6-binary
     multiply
     (putnam-1965-a6-natural-power
      base (- exponent 1) one multiply)
     base)))

(defun putnam-1965-a6-integer-power
    (base exponent one multiply inverse)
  (if (< exponent 0)
      (putnam-1965-a6-unary
       inverse
       (putnam-1965-a6-natural-power
        base (- exponent) one multiply))
    (putnam-1965-a6-natural-power
     base exponent one multiply)))

(defun-sk putnam-1965-a6-power-typing-p
    (carrier zero less power)
  (forall (base exponent)
    (implies
     (and
      (putnam-1965-a6-positive-p carrier less zero base)
      (putnam-1965-a6-member-p carrier exponent))
     (putnam-1965-a6-positive-p
      carrier less zero
      (putnam-1965-a6-binary power base exponent)))))

(defun-sk putnam-1965-a6-power-rational-laws-p
    (carrier zero one add multiply negate inverse less power)
  (forall (base numerator denominator)
    (implies
     (and
      (putnam-1965-a6-positive-p carrier less zero base)
      (integerp numerator)
      (posp denominator))
     (equal
      (putnam-1965-a6-natural-power
       (putnam-1965-a6-binary
        power
        base
        (putnam-1965-a6-binary
         multiply
         (putnam-1965-a6-integer
          numerator zero one add negate)
         (putnam-1965-a6-unary
          inverse
          (putnam-1965-a6-natural
           denominator zero one add))))
       denominator one multiply)
      (putnam-1965-a6-integer-power
       base numerator one multiply inverse)))))

(defun putnam-1965-a6-absolute (zero negate less x)
  (if (apply$ less (list x zero))
      (putnam-1965-a6-unary negate x)
    x))

(defun putnam-1965-a6-distance
    (zero add negate less x y)
  (putnam-1965-a6-absolute
   zero negate less
   (putnam-1965-a6-binary
    add x (putnam-1965-a6-unary negate y))))

(defun-sk putnam-1965-a6-power-neighborhood-p
    (carrier zero add negate less power
     base exponent epsilon delta)
  (forall (y)
    (implies
     (and
      (putnam-1965-a6-member-p carrier y)
      (apply$
       less
       (list
        (putnam-1965-a6-distance
         zero add negate less y exponent)
        delta)))
     (apply$
      less
      (list
       (putnam-1965-a6-distance
        zero add negate less
        (putnam-1965-a6-binary power base y)
        (putnam-1965-a6-binary power base exponent))
       epsilon)))))

(defun-sk putnam-1965-a6-power-delta-exists-p
    (carrier zero add negate less power
     base exponent epsilon)
  (exists (delta)
    (and
     (putnam-1965-a6-positive-p carrier less zero delta)
     (putnam-1965-a6-power-neighborhood-p
      carrier zero add negate less power
      base exponent epsilon delta))))

(defun-sk putnam-1965-a6-power-continuous-p
    (carrier zero add negate less power)
  (forall (base exponent epsilon)
    (implies
     (and
      (putnam-1965-a6-positive-p carrier less zero base)
      (putnam-1965-a6-member-p carrier exponent)
      (putnam-1965-a6-positive-p carrier less zero epsilon))
     (putnam-1965-a6-power-delta-exists-p
      carrier zero add negate less power
      base exponent epsilon))))

(defun putnam-1965-a6-real-power-p
    (carrier zero one add multiply negate inverse less power)
  (and
   (tamep-functionp power)
   (putnam-1965-a6-power-typing-p
    carrier zero less power)
   (putnam-1965-a6-power-rational-laws-p
    carrier zero one add multiply negate inverse less power)
   (putnam-1965-a6-power-continuous-p
    carrier zero add negate less power)))

(defun-sk putnam-1965-a6-tangency-witnesses-p
    (carrier zero one add multiply negate less power u v m)
  (exists (x y)
    (and
     (putnam-1965-a6-positive-p carrier less zero x)
     (putnam-1965-a6-positive-p carrier less zero y)
     (equal
      (putnam-1965-a6-binary
       add
       (putnam-1965-a6-binary multiply u x)
       (putnam-1965-a6-binary multiply v y))
      one)
     (equal
      (putnam-1965-a6-binary
       add
       (putnam-1965-a6-binary power x m)
       (putnam-1965-a6-binary power y m))
      one)
     (equal
      u
      (putnam-1965-a6-binary
       power x
       (putnam-1965-a6-binary
        add m (putnam-1965-a6-unary negate one))))
     (equal
      v
      (putnam-1965-a6-binary
       power y
       (putnam-1965-a6-binary
        add m (putnam-1965-a6-unary negate one)))))))

(defun-sk putnam-1965-a6-conjugate-exponent-p
    (carrier one add multiply inverse power u v m)
  (exists (n)
    (and
     (putnam-1965-a6-member-p carrier n)
     (equal
      (putnam-1965-a6-binary
       add
       (putnam-1965-a6-binary power u n)
       (putnam-1965-a6-binary power v n))
      one)
     (equal
      (putnam-1965-a6-binary
       add
       (putnam-1965-a6-unary inverse m)
       (putnam-1965-a6-unary inverse n))
      one))))

(defun putnambench-putnam-1965-a6-statement
    (carrier zero one add multiply negate inverse less power u v m)
  (implies
   (and
    (putnam-1965-a6-real-field-p
     carrier zero one add multiply negate inverse less)
    (putnam-1965-a6-real-power-p
     carrier zero one add multiply negate inverse less power)
    (putnam-1965-a6-positive-p carrier less zero u)
    (putnam-1965-a6-positive-p carrier less zero v)
    (putnam-1965-a6-member-p carrier m)
    (apply$ less (list one m)))
   (iff
    (putnam-1965-a6-tangency-witnesses-p
     carrier zero one add multiply negate less power u v m)
    (putnam-1965-a6-conjugate-exponent-p
     carrier one add multiply inverse power u v m))))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

title: putnam_1965_a6
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1965_a6:
-- a positive line is tangent to the positive real-power curve exactly when
-- its coefficients satisfy the conjugate-exponent equation. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; _*_)

infix 4 _!=_ _<=N_
infixr 3 _and_

data Bottom : Set where

Not : Set -> Set
Not A =
  A -> Bottom

_!=_ : {A : Set} -> A -> A -> Set
x != y =
  Not (x == y)

record _and_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data _or_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  left  : A -> A or B
  right : B -> A or B

record Iff (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor equivalence
  field
    forward  : A -> B
    backward : B -> A

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

data _<=N_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set where
  zero<=   : {n : Nat} -> zero <=N n
  suc<=suc : {m n : Nat} -> m <=N n -> suc m <=N suc n

record CompleteOrderedField (R : Set) : Set1 where
  field
    zeroR oneR : R
    add multiply : R -> R -> R
    negate inverse : R -> R
    lessOrEqual : R -> R -> Set
    fromNat : Nat -> R

    one-not-zero :
      oneR != zeroR

    add-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> add x y == add y x
    add-associative :
      (x y z : R) -> add (add x y) z == add x (add y z)
    add-zero :
      (x : R) -> add x zeroR == x
    add-inverse :
      (x : R) -> add x (negate x) == zeroR

    multiply-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> multiply x y == multiply y x
    multiply-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply (multiply x y) z == multiply x (multiply y z)
    multiply-one :
      (x : R) -> multiply x oneR == x
    multiply-zero :
      (x : R) -> multiply x zeroR == zeroR
    distribute :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply x (add y z) ==
      add (multiply x y) (multiply x z)
    inverse-zero :
      inverse zeroR == zeroR
    multiply-inverse :
      (x : R) ->
      x != zeroR ->
      multiply x (inverse x) == oneR

    order-reflexive :
      (x : R) -> lessOrEqual x x
    order-transitive :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y z ->
      lessOrEqual x z
    order-antisymmetric :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y x ->
      x == y
    order-total :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y or lessOrEqual y x
    add-order :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual (add z x) (add z y)
    multiply-nonnegative :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR x ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR y ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR (multiply x y)
    zero-less-than-one :
      lessOrEqual zeroR oneR and zeroR != oneR

    fromNat-zero :
      fromNat zero == zeroR
    fromNat-successor :
      (n : Nat) -> fromNat (suc n) == add (fromNat n) oneR
    fromNat-addition :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m + n) == add (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-multiplication :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m * n) == multiply (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-injective :
      (m n : Nat) -> fromNat m == fromNat n -> m == n

    archimedean :
      (x : R) ->
      Exists Nat (\ n -> lessOrEqual x (fromNat n))
    least-upper-bound :
      (P : R -> Set) ->
      Exists R P ->
      Exists R
        (\ upper ->
          (x : R) ->
          P x ->
          lessOrEqual x upper) ->
      Exists R
        (\ supremum ->
          ((x : R) ->
            P x ->
            lessOrEqual x supremum)
          and
          ((upper : R) ->
            ((x : R) ->
              P x ->
              lessOrEqual x upper) ->
            lessOrEqual supremum upper))

open CompleteOrderedField

subtract :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
subtract reals x y =
  add reals x (negate reals y)

divide :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
divide reals x y =
  multiply reals x (inverse reals y)

StrictLess :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
StrictLess reals x y =
  lessOrEqual reals x y and x != y

CloseTo :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
CloseTo reals center radius x =
  StrictLess reals (subtract reals center radius) x
  and
  StrictLess reals x (add reals center radius)

naturalPower :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  Nat ->
  R
naturalPower reals x zero =
  oneR reals
naturalPower reals x (suc n) =
  multiply reals
    (naturalPower reals x n)
    x

factorial : Nat -> Nat
factorial zero =
  suc zero
factorial (suc n) =
  suc n * factorial n

sumFirst :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  Nat ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  R
sumFirst reals zero term =
  zeroR reals
sumFirst reals (suc n) term =
  add reals
    (sumFirst reals n term)
    (term n)

ConvergesTo :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  R ->
  Set
ConvergesTo {R} reals sequence limit =
  (epsilon : R) ->
  StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) epsilon ->
  Exists Nat
    (\ cutoff ->
      (n : Nat) ->
      cutoff <=N n ->
      CloseTo reals limit epsilon (sequence n))

SeriesHasSum :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  R ->
  Set
SeriesHasSum reals terms limit =
  ConvergesTo reals
    (\ n -> sumFirst reals n terms)
    limit

exponentialTerm :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  Nat ->
  R
exponentialTerm reals x n =
  divide reals
    (naturalPower reals x n)
    (fromNat reals (factorial n))

ExponentialValue :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
ExponentialValue reals x value =
  SeriesHasSum reals
    (exponentialTerm reals x)
    value

record StandardRealPowers
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) :
  Set1 where

  field
    exponential logarithm : R -> R

    exponential-series :
      (x : R) ->
      ExponentialValue reals x (exponential x)

    exponential-positive :
      (x : R) ->
      StrictLess reals
        (zeroR reals)
        (exponential x)

    exponential-injective :
      (x y : R) ->
      exponential x == exponential y ->
      x == y

    exponential-logarithm :
      (x : R) ->
      StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) x ->
      exponential (logarithm x) == x

open StandardRealPowers

realPower :
  {R : Set} ->
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R} ->
  StandardRealPowers reals ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
realPower {reals = reals} powers base exponent =
  exponential powers
    (multiply reals exponent (logarithm powers base))

module Putnam1965A6Statement
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R)
  (powers : StandardRealPowers reals) where

  proposition : Set
  proposition =
    (u v m : R) ->
    StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) u ->
    StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) v ->
    StrictLess reals (oneR reals) m ->
    Iff
      (Exists R
        (\ x ->
          StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) x
          and
          Exists R
            (\ y ->
              StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) y
              and
              add reals
                (multiply reals u x)
                (multiply reals v y)
              ==
              oneR reals
              and
              add reals
                (realPower powers x m)
                (realPower powers y m)
              ==
              oneR reals
              and
              u ==
              realPower powers x
                (subtract reals m (oneR reals))
              and
              v ==
              realPower powers y
                (subtract reals m (oneR reals)))))
      (Exists R
        (\ n ->
          add reals
            (realPower powers u n)
            (realPower powers v n)
          ==
          oneR reals
          and
          add reals
            (divide reals (oneR reals) m)
            (divide reals (oneR reals) n)
          ==
          oneR reals))

putnam-1965-a6 : Set1
putnam-1965-a6 =
  (R : Set) ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) ->
  (powers : StandardRealPowers reals) ->
  Putnam1965A6Statement.proposition reals powers

title: putnam_1965_a6
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench artifact putnam_1965_a6:
  positive contact coordinates for the line and real-power curve exist
  exactly when the coefficients satisfy the conjugate-exponent equation.
  This file contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open realTheory transcTheory;

val putnam_1965_a6 =
  ``!u v m : real.
      0 < u /\ 0 < v /\ 1 < m
      ==>
      ((?x y : real.
          0 < x /\
          0 < y /\
          u * x + v * y = 1 /\
          x powr m + y powr m = 1 /\
          u = x powr (m - 1) /\
          v = y powr (m - 1))
       <=>
       ?n : real.
         u powr n + v powr n = 1 /\
         1 / m + 1 / n = 1)``;

title: putnam_1965_a6
content:
$(
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench artifact putnam_1965_a6:
  a positive line ux + vy = 1 is tangent to the positive real-power curve
  x^m + y^m = 1 exactly when u and v satisfy the conjugate-exponent power
  equation. This file contains no proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  The variables u, v, and m range over the reals. Real powers of positive
  bases are represented by set.mm's complex-power operation ^c, which equals
  exp(exponent * log(base)) and is real and positive on these domains.
  The positive tangency point x, y and the conjugate exponent n remain
  internally existentially quantified. The final declaration is the single
  unproved $a corpus statement; this database contains no $p proof statement.
$)

${
  $d m n u v x y $.

  putnambench-putnam-1965-a6 $a
    |- A. u e. RR A. v e. RR A. m e. RR
      (
        (
          (
            0 < u
            /\
            0 < v
          )
          /\
          1 < m
        )
        ->
        (
          E. x e. RR E. y e. RR
            (
              (
                0 < x
                /\
                0 < y
              )
              /\
              (
                ( ( u x. x ) + ( v x. y ) ) = 1
                /\
                (
                  ( ( x ^c m ) + ( y ^c m ) ) = 1
                  /\
                  (
                    u = ( x ^c ( m - 1 ) )
                    /\
                    v = ( y ^c ( m - 1 ) )
                  )
                )
              )
            )
          <->
          E. n e. RR
            (
              ( ( u ^c n ) + ( v ^c n ) ) = 1
              /\
              ( ( 1 / m ) + ( 1 / n ) ) = 1
            )
        )
      )
  $.
$}

% Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench artifact putnam_1965_a6:
% for positive real u and v and real m > 1, the specified positive tangency
% conditions for x^m + y^m = 1 are equivalent to the existence of a conjugate
% exponent n with u^n + v^n = 1. This file contains no proof.

putnam_1965_a6: THEORY
BEGIN
  safe_div(x, y: real): real =
    IF y = 0 THEN 0 ELSE x / y ENDIF

  nat_factorial(n: nat): RECURSIVE nat =
    IF n = 0 THEN
      1
    ELSE
      n * nat_factorial(n - 1)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE n

  exponential_partial(x: real, count: nat): RECURSIVE real =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      LET j: nat = count - 1 IN
        exponential_partial(x, count - 1)
          + safe_div(x ^ j, nat_factorial(j) :: real)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  converges_to(sequence: [nat -> real], value: real): bool =
    FORALL (eps: posreal):
      EXISTS (cutoff: nat):
        FORALL (index: nat):
          cutoff <= index IMPLIES
            abs(sequence(index) - value) < eps

  exponential_value(x, value: real): bool =
    converges_to(
      (LAMBDA (count: nat): exponential_partial(x, count)),
      value)

  real_power_value(base, exponent, value: real): bool =
    base > 0
      AND EXISTS (log_base: real):
        exponential_value(log_base, base)
          AND exponential_value(exponent * log_base, value)

  putnam_1965_a6: bool =
    FORALL (u, v, m: real):
      (u > 0 AND v > 0 AND m > 1)
      IMPLIES
        ((EXISTS
            (x, y,
             x_to_m, y_to_m,
             x_to_m_minus_one, y_to_m_minus_one: real):
            x > 0
              AND y > 0
              AND real_power_value(x, m, x_to_m)
              AND real_power_value(y, m, y_to_m)
              AND real_power_value(
                x, m - 1, x_to_m_minus_one)
              AND real_power_value(
                y, m - 1, y_to_m_minus_one)
              AND u * x + v * y = 1
              AND x_to_m + y_to_m = 1
              AND u = x_to_m_minus_one
              AND v = y_to_m_minus_one)
          IFF
            EXISTS (n, u_to_n, v_to_n: real):
                real_power_value(u, n, u_to_n)
                AND real_power_value(v, n, v_to_n)
                AND u_to_n + v_to_n = 1
                AND safe_div(1, m) + safe_div(1, n) = 1)
END putnam_1965_a6

(* Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench artifact putnam_1965_b1:
   the limit of the repeated unit-cube integrals of the squared cosine of
   the normalized coordinate sum. This file contains no proof. *)

From Stdlib Require Import Reals List.

Import ListNotations.
Open Scope R_scope.

Definition putnam_1965_b1_solution : R := 1 / 2.

Fixpoint putnam_1965_b1_coordinate_sum (coordinates : list R) : R :=
  match coordinates with
  | nil => 0
  | x :: rest => x + putnam_1965_b1_coordinate_sum rest
  end.

Fixpoint putnam_1965_b1_iterated_unit_integral
    (dimension : nat) (f : list R -> R) (value : R) : Prop :=
  match dimension with
  | O => value = f nil
  | S lower_dimension =>
      exists slice_integral : R -> R,
        (forall x : R,
          putnam_1965_b1_iterated_unit_integral
            lower_dimension
            (fun remaining_coordinates : list R =>
              f (x :: remaining_coordinates))
            (slice_integral x)) /\
        exists integrable : Riemann_integrable slice_integral 0 1,
          value = RiemannInt integrable
  end.

Definition putnam_1965_b1_term (n : nat) (value : R) : Prop :=
  putnam_1965_b1_iterated_unit_integral
    (S n)
    (fun coordinates : list R =>
      cos
        (PI / (2 * INR (S n)) *
          putnam_1965_b1_coordinate_sum coordinates) ^ 2)
    value.

Definition putnam_1965_b1_relational_sequence_converges
    (term : nat -> R -> Prop) (limit : R) : Prop :=
  (forall n : nat, exists value : R, term n value) /\
  forall epsilon : R,
    0 < epsilon ->
    exists N : nat,
      forall (n : nat) (value : R),
        (N <= n)%nat ->
        term n value ->
        Rabs (value - limit) < epsilon.

Theorem putnam_1965_b1 :
  putnam_1965_b1_relational_sequence_converges
    putnam_1965_b1_term
    putnam_1965_b1_solution.
Admitted.

content:
;; Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1965_b1:
;; the varying-dimensional unit-cube integrals of
;; cos^2((pi/(2n))*(x_1+...+x_n)) converge to 1/2.
;; This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))

;; For source index N, DIMENSION=N+1 follows the Lean formalization's
;; zero-based indexing.  The exact rational values below are midpoint sums on
;; [0,1]^DIMENSION.  Their mesh is unbounded, while Machin prefixes for pi and
;; Taylor prefixes for cosine converge to the standard real functions.
;; Since the integrand is continuous on each compact cube, the inner limit is
;; exactly the source Lebesgue integral, not a finite quadrature replacement.

(defun putnam-1965-b1-factorial (n)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix n)))
  (if (zp n)
      1
    (* n
       (putnam-1965-b1-factorial (- n 1)))))

(defun putnam-1965-b1-arctan-prefix (z terms)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix terms)))
  (if (zp terms)
      0
    (let* ((index (- terms 1))
           (degree (+ (* 2 index) 1))
           (sign (if (equal (mod index 2) 0) 1 -1)))
      (+ (putnam-1965-b1-arctan-prefix z index)
         (/ (* sign (expt z degree))
            degree)))))

;; Machin's identity: pi = 16*arctan(1/5) - 4*arctan(1/239).
(defun putnam-1965-b1-pi-prefix (terms)
  (- (* 16
        (putnam-1965-b1-arctan-prefix 1/5 terms))
     (* 4
        (putnam-1965-b1-arctan-prefix 1/239 terms))))

(defun putnam-1965-b1-cosine-prefix (x terms)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix terms)))
  (if (zp terms)
      0
    (let* ((index (- terms 1))
           (degree (* 2 index))
           (sign (if (equal (mod index 2) 0) 1 -1)))
      (+ (putnam-1965-b1-cosine-prefix x index)
         (/ (* sign (expt x degree))
            (putnam-1965-b1-factorial degree))))))

;; CELL-INDEX is decoded in base SUBDIVISIONS.  Each digit selects one
;; midpoint coordinate, so this is x_1+...+x_DIMENSION for that grid cell.
(defun putnam-1965-b1-coordinate-sum
    (cell-index dimension subdivisions)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix dimension)))
  (if (zp dimension)
      0
    (+ (/ (+ (* 2 (mod cell-index subdivisions)) 1)
          (* 2 subdivisions))
       (putnam-1965-b1-coordinate-sum
        (floor cell-index subdivisions)
        (- dimension 1)
        subdivisions))))

(defun putnam-1965-b1-cell-value
    (cell-index dimension subdivisions series-terms)
  (let* ((coordinate-sum
          (putnam-1965-b1-coordinate-sum
           cell-index dimension subdivisions))
         (angle
          (/ (* (putnam-1965-b1-pi-prefix series-terms)
                coordinate-sum)
             (* 2 dimension)))
         (cosine
          (putnam-1965-b1-cosine-prefix
           angle series-terms)))
    (* cosine cosine)))

(defun putnam-1965-b1-cell-sum
    (remaining dimension subdivisions series-terms)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix remaining)))
  (if (zp remaining)
      0
    (let ((cell-index (- remaining 1)))
      (+ (putnam-1965-b1-cell-value
          cell-index dimension subdivisions series-terms)
         (putnam-1965-b1-cell-sum
          cell-index dimension subdivisions series-terms)))))

(defun putnam-1965-b1-integral-approx (n precision)
  (if (posp precision)
      (let* ((dimension (+ 1 (nfix n)))
             (subdivisions precision)
             (series-terms precision)
             (cell-count
              (expt subdivisions dimension)))
        (/ (putnam-1965-b1-cell-sum
            cell-count dimension subdivisions series-terms)
           cell-count))
    0))

;; For fixed N, this is the epsilon-tail definition of the inner limit that
;; constructs the corresponding real integral from rational approximants.
(defun-sk putnam-1965-b1-precision-tail-p
    (n epsilon cutoff)
  (forall (precision)
    (implies
     (and (natp precision)
          (<= cutoff precision))
     (< (abs
         (- (putnam-1965-b1-integral-approx
             n precision)
            1/2))
        epsilon))))

(defun-sk putnam-1965-b1-term-within-p (n epsilon)
  (exists (cutoff)
    (and
     (posp cutoff)
     (putnam-1965-b1-precision-tail-p
      n epsilon cutoff))))

;; Positive rational tolerances are cofinal among positive real tolerances.
;; The existential precision cutoff remains inside the universal sequence
;; index, matching "limit in precision" before "limit as N tends to infinity."
(defun-sk putnam-1965-b1-sequence-tail-p
    (epsilon start)
  (forall (n)
    (implies
     (and (natp n)
          (<= start n))
     (putnam-1965-b1-term-within-p n epsilon))))

(defun-sk putnam-1965-b1-limit-cutoff-exists-p (epsilon)
  (exists (start)
    (and
     (natp start)
     (putnam-1965-b1-sequence-tail-p
      epsilon start))))

(defun-sk putnambench-putnam-1965-b1-statement ()
  (forall (epsilon)
    (implies
     (and (rationalp epsilon)
          (< 0 epsilon))
     (putnam-1965-b1-limit-cutoff-exists-p
      epsilon))))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

title: putnam_1965_b1

-- Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1965_b1:
-- the limit of the integrals over unit cubes of a squared cosine of the
-- normalized coordinate sum is one half. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; _*_)

infix 4 _!=_ _<=N_
infixr 3 _and_
infixr 5 _::_

data Bottom : Set where

Not : Set -> Set
Not A =
  A -> Bottom

_!=_ : {A : Set} -> A -> A -> Set
x != y =
  Not (x == y)

record _and_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data _or_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  left  : A -> A or B
  right : B -> A or B

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

data _<=N_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set where
  zero<=   : {n : Nat} -> zero <=N n
  suc<=suc : {m n : Nat} -> m <=N n -> suc m <=N suc n

data Vec (A : Set) : Nat -> Set where
  []    : Vec A zero
  _::_  : {n : Nat} -> A -> Vec A n -> Vec A (suc n)

record CompleteOrderedField (R : Set) : Set1 where
  field
    zeroR oneR : R
    add multiply : R -> R -> R
    negate inverse : R -> R
    lessOrEqual : R -> R -> Set
    fromNat : Nat -> R

    one-not-zero :
      oneR != zeroR

    add-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> add x y == add y x
    add-associative :
      (x y z : R) -> add (add x y) z == add x (add y z)
    add-zero :
      (x : R) -> add x zeroR == x
    add-inverse :
      (x : R) -> add x (negate x) == zeroR

    multiply-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> multiply x y == multiply y x
    multiply-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply (multiply x y) z == multiply x (multiply y z)
    multiply-one :
      (x : R) -> multiply x oneR == x
    multiply-zero :
      (x : R) -> multiply x zeroR == zeroR
    distribute :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply x (add y z) ==
      add (multiply x y) (multiply x z)
    inverse-zero :
      inverse zeroR == zeroR
    multiply-inverse :
      (x : R) ->
      x != zeroR ->
      multiply x (inverse x) == oneR

    order-reflexive :
      (x : R) -> lessOrEqual x x
    order-transitive :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y z ->
      lessOrEqual x z
    order-antisymmetric :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y x ->
      x == y
    order-total :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y or lessOrEqual y x
    add-order :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual (add z x) (add z y)
    multiply-nonnegative :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR x ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR y ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR (multiply x y)
    zero-less-than-one :
      lessOrEqual zeroR oneR and zeroR != oneR

    fromNat-zero :
      fromNat zero == zeroR
    fromNat-successor :
      (n : Nat) -> fromNat (suc n) == add (fromNat n) oneR
    fromNat-addition :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m + n) == add (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-multiplication :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m * n) == multiply (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-injective :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat m == fromNat n ->
      m == n

    archimedean :
      (x : R) ->
      Exists Nat (\ n -> lessOrEqual x (fromNat n))
    least-upper-bound :
      (P : R -> Set) ->
      Exists R P ->
      Exists R
        (\ upper ->
          (x : R) ->
          P x ->
          lessOrEqual x upper) ->
      Exists R
        (\ supremum ->
          ((x : R) ->
            P x ->
            lessOrEqual x supremum)
          and
          ((upper : R) ->
            ((x : R) ->
              P x ->
              lessOrEqual x upper) ->
            lessOrEqual supremum upper))

open CompleteOrderedField

subtract :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
subtract reals x y =
  add reals x (negate reals y)

divide :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
divide reals x y =
  multiply reals x (inverse reals y)

square :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  R
square reals x =
  multiply reals x x

StrictLess :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
StrictLess reals x y =
  lessOrEqual reals x y and x != y

CloseTo :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
CloseTo reals center radius x =
  StrictLess reals
    (subtract reals center radius)
    x
  and
  StrictLess reals
    x
    (add reals center radius)

ConvergesTo :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  R ->
  Set
ConvergesTo {R} reals sequence limit =
  (epsilon : R) ->
  StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) epsilon ->
  Exists Nat
    (\ cutoff ->
      (n : Nat) ->
      cutoff <=N n ->
      CloseTo reals limit epsilon (sequence n))

naturalPower :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  Nat ->
  R
naturalPower reals x zero =
  oneR reals
naturalPower reals x (suc n) =
  multiply reals
    (naturalPower reals x n)
    x

factorial : Nat -> Nat
factorial zero =
  suc zero
factorial (suc n) =
  suc n * factorial n

sumFirst :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  Nat ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  R
sumFirst reals zero term =
  zeroR reals
sumFirst reals (suc n) term =
  add reals
    (sumFirst reals n term)
    (term n)

SeriesHasSum :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  R ->
  Set
SeriesHasSum reals terms limit =
  ConvergesTo reals
    (\ n -> sumFirst reals n terms)
    limit

double : Nat -> Nat
double zero =
  zero
double (suc n) =
  suc (suc (double n))

alternatingSign :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  Nat ->
  R
alternatingSign reals zero =
  oneR reals
alternatingSign reals (suc n) =
  negate reals (alternatingSign reals n)

cosineTerm :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  Nat ->
  R
cosineTerm reals x n =
  divide reals
    (multiply reals
      (alternatingSign reals n)
      (naturalPower reals x (double n)))
    (fromNat reals (factorial (double n)))

two : Nat
two =
  suc (suc zero)

record StandardCosine
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) :
  Set1 where

  field
    cosine : R -> R
    pi : R

    cosine-series :
      (x : R) ->
      SeriesHasSum reals
        (cosineTerm reals x)
        (cosine x)

    pi-positive :
      StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) pi
    cosine-half-pi :
      cosine
        (divide reals pi (fromNat reals two))
      ==
      zeroR reals
    cosine-positive-before-half-pi :
      (x : R) ->
      StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) x ->
      StrictLess reals
        x
        (divide reals pi (fromNat reals two)) ->
      StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) (cosine x)

open StandardCosine

uniformUnitSum :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  (R -> R) ->
  Nat ->
  R
uniformUnitSum reals function pieces =
  divide reals
    (sumFirst reals pieces
      (\ k ->
        function
          (divide reals
            (fromNat reals k)
            (fromNat reals pieces))))
    (fromNat reals pieces)

RiemannIntegralValue :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  (R -> R) ->
  R ->
  Set
RiemannIntegralValue reals function integralValue =
  ConvergesTo reals
    (\ n -> uniformUnitSum reals function (suc n))
    integralValue

RiemannIntegrable :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  (R -> R) ->
  Set
RiemannIntegrable {R} reals function =
  Exists R
    (\ integralValue ->
      RiemannIntegralValue reals function integralValue)

record UnitIntervalIntegration
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) :
  Set1 where

  field
    integral : (R -> R) -> R
    integral-is-riemann :
      (function : R -> R) ->
      RiemannIntegrable reals function ->
      RiemannIntegralValue reals function (integral function)

open UnitIntervalIntegration

cubeIntegral :
  {R : Set} ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) ->
  UnitIntervalIntegration reals ->
  (dimension : Nat) ->
  (Vec R dimension -> R) ->
  R
cubeIntegral reals integration zero function =
  function []
cubeIntegral reals integration (suc dimension) function =
  integral integration
    (\ x ->
      cubeIntegral reals integration dimension
        (\ xs -> function (x :: xs)))

sumCoordinates :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  {dimension : Nat} ->
  Vec R dimension ->
  R
sumCoordinates reals [] =
  zeroR reals
sumCoordinates reals (x :: xs) =
  add reals x (sumCoordinates reals xs)

putnamIntegrand :
  {R : Set} ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) ->
  StandardCosine reals ->
  (n : Nat) ->
  Vec R (suc n) ->
  R
putnamIntegrand reals analysis n point =
  square reals
    (cosine analysis
      (multiply reals
        (divide reals
          (pi analysis)
          (multiply reals
            (fromNat reals two)
            (fromNat reals (suc n))))
        (sumCoordinates reals point)))

putnam-1965-b1-solution :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R
putnam-1965-b1-solution reals =
  divide reals
    (oneR reals)
    (fromNat reals two)

putnam-1965-b1 : Set1
putnam-1965-b1 =
  (R : Set) ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) ->
  (analysis : StandardCosine reals) ->
  (integration : UnitIntervalIntegration reals) ->
  ConvergesTo reals
    (\ n ->
      cubeIntegral reals integration (suc n)
        (putnamIntegrand reals analysis n))
    (putnam-1965-b1-solution reals)

(*
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench artifact putnam_1965_b1:
  the limit of squared-cosine integrals over growing-dimensional unit cubes.
  This file contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open arithmeticTheory listTheory pred_setTheory realTheory real_topologyTheory;
open transcTheory integrationTheory;

val putnam_1965_b1 =
  ``let integrate_coordinate =
      \g : real list -> real.
      \xs : real list.
        integration$integral (interval [0, 1])
          (\x : real. g (x::xs))
    in
    let cube_integral =
      \n : num.
        FUNPOW integrate_coordinate (n + 1)
          (\xs : real list.
             cos (pi / (2 * &(n + 1)) * FOLDR $+ 0 xs) pow 2)
          []
    in
      (cube_integral --> (1 / 2 : real)) sequentially``;

title: putnam_1965_b1
content:
% Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench artifact putnam_1965_b1:
% the sequence of unit-hypercube integrals of the squared cosine of the
% normalized coordinate sum converges to one half. This file contains no proof.

putnam_1965_b1: THEORY
BEGIN
  real_function: TYPE = [real -> real]
  real_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> real]
  real_vector: TYPE = [nat -> real]
  vector_function: TYPE = [real_vector -> real]

  safe_div(numerator, denominator: real): real =
    IF denominator = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      numerator / denominator
    ENDIF

  factorial(index: nat): RECURSIVE nat =
    IF index = 0 THEN
      1
    ELSE
      index * factorial(index - 1)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE index

  alternating_sign(index: nat): RECURSIVE real =
    IF index = 0 THEN
      1
    ELSE
      -alternating_sign(index - 1)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE index

  cosine_partial_sum(count: nat, x: real): RECURSIVE real =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      LET index: nat = count - 1 IN
        cosine_partial_sum(count - 1, x)
          + safe_div(
              alternating_sign(index) * x ^ (2 * index),
              factorial(2 * index) :: real)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  converges_to(sequence: real_sequence, value: real): bool =
    FORALL (epsilon_value: posreal):
      EXISTS (cutoff: nat):
        FORALL (index: nat):
          cutoff <= index IMPLIES
            abs(sequence(index) - value) < epsilon_value

  cosine(x: real): real =
    epsilon(
      LAMBDA (value: real):
        converges_to(
          LAMBDA (count: nat):
            cosine_partial_sum(count, x),
          value))

  pi: real =
    epsilon(
      LAMBDA (value: real):
        3 < value
          AND value < 4
          AND cosine(value / 2) = 0)

  valid_partition(
      points: real_sequence,
      count: nat): bool =
    count > 0
      AND points(0) = 0
      AND points(count) = 1
      AND FORALL (index: nat):
        index < count IMPLIES
          points(index) < points(index + 1)

  valid_tags(
      points, tags: real_sequence,
      count: nat): bool =
    FORALL (index: nat):
      index < count IMPLIES
        points(index) <= tags(index)
          AND tags(index) <= points(index + 1)

  mesh_less_than(
      points: real_sequence,
      count: nat,
      bound: real): bool =
    FORALL (index: nat):
      index < count IMPLIES
        points(index + 1) - points(index) < bound

  riemann_sum(
      f: real_function,
      points, tags: real_sequence,
      count: nat): RECURSIVE real =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      riemann_sum(f, points, tags, count - 1)
        + f(tags(count - 1))
            * (points(count) - points(count - 1))
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  has_unit_interval_integral(
      f: real_function,
      integral_value: real): bool =
    FORALL (epsilon_value: posreal):
      EXISTS (mesh_bound: posreal):
        FORALL
            (points, tags: real_sequence),
            (count: nat):
          (valid_partition(points, count)
            AND valid_tags(points, tags, count)
            AND mesh_less_than(
              points, count, mesh_bound))
          IMPLIES
            abs(
              riemann_sum(f, points, tags, count)
                - integral_value)
              < epsilon_value

  unit_interval_integral(f: real_function): real =
    IF EXISTS (integral_value: real):
        has_unit_interval_integral(f, integral_value)
    THEN
      epsilon(
        LAMBDA (integral_value: real):
          has_unit_interval_integral(
            f, integral_value))
    ELSE
      0
    ENDIF

  zero_vector: real_vector =
    LAMBDA (index: nat): 0

  set_coordinate(
      x: real_vector,
      index: nat,
      value: real): real_vector =
    LAMBDA (coordinate: nat):
      IF coordinate = index THEN value ELSE x(coordinate) ENDIF

  iterated_unit_cube_integral(
      f: vector_function,
      dimension: nat): RECURSIVE real =
    IF dimension = 0 THEN
      f(zero_vector)
    ELSE
      unit_interval_integral(
        LAMBDA (coordinate_value: real):
          iterated_unit_cube_integral(
            LAMBDA (x: real_vector):
              f(set_coordinate(
                x, dimension - 1, coordinate_value)),
            dimension - 1))
    ENDIF
  MEASURE dimension

  coordinate_sum(
      x: real_vector,
      count: nat): RECURSIVE real =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      coordinate_sum(x, count - 1) + x(count - 1)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  cube_integrand(
      dimension: nat,
      x: real_vector): real =
    cosine(
      safe_div(pi, 2 * (dimension :: real))
        * coordinate_sum(x, dimension)) ^ 2

  integral_sequence(index: nat): real =
    LET dimension: nat = index + 1 IN
      iterated_unit_cube_integral(
        LAMBDA (x: real_vector):
          cube_integrand(dimension, x),
        dimension)

  putnam_1965_b1_solution: real = 1 / 2

  putnam_1965_b1: bool =
    converges_to(
      LAMBDA (index: nat): integral_sequence(index),
      putnam_1965_b1_solution)
END putnam_1965_b1

import Mathlib

open EuclideanGeometry Topology Filter Complex

/--
A round-robin tournament has $n > 1$ players $P_1, P_2, \dots, P_n$, who each play one game with each other player. Each game results in a win for one player and a loss for the other. If $w_r$ and $l_r$ denote the number of games won and lost, respectively, by $P_r$, prove that $$\sum_{r=1}^{n} w_r^2 = \sum_{r=1}^{n} l_r^2.$$
-/
theorem putnam_1965_b2
(n : ℕ)
(hn : n > 1)
(won : Fin n → Fin n → Bool)
(hirrefl : ∀ i : Fin n, won i i = false)
(hantisymm : ∀ i j : Fin n, i ≠ j → won i j = ¬won j i)
(w l : Fin n → ℤ)
(hw : w = fun r : Fin n => ∑ j : Fin n, (if won r j then 1 else 0))
(hl : l = fun r : Fin n => n - 1 - w r)
: ∑ r : Fin n, (w r)^2 = ∑ r : Fin n, (l r)^2 :=
sorry

;; Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench artifact putnam_1965_b2:
;; equality of the sums of squared win and loss counts in a finite
;; round-robin tournament. This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

;; The source finite player type is represented by the canonical carrier
;; 0,...,n-1. Any n-element type is bijective with this carrier, and transport
;; along such a bijection preserves the tournament axioms and both sums.
;; WON is an ACL2 function object evaluated by APPLY$, not a finite table.

(defun putnam-1965-b2-won-value (won player opponent)
  (apply$ won (list player opponent)))

(defun putnam-1965-b2-boolean-row-p
    (won player remaining-opponents)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix remaining-opponents)))
  (if (zp remaining-opponents)
      t
    (let ((opponent (- remaining-opponents 1)))
      (and
       (booleanp
        (putnam-1965-b2-won-value won player opponent))
       (putnam-1965-b2-boolean-row-p
        won player opponent)))))

(defun putnam-1965-b2-boolean-matrix-p
    (won remaining-players n)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix remaining-players)))
  (if (zp remaining-players)
      t
    (let ((player (- remaining-players 1)))
      (and
       (putnam-1965-b2-boolean-row-p won player n)
       (putnam-1965-b2-boolean-matrix-p
        won player n)))))

(defun putnam-1965-b2-irreflexive-p
    (won remaining-players)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix remaining-players)))
  (if (zp remaining-players)
      t
    (let ((player (- remaining-players 1)))
      (and
       (equal
        (putnam-1965-b2-won-value won player player)
        nil)
       (putnam-1965-b2-irreflexive-p won player)))))

(defun putnam-1965-b2-antisymmetric-row-p
    (won player remaining-opponents)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix remaining-opponents)))
  (if (zp remaining-opponents)
      t
    (let ((opponent (- remaining-opponents 1)))
      (and
       (or
        (equal player opponent)
        (equal
         (putnam-1965-b2-won-value won player opponent)
         (not
          (putnam-1965-b2-won-value
           won opponent player))))
       (putnam-1965-b2-antisymmetric-row-p
        won player opponent)))))

(defun putnam-1965-b2-antisymmetric-p
    (won remaining-players n)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix remaining-players)))
  (if (zp remaining-players)
      t
    (let ((player (- remaining-players 1)))
      (and
       (putnam-1965-b2-antisymmetric-row-p
        won player n)
       (putnam-1965-b2-antisymmetric-p
        won player n)))))

(defun putnam-1965-b2-win-count
    (won player remaining-opponents)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix remaining-opponents)))
  (if (zp remaining-opponents)
      0
    (let ((opponent (- remaining-opponents 1)))
      (+
       (if (putnam-1965-b2-won-value
            won player opponent)
           1
         0)
       (putnam-1965-b2-win-count
        won player opponent)))))

(defun putnam-1965-b2-sum-win-squares
    (won remaining-players n)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix remaining-players)))
  (if (zp remaining-players)
      0
    (let* ((player (- remaining-players 1))
           (wins
            (putnam-1965-b2-win-count won player n)))
      (+
       (* wins wins)
       (putnam-1965-b2-sum-win-squares
        won player n)))))

(defun putnam-1965-b2-sum-loss-squares
    (won remaining-players n)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix remaining-players)))
  (if (zp remaining-players)
      0
    (let* ((player (- remaining-players 1))
           (wins
            (putnam-1965-b2-win-count won player n))
           (losses (- (- n 1) wins)))
      (+
       (* losses losses)
       (putnam-1965-b2-sum-loss-squares
        won player n)))))

;; W and L from the source are definitionally eliminated by substituting
;; w(r) = sum_j if won(r,j) then 1 else 0 and l(r) = n - 1 - w(r).
(defun putnambench-putnam-1965-b2-statement (n won)
  (implies
   (and
    (natp n)
    (< 1 n)
    (putnam-1965-b2-boolean-matrix-p won n n)
    (putnam-1965-b2-irreflexive-p won n)
    (putnam-1965-b2-antisymmetric-p won n n))
   (equal
    (putnam-1965-b2-sum-win-squares won n n)
    (putnam-1965-b2-sum-loss-squares won n n))))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

-- Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1965_b2:
-- in a finite round-robin tournament with more than one player, the sum of
-- squared win counts equals the sum of squared loss counts. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

open import Agda.Builtin.Bool using (Bool; false; true)
open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Int using (Int; pos; negsuc)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; _*_)

infix 4 _!=_ _<N_

data Bottom : Set where

Not : Set -> Set
Not A =
  A -> Bottom

_!=_ : {A : Set} -> A -> A -> Set
x != y =
  Not (x == y)

data _<N_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set where
  zero<suc : {n : Nat} -> zero <N suc n
  suc<suc  : {m n : Nat} -> m <N n -> suc m <N suc n

data Fin : Nat -> Set where
  fzero : {n : Nat} -> Fin (suc n)
  fsuc  : {n : Nat} -> Fin n -> Fin (suc n)

notBool : Bool -> Bool
notBool false =
  true
notBool true =
  false

negative : Nat -> Int
negative zero =
  pos zero
negative (suc n) =
  negsuc n

difference : Nat -> Nat -> Int
difference zero zero =
  pos zero
difference (suc m) zero =
  pos (suc m)
difference zero (suc n) =
  negsuc n
difference (suc m) (suc n) =
  difference m n

addInt : Int -> Int -> Int
addInt (pos m) (pos n) =
  pos (m + n)
addInt (pos m) (negsuc n) =
  difference m (suc n)
addInt (negsuc m) (pos n) =
  difference n (suc m)
addInt (negsuc m) (negsuc n) =
  negsuc (suc (m + n))

negateInt : Int -> Int
negateInt (pos n) =
  negative n
negateInt (negsuc n) =
  pos (suc n)

subtractInt : Int -> Int -> Int
subtractInt x y =
  addInt x (negateInt y)

multiplyInt : Int -> Int -> Int
multiplyInt (pos m) (pos n) =
  pos (m * n)
multiplyInt (pos m) (negsuc n) =
  negative (m * suc n)
multiplyInt (negsuc m) (pos n) =
  negative (suc m * n)
multiplyInt (negsuc m) (negsuc n) =
  pos (suc m * suc n)

squareInt : Int -> Int
squareInt x =
  multiplyInt x x

indicator : Bool -> Int
indicator false =
  pos zero
indicator true =
  pos (suc zero)

sumFin : {n : Nat} -> (Fin n -> Int) -> Int
sumFin {zero} terms =
  pos zero
sumFin {suc n} terms =
  addInt
    (terms fzero)
    (sumFin (\ i -> terms (fsuc i)))

FunctionEqual :
  {A B : Set} ->
  (A -> B) ->
  (A -> B) ->
  Set
FunctionEqual f g =
  (x : _) -> f x == g x

oneN : Nat
oneN =
  suc zero

oneZ : Int
oneZ =
  pos oneN

putnam-1965-b2 : Set
putnam-1965-b2 =
  (n : Nat) ->
  oneN <N n ->
  (won : Fin n -> Fin n -> Bool) ->
  ((i : Fin n) -> won i i == false) ->
  ((i j : Fin n) -> i != j -> won i j == notBool (won j i)) ->
  (w l : Fin n -> Int) ->
  FunctionEqual w
    (\ r ->
      sumFin
        (\ j -> indicator (won r j))) ->
  FunctionEqual l
    (\ r ->
      subtractInt
        (subtractInt (pos n) oneZ)
        (w r)) ->
  sumFin (\ r -> squareInt (w r))
  ==
  sumFin (\ r -> squareInt (l r))

  win counts equals the sum of the squares of their loss counts. This file
  contains no proof.

$(
  P is an arbitrary finite player set of cardinality n. The subset W of
  P X. P is the true-pair relation of the source Boolean-valued function won:
  <. i , j >. e. W means that i defeated j. Thus relation membership and its
  negation give a bidirectional encoding of the two Boolean values.

  equated to the win-cardinality and n - 1 - w definitions. The final
  declaration is the single unproved $a corpus statement; this database
  contains no $p proof statement.

${
  $d P W i j n r w l $.

  putnambench-putnam-1965-b2 $a |- A. n e. NN0
    A. P e. Fin
      A. W e. ~P ( P X. P )
        A. w e. ( ZZ ^m P )
          A. l e. ( ZZ ^m P )
            (
              (
                (
                  (
                    ( # ` P ) = n
                    /\
                    1 < n
                  )
                  /\
                  A. i e. P -. <. i , i >. e. W
                )
                /\
                A. i e. P A. j e. P

                    i =/= j
                    ->

                      <->

                    r e. P |->

              sum_ r e. P ( ( w ` r ) ^ 2 )

            =
            (
              sum_ r e. P ( ( l ` r ) ^ 2 )

title: putnam_1965_b2
content:
% Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench artifact putnam_1965_b2:
% in a finite round-robin tournament with n > 1 players, the sum of squared
% win counts equals the sum of squared loss counts. This file contains no proof.

putnam_1965_b2: THEORY
BEGIN
  win_count(
      won: [nat, nat -> bool],
      player, count: nat): RECURSIVE int =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      win_count(won, player, count - 1)
        + IF won(player, count - 1) THEN 1 ELSE 0 ENDIF
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  square_prefix_sum(
      values: [nat -> int],
      count: nat): RECURSIVE int =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      square_prefix_sum(values, count - 1)
        + values(count - 1) ^ 2
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  putnam_1965_b2: bool =
    FORALL
        (n: nat),
        (won: [nat, nat -> bool]),
        (w, l: [nat -> int]):
      (n > 1
        AND (FORALL (i: nat):
          i < n IMPLIES won(i, i) = FALSE)
        AND (FORALL (i, j: nat):
          (i < n AND j < n AND i /= j)
            IMPLIES won(i, j) = NOT won(j, i))
        AND (FORALL (r: nat):
          r < n IMPLIES w(r) = win_count(won, r, n))
        AND (FORALL (r: nat):
          r < n IMPLIES
            l(r) = (n :: int) - 1 - w(r)))
      IMPLIES
        square_prefix_sum(w, n) = square_prefix_sum(l, n)
END putnam_1965_b2

;; Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench artifact putnam_1965_b3:
;; exactly three positive integer right triangles, with the shorter leg first,
;; have area equal to twice their perimeter. This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

;; This is the source predicate on integer triples. ACL2 division is exact on
;; rationals, matching the rational area equation in the Lean and Rocq sources;
;; the Isabelle integer division agrees because a*b is even for every integer
;; Pythagorean triple.
(defun putnam-1965-b3-solution-p (a b c)
  (and (integerp a)
       (integerp b)
       (integerp c)
       (< 0 a)
       (<= a b)
       (< 0 c)
       (equal (+ (* a a) (* b b))
              (* c c))
       (equal (/ (* a b) 2)
              (* 2 (+ a b c)))))

;; Exact cardinality is expressed without a proof-derived search bound:
;; three distinct triples are solutions, and every solution is one of them.

(defun putnam-1965-b3-same-triple-p
    (a b c x y z)
  (and (equal a x)
       (equal b y)
       (equal c z)))

(defun-sk putnam-1965-b3-all-solutions-listed-p
    (a1 b1 c1 a2 b2 c2 a3 b3 c3)
  (forall (a b c)
    (implies
     (putnam-1965-b3-solution-p a b c)
     (or
      (putnam-1965-b3-same-triple-p a b c a1 b1 c1)
      (putnam-1965-b3-same-triple-p a b c a2 b2 c2)
      (putnam-1965-b3-same-triple-p a b c a3 b3 c3)))))

(defun putnam-1965-b3-exactly-three-witness-p
    (a1 b1 c1 a2 b2 c2 a3 b3 c3)
  (and
   (putnam-1965-b3-solution-p a1 b1 c1)
   (putnam-1965-b3-solution-p a2 b2 c2)
   (putnam-1965-b3-solution-p a3 b3 c3)
   (not (putnam-1965-b3-same-triple-p a1 b1 c1 a2 b2 c2))
   (not (putnam-1965-b3-same-triple-p a1 b1 c1 a3 b3 c3))
   (not (putnam-1965-b3-same-triple-p a2 b2 c2 a3 b3 c3))
   (putnam-1965-b3-all-solutions-listed-p
    a1 b1 c1 a2 b2 c2 a3 b3 c3)))

(defun-sk putnambench-putnam-1965-b3-statement ()
  (exists (a1 b1 c1 a2 b2 c2 a3 b3 c3)
    (putnam-1965-b3-exactly-three-witness-p
     a1 b1 c1 a2 b2 c2 a3 b3 c3)))

-- Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1965_b3:
-- exactly three positive integer right-triangle side triples with ordered legs
-- have area equal to twice their perimeter. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Int using (Int; pos; negsuc)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; _*_)

infix 4 _<=N_
infixr 3 _and_

record _and_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

data _<=N_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set where
  zero<=   : {n : Nat} -> zero <=N n
  suc<=suc : {m n : Nat} -> m <=N n -> suc m <=N suc n

data IntLessOrEqual : Int -> Int -> Set where
  positive<=positive :
    {m n : Nat} ->
    m <=N n ->
    IntLessOrEqual (pos m) (pos n)
  negative<=positive :
    {m n : Nat} ->
    IntLessOrEqual (negsuc m) (pos n)
  negative<=negative :
    {m n : Nat} ->
    n <=N m ->
    IntLessOrEqual (negsuc m) (negsuc n)

data Positive : Int -> Set where
  positive :
    {n : Nat} ->
    Positive (pos (suc n))

negative : Nat -> Int
negative zero =
  pos zero
negative (suc n) =
  negsuc n

difference : Nat -> Nat -> Int
difference zero zero =
  pos zero
difference (suc m) zero =
  pos (suc m)
difference zero (suc n) =
  negsuc n
difference (suc m) (suc n) =
  difference m n

addInt : Int -> Int -> Int
addInt (pos m) (pos n) =
  pos (m + n)
addInt (pos m) (negsuc n) =
  difference m (suc n)
addInt (negsuc m) (pos n) =
  difference n (suc m)
addInt (negsuc m) (negsuc n) =
  negsuc (suc (m + n))

multiplyInt : Int -> Int -> Int
multiplyInt (pos m) (pos n) =
  pos (m * n)
multiplyInt (pos m) (negsuc n) =
  negative (m * suc n)
multiplyInt (negsuc m) (pos n) =
  negative (suc m * n)
multiplyInt (negsuc m) (negsuc n) =
  pos (suc m * suc n)

squareInt : Int -> Int
squareInt x =
  multiplyInt x x

one : Nat
one =
  suc zero

two : Nat
two =
  suc one

three : Nat
three =
  suc two

fourZ : Int
fourZ =
  pos (suc three)

record Triple : Set where
  constructor triple
  field
    first-coordinate  : Int
    second-coordinate : Int
    third-coordinate  : Int

open Triple

TriangleSolution : Triple -> Set
TriangleSolution sides =
  Positive (first-coordinate sides)
  and
  IntLessOrEqual
    (first-coordinate sides)
    (second-coordinate sides)
  and
  Positive (third-coordinate sides)
  and
  addInt
    (squareInt (first-coordinate sides))
    (squareInt (second-coordinate sides))
  ==
  squareInt (third-coordinate sides)
  and
  multiplyInt
    (first-coordinate sides)
    (second-coordinate sides)
  ==
  multiplyInt fourZ
    (addInt
      (addInt
        (first-coordinate sides)
        (second-coordinate sides))
      (third-coordinate sides))

data Fin : Nat -> Set where
  fzero : {n : Nat} -> Fin (suc n)
  fsuc  : {n : Nat} -> Fin n -> Fin (suc n)

record HasCardinality
  {A : Set}
  (P : A -> Set)
  (cardinality : Nat) :
  Set where

  field
    enumerate :
      Fin cardinality ->
      A
    enumerated-member :
      (index : Fin cardinality) ->
      P (enumerate index)
    enumeration-complete :
      (item : A) ->
      P item ->
      Exists (Fin cardinality)
        (\ index -> item == enumerate index)
    enumeration-injective :
      (left-index right-index : Fin cardinality) ->
      enumerate left-index == enumerate right-index ->
      left-index == right-index

putnam-1965-b3 : Set
putnam-1965-b3 =
  HasCardinality TriangleSolution three

import Mathlib

open EuclideanGeometry Topology Filter Complex

noncomputable abbrev putnam_1965_b4_solution : ((((ℝ → ℝ) → (ℝ → ℝ)) × ((ℝ → ℝ) → (ℝ → ℝ))) × ((Set ℝ) × (ℝ → ℝ))) := sorry
-- ((fun h : ℝ → ℝ => h + (fun x : ℝ => x), fun h : ℝ → ℝ => h + (fun _ : ℝ => 1)), ({x : ℝ | x ≥ 0}, Real.sqrt))
/--
Let $$f(x, n) = \frac{{n \choose 0} + {n \choose 2}x + {n \choose 4}x^2 + \cdots}{{n \choose 1} + {n \choose 3}x + {n \choose 5}x^2 + \cdots}$$ for all real numbers $x$ and positive integers $n$. Express $f(x, n+1)$ as a rational function involving $f(x, n)$ and $x$, and find $\lim_{n \to \infty} f(x, n)$ for all $x$ for which this limit converges.
-/
theorem putnam_1965_b4
    (f u v : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ)
    (hu : ∀ n > 0, ∀ x, u n x = ∑ i ∈ Finset.Icc 0 (n / 2), (n.choose (2 * i)) * x ^ i)
    (hv : ∀ n > 0, ∀ x, v n x = ∑ i ∈ Finset.Icc 0 ((n - 1) / 2), (n.choose (2 * i + 1)) * x ^ i)
    (hf : ∀ n > 0, ∀ x, f n x = u n x / v n x)
    (n : ℕ)
    (hn : 0 < n) :
    let ⟨⟨p, q⟩, ⟨s, g⟩⟩ := putnam_1965_b4_solution
    (∀ x, v n x ≠ 0 → v (n + 1) x ≠ 0 → q (f n) x ≠ 0 → f (n + 1) x = p (f n) x / q (f n) x) ∧
    s = {x | ∃ l, Tendsto (fun n ↦ f n x) atTop (𝓝 l)} ∧
    ∀ x ∈ s, Tendsto (fun n ↦ f n x) atTop (𝓝 (g x)) :=
  sorry

    (hv : forall n : nat, gt n 0 -> forall x : R, v n x = \sum_(0 <= i < (n.-1)%/2 .+1) ('C(n, 2 * i + 1)%:R * x^i))
    (hf : forall n : nat, gt n 0 -> forall x : R, f n x = u n x / v n x)
    (n : nat)
    (hn : gt n 0)
    (f_seq : R -> (nat -> R) := fun (x : R) => fun (m : nat) => f m x) :
    let '((p, q), (s, g)) := putnam_1965_b4_solution in
        (forall x : R, v n x <> 0 -> v (n.+1) x <> 0 -> q (f n) x <> 0 -> f (n.+1) x = p (f n) x / q (f n) x) /\

  the recurrence and pointwise convergence set for a quotient of the even
  and odd parts of a binomial expansion. This file contains no proof.

let library_output = open_out "/dev/null";;
let library_formatter = Format.formatter_of_out_channel library_output;;
let binomial_loaded =
  Toploop.use_file library_formatter "Library/binomial.ml";;
let analysis_loaded =

close_out library_output;;

if not analysis_loaded then failwith "failed to load Library/analysis.ml";;

let statement =
  `let p = \(h:real->real) (x:real). h x + x in
   let q = \(h:real->real) (x:real). h x + &1 in
   let s = \x:real. &0 <= x in
   let g = \x:real. sqrt x in
   !f u v:num->real->real. !n:num.
     (!m:num. 0 < m
              ==> !x:real.
                    u m x =
                    sum (0..m DIV 2)
                        (\i. &(binom (m,2 * i)) * x pow i)) /\
     (!m:num. 0 < m
              ==> !x:real.
                    v m x =
                    sum (0..(m - 1) DIV 2)
                        (\i. &(binom (m,2 * i + 1)) * x pow i)) /\
     (!m:num. 0 < m
              ==> !x:real. f m x = u m x / v m x) /\
     0 < n
     ==> (!x:real.
            ~(v n x = &0)
            ==> ~(v (n + 1) x = &0)
            ==> ~(q (f n) x = &0)
            ==> f (n + 1) x = p (f n) x / q (f n) x) /\
         s = {x:real | ?l:real.
                       (\m:num. f m x) tends_num_real l} /\
         (!x:real. s x
                   ==> (\m:num. f m x) tends_num_real (g x))`;;
