;; Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1965_b4:
;; the recurrence, convergence domain, and square-root limit of ratios of the
;; even and odd binomial sums. This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))

;; The source sequence has an explicit algebraic recurrence and explicit
;; square-root limit. It therefore needs field algebra, order, the
;; Archimedean property, and nonnegative square roots, but not quantification
;; over arbitrary subsets of the real line. Conservative generic symbols
;; preserve arbitrary scalar values without restricting them to ACL2
;; rationals or APPLY$-tame objects.

(defstub p65b4-scalar-p (x) t)
(defstub p65b4-add (x y) t)
(defstub p65b4-multiply (x y) t)
(defstub p65b4-negate (x) t)
(defstub p65b4-inverse (x) t)
(defstub p65b4-less (x y) t)
(defstub p65b4-square-root (x) t)
(defstub p65b4-archimedean-bound (x) t)

(defun p65b4-member-p (x)
  (if (p65b4-scalar-p x) t nil))

(defun p65b4-less-p (x y)
  (if (p65b4-less x y) t nil))

(defun p65b4-subtract (x y)
  (p65b4-add x (p65b4-negate y)))

(defun p65b4-divide (x y)
  (p65b4-multiply x (p65b4-inverse y)))

(defun p65b4-absolute-value (zero x)
  (if (p65b4-less-p x zero)
      (p65b4-negate x)
    x))

(defun p65b4-positive-p (zero x)
  (and
   (p65b4-member-p x)
   (p65b4-less-p zero x)))

(defun p65b4-nonnegative-p (zero x)
  (and
   (p65b4-member-p x)
   (not (p65b4-less-p x zero))))

(defun-sk p65b4-field-laws-p (zero one)
  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (p65b4-member-p x)
      (p65b4-member-p y)
      (p65b4-member-p z))
     (and
      (p65b4-member-p (p65b4-add x y))
      (p65b4-member-p (p65b4-multiply x y))
      (p65b4-member-p (p65b4-negate x))
      (p65b4-member-p (p65b4-inverse x))
      (equal
       (p65b4-add (p65b4-add x y) z)
       (p65b4-add x (p65b4-add y z)))
      (equal (p65b4-add x y) (p65b4-add y x))
      (equal (p65b4-add x zero) x)
      (equal (p65b4-add x (p65b4-negate x)) zero)
      (equal
       (p65b4-multiply (p65b4-multiply x y) z)
       (p65b4-multiply x (p65b4-multiply y z)))
      (equal (p65b4-multiply x y) (p65b4-multiply y x))
      (equal (p65b4-multiply x one) x)
      (implies
       (equal x zero)
       (equal (p65b4-inverse x) zero))
      (implies
       (not (equal x zero))
       (equal
        (p65b4-multiply x (p65b4-inverse x))
        one))
      (equal
       (p65b4-multiply x (p65b4-add y z))
       (p65b4-add
        (p65b4-multiply x y)
        (p65b4-multiply x z)))))))

(defun-sk p65b4-order-laws-p (zero)
  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (p65b4-member-p x)
      (p65b4-member-p y)
      (p65b4-member-p z))
     (and
      (not (p65b4-less-p x x))
      (or
       (equal x y)
       (p65b4-less-p x y)
       (p65b4-less-p y x))
      (implies
       (and
        (p65b4-less-p x y)
        (p65b4-less-p y z))
       (p65b4-less-p x z))
      (implies
       (p65b4-less-p x y)
       (p65b4-less-p
        (p65b4-add x z)
        (p65b4-add y z)))
      (implies
       (and
        (p65b4-less-p zero x)
        (p65b4-less-p zero y))
       (p65b4-less-p
        zero
        (p65b4-multiply x y)))))))

(defun p65b4-natural-value (zero one n)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix n)))
  (if (zp n)
      zero
    (p65b4-add
     (p65b4-natural-value zero one (- n 1))
     one)))

(defun-sk p65b4-archimedean-law-p (zero one)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (p65b4-member-p x)
     (and
      (natp (p65b4-archimedean-bound x))
      (p65b4-less-p
       x
       (p65b4-natural-value
        zero one
        (p65b4-archimedean-bound x)))))))

(defun-sk p65b4-square-root-laws-p (zero)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (p65b4-nonnegative-p zero x)
     (and
      (p65b4-member-p (p65b4-square-root x))
      (not (p65b4-less-p (p65b4-square-root x) zero))
      (equal
       (p65b4-multiply
        (p65b4-square-root x)
        (p65b4-square-root x))
       x)))))

(defun p65b4-real-algebra-p (zero one)
  (and
   (p65b4-member-p zero)
   (p65b4-member-p one)
   (not (equal zero one))
   (p65b4-field-laws-p zero one)
   (p65b4-order-laws-p zero)
   (p65b4-less-p zero one)
   (p65b4-archimedean-law-p zero one)
   (p65b4-square-root-laws-p zero)))

;; Starting from (u_0,v_0)=(1,0), this update expands to the source's
;; even-indexed and odd-indexed binomial sums:
;;
;;   (u_(n+1),v_(n+1))=(u_n+x*v_n,u_n+v_n).
;;
;; The source only constrains positive indices, so fixing index zero does not
;; affect either convergence or the limit.

(defun p65b4-state (n x zero one)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix n)))
  (if (zp n)
      (cons one zero)
    (let* ((previous
            (p65b4-state (- n 1) x zero one))
           (u (car previous))
           (v (cdr previous)))
      (cons
       (p65b4-add u (p65b4-multiply x v))
       (p65b4-add u v)))))

(defun p65b4-u (n x zero one)
  (car (p65b4-state n x zero one)))

(defun p65b4-v (n x zero one)
  (cdr (p65b4-state n x zero one)))

(defun p65b4-f (n x zero one)
  (p65b4-divide
   (p65b4-u n x zero one)
   (p65b4-v n x zero one)))

(defun-sk p65b4-convergence-tail-p
    (zero one x limit epsilon cutoff)
  (forall (index)
    (implies
     (and
      (natp index)
      (<= cutoff index))
     (p65b4-less-p
      (p65b4-absolute-value
       zero
       (p65b4-subtract
        (p65b4-f index x zero one)
        limit))
      epsilon))))

(defun-sk p65b4-convergence-cutoff-exists-p
    (zero one x limit epsilon)
  (exists (cutoff)
    (and
     (natp cutoff)
     (p65b4-convergence-tail-p
      zero one x limit epsilon cutoff))))

(defun-sk p65b4-converges-to-p (zero one x limit)
  (forall (epsilon)
    (implies
     (p65b4-positive-p zero epsilon)
     (p65b4-convergence-cutoff-exists-p
      zero one x limit epsilon))))

(defun-sk p65b4-limit-exists-p (zero one x)
  (exists (limit)
    (and
     (p65b4-member-p limit)
     (p65b4-converges-to-p zero one x limit))))

(defun-sk p65b4-recurrence-p (zero one)
  (forall (n x)
    (implies
     (and
      (posp n)
      (p65b4-member-p x))
     (let* ((v-n (p65b4-v n x zero one))
            (v-next (p65b4-v (+ n 1) x zero one))
            (f-n (p65b4-f n x zero one))
            (q-f-n (p65b4-add f-n one)))
       (implies
        (and
         (not (equal v-n zero))
         (not (equal v-next zero))
         (not (equal q-f-n zero)))
        (equal
         (p65b4-f (+ n 1) x zero one)
         (p65b4-divide
          (p65b4-add f-n x)
          q-f-n)))))))

(defun-sk p65b4-convergence-domain-p (zero one)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (p65b4-member-p x)
     (iff
      (p65b4-limit-exists-p zero one x)
      (p65b4-nonnegative-p zero x)))))

(defun-sk p65b4-square-root-limits-p (zero one)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (p65b4-nonnegative-p zero x)
     (p65b4-converges-to-p
      zero one x (p65b4-square-root x)))))

(defun putnambench-putnam-1965-b4-statement (zero one)
  (implies
   (p65b4-real-algebra-p zero one)
   (and
    (p65b4-recurrence-p zero one)
    (p65b4-convergence-domain-p zero one)
    (p65b4-square-root-limits-p zero one))))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

title: putnam_1965_b4
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1965_b4:
-- the binomial-sum quotient satisfies a rational recurrence, converges exactly
-- for nonnegative real inputs, and then tends to the square root. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; _-_; _*_)

infix 4 _!=_ _<=N_
infixr 3 _and_
infixr 2 _or_

data Bottom : Set where

Not : Set -> Set
Not A =
  A -> Bottom

_!=_ : {A : Set} -> A -> A -> Set
x != y =
  Not (x == y)

record _and_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data _or_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  left  : A -> A or B
  right : B -> A or B

record Iff (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor equivalence
  field
    forward  : A -> B
    backward : B -> A

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

data _<=N_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set where
  zero<=   : {n : Nat} -> zero <=N n
  suc<=suc : {m n : Nat} -> m <=N n -> suc m <=N suc n

data Positive : Nat -> Set where
  positive : {n : Nat} -> Positive (suc n)

oneN : Nat
oneN =
  suc zero

twoN : Nat
twoN =
  suc oneN

halfFloor : Nat -> Nat
halfFloor zero =
  zero
halfFloor (suc zero) =
  zero
halfFloor (suc (suc n)) =
  suc (halfFloor n)

choose : Nat -> Nat -> Nat
choose n zero =
  oneN
choose zero (suc k) =
  zero
choose (suc n) (suc k) =
  choose n (suc k) + choose n k

record CompleteOrderedField (R : Set) : Set1 where
  field
    zeroR oneR : R
    add multiply : R -> R -> R
    negate inverse : R -> R
    lessOrEqual : R -> R -> Set
    fromNat : Nat -> R

    one-not-zero :
      oneR != zeroR

    add-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> add x y == add y x
    add-associative :
      (x y z : R) -> add (add x y) z == add x (add y z)
    add-zero :
      (x : R) -> add x zeroR == x
    add-inverse :
      (x : R) -> add x (negate x) == zeroR

    multiply-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> multiply x y == multiply y x
    multiply-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply (multiply x y) z == multiply x (multiply y z)
    multiply-one :
      (x : R) -> multiply x oneR == x
    multiply-zero :
      (x : R) -> multiply x zeroR == zeroR
    distribute :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply x (add y z) ==
      add (multiply x y) (multiply x z)
    inverse-zero :
      inverse zeroR == zeroR
    multiply-inverse :
      (x : R) ->
      x != zeroR ->
      multiply x (inverse x) == oneR

    order-reflexive :
      (x : R) -> lessOrEqual x x
    order-transitive :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y z ->
      lessOrEqual x z
    order-antisymmetric :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y x ->
      x == y
    order-total :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y or lessOrEqual y x
    add-order :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual (add z x) (add z y)
    multiply-nonnegative :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR x ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR y ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR (multiply x y)
    zero-less-than-one :
      lessOrEqual zeroR oneR and zeroR != oneR

    fromNat-zero :
      fromNat zero == zeroR
    fromNat-successor :
      (n : Nat) -> fromNat (suc n) == add (fromNat n) oneR
    fromNat-addition :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m + n) == add (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-multiplication :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m * n) == multiply (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-injective :
      (m n : Nat) -> fromNat m == fromNat n -> m == n

    archimedean :
      (x : R) ->
      Exists Nat (\ n -> lessOrEqual x (fromNat n))
    least-upper-bound :
      (P : R -> Set) ->
      Exists R P ->
      Exists R
        (\ upper ->
          (x : R) ->
          P x ->
          lessOrEqual x upper) ->
      Exists R
        (\ supremum ->
          ((x : R) ->
            P x ->
            lessOrEqual x supremum)
          and
          ((upper : R) ->
            ((x : R) ->
              P x ->
              lessOrEqual x upper) ->
            lessOrEqual supremum upper))

open CompleteOrderedField

subtract :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
subtract reals x y =
  add reals x (negate reals y)

divide :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
divide reals x y =
  multiply reals x (inverse reals y)

StrictLess :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
StrictLess reals x y =
  lessOrEqual reals x y and x != y

CloseTo :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
CloseTo reals center radius x =
  StrictLess reals (subtract reals center radius) x
  and
  StrictLess reals x (add reals center radius)

naturalPower :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  Nat ->
  R
naturalPower reals x zero =
  oneR reals
naturalPower reals x (suc n) =
  multiply reals
    (naturalPower reals x n)
    x

sumThrough :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  Nat ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  R
sumThrough reals zero term =
  term zero
sumThrough reals (suc n) term =
  add reals
    (sumThrough reals n term)
    (term (suc n))

ConvergesTo :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  R ->
  Set
ConvergesTo {R} reals sequence limit =
  (epsilon : R) ->
  StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) epsilon ->
  Exists Nat
    (\ cutoff ->
      (n : Nat) ->
      cutoff <=N n ->
      CloseTo reals limit epsilon (sequence n))

record StandardSquareRoot
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) :
  Set1 where

  field
    squareRoot : R -> R

    square-root-nonnegative :
      (x : R) ->
      lessOrEqual reals (zeroR reals) x ->
      lessOrEqual reals (zeroR reals) (squareRoot x)

    square-root-square :
      (x : R) ->
      lessOrEqual reals (zeroR reals) x ->
      multiply reals (squareRoot x) (squareRoot x) == x

open StandardSquareRoot

module Putnam1965B4Statement
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R)
  (roots : StandardSquareRoot reals) where

  evenSum : Nat -> R -> R
  evenSum n x =
    sumThrough reals
      (halfFloor n)
      (\ i ->
        multiply reals
          (fromNat reals (choose n (twoN * i)))
          (naturalPower reals x i))

  oddSum : Nat -> R -> R
  oddSum n x =
    sumThrough reals
      (halfFloor (n - oneN))
      (\ i ->
        multiply reals
          (fromNat reals (choose n (twoN * i + oneN)))
          (naturalPower reals x i))

  proposition : Set
  proposition =
    (f u v : Nat -> R -> R) ->
    ((n : Nat) ->
      Positive n ->
      (x : R) ->
      u n x == evenSum n x) ->
    ((n : Nat) ->
      Positive n ->
      (x : R) ->
      v n x == oddSum n x) ->
    ((n : Nat) ->
      Positive n ->
      (x : R) ->
      f n x == divide reals (u n x) (v n x)) ->
    (n : Nat) ->
    Positive n ->
    (((x : R) ->
      v n x != zeroR reals ->
      v (suc n) x != zeroR reals ->
      add reals (f n x) (oneR reals) != zeroR reals ->
      f (suc n) x ==
      divide reals
        (add reals (f n x) x)
        (add reals (f n x) (oneR reals)))
    and
    ((x : R) ->
      Iff
        (lessOrEqual reals (zeroR reals) x)
        (Exists R
          (\ limit ->
            ConvergesTo reals
              (\ m -> f m x)
              limit)))
    and
    ((x : R) ->
      lessOrEqual reals (zeroR reals) x ->
      ConvergesTo reals
        (\ m -> f m x)
        (squareRoot roots x)))

putnam-1965-b4 : Set1
putnam-1965-b4 =
  (R : Set) ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) ->
  (roots : StandardSquareRoot reals) ->
  Putnam1965B4Statement.proposition reals roots

  even- and odd-indexed binomial sums. This file contains no proof.
*)

     real_sigmaTheory;

val putnam_1965_b4 =
  ``!f u v : num -> real -> real. !n : num.
      (!m : num. 0 < m ==>
         !x : real.
           u m x =
           SIGMA
             (\i : num.
                (&(binomial m (2 * i)) : real) * x pow i)
             (count (m DIV 2 + 1))) /\
      (!m : num. 0 < m ==>

title: putnam_1965_b4
content:
% Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench artifact putnam_1965_b4:
% the ratio of the even- and odd-indexed binomial polynomials satisfies the
% stated recurrence, and its convergence set and pointwise limit are identified.
% This file contains no proof.

putnam_1965_b4: THEORY
BEGIN
  real_function: TYPE = [real -> real]
  indexed_real_function: TYPE = [nat -> real_function]
  real_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> real]

  binomial_coefficient(n, k: nat): RECURSIVE nat =
    IF k = 0 THEN
      1
    ELSIF n = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      binomial_coefficient(n - 1, k - 1)
        + binomial_coefficient(n - 1, k)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE n

  safe_div(numerator, denominator: real): real =
    IF denominator = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      numerator / denominator
    ENDIF

  nat_subtract(n, k: nat): nat =
    IF k <= n THEN n - k ELSE 0 ENDIF

  even_binomial_sum(
      n: nat,
      x: real,
      term_count: nat): RECURSIVE real =
    IF term_count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      LET i: nat = term_count - 1 IN
        even_binomial_sum(n, x, term_count - 1)
          + (binomial_coefficient(n, 2 * i) :: real) * x ^ i
    ENDIF
  MEASURE term_count

  odd_binomial_sum(
      n: nat,
      x: real,
      term_count: nat): RECURSIVE real =
    IF term_count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      LET i: nat = term_count - 1 IN
        odd_binomial_sum(n, x, term_count - 1)
          + (binomial_coefficient(n, 2 * i + 1) :: real) * x ^ i
    ENDIF
  MEASURE term_count

  even_binomial_polynomial(n: nat, x: real): real =
    even_binomial_sum(n, x, ndiv(n, 2) + 1)

  odd_binomial_polynomial(n: nat, x: real): real =
    odd_binomial_sum(n, x, ndiv(nat_subtract(n, 1), 2) + 1)

  converges_to(sequence: real_sequence, value: real): bool =
    FORALL (epsilon_value: posreal):
      EXISTS (cutoff: nat):
        FORALL (index: nat):
          cutoff <= index IMPLIES
            abs(sequence(index) - value) < epsilon_value

  convergent(sequence: real_sequence): bool =
    EXISTS (value: real): converges_to(sequence, value)

  nonnegative_square_root(value: real): real =
    IF 0 <= value
    THEN
      epsilon(
        LAMBDA (root: real):
          0 <= root AND root * root = value)
    ELSE
      0
    ENDIF

  solution_p(h: real_function): real_function =
    LAMBDA (x: real): h(x) + x

  solution_q(h: real_function): real_function =
    LAMBDA (x: real): h(x) + 1

  solution_set(x: real): bool =
    0 <= x

  solution_limit(x: real): real =
    nonnegative_square_root(x)

  putnam_1965_b4: bool =
    FORALL
        (f, u, v: indexed_real_function),
        (n: nat):
      ((FORALL (m: nat):
          m > 0 IMPLIES
            (FORALL (x: real):
              u(m)(x) = even_binomial_polynomial(m, x)))
        AND (FORALL (m: nat):
          m > 0 IMPLIES
            (FORALL (x: real):
              v(m)(x) = odd_binomial_polynomial(m, x)))
        AND (FORALL (m: nat):
          m > 0 IMPLIES
            (FORALL (x: real):
              f(m)(x) = safe_div(u(m)(x), v(m)(x))))
        AND n > 0)
      IMPLIES
        ((FORALL (x: real):
            (v(n)(x) /= 0
              AND v(n + 1)(x) /= 0
              AND solution_q(f(n))(x) /= 0)
            IMPLIES
              f(n + 1)(x)
                = safe_div(
                    solution_p(f(n))(x),
                    solution_q(f(n))(x)))
          AND (FORALL (x: real):
            solution_set(x)
              IFF convergent(
                LAMBDA (m: nat): f(m)(x)))
          AND (FORALL (x: real):
            solution_set(x) IMPLIES
              converges_to(
                LAMBDA (m: nat): f(m)(x),
                solution_limit(x))))
END putnam_1965_b4

theorem putnam_1965_b5
{K : Type*}
[Fintype K]
(V E : ℕ)
(hV : V = Nat.card K)
(hE: 4*E ≤ V^2)
: ∃ G : SimpleGraph K, G.edgeSet.ncard = E ∧ ∀ a : K, ∀ w : G.Walk a a, w.length ≠ 3 :=

;; Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench artifact putnam_1965_b5:
;; if 4E <= V^2, a finite simple undirected graph on V vertices exists with
;; exactly E edges and no triangle. This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

;; The canonical vertex carrier is {0,...,V-1}. Every finite type of
;; cardinality V is bijective with this carrier, and transporting adjacency
;; along such a bijection preserves edge count and triangles.

(defun putnam-1965-b5-naturals-below-aux (remaining next)
  (if (zp remaining)
      nil
    (cons next
          (putnam-1965-b5-naturals-below-aux
           (- remaining 1)
           (+ next 1)))))

(defun putnam-1965-b5-naturals-below (v)
  (putnam-1965-b5-naturals-below-aux v 0))

;; Each pair (u v) below has u before v in VERTICES, so subsets of ALL-PAIRS
;; are in bijection with simple undirected graphs on the carrier.

(defun putnam-1965-b5-pairs-with-first (first remaining)
  (if (consp remaining)
      (cons (list first (car remaining))
            (putnam-1965-b5-pairs-with-first
             first (cdr remaining)))
    nil))

(defun putnam-1965-b5-all-pairs (vertices)
  (if (consp vertices)
      (append
       (putnam-1965-b5-pairs-with-first
        (car vertices) (cdr vertices))
       (putnam-1965-b5-all-pairs (cdr vertices)))
    nil))

(defun putnam-1965-b5-adjacent-p (edges left right)
  (or (member-equal (list left right) edges)
      (member-equal (list right left) edges)))

(defun putnam-1965-b5-triangle-third-p
    (first second candidates edges)
  (if (consp candidates)
      (or
       (and
        (putnam-1965-b5-adjacent-p edges first second)
        (putnam-1965-b5-adjacent-p
         edges first (car candidates))
        (putnam-1965-b5-adjacent-p
         edges second (car candidates)))
       (putnam-1965-b5-triangle-third-p
        first second (cdr candidates) edges))
    nil))

(defun putnam-1965-b5-triangle-second-p
    (first candidates vertices edges)
  (if (consp candidates)
      (or
       (putnam-1965-b5-triangle-third-p
        first (car candidates) vertices edges)
       (putnam-1965-b5-triangle-second-p
        first (cdr candidates) vertices edges))
    nil))

(defun putnam-1965-b5-triangle-p
    (candidates vertices edges)
  (if (consp candidates)
      (or
       (putnam-1965-b5-triangle-second-p
        (car candidates) vertices vertices edges)
       (putnam-1965-b5-triangle-p
        (cdr candidates) vertices edges))
    nil))

;; This finite branching search is the source's internal existential
;; quantifier over graphs. It considers every subset of the complete graph;
;; no graph witness is supplied as an external parameter.

(defun putnam-1965-b5-graph-exists-from-p
    (remaining-pairs selected vertices edge-count)
  (declare (xargs :measure (len remaining-pairs)))
  (if (consp remaining-pairs)
      (or
       (putnam-1965-b5-graph-exists-from-p
        (cdr remaining-pairs)
        (cons (car remaining-pairs) selected)
        vertices
        edge-count)
       (putnam-1965-b5-graph-exists-from-p
        (cdr remaining-pairs)
        selected
        vertices
        edge-count))
    (and
     (equal (len selected) edge-count)
     (not
      (putnam-1965-b5-triangle-p
       vertices vertices selected)))))

(defun putnam-1965-b5-graph-exists-p (v edge-count)
  (let ((vertices (putnam-1965-b5-naturals-below v)))
    (putnam-1965-b5-graph-exists-from-p
     (putnam-1965-b5-all-pairs vertices)
     nil
     vertices
     edge-count)))

(defun putnambench-putnam-1965-b5-statement (v e)
  (implies
   (and
    (natp v)
    (natp e)
    (<= (* 4 e) (* v v)))
   (putnam-1965-b5-graph-exists-p v e)))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

title: putnam_1965_b5
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1965_b5:
-- if 4E is at most V squared, a finite V-vertex simple graph with exactly E
-- edges and no triangle exists. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

open import Agda.Builtin.Bool using (Bool; false; true)
open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _*_)
open import Agda.Primitive using (Level; lsuc; _⊔_)

infix 4 _<=N_
infixr 3 _and_

data Bottom : Set where

record _and_
  {a b : Level}
  (A : Set a)
  (B : Set b) :
  Set (a ⊔ b) where
  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

record Exists
  {a p : Level}
  (A : Set a)
  (P : A -> Set p) :
  Set (a ⊔ p) where

  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

data _<=N_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set where
  zero<=N   : {n : Nat} -> zero <=N n
  suc<=sucN : {m n : Nat} -> m <=N n -> suc m <=N suc n

data Fin : Nat -> Set where
  fzero : {n : Nat} -> Fin (suc n)
  fsuc  : {n : Nat} -> Fin n -> Fin (suc n)

record Bijection
  {a b : Level}
  (A : Set a)
  (B : Set b) :
  Set (a ⊔ b) where

  field
    to      : A -> B
    from    : B -> A
    from-to : (x : A) -> from (to x) == x
    to-from : (y : B) -> to (from y) == y

record OrderedPair
  {a : Level}
  (A : Set a) :
  Set a where

  constructor _,_
  field
    left  : A
    right : A

open OrderedPair

FiniteCarrier :
  {a : Level} ->
  Set a ->
  Nat ->
  Set a
FiniteCarrier A cardinality =
  Bijection A (Fin cardinality)

Simple :
  {a : Level} ->
  {A : Set a} ->
  (A -> A -> Bool) ->
  Set a
Simple {A = A} adjacent =
  ((v : A) -> adjacent v v == false)
  and
  ((v w : A) -> adjacent v w == adjacent w v)

record DirectedEdgesHaveCardinality
  {a : Level}
  {A : Set a}
  (adjacent : A -> A -> Bool)
  (cardinality : Nat) :
  Set a where

  field
    enumerate :
      Fin cardinality ->
      OrderedPair A

    enumerated-edge :
      (i : Fin cardinality) ->
      adjacent (left (enumerate i)) (right (enumerate i)) == true

    enumeration-complete :
      (u v : A) ->
      adjacent u v == true ->
      Exists (Fin cardinality)
        (\ i -> enumerate i == (u , v))

    enumeration-injective :
      (i j : Fin cardinality) ->
      enumerate i == enumerate j ->
      i == j

TriangleFree :
  {a : Level} ->
  {A : Set a} ->
  (A -> A -> Bool) ->
  Set a
TriangleFree {A = A} adjacent =
  (a b c : A) ->
  adjacent a b == true ->
  adjacent a c == true ->
  adjacent b c == true ->
  Bottom

two : Nat
two =
  suc (suc zero)

four : Nat
four =
  suc (suc (suc (suc zero)))

putnam-1965-b5 :
  {a : Level} ->
  Set (lsuc a)
putnam-1965-b5 {a} =
  (A : Set a) ->
  (V E : Nat) ->
  FiniteCarrier A V ->
  four * E <=N V * V ->
  Exists (A -> A -> Bool)
    (\ adjacent ->
      Simple adjacent
      and
      (DirectedEdgesHaveCardinality adjacent (two * E)
      and
      TriangleFree adjacent))

title: putnam_1965_b5
content:
% Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench artifact putnam_1965_b5: if
% 4E <= V^2, there is a simple undirected graph on V vertices with exactly E
% edges and no triangle. This file contains no proof.

putnam_1965_b5: THEORY
BEGIN
  row_edge_count(
      graph: [nat, nat -> bool],
      vertex, count: nat): RECURSIVE nat =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      row_edge_count(graph, vertex, count - 1)
        + IF graph(vertex, count - 1) THEN 1 ELSE 0 ENDIF
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  ordered_edge_count(
      graph: [nat, nat -> bool],
      rows, columns: nat): RECURSIVE nat =
    IF rows = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      ordered_edge_count(graph, rows - 1, columns)
        + row_edge_count(graph, rows - 1, columns)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE rows

  simple_undirected(graph: [nat, nat -> bool], V: nat): bool =
    (FORALL (v: nat):
      v < V IMPLIES NOT graph(v, v))
      AND
        (FORALL (v, w: nat):
          v < V AND w < V
            IMPLIES graph(v, w) = graph(w, v))

  triangle_free(graph: [nat, nat -> bool], V: nat): bool =
    NOT
      (EXISTS (a, b, c: nat):
        a < V
          AND b < V
          AND c < V
          AND graph(b, c)
          AND graph(c, a)
          AND graph(a, b))

  putnam_1965_b5: bool =
    FORALL (V, E: nat):
      4 * E <= V ^ 2
        IMPLIES
          EXISTS (graph: [nat, nat -> bool]):
            simple_undirected(graph, V)
              AND ordered_edge_count(graph, V, V) = 2 * E
              AND triangle_free(graph, V)
END putnam_1965_b5

import Mathlib

open EuclideanGeometry Topology Filter Complex SimpleGraph.Walk

/--
Let $A$, $B$, $C$, and $D$ be four distinct points for which every circle through $A$ and $B$ intersects every circle through $C$ and $D$. Prove that $A$, $B$, $C$ and $D$ are either collinear (all lying on the same line) or cocyclic (all lying on the same circle).
-/
theorem putnam_1965_b6
    (A B C D : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
    (S : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)))
    (hS : S = {A, B, C, D})
    (hdistinct : S.ncard = 4)
    (through : (ℝ × (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))) → (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) → Prop)
    (through_def : through = fun (r, P) => fun Q => dist P Q = r)
    (hABCD : ∀ r s : ℝ, ∀ P Q,
      through (r, P) A ∧ through (r, P) B ∧ through (s, Q) C ∧ through (s, Q) D →
      ∃ I, through (r, P) I ∧ through (s, Q) I) :
    Collinear ℝ S ∨ ∃ r : ℝ, ∃ P, ∀ Q ∈ S, through (r, P) Q :=
  sorry

(*
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench artifact putnam_1965_b6:
  four distinct points in the real plane such that every circle through the
  first pair intersects every circle through the second pair are collinear
  or cocyclic. This file contains no proof.
*)

let statement =
  `let edist =
     \(x:real#real) (y:real#real).
       sqrt ((FST x - FST y) pow 2 + (SND x - SND y) pow 2) in
   let collinear3 =
     \(a:real#real) (b:real#real) (c:real#real).
       (FST b - FST a) * (SND c - SND a) =
       (SND b - SND a) * (FST c - FST a) in
   !A B C D:real#real.
     ~(A = B) /\ ~(A = C) /\ ~(A = D) /\
     ~(B = C) /\ ~(B = D) /\ ~(C = D) /\
     (!r s:real. !P Q:real#real.
        &0 < r /\ &0 < s /\
        edist P A = r /\ edist P B = r /\
        edist Q C = s /\ edist Q D = s
        ==> ?X:real#real. edist P X = r /\ edist Q X = s)
     ==>
     (collinear3 A B C /\ collinear3 A B D \/
      ?r:real. ?P:real#real.
        &0 < r /\
        edist P A = r /\ edist P B = r /\
        edist P C = r /\ edist P D = r)`;;

title: putnam_1965_b6
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1965_b6:
;; four distinct points in the real Euclidean plane whose two pencils of
;; circles intersect pairwise are collinear or cocyclic. This file contains
;; no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))

;; The conservative operation symbols below present an arbitrary real-closed
;; ordered field. The field, order, positive-square-root, and odd-degree-root
;; laws are explicit in the statement predicate. Real-closed ordered fields
;; have the same first-order ordered-field theory as the real numbers, so this
;; unbounded coordinate statement is equivalent to its real-plane instance;
;; no coordinate is restricted to a rational or finite surrogate.
;;
;; A point is a pair of field elements. A circle is represented by its center
;; and the squared distance to a point on it. Because all four source points
;; are pairwise distinct, centers equidistant from A,B (respectively C,D) are
;; in bijection with circles through that pair: the positive-square-root law
;; recovers the ordinary radius, and squaring an ordinary distance recovers
;; the equations below. Thus the universally quantified centers and internal
;; intersection witness preserve the source circle hypothesis in both
;; directions. The conclusion retains the source disjunction: the first
;; branch is the two-dimensional collinearity test based at distinct A,B, and
;; the second has an internal center witness equidistant from all four points.

(defstub putnam-1965-b6-real-p (x) t)
(defstub putnam-1965-b6-add-op (x y) t)
(defstub putnam-1965-b6-multiply-op (x y) t)
(defstub putnam-1965-b6-negate-op (x) t)
(defstub putnam-1965-b6-inverse-op (x) t)
(defstub putnam-1965-b6-less-op (x y) t)

(defun putnam-1965-b6-member-p (x)
  (if (putnam-1965-b6-real-p x) t nil))

(defun putnam-1965-b6-add (x y)
  (putnam-1965-b6-add-op x y))

(defun putnam-1965-b6-mul (x y)
  (putnam-1965-b6-multiply-op x y))

(defun putnam-1965-b6-neg (x)
  (putnam-1965-b6-negate-op x))

(defun putnam-1965-b6-inv (x)
  (putnam-1965-b6-inverse-op x))

(defun putnam-1965-b6-less (x y)
  (if (putnam-1965-b6-less-op x y) t nil))

(defun putnam-1965-b6-sub (x y)
  (putnam-1965-b6-add
   x
   (putnam-1965-b6-neg y)))

(defun putnam-1965-b6-square (x)
  (putnam-1965-b6-mul x x))

(defun putnam-1965-b6-positive-p (x zero)
  (and
   (putnam-1965-b6-member-p x)
   (putnam-1965-b6-less zero x)))

(defun-sk putnam-1965-b6-field-laws-p (zero one)
  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (putnam-1965-b6-member-p x)
      (putnam-1965-b6-member-p y)
      (putnam-1965-b6-member-p z))
     (and
      (putnam-1965-b6-member-p
       (putnam-1965-b6-add x y))
      (putnam-1965-b6-member-p
       (putnam-1965-b6-mul x y))
      (putnam-1965-b6-member-p
       (putnam-1965-b6-neg x))
      (putnam-1965-b6-member-p
       (putnam-1965-b6-inv x))
      (equal
       (putnam-1965-b6-add
        (putnam-1965-b6-add x y)
        z)
       (putnam-1965-b6-add
        x
        (putnam-1965-b6-add y z)))
      (equal
       (putnam-1965-b6-add x y)
       (putnam-1965-b6-add y x))
      (equal
       (putnam-1965-b6-add x zero)
       x)
      (equal
       (putnam-1965-b6-add
        x
        (putnam-1965-b6-neg x))
       zero)
      (equal
       (putnam-1965-b6-mul
        (putnam-1965-b6-mul x y)
        z)
       (putnam-1965-b6-mul
        x
        (putnam-1965-b6-mul y z)))
      (equal
       (putnam-1965-b6-mul x y)
       (putnam-1965-b6-mul y x))
      (equal
       (putnam-1965-b6-mul x one)
       x)
      (implies
       (equal x zero)
       (equal
        (putnam-1965-b6-inv x)
        zero))
      (implies
       (not (equal x zero))
       (equal
        (putnam-1965-b6-mul
         x
         (putnam-1965-b6-inv x))
        one))
      (equal
       (putnam-1965-b6-mul
        x
        (putnam-1965-b6-add y z))
       (putnam-1965-b6-add
        (putnam-1965-b6-mul x y)
        (putnam-1965-b6-mul x z)))))))

(defun-sk putnam-1965-b6-order-laws-p (zero)
  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (putnam-1965-b6-member-p x)
      (putnam-1965-b6-member-p y)
      (putnam-1965-b6-member-p z))
     (and
      (not (putnam-1965-b6-less x x))
      (or
       (equal x y)
       (putnam-1965-b6-less x y)
       (putnam-1965-b6-less y x))
      (implies
       (and
        (putnam-1965-b6-less x y)
        (putnam-1965-b6-less y z))
       (putnam-1965-b6-less x z))
      (implies
       (putnam-1965-b6-less x y)
       (putnam-1965-b6-less
        (putnam-1965-b6-add x z)
        (putnam-1965-b6-add y z)))
      (implies
       (and
        (putnam-1965-b6-less zero x)
        (putnam-1965-b6-less zero y))
       (putnam-1965-b6-less
        zero
        (putnam-1965-b6-mul x y)))))))

(defun putnam-1965-b6-polynomial-p (coefficients)
  (if (endp coefficients)
      t
    (and
     (putnam-1965-b6-member-p (car coefficients))
     (putnam-1965-b6-polynomial-p (cdr coefficients)))))

(defun putnam-1965-b6-polynomial-value
    (coefficients x zero)
  (if (endp coefficients)
      zero
    (putnam-1965-b6-add
     (car coefficients)
     (putnam-1965-b6-mul
      x
      (putnam-1965-b6-polynomial-value
       (cdr coefficients)
       x
       zero)))))

(defun putnam-1965-b6-leading-coefficient (coefficients)
  (if (endp (cdr coefficients))
      (car coefficients)
    (putnam-1965-b6-leading-coefficient
     (cdr coefficients))))

(defun putnam-1965-b6-odd-degree-p (coefficients zero)
  (and
   (consp coefficients)
   (consp (cdr coefficients))
   (not
    (equal
     (putnam-1965-b6-leading-coefficient coefficients)
     zero))
   (equal
    (mod (1- (len coefficients)) 2)
    1)))

(defun-sk putnam-1965-b6-square-root-exists-p
    (x zero)
  (exists (root)
    (and
     (or
      (equal root zero)
      (putnam-1965-b6-positive-p root zero))
     (equal
      (putnam-1965-b6-square root)
      x))))

(defun-sk putnam-1965-b6-positive-square-roots-p
    (zero)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (putnam-1965-b6-positive-p x zero)
     (putnam-1965-b6-square-root-exists-p
      x
      zero))))

(defun-sk putnam-1965-b6-polynomial-root-exists-p
    (coefficients zero)
  (exists (root)
    (and
     (putnam-1965-b6-member-p root)
     (equal
      (putnam-1965-b6-polynomial-value
       coefficients
       root
       zero)
      zero))))

(defun-sk putnam-1965-b6-odd-polynomial-roots-p
    (zero)
  (forall (coefficients)
    (implies
     (and
      (true-listp coefficients)
      (putnam-1965-b6-polynomial-p coefficients)
      (putnam-1965-b6-odd-degree-p coefficients zero))
     (putnam-1965-b6-polynomial-root-exists-p
      coefficients
      zero))))

(defun putnam-1965-b6-real-closed-field-p (zero one)
  (and
   (putnam-1965-b6-member-p zero)
   (putnam-1965-b6-member-p one)
   (not (equal zero one))
   (putnam-1965-b6-less zero one)
   (putnam-1965-b6-field-laws-p zero one)
   (putnam-1965-b6-order-laws-p zero)
   (putnam-1965-b6-positive-square-roots-p zero)
   (putnam-1965-b6-odd-polynomial-roots-p zero)))

(defun putnam-1965-b6-point-p (point)
  (and
   (consp point)
   (putnam-1965-b6-member-p (car point))
   (putnam-1965-b6-member-p (cdr point))))

(defun putnam-1965-b6-squared-distance
    (first second)
  (let ((dx
         (putnam-1965-b6-sub
          (car first)
          (car second)))
        (dy
         (putnam-1965-b6-sub
          (cdr first)
          (cdr second))))
    (putnam-1965-b6-add
     (putnam-1965-b6-square dx)
     (putnam-1965-b6-square dy))))

(defun putnam-1965-b6-equidistant-p
    (center first second)
  (equal
   (putnam-1965-b6-squared-distance center first)
   (putnam-1965-b6-squared-distance center second)))

(defun putnam-1965-b6-orientation
    (first second third)
  (putnam-1965-b6-sub
   (putnam-1965-b6-mul
    (putnam-1965-b6-sub
     (car second)
     (car first))
    (putnam-1965-b6-sub
     (cdr third)
     (cdr first)))
   (putnam-1965-b6-mul
    (putnam-1965-b6-sub
     (cdr second)
     (cdr first))
    (putnam-1965-b6-sub
     (car third)
     (car first)))))

(defun putnam-1965-b6-four-distinct-p (a b c d)
  (and
   (not (equal a b))
   (not (equal a c))
   (not (equal a d))
   (not (equal b c))
   (not (equal b d))
   (not (equal c d))))

(defun-sk putnam-1965-b6-intersection-exists-p
    (first-center second-center a c)
  (exists (intersection)
    (and
     (putnam-1965-b6-point-p intersection)
     (equal
      (putnam-1965-b6-squared-distance
       first-center intersection)
      (putnam-1965-b6-squared-distance
       first-center a))
     (equal
      (putnam-1965-b6-squared-distance
       second-center intersection)
      (putnam-1965-b6-squared-distance
       second-center c)))))

(defun-sk putnam-1965-b6-all-circles-intersect-p
    (a b c d)
  (forall (first-center second-center)
    (implies
     (and
      (putnam-1965-b6-point-p first-center)
      (putnam-1965-b6-point-p second-center)
      (putnam-1965-b6-equidistant-p
       first-center a b)
      (putnam-1965-b6-equidistant-p
       second-center c d))
     (putnam-1965-b6-intersection-exists-p
      first-center second-center a c))))

(defun putnam-1965-b6-collinear-p (a b c d zero)
  (and
   (equal
    (putnam-1965-b6-orientation a b c)
    zero)
   (equal
    (putnam-1965-b6-orientation a b d)
    zero)))

(defun-sk putnam-1965-b6-cocyclic-p (a b c d)
  (exists (center)
    (and
     (putnam-1965-b6-point-p center)
     (putnam-1965-b6-equidistant-p center a b)
     (putnam-1965-b6-equidistant-p center a c)
     (putnam-1965-b6-equidistant-p center a d))))

(defun-sk putnambench-putnam-1965-b6-statement
    (zero one)
  (forall (a b c d)
    (implies
     (and
      (putnam-1965-b6-real-closed-field-p zero one)
      (putnam-1965-b6-point-p a)
      (putnam-1965-b6-point-p b)
      (putnam-1965-b6-point-p c)
      (putnam-1965-b6-point-p d)
      (putnam-1965-b6-four-distinct-p a b c d)
      (putnam-1965-b6-all-circles-intersect-p
       a b c d))
     (or
      (putnam-1965-b6-collinear-p
       a b c d zero)
      (putnam-1965-b6-cocyclic-p
       a b c d)))))

title: putnam_1965_b6
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1965_b6:
-- four distinct real-plane points whose two designated circle pencils always
-- intersect are collinear or lie on one circle. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; _*_)

infix 4 _!=_
infixr 3 _and_
infixr 2 _or_

data Bottom : Set where

Not : Set -> Set
Not A =
  A -> Bottom

_!=_ : {A : Set} -> A -> A -> Set
x != y =
  Not (x == y)

record _and_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data _or_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  left  : A -> A or B
  right : B -> A or B

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

record CompleteOrderedRealField (R : Set) : Set1 where
  field
    zeroR oneR : R
    add multiply : R -> R -> R
    negate inverse squareRoot : R -> R
    lessOrEqual : R -> R -> Set
    fromNat : Nat -> R

    one-not-zero :
      oneR != zeroR

    add-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> add x y == add y x
    add-associative :
      (x y z : R) -> add (add x y) z == add x (add y z)
    add-zero :
      (x : R) -> add x zeroR == x
    add-inverse :
      (x : R) -> add x (negate x) == zeroR

    multiply-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> multiply x y == multiply y x
    multiply-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply (multiply x y) z == multiply x (multiply y z)
    multiply-one :
      (x : R) -> multiply x oneR == x
    multiply-zero :
      (x : R) -> multiply x zeroR == zeroR
    distribute :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply x (add y z) ==
      add (multiply x y) (multiply x z)
    inverse-zero :
      inverse zeroR == zeroR
    multiply-inverse :
      (x : R) ->
      x != zeroR ->
      multiply x (inverse x) == oneR

    order-reflexive :
      (x : R) -> lessOrEqual x x
    order-transitive :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y z ->
      lessOrEqual x z
    order-antisymmetric :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y x ->
      x == y
    order-total :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y or lessOrEqual y x
    add-order :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual (add z x) (add z y)
    multiply-nonnegative :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR x ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR y ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR (multiply x y)
    zero-less-than-one :
      lessOrEqual zeroR oneR and zeroR != oneR

    fromNat-zero :
      fromNat zero == zeroR
    fromNat-successor :
      (n : Nat) -> fromNat (suc n) == add (fromNat n) oneR
    fromNat-addition :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m + n) == add (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-multiplication :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m * n) == multiply (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-injective :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat m == fromNat n ->
      m == n

    archimedean :
      (x : R) ->
      Exists Nat (\ n -> lessOrEqual x (fromNat n))
    least-upper-bound :
      (P : R -> Set) ->
      Exists R P ->
      Exists R
        (\ upper ->
          (x : R) ->
          P x ->
          lessOrEqual x upper) ->
      Exists R
        (\ supremum ->
          ((x : R) -> P x -> lessOrEqual x supremum)
          and
          ((upper : R) ->
            ((x : R) -> P x -> lessOrEqual x upper) ->
            lessOrEqual supremum upper))

    square-root-nonnegative :
      (x : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR (squareRoot x)
    square-root-square :
      (x : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR x ->
      multiply (squareRoot x) (squareRoot x) == x
    square-root-nonpositive :
      (x : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x zeroR ->
      squareRoot x == zeroR
    square-root-unique :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR y ->
      multiply y y == x ->
      y == squareRoot x

open CompleteOrderedRealField

subtract :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
subtract reals x y =
  add reals x (negate reals y)

StrictLess :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
StrictLess reals x y =
  lessOrEqual reals x y and x != y

record Point (R : Set) : Set where
  constructor point
  field
    x-coordinate : R
    y-coordinate : R

open Point

squaredDistance :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Point R ->
  Point R ->
  R
squaredDistance reals p q =
  add reals
    (multiply reals
      (subtract reals (x-coordinate p) (x-coordinate q))
      (subtract reals (x-coordinate p) (x-coordinate q)))
    (multiply reals
      (subtract reals (y-coordinate p) (y-coordinate q))
      (subtract reals (y-coordinate p) (y-coordinate q)))

distance :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Point R ->
  Point R ->
  R
distance reals p q =
  squareRoot reals (squaredDistance reals p q)

OnCircle :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  Point R ->
  Point R ->
  Set
OnCircle reals radius center p =
  distance reals center p == radius

doubleSignedArea :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Point R ->
  Point R ->
  Point R ->
  R
doubleSignedArea reals a b c =
  subtract reals
    (multiply reals
      (subtract reals (x-coordinate a) (x-coordinate b))
      (subtract reals (y-coordinate c) (y-coordinate b)))
    (multiply reals
      (subtract reals (y-coordinate a) (y-coordinate b))
      (subtract reals (x-coordinate c) (x-coordinate b)))

Collinear :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Point R ->
  Point R ->
  Point R ->
  Set
Collinear reals a b c =
  doubleSignedArea reals a b c == zeroR reals

PairwiseDistinct :
  {R : Set} ->
  Point R ->
  Point R ->
  Point R ->
  Point R ->
  Set
PairwiseDistinct A B C D =
  A != B
  and A != C
  and A != D
  and B != C
  and B != D
  and C != D

CirclePencilsIntersect :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Point R ->
  Point R ->
  Point R ->
  Point R ->
  Set
CirclePencilsIntersect {R} reals A B C D =
  (r s : R) ->
  StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) r ->
  StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) s ->
  (P Q : Point R) ->
  OnCircle reals r P A ->
  OnCircle reals r P B ->
  OnCircle reals s Q C ->
  OnCircle reals s Q D ->
  Exists (Point R)
    (\ I ->
      OnCircle reals r P I
      and OnCircle reals s Q I)

Cocyclic :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Point R ->
  Point R ->
  Point R ->
  Point R ->
  Set
Cocyclic {R} reals A B C D =
  Exists R
    (\ radius ->
      StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) radius
      and
      Exists (Point R)
        (\ center ->
          OnCircle reals radius center A
          and OnCircle reals radius center B
          and OnCircle reals radius center C
          and OnCircle reals radius center D))

putnam-1965-b6 : Set1
putnam-1965-b6 =
  (R : Set) ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) ->
  (A B C D : Point R) ->
  PairwiseDistinct A B C D ->
  CirclePencilsIntersect reals A B C D ->
  (Collinear reals A B C and Collinear reals A B D)
  or Cocyclic reals A B C D

(*
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench artifact putnam_1965_b6:
  four distinct points in the real Euclidean plane whose two designated
  pencils of circles always intersect are collinear or cocyclic. This file
  contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open pairTheory realTheory transcTheory;

val putnam_1965_b6 =
  ``let dist =
      \P Q : real # real.
        sqrt ((FST P - FST Q) pow 2 + (SND P - SND Q) pow 2)
    in
    let on_circle =
      \radius : real.
      \centre point : real # real.
        dist centre point = radius
    in
    let collinear =
      \P Q R : real # real.
        (FST P - FST Q) * (SND R - SND Q) =
        (SND P - SND Q) * (FST R - FST Q)
    in
    let pairwise_distinct =
      \A B C D : real # real.
        A <> B /\ A <> C /\ A <> D /\
        B <> C /\ B <> D /\ C <> D
    in
      !A B C D : real # real.
        pairwise_distinct A B C D /\
        (!r s : real. !P Q : real # real.
           0 < r /\ 0 < s /\
           on_circle r P A /\ on_circle r P B /\
           on_circle s Q C /\ on_circle s Q D
           ==>
           ?I : real # real.
             on_circle r P I /\ on_circle s Q I)
        ==>
        (collinear A B C /\ collinear A B D) \/
        ?r : real. ?P : real # real.
          0 < r /\
          on_circle r P A /\ on_circle r P B /\
          on_circle r P C /\ on_circle r P D``;

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  P65B6R2 is the real coordinate plane, P65B6Dist is Euclidean distance,
  and P65B6OnCircle O r X says that X lies on the circle with center O and

  determinant, which is equivalent to collinearity of their set even when
  some points coincide.

  circles through A,B and through C,D are automatically positive. Conversely,
  if the four points are not distinct, their set has at most three points and
  is automatically either collinear or contained in a positive-radius circle.

  theorem while retaining the stronger degenerate cases stated by Isabelle.

  contains no $p proof statement.

  <->
  ( P65B6Dist O A ) = r
) $.

p65b6-collinear-definition $a |- (
  ( P65B6Col A B C )
  <->
  (
    (
      ( ( B ` 1 ) - ( A ` 1 ) )
      x.
      ( ( C ` 2 ) - ( A ` 2 ) )
    )
    =
    (
      ( ( B ` 2 ) - ( A ` 2 ) )
      x.
      ( ( C ` 1 ) - ( A ` 1 ) )

  )

p65b6-collinear-four-definition $a |- (
  ( P65B6Col4 A B C D )
  <->
  (
    ( P65B6Col A B C )
    /\
    (
      ( P65B6Col A B D )
      /\
      (
        ( P65B6Col A C D )
        /\
        ( P65B6Col B C D )
      )
    )

${
  $d A B C D I O P Q r s $.

  putnambench-putnam-1965-b6 $a |- (
    A. A e. P65B6R2
    A. B e. P65B6R2
    A. C e. P65B6R2
    A. D e. P65B6R2
      (

          A. P e. P65B6R2
          A. Q e. P65B6R2
            (

                    /\
                    ( P65B6OnCircle P r B )

                  /\

                    /\
                    ( P65B6OnCircle Q s D )
                  )

              E. I e. P65B6R2
                (
                  ( P65B6OnCircle P r I )
                  /\
                  ( P65B6OnCircle Q s I )
                )
            )
        )
        ->
        (
          ( P65B6Col4 A B C D )

          E. r e. RR

title: putnam_1965_b6
content:
% Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench artifact putnam_1965_b6:
% four distinct real-plane points for which every circle through the first
% pair meets every circle through the second pair are collinear or cocyclic.
% This file contains no proof.

putnam_1965_b6: THEORY
BEGIN
  point: TYPE = [# x_coord: real, y_coord: real #]

  squared_distance(P, Q: point): real =
    (x_coord(P) - x_coord(Q)) ^ 2
      + (y_coord(P) - y_coord(Q)) ^ 2

  on_circle(X, center, radius_point: point): bool =
    squared_distance(X, center)
      = squared_distance(radius_point, center)

  collinear(P, Q, R: point): bool =
    (x_coord(Q) - x_coord(P)) * (y_coord(R) - y_coord(P))
      - (y_coord(Q) - y_coord(P)) * (x_coord(R) - x_coord(P))
      = 0

  pairwise_distinct(A, B, C, D: point): bool =
    A /= B
      AND A /= C
      AND A /= D
      AND B /= C
      AND B /= D
      AND C /= D

  putnam_1965_b6: bool =
    FORALL (A, B, C, D: point):
      (pairwise_distinct(A, B, C, D)
        AND
          FORALL (R, S, P, Q: point):
            (R /= P
              AND S /= Q
              AND on_circle(A, P, R)
              AND on_circle(B, P, R)
              AND on_circle(C, Q, S)
              AND on_circle(D, Q, S))
            IMPLIES
              EXISTS (I: point):
                on_circle(I, P, R)
                  AND on_circle(I, Q, S))
      IMPLIES
        (collinear(A, B, C) AND collinear(A, B, D))
          OR EXISTS (R, P: point):
            R /= P
              AND on_circle(A, P, R)
              AND on_circle(B, P, R)
              AND on_circle(C, P, R)
              AND on_circle(D, P, R)
END putnam_1965_b6

import Mathlib

/--
Let $a_n$ denote the sequence $0, 1, 1, 2, 2, 3, \dots$, where $a_n = \frac{n}{2}$ if $n$ is even and $\frac{n - 1}{2}$ if n is odd. Furthermore, let $f(n)$ denote the sum of the first $n$ terms of $a_n$. Prove that all positive integers $x$ and $y$ with $x > y$ satisfy $xy = f(x + y) - f(x - y)$.
-/
theorem putnam_1966_a1
(f : ℤ → ℤ)
(hf : f = fun n : ℤ => ∑ m ∈ Finset.Icc 0 n, (if Even m then m / 2 else (m - 1)/2))
: ∀ x y : ℤ, x > 0 ∧ y > 0 ∧ x > y → x * y = f (x + y) - f (x - y) :=
sorry

(in-package "ACL2")

(defun putnam-1966-a1-sequence-term (m)

    (- (putnam-1966-a1-sum-through (+ x y))

-- Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1966_a1:
-- for positive integers x > y, the difference of the inclusive partial sums
-- of floor(n / 2) at x + y and x - y equals x * y. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Int using (Int; pos; negsuc)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; _-_; _*_)

infix 4 _<_

data _<_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set where
  zero<suc : {n : Nat} -> zero < suc n
  suc<suc  : {m n : Nat} -> m < n -> suc m < suc n

negative : Nat -> Int
negative zero =
  pos zero
negative (suc n) =
  negsuc n

difference : Nat -> Nat -> Int
difference zero zero =
  pos zero
difference (suc m) zero =
  pos (suc m)
difference zero (suc n) =
  negsuc n
difference (suc m) (suc n) =
  difference m n

addInt : Int -> Int -> Int
addInt (pos m) (pos n) =
  pos (m + n)
addInt (pos m) (negsuc n) =
  difference m (suc n)
addInt (negsuc m) (pos n) =
  difference n (suc m)
addInt (negsuc m) (negsuc n) =
  negsuc (suc (m + n))

negateInt : Int -> Int
negateInt (pos n) =
  negative n
negateInt (negsuc n) =
  pos (suc n)

subtractInt : Int -> Int -> Int
subtractInt x y =
  addInt x (negateInt y)

half : Nat -> Nat
half zero =
  zero
half (suc zero) =
  zero
half (suc (suc n)) =
  suc (half n)

sumThrough : Nat -> (Nat -> Nat) -> Nat
sumThrough zero term =
  term zero
sumThrough (suc n) term =
  sumThrough n term + term (suc n)

f : Nat -> Int
f n =
  pos (sumThrough n half)

putnam-1966-a1 : Set
putnam-1966-a1 =
  (x y : Nat) ->
  zero < x ->
  zero < y ->
  y < x ->
  pos (x * y) == subtractInt (f (x + y)) (f (x - y))

:: the finite-sum identity for the cumulative sequence whose m-th term is
:: m/2 for even m and (m-1)/2 for odd m. This file contains no proof.

        len terms = n + 1 &

  holds

      x * y = f.(x + y) - f.(x -' y)
proof
end;

title: putnam_1966_a1
content:
% Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench artifact putnam_1966_a1:
% cumulative sums of the integer sequence floor(n/2) satisfy the stated
% product identity for positive integers x > y. This file contains no proof.

putnam_1966_a1: THEORY
BEGIN
  sequence_term(n: nat): int =
    ndiv(n, 2) :: int

  cumulative_sum(n: nat): RECURSIVE int =
    IF n = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      cumulative_sum(n - 1) + sequence_term(n)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE n

  nat_subtract(minuend, subtrahend: nat): nat =
    IF subtrahend <= minuend THEN
      minuend - subtrahend
    ELSE
      0
    ENDIF

  putnam_1966_a1: bool =
    FORALL (x, y: nat):
      (x > 0 AND y > 0 AND x > y)
        IMPLIES
          (x * y :: int)
            = cumulative_sum(x + y)
                - cumulative_sum(nat_subtract(x, y))
END putnam_1966_a1

title: putnam_1966_a2
content:
import Mathlib

/--
Let $a$, $b$, and $c$ be the side lengths of a triangle with inradius $r$. If $p = \frac{a + b + c}{2}$, show that $$\frac{1}{(p - a)^2} + \frac{1}{(p - b)^2} + \frac{1}{(p - c)^2} \ge \frac{1}{r^2}.$$
-/
theorem putnam_1966_a2
(r : ℝ)
(A B C : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
(hABC : ¬Collinear ℝ {A, B, C})
(a b c p : ℝ)
(ha : a = dist B C)
(hb : b = dist C A)
(hc : c = dist A B)
(hp : p = (dist B C + dist C A + dist A B)/2)
(hr : ∃ I : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2),
(∃! P : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), dist I P = r ∧ Collinear ℝ {P, B, C}) ∧
(∃! Q : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), dist I Q = r ∧ Collinear ℝ {Q, C, A}) ∧
(∃! R : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), dist I R = r ∧ Collinear ℝ {R, A, B}) ∧
(∀ Z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), dist I Z ≤ r → Z ∈ convexHull ℝ {A, B, C}))
: 1/(p - a)^2 + 1/(p - b)^2 + 1/(p - c)^2 ≥ 1/r^2 :=
sorry

title: putnam_1966_a2
content:
(* Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench artifact putnam_1966_a2:
   an inequality relating the side lengths, semiperimeter, and inradius of a
   nondegenerate planar triangle under the stated incenter and enclosed-disk
   conditions. This file contains no proof. *)

From Stdlib Require Import Reals.

Open Scope R_scope.

Definition point := (R * R)%type.
Definition point_set := point -> Prop.

Definition point_distance (a b : point) : R :=
  sqrt ((fst a - fst b) ^ 2 + (snd a - snd b) ^ 2).

Definition collinear_points (a b c : point) : Prop :=
  (fst b - fst a) * (snd c - snd a) =
  (snd b - snd a) * (fst c - fst a).

Definition tripleton (a b c : point) : point_set :=
  fun x : point => x = a \/ x = b \/ x = c.

Definition subset (A B : point_set) : Prop :=
  forall x : point, A x -> B x.

Definition affine_combination
    (lambda : R) (a b : point) : point :=
  ((1 - lambda) * fst a + lambda * fst b,
   (1 - lambda) * snd a + lambda * snd b).

Definition convex (A : point_set) : Prop :=
  forall (a b : point) (lambda : R),
    A a ->
    A b ->
    0 <= lambda <= 1 ->
    A (affine_combination lambda a b).

Definition convex_hull (A : point_set) : point_set :=
  fun x : point =>
    forall C : point_set,
      convex C ->
      subset A C ->
      C x.

Theorem putnam_1966_a2
    (r : R)
    (A B C : point)
    (hABC : ~ collinear_points A B C)
    (a b c p : R)
    (ha : a = point_distance B C)
    (hb : b = point_distance C A)
    (hc : c = point_distance A B)
    (hp : p =
      (point_distance B C + point_distance C A + point_distance A B) / 2)
    (hr :
      exists I : point,
        (exists! P : point,
          point_distance I P = r /\ collinear_points P B C) /\
        (exists! Q : point,
          point_distance I Q = r /\ collinear_points Q C A) /\
        (exists! R0 : point,
          point_distance I R0 = r /\ collinear_points R0 A B) /\
        (forall Z : point,
          point_distance I Z <= r ->
          convex_hull (tripleton A B C) Z)) :
  1 / (p - a) ^ 2 + 1 / (p - b) ^ 2 + 1 / (p - c) ^ 2
    >= 1 / r ^ 2.
Admitted.
