theory putnam_1966_a2 imports Complex_Main
"HOL-Analysis.Linear_Algebra"
"HOL-Analysis.Elementary_Metric_Spaces"
"HOL-Analysis.Finite_Cartesian_Product"
begin

theorem putnam_1966_a2:
  fixes r a b c p :: "real"
    and A B C :: "real^2"
  defines "a \<equiv> dist B C"
    and "b \<equiv> dist C A"
    and "c \<equiv> dist A B"
    and "p \<equiv> (dist B C + dist C A + dist A B)/2"
  assumes hABC : "\<not> collinear {A, B, C}"
    and hr : "\<exists> I :: real^2. 
      (\<exists>! P :: real^2. dist I P = r \<and> collinear {P, B, C}) \<and>
      (\<exists>! Q :: real^2. dist I Q = r \<and> collinear {Q, C, A}) \<and>
      (\<exists>! R :: real^2. dist I R = r \<and> collinear {R, A, B}) \<and>
      (\<forall> Z :: real^2. (dist I Z \<le> r \<longrightarrow> Z \<in> convex hull {A, B, C}))"
  shows "1/(p-a)^2 + 1/(p-b)^2 + 1/(p-c)^2 \<ge> 1/r^2"
  sorry

end

title: putnam_1966_a2
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench artifact putnam_1966_a2:
  the reciprocal-square inequality for the semiperimeter differences of a
  nondegenerate real-plane triangle with inradius r. This file contains no
  proof.
*)

let statement =
  `let edist =
     \(x:real#real) (y:real#real).
       sqrt ((FST x - FST y) pow 2 + (SND x - SND y) pow 2) in
   let collinear3 =
     \(x:real#real) (y:real#real) (z:real#real).
       (FST y - FST x) * (SND z - SND x) =
       (SND y - SND x) * (FST z - FST x) in
   let triangle_hull =
     \(a:real#real) (b:real#real) (c:real#real) (z:real#real).
       ?u v w:real.
         &0 <= u /\ &0 <= v /\ &0 <= w /\
         u + v + w = &1 /\
         FST z = u * FST a + v * FST b + w * FST c /\
         SND z = u * SND a + v * SND b + w * SND c in
   !r a b c p:real. !A B C:real#real.
     a = edist B C /\
     b = edist C A /\
     c = edist A B /\
     p = (edist B C + edist C A + edist A B) / &2 /\
     ~(collinear3 A B C) /\
     (?center:real#real.
        (?!P:real#real. edist center P = r /\ collinear3 P B C) /\
        (?!Q:real#real. edist center Q = r /\ collinear3 Q C A) /\
        (?!R:real#real. edist center R = r /\ collinear3 R A B) /\
        (!Z:real#real. edist center Z <= r ==> triangle_hull A B C Z))
     ==>
     &1 / ((p - a) pow 2) +
     &1 / ((p - b) pow 2) +
     &1 / ((p - c) pow 2) >=
     &1 / (r pow 2)`;;

title: putnam_1966_a2
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact
;; putnam_1966_a2: an inequality relating the side complements of a
;; nondegenerate real Euclidean triangle to its inradius. This file contains
;; no proof.
;;
;; Put x = p-a, y = p-b, and z = p-c. Nondegenerate triangles correspond
;; bidirectionally to x,y,z > 0: their side lengths are y+z, z+x, and x+y.
;; The geometric inradius hypothesis is equivalent to r > 0 together with
;;
;;   r^2 (x+y+z) = xyz.
;;
;; Indeed, the triangle area is r p, while Heron's identity gives area^2 =
;; pxyz; conversely these positive side complements determine a triangle
;; whose positive inradius satisfies the displayed equation. The requested
;; inequality is equivalently
;;
;;   r^2 (y^2 z^2 + z^2 x^2 + x^2 y^2) >= x^2 y^2 z^2,
;;
;; after multiplication by the positive quantity r^2 x^2 y^2 z^2.
;;
;; Standard ACL2 has no primitive real sort. A rational polynomial and a
;; rational isolating interval therefore select one real algebraic number
;; alpha, and x,y,z,r are rational polynomials in alpha. Exact Sturm root
;; counts decide equality and order at alpha. Every finite algebraic-real
;; tuple has such a common primitive-element representation, and every valid
;; representation denotes a real tuple. Since the formula and its negation
;; are first-order formulas over a real closed field, transfer between the
;; reals and the real algebraic numbers makes this encoding bidirectionally
;; equivalent to the arbitrary-real statement, not a rational restriction.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))

;; Polynomials are proper lists of rational coefficients in ascending degree
;; order. The empty list is the zero polynomial.
(defun putnam-1966-a2-rational-polynomial-p (polynomial)
  (if (consp polynomial)
      (and (rationalp (car polynomial))
           (putnam-1966-a2-rational-polynomial-p (cdr polynomial)))
    (equal polynomial nil)))

(defun putnam-1966-a2-poly-normalize (coefficients)
  (if (consp coefficients)
      (let ((tail (putnam-1966-a2-poly-normalize (cdr coefficients))))
        (if (and (equal (car coefficients) 0)
                 (not (consp tail)))
            nil
          (cons (car coefficients) tail)))
    nil))

(defun putnam-1966-a2-poly-add (left right)
  (cond
   ((consp left)
    (if (consp right)
        (cons (+ (car left) (car right))
              (putnam-1966-a2-poly-add (cdr left) (cdr right)))
      left))
   (t right)))

(defun putnam-1966-a2-poly-scale (scalar polynomial)
  (if (consp polynomial)
      (cons (* scalar (car polynomial))
            (putnam-1966-a2-poly-scale scalar (cdr polynomial)))
    nil))

(defun putnam-1966-a2-poly-negate (polynomial)
  (putnam-1966-a2-poly-scale -1 polynomial))

(defun putnam-1966-a2-poly-subtract (left right)
  (putnam-1966-a2-poly-normalize
   (putnam-1966-a2-poly-add
    left
    (putnam-1966-a2-poly-negate right))))

(defun putnam-1966-a2-poly-multiply (left right)
  (if (consp left)
      (putnam-1966-a2-poly-normalize
       (putnam-1966-a2-poly-add
        (putnam-1966-a2-poly-scale (car left) right)
        (cons 0
              (putnam-1966-a2-poly-multiply (cdr left) right))))
    nil))

(defun putnam-1966-a2-poly-derivative-aux (coefficients degree)
  (if (consp coefficients)
      (cons (* degree (car coefficients))
            (putnam-1966-a2-poly-derivative-aux
             (cdr coefficients) (+ degree 1)))
    nil))

(defun putnam-1966-a2-poly-derivative (polynomial)
  (if (consp polynomial)
      (putnam-1966-a2-poly-normalize
       (putnam-1966-a2-poly-derivative-aux
        (cdr polynomial) 1))
    nil))

(defun putnam-1966-a2-zero-list (count)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix count)))
  (if (zp count)
      nil
    (cons 0
          (putnam-1966-a2-zero-list (- count 1)))))

(defun putnam-1966-a2-poly-monomial (coefficient degree)
  (if (equal coefficient 0)
      nil
    (append
     (putnam-1966-a2-zero-list degree)
     (list coefficient))))

(defun putnam-1966-a2-poly-degree (polynomial)
  (let ((normalized (putnam-1966-a2-poly-normalize polynomial)))
    (if (consp normalized)
        (- (len normalized) 1)
      0)))

(defun putnam-1966-a2-poly-leading-coefficient (polynomial)
  (let ((normalized (putnam-1966-a2-poly-normalize polynomial)))
    (if (consp normalized)
        (nth (putnam-1966-a2-poly-degree normalized) normalized)
      0)))

(defun putnam-1966-a2-poly-divmod-steps
    (remainder divisor quotient steps)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix steps)))
  (if (zp steps)
      (cons
       (putnam-1966-a2-poly-normalize quotient)
       (putnam-1966-a2-poly-normalize remainder))
    (let* ((normalized-remainder
            (putnam-1966-a2-poly-normalize remainder))
           (normalized-divisor
            (putnam-1966-a2-poly-normalize divisor)))
      (if (or (not (consp normalized-remainder))
              (not (consp normalized-divisor))
              (< (putnam-1966-a2-poly-degree normalized-remainder)
                 (putnam-1966-a2-poly-degree normalized-divisor)))
          (cons
           (putnam-1966-a2-poly-normalize quotient)
           normalized-remainder)
        (let* ((degree-difference
                (- (putnam-1966-a2-poly-degree normalized-remainder)
                   (putnam-1966-a2-poly-degree normalized-divisor)))
               (coefficient
                (/ (putnam-1966-a2-poly-leading-coefficient
                    normalized-remainder)
                   (putnam-1966-a2-poly-leading-coefficient
                    normalized-divisor)))
               (term
                (putnam-1966-a2-poly-monomial
                 coefficient degree-difference)))
          (putnam-1966-a2-poly-divmod-steps
           (putnam-1966-a2-poly-subtract
            normalized-remainder
            (putnam-1966-a2-poly-multiply
             term normalized-divisor))
           normalized-divisor
           (putnam-1966-a2-poly-add quotient term)
           (- steps 1)))))))

(defun putnam-1966-a2-poly-divmod (dividend divisor)
  (putnam-1966-a2-poly-divmod-steps
   dividend
   divisor
   nil
   (+ 1 (len (putnam-1966-a2-poly-normalize dividend)))))

(defun putnam-1966-a2-poly-remainder (dividend divisor)
  (cdr (putnam-1966-a2-poly-divmod dividend divisor)))

(defun putnam-1966-a2-poly-gcd-steps (left right steps)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix steps)))
  (let ((normalized-left (putnam-1966-a2-poly-normalize left))
        (normalized-right (putnam-1966-a2-poly-normalize right)))
    (if (or (zp steps)
            (not (consp normalized-right)))
        normalized-left
      (putnam-1966-a2-poly-gcd-steps
       normalized-right
       (putnam-1966-a2-poly-remainder
        normalized-left normalized-right)
       (- steps 1)))))

(defun putnam-1966-a2-poly-gcd (left right)
  (putnam-1966-a2-poly-gcd-steps
   left
   right
   (+ 2
      (len (putnam-1966-a2-poly-normalize left))
      (len (putnam-1966-a2-poly-normalize right)))))

(defun putnam-1966-a2-sturm-tail (previous current steps)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix steps)))
  (let ((normalized-current
         (putnam-1966-a2-poly-normalize current)))
    (if (or (zp steps)
            (not (consp normalized-current)))
        nil
      (cons
       normalized-current
       (putnam-1966-a2-sturm-tail
        normalized-current
        (putnam-1966-a2-poly-negate
         (putnam-1966-a2-poly-remainder
          previous normalized-current))
        (- steps 1))))))

(defun putnam-1966-a2-sturm-chain (polynomial)
  (let ((normalized (putnam-1966-a2-poly-normalize polynomial)))
    (if (consp normalized)
        (cons
         normalized
         (putnam-1966-a2-sturm-tail
          normalized
          (putnam-1966-a2-poly-derivative normalized)
          (+ 1 (len normalized))))
      nil)))

(defun putnam-1966-a2-poly-evaluate (polynomial value)
  (if (consp polynomial)
      (+ (car polynomial)
         (* value
            (putnam-1966-a2-poly-evaluate
             (cdr polynomial) value)))
    0))

(defun putnam-1966-a2-chain-values-at (chain value)
  (if (consp chain)
      (cons
       (putnam-1966-a2-poly-evaluate (car chain) value)
       (putnam-1966-a2-chain-values-at (cdr chain) value))
    nil))

(defun putnam-1966-a2-sign (value)
  (cond
   ((< value 0) -1)
   ((< 0 value) 1)
   (t 0)))

(defun putnam-1966-a2-sign-variations-aux (values previous-sign)
  (if (consp values)
      (let ((current-sign (putnam-1966-a2-sign (car values))))
        (cond
         ((equal current-sign 0)
          (putnam-1966-a2-sign-variations-aux
           (cdr values) previous-sign))
         ((equal previous-sign 0)
          (putnam-1966-a2-sign-variations-aux
           (cdr values) current-sign))
         (t
          (+ (if (equal current-sign previous-sign) 0 1)
             (putnam-1966-a2-sign-variations-aux
              (cdr values) current-sign)))))
    0))

(defun putnam-1966-a2-sign-variations (values)
  (putnam-1966-a2-sign-variations-aux values 0))

(defun putnam-1966-a2-open-root-count (polynomial lower upper)
  (let ((chain (putnam-1966-a2-sturm-chain polynomial)))
    (- (putnam-1966-a2-sign-variations
        (putnam-1966-a2-chain-values-at chain lower))
       (putnam-1966-a2-sign-variations
        (putnam-1966-a2-chain-values-at chain upper)))))

(defun putnam-1966-a2-isolates-one-root-p
    (polynomial lower upper)
  (let ((normalized (putnam-1966-a2-poly-normalize polynomial)))
    (and
     (putnam-1966-a2-rational-polynomial-p normalized)
     (consp normalized)
     (< 0 (putnam-1966-a2-poly-degree normalized))
     (rationalp lower)
     (rationalp upper)
     (< lower upper)
     (not (equal
           (putnam-1966-a2-poly-evaluate normalized lower)
           0))
     (not (equal
           (putnam-1966-a2-poly-evaluate normalized upper)
           0))
     (equal
      (putnam-1966-a2-open-root-count normalized lower upper)
      1))))

(defun putnam-1966-a2-root-free-p (polynomial lower upper)
  (let ((normalized (putnam-1966-a2-poly-normalize polynomial)))
    (and
     (putnam-1966-a2-rational-polynomial-p normalized)
     (consp normalized)
     (rationalp lower)
     (rationalp upper)
     (< lower upper)
     (not (equal
           (putnam-1966-a2-poly-evaluate normalized lower)
           0))
     (not (equal
           (putnam-1966-a2-poly-evaluate normalized upper)
           0))
     (equal
      (putnam-1966-a2-open-root-count normalized lower upper)
      0))))

(defun putnam-1966-a2-zero-at-isolated-root-p
    (primitive value lower upper)
  (let ((normalized-value
         (putnam-1966-a2-poly-normalize value)))
    (or
     (not (consp normalized-value))
     (putnam-1966-a2-isolates-one-root-p
      (putnam-1966-a2-poly-gcd primitive normalized-value)
      lower
      upper))))

(defun putnam-1966-a2-sign-decidable-p
    (primitive value lower upper)
  (or
   (putnam-1966-a2-zero-at-isolated-root-p
    primitive value lower upper)
   (putnam-1966-a2-root-free-p value lower upper)))

(defun putnam-1966-a2-sign-at-isolated-root
    (primitive value lower upper)
  (if (putnam-1966-a2-zero-at-isolated-root-p
       primitive value lower upper)
      0
    (putnam-1966-a2-sign
     (putnam-1966-a2-poly-evaluate value lower))))

(defun putnam-1966-a2-positive-at-root-p
    (primitive value lower upper)
  (equal
   (putnam-1966-a2-sign-at-isolated-root
    primitive value lower upper)
   1))

(defun putnambench-putnam-1966-a2-statement
    (primitive lower upper x y z r)
  (let* ((x-squared (putnam-1966-a2-poly-multiply x x))
         (y-squared (putnam-1966-a2-poly-multiply y y))
         (z-squared (putnam-1966-a2-poly-multiply z z))
         (r-squared (putnam-1966-a2-poly-multiply r r))
         (x-plus-y-plus-z
          (putnam-1966-a2-poly-add
           x
           (putnam-1966-a2-poly-add y z)))
         (xyz
          (putnam-1966-a2-poly-multiply
           (putnam-1966-a2-poly-multiply x y)
           z))
         (inradius-equation
          (putnam-1966-a2-poly-subtract
           (putnam-1966-a2-poly-multiply
            r-squared x-plus-y-plus-z)
           xyz))
         (pair-square-sum
          (putnam-1966-a2-poly-add
           (putnam-1966-a2-poly-multiply y-squared z-squared)
           (putnam-1966-a2-poly-add
            (putnam-1966-a2-poly-multiply z-squared x-squared)
            (putnam-1966-a2-poly-multiply x-squared y-squared))))
         (inequality-gap
          (putnam-1966-a2-poly-subtract
           (putnam-1966-a2-poly-multiply
            r-squared pair-square-sum)
           (putnam-1966-a2-poly-multiply
            (putnam-1966-a2-poly-multiply x-squared y-squared)
            z-squared))))
    (implies
     (and
      (putnam-1966-a2-isolates-one-root-p
       primitive lower upper)
      (putnam-1966-a2-rational-polynomial-p x)
      (putnam-1966-a2-rational-polynomial-p y)
      (putnam-1966-a2-rational-polynomial-p z)
      (putnam-1966-a2-rational-polynomial-p r)
      (putnam-1966-a2-sign-decidable-p
       primitive x lower upper)
      (putnam-1966-a2-sign-decidable-p
       primitive y lower upper)
      (putnam-1966-a2-sign-decidable-p
       primitive z lower upper)
      (putnam-1966-a2-sign-decidable-p
       primitive r lower upper)
      (putnam-1966-a2-sign-decidable-p
       primitive inradius-equation lower upper)
      (putnam-1966-a2-sign-decidable-p
       primitive inequality-gap lower upper)
      (putnam-1966-a2-positive-at-root-p
       primitive x lower upper)
      (putnam-1966-a2-positive-at-root-p
       primitive y lower upper)
      (putnam-1966-a2-positive-at-root-p
       primitive z lower upper)
      (putnam-1966-a2-positive-at-root-p
       primitive r lower upper)
      (equal
       (putnam-1966-a2-sign-at-isolated-root
        primitive inradius-equation lower upper)
       0))
     (not
      (equal
       (putnam-1966-a2-sign-at-isolated-root
        primitive inequality-gap lower upper)
       -1)))))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

title: putnam_1966_a2
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1966_a2:
-- for a noncollinear real triangle with inradius r and semiperimeter p, the sum
-- of the reciprocal squares of p minus each side length is at least 1 / r squared.
-- This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; _*_)

infix 4 _!=_
infixr 3 _and_
infixr 2 _or_

data Bottom : Set where

Not : Set -> Set
Not A = A -> Bottom

_!=_ : {A : Set} -> A -> A -> Set
x != y = Not (x == y)

record _and_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data _or_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  left  : A -> A or B
  right : B -> A or B

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

record ExistsUniqueBy
  (A : Set)
  (equal : A -> A -> Set)
  (P : A -> Set) :
  Set where

  constructor unique-witness
  field
    unique-value : A
    unique-property : P unique-value
    uniqueness :
      (other : A) ->
      P other ->
      equal other unique-value

record CompleteOrderedRealField (R : Set) : Set1 where
  field
    zeroR oneR : R
    addR multiplyR : R -> R -> R
    negateR inverseR squareRootR : R -> R
    lessOrEqualR : R -> R -> Set
    fromNatR : Nat -> R

    oneR-not-zeroR :
      oneR != zeroR

    addR-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> addR x y == addR y x
    addR-associative :
      (x y z : R) -> addR (addR x y) z == addR x (addR y z)
    addR-zero :
      (x : R) -> addR x zeroR == x
    addR-inverse :
      (x : R) -> addR x (negateR x) == zeroR

    multiplyR-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> multiplyR x y == multiplyR y x
    multiplyR-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiplyR (multiplyR x y) z == multiplyR x (multiplyR y z)
    multiplyR-one :
      (x : R) -> multiplyR x oneR == x
    multiplyR-zero :
      (x : R) -> multiplyR x zeroR == zeroR
    distributeR :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiplyR x (addR y z) ==
      addR (multiplyR x y) (multiplyR x z)
    inverseR-zero :
      inverseR zeroR == zeroR
    multiplyR-inverse :
      (x : R) ->
      x != zeroR ->
      multiplyR x (inverseR x) == oneR

    order-reflexive :
      (x : R) -> lessOrEqualR x x
    order-transitive :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR x y ->
      lessOrEqualR y z ->
      lessOrEqualR x z
    order-antisymmetric :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR x y ->
      lessOrEqualR y x ->
      x == y
    order-total :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR x y or lessOrEqualR y x
    addR-order :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR x y ->
      lessOrEqualR (addR z x) (addR z y)
    multiplyR-nonnegative :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR zeroR x ->
      lessOrEqualR zeroR y ->
      lessOrEqualR zeroR (multiplyR x y)
    zeroR-less-than-oneR :
      lessOrEqualR zeroR oneR and zeroR != oneR

    fromNatR-zero :
      fromNatR zero == zeroR
    fromNatR-successor :
      (n : Nat) -> fromNatR (suc n) == addR (fromNatR n) oneR
    fromNatR-addition :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNatR (m + n) == addR (fromNatR m) (fromNatR n)
    fromNatR-multiplication :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNatR (m * n) == multiplyR (fromNatR m) (fromNatR n)
    fromNatR-injective :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNatR m == fromNatR n ->
      m == n

    archimedean :
      (x : R) ->
      Exists Nat (\ n -> lessOrEqualR x (fromNatR n))
    least-upper-bound :
      (P : R -> Set) ->
      Exists R P ->
      Exists R
        (\ upper ->
          (x : R) ->
          P x ->
          lessOrEqualR x upper) ->
      Exists R
        (\ supremum ->
          ((x : R) -> P x -> lessOrEqualR x supremum)
          and
          ((upper : R) ->
            ((x : R) -> P x -> lessOrEqualR x upper) ->
            lessOrEqualR supremum upper))

    square-root-nonnegative :
      (x : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR zeroR (squareRootR x)
    square-root-square :
      (x : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR zeroR x ->
      multiplyR (squareRootR x) (squareRootR x) == x
    square-root-nonpositive :
      (x : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR x zeroR ->
      squareRootR x == zeroR
    square-root-unique :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR zeroR y ->
      multiplyR y y == x ->
      y == squareRootR x

open CompleteOrderedRealField

subtract :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
subtract reals x y =
  addR reals x (negateR reals y)

divide :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
divide reals x y =
  multiplyR reals x (inverseR reals y)

square :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R
square reals x =
  multiplyR reals x x

two :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R
two reals =
  addR reals (oneR reals) (oneR reals)

Nonnegative :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  Set
Nonnegative reals x =
  lessOrEqualR reals (zeroR reals) x

record Point (R : Set) : Set where
  constructor point
  field
    x-coordinate : R
    y-coordinate : R

open Point

PointEqual :
  {R : Set} ->
  Point R ->
  Point R ->
  Set
PointEqual p q =
  x-coordinate p == x-coordinate q
  and
  y-coordinate p == y-coordinate q

squaredDistance :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Point R ->
  Point R ->
  R
squaredDistance reals p q =
  addR reals
    (square reals
      (subtract reals (x-coordinate p) (x-coordinate q)))
    (square reals
      (subtract reals (y-coordinate p) (y-coordinate q)))

distance :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Point R ->
  Point R ->
  R
distance reals p q =
  squareRootR reals (squaredDistance reals p q)

doubleSignedArea :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Point R ->
  Point R ->
  Point R ->
  R
doubleSignedArea reals a b c =
  subtract reals
    (multiplyR reals
      (subtract reals (x-coordinate b) (x-coordinate a))
      (subtract reals (y-coordinate c) (y-coordinate a)))
    (multiplyR reals
      (subtract reals (y-coordinate b) (y-coordinate a))
      (subtract reals (x-coordinate c) (x-coordinate a)))

Collinear :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Point R ->
  Point R ->
  Point R ->
  Set
Collinear reals a b c =
  doubleSignedArea reals a b c == zeroR reals

weightedPoint :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Point R ->
  Point R ->
  Point R ->
  Point R
weightedPoint reals alpha beta gamma a b c =
  point
    (addR reals
      (addR reals
        (multiplyR reals alpha (x-coordinate a))
        (multiplyR reals beta (x-coordinate b)))
      (multiplyR reals gamma (x-coordinate c)))
    (addR reals
      (addR reals
        (multiplyR reals alpha (y-coordinate a))
        (multiplyR reals beta (y-coordinate b)))
      (multiplyR reals gamma (y-coordinate c)))

InTriangleConvexHull :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Point R ->
  Point R ->
  Point R ->
  Point R ->
  Set
InTriangleConvexHull {R} reals a b c z =
  Exists R
    (\ alpha ->
      Exists R
        (\ beta ->
          Exists R
            (\ gamma ->
              Nonnegative reals alpha
              and
              Nonnegative reals beta
              and
              Nonnegative reals gamma
              and
              addR reals (addR reals alpha beta) gamma == oneR reals
              and
              PointEqual z
                (weightedPoint reals alpha beta gamma a b c))))

SideContact :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Point R ->
  R ->
  Point R ->
  Point R ->
  Point R ->
  Set
SideContact reals center radius a b contact =
  distance reals center contact == radius
  and
  Collinear reals contact a b

UniqueSideContact :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Point R ->
  R ->
  Point R ->
  Point R ->
  Set
UniqueSideContact {R} reals center radius a b =
  ExistsUniqueBy
    (Point R)
    PointEqual
    (SideContact reals center radius a b)

HasInradius :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Point R ->
  Point R ->
  Point R ->
  R ->
  Set
HasInradius {R} reals a b c radius =
  Exists (Point R)
    (\ center ->
      UniqueSideContact reals center radius b c
      and
      UniqueSideContact reals center radius c a
      and
      UniqueSideContact reals center radius a b
      and
      ((z : Point R) ->
        lessOrEqualR reals (distance reals center z) radius ->
        InTriangleConvexHull reals a b c z))

reciprocalSquare :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R
reciprocalSquare reals x =
  divide reals (oneR reals) (square reals x)

module Putnam1966A2Statement
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) where

  proposition : Set
  proposition =
    (r : R) ->
    (A B C : Point R) ->
    Not (Collinear reals A B C) ->
    (a b c p : R) ->
    a == distance reals B C ->
    b == distance reals C A ->
    c == distance reals A B ->
    p ==
      divide reals
        (addR reals
          (addR reals
            (distance reals B C)
            (distance reals C A))
          (distance reals A B))
        (two reals) ->
    HasInradius reals A B C r ->
    lessOrEqualR reals
      (reciprocalSquare reals r)
      (addR reals
        (addR reals
          (reciprocalSquare reals (subtract reals p a))
          (reciprocalSquare reals (subtract reals p b)))
        (reciprocalSquare reals (subtract reals p c)))

putnam-1966-a2 : Set1
putnam-1966-a2 =
  (R : Set) ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) ->
  Putnam1966A2Statement.proposition reals

title: putnam_1966_a2
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench artifact putnam_1966_a2:
  the side lengths, semiperimeter, and inradius of a nondegenerate real-plane
  triangle satisfy the stated reciprocal-square inequality. This file contains
  no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open pairTheory realTheory transcTheory;

val putnam_1966_a2 =
  ``let dist =
      \P Q : real # real.
        sqrt ((FST P - FST Q) pow 2 + (SND P - SND Q) pow 2)
    in
    let collinear =
      \P Q R : real # real.
        (FST P - FST R) * (SND Q - SND R) =
        (SND P - SND R) * (FST Q - FST R)
    in
    let in_convex_hull =
      \Z A B C : real # real.
        ?u v w : real.
          0 <= u /\ 0 <= v /\ 0 <= w /\ u + v + w = 1 /\
          Z = (u * FST A + v * FST B + w * FST C,
               u * SND A + v * SND B + w * SND C)
    in
      !r a b c p : real. !A B C : real # real.
        a = dist B C /\
        b = dist C A /\
        c = dist A B /\
        p = (dist B C + dist C A + dist A B) / 2 /\
        ~collinear A B C /\
        (?I : real # real.
           (?!P : real # real.
              dist I P = r /\ collinear P B C) /\
           (?!Q : real # real.
              dist I Q = r /\ collinear Q C A) /\
           (?!R : real # real.
              dist I R = r /\ collinear R A B) /\
           (!Z : real # real.
              dist I Z <= r ==> in_convex_hull Z A B C))
        ==>
        1 / ((p - a) pow 2) +
        1 / ((p - b) pow 2) +
        1 / ((p - c) pow 2) >=
        1 / (r pow 2)``;

title: putnam_1966_a2
content:
$(
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench artifact putnam_1966_a2:
  the reciprocal-square inequality for the side lengths, semiperimeter, and
  inradius of a noncollinear real-plane triangle. This file contains no proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  P66A2R2 is the real coordinate plane. P66A2Dist is Euclidean distance,
  P66A2Col is determinant collinearity, and P66A2Hull is the convex hull of
  three points via nonnegative barycentric coordinates. P66A2UniqueTangency
  states existence and uniqueness, within the plane, of a point on the line
  through its last two arguments at the specified distance from its first.

  The final unproved $a assertion preserves the arbitrary real parameters,
  noncollinearity assumption, internally existential incenter, three unique
  tangency conditions, closed-disk containment, and reciprocal-square
  conclusion of the Lean and Isabelle sources. This database has no $p proof
  statement.
$)

$c P66A2I P66A2R2 P66A2Dist P66A2Col P66A2Hull
   P66A2UniqueTangency $.

p66a2-index-syntax $a class P66A2I $.
p66a2-plane-syntax $a class P66A2R2 $.
p66a2-distance-syntax $a class ( P66A2Dist A B ) $.
p66a2-collinear-syntax $a wff ( P66A2Col A B C ) $.
p66a2-hull-syntax $a class ( P66A2Hull A B C ) $.
p66a2-unique-tangency-syntax $a
  wff ( P66A2UniqueTangency I r A B ) $.

p66a2-index-definition $a |- P66A2I = ( 1 ... 2 ) $.

p66a2-plane-definition $a |- P66A2R2 = ( RR ^m P66A2I ) $.

${
  $d A B j $.

  p66a2-distance-definition $a |- (
    P66A2Dist A B
  ) = (
    sqrt
    `
    (
      sum_ j e. P66A2I
        ( ( ( A ` j ) - ( B ` j ) ) ^ 2 )
    )
  ) $.
$}

p66a2-collinear-definition $a |- (
  ( P66A2Col A B C )
  <->
  (
    (
      ( ( B ` 1 ) - ( A ` 1 ) )
      x.
      ( ( C ` 2 ) - ( A ` 2 ) )
    )
    =
    (
      ( ( B ` 2 ) - ( A ` 2 ) )
      x.
      ( ( C ` 1 ) - ( A ` 1 ) )
    )
  )
) $.

${
  $d A B C j u v w x $.

  p66a2-hull-definition $a |- (
    P66A2Hull A B C
  ) = {
    x e. P66A2R2 |
    E. u e. RR E. v e. RR E. w e. RR
      (
        (
          0 <_ u
          /\
          (
            0 <_ v
            /\
            0 <_ w
          )
        )
        /\
        (
          ( ( u + v ) + w ) = 1
          /\
          x =
            (
              j e. P66A2I |->
                (
                  (
                    ( u x. ( A ` j ) )
                    +
                    ( v x. ( B ` j ) )
                  )
                  +
                  ( w x. ( C ` j ) )
                )
            )
        )
      )
  } $.
$}

${
  $d A B I P Q r $.

  p66a2-unique-tangency-definition $a |- (
    ( P66A2UniqueTangency I r A B )
    <->
    E. P e. P66A2R2
      (
        (
          ( P66A2Dist I P ) = r
          /\
          ( P66A2Col P A B )
        )
        /\
        A. Q e. P66A2R2
          (
            (
              ( P66A2Dist I Q ) = r
              /\
              ( P66A2Col Q A B )
            )
            ->
            Q = P
          )
      )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d A B C I Z a b c p r $.

  putnambench-putnam-1966-a2 $a |-
    A. r e. RR
    A. A e. P66A2R2
    A. B e. P66A2R2
    A. C e. P66A2R2
    A. a e. RR
    A. b e. RR
    A. c e. RR
    A. p e. RR
      (
        (
          -. ( P66A2Col A B C )
          /\
          (
            a = ( P66A2Dist B C )
            /\
            (
              b = ( P66A2Dist C A )
              /\
              (
                c = ( P66A2Dist A B )
                /\
                (
                  p =
                    (
                      (
                        (
                          ( P66A2Dist B C )
                          +
                          ( P66A2Dist C A )
                        )
                        +
                        ( P66A2Dist A B )
                      )
                      /
                      2
                    )
                  /\
                  E. I e. P66A2R2
                    (
                      ( P66A2UniqueTangency I r B C )
                      /\
                      (
                        ( P66A2UniqueTangency I r C A )
                        /\
                        (
                          ( P66A2UniqueTangency I r A B )
                          /\
                          A. Z e. P66A2R2
                            (
                              ( P66A2Dist I Z ) <_ r
                              ->
                              Z e. ( P66A2Hull A B C )
                            )
                        )
                      )
                    )
                )
              )
            )
          )
        )
        ->
        (
          ( 1 / ( r ^ 2 ) )
          <_
          (
            (
              ( 1 / ( ( p - a ) ^ 2 ) )
              +
              ( 1 / ( ( p - b ) ^ 2 ) )
            )
            +
            ( 1 / ( ( p - c ) ^ 2 ) )
          )
        )
      )
  $.
$}

:: Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench artifact putnam_1966_a2:
:: the inequality relating the side lengths, semiperimeter, and inradius of

environ

 vocabularies NUMBERS, SUBSET_1, REAL_1, RELAT_1, TARSKI, CARD_1, ARYTM_1,

      RLTOPSP1, EUCLID, TOPREAL6, FUNCT_1, FUNCT_2, BINOP_1, ZFMISC_1,
      SQUARE_1, CONVEX1, RLAFFIN1;

      EUCLID, FUNCT_2, ORDINAL1, CONVEX1, RLAFFIN1, NUMBERS, MEMBERED,
      VALUED_0, VALUED_1, XCMPLX_0, SQUARE_1;
 requirements BOOLE, SUBSET, NUMERALS, ARITHM, REAL;

begin

::$P-
theorem
  for r,a,b,c,p being Real
  for A,B,C being Point of TOP-REAL 2 st
    a = dist(B,C) &
    b = dist(C,A) &
    c = dist(A,B) &
    p = (dist(B,C) + dist(C,A) + dist(A,B)) / 2 &
    not (ex L being line of TOP-REAL 2 st A in L & B in L & C in L) &
    (ex I being Point of TOP-REAL 2 st
      (ex P being Point of TOP-REAL 2 st
        dist(I,P) = r &
        (ex L being line of TOP-REAL 2 st P in L & B in L & C in L) &
        (for P1 being Point of TOP-REAL 2 st
          dist(I,P1) = r &
          (ex L being line of TOP-REAL 2 st P1 in L & B in L & C in L)
        holds P1 = P)) &
      (ex Q being Point of TOP-REAL 2 st
        dist(I,Q) = r &
        (ex L being line of TOP-REAL 2 st Q in L & C in L & A in L) &
        (for Q1 being Point of TOP-REAL 2 st
          dist(I,Q1) = r &
          (ex L being line of TOP-REAL 2 st Q1 in L & C in L & A in L)
        holds Q1 = Q)) &
      (ex R being Point of TOP-REAL 2 st
        dist(I,R) = r &
        (ex L being line of TOP-REAL 2 st R in L & A in L & B in L) &
        (for R1 being Point of TOP-REAL 2 st
          dist(I,R1) = r &
          (ex L being line of TOP-REAL 2 st R1 in L & A in L & B in L)
        holds R1 = R)) &
      (for Z being Point of TOP-REAL 2 st dist(I,Z) <= r holds
        ex x,y,z being Real st
          0 <= x & 0 <= y & 0 <= z & x + y + z = 1 &
          Z = x * A + y * B + z * C))
  holds
    (1 qua Real) / (p-a)^2 + (1 qua Real) / (p-b)^2 +
      (1 qua Real) / (p-c)^2 >= (1 qua Real) / r^2
proof
end;
::$P+

title: putnam_1966_a2
content:
% Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench artifact putnam_1966_a2:
% the side lengths, semiperimeter, and inradius of a nondegenerate real
% Euclidean triangle satisfy a reciprocal-square inequality. This file
% contains no proof.

putnam_1966_a2: THEORY
BEGIN
  point: TYPE = [# x_coord: real, y_coord: real #]
  point_set: TYPE = [point -> bool]

  squared_distance(P, Q: point): real =
    (x_coord(Q) - x_coord(P)) ^ 2
      + (y_coord(Q) - y_coord(P)) ^ 2

  distance(P, Q: point): real =
    epsilon(
      LAMBDA (length: real):
        0 <= length
          AND length * length = squared_distance(P, Q))

  cross_from(P, Q, R: point): real =
    (x_coord(Q) - x_coord(P)) * (y_coord(R) - y_coord(P))
      - (y_coord(Q) - y_coord(P)) * (x_coord(R) - x_coord(P))

  collinear(P, Q, R: point): bool =
    cross_from(P, Q, R) = 0

  affine_combination(t: real, P, Q: point): point =
    (# x_coord := (1 - t) * x_coord(P) + t * x_coord(Q),
       y_coord := (1 - t) * y_coord(P) + t * y_coord(Q) #)

  point_subset(A, B: point_set): bool =
    FORALL (P: point):
      A(P) IMPLIES B(P)

  convex(A: point_set): bool =
    FORALL (P, Q: point), (t: real):
      A(P) AND A(Q) AND 0 <= t AND t <= 1
        IMPLIES A(affine_combination(t, P, Q))

  convex_hull(A: point_set): point_set =
    LAMBDA (P: point):
      FORALL (C: point_set):
        convex(C) AND point_subset(A, C) IMPLIES C(P)

  triangle_vertices(A, B, C: point): point_set =
    LAMBDA (P: point):
      P = A OR P = B OR P = C

  unique_circle_line_point(I: point, r: real, U, V: point): bool =
    EXISTS (P: point):
      distance(I, P) = r
        AND collinear(P, U, V)
        AND FORALL (Q: point):
          distance(I, Q) = r
            AND collinear(Q, U, V)
            IMPLIES Q = P

  quotient_or_zero(numerator, denominator: real): real =
    IF denominator = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      numerator / denominator
    ENDIF

  putnam_1966_a2: bool =
    FORALL
        (r: real), (A, B, C: point), (a, b, c, p: real):
      (NOT collinear(A, B, C)
        AND a = distance(B, C)
        AND b = distance(C, A)
        AND c = distance(A, B)
        AND p = quotient_or_zero(
          distance(B, C) + distance(C, A) + distance(A, B),
          2)
        AND EXISTS (I: point):
          unique_circle_line_point(I, r, B, C)
            AND unique_circle_line_point(I, r, C, A)
            AND unique_circle_line_point(I, r, A, B)
            AND FORALL (Z: point):
              distance(I, Z) <= r
                IMPLIES convex_hull(triangle_vertices(A, B, C))(Z))
      IMPLIES
        quotient_or_zero(1, (p - a) ^ 2)
          + quotient_or_zero(1, (p - b) ^ 2)
          + quotient_or_zero(1, (p - c) ^ 2)
          >= quotient_or_zero(1, r ^ 2)
END putnam_1966_a2

content:
;; Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench artifact putnam_1966_a3:
;; if 0 < x(1) < 1 and x(n+1) = x(n)(1-x(n)), then n*x(n) tends
;; to 1. This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))

;; ACL2's conservative generic-function idiom represents an arbitrary real
;; sequence without restricting it to an APPLY$-recognizable function object.
;; The explicit Archimedean ordered-field interface is sufficient for this
;; algebraic recurrence; positive rational tolerances characterize its real
;; limit exactly.
(defstub p1966a3-scalar-p (x) t)
(defstub p1966a3-add-op (x y) t)
(defstub p1966a3-multiply-op (x y) t)
(defstub p1966a3-negate-op (x) t)
(defstub p1966a3-less-op (x y) t)
(defstub p1966a3-rational-embed (q) t)
(defstub p1966a3-arch-bound (x) t)
(defstub p1966a3-x (n) t)

(defun p1966a3-add (x y)
  (p1966a3-add-op x y))

(defun p1966a3-mul (x y)
  (p1966a3-multiply-op x y))

(defun p1966a3-neg (x)
  (p1966a3-negate-op x))

(defun p1966a3-sub (x y)
  (p1966a3-add x (p1966a3-neg y)))

(defun p1966a3-less (x y)
  (if (p1966a3-less-op x y) t nil))

(defun p1966a3-abs (x zero)
  (if (p1966a3-less x zero)
      (p1966a3-neg x)
    x))

(defun-sk p1966a3-ring-laws-p (zero one)
  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (p1966a3-scalar-p x)
      (p1966a3-scalar-p y)
      (p1966a3-scalar-p z))
     (and
      (p1966a3-scalar-p (p1966a3-add x y))
      (p1966a3-scalar-p (p1966a3-mul x y))
      (p1966a3-scalar-p (p1966a3-neg x))
      (equal (p1966a3-add (p1966a3-add x y) z)
             (p1966a3-add x (p1966a3-add y z)))
      (equal (p1966a3-add x y)
             (p1966a3-add y x))
      (equal (p1966a3-add x zero) x)
      (equal (p1966a3-add x (p1966a3-neg x)) zero)
      (equal (p1966a3-mul (p1966a3-mul x y) z)
             (p1966a3-mul x (p1966a3-mul y z)))
      (equal (p1966a3-mul x y)
             (p1966a3-mul y x))
      (equal (p1966a3-mul x one) x)
      (equal
       (p1966a3-mul x (p1966a3-add y z))
       (p1966a3-add (p1966a3-mul x y)
                    (p1966a3-mul x z)))))))

(defun-sk p1966a3-order-laws-p (zero)
  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (p1966a3-scalar-p x)
      (p1966a3-scalar-p y)
      (p1966a3-scalar-p z))
     (and
      (not (p1966a3-less x x))
      (or
       (equal x y)
       (p1966a3-less x y)
       (p1966a3-less y x))
      (implies
       (and
        (p1966a3-less x y)
        (p1966a3-less y z))
       (p1966a3-less x z))
      (implies
       (p1966a3-less x y)
       (p1966a3-less
        (p1966a3-add x z)
        (p1966a3-add y z)))
      (implies
       (and
        (p1966a3-less zero x)
        (p1966a3-less zero y))
       (p1966a3-less zero (p1966a3-mul x y)))))))

(defun-sk p1966a3-rational-embedding-laws-p ()
  (forall (a b)
    (implies
     (and (rationalp a) (rationalp b))
     (and
      (p1966a3-scalar-p (p1966a3-rational-embed a))
      (equal
       (p1966a3-rational-embed (+ a b))
       (p1966a3-add
        (p1966a3-rational-embed a)
        (p1966a3-rational-embed b)))
      (equal
       (p1966a3-rational-embed (* a b))
       (p1966a3-mul
        (p1966a3-rational-embed a)
        (p1966a3-rational-embed b)))
      (iff
       (< a b)
       (p1966a3-less
        (p1966a3-rational-embed a)
        (p1966a3-rational-embed b)))))))

(defun-sk p1966a3-archimedean-p ()
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (p1966a3-scalar-p x)
     (and
      (natp (p1966a3-arch-bound x))
      (p1966a3-less
       x
       (p1966a3-rational-embed
        (p1966a3-arch-bound x)))))))

(defun p1966a3-real-scalar-structure-p (zero one)
  (and
   (p1966a3-scalar-p zero)
   (p1966a3-scalar-p one)
   (not (equal zero one))
   (p1966a3-less zero one)
   (equal (p1966a3-rational-embed 0) zero)
   (equal (p1966a3-rational-embed 1) one)
   (p1966a3-ring-laws-p zero one)
   (p1966a3-order-laws-p zero)
   (p1966a3-rational-embedding-laws-p)
   (p1966a3-archimedean-p)))

(defun-sk p1966a3-sequence-p ()
  (forall (n)
    (implies
     (natp n)
     (p1966a3-scalar-p (p1966a3-x n)))))

(defun-sk p1966a3-recurrence-p (one)
  (forall (n)
    (implies
     (and (natp n) (<= 1 n))
     (equal
      (p1966a3-x (+ n 1))
      (p1966a3-mul
       (p1966a3-x n)
       (p1966a3-sub one (p1966a3-x n)))))))

(defun p1966a3-scaled-value (n)
  (p1966a3-mul
   (p1966a3-rational-embed n)
   (p1966a3-x n)))

(defun-sk p1966a3-limit-tail-p
    (epsilon cutoff zero one)
  (forall (n)
    (implies
     (and (natp n) (<= cutoff n))
     (p1966a3-less
      (p1966a3-abs
       (p1966a3-sub (p1966a3-scaled-value n) one)
       zero)
      (p1966a3-rational-embed epsilon)))))

(defun-sk p1966a3-limit-cutoff-exists-p
    (epsilon zero one)
  (exists (cutoff)
    (and
     (natp cutoff)
     (p1966a3-limit-tail-p
      epsilon cutoff zero one))))

(defun-sk p1966a3-converges-to-one-p (zero one)
  (forall (epsilon)
    (implies
     (and (rationalp epsilon) (< 0 epsilon))
     (p1966a3-limit-cutoff-exists-p
      epsilon zero one))))

(defun putnambench-putnam-1966-a3-statement (zero one)
  (implies
   (and
    (p1966a3-real-scalar-structure-p zero one)
    (p1966a3-sequence-p)
    (p1966a3-less zero (p1966a3-x 1))
    (p1966a3-less (p1966a3-x 1) one)
    (p1966a3-recurrence-p one))
   (p1966a3-converges-to-one-p zero one)))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

title: putnam_1966_a3
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1966_a3:
-- a real sequence satisfying x_(n+1) = x_n * (1 - x_n) from n = 1 onward,
-- with 0 < x_1 < 1, has n * x_n converging to 1. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; _*_)

infix 4 _!=_ _<=N_
infixr 3 _and_
infixr 2 _or_

data Bottom : Set where

Not : Set -> Set
Not A = A -> Bottom

_!=_ : {A : Set} -> A -> A -> Set
x != y = Not (x == y)

record _and_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data _or_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  left  : A -> A or B
  right : B -> A or B

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

data _<=N_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set where
  zero<=   : {n : Nat} -> zero <=N n
  suc<=suc : {m n : Nat} -> m <=N n -> suc m <=N suc n

record CompleteOrderedRealField (R : Set) : Set1 where
  field
    zeroR oneR : R
    addR multiplyR : R -> R -> R
    negateR inverseR : R -> R
    lessOrEqualR : R -> R -> Set
    fromNatR : Nat -> R

    oneR-not-zeroR :
      oneR != zeroR

    addR-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> addR x y == addR y x
    addR-associative :
      (x y z : R) -> addR (addR x y) z == addR x (addR y z)
    addR-zero :
      (x : R) -> addR x zeroR == x
    addR-inverse :
      (x : R) -> addR x (negateR x) == zeroR

    multiplyR-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> multiplyR x y == multiplyR y x
    multiplyR-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiplyR (multiplyR x y) z == multiplyR x (multiplyR y z)
    multiplyR-one :
      (x : R) -> multiplyR x oneR == x
    multiplyR-zero :
      (x : R) -> multiplyR x zeroR == zeroR
    distributeR :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiplyR x (addR y z) ==
      addR (multiplyR x y) (multiplyR x z)
    inverseR-zero :
      inverseR zeroR == zeroR
    multiplyR-inverse :
      (x : R) ->
      x != zeroR ->
      multiplyR x (inverseR x) == oneR

    order-reflexive :
      (x : R) -> lessOrEqualR x x
    order-transitive :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR x y ->
      lessOrEqualR y z ->
      lessOrEqualR x z
    order-antisymmetric :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR x y ->
      lessOrEqualR y x ->
      x == y
    order-total :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR x y or lessOrEqualR y x
    addR-order :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR x y ->
      lessOrEqualR (addR z x) (addR z y)
    multiplyR-nonnegative :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR zeroR x ->
      lessOrEqualR zeroR y ->
      lessOrEqualR zeroR (multiplyR x y)
    zeroR-less-than-oneR :
      lessOrEqualR zeroR oneR and zeroR != oneR

    fromNatR-zero :
      fromNatR zero == zeroR
    fromNatR-successor :
      (n : Nat) -> fromNatR (suc n) == addR (fromNatR n) oneR
    fromNatR-addition :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNatR (m + n) == addR (fromNatR m) (fromNatR n)
    fromNatR-multiplication :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNatR (m * n) == multiplyR (fromNatR m) (fromNatR n)
    fromNatR-injective :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNatR m == fromNatR n ->
      m == n

    archimedean :
      (x : R) ->
      Exists Nat (\ n -> lessOrEqualR x (fromNatR n))
    least-upper-bound :
      (P : R -> Set) ->
      Exists R P ->
      Exists R
        (\ upper ->
          (x : R) ->
          P x ->
          lessOrEqualR x upper) ->
      Exists R
        (\ supremum ->
          ((x : R) -> P x -> lessOrEqualR x supremum)
          and
          ((upper : R) ->
            ((x : R) -> P x -> lessOrEqualR x upper) ->
            lessOrEqualR supremum upper))

open CompleteOrderedRealField

subtract :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
subtract reals x y =
  addR reals x (negateR reals y)

StrictLess :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
StrictLess reals x y =
  lessOrEqualR reals x y and x != y

CloseTo :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
CloseTo reals center radius x =
  StrictLess reals (subtract reals center radius) x
  and
  StrictLess reals x (addR reals center radius)

SequentialLimit :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  R ->
  Set
SequentialLimit {R} reals sequence limit =
  (epsilon : R) ->
  StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) epsilon ->
  Exists Nat
    (\ cutoff ->
      (n : Nat) ->
      cutoff <=N n ->
      CloseTo reals limit epsilon (sequence n))

putnam-1966-a3 : Set1
putnam-1966-a3 =
  (R : Set) ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) ->
  (x : Nat -> R) ->
  StrictLess reals
    (zeroR reals)
    (x (suc zero)) ->
  StrictLess reals
    (x (suc zero))
    (oneR reals) ->
  ((n : Nat) ->
    suc zero <=N n ->
    x (suc n) ==
      multiplyR reals
        (x n)
        (subtract reals (oneR reals) (x n))) ->
  SequentialLimit reals
    (\ n ->
      multiplyR reals
        (fromNatR reals n)
        (x n))
    (oneR reals)

BEGIN
  real_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> real]

  sorry

end

(*
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench artifact putnam_1966_a4:
  the closed form for the increasing sequence of positive integers that
  omits perfect squares. This file contains no proof.
*)

let statement =
  `let nearest_integer =
     \x:real.
       @z:int.
         real_of_int z - &1 / &2 <= x /\
         x < real_of_int z + &1 / &2 in
   !a:num->int.
     a 1 = &2 /\
     (!n:num.
        1 <= n
        ==> a (n + 1) =
            (if ?m:int. m pow 2 = a n + &1
             then a n + &2
             else a n + &1))
     ==> !n:num.
           1 <= n
           ==> a n = &n + nearest_integer (sqrt (&n))`;;

title: putnam_1966_a4
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact
;; putnam_1966_a4: the closed form for the ascending sequence of positive
;; integers that are not perfect squares, using the nearest integer to the
;; square root of the index. This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

;; Searching down from X keeps the source existential square witness internal.
;; For nonnegative X, any integer M with M^2 = X has |M| <= X, so this search
;; is equivalent to existence of an integer square root.
(defun putnam-1966-a4-square-witness-down-p (x candidate)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix candidate)))
  (if (zp candidate)
      (equal x 0)
    (or (equal (* candidate candidate) x)
        (putnam-1966-a4-square-witness-down-p
         x (- candidate 1)))))

(defun putnam-1966-a4-perfect-square-p (x)
  (and (natp x)
       (putnam-1966-a4-square-witness-down-p x x)))

;; The source assumptions uniquely determine A on all positive indices.
;; Defining that sequence recursively therefore eliminates the arbitrary
;; function bidirectionally: every source A agrees with this function for
;; n >= 1, and this function itself satisfies the source base and recurrence.
(defun putnam-1966-a4-sequence-value (n)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix n)))
  (if (or (not (natp n))
          (<= n 1))
      2
    (let ((previous
           (putnam-1966-a4-sequence-value (- n 1))))
      (if (putnam-1966-a4-perfect-square-p
           (+ previous 1))
          (+ previous 2)
        (+ previous 1)))))

;; This returns floor(sqrt(N)) for natural N.
(defun putnam-1966-a4-floor-sqrt-down (n candidate)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix candidate)))
  (if (zp candidate)
      0
    (if (<= (* candidate candidate) n)
        candidate
      (putnam-1966-a4-floor-sqrt-down
       n (- candidate 1)))))

(defun putnam-1966-a4-floor-sqrt (n)
  (putnam-1966-a4-floor-sqrt-down n n))

;; If K = floor(sqrt(N)), comparison of 4*N with (2*K+1)^2 decides whether
;; sqrt(N) lies below or above K+1/2. Equality cannot occur for integral N,
;; so this is exactly round(sqrt(N)), equivalently floor(sqrt(N)+1/2).
(defun putnam-1966-a4-rounded-sqrt (n)
  (let* ((k (putnam-1966-a4-floor-sqrt n))
         (midpoint-numerator (+ (* 2 k) 1)))
    (if (< (* 4 n)
           (* midpoint-numerator midpoint-numerator))
        k
      (+ k 1))))

(defun putnambench-putnam-1966-a4-statement (n)
  (implies
   (and (natp n)
        (<= 1 n))
   (equal
    (putnam-1966-a4-sequence-value n)
    (+ n (putnam-1966-a4-rounded-sqrt n)))))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

title: putnam_1966_a4
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1966_a4:
-- the recursively enumerated positive nonsquares have nth term equal to n plus
-- the nearest integer to the square root of n. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Int using (Int; pos; negsuc)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; _-_; _*_)

infix 4 _<=N_ _<N_
infixr 3 _and_
infixr 2 _or_

data Bottom : Set where

Not : Set -> Set
Not A =
  A -> Bottom

record _and_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data _or_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  left  : A -> A or B
  right : B -> A or B

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

data _<=N_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set where
  zero<=   : {n : Nat} -> zero <=N n
  suc<=suc : {m n : Nat} -> m <=N n -> suc m <=N suc n

_<N_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set
m <N n =
  suc m <=N n

negative : Nat -> Int
negative zero =
  pos zero
negative (suc n) =
  negsuc n

difference : Nat -> Nat -> Int
difference zero zero =
  pos zero
difference (suc m) zero =
  pos (suc m)
difference zero (suc n) =
  negsuc n
difference (suc m) (suc n) =
  difference m n

addInt : Int -> Int -> Int
addInt (pos m) (pos n) =
  pos (m + n)
addInt (pos m) (negsuc n) =
  difference m (suc n)
addInt (negsuc m) (pos n) =
  difference n (suc m)
addInt (negsuc m) (negsuc n) =
  negsuc (suc (m + n))

multiplyInt : Int -> Int -> Int
multiplyInt (pos m) (pos n) =
  pos (m * n)
multiplyInt (pos m) (negsuc n) =
  negative (m * suc n)
multiplyInt (negsuc m) (pos n) =
  negative (suc m * n)
multiplyInt (negsuc m) (negsuc n) =
  pos (suc m * suc n)

squareInt : Int -> Int
squareInt x =
  multiplyInt x x

oneN : Nat
oneN =
  suc zero

twoN : Nat
twoN =
  suc oneN

fourN : Nat
fourN =
  twoN * twoN

oneZ : Int
oneZ =
  pos oneN

twoZ : Int
twoZ =
  pos twoN

IsIntegerSquare : Int -> Set
IsIntegerSquare x =
  Exists Int (\ m -> squareInt m == x)

RoundedSquareRoot : Nat -> Nat -> Set
RoundedSquareRoot n k =
  ((twoN * k - oneN) * (twoN * k - oneN) <=N fourN * n)
  and
  (fourN * n <N (twoN * k + oneN) * (twoN * k + oneN))

SatisfiesRecurrence : (Nat -> Int) -> Set
SatisfiesRecurrence a =
  (n : Nat) ->
  oneN <=N n ->
  (IsIntegerSquare (addInt (a n) oneZ)
    and
    a (suc n) == addInt (a n) twoZ)
  or
  (Not (IsIntegerSquare (addInt (a n) oneZ))
    and
    a (suc n) == addInt (a n) oneZ)

putnam-1966-a4 : Set
putnam-1966-a4 =
  (a : Nat -> Int) ->
  a oneN == twoZ ->
  SatisfiesRecurrence a ->
  (n : Nat) ->
  oneN <=N n ->
  Exists Nat
    (\ k ->
      RoundedSquareRoot n k
      and
      a n == pos (n + k))

(*
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench artifact putnam_1966_a4:
  the nth positive nonsquare generated by skipping each next perfect square
  equals n plus the nearest integer to sqrt n. This file contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open arithmeticTheory integerTheory realTheory intrealTheory;

val putnam_1966_a4 =
  ``!a : num -> int.
      a 1 = 2 /\
      (!n : num.
         1 <= n
         ==>
         a (n + 1) =
           if ?m : int. m * m = a n + 1
           then a n + 2
           else a n + 1)
      ==>
      !n : num.
        1 <= n
        ==>
        a n =
          int_of_num n + (flr (sqrt (&n) + 1 / 2) : int)``;

title: putnam_1966_a4

$(
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench artifact putnam_1966_a4:
  the formula for the integer sequence enumerating the positive nonsquares,
  defined by stepping past each perfect square. This file contains no proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  A ranges over all integer-valued sequences indexed by the nonnegative
  integers. Quantification over NN is exactly quantification over the source
  indices n >= 1. The recurrence is expressed by its exhaustive square and
  nonsquare cases, preserving the source conditional. In the nonsquare case,
  the next-term equality is placed before the negated restricted existential
  so that the existential's scope is exactly the perfect-square test.

  For n in NN, sqrt(n) is nonnegative and cannot be a nonintegral
  half-integer. Therefore floor(sqrt(n) + 1/2) is exactly the source
  nearest-integer value round(sqrt(n)), as also made explicit in the Rocq
  source. The final declaration is the single unproved $a corpus statement;
  this database contains no $p proof statement.
$)

${
  $d A m n $.

  putnambench-putnam-1966-a4 $a |- A. A e. ( ZZ ^m NN0 )
    (
      (
        ( A ` 1 ) = 2
        /\
        A. n e. NN
          (
            (
              E. m e. ZZ
                ( m ^ 2 ) = ( ( A ` n ) + 1 )
              /\
              ( A ` ( n + 1 ) ) = ( ( A ` n ) + 2 )
            )
            \/
            (
              ( A ` ( n + 1 ) ) = ( ( A ` n ) + 1 )
              /\
              -. E. m e. ZZ
                ( m ^ 2 ) = ( ( A ` n ) + 1 )
            )
          )
      )
      ->
      A. n e. NN
        ( A ` n )
        =
        (
          n
          +
          ( |_ ` ( ( sqrt ` n ) + ( 1 / 2 ) ) )
        )
    )
  $.
$}

% Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench artifact putnam_1966_a4:
% the integer sequence beginning at two and skipping perfect squares has
% nth term n plus the nearest integer to sqrt(n). This file contains no proof.

putnam_1966_a4: THEORY
BEGIN
  sqrt_value(root: real, radicand: nat): bool =
    0 <= root AND root * root = (radicand :: real)

  putnam_1966_a4: bool =
    FORALL (a: [nat -> int]):
      (a(1) = 2
        AND FORALL (n: nat):
          n >= 1 IMPLIES
            a(n + 1) =
              IF EXISTS (m: int):
                   m ^ 2 = a(n) + 1
              THEN
                a(n) + 2
              ELSE
                a(n) + 1
              ENDIF)
      IMPLIES
        FORALL (n: nat):
          n >= 1 IMPLIES
            EXISTS (root: real):
              sqrt_value(root, n)
                AND a(n) =
                  (n :: int) + floor(root + 1 / 2)
END putnam_1966_a4

import Mathlib

/--
Let $C$ be the set of continuous functions $f : \mathbb{R} \to \mathbb{R}$. Let $T : C \to C$ satisfty the following two properties:
\begin{enumerate}
\item Linearity: $T(af + bg) = aT(f) + bT(g)$ for all $a, b \in \mathbb{R}$ and all $f, g \in C$.
\item Locality: If $f \in C$ and $g \in C$ are identical on some interval $I$, then $T(f)$ and $T(g)$ are also identical on $I$.
\end{enumerate}
Prove that there exists some function $f \in C$ such that $T(g(x)) = f(x)g(x)$ for all $g \in C$.
-/
theorem putnam_1966_a5

(hC : C = {f : ℝ → ℝ | Continuous f})
(T : (ℝ → ℝ) → (ℝ → ℝ))
(imageTC : ∀ f ∈ C, T f ∈ C)
(linearT : ∀ a b : ℝ, ∀ f ∈ C, ∀ g ∈ C, T ((fun x => a)*f + (fun x => b)*g) = (fun x => a)*(T f) + (fun x => b)*(T g))
(localT : ∀ r s : ℝ, r ≤ s → ∀ f ∈ C, ∀ g ∈ C, (∀ x ∈ Set.Icc r s, f x = g x) → (∀ x ∈ Set.Icc r s, T f x = T g x))

From mathcomp Require Import all_algebra all_ssreflect.

From mathcomp Require Import classical_sets.

Variable R : realType.
Theorem putnam_1966_a5
    (C := [set f : R -> R | continuous f])
    (T : (R -> R) -> (R -> R))
    (imageTC : forall f : R -> R, f \in C -> T f \in C)
    (linearT : forall a b : R, forall f g : R -> R, f \in C -> g \in C -> T (fun x : R => a * f x + b * g x) = (fun x => a * T f x + b * T g x))
    (localT : forall r s : R, r <= s -> forall f g : R -> R, f \in C -> g \in C -> (forall x : R, r <= x <= s -> f x = g x) -> (forall x : R, r <= x <= s -> T f x = T g x))

(*
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench artifact putnam_1966_a5:
  a linear operator on continuous real-valued functions that preserves
  equality on closed intervals is pointwise multiplication by a continuous
  function. This file contains no proof.
*)

let statement =
  `let continuous =
     \(f:real->real).
       !x e:real.
         &0 < e
         ==> ?d:real.
               &0 < d /\
               !y:real. abs (y - x) < d ==> abs (f y - f x) < e in
   !op:(real->real)->(real->real).
     (!f:real->real. continuous f ==> continuous (op f)) /\
     (!a b:real. !f g:real->real.
        continuous f /\ continuous g
        ==> op (\x:real. a * f x + b * g x) =
            (\x:real. a * op f x + b * op g x)) /\
     (!r s:real.
        r <= s
        ==> !f g:real->real.
              continuous f /\ continuous g /\
              (!x:real. r <= x /\ x <= s ==> f x = g x)
              ==> !x:real. r <= x /\ x <= s
                           ==> op f x = op g x)
     ==> ?f:real->real.
           continuous f /\
           !g:real->real.
             continuous g
             ==> op g = (\x:real. f x * g x)`;;

title: putnam_1966_a5
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1966_a5:
;; every local real-linear endomorphism of the continuous real-valued
;; functions on the real line is pointwise multiplication by a continuous
;; function. This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))

;; A Dedekind-complete ordered field presents the real numbers. Continuous
;; functions and T are APPLY$ function objects, and DEFUN-SK keeps all source
;; quantifiers internal to the statement predicates. Locality is stated on
;; every bounded closed interval, including singleton intervals, exactly as in
;; the canonical source statement.

(defun putnam-1966-a5-quoted (object)
  (list 'quote object))

(defun putnam-1966-a5-term-list (terms)
  (if (consp terms)
      (list 'cons
            (car terms)
            (putnam-1966-a5-term-list (cdr terms)))
    (putnam-1966-a5-quoted nil)))

(defun putnam-1966-a5-apply-term (function arguments)
  (list 'apply$
        (putnam-1966-a5-quoted function)
        (putnam-1966-a5-term-list arguments)))

(defun putnam-1966-a5-member-p (carrier x)
  (if (apply$ carrier (list x)) t nil))

(defun putnam-1966-a5-unary (operation x)
  (apply$ operation (list x)))

(defun putnam-1966-a5-binary (operation x y)
  (apply$ operation (list x y)))

(defun putnam-1966-a5-function-value (function x)
  (apply$ function (list x)))

(defun putnam-1966-a5-operator-value (operator function)
  (apply$ operator (list function)))

(defun putnam-1966-a5-positive-p (carrier zero less x)
  (and
   (putnam-1966-a5-member-p carrier x)
   (apply$ less (list zero x))))

(defun putnam-1966-a5-absolute-value
    (zero negate less x)
  (if (apply$ less (list x zero))
      (putnam-1966-a5-unary negate x)
    x))

(defun putnam-1966-a5-distance
    (zero add negate less x y)
  (putnam-1966-a5-absolute-value
   zero negate less
   (putnam-1966-a5-binary
    add x (putnam-1966-a5-unary negate y))))

(defun-sk putnam-1966-a5-field-laws-p
    (carrier zero one add multiply negate inverse)
  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (putnam-1966-a5-member-p carrier x)
      (putnam-1966-a5-member-p carrier y)
      (putnam-1966-a5-member-p carrier z))
     (and
      (putnam-1966-a5-member-p
       carrier (putnam-1966-a5-binary add x y))
      (putnam-1966-a5-member-p
       carrier (putnam-1966-a5-binary multiply x y))
      (putnam-1966-a5-member-p
       carrier (putnam-1966-a5-unary negate x))
      (putnam-1966-a5-member-p
       carrier (putnam-1966-a5-unary inverse x))
      (equal
       (putnam-1966-a5-binary
        add (putnam-1966-a5-binary add x y) z)
       (putnam-1966-a5-binary
        add x (putnam-1966-a5-binary add y z)))
      (equal
       (putnam-1966-a5-binary add x y)
       (putnam-1966-a5-binary add y x))
      (equal (putnam-1966-a5-binary add x zero) x)
      (equal
       (putnam-1966-a5-binary
        add x (putnam-1966-a5-unary negate x))
       zero)
      (equal
       (putnam-1966-a5-binary
        multiply (putnam-1966-a5-binary multiply x y) z)
       (putnam-1966-a5-binary
        multiply x (putnam-1966-a5-binary multiply y z)))
      (equal
       (putnam-1966-a5-binary multiply x y)
       (putnam-1966-a5-binary multiply y x))
      (equal (putnam-1966-a5-binary multiply x one) x)
      (equal (putnam-1966-a5-unary inverse zero) zero)
      (implies
       (not (equal x zero))
       (equal
        (putnam-1966-a5-binary
         multiply x (putnam-1966-a5-unary inverse x))
        one))
      (equal
       (putnam-1966-a5-binary
        multiply x (putnam-1966-a5-binary add y z))
       (putnam-1966-a5-binary
        add
        (putnam-1966-a5-binary multiply x y)
        (putnam-1966-a5-binary multiply x z)))))))

(defun-sk putnam-1966-a5-order-laws-p
    (carrier zero add multiply less)
  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (putnam-1966-a5-member-p carrier x)
      (putnam-1966-a5-member-p carrier y)
      (putnam-1966-a5-member-p carrier z))
     (and
      (not (apply$ less (list x x)))
      (or
       (equal x y)
       (apply$ less (list x y))
       (apply$ less (list y x)))
      (implies
       (and
        (apply$ less (list x y))
        (apply$ less (list y z)))
       (apply$ less (list x z)))
      (implies
       (apply$ less (list x y))
       (apply$
        less
        (list
         (putnam-1966-a5-binary add x z)
         (putnam-1966-a5-binary add y z))))
      (implies
       (and
        (apply$ less (list zero x))
        (apply$ less (list zero y)))
       (apply$
        less
        (list zero
              (putnam-1966-a5-binary multiply x y))))))))

(defun-sk putnam-1966-a5-set-nonempty-p (carrier set)
  (exists (x)
    (and
     (putnam-1966-a5-member-p carrier x)
     (apply$ set (list x)))))

(defun-sk putnam-1966-a5-upper-bound-p
    (carrier less set bound)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (and
      (putnam-1966-a5-member-p carrier x)
      (apply$ set (list x)))
     (not (apply$ less (list bound x))))))

(defun-sk putnam-1966-a5-bounded-above-p
    (carrier less set)
  (exists (bound)
    (and
     (putnam-1966-a5-member-p carrier bound)
     (putnam-1966-a5-upper-bound-p
      carrier less set bound))))

(defun-sk putnam-1966-a5-supremum-p
    (carrier less set supremum)
  (forall (bound)
    (and
     (putnam-1966-a5-member-p carrier supremum)
     (putnam-1966-a5-upper-bound-p
      carrier less set supremum)
     (implies
      (and
       (putnam-1966-a5-member-p carrier bound)
       (putnam-1966-a5-upper-bound-p
        carrier less set bound))
      (not (apply$ less (list bound supremum)))))))

(defun-sk putnam-1966-a5-has-supremum-p
    (carrier less set)
  (exists (supremum)
    (putnam-1966-a5-supremum-p
     carrier less set supremum)))

(defun-sk putnam-1966-a5-dedekind-complete-p
    (carrier less)

     'lambda

        multiply

        multiply

      (putnam-1966-a5-linear-combination-function

      (putnam-1966-a5-member-p carrier x)
      (not (apply$ less (list x r)))

      (putnam-1966-a5-function-value f x)

     (putnam-1966-a5-continuous-function-p
      carrier zero add negate less multiplier)

    (putnam-1966-a5-real-field-p
     carrier zero one add multiply negate inverse less)
    (tamep-functionp operator)
    (putnam-1966-a5-image-p
     carrier zero add negate less operator)

title: putnam_1966_a5
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1966_a5:
-- every linear operator on continuous real functions that preserves continuity
-- and is local on intervals is pointwise multiplication by a continuous function.
-- This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module Putnam1966A5 where

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; _*_)

infix 4 _!=_
infixr 3 _and_
infixr 2 _or_

data Bottom : Set where

Not : Set -> Set
Not A =
  A -> Bottom

_!=_ : {A : Set} -> A -> A -> Set
x != y =
  Not (x == y)

record _and_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data _or_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  left  : A -> A or B
  right : B -> A or B

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

record CompleteOrderedRealField (R : Set) : Set1 where
  field
    zeroR oneR : R
    addR multiplyR : R -> R -> R
    negateR inverseR : R -> R
    lessOrEqualR : R -> R -> Set
    fromNatR : Nat -> R

    oneR-not-zeroR :
      oneR != zeroR

    addR-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> addR x y == addR y x
    addR-associative :
      (x y z : R) -> addR (addR x y) z == addR x (addR y z)
    addR-zero :
      (x : R) -> addR x zeroR == x
    addR-inverse :
      (x : R) -> addR x (negateR x) == zeroR

    multiplyR-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> multiplyR x y == multiplyR y x
    multiplyR-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiplyR (multiplyR x y) z == multiplyR x (multiplyR y z)
    multiplyR-one :
      (x : R) -> multiplyR x oneR == x
    multiplyR-zero :
      (x : R) -> multiplyR x zeroR == zeroR
    distributeR :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiplyR x (addR y z) ==
      addR (multiplyR x y) (multiplyR x z)
    inverseR-zero :
      inverseR zeroR == zeroR
    multiplyR-inverse :
      (x : R) ->
      x != zeroR ->
      multiplyR x (inverseR x) == oneR

    order-reflexive :
      (x : R) -> lessOrEqualR x x
    order-transitive :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR x y ->
      lessOrEqualR y z ->
      lessOrEqualR x z
    order-antisymmetric :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR x y ->
      lessOrEqualR y x ->
      x == y
    order-total :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR x y or lessOrEqualR y x
    addR-order :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR x y ->
      lessOrEqualR (addR z x) (addR z y)
    multiplyR-nonnegative :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR zeroR x ->
      lessOrEqualR zeroR y ->
      lessOrEqualR zeroR (multiplyR x y)
    zeroR-less-than-oneR :
      lessOrEqualR zeroR oneR and zeroR != oneR

    fromNatR-zero :
      fromNatR zero == zeroR
    fromNatR-successor :
      (n : Nat) -> fromNatR (suc n) == addR (fromNatR n) oneR
    fromNatR-addition :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNatR (m + n) == addR (fromNatR m) (fromNatR n)
    fromNatR-multiplication :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNatR (m * n) == multiplyR (fromNatR m) (fromNatR n)
    fromNatR-injective :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNatR m == fromNatR n ->
      m == n

    archimedean :
      (x : R) ->
      Exists Nat (\ n -> lessOrEqualR x (fromNatR n))
    least-upper-bound :
      (P : R -> Set) ->
      Exists R P ->
      Exists R
        (\ upper ->
          (x : R) ->
          P x ->
          lessOrEqualR x upper) ->
      Exists R
        (\ supremum ->
          ((x : R) -> P x -> lessOrEqualR x supremum)
          and
          ((upper : R) ->
            ((x : R) -> P x -> lessOrEqualR x upper) ->
            lessOrEqualR supremum upper))

open CompleteOrderedRealField

subtract :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
subtract reals x y =
  addR reals x (negateR reals y)

StrictLess :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
StrictLess reals x y =
  lessOrEqualR reals x y and x != y

CloseTo :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
CloseTo reals center radius x =
  StrictLess reals (subtract reals center radius) x
  and
  StrictLess reals x (addR reals center radius)

ContinuousAt :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (R -> R) ->
  R ->
  Set
ContinuousAt {R} reals function point =
  (epsilon : R) ->
  StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) epsilon ->
  Exists R
    (\ delta ->
      StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) delta
      and
      ((x : R) ->
        CloseTo reals point delta x ->
        CloseTo reals (function point) epsilon (function x)))

Continuous :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (R -> R) ->
  Set
Continuous {R} reals function =
  (point : R) ->
  ContinuousAt reals function point

FunctionEqual :
  {A B : Set} ->
  (A -> B) ->
  (A -> B) ->
  Set
FunctionEqual {A} f g =
  (x : A) ->
  f x == g x

LinearCombination :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  (R -> R) ->
  (R -> R) ->
  R ->
  R
LinearCombination reals a b f g x =
  addR reals
    (multiplyR reals a (f x))
    (multiplyR reals b (g x))

PointwiseProduct :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (R -> R) ->
  (R -> R) ->
  R ->
  R
PointwiseProduct reals f g x =
  multiplyR reals (f x) (g x)

InClosedInterval :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
InClosedInterval reals lower upper x =
  lessOrEqualR reals lower x
  and
  lessOrEqualR reals x upper

module Putnam1966A5Statement
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R)
  (T : (R -> R) -> (R -> R)) where

  MapsContinuousToContinuous : Set
  MapsContinuousToContinuous =
    (f : R -> R) ->
    Continuous reals f ->
    Continuous reals (T f)

  LinearOnContinuousFunctions : Set
  LinearOnContinuousFunctions =
    (a b : R) ->
    (f g : R -> R) ->
    Continuous reals f ->
    Continuous reals g ->
    FunctionEqual
      (T (LinearCombination reals a b f g))
      (LinearCombination reals a b (T f) (T g))

  LocalOnClosedIntervals : Set
  LocalOnClosedIntervals =
    (lower upper : R) ->
    lessOrEqualR reals lower upper ->
    (f g : R -> R) ->
    Continuous reals f ->
    Continuous reals g ->
    ((x : R) ->
      InClosedInterval reals lower upper x ->
      f x == g x) ->
    (x : R) ->
    InClosedInterval reals lower upper x ->
    T f x == T g x

  IsPointwiseMultiplier : Set
  IsPointwiseMultiplier =
    Exists (R -> R)
      (\ multiplier ->
        Continuous reals multiplier
        and
        ((g : R -> R) ->
          Continuous reals g ->
          FunctionEqual
            (T g)
            (PointwiseProduct reals multiplier g)))

putnam-1966-a5 : Set1
putnam-1966-a5 =
  (R : Set) ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) ->
  (T : (R -> R) -> (R -> R)) ->
  Putnam1966A5Statement.MapsContinuousToContinuous reals T ->
  Putnam1966A5Statement.LinearOnContinuousFunctions reals T ->
  Putnam1966A5Statement.LocalOnClosedIntervals reals T ->
  Putnam1966A5Statement.IsPointwiseMultiplier reals T

title: putnam_1966_a5
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench artifact putnam_1966_a5:
  every linear local operator on the continuous real-valued functions is
  pointwise multiplication by a continuous function. This file contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open pred_setTheory realTheory real_topologyTheory;

val putnam_1966_a5 =
  ``!C : (real -> real) set.
    !T : (real -> real) -> (real -> real).
      C = {f : real -> real | f continuous_on UNIV} /\
      (!f : real -> real.
         f IN C
         ==>
         T f IN C) /\
      (!a b : real. !f g : real -> real.
         f IN C /\ g IN C
         ==>
         T (\x : real. a * f x + b * g x) =
           (\x : real. a * T f x + b * T g x)) /\
      (!r s : real.
         r <= s
         ==>
         !f g : real -> real.
           f IN C /\ g IN C /\
           (!x : real.
              r <= x /\ x <= s
              ==>
              f x = g x)
           ==>
           !x : real.
             r <= x /\ x <= s
             ==>
             T f x = T g x)
      ==>
      ?h : real -> real.
        h IN C /\
        !g : real -> real.
          g IN C
          ==>
          T g = (\x : real. h x * g x)``;

title: putnam_1966_a5
content:
$(
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench artifact putnam_1966_a5:
  a linear local operator on continuous real-valued functions is pointwise
  multiplication by a continuous real-valued function. This file contains no
  proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  The class ( RR -cn-> RR ) is set.mm's class of continuous functions from
  RR to RR. The operator T is quantified over the full function space from
  real functions to real functions, while its hypotheses restrict its action
  on continuous functions. Locality uses the closed real intervals and
  non-strict endpoint order of the Lean and Rocq sources.

  The final declaration is the single unproved $a corpus statement; this
  database contains no $p proof statement.
$)

${
  $d T a b f g h r s x $.

  putnambench-putnam-1966-a5 $a |-
    A. T e. ( ( RR ^m RR ) ^m ( RR ^m RR ) )
      (
        (
          (
            A. f e. ( RR -cn-> RR )
              ( T ` f ) e. ( RR -cn-> RR )
            /\
            A. a e. RR A. b e. RR
              A. f e. ( RR -cn-> RR )
                A. g e. ( RR -cn-> RR )
                  ( T `
                    ( x e. RR |->
                      ( ( a x. ( f ` x ) ) + ( b x. ( g ` x ) ) )
                    )
                  )
                  =
                  ( x e. RR |->
                    (
                      ( a x. ( ( T ` f ) ` x ) )
                      +
                      ( b x. ( ( T ` g ) ` x ) )
                    )
                  )
          )
          /\
          A. r e. RR A. s e. RR
            (
              r <_ s
              ->
              A. f e. ( RR -cn-> RR )
                A. g e. ( RR -cn-> RR )
                  (
                    A. x e. ( r [,] s )
                      ( f ` x ) = ( g ` x )
                    ->
                    A. x e. ( r [,] s )
                      ( ( T ` f ) ` x ) = ( ( T ` g ) ` x )
                  )
            )
        )
        ->
        E. h e. ( RR -cn-> RR )
          A. g e. ( RR -cn-> RR )
            ( T ` g )
            =
            ( x e. RR |-> ( ( h ` x ) x. ( g ` x ) ) )
      )
  $.
$}
