:: Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench artifact putnam_1966_a5:
:: a linear local operator on continuous real-valued functions is pointwise
:: multiplication by a continuous real-valued function. This file contains
:: no proof.

environ
  vocabularies TARSKI, XBOOLE_0, ZFMISC_1, SUBSET_1, RELAT_1, FUNCT_1,
    FUNCT_2, NUMBERS, XREAL_0, COMPLEX1, CARD_1, XXREAL_0, ARYTM_1,
    ARYTM_3, REAL_1, NAT_1, VALUED_0, VALUED_1, SEQ_1, SEQ_2,
    ORDINAL2, SEQ_4;
  notations TARSKI, XBOOLE_0, ZFMISC_1, SUBSET_1, RELAT_1, FUNCT_1,
    RELSET_1, FUNCT_2, ORDINAL1, CARD_1, NUMBERS, XCMPLX_0, XREAL_0,
    REAL_1, COMPLEX1, XXREAL_0, NAT_1, VALUED_0, VALUED_1, SEQ_1,
    SEQ_2, COMSEQ_2, SEQM_3, SEQ_4;
  constructors FUNCT_1, RELSET_1, FUNCT_2, CARD_1, REAL_1, COMPLEX1,
    XXREAL_0, NAT_1, SEQ_2, SEQM_3, SEQ_4, BINOP_2, COMSEQ_2;
  registrations XBOOLE_0, SUBSET_1, RELAT_1, FUNCT_1, RELSET_1,
    FUNCT_2, NUMBERS, CARD_1, XXREAL_0, MEMBERED, VALUED_0, VALUED_1,
    XCMPLX_0, XREAL_0, ORDINAL1, NAT_1, SEQ_4;
  requirements REAL, NUMERALS, SUBSET, BOOLE, ARITHM;

begin

::$P-
theorem
  for C being Subset of Funcs(REAL,REAL),
      T being Function of Funcs(REAL,REAL),Funcs(REAL,REAL) st
    (for f being Function of REAL,REAL holds
      (f in C iff
        for x being Real holds
          for e being Real st 0 < e holds
            ex d being Real st 0 < d &
              for y being Real st |.y-x.| < d holds
                |.f.y-f.x.| < e)) &
    (for f,Tf being Function of REAL,REAL st
      f in C & Tf = T.f holds Tf in C) &
    (for a,b being Real,
         f,g,h,Tf,Tg,Th being Function of REAL,REAL st
      f in C & g in C &
      (for x being Real holds h.x = a * f.x + b * g.x) &
      Tf = T.f & Tg = T.g & Th = T.h
    holds
      for x being Real holds
        Th.x = a * Tf.x + b * Tg.x) &
    (for r,s being Real st r <= s holds
      for f,g,Tf,Tg being Function of REAL,REAL st
        f in C & g in C & Tf = T.f & Tg = T.g &
        (for x being Real st r <= x & x <= s holds f.x = g.x)
      holds
        for x being Real st r <= x & x <= s holds Tf.x = Tg.x)
  holds
    ex h being Function of REAL,REAL st
      h in C &
      for g,Tg being Function of REAL,REAL st
        g in C & Tg = T.g
      holds
        for x being Real holds Tg.x = h.x * g.x
proof
end;
::$P+

title: putnam_1966_a5
content:
% Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench artifact putnam_1966_a5:
% every linear local operator on the continuous real-valued functions is
% pointwise multiplication by a continuous function. This file contains no proof.

putnam_1966_a5: THEORY
BEGIN
  real_function: TYPE = [real -> real]
  real_function_set: TYPE = [real_function -> bool]
  real_operator: TYPE = [real_function -> real_function]

  continuous(f: real_function): bool =
    FORALL (x: real), (epsilon_value: posreal):
      EXISTS (delta: posreal):
        FORALL (y: real):
          abs(y - x) < delta IMPLIES
            abs(f(y) - f(x)) < epsilon_value

  continuous_functions: real_function_set =
    LAMBDA (f: real_function): continuous(f)

  putnam_1966_a5: bool =
    FORALL (C: real_function_set), (T: real_operator):
      (C = continuous_functions
        AND (FORALL (f: real_function):
          C(f) IMPLIES C(T(f)))
        AND (FORALL (a, b: real), (f, g: real_function):
          C(f) AND C(g) IMPLIES
            FORALL (x: real):
              T(LAMBDA (y: real): a * f(y) + b * g(y))(x)
                = a * T(f)(x) + b * T(g)(x))
        AND (FORALL (r, s: real):
          r <= s IMPLIES
            FORALL (f, g: real_function):
              (C(f)
                AND C(g)
                AND (FORALL (x: real):

END putnam_1966_a5

;; Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact
;; putnam_1966_a6: convergence to 3 of the finite nested-radical sequence
;; determined by a(n,n)=n and a(n,m)=m*sqrt(1+a(n,m+1)).
;; This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

;; The source recurrence uniquely determines a(n,m) whenever
;; 1 <= m <= n, so a(n,1) can be eliminated definitionally.  If X(n,m)
;; denotes that value and R is rational, then positivity makes
;;
;;   X(n,m) < R
;;
;; equivalent, for m<n and R>0, to
;;
;;   X(n,m+1) < R^2/m^2 - 1.
;;
;; Repeating this equivalence reaches X(n,n)=n.  Thus this predicate compares
;; the actual real nested radical with a rational bound without representing
;; the radical by a rational approximation.
(defun putnam-1966-a6-value-less-than-bound-p
    (m remaining bound)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix remaining)))
  (if (zp remaining)
      (< m bound)
    (and
     (posp m)
     (< 0 bound)
     (putnam-1966-a6-value-less-than-bound-p
      (+ m 1)
      (- remaining 1)
      (- (/ (* bound bound) (* m m)) 1)))))

;; This is the converse strict comparison R < X(n,m), reduced by the same
;; reversible squaring.  A nonpositive bound is automatically below the
;; positive nested radical.
(defun putnam-1966-a6-bound-less-than-value-p
    (m remaining bound)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix remaining)))
  (if (zp remaining)
      (< bound m)
    (if (not (posp m))
        nil
      (if (<= bound 0)
          t
        (putnam-1966-a6-bound-less-than-value-p
         (+ m 1)
         (- remaining 1)
         (- (/ (* bound bound) (* m m)) 1))))))

(defun putnam-1966-a6-within-epsilon-p (n epsilon)
  (and
   (natp n)
   (<= 1 n)
   (putnam-1966-a6-bound-less-than-value-p
    1 (- n 1) (- 3 epsilon))
   (putnam-1966-a6-value-less-than-bound-p
    1 (- n 1) (+ 3 epsilon))))

;; Positive rational tolerances are cofinal among positive real tolerances.
;; The three DEFUN-SK predicates preserve the source limit's quantifier order:
;; for every positive tolerance there exists a positive natural cutoff, and
;; every natural index at or above that cutoff lies in the exact interval.
(defun-sk putnam-1966-a6-tail-within-epsilon-p
    (epsilon cutoff)
  (forall (n)
    (implies
     (and
      (natp n)
      (<= cutoff n))
     (putnam-1966-a6-within-epsilon-p n epsilon))))

(defun-sk putnam-1966-a6-cutoff-exists-p (epsilon)
  (exists (cutoff)
    (and
     (posp cutoff)
     (putnam-1966-a6-tail-within-epsilon-p
      epsilon cutoff))))

(defun-sk putnambench-putnam-1966-a6-statement ()
  (forall (epsilon)
    (implies
     (and
      (rationalp epsilon)
      (< 0 epsilon))
     (putnam-1966-a6-cutoff-exists-p epsilon))))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

-- Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1966_a6:
-- the first entries of finite real nested-radical recurrences converge to three.
-- This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; _*_)

infix 4 _!=_ _<=N_
infixr 3 _and_
infixr 2 _or_

data Bottom : Set where

Not : Set -> Set
Not A = A -> Bottom

_!=_ : {A : Set} -> A -> A -> Set
x != y = Not (x == y)

record _and_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data _or_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  left  : A -> A or B
  right : B -> A or B

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

data _<=N_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set where
  zero<=   : {n : Nat} -> zero <=N n
  suc<=suc : {m n : Nat} -> m <=N n -> suc m <=N suc n

oneN : Nat
oneN = suc zero

threeN : Nat
threeN = suc (suc (suc zero))

NatStrictLess : Nat -> Nat -> Set
NatStrictLess m n =
  suc m <=N n

record CompleteOrderedRealField (R : Set) : Set1 where
  field
    zeroR oneR : R
    add multiply : R -> R -> R
    negate inverse squareRoot : R -> R
    lessOrEqual : R -> R -> Set
    fromNat : Nat -> R

    one-not-zero :
      oneR != zeroR

    add-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> add x y == add y x
    add-associative :
      (x y z : R) -> add (add x y) z == add x (add y z)
    add-zero :
      (x : R) -> add x zeroR == x
    add-inverse :
      (x : R) -> add x (negate x) == zeroR

    multiply-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> multiply x y == multiply y x
    multiply-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply (multiply x y) z == multiply x (multiply y z)
    multiply-one :
      (x : R) -> multiply x oneR == x
    multiply-zero :
      (x : R) -> multiply x zeroR == zeroR
    distribute :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply x (add y z) ==
      add (multiply x y) (multiply x z)
    inverse-zero :
      inverse zeroR == zeroR
    multiply-inverse :
      (x : R) ->
      x != zeroR ->
      multiply x (inverse x) == oneR

    order-reflexive :
      (x : R) -> lessOrEqual x x
    order-transitive :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y z ->
      lessOrEqual x z
    order-antisymmetric :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y x ->
      x == y
    order-total :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y or lessOrEqual y x
    add-order :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual (add z x) (add z y)
    multiply-nonnegative :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR x ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR y ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR (multiply x y)
    zero-less-than-one :
      lessOrEqual zeroR oneR and zeroR != oneR

    fromNat-zero :
      fromNat zero == zeroR
    fromNat-successor :
      (n : Nat) -> fromNat (suc n) == add (fromNat n) oneR
    fromNat-addition :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m + n) == add (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-multiplication :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m * n) == multiply (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-injective :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat m == fromNat n ->
      m == n

    archimedean :
      (x : R) ->
      Exists Nat (\ n -> lessOrEqual x (fromNat n))
    least-upper-bound :
      (P : R -> Set) ->
      Exists R P ->
      Exists R
        (\ upper ->
          (x : R) ->
          P x ->
          lessOrEqual x upper) ->
      Exists R
        (\ supremum ->
          ((x : R) -> P x -> lessOrEqual x supremum)
          and
          ((upper : R) ->
            ((x : R) -> P x -> lessOrEqual x upper) ->
            lessOrEqual supremum upper))

    square-root-nonnegative :
      (x : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR (squareRoot x)
    square-root-square :
      (x : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR x ->
      multiply (squareRoot x) (squareRoot x) == x
    square-root-nonpositive :
      (x : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x zeroR ->
      squareRoot x == zeroR
    square-root-unique :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR y ->
      multiply y y == x ->
      y == squareRoot x

open CompleteOrderedRealField

subtract :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
subtract reals x y =
  add reals x (negate reals y)

StrictLess :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
StrictLess reals x y =
  lessOrEqual reals x y and x != y

CloseTo :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
CloseTo reals center radius x =
  StrictLess reals (subtract reals center radius) x
  and
  StrictLess reals x (add reals center radius)

ConvergesTo :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  R ->
  Set
ConvergesTo {R} reals sequence limit =
  (epsilon : R) ->
  StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) epsilon ->
  Exists Nat
    (\ cutoff ->
      (n : Nat) ->
      cutoff <=N n ->
      CloseTo reals limit epsilon (sequence n))

NestedRadicalRecurrence :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (Nat -> Nat -> R) ->
  Set
NestedRadicalRecurrence reals a =
  (n : Nat) ->
  oneN <=N n ->
  a n n == fromNat reals n
  and
  ((m : Nat) ->
    oneN <=N m ->
    NatStrictLess m n ->
    a n m ==
      multiply reals
        (fromNat reals m)
        (squareRoot reals
          (add reals (oneR reals) (a n (suc m)))))

putnam-1966-a6 : Set1
putnam-1966-a6 =
  (R : Set) ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) ->
  (a : Nat -> Nat -> R) ->
  NestedRadicalRecurrence reals a ->
  ConvergesTo reals
    (\ n -> a n oneN)
    (fromNat reals threeN)

  real_bisequence: TYPE = [nat -> [nat -> real]]

(* Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench artifact putnam_1966_b1:
   a convex polygon contained in the unit square has sum of squared side
   lengths at most four. This file contains no proof. *)

From Stdlib Require Import Reals.

Open Scope R_scope.

Definition point := (R * R)%type.
Definition point_set := point -> Prop.

Definition point_distance (a b : point) : R :=
  sqrt ((fst a - fst b) ^ 2 + (snd a - snd b) ^ 2).

Definition affine_combination (t : R) (a b : point) : point :=
  ((1 - t) * fst a + t * fst b,
   (1 - t) * snd a + t * snd b).

Definition closed_segment (a b : point) : point_set :=
  fun p : point =>
    exists t : R,
      0 <= t <= 1 /\
      p = affine_combination t a b.

Definition subset (A B : point_set) : Prop :=
  forall p : point, A p -> B p.

Definition convex (A : point_set) : Prop :=
  forall (a b : point) (t : R),
    A a ->
    A b ->
    0 <= t <= 1 ->
    A (affine_combination t a b).

Definition convex_hull (A : point_set) : point_set :=
  fun p : point =>
    forall C : point_set,
      convex C ->
      subset A C ->
      C p.

Definition interior (A : point_set) : point_set :=
  fun p : point =>
    exists epsilon : R,
      0 < epsilon /\
      forall q : point,
        point_distance q p < epsilon ->
        A q.

Definition collinear_points (a b c : point) : Prop :=
  (fst b - fst a) * (snd c - snd a) =
  (snd b - snd a) * (fst c - fst a).

Definition polygon_vertices
    (n : nat) (L : nat -> point) : point_set :=
  fun p : point =>
    exists i : nat,
      (i < n)%nat /\
      L i = p.

Fixpoint sum_first_n (f : nat -> R) (n : nat) : R :=
  match n with
  | O => 0
  | S k => sum_first_n f k + f k
  end.

Theorem putnam_1966_b1
    (n : nat)
    (hn : (3 <= n)%nat)
    (L : nat -> point)
    (hsq :
      forall i : nat,
        (i < n)%nat ->
        0 <= fst (L i) <= 1 /\
        0 <= snd (L i) <= 1)
    (hnoncol :
      forall i j k : nat,
        (i < n)%nat ->
        (j < n)%nat ->
        (k < n)%nat ->
        i <> j ->
        j <> k ->
        k <> i ->
        ~ collinear_points (L i) (L j) (L k))
    (hconvex :
      forall i : nat,
        (i < n)%nat ->
        forall p : point,
          closed_segment
            (L i)
            (L (Nat.modulo (S i) n))
            p ->
          ~ interior (convex_hull (polygon_vertices n L)) p) :
  sum_first_n
    (fun i : nat =>
      point_distance (L i) (L (Nat.modulo (S i) n)) ^ 2)
    n <= 4.
Admitted.

*)

let statement =

       sqrt ((FST x - FST y) pow 2 + (SND x - SND y) pow 2) in
   let collinear3 =
     \(a:real#real) (b:real#real) (c:real#real).
       (FST b - FST a) * (SND c - SND a) =
       (SND b - SND a) * (FST c - FST a) in
   let segment =
     \(a:real#real) (b:real#real) (x:real#real).
       ?t:real.
         &0 <= t /\ t <= &1 /\
         FST x = (&1 - t) * FST a + t * FST b /\
         SND x = (&1 - t) * SND a + t * SND b in
   let polygon_hull =
     \n (L:num->real#real) (x:real#real).
       ?w:num->real.
         (!j. j < n ==> &0 <= w j) /\
         sum (0..n - 1) w = &1 /\
         FST x = sum (0..n - 1) (\j. w j * FST (L j)) /\

;; Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench artifact putnam_1966_b1:
;; a convex polygon contained in the unit square has sum of squared side
;; lengths at most four. This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

;; A length-n list is exactly a function on the cyclic finite type ZMod n,
;; with the final-to-first edge implementing addition modulo n.
;;
;; Under the stated noncollinearity assumption, a segment joining consecutive
;; vertices is disjoint from the interior of their convex hull exactly when
;; every vertex lies in one of the two closed half-planes bounded by that
;; edge. The supporting-edge predicates below express this equivalence using
;; orientation signs, without external convex-hull or interior witnesses.
;;
;; ACL2's exact ordered arithmetic is rational. This predicate is
;; bidirectionally equivalent to the source universal statement over real
;; coordinates. A real counterexample has a strict conclusion violation,
;; every three vertices have nonzero orientation, and every non-edge vertex
;; has a strict supporting-edge orientation sign. These finitely many strict
;; conditions persist under a sufficiently small perturbation. Rational
;; points are dense in the unit square, including relative to its boundary,
;; so such a perturbation yields a rational counterexample with the same
;; cyclic order. Conversely, every rational counterexample is a real one.

(defun putnam-1966-b1-point-p (point)
  (and (consp point)
       (rationalp (car point))
       (rationalp (cdr point))))

(defun putnam-1966-b1-point-list-p (points)
  (if (consp points)
      (and (putnam-1966-b1-point-p (car points))
           (putnam-1966-b1-point-list-p (cdr points)))
    (equal points nil)))

(defun putnam-1966-b1-points-in-unit-square-p (points)
  (if (consp points)
      (let ((point (car points)))
        (and (<= 0 (car point))
             (<= (car point) 1)
             (<= 0 (cdr point))
             (<= (cdr point) 1)
             (putnam-1966-b1-points-in-unit-square-p (cdr points))))
    t))

(defun putnam-1966-b1-square (x)
  (* x x))

(defun putnam-1966-b1-orientation (a b c)
  (- (* (- (car b) (car a))
        (- (cdr c) (cdr a)))
     (* (- (cdr b) (cdr a))
        (- (car c) (car a)))))

(defun putnam-1966-b1-distance-squared (a b)
  (+ (putnam-1966-b1-square (- (car b) (car a)))
     (putnam-1966-b1-square (- (cdr b) (cdr a)))))

(defun putnam-1966-b1-noncollinear-with-pair-p (a b remaining)
  (if (consp remaining)
      (and
       (not (equal (putnam-1966-b1-orientation a b (car remaining))
                   0))
       (putnam-1966-b1-noncollinear-with-pair-p
        a b (cdr remaining)))
    t))

(defun putnam-1966-b1-noncollinear-with-first-p (a remaining)
  (if (consp remaining)
      (and
       (putnam-1966-b1-noncollinear-with-pair-p
        a (car remaining) (cdr remaining))
       (putnam-1966-b1-noncollinear-with-first-p a (cdr remaining)))
    t))

(defun putnam-1966-b1-all-triples-noncollinear-p (points)
  (if (consp points)
      (and
       (putnam-1966-b1-noncollinear-with-first-p
        (car points) (cdr points))
       (putnam-1966-b1-all-triples-noncollinear-p (cdr points)))
    t))

(defun putnam-1966-b1-all-on-nonnegative-side-p (a b points)
  (if (consp points)
      (and
       (<= 0 (putnam-1966-b1-orientation a b (car points)))
       (putnam-1966-b1-all-on-nonnegative-side-p a b (cdr points)))
    t))

(defun putnam-1966-b1-all-on-nonpositive-side-p (a b points)
  (if (consp points)
      (and
       (<= (putnam-1966-b1-orientation a b (car points)) 0)
       (putnam-1966-b1-all-on-nonpositive-side-p a b (cdr points)))
    t))

(defun putnam-1966-b1-supporting-edge-p (a b points)
  (or (putnam-1966-b1-all-on-nonnegative-side-p a b points)
      (putnam-1966-b1-all-on-nonpositive-side-p a b points)))

(defun putnam-1966-b1-all-cyclic-edges-supporting-aux
    (remaining first all-points)
  (if (consp remaining)
      (if (consp (cdr remaining))
          (and
           (putnam-1966-b1-supporting-edge-p
            (car remaining) (cadr remaining) all-points)
           (putnam-1966-b1-all-cyclic-edges-supporting-aux
            (cdr remaining) first all-points))
        (putnam-1966-b1-supporting-edge-p
         (car remaining) first all-points))
    t))

(defun putnam-1966-b1-all-cyclic-edges-supporting-p (points)
  (if (consp points)
      (putnam-1966-b1-all-cyclic-edges-supporting-aux
       points (car points) points)
    t))

(defun putnam-1966-b1-cyclic-squared-length-sum-aux
    (remaining first)
  (if (consp remaining)
      (if (consp (cdr remaining))
          (+ (putnam-1966-b1-distance-squared
              (car remaining) (cadr remaining))
             (putnam-1966-b1-cyclic-squared-length-sum-aux
              (cdr remaining) first))
        (putnam-1966-b1-distance-squared (car remaining) first))
    0))

(defun putnam-1966-b1-cyclic-squared-length-sum (points)
  (if (consp points)
      (putnam-1966-b1-cyclic-squared-length-sum-aux
       points (car points))
    0))

(defun putnambench-putnam-1966-b1-statement (n points)
  (implies
   (and
    (natp n)
    (<= 3 n)
    (true-listp points)
    (equal (len points) n)
    (putnam-1966-b1-point-list-p points)
    (putnam-1966-b1-points-in-unit-square-p points)
    (putnam-1966-b1-all-triples-noncollinear-p points)
    (putnam-1966-b1-all-cyclic-edges-supporting-p points))
   (<= (putnam-1966-b1-cyclic-squared-length-sum points) 4)))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

title: putnam_1966_b1
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1966_b1:
-- a convex polygon contained in the unit square has sum of squared side
-- lengths at most four. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module Putnam1966B1 where

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc)

infix 4 _!=_
infix 4 _<=N_
infixr 3 _and_
infixr 2 _or_

data Bottom : Set where

Not : Set -> Set
Not A = A -> Bottom

_!=_ : {A : Set} -> A -> A -> Set
x != y = Not (x == y)

record _and_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data _or_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  left  : A -> A or B
  right : B -> A or B

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

data _<=N_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set where
  zero<=N   : {n : Nat} -> zero <=N n
  suc<=sucN : {m n : Nat} -> m <=N n -> suc m <=N suc n

data Fin : Nat -> Set where
  fzero : {n : Nat} -> Fin (suc n)
  fsuc  : {n : Nat} -> Fin n -> Fin (suc n)

weakenFin : {n : Nat} -> Fin n -> Fin (suc n)
weakenFin {zero} ()
weakenFin {suc n} fzero =
  fzero
weakenFin {suc n} (fsuc i) =
  fsuc (weakenFin i)

advanceTail :
  {n : Nat} ->
  Fin (suc n) ->
  Fin (suc (suc n))
advanceTail {zero} fzero =
  fzero
advanceTail {suc n} fzero =
  fsuc (fsuc fzero)
advanceTail {suc n} (fsuc i) =
  fsuc (advanceTail i)

nextFin : {n : Nat} -> Fin n -> Fin n
nextFin {zero} ()
nextFin {suc zero} fzero =
  fzero
nextFin {suc (suc n)} fzero =
  fsuc fzero
nextFin {suc (suc n)} (fsuc i) =
  advanceTail i

one : Nat
one = suc zero

two : Nat
two = suc one

three : Nat
three = suc two

four : Nat
four = suc three

record CompleteOrderedRealField (R : Set) : Set1 where
  field
    zeroR oneR : R
    add multiply : R -> R -> R
    negate inverse squareRoot : R -> R
    lessOrEqual : R -> R -> Set
    fromNat : Nat -> R

    one-not-zero :
      oneR != zeroR

    add-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> add x y == add y x
    add-associative :
      (x y z : R) -> add (add x y) z == add x (add y z)
    add-zero :
      (x : R) -> add x zeroR == x
    add-inverse :
      (x : R) -> add x (negate x) == zeroR

    multiply-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> multiply x y == multiply y x
    multiply-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply (multiply x y) z == multiply x (multiply y z)
    multiply-one :
      (x : R) -> multiply x oneR == x
    multiply-zero :
      (x : R) -> multiply x zeroR == zeroR
    distribute :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply x (add y z) ==
      add (multiply x y) (multiply x z)
    inverse-zero :
      inverse zeroR == zeroR
    multiply-inverse :
      (x : R) ->
      x != zeroR ->
      multiply x (inverse x) == oneR

    order-reflexive :
      (x : R) -> lessOrEqual x x
    order-transitive :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y z ->
      lessOrEqual x z
    order-antisymmetric :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y x ->
      x == y
    order-total :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y or lessOrEqual y x
    add-order :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual (add z x) (add z y)
    multiply-nonnegative :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR x ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR y ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR (multiply x y)
    zero-less-than-one :
      lessOrEqual zeroR oneR and zeroR != oneR

    fromNat-zero :
      fromNat zero == zeroR
    fromNat-successor :
      (n : Nat) -> fromNat (suc n) == add (fromNat n) oneR
    archimedean :
      (x : R) ->
      Exists Nat (\ n -> lessOrEqual x (fromNat n))
    least-upper-bound :
      (P : R -> Set) ->
      Exists R P ->
      Exists R
        (\ upper ->
          (x : R) ->
          P x ->
          lessOrEqual x upper) ->
      Exists R
        (\ supremum ->
          ((x : R) -> P x -> lessOrEqual x supremum)
          and
          ((upper : R) ->
            ((x : R) -> P x -> lessOrEqual x upper) ->
            lessOrEqual supremum upper))

    square-root-nonnegative :
      (x : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR (squareRoot x)
    square-root-square :
      (x : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR x ->
      multiply (squareRoot x) (squareRoot x) == x
    square-root-nonpositive :
      (x : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x zeroR ->
      squareRoot x == zeroR
    square-root-unique :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR y ->
      multiply y y == x ->
      y == squareRoot x

open CompleteOrderedRealField

subtract :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
subtract reals x y =
  add reals x (negate reals y)

square :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R
square reals x =
  multiply reals x x

StrictLess :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
StrictLess reals x y =
  lessOrEqual reals x y and x != y

Nonnegative :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  Set
Nonnegative reals x =
  lessOrEqual reals (zeroR reals) x

record Point (R : Set) : Set where
  constructor point
  field
    x-coordinate : R
    y-coordinate : R

open Point

PointEqual :
  {R : Set} ->
  Point R ->
  Point R ->
  Set
PointEqual p q =
  x-coordinate p == x-coordinate q
  and
  y-coordinate p == y-coordinate q

squaredDistance :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Point R ->
  Point R ->
  R
squaredDistance reals p q =
  add reals
    (square reals
      (subtract reals (x-coordinate p) (x-coordinate q)))
    (square reals
      (subtract reals (y-coordinate p) (y-coordinate q)))

distance :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Point R ->
  Point R ->
  R
distance reals p q =
  squareRoot reals (squaredDistance reals p q)

doubleSignedArea :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Point R ->
  Point R ->
  Point R ->
  R
doubleSignedArea reals a b c =
  subtract reals
    (multiply reals
      (subtract reals (x-coordinate b) (x-coordinate a))
      (subtract reals (y-coordinate c) (y-coordinate a)))
    (multiply reals
      (subtract reals (y-coordinate b) (y-coordinate a))
      (subtract reals (x-coordinate c) (x-coordinate a)))

Collinear :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Point R ->
  Point R ->
  Point R ->
  Set
Collinear reals a b c =
  doubleSignedArea reals a b c == zeroR reals

sumFin :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  {n : Nat} ->
  (Fin n -> R) ->
  R
sumFin reals {zero} values =
  zeroR reals
sumFin reals {suc n} values =
  add reals
    (values fzero)
    (sumFin reals (\ i -> values (fsuc i)))

weightedPoint :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  {n : Nat} ->
  (Fin n -> R) ->
  (Fin n -> Point R) ->
  Point R
weightedPoint reals weights vertices =
  point
    (sumFin reals
      (\ i ->
        multiply reals
          (weights i)
          (x-coordinate (vertices i))))
    (sumFin reals
      (\ i ->
        multiply reals
          (weights i)
          (y-coordinate (vertices i))))

ConvexHull :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  {n : Nat} ->
  (Fin n -> Point R) ->
  Point R ->
  Set
ConvexHull {R} reals {n} vertices p =
  Exists (Fin n -> R)
    (\ weights ->
      ((i : Fin n) -> Nonnegative reals (weights i))
      and
      sumFin reals weights == oneR reals
      and
      PointEqual p (weightedPoint reals weights vertices))

affinePoint :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  Point R ->
  Point R ->
  Point R
affinePoint reals t p q =
  point
    (add reals
      (multiply reals
        (subtract reals (oneR reals) t)
        (x-coordinate p))
      (multiply reals t (x-coordinate q)))
    (add reals
      (multiply reals
        (subtract reals (oneR reals) t)
        (y-coordinate p))
      (multiply reals t (y-coordinate q)))

ClosedSegment :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Point R ->
  Point R ->
  Point R ->
  Set
ClosedSegment {R} reals p q x =
  Exists R
    (\ t ->
      lessOrEqual reals (zeroR reals) t
      and
      lessOrEqual reals t (oneR reals)
      and
      PointEqual x (affinePoint reals t p q))

InteriorOfConvexHull :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  {n : Nat} ->
  (Fin n -> Point R) ->
  Point R ->
  Set
InteriorOfConvexHull {R} reals vertices p =
  Exists R
    (\ epsilon ->
      StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) epsilon
      and
      ((q : Point R) ->
        StrictLess reals (distance reals p q) epsilon ->
        ConvexHull reals vertices q))

VerticesInUnitSquare :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  {n : Nat} ->
  (Fin n -> Point R) ->
  Set
VerticesInUnitSquare reals {n = n} vertices =
  (i : Fin n) ->
  lessOrEqual reals (zeroR reals) (x-coordinate (vertices i))
  and
  lessOrEqual reals (x-coordinate (vertices i)) (oneR reals)
  and
  lessOrEqual reals (zeroR reals) (y-coordinate (vertices i))
  and
  lessOrEqual reals (y-coordinate (vertices i)) (oneR reals)

PairwiseNoncollinear :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  {n : Nat} ->
  (Fin n -> Point R) ->
  Set
PairwiseNoncollinear reals {n = n} vertices =
  (i j k : Fin n) ->
  i != j ->
  j != k ->
  k != i ->
  Not (Collinear reals (vertices i) (vertices j) (vertices k))

EdgesAvoidInterior :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  {n : Nat} ->
  (Fin n -> Point R) ->
  Set
EdgesAvoidInterior {R} reals {n} vertices =
  (i : Fin n) ->
  (x : Point R) ->
  ClosedSegment reals (vertices i) (vertices (nextFin i)) x ->
  InteriorOfConvexHull reals vertices x ->
  Bottom

sumSquaredSideLengths :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  {n : Nat} ->
  (Fin n -> Point R) ->
  R
sumSquaredSideLengths reals vertices =
  sumFin reals
    (\ i ->
      squaredDistance reals
        (vertices i)
        (vertices (nextFin i)))

module Putnam1966B1Statement
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) where

  proposition : Set
  proposition =
    (n : Nat) ->
    three <=N n ->
    (vertices : Fin n -> Point R) ->
    VerticesInUnitSquare reals vertices ->
    PairwiseNoncollinear reals vertices ->
    EdgesAvoidInterior reals vertices ->
    lessOrEqual reals
      (sumSquaredSideLengths reals vertices)
      (fromNat reals four)

putnam-1966-b1 : Set1
putnam-1966-b1 =
  (R : Set) ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) ->
  Putnam1966B1Statement.proposition reals

(*

  a convex polygon contained in the unit square has sum of squared side
  lengths at most 4. This file contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open arithmeticTheory pairTheory pred_setTheory realTheory transcTheory;

val putnam_1966_b1 =
  ``let sqdist =
      \P Q : real # real.
        (FST P - FST Q) pow 2 + (SND P - SND Q) pow 2
    in
    let dist =
      \P Q : real # real. sqrt (sqdist P Q)
    in
    let collinear =
      \P Q R : real # real.
        (FST P - FST R) * (SND Q - SND R) =
        (SND P - SND R) * (FST Q - FST R)
    in
    let closed_segment =
      \A B : real # real.
      \X : real # real.
        ?t : real.
          0 <= t /\ t <= 1 /\
          X = ((1 - t) * FST A + t * FST B,
               (1 - t) * SND A + t * SND B)
    in
    let in_convex_hull =
      \n : num.
      \L : num -> real # real.
      \X : real # real.
        ?w : num -> real.
          (!i : num. i < n ==> 0 <= w i) /\
          SIGMA w (count n) = 1 /\
          X = (SIGMA (\i : num. w i * FST (L i)) (count n),
               SIGMA (\i : num. w i * SND (L i)) (count n))
    in
    let in_interior =
      \n : num.
      \L : num -> real # real.
      \X : real # real.
        ?r : real.
          0 < r /\
          !Y : real # real.
            sqdist X Y < r pow 2 ==> in_convex_hull n L Y
    in
      !n : num. !L : num -> real # real.
        3 <= n /\
        (!i : num.
           i < n
           ==>
           0 <= FST (L i) /\ FST (L i) <= 1 /\
           0 <= SND (L i) /\ SND (L i) <= 1) /\
        (!i j k : num.
           i < n /\ j < n /\ k < n /\
           i <> j /\ j <> k /\ k <> i
           ==>
           ~collinear (L i) (L j) (L k)) /\
        (!i : num.
           i < n
           ==>
           !X : real # real.
             closed_segment (L i) (L ((i + 1) MOD n)) X
             ==>
             ~in_interior n L X)
        ==>
        SIGMA
          (\i : num. dist (L i) (L ((i + 1) MOD n)) pow 2)
          (count n)
        <= 4``;

${

content:
% Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench artifact putnam_1966_b1:
% a convex polygon contained in the unit square has cyclic sum of squared
% side lengths at most four. This file contains no proof.

putnam_1966_b1: THEORY
BEGIN
  point: TYPE = [# x_coord: real, y_coord: real #]
  point_set: TYPE = [point -> bool]
  vertices: TYPE = [nat -> point]

  squared_distance(P, Q: point): real =
    (x_coord(Q) - x_coord(P)) ^ 2
      + (y_coord(Q) - y_coord(P)) ^ 2

  cross_from(P, Q, R: point): real =
    (x_coord(Q) - x_coord(P)) * (y_coord(R) - y_coord(P))
      - (y_coord(Q) - y_coord(P)) * (x_coord(R) - x_coord(P))

  collinear(P, Q, R: point): bool =
    cross_from(P, Q, R) = 0

  affine_combination(t: real, P, Q: point): point =
    (# x_coord := (1 - t) * x_coord(P) + t * x_coord(Q),
       y_coord := (1 - t) * y_coord(P) + t * y_coord(Q) #)

  closed_segment(P, Q: point): point_set =
    LAMBDA (X: point):
      EXISTS (t: real):
        0 <= t AND t <= 1
          AND X = affine_combination(t, P, Q)

  point_subset(A, B: point_set): bool =
    FORALL (P: point):
      A(P) IMPLIES B(P)

  convex(A: point_set): bool =
    FORALL (P, Q: point), (t: real):
      A(P) AND A(Q) AND 0 <= t AND t <= 1
        IMPLIES A(affine_combination(t, P, Q))

  convex_hull(A: point_set): point_set =
    LAMBDA (P: point):
      FORALL (C: point_set):
        convex(C) AND point_subset(A, C) IMPLIES C(P)

  euclidean_interior(A: point_set): point_set =
    LAMBDA (P: point):
      EXISTS (radius: real):
        0 < radius
          AND FORALL (Q: point):
            squared_distance(P, Q) < radius ^ 2
              IMPLIES A(Q)

  vertex_set(n: nat, L: vertices): point_set =
    LAMBDA (P: point):
      EXISTS (i: nat):
        i < n AND P = L(i)

  next_index(i, n: nat): nat =
    IF i + 1 = n THEN 0 ELSE i + 1 ENDIF

  side_square_sum(
      n: nat, L: vertices, count: nat): RECURSIVE real =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      side_square_sum(n, L, count - 1)
        + squared_distance(
            L(count - 1),
            L(next_index(count - 1, n)))
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  putnam_1966_b1: bool =
    FORALL (n: nat), (L: vertices):
      (n >= 3
        AND FORALL (i: nat):
          i < n IMPLIES
            0 <= x_coord(L(i))
              AND x_coord(L(i)) <= 1
              AND 0 <= y_coord(L(i))
              AND y_coord(L(i)) <= 1
        AND FORALL (i, j, k: nat):
          i < n
            AND j < n
            AND k < n
            AND i /= j
            AND j /= k
            AND k /= i
          IMPLIES NOT collinear(L(i), L(j), L(k))
        AND FORALL (i: nat):
          i < n IMPLIES
            FORALL (P: point):
              closed_segment(
                L(i), L(next_index(i, n)))(P)
              IMPLIES
                NOT euclidean_interior(
                  convex_hull(vertex_set(n, L)))(P))
      IMPLIES side_square_sum(n, L, n) <= 4
END putnam_1966_b1

-- Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1966_b2:
-- among any ten consecutive integers with positive first term, one is
-- relatively prime to every other member. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Int using (Int; pos; negsuc)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using
  (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; mod-helper)

infix 4 _!=_
infixr 3 _and_

data Bottom : Set where

Not : Set -> Set
Not A =
  A -> Bottom

_!=_ : {A : Set} -> A -> A -> Set
x != y =
  Not (x == y)

record _and_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

data Fin : Nat -> Set where
  fzero : {n : Nat} -> Fin (suc n)
  fsuc  : {n : Nat} -> Fin n -> Fin (suc n)

finToNat : {n : Nat} -> Fin n -> Nat
finToNat fzero =
  zero
finToNat (fsuc i) =
  suc (finToNat i)

difference : Nat -> Nat -> Int
difference zero zero =
  pos zero
difference (suc m) zero =
  pos (suc m)
difference zero (suc n) =
  negsuc n
difference (suc m) (suc n) =
  difference m n

addInt : Int -> Int -> Int
addInt (pos m) (pos n) =
  pos (m + n)
addInt (pos m) (negsuc n) =
  difference m (suc n)
addInt (negsuc m) (pos n) =
  difference n (suc m)
addInt (negsuc m) (negsuc n) =
  negsuc (suc (m + n))

absInt : Int -> Nat
absInt (pos n) =
  n
absInt (negsuc n) =
  suc n

naturalMod : Nat -> Nat -> Nat
naturalMod numerator zero =
  zero
naturalMod numerator (suc denominator) =
  mod-helper zero denominator numerator denominator

gcdWithFuel : Nat -> Nat -> Nat -> Nat
gcdWithFuel zero a b =
  a
gcdWithFuel (suc fuel) a zero =
  a
gcdWithFuel (suc fuel) a (suc b) =
  gcdWithFuel fuel (suc b) (naturalMod a (suc b))

naturalGCD : Nat -> Nat -> Nat
naturalGCD a b =
  gcdWithFuel (suc (a + b)) a b

Coprime : Int -> Int -> Set
Coprime x y =
  naturalGCD (absInt x) (absInt y) == suc zero

data PositiveInt : Int -> Set where
  positive : (n : Nat) -> PositiveInt (pos (suc n))

ten : Nat
ten =
  suc
    (suc
      (suc
        (suc
          (suc
            (suc
              (suc
                (suc
                  (suc
                    (suc zero)))))))))

InTenConsecutive : Int -> Int -> Set
InTenConsecutive n x =
  Exists (Fin ten)
    (\ i -> x == addInt n (pos (finToNat i)))

putnam-1966-b2 : Set
putnam-1966-b2 =
  (n : Int) ->
  PositiveInt n ->
  Exists Int
    (\ k ->
      InTenConsecutive n k
      and
      ((m : Int) ->
        InTenConsecutive n m ->
        k != m ->
        Coprime m k))

% Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench artifact putnam_1966_b2:
% among any ten consecutive positive integers, one is relatively prime to
% each of the other nine. This file contains no proof.

putnam_1966_b2: THEORY
BEGIN
  int_divides(divisor, value: int): bool =
    EXISTS (quotient: int):
      value = divisor * quotient

  relatively_prime(left, right: int): bool =
    FORALL (divisor: int):
      int_divides(divisor, left)
        AND int_divides(divisor, right)
      IMPLIES divisor = 1 OR divisor = -1

  in_ten_integer_block(value, start: int): bool =
    start <= value AND value <= start + 9

  putnam_1966_b2: bool =
    FORALL (n: int):
      n > 0 IMPLIES
        EXISTS (k: int):
          in_ten_integer_block(k, n)
            AND FORALL (m: int):
              (in_ten_integer_block(m, n) AND k /= m)
                IMPLIES relatively_prime(m, k)
END putnam_1966_b2

import Mathlib

open Topology Filter

/--
Let $p_1, p_2, \dots$ be a sequence of positive real numbers. Prove that if $\sum_{n=1}^{\infty} \frac{1}{p_n}$ converges, then $$\sum_{n=1}^{\infty} \frac {n^2 p_n}{(\sum_{i=1}^{n} p_i)^2}$$ also converges.
-/
theorem putnam_1966_b3
(p : ℕ → ℝ)
(hpos : ∀ n : ℕ, p n > 0)
(hconv : ∃ r : ℝ, Tendsto (fun m : ℕ => ∑ n ∈ Finset.Icc 1 m, 1/(p n)) atTop (𝓝 r))
: ∃ r : ℝ, Tendsto (fun m : ℕ => ∑ n ∈ Finset.Icc 1 m, (p n) * n^2/(∑ i ∈ Finset.Icc 1 n, p i)^2) atTop (𝓝 r) :=
sorry

title: putnam_1966_b3
putnam_1966_b3
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench artifact putnam_1966_b3:
;; convergence of sum 1/p(n) for a positive sequence implies convergence of
;; sum n^2*p(n)/(p(1)+...+p(n))^2. This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))

;; P is an arbitrary conservative sequence symbol. The scalar interface is an
;; Archimedean ordered field with a rational embedding, so the epsilon limits
;; state the source theorem for arbitrary real sequences without APPLY$ or a
;; rational-valued restriction.
(defstub p1966b3-scalar-p (x) t)
(defstub p1966b3-add-op (x y) t)
(defstub p1966b3-multiply-op (x y) t)
(defstub p1966b3-negate-op (x) t)
(defstub p1966b3-inverse-op (x) t)
(defstub p1966b3-less-op (x y) t)
(defstub p1966b3-rational-embed (q) t)
(defstub p1966b3-arch-bound (x) t)
(defstub p1966b3-p (n) t)

(defun p1966b3-add (x y)
  (p1966b3-add-op x y))

(defun p1966b3-mul (x y)
  (p1966b3-multiply-op x y))

(defun p1966b3-neg (x)
  (p1966b3-negate-op x))

(defun p1966b3-inv (x)
  (p1966b3-inverse-op x))

(defun p1966b3-sub (x y)
  (p1966b3-add x (p1966b3-neg y)))

(defun p1966b3-div (x y)
  (p1966b3-mul x (p1966b3-inv y)))

(defun p1966b3-less (x y)
  (if (p1966b3-less-op x y) t nil))

(defun p1966b3-abs (x zero)
  (if (p1966b3-less x zero)
      (p1966b3-neg x)
    x))

(defun-sk p1966b3-field-laws-p (zero one)
  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (p1966b3-scalar-p x)
      (p1966b3-scalar-p y)
      (p1966b3-scalar-p z))
     (and
      (p1966b3-scalar-p (p1966b3-add x y))
      (p1966b3-scalar-p (p1966b3-mul x y))
      (p1966b3-scalar-p (p1966b3-neg x))
      (implies
       (not (equal x zero))
       (p1966b3-scalar-p (p1966b3-inv x)))
      (equal (p1966b3-add (p1966b3-add x y) z)
             (p1966b3-add x (p1966b3-add y z)))
      (equal (p1966b3-add x y)
             (p1966b3-add y x))
      (equal (p1966b3-add x zero) x)
      (equal (p1966b3-add x (p1966b3-neg x)) zero)
      (equal (p1966b3-mul (p1966b3-mul x y) z)
             (p1966b3-mul x (p1966b3-mul y z)))
      (equal (p1966b3-mul x y)
             (p1966b3-mul y x))
      (equal (p1966b3-mul x one) x)
      (implies
       (not (equal x zero))
       (equal (p1966b3-mul x (p1966b3-inv x)) one))
      (equal
       (p1966b3-mul x (p1966b3-add y z))
       (p1966b3-add
        (p1966b3-mul x y)
        (p1966b3-mul x z)))))))

(defun-sk p1966b3-order-laws-p (zero)
  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (p1966b3-scalar-p x)
      (p1966b3-scalar-p y)
      (p1966b3-scalar-p z))
     (and
      (not (p1966b3-less x x))
      (or
       (equal x y)
       (p1966b3-less x y)
       (p1966b3-less y x))
      (implies
       (and (p1966b3-less x y)
            (p1966b3-less y z))
       (p1966b3-less x z))
      (implies
       (p1966b3-less x y)
       (p1966b3-less
        (p1966b3-add x z)
        (p1966b3-add y z)))
      (implies
       (and
        (p1966b3-less zero x)
        (p1966b3-less zero y))
       (p1966b3-less zero (p1966b3-mul x y)))))))

(defun-sk p1966b3-rational-embedding-laws-p ()
  (forall (q r)
    (implies
     (and (rationalp q) (rationalp r))
     (and
      (p1966b3-scalar-p (p1966b3-rational-embed q))
      (equal
       (p1966b3-rational-embed (+ q r))
       (p1966b3-add
        (p1966b3-rational-embed q)
        (p1966b3-rational-embed r)))
      (equal
       (p1966b3-rational-embed (* q r))
       (p1966b3-mul
        (p1966b3-rational-embed q)
        (p1966b3-rational-embed r)))
      (iff
       (< q r)
       (p1966b3-less
        (p1966b3-rational-embed q)
        (p1966b3-rational-embed r)))))))

(defun-sk p1966b3-archimedean-p ()
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (p1966b3-scalar-p x)
     (and
      (natp (p1966b3-arch-bound x))
      (p1966b3-less
       x
       (p1966b3-rational-embed
        (p1966b3-arch-bound x)))))))

(defun p1966b3-real-scalar-structure-p (zero one)
  (and
   (p1966b3-scalar-p zero)
   (p1966b3-scalar-p one)
   (not (equal zero one))
   (p1966b3-less zero one)
   (equal (p1966b3-rational-embed 0) zero)
   (equal (p1966b3-rational-embed 1) one)
   (p1966b3-field-laws-p zero one)
   (p1966b3-order-laws-p zero)
   (p1966b3-rational-embedding-laws-p)
   (p1966b3-archimedean-p)))

(defun-sk p1966b3-positive-sequence-p (zero)
  (forall (n)
    (implies
     (natp n)
     (and
      (p1966b3-scalar-p (p1966b3-p n))
      (p1966b3-less zero (p1966b3-p n))))))

;; Sum over Finset.Icc 1 n.
(defun p1966b3-p-prefix (n zero)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix n)))
  (if (zp n)
      zero
    (p1966b3-add
     (p1966b3-p-prefix (- n 1) zero)
     (p1966b3-p n))))

(defun p1966b3-reciprocal-prefix (n zero one)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix n)))
  (if (zp n)
      zero
    (p1966b3-add
     (p1966b3-reciprocal-prefix (- n 1) zero one)
     (p1966b3-div one (p1966b3-p n)))))

(defun p1966b3-target-term (n zero)
  (let* ((n-value (p1966b3-rational-embed n))
         (prefix (p1966b3-p-prefix n zero)))
    (p1966b3-div
     (p1966b3-mul
      (p1966b3-p n)
      (p1966b3-mul n-value n-value))
     (p1966b3-mul prefix prefix))))

(defun p1966b3-target-prefix (n zero)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix n)))
  (if (zp n)
      zero
    (p1966b3-add
     (p1966b3-target-prefix (- n 1) zero)
     (p1966b3-target-term n zero))))

(defun-sk p1966b3-source-tail-p
    (limit epsilon cutoff zero one)
  (forall (n)
    (implies
     (and (natp n) (<= cutoff n))
     (p1966b3-less
      (p1966b3-abs
       (p1966b3-sub
        (p1966b3-reciprocal-prefix n zero one)
        limit)
       zero)
      (p1966b3-rational-embed epsilon)))))

(defun-sk p1966b3-source-cutoff-exists-p
    (limit epsilon zero one)
  (exists (cutoff)
    (and
     (natp cutoff)
     (p1966b3-source-tail-p
      limit epsilon cutoff zero one))))

(defun-sk p1966b3-source-limit-p (limit zero one)
  (forall (epsilon)
    (implies
     (and (rationalp epsilon) (< 0 epsilon))
     (p1966b3-source-cutoff-exists-p
      limit epsilon zero one))))

(defun-sk p1966b3-source-converges-p (zero one)
  (exists (limit)
    (and
     (p1966b3-scalar-p limit)
     (p1966b3-source-limit-p limit zero one))))

(defun-sk p1966b3-target-tail-p
    (limit epsilon cutoff zero)
  (forall (n)
    (implies
     (and (natp n) (<= cutoff n))
     (p1966b3-less
      (p1966b3-abs
       (p1966b3-sub
        (p1966b3-target-prefix n zero)
        limit)
       zero)
      (p1966b3-rational-embed epsilon)))))

(defun-sk p1966b3-target-cutoff-exists-p
    (limit epsilon zero)
  (exists (cutoff)
    (and
     (natp cutoff)
     (p1966b3-target-tail-p
      limit epsilon cutoff zero))))

(defun-sk p1966b3-target-limit-p (limit zero)
  (forall (epsilon)
    (implies
     (and (rationalp epsilon) (< 0 epsilon))
     (p1966b3-target-cutoff-exists-p
      limit epsilon zero))))

(defun-sk p1966b3-target-converges-p (zero)
  (exists (limit)
    (and
     (p1966b3-scalar-p limit)
     (p1966b3-target-limit-p limit zero))))

;; Completeness is needed only after the target partial sums have been shown
;; Cauchy. This explicit instance states that real completeness step without
;; assuming the theorem's convergence conclusion.
(defun-sk p1966b3-target-cauchy-tail-p
    (epsilon cutoff zero)
  (forall (m n)
    (implies
     (and
      (natp m)
      (natp n)
      (<= cutoff m)
      (<= cutoff n))
     (p1966b3-less
      (p1966b3-abs
       (p1966b3-sub
        (p1966b3-target-prefix m zero)
        (p1966b3-target-prefix n zero))
       zero)
      (p1966b3-rational-embed epsilon)))))

(defun-sk p1966b3-target-cauchy-cutoff-exists-p
    (epsilon zero)
  (exists (cutoff)
    (and
     (natp cutoff)
     (p1966b3-target-cauchy-tail-p
      epsilon cutoff zero))))

(defun-sk p1966b3-target-cauchy-p (zero)
  (forall (epsilon)
    (implies
     (and (rationalp epsilon) (< 0 epsilon))
     (p1966b3-target-cauchy-cutoff-exists-p
      epsilon zero))))

(defun p1966b3-target-completeness-p (zero)
  (implies
   (p1966b3-target-cauchy-p zero)
   (p1966b3-target-converges-p zero)))

(defun putnambench-putnam-1966-b3-statement (zero one)
  (implies
   (and
    (p1966b3-real-scalar-structure-p zero one)
    (p1966b3-positive-sequence-p zero)
    (p1966b3-source-converges-p zero one)
    (p1966b3-target-completeness-p zero))
   (p1966b3-target-converges-p zero)))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

title: putnam_1966_b3
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1966_b3:
-- convergence of the reciprocal series of a positive real sequence implies
-- convergence of the series n^2 p_n / (sum_{i=1}^n p_i)^2. This file contains
-- no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; _*_)

infix 4 _!=_ _<=N_
infixr 3 _and_
infixr 2 _or_

data Bottom : Set where

Not : Set -> Set
Not A = A -> Bottom

_!=_ : {A : Set} -> A -> A -> Set
x != y = Not (x == y)

record _and_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data _or_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  left  : A -> A or B
  right : B -> A or B

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

data _<=N_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set where
  zero<=   : {n : Nat} -> zero <=N n
  suc<=suc : {m n : Nat} -> m <=N n -> suc m <=N suc n

record CompleteOrderedField (R : Set) : Set1 where
  field
    zeroR oneR : R
    add multiply : R -> R -> R
    negate inverse : R -> R
    lessOrEqual : R -> R -> Set
    fromNat : Nat -> R

    one-not-zero :
      oneR != zeroR

    add-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> add x y == add y x
    add-associative :
      (x y z : R) -> add (add x y) z == add x (add y z)
    add-zero :
      (x : R) -> add x zeroR == x
    add-inverse :
      (x : R) -> add x (negate x) == zeroR

    multiply-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> multiply x y == multiply y x
    multiply-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply (multiply x y) z == multiply x (multiply y z)
    multiply-one :
      (x : R) -> multiply x oneR == x
    multiply-zero :
      (x : R) -> multiply x zeroR == zeroR
    distribute :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply x (add y z) ==
      add (multiply x y) (multiply x z)
    inverse-zero :
      inverse zeroR == zeroR
    multiply-inverse :
      (x : R) ->
      x != zeroR ->
      multiply x (inverse x) == oneR

    order-reflexive :
      (x : R) -> lessOrEqual x x
    order-transitive :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y z ->
      lessOrEqual x z
    order-antisymmetric :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y x ->
      x == y
    order-total :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y or lessOrEqual y x
    add-order :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual (add z x) (add z y)
    multiply-nonnegative :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR x ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR y ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR (multiply x y)
    zero-less-than-one :
      lessOrEqual zeroR oneR and zeroR != oneR

    fromNat-zero :
      fromNat zero == zeroR
    fromNat-successor :
      (n : Nat) -> fromNat (suc n) == add (fromNat n) oneR
    fromNat-addition :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m + n) == add (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-multiplication :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m * n) == multiply (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-injective :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat m == fromNat n ->
      m == n

    archimedean :
      (x : R) ->
      Exists Nat (\ n -> lessOrEqual x (fromNat n))
    least-upper-bound :
      (P : R -> Set) ->
      Exists R P ->
      Exists R
        (\ upper ->
          (x : R) ->
          P x ->
          lessOrEqual x upper) ->
      Exists R
        (\ supremum ->
          ((x : R) ->
            P x ->
            lessOrEqual x supremum)
          and
          ((upper : R) ->
            ((x : R) ->
              P x ->
              lessOrEqual x upper) ->
            lessOrEqual supremum upper))

open CompleteOrderedField

subtract :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
subtract reals x y =
  add reals x (negate reals y)

divide :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
divide reals x y =
  multiply reals x (inverse reals y)

square :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  R
square reals x =
  multiply reals x x

StrictLess :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
StrictLess reals x y =
  lessOrEqual reals x y and x != y

CloseTo :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
CloseTo reals center radius x =
  StrictLess reals
    (subtract reals center radius)
    x
  and
  StrictLess reals
    x
    (add reals center radius)

ConvergesTo :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  R ->
  Set
ConvergesTo {R} reals sequence limit =
  (epsilon : R) ->
  StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) epsilon ->
  Exists Nat
    (\ cutoff ->
      (n : Nat) ->
      cutoff <=N n ->
      CloseTo reals limit epsilon (sequence n))

sumFromOneThrough :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  Nat ->
  R
sumFromOneThrough reals term zero =
  zeroR reals
sumFromOneThrough reals term (suc n) =
  add reals
    (sumFromOneThrough reals term n)
    (term (suc n))

SeriesConvergesFromOne :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  Set
SeriesConvergesFromOne {R} reals term =
  Exists R
    (\ limit ->
      ConvergesTo reals
        (sumFromOneThrough reals term)
        limit)

reciprocalTerm :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  Nat ->
  R
reciprocalTerm reals p n =
  divide reals
    (oneR reals)
    (p n)

putnamTerm :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  Nat ->
  R
putnamTerm reals p n =
  divide reals
    (multiply reals
      (p n)
      (square reals (fromNat reals n)))
    (square reals
      (sumFromOneThrough reals p n))

putnam-1966-b3 : Set1
putnam-1966-b3 =
  (R : Set) ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) ->
  (p : Nat -> R) ->
  ((n : Nat) ->
    StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) (p n)) ->
  SeriesConvergesFromOne reals
    (reciprocalTerm reals p) ->
  SeriesConvergesFromOne reals
    (putnamTerm reals p)

title: putnam_1966_b3

(*
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench artifact putnam_1966_b3:
  convergence of a reciprocal series for a positive real sequence implies
  convergence of a series formed from squared indices and partial sums.
  This file contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open arithmeticTheory pred_setTheory realTheory real_sigmaTheory;
open real_topologyTheory;

val putnam_1966_b3 =
  ``!p : num -> real.
      (!n : num. 0 < p n) /\
      (?r : real.
         ((\m : num.
             SIGMA
               (\n : num. (1 : real) / p n)
               (IMAGE SUC (count m))) --> r) sequentially)
      ==>
      ?r : real.
        ((\m : num.
            SIGMA
              (\n : num.
                 p n * ((&n : real) pow 2) /
                 ((SIGMA
                     (\i : num. p i)
                     (IMAGE SUC (count n))) pow 2))
              (IMAGE SUC (count m))) --> r) sequentially``;

$(

  convergence of the series with terms n squared times a positive sequence
  term divided by the square of its prefix sum, assuming convergence of the
  reciprocal series. This file contains no proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  A ranges over all real-valued sequences indexed by the nonnegative
  integers. For m in NN0, the interval 1 ... m is inclusive and is empty
  when m is zero, exactly matching the source partial sums. Each existential
  real limit together with set.mm's real-sequence convergence relation
  expresses convergence of the corresponding series.

  The positivity assumption includes index zero exactly as in all three
  ground-truth formalizations, although both series begin at index one. The
  final declaration is the single unproved $a corpus statement; this database
  contains no $p proof statement.
$)

${
  $d A B C i m n $.

  putnambench-putnam-1966-b3 $a |- A. A e. ( RR ^m NN0 )
    (
      (
        A. n e. NN0 0 < ( A ` n )
        /\
        E. B e. RR
          (
            m e. NN0 |->
              sum_ n e. ( 1 ... m )
                ( 1 / ( A ` n ) )
          )
          ~~>
          B
      )
      ->
      E. C e. RR
        (
          m e. NN0 |->
            sum_ n e. ( 1 ... m )
              (
                (
                  ( A ` n )
                  x.
                  ( n ^ 2 )
                )
                /
                (
                  (
                    sum_ i e. ( 1 ... n )
                      ( A ` i )
                  )
                  ^ 2
                )
              )
        )
        ~~>
        C
    )
  $.
$}

% Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench artifact putnam_1966_b3:
% convergence of the reciprocal series of a positive real sequence implies
% convergence of the series n^2 p_n / (sum from i = 1 to n of p_i)^2.
% This file contains no proof.

putnam_1966_b3: THEORY
BEGIN
  real_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> real]

  safe_div(numerator, denominator: real): real =
    IF denominator = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      numerator / denominator
    ENDIF

  prefix_sum(values: real_sequence, upper: nat): RECURSIVE real =
    IF upper = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      prefix_sum(values, upper - 1) + values(upper)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE upper

  series_converges(values: real_sequence): bool =
    EXISTS (total: real):
      FORALL (epsilon_value: posreal):
        EXISTS (cutoff: nat):
          FORALL (upper: nat):
            cutoff <= upper IMPLIES
              abs(prefix_sum(values, upper) - total) < epsilon_value

  reciprocal_terms(p: real_sequence): real_sequence =
    LAMBDA (index: nat): safe_div(1, p(index))

  weighted_terms(p: real_sequence): real_sequence =
    LAMBDA (index: nat):
      safe_div(
        p(index) * (index :: real) ^ 2,
        prefix_sum(p, index) ^ 2)

  putnam_1966_b3: bool =
    FORALL (p: real_sequence):
      ((FORALL (index: nat): 0 < p(index))
        AND series_converges(reciprocal_terms(p)))
      IMPLIES series_converges(weighted_terms(p))
END putnam_1966_b3

/--
Let $a_1, a_2, ...$ be an increasing sequence of $mn + 1$ positive integers. Prove that there exists either a subset of $m + 1$ $a_i$ such that no element of the subset divides any other, or a subset of $n + 1$ $a_i$ such that each element of the subset (except the greatest) divides the next greatest element.

theorem putnam_1966_b4
(m n : ℕ)
(S : Finset ℕ)
(hS : (∀ i ∈ S, i > 0) ∧ S.card = m * n + 1)
: ∃ T ⊆ S, (T.card = m + 1 ∧ ∀ j ∈ T, ∀ i ∈ T, i ≠ j → ¬(j ∣ i)) ∨ (T.card = n + 1 ∧ ∀ i ∈ T, ∀ j ∈ T, j < i → j ∣ i) :=

;; Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench artifact putnam_1966_b4:
;; every set of m*n+1 positive integers contains either an (m+1)-element
;; divisibility antichain or an (n+1)-element divisibility chain. This file
;; contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

;; The source set is finite by its cardinality hypothesis. A duplicate-free
;; true list therefore gives an arbitrary enumeration of it, and forgetting
;; list order recovers the source set. The searches below consider every
;; extensional subset of the required size, so the witness remains internally
;; existential rather than becoming an extra statement parameter.

(defun putnam-1966-b4-positive-natural-list-p (values)
  (if (consp values)
      (and
       (natp (car values))
       (< 0 (car values))
       (putnam-1966-b4-positive-natural-list-p
        (cdr values)))
    (equal values nil)))

(defun putnam-1966-b4-divides-p (divisor multiple)
  (and
   (integerp divisor)
   (< 0 divisor)
   (integerp multiple)
   (equal (mod multiple divisor) 0)))

(defun putnam-1966-b4-nondivisible-from-p
    (value remaining)
  (if (consp remaining)
      (and
       (not
        (putnam-1966-b4-divides-p
         value (car remaining)))
       (not
        (putnam-1966-b4-divides-p
         (car remaining) value))
       (putnam-1966-b4-nondivisible-from-p
        value (cdr remaining)))
    t))

(defun putnam-1966-b4-antichain-p (values)
  (if (consp values)
      (and
       (putnam-1966-b4-nondivisible-from-p
        (car values) (cdr values))
       (putnam-1966-b4-antichain-p (cdr values)))
    t))

(defun putnam-1966-b4-chain-from-p (value remaining)
  (if (consp remaining)
      (and
       (if (< value (car remaining))
           (putnam-1966-b4-divides-p
            value (car remaining))
         (putnam-1966-b4-divides-p
          (car remaining) value))
       (putnam-1966-b4-chain-from-p
        value (cdr remaining)))
    t))

(defun putnam-1966-b4-chain-p (values)
  (if (consp values)
      (and
       (putnam-1966-b4-chain-from-p
        (car values) (cdr values))
       (putnam-1966-b4-chain-p (cdr values)))
    t))

(defun putnam-1966-b4-antichain-subset-exists-p
    (chosen remaining needed)
  (declare (xargs :measure (len remaining)))
  (cond
   ((zp needed)
    (putnam-1966-b4-antichain-p chosen))
   ((endp remaining) nil)
   (t
    (or
     (putnam-1966-b4-antichain-subset-exists-p
      (cons (car remaining) chosen)
      (cdr remaining)
      (- needed 1))
     (putnam-1966-b4-antichain-subset-exists-p
      chosen
      (cdr remaining)
      needed)))))

(defun putnam-1966-b4-chain-subset-exists-p
    (chosen remaining needed)
  (declare (xargs :measure (len remaining)))
  (cond
   ((zp needed)
    (putnam-1966-b4-chain-p chosen))
   ((endp remaining) nil)
   (t
    (or
     (putnam-1966-b4-chain-subset-exists-p
      (cons (car remaining) chosen)
      (cdr remaining)
      (- needed 1))
     (putnam-1966-b4-chain-subset-exists-p
      chosen
      (cdr remaining)
      needed)))))

(defun putnambench-putnam-1966-b4-statement (m n values)
  (implies
   (and
    (natp m)
    (natp n)
    (true-listp values)
    (no-duplicatesp-equal values)
    (putnam-1966-b4-positive-natural-list-p values)
    (equal (len values) (+ (* m n) 1)))
   (or
    (putnam-1966-b4-antichain-subset-exists-p
     nil values (+ m 1))
    (putnam-1966-b4-chain-subset-exists-p
     nil values (+ n 1)))))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

content:
-- Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1966_b4:
-- every set of m*n+1 positive natural numbers contains either an m+1 element
-- divisibility antichain or an n+1 element divisibility chain. This file
-- contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

open import Agda.Builtin.Bool using (Bool; true)
open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _*_)

infix 4 _!=_ _<_ _divides_
infixr 3 _and_
infixr 2 _or_

data Bottom : Set where

Not : Set -> Set
Not A = A -> Bottom

_!=_ : {A : Set} -> A -> A -> Set
x != y = Not (x == y)

record _and_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data _or_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  left  : A -> A or B
  right : B -> A or B

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

data Fin : Nat -> Set where
  fzero : {n : Nat} -> Fin (suc n)
  fsuc  : {n : Nat} -> Fin n -> Fin (suc n)

data _<_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set where
  zero<suc : {n : Nat} -> zero < suc n
  suc<suc  : {m n : Nat} -> m < n -> suc m < suc n

record _divides_ (divisor dividend : Nat) : Set where
  field
    quotient : Nat
    equation : divisor * quotient == dividend

Subset : Set
Subset = Nat -> Bool

SubsetOf : Subset -> Subset -> Set
SubsetOf T S =
  (x : Nat) ->
  T x == true ->
  S x == true

record HasCardinality (S : Subset) (count : Nat) : Set where
  field
    enumerate :
      Fin count ->
      Nat

    enumerated-member :
      (index : Fin count) ->
      S (enumerate index) == true

    enumeration-complete :
      (x : Nat) ->
      S x == true ->
      Exists (Fin count)
        (\ index -> enumerate index == x)

    enumeration-injective :
      (left-index right-index : Fin count) ->
      enumerate left-index == enumerate right-index ->
      left-index == right-index

putnam-1966-b4 : Set
putnam-1966-b4 =
  (m n : Nat) ->
  (S : Subset) ->
  HasCardinality S (suc (m * n)) ->
  ((i : Nat) ->
    S i == true ->
    zero < i) ->
  Exists Subset
    (\ T ->
      SubsetOf T S
      and
      ((HasCardinality T (suc m)
        and
        ((j i : Nat) ->
          T j == true ->
          T i == true ->
          i != j ->
          Not (j divides i)))
      or
      (HasCardinality T (suc n)
        and
        ((j i : Nat) ->
          T j == true ->
          T i == true ->
          j < i ->
          j divides i))))

(* Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench artifact putnam_1966_b5:
   a finite planar point set in general position is the vertex set of a
   simple closed polygon. This file contains no proof. *)

From Stdlib Require Import Reals List.

Open Scope R_scope.

Definition point := (R * R)%type.
Definition point_set := point -> Prop.

Definition subset (A B : point_set) : Prop :=
  forall p : point, A p -> B p.

Definition has_cardinality (A : point_set) (n : nat) : Prop :=
  exists enumeration : list point,
    NoDup enumeration /\
    length enumeration = n /\
    forall p : point, In p enumeration <-> A p.

Definition affine_combination (t : R) (a b : point) : point :=
  ((1 - t) * fst a + t * fst b,
   (1 - t) * snd a + t * snd b).

Definition closed_segment (a b : point) : point_set :=
  fun p : point =>
    exists t : R,
      0 <= t <= 1 /\
      p = affine_combination t a b.

Definition collinear_points (a b c : point) : Prop :=
  (fst b - fst a) * (snd c - snd a) =
  (snd b - snd a) * (fst c - fst a).

Definition collinear (A : point_set) : Prop :=
  forall a b c : point,
    A a ->
    A b ->
    A c ->
    collinear_points a b c.

Theorem putnam_1966_b5
    (S : point_set)
    (n : nat)
    (hSfin : has_cardinality S n)
    (hcard : (3 <= n)%nat)
    (hS :
      forall s : point_set,
        subset s S ->
        has_cardinality s 3%nat ->
        ~ collinear s) :
  exists L : nat -> point,
    (forall p : point,
      S p ->
      exists! i : nat, (i < n)%nat /\ p = L i) /\
    (forall i j : nat,
      (i < n)%nat ->
      (j < n)%nat ->
      i <> j ->
      forall I : point,
        closed_segment
          (L i)
          (L (Nat.modulo (Nat.succ i) n))
          I /\
        closed_segment
          (L j)
          (L (Nat.modulo (Nat.succ j) n))
          I ->
        I = L i \/
        I = L (Nat.modulo (Nat.succ i) n) \/
        I = L j \/
        I = L (Nat.modulo (Nat.succ j) n)).
Admitted.

  a finite set of at least three real-plane points, no three collinear, is
  the vertex set of a simple closed polygon. This file contains no proof.

let statement =
  `let collinear_set =
     \s:(real#real)->bool.
       ?p d:real#real.
         !x:real#real.
           x IN s
           ==> ?c:real.
                 x = (FST p + c * FST d,
                      SND p + c * SND d) in
   let on_segment =
     \(a:real#real) (b:real#real) (x:real#real).
       ?t:real.
         &0 <= t /\ t <= &1 /\
         FST x = (&1 - t) * FST a + t * FST b /\
