        s SUBSET S /\ s HAS_SIZE 3
        ==> ~(collinear_set s))
     ==> ?L:num->real#real.
           (!p:real#real.
              p IN S
              ==> ?!i:num. i < CARD S /\ p = L i) /\
           (!i j:num.
              i < CARD S /\ j < CARD S /\ ~(i = j)
              ==> !x:real#real.
                    on_segment
                      (L i) (L ((i + 1) MOD CARD S)) x /\
                    on_segment
                      (L j) (L ((j + 1) MOD CARD S)) x
                    ==> x = L i \/
                        x = L ((i + 1) MOD CARD S) \/
                        x = L j \/
                        x = L ((j + 1) MOD CARD S))`;;

title: putnam_1966_b5
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench artifact putnam_1966_b5:
;; every finite set of at least three real planar points in general position
;; is the vertex set of a simple closed polygon. This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

;; A duplicate-free finite list is an enumeration of the source finite set.
;; Enumerating every permutation below keeps the existential cyclic ordering
;; internal; a length-n list is exactly a function on ZMod n.
;;
;; ACL2's exact ordered arithmetic is rational. This universal rational
;; encoding is bidirectionally equivalent to the source theorem over real
;; coordinates. For any finite real configuration in general position, all
;; triple-orientation determinants are nonzero, so a sufficiently small
;; coordinate-wise rational perturbation preserves all their signs. In
;; general position, two nonadjacent closed segments intersect exactly when
;; their endpoint orientations have opposite signs on both supporting lines.
;; Hence polygon simplicity depends only on the preserved orientation signs.
;; A simple ordering of the rational perturbation gives the same simple
;; ordering of the original real points. Conversely, rational configurations
;; are real configurations.

(defun putnam-1966-b5-point-p (point)
  (and (true-listp point)
       (equal (len point) 2)
       (rationalp (nth 0 point))
       (rationalp (nth 1 point))))

(defun putnam-1966-b5-point-list-p (points)
  (if (consp points)
      (and (putnam-1966-b5-point-p (car points))
           (putnam-1966-b5-point-list-p (cdr points)))
    (equal points nil)))

(defun putnam-1966-b5-orientation (a b c)
  (- (* (- (nth 0 b) (nth 0 a))
        (- (nth 1 c) (nth 1 a)))
     (* (- (nth 1 b) (nth 1 a))
        (- (nth 0 c) (nth 0 a)))))

(defun putnam-1966-b5-noncollinear-with-pair-p
    (a b remaining)
  (if (consp remaining)
      (and
       (not (equal
             (putnam-1966-b5-orientation a b (car remaining))
             0))
       (putnam-1966-b5-noncollinear-with-pair-p
        a b (cdr remaining)))
    t))

(defun putnam-1966-b5-noncollinear-with-first-p
    (a remaining)
  (if (consp remaining)
      (and
       (putnam-1966-b5-noncollinear-with-pair-p
        a (car remaining) (cdr remaining))
       (putnam-1966-b5-noncollinear-with-first-p
        a (cdr remaining)))
    t))

(defun putnam-1966-b5-general-position-p (points)
  (if (consp points)
      (and
       (putnam-1966-b5-noncollinear-with-first-p
        (car points) (cdr points))
       (putnam-1966-b5-general-position-p (cdr points)))
    t))

(defun putnam-1966-b5-prepend-to-each (value lists)
  (if (consp lists)
      (cons (cons value (car lists))
            (putnam-1966-b5-prepend-to-each
             value (cdr lists)))
    nil))

(defun putnam-1966-b5-insert-everywhere (value values)
  (declare (xargs :measure (acl2-count values)))
  (if (consp values)
      (cons
       (cons value values)
       (putnam-1966-b5-prepend-to-each
        (car values)
        (putnam-1966-b5-insert-everywhere
         value (cdr values))))
    (list (list value))))

(defun putnam-1966-b5-insert-into-permutations
    (value permutations)
  (if (consp permutations)
      (append
       (putnam-1966-b5-insert-everywhere
        value (car permutations))
       (putnam-1966-b5-insert-into-permutations
        value (cdr permutations)))
    nil))

(defun putnam-1966-b5-permutations (values)
  (if (consp values)
      (putnam-1966-b5-insert-into-permutations
       (car values)
       (putnam-1966-b5-permutations (cdr values)))
    (list nil)))

(defun putnam-1966-b5-cyclic-edges-aux
    (remaining first)
  (if (consp remaining)
      (if (consp (cdr remaining))
          (cons
           (list (car remaining) (cadr remaining))
           (putnam-1966-b5-cyclic-edges-aux
            (cdr remaining) first))
        (list (list (car remaining) first)))
    nil))

(defun putnam-1966-b5-cyclic-edges (ordering)
  (if (consp ordering)
      (putnam-1966-b5-cyclic-edges-aux
       ordering (car ordering))
    nil))

(defun putnam-1966-b5-edges-share-endpoint-p
    (first-edge second-edge)
  (let ((a (nth 0 first-edge))
        (b (nth 1 first-edge))
        (c (nth 0 second-edge))
        (d (nth 1 second-edge)))
    (or (equal a c)
        (equal a d)
        (equal b c)
        (equal b d))))

(defun putnam-1966-b5-proper-crossing-p
    (first-edge second-edge)
  (let ((a (nth 0 first-edge))
        (b (nth 1 first-edge))
        (c (nth 0 second-edge))
        (d (nth 1 second-edge)))
    (and
     (< (* (putnam-1966-b5-orientation a b c)
           (putnam-1966-b5-orientation a b d))
        0)
     (< (* (putnam-1966-b5-orientation c d a)
           (putnam-1966-b5-orientation c d b))
        0))))

(defun putnam-1966-b5-compatible-edge-p
    (first-edge second-edge)
  (or
   (putnam-1966-b5-edges-share-endpoint-p
    first-edge second-edge)
   (not
    (putnam-1966-b5-proper-crossing-p
     first-edge second-edge))))

(defun putnam-1966-b5-compatible-with-edge-p
    (edge remaining-edges)
  (if (consp remaining-edges)
      (and
       (putnam-1966-b5-compatible-edge-p
        edge (car remaining-edges))
       (putnam-1966-b5-compatible-with-edge-p
        edge (cdr remaining-edges)))
    t))

(defun putnam-1966-b5-all-edges-compatible-p (edges)
  (if (consp edges)
      (and
       (putnam-1966-b5-compatible-with-edge-p
        (car edges) (cdr edges))
       (putnam-1966-b5-all-edges-compatible-p
        (cdr edges)))
    t))

(defun putnam-1966-b5-simple-ordering-p (ordering)
  (putnam-1966-b5-all-edges-compatible-p
   (putnam-1966-b5-cyclic-edges ordering)))

(defun putnam-1966-b5-some-simple-ordering-p (orderings)
  (if (consp orderings)
      (or
       (putnam-1966-b5-simple-ordering-p (car orderings))
       (putnam-1966-b5-some-simple-ordering-p
        (cdr orderings)))
    nil))

(defun putnambench-putnam-1966-b5-statement (points)
  (implies
   (and
    (true-listp points)
    (<= 3 (len points))
    (putnam-1966-b5-point-list-p points)
    (no-duplicatesp-equal points)
    (putnam-1966-b5-general-position-p points))
   (putnam-1966-b5-some-simple-ordering-p
    (putnam-1966-b5-permutations points))))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

title: putnam_1966_b5
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1966_b5:
-- every finite set of at least three real-plane points with no three collinear
-- is the vertex set of a simple closed polygon. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc)

infix 4 _!=_ _<=N_
infixr 3 _and_
infixr 2 _or_

data Bottom : Set where

Not : Set -> Set
Not A = A -> Bottom

_!=_ : {A : Set} -> A -> A -> Set
x != y = Not (x == y)

record _and_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data _or_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  left  : A -> A or B
  right : B -> A or B

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

record ExistsUniqueBy
  (A : Set)
  (equal : A -> A -> Set)
  (P : A -> Set) :
  Set where

  constructor unique-witness
  field
    unique-value    : A
    unique-property : P unique-value
    uniqueness :
      (other : A) ->
      P other ->
      equal other unique-value

data _<=N_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set where
  zero<=N   : {n : Nat} -> zero <=N n
  suc<=sucN : {m n : Nat} -> m <=N n -> suc m <=N suc n

data Fin : Nat -> Set where
  fzero : {n : Nat} -> Fin (suc n)
  fsuc  : {n : Nat} -> Fin n -> Fin (suc n)

weakenFin : {n : Nat} -> Fin n -> Fin (suc n)
weakenFin {zero} ()
weakenFin {suc n} fzero =
  fzero
weakenFin {suc n} (fsuc i) =
  fsuc (weakenFin i)

advanceTail :
  {n : Nat} ->
  Fin (suc n) ->
  Fin (suc (suc n))
advanceTail {zero} fzero =
  fzero
advanceTail {suc n} fzero =
  fsuc (fsuc fzero)
advanceTail {suc n} (fsuc i) =
  fsuc (advanceTail i)

nextFin : {n : Nat} -> Fin n -> Fin n
nextFin {zero} ()
nextFin {suc zero} fzero =
  fzero
nextFin {suc (suc n)} fzero =
  fsuc fzero
nextFin {suc (suc n)} (fsuc i) =
  advanceTail i

three : Nat
three = suc (suc (suc zero))

record CompleteOrderedRealField (R : Set) : Set1 where
  field
    zeroR oneR : R
    add multiply : R -> R -> R
    negate inverse squareRoot : R -> R
    lessOrEqual : R -> R -> Set
    fromNat : Nat -> R

    one-not-zero :
      oneR != zeroR

    add-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> add x y == add y x
    add-associative :
      (x y z : R) -> add (add x y) z == add x (add y z)
    add-zero :
      (x : R) -> add x zeroR == x
    add-inverse :
      (x : R) -> add x (negate x) == zeroR

    multiply-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> multiply x y == multiply y x
    multiply-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply (multiply x y) z == multiply x (multiply y z)
    multiply-one :
      (x : R) -> multiply x oneR == x
    multiply-zero :
      (x : R) -> multiply x zeroR == zeroR
    distribute :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply x (add y z) ==
      add (multiply x y) (multiply x z)
    inverse-zero :
      inverse zeroR == zeroR
    multiply-inverse :
      (x : R) ->
      x != zeroR ->
      multiply x (inverse x) == oneR

    order-reflexive :
      (x : R) -> lessOrEqual x x
    order-transitive :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y z ->
      lessOrEqual x z
    order-antisymmetric :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y x ->
      x == y
    order-total :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y or lessOrEqual y x
    add-order :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual (add z x) (add z y)
    multiply-nonnegative :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR x ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR y ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR (multiply x y)
    zero-less-than-one :
      lessOrEqual zeroR oneR and zeroR != oneR

    fromNat-zero :
      fromNat zero == zeroR
    fromNat-successor :
      (n : Nat) -> fromNat (suc n) == add (fromNat n) oneR
    archimedean :
      (x : R) ->
      Exists Nat (\ n -> lessOrEqual x (fromNat n))
    least-upper-bound :
      (P : R -> Set) ->
      Exists R P ->
      Exists R
        (\ upper ->
          (x : R) ->
          P x ->
          lessOrEqual x upper) ->
      Exists R
        (\ supremum ->
          ((x : R) -> P x -> lessOrEqual x supremum)
          and
          ((upper : R) ->
            ((x : R) -> P x -> lessOrEqual x upper) ->
            lessOrEqual supremum upper))

    square-root-nonnegative :
      (x : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR (squareRoot x)
    square-root-square :
      (x : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR x ->
      multiply (squareRoot x) (squareRoot x) == x
    square-root-nonpositive :
      (x : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x zeroR ->
      squareRoot x == zeroR
    square-root-unique :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR y ->
      multiply y y == x ->
      y == squareRoot x

open CompleteOrderedRealField

subtract :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
subtract reals x y =
  add reals x (negate reals y)

record Point (R : Set) : Set where
  constructor point
  field
    x-coordinate : R
    y-coordinate : R

open Point

PointEqual :
  {R : Set} ->
  Point R ->
  Point R ->
  Set
PointEqual p q =
  x-coordinate p == x-coordinate q
  and
  y-coordinate p == y-coordinate q

scalePoint :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  Point R ->
  Point R
scalePoint reals t p =
  point
    (multiply reals t (x-coordinate p))
    (multiply reals t (y-coordinate p))

addPoint :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Point R ->
  Point R ->
  Point R
addPoint reals p q =
  point
    (add reals (x-coordinate p) (x-coordinate q))
    (add reals (y-coordinate p) (y-coordinate q))

affinePoint :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  Point R ->
  Point R ->
  Point R
affinePoint reals t p q =
  addPoint reals
    (scalePoint reals (subtract reals (oneR reals) t) p)
    (scalePoint reals t q)

ClosedSegment :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Point R ->
  Point R ->
  Point R ->
  Set
ClosedSegment {R} reals p q x =
  Exists R
    (\ t ->
      lessOrEqual reals (zeroR reals) t
      and
      lessOrEqual reals t (oneR reals)
      and
      PointEqual x (affinePoint reals t p q))

doubleSignedArea :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Point R ->
  Point R ->
  Point R ->
  R
doubleSignedArea reals a b c =
  subtract reals
    (multiply reals
      (subtract reals (x-coordinate b) (x-coordinate a))
      (subtract reals (y-coordinate c) (y-coordinate a)))
    (multiply reals
      (subtract reals (y-coordinate b) (y-coordinate a))
      (subtract reals (x-coordinate c) (x-coordinate a)))

Collinear :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Point R ->
  Point R ->
  Point R ->
  Set
Collinear reals a b c =
  doubleSignedArea reals a b c == zeroR reals

record FinitePointSet (R : Set) : Set1 where
  field
    cardinality : Nat
    member : Point R -> Set
    listing : Fin cardinality -> Point R

    member-invariant :
      (p q : Point R) ->
      PointEqual p q ->
      (member p -> member q) and (member q -> member p)

    listing-member :
      (i : Fin cardinality) ->
      member (listing i)

    listing-injective :
      (i j : Fin cardinality) ->
      PointEqual (listing i) (listing j) ->
      i == j

    member-listed :
      (p : Point R) ->
      member p ->
      Exists (Fin cardinality)
        (\ i -> PointEqual p (listing i))

open FinitePointSet

GeneralPosition :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  FinitePointSet R ->
  Set
GeneralPosition reals points =
  (a b c : Point _) ->
  member points a ->
  member points b ->
  member points c ->
  Not (PointEqual a b) ->
  Not (PointEqual b c) ->
  Not (PointEqual c a) ->
  Not (Collinear reals a b c)

EnumeratesExactlyOnce :
  {R : Set} ->
  (points : FinitePointSet R) ->
  (Fin (cardinality points) -> Point R) ->
  Set
EnumeratesExactlyOnce points vertices =
  (p : Point _) ->
  member points p ->
  ExistsUniqueBy
    (Fin (cardinality points))
    _==_
    (\ i -> PointEqual p (vertices i))

EdgesMeetOnlyAtEndpoints :
  {R : Set} ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) ->
  {n : Nat} ->
  (Fin n -> Point R) ->
  Set
EdgesMeetOnlyAtEndpoints reals vertices =
  (i j : Fin _) ->
  i != j ->
  (intersection : Point _) ->
  ClosedSegment reals
    (vertices i)
    (vertices (nextFin i))
    intersection ->
  ClosedSegment reals
    (vertices j)
    (vertices (nextFin j))
    intersection ->
  PointEqual intersection (vertices i)
  or
  PointEqual intersection (vertices (nextFin i))
  or
  PointEqual intersection (vertices j)
  or
  PointEqual intersection (vertices (nextFin j))

module Putnam1966B5Statement
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) where

  proposition : Set1
  proposition =
    (points : FinitePointSet R) ->
    three <=N cardinality points ->
    GeneralPosition reals points ->
    Exists
      (Fin (cardinality points) -> Point R)
      (\ vertices ->
        EnumeratesExactlyOnce points vertices
        and
        EdgesMeetOnlyAtEndpoints reals vertices)

putnam-1966-b5 : Set1
putnam-1966-b5 =
  (R : Set) ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) ->
  Putnam1966B5Statement.proposition reals

title: putnam_1966_b5
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench artifact putnam_1966_b5:
  any finite set of at least three real-plane points, with no three collinear,
  is the vertex set of a simple closed polygon. This file contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open arithmeticTheory pairTheory pred_setTheory realTheory;

val putnam_1966_b5 =
  ``let are_collinear =
      \P Q R : real # real.
        (FST P - FST R) * (SND Q - SND R) =
        (SND P - SND R) * (FST Q - FST R)
    in
    let on_closed_segment =
      \A B : real # real.
      \X : real # real.
        ?t : real.
          0 <= t /\ t <= 1 /\
          X = ((1 - t) * FST A + t * FST B,
               (1 - t) * SND A + t * SND B)
    in
      !(S : (real # real) set).
        FINITE S /\
        3 <= CARD S /\
        (!P Q R : real # real.
           P IN S /\ Q IN S /\ R IN S /\
           P <> Q /\ P <> R /\ Q <> R
           ==>
           ~are_collinear P Q R)
        ==>
        ?L : num -> real # real.
          (!p : real # real.
             p IN S
             ==>
             ?!i : num. i < CARD S /\ p = L i) /\
          (!i j : num.
             i < CARD S /\ j < CARD S /\ i <> j
             ==>
             !I : real # real.
               on_closed_segment (L i) (L ((i + 1) MOD CARD S)) I /\
               on_closed_segment (L j) (L ((j + 1) MOD CARD S)) I
               ==>
               I = L i \/
               I = L ((i + 1) MOD CARD S) \/
               I = L j \/
               I = L ((j + 1) MOD CARD S))``;

title: putnam_1966_b5
content:
$(
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench artifact putnam_1966_b5:
  every finite set of at least three points in the real plane, with no three
  collinear, is the vertex set of a simple closed polygon whose distinct
  edges meet only at their endpoints. This file contains no proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  P66B5R2 is the real coordinate plane, P66B5Succ is cyclic successor on
  1 ... N, P66B5Segment is the closed affine segment, and P66B5Noncol is
  determinant noncollinearity.

  A bijection L from 1 ... (# ` S) onto S is equivalent to the source's
  unique cyclic enumeration. Reindexing the finite cyclic carrier from ZMod
  (# ` S), or from naturals below # ` S, by 1 ... (# ` S) preserves adjacency
  through P66B5Succ. The intersection condition includes adjacent edges and
  permits exactly the four endpoints listed in the source statements.

  The final declaration is the single unproved $a corpus statement; this
  database contains no $p proof statement.
$)

$c P66B5I P66B5R2 P66B5Succ P66B5Segment P66B5Noncol $.

p66b5-index-syntax $a class P66B5I $.
p66b5-plane-syntax $a class P66B5R2 $.
p66b5-successor-syntax $a class ( P66B5Succ N ) $.
p66b5-segment-syntax $a class ( P66B5Segment A B ) $.
p66b5-noncollinear-syntax $a wff ( P66B5Noncol A B C ) $.

p66b5-index-definition $a |- P66B5I = ( 1 ... 2 ) $.

p66b5-plane-definition $a |- P66B5R2 = ( RR ^m P66B5I ) $.

${
  $d N i $.

  p66b5-successor-definition $a |- (
    P66B5Succ N
  ) = (
    i e. ( 1 ... N ) |->
      if (
        i = N ,
        1 ,
        ( i + 1 )
      )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d A B j t z $.

  p66b5-segment-definition $a |- (
    P66B5Segment A B
  ) = {
    z e. P66B5R2 |
    E. t e. ( 0 [,] 1 )
      z =
        (
          j e. P66B5I |->
            (
              ( ( 1 - t ) x. ( A ` j ) )
              +
              ( t x. ( B ` j ) )
            )
        )
  } $.
$}

p66b5-noncollinear-definition $a |- (
  ( P66B5Noncol A B C )
  <->
  (
    (
      ( ( B ` 1 ) - ( A ` 1 ) )
      x.
      ( ( C ` 2 ) - ( A ` 2 ) )
    )
    =/=
    (
      ( ( B ` 2 ) - ( A ` 2 ) )
      x.
      ( ( C ` 1 ) - ( A ` 1 ) )
    )
  )
) $.

${
  $d A B C I L S i j $.

  putnambench-putnam-1966-b5 $a |- A. S e. Fin
    (
      (
        (
          S C_ P66B5R2
          /\
          3 <_ ( # ` S )
        )
        /\
        A. A e. S A. B e. S A. C e. S
          (
            (
              A =/= B
              /\
              (
                A =/= C
                /\
                B =/= C
              )
            )
            ->
            ( P66B5Noncol A B C )
          )
      )
      ->
      E. L
        (
          L : ( 1 ... ( # ` S ) ) -1-1-onto-> S
          /\
          A. i e. ( 1 ... ( # ` S ) )
          A. j e. ( 1 ... ( # ` S ) )
            (
              i =/= j
              ->
              A. I e. P66B5R2
                (
                  (
                    I e.
                      (
                        P66B5Segment
                          ( L ` i )
                          ( L ` ( ( P66B5Succ ( # ` S ) ) ` i ) )
                      )
                    /\
                    I e.
                      (
                        P66B5Segment
                          ( L ` j )
                          ( L ` ( ( P66B5Succ ( # ` S ) ) ` j ) )
                      )
                  )
                  ->
                  (
                    I = ( L ` i )
                    \/
                    (
                      I = ( L ` ( ( P66B5Succ ( # ` S ) ) ` i ) )
                      \/
                      (
                        I = ( L ` j )
                        \/
                        I = ( L ` ( ( P66B5Succ ( # ` S ) ) ` j ) )
                      )
                    )
                  )
                )
            )
        )
    )
  $.
$}

% Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench artifact putnam_1966_b5:
% a finite set of at least three real-plane points with no three collinear
% admits a cyclic enumeration whose distinct edges meet only at endpoints.
% This file contains no proof.

putnam_1966_b5: THEORY
BEGIN
  point: TYPE = [# x_coord: real, y_coord: real #]
  point_set: TYPE = [point -> bool]
  point_enumeration: TYPE = [nat -> point]

  cross_from(P, Q, R: point): real =
    (x_coord(Q) - x_coord(P)) * (y_coord(R) - y_coord(P))
      - (y_coord(Q) - y_coord(P)) * (x_coord(R) - x_coord(P))

  collinear(P, Q, R: point): bool =
    cross_from(P, Q, R) = 0

  affine_combination(t: real, P, Q: point): point =
    (# x_coord := (1 - t) * x_coord(P) + t * x_coord(Q),
       y_coord := (1 - t) * y_coord(P) + t * y_coord(Q) #)

  closed_segment(P, Q: point): point_set =
    LAMBDA (X: point):
      EXISTS (t: real):
        0 <= t AND t <= 1
          AND X = affine_combination(t, P, Q)

  injective_below(
      enumeration: point_enumeration,
      bound: nat): bool =
    FORALL (i, j: nat):
      i < bound AND j < bound
        AND enumeration(i) = enumeration(j)
      IMPLIES i = j

  enumerates_exactly(
      enumeration: point_enumeration,
      S: point_set,
      bound: nat): bool =
    FORALL (P: point):
      S(P)
        IFF
          EXISTS (i: nat):
            i < bound AND enumeration(i) = P

  has_cardinality(S: point_set, cardinality: nat): bool =
    EXISTS (enumeration: point_enumeration):
      injective_below(enumeration, cardinality)
        AND enumerates_exactly(enumeration, S, cardinality)

  finite_with_at_least_three_points(S: point_set): bool =
    EXISTS (cardinality: nat):
      cardinality >= 3
        AND has_cardinality(S, cardinality)

  no_three_collinear(S: point_set): bool =
    FORALL (P, Q, R: point):
      (S(P) AND S(Q) AND S(R)
        AND P /= Q AND P /= R AND Q /= R)
      IMPLIES NOT collinear(P, Q, R)

  lists_each_point_once(
      S: point_set,
      cardinality: nat,
      enumeration: point_enumeration): bool =
    FORALL (P: point):
      S(P) IMPLIES
        EXISTS (i: nat):
          i < cardinality
            AND P = enumeration(i)
            AND FORALL (j: nat):
              (j < cardinality AND P = enumeration(j))
                IMPLIES j = i

  next_index(i, cardinality: nat): nat =
    IF i + 1 = cardinality THEN 0 ELSE i + 1 ENDIF

  edges_meet_only_at_endpoints(
      cardinality: nat,
      enumeration: point_enumeration): bool =
    FORALL (i, j: nat):
      (i < cardinality AND j < cardinality AND i /= j)
      IMPLIES
        FORALL (I: point):
          (closed_segment(
              enumeration(i),
              enumeration(next_index(i, cardinality)))(I)
            AND closed_segment(
              enumeration(j),
              enumeration(next_index(j, cardinality)))(I))
          IMPLIES
            I = enumeration(i)
              OR I = enumeration(next_index(i, cardinality))
              OR I = enumeration(j)
              OR I = enumeration(next_index(j, cardinality))

  putnam_1966_b5: bool =
    FORALL (S: point_set):
      (finite_with_at_least_three_points(S)
        AND no_three_collinear(S))
      IMPLIES
        EXISTS
            (cardinality: nat),
            (enumeration: point_enumeration):
          cardinality >= 3
            AND has_cardinality(S, cardinality)
            AND lists_each_point_once(
              S, cardinality, enumeration)
            AND edges_meet_only_at_endpoints(
              cardinality, enumeration)
END putnam_1966_b5

theorem putnam_1966_b6

(hy : Differentiable ℝ y ∧ Differentiable ℝ (deriv y))
(diffeq : deriv (deriv y) + Real.exp * y = 0)
: ∃ r s N : ℝ, ∀ x > N, r ≤ y x ∧ y x ≤ s :=

From mathcomp Require Import all_ssreflect ssrnum ssralg.
From mathcomp Require Import reals exp sequences derive topology normedtype.
From mathcomp Require Import classical_sets cardinality.
Import numFieldNormedType.Exports.

Set Implicit Arguments.
Unset Strict Implicit.
Unset Printing Implicit Defensive.

Local Open Scope ring_scope.
Local Open Scope classical_set_scope.

Variable R : realType.
Theorem putnam_1966_b6
    (y : R -> R)
    (hy : forall x : R, differentiable y x /\ differentiable (y^`()) x)
    (diffeq : forall x : R, y^`(2) x + y x * expR x = 0)
    : exists r s N : R, forall x : R, x > N -> r <= y x <= s.
Proof. Admitted.

title: putnam_1966_b6
putnam_1966_b6
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1966_b6:
;; every twice-differentiable real solution of y''(x) + exp(x)y(x) = 0 is
;; bounded above and below for all sufficiently large x. This file contains
;; no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))

;; The scalar context is a Dedekind-complete ordered field, hence the real
;; field up to ordered-field isomorphism. Arbitrary subsets and real-valued
;; functions are tame APPLY$ function objects. DEFUN-SK keeps every unbounded
;; universal and existential quantifier internal to the statement.

(defun p66-member-p (carrier x)
  (if (apply$ carrier (list x)) t nil))

(defun p66-unary-value (function x)
  (apply$ function (list x)))

(defun p66-binary-value (function x y)
  (apply$ function (list x y)))

(defun-sk p66-valid-set-p (carrier set)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (apply$ set (list x))
     (p66-member-p carrier x))))

(defun-sk p66-real-function-p (carrier function)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (p66-member-p carrier x)
     (p66-member-p
      carrier
      (p66-unary-value function x)))))

(defun-sk p66-field-laws-p
    (carrier add multiply negate inverse zero one)
  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (p66-member-p carrier x)
      (p66-member-p carrier y)
      (p66-member-p carrier z))
     (and
      (p66-member-p carrier
                    (p66-binary-value add x y))
      (p66-member-p carrier
                    (p66-binary-value multiply x y))
      (p66-member-p carrier
                    (p66-unary-value negate x))
      (p66-member-p carrier
                    (p66-unary-value inverse x))
      (equal
       (p66-binary-value
        add (p66-binary-value add x y) z)
       (p66-binary-value
        add x (p66-binary-value add y z)))
      (equal (p66-binary-value add x y)
             (p66-binary-value add y x))
      (equal (p66-binary-value add x zero) x)
      (equal
       (p66-binary-value
        add x (p66-unary-value negate x))
       zero)
      (equal
       (p66-binary-value
        multiply (p66-binary-value multiply x y) z)
       (p66-binary-value
        multiply x (p66-binary-value multiply y z)))
      (equal (p66-binary-value multiply x y)
             (p66-binary-value multiply y x))
      (equal (p66-binary-value multiply x one) x)
      (implies
       (equal x zero)
       (equal (p66-unary-value inverse x) zero))
      (implies
       (not (equal x zero))
       (equal
        (p66-binary-value
         multiply x (p66-unary-value inverse x))
        one))
      (equal
       (p66-binary-value
        multiply x (p66-binary-value add y z))
       (p66-binary-value
        add
        (p66-binary-value multiply x y)
        (p66-binary-value multiply x z)))))))

(defun-sk p66-order-laws-p
    (carrier add multiply zero less)
  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (p66-member-p carrier x)
      (p66-member-p carrier y)
      (p66-member-p carrier z))
     (and
      (not (p66-binary-value less x x))
      (or
       (equal x y)
       (p66-binary-value less x y)
       (p66-binary-value less y x))
      (implies
       (and
        (p66-binary-value less x y)
        (p66-binary-value less y z))
       (p66-binary-value less x z))
      (implies
       (p66-binary-value less x y)
       (p66-binary-value
        less
        (p66-binary-value add x z)
        (p66-binary-value add y z)))
      (implies
       (and
        (p66-binary-value less zero x)
        (p66-binary-value less zero y))
       (p66-binary-value
        less zero (p66-binary-value multiply x y)))))))

(defun-sk p66-set-nonempty-p (carrier set)
  (exists (x)
    (and
     (p66-member-p carrier x)
     (apply$ set (list x)))))

(defun-sk p66-upper-bound-p
    (carrier less set bound)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (and
      (p66-member-p carrier x)
      (apply$ set (list x)))
     (not (p66-binary-value less bound x)))))

(defun-sk p66-bounded-above-p
    (carrier less set)
  (exists (bound)
    (and
     (p66-member-p carrier bound)
     (p66-upper-bound-p
      carrier less set bound))))

(defun-sk p66-least-upper-bound-p
    (carrier less set supremum)
  (forall (bound)
    (implies
     (and
      (p66-member-p carrier bound)
      (p66-upper-bound-p carrier less set bound))
     (not (p66-binary-value less bound supremum)))))

(defun p66-supremum-p
    (carrier less set supremum)
  (and
   (p66-member-p carrier supremum)
   (p66-upper-bound-p carrier less set supremum)
   (p66-least-upper-bound-p
    carrier less set supremum)))

(defun-sk p66-has-supremum-p
    (carrier less set)
  (exists (supremum)
    (p66-supremum-p
     carrier less set supremum)))

(defun-sk p66-dedekind-complete-p
    (carrier less)
  (forall (set)
    (implies
     (and
      (tamep-functionp set)
      (p66-valid-set-p carrier set)
      (p66-set-nonempty-p carrier set)
      (p66-bounded-above-p carrier less set))
     (p66-has-supremum-p carrier less set))))

(defun p66-real-field-p
    (carrier zero one add multiply negate inverse less)
  (and
   (tamep-functionp carrier)
   (tamep-functionp add)
   (tamep-functionp multiply)
   (tamep-functionp negate)
   (tamep-functionp inverse)
   (tamep-functionp less)
   (p66-member-p carrier zero)
   (p66-member-p carrier one)
   (not (equal zero one))
   (p66-field-laws-p
    carrier add multiply negate inverse zero one)
   (p66-order-laws-p
    carrier add multiply zero less)
   (p66-binary-value less zero one)
   (p66-dedekind-complete-p carrier less)))

;; The outer context pairs an eight-entry real-field presentation with its
;; exponential function.

(defun p66-field-context (ctx)
  (car ctx))

(defun p66-r-carrier (ctx)
  (nth 0 (p66-field-context ctx)))

(defun p66-r-zero (ctx)
  (nth 1 (p66-field-context ctx)))

(defun p66-r-one (ctx)
  (nth 2 (p66-field-context ctx)))

(defun p66-r-add (ctx)
  (nth 3 (p66-field-context ctx)))

(defun p66-r-mul (ctx)
  (nth 4 (p66-field-context ctx)))

(defun p66-r-neg (ctx)
  (nth 5 (p66-field-context ctx)))

(defun p66-r-inv (ctx)
  (nth 6 (p66-field-context ctx)))

(defun p66-r-lt (ctx)
  (nth 7 (p66-field-context ctx)))

(defun p66-r-exp (ctx)
  (nth 1 ctx))

(defun p66-field-context-p (field-context)
  (and
   (true-listp field-context)
   (equal (len field-context) 8)
   (p66-real-field-p
    (nth 0 field-context)
    (nth 1 field-context)
    (nth 2 field-context)
    (nth 3 field-context)
    (nth 4 field-context)
    (nth 5 field-context)
    (nth 6 field-context)
    (nth 7 field-context))))

(defun p66-r-add-value (ctx x y)
  (p66-binary-value (p66-r-add ctx) x y))

(defun p66-r-neg-value (ctx x)
  (p66-unary-value (p66-r-neg ctx) x))

(defun p66-r-sub-value (ctx x y)
  (p66-r-add-value
   ctx x (p66-r-neg-value ctx y)))

(defun p66-r-mul-value (ctx x y)
  (p66-binary-value (p66-r-mul ctx) x y))

(defun p66-r-lt-p (ctx x y)
  (if (p66-binary-value (p66-r-lt ctx) x y)
      t nil))

(defun p66-r-le-p (ctx x y)
  (not (p66-r-lt-p ctx y x)))

(defun p66-r-abs-value (ctx x)
  (if (p66-r-lt-p ctx x (p66-r-zero ctx))
      (p66-r-neg-value ctx x)
    x))

(defun p66-positive-real-p (ctx x)
  (and
   (p66-member-p (p66-r-carrier ctx) x)
   (p66-r-lt-p ctx (p66-r-zero ctx) x)))

;; HasDerivAt in epsilon-delta form:
;; |f(z)-f(x)-d(z-x)| <= epsilon |z-x| near x.

(defun-sk p66-derivative-neighborhood-p
    (ctx function derivative x epsilon radius)
  (forall (z)
    (implies
     (and
      (p66-member-p (p66-r-carrier ctx) z)
      (p66-r-lt-p
       ctx
       (p66-r-abs-value
        ctx (p66-r-sub-value ctx z x))
       radius))
     (p66-r-le-p
      ctx
      (p66-r-abs-value
       ctx
       (p66-r-sub-value
        ctx
        (p66-r-sub-value
         ctx
         (p66-unary-value function z)
         (p66-unary-value function x))
        (p66-r-mul-value
         ctx derivative
         (p66-r-sub-value ctx z x))))
      (p66-r-mul-value
       ctx epsilon
       (p66-r-abs-value
        ctx (p66-r-sub-value ctx z x)))))))

(defun-sk p66-derivative-radius-exists-p
    (ctx function derivative x epsilon)
  (exists (radius)
    (and
     (p66-positive-real-p ctx radius)
     (p66-derivative-neighborhood-p
      ctx function derivative x epsilon radius))))

(defun-sk p66-has-derivative-at-p
    (ctx function derivative x)
  (forall (epsilon)
    (implies
     (p66-positive-real-p ctx epsilon)
     (p66-derivative-radius-exists-p
      ctx function derivative x epsilon))))

(defun-sk p66-global-derivative-values-p
    (ctx function derivative-function)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (p66-member-p (p66-r-carrier ctx) x)
     (p66-has-derivative-at-p
      ctx
      function
      (p66-unary-value derivative-function x)
      x))))

(defun p66-global-derivative-function-p
    (ctx function derivative-function)
  (and
   (tamep-functionp function)
   (tamep-functionp derivative-function)
   (p66-real-function-p
    (p66-r-carrier ctx) function)
   (p66-real-function-p
    (p66-r-carrier ctx) derivative-function)
   (p66-global-derivative-values-p
    ctx function derivative-function)))

(defun-sk p66-differentiable-p (ctx function)
  (exists (derivative-function)
    (p66-global-derivative-function-p
     ctx function derivative-function)))

;; A derivative is unique on a real field. DEFCHOOSE conservatively selects
;; that unique function while leaving the existential differentiability
;; assumptions inside the statement.

(defchoose p66-derivative-function
    (derivative-function)
    (ctx function)
  (p66-global-derivative-function-p
   ctx function derivative-function))

;; The real exponential is characterized without extra analytic axioms as the
;; unique globally differentiable function E satisfying E' = E and E(0) = 1.

(defun p66-exponential-function-p (ctx exponential)
  (and
   (p66-global-derivative-function-p
    ctx exponential exponential)
   (equal
    (p66-unary-value exponential (p66-r-zero ctx))
    (p66-r-one ctx))))

(defun p66-context-p (ctx)
  (and
   (true-listp ctx)
   (equal (len ctx) 2)
   (p66-field-context-p (p66-field-context ctx))
   (tamep-functionp (p66-r-exp ctx))
   (p66-exponential-function-p
    ctx (p66-r-exp ctx))))

;; The source differential equation, using the internally selected first and
;; second derivative functions.

(defun p66-first-derivative (ctx function)
  (p66-derivative-function ctx function))

(defun p66-second-derivative (ctx function)
  (p66-derivative-function
   ctx (p66-first-derivative ctx function)))

(defun-sk p66-differential-equation-p (ctx function)
  (forall (x)
    (implies

content:
-- Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1966_b6:
-- every twice-differentiable real solution of y'' + exp(x)y = 0 is eventually
-- bounded above and below. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; _*_)

infix 4 _!=_ _<=N_
infixr 3 _and_
infixr 2 _or_

data Bottom : Set where

Not : Set -> Set
Not A =
  A -> Bottom

_!=_ : {A : Set} -> A -> A -> Set
x != y =
  Not (x == y)

record _and_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data _or_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  left  : A -> A or B
  right : B -> A or B

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

data _<=N_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set where
  zero<=   : {n : Nat} -> zero <=N n
  suc<=suc : {m n : Nat} -> m <=N n -> suc m <=N suc n

record CompleteOrderedField (R : Set) : Set1 where
  field
    zeroR oneR : R
    add multiply : R -> R -> R
    negate inverse : R -> R
    lessOrEqual : R -> R -> Set
    fromNat : Nat -> R

    one-not-zero :
      oneR != zeroR

    add-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> add x y == add y x
    add-associative :
      (x y z : R) -> add (add x y) z == add x (add y z)
    add-zero :
      (x : R) -> add x zeroR == x
    add-inverse :
      (x : R) -> add x (negate x) == zeroR

    multiply-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> multiply x y == multiply y x
    multiply-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply (multiply x y) z == multiply x (multiply y z)
    multiply-one :
      (x : R) -> multiply x oneR == x
    multiply-zero :
      (x : R) -> multiply x zeroR == zeroR
    distribute :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply x (add y z) ==
      add (multiply x y) (multiply x z)
    inverse-zero :
      inverse zeroR == zeroR
    multiply-inverse :
      (x : R) ->
      x != zeroR ->
      multiply x (inverse x) == oneR

    order-reflexive :
      (x : R) -> lessOrEqual x x
    order-transitive :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y z ->
      lessOrEqual x z
    order-antisymmetric :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y x ->
      x == y
    order-total :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y or lessOrEqual y x
    add-order :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual (add z x) (add z y)
    multiply-nonnegative :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR x ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR y ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR (multiply x y)
    zero-less-than-one :
      lessOrEqual zeroR oneR and zeroR != oneR

    fromNat-zero :
      fromNat zero == zeroR
    fromNat-successor :
      (n : Nat) -> fromNat (suc n) == add (fromNat n) oneR
    fromNat-addition :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m + n) == add (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-multiplication :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m * n) == multiply (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-injective :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat m == fromNat n ->
      m == n

    archimedean :
      (x : R) ->
      Exists Nat (\ n -> lessOrEqual x (fromNat n))
    least-upper-bound :
      (P : R -> Set) ->
      Exists R P ->
      Exists R
        (\ upper ->
          (x : R) ->
          P x ->
          lessOrEqual x upper) ->
      Exists R
        (\ supremum ->
          ((x : R) ->
            P x ->
            lessOrEqual x supremum)
          and
          ((upper : R) ->
            ((x : R) ->
              P x ->
              lessOrEqual x upper) ->
            lessOrEqual supremum upper))

open CompleteOrderedField

subtract :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
subtract reals x y =
  add reals x (negate reals y)

divide :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
divide reals x y =
  multiply reals x (inverse reals y)

StrictLess :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
StrictLess reals x y =
  lessOrEqual reals x y and x != y

CloseTo :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
CloseTo reals center radius x =
  StrictLess reals (subtract reals center radius) x
  and
  StrictLess reals x (add reals center radius)

naturalPower :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  Nat ->
  R
naturalPower reals x zero =
  oneR reals
naturalPower reals x (suc n) =
  multiply reals (naturalPower reals x n) x

factorial : Nat -> Nat
factorial zero =
  suc zero
factorial (suc n) =
  suc n * factorial n

sumFirst :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  Nat ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  R
sumFirst reals zero term =
  zeroR reals
sumFirst reals (suc n) term =
  add reals
    (sumFirst reals n term)
    (term n)

ConvergesTo :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  R ->
  Set
ConvergesTo {R} reals sequence limit =
  (epsilon : R) ->
  StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) epsilon ->
  Exists Nat
    (\ cutoff ->
      (n : Nat) ->
      cutoff <=N n ->
      CloseTo reals limit epsilon (sequence n))

SeriesHasSum :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  R ->
  Set
SeriesHasSum reals terms limit =
  ConvergesTo reals
    (\ n -> sumFirst reals n terms)
    limit

exponentialTerm :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  Nat ->
  R
exponentialTerm reals x n =
  divide reals
    (naturalPower reals x n)
    (fromNat reals (factorial n))

ExponentialValue :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
ExponentialValue reals x value =
  SeriesHasSum reals
    (exponentialTerm reals x)
    value

record StandardExponential
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) :
  Set1 where

  field
    exponential : R -> R
    exponential-series :
      (x : R) ->
      ExponentialValue reals x (exponential x)

open StandardExponential

differenceQuotient :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  (R -> R) ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
differenceQuotient reals function point x =
  divide reals
    (subtract reals (function x) (function point))
    (subtract reals x point)

DerivativeAt :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  (R -> R) ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
DerivativeAt {R} reals function point derivative =
  (epsilon : R) ->
  StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) epsilon ->
  Exists R
    (\ delta ->
      StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) delta
      and
      ((x : R) ->
        CloseTo reals point delta x ->
        x != point ->
        CloseTo reals derivative epsilon
          (differenceQuotient reals function point x)))

DifferentialEquation :
  {R : Set} ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) ->
  StandardExponential reals ->
  (R -> R) ->
  Set
DifferentialEquation {R} reals realExp y =
  Exists (R -> R)
    (\ firstDerivative ->
      ((x : R) ->
        DerivativeAt reals y x (firstDerivative x))
      and
      Exists (R -> R)
        (\ secondDerivative ->
          ((x : R) ->
            DerivativeAt reals
              firstDerivative
              x
              (secondDerivative x))
          and
          ((x : R) ->
            add reals
              (secondDerivative x)
              (multiply reals
                (exponential realExp x)
                (y x))
            ==
            zeroR reals)))

EventuallyBounded :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  (R -> R) ->
  Set
EventuallyBounded {R} reals y =
  Exists R
    (\ lower ->
      Exists R
        (\ upper ->
          Exists R
            (\ cutoff ->
              (x : R) ->
              StrictLess reals cutoff x ->
              lessOrEqual reals lower (y x)
              and
              lessOrEqual reals (y x) upper)))

putnam-1966-b6 : Set1
putnam-1966-b6 =
  (R : Set) ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) ->
  (realExp : StandardExponential reals) ->
  (y : R -> R) ->
  DifferentialEquation reals realExp y ->
  EventuallyBounded reals y

% Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench artifact putnam_1966_b6:
% every globally twice-differentiable real solution of y'' + exp(x) * y = 0
% is bounded above and below for all sufficiently large inputs. This file
% contains no proof.

putnam_1966_b6: THEORY
BEGIN
  real_function: TYPE = [real -> real]

  safe_div(numerator, denominator: real): real =
    IF denominator = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      numerator / denominator
    ENDIF

  nat_factorial(index: nat): RECURSIVE nat =
    IF index = 0 THEN
      1
    ELSE
      index * nat_factorial(index - 1)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE index

  exponential_partial(x: real, count: nat): RECURSIVE real =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      LET index: nat = count - 1 IN
        exponential_partial(x, count - 1)
          + safe_div(
              x ^ index,
              nat_factorial(index) :: real)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  converges_to(sequence: [nat -> real], value: real): bool =
    FORALL (epsilon_value: posreal):
      EXISTS (cutoff: nat):
        FORALL (index: nat):
          cutoff <= index IMPLIES
            abs(sequence(index) - value) < epsilon_value

  real_exponential(x: real): real =
    epsilon(
      LAMBDA (value: real):
        converges_to(
          (LAMBDA (count: nat):
            exponential_partial(x, count)),
          value))

  has_derivative_at(
      f: real_function,
      derivative, x: real): bool =
    FORALL (epsilon_value: real):
      epsilon_value > 0 IMPLIES
        EXISTS (delta: real):
          delta > 0
            AND FORALL (h: real):
              (NOT (h = 0) AND abs(h) < delta)
                IMPLIES
                  abs(
                    f(x + h) - f(x)
                      - derivative * h)
                    < epsilon_value * abs(h)

  differentiable_at(f: real_function, x: real): bool =
    EXISTS (derivative: real):
      has_derivative_at(f, derivative, x)

  derivative_value(f: real_function, x: real): real =
    IF differentiable_at(f, x) THEN
      epsilon(
        LAMBDA (derivative: real):
          has_derivative_at(f, derivative, x))
    ELSE
      0
    ENDIF

  derivative_function(f: real_function): real_function =
    LAMBDA (x: real): derivative_value(f, x)

  twice_differentiable(f: real_function): bool =
    FORALL (x: real):
      differentiable_at(f, x)
        AND differentiable_at(derivative_function(f), x)

  satisfies_differential_equation(y: real_function): bool =
    FORALL (x: real):
      derivative_function(derivative_function(y))(x)
        + real_exponential(x) * y(x)
        = 0

  eventually_bounded(y: real_function): bool =
    EXISTS (lower_bound, upper_bound, threshold: real):
      FORALL (x: real):
        x > threshold IMPLIES
          lower_bound <= y(x) AND y(x) <= upper_bound

  putnam_1966_b6: bool =
    FORALL (y: real_function):
      (twice_differentiable(y)
        AND satisfies_differential_equation(y))
      IMPLIES eventually_bounded(y)
END putnam_1966_b6

import Mathlib

open Nat Topology Filter

/--
Let $f(x)=a_1\sin x+a_2\sin 2x+\dots+a_n\sin nx$, where $a_1,a_2,\dots,a_n$ are real numbers and where $n$ is a positive integer. Given that $|f(x)| \leq |\sin x|$ for all real $x$, prove that $|a_1|+|2a_2|+\dots+|na_n| \leq 1$.
-/
theorem putnam_1967_a1
(n : ℕ) (hn : n > 0)
(a : Set.Icc 1 n → ℝ)
(f : ℝ → ℝ)
(hf : f = (fun x : ℝ => ∑ i : Set.Icc 1 n, a i * Real.sin (i * x)))
(flesin : ∀ x : ℝ, abs (f x) ≤ abs (Real.sin x))
: abs (∑ i : Set.Icc 1 n, i * a i) ≤ 1 :=
sorry

;; a real sine polynomial bounded in absolute value by |sin(x)| has its
;; weighted coefficient sum bounded in absolute value by one. This file
;; contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))

;; The conservative interfaces present a Dedekind-complete ordered field,
;; hence the real field up to ordered-field isomorphism. Coefficients are
;; values of an arbitrary function token; they are not restricted to
;; rationals, algebraic reals, a finite carrier, or a finite lookup table.

(defstub putnam-1967-a1-real-p (real-type value) t)
(defstub putnam-1967-a1-zero (real-type) t)
(defstub putnam-1967-a1-one (real-type) t)
(defstub putnam-1967-a1-add (real-type left right) t)
(defstub putnam-1967-a1-mul (real-type left right) t)
(defstub putnam-1967-a1-neg (real-type value) t)
(defstub putnam-1967-a1-inv (real-type value) t)
(defstub putnam-1967-a1-lt (real-type left right) t)
(defstub putnam-1967-a1-set-member-p (real-type set value) t)
(defstub putnam-1967-a1-coefficient
  (real-type coefficients index) t)

(defun putnam-1967-a1-sub (real-type left right)
  (putnam-1967-a1-add
   real-type left (putnam-1967-a1-neg real-type right)))

(defun putnam-1967-a1-le (real-type left right)
  (not (putnam-1967-a1-lt real-type right left)))

(defun putnam-1967-a1-abs (real-type value)
  (if (putnam-1967-a1-lt
       real-type value (putnam-1967-a1-zero real-type))
      (putnam-1967-a1-neg real-type value)
    value))

(defun putnam-1967-a1-real-nat (real-type n)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix n)))
  (if (zp n)
      (putnam-1967-a1-zero real-type)
    (putnam-1967-a1-add
     real-type
     (putnam-1967-a1-one real-type)
     (putnam-1967-a1-real-nat real-type (1- n)))))

;; A complete ordered-field presentation of the real carrier.

(defun-sk putnam-1967-a1-operation-closure-p (real-type)
  (forall (x y)
    (and
     (putnam-1967-a1-real-p
      real-type (putnam-1967-a1-zero real-type))
     (putnam-1967-a1-real-p
      real-type (putnam-1967-a1-one real-type))
     (implies
      (putnam-1967-a1-real-p real-type x)
      (and
       (putnam-1967-a1-real-p
        real-type (putnam-1967-a1-neg real-type x))
       (putnam-1967-a1-real-p
        real-type (putnam-1967-a1-inv real-type x))))
     (implies
      (and
       (putnam-1967-a1-real-p real-type x)
       (putnam-1967-a1-real-p real-type y))
      (and
       (putnam-1967-a1-real-p
        real-type (putnam-1967-a1-add real-type x y))

;; definition of f, the source hypothesis is equivalent to

;; inequality is automatic, and every t in (-1,1) is cos(x) for an x with
;; sin(x) nonzero. The conclusion is evaluation at t=1 because U_(i-1)(1)=i.

(defun putnam-1967-a1-chebyshev-u-iter

   (putnam-1967-a1-mul
    real-type

     real-type

      real-type
      (putnam-1967-a1-coefficient
       real-type coefficients index)

       real-type (1- index) t-value))

      real-type coefficients (1- remaining) (1+ index) t-value))))

    (real-type coefficients n t-value)

      (putnam-1967-a1-real-p real-type t-value)
      (putnam-1967-a1-lt
       real-type
       (putnam-1967-a1-neg
        real-type (putnam-1967-a1-one real-type))
       t-value)

title: putnam_1967_a1
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1967_a1:
-- a positive-degree real sine polynomial bounded in absolute value by sine has
-- the absolute value of its weighted coefficient sum at most one. This file
-- contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; _*_)

infix 4 _!=_ _<=N_
infixr 3 _and_
infixr 2 _or_

data Bottom : Set where

Not : Set -> Set
Not A = A -> Bottom

_!=_ : {A : Set} -> A -> A -> Set
x != y = Not (x == y)

record _and_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data _or_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  left  : A -> A or B
  right : B -> A or B

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

data _<=N_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set where
  zero<=   : {n : Nat} -> zero <=N n
  suc<=suc : {m n : Nat} -> m <=N n -> suc m <=N suc n

data Positive : Nat -> Set where
  positive : {n : Nat} -> Positive (suc n)

oneN : Nat
oneN = suc zero

twoN : Nat
twoN = suc oneN

record CompleteOrderedField (R : Set) : Set1 where
  field
    zeroR oneR : R
    add multiply : R -> R -> R
    negate inverse : R -> R
    lessOrEqual : R -> R -> Set
    fromNat : Nat -> R

    one-not-zero :
      oneR != zeroR

    add-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> add x y == add y x
    add-associative :
      (x y z : R) -> add (add x y) z == add x (add y z)
    add-zero :
      (x : R) -> add x zeroR == x
    add-inverse :
      (x : R) -> add x (negate x) == zeroR

    multiply-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> multiply x y == multiply y x
    multiply-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply (multiply x y) z == multiply x (multiply y z)
    multiply-one :
      (x : R) -> multiply x oneR == x
    multiply-zero :
      (x : R) -> multiply x zeroR == zeroR
    distribute :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply x (add y z) ==
      add (multiply x y) (multiply x z)
    inverse-zero :
      inverse zeroR == zeroR
    multiply-inverse :
      (x : R) ->
      x != zeroR ->
      multiply x (inverse x) == oneR

    order-reflexive :
      (x : R) -> lessOrEqual x x
    order-transitive :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y z ->
      lessOrEqual x z
    order-antisymmetric :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y x ->
      x == y
    order-total :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y or lessOrEqual y x
    add-order :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual (add z x) (add z y)
    multiply-nonnegative :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR x ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR y ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR (multiply x y)
    zero-less-than-one :
      lessOrEqual zeroR oneR and zeroR != oneR

    fromNat-zero :
      fromNat zero == zeroR
    fromNat-successor :
      (n : Nat) -> fromNat (suc n) == add (fromNat n) oneR
    fromNat-addition :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m + n) == add (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-multiplication :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m * n) == multiply (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-injective :
      (m n : Nat) -> fromNat m == fromNat n -> m == n

    archimedean :
      (x : R) ->
      Exists Nat (\ n -> lessOrEqual x (fromNat n))
    least-upper-bound :
      (P : R -> Set) ->
      Exists R P ->
      Exists R
        (\ upper ->
          (x : R) ->
          P x ->
          lessOrEqual x upper) ->
      Exists R
        (\ supremum ->
          ((x : R) -> P x -> lessOrEqual x supremum)
          and
          ((upper : R) ->
            ((x : R) -> P x -> lessOrEqual x upper) ->
            lessOrEqual supremum upper))

open CompleteOrderedField

subtract :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
subtract reals x y =
  add reals x (negate reals y)

divide :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
divide reals x y =
  multiply reals x (inverse reals y)

StrictLess :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
StrictLess reals x y =
  lessOrEqual reals x y and x != y

maximum :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
maximum reals x y with order-total reals x y
... | left _ = y
... | right _ = x

absoluteValue :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  R
absoluteValue reals x =
  maximum reals x (negate reals x)

CloseTo :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
CloseTo reals center radius x =
  StrictLess reals (subtract reals center radius) x
  and
  StrictLess reals x (add reals center radius)

naturalPower :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  Nat ->
  R
naturalPower reals x zero =
  oneR reals
naturalPower reals x (suc n) =
  multiply reals (naturalPower reals x n) x

factorial : Nat -> Nat
factorial zero =
  oneN
factorial (suc n) =
  suc n * factorial n

sumFirst :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  Nat ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  R
sumFirst reals zero term =
  zeroR reals
sumFirst reals (suc n) term =
  add reals
    (sumFirst reals n term)
    (term n)

sumFromOneThrough :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  Nat ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  R
sumFromOneThrough reals zero term =
  zeroR reals
sumFromOneThrough reals (suc n) term =
  add reals
    (sumFromOneThrough reals n term)
    (term (suc n))

ConvergesTo :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  R ->
  Set
ConvergesTo {R} reals sequence limit =
  (epsilon : R) ->
  StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) epsilon ->
  Exists Nat
    (\ cutoff ->
      (n : Nat) ->
      cutoff <=N n ->
      CloseTo reals limit epsilon (sequence n))

SeriesHasSum :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  R ->
  Set
SeriesHasSum reals terms limit =
  ConvergesTo reals
    (\ n -> sumFirst reals n terms)
    limit

alternatingPower :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  Nat ->
  R
alternatingPower reals n =
  naturalPower reals (negate reals (oneR reals)) n

sineTerm :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  Nat ->
  R
sineTerm reals x n =
  divide reals
    (multiply reals
      (alternatingPower reals n)
      (naturalPower reals x (suc (twoN * n))))
    (fromNat reals (factorial (suc (twoN * n))))

record StandardSine
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) : Set1 where
  field
    sine : R -> R
    sine-series :
      (x : R) ->
      SeriesHasSum reals (sineTerm reals x) (sine x)

open StandardSine

EqFunction :
  {A B : Set} ->
  (A -> B) ->
  (A -> B) ->
  Set
EqFunction {A} f g =
  (x : A) ->
  f x == g x

module Putnam1967A1Statement
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R)
  (trigonometry : StandardSine reals) where

  trigonometricPolynomial :
    Nat ->
    (Nat -> R) ->
    R ->
    R
  trigonometricPolynomial n a x =
    sumFromOneThrough reals n
      (\ i ->
        multiply reals
          (a i)
          (sine trigonometry
            (multiply reals
              (fromNat reals i)
              x)))

  weightedCoefficientSum :
    Nat ->
    (Nat -> R) ->
    R
  weightedCoefficientSum n a =
    sumFromOneThrough reals n
      (\ i ->
        multiply reals
          (fromNat reals i)
          (a i))

  proposition : Set
  proposition =
    (n : Nat) ->
    Positive n ->
    (a : Nat -> R) ->
    (f : R -> R) ->
    EqFunction f (trigonometricPolynomial n a) ->
    ((x : R) ->
      lessOrEqual reals
        (absoluteValue reals (f x))
        (absoluteValue reals (sine trigonometry x))) ->
    lessOrEqual reals
      (absoluteValue reals (weightedCoefficientSum n a))
      (oneR reals)

putnam-1967-a1 : Set1
putnam-1967-a1 =
  (R : Set) ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) ->
  (trigonometry : StandardSine reals) ->
  Putnam1967A1Statement.proposition reals trigonometry

title: putnam_1967_a1
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench artifact putnam_1967_a1:
  a real sine polynomial bounded pointwise by the absolute value of sine has
  the absolute value of its weighted coefficient sum at most one. This file
  contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open arithmeticTheory pred_setTheory realTheory real_sigmaTheory transcTheory;

val putnam_1967_a1 =
  ``!n : num. !a : num -> real. !f : real -> real.
      0 < n /\
      f =
        (\x : real.
           SIGMA
             (\i : num. a i * sin (&i * x))
             (IMAGE SUC (count n))) /\
      (!x : real. abs (f x) <= abs (sin x))
      ==>
      abs
        (SIGMA
           (\i : num. &i * a i)
           (IMAGE SUC (count n))) <=
      1``;

title: putnam_1967_a1
content:
$(
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench artifact putnam_1967_a1:
  the coefficient-weighted sum bound for a finite real sine polynomial whose
  absolute value is bounded pointwise by the absolute value of sin(x). This
  file contains no proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  The positive integer n is represented as a nonnegative integer together
  with the explicit hypothesis 0 < n. The coefficient function A is a total
  real sequence, but only its values on the inclusive interval 1 ... n occur,
  which is equivalent to the finite coefficient domain in the source. The
  function F and its defining equality are retained explicitly.

  The final declaration is the single unproved $a corpus statement; this
  database contains no $p proof statement.
$)

${
  $d A F i n x $.

  putnambench-putnam-1967-a1 $a |- A. n e. NN0
    A. A A. F
      (
        (
          (
            (
              0 < n
              /\
              A : NN0 --> RR
            )
            /\
            (
              F : RR --> RR
              /\
              F =
                (
                  x e. RR |->
                    sum_ i e. ( 1 ... n )
                      (
                        ( A ` i )
                        x.
                        ( sin ` ( i x. x ) )
                      )
                )
            )
          )
          /\
          A. x e. RR
            ( abs ` ( F ` x ) ) <_ ( abs ` ( sin ` x ) )
        )
        ->
        (
          abs
          `
          (
            sum_ i e. ( 1 ... n )
              ( i x. ( A ` i ) )
          )
        )
        <_
        1
      )
  $.
$}

% Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench artifact putnam_1967_a1:
% a real sine polynomial bounded in absolute value by sine has weighted
% coefficient sum of absolute value at most one. This file contains no proof.

putnam_1967_a1: THEORY
BEGIN
  real_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> real]
  real_function: TYPE = [real -> real]

  safe_div(numerator, denominator: real): real =
    IF denominator = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      numerator / denominator
    ENDIF

  factorial(index: nat): RECURSIVE nat =
    IF index = 0 THEN
      1
    ELSE
      index * factorial(index - 1)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE index

  sine_partial(x: real, count: nat): RECURSIVE real =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      LET index: nat = count - 1 IN
        sine_partial(x, count - 1)
          + safe_div(
              ((-1 :: real) ^ index) * x ^ (2 * index + 1),
              factorial(2 * index + 1) :: real)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  converges_to(sequence: real_sequence, value: real): bool =
    FORALL (epsilon_value: posreal):
      EXISTS (cutoff: nat):
        FORALL (index: nat):
          cutoff <= index IMPLIES
            abs(sequence(index) - value) < epsilon_value

  sine(x: real): real =
    epsilon(
      LAMBDA (value: real):
        converges_to(
          LAMBDA (count: nat): sine_partial(x, count),
          value))

  sine_polynomial_sum(
      a: real_sequence,
      x: real,
      count: nat): RECURSIVE real =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      sine_polynomial_sum(a, x, count - 1)
        + a(count) * sine((count :: real) * x)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  weighted_coefficient_sum(
      a: real_sequence,
      count: nat): RECURSIVE real =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      weighted_coefficient_sum(a, count - 1)
        + (count :: real) * a(count)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  putnam_1967_a1: bool =
    FORALL
        (n: nat),
        (a: real_sequence),
        (f: real_function):
      (n > 0
        AND f =
          (LAMBDA (x: real):
            sine_polynomial_sum(a, x, n))
        AND (FORALL (x: real):
          abs(f(x)) <= abs(sine(x))))
      IMPLIES
        abs(weighted_coefficient_sum(a, n)) <= 1
END putnam_1967_a1

import Mathlib

open Nat Topology Filter

/--
Define $S_0$ to be $1$. For $n \geq 1$, let $S_n$ be the number of $n \times n$ matrices whose elements are nonnegative integers with the property that $a_{ij}=a_{ji}$, ($i,j=1,2,\dots,n$) and where $\sum_{i=1}^n a_{ij}=1$, ($j=1,2,\dots,n$). Prove
\begin{enumerate}
\item[(a)] $S_{n+1}=S_n+nS_{n-1}$
\item[(b)] $\sum_{n=0}^\infty S_n\frac{x^n}{n!} = \exp(x+x^2/2)$, where $\exp(x)=e^x$.
\end{enumerate}
-/
theorem putnam_1967_a2
    (S : ℕ → ℤ)
    (hS0 : S 0 = 1)
    (hSn : ∀ n ≥ 1, S n = {A : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℕ | (∀ i j, A i j = A j i) ∧ (∀ j, (∑ i, A i j) = 1)}.ncard) :
    (∀ n ≥ 1, S (n + 1) = S n + n * S (n - 1)) ∧
    (∀ x : ℝ, (∑' n : ℕ, S n * (x ^ n / (n)!)) = Real.exp (x + x ^ 2 / 2)) :=
  sorry

;; Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench artifact putnam_1967_a2:
;; the count of symmetric nonnegative-integer matrices with every column sum
;; equal to one, its recurrence, and its exponential generating function.
;; This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

;; A matrix in the source set has exactly one entry equal to one in each
;; column and all other entries zero. It is therefore determined by a
;; function f on {0,...,n-1}; symmetry is equivalent to f(f(j)) = j.
;; Thus counting the function codes accepted below is exactly the source
;; matrix cardinality, including the unique empty matrix when n = 0.
(defun putnam-1967-a2-function-value (code index radix)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix index)))
  (if (zp index)
      (mod code radix)
    (putnam-1967-a2-function-value
     (floor code radix)
     (- index 1)
     radix)))

(defun putnam-1967-a2-involution-code-aux-p
    (code remaining radix)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix remaining)))
  (if (zp remaining)
      t
    (let* ((index (- remaining 1))
           (image
            (putnam-1967-a2-function-value
             code index radix)))
      (and
       (equal
        (putnam-1967-a2-function-value
         code image radix)
        index)
       (putnam-1967-a2-involution-code-aux-p
        code index radix)))))

(defun putnam-1967-a2-involution-code-p (code n)
  (and (natp n)
       (< code (expt n n))
       (putnam-1967-a2-involution-code-aux-p
        code n n)))

(defun putnam-1967-a2-count-involution-codes
    (code-count n)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix code-count)))
  (if (zp code-count)
      0
    (let ((code (- code-count 1)))
      (+
       (if (putnam-1967-a2-involution-code-p code n)
           1
         0)
       (putnam-1967-a2-count-involution-codes
        code n)))))

(defun putnam-1967-a2-matrix-count (n)
  (if (natp n)
      (putnam-1967-a2-count-involution-codes
       (expt n n)
       n)
    0))

(defun putnam-1967-a2-factorial (n)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix n)))
  (if (zp n)
      1
    (* n
       (putnam-1967-a2-factorial (- n 1)))))

;; Since exp(x + x^2/2) = exp(x) * exp(x^2/2), its coefficient of x^n is
;;
;;   sum_{0 <= k <= n/2} 1 / ((n-2k)! 2^k k!).
;;
;; Both sides of the source generating-function identity are entire real
;; power series. Consequently, equality for every real x is bidirectionally
;; equivalent to equality of every rational Taylor coefficient. This formal
;; coefficient encoding preserves the universal real identity without
;; restricting x to the ACL2 rationals.
(defun putnam-1967-a2-exp-quadratic-coefficient-sum
    (n term-count)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix term-count)))
  (if (zp term-count)
      0
    (let* ((k (- term-count 1))
           (linear-degree (- n (* 2 k))))
      (+
       (/ 1
          (* (putnam-1967-a2-factorial linear-degree)
             (expt 2 k)
             (putnam-1967-a2-factorial k)))
       (putnam-1967-a2-exp-quadratic-coefficient-sum
        n k)))))

(defun putnam-1967-a2-exp-quadratic-coefficient (n)
  (if (natp n)
      (putnam-1967-a2-exp-quadratic-coefficient-sum
       n
       (+ 1 (floor n 2)))
    0))

;; The source hypotheses uniquely determine S at every natural index:
;; S(0) is one and, for n >= 1, S(n) is the matrix count defined above.
;; Eliminating that uniquely specified function is definitionally
;; equivalent to the original implication. The free ACL2 argument n
;; universally ranges over both requested conclusions.
(defun putnambench-putnam-1967-a2-statement (n)
  (implies
   (natp n)
   (and
    (implies
     (<= 1 n)
     (equal
      (putnam-1967-a2-matrix-count (+ n 1))
      (+
       (putnam-1967-a2-matrix-count n)
       (* n
          (putnam-1967-a2-matrix-count
           (- n 1))))))
    (equal
     (/ (putnam-1967-a2-matrix-count n)
        (putnam-1967-a2-factorial n))
     (putnam-1967-a2-exp-quadratic-coefficient n)))))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

title: putnam_1967_a2
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1967_a2:
-- counting symmetric nonnegative-integer matrices with unit column sums, with
-- the resulting recurrence and exponential generating function. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; _*_)

infix 4 _!=_ _<=N_
infixr 3 _and_
infixr 2 _or_

data Bottom : Set where

Not : Set -> Set
Not A =
  A -> Bottom

_!=_ : {A : Set} -> A -> A -> Set
x != y =
  Not (x == y)

record _and_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data _or_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  left  : A -> A or B
  right : B -> A or B

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

data _<=N_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set where
  zero<=N   : {n : Nat} -> zero <=N n
  suc<=sucN : {m n : Nat} -> m <=N n -> suc m <=N suc n

data Fin : Nat -> Set where
  fzero : {n : Nat} -> Fin (suc n)
  fsuc  : {n : Nat} -> Fin n -> Fin (suc n)

predecessor : Nat -> Nat
predecessor zero =
  zero
predecessor (suc n) =
  n

sumFinNat :
  {n : Nat} ->
  (Fin n -> Nat) ->
  Nat
sumFinNat {zero} values =
  zero
sumFinNat {suc n} values =
  values fzero + sumFinNat (\ i -> values (fsuc i))

Matrix : Nat -> Set
Matrix n =
  Fin n -> Fin n -> Nat

MatrixEqual :
  {n : Nat} ->
  Matrix n ->
  Matrix n ->
  Set
MatrixEqual {n} A B =
  (i j : Fin n) ->
  A i j == B i j

AdmissibleMatrix :
  {n : Nat} ->
  Matrix n ->
  Set
AdmissibleMatrix {n} A =
  ((i j : Fin n) -> A i j == A j i)
  and
  ((j : Fin n) ->
    sumFinNat (\ i -> A i j) == suc zero)

record MatrixCount (n count : Nat) : Set where
  field
    enumerate :
      Fin count ->
      Matrix n
    enumerated-admissible :
      (k : Fin count) ->
      AdmissibleMatrix (enumerate k)
    enumeration-complete :
      (A : Matrix n) ->
      AdmissibleMatrix A ->
      Exists (Fin count)
        (\ k -> MatrixEqual A (enumerate k))
    enumeration-injective :
      (i j : Fin count) ->
      MatrixEqual (enumerate i) (enumerate j) ->
      i == j

record CompleteOrderedField (R : Set) : Set1 where
  field
    zeroR oneR : R
    add multiply : R -> R -> R
    negate inverse absoluteValue : R -> R
    lessOrEqual : R -> R -> Set
    fromNat : Nat -> R

    one-not-zero :
      oneR != zeroR

    add-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> add x y == add y x
    add-associative :
      (x y z : R) -> add (add x y) z == add x (add y z)
    add-zero :
      (x : R) -> add x zeroR == x
    add-inverse :
      (x : R) -> add x (negate x) == zeroR

    multiply-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> multiply x y == multiply y x
    multiply-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply (multiply x y) z == multiply x (multiply y z)
    multiply-one :
      (x : R) -> multiply x oneR == x
    multiply-zero :
      (x : R) -> multiply x zeroR == zeroR
    distribute :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply x (add y z) ==
      add (multiply x y) (multiply x z)
    inverse-zero :
      inverse zeroR == zeroR
    multiply-inverse :
      (x : R) ->
      x != zeroR ->
      multiply x (inverse x) == oneR

    order-reflexive :
      (x : R) -> lessOrEqual x x
    order-transitive :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y z ->
      lessOrEqual x z
    order-antisymmetric :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y x ->
      x == y
    order-total :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y or lessOrEqual y x
    add-order :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual (add z x) (add z y)
    multiply-nonnegative :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR x ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR y ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR (multiply x y)
    zero-less-than-one :
      lessOrEqual zeroR oneR and zeroR != oneR

    absolute-nonnegative :
      (x : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR (absoluteValue x)
    absolute-of-nonnegative :
      (x : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR x ->
      absoluteValue x == x
    absolute-of-nonpositive :
      (x : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x zeroR ->
      absoluteValue x == negate x

    fromNat-zero :
      fromNat zero == zeroR
    fromNat-successor :
      (n : Nat) -> fromNat (suc n) == add (fromNat n) oneR
    fromNat-addition :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m + n) == add (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-multiplication :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m * n) == multiply (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-injective :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat m == fromNat n ->
      m == n

    archimedean :
      (x : R) ->
      Exists Nat (\ n -> lessOrEqual x (fromNat n))
    least-upper-bound :
      (P : R -> Set) ->
      Exists R P ->
      Exists R
        (\ upper ->
          (x : R) ->
          P x ->
          lessOrEqual x upper) ->
      Exists R
        (\ supremum ->
          ((x : R) ->
            P x ->
            lessOrEqual x supremum)
          and
          ((upper : R) ->
            ((x : R) ->
              P x ->
              lessOrEqual x upper) ->
            lessOrEqual supremum upper))

open CompleteOrderedField

subtract :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
subtract reals x y =
  add reals x (negate reals y)

divide :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
divide reals x y =
  multiply reals x (inverse reals y)

StrictLess :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
StrictLess reals x y =
  lessOrEqual reals x y and x != y

CloseTo :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
CloseTo reals center radius x =
  StrictLess reals
    (subtract reals center radius)
    x
  and
  StrictLess reals
    x
    (add reals center radius)

naturalPower :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  Nat ->
  R
naturalPower reals x zero =
  oneR reals
naturalPower reals x (suc n) =
  multiply reals
    (naturalPower reals x n)
    x

factorial : Nat -> Nat
factorial zero =
  suc zero
factorial (suc n) =
  suc n * factorial n

sumFirst :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  Nat ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  R
sumFirst reals zero term =
  zeroR reals
sumFirst reals (suc n) term =
  add reals
    (sumFirst reals n term)
    (term n)

ConvergesTo :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  R ->
  Set
ConvergesTo {R} reals sequence limit =
  (epsilon : R) ->
  StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) epsilon ->
  Exists Nat
    (\ cutoff ->
      (n : Nat) ->
      cutoff <=N n ->
      CloseTo reals limit epsilon (sequence n))

SeriesHasSum :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  R ->
  Set
SeriesHasSum reals terms limit =
  ConvergesTo reals
    (\ n -> sumFirst reals n terms)
    limit

exponentialTerm :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  Nat ->
  R
exponentialTerm reals x n =
  divide reals
    (naturalPower reals x n)
    (fromNat reals (factorial n))

record StandardExponential
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) :
  Set1 where

  field
    exponential : R -> R

    exponential-series :
      (x : R) ->
      SeriesHasSum reals
        (exponentialTerm reals x)
        (exponential x)

open StandardExponential

twoN : Nat
twoN =
  suc (suc zero)

module Putnam1967A2Statement
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R)
  (realExp : StandardExponential reals) where

  generatingTerm :
    (Nat -> Nat) ->
    R ->
    Nat ->
    R
  generatingTerm S x n =
    divide reals
      (multiply reals
        (fromNat reals (S n))
        (naturalPower reals x n))
      (fromNat reals (factorial n))

  exponentialArgument :
    R ->
    R
  exponentialArgument x =
    add reals
      x
      (divide reals
        (naturalPower reals x twoN)
        (fromNat reals twoN))

  proposition : Set
  proposition =
    (S : Nat -> Nat) ->
    S zero == suc zero ->
    ((n : Nat) ->
      suc zero <=N n ->
      MatrixCount n (S n)) ->
    (((n : Nat) ->
      suc zero <=N n ->
      S (suc n) ==
      S n + n * S (predecessor n))
    and
    ((x : R) ->
      SeriesHasSum reals
        (generatingTerm S x)
        (exponential realExp (exponentialArgument x))))

putnam-1967-a2 : Set1
putnam-1967-a2 =
  (R : Set) ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) ->
  (realExp : StandardExponential reals) ->
  Putnam1967A2Statement.proposition reals realExp

                      A i j = A j i) /\
                   (!j : num.
                      j < n
                      ==>
                      SIGMA (\i : num. A i j) (count n) = 1) /\
                   (!i j : num.
                      n <= i \/ n <= j
                      ==>
                      A i j = 0)}))
      ==>
      ((!n : num.
          1 <= n
          ==>
          S (n + 1) =
            S n + int_of_num n * S (n - 1)) /\
       (!x : real.
          suminf
            (\n : num.
               real_of_int (S n) *
               (x pow n / &(FACT n))) =
          exp (x + x pow 2 / 2)))``;

$(

  the recurrence and exponential generating function for the number of
  symmetric nonnegative-integer matrices whose column sums are one. This file
  contains no proof.

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  The index set 0 ..^ n is {0,...,n-1}. Thus a matrix is represented exactly
  as a function from (0 ..^ n) X. (0 ..^ n) to NN0. The restricted class in
  the cardinality expression imposes symmetry and column sum one.

  S is integer-valued as in the Lean and Isabelle sources. Its value at zero
  and every positive index is fixed to a natural-number cardinality, so this
  is equivalent to the natural-valued sequence in the Rocq source. The
  infinite sum and exp are set.mm's real-series sum and real exponential.

  The final declaration is the single unproved $a corpus statement; this
  database contains no $p proof statement.
$)

${
  $d A S i j n x $.

  putnambench-putnam-1967-a2 $a |- A. S e. ( ZZ ^m NN0 )
    (
      (
        ( S ` 0 ) = 1
        /\
        A. n e. NN
          ( S ` n )
          =
          (
            #
            `
            { A e.
              (
                NN0
                ^m
                ( ( 0 ..^ n ) X. ( 0 ..^ n ) )
              )
              |
              (
                A. i e. ( 0 ..^ n )
                  A. j e. ( 0 ..^ n )
                    ( A ` <. i , j >. ) = ( A ` <. j , i >. )
                /\
                A. j e. ( 0 ..^ n )
                  (
                    sum_ i e. ( 0 ..^ n )
                      ( A ` <. i , j >. )
                  )
                  =
                  1
              )
            }
          )
      )
      ->
      (
        A. n e. NN
          ( S ` ( n + 1 ) )
          =
          (
            ( S ` n )
            +
            ( n x. ( S ` ( n - 1 ) ) )

        /\

                x.
                (
                  ( x ^ n )
                  /
                  ( ! ` n )
                )
              )
          )
          =
          (
            exp
            `
            (
              x
              +
              ( ( x ^ 2 ) / 2 )
            )
          )
      )
    )
  $.
$}
