title: putnam_1967_b4
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact
;; putnam_1967_b4: after successively toggling lockers whose numbers are
;; multiples of each operation number, exactly the perfect-square-numbered
;; lockers are open. This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

;; On operations 0,...,n and locker indices 1,...,n, the source hypotheses
;; uniquely determine every locker value from the initially closed state.
;; The recursive function below definitionally eliminates that arbitrary
;; source function without changing its universally quantified conclusion.
;; Free n and i supply the source universal quantifiers.
;;
;; For positive i, an integer j satisfies j^2 = i exactly when a natural
;; candidate from 0 through i does, so the bounded search preserves the
;; source's internal existential integer witness.

(defun putnam-1967-b4-locker-open-after-p (operation locker)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix operation)))
  (if (zp operation)
      nil
    (let ((previous
           (putnam-1967-b4-locker-open-after-p
            (- operation 1) locker)))
      (if (equal (mod locker operation) 0)
          (not previous)
        previous))))

(defun putnam-1967-b4-square-witness-through-p (i candidate)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix candidate)))
  (if (zp candidate)
      (equal i 0)
    (or (equal (* candidate candidate) i)
        (putnam-1967-b4-square-witness-through-p
         i (- candidate 1)))))

(defun putnam-1967-b4-perfect-square-p (i)
  (and (natp i)
       (putnam-1967-b4-square-witness-through-p i i)))

(defun putnambench-putnam-1967-b4-statement (n i)
  (implies
   (and (natp n)
        (<= 1 n)
        (natp i)
        (<= 1 i)
        (<= i n))
   (equal
    (putnam-1967-b4-locker-open-after-p n i)
    (putnam-1967-b4-perfect-square-p i))))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

title: putnam_1967_b4
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1967_b4:
-- after divisor-indexed toggling operations on finitely many lockers, exactly
-- the perfect-square-indexed lockers are open. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

open import Agda.Builtin.Bool using (Bool; false; true)
open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _-_; _*_)

infix 4 _<=_ _divides_
infixr 3 _and_

data Bottom : Set where

Not : Set -> Set
Not A =
  A -> Bottom

record _and_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

record Iff (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor iff
  field
    forward  : A -> B
    backward : B -> A

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

data _<=_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set where
  zero<= : {n : Nat} -> zero <= n
  suc<=suc : {m n : Nat} -> m <= n -> suc m <= suc n

record _divides_ (divisor dividend : Nat) : Set where
  constructor quotient
  field
    factor   : Nat
    equation : divisor * factor == dividend

one : Nat
one =
  suc zero

InRange : Nat -> Nat -> Set
InRange i n =
  (one <= i) and (i <= n)

notBool : Bool -> Bool
notBool false =
  true
notBool true =
  false

putnam-1967-b4 : Set
putnam-1967-b4 =
  (n : Nat) ->
  (lockers : Nat -> Nat -> Bool) ->
  one <= n ->
  ((i : Nat) ->
    InRange i n ->
    lockers zero i == false) ->
  ((k i : Nat) ->
    InRange k n ->
    InRange i n ->
    ((k divides i ->
      lockers k i == notBool (lockers (k - one) i))
    and
    (Not (k divides i) ->
      lockers k i == lockers (k - one) i))) ->
  (i : Nat) ->
  InRange i n ->
  Iff
    (lockers n i == true)
    (Exists Nat (\ j -> j * j == i))

  putnam_1967_b4: after successively toggling exactly the lockers whose

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  The locker state is an arbitrary total integer-valued function of a
  nonnegative operation index and a nonnegative locker number. On the
  constrained indices, 0 and 1 encode the two Boolean states, and
  1 - state is exactly Boolean negation. Values outside stages 0 through n
  and locker numbers 1 through n are irrelevant, so total extension is
  equivalent to the source finite-index function representations.

  Quantification over NN incorporates the source assumption n >= 1. For a
  positive integer i, existence of an integer j with j ^ 2 = i is equivalent
  to existence of a natural-number square root. The final declaration is the
  single unproved $a corpus statement; this database contains no $p proof
  statement.
$)

${
  $d L i j k n $.

  putnambench-putnam-1967-b4 $a |-
    A. n e. NN
    A. L e. ( ( ZZ ^m NN0 ) ^m NN0 )
      (
        (
          A. i e. ( 1 ... n )
            ( ( L ` 0 ) ` i ) = 0
          /\
          A. k e. ( 1 ... n )
          A. i e. ( 1 ... n )
            ( ( L ` k ) ` i )
            =
            if (
              k || i ,
              ( 1 - ( ( L ` ( k - 1 ) ) ` i ) ) ,
              ( ( L ` ( k - 1 ) ) ` i )
            )
        )
        ->
        A. i e. ( 1 ... n )
          (
            ( ( L ` n ) ` i ) = 1
            <->
            E. j e. ZZ ( j ^ 2 ) = i
          )
      )
  $.
$}

% Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench artifact putnam_1967_b4:
% toggling exactly the lockers divisible by each successive operation number
% leaves precisely the perfect-square-numbered lockers open. This file contains no proof.

putnam_1967_b4: THEORY
BEGIN
  locker_configuration: TYPE = [nat -> [nat -> bool]]

  nat_divides(divisor, value: nat): bool =
    EXISTS (quotient: nat):
      value = divisor * quotient

  perfect_square(value: nat): bool =
    EXISTS (root: nat):
      root * root = value

  putnam_1967_b4: bool =
    FORALL
        (n: nat),
        (lockers: locker_configuration):
      (n >= 1
        AND (FORALL (i: nat):
          1 <= i AND i <= n IMPLIES
            lockers(0)(i) = FALSE)
        AND (FORALL (k, i: nat):
          1 <= k AND k <= n
            AND 1 <= i AND i <= n
          IMPLIES
            lockers(k)(i)
              = IF nat_divides(k, i) THEN
                  NOT lockers(k - 1)(i)
                ELSE
                  lockers(k - 1)(i)
                ENDIF))
      IMPLIES
        FORALL (i: nat):
          1 <= i AND i <= n IMPLIES
            (lockers(n)(i) IFF perfect_square(i))
END putnam_1967_b4

;; Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact
;; putnam_1967_b5: for every positive natural n, the first n terms of a
;; negative-binomial expansion sum to one half. This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

;; Pascal recursion represents the natural-number binomial coefficient.
(defun putnam-1967-b5-binomial-coefficient (n k)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix n)))
  (if (or (zp k)
          (zp n))
      (if (zp k) 1 0)
    (+ (putnam-1967-b5-binomial-coefficient (- n 1) k)
       (putnam-1967-b5-binomial-coefficient
        (- n 1) (- k 1)))))

;; This inclusive recursion enumerates i = 0 through upper. Under the
;; statement hypotheses, upper = n-1 and every term is the exact rational
;;
;;   choose(n+i-1,i) / 2^(n+i).
;;
;; This equals the sources' integer negative-power form. Since all terms are
;; rational, ACL2 equality is equivalent to equality of their canonical
;; images in the real and real-closed-field formulations.
(defun putnam-1967-b5-sum-through (n upper)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix upper)))
  (let ((term
         (/ (putnam-1967-b5-binomial-coefficient
             (- (+ n upper) 1)
             upper)
            (expt 2 (+ n upper)))))
    (if (zp upper)
        term
      (+ (putnam-1967-b5-sum-through n (- upper 1))
         term))))

(defun putnambench-putnam-1967-b5-statement (n)
  (implies
   (and (natp n)
        (< 0 n))
   (equal
    (/ 1 2)
    (putnam-1967-b5-sum-through n (- n 1)))))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

-- Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1967_b5:
-- for every positive natural n, a finite binomial sum with powers of two in
-- the denominators equals one half. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; _-_; _*_)

data Positive : Nat -> Set where
  positive : {n : Nat} -> Positive (suc n)

one : Nat
one = suc zero

two : Nat
two = suc one

power : Nat -> Nat -> Nat
power base zero = one
power base (suc exponent) =
  power base exponent * base

choose : Nat -> Nat -> Nat
choose n zero = one
choose zero (suc k) = zero
choose (suc n) (suc k) =
  choose n (suc k) + choose n k

record NonnegativeFraction : Set where
  constructor fraction
  field
    numerator   : Nat
    denominator : Nat

open NonnegativeFraction

infix 4 _~Q_

_~Q_ : NonnegativeFraction -> NonnegativeFraction -> Set
x ~Q y =
  numerator x * denominator y ==
  numerator y * denominator x

addFraction :
  NonnegativeFraction ->
  NonnegativeFraction ->
  NonnegativeFraction
addFraction (fraction a b) (fraction c d) =
  fraction (a * d + c * b) (b * d)

sumFirst :
  Nat ->
  (Nat -> NonnegativeFraction) ->
  NonnegativeFraction
sumFirst zero term =
  fraction zero one
sumFirst (suc n) term =
  addFraction
    (sumFirst n term)
    (term n)

summand : Nat -> Nat -> NonnegativeFraction
summand n i =
  fraction
    (choose (n + i - one) i)
    (power two (n + i))

oneHalf : NonnegativeFraction
oneHalf =
  fraction one two

putnam-1967-b5 : Set
putnam-1967-b5 =
  (n : Nat) ->
  Positive n ->
  oneHalf ~Q sumFirst n (summand n)

% Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench artifact putnam_1967_b5:
% for every positive natural n, the first n terms of the relevant negative
% binomial expansion sum to one half. This file contains no proof.

putnam_1967_b5: THEORY
BEGIN
  binomial_coefficient(n, k: nat): RECURSIVE nat =
    IF k = 0 THEN
      1
    ELSIF n = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      binomial_coefficient(n - 1, k - 1)
        + binomial_coefficient(n - 1, k)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE n

  nat_subtract(n, k: nat): nat =
    IF k <= n THEN n - k ELSE 0 ENDIF

  safe_div(numerator, denominator: real): real =
    IF denominator = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      numerator / denominator
    ENDIF

  negative_binomial_partial_sum(
      n, term_count: nat): RECURSIVE real =
    IF term_count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      LET i: nat = term_count - 1
      IN
        negative_binomial_partial_sum(n, term_count - 1)
          + safe_div(
              binomial_coefficient(
                nat_subtract(n + i, 1), i) :: real,
              (2 :: real) ^ (n + i))
    ENDIF
  MEASURE term_count

  putnam_1967_b5: bool =
    FORALL (n: nat):
      n > 0 IMPLIES
        (1 :: real) / 2
          = negative_binomial_partial_sum(n, n)
END putnam_1967_b5

(fbound : ∀ x y : ℝ, (x ^ 2 + y ^ 2 ≤ 1) → |f x y| ≤ 1)
: ∃ x0 y0 : ℝ, (x0 ^ 2 + y0 ^ 2 < 1) ∧ ((deriv (fun x : ℝ => f x y0) x0) ^ 2 + (deriv (fun y : ℝ => f x0 y) y0) ^ 2 ≤ 16) :=

content:
;; Statement-only formalization of putnambench corpus artifact putnam_1967_b6:
;; a bounded real-valued function on the unit disk, differentiable in each
;; coordinate, has an interior point where the sum of the squared partial
;; derivatives is at most 16. This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))

;; The scalar arguments present the reals as a Dedekind-complete ordered
;; field. The bivariate function is an arbitrary tame APPLY$ function object.
;; All quantifiers below are unbounded ACL2 quantifiers introduced by
;; conservative DEFUN-SK events; no finite carrier or rational restriction is
;; used.

(defun p67b6-member-p (carrier x)
  (if (apply$ carrier (list x)) t nil))

(defun p67b6-unary (operation x)
  (apply$ operation (list x)))

(defun p67b6-binary (operation x y)
  (apply$ operation (list x y)))

(defun p67b6-function-value (function x y)
  (apply$ function (list x y)))

(defun-sk p67b6-field-laws-p
    (carrier add multiply negate inverse zero one)
  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and (p67b6-member-p carrier x)
          (p67b6-member-p carrier y)
          (p67b6-member-p carrier z))
     (and
      (p67b6-member-p carrier
                      (p67b6-binary add x y))
      (p67b6-member-p carrier
                      (p67b6-binary multiply x y))
      (p67b6-member-p carrier
                      (p67b6-unary negate x))
      (p67b6-member-p carrier
                      (p67b6-unary inverse x))
      (equal
       (p67b6-binary add (p67b6-binary add x y) z)
       (p67b6-binary add x (p67b6-binary add y z)))
      (equal (p67b6-binary add x y)
             (p67b6-binary add y x))
      (equal (p67b6-binary add x zero) x)
      (equal
       (p67b6-binary add x (p67b6-unary negate x))
       zero)
      (equal
       (p67b6-binary multiply
                       (p67b6-binary multiply x y) z)
       (p67b6-binary multiply
                       x (p67b6-binary multiply y z)))
      (equal (p67b6-binary multiply x y)
             (p67b6-binary multiply y x))
      (equal (p67b6-binary multiply x one) x)
      (implies
       (equal x zero)
       (equal (p67b6-unary inverse x) zero))
      (implies
       (not (equal x zero))
       (equal
        (p67b6-binary multiply
                        x (p67b6-unary inverse x))
        one))
      (equal
       (p67b6-binary multiply
                       x (p67b6-binary add y z))
       (p67b6-binary add
                       (p67b6-binary multiply x y)
                       (p67b6-binary multiply x z)))))))

(defun-sk p67b6-order-laws-p
    (carrier add multiply zero less)
  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and (p67b6-member-p carrier x)
          (p67b6-member-p carrier y)
          (p67b6-member-p carrier z))
     (and
      (not (p67b6-binary less x x))
      (or (equal x y)
          (p67b6-binary less x y)
          (p67b6-binary less y x))
      (implies
       (and (p67b6-binary less x y)
            (p67b6-binary less y z))
       (p67b6-binary less x z))
      (implies
       (p67b6-binary less x y)
       (p67b6-binary
        less
        (p67b6-binary add x z)
        (p67b6-binary add y z)))
      (implies
       (and (p67b6-binary less zero x)
            (p67b6-binary less zero y))
       (p67b6-binary
        less zero (p67b6-binary multiply x y)))))))

(defun-sk p67b6-set-nonempty-p (carrier set)
  (exists (x)
    (and (p67b6-member-p carrier x)
         (apply$ set (list x)))))

(defun-sk p67b6-upper-bound-p (carrier less set bound)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (and (p67b6-member-p carrier x)
          (apply$ set (list x)))
     (not (p67b6-binary less bound x)))))

(defun-sk p67b6-bounded-above-p (carrier less set)
  (exists (bound)
    (and (p67b6-member-p carrier bound)
         (p67b6-upper-bound-p carrier less set bound))))

(defun-sk p67b6-supremum-p (carrier less set supremum)
  (forall (bound)
    (and
     (p67b6-member-p carrier supremum)
     (p67b6-upper-bound-p carrier less set supremum)
     (implies
      (and (p67b6-member-p carrier bound)
           (p67b6-upper-bound-p carrier less set bound))
      (not (p67b6-binary less bound supremum))))))

(defun-sk p67b6-has-supremum-p (carrier less set)
  (exists (supremum)
    (p67b6-supremum-p carrier less set supremum)))

(defun-sk p67b6-dedekind-complete-p (carrier less)
  (forall (set)
    (implies
     (and (tamep-functionp set)
          (p67b6-set-nonempty-p carrier set)
          (p67b6-bounded-above-p carrier less set))
     (p67b6-has-supremum-p carrier less set))))

(defun p67b6-real-field-p
    (carrier add multiply negate inverse zero one less)
  (and
   (tamep-functionp carrier)
   (tamep-functionp add)
   (tamep-functionp multiply)
   (tamep-functionp negate)
   (tamep-functionp inverse)
   (tamep-functionp less)
   (p67b6-member-p carrier zero)
   (p67b6-member-p carrier one)
   (not (equal zero one))
   (p67b6-field-laws-p
    carrier add multiply negate inverse zero one)
   (p67b6-order-laws-p carrier add multiply zero less)
   (p67b6-binary less zero one)
   (p67b6-dedekind-complete-p carrier less)))

(defun p67b6-add (add x y)
  (p67b6-binary add x y))

(defun p67b6-negate (negate x)
  (p67b6-unary negate x))

(defun p67b6-subtract (add negate x y)
  (p67b6-add add x (p67b6-negate negate y)))

(defun p67b6-multiply (multiply x y)
  (p67b6-binary multiply x y))

(defun p67b6-square (multiply x)
  (p67b6-multiply multiply x x))

(defun p67b6-less-p (less x y)
  (if (p67b6-binary less x y) t nil))

(defun p67b6-less-equal-p (less x y)
  (not (p67b6-less-p less y x)))

(defun p67b6-absolute-value (less negate zero x)
  (if (p67b6-less-p less x zero)
      (p67b6-negate negate x)
    x))

(defun p67b6-positive-p (carrier less zero x)
  (and (p67b6-member-p carrier x)
       (p67b6-less-p less zero x)))

(defun p67b6-two (add one)
  (p67b6-add add one one))

(defun p67b6-four (add one)
  (let ((two (p67b6-two add one)))
    (p67b6-add add two two)))

(defun p67b6-eight (add one)
  (let ((four (p67b6-four add one)))
    (p67b6-add add four four)))

(defun p67b6-sixteen (add one)
  (let ((eight (p67b6-eight add one)))
    (p67b6-add add eight eight)))

(defun-sk p67b6-bivariate-real-function-p (carrier function)
  (forall (x y)
    (implies
     (and (p67b6-member-p carrier x)
          (p67b6-member-p carrier y))
     (p67b6-member-p
      carrier (p67b6-function-value function x y)))))

(defun p67b6-valid-bivariate-function-p (carrier function)
  (and (tamep-functionp function)
       (p67b6-bivariate-real-function-p carrier function)))

;; The derivative condition is
;; |f(z,y)-f(x,y)-d(z-x)| <= epsilon |z-x|
;; on a sufficiently small neighborhood. This is the standard real
;; epsilon-remainder characterization of a derivative.

(defun p67b6-x-derivative-residual
    (function add multiply negate x y derivative z)
  (p67b6-subtract
   add negate
   (p67b6-subtract
    add negate
    (p67b6-function-value function z y)
    (p67b6-function-value function x y))
   (p67b6-multiply
    multiply derivative
    (p67b6-subtract add negate z x))))

(defun p67b6-y-derivative-residual
    (function add multiply negate x y derivative z)
  (p67b6-subtract
   add negate
   (p67b6-subtract
    add negate
    (p67b6-function-value function x z)
    (p67b6-function-value function x y))
   (p67b6-multiply
    multiply derivative
    (p67b6-subtract add negate z y))))

(defun-sk p67b6-x-derivative-neighborhood-p
    (carrier function add multiply negate zero less
     x y derivative epsilon delta)
  (forall (z)
    (implies
     (and
      (p67b6-member-p carrier z)
      (p67b6-less-p
       less
       (p67b6-absolute-value
        less negate zero
        (p67b6-subtract add negate z x))
       delta))
     (p67b6-less-equal-p
      less
      (p67b6-absolute-value
       less negate zero
       (p67b6-x-derivative-residual
        function add multiply negate x y derivative z))
      (p67b6-multiply
       multiply epsilon
       (p67b6-absolute-value
        less negate zero
        (p67b6-subtract add negate z x)))))))

(defun-sk p67b6-y-derivative-neighborhood-p
    (carrier function add multiply negate zero less
     x y derivative epsilon delta)
  (forall (z)
    (implies
     (and
      (p67b6-member-p carrier z)
      (p67b6-less-p
       less
       (p67b6-absolute-value
        less negate zero
        (p67b6-subtract add negate z y))
       delta))
     (p67b6-less-equal-p
      less
      (p67b6-absolute-value
       less negate zero
       (p67b6-y-derivative-residual
        function add multiply negate x y derivative z))
      (p67b6-multiply
       multiply epsilon
       (p67b6-absolute-value
        less negate zero
        (p67b6-subtract add negate z y)))))))

(defun-sk p67b6-x-derivative-radius-exists-p
    (carrier function add multiply negate zero less
     x y derivative epsilon)
  (exists (delta)
    (and
     (p67b6-positive-p carrier less zero delta)
     (p67b6-x-derivative-neighborhood-p
      carrier function add multiply negate zero less
      x y derivative epsilon delta))))

(defun-sk p67b6-y-derivative-radius-exists-p
    (carrier function add multiply negate zero less
     x y derivative epsilon)
  (exists (delta)
    (and
     (p67b6-positive-p carrier less zero delta)
     (p67b6-y-derivative-neighborhood-p
      carrier function add multiply negate zero less
      x y derivative epsilon delta))))

(defun-sk p67b6-has-x-derivative-at-p
    (carrier function add multiply negate zero less
     x y derivative)
  (forall (epsilon)
    (implies
     (p67b6-positive-p carrier less zero epsilon)
     (p67b6-x-derivative-radius-exists-p
      carrier function add multiply negate zero less
      x y derivative epsilon))))

(defun-sk p67b6-has-y-derivative-at-p
    (carrier function add multiply negate zero less
     x y derivative)
  (forall (epsilon)
    (implies
     (p67b6-positive-p carrier less zero epsilon)
     (p67b6-y-derivative-radius-exists-p
      carrier function add multiply negate zero less
      x y derivative epsilon))))

(defun p67b6-x-derivative-p
    (carrier function add multiply negate zero less
     x y derivative)
  (and
   (p67b6-member-p carrier x)
   (p67b6-member-p carrier y)
   (p67b6-member-p carrier derivative)
   (p67b6-has-x-derivative-at-p
    carrier function add multiply negate zero less
    x y derivative)))

(defun p67b6-y-derivative-p
    (carrier function add multiply negate zero less
     x y derivative)
  (and
   (p67b6-member-p carrier x)
   (p67b6-member-p carrier y)
   (p67b6-member-p carrier derivative)
   (p67b6-has-y-derivative-at-p
    carrier function add multiply negate zero less
    x y derivative)))

(defun-sk p67b6-x-derivative-exists-at-p
    (carrier function add multiply negate zero less x y)
  (exists (derivative)
    (p67b6-x-derivative-p
     carrier function add multiply negate zero less
     x y derivative)))

(defun-sk p67b6-y-derivative-exists-at-p
    (carrier function add multiply negate zero less x y)
  (exists (derivative)
    (p67b6-y-derivative-p
     carrier function add multiply negate zero less
     x y derivative)))

(defun-sk p67b6-coordinatewise-differentiable-p
    (carrier function add multiply negate zero less)
  (forall (x y)
    (implies
     (and (p67b6-member-p carrier x)
          (p67b6-member-p carrier y))
     (and
      (p67b6-x-derivative-exists-at-p
       carrier function add multiply negate zero less x y)
      (p67b6-y-derivative-exists-at-p
       carrier function add multiply negate zero less x y)))))

(defun p67b6-radius-squared (add multiply x y)
  (p67b6-add
   add
   (p67b6-square multiply x)
   (p67b6-square multiply y)))

(defun-sk p67b6-bounded-on-unit-disk-p
    (carrier function add multiply negate zero one less)
  (forall (x y)
    (implies
     (and
      (p67b6-member-p carrier x)
      (p67b6-member-p carrier y)
      (p67b6-less-equal-p
       less (p67b6-radius-squared add multiply x y) one))
     (p67b6-less-equal-p
      less
      (p67b6-absolute-value
       less negate zero
       (p67b6-function-value function x y))
      one))))

(defun-sk p67b6-interior-small-gradient-point-p
    (carrier function add multiply negate zero one less)
  (exists (x y x-derivative y-derivative)
    (and
     (p67b6-member-p carrier x)
     (p67b6-member-p carrier y)
     (p67b6-x-derivative-p
      carrier function add multiply negate zero less
      x y x-derivative)
     (p67b6-y-derivative-p
      carrier function add multiply negate zero less
      x y y-derivative)
     (p67b6-less-p
      less (p67b6-radius-squared add multiply x y) one)
     (p67b6-less-equal-p
      less
      (p67b6-add
       add
       (p67b6-square multiply x-derivative)
       (p67b6-square multiply y-derivative))
      (p67b6-sixteen add one)))))

(defun putnambench-putnam-1967-b6-statement
    (carrier add multiply negate inverse zero one less function)
  (implies
   (and
    (p67b6-real-field-p
     carrier add multiply negate inverse zero one less)
    (p67b6-valid-bivariate-function-p carrier function)
    (p67b6-coordinatewise-differentiable-p
     carrier function add multiply negate zero less)
    (p67b6-bounded-on-unit-disk-p
     carrier function add multiply negate zero one less))
   (p67b6-interior-small-gradient-point-p
    carrier function add multiply negate zero one less)))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

title: putnam_1967_b6
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1967_b6:
-- a real function whose partial derivatives exist at every interior disk point
-- and whose absolute value is at most one on the closed unit disk has an
-- interior point where the sum of the squared partial derivatives is at most
-- sixteen. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module Putnam1967B6 where

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; _*_)

infix 4 _!=_
infixr 3 _and_
infixr 2 _or_

data Bottom : Set where

Not : Set -> Set
Not A =
  A -> Bottom

_!=_ : {A : Set} -> A -> A -> Set
x != y =
  Not (x == y)

record _and_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data _or_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  left  : A -> A or B
  right : B -> A or B

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

record CompleteOrderedField (R : Set) : Set1 where
  field
    zeroR oneR : R
    add multiply : R -> R -> R
    negate inverse : R -> R
    lessOrEqual : R -> R -> Set
    fromNat : Nat -> R

    one-not-zero :
      oneR != zeroR

    add-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> add x y == add y x
    add-associative :
      (x y z : R) -> add (add x y) z == add x (add y z)
    add-zero :
      (x : R) -> add x zeroR == x
    add-inverse :
      (x : R) -> add x (negate x) == zeroR

    multiply-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> multiply x y == multiply y x
    multiply-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply (multiply x y) z == multiply x (multiply y z)
    multiply-one :
      (x : R) -> multiply x oneR == x
    multiply-zero :
      (x : R) -> multiply x zeroR == zeroR
    distribute :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply x (add y z) ==
      add (multiply x y) (multiply x z)
    inverse-zero :
      inverse zeroR == zeroR
    multiply-inverse :
      (x : R) ->
      x != zeroR ->
      multiply x (inverse x) == oneR

    order-reflexive :
      (x : R) -> lessOrEqual x x
    order-transitive :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y z ->
      lessOrEqual x z
    order-antisymmetric :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y x ->
      x == y
    order-total :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y or lessOrEqual y x
    add-order :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual (add z x) (add z y)
    multiply-nonnegative :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR x ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR y ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR (multiply x y)
    zero-less-than-one :
      lessOrEqual zeroR oneR and zeroR != oneR

    fromNat-zero :
      fromNat zero == zeroR
    fromNat-successor :
      (n : Nat) -> fromNat (suc n) == add (fromNat n) oneR
    fromNat-addition :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m + n) == add (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-multiplication :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m * n) == multiply (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-injective :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat m == fromNat n ->
      m == n

    archimedean :
      (x : R) ->
      Exists Nat (\ n -> lessOrEqual x (fromNat n))
    least-upper-bound :
      (P : R -> Set) ->
      Exists R P ->
      Exists R
        (\ upper ->
          (x : R) ->
          P x ->
          lessOrEqual x upper) ->
      Exists R
        (\ supremum ->
          ((x : R) ->
            P x ->
            lessOrEqual x supremum)
          and
          ((upper : R) ->
            ((x : R) ->
              P x ->
              lessOrEqual x upper) ->
            lessOrEqual supremum upper))

open CompleteOrderedField

subtract :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
subtract reals x y =
  add reals x (negate reals y)

divide :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
divide reals x y =
  multiply reals x (inverse reals y)

square :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  R
square reals x =
  multiply reals x x

StrictLess :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
StrictLess reals x y =
  lessOrEqual reals x y and x != y

CloseTo :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
CloseTo reals center radius x =
  StrictLess reals (subtract reals center radius) x
  and
  StrictLess reals x (add reals center radius)

differenceQuotient :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  (R -> R) ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
differenceQuotient reals function point x =
  divide reals
    (subtract reals (function x) (function point))
    (subtract reals x point)

DerivativeAt :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  (R -> R) ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
DerivativeAt {R} reals function point derivative =
  (epsilon : R) ->
  StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) epsilon ->
  Exists R
    (\ delta ->
      StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) delta
      and
      ((x : R) ->
        CloseTo reals point delta x ->
        x != point ->
        CloseTo reals derivative epsilon
          (differenceQuotient reals function point x)))

Differentiable :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  (R -> R) ->
  Set
Differentiable {R} reals function =
  (point : R) ->
  Exists R (DerivativeAt reals function point)

PartiallyDifferentiableOn :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  (R -> R -> R) ->
  (R -> R -> Set) ->
  Set
PartiallyDifferentiableOn {R} reals f domain =
  ((x y : R) ->
    domain x y ->
    Exists R (DerivativeAt reals (\ t -> f t y) x))
  and
  ((x y : R) ->
    domain x y ->
    Exists R (DerivativeAt reals (f x) y))

UnitDisk :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
UnitDisk reals x y =
  lessOrEqual reals
    (add reals (square reals x) (square reals y))
    (oneR reals)

InteriorUnitDisk :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
InteriorUnitDisk reals x y =
  StrictLess reals
    (add reals (square reals x) (square reals y))
    (oneR reals)

BoundedByOne :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  Set
BoundedByOne reals value =
  lessOrEqual reals (negate reals (oneR reals)) value
  and
  lessOrEqual reals value (oneR reals)

fourN : Nat
fourN =
  suc (suc (suc (suc zero)))

eightN : Nat
eightN =
  fourN + fourN

sixteenN : Nat
sixteenN =
  eightN + eightN

module Putnam1967B6Statement
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) where

  GradientBoundAt :
    (R -> R -> R) ->
    R ->
    R ->
    Set
  GradientBoundAt f x y =
    Exists R
      (\ partialX ->
        Exists R
          (\ partialY ->
            DerivativeAt reals
              (\ t -> f t y)
              x
              partialX
            and
            DerivativeAt reals
              (f x)
              y
              partialY
            and
            lessOrEqual reals
              (add reals
                (square reals partialX)
                (square reals partialY))
              (fromNat reals sixteenN)))

  proposition : Set
  proposition =
    (f : R -> R -> R) ->
    PartiallyDifferentiableOn reals f
      (InteriorUnitDisk reals) ->
    ((x y : R) ->
      UnitDisk reals x y ->
      BoundedByOne reals (f x y)) ->
    Exists R
      (\ x0 ->
        Exists R
          (\ y0 ->
            InteriorUnitDisk reals x0 y0
            and
            GradientBoundAt f x0 y0))

putnam-1967-b6 : Set1
putnam-1967-b6 =
  (R : Set) ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) ->
  Putnam1967B6Statement.proposition reals

title: putnam_1967_b6
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench artifact putnam_1967_b6:
  a bounded real function on the closed unit disk with both partial
  derivatives everywhere has an interior point where the sum of their
  squares is at most sixteen. This file contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open realTheory limTheory;

val putnam_1967_b6 =
  ``!f : real -> real -> real.
      (!x y : real.
         higher_differentiable 1 (\t : real. f t y) x /\
         higher_differentiable 1 (\t : real. f x t) y) /\
      (!x y : real.
         x pow 2 + y pow 2 <= 1
         ==>
         abs (f x y) <= 1)
      ==>
      ?x0 y0 : real.
        x0 pow 2 + y0 pow 2 < 1 /\
        (diffn 1 (\x : real. f x y0) x0) pow 2 +
          (diffn 1 (\y : real. f x0 y) y0) pow 2 <= 16``;

title: putnam_1967_b6
content:
$(
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact
  putnam_1967_b6: a bounded real function with both partial derivatives in
  the open unit disk has an interior point where the sum of the squared
  partial derivatives is at most 16. This file contains no proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  F is an arbitrary curried total function from RR x RR to RR. The first
  antecedent requires both coordinate slices to be differentiable at each
  point of the open unit disk. The second is the source bound on the closed
  unit disk. The conclusion keeps both point coordinates existential and
  evaluates the native set.mm real derivative on the corresponding slices.

  The final declaration is the single unproved $a corpus statement; this
  database contains no $p proof statement.
$)

${
  $d F t x y $.

  putnambench-putnam-1967-b6 $a |-
    A. F e. ( ( RR ^m RR ) ^m RR )
      (
        (
          (
            A. x e. RR A. y e. RR
              (
                ( ( x ^ 2 ) + ( y ^ 2 ) ) < 1
                ->
                (
                  x e.
                    dom
                      (
                        RR _D
                          ( t e. RR |-> ( ( F ` t ) ` y ) )
                      )
                  /\
                  y e.
                    dom
                      (
                        RR _D
                          ( t e. RR |-> ( ( F ` x ) ` t ) )
                      )
                )
              )
          )
          /\
          A. x e. RR A. y e. RR
            (
              ( ( x ^ 2 ) + ( y ^ 2 ) ) <_ 1
              ->
              ( abs ` ( ( F ` x ) ` y ) ) <_ 1
            )
        )
        ->
        E. x e. RR E. y e. RR
          (
            ( ( x ^ 2 ) + ( y ^ 2 ) ) < 1
            /\
            (
              (
                (
                  (
                    RR _D
                      ( t e. RR |-> ( ( F ` t ) ` y ) )
                  )
                  ` x
                )
                ^ 2
              )
              +
              (
                (
                  (
                    RR _D
                      ( t e. RR |-> ( ( F ` x ) ` t ) )
                  )
                  ` y
                )
                ^ 2
              )
            )
            <_
            ( 8 + 8 )
          )
      )
  $.
$}

content:

:: a real function whose horizontal and vertical sections are differentiable
:: everywhere and which is bounded by one on the closed unit disk has an

environ

    ORDINAL1, SQUARE_1;
  requirements REAL, NUMERALS, SUBSET, BOOLE, ARITHM;
  definitions TARSKI;
  equalities XCMPLX_0, SQUARE_1;
  expansions TARSKI;
  theorems TARSKI, NAT_1, SEQ_1, SEQ_2, SEQ_4, PARTFUN2, RFUNCT_2,
    RCOMP_1, FCONT_1, FDIFF_1, ZFMISC_1, FUNCT_1, XREAL_0, XBOOLE_0,
    XBOOLE_1, XCMPLX_1, FUNCOP_1, XREAL_1, XXREAL_0, VALUED_1,
    XXREAL_2, XXREAL_1, FUNCT_2, VALUED_0, ORDINAL1, COMPLEX1;
  schemes SEQ_1;

begin

::$P-
theorem
  for f being Function of [:REAL,REAL:],REAL st
    (for y being Real holds
      ex fx being Function of REAL,REAL st
        (for t being Real holds fx.t = f.([t,y])) &
        fx is_differentiable_on [#]REAL) &
    (for x being Real holds
      ex fy being Function of REAL,REAL st
        (for t being Real holds fy.t = f.([x,t])) &
        fy is_differentiable_on [#]REAL) &
    (for x,y being Real st x^2 + y^2 <= 1 holds

  holds
    ex x0,y0 being Real,
       fx,fy being Function of REAL,REAL st
      x0^2 + y0^2 < 1 &
      (for x being Real holds fx.x = f.([x,y0])) &
      (for y being Real holds fy.y = f.([x0,y])) &
      (diff(fx,x0))^2 + (diff(fy,y0))^2 <= 16
proof
end;

title: putnam_1967_b6
content:
% Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench artifact putnam_1967_b6:
% a bounded real function on the closed unit disk with both partial
% derivatives in its interior has an interior point where their squared sum
% is at most 16.
% This file contains no proof.

putnam_1967_b6: THEORY
BEGIN
  real_function: TYPE = [real -> real]
  bivariate_function: TYPE = [real, real -> real]

  has_derivative_at(
      f: real_function,
      derivative, x: real): bool =
    FORALL (epsilon_value: real):

                    < epsilon_value * abs(h)

    EXISTS (derivative: real):
      has_derivative_at(f, derivative, x)

  partial_y(f: bivariate_function, x, y: real): real =

    FORALL (x, y: real):

;; Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench artifact putnam_1968_a1:
;; the identity equating 22/7 minus pi with the integral on [0,1] of
;; x^4(1-x)^4/(1+x^2). This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

;; These exact rational prefixes converge to pi by Machin's identity
;; pi = 16*arctan(1/5) - 4*arctan(1/239).
(defun putnam-1968-a1-arctan-prefix (z terms)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix terms)))
  (if (zp terms)
      0
    (let* ((index (- terms 1))
           (sign (if (equal (mod index 2) 0) 1 -1))
           (exponent (+ (* 2 index) 1)))
      (+ (putnam-1968-a1-arctan-prefix z index)
         (/ (* sign (expt z exponent))
            exponent)))))

(defun putnam-1968-a1-pi-prefix (terms)
  (- (* 16
        (putnam-1968-a1-arctan-prefix (/ 1 5) terms))
     (* 4
        (putnam-1968-a1-arctan-prefix (/ 1 239) terms))))

(defun putnam-1968-a1-integrand (x)
  (/ (* (expt x 4)
        (expt (- 1 x) 4))
     (+ 1 (expt x 2))))

;; The sum at SUBDIVISIONS is the right Riemann sum on the uniform partition
;; of [0,1]. Its values are exact rationals and its real limit is the source
;; integral.
(defun putnam-1968-a1-riemann-sum-aux (index subdivisions)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix index)))
  (if (zp index)
      0
    (+ (putnam-1968-a1-integrand
        (/ index subdivisions))
       (putnam-1968-a1-riemann-sum-aux
        (- index 1)
        subdivisions))))

(defun putnam-1968-a1-riemann-sum (subdivisions)
  (if (and (natp subdivisions)
           (< 0 subdivisions))
      (/ (putnam-1968-a1-riemann-sum-aux
          subdivisions
          subdivisions)
         subdivisions)
    0))

;; For epsilon = p/q > 0, 40q controls both approximation errors. The
;; alternating-series error of the pi prefix is below 1/(4q), while the
;; integrand is 10-Lipschitz on [0,1], so the Riemann-sum error is at most
;; 5/(40q). Thus using this fixed modulus is equivalent to equality of the
;; two represented real limits, rather than a bounded approximation.
(defun putnam-1968-a1-cutoff (epsilon)
  (if (and (rationalp epsilon)
           (< 0 epsilon))
      (* 40 (denominator epsilon))
    0))

(defun putnambench-putnam-1968-a1-statement
    (epsilon pi-terms subdivisions)
  (implies
   (and (rationalp epsilon)
        (< 0 epsilon)
        (natp pi-terms)
        (<= (putnam-1968-a1-cutoff epsilon)
            pi-terms)
        (natp subdivisions)
        (<= (putnam-1968-a1-cutoff epsilon)
            subdivisions))
   (< (abs
       (- (- (/ 22 7)
             (putnam-1968-a1-pi-prefix pi-terms))
          (putnam-1968-a1-riemann-sum subdivisions)))
      epsilon)))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

-- Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1968_a1:
-- the difference 22 / 7 - pi equals the integral from zero to one of
-- x^4 * (1 - x)^4 / (1 + x^2). This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; _*_)

infix 4 _!=_ _<=N_
infixr 3 _and_
infixr 2 _or_

data Bottom : Set where

Not : Set -> Set
Not A =
  A -> Bottom

_!=_ : {A : Set} -> A -> A -> Set
x != y =
  Not (x == y)

record _and_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data _or_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  left  : A -> A or B
  right : B -> A or B

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

data _<=N_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set where
  zero<=   : {n : Nat} -> zero <=N n
  suc<=suc : {m n : Nat} -> m <=N n -> suc m <=N suc n

record CompleteOrderedField (R : Set) : Set1 where
  field
    zeroR oneR : R
    add multiply : R -> R -> R
    negate inverse : R -> R
    lessOrEqual : R -> R -> Set
    fromNat : Nat -> R

    one-not-zero :
      oneR != zeroR

    add-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> add x y == add y x
    add-associative :
      (x y z : R) -> add (add x y) z == add x (add y z)
    add-zero :
      (x : R) -> add x zeroR == x
    add-inverse :
      (x : R) -> add x (negate x) == zeroR

    multiply-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> multiply x y == multiply y x
    multiply-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply (multiply x y) z == multiply x (multiply y z)
    multiply-one :
      (x : R) -> multiply x oneR == x
    multiply-zero :
      (x : R) -> multiply x zeroR == zeroR
    distribute :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply x (add y z) ==
      add (multiply x y) (multiply x z)
    inverse-zero :
      inverse zeroR == zeroR
    multiply-inverse :
      (x : R) ->
      x != zeroR ->
      multiply x (inverse x) == oneR

    order-reflexive :
      (x : R) -> lessOrEqual x x
    order-transitive :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y z ->
      lessOrEqual x z
    order-antisymmetric :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y x ->
      x == y
    order-total :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y or lessOrEqual y x
    add-order :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual (add z x) (add z y)
    multiply-nonnegative :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR x ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR y ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR (multiply x y)
    zero-less-than-one :
      lessOrEqual zeroR oneR and zeroR != oneR

    fromNat-zero :
      fromNat zero == zeroR
    fromNat-successor :
      (n : Nat) -> fromNat (suc n) == add (fromNat n) oneR
    fromNat-addition :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m + n) == add (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-multiplication :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m * n) == multiply (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-injective :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat m == fromNat n ->
      m == n

    archimedean :
      (x : R) ->
      Exists Nat (\ n -> lessOrEqual x (fromNat n))
    least-upper-bound :
      (P : R -> Set) ->
      Exists R P ->
      Exists R
        (\ upper ->
          (x : R) ->
          P x ->
          lessOrEqual x upper) ->
      Exists R
        (\ supremum ->
          ((x : R) -> P x -> lessOrEqual x supremum)
          and
          ((upper : R) ->
            ((x : R) -> P x -> lessOrEqual x upper) ->
            lessOrEqual supremum upper))

open CompleteOrderedField

subtract :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
subtract reals x y =
  add reals x (negate reals y)

divide :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
divide reals x y =
  multiply reals x (inverse reals y)

naturalPower :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  Nat ->
  R
naturalPower reals x zero =
  oneR reals
naturalPower reals x (suc n) =
  multiply reals (naturalPower reals x n) x

StrictLess :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
StrictLess reals x y =
  lessOrEqual reals x y and x != y

CloseTo :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
CloseTo reals center radius x =
  StrictLess reals
    (subtract reals center radius)
    x
  and
  StrictLess reals
    x
    (add reals center radius)

SequentialLimit :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  R ->
  Set
SequentialLimit {R} reals sequence limit =
  (epsilon : R) ->
  StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) epsilon ->
  Exists Nat
    (\ cutoff ->
      (n : Nat) ->
      cutoff <=N n ->
      CloseTo reals limit epsilon (sequence n))

sumFirst :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  Nat ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  R
sumFirst reals zero terms =
  zeroR reals
sumFirst reals (suc n) terms =
  add reals
    (sumFirst reals n terms)
    (terms n)

alternatingUnit :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  Nat ->
  R
alternatingUnit reals zero =
  oneR reals
alternatingUnit reals (suc n) =
  negate reals (alternatingUnit reals n)

oddNatural : Nat -> Nat
oddNatural n =
  suc (n + n)

leibnizTerm :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  Nat ->
  R
leibnizTerm reals n =
  divide reals
    (alternatingUnit reals n)
    (fromNat reals (oddNatural n))

piApproximation :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  Nat ->
  R
piApproximation reals n =
  multiply reals
    (fromNat reals 4)
    (sumFirst reals (suc n) (leibnizTerm reals))

record StandardRealAnalysis (R : Set) : Set1 where
  field
    algebra : CompleteOrderedField R
    pi : R
    pi-leibniz-limit :
      SequentialLimit algebra
        (piApproximation algebra)
        pi

open StandardRealAnalysis

riemannStep :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Nat ->
  R
riemannStep reals lower upper pieces =
  divide reals
    (subtract reals upper lower)
    (fromNat reals pieces)

rightRiemannSum :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  (R -> R) ->
  Nat ->
  R
rightRiemannSum reals lower upper function pieces =
  let
    step = riemannStep reals lower upper pieces
  in
  sumFirst reals pieces
    (\ i ->
      multiply reals
        (function
          (add reals lower
            (multiply reals
              (fromNat reals (suc i))
              step)))
        step)

IntervalIntegralValue :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  (R -> R) ->
  R ->
  Set
IntervalIntegralValue reals lower upper function value =
  SequentialLimit reals
    (\ n ->
      rightRiemannSum reals lower upper function (suc n))
    value

putnamIntegrand :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  R
putnamIntegrand reals x =
  divide reals
    (multiply reals
      (naturalPower reals x 4)
      (naturalPower reals
        (subtract reals (oneR reals) x)
        4))
    (add reals
      (oneR reals)
      (naturalPower reals x 2))

module Putnam1968A1Statement
  {R : Set}
  (analysis : StandardRealAnalysis R) where

  reals : CompleteOrderedField R
  reals =
    algebra analysis

  proposition : Set
  proposition =
    IntervalIntegralValue reals
      (zeroR reals)
      (oneR reals)
      (putnamIntegrand reals)
      (subtract reals
        (divide reals
          (fromNat reals 22)
          (fromNat reals 7))
        (pi analysis))

putnam-1968-a1 : Set1
putnam-1968-a1 =
  (R : Set) ->
  (analysis : StandardRealAnalysis R) ->
  Putnam1968A1Statement.proposition analysis

% Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench artifact putnam_1968_a1:
% the difference 22/7 - pi equals the unit-interval integral of
% x^4(1 - x)^4/(1 + x^2). This file contains no proof.

putnam_1968_a1: THEORY
BEGIN
  real_function: TYPE = [real -> real]
  real_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> real]

  alternating_sign(index: nat): RECURSIVE real =
    IF index = 0 THEN
      1
    ELSE
      -alternating_sign(index - 1)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE index

  leibniz_partial_sum(count: nat): RECURSIVE real =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      LET index: nat = count - 1 IN
        leibniz_partial_sum(count - 1)
          + alternating_sign(index)
              / ((2 * index + 1) :: real)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  converges_to(sequence: real_sequence, value: real): bool =
    FORALL (epsilon_value: posreal):
      EXISTS (cutoff: nat):
        FORALL (index: nat):
          cutoff <= index IMPLIES
            abs(sequence(index) - value) < epsilon_value

  is_pi(value: real): bool =
    converges_to(
      LAMBDA (count: nat):
        4 * leibniz_partial_sum(count),
      value)

  pi: real =
    epsilon(
      LAMBDA (value: real):
        is_pi(value))

  valid_partition(
      points: real_sequence,
      count: nat): bool =
    count > 0
      AND points(0) = 0
      AND points(count) = 1
      AND FORALL (index: nat):
        index < count IMPLIES
          points(index) < points(index + 1)

  valid_tags(
      points, tags: real_sequence,
      count: nat): bool =
    FORALL (index: nat):
      index < count IMPLIES
        points(index) <= tags(index)
          AND tags(index) <= points(index + 1)

  mesh_less_than(
      points: real_sequence,
      count: nat,
      bound: real): bool =
    FORALL (index: nat):
      index < count IMPLIES
        points(index + 1) - points(index) < bound

  riemann_sum(
      f: real_function,
      points, tags: real_sequence,
      count: nat): RECURSIVE real =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      riemann_sum(f, points, tags, count - 1)
        + f(tags(count - 1))
            * (points(count) - points(count - 1))
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  has_unit_interval_integral(
      f: real_function,
      integral_value: real): bool =
    FORALL (epsilon_value: posreal):
      EXISTS (mesh_bound: posreal):
        FORALL
            (points, tags: real_sequence),
            (count: nat):
          (valid_partition(points, count)
            AND valid_tags(points, tags, count)
            AND mesh_less_than(
              points, count, mesh_bound))
          IMPLIES
            abs(
              riemann_sum(f, points, tags, count)
                - integral_value)
              < epsilon_value

  unit_interval_integral(f: real_function): real =
    IF EXISTS (integral_value: real):
        has_unit_interval_integral(f, integral_value)
    THEN
      epsilon(
        LAMBDA (integral_value: real):
          has_unit_interval_integral(
            f, integral_value))
    ELSE
      0
    ENDIF

  safe_div(numerator, denominator: real): real =
    IF denominator = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      numerator / denominator
    ENDIF

  integrand(x: real): real =
    safe_div(
      x ^ 4 * (1 - x) ^ 4,
      1 + x ^ 2)

  putnam_1968_a1: bool =
    22 / 7 - pi = unit_interval_integral(integrand)
END putnam_1968_a1

;; Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact
;; putnam_1968_a2: simultaneous nonzero rational approximation of two
;; integer linear forms with nonzero determinant. This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

;; Positive rational tolerances are cofinal in the positive reals. Therefore
;; universal closure over the tolerances below is equivalent to the source's
;; universal closure over positive real epsilon.
;;
;; DEFUN-SK keeps the two unrestricted rational witnesses internal to the
;; statement instead of replacing them by a proof-derived finite search.

(defun putnam-1968-a2-witness-p
    (r s a b c d e f epsilon)
  (let ((first-error
         (abs (- (+ (* r a) (* s b)) e)))
        (second-error
         (abs (- (+ (* r c) (* s d)) f))))
    (and (rationalp r)
         (rationalp s)
         (< 0 first-error)
         (< first-error epsilon)
         (< 0 second-error)
         (< second-error epsilon))))

(defun-sk putnam-1968-a2-witness-exists-p
    (a b c d e f epsilon)
  (exists (r s)
    (putnam-1968-a2-witness-p
     r s a b c d e f epsilon)))

(defun putnambench-putnam-1968-a2-statement
    (a b c d e f epsilon)
  (implies
   (and (integerp a)
        (integerp b)
        (integerp c)
        (integerp d)
        (integerp e)
        (integerp f)
        (not (equal (* a d) (* b c)))
        (rationalp epsilon)
        (< 0 epsilon))
   (putnam-1968-a2-witness-exists-p
    a b c d e f epsilon)))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

title: putnam_1968_a2
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1968_a2:
-- rational coefficients make two integer affine expressions nonzero and
-- arbitrarily small when the associated determinant is nonzero. This file
-- contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Int using (Int; pos; negsuc)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; _*_)

infix 4 _!=_
infixr 3 _and_
infixr 2 _or_

data Bottom : Set where

Not : Set -> Set
Not A = A -> Bottom

_!=_ : {A : Set} -> A -> A -> Set
x != y = Not (x == y)

record _and_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data _or_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  left  : A -> A or B
  right : B -> A or B

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

pred : Nat -> Nat
pred zero = zero
pred (suc n) = n

negative : Nat -> Int
negative zero = pos zero
negative (suc n) = negsuc n

negateInt : Int -> Int
negateInt (pos n) = negative n
negateInt (negsuc n) = pos (suc n)

difference : Nat -> Nat -> Int
difference zero zero = pos zero
difference (suc m) zero = pos (suc m)
difference zero (suc n) = negsuc n
difference (suc m) (suc n) = difference m n

addInt : Int -> Int -> Int
addInt (pos m) (pos n) = pos (m + n)
addInt (pos m) (negsuc n) = difference m (suc n)
addInt (negsuc m) (pos n) = difference n (suc m)
addInt (negsuc m) (negsuc n) = negsuc (suc (m + n))

multiplyInt : Int -> Int -> Int
multiplyInt (pos m) (pos n) = pos (m * n)
multiplyInt (pos m) (negsuc n) = negative (m * suc n)
multiplyInt (negsuc m) (pos n) = negative (suc m * n)
multiplyInt (negsuc m) (negsuc n) = pos (suc m * suc n)

absoluteInt : Int -> Int
absoluteInt (pos n) = pos n
absoluteInt (negsuc n) = pos (suc n)

scaleInt : Int -> Nat -> Int
scaleInt z n = multiplyInt z (pos n)

record Rational : Set where
  constructor fraction
  field
    numerator             : Int
    denominator-minus-one : Nat

open Rational

denominator : Rational -> Nat
denominator q = suc (denominator-minus-one q)

zeroQ : Rational
zeroQ = fraction (pos zero) zero

rationalFromInt : Int -> Rational
rationalFromInt z = fraction z zero

negateQ : Rational -> Rational
negateQ q =
  fraction
    (negateInt (numerator q))
    (denominator-minus-one q)

addQ : Rational -> Rational -> Rational
addQ x y =
  fraction
    (addInt
      (scaleInt (numerator x) (denominator y))
      (scaleInt (numerator y) (denominator x)))
    (pred (denominator x * denominator y))

subtractQ : Rational -> Rational -> Rational
subtractQ x y = addQ x (negateQ y)

multiplyQ : Rational -> Rational -> Rational
multiplyQ x y =
  fraction
    (multiplyInt (numerator x) (numerator y))
    (pred (denominator x * denominator y))

absoluteQ : Rational -> Rational
absoluteQ q =
  fraction
    (absoluteInt (numerator q))
    (denominator-minus-one q)

record CompleteOrderedField (R : Set) : Set1 where
  field
    zeroR oneR : R
    addR multiplyR : R -> R -> R
    negateR inverseR : R -> R
    lessOrEqualR : R -> R -> Set
    fromNatR : Nat -> R

    one-not-zero :
      oneR != zeroR

    add-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> addR x y == addR y x
    add-associative :
      (x y z : R) -> addR (addR x y) z == addR x (addR y z)
    add-zero :
      (x : R) -> addR x zeroR == x
    add-inverse :
      (x : R) -> addR x (negateR x) == zeroR

    multiply-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> multiplyR x y == multiplyR y x
    multiply-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiplyR (multiplyR x y) z == multiplyR x (multiplyR y z)
    multiply-one :
      (x : R) -> multiplyR x oneR == x
    multiply-zero :
      (x : R) -> multiplyR x zeroR == zeroR
    distribute :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiplyR x (addR y z) ==
      addR (multiplyR x y) (multiplyR x z)
    inverse-zero :
      inverseR zeroR == zeroR
    multiply-inverse :
      (x : R) ->
      x != zeroR ->
      multiplyR x (inverseR x) == oneR

    order-reflexive :
      (x : R) -> lessOrEqualR x x
    order-transitive :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR x y ->
      lessOrEqualR y z ->
      lessOrEqualR x z
    order-antisymmetric :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR x y ->
      lessOrEqualR y x ->
      x == y
    order-total :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR x y or lessOrEqualR y x
    add-order :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR x y ->
      lessOrEqualR (addR z x) (addR z y)
    multiply-nonnegative :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR zeroR x ->
      lessOrEqualR zeroR y ->
      lessOrEqualR zeroR (multiplyR x y)
    zero-less-than-one :
      lessOrEqualR zeroR oneR and zeroR != oneR

    fromNat-zero :
      fromNatR zero == zeroR
    fromNat-successor :
      (n : Nat) -> fromNatR (suc n) == addR (fromNatR n) oneR
    fromNat-addition :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNatR (m + n) == addR (fromNatR m) (fromNatR n)
    fromNat-multiplication :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNatR (m * n) == multiplyR (fromNatR m) (fromNatR n)
    fromNat-injective :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNatR m == fromNatR n ->
      m == n

    archimedean :
      (x : R) ->
      Exists Nat (\ n -> lessOrEqualR x (fromNatR n))
    least-upper-bound :
      (P : R -> Set) ->
      Exists R P ->
      Exists R
        (\ upper ->
          (x : R) ->
          P x ->
          lessOrEqualR x upper) ->
      Exists R
        (\ supremum ->
          ((x : R) -> P x -> lessOrEqualR x supremum)
          and
          ((upper : R) ->
            ((x : R) -> P x -> lessOrEqualR x upper) ->
            lessOrEqualR supremum upper))

open CompleteOrderedField

subtractR :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
subtractR reals x y =
  addR reals x (negateR reals y)

divideR :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
divideR reals x y =
  multiplyR reals x (inverseR reals y)

StrictLess :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
StrictLess reals x y =
  lessOrEqualR reals x y and x != y

fromIntR :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  Int ->
  R
fromIntR reals (pos n) =
  fromNatR reals n
fromIntR reals (negsuc n) =
  negateR reals (fromNatR reals (suc n))

fromRationalR :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  Rational ->
  R
fromRationalR reals q =
  divideR reals
    (fromIntR reals (numerator q))
    (fromNatR reals (denominator q))

affineError :
  Rational ->
  Rational ->
  Int ->
  Int ->
  Int ->
  Rational
affineError r s x y target =
  subtractQ
    (addQ
      (multiplyQ r (rationalFromInt x))
      (multiplyQ s (rationalFromInt y)))
    (rationalFromInt target)

AbsoluteErrorBetweenZeroAnd :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  Rational ->
  Rational ->
  Int ->
  Int ->
  Int ->
  R ->
  Set
AbsoluteErrorBetweenZeroAnd reals r s x y target epsilon =
  let
    error =
      fromRationalR reals
        (absoluteQ (affineError r s x y target))
  in
  StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) error
  and
  StrictLess reals error epsilon

module Putnam1968A2Statement
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) where

  proposition : Set
  proposition =
    (a b c d e f : Int) ->
    (epsilon : R) ->
    multiplyInt a d != multiplyInt b c ->
    StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) epsilon ->
    Exists Rational
      (\ r ->
        Exists Rational
          (\ s ->
            AbsoluteErrorBetweenZeroAnd
              reals r s a b e epsilon
            and
            AbsoluteErrorBetweenZeroAnd
              reals r s c d f epsilon))

putnam-1968-a2 : Set1
putnam-1968-a2 =
  (R : Set) ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) ->
  Putnam1968A2Statement.proposition reals

import Mathlib

open Finset symmDiff

/--
Let $S$ be a finite set. Prove that there exists a list of subsets of $S$ such that
\begin{enumerate}
\item The first element of the list is the empty set,
\item Each subset of $S$ occurs exactly once in the list, and
\item Each successive element in the list is formed by adding or removing one element from the previous subset in the list.
\end{enumerate}
-/
theorem putnam_1968_a3
    (α : Type*) [Finite α] :
    ∃ (n : ℕ) (s : Fin (2 ^ n) → Set α),
      s 0 = ∅ ∧
      (∀ t, ∃! i, s i = t) ∧
      (∀ i, i.1 + 1 < 2 ^ n → (s i ∆ s (i + 1)).ncard = 1) :=
  sorry

content:
;; Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench artifact putnam_1968_a3:
;; existence of a Gray-code ordering of all subsets of an arbitrary finite
;; set, beginning with the empty set. This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

;; A finite set of cardinality N is identified with its positions
;; 0,...,N-1. Its subsets are exactly the N-bit naturals below 2^N. A list
;; of all subsets is encoded by the base-2^N digits of SEQUENCE-CODE. This
;; representation is invariant under a bijection of finite carriers, so it
;; preserves arbitrary finite sets rather than selecting a particular one.

(defun putnam-1968-a3-sequence-entry
    (sequence-code index radix)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix index)))
  (if (zp index)
      (mod sequence-code radix)
    (putnam-1968-a3-sequence-entry
     (floor sequence-code radix)
     (- index 1)
     radix)))

(defun putnam-1968-a3-occurrence-count
    (subset-code sequence-code positions radix)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix positions)))
  (if (zp positions)
      0
    (let ((index (- positions 1)))
      (+
       (if (equal
            (putnam-1968-a3-sequence-entry
             sequence-code index radix)
            subset-code)
           1
         0)
       (putnam-1968-a3-occurrence-count
        subset-code sequence-code index radix)))))

(defun putnam-1968-a3-every-subset-once-p
    (subset-count sequence-code positions radix)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix subset-count)))
  (if (zp subset-count)
      t
    (let ((subset-code (- subset-count 1)))
      (and
       (equal
        (putnam-1968-a3-occurrence-count
         subset-code sequence-code positions radix)
        1)
       (putnam-1968-a3-every-subset-once-p
        subset-code sequence-code positions radix)))))

(defun putnam-1968-a3-bit-difference-count
    (left right bits)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix bits)))
  (if (zp bits)
      0
    (+
     (if (equal (mod left 2) (mod right 2))
         0
       1)
     (putnam-1968-a3-bit-difference-count
      (floor left 2)
      (floor right 2)
      (- bits 1)))))

(defun putnam-1968-a3-adjacent-p
    (sequence-code adjacency-count radix bits)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix adjacency-count)))
  (if (zp adjacency-count)
      t
    (let ((index (- adjacency-count 1)))
      (and
       (equal
        (putnam-1968-a3-bit-difference-count
         (putnam-1968-a3-sequence-entry
          sequence-code index radix)
         (putnam-1968-a3-sequence-entry
          sequence-code (+ index 1) radix)
         bits)
        1)
       (putnam-1968-a3-adjacent-p
        sequence-code index radix bits)))))

(defun putnam-1968-a3-valid-sequence-code-p
    (sequence-code radix bits)
  (and
   (equal
    (putnam-1968-a3-sequence-entry
     sequence-code 0 radix)
    0)
   (putnam-1968-a3-every-subset-once-p
    radix sequence-code radix radix)
   (putnam-1968-a3-adjacent-p
    sequence-code (- radix 1) radix bits)))

;; This exhaustive finite search is the source statement's internal
;; existential quantifier over lists. It ranges over every list of length

-- Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench artifact
-- putnambench__agda__putnam_1968_a3: every finite type has an ordering of
-- all its subsets that starts with the empty subset and changes exactly one
-- element between consecutive subsets. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

open import Agda.Primitive using (Level; lsuc) renaming (_⊔_ to _lmax_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Bool using (Bool; false; true)
open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc)

data Bottom {a : Level} : Set a where

Not : {a : Level} -> Set a -> Set a
Not {a} proposition = proposition -> Bottom {a}

data Fin : Nat -> Set where
  fzero : {n : Nat} -> Fin (suc n)
  fsuc : {n : Nat} -> Fin n -> Fin (suc n)

weaken :
  {n : Nat} ->
  Fin n ->
  Fin (suc n)
weaken fzero = fzero
weaken (fsuc i) = fsuc (weaken i)

record Finite
  {a : Level}
  (A : Set a) :
  Set a where

  field
    size : Nat
    to-fin : A -> Fin size
    from-fin : Fin size -> A
    from-to :
      (x : A) ->
      from-fin (to-fin x) == x
    to-from :
      (i : Fin size) ->
      to-fin (from-fin i) == i

Subset :
  {a : Level} ->
  Set a ->
  Set a
Subset A = A -> Bool

record SameSubset
  {a : Level}
  {A : Set a}
  (left right : Subset A) :
  Set a where

  field
    same-membership :
      (x : A) ->
      left x == right x

emptySubset :
  {a : Level}
  {A : Set a} ->
  Subset A
emptySubset _ = false

record ExistsUnique
  {a p : Level}
  (A : Set a)
  (property : A -> Set p) :
  Set (a lmax p) where

  field
    witness : A
    witness-property : property witness
    unique :
      (other : A) ->
      property other ->
      other == witness

record AddsOne
  {a : Level}
  {A : Set a}
  (before after : Subset A) :
  Set a where

  field
    element : A
    absent-before : before element == false
    present-after : after element == true
    unchanged-elsewhere :
      (x : A) ->
      Not (x == element) ->
      after x == before x

data OneElementChange
  {a : Level}
  {A : Set a}
  (left right : Subset A) :
  Set a where

  added :
    AddsOne left right ->
    OneElementChange left right
  removed :
    AddsOne right left ->
    OneElementChange left right

record GrayEnumeration
  {a : Level}
  (A : Set a) :
  Set a where

  field
    steps : Nat
    subsets : Fin (suc steps) -> Subset A
    starts-empty :
      SameSubset (subsets fzero) emptySubset
    every-subset-exactly-once :
      (target : Subset A) ->
      ExistsUnique
        (Fin (suc steps))
        (\ i -> SameSubset (subsets i) target)
    consecutive-change :
      (i : Fin steps) ->
      OneElementChange
        (subsets (weaken i))
        (subsets (fsuc i))

putnam-1968-a3 :
  {a : Level} ->
  Set (lsuc a)
putnam-1968-a3 {a} =
  (A : Set a) ->

  a Gray-code ordering of all subsets of an arbitrary finite set, beginning
  with the empty set and changing one element at each step. This file contains
  no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open arithmeticTheory listTheory pred_setTheory;

val putnam_1968_a3 =
  ``!A : 'a set.
      FINITE A
      ==>
      ?l : ('a set) list.
        EL 0 l = {} /\
        (!i : num.
           i < LENGTH l
           ==>
           EL i l SUBSET A) /\
        (!S : 'a set.
           S SUBSET A
           ==>
           ?!i : num. i < LENGTH l /\ EL i l = S) /\
        (!i : num.
           i + 1 < LENGTH l
           ==>
           ?a : 'a.
             (a NOTIN EL i l /\
              EL (i + 1) l = a INSERT EL i l) \/
             (a NOTIN EL (i + 1) l /\
              EL i l = a INSERT EL (i + 1) l))``;

% Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench artifact putnam_1968_a3:
% every finite set has an ordering of all its subsets, beginning with the
% empty set, in which consecutive subsets differ by exactly one element.
% This file contains no proof.

putnam_1968_a3[Element: TYPE]: THEORY
BEGIN
  IMPORTING finite_sets[Element]

  element_set: TYPE = finite_set[Element]
  subset_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> element_set]

  subset_of(A, S: element_set): bool =
    FORALL (x: Element):
      A(x) IMPLIES S(x)

  is_empty(A: element_set): bool =
    FORALL (x: Element):
      NOT A(x)

  differ_at_exactly_one(A, B: element_set): bool =
    EXISTS (changed: Element):
      A(changed) /= B(changed)
        AND
          (FORALL (x: Element):
            x /= changed IMPLIES (A(x) IFF B(x)))

  enumerates_subsets_once(
      S: element_set,
      count: nat,
      sequence: subset_sequence): bool =
    (FORALL (index: nat):
      index < count IMPLIES subset_of(sequence(index), S))
      AND
    (FORALL (A: element_set):
      subset_of(A, S) IMPLIES
        EXISTS (index: nat):
          index < count
            AND sequence(index) = A
            AND
              (FORALL (other: nat):
                (other < count AND sequence(other) = A)
                  IMPLIES other = index))

  putnam_1968_a3: bool =
    FORALL (S: element_set):
      EXISTS (exponent: nat), (sequence: subset_sequence):
        is_empty(sequence(0))
          AND enumerates_subsets_once(
            S, 2 ^ exponent, sequence)
          AND
            (FORALL (index: nat):
              index + 1 < 2 ^ exponent IMPLIES
                differ_at_exactly_one(
                  sequence(index), sequence(index + 1)))
END putnam_1968_a3

;; Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench artifact putnam_1968_a4:
;; the sum of squared distances over all unordered pairs among n points on
;; the unit sphere in real three-space is at most n^2. This file contains no
;; proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

;; A length-n list is definitionally equivalent to a function on Fin n.
;; ACL2 evaluates its coordinates over the rationals. This preserves the real
;; statement in both directions: rational unit-sphere points are real points,
;; while rational points are dense in the real unit sphere (for example by
;; stereographic parametrization). If a real n-tuple violated the bound, its
;; pairwise squared-distance sum would be strictly greater than n^2; continuity
;; on the finite product of spheres would then give a nearby rational
;; unit-sphere n-tuple with the same strict violation.

(defun putnam-1968-a4-rational-point-p (point)
  (and (true-listp point)
       (equal (len point) 3)
       (rationalp (nth 0 point))
       (rationalp (nth 1 point))
       (rationalp (nth 2 point))))

(defun putnam-1968-a4-rational-point-list-p (points)
  (if (consp points)
      (and (putnam-1968-a4-rational-point-p (car points))
           (putnam-1968-a4-rational-point-list-p (cdr points)))
    (equal points nil)))

(defun putnam-1968-a4-square (x)
  (* x x))

(defun putnam-1968-a4-unit-point-p (point)
  (equal
   (+ (putnam-1968-a4-square (nth 0 point))
      (putnam-1968-a4-square (nth 1 point))
      (putnam-1968-a4-square (nth 2 point)))
   1))

(defun putnam-1968-a4-unit-point-list-p (points)
  (if (consp points)
      (and (putnam-1968-a4-unit-point-p (car points))
           (putnam-1968-a4-unit-point-list-p (cdr points)))
    (equal points nil)))

(defun putnam-1968-a4-distance-squared (left right)
  (+ (putnam-1968-a4-square
      (- (nth 0 left) (nth 0 right)))
     (putnam-1968-a4-square
      (- (nth 1 left) (nth 1 right)))
     (putnam-1968-a4-square
      (- (nth 2 left) (nth 2 right)))))

(defun putnam-1968-a4-sum-from-point (point remaining)
  (if (consp remaining)
      (+ (putnam-1968-a4-distance-squared point (car remaining))
         (putnam-1968-a4-sum-from-point point (cdr remaining)))
    0))

(defun putnam-1968-a4-pairwise-sum (points)
  (if (consp points)
      (+ (putnam-1968-a4-sum-from-point
          (car points) (cdr points))
         (putnam-1968-a4-pairwise-sum (cdr points)))
    0))

(defun putnambench-putnam-1968-a4-statement (n points)
  (implies
   (and (natp n)
        (true-listp points)
        (equal (len points) n)
        (putnam-1968-a4-rational-point-list-p points)
        (putnam-1968-a4-unit-point-list-p points))
   (<= (putnam-1968-a4-pairwise-sum points)
       (* n n))))

-- Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1968_a4:
-- the sum of squared distances between unordered pairs of n points on the
-- unit sphere in real three-space is at most n squared. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; _*_)

infix 4 _!=_
infixr 3 _and_
infixr 2 _or_

data Bottom : Set where

Not : Set -> Set
Not A = A -> Bottom

_!=_ : {A : Set} -> A -> A -> Set
x != y = Not (x == y)

record _and_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data _or_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  left  : A -> A or B
  right : B -> A or B

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

data Fin : Nat -> Set where
  fzero : {n : Nat} -> Fin (suc n)
  fsuc  : {n : Nat} -> Fin n -> Fin (suc n)

record CompleteOrderedField (R : Set) : Set1 where
  field
    zeroR oneR : R
    add multiply : R -> R -> R
    negate inverse : R -> R
    lessOrEqual : R -> R -> Set
    fromNat : Nat -> R

    one-not-zero :
      oneR != zeroR

    add-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> add x y == add y x
    add-associative :
      (x y z : R) -> add (add x y) z == add x (add y z)
    add-zero :
      (x : R) -> add x zeroR == x
    add-inverse :
      (x : R) -> add x (negate x) == zeroR

    multiply-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> multiply x y == multiply y x
    multiply-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply (multiply x y) z == multiply x (multiply y z)
    multiply-one :
      (x : R) -> multiply x oneR == x
    multiply-zero :
      (x : R) -> multiply x zeroR == zeroR
    distribute :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply x (add y z) ==
      add (multiply x y) (multiply x z)
    inverse-zero :
      inverse zeroR == zeroR
    multiply-inverse :
      (x : R) ->
      x != zeroR ->
      multiply x (inverse x) == oneR

    order-reflexive :
      (x : R) -> lessOrEqual x x
    order-transitive :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y z ->
      lessOrEqual x z
    order-antisymmetric :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y x ->
      x == y
    order-total :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y or lessOrEqual y x
    add-order :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual (add z x) (add z y)
    multiply-nonnegative :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR x ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR y ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR (multiply x y)
    zero-less-than-one :
      lessOrEqual zeroR oneR and zeroR != oneR

    fromNat-zero :
      fromNat zero == zeroR
    fromNat-successor :
      (n : Nat) -> fromNat (suc n) == add (fromNat n) oneR
    fromNat-addition :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m + n) == add (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-multiplication :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m * n) == multiply (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-injective :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat m == fromNat n ->
      m == n

    archimedean :
      (x : R) ->
      Exists Nat (\ n -> lessOrEqual x (fromNat n))
    least-upper-bound :
      (P : R -> Set) ->
      Exists R P ->
      Exists R
        (\ upper ->
          (x : R) ->
          P x ->
          lessOrEqual x upper) ->
      Exists R
        (\ supremum ->
          ((x : R) -> P x -> lessOrEqual x supremum)
          and
          ((upper : R) ->
            ((x : R) -> P x -> lessOrEqual x upper) ->
            lessOrEqual supremum upper))

open CompleteOrderedField

record Point3 (R : Set) : Set where
  constructor point3
  field
    x-coordinate : R
    y-coordinate : R
    z-coordinate : R

open Point3

subtract :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
subtract reals x y =
  add reals x (negate reals y)

square :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  R
square reals x =
  multiply reals x x

squaredNorm :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  Point3 R ->
  R
squaredNorm reals point =
  add reals
    (add reals
      (square reals (x-coordinate point))
      (square reals (y-coordinate point)))
    (square reals (z-coordinate point))

squaredDistance :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  Point3 R ->
  Point3 R ->
  R
squaredDistance reals leftPoint rightPoint =
  add reals
    (add reals
      (square reals
        (subtract reals
          (x-coordinate leftPoint)
          (x-coordinate rightPoint)))
      (square reals
        (subtract reals
          (y-coordinate leftPoint)
          (y-coordinate rightPoint))))
    (square reals
      (subtract reals
        (z-coordinate leftPoint)
        (z-coordinate rightPoint)))

sumFin :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  {n : Nat} ->
  (Fin n -> R) ->
  R
sumFin reals {zero} term =
  zeroR reals
sumFin reals {suc n} term =
  add reals
    (term fzero)
    (sumFin reals (\ i -> term (fsuc i)))

unorderedPairSquaredDistanceSum :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  {n : Nat} ->
  (Fin n -> Point3 R) ->
  R
unorderedPairSquaredDistanceSum reals {zero} points =
  zeroR reals
unorderedPairSquaredDistanceSum reals {suc n} points =
  add reals
    (sumFin reals
      (\ j ->
        squaredDistance reals
          (points fzero)
          (points (fsuc j))))
    (unorderedPairSquaredDistanceSum reals
      (\ i -> points (fsuc i)))

module Putnam1968A4Statement
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) where

  proposition : Set
  proposition =
    (n : Nat) ->
    (points : Fin n -> Point3 R) ->
    ((i : Fin n) ->
      squaredNorm reals (points i) == oneR reals) ->
    lessOrEqual reals
      (unorderedPairSquaredDistanceSum reals points)
      (square reals (fromNat reals n))

putnam-1968-a4 : Set1
putnam-1968-a4 =
  (R : Set) ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) ->
  Putnam1968A4Statement.proposition reals

  the sum of squared pairwise distances among finitely many points on the

  This file contains no proof.

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open arithmeticTheory pairTheory pred_setTheory realTheory real_sigmaTheory;

val putnam_1968_a4 =
  ``let norm_sq3 =
      \P : (real # real) # real.
        FST (FST P) pow 2 +
        SND (FST P) pow 2 +
        SND P pow 2
    in
    let dist_sq3 =
      \P Q : (real # real) # real.
        (FST (FST P) - FST (FST Q)) pow 2 +
        (SND (FST P) - SND (FST Q)) pow 2 +
        (SND P - SND Q) pow 2
    in
      !n : num. !S : num -> (real # real) # real.
        (!i : num. i < n ==> norm_sq3 (S i) = 1)
        ==>
        SIGMA
          (\i : num.
             SIGMA
               (\j : num.
                  if i < j then dist_sq3 (S i) (S j) else 0)
               (count n))
          (count n)
        <= (&n : real) pow 2``;
