content:
-- Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1968_b2:
-- every element of a finite group is a product of two elements of any subset
-- containing more than half of the group. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

open import Agda.Primitive using (Level; lsuc; _⊔_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _*_)

infix 4 _<N_
infixr 3 _and_

record Top : Set where
  constructor truth

record _and_
  {a b : Level}
  (A : Set a)
  (B : Set b) :
  Set (a ⊔ b) where

  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

record Exists
  {a p : Level}
  (A : Set a)
  (P : A -> Set p) :
  Set (a ⊔ p) where

  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

data _<N_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set where
  zero<suc : {n : Nat} -> zero <N suc n
  suc<suc  : {m n : Nat} -> m <N n -> suc m <N suc n

data Fin : Nat -> Set where
  fzero : {n : Nat} -> Fin (suc n)
  fsuc  : {n : Nat} -> Fin n -> Fin (suc n)

record HasCardinality
  {a p : Level}
  {A : Set a}
  (P : A -> Set p)
  (cardinality : Nat) :
  Set (a ⊔ p) where

  field
    enumerate :
      Fin cardinality ->
      A
    enumerated-member :
      (index : Fin cardinality) ->
      P (enumerate index)
    enumeration-complete :
      (x : A) ->
      P x ->
      Exists (Fin cardinality)
        (\ index -> x == enumerate index)
    enumeration-injective :
      (left-index right-index : Fin cardinality) ->
      enumerate left-index == enumerate right-index ->
      left-index == right-index

record FiniteCarrier
  {a : Level}
  (A : Set a) :
  Set a where

  field
    cardinality :
      Nat
    has-cardinality :
      HasCardinality {A = A} (\ _ -> Top) cardinality

record FiniteSubset
  {a p : Level}
  {A : Set a}
  (P : A -> Set p) :
  Set (a ⊔ p) where

  field
    cardinality :
      Nat
    has-cardinality :
      HasCardinality P cardinality

record Group
  {a : Level}
  (G : Set a) :
  Set a where

  field
    identity :
      G
    multiply :
      G ->
      G ->
      G
    inverse :
      G ->
      G
    multiply-associative :
      (x y z : G) ->
      multiply (multiply x y) z ==
      multiply x (multiply y z)
    identity-left :
      (x : G) ->
      multiply identity x == x
    identity-right :
      (x : G) ->
      multiply x identity == x
    inverse-left :
      (x : G) ->
      multiply (inverse x) x == identity
    inverse-right :
      (x : G) ->
      multiply x (inverse x) == identity

open FiniteCarrier
open FiniteSubset
open Group

two : Nat
two =
  suc (suc zero)

putnam-1968-b2 :
  {a p : Level} ->
  Set (lsuc (a ⊔ p))
putnam-1968-b2 {a} {p} =
  (G : Set a) ->
  (group : Group G) ->
  (A : G -> Set p) ->
  (finite-group : FiniteCarrier G) ->
  (finite-A : FiniteSubset A) ->
  cardinality finite-group <N two * cardinality finite-A ->
  (g : G) ->
  Exists G
    (\ x ->
      A x
      and
      Exists G
        (\ y ->
          A y
          and
          g == multiply group x y))

$(

  and # gives finite cardinality. Since these cardinalities are natural
  numbers, comparison with half the carrier cardinality agrees with the
  floor-division presentation in the Isabelle and Rocq sources.

  The factors x and y remain existentially quantified within the conclusion

          /\
          A C_ ( Base ` G )
        )
        /\
        ( ( # ` ( Base ` G ) ) / 2 ) < ( # ` A )
      )
      ->
      A. g e. ( Base ` G )
        E. x e. A E. y e. A
          g = ( x ( +g ` G ) y )

% Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench artifact putnam_1968_b2: every
% element of a finite group is a product of two elements of any subset
% containing more than half of the group. This file contains no proof.

putnam_1968_b2[Element: TYPE+]: THEORY
BEGIN
  IMPORTING finite_sets[Element]

  element_set: TYPE = finite_set[Element]

  subset_of(A, B: element_set): bool =
    FORALL (x: Element):
      A(x) IMPLIES B(x)

  finite_group(
      carrier: element_set,
      one: Element,
      inverse: [Element -> Element],
      multiply: [Element, Element -> Element]): bool =
    carrier(one)
      AND
        (FORALL (a, b: Element):
          carrier(a) AND carrier(b) IMPLIES carrier(multiply(a, b)))
      AND
        (FORALL (a: Element):
          carrier(a) IMPLIES carrier(inverse(a)))
      AND
        (FORALL (a, b, c: Element):
          carrier(a) AND carrier(b) AND carrier(c) IMPLIES
            multiply(a, multiply(b, c)) = multiply(multiply(a, b), c))
      AND
        (FORALL (a: Element):
          carrier(a) IMPLIES
            multiply(one, a) = a AND multiply(a, one) = a)
      AND
        (FORALL (a: Element):
          carrier(a) IMPLIES
            multiply(inverse(a), a) = one
              AND multiply(a, inverse(a)) = one)

  putnam_1968_b2: bool =
    FORALL (carrier, A: element_set),
           (one: Element),
           (inverse: [Element -> Element]),
           (multiply: [Element, Element -> Element]):
      finite_group(carrier, one, inverse, multiply)
        AND subset_of(A, carrier)
        AND 2 * card(A) > card(carrier)
      IMPLIES
        (FORALL (g: Element):
          carrier(g) IMPLIES
            EXISTS (x, y: Element):
              A(x) AND A(y) AND g = multiply(x, y))
END putnam_1968_b2

title: putnam_1968_b4
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1968_b4:
;; invariance of a convergent symmetric improper integral of a continuous
;; real function under the substitution x |-> x - 1/x. This file contains no
;; proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))

;; The scalar arguments present the full real field as an arbitrary
;; Dedekind-complete ordered field. Functions and subsets are unbounded tame
;; APPLY$ objects, and DEFUN-SK keeps every analytic witness and quantifier
;; internal. On bounded intervals the integrals are defined by convergence of
;; uniform left Riemann sums. For continuous functions these are exactly the
;; corresponding Lebesgue integrals. The transformed truncation is the union
;; [-y,-1/y] U [1/y,y], matching the punctured Lean formulation; endpoints and
;; the single value at zero do not affect the integral.

(defun p68b4-member-p (carrier x)
  (if (apply$ carrier (list x)) t nil))

(defun p68b4-unary (operation x)
  (apply$ operation (list x)))

(defun p68b4-binary (operation x y)
  (apply$ operation (list x y)))

(defun p68b4-function-value (function x)
  (apply$ function (list x)))

(defun-sk p68b4-field-laws-p
    (carrier add multiply negate inverse zero one)
  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and (p68b4-member-p carrier x)
          (p68b4-member-p carrier y)
          (p68b4-member-p carrier z))
     (and
      (p68b4-member-p carrier
                      (p68b4-binary add x y))
      (p68b4-member-p carrier
                      (p68b4-binary multiply x y))
      (p68b4-member-p carrier
                      (p68b4-unary negate x))
      (p68b4-member-p carrier
                      (p68b4-unary inverse x))
      (equal
       (p68b4-binary add (p68b4-binary add x y) z)
       (p68b4-binary add x (p68b4-binary add y z)))
      (equal (p68b4-binary add x y)
             (p68b4-binary add y x))
      (equal (p68b4-binary add x zero) x)
      (equal
       (p68b4-binary add x (p68b4-unary negate x))
       zero)
      (equal
       (p68b4-binary multiply
                      (p68b4-binary multiply x y) z)
       (p68b4-binary multiply
                      x (p68b4-binary multiply y z)))
      (equal (p68b4-binary multiply x y)
             (p68b4-binary multiply y x))
      (equal (p68b4-binary multiply x one) x)
      (implies
       (equal x zero)
       (equal (p68b4-unary inverse x) zero))
      (implies
       (not (equal x zero))
       (equal
        (p68b4-binary multiply
                       x (p68b4-unary inverse x))
        one))
      (equal
       (p68b4-binary multiply
                      x (p68b4-binary add y z))
       (p68b4-binary add
                     (p68b4-binary multiply x y)
                     (p68b4-binary multiply x z)))))))

(defun-sk p68b4-order-laws-p
    (carrier add multiply zero less)
  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and (p68b4-member-p carrier x)
          (p68b4-member-p carrier y)
          (p68b4-member-p carrier z))
     (and
      (not (p68b4-binary less x x))
      (or (equal x y)
          (p68b4-binary less x y)
          (p68b4-binary less y x))
      (implies
       (and (p68b4-binary less x y)
            (p68b4-binary less y z))
       (p68b4-binary less x z))
      (implies
       (p68b4-binary less x y)
       (p68b4-binary
        less
        (p68b4-binary add x z)
        (p68b4-binary add y z)))
      (implies
       (and (p68b4-binary less zero x)
            (p68b4-binary less zero y))
       (p68b4-binary
        less zero (p68b4-binary multiply x y)))))))

(defun-sk p68b4-set-nonempty-p (carrier set)
  (exists (x)
    (and (p68b4-member-p carrier x)
         (apply$ set (list x)))))

(defun-sk p68b4-upper-bound-p (carrier less set bound)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (and (p68b4-member-p carrier x)
          (apply$ set (list x)))
     (not (p68b4-binary less bound x)))))

(defun-sk p68b4-bounded-above-p (carrier less set)
  (exists (bound)
    (and (p68b4-member-p carrier bound)
         (p68b4-upper-bound-p carrier less set bound))))

(defun-sk p68b4-supremum-p (carrier less set supremum)
  (forall (bound)
    (and
     (p68b4-member-p carrier supremum)
     (p68b4-upper-bound-p carrier less set supremum)
     (implies
      (and (p68b4-member-p carrier bound)
           (p68b4-upper-bound-p carrier less set bound))
      (not (p68b4-binary less bound supremum))))))

(defun-sk p68b4-has-supremum-p (carrier less set)
  (exists (supremum)
    (p68b4-supremum-p carrier less set supremum)))

(defun-sk p68b4-dedekind-complete-p (carrier less)
  (forall (set)
    (implies
     (and (tamep-functionp set)
          (p68b4-set-nonempty-p carrier set)
          (p68b4-bounded-above-p carrier less set))
     (p68b4-has-supremum-p carrier less set))))

(defun p68b4-real-field-p
    (carrier add multiply negate inverse zero one less)
  (and
   (tamep-functionp carrier)
   (tamep-functionp add)
   (tamep-functionp multiply)
   (tamep-functionp negate)
   (tamep-functionp inverse)
   (tamep-functionp less)
   (p68b4-member-p carrier zero)
   (p68b4-member-p carrier one)
   (not (equal zero one))
   (p68b4-field-laws-p
    carrier add multiply negate inverse zero one)
   (p68b4-order-laws-p carrier add multiply zero less)
   (p68b4-binary less zero one)
   (p68b4-dedekind-complete-p carrier less)))

(defun p68b4-add (add x y)
  (p68b4-binary add x y))

(defun p68b4-negate (negate x)
  (p68b4-unary negate x))

(defun p68b4-subtract (add negate x y)
  (p68b4-add add x (p68b4-negate negate y)))

(defun p68b4-multiply (multiply x y)
  (p68b4-binary multiply x y))

(defun p68b4-inverse (inverse x)
  (p68b4-unary inverse x))

(defun p68b4-divide (multiply inverse x y)
  (p68b4-multiply multiply x (p68b4-inverse inverse y)))

(defun p68b4-less-p (less x y)
  (if (p68b4-binary less x y) t nil))

(defun p68b4-less-equal-p (less x y)
  (not (p68b4-less-p less y x)))

(defun p68b4-absolute-value (less negate zero x)
  (if (p68b4-less-p less x zero)
      (p68b4-negate negate x)
    x))

(defun p68b4-positive-p (carrier less zero x)
  (and (p68b4-member-p carrier x)
       (p68b4-less-p less zero x)))

(defun-sk p68b4-function-values-p (carrier function)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (p68b4-member-p carrier x)
     (p68b4-member-p
      carrier (p68b4-function-value function x)))))

(defun p68b4-real-function-p (carrier function)
  (and (tamep-functionp function)
       (p68b4-function-values-p carrier function)))

(defun-sk p68b4-continuity-neighborhood-p
    (carrier function add negate zero less
     x epsilon delta)
  (forall (z)
    (implies
     (and
      (p68b4-member-p carrier z)
      (p68b4-less-p
       less
       (p68b4-absolute-value
        less negate zero
        (p68b4-subtract add negate z x))
       delta))
     (p68b4-less-p
      less
      (p68b4-absolute-value
       less negate zero
       (p68b4-subtract
        add negate
        (p68b4-function-value function z)
        (p68b4-function-value function x)))
      epsilon))))

(defun-sk p68b4-continuity-radius-exists-p
    (carrier function add negate zero less x epsilon)
  (exists (delta)
    (and
     (p68b4-positive-p carrier less zero delta)
     (p68b4-continuity-neighborhood-p
      carrier function add negate zero less
      x epsilon delta))))

(defun-sk p68b4-continuous-p
    (carrier function add negate zero less)
  (forall (x epsilon)
    (implies
     (and
      (p68b4-member-p carrier x)
      (p68b4-positive-p carrier less zero epsilon))
     (p68b4-continuity-radius-exists-p
      carrier function add negate zero less
      x epsilon))))

(defun p68b4-nat-multiple (count x zero add)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix count)))
  (if (zp count)
      zero
    (p68b4-add
     add x
     (p68b4-nat-multiple (- count 1) x zero add))))

(defun p68b4-riemann-width
    (subdivisions a b zero one add multiply negate inverse)
  (let ((n-real
         (p68b4-nat-multiple subdivisions one zero add)))
    (p68b4-divide
     multiply inverse
     (p68b4-subtract add negate b a)
     n-real)))

(defun p68b4-riemann-point
    (index subdivisions a b
     zero one add multiply negate inverse)
  (let* ((width
          (p68b4-riemann-width
           subdivisions a b zero one add multiply negate inverse))
         (index-real
          (p68b4-nat-multiple index one zero add)))
    (p68b4-add
     add a
     (p68b4-multiply multiply index-real width))))

(defun p68b4-integrand-value
    (function transformedp x add negate inverse)
  (if transformedp
      (p68b4-function-value
       function
       (p68b4-subtract
        add negate x (p68b4-inverse inverse x)))
    (p68b4-function-value function x)))

(defun p68b4-riemann-sum-aux
    (remaining subdivisions a b function transformedp
     zero one add multiply negate inverse)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix remaining)))
  (if (zp remaining)
      zero
    (let* ((index (- remaining 1))
           (width
            (p68b4-riemann-width
             subdivisions a b
             zero one add multiply negate inverse))
           (point
            (p68b4-riemann-point
             index subdivisions a b
             zero one add multiply negate inverse))
           (summand
            (p68b4-multiply
             multiply width
             (p68b4-integrand-value
              function transformedp point
              add negate inverse))))
      (p68b4-add
       add
       (p68b4-riemann-sum-aux
        index subdivisions a b function transformedp
        zero one add multiply negate inverse)
       summand))))

(defun p68b4-riemann-sum
    (subdivisions a b function transformedp
     zero one add multiply negate inverse)
  (if (posp subdivisions)
      (p68b4-riemann-sum-aux
       subdivisions subdivisions a b function transformedp
       zero one add multiply negate inverse)
    zero))

(defun-sk p68b4-riemann-tail-p
    (function transformedp a b value epsilon cutoff
     zero one add multiply negate inverse less)
  (forall (subdivisions)
    (implies
     (and
      (natp subdivisions)
      (< 0 subdivisions)
      (<= cutoff subdivisions))
     (p68b4-less-p
      less
      (p68b4-absolute-value
       less negate zero
       (p68b4-subtract
        add negate
        (p68b4-riemann-sum
         subdivisions a b function transformedp
         zero one add multiply negate inverse)
        value))
      epsilon))))

(defun-sk p68b4-riemann-cutoff-exists-p
    (function transformedp a b value epsilon
     zero one add multiply negate inverse less)
  (exists (cutoff)
    (and
     (natp cutoff)
     (< 0 cutoff)
     (p68b4-riemann-tail-p
      function transformedp a b value epsilon cutoff
      zero one add multiply negate inverse less))))

(defun-sk p68b4-riemann-integral-converges-p
    (carrier function transformedp a b value
     zero one add multiply negate inverse less)
  (forall (epsilon)
    (implies
     (p68b4-positive-p carrier less zero epsilon)
     (p68b4-riemann-cutoff-exists-p
      function transformedp a b value epsilon
      zero one add multiply negate inverse less))))

(defun p68b4-interval-integral-p
    (carrier function transformedp a b value
     zero one add multiply negate inverse less)
  (and
   (p68b4-member-p carrier a)
   (p68b4-member-p carrier b)
   (p68b4-member-p carrier value)
   (p68b4-less-equal-p less a b)
   (p68b4-riemann-integral-converges-p
    carrier function transformedp a b value
    zero one add multiply negate inverse less)))

(defun-sk p68b4-original-at-radius-p
    (carrier function radius limit epsilon
     zero one add multiply negate inverse less)
  (exists (value)
    (and
     (p68b4-interval-integral-p
      carrier function nil
      (p68b4-negate negate radius) radius value
      zero one add multiply negate inverse less)
     (p68b4-less-p
      less
      (p68b4-absolute-value
       less negate zero
       (p68b4-subtract add negate value limit))
      epsilon))))

(defun-sk p68b4-original-tail-p
    (carrier function limit epsilon cutoff
     zero one add multiply negate inverse less)
  (forall (radius)
    (implies
     (and
      (p68b4-member-p carrier radius)
      (p68b4-less-equal-p less cutoff radius))
     (p68b4-original-at-radius-p
      carrier function radius limit epsilon
      zero one add multiply negate inverse less))))

(defun-sk p68b4-original-cutoff-exists-p
    (carrier function limit epsilon
     zero one add multiply negate inverse less)
  (exists (cutoff)
    (and
     (p68b4-positive-p carrier less zero cutoff)
     (p68b4-original-tail-p
      carrier function limit epsilon cutoff
      zero one add multiply negate inverse less))))

(defun-sk p68b4-original-limit-p
    (carrier function limit
     zero one add multiply negate inverse less)
  (forall (epsilon)
    (implies
     (p68b4-positive-p carrier less zero epsilon)
     (p68b4-original-cutoff-exists-p
      carrier function limit epsilon
      zero one add multiply negate inverse less))))

(defun-sk p68b4-original-limit-exists-p
    (carrier function
     zero one add multiply negate inverse less)
  (exists (limit)
    (and
     (p68b4-member-p carrier limit)
     (p68b4-original-limit-p
      carrier function limit
      zero one add multiply negate inverse less))))

(defun-sk p68b4-transformed-at-radius-p
    (carrier function radius limit epsilon
     zero one add multiply negate inverse less)
  (exists (left-value right-value)
    (let ((reciprocal
           (p68b4-inverse inverse radius)))
      (and
       (p68b4-interval-integral-p
        carrier function t
        (p68b4-negate negate radius)
        (p68b4-negate negate reciprocal)
        left-value
        zero one add multiply negate inverse less)
       (p68b4-interval-integral-p
        carrier function t
        reciprocal radius right-value
        zero one add multiply negate inverse less)
       (p68b4-less-p
        less
        (p68b4-absolute-value
         less negate zero
         (p68b4-subtract
          add negate
          (p68b4-add add left-value right-value)
          limit))
        epsilon)))))

(defun-sk p68b4-transformed-tail-p
    (carrier function limit epsilon cutoff
     zero one add multiply negate inverse less)
  (forall (radius)
    (implies
     (and
      (p68b4-member-p carrier radius)
      (p68b4-less-equal-p less cutoff radius))
     (p68b4-transformed-at-radius-p

(defun-sk p68b4-transformed-cutoff-exists-p

    (implies

     zero one add multiply negate inverse less)

(defun putnambench-putnam-1968-b4-statement

content:
-- Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1968_b4:
-- invariance of a convergent symmetric improper real integral under
-- x - 1/x, with the transformed integral truncated away from zero.
-- This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module Putnam1968B4 where

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; _*_)

infix 4 _!=_ _<=N_
infixr 3 _and_
infixr 2 _or_

data Bottom : Set where

Not : Set -> Set
Not A =
  A -> Bottom

_!=_ : {A : Set} -> A -> A -> Set
x != y =
  Not (x == y)

record _and_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data _or_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  left  : A -> A or B
  right : B -> A or B

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

data _<=N_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set where
  zero<=   : {n : Nat} -> zero <=N n
  suc<=suc : {m n : Nat} -> m <=N n -> suc m <=N suc n

record CompleteOrderedField (R : Set) : Set1 where
  field
    zeroR oneR : R
    add multiply : R -> R -> R
    negate inverse : R -> R
    lessOrEqual : R -> R -> Set
    fromNat : Nat -> R

    one-not-zero :
      oneR != zeroR

    add-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> add x y == add y x
    add-associative :
      (x y z : R) -> add (add x y) z == add x (add y z)
    add-zero :
      (x : R) -> add x zeroR == x
    add-inverse :
      (x : R) -> add x (negate x) == zeroR

    multiply-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> multiply x y == multiply y x
    multiply-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply (multiply x y) z == multiply x (multiply y z)
    multiply-one :
      (x : R) -> multiply x oneR == x
    multiply-zero :
      (x : R) -> multiply x zeroR == zeroR
    distribute :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply x (add y z) ==
      add (multiply x y) (multiply x z)
    inverse-zero :
      inverse zeroR == zeroR
    multiply-inverse :
      (x : R) ->
      x != zeroR ->
      multiply x (inverse x) == oneR

    order-reflexive :
      (x : R) -> lessOrEqual x x
    order-transitive :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y z ->
      lessOrEqual x z
    order-antisymmetric :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y x ->
      x == y
    order-total :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y or lessOrEqual y x
    add-order :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual (add z x) (add z y)
    multiply-nonnegative :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR x ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR y ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR (multiply x y)
    zero-less-than-one :
      lessOrEqual zeroR oneR and zeroR != oneR

    fromNat-zero :
      fromNat zero == zeroR
    fromNat-successor :
      (n : Nat) -> fromNat (suc n) == add (fromNat n) oneR
    fromNat-addition :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m + n) == add (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-multiplication :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m * n) == multiply (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-injective :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat m == fromNat n ->
      m == n

    archimedean :
      (x : R) ->
      Exists Nat (\ n -> lessOrEqual x (fromNat n))
    least-upper-bound :
      (P : R -> Set) ->
      Exists R P ->
      Exists R
        (\ upper ->
          (x : R) ->
          P x ->
          lessOrEqual x upper) ->
      Exists R
        (\ supremum ->
          ((x : R) ->
            P x ->
            lessOrEqual x supremum)
          and
          ((upper : R) ->
            ((x : R) ->
              P x ->
              lessOrEqual x upper) ->
            lessOrEqual supremum upper))

open CompleteOrderedField

subtract :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
subtract reals x y =
  add reals x (negate reals y)

divide :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
divide reals x y =
  multiply reals x (inverse reals y)

StrictLess :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
StrictLess reals x y =
  lessOrEqual reals x y and x != y

CloseTo :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
CloseTo reals center radius x =
  StrictLess reals
    (subtract reals center radius)
    x
  and
  StrictLess reals
    x
    (add reals center radius)

ContinuousAt :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  (R -> R) ->
  R ->
  Set
ContinuousAt {R} reals function point =
  (epsilon : R) ->
  StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) epsilon ->
  Exists R
    (\ delta ->
      StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) delta
      and
      ((x : R) ->
        CloseTo reals point delta x ->
        CloseTo reals (function point) epsilon (function x)))

Continuous :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  (R -> R) ->
  Set
Continuous {R} reals function =
  (point : R) ->
  ContinuousAt reals function point

Between :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
Between reals lower upper x =
  lessOrEqual reals lower x
  and
  lessOrEqual reals x upper

ContinuousOnInterval :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  (R -> R) ->
  Set
ContinuousOnInterval {R} reals lower upper function =
  (point : R) ->
  Between reals lower upper point ->
  (epsilon : R) ->
  StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) epsilon ->
  Exists R
    (\ delta ->
      StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) delta
      and
      ((x : R) ->
        Between reals lower upper x ->
        CloseTo reals point delta x ->
        CloseTo reals (function point) epsilon (function x)))

SequentialLimit :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  R ->
  Set
SequentialLimit {R} reals sequence limit =
  (epsilon : R) ->
  StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) epsilon ->
  Exists Nat
    (\ cutoff ->
      (n : Nat) ->
      cutoff <=N n ->
      CloseTo reals limit epsilon (sequence n))

TendsAtTop :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  (R -> R) ->
  R ->
  Set
TendsAtTop {R} reals function limit =
  (epsilon : R) ->
  StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) epsilon ->
  Exists R
    (\ cutoff ->
      (y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual reals cutoff y ->
      CloseTo reals limit epsilon (function y))

sumFirst :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  Nat ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  R
sumFirst reals zero term =
  zeroR reals
sumFirst reals (suc n) term =
  add reals
    (sumFirst reals n term)
    (term n)

riemannStep :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Nat ->
  R
riemannStep reals lower upper pieces =
  divide reals
    (subtract reals upper lower)
    (fromNat reals pieces)

rightRiemannSum :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  (R -> R) ->
  Nat ->
  R
rightRiemannSum reals lower upper function pieces =
  let
    step = riemannStep reals lower upper pieces
  in
  sumFirst reals pieces
    (\ i ->
      multiply reals
        (function
          (add reals lower
            (multiply reals
              (fromNat reals (suc i))
              step)))
        step)

IntervalIntegralValue :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  (R -> R) ->
  R ->
  Set
IntervalIntegralValue reals lower upper function value =
  SequentialLimit reals
    (\ n ->
      rightRiemannSum reals lower upper function (suc n))
    value

record IntervalIntegration
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) :
  Set1 where

  field
    intervalIntegral : R -> R -> (R -> R) -> R
    integral-of-continuous :
      (lower upper : R) ->
      (function : R -> R) ->
      lessOrEqual reals lower upper ->
      ContinuousOnInterval reals lower upper function ->
      IntervalIntegralValue reals lower upper function
        (intervalIntegral lower upper function)

open IntervalIntegration

symmetricIntegral :
  {R : Set} ->
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R} ->
  IntervalIntegration reals ->
  (R -> R) ->
  R ->
  R
symmetricIntegral {reals = reals} integration function radius =
  intervalIntegral integration
    (negate reals radius)
    radius
    function

puncturedSymmetricIntegral :
  {R : Set} ->
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R} ->
  IntervalIntegration reals ->
  (R -> R) ->
  R ->
  R
puncturedSymmetricIntegral {reals = reals} integration function radius =
  add reals
    (intervalIntegral integration
      (negate reals radius)
      (negate reals (inverse reals radius))
      function)
    (intervalIntegral integration
      (inverse reals radius)
      radius
      function)

putnamTransform :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  (R -> R) ->
  R ->
  R
putnamTransform reals function x =
  function (subtract reals x (inverse reals x))

putnam-1968-b4 : Set1
putnam-1968-b4 =
  (R : Set) ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) ->
  (integration : IntervalIntegration reals) ->
  (f : R -> R) ->
  Continuous reals f
  and
  Exists R
    (\ originalLimit ->
      TendsAtTop reals
        (symmetricIntegral integration f)
        originalLimit)
  ->
  Exists R
    (\ commonLimit ->
      TendsAtTop reals
        (puncturedSymmetricIntegral integration
          (putnamTransform reals f))
        commonLimit
      and
      TendsAtTop reals
        (symmetricIntegral integration f)
        commonLimit)

(*
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench artifact putnam_1968_b4:
  equality of a continuous function's symmetric improper integral with the
  corresponding integral after the substitution x - 1/x. This file contains
  no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open pred_setTheory realTheory real_topologyTheory integrationTheory;

val putnam_1968_b4 =
  ``!f : real -> real.
      f continuous_on UNIV /\
      (?r : real.
         ((\y : real.
             integration$integral (interval [-y, y]) f) --> r)
           at_posinfinity)
      ==>
      ?r : real.
        ((\y : real.
            integration$integral
              (interval [-y, y] DIFF interval [-1 / y, 1 / y])
              (\x : real. f (x - 1 / x))) --> r)
          at_posinfinity /\
        ((\y : real.
            integration$integral (interval [-y, y]) f) --> r)
          at_posinfinity``;

title: putnam_1968_b4
content:
$(
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact
  putnam_1968_b4: invariance of a convergent symmetric improper integral
  under the substitution x maps to x minus one over x. This file contains
  no proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  F ranges over arbitrary total real-valued functions on the reals, and
  membership in RR -cn-> RR is continuity. The real limit relation ~~>r
  gives the limit at positive infinity of the RR-indexed symmetric
  integrals.

  The transformed integral is taken over
  (-y,-1/y) union (1/y,y). This is the punctured symmetric domain used
  explicitly by Lean and required by the singularity at zero. The
  unpunctured Isabelle and Rocq formulas do not preserve this
  improper-integral domain.
  Open versus closed finite endpoints does not change a Lebesgue integral.
  The same internally quantified real r is the limit of both integral
  families. The final declaration is the single unproved $a corpus
  statement; this database contains no $p proof statement.
$)

${
  $d F r x y $.

  putnambench-putnam-1968-b4 $a |- A. F e. ( RR ^m RR )
    (
      (
        F e. ( RR -cn-> RR )
        /\
        E. r e. RR
          (
            y e. RR |->
              S. ( ( -u y ) (,) y )
                ( F ` x )
                _d x
          )
          ~~>r
          r
      )
      ->
      E. r e. RR
        (
          (
            y e. RR |->
              S.
                (
                  ( ( -u y ) (,) ( -u ( 1 / y ) ) )
                  u.
                  ( ( 1 / y ) (,) y )
                )
                ( F ` ( x - ( 1 / x ) ) )
                _d x
          )
          ~~>r
          r
          /\
          (
            y e. RR |->
              S. ( ( -u y ) (,) y )
                ( F ` x )
                _d x
          )
          ~~>r
          r
        )
    )
  $.
$}

title: putnam_1968_b4
content:
% Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench artifact putnam_1968_b4:
% invariance of a convergent symmetric improper integral under the substitution
% x maps to x - 1/x for a continuous real function. This file contains no proof.

putnam_1968_b4: THEORY
BEGIN
  real_function: TYPE = [real -> real]
  real_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> real]
  positive_real_function: TYPE = [posreal -> real]

  continuous(f: real_function): bool =
    FORALL (x: real), (epsilon_value: posreal):
      EXISTS (delta: posreal):
        FORALL (y: real):
          abs(y - x) < delta IMPLIES
            abs(f(y) - f(x)) < epsilon_value

  valid_tagged_partition(
      left, right: real,
      points, tags: real_sequence,
      count: nat): bool =
    count > 0
      AND points(0) = left
      AND points(count) = right
      AND FORALL (index: nat):
        index < count IMPLIES
          (points(index) < points(index + 1)
            AND points(index) <= tags(index)
            AND tags(index) <= points(index + 1))

  mesh_less_than(
      points: real_sequence,
      count: nat,
      bound: real): bool =
    FORALL (index: nat):
      index < count IMPLIES
        points(index + 1) - points(index) < bound

  riemann_sum(
      f: real_function,
      points, tags: real_sequence,
      count: nat): RECURSIVE real =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      riemann_sum(f, points, tags, count - 1)
        + f(tags(count - 1))
            * (points(count) - points(count - 1))
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  has_interval_integral(
      f: real_function,
      left, right, integral_value: real): bool =
    left < right
      AND FORALL (epsilon_value: posreal):
        EXISTS (mesh_bound: posreal):
          FORALL
              (points, tags: real_sequence),
              (count: nat):
            (valid_tagged_partition(
                left, right, points, tags, count)
              AND mesh_less_than(points, count, mesh_bound))
            IMPLIES
              abs(
                riemann_sum(f, points, tags, count)
                  - integral_value)
                < epsilon_value

  interval_integral(
      f: real_function,
      left, right: real): real =
    IF EXISTS (integral_value: real):
        has_interval_integral(f, left, right, integral_value)
    THEN
      epsilon(
        LAMBDA (integral_value: real):
          has_interval_integral(
            f, left, right, integral_value))
    ELSE
      0
    ENDIF

  converges_at_real_top(
      values: positive_real_function,
      limit_value: real): bool =
    FORALL (epsilon_value: posreal):
      EXISTS (cutoff: posreal):
        FORALL (radius: posreal):
          cutoff <= radius IMPLIES
            abs(values(radius) - limit_value) < epsilon_value

  reciprocal_or_zero(x: real): real =
    IF x = 0 THEN 0 ELSE 1 / x ENDIF

  symmetric_truncation(
      f: real_function,
      radius: posreal): real =
    interval_integral(f, -radius, radius)

  transformed_truncation(
      f: real_function,
      radius: posreal): real =
    LET transformed: real_function =
          LAMBDA (x: real):
            f(x - reciprocal_or_zero(x))
    IN
      interval_integral(
        transformed, -radius, -(1 / radius))
        + interval_integral(
            transformed, 1 / radius, radius)

  putnam_1968_b4: bool =
    FORALL (f: real_function):
      (continuous(f)
        AND EXISTS (original_limit: real):
          converges_at_real_top(
            LAMBDA (radius: posreal):
              symmetric_truncation(f, radius),
            original_limit))
      IMPLIES
        EXISTS (common_limit: real):
          converges_at_real_top(
            LAMBDA (radius: posreal):
              transformed_truncation(f, radius),
            common_limit)
            AND converges_at_real_top(
              LAMBDA (radius: posreal):
                symmetric_truncation(f, radius),
              common_limit)
END putnam_1968_b4

import Mathlib

open Finset Polynomial Topology Filter Metric

abbrev putnam_1968_b5_solution : ℕ → ℕ := sorry
-- fun p => p^2 + p
/--
Let $p$ be a prime number. Find the number of distinct $2 \times 2$ matrices $$\begin{pmatrix} a & b \\ c & d \end{pmatrix}$$ such that $a, b, c, d \in \{0, 1, ..., p - 1\}$, $a + d \equiv 1 \pmod p$, and $ad - bc \equiv 0 \pmod p$.
-/
theorem putnam_1968_b5
(p : ℕ)
(hp : Prime p)
: {M : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) (ZMod p) | M 0 0 + M 1 1 = 1 ∧ M 0 0 * M 1 1 - M 0 1 * M 1 0 = 0}.ncard = putnam_1968_b5_solution p :=
sorry

title: putnam_1968_b5
content:
(* Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench artifact putnam_1968_b5:
   counting 2 x 2 matrices over the field with p elements that have trace 1
   and determinant 0. This file contains no proof. *)

From mathcomp Require Import all_ssreflect.

Set Implicit Arguments.
Unset Strict Implicit.
Unset Printing Implicit Defensive.

Definition putnam_1968_b5_solution (p : nat) : nat := (p ^ 2 + p)%nat.

Definition putnam_1968_b5_entry
    {p : nat} (M : 4.-tuple 'I_p) (i : 'I_4) : nat :=
  nat_of_ord (tnth M i).

Definition putnam_1968_b5_condition
    {p : nat} (M : 4.-tuple 'I_p) : bool :=
  let a := putnam_1968_b5_entry M (inord 0) in
  let b := putnam_1968_b5_entry M (inord 1) in
  let c := putnam_1968_b5_entry M (inord 2) in
  let d := putnam_1968_b5_entry M (inord 3) in
  (((a + d) %% p == 1) && ((a * d) %% p == (b * c) %% p))%nat.

Theorem putnam_1968_b5
    (p : nat)
    (hp : prime p) :
  #|[pred M : 4.-tuple 'I_p | putnam_1968_b5_condition M]|
    = putnam_1968_b5_solution p.
Proof. Admitted.

  the number of 2 by 2 matrices over residues modulo a prime with trace one
  and determinant zero. This file contains no proof.
*)

let statement =

     prime p
     ==> CARD
           {(a,b,c,d):num#num#num#num |

title: putnam_1968_b5
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1968_b5:
;; for prime p, the number of 2 by 2 matrices over ZMod p with trace one and
;; determinant zero is p^2 + p. This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

;; Every element of ZMod p has a unique representative in {0,...,p-1}.
;; Consequently, matrices over ZMod p are in bijection with the quadruples
;; enumerated below. ACL2's mod by the positive prime p expresses exactly the
;; two source equalities in ZMod p, so the nested count is the source ncard.

(defun putnam-1968-b5-no-divisor-through-p (p candidate)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix candidate)))
  (if (or (not (natp candidate))
          (<= candidate 1))
      t
    (and
     (not (equal (mod p candidate) 0))
     (putnam-1968-b5-no-divisor-through-p
      p (- candidate 1)))))

(defun putnam-1968-b5-prime-p (p)
  (and
   (natp p)
   (< 1 p)
   (putnam-1968-b5-no-divisor-through-p
    p (- p 1))))

(defun putnam-1968-b5-matrix-p (p a b c d)
  (and
   (natp p)
   (< 0 p)
   (natp a)
   (< a p)
   (natp b)
   (< b p)
   (natp c)
   (< c p)
   (natp d)
   (< d p)
   (equal (mod (+ a d) p) 1)
   (equal (mod (- (* a d) (* b c)) p) 0)))

(defun putnam-1968-b5-count-d (p a b c d-count)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix d-count)))
  (if (zp d-count)
      0
    (let ((d (- d-count 1)))
      (+
       (if (putnam-1968-b5-matrix-p p a b c d)
           1
         0)
       (putnam-1968-b5-count-d p a b c d)))))

(defun putnam-1968-b5-count-c (p a b c-count)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix c-count)))
  (if (zp c-count)
      0
    (let ((c (- c-count 1)))
      (+
       (putnam-1968-b5-count-d p a b c p)
       (putnam-1968-b5-count-c p a b c)))))

(defun putnam-1968-b5-count-b (p a b-count)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix b-count)))
  (if (zp b-count)
      0
    (let ((b (- b-count 1)))
      (+
       (putnam-1968-b5-count-c p a b p)
       (putnam-1968-b5-count-b p a b)))))

(defun putnam-1968-b5-count-a (p a-count)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix a-count)))
  (if (zp a-count)
      0
    (let ((a (- a-count 1)))
      (+
       (putnam-1968-b5-count-b p a p)

-- Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1968_b5:
-- for prime p, the number of 2 x 2 matrices over the p-element field with
-- trace 1 and determinant 0 is p squared plus p. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; _*_)

infix 4 _!=_ _<=N_
infixr 3 _and_
infixr 2 _or_

data Bottom : Set where

Not : Set -> Set
Not A =
  A -> Bottom

_!=_ : {A : Set} -> A -> A -> Set
x != y =
  Not (x == y)

record Top : Set where
  constructor truth

record _and_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data _or_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  left  : A -> A or B
  right : B -> A or B

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

data _<=N_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set where
  zero<=N   : {n : Nat} -> zero <=N n
  suc<=sucN : {m n : Nat} -> m <=N n -> suc m <=N suc n

data Fin : Nat -> Set where
  fzero : {n : Nat} -> Fin (suc n)
  fsuc  : {n : Nat} -> Fin n -> Fin (suc n)

record HasCardinality
  {A : Set}
  (P : A -> Set)
  (cardinality : Nat) :
  Set where

  field
    enumerate :
      Fin cardinality ->
      A
    enumerated-member :
      (index : Fin cardinality) ->
      P (enumerate index)
    enumeration-complete :
      (x : A) ->
      P x ->
      Exists (Fin cardinality)
        (\ index -> x == enumerate index)
    enumeration-injective :
      (left-index right-index : Fin cardinality) ->
      enumerate left-index == enumerate right-index ->
      left-index == right-index

CarrierHasCardinality :
  Set ->
  Nat ->
  Set
CarrierHasCardinality A cardinality =
  HasCardinality {A = A} (\ _ -> Top) cardinality

record Field (F : Set) : Set1 where
  field
    zeroF oneF : F
    add multiply : F -> F -> F
    negate inverse : F -> F

    zero-not-one :
      zeroF != oneF

    add-commutative :
      (x y : F) ->
      add x y == add y x
    add-associative :
      (x y z : F) ->
      add (add x y) z == add x (add y z)
    add-zero :
      (x : F) ->
      add x zeroF == x
    add-inverse :
      (x : F) ->
      add x (negate x) == zeroF

    multiply-commutative :
      (x y : F) ->
      multiply x y == multiply y x
    multiply-associative :
      (x y z : F) ->
      multiply (multiply x y) z ==
      multiply x (multiply y z)
    multiply-one :
      (x : F) ->
      multiply x oneF == x
    distribute :
      (x y z : F) ->
      multiply x (add y z) ==
      add (multiply x y) (multiply x z)
    multiply-inverse :
      (x : F) ->
      x != zeroF ->
      multiply x (inverse x) == oneF

open Field

subtract :
  {F : Set} ->
  Field F ->
  F ->
  F ->
  F
subtract fieldStructure x y =
  add fieldStructure x (negate fieldStructure y)

record Matrix2 (F : Set) : Set where
  constructor matrix
  field
    entry00 : F
    entry01 : F
    entry10 : F
    entry11 : F

open Matrix2

Qualifying :
  {F : Set} ->
  Field F ->
  Matrix2 F ->
  Set
Qualifying fieldStructure M =
  add fieldStructure
    (entry00 M)
    (entry11 M)
  == oneF fieldStructure
  and
  subtract fieldStructure
    (multiply fieldStructure
      (entry00 M)
      (entry11 M))
    (multiply fieldStructure
      (entry01 M)
      (entry10 M))
  == zeroF fieldStructure

Divides :
  Nat ->
  Nat ->
  Set
Divides divisor number =
  Exists Nat
    (\ factor -> divisor * factor == number)

oneN : Nat
oneN =
  suc zero

twoN : Nat
twoN =
  suc oneN

Prime :
  Nat ->
  Set
Prime p =
  twoN <=N p
  and
  ((divisor : Nat) ->
    Divides divisor p ->
    divisor == oneN or divisor == p)

putnam-1968-b5 : Set1
putnam-1968-b5 =
  (p : Nat) ->
  Prime p ->
  (F : Set) ->
  (fieldStructure : Field F) ->
  CarrierHasCardinality F p ->
  HasCardinality
    (Qualifying fieldStructure)
    (p * p + p)

(*
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench artifact putnam_1968_b5:
  the number of 2 by 2 matrices over a prime residue field with trace one
  and determinant zero is p squared plus p. This file contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open arithmeticTheory pred_setTheory ringTheory;

val putnam_1968_b5 =
  ``!p : num.
      prime p
      ==>
      CARD
        {M : (num # num) # (num # num) |
           FST (FST M) IN (ZN p).carrier /\
           SND (FST M) IN (ZN p).carrier /\
           FST (SND M) IN (ZN p).carrier /\
           SND (SND M) IN (ZN p).carrier /\
           (ZN p).sum.op (FST (FST M)) (SND (SND M)) =
             (ZN p).prod.id /\
           (ZN p).sum.op
             ((ZN p).prod.op (FST (FST M)) (SND (SND M)))
             ((ZN p).sum.inv
                ((ZN p).prod.op (SND (FST M)) (FST (SND M)))) =
             (ZN p).sum.id} =
      p EXP 2 + p``;

$(
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact
  putnam_1968_b5: the number of two-by-two matrices over the field of
  residues modulo a prime with trace one and determinant zero is p squared
  plus p. This file contains no proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  For each p in the SetMM class Prime, Z/nZ ` p is the quotient field of
  integers modulo p. The carrier of ( 0 ..^ 2 ) Mat ( Z/nZ ` p ) consists
  exactly of two-by-two matrices indexed by 0 and 1. The first conjunct is
  the trace-one condition using the field addition and unit, and the second
  uses SetMM's native determinant function and field zero.

  Thus the restricted class contains exactly the matrices quantified in the
  Lean and Isabelle sources, and # gives its finite cardinality. The final
  declaration is the single unproved $a corpus statement; this database
  contains no $p proof statement.
$)

${
  $d M p $.

  putnambench-putnam-1968-b5 $a |- A. p e. Prime
    (
      #
      `
      {
        M e. ( Base ` ( ( 0 ..^ 2 ) Mat ( Z/nZ ` p ) ) )
        |
        (
          (
            ( 0 M 0 )
            ( +g ` ( Z/nZ ` p ) )
            ( 1 M 1 )
          )
          =
          ( 1r ` ( Z/nZ ` p ) )
          /\
          (
            (
              ( ( 0 ..^ 2 ) maDet ( Z/nZ ` p ) )
              `
              M
            )
            =
            ( 0g ` ( Z/nZ ` p ) )
          )
        )
      }
      =
      ( ( p ^ 2 ) + p )
    )
  $.
$}

% Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench artifact putnam_1968_b5:
% for each prime p, exactly p^2 + p two-by-two matrices over the residues
% modulo p have trace 1 and determinant 0. This file contains no proof.

putnam_1968_b5: THEORY
BEGIN
  matrix: TYPE = [# a: nat, b: nat, c: nat, d: nat #]

  IMPORTING finite_sets[matrix]

  nat_divides(divisor: posnat, value: nat): bool =
    EXISTS (quotient: nat): value = divisor * quotient

  prime_nat(p: nat): bool =
    p >= 2
      AND FORALL (divisor: posnat):
        nat_divides(divisor, p)
          IMPLIES divisor = 1 OR divisor = p

  qualifying(M: matrix, p: posnat): bool =
    a(M) < p
      AND b(M) < p
      AND c(M) < p
      AND d(M) < p
      AND mod(a(M) + d(M), p) = 1
      AND mod(a(M) * d(M), p) = mod(b(M) * c(M), p)

  putnam_1968_b5: bool =
    FORALL (p: posnat):
      prime_nat(p)
        IMPLIES
          EXISTS (solutions: finite_set[matrix]):
            (FORALL (M: matrix):
              solutions(M) IFF qualifying(M, p))
              AND card(solutions) = p ^ 2 + p
END putnam_1968_b5

(* Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench artifact putnam_1968_b6:
   no sequence of compact sets of rational numbers contains every compact
   set of rational numbers as a subset. This file contains no proof. *)

From Stdlib Require Import QArith Qabs List.

Open Scope Q_scope.

Definition qset : Type := Q -> Prop.

Definition q_subset (S T : qset) : Prop :=
  forall x : Q, S x -> T x.

Definition q_open (U : qset) : Prop :=
  forall x : Q,
    U x ->
    exists epsilon : Q,
      0 < epsilon /\
      forall y : Q, Qabs (y - x) < epsilon -> U y.

Definition q_open_cover (cover : qset -> Prop) (S : qset) : Prop :=
  (forall U : qset, cover U -> q_open U) /\
  (forall x : Q, S x -> exists U : qset, cover U /\ U x).

Definition q_compact (S : qset) : Prop :=
  forall cover : qset -> Prop,
    q_open_cover cover S ->
    exists finite_cover : list qset,
      (forall U : qset, List.In U finite_cover -> cover U) /\
      (forall x : Q,
        S x ->
        exists U : qset, List.In U finite_cover /\ U x).

Theorem putnam_1968_b6 :
  ~ exists K : nat -> qset,
      (forall n : nat, q_compact (K n)) /\
      (forall S : qset,
        q_compact S ->
        exists n : nat, q_subset S (K n)).
Proof. Admitted.

;; Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1968_b6:
;; no sequence of compact subsets of the rationals is cofinal under inclusion
;; among all compact subsets of the rationals. This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))

;; Sets and set-valued sequences use the repository's tame APPLY$ function
;; objects. Compactness is represented by the equivalent sequential
;; compactness condition for the metric space of rational numbers.

(defun p68b6-member-p (set x)
  (if (apply$ set (list x)) t nil))

(defun p68b6-sequence-value (sequence n)
  (apply$ sequence (list n)))

(defun p68b6-family-set (family n)
  (apply$ family (list n)))

(defun-sk p68b6-set-values-rational-p (set)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (p68b6-member-p set x)
     (rationalp x))))

(defun p68b6-rational-set-p (set)
  (and
   (tamep-functionp set)
   (p68b6-set-values-rational-p set)))

(defun-sk p68b6-subset-values-p (left right)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (p68b6-member-p left x)
     (p68b6-member-p right x))))

(defun p68b6-subset-p (left right)
  (and
   (p68b6-rational-set-p left)
   (p68b6-rational-set-p right)
   (p68b6-subset-values-p left right)))

(defun-sk p68b6-sequence-values-in-set-p (set sequence)
  (forall (n)
    (implies
     (natp n)
     (let ((value (p68b6-sequence-value sequence n)))
       (and
        (rationalp value)
        (p68b6-member-p set value))))))

(defun p68b6-sequence-in-set-p (set sequence)
  (and
   (p68b6-rational-set-p set)
   (tamep-functionp sequence)
   (p68b6-sequence-values-in-set-p set sequence)))

(defun-sk p68b6-subsequence-values-p (subsequence)
  (forall (m n)
    (and
     (implies
      (natp m)
      (natp (p68b6-sequence-value subsequence m)))
     (implies
      (and
       (natp m)
       (natp n)
       (< m n))
      (< (p68b6-sequence-value subsequence m)
         (p68b6-sequence-value subsequence n))))))

(defun p68b6-subsequence-p (subsequence)
  (and
   (tamep-functionp subsequence)
   (p68b6-subsequence-values-p subsequence)))

(defun-sk p68b6-convergence-tail-p
    (sequence subsequence limit epsilon cutoff)
  (forall (n)
    (implies
     (and
      (natp n)
      (<= cutoff n))
     (<
      (abs
       (-
        (p68b6-sequence-value
         sequence
         (p68b6-sequence-value subsequence n))
        limit))
      epsilon))))

(defun-sk p68b6-convergence-tail-exists-p
    (sequence subsequence limit epsilon)
  (exists (cutoff)
    (and
     (natp cutoff)
     (p68b6-convergence-tail-p
      sequence subsequence limit epsilon cutoff))))

(defun-sk p68b6-converges-along-subsequence-p
    (sequence subsequence limit)
  (forall (epsilon)
    (implies
     (and
      (rationalp epsilon)
      (< 0 epsilon))
     (p68b6-convergence-tail-exists-p
      sequence subsequence limit epsilon))))

(defun-sk p68b6-compact-sequence-witness-exists-p
    (set sequence)
  (exists (subsequence limit)
    (and
     (p68b6-subsequence-p subsequence)
     (rationalp limit)
     (p68b6-member-p set limit)
     (p68b6-converges-along-subsequence-p
      sequence subsequence limit))))

(defun-sk p68b6-every-sequence-has-compact-witness-p (set)
  (forall (sequence)
    (implies
     (p68b6-sequence-in-set-p set sequence)
     (p68b6-compact-sequence-witness-exists-p
      set sequence))))

(defun p68b6-compact-rational-set-p (set)
  (and
   (p68b6-rational-set-p set)
   (p68b6-every-sequence-has-compact-witness-p set)))

(defun-sk p68b6-family-values-compact-p (family)
  (forall (n)
    (implies
     (natp n)
     (p68b6-compact-rational-set-p
      (p68b6-family-set family n)))))

(defun-sk p68b6-family-contains-set-p (family set)
  (exists (n)
    (and
     (natp n)
     (p68b6-subset-p
      set
      (p68b6-family-set family n)))))

(defun-sk p68b6-family-cofinal-p (family)
  (forall (set)
    (implies
     (p68b6-compact-rational-set-p set)
     (p68b6-family-contains-set-p family set))))

(defun p68b6-compact-cofinal-family-p (family)
  (and
   (tamep-functionp family)
   (p68b6-family-values-compact-p family)
   (p68b6-family-cofinal-p family)))

(defun-sk p68b6-compact-cofinal-family-exists-p ()
  (exists (family)
    (p68b6-compact-cofinal-family-p family)))

(defun putnambench-putnam-1968-b6-statement ()
  (not (p68b6-compact-cofinal-family-exists-p)))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

-- no sequence of compact sets of rational numbers contains every compact set
-- of rational numbers as a subset of one of its terms. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

open import Agda.Primitive using (Level; lsuc; _⊔_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Int using (Int; pos; negsuc)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; _*_)

infix 4 _!=_ _<=N_ _<N_
infixr 3 _and_

data Bottom : Set where

Not :
  {a : Level} ->
  Set a ->
  Set a
Not A =
  A -> Bottom

_!=_ :
  {a : Level} ->
  {A : Set a} ->
  A ->
  A ->
  Set a
x != y =
  Not (x == y)

record _and_
  {a b : Level}
  (A : Set a)
  (B : Set b) :
  Set (a ⊔ b) where

  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data Either
  {a b : Level}
  (A : Set a)
  (B : Set b) :
  Set (a ⊔ b) where

  left  : A -> Either A B
  right : B -> Either A B

record Exists
  {a p : Level}
  (A : Set a)
  (P : A -> Set p) :
  Set (a ⊔ p) where

  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

data _<=N_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set where
  zero<=N   : {n : Nat} -> zero <=N n
  suc<=sucN : {m n : Nat} -> m <=N n -> suc m <=N suc n

_<N_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set
m <N n =
  suc m <=N n

record CompleteOrderedRealField (R : Set) : Set1 where
  field
    zeroR oneR : R
    add multiply : R -> R -> R
    negate inverse : R -> R
    lessOrEqual : R -> R -> Set
    fromNat : Nat -> R

    one-not-zero :
      oneR != zeroR

    add-commutative :
      (x y : R) ->
      add x y == add y x
    add-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      add (add x y) z == add x (add y z)
    add-zero :
      (x : R) ->
      add x zeroR == x
    add-inverse :
      (x : R) ->
      add x (negate x) == zeroR

    multiply-commutative :
      (x y : R) ->
      multiply x y == multiply y x
    multiply-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply (multiply x y) z ==
      multiply x (multiply y z)
    multiply-one :
      (x : R) ->
      multiply x oneR == x
    multiply-zero :
      (x : R) ->
      multiply x zeroR == zeroR
    distribute :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply x (add y z) ==
      add (multiply x y) (multiply x z)
    inverse-zero :
      inverse zeroR == zeroR
    multiply-inverse :
      (x : R) ->
      x != zeroR ->
      multiply x (inverse x) == oneR

    order-reflexive :
      (x : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x x
    order-transitive :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y z ->
      lessOrEqual x z
    order-antisymmetric :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y x ->
      x == y
    order-total :
      (x y : R) ->
      Either (lessOrEqual x y) (lessOrEqual y x)
    add-order :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual (add z x) (add z y)
    multiply-nonnegative :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR x ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR y ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR (multiply x y)
    zero-less-than-one :
      (lessOrEqual zeroR oneR) and (zeroR != oneR)

    fromNat-zero :
      fromNat zero == zeroR
    fromNat-successor :
      (n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (suc n) == add (fromNat n) oneR
    fromNat-addition :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m + n) ==
      add (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-multiplication :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m * n) ==
      multiply (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-injective :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat m == fromNat n ->
      m == n

    archimedean :
      (x : R) ->
      Exists Nat
        (\ n -> lessOrEqual x (fromNat n))

    least-upper-bound :
      (P : R -> Set) ->
      Exists R P ->
      Exists R
        (\ upper ->
          (x : R) ->
          P x ->
          lessOrEqual x upper) ->
      Exists R
        (\ supremum ->
          ((x : R) ->
            P x ->
            lessOrEqual x supremum)
          and
          ((upper : R) ->
            ((x : R) ->
              P x ->
              lessOrEqual x upper) ->
            lessOrEqual supremum upper))

open CompleteOrderedRealField

StrictLess :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
StrictLess reals x y =
  (lessOrEqual reals x y) and (x != y)

subtract :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
subtract reals x y =
  add reals x (negate reals y)

fromInt :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Int ->
  R
fromInt reals (pos n) =
  fromNat reals n
fromInt reals (negsuc n) =
  negate reals (fromNat reals (suc n))

Subset :
  Set ->
  Set1
Subset R =
  R -> Set

SubsetOf :
  {R : Set} ->
  Subset R ->
  Subset R ->
  Set
SubsetOf S T =
  (x : _) ->
  S x ->
  T x

RationalPoint :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  Set
RationalPoint reals x =
  Exists Int
    (\ numerator ->
      Exists Nat
        (\ denominator-minus-one ->
          x ==
          multiply reals
            (fromInt reals numerator)
            (inverse reals
              (fromNat reals
                (suc denominator-minus-one)))))

ConvergesTo :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  R ->
  Set
ConvergesTo reals sequence limit =
  (epsilon : _) ->
  StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) epsilon ->
  Exists Nat
    (\ cutoff ->
      (n : Nat) ->
      cutoff <=N n ->
      (StrictLess reals
        (subtract reals limit epsilon)
        (sequence n))
      and
      (StrictLess reals
        (sequence n)
        (add reals limit epsilon)))

StrictlyIncreasing :
  (Nat -> Nat) ->
  Set
StrictlyIncreasing subsequence =
  (n : Nat) ->
  subsequence n <N subsequence (suc n)

Compact :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Subset R ->
  Set
Compact {R} reals S =
  (sequence : Nat -> R) ->
  ((n : Nat) -> S (sequence n)) ->
  Exists (Nat -> Nat)
    (\ subsequence ->
      (StrictlyIncreasing subsequence)
      and
      (Exists R
        (\ limit ->
          (S limit)
          and
          (ConvergesTo reals
            (\ n -> sequence (subsequence n))
            limit))))

CompactRationalSubset :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Subset R ->
  Set
CompactRationalSubset {R} reals S =
  (Compact reals S)
  and
  ((x : R) ->
    S x ->
    RationalPoint reals x)

CofinalCompactSequence :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Set1
CofinalCompactSequence {R} reals =
  Exists (Nat -> Subset R)
    (\ K ->
      ((n : Nat) ->
        CompactRationalSubset reals (K n))
      and
      ((S : Subset R) ->
        CompactRationalSubset reals S ->
        Exists Nat
          (\ n -> SubsetOf S (K n))))

putnam-1968-b6 : Set1
putnam-1968-b6 =
  (R : Set) ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) ->
  Not (CofinalCompactSequence reals)

  no sequence of compact sets of rational numbers is cofinal under set
  inclusion among all compact sets of rational numbers. This file contains

$(
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact
  putnam_1968_b6: no sequence of compact sets of rational numbers contains
  every compact set of rational numbers as a subset of one of its terms.
  This file contains no proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  K ranges over all functions from NN0 to the full power set of QQ. For a
  subset of QQ, restriction of the standard real topology gives the usual
  rational subspace topology, so membership of that restricted topology in
  Comp is exactly compactness of the rational set.

  The second universal quantifier ranges over every subset S of QQ and keeps
  the containing index existentially quantified. Thus the assertion is the
  negation of the same cofinal-sequence property stated in the Lean and
  Isabelle sources. The final declaration is the single unproved $a corpus
  statement; this database contains no $p proof statement.
$)

${
  $d K n S $.

  putnambench-putnam-1968-b6 $a |- -. E. K
    (
      K : NN0 --> ~P QQ
      /\
      (
        A. n e. NN0
          (
            ( ( TopOpen ` RRfld ) |`t ( K ` n ) )
            e. Comp
          )
        /\
        A. S e. ~P QQ
          (
            ( ( ( TopOpen ` RRfld ) |`t S ) e. Comp )
            ->
            E. n e. NN0 S C_ ( K ` n )
          )
      )
    )
  $.
$}

% Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench artifact putnam_1968_b6:
% no sequence of compact sets of rational numbers contains every compact
% set of rational numbers as a subset. This file contains no proof.

putnam_1968_b6: THEORY
BEGIN
  real_set: TYPE = [real -> bool]
  real_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> real]
  index_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> nat]
  set_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> real_set]

  converges(sequence: real_sequence, limit: real): bool =
    FORALL (epsilon_value: posreal):
      EXISTS (cutoff: nat):
        FORALL (index: nat):
          cutoff <= index IMPLIES
            abs(sequence(index) - limit) < epsilon_value

  strictly_increasing(indices: index_sequence): bool =
    FORALL (index: nat):
      indices(index) < indices(index + 1)

  compact(S: real_set): bool =
    FORALL (sequence: real_sequence):
      (FORALL (index: nat): S(sequence(index)))
      IMPLIES
        EXISTS (limit: real), (indices: index_sequence):
          S(limit)
            AND strictly_increasing(indices)
            AND converges(
              LAMBDA (index: nat):
                sequence(indices(index)),
              limit)

  rational_set(S: real_set): bool =
    FORALL (x: real):
      S(x) IMPLIES rational?(x)

  compact_rational_set(S: real_set): bool =
    compact(S) AND rational_set(S)

  subset_of(S, T: real_set): bool =
    FORALL (x: real):
      S(x) IMPLIES T(x)

  putnam_1968_b6: bool =
    NOT EXISTS (K: set_sequence):
      (FORALL (n: nat):
        compact_rational_set(K(n)))
      AND
        (FORALL (S: real_set):
          compact_rational_set(S)
            IMPLIES
              EXISTS (n: nat):
                subset_of(S, K(n)))
END putnam_1968_b6

content:
(* Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench artifact putnam_1969_a1:
   the possible ranges over R^2 of real bivariate polynomials are precisely
   singletons, open or closed rays, and R itself. This file contains no proof. *)

From Stdlib Require Import Reals.

Open Scope R_scope.

Record bivariate_polynomial : Type := {
  x_degree_bound : nat;
  y_degree_bound : nat;
  coefficient : nat -> nat -> R;
  coefficient_outside_bounds :
    forall i j : nat,
      ((x_degree_bound < i)%nat \/ (y_degree_bound < j)%nat) ->
      coefficient i j = 0
}.

Fixpoint finite_sum (n : nat) (f : nat -> R) : R :=
  match n with
  | O => f O
  | S k => finite_sum k f + f (S k)
  end.

Definition polynomial_eval
    (p : bivariate_polynomial) (x y : R) : R :=
  finite_sum (x_degree_bound p) (fun i : nat =>
    finite_sum (y_degree_bound p) (fun j : nat =>
      coefficient p i j * x ^ i * y ^ j)).

Definition is_polynomial_range
    (S : R -> Prop) : Prop :=
  exists p : bivariate_polynomial,
    forall z : R,
      S z <-> exists x y : R, polynomial_eval p x y = z.

Definition putnam_1969_a1_solution
    (S : R -> Prop) : Prop :=
  (exists c : R, forall z : R, S z <-> z = c) \/
  (exists c : R, forall z : R, S z <-> c <= z) \/
  (exists c : R, forall z : R, S z <-> z <= c) \/
  (exists c : R, forall z : R, S z <-> c < z) \/
  (exists c : R, forall z : R, S z <-> z < c) \/
  (forall z : R, S z).

Theorem putnam_1969_a1 :
  forall S : R -> Prop,
    is_polynomial_range S <-> putnam_1969_a1_solution S.
Admitted.

title: putnam_1969_a1
putnam_1969_a1
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1969_a1:
;; the ranges of bivariate polynomials over the real numbers are exactly the
;; singletons, open or closed rays, and the full real line. This file contains
;; no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))

;; The scalar arguments present a real-closed ordered field. By completeness
;; of the first-order theory of real-closed fields, the range classification
;; below is equivalent to its instance over the real numbers. A polynomial is
;; a finite list of (x-exponent y-exponent coefficient) terms; this is an exact
;; finite-support presentation, and range equality is stated extensionally.

(defun p69a1-member-p (carrier x)
  (if (apply$ carrier (list x)) t nil))

(defun p69a1-unary-value (operation x)
  (apply$ operation (list x)))

(defun p69a1-binary-value (operation x y)
  (apply$ operation (list x y)))

(defun p69a1-iff (left right)
  (if left
      (if right t nil)
    (if right nil t)))

(defun-sk p69a1-field-laws-p
    (carrier zero one add multiply negate inverse)
  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (p69a1-member-p carrier x)
      (p69a1-member-p carrier y)
      (p69a1-member-p carrier z))
     (and
      (p69a1-member-p
       carrier (p69a1-binary-value add x y))
      (p69a1-member-p
       carrier (p69a1-binary-value multiply x y))
      (p69a1-member-p
       carrier (p69a1-unary-value negate x))
      (p69a1-member-p
       carrier (p69a1-unary-value inverse x))
      (equal
       (p69a1-binary-value
        add (p69a1-binary-value add x y) z)
       (p69a1-binary-value
        add x (p69a1-binary-value add y z)))
      (equal
       (p69a1-binary-value add x y)
       (p69a1-binary-value add y x))
      (equal (p69a1-binary-value add x zero) x)
      (equal
       (p69a1-binary-value
        add x (p69a1-unary-value negate x))
       zero)
      (equal
       (p69a1-binary-value
        multiply
        (p69a1-binary-value multiply x y)
        z)
       (p69a1-binary-value
        multiply
        x
        (p69a1-binary-value multiply y z)))
      (equal
       (p69a1-binary-value multiply x y)
       (p69a1-binary-value multiply y x))
      (equal (p69a1-binary-value multiply x one) x)
      (implies
       (not (equal x zero))
       (equal
        (p69a1-binary-value
         multiply x (p69a1-unary-value inverse x))
        one))
      (equal
       (p69a1-binary-value
        multiply x (p69a1-binary-value add y z))
       (p69a1-binary-value
        add
        (p69a1-binary-value multiply x y)
        (p69a1-binary-value multiply x z)))))))

(defun-sk p69a1-order-laws-p
    (carrier zero add multiply less)
  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (p69a1-member-p carrier x)
      (p69a1-member-p carrier y)
      (p69a1-member-p carrier z))
     (and
      (not (p69a1-binary-value less x x))
      (or
       (equal x y)
       (p69a1-binary-value less x y)
       (p69a1-binary-value less y x))
      (implies
       (and
        (p69a1-binary-value less x y)
        (p69a1-binary-value less y z))
       (p69a1-binary-value less x z))
      (implies
       (p69a1-binary-value less x y)
       (p69a1-binary-value
        less
        (p69a1-binary-value add x z)
        (p69a1-binary-value add y z)))
      (implies
       (and
        (p69a1-binary-value less zero x)
        (p69a1-binary-value less zero y))
       (p69a1-binary-value
        less
        zero
        (p69a1-binary-value multiply x y)))))))

(defun p69a1-univariate-polynomial-p
    (carrier coefficients)
  (if (consp coefficients)
      (and
       (p69a1-member-p carrier (car coefficients))
       (p69a1-univariate-polynomial-p
        carrier (cdr coefficients)))
    (equal coefficients nil)))

(defun p69a1-univariate-eval
    (zero add multiply coefficients x)
  (if (consp coefficients)
      (p69a1-binary-value
       add
       (car coefficients)
       (p69a1-binary-value
        multiply
        x
        (p69a1-univariate-eval
         zero add multiply (cdr coefficients) x)))
    zero))

(defun p69a1-odd-degree-polynomial-p
    (carrier zero coefficients)
  (and
   (true-listp coefficients)
   (consp coefficients)
   (p69a1-univariate-polynomial-p carrier coefficients)
   (not (equal (car (last coefficients)) zero))
   (oddp (- (len coefficients) 1))))

(defun-sk p69a1-positive-square-root-exists-p
    (carrier multiply x)
  (exists (root)
    (and
     (p69a1-member-p carrier root)
     (equal
      (p69a1-binary-value multiply root root)
      x))))

(defun-sk p69a1-positive-elements-are-squares-p
    (carrier zero multiply less)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (and
      (p69a1-member-p carrier x)
      (p69a1-binary-value less zero x))
     (p69a1-positive-square-root-exists-p
      carrier multiply x))))

(defun-sk p69a1-odd-polynomial-root-exists-p
    (carrier zero add multiply coefficients)
  (exists (root)
    (and
     (p69a1-member-p carrier root)
     (equal
      (p69a1-univariate-eval
       zero add multiply coefficients root)
      zero))))

(defun-sk p69a1-odd-polynomials-have-roots-p
    (carrier zero add multiply)
  (forall (coefficients)
    (implies
     (p69a1-odd-degree-polynomial-p
      carrier zero coefficients)
     (p69a1-odd-polynomial-root-exists-p
      carrier zero add multiply coefficients))))

(defun p69a1-real-closed-field-p
    (carrier zero one add multiply negate inverse less)
  (and
   (tamep-functionp carrier)
   (tamep-functionp add)
   (tamep-functionp multiply)
   (tamep-functionp negate)
   (tamep-functionp inverse)
   (tamep-functionp less)
   (p69a1-member-p carrier zero)
   (p69a1-member-p carrier one)
   (not (equal zero one))
   (p69a1-field-laws-p
    carrier zero one add multiply negate inverse)
   (p69a1-order-laws-p
    carrier zero add multiply less)
   (p69a1-binary-value less zero one)
   (p69a1-positive-elements-are-squares-p
    carrier zero multiply less)
   (p69a1-odd-polynomials-have-roots-p
    carrier zero add multiply)))

(defun p69a1-term-p (carrier term)
  (and
   (true-listp term)
   (equal (len term) 3)
   (natp (nth 0 term))
   (natp (nth 1 term))
   (p69a1-member-p carrier (nth 2 term))))

(defun p69a1-polynomial-p (carrier polynomial)
  (if (consp polynomial)
      (and
       (p69a1-term-p carrier (car polynomial))
       (p69a1-polynomial-p carrier (cdr polynomial)))
    (equal polynomial nil)))

(defun p69a1-power (one multiply base exponent)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix exponent)))
  (if (zp exponent)
      one
    (p69a1-binary-value
     multiply
     base
     (p69a1-power
      one multiply base (- exponent 1)))))

(defun p69a1-term-value
    (one multiply term x y)
  (p69a1-binary-value
   multiply
   (nth 2 term)
   (p69a1-binary-value
    multiply
    (p69a1-power
     one multiply x (nth 0 term))
    (p69a1-power
     one multiply y (nth 1 term)))))

(defun p69a1-polynomial-value
    (zero one add multiply polynomial x y)
  (if (consp polynomial)
      (p69a1-binary-value
       add
       (p69a1-term-value
        one multiply (car polynomial) x y)
       (p69a1-polynomial-value
        zero one add multiply (cdr polynomial) x y))
    zero))

(defun-sk p69a1-range-member-p
    (carrier zero one add multiply polynomial value)
  (exists (x y)
    (and
     (p69a1-member-p carrier x)
     (p69a1-member-p carrier y)
     (equal
      (p69a1-polynomial-value
       zero one add multiply polynomial x y)
      value))))

(defun-sk p69a1-range-equals-singleton-p
    (carrier zero one add multiply polynomial endpoint)
  (forall (value)
    (implies
     (p69a1-member-p carrier value)
     (p69a1-iff
      (p69a1-range-member-p
       carrier zero one add multiply polynomial value)
      (equal value endpoint)))))

(defun-sk p69a1-range-equals-closed-upper-ray-p
    (carrier zero one add multiply less polynomial endpoint)
  (forall (value)
    (implies
     (p69a1-member-p carrier value)
     (p69a1-iff
      (p69a1-range-member-p
       carrier zero one add multiply polynomial value)
      (not (p69a1-binary-value less value endpoint))))))

(defun-sk p69a1-range-equals-closed-lower-ray-p
    (carrier zero one add multiply less polynomial endpoint)
  (forall (value)
    (implies
     (p69a1-member-p carrier value)
     (p69a1-iff
      (p69a1-range-member-p
       carrier zero one add multiply polynomial value)
      (not (p69a1-binary-value less endpoint value))))))

(defun-sk p69a1-range-equals-open-lower-ray-p
    (carrier zero one add multiply less polynomial endpoint)
  (forall (value)
    (implies
     (p69a1-member-p carrier value)
     (p69a1-iff
      (p69a1-range-member-p
       carrier zero one add multiply polynomial value)
      (p69a1-binary-value less value endpoint)))))

(defun-sk p69a1-range-equals-open-upper-ray-p
    (carrier zero one add multiply less polynomial endpoint)
  (forall (value)
    (implies
     (p69a1-member-p carrier value)
     (p69a1-iff
      (p69a1-range-member-p
       carrier zero one add multiply polynomial value)
      (p69a1-binary-value less endpoint value)))))

(defun-sk p69a1-range-equals-universe-p
    (carrier zero one add multiply polynomial)
  (forall (value)
    (implies
     (p69a1-member-p carrier value)
     (p69a1-range-member-p
      carrier zero one add multiply polynomial value))))

(defun-sk p69a1-range-equals-nonuniversal-solution-p
    (carrier zero one add multiply less polynomial)
  (exists (endpoint)
    (and
     (p69a1-member-p carrier endpoint)
     (or
      (p69a1-range-equals-singleton-p
       carrier zero one add multiply polynomial endpoint)
      (p69a1-range-equals-closed-upper-ray-p
       carrier zero one add multiply less polynomial endpoint)
      (p69a1-range-equals-closed-lower-ray-p
       carrier zero one add multiply less polynomial endpoint)
