-- Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1969_a1:
-- the possible ranges of real bivariate polynomials are exactly the singletons,
-- four one-sided intervals, and the whole real line. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.List using (List; []; _∷_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc)

infix 4 _!=_
infixr 3 _and_
infixr 2 _or_

data Bottom : Set where

record Top : Set where
  constructor truth

Not : Set -> Set
Not A = A -> Bottom

_!=_ : {A : Set} -> A -> A -> Set
x != y = Not (x == y)

record _and_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data _or_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  left  : A -> A or B
  right : B -> A or B

record Iff (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor equivalence
  field
    forward  : A -> B
    backward : B -> A

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

record CompleteOrderedField (R : Set) : Set1 where
  field
    zeroR oneR : R
    add multiply : R -> R -> R
    negate inverse : R -> R
    lessOrEqual : R -> R -> Set
    fromNat : Nat -> R

    one-not-zero :
      oneR != zeroR

    add-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> add x y == add y x
    add-associative :
      (x y z : R) -> add (add x y) z == add x (add y z)
    add-zero :
      (x : R) -> add x zeroR == x
    add-inverse :
      (x : R) -> add x (negate x) == zeroR

    multiply-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> multiply x y == multiply y x
    multiply-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply (multiply x y) z == multiply x (multiply y z)
    multiply-one :
      (x : R) -> multiply x oneR == x
    multiply-zero :
      (x : R) -> multiply x zeroR == zeroR
    distribute :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply x (add y z) ==
      add (multiply x y) (multiply x z)
    inverse-zero :
      inverse zeroR == zeroR
    multiply-inverse :
      (x : R) ->
      x != zeroR ->
      multiply x (inverse x) == oneR

    order-reflexive :
      (x : R) -> lessOrEqual x x
    order-transitive :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y z ->
      lessOrEqual x z
    order-antisymmetric :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y x ->
      x == y
    order-total :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y or lessOrEqual y x
    add-order :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual (add z x) (add z y)
    multiply-nonnegative :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR x ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR y ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR (multiply x y)
    zero-less-than-one :
      lessOrEqual zeroR oneR and zeroR != oneR

    fromNat-zero :
      fromNat zero == zeroR
    fromNat-successor :
      (n : Nat) -> fromNat (suc n) == add (fromNat n) oneR
    fromNat-injective :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat m == fromNat n ->
      m == n

    archimedean :
      (x : R) ->
      Exists Nat (\ n -> lessOrEqual x (fromNat n))
    least-upper-bound :
      (P : R -> Set) ->
      Exists R P ->
      Exists R
        (\ upper ->
          (x : R) ->
          P x ->
          lessOrEqual x upper) ->
      Exists R
        (\ supremum ->
          ((x : R) -> P x -> lessOrEqual x supremum)
          and
          ((upper : R) ->
            ((x : R) -> P x -> lessOrEqual x upper) ->
            lessOrEqual supremum upper))

open CompleteOrderedField

record Monomial (R : Set) : Set where
  constructor monomial
  field
    coefficient : R
    x-exponent  : Nat
    y-exponent  : Nat

open Monomial

Polynomial : Set -> Set
Polynomial R = List (Monomial R)

power :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  Nat ->
  R
power reals x zero =
  oneR reals
power reals x (suc n) =
  multiply reals x (power reals x n)

evaluateMonomial :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  Monomial R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
evaluateMonomial reals term x y =
  multiply reals
    (coefficient term)
    (multiply reals
      (power reals x (x-exponent term))
      (power reals y (y-exponent term)))

evaluate :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  Polynomial R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
evaluate reals [] x y =
  zeroR reals
evaluate reals (term ∷ terms) x y =
  add reals
    (evaluateMonomial reals term x y)
    (evaluate reals terms x y)

module Putnam1969A1Statement
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) where

  Subset : Set1
  Subset = R -> Set

  SetEqual : Subset -> Subset -> Set
  SetEqual A B =
    (z : R) -> Iff (A z) (B z)

  StrictLess : R -> R -> Set
  StrictLess x y =
    lessOrEqual reals x y and x != y

  PolynomialRange : Polynomial R -> Subset
  PolynomialRange polynomial z =
    Exists R
      (\ x ->
        Exists R
          (\ y ->
            evaluate reals polynomial x y == z))

  HasPolynomialRange : Subset -> Set
  HasPolynomialRange S =
    Exists (Polynomial R)
      (\ polynomial ->
        SetEqual S (PolynomialRange polynomial))

  Singleton : R -> Subset
  Singleton endpoint z =
    z == endpoint

  ClosedAbove : R -> Subset
  ClosedAbove endpoint z =
    lessOrEqual reals endpoint z

  ClosedBelow : R -> Subset
  ClosedBelow endpoint z =
    lessOrEqual reals z endpoint

  OpenAbove : R -> Subset
  OpenAbove endpoint z =
    StrictLess endpoint z

  OpenBelow : R -> Subset
  OpenBelow endpoint z =
    StrictLess z endpoint

  Universal : Subset
  Universal z =
    Top

  ClassifiedRange : Subset -> Set
  ClassifiedRange S =
    Exists R
      (\ endpoint ->
        SetEqual S (Singleton endpoint)
        or
        SetEqual S (ClosedAbove endpoint)
        or
        SetEqual S (ClosedBelow endpoint)
        or
        SetEqual S (OpenAbove endpoint)
        or
        SetEqual S (OpenBelow endpoint))
    or
    SetEqual S Universal

  proposition : Set1
  proposition =
    (S : Subset) ->
    Iff
      (HasPolynomialRange S)
      (ClassifiedRange S)

putnam-1969-a1 : Set1
putnam-1969-a1 =
  (R : Set) ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) ->
  Putnam1969A1Statement.proposition reals

% Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench artifact putnam_1969_a1:
% classification of the possible ranges of real bivariate polynomials as
% singletons, open or closed half-lines, or all real numbers. This file contains no proof.

putnam_1969_a1: THEORY
BEGIN
  real_set: TYPE = [real -> bool]
  coefficient_table: TYPE = [nat, nat -> real]

  row_value(
      coefficients: coefficient_table,
      x_index: nat,
      y: real,
      count: nat): RECURSIVE real =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      LET y_index: nat = count - 1 IN
        row_value(coefficients, x_index, y, count - 1)
          + coefficients(x_index, y_index) * y ^ y_index
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  bivariate_polynomial_value(
      coefficients: coefficient_table,
      x, y: real,
      x_count, y_count: nat): RECURSIVE real =
    IF x_count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      LET x_index: nat = x_count - 1 IN
        bivariate_polynomial_value(
          coefficients, x, y, x_count - 1, y_count)
          + row_value(coefficients, x_index, y, y_count)
              * x ^ x_index
    ENDIF
  MEASURE x_count

  is_polynomial_range(S: real_set): bool =
    EXISTS
        (coefficients: coefficient_table),
        (x_count, y_count: nat):
      FORALL (z: real):
        S(z) IFF
          EXISTS (x, y: real):
            bivariate_polynomial_value(
              coefficients, x, y, x_count, y_count) = z

  is_classified_range(S: real_set): bool =
    (EXISTS (endpoint: real):
      FORALL (z: real): S(z) IFF z = endpoint)
    OR
    (EXISTS (endpoint: real):
      FORALL (z: real): S(z) IFF endpoint <= z)
    OR
    (EXISTS (endpoint: real):
      FORALL (z: real): S(z) IFF z <= endpoint)
    OR
    (EXISTS (endpoint: real):
      FORALL (z: real): S(z) IFF endpoint < z)
    OR
    (EXISTS (endpoint: real):
      FORALL (z: real): S(z) IFF z < endpoint)
    OR
    (FORALL (z: real): S(z))

  putnam_1969_a1: bool =
    FORALL (S: real_set):
      is_polynomial_range(S) IFF is_classified_range(S)
END putnam_1969_a1

(* Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench artifact putnam_1969_a2:
   the determinant of the finite real matrix with entries |i - j|.
   This file contains no proof. *)

From Stdlib Require Import Reals List Arith ZArith.

Import ListNotations.
Open Scope R_scope.

Fixpoint putnam_1969_a2_sum (xs : list R) : R :=
  match xs with
  | [] => 0
  | x :: rest => x + putnam_1969_a2_sum rest
  end.

Definition putnam_1969_a2_delete_nth
    {A : Type} (j : nat) (xs : list A) : list A :=
  firstn j xs ++ skipn (S j) xs.

Definition putnam_1969_a2_cofactor_sign (j : nat) : R :=
  if Nat.even j then 1 else -1.

Fixpoint putnam_1969_a2_det
    (n : nat) (M : list (list R)) {struct n} : R :=
  match n with
  | O => 1
  | S k =>
      match M with
      | [] => 0
      | row :: rows =>
          putnam_1969_a2_sum
            (map
              (fun j : nat =>
                putnam_1969_a2_cofactor_sign j *
                nth j row 0 *
                putnam_1969_a2_det k
                  (map (putnam_1969_a2_delete_nth j) rows))
              (seq 0 (S k)))
      end
  end.

Definition putnam_1969_a2_matrix (n : nat) : list (list R) :=
  map
    (fun i : nat =>
      map (fun j : nat => Rabs (INR i - INR j)) (seq 0 n))
    (seq 0 n).

Theorem putnam_1969_a2 :
  forall n : nat,
    (0 < n)%nat ->
    putnam_1969_a2_det n (putnam_1969_a2_matrix n) =
      powerRZ (-1) ((Z.of_nat n - 1)%Z) *
      IZR ((Z.of_nat n - 1)%Z) *
      powerRZ 2 ((Z.of_nat n - 2)%Z).
Admitted.

(in-package "ACL2")

;; The matrix entries are integers. Its determinant over the reals is therefore
;; the canonical real image of the exact integer Leibniz sum computed below.
;; Permutations are image lists for the ordered index set {0,...,n-1}.

(defun putnam-1969-a2-range-from (start count)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix count)))
  (if (zp count)

  (if (endp values)
      (list (list value))
    (cons (cons value values)

           (putnam-1969-a2-insert-everywhere

     (putnam-1969-a2-insert-everywhere
      value (car permutations))

      value (cdr permutations)))))

(defun putnam-1969-a2-permutations (values)
  (if (endp values)
      (list nil)
    (putnam-1969-a2-insert-into-each

-- Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1969_a2:
-- the determinant of the real n by n matrix with entries |i - j| has the
-- stated closed form for every positive n. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; _-_; _*_)

infix 4 _!=_ _<=N_
infixr 3 _and_
infixr 2 _or_

data Bottom : Set where

Not : Set -> Set
Not A =
  A -> Bottom

_!=_ : {A : Set} -> A -> A -> Set
x != y =
  Not (x == y)

record _and_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data _or_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  left  : A -> A or B
  right : B -> A or B

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

data _<=N_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set where
  zero<= : {n : Nat} -> zero <=N n
  suc<=suc : {m n : Nat} -> m <=N n -> suc m <=N suc n

data Fin : Nat -> Set where
  fzero : {n : Nat} -> Fin (suc n)
  fsuc  : {n : Nat} -> Fin n -> Fin (suc n)

finToNat : {n : Nat} -> Fin n -> Nat
finToNat fzero =
  zero
finToNat (fsuc i) =
  suc (finToNat i)

record CompleteOrderedRealField (R : Set) : Set1 where
  field
    zeroR oneR : R
    addR multiplyR : R -> R -> R
    negateR inverseR absoluteR : R -> R
    lessOrEqualR : R -> R -> Set
    fromNatR : Nat -> R

    oneR-not-zeroR :
      oneR != zeroR

    addR-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> addR x y == addR y x
    addR-associative :
      (x y z : R) -> addR (addR x y) z == addR x (addR y z)
    addR-zero :
      (x : R) -> addR x zeroR == x
    addR-inverse :
      (x : R) -> addR x (negateR x) == zeroR

    multiplyR-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> multiplyR x y == multiplyR y x
    multiplyR-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiplyR (multiplyR x y) z ==
      multiplyR x (multiplyR y z)
    multiplyR-one :
      (x : R) -> multiplyR x oneR == x
    multiplyR-zero :
      (x : R) -> multiplyR x zeroR == zeroR
    distributeR :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiplyR x (addR y z) ==
      addR (multiplyR x y) (multiplyR x z)
    inverseR-zero :
      inverseR zeroR == zeroR
    multiplyR-inverse :
      (x : R) ->
      x != zeroR ->
      multiplyR x (inverseR x) == oneR

    order-reflexive :
      (x : R) -> lessOrEqualR x x
    order-transitive :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR x y ->
      lessOrEqualR y z ->
      lessOrEqualR x z
    order-antisymmetric :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR x y ->
      lessOrEqualR y x ->
      x == y
    order-total :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR x y or lessOrEqualR y x
    addR-order :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR x y ->
      lessOrEqualR (addR z x) (addR z y)
    multiplyR-nonnegative :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR zeroR x ->
      lessOrEqualR zeroR y ->
      lessOrEqualR zeroR (multiplyR x y)
    zeroR-less-than-oneR :
      lessOrEqualR zeroR oneR and zeroR != oneR

    fromNatR-zero :
      fromNatR zero == zeroR
    fromNatR-successor :
      (n : Nat) ->
      fromNatR (suc n) == addR (fromNatR n) oneR
    fromNatR-addition :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNatR (m + n) == addR (fromNatR m) (fromNatR n)
    fromNatR-multiplication :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNatR (m * n) == multiplyR (fromNatR m) (fromNatR n)
    fromNatR-injective :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNatR m == fromNatR n ->
      m == n

    archimedean :
      (x : R) ->
      Exists Nat (\ n -> lessOrEqualR x (fromNatR n))
    least-upper-bound :
      (P : R -> Set) ->
      Exists R P ->
      Exists R
        (\ upper ->
          (x : R) ->
          P x ->
          lessOrEqualR x upper) ->
      Exists R
        (\ supremum ->
          ((x : R) -> P x -> lessOrEqualR x supremum)
          and
          ((upper : R) ->
            ((x : R) -> P x -> lessOrEqualR x upper) ->
            lessOrEqualR supremum upper))

    absoluteR-nonnegative :
      (x : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR zeroR (absoluteR x)
    absoluteR-of-nonnegative :
      (x : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR zeroR x ->
      absoluteR x == x
    absoluteR-of-nonpositive :
      (x : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR x zeroR ->
      absoluteR x == negateR x

open CompleteOrderedRealField

subtract :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
subtract reals x y =
  addR reals x (negateR reals y)

power :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  Nat ->
  R
power reals x zero =
  oneR reals
power reals x (suc n) =
  multiplyR reals x (power reals x n)

sumFin :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  {n : Nat} ->
  (Fin n -> R) ->
  R
sumFin reals {zero} term =
  zeroR reals
sumFin reals {suc n} term =
  addR reals
    (term fzero)
    (sumFin reals (\ i -> term (fsuc i)))

Matrix : Set -> Nat -> Set
Matrix R n =
  Fin n -> Fin n -> R

skip :
  {n : Nat} ->
  Fin (suc n) ->
  Fin n ->
  Fin (suc n)
skip {zero} column ()
skip {suc n} fzero k =
  fsuc k
skip {suc n} (fsuc column) fzero =
  fzero
skip {suc n} (fsuc column) (fsuc k) =
  fsuc (skip column k)

firstRowMinor :
  {R : Set} {n : Nat} ->
  Matrix R (suc n) ->
  Fin (suc n) ->
  Matrix R n
firstRowMinor A column i j =
  A (fsuc i) (skip column j)

alternatingSign :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  {n : Nat} ->
  Fin n ->
  R
alternatingSign reals fzero =
  oneR reals
alternatingSign reals (fsuc i) =
  negateR reals (alternatingSign reals i)

determinant :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  {n : Nat} ->
  Matrix R n ->
  R
determinant reals {zero} A =
  oneR reals
determinant reals {suc n} A =
  sumFin reals
    (\ column ->
      multiplyR reals
        (alternatingSign reals column)
        (multiplyR reals
          (A fzero column)
          (determinant reals (firstRowMinor A column))))

distanceMatrix :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (n : Nat) ->
  Matrix R n
distanceMatrix reals n i j =
  absoluteR reals
    (subtract reals
      (fromNatR reals (finToNat i))
      (fromNatR reals (finToNat j)))

oneN : Nat
oneN =
  suc zero

twoN : Nat
twoN =
  suc oneN

closedForm :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Nat ->
  R
closedForm reals n =
  multiplyR reals
    (multiplyR reals
      (power reals
        (negateR reals (oneR reals))
        (n - oneN))
      (fromNatR reals (n - oneN)))
    (power reals
      (fromNatR reals twoN)
      (n - twoN))

module Putnam1969A2Statement
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) where

  proposition : Set
  proposition =
    (n : Nat) ->
    oneN <=N n ->
    determinant reals (distanceMatrix reals n)
    ==
    closedForm reals n

putnam-1969-a2 : Set1
putnam-1969-a2 =
  (R : Set) ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) ->
  Putnam1969A2Statement.proposition reals

content:
% Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench artifact putnam_1969_a2:
% the determinant of the n-by-n real matrix with entries |i-j| has the
% stated closed form for every n at least 2. This file contains no proof.

putnam_1969_a2: THEORY
BEGIN
  matrix: TYPE = [nat, nat -> real]

  quotient_aux(
      numerator, denominator, fuel: nat): RECURSIVE nat =
    IF fuel = 0
        OR denominator = 0
        OR numerator < denominator THEN
      0
    ELSE
      1
        + quotient_aux(
            numerator - denominator,
            denominator,
            fuel - 1)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE fuel

  remainder_aux(
      numerator, denominator, fuel: nat): RECURSIVE nat =
    IF fuel = 0
        OR denominator = 0
        OR numerator < denominator THEN
      numerator
    ELSE
      remainder_aux(
        numerator - denominator,
        denominator,
        fuel - 1)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE fuel

  safe_ndiv(numerator, denominator: nat): nat =
    quotient_aux(
      numerator,
      denominator,
      numerator + 1)

  safe_mod(numerator, denominator: nat): nat =
    IF denominator = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      remainder_aux(
        numerator,
        denominator,
        numerator + 1)
    ENDIF

  function_code_count(n: nat): nat =
    IF n = 0 THEN 1 ELSE n ^ n ENDIF

  permutation_entry(code, row, n: nat): nat =
    IF n = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      safe_mod(safe_ndiv(code, n ^ row), n)
    ENDIF

  permutation_code(code, n: nat): bool =
    code < function_code_count(n)
      AND (FORALL (row_1, row_2: nat):
        (row_1 < n
          AND row_2 < n
          AND permutation_entry(code, row_1, n)
            = permutation_entry(code, row_2, n))
        IMPLIES row_1 = row_2)

  pair_row(pair, n: nat): nat =
    safe_ndiv(pair, n)

  pair_column(pair, n: nat): nat =
    safe_mod(pair, n)

  inversion_at(code, pair, n: nat): bool =
    pair_row(pair, n) < n
      AND pair_column(pair, n) < n
      AND pair_row(pair, n) < pair_column(pair, n)
      AND permutation_entry(code, pair_row(pair, n), n)
        > permutation_entry(code, pair_column(pair, n), n)

  count_true(
      property: [nat -> bool],
      count: nat): RECURSIVE nat =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      count_true(property, count - 1)
        + IF property(count - 1) THEN 1 ELSE 0 ENDIF
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  inversion_count(code, n: nat): nat =
    count_true(
      (LAMBDA (pair: nat): inversion_at(code, pair, n)),
      n * n)

  permutation_sign(code, n: nat): real =
    IF mod(inversion_count(code, n), 2) = 0 THEN
      1
    ELSE
      -1
    ENDIF

  permutation_product(
      A: matrix,
      code, n, count: nat): RECURSIVE real =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      1
    ELSE
      permutation_product(A, code, n, count - 1)
        * A(
            count - 1,
            permutation_entry(code, count - 1, n))
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  determinant_sum(
      A: matrix,
      n, limit: nat): RECURSIVE real =
    IF limit = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      LET code: nat = limit - 1 IN
        determinant_sum(A, n, limit - 1)
          + IF permutation_code(code, n) THEN
              permutation_sign(code, n)
                * permutation_product(A, code, n, n)
            ELSE
              0
            ENDIF
    ENDIF
  MEASURE limit

  determinant(A: matrix, n: nat): real =
    determinant_sum(A, n, function_code_count(n))

  distance_matrix: matrix =
    (LAMBDA (row, column: nat):
      abs((row :: real) - (column :: real)))

  putnam_1969_a2: bool =
    FORALL (n: nat):
      n >= 2 IMPLIES
        determinant(distance_matrix, n)
          = ((-1 :: real) ^ (n - 1))
              * ((n - 1) :: real)
              * ((2 :: real) ^ (n - 2))
END putnam_1969_a2

putnam_1969_a4
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1969_a4:
;; the real integral of x^x on (0,1) equals the alternating infinite series
;; with nth term (-1)^(n+1)/n^n. This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(defun putnam-1969-a4-series-prefix (terms)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix terms)))
  (if (zp terms)
      0
    (let ((sign (if (equal (mod terms 2) 1) 1 -1)))
      (+ (putnam-1969-a4-series-prefix (- terms 1))
         (/ sign (expt terms terms))))))

;; For 1 <= INDEX <= SUBDIVISIONS, (INDEX/SUBDIVISIONS)^
;; (INDEX/SUBDIVISIONS) is the unique number in [0,1] whose SUBDIVISIONS-th
;; power is (INDEX/SUBDIVISIONS)^INDEX. Bisection therefore gives rational
;; lower approximations to the exact real integrand values.
(defun putnam-1969-a4-root-lower
    (radicand degree steps lower upper)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix steps)))
  (if (zp steps)
      lower
    (let ((midpoint (/ (+ lower upper) 2)))
      (if (<= (expt midpoint degree) radicand)
          (putnam-1969-a4-root-lower
           radicand degree (- steps 1) midpoint upper)
        (putnam-1969-a4-root-lower
         radicand degree (- steps 1) lower midpoint)))))

(defun putnam-1969-a4-grid-value
    (index subdivisions root-steps)
  (putnam-1969-a4-root-lower
   (expt (/ index subdivisions) index)
   subdivisions
   root-steps
   0
   1))

(defun putnam-1969-a4-riemann-sum-aux
    (index subdivisions root-steps)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix index)))
  (if (zp index)
      0
    (+ (putnam-1969-a4-grid-value
        index subdivisions root-steps)
       (putnam-1969-a4-riemann-sum-aux
        (- index 1) subdivisions root-steps))))

(defun putnam-1969-a4-riemann-sum
    (subdivisions root-steps)
  (if (and (natp subdivisions)
           (< 0 subdivisions)
           (natp root-steps))
      (/ (putnam-1969-a4-riemann-sum-aux
          subdivisions subdivisions root-steps)
         subdivisions)
    0))

;; The exact source equality is stated through its epsilon definition. The
;; first precision parameter truncates the alternating series, the second is
;; the right-Riemann mesh, and the third controls the exact-root bisections.
;; Requiring one existential cutoff for all three independent tails says that
;; the series prefixes and Riemann approximants have the same real limit. It
;; deliberately asserts no particular convergence rate.
(defun-sk putnam-1969-a4-common-tail-p (epsilon cutoff)
  (forall (terms subdivisions root-steps)
    (implies
     (and (natp terms)
          (natp subdivisions)
          (< 0 subdivisions)
          (natp root-steps)
          (<= cutoff terms)
          (<= cutoff subdivisions)
          (<= cutoff root-steps))
     (< (abs
         (- (putnam-1969-a4-series-prefix terms)
            (putnam-1969-a4-riemann-sum
             subdivisions root-steps)))
        epsilon))))

(defun-sk putnam-1969-a4-cutoff-exists-p (epsilon)
  (exists (cutoff)
    (and (natp cutoff)
         (< 0 cutoff)
         (putnam-1969-a4-common-tail-p epsilon cutoff))))

(defun putnambench-putnam-1969-a4-statement (epsilon)
  (implies
   (and (rationalp epsilon)
        (< 0 epsilon))
   (putnam-1969-a4-cutoff-exists-p epsilon)))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

title: putnam_1969_a4
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1969_a4:
-- the integral of x raised to x over the unit interval equals the alternating
-- series with terms (-1)^(n+1) times n^(-n). This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; _*_)

infix 4 _!=_ _<=N_
infixr 3 _and_
infixr 2 _or_

data Bottom : Set where

Not : Set -> Set
Not A =
  A -> Bottom

_!=_ : {A : Set} -> A -> A -> Set
x != y =
  Not (x == y)

record _and_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data _or_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  left  : A -> A or B
  right : B -> A or B

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

data _<=N_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set where
  zero<=   : {n : Nat} -> zero <=N n
  suc<=suc : {m n : Nat} -> m <=N n -> suc m <=N suc n

record CompleteOrderedField (R : Set) : Set1 where
  field
    zeroR oneR : R
    add multiply : R -> R -> R
    negate inverse : R -> R
    lessOrEqual : R -> R -> Set
    fromNat : Nat -> R

    one-not-zero :
      oneR != zeroR

    add-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> add x y == add y x
    add-associative :
      (x y z : R) -> add (add x y) z == add x (add y z)
    add-zero :
      (x : R) -> add x zeroR == x
    add-inverse :
      (x : R) -> add x (negate x) == zeroR

    multiply-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> multiply x y == multiply y x
    multiply-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply (multiply x y) z == multiply x (multiply y z)
    multiply-one :
      (x : R) -> multiply x oneR == x
    multiply-zero :
      (x : R) -> multiply x zeroR == zeroR
    distribute :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply x (add y z) ==
      add (multiply x y) (multiply x z)
    inverse-zero :
      inverse zeroR == zeroR
    multiply-inverse :
      (x : R) ->
      x != zeroR ->
      multiply x (inverse x) == oneR

    order-reflexive :
      (x : R) -> lessOrEqual x x
    order-transitive :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y z ->
      lessOrEqual x z
    order-antisymmetric :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y x ->
      x == y
    order-total :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y or lessOrEqual y x
    add-order :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual (add z x) (add z y)
    multiply-nonnegative :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR x ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR y ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR (multiply x y)
    zero-less-than-one :
      lessOrEqual zeroR oneR and zeroR != oneR

    fromNat-zero :
      fromNat zero == zeroR
    fromNat-successor :
      (n : Nat) -> fromNat (suc n) == add (fromNat n) oneR
    fromNat-addition :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m + n) == add (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-multiplication :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m * n) == multiply (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-injective :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat m == fromNat n ->
      m == n

    archimedean :
      (x : R) ->
      Exists Nat (\ n -> lessOrEqual x (fromNat n))
    least-upper-bound :
      (P : R -> Set) ->
      Exists R P ->
      Exists R
        (\ upper ->
          (x : R) ->
          P x ->
          lessOrEqual x upper) ->
      Exists R
        (\ supremum ->
          ((x : R) ->
            P x ->
            lessOrEqual x supremum)
          and
          ((upper : R) ->
            ((x : R) ->
              P x ->
              lessOrEqual x upper) ->
            lessOrEqual supremum upper))

open CompleteOrderedField

subtract :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
subtract reals x y =
  add reals x (negate reals y)

divide :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
divide reals x y =
  multiply reals x (inverse reals y)

StrictLess :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
StrictLess reals x y =
  lessOrEqual reals x y and x != y

CloseTo :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
CloseTo reals center radius x =
  StrictLess reals
    (subtract reals center radius)
    x
  and
  StrictLess reals
    x
    (add reals center radius)

naturalPower :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  Nat ->
  R
naturalPower reals x zero =
  oneR reals
naturalPower reals x (suc n) =
  multiply reals
    (naturalPower reals x n)
    x

factorial : Nat -> Nat
factorial zero =
  suc zero
factorial (suc n) =
  suc n * factorial n

sumFirst :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  Nat ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  R
sumFirst reals zero term =
  zeroR reals
sumFirst reals (suc n) term =
  add reals
    (sumFirst reals n term)
    (term n)

ConvergesTo :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  R ->
  Set
ConvergesTo {R} reals sequence limit =
  (epsilon : R) ->
  StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) epsilon ->
  Exists Nat
    (\ cutoff ->
      (n : Nat) ->
      cutoff <=N n ->
      CloseTo reals limit epsilon (sequence n))

SeriesHasSum :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  R ->
  Set
SeriesHasSum reals terms limit =
  ConvergesTo reals
    (\ n -> sumFirst reals n terms)
    limit

exponentialTerm :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  Nat ->
  R
exponentialTerm reals x n =
  divide reals
    (naturalPower reals x n)
    (fromNat reals (factorial n))

ExponentialValue :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
ExponentialValue reals x value =
  SeriesHasSum reals
    (exponentialTerm reals x)
    value

record StandardRealPowers
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) :
  Set1 where

  field
    exponential logarithm : R -> R

    exponential-series :
      (x : R) ->
      ExponentialValue reals x (exponential x)

    exponential-positive :
      (x : R) ->
      StrictLess reals
        (zeroR reals)
        (exponential x)

    exponential-injective :
      (x y : R) ->
      exponential x == exponential y ->
      x == y

    exponential-logarithm :
      (x : R) ->
      StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) x ->
      exponential (logarithm x) == x

open StandardRealPowers

realPower :
  {R : Set} ->
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R} ->
  StandardRealPowers reals ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
realPower {reals = reals} powers base exponent =
  exponential powers
    (multiply reals exponent (logarithm powers base))

rightRiemannSum :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  (R -> R) ->
  Nat ->
  R
rightRiemannSum reals function pieces =
  let
    step = divide reals (oneR reals) (fromNat reals pieces)
  in
  sumFirst reals pieces
    (\ i ->
      multiply reals
        (function
          (multiply reals
            (fromNat reals (suc i))
            step))
        step)

UnitIntervalIntegralValue :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  (R -> R) ->
  R ->
  Set
UnitIntervalIntegralValue reals function value =
  ConvergesTo reals
    (\ n -> rightRiemannSum reals function (suc n))
    value

putnamIntegrand :
  {R : Set} ->
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R} ->
  StandardRealPowers reals ->
  R ->
  R
putnamIntegrand powers x =
  realPower powers x x

putnamTerm :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  Nat ->
  R
putnamTerm reals n =
  divide reals
    (naturalPower reals
      (negate reals (oneR reals))
      (suc (suc n)))
    (naturalPower reals
      (fromNat reals (suc n))
      (suc n))

putnam-1969-a4 : Set1
putnam-1969-a4 =
  (R : Set) ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) ->
  (powers : StandardRealPowers reals) ->
  Exists R
    (\ commonValue ->
      UnitIntervalIntegralValue reals
        (putnamIntegrand powers)
        commonValue
      and
      SeriesHasSum reals
        (putnamTerm reals)
        commonValue)

$(
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact
  putnam_1969_a4: convergence of the alternating real series with terms
  n to the power negative n to the integral of x to the power x on the
  unit interval. This file contains no proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  The mapping on ZZ is the integer-indexed sequence from the Isabelle and
  Lean sources. For each n its finite sum uses the inclusive positive-integer
  interval 1 ... n; values before index one do not affect the limit and its
  restriction to natural indices is the Rocq sequence.

  Since every summation index i is positive, division by i ^ i is exactly
  multiplication by i raised to negative i. On the open interval (0,1),
  exp(x * log(x)) is x raised to the real power x. The open-interval
  Lebesgue integral matches the Lean and Rocq sources, and endpoint inclusion
  does not change it, matching the Isabelle interval integral.

  The final declaration is the single unproved $a corpus statement; this
  database contains no $p proof statement.
$)

${
  $d i n x $.

  putnambench-putnam-1969-a4 $a |-
    (
      n e. ZZ |->
        sum_ i e. ( 1 ... n )
          (
            ( ( -u 1 ) ^ ( i + 1 ) )
            /
            ( i ^ i )
          )
    )
    ~~>
    (
      S. ( 0 (,) 1 )
        ( exp ` ( x x. ( log ` x ) ) )
        _d x
    )
  $.
$}

title: putnam_1969_a4
content:
% Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench artifact putnam_1969_a4:
% the alternating series with terms (-1)^(n+1) n^(-n) converges to the
% unit-interval integral of x^x. This file contains no proof.

putnam_1969_a4: THEORY
BEGIN
  real_function: TYPE = [real -> real]
  real_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> real]

  safe_div(numerator, denominator: real): real =
    IF denominator = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      numerator / denominator
    ENDIF

  nat_factorial(index: nat): RECURSIVE nat =
    IF index = 0 THEN
      1
    ELSE
      index * nat_factorial(index - 1)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE index

  exponential_partial(x: real, count: nat): RECURSIVE real =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      LET index: nat = count - 1 IN
        exponential_partial(x, count - 1)
          + safe_div(
              x ^ index,
              nat_factorial(index) :: real)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  converges_to(sequence: real_sequence, value: real): bool =
    FORALL (epsilon_value: posreal):
      EXISTS (cutoff: nat):
        FORALL (index: nat):
          cutoff <= index IMPLIES
            abs(sequence(index) - value) < epsilon_value

  real_exponential(x: real): real =
    epsilon(
      LAMBDA (value: real):
        converges_to(
          LAMBDA (count: nat):
            exponential_partial(x, count),
          value))

  natural_log(x: real): real =
    IF x > 0 THEN
      epsilon(
        LAMBDA (value: real):
          real_exponential(value) = x)
    ELSE
      0
    ENDIF

  real_power(base, exponent: real): real =
    IF base > 0 THEN
      real_exponential(exponent * natural_log(base))
    ELSIF base = 0 AND exponent = 0 THEN
      1
    ELSE
      0
    ENDIF

  integrand(x: real): real =
    real_power(x, x)

  alternating_sign(index: nat): RECURSIVE real =
    IF index = 0 THEN
      1
    ELSE
      -alternating_sign(index - 1)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE index

  series_partial_sum(count: nat): RECURSIVE real =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      series_partial_sum(count - 1)
        + alternating_sign(count + 1)
            * safe_div(
                1,
                (count :: real) ^ count)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  valid_partition(
      points: real_sequence,
      count: nat): bool =
    count > 0
      AND points(0) = 0
      AND points(count) = 1
      AND FORALL (index: nat):
        index < count IMPLIES
          points(index) < points(index + 1)

  valid_tags(
      points, tags: real_sequence,
      count: nat): bool =
    FORALL (index: nat):
      index < count IMPLIES
        points(index) <= tags(index)
          AND tags(index) <= points(index + 1)

  mesh_less_than(
      points: real_sequence,
      count: nat,
      bound: real): bool =
    FORALL (index: nat):
      index < count IMPLIES
        points(index + 1) - points(index) < bound

  riemann_sum(
      f: real_function,
      points, tags: real_sequence,
      count: nat): RECURSIVE real =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      riemann_sum(f, points, tags, count - 1)
        + f(tags(count - 1))
            * (points(count) - points(count - 1))
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  has_unit_interval_integral(
      f: real_function,
      integral_value: real): bool =
    FORALL (epsilon_value: posreal):
      EXISTS (mesh_bound: posreal):
        FORALL
            (points, tags: real_sequence),
            (count: nat):
          (valid_partition(points, count)
            AND valid_tags(points, tags, count)
            AND mesh_less_than(
              points, count, mesh_bound))
          IMPLIES
            abs(
              riemann_sum(f, points, tags, count)
                - integral_value)
              < epsilon_value

  unit_interval_integral(f: real_function): real =
    IF EXISTS (integral_value: real):
        has_unit_interval_integral(f, integral_value)
    THEN
      epsilon(
        LAMBDA (integral_value: real):
          has_unit_interval_integral(
            f, integral_value))
    ELSE
      0
    ENDIF

  putnam_1969_a4: bool =
    converges_to(
      LAMBDA (count: nat):
        series_partial_sum(count),
      unit_interval_integral(integrand))
END putnam_1969_a4

title: putnam_1969_a5

import Mathlib

open Matrix Filter Topology Set Nat

/--
Consider the system of differential equations $$\frac{dx}{dt} = -2y + u(t), \frac{dy}{dt} = -2x + u(t)$$ for some continuous function $u(t)$. Prove that, if $x(0) \ne y(0)$, the solution will never pass through $(0, 0)$ regardless of the choice of $u(t)$, and if $x(0) = y(0)$, a suitable $u(t)$ can be chosen for any $T > 0$ so that $(x(T), y(T)) = (0, 0)$.
-/
theorem putnam_1969_a5
    (x0 y0 t : ℝ)
    (ht : 0 < t) :
    x0 = y0 ↔ ∃ x y u : ℝ → ℝ,
      Differentiable ℝ x ∧
      Differentiable ℝ y ∧
      Continuous u ∧
      deriv x = - 2 • y + u ∧
      deriv y = - 2 • x + u ∧
      x 0 = x0 ∧
      y 0 = y0 ∧
      x t = 0 ∧
      y t = 0 :=
  sorry

content:
From mathcomp Require Import all_ssreflect ssrnum ssralg.
From mathcomp Require Import reals exp sequences topology normedtype derive.
From mathcomp Require Import classical_sets.
Import numFieldNormedType.Exports.

Set Implicit Arguments.
Unset Strict Implicit.
Unset Printing Implicit Defensive.

Local Open Scope ring_scope.
Local Open Scope classical_set_scope.

Variable R : realType.
Theorem putnam_1969_a5
    (x0 y0 t : R)
    (ht : 0 < t) :
    x0 = y0 <-> exists x y u : R -> R,
        (forall x' : R, differentiable x x') /\
        (forall y' : R, differentiable y y') /\
        continuous u /\
        (forall x' : R, x^`() x' = -2 * (y x') + u x') /\
        (forall y' : R, y^`() y' = -2 * (x y') + u y') /\
        x 0 = x0 /\
        y 0 = y0 /\
        x t = 0 /\
        y t = 0.
Proof. Admitted.

title: putnam_1969_a5

theory putnam_1969_a5 imports Complex_Main
"HOL-Analysis.Derivative"
begin

theorem putnam_1969_a5:
  fixes x0 y0 t :: "real"
  assumes ht : "0 < t"
  shows "x0 = y0 \<longleftrightarrow> (\<exists> x y u :: real \<Rightarrow> real.
          x differentiable_on UNIV \<and>
          y differentiable_on UNIV \<and>
          continuous_on UNIV u \<and>
          (\<forall> p :: real. deriv x p = -2 * y p + u p) \<and>
          (\<forall> p :: real. deriv y p = -2 * x p + u p) \<and>
          x 0 = x0 \<and>
          y 0 = y0 \<and>
          x t = 0 \<and>
          y t = 0)"
  sorry


end

title: putnam_1969_a5
putnam_1969_a5
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1969_a5:
;; a controlled two-dimensional real differential system reaches the origin
;; at a positive time exactly when its two initial coordinates agree. This
;; file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))

;; A Dedekind-complete ordered field presents the real numbers up to the
;; unique ordered-field isomorphism. APPLY$ function objects represent the
;; arbitrary real-valued functions in the source, and DEFUN-SK keeps the
;; existential witnesses x, y, and u internal to the statement. Continuity
;; and differentiability are expanded by their global epsilon-delta
;; definitions.

(defun p69a5-member-p (carrier value)
  (if (apply$ carrier (list value)) t nil))

(defun p69a5-unary-value (function value)
  (apply$ function (list value)))

(defun p69a5-binary-value (function left right)
  (apply$ function (list left right)))

(defun-sk p69a5-real-function-values-p (carrier function)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (p69a5-member-p carrier x)
     (p69a5-member-p
      carrier
      (p69a5-unary-value function x)))))

(defun p69a5-real-function-p (carrier function)
  (and
   (tamep-functionp function)
   (p69a5-real-function-values-p carrier function)))

;; Complete ordered-field presentation of the real scalar domain.

(defun-sk p69a5-field-laws-p
    (carrier zero one add multiply negate inverse)
  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (p69a5-member-p carrier x)
      (p69a5-member-p carrier y)
      (p69a5-member-p carrier z))
     (let* ((xy-add (p69a5-binary-value add x y))
            (yz-add (p69a5-binary-value add y z))
            (xy-mul (p69a5-binary-value multiply x y))
            (yz-mul (p69a5-binary-value multiply y z))
            (neg-x (p69a5-unary-value negate x))
            (inv-x (p69a5-unary-value inverse x)))
       (and
        (p69a5-member-p carrier xy-add)
        (p69a5-member-p carrier xy-mul)
        (p69a5-member-p carrier neg-x)
        (p69a5-member-p carrier inv-x)
        (equal
         (p69a5-binary-value add xy-add z)
         (p69a5-binary-value add x yz-add))
        (equal xy-add (p69a5-binary-value add y x))
        (equal (p69a5-binary-value add x zero) x)
        (equal (p69a5-binary-value add x neg-x) zero)
        (equal
         (p69a5-binary-value multiply xy-mul z)
         (p69a5-binary-value multiply x yz-mul))
        (equal xy-mul (p69a5-binary-value multiply y x))
        (equal (p69a5-binary-value multiply x one) x)
        (equal
         (p69a5-binary-value multiply x yz-add)
         (p69a5-binary-value
          add
          (p69a5-binary-value multiply x y)
          (p69a5-binary-value multiply x z)))
        (implies
         (equal x zero)
         (equal inv-x zero))
        (implies
         (not (equal x zero))
         (equal
          (p69a5-binary-value multiply x inv-x)
          one)))))))

(defun-sk p69a5-order-laws-p
    (carrier zero add multiply less)
  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (p69a5-member-p carrier x)
      (p69a5-member-p carrier y)
      (p69a5-member-p carrier z))
     (let ((xy (p69a5-binary-value less x y))
           (yx (p69a5-binary-value less y x))
           (yz (p69a5-binary-value less y z)))
       (and
        (not (p69a5-binary-value less x x))
        (or xy yx (equal x y))
        (implies
         (and xy yz)
         (p69a5-binary-value less x z))
        (implies
         xy
         (p69a5-binary-value
          less
          (p69a5-binary-value add x z)
          (p69a5-binary-value add y z)))
        (implies
         (and
          (p69a5-binary-value less zero x)
          (p69a5-binary-value less zero y))
         (p69a5-binary-value
          less
          zero
          (p69a5-binary-value multiply x y))))))))

(defun-sk p69a5-set-subset-carrier-p (carrier set)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (p69a5-member-p set x)
     (p69a5-member-p carrier x))))

(defun p69a5-valid-set-p (carrier set)
  (and
   (tamep-functionp set)
   (p69a5-set-subset-carrier-p carrier set)))

(defun-sk p69a5-set-nonempty-p (carrier set)
  (exists (x)
    (and
     (p69a5-member-p carrier x)
     (p69a5-member-p set x))))

(defun-sk p69a5-upper-bound-p (carrier less set upper)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (and
      (p69a5-member-p carrier x)
      (p69a5-member-p set x))
     (not (p69a5-binary-value less upper x)))))

(defun-sk p69a5-bounded-above-p (carrier less set)
  (exists (upper)
    (and
     (p69a5-member-p carrier upper)
     (p69a5-upper-bound-p
      carrier less set upper))))

(defun-sk p69a5-least-upper-bound-p
    (carrier less set supremum)
  (forall (upper)
    (implies
     (and
      (p69a5-member-p carrier upper)
      (p69a5-upper-bound-p
       carrier less set upper))
     (not (p69a5-binary-value
           less upper supremum)))))

(defun p69a5-supremum-p
    (carrier less set supremum)
  (and
   (p69a5-member-p carrier supremum)
   (p69a5-upper-bound-p
    carrier less set supremum)
   (p69a5-least-upper-bound-p
    carrier less set supremum)))

(defun-sk p69a5-dedekind-complete-p
    (carrier less supremum-operation)
  (forall (set)
    (implies
     (and
      (p69a5-valid-set-p carrier set)
      (p69a5-set-nonempty-p carrier set)
      (p69a5-bounded-above-p carrier less set))
     (p69a5-supremum-p
      carrier
      less
      set
      (p69a5-unary-value supremum-operation set)))))

(defun p69a5-real-field-p
    (carrier zero one add multiply negate inverse less supremum)
  (and
   (tamep-functionp carrier)
   (tamep-functionp add)
   (tamep-functionp multiply)
   (tamep-functionp negate)
   (tamep-functionp inverse)
   (tamep-functionp less)
   (tamep-functionp supremum)
   (p69a5-member-p carrier zero)
   (p69a5-member-p carrier one)
   (not (equal zero one))
   (p69a5-field-laws-p
    carrier zero one add multiply negate inverse)
   (p69a5-order-laws-p
    carrier zero add multiply less)
   (p69a5-dedekind-complete-p
    carrier less supremum)
   (p69a5-binary-value less zero one)))

;; Real-field context and arithmetic.

(defun p69a5-r-carrier (ctx) (nth 0 ctx))
(defun p69a5-r-zero (ctx) (nth 1 ctx))
(defun p69a5-r-one (ctx) (nth 2 ctx))
(defun p69a5-r-add (ctx) (nth 3 ctx))
(defun p69a5-r-mul (ctx) (nth 4 ctx))
(defun p69a5-r-neg (ctx) (nth 5 ctx))
(defun p69a5-r-inv (ctx) (nth 6 ctx))
(defun p69a5-r-lt (ctx) (nth 7 ctx))
(defun p69a5-r-sup (ctx) (nth 8 ctx))

(defun p69a5-context-p (ctx)
  (and
   (true-listp ctx)
   (equal (len ctx) 9)
   (p69a5-real-field-p
    (p69a5-r-carrier ctx)
    (p69a5-r-zero ctx)
    (p69a5-r-one ctx)
    (p69a5-r-add ctx)
    (p69a5-r-mul ctx)
    (p69a5-r-neg ctx)
    (p69a5-r-inv ctx)
    (p69a5-r-lt ctx)
    (p69a5-r-sup ctx))))

(defun p69a5-r-add-value (ctx left right)
  (p69a5-binary-value
   (p69a5-r-add ctx) left right))

(defun p69a5-r-neg-value (ctx value)
  (p69a5-unary-value
   (p69a5-r-neg ctx) value))

(defun p69a5-r-sub-value (ctx left right)
  (p69a5-r-add-value
   ctx left (p69a5-r-neg-value ctx right)))

(defun p69a5-r-mul-value (ctx left right)
  (p69a5-binary-value
   (p69a5-r-mul ctx) left right))

(defun p69a5-r-lt-p (ctx left right)
  (if (p69a5-binary-value
       (p69a5-r-lt ctx) left right)
      t nil))

(defun p69a5-r-le-p (ctx left right)
  (not (p69a5-r-lt-p ctx right left)))

(defun p69a5-r-abs-value (ctx value)
  (if (p69a5-r-lt-p
       ctx value (p69a5-r-zero ctx))
      (p69a5-r-neg-value ctx value)
    value))

(defun p69a5-positive-real-p (ctx value)
  (and
   (p69a5-member-p
    (p69a5-r-carrier ctx) value)
   (p69a5-r-lt-p
    ctx (p69a5-r-zero ctx) value)))

(defun p69a5-negative-two (ctx)
  (p69a5-r-neg-value
   ctx
   (p69a5-r-add-value
    ctx
    (p69a5-r-one ctx)
    (p69a5-r-one ctx))))

;; Global continuity on the represented real line.

(defun-sk p69a5-continuity-neighborhood-p
    (ctx function x epsilon radius)
  (forall (y)
    (implies
     (and
      (p69a5-member-p
       (p69a5-r-carrier ctx) y)
      (p69a5-r-lt-p
       ctx
       (p69a5-r-abs-value
        ctx (p69a5-r-sub-value ctx y x))
       radius))
     (p69a5-r-lt-p
      ctx
      (p69a5-r-abs-value
       ctx
       (p69a5-r-sub-value
        ctx
        (p69a5-unary-value function y)
        (p69a5-unary-value function x)))
      epsilon))))

(defun-sk p69a5-continuity-radius-exists-p
    (ctx function x epsilon)
  (exists (radius)
    (and
     (p69a5-positive-real-p ctx radius)
     (p69a5-continuity-neighborhood-p
      ctx function x epsilon radius))))

(defun-sk p69a5-continuous-at-p
    (ctx function x)
  (forall (epsilon)
    (implies
     (p69a5-positive-real-p ctx epsilon)
     (p69a5-continuity-radius-exists-p
      ctx function x epsilon))))

(defun-sk p69a5-continuous-p (ctx function)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (p69a5-member-p
      (p69a5-r-carrier ctx) x)
     (p69a5-continuous-at-p
      ctx function x))))

;; HasDerivAt in epsilon-delta form:
;; |f(y)-f(x)-d*(y-x)| <= epsilon*|y-x| near x.

(defun-sk p69a5-derivative-neighborhood-p
    (ctx function derivative x epsilon radius)
  (forall (y)
    (implies
     (and
      (p69a5-member-p
       (p69a5-r-carrier ctx) y)
      (p69a5-r-lt-p
       ctx
       (p69a5-r-abs-value
        ctx (p69a5-r-sub-value ctx y x))
       radius))
     (p69a5-r-le-p
      ctx
      (p69a5-r-abs-value
       ctx
       (p69a5-r-sub-value
        ctx
        (p69a5-r-sub-value
         ctx
         (p69a5-unary-value function y)
         (p69a5-unary-value function x))
        (p69a5-r-mul-value
         ctx derivative
         (p69a5-r-sub-value ctx y x))))
      (p69a5-r-mul-value
       ctx epsilon
       (p69a5-r-abs-value
        ctx (p69a5-r-sub-value ctx y x)))))))

(defun-sk p69a5-derivative-radius-exists-p
    (ctx function derivative x epsilon)
  (exists (radius)
    (and
     (p69a5-positive-real-p ctx radius)
     (p69a5-derivative-neighborhood-p
      ctx function derivative x epsilon radius))))

(defun-sk p69a5-has-derivative-at-p
    (ctx function derivative x)
  (forall (epsilon)
    (implies
     (p69a5-positive-real-p ctx epsilon)
     (p69a5-derivative-radius-exists-p
      ctx function derivative x epsilon))))

(defun-sk p69a5-differentiable-at-p
    (ctx function x)
  (exists (derivative)
    (and
     (p69a5-member-p
      (p69a5-r-carrier ctx) derivative)
     (p69a5-has-derivative-at-p
      ctx function derivative x))))

(defun-sk p69a5-differentiable-p (ctx function)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (p69a5-member-p
      (p69a5-r-carrier ctx) x)
     (p69a5-differentiable-at-p
      ctx function x))))

;; The coupled differential equations, pointwise on the whole real line.

(defun p69a5-x-derivative-value
    (ctx y u point)
  (p69a5-r-add-value
   ctx
   (p69a5-r-mul-value
    ctx
    (p69a5-negative-two ctx)
    (p69a5-unary-value y point))
   (p69a5-unary-value u point)))

(defun p69a5-y-derivative-value
    (ctx x u point)
  (p69a5-r-add-value
   ctx
   (p69a5-r-mul-value
    ctx
    (p69a5-negative-two ctx)
    (p69a5-unary-value x point))
   (p69a5-unary-value u point)))

(defun-sk p69a5-ode-system-p (ctx x y u)
  (forall (point)
    (implies
     (p69a5-member-p
      (p69a5-r-carrier ctx) point)
     (and
      (p69a5-has-derivative-at-p
       ctx x
       (p69a5-x-derivative-value
        ctx y u point)
       point)
      (p69a5-has-derivative-at-p
       ctx y
       (p69a5-y-derivative-value
        ctx x u point)
       point)))))

(defun p69a5-solution-p
    (ctx x0 y0 time x y u)
  (and
   (p69a5-real-function-p
    (p69a5-r-carrier ctx) x)
   (p69a5-real-function-p
    (p69a5-r-carrier ctx) y)
   (p69a5-real-function-p
    (p69a5-r-carrier ctx) u)
   (p69a5-differentiable-p ctx x)
   (p69a5-differentiable-p ctx y)
   (p69a5-continuous-p ctx u)
   (p69a5-ode-system-p ctx x y u)
   (equal
    (p69a5-unary-value x (p69a5-r-zero ctx))
    x0)
   (equal
    (p69a5-unary-value y (p69a5-r-zero ctx))
    y0)
   (equal
    (p69a5-unary-value x time)
    (p69a5-r-zero ctx))
   (equal
    (p69a5-unary-value y time)
    (p69a5-r-zero ctx))))

(defun-sk p69a5-solution-exists-p
    (ctx x0 y0 time)
  (exists (x y u)
    (p69a5-solution-p
     ctx x0 y0 time x y u)))

(defun putnambench-putnam-1969-a5-statement
    (ctx x0 y0 time)
  (implies
   (and
    (p69a5-context-p ctx)
    (p69a5-member-p
     (p69a5-r-carrier ctx) x0)
    (p69a5-member-p
     (p69a5-r-carrier ctx) y0)
    (p69a5-positive-real-p ctx time))
   (iff
    (equal x0 y0)
    (p69a5-solution-exists-p
     ctx x0 y0 time))))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

title: putnam_1969_a5
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1969_a5:
-- for a controlled symmetric system of two real differential equations, the
-- origin is reachable at any positive time exactly when the initial coordinates
-- are equal. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; _*_)

infix 4 _!=_
infixr 3 _and_
infix 2 _iff_

data Bottom : Set where

Not : Set -> Set
Not A =
  A -> Bottom

_!=_ : {A : Set} -> A -> A -> Set
x != y =
  Not (x == y)

record _and_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

record _iff_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor equivalence
  field
    forward  : A -> B
    backward : B -> A

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

data _or_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  left  : A -> A or B
  right : B -> A or B

record CompleteOrderedRealField (R : Set) : Set1 where
  field
    zeroR oneR : R
    addR multiplyR : R -> R -> R
    negateR inverseR : R -> R
    lessOrEqualR : R -> R -> Set
    fromNatR : Nat -> R

    oneR-not-zeroR :
      oneR != zeroR

    addR-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> addR x y == addR y x
    addR-associative :
      (x y z : R) -> addR (addR x y) z == addR x (addR y z)
    addR-zero :
      (x : R) -> addR x zeroR == x
    addR-inverse :
      (x : R) -> addR x (negateR x) == zeroR

    multiplyR-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> multiplyR x y == multiplyR y x
    multiplyR-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiplyR (multiplyR x y) z ==
      multiplyR x (multiplyR y z)
    multiplyR-one :
      (x : R) -> multiplyR x oneR == x
    multiplyR-zero :
      (x : R) -> multiplyR x zeroR == zeroR
    distributeR :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiplyR x (addR y z) ==
      addR (multiplyR x y) (multiplyR x z)
    inverseR-zero :
      inverseR zeroR == zeroR
    multiplyR-inverse :
      (x : R) ->
      x != zeroR ->
      multiplyR x (inverseR x) == oneR

    order-reflexive :
      (x : R) -> lessOrEqualR x x
    order-transitive :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR x y ->
      lessOrEqualR y z ->
      lessOrEqualR x z
    order-antisymmetric :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR x y ->
      lessOrEqualR y x ->
      x == y
    order-total :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR x y or lessOrEqualR y x
    addR-order :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR x y ->
      lessOrEqualR (addR z x) (addR z y)
    multiplyR-nonnegative :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR zeroR x ->
      lessOrEqualR zeroR y ->
      lessOrEqualR zeroR (multiplyR x y)
    zeroR-less-than-oneR :
      lessOrEqualR zeroR oneR and zeroR != oneR

    fromNatR-zero :
      fromNatR zero == zeroR
    fromNatR-successor :
      (n : Nat) ->
      fromNatR (suc n) == addR (fromNatR n) oneR
    fromNatR-addition :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNatR (m + n) == addR (fromNatR m) (fromNatR n)
    fromNatR-multiplication :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNatR (m * n) == multiplyR (fromNatR m) (fromNatR n)
    fromNatR-injective :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNatR m == fromNatR n ->
      m == n

    archimedean :
      (x : R) ->
      Exists Nat (\ n -> lessOrEqualR x (fromNatR n))
    least-upper-bound :
      (P : R -> Set) ->
      Exists R P ->
      Exists R
        (\ upper ->
          (x : R) ->
          P x ->
          lessOrEqualR x upper) ->
      Exists R
        (\ supremum ->
          ((x : R) ->
            P x ->
            lessOrEqualR x supremum)
          and
          ((upper : R) ->
            ((x : R) ->
              P x ->
              lessOrEqualR x upper) ->
            lessOrEqualR supremum upper))

open CompleteOrderedRealField

subtract :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
subtract reals x y =
  addR reals x (negateR reals y)

divide :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
divide reals x y =
  multiplyR reals x (inverseR reals y)

StrictLess :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
StrictLess reals x y =
  lessOrEqualR reals x y and x != y

CloseTo :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
CloseTo reals center radius x =
  StrictLess reals (subtract reals center radius) x
  and
  StrictLess reals x (addR reals center radius)

differenceQuotient :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (R -> R) ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
differenceQuotient reals function point x =
  divide reals
    (subtract reals (function x) (function point))
    (subtract reals x point)

DerivativeAt :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (R -> R) ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
DerivativeAt {R} reals function point derivative =
  (epsilon : R) ->
  StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) epsilon ->
  Exists R
    (\ delta ->
      StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) delta
      and
      ((x : R) ->
        CloseTo reals point delta x ->
        x != point ->
        CloseTo reals derivative epsilon
          (differenceQuotient reals function point x)))

ContinuousAt :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (R -> R) ->
  R ->
  Set
ContinuousAt {R} reals function point =
  (epsilon : R) ->
  StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) epsilon ->
  Exists R
    (\ delta ->
      StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) delta
      and
      ((x : R) ->
        CloseTo reals point delta x ->
        CloseTo reals (function point) epsilon (function x)))

Continuous :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (R -> R) ->
  Set
Continuous {R} reals function =
  (point : R) ->
  ContinuousAt reals function point

negativeTwo :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R
negativeTwo reals =
  negateR reals
    (addR reals (oneR reals) (oneR reals))

controlledRightHandSide :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (R -> R) ->
  (R -> R) ->
  R ->
  R
controlledRightHandSide reals other control point =
  addR reals
    (multiplyR reals (negativeTwo reals) (other point))
    (control point)

record SystemWitness
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R)
  (x0 y0 t : R) : Set where
  field
    x y u : R -> R
    x-equation :
      (point : R) ->
      DerivativeAt reals x point
        (controlledRightHandSide reals y u point)
    y-equation :
      (point : R) ->
      DerivativeAt reals y point
        (controlledRightHandSide reals x u point)
    u-continuous :
      Continuous reals u
    x-initial :
      x (zeroR reals) == x0
    y-initial :
      y (zeroR reals) == y0
    x-terminal :
      x t == zeroR reals
    y-terminal :
      y t == zeroR reals

putnam-1969-a5 : Set1
putnam-1969-a5 =
  (R : Set) ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) ->
  (x0 y0 t : R) ->
  StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) t ->
  (x0 == y0) iff SystemWitness reals x0 y0 t

val putnam_1969_a5 =

       ?x y u : real -> real.
         (!p : real. x differentiable p) /\

$(
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact
  putnam_1969_a5: a controlled linear system of two real differential
  equations reaches the origin at a prescribed positive time exactly when
  its two initial values are equal. This file contains no proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  The witnesses X and Y range over all total real-valued functions, and U
  ranges over set.mm's class of continuous real-valued functions. Membership
  of every real p in dom ( RR _D X ) and dom ( RR _D Y ) states global
  differentiability; the corresponding derivative values state the two
  differential equations pointwise. The witnesses remain internal to the
  equivalence, as in all three source formulations.

  The final declaration is the single unproved $a corpus statement; this
  database contains no $p proof statement.
$)

${
  $d a b t p X Y U $.

  putnambench-putnam-1969-a5 $a |-
    A. a e. RR A. b e. RR A. t e. RR
      (
        0 < t
        ->
        (
          a = b
          <->
          E. X e. ( RR ^m RR )
          E. Y e. ( RR ^m RR )
          E. U e. ( RR -cn-> RR )
            (
              (
                A. p e. RR
                  (
                    p e. dom ( RR _D X )
                    /\
                    ( ( RR _D X ) ` p )
                    =
                    (
                      ( ( -u 2 ) x. ( Y ` p ) )
                      +
                      ( U ` p )
                    )
                  )
                /\
                A. p e. RR
                  (
                    p e. dom ( RR _D Y )
                    /\
                    ( ( RR _D Y ) ` p )
                    =
                    (
                      ( ( -u 2 ) x. ( X ` p ) )
                      +
                      ( U ` p )
                    )
                  )
              )
              /\
              (
                (
                  ( X ` 0 ) = a
                  /\
                  ( Y ` 0 ) = b
                )
                /\
                (
                  ( X ` t ) = 0
                  /\
                  ( Y ` t ) = 0
                )
              )
            )
        )
      )
  $.
$}

title: putnam_1969_a5
content:
% Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench artifact putnam_1969_a5:
% reachability of the origin at positive time for two coupled real differential
% equations driven by one continuous control. This file contains no proof.

putnam_1969_a5: THEORY
BEGIN
  real_function: TYPE = [real -> real]

  continuous(f: real_function): bool =
    FORALL (x: real), (epsilon_value: posreal):
      EXISTS (delta: posreal):
        FORALL (y: real):
          abs(y - x) < delta IMPLIES
            abs(f(y) - f(x)) < epsilon_value

  has_derivative_at(
      f: real_function,
      derivative, x: real): bool =
    FORALL (epsilon_value: real):
      epsilon_value > 0 IMPLIES
        EXISTS (delta: real):
          delta > 0
            AND FORALL (h: real):
              (NOT (h = 0) AND abs(h) < delta)
                IMPLIES
                  abs(
                    f(x + h) - f(x)
                      - derivative * h)
                    < epsilon_value * abs(h)

  differentiable(f: real_function): bool =
    FORALL (x: real):
      EXISTS (derivative: real):
        has_derivative_at(f, derivative, x)

  putnam_1969_a5: bool =
    FORALL (x0, y0, t: real):
      t > 0 IMPLIES
        ((x0 = y0)
          IFF
            EXISTS (x, y, u: real_function):
              differentiable(x)
                AND differentiable(y)
                AND continuous(u)
                AND (FORALL (p: real):
                  has_derivative_at(
                    x, -2 * y(p) + u(p), p))
                AND (FORALL (p: real):
                  has_derivative_at(
                    y, -2 * x(p) + u(p), p))
                AND x(0) = x0
                AND y(0) = y0
                AND x(t) = 0
                AND y(t) = 0)
END putnam_1969_a5

/--
Let $(x_n)$ be a sequence, and let $y_n = x_{n-1} + 2*x_n$ for $n \geq 2$. Suppose that $(y_n)$ converges, then prove that $(x_n)$ converges.
-/
theorem putnam_1969_a6
(x : ℕ → ℝ)
(y : ℕ → ℝ)
(hy1 : ∀ n ≥ 2, y n = x (n-1) + 2 * (x n))
(hy2 : ∃ c : ℝ, Tendsto y atTop (𝓝 c))
: ∃ C : ℝ, Tendsto x atTop (𝓝 C) :=

;; Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench artifact putnam_1969_a6:
;; if y(n) = x(n-1) + 2*x(n) from index two onward and y converges, then x
;; converges. This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))

;; X and Y are arbitrary conservative sequence symbols. Scalar values live in
;; an Archimedean ordered field with its rational embedding. Positive rational
;; tolerances form a neighborhood basis at zero in this setting, so the
;; epsilon formulation is equivalent to the source's real convergence while
;; avoiding both rational-valued-sequence and APPLY$ restrictions.
(defstub p1969a6-scalar-p (x) t)
(defstub p1969a6-add-op (x y) t)
(defstub p1969a6-multiply-op (x y) t)
(defstub p1969a6-negate-op (x) t)
(defstub p1969a6-inverse-op (x) t)
(defstub p1969a6-less-op (x y) t)
(defstub p1969a6-rational-embed (q) t)
(defstub p1969a6-arch-bound (x) t)
(defstub p1969a6-x (n) t)
(defstub p1969a6-y (n) t)

(defun p1969a6-add (x y)
  (p1969a6-add-op x y))

(defun p1969a6-mul (x y)
  (p1969a6-multiply-op x y))

(defun p1969a6-neg (x)
  (p1969a6-negate-op x))

(defun p1969a6-inv (x)
  (p1969a6-inverse-op x))

(defun p1969a6-sub (x y)
  (p1969a6-add x (p1969a6-neg y)))

(defun p1969a6-less (x y)
  (if (p1969a6-less-op x y) t nil))

(defun p1969a6-abs (x zero)
  (if (p1969a6-less x zero)
      (p1969a6-neg x)
    x))

(defun-sk p1969a6-field-laws-p (zero one)
  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (p1969a6-scalar-p x)
      (p1969a6-scalar-p y)
      (p1969a6-scalar-p z))
     (and
      (p1969a6-scalar-p (p1969a6-add x y))
      (p1969a6-scalar-p (p1969a6-mul x y))
      (p1969a6-scalar-p (p1969a6-neg x))
      (implies
       (not (equal x zero))
       (p1969a6-scalar-p (p1969a6-inv x)))
      (equal (p1969a6-add (p1969a6-add x y) z)
             (p1969a6-add x (p1969a6-add y z)))
      (equal (p1969a6-add x y)
             (p1969a6-add y x))
      (equal (p1969a6-add x zero) x)
      (equal (p1969a6-add x (p1969a6-neg x)) zero)
      (equal (p1969a6-mul (p1969a6-mul x y) z)
             (p1969a6-mul x (p1969a6-mul y z)))
      (equal (p1969a6-mul x y)
             (p1969a6-mul y x))
      (equal (p1969a6-mul x one) x)
      (implies
       (not (equal x zero))
       (equal (p1969a6-mul x (p1969a6-inv x)) one))
      (equal
       (p1969a6-mul x (p1969a6-add y z))
       (p1969a6-add (p1969a6-mul x y)
                    (p1969a6-mul x z)))))))

(defun-sk p1969a6-order-laws-p (zero)
  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (p1969a6-scalar-p x)
      (p1969a6-scalar-p y)
      (p1969a6-scalar-p z))
     (and
      (not (p1969a6-less x x))
      (or
       (equal x y)
       (p1969a6-less x y)
       (p1969a6-less y x))
      (implies
       (and
        (p1969a6-less x y)
        (p1969a6-less y z))
       (p1969a6-less x z))
      (implies
       (p1969a6-less x y)
       (p1969a6-less
        (p1969a6-add x z)
        (p1969a6-add y z)))
      (implies
       (and
        (p1969a6-less zero x)
        (p1969a6-less zero y))
       (p1969a6-less zero (p1969a6-mul x y)))))))

(defun-sk p1969a6-rational-embedding-laws-p ()
  (forall (a b)
    (implies
     (and (rationalp a) (rationalp b))
     (and
      (p1969a6-scalar-p (p1969a6-rational-embed a))
      (equal
       (p1969a6-rational-embed (+ a b))
       (p1969a6-add
        (p1969a6-rational-embed a)
        (p1969a6-rational-embed b)))
      (equal
       (p1969a6-rational-embed (* a b))
       (p1969a6-mul
        (p1969a6-rational-embed a)
        (p1969a6-rational-embed b)))
      (iff
       (< a b)
       (p1969a6-less
        (p1969a6-rational-embed a)
        (p1969a6-rational-embed b)))))))

(defun-sk p1969a6-archimedean-p ()
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (p1969a6-scalar-p x)
     (and
      (natp (p1969a6-arch-bound x))
      (p1969a6-less
       x
       (p1969a6-rational-embed
        (p1969a6-arch-bound x)))))))

(defun p1969a6-ordered-field-with-rationals-p (zero one)
  (and
   (p1969a6-scalar-p zero)
   (p1969a6-scalar-p one)
   (not (equal zero one))
   (p1969a6-less zero one)
   (equal (p1969a6-rational-embed 0) zero)
   (equal (p1969a6-rational-embed 1) one)
   (p1969a6-field-laws-p zero one)
   (p1969a6-order-laws-p zero)
   (p1969a6-rational-embedding-laws-p)
   (p1969a6-archimedean-p)))

(defun-sk p1969a6-sequences-p ()
  (forall (n)
    (implies
     (natp n)
     (and
      (p1969a6-scalar-p (p1969a6-x n))
      (p1969a6-scalar-p (p1969a6-y n))))))

(defun-sk p1969a6-recurrence-p (one)
  (forall (n)
    (implies
     (and (natp n) (<= 2 n))
     (equal
      (p1969a6-y n)
      (p1969a6-add
       (p1969a6-x (1- n))
       (p1969a6-mul
        (p1969a6-add one one)
        (p1969a6-x n)))))))

(defun-sk p1969a6-y-tail-p
    (limit epsilon cutoff zero)
  (forall (n)
    (implies
     (and (natp n) (<= cutoff n))
     (p1969a6-less
      (p1969a6-abs
       (p1969a6-sub (p1969a6-y n) limit)
       zero)
      (p1969a6-rational-embed epsilon)))))

(defun-sk p1969a6-y-cutoff-exists-p
    (limit epsilon zero)
  (exists (cutoff)
    (and
     (natp cutoff)
     (p1969a6-y-tail-p limit epsilon cutoff zero))))

(defun-sk p1969a6-y-limit-p (limit zero)
  (forall (epsilon)
    (implies
     (and (rationalp epsilon) (< 0 epsilon))
     (p1969a6-y-cutoff-exists-p
      limit epsilon zero))))

(defun-sk p1969a6-y-converges-p (zero)
  (exists (limit)
    (and
     (p1969a6-scalar-p limit)
     (p1969a6-y-limit-p limit zero))))

(defun-sk p1969a6-x-tail-p
    (limit epsilon cutoff zero)
  (forall (n)
    (implies
     (and (natp n) (<= cutoff n))
     (p1969a6-less
      (p1969a6-abs
       (p1969a6-sub (p1969a6-x n) limit)
       zero)
      (p1969a6-rational-embed epsilon)))))

(defun-sk p1969a6-x-cutoff-exists-p
    (limit epsilon zero)
  (exists (cutoff)
    (and
     (natp cutoff)
     (p1969a6-x-tail-p limit epsilon cutoff zero))))

(defun-sk p1969a6-x-limit-p (limit zero)
  (forall (epsilon)
    (implies
     (and (rationalp epsilon) (< 0 epsilon))
     (p1969a6-x-cutoff-exists-p
      limit epsilon zero))))

(defun-sk p1969a6-x-converges-p (zero)
  (exists (limit)
    (and
     (p1969a6-scalar-p limit)
     (p1969a6-x-limit-p limit zero))))

(defun putnambench-putnam-1969-a6-statement (zero one)
  (implies
   (and
    (p1969a6-ordered-field-with-rationals-p zero one)
    (p1969a6-sequences-p)
    (p1969a6-recurrence-p one)
    (p1969a6-y-converges-p zero))
   (p1969a6-x-converges-p zero)))

title: putnam_1969_a6
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1969_a6:
-- if the real sequence y_n = x_(n-1) + 2*x_n for every n at least two
-- converges, then the real sequence x_n converges. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; _*_)

infix 4 _!=_ _<=N_
infixr 3 _and_
infixr 2 _or_

data Bottom : Set where

Not : Set -> Set
Not A =
  A -> Bottom

_!=_ : {A : Set} -> A -> A -> Set
x != y =
  Not (x == y)

record _and_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data _or_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  left  : A -> A or B
  right : B -> A or B

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

data _<=N_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set where
  zero<=   : {n : Nat} -> zero <=N n
  suc<=suc : {m n : Nat} -> m <=N n -> suc m <=N suc n

oneN : Nat
oneN =
  suc zero

twoN : Nat
twoN =
  suc oneN

predecessor : Nat -> Nat
predecessor zero =
  zero
predecessor (suc n) =
  n

record CompleteOrderedField (R : Set) : Set1 where
  field
    zeroR oneR : R
    add multiply : R -> R -> R
    negate inverse : R -> R
    lessOrEqual : R -> R -> Set
    fromNat : Nat -> R

    one-not-zero :
      oneR != zeroR

    add-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> add x y == add y x
    add-associative :
      (x y z : R) -> add (add x y) z == add x (add y z)
    add-zero :
      (x : R) -> add x zeroR == x
    add-inverse :
      (x : R) -> add x (negate x) == zeroR

    multiply-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> multiply x y == multiply y x
    multiply-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply (multiply x y) z == multiply x (multiply y z)
    multiply-one :
      (x : R) -> multiply x oneR == x
    multiply-zero :
      (x : R) -> multiply x zeroR == zeroR
    distribute :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply x (add y z) ==
      add (multiply x y) (multiply x z)
    inverse-zero :
      inverse zeroR == zeroR
    multiply-inverse :
      (x : R) ->
      x != zeroR ->
      multiply x (inverse x) == oneR

    order-reflexive :
      (x : R) -> lessOrEqual x x
    order-transitive :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y z ->
      lessOrEqual x z
    order-antisymmetric :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y x ->
      x == y
    order-total :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y or lessOrEqual y x
    add-order :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual (add z x) (add z y)
    multiply-nonnegative :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR x ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR y ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR (multiply x y)
    zero-less-than-one :
      lessOrEqual zeroR oneR and zeroR != oneR

    fromNat-zero :
      fromNat zero == zeroR
    fromNat-successor :
      (n : Nat) -> fromNat (suc n) == add (fromNat n) oneR
    fromNat-addition :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m + n) == add (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-multiplication :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m * n) == multiply (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-injective :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat m == fromNat n ->
      m == n

    archimedean :
      (x : R) ->
      Exists Nat (\ n -> lessOrEqual x (fromNat n))
    least-upper-bound :
      (P : R -> Set) ->
      Exists R P ->
      Exists R
        (\ upper ->
          (x : R) ->
          P x ->
          lessOrEqual x upper) ->
      Exists R
        (\ supremum ->
          ((x : R) ->
            P x ->
            lessOrEqual x supremum)
          and
          ((upper : R) ->
            ((x : R) ->
              P x ->
              lessOrEqual x upper) ->
            lessOrEqual supremum upper))

open CompleteOrderedField

subtract :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
subtract reals x y =
  add reals x (negate reals y)

StrictLess :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
StrictLess reals x y =
  lessOrEqual reals x y and x != y

CloseTo :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
CloseTo reals center radius x =
  StrictLess reals
    (subtract reals center radius)
    x

    x
    (add reals center radius)

ConvergesTo :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  R ->
  Set
ConvergesTo {R} reals sequence limit =
  (epsilon : R) ->
  StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) epsilon ->
  Exists Nat
    (\ cutoff ->
      (n : Nat) ->
      cutoff <=N n ->
      CloseTo reals limit epsilon (sequence n))

putnam-1969-a6 =
  (R : Set) ->

  (x y : Nat -> R) ->
  ((n : Nat) ->

    y n ==

        (multiply reals (fromNat reals twoN) (x n))) ->
  Exists R (\ c -> ConvergesTo reals y c) ->
  Exists R (\ C -> ConvergesTo reals x C)

open import Agda.Builtin.Bool using (Bool; false; true)
open import Agda.Builtin.Equality using (_≡_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using
  (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; _*_; mod-helper)

infix 4 _∣_

data Positive : Nat → Set where
  positive : {n : Nat} → Positive (suc n)

record _∣_ (divisor dividend : Nat) : Set where
  field
    quotient : Nat
    division-equation : divisor * quotient ≡ dividend

natEqual : Nat → Nat → Bool
natEqual zero zero = true
natEqual zero (suc n) = false
natEqual (suc m) zero = false
natEqual (suc m) (suc n) = natEqual m n

naturalMod : Nat → Nat → Nat
naturalMod numerator zero = zero
naturalMod numerator (suc denominator) =
  mod-helper zero denominator numerator denominator

sumDivisorsUpTo : Nat → Nat → Nat
sumDivisorsUpTo number zero = zero
sumDivisorsUpTo number (suc bound)
  with natEqual (naturalMod number (suc bound)) zero
... | true = suc bound + sumDivisorsUpTo number bound
... | false = sumDivisorsUpTo number bound

sumDivisors : Nat → Nat
sumDivisors number = sumDivisorsUpTo number number

putnam-1969-b1 : Set
putnam-1969-b1 =
  (n : Nat) →
  Positive n →
  24 ∣ (n + 1) →
  24 ∣ sumDivisors n

% Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench artifact putnam_1969_b1:
% divisibility by 24 of the sum of all positive divisors of a positive natural
% number whose successor is divisible by 24. This file contains no proof.

putnam_1969_b1: THEORY
BEGIN
  nat_divides(divisor, value: nat): bool =
    EXISTS (quotient: nat):
      value = divisor * quotient

  divisor_sum(value, count: nat): RECURSIVE nat =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      LET divisor: nat = count - 1 IN
        divisor_sum(value, count - 1)
          + IF nat_divides(divisor, value) THEN
              divisor
            ELSE
              0
            ENDIF
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  putnam_1969_b1: bool =
    FORALL (n: nat):
      (n > 0
        AND nat_divides(24, n + 1))
      IMPLIES
        nat_divides(24, divisor_sum(n, n + 1))
END putnam_1969_b1

(* Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench artifact putnam_1969_b2:
   finite groups cannot be unions of two proper subgroups, and the analogous
   assertion for three proper subgroups is false. This file contains no proof. *)

From Stdlib Require Import Lists.List Arith.PeanoNat.

Record group_structure (G : Type) : Type := {
  group_mul : G -> G -> G;
  group_one : G;
  group_inv : G -> G;
  group_assoc :
    forall x y z : G,
      group_mul x (group_mul y z) = group_mul (group_mul x y) z;
  group_left_identity :
    forall x : G, group_mul group_one x = x;
  group_right_identity :
    forall x : G, group_mul x group_one = x;
  group_left_inverse :
    forall x : G, group_mul (group_inv x) x = group_one;
  group_right_inverse :
    forall x : G, group_mul x (group_inv x) = group_one
}.

Arguments group_mul {G} _ _ _.
Arguments group_one {G} _.
Arguments group_inv {G} _ _.

Definition finite_type (G : Type) : Prop :=
  exists enumeration : list G,
    forall x : G, List.In x enumeration.

Record finite_index (n : nat) : Type := {
  index_value : nat;
  index_bound : index_value < n
}.

Definition is_subgroup
    {G : Type}
    (grp : group_structure G)
    (H : G -> Prop) : Prop :=
  H (group_one grp) /\
  (forall x y : G,
    H x ->
    H y ->
    H (group_mul grp x y)) /\
  (forall x : G,
    H x ->
    H (group_inv grp x)).

Definition putnam_1969_b2_property (n : nat) : Prop :=
  forall
    (G : Type)
    (grp : group_structure G),
    finite_type G ->
    forall H : finite_index n -> G -> Prop,
      (forall i : finite_index n,
        is_subgroup grp (H i) /\
        ~ (forall x : G, H i x)) ->
      ~ (forall x : G,
          exists i : finite_index n, H i x).

Definition putnam_1969_b2_solution : Prop := False.

Theorem putnam_1969_b2
    (P : nat -> Prop)
    (P_def :
      forall n : nat,
        P n <-> putnam_1969_b2_property n) :
  P 2 /\ (P 3 <-> putnam_1969_b2_solution).
Admitted.
