(*
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench artifact putnam_1969_b2:
  a finite group is not the union of two proper subgroups, while the
  corresponding assertion for three proper subgroups is false. This file
  contains no proof.
*)

let statement =
  `let is_group =
     \(carrier:num->bool) (mul:num->num->num)
      (identity:num) (ginv:num->num).
       FINITE carrier /\
       identity IN carrier /\
       (!x y:num.
          x IN carrier /\ y IN carrier ==> mul x y IN carrier) /\
       (!x y z:num.
          x IN carrier /\ y IN carrier /\ z IN carrier
          ==> mul (mul x y) z = mul x (mul y z)) /\
       (!x:num.
          x IN carrier
          ==> mul identity x = x /\ mul x identity = x) /\
       (!x:num.
          x IN carrier
          ==> ginv x IN carrier /\
              mul (ginv x) x = identity /\
              mul x (ginv x) = identity) in
   let is_subgroup =
     \(carrier:num->bool) (mul:num->num->num)
      (identity:num) (ginv:num->num) (h:num->bool).
       h SUBSET carrier /\
       identity IN h /\
       (!x:num. x IN h ==> ginv x IN h) /\
       (!x y:num. x IN h /\ y IN h ==> mul x y IN h) in
   let P =
     \n:num.
       !carrier:num->bool. !mul:num->num->num.
       !identity:num. !ginv:num->num.
         is_group carrier mul identity ginv
         ==> !H:num->num->bool.
               (!i:num.
                  i < n
                  ==> is_subgroup carrier mul identity ginv (H i) /\
                      H i PSUBSET carrier)
               ==> ~(UNIONS (IMAGE H {i:num | i < n}) =
                     carrier) in
   P 2 /\ ~P 3`;;

;; no finite group is the union of two proper subgroups, while the Klein four
;; group is the union of three proper subgroups. This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

;; A finite group is represented by a duplicate-free carrier enumeration and
;; total multiplication and inverse tables. Every source finite group yields
;; such data after choosing an enumeration, and every data tuple satisfying
;; the predicates below determines a finite group. The powerset search ranges
;; over every subgroup extensionally, so no subgroup family is externalized.

(defun putnam-1969-b2-subsetp-equal (xs ys)
  (if (endp xs)
      t
    (and
     (member-equal (car xs) ys)
     (putnam-1969-b2-subsetp-equal (cdr xs) ys))))

(defun putnam-1969-b2-product-entry (x y product-table)
  (assoc-equal (list x y) product-table))

(defun putnam-1969-b2-product (x y product-table)
  (cdr (putnam-1969-b2-product-entry x y product-table)))

(defun putnam-1969-b2-inverse-entry (x inverse-table)
  (assoc-equal x inverse-table))

(defun putnam-1969-b2-inverse (x inverse-table)
  (cdr (putnam-1969-b2-inverse-entry x inverse-table)))

(defun putnam-1969-b2-product-row-total-p
    (x ys carrier product-table)
  (if (endp ys)
      t
    (and
     (consp
      (putnam-1969-b2-product-entry
       x (car ys) product-table))
     (member-equal
      (putnam-1969-b2-product
       x (car ys) product-table)
      carrier)
     (putnam-1969-b2-product-row-total-p
      x (cdr ys) carrier product-table))))

(defun putnam-1969-b2-product-total-p

  (if (endp xs)

      (car xs) carrier carrier product-table)
     (putnam-1969-b2-product-total-p
      (cdr xs) carrier product-table))))

(defun putnam-1969-b2-inverse-total-p

     (consp
      (putnam-1969-b2-inverse-entry
       (car xs) inverse-table))
     (member-equal
      (putnam-1969-b2-inverse
       (car xs) inverse-table)
      carrier)
     (putnam-1969-b2-inverse-total-p
      (cdr xs) carrier inverse-table))))

(defun putnam-1969-b2-associative-third-p

    (and
     (equal
      (putnam-1969-b2-product
       (putnam-1969-b2-product
        x y product-table)

      (putnam-1969-b2-product

        y (car zs) product-table)
       product-table))
     (putnam-1969-b2-associative-third-p

(defun putnam-1969-b2-associative-second-p

     (putnam-1969-b2-associative-third-p

       identity (car xs) product-table)
      (car xs))

      (car xs))

      t

-- Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1969_b2:
-- a finite group is not the union of two proper subgroups, while the analogous
-- assertion for three proper subgroups is false. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc)
open import Agda.Primitive using (Level; lsuc; _⊔_)

infixr 3 _and_

data Bottom : Set where

Not :
  {a : Level} ->
  Set a ->
  Set a
Not A =
  A -> Bottom

record _and_
  {a b : Level}
  (A : Set a)
  (B : Set b) :
  Set (a ⊔ b) where

  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

record Iff
  {a b : Level}
  (A : Set a)
  (B : Set b) :
  Set (a ⊔ b) where

  constructor equivalence
  field
    forward  : A -> B
    backward : B -> A

record Exists
  {a p : Level}
  (A : Set a)
  (property : A -> Set p) :
  Set (a ⊔ p) where

  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    satisfies : property value

data Fin : Nat -> Set where
  fzero : {n : Nat} -> Fin (suc n)
  fsuc  : {n : Nat} -> Fin n -> Fin (suc n)

record Bijection
  {a b : Level}
  (A : Set a)
  (B : Set b) :
  Set (a ⊔ b) where

  field
    to      : A -> B
    from    : B -> A
    from-to : (x : A) -> from (to x) == x
    to-from : (y : B) -> to (from y) == y

record Finite
  {ℓ : Level}
  (A : Set ℓ) :
  Set ℓ where

  field
    cardinality : Nat
    finite-bijection : Bijection A (Fin cardinality)

record Group
  {ℓ : Level}
  (G : Set ℓ) :
  Set ℓ where

  field
    identity       : G
    inverse        : G -> G
    multiply       : G -> G -> G
    associative    : (x y z : G) ->
                     multiply x (multiply y z) ==
                     multiply (multiply x y) z
    identity-left  : (x : G) -> multiply identity x == x
    identity-right : (x : G) -> multiply x identity == x
    inverse-left   : (x : G) -> multiply (inverse x) x == identity
    inverse-right  : (x : G) -> multiply x (inverse x) == identity

record Subgroup
  {ℓ : Level}
  {G : Set ℓ}
  (structure : Group G) :
  Set (lsuc ℓ) where

  open Group structure

  field
    member : G -> Set ℓ
    membership-propositional :
      (x : G) ->
      (u v : member x) ->
      u == v
    contains-identity :
      member identity
    closed-under-inverse :
      (x : G) ->
      member x ->
      member (inverse x)
    closed-under-multiply :
      (x y : G) ->
      member x ->
      member y ->
      member (multiply x y)

open Subgroup

ProperSubgroup :
  {ℓ : Level} ->
  {G : Set ℓ} ->
  {structure : Group G} ->
  Subgroup structure ->
  Set ℓ
ProperSubgroup {G = G} subgroup =
  Not ((x : G) -> member subgroup x)

UnionCovers :
  {ℓ : Level} ->
  {G : Set ℓ} ->
  {structure : Group G} ->
  {n : Nat} ->
  (Fin n -> Subgroup structure) ->
  Set ℓ
UnionCovers {G = G} {n = n} subgroups =
  (x : G) ->
  Exists (Fin n) (\ i -> member (subgroups i) x)

NoCoverBy :
  (ℓ : Level) ->
  Nat ->
  Set (lsuc ℓ)
NoCoverBy ℓ n =
  (G : Set ℓ) ->
  (structure : Group G) ->
  Finite G ->
  (subgroups : Fin n -> Subgroup structure) ->
  ((i : Fin n) -> ProperSubgroup (subgroups i)) ->
  Not (UnionCovers subgroups)

two : Nat
two =
  suc (suc zero)

three : Nat
three =
  suc two

putnam-1969-b2-solution : Set
putnam-1969-b2-solution =
  Bottom

putnam-1969-b2 :
  (ℓ : Level) ->
  Set (lsuc (lsuc ℓ))
putnam-1969-b2 ℓ =
  (P : Nat -> Set (lsuc ℓ)) ->
  ((n : Nat) -> Iff (P n) (NoCoverBy ℓ n)) ->
  P two
  and
  Iff (P three) putnam-1969-b2-solution

$(

p69b2-cover-property-syntax $a wff ( P69B2CoverProperty N ) $.

${
  $d G H N i $.

  p69b2-cover-property-definition $a |- (

    <->

      N e. NN0

      A. G

            G e. Grp

% Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench artifact putnam_1969_b2:
% a finite group cannot be covered by two proper subgroups, while three
% proper subgroups can cover a finite group. This file contains no proof.

putnam_1969_b2: THEORY
BEGIN
  IMPORTING finite_sets[nat]

  element_set: TYPE = finite_set[nat]
  subgroup_family: TYPE = [nat -> element_set]

  is_group(
      G: element_set,
      multiply: [nat, nat -> nat],
      inverse: [nat -> nat],
      one: nat): bool =
    G(one)
      AND
        (FORALL (x, y: nat):
          G(x) AND G(y) IMPLIES G(multiply(x, y)))
      AND
        (FORALL (x, y, z: nat):
          G(x) AND G(y) AND G(z) IMPLIES
            multiply(multiply(x, y), z) = multiply(x, multiply(y, z)))
      AND
        (FORALL (x: nat):
          G(x) IMPLIES
            multiply(one, x) = x AND multiply(x, one) = x)
      AND
        (FORALL (x: nat):
          G(x) IMPLIES
            G(inverse(x))
              AND multiply(inverse(x), x) = one
              AND multiply(x, inverse(x)) = one)

  is_subgroup(
      H, G: element_set,
      multiply: [nat, nat -> nat],
      inverse: [nat -> nat],
      one: nat): bool =
    (FORALL (x: nat):
      H(x) IMPLIES G(x))
      AND is_group(H, multiply, inverse, one)

  is_proper_subgroup(
      H, G: element_set,
      multiply: [nat, nat -> nat],
      inverse: [nat -> nat],
      one: nat): bool =
    is_subgroup(H, G, multiply, inverse, one)
      AND H /= G

  covers(
      G: element_set,
      H: subgroup_family,
      count: nat): bool =
    FORALL (x: nat):
      G(x) IMPLIES
        EXISTS (i: nat):
          i < count AND H(i)(x)

  noncovering_property(count: nat): bool =
    FORALL (G: element_set),
           (multiply: [nat, nat -> nat]),
           (inverse: [nat -> nat]),
           (one: nat),
           (H: subgroup_family):
      (is_group(G, multiply, inverse, one)
        AND
          (FORALL (i: nat):
            i < count IMPLIES
              is_proper_subgroup(
                H(i), G, multiply, inverse, one)))
      IMPLIES
        NOT covers(G, H, count)

  putnam_1969_b2: bool =
    noncovering_property(2)
      AND NOT noncovering_property(3)
END putnam_1969_b2

;; sequence. Every particular real sequence, together with pi, is contained

   real-type left (p69b3-negate real-type right)))

(defun p69b3-divide (real-type numerator denominator)
  (p69b3-multiply
   real-type numerator (p69b3-inverse real-type denominator)))

    (implies
     (and
      (p69b3-real-p real-type x)
      (p69b3-real-p real-type y)
      (p69b3-real-p real-type z))
     (let* ((zero (p69b3-zero real-type))
            (one (p69b3-one real-type))
            (x-plus-y (p69b3-add real-type x y))
            (y-plus-z (p69b3-add real-type y z))

            (y-times-z (p69b3-multiply real-type y z))

        (p69b3-real-p real-type x-plus-y)
        (p69b3-real-p real-type x-times-y)
        (p69b3-real-p real-type minus-x)
        (p69b3-real-p real-type inverse-x)
        (equal
         (p69b3-add real-type x-plus-y z)
         (p69b3-add real-type x y-plus-z))
        (equal x-plus-y (p69b3-add real-type y x))
        (equal (p69b3-add real-type x zero) x)
        (equal (p69b3-add real-type x minus-x) zero)
        (equal
         (p69b3-multiply real-type x-times-y z)
         (p69b3-multiply real-type x y-times-z))
        (equal x-times-y (p69b3-multiply real-type y x))
        (equal (p69b3-multiply real-type x one) x)
        (implies
         (equal x zero)
         (equal inverse-x zero))
        (implies
         (not (equal x zero))
         (equal
          (p69b3-multiply real-type x inverse-x)
          one))
        (equal
         (p69b3-multiply real-type x y-plus-z)
         (p69b3-add
          real-type
          (p69b3-multiply real-type x y)
          (p69b3-multiply real-type x z))))))))

(defun-sk p69b3-order-laws-p (real-type)
  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (p69b3-real-p real-type x)
      (p69b3-real-p real-type y)
      (p69b3-real-p real-type z))
     (let ((zero (p69b3-zero real-type)))
       (and
        (not (p69b3-less real-type x x))
        (or
         (p69b3-less real-type x y)
         (equal x y)
         (p69b3-less real-type y x))
        (implies
         (and
          (p69b3-less real-type x y)
          (p69b3-less real-type y z))
         (p69b3-less real-type x z))
        (implies
         (p69b3-less real-type x y)
         (p69b3-less
          real-type
          (p69b3-add real-type x z)
          (p69b3-add real-type y z)))
        (implies
         (and
          (p69b3-less real-type zero x)
          (p69b3-less real-type zero y))
         (p69b3-less
          real-type
          zero
          (p69b3-multiply real-type x y))))))))

(defun-sk p69b3-archimedean-bound-exists-p
    (real-type value)
  (exists (n)
    (and
     (natp n)
     (p69b3-less
      real-type value (p69b3-natural-value real-type n)))))

(defun-sk p69b3-archimedean-p (real-type)
  (forall (value)
    (implies
     (p69b3-real-p real-type value)
     (p69b3-archimedean-bound-exists-p
      real-type value))))

(defun p69b3-real-structure-p (real-type)
  (let ((zero (p69b3-zero real-type))
        (one (p69b3-one real-type)))
    (and
     (p69b3-real-p real-type zero)
     (p69b3-real-p real-type one)
     (not (equal zero one))
     (p69b3-field-laws-p real-type)
     (p69b3-order-laws-p real-type)
     (p69b3-less real-type zero one)
     (p69b3-archimedean-p real-type))))

;; Machin's identity fixes pi exactly:
;; pi = 16*arctan(1/5) - 4*arctan(1/239).

(defun p69b3-power (real-type base exponent)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix exponent)))
  (if (zp exponent)
      (p69b3-one real-type)
    (p69b3-multiply
     real-type
     base
     (p69b3-power real-type base (1- exponent)))))

(defun p69b3-arctan-prefix (real-type z terms)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix terms)))
  (if (zp terms)
      (p69b3-zero real-type)
    (let* ((index (1- terms))
           (exponent (+ (* 2 index) 1))
           (unsigned-term
            (p69b3-divide
             real-type
             (p69b3-power real-type z exponent)
             (p69b3-natural-value real-type exponent)))
           (term
            (if (equal (mod index 2) 0)
                unsigned-term
              (p69b3-negate real-type unsigned-term))))
      (p69b3-add
       real-type
       (p69b3-arctan-prefix real-type z index)
       term))))

(defun p69b3-pi-prefix (real-type terms)
  (let* ((one (p69b3-one real-type))
         (five (p69b3-natural-value real-type 5))
         (two-hundred-thirty-nine
          (p69b3-natural-value real-type 239))
         (sixteen (p69b3-natural-value real-type 16))
         (four (p69b3-natural-value real-type 4))
         (atan-one-fifth
          (p69b3-arctan-prefix
           real-type
           (p69b3-divide real-type one five)
           terms))
         (atan-one-over-two-hundred-thirty-nine
          (p69b3-arctan-prefix
           real-type
           (p69b3-divide
            real-type one two-hundred-thirty-nine)
           terms)))
    (p69b3-subtract
     real-type
     (p69b3-multiply real-type sixteen atan-one-fifth)
     (p69b3-multiply
      real-type four atan-one-over-two-hundred-thirty-nine))))

(defun-sk p69b3-pi-tail-p
    (real-type epsilon cutoff)
  (forall (terms)
    (implies
     (and
      (natp terms)
      (natp cutoff)
      (<= cutoff terms))
     (p69b3-less
      real-type
      (p69b3-absolute-value
       real-type
       (p69b3-subtract
        real-type
        (p69b3-pi-prefix real-type terms)
        (p69b3-pi real-type)))
      epsilon))))

(defun-sk p69b3-pi-cutoff-exists-p
    (real-type epsilon)
  (exists (cutoff)
    (and
     (natp cutoff)
     (p69b3-pi-tail-p real-type epsilon cutoff))))

(defun-sk p69b3-pi-converges-p (real-type)
  (forall (epsilon)
    (implies
     (and
      (p69b3-real-p real-type epsilon)
      (p69b3-less
       real-type (p69b3-zero real-type) epsilon))
     (p69b3-pi-cutoff-exists-p
      real-type epsilon))))

(defun p69b3-pi-value-p (real-type)
  (and
   (p69b3-real-p real-type (p69b3-pi real-type))
   (p69b3-pi-converges-p real-type)))

(defun-sk p69b3-sequence-real-valued-p (real-type)
  (forall (n)
    (implies
     (natp n)
     (p69b3-real-p real-type (p69b3-t real-type n)))))

(defun-sk p69b3-recurrence-p (real-type)
  (forall (n)
    (implies
     (and (natp n)
          (<= 1 n))
     (equal
      (p69b3-multiply
       real-type
       (p69b3-t real-type n)
       (p69b3-t real-type (+ n 1)))
      (p69b3-natural-value real-type n)))))

(defun p69b3-ratio (real-type n)
  (p69b3-divide
   real-type
   (p69b3-t real-type n)
   (p69b3-t real-type (+ n 1))))

(defun-sk p69b3-ratio-limit-tail-p
    (real-type epsilon cutoff)
  (forall (n)
    (implies
     (and
      (natp n)
      (natp cutoff)
      (<= cutoff n))
     (p69b3-less
      real-type
      (p69b3-absolute-value
       real-type
       (p69b3-subtract
        real-type
        (p69b3-ratio real-type n)
        (p69b3-one real-type)))
      epsilon))))

(defun-sk p69b3-ratio-limit-cutoff-exists-p
    (real-type epsilon)
  (exists (cutoff)
    (and
     (natp cutoff)
     (p69b3-ratio-limit-tail-p
      real-type epsilon cutoff))))

(defun-sk p69b3-ratio-converges-to-one-p (real-type)
  (forall (epsilon)
    (implies
     (and
      (p69b3-real-p real-type epsilon)
      (p69b3-less
       real-type (p69b3-zero real-type) epsilon))
     (p69b3-ratio-limit-cutoff-exists-p
      real-type epsilon))))

(defun putnambench-putnam-1969-b3-statement
    (real-type)
  (implies
   (and
    (p69b3-real-structure-p real-type)
    (p69b3-pi-value-p real-type)
    (p69b3-sequence-real-valued-p real-type)
    (p69b3-recurrence-p real-type)
    (p69b3-ratio-converges-to-one-p real-type))
   (equal
    (p69b3-multiply
     real-type
     (p69b3-pi real-type)
     (p69b3-multiply
      real-type
      (p69b3-t real-type 1)
      (p69b3-t real-type 1)))
    (p69b3-natural-value real-type 2))))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

title: putnam_1969_b3
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1969_b3:
-- a real sequence satisfying T_n * T_(n+1) = n for every positive n and
-- T_n / T_(n+1) tending to one has pi * T_1^2 = 2. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; _*_)

infix 4 _!=_ _<=N_
infixr 3 _and_
infixr 2 _or_

data Bottom : Set where

Not : Set -> Set
Not A =
  A -> Bottom

_!=_ : {A : Set} -> A -> A -> Set
x != y =
  Not (x == y)

record _and_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data _or_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  left  : A -> A or B
  right : B -> A or B

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

data _<=N_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set where
  zero<=   : {n : Nat} -> zero <=N n
  suc<=suc : {m n : Nat} -> m <=N n -> suc m <=N suc n

oneN : Nat
oneN =
  suc zero

twoN : Nat
twoN =
  suc oneN

fourN : Nat
fourN =
  twoN + twoN

record CompleteOrderedField (R : Set) : Set1 where
  field
    zeroR oneR : R
    add multiply : R -> R -> R
    negate inverse : R -> R
    lessOrEqual : R -> R -> Set
    fromNat : Nat -> R

    one-not-zero :
      oneR != zeroR

    add-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> add x y == add y x
    add-associative :
      (x y z : R) -> add (add x y) z == add x (add y z)
    add-zero :
      (x : R) -> add x zeroR == x
    add-inverse :
      (x : R) -> add x (negate x) == zeroR

    multiply-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> multiply x y == multiply y x
    multiply-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply (multiply x y) z == multiply x (multiply y z)
    multiply-one :
      (x : R) -> multiply x oneR == x
    multiply-zero :
      (x : R) -> multiply x zeroR == zeroR
    distribute :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply x (add y z) ==
      add (multiply x y) (multiply x z)
    inverse-zero :
      inverse zeroR == zeroR
    multiply-inverse :
      (x : R) ->
      x != zeroR ->
      multiply x (inverse x) == oneR

    order-reflexive :
      (x : R) -> lessOrEqual x x
    order-transitive :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y z ->
      lessOrEqual x z
    order-antisymmetric :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y x ->
      x == y
    order-total :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y or lessOrEqual y x
    add-order :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual (add z x) (add z y)
    multiply-nonnegative :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR x ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR y ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR (multiply x y)
    zero-less-than-one :
      lessOrEqual zeroR oneR and zeroR != oneR

    fromNat-zero :
      fromNat zero == zeroR
    fromNat-successor :
      (n : Nat) -> fromNat (suc n) == add (fromNat n) oneR
    fromNat-addition :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m + n) == add (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-multiplication :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m * n) == multiply (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-injective :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat m == fromNat n ->
      m == n

    archimedean :
      (x : R) ->
      Exists Nat (\ n -> lessOrEqual x (fromNat n))
    least-upper-bound :
      (P : R -> Set) ->
      Exists R P ->
      Exists R
        (\ upper ->
          (x : R) ->
          P x ->
          lessOrEqual x upper) ->
      Exists R
        (\ supremum ->
          ((x : R) ->
            P x ->
            lessOrEqual x supremum)
          and
          ((upper : R) ->
            ((x : R) ->
              P x ->
              lessOrEqual x upper) ->
            lessOrEqual supremum upper))

open CompleteOrderedField

subtract :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
subtract reals x y =
  add reals x (negate reals y)

divide :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
divide reals x y =
  multiply reals x (inverse reals y)

StrictLess :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
StrictLess reals x y =
  lessOrEqual reals x y and x != y

CloseTo :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
CloseTo reals center radius x =
  StrictLess reals
    (subtract reals center radius)
    x
  and
  StrictLess reals
    x
    (add reals center radius)

ConvergesTo :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  R ->
  Set
ConvergesTo {R} reals sequence limit =
  (epsilon : R) ->
  StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) epsilon ->
  Exists Nat
    (\ cutoff ->
      (n : Nat) ->
      cutoff <=N n ->
      CloseTo reals limit epsilon (sequence n))

sumFirst :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  Nat ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  R
sumFirst reals zero term =
  zeroR reals
sumFirst reals (suc n) term =
  add reals
    (sumFirst reals n term)
    (term n)

SeriesHasSum :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  R ->
  Set
SeriesHasSum reals terms limit =
  ConvergesTo reals
    (\ n -> sumFirst reals n terms)
    limit

alternatingUnit :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  Nat ->
  R
alternatingUnit reals zero =
  oneR reals
alternatingUnit reals (suc n) =
  negate reals (alternatingUnit reals n)

oddNatural : Nat -> Nat
oddNatural zero =
  oneN
oddNatural (suc n) =
  suc (suc (oddNatural n))

leibnizTerm :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  Nat ->
  R
leibnizTerm reals n =
  divide reals
    (alternatingUnit reals n)
    (fromNat reals (oddNatural n))

record PiValue
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R)
  (value : R) : Set where
  field
    positive :
      StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) value
    leibniz-series :
      SeriesHasSum reals
        (leibnizTerm reals)
        (divide reals value (fromNat reals fourN))

record StandardReals (R : Set) : Set1 where
  field
    algebra : CompleteOrderedField R
    pi : R
    pi-value : PiValue algebra pi

open StandardReals

module Putnam1969B3Statement
  {R : Set}
  (standardReals : StandardReals R) where

  reals : CompleteOrderedField R
  reals =
    algebra standardReals

  proposition : Set
  proposition =
    (T : Nat -> R) ->
    ((n : Nat) ->
      oneN <=N n ->
      multiply reals (T n) (T (suc n)) ==
        fromNat reals n) ->
    ConvergesTo reals
      (\ n -> divide reals (T n) (T (suc n)))
      (oneR reals) ->
    multiply reals
      (pi standardReals)
      (multiply reals (T oneN) (T oneN)) ==
      fromNat reals twoN

putnam-1969-b3 : Set1
putnam-1969-b3 =
  (R : Set) ->
  (standardReals : StandardReals R) ->
  Putnam1969B3Statement.proposition standardReals

(*
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench artifact putnam_1969_b3:
  a real sequence whose adjacent terms have product n for every n >= 1
  and whose successive-term ratio tends to 1 satisfies pi * T_1^2 = 2.
  This file contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open arithmeticTheory realTheory real_topologyTheory transcTheory;

val putnam_1969_b3 =
  ``!T : num -> real.
      (!n : num.
         1 <= n
         ==>
         T n * T (n + 1) = &n) /\
      ((\n : num. T n / T (n + 1)) --> 1) sequentially
      ==>
      pi * (T 1) pow 2 = 2``;

$(
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact
  putnam_1969_b3: a real sequence whose adjacent products equal their
  positive indices and whose consecutive-term ratios converge to one
  satisfies pi times the square of its first term equals two. This file
  contains no proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  T ranges over all real-valued sequences indexed by the nonnegative
  integers. Quantification over NN imposes the adjacent-product recurrence
  exactly at every index n >= 1. The map on NN0 is the full ratio sequence,
  and set.mm's ~~> relation states its convergence to 1. The final
  declaration is the single unproved $a corpus statement; this database
  contains no $p proof statement.

${
  $d T n $.

  putnambench-putnam-1969-b3 $a |-
    A. T e. ( RR ^m NN0 )
      (
        (
          A. n e. NN
            (
              ( ( T ` n ) x. ( T ` ( n + 1 ) ) )
              =
              n
            )
          /\
          (
            n e. NN0 |->
              ( ( T ` n ) / ( T ` ( n + 1 ) ) )
          )
          ~~>
          1
        )
        ->
        ( _pi x. ( ( T ` 1 ) ^ 2 ) ) = 2
      )

$}

:: Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench artifact putnam_1969_b3:
:: a real sequence satisfying T_n*T_(n+1) = n for n >= 1 and whose
:: consecutive-term ratios tend to one has PI*(T_1)^2 = 2. This file

environ
  vocabularies TARSKI, XBOOLE_0, SUBSET_1, RELAT_1, FUNCT_1, FUNCT_2,
    NUMBERS, XREAL_0, XCMPLX_0, COMPLEX1, CARD_1, XXREAL_0, ARYTM_1,

  notations TARSKI, XBOOLE_0, SUBSET_1, RELAT_1, FUNCT_1, RELSET_1,
    FUNCT_2, ORDINAL1, CARD_1, NUMBERS, XCMPLX_0, XREAL_0, REAL_1,
    COMPLEX1, XXREAL_0, NAT_1, VALUED_0, VALUED_1, SEQ_1, SEQ_2,
    COMSEQ_2, SEQM_3, SEQ_4, SQUARE_1, SIN_COS;

    XXREAL_0, NAT_1, SEQ_2, SEQM_3, SEQ_4, BINOP_2, COMSEQ_2,
    SQUARE_1, SIN_COS;
  registrations XBOOLE_0, SUBSET_1, RELAT_1, FUNCT_1, RELSET_1,
    FUNCT_2, NUMBERS, CARD_1, XXREAL_0, MEMBERED, VALUED_0, VALUED_1,

begin

::$P-
theorem
  for T being Real_Sequence st
    (for n being Nat st 1 <= n holds
      T.n * T.(n+1) = (n qua Real)) &
    (ex q being Real_Sequence st

title: putnam_1969_b3
content:
% Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench artifact putnam_1969_b3:
% a real sequence satisfying T(n) * T(n + 1) = n for every n >= 1 and
% T(n) / T(n + 1) converging to one has pi * T(1)^2 = 2. This file
% contains no proof.

putnam_1969_b3: THEORY
BEGIN
  real_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> real]

  alternating_sign(index: nat): RECURSIVE real =
    IF index = 0 THEN
      1
    ELSE
      -alternating_sign(index - 1)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE index

  leibniz_partial_sum(count: nat): RECURSIVE real =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      LET index: nat = count - 1 IN
        leibniz_partial_sum(count - 1)
          + alternating_sign(index)
              / ((2 * index + 1) :: real)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  converges_to(sequence: real_sequence, value: real): bool =
    FORALL (epsilon_value: posreal):
      EXISTS (cutoff: nat):
        FORALL (index: nat):
          cutoff <= index IMPLIES
            abs(sequence(index) - value) < epsilon_value

  is_pi(value: real): bool =
    converges_to(
      LAMBDA (count: nat):
        4 * leibniz_partial_sum(count),
      value)

  pi: real =
    epsilon(
      LAMBDA (value: real):
        is_pi(value))

  real_quotient(numerator, denominator: real): real =
    IF denominator = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      numerator / denominator
    ENDIF

  putnam_1969_b3: bool =
    FORALL (T: real_sequence):
      ((FORALL (n: nat):
          n >= 1 IMPLIES
            T(n) * T(n + 1) = (n :: real))
        AND converges_to(
          LAMBDA (n: nat):
            real_quotient(T(n), T(n + 1)),
          1))
      IMPLIES
        pi * T(1) ^ 2 = 2
END putnam_1969_b3

import Mathlib

open scoped Real EuclideanGeometry

/--
$Γ$ is a plane curve of length 1. Show that we can find a closed rectangle of area 1/4 which covers $Γ$.
-/
theorem putnam_1969_b4
    (Γ : ℝ → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
    --Note: the problem doesn't say what regularity conditions we should impose on `Γ` - hopefully continuity is enough.
    (Γ_cts : ContinuousOn Γ (Set.Icc 0 1))
    (hΓ : eVariationOn Γ (Set.Icc 0 1) = 1) :
    letI : Module.Oriented ℝ (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) (Fin 2) := ⟨Module.Basis.orientation <| PiLp.basisFun 2 ℝ (Fin 2)⟩
    letI : Fact (Module.finrank ℝ (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) = 2) := ⟨finrank_euclideanSpace_fin⟩
    ∃ (a b c d : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)), Γ '' (Set.Icc 0 1) ⊆
      convexHull ℝ {a, b, c, d} ∧ dist a b * dist b c = 1/4 ∧
      --`abcd` is a rectangle
      letI π_div_2 := Real.Angle.coe <| π / 2
      (∡ a b c = π_div_2 ∧ ∡ b c d = π_div_2 ∧ ∡ c d a = π_div_2 ∧ ∡ d a b = π_div_2) :=
  sorry

title: putnam_1969_b4
content:
(* Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench artifact putnam_1969_b4:
   a continuous plane curve of total variation one is covered by a closed
   rectangle of area one quarter. This file contains no proof. *)

From Stdlib Require Import Reals.

Open Scope R_scope.

Definition point := (R * R)%type.
Definition point_set := point -> Prop.

Definition point_subtract (p q : point) : point :=
  (fst p - fst q, snd p - snd q).

Definition point_dot (p q : point) : R :=
  fst p * fst q + snd p * snd q.

Definition point_determinant (p q : point) : R :=
  fst p * snd q - snd p * fst q.

Definition point_distance (p q : point) : R :=
  sqrt ((fst p - fst q) ^ 2 + (snd p - snd q) ^ 2).

Definition affine_combination (t : R) (p q : point) : point :=
  ((1 - t) * fst p + t * fst q,
   (1 - t) * snd p + t * snd q).

Definition subset (A B : point_set) : Prop :=
  forall p : point, A p -> B p.

Definition convex (S : point_set) : Prop :=
  forall (p q : point) (t : R),
    S p ->
    S q ->
    0 <= t <= 1 ->
    S (affine_combination t p q).

Definition convex_hull (S : point_set) : point_set :=
  fun p : point =>
    forall C : point_set,
      convex C ->
      subset S C ->
      C p.

Definition four_points (a b c d : point) : point_set :=
  fun p : point => p = a \/ p = b \/ p = c \/ p = d.

Definition curve_continuous_on_unit_interval
    (Gamma : R -> point) : Prop :=
  forall t : R,
    0 <= t <= 1 ->
    forall epsilon : R,
      0 < epsilon ->
      exists delta : R,
        0 < delta /\
        forall u : R,
          0 <= u <= 1 ->
          Rabs (u - t) < delta ->
          point_distance (Gamma u) (Gamma t) < epsilon.

Fixpoint chain_sum
    (Gamma : R -> point) (parameters : nat -> R) (n : nat) : R :=
  match n with
  | O => 0
  | S k =>
      chain_sum Gamma parameters k +
      point_distance (Gamma (parameters k)) (Gamma (parameters (S k)))
  end.

Definition valid_unit_interval_chain
    (parameters : nat -> R) (n : nat) : Prop :=
  (forall i : nat,
      (i <= n)%nat ->
      0 <= parameters i <= 1) /\
  (forall i : nat,
      (i < n)%nat ->
      parameters i <= parameters (S i)).

Definition curve_total_variation_one
    (Gamma : R -> point) : Prop :=
  (forall (n : nat) (parameters : nat -> R),
      valid_unit_interval_chain parameters n ->
      chain_sum Gamma parameters n <= 1) /\
  (forall lower : R,
      lower < 1 ->
      exists (n : nat) (parameters : nat -> R),
        valid_unit_interval_chain parameters n /\
        lower < chain_sum Gamma parameters n).

Definition oriented_right_angle (a b c : point) : Prop :=
  let ba := point_subtract a b in
  let bc := point_subtract c b in
  point_dot ba bc = 0 /\ 0 < point_determinant ba bc.

Theorem putnam_1969_b4
    (Gamma : R -> point)
    (Gamma_continuous : curve_continuous_on_unit_interval Gamma)
    (Gamma_length : curve_total_variation_one Gamma) :
  exists a b c d : point,
    (forall t : R,
      0 <= t <= 1 ->
      convex_hull (four_points a b c d) (Gamma t)) /\
    point_distance a b * point_distance b c = 1 / 4 /\
    oriented_right_angle a b c /\
    oriented_right_angle b c d /\
    oriented_right_angle c d a /\
    oriented_right_angle d a b.
Admitted.

title: putnam_1969_b4
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench artifact putnam_1969_b4,
  concerning a length-one continuous plane curve covered by a rectangle of
  area one quarter. This file contains no proof.
*)

theory putnam_1969_b4
  imports Complex_Main
begin

definition putnam_1969_b4_partition :: "real list \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "putnam_1969_b4_partition xs \<longleftrightarrow>
    xs \<noteq> [] \<and>
    hd xs = 0 \<and>
    last xs = 1 \<and>
    sorted xs \<and>
    set xs \<subseteq> {0..1}"

definition putnam_1969_b4_partition_length ::
    "(real \<Rightarrow> complex) \<Rightarrow> real list \<Rightarrow> real" where
  "putnam_1969_b4_partition_length \<Gamma> xs =
    (\<Sum>i<length xs - 1. dist (\<Gamma> (xs ! i)) (\<Gamma> (xs ! (Suc i))))"

definition putnam_1969_b4_bounded_variation ::
    "(real \<Rightarrow> complex) \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "putnam_1969_b4_bounded_variation \<Gamma> \<longleftrightarrow>
    (\<exists>B. \<forall>xs.
      putnam_1969_b4_partition xs \<longrightarrow>
      putnam_1969_b4_partition_length \<Gamma> xs \<le> B)"

definition putnam_1969_b4_curve_length ::
    "(real \<Rightarrow> complex) \<Rightarrow> real" where
  "putnam_1969_b4_curve_length \<Gamma> =
    Sup {putnam_1969_b4_partition_length \<Gamma> xs | xs.
      putnam_1969_b4_partition xs}"

definition putnam_1969_b4_in_convex_hull4 ::
    "complex \<Rightarrow> complex \<Rightarrow> complex \<Rightarrow> complex \<Rightarrow>
      complex \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "putnam_1969_b4_in_convex_hull4 p a b c d \<longleftrightarrow>
    (\<exists>wa wb wc wd :: real.
      0 \<le> wa \<and> 0 \<le> wb \<and> 0 \<le> wc \<and> 0 \<le> wd \<and>
      wa + wb + wc + wd = 1 \<and>
      p = of_real wa * a + of_real wb * b +
          of_real wc * c + of_real wd * d)"

definition putnam_1969_b4_right_angle ::
    "complex \<Rightarrow> complex \<Rightarrow> complex \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "putnam_1969_b4_right_angle a b c \<longleftrightarrow>
    Re (cnj (a - b) * (c - b)) = 0"

theorem putnam_1969_b4:
  fixes \<Gamma> :: "real \<Rightarrow> complex"
  assumes \<Gamma>_cts: "continuous_on {0..1} \<Gamma>"
    and \<Gamma>_length:
      "putnam_1969_b4_bounded_variation \<Gamma> \<and>
       putnam_1969_b4_curve_length \<Gamma> = 1"
  shows "\<exists>a b c d :: complex.
    (\<forall>t\<in>{0..1}. putnam_1969_b4_in_convex_hull4 (\<Gamma> t) a b c d) \<and>
    dist a b * dist b c = (1 / 4 :: real) \<and>
    putnam_1969_b4_right_angle a b c \<and>
    putnam_1969_b4_right_angle b c d \<and>
    putnam_1969_b4_right_angle c d a \<and>
    putnam_1969_b4_right_angle d a b"
  sorry

end

(*
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench artifact putnam_1969_b4:
  every continuous plane curve on the unit interval with total variation one
  is contained in a closed rectangle of area one quarter. This file contains
  no proof.
*)

let statement =
  `let vsub =
     \(p:real#real) (q:real#real).
       (FST p - FST q,SND p - SND q) in
   let dot =
     \(u:real#real) (v:real#real).
       FST u * FST v + SND u * SND v in
   let edist =
     \(p:real#real) (q:real#real).
       sqrt (dot (vsub p q) (vsub p q)) in
   let continuous_on_unit_interval =
     \(g:real->real#real).
       !x. &0 <= x /\ x <= &1
           ==> !e. &0 < e
                   ==> ?d. &0 < d /\
                           !y. &0 <= y /\ y <= &1 /\ abs (y - x) < d
                               ==> edist (g y) (g x) < e in
   let unit_partition =
     \n (t:num->real).
       1 <= n /\ t 0 = &0 /\ t n = &1 /\
       (!i. i < n ==> t i < t (i + 1)) in
   let has_unit_variation =
     \(g:real->real#real).
       (!n t. unit_partition n t
              ==> sum (0..n - 1) (\i. edist (g (t (i + 1))) (g (t i)))
                  <= &1) /\
       (!e. &0 < e
            ==> ?n t. unit_partition n t /\
                      &1 - e <
                      sum (0..n - 1)
                          (\i. edist (g (t (i + 1))) (g (t i)))) in
   let quadrilateral_hull =
     \(a:real#real) (b:real#real) (c:real#real) (d:real#real)
      (p:real#real).
       ?u v w z:real.
         &0 <= u /\ &0 <= v /\ &0 <= w /\ &0 <= z /\
         u + v + w + z = &1 /\
         FST p = u * FST a + v * FST b + w * FST c + z * FST d /\
         SND p = u * SND a + v * SND b + w * SND c + z * SND d in
   let right_angle =
     \(a:real#real) (b:real#real) (c:real#real).
       dot (vsub a b) (vsub c b) = &0 in
   !g:real->real#real.
     continuous_on_unit_interval g /\
     has_unit_variation g
     ==> ?a b c d:real#real.
       (!x. &0 <= x /\ x <= &1 ==> quadrilateral_hull a b c d (g x)) /\
       edist a b * edist b c = &1 / &4 /\
       right_angle a b c /\
       right_angle b c d /\
       right_angle c d a /\
       right_angle d a b`;;

title: putnam_1969_b4

;; Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1969_b4:
;; every continuous plane curve of Euclidean length 1 is covered by a closed
;; rectangle of area 1/4. This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

;; A code is an ordered rational polygonal path.  LENGTHS records the positive
;; rational Euclidean length of each consecutive segment, so the squared
;; distance equation below is exact and their sum being 1 is exactly the
;; source variation hypothesis for the associated piecewise-linear curve.
;;
;; This polygonal formulation is bidirectionally counterexample-preserving.
;; Every code denotes a source curve.  Conversely, failure of the source
;; conclusion means that the minimum area of an enclosing rectangle is
;; strictly greater than 1/4: any rectangle of smaller area can be widened to
;; area exactly 1/4.  Fine polygonal approximation preserves that strict
;; failure.  Rational unit directions and rational positive segment lengths
;; are dense; after approximating the segments, rational rescaling makes their
;; total length exactly 1 while preserving the strict failure.
;;
;; For a polygon, a minimum-area enclosing rectangle has a side parallel to an
;; edge of its convex hull.  Every hull edge joins two listed vertices.  For a
;; vertex-pair direction d, the rectangle side lengths are the spans of dot
;; and perpendicular projections divided by |d|, so its area is at most 1/4
;; exactly when
;;
;;   4 * dot-span * perpendicular-span <= |d|^2.
;;
;; The finite pair search therefore keeps the source rectangle existential
;; internal.  Its two projection slabs form a closed right-angled rectangle
;; covering every segment, and widening a side gives area exactly 1/4.

(defun putnam-1969-b4-rational-point-p (point)
  (and (consp point)
       (rationalp (car point))
       (rationalp (cdr point))))

(defun putnam-1969-b4-distance-squared (left right)
  (+ (* (- (car right) (car left))
        (- (car right) (car left)))
     (* (- (cdr right) (cdr left))
        (- (cdr right) (cdr left)))))

(defun putnam-1969-b4-polygon-code-p (points lengths)
  (if (consp points)
      (if (consp (cdr points))
          (and (putnam-1969-b4-rational-point-p (car points))
               (consp lengths)
               (rationalp (car lengths))
               (< 0 (car lengths))
               (equal
                (putnam-1969-b4-distance-squared
                 (car points) (cadr points))
                (* (car lengths) (car lengths)))
               (putnam-1969-b4-polygon-code-p
                (cdr points) (cdr lengths)))
        (and (putnam-1969-b4-rational-point-p (car points))
             (equal (cdr points) nil)
             (equal lengths nil)))
    nil))

(defun putnam-1969-b4-sum (values)
  (if (consp values)
      (+ (car values)
         (putnam-1969-b4-sum (cdr values)))
    0))

(defun putnam-1969-b4-dot-projection (point dx dy)
  (+ (* (car point) dx)
     (* (cdr point) dy)))

(defun putnam-1969-b4-perpendicular-projection (point dx dy)
  (- (* (cdr point) dx)
     (* (car point) dy)))

(defun putnam-1969-b4-dot-min (points dx dy current)
  (if (consp points)
      (let ((value
             (putnam-1969-b4-dot-projection
              (car points) dx dy)))
        (putnam-1969-b4-dot-min
         (cdr points) dx dy
         (if (< value current) value current)))
    current))

(defun putnam-1969-b4-dot-max (points dx dy current)
  (if (consp points)
      (let ((value
             (putnam-1969-b4-dot-projection
              (car points) dx dy)))
        (putnam-1969-b4-dot-max
         (cdr points) dx dy
         (if (< current value) value current)))
    current))

(defun putnam-1969-b4-perpendicular-min
    (points dx dy current)
  (if (consp points)
      (let ((value
             (putnam-1969-b4-perpendicular-projection
              (car points) dx dy)))
        (putnam-1969-b4-perpendicular-min
         (cdr points) dx dy
         (if (< value current) value current)))
    current))

(defun putnam-1969-b4-perpendicular-max
    (points dx dy current)
  (if (consp points)
      (let ((value
             (putnam-1969-b4-perpendicular-projection
              (car points) dx dy)))
        (putnam-1969-b4-perpendicular-max
         (cdr points) dx dy
         (if (< current value) value current)))
    current))

(defun putnam-1969-b4-quarter-area-direction-p
    (left right all-points)
  (let* ((dx (- (car right) (car left)))
         (dy (- (cdr right) (cdr left)))
         (norm-squared (+ (* dx dx) (* dy dy)))
         (first (car all-points))
         (first-dot
          (putnam-1969-b4-dot-projection first dx dy))
         (first-perpendicular
          (putnam-1969-b4-perpendicular-projection first dx dy))
         (dot-span
          (- (putnam-1969-b4-dot-max
              (cdr all-points) dx dy first-dot)
             (putnam-1969-b4-dot-min
              (cdr all-points) dx dy first-dot)))
         (perpendicular-span
          (- (putnam-1969-b4-perpendicular-max
              (cdr all-points) dx dy first-perpendicular)
             (putnam-1969-b4-perpendicular-min
              (cdr all-points) dx dy first-perpendicular))))
    (and (< 0 norm-squared)
         (<= (* 4 dot-span perpendicular-span)
             norm-squared))))

(defun putnam-1969-b4-direction-from-point-p
    (left remaining all-points)
  (if (consp remaining)
      (or (putnam-1969-b4-quarter-area-direction-p
           left (car remaining) all-points)
          (putnam-1969-b4-direction-from-point-p
           left (cdr remaining) all-points))
    nil))

(defun putnam-1969-b4-enclosing-quarter-rectangle-p
    (remaining all-points)
  (if (consp remaining)
      (or (putnam-1969-b4-direction-from-point-p
           (car remaining) (cdr remaining) all-points)
          (putnam-1969-b4-enclosing-quarter-rectangle-p
           (cdr remaining) all-points))
    nil))

(defun putnambench-putnam-1969-b4-statement (points lengths)
  (implies
   (and (true-listp points)
        (true-listp lengths)
        (consp (cdr points))
        (putnam-1969-b4-polygon-code-p points lengths)
        (equal (putnam-1969-b4-sum lengths) 1))
   (putnam-1969-b4-enclosing-quarter-rectangle-p
    points points)))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

content:
-- Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1969_b4:
-- every continuous plane curve of length one is covered by a closed rectangle
-- of area one quarter. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc)

infix 4 _!=_ _<N_
infixr 3 _and_
infixr 2 _or_

data Bottom : Set where

Not : Set -> Set
Not A =
  A -> Bottom

_!=_ : {A : Set} -> A -> A -> Set
x != y =
  Not (x == y)

record _and_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data _or_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  left  : A -> A or B
  right : B -> A or B

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

data _<N_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set where
  zero<suc : {n : Nat} -> zero <N suc n
  suc<suc  : {m n : Nat} -> m <N n -> suc m <N suc n

one : Nat
one =
  suc zero

two : Nat
two =
  suc one

three : Nat
three =
  suc two

four : Nat
four =
  suc three

record CompleteOrderedRealField (R : Set) : Set1 where
  field
    zeroR oneR : R
    add multiply : R -> R -> R
    negate inverse squareRoot : R -> R
    lessOrEqual : R -> R -> Set
    fromNat : Nat -> R

    one-not-zero :
      oneR != zeroR

    add-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> add x y == add y x
    add-associative :
      (x y z : R) -> add (add x y) z == add x (add y z)
    add-zero :
      (x : R) -> add x zeroR == x
    add-inverse :
      (x : R) -> add x (negate x) == zeroR

    multiply-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> multiply x y == multiply y x
    multiply-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply (multiply x y) z == multiply x (multiply y z)
    multiply-one :
      (x : R) -> multiply x oneR == x
    multiply-zero :
      (x : R) -> multiply x zeroR == zeroR
    distribute :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply x (add y z) ==
      add (multiply x y) (multiply x z)
    inverse-zero :
      inverse zeroR == zeroR
    multiply-inverse :
      (x : R) ->
      x != zeroR ->
      multiply x (inverse x) == oneR

    order-reflexive :
      (x : R) -> lessOrEqual x x
    order-transitive :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y z ->
      lessOrEqual x z
    order-antisymmetric :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y x ->
      x == y
    order-total :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y or lessOrEqual y x
    add-order :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual (add z x) (add z y)
    multiply-nonnegative :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR x ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR y ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR (multiply x y)
    zero-less-than-one :
      lessOrEqual zeroR oneR and zeroR != oneR

    fromNat-zero :
      fromNat zero == zeroR
    fromNat-successor :
      (n : Nat) -> fromNat (suc n) == add (fromNat n) oneR

    archimedean :
      (x : R) ->
      Exists Nat (\ n -> lessOrEqual x (fromNat n))
    least-upper-bound :
      (P : R -> Set) ->
      Exists R P ->
      Exists R
        (\ upper ->
          (x : R) ->
          P x ->
          lessOrEqual x upper) ->
      Exists R
        (\ supremum ->
          ((x : R) -> P x -> lessOrEqual x supremum)
          and
          ((upper : R) ->
            ((x : R) -> P x -> lessOrEqual x upper) ->
            lessOrEqual supremum upper))

    square-root-nonnegative :
      (x : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR (squareRoot x)
    square-root-square :
      (x : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR x ->
      multiply (squareRoot x) (squareRoot x) == x
    square-root-nonpositive :
      (x : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x zeroR ->
      squareRoot x == zeroR

open CompleteOrderedRealField

subtract :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
subtract reals x y =
  add reals x (negate reals y)

square :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R
square reals x =
  multiply reals x x

StrictLess :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
StrictLess reals x y =
  lessOrEqual reals x y and x != y

Nonnegative :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  Set
Nonnegative reals x =
  lessOrEqual reals (zeroR reals) x

UnitInterval :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  Set
UnitInterval reals x =
  lessOrEqual reals (zeroR reals) x
  and
  lessOrEqual reals x (oneR reals)

realDistance :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
realDistance reals x y =
  squareRoot reals (square reals (subtract reals x y))

record Point (R : Set) : Set where
  constructor point
  field
    x-coordinate : R
    y-coordinate : R

open Point

PointEqual :
  {R : Set} ->
  Point R ->
  Point R ->
  Set
PointEqual p q =
  x-coordinate p == x-coordinate q
  and
  y-coordinate p == y-coordinate q

squaredDistance :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Point R ->
  Point R ->
  R
squaredDistance reals p q =
  add reals
    (square reals
      (subtract reals (x-coordinate p) (x-coordinate q)))
    (square reals
      (subtract reals (y-coordinate p) (y-coordinate q)))

pointDistance :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Point R ->
  Point R ->
  R
pointDistance reals p q =
  squareRoot reals (squaredDistance reals p q)

ContinuousOnUnitInterval :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (R -> Point R) ->
  Set
ContinuousOnUnitInterval {R} reals curve =
  (t : R) ->
  UnitInterval reals t ->
  (epsilon : R) ->
  StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) epsilon ->
  Exists R
    (\ delta ->
      StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) delta
      and
      ((s : R) ->
        UnitInterval reals s ->
        StrictLess reals (realDistance reals s t) delta ->
        StrictLess reals
          (pointDistance reals (curve s) (curve t))
          epsilon))

module Putnam1969B4Statement
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) where

  Curve : Set
  Curve =
    R -> Point R

  record Partition : Set where
    constructor partition
    field
      count : Nat
      parameter : Nat -> R
      begins-at-zero :
        parameter zero == zeroR reals
      ends-at-one :
        parameter count == oneR reals
      increasing :
        (i : Nat) ->
        i <N count ->
        lessOrEqual reals
          (parameter i)
          (parameter (suc i))

  open Partition

  distanceSum :
    Curve ->
    (Nat -> R) ->
    Nat ->
    R
  distanceSum curve parameters zero =
    zeroR reals
  distanceSum curve parameters (suc n) =
    add reals
      (distanceSum curve parameters n)
      (pointDistance reals
        (curve (parameters n))
        (curve (parameters (suc n))))

  partitionLength :
    Curve ->
    Partition ->
    R
  partitionLength curve p =
    distanceSum curve (parameter p) (count p)

  UpperLengthBound :
    Curve ->
    R ->
    Set
  UpperLengthBound curve bound =
    (p : Partition) ->
    lessOrEqual reals (partitionLength curve p) bound

  PathLength :
    Curve ->
    R ->
    Set
  PathLength curve length =
    UpperLengthBound curve length
    and
    ((bound : R) ->
      UpperLengthBound curve bound ->
      lessOrEqual reals length bound)

  record ConvexWeights : Set where
    constructor weights
    field
      alpha beta gamma delta : R

  open ConvexWeights

  weightSum :
    ConvexWeights ->
    R
  weightSum w =
    add reals
      (alpha w)
      (add reals
        (beta w)
        (add reals (gamma w) (delta w)))

  weightedPoint :
    ConvexWeights ->
    Point R ->
    Point R ->
    Point R ->
    Point R ->
    Point R
  weightedPoint w a b c d =
    point
      (add reals
        (multiply reals (alpha w) (x-coordinate a))
        (add reals
          (multiply reals (beta w) (x-coordinate b))
          (add reals
            (multiply reals (gamma w) (x-coordinate c))
            (multiply reals (delta w) (x-coordinate d)))))
      (add reals
        (multiply reals (alpha w) (y-coordinate a))
        (add reals
          (multiply reals (beta w) (y-coordinate b))
          (add reals
            (multiply reals (gamma w) (y-coordinate c))
            (multiply reals (delta w) (y-coordinate d)))))

  ConvexHull4 :
    Point R ->
    Point R ->
    Point R ->
    Point R ->
    Point R ->
    Set
  ConvexHull4 a b c d p =
    Exists ConvexWeights
      (\ w ->
        Nonnegative reals (alpha w)
        and
        Nonnegative reals (beta w)
        and
        Nonnegative reals (gamma w)
        and
        Nonnegative reals (delta w)
        and
        weightSum w == oneR reals
        and
        PointEqual p (weightedPoint w a b c d))

  dotAt :
    Point R ->
    Point R ->
    Point R ->
    R
  dotAt a vertex c =
    add reals
      (multiply reals
        (subtract reals (x-coordinate a) (x-coordinate vertex))
        (subtract reals (x-coordinate c) (x-coordinate vertex)))
      (multiply reals
        (subtract reals (y-coordinate a) (y-coordinate vertex))
        (subtract reals (y-coordinate c) (y-coordinate vertex)))

  RightAngle :
    Point R ->
    Point R ->
    Point R ->
    Set
  RightAngle a vertex c =
    Not (PointEqual a vertex)
    and
    Not (PointEqual c vertex)
    and
    dotAt a vertex c == zeroR reals

  oneQuarter : R
  oneQuarter =
    multiply reals
      (oneR reals)
      (inverse reals (fromNat reals four))

  CoveredByRectangle :
    Curve ->
    Point R ->
    Point R ->
    Point R ->
    Point R ->
    Set
  CoveredByRectangle curve a b c d =
    ((t : R) ->
      UnitInterval reals t ->
      ConvexHull4 a b c d (curve t))
    and
    multiply reals
      (pointDistance reals a b)
      (pointDistance reals b c)
      == oneQuarter
    and
    RightAngle a b c
    and
    RightAngle b c d
    and
    RightAngle c d a
    and
    RightAngle d a b

  proposition : Set
  proposition =
    (curve : Curve) ->
    ContinuousOnUnitInterval reals curve ->
    PathLength curve (oneR reals) ->
    Exists (Point R)
      (\ a ->
        Exists (Point R)
          (\ b ->
            Exists (Point R)
              (\ c ->
                Exists (Point R)
                  (\ d ->
                    CoveredByRectangle curve a b c d))))

putnam-1969-b4 : Set1
putnam-1969-b4 =
  (R : Set) ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) ->
  Putnam1969B4Statement.proposition reals

title: putnam_1969_b4
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench artifact putnam_1969_b4:
  every continuous plane curve of Euclidean variation one on the unit
  interval is covered by a closed rectangle of area one quarter.
  This file contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open arithmeticTheory pairTheory pred_setTheory realTheory real_sigmaTheory
     real_topologyTheory transcTheory;

val putnam_1969_b4 =
  ``let sqdist =
      \P Q : real # real.
        (FST P - FST Q) pow 2 + (SND P - SND Q) pow 2
    in
    let dist =
      \P Q : real # real. sqrt (sqdist P Q)
    in
    let monotone_partition =
      \u : num -> real.
        (!i j : num. i <= j ==> u i <= u j) /\
        (!i : num. 0 <= u i /\ u i <= 1)
    in
    let polygonal_sum =
      \G : real -> real # real.
      \n : num.
      \u : num -> real.
        SIGMA
          (\i : num. dist (G (u (i + 1))) (G (u i)))
          (count n)
    in
    let curve_length_one =
      \G : real -> real # real.
        (!n : num. !u : num -> real.
           monotone_partition u ==> polygonal_sum G n u <= 1) /\
        (!b : real.
           (!n : num. !u : num -> real.
              monotone_partition u ==> polygonal_sum G n u <= b)
           ==>
           1 <= b)
    in
    let in_convex_hull4 =
      \A B C D X : real # real.
        ?wa wb wc wd : real.
          0 <= wa /\ 0 <= wb /\ 0 <= wc /\ 0 <= wd /\
          wa + wb + wc + wd = 1 /\
          X =
            (wa * FST A + wb * FST B + wc * FST C + wd * FST D,
             wa * SND A + wb * SND B + wc * SND C + wd * SND D)
    in
    let right_angle =
      \P Q R : real # real.
        (FST P - FST Q) * (FST R - FST Q) +
        (SND P - SND Q) * (SND R - SND Q) = 0 /\
        0 <
          (FST P - FST Q) * (SND R - SND Q) -
          (SND P - SND Q) * (FST R - FST Q)
    in
      !G : real -> real # real.
        (\t : real. FST (G t)) continuous_on interval [0, 1] /\
        (\t : real. SND (G t)) continuous_on interval [0, 1] /\
        curve_length_one G
        ==>
        ?A B C D : real # real.
          (!t : real.
             0 <= t /\ t <= 1 ==> in_convex_hull4 A B C D (G t)) /\
          dist A B * dist B C = 1 / 4 /\
          right_angle A B C /\
          right_angle B C D /\
          right_angle C D A /\
          right_angle D A B``;

$(
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact
  putnam_1969_b4: every continuous real-plane curve on the closed unit
  interval with extended variation one is covered by a four-vertex rectangle
  whose area is one quarter. This file contains no proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  P69B4R2 is the real coordinate plane with its standard finite-product
  topology. P69B4Dist is Euclidean distance, and P69B4Angle A B C is the
  total unoriented angle at B, with value pi/2 when either ray is zero, as in
  Lean's EuclideanGeometry angle.

  P69B4Continuous says that the restriction of the total curve G to [0,1] is
  continuous. P69B4Variation is the supremum of all polygonal sums over
  strictly increasing finite partitions from 0 to 1. This equals the
  extended metric variation on [0,1] when finite; hence equality to one is
  equivalent to the source hypothesis eVariationOn G [0,1] = 1.

  P69B4Hull is the convex hull of a finite point set, expressed through
  internally existential nonnegative barycentric weights. The four rectangle
  vertices in the final assertion are likewise internally existential. The
  final declaration is the single unproved $a corpus statement; this
  database contains no $p proof statement.
$)

$c P69B4I P69B4R2 P69B4Top P69B4Dist P69B4Dot P69B4Angle $.
$c P69B4Hull P69B4Continuous P69B4Variation $.

p69b4-coordinate-index-syntax $a class P69B4I $.
p69b4-plane-syntax $a class P69B4R2 $.
p69b4-topology-syntax $a class P69B4Top $.
p69b4-distance-syntax $a class ( P69B4Dist A B ) $.
p69b4-dot-syntax $a class ( P69B4Dot A B C ) $.
p69b4-angle-syntax $a class ( P69B4Angle A B C ) $.
p69b4-hull-syntax $a class ( P69B4Hull S ) $.
p69b4-continuous-syntax $a wff ( P69B4Continuous G ) $.
p69b4-variation-syntax $a class ( P69B4Variation G ) $.

p69b4-coordinate-index-definition $a |- P69B4I = ( 1 ... 2 ) $.

p69b4-plane-definition $a |- P69B4R2 = ( RR ^m P69B4I ) $.

p69b4-topology-definition $a |- P69B4Top = (
  Xt_ `
    ( P69B4I X. { ( topGen ` ran (,) ) } )
) $.

${
  $d A B k $.

  p69b4-distance-definition $a |- (
    P69B4Dist A B
  ) = (
    sqrt
    `
    (
      sum_ k e. P69B4I
        ( ( ( A ` k ) - ( B ` k ) ) ^ 2 )
    )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d A B C k $.

  p69b4-dot-definition $a |- (
    P69B4Dot A B C
  ) = (
    sum_ k e. P69B4I
      (
        ( ( A ` k ) - ( B ` k ) )
        x.
        ( ( C ` k ) - ( B ` k ) )
      )
  ) $.
$}

p69b4-angle-definition $a |- (
  P69B4Angle A B C
) = if (
  (
    ( ( P69B4Dist A B ) = 0 )
    \/
    ( ( P69B4Dist C B ) = 0 )
  )
  ,
  ( _pi / 2 )
  ,
  (
    arccos
    `
    (
      ( P69B4Dot A B C )
      /
      (
        ( P69B4Dist A B )
        x.
        ( P69B4Dist C B )
      )
    )
  )
) $.

${
  $d S i w x z $.

  p69b4-hull-definition $a |- (
    P69B4Hull S
  ) = {
    z e. P69B4R2 |
    E. w
      (
        (
          w : S --> RR
          /\
          A. x e. S 0 <_ ( w ` x )
        )
        /\
        (
          ( sum_ x e. S ( w ` x ) ) = 1
          /\
          z =
            (
              i e. P69B4I |->
                sum_ x e. S
                  (
                    ( w ` x )
                    x.
                    ( x ` i )
                  )
            )
        )
      )
  } $.
$}

${
  p69b4-continuous-definition $a |- (
    ( P69B4Continuous G )
    <->
    (
      ( G |` ( 0 [,] 1 ) ) e.
        (
          ( ( TopOpen ` RRfld ) |`t ( 0 [,] 1 ) )
          Cn
          P69B4Top
        )
    )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d G j k n p s $.

  p69b4-variation-definition $a |- (
    ( P69B4Variation G )
    =
    sup
      (
        { s e. RR |
          E. n e. NN E. p
            (
              (
                p : ( 0 ... n ) --> RR
                /\
                ( ( p ` 0 ) = 0 /\ ( p ` n ) = 1 )
              )
              /\
              (
                A. j e. ( 0 ..^ n )
                  ( p ` j ) < ( p ` ( j + 1 ) )
                /\
                s =
                  sum_ k e. ( 0 ..^ n )
                    (
                      P69B4Dist
                        ( G ` ( p ` ( k + 1 ) ) )
                        ( G ` ( p ` k ) )
                    )
              )
            )
        } ,
        RR ,
        <
      )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d A B C D G $.

  putnambench-putnam-1969-b4 $a |-
    A. G e. ( P69B4R2 ^m RR )
      (
        (
          ( P69B4Continuous G )
          /\
          ( P69B4Variation G ) = 1
        )
        ->
        E. A e. P69B4R2
        E. B e. P69B4R2
        E. C e. P69B4R2
        E. D e. P69B4R2
          (
            ( G " ( 0 [,] 1 ) )
              C_ ( P69B4Hull ( { A , B } u. { C , D } ) )
            /\
            (
              (
                ( P69B4Dist A B )
                x.
                ( P69B4Dist B C )
              )
              =
              ( 1 / 4 )
              /\
              (
                ( P69B4Angle A B C ) = ( _pi / 2 )
                /\
                (
                  ( P69B4Angle B C D ) = ( _pi / 2 )
                  /\
                  (
                    ( P69B4Angle C D A ) = ( _pi / 2 )
                    /\
                    ( P69B4Angle D A B ) = ( _pi / 2 )
                  )
                )
              )
            )
          )
      )
  $.
$}

title: putnam_1969_b4
content:
% Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench artifact putnam_1969_b4:
% a continuous real plane curve of total variation one admits four vertices
% whose convex hull covers the curve, whose adjacent side lengths multiply
% to 1/4, and whose four vertex angles are right angles. This file contains no proof.

putnam_1969_b4: THEORY
BEGIN
  point: TYPE = [# x_coord: real, y_coord: real #]
  parametrized_curve: TYPE = [real -> point]
  knot_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> real]

  squared_distance(p, q: point): real =
    (x_coord(p) - x_coord(q)) ^ 2
      + (y_coord(p) - y_coord(q)) ^ 2

  euclidean_distance(p, q: point): real =
    epsilon(
      LAMBDA (distance: real):
        0 <= distance
          AND distance ^ 2 = squared_distance(p, q))

  in_unit_interval(t: real): bool =
    0 <= t AND t <= 1

  point_close(p, q: point, epsilon_value: real): bool =
    squared_distance(p, q) < epsilon_value ^ 2

  continuous_on_unit_interval(g: parametrized_curve): bool =
    FORALL (t: real):
      in_unit_interval(t) IMPLIES
        FORALL (epsilon_value: posreal):
          EXISTS (delta: posreal):
            FORALL (s: real):
              (in_unit_interval(s) AND abs(s - t) < delta)
                IMPLIES point_close(g(s), g(t), epsilon_value)

  partition_of_unit_interval(
      knots: knot_sequence,
      count: nat): bool =
    knots(0) = 0
      AND knots(count) = 1
      AND FORALL (index: nat):
        index < count IMPLIES
          knots(index) < knots(index + 1)

  polygonal_length(
      g: parametrized_curve,
      knots: knot_sequence,
      count: nat): RECURSIVE real =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      polygonal_length(g, knots, count - 1)
        + euclidean_distance(
            g(knots(count - 1)),
            g(knots(count)))
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  variation_upper_bound(g: parametrized_curve, bound: real): bool =
    0 <= bound
      AND FORALL (knots: knot_sequence), (count: nat):
        partition_of_unit_interval(knots, count)
          IMPLIES polygonal_length(g, knots, count) <= bound

  is_path_length(g: parametrized_curve, length: real): bool =
    variation_upper_bound(g, length)
      AND FORALL (lower: real):
        lower < length IMPLIES
          EXISTS (knots: knot_sequence), (count: nat):
            partition_of_unit_interval(knots, count)
              AND lower < polygonal_length(g, knots, count)

  in_four_point_convex_hull(
      p, a, b, c, d: point): bool =
    EXISTS (wa, wb, wc, wd: real):
      0 <= wa
        AND 0 <= wb
        AND 0 <= wc
        AND 0 <= wd
        AND wa + wb + wc + wd = 1
        AND x_coord(p) =
          wa * x_coord(a)
            + wb * x_coord(b)
            + wc * x_coord(c)
            + wd * x_coord(d)
        AND y_coord(p) =
          wa * y_coord(a)
            + wb * y_coord(b)
            + wc * y_coord(c)
            + wd * y_coord(d)

  curve_covered_by_convex_hull(
      g: parametrized_curve,
      a, b, c, d: point): bool =
    FORALL (t: real):
      in_unit_interval(t) IMPLIES
        in_four_point_convex_hull(g(t), a, b, c, d)

  dot_from(vertex, first, second: point): real =
    (x_coord(first) - x_coord(vertex))
      * (x_coord(second) - x_coord(vertex))
      + (y_coord(first) - y_coord(vertex))
          * (y_coord(second) - y_coord(vertex))

  right_angle(first, vertex, second: point): bool =
    dot_from(vertex, first, second) = 0

  putnam_1969_b4: bool =
    FORALL (g: parametrized_curve):
      (continuous_on_unit_interval(g)
        AND is_path_length(g, 1))
      IMPLIES
        EXISTS (a, b, c, d: point):
          curve_covered_by_convex_hull(g, a, b, c, d)
            AND euclidean_distance(a, b)
                  * euclidean_distance(b, c)
                = 1 / 4
            AND right_angle(a, b, c)
            AND right_angle(b, c, d)
            AND right_angle(c, d, a)
            AND right_angle(d, a, b)
END putnam_1969_b4

title: putnam_1969_b5

import Mathlib

open Matrix Filter Topology Set Nat

/--
Let $a_1 < a_2 < a_3 < \dots$ be an increasing sequence of positive integers. Assume that the sequences $\sum_{i = 1}^{\infty} 1/(a n)$ is convergent. For any number $x$, let $k(x)$ be the number of $a_n$'s which do not exceed $x$. Show that $\lim_{x \to \infty} k(x)/x = 0$.
-/
theorem putnam_1969_b5
(a : ℕ → ℕ)
(ha : StrictMono a ∧ ∀ x : ℕ, a x > 0)
(hinvasum : ∃ C : ℝ, Tendsto (fun n => ∑ i : Fin n, 1 / (a i : ℝ)) atTop (𝓝 C))
(k : ℕ → ℕ)
(hk : k = fun x => {n | a n ≤ x}.ncard)
: Tendsto (fun t => (k t : ℝ) / (t : ℝ)) atTop (𝓝 0) :=
sorry

title: putnam_1969_b5
content:
Section putnam_1969_b5.
Require Import Reals Finite_sets. From Coquelicot Require Import Coquelicot.
Open Scope R.

Theorem putnam_1969_b5
    (a : nat -> nat)
    (ha : forall n : nat, (0 < a n < a (Nat.add n 1))%nat)
    (hinvasum : ex_finite_lim_seq (fun n => sum_n (fun i => 1 / INR (a i)) n))
    (k : nat -> nat)
    (hk : forall x : nat, cardinal nat (fun n => (a n <= x)%nat) (k x))
    : is_lim_seq (fun t : nat => INR (k t) / INR t) 0.
Proof. Admitted.
End putnam_1969_b5.

theorem putnam_1969_b5:
  fixes a :: "nat \<Rightarrow> nat"
  and k :: "nat \<Rightarrow> nat"
  assumes ha: "strict_mono a \<and> (\<forall>n::nat. a n > 0)"
  and hinvasum: "\<exists>C::real. filterlim (\<lambda>n::nat. (\<Sum>i\<in>{..<n}. 1 / real_of_nat (a i))) (nhds C) at_top"
  defines "k \<equiv> (\<lambda>x::nat. card {n::nat. a n \<le> x})"
  shows "filterlim (\<lambda>t::nat. real_of_nat (k t) / real_of_nat t) (nhds 0) at_top"
  sorry

end

;; Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1969_b5:
;; for a strictly increasing sequence of positive integers whose reciprocal
;; series converges, its counting function K(N) satisfies K(N)/N -> 0. The
;; published problem has an integer sequence; checking natural thresholds is
;; equivalent to checking all real thresholds because K is a step function.
;; This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))

(defstub putnam-1969-b5-a (n) t)
(defstub putnam-1969-b5-k (threshold) t)

(defun-sk putnam-1969-b5-positive-sequence-p ()
  (forall (n)
    (implies
     (natp n)
     (posp (putnam-1969-b5-a n)))))

(defun-sk putnam-1969-b5-strictly-increasing-p ()
  (forall (i j)
    (implies
     (and (natp i) (natp j) (< i j))
     (< (putnam-1969-b5-a i)
        (putnam-1969-b5-a j)))))

(defun putnam-1969-b5-reciprocal-partial-sum (count)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix count)))
  (if (and (natp count) (< 0 count))
      (+ (putnam-1969-b5-reciprocal-partial-sum (- count 1))
         (/ (putnam-1969-b5-a (- count 1))))
    0))

(defun-sk putnam-1969-b5-series-tail-p (epsilon cutoff)
  (forall (m n)
    (implies
     (and
      (natp m)
      (natp n)
      (natp cutoff)
      (<= cutoff m)
      (<= cutoff n))
     (<
      (abs
       (-
        (putnam-1969-b5-reciprocal-partial-sum m)
        (putnam-1969-b5-reciprocal-partial-sum n)))
      epsilon))))

(defun-sk putnam-1969-b5-series-cutoff-exists-p (epsilon)
  (exists (cutoff)
    (and
     (natp cutoff)
     (putnam-1969-b5-series-tail-p epsilon cutoff))))

(defun-sk putnam-1969-b5-reciprocal-series-converges-p ()
  (forall (epsilon)
    (implies
     (and (rationalp epsilon) (< 0 epsilon))
     (putnam-1969-b5-series-cutoff-exists-p epsilon))))

(defun putnam-1969-b5-index-list-p (threshold indices)
  (if (consp indices)
      (and
       (natp (car indices))
       (<= (putnam-1969-b5-a (car indices)) threshold)
       (putnam-1969-b5-index-list-p threshold (cdr indices)))
    (equal indices nil)))

(defun-sk putnam-1969-b5-all-indices-listed-p (threshold indices)
  (forall (index)
    (implies
     (and
      (natp index)
      (<= (putnam-1969-b5-a index) threshold))
     (member-equal index indices))))

(defun putnam-1969-b5-count-witness-p (threshold indices)
  (and
   (natp threshold)
   (true-listp indices)
   (no-duplicatesp-equal indices)
   (putnam-1969-b5-index-list-p threshold indices)
   (putnam-1969-b5-all-indices-listed-p threshold indices)
   (equal (len indices) (putnam-1969-b5-k threshold))))

(defun-sk putnam-1969-b5-count-witness-exists-p (threshold)
  (exists (indices)
    (putnam-1969-b5-count-witness-p threshold indices)))

(defun-sk putnam-1969-b5-counting-function-p ()
  (forall (threshold)
    (implies
     (natp threshold)
     (putnam-1969-b5-count-witness-exists-p threshold))))

(defun-sk putnam-1969-b5-density-tail-p (epsilon cutoff)
  (forall (threshold)
    (implies
     (and
      (posp threshold)
      (natp cutoff)
      (<= cutoff threshold))
     (<
      (abs (/ (putnam-1969-b5-k threshold) threshold))
      epsilon))))

(defun-sk putnam-1969-b5-density-cutoff-exists-p (epsilon)
  (exists (cutoff)
    (and
     (posp cutoff)
     (putnam-1969-b5-density-tail-p epsilon cutoff))))

(defun-sk putnam-1969-b5-density-tends-to-zero-p ()
  (forall (epsilon)
    (implies
     (and (rationalp epsilon) (< 0 epsilon))
     (putnam-1969-b5-density-cutoff-exists-p epsilon))))

(defun putnambench-putnam-1969-b5-statement ()
  (implies
   (and
    (putnam-1969-b5-positive-sequence-p)
    (putnam-1969-b5-strictly-increasing-p)
    (putnam-1969-b5-reciprocal-series-converges-p)
    (putnam-1969-b5-counting-function-p))
   (putnam-1969-b5-density-tends-to-zero-p)))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

title: putnam_1969_b5
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1969_b5:
-- a strictly increasing positive integer sequence with convergent reciprocal
-- series has counting function k(x) satisfying k(x) / x -> 0 at positive
-- infinity. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; _*_)

infix 4 _!=_ _<=N_
infixr 3 _and_
infixr 2 _or_

data Bottom : Set where

Not : Set -> Set
Not A =
  A -> Bottom

_!=_ : {A : Set} -> A -> A -> Set
x != y =
  Not (x == y)

record _and_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data _or_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  left  : A -> A or B
  right : B -> A or B

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

data _<=N_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set where
  zero<=   : {n : Nat} -> zero <=N n
  suc<=suc : {m n : Nat} -> m <=N n -> suc m <=N suc n

NatStrictLess : Nat -> Nat -> Set
NatStrictLess m n =
  suc m <=N n

data Fin : Nat -> Set where
  fzero : {n : Nat} -> Fin (suc n)
  fsuc  : {n : Nat} -> Fin n -> Fin (suc n)

record HasCardinality
  {A : Set}
  (P : A -> Set)
  (cardinality : Nat) :
  Set where

  field
    enumerate :
      Fin cardinality ->
      A
    enumerated-member :
      (index : Fin cardinality) ->
      P (enumerate index)
    enumeration-complete :
      (x : A) ->
      P x ->
      Exists (Fin cardinality)
        (\ index -> x == enumerate index)
    enumeration-injective :
      (left-index right-index : Fin cardinality) ->
      enumerate left-index == enumerate right-index ->
      left-index == right-index

record CompleteOrderedRealField (R : Set) : Set1 where
  field
    zeroR oneR : R
    add multiply : R -> R -> R
    negate inverse : R -> R
    lessOrEqual : R -> R -> Set
    fromNat : Nat -> R

    one-not-zero :
      oneR != zeroR

    add-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> add x y == add y x
    add-associative :
      (x y z : R) -> add (add x y) z == add x (add y z)
    add-zero :
      (x : R) -> add x zeroR == x
    add-inverse :
      (x : R) -> add x (negate x) == zeroR

    multiply-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> multiply x y == multiply y x
    multiply-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply (multiply x y) z == multiply x (multiply y z)
    multiply-one :
      (x : R) -> multiply x oneR == x
    multiply-zero :
      (x : R) -> multiply x zeroR == zeroR
    distribute :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply x (add y z) ==
      add (multiply x y) (multiply x z)
    inverse-zero :
      inverse zeroR == zeroR
    multiply-inverse :
      (x : R) ->
      x != zeroR ->
      multiply x (inverse x) == oneR

    order-reflexive :
      (x : R) -> lessOrEqual x x
    order-transitive :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y z ->
      lessOrEqual x z
    order-antisymmetric :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y x ->
      x == y
    order-total :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y or lessOrEqual y x
    add-order :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual (add z x) (add z y)
    multiply-nonnegative :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR x ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR y ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR (multiply x y)
    zero-less-than-one :
      lessOrEqual zeroR oneR and zeroR != oneR

    fromNat-zero :
      fromNat zero == zeroR
    fromNat-successor :
      (n : Nat) -> fromNat (suc n) == add (fromNat n) oneR
    fromNat-addition :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m + n) == add (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-multiplication :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m * n) == multiply (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-injective :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat m == fromNat n ->
      m == n

    archimedean :
      (x : R) ->
      Exists Nat (\ n -> lessOrEqual x (fromNat n))
    least-upper-bound :
      (P : R -> Set) ->
      Exists R P ->
      Exists R
        (\ upper ->
          (x : R) ->
          P x ->
          lessOrEqual x upper) ->
      Exists R
        (\ supremum ->
          ((x : R) ->
            P x ->
            lessOrEqual x supremum)
          and
          ((upper : R) ->
            ((x : R) ->
              P x ->
              lessOrEqual x upper) ->
            lessOrEqual supremum upper))

open CompleteOrderedRealField

subtract :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
subtract reals x y =
  add reals x (negate reals y)

divide :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
divide reals x y =
  multiply reals x (inverse reals y)

StrictLess :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
StrictLess reals x y =
  lessOrEqual reals x y and x != y

CloseTo :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
CloseTo reals center radius x =
  StrictLess reals
    (subtract reals center radius)
    x
  and
  StrictLess reals
    x
    (add reals center radius)

ConvergesTo :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  R ->
  Set
ConvergesTo {R} reals sequence limit =
  (epsilon : R) ->
  StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) epsilon ->
  Exists Nat
    (\ cutoff ->
      (n : Nat) ->
      cutoff <=N n ->
      CloseTo reals limit epsilon (sequence n))

TendsAtPositiveInfinity :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (R -> R) ->
  R ->
  Set
TendsAtPositiveInfinity {R} reals function limit =
  (epsilon : R) ->
  StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) epsilon ->
  Exists R
    (\ cutoff ->
      (x : R) ->
      lessOrEqual reals cutoff x ->
      CloseTo reals limit epsilon (function x))

sumFirst :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Nat ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  R
sumFirst reals zero term =
  zeroR reals
sumFirst reals (suc n) term =
  add reals
    (sumFirst reals n term)
    (term n)

StrictlyIncreasing :
  (Nat -> Nat) ->
  Set
StrictlyIncreasing sequence =
  (m n : Nat) ->
  NatStrictLess m n ->
  NatStrictLess (sequence m) (sequence n)

PositiveSequence :
  (Nat -> Nat) ->
  Set
PositiveSequence sequence =
  (n : Nat) ->
  NatStrictLess zero (sequence n)

reciprocalTerm :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (Nat -> Nat) ->
  Nat ->
  R
reciprocalTerm reals sequence n =
  divide reals
    (oneR reals)
    (fromNat reals (sequence n))

ReciprocalSeriesConverges :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (Nat -> Nat) ->
  Set
ReciprocalSeriesConverges reals sequence =
  Exists _
    (\ limit ->
      ConvergesTo reals
        (\ n ->
          sumFirst reals n
            (reciprocalTerm reals sequence))
        limit)

CountingFunction :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (Nat -> Nat) ->
  (R -> Nat) ->
  Set
CountingFunction {R} reals sequence count =
  (x : R) ->
  HasCardinality
    (\ n -> lessOrEqual reals (fromNat reals (sequence n)) x)
    (count x)

putnam-1969-b5 : Set1
putnam-1969-b5 =
  (R : Set) ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) ->
  (a : Nat -> Nat) ->
  (k : R -> Nat) ->
  (StrictlyIncreasing a and PositiveSequence a) ->
  ReciprocalSeriesConverges reals a ->
  CountingFunction reals a k ->
  TendsAtPositiveInfinity reals
    (\ x ->
      divide reals
        (fromNat reals (k x))
        x)
    (zeroR reals)

(*
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench artifact putnam_1969_b5:
  a strictly increasing positive integer sequence with convergent reciprocal
  series has a counting function that is sublinear at positive infinity.
  This file contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open arithmeticTheory pred_setTheory realTheory real_sigmaTheory;
open real_topologyTheory;

val putnam_1969_b5 =
  ``!a : num -> num. !k : real -> num.
      (!m n : num. m < n ==> a m < a n) /\
      (!n : num. 0 < a n) /\
      (?L : real.
         ((\N : num.
             SIGMA
               (\n : num. (1 : real) / &(a n))
               (count N)) --> L) sequentially) /\
      (!x : real. k x = CARD {n : num | &(a n) <= x})
      ==>
      !e : real.
        0 < e
        ==>
        ?B : real.
          !t : real.
            B <= t ==> abs (&(k t) / t - 0) < e``;
