$(
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact
  putnam_1970_a3: the longest nonzero repeated decimal suffix of a perfect
  square has length three, and the least square attaining that length is
  1444. This file contains no proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  P70A3Run S K D says that the last K base-10 digits of the nonnegative
  integer S are all the nonzero digit D. The residue formula is exactly the
  least-significant-first digit-list condition in the sources. P70A3Exact
  additionally says that the run does not extend to the next digit; this also
  handles a run reaching the most significant digit because the next leading
  digit is zero.

  The source function L is uniquely characterized by these exact runs on
  numbers with nonzero final digit. Thus the existence and upper-bound
  conjuncts state that its greatest value on squares is 3, while the last
  three conjuncts state that 1444 is a square, has exact run length 3, and is
  no larger than any square with that exact run length. The final declaration
  is the single unproved $a corpus statement; this database contains no $p
  proof statement.
$)

$c P70A3Run P70A3Exact $.

p70a3-run-syntax $a wff ( P70A3Run S K D ) $.
p70a3-exact-syntax $a wff ( P70A3Exact S K ) $.

${
  $d D I K S $.

  p70a3-run-definition $a |- (
    ( P70A3Run S K D )
    <->
    (
      (
        S e. NN0
        /\
        K e. NN
      )
      /\
      (
        D e. ( 1 ... 9 )
        /\
        (
          S mod ( ; 1 0 ^ K )
        )
        =
        (
          D
          x.
          sum_ I e. ( 0 ..^ K ) ( ; 1 0 ^ I )
        )
      )
    )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d D K S $.

  p70a3-exact-definition $a |- (
    ( P70A3Exact S K )
    <->
    E. D e. ( 1 ... 9 )
      (
        ( P70A3Run S K D )
        /\
        -. ( P70A3Run S ( K + 1 ) D )
      )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d D K N R $.

  putnambench-putnam-1970-a3 $a |-
    (
      (
        E. N e. NN0 ( P70A3Exact ( N ^ 2 ) 3 )
        /\
        A. N e. NN0
          A. K e. NN
            A. D e. ( 1 ... 9 )
              (
                ( P70A3Run ( N ^ 2 ) K D )
                ->
                K <_ 3
              )
      )
      /\
      (
        E. R e. NN0
          ( R ^ 2 ) = ; ; ; 1 4 4 4
        /\
        (
          ( P70A3Exact ; ; ; 1 4 4 4 3 )
          /\
          A. N e. NN0
            (
              ( P70A3Exact ( N ^ 2 ) 3 )
              ->
              ; ; ; 1 4 4 4 <_ ( N ^ 2 )
            )
        )
      )
    )
  $.
$}

title: putnam_1970_a3

% Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench artifact putnam_1970_a3:
% the longest equal nonzero base-10 digit suffix of a perfect square has
% length three, first attained by the square 1444. This file contains no proof.

putnam_1970_a3: THEORY
BEGIN
  decimal_length(value: nat): nat =
    IF value = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      epsilon(
        LAMBDA (length: nat):
          0 < length
            AND 10 ^ (length - 1) <= value
            AND value < 10 ^ length)
    ENDIF

  decimal_digit(value, position: nat): nat =
    epsilon(
      LAMBDA (digit: nat):
        digit < 10
          AND EXISTS (higher, lower: nat):
            lower < 10 ^ position
              AND value =
                higher * 10 ^ (position + 1)
                  + digit * 10 ^ position
                  + lower)

  valid_run_length(L: [nat -> nat]): bool =
    FORALL (value: nat):
      L(value) <= decimal_length(value)
        AND (FORALL (position: nat):
          position < L(value) IMPLIES
            decimal_digit(value, position) =
              decimal_digit(value, 0))
        AND (L(value) /= decimal_length(value) IMPLIES
          decimal_digit(value, L(value)) /=
            decimal_digit(value, 0))

  solution_length: nat = 3
  solution_square: nat = 1444

  putnam_1970_a3: bool =
    FORALL (L: [nat -> nat]):
      valid_run_length(L) IMPLIES
        (EXISTS (root: nat):
          decimal_digit(root ^ 2, 0) /= 0
            AND L(root ^ 2) = solution_length)
        AND (FORALL (root: nat):
          decimal_digit(root ^ 2, 0) /= 0 IMPLIES
            L(root ^ 2) <= solution_length)
        AND (EXISTS (root: nat):
          root ^ 2 = solution_square)
        AND L(solution_square) = solution_length
        AND decimal_digit(solution_square, 0) /= 0
        AND (FORALL (root: nat):
          (decimal_digit(root ^ 2, 0) /= 0
            AND L(root ^ 2) = solution_length)
          IMPLIES solution_square <= root ^ 2)
END putnam_1970_a3

content:
;; Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench artifact putnam_1970_a4:
;; if x(n+2)-x(n) tends to zero, then
;; (x(n+1)-x(n))/(n+1) tends to zero. This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))

;; X is an arbitrary conservative sequence symbol over an Archimedean ordered
;; field. Positive rational tolerances are cofinal in its order topology, so
;; the epsilon definitions below preserve arbitrary real-valued sequences
;; instead of restricting their values to ACL2 rationals or APPLY$ codes.
(defstub p1970a4-scalar-p (x) t)
(defstub p1970a4-add-op (x y) t)
(defstub p1970a4-multiply-op (x y) t)
(defstub p1970a4-negate-op (x) t)
(defstub p1970a4-inverse-op (x) t)
(defstub p1970a4-less-op (x y) t)
(defstub p1970a4-rational-embed (q) t)
(defstub p1970a4-arch-bound (x) t)
(defstub p1970a4-x (n) t)

(defun p1970a4-add (x y)
  (p1970a4-add-op x y))

(defun p1970a4-mul (x y)
  (p1970a4-multiply-op x y))

(defun p1970a4-neg (x)
  (p1970a4-negate-op x))

(defun p1970a4-inv (x)
  (p1970a4-inverse-op x))

(defun p1970a4-sub (x y)
  (p1970a4-add x (p1970a4-neg y)))

(defun p1970a4-less (x y)
  (if (p1970a4-less-op x y) t nil))

(defun p1970a4-abs (x zero)
  (if (p1970a4-less x zero)
      (p1970a4-neg x)
    x))

(defun-sk p1970a4-field-laws-p (zero one)
  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (p1970a4-scalar-p x)
      (p1970a4-scalar-p y)
      (p1970a4-scalar-p z))
     (and
      (p1970a4-scalar-p (p1970a4-add x y))
      (p1970a4-scalar-p (p1970a4-mul x y))
      (p1970a4-scalar-p (p1970a4-neg x))
      (implies
       (not (equal x zero))
       (p1970a4-scalar-p (p1970a4-inv x)))
      (equal (p1970a4-add (p1970a4-add x y) z)
             (p1970a4-add x (p1970a4-add y z)))
      (equal (p1970a4-add x y)
             (p1970a4-add y x))
      (equal (p1970a4-add x zero) x)
      (equal (p1970a4-add x (p1970a4-neg x)) zero)
      (equal (p1970a4-mul (p1970a4-mul x y) z)
             (p1970a4-mul x (p1970a4-mul y z)))
      (equal (p1970a4-mul x y)
             (p1970a4-mul y x))
      (equal (p1970a4-mul x one) x)
      (implies
       (not (equal x zero))
       (equal (p1970a4-mul x (p1970a4-inv x)) one))
      (equal
       (p1970a4-mul x (p1970a4-add y z))
       (p1970a4-add (p1970a4-mul x y)
                    (p1970a4-mul x z)))))))

(defun-sk p1970a4-order-laws-p (zero)
  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (p1970a4-scalar-p x)
      (p1970a4-scalar-p y)
      (p1970a4-scalar-p z))
     (and
      (not (p1970a4-less x x))
      (or
       (equal x y)
       (p1970a4-less x y)
       (p1970a4-less y x))
      (implies
       (and
        (p1970a4-less x y)
        (p1970a4-less y z))
       (p1970a4-less x z))
      (implies
       (p1970a4-less x y)
       (p1970a4-less
        (p1970a4-add x z)
        (p1970a4-add y z)))
      (implies
       (and
        (p1970a4-less zero x)
        (p1970a4-less zero y))
       (p1970a4-less zero (p1970a4-mul x y)))))))

(defun-sk p1970a4-rational-embedding-laws-p ()
  (forall (a b)
    (implies
     (and (rationalp a) (rationalp b))
     (and
      (p1970a4-scalar-p (p1970a4-rational-embed a))
      (equal
       (p1970a4-rational-embed (+ a b))
       (p1970a4-add
        (p1970a4-rational-embed a)
        (p1970a4-rational-embed b)))
      (equal
       (p1970a4-rational-embed (* a b))
       (p1970a4-mul
        (p1970a4-rational-embed a)
        (p1970a4-rational-embed b)))
      (iff
       (< a b)
       (p1970a4-less
        (p1970a4-rational-embed a)
        (p1970a4-rational-embed b)))))))

(defun-sk p1970a4-archimedean-p ()
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (p1970a4-scalar-p x)
     (and
      (natp (p1970a4-arch-bound x))
      (p1970a4-less
       x
       (p1970a4-rational-embed
        (p1970a4-arch-bound x)))))))

(defun p1970a4-ordered-field-with-rationals-p (zero one)
  (and
   (p1970a4-scalar-p zero)
   (p1970a4-scalar-p one)
   (not (equal zero one))
   (p1970a4-less zero one)
   (equal (p1970a4-rational-embed 0) zero)
   (equal (p1970a4-rational-embed 1) one)
   (p1970a4-field-laws-p zero one)
   (p1970a4-order-laws-p zero)
   (p1970a4-rational-embedding-laws-p)
   (p1970a4-archimedean-p)))

(defun-sk p1970a4-sequence-p ()
  (forall (n)
    (implies
     (natp n)
     (p1970a4-scalar-p (p1970a4-x n)))))

(defun p1970a4-source-value (n)
  (p1970a4-sub
   (p1970a4-x (+ n 2))
   (p1970a4-x n)))

(defun p1970a4-target-value (n)
  (p1970a4-mul
   (p1970a4-sub
    (p1970a4-x (+ n 1))
    (p1970a4-x n))
   (p1970a4-inv
    (p1970a4-rational-embed (+ n 1)))))

(defun-sk p1970a4-source-tail-p
    (epsilon cutoff zero)
  (forall (n)
    (implies
     (and (natp n) (<= cutoff n))
     (p1970a4-less
      (p1970a4-abs (p1970a4-source-value n) zero)
      (p1970a4-rational-embed epsilon)))))

(defun-sk p1970a4-source-cutoff-exists-p
    (epsilon zero)
  (exists (cutoff)
    (and
     (natp cutoff)
     (p1970a4-source-tail-p epsilon cutoff zero))))

(defun-sk p1970a4-source-limit-p (zero)
  (forall (epsilon)
    (implies
     (and (rationalp epsilon) (< 0 epsilon))
     (p1970a4-source-cutoff-exists-p
      epsilon zero))))

(defun-sk p1970a4-target-tail-p
    (epsilon cutoff zero)
  (forall (n)
    (implies
     (and (natp n) (<= cutoff n))
     (p1970a4-less
      (p1970a4-abs (p1970a4-target-value n) zero)
      (p1970a4-rational-embed epsilon)))))

(defun-sk p1970a4-target-cutoff-exists-p
    (epsilon zero)
  (exists (cutoff)
    (and
     (natp cutoff)
     (p1970a4-target-tail-p epsilon cutoff zero))))

(defun-sk p1970a4-target-limit-p (zero)

-- Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1970_a4:
-- a real sequence whose two-step differences converge to zero has its
-- normalized one-step differences converge to zero. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; _*_)

infix 4 _!=_ _<=N_
infixr 3 _and_
infixr 2 _or_

data Bottom : Set where

Not : Set -> Set
Not A = A -> Bottom

_!=_ : {A : Set} -> A -> A -> Set
x != y = Not (x == y)

record _and_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data _or_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  left  : A -> A or B
  right : B -> A or B

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

data _<=N_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set where
  zero<=   : {n : Nat} -> zero <=N n
  suc<=suc : {m n : Nat} -> m <=N n -> suc m <=N suc n

record CompleteOrderedRealField (R : Set) : Set1 where
  field
    zeroR oneR : R
    addR multiplyR : R -> R -> R
    negateR inverseR : R -> R
    lessOrEqualR : R -> R -> Set
    fromNatR : Nat -> R

    oneR-not-zeroR :
      oneR != zeroR

    addR-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> addR x y == addR y x
    addR-associative :
      (x y z : R) -> addR (addR x y) z == addR x (addR y z)
    addR-zero :
      (x : R) -> addR x zeroR == x
    addR-inverse :
      (x : R) -> addR x (negateR x) == zeroR

    multiplyR-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> multiplyR x y == multiplyR y x
    multiplyR-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiplyR (multiplyR x y) z == multiplyR x (multiplyR y z)
    multiplyR-one :
      (x : R) -> multiplyR x oneR == x
    multiplyR-zero :
      (x : R) -> multiplyR x zeroR == zeroR
    distributeR :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiplyR x (addR y z) ==
      addR (multiplyR x y) (multiplyR x z)
    inverseR-zero :
      inverseR zeroR == zeroR
    multiplyR-inverse :
      (x : R) ->
      x != zeroR ->
      multiplyR x (inverseR x) == oneR

    order-reflexive :
      (x : R) -> lessOrEqualR x x
    order-transitive :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR x y ->
      lessOrEqualR y z ->
      lessOrEqualR x z
    order-antisymmetric :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR x y ->
      lessOrEqualR y x ->
      x == y
    order-total :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR x y or lessOrEqualR y x
    addR-order :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR x y ->
      lessOrEqualR (addR z x) (addR z y)
    multiplyR-nonnegative :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR zeroR x ->
      lessOrEqualR zeroR y ->
      lessOrEqualR zeroR (multiplyR x y)
    zeroR-less-than-oneR :
      lessOrEqualR zeroR oneR and zeroR != oneR

    fromNatR-zero :
      fromNatR zero == zeroR
    fromNatR-successor :
      (n : Nat) -> fromNatR (suc n) == addR (fromNatR n) oneR
    fromNatR-addition :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNatR (m + n) == addR (fromNatR m) (fromNatR n)
    fromNatR-multiplication :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNatR (m * n) == multiplyR (fromNatR m) (fromNatR n)
    fromNatR-injective :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNatR m == fromNatR n ->
      m == n

    archimedean :
      (x : R) ->
      Exists Nat (\ n -> lessOrEqualR x (fromNatR n))
    least-upper-bound :
      (P : R -> Set) ->
      Exists R P ->
      Exists R
        (\ upper ->
          (x : R) ->
          P x ->
          lessOrEqualR x upper) ->
      Exists R
        (\ supremum ->
          ((x : R) -> P x -> lessOrEqualR x supremum)
          and
          ((upper : R) ->
            ((x : R) -> P x -> lessOrEqualR x upper) ->
            lessOrEqualR supremum upper))

open CompleteOrderedRealField

subtract :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
subtract reals x y =
  addR reals x (negateR reals y)

divide :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
divide reals x y =
  multiplyR reals x (inverseR reals y)

StrictLess :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
StrictLess reals x y =
  lessOrEqualR reals x y and x != y

CloseTo :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
CloseTo reals center radius x =
  StrictLess reals (subtract reals center radius) x
  and
  StrictLess reals x (addR reals center radius)

SequentialLimit :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  R ->
  Set
SequentialLimit {R} reals sequence limit =
  (epsilon : R) ->
  StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) epsilon ->
  Exists Nat
    (\ cutoff ->
      (n : Nat) ->
      cutoff <=N n ->
      CloseTo reals limit epsilon (sequence n))

putnam-1970-a4 : Set1
putnam-1970-a4 =
  (R : Set) ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) ->
  (x : Nat -> R) ->
  SequentialLimit reals
    (\ n ->
      subtract reals
        (x (suc (suc n)))
        (x n))
    (zeroR reals) ->
  SequentialLimit reals
    (\ n ->
      divide reals
        (subtract reals
          (x (suc n))
          (x n))
        (fromNatR reals (suc n)))
    (zeroR reals)

% Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench artifact putnam_1970_a4:
% a real sequence whose two-step differences tend to zero has its one-step
% differences divided by the index tend to zero. This file contains no proof.

putnam_1970_a4: THEORY
BEGIN
  real_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> real]

  safe_div(numerator, denominator: real): real =
    IF denominator = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      numerator / denominator
    ENDIF

  converges_to(sequence: real_sequence, value: real): bool =
    FORALL (epsilon_value: posreal):
      EXISTS (cutoff: nat):
        FORALL (index: nat):
          cutoff <= index IMPLIES
            abs(sequence(index) - value) < epsilon_value

  putnam_1970_a4: bool =
    FORALL (x: real_sequence):
      converges_to(
        LAMBDA (index: nat):
          x(index + 2) - x(index),
        0)
      IMPLIES
        converges_to(
          LAMBDA (index: nat):
            safe_div(
              x(index + 1) - x(index),
              (index + 1) :: real),
          0)
END putnam_1970_a4

;; Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1970_b1:
;; the real limit of a normalized finite product of positive nth roots,
;; evaluated as exp(2 log 5 - 4 + 2 arctan 2). This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

;; For n > 0, put
;;
;;   P_n = product_(i=1)^(2n) (n^2+i^2).
;;
;; The source sequence is exactly P_n^(1/n)/n^4.  The scaled-root search
;; returns the greatest integer k with k^n <= P_n*scale^n, so k/scale is a
;; lower approximation to the positive real nth root with error below
;; 1/scale.  Thus the normalized rational value below differs from the source
;; term by less than 1/(scale*n^4); it does not replace the real root by a
;; rational root or restrict the source domain.

(defun putnam-1970-b1-product (n remaining)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix remaining)))
  (if (zp remaining)
      1
    (* (+ (* n n)
          (* remaining remaining))
       (putnam-1970-b1-product n (- remaining 1)))))

(defun putnam-1970-b1-scaled-root-search
    (radicand degree scale candidate)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix candidate)))
  (if (zp candidate)
      0
    (if (<= (expt candidate degree)
            (* radicand (expt scale degree)))
        candidate
      (putnam-1970-b1-scaled-root-search
       radicand degree scale (- candidate 1)))))

(defun putnam-1970-b1-scaled-root-floor (radicand degree scale)
  (if (and (natp radicand)
           (natp degree)
           (< 0 degree)
           (natp scale)
           (< 0 scale))
      (putnam-1970-b1-scaled-root-search
       radicand
       degree
       scale
       (* 25 (expt degree 4) scale))
    0))

(defun putnam-1970-b1-product-approximant (n scale)
  (if (and (natp n)
           (< 0 n)
           (natp scale)
           (< 0 scale))
      (/ (putnam-1970-b1-scaled-root-floor
          (putnam-1970-b1-product n (* 2 n))
          n
          scale)
         (* scale (expt n 4)))
    0))

;; The following exact rational prefixes independently represent the stated
;; target.  The identity
;;
;;   log 5 = 2*sum_(j>=0) (2/3)^(2j+1)/(2j+1)
;;
;; is the atanh series.  Machin's identity represents pi, and
;; arctan 2 = pi/2 - arctan(1/2).  Substitution into the exponential Taylor
;; series makes the target prefixes converge to
;;
;;   exp(2*log 5 - 4 + 2*arctan 2).

(defun putnam-1970-b1-factorial (n)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix n)))
  (if (zp n)
      1
    (* n (putnam-1970-b1-factorial (- n 1)))))

(defun putnam-1970-b1-atan-prefix (z terms)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix terms)))
  (if (zp terms)
      0
    (let* ((index (- terms 1))
           (sign (if (equal (mod index 2) 0) 1 -1))
           (exponent (+ (* 2 index) 1)))
      (+ (putnam-1970-b1-atan-prefix z index)
         (/ (* sign (expt z exponent))
            exponent)))))

(defun putnam-1970-b1-log-five-prefix (terms)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix terms)))
  (if (zp terms)
      0
    (let* ((index (- terms 1))
           (exponent (+ (* 2 index) 1)))
      (+ (putnam-1970-b1-log-five-prefix index)
         (* 2
            (/ (expt (/ 2 3) exponent)
               exponent))))))

(defun putnam-1970-b1-pi-prefix (terms)
  (- (* 16
        (putnam-1970-b1-atan-prefix (/ 1 5) terms))
     (* 4
        (putnam-1970-b1-atan-prefix (/ 1 239) terms))))

(defun putnam-1970-b1-atan-two-prefix (terms)
  (- (/ (putnam-1970-b1-pi-prefix terms) 2)
     (putnam-1970-b1-atan-prefix (/ 1 2) terms)))

(defun putnam-1970-b1-limit-exponent-prefix (terms)
  (+ (* 2 (putnam-1970-b1-log-five-prefix terms))
     -4
     (* 2 (putnam-1970-b1-atan-two-prefix terms))))

(defun putnam-1970-b1-exp-prefix (x terms)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix terms)))
  (if (zp terms)
      0
    (let ((index (- terms 1)))
      (+ (putnam-1970-b1-exp-prefix x index)
         (/ (expt x index)
            (putnam-1970-b1-factorial index))))))

(defun putnam-1970-b1-limit-approximant (terms)
  (putnam-1970-b1-exp-prefix
   (putnam-1970-b1-limit-exponent-prefix terms)
   terms))

;; Positive rational tolerances are cofinal among positive real tolerances.
;; Moreover,
;;
;;   log(P_n^(1/n)/n^4)
;;     = (1/n) * sum_(i=1)^(2n) log(1+(i/n)^2).
;;
;; This is the right Riemann sum for log(1+x^2) on [0,2], whose integral is
;; 2*log 5 - 4 + 2*arctan 2. The predicate below states that source limit
;; exactly through its epsilon definition. SCALE controls
;; only the floor approximation to the positive nth root, while TERMS controls
;; only the rational transcendental prefixes. One existential cutoff for the
;; three independent parameters states convergence without fabricating a
;; numerical rate.
(defun-sk putnam-1970-b1-common-tail-p (epsilon cutoff)
  (forall (n scale terms)
    (implies
     (and (natp n)
          (< 0 n)
          (natp scale)
          (< 0 scale)
          (natp terms)
          (< 0 terms)
          (<= cutoff n)
          (<= cutoff scale)
          (<= cutoff terms))
     (< (abs
         (- (putnam-1970-b1-product-approximant n scale)
            (putnam-1970-b1-limit-approximant terms)))
        epsilon))))

(defun-sk putnam-1970-b1-cutoff-exists-p (epsilon)
  (exists (cutoff)
    (and (natp cutoff)
         (< 0 cutoff)
         (putnam-1970-b1-common-tail-p epsilon cutoff))))

(defun putnambench-putnam-1970-b1-statement (epsilon)
  (implies
   (and (rationalp epsilon)
        (< 0 epsilon))
   (putnam-1970-b1-cutoff-exists-p epsilon)))

data _<=N_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set where
  zero<=   : {n : Nat} -> zero <=N n
  suc<=suc : {m n : Nat} -> m <=N n -> suc m <=N suc n

record CompleteOrderedField (R : Set) : Set1 where
  field
    zeroR oneR : R
    add multiply : R -> R -> R
    negate inverse : R -> R
    lessOrEqual : R -> R -> Set
    fromNat : Nat -> R

    one-not-zero :
      oneR != zeroR

    add-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> add x y == add y x
    add-associative :

    add-zero :
      (x : R) -> add x zeroR == x
    add-inverse :
      (x : R) -> add x (negate x) == zeroR

    multiply-commutative :

    multiply-associative :

    multiply-one :
      (x : R) -> multiply x oneR == x
    multiply-zero :
      (x : R) -> multiply x zeroR == zeroR
    distribute :
      (x y z : R) ->

    inverse-zero :

    multiply-nonnegative :

      (n : Nat) ->

    fromNat-addition :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m + n) == add (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-multiplication :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m * n) == multiply (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-injective :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat m == fromNat n ->
      m == n

    archimedean :
      (x : R) ->
      Exists Nat (\ n -> lessOrEqual x (fromNat n))
    least-upper-bound :
      (P : R -> Set) ->
      Exists R P ->
      Exists R
        (\ upper ->
          (x : R) ->
          P x ->
          lessOrEqual x upper) ->
      Exists R
        (\ supremum ->
          ((x : R) ->
            P x ->
            lessOrEqual x supremum)
          and
          ((upper : R) ->
            ((x : R) ->
              P x ->
              lessOrEqual x upper) ->
            lessOrEqual supremum upper))

open CompleteOrderedField

oneN : Nat
oneN =
  suc zero

twoN : Nat
twoN =
  suc oneN

fourN : Nat
fourN =
  twoN + twoN

fiveN : Nat
fiveN =
  suc fourN

subtract :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
subtract reals x y =
  add reals x (negate reals y)

divide :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
divide reals x y =
  multiply reals x (inverse reals y)

StrictLess :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
StrictLess reals x y =
  lessOrEqual reals x y and x != y

CloseTo :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
CloseTo reals center radius x =
  StrictLess reals
    (subtract reals center radius)
    x
  and
  StrictLess reals
    x
    (add reals center radius)

naturalPower :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  Nat ->
  R
naturalPower reals x zero =
  oneR reals
naturalPower reals x (suc n) =
  multiply reals
    (naturalPower reals x n)
    x

factorial : Nat -> Nat
factorial zero =
  oneN
factorial (suc n) =
  suc n * factorial n

sumFirst :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  Nat ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  R
sumFirst reals zero term =
  zeroR reals
sumFirst reals (suc n) term =
  add reals
    (sumFirst reals n term)
    (term n)

productFirst :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  Nat ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  R
productFirst reals zero term =
  oneR reals
productFirst reals (suc n) term =
  multiply reals
    (productFirst reals n term)
    (term n)

ConvergesTo :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  R ->
  Set
ConvergesTo {R} reals sequence limit =
  (epsilon : R) ->
  StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) epsilon ->
  Exists Nat
    (\ cutoff ->
      (n : Nat) ->
      cutoff <=N n ->
      CloseTo reals limit epsilon (sequence n))

SeriesHasSum :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  R ->
  Set
SeriesHasSum reals terms limit =
  ConvergesTo reals
    (\ n -> sumFirst reals n terms)
    limit

exponentialTerm :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  Nat ->
  R
exponentialTerm reals x n =
  divide reals
    (naturalPower reals x n)
    (fromNat reals (factorial n))

ExponentialValue :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
ExponentialValue reals x value =
  SeriesHasSum reals
    (exponentialTerm reals x)
    value

record StandardRealPowers
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) :
  Set1 where

  field
    exponential logarithm : R -> R

    exponential-series :
      (x : R) ->
      ExponentialValue reals x (exponential x)

    exponential-positive :
      (x : R) ->
      StrictLess reals
        (zeroR reals)
        (exponential x)

    exponential-injective :
      (x y : R) ->
      exponential x == exponential y ->
      x == y

    exponential-logarithm :
      (x : R) ->
      StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) x ->
      exponential (logarithm x) == x

open StandardRealPowers

realPower :
  {R : Set} ->
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R} ->
  StandardRealPowers reals ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
realPower {reals = reals} powers base exponent =
  exponential powers
    (multiply reals exponent (logarithm powers base))

rightRiemannSum :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  (R -> R) ->
  Nat ->
  R
rightRiemannSum reals lower upper function pieces =
  let
    step =
      divide reals
        (subtract reals upper lower)
        (fromNat reals pieces)
  in
  sumFirst reals pieces
    (\ i ->
      multiply reals
        (function
          (add reals lower
            (multiply reals
              (fromNat reals (suc i))
              step)))
        step)

IntervalIntegralValue :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  (R -> R) ->
  R ->
  Set
IntervalIntegralValue reals lower upper function value =
  ConvergesTo reals
    (\ n ->
      rightRiemannSum reals
        lower
        upper
        function
        (suc n))
    value

arctangentIntegrand :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  R
arctangentIntegrand reals x =
  inverse reals
    (add reals
      (oneR reals)
      (naturalPower reals x twoN))

record StandardRealAnalysis
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) :
  Set1 where

  field
    powers : StandardRealPowers reals
    arctangent : R -> R

    arctangent-integral :
      (x : R) ->
      lessOrEqual reals (zeroR reals) x ->
      IntervalIntegralValue reals
        (zeroR reals)
        x
        (arctangentIntegrand reals)
        (arctangent x)

open StandardRealAnalysis

module Putnam1970B1Statement
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R)
  (analysis : StandardRealAnalysis reals) where

  realPowers : StandardRealPowers reals
  realPowers =
    powers analysis

  productFactor :
    Nat ->
    Nat ->
    R
  productFactor n i =
    realPower realPowers
      (add reals
        (naturalPower reals (fromNat reals n) twoN)
        (naturalPower reals (fromNat reals i) twoN))
      (divide reals
        (oneR reals)
        (fromNat reals n))

  normalizedProduct :
    Nat ->
    R
  normalizedProduct n =
    multiply reals
      (divide reals
        (oneR reals)
        (naturalPower reals
          (fromNat reals n)
          fourN))
      (productFirst reals
        (twoN * n)
        (\ i -> productFactor n (suc i)))

  solution : R
  solution =
    exponential realPowers
      (add reals
        (subtract reals
          (multiply reals
            (fromNat reals twoN)
            (logarithm realPowers
              (fromNat reals fiveN)))
          (fromNat reals fourN))
        (multiply reals
          (fromNat reals twoN)
          (arctangent analysis
            (fromNat reals twoN))))

  proposition : Set
  proposition =
    ConvergesTo reals
      normalizedProduct
      solution

putnam-1970-b1 : Set1
putnam-1970-b1 =
  (R : Set) ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) ->
  (analysis : StandardRealAnalysis reals) ->
  Putnam1970B1Statement.proposition reals analysis

content:
$(
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact
  putnam_1970_b1: evaluation of a real infinite-product limit as an
  exponential involving the natural logarithm and arctangent. This file
  contains no proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  The sequence is indexed by the positive integers. This is the tail from
  index one of the natural- or integer-indexed sequences in the sources, so
  it has exactly the same limit at infinity while avoiding the irrelevant
  initial expression containing 1 / 0.

  For every positive n, the finite product is over the inclusive interval
  from 1 through 2n. Since n^2 + i^2 is positive on this interval, set.mm's
  complex-power operation ^c agrees with the source real power
  exp((1 / n) log(n^2 + i^2)). The right side is the explicit solution from
  the Rocq source and the solution annotations in the Lean and Isabelle
  sources. The final declaration is an unproved $a corpus statement; this
  database contains no $p proof statement.
$)

${
  $d i n $.

  putnambench-putnam-1970-b1 $a |-
    (
      n e. NN |->
        (
          ( 1 / ( n ^ 4 ) )
          x.
          prod_ i e. ( 1 ... ( 2 x. n ) )
            (
              ( ( n ^ 2 ) + ( i ^ 2 ) )
              ^c
              ( 1 / n )
            )
        )
    )
    ~~>
    (
      exp
      `
      (
        (
          ( 2 x. ( log ` 5 ) )
          -
          4
        )
        +
        ( 2 x. ( arctan ` 2 ) )
      )
    )
  $.
$}

theorem

title: putnam_1970_b1
content:
% Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench artifact putnam_1970_b1:
% the specified normalized finite products converge to
% exp(2 * ln(5) - 4 + 2 * arctan(2)). This file contains no proof.

putnam_1970_b1: THEORY
BEGIN
  real_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> real]

  safe_div(numerator, denominator: real): real =
    IF denominator = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      numerator / denominator
    ENDIF

  nat_factorial(index: nat): RECURSIVE nat =
    IF index = 0 THEN
      1
    ELSE
      index * nat_factorial(index - 1)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE index

  converges_to(sequence: real_sequence, value: real): bool =
    FORALL (epsilon_value: posreal):
      EXISTS (cutoff: nat):
        FORALL (index: nat):
          cutoff <= index IMPLIES
            abs(sequence(index) - value) < epsilon_value

  exponential_partial(x: real, count: nat): RECURSIVE real =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      LET index: nat = count - 1 IN
        exponential_partial(x, count - 1)
          + safe_div(
              x ^ index,
              nat_factorial(index) :: real)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  real_exponential(x: real): real =
    epsilon(
      LAMBDA (value: real):
        converges_to(
          LAMBDA (count: nat):
            exponential_partial(x, count),
          value))

  natural_log(x: real): real =
    IF x > 0 THEN
      epsilon(
        LAMBDA (value: real):
          real_exponential(value) = x)
    ELSE
      0
    ENDIF

  real_power(base, exponent: real): real =
    IF base > 0 THEN
      real_exponential(exponent * natural_log(base))
    ELSIF base = 0 AND exponent = 0 THEN
      1
    ELSE
      0
    ENDIF

  alternating_sign(index: nat): RECURSIVE real =
    IF index = 0 THEN
      1
    ELSE
      -alternating_sign(index - 1)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE index

  leibniz_partial_sum(count: nat): RECURSIVE real =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      LET index: nat = count - 1 IN
        leibniz_partial_sum(count - 1)
          + safe_div(
              alternating_sign(index),
              (2 * index + 1) :: real)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  pi: real =
    epsilon(
      LAMBDA (value: real):
        converges_to(
          LAMBDA (count: nat):
            4 * leibniz_partial_sum(count),
          value))

  sine_partial(x: real, count: nat): RECURSIVE real =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      LET index: nat = count - 1 IN
        sine_partial(x, count - 1)
          + safe_div(
              alternating_sign(index) * x ^ (2 * index + 1),
              nat_factorial(2 * index + 1) :: real)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  cosine_partial(x: real, count: nat): RECURSIVE real =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      LET index: nat = count - 1 IN
        cosine_partial(x, count - 1)
          + safe_div(
              alternating_sign(index) * x ^ (2 * index),
              nat_factorial(2 * index) :: real)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  real_sine(x: real): real =
    epsilon(
      LAMBDA (value: real):
        converges_to(
          LAMBDA (count: nat):
            sine_partial(x, count),
          value))

  real_cosine(x: real): real =
    epsilon(
      LAMBDA (value: real):
        converges_to(
          LAMBDA (count: nat):
            cosine_partial(x, count),
          value))

  real_arctangent(x: real): real =
    epsilon(
      LAMBDA (angle: real):
        -pi / 2 < angle
          AND angle < pi / 2
          AND real_sine(angle) = x * real_cosine(angle))

  product_1_to_count(n, count: nat): RECURSIVE real =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      1
    ELSE
      product_1_to_count(n, count - 1)
        * real_power(
            (n :: real) ^ 2 + (count :: real) ^ 2,
            safe_div(1, n :: real))
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  normalized_product(n: nat): real =
    safe_div(1, (n :: real) ^ 4)
      * product_1_to_count(n, 2 * n)

  putnam_1970_b1: bool =
    converges_to(
      normalized_product,
      real_exponential(
        2 * natural_log(5)
          - 4
          + 2 * real_arctangent(2)))
END putnam_1970_b1

import Mathlib

open Metric Set EuclideanGeometry Filter Topology

/--
Let $H$ be a polynomial of degree at most $3$ and $T$ be a positive real number. Show that the average value of $H(t)$ over the interval $[-T, T]$ equals the average of $H\left(-\frac{T}{\sqrt{3}}\right)$ and $H\left(\frac{T}{\sqrt{3}}\right)$.
-/
theorem putnam_1970_b2
(T : ℝ)
(H : Polynomial ℝ)
(hT : T > 0)
(hH : H.degree ≤ 3)
: (H.eval (-T / Real.sqrt 3) + H.eval (T / Real.sqrt 3))/2 = ⨍ t in Set.Icc (-T) T, H.eval t :=
sorry

Set Implicit Arguments.

Variable R : realType.
Definition mu := [the measure _ _ of @lebesgue_measure R].
Theorem putnam_1970_b2
    (T : R)
    (H : {poly R})
    (hT : T > 0)
    (hH : le (size H) 4%nat)
    : (H.[(-T/(@Num.sqrt R 3))] + H.[(T/(@Num.sqrt R 3))])/2 = 1/(2*T) * \int[mu]_(t in [set x : R | -T <= x <= T]) H.[t].
Proof. Admitted.

putnam_1970_b2
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1970_b2:
;; the two-node Gaussian quadrature identity for every real polynomial of
;; degree at most three on a symmetric interval. This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

;; Multivariate polynomials over the rationals represent arbitrary real
;; assignments to T and to the four coefficients of H. A monomial is a sorted
;; list of variable indices, with repetition denoting powers; a polynomial is
;; a canonical sorted list of (monomial . coefficient) pairs.

(defun putnam-1970-b2-monomial-multiply (left right)
  (declare (xargs :measure
                  (+ (acl2-count left) (acl2-count right))))
  (cond ((endp left) right)
        ((endp right) left)
        ((<= (car left) (car right))
         (cons (car left)
               (putnam-1970-b2-monomial-multiply
                (cdr left) right)))
        (t
         (cons (car right)
               (putnam-1970-b2-monomial-multiply
                left (cdr right))))))

(defun putnam-1970-b2-polynomial-insert
    (monomial coefficient polynomial)
  (cond ((equal coefficient 0) polynomial)
        ((endp polynomial)
         (list (cons monomial coefficient)))
        ((equal monomial (caar polynomial))
         (let ((sum (+ coefficient (cdar polynomial))))
           (if (equal sum 0)
               (cdr polynomial)
             (cons (cons monomial sum)
                   (cdr polynomial)))))
        ((lexorder monomial (caar polynomial))
         (cons (cons monomial coefficient) polynomial))
        (t
         (cons (car polynomial)
               (putnam-1970-b2-polynomial-insert
                monomial coefficient (cdr polynomial))))))

(defun putnam-1970-b2-polynomial-add (left right)
  (if (endp left)
      right
    (putnam-1970-b2-polynomial-add
     (cdr left)
     (putnam-1970-b2-polynomial-insert
      (caar left) (cdar left) right))))

(defun putnam-1970-b2-polynomial-negate (polynomial)
  (if (endp polynomial)
      nil
    (cons
     (cons (caar polynomial) (- (cdar polynomial)))
     (putnam-1970-b2-polynomial-negate
      (cdr polynomial)))))

(defun putnam-1970-b2-polynomial-subtract (left right)
  (putnam-1970-b2-polynomial-add
   left
   (putnam-1970-b2-polynomial-negate right)))

(defun putnam-1970-b2-polynomial-scale (scalar polynomial)
  (if (endp polynomial)
      nil
    (cons
     (cons (caar polynomial) (* scalar (cdar polynomial)))
     (putnam-1970-b2-polynomial-scale
      scalar (cdr polynomial)))))

(defun putnam-1970-b2-polynomial-multiply-term
    (monomial coefficient polynomial)
  (if (endp polynomial)
      nil
    (putnam-1970-b2-polynomial-insert
     (putnam-1970-b2-monomial-multiply
      monomial (caar polynomial))
     (* coefficient (cdar polynomial))
     (putnam-1970-b2-polynomial-multiply-term
      monomial coefficient (cdr polynomial)))))

(defun putnam-1970-b2-polynomial-multiply (left right)
  (if (endp left)
      nil
    (putnam-1970-b2-polynomial-add
     (putnam-1970-b2-polynomial-multiply-term
      (caar left) (cdar left) right)
     (putnam-1970-b2-polynomial-multiply
      (cdr left) right))))

(defun putnam-1970-b2-polynomial-power (polynomial exponent)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix exponent)))
  (if (zp exponent)
      (list (cons nil 1))
    (putnam-1970-b2-polynomial-multiply
     polynomial
     (putnam-1970-b2-polynomial-power
      polynomial (- exponent 1)))))

(defun putnam-1970-b2-polynomial-variable (index)
  (list (cons (list index) 1)))

;; A pair (P . Q) denotes P + Q*s in the exact quadratic extension with
;; s^2 = 3. Thus T/s is represented exactly as (T/3)*s.

(defun putnam-1970-b2-extension-base (polynomial)
  (cons polynomial nil))

(defun putnam-1970-b2-extension-add (left right)
  (cons
   (putnam-1970-b2-polynomial-add
    (car left) (car right))
   (putnam-1970-b2-polynomial-add
    (cdr left) (cdr right))))

(defun putnam-1970-b2-extension-multiply (left right)
  (cons
   (putnam-1970-b2-polynomial-add
    (putnam-1970-b2-polynomial-multiply
     (car left) (car right))
    (putnam-1970-b2-polynomial-scale
     3
     (putnam-1970-b2-polynomial-multiply
      (cdr left) (cdr right))))
   (putnam-1970-b2-polynomial-add
    (putnam-1970-b2-polynomial-multiply
     (car left) (cdr right))
    (putnam-1970-b2-polynomial-multiply
     (cdr left) (car right)))))

(defun putnam-1970-b2-cubic-eval-extension
    (coefficients point)
  (putnam-1970-b2-extension-add
   (putnam-1970-b2-extension-base (nth 0 coefficients))
   (putnam-1970-b2-extension-multiply
    point
    (putnam-1970-b2-extension-add
     (putnam-1970-b2-extension-base (nth 1 coefficients))
     (putnam-1970-b2-extension-multiply
      point
      (putnam-1970-b2-extension-add
       (putnam-1970-b2-extension-base (nth 2 coefficients))
       (putnam-1970-b2-extension-multiply
        point
        (putnam-1970-b2-extension-base
         (nth 3 coefficients)))))))))

;; For H(x)=a0+a1*x+a2*x^2+a3*x^3, this is its exact antiderivative
;; a0*x+(a1/2)*x^2+(a2/3)*x^3+(a3/4)*x^4.

(defun putnam-1970-b2-antiderivative-value
    (coefficients point)
  (putnam-1970-b2-polynomial-add
   (putnam-1970-b2-polynomial-multiply
    (nth 0 coefficients) point)
   (putnam-1970-b2-polynomial-add
    (putnam-1970-b2-polynomial-scale
     1/2
     (putnam-1970-b2-polynomial-multiply
      (nth 1 coefficients)
      (putnam-1970-b2-polynomial-power point 2)))
    (putnam-1970-b2-polynomial-add
     (putnam-1970-b2-polynomial-scale
      1/3
      (putnam-1970-b2-polynomial-multiply
       (nth 2 coefficients)
       (putnam-1970-b2-polynomial-power point 3)))
     (putnam-1970-b2-polynomial-scale
      1/4
      (putnam-1970-b2-polynomial-multiply
       (nth 3 coefficients)
       (putnam-1970-b2-polynomial-power point 4)))))))

;; Variable 0 is T; variables 1 through 4 are the arbitrary real
;; coefficients a0 through a3. Multiplying the source equality by 2*T gives
;;
;;   T * (H(-T/sqrt(3)) + H(T/sqrt(3)))
;;     = integral_[-T,T] H.
;;
;; This is reversible because the source assumes T > 0. The right side below
;; is the exact antiderivative difference. Equality of these generic formal
;; polynomials is equivalent to the displayed equality under every real
;; coefficient assignment and every positive real T.

(defun putnambench-putnam-1970-b2-statement ()
  (let* ((time (putnam-1970-b2-polynomial-variable 0))
         (negative-time
          (putnam-1970-b2-polynomial-negate time))
         (coefficients
          (list
           (putnam-1970-b2-polynomial-variable 1)
           (putnam-1970-b2-polynomial-variable 2)
           (putnam-1970-b2-polynomial-variable 3)
           (putnam-1970-b2-polynomial-variable 4)))
         (positive-node
          (cons
           nil
           (putnam-1970-b2-polynomial-scale 1/3 time)))
         (negative-node
          (cons
           nil
           (putnam-1970-b2-polynomial-scale -1/3 time)))
         (quadrature-sum
          (putnam-1970-b2-extension-add
           (putnam-1970-b2-cubic-eval-extension
            coefficients negative-node)
           (putnam-1970-b2-cubic-eval-extension
            coefficients positive-node)))
         (cleared-quadrature
          (putnam-1970-b2-extension-multiply
           (putnam-1970-b2-extension-base time)
           quadrature-sum))
         (integral
          (putnam-1970-b2-polynomial-subtract
           (putnam-1970-b2-antiderivative-value
            coefficients time)
           (putnam-1970-b2-antiderivative-value
            coefficients negative-time))))
    (equal
     cleared-quadrature
     (putnam-1970-b2-extension-base integral))))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

title: putnam_1970_b2
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1970_b2:
-- the average of a real polynomial of degree at most three on [-T, T] equals
-- its average at the two points plus and minus T / sqrt(3). This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; _*_)

infix 4 _!=_ _<=N_
infixr 3 _and_
infixr 2 _or_

data Bottom : Set where

Not : Set -> Set
Not A =
  A -> Bottom

_!=_ : {A : Set} -> A -> A -> Set
x != y =
  Not (x == y)

record _and_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data _or_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  left  : A -> A or B
  right : B -> A or B

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

data _<=N_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set where
  zero<=   : {n : Nat} -> zero <=N n
  suc<=suc : {m n : Nat} -> m <=N n -> suc m <=N suc n

record CompleteOrderedRealField (R : Set) : Set1 where
  field
    zeroR oneR : R
    add multiply : R -> R -> R
    negate inverse squareRoot : R -> R
    lessOrEqual : R -> R -> Set
    fromNat : Nat -> R

    one-not-zero :
      oneR != zeroR

    add-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> add x y == add y x
    add-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      add (add x y) z == add x (add y z)
    add-zero :
      (x : R) -> add x zeroR == x
    add-inverse :
      (x : R) -> add x (negate x) == zeroR

    multiply-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> multiply x y == multiply y x
    multiply-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply (multiply x y) z ==
      multiply x (multiply y z)
    multiply-one :
      (x : R) -> multiply x oneR == x
    multiply-zero :
      (x : R) -> multiply x zeroR == zeroR
    distribute :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply x (add y z) ==
      add (multiply x y) (multiply x z)
    inverse-zero :
      inverse zeroR == zeroR
    multiply-inverse :
      (x : R) ->
      x != zeroR ->
      multiply x (inverse x) == oneR

    order-reflexive :
      (x : R) -> lessOrEqual x x
    order-transitive :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y z ->
      lessOrEqual x z
    order-antisymmetric :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y x ->
      x == y
    order-total :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y or lessOrEqual y x
    add-order :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual (add z x) (add z y)
    multiply-nonnegative :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR x ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR y ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR (multiply x y)
    zero-less-than-one :
      lessOrEqual zeroR oneR and zeroR != oneR

    fromNat-zero :
      fromNat zero == zeroR
    fromNat-successor :
      (n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (suc n) == add (fromNat n) oneR
    fromNat-addition :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m + n) == add (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-multiplication :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m * n) == multiply (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-injective :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat m == fromNat n ->
      m == n

    archimedean :
      (x : R) ->
      Exists Nat (\ n -> lessOrEqual x (fromNat n))
    least-upper-bound :
      (P : R -> Set) ->
      Exists R P ->
      Exists R
        (\ upper ->
          (x : R) ->
          P x ->
          lessOrEqual x upper) ->
      Exists R
        (\ supremum ->
          ((x : R) ->
            P x ->
            lessOrEqual x supremum)
          and
          ((upper : R) ->
            ((x : R) ->
              P x ->
              lessOrEqual x upper) ->
            lessOrEqual supremum upper))

    square-root-nonnegative :
      (x : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR (squareRoot x)
    square-root-square :
      (x : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR x ->
      multiply (squareRoot x) (squareRoot x) == x
    square-root-nonpositive :
      (x : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x zeroR ->
      squareRoot x == zeroR

open CompleteOrderedRealField

subtract :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
subtract reals x y =
  add reals x (negate reals y)

divide :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
divide reals x y =
  multiply reals x (inverse reals y)

StrictLess :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
StrictLess reals x y =
  lessOrEqual reals x y and x != y

CloseTo :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
CloseTo reals center radius x =
  StrictLess reals
    (subtract reals center radius)
    x
  and
  StrictLess reals
    x
    (add reals center radius)

SequentialLimit :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  R ->
  Set
SequentialLimit {R} reals sequence limit =
  (epsilon : R) ->
  StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) epsilon ->
  Exists Nat
    (\ cutoff ->
      (n : Nat) ->
      cutoff <=N n ->
      CloseTo reals limit epsilon (sequence n))

sumFirst :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Nat ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  R
sumFirst reals zero terms =
  zeroR reals
sumFirst reals (suc n) terms =
  add reals
    (sumFirst reals n terms)
    (terms n)

record CubicPolynomial (R : Set) : Set where
  constructor cubic
  field
    constantCoefficient  : R
    linearCoefficient    : R
    quadraticCoefficient : R
    cubicCoefficient     : R

open CubicPolynomial

evaluate :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  CubicPolynomial R ->
  R ->
  R
evaluate reals polynomial x =
  add reals
    (constantCoefficient polynomial)
    (multiply reals x
      (add reals
        (linearCoefficient polynomial)
        (multiply reals x
          (add reals
            (quadraticCoefficient polynomial)
            (multiply reals x
              (cubicCoefficient polynomial))))))

rightRiemannSum :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  (R -> R) ->
  Nat ->
  R
rightRiemannSum reals lower upper function pieces =
  let
    step =
      divide reals
        (subtract reals upper lower)
        (fromNat reals pieces)
  in
  sumFirst reals pieces
    (\ i ->
      multiply reals
        (function
          (add reals lower
            (multiply reals
              (fromNat reals (suc i))
              step)))
        step)

IntervalIntegralValue :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  (R -> R) ->
  R ->
  Set
IntervalIntegralValue reals lower upper function value =
  SequentialLimit reals
    (\ n ->
      rightRiemannSum reals
        lower
        upper
        function
        (suc n))
    value

record StandardCubicIntegration
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) :
  Set1 where

  field
    intervalIntegral :
      R ->
      R ->
      CubicPolynomial R ->
      R

    interval-integral-is-riemann :
      (lower upper : R) ->
      (polynomial : CubicPolynomial R) ->
      IntervalIntegralValue reals
        lower
        upper
        (evaluate reals polynomial)
        (intervalIntegral lower upper polynomial)

open StandardCubicIntegration

module Putnam1970B2Statement
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R)
  (integration : StandardCubicIntegration reals) where

  two : R
  two =
    fromNat reals 2

  three : R
  three =
    fromNat reals 3

  symmetricPoint : R -> R
  symmetricPoint T =
    divide reals T (squareRoot reals three)

  twoPointAverage :
    CubicPolynomial R ->
    R ->
    R
  twoPointAverage polynomial T =
    divide reals
      (add reals
        (evaluate reals polynomial
          (negate reals (symmetricPoint T)))
        (evaluate reals polynomial
          (symmetricPoint T)))
      two

  intervalAverage :
    CubicPolynomial R ->
    R ->
    R
  intervalAverage polynomial T =
    multiply reals
      (inverse reals (multiply reals two T))
      (intervalIntegral integration
        (negate reals T)
        T
        polynomial)

  proposition : Set
  proposition =
    (T : R) ->
    (polynomial : CubicPolynomial R) ->
    StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) T ->
    twoPointAverage polynomial T ==
    intervalAverage polynomial T

putnam-1970-b2 : Set1
putnam-1970-b2 =
  (R : Set) ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) ->
  (integration : StandardCubicIntegration reals) ->
  Putnam1970B2Statement.proposition reals integration

(*
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench artifact putnam_1970_b2:
  the two-point Gaussian quadrature identity for the average of a real
  polynomial of degree at most three on a symmetric interval. This file
  contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open pred_setTheory realTheory transcTheory integrationTheory polyTheory;

val putnam_1970_b2 =
  ``!T : real. !H : real list.
      0 < T /\ degree H <= 3
      ==>
      (poly H (~T / sqrt 3) + poly H (T / sqrt 3)) / 2 =
      1 / (2 * T) *
        integration$integral (interval [~T, T]) (poly H)``;

title: putnam_1970_b2
content:
% Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench artifact putnam_1970_b2:
% the normalized integral of a real polynomial of degree at most three over
% [-T, T] equals its two-point average at +/-T/sqrt(3). This file contains no
% proof.

putnam_1970_b2: THEORY
BEGIN
  real_function: TYPE = [real -> real]
  real_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> real]
  coefficient_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> real]

  safe_div(numerator, denominator: real): real =
    IF denominator = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      numerator / denominator
    ENDIF

  polynomial_value(
      coefficients: coefficient_sequence,
      x: real,
      count: nat): RECURSIVE real =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      LET index: nat = count - 1 IN
        polynomial_value(coefficients, x, count - 1)
          + coefficients(index) * x ^ index
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  degree_at_most_three(
      coefficients: coefficient_sequence): bool =
    FORALL (index: nat):
      3 < index IMPLIES coefficients(index) = 0

  valid_tagged_partition(
      left, right: real,
      points, tags: real_sequence,
      count: nat): bool =
    count > 0
      AND points(0) = left
      AND points(count) = right
      AND FORALL (index: nat):
        index < count IMPLIES
          (points(index) < points(index + 1)
            AND points(index) <= tags(index)
            AND tags(index) <= points(index + 1))

  mesh_less_than(
      points: real_sequence,
      count: nat,
      bound: real): bool =
    FORALL (index: nat):
      index < count IMPLIES
        points(index + 1) - points(index) < bound

  riemann_sum(
      f: real_function,
      points, tags: real_sequence,
      count: nat): RECURSIVE real =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      riemann_sum(f, points, tags, count - 1)
        + f(tags(count - 1))
            * (points(count) - points(count - 1))
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  has_interval_integral(
      f: real_function,
      left, right, integral_value: real): bool =
    left < right
      AND FORALL (epsilon_value: posreal):
        EXISTS (mesh_bound: posreal):
          FORALL
              (points, tags: real_sequence),
              (count: nat):
            (valid_tagged_partition(
                left, right, points, tags, count)
              AND mesh_less_than(points, count, mesh_bound))
            IMPLIES
              abs(
                riemann_sum(f, points, tags, count)
                  - integral_value)
                < epsilon_value

  interval_integral(
      f: real_function,
      left, right: real): real =
    IF EXISTS (integral_value: real):
        has_interval_integral(f, left, right, integral_value)
    THEN
      epsilon(
        LAMBDA (integral_value: real):
          has_interval_integral(
            f, left, right, integral_value))
    ELSE
      0
    ENDIF

  sqrt_value(root, radicand: real): bool =
    0 <= root AND root * root = radicand

  putnam_1970_b2: bool =
    FORALL
        (T: real),
        (coefficients: coefficient_sequence):
      (T > 0 AND degree_at_most_three(coefficients))
      IMPLIES
        EXISTS (sqrt_three: real):
          sqrt_value(sqrt_three, 3)
            AND
              (safe_div(
                  polynomial_value(
                    coefficients,
                    -safe_div(T, sqrt_three),
                    4)
                    + polynomial_value(
                        coefficients,
                        safe_div(T, sqrt_three),
                        4),
                  2)
                =
                safe_div(1, 2 * T)
                  * interval_integral(
                      LAMBDA (x: real):
                        polynomial_value(coefficients, x, 4),
                      -T,
                      T))
END putnam_1970_b2

  and a b :: real
  assumes hab: "a < b"
  and hS: "\<forall>s\<in>S. s$1 \<in> {a<..<b}"
  and hSclosed: "closed S"
  shows "closed {y::real. (\<exists>s\<in>S. y = s$2)}"
  sorry

end

title: putnam_1970_b3
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench artifact putnam_1970_b3:
  closedness of the y-coordinate projection of a closed subset of the real
  plane whose x-coordinates lie in a bounded open interval. This file
  contains no proof.
*)

let statement =
  `let closed_plane =
     \S:(real#real)->bool.
       !p:real#real.
         ~(p IN S)
         ==> ?e:real.
               &0 < e /\
               !q:real#real.
                 (FST q - FST p) pow 2 +
                 (SND q - SND p) pow 2 < e pow 2
                 ==> ~(q IN S) in
   let closed_real =
     \A:real->bool.
       !x:real.
         ~(x IN A)
         ==> ?e:real.
               &0 < e /\
               !y:real.
                 (y - x) pow 2 < e pow 2
                 ==> ~(y IN A) in
   !S:(real#real)->bool. !a b:real.
     a < b /\
     (!s:real#real. s IN S ==> a < FST s /\ FST s < b) /\
     closed_plane S
     ==> closed_real {y:real | ?x:real. (x,y) IN S}`;;

title: putnam_1970_b3
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1970_b3:
;; a closed subset of the real plane contained in a bounded vertical strip
;; has closed projection onto the y-axis. This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))

;; Tame APPLY$ objects present an arbitrary Dedekind-complete ordered field,
;; hence a copy of the real field, and arbitrary predicates on it. FN-EQUAL
;; supplies unbounded universal quantification; inequality with a constant
;; false function supplies internal existential witnesses. Closedness is
;; expanded using the exact order topology and its product-rectangle basis.

(defun putnam-1970-b3-quoted (object)
  (list 'quote object))

(defun putnam-1970-b3-term-list (terms)
  (if (consp terms)
      (list 'cons
            (car terms)
            (putnam-1970-b3-term-list (cdr terms)))
    (putnam-1970-b3-quoted nil)))

(defun putnam-1970-b3-apply-term (function-term arguments)
  (list 'apply$
        function-term
        (putnam-1970-b3-term-list arguments)))

(defun putnam-1970-b3-static-apply-term (function arguments)
  (putnam-1970-b3-apply-term
   (putnam-1970-b3-quoted function)
   arguments))

(defun putnam-1970-b3-and-terms (terms)
  (if (consp terms)
      (list 'if
            (car terms)
            (putnam-1970-b3-and-terms (cdr terms))
            (putnam-1970-b3-quoted nil))
    (putnam-1970-b3-quoted t)))

(defun putnam-1970-b3-or-terms (terms)
  (if (consp terms)
      (list 'if
            (car terms)
            (putnam-1970-b3-quoted t)
            (putnam-1970-b3-or-terms (cdr terms)))
    (putnam-1970-b3-quoted nil)))

(defun putnam-1970-b3-not-term (term)
  (list 'if term
        (putnam-1970-b3-quoted nil)
        (putnam-1970-b3-quoted t)))

(defun putnam-1970-b3-implies-term (hypothesis conclusion)
  (list 'if hypothesis conclusion (putnam-1970-b3-quoted t)))

(defun putnam-1970-b3-true-function (formals)
  (list 'lambda formals (putnam-1970-b3-quoted t)))

(defun putnam-1970-b3-false-function (formals)
  (list 'lambda formals (putnam-1970-b3-quoted nil)))

(defun putnam-1970-b3-universal-p (function formals)
  (let ((always-true
         (putnam-1970-b3-true-function formals)))
    (and
     (tamep-functionp function)
     (tamep-functionp always-true)
     (fn-equal function always-true))))

(defun putnam-1970-b3-exists-p (function formals)
  (let ((always-false
         (putnam-1970-b3-false-function formals)))
    (and
     (tamep-functionp function)
     (tamep-functionp always-false)
     (not (fn-equal function always-false)))))

(defun putnam-1970-b3-member-p (predicate object)
  (if (apply$ predicate (list object)) t nil))

(defun putnam-1970-b3-binary-value (function left right)
  (apply$ function (list left right)))

;; Arbitrary subsets of a represented carrier.

(defun putnam-1970-b3-set-subset-function
    (carrier left right)
  (list
   'lambda '(x)
   (putnam-1970-b3-implies-term
    (putnam-1970-b3-and-terms
     (list
      (putnam-1970-b3-static-apply-term carrier '(x))
      (putnam-1970-b3-static-apply-term left '(x))))
    (putnam-1970-b3-static-apply-term right '(x)))))

(defun putnam-1970-b3-set-subset-p
    (carrier left right)
  (and
   (tamep-functionp carrier)
   (tamep-functionp left)
   (tamep-functionp right)
   (putnam-1970-b3-universal-p
    (putnam-1970-b3-set-subset-function
     carrier left right)
    '(x))))

(defun putnam-1970-b3-valid-set-p (carrier set)
  (and
   (tamep-functionp set)
   (putnam-1970-b3-set-subset-p carrier set carrier)))

(defun putnam-1970-b3-complement-set (carrier set)
  (list
   'lambda '(x)
   (putnam-1970-b3-and-terms
    (list
     (putnam-1970-b3-static-apply-term carrier '(x))
     (putnam-1970-b3-not-term
      (putnam-1970-b3-static-apply-term set '(x)))))))

;; A Dedekind-complete ordered field is an abstract presentation of R.

(defun putnam-1970-b3-field-laws-function
    (carrier zero one add multiply negate inverse)
  (let* ((xy-add
          (putnam-1970-b3-static-apply-term add '(x y)))
         (yz-add
          (putnam-1970-b3-static-apply-term add '(y z)))
         (xy-mul
          (putnam-1970-b3-static-apply-term multiply '(x y)))
         (yz-mul
          (putnam-1970-b3-static-apply-term multiply '(y z)))
         (neg-x
          (putnam-1970-b3-static-apply-term negate '(x)))
         (inv-x
          (putnam-1970-b3-static-apply-term inverse '(x))))
    (list
     'lambda '(x y z)
     (putnam-1970-b3-implies-term
      (putnam-1970-b3-and-terms
       (list
        (putnam-1970-b3-static-apply-term carrier '(x))
        (putnam-1970-b3-static-apply-term carrier '(y))
        (putnam-1970-b3-static-apply-term carrier '(z))))
      (putnam-1970-b3-and-terms
       (list
        (putnam-1970-b3-static-apply-term carrier (list xy-add))
        (putnam-1970-b3-static-apply-term carrier (list xy-mul))
        (putnam-1970-b3-static-apply-term carrier (list neg-x))
        (putnam-1970-b3-static-apply-term carrier (list inv-x))
        (list
         'equal
         (putnam-1970-b3-static-apply-term add (list xy-add 'z))
         (putnam-1970-b3-static-apply-term add (list 'x yz-add)))
        (list
         'equal
         xy-add
         (putnam-1970-b3-static-apply-term add '(y x)))
        (list
         'equal
         (putnam-1970-b3-static-apply-term
          add (list 'x (putnam-1970-b3-quoted zero)))
         'x)
        (list
         'equal
         (putnam-1970-b3-static-apply-term add (list 'x neg-x))
         (putnam-1970-b3-quoted zero))
        (list
         'equal
         (putnam-1970-b3-static-apply-term
          multiply (list xy-mul 'z))
         (putnam-1970-b3-static-apply-term
          multiply (list 'x yz-mul)))
        (list
         'equal
         xy-mul
         (putnam-1970-b3-static-apply-term multiply '(y x)))
        (list
         'equal
         (putnam-1970-b3-static-apply-term
          multiply (list 'x (putnam-1970-b3-quoted one)))
         'x)
        (putnam-1970-b3-implies-term
         (list 'equal 'x (putnam-1970-b3-quoted zero))
         (list 'equal inv-x (putnam-1970-b3-quoted zero)))
        (putnam-1970-b3-implies-term
         (putnam-1970-b3-not-term
          (list 'equal 'x (putnam-1970-b3-quoted zero)))
         (list
          'equal
          (putnam-1970-b3-static-apply-term
           multiply (list 'x inv-x))
          (putnam-1970-b3-quoted one)))
        (list
         'equal
         (putnam-1970-b3-static-apply-term
          multiply (list 'x yz-add))
         (putnam-1970-b3-static-apply-term
          add
          (list
           (putnam-1970-b3-static-apply-term multiply '(x y))
           (putnam-1970-b3-static-apply-term
            multiply '(x z)))))))))))

(defun putnam-1970-b3-order-laws-function
    (carrier zero add multiply less)
  (let ((xy
         (putnam-1970-b3-static-apply-term less '(x y)))
        (yx
         (putnam-1970-b3-static-apply-term less '(y x)))
        (yz
         (putnam-1970-b3-static-apply-term less '(y z))))
    (list
     'lambda '(x y z)
     (putnam-1970-b3-implies-term
      (putnam-1970-b3-and-terms
       (list
        (putnam-1970-b3-static-apply-term carrier '(x))
        (putnam-1970-b3-static-apply-term carrier '(y))
        (putnam-1970-b3-static-apply-term carrier '(z))))
      (putnam-1970-b3-and-terms
       (list
        (putnam-1970-b3-not-term
         (putnam-1970-b3-static-apply-term less '(x x)))
        (putnam-1970-b3-or-terms
         (list xy yx (list 'equal 'x 'y)))
        (putnam-1970-b3-implies-term
         (putnam-1970-b3-and-terms (list xy yz))
         (putnam-1970-b3-static-apply-term less '(x z)))
        (putnam-1970-b3-implies-term
         xy
         (putnam-1970-b3-static-apply-term
          less
          (list
           (putnam-1970-b3-static-apply-term add '(x z))
           (putnam-1970-b3-static-apply-term add '(y z)))))
        (putnam-1970-b3-implies-term
         (putnam-1970-b3-and-terms
          (list
           (putnam-1970-b3-static-apply-term
            less (list (putnam-1970-b3-quoted zero) 'x))
           (putnam-1970-b3-static-apply-term
            less (list (putnam-1970-b3-quoted zero) 'y))))
         (putnam-1970-b3-static-apply-term
          less
          (list
           (putnam-1970-b3-quoted zero)
           (putnam-1970-b3-static-apply-term
            multiply '(x y)))))))))))

(defun putnam-1970-b3-upper-bound-function
    (carrier less set upper)
  (list
   'lambda '(x)
   (putnam-1970-b3-implies-term
    (putnam-1970-b3-and-terms
     (list
      (putnam-1970-b3-static-apply-term carrier '(x))
      (putnam-1970-b3-static-apply-term set '(x))))
    (putnam-1970-b3-not-term
     (putnam-1970-b3-static-apply-term
      less (list (putnam-1970-b3-quoted upper) 'x))))))

(defun putnam-1970-b3-upper-bound-p
    (carrier less set upper)
  (and
   (putnam-1970-b3-member-p carrier upper)
   (putnam-1970-b3-valid-set-p carrier set)
   (putnam-1970-b3-universal-p
    (putnam-1970-b3-upper-bound-function
     carrier less set upper)
    '(x))))

(defun putnam-1970-b3-set-nonempty-function
    (carrier set)
  (list
   'lambda '(x)
   (putnam-1970-b3-and-terms
    (list
     (putnam-1970-b3-static-apply-term carrier '(x))
     (putnam-1970-b3-static-apply-term set '(x))))))

(defun putnam-1970-b3-set-nonempty-p (carrier set)
  (and
   (putnam-1970-b3-valid-set-p carrier set)
   (putnam-1970-b3-exists-p
    (putnam-1970-b3-set-nonempty-function carrier set)
    '(x))))

(defun putnam-1970-b3-bounded-above-function
    (carrier less set)
  (list
   'lambda '(upper)
   (list
    'putnam-1970-b3-upper-bound-p
    (putnam-1970-b3-quoted carrier)
    (putnam-1970-b3-quoted less)
    (putnam-1970-b3-quoted set)
    'upper)))

(defun putnam-1970-b3-bounded-above-p
    (carrier less set)
  (putnam-1970-b3-exists-p
   (putnam-1970-b3-bounded-above-function
    carrier less set)
   '(upper)))

(defun putnam-1970-b3-least-upper-bound-function
    (carrier less set supremum)
  (list
   'lambda '(upper)
   (putnam-1970-b3-implies-term
    (list
     'putnam-1970-b3-upper-bound-p
     (putnam-1970-b3-quoted carrier)
     (putnam-1970-b3-quoted less)
     (putnam-1970-b3-quoted set)
     'upper)
    (putnam-1970-b3-not-term
     (putnam-1970-b3-static-apply-term
      less (list 'upper (putnam-1970-b3-quoted supremum)))))))

(defun putnam-1970-b3-least-upper-bound-p
    (carrier less set supremum)
  (and
   (putnam-1970-b3-upper-bound-p
    carrier less set supremum)
   (putnam-1970-b3-universal-p
    (putnam-1970-b3-least-upper-bound-function
     carrier less set supremum)
    '(upper))))

(defun putnam-1970-b3-completeness-function
    (carrier less supremum-operation)
  (list
   'lambda '(set)
   (putnam-1970-b3-implies-term
    (putnam-1970-b3-and-terms
     (list
      (list
       'putnam-1970-b3-valid-set-p
       (putnam-1970-b3-quoted carrier)
       'set)
      (list
       'putnam-1970-b3-set-nonempty-p
       (putnam-1970-b3-quoted carrier)
       'set)
      (list
       'putnam-1970-b3-bounded-above-p
       (putnam-1970-b3-quoted carrier)
       (putnam-1970-b3-quoted less)
       'set)))
    (list
     'putnam-1970-b3-least-upper-bound-p
     (putnam-1970-b3-quoted carrier)
     (putnam-1970-b3-quoted less)
     'set
     (putnam-1970-b3-static-apply-term
      supremum-operation '(set))))))

(defun putnam-1970-b3-real-field-p
    (carrier zero one add multiply negate inverse less supremum)
  (and
   (tamep-functionp carrier)
   (tamep-functionp add)
   (tamep-functionp multiply)
   (tamep-functionp negate)
   (tamep-functionp inverse)
   (tamep-functionp less)
   (tamep-functionp supremum)
   (putnam-1970-b3-member-p carrier zero)
   (putnam-1970-b3-member-p carrier one)
   (not (equal zero one))
   (putnam-1970-b3-universal-p
    (putnam-1970-b3-field-laws-function
     carrier zero one add multiply negate inverse)
    '(x y z))
   (putnam-1970-b3-universal-p
    (putnam-1970-b3-order-laws-function
     carrier zero add multiply less)
    '(x y z))
   (putnam-1970-b3-universal-p
    (putnam-1970-b3-completeness-function
     carrier less supremum)
    '(set))
   (putnam-1970-b3-binary-value less zero one)))

;; Real-field context.

(defun putnam-1970-b3-r-carrier (ctx) (nth 0 ctx))
(defun putnam-1970-b3-r-zero (ctx) (nth 1 ctx))
(defun putnam-1970-b3-r-one (ctx) (nth 2 ctx))
(defun putnam-1970-b3-r-add (ctx) (nth 3 ctx))
(defun putnam-1970-b3-r-multiply (ctx) (nth 4 ctx))
(defun putnam-1970-b3-r-negate (ctx) (nth 5 ctx))
(defun putnam-1970-b3-r-inverse (ctx) (nth 6 ctx))
(defun putnam-1970-b3-r-less (ctx) (nth 7 ctx))
(defun putnam-1970-b3-r-supremum (ctx) (nth 8 ctx))

(defun putnam-1970-b3-context-p (ctx)
  (and
   (true-listp ctx)
   (equal (len ctx) 9)
   (putnam-1970-b3-real-field-p
    (putnam-1970-b3-r-carrier ctx)
    (putnam-1970-b3-r-zero ctx)
    (putnam-1970-b3-r-one ctx)
    (putnam-1970-b3-r-add ctx)
    (putnam-1970-b3-r-multiply ctx)
    (putnam-1970-b3-r-negate ctx)
    (putnam-1970-b3-r-inverse ctx)
    (putnam-1970-b3-r-less ctx)
    (putnam-1970-b3-r-supremum ctx))))

;; The exact order topology on the represented real field.

(defun putnam-1970-b3-open-interval-subset-function
    (carrier less lower upper set)
  (list
   'lambda '(y)
   (putnam-1970-b3-implies-term
    (putnam-1970-b3-and-terms
     (list
      (putnam-1970-b3-static-apply-term carrier '(y))
      (putnam-1970-b3-static-apply-term
       less (list (putnam-1970-b3-quoted lower) 'y))
      (putnam-1970-b3-static-apply-term
       less (list 'y (putnam-1970-b3-quoted upper)))))
    (putnam-1970-b3-static-apply-term set '(y)))))

(defun putnam-1970-b3-open-interval-subset-p
    (carrier less lower upper set)
  (putnam-1970-b3-universal-p
   (putnam-1970-b3-open-interval-subset-function
    carrier less lower upper set)
   '(y)))

(defun putnam-1970-b3-order-neighborhood-witness-function
    (carrier less set x)
  (list
   'lambda '(bounds)
   (putnam-1970-b3-and-terms
    (list
     (list 'true-listp 'bounds)
     (list 'equal (list 'len 'bounds) (putnam-1970-b3-quoted 2))
     (putnam-1970-b3-static-apply-term
      carrier (list (list 'car 'bounds)))
     (putnam-1970-b3-static-apply-term
      carrier (list (list 'cadr 'bounds)))
     (putnam-1970-b3-static-apply-term
      less
      (list (list 'car 'bounds) (putnam-1970-b3-quoted x)))
     (putnam-1970-b3-static-apply-term
      less
      (list (putnam-1970-b3-quoted x) (list 'cadr 'bounds)))
     (list
      'putnam-1970-b3-open-interval-subset-p
      (putnam-1970-b3-quoted carrier)
      (putnam-1970-b3-quoted less)
      (list 'car 'bounds)
      (list 'cadr 'bounds)
      (putnam-1970-b3-quoted set))))))

(defun putnam-1970-b3-order-neighborhood-p
    (carrier less set x)
  (putnam-1970-b3-exists-p
   (putnam-1970-b3-order-neighborhood-witness-function
    carrier less set x)
   '(bounds)))

(defun putnam-1970-b3-order-open-points-function
    (carrier less set)
  (list
   'lambda '(x)
   (putnam-1970-b3-implies-term
    (putnam-1970-b3-and-terms
     (list
      (putnam-1970-b3-static-apply-term carrier '(x))
      (putnam-1970-b3-static-apply-term set '(x))))
    (list
     'putnam-1970-b3-order-neighborhood-p
     (putnam-1970-b3-quoted carrier)
     (putnam-1970-b3-quoted less)
     (putnam-1970-b3-quoted set)
     'x))))

(defun putnam-1970-b3-order-open-p
    (carrier less set)
  (and
   (putnam-1970-b3-valid-set-p carrier set)
   (putnam-1970-b3-universal-p
    (putnam-1970-b3-order-open-points-function
     carrier less set)
    '(x))))

(defun putnam-1970-b3-order-closed-p
    (carrier less set)
  (and
   (putnam-1970-b3-valid-set-p carrier set)
   (putnam-1970-b3-order-open-p
    carrier less
    (putnam-1970-b3-complement-set carrier set))))

;; Ordered pairs are dotted ACL2 pairs. Open rectangles give the product
;; topology on R x R.

(defun putnam-1970-b3-plane-carrier (carrier)
  (list
   'lambda '(point)
   (putnam-1970-b3-and-terms
    (list
     (list 'consp 'point)
     (putnam-1970-b3-static-apply-term
      carrier (list (list 'car 'point)))
     (putnam-1970-b3-static-apply-term
      carrier (list (list 'cdr 'point)))))))

(defun putnam-1970-b3-nth-term (index list-term)
  (list 'nth (putnam-1970-b3-quoted index) list-term))

(defun putnam-1970-b3-rectangle-subset-function
    (carrier less lower-x upper-x lower-y upper-y set)
  (list
   'lambda '(point)
   (putnam-1970-b3-implies-term
    (putnam-1970-b3-and-terms
     (list
      (list 'consp 'point)
      (putnam-1970-b3-static-apply-term
       carrier (list (list 'car 'point)))
      (putnam-1970-b3-static-apply-term
       carrier (list (list 'cdr 'point)))
      (putnam-1970-b3-static-apply-term
       less
       (list
        (putnam-1970-b3-quoted lower-x)
        (list 'car 'point)))
      (putnam-1970-b3-static-apply-term
       less
       (list
        (list 'car 'point)
        (putnam-1970-b3-quoted upper-x)))
      (putnam-1970-b3-static-apply-term
       less
       (list
        (putnam-1970-b3-quoted lower-y)
        (list 'cdr 'point)))
      (putnam-1970-b3-static-apply-term
       less
       (list
        (list 'cdr 'point)
        (putnam-1970-b3-quoted upper-y)))))
    (putnam-1970-b3-static-apply-term set '(point)))))

(defun putnam-1970-b3-rectangle-subset-p
    (carrier less lower-x upper-x lower-y upper-y set)
  (putnam-1970-b3-universal-p
   (putnam-1970-b3-rectangle-subset-function
    carrier less lower-x upper-x lower-y upper-y set)
   '(point)))

(defun putnam-1970-b3-plane-neighborhood-witness-function
    (carrier less set point)
  (let ((lower-x (putnam-1970-b3-nth-term 0 'bounds))
        (upper-x (putnam-1970-b3-nth-term 1 'bounds))
        (lower-y (putnam-1970-b3-nth-term 2 'bounds))
        (upper-y (putnam-1970-b3-nth-term 3 'bounds)))
    (list
     'lambda '(bounds)
     (putnam-1970-b3-and-terms
      (list
       (list 'true-listp 'bounds)
       (list 'equal
             (list 'len 'bounds)
             (putnam-1970-b3-quoted 4))
       (putnam-1970-b3-static-apply-term carrier (list lower-x))
       (putnam-1970-b3-static-apply-term carrier (list upper-x))
       (putnam-1970-b3-static-apply-term carrier (list lower-y))
       (putnam-1970-b3-static-apply-term carrier (list upper-y))
       (putnam-1970-b3-static-apply-term
        less
        (list
         lower-x
         (list 'car (putnam-1970-b3-quoted point))))
       (putnam-1970-b3-static-apply-term
        less
        (list
         (list 'car (putnam-1970-b3-quoted point))
         upper-x))
       (putnam-1970-b3-static-apply-term
        less
        (list
         lower-y
         (list 'cdr (putnam-1970-b3-quoted point))))
       (putnam-1970-b3-static-apply-term
        less
        (list
         (list 'cdr (putnam-1970-b3-quoted point))
         upper-y))
