-- Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1970_b3:
-- a closed subset of the real plane confined to an open vertical strip has
-- a closed projection on the y-axis. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; _*_)

infix 4 _!=_
infixr 3 _and_
infixr 2 _or_

data Bottom : Set where

Not : Set -> Set
Not A =
  A -> Bottom

_!=_ : {A : Set} -> A -> A -> Set
x != y =
  Not (x == y)

record _and_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data _or_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  left  : A -> A or B
  right : B -> A or B

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

record CompleteOrderedRealField (R : Set) : Set1 where
  field
    zeroR oneR : R
    add multiply : R -> R -> R
    negate inverse : R -> R
    lessOrEqual : R -> R -> Set
    fromNat : Nat -> R

    one-not-zero :
      oneR != zeroR

    add-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> add x y == add y x
    add-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      add (add x y) z == add x (add y z)
    add-zero :
      (x : R) -> add x zeroR == x
    add-inverse :
      (x : R) -> add x (negate x) == zeroR

    multiply-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> multiply x y == multiply y x
    multiply-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply (multiply x y) z ==
      multiply x (multiply y z)
    multiply-one :
      (x : R) -> multiply x oneR == x
    multiply-zero :
      (x : R) -> multiply x zeroR == zeroR
    distribute :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply x (add y z) ==
      add (multiply x y) (multiply x z)
    inverse-zero :
      inverse zeroR == zeroR
    multiply-inverse :
      (x : R) ->
      x != zeroR ->
      multiply x (inverse x) == oneR

    order-reflexive :
      (x : R) -> lessOrEqual x x
    order-transitive :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y z ->
      lessOrEqual x z
    order-antisymmetric :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y x ->
      x == y
    order-total :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y or lessOrEqual y x
    add-order :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual (add z x) (add z y)
    multiply-nonnegative :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR x ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR y ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR (multiply x y)
    zero-less-than-one :
      lessOrEqual zeroR oneR and zeroR != oneR

    fromNat-zero :
      fromNat zero == zeroR
    fromNat-successor :
      (n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (suc n) == add (fromNat n) oneR
    fromNat-addition :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m + n) == add (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-multiplication :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m * n) == multiply (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-injective :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat m == fromNat n ->
      m == n

    archimedean :
      (x : R) ->
      Exists Nat (\ n -> lessOrEqual x (fromNat n))
    least-upper-bound :
      (P : R -> Set) ->
      Exists R P ->
      Exists R
        (\ upper ->
          (x : R) ->
          P x ->
          lessOrEqual x upper) ->
      Exists R
        (\ supremum ->
          ((x : R) ->
            P x ->
            lessOrEqual x supremum)
          and
          ((upper : R) ->
            ((x : R) ->
              P x ->
              lessOrEqual x upper) ->
            lessOrEqual supremum upper))

open CompleteOrderedRealField

record Point (R : Set) : Set where
  constructor point
  field
    x-coordinate : R
    y-coordinate : R

open Point

RealSubset : Set -> Set1
RealSubset R =
  R -> Set

PlaneSubset : Set -> Set1
PlaneSubset R =
  Point R -> Set

subtract :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
subtract reals x y =
  add reals x (negate reals y)

square :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R
square reals x =
  multiply reals x x

StrictLess :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
StrictLess reals x y =
  lessOrEqual reals x y and x != y

StrictPositive :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  Set
StrictPositive reals radius =
  StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) radius

OpenRealBall :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
OpenRealBall reals center radius x =
  StrictLess reals
    (subtract reals center radius)
    x
  and
  StrictLess reals
    x
    (add reals center radius)

squaredDistance :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Point R ->
  Point R ->
  R
squaredDistance reals p q =
  add reals
    (square reals
      (subtract reals (x-coordinate p) (x-coordinate q)))
    (square reals
      (subtract reals (y-coordinate p) (y-coordinate q)))

OpenPlaneBall :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Point R ->
  R ->
  Point R ->
  Set
OpenPlaneBall reals center radius p =
  StrictLess reals
    (squaredDistance reals center p)
    (square reals radius)

ClosedReal :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  RealSubset R ->
  Set
ClosedReal {R} reals S =
  (x : R) ->
  Not (S x) ->
  Exists R
    (\ radius ->
      StrictPositive reals radius
      and
      ((y : R) ->
        OpenRealBall reals x radius y ->
        Not (S y)))

ClosedPlane :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  PlaneSubset R ->
  Set
ClosedPlane {R} reals S =
  (p : Point R) ->
  Not (S p) ->
  Exists R
    (\ radius ->
      StrictPositive reals radius
      and
      ((q : Point R) ->
        OpenPlaneBall reals p radius q ->
        Not (S q)))

ProjectionOnYAxis :
  {R : Set} ->
  PlaneSubset R ->
  RealSubset R
ProjectionOnYAxis {R} S y =
  Exists R
    (\ x -> S (point x y))

module Putnam1970B3Statement
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) where

  proposition : Set1
  proposition =
    (S : PlaneSubset R) ->
    (a b : R) ->
    StrictLess reals a b ->
    ((p : Point R) ->
      S p ->
      StrictLess reals a (x-coordinate p)
      and
      StrictLess reals (x-coordinate p) b) ->
    ClosedPlane reals S ->
    ClosedReal reals (ProjectionOnYAxis S)

putnam-1970-b3 : Set1
putnam-1970-b3 =
  (R : Set) ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) ->
  Putnam1970B3Statement.proposition reals

  closedness of the y-axis projection of a closed subset of a bounded open
  vertical strip in the real plane. This file contains no proof.
*)

open metricTheory topologyTheory realTheory real_topologyTheory;

val putnam_1970_b3 =
  ``!S : (real # real) set. !a b : real.
      a < b /\
      (!s : real # real.
         s IN S
         ==>
         a < FST s /\ FST s < b) /\
      closed_in (mtop mr2) S

      closed {y : real | ?x : real. (x, y) IN S}``;

                ( s ` 1 ) < b

            /\
            S e. ( Clsd ` P70B3Top )

        )
        ->
        { y e. RR |
          E. s e. S y = ( s ` 2 )
        }
        e. ( Clsd ` ( TopOpen ` RRfld ) )
      )
  $.
$}

content:
% Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench artifact putnam_1970_b3:
% a closed subset of the real plane contained in a bounded open vertical
% strip has a closed projection onto the y-axis. This file contains no proof.

putnam_1970_b3: THEORY
BEGIN
  point: TYPE = [# x_coord: real, y_coord: real #]
  point_set: TYPE = [point -> bool]
  real_set: TYPE = [real -> bool]

  squared_distance(P, Q: point): real =
    (x_coord(P) - x_coord(Q)) ^ 2
      + (y_coord(P) - y_coord(Q)) ^ 2

  closed_point_set(S: point_set): bool =
    FORALL (P: point):
      NOT S(P) IMPLIES
        EXISTS (radius: real):
          radius > 0
            AND FORALL (Q: point):
              squared_distance(P, Q) < radius ^ 2
                IMPLIES NOT S(Q)

  closed_real_set(T: real_set): bool =
    FORALL (y: real):
      NOT T(y) IMPLIES
        EXISTS (radius: real):
          radius > 0
            AND FORALL (z: real):
              (y - z) ^ 2 < radius ^ 2
                IMPLIES NOT T(z)

  vertical_projection(S: point_set): real_set =
    LAMBDA (y: real):
      EXISTS (x: real):
        S((# x_coord := x, y_coord := y #))

  putnam_1970_b3: bool =
    FORALL (S: point_set), (a, b: real):
      (a < b
        AND (FORALL (P: point):
          S(P) IMPLIES
            a < x_coord(P) AND x_coord(P) < b)
        AND closed_point_set(S))
      IMPLIES closed_real_set(vertical_projection(S))
END putnam_1970_b3

import Mathlib

open Metric Set EuclideanGeometry Filter Topology

/--
Let $x : \mathbb{R} \to \mathbb{R}$ be a twice differentiable function satisfying $x(1) - x(0) = 1$, $x'(0) = x'(1) = 0$, and $|x'(t)| \le \frac{3}{2}$ for all $t \in (0, 1)$. Prove that there exists some $t \in [0, 1]$ such that $|x''(t)| \ge \frac{9}{2}$.
-/
theorem putnam_1970_b4
(x : ℝ → ℝ)
(hdiff : ∀ t ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1,
  DifferentiableAt ℝ x t ∧ DifferentiableAt ℝ (deriv x) t)
(hx : x 1 - x 0 = 1)
(hv : deriv x 0 = 0 ∧ deriv x 1 = 0)
(hs : ∀ t ∈ Set.Ioo 0 1, |deriv x t| ≤ 3/2)
: ∃ t ∈ Set.Icc 0 1, |(deriv (deriv x)) t| ≥ 9/2 :=
sorry

    (x : R -> R)

    (hs : forall t : R, 0 < t < 1 -> `| x^`() t | <= 3/2)
    : exists t : R, 0 <= t <= 1 /\ `| (x^`(2)) t | >= 9/2.
Proof. Admitted.

title: putnam_1970_b4

(*
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench artifact putnam_1970_b4:
  a twice-differentiable real function with prescribed displacement, zero
  endpoint derivatives, and bounded first derivative has a large second
  derivative somewhere on the unit interval. This file contains no proof.
*)

let statement =
  `let has_derivative_at =
     \(g:real->real) (d:real) (a:real).
       !e. &0 < e
           ==> ?delta. &0 < delta /\
                       !y. &0 < abs (y - a) /\ abs (y - a) < delta
                           ==> abs ((g y - g a) / (y - a) - d) < e in
   let deriv =
     \(g:real->real) (a:real). @d. has_derivative_at g d a in
   !x:real->real.
     (!a. &0 <= a /\ a <= &1 ==> ?d. has_derivative_at x d a) /\
     (!a. &0 <= a /\ a <= &1
          ==> ?d. has_derivative_at (deriv x) d a) /\
     x (&1) - x (&0) = &1 /\
     deriv x (&0) = &0 /\
     deriv x (&1) = &0 /\
     (!t. &0 < t /\ t < &1 ==> abs (deriv x t) <= &3 / &2)
     ==> ?t.
           &0 <= t /\ t <= &1 /\
           abs (deriv (deriv x) t) >= &9 / &2`;;

title: putnam_1970_b4
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1970_b4:
;; a twice differentiable real function with prescribed displacement, zero
;; endpoint velocities, and bounded speed has second derivative of magnitude
;; at least 9/2 somewhere on the unit interval. This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))

;; ACL2 has no primitive complete real field.  CTX is therefore an arbitrary
;; Dedekind-complete ordered-field presentation, which is uniquely isomorphic
;; to the real field.  Tame APPLY$ function objects represent arbitrary sets
;; and functions.  The derivative predicates below expand the epsilon
;; remainder definition, and DERIV-VALUE-P exactly totalizes the derivative to
;; zero at nondifferentiable points, as in the source libraries.
;;
;; The final predicate rules out an internally quantified counterexample.
;; Thus the derivative functions and the point in the source conclusion retain
;; their original quantifier scopes; none is exposed as a statement parameter.

(defun putnam-1970-b4-member-p (carrier value)
  (if (apply$ carrier (list value)) t nil))

(defun putnam-1970-b4-unary (function value)
  (apply$ function (list value)))

(defun putnam-1970-b4-binary (function left right)
  (apply$ function (list left right)))

(defun-sk putnam-1970-b4-field-laws-p
    (carrier zero one add multiply negate inverse)
  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (putnam-1970-b4-member-p carrier x)
      (putnam-1970-b4-member-p carrier y)
      (putnam-1970-b4-member-p carrier z))
     (and
      (putnam-1970-b4-member-p
       carrier (putnam-1970-b4-binary add x y))
      (putnam-1970-b4-member-p
       carrier (putnam-1970-b4-binary multiply x y))
      (putnam-1970-b4-member-p
       carrier (putnam-1970-b4-unary negate x))
      (putnam-1970-b4-member-p
       carrier (putnam-1970-b4-unary inverse x))
      (equal
       (putnam-1970-b4-binary
        add (putnam-1970-b4-binary add x y) z)
       (putnam-1970-b4-binary
        add x (putnam-1970-b4-binary add y z)))
      (equal
       (putnam-1970-b4-binary add x y)
       (putnam-1970-b4-binary add y x))
      (equal (putnam-1970-b4-binary add x zero) x)
      (equal
       (putnam-1970-b4-binary
        add x (putnam-1970-b4-unary negate x))
       zero)
      (equal
       (putnam-1970-b4-binary
        multiply (putnam-1970-b4-binary multiply x y) z)
       (putnam-1970-b4-binary
        multiply x (putnam-1970-b4-binary multiply y z)))
      (equal
       (putnam-1970-b4-binary multiply x y)
       (putnam-1970-b4-binary multiply y x))
      (equal (putnam-1970-b4-binary multiply x one) x)
      (implies
       (equal x zero)
       (equal (putnam-1970-b4-unary inverse x) zero))
      (implies
       (not (equal x zero))
       (equal
        (putnam-1970-b4-binary
         multiply x (putnam-1970-b4-unary inverse x))
        one))
      (equal
       (putnam-1970-b4-binary
        multiply x (putnam-1970-b4-binary add y z))
       (putnam-1970-b4-binary
        add
        (putnam-1970-b4-binary multiply x y)
        (putnam-1970-b4-binary multiply x z)))))))

(defun-sk putnam-1970-b4-order-laws-p
    (carrier zero add multiply less)
  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (putnam-1970-b4-member-p carrier x)
      (putnam-1970-b4-member-p carrier y)
      (putnam-1970-b4-member-p carrier z))
     (and
      (not (putnam-1970-b4-binary less x x))
      (or
       (equal x y)
       (putnam-1970-b4-binary less x y)
       (putnam-1970-b4-binary less y x))
      (implies
       (and
        (putnam-1970-b4-binary less x y)
        (putnam-1970-b4-binary less y z))
       (putnam-1970-b4-binary less x z))
      (implies
       (putnam-1970-b4-binary less x y)
       (putnam-1970-b4-binary
        less
        (putnam-1970-b4-binary add x z)
        (putnam-1970-b4-binary add y z)))
      (implies
       (and
        (putnam-1970-b4-binary less zero x)
        (putnam-1970-b4-binary less zero y))
       (putnam-1970-b4-binary
        less zero
        (putnam-1970-b4-binary multiply x y)))))))

(defun-sk putnam-1970-b4-set-nonempty-p (carrier set)
  (exists (x)
    (and
     (putnam-1970-b4-member-p carrier x)
     (apply$ set (list x)))))

(defun-sk putnam-1970-b4-upper-bound-p
    (carrier less set bound)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (and
      (putnam-1970-b4-member-p carrier x)
      (apply$ set (list x)))
     (not (putnam-1970-b4-binary less bound x)))))

(defun-sk putnam-1970-b4-bounded-above-p
    (carrier less set)
  (exists (bound)
    (and
     (putnam-1970-b4-member-p carrier bound)
     (putnam-1970-b4-upper-bound-p
      carrier less set bound))))

(defun-sk putnam-1970-b4-least-upper-bound-p
    (carrier less set supremum)
  (forall (bound)
    (implies
     (and
      (putnam-1970-b4-member-p carrier bound)
      (putnam-1970-b4-upper-bound-p
       carrier less set bound))
     (not
      (putnam-1970-b4-binary less bound supremum)))))

(defun putnam-1970-b4-supremum-p
    (carrier less set supremum)
  (and
   (putnam-1970-b4-member-p carrier supremum)
   (putnam-1970-b4-upper-bound-p
    carrier less set supremum)
   (putnam-1970-b4-least-upper-bound-p
    carrier less set supremum)))

(defun-sk putnam-1970-b4-has-supremum-p
    (carrier less set)
  (exists (supremum)
    (putnam-1970-b4-supremum-p
     carrier less set supremum)))

(defun-sk putnam-1970-b4-dedekind-complete-p
    (carrier less)
  (forall (set)
    (implies
     (and
      (tamep-functionp set)
      (putnam-1970-b4-set-nonempty-p carrier set)
      (putnam-1970-b4-bounded-above-p
       carrier less set))
     (putnam-1970-b4-has-supremum-p
      carrier less set))))

;; CTX = (carrier zero one add multiply negate inverse less).

(defun putnam-1970-b4-carrier (ctx) (nth 0 ctx))
(defun putnam-1970-b4-zero (ctx) (nth 1 ctx))
(defun putnam-1970-b4-one (ctx) (nth 2 ctx))
(defun putnam-1970-b4-add (ctx) (nth 3 ctx))
(defun putnam-1970-b4-multiply (ctx) (nth 4 ctx))
(defun putnam-1970-b4-negate (ctx) (nth 5 ctx))
(defun putnam-1970-b4-inverse (ctx) (nth 6 ctx))
(defun putnam-1970-b4-less (ctx) (nth 7 ctx))

(defun putnam-1970-b4-context-p (ctx)
  (and
   (true-listp ctx)
   (equal (len ctx) 8)
   (tamep-functionp (putnam-1970-b4-carrier ctx))
   (tamep-functionp (putnam-1970-b4-add ctx))
   (tamep-functionp (putnam-1970-b4-multiply ctx))
   (tamep-functionp (putnam-1970-b4-negate ctx))
   (tamep-functionp (putnam-1970-b4-inverse ctx))
   (tamep-functionp (putnam-1970-b4-less ctx))
   (putnam-1970-b4-member-p
    (putnam-1970-b4-carrier ctx)
    (putnam-1970-b4-zero ctx))
   (putnam-1970-b4-member-p
    (putnam-1970-b4-carrier ctx)
    (putnam-1970-b4-one ctx))
   (not
    (equal
     (putnam-1970-b4-zero ctx)
     (putnam-1970-b4-one ctx)))
   (putnam-1970-b4-field-laws-p
    (putnam-1970-b4-carrier ctx)
    (putnam-1970-b4-zero ctx)
    (putnam-1970-b4-one ctx)
    (putnam-1970-b4-add ctx)
    (putnam-1970-b4-multiply ctx)
    (putnam-1970-b4-negate ctx)
    (putnam-1970-b4-inverse ctx))
   (putnam-1970-b4-order-laws-p
    (putnam-1970-b4-carrier ctx)
    (putnam-1970-b4-zero ctx)
    (putnam-1970-b4-add ctx)
    (putnam-1970-b4-multiply ctx)
    (putnam-1970-b4-less ctx))
   (putnam-1970-b4-binary
    (putnam-1970-b4-less ctx)
    (putnam-1970-b4-zero ctx)
    (putnam-1970-b4-one ctx))
   (putnam-1970-b4-dedekind-complete-p
    (putnam-1970-b4-carrier ctx)
    (putnam-1970-b4-less ctx))))

(defun putnam-1970-b4-r-add (ctx left right)
  (putnam-1970-b4-binary
   (putnam-1970-b4-add ctx) left right))

(defun putnam-1970-b4-r-negate (ctx value)
  (putnam-1970-b4-unary
   (putnam-1970-b4-negate ctx) value))

(defun putnam-1970-b4-r-subtract (ctx left right)
  (putnam-1970-b4-r-add
   ctx left (putnam-1970-b4-r-negate ctx right)))

(defun putnam-1970-b4-r-multiply (ctx left right)
  (putnam-1970-b4-binary
   (putnam-1970-b4-multiply ctx) left right))

(defun putnam-1970-b4-r-inverse (ctx value)
  (putnam-1970-b4-unary
   (putnam-1970-b4-inverse ctx) value))

(defun putnam-1970-b4-r-divide (ctx numerator denominator)
  (putnam-1970-b4-r-multiply
   ctx numerator
   (putnam-1970-b4-r-inverse ctx denominator)))

(defun putnam-1970-b4-r-less-p (ctx left right)
  (if
      (putnam-1970-b4-binary
       (putnam-1970-b4-less ctx) left right)
      t nil))

(defun putnam-1970-b4-r-less-equal-p (ctx left right)
  (not (putnam-1970-b4-r-less-p ctx right left)))

(defun putnam-1970-b4-r-absolute (ctx value)
  (if
      (putnam-1970-b4-r-less-p
       ctx value (putnam-1970-b4-zero ctx))
      (putnam-1970-b4-r-negate ctx value)
    value))

(defun putnam-1970-b4-positive-p (ctx value)
  (and
   (putnam-1970-b4-member-p
    (putnam-1970-b4-carrier ctx) value)
   (putnam-1970-b4-r-less-p
    ctx (putnam-1970-b4-zero ctx) value)))

(defun putnam-1970-b4-two (ctx)
  (putnam-1970-b4-r-add
   ctx
   (putnam-1970-b4-one ctx)
   (putnam-1970-b4-one ctx)))

(defun putnam-1970-b4-three (ctx)
  (putnam-1970-b4-r-add
   ctx
   (putnam-1970-b4-two ctx)
   (putnam-1970-b4-one ctx)))

(defun putnam-1970-b4-nine (ctx)
  (putnam-1970-b4-r-multiply
   ctx
   (putnam-1970-b4-three ctx)
   (putnam-1970-b4-three ctx)))

(defun putnam-1970-b4-three-halves (ctx)
  (putnam-1970-b4-r-divide
   ctx
   (putnam-1970-b4-three ctx)
   (putnam-1970-b4-two ctx)))

(defun putnam-1970-b4-nine-halves (ctx)
  (putnam-1970-b4-r-divide
   ctx
   (putnam-1970-b4-nine ctx)
   (putnam-1970-b4-two ctx)))

(defun putnam-1970-b4-in-unit-closed-p (ctx value)
  (and
   (putnam-1970-b4-member-p
    (putnam-1970-b4-carrier ctx) value)
   (putnam-1970-b4-r-less-equal-p
    ctx (putnam-1970-b4-zero ctx) value)
   (putnam-1970-b4-r-less-equal-p
    ctx value (putnam-1970-b4-one ctx))))

(defun putnam-1970-b4-in-unit-open-p (ctx value)
  (and
   (putnam-1970-b4-member-p
    (putnam-1970-b4-carrier ctx) value)
   (putnam-1970-b4-r-less-p
    ctx (putnam-1970-b4-zero ctx) value)
   (putnam-1970-b4-r-less-p
    ctx value (putnam-1970-b4-one ctx))))

(defun-sk putnam-1970-b4-real-function-p
    (ctx function)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (putnam-1970-b4-member-p
      (putnam-1970-b4-carrier ctx) x)
     (putnam-1970-b4-member-p
      (putnam-1970-b4-carrier ctx)
      (putnam-1970-b4-unary function x)))))

(defun putnam-1970-b4-derivative-error
    (ctx function derivative point y)
  (putnam-1970-b4-r-absolute
   ctx
   (putnam-1970-b4-r-subtract
    ctx
    (putnam-1970-b4-r-subtract
     ctx
     (putnam-1970-b4-unary function y)
     (putnam-1970-b4-unary function point))
    (putnam-1970-b4-r-multiply
     ctx derivative
     (putnam-1970-b4-r-subtract ctx y point)))))

(defun-sk putnam-1970-b4-global-error-bound-p
    (ctx function derivative point epsilon radius)
  (forall (y)
    (implies
     (and
      (putnam-1970-b4-member-p
       (putnam-1970-b4-carrier ctx) y)
      (putnam-1970-b4-r-less-p
       ctx
       (putnam-1970-b4-r-absolute
        ctx (putnam-1970-b4-r-subtract ctx y point))
       radius))
     (putnam-1970-b4-r-less-equal-p
      ctx
      (putnam-1970-b4-derivative-error
       ctx function derivative point y)
      (putnam-1970-b4-r-multiply
       ctx epsilon
       (putnam-1970-b4-r-absolute
        ctx
        (putnam-1970-b4-r-subtract ctx y point)))))))

(defun-sk putnam-1970-b4-global-radius-exists-p
    (ctx function derivative point epsilon)
  (exists (radius)
    (and
     (putnam-1970-b4-positive-p ctx radius)
     (putnam-1970-b4-global-error-bound-p
      ctx function derivative point epsilon radius))))

(defun-sk putnam-1970-b4-has-derivative-at-p
    (ctx function derivative point)
  (forall (epsilon)
    (implies
     (putnam-1970-b4-positive-p ctx epsilon)
     (putnam-1970-b4-global-radius-exists-p
      ctx function derivative point epsilon))))

(defun-sk putnam-1970-b4-differentiable-at-p
    (ctx function point)
  (exists (derivative)
    (and
     (putnam-1970-b4-member-p
      (putnam-1970-b4-carrier ctx) derivative)
     (putnam-1970-b4-has-derivative-at-p
      ctx function derivative point))))

(defun putnam-1970-b4-deriv-value-p
    (ctx function point value)
  (and
   (putnam-1970-b4-member-p
    (putnam-1970-b4-carrier ctx) value)
   (if
       (putnam-1970-b4-has-derivative-at-p
        ctx function (putnam-1970-b4-zero ctx) point)
       (equal value (putnam-1970-b4-zero ctx))
     (if
         (putnam-1970-b4-differentiable-at-p
          ctx function point)
         (putnam-1970-b4-has-derivative-at-p
          ctx function value point)
       (equal value (putnam-1970-b4-zero ctx))))))

(defun-sk putnam-1970-b4-deriv-field-values-p
    (ctx function derivative-field)
  (forall (point)
    (implies
     (putnam-1970-b4-member-p
      (putnam-1970-b4-carrier ctx) point)
     (putnam-1970-b4-deriv-value-p
      ctx function point
      (putnam-1970-b4-unary derivative-field point)))))

(defun putnam-1970-b4-deriv-field-p
    (ctx function derivative-field)
  (and
   (tamep-functionp derivative-field)
   (putnam-1970-b4-real-function-p
    ctx derivative-field)
   (putnam-1970-b4-deriv-field-values-p
    ctx function derivative-field)))

(defun-sk putnam-1970-b4-differentiable-on-unit-p
    (ctx function)
  (forall (point)
    (implies
     (putnam-1970-b4-in-unit-closed-p ctx point)
     (putnam-1970-b4-differentiable-at-p
      ctx function point))))

(defun-sk putnam-1970-b4-speed-bound-p
    (ctx derivative-field)
  (forall (point)
    (implies
     (putnam-1970-b4-in-unit-open-p ctx point)
     (putnam-1970-b4-r-less-equal-p
      ctx
      (putnam-1970-b4-r-absolute
       ctx (putnam-1970-b4-unary derivative-field point))
      (putnam-1970-b4-three-halves ctx)))))

(defun putnam-1970-b4-source-assumptions-p
    (ctx function derivative-field)
  (and
   (putnam-1970-b4-differentiable-on-unit-p
    ctx function)
   (putnam-1970-b4-differentiable-on-unit-p
    ctx derivative-field)
   (equal
    (putnam-1970-b4-r-subtract
     ctx
     (putnam-1970-b4-unary
      function (putnam-1970-b4-one ctx))
     (putnam-1970-b4-unary
      function (putnam-1970-b4-zero ctx)))
    (putnam-1970-b4-one ctx))
   (equal
    (putnam-1970-b4-unary
     derivative-field (putnam-1970-b4-zero ctx))
    (putnam-1970-b4-zero ctx))
   (equal
    (putnam-1970-b4-unary
     derivative-field (putnam-1970-b4-one ctx))
    (putnam-1970-b4-zero ctx))
   (putnam-1970-b4-speed-bound-p
    ctx derivative-field)))

;; This is exactly the negation of the source's existential conclusion.

(defun-sk putnam-1970-b4-no-large-second-derivative-p
    (ctx second-derivative-field)
  (forall (point)
    (implies
     (putnam-1970-b4-in-unit-closed-p ctx point)
     (putnam-1970-b4-r-less-p
      ctx
      (putnam-1970-b4-r-absolute
       ctx
       (putnam-1970-b4-unary
        second-derivative-field point))
      (putnam-1970-b4-nine-halves ctx)))))

(defun-sk putnam-1970-b4-counterexample-p
    (ctx function)
  (exists (derivative-field second-derivative-field)
    (and
     (putnam-1970-b4-deriv-field-p
      ctx function derivative-field)
     (putnam-1970-b4-deriv-field-p
      ctx derivative-field second-derivative-field)
     (putnam-1970-b4-source-assumptions-p
      ctx function derivative-field)
     (putnam-1970-b4-no-large-second-derivative-p
      ctx second-derivative-field))))

(defun putnambench-putnam-1970-b4-statement
    (ctx function)
  (implies
   (and
    (putnam-1970-b4-context-p ctx)
    (tamep-functionp function)
    (putnam-1970-b4-real-function-p ctx function))
   (not
    (putnam-1970-b4-counterexample-p
     ctx function))))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

title: putnam_1970_b4
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1970_b4:
-- a twice-differentiable real function with the stated endpoint and derivative
-- bounds has second derivative of magnitude at least 9/2 on [0, 1].
-- This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module Putnam1970B4 where

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; _*_)

infix 4 _!=_
infixr 3 _and_
infixr 2 _or_

data Bottom : Set where

Not : Set -> Set
Not A =
  A -> Bottom

_!=_ : {A : Set} -> A -> A -> Set
x != y =
  Not (x == y)

record _and_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data _or_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  left  : A -> A or B
  right : B -> A or B

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

record CompleteOrderedRealField (R : Set) : Set1 where
  field
    zeroR oneR : R
    add multiply : R -> R -> R
    negate inverse : R -> R
    lessOrEqual : R -> R -> Set
    fromNat : Nat -> R

    one-not-zero :
      oneR != zeroR

    add-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> add x y == add y x
    add-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      add (add x y) z == add x (add y z)
    add-zero :
      (x : R) -> add x zeroR == x
    add-inverse :
      (x : R) -> add x (negate x) == zeroR

    multiply-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> multiply x y == multiply y x
    multiply-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply (multiply x y) z ==
      multiply x (multiply y z)
    multiply-one :
      (x : R) -> multiply x oneR == x
    multiply-zero :
      (x : R) -> multiply x zeroR == zeroR
    distribute :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply x (add y z) ==
      add (multiply x y) (multiply x z)
    inverse-zero :
      inverse zeroR == zeroR
    multiply-inverse :
      (x : R) ->
      x != zeroR ->
      multiply x (inverse x) == oneR

    order-reflexive :
      (x : R) -> lessOrEqual x x
    order-transitive :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y z ->
      lessOrEqual x z
    order-antisymmetric :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y x ->
      x == y
    order-total :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y or lessOrEqual y x
    add-order :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual (add z x) (add z y)
    multiply-nonnegative :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR x ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR y ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR (multiply x y)
    zero-less-than-one :
      lessOrEqual zeroR oneR and zeroR != oneR

    fromNat-zero :
      fromNat zero == zeroR
    fromNat-successor :
      (n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (suc n) == add (fromNat n) oneR
    fromNat-addition :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m + n) == add (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-multiplication :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m * n) == multiply (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-injective :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat m == fromNat n ->
      m == n

    archimedean :
      (x : R) ->
      Exists Nat (\ n -> lessOrEqual x (fromNat n))
    least-upper-bound :
      (P : R -> Set) ->
      Exists R P ->
      Exists R
        (\ upper ->
          (x : R) ->
          P x ->
          lessOrEqual x upper) ->
      Exists R
        (\ supremum ->
          ((x : R) ->
            P x ->
            lessOrEqual x supremum)
          and
          ((upper : R) ->
            ((x : R) ->
              P x ->
              lessOrEqual x upper) ->
            lessOrEqual supremum upper))

open CompleteOrderedRealField

subtract :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
subtract reals x y =
  add reals x (negate reals y)

divide :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
divide reals x y =
  multiply reals x (inverse reals y)

StrictLess :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
StrictLess reals x y =
  lessOrEqual reals x y and x != y

CloseTo :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
CloseTo reals center radius x =
  StrictLess reals
    (subtract reals center radius)
    x
  and
  StrictLess reals
    x
    (add reals center radius)

Predicate : Set -> Set1
Predicate A =
  A -> Set

whole : {A : Set} -> Predicate A
whole _ =
  Bottom -> Bottom

differenceQuotient :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (R -> R) ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
differenceQuotient reals function point x =
  divide reals
    (subtract reals (function x) (function point))
    (subtract reals x point)

DerivativeWithinAt :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (R -> R) ->
  Predicate R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
DerivativeWithinAt {R} reals function domain point derivativeValue =
  (epsilon : R) ->
  StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) epsilon ->
  Exists R
    (\ delta ->
      StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) delta
      and
      ((x : R) ->
        domain x ->
        CloseTo reals point delta x ->
        x != point ->
        CloseTo reals derivativeValue epsilon
          (differenceQuotient reals function point x)))

DerivativeAt :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (R -> R) ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
DerivativeAt reals function point derivativeValue =
  DerivativeWithinAt
    reals
    function
    whole
    point
    derivativeValue

record StandardRealCalculus
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) : Set1 where

  field
    derivative : (R -> R) -> R -> R
    derivative-correct :
      (function : R -> R) ->
      (point derivativeValue : R) ->
      DerivativeAt reals function point derivativeValue ->
      derivative function point == derivativeValue
    derivative-totalized-at-zero :
      (function : R -> R) ->
      (point : R) ->
      Not (Exists R (DerivativeAt reals function point)) ->
      derivative function point == zeroR reals

open StandardRealCalculus

InClosedUnitInterval :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  Set
InClosedUnitInterval reals x =
  lessOrEqual reals (zeroR reals) x
  and
  lessOrEqual reals x (oneR reals)

InOpenUnitInterval :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  Set
InOpenUnitInterval reals x =
  StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) x
  and
  StrictLess reals x (oneR reals)

DifferentiableWithinOn :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (R -> R) ->
  Predicate R ->
  Set
DifferentiableWithinOn {R} reals function domain =
  (point : R) ->
  domain point ->
  Exists R
    (DerivativeWithinAt reals function domain point)

DifferentiableOn :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (R -> R) ->
  Predicate R ->
  Set
DifferentiableOn {R} reals function domain =
  (point : R) ->
  domain point ->
  Exists R
    (DerivativeAt reals function point)

AbsoluteValueAtMost :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
AbsoluteValueAtMost reals bound value =
  lessOrEqual reals (negate reals bound) value
  and
  lessOrEqual reals value bound

AbsoluteValueAtLeast :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
AbsoluteValueAtLeast reals bound value =
  lessOrEqual reals bound value
  or
  lessOrEqual reals value (negate reals bound)

threeHalves :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R
threeHalves reals =
  divide reals
    (fromNat reals (suc (suc (suc zero))))
    (fromNat reals (suc (suc zero)))

nineHalves :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R
nineHalves reals =
  divide reals
    (fromNat reals
      (suc (suc (suc (suc (suc (suc (suc (suc (suc zero))))))))))
    (fromNat reals (suc (suc zero)))

module Putnam1970B4Statement
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R)
  (calculus : StandardRealCalculus reals) where

  proposition : Set
  proposition =
    (x : R -> R) ->
    (DifferentiableOn reals x
      (InClosedUnitInterval reals)
    and
    DifferentiableOn reals
      (derivative calculus x)
      (InClosedUnitInterval reals)) ->
    subtract reals
      (x (oneR reals))
      (x (zeroR reals))
      ==
      oneR reals ->
    (derivative calculus x (zeroR reals) == zeroR reals
    and
    derivative calculus x (oneR reals) == zeroR reals) ->
    ((t : R) ->
      InOpenUnitInterval reals t ->
      AbsoluteValueAtMost reals
        (threeHalves reals)
        (derivative calculus x t)) ->
    Exists R
      (\ t ->
        InClosedUnitInterval reals t
        and
        AbsoluteValueAtLeast reals
          (nineHalves reals)
          (derivative calculus
            (derivative calculus x)
            t))

putnam-1970-b4 : Set1
putnam-1970-b4 =
  (R : Set) ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) ->
  (calculus : StandardRealCalculus reals) ->
  Putnam1970B4Statement.proposition reals calculus

(*

  a twice-differentiable real function on the closed unit interval satisfying
  endpoint and first-derivative bounds has a point where the second derivative
  has magnitude at least nine halves. This file contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open realTheory limTheory;

val putnam_1970_b4 =
  ``!x : real -> real.
      (!t : real.
         0 <= t /\ t <= 1
         ==>
         higher_differentiable 2 x t) /\
      x 1 - x 0 = 1 /\
      diffn 1 x 0 = 0 /\
      diffn 1 x 1 = 0 /\
      (!t : real.
         0 < t /\ t < 1
         ==>
         abs (diffn 1 x t) <= 3 / 2)
      ==>
      ?t : real.
        0 <= t /\ t <= 1 /\
        9 / 2 <= abs (diffn 2 x t)``;

$(
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact
  putnam_1970_b4: a twice-differentiable real function with unit endpoint
  displacement, zero endpoint derivatives, and bounded first derivative
  has a point where the second derivative has absolute value at least 9/2.
  This file contains no proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  RR ^m RR is the class of total real-valued functions. The first two
  entries of ( RR Dn F ) are the first and second real derivatives of F;
  requiring the closed unit interval to lie in their domains preserves the
  two differentiability assumptions. The remaining antecedents reproduce
  the endpoint and open-interval hypotheses, and the conclusion keeps the
  witness existentially quantified in the closed unit interval.

  The final declaration is the single unproved $a corpus statement; this
  database contains no $p proof statement.
$)

${
  $d F t $.

  putnambench-putnam-1970-b4 $a |-
    A. F e. ( RR ^m RR )
      (
        (
          (
            (
              ( 0 [,] 1 ) C_ dom ( ( RR Dn F ) ` 1 )
              /\
              ( 0 [,] 1 ) C_ dom ( ( RR Dn F ) ` 2 )
            )
            /\
            ( ( F ` 1 ) - ( F ` 0 ) ) = 1
          )
          /\
          (
            (
              ( ( ( RR Dn F ) ` 1 ) ` 0 ) = 0
              /\
              ( ( ( RR Dn F ) ` 1 ) ` 1 ) = 0
            )
            /\
            A. t e. ( 0 (,) 1 )
              (
                abs
                `
                ( ( ( RR Dn F ) ` 1 ) ` t )
              )
              <_
              ( 3 / 2 )
          )
        )
        ->
        E. t e. ( 0 [,] 1 )
          (
            ( 9 / 2 )
            <_
            (
              abs
              `
              ( ( ( RR Dn F ) ` 2 ) ` t )
            )
          )
      )
  $.
$}

title: putnam_1970_b4
content:
% Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench artifact putnam_1970_b4:
% a twice-differentiable real function on [0, 1] with displacement one, zero
% endpoint velocities, and interior speed at most 3/2 has acceleration of
% magnitude at least 9/2 somewhere on the interval. This file contains no proof.

putnam_1970_b4: THEORY
BEGIN
  real_function: TYPE = [real -> real]

  in_closed_unit_interval(x: real): bool =
    0 <= x AND x <= 1

  in_open_unit_interval(x: real): bool =
    0 < x AND x < 1

  has_derivative_at(
      f: real_function,
      derivative, x: real): bool =
    FORALL (epsilon_value: real):
      epsilon_value > 0 IMPLIES
        EXISTS (delta: real):
          delta > 0
            AND FORALL (h: real):
              (NOT (h = 0) AND abs(h) < delta)
                IMPLIES
                  abs(
                    f(x + h) - f(x)
                      - derivative * h)
                    < epsilon_value * abs(h)

  differentiable_at(f: real_function, x: real): bool =
    EXISTS (derivative: real):
      has_derivative_at(f, derivative, x)

  derivative_value(f: real_function, x: real): real =
    IF differentiable_at(f, x) THEN
      epsilon(
        LAMBDA (derivative: real):
          has_derivative_at(f, derivative, x))
    ELSE
      0
    ENDIF

  derivative_function(f: real_function): real_function =
    LAMBDA (x: real): derivative_value(f, x)

  ordinarily_differentiable_on_closed_unit_interval(
      f: real_function): bool =
    FORALL (x: real):
      in_closed_unit_interval(x) IMPLIES
        differentiable_at(f, x)

  putnam_1970_b4: bool =
    FORALL (x: real_function):
      (ordinarily_differentiable_on_closed_unit_interval(x)
        AND ordinarily_differentiable_on_closed_unit_interval(
          derivative_function(x))
        AND x(1) - x(0) = 1
        AND derivative_function(x)(0) = 0
        AND derivative_function(x)(1) = 0
        AND (FORALL (t: real):
          in_open_unit_interval(t) IMPLIES
            abs(derivative_function(x)(t)) <= 3 / 2))
      IMPLIES
        EXISTS (t: real):
          in_closed_unit_interval(t)
            AND abs(
              derivative_function(
                derivative_function(x))(t))
              >= 9 / 2
END putnam_1970_b4

import Mathlib

open Metric Set EuclideanGeometry Filter Topology

/--
Let $u_n$ denote the function $u_n(x) = -n$ if $x \leq -n$, $x$ if $-n < x \leq n$, and $n$ otherwise. Let $F$ be a function on the reals. Show that $F$ is continuous if and only if $u_n \circ F$ is continuous for all natural numbers $n$.
-/
theorem putnam_1970_b5
(ramp : ℤ → (ℝ → ℝ))
(ramp_def : ramp = fun (n : ℤ) => (fun (x : ℝ) => if x ≤ -n then (-n : ℝ) else (if -n < x ∧ x ≤ n then x else (n : ℝ))))
(F : ℝ → ℝ)
: Continuous F ↔ (∀ n : ℕ, Continuous ((ramp n) ∘ F)) :=
sorry

title: putnam_1970_b5
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1970_b5:
;; a real function is continuous exactly when every natural-number clamp
;; composed with it is continuous. This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))

;; Conservative generic symbols present an arbitrary scalar function on an
;; Archimedean linearly ordered additive group. This is the exact structure
;; used by the statement; neither completeness nor an APPLY$ function-object
;; encoding is needed.

(defstub p1970b5-scalar-p (x) t)
(defstub p1970b5-add (x y) t)
(defstub p1970b5-negate (x) t)
(defstub p1970b5-less (x y) t)
(defstub p1970b5-function (x) t)
(defstub p1970b5-archimedean-bound (x) t)

(defun p1970b5-member-p (x)
  (if (p1970b5-scalar-p x) t nil))

(defun p1970b5-less-p (x y)
  (if (p1970b5-less x y) t nil))

(defun p1970b5-less-equal-p (x y)
  (not (p1970b5-less-p y x)))

(defun p1970b5-subtract (x y)
  (p1970b5-add x (p1970b5-negate y)))

(defun p1970b5-absolute-value (zero x)
  (if (p1970b5-less-p x zero)
      (p1970b5-negate x)
    x))

(defun p1970b5-distance (zero x y)
  (p1970b5-absolute-value
   zero
   (p1970b5-subtract x y)))

(defun p1970b5-positive-p (zero x)
  (and
   (p1970b5-member-p x)
   (p1970b5-less-p zero x)))

(defun-sk p1970b5-additive-group-laws-p (zero)
  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (p1970b5-member-p x)
      (p1970b5-member-p y)
      (p1970b5-member-p z))
     (and
      (p1970b5-member-p (p1970b5-add x y))
      (p1970b5-member-p (p1970b5-negate x))
      (equal
       (p1970b5-add (p1970b5-add x y) z)
       (p1970b5-add x (p1970b5-add y z)))
      (equal
       (p1970b5-add x y)
       (p1970b5-add y x))
      (equal
       (p1970b5-add x zero)
       x)
      (equal
       (p1970b5-add x (p1970b5-negate x))
       zero)))))

(defun-sk p1970b5-order-laws-p ()
  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (p1970b5-member-p x)
      (p1970b5-member-p y)
      (p1970b5-member-p z))
     (and
      (not (p1970b5-less-p x x))
      (or
       (equal x y)
       (p1970b5-less-p x y)
       (p1970b5-less-p y x))
      (implies
       (and
        (p1970b5-less-p x y)
        (p1970b5-less-p y z))
       (p1970b5-less-p x z))
      (implies
       (p1970b5-less-p x y)
       (p1970b5-less-p
        (p1970b5-add x z)
        (p1970b5-add y z)))))))

(defun p1970b5-natural-value (zero one n)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix n)))
  (if (zp n)
      zero
    (p1970b5-add
     one
     (p1970b5-natural-value zero one (- n 1)))))

(defun-sk p1970b5-archimedean-law-p (zero one)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (p1970b5-member-p x)
     (and
      (natp (p1970b5-archimedean-bound x))
      (p1970b5-less-p
       x
       (p1970b5-natural-value
        zero one
        (p1970b5-archimedean-bound x)))))))

(defun p1970b5-archimedean-ordered-group-p (zero one)
  (and
   (p1970b5-member-p zero)
   (p1970b5-member-p one)
   (not (equal zero one))
   (p1970b5-additive-group-laws-p zero)
   (p1970b5-order-laws-p)
   (p1970b5-less-p zero one)
   (p1970b5-archimedean-law-p zero one)))

(defun-sk p1970b5-function-typed-p ()
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (p1970b5-member-p x)
     (p1970b5-member-p
      (p1970b5-function x)))))

(defun p1970b5-ramp-value (zero one n x)
  (let* ((bound
          (p1970b5-natural-value zero one n))
         (negative-bound
          (p1970b5-negate bound)))
    (if (p1970b5-less-equal-p x negative-bound)
        negative-bound
      (if (p1970b5-less-equal-p x bound)
          x
        bound))))

(defun p1970b5-observed-value (kind zero one n x)
  (if (equal kind :source)
      (p1970b5-function x)
    (p1970b5-ramp-value
     zero one n
     (p1970b5-function x))))

(defun-sk p1970b5-continuity-neighborhood-p
    (kind zero one n x epsilon delta)
  (forall (y)
    (implies
     (and
      (p1970b5-member-p y)
      (p1970b5-less-p
       (p1970b5-distance zero y x)
       delta))
     (p1970b5-less-p
      (p1970b5-distance
       zero
       (p1970b5-observed-value
        kind zero one n y)
       (p1970b5-observed-value
        kind zero one n x))
      epsilon))))

(defun-sk p1970b5-continuity-radius-exists-p
    (kind zero one n x epsilon)
  (exists (delta)
    (and
     (p1970b5-positive-p zero delta)
     (p1970b5-continuity-neighborhood-p
      kind zero one n x epsilon delta))))

(defun-sk p1970b5-continuous-p
    (kind zero one n)
  (forall (x epsilon)
    (implies
     (and
      (p1970b5-member-p x)
      (p1970b5-positive-p zero epsilon))
     (p1970b5-continuity-radius-exists-p
      kind zero one n x epsilon))))

(defun-sk p1970b5-all-ramp-compositions-continuous-p
    (zero one)
  (forall (n)
    (implies
     (natp n)
     (p1970b5-continuous-p
      :ramp zero one n))))

(defun putnambench-putnam-1970-b5-statement
    (zero one)
  (implies
   (and
    (p1970b5-archimedean-ordered-group-p
     zero one)
    (p1970b5-function-typed-p))
   (iff
    (p1970b5-continuous-p
     :source zero one 0)
    (p1970b5-all-ramp-compositions-continuous-p
     zero one))))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

title: putnam_1970_b5
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1970_b5:
-- continuity of a real function is equivalent to continuity of all its
-- compositions with natural-threshold clipping maps. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; _*_)

infix 4 _!=_
infixr 3 _and_
infix 2 _iff_

data Bottom : Set where

Not : Set -> Set
Not A =
  A -> Bottom

_!=_ : {A : Set} -> A -> A -> Set
x != y =
  Not (x == y)

record _and_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data _or_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  left  : A -> A or B
  right : B -> A or B

record _iff_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor equivalence
  field
    forward  : A -> B
    backward : B -> A

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

record CompleteOrderedRealField (R : Set) : Set1 where
  field
    zeroR oneR : R
    add multiply : R -> R -> R
    negate inverse : R -> R
    lessOrEqual : R -> R -> Set
    fromNat : Nat -> R

    one-not-zero :
      oneR != zeroR

    add-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> add x y == add y x
    add-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      add (add x y) z == add x (add y z)
    add-zero :
      (x : R) -> add x zeroR == x
    add-inverse :
      (x : R) -> add x (negate x) == zeroR

    multiply-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> multiply x y == multiply y x
    multiply-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply (multiply x y) z ==
      multiply x (multiply y z)
    multiply-one :
      (x : R) -> multiply x oneR == x
    multiply-zero :
      (x : R) -> multiply x zeroR == zeroR
    distribute :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply x (add y z) ==
      add (multiply x y) (multiply x z)
    inverse-zero :
      inverse zeroR == zeroR
    multiply-inverse :
      (x : R) ->
      x != zeroR ->
      multiply x (inverse x) == oneR

    order-reflexive :
      (x : R) -> lessOrEqual x x
    order-transitive :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y z ->
      lessOrEqual x z
    order-antisymmetric :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y x ->
      x == y
    order-total :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y or lessOrEqual y x
    add-order :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual (add z x) (add z y)
    multiply-nonnegative :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR x ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR y ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR (multiply x y)
    zero-less-than-one :
      lessOrEqual zeroR oneR and zeroR != oneR

    fromNat-zero :
      fromNat zero == zeroR
    fromNat-successor :
      (n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (suc n) == add (fromNat n) oneR
    fromNat-addition :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m + n) == add (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-multiplication :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m * n) == multiply (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-injective :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat m == fromNat n ->
      m == n

    archimedean :
      (x : R) ->
      Exists Nat (\ n -> lessOrEqual x (fromNat n))
    least-upper-bound :
      (P : R -> Set) ->
      Exists R P ->
      Exists R
        (\ upper ->
          (x : R) ->
          P x ->
          lessOrEqual x upper) ->
      Exists R
        (\ supremum ->
          ((x : R) ->
            P x ->
            lessOrEqual x supremum)
          and
          ((upper : R) ->
            ((x : R) ->
              P x ->
              lessOrEqual x upper) ->
            lessOrEqual supremum upper))

open CompleteOrderedRealField

subtract :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
subtract reals x y =
  add reals x (negate reals y)

StrictLess :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
StrictLess reals x y =
  lessOrEqual reals x y and x != y

CloseTo :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
CloseTo reals center radius x =
  StrictLess reals
    (subtract reals center radius)
    x
  and
  StrictLess reals
    x
    (add reals center radius)

ContinuousAt :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (R -> R) ->
  R ->
  Set
ContinuousAt {R} reals function point =
  (epsilon : R) ->
  StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) epsilon ->
  Exists R
    (\ delta ->
      StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) delta
      and
      ((x : R) ->
        CloseTo reals point delta x ->
        CloseTo reals (function point) epsilon (function x)))

Continuous :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (R -> R) ->
  Set
Continuous {R} reals function =
  (point : R) ->
  ContinuousAt reals function point

DefinesRamp :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (Nat -> R -> R) ->
  Set
DefinesRamp {R} reals ramp =
  (n : Nat) ->
  (x : R) ->
  let
    threshold = fromNat reals n
    negativeThreshold = negate reals threshold
  in
  (lessOrEqual reals x negativeThreshold ->
    ramp n x == negativeThreshold)
  and
  ((StrictLess reals negativeThreshold x
    and
    lessOrEqual reals x threshold) ->
    ramp n x == x)
  and
  (StrictLess reals threshold x ->
    ramp n x == threshold)

putnam-1970-b5 : Set1
putnam-1970-b5 =
  (R : Set) ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) ->
  (ramp : Nat -> R -> R) ->
  DefinesRamp reals ramp ->
  (F : R -> R) ->
  Continuous reals F
  iff
  ((n : Nat) ->
    Continuous reals (\ x -> ramp n (F x)))

(*
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench artifact putnam_1970_b5:
  a real function is continuous if and only if all of its naturally indexed
  integer-level clipped compositions are continuous. This file contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open arithmeticTheory integerTheory pred_setTheory realTheory intrealTheory
     real_topologyTheory;

val putnam_1970_b5 =
  ``!ramp : int -> real -> real. !F : real -> real.
      ramp =
        (\n : int. \x : real.
           if x <= ~(real_of_int n) then
             ~(real_of_int n)
           else if ~(real_of_int n) < x /\ x <= real_of_int n then
             x
           else
             real_of_int n)
      ==>
      (F continuous_on UNIV <=>
       !n : num.
         (\x : real. ramp (int_of_num n) (F x)) continuous_on UNIV)``;

title: putnam_1970_b5
content:
$(
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact
  putnam_1970_b5: a real function is continuous exactly when every
  natural-level clamp composed with it is continuous. This file contains no
  proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  P70B5Ramp is the integer-indexed family of real clamp functions from the
  sources. Its nested conditional gives -n on x <= -n, gives x on
  -n < x <= n, and gives n otherwise. The final assertion quantifies over
  every total real function F and uses membership in ( RR -cn-> RR ) for
  global continuity.

  The ramp definition and final corpus statement are unproved $a
  declarations; this database contains no $p proof statement.
$)

$c P70B5Ramp $.

p70b5-ramp-syntax $a class P70B5Ramp $.

${
  $d n x $.

  p70b5-ramp-definition $a |- P70B5Ramp =
    (
      n e. ZZ |->
        (
          x e. RR |->
            if (
              x <_ ( -u n ) ,
              ( -u n ) ,
              if (
                ( ( -u n ) < x /\ x <_ n ) ,
                x ,
                n
              )
            )
        )
    )
  $.
$}

${
  $d F n $.

  putnambench-putnam-1970-b5 $a |-
    A. F e. ( RR ^m RR )
      (
        F e. ( RR -cn-> RR )
        <->
        A. n e. NN0
          ( ( ( P70B5Ramp ` n ) o. F ) e. ( RR -cn-> RR ) )
      )
  $.
$}

environ

::$P-
theorem

      F being Function of REAL,REAL st
    (for n being Integer, x being Real holds
      (0 <= n implies

title: putnam_1970_b5
content:
% Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench artifact putnam_1970_b5:
% continuity of a real function is equivalent to continuity after composition
% with every natural-level clipping function. This file contains no proof.

putnam_1970_b5: THEORY
BEGIN
  real_function: TYPE = [real -> real]

  continuous(f: real_function): bool =
    FORALL (x: real), (epsilon_value: posreal):
      EXISTS (delta: posreal):
        FORALL (y: real):
          abs(y - x) < delta IMPLIES
            abs(f(y) - f(x)) < epsilon_value

  ramp(n: int): real_function =
    LET bound: real = n :: real
    IN
      LAMBDA (x: real):
        IF x <= -bound THEN
          -bound
        ELSIF -bound < x AND x <= bound THEN
          x
        ELSE
          bound
        ENDIF

  compose(g, f: real_function): real_function =
    LAMBDA (x: real): g(f(x))

  putnam_1970_b5: bool =
    FORALL (F: real_function):
      continuous(F)
        IFF
          FORALL (n: nat):
            continuous(compose(ramp(n), F))
END putnam_1970_b5
