import Mathlib

open Metric Set EuclideanGeometry Filter Topology

/--
Prove that if a quadrilateral with side lengths $a$, $b$, $c$, and $d$ and area $\sqrt{abcd}$ can be circumscribed to a circle (i.e., a circle can be inscribed in it), then it must be cyclic (i.e., it can be inscribed in a circle).
-/
theorem putnam_1970_b6
(L : ZMod 4 → (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)))
(S : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)))
(S_def : S = {L i | i : ZMod 4})
(hSquad : S.ncard = 4 ∧ ∀ s ⊆ S, s.ncard = 3 → ¬ Collinear ℝ s)
(hlens : dist (L 0) (L 1) > 0 ∧ dist (L 1) (L 2) > 0 ∧ dist (L 2) (L 3) > 0 ∧ dist (L 3) (L 0) > 0)
(horder : ∀ i : ZMod 4, segment ℝ (L i) (L (i + 1)) ∩ interior (convexHull ℝ S) = ∅)
(hcircum : ∃ (O: EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) (r : ℝ), O ∈ convexHull ℝ S ∧ r > 0 ∧ ∀ i : ZMod 4,
∃! I : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), Collinear ℝ {I, L i, L (i + 1)} ∧ dist O I = r)
(harea : (MeasureTheory.volume (convexHull ℝ S)).toReal =
Real.sqrt (dist (L 0) (L 1) * dist (L 1) (L 2) * dist (L 2) (L 3) * dist (L 3) (L 0)))
: Cospherical S :=
sorry

title: putnam_1970_b6
content:
(* Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench artifact putnam_1970_b6:
   a nondegenerate ordered quadrilateral tangent to an inscribed circle and
   having area equal to the square root of the product of its side lengths is
   cyclic. This file contains no proof. *)

From Stdlib Require Import Reals List.

Open Scope R_scope.

Inductive index4 : Type :=
| index0
| index1
| index2
| index3.

Definition next_index (i : index4) : index4 :=
  match i with
  | index0 => index1
  | index1 => index2
  | index2 => index3
  | index3 => index0
  end.

Definition point := (R * R)%type.
Definition point_set := point -> Prop.

Definition point_distance (p q : point) : R :=
  sqrt ((fst p - fst q) ^ 2 + (snd p - snd q) ^ 2).

Definition point_affine_combination
    (t : R) (p q : point) : point :=
  ((1 - t) * fst p + t * fst q,
   (1 - t) * snd p + t * snd q).

Definition subset (A B : point_set) : Prop :=
  forall p : point, A p -> B p.

Definition same_set (A B : point_set) : Prop :=
  forall p : point, A p <-> B p.

Definition convex (A : point_set) : Prop :=
  forall (p q : point) (t : R),
    A p ->
    A q ->
    0 <= t <= 1 ->
    A (point_affine_combination t p q).

Definition convex_hull (A : point_set) : point_set :=
  fun p : point =>
    forall C : point_set,
      convex C ->
      subset A C ->
      C p.

Definition interior (A : point_set) : point_set :=
  fun p : point =>
    exists epsilon : R,
      0 < epsilon /\
      forall q : point,
        point_distance q p < epsilon ->
        A q.

Definition closed_segment (p q : point) : point_set :=
  fun x : point =>
    exists t : R,
      0 <= t <= 1 /\
      x = point_affine_combination t p q.

Definition collinear_points (p q r : point) : Prop :=
  (fst q - fst p) * (snd r - snd p) =
  (snd q - snd p) * (fst r - fst p).

Definition collinear (A : point_set) : Prop :=
  forall p q r : point,
    A p ->
    A q ->
    A r ->
    collinear_points p q r.

Definition vertex_set (L : index4 -> point) : point_set :=
  fun p : point => exists i : index4, p = L i.

Definition has_cardinality (A : point_set) (n : nat) : Prop :=
  exists enumeration : list point,
    NoDup enumeration /\
    length enumeration = n /\
    forall p : point, In p enumeration <-> A p.

Record open_rectangle : Type := {
  rectangle_x_lower : R;
  rectangle_x_upper : R;
  rectangle_y_lower : R;
  rectangle_y_upper : R
}.

Definition in_open_rectangle
    (rectangle : open_rectangle) (p : point) : Prop :=
  rectangle_x_lower rectangle < fst p <
    rectangle_x_upper rectangle /\
  rectangle_y_lower rectangle < snd p <
    rectangle_y_upper rectangle.

Definition rectangle_area (rectangle : open_rectangle) : R :=
  Rmax 0
    (rectangle_x_upper rectangle - rectangle_x_lower rectangle) *
  Rmax 0
    (rectangle_y_upper rectangle - rectangle_y_lower rectangle).

Definition rectangles_cover
    (A : point_set) (rectangles : nat -> open_rectangle) : Prop :=
  forall p : point,
    A p ->
    exists n : nat, in_open_rectangle (rectangles n) p.

Fixpoint partial_rectangle_area
    (rectangles : nat -> open_rectangle) (n : nat) : R :=
  match n with
  | O => 0
  | S k =>
      partial_rectangle_area rectangles k +
      rectangle_area (rectangles k)
  end.

(* This is the countable-open-rectangle characterization of planar Lebesgue
   outer measure. On a finite convex hull it equals planar Lebesgue measure. *)
Definition has_planar_lebesgue_measure
    (A : point_set) (area : R) : Prop :=
  0 <= area /\
  (forall rectangles : nat -> open_rectangle,
    rectangles_cover A rectangles ->
    forall lower : R,
      lower < area ->
      exists n : nat,
        lower < partial_rectangle_area rectangles n) /\
  (forall epsilon : R,
    0 < epsilon ->
    exists rectangles : nat -> open_rectangle,
      rectangles_cover A rectangles /\
      forall n : nat,
        partial_rectangle_area rectangles n < area + epsilon).

Theorem putnam_1970_b6
    (L : index4 -> point)
    (S : point_set)
    (S_def : same_set S (vertex_set L))
    (hSquad :
      has_cardinality S 4%nat /\
      forall s : point_set,
        subset s S ->
        has_cardinality s 3%nat ->
        ~ collinear s)
    (hlens :
      0 < point_distance (L index0) (L index1) /\
      0 < point_distance (L index1) (L index2) /\
      0 < point_distance (L index2) (L index3) /\
      0 < point_distance (L index3) (L index0))
    (horder :
      forall (i : index4) (p : point),
        closed_segment (L i) (L (next_index i)) p ->
        ~ interior (convex_hull S) p)
    (hcircum :
      exists (center : point) (radius : R),
        convex_hull S center /\
        0 < radius /\
        forall i : index4,
          exists! tangent : point,
            collinear_points
              tangent (L i) (L (next_index i)) /\
            point_distance center tangent = radius)
    (harea :
      has_planar_lebesgue_measure
        (convex_hull S)
        (sqrt
          (point_distance (L index0) (L index1) *
           point_distance (L index1) (L index2) *
           point_distance (L index2) (L index3) *
           point_distance (L index3) (L index0)))) :
  exists (center : point) (radius : R),
    forall p : point,
      S p ->
      point_distance p center = radius.
Admitted.

title: putnam_1970_b6
content:
theory putnam_1970_b6 imports Complex_Main
"HOL-Analysis.Lebesgue_Measure"
"HOL-Analysis.Elementary_Topology"
"HOL-Analysis.Linear_Algebra"
begin

(* Note: Boosts ZMod 4 to nat *)
theorem putnam_1970_b6:
  fixes L :: "nat \<Rightarrow> real^2"
    and S :: "(real^2) set"
  defines "S \<equiv> {L 0, L 1, L 2, L 3}"
  assumes hSquad : "card S = 4 \<and> (\<forall> s \<subseteq> S. card s = 3 \<longrightarrow> (\<not>collinear s))"
    and hlens : "dist (L 0) (L 1) > 0 \<and> dist (L 1) (L 2) > 0 \<and> dist (L 2) (L 3) > 0 \<and> dist (L 3) (L 0) > 0"
    and horder : "\<forall> i \<in> {0..3}. closed_segment (L i) (L ((i + 1) mod 4)) \<inter> interior (convex hull S) = {}"
    and hcircum : "\<exists> (center :: real^2) (r :: real). center \<in> convex hull S \<and> r > 0 \<and>
          (\<forall> i \<in> {0..3}. \<exists>! I :: real^2. collinear {I, L i, L ((i + 1) mod 4)} \<and> dist center I = r)"
    and harea : "emeasure lebesgue (convex hull S) = sqrt (dist (L 0) (L 1) * dist (L 1) (L 2) * dist (L 2) (L 3) * dist (L 3) (L 0))"
  shows "\<exists> center :: real^2. \<exists> radius :: real. \<forall> p \<in> S. dist p center = radius"
  sorry

end

title: putnam_1970_b6
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench artifact putnam_1970_b6:
  a nondegenerate ordered quadrilateral tangent to a common circle and having
  area equal to the square root of the product of its side lengths is cyclic.
  This file contains no proof.
*)

let statement =
  `let edist =
     \(x:real#real) (y:real#real).
       sqrt ((FST x - FST y) pow 2 + (SND x - SND y) pow 2) in
   let collinear3 =
     \(x:real#real) (y:real#real) (z:real#real).
       (FST y - FST x) * (SND z - SND x) =
       (SND y - SND x) * (FST z - FST x) in
   let collinear_set =
     \(s:(real#real)->bool).
       !x y z:real#real.
         x IN s /\ y IN s /\ z IN s ==> collinear3 x y z in
   let segment =
     \(a:real#real) (b:real#real) (x:real#real).
       ?t:real.
         &0 <= t /\ t <= &1 /\
         FST x = (&1 - t) * FST a + t * FST b /\
         SND x = (&1 - t) * SND a + t * SND b in
   let quadrilateral_hull =
     \(L:num->real#real) (x:real#real).
       ?a0 a1 a2 a3:real.
         &0 <= a0 /\ &0 <= a1 /\ &0 <= a2 /\ &0 <= a3 /\
         a0 + a1 + a2 + a3 = &1 /\
         FST x =
           a0 * FST (L 0) + a1 * FST (L 1) +
           a2 * FST (L 2) + a3 * FST (L 3) /\
         SND x =
           a0 * SND (L 0) + a1 * SND (L 1) +
           a2 * SND (L 2) + a3 * SND (L 3) in
   let hull_interior =
     \(L:num->real#real) (x:real#real).
       ?e:real.
         &0 < e /\
         !y:real#real. edist x y < e ==> quadrilateral_hull L y in
   let quadrilateral_area =
     \(L:num->real#real).
       abs
         (FST (L 0) * SND (L 1) - SND (L 0) * FST (L 1) +
          FST (L 1) * SND (L 2) - SND (L 1) * FST (L 2) +
          FST (L 2) * SND (L 3) - SND (L 2) * FST (L 3) +
          FST (L 3) * SND (L 0) - SND (L 3) * FST (L 0)) / &2 in
   !L:num->real#real. !S:(real#real)->bool.
     S = {L 0,L 1,L 2,L 3} /\
     CARD S = 4 /\
     (!s:(real#real)->bool.
        s SUBSET S /\ CARD s = 3 ==> ~collinear_set s) /\
     edist (L 0) (L 1) > &0 /\
     edist (L 1) (L 2) > &0 /\
     edist (L 2) (L 3) > &0 /\
     edist (L 3) (L 0) > &0 /\
     (!i:num.
        i < 4
        ==> ~(?x:real#real.
                segment (L i) (L ((i + 1) MOD 4)) x /\
                hull_interior L x)) /\
     (?O:real#real. ?r:real.
        quadrilateral_hull L O /\ r > &0 /\
        (!i:num.
           i < 4
           ==> (?!q:real#real.
                  collinear3 q (L i) (L ((i + 1) MOD 4)) /\
                  edist O q = r))) /\
     quadrilateral_area L =
       sqrt
         (edist (L 0) (L 1) * edist (L 1) (L 2) *
          edist (L 2) (L 3) * edist (L 3) (L 0))
     ==> ?center:real#real. ?radius:real.
           !p:real#real. p IN S ==> edist p center = radius`;;

title: putnam_1970_b6
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1970_b6:
;; a tangential real-plane quadrilateral whose area is the square root of the
;; product of its side lengths is cyclic. This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))

;; The scalar stubs below present an arbitrary real closed ordered field.  All
;; field, order, square-root, and odd-degree-root laws are explicit hypotheses
;; of the statement predicate.  This preserves arbitrary real coordinates:
;; the reals are one such field, and real closed fields have the same
;; first-order theory.
;;
;; The four point arguments are definitionally the values of L on ZMod 4, and
;; pairwise distinctness makes their image exactly S.  Under the source
;; no-three-collinear hypothesis, the boundary-segment condition is equivalent
;; to the four points occurring in one of the two cyclic orientations.
;; Convex-hull membership is then the corresponding four half-plane tests.
;;
;; Euclidean distances are represented by their squared coordinate formulas.
;; Every length variable below is internally existential and constrained to be
;; the unique nonnegative square root.  The shoelace formula gives twice the
;; convex-hull area in cyclic order.  The incircle and circumcircle centers,
;; radii, and tangent points all remain internally quantified.

(defstub p70b6-scalar-p (x) t)
(defstub p70b6-add (x y) t)
(defstub p70b6-mul (x y) t)
(defstub p70b6-neg (x) t)
(defstub p70b6-inv (x) t)
(defstub p70b6-less (x y) t)
(defstub p70b6-square-root (x) t)
(defstub p70b6-odd-root (coefficients) t)

(defun p70b6-member-p (x)
  (if (p70b6-scalar-p x) t nil))

(defun p70b6-less-p (x y)
  (if (p70b6-less x y) t nil))

(defun p70b6-nonnegative-p (zero x)
  (and
   (p70b6-member-p x)
   (not (p70b6-less-p x zero))))

(defun p70b6-sub (x y)
  (p70b6-add x (p70b6-neg y)))

(defun p70b6-square (x)
  (p70b6-mul x x))

(defun p70b6-polynomial-coefficients-p (coefficients)
  (if (consp coefficients)
      (and
       (p70b6-member-p (car coefficients))
       (p70b6-polynomial-coefficients-p (cdr coefficients)))
    (equal coefficients nil)))

;; Coefficients are in ascending degree order.
(defun p70b6-polynomial-p (zero coefficients)
  (and
   (true-listp coefficients)
   (consp coefficients)
   (p70b6-polynomial-coefficients-p coefficients)
   (or
    (equal (len coefficients) 1)
    (not (equal (car (last coefficients)) zero)))))

(defun p70b6-polynomial-eval (zero coefficients x)
  (if (consp coefficients)
      (p70b6-add
       (car coefficients)
       (p70b6-mul
        x
        (p70b6-polynomial-eval
         zero (cdr coefficients) x)))
    zero))

(defun-sk p70b6-field-laws-p (zero one)
  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (p70b6-member-p x)
      (p70b6-member-p y)
      (p70b6-member-p z))
     (and
      (p70b6-member-p (p70b6-add x y))
      (p70b6-member-p (p70b6-mul x y))
      (p70b6-member-p (p70b6-neg x))
      (p70b6-member-p (p70b6-inv x))
      (equal
       (p70b6-add (p70b6-add x y) z)
       (p70b6-add x (p70b6-add y z)))
      (equal
       (p70b6-mul (p70b6-mul x y) z)
       (p70b6-mul x (p70b6-mul y z)))
      (equal (p70b6-add x y) (p70b6-add y x))
      (equal (p70b6-mul x y) (p70b6-mul y x))
      (equal (p70b6-add x zero) x)
      (equal (p70b6-add x (p70b6-neg x)) zero)
      (equal (p70b6-mul x one) x)
      (implies
       (equal x zero)
       (equal (p70b6-inv x) zero))
      (implies
       (not (equal x zero))
       (equal (p70b6-mul x (p70b6-inv x)) one))
      (equal
       (p70b6-mul x (p70b6-add y z))
       (p70b6-add
        (p70b6-mul x y)
        (p70b6-mul x z)))))))

(defun-sk p70b6-order-laws-p (zero)
  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (p70b6-member-p x)
      (p70b6-member-p y)
      (p70b6-member-p z))
     (and
      (not (p70b6-less-p x x))
      (or
       (p70b6-less-p x y)
       (equal x y)
       (p70b6-less-p y x))
      (implies
       (and
        (p70b6-less-p x y)
        (p70b6-less-p y z))
       (p70b6-less-p x z))
      (implies
       (p70b6-less-p x y)
       (p70b6-less-p
        (p70b6-add x z)
        (p70b6-add y z)))
      (implies
       (and
        (p70b6-less-p zero x)
        (p70b6-less-p zero y))
       (p70b6-less-p
        zero
        (p70b6-mul x y)))))))

(defun-sk p70b6-square-root-laws-p (zero)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (p70b6-nonnegative-p zero x)
     (and
      (p70b6-nonnegative-p
       zero (p70b6-square-root x))
      (equal
       (p70b6-square (p70b6-square-root x))
       x)))))

(defun-sk p70b6-odd-root-laws-p (zero)
  (forall (coefficients)
    (implies
     (and
      (p70b6-polynomial-p zero coefficients)
      (evenp (len coefficients)))
     (and
      (p70b6-member-p
       (p70b6-odd-root coefficients))
      (equal
       (p70b6-polynomial-eval
        zero
        coefficients
        (p70b6-odd-root coefficients))
       zero)))))

(defun p70b6-real-closed-field-p (zero one)
  (and
   (p70b6-member-p zero)
   (p70b6-member-p one)
   (not (equal zero one))
   (p70b6-less-p zero one)
   (p70b6-field-laws-p zero one)
   (p70b6-order-laws-p zero)
   (p70b6-square-root-laws-p zero)
   (p70b6-odd-root-laws-p zero)))

(defun p70b6-point-p (point)
  (and
   (true-listp point)
   (equal (len point) 2)
   (p70b6-member-p (nth 0 point))
   (p70b6-member-p (nth 1 point))))

(defun p70b6-distance-squared (left right)
  (p70b6-add
   (p70b6-square
    (p70b6-sub (nth 0 left) (nth 0 right)))
   (p70b6-square
    (p70b6-sub (nth 1 left) (nth 1 right)))))

(defun p70b6-orientation (a b c)
  (p70b6-sub
   (p70b6-mul
    (p70b6-sub (nth 0 b) (nth 0 a))
    (p70b6-sub (nth 1 c) (nth 1 a)))
   (p70b6-mul
    (p70b6-sub (nth 1 b) (nth 1 a))
    (p70b6-sub (nth 0 c) (nth 0 a)))))

(defun p70b6-four-distinct-p (l0 l1 l2 l3)
  (and
   (not (equal l0 l1))
   (not (equal l0 l2))
   (not (equal l0 l3))
   (not (equal l1 l2))
   (not (equal l1 l3))
   (not (equal l2 l3))))

(defun p70b6-general-position-p (zero l0 l1 l2 l3)
  (and
   (not (equal (p70b6-orientation l0 l1 l2) zero))
   (not (equal (p70b6-orientation l0 l1 l3) zero))
   (not (equal (p70b6-orientation l0 l2 l3) zero))
   (not (equal (p70b6-orientation l1 l2 l3) zero))))

(defun p70b6-positive-cyclic-order-p (zero l0 l1 l2 l3)
  (and
   (p70b6-less-p
    zero (p70b6-orientation l0 l1 l2))
   (p70b6-less-p
    zero (p70b6-orientation l1 l2 l3))
   (p70b6-less-p
    zero (p70b6-orientation l2 l3 l0))
   (p70b6-less-p
    zero (p70b6-orientation l3 l0 l1))))

(defun p70b6-negative-cyclic-order-p (zero l0 l1 l2 l3)
  (and
   (p70b6-less-p
    (p70b6-orientation l0 l1 l2) zero)
   (p70b6-less-p
    (p70b6-orientation l1 l2 l3) zero)
   (p70b6-less-p
    (p70b6-orientation l2 l3 l0) zero)
   (p70b6-less-p
    (p70b6-orientation l3 l0 l1) zero)))

(defun p70b6-boundary-order-p (zero l0 l1 l2 l3)
  (or
   (p70b6-positive-cyclic-order-p
    zero l0 l1 l2 l3)
   (p70b6-negative-cyclic-order-p
    zero l0 l1 l2 l3)))

(defun p70b6-positive-side-lengths-p
    (zero l0 l1 l2 l3)
  (and
   (p70b6-less-p
    zero (p70b6-distance-squared l0 l1))
   (p70b6-less-p
    zero (p70b6-distance-squared l1 l2))
   (p70b6-less-p
    zero (p70b6-distance-squared l2 l3))
   (p70b6-less-p
    zero (p70b6-distance-squared l3 l0))))

(defun p70b6-center-in-hull-p
    (zero center l0 l1 l2 l3)
  (if (p70b6-positive-cyclic-order-p
       zero l0 l1 l2 l3)
      (and
       (p70b6-nonnegative-p
        zero (p70b6-orientation l0 l1 center))
       (p70b6-nonnegative-p
        zero (p70b6-orientation l1 l2 center))
       (p70b6-nonnegative-p
        zero (p70b6-orientation l2 l3 center))
       (p70b6-nonnegative-p
        zero (p70b6-orientation l3 l0 center)))
    (and
     (p70b6-nonnegative-p
      zero (p70b6-neg
            (p70b6-orientation l0 l1 center)))
     (p70b6-nonnegative-p
      zero (p70b6-neg
            (p70b6-orientation l1 l2 center)))
     (p70b6-nonnegative-p
      zero (p70b6-neg
            (p70b6-orientation l2 l3 center)))
     (p70b6-nonnegative-p
      zero (p70b6-neg
            (p70b6-orientation l3 l0 center))))))

(defun p70b6-tangent-point-p
    (zero center radius a b point)
  (and
   (p70b6-point-p point)
   (equal (p70b6-orientation a b point) zero)
   (equal
    (p70b6-distance-squared center point)
    (p70b6-square radius))))

(defun-sk p70b6-tangent-point-exists-p
    (zero center radius a b)
  (exists (point)
    (p70b6-tangent-point-p
     zero center radius a b point)))

(defun-sk p70b6-tangent-point-unique-p
    (zero center radius a b)
  (forall (left right)
    (implies
     (and
      (p70b6-tangent-point-p
       zero center radius a b left)
      (p70b6-tangent-point-p
       zero center radius a b right))
     (equal left right))))

(defun p70b6-side-tangent-p
    (zero center radius a b)
  (and
   (p70b6-tangent-point-exists-p
    zero center radius a b)
   (p70b6-tangent-point-unique-p
    zero center radius a b)))

(defun-sk p70b6-incircle-exists-p
    (zero l0 l1 l2 l3)
  (exists (center radius)
    (and
     (p70b6-point-p center)
     (p70b6-member-p radius)
     (p70b6-less-p zero radius)
     (p70b6-center-in-hull-p
      zero center l0 l1 l2 l3)
     (p70b6-side-tangent-p
      zero center radius l0 l1)
     (p70b6-side-tangent-p
      zero center radius l1 l2)
     (p70b6-side-tangent-p
      zero center radius l2 l3)
     (p70b6-side-tangent-p
      zero center radius l3 l0))))

(defun p70b6-origin-cross (a b)
  (p70b6-sub
   (p70b6-mul (nth 0 a) (nth 1 b))
   (p70b6-mul (nth 1 a) (nth 0 b))))

(defun p70b6-twice-signed-area (l0 l1 l2 l3)
  (p70b6-add
   (p70b6-origin-cross l0 l1)
   (p70b6-add
    (p70b6-origin-cross l1 l2)
    (p70b6-add
     (p70b6-origin-cross l2 l3)
     (p70b6-origin-cross l3 l0)))))

(defun p70b6-absolute-value (zero x)
  (if (p70b6-less-p x zero)
      (p70b6-neg x)
    x))

(defun p70b6-length-value-p (zero a b length)
  (and
   (p70b6-nonnegative-p zero length)
   (equal
    (p70b6-square length)
    (p70b6-distance-squared a b))))

(defun p70b6-area-value-p
    (zero one l0 l1 l2 l3 area)
  (and
   (p70b6-nonnegative-p zero area)
   (equal
    (p70b6-mul
     (p70b6-add one one)
     area)
    (p70b6-absolute-value
     zero
     (p70b6-twice-signed-area
      l0 l1 l2 l3)))))

(defun p70b6-square-root-value-p (zero value root)
  (and
   (p70b6-nonnegative-p zero root)
   (equal (p70b6-square root) value)))

(defun-sk p70b6-area-identity-p
    (zero one l0 l1 l2 l3)
  (exists (a b c d area root)
    (and
     (p70b6-length-value-p zero l0 l1 a)
     (p70b6-length-value-p zero l1 l2 b)
     (p70b6-length-value-p zero l2 l3 c)
     (p70b6-length-value-p zero l3 l0 d)
     (p70b6-area-value-p
      zero one l0 l1 l2 l3 area)
     (p70b6-square-root-value-p
      zero
      (p70b6-mul
       a
       (p70b6-mul
        b
        (p70b6-mul c d)))
      root)
     (equal area root))))

(defun-sk p70b6-cospherical-p
    (zero l0 l1 l2 l3)
  (exists (center radius)
    (and
     (p70b6-point-p center)
     (p70b6-nonnegative-p zero radius)
     (equal
      (p70b6-distance-squared l0 center)
      (p70b6-square radius))
     (equal
      (p70b6-distance-squared l1 center)
      (p70b6-square radius))
     (equal
      (p70b6-distance-squared l2 center)
      (p70b6-square radius))
     (equal
      (p70b6-distance-squared l3 center)
      (p70b6-square radius)))))

(defun putnambench-putnam-1970-b6-statement
    (zero one l0 l1 l2 l3)
  (implies
   (and
    (p70b6-real-closed-field-p zero one)
    (p70b6-point-p l0)
    (p70b6-point-p l1)
    (p70b6-point-p l2)
    (p70b6-point-p l3)
    (p70b6-four-distinct-p l0 l1 l2 l3)
    (p70b6-general-position-p
     zero l0 l1 l2 l3)
    (p70b6-positive-side-lengths-p
     zero l0 l1 l2 l3)
    (p70b6-boundary-order-p
     zero l0 l1 l2 l3)
    (p70b6-incircle-exists-p
     zero l0 l1 l2 l3)
    (p70b6-area-identity-p
     zero one l0 l1 l2 l3))
   (p70b6-cospherical-p
    zero l0 l1 l2 l3)))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

title: putnam_1970_b6
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1970_b6:
-- an ordered nondegenerate quadrilateral tangent to an interior circle and
-- having area equal to the square root of the product of its side lengths is
-- cyclic. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; _*_)

infix 4 _!=_
infixr 3 _and_
infixr 2 _or_

data Bottom : Set where

Not : Set -> Set
Not A =
  A -> Bottom

_!=_ : {A : Set} -> A -> A -> Set
x != y =
  Not (x == y)

record _and_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data _or_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  left  : A -> A or B
  right : B -> A or B

record Iff (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor iff
  field
    forward  : A -> B
    backward : B -> A

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

record ExistsUnique (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor unique-witness
  field
    value      : A
    property   : P value
    uniqueness : (other : A) -> P other -> other == value

record CompleteOrderedRealField (R : Set) : Set1 where
  field
    zeroR oneR : R
    add multiply : R -> R -> R
    negate inverse squareRoot : R -> R
    lessOrEqual : R -> R -> Set
    fromNat : Nat -> R

    one-not-zero :
      oneR != zeroR

    add-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> add x y == add y x
    add-associative :
      (x y z : R) -> add (add x y) z == add x (add y z)
    add-zero :
      (x : R) -> add x zeroR == x
    add-inverse :
      (x : R) -> add x (negate x) == zeroR

    multiply-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> multiply x y == multiply y x
    multiply-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply (multiply x y) z == multiply x (multiply y z)
    multiply-one :
      (x : R) -> multiply x oneR == x
    multiply-zero :
      (x : R) -> multiply x zeroR == zeroR
    distribute :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply x (add y z) ==
      add (multiply x y) (multiply x z)
    inverse-zero :
      inverse zeroR == zeroR
    multiply-inverse :
      (x : R) ->
      x != zeroR ->
      multiply x (inverse x) == oneR

    order-reflexive :
      (x : R) -> lessOrEqual x x
    order-transitive :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y z ->
      lessOrEqual x z
    order-antisymmetric :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y x ->
      x == y
    order-total :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y or lessOrEqual y x
    add-order :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual (add z x) (add z y)
    multiply-nonnegative :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR x ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR y ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR (multiply x y)
    zero-less-than-one :
      lessOrEqual zeroR oneR and zeroR != oneR

    fromNat-zero :
      fromNat zero == zeroR
    fromNat-successor :
      (n : Nat) -> fromNat (suc n) == add (fromNat n) oneR
    fromNat-addition :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m + n) == add (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-multiplication :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m * n) == multiply (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-injective :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat m == fromNat n ->
      m == n

    archimedean :
      (x : R) ->
      Exists Nat (\ n -> lessOrEqual x (fromNat n))
    least-upper-bound :
      (P : R -> Set) ->
      Exists R P ->
      Exists R
        (\ upper ->
          (x : R) ->
          P x ->
          lessOrEqual x upper) ->
      Exists R
        (\ supremum ->
          ((x : R) ->
            P x ->
            lessOrEqual x supremum)
          and
          ((upper : R) ->
            ((x : R) ->
              P x ->
              lessOrEqual x upper) ->
            lessOrEqual supremum upper))

    square-root-nonnegative :
      (x : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR (squareRoot x)
    square-root-square :
      (x : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR x ->
      multiply (squareRoot x) (squareRoot x) == x
    square-root-nonpositive :
      (x : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x zeroR ->
      squareRoot x == zeroR
    square-root-unique :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR y ->
      multiply y y == x ->
      y == squareRoot x

open CompleteOrderedRealField

subtract :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
subtract reals x y =
  add reals x (negate reals y)

square :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R
square reals x =
  multiply reals x x

two :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R
two reals =
  add reals (oneR reals) (oneR reals)

half :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R
half reals =
  inverse reals (two reals)

StrictLess :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
StrictLess reals x y =
  lessOrEqual reals x y and x != y

Nonnegative :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  Set
Nonnegative reals x =
  lessOrEqual reals (zeroR reals) x

record Point (R : Set) : Set where
  constructor point
  field
    x-coordinate : R
    y-coordinate : R

open Point

PointEqual :
  {R : Set} ->
  Point R ->
  Point R ->
  Set
PointEqual p q =
  x-coordinate p == x-coordinate q
  and
  y-coordinate p == y-coordinate q

squaredDistance :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Point R ->
  Point R ->
  R
squaredDistance reals p q =
  add reals
    (square reals
      (subtract reals (x-coordinate p) (x-coordinate q)))
    (square reals
      (subtract reals (y-coordinate p) (y-coordinate q)))

distance :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Point R ->
  Point R ->
  R
distance reals p q =
  squareRoot reals (squaredDistance reals p q)

affinePoint :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  Point R ->
  Point R ->
  Point R
affinePoint reals t p q =
  point
    (add reals
      (multiply reals
        (subtract reals (oneR reals) t)
        (x-coordinate p))
      (multiply reals t (x-coordinate q)))
    (add reals
      (multiply reals
        (subtract reals (oneR reals) t)
        (y-coordinate p))
      (multiply reals t (y-coordinate q)))

determinant :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Point R ->
  Point R ->
  Point R ->
  R
determinant reals a b c =
  subtract reals
    (multiply reals
      (subtract reals (x-coordinate b) (x-coordinate a))
      (subtract reals (y-coordinate c) (y-coordinate a)))
    (multiply reals
      (subtract reals (y-coordinate b) (y-coordinate a))
      (subtract reals (x-coordinate c) (x-coordinate a)))

Collinear :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Point R ->
  Point R ->
  Point R ->
  Set
Collinear reals a b c =
  determinant reals a b c == zeroR reals

Predicate : Set -> Set1
Predicate A =
  A -> Set

SameSet :
  {A : Set} ->
  Predicate A ->
  Predicate A ->
  Set
SameSet {A} S T =
  (x : A) -> Iff (S x) (T x)

data Fin4 : Set where
  i0 i1 i2 i3 : Fin4

next4 : Fin4 -> Fin4
next4 i0 = i1
next4 i1 = i2
next4 i2 = i3
next4 i3 = i0

sum4 :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (Fin4 -> R) ->
  R
sum4 reals values =
  add reals
    (add reals (values i0) (values i1))
    (add reals (values i2) (values i3))

weightedPoint4 :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (Fin4 -> R) ->
  (Fin4 -> Point R) ->
  Point R
weightedPoint4 reals weights vertices =
  point
    (sum4 reals
      (\ i ->
        multiply reals
          (weights i)
          (x-coordinate (vertices i))))
    (sum4 reals
      (\ i ->
        multiply reals
          (weights i)
          (y-coordinate (vertices i))))

VertexSet :
  {R : Set} ->
  (Fin4 -> Point R) ->
  Predicate (Point R)
VertexSet vertices p =
  Exists Fin4 (\ i -> p == vertices i)

PairwiseDistinct :
  {R : Set} ->
  (Fin4 -> Point R) ->
  Set
PairwiseDistinct vertices =
  (i j : Fin4) ->
  i != j ->
  vertices i != vertices j

NoThreeCollinear :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Predicate (Point R) ->
  Set
NoThreeCollinear {R} reals S =
  (a b c : Point R) ->
  S a ->
  S b ->
  S c ->
  a != b ->
  b != c ->
  c != a ->
  Not (Collinear reals a b c)

ExactlyFourNoncollinear :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Predicate (Point R) ->
  Set
ExactlyFourNoncollinear {R} reals S =
  Exists (Fin4 -> Point R)
    (\ vertices ->
      PairwiseDistinct vertices
      and
      SameSet S (VertexSet vertices))
  and
  NoThreeCollinear reals S

ConvexHull4 :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (Fin4 -> Point R) ->
  Point R ->
  Set
ConvexHull4 {R} reals vertices p =
  Exists (Fin4 -> R)
    (\ weights ->
      ((i : Fin4) -> Nonnegative reals (weights i))
      and
      sum4 reals weights == oneR reals
      and
      PointEqual p (weightedPoint4 reals weights vertices))

ClosedSegment :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Point R ->
  Point R ->
  Point R ->
  Set
ClosedSegment {R} reals p q x =
  Exists R
    (\ t ->
      lessOrEqual reals (zeroR reals) t
      and
      lessOrEqual reals t (oneR reals)
      and
      PointEqual x (affinePoint reals t p q))

InteriorOfConvexHull4 :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (Fin4 -> Point R) ->
  Point R ->
  Set
InteriorOfConvexHull4 {R} reals vertices p =
  Exists R
    (\ epsilon ->
      StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) epsilon
      and
      ((q : Point R) ->
        StrictLess reals (distance reals p q) epsilon ->
        ConvexHull4 reals vertices q))

EdgesAvoidInterior :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (Fin4 -> Point R) ->
  Set
EdgesAvoidInterior {R} reals vertices =
  (i : Fin4) ->
  (p : Point R) ->
  ClosedSegment reals (vertices i) (vertices (next4 i)) p ->
  Not (InteriorOfConvexHull4 reals vertices p)

CircumscribedAboutCircle :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (Fin4 -> Point R) ->
  Set
CircumscribedAboutCircle {R} reals vertices =
  Exists (Point R)
    (\ center ->
      Exists R
        (\ radius ->
          ConvexHull4 reals vertices center
          and
          StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) radius
          and
          ((i : Fin4) ->
            ExistsUnique (Point R)
              (\ contact ->
                Collinear reals
                  contact
                  (vertices i)
                  (vertices (next4 i))
                and
                distance reals center contact == radius))))

cross :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Point R ->
  Point R ->
  R
cross reals p q =
  subtract reals
    (multiply reals (x-coordinate p) (y-coordinate q))
    (multiply reals (y-coordinate p) (x-coordinate q))

signedDoubleArea4 :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (Fin4 -> Point R) ->
  R
signedDoubleArea4 reals vertices =
  add reals
    (add reals
      (cross reals (vertices i0) (vertices i1))
      (cross reals (vertices i1) (vertices i2)))
    (add reals
      (cross reals (vertices i2) (vertices i3))
      (cross reals (vertices i3) (vertices i0)))

convexQuadrilateralArea :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (Fin4 -> Point R) ->
  R
convexQuadrilateralArea reals vertices =
  multiply reals
    (half reals)
    (squareRoot reals
      (square reals (signedDoubleArea4 reals vertices)))

sideLengthProduct :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (Fin4 -> Point R) ->
  R
sideLengthProduct reals vertices =
  multiply reals
    (multiply reals
      (multiply reals
        (distance reals (vertices i0) (vertices i1))
        (distance reals (vertices i1) (vertices i2)))
      (distance reals (vertices i2) (vertices i3)))
    (distance reals (vertices i3) (vertices i0))

PositiveSideLengths :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (Fin4 -> Point R) ->
  Set
PositiveSideLengths reals vertices =
  StrictLess reals
    (zeroR reals)
    (distance reals (vertices i0) (vertices i1))
  and
  StrictLess reals
    (zeroR reals)
    (distance reals (vertices i1) (vertices i2))
  and
  StrictLess reals
    (zeroR reals)
    (distance reals (vertices i2) (vertices i3))
  and
  StrictLess reals
    (zeroR reals)
    (distance reals (vertices i3) (vertices i0))

Cospherical :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Predicate (Point R) ->
  Set
Cospherical {R} reals S =
  Exists (Point R)
    (\ center ->
      Exists R
        (\ radius ->
          (p : Point R) ->
          S p ->
          distance reals p center == radius))

module Putnam1970B6Statement
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) where

  proposition : Set1
  proposition =
    (vertices : Fin4 -> Point R) ->
    (S : Predicate (Point R)) ->
    SameSet S (VertexSet vertices) ->
    ExactlyFourNoncollinear reals S ->
    PositiveSideLengths reals vertices ->
    EdgesAvoidInterior reals vertices ->
    CircumscribedAboutCircle reals vertices ->
    convexQuadrilateralArea reals vertices
      ==
    squareRoot reals (sideLengthProduct reals vertices) ->
    Cospherical reals S

putnam-1970-b6 : Set1
putnam-1970-b6 =
  (R : Set) ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) ->
  Putnam1970B6Statement.proposition reals

title: putnam_1970_b6
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench artifact putnam_1970_b6:
  a nondegenerate quadrilateral tangent to an interior circle and having
  area equal to the square root of the product of its side lengths is cyclic.
  This file contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open arithmeticTheory pairTheory pred_setTheory realTheory transcTheory;
open extrealTheory measureTheory lebesgue_measureTheory;

val putnam_1970_b6 =
  ``let sqdist =
      \P Q : real # real.
        (FST P - FST Q) pow 2 + (SND P - SND Q) pow 2
    in
    let dist =
      \P Q : real # real. sqrt (sqdist P Q)
    in
    let collinear =
      \P Q R : real # real.
        (FST P - FST R) * (SND Q - SND R) =
        (SND P - SND R) * (FST Q - FST R)
    in
    let collinear_set =
      \T : (real # real) set.
        !P Q R : real # real.
          P IN T /\ Q IN T /\ R IN T ==> collinear P Q R
    in
    let closed_segment =
      \A B : real # real.
      \X : real # real.
        ?t : real.
          0 <= t /\ t <= 1 /\
          X = ((1 - t) * FST A + t * FST B,
               (1 - t) * SND A + t * SND B)
    in
    let in_convex_hull4 =
      \A B C D X : real # real.
        ?wa wb wc wd : real.
          0 <= wa /\ 0 <= wb /\ 0 <= wc /\ 0 <= wd /\
          wa + wb + wc + wd = 1 /\
          X =
            (wa * FST A + wb * FST B + wc * FST C + wd * FST D,
             wa * SND A + wb * SND B + wc * SND C + wd * SND D)
    in
    let in_interior4 =
      \A B C D X : real # real.
        ?e : real.
          0 < e /\
          !Y : real # real.
            sqdist X Y < e pow 2 ==> in_convex_hull4 A B C D Y
    in
      !L : num -> real # real.
        let S = {L 0; L 1; L 2; L 3}
        in
          CARD S = 4 /\
          (!T : (real # real) set.
             T SUBSET S /\ CARD T = 3 ==> ~collinear_set T) /\
          dist (L 0) (L 1) > 0 /\
          dist (L 1) (L 2) > 0 /\
          dist (L 2) (L 3) > 0 /\
          dist (L 3) (L 0) > 0 /\
          (!i : num.
             i < 4
             ==>
             !X : real # real.
               closed_segment (L i) (L ((i + 1) MOD 4)) X
               ==>
               ~in_interior4 (L 0) (L 1) (L 2) (L 3) X) /\
          (?O : real # real. ?r : real.
             in_convex_hull4 (L 0) (L 1) (L 2) (L 3) O /\
             r > 0 /\
             !i : num.
               i < 4
               ==>
               ?!I : real # real.
                 collinear I (L i) (L ((i + 1) MOD 4)) /\
                 dist O I = r) /\
          measure (prod_measure_space lebesgue lebesgue)
            {X | in_convex_hull4 (L 0) (L 1) (L 2) (L 3) X} =
            Normal
              (sqrt
                (dist (L 0) (L 1) * dist (L 1) (L 2) *
                 dist (L 2) (L 3) * dist (L 3) (L 0)))
          ==>
          ?O : real # real. ?r : real.
            !P : real # real. P IN S ==> dist P O = r``;

title: putnam_1970_b6
content:
$(
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact
  putnam_1970_b6: a nondegenerate ordered quadrilateral circumscribed about
  a circle, whose area is the square root of the product of its four side
  lengths, is cyclic. This file contains no proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  P70B6I and P70B6V are the two-coordinate and four-vertex index sets.
  P70B6R2 is the real Euclidean plane with its standard finite product
  topology P70B6Top, and P70B6Succ is cyclic successor on 0 ... 3.
  P70B6Dist, P70B6Segment, P70B6Hull, and P70B6Col expand Euclidean
  distance, closed affine segments, finite convex hulls, and determinant
  collinearity. P70B6NoncolSet expresses noncollinearity of every three
  distinct points in a set. P70B6UniqueTangency is existence and uniqueness
  in the plane of a point on a specified line at a specified distance from
  the center.

  Reindexing ZMod 4 by 0 ... 3 preserves cyclic successor. The final
  unproved $a assertion preserves the arbitrary vertex map and set, the
  four-point and noncollinearity conditions, positive side lengths, boundary
  ordering, internally existential incircle center and radius with unique
  tangencies, planar Lebesgue-area equality, and internally existential
  circumcircle. This database contains no $p proof statement.
$)

$c P70B6I P70B6V P70B6R2 P70B6Top P70B6Succ $.
$c P70B6Dist P70B6Segment P70B6Hull P70B6Col $.
$c P70B6NoncolSet P70B6UniqueTangency $.

p70b6-coordinate-index-syntax $a class P70B6I $.
p70b6-vertex-index-syntax $a class P70B6V $.
p70b6-plane-syntax $a class P70B6R2 $.
p70b6-topology-syntax $a class P70B6Top $.
p70b6-successor-syntax $a class P70B6Succ $.
p70b6-distance-syntax $a class ( P70B6Dist A B ) $.
p70b6-segment-syntax $a class ( P70B6Segment A B ) $.
p70b6-hull-syntax $a class ( P70B6Hull A ) $.
p70b6-collinear-syntax $a wff ( P70B6Col A B C ) $.
p70b6-noncollinear-set-syntax $a wff ( P70B6NoncolSet A ) $.
p70b6-unique-tangency-syntax $a
  wff ( P70B6UniqueTangency O r A B ) $.

p70b6-coordinate-index-definition $a |- P70B6I = ( 1 ... 2 ) $.

p70b6-vertex-index-definition $a |- P70B6V = ( 0 ... 3 ) $.

p70b6-plane-definition $a |- P70B6R2 = ( RR ^m P70B6I ) $.

p70b6-topology-definition $a |- P70B6Top =
  (
    Xt_ `
      ( P70B6I X. { ( topGen ` ran (,) ) } )
  )
$.

p70b6-successor-definition $a |- P70B6Succ = (
  i e. P70B6V |->
    if (
      i = 3 ,
      0 ,
      ( i + 1 )
    )
) $.

${
  $d A B j $.

  p70b6-distance-definition $a |- (
    P70B6Dist A B
  ) = (
    sqrt
    `
    (
      sum_ j e. P70B6I
        ( ( ( A ` j ) - ( B ` j ) ) ^ 2 )
    )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d A B j t z $.

  p70b6-segment-definition $a |- (
    P70B6Segment A B
  ) = {
    z e. P70B6R2 |
    E. t e. ( 0 [,] 1 )
      z =
        (
          j e. P70B6I |->
            (
              ( ( 1 - t ) x. ( A ` j ) )
              +
              ( t x. ( B ` j ) )
            )
        )
  } $.
$}

${
  $d A j w x z $.

  p70b6-hull-definition $a |- (
    P70B6Hull A
  ) = {
    z e. P70B6R2 |
    E. w
      (
        (
          w : A --> RR
          /\
          A. x e. A 0 <_ ( w ` x )
        )
        /\
        (
          ( sum_ x e. A ( w ` x ) ) = 1
          /\
          z =
            (
              j e. P70B6I |->
                sum_ x e. A
                  (
                    ( w ` x )
                    x.
                    ( x ` j )
                  )
            )
        )
      )
  } $.
$}

p70b6-collinear-definition $a |- (
  ( P70B6Col A B C )
  <->
  (
    (
      ( ( B ` 1 ) - ( A ` 1 ) )
      x.
      ( ( C ` 2 ) - ( A ` 2 ) )
    )
    =
    (
      ( ( B ` 2 ) - ( A ` 2 ) )
      x.
      ( ( C ` 1 ) - ( A ` 1 ) )
    )
  )
) $.

${
  $d A B C D $.

  p70b6-noncollinear-set-definition $a |- (
    ( P70B6NoncolSet A )
    <->
    (
      A C_ P70B6R2
      /\
      A. B e. A A. C e. A A. D e. A
        (
          (
            B =/= C
            /\
            (
              B =/= D
              /\
              C =/= D
            )
          )
          ->
          -. ( P70B6Col B C D )
        )
    )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d A B O P Q r $.

  p70b6-unique-tangency-definition $a |- (
    ( P70B6UniqueTangency O r A B )
    <->
    E. P e. P70B6R2
      (
        (
          ( P70B6Col P A B )
          /\
          ( P70B6Dist O P ) = r
        )
        /\
        A. Q e. P70B6R2
          (
            (
              ( P70B6Col Q A B )
              /\
              ( P70B6Dist O Q ) = r
            )
            ->
            Q = P
          )
      )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d L O P S i r s $.

  putnambench-putnam-1970-b6 $a |-
    A. L e. ( P70B6R2 ^m P70B6V )
    A. S
      (
        (
          S = ran L
          /\
          (
            (
              ( # ` S ) = 4
              /\
              A. s e. { s e. ~P S | ( # ` s ) = 3 }
                ( P70B6NoncolSet s )
            )
            /\
            (
              (
                0 < ( P70B6Dist ( L ` 0 ) ( L ` 1 ) )
                /\
                (
                  0 < ( P70B6Dist ( L ` 1 ) ( L ` 2 ) )
                  /\
                  (
                    0 < ( P70B6Dist ( L ` 2 ) ( L ` 3 ) )
                    /\
                    0 < ( P70B6Dist ( L ` 3 ) ( L ` 0 ) )
                  )
                )
              )
              /\
              (
                A. i e. P70B6V
                  (
                    (
                      P70B6Segment
                        ( L ` i )
                        ( L ` ( P70B6Succ ` i ) )
                    )
                    i^i
                    (
                      ( int ` P70B6Top )
                      `
                      ( P70B6Hull S )
                    )
                  )
                  =
                  (/)
                /\
                (
                  E. O e. P70B6R2 E. r e. RR
                    (
                      O e. ( P70B6Hull S )
                      /\
                      (
                        0 < r
                        /\
                        A. i e. P70B6V
                          (
                            P70B6UniqueTangency
                              O
                              r
                              ( L ` i )
                              ( L ` ( P70B6Succ ` i ) )
                          )
                      )
                    )
                  /\
                  (
                    (
                      ( voln ` P70B6I )
                      `
                      ( P70B6Hull S )
                    )
                    =
                    (
                      sqrt
                      `
                      (
                        (
                          (
                            ( P70B6Dist ( L ` 0 ) ( L ` 1 ) )
                            x.
                            ( P70B6Dist ( L ` 1 ) ( L ` 2 ) )
                          )
                          x.
                          ( P70B6Dist ( L ` 2 ) ( L ` 3 ) )
                        )
                        x.
                        ( P70B6Dist ( L ` 3 ) ( L ` 0 ) )
                      )
                    )
                  )
                )
              )
            )
          )
        )
        ->
        E. O e. P70B6R2 E. r e. RR
          A. P e. S
            ( P70B6Dist P O ) = r
      )
  $.
$}

title: putnam_1970_b6
content:
:: Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench artifact putnam_1970_b6:
:: an ordered nondegenerate real-plane quadrilateral circumscribed about a
:: circle and having area the square root of the product of its side lengths
:: is cyclic. This file contains no proof.

environ

 vocabularies MEASUR14, MEASUR13, FINSEQ_1, FINSEQ_2, NUMBERS, XXREAL_0,
      SUBSET_1, CARD_1, ARYTM_3, ARYTM_1, RELAT_1, REAL_1, FUNCT_1,
      XBOOLE_0, TARSKI, ZFMISC_1, PROB_1, SUPINF_2, VALUED_0, PARTFUN1,
      MEASURE1, MEASURE5, MEASURE8, NAT_1, FUNCT_2, FUNCOP_1, CARD_3, FINSUB_1,
      SETFAM_1, PROB_2, XCMPLX_0, STRUCT_0, PRE_TOPC, RLVECT_1, RLTOPSP1,
      EUCLID, CONVEX1, MEMBERED, METRIC_1, SQUARE_1, RLAFFIN1, PCOMPS_1,
      TBSP_1, TOPMETR, TOPS_1, TOPS_2;
 notations TARSKI, XBOOLE_0, ZFMISC_1, SUBSET_1, SETFAM_1, RELAT_1,
      FUNCT_1, ORDINAL1, RELSET_1, PARTFUN1, FUNCT_2, FUNCOP_1, CARD_1,
      FINSUB_1, CARD_3, NUMBERS, XCMPLX_0, XXREAL_0, XXREAL_3, XREAL_0,
      VALUED_0, EXTREAL1, NAT_1, FINSEQ_1, FINSEQ_2, STRUCT_0, METRIC_1,
      PRE_TOPC, PCOMPS_1, TBSP_1, TOPS_2, TOPMETR, RLVECT_1, RLTOPSP1,
      EUCLID, SUPINF_2, PROB_1, PROB_2,
      MEASURE1, MEASURE3, MEASURE4, MEASURE5, MEASURE8, MEASUR12, MEASUR13,
      MEASUR14, CONVEX1, TOPREAL6, SQUARE_1, RLAFFIN1;
 constructors EXTREAL1, SUPINF_1, DOMAIN_1, FINSEQOP, MEASURE3, PROB_3,
      MEASUR12, MEASUR13, MEASUR14, MEASURE8, METRIC_1, EUCLID, RLTOPSP1,
      CONVEX1, TOPREAL6, SQUARE_1, RLAFFIN1, PCOMPS_1, TBSP_1, TOPMETR,
      TOPS_1, TOPS_2;
 registrations ORDINAL1, XBOOLE_0, RELAT_1, SUBSET_1, XREAL_0, NAT_1,
      NUMBERS, VALUED_0, RELSET_1, MEASURE1, FINSEQ_1, FINSEQ_2, FUNCT_1,
      FUNCT_2, FUNCOP_1, CARD_1, CARD_3, MEASURE9, MEMBERED, SRINGS_4,
      SETFAM_1, MEASUR13, MEASUR14, GLIBPRE1, EUCLID, STRUCT_0, RLVECT_1,
      RLTOPSP1, CONVEX1, XXREAL_3, SQUARE_1, RLAFFIN1, PRE_TOPC, TBSP_1,
      TOPMETR, TOPS_1;
 requirements BOOLE, SUBSET, NUMERALS, REAL, ARITHM;
 definitions RLTOPSP1, TARSKI, TBSP_1, XBOOLE_0;
 equalities FINSEQ_1, BINOP_1, SUBSET_1, MEASUR13, FINSEQ_2, XCMPLX_0,
      STRUCT_0, RLVECT_1, EUCLID;
 expansions TARSKI, XBOOLE_0;

begin

::$P-
theorem
  for A,B,C,D being Point of TOP-REAL 2,
      S being Subset of TOP-REAL 2 st
    S = {A,B} \/ {C,D} &
    card S = 4 &
    (for s being Subset of TOP-REAL 2 st s c= S & card s = 3
      holds s is affinely-independent) &
    dist(A,B) > 0 & dist(B,C) > 0 &
    dist(C,D) > 0 & dist(D,A) > 0 &
    LSeg(A,B) misses (Cl (conv S)`)` &
    LSeg(B,C) misses (Cl (conv S)`)` &
    LSeg(C,D) misses (Cl (conv S)`)` &
    LSeg(D,A) misses (Cl (conv S)`)` &
    (ex O being Point of TOP-REAL 2, r being Real st
      O in conv S & r > 0 &
      (ex I being Point of TOP-REAL 2 st
        (ex l being line of TOP-REAL 2 st I in l & A in l & B in l) &
        dist(O,I) = r &
        (for J being Point of TOP-REAL 2 st
          (ex l being line of TOP-REAL 2 st J in l & A in l & B in l) &
          dist(O,J) = r holds J = I)) &
      (ex I being Point of TOP-REAL 2 st

        (for J being Point of TOP-REAL 2 st

          dist(O,J) = r holds J = I)) &
      (ex I being Point of TOP-REAL 2 st

% Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench artifact putnam_1970_b6:
% a nondegenerate ordered quadrilateral circumscribed about a circle and having
% area sqrt(abcd) is cyclic. This file contains no proof.

putnam_1970_b6: THEORY
BEGIN
  point: TYPE = [# x_coord: real, y_coord: real #]
  point_set: TYPE = [point -> bool]
  vertex_index: TYPE = below(4)
  vertices: TYPE = [vertex_index -> point]
  point_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> point]
  real_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> real]

  box: TYPE =
    [# left: real, right: real, bottom: real, top: real #]
  box_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> box]

  squared_distance(P, Q: point): real =
    (x_coord(P) - x_coord(Q)) ^ 2
      + (y_coord(P) - y_coord(Q)) ^ 2

  distance(P, Q: point): real =
    epsilon(
      LAMBDA (length: real):
        0 <= length
          AND length * length = squared_distance(P, Q))

  cross_from(P, Q, R: point): real =
    (x_coord(Q) - x_coord(P)) * (y_coord(R) - y_coord(P))
      - (y_coord(Q) - y_coord(P)) * (x_coord(R) - x_coord(P))

  collinear(P, Q, R: point): bool =
    cross_from(P, Q, R) = 0

  affine_combination(t: real, P, Q: point): point =
    (# x_coord := (1 - t) * x_coord(P) + t * x_coord(Q),
       y_coord := (1 - t) * y_coord(P) + t * y_coord(Q) #)

  closed_segment(P, Q: point): point_set =
    LAMBDA (X: point):
      EXISTS (t: real):
        0 <= t AND t <= 1
          AND X = affine_combination(t, P, Q)

  point_subset(A, B: point_set): bool =
    FORALL (P: point):
      A(P) IMPLIES B(P)

  convex(A: point_set): bool =
    FORALL (P, Q: point), (t: real):
      A(P) AND A(Q) AND 0 <= t AND t <= 1
        IMPLIES A(affine_combination(t, P, Q))

  convex_hull(A: point_set): point_set =
    LAMBDA (P: point):
      FORALL (C: point_set):
        convex(C) AND point_subset(A, C) IMPLIES C(P)

  euclidean_interior(A: point_set): point_set =
    LAMBDA (P: point):
      EXISTS (radius: real):
        0 < radius
          AND FORALL (Q: point):
            squared_distance(P, Q) < radius ^ 2
              IMPLIES A(Q)

  next_vertex(i: vertex_index): vertex_index =
    IF i = 0 THEN
      1
    ELSIF i = 1 THEN
      2
    ELSIF i = 2 THEN
      3
    ELSE
      0
    ENDIF

  vertex_set(L: vertices): point_set =
    LAMBDA (P: point):
      EXISTS (i: vertex_index):
        P = L(i)

  injective_vertices(L: vertices): bool =
    FORALL (i, j: vertex_index):
      L(i) = L(j) IMPLIES i = j

  has_four_points(S: point_set): bool =
    EXISTS (L: vertices):
      injective_vertices(L)
        AND FORALL (P: point):
          S(P) IFF
            EXISTS (i: vertex_index):
              P = L(i)

  no_three_collinear(S: point_set): bool =
    FORALL (P, Q, R: point):
      (S(P) AND S(Q) AND S(R)
        AND P /= Q AND P /= R AND Q /= R)
      IMPLIES NOT collinear(P, Q, R)

  bounded_region(A: point_set): bool =
    EXISTS (bound: nonneg_real):
      FORALL (P: point):
        A(P) IMPLIES
          abs(x_coord(P)) <= bound
            AND abs(y_coord(P)) <= bound

  in_open_box(P: point, B: box): bool =
    left(B) < x_coord(P)
      AND x_coord(P) < right(B)
      AND bottom(B) < y_coord(P)
      AND y_coord(P) < top(B)

  proper_box(B: box): bool =
    left(B) < right(B) AND bottom(B) < top(B)

  box_area(B: box): real =
    (right(B) - left(B)) * (top(B) - bottom(B))

  partial_sum(values: real_sequence, count: nat): RECURSIVE real =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      partial_sum(values, count - 1) + values(count - 1)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  nonnegative_series_sum(
      values: real_sequence,
      total: real): bool =
    (FORALL (index: nat): 0 <= values(index))
      AND FORALL (eps: posreal):
        EXISTS (start: nat):
          FORALL (count: nat):
            start <= count IMPLIES
              abs(partial_sum(values, count) - total) < eps

  box_areas(boxes: box_sequence): real_sequence =
    LAMBDA (index: nat):
      box_area(boxes(index))

  covers(A: point_set, boxes: box_sequence): bool =
    (FORALL (index: nat): proper_box(boxes(index)))
      AND FORALL (P: point):
        A(P) IMPLIES
          EXISTS (index: nat):
            in_open_box(P, boxes(index))

  box_cover_total(
      A: point_set,
      boxes: box_sequence,
      total: real): bool =
    covers(A, boxes)
      AND nonnegative_series_sum(box_areas(boxes), total)

  lebesgue_outer_area(
      A: point_set,
      area: real): bool =
    bounded_region(A)
      AND 0 <= area
      AND (FORALL (boxes: box_sequence), (total: real):
        box_cover_total(A, boxes, total)
          IMPLIES area <= total)
      AND (FORALL (eps: posreal):
        EXISTS (boxes: box_sequence), (total: real):
          box_cover_total(A, boxes, total)
            AND total < area + eps)

  side_lengths_positive(L: vertices): bool =
    distance(L(0), L(1)) > 0
      AND distance(L(1), L(2)) > 0
      AND distance(L(2), L(3)) > 0
      AND distance(L(3), L(0)) > 0

  ordered_boundary(L: vertices, S: point_set): bool =
    FORALL (i: vertex_index), (P: point):
      closed_segment(L(i), L(next_vertex(i)))(P)
        IMPLIES NOT euclidean_interior(convex_hull(S))(P)

  tangent_contact(
      center: point,
      radius: real,
      L: vertices,
      i: vertex_index,
      I: point): bool =
    collinear(I, L(i), L(next_vertex(i)))
      AND distance(center, I) = radius

  unique_tangent_contact(
      center: point,
      radius: real,
      L: vertices,
      i: vertex_index): bool =
    EXISTS (I: point):
      tangent_contact(center, radius, L, i, I)
        AND FORALL (J: point):
          tangent_contact(center, radius, L, i, J)
            IMPLIES J = I

  circumscribed_about_circle(
      L: vertices,
      S: point_set): bool =
    EXISTS (center: point), (radius: real):
      convex_hull(S)(center)
        AND radius > 0
        AND FORALL (i: vertex_index):
          unique_tangent_contact(center, radius, L, i)

  sqrt_value(root, radicand: real): bool =
    0 <= root AND root * root = radicand

  brahmagupta_area_identity(
      L: vertices,
      S: point_set): bool =
    EXISTS (area: real):
      lebesgue_outer_area(convex_hull(S), area)
        AND sqrt_value(
          area,
          distance(L(0), L(1))
            * distance(L(1), L(2))
            * distance(L(2), L(3))
            * distance(L(3), L(0)))

  cospherical(S: point_set): bool =
    EXISTS (center: point), (radius: real):
      FORALL (P: point):
        S(P) IMPLIES distance(P, center) = radius

  putnam_1970_b6: bool =
    FORALL (L: vertices), (S: point_set):
      (S = vertex_set(L)
        AND has_four_points(S)
        AND no_three_collinear(S)
        AND side_lengths_positive(L)
        AND ordered_boundary(L, S)
        AND circumscribed_about_circle(L, S)
        AND brahmagupta_area_identity(L, S))
      IMPLIES cospherical(S)
END putnam_1970_b6

title: putnam_1971_a1
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1971_a1:
;; every set of nine lattice points in three-dimensional Euclidean space has
;; an interior lattice point on a segment joining two distinct set members.
;; This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

;; The source set has cardinality nine, so a duplicate-free nine-element list
;; is a bijective representation of it. Each point is an integer coordinate
;; triple. For distinct lattice points P and Q, their open segment contains a
;; lattice point exactly when some integer d >= 2 divides all three coordinate
;; differences: such a d gives P + (Q-P)/d, and conversely the lattice points
;; on the line are spaced by the primitive direction vector. Any such d is at
;; most the largest absolute coordinate difference, so the bounded search is
;; exhaustive. Thus the pair and lattice-point witnesses from the source
;; conclusion remain internal rather than becoming statement parameters.

(defun putnam-1971-a1-integer-point-p (point)
  (and
   (true-listp point)
   (equal (len point) 3)
   (integerp (nth 0 point))
   (integerp (nth 1 point))
   (integerp (nth 2 point))))

(defun putnam-1971-a1-integer-point-list-p (points)
  (if (consp points)
      (and
       (putnam-1971-a1-integer-point-p (car points))
       (putnam-1971-a1-integer-point-list-p (cdr points)))
    (equal points nil)))

(defun putnam-1971-a1-max2 (left right)
  (if (< left right) right left))

(defun putnam-1971-a1-common-divisor-from-p
    (dx dy dz divisor)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix divisor)))
  (if (and (integerp divisor) (< 1 divisor))
      (or
       (and
        (equal (mod dx divisor) 0)
        (equal (mod dy divisor) 0)
        (equal (mod dz divisor) 0))
       (putnam-1971-a1-common-divisor-from-p
        dx dy dz (- divisor 1)))
    nil))

(defun putnam-1971-a1-segment-has-interior-lattice-point-p
    (left right)
  (let* ((dx (abs (- (nth 0 right) (nth 0 left))))
         (dy (abs (- (nth 1 right) (nth 1 left))))
         (dz (abs (- (nth 2 right) (nth 2 left))))
         (bound
          (putnam-1971-a1-max2
           dx (putnam-1971-a1-max2 dy dz))))
    (and
     (not (equal left right))
     (putnam-1971-a1-common-divisor-from-p
      dx dy dz bound))))

(defun putnam-1971-a1-pair-from-point-exists-p
    (left remaining)
  (if (consp remaining)
      (or
       (putnam-1971-a1-segment-has-interior-lattice-point-p
        left (car remaining))
       (putnam-1971-a1-pair-from-point-exists-p
        left (cdr remaining)))
    nil))

(defun putnam-1971-a1-pair-exists-p (points)
  (if (consp points)
      (or
       (putnam-1971-a1-pair-from-point-exists-p
        (car points) (cdr points))
       (putnam-1971-a1-pair-exists-p (cdr points)))
    nil))

(defun putnambench-putnam-1971-a1-statement (points)
  (implies
   (and
    (true-listp points)
    (no-duplicatesp-equal points)
    (equal (len points) 9)
    (putnam-1971-a1-integer-point-list-p points))
   (putnam-1971-a1-pair-exists-p points)))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

-- Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1971_a1:
-- every set of nine lattice points in three-dimensional real space has a
-- lattice point in the interior of a segment joining two distinct members.
-- This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Int using (Int; pos; negsuc)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; _*_)

infix 4 _!=_
infixr 3 _and_
infixr 2 _or_

data Bottom : Set where

Not : Set -> Set
Not A =
  A -> Bottom

_!=_ : {A : Set} -> A -> A -> Set
x != y =
  Not (x == y)

record _and_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data _or_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  left  : A -> A or B
  right : B -> A or B

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

data Fin : Nat -> Set where
  fzero : {n : Nat} -> Fin (suc n)
  fsuc  : {n : Nat} -> Fin n -> Fin (suc n)

oneN : Nat
oneN =
  suc zero

twoN : Nat
twoN =
  suc oneN

threeN : Nat
threeN =
  suc twoN

fourN : Nat
fourN =
  suc threeN

fiveN : Nat
fiveN =
  suc fourN

sixN : Nat
sixN =
  suc fiveN

sevenN : Nat
sevenN =
  suc sixN

eightN : Nat
eightN =
  suc sevenN

nineN : Nat
nineN =
  suc eightN

record CompleteOrderedRealField (R : Set) : Set1 where
  field
    zeroR oneR : R
    add multiply : R -> R -> R
    negate inverse : R -> R
    lessOrEqual : R -> R -> Set
    fromNat : Nat -> R

    one-not-zero :
      oneR != zeroR

    add-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> add x y == add y x
    add-associative :
      (x y z : R) -> add (add x y) z == add x (add y z)
    add-zero :
      (x : R) -> add x zeroR == x
    add-inverse :
      (x : R) -> add x (negate x) == zeroR

    multiply-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> multiply x y == multiply y x
    multiply-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply (multiply x y) z == multiply x (multiply y z)
    multiply-one :
      (x : R) -> multiply x oneR == x
    multiply-zero :
      (x : R) -> multiply x zeroR == zeroR
    distribute :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply x (add y z) ==
      add (multiply x y) (multiply x z)
    inverse-zero :
      inverse zeroR == zeroR
    multiply-inverse :
      (x : R) ->
      x != zeroR ->
      multiply x (inverse x) == oneR

    order-reflexive :
      (x : R) -> lessOrEqual x x
    order-transitive :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y z ->
      lessOrEqual x z
    order-antisymmetric :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y x ->
      x == y
    order-total :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y or lessOrEqual y x
    add-order :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual (add z x) (add z y)
    multiply-nonnegative :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR x ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR y ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR (multiply x y)
    zero-less-than-one :
      lessOrEqual zeroR oneR and zeroR != oneR

    fromNat-zero :
      fromNat zero == zeroR
    fromNat-successor :
      (n : Nat) -> fromNat (suc n) == add (fromNat n) oneR
    fromNat-addition :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m + n) == add (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-multiplication :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m * n) == multiply (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-injective :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat m == fromNat n ->
      m == n

    archimedean :
      (x : R) ->
      Exists Nat (\ n -> lessOrEqual x (fromNat n))
    least-upper-bound :
      (P : R -> Set) ->
      Exists R P ->
      Exists R
        (\ upper ->
          (x : R) ->
          P x ->
          lessOrEqual x upper) ->
      Exists R
        (\ supremum ->
          ((x : R) -> P x -> lessOrEqual x supremum)
          and
          ((upper : R) ->
            ((x : R) -> P x -> lessOrEqual x upper) ->
            lessOrEqual supremum upper))

open CompleteOrderedRealField

fromInt :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Int ->
  R
fromInt reals (pos n) =
  fromNat reals n
fromInt reals (negsuc n) =
  negate reals (fromNat reals (suc n))

subtract :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
subtract reals x y =
  add reals x (negate reals y)

StrictLess :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
StrictLess reals x y =
  lessOrEqual reals x y and x != y

record LatticePoint : Set where
  constructor lattice-point
  field
    x-coordinate : Int
    y-coordinate : Int
    z-coordinate : Int

open LatticePoint

LatticeSubset : Set1
LatticeSubset =
  LatticePoint -> Set

record HasCardinality
  (S : LatticeSubset)
  (cardinality : Nat) :
  Set where

  field
    enumerate :
      Fin cardinality ->
      LatticePoint
    enumerated-member :
      (index : Fin cardinality) ->
      S (enumerate index)
    enumeration-complete :
      (point : LatticePoint) ->
      S point ->
      Exists (Fin cardinality)
        (\ index -> point == enumerate index)
    enumeration-injective :
      (left-index right-index : Fin cardinality) ->
      enumerate left-index == enumerate right-index ->
      left-index == right-index

InteriorSegment :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  LatticePoint ->
  LatticePoint ->
  Int ->
  Int ->
  Int ->
  Set
InteriorSegment reals P Q x y z =
  Exists _
    (\ t ->
      StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) t
      and
      StrictLess reals t (oneR reals)
      and
      fromInt reals x ==
        add reals
          (multiply reals t (fromInt reals (x-coordinate P)))
          (multiply reals
            (subtract reals (oneR reals) t)
            (fromInt reals (x-coordinate Q)))
      and
      fromInt reals y ==
        add reals
          (multiply reals t (fromInt reals (y-coordinate P)))
          (multiply reals
            (subtract reals (oneR reals) t)
            (fromInt reals (y-coordinate Q)))
      and
      fromInt reals z ==
        add reals
          (multiply reals t (fromInt reals (z-coordinate P)))
          (multiply reals
            (subtract reals (oneR reals) t)
            (fromInt reals (z-coordinate Q))))

module Putnam1971A1Statement
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) where

  proposition : Set1
  proposition =
    (S : LatticeSubset) ->
    HasCardinality S nineN ->
    Exists Int
      (\ x ->
        Exists Int
          (\ y ->
            Exists Int
              (\ z ->
                Exists LatticePoint
                  (\ P ->
                    Exists LatticePoint
                      (\ Q ->
                        S P
                        and
                        S Q
                        and
                        P != Q
                        and
                        InteriorSegment reals P Q x y z)))))

putnam-1971-a1 : Set1
putnam-1971-a1 =
  (R : Set) ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) ->
  Putnam1971A1Statement.proposition reals

(*

  among any nine lattice points in real three-space, the open segment joining

title: putnam_1971_a1

% Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench artifact putnam_1971_a1:
% every set of nine lattice points in real three-dimensional space has a
% lattice point in the open segment joining two distinct points of the set.
% This file contains no proof.

putnam_1971_a1: THEORY
BEGIN
  lattice_point: TYPE =
    [# x_coord: int, y_coord: int, z_coord: int #]
  lattice_point_set: TYPE = [lattice_point -> bool]
  point_enumeration: TYPE = [nat -> lattice_point]

  injective_below(
      enumeration: point_enumeration,
      bound: nat): bool =
    FORALL (i, j: nat):
      i < bound AND j < bound
        AND enumeration(i) = enumeration(j)
      IMPLIES i = j

  enumerates_exactly(
      enumeration: point_enumeration,
      S: lattice_point_set,
      bound: nat): bool =
    FORALL (P: lattice_point):
      S(P)
        IFF
          EXISTS (i: nat):
            i < bound AND enumeration(i) = P

  has_cardinality(
      S: lattice_point_set,
      cardinality: nat): bool =
    EXISTS (enumeration: point_enumeration):
      injective_below(enumeration, cardinality)
        AND enumerates_exactly(enumeration, S, cardinality)

  putnam_1971_a1: bool =
    FORALL (S: lattice_point_set):
      has_cardinality(S, 9)
        IMPLIES
          EXISTS
              (x, y, z: int),
              (P, Q: lattice_point),
              (t: real):
            S(P)
              AND S(Q)
              AND P /= Q
              AND 0 < t
              AND t < 1
              AND (x :: real)
                = t * (x_coord(P) :: real)
                  + (1 - t) * (x_coord(Q) :: real)
              AND (y :: real)
                = t * (y_coord(P) :: real)
                  + (1 - t) * (y_coord(Q) :: real)
              AND (z :: real)
                = t * (z_coord(P) :: real)
                  + (1 - t) * (z_coord(Q) :: real)
END putnam_1971_a1

;; the identity polynomial is exactly the real polynomial P with P(0) = 0
;; and P(x^2 + 1) = P(x)^2 + 1 for every real x. This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))

;; A context tag selects a real closed ordered field. Conservative DEFSTUB
;; symbols provide its carrier, arithmetic, order, and root selectors; every
;; field, order, closure, square-root, and odd-degree-root law is an explicit
;; hypothesis of the statement. The latter two root laws are the standard
;; algebraic characterization of real closed ordered fields.
;;
;; Polynomials are canonical nonempty finite coefficient lists in ascending
;; degree order, so they range over every polynomial over the represented
;; field. The source assertion is first-order polynomial algebra. Since all
;; real closed fields are elementarily equivalent and the usual reals form
;; one, its validity over this presentation is bidirectionally equivalent to
;; its validity over all real-coefficient polynomials. No coefficient is
;; restricted to the rationals, algebraic numbers, or any bounded carrier.

(defstub putnam-1971-a2-real-p (context value) t)
(defstub putnam-1971-a2-zero (context) t)
(defstub putnam-1971-a2-one (context) t)
(defstub putnam-1971-a2-add (context left right) t)
(defstub putnam-1971-a2-multiply (context left right) t)

(defun putnam-1971-a2-coefficient-list-p (context coefficients)

        context (cdr coefficients)))

title: putnam_1971_a2
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1971_a2:
-- the real polynomials satisfying P(0) = 0 and
-- P(x^2 + 1) = P(x)^2 + 1 for every real x are exactly the identity
-- polynomial. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.List using (List; []; _∷_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc)

infix 4 _!=_
infixr 3 _and_

data Bottom : Set where

Not : Set -> Set
Not A =
  A -> Bottom

_!=_ : {A : Set} -> A -> A -> Set
x != y =
  Not (x == y)

record _and_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data _or_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  left  : A -> A or B
  right : B -> A or B

record Iff (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor equivalence
  field
    forward  : A -> B
    backward : B -> A

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

record CompleteOrderedRealField (R : Set) : Set1 where
  field
    zeroR oneR : R
    add multiply : R -> R -> R
    negate inverse : R -> R
    lessOrEqual : R -> R -> Set
    fromNat : Nat -> R

    one-not-zero :
      oneR != zeroR

    add-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> add x y == add y x
    add-associative :
      (x y z : R) -> add (add x y) z == add x (add y z)
    add-zero :
      (x : R) -> add x zeroR == x
    add-inverse :
      (x : R) -> add x (negate x) == zeroR

    multiply-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> multiply x y == multiply y x
    multiply-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply (multiply x y) z == multiply x (multiply y z)
    multiply-one :
      (x : R) -> multiply x oneR == x
    multiply-zero :
      (x : R) -> multiply x zeroR == zeroR
    distribute :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply x (add y z) ==
      add (multiply x y) (multiply x z)
    inverse-zero :
      inverse zeroR == zeroR
    multiply-inverse :
      (x : R) ->
      x != zeroR ->
      multiply x (inverse x) == oneR

    order-reflexive :
      (x : R) -> lessOrEqual x x
    order-transitive :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y z ->
      lessOrEqual x z
    order-antisymmetric :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y x ->
      x == y
    order-total :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y or lessOrEqual y x
    add-order :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual (add z x) (add z y)
    multiply-nonnegative :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR x ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR y ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR (multiply x y)
    zero-less-than-one :
      lessOrEqual zeroR oneR and zeroR != oneR

    fromNat-zero :
      fromNat zero == zeroR
    fromNat-successor :
      (n : Nat) -> fromNat (suc n) == add (fromNat n) oneR
    fromNat-injective :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat m == fromNat n ->
      m == n

    archimedean :
      (x : R) ->
      Exists Nat (\ n -> lessOrEqual x (fromNat n))
    least-upper-bound :
      (P : R -> Set) ->
      Exists R P ->
      Exists R
        (\ upper ->
          (x : R) ->
          P x ->
          lessOrEqual x upper) ->
      Exists R
        (\ supremum ->
          ((x : R) -> P x -> lessOrEqual x supremum)
          and
          ((upper : R) ->
            ((x : R) -> P x -> lessOrEqual x upper) ->
            lessOrEqual supremum upper))

open CompleteOrderedRealField

module PolynomialDefinitions
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) where

  Polynomial : Set
  Polynomial =
    List R

  coefficient : Polynomial -> Nat -> R
  coefficient [] n =
    zeroR reals
  coefficient (c ∷ coefficients) zero =
    c
  coefficient (c ∷ coefficients) (suc n) =
    coefficient coefficients n

  PolynomialEqual : Polynomial -> Polynomial -> Set
  PolynomialEqual p q =
    (n : Nat) -> coefficient p n == coefficient q n

  evaluate : Polynomial -> R -> R
  evaluate [] x =
    zeroR reals
  evaluate (c ∷ coefficients) x =
    add reals c
      (multiply reals x (evaluate coefficients x))

  X : Polynomial
  X =
    zeroR reals ∷ oneR reals ∷ []

  Solution : Polynomial -> Set
  Solution polynomial =
    PolynomialEqual polynomial X

  SatisfiesEquation : Polynomial -> Set
  SatisfiesEquation polynomial =
    evaluate polynomial (zeroR reals) == zeroR reals
    and
    ((x : R) ->
      evaluate polynomial
        (add reals
          (multiply reals x x)
          (oneR reals))
      ==
      add reals
        (multiply reals
          (evaluate polynomial x)
          (evaluate polynomial x))
        (oneR reals))

  proposition : Set
  proposition =
    (polynomial : Polynomial) ->
    Iff
      (SatisfiesEquation polynomial)
      (Solution polynomial)

putnam-1971-a2 : Set1
putnam-1971-a2 =
  (R : Set) ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) ->

% Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench artifact putnam_1971_a2:
% the real polynomials P satisfying P(0) = 0 and
% P(x^2 + 1) = P(x)^2 + 1 for every real x are exactly P = X.
% This file contains no proof.

putnam_1971_a2: THEORY
BEGIN
  polynomial_coefficient(
      polynomial: list[real],
      degree: nat): RECURSIVE real =
    CASES polynomial OF
      null: 0,
      cons(coefficient, tail):
        IF degree = 0 THEN
          coefficient
        ELSE
          polynomial_coefficient(tail, degree - 1)
        ENDIF
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE polynomial BY <<

  polynomial_equal(left, right: list[real]): bool =
    FORALL (degree: nat):
      polynomial_coefficient(left, degree)
        = polynomial_coefficient(right, degree)

  polynomial_value(polynomial: list[real], x: real): RECURSIVE real =
    CASES polynomial OF
      null: 0,
      cons(coefficient, tail):
        coefficient + x * polynomial_value(tail, x)
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE polynomial BY <<

  X: list[real] = cons(0, cons(1, null))

  putnam_1971_a2: bool =
    FORALL (P: list[real]):
      (polynomial_value(P, 0) = 0
        AND (FORALL (x: real):
          polynomial_value(P, x ^ 2 + 1)
            = polynomial_value(P, x) ^ 2 + 1))
      IFF polynomial_equal(P, X)
END putnam_1971_a2

;; Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1971_a3:
;; the product of the three side lengths of a lattice triangle on a circle
;; is at least twice the positive circle radius. This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

;; ACL2 represents the positive radius R by the exact rational value R^2 and
;; replaces each Euclidean distance by its square.  The conclusion below is
;; therefore exactly the square of
;;
;;   distance(A,B) * distance(A,C) * distance(B,C) >= 2 * R;
;;
;; both sides of the source inequality are nonnegative, so the two conclusions
;; are bidirectionally equivalent.
;;
;; This does not restrict the source's real circle-center witness.  For three
;; distinct lattice points on a positive-radius circle, subtracting pairs of
;; circle equations gives two independent linear equations with integer
;; coefficients.  Hence the unique real center has rational coordinates, and
;; then R^2 is rational.  Conversely, every positive rational radius-square
;; and rational center satisfying the equations below embeds in the reals,
;; with source radius sqrt(R^2).  The center remains internally existential.

(defun putnam-1971-a3-square (x)
  (* x x))

(defun putnam-1971-a3-distance-squared
    (left-x left-y right-x right-y)
  (+ (putnam-1971-a3-square (- left-x right-x))
     (putnam-1971-a3-square (- left-y right-y))))

(defun-sk putnam-1971-a3-on-common-circle-p
    (a-x a-y b-x b-y c-x c-y radius-squared)
  (exists (center-x center-y)
    (and
     (rationalp center-x)
     (rationalp center-y)
     (equal
      (putnam-1971-a3-distance-squared
       a-x a-y center-x center-y)
      radius-squared)
     (equal
      (putnam-1971-a3-distance-squared
       b-x b-y center-x center-y)
      radius-squared)
     (equal
      (putnam-1971-a3-distance-squared
       c-x c-y center-x center-y)
      radius-squared))))

(defun putnambench-putnam-1971-a3-statement
    (a-x a-y b-x b-y c-x c-y radius-squared)
  (let
      ((ab-squared
        (putnam-1971-a3-distance-squared a-x a-y b-x b-y))
       (ac-squared
        (putnam-1971-a3-distance-squared a-x a-y c-x c-y))
       (bc-squared
        (putnam-1971-a3-distance-squared b-x b-y c-x c-y)))
    (implies
     (and
      (integerp a-x)
      (integerp a-y)
      (integerp b-x)
      (integerp b-y)
      (integerp c-x)
      (integerp c-y)
      (not (and (equal a-x b-x) (equal a-y b-y)))
      (not (and (equal a-x c-x) (equal a-y c-y)))
      (not (and (equal b-x c-x) (equal b-y c-y)))
      (rationalp radius-squared)
      (< 0 radius-squared)
      (putnam-1971-a3-on-common-circle-p
       a-x a-y b-x b-y c-x c-y radius-squared))
     (<= (* 4 radius-squared)
         (* ab-squared ac-squared bc-squared)))))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q
