-- Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1971_a3:
-- three distinct lattice points on a circle of positive radius have the
-- product of their three pairwise side lengths at least twice the radius.
-- This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Int using (Int; pos; negsuc)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; _*_)

infix 4 _!=_
infixr 3 _and_
infixr 2 _or_

data Bottom : Set where

Not : Set -> Set
Not A =
  A -> Bottom

_!=_ : {A : Set} -> A -> A -> Set
x != y =
  Not (x == y)

record _and_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data _or_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  left  : A -> A or B
  right : B -> A or B

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

record CompleteOrderedRealField (R : Set) : Set1 where
  field
    zeroR oneR : R
    add multiply : R -> R -> R
    negate inverse : R -> R
    lessOrEqual : R -> R -> Set
    fromNat : Nat -> R

    one-not-zero :
      oneR != zeroR

    add-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> add x y == add y x
    add-associative :
      (x y z : R) -> add (add x y) z == add x (add y z)
    add-zero :
      (x : R) -> add x zeroR == x
    add-inverse :
      (x : R) -> add x (negate x) == zeroR

    multiply-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> multiply x y == multiply y x
    multiply-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply (multiply x y) z == multiply x (multiply y z)
    multiply-one :
      (x : R) -> multiply x oneR == x
    multiply-zero :
      (x : R) -> multiply x zeroR == zeroR
    distribute :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply x (add y z) ==
      add (multiply x y) (multiply x z)
    inverse-zero :
      inverse zeroR == zeroR
    multiply-inverse :
      (x : R) ->
      x != zeroR ->
      multiply x (inverse x) == oneR

    order-reflexive :
      (x : R) -> lessOrEqual x x
    order-transitive :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y z ->
      lessOrEqual x z
    order-antisymmetric :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y x ->
      x == y
    order-total :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y or lessOrEqual y x
    add-order :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual (add z x) (add z y)
    multiply-nonnegative :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR x ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR y ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR (multiply x y)
    zero-less-than-one :
      lessOrEqual zeroR oneR and zeroR != oneR

    fromNat-zero :
      fromNat zero == zeroR
    fromNat-successor :
      (n : Nat) -> fromNat (suc n) == add (fromNat n) oneR
    fromNat-addition :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m + n) == add (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-multiplication :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m * n) == multiply (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-injective :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat m == fromNat n ->
      m == n

    archimedean :
      (x : R) ->
      Exists Nat (\ n -> lessOrEqual x (fromNat n))
    least-upper-bound :
      (P : R -> Set) ->
      Exists R P ->
      Exists R
        (\ upper ->
          (x : R) ->
          P x ->
          lessOrEqual x upper) ->
      Exists R
        (\ supremum ->
          ((x : R) -> P x -> lessOrEqual x supremum)
          and
          ((upper : R) ->
            ((x : R) -> P x -> lessOrEqual x upper) ->
            lessOrEqual supremum upper))

open CompleteOrderedRealField

fromInt :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Int ->
  R
fromInt reals (pos n) =
  fromNat reals n
fromInt reals (negsuc n) =
  negate reals (fromNat reals (suc n))

subtract :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
subtract reals x y =
  add reals x (negate reals y)

square :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R
square reals x =
  multiply reals x x

StrictLess :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
StrictLess reals x y =
  lessOrEqual reals x y and x != y

record Point (R : Set) : Set where
  constructor point
  field
    x-coordinate : R
    y-coordinate : R

open Point

record LatticePoint : Set where
  constructor lattice-point
  field
    lattice-x : Int
    lattice-y : Int

open LatticePoint

squaredDistance :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Point R ->
  Point R ->
  R
squaredDistance reals p q =
  add reals
    (square reals
      (subtract reals (x-coordinate p) (x-coordinate q)))
    (square reals
      (subtract reals (y-coordinate p) (y-coordinate q)))

embedLatticePoint :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  LatticePoint ->
  Point R
embedLatticePoint reals p =
  point
    (fromInt reals (lattice-x p))
    (fromInt reals (lattice-y p))

latticeSquaredDistance :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  LatticePoint ->
  LatticePoint ->
  R
latticeSquaredDistance reals p q =
  squaredDistance reals
    (embedLatticePoint reals p)
    (embedLatticePoint reals q)

OnCircle :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Point R ->
  R ->
  LatticePoint ->
  Set
OnCircle reals center radius p =
  squaredDistance reals center (embedLatticePoint reals p)
  ==
  square reals radius

four :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R
four reals =
  fromNat reals (suc (suc (suc (suc zero))))

module Putnam1971A3Statement
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) where

  proposition : Set
  proposition =
    (a b c : LatticePoint) ->
    (a != b and a != c and b != c) ->
    (radius : R) ->
    StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) radius ->
    Exists (Point R)
      (\ center ->
        OnCircle reals center radius a
        and
        OnCircle reals center radius b
        and
        OnCircle reals center radius c) ->
    lessOrEqual reals
      (multiply reals
        (four reals)
        (square reals radius))
      (multiply reals
        (multiply reals
          (latticeSquaredDistance reals a b)
          (latticeSquaredDistance reals a c))
        (latticeSquaredDistance reals b c))

putnam-1971-a3 : Set1
putnam-1971-a3 =
  (R : Set) ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) ->
  Putnam1971A3Statement.proposition reals

% Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench artifact putnam_1971_a3:
% three distinct lattice points in the real plane lying on a circle of
% positive radius satisfy the stated product-of-side-lengths bound. This file
% contains no proof.

putnam_1971_a3: THEORY
BEGIN
  point: TYPE = [# x_coord: real, y_coord: real #]

  lattice_point(P: point): bool =
    EXISTS (m, n: int):
      x_coord(P) = (m :: real)
        AND y_coord(P) = (n :: real)

  squared_distance(P, Q: point): real =
    (x_coord(P) - x_coord(Q)) ^ 2
      + (y_coord(P) - y_coord(Q)) ^ 2

  distance(P, Q: point): real =
    epsilon(
      LAMBDA (length: real):
        0 <= length
          AND length * length = squared_distance(P, Q))

  on_circle(center: point, radius: real, P: point): bool =
    distance(P, center) = radius

  putnam_1971_a3: bool =
    FORALL (A, B, C: point), (R: real):
      (lattice_point(A)
        AND lattice_point(B)
        AND lattice_point(C)
        AND A /= B
        AND A /= C
        AND B /= C
        AND R > 0
        AND EXISTS (center: point):
          on_circle(center, R, A)
            AND on_circle(center, R, B)
            AND on_circle(center, R, C))
      IMPLIES
        distance(A, B) * distance(A, C) * distance(B, C)
          >= 2 * R
END putnam_1971_a3

    (epsilon : R)

putnam_1971_a4
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench artifact putnam_1971_a4:
;; for 0 < epsilon < 1, every coefficient in the homogeneous support of
;; (x+y)^n (x^2-(2-epsilon)xy+y^2) is strictly positive for all sufficiently
;; large n. This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

;; Pascal recursion gives choose(n,k), with zero outside 0 <= k <= n.
(defun putnam-1971-a4-binomial (n k)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix n)))
  (if (and (natp n)
           (natp k)
           (<= k n))
      (if (or (zp k)
              (equal k n))
          1
        (+ (putnam-1971-a4-binomial (- n 1) (- k 1))
           (putnam-1971-a4-binomial (- n 1) k)))
    0))

;; This is the coefficient of x^i*y^(n+2-i) in the displayed polynomial.
(defun putnam-1971-a4-coefficient (n epsilon i)
  (+ (if (<= 2 i)
         (putnam-1971-a4-binomial n (- i 2))
       0)
     (- (* (- 2 epsilon)
           (if (<= 1 i)
               (putnam-1971-a4-binomial n (- i 1))
             0)))
     (putnam-1971-a4-binomial n i)))

(defun-sk putnam-1971-a4-all-coefficients-positive-p
    (epsilon n)
  (forall (i)
    (implies
     (and (natp i)
          (<= i (+ n 2)))
     (< 0
        (putnam-1971-a4-coefficient
         n epsilon i)))))

(defun-sk putnam-1971-a4-positive-tail-p
    (epsilon cutoff)
  (forall (n)
    (implies
     (and (natp n)
          (<= cutoff n))
     (putnam-1971-a4-all-coefficients-positive-p
      epsilon n))))

(defun-sk putnam-1971-a4-cutoff-exists-p (epsilon)
  (exists (cutoff)
    (and
     (natp cutoff)
     (putnam-1971-a4-positive-tail-p
      epsilon cutoff))))

;; Exact rational epsilon is bidirectionally equivalent here to arbitrary real
;; epsilon. Restriction gives one direction. Conversely, for a real epsilon
;; choose a positive rational q < epsilon. Every coefficient is
;; A-(2-epsilon)B+C with B a nonnegative binomial coefficient, so positivity
;; at q implies positivity at epsilon with the same cutoff.
(defun-sk putnambench-putnam-1971-a4-statement ()
  (forall (epsilon)
    (implies
     (and (rationalp epsilon)
          (< 0 epsilon)
          (< epsilon 1))
     (putnam-1971-a4-cutoff-exists-p
      epsilon))))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

-- Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1971_a4:
-- eventual strict positivity of every coefficient in the finite homogeneous
-- support of a parameterized bivariate polynomial. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module Putnam1971A4 where

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; _*_; _-_)

infix 4 _!=_ _<=N_
infixr 3 _and_
infixr 2 _or_

data Bottom : Set where

Not : Set -> Set
Not A =
  A -> Bottom

_!=_ : {A : Set} -> A -> A -> Set
x != y =
  Not (x == y)

record _and_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data _or_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  left  : A -> A or B
  right : B -> A or B

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

data _<=N_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set where
  zero<=   : {n : Nat} -> zero <=N n
  suc<=suc : {m n : Nat} -> m <=N n -> suc m <=N suc n

record CompleteOrderedRealField (R : Set) : Set1 where
  field
    zeroR oneR : R
    addR multiplyR : R -> R -> R
    negateR inverseR : R -> R
    lessOrEqualR : R -> R -> Set
    fromNatR : Nat -> R

    one-not-zero :
      oneR != zeroR

    add-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> addR x y == addR y x
    add-associative :
      (x y z : R) -> addR (addR x y) z == addR x (addR y z)
    add-zero :
      (x : R) -> addR x zeroR == x
    add-inverse :
      (x : R) -> addR x (negateR x) == zeroR

    multiply-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> multiplyR x y == multiplyR y x
    multiply-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiplyR (multiplyR x y) z == multiplyR x (multiplyR y z)
    multiply-one :
      (x : R) -> multiplyR x oneR == x
    multiply-zero :
      (x : R) -> multiplyR x zeroR == zeroR
    distribute :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiplyR x (addR y z) ==
      addR (multiplyR x y) (multiplyR x z)
    inverse-zero :
      inverseR zeroR == zeroR
    multiply-inverse :
      (x : R) ->
      x != zeroR ->
      multiplyR x (inverseR x) == oneR

    order-reflexive :
      (x : R) -> lessOrEqualR x x
    order-transitive :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR x y ->
      lessOrEqualR y z ->
      lessOrEqualR x z
    order-antisymmetric :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR x y ->
      lessOrEqualR y x ->
      x == y
    order-total :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR x y or lessOrEqualR y x
    add-order :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR x y ->
      lessOrEqualR (addR z x) (addR z y)
    multiply-nonnegative :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR zeroR x ->
      lessOrEqualR zeroR y ->
      lessOrEqualR zeroR (multiplyR x y)
    zero-less-than-one :
      lessOrEqualR zeroR oneR and zeroR != oneR

    fromNat-zero :
      fromNatR zero == zeroR
    fromNat-successor :
      (n : Nat) -> fromNatR (suc n) == addR (fromNatR n) oneR
    fromNat-addition :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNatR (m + n) == addR (fromNatR m) (fromNatR n)
    fromNat-multiplication :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNatR (m * n) == multiplyR (fromNatR m) (fromNatR n)
    fromNat-injective :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNatR m == fromNatR n ->
      m == n

    archimedean :
      (x : R) ->
      Exists Nat (\ n -> lessOrEqualR x (fromNatR n))
    least-upper-bound :
      (P : R -> Set) ->
      Exists R P ->
      Exists R
        (\ upper ->
          (x : R) ->
          P x ->
          lessOrEqualR x upper) ->
      Exists R
        (\ supremum ->
          ((x : R) -> P x -> lessOrEqualR x supremum)
          and
          ((upper : R) ->
            ((x : R) -> P x -> lessOrEqualR x upper) ->
            lessOrEqualR supremum upper))

open CompleteOrderedRealField

StrictLess :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
StrictLess reals x y =
  lessOrEqualR reals x y and x != y

module PolynomialDefinitions
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) where

  Polynomial : Set
  Polynomial =
    Nat -> Nat -> R

  sumThrough : (Nat -> R) -> Nat -> R
  sumThrough f zero =
    f zero
  sumThrough f (suc n) =
    addR reals (sumThrough f n) (f (suc n))

  zeroPolynomial : Polynomial
  zeroPolynomial i j =
    zeroR reals

  constantPolynomial : R -> Polynomial
  constantPolynomial c zero zero =
    c
  constantPolynomial c zero (suc j) =
    zeroR reals
  constantPolynomial c (suc i) j =
    zeroR reals

  xVariable : Polynomial
  xVariable zero j =
    zeroR reals
  xVariable (suc zero) zero =
    oneR reals
  xVariable (suc zero) (suc j) =
    zeroR reals
  xVariable (suc (suc i)) j =
    zeroR reals

  yVariable : Polynomial
  yVariable zero zero =
    zeroR reals
  yVariable zero (suc zero) =
    oneR reals
  yVariable zero (suc (suc j)) =
    zeroR reals
  yVariable (suc i) j =
    zeroR reals

  addPolynomial : Polynomial -> Polynomial -> Polynomial
  addPolynomial p q i j =
    addR reals (p i j) (q i j)

  negatePolynomial : Polynomial -> Polynomial
  negatePolynomial p i j =
    negateR reals (p i j)

  subtractPolynomial : Polynomial -> Polynomial -> Polynomial
  subtractPolynomial p q =
    addPolynomial p (negatePolynomial q)

  scalePolynomial : R -> Polynomial -> Polynomial
  scalePolynomial c p i j =
    multiplyR reals c (p i j)

  multiplyPolynomial : Polynomial -> Polynomial -> Polynomial
  multiplyPolynomial p q i j =
    sumThrough
      (\ a ->
        sumThrough
          (\ b ->
            multiplyR reals
              (p a b)
              (q (i - a) (j - b)))
          j)
      i

  powerPolynomial : Polynomial -> Nat -> Polynomial
  powerPolynomial p zero =
    constantPolynomial (oneR reals)
  powerPolynomial p (suc n) =
    multiplyPolynomial (powerPolynomial p n) p

  twoR : R
  twoR =
    fromNatR reals (suc (suc zero))

  polynomialFamily : Nat -> R -> Polynomial
  polynomialFamily n delta =
    multiplyPolynomial
      (powerPolynomial
        (addPolynomial xVariable yVariable)
        n)
      (addPolynomial
        (subtractPolynomial
          (powerPolynomial xVariable (suc (suc zero)))
          (scalePolynomial
            (addR reals twoR (negateR reals delta))
            (multiplyPolynomial xVariable yVariable)))
        (powerPolynomial yVariable (suc (suc zero))))

  proposition : Set
  proposition =
    (epsilon : R) ->
    StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) epsilon ->
    StrictLess reals epsilon (oneR reals) ->
    Exists Nat
      (\ cutoff ->
        (n : Nat) ->
        cutoff <=N n ->
        (i : Nat) ->
        i <=N (n + suc (suc zero)) ->
        StrictLess reals
          (zeroR reals)
          (polynomialFamily n epsilon
            i
            ((n + suc (suc zero)) - i)))

putnam-1971-a4 : Set1
putnam-1971-a4 =
  (R : Set) ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) ->
  PolynomialDefinitions.proposition reals

  polynomial_add(
      left, right: bivariate_polynomial): bivariate_polynomial =
    LAMBDA (i, j: nat): left(i, j) + right(i, j)

  polynomial_negate(
      polynomial: bivariate_polynomial): bivariate_polynomial =
    LAMBDA (i, j: nat): -polynomial(i, j)

  polynomial_scale(
      scalar: real,
      polynomial: bivariate_polynomial): bivariate_polynomial =
    LAMBDA (i, j: nat): scalar * polynomial(i, j)

  convolution_y(
      left, right: bivariate_polynomial,
      i, j, a, count: nat): RECURSIVE real =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      LET b: nat = count - 1 IN
        convolution_y(left, right, i, j, a, count - 1)
          + IF a <= i AND b <= j THEN
              left(a, b) * right(i - a, j - b)
            ELSE
              0
            ENDIF
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  convolution_x(
      left, right: bivariate_polynomial,
      i, j, count: nat): RECURSIVE real =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      LET a: nat = count - 1 IN
        convolution_x(left, right, i, j, count - 1)
          + convolution_y(left, right, i, j, a, j + 1)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  polynomial_multiply(
      left, right: bivariate_polynomial): bivariate_polynomial =
    LAMBDA (i, j: nat):
      convolution_x(left, right, i, j, i + 1)

  polynomial_power(
      polynomial: bivariate_polynomial,
      exponent: nat): RECURSIVE bivariate_polynomial =
    IF exponent = 0 THEN
      polynomial_one
    ELSE
      polynomial_multiply(
        polynomial_power(polynomial, exponent - 1),
        polynomial)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE exponent

  x_plus_y: bivariate_polynomial =
    polynomial_add(polynomial_x, polynomial_y)

  quadratic(delta: real): bivariate_polynomial =
    polynomial_add(
      polynomial_add(
        polynomial_power(polynomial_x, 2),
        polynomial_negate(
          polynomial_scale(
            2 - delta,
            polynomial_multiply(polynomial_x, polynomial_y)))),
      polynomial_power(polynomial_y, 2))

  polynomial_family(
      n: nat,
      delta: real): bivariate_polynomial =
    polynomial_multiply(
      polynomial_power(x_plus_y, n),
      quadratic(delta))

  putnam_1971_a4: bool =
    FORALL (epsilon: real):
      (0 < epsilon AND epsilon < 1)
        IMPLIES
          EXISTS (N: nat):
            FORALL (n, i: nat):
              n >= N AND i <= n + 2 IMPLIES
                polynomial_family(
                  n, epsilon)(i, n + 2 - i) > 0
END putnam_1971_a4

    (x y : Z) (s : nat) : Prop :=

      Z.of_nat m * x + Z.of_nat n * y = Z.of_nat s.

  putnam_1971_a5_unattainable x y 58%nat.

Theorem putnam_1971_a5
    (a b : Z)

  putnam_1971_a5_pab a b <->
  a = fst putnam_1971_a5_solution /\
  b = snd putnam_1971_a5_solution.

;; Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1971_a5:
;; positive integer solitaire point values a > b have exactly 35 unattainable
;; accumulated scores, including 58, exactly when (a,b) = (11,8).
;; This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

;; For positive X and Y, a representation S = M*X + N*Y has M <= S.
;; Searching M downward from S is therefore exactly the source existential
;; quantification over natural M and N; divisibility of the nonnegative
;; remainder by Y supplies N internally.
(defun putnam-1971-a5-attainable-through-m-p (s x y m)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix m)))
  (if (zp m)
      (equal (mod s y) 0)
    (or
     (and
      (<= (* m x) s)
      (equal (mod (- s (* m x)) y) 0))
     (putnam-1971-a5-attainable-through-m-p
      s x y (- m 1)))))

(defun putnam-1971-a5-attainable-p (s x y)
  (and
   (natp s)
   (putnam-1971-a5-attainable-through-m-p s x y s)))

(defun putnam-1971-a5-unattainable-count-below (bound x y)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix bound)))
  (if (zp bound)
      0
    (let ((score (- bound 1)))
      (+
       (if (putnam-1971-a5-attainable-p score x y) 0 1)
       (putnam-1971-a5-unattainable-count-below
        score x y)))))

(defun putnam-1971-a5-gcd (x y)
  (declare (xargs :measure (+ (nfix x) (nfix y))))
  (if (and (natp x) (natp y))
      (cond
       ((equal x 0) y)
       ((equal y 0) x)
       ((< x y)
        (putnam-1971-a5-gcd x (- y x)))
       (t
        (putnam-1971-a5-gcd (- x y) y)))
    0))

;; For positive X and Y, the set of unattainable natural scores is finite
;; exactly when gcd(X,Y)=1. In that case every unattainable score is below
;; X*Y. Since ACL2, Isabelle card, and Lean ncard all give zero rather than 35
;; for an infinite set, this finite count is bidirectionally equivalent to the
;; source cardinality condition.
(defun putnam-1971-a5-source-condition-p (x y)
  (and
   (equal (putnam-1971-a5-gcd x y) 1)
   (equal
    (putnam-1971-a5-unattainable-count-below (* x y) x y)
    35)
   (not (putnam-1971-a5-attainable-p 58 x y))))

;; The universally specified source predicate PAB is inlined using its
;; defining biconditional. The source's designated solution is (11,8).
(defun putnambench-putnam-1971-a5-statement (a b)
  (implies
   (and
    (integerp a)
    (integerp b)
    (< 0 a)
    (< 0 b)
    (< b a))
   (equal
    (putnam-1971-a5-source-condition-p a b)
    (and (equal a 11)
         (equal b 8)))))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

-- accumulated totals including 58 exactly when (a , b) = (11 , 8).

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Int using (Int; pos; negsuc)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_)

infix 4 _!=_ _<N_ _<Z_
infixr 3 _and_

data Bottom : Set where

Not : Set -> Set
Not A =
  A -> Bottom

_!=_ : {A : Set} -> A -> A -> Set
x != y =
  Not (x == y)

record _and_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

record Iff (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor equivalence
  field
    forward  : A -> B
    backward : B -> A

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

data _<N_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set where
  zero<suc : {n : Nat} -> zero <N suc n
  suc<suc  : {m n : Nat} -> m <N n -> suc m <N suc n

data _<Z_ : Int -> Int -> Set where
  neg<pos : {m n : Nat} -> negsuc m <Z pos n
  pos<pos : {m n : Nat} -> m <N n -> pos m <Z pos n
  neg<neg : {m n : Nat} -> n <N m -> negsuc m <Z negsuc n

data PositiveInteger : Int -> Set where
  positive : {n : Nat} -> PositiveInteger (pos (suc n))

data Fin : Nat -> Set where
  fzero : {n : Nat} -> Fin (suc n)
  fsuc  : {n : Nat} -> Fin n -> Fin (suc n)

record HasCardinality
  {A : Set}
  (P : A -> Set)
  (cardinality : Nat) :
  Set where

  field
    enumerate :
      Fin cardinality ->
      A
    enumerated-member :
      (index : Fin cardinality) ->
      P (enumerate index)
    enumeration-complete :
      (x : A) ->
      P x ->
      Exists (Fin cardinality)
        (\ index -> x == enumerate index)
    enumeration-injective :
      (left-index right-index : Fin cardinality) ->
      enumerate left-index == enumerate right-index ->
      left-index == right-index

negative : Nat -> Int
negative zero =
  pos zero
negative (suc n) =
  negsuc n

difference : Nat -> Nat -> Int
difference zero zero =
  pos zero
difference (suc m) zero =
  pos (suc m)
difference zero (suc n) =
  negsuc n
difference (suc m) (suc n) =
  difference m n

addInt : Int -> Int -> Int
addInt (pos m) (pos n) =
  pos (m + n)
addInt (pos m) (negsuc n) =
  difference m (suc n)
addInt (negsuc m) (pos n) =
  difference n (suc m)
addInt (negsuc m) (negsuc n) =
  negsuc (suc (m + n))

scaleNat : Nat -> Int -> Int
scaleNat zero x =
  pos zero
scaleNat (suc n) x =
  addInt x (scaleNat n x)

score : Int -> Int -> Nat -> Nat -> Int
score x y m n =
  addInt (scaleNat m x) (scaleNat n y)

Unattainable : Int -> Int -> Nat -> Set
Unattainable x y s =
  Not
    (Exists Nat
      (\ m ->
        Exists Nat
          (\ n -> score x y m n == pos s)))

thirtyFive : Nat
thirtyFive =
  35

fiftyEight : Nat
fiftyEight =
  58

ScoreCondition : Int -> Int -> Set
ScoreCondition x y =
  HasCardinality (Unattainable x y) thirtyFive
  and
  Unattainable x y fiftyEight

elevenInt : Int
elevenInt =
  pos 11

eightInt : Int
eightInt =
  pos 8

putnam-1971-a5 : Set1
putnam-1971-a5 =
  (a b : Int) ->
  (PositiveInteger a and PositiveInteger b and b <Z a) ->
  (pab : Int -> Int -> Set) ->
  ((x y : Int) ->
    Iff
      (pab x y)
      (ScoreCondition x y)) ->
  Iff
    (pab a b)
    (a == elevenInt and b == eightInt)

;; Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1971_a6:
;; a real exponent whose power of every positive integer is an integer must
;; be a nonnegative integer. This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))

;; A Dedekind-complete ordered field presents the real numbers. Positive-base
;; real powers are uniquely fixed by their values at rational exponents and
;; continuity in the exponent. Thus the structure arguments below are an
;; explicit presentation of the source real field and its power operation,
;; without restricting the exponent or integer quantifiers to finite data.

(defun putnam-1971-a6-member-p (carrier x)
  (if (apply$ carrier (list x)) t nil))

(defun putnam-1971-a6-unary (operation x)
  (apply$ operation (list x)))

(defun putnam-1971-a6-binary (operation x y)
  (apply$ operation (list x y)))

(defun putnam-1971-a6-positive-p (carrier less zero x)
  (and
   (putnam-1971-a6-member-p carrier x)
   (apply$ less (list zero x))))

(defun-sk putnam-1971-a6-field-laws-p
    (carrier zero one add multiply negate inverse)
  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (putnam-1971-a6-member-p carrier x)
      (putnam-1971-a6-member-p carrier y)
      (putnam-1971-a6-member-p carrier z))
     (and
      (putnam-1971-a6-member-p
       carrier (putnam-1971-a6-binary add x y))
      (putnam-1971-a6-member-p
       carrier (putnam-1971-a6-binary multiply x y))
      (putnam-1971-a6-member-p
       carrier (putnam-1971-a6-unary negate x))
      (putnam-1971-a6-member-p
       carrier (putnam-1971-a6-unary inverse x))
      (equal
       (putnam-1971-a6-binary
        add (putnam-1971-a6-binary add x y) z)
       (putnam-1971-a6-binary
        add x (putnam-1971-a6-binary add y z)))
      (equal
       (putnam-1971-a6-binary add x y)
       (putnam-1971-a6-binary add y x))
      (equal (putnam-1971-a6-binary add x zero) x)
      (equal
       (putnam-1971-a6-binary
        add x (putnam-1971-a6-unary negate x))
       zero)
      (equal
       (putnam-1971-a6-binary
        multiply (putnam-1971-a6-binary multiply x y) z)
       (putnam-1971-a6-binary
        multiply x (putnam-1971-a6-binary multiply y z)))
      (equal
       (putnam-1971-a6-binary multiply x y)
       (putnam-1971-a6-binary multiply y x))
      (equal (putnam-1971-a6-binary multiply x one) x)
      (equal (putnam-1971-a6-unary inverse zero) zero)
      (implies
       (not (equal x zero))
       (equal
        (putnam-1971-a6-binary
         multiply x (putnam-1971-a6-unary inverse x))
        one))
      (equal
       (putnam-1971-a6-binary
        multiply x (putnam-1971-a6-binary add y z))
       (putnam-1971-a6-binary
        add
        (putnam-1971-a6-binary multiply x y)
        (putnam-1971-a6-binary multiply x z)))))))

(defun-sk putnam-1971-a6-order-laws-p
    (carrier zero add multiply less)
  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (putnam-1971-a6-member-p carrier x)
      (putnam-1971-a6-member-p carrier y)
      (putnam-1971-a6-member-p carrier z))
     (and
      (not (apply$ less (list x x)))
      (or
       (equal x y)
       (apply$ less (list x y))
       (apply$ less (list y x)))
      (implies
       (and
        (apply$ less (list x y))
        (apply$ less (list y z)))
       (apply$ less (list x z)))
      (implies
       (apply$ less (list x y))
       (apply$
        less
        (list
         (putnam-1971-a6-binary add x z)
         (putnam-1971-a6-binary add y z))))
      (implies
       (and
        (apply$ less (list zero x))
        (apply$ less (list zero y)))
       (apply$
        less
        (list zero
              (putnam-1971-a6-binary multiply x y))))))))

(defun-sk putnam-1971-a6-set-nonempty-p (carrier set)
  (exists (x)
    (and
     (putnam-1971-a6-member-p carrier x)
     (apply$ set (list x)))))

(defun-sk putnam-1971-a6-upper-bound-p
    (carrier less set bound)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (and
      (putnam-1971-a6-member-p carrier x)
      (apply$ set (list x)))
     (not (apply$ less (list bound x))))))

(defun-sk putnam-1971-a6-bounded-above-p
    (carrier less set)
  (exists (bound)
    (and
     (putnam-1971-a6-member-p carrier bound)
     (putnam-1971-a6-upper-bound-p
      carrier less set bound))))

(defun-sk putnam-1971-a6-supremum-p
    (carrier less set supremum)
  (forall (bound)
    (and
     (putnam-1971-a6-member-p carrier supremum)
     (putnam-1971-a6-upper-bound-p
      carrier less set supremum)
     (implies
      (and
       (putnam-1971-a6-member-p carrier bound)
       (putnam-1971-a6-upper-bound-p
        carrier less set bound))
      (not (apply$ less (list bound supremum)))))))

(defun-sk putnam-1971-a6-has-supremum-p
    (carrier less set)
  (exists (supremum)
    (putnam-1971-a6-supremum-p
     carrier less set supremum)))

(defun-sk putnam-1971-a6-dedekind-complete-p
    (carrier less)
  (forall (set)
    (implies
     (and
      (tamep-functionp set)
      (putnam-1971-a6-set-nonempty-p carrier set)
      (putnam-1971-a6-bounded-above-p carrier less set))
     (putnam-1971-a6-has-supremum-p
      carrier less set))))

(defun putnam-1971-a6-real-field-p
    (carrier zero one add multiply negate inverse less)
  (and
   (tamep-functionp carrier)
   (tamep-functionp add)
   (tamep-functionp multiply)
   (tamep-functionp negate)
   (tamep-functionp inverse)
   (tamep-functionp less)
   (putnam-1971-a6-member-p carrier zero)
   (putnam-1971-a6-member-p carrier one)
   (not (equal zero one))
   (putnam-1971-a6-field-laws-p
    carrier zero one add multiply negate inverse)
   (putnam-1971-a6-order-laws-p
    carrier zero add multiply less)
   (apply$ less (list zero one))
   (putnam-1971-a6-dedekind-complete-p carrier less)))

(defun putnam-1971-a6-natural
    (n zero one add)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix n)))
  (if (zp n)
      zero
    (putnam-1971-a6-binary
     add one
     (putnam-1971-a6-natural (- n 1) zero one add))))

(defun putnam-1971-a6-integer
    (n zero one add negate)
  (if (< n 0)
      (putnam-1971-a6-unary
       negate
       (putnam-1971-a6-natural (- n) zero one add))
    (putnam-1971-a6-natural n zero one add)))

(defun putnam-1971-a6-natural-power
    (base exponent one multiply)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix exponent)))
  (if (zp exponent)
      one
    (putnam-1971-a6-binary
     multiply
     (putnam-1971-a6-natural-power
      base (- exponent 1) one multiply)
     base)))

(defun putnam-1971-a6-integer-power
    (base exponent one multiply inverse)
  (if (< exponent 0)
      (putnam-1971-a6-unary
       inverse
       (putnam-1971-a6-natural-power
        base (- exponent) one multiply))
    (putnam-1971-a6-natural-power
     base exponent one multiply)))

(defun-sk putnam-1971-a6-power-typing-p
    (carrier zero less power)
  (forall (base exponent)
    (implies
     (and
      (putnam-1971-a6-positive-p carrier less zero base)
      (putnam-1971-a6-member-p carrier exponent))
     (putnam-1971-a6-positive-p
      carrier less zero
      (putnam-1971-a6-binary power base exponent)))))

(defun-sk putnam-1971-a6-power-rational-laws-p
    (carrier zero one add multiply negate inverse less power)
  (forall (base numerator denominator)
    (implies
     (and
      (putnam-1971-a6-positive-p carrier less zero base)
      (integerp numerator)
      (posp denominator))
     (equal
      (putnam-1971-a6-natural-power
       (putnam-1971-a6-binary
        power
        base
        (putnam-1971-a6-binary
         multiply
         (putnam-1971-a6-integer
          numerator zero one add negate)
         (putnam-1971-a6-unary
          inverse
          (putnam-1971-a6-natural
           denominator zero one add))))
       denominator one multiply)
      (putnam-1971-a6-integer-power
       base numerator one multiply inverse)))))

(defun putnam-1971-a6-absolute (zero negate less x)
  (if (apply$ less (list x zero))
      (putnam-1971-a6-unary negate x)
    x))

(defun putnam-1971-a6-distance
    (zero add negate less x y)
  (putnam-1971-a6-absolute
   zero negate less
   (putnam-1971-a6-binary
    add x (putnam-1971-a6-unary negate y))))

(defun-sk putnam-1971-a6-power-neighborhood-p
    (carrier zero add negate less power
     base exponent epsilon delta)
  (forall (y)
    (implies
     (and
      (putnam-1971-a6-member-p carrier y)
      (apply$
       less
       (list
        (putnam-1971-a6-distance
         zero add negate less y exponent)
        delta)))
     (apply$
      less
      (list
       (putnam-1971-a6-distance
        zero add negate less
        (putnam-1971-a6-binary power base y)
        (putnam-1971-a6-binary power base exponent))
       epsilon)))))

(defun-sk putnam-1971-a6-power-delta-exists-p
    (carrier zero add negate less power
     base exponent epsilon)
  (exists (delta)
    (and
     (putnam-1971-a6-positive-p carrier less zero delta)
     (putnam-1971-a6-power-neighborhood-p
      carrier zero add negate less power
      base exponent epsilon delta))))

(defun-sk putnam-1971-a6-power-continuous-p
    (carrier zero add negate less power)
  (forall (base exponent epsilon)
    (implies
     (and
      (putnam-1971-a6-positive-p carrier less zero base)
      (putnam-1971-a6-member-p carrier exponent)
      (putnam-1971-a6-positive-p carrier less zero epsilon))
     (putnam-1971-a6-power-delta-exists-p
      carrier zero add negate less power
      base exponent epsilon))))

(defun putnam-1971-a6-real-power-p
    (carrier zero one add multiply negate inverse less power)
  (and
   (tamep-functionp power)
   (putnam-1971-a6-power-typing-p
    carrier zero less power)
   (putnam-1971-a6-power-rational-laws-p
    carrier zero one add multiply negate inverse less power)
   (putnam-1971-a6-power-continuous-p
    carrier zero add negate less power)))

(defun-sk putnam-1971-a6-power-is-integer-p
    (zero one add negate power n c)
  (exists (m)
    (and
     (integerp m)
     (equal
      (putnam-1971-a6-binary
       power
       (putnam-1971-a6-integer n zero one add negate)
       c)
      (putnam-1971-a6-integer
       m zero one add negate)))))

(defun-sk putnam-1971-a6-all-positive-powers-integer-p
    (zero one add negate power c)
  (forall (n)
    (implies
     (and (integerp n)
          (< 0 n))
     (putnam-1971-a6-power-is-integer-p
      zero one add negate power n c))))

(defun-sk putnam-1971-a6-nonnegative-integer-p
    (zero one add negate c)
  (exists (m)
    (and
     (integerp m)
     (<= 0 m)
     (equal
      c
      (putnam-1971-a6-integer
       m zero one add negate)))))

(defun putnambench-putnam-1971-a6-statement
    (carrier zero one add multiply negate inverse less power c)
  (implies
   (and
    (putnam-1971-a6-real-field-p
     carrier zero one add multiply negate inverse less)
    (putnam-1971-a6-real-power-p
     carrier zero one add multiply negate inverse less power)
    (putnam-1971-a6-member-p carrier c)
    (putnam-1971-a6-all-positive-powers-integer-p
     zero one add negate power c))
   (putnam-1971-a6-nonnegative-integer-p
    zero one add negate c)))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

title: putnam_1971_a6
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1971_a6:
-- a real exponent whose powers of every positive integer are integers is
-- itself a nonnegative integer. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Int using (Int; pos; negsuc)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; _*_)

infix 4 _!=_
infixr 3 _and_
infixr 2 _or_

data Bottom : Set where

Not : Set -> Set
Not A =
  A -> Bottom

_!=_ : {A : Set} -> A -> A -> Set
x != y =
  Not (x == y)

record _and_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data _or_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  left  : A -> A or B
  right : B -> A or B

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

data _<=N_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set where
  zero<=   : {n : Nat} -> zero <=N n
  suc<=suc : {m n : Nat} -> m <=N n -> suc m <=N suc n

data NonnegativeInteger : Int -> Set where
  nonnegative : {n : Nat} -> NonnegativeInteger (pos n)

record CompleteOrderedRealField (R : Set) : Set1 where
  field
    zeroR oneR : R
    add multiply : R -> R -> R
    negate inverse : R -> R
    lessOrEqual : R -> R -> Set
    fromNat : Nat -> R

    one-not-zero :
      oneR != zeroR

    add-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> add x y == add y x
    add-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      add (add x y) z == add x (add y z)
    add-zero :
      (x : R) -> add x zeroR == x
    add-inverse :
      (x : R) -> add x (negate x) == zeroR

    multiply-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> multiply x y == multiply y x
    multiply-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply (multiply x y) z ==
      multiply x (multiply y z)
    multiply-one :
      (x : R) -> multiply x oneR == x
    multiply-zero :
      (x : R) -> multiply x zeroR == zeroR
    distribute :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply x (add y z) ==
      add (multiply x y) (multiply x z)
    inverse-zero :
      inverse zeroR == zeroR
    multiply-inverse :
      (x : R) ->
      x != zeroR ->
      multiply x (inverse x) == oneR

    order-reflexive :
      (x : R) -> lessOrEqual x x
    order-transitive :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y z ->
      lessOrEqual x z
    order-antisymmetric :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y x ->
      x == y
    order-total :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y or lessOrEqual y x
    add-order :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual (add z x) (add z y)
    multiply-nonnegative :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR x ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR y ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR (multiply x y)
    zero-less-than-one :
      lessOrEqual zeroR oneR and zeroR != oneR

    fromNat-zero :
      fromNat zero == zeroR
    fromNat-successor :
      (n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (suc n) == add (fromNat n) oneR
    fromNat-addition :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m + n) == add (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-multiplication :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m * n) == multiply (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-injective :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat m == fromNat n ->
      m == n

    archimedean :
      (x : R) ->
      Exists Nat (\ n -> lessOrEqual x (fromNat n))
    least-upper-bound :
      (P : R -> Set) ->
      Exists R P ->
      Exists R
        (\ upper ->
          (x : R) ->
          P x ->
          lessOrEqual x upper) ->
      Exists R
        (\ supremum ->
          ((x : R) ->
            P x ->
            lessOrEqual x supremum)
          and
          ((upper : R) ->
            ((x : R) ->
              P x ->
              lessOrEqual x upper) ->
            lessOrEqual supremum upper))

open CompleteOrderedRealField

fromInt :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Int ->
  R
fromInt reals (pos n) =
  fromNat reals n
fromInt reals (negsuc n) =
  negate reals (fromNat reals (suc n))

subtract :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
subtract reals x y =
  add reals x (negate reals y)

divide :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
divide reals x y =
  multiply reals x (inverse reals y)

StrictLess :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
StrictLess reals x y =
  lessOrEqual reals x y and x != y

CloseTo :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
CloseTo reals center radius x =
  StrictLess reals
    (subtract reals center radius)
    x
  and
  StrictLess reals
    x
    (add reals center radius)

naturalPower :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  Nat ->
  R
naturalPower reals x zero =
  oneR reals
naturalPower reals x (suc n) =
  multiply reals
    (naturalPower reals x n)
    x

factorial : Nat -> Nat
factorial zero =
  suc zero
factorial (suc n) =
  suc n * factorial n

sumFirst :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Nat ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  R
sumFirst reals zero term =
  zeroR reals
sumFirst reals (suc n) term =
  add reals
    (sumFirst reals n term)
    (term n)

ConvergesTo :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  R ->
  Set
ConvergesTo {R} reals sequence limit =
  (epsilon : R) ->
  StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) epsilon ->
  Exists Nat
    (\ cutoff ->
      (n : Nat) ->
      cutoff <=N n ->
      CloseTo reals limit epsilon (sequence n))

SeriesHasSum :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  R ->
  Set
SeriesHasSum reals terms limit =
  ConvergesTo reals
    (\ n -> sumFirst reals n terms)
    limit

exponentialTerm :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  Nat ->
  R
exponentialTerm reals x n =
  divide reals
    (naturalPower reals x n)
    (fromNat reals (factorial n))

ExponentialValue :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
ExponentialValue reals x value =
  SeriesHasSum reals
    (exponentialTerm reals x)
    value

record StandardRealPowers
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) :
  Set1 where

  field
    exponential logarithm : R -> R

    exponential-series :
      (x : R) ->
      ExponentialValue reals x (exponential x)

    exponential-positive :
      (x : R) ->
      StrictLess reals
        (zeroR reals)
        (exponential x)

    exponential-injective :
      (x y : R) ->
      exponential x == exponential y ->
      x == y

    exponential-logarithm :
      (x : R) ->
      StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) x ->
      exponential (logarithm x) == x

open StandardRealPowers

realPower :
  {R : Set} ->
  {reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R} ->
  StandardRealPowers reals ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
realPower {reals = reals} powers base exponent =
  exponential powers
    (multiply reals exponent (logarithm powers base))

module Putnam1971A6Statement
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R)
  (powers : StandardRealPowers reals) where

  IntegerValuedPositivePowers : R -> Set
  IntegerValuedPositivePowers c =
    (n : Nat) ->
    Exists Int
      (\ m ->
        realPower powers
          (fromNat reals (suc n))
          c
        ==
        fromInt reals m)

  IsNonnegativeInteger : R -> Set
  IsNonnegativeInteger c =
    Exists Int
      (\ m ->
        NonnegativeInteger m
        and
        c == fromInt reals m)

  proposition : Set
  proposition =
    (c : R) ->
    IntegerValuedPositivePowers c ->
    IsNonnegativeInteger c

putnam-1971-a6 : Set1
putnam-1971-a6 =
  (R : Set) ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) ->
  (powers : StandardRealPowers reals) ->
  Putnam1971A6Statement.proposition reals powers

$(

  putnam_1971_a6: a real number whose power of every positive integer
  base is an integer is itself a nonnegative integer. This file contains

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  SetMM's NN is the class of positive integers. For a positive base n,
  the complex-power operation n ^c c agrees with the source real power
  exp(c log n). Integer-valuedness and the nonnegative-integer conclusion
  are both represented with their integer witnesses internally quantified.

  database contains no $p proof statement.

${

    (
      (
        A. n e. NN E. m e. ZZ
          ( n ^c c ) = m
      )
      ->
      E. m e. ZZ
        (
          0 <_ m
          /\
          c = m
        )
    )
  $.
$}

title: putnam_1971_a6
content:
% Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench artifact putnam_1971_a6:
% a real exponent whose power of every positive integer is an integer must
% be a nonnegative integer. This file contains no proof.

putnam_1971_a6: THEORY
BEGIN
  safe_div(x, y: real): real =
    IF y = 0 THEN 0 ELSE x / y ENDIF

  nat_factorial(n: nat): RECURSIVE nat =
    IF n = 0 THEN
      1
    ELSE
      n * nat_factorial(n - 1)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE n

  exponential_partial(x: real, count: nat): RECURSIVE real =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      LET j: nat = count - 1 IN
        exponential_partial(x, count - 1)
          + safe_div(x ^ j, nat_factorial(j) :: real)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  converges_to(sequence: [nat -> real], value: real): bool =
    FORALL (eps: posreal):
      EXISTS (cutoff: nat):
        FORALL (index: nat):
          cutoff <= index IMPLIES
            abs(sequence(index) - value) < eps

  exponential_value(x, value: real): bool =
    converges_to(
      (LAMBDA (count: nat): exponential_partial(x, count)),
      value)

  real_power_value(base, exponent, value: real): bool =
    base > 0
      AND EXISTS (log_base: real):
        exponential_value(log_base, base)
          AND exponential_value(exponent * log_base, value)

  putnam_1971_a6: bool =
    FORALL (c: real):
      (FORALL (n: int):
        n > 0 IMPLIES
          EXISTS (m: int):
            real_power_value(n :: real, c, m :: real))
      IMPLIES
        EXISTS (m: int):
          m >= 0 AND c = (m :: real)
END putnam_1971_a6

import Mathlib

open Set MvPolynomial

/--
Let $S$ be a set and let $\cdot$ be a binary operation on $S$ satisfying the two following laws: (1) for all $x$ in $S$, $x = x \cdot x$, (2) for all $x,y,z$ in $S$, $(x \cdot y) \cdot z) = (y \cdot z) \cdot x$. Show that $\cdot$ is associative and commutative.
-/
theorem putnam_1971_b1
(S : Type*) [Mul S]
(hself : ∀ x : S, x * x = x)
(h2 : ∀ x y z : S, (x * y) * z = (y * z) * x)
: (∀ x y z : S, (x * y) * z = x * (y * z)) ∧ (∀ x y : S, x * y = y * x) :=
sorry

;; Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1971_b1:
;; an idempotent binary operation satisfying the cyclic three-variable law is
;; associative and commutative. This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

;; CARRIER and OP are ACL2 function objects.  The generated predicate lambdas
;; return T outside CARRIER, so FN-EQUAL with the matching constant-T lambda
;; expresses universal quantification over exactly the represented type.

(defun putnam-1971-b1-quoted (object)
  (list 'quote object))

(defun putnam-1971-b1-apply1-term (function argument)
  (list 'apply$
        (putnam-1971-b1-quoted function)
        (list 'cons argument nil)))

(defun putnam-1971-b1-apply2-term (function left right)
  (list 'apply$
        (putnam-1971-b1-quoted function)
        (list 'cons left
              (list 'cons right nil))))

(defun putnam-1971-b1-carrier-term (carrier element)
  (putnam-1971-b1-apply1-term carrier element))

(defun putnam-1971-b1-operation-term (op left right)
  (putnam-1971-b1-apply2-term op left right))

(defun putnam-1971-b1-all-in-carrier-term
    (carrier variables)
  (if (endp variables)
      t
    (list 'if
          (putnam-1971-b1-carrier-term
           carrier (car variables))
          (putnam-1971-b1-all-in-carrier-term
           carrier (cdr variables))
          nil)))

(defun putnam-1971-b1-restricted-predicate-term
    (carrier variables proposition)
  (list 'if
        (putnam-1971-b1-all-in-carrier-term
         carrier variables)
        proposition
        t))

(defun putnam-1971-b1-true-function (formals)
  (list 'lambda formals t))

(defun putnam-1971-b1-closure-function (carrier op)
  (let ((op-xy
         (putnam-1971-b1-operation-term op 'x 'y)))
    (list
     'lambda
     '(x y)
     (putnam-1971-b1-restricted-predicate-term
      carrier
      '(x y)
      (putnam-1971-b1-carrier-term carrier op-xy)))))

(defun putnam-1971-b1-idempotent-function (carrier op)
  (list
   'lambda
   '(x)
   (putnam-1971-b1-restricted-predicate-term
    carrier
    '(x)
    (list
     'equal
     (putnam-1971-b1-operation-term op 'x 'x)
     'x))))

(defun putnam-1971-b1-cyclic-function (carrier op)
  (let* ((op-xy
          (putnam-1971-b1-operation-term op 'x 'y))
         (op-yz
          (putnam-1971-b1-operation-term op 'y 'z)))
    (list
     'lambda
     '(x y z)
     (putnam-1971-b1-restricted-predicate-term
      carrier
      '(x y z)
      (list
       'equal
       (putnam-1971-b1-operation-term op op-xy 'z)
       (putnam-1971-b1-operation-term op op-yz 'x))))))

(defun putnam-1971-b1-associative-function (carrier op)
  (let* ((op-xy
          (putnam-1971-b1-operation-term op 'x 'y))
         (op-yz
          (putnam-1971-b1-operation-term op 'y 'z)))
    (list
     'lambda
     '(x y z)
     (putnam-1971-b1-restricted-predicate-term
      carrier
      '(x y z)
      (list
       'equal
       (putnam-1971-b1-operation-term op op-xy 'z)
       (putnam-1971-b1-operation-term op 'x op-yz))))))

(defun putnam-1971-b1-commutative-function (carrier op)
  (list
   'lambda
   '(x y)
   (putnam-1971-b1-restricted-predicate-term
    carrier
    '(x y)
    (list
     'equal
     (putnam-1971-b1-operation-term op 'x 'y)
     (putnam-1971-b1-operation-term op 'y 'x)))))

(defun putnambench-putnam-1971-b1-statement (carrier op)
  (implies
   (and
    (tamep-functionp carrier)
    (tamep-functionp op)
    (fn-equal
     (putnam-1971-b1-closure-function carrier op)
     (putnam-1971-b1-true-function '(x y)))
    (fn-equal
     (putnam-1971-b1-idempotent-function carrier op)
     (putnam-1971-b1-true-function '(x)))
    (fn-equal
     (putnam-1971-b1-cyclic-function carrier op)
     (putnam-1971-b1-true-function '(x y z))))
   (and
    (fn-equal
     (putnam-1971-b1-associative-function carrier op)
     (putnam-1971-b1-true-function '(x y z)))
    (fn-equal
     (putnam-1971-b1-commutative-function carrier op)
     (putnam-1971-b1-true-function '(x y))))))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

/--
Find all functions $F : \mathbb{R} \setminus \{0, 1\} \to \mathbb{R}$ that satisfy $F(x) + F\left(\frac{x - 1}{x}\right) = 1 + x$ for all $x \in \mathbb{R} \setminus \{0, 1\}$.

: (∀ F ∈ putnam_1971_b2_solution, P F) ∧ ∀ f : ℝ → ℝ, P f → ∃ F ∈ putnam_1971_b2_solution, (∀ x ∈ S, f x = F x) :=

let statement =
  `let S = {x:real | ~(x = &0) /\ ~(x = &1)} in
   let satisfies =
     \(f:real->real).
       !x. x IN S ==> f x + f ((x - &1) / x) = &1 + x in
   let is_solution =

title: putnam_1971_b2
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1971_b2:
;; the unique real function on R minus {0,1} satisfying a three-cycle
;; functional equation is the specified rational function. This file contains
;; no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

;; On S = R minus {0,1}, T(x) = (x-1)/x has order three.  Hence the source
;; predicate for a function F is, on each orbit, exactly the three equations
;;
;;   F(x)     + F(T(x))   = 1 + x,
;;   F(T(x))  + F(T^2(x)) = 1 + T(x),
;;   F(T^2(x)) + F(x)     = 1 + T^2(x).
;;
;; The source's singleton-solution assertion is therefore equivalent to the
;; conjunction below: the displayed solution satisfies the equation, and
;; every arbitrary triple satisfying the orbit equations has the displayed
;; value at x.  Conversely, any such triple extends orbitwise to a function,
;; so this local form also implies the original higher-order uniqueness claim.
;;
;; Standard ACL2 has exact rationals rather than a primitive real sort.  This
;; local rational predicate is bidirectionally equivalent to the real
;; statement, not a restriction of its generality.  After solving the three
;; linear equations, both a failure of the solution equation and a failure of
;; uniqueness are nonzero rational-function conditions in x.  Any real
;; failure away from the excluded poles persists at a nearby rational x, and
;; the corresponding three values are rational.  Every rational failure is
;; immediately a real failure.

(defun putnam-1971-b2-transform (x)
  (/ (- x 1) x))

(defun putnam-1971-b2-solution-value (x)
  (/ (- (- (expt x 3)
           (expt x 2))
        1)
     (* 2 x (- x 1))))

(defun putnambench-putnam-1971-b2-statement
    (x value-at-x value-at-tx value-at-t2x)
  (implies
   (and
    (rationalp x)
    (not (equal x 0))
    (not (equal x 1))
    (rationalp value-at-x)
    (rationalp value-at-tx)
    (rationalp value-at-t2x))
   (let* ((tx (putnam-1971-b2-transform x))
          (t2x (putnam-1971-b2-transform tx)))
     (and
      (equal
       (+ (putnam-1971-b2-solution-value x)
          (putnam-1971-b2-solution-value tx))
       (+ 1 x))
      (implies
       (and
        (equal (+ value-at-x value-at-tx)
               (+ 1 x))
        (equal (+ value-at-tx value-at-t2x)
               (+ 1 tx))
        (equal (+ value-at-t2x value-at-x)
               (+ 1 t2x)))
       (equal value-at-x
              (putnam-1971-b2-solution-value x)))))))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

title: putnam_1971_b2
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1971_b2:
-- every real function satisfying F(x) + F((x - 1) / x) = 1 + x away from
-- 0 and 1 agrees there with (x^3 - x^2 - 1) / (2*x*(x - 1)), which itself
-- satisfies the equation. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; _*_)

infix 4 _!=_
infixr 3 _and_
infixr 2 _or_

data Bottom : Set where

Not : Set -> Set
Not A =
  A -> Bottom

_!=_ : {A : Set} -> A -> A -> Set
x != y =
  Not (x == y)

record _and_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data _or_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  left  : A -> A or B
  right : B -> A or B

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

record CompleteOrderedRealField (R : Set) : Set1 where
  field
    zeroR oneR : R
    add multiply : R -> R -> R
    negate inverse : R -> R
    lessOrEqual : R -> R -> Set
    fromNat : Nat -> R

    one-not-zero :
      oneR != zeroR

    add-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> add x y == add y x
    add-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      add (add x y) z == add x (add y z)
    add-zero :
      (x : R) -> add x zeroR == x
    add-inverse :
      (x : R) -> add x (negate x) == zeroR

    multiply-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> multiply x y == multiply y x
    multiply-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply (multiply x y) z ==
      multiply x (multiply y z)
    multiply-one :
      (x : R) -> multiply x oneR == x
    multiply-zero :
      (x : R) -> multiply x zeroR == zeroR
    distribute :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply x (add y z) ==
      add (multiply x y) (multiply x z)
    inverse-zero :
      inverse zeroR == zeroR
    multiply-inverse :
      (x : R) ->
      x != zeroR ->
      multiply x (inverse x) == oneR

    order-reflexive :
      (x : R) -> lessOrEqual x x
    order-transitive :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y z ->
      lessOrEqual x z
    order-antisymmetric :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y x ->
      x == y
    order-total :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y or lessOrEqual y x
    add-order :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual (add z x) (add z y)
    multiply-nonnegative :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR x ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR y ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR (multiply x y)
    zero-less-than-one :
      lessOrEqual zeroR oneR and zeroR != oneR

    fromNat-zero :
      fromNat zero == zeroR
    fromNat-successor :
      (n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (suc n) == add (fromNat n) oneR
    fromNat-addition :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m + n) == add (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-multiplication :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m * n) == multiply (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-injective :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat m == fromNat n ->
      m == n

    archimedean :
      (x : R) ->
      Exists Nat (\ n -> lessOrEqual x (fromNat n))
    least-upper-bound :
      (P : R -> Set) ->
      Exists R P ->
      Exists R
        (\ upper ->
          (x : R) ->
          P x ->
          lessOrEqual x upper) ->
      Exists R
        (\ supremum ->
          ((x : R) ->
            P x ->
            lessOrEqual x supremum)
          and
          ((upper : R) ->
            ((x : R) ->
              P x ->
              lessOrEqual x upper) ->
            lessOrEqual supremum upper))

open CompleteOrderedRealField

subtract :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
subtract reals x y =
  add reals x (negate reals y)

divide :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
divide reals x y =
  multiply reals x (inverse reals y)

module Putnam1971B2Statement
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) where

  two : R
  two =
    fromNat reals (suc (suc zero))

  square : R -> R
  square x =
    multiply reals x x

  cube : R -> R
  cube x =
    multiply reals (square x) x

  solution : R -> R
  solution x =
    divide reals
      (subtract reals
        (subtract reals (cube x) (square x))
        (oneR reals))
      (multiply reals
        (multiply reals two x)
        (subtract reals x (oneR reals)))

  InDomain : R -> Set
  InDomain x =
    x != zeroR reals
    and
    x != oneR reals

  transformed : R -> R
  transformed x =
    divide reals
      (subtract reals x (oneR reals))
      x

  SatisfiesEquation : (R -> R) -> Set
  SatisfiesEquation F =
    (x : R) ->
    InDomain x ->
    add reals (F x) (F (transformed x)) ==
    add reals (oneR reals) x

  AgreesWithSolution : (R -> R) -> Set
  AgreesWithSolution F =
    (x : R) ->
    InDomain x ->
    F x == solution x

  proposition : Set
  proposition =
    SatisfiesEquation solution
    and
    ((F : R -> R) ->
      SatisfiesEquation F ->
      AgreesWithSolution F)

putnam-1971-b2 : Set1
putnam-1971-b2 =
  (R : Set) ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) ->
  Putnam1971B2Statement.proposition reals

(*
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench artifact putnam_1971_b2:
  classification of real functions on the reals excluding zero and one that
  satisfy a functional equation. This file contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open pred_setTheory realTheory;

val putnam_1971_b2 =
  ``let S = {x : real | x <> 0 /\ x <> 1}
    in
    let solution =
      \x : real.
        (x pow 3 - x pow 2 - 1) / (2 * x * (x - 1))
    in
    let solutions = {solution}
    in
    let P =
      \F : real -> real.
        !x : real.
          x IN S ==> F x + F ((x - 1) / x) = 1 + x
    in
      (!F : real -> real. F IN solutions ==> P F) /\
      (!f : real -> real.
         P f
         ==>
         ?F : real -> real.
           F IN solutions /\
           !x : real. x IN S ==> f x = F x)``;

  source conjunction after expanding its property and singleton solution-set
  definitions.

  The function definition and final corpus statement are unproved $a
  declarations; this database contains no $p proof statement.
$)

$c P71B2F $.

p71b2-function-syntax $a class P71B2F $.

p71b2-function-definition $a |- P71B2F =
  (
    x e. RR |->
      (
        ( ( ( x ^ 3 ) - ( x ^ 2 ) ) - 1 )
        /
        ( ( 2 x. x ) x. ( x - 1 ) )
      )
  )
$.

${
  $d f x $.

  putnambench-putnam-1971-b2 $a |- (
    (

          +

$}

:: the real functions satisfying F(x) + F((x-1)/x) = 1+x away from 0 and 1
:: are uniquely determined by an explicit rational formula. This file
:: contains no proof.

title: putnam_1971_b2
content:
% Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench artifact putnam_1971_b2:
% the real functions satisfying the stated functional equation away from
% zero and one are exactly the displayed rational function there.
% This file contains no proof.

putnam_1971_b2: THEORY
BEGIN
  real_function: TYPE = [real -> real]

  quotient_or_zero(numerator, denominator: real): real =
    IF denominator = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      numerator / denominator
    ENDIF

  in_domain(x: real): bool =
    x /= 0 AND x /= 1

  putnam_1971_b2_solution(F: real_function): bool =
    F = (LAMBDA (x: real):
      quotient_or_zero(
        x ^ 3 - x ^ 2 - 1,
        2 * x * (x - 1)))

  satisfies_equation(F: real_function): bool =
    FORALL (x: real):
      in_domain(x) IMPLIES
        F(x) + F(quotient_or_zero(x - 1, x)) = 1 + x

  agree_on_domain(f, F: real_function): bool =
    FORALL (x: real):
      in_domain(x) IMPLIES f(x) = F(x)

  putnam_1971_b2: bool =
    (FORALL (F: real_function):
      putnam_1971_b2_solution(F) IMPLIES satisfies_equation(F))
    AND
    (FORALL (f: real_function):
      satisfies_equation(f) IMPLIES
        EXISTS (F: real_function):
          putnam_1971_b2_solution(F)
            AND agree_on_domain(f, F))
END putnam_1971_b2

title: putnam_1971_b3
content:
(* Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench artifact putnam_1971_b3:
   the Lebesgue measure of the times when one integer lap count is twice the
   delayed lap count is one, for every positive delay. This file contains no
   proof. *)

From Stdlib Require Import Reals ZArith.

Open Scope R_scope.

Definition real_set := R -> Prop.

Record open_interval : Type := {
  interval_lower : R;
  interval_upper : R
}.

Definition in_open_interval
    (interval : open_interval) (x : R) : Prop :=
  interval_lower interval < x < interval_upper interval.

Definition interval_length (interval : open_interval) : R :=
  Rmax 0 (interval_upper interval - interval_lower interval).

Definition intervals_cover
    (A : real_set) (intervals : nat -> open_interval) : Prop :=
  forall x : R,
    A x ->
    exists n : nat, in_open_interval (intervals n) x.

Fixpoint partial_interval_length
    (intervals : nat -> open_interval) (n : nat) : R :=
  match n with
  | O => 0
  | S k =>
      partial_interval_length intervals k +
      interval_length (intervals k)
  end.

(* This is the countable-open-interval characterization of one-dimensional
   Lebesgue outer measure. *)
Definition has_lebesgue_measure
    (A : real_set) (measure : R) : Prop :=
  0 <= measure /\
  (forall intervals : nat -> open_interval,
    intervals_cover A intervals ->
    forall lower : R,
      lower < measure ->
      exists n : nat,
        lower < partial_interval_length intervals n) /\
  (forall epsilon : R,
    0 < epsilon ->
    exists intervals : nat -> open_interval,
      intervals_cover A intervals /\
      forall n : nat,
        partial_interval_length intervals n < measure + epsilon).

Definition putnam_1971_b3_times (T : R) : real_set :=
  fun t : R =>
    T <= t /\
    Int_part t = (2 * Int_part (t - T))%Z.

Theorem putnam_1971_b3
    (T : R)
    (hT : 0 < T) :
  has_lebesgue_measure (putnam_1971_b3_times T) 1.
Admitted.

content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench artifact putnam_1971_b3:
  the real times at which one equal-speed traveler has completed exactly twice
  as many laps as a later-starting traveler have Lebesgue measure one. This
  file contains no proof.
*)

let statement =
  `let floor_real =
     \x:real. @z:real. integer z /\ z <= x /\ x < z + &1 in
   let cover_length =
     \(a:num->real) (b:num->real).
       sup (IMAGE
             (\n. sum (0..n) (\k. b k - a k))
             (:num)) in
   let lebesgue_outer_measure =
     \(s:real->bool).
       inf {m:real |
              ?a b:num->real.
                (!n. a n <= b n) /\
                (?B. !n. sum (0..n) (\k. b k - a k) <= B) /\
                (!x. x IN s ==> ?n. a n < x /\ x < b n) /\
                m = cover_length a b} in
   !tau:real.
     &0 < tau
     ==> lebesgue_outer_measure
           {t:real |
              tau <= t /\
              floor_real t = &2 * floor_real (t - tau)} = &1`;;

title: putnam_1971_b3
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1971_b3:
;; the Lebesgue measure of the real times at which one car has completed
;; exactly twice as many laps as a later-starting car is one hour. This file
;; contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

;; Write the positive real delay as T = n + a, where n = floor(T) and
;; 0 <= a < 1.  After translating t by T, split u = t - T >= 0 into the
;; unit cells k <= u < k+1.  Writing u = k+s, the source floor equality is
;;
;;   floor(n+a+k+s) = 2*k.
;;
;; Thus the contribution of cell k is the length of the intersection of
;; [0,1) with [k-n-a, k+1-n-a).  Cells above n+1 are empty, so the finite
;; sum below is exactly the source set's Lebesgue measure.
;;
;; The resulting measure is a rational piecewise-linear expression in a,
;; with rational breakpoints.  Its equality to 1 for every real a in [0,1)
;; is equivalent to its equality for every rational a there: a real failure
;; inside a linear piece persists at a nearby rational, and every breakpoint
;; is rational.  Hence rationalp is an exact validity encoding here, not a
;; restriction of the source's arbitrary real delay.

(defun putnam-1971-b3-cell-measure (n a k)
  (let* ((lower (- (- k n) a))
         (upper (+ lower 1))
         (left (if (< lower 0) 0 lower))
         (right (if (< 1 upper) 1 upper)))
    (if (< left right)
        (- right left)
      0)))

(defun putnam-1971-b3-measure-sum (n a k)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix k)))
  (if (zp k)
      (putnam-1971-b3-cell-measure n a 0)
    (+ (putnam-1971-b3-cell-measure n a k)
       (putnam-1971-b3-measure-sum n a (- k 1)))))

(defun putnambench-putnam-1971-b3-statement (n a)
  (implies
   (and
    (natp n)
    (rationalp a)
    (<= 0 a)
    (< a 1)
    (or (< 0 n)
        (< 0 a)))
   (equal
    (putnam-1971-b3-measure-sum n a (+ n 1))
    1)))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

title: putnam_1971_b3
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1971_b3:
-- for every positive start delay T, the set of times t at least T for which
-- floor(t) is twice floor(t - T) has Lebesgue measure one. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Int using (Int; pos; negsuc)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; _*_)

infix 4 _!=_
infixr 3 _and_
infixr 2 _or_

data Bottom : Set where

record Top : Set where
  constructor top

Not : Set -> Set
Not A =
  A -> Bottom

_!=_ : {A : Set} -> A -> A -> Set
x != y =
  Not (x == y)

record _and_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data _or_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  left  : A -> A or B
  right : B -> A or B

record Iff (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor equivalence
  field
    forward  : A -> B
    backward : B -> A

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

Predicate : Set -> Set1
Predicate A =
  A -> Set

emptySet :
  {A : Set} ->
  Predicate A
emptySet _ =
  Bottom

complement :
  {A : Set} ->
  Predicate A ->
  Predicate A
complement S x =
  Not (S x)

countableUnion :
  {A : Set} ->
  (Nat -> Predicate A) ->
  Predicate A
countableUnion sets x =
  Exists Nat (\ n -> sets n x)

Subset :
  {A : Set} ->
  Predicate A ->
  Predicate A ->
  Set
Subset {A} S T =
  (x : A) ->
  S x ->
  T x

PairwiseDisjoint :
  {A : Set} ->
  (Nat -> Predicate A) ->
  Set
PairwiseDisjoint {A} sets =
  (i j : Nat) ->
  i != j ->
  (x : A) ->
  sets i x ->
  sets j x ->
  Bottom

record CompleteOrderedRealField (R : Set) : Set1 where
  field
    zeroR oneR : R
    add multiply : R -> R -> R
    negate inverse : R -> R
    lessOrEqual : R -> R -> Set
    fromNat : Nat -> R

    one-not-zero :
      oneR != zeroR

    add-commutative :
      (x y : R) ->
      add x y == add y x
    add-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      add (add x y) z == add x (add y z)
    add-zero :
      (x : R) ->
      add x zeroR == x
    add-inverse :
      (x : R) ->
      add x (negate x) == zeroR

    multiply-commutative :
      (x y : R) ->
      multiply x y == multiply y x
    multiply-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply (multiply x y) z ==
      multiply x (multiply y z)
    multiply-one :
      (x : R) ->
      multiply x oneR == x
    multiply-zero :
      (x : R) ->
      multiply x zeroR == zeroR
    distribute :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply x (add y z) ==
      add (multiply x y) (multiply x z)
    inverse-zero :
      inverse zeroR == zeroR
    multiply-inverse :
      (x : R) ->
      x != zeroR ->
      multiply x (inverse x) == oneR

    order-reflexive :
      (x : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x x
    order-transitive :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y z ->
      lessOrEqual x z
    order-antisymmetric :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y x ->
      x == y
    order-total :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y or lessOrEqual y x
    add-order :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual (add z x) (add z y)
    multiply-nonnegative :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR x ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR y ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR (multiply x y)
    zero-less-than-one :
      lessOrEqual zeroR oneR and zeroR != oneR

    fromNat-zero :
      fromNat zero == zeroR
    fromNat-successor :
      (n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (suc n) == add (fromNat n) oneR
    fromNat-addition :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m + n) == add (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-multiplication :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m * n) == multiply (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-injective :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat m == fromNat n ->
      m == n

    archimedean :
      (x : R) ->
      Exists Nat (\ n -> lessOrEqual x (fromNat n))
    least-upper-bound :
      (P : Predicate R) ->
      Exists R P ->
      Exists R
        (\ upper ->
          (x : R) ->
          P x ->
          lessOrEqual x upper) ->
      Exists R
        (\ supremum ->
          ((x : R) ->
            P x ->
            lessOrEqual x supremum)
          and
          ((upper : R) ->
            ((x : R) ->
              P x ->
              lessOrEqual x upper) ->
            lessOrEqual supremum upper))

open CompleteOrderedRealField

subtract :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
subtract reals x y =
  add reals x (negate reals y)

StrictLess :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
StrictLess reals x y =
  lessOrEqual reals x y and x != y

fromInt :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Int ->
  R
fromInt reals (pos n) =
  fromNat reals n
fromInt reals (negsuc n) =
  negate reals (fromNat reals (suc n))

successorInt : Int -> Int
successorInt (pos n) =
  pos (suc n)
successorInt (negsuc zero) =
  pos zero
successorInt (negsuc (suc n)) =
  negsuc n

doubleInt : Int -> Int
doubleInt (pos n) =
  pos (n + n)
doubleInt (negsuc n) =
  negsuc (suc (n + n))

record StandardFloor
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) : Set1 where
  field
    floor : R -> Int

    floor-lower :
      (x : R) ->
      lessOrEqual reals
        (fromInt reals (floor x))
        x
    floor-upper :
      (x : R) ->
      StrictLess reals
        x
        (fromInt reals (successorInt (floor x)))
    floor-unique :
      (x : R) ->
      (z : Int) ->
      lessOrEqual reals (fromInt reals z) x ->
      StrictLess reals x (fromInt reals (successorInt z)) ->
      floor x == z

open StandardFloor

HalfOpen :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Predicate R
HalfOpen reals lower upper x =
  lessOrEqual reals lower x
  and
  StrictLess reals x upper

data ExtendedNonnegative
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) : Set where
  finiteE   : R -> ExtendedNonnegative reals
  infinityE : ExtendedNonnegative reals

NonnegativeExtended :
  {R : Set} ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) ->
  ExtendedNonnegative reals ->
  Set
NonnegativeExtended reals (finiteE value) =
  lessOrEqual reals (zeroR reals) value
NonnegativeExtended reals infinityE =
  Top

LessOrEqualE :
  {R : Set} ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) ->
  ExtendedNonnegative reals ->
  ExtendedNonnegative reals ->
  Set
LessOrEqualE reals (finiteE x) (finiteE y) =
  lessOrEqual reals x y
LessOrEqualE reals (finiteE x) infinityE =
  Top
LessOrEqualE reals infinityE (finiteE y) =
  Bottom
LessOrEqualE reals infinityE infinityE =
  Top

addE :
  {R : Set} ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) ->
  ExtendedNonnegative reals ->
  ExtendedNonnegative reals ->
  ExtendedNonnegative reals
addE reals (finiteE x) (finiteE y) =
  finiteE (add reals x y)
addE reals infinityE y =
  infinityE
addE reals (finiteE x) infinityE =
  infinityE

sumFirstE :
  {R : Set} ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) ->
  (Nat -> ExtendedNonnegative reals) ->
  Nat ->
  ExtendedNonnegative reals
sumFirstE reals terms zero =
  finiteE (zeroR reals)
sumFirstE reals terms (suc n) =
  addE reals
    (sumFirstE reals terms n)
    (terms n)

record IsCountableSum
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R)
  (terms : Nat -> ExtendedNonnegative reals)
  (total : ExtendedNonnegative reals) : Set1 where
  field
    partial-sums-below :
      (n : Nat) ->
      LessOrEqualE reals
        (sumFirstE reals terms n)
        total
    least-upper-bound :
      (bound : ExtendedNonnegative reals) ->
      ((n : Nat) ->
        LessOrEqualE reals
          (sumFirstE reals terms n)
          bound) ->
      LessOrEqualE reals total bound

record StandardLebesgueMeasure
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) : Set1 where
  field
    measurable : Predicate R -> Set
    measure : Predicate R -> ExtendedNonnegative reals

    measurable-empty :
      measurable emptySet
    measurable-complement :
      (S : Predicate R) ->
      measurable S ->
      measurable (complement S)
    measurable-countable-union :
      (sets : Nat -> Predicate R) ->
      ((n : Nat) -> measurable (sets n)) ->
      measurable (countableUnion sets)
    measurable-congruent :
      (S T : Predicate R) ->
      ((x : R) -> Iff (S x) (T x)) ->
      measurable S ->
      measurable T
    measurable-open-ray :
      (endpoint : R) ->
      measurable (\ x -> StrictLess reals endpoint x)
    measurable-complete :
      (N S : Predicate R) ->
      measurable N ->
      measure N == finiteE (zeroR reals) ->
      Subset S N ->
      measurable S

    measure-congruent :
      (S T : Predicate R) ->
      ((x : R) -> Iff (S x) (T x)) ->
      measure S == measure T
    measure-empty :
      measure emptySet == finiteE (zeroR reals)
    measure-nonnegative :
      (S : Predicate R) ->
      measurable S ->
      NonnegativeExtended reals (measure S)
    measure-half-open :
      (lower upper : R) ->
      lessOrEqual reals lower upper ->
      measure (HalfOpen reals lower upper) ==
      finiteE (subtract reals upper lower)
    measure-countable-additivity :
      (sets : Nat -> Predicate R) ->
      ((n : Nat) -> measurable (sets n)) ->
      PairwiseDisjoint sets ->
      IsCountableSum reals
        (\ n -> measure (sets n))
        (measure (countableUnion sets))
    measure-complete-null-subset :
      (N S : Predicate R) ->
      measurable N ->
      measure N == finiteE (zeroR reals) ->
      Subset S N ->
      measure S == finiteE (zeroR reals)

open StandardLebesgueMeasure

module Putnam1971B3Statement
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R)
  (flooring : StandardFloor reals)
  (lebesgue : StandardLebesgueMeasure reals) where

  targetSet : R -> Predicate R
  targetSet T t =
    lessOrEqual reals T t
    and
    floor flooring t ==
      doubleInt (floor flooring (subtract reals t T))

  proposition : Set
  proposition =
    (T : R) ->
    StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) T ->
    measure lebesgue (targetSet T) ==
      finiteE (oneR reals)

putnam-1971-b3 : Set1
putnam-1971-b3 =
  (R : Set) ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) ->
  (flooring : StandardFloor reals) ->
  (lebesgue : StandardLebesgueMeasure reals) ->
  Putnam1971B3Statement.proposition reals flooring lebesgue

content:
$(
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact
  putnam_1971_b3: for every positive real starting-time offset, the set of
  later real times at which one integer lap count is twice the other has
  Lebesgue measure one. This file contains no proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  The parameter T and time t range over all reals. The condition t >= T
  makes both floor arguments nonnegative, matching the natural-valued floor
  in the Lean source, while set.mm's integer-valued floor directly matches
  the Isabelle source. The function vol is set.mm's Lebesgue measure on
  measurable subsets of the real line.

  The final declaration is the single unproved $a corpus statement; this
  database contains no $p proof statement.
