module Putnam1972B1 where

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; _*_)

infix 4 _!=_ _<=N_
infixr 3 _and_
infixr 2 _or_

data Bottom : Set where

Not : Set -> Set
Not A =
  A -> Bottom

_!=_ : {A : Set} -> A -> A -> Set
x != y =
  Not (x == y)

record _and_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data _or_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  left  : A -> A or B
  right : B -> A or B

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

data _<=N_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set where
  zero<=   : {n : Nat} -> zero <=N n
  suc<=suc : {m n : Nat} -> m <=N n -> suc m <=N suc n

record CompleteOrderedRealField (R : Set) : Set1 where
  field
    zeroR oneR : R
    add multiply : R -> R -> R
    negate inverse : R -> R
    lessOrEqual : R -> R -> Set
    fromNat : Nat -> R

    one-not-zero :
      oneR != zeroR

    add-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> add x y == add y x
    add-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      add (add x y) z == add x (add y z)
    add-zero :
      (x : R) -> add x zeroR == x
    add-inverse :
      (x : R) -> add x (negate x) == zeroR

    multiply-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> multiply x y == multiply y x
    multiply-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply (multiply x y) z ==
      multiply x (multiply y z)
    multiply-one :
      (x : R) -> multiply x oneR == x
    multiply-zero :
      (x : R) -> multiply x zeroR == zeroR
    distribute :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply x (add y z) ==
      add (multiply x y) (multiply x z)
    inverse-zero :
      inverse zeroR == zeroR
    multiply-inverse :
      (x : R) ->
      x != zeroR ->
      multiply x (inverse x) == oneR

    order-reflexive :
      (x : R) -> lessOrEqual x x
    order-transitive :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y z ->
      lessOrEqual x z
    order-antisymmetric :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y x ->
      x == y
    order-total :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y or lessOrEqual y x
    add-order :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual (add z x) (add z y)
    multiply-nonnegative :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR x ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR y ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR (multiply x y)
    zero-less-than-one :
      lessOrEqual zeroR oneR and zeroR != oneR

    fromNat-zero :
      fromNat zero == zeroR
    fromNat-successor :
      (n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (suc n) == add (fromNat n) oneR
    fromNat-addition :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m + n) == add (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-multiplication :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m * n) == multiply (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-injective :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat m == fromNat n ->
      m == n

    archimedean :
      (x : R) ->
      Exists Nat (\ n -> lessOrEqual x (fromNat n))
    least-upper-bound :
      (P : R -> Set) ->
      Exists R P ->
      Exists R
        (\ upper ->
          (x : R) ->
          P x ->
          lessOrEqual x upper) ->
      Exists R
        (\ supremum ->
          ((x : R) ->
            P x ->
            lessOrEqual x supremum)
          and
          ((upper : R) ->
            ((x : R) ->
              P x ->
              lessOrEqual x upper) ->
            lessOrEqual supremum upper))

open CompleteOrderedRealField

oneN : Nat
oneN =
  suc zero

twoN : Nat
twoN =
  suc oneN

subtract :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
subtract reals x y =
  add reals x (negate reals y)

divide :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
divide reals x y =
  multiply reals x (inverse reals y)

StrictLess :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
StrictLess reals x y =
  lessOrEqual reals x y and x != y

CloseTo :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
CloseTo reals center radius x =
  StrictLess reals
    (subtract reals center radius)
    x
  and
  StrictLess reals
    x
    (add reals center radius)

naturalPower :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  Nat ->
  R
naturalPower reals x zero =
  oneR reals
naturalPower reals x (suc n) =
  multiply reals
    (naturalPower reals x n)
    x

factorial : Nat -> Nat
factorial zero =
  oneN
factorial (suc n) =
  suc n * factorial n

sumFirst :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Nat ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  R
sumFirst reals zero terms =
  zeroR reals
sumFirst reals (suc n) terms =
  add reals
    (sumFirst reals n terms)
    (terms n)

ConvergesTo :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  R ->
  Set
ConvergesTo {R} reals sequence limit =
  (epsilon : R) ->
  StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) epsilon ->
  Exists Nat
    (\ cutoff ->
      (n : Nat) ->
      cutoff <=N n ->
      CloseTo reals limit epsilon (sequence n))

SeriesHasSum :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  R ->
  Set
SeriesHasSum reals terms limit =
  ConvergesTo reals
    (\ n -> sumFirst reals n terms)
    limit

specifiedTerm :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  Nat ->
  R
specifiedTerm reals x n =
  divide reals
    (multiply reals
      (naturalPower reals x n)
      (naturalPower reals
        (subtract reals x (oneR reals))
        (twoN * n)))
    (fromNat reals (factorial n))

coefficientTerm :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  R ->
  Nat ->
  R
coefficientTerm reals p x n =
  multiply reals
    (p n)
    (naturalPower reals x n)

AgreesNearZero :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  (R -> R) ->
  Set
AgreesNearZero {R} reals p S =
  Exists R
    (\ radius ->
      StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) radius
      and
      ((x : R) ->
        CloseTo reals (zeroR reals) radius x ->
        SeriesHasSum reals
          (coefficientTerm reals p x)
          (S x)))

NoThreeConsecutiveZeros :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  Set
NoThreeConsecutiveZeros reals p =
  Not
    (Exists Nat
      (\ n ->
        p n == zeroR reals
        and
        p (suc n) == zeroR reals
        and
        p (suc (suc n)) == zeroR reals))

putnam-1972-b1 : Set1
putnam-1972-b1 =
  (R : Set) ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) ->
  (S : R -> R) ->
  ((x : R) ->
    SeriesHasSum reals
      (specifiedTerm reals x)
      (S x)) ->
  (p : Nat -> R) ->
  AgreesNearZero reals p S ->
  NoThreeConsecutiveZeros reals p

(*
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench artifact putnam_1972_b1:
  no three consecutive coefficients vanish in a real power series agreeing
  near zero with the sum of x^n (x - 1)^(2n) / n!. This file contains no
  proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open arithmeticTheory realTheory seqTheory;

val putnam_1972_b1 =
  ``!S : real -> real. !p : num -> real.
      S =
        (\x : real.
           if
             summable
               (\n : num.
                  x pow n * (x - 1) pow (2 * n) / &(FACT n))
           then
             suminf
               (\n : num.
                  x pow n * (x - 1) pow (2 * n) / &(FACT n))
           else
             0) /\
      (?a : real.
         0 < a /\
         !x : real.
           abs x < a
           ==>
           (if summable (\n : num. p n * x pow n) then
              suminf (\n : num. p n * x pow n)
            else
              0) =
           S x)
      ==>
      ~?n : num.
         p n = 0 /\
         p (n + 1) = 0 /\
         p (n + 2) = 0``;

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  RR ^m NN0 is the class of all real-valued sequences indexed by the
  nonnegative integers. The two sum_ expressions are set.mm's unbounded
  real-series sums. Eliminating the source's definitionally specified
  auxiliary function S gives the displayed local equality directly.

  The positive real a and the coefficient index n remain internally
  existentially quantified. The final declaration is the single unproved

  $d a n p x $.

  putnambench-putnam-1972-b1 $a |- A. p e. ( RR ^m NN0 )
    (
      (
        E. a e. RR+
          A. x e. RR
            (

          /\

            /\

% Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench artifact putnam_1972_b1:
% no three consecutive coefficients vanish in the real power series for
% the displayed factorial-denominator series near zero. This file contains no proof.

putnam_1972_b1: THEORY
BEGIN
  real_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> real]
  real_function: TYPE = [real -> real]

  safe_div(numerator, denominator: real): real =
    IF denominator = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      numerator / denominator
    ENDIF

  nat_factorial(index: nat): RECURSIVE nat =
    IF index = 0 THEN
      1
    ELSE
      index * nat_factorial(index - 1)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE index

  finite_sum(values: real_sequence, count: nat): RECURSIVE real =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      finite_sum(values, count - 1) + values(count - 1)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  converges_to(values: real_sequence, limit: real): bool =
    FORALL (epsilon_value: posreal):
      EXISTS (cutoff: nat):
        FORALL (count: nat):
          cutoff <= count IMPLIES
            abs(values(count) - limit) < epsilon_value

  source_term(x: real, index: nat): real =
    safe_div(
      x ^ index * (x - 1) ^ (2 * index),
      nat_factorial(index) :: real)

  source_partial_sum(x: real, count: nat): real =
    finite_sum(
      LAMBDA (index: nat): source_term(x, index),
      count)

  coefficient_partial_sum(
      coefficients: real_sequence,
      x: real,
      count: nat): real =
    finite_sum(
      LAMBDA (index: nat):
        coefficients(index) * x ^ index,
      count)

  is_source_series(series: real_function): bool =
    FORALL (x: real):
      converges_to(
        LAMBDA (count: nat): source_partial_sum(x, count),
        series(x))

  represents_near_zero(
      coefficients: real_sequence,
      series: real_function): bool =
    EXISTS (radius: real):
      radius > 0
        AND FORALL (x: real):
          abs(x) < radius IMPLIES
            converges_to(
              LAMBDA (count: nat):
                coefficient_partial_sum(
                  coefficients, x, count),
              series(x))

  no_three_consecutive_zero_coefficients(
      coefficients: real_sequence): bool =
    NOT EXISTS (index: nat):
      coefficients(index) = 0
        AND coefficients(index + 1) = 0
        AND coefficients(index + 2) = 0

  putnam_1972_b1: bool =
    FORALL
        (series: real_function),
        (coefficients: real_sequence):
      (is_source_series(series)
        AND represents_near_zero(coefficients, series))
      IMPLIES
        no_three_consecutive_zero_coefficients(coefficients)
END putnam_1972_b1

import Mathlib

open EuclideanGeometry Filter Topology Set MeasureTheory Metric

noncomputable abbrev putnam_1972_b2_solution : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ :=
  fun s v ↦ 2 * s / v
/--
Let $x : \mathbb{R} \to \mathbb{R}$ be a twice differentiable function whose second derivative is nonstrictly decreasing. If $x(t) - x(0) = s$, $x'(0) = 0$, and $x'(t) = v$ for some $t > 0$, find the maximum possible value of $t$ in terms of $s$ and $v$.
-/
theorem putnam_1972_b2
    (s v : ℝ)
    (hs : s > 0)
    (hv : v > 0)
    (valid : ℝ → (ℝ → ℝ) → Prop)
    (hvalid : ∀ t x, valid t x ↔
      0 < t ∧
      (∀ w ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) t,
        DifferentiableAt ℝ x w ∧ DifferentiableAt ℝ (deriv x) w) ∧
      AntitoneOn (deriv (deriv x)) (Set.Icc 0 t) ∧
      deriv x 0 = 0 ∧ deriv x t = v ∧ x t - x 0 = s)
    : IsGreatest {t | ∃ x : ℝ → ℝ, valid t x} (putnam_1972_b2_solution s v) :=
  sorry

From mathcomp Require Import all_ssreflect ssrnum ssralg.
From mathcomp Require Import reals sequences topology normedtype derive.
From mathcomp Require Import classical_sets.
Import numFieldNormedType.Exports.

Set Implicit Arguments.
Unset Strict Implicit.
Unset Printing Implicit Defensive.

Local Open Scope ring_scope.
Local Open Scope classical_set_scope.

Variable R : realType.
Definition putnam_1972_b2_solution : R -> R -> R := fun s v => 2 * s / v. 
Theorem putnam_1972_b2
    (s v : R)
    (hs : s > 0)
    (hv : v > 0)
    (valid : R -> (R -> R) -> Prop := fun t x =>
        (forall w : R, 0 <= w <= t -> differentiable x w /\ differentiable x^`() w) /\
        (forall a b : R, 0 <= a <= b /\ b <= t -> x^`(2) b <= x^`(2) a /\ 
        x^`() 0 = 0 /\ x^`() t = v /\ x t - x 0 = s))
    : (exists x : R -> R, valid (putnam_1972_b2_solution s v) x) /\
      (forall t : R, t > putnam_1972_b2_solution s v -> ~(exists x : R -> R, valid t x)).
Proof. Admitted.

theory putnam_1972_b2 imports Complex_Main
"HOL-Analysis.Derivative"
begin

definition putnam_1972_b2_solution :: "real \<Rightarrow> real \<Rightarrow> real" where
"putnam_1972_b2_solution \<equiv> \<lambda> s :: real. \<lambda> v :: real. 2 * s / v"
theorem putnam_1972_b2:
  fixes s v :: "real"
    and valid :: "real \<Rightarrow> (real \<Rightarrow> real) \<Rightarrow> bool"
  defines "valid \<equiv> \<lambda> t :: real. \<lambda> x :: real \<Rightarrow> real.
            0 < t
            \<and> (\<forall> w \<in> {0::real..t}. x differentiable at w \<and> (deriv x) differentiable at w)
            \<and> antimono_on {0::real..t} (deriv (deriv x))
            \<and> deriv x 0 = 0 \<and> deriv x t = v \<and> x t - x 0 = s"
  assumes hs : "s > 0"
    and hv : "v > 0"
  shows "(\<exists> x :: real \<Rightarrow> real. valid (putnam_1972_b2_solution s v) x) \<and> (\<forall> t :: real > putnam_1972_b2_solution s v. \<not>(\<exists> x :: real \<Rightarrow> real. valid t x))"
  sorry

end

(*
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench artifact putnam_1972_b2:
  the maximum elapsed time for a twice-differentiable real motion whose
  acceleration is nonincreasing, with prescribed displacement and endpoint
  velocities. This file contains no proof.
*)

let statement =
  `let has_derivative_at =
     \(g:real->real) (d:real) (a:real).
       !e. &0 < e
           ==> ?delta. &0 < delta /\
                       !y. &0 < abs (y - a) /\ abs (y - a) < delta
                           ==> abs ((g y - g a) / (y - a) - d) < e in
   let deriv =
     \(g:real->real) (a:real). @d. has_derivative_at g d a in
   let differentiable_at =
     \(g:real->real) (a:real).
       ?d. has_derivative_at g d a in
   let antitone_on =
     \(g:real->real) (u:real->bool).
       !a b. a IN u /\ b IN u /\ a <= b ==> g b <= g a in
   let solution =
     \(s:real) (v:real). &2 * s / v in
   let valid =
     \(s:real) (v:real) (t:real) (x:real->real).
       let interval = {w:real | &0 <= w /\ w <= t} in
       &0 < t /\
       (!w:real.
          w IN interval
          ==> differentiable_at x w /\
              differentiable_at (deriv x) w) /\
       antitone_on (deriv (deriv x)) interval /\
       deriv x (&0) = &0 /\
       deriv x t = v /\
       x t - x (&0) = s in
   !s v:real.
     &0 < s /\ &0 < v
     ==> (?x:real->real. valid s v (solution s v) x) /\
         (!t:real.
            t > solution s v
            ==> ~(?x:real->real. valid s v t x))`;;

title: putnam_1972_b2
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1972_b2:
;; the greatest time for a twice-differentiable real trajectory with
;; nonincreasing second derivative, prescribed displacement s, and endpoint
;; velocities 0 and v is 2*s/v. This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))

;; ACL2 has no primitive complete real field.  CTX is therefore an arbitrary
;; Dedekind-complete ordered-field presentation, hence the real field up to
;; ordered-field isomorphism.  Tame APPLY$ function objects represent the
;; source sets and real-valued functions.  DEFUN-SK keeps the trajectory,
;; both totalized derivative functions, and every real quantifier internal.
;; Differentiability is the epsilon-remainder definition, while the final two
;; predicates are exactly membership and the upper-bound clause of IsGreatest.

(defun p72b2-member-p (carrier value)
  (if (apply$ carrier (list value)) t nil))

(defun p72b2-unary (function value)
  (apply$ function (list value)))

(defun p72b2-binary (function left right)
  (apply$ function (list left right)))

(defun-sk p72b2-valid-set-p (carrier set)
  (forall (value)
    (implies
     (apply$ set (list value))
     (p72b2-member-p carrier value))))

(defun-sk p72b2-field-laws-p
    (carrier zero one add multiply negate inverse)
  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (p72b2-member-p carrier x)
      (p72b2-member-p carrier y)
      (p72b2-member-p carrier z))
     (and
      (p72b2-member-p
       carrier (p72b2-binary add x y))
      (p72b2-member-p
       carrier (p72b2-binary multiply x y))
      (p72b2-member-p
       carrier (p72b2-unary negate x))
      (p72b2-member-p
       carrier (p72b2-unary inverse x))
      (equal
       (p72b2-binary add (p72b2-binary add x y) z)
       (p72b2-binary add x (p72b2-binary add y z)))
      (equal
       (p72b2-binary add x y)
       (p72b2-binary add y x))
      (equal (p72b2-binary add x zero) x)
      (equal
       (p72b2-binary add x (p72b2-unary negate x))
       zero)
      (equal
       (p72b2-binary
        multiply (p72b2-binary multiply x y) z)
       (p72b2-binary
        multiply x (p72b2-binary multiply y z)))
      (equal
       (p72b2-binary multiply x y)
       (p72b2-binary multiply y x))
      (equal (p72b2-binary multiply x one) x)
      (implies
       (equal x zero)
       (equal (p72b2-unary inverse x) zero))
      (implies
       (not (equal x zero))
       (equal
        (p72b2-binary
         multiply x (p72b2-unary inverse x))
        one))
      (equal
       (p72b2-binary
        multiply x (p72b2-binary add y z))
       (p72b2-binary
        add
        (p72b2-binary multiply x y)
        (p72b2-binary multiply x z)))))))

(defun-sk p72b2-order-laws-p
    (carrier zero add multiply less)
  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (p72b2-member-p carrier x)
      (p72b2-member-p carrier y)
      (p72b2-member-p carrier z))
     (and
      (not (p72b2-binary less x x))
      (or
       (equal x y)
       (p72b2-binary less x y)
       (p72b2-binary less y x))
      (implies
       (and
        (p72b2-binary less x y)
        (p72b2-binary less y z))
       (p72b2-binary less x z))
      (implies
       (p72b2-binary less x y)
       (p72b2-binary
        less
        (p72b2-binary add x z)
        (p72b2-binary add y z)))
      (implies
       (and
        (p72b2-binary less zero x)
        (p72b2-binary less zero y))
       (p72b2-binary
        less zero (p72b2-binary multiply x y)))))))

(defun-sk p72b2-set-nonempty-p (carrier set)
  (exists (value)
    (and
     (p72b2-member-p carrier value)
     (apply$ set (list value)))))

(defun-sk p72b2-upper-bound-p
    (carrier less set bound)
  (forall (value)
    (implies
     (and
      (p72b2-member-p carrier value)
      (apply$ set (list value)))
     (not (p72b2-binary less bound value)))))

(defun-sk p72b2-bounded-above-p
    (carrier less set)
  (exists (bound)
    (and
     (p72b2-member-p carrier bound)
     (p72b2-upper-bound-p
      carrier less set bound))))

(defun-sk p72b2-least-upper-bound-p
    (carrier less set supremum)
  (forall (bound)
    (implies
     (and
      (p72b2-member-p carrier bound)
      (p72b2-upper-bound-p carrier less set bound))
     (not (p72b2-binary less bound supremum)))))

(defun p72b2-supremum-p
    (carrier less set supremum)
  (and
   (p72b2-member-p carrier supremum)
   (p72b2-upper-bound-p carrier less set supremum)
   (p72b2-least-upper-bound-p
    carrier less set supremum)))

(defun-sk p72b2-has-supremum-p
    (carrier less set)
  (exists (supremum)
    (p72b2-supremum-p
     carrier less set supremum)))

(defun-sk p72b2-dedekind-complete-p
    (carrier less)
  (forall (set)
    (implies
     (and
      (tamep-functionp set)
      (p72b2-valid-set-p carrier set)
      (p72b2-set-nonempty-p carrier set)
      (p72b2-bounded-above-p carrier less set))
     (p72b2-has-supremum-p carrier less set))))

;; CTX = (carrier zero one add multiply negate inverse less).

(defun p72b2-carrier (ctx) (nth 0 ctx))
(defun p72b2-zero (ctx) (nth 1 ctx))
(defun p72b2-one (ctx) (nth 2 ctx))
(defun p72b2-add (ctx) (nth 3 ctx))
(defun p72b2-multiply (ctx) (nth 4 ctx))
(defun p72b2-negate (ctx) (nth 5 ctx))
(defun p72b2-inverse (ctx) (nth 6 ctx))
(defun p72b2-less (ctx) (nth 7 ctx))

(defun p72b2-context-p (ctx)
  (and
   (true-listp ctx)
   (equal (len ctx) 8)
   (tamep-functionp (p72b2-carrier ctx))
   (tamep-functionp (p72b2-add ctx))
   (tamep-functionp (p72b2-multiply ctx))
   (tamep-functionp (p72b2-negate ctx))
   (tamep-functionp (p72b2-inverse ctx))
   (tamep-functionp (p72b2-less ctx))
   (p72b2-member-p
    (p72b2-carrier ctx) (p72b2-zero ctx))
   (p72b2-member-p
    (p72b2-carrier ctx) (p72b2-one ctx))
   (not (equal (p72b2-zero ctx) (p72b2-one ctx)))
   (p72b2-field-laws-p
    (p72b2-carrier ctx)
    (p72b2-zero ctx)
    (p72b2-one ctx)
    (p72b2-add ctx)
    (p72b2-multiply ctx)
    (p72b2-negate ctx)
    (p72b2-inverse ctx))
   (p72b2-order-laws-p
    (p72b2-carrier ctx)
    (p72b2-zero ctx)
    (p72b2-add ctx)
    (p72b2-multiply ctx)
    (p72b2-less ctx))
   (p72b2-binary
    (p72b2-less ctx) (p72b2-zero ctx) (p72b2-one ctx))
   (p72b2-dedekind-complete-p
    (p72b2-carrier ctx) (p72b2-less ctx))))

(defun p72b2-r-add (ctx left right)
  (p72b2-binary (p72b2-add ctx) left right))

(defun p72b2-r-negate (ctx value)
  (p72b2-unary (p72b2-negate ctx) value))

(defun p72b2-r-subtract (ctx left right)
  (p72b2-r-add ctx left (p72b2-r-negate ctx right)))

(defun p72b2-r-multiply (ctx left right)
  (p72b2-binary (p72b2-multiply ctx) left right))

(defun p72b2-r-inverse (ctx value)
  (p72b2-unary (p72b2-inverse ctx) value))

(defun p72b2-r-divide (ctx numerator denominator)
  (p72b2-r-multiply
   ctx numerator (p72b2-r-inverse ctx denominator)))

(defun p72b2-r-less-p (ctx left right)
  (if (p72b2-binary (p72b2-less ctx) left right)
      t nil))

(defun p72b2-r-less-equal-p (ctx left right)
  (not (p72b2-r-less-p ctx right left)))

(defun p72b2-r-absolute (ctx value)
  (if (p72b2-r-less-p ctx value (p72b2-zero ctx))
      (p72b2-r-negate ctx value)
    value))

(defun p72b2-positive-p (ctx value)
  (and
   (p72b2-member-p (p72b2-carrier ctx) value)
   (p72b2-r-less-p ctx (p72b2-zero ctx) value)))

(defun p72b2-two (ctx)
  (p72b2-r-add ctx (p72b2-one ctx) (p72b2-one ctx)))

(defun p72b2-solution-time (ctx s v)
  (p72b2-r-divide
   ctx
   (p72b2-r-multiply ctx (p72b2-two ctx) s)
   v))

(defun p72b2-in-closed-interval-p
    (ctx left right value)
  (and
   (p72b2-member-p (p72b2-carrier ctx) value)
   (p72b2-r-less-equal-p ctx left value)
   (p72b2-r-less-equal-p ctx value right)))

(defun-sk p72b2-real-function-p (ctx function)
  (forall (value)
    (implies
     (p72b2-member-p (p72b2-carrier ctx) value)
     (p72b2-member-p
      (p72b2-carrier ctx)
      (p72b2-unary function value)))))

;; HasDerivAt in epsilon-remainder form:
;; |f(y)-f(x)-d(y-x)| <= epsilon*|y-x| near x.

(defun p72b2-derivative-error
    (ctx function derivative point value)
  (p72b2-r-absolute
   ctx
   (p72b2-r-subtract
    ctx
    (p72b2-r-subtract
     ctx
     (p72b2-unary function value)
     (p72b2-unary function point))
    (p72b2-r-multiply
     ctx derivative
     (p72b2-r-subtract ctx value point)))))

(defun-sk p72b2-global-error-bound-p
    (ctx function derivative point epsilon radius)
  (forall (value)
    (implies
     (and
      (p72b2-member-p (p72b2-carrier ctx) value)
      (p72b2-r-less-p
       ctx
       (p72b2-r-absolute
        ctx (p72b2-r-subtract ctx value point))
       radius))
     (p72b2-r-less-equal-p
      ctx
      (p72b2-derivative-error
       ctx function derivative point value)
      (p72b2-r-multiply
       ctx epsilon
       (p72b2-r-absolute
        ctx (p72b2-r-subtract ctx value point)))))))

(defun-sk p72b2-global-radius-exists-p
    (ctx function derivative point epsilon)
  (exists (radius)
    (and
     (p72b2-positive-p ctx radius)
     (p72b2-global-error-bound-p
      ctx function derivative point epsilon radius))))

(defun-sk p72b2-has-derivative-at-p
    (ctx function derivative point)
  (forall (epsilon)
    (implies
     (p72b2-positive-p ctx epsilon)
     (p72b2-global-radius-exists-p
      ctx function derivative point epsilon))))

(defun-sk p72b2-differentiable-at-p
    (ctx function point)
  (exists (derivative)
    (and
     (p72b2-member-p (p72b2-carrier ctx) derivative)
     (p72b2-has-derivative-at-p
      ctx function derivative point))))

;; This is the source libraries' totalized derivative: the unique derivative
;; at differentiability points, and zero otherwise.

(defun p72b2-deriv-value-p
    (ctx function point value)
  (and
   (p72b2-member-p (p72b2-carrier ctx) value)
   (if (p72b2-differentiable-at-p ctx function point)
       (p72b2-has-derivative-at-p
        ctx function value point)
     (equal value (p72b2-zero ctx)))))

(defun-sk p72b2-deriv-field-values-p
    (ctx function derivative-field)
  (forall (point)
    (implies
     (p72b2-member-p (p72b2-carrier ctx) point)
     (p72b2-deriv-value-p
      ctx function point
      (p72b2-unary derivative-field point)))))

(defun p72b2-deriv-field-p
    (ctx function derivative-field)
  (and
   (tamep-functionp derivative-field)
   (p72b2-real-function-p ctx derivative-field)
   (p72b2-deriv-field-values-p
    ctx function derivative-field)))

;; The Lean source uses ordinary DifferentiableAt, not differentiability
;; relative to the interval. In particular, both endpoints require two-sided
;; derivatives in the ambient real field.
(defun-sk p72b2-differentiable-on-p
    (ctx function left right)
  (forall (point)
    (implies
     (p72b2-in-closed-interval-p ctx left right point)
     (p72b2-differentiable-at-p ctx function point))))

(defun-sk p72b2-antitone-on-p
    (ctx function left right)
  (forall (a b)
    (implies
     (and
      (p72b2-in-closed-interval-p ctx left right a)
      (p72b2-in-closed-interval-p ctx left right b)
      (p72b2-r-less-equal-p ctx a b))
     (p72b2-r-less-equal-p
      ctx
      (p72b2-unary function b)
      (p72b2-unary function a)))))

(defun p72b2-valid-trajectory-p
    (ctx s v time trajectory
         first-derivative second-derivative)
  (and
   (p72b2-member-p (p72b2-carrier ctx) s)
   (p72b2-member-p (p72b2-carrier ctx) v)
   (p72b2-member-p (p72b2-carrier ctx) time)
   (tamep-functionp trajectory)
   (p72b2-real-function-p ctx trajectory)
   (p72b2-deriv-field-p
    ctx trajectory first-derivative)
   (p72b2-deriv-field-p
    ctx first-derivative second-derivative)
   (p72b2-differentiable-on-p
    ctx trajectory (p72b2-zero ctx) time)
   (p72b2-differentiable-on-p
    ctx first-derivative (p72b2-zero ctx) time)
   (p72b2-antitone-on-p
    ctx second-derivative (p72b2-zero ctx) time)
   (equal
    (p72b2-unary first-derivative (p72b2-zero ctx))
    (p72b2-zero ctx))
   (equal
    (p72b2-unary first-derivative time)
    v)
   (equal
    (p72b2-r-subtract
     ctx
     (p72b2-unary trajectory time)
     (p72b2-unary trajectory (p72b2-zero ctx)))
    s)))

(defun-sk p72b2-attainable-p (ctx s v time)
  (exists (trajectory first-derivative second-derivative)
    (p72b2-valid-trajectory-p
     ctx s v time trajectory
     first-derivative second-derivative)))

(defun-sk p72b2-all-attainable-times-bounded-p
    (ctx s v greatest)
  (forall (time)
    (implies
     (and
      (p72b2-member-p (p72b2-carrier ctx) time)
      (p72b2-attainable-p ctx s v time))
     (p72b2-r-less-equal-p ctx time greatest))))

(defun-sk putnambench-putnam-1972-b2-statement ()
  (forall (ctx s v)
    (implies
     (and
      (p72b2-context-p ctx)
      (p72b2-positive-p ctx s)
      (p72b2-positive-p ctx v))
     (let ((greatest (p72b2-solution-time ctx s v)))
       (and
        (p72b2-member-p (p72b2-carrier ctx) greatest)
        (p72b2-attainable-p ctx s v greatest)
        (p72b2-all-attainable-times-bounded-p
         ctx s v greatest))))))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

title: putnam_1972_b2
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1972_b2:
-- the maximum time for a twice-differentiable real trajectory with nonstrictly
-- decreasing second derivative, prescribed displacement s, and terminal
-- velocity v is 2s/v. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; _*_)

infix 4 _!=_
infixr 3 _and_
infixr 2 _or_

data Bottom : Set where

record Top : Set where
  constructor top

Not : Set -> Set
Not A =
  A -> Bottom

_!=_ : {A : Set} -> A -> A -> Set
x != y =
  Not (x == y)

record _and_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data _or_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  left  : A -> A or B
  right : B -> A or B

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

record CompleteOrderedRealField (R : Set) : Set1 where
  field
    zeroR oneR : R
    add multiply : R -> R -> R
    negate inverse : R -> R
    lessOrEqual : R -> R -> Set
    fromNat : Nat -> R

    one-not-zero :
      oneR != zeroR

    add-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> add x y == add y x
    add-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      add (add x y) z == add x (add y z)
    add-zero :
      (x : R) -> add x zeroR == x
    add-inverse :
      (x : R) -> add x (negate x) == zeroR

    multiply-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> multiply x y == multiply y x
    multiply-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply (multiply x y) z ==
      multiply x (multiply y z)
    multiply-one :
      (x : R) -> multiply x oneR == x
    multiply-zero :
      (x : R) -> multiply x zeroR == zeroR
    distribute :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply x (add y z) ==
      add (multiply x y) (multiply x z)
    inverse-zero :
      inverse zeroR == zeroR
    multiply-inverse :
      (x : R) ->
      x != zeroR ->
      multiply x (inverse x) == oneR

    order-reflexive :
      (x : R) -> lessOrEqual x x
    order-transitive :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y z ->
      lessOrEqual x z
    order-antisymmetric :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y x ->
      x == y
    order-total :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y or lessOrEqual y x
    add-order :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual (add z x) (add z y)
    multiply-nonnegative :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR x ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR y ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR (multiply x y)
    zero-less-than-one :
      lessOrEqual zeroR oneR and zeroR != oneR

    fromNat-zero :
      fromNat zero == zeroR
    fromNat-successor :
      (n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (suc n) == add (fromNat n) oneR
    fromNat-addition :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m + n) == add (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-multiplication :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m * n) == multiply (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-injective :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat m == fromNat n ->
      m == n

    archimedean :
      (x : R) ->
      Exists Nat (\ n -> lessOrEqual x (fromNat n))
    least-upper-bound :
      (P : R -> Set) ->
      Exists R P ->
      Exists R
        (\ upper ->
          (x : R) ->
          P x ->
          lessOrEqual x upper) ->
      Exists R
        (\ supremum ->
          ((x : R) ->
            P x ->
            lessOrEqual x supremum)
          and
          ((upper : R) ->
            ((x : R) ->
              P x ->
              lessOrEqual x upper) ->
            lessOrEqual supremum upper))

open CompleteOrderedRealField

subtract :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
subtract reals x y =
  add reals x (negate reals y)

divide :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
divide reals x y =
  multiply reals x (inverse reals y)

two :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R
two reals =
  add reals (oneR reals) (oneR reals)

StrictLess :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
StrictLess reals x y =
  lessOrEqual reals x y and x != y

CloseTo :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
CloseTo reals center radius x =
  StrictLess reals
    (subtract reals center radius)
    x
  and
  StrictLess reals
    x
    (add reals center radius)

Predicate : Set -> Set1
Predicate A =
  A -> Set

whole :
  {A : Set} ->
  Predicate A
whole _ =
  Top

differenceQuotient :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (R -> R) ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
differenceQuotient reals function point x =
  divide reals
    (subtract reals (function x) (function point))
    (subtract reals x point)

DerivativeWithinAt :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (R -> R) ->
  Predicate R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
DerivativeWithinAt {R} reals function domain point derivativeValue =
  (epsilon : R) ->
  StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) epsilon ->
  Exists R
    (\ delta ->
      StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) delta
      and
      ((x : R) ->
        domain x ->
        CloseTo reals point delta x ->
        x != point ->
        CloseTo reals derivativeValue epsilon
          (differenceQuotient reals function point x)))

DerivativeAt :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (R -> R) ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
DerivativeAt reals function point derivativeValue =
  DerivativeWithinAt
    reals
    function
    whole
    point
    derivativeValue

record StandardRealCalculus
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) : Set1 where

  field
    derivative : (R -> R) -> R -> R
    derivative-correct :
      (function : R -> R) ->
      (point derivativeValue : R) ->
      DerivativeAt reals function point derivativeValue ->
      derivative function point == derivativeValue
    derivative-totalized-at-zero :
      (function : R -> R) ->
      (point : R) ->
      Not (Exists R (DerivativeAt reals function point)) ->
      derivative function point == zeroR reals

open StandardRealCalculus

ClosedIntervalFromZero :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  Predicate R
ClosedIntervalFromZero reals endpoint x =
  lessOrEqual reals (zeroR reals) x
  and
  lessOrEqual reals x endpoint

DifferentiableWithinOn :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (R -> R) ->
  Predicate R ->
  Set
DifferentiableWithinOn {R} reals function domain =
  (point : R) ->
  domain point ->
  Exists R
    (DerivativeWithinAt reals function domain point)

DifferentiableOn :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (R -> R) ->
  Predicate R ->
  Set
DifferentiableOn {R} reals function domain =
  (point : R) ->
  domain point ->
  Exists R
    (DerivativeAt reals function point)

AntitoneOn :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (R -> R) ->
  Predicate R ->
  Set
AntitoneOn {R} reals function domain =
  (a b : R) ->
  domain a ->
  domain b ->
  lessOrEqual reals a b ->
  lessOrEqual reals (function b) (function a)

solutionTime :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
solutionTime reals s v =
  divide reals
    (multiply reals (two reals) s)
    v

ValidTrajectory :
  {R : Set} ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) ->
  StandardRealCalculus reals ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  (R -> R) ->
  Set
ValidTrajectory reals calculus s v t x =
  DifferentiableOn reals x
    (ClosedIntervalFromZero reals t)
  and
  DifferentiableOn reals
    (derivative calculus x)
    (ClosedIntervalFromZero reals t)
  and
  AntitoneOn reals
    (derivative calculus (derivative calculus x))
    (ClosedIntervalFromZero reals t)
  and
  derivative calculus x (zeroR reals) == zeroR reals
  and
  derivative calculus x t == v
  and
  subtract reals (x t) (x (zeroR reals)) == s

putnam-1972-b2 : Set1
putnam-1972-b2 =
  (R : Set) ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) ->
  (calculus : StandardRealCalculus reals) ->
  (s v : R) ->
  StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) s ->
  StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) v ->
  Exists (R -> R)
    (ValidTrajectory reals calculus s v
      (solutionTime reals s v))
  and
  ((t : R) ->
    StrictLess reals (solutionTime reals s v) t ->
    Not
      (Exists (R -> R)
        (ValidTrajectory reals calculus s v t)))

title: putnam_1972_b2
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench artifact putnam_1972_b2:
  the maximum elapsed time for a twice-differentiable real function whose
  second derivative is nonincreasing and whose displacement and endpoint
  velocities are prescribed. This file contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open realTheory limTheory;

val putnam_1972_b2 =
  ``!s v : real.
      let solution = 2 * s / v
      in
      let valid =
        \t : real.
        \x : real -> real.
          (!w : real.
             0 <= w /\ w <= t
             ==>
             higher_differentiable 2 x w) /\
          (!a b : real.
             0 <= a /\ a <= b /\ b <= t
             ==>
             diffn 2 x b <= diffn 2 x a) /\
          diffn 1 x 0 = 0 /\
          diffn 1 x t = v /\
          x t - x 0 = s
      in
        0 < s /\ 0 < v
        ==>
        (?x : real -> real. valid solution x) /\
        (!t : real.
           solution < t
           ==>
           ~(?x : real -> real. valid t x))``;

title: putnam_1972_b2
content:
$(
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact
  putnam_1972_b2: the maximum time for a twice-differentiable real
  trajectory with nonincreasing second derivative and prescribed positive
  displacement s and final velocity v is 2s/v. This file contains no proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  RR ^m RR is the class of total real-valued functions. The first two
  entries of ( RR Dn F ) are the first and second real derivatives of F.
  Inclusion of [0,t] in their domains expresses the two differentiability
  requirements, and the nested universal quantifiers express that the second
  derivative is antitone there.

  The witness function remains existentially quantified separately at the
  attained value 2s/v and at every excluded larger time. The final
  declaration is the single unproved $a corpus statement; this database
  contains no $p proof statement.
$)

${
  $d F a b s t v $.

  putnambench-putnam-1972-b2 $a |-
    A. s e. RR A. v e. RR
      (
        (
          0 < s
          /\
          0 < v
        )
        ->
        (
          E. F e. ( RR ^m RR )
            (
              (
                (
                  ( 0 [,] ( ( 2 x. s ) / v ) )
                    C_ dom ( ( RR Dn F ) ` 1 )
                  /\
                  ( 0 [,] ( ( 2 x. s ) / v ) )
                    C_ dom ( ( RR Dn F ) ` 2 )
                )
                /\
                A. a e. ( 0 [,] ( ( 2 x. s ) / v ) )
                  A. b e. ( 0 [,] ( ( 2 x. s ) / v ) )
                    (
                      a <_ b
                      ->
                      ( ( ( RR Dn F ) ` 2 ) ` b )
                        <_ ( ( ( RR Dn F ) ` 2 ) ` a )
                    )
              )
              /\
              (
                (
                  ( ( ( RR Dn F ) ` 1 ) ` 0 ) = 0
                  /\
                  ( ( ( RR Dn F ) ` 1 )
                      ` ( ( 2 x. s ) / v ) ) = v
                )
                /\
                (
                  ( F ` ( ( 2 x. s ) / v ) )
                  -
                  ( F ` 0 )
                )
                =
                s
              )
            )
          /\
          A. t e. RR
            (
              ( ( 2 x. s ) / v ) < t
              ->
              -. E. F e. ( RR ^m RR )
                (
                  (
                    (
                      ( 0 [,] t )
                        C_ dom ( ( RR Dn F ) ` 1 )
                      /\
                      ( 0 [,] t )
                        C_ dom ( ( RR Dn F ) ` 2 )
                    )
                    /\
                    A. a e. ( 0 [,] t )
                      A. b e. ( 0 [,] t )
                        (
                          a <_ b
                          ->
                          ( ( ( RR Dn F ) ` 2 ) ` b )
                            <_ ( ( ( RR Dn F ) ` 2 ) ` a )
                        )
                  )
                  /\
                  (
                    (
                      ( ( ( RR Dn F ) ` 1 ) ` 0 ) = 0
                      /\
                      ( ( ( RR Dn F ) ` 1 ) ` t ) = v
                    )
                    /\
                    ( ( F ` t ) - ( F ` 0 ) ) = s
                  )
                )
            )
        )
      )
  $.
$}

title: putnam_1972_b2
content:
% Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench artifact putnam_1972_b2:
% the maximum time for a twice-differentiable real trajectory with
% nonincreasing second derivative, prescribed displacement s, initial
% velocity zero, and final velocity v is 2*s/v. This file contains no proof.

putnam_1972_b2: THEORY
BEGIN
  real_function: TYPE = [real -> real]

  safe_div(numerator, denominator: real): real =
    IF denominator = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      numerator / denominator
    ENDIF

  in_closed_interval(x, a, b: real): bool =
    a <= x AND x <= b

  has_derivative_at(
      f: real_function,
      derivative, x: real): bool =
    FORALL (epsilon_value: real):
      epsilon_value > 0 IMPLIES
        EXISTS (delta: real):
          delta > 0
            AND FORALL (h: real):
              (NOT (h = 0) AND abs(h) < delta)
                IMPLIES
                  abs(
                    f(x + h) - f(x)
                      - derivative * h)
                    < epsilon_value * abs(h)

  differentiable_at(f: real_function, x: real): bool =
    EXISTS (derivative: real):
      has_derivative_at(f, derivative, x)

  derivative_value(f: real_function, x: real): real =
    IF differentiable_at(f, x) THEN
      epsilon(
        LAMBDA (derivative: real):
          has_derivative_at(f, derivative, x))
    ELSE
      0
    ENDIF

  derivative_function(f: real_function): real_function =
    LAMBDA (x: real): derivative_value(f, x)

  has_derivative_within_closed_interval(
      f: real_function,
      derivative, x, a, b: real): bool =
    FORALL (epsilon_value: real):
      epsilon_value > 0 IMPLIES
        EXISTS (delta: real):
          delta > 0
            AND FORALL (y: real):
              (in_closed_interval(y, a, b)
                AND NOT (y = x)
                AND abs(y - x) < delta)
                IMPLIES
                  abs(
                    f(y) - f(x)
                      - derivative * (y - x))
                    < epsilon_value * abs(y - x)

  differentiable_on_closed_interval(
      f: real_function,
      a, b: real): bool =
    FORALL (x: real):
      in_closed_interval(x, a, b) IMPLIES
        differentiable_at(f, x)

  nonincreasing_on_closed_interval(
      f: real_function,
      a, b: real): bool =
    FORALL (x, y: real):
      (in_closed_interval(x, a, b)
        AND in_closed_interval(y, a, b)
        AND x <= y)
      IMPLIES f(y) <= f(x)

  admissible(
      t, s, v: real,
      x: real_function): bool =
    differentiable_on_closed_interval(x, 0, t)
      AND differentiable_on_closed_interval(
        derivative_function(x), 0, t)
      AND nonincreasing_on_closed_interval(
        derivative_function(derivative_function(x)), 0, t)
      AND derivative_function(x)(0) = 0
      AND derivative_function(x)(t) = v
      AND x(t) - x(0) = s

  putnam_1972_b2_solution(s, v: real): real =
    safe_div(2 * s, v)

  putnam_1972_b2: bool =
    FORALL (s, v: real):
      (s > 0 AND v > 0)
      IMPLIES
        (EXISTS (x: real_function):
          admissible(
            putnam_1972_b2_solution(s, v),
            s,
            v,
            x))
        AND FORALL (t: real):
          t > putnam_1972_b2_solution(s, v)
            IMPLIES
              NOT (EXISTS (x: real_function):
                admissible(t, s, v, x))
END putnam_1972_b2

title: putnam_1972_b3
content:
(* Statement-only formalization over an arbitrary group. *)

From Coq Require Import Arith.PeanoNat.

Record putnam_1972_b3_group (G : Type) : Type := {
  putnam_1972_b3_mul : G -> G -> G;
  putnam_1972_b3_one : G;
  putnam_1972_b3_inv : G -> G;
  putnam_1972_b3_assoc :
    forall x y z : G,
      putnam_1972_b3_mul x (putnam_1972_b3_mul y z) =
      putnam_1972_b3_mul (putnam_1972_b3_mul x y) z;
  putnam_1972_b3_left_identity :
    forall x : G, putnam_1972_b3_mul putnam_1972_b3_one x = x;
  putnam_1972_b3_right_identity :
    forall x : G, putnam_1972_b3_mul x putnam_1972_b3_one = x;
  putnam_1972_b3_left_inverse :
    forall x : G,
      putnam_1972_b3_mul (putnam_1972_b3_inv x) x =
      putnam_1972_b3_one;
  putnam_1972_b3_right_inverse :
    forall x : G,
      putnam_1972_b3_mul x (putnam_1972_b3_inv x) =
      putnam_1972_b3_one
}.

Arguments putnam_1972_b3_mul {G} _ _ _.
Arguments putnam_1972_b3_one {G} _.

Fixpoint putnam_1972_b3_pow
    {G : Type}
    (grp : putnam_1972_b3_group G)
    (x : G)
    (n : nat) : G :=
  match n with
  | O => putnam_1972_b3_one grp
  | S k => putnam_1972_b3_mul grp x (putnam_1972_b3_pow grp x k)
  end.

Theorem putnam_1972_b3
    (G : Type)
    (grp : putnam_1972_b3_group G)
    (A B : G)
    (hab :
      putnam_1972_b3_mul grp (putnam_1972_b3_mul grp A B) A =
        putnam_1972_b3_mul grp
          (putnam_1972_b3_mul grp B (putnam_1972_b3_pow grp A 2))
          B /\
      putnam_1972_b3_pow grp A 3 = putnam_1972_b3_one grp /\
      exists n : nat,
        n > 0 /\
        putnam_1972_b3_pow grp B (2 * n - 1) =
          putnam_1972_b3_one grp) :
  B = putnam_1972_b3_one grp.
Admitted.

content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench artifact putnam_1972_b3:
  group relations involving an element of order dividing three and an
  odd-power relation force the second element to be the identity. This file
  contains no proof.
*)

let statement =
  `let is_group =
     \(mul:G->G->G) (identity:G) (ginv:G->G).
       (!x y z:G. mul (mul x y) z = mul x (mul y z)) /\
       (!x:G. mul identity x = x /\ mul x identity = x) /\
       (!x:G.
          mul (ginv x) x = identity /\ mul x (ginv x) = identity) in
   let is_power =
     \(mul:G->G->G) (identity:G) (x:G) (n:num) (y:G).
       ?powers:num->G.
         powers 0 = identity /\
         (!k:num. powers (SUC k) = mul x (powers k)) /\
         powers n = y in
   !mul:G->G->G identity:G ginv:G->G A B:G.
     is_group mul identity ginv /\
     mul (mul A B) A = mul (mul B (mul A A)) B /\
     mul (mul A A) A = identity /\
     (?n:num. 0 < n /\ is_power mul identity B (2 * n - 1) identity)
     ==> B = identity`;;

title: putnam_1972_b3
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1972_b3:
;; in a group, the stated relations on A and B and an odd positive power of B
;; imply that B is the identity. This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

;; CARRIER, OP, and INV are ACL2 function objects.  The generated predicate
;; lambdas return T outside CARRIER, so FN-EQUAL against a constant-T lambda
;; expresses each universally quantified group law on the represented type.

(defun putnam-1972-b3-quoted (object)
  (list 'quote object))

(defun putnam-1972-b3-apply1-term (function argument)
  (list 'apply$
        (putnam-1972-b3-quoted function)
        (list 'cons argument nil)))

(defun putnam-1972-b3-apply2-term (function left right)
  (list 'apply$
        (putnam-1972-b3-quoted function)
        (list 'cons left
              (list 'cons right nil))))

(defun putnam-1972-b3-carrier-term (carrier element)
  (putnam-1972-b3-apply1-term carrier element))

(defun putnam-1972-b3-operation-term (op left right)
  (putnam-1972-b3-apply2-term op left right))

(defun putnam-1972-b3-inverse-term (inv element)
  (putnam-1972-b3-apply1-term inv element))

(defun putnam-1972-b3-all-in-carrier-term
    (carrier variables)
  (if (endp variables)
      (putnam-1972-b3-quoted t)
    (list 'if
          (putnam-1972-b3-carrier-term
           carrier (car variables))
          (putnam-1972-b3-all-in-carrier-term
           carrier (cdr variables))
          (putnam-1972-b3-quoted nil))))

(defun putnam-1972-b3-restricted-predicate-term
    (carrier variables proposition)
  (list 'if
        (putnam-1972-b3-all-in-carrier-term
         carrier variables)
        proposition
        (putnam-1972-b3-quoted t)))

(defun putnam-1972-b3-and-term (left right)
  (list 'if left right (putnam-1972-b3-quoted nil)))

(defun putnam-1972-b3-true-function (formals)
  (list 'lambda formals (putnam-1972-b3-quoted t)))

(defun putnam-1972-b3-operation-closure-function (carrier op)
  (let ((op-xy
         (putnam-1972-b3-operation-term op 'x 'y)))
    (list
     'lambda
     '(x y)
     (putnam-1972-b3-restricted-predicate-term
      carrier
      '(x y)
      (putnam-1972-b3-carrier-term carrier op-xy)))))

(defun putnam-1972-b3-inverse-closure-function (carrier inv)
  (list
   'lambda
   '(x)
   (putnam-1972-b3-restricted-predicate-term
    carrier
    '(x)
    (putnam-1972-b3-carrier-term
     carrier
     (putnam-1972-b3-inverse-term inv 'x)))))

(defun putnam-1972-b3-associative-function (carrier op)
  (let* ((op-xy
          (putnam-1972-b3-operation-term op 'x 'y))
         (op-yz
          (putnam-1972-b3-operation-term op 'y 'z)))
    (list
     'lambda
     '(x y z)
     (putnam-1972-b3-restricted-predicate-term
      carrier
      '(x y z)
      (list
       'equal
       (putnam-1972-b3-operation-term op op-xy 'z)
       (putnam-1972-b3-operation-term op 'x op-yz))))))

(defun putnam-1972-b3-identity-function (carrier op one)
  (let ((left
         (list
          'equal
          (putnam-1972-b3-operation-term
           op (putnam-1972-b3-quoted one) 'x)
          'x))
        (right
         (list
          'equal
          (putnam-1972-b3-operation-term
           op 'x (putnam-1972-b3-quoted one))
          'x)))
    (list
     'lambda
     '(x)
     (putnam-1972-b3-restricted-predicate-term
      carrier
      '(x)
      (putnam-1972-b3-and-term left right)))))

(defun putnam-1972-b3-inverse-law-function
    (carrier op inv one)
  (let* ((inv-x
          (putnam-1972-b3-inverse-term inv 'x))
         (left
          (list
           'equal
           (putnam-1972-b3-operation-term op inv-x 'x)
           (putnam-1972-b3-quoted one)))
         (right
          (list
           'equal
           (putnam-1972-b3-operation-term op 'x inv-x)
           (putnam-1972-b3-quoted one))))
    (list
     'lambda
     '(x)
     (putnam-1972-b3-restricted-predicate-term
      carrier
      '(x)
      (putnam-1972-b3-and-term left right)))))

(defun putnam-1972-b3-member-p (carrier element)
  (apply$ carrier (list element)))

(defun putnam-1972-b3-multiply (op left right)
  (apply$ op (list left right)))

(defun putnam-1972-b3-power (op base exponent one)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix exponent)))
  (if (zp exponent)
      one
    (putnam-1972-b3-multiply
     op
     base
     (putnam-1972-b3-power op base (- exponent 1) one))))

(defun putnam-1972-b3-group-p (carrier op inv one)
  (and
   (tamep-functionp carrier)
   (tamep-functionp op)
   (tamep-functionp inv)
   (putnam-1972-b3-member-p carrier one)
   (fn-equal
    (putnam-1972-b3-operation-closure-function carrier op)
    (putnam-1972-b3-true-function '(x y)))
   (fn-equal
    (putnam-1972-b3-inverse-closure-function carrier inv)
    (putnam-1972-b3-true-function '(x)))
   (fn-equal
    (putnam-1972-b3-associative-function carrier op)
    (putnam-1972-b3-true-function '(x y z)))
   (fn-equal
    (putnam-1972-b3-identity-function carrier op one)
    (putnam-1972-b3-true-function '(x)))
   (fn-equal
    (putnam-1972-b3-inverse-law-function carrier op inv one)
    (putnam-1972-b3-true-function '(x)))))

;; A trace (ONE, B, B^2, ..., B^k) has even list length exactly when its
;; positive number k of multiplication steps is odd.  Requiring its last entry
;; to be ONE is therefore equivalent to B^(2*n-1) = ONE for some n > 0.

(defun putnam-1972-b3-trace-step-function (op b)
  (list
   'lambda
   '(tail)
   (list
    'if
    (list 'consp (list 'cdr 'tail))
    (list
     'equal
     (list 'car (list 'cdr 'tail))
     (putnam-1972-b3-operation-term
      op
      (putnam-1972-b3-quoted b)
      (list 'car 'tail)))
    (putnam-1972-b3-quoted t))))

(defun putnam-1972-b3-no-odd-power-witness-function (op b one)
  (let ((one-term
         (putnam-1972-b3-quoted one))
        (steps-hold
         (list
          'always$
          (putnam-1972-b3-quoted
           (putnam-1972-b3-trace-step-function op b))
          (list 'tails 'trace))))
    (list
     'lambda
     '(trace)
     (list
      'if
      (list 'true-listp 'trace)
      (list
       'if
       (list 'consp 'trace)
       (list
        'if
        (list 'consp (list 'cdr 'trace))
        (list
         'if
         (list 'evenp (list 'len 'trace))
         (list
          'if
          (list 'equal (list 'car 'trace) one-term)
          (list
           'if
           (list 'equal
                 (list 'car (list 'last 'trace))
                 one-term)
           (list 'if
                 steps-hold
                 (putnam-1972-b3-quoted nil)
                 (putnam-1972-b3-quoted t))
           (putnam-1972-b3-quoted t))
          (putnam-1972-b3-quoted t))
         (putnam-1972-b3-quoted t))
        (putnam-1972-b3-quoted t))
       (putnam-1972-b3-quoted t))
      (putnam-1972-b3-quoted t)))))

(defun putnam-1972-b3-odd-power-exists-p (op b one)
  (let ((witness-predicate
         (putnam-1972-b3-no-odd-power-witness-function op b one)))
    (and
     (tamep-functionp witness-predicate)
     (not
      (fn-equal
       witness-predicate
       (putnam-1972-b3-true-function '(trace)))))))

(defun putnambench-putnam-1972-b3-statement
    (carrier op inv one a b)
  (implies
   (and
    (putnam-1972-b3-group-p carrier op inv one)
    (putnam-1972-b3-member-p carrier a)
    (putnam-1972-b3-member-p carrier b)
    (equal
     (putnam-1972-b3-multiply
      op
      (putnam-1972-b3-multiply op a b)
      a)
     (putnam-1972-b3-multiply
      op
      (putnam-1972-b3-multiply
       op
       b
       (putnam-1972-b3-power op a 2 one))
      b))
    (equal
     (putnam-1972-b3-power op a 3 one)
     one)
    (putnam-1972-b3-odd-power-exists-p op b one))
   (equal b one)))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

title: putnam_1972_b3
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1972_b3:
-- in an arbitrary group, the relations ABA = BA^2B and A^3 = 1, together
-- with an odd positive power of B equal to 1, imply B = 1.
-- This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _*_)
open import Agda.Primitive using (Level; lsuc; _⊔_)

record Exists
  {a p : Level}
  (A : Set a)
  (property : A -> Set p) :
  Set (a ⊔ p) where

  constructor witness
  field
    value     : A
    satisfies : property value

record Group
  {ell : Level}
  (G : Set ell) :
  Set ell where

  field
    identity       : G
    inverse        : G -> G
    multiply       : G -> G -> G
    associative    : (x y z : G) ->
                     multiply (multiply x y) z ==
                     multiply x (multiply y z)
    identity-left  : (x : G) -> multiply identity x == x
    identity-right : (x : G) -> multiply x identity == x
    inverse-left   : (x : G) -> multiply (inverse x) x == identity
    inverse-right  : (x : G) -> multiply x (inverse x) == identity

open Group

power :
  {ell : Level} ->
  {G : Set ell} ->
  Group G ->
  G ->
  Nat ->
  G
power structure x zero =
  identity structure
power structure x (suc exponent) =
  multiply structure (power structure x exponent) x

two : Nat
two =
  suc (suc zero)

three : Nat
three =
  suc two

putnam-1972-b3 :
  (ell : Level) ->
  Set (lsuc ell)
putnam-1972-b3 ell =
  (G : Set ell) ->
  (structure : Group G) ->
  (A B : G) ->
  multiply structure (multiply structure A B) A ==
    multiply structure
      (multiply structure B (power structure A two))
      B ->
  power structure A three == identity structure ->
  Exists Nat
    (\ k ->
      power structure B (suc (two * k)) == identity structure) ->
  B == identity structure

(*
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench artifact putnam_1972_b3:
  group relations forcing an element whose positive odd power is the identity
  to be the identity. This file contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open arithmeticTheory pred_setTheory groupTheory;

val putnam_1972_b3 =
  ``!(g : 'a group) (A B : 'a).
      Group g /\
      A IN g.carrier /\
      B IN g.carrier /\
      g.op (g.op A B) A =
        g.op (g.op B (g.exp A 2)) B /\
      g.exp A 3 = g.id /\
      (?n : num.
         0 < n /\
         g.exp B (2 * n - 1) = g.id)
      ==>
      B = g.id``;

$(
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact
  putnam_1972_b3: group elements satisfying ABA = BA^2B, A^3 = 1, and
  an odd positive power of B equal to 1 must have B = 1. This file contains
  no proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  In SetMM, G e. Grp supplies an arbitrary group, Base ` G is its carrier,
  +g ` G is its group operation, 0g ` G is its identity, and .g ` G is
  integer group exponentiation with the exponent as the first argument.
  The witness n ranges over the positive integers NN, so 2n - 1 is precisely
  the source's positive odd exponent.

  The final declaration is the single unproved $a corpus statement; this
  database contains no $p proof statement.
$)

${
  $d A B G n $.

  putnambench-putnam-1972-b3 $a |-
    A. G A. A e. ( Base ` G ) A. B e. ( Base ` G )
      (
        (
          G e. Grp
          /\
          (
            (
              ( A ( +g ` G ) B ) ( +g ` G ) A
            )
            =
            (
              ( B ( +g ` G ) ( 2 ( .g ` G ) A ) )
              ( +g ` G )
              B
            )
            /\
            (
              ( 3 ( .g ` G ) A ) = ( 0g ` G )
              /\
              E. n e. NN
                (
                  ( ( ( 2 x. n ) - 1 ) ( .g ` G ) B )
                  =
                  ( 0g ` G )
                )
            )
          )
        )
        ->
        B = ( 0g ` G )
      )
  $.
$}

title: putnam_1972_b3
putnam_1972_b3
content:
% Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench artifact putnam_1972_b3:
% in any group, elements A and B satisfying ABA = BA^2B, A^3 = 1, and
% B^(2n-1) = 1 for some positive integer n must have B = 1. This file contains no proof.

putnam_1972_b3[
  Element: TYPE+,
  multiply: [Element, Element -> Element],
  inverse: [Element -> Element],
  one: Element
]: THEORY
BEGIN
  group_laws: bool =
    (FORALL (x, y, z: Element):
      multiply(multiply(x, y), z)
        = multiply(x, multiply(y, z)))
      AND (FORALL (x: Element):
        multiply(one, x) = x
          AND multiply(x, one) = x)
      AND (FORALL (x: Element):
        multiply(inverse(x), x) = one
          AND multiply(x, inverse(x)) = one)

  group_power(base: Element, exponent: nat): RECURSIVE Element =
    IF exponent = 0 THEN
      one
    ELSE
      multiply(
        group_power(base, exponent - 1),
        base)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE exponent

  putnam_1972_b3: bool =
    group_laws IMPLIES
      (FORALL (A, B: Element):
        (multiply(multiply(A, B), A)
            = multiply(
                multiply(B, group_power(A, 2)),
                B)
          AND group_power(A, 3) = one
          AND (EXISTS (n: posnat):
            group_power(B, 2 * n - 1) = one))
        IMPLIES B = one)
END putnam_1972_b3

(* Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench artifact putnam_1972_b4:
   an integer-coefficient polynomial in three variables recovers x from
   x^n, x^(n+1), and x + x^(n+2). This file contains no proof. *)

From Stdlib Require Import ZArith List.

Open Scope Z_scope.

Fixpoint zpow_nat (x : Z) (n : nat) : Z :=
  match n with
  | O => 1
  | S k => x * zpow_nat x k
  end.

Fixpoint eval_int_poly (P : list Z) (x : Z) : Z :=
  match P with
  | nil => 0
  | coefficient :: rest =>
      coefficient + x * eval_int_poly rest x
  end.

Fixpoint eval_int_poly2
    (P : list (list Z)) (a b : Z) : Z :=
  match P with
  | nil => 0
  | coefficient :: rest =>
      eval_int_poly coefficient a +
      b * eval_int_poly2 rest a b
  end.

Fixpoint eval_int_poly3
    (P : list (list (list Z))) (a b c : Z) : Z :=
  match P with
  | nil => 0
  | coefficient :: rest =>
      eval_int_poly2 coefficient a b +
      c * eval_int_poly3 rest a b c
  end.

Theorem putnam_1972_b4
    (n : nat)
    (hn : (n > 1)%nat) :
  exists P : list (list (list Z)),
    forall x : Z,
      x = eval_int_poly3 P
        (zpow_nat x n)
        (zpow_nat x (n + 1)%nat)
        (x + zpow_nat x (n + 2)%nat).
Admitted.

title: putnam_1972_b4
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1972_b4:
;; for every natural n at least two, an integer-coefficient polynomial in
;; three variables recovers x from x^n, x^(n+1), and x+x^(n+2). This file
;; contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

;; A term is (coefficient exponent-a exponent-b exponent-c), and a polynomial
;; is a finite list of terms. This is an exact sparse representation of an
;; integer polynomial, not a finite table of its values.

(defun putnam-1972-b4-integer-polynomial-p (polynomial)
  (if (consp polynomial)
      (let ((term (car polynomial)))
        (and (true-listp term)
             (equal (len term) 4)
             (integerp (nth 0 term))
             (natp (nth 1 term))
             (natp (nth 2 term))
             (natp (nth 3 term))
             (putnam-1972-b4-integer-polynomial-p
              (cdr polynomial))))
    (equal polynomial nil)))

(defun putnam-1972-b4-term-value (term a b c)
  (* (nth 0 term)
     (expt a (nth 1 term))
     (expt b (nth 2 term))
     (expt c (nth 3 term))))

(defun putnam-1972-b4-polynomial-value (polynomial a b c)
  (if (consp polynomial)
      (+ (putnam-1972-b4-term-value (car polynomial) a b c)
         (putnam-1972-b4-polynomial-value
          (cdr polynomial) a b c))
    0))

(defun-sk putnam-1972-b4-polynomial-identity-p (n polynomial)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (integerp x)
     (equal
      x
      (putnam-1972-b4-polynomial-value
       polynomial
       (expt x n)
       (expt x (+ n 1))
       (+ x (expt x (+ n 2))))))))

(defun-sk putnam-1972-b4-polynomial-exists-p (n)
  (exists (polynomial)
    (and
     (putnam-1972-b4-integer-polynomial-p polynomial)
     (putnam-1972-b4-polynomial-identity-p n polynomial))))

(defun putnambench-putnam-1972-b4-statement (n)
  (implies
   (and (natp n)
        (< 1 n))
   (putnam-1972-b4-polynomial-exists-p n)))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

title: putnam_1972_b4
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1972_b4:
-- for every natural n greater than one, an integer polynomial in three
-- variables recovers x from x^n, x^(n+1), and x+x^(n+2). This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Int using (Int; pos; negsuc)
open import Agda.Builtin.List using (List; []; _∷_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; _*_)

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

data GreaterThanOne : Nat -> Set where
  greater-than-one :
    {k : Nat} ->
    GreaterThanOne (suc (suc k))

negative : Nat -> Int
negative zero =
  pos zero
negative (suc n) =
  negsuc n

difference : Nat -> Nat -> Int
difference zero zero =
  pos zero
difference (suc m) zero =
  pos (suc m)
difference zero (suc n) =
  negsuc n
difference (suc m) (suc n) =
  difference m n

addInt : Int -> Int -> Int
addInt (pos m) (pos n) =
  pos (m + n)
addInt (pos m) (negsuc n) =
  difference m (suc n)
addInt (negsuc m) (pos n) =
  difference n (suc m)
addInt (negsuc m) (negsuc n) =
  negsuc (suc (m + n))

multiplyInt : Int -> Int -> Int
multiplyInt (pos m) (pos n) =
  pos (m * n)
multiplyInt (pos m) (negsuc n) =
  negative (m * suc n)
multiplyInt (negsuc m) (pos n) =
  negative (suc m * n)
multiplyInt (negsuc m) (negsuc n) =
  pos (suc m * suc n)

powerInt : Int -> Nat -> Int
powerInt x zero =
  pos (suc zero)
powerInt x (suc n) =
  multiplyInt x (powerInt x n)

record Monomial : Set where
  constructor monomial
  field
    coefficient    : Int
    firstExponent  : Nat
    secondExponent : Nat
    thirdExponent  : Nat

open Monomial

Polynomial : Set
Polynomial =
  List Monomial

evaluateMonomial : Monomial -> Int -> Int -> Int -> Int
evaluateMonomial term x y z =
  multiplyInt
    (coefficient term)
    (multiplyInt
      (powerInt x (firstExponent term))
      (multiplyInt
        (powerInt y (secondExponent term))
        (powerInt z (thirdExponent term))))

evaluatePolynomial : Polynomial -> Int -> Int -> Int -> Int
evaluatePolynomial [] x y z =
  pos zero
evaluatePolynomial (term ∷ terms) x y z =
  addInt
    (evaluateMonomial term x y z)
    (evaluatePolynomial terms x y z)

putnam-1972-b4 : Set
putnam-1972-b4 =
  (n : Nat) ->
  GreaterThanOne n ->
  Exists Polynomial
    (\ polynomial ->
      (x : Int) ->
      x ==
      evaluatePolynomial polynomial
        (powerInt x n)
        (powerInt x (suc n))
        (addInt x (powerInt x (suc (suc n)))))

$(
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact
  putnam_1972_b4: existence, for every natural exponent n greater than one,
  of an integer-coefficient polynomial in three variables that
  recovers each integer x from x^n, x^(n+1), and x+x^(n+2).
  This file contains no proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  The ordinal 3o is the three-element variable-index set. Thus
  ( 3o mPoly ZZring ) is set.mm's ring of finite-support polynomials in
  three variables over the integers, and ( 3o eval ZZring ) evaluates such
  a polynomial at an assignment from 3o to ZZ. The assignment sends ordinal
  indices (/), 1o, and 2o respectively to x^n, x^(n+1), and x+x^(n+2).

  The polynomial witness remains existentially quantified inside the
  universal quantifier over n. The final declaration is the single unproved
  $a corpus statement; this database contains no $p proof statement.
$)

${
  $d i n p x $.

  putnambench-putnam-1972-b4 $a |-
    A. n e. NN0
      (
        1 < n
        ->
        E. p e. ( Base ` ( 3o mPoly ZZring ) )
          A. x e. ZZ
            x
            =
            (
              ( ( 3o eval ZZring ) ` p )
              `
              (
                i e. 3o |->
                  if (
                    i = (/) ,
                    ( x ^ n ) ,
                    if (
                      i = 1o ,
                      ( x ^ ( n + 1 ) ) ,
                      ( x + ( x ^ ( n + 2 ) ) )
                    )
                  )
              )
            )
      )
  $.
$}

content:
% Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench artifact putnam_1972_b4:
% for every natural number n at least 2, an integer polynomial in three variables
% recovers x from x^n, x^(n+1), and x + x^(n+2). This file contains no proof.

putnam_1972_b4: THEORY
BEGIN
  coefficients: TYPE = [nat, nat, nat -> int]

  sum_third_variable(
      coefficient: coefficients,
      first_value, second_value, third_value: int,
      first_exponent, second_exponent, third_count: nat):
      RECURSIVE int =
    IF third_count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      sum_third_variable(
        coefficient,
        first_value, second_value, third_value,
        first_exponent, second_exponent, third_count - 1)
        + coefficient(
            first_exponent,
            second_exponent,
            third_count - 1)
          * first_value ^ first_exponent
          * second_value ^ second_exponent
          * third_value ^ (third_count - 1)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE third_count

  sum_second_variable(
      coefficient: coefficients,
      first_value, second_value, third_value: int,
      first_exponent, second_count, third_count: nat):
      RECURSIVE int =
    IF second_count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      sum_second_variable(
        coefficient,
        first_value, second_value, third_value,
        first_exponent, second_count - 1, third_count)
        + sum_third_variable(
            coefficient,
            first_value, second_value, third_value,
            first_exponent, second_count - 1, third_count)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE second_count

  polynomial_value(
      coefficient: coefficients,
      first_value, second_value, third_value: int,
      first_count, second_count, third_count: nat):
      RECURSIVE int =
    IF first_count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      polynomial_value(
        coefficient,
        first_value, second_value, third_value,
        first_count - 1, second_count, third_count)
        + sum_second_variable(
            coefficient,
            first_value, second_value, third_value,
            first_count - 1, second_count, third_count)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE first_count

  putnam_1972_b4: bool =
    FORALL (n: nat):
      n > 1 IMPLIES
        EXISTS (coefficient: coefficients),
               (first_count, second_count, third_count: nat):
          FORALL (x: int):
            x = polynomial_value(
              coefficient,
              x ^ n,
              x ^ (n + 1),
              x + x ^ (n + 2),
              first_count,
              second_count,
              third_count)
END putnam_1972_b4
