(* Note: Alternatively, for this problem, one may import Triangle.Angles by Manuel Eberl from AFP, however we have included the relevant definitions locally to avoid an extra dependency on AFP *)
definition vangle where
  "vangle u v = (if u = 0 \<or> v = 0 then pi / 2 else arccos (u \<bullet> v / (norm u * norm v)))"
definition angle where
  "angle a b c = vangle (a - b) (c - b)"
definition coplanar where
  "coplanar S \<longleftrightarrow> (\<exists>u v. \<forall>x \<in> S. \<forall>y \<in> S. \<exists>c d. x - y = c *\<^sub>R u + d *\<^sub>R v)"
theorem putnam_1972_b5:
  fixes A B C D :: "real^3"
  assumes hnonplanar : "\<not> coplanar {A,B,C,D}"
    and hangles : "angle A B C = angle C D A \<and> angle B C D = angle D A B"
  shows "dist A B = dist C D \<and> dist B C = dist D A"
  sorry

end

title: putnam_1972_b5
putnam_1972_b5
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1972_b5:
;; for four noncoplanar points in real three-space, equality of two pairs of
;; opposite angles implies equality of the corresponding opposite side
;; lengths. This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))

;; Noncoplanarity is the nonvanishing of a 3-by-3 determinant. Under that
;; hypothesis all rays in the four angles are nonzero. Equality of two such
;; angles is therefore equivalent to equality of their cosines; after removing
;; the positive square-root denominators, this says that the two dot products
;; have the same sign and that their squared normalized values are equal.
;; Distance equality is equivalently equality of squared distances. Thus the
;; complete statement is a universal first-order sentence over real closed
;; fields.
;;
;; A real counterexample exists iff one exists over the real algebraic
;; numbers. Every finite algebraic coordinate tuple lies in Q(alpha) for one
;; real algebraic alpha. Rational polynomials in alpha encode the twelve
;; coordinates, and Sturm-Tarski queries decide their signs exactly.

;; Rational polynomials in alpha use descending coefficient order.

(defun putnam-1972-b5-rp-p (p)
  (if (consp p)
      (and (rationalp (car p))
           (putnam-1972-b5-rp-p (cdr p)))
    (equal p nil)))

(defun putnam-1972-b5-rp-normalize (p)
  (if (consp p)
      (if (equal (car p) 0)
          (putnam-1972-b5-rp-normalize (cdr p))
        p)
    nil))

(defun putnam-1972-b5-rp-negate (p)
  (if (consp p)
      (cons (- (car p))
            (putnam-1972-b5-rp-negate (cdr p)))
    nil))

(defun putnam-1972-b5-rp-add-raw (p q)
  (declare (xargs :measure (+ (acl2-count p) (acl2-count q))))
  (cond
   ((endp p) q)
   ((endp q) p)
   ((< (len p) (len q))
    (cons (car q)
          (putnam-1972-b5-rp-add-raw p (cdr q))))
   ((< (len q) (len p))
    (cons (car p)
          (putnam-1972-b5-rp-add-raw (cdr p) q)))
   (t
    (cons (+ (car p) (car q))
          (putnam-1972-b5-rp-add-raw (cdr p) (cdr q))))))

(defun putnam-1972-b5-rp-add (p q)
  (putnam-1972-b5-rp-normalize
   (putnam-1972-b5-rp-add-raw p q)))

(defun putnam-1972-b5-rp-subtract (p q)
  (putnam-1972-b5-rp-add
   p (putnam-1972-b5-rp-negate q)))

(defun putnam-1972-b5-rp-scale (coefficient p)
  (if (consp p)
      (cons (* coefficient (car p))
            (putnam-1972-b5-rp-scale coefficient (cdr p)))
    nil))

(defun putnam-1972-b5-zeroes (n)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix n)))
  (if (zp n)
      nil
    (cons 0 (putnam-1972-b5-zeroes (- n 1)))))

(defun putnam-1972-b5-rp-scale-shift (coefficient p shift)
  (append
   (putnam-1972-b5-rp-scale coefficient p)
   (putnam-1972-b5-zeroes shift)))

(defun putnam-1972-b5-rp-multiply-raw (p q)
  (if (consp p)
      (putnam-1972-b5-rp-add
       (putnam-1972-b5-rp-scale-shift
        (car p) q (len (cdr p)))
       (putnam-1972-b5-rp-multiply-raw (cdr p) q))
    nil))

(defun putnam-1972-b5-rp-multiply (p q)
  (putnam-1972-b5-rp-normalize
   (putnam-1972-b5-rp-multiply-raw p q)))

(defun putnam-1972-b5-rp-square (p)
  (putnam-1972-b5-rp-multiply p p))

(defun putnam-1972-b5-rp-eval-aux (p x accumulator)
  (if (consp p)
      (putnam-1972-b5-rp-eval-aux
       (cdr p) x (+ (* accumulator x) (car p)))
    accumulator))

(defun putnam-1972-b5-rp-eval (p x)
  (putnam-1972-b5-rp-eval-aux p x 0))

(defun putnam-1972-b5-rp-derivative-aux (p degree)
  (if (consp p)
      (if (zp degree)
          nil
        (cons (* degree (car p))
              (putnam-1972-b5-rp-derivative-aux
               (cdr p) (- degree 1))))
    nil))

(defun putnam-1972-b5-rp-derivative (p)
  (let ((normalized (putnam-1972-b5-rp-normalize p)))
    (putnam-1972-b5-rp-normalize
     (putnam-1972-b5-rp-derivative-aux
      normalized
      (nfix (- (len normalized) 1))))))

(defun putnam-1972-b5-rp-remainder-fuel (p q fuel)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix fuel)))
  (let ((p (putnam-1972-b5-rp-normalize p))
        (q (putnam-1972-b5-rp-normalize q)))
    (if (or (zp fuel)
            (endp q)
            (< (len p) (len q)))
        p
      (putnam-1972-b5-rp-remainder-fuel
       (putnam-1972-b5-rp-subtract
        p
        (putnam-1972-b5-rp-scale-shift
         (/ (car p) (car q))
         q
         (- (len p) (len q))))
       q
       (- fuel 1)))))

(defun putnam-1972-b5-rp-remainder (p q)
  (putnam-1972-b5-rp-remainder-fuel
   p q (+ 1 (len (putnam-1972-b5-rp-normalize p)))))

(defun putnam-1972-b5-rp-sturm-tail (previous current fuel)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix fuel)))
  (let ((current (putnam-1972-b5-rp-normalize current)))
    (if (or (zp fuel) (endp current))
        nil
      (cons
       current
       (putnam-1972-b5-rp-sturm-tail
        current
        (putnam-1972-b5-rp-negate
         (putnam-1972-b5-rp-remainder previous current))
        (- fuel 1))))))

(defun putnam-1972-b5-rp-sturm-sequence (p q)
  (let ((p (putnam-1972-b5-rp-normalize p))
        (q (putnam-1972-b5-rp-normalize q)))
    (if (endp p)
        nil
      (cons
       p
       (if (endp q)
           nil
         (cons
          q
          (putnam-1972-b5-rp-sturm-tail
           p q (+ 1 (len p) (len q)))))))))

(defun putnam-1972-b5-rational-sign (x)
  (cond ((< x 0) -1)
        ((< 0 x) 1)
        (t 0)))

(defun putnam-1972-b5-rp-variations-aux
    (polynomials x previous-sign)
  (if (consp polynomials)
      (let ((sign
             (putnam-1972-b5-rational-sign
              (putnam-1972-b5-rp-eval
               (car polynomials) x))))
        (if (equal sign 0)
            (putnam-1972-b5-rp-variations-aux
             (cdr polynomials) x previous-sign)
          (+ (if (and (not (equal previous-sign 0))
                      (not (equal sign previous-sign)))
                 1
               0)
             (putnam-1972-b5-rp-variations-aux
              (cdr polynomials) x sign))))
    0))

(defun putnam-1972-b5-rp-variations (polynomials x)
  (putnam-1972-b5-rp-variations-aux polynomials x 0))

(defun putnam-1972-b5-rp-cauchy-index (p q lower upper)
  (let ((sequence
         (putnam-1972-b5-rp-sturm-sequence p q)))
    (- (putnam-1972-b5-rp-variations sequence lower)
       (putnam-1972-b5-rp-variations sequence upper))))

(defun putnam-1972-b5-rp-root-count (p lower upper)
  (putnam-1972-b5-rp-cauchy-index
   p (putnam-1972-b5-rp-derivative p) lower upper))

(defun putnam-1972-b5-primitive-p (primitive lower upper)
  (and
   (putnam-1972-b5-rp-p primitive)
   (consp (putnam-1972-b5-rp-normalize primitive))
   (rationalp lower)
   (rationalp upper)
   (< lower upper)
   (not (equal
         (putnam-1972-b5-rp-eval primitive lower) 0))
   (not (equal
         (putnam-1972-b5-rp-eval primitive upper) 0))
   (equal
    (putnam-1972-b5-rp-root-count primitive lower upper)
    1)
   (not
    (equal
     (putnam-1972-b5-rp-cauchy-index
      primitive
      (putnam-1972-b5-rp-multiply
       (putnam-1972-b5-rp-derivative primitive)
       (putnam-1972-b5-rp-derivative primitive))
      lower
      upper)
     0))))

;; For the single isolated simple root alpha, this Sturm-Tarski query is the
;; sign of VALUE(alpha).
(defun putnam-1972-b5-algebraic-sign
    (primitive lower upper value)
  (putnam-1972-b5-rp-cauchy-index
   primitive
   (putnam-1972-b5-rp-multiply
    (putnam-1972-b5-rp-derivative primitive)
    value)
   lower
   upper))

(defun putnam-1972-b5-point-code-p (point)
  (and
   (true-listp point)
   (equal (len point) 3)
   (putnam-1972-b5-rp-p (nth 0 point))
   (putnam-1972-b5-rp-p (nth 1 point))
   (putnam-1972-b5-rp-p (nth 2 point))))

(defun putnam-1972-b5-vector-subtract (left right)
  (list
   (putnam-1972-b5-rp-subtract (nth 0 left) (nth 0 right))
   (putnam-1972-b5-rp-subtract (nth 1 left) (nth 1 right))
   (putnam-1972-b5-rp-subtract (nth 2 left) (nth 2 right))))

(defun putnam-1972-b5-dot-product (left right)
  (putnam-1972-b5-rp-add
   (putnam-1972-b5-rp-multiply
    (nth 0 left) (nth 0 right))
   (putnam-1972-b5-rp-add
    (putnam-1972-b5-rp-multiply
     (nth 1 left) (nth 1 right))
    (putnam-1972-b5-rp-multiply
     (nth 2 left) (nth 2 right)))))

(defun putnam-1972-b5-distance-squared (left right)
  (putnam-1972-b5-dot-product
   (putnam-1972-b5-vector-subtract left right)
   (putnam-1972-b5-vector-subtract left right)))

(defun putnam-1972-b5-determinant (u v w)
  (putnam-1972-b5-rp-add
   (putnam-1972-b5-rp-subtract
    (putnam-1972-b5-rp-multiply
     (nth 0 u)
     (putnam-1972-b5-rp-subtract
      (putnam-1972-b5-rp-multiply (nth 1 v) (nth 2 w))
      (putnam-1972-b5-rp-multiply (nth 2 v) (nth 1 w))))
    (putnam-1972-b5-rp-multiply
     (nth 1 u)
     (putnam-1972-b5-rp-subtract
      (putnam-1972-b5-rp-multiply (nth 0 v) (nth 2 w))
      (putnam-1972-b5-rp-multiply (nth 2 v) (nth 0 w)))))
   (putnam-1972-b5-rp-multiply
    (nth 2 u)
    (putnam-1972-b5-rp-subtract
     (putnam-1972-b5-rp-multiply (nth 0 v) (nth 1 w))
     (putnam-1972-b5-rp-multiply (nth 1 v) (nth 0 w))))))

(defun putnam-1972-b5-zero-at-alpha-p
    (primitive lower upper value)
  (equal
   (putnam-1972-b5-algebraic-sign
    primitive lower upper value)
   0))

(defun putnam-1972-b5-equal-at-alpha-p
    (primitive lower upper left right)
  (putnam-1972-b5-zero-at-alpha-p
   primitive lower upper
   (putnam-1972-b5-rp-subtract left right)))

(defun putnam-1972-b5-noncoplanar-p
    (primitive lower upper a b c d)
  (not
   (putnam-1972-b5-zero-at-alpha-p
    primitive
    lower
    upper
    (putnam-1972-b5-determinant
     (putnam-1972-b5-vector-subtract b a)
     (putnam-1972-b5-vector-subtract c a)
     (putnam-1972-b5-vector-subtract d a)))))

(defun putnam-1972-b5-angle-equal-p
    (primitive lower upper
               left vertex right
               other-left other-vertex other-right)
  (let* ((u (putnam-1972-b5-vector-subtract left vertex))
         (v (putnam-1972-b5-vector-subtract right vertex))
         (other-u
          (putnam-1972-b5-vector-subtract
           other-left other-vertex))
         (other-v
          (putnam-1972-b5-vector-subtract
           other-right other-vertex))
         (dot (putnam-1972-b5-dot-product u v))
         (other-dot
          (putnam-1972-b5-dot-product other-u other-v))
         (norm-product
          (putnam-1972-b5-rp-multiply
           (putnam-1972-b5-dot-product u u)
           (putnam-1972-b5-dot-product v v)))
         (other-norm-product
          (putnam-1972-b5-rp-multiply
           (putnam-1972-b5-dot-product other-u other-u)
           (putnam-1972-b5-dot-product other-v other-v)))
         (squared-cosine-difference
          (putnam-1972-b5-rp-subtract
           (putnam-1972-b5-rp-multiply
            (putnam-1972-b5-rp-square dot)
            other-norm-product)
           (putnam-1972-b5-rp-multiply
            (putnam-1972-b5-rp-square other-dot)
            norm-product))))
    (and
     (equal
      (putnam-1972-b5-algebraic-sign
       primitive lower upper dot)
      (putnam-1972-b5-algebraic-sign
       primitive lower upper other-dot))
     (putnam-1972-b5-zero-at-alpha-p
      primitive lower upper squared-cosine-difference))))

(defun putnambench-putnam-1972-b5-statement
    (primitive lower upper a b c d)
  (implies
   (and
    (putnam-1972-b5-primitive-p primitive lower upper)
    (putnam-1972-b5-point-code-p a)
    (putnam-1972-b5-point-code-p b)
    (putnam-1972-b5-point-code-p c)
    (putnam-1972-b5-point-code-p d)
    (putnam-1972-b5-noncoplanar-p
     primitive lower upper a b c d)
    (putnam-1972-b5-angle-equal-p
     primitive lower upper a b c c d a)
    (putnam-1972-b5-angle-equal-p
     primitive lower upper b c d d a b))
   (and
    (putnam-1972-b5-equal-at-alpha-p
     primitive lower upper
     (putnam-1972-b5-distance-squared a b)
     (putnam-1972-b5-distance-squared c d))
    (putnam-1972-b5-equal-at-alpha-p
     primitive lower upper
     (putnam-1972-b5-distance-squared b c)
     (putnam-1972-b5-distance-squared d a)))))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

title: putnam_1972_b5
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1972_b5:
-- a non-coplanar quadrilateral in real Euclidean three-space with two pairs
-- of equal opposite angles has equal corresponding opposite side lengths.
-- This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc)

infix 4 _!=_
infixr 3 _and_
infixr 2 _or_

data Bottom : Set where

Not : Set -> Set
Not A =
  A -> Bottom

_!=_ : {A : Set} -> A -> A -> Set
x != y =
  Not (x == y)

record _and_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data _or_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  left  : A -> A or B
  right : B -> A or B

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

record CompleteOrderedField (R : Set) : Set1 where
  field
    zeroR oneR : R
    add multiply : R -> R -> R
    negate inverse : R -> R
    lessOrEqual : R -> R -> Set
    fromNat : Nat -> R

    one-not-zero :
      oneR != zeroR

    add-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> add x y == add y x
    add-associative :
      (x y z : R) -> add (add x y) z == add x (add y z)
    add-zero :
      (x : R) -> add x zeroR == x
    add-inverse :
      (x : R) -> add x (negate x) == zeroR

    multiply-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> multiply x y == multiply y x
    multiply-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply (multiply x y) z == multiply x (multiply y z)
    multiply-one :
      (x : R) -> multiply x oneR == x
    multiply-zero :
      (x : R) -> multiply x zeroR == zeroR
    distribute :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply x (add y z) ==
      add (multiply x y) (multiply x z)
    inverse-zero :
      inverse zeroR == zeroR
    multiply-inverse :
      (x : R) ->
      x != zeroR ->
      multiply x (inverse x) == oneR

    order-reflexive :
      (x : R) -> lessOrEqual x x
    order-transitive :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y z ->
      lessOrEqual x z
    order-antisymmetric :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y x ->
      x == y
    order-total :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y or lessOrEqual y x
    add-order :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual (add z x) (add z y)
    multiply-nonnegative :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR x ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR y ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR (multiply x y)
    zero-less-than-one :
      lessOrEqual zeroR oneR and zeroR != oneR

    fromNat-zero :
      fromNat zero == zeroR
    fromNat-successor :
      (n : Nat) -> fromNat (suc n) == add (fromNat n) oneR
    archimedean :
      (x : R) ->
      Exists Nat (\ n -> lessOrEqual x (fromNat n))
    least-upper-bound :
      (P : R -> Set) ->
      Exists R P ->
      Exists R
        (\ upper ->
          (x : R) ->
          P x ->
          lessOrEqual x upper) ->
      Exists R
        (\ supremum ->
          ((x : R) -> P x -> lessOrEqual x supremum)
          and
          ((upper : R) ->
            ((x : R) -> P x -> lessOrEqual x upper) ->
            lessOrEqual supremum upper))

open CompleteOrderedField

record Vector3 (R : Set) : Set where
  constructor vector3
  field
    x-coordinate : R
    y-coordinate : R
    z-coordinate : R

open Vector3

zeroVector :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  Vector3 R
zeroVector reals =
  vector3 (zeroR reals) (zeroR reals) (zeroR reals)

subtractR :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
subtractR reals x y =
  add reals x (negate reals y)

subtractVector :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  Vector3 R ->
  Vector3 R ->
  Vector3 R
subtractVector reals u v =
  vector3
    (subtractR reals (x-coordinate u) (x-coordinate v))
    (subtractR reals (y-coordinate u) (y-coordinate v))
    (subtractR reals (z-coordinate u) (z-coordinate v))

dot :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  Vector3 R ->
  Vector3 R ->
  R
dot reals u v =
  add reals
    (add reals
      (multiply reals (x-coordinate u) (x-coordinate v))
      (multiply reals (y-coordinate u) (y-coordinate v)))
    (multiply reals (z-coordinate u) (z-coordinate v))

determinant3 :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  Vector3 R ->
  Vector3 R ->
  Vector3 R ->
  R
determinant3 reals u v w =
  add reals
    (subtractR reals
      (multiply reals
        (x-coordinate u)
        (subtractR reals
          (multiply reals (y-coordinate v) (z-coordinate w))
          (multiply reals (z-coordinate v) (y-coordinate w))))
      (multiply reals
        (y-coordinate u)
        (subtractR reals
          (multiply reals (x-coordinate v) (z-coordinate w))
          (multiply reals (z-coordinate v) (x-coordinate w)))))
    (multiply reals
      (z-coordinate u)
      (subtractR reals
        (multiply reals (x-coordinate v) (y-coordinate w))
        (multiply reals (y-coordinate v) (x-coordinate w))))

record EuclideanNorm3
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) :
  Set1 where

  field
    norm : Vector3 R -> R
    norm-nonnegative :
      (v : Vector3 R) ->
      lessOrEqual reals (zeroR reals) (norm v)
    norm-square :
      (v : Vector3 R) ->
      multiply reals (norm v) (norm v) == dot reals v v
    norm-zero-vector :
      norm (zeroVector reals) == zeroR reals
    norm-definite :
      (v : Vector3 R) ->
      norm v == zeroR reals ->
      v == zeroVector reals

open EuclideanNorm3

distance :
  {R : Set} ->
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R} ->
  EuclideanNorm3 reals ->
  Vector3 R ->
  Vector3 R ->
  R
distance {reals = reals} euclidean p q =
  norm euclidean (subtractVector reals p q)

normalizedDot :
  {R : Set} ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) ->
  EuclideanNorm3 reals ->
  Vector3 R ->
  Vector3 R ->
  R
normalizedDot reals euclidean u v =
  multiply reals
    (dot reals u v)
    (inverse reals
      (multiply reals (norm euclidean u) (norm euclidean v)))

angleCosineAt :
  {R : Set} ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) ->
  EuclideanNorm3 reals ->
  Vector3 R ->
  Vector3 R ->
  Vector3 R ->
  R
angleCosineAt reals euclidean a b c =
  normalizedDot reals euclidean
    (subtractVector reals a b)
    (subtractVector reals c b)

Noncoplanar :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  Vector3 R ->
  Vector3 R ->
  Vector3 R ->
  Vector3 R ->
  Set
Noncoplanar reals a b c d =
  determinant3 reals
    (subtractVector reals b a)
    (subtractVector reals c a)
    (subtractVector reals d a)
  !=
  zeroR reals

module Putnam1972B5Statement
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R)
  (euclidean : EuclideanNorm3 reals) where

  proposition : Set
  proposition =
    (a b c d : Vector3 R) ->
    Noncoplanar reals a b c d ->
    (angleCosineAt reals euclidean a b c ==
       angleCosineAt reals euclidean c d a
    and
     angleCosineAt reals euclidean b c d ==
       angleCosineAt reals euclidean d a b) ->
    distance euclidean a b == distance euclidean c d
    and
    distance euclidean b c == distance euclidean d a

putnam-1972-b5 : Set1
putnam-1972-b5 =
  (R : Set) ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) ->
  (euclidean : EuclideanNorm3 reals) ->
  Putnam1972B5Statement.proposition reals euclidean

content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench artifact putnam_1972_b5:
  a skew quadrilateral in real three-space with two pairs of equal opposite
  vertex angles has equal corresponding opposite side lengths. This file
  contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open pairTheory realTheory transcTheory;

val putnam_1972_b5 =
  ``let zero3 = ((0, 0), 0) : (real # real) # real
    in
    let add3 =
      \P Q : (real # real) # real.
        ((FST (FST P) + FST (FST Q),
          SND (FST P) + SND (FST Q)),
         SND P + SND Q)
    in
    let sub3 =
      \P Q : (real # real) # real.
        ((FST (FST P) - FST (FST Q),
          SND (FST P) - SND (FST Q)),
         SND P - SND Q)
    in
    let smul3 =
      \c : real.
      \P : (real # real) # real.
        ((c * FST (FST P), c * SND (FST P)), c * SND P)
    in
    let dot3 =
      \P Q : (real # real) # real.
        FST (FST P) * FST (FST Q) +
        SND (FST P) * SND (FST Q) +
        SND P * SND Q
    in
    let norm3 =
      \P : (real # real) # real. sqrt (dot3 P P)
    in
    let dist3 =
      \P Q : (real # real) # real. norm3 (sub3 P Q)
    in
    let vangle3 =
      \u v : (real # real) # real.
        if u = zero3 \/ v = zero3 then
          pi / 2
        else
          acs (dot3 u v / (norm3 u * norm3 v))
    in
    let angle3 =
      \P Q R : (real # real) # real.
        vangle3 (sub3 P Q) (sub3 R Q)
    in
    let among4 =
      \A B C D x : (real # real) # real.
        x = A \/ x = B \/ x = C \/ x = D
    in
    let coplanar4 =
      \A B C D : (real # real) # real.
        ?u v : (real # real) # real.
          !x y : (real # real) # real.
            among4 A B C D x /\ among4 A B C D y
            ==>
            ?c d : real.
              sub3 x y = add3 (smul3 c u) (smul3 d v)
    in
      !A B C D : (real # real) # real.
        ~coplanar4 A B C D /\
        angle3 A B C = angle3 C D A /\
        angle3 B C D = angle3 D A B
        ==>
        dist3 A B = dist3 C D /\
        dist3 B C = dist3 D A``;

title: putnam_1972_b5
content:
$(
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact
  putnam_1972_b5: a noncoplanar quadrilateral in real three-space with two
  pairs of equal opposite angles has the corresponding pairs of opposite
  sides equal in length. This file contains no proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  P72B5R3 is real coordinate three-space. P72B5Dist is ordinary Euclidean
  distance, and P72B5Angle A B C is the total unoriented angle at B, with
  value pi/2 when either ray is zero, exactly as in the Lean and Isabelle
  sources.

  P72B5Coplanar S says that there are two vectors u and v such that every
  difference x - y of members of S is a real linear combination of u and v.
  The coordinate equation used below is exactly x - y = c u + d v, rewritten
  as x = y + c u + d v. All spanning vectors and scalar coefficients remain
  internally existentially quantified.

  The final declaration universally quantifies all four points and is the
  single unproved $a corpus statement; this database contains no $p proof
  statement.
$)

$c P72B5I P72B5R3 P72B5Dist P72B5Dot P72B5Angle P72B5Coplanar $.

p72b5-index-syntax $a class P72B5I $.
p72b5-space-syntax $a class P72B5R3 $.
p72b5-distance-syntax $a class ( P72B5Dist A B ) $.
p72b5-dot-syntax $a class ( P72B5Dot A B C ) $.
p72b5-angle-syntax $a class ( P72B5Angle A B C ) $.
p72b5-coplanar-syntax $a wff ( P72B5Coplanar S ) $.

p72b5-index-definition $a |- P72B5I = ( 1 ... 3 ) $.

p72b5-space-definition $a |- P72B5R3 = ( RR ^m P72B5I ) $.

${
  $d A B k $.

  p72b5-distance-definition $a |- (
    P72B5Dist A B
  ) = (
    sqrt
    `
    (
      sum_ k e. P72B5I
        ( ( ( A ` k ) - ( B ` k ) ) ^ 2 )
    )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d A B C k $.

  p72b5-dot-definition $a |- (
    P72B5Dot A B C
  ) = (
    sum_ k e. P72B5I
      (
        ( ( A ` k ) - ( B ` k ) )
        x.
        ( ( C ` k ) - ( B ` k ) )
      )
  ) $.
$}

p72b5-angle-definition $a |- (
  P72B5Angle A B C
) = if (
  (
    ( ( P72B5Dist A B ) = 0 )
    \/
    ( ( P72B5Dist C B ) = 0 )
  )
  ,
  ( _pi / 2 )
  ,
  (
    arccos
    `
    (
      ( P72B5Dot A B C )
      /
      (
        ( P72B5Dist A B )
        x.
        ( P72B5Dist C B )
      )
    )
  )
) $.

${
  $d S c d i u v x y $.

  p72b5-coplanar-definition $a |- (
    ( P72B5Coplanar S )
    <->
    (
      S C_ P72B5R3
      /\
      E. u e. P72B5R3 E. v e. P72B5R3
        A. x e. S A. y e. S
          E. c e. RR E. d e. RR
            x =
              (
                i e. P72B5I |->
                  (
                    ( y ` i )
                    +
                    (
                      ( c x. ( u ` i ) )
                      +
                      ( d x. ( v ` i ) )
                    )
                  )
              )
    )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d A B C D $.

  putnambench-putnam-1972-b5 $a |-
    A. A e. P72B5R3
    A. B e. P72B5R3
    A. C e. P72B5R3
    A. D e. P72B5R3
      (
        (
          -.
            (
              P72B5Coplanar
                ( { A , B } u. { C , D } )
            )
          /\
          (
            ( P72B5Angle A B C ) = ( P72B5Angle C D A )
            /\
            ( P72B5Angle B C D ) = ( P72B5Angle D A B )
          )
        )
        ->
        (
          ( P72B5Dist A B ) = ( P72B5Dist C D )
          /\
          ( P72B5Dist B C ) = ( P72B5Dist D A )
        )
      )
  $.
$}

title: putnam_1972_b5
content:
% Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench artifact putnam_1972_b5:
% a non-coplanar quadrilateral in real Euclidean three-space with two pairs
% of equal opposite angles has equal opposite side lengths. This file contains
% no proof.

putnam_1972_b5: THEORY
BEGIN
  point: TYPE =
    [# x_coord: real, y_coord: real, z_coord: real #]

  squared_distance(P, Q: point): real =
    (x_coord(Q) - x_coord(P)) ^ 2
      + (y_coord(Q) - y_coord(P)) ^ 2
      + (z_coord(Q) - z_coord(P)) ^ 2

  distance(P, Q: point): real =
    epsilon(
      LAMBDA (length: real):
        0 <= length
          AND length ^ 2 = squared_distance(P, Q))

  dot_from(vertex, first, second: point): real =
    (x_coord(first) - x_coord(vertex))
        * (x_coord(second) - x_coord(vertex))
      + (y_coord(first) - y_coord(vertex))
          * (y_coord(second) - y_coord(vertex))
      + (z_coord(first) - z_coord(vertex))
          * (z_coord(second) - z_coord(vertex))

  safe_div(numerator, denominator: real): real =
    IF denominator = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      numerator / denominator
    ENDIF

  angle_cosine(first, vertex, second: point): real =
    IF first = vertex OR second = vertex THEN
      0
    ELSE
      safe_div(
        dot_from(vertex, first, second),
        distance(vertex, first) * distance(vertex, second))
    ENDIF

  affine_determinant(A, B, C, D: point): real =
    LET ux: real = x_coord(B) - x_coord(A),
        uy: real = y_coord(B) - y_coord(A),
        uz: real = z_coord(B) - z_coord(A),
        vx: real = x_coord(C) - x_coord(A),
        vy: real = y_coord(C) - y_coord(A),
        vz: real = z_coord(C) - z_coord(A),
        wx: real = x_coord(D) - x_coord(A),
        wy: real = y_coord(D) - y_coord(A),
        wz: real = z_coord(D) - z_coord(A)
    IN
      ux * (vy * wz - vz * wy)
        - uy * (vx * wz - vz * wx)
        + uz * (vx * wy - vy * wx)

  coplanar(A, B, C, D: point): bool =
    affine_determinant(A, B, C, D) = 0

  putnam_1972_b5: bool =
    FORALL (A, B, C, D: point):
      (NOT coplanar(A, B, C, D)
        AND angle_cosine(A, B, C) = angle_cosine(C, D, A)
        AND angle_cosine(B, C, D) = angle_cosine(D, A, B))
      IMPLIES
        distance(A, B) = distance(C, D)
          AND distance(B, C) = distance(D, A)
END putnam_1972_b5

/--

(k : ℕ)
(hk : k ≥ 1)
(n : Fin k → ℤ)
(hn : ∀ i : Fin k, n i > 0)
(hn' : ∀ i j : Fin k, i < j → n i < n j)
(zpoly : ℂ → ℂ)
(hzpoly : zpoly = fun z => 1 + ∑ i : Fin k, z^(n i))
: ∀ z : ℂ, z ∈ ball 0 ((Real.sqrt 5 - 1)/2) → zpoly z ≠ 0 :=

    (zpoly : C -> C := fun z : C => (1 + sum_n (fun i => Cpow z (n i)) (k - 1))%C)
    (hk : (k >= 1)%nat)
    (hn : (forall i : nat, i <= k - 1 -> n i > 0)%nat)
    (hn' : (forall i : nat, i <= k - 1 -> forall j : nat, j <= k - 1 -> i < j -> n i < n j)%nat)

title: putnam_1972_b6
putnam_1972_b6
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1972_b6:
;; a polynomial with constant term one and strictly increasing positive
;; integer exponents has no complex zero of modulus less than
;; (sqrt(5)-1)/2. This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))

;; A zero of the source integer polynomial is algebraic. Its real and
;; imaginary parts can therefore be represented in one real number field
;; Q(alpha), using rational polynomials in a real algebraic generator alpha.
;; Conversely, every code below denotes an actual algebraic complex number.
;; Thus quantifying over these codes preserves every possible zero rather
;; than restricting the source's complex domain.
;;
;; Rational polynomials in alpha use descending coefficient order. A
;; rational polynomial and rational isolating interval define alpha, while
;; Sturm-Tarski queries decide signs at alpha exactly.

(defun putnam-1972-b6-rp-p (p)
  (if (consp p)
      (and (rationalp (car p))
           (putnam-1972-b6-rp-p (cdr p)))
    (equal p nil)))

(defun putnam-1972-b6-rp-normalize (p)
  (if (consp p)
      (if (equal (car p) 0)
          (putnam-1972-b6-rp-normalize (cdr p))
        p)
    nil))

(defun putnam-1972-b6-rp-negate (p)
  (if (consp p)
      (cons (- (car p))
            (putnam-1972-b6-rp-negate (cdr p)))
    nil))

(defun putnam-1972-b6-rp-add-raw (p q)
  (declare (xargs :measure (+ (acl2-count p) (acl2-count q))))
  (cond
   ((endp p) q)
   ((endp q) p)
   ((< (len p) (len q))
    (cons (car q)
          (putnam-1972-b6-rp-add-raw p (cdr q))))
   ((< (len q) (len p))
    (cons (car p)
          (putnam-1972-b6-rp-add-raw (cdr p) q)))
   (t
    (cons (+ (car p) (car q))
          (putnam-1972-b6-rp-add-raw (cdr p) (cdr q))))))

(defun putnam-1972-b6-rp-add (p q)
  (putnam-1972-b6-rp-normalize
   (putnam-1972-b6-rp-add-raw p q)))

(defun putnam-1972-b6-rp-subtract (p q)
  (putnam-1972-b6-rp-add
   p (putnam-1972-b6-rp-negate q)))

(defun putnam-1972-b6-rp-scale (coefficient p)
  (if (consp p)
      (cons (* coefficient (car p))
            (putnam-1972-b6-rp-scale coefficient (cdr p)))
    nil))

(defun putnam-1972-b6-zeroes (n)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix n)))
  (if (zp n)
      nil
    (cons 0 (putnam-1972-b6-zeroes (- n 1)))))

(defun putnam-1972-b6-rp-scale-shift (coefficient p shift)
  (append
   (putnam-1972-b6-rp-scale coefficient p)
   (putnam-1972-b6-zeroes shift)))

(defun putnam-1972-b6-rp-multiply-raw (p q)
  (if (consp p)
      (putnam-1972-b6-rp-add
       (putnam-1972-b6-rp-scale-shift
        (car p) q (len (cdr p)))
       (putnam-1972-b6-rp-multiply-raw (cdr p) q))
    nil))

(defun putnam-1972-b6-rp-multiply (p q)
  (putnam-1972-b6-rp-normalize
   (putnam-1972-b6-rp-multiply-raw p q)))

(defun putnam-1972-b6-rp-square (p)
  (putnam-1972-b6-rp-multiply p p))

(defun putnam-1972-b6-rp-eval-aux (p x accumulator)
  (if (consp p)
      (putnam-1972-b6-rp-eval-aux
       (cdr p) x (+ (* accumulator x) (car p)))
    accumulator))

(defun putnam-1972-b6-rp-eval (p x)
  (putnam-1972-b6-rp-eval-aux p x 0))

(defun putnam-1972-b6-rp-derivative-aux (p degree)
  (if (consp p)
      (if (zp degree)
          nil
        (cons (* degree (car p))
              (putnam-1972-b6-rp-derivative-aux
               (cdr p) (- degree 1))))
    nil))

(defun putnam-1972-b6-rp-derivative (p)
  (let ((normalized (putnam-1972-b6-rp-normalize p)))
    (putnam-1972-b6-rp-normalize
     (putnam-1972-b6-rp-derivative-aux
      normalized
      (nfix (- (len normalized) 1))))))

(defun putnam-1972-b6-rp-remainder-fuel (p q fuel)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix fuel)))
  (let ((p (putnam-1972-b6-rp-normalize p))
        (q (putnam-1972-b6-rp-normalize q)))
    (if (or (zp fuel)
            (endp q)
            (< (len p) (len q)))
        p
      (putnam-1972-b6-rp-remainder-fuel
       (putnam-1972-b6-rp-subtract
        p
        (putnam-1972-b6-rp-scale-shift
         (/ (car p) (car q))
         q
         (- (len p) (len q))))
       q
       (- fuel 1)))))

(defun putnam-1972-b6-rp-remainder (p q)
  (putnam-1972-b6-rp-remainder-fuel
   p q (+ 1 (len (putnam-1972-b6-rp-normalize p)))))

(defun putnam-1972-b6-rp-sturm-tail (previous current fuel)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix fuel)))
  (let ((current (putnam-1972-b6-rp-normalize current)))
    (if (or (zp fuel) (endp current))
        nil
      (cons
       current
       (putnam-1972-b6-rp-sturm-tail
        current
        (putnam-1972-b6-rp-negate
         (putnam-1972-b6-rp-remainder previous current))
        (- fuel 1))))))

(defun putnam-1972-b6-rp-sturm-sequence (p q)
  (let ((p (putnam-1972-b6-rp-normalize p))
        (q (putnam-1972-b6-rp-normalize q)))
    (if (endp p)
        nil
      (cons
       p
       (if (endp q)
           nil
         (cons
          q
          (putnam-1972-b6-rp-sturm-tail
           p q (+ 1 (len p) (len q)))))))))

(defun putnam-1972-b6-rational-sign (x)
  (cond ((< x 0) -1)
        ((< 0 x) 1)
        (t 0)))

(defun putnam-1972-b6-rp-variations-aux
    (polynomials x previous-sign)
  (if (consp polynomials)
      (let ((sign
             (putnam-1972-b6-rational-sign
              (putnam-1972-b6-rp-eval
               (car polynomials) x))))
        (if (equal sign 0)
            (putnam-1972-b6-rp-variations-aux
             (cdr polynomials) x previous-sign)
          (+ (if (and (not (equal previous-sign 0))
                      (not (equal sign previous-sign)))
                 1
               0)
             (putnam-1972-b6-rp-variations-aux
              (cdr polynomials) x sign))))
    0))

(defun putnam-1972-b6-rp-variations (polynomials x)
  (putnam-1972-b6-rp-variations-aux polynomials x 0))

(defun putnam-1972-b6-rp-cauchy-index (p q lower upper)
  (let ((sequence
         (putnam-1972-b6-rp-sturm-sequence p q)))
    (- (putnam-1972-b6-rp-variations sequence lower)
       (putnam-1972-b6-rp-variations sequence upper))))

(defun putnam-1972-b6-rp-root-count (p lower upper)
  (putnam-1972-b6-rp-cauchy-index
   p (putnam-1972-b6-rp-derivative p) lower upper))

(defun putnam-1972-b6-primitive-p (primitive lower upper)
  (and
   (putnam-1972-b6-rp-p primitive)
   (consp (putnam-1972-b6-rp-normalize primitive))
   (rationalp lower)
   (rationalp upper)
   (< lower upper)
   (not (equal
         (putnam-1972-b6-rp-eval primitive lower) 0))
   (not (equal
         (putnam-1972-b6-rp-eval primitive upper) 0))
   (equal
    (putnam-1972-b6-rp-root-count primitive lower upper)
    1)
   (not
    (equal
     (putnam-1972-b6-rp-cauchy-index
      primitive
      (putnam-1972-b6-rp-multiply
       (putnam-1972-b6-rp-derivative primitive)
       (putnam-1972-b6-rp-derivative primitive))
      lower
      upper)
     0))))

;; For the single isolated simple root alpha, this Sturm-Tarski query is the
;; sign of VALUE(alpha).
(defun putnam-1972-b6-algebraic-sign
    (primitive lower upper value)
  (putnam-1972-b6-rp-cauchy-index
   primitive
   (putnam-1972-b6-rp-multiply
    (putnam-1972-b6-rp-derivative primitive)
    value)
   lower
   upper))

(defun putnam-1972-b6-zero-at-alpha-p
    (primitive lower upper value)
  (equal
   (putnam-1972-b6-algebraic-sign
    primitive lower upper value)
   0))

;; A pair stores the real and imaginary parts as polynomials in alpha.
(defun putnam-1972-b6-complex (real-part imaginary-part)
  (cons real-part imaginary-part))

(defun putnam-1972-b6-complex-real (z)
  (car z))

(defun putnam-1972-b6-complex-imaginary (z)
  (cdr z))

(defun putnam-1972-b6-complex-rational (q)
  (putnam-1972-b6-complex (list q) nil))

(defun putnam-1972-b6-complex-add (left right)
  (putnam-1972-b6-complex
   (putnam-1972-b6-rp-add
    (putnam-1972-b6-complex-real left)
    (putnam-1972-b6-complex-real right))
   (putnam-1972-b6-rp-add
    (putnam-1972-b6-complex-imaginary left)
    (putnam-1972-b6-complex-imaginary right))))

(defun putnam-1972-b6-complex-multiply (left right)
  (putnam-1972-b6-complex
   (putnam-1972-b6-rp-subtract
    (putnam-1972-b6-rp-multiply
     (putnam-1972-b6-complex-real left)
     (putnam-1972-b6-complex-real right))
    (putnam-1972-b6-rp-multiply
     (putnam-1972-b6-complex-imaginary left)
     (putnam-1972-b6-complex-imaginary right)))
   (putnam-1972-b6-rp-add
    (putnam-1972-b6-rp-multiply
     (putnam-1972-b6-complex-real left)
     (putnam-1972-b6-complex-imaginary right))
    (putnam-1972-b6-rp-multiply
     (putnam-1972-b6-complex-imaginary left)
     (putnam-1972-b6-complex-real right)))))

(defun putnam-1972-b6-complex-power (z exponent)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix exponent)))
  (if (zp exponent)
      (putnam-1972-b6-complex-rational 1)
    (putnam-1972-b6-complex-multiply
     z
     (putnam-1972-b6-complex-power z (- exponent 1)))))

(defun putnam-1972-b6-polynomial-value (z exponents)
  (if (consp exponents)
      (putnam-1972-b6-complex-add
       (putnam-1972-b6-complex-power z (car exponents))
       (putnam-1972-b6-polynomial-value z (cdr exponents)))
    (putnam-1972-b6-complex-rational 1)))

(defun putnam-1972-b6-increasing-positive-exponents-p (exponents)
  (if (consp exponents)
      (and
       (posp (car exponents))
       (or
        (endp (cdr exponents))
        (and
         (< (car exponents) (cadr exponents))
         (putnam-1972-b6-increasing-positive-exponents-p
          (cdr exponents)))))
    (equal exponents nil)))

(defun putnam-1972-b6-complex-zero-at-alpha-p
    (primitive lower upper z)
  (and
   (putnam-1972-b6-zero-at-alpha-p
    primitive lower upper
    (putnam-1972-b6-complex-real z))
   (putnam-1972-b6-zero-at-alpha-p
    primitive lower upper
    (putnam-1972-b6-complex-imaginary z))))

(defun putnam-1972-b6-modulus-squared (z)
  (putnam-1972-b6-rp-add
   (putnam-1972-b6-rp-square
    (putnam-1972-b6-complex-real z))
   (putnam-1972-b6-rp-square
    (putnam-1972-b6-complex-imaginary z))))

;; With q = |z|^2 >= 0,
;;
;;   |z| < (sqrt(5)-1)/2
;;
;; is equivalent to 3-2q > 0 and (3-2q)^2 > 5. This removes both square
;; roots without changing the strict disk.
(defun putnam-1972-b6-inside-disk-p
    (primitive lower upper z)
  (let* ((q (putnam-1972-b6-modulus-squared z))
         (three-minus-two-q
          (putnam-1972-b6-rp-subtract
           (list 3)
           (putnam-1972-b6-rp-scale 2 q)))
         (square-minus-five
          (putnam-1972-b6-rp-subtract
           (putnam-1972-b6-rp-square three-minus-two-q)
           (list 5))))
    (and
     (equal
      (putnam-1972-b6-algebraic-sign
       primitive lower upper three-minus-two-q)
      1)
     (equal
      (putnam-1972-b6-algebraic-sign
       primitive lower upper square-minus-five)
      1))))

(defun putnambench-putnam-1972-b6-statement
    (primitive lower upper exponents z-real z-imaginary)
  (let ((z (putnam-1972-b6-complex z-real z-imaginary)))
    (implies
     (and
      (putnam-1972-b6-primitive-p primitive lower upper)
      (true-listp exponents)
      (consp exponents)
      (putnam-1972-b6-increasing-positive-exponents-p exponents)
      (putnam-1972-b6-rp-p z-real)
      (putnam-1972-b6-rp-p z-imaginary)
      (putnam-1972-b6-inside-disk-p
       primitive lower upper z))
     (not
      (putnam-1972-b6-complex-zero-at-alpha-p
       primitive lower upper
       (putnam-1972-b6-polynomial-value z exponents))))))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

title: putnam_1972_b6
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1972_b6:
-- a polynomial with positive strictly increasing integer exponents has no
-- complex zero of modulus less than (sqrt(5) - 1) / 2. This file contains no
-- proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; _*_)

infix 4 _!=_ _<=N_ _<N_
infixr 3 _and_
infixr 2 _or_

data Bottom : Set where

Not : Set -> Set
Not A =
  A -> Bottom

_!=_ : {A : Set} -> A -> A -> Set
x != y =
  Not (x == y)

record _and_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data _or_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  left  : A -> A or B
  right : B -> A or B

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

data _<=N_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set where
  zero<=N   : {n : Nat} -> zero <=N n
  suc<=sucN : {m n : Nat} -> m <=N n -> suc m <=N suc n

_<N_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set
m <N n =
  suc m <=N n

data Fin : Nat -> Set where
  fzero : {n : Nat} -> Fin (suc n)
  fsuc  : {n : Nat} -> Fin n -> Fin (suc n)

finToNat : {n : Nat} -> Fin n -> Nat
finToNat fzero =
  zero
finToNat (fsuc i) =
  suc (finToNat i)

oneN : Nat
oneN =
  suc zero

twoN : Nat
twoN =
  suc oneN

fiveN : Nat
fiveN =
  suc (suc (suc twoN))

record CompleteOrderedRealField (R : Set) : Set1 where
  field
    zeroR oneR : R
    add multiply : R -> R -> R
    negate inverse squareRoot : R -> R
    lessOrEqual : R -> R -> Set
    fromNat : Nat -> R

    one-not-zero :
      oneR != zeroR

    add-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> add x y == add y x
    add-associative :
      (x y z : R) -> add (add x y) z == add x (add y z)
    add-zero :
      (x : R) -> add x zeroR == x
    add-inverse :
      (x : R) -> add x (negate x) == zeroR

    multiply-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> multiply x y == multiply y x
    multiply-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply (multiply x y) z == multiply x (multiply y z)
    multiply-one :
      (x : R) -> multiply x oneR == x
    multiply-zero :
      (x : R) -> multiply x zeroR == zeroR
    distribute :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply x (add y z) ==
      add (multiply x y) (multiply x z)
    inverse-zero :
      inverse zeroR == zeroR
    multiply-inverse :
      (x : R) ->
      x != zeroR ->
      multiply x (inverse x) == oneR

    order-reflexive :
      (x : R) -> lessOrEqual x x
    order-transitive :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y z ->
      lessOrEqual x z
    order-antisymmetric :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y x ->
      x == y
    order-total :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y or lessOrEqual y x
    add-order :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual (add z x) (add z y)
    multiply-nonnegative :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR x ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR y ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR (multiply x y)
    zero-less-than-one :
      lessOrEqual zeroR oneR and zeroR != oneR

    fromNat-zero :
      fromNat zero == zeroR
    fromNat-successor :
      (n : Nat) -> fromNat (suc n) == add (fromNat n) oneR
    fromNat-addition :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m + n) == add (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-multiplication :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m * n) == multiply (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-injective :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat m == fromNat n ->
      m == n

    archimedean :
      (x : R) ->
      Exists Nat (\ n -> lessOrEqual x (fromNat n))
    least-upper-bound :
      (P : R -> Set) ->
      Exists R P ->
      Exists R
        (\ upper ->
          (x : R) ->
          P x ->
          lessOrEqual x upper) ->
      Exists R
        (\ supremum ->
          ((x : R) ->
            P x ->
            lessOrEqual x supremum)
          and
          ((upper : R) ->
            ((x : R) ->
              P x ->
              lessOrEqual x upper) ->
            lessOrEqual supremum upper))

    square-root-nonnegative :
      (x : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR (squareRoot x)
    square-root-square :
      (x : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR x ->
      multiply (squareRoot x) (squareRoot x) == x
    square-root-nonpositive :
      (x : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x zeroR ->
      squareRoot x == zeroR
    square-root-unique :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR y ->
      multiply y y == x ->
      y == squareRoot x

open CompleteOrderedRealField

subtract :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
subtract reals x y =
  add reals x (negate reals y)

divide :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
divide reals x y =
  multiply reals x (inverse reals y)

StrictLess :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
StrictLess reals x y =
  lessOrEqual reals x y and x != y

record Complex (R : Set) : Set where
  constructor complex
  field
    realPart      : R
    imaginaryPart : R

open Complex

complexZero :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Complex R
complexZero reals =
  complex (zeroR reals) (zeroR reals)

complexOne :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Complex R
complexOne reals =
  complex (oneR reals) (zeroR reals)

complexAdd :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Complex R ->
  Complex R ->
  Complex R
complexAdd reals z w =
  complex
    (add reals (realPart z) (realPart w))
    (add reals (imaginaryPart z) (imaginaryPart w))

complexMultiply :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Complex R ->
  Complex R ->
  Complex R
complexMultiply reals z w =
  complex
    (add reals
      (multiply reals (realPart z) (realPart w))
      (negate reals
        (multiply reals (imaginaryPart z) (imaginaryPart w))))
    (add reals
      (multiply reals (realPart z) (imaginaryPart w))
      (multiply reals (imaginaryPart z) (realPart w)))

complexPower :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Complex R ->
  Nat ->
  Complex R
complexPower reals z zero =
  complexOne reals
complexPower reals z (suc n) =
  complexMultiply reals (complexPower reals z n) z

sumFinComplex :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  {n : Nat} ->
  (Fin n -> Complex R) ->
  Complex R
sumFinComplex reals {zero} terms =
  complexZero reals
sumFinComplex reals {suc n} terms =
  complexAdd reals
    (terms fzero)
    (sumFinComplex reals (\ i -> terms (fsuc i)))

complexSquaredModulus :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Complex R ->
  R
complexSquaredModulus reals z =
  add reals
    (multiply reals (realPart z) (realPart z))
    (multiply reals (imaginaryPart z) (imaginaryPart z))

complexModulus :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Complex R ->
  R
complexModulus reals z =
  squareRoot reals (complexSquaredModulus reals z)

polynomialValue :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  {k : Nat} ->
  (Fin k -> Nat) ->
  Complex R ->
  Complex R
polynomialValue reals exponents z =
  complexAdd reals
    (complexOne reals)
    (sumFinComplex reals
      (\ i -> complexPower reals z (exponents i)))

module Putnam1972B6Statement
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) where

  radius : R
  radius =
    divide reals
      (subtract reals
        (squareRoot reals (fromNat reals fiveN))
        (oneR reals))
      (fromNat reals twoN)

  proposition : Set
  proposition =
    (k : Nat) ->
    oneN <=N k ->
    (exponents : Fin k -> Nat) ->
    ((i : Fin k) ->
      zero <N exponents i) ->
    ((i j : Fin k) ->
      finToNat i <N finToNat j ->
      exponents i <N exponents j) ->
    (z : Complex R) ->
    StrictLess reals (complexModulus reals z) radius ->
    polynomialValue reals exponents z != complexZero reals

putnam-1972-b6 : Set1
putnam-1972-b6 =
  (R : Set) ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) ->
  Putnam1972B6Statement.proposition reals

title: putnam_1972_b6
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench artifact putnam_1972_b6:
  a polynomial with constant term one and strictly increasing positive
  integer exponents has no complex zero of modulus less than
  (sqrt 5 - 1) / 2. This file contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open arithmeticTheory pred_setTheory realTheory transcTheory complexTheory;

val putnam_1972_b6 =
  ``!k : num. !n : num -> num. !zpoly : complex -> complex.
      1 <= k /\
      (!i : num. i < k ==> 0 < n i) /\
      (!i j : num.
         i < k /\ j < k /\ i < j ==> n i < n j) /\
      zpoly =
        (\z : complex.
           1 +
           ITSET
             (\i acc. z pow (n i) + acc)
             (count k)
             0)
      ==>
      !z : complex.
        modu z < (sqrt 5 - 1) / 2
        ==>
        zpoly z <> 0``;

title: putnam_1972_b6
content:
$(
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact
  putnam_1972_b6: a polynomial with constant term one and strictly increasing
  positive-integer exponents has no complex zero of modulus less than
  (sqrt(5) - 1) / 2. This file contains no proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  The positive natural k is the number of exponents, and 0 ..^ k is the
  k-element zero-based carrier corresponding to Fin k. The function n maps
  that carrier to the positive integers and is strictly increasing. Restriction
  to this carrier, and extension outside it, give the same data as the
  natural-indexed Isabelle and Rocq formulations.

  The source-defined function zpoly is inlined as the finite complex sum
  1 + sum_i z^(n_i). Since every n_i is positive, the natural exponent here
  agrees with the positive integer exponent in the Lean formulation. The final
  declaration is the single unproved $a corpus statement; this database
  contains no $p proof statement.
$)

${
  $d i j k n z $.

  putnambench-putnam-1972-b6 $a |-
    A. k e. NN
      A. n e. ( NN ^m ( 0 ..^ k ) )
        (
          A. i e. ( 0 ..^ k )
            A. j e. ( 0 ..^ k )
              ( i < j -> ( n ` i ) < ( n ` j ) )
          ->
          A. z e. CC
            (
              ( abs ` z ) < ( ( ( sqrt ` 5 ) - 1 ) / 2 )
              ->
              (
                1
                +
                sum_ i e. ( 0 ..^ k )
                  ( z ^ ( n ` i ) )
              )
              =/=
              0
            )
        )
  $.
$}

content:
:: Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench artifact putnam_1972_b6:
:: a complex polynomial with constant term one and strictly increasing
:: positive integer exponents has no zero of modulus less than
:: (sqrt 5 - 1)/2. This file contains no proof.

environ

    SETWOP_2, FINSOP_1, RVSUM_1, FUNCT_7, ORDINAL1, COMPLEX1, NEWTON;
  notations TARSKI, SUBSET_1, ZFMISC_1, ORDINAL1, CARD_1, NUMBERS,
    VALUED_0, XBOOLE_0, XCMPLX_0, XXREAL_0, XREAL_0, COMPLEX1, REAL_1,
    SQUARE_1, RELAT_1, FUNCT_1, PARTFUN1, BINOP_2, SETWISEO, FUNCT_2,
    BINOP_1, FUNCOP_1, FINSEQ_1, FINSEQ_2, FINSEQ_4, VALUED_1, NAT_1,
    FINSOP_1, FINSEQOP, SETWOP_2, RVSUM_1, NEWTON;
  constructors PARTFUN1, BINOP_1, SETWISEO, SQUARE_1, NAT_1, BINOP_2,
    VALUED_1, FINSEQOP, FINSEQ_4, FINSOP_1, SETWOP_2, RELSET_1,
    XXREAL_1, REAL_1, FINSEQ_2, RVSUM_1, COMPLEX1, NEWTON;
  registrations XBOOLE_0, FUNCT_1, ORDINAL1, FUNCT_2, FUNCOP_1, NUMBERS,
    XCMPLX_0, XREAL_0, XXREAL_0, SQUARE_1, NAT_1, BINOP_2, FINSEQ_1,
    FINSEQ_2, VALUED_0, VALUED_1, RELAT_1, FINSEQ_4, CARD_1, RVSUM_1,
    RELSET_1, MEMBERED, NEWTON;
  requirements REAL, NUMERALS, SUBSET, BOOLE, ARITHM;

begin

::$P-
theorem
  for k being Nat,
      n being FinSequence of NAT,
      zpoly being Function of COMPLEX,COMPLEX st
    1 <= k &
    len n = k &
    (for i being Nat st i in Seg k holds 0 < n.i) &
    (for i,j being Nat st
      i in Seg k & j in Seg k & i < j
    holds n.i < n.j) &
    (for z being Complex holds
      ex terms being FinSequence of COMPLEX st
        len terms = k &
        (for i being Nat st i in Seg k holds
          terms.i = z |^ n.i) &
        zpoly.z = (1 qua Complex) + Sum terms)
  holds
    for z being Complex st
      |.z.| < (sqrt 5 - 1) / 2
    holds zpoly.z <> 0
proof
end;
::$P+

title: putnam_1972_b6
content:
% Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench artifact putnam_1972_b6:
% a polynomial with constant term one and strictly increasing positive integer
% exponents has no complex root in the specified open disk. This file contains
% no proof.

putnam_1972_b6: THEORY
BEGIN
  complex: TYPE = [# real_part: real, imag_part: real #]
  exponent_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> nat]

  complex_zero: complex =
    (# real_part := 0, imag_part := 0 #)

  complex_one: complex =
    (# real_part := 1, imag_part := 0 #)

  complex_add(x, y: complex): complex =
    (# real_part := real_part(x) + real_part(y),
       imag_part := imag_part(x) + imag_part(y) #)

  complex_mul(x, y: complex): complex =
    (# real_part := real_part(x) * real_part(y)
                       - imag_part(x) * imag_part(y),
       imag_part := real_part(x) * imag_part(y)
                       + imag_part(x) * real_part(y) #)

  complex_power(z: complex, exponent: nat): RECURSIVE complex =
    IF exponent = 0 THEN
      complex_one
    ELSE
      complex_mul(complex_power(z, exponent - 1), z)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE exponent

  polynomial_value(
      exponents: exponent_sequence,
      z: complex,
      count: nat): RECURSIVE complex =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      complex_one
    ELSE
      complex_add(
        polynomial_value(exponents, z, count - 1),
        complex_power(z, exponents(count - 1)))
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  nonnegative_square_root(value: real): real =
    IF 0 <= value THEN
      epsilon(
        LAMBDA (root: real):
          0 <= root AND root * root = value)
    ELSE
      0
    ENDIF

  squared_modulus(z: complex): real =
    real_part(z) ^ 2 + imag_part(z) ^ 2

  complex_modulus(z: complex): real =
    nonnegative_square_root(squared_modulus(z))

  disk_radius: real =
    (nonnegative_square_root(5) - 1) / 2

  positive_exponents_below(
      exponents: exponent_sequence,
      count: nat): bool =
    FORALL (index: nat):
      index < count IMPLIES exponents(index) > 0

  strictly_increasing_below(
      exponents: exponent_sequence,
      count: nat): bool =
    FORALL (left_index, right_index: nat):
      (left_index < count
        AND right_index < count
        AND left_index < right_index)
      IMPLIES
        exponents(left_index) < exponents(right_index)

  putnam_1972_b6: bool =
    FORALL (k: nat), (exponents: exponent_sequence):
      (k >= 1
        AND positive_exponents_below(exponents, k)
        AND strictly_increasing_below(exponents, k))
      IMPLIES
        FORALL (z: complex):
          complex_modulus(z) < disk_radius
            IMPLIES
              polynomial_value(exponents, z, k) /= complex_zero
END putnam_1972_b6

import Mathlib

open Nat Set MeasureTheory Topology Filter

/--
Let $\triangle ABC$ be any triangle in the Euclidean plane, and let points $X$, $Y$, and $Z$ lie on sides $\overline{BC}$, $\overline{CA}$, and $\overline{AB}$ respectively. If $BX \le XC$, $CY \le YA$, and $AZ \le ZB$, prove that $[\triangle XYZ] \ge \frac{1}{4} [\triangle ABC]$.  Regardless of this constraint on $X$, $Y$, and $Z$, prove that one of $[\triangle AZY]$, $[\triangle BXZ]$, or $[\triangle CYX]$ is less than or equal to $[\triangle XYZ]$. (Here, $[\triangle]$ denotes the area of triangle $\triangle$.)
-/
theorem putnam_1973_a1
(A B C X Y Z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
(hnoncol : ¬Collinear ℝ {A, B, C})
(hX : X ∈ segment ℝ B C)
(hY : Y ∈ segment ℝ C A)
(hZ : Z ∈ segment ℝ A B)
: ((dist B X ≤ dist X C ∧ dist C Y ≤ dist Y A ∧ dist A Z ≤ dist Z B) →
volume (convexHull ℝ {X, Y, Z}) ≥ (1/4) * volume (convexHull ℝ {A, B, C})) ∧
sInf {volume (convexHull ℝ {A, Z, Y}), volume (convexHull ℝ {B, X, Z}), volume (convexHull ℝ {C, Y, X})} ≤ volume (convexHull ℝ {X, Y, Z}) :=
sorry

title: putnam_1973_a1
content:
(* Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench artifact putnam_1973_a1:
   the one-quarter area bound and the complementary-subtriangle area bound
   for points on the sides of a nondegenerate planar triangle. This file
   contains no proof. *)

From Stdlib Require Import Reals.

Open Scope R_scope.

Definition point := (R * R)%type.

Definition affine_combination (t : R) (a b : point) : point :=
  ((1 - t) * fst a + t * fst b,
   (1 - t) * snd a + t * snd b).

Definition closed_segment (a b : point) : point -> Prop :=
  fun p : point =>
    exists t : R,
      0 <= t <= 1 /\
      p = affine_combination t a b.

Definition point_distance (a b : point) : R :=
  sqrt ((fst a - fst b) ^ 2 + (snd a - snd b) ^ 2).

Definition signed_twice_area (a b c : point) : R :=
  (fst b - fst a) * (snd c - snd a) -
  (snd b - snd a) * (fst c - fst a).

Definition noncollinear (a b c : point) : Prop :=
  signed_twice_area a b c <> 0.

Definition triangle_area (a b c : point) : R :=
  Rabs (signed_twice_area a b c) / 2.

Theorem putnam_1973_a1
    (A B C X Y Z : point)
    (hABC : noncollinear A B C)
    (hX : closed_segment B C X)
    (hY : closed_segment C A Y)
    (hZ : closed_segment A B Z) :
  ((point_distance B X <= point_distance X C /\
    point_distance C Y <= point_distance Y A /\
    point_distance A Z <= point_distance Z B) ->
   triangle_area X Y Z >=
     (1 / 4) * triangle_area A B C) /\
  Rmin
    (triangle_area A Z Y)
    (Rmin (triangle_area B X Z) (triangle_area C Y X))
    <= triangle_area X Y Z.
Admitted.

(*
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench artifact putnam_1973_a1:
  area bounds for a triangle formed by points on the three sides of a
  nondegenerate triangle in the real Euclidean plane. This file contains no
  proof.
*)

let statement =
  `let edist =
     \(p:real#real) (q:real#real).
       sqrt ((FST p - FST q) pow 2 + (SND p - SND q) pow 2) in
   let segment =
     \(p:real#real) (q:real#real) (x:real#real).
       ?t:real.
         &0 <= t /\ t <= &1 /\
         FST x = (&1 - t) * FST p + t * FST q /\
         SND x = (&1 - t) * SND p + t * SND q in
   let det2 =
     \(p:real#real) (q:real#real) (r:real#real).
       (FST q - FST p) * (SND r - SND p) -
       (SND q - SND p) * (FST r - FST p) in
   let triangle_area =
     \(p:real#real) (q:real#real) (r:real#real).
       abs (det2 p q r) / &2 in
   !A B C X Y Z:real#real.
     ~(det2 A B C = &0) /\
     segment B C X /\
     segment C A Y /\
     segment A B Z
     ==>
     (((edist B X <= edist X C /\
        edist C Y <= edist Y A /\
        edist A Z <= edist Z B)
       ==> triangle_area X Y Z >=
           (&1 / &4) * triangle_area A B C) /\
      (triangle_area A Z Y <= triangle_area X Y Z \/
       triangle_area B X Z <= triangle_area X Y Z \/
       triangle_area C Y X <= triangle_area X Y Z))`;;

title: putnam_1973_a1
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1973_a1:
;; area inequalities for a triangle and three points on its closed sides.
;; This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

;; Closed-segment membership is expressed by collinearity together with
;; (P-L) dot (P-R) <= 0. Squared distances preserve the source distance
;; comparisons, and absolute orientation determinants are twice the triangle
;; areas, so their common factor cancels from every area comparison. The
;; infimum of the three corner-triangle areas is at most the central area
;; exactly when at least one of those three areas is at most the central area.
;;
;; ACL2 evaluates the coordinates below as exact rationals. This universal
;; rational-coordinate statement is bidirectionally equivalent to the source
;; statement over arbitrary real coordinates. Every rational configuration is
;; real. Conversely, in any real counterexample the noncollinear vertices make
;; the three side parameters unique. Approximate the vertices and parameters
;; by rationals, keeping each parameter in [0,1] and, when required, in
;; [0,1/2], and reconstruct the side points. Noncollinearity persists. Failure
;; of either conclusion is given by strict area inequalities, so it also
;; persists under a sufficiently close approximation. Thus every real
;; counterexample would yield a rational counterexample.

(defun putnam-1973-a1-orientation (a b c)
  (- (* (- (car b) (car a))
        (- (cadr c) (cadr a)))
     (* (- (cadr b) (cadr a))
        (- (car c) (car a)))))

(defun putnam-1973-a1-vector-dot-from (point left right)
  (+ (* (- (car point) (car left))
        (- (car point) (car right)))
     (* (- (cadr point) (cadr left))
        (- (cadr point) (cadr right)))))

(defun putnam-1973-a1-on-closed-segment-p (point left right)
  (and
   (equal (putnam-1973-a1-orientation left right point) 0)
   (<= (putnam-1973-a1-vector-dot-from point left right) 0)))

(defun putnam-1973-a1-distance-squared (left right)
  (+ (* (- (car left) (car right))
        (- (car left) (car right)))
     (* (- (cadr left) (cadr right))
        (- (cadr left) (cadr right)))))

(defun putnam-1973-a1-absolute (value)
  (if (< value 0) (- value) value))

(defun putnam-1973-a1-twice-area (a b c)
  (putnam-1973-a1-absolute
   (putnam-1973-a1-orientation a b c)))

(defun putnambench-putnam-1973-a1-statement
    (a-x a-y b-x b-y c-x c-y x-x x-y y-x y-y z-x z-y)
  (let ((a (list a-x a-y))
        (b (list b-x b-y))
        (c (list c-x c-y))
        (x (list x-x x-y))
        (y (list y-x y-y))
        (z (list z-x z-y)))
    (implies
     (and
      (rationalp a-x) (rationalp a-y)
      (rationalp b-x) (rationalp b-y)
      (rationalp c-x) (rationalp c-y)
      (rationalp x-x) (rationalp x-y)
      (rationalp y-x) (rationalp y-y)
      (rationalp z-x) (rationalp z-y)
      (not (equal (putnam-1973-a1-orientation a b c) 0))
      (putnam-1973-a1-on-closed-segment-p x b c)
      (putnam-1973-a1-on-closed-segment-p y c a)
      (putnam-1973-a1-on-closed-segment-p z a b))
     (let ((abc-area (putnam-1973-a1-twice-area a b c))
           (xyz-area (putnam-1973-a1-twice-area x y z))
           (azy-area (putnam-1973-a1-twice-area a z y))
           (bxz-area (putnam-1973-a1-twice-area b x z))
           (cyx-area (putnam-1973-a1-twice-area c y x)))
       (and
        (implies
         (and
          (<= (putnam-1973-a1-distance-squared b x)
              (putnam-1973-a1-distance-squared x c))
          (<= (putnam-1973-a1-distance-squared c y)
              (putnam-1973-a1-distance-squared y a))
          (<= (putnam-1973-a1-distance-squared a z)
              (putnam-1973-a1-distance-squared z b)))
         (<= (* (/ 1 4) abc-area) xyz-area))
        (or
         (<= azy-area xyz-area)
         (<= bxz-area xyz-area)
         (<= cyx-area xyz-area)))))))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

title: putnam_1973_a1
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1973_a1:
-- area inequalities for a triangle and points on its three closed sides,
-- including the quarter-area bound and a comparison with a corner triangle.
-- This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; _*_)

infix 4 _!=_
infixr 3 _and_
infixr 2 _or_

data Bottom : Set where

Not : Set -> Set
Not A =
  A -> Bottom

_!=_ : {A : Set} -> A -> A -> Set
x != y =
  Not (x == y)

record _and_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data _or_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  left  : A -> A or B
  right : B -> A or B

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

record CompleteOrderedRealField (R : Set) : Set1 where
  field
    zeroR oneR : R
    add multiply : R -> R -> R
    negate inverse squareRoot : R -> R
    lessOrEqual : R -> R -> Set
    fromNat : Nat -> R

    one-not-zero :
      oneR != zeroR

    add-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> add x y == add y x
    add-associative :
      (x y z : R) -> add (add x y) z == add x (add y z)
    add-zero :
      (x : R) -> add x zeroR == x
    add-inverse :
      (x : R) -> add x (negate x) == zeroR

    multiply-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> multiply x y == multiply y x
    multiply-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply (multiply x y) z == multiply x (multiply y z)
    multiply-one :
      (x : R) -> multiply x oneR == x
    multiply-zero :
      (x : R) -> multiply x zeroR == zeroR
    distribute :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply x (add y z) ==
      add (multiply x y) (multiply x z)
    inverse-zero :
      inverse zeroR == zeroR
    multiply-inverse :
      (x : R) ->
      x != zeroR ->
      multiply x (inverse x) == oneR

    order-reflexive :
      (x : R) -> lessOrEqual x x
    order-transitive :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y z ->
      lessOrEqual x z
    order-antisymmetric :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y x ->
      x == y
    order-total :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y or lessOrEqual y x
    add-order :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual (add z x) (add z y)
    multiply-nonnegative :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR x ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR y ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR (multiply x y)
    zero-less-than-one :
      lessOrEqual zeroR oneR and zeroR != oneR

    fromNat-zero :
      fromNat zero == zeroR
    fromNat-successor :
      (n : Nat) -> fromNat (suc n) == add (fromNat n) oneR
    fromNat-addition :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m + n) == add (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-multiplication :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m * n) == multiply (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-injective :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat m == fromNat n ->
      m == n

    archimedean :
      (x : R) ->
      Exists Nat (\ n -> lessOrEqual x (fromNat n))
    least-upper-bound :
      (P : R -> Set) ->
      Exists R P ->
      Exists R
        (\ upper ->
          (x : R) ->
          P x ->
          lessOrEqual x upper) ->
      Exists R
        (\ supremum ->
          ((x : R) ->
            P x ->
            lessOrEqual x supremum)
          and
          ((upper : R) ->
            ((x : R) ->
              P x ->
              lessOrEqual x upper) ->
            lessOrEqual supremum upper))

    square-root-nonnegative :
      (x : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR (squareRoot x)
    square-root-square :
      (x : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR x ->
      multiply (squareRoot x) (squareRoot x) == x
    square-root-nonpositive :
      (x : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x zeroR ->
      squareRoot x == zeroR
    square-root-unique :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR y ->
      multiply y y == x ->
      y == squareRoot x

open CompleteOrderedRealField

subtract :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
subtract reals x y =
  add reals x (negate reals y)

square :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R
square reals x =
  multiply reals x x

four :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R
four reals =
  fromNat reals (suc (suc (suc (suc zero))))

oneFourth :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R
oneFourth reals =
  multiply reals (oneR reals) (inverse reals (four reals))

half :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R
half reals =
  inverse reals (add reals (oneR reals) (oneR reals))

absolute :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R
absolute reals x =
  squareRoot reals (square reals x)

record Point (R : Set) : Set where
  constructor point
  field
    x-coordinate : R
    y-coordinate : R

open Point

PointEqual :
  {R : Set} ->
  Point R ->
  Point R ->
  Set
PointEqual p q =
  x-coordinate p == x-coordinate q
  and
  y-coordinate p == y-coordinate q

squaredDistance :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Point R ->
  Point R ->
  R
squaredDistance reals p q =
  add reals
    (square reals
      (subtract reals (x-coordinate p) (x-coordinate q)))
    (square reals
      (subtract reals (y-coordinate p) (y-coordinate q)))

distance :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Point R ->
  Point R ->
  R
distance reals p q =
  squareRoot reals (squaredDistance reals p q)

affinePoint :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  Point R ->
  Point R ->
  Point R
affinePoint reals t p q =
  point
    (add reals
      (multiply reals
        (subtract reals (oneR reals) t)
        (x-coordinate p))
      (multiply reals t (x-coordinate q)))
    (add reals
      (multiply reals
        (subtract reals (oneR reals) t)
        (y-coordinate p))
      (multiply reals t (y-coordinate q)))

ClosedSegment :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Point R ->
  Point R ->
  Point R ->
  Set
ClosedSegment {R} reals p q x =
  Exists R
    (\ t ->
      lessOrEqual reals (zeroR reals) t
      and
      lessOrEqual reals t (oneR reals)
      and
      PointEqual x (affinePoint reals t p q))

determinant :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Point R ->
  Point R ->
  Point R ->
  R
determinant reals a b c =
  subtract reals
    (multiply reals
      (subtract reals (x-coordinate b) (x-coordinate a))
      (subtract reals (y-coordinate c) (y-coordinate a)))
    (multiply reals
      (subtract reals (y-coordinate b) (y-coordinate a))
      (subtract reals (x-coordinate c) (x-coordinate a)))

Collinear :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Point R ->
  Point R ->
  Point R ->
  Set
Collinear reals a b c =
  determinant reals a b c == zeroR reals

triangleArea :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Point R ->
  Point R ->
  Point R ->
  R
triangleArea reals a b c =
  multiply reals
    (half reals)
    (absolute reals (determinant reals a b c))

module Putnam1973A1Statement
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) where

  proposition : Set
  proposition =
    (A B C X Y Z : Point R) ->
    Not (Collinear reals A B C) ->
    ClosedSegment reals B C X ->
    ClosedSegment reals C A Y ->
    ClosedSegment reals A B Z ->
    ((lessOrEqual reals
        (distance reals B X)
        (distance reals X C)
      and
      lessOrEqual reals
        (distance reals C Y)
        (distance reals Y A)
      and
      lessOrEqual reals
        (distance reals A Z)
        (distance reals Z B))
      ->
      lessOrEqual reals
        (multiply reals
          (oneFourth reals)
          (triangleArea reals A B C))
        (triangleArea reals X Y Z))
    and
    (lessOrEqual reals
      (triangleArea reals A Z Y)
      (triangleArea reals X Y Z)
    or
    lessOrEqual reals
      (triangleArea reals B X Z)
      (triangleArea reals X Y Z)
    or
    lessOrEqual reals
      (triangleArea reals C Y X)
      (triangleArea reals X Y Z))

putnam-1973-a1 : Set1
putnam-1973-a1 =
  (R : Set) ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) ->
  Putnam1973A1Statement.proposition reals

title: putnam_1973_a1
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench artifact putnam_1973_a1:
  area bounds for a triangle formed by points on the sides of a nondegenerate
  real-plane triangle. This file contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open pairTheory realTheory transcTheory;

val putnam_1973_a1 =
  ``let collinear =
      \P Q R : real # real.
        (FST P - FST R) * (SND Q - SND R) =
        (SND P - SND R) * (FST Q - FST R)
    in
    let in_closed_segment =
      \X U V : real # real.
        ?t : real.
          0 <= t /\ t <= 1 /\
          X = ((1 - t) * FST U + t * FST V,
               (1 - t) * SND U + t * SND V)
    in
    let dist =
      \P Q : real # real.
        sqrt ((FST P - FST Q) pow 2 + (SND P - SND Q) pow 2)
    in
    let triangle_area =
      \A B C : real # real.
        abs ((FST B - FST A) * (SND C - SND A) -
             (SND B - SND A) * (FST C - FST A)) / 2
    in
      !A B C X Y Z : real # real.
        ~collinear A B C /\
        in_closed_segment X B C /\
        in_closed_segment Y C A /\
        in_closed_segment Z A B
        ==>
        (((dist B X <= dist X C /\
           dist C Y <= dist Y A /\
           dist A Z <= dist Z B)
          ==>
          triangle_area X Y Z >=
            (1 / 4) * triangle_area A B C) /\
         (triangle_area A Z Y <= triangle_area X Y Z \/
          triangle_area B X Z <= triangle_area X Y Z \/
          triangle_area C Y X <= triangle_area X Y Z))``;

title: putnam_1973_a1
content:
$(
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact
  putnam_1973_a1: two area inequalities for side points of a noncollinear
  triangle in the real Euclidean plane. This file contains no proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  P73A1R2 is the real coordinate plane. P73A1Dist is Euclidean distance,
  P73A1Segment is the closed affine segment, and P73A1Noncol is determinant
  noncollinearity. P73A1Hull is the convex hull of three points via
  nonnegative barycentric coordinates, and P73A1Area is its planar Lebesgue
  measure through the set.mm finite-dimensional volume function voln.

  The final unproved $a assertion universally quantifies the six points. Its
  second area conclusion writes the infimum inequality for a nonempty
  three-element set equivalently as a disjunction that one of its members is
  at most the area of the central triangle. This database contains no $p
  proof statement.
$)

$c P73A1I P73A1R2 P73A1Dist P73A1Segment $.
$c P73A1Noncol P73A1Hull P73A1Area $.

p73a1-index-syntax $a class P73A1I $.
p73a1-plane-syntax $a class P73A1R2 $.
p73a1-distance-syntax $a class ( P73A1Dist A B ) $.
p73a1-segment-syntax $a class ( P73A1Segment A B ) $.
p73a1-noncollinear-syntax $a wff ( P73A1Noncol A B C ) $.
p73a1-hull-syntax $a class ( P73A1Hull A B C ) $.
p73a1-area-syntax $a class ( P73A1Area A B C ) $.

p73a1-index-definition $a |- P73A1I = ( 1 ... 2 ) $.

p73a1-plane-definition $a |- P73A1R2 = ( RR ^m P73A1I ) $.

${
  $d A B j $.

  p73a1-distance-definition $a |- (
    P73A1Dist A B
  ) = (
    sqrt
    `
    (
      sum_ j e. P73A1I
        ( ( ( A ` j ) - ( B ` j ) ) ^ 2 )
    )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d A B j t z $.

  p73a1-segment-definition $a |- (
    P73A1Segment A B
  ) = {
    z e. P73A1R2 |
    E. t e. ( 0 [,] 1 )
      z =
        (
          j e. P73A1I |->
            (
              ( ( 1 - t ) x. ( A ` j ) )
              +
              ( t x. ( B ` j ) )
            )
        )
  } $.
$}

p73a1-noncollinear-definition $a |- (
  ( P73A1Noncol A B C )
  <->
  (
    (
      ( ( B ` 1 ) - ( A ` 1 ) )
      x.
      ( ( C ` 2 ) - ( A ` 2 ) )
    )
    =/=
    (
      ( ( B ` 2 ) - ( A ` 2 ) )
      x.
      ( ( C ` 1 ) - ( A ` 1 ) )
    )
  )
) $.

${
  $d A B C j u v w x $.

  p73a1-hull-definition $a |- (
    P73A1Hull A B C
  ) = {
    x e. P73A1R2 |
    E. u e. RR E. v e. RR E. w e. RR
      (
        (
          0 <_ u
          /\
          (
            0 <_ v
            /\
            0 <_ w
          )
        )
        /\
        (
          ( ( u + v ) + w ) = 1
          /\
          x =
            (
              j e. P73A1I |->
                (
                  (
                    ( u x. ( A ` j ) )
                    +
                    ( v x. ( B ` j ) )
                  )
                  +
                  ( w x. ( C ` j ) )
                )
            )
        )
      )
  } $.
$}

p73a1-area-definition $a |- (
  P73A1Area A B C
) = (
  ( voln ` P73A1I )
  `
  ( P73A1Hull A B C )
) $.

${
  $d A B C X Y Z $.

  putnambench-putnam-1973-a1 $a |- (
    A. A e. P73A1R2
    A. B e. P73A1R2
    A. C e. P73A1R2
    A. X e. P73A1R2
    A. Y e. P73A1R2
    A. Z e. P73A1R2
      (
        (
          ( P73A1Noncol A B C )
          /\
          (
            X e. ( P73A1Segment B C )
            /\
            (
              Y e. ( P73A1Segment C A )
              /\
              Z e. ( P73A1Segment A B )
            )
          )
        )
        ->
        (
          (
            (
              ( P73A1Dist B X ) <_ ( P73A1Dist X C )
              /\
              (
                ( P73A1Dist C Y ) <_ ( P73A1Dist Y A )
                /\
                ( P73A1Dist A Z ) <_ ( P73A1Dist Z B )
              )
            )
            ->
            (
              ( ( 1 / 4 ) x. ( P73A1Area A B C ) )
              <_
              ( P73A1Area X Y Z )
            )
          )
          /\
          (
            ( P73A1Area A Z Y ) <_ ( P73A1Area X Y Z )
            \/
            (
              ( P73A1Area B X Z ) <_ ( P73A1Area X Y Z )
              \/
              ( P73A1Area C Y X ) <_ ( P73A1Area X Y Z )
            )
          )
        )
      )
  ) $.
$}

environ

% Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench artifact putnam_1973_a1:
% area bounds for a triangle formed by points on the three sides of a
% nondegenerate Euclidean-plane triangle. This file contains no proof.

putnam_1973_a1: THEORY
BEGIN
  point: TYPE = [# x_coord: real, y_coord: real #]

  cross_from(P, Q, R: point): real =
    (x_coord(Q) - x_coord(P)) * (y_coord(R) - y_coord(P))
      - (y_coord(Q) - y_coord(P)) * (x_coord(R) - x_coord(P))

  collinear(P, Q, R: point): bool =
    cross_from(P, Q, R) = 0

  affine_combination(t: real, P, Q: point): point =
    (# x_coord := (1 - t) * x_coord(P) + t * x_coord(Q),
       y_coord := (1 - t) * y_coord(P) + t * y_coord(Q) #)

  on_closed_segment(X, P, Q: point): bool =
    EXISTS (t: real):
      0 <= t
        AND t <= 1
        AND X = affine_combination(t, P, Q)

  squared_distance(P, Q: point): real =
    (x_coord(P) - x_coord(Q)) ^ 2
      + (y_coord(P) - y_coord(Q)) ^ 2

  triangle_area(P, Q, R: point): real =
    abs(cross_from(P, Q, R)) / 2

  putnam_1973_a1: bool =
    FORALL (A, B, C, X, Y, Z: point):
      (NOT collinear(A, B, C)
        AND on_closed_segment(X, B, C)
        AND on_closed_segment(Y, C, A)
        AND on_closed_segment(Z, A, B))
      IMPLIES
        (((squared_distance(B, X) <= squared_distance(X, C)
            AND squared_distance(C, Y) <= squared_distance(Y, A)
            AND squared_distance(A, Z) <= squared_distance(Z, B))
          IMPLIES
            triangle_area(X, Y, Z)
              >= (1 / 4) * triangle_area(A, B, C))
        AND
          (triangle_area(A, Z, Y) <= triangle_area(X, Y, Z)
            OR triangle_area(B, X, Z) <= triangle_area(X, Y, Z)
            OR triangle_area(C, Y, X) <= triangle_area(X, Y, Z)))
END putnam_1973_a1

title: putnam_1973_a2
content:
import Mathlib

open Nat Set MeasureTheory Topology Filter

abbrev putnam_1973_a2_solution : Prop := sorry
-- True
/--
Consider an infinite series whose $n$th term is given by $\pm \frac{1}{n}$, where the actual values of the $\pm$ signs repeat in blocks of $8$ (so the $\frac{1}{9}$ term has the same sign as the $\frac{1}{1}$ term, and so on). Call such a sequence balanced if each block contains four $+$ and four $-$ signs. Prove that being balanced is a sufficient condition for the sequence to converge. Is being balanced also necessary for the sequence to converge?
-/
theorem putnam_1973_a2
(L : List ℝ)
(hL : L.length = 8 ∧ ∀ i : Fin L.length, L[i] = 1 ∨ L[i] = -1)
(pluses : ℕ)
(hpluses : pluses = {i : Fin L.length | L[i] = 1}.ncard)
(S : ℕ → ℝ)
(hS : S = fun n : ℕ ↦ ∑ i ∈ Finset.Icc 1 n, L[i % 8]/i)
: (pluses = 4 → ∃ l : ℝ, Tendsto S atTop (𝓝 l)) ∧ (putnam_1973_a2_solution ↔ ((∃ l : ℝ, Tendsto S atTop (𝓝 l)) → pluses = 4)) :=
sorry
