(* Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench artifact putnam_1973_a2:
   convergence of a periodic signed harmonic series is equivalent to each
   eight-term sign block containing four plus signs. This file contains no proof. *)

From Stdlib Require Import Reals List Arith.

Open Scope R_scope.

Fixpoint putnam_1973_a2_count_ones (L : list R) : nat :=
  match L with
  | nil => O
  | x :: xs =>
      if Req_EM_T x 1
      then S (putnam_1973_a2_count_ones xs)
      else putnam_1973_a2_count_ones xs
  end.

Fixpoint putnam_1973_a2_partial_sum
    (L : list R) (n : nat) : R :=
  match n with
  | O => 0
  | S k =>
      putnam_1973_a2_partial_sum L k +
      nth ((S k) mod 8) L 0 / INR (S k)
  end.

Definition putnam_1973_a2_tends_to
    (S : nat -> R) (l : R) : Prop :=
  forall epsilon : R,
    0 < epsilon ->
    exists N : nat,
      forall n : nat,
        (N <= n)%nat ->
        Rabs (S n - l) < epsilon.

Theorem putnam_1973_a2
    (L : list R)
    (hLlength : length L = 8%nat)
    (hLsigns :
      forall i : nat,
        (i < length L)%nat ->
        nth i L 0 = 1 \/ nth i L 0 = -1)
    (pluses : nat)
    (hpluses : pluses = putnam_1973_a2_count_ones L)
    (S : nat -> R)
    (hS : S = putnam_1973_a2_partial_sum L) :
  (exists l : R, putnam_1973_a2_tends_to S l) <->
  pluses = 4%nat.
Admitted.

content:
;; Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1973_a2:
;; a periodic signed harmonic series converges exactly when its eight-term
;; sign block contains four plus signs. This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))

(defun putnam-1973-a2-sign-list-p (signs)
  (if (consp signs)
      (and (or (equal (car signs) 1)
               (equal (car signs) -1))
           (putnam-1973-a2-sign-list-p (cdr signs)))
    (equal signs nil)))

(defun putnam-1973-a2-sign-block-p (signs)
  (and (true-listp signs)
       (equal (len signs) 8)
       (putnam-1973-a2-sign-list-p signs)))

(defun putnam-1973-a2-count-pluses (signs)
  (if (consp signs)
      (+ (if (equal (car signs) 1) 1 0)
         (putnam-1973-a2-count-pluses (cdr signs)))
    0))

;; The nth partial sum is sum_{i=1}^n signs[i mod 8]/i, matching the
;; indexing in the formal sources. Every value is an exact rational.
(defun putnam-1973-a2-partial-sum (signs n)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix n)))
  (if (zp n)
      0
    (+ (putnam-1973-a2-partial-sum signs (- n 1))
       (/ (nth (mod n 8) signs) n))))

;; A rational sequence converges in the reals exactly when it is Cauchy.
;; Positive rational tolerances are cofinal among positive real tolerances,
;; so this retains the source's real convergence statement without choosing
;; or externally parameterizing a rational limit.
(defun-sk putnam-1973-a2-cauchy-tail-p
    (signs epsilon cutoff)
  (forall (left-index right-index)
    (implies
     (and (natp cutoff)
          (natp left-index)
          (natp right-index)
          (<= cutoff left-index)
          (<= cutoff right-index))
     (< (abs
         (- (putnam-1973-a2-partial-sum
             signs left-index)
            (putnam-1973-a2-partial-sum
             signs right-index)))
        epsilon))))

(defun-sk putnam-1973-a2-cauchy-cutoff-exists-p
    (signs epsilon)
  (exists (cutoff)
    (and (natp cutoff)
         (putnam-1973-a2-cauchy-tail-p
          signs epsilon cutoff))))

(defun-sk putnam-1973-a2-converges-p (signs)
  (forall (epsilon)
    (implies
     (and (rationalp epsilon)
          (< 0 epsilon))
     (putnam-1973-a2-cauchy-cutoff-exists-p
      signs epsilon))))

(defun-sk putnambench-putnam-1973-a2-statement ()
  (forall (signs)
    (implies
     (putnam-1973-a2-sign-block-p signs)
     (iff (putnam-1973-a2-converges-p signs)
          (equal (putnam-1973-a2-count-pluses signs)
                 4)))))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

title: putnam_1973_a2
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1973_a2:
-- convergence of a harmonic series with an eight-periodic pattern of plus and
-- minus signs, and the necessity and sufficiency of four plus signs per period.
-- This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module Putnam1973A2 where

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_)

infix 4 _!=_ _<=N_
infixr 3 _and_
infixr 2 _or_ _iff_

data Bottom : Set where

Not : Set -> Set
Not A =
  A -> Bottom

_!=_ : {A : Set} -> A -> A -> Set
x != y =
  Not (x == y)

record _and_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data _or_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  left  : A -> A or B
  right : B -> A or B

record _iff_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor equivalence
  field
    forward  : A -> B
    backward : B -> A

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

record Top : Set where
  constructor top

data _<=N_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set where
  zero<=   : {n : Nat} -> zero <=N n
  suc<=suc : {m n : Nat} -> m <=N n -> suc m <=N suc n

record CompleteOrderedRealField (R : Set) : Set1 where
  field
    zeroR oneR : R
    add multiply : R -> R -> R
    negate inverse : R -> R
    lessOrEqual : R -> R -> Set
    fromNat : Nat -> R

    one-not-zero :
      oneR != zeroR

    add-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> add x y == add y x
    add-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      add (add x y) z == add x (add y z)
    add-zero :
      (x : R) -> add x zeroR == x
    add-inverse :
      (x : R) -> add x (negate x) == zeroR

    multiply-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> multiply x y == multiply y x
    multiply-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply (multiply x y) z ==
      multiply x (multiply y z)
    multiply-one :
      (x : R) -> multiply x oneR == x
    multiply-zero :
      (x : R) -> multiply x zeroR == zeroR
    distribute :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply x (add y z) ==
      add (multiply x y) (multiply x z)
    inverse-zero :
      inverse zeroR == zeroR
    multiply-inverse :
      (x : R) ->
      x != zeroR ->
      multiply x (inverse x) == oneR

    order-reflexive :
      (x : R) -> lessOrEqual x x
    order-transitive :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y z ->
      lessOrEqual x z
    order-antisymmetric :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y x ->
      x == y
    order-total :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y or lessOrEqual y x
    add-order :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual (add z x) (add z y)
    multiply-nonnegative :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR x ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR y ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR (multiply x y)
    zero-less-than-one :
      lessOrEqual zeroR oneR and zeroR != oneR

    fromNat-zero :
      fromNat zero == zeroR
    fromNat-successor :
      (n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (suc n) == add (fromNat n) oneR
    fromNat-addition :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m + n) == add (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-injective :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat m == fromNat n ->
      m == n

    archimedean :
      (x : R) ->
      Exists Nat (\ n -> lessOrEqual x (fromNat n))
    least-upper-bound :
      (P : R -> Set) ->
      Exists R P ->
      Exists R
        (\ upper ->
          (x : R) ->
          P x ->
          lessOrEqual x upper) ->
      Exists R
        (\ supremum ->
          ((x : R) ->
            P x ->
            lessOrEqual x supremum)
          and
          ((upper : R) ->
            ((x : R) ->
              P x ->
              lessOrEqual x upper) ->
            lessOrEqual supremum upper))

open CompleteOrderedRealField

subtract :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
subtract reals x y =
  add reals x (negate reals y)

divide :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
divide reals x y =
  multiply reals x (inverse reals y)

StrictLess :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
StrictLess reals x y =
  lessOrEqual reals x y and x != y

CloseTo :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
CloseTo reals center radius x =
  StrictLess reals
    (subtract reals center radius)
    x
  and
  StrictLess reals
    x
    (add reals center radius)

ConvergesTo :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  R ->
  Set
ConvergesTo {R} reals sequence limit =
  (epsilon : R) ->
  StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) epsilon ->
  Exists Nat
    (\ cutoff ->
      (n : Nat) ->
      cutoff <=N n ->
      CloseTo reals limit epsilon (sequence n))

data Index8 : Set where
  i0 i1 i2 i3 i4 i5 i6 i7 : Index8

nextIndex : Index8 -> Index8
nextIndex i0 = i1
nextIndex i1 = i2
nextIndex i2 = i3
nextIndex i3 = i4
nextIndex i4 = i5
nextIndex i5 = i6
nextIndex i6 = i7
nextIndex i7 = i0

modEight : Nat -> Index8
modEight zero =
  i0
modEight (suc n) =
  nextIndex (modEight n)

data Sign : Set where
  plus minus : Sign

signValue :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Sign ->
  R
signValue reals plus =
  oneR reals
signValue reals minus =
  negate reals (oneR reals)

plusCount : Sign -> Nat
plusCount plus =
  suc zero
plusCount minus =
  zero

countPluses : (Index8 -> Sign) -> Nat
countPluses signs =
  plusCount (signs i0) +
  plusCount (signs i1) +
  plusCount (signs i2) +
  plusCount (signs i3) +
  plusCount (signs i4) +
  plusCount (signs i5) +
  plusCount (signs i6) +
  plusCount (signs i7)

four : Nat
four =
  suc (suc (suc (suc zero)))

periodicTerm :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (Index8 -> Sign) ->
  Nat ->
  R
periodicTerm reals signs n =
  divide reals
    (signValue reals (signs (modEight n)))
    (fromNat reals n)

partialSums :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (Index8 -> Sign) ->
  Nat ->
  R
partialSums reals signs zero =
  zeroR reals
partialSums reals signs (suc n) =
  add reals
    (partialSums reals signs n)
    (periodicTerm reals signs (suc n))

putnam-1973-a2-solution : Set
putnam-1973-a2-solution =
  Top

module Putnam1973A2Statement
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) where

  Converges :
    (Index8 -> Sign) ->
    Set
  Converges signs =
    Exists R
      (\ limit ->
        ConvergesTo reals
          (partialSums reals signs)
          limit)

  proposition : Set
  proposition =
    (signs : Index8 -> Sign) ->
    (pluses : Nat) ->
    pluses == countPluses signs ->
    (pluses == four -> Converges signs)
    and
    (putnam-1973-a2-solution
      iff
      (Converges signs -> pluses == four))

putnam-1973-a2 : Set1
putnam-1973-a2 =
  (R : Set) ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) ->
  Putnam1973A2Statement.proposition reals

(*
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench artifact putnam_1973_a2:
  an eight-periodic signed harmonic series converges exactly when each
  period contains four positive and four negative signs.

  The term with index i uses EL ((i - 1) MOD 8) L, so terms 1 and 9 have
  the same sign as in the published problem. This is a cyclic reindexing
  of the upstream Lean encoding and does not change the balance criterion.
  This file contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open arithmeticTheory listTheory pred_setTheory realTheory real_sigmaTheory;
open real_topologyTheory;

val putnam_1973_a2 =
  ``!L : real list.
      LENGTH L = 8 /\
      (!i : num.
         i < LENGTH L
         ==>
         EL i L = (1 : real) \/ EL i L = ~(1 : real))
      ==>
      ((CARD {i : num | i < LENGTH L /\ EL i L = (1 : real)} = 4)
       <=>
       ?l : real.
         ((\n : num.
             SIGMA
               (\i : num. EL ((i - 1) MOD 8) L / &i)
               (IMAGE SUC (count n))) --> l)
           sequentially)``;

% Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench artifact putnam_1973_a2:
% convergence of a harmonic series with an eight-term periodic sign pattern,
% including sufficiency and necessity of four positive signs per period.
% This file contains no proof.

putnam_1973_a2: THEORY
BEGIN
  block_index: TYPE = below(8)
  sign_block: TYPE = [block_index -> real]
  real_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> real]

  periodic_index(index: nat): block_index =
    mod(index, 8)

  valid_sign_block(block: sign_block): bool =
    FORALL (index: block_index):
      block(index) = 1 OR block(index) = -1

  positive_sign_count(
      block: sign_block,
      count: nat): RECURSIVE nat =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      positive_sign_count(block, count - 1)
        + IF block(periodic_index(count - 1)) = 1
          THEN 1
          ELSE 0
          ENDIF
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  pluses(block: sign_block): nat =
    positive_sign_count(block, 8)

  partial_sum(
      block: sign_block,
      count: nat): RECURSIVE real =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      partial_sum(block, count - 1)
        + block(periodic_index(count)) / (count :: real)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  converges_to(sequence: real_sequence, limit: real): bool =
    FORALL (epsilon_value: posreal):
      EXISTS (cutoff: nat):
        FORALL (count: nat):
          cutoff <= count IMPLIES
            abs(sequence(count) - limit) < epsilon_value

  series_converges(block: sign_block): bool =
    EXISTS (limit: real):
      converges_to(
        LAMBDA (count: nat):
          partial_sum(block, count),
        limit)

  putnam_1973_a2_solution: bool = TRUE

  putnam_1973_a2_statement: bool =
    FORALL (block: sign_block):
      valid_sign_block(block) IMPLIES
        ((pluses(block) = 4 IMPLIES series_converges(block))
          AND
            (putnam_1973_a2_solution IFF
              (series_converges(block) IMPLIES
                pluses(block) = 4)))
END putnam_1973_a2

content:
;; Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1973_a3:
;; for each positive integer n, the minimum of k + n/k over positive integers
;; has the same integer part as sqrt(4*n + 1). This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

;; The source function B is eliminated by its defining minimum. For positive
;; integer N, every integer K > N gives
;;
;;   K + N/K > N + 1 = 1 + N/1,
;;
;; so the unrestricted positive-integer minimum is exactly the minimum over
;; 1 <= K <= N. ACL2 computes these values as exact rationals.
(defun putnam-1973-a3-value (n k)
  (+ k (/ n k)))

(defun putnam-1973-a3-minimum-through (n k)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix k)))
  (if (and (integerp k)
           (< 1 k))
      (let ((current (putnam-1973-a3-value n k))
            (previous
             (putnam-1973-a3-minimum-through n (- k 1))))
        (if (< current previous)
            current
          previous))
    (putnam-1973-a3-value n 1)))

;; For natural X, descending from X returns the unique integer M satisfying
;; M^2 <= X < (M+1)^2, hence exactly floor(sqrt(X)). This keeps the source
;; square root internal while preserving its integer part bidirectionally.
(defun putnam-1973-a3-floor-sqrt-down (x candidate)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix candidate)))
  (if (zp candidate)
      0
    (if (<= (* candidate candidate) x)
        candidate
      (putnam-1973-a3-floor-sqrt-down
       x (- candidate 1)))))

(defun putnam-1973-a3-floor-sqrt (x)
  (putnam-1973-a3-floor-sqrt-down x x))

(defun putnambench-putnam-1973-a3-statement (n)
  (implies
   (and (integerp n)
        (< 0 n))
   (equal
    (floor (putnam-1973-a3-minimum-through n n) 1)
    (putnam-1973-a3-floor-sqrt (+ (* 4 n) 1)))))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

-- Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1973_a3:
-- the integer part of the minimum of k + n/k over positive integers k equals
-- the integer part of the square root of 4n + 1. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Int using (Int; pos; negsuc)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; _*_)

infix 4 _!=_
infixr 3 _and_
infixr 2 _or_

data Bottom : Set where

Not : Set -> Set
Not A =
  A -> Bottom

_!=_ : {A : Set} -> A -> A -> Set
x != y =
  Not (x == y)

record _and_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data _or_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  left  : A -> A or B
  right : B -> A or B

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

intSuccessor : Int -> Int
intSuccessor (pos n) =
  pos (suc n)
intSuccessor (negsuc zero) =
  pos zero
intSuccessor (negsuc (suc n)) =
  negsuc n

embedInt :
  {R : Set} ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  (R -> R) ->
  Int ->
  R
embedInt fromNatural negateR (pos n) =
  fromNatural n
embedInt fromNatural negateR (negsuc n) =
  negateR (fromNatural (suc n))

data PositiveInt : Int -> Set where
  positive : {n : Nat} -> PositiveInt (pos (suc n))

record CompleteOrderedRealField (R : Set) : Set1 where
  field
    zeroR oneR : R
    add multiply : R -> R -> R
    negate inverse squareRoot : R -> R
    lessOrEqual : R -> R -> Set
    fromNat : Nat -> R
    floor : R -> Int

    one-not-zero :
      oneR != zeroR

    add-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> add x y == add y x
    add-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      add (add x y) z == add x (add y z)
    add-zero :
      (x : R) -> add x zeroR == x
    add-inverse :
      (x : R) -> add x (negate x) == zeroR

    multiply-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> multiply x y == multiply y x
    multiply-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply (multiply x y) z ==
      multiply x (multiply y z)
    multiply-one :
      (x : R) -> multiply x oneR == x
    multiply-zero :
      (x : R) -> multiply x zeroR == zeroR
    distribute :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply x (add y z) ==
      add (multiply x y) (multiply x z)
    inverse-zero :
      inverse zeroR == zeroR
    multiply-inverse :
      (x : R) ->
      x != zeroR ->
      multiply x (inverse x) == oneR

    order-reflexive :
      (x : R) -> lessOrEqual x x
    order-transitive :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y z ->
      lessOrEqual x z
    order-antisymmetric :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y x ->
      x == y
    order-total :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y or lessOrEqual y x
    add-order :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual (add z x) (add z y)
    multiply-nonnegative :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR x ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR y ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR (multiply x y)
    zero-less-than-one :
      lessOrEqual zeroR oneR and zeroR != oneR

    fromNat-zero :
      fromNat zero == zeroR
    fromNat-successor :
      (n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (suc n) == add (fromNat n) oneR
    fromNat-addition :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m + n) == add (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-multiplication :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m * n) == multiply (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-injective :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat m == fromNat n ->
      m == n

    archimedean :
      (x : R) ->
      Exists Nat (\ n -> lessOrEqual x (fromNat n))
    least-upper-bound :
      (P : R -> Set) ->
      Exists R P ->
      Exists R
        (\ upper ->
          (x : R) ->
          P x ->
          lessOrEqual x upper) ->
      Exists R
        (\ supremum ->
          ((x : R) ->
            P x ->
            lessOrEqual x supremum)
          and
          ((upper : R) ->
            ((x : R) ->
              P x ->
              lessOrEqual x upper) ->
            lessOrEqual supremum upper))

    square-root-nonnegative :
      (x : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR (squareRoot x)
    square-root-square :
      (x : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR x ->
      multiply (squareRoot x) (squareRoot x) == x
    square-root-nonpositive :
      (x : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x zeroR ->
      squareRoot x == zeroR
    square-root-unique :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR y ->
      multiply y y == x ->
      y == squareRoot x

    floor-lower :
      (x : R) ->
      lessOrEqual
        (embedInt fromNat negate (floor x))
        x
    floor-upper :
      (x : R) ->
      lessOrEqual
        x
        (embedInt fromNat negate (intSuccessor (floor x)))
      and
      x != embedInt fromNat negate (intSuccessor (floor x))

open CompleteOrderedRealField

fromInt :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Int ->
  R
fromInt reals =
  embedInt (fromNat reals) (negate reals)

divide :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
divide reals x y =
  multiply reals x (inverse reals y)

MinimumValue :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Int ->
  R ->
  Set
MinimumValue {R} reals n minimum =
  ((k : Int) ->
    PositiveInt k ->
    lessOrEqual reals
      minimum
      (add reals
        (fromInt reals k)
        (divide reals
          (fromInt reals n)
          (fromInt reals k))))
  and
  Exists Int
    (\ k ->
      PositiveInt k
      and
      minimum ==
      add reals
        (fromInt reals k)
        (divide reals
          (fromInt reals n)
          (fromInt reals k)))

module Putnam1973A3Statement
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) where

  four : R
  four =
    fromNat reals (suc (suc (suc (suc zero))))

  radicand : Int -> R
  radicand n =
    add reals
      (multiply reals four (fromInt reals n))
      (oneR reals)

  proposition : Set
  proposition =
    (b : Int -> R) ->
    ((n : Int) -> MinimumValue reals n (b n)) ->
    (n : Int) ->
    PositiveInt n ->
    floor reals (b n) ==
    floor reals (squareRoot reals (radicand n))

putnam-1973-a3 : Set1
putnam-1973-a3 =
  (R : Set) ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) ->
  Putnam1973A3Statement.proposition reals

BEGIN

  safe_div(numerator, denominator: real): real =
    IF denominator = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      numerator / denominator
    ENDIF

  candidate_value(n, k: int): real =
    (k :: real) + safe_div(n :: real, k :: real)

      b: integer_real_function,
      n: int): bool =
    (FORALL (k: int):
      k > 0 IMPLIES b(n) <= candidate_value(n, k))
      AND EXISTS (k: int):
        k > 0 AND b(n) = candidate_value(n, k)

  sqrt_value(root, radicand: real): bool =
    0 <= root AND root * root = radicand

  putnam_1973_a3: bool =
    FORALL (b: integer_real_function):
      (FORALL (n: int): is_minimum_value(b, n))
      IMPLIES
        FORALL (n: int):
          n > 0 IMPLIES
            EXISTS (root: real):
              sqrt_value(root, 4 * (n :: real) + 1)
                AND floor(b(n)) = floor(root)
END putnam_1973_a3

;; Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1973_a4:
;; the real function 2^x - 1 - x^2 has exactly three distinct zeros on the
;; real line. This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))

;; A context presents a Dedekind-complete ordered field, hence the real field
;; up to ordered-field isomorphism. Its final operation is base-2 real
;; exponentiation. Positivity, normalization at 0 and 1, the exponential
;; addition law, and strict monotonicity uniquely characterize x |-> 2^x.
;; Thus the operation is not an uninterpreted surrogate or a restriction to
;; rational exponents.

(defun putnam-1973-a4-member-p (carrier x)
  (if (apply$ carrier (list x)) t nil))

(defun putnam-1973-a4-unary-value (operation x)
  (apply$ operation (list x)))

(defun putnam-1973-a4-binary-value (operation x y)
  (apply$ operation (list x y)))

(defun-sk putnam-1973-a4-valid-set-p (carrier set)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (apply$ set (list x))
     (putnam-1973-a4-member-p carrier x))))

(defun-sk putnam-1973-a4-field-laws-p
    (carrier add multiply negate inverse zero one)
  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and (putnam-1973-a4-member-p carrier x)
          (putnam-1973-a4-member-p carrier y)
          (putnam-1973-a4-member-p carrier z))
     (and
      (putnam-1973-a4-member-p
       carrier

title: putnam_1973_a4
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1973_a4:
-- the real function f(x) = 2^x - 1 - x^2 has exactly three zeros.
-- This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; _*_)

infix 4 _!=_ _<=N_
infixr 3 _and_
infixr 2 _or_

data Bottom : Set where

Not : Set -> Set
Not A =
  A -> Bottom

_!=_ : {A : Set} -> A -> A -> Set
x != y =
  Not (x == y)

record _and_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data _or_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  left  : A -> A or B
  right : B -> A or B

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

data _<=N_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set where
  zero<=   : {n : Nat} -> zero <=N n
  suc<=suc : {m n : Nat} -> m <=N n -> suc m <=N suc n

data Fin : Nat -> Set where
  fzero : {n : Nat} -> Fin (suc n)
  fsuc  : {n : Nat} -> Fin n -> Fin (suc n)

record HasCardinality
  {A : Set}
  (P : A -> Set)
  (cardinality : Nat) :
  Set where

  field
    enumerate :
      Fin cardinality ->
      A
    enumerated-member :
      (index : Fin cardinality) ->
      P (enumerate index)
    enumeration-complete :
      (x : A) ->
      P x ->
      Exists (Fin cardinality)
        (\ index -> x == enumerate index)
    enumeration-injective :
      (left-index right-index : Fin cardinality) ->
      enumerate left-index == enumerate right-index ->
      left-index == right-index

record CompleteOrderedRealField (R : Set) : Set1 where
  field
    zeroR oneR : R
    add multiply : R -> R -> R
    negate inverse : R -> R
    lessOrEqual : R -> R -> Set
    fromNat : Nat -> R

    one-not-zero :
      oneR != zeroR

    add-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> add x y == add y x
    add-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      add (add x y) z == add x (add y z)
    add-zero :
      (x : R) -> add x zeroR == x
    add-inverse :
      (x : R) -> add x (negate x) == zeroR

    multiply-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> multiply x y == multiply y x
    multiply-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply (multiply x y) z ==
      multiply x (multiply y z)
    multiply-one :
      (x : R) -> multiply x oneR == x
    multiply-zero :
      (x : R) -> multiply x zeroR == zeroR
    distribute :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply x (add y z) ==
      add (multiply x y) (multiply x z)
    inverse-zero :
      inverse zeroR == zeroR
    multiply-inverse :
      (x : R) ->
      x != zeroR ->
      multiply x (inverse x) == oneR

    order-reflexive :
      (x : R) -> lessOrEqual x x
    order-transitive :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y z ->
      lessOrEqual x z
    order-antisymmetric :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y x ->
      x == y
    order-total :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y or lessOrEqual y x
    add-order :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual (add z x) (add z y)
    multiply-nonnegative :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR x ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR y ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR (multiply x y)
    zero-less-than-one :
      lessOrEqual zeroR oneR and zeroR != oneR

    fromNat-zero :
      fromNat zero == zeroR
    fromNat-successor :
      (n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (suc n) == add (fromNat n) oneR
    fromNat-addition :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m + n) == add (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-multiplication :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m * n) == multiply (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-injective :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat m == fromNat n ->
      m == n

    archimedean :
      (x : R) ->
      Exists Nat (\ n -> lessOrEqual x (fromNat n))
    least-upper-bound :
      (P : R -> Set) ->
      Exists R P ->
      Exists R
        (\ upper ->
          (x : R) ->
          P x ->
          lessOrEqual x upper) ->
      Exists R
        (\ supremum ->
          ((x : R) ->
            P x ->
            lessOrEqual x supremum)
          and
          ((upper : R) ->
            ((x : R) ->
              P x ->
              lessOrEqual x upper) ->
            lessOrEqual supremum upper))

open CompleteOrderedRealField

oneN : Nat
oneN =
  suc zero

twoN : Nat
twoN =
  suc oneN

threeN : Nat
threeN =
  suc twoN

subtract :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
subtract reals x y =
  add reals x (negate reals y)

divide :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
divide reals x y =
  multiply reals x (inverse reals y)

StrictLess :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
StrictLess reals x y =
  lessOrEqual reals x y and x != y

CloseTo :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
CloseTo reals center radius x =
  StrictLess reals
    (subtract reals center radius)
    x
  and
  StrictLess reals
    x
    (add reals center radius)

naturalPower :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  Nat ->
  R
naturalPower reals x zero =
  oneR reals
naturalPower reals x (suc n) =
  multiply reals
    (naturalPower reals x n)
    x

factorial : Nat -> Nat
factorial zero =
  oneN
factorial (suc n) =
  suc n * factorial n

sumFirst :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Nat ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  R
sumFirst reals zero term =
  zeroR reals
sumFirst reals (suc n) term =
  add reals
    (sumFirst reals n term)
    (term n)

ConvergesTo :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  R ->
  Set
ConvergesTo {R} reals sequence limit =
  (epsilon : R) ->
  StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) epsilon ->
  Exists Nat
    (\ cutoff ->
      (n : Nat) ->
      cutoff <=N n ->
      CloseTo reals limit epsilon (sequence n))

SeriesHasSum :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  R ->
  Set
SeriesHasSum reals terms limit =
  ConvergesTo reals
    (\ n -> sumFirst reals n terms)
    limit

exponentialTerm :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  Nat ->
  R
exponentialTerm reals x n =
  divide reals
    (naturalPower reals x n)
    (fromNat reals (factorial n))

ExponentialValue :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
ExponentialValue reals x value =
  SeriesHasSum reals
    (exponentialTerm reals x)
    value

record StandardRealPowers
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) :
  Set1 where

  field
    exponential logarithm : R -> R

    exponential-series :
      (x : R) ->
      ExponentialValue reals x (exponential x)

    exponential-positive :
      (x : R) ->
      StrictLess reals
        (zeroR reals)
        (exponential x)

    exponential-injective :
      (x y : R) ->
      exponential x == exponential y ->
      x == y

    exponential-logarithm :
      (x : R) ->
      StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) x ->
      exponential (logarithm x) == x

open StandardRealPowers

realPower :
  {R : Set} ->
  {reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R} ->
  StandardRealPowers reals ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
realPower {reals = reals} powers base exponent =
  exponential powers
    (multiply reals exponent (logarithm powers base))

PutnamFunction :
  {R : Set} ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) ->
  StandardRealPowers reals ->
  R ->
  R
PutnamFunction reals powers x =
  subtract reals
    (subtract reals
      (realPower powers (fromNat reals twoN) x)
      (oneR reals))
    (naturalPower reals x twoN)

putnam-1973-a4 : Set1
putnam-1973-a4 =
  (R : Set) ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) ->
  (powers : StandardRealPowers reals) ->
  HasCardinality
    (\ x ->
      PutnamFunction reals powers x ==
      zeroR reals)
    threeN

content:
$(
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact
  putnam_1973_a4: the real function x |-> 2^x - 1 - x^2 has exactly
  three zeros on the real line. This file contains no proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  The source function is inlined into its zero set. On the positive real
  base 2, set.mm's complex-power operation ^c equals the source real power
  exp(x log 2). Thus the cardinality assertion below is definitionally
  equivalent to saying that the source function has exactly three real
  zeros.

  The final declaration is the single unproved $a corpus statement; this
  database contains no $p proof statement.
$)

${
  putnambench-putnam-1973-a4 $a |- (
    #
    `
    {
      x e. RR |
        (
          (
            ( 2 ^c x )
            -
            1
          )
          -
          ( x ^ 2 )
        )
        =
        0
    }
  )
  =
  3 $.
$}

% Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench artifact putnam_1973_a4:
% the real function 2^x - 1 - x^2 has exactly three zeros on the real line.
% This file contains no proof.

putnam_1973_a4: THEORY
BEGIN
  real_set: TYPE = [real -> bool]
  real_enumeration: TYPE = [nat -> real]

  safe_div(numerator, denominator: real): real =
    IF denominator = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      numerator / denominator
    ENDIF

  nat_factorial(index: nat): RECURSIVE nat =
    IF index = 0 THEN
      1
    ELSE
      index * nat_factorial(index - 1)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE index

  exponential_partial(x: real, count: nat): RECURSIVE real =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      LET index: nat = count - 1 IN
        exponential_partial(x, count - 1)
          + safe_div(
              x ^ index,
              nat_factorial(index) :: real)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  converges_to(sequence: [nat -> real], value: real): bool =
    FORALL (epsilon_value: posreal):
      EXISTS (cutoff: nat):
        FORALL (index: nat):
          cutoff <= index IMPLIES
            abs(sequence(index) - value) < epsilon_value

  exponential_value(x, value: real): bool =
    converges_to(
      LAMBDA (count: nat):
        exponential_partial(x, count),
      value)

  real_power_value(base, exponent, value: real): bool =
    base > 0
      AND EXISTS (log_base: real):
        exponential_value(log_base, base)
          AND exponential_value(exponent * log_base, value)

  putnam_zero_set: real_set =
    LAMBDA (x: real):
      EXISTS (two_to_x: real):
        real_power_value(2, x, two_to_x)
          AND two_to_x - 1 - x ^ 2 = 0

  injective_below(
      enumeration: real_enumeration,
      bound: nat): bool =
    FORALL (i, j: nat):
      i < bound
        AND j < bound
        AND enumeration(i) = enumeration(j)
      IMPLIES i = j

  enumerates_exactly(
      enumeration: real_enumeration,
      set_value: real_set,
      bound: nat): bool =
    FORALL (x: real):
      set_value(x)
        IFF
          EXISTS (position: nat):
            position < bound
              AND enumeration(position) = x

  has_cardinality(
      set_value: real_set,
      cardinality: nat): bool =
    EXISTS (enumeration: real_enumeration):
      injective_below(enumeration, cardinality)
        AND enumerates_exactly(
          enumeration, set_value, cardinality)

  putnam_1973_a4_solution: nat = 3

  putnam_1973_a4: bool =
    has_cardinality(
      putnam_zero_set, putnam_1973_a4_solution)
END putnam_1973_a4

-- Note: Uses the slope/intercept formulation of line in the plane
/--
Prove that it is impossible for seven distinct straight lines to be situated in the Euclidean plane so as to have at least six points where exactly three of these lines intersect and at least four points where exactly two of these lines interest.
-/
theorem putnam_1973_a6
(nint : ℕ → (Fin 7 → (ℝ × ℝ)) → ℕ)
(h_nint : nint = fun n lines => {p : ℝ × ℝ | ∃! S : Set (Fin 7), S.ncard = n ∧ p ∈ ⋂ i ∈ S, {pts | pts.2 = (lines i).1 * pts.1 + (lines i).2}}.ncard)
: ¬ ∃ lines : Fin 7 → (ℝ × ℝ), (∀ i j : Fin 7, i ≠ j → lines i ≠ lines j) ∧ nint 3 lines ≥ 6 ∧ nint 2 lines ≥ 4 :=

title: putnam_1973_a6
content:
(* Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench artifact putnam_1973_a6:
   seven distinct real plane lines cannot have at least six points incident
   with exactly three lines and at least four points incident with exactly
   two. This file contains no proof. *)

From Stdlib Require Import Vectors.Fin Reals Ensembles Finite_sets.

Open Scope R_scope.

Definition putnam_1973_a6_index : Type := Fin.t 7.
Definition putnam_1973_a6_point : Type := (R * R)%type.
Definition putnam_1973_a6_line : Type := (R * R)%type.

Definition putnam_1973_a6_on_line
    (p : putnam_1973_a6_point)
    (line : putnam_1973_a6_line) : Prop :=
  snd p = fst line * fst p + snd line.

Definition putnam_1973_a6_on_all
    (lines : putnam_1973_a6_index -> putnam_1973_a6_line)
    (indices : Ensemble putnam_1973_a6_index)
    (p : putnam_1973_a6_point) : Prop :=
  forall i : putnam_1973_a6_index,
    In putnam_1973_a6_index indices i ->
    putnam_1973_a6_on_line p (lines i).

Definition putnam_1973_a6_nfold_point
    (n : nat)
    (lines : putnam_1973_a6_index -> putnam_1973_a6_line)
    (p : putnam_1973_a6_point) : Prop :=
  exists indices : Ensemble putnam_1973_a6_index,
    cardinal putnam_1973_a6_index indices n /\
    putnam_1973_a6_on_all lines indices p /\
    forall other : Ensemble putnam_1973_a6_index,
      cardinal putnam_1973_a6_index other n ->
      putnam_1973_a6_on_all lines other p ->
      Same_set putnam_1973_a6_index indices other.

Definition putnam_1973_a6_at_least
    (n lower : nat)
    (lines : putnam_1973_a6_index -> putnam_1973_a6_line) : Prop :=
  exists total : nat,
    cardinal
      putnam_1973_a6_point
      (putnam_1973_a6_nfold_point n lines)
      total /\
    (lower <= total)%nat.

Theorem putnam_1973_a6 :
  ~ exists lines : putnam_1973_a6_index -> putnam_1973_a6_line,
      (forall i j : putnam_1973_a6_index,
        i <> j ->
        lines i <> lines j) /\
      putnam_1973_a6_at_least 3 6 lines /\
      putnam_1973_a6_at_least 2 4 lines.
Admitted.

(* Note: Uses the slope/intercept formulation of line in the plane *)

theorem putnam_1973_a6:
  fixes h_nint :: "nat \<Rightarrow> (nat \<Rightarrow> (real \<times> real)) \<Rightarrow> nat"
  defines "h_nint \<equiv> (\<lambda>(n::nat)(lines::nat\<Rightarrow>(real\<times>real)). card {p::real\<times>real. (\<exists>!S::nat set. S \<subseteq> {0..6} \<and> card S = n \<and> p \<in> (\<Inter>i\<in>S. {pts::real\<times>real. (snd pts = fst (lines i) * fst pts + snd (lines i))}))})"
  shows "\<not>(\<exists>lines::nat\<Rightarrow>(real\<times>real). (\<forall>i::nat\<in>{0..6}. \<forall>j::nat\<in>{0..6}. (i \<noteq> j \<longrightarrow> lines i \<noteq> lines j)) \<and> h_nint 3 lines \<ge> 6 \<and> h_nint 2 lines \<ge> 4)"

(*
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench artifact putnam_1973_a6:
  impossibility of seven distinct slope-intercept lines having at least six
  points incident to exactly three lines and at least four points incident to
  exactly two lines. This file contains no proof.
*)

let statement =
  `let nint =
     \n (lines:num->real#real).
       CARD
         {p:real#real |
            ?!S:num->bool.
              S SUBSET (0..6) /\
              CARD S = n /\
              (!i. i IN S
                   ==> SND p =
                       FST (lines i) * FST p + SND (lines i))} in
   ~(?lines:num->real#real.
       (!i j.
          i IN (0..6) /\ j IN (0..6) /\ ~(i = j)
          ==> ~(lines i = lines j)) /\
       6 <= nint 3 lines /\
       4 <= nint 2 lines)`;;

title: putnam_1973_a6
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1973_a6:
;; seven distinct affine lines over the real numbers cannot have at least six
;; points on exactly three lines and at least four points on exactly two lines.
;; This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))

;; Scalars are presented as an arbitrary real-closed ordered field.  The
;; existence of a seven-line counterexample, with all incidence multiplicities
;; expanded as below, is a first-order sentence in the language of ordered
;; fields.  Real-closed fields are elementarily equivalent, so quantifying over
;; such a presentation is bidirectionally equivalent to the source statement
;; over R; in particular, no restriction to rational coefficients is made.

(defstub putnam-1973-a6-scalar-p (x) t)
(defstub putnam-1973-a6-add (x y) t)
(defstub putnam-1973-a6-mul (x y) t)
(defstub putnam-1973-a6-neg (x) t)
(defstub putnam-1973-a6-inv (x) t)
(defstub putnam-1973-a6-lt (x y) t)

(defun putnam-1973-a6-member-p (x)
  (if (putnam-1973-a6-scalar-p x) t nil))

(defun putnam-1973-a6-sub (x y)
  (putnam-1973-a6-add x (putnam-1973-a6-neg y)))

(defun-sk putnam-1973-a6-field-laws-p ()
  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (putnam-1973-a6-member-p x)
      (putnam-1973-a6-member-p y)
      (putnam-1973-a6-member-p z))
     (and
      (putnam-1973-a6-member-p
       (putnam-1973-a6-add x y))
      (putnam-1973-a6-member-p
       (putnam-1973-a6-mul x y))
      (putnam-1973-a6-member-p
       (putnam-1973-a6-neg x))
      (putnam-1973-a6-member-p
       (putnam-1973-a6-inv x))
      (equal
       (putnam-1973-a6-add
        (putnam-1973-a6-add x y) z)
       (putnam-1973-a6-add
        x (putnam-1973-a6-add y z)))
      (equal
       (putnam-1973-a6-add x y)
       (putnam-1973-a6-add y x))
      (equal
       (putnam-1973-a6-add x 0)
       x)
      (equal
       (putnam-1973-a6-add
        x (putnam-1973-a6-neg x))
       0)
      (equal
       (putnam-1973-a6-mul
        (putnam-1973-a6-mul x y) z)
       (putnam-1973-a6-mul
        x (putnam-1973-a6-mul y z)))
      (equal
       (putnam-1973-a6-mul x y)
       (putnam-1973-a6-mul y x))
      (equal
       (putnam-1973-a6-mul x 1)
       x)
      (implies
       (equal x 0)
       (equal (putnam-1973-a6-inv x) 0))
      (implies
       (not (equal x 0))
       (equal
        (putnam-1973-a6-mul
         x (putnam-1973-a6-inv x))
        1))
      (equal
       (putnam-1973-a6-mul
        x (putnam-1973-a6-add y z))
       (putnam-1973-a6-add
        (putnam-1973-a6-mul x y)
        (putnam-1973-a6-mul x z)))))))

(defun-sk putnam-1973-a6-order-laws-p ()
  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (putnam-1973-a6-member-p x)
      (putnam-1973-a6-member-p y)
      (putnam-1973-a6-member-p z))
     (and
      (not (putnam-1973-a6-lt x x))
      (or
       (equal x y)
       (putnam-1973-a6-lt x y)
       (putnam-1973-a6-lt y x))
      (implies
       (and
        (putnam-1973-a6-lt x y)
        (putnam-1973-a6-lt y z))
       (putnam-1973-a6-lt x z))
      (implies
       (putnam-1973-a6-lt x y)
       (putnam-1973-a6-lt
        (putnam-1973-a6-add x z)
        (putnam-1973-a6-add y z)))
      (implies
       (and
        (putnam-1973-a6-lt 0 x)
        (putnam-1973-a6-lt 0 y))
       (putnam-1973-a6-lt
        0 (putnam-1973-a6-mul x y)))))))

(defun-sk putnam-1973-a6-has-square-root-p (x)
  (exists (root)
    (and
     (putnam-1973-a6-member-p root)
     (equal
      (putnam-1973-a6-mul root root)
      x))))

(defun-sk putnam-1973-a6-square-root-law-p ()
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (and
      (putnam-1973-a6-member-p x)
      (not (putnam-1973-a6-lt x 0)))
     (putnam-1973-a6-has-square-root-p x))))

(defun putnam-1973-a6-scalar-list-p (values)
  (if (consp values)
      (and
       (putnam-1973-a6-member-p (car values))
       (putnam-1973-a6-scalar-list-p (cdr values)))
    (equal values nil)))

(defun putnam-1973-a6-polynomial-p (coefficients)
  (and
   (true-listp coefficients)
   (consp coefficients)
   (putnam-1973-a6-scalar-list-p coefficients)
   (not (equal (car (last coefficients)) 0))))

(defun putnam-1973-a6-polynomial-value (coefficients x)
  (if (consp coefficients)
      (putnam-1973-a6-add
       (car coefficients)
       (putnam-1973-a6-mul
        x
        (putnam-1973-a6-polynomial-value
         (cdr coefficients) x)))
    0))

(defun-sk putnam-1973-a6-polynomial-has-root-p
    (coefficients)
  (exists (root)
    (and
     (putnam-1973-a6-member-p root)
     (equal
      (putnam-1973-a6-polynomial-value
       coefficients root)
      0))))

(defun-sk putnam-1973-a6-odd-polynomial-root-law-p ()
  (forall (coefficients)
    (implies
     (and
      (putnam-1973-a6-polynomial-p coefficients)
      (evenp (len coefficients)))
     (putnam-1973-a6-polynomial-has-root-p
      coefficients))))

(defun putnam-1973-a6-real-closed-field-p ()
  (and
   (putnam-1973-a6-member-p 0)
   (putnam-1973-a6-member-p 1)
   (not (equal 0 1))
   (putnam-1973-a6-field-laws-p)
   (putnam-1973-a6-order-laws-p)
   (putnam-1973-a6-lt 0 1)
   (putnam-1973-a6-square-root-law-p)
   (putnam-1973-a6-odd-polynomial-root-law-p)))

;; Each source line y = m*x + b is represented by the list (m b).

(defun putnam-1973-a6-line-p (line)
  (and
   (true-listp line)
   (equal (len line) 2)
   (putnam-1973-a6-member-p (nth 0 line))
   (putnam-1973-a6-member-p (nth 1 line))))

(defun putnam-1973-a6-line-list-p (lines)
  (if (consp lines)
      (and
       (putnam-1973-a6-line-p (car lines))
       (putnam-1973-a6-line-list-p (cdr lines)))
    (equal lines nil)))

;; NIL denotes a parallel pair.  Otherwise the returned pair is their unique
;; affine intersection, computed with the presented field operations.

(defun putnam-1973-a6-line-intersection (first second)
  (let ((first-slope (nth 0 first))
        (first-intercept (nth 1 first))
        (second-slope (nth 0 second))
        (second-intercept (nth 1 second)))
    (if (equal first-slope second-slope)
        nil
      (let ((x
             (putnam-1973-a6-mul
              (putnam-1973-a6-sub
               second-intercept first-intercept)
              (putnam-1973-a6-inv
               (putnam-1973-a6-sub
                first-slope second-slope)))))
        (list
         x
         (putnam-1973-a6-add
          (putnam-1973-a6-mul first-slope x)
          first-intercept))))))

(defun putnam-1973-a6-intersections-with-line
    (line remaining)
  (if (consp remaining)
      (let ((point
             (putnam-1973-a6-line-intersection
              line (car remaining))))
        (if point
            (cons
             point
             (putnam-1973-a6-intersections-with-line
              line (cdr remaining)))
          (putnam-1973-a6-intersections-with-line
           line (cdr remaining))))
    nil))

(defun putnam-1973-a6-pair-intersections (lines)
  (if (consp lines)
      (append
       (putnam-1973-a6-intersections-with-line
        (car lines) (cdr lines))
       (putnam-1973-a6-pair-intersections
        (cdr lines)))
    nil))

(defun putnam-1973-a6-unique-points (points seen)
  (if (consp points)
      (if (member-equal (car points) seen)
          (putnam-1973-a6-unique-points
           (cdr points) seen)
        (putnam-1973-a6-unique-points
         (cdr points) (cons (car points) seen)))
    seen))

(defun putnam-1973-a6-point-on-line-p (point line)
  (equal
   (nth 1 point)
   (putnam-1973-a6-add
    (putnam-1973-a6-mul
     (nth 0 line) (nth 0 point))
    (nth 1 line))))

(defun putnam-1973-a6-point-multiplicity (point lines)
  (if (consp lines)
      (+ (if (putnam-1973-a6-point-on-line-p
              point (car lines))
             1
           0)
         (putnam-1973-a6-point-multiplicity
          point (cdr lines)))
    0))

(defun putnam-1973-a6-count-exact-multiplicity
    (points lines multiplicity)
  (if (consp points)
      (+ (if (equal
              (putnam-1973-a6-point-multiplicity
               (car points) lines)
              multiplicity)
             1
           0)
         (putnam-1973-a6-count-exact-multiplicity
          (cdr points) lines multiplicity))
    0))

(defun putnam-1973-a6-nint (multiplicity lines)
  (putnam-1973-a6-count-exact-multiplicity
   (putnam-1973-a6-unique-points
    (putnam-1973-a6-pair-intersections lines)
    nil)
   lines
   multiplicity))

(defun putnambench-putnam-1973-a6-statement (lines)
  (implies
   (and
    (putnam-1973-a6-real-closed-field-p)
    (true-listp lines)
    (equal (len lines) 7)
    (putnam-1973-a6-line-list-p lines)
    (no-duplicatesp-equal lines))
   (not
    (and
     (<= 6 (putnam-1973-a6-nint 3 lines))
     (<= 4 (putnam-1973-a6-nint 2 lines))))))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

title: putnam_1973_a6
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1973_a6:
-- seven distinct real affine lines cannot have at least six points incident
-- to exactly three lines and four points incident to exactly two lines.
-- This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; _*_)

infix 4 _!=_
infixr 3 _and_
infixr 2 _or_

data Bottom : Set where

Not : Set -> Set
Not A =
  A -> Bottom

_!=_ : {A : Set} -> A -> A -> Set
x != y =
  Not (x == y)

record _and_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data _or_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  left  : A -> A or B
  right : B -> A or B

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

data Fin : Nat -> Set where
  fzero : {n : Nat} -> Fin (suc n)
  fsuc  : {n : Nat} -> Fin n -> Fin (suc n)

one : Nat
one =
  suc zero

two : Nat
two =
  suc one

three : Nat
three =
  suc two

four : Nat
four =
  suc three

five : Nat
five =
  suc four

six : Nat
six =
  suc five

seven : Nat
seven =
  suc six

record CompleteOrderedField (R : Set) : Set1 where
  field
    zeroR oneR : R
    add multiply : R -> R -> R
    negate inverse : R -> R
    lessOrEqual : R -> R -> Set
    fromNat : Nat -> R

    one-not-zero :
      oneR != zeroR

    add-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> add x y == add y x
    add-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      add (add x y) z == add x (add y z)
    add-zero :
      (x : R) -> add x zeroR == x
    add-inverse :
      (x : R) -> add x (negate x) == zeroR

    multiply-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> multiply x y == multiply y x
    multiply-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply (multiply x y) z ==
      multiply x (multiply y z)
    multiply-one :
      (x : R) -> multiply x oneR == x
    multiply-zero :
      (x : R) -> multiply x zeroR == zeroR
    distribute :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply x (add y z) ==
      add (multiply x y) (multiply x z)
    inverse-zero :
      inverse zeroR == zeroR
    multiply-inverse :
      (x : R) ->
      x != zeroR ->
      multiply x (inverse x) == oneR

    order-reflexive :
      (x : R) -> lessOrEqual x x
    order-transitive :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y z ->
      lessOrEqual x z
    order-antisymmetric :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y x ->
      x == y
    order-total :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y or lessOrEqual y x
    add-order :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual (add z x) (add z y)
    multiply-nonnegative :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR x ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR y ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR (multiply x y)
    zero-less-than-one :
      lessOrEqual zeroR oneR and zeroR != oneR

    fromNat-zero :
      fromNat zero == zeroR
    fromNat-successor :
      (n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (suc n) == add (fromNat n) oneR
    fromNat-addition :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m + n) == add (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-multiplication :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m * n) == multiply (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-injective :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat m == fromNat n ->
      m == n

    archimedean :
      (x : R) ->
      Exists Nat (\ n -> lessOrEqual x (fromNat n))
    least-upper-bound :
      (P : R -> Set) ->
      Exists R P ->
      Exists R
        (\ upper ->
          (x : R) ->
          P x ->
          lessOrEqual x upper) ->
      Exists R
        (\ supremum ->
          ((x : R) ->
            P x ->
            lessOrEqual x supremum)
          and
          ((upper : R) ->
            ((x : R) ->
              P x ->
              lessOrEqual x upper) ->
            lessOrEqual supremum upper))

open CompleteOrderedField

record Point (R : Set) : Set where
  constructor point
  field
    x-coordinate : R
    y-coordinate : R

record Line (R : Set) : Set where
  constructor line
  field
    slope     : R
    intercept : R

open Point
open Line

Injective :
  {A B : Set} ->
  (A -> B) ->
  Set
Injective function =
  (i j : _) ->
  function i == function j ->
  i == j

module Putnam1973A6Statement
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) where

  LineIndex : Set
  LineIndex =
    Fin seven

  Lines : Set
  Lines =
    LineIndex -> Line R

  Incident :
    Lines ->
    LineIndex ->
    Point R ->
    Set
  Incident lines i p =
    y-coordinate p ==
    add reals
      (multiply reals
        (slope (lines i))
        (x-coordinate p))
      (intercept (lines i))

  DistinctLines :
    Lines ->
    Set
  DistinctLines lines =
    (i j : LineIndex) ->
    i != j ->
    lines i != lines j

  ExactlyTwo :
    Lines ->
    Point R ->
    Set
  ExactlyTwo lines p =
    Exists LineIndex
      (\ i ->
        Exists LineIndex
          (\ j ->
            i != j
            and
            Incident lines i p
            and
            Incident lines j p
            and
            ((k : LineIndex) ->
              Incident lines k p ->
              k == i or k == j)))

  ExactlyThree :
    Lines ->
    Point R ->
    Set
  ExactlyThree lines p =
    Exists LineIndex
      (\ i ->
        Exists LineIndex
          (\ j ->
            Exists LineIndex
              (\ k ->
                i != j
                and
                i != k
                and
                j != k
                and
                Incident lines i p
                and
                Incident lines j p
                and
                Incident lines k p
                and
                ((ell : LineIndex) ->
                  Incident lines ell p ->
                  ell == i or ell == j or ell == k))))

  AtLeastSixTriplePoints :
    Lines ->
    Set
  AtLeastSixTriplePoints lines =
    Exists (Fin six -> Point R)
      (\ points ->
        Injective points
        and
        ((i : Fin six) ->
          ExactlyThree lines (points i)))

  AtLeastFourDoublePoints :
    Lines ->
    Set
  AtLeastFourDoublePoints lines =
    Exists (Fin four -> Point R)
      (\ points ->
        Injective points
        and
        ((i : Fin four) ->
          ExactlyTwo lines (points i)))

  proposition : Set
  proposition =
    Not
      (Exists Lines
        (\ lines ->
          DistinctLines lines
          and
          AtLeastSixTriplePoints lines
          and
          AtLeastFourDoublePoints lines))

(*

  the impossibility of seven distinct real plane lines having at least six
  exact triple-intersection points and four exact double-intersection points.
  This file contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open arithmeticTheory pairTheory pred_setTheory realTheory;

val putnam_1973_a6 =
  ``!nint : num -> (num -> real # real) -> num.
      nint =
        (\n (lines : num -> real # real).
           CARD
             {p : real # real |
                ?!S : num set.
                  S SUBSET count 7 /\
                  CARD S = n /\
                  !i : num.
                    i IN S ==>
                    SND p =
                      FST (lines i) * FST p + SND (lines i)})
      ==>
      ~(?lines : num -> real # real.
          (!i j : num.
             i IN count 7 /\ j IN count 7 /\ i <> j
             ==>
             lines i <> lines j) /\
          6 <= nint 3 lines /\
          4 <= nint 2 lines)``;

title: putnam_1973_a6

% Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench artifact putnam_1973_a6:
% seven distinct real lines cannot have at least six points incident with a
% unique triple of the lines and at least four points incident with a unique
% pair of the lines. This file contains no proof.

putnam_1973_a6: THEORY
BEGIN
  line_index: TYPE = below(7)
  point: TYPE = [# x_coord: real, y_coord: real #]
  line: TYPE = [# slope: real, intercept: real #]
  line_family: TYPE = [line_index -> line]
  point_set: TYPE = [point -> bool]

  IMPORTING finite_sets[line_index], finite_sets[point]

  lies_on(P: point, L: line): bool =
    y_coord(P) = slope(L) * x_coord(P) + intercept(L)

  common_point(
      P: point,
      lines: line_family,
      indices: finite_set[line_index]): bool =
    FORALL (i: line_index):
      indices(i) IMPLIES lies_on(P, lines(i))

  qualifying_subset(
      n: nat,
      P: point,
      lines: line_family,
      indices: finite_set[line_index]): bool =
    card(indices) = n
      AND common_point(P, lines, indices)

  has_unique_qualifying_subset(
      n: nat,
      P: point,
      lines: line_family): bool =
    EXISTS (indices: finite_set[line_index]):
      qualifying_subset(n, P, lines, indices)
        AND
          (FORALL (other: finite_set[line_index]):
            qualifying_subset(n, P, lines, other)
              IMPLIES other = indices)

  intersection_points(
      n: nat,
      lines: line_family): point_set =
    LAMBDA (P: point):
      has_unique_qualifying_subset(n, P, lines)

  has_at_least(
      S: point_set,
      lower_bound: nat): bool =
    EXISTS (witnesses: finite_set[point]):
      card(witnesses) >= lower_bound
        AND
          (FORALL (P: point):
            witnesses(P) IMPLIES S(P))

  distinct_lines(lines: line_family): bool =
    FORALL (i, j: line_index):
      i /= j IMPLIES lines(i) /= lines(j)

  putnam_1973_a6: bool =
    NOT EXISTS (lines: line_family):
      distinct_lines(lines)
        AND has_at_least(intersection_points(3, lines), 6)
        AND has_at_least(intersection_points(2, lines), 4)
END putnam_1973_a6

;; Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1973_b1:
;; if deleting any one of 2*n+1 indexed integers leaves values partitionable
;; into two n-element parts with equal sums, then all the integers are equal.
;; This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

;; List order represents the source index set, so repeated integer values remain
;; distinct indexed entries. The recursive search chooses every n-position
;; subsequence of a deletion; its complement is the other n-position part.

(defun putnam-1973-b1-integer-list-p (values)
  (if (consp values)
      (and
       (integerp (car values))
       (putnam-1973-b1-integer-list-p (cdr values)))
    (equal values nil)))

(defun putnam-1973-b1-sum-list (values)
  (if (consp values)
      (+ (car values)
         (putnam-1973-b1-sum-list (cdr values)))
    0))

(defun putnam-1973-b1-balanced-choice-exists-p
    (remaining needed chosen-sum total-sum)
  (declare (xargs :measure (len remaining)))
  (cond
   ((zp needed)
    (equal (* 2 chosen-sum) total-sum))
   ((endp remaining) nil)
   (t
    (or
     (putnam-1973-b1-balanced-choice-exists-p
      (cdr remaining)
      (- needed 1)
      (+ chosen-sum (car remaining))
      total-sum)
     (putnam-1973-b1-balanced-choice-exists-p
      (cdr remaining)
      needed
      chosen-sum
      total-sum)))))

(defun putnam-1973-b1-balanced-after-removal-p
    (values n)
  (putnam-1973-b1-balanced-choice-exists-p
   values n 0 (putnam-1973-b1-sum-list values)))

(defun putnam-1973-b1-every-removal-balanced-p
    (prefix-reversed remaining n)
  (declare (xargs :measure (len remaining)))
  (if (consp remaining)
      (and
       (putnam-1973-b1-balanced-after-removal-p
        (revappend prefix-reversed (cdr remaining))
        n)
       (putnam-1973-b1-every-removal-balanced-p
        (cons (car remaining) prefix-reversed)
        (cdr remaining)
        n))
    t))

(defun putnam-1973-b1-all-equal-to-p
    (value remaining)
  (if (consp remaining)
      (and
       (equal value (car remaining))
       (putnam-1973-b1-all-equal-to-p
        value (cdr remaining)))
    (equal remaining nil)))

(defun putnam-1973-b1-all-equal-p (values)
  (if (consp values)
      (putnam-1973-b1-all-equal-to-p
       (car values) (cdr values))
    (equal values nil)))

(defun putnambench-putnam-1973-b1-statement
    (n values)
  (implies
   (and
    (natp n)
    (true-listp values)
    (putnam-1973-b1-integer-list-p values)
    (equal (len values) (+ (* 2 n) 1))
    (putnam-1973-b1-every-removal-balanced-p
     nil values n))
   (putnam-1973-b1-all-equal-p values)))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

title: putnam_1973_b1
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1973_b1:
-- equal-sum partitions after removing any one of 2n+1 indexed integers force
-- all entries to be equal. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

open import Agda.Primitive using (Level; _⊔_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Int using (Int; pos; negsuc)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_)

infixr 3 _and_
infixr 2 _or_

data Bottom : Set where

record _and_
  {a b : Level}
  (A : Set a)
  (B : Set b) :
  Set (a ⊔ b) where

  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data _or_
  {a b : Level}
  (A : Set a)
  (B : Set b) :
  Set (a ⊔ b) where

  left  : A -> A or B
  right : B -> A or B

record Exists
  {a p : Level}
  (A : Set a)
  (P : A -> Set p) :
  Set (a ⊔ p) where

  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

data Fin : Nat -> Set where
  fzero : {n : Nat} -> Fin (suc n)
  fsuc  : {n : Nat} -> Fin n -> Fin (suc n)

Predicate : Set -> Set1
Predicate A =
  A -> Set

record HasCardinality
  {a p : Level}
  {A : Set a}
  (P : A -> Set p)
  (cardinality : Nat) :
  Set (a ⊔ p) where

  field
    enumerate :
      Fin cardinality ->
      A
    enumerated-member :
      (index : Fin cardinality) ->
      P (enumerate index)
    enumeration-complete :
      (x : A) ->
      P x ->
      Exists (Fin cardinality)
        (\ index -> x == enumerate index)
    enumeration-injective :
      (left-index right-index : Fin cardinality) ->
      enumerate left-index == enumerate right-index ->
      left-index == right-index

open HasCardinality

SubsetOf :
  {A : Set} ->
  Predicate A ->
  Predicate A ->
  Set
SubsetOf T S =
  (x : _) ->
  T x ->
  S x

Disjoint :
  {A : Set} ->
  Predicate A ->
  Predicate A ->
  Set
Disjoint T U =
  (x : _) ->
  T x ->
  U x ->
  Bottom

Covers :
  {A : Set} ->
  Predicate A ->
  Predicate A ->
  Predicate A ->
  Set
Covers S T U =
  (x : _) ->
  S x ->
  T x or U x

negative : Nat -> Int
negative zero =
  pos zero
negative (suc n) =
  negsuc n

difference : Nat -> Nat -> Int
difference zero zero =
  pos zero
difference (suc m) zero =
  pos (suc m)
difference zero (suc n) =
  negsuc n
difference (suc m) (suc n) =
  difference m n

addInt : Int -> Int -> Int
addInt (pos m) (pos n) =
  pos (m + n)
addInt (pos m) (negsuc n) =
  difference m (suc n)
addInt (negsuc m) (pos n) =
  difference n (suc m)
addInt (negsuc m) (negsuc n) =
  negsuc (suc (m + n))

sumFin : {n : Nat} -> (Fin n -> Int) -> Int
sumFin {zero} terms =
  pos zero
sumFin {suc n} terms =
  addInt
    (terms fzero)
    (sumFin (\ i -> terms (fsuc i)))

sumSubset :
  {A : Set} ->
  {P : Predicate A} ->
  {cardinality : Nat} ->
  (A -> Int) ->
  HasCardinality P cardinality ->
  Int
sumSubset values finite =
  sumFin (\ i -> values (enumerate finite i))

module Putnam1973B1Statement (n : Nat) where

  twiceN : Nat
  twiceN =
    n + n

  Index : Set
  Index =
    Fin (suc twiceN)

  EqualSumPartition :
    (Index -> Int) ->
    Predicate Index ->
    Set1
  EqualSumPartition values S =
    Exists (Predicate Index)
      (\ T ->
        Exists (Predicate Index)
          (\ U ->
            Exists (HasCardinality T n)
              (\ finite-T ->
                Exists (HasCardinality U n)
                  (\ finite-U ->
                    SubsetOf T S
                    and
                    SubsetOf U S
                    and
                    Disjoint T U
                    and
                    Covers S T U
                    and
                    sumSubset values finite-T ==
                    sumSubset values finite-U))))

  proposition : Set1
  proposition =
    (values : Index -> Int) ->
    ((S : Predicate Index) ->
      HasCardinality S twiceN ->
      EqualSumPartition values S) ->
    (i j : Index) ->
    values i == values j

putnam-1973-b1 : Set1
putnam-1973-b1 =
  (n : Nat) ->
  Putnam1973B1Statement.proposition n

(*

  deleting any one of 2n+1 indexed integers leaves two n-element parts with
  equal sums only if all the integers are equal. This file contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open arithmeticTheory integerTheory pred_setTheory;

val putnam_1973_b1 =
  ``!n : num. !a : num -> int.
      let indices = IMAGE SUC (count (2 * n + 1))
      in
        (!S : num set.
           S SUBSET indices /\ CARD S = 2 * n
           ==>
           ?T : num set.
             T SUBSET S /\

$(
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact
  putnam_1973_b1: an integer family of length 2n+1 is constant if every
  deletion leaves 2n entries that split into two n-entry sets of equal sum.
  This file contains no proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  The index set is the inclusive natural interval 1 ... (2n+1), and a ranges
  over all integer-valued functions on that exact finite carrier. Each S is
  an arbitrary 2n-element subset of the carrier, and its balancing n-element
  subset T remains existentially quantified inside the universal quantifier
  over S. Since T is a subset of S and both have sizes n and 2n, S \ T is
  the complementary n-element part.

  Thus the antecedent is precisely the equal-sum partition condition after
  any one indexed entry is removed, including repeated integer values at
  distinct indices. The conclusion states that all indexed entries are
  equal. The final declaration is the single unproved $a corpus statement;
  this database contains no $p proof statement.
$)

${
  $d S T a i j n $.

  putnambench-putnam-1973-b1 $a |- A. n e. NN0
    A. a e. ( ZZ ^m ( 1 ... ( ( 2 x. n ) + 1 ) ) )
      (
        (
          A. S e.
            {
              S e. ~P ( 1 ... ( ( 2 x. n ) + 1 ) ) |
                ( # ` S ) = ( 2 x. n )
            }
            E. T e. { T e. ~P S | ( # ` T ) = n }
              (
                sum_ i e. T ( a ` i )
              )
              =
              (
                sum_ i e. ( S \ T ) ( a ` i )
              )
        )
        ->
        A. i e. ( 1 ... ( ( 2 x. n ) + 1 ) )
        A. j e. ( 1 ... ( ( 2 x. n ) + 1 ) )
          ( a ` i ) = ( a ` j )
      )
  $.
$}

begin

::$P-
theorem

        len right = n &
        (for k being Nat st k in Seg n holds
          right.k = a.((Sgm (S \ T)).k)) &
        Sum left = Sum right)
  holds
    for i,j being Nat st
      i in Seg (2*n + 1) & j in Seg (2*n + 1)
    holds a.i = a.j
proof
end;
::$P+

% Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench artifact putnam_1973_b1:
% if deleting any one of 2*n+1 indexed integers leaves values that can be
% partitioned into two n-element subsets with equal sums, then all values are
% equal. This file contains no proof.

putnam_1973_b1[n: nat]: THEORY
BEGIN
  index: TYPE = below(2 * n + 1)
  integer_family: TYPE = [index -> int]

  IMPORTING finite_sets@finite_sets_sum_real[index]

  finite_subset(A, B: finite_set[index]): bool =
    FORALL (i: index):
      A(i) IMPLIES B(i)

  selected_sum(
      S: finite_set[index],
      a: integer_family): real =
    sum(S, (LAMBDA (i: index): a(i) :: real))

  complementary_sum(
      S, T: finite_set[index],
      a: integer_family): real =
    sum(
      S,
      (LAMBDA (i: index):
        IF T(i) THEN 0 ELSE (a(i) :: real) ENDIF))

  putnam_1973_b1: bool =
    FORALL (a: integer_family):
      (FORALL (S: finite_set[index]):
        card(S) = 2 * n
          IMPLIES
            EXISTS (T: finite_set[index]):
              finite_subset(T, S)
                AND card(T) = n
                AND selected_sum(T, a)
                  = complementary_sum(S, T, a))
      IMPLIES
        FORALL (i, j: index):
          a(i) = a(j)
END putnam_1973_b1
