putnam_1973_b2
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1973_b2:
;; a unit complex number with rational real and imaginary parts has rational
;; distance from 1 after every even integer power. This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

;; A pair (real-part . imaginary-part) represents a complex number whose
;; coordinates are rational.
(defun putnam-1973-b2-complexp (z)
  (and (consp z)
       (rationalp (car z))
       (rationalp (cdr z))))

(defun putnam-1973-b2-complex (real-part imaginary-part)
  (cons real-part imaginary-part))

(defun putnam-1973-b2-complex-add (z w)
  (putnam-1973-b2-complex
   (+ (car z) (car w))
   (+ (cdr z) (cdr w))))

(defun putnam-1973-b2-complex-neg (z)
  (putnam-1973-b2-complex
   (- (car z))
   (- (cdr z))))

(defun putnam-1973-b2-complex-sub (z w)
  (putnam-1973-b2-complex-add
   z
   (putnam-1973-b2-complex-neg w)))

(defun putnam-1973-b2-complex-mul (z w)
  (putnam-1973-b2-complex
   (- (* (car z) (car w))
      (* (cdr z) (cdr w)))
   (+ (* (car z) (cdr w))
      (* (cdr z) (car w)))))

(defun putnam-1973-b2-norm-squared (z)
  (+ (* (car z) (car z))
     (* (cdr z) (cdr z))))

(defun putnam-1973-b2-complex-inverse (z)
  (let ((norm-squared (putnam-1973-b2-norm-squared z)))
    (putnam-1973-b2-complex
     (/ (car z) norm-squared)
     (/ (- (cdr z)) norm-squared))))

(defun putnam-1973-b2-natural-power (z n)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix n)))
  (if (zp n)
      (putnam-1973-b2-complex 1 0)
    (putnam-1973-b2-complex-mul
     z
     (putnam-1973-b2-natural-power z (- n 1)))))

(defun putnam-1973-b2-integer-power (z n)
  (if (< n 0)
      (putnam-1973-b2-natural-power
       (putnam-1973-b2-complex-inverse z)
       (- n))
    (putnam-1973-b2-natural-power z n)))

;; For a nonnegative rational x, this finite search is true exactly when x is
;; the square of an integer no larger than candidate.
(defun putnam-1973-b2-square-witness-down-p (x candidate)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix candidate)))
  (if (zp candidate)
      (equal x 0)
    (or (equal (* candidate candidate) x)
        (putnam-1973-b2-square-witness-down-p
         x
         (- candidate 1)))))

;; A nonnegative rational is the square of a rational exactly when its reduced
;; numerator and denominator are both integer squares. Thus this predicate is
;; equivalent to the source conclusion's existential rational norm witness.
(defun putnam-1973-b2-rational-square-p (x)
  (and (rationalp x)
       (<= 0 x)
       (putnam-1973-b2-square-witness-down-p
        (numerator x)
        (numerator x))
       (putnam-1973-b2-square-witness-down-p
        (denominator x)
        (denominator x))))

(defun putnambench-putnam-1973-b2-statement (z n)
  (implies
   (and (putnam-1973-b2-complexp z)
        (equal (putnam-1973-b2-norm-squared z) 1)
        (integerp n))
   (putnam-1973-b2-rational-square-p
    (putnam-1973-b2-norm-squared
     (putnam-1973-b2-complex-sub
      (putnam-1973-b2-integer-power z (* 2 n))
      (putnam-1973-b2-complex 1 0))))))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

title: putnam_1973_b2
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1973_b2:
-- a complex number with rational coordinates and modulus one has rational
-- modulus after subtracting one from every even integer power; the equivalent
-- reciprocal-modulus formulation for natural powers is also included. This
-- file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Int using (Int; pos; negsuc)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; _*_)

infix 4 _!=_
infixr 3 _and_
infixr 2 _or_

data Bottom : Set where

Not : Set -> Set
Not A =
  A -> Bottom

_!=_ : {A : Set} -> A -> A -> Set
x != y =
  Not (x == y)

record _and_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data _or_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  left  : A -> A or B
  right : B -> A or B

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

record CompleteOrderedRealField (R : Set) : Set1 where
  field
    zeroR oneR : R
    add multiply : R -> R -> R
    negate inverse squareRoot : R -> R
    lessOrEqual : R -> R -> Set
    fromNat : Nat -> R

    one-not-zero :
      oneR != zeroR

    add-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> add x y == add y x
    add-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      add (add x y) z == add x (add y z)
    add-zero :
      (x : R) -> add x zeroR == x
    add-inverse :
      (x : R) -> add x (negate x) == zeroR

    multiply-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> multiply x y == multiply y x
    multiply-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply (multiply x y) z ==
      multiply x (multiply y z)
    multiply-one :
      (x : R) -> multiply x oneR == x
    multiply-zero :
      (x : R) -> multiply x zeroR == zeroR
    distribute :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply x (add y z) ==
      add (multiply x y) (multiply x z)
    inverse-zero :
      inverse zeroR == zeroR
    multiply-inverse :
      (x : R) ->
      x != zeroR ->
      multiply x (inverse x) == oneR

    order-reflexive :
      (x : R) -> lessOrEqual x x
    order-transitive :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y z ->
      lessOrEqual x z
    order-antisymmetric :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y x ->
      x == y
    order-total :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y or lessOrEqual y x
    add-order :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual (add z x) (add z y)
    multiply-nonnegative :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR x ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR y ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR (multiply x y)
    zero-less-than-one :
      lessOrEqual zeroR oneR and zeroR != oneR

    fromNat-zero :
      fromNat zero == zeroR
    fromNat-successor :
      (n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (suc n) == add (fromNat n) oneR
    fromNat-addition :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m + n) == add (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-multiplication :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m * n) == multiply (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-injective :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat m == fromNat n ->
      m == n

    archimedean :
      (x : R) ->
      Exists Nat (\ n -> lessOrEqual x (fromNat n))
    least-upper-bound :
      (P : R -> Set) ->
      Exists R P ->
      Exists R
        (\ upper ->
          (x : R) ->
          P x ->
          lessOrEqual x upper) ->
      Exists R
        (\ supremum ->
          ((x : R) ->
            P x ->
            lessOrEqual x supremum)
          and
          ((upper : R) ->
            ((x : R) ->
              P x ->
              lessOrEqual x upper) ->
            lessOrEqual supremum upper))

    square-root-nonnegative :
      (x : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR (squareRoot x)
    square-root-square :
      (x : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR x ->
      multiply (squareRoot x) (squareRoot x) == x
    square-root-nonpositive :
      (x : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x zeroR ->
      squareRoot x == zeroR
    square-root-unique :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR y ->
      multiply y y == x ->
      y == squareRoot x

open CompleteOrderedRealField

fromInt :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Int ->
  R
fromInt reals (pos n) =
  fromNat reals n
fromInt reals (negsuc n) =
  negate reals (fromNat reals (suc n))

divide :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
divide reals x y =
  multiply reals x (inverse reals y)

record Rational : Set where
  constructor fraction
  field
    numerator             : Int
    denominator-minus-one : Nat

open Rational

denominator : Rational -> Nat
denominator q =
  suc (denominator-minus-one q)

fromRational :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Rational ->
  R
fromRational reals q =
  divide reals
    (fromInt reals (numerator q))
    (fromNat reals (denominator q))

record Complex (R : Set) : Set where
  constructor complex
  field
    realPart      : R
    imaginaryPart : R

open Complex

complexOne :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Complex R
complexOne reals =
  complex (oneR reals) (zeroR reals)

complexAdd :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Complex R ->
  Complex R ->
  Complex R
complexAdd reals z w =
  complex
    (add reals (realPart z) (realPart w))
    (add reals (imaginaryPart z) (imaginaryPart w))

complexNegate :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Complex R ->
  Complex R
complexNegate reals z =
  complex
    (negate reals (realPart z))
    (negate reals (imaginaryPart z))

complexSubtract :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Complex R ->
  Complex R ->
  Complex R
complexSubtract reals z w =
  complexAdd reals z (complexNegate reals w)

complexMultiply :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Complex R ->
  Complex R ->
  Complex R
complexMultiply reals z w =
  complex
    (add reals
      (multiply reals (realPart z) (realPart w))
      (negate reals
        (multiply reals (imaginaryPart z) (imaginaryPart w))))
    (add reals
      (multiply reals (realPart z) (imaginaryPart w))
      (multiply reals (imaginaryPart z) (realPart w)))

complexSquaredModulus :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Complex R ->
  R
complexSquaredModulus reals z =
  add reals
    (multiply reals (realPart z) (realPart z))
    (multiply reals (imaginaryPart z) (imaginaryPart z))

complexModulus :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Complex R ->
  R
complexModulus reals z =
  squareRoot reals (complexSquaredModulus reals z)

complexInverse :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Complex R ->
  Complex R
complexInverse reals z =
  let
    reciprocalSquaredModulus =
      inverse reals (complexSquaredModulus reals z)
  in
  complex
    (multiply reals
      (realPart z)
      reciprocalSquaredModulus)
    (negate reals
      (multiply reals
        (imaginaryPart z)
        reciprocalSquaredModulus))

complexNaturalPower :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Complex R ->
  Nat ->
  Complex R
complexNaturalPower reals z zero =
  complexOne reals
complexNaturalPower reals z (suc n) =
  complexMultiply reals
    (complexNaturalPower reals z n)
    z

complexIntegerPower :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Complex R ->
  Int ->
  Complex R
complexIntegerPower reals z (pos n) =
  complexNaturalPower reals z n
complexIntegerPower reals z (negsuc n) =
  complexNaturalPower reals
    (complexInverse reals z)
    (suc n)

doubleInt : Int -> Int
doubleInt (pos n) =
  pos (n + n)
doubleInt (negsuc n) =
  negsuc (suc (n + n))

twoN : Nat
twoN =
  suc (suc zero)

module Putnam1973B2Statement
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) where

  IsRational : R -> Set
  IsRational x =
    Exists Rational
      (\ q -> x == fromRational reals q)

  HasRationalCoordinates : Complex R -> Set
  HasRationalCoordinates z =
    Exists Rational
      (\ q1 ->
        Exists Rational
          (\ q2 ->
            realPart z == fromRational reals q1
            and
            imaginaryPart z == fromRational reals q2))

  evenIntegerPowerDistance : Complex R -> Int -> R
  evenIntegerPowerDistance z n =
    complexModulus reals
      (complexSubtract reals
        (complexIntegerPower reals z (doubleInt n))
        (complexOne reals))

  reciprocalEvenNaturalPowerDistance :
    Complex R ->
    Nat ->
    R
  reciprocalEvenNaturalPowerDistance z n =
    complexModulus reals
      (complexInverse reals
        (complexSubtract reals
          (complexNaturalPower reals z (twoN * n))
          (complexOne reals)))

  proposition : Set
  proposition =
    (z : Complex R) ->
    HasRationalCoordinates z ->
    complexModulus reals z == oneR reals ->
    ((n : Int) ->
      IsRational (evenIntegerPowerDistance z n))
    and
    ((n : Nat) ->
      IsRational
        (reciprocalEvenNaturalPowerDistance z n))

putnam-1973-b2 : Set1
putnam-1973-b2 =
  (R : Set) ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) ->
  Putnam1973B2Statement.proposition reals

title: putnam_1973_b2
content:
% Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench artifact putnam_1973_b2:
% a unit complex number with rational real and imaginary parts has rational
% distance from one after every even integer power. This file contains no proof.

putnam_1973_b2: THEORY
BEGIN
  complex: TYPE = [# real_part: real, imag_part: real #]

  complex_one: complex =
    (# real_part := 1, imag_part := 0 #)

  complex_neg(z: complex): complex =
    (# real_part := -real_part(z),
       imag_part := -imag_part(z) #)

  complex_add(z, w: complex): complex =
    (# real_part := real_part(z) + real_part(w),
       imag_part := imag_part(z) + imag_part(w) #)

  complex_sub(z, w: complex): complex =
    complex_add(z, complex_neg(w))

  complex_mul(z, w: complex): complex =
    (# real_part := real_part(z) * real_part(w)
                       - imag_part(z) * imag_part(w),
       imag_part := real_part(z) * imag_part(w)
                       + imag_part(z) * real_part(w) #)

  complex_power(z: complex, exponent: nat): RECURSIVE complex =
    IF exponent = 0 THEN
      complex_one
    ELSE
      complex_mul(complex_power(z, exponent - 1), z)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE exponent

  integer_power_value(
      z: complex,
      exponent: int,
      value: complex): bool =
    (exponent >= 0
      AND EXISTS (power: nat):
        exponent = (power :: int)
          AND value = complex_power(z, power))
      OR
    (exponent < 0
      AND EXISTS (power: posnat):
        exponent = -(power :: int)
          AND complex_mul(value, complex_power(z, power))
            = complex_one)

  nonnegative_square_root(value: real): real =
    IF 0 <= value THEN
      epsilon(
        LAMBDA (root: real):
          0 <= root AND root * root = value)
    ELSE
      0
    ENDIF

  squared_modulus(z: complex): real =
    real_part(z) ^ 2 + imag_part(z) ^ 2

  complex_modulus(z: complex): real =
    nonnegative_square_root(squared_modulus(z))

  rational_coordinates(z: complex): bool =
    rational?(real_part(z)) AND rational?(imag_part(z))

  putnam_1973_b2: bool =
    FORALL (z: complex):
      (rational_coordinates(z) AND complex_modulus(z) = 1)
      IMPLIES
        FORALL (n: int):
          EXISTS (power_value: complex), (q: real):
            integer_power_value(z, 2 * n, power_value)
              AND rational?(q)
              AND complex_modulus(
                complex_sub(power_value, complex_one)) = q
END putnam_1973_b2

import Mathlib

/--
Let $p > 1$ be an integer with the property that $x^2 - x + p$ is prime for all $x$ in the range $0 < x < p$. Show there exists exactly one triple of integers $a,b,c$ satisfying $b^2 - 4ac = 1 - 4p$, $0 < a \leq c$, and $-a \leq b < a$.
-/
theorem putnam_1973_b3
(p : ℕ)
(pgt1 : p > 1)
(hprime : ∀ x ∈ Set.Ico 0 p, Nat.Prime (x^2 - x + p))
: ∃! triple : ℤ × ℤ × ℤ, let (a,b,c) := triple; b^2 - 4*a*c = 1 - 4*p ∧ 0 < a ∧ a ≤ c ∧ -a ≤ b ∧ b < a :=
sorry

From mathcomp Require Import all_algebra all_ssreflect.

Set Implicit Arguments.
Unset Strict Implicit.
Unset Printing Implicit Defensive.

Local Open Scope ring_scope.

Theorem putnam_1973_b3
    (p : nat)
    (hp : gt p 1)
    (hprime : forall x : nat, ge x 0 -> lt x p -> prime (x^2 - x + p))
    : exists! triple : int * int * int, 
      let '(a, b, c) := triple in 
      (b^2 - 4*a*c = 1 - 4 * (p%:Z) /\ 0 < a <= c /\ -a <= b < a).
Proof. Admitted.

"HOL-Computational_Algebra.Primes"

theorem putnam_1973_b3:
  fixes p :: nat
  assumes pgt1: "p > 1"
    and hprime: "\<forall>x::int\<in>{0..<p}. prime (x^2 - x + p)"
  shows "\<exists>!triple::int\<times>int\<times>int. let (a,b,c) = triple in (b^2 - 4*a*c = 1 - 4*p \<and> 0 < a \<and> a \<le> c \<and> -a \<le> b \<and> b < a)"
  sorry

end

     p > 1 /\
     (!x:num. x < p ==> prime (x EXP 2 - x + p))
     ==> ?!(a,b,c):int#int#int.
           b pow 2 - (&4:int) * a * c = &1 - &4 * &p /\
           (&0:int) < a /\

title: putnam_1973_b3
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1973_b3:
-- a prime-valued quadratic condition on the natural interval below p implies
-- existence and uniqueness of a reduced integer quadratic-form triple with
-- discriminant 1 - 4p. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Int using (Int; pos; negsuc)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; _-_; _*_)

infix 4 _<=N_ _<N_ _<=Z_ _<Z_
infixr 3 _and_
infixr 2 _or_

record _and_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data _or_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  left  : A -> A or B
  right : B -> A or B

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

record ExistsUnique (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor uniqueWitness
  field
    value      : A
    property   : P value
    uniqueness : (other : A) -> P other -> other == value

data _<=N_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set where
  zero<=N   : {n : Nat} -> zero <=N n
  suc<=sucN : {m n : Nat} -> m <=N n -> suc m <=N suc n

_<N_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set
m <N n =
  suc m <=N n

data _<=Z_ : Int -> Int -> Set where
  negative<=positive :
    {m n : Nat} ->
    negsuc m <=Z pos n
  positive<=positive :
    {m n : Nat} ->
    m <=N n ->
    pos m <=Z pos n
  negative<=negative :
    {m n : Nat} ->
    n <=N m ->
    negsuc m <=Z negsuc n

intSuccessor : Int -> Int
intSuccessor (pos n) =
  pos (suc n)
intSuccessor (negsuc zero) =
  pos zero
intSuccessor (negsuc (suc n)) =
  negsuc n

_<Z_ : Int -> Int -> Set
x <Z y =
  intSuccessor x <=Z y

negative : Nat -> Int
negative zero =
  pos zero
negative (suc n) =
  negsuc n

negateInt : Int -> Int
negateInt (pos n) =
  negative n
negateInt (negsuc n) =
  pos (suc n)

difference : Nat -> Nat -> Int
difference zero zero =
  pos zero
difference (suc m) zero =
  pos (suc m)
difference zero (suc n) =
  negsuc n
difference (suc m) (suc n) =
  difference m n

addInt : Int -> Int -> Int
addInt (pos m) (pos n) =
  pos (m + n)
addInt (pos m) (negsuc n) =
  difference m (suc n)
addInt (negsuc m) (pos n) =
  difference n (suc m)
addInt (negsuc m) (negsuc n) =
  negsuc (suc (m + n))

subtractInt : Int -> Int -> Int
subtractInt x y =
  addInt x (negateInt y)

multiplyInt : Int -> Int -> Int
multiplyInt (pos m) (pos n) =
  pos (m * n)
multiplyInt (pos m) (negsuc n) =
  negative (m * suc n)
multiplyInt (negsuc m) (pos n) =
  negative (suc m * n)
multiplyInt (negsuc m) (negsuc n) =
  pos (suc m * suc n)

squareInt : Int -> Int
squareInt x =
  multiplyInt x x

Divides : Nat -> Nat -> Set
Divides divisor number =
  Exists Nat
    (\ factor -> divisor * factor == number)

oneN : Nat
oneN =
  suc zero

twoN : Nat
twoN =
  suc oneN

Prime : Nat -> Set
Prime number =
  twoN <=N number
  and
  ((divisor : Nat) ->
    Divides divisor number ->
    divisor == oneN or divisor == number)

record Triple : Set where
  constructor triple
  field
    first-coordinate  : Int
    second-coordinate : Int
    third-coordinate  : Int

open Triple

oneZ : Int
oneZ =
  pos oneN

fourZ : Int
fourZ =
  pos (suc (suc twoN))

Positive : Int -> Set
Positive x =
  pos zero <Z x

ReducedTriple : Nat -> Triple -> Set
ReducedTriple p coefficients =
  subtractInt
    (squareInt (second-coordinate coefficients))
    (multiplyInt
      fourZ
      (multiplyInt
        (first-coordinate coefficients)
        (third-coordinate coefficients)))
  ==
  subtractInt
    oneZ
    (multiplyInt fourZ (pos p))
  and
  Positive (first-coordinate coefficients)
  and
  first-coordinate coefficients <=Z third-coordinate coefficients
  and
  negateInt (first-coordinate coefficients) <=Z
    second-coordinate coefficients
  and
  second-coordinate coefficients <Z first-coordinate coefficients

putnam-1973-b3 : Set
putnam-1973-b3 =
  (p : Nat) ->
  oneN <N p ->
  ((x : Nat) ->
    x <N p ->
    Prime (x * x - x + p)) ->
  ExistsUnique Triple (ReducedTriple p)

title: putnam_1973_b3
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench artifact putnam_1973_b3:
  a prime-valued quadratic condition determines a unique reduced integer
  binary quadratic form of discriminant 1 - 4p. This file contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open arithmeticTheory dividesTheory integerTheory pairTheory;

val putnam_1973_b3 =
  ``!p : num.
      1 < p /\
      (!x : num. x < p ==> prime (x EXP 2 - x + p))
      ==>
      ?!triple : int # int # int.
        let a = FST triple in
        let b = FST (SND triple) in
        let c = SND (SND triple) in
          b ** 2 - 4 * a * c = 1 - 4 * int_of_num p /\
          0 < a /\
          a <= c /\
          -a <= b /\
          b < a``;

title: putnam_1973_b3
content:
$(
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact
  putnam_1973_b3: a prime-producing quadratic condition determines exactly
  one reduced integer triple with discriminant 1 - 4p.
  This file contains no proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  NN0 is the class of nonnegative integers and Prime is the class of natural
  primes. Thus the restricted quantification over x below p is exactly the
  source natural-number range 0 <= x < p.

  A source triple (a,b,c) is represented by set.mm's ordered triple
  <. a , b , c >. = <. <. a , b >. , c >., hence by an element of
  ( ZZ X. ZZ ) X. ZZ. The nested projections recover a, b, and c, so the
  restricted unique existential quantifier states uniqueness of the entire
  integer triple. The final declaration is the single unproved $a corpus
  statement; this database contains no $p proof statement.
$)

${
  $d p t x $.

  putnambench-putnam-1973-b3 $a |- A. p e. NN0
    (
      (
        1 < p
        /\
        A. x e. NN0
          (
            x < p
            ->
            ( ( ( x ^ 2 ) - x ) + p ) e. Prime
          )
      )
      ->
      E! t e. ( ( ZZ X. ZZ ) X. ZZ )
        (
          (
            (
              ( 2nd ` ( 1st ` t ) ) ^ 2
            )
            -
            (
              ( 4 x. ( 1st ` ( 1st ` t ) ) )
              x.
              ( 2nd ` t )
            )
          )
          =
          ( 1 - ( 4 x. p ) )
          /\
          (
            0 < ( 1st ` ( 1st ` t ) )
            /\
            (
              ( 1st ` ( 1st ` t ) ) <_ ( 2nd ` t )
              /\
              (
                ( -u ( 1st ` ( 1st ` t ) ) )
                <_
                ( 2nd ` ( 1st ` t ) )
                /\
                ( 2nd ` ( 1st ` t ) )
                <
                ( 1st ` ( 1st ` t ) )
              )
            )
          )
        )
    )
  $.
$}

:: Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench artifact putnam_1973_b3:
:: uniqueness of a reduced integral binary quadratic form with discriminant
:: 1 - 4p under the stated prime-value hypothesis. This file contains no proof.

environ
  vocabularies NUMBERS, NAT_1, INT_1, INT_2, RELAT_1, XBOOLE_0,
    SUBSET_1, CARD_1, XCMPLX_0, XREAL_0, XXREAL_0, ORDINAL1, NEWTON,
    SQUARE_1, ARYTM_1, ARYTM_3;
  notations XBOOLE_0, SUBSET_1, ORDINAL1, CARD_1, NUMBERS, XCMPLX_0,
    XREAL_0, XXREAL_0, INT_1, INT_2, SQUARE_1, NEWTON, NAT_1, NAT_D;
  constructors REAL_1, NAT_1, NAT_D, INT_1, INT_2, SQUARE_1, NEWTON,
    NUMBERS;
  registrations XBOOLE_0, ORDINAL1, NUMBERS, XCMPLX_0, XXREAL_0,
    XREAL_0, NAT_1, INT_1, SQUARE_1, NEWTON, CARD_1;
  requirements REAL, NUMERALS, SUBSET, BOOLE, ARITHM;

begin

::$P-
theorem
  for p being Nat st
    p > 1 &
    (for x being Nat st x < p holds
      ((x |^ 2) -' x + p) is prime)
  holds
    ex a,b,c being Integer st
      b^2 - 4*a*c = 1 - 4*(p qua Integer) &
      0 < a & a <= c & -a <= b & b < a &
      (for a1,b1,c1 being Integer st
        b1^2 - 4*a1*c1 = 1 - 4*(p qua Integer) &
        0 < a1 & a1 <= c1 & -a1 <= b1 & b1 < a1
      holds
        a1 = a & b1 = b & c1 = c)
proof
end;
::$P+

title: putnam_1973_b3
content:
% Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench artifact putnam_1973_b3:
% for a natural p greater than one whose quadratic x^2 - x + p is prime for
% every natural x below p, there is a unique reduced integer triple with
% discriminant 1 - 4p. This file contains no proof.

putnam_1973_b3: THEORY
BEGIN
  integer_triple: TYPE = [# a: int, b: int, c: int #]

  nat_divides_integer(divisor: nat, value: int): bool =
    divisor > 0
      AND EXISTS (quotient: int):
        value = (divisor :: int) * quotient

  prime_integer(value: int): bool =
    value >= 2
      AND FORALL (divisor: nat):
        nat_divides_integer(divisor, value)
          IMPLIES divisor = 1 OR value = (divisor :: int)

  quadratic_value(x, p: nat): int =
    (x :: int) ^ 2 - (x :: int) + (p :: int)

  qualifying_triple(p: nat, triple: integer_triple): bool =
    b(triple) ^ 2 - 4 * a(triple) * c(triple)
        = 1 - 4 * (p :: int)
      AND 0 < a(triple)
      AND a(triple) <= c(triple)
      AND -a(triple) <= b(triple)
      AND b(triple) < a(triple)

  putnam_1973_b3: bool =
    FORALL (p: nat):
      (p > 1
        AND FORALL (x: nat):
          x < p IMPLIES prime_integer(quadratic_value(x, p)))
      IMPLIES
        EXISTS (triple: integer_triple):
          qualifying_triple(p, triple)
            AND FORALL (other: integer_triple):
              qualifying_triple(p, other) IMPLIES other = triple
END putnam_1973_b3

title: putnam_1973_b4
content:
import Mathlib

open Nat Set MeasureTheory Topology Filter

-- Note: Boosted domain to ℝ, which is fine because you can extend any such function f from [0,1] to ℝ satisfying the same properties. There may be multiple correct answers.
abbrev putnam_1973_b4_solution : ℝ → ℝ := sorry
-- (fun x => x)
/--
Suppose $f$ is a function on $[0,1]$ with continuous derivative satisfying $0 < f'(x) \leq 1$ and $f 0 = 0$. Prove that $\left[\int_0^1 f(x) dx\right]]^2 \geq \int_0^1 (f(x))^3 dx$, and find an example where equality holds.
-/
theorem putnam_1973_b4
(f : ℝ → ℝ)
(hprop : (ℝ → ℝ) → Prop)
(hprop_def : hprop = fun g => ContDiff ℝ 1 g ∧ (∀ x : ℝ, 0 < deriv g x ∧ deriv g x ≤ 1) ∧ g 0 = 0)
(hf : hprop f)
: (∫ x in Icc 0 1, f x)^2 ≥ ∫ x in Icc 0 1, (f x)^3 ∧ (hprop putnam_1973_b4_solution ∧ (∫ x in Icc 0 1, putnam_1973_b4_solution x)^2 = ∫ x in Icc 0 1, (putnam_1973_b4_solution x)^3) :=
sorry

title: putnam_1973_b4
content:
From mathcomp Require Import all_ssreflect ssrnum ssralg.
From mathcomp Require Import reals sequences topology measure lebesgue_measure lebesgue_integral normedtype derive.
From mathcomp Require Import classical_sets.
Import numFieldNormedType.Exports.

Set Implicit Arguments.
Unset Strict Implicit.
Unset Printing Implicit Defensive.

Local Open Scope ring_scope.
Local Open Scope classical_set_scope.

Variable R : realType.
Definition mu := [the measure _ _ of @lebesgue_measure R].
Definition putnam_1973_b4_solution : R -> R := fun x => x.
Theorem putnam_1973_b4
    (f : R -> R)
    (hprop : (R -> R) -> Prop := fun g => (forall x : R, differentiable g x) /\ (continuous g^`()) /\ (forall x : R, 0 < g^`() x <= 1) /\ g 0 = 0)
    (hf : hprop f)
    : (\int[mu]_(x in [set x | 0 <= x <= 1]) f x) ^+ 2 >= \int[mu]_(x in [set x | 0 <= x <= 1]) ((f x) ^+ 3) /\
      hprop putnam_1973_b4_solution /\
      (\int[mu]_(x in [set x | 0 <= x <= 1]) putnam_1973_b4_solution x) ^+ 2 =
        \int[mu]_(x in [set x | 0 <= x <= 1]) ((putnam_1973_b4_solution x) ^+ 3).
Proof. Admitted.

(* Note: There may be multiple correct answers. *)
definition putnam_1973_b4_solution :: "real \<Rightarrow> real" where "putnam_1973_b4_solution \<equiv> undefined"

theorem putnam_1973_b4:
  fixes f :: "real \<Rightarrow> real"
  and hprop :: "(real \<Rightarrow> real) \<Rightarrow> bool"
  defines "hprop \<equiv> (\<lambda>g::real\<Rightarrow>real. g C1_differentiable_on UNIV \<and> (\<forall>x::real. 0 < deriv g x \<and> deriv g x \<le> 1) \<and> g 0 = 0)"
  assumes hf: "hprop f"

(f x)^3)) \<and> (hprop putnam_1973_b4_solution \<and> ((interval_lebesgue_integral lebesgue 0 1 putnam_1973_b4_solution)^2 = interval_lebesgue_integral lebesgue 0 1 (\<lambda>x::real. (putnam_1973_b4_solution x)^3)))"

(*
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench artifact putnam_1973_b4:
  an integral inequality for a real C1 function whose derivative lies in
  (0,1], together with an equality example. This file contains no proof.
*)

let analysis_output = open_out "/dev/null";;
let analysis_formatter = Format.formatter_of_out_channel analysis_output;;
let analysis_loaded =
  Toploop.use_file analysis_formatter "Library/transc.ml";;
Format.pp_print_flush analysis_formatter ();;
close_out analysis_output;;
if not analysis_loaded then failwith "failed to load Library/transc.ml";;

let statement =
  `let admissible =
     \(g:real->real).
       ?g':real->real.
         (!x. (g diffl g' x) x) /\
         (!x e. &0 < e
                ==> ?d. &0 < d /\
                        !y. abs (y - x) < d
                            ==> abs (g' y - g' x) < e) /\
         (!x. &0 < g' x /\ g' x <= &1) /\
         g (&0) = &0 in
   let solution = \x:real. x in
   !f:real->real.
     admissible f
     ==>
     (integral(&0,&1) f) pow 2 >=
       integral(&0,&1) (\x. f x pow 3) /\
     admissible solution /\
     (integral(&0,&1) solution) pow 2 =
       integral(&0,&1) (\x. solution x pow 3)`;;

title: putnam_1973_b4
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1973_b4:
;; a continuously differentiable real function on [0,1] with f(0)=0 and
;; 0<f'(x)<=1 satisfies (integral f)^2 >= integral(f^3), with the identity
;; function attaining equality. This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))

;; The context presents a Dedekind-complete ordered field, hence the real
;; field up to ordered-field isomorphism. APPLY$ objects represent sets and
;; functions. Differentiability and derivative continuity are expanded into
;; epsilon-delta predicates. For continuous functions on [0,1], the unbounded
;; right-endpoint Riemann-sum limit below is exactly the source Lebesgue
;; integral, so no finite quadrature or rational-domain restriction is used.

(defun p73b4-member-p (carrier x)
  (if (apply$ carrier (list x)) t nil))

(defun p73b4-unary-value (operation x)
  (apply$ operation (list x)))

(defun p73b4-binary-value (operation x y)
  (apply$ operation (list x y)))

(defun-sk p73b4-valid-set-p (carrier set)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (apply$ set (list x))
     (p73b4-member-p carrier x))))

(defun-sk p73b4-real-function-p (carrier function)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (p73b4-member-p carrier x)
     (p73b4-member-p
      carrier
      (p73b4-unary-value function x)))))

(defun-sk p73b4-field-laws-p
    (carrier add multiply negate inverse zero one)
  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (p73b4-member-p carrier x)
      (p73b4-member-p carrier y)
      (p73b4-member-p carrier z))
     (and
      (p73b4-member-p
       carrier (p73b4-binary-value add x y))
      (p73b4-member-p
       carrier (p73b4-binary-value multiply x y))
      (p73b4-member-p
       carrier (p73b4-unary-value negate x))
      (implies
       (not (equal x zero))
       (p73b4-member-p
        carrier (p73b4-unary-value inverse x)))
      (equal
       (p73b4-binary-value
        add (p73b4-binary-value add x y) z)
       (p73b4-binary-value
        add x (p73b4-binary-value add y z)))
      (equal
       (p73b4-binary-value add x y)
       (p73b4-binary-value add y x))
      (equal (p73b4-binary-value add x zero) x)
      (equal
       (p73b4-binary-value
        add x (p73b4-unary-value negate x))
       zero)
      (equal
       (p73b4-binary-value
        multiply
        (p73b4-binary-value multiply x y)
        z)
       (p73b4-binary-value
        multiply
        x
        (p73b4-binary-value multiply y z)))
      (equal
       (p73b4-binary-value multiply x y)
       (p73b4-binary-value multiply y x))
      (equal
       (p73b4-binary-value multiply x one)
       x)
      (implies
       (not (equal x zero))
       (equal
        (p73b4-binary-value
         multiply x (p73b4-unary-value inverse x))
        one))
      (equal
       (p73b4-binary-value
        multiply x (p73b4-binary-value add y z))
       (p73b4-binary-value
        add
        (p73b4-binary-value multiply x y)
        (p73b4-binary-value multiply x z)))))))

(defun-sk p73b4-order-laws-p
    (carrier add multiply zero less)
  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (p73b4-member-p carrier x)
      (p73b4-member-p carrier y)
      (p73b4-member-p carrier z))
     (and
      (not (p73b4-binary-value less x x))
      (or
       (equal x y)
       (p73b4-binary-value less x y)
       (p73b4-binary-value less y x))
      (implies
       (and
        (p73b4-binary-value less x y)
        (p73b4-binary-value less y z))
       (p73b4-binary-value less x z))
      (implies
       (p73b4-binary-value less x y)
       (p73b4-binary-value
        less
        (p73b4-binary-value add x z)
        (p73b4-binary-value add y z)))
      (implies
       (and
        (p73b4-binary-value less zero x)
        (p73b4-binary-value less zero y))
       (p73b4-binary-value
        less
        zero
        (p73b4-binary-value multiply x y)))))))

(defun-sk p73b4-set-nonempty-p (carrier set)
  (exists (x)
    (and
     (p73b4-member-p carrier x)
     (apply$ set (list x)))))

(defun-sk p73b4-upper-bound-p
    (carrier less set bound)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (and
      (p73b4-member-p carrier x)
      (apply$ set (list x)))
     (not
      (p73b4-binary-value less bound x)))))

(defun-sk p73b4-bounded-above-p
    (carrier less set)
  (exists (bound)
    (and
     (p73b4-member-p carrier bound)
     (p73b4-upper-bound-p
      carrier less set bound))))

(defun-sk p73b4-supremum-p
    (carrier less set supremum)
  (forall (bound)
    (and
     (p73b4-member-p carrier supremum)
     (p73b4-upper-bound-p
      carrier less set supremum)
     (implies
      (and
       (p73b4-member-p carrier bound)
       (p73b4-upper-bound-p
        carrier less set bound))
      (not
       (p73b4-binary-value
        less bound supremum))))))

(defun-sk p73b4-has-supremum-p
    (carrier less set)
  (exists (supremum)
    (p73b4-supremum-p
     carrier less set supremum)))

(defun-sk p73b4-dedekind-complete-p
    (carrier less)
  (forall (set)
    (implies
     (and
      (tamep-functionp set)
      (p73b4-valid-set-p carrier set)
      (p73b4-set-nonempty-p carrier set)
      (p73b4-bounded-above-p carrier less set))
     (p73b4-has-supremum-p
      carrier less set))))

(defun p73b4-real-field-p
    (carrier add multiply negate inverse zero one less)
  (and
   (tamep-functionp carrier)
   (tamep-functionp add)
   (tamep-functionp multiply)
   (tamep-functionp negate)
   (tamep-functionp inverse)
   (tamep-functionp less)
   (p73b4-member-p carrier zero)
   (p73b4-member-p carrier one)
   (not (equal zero one))
   (p73b4-field-laws-p
    carrier add multiply negate inverse zero one)
   (p73b4-order-laws-p
    carrier add multiply zero less)
   (p73b4-binary-value less zero one)
   (p73b4-dedekind-complete-p carrier less)))

;; Real-field context and arithmetic.

(defun p73b4-r-carrier (ctx) (nth 0 ctx))
(defun p73b4-r-zero (ctx) (nth 1 ctx))
(defun p73b4-r-one (ctx) (nth 2 ctx))
(defun p73b4-r-add (ctx) (nth 3 ctx))
(defun p73b4-r-mul (ctx) (nth 4 ctx))
(defun p73b4-r-neg (ctx) (nth 5 ctx))
(defun p73b4-r-inv (ctx) (nth 6 ctx))
(defun p73b4-r-lt (ctx) (nth 7 ctx))

(defun p73b4-context-p (ctx)
  (and
   (true-listp ctx)
   (equal (len ctx) 8)
   (p73b4-real-field-p
    (p73b4-r-carrier ctx)
    (p73b4-r-add ctx)
    (p73b4-r-mul ctx)
    (p73b4-r-neg ctx)
    (p73b4-r-inv ctx)
    (p73b4-r-zero ctx)
    (p73b4-r-one ctx)
    (p73b4-r-lt ctx))))

(defun p73b4-r-add-value (ctx x y)
  (p73b4-binary-value (p73b4-r-add ctx) x y))

(defun p73b4-r-mul-value (ctx x y)
  (p73b4-binary-value (p73b4-r-mul ctx) x y))

(defun p73b4-r-neg-value (ctx x)
  (p73b4-unary-value (p73b4-r-neg ctx) x))

(defun p73b4-r-inv-value (ctx x)
  (p73b4-unary-value (p73b4-r-inv ctx) x))

(defun p73b4-r-sub-value (ctx x y)
  (p73b4-r-add-value
   ctx x (p73b4-r-neg-value ctx y)))

(defun p73b4-r-div-value (ctx x y)
  (p73b4-r-mul-value
   ctx x (p73b4-r-inv-value ctx y)))

(defun p73b4-r-lt-p (ctx x y)
  (if (p73b4-binary-value
       (p73b4-r-lt ctx) x y)
      t nil))

(defun p73b4-r-le-p (ctx x y)
  (not (p73b4-r-lt-p ctx y x)))

(defun p73b4-r-abs-value (ctx x)
  (if (p73b4-r-lt-p
       ctx x (p73b4-r-zero ctx))
      (p73b4-r-neg-value ctx x)
    x))

(defun p73b4-positive-real-p (ctx x)
  (and
   (p73b4-member-p (p73b4-r-carrier ctx) x)
   (p73b4-r-lt-p
    ctx (p73b4-r-zero ctx) x)))

(defun p73b4-icc-member-p (ctx x)
  (and
   (p73b4-member-p (p73b4-r-carrier ctx) x)
   (p73b4-r-le-p ctx (p73b4-r-zero ctx) x)
   (p73b4-r-le-p ctx x (p73b4-r-one ctx))))

;; Continuous differentiability on [0,1].

(defun-sk p73b4-continuity-neighborhood-p
    (ctx function x epsilon radius)
  (forall (y)
    (implies
     (and
      (p73b4-icc-member-p ctx y)
      (p73b4-r-lt-p
       ctx
       (p73b4-r-abs-value
        ctx (p73b4-r-sub-value ctx y x))
       radius))
     (p73b4-r-lt-p
      ctx
      (p73b4-r-abs-value
       ctx
       (p73b4-r-sub-value
        ctx
        (p73b4-unary-value function y)
        (p73b4-unary-value function x)))
      epsilon))))

(defun-sk p73b4-continuity-radius-exists-p
    (ctx function x epsilon)
  (exists (radius)
    (and
     (p73b4-positive-real-p ctx radius)
     (p73b4-continuity-neighborhood-p
      ctx function x epsilon radius))))

(defun-sk p73b4-continuous-at-p
    (ctx function x)
  (forall (epsilon)
    (implies
     (p73b4-positive-real-p ctx epsilon)
     (p73b4-continuity-radius-exists-p
      ctx function x epsilon))))

(defun-sk p73b4-continuous-on-icc-p
    (ctx function)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (p73b4-icc-member-p ctx x)
     (p73b4-continuous-at-p
      ctx function x))))

(defun p73b4-difference-quotient
    (ctx function x y)
  (p73b4-r-div-value
   ctx
   (p73b4-r-sub-value
    ctx
    (p73b4-unary-value function y)
    (p73b4-unary-value function x))
   (p73b4-r-sub-value ctx y x)))

(defun-sk p73b4-derivative-neighborhood-p
    (ctx function derivative x epsilon radius)
  (forall (y)
    (implies
     (and
      (p73b4-icc-member-p ctx y)
      (not (equal y x))
      (p73b4-r-lt-p
       ctx
       (p73b4-r-abs-value
        ctx (p73b4-r-sub-value ctx y x))
       radius))
     (p73b4-r-lt-p
      ctx
      (p73b4-r-abs-value
       ctx
       (p73b4-r-sub-value
        ctx
        (p73b4-difference-quotient
         ctx function x y)
        derivative))
      epsilon))))

(defun-sk p73b4-derivative-radius-exists-p
    (ctx function derivative x epsilon)
  (exists (radius)
    (and
     (p73b4-positive-real-p ctx radius)
     (p73b4-derivative-neighborhood-p
      ctx function derivative x epsilon radius))))

(defun-sk p73b4-has-derivative-at-p
    (ctx function derivative x)
  (forall (epsilon)
    (implies
     (p73b4-positive-real-p ctx epsilon)
     (p73b4-derivative-radius-exists-p
      ctx function derivative x epsilon))))

(defun-sk p73b4-derivative-correct-on-icc-p
    (ctx function derivative-function)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (p73b4-icc-member-p ctx x)
     (p73b4-has-derivative-at-p
      ctx
      function
      (p73b4-unary-value derivative-function x)
      x))))

(defun-sk p73b4-derivative-bounds-p
    (ctx derivative-function)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (p73b4-icc-member-p ctx x)
     (and
      (p73b4-r-lt-p
       ctx
       (p73b4-r-zero ctx)
       (p73b4-unary-value derivative-function x))
      (p73b4-r-le-p
       ctx
       (p73b4-unary-value derivative-function x)
       (p73b4-r-one ctx))))))

(defun-sk p73b4-admissible-p (ctx function)
  (exists (derivative-function)
    (and
     (tamep-functionp derivative-function)
     (p73b4-real-function-p
      (p73b4-r-carrier ctx)
      derivative-function)
     (p73b4-continuous-on-icc-p
      ctx derivative-function)
     (p73b4-derivative-correct-on-icc-p
      ctx function derivative-function)
     (p73b4-derivative-bounds-p
      ctx derivative-function)
     (equal
      (p73b4-unary-value
       function (p73b4-r-zero ctx))
      (p73b4-r-zero ctx)))))

;; Riemann-sum presentation of the interval Lebesgue integrals.

(defun p73b4-nat-cast (ctx n)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix n)))
  (if (zp n)
      (p73b4-r-zero ctx)
    (p73b4-r-add-value
     ctx
     (p73b4-r-one ctx)
     (p73b4-nat-cast ctx (- n 1)))))

(defun p73b4-integrand-value
    (ctx function cube-p x)
  (let ((value (p73b4-unary-value function x)))
    (if cube-p
        (p73b4-r-mul-value
         ctx
         value
         (p73b4-r-mul-value ctx value value))
      value)))

(defun p73b4-riemann-sum
    (ctx function cube-p subdivisions remaining)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix remaining)))
  (if (zp remaining)
      (p73b4-r-zero ctx)
    (let* ((denominator
            (p73b4-nat-cast ctx subdivisions))
           (numerator
            (p73b4-nat-cast ctx remaining))
           (point
            (p73b4-r-div-value
             ctx numerator denominator)))
      (p73b4-r-add-value
       ctx
       (p73b4-integrand-value
        ctx function cube-p point)
       (p73b4-riemann-sum
        ctx function cube-p subdivisions
        (- remaining 1))))))

(defun p73b4-integral-approx
    (ctx function cube-p subdivisions)
  (if (posp subdivisions)
      (p73b4-r-div-value
       ctx
       (p73b4-riemann-sum
        ctx function cube-p subdivisions subdivisions)
       (p73b4-nat-cast ctx subdivisions))
    (p73b4-r-zero ctx)))

(defun-sk p73b4-integral-tail-p
    (ctx function cube-p value epsilon cutoff)
  (forall (subdivisions)
    (implies
     (and
      (posp subdivisions)
      (<= cutoff subdivisions))
     (p73b4-r-lt-p
      ctx
      (p73b4-r-abs-value
       ctx
       (p73b4-r-sub-value
        ctx
        (p73b4-integral-approx
         ctx function cube-p subdivisions)
        value))
      epsilon))))

(defun-sk p73b4-integral-cutoff-exists-p
    (ctx function cube-p value epsilon)
  (exists (cutoff)
    (and
     (posp cutoff)
     (p73b4-integral-tail-p
      ctx function cube-p value epsilon cutoff))))

(defun-sk p73b4-integral-converges-to-p
    (ctx function cube-p value)
  (forall (epsilon)
    (implies
     (p73b4-positive-real-p ctx epsilon)
     (p73b4-integral-cutoff-exists-p
      ctx function cube-p value epsilon))))

(defun p73b4-integral-value-p
    (ctx function cube-p value)
  (and
   (p73b4-member-p (p73b4-r-carrier ctx) value)
   (p73b4-integral-converges-to-p
    ctx function cube-p value)))

(defun-sk p73b4-inequality-witnesses-exist-p
    (ctx function)
  (exists (integral-f integral-cube)
    (and
     (p73b4-integral-value-p
      ctx function nil integral-f)
     (p73b4-integral-value-p
      ctx function t integral-cube)
     (p73b4-r-le-p
      ctx
      integral-cube
      (p73b4-r-mul-value
       ctx integral-f integral-f)))))

;; The identity function is the requested equality case.

(defun p73b4-identity-function ()
  (list 'lambda '(x) 'x))

(defun-sk p73b4-identity-equality-witnesses-exist-p
    (ctx)
  (exists (integral-identity integral-cube)
    (and
     (p73b4-integral-value-p
      ctx
      (p73b4-identity-function)
      nil
      integral-identity)
     (p73b4-integral-value-p
      ctx
      (p73b4-identity-function)
      t
      integral-cube)
     (equal
      (p73b4-r-mul-value
       ctx integral-identity integral-identity)
      integral-cube))))

(defun putnambench-putnam-1973-b4-statement
    (ctx function)
  (implies
   (and
    (p73b4-context-p ctx)
    (tamep-functionp function)
    (p73b4-real-function-p
     (p73b4-r-carrier ctx) function)
    (p73b4-admissible-p ctx function))
   (and
    (p73b4-inequality-witnesses-exist-p
     ctx function)
    (tamep-functionp
     (p73b4-identity-function))
    (p73b4-real-function-p
     (p73b4-r-carrier ctx)
     (p73b4-identity-function))
    (p73b4-admissible-p
     ctx (p73b4-identity-function))
    (p73b4-identity-equality-witnesses-exist-p
     ctx))))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

title: putnam_1973_b4
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1973_b4:
-- the unit-interval integral inequality for C1 real functions whose derivative
-- lies in (0, 1], together with the identity-function equality case. This file
-- contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; _*_)

infix 4 _!=_ _<=N_
infixr 3 _and_
infixr 2 _or_

data Bottom : Set where

Not : Set -> Set
Not A =
  A -> Bottom

_!=_ : {A : Set} -> A -> A -> Set
x != y =
  Not (x == y)

record _and_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data _or_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  left  : A -> A or B
  right : B -> A or B

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

data _<=N_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set where
  zero<=   : {n : Nat} -> zero <=N n
  suc<=suc : {m n : Nat} -> m <=N n -> suc m <=N suc n

record CompleteOrderedField (R : Set) : Set1 where
  field
    zeroR oneR : R
    add multiply : R -> R -> R
    negate inverse : R -> R
    lessOrEqual : R -> R -> Set
    fromNat : Nat -> R

    one-not-zero :
      oneR != zeroR

    add-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> add x y == add y x
    add-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      add (add x y) z == add x (add y z)
    add-zero :
      (x : R) -> add x zeroR == x
    add-inverse :
      (x : R) -> add x (negate x) == zeroR

    multiply-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> multiply x y == multiply y x
    multiply-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply (multiply x y) z ==
      multiply x (multiply y z)
    multiply-one :
      (x : R) -> multiply x oneR == x
    multiply-zero :
      (x : R) -> multiply x zeroR == zeroR
    distribute :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply x (add y z) ==
      add (multiply x y) (multiply x z)
    inverse-zero :
      inverse zeroR == zeroR
    multiply-inverse :
      (x : R) ->
      x != zeroR ->
      multiply x (inverse x) == oneR

    order-reflexive :
      (x : R) -> lessOrEqual x x
    order-transitive :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y z ->
      lessOrEqual x z
    order-antisymmetric :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y x ->
      x == y
    order-total :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y or lessOrEqual y x
    add-order :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual (add z x) (add z y)
    multiply-nonnegative :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR x ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR y ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR (multiply x y)
    zero-less-than-one :
      lessOrEqual zeroR oneR and zeroR != oneR

    fromNat-zero :
      fromNat zero == zeroR
    fromNat-successor :
      (n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (suc n) == add (fromNat n) oneR
    fromNat-addition :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m + n) == add (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-multiplication :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m * n) == multiply (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-injective :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat m == fromNat n ->
      m == n

    archimedean :
      (x : R) ->
      Exists Nat (\ n -> lessOrEqual x (fromNat n))
    least-upper-bound :
      (P : R -> Set) ->
      Exists R P ->
      Exists R
        (\ upper ->
          (x : R) ->
          P x ->
          lessOrEqual x upper) ->
      Exists R
        (\ supremum ->
          ((x : R) ->
            P x ->
            lessOrEqual x supremum)
          and
          ((upper : R) ->
            ((x : R) ->
              P x ->
              lessOrEqual x upper) ->
            lessOrEqual supremum upper))

open CompleteOrderedField

subtract :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
subtract reals x y =
  add reals x (negate reals y)

divide :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
divide reals x y =
  multiply reals x (inverse reals y)

StrictLess :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
StrictLess reals x y =
  lessOrEqual reals x y and x != y

CloseTo :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
CloseTo reals center radius x =
  StrictLess reals
    (subtract reals center radius)
    x
  and
  StrictLess reals
    x
    (add reals center radius)

ContinuousAt :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  (R -> R) ->
  R ->
  Set
ContinuousAt {R} reals function point =
  (epsilon : R) ->
  StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) epsilon ->
  Exists R
    (\ delta ->
      StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) delta
      and
      ((x : R) ->
        CloseTo reals point delta x ->
        CloseTo reals
          (function point)
          epsilon
          (function x)))

Continuous :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  (R -> R) ->
  Set
Continuous {R} reals function =
  (point : R) ->
  ContinuousAt reals function point

differenceQuotient :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  (R -> R) ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
differenceQuotient reals function point x =
  divide reals
    (subtract reals (function x) (function point))
    (subtract reals x point)

DerivativeAt :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  (R -> R) ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
DerivativeAt {R} reals function point derivative =
  (epsilon : R) ->
  StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) epsilon ->
  Exists R
    (\ delta ->
      StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) delta
      and
      ((x : R) ->
        CloseTo reals point delta x ->
        x != point ->
        CloseTo reals derivative epsilon
          (differenceQuotient reals function point x)))

record AdmissibleFunction
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R)
  (function : R -> R) :
  Set where

  field
    derivative : R -> R

    derivative-correct :
      (x : R) ->
      DerivativeAt reals function x (derivative x)

    derivative-continuous :
      Continuous reals derivative

    derivative-positive :
      (x : R) ->
      StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) (derivative x)

    derivative-at-most-one :
      (x : R) ->
      lessOrEqual reals (derivative x) (oneR reals)

    value-at-zero :
      function (zeroR reals) == zeroR reals

naturalPower :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  Nat ->
  R
naturalPower reals x zero =
  oneR reals
naturalPower reals x (suc n) =
  multiply reals
    (naturalPower reals x n)
    x

sumFirst :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  Nat ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  R
sumFirst reals zero terms =
  zeroR reals
sumFirst reals (suc n) terms =
  add reals
    (sumFirst reals n terms)
    (terms n)

SequentialLimit :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  R ->
  Set
SequentialLimit {R} reals sequence limit =
  (epsilon : R) ->
  StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) epsilon ->
  Exists Nat
    (\ cutoff ->
      (n : Nat) ->
      cutoff <=N n ->
      CloseTo reals limit epsilon (sequence n))

Between :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
Between reals lower upper x =
  lessOrEqual reals lower x
  and
  lessOrEqual reals x upper

ContinuousOnInterval :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  (R -> R) ->
  Set
ContinuousOnInterval {R} reals lower upper function =
  (point : R) ->
  Between reals lower upper point ->
  (epsilon : R) ->
  StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) epsilon ->
  Exists R
    (\ delta ->
      StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) delta
      and
      ((x : R) ->
        Between reals lower upper x ->
        CloseTo reals point delta x ->
        CloseTo reals
          (function point)
          epsilon
          (function x)))

rightRiemannSum :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  (R -> R) ->
  Nat ->
  R
rightRiemannSum reals lower upper function pieces =
  let
    step =
      divide reals
        (subtract reals upper lower)
        (fromNat reals pieces)
  in
  sumFirst reals pieces
    (\ i ->
      multiply reals
        (function
          (add reals lower
            (multiply reals
              (fromNat reals (suc i))
              step)))
        step)

IntervalIntegralValue :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  (R -> R) ->
  R ->
  Set
IntervalIntegralValue reals lower upper function value =
  SequentialLimit reals
    (\ n ->
      rightRiemannSum reals
        lower
        upper
        function
        (suc n))
    value

record StandardIntervalIntegration
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) :
  Set1 where

  field
    intervalIntegral :
      R ->
      R ->
      (R -> R) ->
      R

    integral-of-continuous :
      (lower upper : R) ->
      (function : R -> R) ->
      lessOrEqual reals lower upper ->
      ContinuousOnInterval reals lower upper function ->
      IntervalIntegralValue reals
        lower
        upper
        function
        (intervalIntegral lower upper function)

open StandardIntervalIntegration

identityFunction :
  {R : Set} ->
  R ->
  R
identityFunction x =
  x

cubeFunction :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  (R -> R) ->
  R ->
  R
cubeFunction reals function x =
  naturalPower reals (function x) (suc (suc (suc zero)))

integralSquare :
  {R : Set} ->
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R} ->
  StandardIntervalIntegration reals ->
  (R -> R) ->
  R
integralSquare {reals = reals} integration function =
  naturalPower reals
    (intervalIntegral integration
      (zeroR reals)
      (oneR reals)
      function)
    (suc (suc zero))

integralCube :
  {R : Set} ->
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R} ->
  StandardIntervalIntegration reals ->
  (R -> R) ->
  R
integralCube {reals = reals} integration function =
  intervalIntegral integration
    (zeroR reals)
    (oneR reals)
    (cubeFunction reals function)

putnam-1973-b4 : Set1
putnam-1973-b4 =
  (R : Set) ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) ->
  (integration : StandardIntervalIntegration reals) ->
  (f : R -> R) ->
  AdmissibleFunction reals f ->
  lessOrEqual reals
    (integralCube integration f)
    (integralSquare integration f)
  and
  (AdmissibleFunction reals identityFunction
  and
  integralSquare integration identityFunction ==
  integralCube integration identityFunction)

(*
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench artifact putnam_1973_b4:
  the integral inequality for globally continuously differentiable real
  functions with derivative in (0,1], together with an equality example.
  This file contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open pred_setTheory realTheory real_topologyTheory limTheory integrationTheory;

val putnam_1973_b4 =
  ``let hprop =
      \g : real -> real.
        (!x : real. higher_differentiable 1 g x) /\
        (\x : real. diffn 1 g x) continuous_on UNIV /\
        (!x : real. 0 < diffn 1 g x /\ diffn 1 g x <= 1) /\
        g 0 = 0
    in
      let solution = \x : real. x
      in
        !f : real -> real.
          hprop f
          ==>
          integration$integral (interval [0, 1])
            (\x : real. f x pow 3) <=
            (integration$integral (interval [0, 1]) f) pow 2 /\
          hprop solution /\
          (integration$integral (interval [0, 1]) solution) pow 2 =
            integration$integral (interval [0, 1])
              (\x : real. solution x pow 3)``;

  P73B4Solution is the identity function, the equality example specified by

  admissible equality example, and exact equality required by the sources.

  The final declaration is the single unproved $a corpus statement; this

${

title: putnam_1973_b4
content:
% Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench artifact putnam_1973_b4:
% an integral inequality for real C1 functions with derivative in (0, 1],
% together with the identity function as an equality case. This file contains no proof.

putnam_1973_b4: THEORY
BEGIN
  real_function: TYPE = [real -> real]
  real_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> real]

  continuous(f: real_function): bool =
    FORALL (x: real), (epsilon_value: posreal):
      EXISTS (delta: posreal):
        FORALL (y: real):
          abs(y - x) < delta IMPLIES
            abs(f(y) - f(x)) < epsilon_value

  has_derivative_at(
      f: real_function,
      derivative, x: real): bool =
    FORALL (epsilon_value: posreal):
      EXISTS (delta: posreal):
        FORALL (h: real):
          (NOT (h = 0) AND abs(h) < delta)
            IMPLIES
              abs(
                f(x + h) - f(x)
                  - derivative * h)
                < epsilon_value * abs(h)

  differentiable_at(f: real_function, x: real): bool =
    EXISTS (derivative: real):
      has_derivative_at(f, derivative, x)

  derivative_value(f: real_function, x: real): real =
    IF differentiable_at(f, x) THEN
      epsilon(
        LAMBDA (derivative: real):
          has_derivative_at(f, derivative, x))
    ELSE
      0
    ENDIF

  derivative_function(f: real_function): real_function =
    LAMBDA (x: real): derivative_value(f, x)

  continuously_differentiable(f: real_function): bool =
    (FORALL (x: real): differentiable_at(f, x))
      AND continuous(derivative_function(f))

  admissible(f: real_function): bool =
    continuously_differentiable(f)
      AND (FORALL (x: real):
        0 < derivative_value(f, x)
          AND derivative_value(f, x) <= 1)
      AND f(0) = 0

  valid_partition(
      points: real_sequence,
      count: nat): bool =
    count > 0
      AND points(0) = 0
      AND points(count) = 1
      AND FORALL (index: nat):
        index < count IMPLIES
          points(index) < points(index + 1)

  valid_tags(
      points, tags: real_sequence,
      count: nat): bool =
    FORALL (index: nat):
      index < count IMPLIES
        points(index) <= tags(index)
          AND tags(index) <= points(index + 1)

  mesh_less_than(
      points: real_sequence,
      count: nat,
      bound: real): bool =
    FORALL (index: nat):
      index < count IMPLIES
        points(index + 1) - points(index) < bound

  riemann_sum(
      f: real_function,
      points, tags: real_sequence,
      count: nat): RECURSIVE real =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      riemann_sum(f, points, tags, count - 1)
        + f(tags(count - 1))
            * (points(count) - points(count - 1))
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  has_unit_interval_integral(
      f: real_function,
      integral_value: real): bool =
    FORALL (epsilon_value: posreal):
      EXISTS (mesh_bound: posreal):
        FORALL
            (points, tags: real_sequence),
            (count: nat):
          (valid_partition(points, count)
            AND valid_tags(points, tags, count)
            AND mesh_less_than(points, count, mesh_bound))
          IMPLIES
            abs(
              riemann_sum(f, points, tags, count)
                - integral_value)
              < epsilon_value

  unit_interval_integral(f: real_function): real =
    IF EXISTS (integral_value: real):
        has_unit_interval_integral(f, integral_value)
    THEN
      epsilon(
        LAMBDA (integral_value: real):
          has_unit_interval_integral(
            f, integral_value))
    ELSE
      0
    ENDIF

  cubed(f: real_function): real_function =
    LAMBDA (x: real): f(x) ^ 3

  putnam_1973_b4_solution: real_function =
    LAMBDA (x: real): x

  putnam_1973_b4: bool =
    FORALL (f: real_function):
      admissible(f)
      IMPLIES
        unit_interval_integral(f) ^ 2
            >= unit_interval_integral(cubed(f))
          AND admissible(putnam_1973_b4_solution)
          AND unit_interval_integral(
                putnam_1973_b4_solution) ^ 2
              = unit_interval_integral(
                  cubed(putnam_1973_b4_solution))
END putnam_1973_b4

Theorem putnam_1974_a1
    (conspiratorial : set int -> Prop := fun A => forall a b c : int, (a \in A) -> (b \in A) -> (c \in A) -> (a > 0) -> (b > 0) -> (c > 0) -> (a <> b) -> (b <> c) -> (c <> a) -> (~ coprimez a b \/ ~ coprimez b c \/ ~ coprimez c a))
    : (forall A : set int,

      exists A : set int,

        conspiratorial A /\
        A #= [set : 'I_(putnam_1974_a1_solution)].

title: putnam_1974_a1
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench artifact putnam_1974_a1:
;; 11 is the largest cardinality of a subset of the integers 1 through 16
;; containing no three distinct pairwise relatively prime elements.
;; This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

;; A subset of {1,...,16} is represented by its 16-bit characteristic
;; number. This is a bijection with all source subsets, so the exhaustive
;; searches below preserve both the internal existential witness and the
;; universal maximality assertion.

(defun putnam-1974-a1-selected-p (subset-code element)
  (and
   (natp subset-code)
   (posp element)
   (equal
    (mod
     (floor subset-code
            (expt 2 (- element 1)))
     2)
    1)))

(defun putnam-1974-a1-gcd (a b)
  (declare (xargs :measure (+ (nfix a) (nfix b))))
  (if (and (natp a) (natp b))
      (cond
       ((equal a 0) b)
       ((equal b 0) a)
       ((< a b)
        (putnam-1974-a1-gcd a (- b a)))
       (t
        (putnam-1974-a1-gcd (- a b) b)))
    0))

(defun putnam-1974-a1-triple-condition-p
    (subset-code a b c)
  (or
   (not
    (and
     (putnam-1974-a1-selected-p subset-code a)
     (putnam-1974-a1-selected-p subset-code b)
     (putnam-1974-a1-selected-p subset-code c)
     (not (equal a b))
     (not (equal b c))
     (not (equal a c))))
   (< 1 (putnam-1974-a1-gcd a b))
   (< 1 (putnam-1974-a1-gcd b c))
   (< 1 (putnam-1974-a1-gcd a c))))

(defun putnam-1974-a1-all-c-p
    (subset-code a b c)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix c)))
  (if (zp c)
      t
    (and
     (putnam-1974-a1-triple-condition-p
      subset-code a b c)
     (putnam-1974-a1-all-c-p
      subset-code a b (- c 1)))))

(defun putnam-1974-a1-all-b-p
    (subset-code a b)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix b)))
  (if (zp b)
      t
    (and
     (putnam-1974-a1-all-c-p
      subset-code a b 16)
     (putnam-1974-a1-all-b-p
      subset-code a (- b 1)))))

(defun putnam-1974-a1-conspiratorial-p
    (subset-code a)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix a)))
  (if (zp a)
      t
    (and
     (putnam-1974-a1-all-b-p
      subset-code a 16)
     (putnam-1974-a1-conspiratorial-p
      subset-code (- a 1)))))

(defun putnam-1974-a1-cardinality-through
    (subset-code element)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix element)))
  (if (zp element)
      0
    (+
     (if
         (putnam-1974-a1-selected-p
          subset-code element)
         1
       0)
     (putnam-1974-a1-cardinality-through
      subset-code (- element 1)))))

(defun putnam-1974-a1-valid-subset-code-p
    (subset-code)
  (and
   (natp subset-code)
   (< subset-code (expt 2 16))
   (putnam-1974-a1-conspiratorial-p
    subset-code 16)))

(defun putnam-1974-a1-size-11-exists-p
    (candidate-count)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix candidate-count)))
  (if (zp candidate-count)
      nil
    (let ((subset-code (- candidate-count 1)))
      (or
       (and
        (putnam-1974-a1-valid-subset-code-p
         subset-code)
        (equal
         (putnam-1974-a1-cardinality-through
          subset-code 16)
         11))
       (putnam-1974-a1-size-11-exists-p
        subset-code)))))

(defun putnam-1974-a1-all-sizes-at-most-11-p
    (candidate-count)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix candidate-count)))
  (if (zp candidate-count)
      t
    (let ((subset-code (- candidate-count 1)))
      (and
       (or
        (not
         (putnam-1974-a1-valid-subset-code-p
          subset-code))
        (<=
         (putnam-1974-a1-cardinality-through
          subset-code 16)
         11))
       (putnam-1974-a1-all-sizes-at-most-11-p
        subset-code)))))

(defun putnambench-putnam-1974-a1-statement ()
  (let ((subset-count (expt 2 16)))
    (and
     (putnam-1974-a1-size-11-exists-p
      subset-count)
     (putnam-1974-a1-all-sizes-at-most-11-p
      subset-count))))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

gcdWithFuel (suc fuel) a (suc b) =
  gcdWithFuel fuel (suc b) (naturalMod a (suc b))

naturalGCD : Nat -> Nat -> Nat
naturalGCD a b =
  gcdWithFuel (suc (a + b)) a b

HasCommonFactor : Int -> Int -> Set
HasCommonFactor x y =
  two <=N naturalGCD (absInt x) (absInt y)

Subset : {A : Set} -> (A -> Set) -> (A -> Set) -> Set
Subset S T =
  (x : _) -> S x -> T x

InOneThroughSixteen : Int -> Set
InOneThroughSixteen x =
  Exists Nat
    (\ n ->
      n <=N fifteen
      and
      x == pos (suc n))

PairwiseDistinct : Int -> Int -> Int -> Set
PairwiseDistinct a b c =
  a != b
  and
  b != c
  and
  a != c

Conspiratorial : (Int -> Set) -> Set
Conspiratorial S =
  (a b c : Int) ->
  S a ->
  S b ->
  S c ->
  PairwiseDistinct a b c ->
  HasCommonFactor a b
  or
  HasCommonFactor b c
  or
  HasCommonFactor a c

record HasCardinality
  {A : Set}
  (S : A -> Set)
  (cardinality : Nat) :
  Set where

  field
    enumerate :
      Fin cardinality ->
      A
    enumerated-member :
      (index : Fin cardinality) ->
      S (enumerate index)
    enumeration-complete :
      (x : A) ->
      S x ->
      Exists (Fin cardinality)
        (\ index -> x == enumerate index)
    enumeration-injective :
      (left-index right-index : Fin cardinality) ->
      enumerate left-index == enumerate right-index ->
      left-index == right-index

record MaximumConspiratorialCardinality
  (maximum : Nat) :
  Set1 where

  field
    maximizing-set :
      Int -> Set
    maximizing-subset :
      Subset maximizing-set InOneThroughSixteen
    maximizing-conspiratorial :
      Conspiratorial maximizing-set
    maximizing-cardinality :
      HasCardinality maximizing-set maximum
    upper-bound :
      (S : Int -> Set) ->
      (cardinality : Nat) ->
      Subset S InOneThroughSixteen ->
      Conspiratorial S ->
      HasCardinality S cardinality ->
      cardinality <=N maximum

putnam-1974-a1 : Set1
putnam-1974-a1 =
  MaximumConspiratorialCardinality eleven

(*
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench artifact putnam_1974_a1:
  the maximum size, namely 11, of a subset of the integers from 1 through 16
  containing no three distinct pairwise relatively prime elements. This file
  contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open arithmeticTheory gcdTheory integerTheory pred_setTheory;

val putnam_1974_a1 =
  ``let conspiratorial =
      \S : int set.
        !a b c : int.
          a IN S /\ b IN S /\ c IN S
          ==>
          0 < a /\ 0 < b /\ 0 < c /\
          ((a <> b /\ b <> c /\ a <> c)
           ==>
           1 < gcd (Num (ABS a)) (Num (ABS b)) \/
           1 < gcd (Num (ABS b)) (Num (ABS c)) \/
           1 < gcd (Num (ABS a)) (Num (ABS c)))
    in
      (?S : int set.
         FINITE S /\
         S SUBSET {x : int | 1 <= x /\ x <= 16} /\
         conspiratorial S /\
         CARD S = 11) /\
      (!S : int set.
         FINITE S /\
         S SUBSET {x : int | 1 <= x /\ x <= 16} /\
         conspiratorial S
         ==>
         CARD S <= 11)``;

% Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench artifact putnam_1974_a1:
% the largest cardinality of a subset of the integers from 1 through 16 in
% which every three distinct elements contain a non-coprime pair is 11. This
% file contains no proof.

putnam_1974_a1: THEORY
BEGIN
  IMPORTING finite_sets[int]

  integer_divides(divisor, value: int): bool =
    EXISTS (quotient: int):
      value = divisor * quotient

  have_common_divisor_greater_than_one(left, right: int): bool =
    EXISTS (divisor: int):
      divisor > 1
        AND integer_divides(divisor, left)
        AND integer_divides(divisor, right)

  conspiratorial(S: finite_set[int]): bool =
    FORALL (a, b, c: int):
      S(a) AND S(b) AND S(c)
        AND a /= b AND b /= c AND a /= c
      IMPLIES
        have_common_divisor_greater_than_one(a, b)
          OR have_common_divisor_greater_than_one(b, c)
          OR have_common_divisor_greater_than_one(a, c)

  contained_in_one_through_sixteen(S: finite_set[int]): bool =
    FORALL (value: int):
      S(value) IMPLIES 1 <= value AND value <= 16

  putnam_1974_a1_solution: nat = 11

  putnam_1974_a1: bool =
    (EXISTS (S: finite_set[int]):
      contained_in_one_through_sixteen(S)
        AND conspiratorial(S)
        AND card(S) = putnam_1974_a1_solution)
      AND
        (FORALL (S: finite_set[int]):
          contained_in_one_through_sixteen(S)
            AND conspiratorial(S)
          IMPLIES card(S) <= putnam_1974_a1_solution)
END putnam_1974_a1

import Mathlib

open Set

abbrev putnam_1974_a3_solution : (Set ℕ) × (Set ℕ) := sorry
-- ({p : ℕ | p.Prime ∧ p ≡ 1 [MOD 8]}, {p : ℕ | p.Prime ∧ p ≡ 5 [MOD 8]})
/--
A well-known theorem asserts that a prime $p > 2$ can be written as the sum of two perfect squres if and only if $p \equiv 1 \bmod 4$. Find which primes $p > 2$ can be written in each of the following forms, using (not necessarily positive) integers $x$ and $y$: (a) $x^2 + 16y^2$, (b) $4x^2 + 4xy + 5y^2$.
-/
theorem putnam_1974_a3
(assmption : ∀ p : ℕ, p.Prime ∧ p > 2 → ((∃ m n : ℤ, p = m^2 + n^2) ↔ p ≡ 1 [MOD 4]))
: ∀ p : ℕ, ((p.Prime ∧ p > 2 ∧ (∃ x y : ℤ, p = x^2 + 16*y^2)) ↔ p ∈ putnam_1974_a3_solution.1) ∧ ((p.Prime ∧ p > 2 ∧ (∃ x y : ℤ, p = 4*x^2 + 4*x*y + 5*y^2)) ↔ p ∈ putnam_1974_a3_solution.2) :=
sorry

Local Open Scope classical_set_scope.

Definition putnam_1974_a3_solution : (set nat) * (set nat) := ([set p : nat | prime p /\ p = 1 %[mod 8]], [set p : nat | prime p /\ p = 5 %[mod 8]]).
Theorem putnam_1974_a3

        ((prime p /\ gt p 2 /\ (exists x y : int, p%:Z = 4 * x ^+ 2 + 4 * x * y + 5 * y ^+ 2)) <-> p \in snd putnam_1974_a3_solution).

;; Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1974_a3:
;; primes represented by x^2 + 16*y^2 and by 4*x^2 + 4*x*y + 5*y^2 are
;; classified by their residue modulo 8. This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(defun putnam-1974-a3-no-divisor-from-p (n d)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix (- n d))))
  (if (and (natp n)
           (natp d)
           (<= 2 d)
           (< d n))
      (and
       (not (equal (mod n d) 0))
       (putnam-1974-a3-no-divisor-from-p n (+ d 1)))
    t))

(defun putnam-1974-a3-primep (n)
  (and
   (natp n)
   (< 1 n)
   (putnam-1974-a3-no-divisor-from-p n 2)))

;; These predicates retain the source's unrestricted integer witnesses.
(defun-sk putnam-1974-a3-sum-two-squares-p (p)
  (exists (m n)
    (and
     (integerp m)
     (integerp n)
     (equal p
            (+ (* m m)
               (* n n))))))

(defun-sk putnam-1974-a3-form-a-representable-p (p)
  (exists (x y)
    (and
     (integerp x)
     (integerp y)
     (equal p
            (+ (* x x)
               (* 16 y y))))))

(defun-sk putnam-1974-a3-form-b-representable-p (p)
  (exists (x y)
    (and
     (integerp x)
     (integerp y)
     (equal p
            (+ (* 4 x x)
               (* 4 x y)
               (* 5 y y))))))

;; This is the supplied sum-of-two-squares theorem, universally quantified
;; over the same natural-number domain as in the source.
(defun-sk putnam-1974-a3-sum-two-squares-assumption-p ()
  (forall (p)
    (implies
     (natp p)
     (implies
      (and
       (putnam-1974-a3-primep p)
       (< 2 p))
      (iff
       (putnam-1974-a3-sum-two-squares-p p)
       (equal (mod p 4) 1))))))

(defun putnam-1974-a3-first-solution-set-p (p)
  (and
   (putnam-1974-a3-primep p)
   (equal (mod p 8) 1)))

(defun putnam-1974-a3-second-solution-set-p (p)
  (and
   (putnam-1974-a3-primep p)
   (equal (mod p 8) 5)))

(defun-sk putnam-1974-a3-classification-p ()
  (forall (p)
    (implies
     (natp p)
     (and
      (iff
       (and
        (putnam-1974-a3-primep p)
        (< 2 p)
        (putnam-1974-a3-form-a-representable-p p))
       (putnam-1974-a3-first-solution-set-p p))
      (iff
       (and
        (putnam-1974-a3-primep p)
        (< 2 p)
        (putnam-1974-a3-form-b-representable-p p))
       (putnam-1974-a3-second-solution-set-p p))))))

(defun putnambench-putnam-1974-a3-statement ()
  (implies
   (putnam-1974-a3-sum-two-squares-assumption-p)
   (putnam-1974-a3-classification-p)))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

content:
-- Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1974_a3:
-- the odd primes represented by two specified binary quadratic forms are
-- characterized by their congruence classes modulo eight. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module Putnam1974A3 where

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Int using (Int; pos; negsuc)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; _*_)

infix 4 _<=_ _<_ _divides_
infixl 6 _+z_
infixl 7 _*z_
infixr 3 _and_
infixr 2 _or_
infix 1 _iff_

data _<=_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set where
  zero<= : {n : Nat} -> zero <= n
  suc<=suc : {m n : Nat} -> m <= n -> suc m <= suc n

_<_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set
m < n =
  suc m <= n

record _and_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first : A
    second : B

data _or_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  left : A -> A or B
  right : B -> A or B

record _iff_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor equivalence
  field
    forward : A -> B
    backward : B -> A

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value : A
    property : P value

record _divides_ (divisor dividend : Nat) : Set where
  field
    quotient : Nat
    division-equation : dividend == divisor * quotient

record Prime (p : Nat) : Set where
  field
    at-least-two : suc (suc zero) <= p
    only-trivial-divisors :
      (d : Nat) ->
      d divides p ->
      (d == suc zero) or (d == p)

Congruent : Nat -> Nat -> Nat -> Set
Congruent value residue modulus =
  Exists Nat
    (\ k ->
      value == residue + modulus * k)

difference : Nat -> Nat -> Int
difference zero zero =
  pos zero
difference (suc m) zero =
  pos (suc m)
difference zero (suc n) =
  negsuc n
difference (suc m) (suc n) =
  difference m n

negative : Nat -> Int
negative zero =
  pos zero
negative (suc n) =
  negsuc n

_+z_ : Int -> Int -> Int
pos m +z pos n =
  pos (m + n)
pos m +z negsuc n =
  difference m (suc n)
negsuc m +z pos n =
  difference n (suc m)
negsuc m +z negsuc n =
  negsuc (suc (m + n))

_*z_ : Int -> Int -> Int
pos m *z pos n =
  pos (m * n)
pos m *z negsuc n =
  negative (m * suc n)
negsuc m *z pos n =
  negative (suc m * n)
negsuc m *z negsuc n =
  pos (suc m * suc n)

square : Int -> Int
square x =
  x *z x

two : Nat
two =
  suc (suc zero)

four : Nat
four =
  suc (suc (suc (suc zero)))

five : Nat
five =
  suc four

eight : Nat
eight =
  suc (suc (suc five))

sixteen : Nat
sixteen =
  eight + eight

GreaterThanTwo : Nat -> Set
GreaterThanTwo p =
  two < p

SumOfTwoIntegerSquares : Nat -> Set
SumOfTwoIntegerSquares p =
  Exists Int
    (\ m ->
      Exists Int
        (\ n ->
          pos p == square m +z square n))

FirstQuadraticForm : Nat -> Set
FirstQuadraticForm p =
  Exists Int
    (\ x ->
      Exists Int
        (\ y ->
          pos p ==
          square x +z (pos sixteen *z square y)))

SecondQuadraticForm : Nat -> Set
SecondQuadraticForm p =
  Exists Int
    (\ x ->
      Exists Int
        (\ y ->
          pos p ==
          (pos four *z square x)
          +z
          ((pos four *z x) *z y)
          +z
          (pos five *z square y)))

FirstSolutionClass : Nat -> Set
FirstSolutionClass p =
  Prime p
  and
  Congruent p (suc zero) eight

SecondSolutionClass : Nat -> Set
SecondSolutionClass p =
  Prime p
  and
  Congruent p five eight

SumOfTwoSquaresCriterion : Set
SumOfTwoSquaresCriterion =
  (p : Nat) ->
  Prime p ->
  GreaterThanTwo p ->
  (SumOfTwoIntegerSquares p
    iff
    Congruent p (suc zero) four)

putnam-1974-a3 : Set
putnam-1974-a3 =
  SumOfTwoSquaresCriterion ->
  (p : Nat) ->
  ((Prime p
    and
    GreaterThanTwo p
    and
    FirstQuadraticForm p)
    iff
    FirstSolutionClass p)
  and
  ((Prime p
    and
    GreaterThanTwo p
    and
    SecondQuadraticForm p)
    iff
    SecondSolutionClass p)

:: Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench artifact putnam_1974_a3:
:: odd primes represented by x^2 + 16y^2 and 4x^2 + 4xy + 5y^2 are
:: characterized by their residue classes modulo 8. This file contains no proof.

environ
  vocabularies NUMBERS, NAT_1, XBOOLE_0, ARYTM_3, CARD_1, SUBSET_1,
    XXREAL_0, XCMPLX_0, COMPLEX1, ARYTM_1, RELAT_1, SQUARE_1, SIN_COS,
    REAL_1, VALUED_0, INT_1, INT_2;
  notations TARSKI, XBOOLE_0, SUBSET_1, ORDINAL1, NUMBERS, XCMPLX_0,
    XREAL_0, COMPLEX1, REAL_1, SQUARE_1, NAT_1, INT_1, INT_2, NAT_D,
    RELAT_1, SIN_COS, XXREAL_0;
  constructors REAL_1, SQUARE_1, NAT_1, NAT_D, SIN_COS, RELSET_1;
  registrations RELSET_1, XCMPLX_0, XXREAL_0, XREAL_0, NAT_1, MEMBERED,
    SIN_COS, VALUED_0, SQUARE_1, ORDINAL1, CARD_1, INT_1;
  requirements NUMERALS, SUBSET, REAL, ARITHM, BOOLE;

begin

::$P-
theorem
  (for q being Nat st q is prime & q > 2 holds
    ((ex m,n being Integer st q = m*m + n*n) iff q mod 4 = 1))
  implies
    for p being Nat holds
      ((p is prime & p > 2 &
          (ex x,y being Integer st p = x*x + 16*y*y))
        iff p is prime & p mod 8 = 1) &
      ((p is prime & p > 2 &
          (ex x,y being Integer st p = 4*x*x + 4*x*y + 5*y*y))
        iff p is prime & p mod 8 = 5)
proof
end;
::$P+

title: putnam_1974_a3

% Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench artifact putnam_1974_a3:
% primes greater than two represented by two quadratic forms are classified
% by the residue classes 1 and 5 modulo 8. This file contains no proof.

putnam_1974_a3: THEORY
BEGIN
  natural_set: TYPE = [nat -> bool]
  solution_pair: TYPE =
    [# first_set: natural_set, second_set: natural_set #]

  nat_divides(divisor: posnat, value: nat): bool =
    EXISTS (quotient: nat):
      value = divisor * quotient

  prime_nat(value: nat): bool =
    value >= 2
      AND FORALL (divisor: posnat):
        nat_divides(divisor, value)
          IMPLIES divisor = 1 OR divisor = value

  putnam_1974_a3_solution: solution_pair =
    (# first_set :=
         LAMBDA (p: nat):
           prime_nat(p) AND mod(p, 8) = 1,
       second_set :=
         LAMBDA (p: nat):
           prime_nat(p) AND mod(p, 8) = 5 #)

  sum_of_two_squares(p: nat): bool =
    EXISTS (m, n: int):
      (p :: int) = m ^ 2 + n ^ 2

  represented_by_first_form(p: nat): bool =
    EXISTS (x, y: int):
      (p :: int) = x ^ 2 + 16 * y ^ 2

  represented_by_second_form(p: nat): bool =
    EXISTS (x, y: int):
      (p :: int) = 4 * x ^ 2 + 4 * x * y + 5 * y ^ 2

  given_sum_of_two_squares_characterization: bool =
    FORALL (p: nat):
      prime_nat(p) AND p > 2
        IMPLIES
          (sum_of_two_squares(p) IFF mod(p, 4) = 1)

  putnam_1974_a3: bool =
    given_sum_of_two_squares_characterization
      IMPLIES
        FORALL (p: nat):
          ((prime_nat(p)
              AND p > 2
              AND represented_by_first_form(p))
            IFF first_set(putnam_1974_a3_solution)(p))
          AND
          ((prime_nat(p)
              AND p > 2
              AND represented_by_second_form(p))
            IFF second_set(putnam_1974_a3_solution)(p))
END putnam_1974_a3

import Mathlib

open Set Nat

noncomputable abbrev putnam_1974_a4_solution : ℕ → ℚ := sorry
-- (fun n ↦ (1 : ℚ) / (2 ^ (n - 1)) * (n * (n - 1).choose ⌊n / 2⌋₊))

/--
Evaluate in closed form: $\frac{1}{2^{n-1}} \sum_{k < n/2} (n-2k)*{n \choose k}$.
-/
theorem putnam_1974_a4
    (n : ℕ)
    (hn : 0 < n) :
    (1 : ℚ) / (2 ^ (n - 1)) * ∑ k ∈ Finset.Icc 0 ⌊n / 2⌋₊, (n - 2 * k) * (n.choose k) =
    putnam_1974_a4_solution n :=
  sorry
