open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Int using (Int; pos; negsuc)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; _*_)

infix 4 _!=_ _<=N_
infixr 3 _and_
infixr 2 _or_

data Bottom : Set where

Not : Set -> Set
Not A =
  A -> Bottom

_!=_ : {A : Set} -> A -> A -> Set
x != y =
  Not (x == y)

record _and_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data _or_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  left  : A -> A or B
  right : B -> A or B

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

data _<=N_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set where
  zero<=   : {n : Nat} -> zero <=N n
  suc<=suc : {m n : Nat} -> m <=N n -> suc m <=N suc n

oneN : Nat
oneN =
  suc zero

twoN : Nat
twoN =
  suc oneN

threeN : Nat
threeN =
  suc twoN

fourN : Nat
fourN =
  twoN + twoN

record CompleteOrderedField (R : Set) : Set1 where
  field
    zeroR oneR : R
    add multiply : R -> R -> R
    negate inverse : R -> R
    lessOrEqual : R -> R -> Set
    fromNat : Nat -> R

    one-not-zero :
      oneR != zeroR

    add-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> add x y == add y x
    add-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      add (add x y) z == add x (add y z)
    add-zero :
      (x : R) -> add x zeroR == x
    add-inverse :
      (x : R) -> add x (negate x) == zeroR

    multiply-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> multiply x y == multiply y x
    multiply-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply (multiply x y) z == multiply x (multiply y z)
    multiply-one :
      (x : R) -> multiply x oneR == x
    multiply-zero :
      (x : R) -> multiply x zeroR == zeroR
    distribute :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply x (add y z) ==
      add (multiply x y) (multiply x z)
    inverse-zero :
      inverse zeroR == zeroR
    multiply-inverse :
      (x : R) ->
      x != zeroR ->
      multiply x (inverse x) == oneR

    order-reflexive :
      (x : R) -> lessOrEqual x x
    order-transitive :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y z ->
      lessOrEqual x z
    order-antisymmetric :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y x ->
      x == y
    order-total :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y or lessOrEqual y x
    add-order :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual (add z x) (add z y)
    multiply-nonnegative :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR x ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR y ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR (multiply x y)
    zero-less-than-one :
      lessOrEqual zeroR oneR and zeroR != oneR

    fromNat-zero :
      fromNat zero == zeroR
    fromNat-successor :
      (n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (suc n) == add (fromNat n) oneR
    fromNat-addition :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m + n) == add (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-multiplication :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m * n) == multiply (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-injective :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat m == fromNat n ->
      m == n

    archimedean :
      (x : R) ->
      Exists Nat (\ n -> lessOrEqual x (fromNat n))
    least-upper-bound :
      (P : R -> Set) ->
      Exists R P ->
      Exists R
        (\ upper ->
          (x : R) ->
          P x ->
          lessOrEqual x upper) ->
      Exists R
        (\ supremum ->
          ((x : R) ->
            P x ->
            lessOrEqual x supremum)
          and
          ((upper : R) ->
            ((x : R) ->
              P x ->
              lessOrEqual x upper) ->
            lessOrEqual supremum upper))

open CompleteOrderedField

fromInt :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  Int ->
  R
fromInt reals (pos n) =
  fromNat reals n
fromInt reals (negsuc n) =
  negate reals (fromNat reals (suc n))

subtract :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
subtract reals x y =
  add reals x (negate reals y)

divide :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
divide reals x y =
  multiply reals x (inverse reals y)

StrictLess :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
StrictLess reals x y =
  lessOrEqual reals x y and x != y

CloseTo :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
CloseTo reals center radius x =
  StrictLess reals
    (subtract reals center radius)
    x
  and
  StrictLess reals
    x
    (add reals center radius)

naturalPower :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  Nat ->
  R
naturalPower reals x zero =
  oneR reals
naturalPower reals x (suc n) =
  multiply reals
    (naturalPower reals x n)
    x

factorial : Nat -> Nat
factorial zero =
  oneN
factorial (suc n) =
  suc n * factorial n

sumFirst :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  Nat ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  R
sumFirst reals zero term =
  zeroR reals
sumFirst reals (suc n) term =
  add reals
    (sumFirst reals n term)
    (term n)

ConvergesTo :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  R ->
  Set
ConvergesTo {R} reals sequence limit =
  (epsilon : R) ->
  StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) epsilon ->
  Exists Nat
    (\ cutoff ->
      (n : Nat) ->
      cutoff <=N n ->
      CloseTo reals limit epsilon (sequence n))

SeriesHasSum :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  R ->
  Set
SeriesHasSum reals terms limit =
  ConvergesTo reals
    (\ n -> sumFirst reals n terms)
    limit

alternatingPower :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  Nat ->
  R
alternatingPower reals n =
  naturalPower reals
    (negate reals (oneR reals))
    n

cosineTerm :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  Nat ->
  R
cosineTerm reals x n =
  divide reals
    (multiply reals
      (alternatingPower reals n)
      (naturalPower reals x (twoN * n)))
    (fromNat reals (factorial (twoN * n)))

leibnizTerm :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  Nat ->
  R
leibnizTerm reals n =
  divide reals
    (alternatingPower reals n)
    (fromNat reals (suc (twoN * n)))

record StandardCosine
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) : Set1 where
  field
    cosine : R -> R
    pi : R
    cosine-series :
      (x : R) ->
      SeriesHasSum reals
        (cosineTerm reals x)
        (cosine x)
    pi-positive :
      StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) pi
    pi-leibniz-series :
      SeriesHasSum reals
        (leibnizTerm reals)
        (divide reals pi (fromNat reals fourN))

open StandardCosine

IsRational :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  Set
IsRational reals x =
  Exists Int
    (\ numerator ->
      Exists Int
        (\ denominator ->
          denominator != pos zero
          and
          x ==
          divide reals
            (fromInt reals numerator)
            (fromInt reals denominator)))

putnam-1974-b3 : Set1
putnam-1974-b3 =
  (R : Set) ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) ->
  (trigonometry : StandardCosine reals) ->
  (alpha : R) ->
  cosine trigonometry
    (multiply reals (pi trigonometry) alpha) ==
    divide reals
      (oneR reals)
      (fromNat reals threeN) ->
  Not (IsRational reals alpha)

% Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench artifact putnam_1974_b3:
% if cos(pi * alpha) = 1/3 for a real alpha, then alpha is irrational.
% This file contains no proof.

putnam_1974_b3: THEORY
BEGIN
  safe_div(x, y: real): real =
    IF y = 0 THEN 0 ELSE x / y ENDIF

  nat_factorial(n: nat): RECURSIVE nat =
    IF n = 0 THEN
      1
    ELSE
      n * nat_factorial(n - 1)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE n

  cosine_partial(x: real, count: nat): RECURSIVE real =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      LET j: nat = count - 1 IN
        cosine_partial(x, count - 1)
          + safe_div(
              ((-1 :: real) ^ j) * x ^ (2 * j),
              nat_factorial(2 * j) :: real)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  converges_to(sequence: [nat -> real], value: real): bool =
    FORALL (eps: posreal):
      EXISTS (cutoff: nat):
        FORALL (index: nat):
          cutoff <= index IMPLIES
            abs(sequence(index) - value) < eps

  cosine_value(x, value: real): bool =
    converges_to(
      (LAMBDA (count: nat): cosine_partial(x, count)),
      value)

  pi_value(p: real): bool =
    3 < p AND p < 4 AND cosine_value(p / 2, 0)

  pi: real =
    epsilon(LAMBDA (p: real): pi_value(p))

  putnam_1974_b3: bool =
    FORALL (alpha: real):
      cosine_value(pi * alpha, (1 :: real) / 3)
        IMPLIES NOT rational?(alpha)
END putnam_1974_b3

;; Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1974_b5:
;; the finite exponential-series sum through degree n is greater than half
;; of exp(n) for every natural n. This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

;; For natural n, put S_n = sum_(i=0)^n n^i/i!.  The exact rational prefixes
;; below increase to the real number exp(n).  Thus the source inequality
;; exp(n) < 2*S_n implies that every prefix is below 2*S_n.
;;
;; Conversely, if every prefix is below 2*S_n, passage to the limit gives
;; exp(n) <= 2*S_n.  For n > 0, exp(n) is transcendental while 2*S_n is
;; rational, so equality is impossible; for n = 0, exp(0) = 1 < 2*S_0 = 2.
;; Hence universal closure over TERM-COUNT is bidirectionally equivalent to
;; the source strict real inequality, without replacing exp(n) by a rational
;; value or restricting the natural-number domain.

(defun putnam-1974-b5-factorial (n)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix n)))
  (if (zp n)
      1
    (* n
       (putnam-1974-b5-factorial (- n 1)))))

(defun putnam-1974-b5-exp-prefix (n term-count)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix term-count)))
  (if (zp term-count)
      0
    (let ((index (- term-count 1)))
      (+ (putnam-1974-b5-exp-prefix n index)
         (/ (expt n index)
            (putnam-1974-b5-factorial index))))))

(defun putnam-1974-b5-finite-sum (n)
  (putnam-1974-b5-exp-prefix n (+ n 1)))

(defun putnambench-putnam-1974-b5-statement (n term-count)
  (implies
   (and (natp n)
        (natp term-count))
   (< (putnam-1974-b5-exp-prefix n term-count)
      (* 2 (putnam-1974-b5-finite-sum n)))))

-- every natural-indexed partial sum of the exponential series at n, through

-- This file contains no proof.

    inverse-zero :

    multiply-inverse :

    add-order :

    multiply-nonnegative :

    zero-less-than-one :

    fromNat-addition :
      (m n : Nat) ->

    fromNat-multiplication :

    fromNat-injective :

    least-upper-bound :
      (P : R -> Set) ->
      Exists R P ->

        (\ upper ->
          (x : R) ->
          P x ->
          lessOrEqual x upper) ->
      Exists R
        (\ supremum ->
          ((x : R) ->
            P x ->
            lessOrEqual x supremum)
          and
          ((upper : R) ->
            ((x : R) ->

              lessOrEqual x upper) ->

open CompleteOrderedRealField

oneN : Nat
oneN =
  suc zero

twoN : Nat
twoN =
  suc oneN

subtract :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
subtract reals x y =
  add reals x (negate reals y)

divide :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->

divide reals x y =

StrictLess :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->

  lessOrEqual reals x y and x != y

CloseTo :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
CloseTo reals center radius x =
  StrictLess reals
    (subtract reals center radius)
    x
  and
  StrictLess reals
    x
    (add reals center radius)

naturalPower :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  Nat ->
  R
naturalPower reals x zero =
  oneR reals
naturalPower reals x (suc n) =
  multiply reals
    (naturalPower reals x n)
    x

factorial : Nat -> Nat
factorial zero =
  oneN
factorial (suc n) =
  suc n * factorial n

sumFirst :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Nat ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  R
sumFirst reals zero term =
  zeroR reals
sumFirst reals (suc n) term =
  add reals
    (sumFirst reals n term)
    (term n)

ConvergesTo :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  R ->
  Set
ConvergesTo {R} reals sequence limit =
  (epsilon : R) ->
  StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) epsilon ->
  Exists Nat
    (\ cutoff ->
      (n : Nat) ->
      cutoff <=N n ->
      CloseTo reals limit epsilon (sequence n))

SeriesHasSum :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  R ->
  Set
SeriesHasSum reals terms limit =
  ConvergesTo reals
    (\ n -> sumFirst reals n terms)
    limit

exponentialTerm :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  Nat ->
  R
exponentialTerm reals x n =
  divide reals
    (naturalPower reals x n)
    (fromNat reals (factorial n))

record StandardExponential
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) :
  Set1 where

  field
    exponential : R -> R
    exponential-series :
      (x : R) ->
      SeriesHasSum reals
        (exponentialTerm reals x)
        (exponential x)

open StandardExponential

putnamPartialSum :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Nat ->
  R

% Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench artifact putnam_1974_b5:
% for every natural n, the sum of n^i / i! from i = 0 through n is greater
% than half of exp(n). This file contains no proof.

putnam_1974_b5: THEORY
BEGIN
  safe_div(numerator, denominator: real): real =
    IF denominator = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      numerator / denominator
    ENDIF

  nat_factorial(index: nat): RECURSIVE nat =
    IF index = 0 THEN
      1
    ELSE
      index * nat_factorial(index - 1)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE index

  power_factorial_sum(n, count: nat): RECURSIVE real =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      LET index: nat = count - 1 IN
        power_factorial_sum(n, count - 1)
          + safe_div(
              (n :: real) ^ index,
              nat_factorial(index) :: real)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  exponential_partial(x: real, count: nat): RECURSIVE real =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      LET index: nat = count - 1 IN
        exponential_partial(x, count - 1)
          + safe_div(
              x ^ index,
              nat_factorial(index) :: real)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  converges_to(sequence: [nat -> real], value: real): bool =
    FORALL (epsilon_value: posreal):
      EXISTS (cutoff: nat):
        FORALL (index: nat):
          cutoff <= index IMPLIES
            abs(sequence(index) - value) < epsilon_value

  real_exponential(x: real): real =
    epsilon(
      LAMBDA (value: real):
        converges_to(
          LAMBDA (count: nat):
            exponential_partial(x, count),
          value))

  putnam_1974_b5: bool =
    FORALL (n: nat):
      power_factorial_sum(n, n + 1)
        > real_exponential(n :: real) / 2
END putnam_1974_b5

     CARD {S:num->bool |
             S SUBSET (1..1000) /\ CARD S MOD 3 = 0} in

;; Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1974_b6:
;; among the subsets of the integers 1 through 1000, the numbers having
;; cardinality congruent to 0, 1, and 2 modulo 3 are respectively
;; (2^1000 - 1)/3, (2^1000 - 1)/3, and (2^1000 - 1)/3 + 1.
;; This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

;; A subset of {1,...,1000} is represented by its 1000-bit characteristic
;; number. Codes from 0 through 2^1000 - 1 are therefore in bijection with
;; all source subsets, and the bit count is exactly the subset cardinality.
(defun putnam-1974-b6-subset-cardinality
    (subset-code element-count)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix element-count)))
  (if (zp element-count)
      0
    (+ (mod subset-code 2)
       (putnam-1974-b6-subset-cardinality
        (floor subset-code 2)
        (- element-count 1)))))

(defun putnam-1974-b6-count-residue
    (candidate-count element-count residue)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix candidate-count)))
  (if (zp candidate-count)
      0
    (let ((subset-code (- candidate-count 1)))
      (+ (if (equal
              (mod
               (putnam-1974-b6-subset-cardinality
                subset-code element-count)
               3)
              residue)
             1
           0)
         (putnam-1974-b6-count-residue
          subset-code element-count residue)))))

(defun putnambench-putnam-1974-b6-statement ()
  (let* ((element-count 1000)
         (subset-count (expt 2 element-count))
         (one-third (floor (- subset-count 1) 3)))
    (and
     (equal
      (putnam-1974-b6-count-residue
       subset-count element-count 0)
      one-third)
     (equal
      (putnam-1974-b6-count-residue
       subset-count element-count 1)
      one-third)
     (equal
      (putnam-1974-b6-count-residue
       subset-count element-count 2)
      (+ one-third 1)))))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

-- Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1974_b6:
-- the subsets of a 1000-element set whose cardinalities are congruent to
-- 0, 1, and 2 modulo 3 have the stated three exact counts.
-- This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

open import Agda.Builtin.Bool using (Bool; false; true)
open import Agda.Builtin.Equality using (_≡_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; _-_; _*_)

data Fin : Nat → Set where
  fzero : {n : Nat} → Fin (suc n)
  fsuc  : {n : Nat} → Fin n → Fin (suc n)

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A → Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value : A
    property : P value

record HasExtensionalCardinality
  {A : Set}
  (equivalent : A → A → Set)
  (cardinality : Nat) :
  Set where

  field
    enumerate :
      Fin cardinality →
      A

    enumeration-complete :
      (item : A) →
      Exists (Fin cardinality)
        (λ index → equivalent item (enumerate index))

    enumeration-injective :
      (left-index right-index : Fin cardinality) →
      equivalent (enumerate left-index) (enumerate right-index) →
      left-index ≡ right-index

record Subset (n : Nat) : Set where
  constructor subset
  field
    contains : Fin n → Bool

open Subset

countTrue :
  {n : Nat} →
  (Fin n → Bool) →
  Nat
countTrue {zero} membership =
  zero
countTrue {suc n} membership with membership fzero
... | false =
  countTrue (λ index → membership (fsuc index))
... | true =
  suc (countTrue (λ index → membership (fsuc index)))

subsetCardinality :
  {n : Nat} →
  Subset n →
  Nat
subsetCardinality finiteSubset =
  countTrue (contains finiteSubset)

three : Nat
three =
  suc (suc (suc zero))

CongruentModuloThree :
  Nat →
  Nat →
  Set
CongruentModuloThree cardinality residue =
  Exists Nat
    (λ quotient →
      cardinality ≡ three * quotient + residue)

record ResidueSubset (n residue : Nat) : Set where
  constructor residueSubset
  field
    finiteSubset : Subset n
    residue-equation :
      CongruentModuloThree
        (subsetCardinality finiteSubset)
        residue

open ResidueSubset

SameResidueSubset :
  {n residue : Nat} →
  ResidueSubset n residue →
  ResidueSubset n residue →
  Set
SameResidueSubset {n} left right =
  (index : Fin n) →
  contains (finiteSubset left) index ≡
  contains (finiteSubset right) index

ResidueFamily :
  Nat →
  Nat →
  Nat →
  Set
ResidueFamily n residue cardinality =
  HasExtensionalCardinality
    {A = ResidueSubset n residue}
    SameResidueSubset
    cardinality

one : Nat
one =
  suc zero

two : Nat
two =
  suc one

thousand : Nat
thousand =
  1000

power :
  Nat →
  Nat →
  Nat
power base zero =
  one
power base (suc exponent) =
  base * power base exponent

divideByThree : Nat → Nat
divideByThree zero =
  zero
divideByThree (suc zero) =
  zero
divideByThree (suc (suc zero)) =
  zero
divideByThree (suc (suc (suc n))) =
  suc (divideByThree n)

solutionBase : Nat
solutionBase =
  divideByThree (power two thousand - one)

record NatTriple : Set where
  constructor triple
  field
    first second third-component : Nat

putnam-1974-b6-solution : NatTriple
putnam-1974-b6-solution =
  triple
    solutionBase
    solutionBase
    (suc solutionBase)

putnam-1974-b6 : Set
putnam-1974-b6 =
  (count0 count1 count2 : Nat) →
  ResidueFamily thousand zero count0 →
  ResidueFamily thousand one count1 →
  ResidueFamily thousand two count2 →
  triple count0 count1 count2 ≡
  putnam-1974-b6-solution

title: putnam_1975_a1
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1975_a1:
;; the equivalence between representing an integer as a sum of two triangular
;; numbers and representing four times that integer plus one as two squares,
;; with the specified forward witnesses. This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(defun putnam-1975-a1-triangular (z)
  (/ (+ (* z z) z) 2))

(defun putnam-1975-a1-nab-p (n a b)
  (and (integerp n)
       (integerp a)
       (integerp b)
       (equal n
              (+ (putnam-1975-a1-triangular a)
                 (putnam-1975-a1-triangular b)))))

(defun putnam-1975-a1-nxy-p (n x y)
  (and (integerp n)
       (integerp x)
       (integerp y)
       (equal (+ (* 4 n) 1)
              (+ (* x x) (* y y)))))

(defun putnam-1975-a1-solution-x (a b)
  (+ a b 1))

(defun putnam-1975-a1-solution-y (a b)
  (- a b))

;; If x^2+y^2=4*n+1, then n is nonnegative and both absolute values are at
;; most 4*n+1. Thus this search is equivalent to the unbounded existential
;; quantifier over integer x and y.
(defun putnam-1975-a1-nxy-y-through-index-p
    (n x bound y-index)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix y-index)))
  (if (and (integerp n)
           (integerp x)
           (natp bound)
           (natp y-index))
      (or (putnam-1975-a1-nxy-p
           n x (- y-index bound))
          (and (not (zp y-index))
               (putnam-1975-a1-nxy-y-through-index-p
                n x bound (- y-index 1))))
    nil))

(defun putnam-1975-a1-nxy-x-through-index-p
    (n bound x-index)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix x-index)))
  (if (and (integerp n)
           (natp bound)
           (natp x-index))
      (or (putnam-1975-a1-nxy-y-through-index-p
           n (- x-index bound) bound (* 2 bound))
          (and (not (zp x-index))
               (putnam-1975-a1-nxy-x-through-index-p
                n bound (- x-index 1))))
    nil))

(defun putnam-1975-a1-nxy-exists-p (n)
  (if (and (integerp n)
           (<= 0 n))
      (let ((bound (+ (* 4 n) 1)))
        (putnam-1975-a1-nxy-x-through-index-p
         n bound (* 2 bound)))
    nil))

;; Every integer triangular number z*(z+1)/2 is nonnegative. If two such
;; numbers sum to n, then n is nonnegative; using T(z)=T(-z-1), each witness
;; has absolute value at most n+1. Hence this search is equivalent to the
;; unbounded existential quantifier over integer a and b.
(defun putnam-1975-a1-nab-b-through-index-p
    (n a bound b-index)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix b-index)))
  (if (and (integerp n)
           (integerp a)
           (natp bound)
           (natp b-index))
      (or (putnam-1975-a1-nab-p
           n a (- b-index bound))
          (and (not (zp b-index))
               (putnam-1975-a1-nab-b-through-index-p
                n a bound (- b-index 1))))
    nil))

(defun putnam-1975-a1-nab-a-through-index-p
    (n bound a-index)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix a-index)))
  (if (and (integerp n)
           (natp bound)
           (natp a-index))
      (or (putnam-1975-a1-nab-b-through-index-p
           n (- a-index bound) bound (* 2 bound))
          (and (not (zp a-index))
               (putnam-1975-a1-nab-a-through-index-p
                n bound (- a-index 1))))
    nil))

(defun putnam-1975-a1-nab-exists-p (n)
  (if (and (integerp n)
           (<= 0 n))
      (let ((bound (+ n 1)))
        (putnam-1975-a1-nab-a-through-index-p
         n bound (* 2 bound)))
    nil))

;; Rocq states the fixed-witness forward clause as an equivalence, whereas
;; Lean and Isabelle state its forward implication. Expanding x=a+b+1 and
;; y=a-b makes the reverse implication the same integer identity, so Boolean
;; equality below is equivalent to the implication under these definitions.
(defun putnambench-putnam-1975-a1-statement (n a b)
  (implies
   (and (integerp n)
        (integerp a)
        (integerp b))
   (and
    (equal
     (putnam-1975-a1-nab-p n a b)
     (putnam-1975-a1-nxy-p
      n
      (putnam-1975-a1-solution-x a b)
      (putnam-1975-a1-solution-y a b)))
    (implies
     (putnam-1975-a1-nxy-exists-p n)
     (putnam-1975-a1-nab-exists-p n)))))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

title: putnam_1975_a1
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1975_a1:
-- the equivalence between sums of two integer triangular numbers and
-- representations of four times the integer plus one as two squares, with
-- specified forward witnesses. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Int using (Int; pos; negsuc)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; _*_)

infixr 3 _and_

record _and_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

record Iff (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor equivalence
  field
    forward  : A -> B
    backward : B -> A

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

negative : Nat -> Int
negative zero =
  pos zero
negative (suc n) =
  negsuc n

difference : Nat -> Nat -> Int
difference zero zero =
  pos zero
difference (suc m) zero =
  pos (suc m)
difference zero (suc n) =
  negsuc n
difference (suc m) (suc n) =
  difference m n

addInt : Int -> Int -> Int
addInt (pos m) (pos n) =
  pos (m + n)
addInt (pos m) (negsuc n) =
  difference m (suc n)
addInt (negsuc m) (pos n) =
  difference n (suc m)
addInt (negsuc m) (negsuc n) =
  negsuc (suc (m + n))

negateInt : Int -> Int
negateInt (pos n) =
  negative n
negateInt (negsuc n) =
  pos (suc n)

subtractInt : Int -> Int -> Int
subtractInt x y =
  addInt x (negateInt y)

multiplyInt : Int -> Int -> Int
multiplyInt (pos m) (pos n) =
  pos (m * n)
multiplyInt (pos m) (negsuc n) =
  negative (m * suc n)
multiplyInt (negsuc m) (pos n) =
  negative (suc m * n)
multiplyInt (negsuc m) (negsuc n) =
  pos (suc m * suc n)

squareInt : Int -> Int
squareInt x =
  multiplyInt x x

oneN : Nat
oneN =
  suc zero

twoN : Nat
twoN =
  suc oneN

fourN : Nat
fourN =
  twoN * twoN

oneZ : Int
oneZ =
  pos oneN

twoZ : Int
twoZ =
  pos twoN

fourZ : Int
fourZ =
  pos fourN

TriangularSum : Int -> Int -> Int -> Set
TriangularSum n a b =
  multiplyInt twoZ n
  ==
  addInt
    (addInt (squareInt a) a)
    (addInt (squareInt b) b)

TwoSquareRepresentation : Int -> Int -> Int -> Set
TwoSquareRepresentation n x y =
  addInt (multiplyInt fourZ n) oneZ
  ==
  addInt (squareInt x) (squareInt y)

solutionX : Int -> Int -> Int
solutionX a b =
  addInt (addInt a b) oneZ

solutionY : Int -> Int -> Int
solutionY a b =
  subtractInt a b

putnam-1975-a1 : Set
putnam-1975-a1 =
  ((n a b : Int) ->
    Iff
      (TriangularSum n a b)
      (TwoSquareRepresentation n (solutionX a b) (solutionY a b)))
  and
  ((n : Int) ->
    Exists Int
      (\ x ->
        Exists Int
          (\ y ->
            TwoSquareRepresentation n x y)) ->
    Exists Int
      (\ a ->
        Exists Int
          (\ b ->
            TriangularSum n a b)))

$(
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact
  putnam_1975_a1: the equivalence between an integer being a sum of two
  triangular numbers and four times that integer plus one being a sum of
  two integer squares, with explicit forward witnesses. This file contains
  no proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  All variables are restricted to set.mm's class ZZ of integers. Since
  a^2 + a and b^2 + b are even, division by 2 agrees with the exact
  rational or real division in the Lean and Rocq sources and with the
  integer division in Isabelle.

  Substituting x = a + b + 1 and y = a - b makes the square-sum equation
  algebraically equivalent to the triangular-number equation. Thus the
  forward biconditional matches Rocq and is bidirectionally equivalent to
  the forward implication in Lean and Isabelle. The second conjunct keeps
  the square witnesses and triangular-number witnesses internally
  existentially quantified.

  The final declaration is the single unproved $a corpus statement; this
  database contains no $p proof statement.
$)

${
  $d a b n x y $.

  putnambench-putnam-1975-a1 $a |- (
    (
      A. n e. ZZ A. a e. ZZ A. b e. ZZ
        (
          n =
            (
              ( ( ( a ^ 2 ) + a ) / 2 )
              +
              ( ( ( b ^ 2 ) + b ) / 2 )
            )
          <->
          ( ( 4 x. n ) + 1 ) =
            (
              ( ( ( a + b ) + 1 ) ^ 2 )
              +
              ( ( a - b ) ^ 2 )
            )
        )
    )
    /\
    A. n e. ZZ
      (
        (
          E. x e. ZZ E. y e. ZZ
            ( ( 4 x. n ) + 1 ) =
              ( ( x ^ 2 ) + ( y ^ 2 ) )
        )
        ->
        E. a e. ZZ E. b e. ZZ
          n =
            (
              ( ( ( a ^ 2 ) + a ) / 2 )
              +
              ( ( ( b ^ 2 ) + b ) / 2 )
            )
      )
  ) $.
$}

title: putnam_1975_a1
content:
% Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench artifact putnam_1975_a1:
% the correspondence between sums of two integer triangular numbers and
% representations of 4n + 1 as a sum of two integer squares, with explicit
% forward witnesses. This file contains no proof.

putnam_1975_a1: THEORY
BEGIN
  triangular_sum(n, a, b: int): bool =
    2 * n = a * a + a + b * b + b

  square_sum(n, x, y: int): bool =
    4 * n + 1 = x * x + y * y

  solution_x(a, b: int): int =
    a + b + 1

  solution_y(a, b: int): int =
    a - b

  putnam_1975_a1: bool =
    (FORALL (n, a, b: int):
      triangular_sum(n, a, b)
        IMPLIES square_sum(n, solution_x(a, b), solution_y(a, b)))
      AND
        (FORALL (n: int):
          (EXISTS (x, y: int):
            square_sum(n, x, y))
          IMPLIES
            (EXISTS (a, b: int):
              triangular_sum(n, a, b)))
END putnam_1975_a1

From mathcomp Require Import all_algebra all_ssreflect.

Import Order.TTheory GRing.Theory Num.Theory.

Set Implicit Arguments.

Unset Printing Implicit Defensive.

Local Open Scope ring_scope.
Local Open Scope complex_scope.

(* Note: normc is defined in real_closed.complex but cannot be recognized when I try to use it here. I substitute an equivalent (to this problem) definition here.*)
Variable R : realType.
Definition putnam_1975_a2_solution : (R * R) -> Prop := fun '(b, c) => c < 1 /\ c - b > -1 /\ c + b > -1.
Theorem putnam_1975_a2

Proof. Admitted.

content:
;; Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1975_a2:
;; the real coefficient pairs for which every root of z^2+bz+c lies strictly
;; inside the complex unit disk. This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))

;; The conservative symbols below present an arbitrary real-closed ordered
;; field. Complex numbers are represented by pairs of field elements, and the
;; polynomial equation and squared-modulus inequality are expanded
;; definitionally. The resulting assertion is a first-order sentence in the
;; language of ordered fields. Completeness of the theory of real-closed
;; fields therefore transfers it bidirectionally between this representation
;; and its instance over the real numbers.

(defstub putnam-1975-a2-real-p (real-type value) t)
(defstub putnam-1975-a2-zero (real-type) t)
(defstub putnam-1975-a2-one (real-type) t)
(defstub putnam-1975-a2-add (real-type left right) t)
(defstub putnam-1975-a2-mul (real-type left right) t)
(defstub putnam-1975-a2-neg (real-type value) t)
(defstub putnam-1975-a2-inv (real-type value) t)
(defstub putnam-1975-a2-less (real-type left right) t)

(defun putnam-1975-a2-sub (real-type left right)
  (putnam-1975-a2-add
   real-type left (putnam-1975-a2-neg real-type right)))

(defun-sk putnam-1975-a2-field-laws-p (real-type)
  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (putnam-1975-a2-real-p real-type x)
      (putnam-1975-a2-real-p real-type y)
      (putnam-1975-a2-real-p real-type z))
     (let* ((zero (putnam-1975-a2-zero real-type))
            (one (putnam-1975-a2-one real-type))
            (xy-add (putnam-1975-a2-add real-type x y))
            (yz-add (putnam-1975-a2-add real-type y z))
            (xy-mul (putnam-1975-a2-mul real-type x y))
            (yz-mul (putnam-1975-a2-mul real-type y z))
            (neg-x (putnam-1975-a2-neg real-type x))
            (inv-x (putnam-1975-a2-inv real-type x)))
       (and
        (putnam-1975-a2-real-p real-type xy-add)
        (putnam-1975-a2-real-p real-type xy-mul)
        (putnam-1975-a2-real-p real-type neg-x)
        (putnam-1975-a2-real-p real-type inv-x)
        (equal
         (putnam-1975-a2-add real-type xy-add z)
         (putnam-1975-a2-add real-type x yz-add))
        (equal xy-add (putnam-1975-a2-add real-type y x))
        (equal (putnam-1975-a2-add real-type x zero) x)
        (equal (putnam-1975-a2-add real-type x neg-x) zero)
        (equal
         (putnam-1975-a2-mul real-type xy-mul z)
         (putnam-1975-a2-mul real-type x yz-mul))
        (equal xy-mul (putnam-1975-a2-mul real-type y x))
        (equal (putnam-1975-a2-mul real-type x one) x)
        (implies
         (equal x zero)
         (equal inv-x zero))
        (implies
         (not (equal x zero))
         (equal
          (putnam-1975-a2-mul real-type x inv-x)
          one))
        (equal
         (putnam-1975-a2-mul real-type x yz-add)
         (putnam-1975-a2-add
          real-type
          (putnam-1975-a2-mul real-type x y)
          (putnam-1975-a2-mul real-type x z))))))))

(defun-sk putnam-1975-a2-order-laws-p (real-type)
  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (putnam-1975-a2-real-p real-type x)
      (putnam-1975-a2-real-p real-type y)
      (putnam-1975-a2-real-p real-type z))
     (let ((zero (putnam-1975-a2-zero real-type)))
       (and
        (not (putnam-1975-a2-less real-type x x))
        (or
         (equal x y)
         (putnam-1975-a2-less real-type x y)
         (putnam-1975-a2-less real-type y x))
        (implies
         (and
          (putnam-1975-a2-less real-type x y)
          (putnam-1975-a2-less real-type y z))
         (putnam-1975-a2-less real-type x z))
        (implies
         (putnam-1975-a2-less real-type x y)
         (putnam-1975-a2-less
          real-type
          (putnam-1975-a2-add real-type x z)
          (putnam-1975-a2-add real-type y z)))
        (implies
         (and
          (putnam-1975-a2-less real-type zero x)
          (putnam-1975-a2-less real-type zero y))
         (putnam-1975-a2-less
          real-type
          zero
          (putnam-1975-a2-mul real-type x y))))))))

(defun putnam-1975-a2-real-list-p (real-type values)
  (if (consp values)
      (and
       (putnam-1975-a2-real-p real-type (car values))
       (putnam-1975-a2-real-list-p real-type (cdr values)))
    (equal values nil)))

(defun putnam-1975-a2-polynomial-value
    (real-type coefficients x)
  (if (consp coefficients)
      (putnam-1975-a2-add
       real-type
       (car coefficients)
       (putnam-1975-a2-mul
        real-type
        x
        (putnam-1975-a2-polynomial-value
         real-type (cdr coefficients) x)))
    (putnam-1975-a2-zero real-type)))

(defun-sk putnam-1975-a2-square-root-exists-p
    (real-type x)
  (exists (root)
    (and
     (putnam-1975-a2-real-p real-type root)
     (not
      (putnam-1975-a2-less
       real-type root (putnam-1975-a2-zero real-type)))
     (equal
      (putnam-1975-a2-mul real-type root root)
      x))))

(defun-sk putnam-1975-a2-nonnegative-square-roots-p
    (real-type)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (and
      (putnam-1975-a2-real-p real-type x)
      (not
       (putnam-1975-a2-less
        real-type x (putnam-1975-a2-zero real-type))))
     (putnam-1975-a2-square-root-exists-p
      real-type x))))

(defun putnam-1975-a2-odd-degree-polynomial-p
    (real-type coefficients)
  (and
   (true-listp coefficients)
   (<= 2 (len coefficients))
   (evenp (len coefficients))

-- Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1975_a2:
-- the real coefficient conditions equivalent to every complex root of a
-- monic quadratic lying strictly inside the unit disk. This file contains no
-- proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc)

infix 4 _!=_
infixr 3 _and_

data Bottom : Set where

Not : Set -> Set
Not A =
  A -> Bottom

_!=_ : {A : Set} -> A -> A -> Set
x != y =
  Not (x == y)

record _and_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data _or_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  left  : A -> A or B
  right : B -> A or B

record Iff (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor equivalence
  field
    forward  : A -> B
    backward : B -> A

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

record CompleteOrderedRealField (R : Set) : Set1 where
  field
    zeroR oneR : R
    add multiply : R -> R -> R
    negate inverse : R -> R
    lessOrEqual : R -> R -> Set
    fromNat : Nat -> R

    one-not-zero :
      oneR != zeroR

    add-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> add x y == add y x
    add-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      add (add x y) z == add x (add y z)
    add-zero :
      (x : R) -> add x zeroR == x
    add-inverse :
      (x : R) -> add x (negate x) == zeroR

    multiply-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> multiply x y == multiply y x
    multiply-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply (multiply x y) z ==
      multiply x (multiply y z)
    multiply-one :
      (x : R) -> multiply x oneR == x
    multiply-zero :
      (x : R) -> multiply x zeroR == zeroR
    distribute :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply x (add y z) ==
      add (multiply x y) (multiply x z)
    inverse-zero :
      inverse zeroR == zeroR
    multiply-inverse :
      (x : R) ->
      x != zeroR ->
      multiply x (inverse x) == oneR

    order-reflexive :
      (x : R) -> lessOrEqual x x
    order-transitive :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y z ->
      lessOrEqual x z
    order-antisymmetric :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y x ->
      x == y
    order-total :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y or lessOrEqual y x
    add-order :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual (add z x) (add z y)
    multiply-nonnegative :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR x ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR y ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR (multiply x y)
    zero-less-than-one :
      lessOrEqual zeroR oneR and zeroR != oneR

    fromNat-zero :
      fromNat zero == zeroR
    fromNat-successor :
      (n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (suc n) == add (fromNat n) oneR

    archimedean :
      (x : R) ->
      Exists Nat (\ n -> lessOrEqual x (fromNat n))
    least-upper-bound :
      (P : R -> Set) ->
      Exists R P ->
      Exists R
        (\ upper ->
          (x : R) ->
          P x ->
          lessOrEqual x upper) ->
      Exists R
        (\ supremum ->
          ((x : R) ->
            P x ->
            lessOrEqual x supremum)
          and
          ((upper : R) ->
            ((x : R) ->
              P x ->
              lessOrEqual x upper) ->
            lessOrEqual supremum upper))

open CompleteOrderedRealField

Less :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
Less reals x y =
  lessOrEqual reals x y and x != y

subtract :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
subtract reals x y =
  add reals x (negate reals y)

record Complex (R : Set) : Set where
  constructor complex
  field
    realPart      : R
    imaginaryPart : R

open Complex

complexZero :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Complex R
complexZero reals =
  complex (zeroR reals) (zeroR reals)

embedReal :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  Complex R
embedReal reals x =
  complex x (zeroR reals)

complexAdd :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Complex R ->
  Complex R ->
  Complex R
complexAdd reals z w =
  complex
    (add reals (realPart z) (realPart w))
    (add reals (imaginaryPart z) (imaginaryPart w))

complexMultiply :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Complex R ->
  Complex R ->
  Complex R
complexMultiply reals z w =
  complex
    (add reals
      (multiply reals (realPart z) (realPart w))
      (negate reals
        (multiply reals (imaginaryPart z) (imaginaryPart w))))
    (add reals
      (multiply reals (realPart z) (imaginaryPart w))
      (multiply reals (imaginaryPart z) (realPart w)))

complexSquaredModulus :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Complex R ->
  R
complexSquaredModulus reals z =
  add reals
    (multiply reals (realPart z) (realPart z))
    (multiply reals (imaginaryPart z) (imaginaryPart z))

module Putnam1975A2Statement
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) where

  quadraticValue : R -> R -> Complex R -> Complex R
  quadraticValue b c z =
    complexAdd reals
      (complexAdd reals
        (complexMultiply reals z z)
        (complexMultiply reals (embedReal reals b) z))
      (embedReal reals c)

  IsQuadraticRoot : R -> R -> Complex R -> Set
  IsQuadraticRoot b c z =
    quadraticValue b c z == complexZero reals

  InsideUnitDisk : Complex R -> Set
  InsideUnitDisk z =
    Less reals (complexSquaredModulus reals z) (oneR reals)

  Solution : R -> R -> Set
  Solution b c =
    Less reals c (oneR reals)
    and
    (Less reals
      (negate reals (oneR reals))
      (subtract reals c b)
    and
    Less reals
      (negate reals (oneR reals))
      (add reals c b))

  proposition : Set
  proposition =
    (b c : R) ->
    Iff
      ((z : Complex R) ->
        IsQuadraticRoot b c z ->
        InsideUnitDisk z)
      (Solution b c)

putnam-1975-a2 : Set1
putnam-1975-a2 =
  (R : Set) ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) ->
  Putnam1975A2Statement.proposition reals

% Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench artifact putnam_1975_a2:
% the real coefficient pairs for which every complex root of
% z^2 + b*z + c lies strictly inside the unit disk. This file contains no proof.

putnam_1975_a2: THEORY
BEGIN
  complex: TYPE = [# real_part: real, imag_part: real #]

  complex_zero: complex =
    (# real_part := 0, imag_part := 0 #)

  complex_of_real(x: real): complex =
    (# real_part := x, imag_part := 0 #)

  complex_add(x, y: complex): complex =
    (# real_part := real_part(x) + real_part(y),
       imag_part := imag_part(x) + imag_part(y) #)

  complex_mul(x, y: complex): complex =
    (# real_part := real_part(x) * real_part(y)
                       - imag_part(x) * imag_part(y),
       imag_part := real_part(x) * imag_part(y)
                       + imag_part(x) * real_part(y) #)

  quadratic_value(b, c: real, z: complex): complex =
    complex_add(
      complex_add(
        complex_mul(z, z),
        complex_mul(complex_of_real(b), z)),
      complex_of_real(c))

  squared_modulus(z: complex): real =
    real_part(z) ^ 2 + imag_part(z) ^ 2

  putnam_1975_a2_solution(b, c: real): bool =
    c < 1 AND c - b > -1 AND c + b > -1

  putnam_1975_a2: bool =
    FORALL (b, c: real):
      (FORALL (z: complex):
        quadratic_value(b, c, z) = complex_zero
          IMPLIES squared_modulus(z) < 1)
      IFF putnam_1975_a2_solution(b, c)
END putnam_1975_a2

import Mathlib

open Polynomial

noncomputable abbrev putnam_1975_a3_solution : ((ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) → (ℝ × ℝ × ℝ)) × ((ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) → (ℝ × ℝ × ℝ)) := sorry
-- (fun (a, b, c) => ((a/b)^(1/(b - a)), (1 - ((a/b)^(1/(b - a)))^b)^(1/b), 0), fun (a, b, c) => (0, (1 - ((b/c)^(1/(c - b)))^b)^(1/b), (b/c)^(1/(c - b))))
/--
If $a$, $b$, and $c$ are real numbers satisfying $0 < a < b < c$, at what points in the set $$\{(x, y, z) \in \mathbb{R}^3 : x^b + y^b + z^b = 1, x \ge 0, y \ge 0, z \ge 0\}$$ does $f(x, y, z) = x^a + y^b + z^c$ attain its maximum and minimum?
-/
theorem putnam_1975_a3
(a b c : ℝ)
(hi : 0 < a ∧ a < b ∧ b < c)
(P : (ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) → Prop)
(f : (ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) → ℝ)
(hP : P = fun (x, y, z) => x ≥ 0 ∧ y ≥ 0 ∧ z ≥ 0 ∧ x^b + y^b + z^b = 1)
(hf : f = fun (x, y, z) => x^a + y^b + z^c)
: (P (putnam_1975_a3_solution.1 (a, b, c)) ∧ ∀ x y z : ℝ, P (x, y, z) →
f (x, y, z) ≤ f (putnam_1975_a3_solution.1 (a, b, c))) ∧
(P (putnam_1975_a3_solution.2 (a, b, c)) ∧ ∀ x y z : ℝ, P (x, y, z) →
f (x, y, z) ≥ f (putnam_1975_a3_solution.2 (a, b, c))) :=
sorry

From mathcomp Require Import all_algebra all_ssreflect.
From mathcomp Require Import reals exp sequences.

Set Implicit Arguments.
Unset Strict Implicit.
Unset Printing Implicit Defensive.

Local Open Scope ring_scope.

Variable R : realType.
Definition putnam_1975_a3_rpow (x r : R) : R :=
  if x == 0 then 0 else expR (r * ln x).

Definition putnam_1975_a3_solution : ((R * R * R) -> (R * R * R)) * ((R * R * R) -> (R * R * R)) :=
    (fun xyz => let '(a, b, c) := xyz in
      let x := putnam_1975_a3_rpow (a / b) (1 / (b - a)) in
      (x, putnam_1975_a3_rpow (1 - putnam_1975_a3_rpow x b) (1 / b), 0),
    fun xyz => let '(a, b, c) := xyz in
      let z := putnam_1975_a3_rpow (b / c) (1 / (c - b)) in
      (0, putnam_1975_a3_rpow (1 - putnam_1975_a3_rpow z b) (1 / b), z)).
Theorem putnam_1975_a3
    (a b c : R)
    (hi : 0 < a /\ a < b < c)
    (P : (R * R * R) -> Prop := fun xyz: R * R * R => let '(x, y, z) := xyz in
      (x >= 0 /\ y >= 0 /\ z >= 0 /\
       putnam_1975_a3_rpow x b + putnam_1975_a3_rpow y b + putnam_1975_a3_rpow z b = 1))
    (f : (R * R * R) -> R := fun xyz: R * R * R => let '(x, y, z) := xyz in
      putnam_1975_a3_rpow x a + putnam_1975_a3_rpow y b + putnam_1975_a3_rpow z c)
    : (P ((fst putnam_1975_a3_solution) (a, b, c)) /\ forall x y z : R, P (x, y, z) ->
    f (x, y, z) <= f ((fst putnam_1975_a3_solution) (a, b, c))) /\
    (P ((snd putnam_1975_a3_solution) (a, b, c)) /\ forall x y z : R, P (x, y, z) ->
    f (x, y, z) >= f ((snd putnam_1975_a3_solution) (a, b, c))).
Proof. Admitted.

;; Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1975_a3:
;; the explicit points where x^a + y^b + z^c attains its maximum and minimum
;; on the nonnegative real surface x^b + y^b + z^b = 1 for 0 < a < b < c.
;; This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))

;; A Dedekind-complete ordered field presents the real numbers. Positive-base
;; real powers are fixed uniquely by their rational values and continuity in
;; the exponent; the zero-base law covers the positive exponents used below.
;; Thus POWER denotes the source real-power operation on every relevant input.

(defun putnam-1975-a3-member-p (carrier x)
  (if (apply$ carrier (list x)) t nil))

(defun putnam-1975-a3-unary (operation x)
  (apply$ operation (list x)))

(defun putnam-1975-a3-binary (operation x y)
  (apply$ operation (list x y)))

(defun putnam-1975-a3-positive-p (carrier less zero x)
  (and
   (putnam-1975-a3-member-p carrier x)
   (apply$ less (list zero x))))

(defun putnam-1975-a3-nonnegative-p (carrier less zero x)
  (and
   (putnam-1975-a3-member-p carrier x)
   (not (apply$ less (list x zero)))))

(defun-sk putnam-1975-a3-field-laws-p
    (carrier zero one add multiply negate inverse)
  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (putnam-1975-a3-member-p carrier x)
      (putnam-1975-a3-member-p carrier y)
      (putnam-1975-a3-member-p carrier z))
     (and
      (putnam-1975-a3-member-p
       carrier (putnam-1975-a3-binary add x y))
      (putnam-1975-a3-member-p
       carrier (putnam-1975-a3-binary multiply x y))
      (putnam-1975-a3-member-p
       carrier (putnam-1975-a3-unary negate x))
      (putnam-1975-a3-member-p
       carrier (putnam-1975-a3-unary inverse x))
      (equal
       (putnam-1975-a3-binary
        add (putnam-1975-a3-binary add x y) z)
       (putnam-1975-a3-binary
        add x (putnam-1975-a3-binary add y z)))
      (equal
       (putnam-1975-a3-binary add x y)
       (putnam-1975-a3-binary add y x))
      (equal (putnam-1975-a3-binary add x zero) x)
      (equal
       (putnam-1975-a3-binary
        add x (putnam-1975-a3-unary negate x))
       zero)
      (equal
       (putnam-1975-a3-binary
        multiply (putnam-1975-a3-binary multiply x y) z)
       (putnam-1975-a3-binary
        multiply x (putnam-1975-a3-binary multiply y z)))
      (equal
       (putnam-1975-a3-binary multiply x y)
       (putnam-1975-a3-binary multiply y x))
      (equal (putnam-1975-a3-binary multiply x one) x)
      (equal (putnam-1975-a3-unary inverse zero) zero)
      (implies
       (not (equal x zero))
       (equal
        (putnam-1975-a3-binary
         multiply x (putnam-1975-a3-unary inverse x))
        one))
      (equal
       (putnam-1975-a3-binary
        multiply x (putnam-1975-a3-binary add y z))
       (putnam-1975-a3-binary
        add
        (putnam-1975-a3-binary multiply x y)
        (putnam-1975-a3-binary multiply x z)))))))

(defun-sk putnam-1975-a3-order-laws-p
    (carrier zero add multiply less)
  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (putnam-1975-a3-member-p carrier x)
      (putnam-1975-a3-member-p carrier y)
      (putnam-1975-a3-member-p carrier z))
     (and
      (not (apply$ less (list x x)))
      (or
       (equal x y)
       (apply$ less (list x y))
       (apply$ less (list y x)))
      (implies
       (and
        (apply$ less (list x y))
        (apply$ less (list y z)))
       (apply$ less (list x z)))
      (implies
       (apply$ less (list x y))
       (apply$
        less
        (list
         (putnam-1975-a3-binary add x z)
         (putnam-1975-a3-binary add y z))))
      (implies
       (and
        (apply$ less (list zero x))
        (apply$ less (list zero y)))
       (apply$
        less
        (list zero
              (putnam-1975-a3-binary multiply x y))))))))

(defun-sk putnam-1975-a3-set-nonempty-p (carrier set)
  (exists (x)
    (and
     (putnam-1975-a3-member-p carrier x)
     (apply$ set (list x)))))

(defun-sk putnam-1975-a3-upper-bound-p
    (carrier less set bound)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (and
      (putnam-1975-a3-member-p carrier x)
      (apply$ set (list x)))
     (not (apply$ less (list bound x))))))

(defun-sk putnam-1975-a3-bounded-above-p
    (carrier less set)
  (exists (bound)
    (and
     (putnam-1975-a3-member-p carrier bound)
     (putnam-1975-a3-upper-bound-p
      carrier less set bound))))

(defun-sk putnam-1975-a3-supremum-p
    (carrier less set supremum)
  (forall (bound)
    (and
     (putnam-1975-a3-member-p carrier supremum)
     (putnam-1975-a3-upper-bound-p
      carrier less set supremum)
     (implies
      (and
       (putnam-1975-a3-member-p carrier bound)
       (putnam-1975-a3-upper-bound-p
        carrier less set bound))
      (not (apply$ less (list bound supremum)))))))

(defun-sk putnam-1975-a3-has-supremum-p
    (carrier less set)
  (exists (supremum)
    (putnam-1975-a3-supremum-p
     carrier less set supremum)))

(defun-sk putnam-1975-a3-dedekind-complete-p
    (carrier less)
  (forall (set)
    (implies
     (and
      (tamep-functionp set)
      (putnam-1975-a3-set-nonempty-p carrier set)
      (putnam-1975-a3-bounded-above-p carrier less set))
     (putnam-1975-a3-has-supremum-p
      carrier less set))))

(defun putnam-1975-a3-real-field-p
    (carrier zero one add multiply negate inverse less)
  (and
   (tamep-functionp carrier)
   (tamep-functionp add)
   (tamep-functionp multiply)
   (tamep-functionp negate)
   (tamep-functionp inverse)
   (tamep-functionp less)
   (putnam-1975-a3-member-p carrier zero)
   (putnam-1975-a3-member-p carrier one)
   (not (equal zero one))
   (putnam-1975-a3-field-laws-p
    carrier zero one add multiply negate inverse)
   (putnam-1975-a3-order-laws-p
    carrier zero add multiply less)
   (apply$ less (list zero one))
   (putnam-1975-a3-dedekind-complete-p carrier less)))

(defun putnam-1975-a3-natural
    (n zero one add)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix n)))
  (if (zp n)
      zero
    (putnam-1975-a3-binary
     add one
     (putnam-1975-a3-natural (- n 1) zero one add))))

(defun putnam-1975-a3-integer
    (n zero one add negate)
  (if (< n 0)
      (putnam-1975-a3-unary
       negate
       (putnam-1975-a3-natural (- n) zero one add))
    (putnam-1975-a3-natural n zero one add)))

(defun putnam-1975-a3-natural-power
    (base exponent one multiply)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix exponent)))
  (if (zp exponent)
      one
    (putnam-1975-a3-binary
     multiply
     (putnam-1975-a3-natural-power
      base (- exponent 1) one multiply)
     base)))

(defun putnam-1975-a3-integer-power
    (base exponent one multiply inverse)
  (if (< exponent 0)
      (putnam-1975-a3-unary
       inverse
       (putnam-1975-a3-natural-power
        base (- exponent) one multiply))
    (putnam-1975-a3-natural-power
     base exponent one multiply)))

(defun-sk putnam-1975-a3-power-typing-p
    (carrier zero less power)
  (forall (base exponent)
    (implies
     (and
      (putnam-1975-a3-positive-p carrier less zero base)
      (putnam-1975-a3-member-p carrier exponent))
     (putnam-1975-a3-positive-p
      carrier less zero
      (putnam-1975-a3-binary power base exponent)))))

(defun-sk putnam-1975-a3-power-rational-laws-p
    (carrier zero one add multiply negate inverse less power)
  (forall (base numerator denominator)
    (implies
     (and
      (putnam-1975-a3-positive-p carrier less zero base)
      (integerp numerator)
      (posp denominator))
     (equal
      (putnam-1975-a3-natural-power
       (putnam-1975-a3-binary
        power
        base
        (putnam-1975-a3-binary
         multiply
         (putnam-1975-a3-integer
          numerator zero one add negate)
         (putnam-1975-a3-unary
          inverse
          (putnam-1975-a3-natural
           denominator zero one add))))
       denominator one multiply)
      (putnam-1975-a3-integer-power
       base numerator one multiply inverse)))))

(defun putnam-1975-a3-absolute (zero negate less x)
  (if (apply$ less (list x zero))
      (putnam-1975-a3-unary negate x)
    x))

(defun putnam-1975-a3-distance
    (zero add negate less x y)
  (putnam-1975-a3-absolute
   zero negate less
   (putnam-1975-a3-binary
    add x (putnam-1975-a3-unary negate y))))

(defun-sk putnam-1975-a3-power-neighborhood-p
    (carrier zero add negate less power
     base exponent epsilon delta)
  (forall (y)
    (implies
     (and
      (putnam-1975-a3-member-p carrier y)
      (apply$
       less
       (list
        (putnam-1975-a3-distance
         zero add negate less y exponent)
        delta)))
     (apply$
      less
      (list
       (putnam-1975-a3-distance
        zero add negate less
        (putnam-1975-a3-binary power base y)
        (putnam-1975-a3-binary power base exponent))
       epsilon)))))

(defun-sk putnam-1975-a3-power-delta-exists-p
    (carrier zero add negate less power
     base exponent epsilon)
  (exists (delta)
    (and
     (putnam-1975-a3-positive-p carrier less zero delta)
     (putnam-1975-a3-power-neighborhood-p
      carrier zero add negate less power
      base exponent epsilon delta))))

(defun-sk putnam-1975-a3-power-continuous-p
    (carrier zero add negate less power)
  (forall (base exponent epsilon)
    (implies
     (and
      (putnam-1975-a3-positive-p carrier less zero base)
      (putnam-1975-a3-member-p carrier exponent)
      (putnam-1975-a3-positive-p carrier less zero epsilon))
     (putnam-1975-a3-power-delta-exists-p
      carrier zero add negate less power
      base exponent epsilon))))

(defun-sk putnam-1975-a3-zero-base-power-p
    (carrier zero less power)
  (forall (exponent)
    (implies
     (putnam-1975-a3-positive-p carrier less zero exponent)
     (equal
      (putnam-1975-a3-binary power zero exponent)
      zero))))

(defun putnam-1975-a3-real-power-p
    (carrier zero one add multiply negate inverse less power)
  (and
   (tamep-functionp power)
   (putnam-1975-a3-power-typing-p
    carrier zero less power)
   (putnam-1975-a3-power-rational-laws-p
    carrier zero one add multiply negate inverse less power)
   (putnam-1975-a3-power-continuous-p
    carrier zero add negate less power)
   (putnam-1975-a3-zero-base-power-p
    carrier zero less power)))

(defun putnam-1975-a3-add (add x y)
  (putnam-1975-a3-binary add x y))

(defun putnam-1975-a3-negate (negate x)
  (putnam-1975-a3-unary negate x))

(defun putnam-1975-a3-subtract (add negate x y)
  (putnam-1975-a3-add
   add x (putnam-1975-a3-negate negate y)))

(defun putnam-1975-a3-multiply (multiply x y)
  (putnam-1975-a3-binary multiply x y))

(defun putnam-1975-a3-divide (multiply inverse x y)
  (putnam-1975-a3-multiply
   multiply x (putnam-1975-a3-unary inverse y)))

(defun putnam-1975-a3-power (power base exponent)
  (putnam-1975-a3-binary power base exponent))

(defun putnam-1975-a3-less-equal-p (less x y)
  (not (apply$ less (list y x))))

(defun putnam-1975-a3-feasible-p
    (carrier zero one add power less b point)
  (let ((x (nth 0 point))
        (y (nth 1 point))
        (z (nth 2 point)))
    (and
     (putnam-1975-a3-nonnegative-p carrier less zero x)
     (putnam-1975-a3-nonnegative-p carrier less zero y)
     (putnam-1975-a3-nonnegative-p carrier less zero z)
     (equal
      (putnam-1975-a3-add
       add
       (putnam-1975-a3-add
        add
        (putnam-1975-a3-power power x b)
        (putnam-1975-a3-power power y b))
       (putnam-1975-a3-power power z b))
      one))))

(defun putnam-1975-a3-objective
    (add power a b c point)
  (let ((x (nth 0 point))
        (y (nth 1 point))
        (z (nth 2 point)))
    (putnam-1975-a3-add
     add
     (putnam-1975-a3-add
      add
      (putnam-1975-a3-power power x a)
      (putnam-1975-a3-power power y b))
     (putnam-1975-a3-power power z c))))

(defun putnam-1975-a3-maximum-point
    (zero one add multiply negate inverse power a b)
  (let* ((a-over-b
          (putnam-1975-a3-divide multiply inverse a b))
         (b-minus-a
          (putnam-1975-a3-subtract add negate b a))
         (one-over-b-minus-a
          (putnam-1975-a3-divide
           multiply inverse one b-minus-a))
         (x
          (putnam-1975-a3-power
           power a-over-b one-over-b-minus-a))
         (x-to-b
          (putnam-1975-a3-power power x b))
         (one-minus-x-to-b
          (putnam-1975-a3-subtract
           add negate one x-to-b))
         (one-over-b
          (putnam-1975-a3-divide multiply inverse one b))
         (y
          (putnam-1975-a3-power
           power one-minus-x-to-b one-over-b)))
    (list x y zero)))

(defun putnam-1975-a3-minimum-point
    (zero one add multiply negate inverse power b c)
  (let* ((b-over-c
          (putnam-1975-a3-divide multiply inverse b c))
         (c-minus-b
          (putnam-1975-a3-subtract add negate c b))
         (one-over-c-minus-b
          (putnam-1975-a3-divide
           multiply inverse one c-minus-b))
         (z
          (putnam-1975-a3-power
           power b-over-c one-over-c-minus-b))
         (z-to-b
          (putnam-1975-a3-power power z b))
         (one-minus-z-to-b
          (putnam-1975-a3-subtract
           add negate one z-to-b))
         (one-over-b
          (putnam-1975-a3-divide multiply inverse one b))
         (y
          (putnam-1975-a3-power
           power one-minus-z-to-b one-over-b)))
    (list zero y z)))

(defun-sk putnam-1975-a3-global-maximum-p
    (carrier zero one add power less a b c point)
  (forall (x y z)
    (let ((candidate (list x y z)))
      (implies
       (putnam-1975-a3-feasible-p
        carrier zero one add power less b candidate)
       (putnam-1975-a3-less-equal-p
        less
        (putnam-1975-a3-objective
         add power a b c candidate)
        (putnam-1975-a3-objective
         add power a b c point))))))

(defun-sk putnam-1975-a3-global-minimum-p
    (carrier zero one add power less a b c point)
  (forall (x y z)
    (let ((candidate (list x y z)))
      (implies
       (putnam-1975-a3-feasible-p
        carrier zero one add power less b candidate)
       (putnam-1975-a3-less-equal-p
        less
        (putnam-1975-a3-objective
         add power a b c point)
        (putnam-1975-a3-objective
         add power a b c candidate))))))

(defun putnambench-putnam-1975-a3-statement
    (carrier zero one add multiply negate inverse less power a b c)
  (implies
   (and
    (putnam-1975-a3-real-field-p
     carrier zero one add multiply negate inverse less)
    (putnam-1975-a3-real-power-p
     carrier zero one add multiply negate inverse less power)
    (putnam-1975-a3-positive-p carrier less zero a)
    (putnam-1975-a3-member-p carrier b)
    (putnam-1975-a3-member-p carrier c)
    (apply$ less (list a b))
    (apply$ less (list b c)))
   (let ((maximum-point
          (putnam-1975-a3-maximum-point
           zero one add multiply negate inverse power a b))
         (minimum-point
          (putnam-1975-a3-minimum-point
           zero one add multiply negate inverse power b c)))
     (and
      (putnam-1975-a3-feasible-p
       carrier zero one add power less b maximum-point)
      (putnam-1975-a3-global-maximum-p
       carrier zero one add power less a b c maximum-point)
      (putnam-1975-a3-feasible-p
       carrier zero one add power less b minimum-point)
      (putnam-1975-a3-global-minimum-p
       carrier zero one add power less a b c minimum-point)))))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

title: putnam_1975_a3
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1975_a3:
-- the explicit maximum and minimum points of a real-power objective on a
-- nonnegative real-power constraint surface. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module Putnam1975A3 where

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; _*_)

infix 4 _!=_ _<=N_
infixr 3 _and_
infixr 2 _or_

data Bottom : Set where

Not : Set -> Set
Not A =
  A -> Bottom

_!=_ : {A : Set} -> A -> A -> Set
x != y =
  Not (x == y)

record _and_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data _or_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  left  : A -> A or B
  right : B -> A or B

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

data _<=N_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set where
  zero<=   : {n : Nat} -> zero <=N n
  suc<=suc : {m n : Nat} -> m <=N n -> suc m <=N suc n

record CompleteOrderedRealField (R : Set) : Set1 where
  field
    zeroR oneR : R
    add multiply : R -> R -> R
    negate inverse : R -> R
    lessOrEqual : R -> R -> Set
    fromNat : Nat -> R

    one-not-zero :
      oneR != zeroR

    add-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> add x y == add y x
    add-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      add (add x y) z == add x (add y z)
    add-zero :
      (x : R) -> add x zeroR == x
    add-inverse :
      (x : R) -> add x (negate x) == zeroR

    multiply-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> multiply x y == multiply y x
    multiply-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply (multiply x y) z ==
      multiply x (multiply y z)
    multiply-one :
      (x : R) -> multiply x oneR == x
    multiply-zero :
      (x : R) -> multiply x zeroR == zeroR
    distribute :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply x (add y z) ==
      add (multiply x y) (multiply x z)
    inverse-zero :
      inverse zeroR == zeroR
    multiply-inverse :
      (x : R) ->
      x != zeroR ->
      multiply x (inverse x) == oneR

    order-reflexive :
      (x : R) -> lessOrEqual x x
    order-transitive :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y z ->
      lessOrEqual x z
    order-antisymmetric :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y x ->
      x == y
    order-total :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y or lessOrEqual y x
    add-order :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual (add z x) (add z y)
    multiply-nonnegative :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR x ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR y ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR (multiply x y)
    zero-less-than-one :
      lessOrEqual zeroR oneR and zeroR != oneR

    fromNat-zero :
      fromNat zero == zeroR
    fromNat-successor :
      (n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (suc n) == add (fromNat n) oneR
    fromNat-addition :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m + n) == add (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-multiplication :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m * n) == multiply (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-injective :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat m == fromNat n ->
      m == n

    archimedean :
      (x : R) ->
      Exists Nat (\ n -> lessOrEqual x (fromNat n))
    least-upper-bound :
      (P : R -> Set) ->
      Exists R P ->
      Exists R
        (\ upper ->
          (x : R) ->
          P x ->
          lessOrEqual x upper) ->
      Exists R
        (\ supremum ->
          ((x : R) ->
            P x ->
            lessOrEqual x supremum)
          and
          ((upper : R) ->
            ((x : R) ->
              P x ->
              lessOrEqual x upper) ->
            lessOrEqual supremum upper))

open CompleteOrderedRealField

subtract :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
subtract reals x y =
  add reals x (negate reals y)

divide :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
divide reals x y =
  multiply reals x (inverse reals y)

StrictLess :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
StrictLess reals x y =
  lessOrEqual reals x y and x != y

CloseTo :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
CloseTo reals center radius x =
  StrictLess reals
    (subtract reals center radius)
    x
  and
  StrictLess reals
    x
    (add reals center radius)

naturalPower :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  Nat ->
  R
naturalPower reals x zero =
  oneR reals
naturalPower reals x (suc n) =
  multiply reals
    (naturalPower reals x n)
    x

factorial : Nat -> Nat
factorial zero =
  suc zero
factorial (suc n) =
  suc n * factorial n

sumFirst :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Nat ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  R
sumFirst reals zero term =
  zeroR reals
sumFirst reals (suc n) term =
  add reals
    (sumFirst reals n term)
    (term n)

ConvergesTo :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  R ->
  Set
ConvergesTo {R} reals sequence limit =
  (epsilon : R) ->
  StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) epsilon ->
  Exists Nat
    (\ cutoff ->
      (n : Nat) ->
      cutoff <=N n ->
      CloseTo reals limit epsilon (sequence n))

SeriesHasSum :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  R ->
  Set
SeriesHasSum reals terms limit =
  ConvergesTo reals
    (\ n -> sumFirst reals n terms)
    limit

exponentialTerm :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  Nat ->
  R
exponentialTerm reals x n =
  divide reals
    (naturalPower reals x n)
    (fromNat reals (factorial n))

ExponentialValue :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
ExponentialValue reals x value =
  SeriesHasSum reals
    (exponentialTerm reals x)
    value

record StandardNonnegativeRealPowers
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) :
  Set1 where

  field
    exponential logarithm : R -> R
    realPower : R -> R -> R

    exponential-series :
      (x : R) ->
      ExponentialValue reals x (exponential x)

    exponential-positive :
      (x : R) ->
      StrictLess reals
        (zeroR reals)
        (exponential x)

    exponential-injective :
      (x y : R) ->
      exponential x == exponential y ->
      x == y

    exponential-logarithm :
      (x : R) ->
      StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) x ->
      exponential (logarithm x) == x

    positive-base-power :
      (base exponent : R) ->
      StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) base ->
      realPower base exponent ==
      exponential
        (multiply reals exponent (logarithm base))

    zero-positive-power :
      (exponent : R) ->
      StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) exponent ->
      realPower (zeroR reals) exponent == zeroR reals

open StandardNonnegativeRealPowers

record Triple (R : Set) : Set where
  constructor triple
  field
    firstCoordinate  : R
    secondCoordinate : R
    thirdCoordinate  : R

open Triple

module Putnam1975A3Statement
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R)
  (powers : StandardNonnegativeRealPowers reals) where

  powerSum : R -> Triple R -> R
  powerSum exponent point =
    add reals
      (add reals
        (realPower powers (firstCoordinate point) exponent)
        (realPower powers (secondCoordinate point) exponent))
      (realPower powers (thirdCoordinate point) exponent)

  Feasible : R -> Triple R -> Set
  Feasible exponent point =
    lessOrEqual reals (zeroR reals) (firstCoordinate point)
    and
    lessOrEqual reals (zeroR reals) (secondCoordinate point)
    and
    lessOrEqual reals (zeroR reals) (thirdCoordinate point)
    and
    powerSum exponent point == oneR reals

  objective : R -> R -> R -> Triple R -> R
  objective a b c point =
    add reals
      (add reals
        (realPower powers (firstCoordinate point) a)
        (realPower powers (secondCoordinate point) b))
      (realPower powers (thirdCoordinate point) c)

  maximumFirstCoordinate : R -> R -> R
  maximumFirstCoordinate a b =
    realPower powers
      (divide reals a b)
      (divide reals
        (oneR reals)
        (subtract reals b a))

  maximumSecondCoordinate : R -> R -> R
  maximumSecondCoordinate a b =
    realPower powers
      (subtract reals
        (oneR reals)
        (realPower powers
          (maximumFirstCoordinate a b)
          b))
      (divide reals (oneR reals) b)

  maximumPoint : R -> R -> R -> Triple R
  maximumPoint a b c =
    triple
      (maximumFirstCoordinate a b)
      (maximumSecondCoordinate a b)
      (zeroR reals)

  minimumThirdCoordinate : R -> R -> R
  minimumThirdCoordinate b c =
    realPower powers
      (divide reals b c)
      (divide reals
        (oneR reals)
        (subtract reals c b))

  minimumSecondCoordinate : R -> R -> R
  minimumSecondCoordinate b c =
    realPower powers
      (subtract reals
        (oneR reals)
        (realPower powers
          (minimumThirdCoordinate b c)
          b))
      (divide reals (oneR reals) b)

  minimumPoint : R -> R -> R -> Triple R
  minimumPoint a b c =
    triple
      (zeroR reals)
      (minimumSecondCoordinate b c)
      (minimumThirdCoordinate b c)

  IsMaximumPoint : R -> R -> R -> Triple R -> Set
  IsMaximumPoint a b c candidate =
    Feasible b candidate
    and
    ((point : Triple R) ->
      Feasible b point ->
      lessOrEqual reals
        (objective a b c point)
        (objective a b c candidate))

  IsMinimumPoint : R -> R -> R -> Triple R -> Set
  IsMinimumPoint a b c candidate =
    Feasible b candidate
    and
    ((point : Triple R) ->
      Feasible b point ->
      lessOrEqual reals
        (objective a b c candidate)
        (objective a b c point))

  proposition : Set
  proposition =
    (a b c : R) ->
    StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) a ->
    StrictLess reals a b ->
    StrictLess reals b c ->
    IsMaximumPoint a b c (maximumPoint a b c)
    and
    IsMinimumPoint a b c (minimumPoint a b c)

putnam-1975-a3 : Set1
putnam-1975-a3 =
  (R : Set) ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) ->
  (powers : StandardNonnegativeRealPowers reals) ->
  Putnam1975A3Statement.proposition reals powers

(*
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench artifact putnam_1975_a3:
  the explicit points where x^a + y^b + z^c attains its maximum and
  minimum on the nonnegative real surface x^b + y^b + z^b = 1 for
  0 < a < b < c. This file contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open pairTheory realTheory transcTheory;

val putnam_1975_a3 =
  ``!a b c : real.
      0 < a /\ a < b /\ b < c
      ==>
      let solution =
        ((\a b c : real.
            (((a / b) powr (1 / (b - a)),
              (1 - ((a / b) powr (1 / (b - a))) powr b)
                powr (1 / b)),
             0)),
         (\a b c : real.
            ((0,
              (1 - ((b / c) powr (1 / (c - b))) powr b)
                powr (1 / b)),
             (b / c) powr (1 / (c - b)))))
      in
      let feasible =
        \p : (real # real) # real.
          0 <= FST (FST p) /\
          0 <= SND (FST p) /\
          0 <= SND p /\
          FST (FST p) powr b +
            SND (FST p) powr b +
            SND p powr b = 1
      in
      let objective =
        \p : (real # real) # real.
          FST (FST p) powr a +
            SND (FST p) powr b +
            SND p powr c
      in
      let pmax = (FST solution) a b c in
      let pmin = (SND solution) a b c in
        (feasible pmax /\
         !x y z : real.
           feasible ((x, y), z) ==> objective ((x, y), z) <= objective pmax) /\
        (feasible pmin /\
         !x y z : real.
           feasible ((x, y), z) ==> objective pmin <= objective ((x, y), z))``;

  database contains no $p proof statement.

title: putnam_1975_a3
content:
% Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench artifact putnam_1975_a3:
% the explicit maximum and minimum points of x^a + y^b + z^c on the
% nonnegative surface x^b + y^b + z^b = 1 for 0 < a < b < c.
% This file contains no proof.

putnam_1975_a3: THEORY
BEGIN
  point: TYPE =
    [# x_coord: real, y_coord: real, z_coord: real #]

  safe_div(numerator, denominator: real): real =
    IF denominator = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      numerator / denominator
    ENDIF

  nat_factorial(index: nat): RECURSIVE nat =
    IF index = 0 THEN
      1
    ELSE
      index * nat_factorial(index - 1)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE index

  exponential_partial(x: real, count: nat): RECURSIVE real =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      LET index: nat = count - 1 IN
        exponential_partial(x, count - 1)
          + safe_div(
              x ^ index,
              nat_factorial(index) :: real)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  converges_to(sequence: [nat -> real], value: real): bool =
    FORALL (epsilon_value: posreal):
      EXISTS (cutoff: nat):
        FORALL (index: nat):
          cutoff <= index IMPLIES
            abs(sequence(index) - value) < epsilon_value

  real_exponential(x: real): real =
    epsilon(
      LAMBDA (value: real):
        converges_to(
          LAMBDA (count: nat):
            exponential_partial(x, count),
          value))

  natural_log(x: real): real =
    IF x > 0 THEN
      epsilon(
        LAMBDA (value: real):
          real_exponential(value) = x)
    ELSE
      0
    ENDIF

  real_power(base, exponent: real): real =
    IF base > 0 THEN
      real_exponential(exponent * natural_log(base))
    ELSIF base = 0 AND exponent = 0 THEN
      1
    ELSE
      0
    ENDIF

  feasible(p: point, b: real): bool =
    x_coord(p) >= 0
      AND y_coord(p) >= 0
      AND z_coord(p) >= 0
      AND real_power(x_coord(p), b)
        + real_power(y_coord(p), b)
        + real_power(z_coord(p), b)
        = 1

  objective(p: point, a, b, c: real): real =
    real_power(x_coord(p), a)
      + real_power(y_coord(p), b)
      + real_power(z_coord(p), c)

  maximum_point(a, b, c: real): point =
    LET x_value: real =
          real_power(
            safe_div(a, b),
            safe_div(1, b - a))
    IN
      (# x_coord := x_value,
         y_coord :=
           real_power(
             1 - real_power(x_value, b),
             safe_div(1, b)),
         z_coord := 0 #)

  minimum_point(a, b, c: real): point =
    LET z_value: real =
          real_power(
            safe_div(b, c),
            safe_div(1, c - b))
    IN
      (# x_coord := 0,
         y_coord :=
           real_power(
             1 - real_power(z_value, b),
             safe_div(1, b)),
         z_coord := z_value #)

  is_global_maximum(p: point, a, b, c: real): bool =
    feasible(p, b)
      AND FORALL (q: point):
        feasible(q, b) IMPLIES
          objective(q, a, b, c)
            <= objective(p, a, b, c)

  is_global_minimum(p: point, a, b, c: real): bool =
    feasible(p, b)
      AND FORALL (q: point):
        feasible(q, b) IMPLIES
          objective(q, a, b, c)
            >= objective(p, a, b, c)

  putnam_1975_a3: bool =
    FORALL (a, b, c: real):
      (0 < a AND a < b AND b < c)
      IMPLIES
        is_global_maximum(
          maximum_point(a, b, c), a, b, c)
          AND is_global_minimum(
            minimum_point(a, b, c), a, b, c)
END putnam_1975_a3

open Polynomial Real Complex

noncomputable abbrev putnam_1975_a4_solution : ℕ → Polynomial ℤ := sorry
-- fun m => ∑ j ∈ Finset.range ((m - 1) / 2), Polynomial.X ^ (2 * j + 1)
/--
Let $n = 2m$, where $m$ is an odd integer greater than 1. Let $\theta = e^{2\pi i/n}$. Expression $(1 - \theta)^{-1}$ explicitly as a polynomial in $\theta$ \[ a_k \theta^k  + a_{k-1}\theta^{k-1} + \dots + a_1\theta + a_0\], with integer coefficients $a_i$.
-/
theorem putnam_1975_a4
(m : ℕ)
(hm : Odd m ∧ m > 1)
(θ : ℂ)
(hθ : θ = cexp (2 * Real.pi * I / (2 * m)))
: 1/(1 - θ) = Polynomial.aeval θ (putnam_1975_a4_solution m) :=
sorry

title: putnam_1975_a4
content:
(* Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench artifact putnam_1975_a4:
   an integer-coefficient polynomial expression for the reciprocal of one
   minus a specified complex root of unity. This file contains no proof. *)

From Stdlib Require Import Reals ZArith List Arith.

Import ListNotations.

Definition C := (R * R)%type.

Definition RtoC (x : R) : C := (x, 0%R).
Definition Ci : C := (0%R, 1%R).

Definition Cplus (z w : C) : C :=
  ((fst z + fst w)%R, (snd z + snd w)%R).

Definition Copp (z : C) : C :=
  ((- fst z)%R, (- snd z)%R).

Definition Cminus (z w : C) : C :=
  Cplus z (Copp w).

Definition Cmult (z w : C) : C :=
  ((fst z * fst w - snd z * snd w)%R,
   (fst z * snd w + snd z * fst w)%R).

Definition Cinv (z : C) : C :=
  ((fst z / (fst z ^ 2 + snd z ^ 2))%R,
   (- snd z / (fst z ^ 2 + snd z ^ 2))%R).

Definition Cdiv (z w : C) : C :=
  Cmult z (Cinv w).

Definition Re (z : C) : R := fst z.
Definition Im (z : C) : R := snd z.

Definition complex_exp (z : C) : C :=
  ((exp (Re z) * cos (Im z))%R,
   (exp (Re z) * sin (Im z))%R).

Fixpoint add_integer_polynomials (p q : list Z) : list Z :=
  match p, q with
  | [], _ => q
  | _, [] => p
  | a :: p', b :: q' => (a + b)%Z :: add_integer_polynomials p' q'
  end.

Definition integer_monomial (degree : nat) : list Z :=
  repeat 0%Z degree ++ [1%Z].

Fixpoint sum_odd_monomials (count : nat) : list Z :=
  match count with
  | O => []
  | S k =>
      add_integer_polynomials
        (sum_odd_monomials k)
        (integer_monomial (2 * k + 1))
  end.

Definition putnam_1975_a4_solution (m : nat) : list Z :=
  sum_odd_monomials ((m - 1) / 2).

Fixpoint eval_integer_polynomial (p : list Z) (z : C) : C :=
  match p with
  | [] => RtoC 0
  | a :: p' =>
      Cplus (RtoC (IZR a)) (Cmult z (eval_integer_polynomial p' z))
  end.

Theorem putnam_1975_a4
    (m : nat)
    (hm : (exists k : nat, m = 2 * k + 1) /\ (1 < m)%nat)
    (theta : C)
    (htheta :
      theta =
        complex_exp
          (Cdiv
            (Cmult (RtoC (2 * PI)) Ci)
            (RtoC (INR (2 * m))))) :
  Cdiv (RtoC 1) (Cminus (RtoC 1) theta) =
    eval_integer_polynomial (putnam_1975_a4_solution m) theta.
Admitted.

definition putnam_1975_a4_solution :: "nat \<Rightarrow> int poly" where "putnam_1975_a4_solution \<equiv> undefined"

  and "theta \<equiv> exp (2 * pi * \<i> / n)"
