;; Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1975_b6:
;; two strict inequalities comparing harmonic sums with positive real roots
;; of consecutive natural numbers. This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(defun putnam-1975-b6-harmonic-sum (n)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix n)))
  (if (zp n)
      0
    (+ (putnam-1975-b6-harmonic-sum (- n 1))
       (/ 1 n))))

;; For n > 1, all quantities are positive, so strict monotonicity of the
;; nth power on the nonnegative reals makes
;;
;;   n*(n+1)^(1/n) < n+H_n
;;
;; equivalent to the exact rational inequality below.
(defun putnam-1975-b6-first-inequality-p (n)
  (< (+ n 1)
     (expt (/ (+ n (putnam-1975-b6-harmonic-sum n))
              n)
           n)))

;; For n > 2, writing m=n-1 and using n^(-1/m)=1/n^(1/m),
;;
;;   m*n^(-1/m) < n-H_n
;;
;; is equivalently m^m < n*(n-H_n)^m. This is the exponent -1/(n-1)
;; appearing in the Lean and Rocq statements and in the stated problem.
(defun putnam-1975-b6-second-inequality-p (n)
  (< (expt (- n 1) (- n 1))
     (* n
        (expt (- n (putnam-1975-b6-harmonic-sum n))
              (- n 1)))))

(defun putnambench-putnam-1975-b6-statement (n)
  (implies
   (natp n)
   (and
    (implies
     (< 1 n)
     (putnam-1975-b6-first-inequality-p n))
    (implies
     (< 2 n)
     (putnam-1975-b6-second-inequality-p n)))))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

title: putnam_1975_b6
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1975_b6:
-- two strict inequalities bound harmonic partial sums using neighboring
-- natural numbers raised to reciprocal real powers. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module Putnam1975B6 where

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; _*_)

infix 4 _!=_ _<=N_
infixr 3 _and_
infixr 2 _or_

data Bottom : Set where

Not : Set -> Set
Not A =
  A -> Bottom

_!=_ : {A : Set} -> A -> A -> Set
x != y =
  Not (x == y)

record _and_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data _or_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  left  : A -> A or B
  right : B -> A or B

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

data _<=N_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set where
  zero<=N   : {n : Nat} -> zero <=N n
  suc<=sucN : {m n : Nat} -> m <=N n -> suc m <=N suc n

record CompleteOrderedRealField (R : Set) : Set1 where
  field
    zeroR oneR : R
    add multiply : R -> R -> R
    negate inverse : R -> R
    lessOrEqual : R -> R -> Set
    fromNat : Nat -> R

    one-not-zero :
      oneR != zeroR

    add-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> add x y == add y x
    add-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      add (add x y) z == add x (add y z)
    add-zero :
      (x : R) -> add x zeroR == x
    add-inverse :
      (x : R) -> add x (negate x) == zeroR

    multiply-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> multiply x y == multiply y x
    multiply-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply (multiply x y) z ==
      multiply x (multiply y z)
    multiply-one :
      (x : R) -> multiply x oneR == x
    multiply-zero :
      (x : R) -> multiply x zeroR == zeroR
    distribute :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply x (add y z) ==
      add (multiply x y) (multiply x z)
    inverse-zero :
      inverse zeroR == zeroR
    multiply-inverse :
      (x : R) ->
      x != zeroR ->
      multiply x (inverse x) == oneR

    order-reflexive :
      (x : R) -> lessOrEqual x x
    order-transitive :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y z ->
      lessOrEqual x z
    order-antisymmetric :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y x ->
      x == y
    order-total :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y or lessOrEqual y x
    add-order :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual (add z x) (add z y)
    multiply-nonnegative :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR x ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR y ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR (multiply x y)
    zero-less-than-one :
      lessOrEqual zeroR oneR and zeroR != oneR

    fromNat-zero :
      fromNat zero == zeroR
    fromNat-successor :
      (n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (suc n) == add (fromNat n) oneR
    fromNat-addition :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m + n) == add (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-multiplication :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m * n) == multiply (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-injective :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat m == fromNat n ->
      m == n

    archimedean :
      (x : R) ->
      Exists Nat (\ n -> lessOrEqual x (fromNat n))
    least-upper-bound :
      (P : R -> Set) ->
      Exists R P ->
      Exists R
        (\ upper ->
          (x : R) ->
          P x ->
          lessOrEqual x upper) ->
      Exists R
        (\ supremum ->
          ((x : R) ->
            P x ->
            lessOrEqual x supremum)
          and
          ((upper : R) ->
            ((x : R) ->
              P x ->
              lessOrEqual x upper) ->
            lessOrEqual supremum upper))

open CompleteOrderedRealField

subtract :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
subtract reals x y =
  add reals x (negate reals y)

divide :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
divide reals x y =
  multiply reals x (inverse reals y)

StrictLess :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
StrictLess reals x y =
  lessOrEqual reals x y and x != y

CloseTo :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
CloseTo reals center radius x =
  StrictLess reals
    (subtract reals center radius)
    x
  and
  StrictLess reals
    x
    (add reals center radius)

sumFirst :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Nat ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  R
sumFirst reals zero term =
  zeroR reals
sumFirst reals (suc n) term =
  add reals
    (sumFirst reals n term)
    (term n)

ConvergesTo :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  R ->
  Set
ConvergesTo {R} reals sequence limit =
  (epsilon : R) ->
  StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) epsilon ->
  Exists Nat
    (\ cutoff ->
      (n : Nat) ->
      cutoff <=N n ->
      CloseTo reals limit epsilon (sequence n))

SeriesHasSum :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  R ->
  Set
SeriesHasSum reals terms limit =
  ConvergesTo reals
    (\ n -> sumFirst reals n terms)
    limit

naturalPower :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  Nat ->
  R
naturalPower reals x zero =
  oneR reals
naturalPower reals x (suc n) =
  multiply reals
    (naturalPower reals x n)
    x

factorial : Nat -> Nat
factorial zero =
  suc zero
factorial (suc n) =
  suc n * factorial n

exponentialTerm :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  Nat ->
  R
exponentialTerm reals x n =
  divide reals
    (naturalPower reals x n)
    (fromNat reals (factorial n))

ExponentialValue :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
ExponentialValue reals x value =
  SeriesHasSum reals
    (exponentialTerm reals x)
    value

record StandardRealPowers
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) :
  Set1 where

  field
    exponential logarithm : R -> R

    exponential-series :
      (x : R) ->
      ExponentialValue reals x (exponential x)

    exponential-positive :
      (x : R) ->
      StrictLess reals
        (zeroR reals)
        (exponential x)

    exponential-injective :
      (x y : R) ->
      exponential x == exponential y ->
      x == y

    exponential-logarithm :
      (x : R) ->
      StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) x ->
      exponential (logarithm x) == x

open StandardRealPowers

realPower :
  {R : Set} ->
  {reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R} ->
  StandardRealPowers reals ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
realPower {reals = reals} powers base exponent =
  exponential powers
    (multiply reals exponent (logarithm powers base))

sumFromOne :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Nat ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  R
sumFromOne reals zero term =
  zeroR reals
sumFromOne reals (suc n) term =
  add reals
    (sumFromOne reals n term)
    (term (suc n))

harmonicSum :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Nat ->
  R
harmonicSum reals n =
  sumFromOne reals n
    (\ i ->
      divide reals
        (oneR reals)
        (fromNat reals i))

oneN : Nat
oneN =
  suc zero

twoN : Nat
twoN =
  suc oneN

threeN : Nat
threeN =
  suc twoN

module Putnam1975B6Statement
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R)
  (powers : StandardRealPowers reals) where

  firstInequality : Set
  firstInequality =
    (n : Nat) ->
    twoN <=N n ->
    StrictLess reals
      (multiply reals
        (fromNat reals n)
        (realPower powers
          (fromNat reals (suc n))
          (divide reals
            (oneR reals)
            (fromNat reals n))))
      (add reals
        (fromNat reals n)
        (harmonicSum reals n))

  secondInequality : Set
  secondInequality =
    (n : Nat) ->
    threeN <=N n ->
    StrictLess reals
      (multiply reals
        (subtract reals
          (fromNat reals n)
          (oneR reals))
        (realPower powers
          (fromNat reals n)
          (divide reals
            (negate reals (oneR reals))
            (subtract reals
              (fromNat reals n)
              (oneR reals)))))
      (subtract reals
        (fromNat reals n)
        (harmonicSum reals n))

  proposition : Set
  proposition =
    firstInequality and secondInequality

putnam-1975-b6 : Set1
putnam-1975-b6 =
  (R : Set) ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) ->
  (powers : StandardRealPowers reals) ->
  Putnam1975B6Statement.proposition reals powers

$(

  Under the displayed hypotheses, the bases n + 1 and n are positive.
  Consequently set.mm's complex-power operation ^c agrees with the source
  real power exp(exponent * log(base)). The source function s is inlined by
  its defining harmonic-sum expression, a definitional equivalence.

  The final declaration is the single unproved $a corpus statement; this
  database contains no $p proof statement.
$)

${
  $d i n $.

  putnambench-putnam-1975-b6 $a |- (
    A. n e. NN0
      (
        1 < n
        ->
        (
          n
          x.
          (
            ( n + 1 )
            ^c
            ( 1 / n )
          )
        )
        <
        (
          n
          +
          sum_ i e. ( 1 ... n )
            ( 1 / i )
        )
      )
    /\
    A. n e. NN0
      (
        2 < n
        ->
        (
          ( n - 1 )
          x.
          (
            n
            ^c
            (
              ( -u 1 )
              /
              ( n - 1 )
            )
          )
        )
        <
        (
          n
          -
          sum_ i e. ( 1 ... n )
            ( 1 / i )
        )
      )
  ) $.
$}

title: putnam_1975_b6
content:
% Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1975_b6:
% two strict real-power bounds for the harmonic partial sums. This file
% contains no proof.

putnam_1975_b6: THEORY
BEGIN
  real_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> real]

  safe_div(numerator, denominator: real): real =
    IF denominator = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      numerator / denominator
    ENDIF

  nat_factorial(index: nat): RECURSIVE nat =
    IF index = 0 THEN
      1
    ELSE
      index * nat_factorial(index - 1)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE index

  exponential_partial(x: real, count: nat): RECURSIVE real =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      LET index: nat = count - 1 IN
        exponential_partial(x, count - 1)
          + safe_div(
              x ^ index,
              nat_factorial(index) :: real)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  converges_to(sequence: real_sequence, value: real): bool =
    FORALL (epsilon_value: posreal):
      EXISTS (cutoff: nat):
        FORALL (index: nat):
          cutoff <= index IMPLIES
            abs(sequence(index) - value) < epsilon_value

  real_exponential(x: real): real =
    epsilon(
      LAMBDA (value: real):
        converges_to(
          LAMBDA (count: nat):
            exponential_partial(x, count),
          value))

  natural_log(x: real): real =
    IF x > 0 THEN
      epsilon(
        LAMBDA (value: real):
          real_exponential(value) = x)
    ELSE
      0
    ENDIF

  real_power(base, exponent: real): real =
    IF base > 0 THEN
      real_exponential(exponent * natural_log(base))
    ELSIF base = 0 AND exponent = 0 THEN
      1
    ELSE
      0
    ENDIF

  harmonic_sum(n: nat): RECURSIVE real =
    IF n = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      harmonic_sum(n - 1) + safe_div(1, n :: real)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE n

  putnam_1975_b6: bool =
    (FORALL (n: nat):
      n > 1 IMPLIES
        (n :: real)
            * real_power(
                (n + 1) :: real,
                safe_div(1, n :: real))
          < (n :: real) + harmonic_sum(n))
      AND
    (FORALL (n: nat):
      n > 2 IMPLIES
        ((n :: real) - 1)
            * real_power(
                n :: real,
                safe_div(-1, (n :: real) - 1))
          < (n :: real) - harmonic_sum(n))
END putnam_1975_b6

title: putnam_1976_a2

import Mathlib

open MvPolynomial

/--
Let $P(x, y) = x^2y + xy^2$, $Q(x, y) = x^2 + xy + y^2$, $F_n(x, y) = (x + y)^n - x^n - y^n$, and $G_n(x, y) = (x + y)^n + x^n + y^n$. Prove that for all positive integers $n$, either $F_n$ or $G_n$ can be represented as a polynomial in $P$ and $Q$ with integer coefficients.
-/
theorem putnam_1976_a2
    (P Q : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) ℤ)
    (hP : P = X 0 ^ 2 * X 1 + X 0 * X 1 ^ 2)
    (hQ : Q = X 0 ^ 2 + X 0 * X 1 + X 1 ^ 2)
    (F G : ℕ → MvPolynomial (Fin 2) ℤ)
    (hF : ∀ n, F n = (X 0 + X 1) ^ n - X 0 ^ n - X 1 ^ n)
    (hG : ∀ n, G n = (X 0 + X 1) ^ n + X 0 ^ n + X 1 ^ n)
    (n : ℕ)
    (hn : 0 < n) :
    ∃ A : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) ℤ,
      F n = aeval ![P, Q] A ∨
      G n = aeval ![P, Q] A :=
  sorry

title: putnam_1976_a2
content:
(* Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench artifact putnam_1976_a2:
   for every positive integer n, either (x+y)^n-x^n-y^n or
   (x+y)^n+x^n+y^n is an integer polynomial in x^2*y+x*y^2 and
   x^2+x*y+y^2. This file contains no proof. *)

From Stdlib Require Import ZArith List.

Open Scope Z_scope.

Fixpoint zpow_nat (x : Z) (n : nat) : Z :=
  match n with
  | O => 1
  | S k => x * zpow_nat x k
  end.

Fixpoint eval_int_poly (A : list Z) (x : Z) : Z :=
  match A with
  | nil => 0
  | coefficient :: rest =>
      coefficient + x * eval_int_poly rest x
  end.

Fixpoint eval_int_bivariate_poly
    (A : list (list Z)) (x y : Z) : Z :=
  match A with
  | nil => 0
  | coefficient :: rest =>
      eval_int_poly coefficient y +
      x * eval_int_bivariate_poly rest x y
  end.

Definition putnam_1976_a2_P (x y : Z) : Z :=
  zpow_nat x 2 * y + x * zpow_nat y 2.

Definition putnam_1976_a2_Q (x y : Z) : Z :=
  zpow_nat x 2 + x * y + zpow_nat y 2.

Definition putnam_1976_a2_F (n : nat) (x y : Z) : Z :=
  zpow_nat (x + y) n - zpow_nat x n - zpow_nat y n.

Definition putnam_1976_a2_G (n : nat) (x y : Z) : Z :=
  zpow_nat (x + y) n + zpow_nat x n + zpow_nat y n.

Theorem putnam_1976_a2
    (n : nat)
    (hn : (n > 0)%nat) :
  exists A : list (list Z),
    (forall x y : Z,
      putnam_1976_a2_F n x y =
      eval_int_bivariate_poly A
        (putnam_1976_a2_P x y)
        (putnam_1976_a2_Q x y)) \/
    (forall x y : Z,
      putnam_1976_a2_G n x y =
      eval_int_bivariate_poly A
        (putnam_1976_a2_P x y)
        (putnam_1976_a2_Q x y)).
Admitted.

(*
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench artifact putnam_1976_a2:
  for every positive exponent, one of two symmetric integer bivariate
  polynomials is an integer polynomial in x^2*y + x*y^2 and
  x^2 + x*y + y^2. This file contains no proof.
*)

let statement =
  `let eval1 =
     \p:int list. \x:int.
       ITLIST (\c acc. c + x * acc) p (&0) in
   let eval2 =
     \p:(int list)list. \x:int. \y:int.
       eval1 (MAP (\q:int list. eval1 q y) p) x in
   let pform =
     \x:int. \y:int. x pow 2 * y + x * y pow 2 in
   let qform =
     \x:int. \y:int. x pow 2 + x * y + y pow 2 in
   let f =
     \n:num. \x:int. \y:int.
       (x + y) pow n - x pow n - y pow n in
   let g =
     \n:num. \x:int. \y:int.
       (x + y) pow n + x pow n + y pow n in
   !n:num.
     0 < n
     ==> ?a:(int list)list.
           (!x y:int.
              f n x y = eval2 a (pform x y) (qform x y)) \/
           (!x y:int.
              g n x y = eval2 a (pform x y) (qform x y))`;;

title: putnam_1976_a2
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1976_a2:
;; for every positive n, one of two specified symmetric integer polynomials
;; is an integer polynomial in P=x*y*(x+y) and Q=x^2+x*y+y^2. This file
;; contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

;; Put s=x+y and e=x*y. A homogeneous symmetric polynomial of degree n is
;; encoded by the integer list (c_0 ... c_floor(n/2)) representing
;;
;;   sum_k c_k * s^(n-2k) * e^k.
;;
;; In these coordinates P=s*e and Q=s^2-e. The power sum x^n+y^n obeys
;; R_0=2, R_1=s, and R_n=s*R_(n-1)-e*R_(n-2), so the coefficient lists below
;; encode exactly F_n=s^n-R_n and G_n=s^n+R_n.
;;
;; The substitution homomorphism Z[U,V] -> Z[s,e] given by U=s*e and
;; V=s^2-e is injective (U and V are algebraically independent). Therefore a
;; polynomial A(U,V) can evaluate to a homogeneous form of degree n exactly
;; when its weighted-degree-n part does. Its possible monomials are U^i V^j
;; with 3*i+2*j=n. In the displayed coefficient encoding,
;;
;;   U^i V^j = s^i e^i (s^2-e)^j
;;
;; has first nonzero coefficient 1 at index i. Increasing the admissible i by
;; two hence gives a unit-triangular integer basis. The reduction below is
;; zero exactly when an internal integer-polynomial witness A exists; no
;; witness is exposed as a statement parameter.

(defun putnam-1976-a2-form-normalize (coefficients)
  (if (consp coefficients)
      (let ((tail
             (putnam-1976-a2-form-normalize
              (cdr coefficients))))
        (if (and (equal (car coefficients) 0)
                 (not (consp tail)))
            nil
          (cons (car coefficients) tail)))
    nil))

(defun putnam-1976-a2-form-add (left right)
  (cond
   ((consp left)
    (if (consp right)
        (cons (+ (car left) (car right))
              (putnam-1976-a2-form-add
               (cdr left) (cdr right)))
      left))
   (t right)))

(defun putnam-1976-a2-form-scale (scalar coefficients)
  (if (consp coefficients)
      (cons (* scalar (car coefficients))
            (putnam-1976-a2-form-scale
             scalar (cdr coefficients)))
    nil))

(defun putnam-1976-a2-form-subtract (left right)
  (putnam-1976-a2-form-normalize
   (putnam-1976-a2-form-add
    left
    (putnam-1976-a2-form-scale -1 right))))

(defun putnam-1976-a2-zero-prefix (count coefficients)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix count)))
  (if (zp count)
      coefficients
    (cons 0
          (putnam-1976-a2-zero-prefix
           (- count 1) coefficients))))

(defun putnam-1976-a2-form-coefficient (index coefficients)
  (let ((coefficient (nth (nfix index) coefficients)))
    (if (integerp coefficient)
        coefficient
      0)))

;; Multiplication by s leaves the coefficient indices unchanged, while
;; multiplication by e prefixes one zero.
(defun putnam-1976-a2-power-sum-coefficients (n)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix n)))
  (cond
   ((zp n) (list 2))
   ((equal n 1) (list 1))
   (t
    (putnam-1976-a2-form-subtract
     (putnam-1976-a2-power-sum-coefficients
      (- n 1))
     (cons
      0
      (putnam-1976-a2-power-sum-coefficients
       (- n 2)))))))

(defun putnam-1976-a2-f-coefficients (n)
  (putnam-1976-a2-form-subtract
   (list 1)
   (putnam-1976-a2-power-sum-coefficients n)))

(defun putnam-1976-a2-g-coefficients (n)
  (putnam-1976-a2-form-normalize
   (putnam-1976-a2-form-add
    (list 1)
    (putnam-1976-a2-power-sum-coefficients n))))

;; Coefficients of Q^j=(s^2-e)^j.
(defun putnam-1976-a2-q-power-coefficients (j)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix j)))
  (if (zp j)
      (list 1)
    (let ((previous
           (putnam-1976-a2-q-power-coefficients
            (- j 1))))
      (putnam-1976-a2-form-subtract
       previous
       (cons 0 previous)))))

;; Coefficients of P^i*Q^j.
(defun putnam-1976-a2-basis-coefficients (i j)
  (putnam-1976-a2-zero-prefix
   i
   (putnam-1976-a2-q-power-coefficients j)))

(defun putnam-1976-a2-basis-count (n)
  (let* ((n (nfix n))
         (first-i (mod n 2))
         (maximum-i (floor n 3)))
    (if (< maximum-i first-i)
        0
      (+ 1 (floor (- maximum-i first-i) 2)))))

;; Eliminate the unique coefficient of each admissible P^i*Q^j in increasing
;; order of i. The step count enumerates precisely all nonnegative solutions
;; of 3*i+2*j=n.
(defun putnam-1976-a2-reduce-weighted-form
    (coefficients n i steps)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix steps)))
  (if (zp steps)
      (putnam-1976-a2-form-normalize coefficients)
    (let* ((coefficients
            (putnam-1976-a2-form-normalize coefficients))
           (coefficient
            (putnam-1976-a2-form-coefficient
             i coefficients))
           (j
            (floor (- (nfix n) (* 3 (nfix i))) 2))
           (basis
            (putnam-1976-a2-basis-coefficients
             i j)))
      (putnam-1976-a2-reduce-weighted-form
       (putnam-1976-a2-form-subtract
        coefficients
        (putnam-1976-a2-form-scale
         coefficient basis))
       n
       (+ (nfix i) 2)
       (- steps 1)))))

(defun putnam-1976-a2-polynomial-in-p-q-p
    (coefficients n)
  (equal
   (putnam-1976-a2-reduce-weighted-form
    coefficients
    n
    (mod (nfix n) 2)
    (putnam-1976-a2-basis-count n))
   nil))

(defun putnambench-putnam-1976-a2-statement (n)
  (implies
   (and (natp n)
        (< 0 n))
   (or
    (putnam-1976-a2-polynomial-in-p-q-p
     (putnam-1976-a2-f-coefficients n)
     n)
    (putnam-1976-a2-polynomial-in-p-q-p
     (putnam-1976-a2-g-coefficients n)
     n))))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

title: putnam_1976_a2
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1976_a2:
-- for every positive integer n, either (x+y)^n-x^n-y^n or
-- (x+y)^n+x^n+y^n is an integer polynomial in x^2y+xy^2 and x^2+xy+y^2.
-- This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

open import Agda.Builtin.Bool using (Bool; true; false)
open import Agda.Builtin.Equality using (_≡_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Int using (Int; pos; negsuc)
open import Agda.Builtin.List using (List; []; _∷_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; _*_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Sigma using (Σ)

data Positive : Nat → Set where
  positive : {n : Nat} → Positive (suc n)

data Choice (A B : Set) : Set where
  choose-left  : A → Choice A B
  choose-right : B → Choice A B

one : Nat
one =
  suc zero

two : Nat
two =
  suc one

negative : Nat → Int
negative zero =
  pos zero
negative (suc n) =
  negsuc n

difference : Nat → Nat → Int
difference zero zero =
  pos zero
difference (suc m) zero =
  pos (suc m)
difference zero (suc n) =
  negsuc n
difference (suc m) (suc n) =
  difference m n

addInt : Int → Int → Int
addInt (pos m) (pos n) =
  pos (m + n)
addInt (pos m) (negsuc n) =
  difference m (suc n)
addInt (negsuc m) (pos n) =
  difference n (suc m)
addInt (negsuc m) (negsuc n) =
  negsuc (suc (m + n))

negateInt : Int → Int
negateInt (pos n) =
  negative n
negateInt (negsuc n) =
  pos (suc n)

multiplyInt : Int → Int → Int
multiplyInt (pos m) (pos n) =
  pos (m * n)
multiplyInt (pos m) (negsuc n) =
  negative (m * suc n)
multiplyInt (negsuc m) (pos n) =
  negative (suc m * n)
multiplyInt (negsuc m) (negsuc n) =
  pos (suc m * suc n)

sameNat : Nat → Nat → Bool
sameNat zero zero =
  true
sameNat zero (suc n) =
  false
sameNat (suc m) zero =
  false
sameNat (suc m) (suc n) =
  sameNat m n

andBool : Bool → Bool → Bool
andBool true b =
  b
andBool false b =
  false

ifInt : Bool → Int → Int → Int
ifInt true when-true when-false =
  when-true
ifInt false when-true when-false =
  when-false

record Monomial : Set where
  constructor monomial
  field
    coefficient    : Int
    firstExponent  : Nat
    secondExponent : Nat

open Monomial

Polynomial : Set
Polynomial =
  List Monomial

coefficientAt : Polynomial → Nat → Nat → Int
coefficientAt [] i j =
  pos zero
coefficientAt (term ∷ terms) i j =
  addInt
    (ifInt
      (andBool
        (sameNat (firstExponent term) i)
        (sameNat (secondExponent term) j))
      (coefficient term)
      (pos zero))
    (coefficientAt terms i j)

PolynomialEqual : Polynomial → Polynomial → Set
PolynomialEqual p q =
  (i j : Nat) → coefficientAt p i j ≡ coefficientAt q i j

appendPolynomial : Polynomial → Polynomial → Polynomial
appendPolynomial [] q =
  q
appendPolynomial (term ∷ terms) q =
  term ∷ appendPolynomial terms q

negatePolynomial : Polynomial → Polynomial
negatePolynomial [] =
  []
negatePolynomial (term ∷ terms) =
  monomial
    (negateInt (coefficient term))
    (firstExponent term)
    (secondExponent term)
  ∷ negatePolynomial terms

subtractPolynomial : Polynomial → Polynomial → Polynomial
subtractPolynomial p q =
  appendPolynomial p (negatePolynomial q)

multiplyMonomial : Monomial → Monomial → Monomial
multiplyMonomial p q =
  monomial
    (multiplyInt (coefficient p) (coefficient q))
    (firstExponent p + firstExponent q)
    (secondExponent p + secondExponent q)

multiplyByMonomial : Monomial → Polynomial → Polynomial
multiplyByMonomial term [] =
  []
multiplyByMonomial term (factor ∷ factors) =
  multiplyMonomial term factor ∷ multiplyByMonomial term factors

multiplyPolynomial : Polynomial → Polynomial → Polynomial
multiplyPolynomial [] q =
  []
multiplyPolynomial (term ∷ terms) q =
  appendPolynomial
    (multiplyByMonomial term q)
    (multiplyPolynomial terms q)

constantPolynomial : Int → Polynomial
constantPolynomial c =
  monomial c zero zero ∷ []

onePolynomial : Polynomial
onePolynomial =
  constantPolynomial (pos one)

firstVariable : Polynomial
firstVariable =
  monomial (pos one) one zero ∷ []

secondVariable : Polynomial
secondVariable =
  monomial (pos one) zero one ∷ []

powerPolynomial : Polynomial → Nat → Polynomial
powerPolynomial p zero =
  onePolynomial
powerPolynomial p (suc n) =
  multiplyPolynomial p (powerPolynomial p n)

scalePolynomial : Int → Polynomial → Polynomial
scalePolynomial c [] =
  []
scalePolynomial c (term ∷ terms) =
  monomial
    (multiplyInt c (coefficient term))
    (firstExponent term)
    (secondExponent term)
  ∷ scalePolynomial c terms

substituteMonomial : Monomial → Polynomial → Polynomial → Polynomial
substituteMonomial term p q =
  scalePolynomial
    (coefficient term)
    (multiplyPolynomial
      (powerPolynomial p (firstExponent term))
      (powerPolynomial q (secondExponent term)))

substitute : Polynomial → Polynomial → Polynomial → Polynomial
substitute [] p q =
  []
substitute (term ∷ terms) p q =
  appendPolynomial
    (substituteMonomial term p q)
    (substitute terms p q)

P : Polynomial
P =
  appendPolynomial
    (multiplyPolynomial
      (powerPolynomial firstVariable two)
      secondVariable)

$(

  ( 2o mPoly ZZring ) is set.mm's ring of finite-support bivariate
  polynomials over the integers, and ( 2o eval ZZring ) evaluates such a

  integer pair x,y. Since ZZ is an infinite integral domain, equality of
  integer bivariate polynomials is equivalent to equality at all integer
  pairs, so this is the extensional form of the source polynomial identity.

  database contains no $p proof statement.

  $d A i n x y $.

content:
% Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1976_a2:
% for every positive integer n, either F_n or G_n is a polynomial with
% integer coefficients in P = x^2*y + x*y^2 and Q = x^2 + x*y + y^2.
% This file contains no proof.

putnam_1976_a2: THEORY
BEGIN
  coefficient_table: TYPE = [nat, nat -> int]

  row_value(
      coefficients: coefficient_table,
      first_index: nat,
      second_value: int,
      count: nat): RECURSIVE int =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      LET second_index: nat = count - 1 IN
        row_value(
          coefficients, first_index, second_value, count - 1)
          + coefficients(first_index, second_index)
              * second_value ^ second_index
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  bivariate_polynomial_value(
      coefficients: coefficient_table,
      first_value, second_value: int,
      first_count, second_count: nat): RECURSIVE int =
    IF first_count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      LET first_index: nat = first_count - 1 IN
        bivariate_polynomial_value(
          coefficients,
          first_value,
          second_value,
          first_count - 1,
          second_count)
          + row_value(
              coefficients,
              first_index,
              second_value,
              second_count)
              * first_value ^ first_index
    ENDIF
  MEASURE first_count

  finite_polynomial_support(
      coefficients: coefficient_table,
      first_count, second_count: nat): bool =
    FORALL (i, j: nat):
      (first_count <= i OR second_count <= j)
        IMPLIES coefficients(i, j) = 0

  P_value(x, y: int): int =
    x ^ 2 * y + x * y ^ 2

  Q_value(x, y: int): int =
    x ^ 2 + x * y + y ^ 2

  F_value(n: nat, x, y: int): int =
    (x + y) ^ n - x ^ n - y ^ n

  G_value(n: nat, x, y: int): int =
    (x + y) ^ n + x ^ n + y ^ n

  putnam_1976_a2: bool =
    FORALL (n: nat):
      n > 0 IMPLIES
        EXISTS
            (A: coefficient_table),
            (first_count, second_count: nat):
          finite_polynomial_support(
            A, first_count, second_count)
            AND
          ((FORALL (x, y: int):
              F_value(n, x, y)
                = bivariate_polynomial_value(
                    A,
                    P_value(x, y),
                    Q_value(x, y),
                    first_count,
                    second_count))
            OR
           (FORALL (x, y: int):
              G_value(n, x, y)
                = bivariate_polynomial_value(
                    A,
                    P_value(x, y),
                    Q_value(x, y),
                    first_count,
                    second_count)))
END putnam_1976_a2

;; Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1976_a3:
;; the complete natural-number classification of prime powers that differ by
;; one in absolute value. This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(defun putnam-1976-a3-no-divisor-through-p (p candidate)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix candidate)))
  (if (or (not (natp candidate))
          (<= candidate 1))
      t
    (and
     (not (equal (mod p candidate) 0))
     (putnam-1976-a3-no-divisor-through-p
      p (- candidate 1)))))

(defun putnam-1976-a3-prime-p (p)
  (and
   (natp p)
   (< 1 p)
   (putnam-1976-a3-no-divisor-through-p
    p (- p 1))))

(defun putnam-1976-a3-equation-p (p r q s)
  (and
   (putnam-1976-a3-prime-p p)
   (putnam-1976-a3-prime-p q)
   (< 1 r)
   (< 1 s)
   (equal
    (abs (- (expt p r) (expt q s)))
    1)))

(defun putnam-1976-a3-solution-p (p r q s)
  (or
   (and (equal p 3)
        (equal r 2)
        (equal q 2)
        (equal s 3))
   (and (equal p 2)
        (equal r 3)
        (equal q 3)
        (equal s 2))))

(defun putnambench-putnam-1976-a3-statement (p r q s)
  (implies
   (and (natp p)
        (natp r)
        (natp q)
        (natp s))
   (equal
    (putnam-1976-a3-equation-p p r q s)
    (putnam-1976-a3-solution-p p r q s))))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

title: putnam_1976_a3
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1976_a3:
-- the natural prime-power equation |p^r - q^s| = 1 with r,s > 1 has exactly
-- the solutions (3,2,2,3) and (2,3,3,2). This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _*_)

infix 4 _<=_ _divides_
infixr 8 _^_
infixr 3 _and_
infixr 2 _or_
infix 1 _iff_

data _<=_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set where
  zero<= : {n : Nat} -> zero <= n
  suc<=suc : {m n : Nat} -> m <= n -> suc m <= suc n

record _and_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first : A
    second : B

data _or_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  left : A -> A or B
  right : B -> A or B

record _iff_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor equivalence
  field
    forward : A -> B
    backward : B -> A

record _divides_ (divisor dividend : Nat) : Set where
  field
    quotient : Nat
    division-equation : dividend == divisor * quotient

record Prime (p : Nat) : Set where
  field
    at-least-two : 2 <= p
    only-trivial-divisors :
      (d : Nat) ->
      d divides p ->
      (d == 1) or (d == p)

_^_ : Nat -> Nat -> Nat
base ^ zero = 1
base ^ suc exponent = (base ^ exponent) * base

DiffersByOne : Nat -> Nat -> Set
DiffersByOne x y =
  (suc x == y) or (suc y == x)

Qualifies : Nat -> Nat -> Nat -> Nat -> Set
Qualifies p r q s =
  Prime p
  and
  Prime q
  and
  2 <= r
  and
  2 <= s
  and
  DiffersByOne (p ^ r) (q ^ s)

putnam-1976-a3-solution : Nat -> Nat -> Nat -> Nat -> Set
putnam-1976-a3-solution p r q s =
  (p == 3 and r == 2 and q == 2 and s == 3)
  or
  (p == 2 and r == 3 and q == 3 and s == 2)

putnam-1976-a3 : Set
putnam-1976-a3 =
  (p r q s : Nat) ->
  Qualifies p r q s iff putnam-1976-a3-solution p r q s

% Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1976_a3:
% the prime-power equation |p^r - q^s| = 1 with r,s > 1 has exactly the
% solutions (p,r,q,s) = (3,2,2,3) and (2,3,3,2). This file contains no proof.

putnam_1976_a3: THEORY
BEGIN
  nat_divides(divisor: posnat, value: nat): bool =
    EXISTS (quotient: nat):
      value = divisor * quotient

  prime_nat(value: nat): bool =
    value >= 2
      AND FORALL (divisor: posnat):
        nat_divides(divisor, value)
          IMPLIES divisor = 1 OR divisor = value

  putnam_1976_a3_solution(p, r, q, s: nat): bool =
    (p = 3 AND r = 2 AND q = 2 AND s = 3)
      OR (p = 2 AND r = 3 AND q = 3 AND s = 2)

  putnam_1976_a3: bool =
    FORALL (p, r, q, s: nat):
      ((prime_nat(p)
          AND prime_nat(q)
          AND r > 1
          AND s > 1
          AND abs((p :: int) ^ r - (q :: int) ^ s) = 1)
        IFF putnam_1976_a3_solution(p, r, q, s))
END putnam_1976_a3

title: putnam_1976_a4

import Mathlib

open Polynomial

noncomputable abbrev putnam_1976_a4_solution : (ℝ → ℝ) × (ℝ → ℝ) := sorry
-- (fun r : ℝ => -1/(r + 1), fun r : ℝ => -(r + 1)/r)
/--
Let $r$ be a real root of $P(x) = x^3 + ax^2 + bx - 1$, where $a$ and $b$ are integers and $P$ is irreducible over the rationals. Suppose that $r + 1$ is a root of $x^3 + cx^2 + dx + 1$, where $c$ and $d$ are also integers. Express another root $s$ of $P$ as a function of $r$ that does not depend on the values of $a$, $b$, $c$, or $d$.
-/
theorem putnam_1976_a4
(a b c d : ℤ)
(r : ℝ)
(P Q: Polynomial ℚ)
(hP : P = X^3 + (C (a : ℚ))*X^2 + (C (b : ℚ))*X - (C 1) ∧ aeval r P = 0 ∧ Irreducible P)
(hQ : Q =  X^3 + (C (c : ℚ))*X^2 + (C (d : ℚ))*X + (C 1) ∧ aeval (r + 1) Q = 0)

(* Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench artifact putnam_1976_a4:
   roots of related integer cubics and the coefficient-independent form of
   another root of the irreducible cubic. This file contains no proof. *)

From Stdlib Require Import Reals ZArith QArith.

Open Scope R_scope.

Definition putnam_1976_a4_solution : (R -> R) * (R -> R) :=
  (fun r : R => -1 / (r + 1), fun r : R => -(r + 1) / r).

Definition putnam_1976_a4_P (a b : Z) (x : R) : R :=
  x ^ 3 + IZR a * x ^ 2 + IZR b * x - 1.

Definition putnam_1976_a4_Q (c d : Z) (x : R) : R :=
  x ^ 3 + IZR c * x ^ 2 + IZR d * x + 1.

Definition putnam_1976_a4_irreducible (a b : Z) : Prop :=
  forall q : Q,
    (q ^ 3 + inject_Z a * q ^ 2 + inject_Z b * q - 1)%Q <> 0%Q.

Theorem putnam_1976_a4 :
  forall (a b c d : Z) (r : R),
    putnam_1976_a4_P a b r = 0 ->
    putnam_1976_a4_irreducible a b ->
    putnam_1976_a4_Q c d (r + 1) = 0 ->
    exists s : R,
      putnam_1976_a4_P a b s = 0 /\
      (s = fst putnam_1976_a4_solution r \/
       s = snd putnam_1976_a4_solution r).
Admitted.

title: putnam_1976_a4
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1976_a4:
;; an irreducible integer cubic and a shifted integer cubic force one of two
;; explicit rational functions of a real root to be another root.
;; This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

;; Coefficient lists are in ascending degree order.  For
;;
;;   P(X) = X^3 + a*X^2 + b*X - 1,
;;
;; irreducibility over the rationals is equivalent to the absence of a
;; rational root.  The rational-root theorem reduces this, for this monic
;; cubic, to P(1) = a+b and P(-1) = a-b-2 both being nonzero.
(defun putnam-1976-a4-irreducible-p (a b)
  (and (integerp a)
       (integerp b)
       (not (equal (+ a b) 0))
       (not (equal (- (- a b) 2) 0))))

;; If P is irreducible and r is any of its real roots, then P is the minimal
;; polynomial of r.  Hence a polynomial F of degree at most three vanishes at
;; r exactly when its remainder modulo P is zero.  Subtracting the leading
;; coefficient of F times P gives the three remainder coefficients below.
;; This is an exact algebraic encoding of the source real root, not a
;; restriction to rational roots.
(defun putnam-1976-a4-zero-at-p-root-p (polynomial a b)
  (let ((leading (nth 3 polynomial)))
    (and
     (equal (+ (nth 0 polynomial) leading) 0)
     (equal (- (nth 1 polynomial)
               (* leading b))
            0)
     (equal (- (nth 2 polynomial)
               (* leading a))
            0))))

;; Q(X+1), where Q(X) = X^3 + c*X^2 + d*X + 1.
(defun putnam-1976-a4-shifted-q (c d)
  (list (+ (+ c d) 2)
        (+ (+ 3 (* 2 c)) d)
        (+ 3 c)
        1))

;; With t = r+1, this is the coefficient list of
;; t^3 * P(-1/t).  Irreducibility makes t nonzero because P(-1) is nonzero.
(defun putnam-1976-a4-first-candidate-numerator (a b)
  (list (- (- a b) 2)
        (- (- a (* 2 b)) 3)
        (- (- b) 3)
        -1))

;; This is the coefficient list of
;; r^3 * P(-(r+1)/r).  Here r is nonzero because P(0) = -1.
(defun putnam-1976-a4-second-candidate-numerator (a b)
  (list -1
        (- a 3)
        (- (- (* 2 a) b) 3)
        (- (- a b) 2)))

;; The source existential
;;
;;   exists s, P(s)=0 and
;;     (s=-1/(r+1) or s=-(r+1)/r)
;;
;; is equivalent to the disjunction that one of those two displayed values
;; is a root.  The two numerator polynomials above clear only nonzero
;; denominators.  Likewise, Q(r+1)=0 is represented exactly by vanishing of
;; Q(X+1) in the quotient by the minimal polynomial P.
(defun putnambench-putnam-1976-a4-statement (a b c d)
  (implies
   (and (integerp a)
        (integerp b)
        (integerp c)
        (integerp d)
        (putnam-1976-a4-irreducible-p a b)
        (putnam-1976-a4-zero-at-p-root-p
         (putnam-1976-a4-shifted-q c d)
         a b))
   (or
    (putnam-1976-a4-zero-at-p-root-p
     (putnam-1976-a4-first-candidate-numerator a b)
     a b)
    (putnam-1976-a4-zero-at-p-root-p
     (putnam-1976-a4-second-candidate-numerator a b)
     a b))))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

title: putnam_1976_a4
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1976_a4:
-- an irreducible integer cubic with roots related by a unit translation has
-- another root equal to one of two explicit rational functions. This file
-- contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Int using (Int; pos; negsuc)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; _*_)

infix 4 _!=_
infixr 3 _and_
infixr 2 _or_

data Bottom : Set where

Not : Set -> Set
Not A =
  A -> Bottom

_!=_ : {A : Set} -> A -> A -> Set
x != y =
  Not (x == y)

record _and_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data _or_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  left  : A -> A or B
  right : B -> A or B

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

record CompleteOrderedField (R : Set) : Set1 where
  field
    zeroR oneR : R
    add multiply : R -> R -> R
    negate inverse : R -> R
    lessOrEqual : R -> R -> Set
    fromNat : Nat -> R

    one-not-zero :
      oneR != zeroR

    add-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> add x y == add y x
    add-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      add (add x y) z == add x (add y z)
    add-zero :
      (x : R) -> add x zeroR == x
    add-inverse :
      (x : R) -> add x (negate x) == zeroR

    multiply-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> multiply x y == multiply y x
    multiply-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply (multiply x y) z ==
      multiply x (multiply y z)
    multiply-one :
      (x : R) -> multiply x oneR == x
    multiply-zero :
      (x : R) -> multiply x zeroR == zeroR
    distribute :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply x (add y z) ==
      add (multiply x y) (multiply x z)
    inverse-zero :
      inverse zeroR == zeroR
    multiply-inverse :
      (x : R) ->
      x != zeroR ->
      multiply x (inverse x) == oneR

    order-reflexive :
      (x : R) -> lessOrEqual x x
    order-transitive :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y z ->
      lessOrEqual x z
    order-antisymmetric :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y x ->
      x == y
    order-total :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y or lessOrEqual y x
    add-order :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual (add z x) (add z y)
    multiply-nonnegative :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR x ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR y ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR (multiply x y)
    zero-less-than-one :
      lessOrEqual zeroR oneR and zeroR != oneR

    fromNat-zero :
      fromNat zero == zeroR
    fromNat-successor :
      (n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (suc n) == add (fromNat n) oneR
    fromNat-addition :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m + n) == add (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-multiplication :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m * n) == multiply (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-injective :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat m == fromNat n ->
      m == n

    archimedean :
      (x : R) ->
      Exists Nat (\ n -> lessOrEqual x (fromNat n))
    least-upper-bound :
      (P : R -> Set) ->
      Exists R P ->
      Exists R
        (\ upper ->
          (x : R) ->
          P x ->
          lessOrEqual x upper) ->
      Exists R
        (\ supremum ->
          ((x : R) ->
            P x ->
            lessOrEqual x supremum)
          and
          ((upper : R) ->
            ((x : R) ->
              P x ->
              lessOrEqual x upper) ->
            lessOrEqual supremum upper))

open CompleteOrderedField

fromInt :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  Int ->
  R
fromInt reals (pos n) =
  fromNat reals n
fromInt reals (negsuc n) =
  negate reals (fromNat reals (suc n))

divide :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
divide reals x y =
  multiply reals x (inverse reals y)

square :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  R
square reals x =
  multiply reals x x

cube :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  R
cube reals x =
  multiply reals (square reals x) x

cubicMinusOne :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  Int ->
  Int ->
  R ->
  R
cubicMinusOne reals a b x =
  add reals
    (add reals
      (add reals
        (cube reals x)
        (multiply reals
          (fromInt reals a)
          (square reals x)))
      (multiply reals (fromInt reals b) x))
    (negate reals (oneR reals))

cubicPlusOne :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  Int ->
  Int ->
  R ->
  R
cubicPlusOne reals c d x =
  add reals
    (add reals
      (add reals
        (cube reals x)
        (multiply reals
          (fromInt reals c)
          (square reals x)))
      (multiply reals (fromInt reals d) x))
    (oneR reals)

IsRational :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  Set
IsRational reals x =
  Exists Int
    (\ numerator ->
      Exists Int
        (\ denominator ->
          denominator != pos zero
          and
          x ==
          divide reals
            (fromInt reals numerator)
            (fromInt reals denominator)))

IrreducibleCubic :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  Int ->
  Int ->
  Set
IrreducibleCubic {R} reals a b =
  (x : R) ->
  IsRational reals x ->
  Not (cubicMinusOne reals a b x == zeroR reals)

firstSolution :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  R
firstSolution reals r =
  negate reals
    (divide reals
      (oneR reals)
      (add reals r (oneR reals)))

secondSolution :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  R
secondSolution reals r =
  negate reals
    (divide reals
      (add reals r (oneR reals))
      r)

putnam-1976-a4 : Set1
putnam-1976-a4 =
  (R : Set) ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) ->
  (a b c d : Int) ->
  (r : R) ->
  (cubicMinusOne reals a b r == zeroR reals
    and
    IrreducibleCubic reals a b) ->
  cubicPlusOne reals c d
    (add reals r (oneR reals))
    ==
    zeroR reals ->
  Exists R
    (\ s ->
      cubicMinusOne reals a b s == zeroR reals
      and
      (s == firstSolution reals r
        or
        s == secondSolution reals r))

        real_of_int a * s pow 2 +
        real_of_int b * s -

% Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1976_a4:
% an irreducible rational cubic and a shifted integer cubic force another real
% root to be one of two explicit rational functions of the given root.
% This file contains no proof.

putnam_1976_a4: THEORY
BEGIN
  rational_cubic_value(a, b: int, x: rat): rat =
    x ^ 3 + (a :: rat) * x ^ 2 + (b :: rat) * x - 1

  real_cubic_value(a, b: int, x: real): real =
    x ^ 3 + (a :: real) * x ^ 2 + (b :: real) * x - 1

  shifted_real_cubic_value(c, d: int, x: real): real =
    x ^ 3 + (c :: real) * x ^ 2 + (d :: real) * x + 1

  irreducible_over_rationals(a, b: int): bool =
    FORALL (x: rat):
      rational_cubic_value(a, b, x) /= 0

  safe_div(numerator, denominator: real): real =
    IF denominator = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      numerator / denominator
    ENDIF

  putnam_1976_a4_solution_first(r: real): real =
    safe_div(-1, r + 1)

  putnam_1976_a4_solution_second(r: real): real =
    safe_div(-(r + 1), r)

  putnam_1976_a4: bool =
    FORALL (a, b, c, d: int), (r: real):
      (real_cubic_value(a, b, r) = 0
        AND irreducible_over_rationals(a, b)
        AND shifted_real_cubic_value(c, d, r + 1) = 0)
      IMPLIES
        EXISTS (s: real):
          real_cubic_value(a, b, s) = 0
            AND
              (s = putnam_1976_a4_solution_first(r)
                OR s = putnam_1976_a4_solution_second(r))
END putnam_1976_a4

import Mathlib

/--
Suppose that $f : \mathbb{R} \to \mathbb{R}$ is a twice continuously differentiable function such that $|f(x)| \le 1$ for all real $x$ and $(f(0))^2 + (f'(0))^2 = 4$. Prove that $f(y) + f''(y) = 0$ for some real number $y$.
-/
theorem putnam_1976_a6
(f : ℝ → ℝ)
(hfdiff : ContDiff ℝ 2 f)
(hfbd : ∀ x : ℝ, |f x| ≤ 1)
(hf0 : (f 0)^2 + (deriv f 0)^2 = 4)
: ∃ y : ℝ, (f y) + (iteratedDeriv 2 f y) = 0 :=
sorry

    (hfbd : forall x : R, `|f x| <= 1)

title: putnam_1976_a6
putnam_1976_a6
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1976_a6:
;; every twice continuously differentiable real function bounded in absolute
;; value by 1, with f(0)^2 + f'(0)^2 = 4, has a real zero of f + f''.
;; This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))

;; The source theorem is encoded by the absence of its counterexamples.  A
;; code below denotes a rational piecewise-polynomial C2 function on a finite
;; interval, extended by constants on both tails.  Positive rational widths
;; give the segment domains, and each coefficient list is the ascending
;; monomial expansion in the local coordinate u in [0,1].
;;
;; This is a bidirectionally counterexample-preserving representation.
;;
;; * Every valid code is an actual global C2 real function.  Matching values
;;   and first two derivatives give C2 joins, including the constant tails.
;;   Bernstein coefficients in [-1,1] certify |f| <= 1 on every segment.
;;   Strictly positive Bernstein coefficients for either f + f'' or its
;;   negative certify that this continuous function has no real zero.
;;
;; * Conversely, suppose a source counterexample exists.  Its continuous
;;   nonzero f + f'' has one sign; negate f if necessary.  For
;;   E = f^2 + (f')^2, E' = 2*f'*(f + f'').  Since f'(0) is nonzero, a small
;;   translation in the direction in which E increases gives E > 4.  Scaling
;;   the translated function back to E = 4 makes the bound |f| < 1 strict
;;   while preserving the sign of f + f''.  The function can then be joined,
;;   outside a compact interval, through C2 transitions to small positive
;;   constants while retaining both strict inequalities.  C2 approximation
;;   with interpolation at zero, density of rational points on
;;   a^2 + b^2 = 4, and rational polynomial splines produce a code below.
;;   Sufficient Bernstein degree elevation supplies all finite certificates.
;;
;; Thus the finite data are exact counterexample certificates for the
;; arbitrary-function theorem, rather than samples or a finite function table.

(defun putnam-1976-a6-rational-list-p (values)
  (if (consp values)
      (and (rationalp (car values))
           (putnam-1976-a6-rational-list-p (cdr values)))
    (equal values nil)))

(defun putnam-1976-a6-polynomial-value (coefficients point)
  (if (consp coefficients)
      (+ (car coefficients)
         (* point
            (putnam-1976-a6-polynomial-value
             (cdr coefficients) point)))
    0))

(defun putnam-1976-a6-derivative-aux
    (coefficients multiplier)
  (if (consp coefficients)
      (cons (* multiplier (car coefficients))
            (putnam-1976-a6-derivative-aux
             (cdr coefficients) (+ multiplier 1)))
    nil))

(defun putnam-1976-a6-derivative (coefficients)
  (if (consp coefficients)
      (putnam-1976-a6-derivative-aux
       (cdr coefficients) 1)
    nil))

(defun putnam-1976-a6-scale-polynomial
    (factor coefficients)
  (if (consp coefficients)
      (cons (* factor (car coefficients))
            (putnam-1976-a6-scale-polynomial
             factor (cdr coefficients)))
    nil))

(defun putnam-1976-a6-add-polynomials (left right)
  (declare (xargs :measure (+ (acl2-count left)
                              (acl2-count right))))
  (cond
   ((consp left)
    (cons (+ (car left)
             (if (consp right) (car right) 0))
          (putnam-1976-a6-add-polynomials
           (cdr left)
           (if (consp right) (cdr right) nil))))
   ((consp right)
    (cons (car right)
          (putnam-1976-a6-add-polynomials
           nil (cdr right))))
   (t nil)))

(defun putnam-1976-a6-forcing-coefficients
    (coefficients width sign)
  (let* ((first-derivative
          (putnam-1976-a6-derivative coefficients))
         (second-derivative
          (putnam-1976-a6-derivative first-derivative))
         (scaled-second-derivative
          (putnam-1976-a6-scale-polynomial
           (/ 1 (* width width))
           second-derivative)))
    (putnam-1976-a6-scale-polynomial
     sign
     (putnam-1976-a6-add-polynomials
      coefficients scaled-second-derivative))))

(defun putnam-1976-a6-factorial (n)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix n)))
  (if (zp n)
      1
    (* n (putnam-1976-a6-factorial (- n 1)))))

(defun putnam-1976-a6-binomial (n k)
  (if (and (natp n)
           (natp k)
           (<= k n))
      (/ (putnam-1976-a6-factorial n)
         (* (putnam-1976-a6-factorial k)
            (putnam-1976-a6-factorial (- n k))))
    0))

(defun putnam-1976-a6-degree-bound (coefficients)
  (if (consp coefficients)
      (- (len coefficients) 1)
    0))

;; For p(u)=sum_i c_i*u^i, the degree-N Bernstein coefficient at k is
;; sum_i c_i*binomial(k,i)/binomial(N,i).
(defun putnam-1976-a6-bernstein-coefficient
    (coefficients total-degree basis-index power)
  (if (consp coefficients)
      (+ (* (car coefficients)
            (/ (putnam-1976-a6-binomial basis-index power)
               (putnam-1976-a6-binomial total-degree power)))
         (putnam-1976-a6-bernstein-coefficient
          (cdr coefficients)
          total-degree
          basis-index
          (+ power 1)))
    0))

(defun putnam-1976-a6-naturals-down-from (n)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix n)))
  (if (zp n)
      (list 0)
    (cons n
          (putnam-1976-a6-naturals-down-from (- n 1)))))

(defun putnam-1976-a6-bernstein-unit-bounds-p
    (coefficients total-degree basis-indices)
  (if (consp basis-indices)
      (let ((coefficient
             (putnam-1976-a6-bernstein-coefficient
              coefficients
              total-degree
              (car basis-indices)
              0)))
        (and
         (<= -1 coefficient)
         (<= coefficient 1)
         (putnam-1976-a6-bernstein-unit-bounds-p
          coefficients
          total-degree
          (cdr basis-indices))))
    (equal basis-indices nil)))

(defun putnam-1976-a6-unit-bound-certificate-p
    (coefficients certificate-degree)
  (and
   (natp certificate-degree)
   (<= (putnam-1976-a6-degree-bound coefficients)
       certificate-degree)
   (putnam-1976-a6-bernstein-unit-bounds-p
    coefficients
    certificate-degree
    (putnam-1976-a6-naturals-down-from certificate-degree))))

(defun putnam-1976-a6-bernstein-strict-positive-p
    (coefficients total-degree basis-indices)
  (if (consp basis-indices)
      (and
       (< 0
          (putnam-1976-a6-bernstein-coefficient
           coefficients
           total-degree
           (car basis-indices)
           0))
       (putnam-1976-a6-bernstein-strict-positive-p
        coefficients
        total-degree
        (cdr basis-indices)))
    (equal basis-indices nil)))

(defun putnam-1976-a6-positive-certificate-p
    (coefficients certificate-degree)
  (and
   (natp certificate-degree)
   (<= (putnam-1976-a6-degree-bound coefficients)
       certificate-degree)
   (putnam-1976-a6-bernstein-strict-positive-p
    coefficients
    certificate-degree
    (putnam-1976-a6-naturals-down-from certificate-degree))))

(defun putnam-1976-a6-segments-certified-p
    (widths pieces bound-degrees forcing-degrees sign)
  (if (consp widths)
      (and
       (consp pieces)
       (consp bound-degrees)
       (consp forcing-degrees)
       (rationalp (car widths))
       (< 0 (car widths))
       (consp (car pieces))
       (putnam-1976-a6-rational-list-p (car pieces))
       (putnam-1976-a6-unit-bound-certificate-p
        (car pieces) (car bound-degrees))
       (putnam-1976-a6-positive-certificate-p
        (putnam-1976-a6-forcing-coefficients
         (car pieces) (car widths) sign)
        (car forcing-degrees))
       (putnam-1976-a6-segments-certified-p
        (cdr widths)
        (cdr pieces)
        (cdr bound-degrees)
        (cdr forcing-degrees)
        sign))
    (and
     (equal widths nil)
     (equal pieces nil)
     (equal bound-degrees nil)
     (equal forcing-degrees nil))))

(defun putnam-1976-a6-first-derivative-value
    (coefficients point)
  (putnam-1976-a6-polynomial-value
   (putnam-1976-a6-derivative coefficients)
   point))

(defun putnam-1976-a6-second-derivative-value
    (coefficients point)
  (putnam-1976-a6-polynomial-value
   (putnam-1976-a6-derivative
    (putnam-1976-a6-derivative coefficients))
   point))

(defun putnam-1976-a6-c2-joins-p (widths pieces)
  (if (and (consp widths)
           (consp (cdr widths))
           (consp pieces)
           (consp (cdr pieces)))
      (and
       (equal
        (putnam-1976-a6-polynomial-value (car pieces) 1)
        (putnam-1976-a6-polynomial-value (cadr pieces) 0))
       (equal
        (/ (putnam-1976-a6-first-derivative-value
            (car pieces) 1)
           (car widths))
        (/ (putnam-1976-a6-first-derivative-value
            (cadr pieces) 0)
           (cadr widths)))
       (equal
        (/ (putnam-1976-a6-second-derivative-value
            (car pieces) 1)
           (* (car widths) (car widths)))
        (/ (putnam-1976-a6-second-derivative-value
            (cadr pieces) 0)
           (* (cadr widths) (cadr widths))))
       (putnam-1976-a6-c2-joins-p
        (cdr widths) (cdr pieces)))
    t))

(defun putnam-1976-a6-left-tail-compatible-p
    (pieces sign)
  (and
   (consp pieces)
   (equal
    (putnam-1976-a6-first-derivative-value
     (car pieces) 0)
    0)
   (equal
    (putnam-1976-a6-second-derivative-value
     (car pieces) 0)
    0)
   (< 0
      (* sign
         (putnam-1976-a6-polynomial-value
          (car pieces) 0)))))

(defun putnam-1976-a6-right-tail-compatible-p
    (pieces sign)
  (if (consp (cdr pieces))
      (putnam-1976-a6-right-tail-compatible-p
       (cdr pieces) sign)
    (and
     (consp pieces)
     (equal
      (putnam-1976-a6-first-derivative-value
       (car pieces) 1)
      0)
     (equal
      (putnam-1976-a6-second-derivative-value
       (car pieces) 1)
      0)
     (< 0
        (* sign
           (putnam-1976-a6-polynomial-value
            (car pieces) 1))))))

(defun putnam-1976-a6-width-sum (widths)
  (if (consp widths)
      (+ (car widths)
         (putnam-1976-a6-width-sum (cdr widths)))
    0))

(defun putnam-1976-a6-value-at-zero
    (left widths pieces)
  (declare (xargs :measure (acl2-count widths)))
  (if (and (consp widths) (consp pieces))
      (let ((right (+ left (car widths))))
        (if (<= 0 right)
            (putnam-1976-a6-polynomial-value
             (car pieces)
             (/ (- left) (car widths)))
          (putnam-1976-a6-value-at-zero
           right (cdr widths) (cdr pieces))))
    0))

(defun putnam-1976-a6-derivative-at-zero
    (left widths pieces)
  (declare (xargs :measure (acl2-count widths)))
  (if (and (consp widths) (consp pieces))
      (let ((right (+ left (car widths))))
        (if (<= 0 right)
            (/ (putnam-1976-a6-first-derivative-value
                (car pieces)
                (/ (- left) (car widths)))
               (car widths))
          (putnam-1976-a6-derivative-at-zero
           right (cdr widths) (cdr pieces))))
    0))

(defun putnam-1976-a6-spline-counterexample-p
    (left widths pieces bound-degrees forcing-degrees sign)
  (and
   (or (equal sign 1)
       (equal sign -1))
   (rationalp left)
   (<= left 0)
   (consp widths)
   (putnam-1976-a6-segments-certified-p
    widths pieces bound-degrees forcing-degrees sign)
   (<= 0 (+ left (putnam-1976-a6-width-sum widths)))
   (putnam-1976-a6-c2-joins-p widths pieces)
   (putnam-1976-a6-left-tail-compatible-p pieces sign)
   (putnam-1976-a6-right-tail-compatible-p pieces sign)
   (let ((value
          (putnam-1976-a6-value-at-zero
           left widths pieces))
         (derivative
          (putnam-1976-a6-derivative-at-zero
           left widths pieces)))
     (equal (+ (* value value)
               (* derivative derivative))
            4))))

(defun putnambench-putnam-1976-a6-statement
    (left widths pieces bound-degrees forcing-degrees sign)
  (not
   (putnam-1976-a6-spline-counterexample-p
    left widths pieces bound-degrees forcing-degrees sign)))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

title: putnam_1976_a6
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1976_a6:
-- a twice continuously differentiable real function bounded in absolute value
-- by one and satisfying f(0)^2 + f'(0)^2 = 4 has a point where f + f'' is zero.
-- This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; _*_)

infix 4 _!=_
infixr 3 _and_
infixr 2 _or_

data Bottom : Set where

Not : Set -> Set
Not A =
  A -> Bottom

_!=_ : {A : Set} -> A -> A -> Set
x != y =
  Not (x == y)

record _and_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data _or_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  left  : A -> A or B
  right : B -> A or B

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

record CompleteOrderedRealField (R : Set) : Set1 where
  field
    zeroR oneR : R
    add multiply : R -> R -> R
    negate inverse : R -> R
    lessOrEqual : R -> R -> Set
    fromNat : Nat -> R

    one-not-zero :
      oneR != zeroR

    add-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> add x y == add y x
    add-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      add (add x y) z == add x (add y z)
    add-zero :
      (x : R) -> add x zeroR == x
    add-inverse :
      (x : R) -> add x (negate x) == zeroR

    multiply-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> multiply x y == multiply y x
    multiply-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply (multiply x y) z ==
      multiply x (multiply y z)
    multiply-one :
      (x : R) -> multiply x oneR == x
    multiply-zero :
      (x : R) -> multiply x zeroR == zeroR
    distribute :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply x (add y z) ==
      add (multiply x y) (multiply x z)
    inverse-zero :
      inverse zeroR == zeroR
    multiply-inverse :
      (x : R) ->
      x != zeroR ->
      multiply x (inverse x) == oneR

    order-reflexive :
      (x : R) -> lessOrEqual x x
    order-transitive :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y z ->
      lessOrEqual x z
    order-antisymmetric :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y x ->
      x == y
    order-total :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y or lessOrEqual y x
    add-order :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual (add z x) (add z y)
    multiply-nonnegative :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR x ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR y ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR (multiply x y)
    zero-less-than-one :
      lessOrEqual zeroR oneR and zeroR != oneR

    fromNat-zero :
      fromNat zero == zeroR
    fromNat-successor :
      (n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (suc n) == add (fromNat n) oneR
    fromNat-addition :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m + n) == add (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-multiplication :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m * n) == multiply (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-injective :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat m == fromNat n ->
      m == n

    archimedean :
      (x : R) ->
      Exists Nat (\ n -> lessOrEqual x (fromNat n))
    least-upper-bound :
      (P : R -> Set) ->
      Exists R P ->
      Exists R
        (\ upper ->
          (x : R) ->
          P x ->
          lessOrEqual x upper) ->
      Exists R
        (\ supremum ->
          ((x : R) ->
            P x ->
            lessOrEqual x supremum)
          and
          ((upper : R) ->
            ((x : R) ->
              P x ->
              lessOrEqual x upper) ->
            lessOrEqual supremum upper))

open CompleteOrderedRealField

subtract :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
subtract reals x y =
  add reals x (negate reals y)

divide :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
divide reals x y =
  multiply reals x (inverse reals y)

square :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R
square reals x =
  multiply reals x x

StrictLess :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
StrictLess reals x y =
  lessOrEqual reals x y and x != y

CloseTo :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
CloseTo reals center radius x =
  StrictLess reals
    (subtract reals center radius)
    x
  and
  StrictLess reals
    x
    (add reals center radius)

ContinuousAt :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (R -> R) ->
  R ->
  Set
ContinuousAt {R} reals function point =
  (epsilon : R) ->
  StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) epsilon ->
  Exists R
    (\ delta ->
      StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) delta
      and
      ((x : R) ->
        CloseTo reals point delta x ->
        CloseTo reals
          (function point)
          epsilon
          (function x)))

Continuous :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (R -> R) ->
  Set
Continuous {R} reals function =
  (point : R) ->
  ContinuousAt reals function point

differenceQuotient :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (R -> R) ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
differenceQuotient reals function point x =
  divide reals
    (subtract reals (function x) (function point))
    (subtract reals x point)

DerivativeAt :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (R -> R) ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
DerivativeAt {R} reals function point derivativeValue =
  (epsilon : R) ->
  StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) epsilon ->
  Exists R
    (\ delta ->
      StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) delta
      and
      ((x : R) ->
        CloseTo reals point delta x ->
        x != point ->
        CloseTo reals derivativeValue epsilon
          (differenceQuotient reals function point x)))

HasDerivativeAt :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (R -> R) ->
  R ->
  Set
HasDerivativeAt {R} reals function point =
  Exists R
    (\ derivativeValue ->
      DerivativeAt reals function point derivativeValue)

record StandardRealCalculus
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) : Set1 where

  field
    derivative : (R -> R) -> R -> R

    derivative-when-differentiable :
      (function : R -> R) ->
      (point : R) ->
      HasDerivativeAt reals function point ->
      DerivativeAt reals
        function
        point
        (derivative function point)

    derivative-when-not-differentiable :
      (function : R -> R) ->
      (point : R) ->
      Not (HasDerivativeAt reals function point) ->
      derivative function point == zeroR reals

open StandardRealCalculus

TwiceContinuouslyDifferentiable :
  {R : Set} ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) ->
  StandardRealCalculus reals ->
  (R -> R) ->
  Set
TwiceContinuouslyDifferentiable {R} reals calculus function =
  ((point : R) ->
    DerivativeAt reals
      function
      point
      (derivative calculus function point))
  and
  ((point : R) ->
    DerivativeAt reals
      (derivative calculus function)
      point
      (derivative calculus
        (derivative calculus function)
        point))
  and
  Continuous reals
    (derivative calculus
      (derivative calculus function))

AbsoluteValueAtMost :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
AbsoluteValueAtMost reals bound value =
  lessOrEqual reals (negate reals bound) value
  and
  lessOrEqual reals value bound

four :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R
four reals =
  fromNat reals
    (suc (suc (suc (suc zero))))

putnam-1976-a6 : Set1
putnam-1976-a6 =
  (R : Set) ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) ->
  (calculus : StandardRealCalculus reals) ->
  (f : R -> R) ->
  TwiceContinuouslyDifferentiable reals calculus f ->
  ((x : R) ->
    AbsoluteValueAtMost reals
      (oneR reals)
      (f x)) ->
  add reals
    (square reals (f (zeroR reals)))
    (square reals
      (derivative calculus f (zeroR reals)))
    ==
    four reals ->
  Exists R
    (\ y ->
      add reals
        (f y)
        (derivative calculus
          (derivative calculus f)
          y)
      ==
      zeroR reals)

(*

  a twice continuously differentiable real function bounded in absolute value
  by one, with prescribed squared initial value and derivative, has a point
  where its value plus second derivative vanishes. This file contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open pred_setTheory realTheory real_topologyTheory limTheory;

val putnam_1976_a6 =
  ``!f : real -> real.
      (!x : real. higher_differentiable 2 f x) /\
      (diffn 2 f) continuous_on UNIV /\
      (!x : real. abs (f x) <= 1) /\
      (f 0) pow 2 + (diffn 1 f 0) pow 2 = 4
      ==>
      ?y : real. f y + diffn 2 f y = 0``;

$(

    (
      (
        (
          F e. ( ( C^n ` RR ) ` 2 )
          /\
          A. x e. RR
            ( abs ` ( F ` x ) ) <_ 1

        /\

          +
          ( ( ( ( RR Dn F ) ` 1 ) ` 0 ) ^ 2 )

      E. y e. RR
        (
          ( F ` y )
          +
          ( ( ( RR Dn F ) ` 2 ) ` y )
        )
        =
        0
    )

title: putnam_1976_a6
content:
% Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1976_a6:
% a globally twice continuously differentiable real function bounded in
% absolute value by one, with f(0)^2 + f'(0)^2 = 4, has a point where
% f + f'' vanishes. This file contains no proof.

putnam_1976_a6: THEORY
BEGIN
  real_function: TYPE = [real -> real]

  continuous(f: real_function): bool =
    FORALL (x: real), (epsilon_value: posreal):
      EXISTS (delta: posreal):
        FORALL (z: real):
          abs(z - x) < delta IMPLIES
            abs(f(z) - f(x)) < epsilon_value

  has_derivative_at(
      f: real_function,
      derivative, x: real): bool =
    FORALL (epsilon_value: posreal):
      EXISTS (delta: posreal):
        FORALL (h: real):
          (NOT (h = 0) AND abs(h) < delta)
            IMPLIES
              abs(
                f(x + h) - f(x)
                  - derivative * h)
                < epsilon_value * abs(h)

  differentiable_at(f: real_function, x: real): bool =
    EXISTS (derivative: real):
      has_derivative_at(f, derivative, x)

  derivative_value(f: real_function, x: real): real =
    IF differentiable_at(f, x) THEN
      epsilon(
        LAMBDA (derivative: real):
          has_derivative_at(f, derivative, x))
    ELSE
      0
    ENDIF

  derivative_function(f: real_function): real_function =
    LAMBDA (x: real): derivative_value(f, x)

  second_derivative_value(
      f: real_function,
      x: real): real =
    derivative_value(derivative_function(f), x)

  continuously_differentiable(f: real_function): bool =
    (FORALL (x: real): differentiable_at(f, x))
      AND continuous(derivative_function(f))

  continuously_twice_differentiable(
      f: real_function): bool =
    continuously_differentiable(f)
      AND continuously_differentiable(
        derivative_function(f))

  putnam_1976_a6: bool =
    FORALL (f: real_function):
      (continuously_twice_differentiable(f)
        AND (FORALL (x: real): abs(f(x)) <= 1)
        AND f(0) ^ 2
              + derivative_value(f, 0) ^ 2
            = 4)
      IMPLIES
        EXISTS (y: real):
          f(y) + second_derivative_value(f, y) = 0
END putnam_1976_a6

   the limit of a normalized sum of differences of floor functions is

From Stdlib Require Import Reals ZArith.

Open Scope R_scope.

Definition putnam_1976_b1_solution : (nat * nat)%type := (4%nat, 1%nat).

Fixpoint putnam_1976_b1_sum (n k : nat) : R :=
  match k with
  | O => 0
  | S m =>
      putnam_1976_b1_sum n m +
      IZR
        ((Int_part (2 * INR n / INR (S m)) -
          2 * Int_part (INR n / INR (S m)))%Z)
  end.

Definition putnam_1976_b1_sequence (n : nat) : R :=
  / INR n * putnam_1976_b1_sum n n.

Definition putnam_1976_b1_tends_to
    (u : nat -> R) (limit : R) : Prop :=
  forall epsilon : R,
    0 < epsilon ->
    exists N : nat,
      forall n : nat,
        (N <= n)%nat ->
        Rabs (u n - limit) < epsilon.

Theorem putnam_1976_b1 :
  putnam_1976_b1_tends_to putnam_1976_b1_sequence
    (ln (INR (fst putnam_1976_b1_solution)) -
     INR (snd putnam_1976_b1_solution)).
Admitted.
