(*
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench artifact putnam_1976_b3:
  a lower bound for the probability of the intersection of a finite sequence
  of locally dependent events, expressed by a positive recurrence. This file
  contains no proof.
*)

let statement =
  `let seq_tends =
     \(v:num->real) l.
       !e. &0 < e ==> ?N. !m. N <= m ==> abs (v m - l) < e in
   let sigma_algebra =
     \(measurable:(A->bool)->bool).
       {} IN measurable /\
       (:A) IN measurable /\
       (!s:A->bool.
          s IN measurable ==> (:A) DIFF s IN measurable) /\
       (!sets:num->A->bool.
          (!k. sets k IN measurable)
          ==> {w:A | ?k. w IN sets k} IN measurable) in
   let probability_space =
     \(measurable:(A->bool)->bool) (p:(A->bool)->real).
       sigma_algebra measurable /\
       p {} = &0 /\
       p (:A) = &1 /\
       (!s:A->bool. s IN measurable ==> &0 <= p s) /\
       (!sets:num->A->bool.
          (!k. sets k IN measurable) /\
          (!j k. ~(j = k) ==> DISJOINT (sets j) (sets k))
          ==> seq_tends
                (\m. sum {k:num | k < m} (\k. p (sets k)))
                (p {w:A | ?k. w IN sets k})) in
   let independent_events =
     \(p:(A->bool)->real) (s:A->bool) (t:A->bool).
       p (s INTER t) = p s * p t in
   !measurable:(A->bool)->bool
    p:(A->bool)->real
    n:num
    a:real
    u:num->real
    events:num->A->bool.
      probability_space measurable p /\
      1 <= n /\
      &0 <= a /\ a < &1 / &4 /\
      u 0 = &1 /\ u 1 = &1 - a /\
      (!k. 1 <= k
           ==> u (k + 1) = u k - a * u (k - 1)) /\
      (!k. &0 < u k) /\
      (!i. i < n ==> events i IN measurable) /\
      (!i. i < n ==> &1 - a <= p (events i)) /\
      (!i j. i < n /\ j < n /\
             (i + 1 < j \/ j + 1 < i)
             ==> independent_events p (events i) (events j))
      ==> u n <= p {w:A | !i. i < n ==> w IN events i}`;;

title: putnam_1976_b3
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1976_b3:
;; lower bounds for the probability of intersecting a finite sequence of
;; high-probability events with pairwise independence whenever their indices
;; differ by more than one. This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))

;; Standard ACL2 has no primitive real sort. A rational polynomial and a
;; rational isolating interval select one real algebraic number alpha. The
;; parameter a, recurrence values, and atom probabilities are rational
;; polynomials in alpha. Every finite algebraic-real tuple has such a common
;; primitive-element representation. Conversely every valid representation
;; denotes a real tuple. For each fixed n, all hypotheses and the negation of
;; the conclusion are first-order over real closed fields, so transfer between
;; the reals and the real algebraic numbers makes this representation
;; bidirectionally equivalent to the arbitrary-real statement.

(defun putnam-1976-b3-rational-polynomial-p (polynomial)
  (if (consp polynomial)
      (and (rationalp (car polynomial))
           (putnam-1976-b3-rational-polynomial-p (cdr polynomial)))
    (equal polynomial nil)))

(defun putnam-1976-b3-polynomial-list-p (polynomials)
  (if (consp polynomials)
      (and
       (putnam-1976-b3-rational-polynomial-p (car polynomials))
       (putnam-1976-b3-polynomial-list-p (cdr polynomials)))
    (equal polynomials nil)))

(defun putnam-1976-b3-poly-normalize (coefficients)
  (if (consp coefficients)
      (let ((tail
             (putnam-1976-b3-poly-normalize
              (cdr coefficients))))
        (if (and (equal (car coefficients) 0)
                 (not (consp tail)))
            nil
          (cons (car coefficients) tail)))
    nil))

(defun putnam-1976-b3-poly-add (left right)
  (cond
   ((consp left)
    (if (consp right)
        (cons (+ (car left) (car right))
              (putnam-1976-b3-poly-add
               (cdr left) (cdr right)))
      left))
   (t right)))

(defun putnam-1976-b3-poly-scale (scalar polynomial)
  (if (consp polynomial)
      (cons (* scalar (car polynomial))
            (putnam-1976-b3-poly-scale
             scalar (cdr polynomial)))
    nil))

(defun putnam-1976-b3-poly-negate (polynomial)
  (putnam-1976-b3-poly-scale -1 polynomial))

(defun putnam-1976-b3-poly-subtract (left right)
  (putnam-1976-b3-poly-normalize
   (putnam-1976-b3-poly-add
    left
    (putnam-1976-b3-poly-negate right))))

(defun putnam-1976-b3-poly-multiply (left right)
  (if (consp left)
      (putnam-1976-b3-poly-normalize
       (putnam-1976-b3-poly-add
        (putnam-1976-b3-poly-scale (car left) right)
        (cons 0
              (putnam-1976-b3-poly-multiply
               (cdr left) right))))
    nil))

(defun putnam-1976-b3-poly-derivative-aux
    (coefficients degree)
  (if (consp coefficients)
      (cons (* degree (car coefficients))
            (putnam-1976-b3-poly-derivative-aux
             (cdr coefficients) (+ degree 1)))
    nil))

(defun putnam-1976-b3-poly-derivative (polynomial)
  (if (consp polynomial)
      (putnam-1976-b3-poly-normalize
       (putnam-1976-b3-poly-derivative-aux
        (cdr polynomial) 1))
    nil))

(defun putnam-1976-b3-zero-list (count)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix count)))
  (if (zp count)
      nil
    (cons 0
          (putnam-1976-b3-zero-list (- count 1)))))

(defun putnam-1976-b3-poly-monomial (coefficient degree)
  (if (equal coefficient 0)
      nil
    (append
     (putnam-1976-b3-zero-list degree)
     (list coefficient))))

(defun putnam-1976-b3-poly-degree (polynomial)
  (let ((normalized
         (putnam-1976-b3-poly-normalize polynomial)))
    (if (consp normalized)
        (- (len normalized) 1)
      0)))

(defun putnam-1976-b3-poly-leading-coefficient (polynomial)
  (let ((normalized
         (putnam-1976-b3-poly-normalize polynomial)))
    (if (consp normalized)
        (nth (putnam-1976-b3-poly-degree normalized)
             normalized)
      0)))

(defun putnam-1976-b3-poly-divmod-steps
    (remainder divisor quotient steps)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix steps)))
  (if (zp steps)
      (cons
       (putnam-1976-b3-poly-normalize quotient)
       (putnam-1976-b3-poly-normalize remainder))
    (let* ((normalized-remainder
            (putnam-1976-b3-poly-normalize remainder))
           (normalized-divisor
            (putnam-1976-b3-poly-normalize divisor)))
      (if (or (not (consp normalized-remainder))
              (not (consp normalized-divisor))
              (< (putnam-1976-b3-poly-degree
                  normalized-remainder)
                 (putnam-1976-b3-poly-degree
                  normalized-divisor)))
          (cons
           (putnam-1976-b3-poly-normalize quotient)
           normalized-remainder)
        (let* ((degree-difference
                (- (putnam-1976-b3-poly-degree
                    normalized-remainder)
                   (putnam-1976-b3-poly-degree
                    normalized-divisor)))
               (coefficient
                (/ (putnam-1976-b3-poly-leading-coefficient
                    normalized-remainder)
                   (putnam-1976-b3-poly-leading-coefficient
                    normalized-divisor)))
               (term
                (putnam-1976-b3-poly-monomial
                 coefficient degree-difference)))
          (putnam-1976-b3-poly-divmod-steps
           (putnam-1976-b3-poly-subtract
            normalized-remainder
            (putnam-1976-b3-poly-multiply
             term normalized-divisor))
           normalized-divisor
           (putnam-1976-b3-poly-add quotient term)
           (- steps 1)))))))

(defun putnam-1976-b3-poly-divmod (dividend divisor)
  (putnam-1976-b3-poly-divmod-steps
   dividend
   divisor
   nil
   (+ 1 (len (putnam-1976-b3-poly-normalize dividend)))))

(defun putnam-1976-b3-poly-remainder (dividend divisor)
  (cdr (putnam-1976-b3-poly-divmod dividend divisor)))

(defun putnam-1976-b3-poly-gcd-steps (left right steps)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix steps)))
  (let ((normalized-left
         (putnam-1976-b3-poly-normalize left))
        (normalized-right
         (putnam-1976-b3-poly-normalize right)))
    (if (or (zp steps)
            (not (consp normalized-right)))
        normalized-left
      (putnam-1976-b3-poly-gcd-steps
       normalized-right
       (putnam-1976-b3-poly-remainder
        normalized-left normalized-right)
       (- steps 1)))))

(defun putnam-1976-b3-poly-gcd (left right)
  (putnam-1976-b3-poly-gcd-steps
   left
   right
   (+ 2
      (len (putnam-1976-b3-poly-normalize left))
      (len (putnam-1976-b3-poly-normalize right)))))

(defun putnam-1976-b3-sturm-tail
    (previous current steps)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix steps)))
  (let ((normalized-current
         (putnam-1976-b3-poly-normalize current)))
    (if (or (zp steps)
            (not (consp normalized-current)))
        nil
      (cons
       normalized-current
       (putnam-1976-b3-sturm-tail
        normalized-current
        (putnam-1976-b3-poly-negate
         (putnam-1976-b3-poly-remainder
          previous normalized-current))
        (- steps 1))))))

(defun putnam-1976-b3-sturm-chain (polynomial)
  (let ((normalized
         (putnam-1976-b3-poly-normalize polynomial)))
    (if (consp normalized)
        (cons
         normalized
         (putnam-1976-b3-sturm-tail
          normalized
          (putnam-1976-b3-poly-derivative normalized)
          (+ 1 (len normalized))))
      nil)))

(defun putnam-1976-b3-poly-evaluate (polynomial value)
  (if (consp polynomial)
      (+ (car polynomial)
         (* value
            (putnam-1976-b3-poly-evaluate
             (cdr polynomial) value)))
    0))

(defun putnam-1976-b3-chain-values-at (chain value)
  (if (consp chain)
      (cons
       (putnam-1976-b3-poly-evaluate (car chain) value)
       (putnam-1976-b3-chain-values-at
        (cdr chain) value))
    nil))

(defun putnam-1976-b3-sign (value)
  (cond
   ((< value 0) -1)
   ((< 0 value) 1)
   (t 0)))

(defun putnam-1976-b3-sign-variations-aux
    (values previous-sign)
  (if (consp values)
      (let ((current-sign
             (putnam-1976-b3-sign (car values))))
        (cond
         ((equal current-sign 0)
          (putnam-1976-b3-sign-variations-aux
           (cdr values) previous-sign))
         ((equal previous-sign 0)
          (putnam-1976-b3-sign-variations-aux
           (cdr values) current-sign))
         (t
          (+ (if (equal current-sign previous-sign) 0 1)
             (putnam-1976-b3-sign-variations-aux
              (cdr values) current-sign)))))
    0))

(defun putnam-1976-b3-sign-variations (values)
  (putnam-1976-b3-sign-variations-aux values 0))

(defun putnam-1976-b3-open-root-count
    (polynomial lower upper)
  (let ((chain
         (putnam-1976-b3-sturm-chain polynomial)))
    (- (putnam-1976-b3-sign-variations
        (putnam-1976-b3-chain-values-at chain lower))
       (putnam-1976-b3-sign-variations
        (putnam-1976-b3-chain-values-at chain upper)))))

(defun putnam-1976-b3-isolates-one-root-p
    (polynomial lower upper)
  (let ((normalized
         (putnam-1976-b3-poly-normalize polynomial)))
    (and
     (putnam-1976-b3-rational-polynomial-p normalized)
     (consp normalized)
     (< 0 (putnam-1976-b3-poly-degree normalized))
     (rationalp lower)
     (rationalp upper)
     (< lower upper)
     (not (equal
           (putnam-1976-b3-poly-evaluate normalized lower)
           0))
     (not (equal
           (putnam-1976-b3-poly-evaluate normalized upper)
           0))
     (equal
      (putnam-1976-b3-open-root-count
       normalized lower upper)
      1))))

(defun putnam-1976-b3-root-free-p
    (polynomial lower upper)
  (let ((normalized
         (putnam-1976-b3-poly-normalize polynomial)))
    (and
     (putnam-1976-b3-rational-polynomial-p normalized)
     (consp normalized)
     (rationalp lower)
     (rationalp upper)
     (< lower upper)
     (not (equal
           (putnam-1976-b3-poly-evaluate normalized lower)
           0))
     (not (equal
           (putnam-1976-b3-poly-evaluate normalized upper)
           0))
     (equal
      (putnam-1976-b3-open-root-count
       normalized lower upper)
      0))))

(defun putnam-1976-b3-zero-at-root-p
    (primitive value lower upper)
  (let ((normalized-value
         (putnam-1976-b3-poly-normalize value)))
    (or
     (not (consp normalized-value))
     (putnam-1976-b3-isolates-one-root-p
      (putnam-1976-b3-poly-gcd primitive normalized-value)
      lower
      upper))))

(defun putnam-1976-b3-sign-decidable-p
    (primitive value lower upper)
  (or
   (putnam-1976-b3-zero-at-root-p
    primitive value lower upper)
   (putnam-1976-b3-root-free-p value lower upper)))

(defun putnam-1976-b3-sign-at-root
    (primitive value lower upper)
  (if (putnam-1976-b3-zero-at-root-p
       primitive value lower upper)
      0
    (putnam-1976-b3-sign
     (putnam-1976-b3-poly-evaluate value lower))))

(defun putnam-1976-b3-positive-at-root-p
    (primitive value lower upper)
  (and
   (putnam-1976-b3-sign-decidable-p
    primitive value lower upper)
   (equal
    (putnam-1976-b3-sign-at-root
     primitive value lower upper)
    1)))

(defun putnam-1976-b3-nonnegative-at-root-p
    (primitive value lower upper)
  (and
   (putnam-1976-b3-sign-decidable-p
    primitive value lower upper)
   (not
    (equal
     (putnam-1976-b3-sign-at-root
      primitive value lower upper)
     -1))))

;; The finite family of source events is observed only through its joint law.
;; MASSES lists the probabilities of the 2^n Boolean truth assignments. Every
;; measurable source family induces exactly such masses. Conversely the same
;; list is realized on the finite Boolean sample space, so this removes no
;; probability space or event family relevant to the statement.

(defun putnam-1976-b3-bit-p (index bit)
  (equal
   (mod (floor index (expt 2 bit)) 2)
   1))

(defun putnam-1976-b3-sum-event-aux
    (masses index event-index)
  (if (consp masses)
      (putnam-1976-b3-poly-add
       (if (putnam-1976-b3-bit-p index event-index)
           (car masses)
         nil)
       (putnam-1976-b3-sum-event-aux
        (cdr masses) (+ index 1) event-index))
    nil))

(defun putnam-1976-b3-sum-event
    (masses event-index)
  (putnam-1976-b3-sum-event-aux
   masses 0 event-index))

(defun putnam-1976-b3-sum-two-events-aux
    (masses index first second)
  (if (consp masses)
      (putnam-1976-b3-poly-add
       (if (and
            (putnam-1976-b3-bit-p index first)
            (putnam-1976-b3-bit-p index second))
           (car masses)
         nil)
       (putnam-1976-b3-sum-two-events-aux
        (cdr masses) (+ index 1) first second))
    nil))

(defun putnam-1976-b3-sum-two-events
    (masses first second)
  (putnam-1976-b3-sum-two-events-aux
   masses 0 first second))

(defun putnam-1976-b3-poly-sum (polynomials)
  (if (consp polynomials)
      (putnam-1976-b3-poly-add
       (car polynomials)
       (putnam-1976-b3-poly-sum (cdr polynomials)))
    nil))

(defun putnam-1976-b3-all-nonnegative-p
    (primitive values lower upper)
  (if (consp values)
      (and
       (putnam-1976-b3-nonnegative-at-root-p
        primitive (car values) lower upper)
       (putnam-1976-b3-all-nonnegative-p
        primitive (cdr values) lower upper))
    (equal values nil)))

(defun putnam-1976-b3-all-positive-p
    (primitive values lower upper)
  (if (consp values)
      (and
       (putnam-1976-b3-positive-at-root-p
        primitive (car values) lower upper)
       (putnam-1976-b3-all-positive-p
        primitive (cdr values) lower upper))
    (equal values nil)))

(defun putnam-1976-b3-natural-range (count)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix count)))
  (if (zp count)
      nil
    (cons (- count 1)
          (putnam-1976-b3-natural-range (- count 1)))))

;; U-VALUES contains u_0 through u_n. The recurrence and initial values give
;; a unique infinite extension. Under 0 <= a < 1/4 that extension is positive:
;; its characteristic roots are nonnegative and
;; u_k = (r_1^(k+2)-r_2^(k+2))/(r_1-r_2), with the repeated-root limit at
;; a = 1/4. Thus checking the represented prefix is bidirectionally equivalent
;; to retaining the source sequence and its global positivity assumption.

(defun putnam-1976-b3-recurrence-p
    (primitive values a lower upper)
  (if (and (consp values)
           (consp (cdr values))
           (consp (cddr values)))
      (and
       (putnam-1976-b3-zero-at-root-p
        primitive
        (putnam-1976-b3-poly-subtract
         (caddr values)
         (putnam-1976-b3-poly-subtract
          (cadr values)
          (putnam-1976-b3-poly-multiply
           a (car values))))
        lower
        upper)
       (putnam-1976-b3-recurrence-p
        primitive (cdr values) a lower upper))
    t))

(defun putnam-1976-b3-event-bounds-p
    (primitive masses a lower upper indices)
  (if (consp indices)
    (let* ((event-index (car indices))
           (event-probability
            (putnam-1976-b3-sum-event
             masses event-index))
           (one-minus-a
            (putnam-1976-b3-poly-subtract
             (list 1) a))
           (gap
            (putnam-1976-b3-poly-subtract
             event-probability one-minus-a)))
      (and
       (putnam-1976-b3-nonnegative-at-root-p
        primitive gap lower upper)
       (putnam-1976-b3-event-bounds-p
        primitive masses a lower upper (cdr indices))))
    (equal indices nil)))

(defun putnam-1976-b3-pairwise-row-p
    (primitive masses event-index lower upper other-indices)
  (if (consp other-indices)
    (let* ((other-index (car other-indices))
           (intersection
            (putnam-1976-b3-sum-two-events
             masses event-index other-index))
           (product
            (putnam-1976-b3-poly-multiply
             (putnam-1976-b3-sum-event
              masses event-index)
             (putnam-1976-b3-sum-event
              masses other-index))))
      (and
       (if (< 1 (abs (- event-index other-index)))
           (putnam-1976-b3-zero-at-root-p
            primitive
            (putnam-1976-b3-poly-subtract
             intersection product)
            lower
            upper)
         t)
       (putnam-1976-b3-pairwise-row-p
        primitive
        masses
        event-index
        lower
        upper
        (cdr other-indices))))
    (equal other-indices nil)))

(defun putnam-1976-b3-pairwise-independence-p
    (primitive masses lower upper indices all-indices)
  (if (consp indices)
    (let ((event-index (car indices)))
      (and
       (putnam-1976-b3-pairwise-row-p
        primitive
        masses
        event-index
        lower
        upper
        all-indices)
       (putnam-1976-b3-pairwise-independence-p
        primitive
        masses
        lower
        upper
        (cdr indices)
        all-indices)))
    (equal indices nil)))

(defun putnam-1976-b3-common-context-p
    (primitive lower upper n a u-values masses)
  (let* ((quarter-minus-a
          (putnam-1976-b3-poly-subtract
           (list 1/4) a))
         (total-gap
          (putnam-1976-b3-poly-subtract
           (putnam-1976-b3-poly-sum masses)
           (list 1)))
         (u-zero-gap
          (putnam-1976-b3-poly-subtract
           (car u-values) (list 1)))
         (u-one-gap
          (putnam-1976-b3-poly-subtract
           (cadr u-values)
           (putnam-1976-b3-poly-subtract
            (list 1) a))))
    (and
     (putnam-1976-b3-isolates-one-root-p
      primitive lower upper)
     (natp n)
     (< 0 n)
     (putnam-1976-b3-rational-polynomial-p a)
     (putnam-1976-b3-polynomial-list-p u-values)
     (equal (len u-values) (+ n 1))
     (putnam-1976-b3-polynomial-list-p masses)
     (equal (len masses) (expt 2 n))
     (putnam-1976-b3-nonnegative-at-root-p
      primitive a lower upper)
     (putnam-1976-b3-positive-at-root-p
      primitive quarter-minus-a lower upper)
     (putnam-1976-b3-zero-at-root-p
      primitive u-zero-gap lower upper)
     (putnam-1976-b3-zero-at-root-p
      primitive u-one-gap lower upper)
     (putnam-1976-b3-recurrence-p
      primitive u-values a lower upper)
     (putnam-1976-b3-all-positive-p
      primitive u-values lower upper)
     (putnam-1976-b3-all-nonnegative-p
      primitive masses lower upper)
     (putnam-1976-b3-zero-at-root-p
      primitive total-gap lower upper)
     (putnam-1976-b3-event-bounds-p
      primitive
      masses
      a
      lower
      upper
      (putnam-1976-b3-natural-range n)))))

(defun putnam-1976-b3-conclusion-p
    (primitive lower upper n u-values masses)
  (let* ((all-events-probability
          (nth (- (expt 2 n) 1) masses))
         (gap
          (putnam-1976-b3-poly-subtract
           all-events-probability
           (nth n u-values))))
    (putnam-1976-b3-nonnegative-at-root-p
     primitive gap lower upper)))

(defun putnambench-putnam-1976-b3-statement
    (primitive lower upper n a u-values masses)
  (implies
   (and
    (putnam-1976-b3-common-context-p
     primitive lower upper n a u-values masses)
    (putnam-1976-b3-pairwise-independence-p
     primitive
     masses
     lower
     upper
     (putnam-1976-b3-natural-range n)
     (putnam-1976-b3-natural-range n)))
   (putnam-1976-b3-conclusion-p
    primitive lower upper n u-values masses)))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

title: putnam_1976_b3
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1976_b3:
-- a lower bound for the probability of the intersection of locally dependent
-- high-probability events, governed by a positive recurrence. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module Putnam1976B3 where

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; _*_)

infix 4 _!=_ _<=N_ _<N_
infixr 3 _and_
infixr 2 _or_

data Bottom : Set where

record Top : Set where
  constructor top

Not : Set -> Set
Not A =
  A -> Bottom

_!=_ : {A : Set} -> A -> A -> Set
x != y =
  Not (x == y)

record _and_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data _or_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  left  : A -> A or B
  right : B -> A or B

record Iff (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor equivalence
  field
    forward  : A -> B
    backward : B -> A

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

data _<=N_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set where
  zero<=   : {n : Nat} -> zero <=N n
  suc<=suc : {m n : Nat} -> m <=N n -> suc m <=N suc n

data _<N_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set where
  zero<   : {n : Nat} -> zero <N suc n
  suc<suc : {m n : Nat} -> m <N n -> suc m <N suc n

Predicate : Set -> Set1
Predicate A =
  A -> Set

emptySet :
  {A : Set} ->
  Predicate A
emptySet _ =
  Bottom

wholeSet :
  {A : Set} ->
  Predicate A
wholeSet _ =
  Top

complement :
  {A : Set} ->
  Predicate A ->
  Predicate A
complement E x =
  Not (E x)

intersection :
  {A : Set} ->
  Predicate A ->
  Predicate A ->
  Predicate A
intersection E F x =
  E x and F x

countableUnion :
  {A : Set} ->
  (Nat -> Predicate A) ->
  Predicate A
countableUnion sets x =
  Exists Nat (\ n -> sets n x)

PairwiseDisjoint :
  {A : Set} ->
  (Nat -> Predicate A) ->
  Set
PairwiseDisjoint {A} sets =
  (i j : Nat) ->
  i != j ->
  (x : A) ->
  sets i x ->
  sets j x ->
  Bottom

record CompleteOrderedField (R : Set) : Set1 where
  field
    zeroR oneR : R
    add multiply : R -> R -> R
    negate inverse : R -> R
    lessOrEqual : R -> R -> Set
    fromNat : Nat -> R

    one-not-zero :
      oneR != zeroR

    add-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> add x y == add y x
    add-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      add (add x y) z == add x (add y z)
    add-zero :
      (x : R) -> add x zeroR == x
    add-inverse :
      (x : R) -> add x (negate x) == zeroR

    multiply-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> multiply x y == multiply y x
    multiply-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply (multiply x y) z ==
      multiply x (multiply y z)
    multiply-one :
      (x : R) -> multiply x oneR == x
    multiply-zero :
      (x : R) -> multiply x zeroR == zeroR
    distribute :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply x (add y z) ==
      add (multiply x y) (multiply x z)
    inverse-zero :
      inverse zeroR == zeroR
    multiply-inverse :
      (x : R) ->
      x != zeroR ->
      multiply x (inverse x) == oneR

    order-reflexive :
      (x : R) -> lessOrEqual x x
    order-transitive :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y z ->
      lessOrEqual x z
    order-antisymmetric :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y x ->
      x == y
    order-total :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y or lessOrEqual y x
    add-order :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual (add z x) (add z y)
    multiply-nonnegative :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR x ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR y ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR (multiply x y)
    zero-less-than-one :
      lessOrEqual zeroR oneR and zeroR != oneR

    fromNat-zero :
      fromNat zero == zeroR
    fromNat-successor :
      (n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (suc n) == add (fromNat n) oneR
    fromNat-addition :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m + n) == add (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-multiplication :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m * n) == multiply (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-injective :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat m == fromNat n ->
      m == n

    archimedean :
      (x : R) ->
      Exists Nat (\ n -> lessOrEqual x (fromNat n))
    least-upper-bound :
      (P : Predicate R) ->
      Exists R P ->
      Exists R
        (\ upper ->
          (x : R) ->
          P x ->
          lessOrEqual x upper) ->
      Exists R
        (\ supremum ->
          ((x : R) ->
            P x ->
            lessOrEqual x supremum)
          and
          ((upper : R) ->
            ((x : R) ->
              P x ->
              lessOrEqual x upper) ->
            lessOrEqual supremum upper))

open CompleteOrderedField

subtract :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
subtract reals x y =
  add reals x (negate reals y)

divide :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
divide reals x y =
  multiply reals x (inverse reals y)

StrictLess :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
StrictLess reals x y =
  lessOrEqual reals x y and x != y

CloseTo :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
CloseTo reals center radius x =
  StrictLess reals
    (subtract reals center radius)
    x
  and
  StrictLess reals
    x
    (add reals center radius)

sumFirst :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  Nat ->
  R
sumFirst reals terms zero =
  zeroR reals
sumFirst reals terms (suc n) =
  add reals
    (sumFirst reals terms n)
    (terms n)

SequentialLimit :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  R ->
  Set
SequentialLimit reals sequence limit =
  (epsilon : _) ->
  StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) epsilon ->
  Exists Nat
    (\ cutoff ->
      (n : Nat) ->
      cutoff <=N n ->
      CloseTo reals limit epsilon (sequence n))

record SigmaAlgebra (A : Set) : Set1 where
  field
    measurable : Predicate A -> Set

    measurable-empty :
      measurable emptySet
    measurable-complement :
      (E : Predicate A) ->
      measurable E ->
      measurable (complement E)
    measurable-countable-union :
      (sets : Nat -> Predicate A) ->
      ((n : Nat) -> measurable (sets n)) ->
      measurable (countableUnion sets)
    measurable-congruent :
      (E F : Predicate A) ->
      ((x : A) -> Iff (E x) (F x)) ->
      measurable E ->
      measurable F

open SigmaAlgebra

record ProbabilitySpace
  {A R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R)
  (events : SigmaAlgebra A) : Set1 where
  field
    probability : Predicate A -> R

    probability-congruent :
      (E F : Predicate A) ->
      ((x : A) -> Iff (E x) (F x)) ->
      probability E == probability F
    probability-empty :
      probability emptySet == zeroR reals
    probability-total :
      probability wholeSet == oneR reals
    probability-nonnegative :
      (E : Predicate A) ->
      measurable events E ->
      lessOrEqual reals (zeroR reals) (probability E)
    probability-countable-additivity :
      (sets : Nat -> Predicate A) ->
      ((n : Nat) -> measurable events (sets n)) ->
      PairwiseDisjoint sets ->
      SequentialLimit reals
        (\ count ->
          sumFirst reals
            (\ n -> probability (sets n))
            count)
        (probability (countableUnion sets))

open ProbabilitySpace

IndependentEvents :
  {A R : Set}
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R}
  {events : SigmaAlgebra A} ->
  ProbabilitySpace reals events ->
  Predicate A ->
  Predicate A ->
  Set
IndependentEvents {reals = reals} space E F =
  probability space (intersection E F) ==
  multiply reals
    (probability space E)
    (probability space F)

Separated : Nat -> Nat -> Set
Separated i j =
  suc (suc i) <=N j or suc (suc j) <=N i

finiteIntersection :
  {A : Set} ->
  (Nat -> Predicate A) ->
  Nat ->
  Predicate A
finiteIntersection events zero =
  wholeSet
finiteIntersection events (suc n) =
  intersection
    (finiteIntersection events n)
    (events n)

oneFourth :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R
oneFourth reals =
  divide reals
    (oneR reals)
    (fromNat reals (suc (suc (suc (suc zero)))))

putnam-1976-b3 : Set1
putnam-1976-b3 =
  (R A : Set) ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) ->
  (eventSigma : SigmaAlgebra A) ->
  (space : ProbabilitySpace reals eventSigma) ->
  (n : Nat) ->
  zero <N n ->
  (a : R) ->
  (lessOrEqual reals (zeroR reals) a
    and
    StrictLess reals a (oneFourth reals)) ->
  (u : Nat -> R) ->
  (u zero == oneR reals
    and
    u (suc zero) == subtract reals (oneR reals) a) ->
  ((k : Nat) ->
    u (suc (suc k)) ==
    subtract reals
      (u (suc k))
      (multiply reals a (u k))) ->
  ((k : Nat) ->
    StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) (u k)) ->
  (events : Nat -> Predicate A) ->
  ((i : Nat) ->
    i <N n ->
    measurable eventSigma (events i)) ->
  ((i : Nat) ->
    i <N n ->
    lessOrEqual reals
      (subtract reals (oneR reals) a)
      (probability space (events i))) ->
  ((i j : Nat) ->
    i <N n ->
    j <N n ->
    Separated i j ->
    IndependentEvents space (events i) (events j)) ->
  lessOrEqual reals
    (u n)
    (probability space (finiteIntersection events n))

title: putnam_1976_b3
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1976_b3:
  a recurrence-controlled lower bound for the probability of intersecting
  locally dependent high-probability events. Nonadjacent events are pairwise
  independent, as in the published problem. This file contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open arithmeticTheory pred_setTheory realTheory;
open extrealTheory sigma_algebraTheory measureTheory probabilityTheory;

val putnam_1976_b3 =
  ``!(p : 'a p_space) (n : num) (a : real)
     (u : num -> real) (E : num -> 'a set).
      prob_space p /\
      1 <= n /\
      0 <= a /\ a < 1 / 4 /\
      u 0 = 1 /\ u 1 = 1 - a /\
      (!k. 1 <= k ==>
           u (k + 1) = u k - a * u (k - 1)) /\
      (!k. 0 < u k) /\
      (!i. i < n ==> E i IN events p) /\
      (!i. i < n ==> Normal (1 - a) <= prob p (E i)) /\
      (!i j.
         i < n /\ j < n /\ (i + 1 < j \/ j + 1 < i)
         ==>
         indep p (E i) (E j))
      ==>
      Normal (u n) <=
      prob p (BIGINTER (IMAGE E (count n)))``;

title: putnam_1976_b3
content:
$(
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact
  putnam_1976_b3: a lower bound for the probability of the intersection
  of events with only nearest-neighbor dependence. This file contains no
  proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  P is a set.mm probability measure and E is an n-event family indexed by
  0 ..^ n. Pairwise independence for non-neighboring events is expressed
  by its defining equation

      P(E_i intersection E_j) = P(E_i) * P(E_j).

  The recurrence is indexed from u_0 and u_1, matching the published
  problem. The final declaration is the single unproved $a corpus
  statement; there is no $p proof declaration in this file.
$)

${
  $d P E u n a i j k $.

  putnambench-putnam-1976-b3 $a |-
    A. P e. Prob
    A. n e. NN
    A. a e. RR
    A. u e. ( RR ^m NN0 )
    A. E e. ( ( dom P ) ^m ( 0 ..^ n ) )
      (
        (
          (
            ( 0 <_ a /\ a < ( 1 / 4 ) )
            /\
            ( ( u ` 0 ) = 1 /\ ( u ` 1 ) = ( 1 - a ) )
          )
          /\
          (
            (
              A. k e. NN
                ( u ` ( k + 1 ) )
                =
                ( ( u ` k ) - ( a x. ( u ` ( k - 1 ) ) ) )
            )
            /\
            A. k e. NN0 0 < ( u ` k )
          )
        )
        /\
        (
          (
            A. i e. ( 0 ..^ n )
              ( 1 - a ) <_ ( P ` ( E ` i ) )
          )
          /\
          A. i e. ( 0 ..^ n )
            A. j e. ( 0 ..^ n )
              (
                (
                  ( ( i + 1 ) < j \/ ( j + 1 ) < i )
                  ->
                  ( P ` ( ( E ` i ) i^i ( E ` j ) ) )
                  =
                  ( ( P ` ( E ` i ) ) x. ( P ` ( E ` j ) ) )
                )
              )
        )
        ->
        ( u ` n )
        <_
        (
          P `
          |^|_ i e. ( 0 ..^ n ) ( E ` i )
        )
      )
  $.
$}

title: putnam_1976_b3
content:
% Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1976_b3:
% a recurrence lower bound for intersections of locally dependent high-probability
% events under the source's pairwise-independence hypothesis.
% This file contains no proof.

putnam_1976_b3: THEORY
BEGIN
  sample_space: TYPE+

  event: TYPE = [sample_space -> bool]
  event_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> event]
  event_family: TYPE = [event -> bool]
  sigma_algebra: TYPE = [event -> bool]
  probability_measure: TYPE = [event -> real]
  real_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> real]

  empty_event: event =
    LAMBDA (omega: sample_space): FALSE

  full_event: event =
    LAMBDA (omega: sample_space): TRUE

  event_complement(A: event): event =
    LAMBDA (omega: sample_space):
      NOT A(omega)

  event_intersection(A, B: event): event =
    LAMBDA (omega: sample_space):
      A(omega) AND B(omega)

  countable_union(events: event_sequence): event =
    LAMBDA (omega: sample_space):
      EXISTS (index: nat):
        events(index)(omega)

  pairwise_disjoint(events: event_sequence): bool =
    FORALL (i, j: nat):
      i /= j IMPLIES
        FORALL (omega: sample_space):
          NOT (events(i)(omega) AND events(j)(omega))

  finite_sum(values: real_sequence, count: nat): RECURSIVE real =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      finite_sum(values, count - 1) + values(count - 1)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  converges_to(values: real_sequence, limit: real): bool =
    FORALL (epsilon_value: posreal):
      EXISTS (cutoff: nat):
        FORALL (count: nat):
          cutoff <= count IMPLIES
            abs(values(count) - limit) < epsilon_value

  is_sigma_algebra(Sigma: sigma_algebra): bool =
    Sigma(full_event)
      AND (FORALL (A: event):
        Sigma(A) IMPLIES Sigma(event_complement(A)))
      AND (FORALL (events: event_sequence):
        (FORALL (index: nat): Sigma(events(index)))
          IMPLIES Sigma(countable_union(events)))

  is_probability_measure(
      M: probability_measure,
      Sigma: sigma_algebra): bool =
    is_sigma_algebra(Sigma)
      AND M(empty_event) = 0
      AND M(full_event) = 1
      AND (FORALL (A: event):
        Sigma(A) IMPLIES
          0 <= M(A) AND M(A) <= 1)
      AND (FORALL (events: event_sequence):
        ((FORALL (index: nat): Sigma(events(index)))
          AND pairwise_disjoint(events))
        IMPLIES
          converges_to(
            LAMBDA (count: nat):
              finite_sum(
                LAMBDA (index: nat): M(events(index)),
                count),
            M(countable_union(events))))

  contains_family(
      Sigma: sigma_algebra,
      family: event_family): bool =
    FORALL (A: event):
      family(A) IMPLIES Sigma(A)

  generated_sigma(family: event_family): sigma_algebra =
    LAMBDA (A: event):
      FORALL (Sigma: sigma_algebra):
        (is_sigma_algebra(Sigma)
          AND contains_family(Sigma, family))
        IMPLIES Sigma(A)

  singleton_event_family(A: event): event_family =
    LAMBDA (B: event):
      B = A

  earlier_event_family(
      events: event_sequence,
      event_count, index: nat): event_family =
    LAMBDA (A: event):
      EXISTS (j: nat):
        j < event_count
          AND j + 1 < index
          AND A = events(j)

  independent_events(
      M: probability_measure,
      A, B: event): bool =
    M(event_intersection(A, B)) = M(A) * M(B)

  independent_sigma_algebras(
      M: probability_measure,
      left, right: sigma_algebra): bool =
    FORALL (A, B: event):
      left(A) AND right(B) IMPLIES
        independent_events(M, A, B)

  separated(i, j: nat): bool =
    i + 1 < j OR j + 1 < i

  finite_intersection(
      events: event_sequence,
      event_count: nat): RECURSIVE event =
    IF event_count = 0 THEN
      full_event
    ELSE
      event_intersection(
        finite_intersection(events, event_count - 1),
        events(event_count - 1))
    ENDIF
  MEASURE event_count

  common_assumptions(
      M: probability_measure,
      Sigma: sigma_algebra,
      n: nat,
      a: real,
      u: real_sequence,
      events: event_sequence): bool =
    is_probability_measure(M, Sigma)
      AND n >= 1
      AND 0 <= a
      AND a < 1 / 4
      AND u(0) = 1
      AND u(1) = 1 - a
      AND (FORALL (k: nat):
        k >= 1 IMPLIES
          u(k + 1) = u(k) - a * u(k - 1))
      AND (FORALL (k: nat):
        u(k) > 0)
      AND (FORALL (i: nat):
        i < n IMPLIES Sigma(events(i)))
      AND (FORALL (i: nat):
        i < n IMPLIES M(events(i)) >= 1 - a)

  isabelle_pairwise_independence(
      M: probability_measure,
      n: nat,
      events: event_sequence): bool =
    FORALL (i, j: nat):
      i < n AND j < n AND separated(i, j)
      IMPLIES independent_events(M, events(i), events(j))

  lean_generated_sigma_independence(
      M: probability_measure,
      n: nat,
      events: event_sequence): bool =
    FORALL (i: nat):
      i < n IMPLIES
        independent_sigma_algebras(
          M,
          generated_sigma(
            singleton_event_family(events(i))),
          generated_sigma(
            earlier_event_family(events, n, i)))

  putnam_1976_b3: bool =
    FORALL
        (M: probability_measure),
        (Sigma: sigma_algebra),
        (n: nat),
        (a: real),
        (u: real_sequence),
        (events: event_sequence):
      (common_assumptions(M, Sigma, n, a, u, events)
        AND isabelle_pairwise_independence(M, n, events))
      IMPLIES
        M(finite_intersection(events, n)) >= u(n)
END putnam_1976_b3

;; Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1976_b5:
;; for every natural n, the alternating binomial sum of the polynomials
;; (X-k)^n is the constant polynomial n!. This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

;; Coefficient vectors are listed from degree n down through degree zero.
;; The coefficient of X^degree in (X-k)^n is
;;
;;   choose(n, degree) * (-k)^(n-degree).
;;
;; Thus the left vector below is exactly the coefficient vector of the
;; source sum. Equality with the constant-polynomial vector is equivalent to
;; equality in Z[X]. Evaluating equal integer polynomials gives the source
;; identity for every real X; conversely, equality for every real X forces
;; equality of all coefficients. This encoding therefore preserves the real
;; function statement without restricting X to ACL2's rational numbers.

(defun putnam-1976-b5-factorial (n)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix n)))
  (if (zp n)
      1
    (* n
       (putnam-1976-b5-factorial (- n 1)))))

(defun putnam-1976-b5-binomial (n k)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix n)))
  (if (or (zp k)
          (zp n))
      (if (zp k) 1 0)
    (+ (putnam-1976-b5-binomial (- n 1) k)
       (putnam-1976-b5-binomial
        (- n 1) (- k 1)))))

(defun putnam-1976-b5-coefficient-sum-through
    (n degree k)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix k)))
  (let ((term
         (* (expt -1 k)
            (putnam-1976-b5-binomial n k)
            (putnam-1976-b5-binomial n degree)
            (expt (- k) (- n degree)))))
    (if (zp k)
        term
      (+ (putnam-1976-b5-coefficient-sum-through
          n degree (- k 1))
         term))))

(defun putnam-1976-b5-left-coefficients (n degree)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix degree)))
  (if (zp degree)
      (list
       (putnam-1976-b5-coefficient-sum-through
        n 0 n))
    (cons
     (putnam-1976-b5-coefficient-sum-through
      n degree n)
     (putnam-1976-b5-left-coefficients
      n (- degree 1)))))

(defun putnam-1976-b5-constant-coefficients (n degree)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix degree)))
  (if (zp degree)
      (list (putnam-1976-b5-factorial n))
    (cons 0
          (putnam-1976-b5-constant-coefficients
           n (- degree 1)))))

(defun putnambench-putnam-1976-b5-statement (n)
  (implies
   (natp n)
   (equal
    (putnam-1976-b5-left-coefficients n n)
    (putnam-1976-b5-constant-coefficients n n))))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

-- Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1976_b5:
-- the alternating binomial finite-difference sum of (x - k)^n equals n
-- factorial for every natural n and real x. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; _*_)

infix 4 _!=_
infixr 3 _and_
infixr 2 _or_

data Bottom : Set where

Not : Set -> Set
Not A =
  A -> Bottom

_!=_ : {A : Set} -> A -> A -> Set
x != y =
  Not (x == y)

record _and_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data _or_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  left  : A -> A or B
  right : B -> A or B

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

record CompleteOrderedRealField (R : Set) : Set1 where
  field
    zeroR oneR : R
    add multiply : R -> R -> R
    negate inverse : R -> R
    lessOrEqual : R -> R -> Set
    fromNat : Nat -> R

    one-not-zero :
      oneR != zeroR

    add-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> add x y == add y x
    add-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      add (add x y) z == add x (add y z)
    add-zero :
      (x : R) -> add x zeroR == x
    add-inverse :
      (x : R) -> add x (negate x) == zeroR

    multiply-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> multiply x y == multiply y x
    multiply-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply (multiply x y) z ==
      multiply x (multiply y z)
    multiply-one :
      (x : R) -> multiply x oneR == x
    multiply-zero :
      (x : R) -> multiply x zeroR == zeroR
    distribute :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply x (add y z) ==
      add (multiply x y) (multiply x z)
    inverse-zero :
      inverse zeroR == zeroR
    multiply-inverse :
      (x : R) ->
      x != zeroR ->
      multiply x (inverse x) == oneR

    order-reflexive :
      (x : R) -> lessOrEqual x x
    order-transitive :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y z ->
      lessOrEqual x z
    order-antisymmetric :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y x ->
      x == y
    order-total :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y or lessOrEqual y x
    add-order :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual (add z x) (add z y)
    multiply-nonnegative :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR x ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR y ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR (multiply x y)
    zero-less-than-one :
      lessOrEqual zeroR oneR and zeroR != oneR

    fromNat-zero :
      fromNat zero == zeroR
    fromNat-successor :
      (n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (suc n) == add (fromNat n) oneR
    fromNat-addition :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m + n) == add (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-multiplication :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m * n) == multiply (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-injective :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat m == fromNat n ->
      m == n

    archimedean :
      (x : R) ->
      Exists Nat (\ n -> lessOrEqual x (fromNat n))
    least-upper-bound :
      (P : R -> Set) ->
      Exists R P ->
      Exists R
        (\ upper ->
          (x : R) ->
          P x ->
          lessOrEqual x upper) ->
      Exists R
        (\ supremum ->
          ((x : R) ->
            P x ->
            lessOrEqual x supremum)
          and
          ((upper : R) ->
            ((x : R) ->
              P x ->
              lessOrEqual x upper) ->
            lessOrEqual supremum upper))

open CompleteOrderedRealField

oneN : Nat
oneN =
  suc zero

subtract :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
subtract reals x y =
  add reals x (negate reals y)

naturalPower :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  Nat ->
  R
naturalPower reals x zero =
  oneR reals
naturalPower reals x (suc n) =
  multiply reals
    (naturalPower reals x n)
    x

factorial : Nat -> Nat
factorial zero =
  oneN
factorial (suc n) =
  suc n * factorial n

choose : Nat -> Nat -> Nat
choose n zero =
  oneN
choose zero (suc k) =
  zero
choose (suc n) (suc k) =
  choose n (suc k) + choose n k

sumThrough :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Nat ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  R
sumThrough reals zero term =
  term zero
sumThrough reals (suc n) term =
  add reals
    (sumThrough reals n term)
    (term (suc n))

alternatingSign :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Nat ->
  R
alternatingSign reals k =
  naturalPower reals
    (negate reals (oneR reals))
    k

putnam1976B5Term :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Nat ->
  R ->
  Nat ->
  R
putnam1976B5Term reals n x k =
  multiply reals
    (multiply reals
      (alternatingSign reals k)
      (fromNat reals (choose n k)))
    (naturalPower reals
      (subtract reals x (fromNat reals k))
      n)

putnam1976B5Sum :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Nat ->
  R ->
  R
putnam1976B5Sum reals n x =
  sumThrough reals n
    (putnam1976B5Term reals n x)

putnam-1976-b5 : Set1
putnam-1976-b5 =
  (R : Set) ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) ->
  (n : Nat) ->
  (x : R) ->
  putnam1976B5Sum reals n x ==
  fromNat reals (factorial n)

% Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1976_b5:
% for every natural n and real x, the alternating binomial sum of (x - k)^n
% from k = 0 through n equals n factorial. This file contains no proof.

putnam_1976_b5: THEORY
BEGIN
  binomial_coefficient(n, k: nat): RECURSIVE nat =
    IF k = 0 THEN
      1
    ELSIF n = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      binomial_coefficient(n - 1, k - 1)
        + binomial_coefficient(n - 1, k)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE n

  nat_factorial(n: nat): RECURSIVE nat =
    IF n = 0 THEN
      1
    ELSE
      n * nat_factorial(n - 1)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE n

  alternating_binomial_sum(
      n: nat, x: real, count: nat): RECURSIVE real =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      LET k: nat = count - 1 IN
        alternating_binomial_sum(n, x, count - 1)
          + (-1 :: real) ^ k
              * (binomial_coefficient(n, k) :: real)
              * (x - (k :: real)) ^ n
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  putnam_1976_b5: bool =
    FORALL (n: nat), (x: real):
      alternating_binomial_sum(n, x, n + 1)
        = (nat_factorial(n) :: real)
END putnam_1976_b5

;; Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1976_b6:
;; every natural number whose sum of positive divisors is 2*N+1 is the square
;; of an odd integer. This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

;; For positive n, every positive divisor is at most n, so this recursion sums
;; exactly all positive divisors. For n = 0 it gives the empty divisor sum.
(defun putnam-1976-b6-sum-divisors-through (n d)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix d)))
  (if (and (natp n)
           (natp d))
      (if (zp d)
          0
        (+ (if (equal (mod n d) 0)
               d
             0)
           (putnam-1976-b6-sum-divisors-through
            n (- d 1))))
    0))

;; This bounded search is the internal existential odd square root. If an
;; integer m satisfies m^2 = n, its absolute value is a natural root at most n.
(defun putnam-1976-b6-odd-square-root-through-p (n candidate)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix candidate)))
  (if (and (natp n)
           (natp candidate))
      (or (and (equal (mod candidate 2) 1)
               (equal (* candidate candidate) n))
          (and (not (zp candidate))
               (putnam-1976-b6-odd-square-root-through-p
                n (- candidate 1))))
    nil))

(defun putnambench-putnam-1976-b6-statement (n)
  (implies
   (and
    (natp n)
    (equal
     (putnam-1976-b6-sum-divisors-through n n)
     (+ (* 2 n) 1)))
   (putnam-1976-b6-odd-square-root-through-p n n)))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

-- Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1976_b6:
-- every quasiperfect natural number, whose positive divisors sum to one more
-- than twice the number, is the square of an odd integer. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

open import Agda.Builtin.Bool using (Bool; false; true)
open import Agda.Builtin.Equality using (_≡_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using
  (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; _*_; mod-helper)

infixr 3 _and_

record _and_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A → Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

natEqual : Nat → Nat → Bool
natEqual zero zero = true
natEqual zero (suc n) = false
natEqual (suc m) zero = false
natEqual (suc m) (suc n) = natEqual m n

naturalMod : Nat → Nat → Nat
naturalMod numerator zero = zero
naturalMod numerator (suc denominator) =
  mod-helper zero denominator numerator denominator

sumDivisorsUpTo : Nat → Nat → Nat
sumDivisorsUpTo number zero = zero
sumDivisorsUpTo number (suc bound)
  with natEqual (naturalMod number (suc bound)) zero
... | true = suc bound + sumDivisorsUpTo number bound
... | false = sumDivisorsUpTo number bound

sumDivisors : Nat → Nat
sumDivisors number = sumDivisorsUpTo number number

Odd : Nat → Set
Odd m =
  Exists Nat (λ k → m ≡ suc (2 * k))

putnam-1976-b6 : Set
putnam-1976-b6 =
  (N : Nat) →
  sumDivisors N ≡ 2 * N + 1 →
  Exists Nat (λ m → Odd m and (m * m ≡ N))

$(

  set.mm. The expression ( 1 sigma N ) is the sum of the positive divisors

${

    A. N e. NN0
      (
        ( 1 sigma N ) = ( ( 2 x. N ) + 1 )
        ->
        E. m e. ZZ
          (
            -. 2 || m
            /\
            ( m ^ 2 ) = N

  $.
$}

title: putnam_1976_b6
content:
% Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1976_b6:
% every quasiperfect natural number, whose positive divisors sum to one more
% than twice the number, is the square of an odd integer. This file contains
% no proof.

putnam_1976_b6: THEORY
BEGIN
  nat_divides(divisor, value: nat): bool =
    divisor > 0
      AND EXISTS (quotient: nat):
        value = divisor * quotient

  divisor_sum_aux(value, bound: nat): RECURSIVE nat =
    IF bound = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      divisor_sum_aux(value, bound - 1)
        + IF nat_divides(bound, value) THEN bound ELSE 0 ENDIF
    ENDIF
  MEASURE bound

  divisor_sum(value: nat): nat =
    divisor_sum_aux(value, value)

  sigma(value: nat): int =
    (divisor_sum(value) :: int)

  quasiperfect(value: nat): bool =
    sigma(value) = 2 * (value :: int) + 1

  odd_int(value: int): bool =
    EXISTS (half: int):
      value = 2 * half + 1

  putnam_1976_b6: bool =
    FORALL (N: nat):
      quasiperfect(N)
        IMPLIES
          EXISTS (m: int):
            odd_int(m) AND m * m = (N :: int)
END putnam_1976_b6

Set Implicit Arguments.

Local Open Scope ring_scope.

Variable R : realType.
Definition putnam_1977_a1_solution : R := -7/8.
Theorem putnam_1977_a1
    (y : R -> R := fun x => 2 * x ^+ 4 + 7 * x ^+ 3 + 3 * x - 5)
    (pts : seq R)
    (hpts : size pts = 4%nat /\ uniq pts)
    (hcollinear : exists (m b : R), all (fun x => y x == m * x + b) pts)
    : (\sum_(x <- pts) x) / 4 = putnam_1977_a1_solution.

title: putnam_1977_a1
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1977_a1:
;; four distinct points on the real quartic y=2x^4+7x^3+3x-5 that lie on
;; one line have average x-coordinate -7/8. This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))

;; A rational polynomial and a rational isolating interval represent one real
;; algebraic generator alpha. The four abscissas, slope, and intercept are
;; rational polynomials in alpha. Every finite tuple of real algebraic numbers
;; has such a common primitive representation, and every accepted
;; representation denotes an actual tuple. The source implication and its
;; negation are first-order formulas over real closed fields, so transfer
;; between the reals and the real algebraic numbers makes this encoding
;; equivalent to universal quantification over arbitrary reals.
;;
;; Pairwise inequality encodes a four-element set. For four distinct graph
;; points, collinearity is equivalent to lying on y=slope*x+intercept. Moving
;; that line's existential parameters to universal statement arguments is
;; bidirectionally valid because the conclusion does not depend on them:
;; (exists slope intercept, H) -> C iff
;; (forall slope intercept, H -> C).

(defun putnam-1977-a1-rational-polynomial-p (polynomial)
  (if (consp polynomial)
      (and (rationalp (car polynomial))
           (putnam-1977-a1-rational-polynomial-p (cdr polynomial)))
    (equal polynomial nil)))

(defun putnam-1977-a1-poly-normalize (coefficients)
  (if (consp coefficients)
      (let ((tail (putnam-1977-a1-poly-normalize (cdr coefficients))))
        (if (and (equal (car coefficients) 0)
                 (not (consp tail)))
            nil
          (cons (car coefficients) tail)))
    nil))

(defun putnam-1977-a1-poly-add (left right)
  (cond
   ((consp left)
    (if (consp right)
        (cons (+ (car left) (car right))
              (putnam-1977-a1-poly-add (cdr left) (cdr right)))
      left))
   (t right)))

(defun putnam-1977-a1-poly-scale (scalar polynomial)
  (if (consp polynomial)
      (cons (* scalar (car polynomial))
            (putnam-1977-a1-poly-scale scalar (cdr polynomial)))
    nil))

(defun putnam-1977-a1-poly-negate (polynomial)
  (putnam-1977-a1-poly-scale -1 polynomial))

(defun putnam-1977-a1-poly-subtract (left right)
  (putnam-1977-a1-poly-normalize
   (putnam-1977-a1-poly-add
    left
    (putnam-1977-a1-poly-negate right))))

(defun putnam-1977-a1-poly-multiply (left right)
  (if (consp left)
      (putnam-1977-a1-poly-normalize
       (putnam-1977-a1-poly-add
        (putnam-1977-a1-poly-scale (car left) right)
        (cons 0
              (putnam-1977-a1-poly-multiply (cdr left) right))))
    nil))

(defun putnam-1977-a1-poly-derivative-aux (coefficients degree)
  (if (consp coefficients)
      (cons (* degree (car coefficients))
            (putnam-1977-a1-poly-derivative-aux
             (cdr coefficients) (+ degree 1)))
    nil))

(defun putnam-1977-a1-poly-derivative (polynomial)
  (if (consp polynomial)
      (putnam-1977-a1-poly-normalize
       (putnam-1977-a1-poly-derivative-aux
        (cdr polynomial) 1))
    nil))

(defun putnam-1977-a1-zero-list (count)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix count)))
  (if (zp count)
      nil
    (cons 0
          (putnam-1977-a1-zero-list (- count 1)))))

(defun putnam-1977-a1-poly-monomial (coefficient degree)
  (if (equal coefficient 0)
      nil
    (append
     (putnam-1977-a1-zero-list degree)
     (list coefficient))))

(defun putnam-1977-a1-poly-degree (polynomial)
  (let ((normalized (putnam-1977-a1-poly-normalize polynomial)))
    (if (consp normalized)
        (- (len normalized) 1)
      0)))

(defun putnam-1977-a1-poly-leading-coefficient (polynomial)
  (let ((normalized (putnam-1977-a1-poly-normalize polynomial)))
    (if (consp normalized)
        (nth (putnam-1977-a1-poly-degree normalized) normalized)
      0)))

(defun putnam-1977-a1-poly-divmod-steps
    (remainder divisor quotient steps)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix steps)))
  (if (zp steps)
      (cons
       (putnam-1977-a1-poly-normalize quotient)
       (putnam-1977-a1-poly-normalize remainder))
    (let* ((normalized-remainder
            (putnam-1977-a1-poly-normalize remainder))
           (normalized-divisor
            (putnam-1977-a1-poly-normalize divisor)))
      (if (or (not (consp normalized-remainder))
              (not (consp normalized-divisor))
              (< (putnam-1977-a1-poly-degree normalized-remainder)
                 (putnam-1977-a1-poly-degree normalized-divisor)))
          (cons
           (putnam-1977-a1-poly-normalize quotient)
           normalized-remainder)
        (let* ((degree-difference
                (- (putnam-1977-a1-poly-degree normalized-remainder)
                   (putnam-1977-a1-poly-degree normalized-divisor)))
               (coefficient
                (/ (putnam-1977-a1-poly-leading-coefficient
                    normalized-remainder)
                   (putnam-1977-a1-poly-leading-coefficient
                    normalized-divisor)))
               (term
                (putnam-1977-a1-poly-monomial
                 coefficient degree-difference)))
          (putnam-1977-a1-poly-divmod-steps
           (putnam-1977-a1-poly-subtract
            normalized-remainder
            (putnam-1977-a1-poly-multiply
             term normalized-divisor))
           normalized-divisor
           (putnam-1977-a1-poly-add quotient term)
           (- steps 1)))))))

(defun putnam-1977-a1-poly-divmod (dividend divisor)
  (putnam-1977-a1-poly-divmod-steps
   dividend
   divisor
   nil
   (+ 1 (len (putnam-1977-a1-poly-normalize dividend)))))

(defun putnam-1977-a1-poly-remainder (dividend divisor)
  (cdr (putnam-1977-a1-poly-divmod dividend divisor)))

(defun putnam-1977-a1-poly-gcd-steps (left right steps)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix steps)))
  (let ((normalized-left (putnam-1977-a1-poly-normalize left))
        (normalized-right (putnam-1977-a1-poly-normalize right)))
    (if (or (zp steps)
            (not (consp normalized-right)))
        normalized-left
      (putnam-1977-a1-poly-gcd-steps
       normalized-right
       (putnam-1977-a1-poly-remainder
        normalized-left normalized-right)
       (- steps 1)))))

(defun putnam-1977-a1-poly-gcd (left right)
  (putnam-1977-a1-poly-gcd-steps
   left
   right
   (+ 2
      (len (putnam-1977-a1-poly-normalize left))
      (len (putnam-1977-a1-poly-normalize right)))))

(defun putnam-1977-a1-sturm-tail (previous current steps)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix steps)))
  (let ((normalized-current
         (putnam-1977-a1-poly-normalize current)))
    (if (or (zp steps)
            (not (consp normalized-current)))
        nil
      (cons
       normalized-current
       (putnam-1977-a1-sturm-tail
        normalized-current
        (putnam-1977-a1-poly-negate
         (putnam-1977-a1-poly-remainder
          previous normalized-current))
        (- steps 1))))))

(defun putnam-1977-a1-sturm-chain (polynomial)
  (let ((normalized (putnam-1977-a1-poly-normalize polynomial)))
    (if (consp normalized)
        (cons
         normalized
         (putnam-1977-a1-sturm-tail
          normalized
          (putnam-1977-a1-poly-derivative normalized)
          (+ 1 (len normalized))))
      nil)))

(defun putnam-1977-a1-poly-evaluate (polynomial value)
  (if (consp polynomial)
      (+ (car polynomial)
         (* value
            (putnam-1977-a1-poly-evaluate
             (cdr polynomial) value)))
    0))

(defun putnam-1977-a1-chain-values-at (chain value)
  (if (consp chain)
      (cons
       (putnam-1977-a1-poly-evaluate (car chain) value)
       (putnam-1977-a1-chain-values-at (cdr chain) value))
    nil))

(defun putnam-1977-a1-sign (value)
  (cond
   ((< value 0) -1)
   ((< 0 value) 1)
   (t 0)))

(defun putnam-1977-a1-sign-variations-aux
    (values previous-sign)
  (if (consp values)
      (let ((current-sign (putnam-1977-a1-sign (car values))))
        (cond
         ((equal current-sign 0)
          (putnam-1977-a1-sign-variations-aux
           (cdr values) previous-sign))
         ((equal previous-sign 0)
          (putnam-1977-a1-sign-variations-aux
           (cdr values) current-sign))
         (t
          (+ (if (equal current-sign previous-sign) 0 1)
             (putnam-1977-a1-sign-variations-aux
              (cdr values) current-sign)))))
    0))

(defun putnam-1977-a1-sign-variations (values)
  (putnam-1977-a1-sign-variations-aux values 0))

(defun putnam-1977-a1-open-root-count
    (polynomial lower upper)
  (let ((chain (putnam-1977-a1-sturm-chain polynomial)))
    (- (putnam-1977-a1-sign-variations
        (putnam-1977-a1-chain-values-at chain lower))
       (putnam-1977-a1-sign-variations
        (putnam-1977-a1-chain-values-at chain upper)))))

(defun putnam-1977-a1-isolates-one-root-p
    (polynomial lower upper)
  (let ((normalized (putnam-1977-a1-poly-normalize polynomial)))
    (and
     (putnam-1977-a1-rational-polynomial-p normalized)
     (consp normalized)
     (< 0 (putnam-1977-a1-poly-degree normalized))
     (rationalp lower)
     (rationalp upper)
     (< lower upper)
     (not (equal
           (putnam-1977-a1-poly-evaluate normalized lower)
           0))
     (not (equal
           (putnam-1977-a1-poly-evaluate normalized upper)
           0))
     (equal
      (putnam-1977-a1-open-root-count normalized lower upper)
      1))))

(defun putnam-1977-a1-zero-at-isolated-root-p
    (primitive value lower upper)
  (let ((normalized-value
         (putnam-1977-a1-poly-normalize value)))
    (or
     (not (consp normalized-value))
     (putnam-1977-a1-isolates-one-root-p
      (putnam-1977-a1-poly-gcd primitive normalized-value)
      lower
      upper))))

(defun putnam-1977-a1-quartic-minus-line
    (x slope intercept)
  (let* ((x-squared
          (putnam-1977-a1-poly-multiply x x))
         (x-cubed
          (putnam-1977-a1-poly-multiply x-squared x))
         (x-fourth
          (putnam-1977-a1-poly-multiply x-cubed x))
         (quartic
          (putnam-1977-a1-poly-add
           (putnam-1977-a1-poly-scale 2 x-fourth)
           (putnam-1977-a1-poly-add
            (putnam-1977-a1-poly-scale 7 x-cubed)
            (putnam-1977-a1-poly-add
             (putnam-1977-a1-poly-scale 3 x)
             (list -5))))))
    (putnam-1977-a1-poly-subtract
     quartic
     (putnam-1977-a1-poly-add
      (putnam-1977-a1-poly-multiply slope x)
      intercept))))

(defun putnambench-putnam-1977-a1-statement
    (primitive lower upper x1 x2 x3 x4 slope intercept)
  (let* ((x1-minus-x2
          (putnam-1977-a1-poly-subtract x1 x2))
         (x1-minus-x3
          (putnam-1977-a1-poly-subtract x1 x3))
         (x1-minus-x4
          (putnam-1977-a1-poly-subtract x1 x4))
         (x2-minus-x3
          (putnam-1977-a1-poly-subtract x2 x3))
         (x2-minus-x4
          (putnam-1977-a1-poly-subtract x2 x4))
         (x3-minus-x4
          (putnam-1977-a1-poly-subtract x3 x4))
         (sum-plus-seven-halves
          (putnam-1977-a1-poly-add
           (putnam-1977-a1-poly-add
            (putnam-1977-a1-poly-add x1 x2)
            (putnam-1977-a1-poly-add x3 x4))
           (list 7/2))))
    (implies
     (and

open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; _*_)

infix 4 _!=_
infixr 3 _and_
infixr 2 _or_

data Bottom : Set where

Not : Set -> Set
Not A =
  A -> Bottom

_!=_ : {A : Set} -> A -> A -> Set
x != y =
  Not (x == y)

record _and_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data _or_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  left  : A -> A or B
  right : B -> A or B

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

oneN : Nat
oneN =
  suc zero

twoN : Nat
twoN =
  suc oneN

threeN : Nat
threeN =
  suc twoN

fourN : Nat
fourN =
  suc threeN

fiveN : Nat
fiveN =
  suc fourN

sixN : Nat
sixN =
  suc fiveN

sevenN : Nat
sevenN =

eightN : Nat

record CompleteOrderedRealField (R : Set) : Set1 where
  field
    zeroR oneR : R
    add multiply : R -> R -> R
    negate inverse : R -> R
    lessOrEqual : R -> R -> Set
    fromNat : Nat -> R

    one-not-zero :
      oneR != zeroR

    add-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> add x y == add y x
    add-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      add (add x y) z == add x (add y z)
    add-zero :
      (x : R) -> add x zeroR == x
    add-inverse :
      (x : R) -> add x (negate x) == zeroR

    multiply-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> multiply x y == multiply y x
    multiply-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply (multiply x y) z == multiply x (multiply y z)
    multiply-one :
      (x : R) -> multiply x oneR == x
    multiply-zero :
      (x : R) -> multiply x zeroR == zeroR
    distribute :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply x (add y z) ==

    inverse-zero :
      inverse zeroR == zeroR
    multiply-inverse :
      (x : R) ->
      x != zeroR ->

    order-transitive :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y z ->
      lessOrEqual x z
    order-antisymmetric :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y x ->

    order-total :
      (x y : R) ->

    add-order :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->

    multiply-nonnegative :

      fromNat zero == zeroR

      (n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (suc n) == add (fromNat n) oneR

      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m + n) == add (fromNat m) (fromNat n)

      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m * n) == multiply (fromNat m) (fromNat n)

      (m n : Nat) ->

    archimedean :
      (x : R) ->
      Exists Nat (\ n -> lessOrEqual x (fromNat n))

      (P : R -> Set) ->
      Exists R P ->

            lessOrEqual x supremum)

open CompleteOrderedRealField

subtract :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
subtract reals x y =
  add reals x (negate reals y)

divide :

  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
divide reals x y =
  multiply reals x (inverse reals y)

naturalPower :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  Nat ->
  R
naturalPower reals x zero =
  oneR reals
naturalPower reals x (suc n) =
  multiply reals
    (naturalPower reals x n)
    x

quartic :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R
quartic reals x =
  subtract reals
    (add reals
      (add reals
        (multiply reals
          (fromNat reals twoN)
          (naturalPower reals x fourN))
        (multiply reals
          (fromNat reals sevenN)
          (naturalPower reals x threeN)))
      (multiply reals
        (fromNat reals threeN)
        x))
    (fromNat reals fiveN)

FourDistinct :
  {R : Set} ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
FourDistinct x1 x2 x3 x4 =
  x1 != x2
  and
  x1 != x3
  and
  x1 != x4
  and
  x2 != x3
  and
  x2 != x4
  and
  x3 != x4

OnOneAffineLine :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
OnOneAffineLine {R} reals x1 x2 x3 x4 =
  Exists R
    (\ slope ->
      Exists R
        (\ intercept ->
          quartic reals x1 ==
            add reals (multiply reals slope x1) intercept
          and
          quartic reals x2 ==
            add reals (multiply reals slope x2) intercept
          and
          quartic reals x3 ==
            add reals (multiply reals slope x3) intercept
          and
          quartic reals x4 ==
            add reals (multiply reals slope x4) intercept))

sumFour :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
sumFour reals x1 x2 x3 x4 =
  add reals
    (add reals (add reals x1 x2) x3)
    x4

averageFour :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
averageFour reals x1 x2 x3 x4 =
  divide reals
    (sumFour reals x1 x2 x3 x4)
    (fromNat reals fourN)

minusSevenEighths :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R
minusSevenEighths reals =
  divide reals
    (negate reals (fromNat reals sevenN))
    (fromNat reals eightN)

module Putnam1977A1Statement

    FourDistinct x1 x2 x3 x4 ->
    OnOneAffineLine reals x1 x2 x3 x4 ->
    averageFour reals x1 x2 x3 x4 ==
    minusSevenEighths reals

putnam-1977-a1 : Set1
putnam-1977-a1 =

    multiply-zero :
      (x : R) -> multiply x zeroR == zeroR
    distribute :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply x (add y z) == add (multiply x y) (multiply x z)
    inverse-zero :
      inverse zeroR == zeroR
    multiply-inverse :
      (x : R) -> x != zeroR -> multiply x (inverse x) == oneR

    order-reflexive :
      (x : R) -> lessOrEqual x x
    order-transitive :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y z ->
      lessOrEqual x z
    order-antisymmetric :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y x ->
      x == y
    order-total :
      (x y : R) -> Choice (lessOrEqual x y) (lessOrEqual y x)
    add-order :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->

    multiply-nonnegative :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR x ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR y ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR (multiply x y)
    zero-less-than-one :
      lessOrEqual zeroR oneR and zeroR != oneR

    fromNat-zero :
      fromNat zero == zeroR
    fromNat-successor :
      (n : Nat) -> fromNat (suc n) == add (fromNat n) oneR
    fromNat-addition :
      (m n : Nat) -> fromNat (m + n) == add (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-multiplication :
      (m n : Nat) ->

    fromNat-injective :
      (m n : Nat) -> fromNat m == fromNat n -> m == n

    archimedean :
      (x : R) -> Σ Nat (\ n -> lessOrEqual x (fromNat n))
    least-upper-bound :
      (P : R -> Set) ->
      Σ R P ->
      Σ R (\ upper -> (x : R) -> P x -> lessOrEqual x upper) ->
      Σ R
        (\ supremum ->
          ((x : R) -> P x -> lessOrEqual x supremum)
          and
          ((upper : R) ->
            ((x : R) -> P x -> lessOrEqual x upper) ->
            lessOrEqual supremum upper))

open CompleteOrderedRealField

divide :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
divide reals x y = multiply reals x (inverse reals y)

module Putnam1977A2Statement
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) where

  equations : R -> R -> R -> R -> Set
  equations a b c d =
    (add reals (add reals a b) c == d)
    and
    (add reals
      (add reals
        (divide reals (oneR reals) a)
        (divide reals (oneR reals) b))
      (divide reals (oneR reals) c)
      ==
      divide reals (oneR reals) d)

  solutions : R -> R -> R -> R -> Set
  solutions a b c d =
    ThreeWays
      ((d == a) and (b == negate reals c))
      ((d == b) and (a == negate reals c))
      ((d == c) and (a == negate reals b))

  proposition : Set
  proposition =
    (a b c d : R) ->
    (a != zeroR reals)
    and
    ((b != zeroR reals)
    and
    ((c != zeroR reals) and (d != zeroR reals))) ->
    Iff (equations a b c d) (solutions a b c d)

putnam-1977-a2 =

open realTheory;

% Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench artifact putnam_1977_a2:
% the classification of nonzero real quadruples satisfying a sum equation
% and its reciprocal equation. This file contains no proof.

putnam_1977_a2: THEORY
BEGIN
  safe_div(numerator, denominator: real): real =
    IF denominator = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      numerator / denominator
    ENDIF

  satisfies_equations(a, b, c, d: real): bool =
    a + b + c = d
      AND safe_div(1, a) + safe_div(1, b) + safe_div(1, c)
        = safe_div(1, d)

  putnam_1977_a2_solution(a, b, c, d: real): bool =
    (d = a AND b = -c)
      OR (d = b AND a = -c)
      OR (d = c AND a = -b)

  putnam_1977_a2: bool =
    FORALL (a, b, c, d: real):
      (NOT a = 0 AND NOT b = 0 AND NOT c = 0 AND NOT d = 0)
        IMPLIES
          (satisfies_equations(a, b, c, d)
            IFF putnam_1977_a2_solution(a, b, c, d))
END putnam_1977_a2

import Mathlib

abbrev putnam_1977_a3_solution : (ℝ → ℝ) → (ℝ → ℝ) → (ℝ → ℝ) := sorry
-- fun f g x ↦ g x - f (x - 3) + f (x - 1) + f (x + 1) - f (x + 3)
/--
Let $f, g, h$ be functions $\mathbb{R} \to \mathbb{R}$. Find an expression for $h(x)$ in terms of $f$ and $g$ such that $f(x) = \frac{h(x + 1) + h(x - 1)}{2}$ and $g(x) = \frac{h(x + 4) + h(x - 4)}{2}$.
-/
theorem putnam_1977_a3
    (f g h : ℝ → ℝ)
    (hf : ∀ x, f x = (h (x + 1) + h (x - 1)) / 2)
    (hg : ∀ x, g x = (h (x + 4) + h (x - 4)) / 2) :
    h = putnam_1977_a3_solution f g :=
  sorry

;; Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1977_a3:
;; recovering a real-valued function from its averages at shifts 1 and 4 by
;; an explicit linear combination of the two average functions. This file
;; contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

;; At a fixed real x, the source hypotheses needed for the conclusion are
;; exactly the four averaging equations for f at x-3, x-1, x+1, and x+3,
;; together with the averaging equation for g at x. Substituting them makes
;; the displayed solution formula a linear identity in
;;
;;   h(x-4), h(x-2), h(x), h(x+2), h(x+4).
;;
;; This local form is bidirectionally equivalent to the arbitrary-function
;; statement. A source counterexample supplies a violating local tuple.
;; Conversely, any local tuple satisfying these equations extends to a real
;; function h (take x=0 and assign the five displayed values arbitrarily);
;; defining f(y)=(h(y+1)+h(y-1))/2 and g(y)=(h(y+4)+h(y-4))/2 gives the
;; global source hypotheses and preserves the local violation.
;;
;; Standard ACL2 has exact rationals rather than a primitive real sort. The
;; local equations and conclusion are affine identities with rational
;; coefficients. A real counterexample would persist after rationally
;; approximating the five free h-values and defining the f- and g-values by
;; the equations, while every rational counterexample is already real.
;; Therefore the rational predicate below has exactly the source theorem's
;; counterexamples and does not restrict its mathematical generality.

(defun putnam-1977-a3-solution-value
    (g-at-x
     f-at-x-minus-3
     f-at-x-minus-1
     f-at-x-plus-1
     f-at-x-plus-3)
  (- (+ (- g-at-x f-at-x-minus-3)
        f-at-x-minus-1
        f-at-x-plus-1)
     f-at-x-plus-3))

(defun putnambench-putnam-1977-a3-statement
    (h-at-x-minus-4
     h-at-x-minus-2
     h-at-x
     h-at-x-plus-2
     h-at-x-plus-4
     f-at-x-minus-3
     f-at-x-minus-1
     f-at-x-plus-1
     f-at-x-plus-3
     g-at-x)
  (implies
   (and
    (rationalp h-at-x-minus-4)
    (rationalp h-at-x-minus-2)
    (rationalp h-at-x)
    (rationalp h-at-x-plus-2)
    (rationalp h-at-x-plus-4)
    (rationalp f-at-x-minus-3)
    (rationalp f-at-x-minus-1)
    (rationalp f-at-x-plus-1)
    (rationalp f-at-x-plus-3)
    (rationalp g-at-x)
    (equal f-at-x-minus-3
           (/ (+ h-at-x-minus-2 h-at-x-minus-4) 2))
    (equal f-at-x-minus-1
           (/ (+ h-at-x h-at-x-minus-2) 2))
    (equal f-at-x-plus-1
           (/ (+ h-at-x-plus-2 h-at-x) 2))
    (equal f-at-x-plus-3
           (/ (+ h-at-x-plus-4 h-at-x-plus-2) 2))
    (equal g-at-x
           (/ (+ h-at-x-plus-4 h-at-x-minus-4) 2)))
   (equal
    h-at-x
    (putnam-1977-a3-solution-value
     g-at-x
     f-at-x-minus-3
     f-at-x-minus-1
     f-at-x-plus-1
     f-at-x-plus-3))))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q
