-- Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1977_a3:
-- two symmetric-average identities for real functions determine h pointwise
-- by an explicit telescoping expression in f and g. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; _*_)

infix 4 _!=_
infixr 3 _and_
infixr 2 _or_

data Bottom : Set where

Not : Set -> Set
Not A =
  A -> Bottom

_!=_ : {A : Set} -> A -> A -> Set
x != y =
  Not (x == y)

record _and_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data _or_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  left  : A -> A or B
  right : B -> A or B

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

record CompleteOrderedRealField (R : Set) : Set1 where
  field
    zeroR oneR : R
    add multiply : R -> R -> R
    negate inverse : R -> R
    lessOrEqual : R -> R -> Set
    fromNat : Nat -> R

    one-not-zero :
      oneR != zeroR

    add-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> add x y == add y x
    add-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      add (add x y) z == add x (add y z)
    add-zero :
      (x : R) -> add x zeroR == x
    add-inverse :
      (x : R) -> add x (negate x) == zeroR

    multiply-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> multiply x y == multiply y x
    multiply-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply (multiply x y) z ==
      multiply x (multiply y z)
    multiply-one :
      (x : R) -> multiply x oneR == x
    multiply-zero :
      (x : R) -> multiply x zeroR == zeroR
    distribute :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply x (add y z) ==
      add (multiply x y) (multiply x z)
    inverse-zero :
      inverse zeroR == zeroR
    multiply-inverse :
      (x : R) ->
      x != zeroR ->
      multiply x (inverse x) == oneR

    order-reflexive :
      (x : R) -> lessOrEqual x x
    order-transitive :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y z ->
      lessOrEqual x z
    order-antisymmetric :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y x ->
      x == y
    order-total :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y or lessOrEqual y x
    add-order :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual (add z x) (add z y)
    multiply-nonnegative :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR x ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR y ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR (multiply x y)
    zero-less-than-one :
      lessOrEqual zeroR oneR and zeroR != oneR

    fromNat-zero :
      fromNat zero == zeroR
    fromNat-successor :
      (n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (suc n) == add (fromNat n) oneR
    fromNat-addition :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m + n) == add (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-multiplication :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m * n) == multiply (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-injective :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat m == fromNat n ->
      m == n

    archimedean :
      (x : R) ->
      Exists Nat (\ n -> lessOrEqual x (fromNat n))
    least-upper-bound :
      (P : R -> Set) ->
      Exists R P ->
      Exists R
        (\ upper ->
          (x : R) ->
          P x ->
          lessOrEqual x upper) ->
      Exists R
        (\ supremum ->
          ((x : R) ->
            P x ->
            lessOrEqual x supremum)
          and
          ((upper : R) ->
            ((x : R) ->
              P x ->
              lessOrEqual x upper) ->
            lessOrEqual supremum upper))

open CompleteOrderedRealField

subtract :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
subtract reals x y =
  add reals x (negate reals y)

divide :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
divide reals x y =
  multiply reals x (inverse reals y)

module Putnam1977A3Statement
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) where

  two : R
  two =
    fromNat reals (suc (suc zero))

  four : R
  four =
    fromNat reals (suc (suc (suc (suc zero))))

  solution : (R -> R) -> (R -> R) -> R -> R
  solution f g x =
    subtract reals
      (add reals
        (add reals
          (subtract reals
            (g x)
            (f (subtract reals x (fromNat reals (suc (suc (suc zero)))))))
          (f (subtract reals x (oneR reals))))
        (f (add reals x (oneR reals))))
      (f (add reals x (fromNat reals (suc (suc (suc zero))))))

  AveragesAtOne : (R -> R) -> (R -> R) -> Set
  AveragesAtOne f h =
    (x : R) ->
    f x ==
    divide reals
      (add reals
        (h (add reals x (oneR reals)))
        (h (subtract reals x (oneR reals))))
      two

  AveragesAtFour : (R -> R) -> (R -> R) -> Set
  AveragesAtFour g h =
    (x : R) ->
    g x ==
    divide reals
      (add reals
        (h (add reals x four))
        (h (subtract reals x four)))
      two

  AgreesWithSolution :
    (R -> R) ->
    (R -> R) ->
    (R -> R) ->
    Set
  AgreesWithSolution h f g =
    (x : R) ->
    h x == solution f g x

  proposition : Set
  proposition =
    (f g h : R -> R) ->
    AveragesAtOne f h ->
    AveragesAtFour g h ->
    AgreesWithSolution h f g

putnam-1977-a3 : Set1
putnam-1977-a3 =
  (R : Set) ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) ->
  Putnam1977A3Statement.proposition reals

    REAL_1, INT_1, NAT_1, VALUED_0, VALUED_1;
  notations TARSKI, XBOOLE_0, SUBSET_1, RELAT_1, FUNCT_1, RELSET_1,
    FUNCT_2, ORDINAL1, NUMBERS, XCMPLX_0, XREAL_0, XXREAL_0, REAL_1,

% Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1977_a3:
% reconstruction of a real-valued function from two symmetric averaging
% identities. This file contains no proof.

putnam_1977_a3: THEORY
BEGIN
  real_function: TYPE = [real -> real]

  putnam_1977_a3_solution(
      f, g: real_function): real_function =
    LAMBDA (x: real):
      g(x) - f(x - 3) + f(x - 1) + f(x + 1) - f(x + 3)

  putnam_1977_a3: bool =
    FORALL (f, g, h: real_function):
      ((FORALL (x: real):
          f(x) = (h(x + 1) + h(x - 1)) / 2)
        AND
        (FORALL (x: real):
          g(x) = (h(x + 4) + h(x - 4)) / 2))
      IMPLIES
        h = putnam_1977_a3_solution(f, g)
END putnam_1977_a3

putnam_1977_a4
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1977_a4:
;; for every real x in (0,1), the power-of-two series sums to x/(1-x).
;; This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))

;; The series has an explicit limit, so its statement needs field algebra and
;; the Archimedean property, not quantification over every subset of the real
;; line. Conservative generic symbols avoid restricting x to ACL2 rationals.

(defstub p77a4-scalar-p (x) t)
(defstub p77a4-add (x y) t)
(defstub p77a4-multiply (x y) t)
(defstub p77a4-negate (x) t)
(defstub p77a4-inverse (x) t)
(defstub p77a4-less (x y) t)
(defstub p77a4-archimedean-bound (x) t)

(defun p77a4-member-p (x)
  (if (p77a4-scalar-p x) t nil))

(defun p77a4-less-p (x y)
  (if (p77a4-less x y) t nil))

(defun p77a4-subtract (x y)
  (p77a4-add x (p77a4-negate y)))

(defun p77a4-divide (x y)
  (p77a4-multiply x (p77a4-inverse y)))

(defun p77a4-absolute-value (zero x)
  (if (p77a4-less-p x zero)
      (p77a4-negate x)
    x))

(defun p77a4-positive-p (zero x)
  (and
   (p77a4-member-p x)
   (p77a4-less-p zero x)))

(defun-sk p77a4-field-laws-p (zero one)
  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (p77a4-member-p x)
      (p77a4-member-p y)
      (p77a4-member-p z))
     (and
      (p77a4-member-p (p77a4-add x y))
      (p77a4-member-p (p77a4-multiply x y))
      (p77a4-member-p (p77a4-negate x))
      (p77a4-member-p (p77a4-inverse x))
      (equal
       (p77a4-add (p77a4-add x y) z)
       (p77a4-add x (p77a4-add y z)))
      (equal (p77a4-add x y) (p77a4-add y x))
      (equal (p77a4-add x zero) x)
      (equal (p77a4-add x (p77a4-negate x)) zero)
      (equal
       (p77a4-multiply (p77a4-multiply x y) z)
       (p77a4-multiply x (p77a4-multiply y z)))
      (equal (p77a4-multiply x y) (p77a4-multiply y x))
      (equal (p77a4-multiply x one) x)
      (implies
       (equal x zero)
       (equal (p77a4-inverse x) zero))
      (implies
       (not (equal x zero))
       (equal
        (p77a4-multiply x (p77a4-inverse x))
        one))
      (equal
       (p77a4-multiply x (p77a4-add y z))
       (p77a4-add
        (p77a4-multiply x y)
        (p77a4-multiply x z)))))))

(defun-sk p77a4-order-laws-p (zero)
  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (p77a4-member-p x)
      (p77a4-member-p y)
      (p77a4-member-p z))
     (and
      (not (p77a4-less-p x x))
      (or
       (equal x y)
       (p77a4-less-p x y)
       (p77a4-less-p y x))
      (implies
       (and
        (p77a4-less-p x y)
        (p77a4-less-p y z))
       (p77a4-less-p x z))
      (implies
       (p77a4-less-p x y)
       (p77a4-less-p
        (p77a4-add x z)
        (p77a4-add y z)))
      (implies
       (and
        (p77a4-less-p zero x)
        (p77a4-less-p zero y))
       (p77a4-less-p
        zero
        (p77a4-multiply x y)))))))

(defun p77a4-natural-value (zero one n)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix n)))
  (if (zp n)
      zero
    (p77a4-add
     (p77a4-natural-value zero one (- n 1))
     one)))

(defun-sk p77a4-archimedean-law-p (zero one)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (p77a4-member-p x)
     (and
      (natp (p77a4-archimedean-bound x))
      (p77a4-less-p
       x
       (p77a4-natural-value
        zero one
        (p77a4-archimedean-bound x)))))))

(defun p77a4-archimedean-ordered-field-p (zero one)
  (and
   (p77a4-member-p zero)
   (p77a4-member-p one)
   (not (equal zero one))
   (p77a4-field-laws-p zero one)
   (p77a4-order-laws-p zero)
   (p77a4-less-p zero one)
   (p77a4-archimedean-law-p zero one)))

(defun p77a4-power (one base exponent)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix exponent)))
  (if (zp exponent)
      one
    (p77a4-multiply
     base
     (p77a4-power one base (- exponent 1)))))

(defun p77a4-series-term (one x n)
  (let* ((power (expt 2 (nfix n)))
         (numerator (p77a4-power one x power))
         (denominator
          (p77a4-subtract
           one
           (p77a4-power one x (* 2 power)))))
    (p77a4-divide numerator denominator)))

(defun p77a4-series-prefix (zero one x terms)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix terms)))
  (if (zp terms)
      zero
    (let ((index (- terms 1)))
      (p77a4-add
       (p77a4-series-prefix zero one x index)
       (p77a4-series-term one x index)))))

(defun p77a4-solution (one x)
  (p77a4-divide
   x
   (p77a4-subtract one x)))

(defun-sk p77a4-series-tail-p
    (zero one x epsilon cutoff)
  (forall (terms)
    (implies
     (and
      (natp terms)
      (<= cutoff terms))
     (p77a4-less-p
      (p77a4-absolute-value
       zero
       (p77a4-subtract
        (p77a4-series-prefix zero one x terms)
        (p77a4-solution one x)))
      epsilon))))

(defun-sk p77a4-series-cutoff-exists-p
    (zero one x epsilon)
  (exists (cutoff)
    (and
     (natp cutoff)
     (p77a4-series-tail-p
      zero one x epsilon cutoff))))

(defun-sk p77a4-series-sums-to-solution-p
    (zero one x)
  (forall (epsilon)
    (implies
     (p77a4-positive-p zero epsilon)
     (p77a4-series-cutoff-exists-p
      zero one x epsilon))))

(defun-sk putnambench-putnam-1977-a4-statement (zero one)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (and
      (p77a4-archimedean-ordered-field-p zero one)
      (p77a4-member-p x)
      (p77a4-less-p zero x)
      (p77a4-less-p x one))
     (p77a4-series-sums-to-solution-p
      zero one x))))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

title: putnam_1977_a4
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1977_a4:
-- for every real x in (0, 1), the series with nth term
-- x^(2^n) / (1 - x^(2^(n+1))) sums to x / (1 - x). This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; _*_)

infix 4 _!=_ _<=N_
infixr 3 _and_
infixr 2 _or_

data Bottom : Set where

Not : Set -> Set
Not A =
  A -> Bottom

_!=_ : {A : Set} -> A -> A -> Set
x != y =
  Not (x == y)

record _and_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data _or_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  left  : A -> A or B
  right : B -> A or B

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

data _<=N_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set where
  zero<=   : {n : Nat} -> zero <=N n
  suc<=suc : {m n : Nat} -> m <=N n -> suc m <=N suc n

record CompleteOrderedRealField (R : Set) : Set1 where
  field
    zeroR oneR : R
    add multiply : R -> R -> R
    negate inverse : R -> R
    lessOrEqual : R -> R -> Set
    fromNat : Nat -> R

    one-not-zero :
      oneR != zeroR

    add-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> add x y == add y x
    add-associative :
      (x y z : R) -> add (add x y) z == add x (add y z)
    add-zero :
      (x : R) -> add x zeroR == x
    add-inverse :
      (x : R) -> add x (negate x) == zeroR

    multiply-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> multiply x y == multiply y x
    multiply-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply (multiply x y) z == multiply x (multiply y z)
    multiply-one :
      (x : R) -> multiply x oneR == x
    multiply-zero :
      (x : R) -> multiply x zeroR == zeroR
    distribute :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply x (add y z) ==
      add (multiply x y) (multiply x z)
    inverse-zero :
      inverse zeroR == zeroR
    multiply-inverse :
      (x : R) ->
      x != zeroR ->
      multiply x (inverse x) == oneR

    order-reflexive :
      (x : R) -> lessOrEqual x x
    order-transitive :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y z ->
      lessOrEqual x z
    order-antisymmetric :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y x ->
      x == y
    order-total :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y or lessOrEqual y x
    add-order :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual (add z x) (add z y)
    multiply-nonnegative :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR x ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR y ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR (multiply x y)
    zero-less-than-one :
      lessOrEqual zeroR oneR and zeroR != oneR

    fromNat-zero :
      fromNat zero == zeroR
    fromNat-successor :
      (n : Nat) -> fromNat (suc n) == add (fromNat n) oneR
    fromNat-addition :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m + n) == add (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-multiplication :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m * n) == multiply (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-injective :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat m == fromNat n ->
      m == n

    archimedean :
      (x : R) ->
      Exists Nat (\ n -> lessOrEqual x (fromNat n))
    least-upper-bound :
      (P : R -> Set) ->
      Exists R P ->
      Exists R
        (\ upper ->
          (x : R) ->
          P x ->
          lessOrEqual x upper) ->
      Exists R
        (\ supremum ->
          ((x : R) ->
            P x ->
            lessOrEqual x supremum)
          and
          ((upper : R) ->
            ((x : R) ->
              P x ->
              lessOrEqual x upper) ->
            lessOrEqual supremum upper))

open CompleteOrderedRealField

subtract :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
subtract reals x y =
  add reals x (negate reals y)

divide :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
divide reals x y =
  multiply reals x (inverse reals y)

StrictLess :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
StrictLess reals x y =
  lessOrEqual reals x y and x != y

CloseTo :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
CloseTo reals center radius x =
  StrictLess reals
    (subtract reals center radius)
    x
  and
  StrictLess reals
    x
    (add reals center radius)

naturalPower :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  Nat ->
  R
naturalPower reals x zero =
  oneR reals
naturalPower reals x (suc n) =
  multiply reals
    (naturalPower reals x n)
    x

naturalNatPower : Nat -> Nat -> Nat
naturalNatPower base zero =
  suc zero
naturalNatPower base (suc exponent) =
  naturalNatPower base exponent * base

twoTo : Nat -> Nat
twoTo n =
  naturalNatPower (suc (suc zero)) n

sumFirst :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Nat ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  R
sumFirst reals zero term =
  zeroR reals
sumFirst reals (suc n) term =
  add reals
    (sumFirst reals n term)
    (term n)

ConvergesTo :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  R ->
  Set
ConvergesTo {R} reals sequence limit =
  (epsilon : R) ->
  StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) epsilon ->
  Exists Nat
    (\ cutoff ->
      (n : Nat) ->
      cutoff <=N n ->
      CloseTo reals limit epsilon (sequence n))

SeriesHasSum :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  R ->
  Set
SeriesHasSum reals terms limit =
  ConvergesTo reals
    (\ n -> sumFirst reals n terms)
    limit

putnamTerm :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  Nat ->
  R
putnamTerm reals x n =
  divide reals
    (naturalPower reals x (twoTo n))
    (subtract reals
      (oneR reals)
      (naturalPower reals x (twoTo (suc n))))

putnam-1977-a4-solution :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R
putnam-1977-a4-solution reals x =
  divide reals
    x
    (subtract reals (oneR reals) x)

InOpenUnitInterval :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  Set
InOpenUnitInterval reals x =
  StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) x
  and
  StrictLess reals x (oneR reals)

putnam-1977-a4 : Set1
putnam-1977-a4 =
  (R : Set) ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) ->
  (x : R) ->
  InOpenUnitInterval reals x ->
  SeriesHasSum reals
    (putnamTerm reals x)
    (putnam-1977-a4-solution reals x)

(*
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench artifact putnam_1977_a4:
  the lacunary real series with terms x^(2^n) / (1 - x^(2^(n+1)))
  equals the rational function x / (1 - x) on (0,1). This file contains no
  proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open arithmeticTheory realTheory seqTheory;

val putnam_1977_a4 =
  ``!x : real.
      0 < x /\ x < 1
      ==>
      suminf
        (\n : num.
           x pow (2 EXP n) /
           (1 - x pow (2 EXP (n + 1)))) =

content:
$(
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact
  putnam_1977_a4: evaluation on the open unit interval of a real series
  with powers indexed by powers of two as the rational function x/(1-x).
  This file contains no proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  For each real x with 0 < x < 1, the NN0-indexed sequence consists of the
  finite partial sums through index n of

    x^(2^k) / (1 - x^(2^(k+1))).

  Convergence of these partial sums to x/(1-x) is the standard sequence-limit
  encoding of the infinite-sum equality in the Lean and Isabelle sources and
  the intended convergence statement in the Rocq source. The inclusive
  partial-sum convention differs from an exclusive upper bound by only the
  indexing of the same series.

  The final declaration is the single unproved $a corpus statement; this
  database contains no $p proof statement.
$)

${
  $d k n x $.

  putnambench-putnam-1977-a4 $a |- A. x e. RR
    (
      (
        0 < x
        /\
        x < 1
      )
      ->
      (
        n e. NN0 |->
          sum_ k e. ( 0 ... n )
            (
              ( x ^ ( 2 ^ k ) )
              /
              (
                1
                -
                ( x ^ ( 2 ^ ( k + 1 ) ) )
              )
            )
      )
      ~~>
      ( x / ( 1 - x ) )
    )
  $.
$}

% Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1977_a4:
% the dyadic-power series on 0 < x < 1 sums to the rational function
% x / (1 - x). This file contains no proof.

putnam_1977_a4: THEORY
BEGIN
  real_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> real]

  safe_div(numerator, denominator: real): real =
    IF denominator = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      numerator / denominator
    ENDIF

  partial_sum(values: real_sequence, count: nat): RECURSIVE real =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      partial_sum(values, count - 1) + values(count - 1)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  series_sums_to(values: real_sequence, total: real): bool =
    FORALL (epsilon_value: posreal):
      EXISTS (cutoff: nat):
        FORALL (count: nat):
          cutoff <= count IMPLIES
            abs(partial_sum(values, count) - total) < epsilon_value

  dyadic_term(x: real, index: nat): real =
    safe_div(
      x ^ (2 ^ index),
      1 - x ^ (2 ^ (index + 1)))

  dyadic_terms(x: real): real_sequence =
    LAMBDA (index: nat): dyadic_term(x, index)

  putnam_1977_a4_solution(x: real): real =
    safe_div(x, 1 - x)

  putnam_1977_a4: bool =
    FORALL (x: real):
      (0 < x AND x < 1)
      IMPLIES
        series_sums_to(
          dyadic_terms(x),
          putnam_1977_a4_solution(x))
END putnam_1977_a4

;; for a prime natural p and natural numbers m >= n, the binomial coefficients
;; choose(p*m,p*n) and choose(m,n) are congruent modulo p. This file contains

(in-package "ACL2")

;; Pascal recursion represents the natural-number binomial coefficient.
(defun putnam-1977-a5-binomial-coefficient (n k)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix n)))
  (if (or (zp k)
          (zp n))
      (if (zp k) 1 0)
    (+ (putnam-1977-a5-binomial-coefficient (- n 1) k)
       (putnam-1977-a5-binomial-coefficient
        (- n 1) (- k 1)))))

(defun putnam-1977-a5-no-divisor-through-p (p candidate)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix candidate)))
  (if (or (not (natp candidate))
          (<= candidate 1))
      t
    (and
     (not (equal (mod p candidate) 0))
     (putnam-1977-a5-no-divisor-through-p
      p (- candidate 1)))))

(defun putnam-1977-a5-prime-p (p)
  (and
   (natp p)
   (< 1 p)
   (putnam-1977-a5-no-divisor-through-p
    p (- p 1))))

   (and
    (natp p)
    (natp m)
    (natp n)
    (putnam-1977-a5-prime-p p)
    (<= n m))
   (equal
    (mod
     (putnam-1977-a5-binomial-coefficient
      (* p m) (* p n))
     p)
    (mod
     (putnam-1977-a5-binomial-coefficient m n)
     p))))

-- Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1977_a5:
-- for a prime natural p and naturals m at least n, the binomial coefficients
-- C(p*m,p*n) and C(m,n) are congruent modulo p. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using
  (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; _*_; mod-helper)

infix 4 _<=_ _divides_
infixr 2 _or_

data _<=_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set where
  zero<= : {n : Nat} -> zero <= n
  suc<=suc : {m n : Nat} -> m <= n -> suc m <= suc n

record _divides_ (divisor dividend : Nat) : Set where
  field
    quotient : Nat
    division-equation : dividend == divisor * quotient

data _or_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  left : A -> A or B
  right : B -> A or B

record Prime (p : Nat) : Set where
  field
    at-least-two : suc (suc zero) <= p
    only-trivial-divisors :
      (d : Nat) ->
      d divides p ->
      (d == suc zero) or (d == p)

one : Nat
one =
  suc zero

choose : Nat -> Nat -> Nat
choose n zero =
  one
choose zero (suc k) =
  zero
choose (suc n) (suc k) =
  choose n (suc k) + choose n k

naturalMod : Nat -> Nat -> Nat
naturalMod numerator zero =
  numerator
naturalMod numerator (suc denominator) =
  mod-helper zero denominator numerator denominator

ModEq : Nat -> Nat -> Nat -> Set
ModEq modulus lhs rhs =
  naturalMod lhs modulus == naturalMod rhs modulus

putnam-1977-a5 : Set
putnam-1977-a5 =
  (p m n : Nat) ->
  Prime p ->
  n <= m ->
  ModEq p
    (choose (p * m) (p * n))
    (choose m n)

content:
% Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench artifact putnam_1977_a5:
% for a prime p and natural numbers m >= n, the binomial coefficients
% (p*m choose p*n) and (m choose n) are congruent modulo p. This file contains no proof.

putnam_1977_a5: THEORY
BEGIN
  nat_divides(divisor: posnat, value: nat): bool =
    EXISTS (quotient: nat): value = divisor * quotient

  prime_nat(value: nat): bool =
    value >= 2
      AND FORALL (divisor: posnat):
        nat_divides(divisor, value)
          IMPLIES divisor = 1 OR divisor = value

  binomial_coefficient(n, k: nat): RECURSIVE nat =
    IF k = 0 THEN
      1
    ELSIF n = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      binomial_coefficient(n - 1, k - 1)
        + binomial_coefficient(n - 1, k)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE n

  putnam_1977_a5: bool =
    FORALL (p, m, n: nat):
      (prime_nat(p) AND m >= n)
        IMPLIES
          mod(binomial_coefficient(p * m, p * n), p)
            = mod(binomial_coefficient(m, n), p)
END putnam_1977_a5

-- True
/--
Let $X$ be the square $[0, 1] \times [0, 1]$, and let $f : X \to \mathbb{R}$ be continuous. If $\int_Y f(x, y) \, dx \, dy = 0$ for all squares $Y$ such that
\begin{itemize}
\item[(1)] $Y \subseteq X$,
\item[(2)] $Y$ has sides parallel to those of $X$,
\item[(3)] at least one of $Y$'s sides is contained in the boundary of $X$,
\end{itemize}
is it true that $f(x, y) = 0$ for all $x, y$?

(X : Set (ℝ × ℝ))
(hX : X = Set.prod (Icc 0 1) (Icc 0 1))
(room : (ℝ × ℝ) → ℝ)
(hroom : room = fun (a,b) ↦ min (min a (1 - a)) (min b (1 - b)))
: ((∀ f : (ℝ × ℝ) → ℝ, Continuous f → (∀ P ∈ X, ∫ x in (P.1 - room P)..(P.1 + room P), ∫ y in (P.2 - room P)..(P.2 + room P), f (x, y) = 0) → (∀ P ∈ X, f P = 0)) ↔ putnam_1977_a6_solution) :=

(* Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench artifact putnam_1977_a6: vanishing integrals over maximal centered squares for a continuous real function imply pointwise vanishing on the unit square; this file contains no proof. *)
From Stdlib Require Import Reals.

Open Scope R_scope.

Definition putnam_1977_a6_solution : Prop := True.

Definition putnam_1977_a6_unit_square (p : (R * R)%type) : Prop :=
  0 <= fst p <= 1 /\ 0 <= snd p <= 1.

Definition putnam_1977_a6_room (p : (R * R)%type) : R :=
  Rmin (Rmin (fst p) (1 - fst p))
       (Rmin (snd p) (1 - snd p)).

Definition putnam_1977_a6_continuous
    (f : (R * R)%type -> R) : Prop :=
  forall x y eps : R,
    eps > 0 ->
    exists delta : R,
      delta > 0 /\
      forall x' y' : R,
        Rabs (x' - x) < delta ->
        Rabs (y' - y) < delta ->
        Rabs (f (x', y') - f (x, y)) < eps.

Definition putnam_1977_a6_square_integral_has_value
    (f : (R * R)%type -> R) (p : (R * R)%type)
    (value : R) : Prop :=
  exists inner_integral : R -> R,
    (forall x : R,
      exists inner_integrable :
        Riemann_integrable
          (fun y : R => f (x, y))
          (snd p - putnam_1977_a6_room p)
          (snd p + putnam_1977_a6_room p),
        inner_integral x = RiemannInt inner_integrable) /\
    exists outer_integrable :
      Riemann_integrable
        inner_integral
        (fst p - putnam_1977_a6_room p)
        (fst p + putnam_1977_a6_room p),
      value = RiemannInt outer_integrable.

Theorem putnam_1977_a6 :
  ((forall f : (R * R)%type -> R,
      putnam_1977_a6_continuous f ->
      (forall p : (R * R)%type,
        putnam_1977_a6_unit_square p ->
        putnam_1977_a6_square_integral_has_value f p 0) ->
      forall p : (R * R)%type,
        putnam_1977_a6_unit_square p ->
        f p = 0) <->
    putnam_1977_a6_solution).
Admitted.

title: putnam_1977_a6
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1977_a6:
;; injectivity of the integrals of a continuous real function over all
;; maximal centered axis-parallel squares in the unit square. This file
;; contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))

;; FUNCTION and PRIMITIVE are ACL2 function objects giving rational Cauchy
;; names for a real-valued function g and its normalized double primitive G
;; on rational points of [0,1]^2. MODULUS is a uniform-continuity modulus for
;; g. Positive rational tolerances are cofinal in the positive reals, so the
;; Cauchy and continuity matrices below denote exact real values and genuine
;; uniform continuity, rather than finite samples or rational-valued
;; restrictions.
;;
;; Every continuous source function restricted to the unit square has such
;; names and a modulus. Conversely, every accepted name denotes a continuous
;; real function on the square; such a function extends continuously to the
;; plane, so restricting the source's domain to the square is bidirectionally
;; equivalent.
;;
;; The local rectangle matrix says that the mixed increment of G over a
;; sufficiently small rectangle differs from its area times g at the
;; lower-left corner by at most twice area times the requested tolerance.
;; Uniform continuity and subdivision show that this is equivalent to
;;
;;   G(b,d)-G(a,d)-G(b,c)+G(a,c)
;;     = integral_[a,b]x[c,d] g,
;;
;; with G zero on the coordinate axes. Thus the square hypotheses below are
;; exactly the source double-integral hypotheses. Rational centers are dense,
;; and both the room function and mixed increments of G are continuous, so
;; quantifying rational centers is equivalent to quantifying every real
;; center. The final matrix similarly says exactly that g vanishes everywhere.

(defun putnam-1977-a6-quoted (object)
  (list 'quote object))

(defun putnam-1977-a6-term-list (terms)
  (if (consp terms)
      (list 'cons
            (car terms)
            (putnam-1977-a6-term-list (cdr terms)))
    nil))

(defun putnam-1977-a6-apply-term (function arguments)
  (list 'apply$
        (putnam-1977-a6-quoted function)
        (putnam-1977-a6-term-list arguments)))

(defun putnam-1977-a6-and-terms (terms)
  (if (consp terms)
      (list 'if
            (car terms)
            (putnam-1977-a6-and-terms (cdr terms))
            (putnam-1977-a6-quoted nil))
    (putnam-1977-a6-quoted t)))

(defun putnam-1977-a6-implies-term (hypothesis conclusion)
  (list 'if
        hypothesis
        conclusion
        (putnam-1977-a6-quoted t)))

(defun putnam-1977-a6-add-term (left right)
  (list 'binary-+ left right))

(defun putnam-1977-a6-negate-term (value)
  (list 'unary-- value))

(defun putnam-1977-a6-subtract-term (left right)
  (putnam-1977-a6-add-term
   left
   (putnam-1977-a6-negate-term right)))

(defun putnam-1977-a6-multiply-term (left right)
  (list 'binary-* left right))

(defun putnam-1977-a6-absolute-term (value)
  (list 'if
        (list '< value 0)
        (putnam-1977-a6-negate-term value)
        value))

(defun putnam-1977-a6-less-equal-term (left right)
  (list 'if
        (list '< right left)
        (putnam-1977-a6-quoted nil)
        (putnam-1977-a6-quoted t)))

(defun putnam-1977-a6-minimum-term (left right)
  (list 'if
        (list '< left right)
        left
        right))

(defun putnam-1977-a6-positive-rational-term (value)
  (putnam-1977-a6-and-terms
   (list
    (list 'rationalp value)
    (list '< 0 value))))

(defun putnam-1977-a6-unit-rational-term (value)
  (putnam-1977-a6-and-terms
   (list
    (list 'rationalp value)
    (putnam-1977-a6-less-equal-term 0 value)
    (putnam-1977-a6-less-equal-term value 1))))

(defun putnam-1977-a6-true-function (formals)
  (list 'lambda
        formals
        (putnam-1977-a6-quoted t)))

(defun putnam-1977-a6-cauchy-function (function)
  (let* ((value-at-epsilon
          (putnam-1977-a6-apply-term
           function '(x y epsilon)))
         (value-at-eta
          (putnam-1977-a6-apply-term
           function '(x y eta)))
         (distance
          (putnam-1977-a6-absolute-term
           (putnam-1977-a6-subtract-term
            value-at-epsilon value-at-eta))))
    (list
     'lambda
     '(x y epsilon eta)
     (putnam-1977-a6-implies-term
      (putnam-1977-a6-and-terms
       (list
        (putnam-1977-a6-unit-rational-term 'x)
        (putnam-1977-a6-unit-rational-term 'y)
        (putnam-1977-a6-positive-rational-term 'epsilon)
        (putnam-1977-a6-positive-rational-term 'eta)))
      (putnam-1977-a6-and-terms
       (list
        (list 'rationalp value-at-epsilon)
        (list 'rationalp value-at-eta)
        (putnam-1977-a6-less-equal-term
         distance
         (putnam-1977-a6-add-term 'epsilon 'eta))))))))

(defun putnam-1977-a6-modulus-function (modulus)
  (let ((delta
         (putnam-1977-a6-apply-term modulus '(epsilon))))
    (list
     'lambda
     '(epsilon)
     (putnam-1977-a6-implies-term
      (putnam-1977-a6-positive-rational-term 'epsilon)
      (putnam-1977-a6-positive-rational-term delta)))))

(defun putnam-1977-a6-continuity-function (function modulus)
  (let* ((delta
          (putnam-1977-a6-apply-term modulus '(epsilon)))
         (quarter-epsilon
          (putnam-1977-a6-multiply-term 1/4 'epsilon))
         (half-epsilon
          (putnam-1977-a6-multiply-term 1/2 'epsilon))
         (left-value
          (putnam-1977-a6-apply-term
           function
           (list 'x1 'y1 quarter-epsilon)))
         (right-value
          (putnam-1977-a6-apply-term
           function
           (list 'x2 'y2 quarter-epsilon)))
         (x-distance
          (putnam-1977-a6-absolute-term
           (putnam-1977-a6-subtract-term 'x1 'x2)))
         (y-distance
          (putnam-1977-a6-absolute-term
           (putnam-1977-a6-subtract-term 'y1 'y2)))
         (value-distance
          (putnam-1977-a6-absolute-term
           (putnam-1977-a6-subtract-term
            left-value right-value))))
    (list
     'lambda
     '(x1 y1 x2 y2 epsilon)
     (putnam-1977-a6-implies-term
      (putnam-1977-a6-and-terms
       (list
        (putnam-1977-a6-unit-rational-term 'x1)
        (putnam-1977-a6-unit-rational-term 'y1)
        (putnam-1977-a6-unit-rational-term 'x2)
        (putnam-1977-a6-unit-rational-term 'y2)
        (putnam-1977-a6-positive-rational-term 'epsilon)
        (putnam-1977-a6-positive-rational-term delta)
        (list '< x-distance delta)
        (list '< y-distance delta)))
      (putnam-1977-a6-less-equal-term
       value-distance half-epsilon)))))

(defun putnam-1977-a6-normalized-primitive-function (primitive)
  (let* ((x-axis-value
          (putnam-1977-a6-apply-term
           primitive '(x 0 epsilon)))
         (y-axis-value
          (putnam-1977-a6-apply-term
           primitive '(0 y epsilon))))
    (list
     'lambda
     '(x y epsilon)
     (putnam-1977-a6-implies-term
      (putnam-1977-a6-and-terms
       (list
        (putnam-1977-a6-unit-rational-term 'x)
        (putnam-1977-a6-unit-rational-term 'y)
        (putnam-1977-a6-positive-rational-term 'epsilon)))
      (putnam-1977-a6-and-terms
       (list
        (putnam-1977-a6-less-equal-term

title: putnam_1977_a6
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1977_a6:
-- vanishing integrals over every maximal axis-parallel square centered in the
-- unit square force a continuous real function to vanish there; the answer is
-- true. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; _*_)

infix 4 _!=_ _<=N_
infixr 3 _and_
infixr 2 _or_

data Bottom : Set where

record Top : Set where
  constructor top

Not : Set -> Set
Not A =
  A -> Bottom

_!=_ : {A : Set} -> A -> A -> Set
x != y =
  Not (x == y)

record _and_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data _or_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  left  : A -> A or B
  right : B -> A or B

record Iff (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor equivalence
  field
    forward  : A -> B
    backward : B -> A

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

data _<=N_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set where
  zero<=   : {n : Nat} -> zero <=N n
  suc<=suc : {m n : Nat} -> m <=N n -> suc m <=N suc n

data Fin : Nat -> Set where
  fzero : {n : Nat} -> Fin (suc n)
  fsuc  : {n : Nat} -> Fin n -> Fin (suc n)

record CompleteOrderedRealField (R : Set) : Set1 where
  field
    zeroR oneR : R
    add multiply : R -> R -> R
    negate inverse : R -> R
    lessOrEqual : R -> R -> Set
    fromNat : Nat -> R

    one-not-zero :
      oneR != zeroR

    add-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> add x y == add y x
    add-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      add (add x y) z == add x (add y z)
    add-zero :
      (x : R) -> add x zeroR == x
    add-inverse :
      (x : R) -> add x (negate x) == zeroR

    multiply-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> multiply x y == multiply y x
    multiply-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply (multiply x y) z ==
      multiply x (multiply y z)
    multiply-one :
      (x : R) -> multiply x oneR == x
    multiply-zero :
      (x : R) -> multiply x zeroR == zeroR
    distribute :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply x (add y z) ==
      add (multiply x y) (multiply x z)
    inverse-zero :
      inverse zeroR == zeroR
    multiply-inverse :
      (x : R) ->
      x != zeroR ->
      multiply x (inverse x) == oneR

    order-reflexive :
      (x : R) -> lessOrEqual x x
    order-transitive :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y z ->
      lessOrEqual x z
    order-antisymmetric :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y x ->
      x == y
    order-total :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y or lessOrEqual y x
    add-order :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual (add z x) (add z y)
    multiply-nonnegative :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR x ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR y ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR (multiply x y)
    zero-less-than-one :
      lessOrEqual zeroR oneR and zeroR != oneR

    fromNat-zero :
      fromNat zero == zeroR
    fromNat-successor :
      (n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (suc n) == add (fromNat n) oneR
    fromNat-addition :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m + n) == add (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-multiplication :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m * n) == multiply (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-injective :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat m == fromNat n ->
      m == n

    archimedean :
      (x : R) ->
      Exists Nat (\ n -> lessOrEqual x (fromNat n))
    least-upper-bound :
      (P : R -> Set) ->
      Exists R P ->
      Exists R
        (\ upper ->
          (x : R) ->
          P x ->
          lessOrEqual x upper) ->
      Exists R
        (\ supremum ->
          ((x : R) ->
            P x ->
            lessOrEqual x supremum)
          and
          ((upper : R) ->
            ((x : R) ->
              P x ->
              lessOrEqual x upper) ->
            lessOrEqual supremum upper))

open CompleteOrderedRealField

record Point (R : Set) : Set where
  constructor point
  field
    x-coordinate : R
    y-coordinate : R

open Point

Predicate : Set -> Set1
Predicate A =
  A -> Set

subtract :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
subtract reals x y =
  add reals x (negate reals y)

divide :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
divide reals x y =
  multiply reals x (inverse reals y)

StrictLess :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
StrictLess reals x y =
  lessOrEqual reals x y and x != y

CloseTo :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
CloseTo reals center radius x =
  StrictLess reals
    (subtract reals center radius)
    x
  and
  StrictLess reals
    x
    (add reals center radius)

PairClose :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Point R ->
  R ->
  Point R ->
  Set
PairClose reals center radius p =
  CloseTo reals
    (x-coordinate center)
    radius
    (x-coordinate p)
  and
  CloseTo reals
    (y-coordinate center)
    radius
    (y-coordinate p)

Continuous :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (Point R -> R) ->
  Set
Continuous {R} reals function =
  (center : Point R) ->
  (epsilon : R) ->
  StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) epsilon ->
  Exists R
    (\ delta ->
      StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) delta
      and
      ((p : Point R) ->
        PairClose reals center delta p ->
        CloseTo reals
          (function center)
          epsilon
          (function p)))

natIndex :
  {n : Nat} ->
  Fin n ->
  Nat
natIndex fzero =
  zero
natIndex (fsuc i) =
  suc (natIndex i)

sumFin :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  {n : Nat} ->
  (Fin n -> R) ->
  R
sumFin reals {zero} term =
  zeroR reals
sumFin reals {suc n} term =
  add reals
    (term fzero)
    (sumFin reals (\ i -> term (fsuc i)))

gridPoint :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (lower upper : R) ->
  {n : Nat} ->
  Fin n ->
  R
gridPoint reals lower upper {n} i =
  add reals
    lower
    (multiply reals
      (divide reals
        (subtract reals upper lower)
        (fromNat reals n))
      (fromNat reals (natIndex i)))

rectangleRiemannSum :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (Point R -> R) ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Nat ->
  R
rectangleRiemannSum reals function
  lowerX upperX lowerY upperY n =
  multiply reals
    (multiply reals
      (divide reals
        (subtract reals upperX lowerX)
        (fromNat reals n))
      (divide reals
        (subtract reals upperY lowerY)
        (fromNat reals n)))
    (sumFin reals {n = n}
      (\ i ->
        sumFin reals {n = n}
          (\ j ->
            function
              (point
                (gridPoint reals lowerX upperX i)
                (gridPoint reals lowerY upperY j)))))

ConvergesTo :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  R ->
  Set
ConvergesTo {R} reals sequence limit =
  (epsilon : R) ->
  StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) epsilon ->
  Exists Nat
    (\ cutoff ->
      (n : Nat) ->
      cutoff <=N n ->
      CloseTo reals limit epsilon (sequence n))

RectangleIntegral :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (Point R -> R) ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
RectangleIntegral reals function
  lowerX upperX lowerY upperY value =
  ConvergesTo reals
    (\ n ->
      rectangleRiemannSum reals function
        lowerX upperX lowerY upperY (suc n))
    value

UnitSquare :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Predicate (Point R)
UnitSquare reals p =
  lessOrEqual reals (zeroR reals) (x-coordinate p)
  and
  lessOrEqual reals (x-coordinate p) (oneR reals)
  and
  lessOrEqual reals (zeroR reals) (y-coordinate p)
  and
  lessOrEqual reals (y-coordinate p) (oneR reals)

RoomValue :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Point R ->
  R ->
  Set
RoomValue reals p radius =
  lessOrEqual reals radius (x-coordinate p)
  and
  lessOrEqual reals radius
    (subtract reals (oneR reals) (x-coordinate p))
  and
  lessOrEqual reals radius (y-coordinate p)
  and
  lessOrEqual reals radius
    (subtract reals (oneR reals) (y-coordinate p))
  and
  (radius == x-coordinate p
  or
  radius == subtract reals (oneR reals) (x-coordinate p)
  or
  radius == y-coordinate p
  or
  radius == subtract reals (oneR reals) (y-coordinate p))

SetMatchesUnitSquare :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Predicate (Point R) ->
  Set
SetMatchesUnitSquare {R} reals X =
  (p : Point R) ->
  Iff (X p) (UnitSquare reals p)

RoomMatchesDefinition :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (Point R -> R) ->
  Set
RoomMatchesDefinition {R} reals room =
  (p : Point R) ->
  RoomValue reals p (room p)

CenteredSquareIntegralIsZero :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (Point R -> R) ->
  (Point R -> R) ->
  Point R ->
  Set
CenteredSquareIntegralIsZero reals room function p =
  RectangleIntegral reals function
    (subtract reals (x-coordinate p) (room p))
    (add reals (x-coordinate p) (room p))
    (subtract reals (y-coordinate p) (room p))
    (add reals (y-coordinate p) (room p))
    (zeroR reals)

PutnamImplication :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Predicate (Point R) ->
  (Point R -> R) ->
  Set
PutnamImplication {R} reals X room =
  (function : Point R -> R) ->
  Continuous reals function ->
  ((p : Point R) ->
    X p ->
    CenteredSquareIntegralIsZero
      reals room function p) ->
  (p : Point R) ->
  X p ->
  function p == zeroR reals

putnam-1977-a6-solution : Set
putnam-1977-a6-solution =
  Top

putnam-1977-a6 : Set1
putnam-1977-a6 =
  (R : Set) ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) ->
  (X : Predicate (Point R)) ->
  SetMatchesUnitSquare reals X ->
  (room : Point R -> R) ->
  RoomMatchesDefinition reals room ->
  Iff
    (PutnamImplication reals X room)
    putnam-1977-a6-solution

title: putnam_1977_a6
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench artifact putnam_1977_a6:
  vanishing integrals over all centered maximal axis-parallel squares in the
  unit square force a continuous real function to vanish there. This file
  contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open pairTheory pred_setTheory metricTheory topologyTheory realTheory;
open real_topologyTheory integrationTheory;

val putnam_1977_a6 =
  ``let X =
      \P : real # real.
        0 <= FST P /\ FST P <= 1 /\
        0 <= SND P /\ SND P <= 1
    in
    let room =
      \P : real # real.
        min (min (FST P) (1 - FST P))
            (min (SND P) (1 - SND P))
    in
    let solution = T
    in
      ((!f : real # real -> real.
          continuous_map (mtop mr2, euclidean) f
          ==>
          ((!P : real # real.
              X P
              ==>
              integration$integral
                (interval [FST P - room P, FST P + room P])
                (\x : real.
                   integration$integral
                     (interval [SND P - room P, SND P + room P])
                     (\y : real. f (x, y))) =
              0)
           ==>
           !P : real # real. X P ==> f P = 0))
       <=>
       solution)``;

title: putnam_1977_a6
content:
$(
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact
  putnam_1977_a6: the affirmative assertion that a continuous real function
  on the unit square is zero when its integral over every centered square
  reaching the boundary is zero. This file contains no proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  P77A6Edge(t) is min(t,1-t), and P77A6Room(x,y) is the minimum of the
  four distances x, 1-x, y, and 1-y from a point of the unit square to its
  sides. P77A6Continuous(f) expands global joint continuity of a total
  real-valued function on RR X. RR in epsilon-delta form; coordinatewise
  delta neighborhoods induce the standard product topology.

  The nested Lebesgue integrals are over the closed centered square with
  radius P77A6Room(x,y). For continuous functions this iterated integral is
  equal to the product-measure integral used by the Isabelle source.

  The final declaration is the single unproved $a corpus statement; this
  database contains no $p proof statement.
$)

$c P77A6Edge P77A6Room P77A6Continuous $.

p77a6-edge-syntax $a class ( P77A6Edge x ) $.
p77a6-room-syntax $a class ( P77A6Room x y ) $.
p77a6-continuous-syntax $a wff ( P77A6Continuous F ) $.

p77a6-edge-definition $a |- (
  ( P77A6Edge x )
  =
  if (
    x <_ ( 1 - x ) ,
    x ,
    ( 1 - x )
  )
) $.

${
  $d x y $.

  p77a6-room-definition $a |- (
    ( P77A6Room x y )
    =
    if (
      ( P77A6Edge x ) <_ ( P77A6Edge y ) ,
      ( P77A6Edge x ) ,
      ( P77A6Edge y )
    )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d d e f u v x y $.

  p77a6-continuous-definition $a |- (
    ( P77A6Continuous f )
    <->
    A. x e. RR A. y e. RR A. e e. RR
      (
        0 < e
        ->
        E. d e. RR
          (
            0 < d
            /\
            A. u e. RR A. v e. RR
              (
                (
                  ( abs ` ( u - x ) ) < d
                  /\
                  ( abs ` ( v - y ) ) < d
                )
                ->
                (
                  abs
                  `
                  (
                    ( f ` <. u , v >. )
                    -
                    ( f ` <. x , y >. )
                  )
                )
                < e
              )
          )
      )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d f u v x y $.

  putnambench-putnam-1977-a6 $a |-
    A. f e. ( RR ^m ( RR X. RR ) )
      (
        ( P77A6Continuous f )
        ->
        (
          (
            A. x e. ( 0 [,] 1 ) A. y e. ( 0 [,] 1 )
              (
                S.
                  (
                    ( x - ( P77A6Room x y ) )
                    [,]
                    ( x + ( P77A6Room x y ) )
                  )
                  (
                    S.
                      (
                        ( y - ( P77A6Room x y ) )
                        [,]
                        ( y + ( P77A6Room x y ) )
                      )
                      ( f ` <. u , v >. )
                      _d v
                  )
                  _d u
              )
              =
              0
          )
          ->
          A. x e. ( 0 [,] 1 ) A. y e. ( 0 [,] 1 )
            ( f ` <. x , y >. ) = 0
        )
      )
  $.
$}

% Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1977_a6:
% a continuous real function on the unit square whose integral vanishes on
% every centered maximal boundary-touching square must vanish on the square.
% This file contains no proof.

putnam_1977_a6: THEORY
BEGIN
  point: TYPE = [# x_coord: real, y_coord: real #]
  plane_function: TYPE = [point -> real]
  real_function: TYPE = [real -> real]
  real_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> real]

  real_min(left, right: real): real =
    IF left <= right THEN left ELSE right ENDIF

  unit_square(P: point): bool =
    0 <= x_coord(P) AND x_coord(P) <= 1
      AND 0 <= y_coord(P) AND y_coord(P) <= 1

  room(P: point): real =
    real_min(
      real_min(x_coord(P), 1 - x_coord(P)),
      real_min(y_coord(P), 1 - y_coord(P)))

  continuous(f: plane_function): bool =
    FORALL (P: point), (epsilon_value: posreal):
      EXISTS (delta: posreal):
        FORALL (Q: point):
          (abs(x_coord(Q) - x_coord(P)) < delta
            AND abs(y_coord(Q) - y_coord(P)) < delta)
          IMPLIES
            abs(f(Q) - f(P)) < epsilon_value

  valid_tagged_partition(
      left, right: real,
      points, tags: real_sequence,
      count: nat): bool =
    count > 0
      AND points(0) = left
      AND points(count) = right
      AND FORALL (index: nat):
        index < count IMPLIES
          (points(index) < points(index + 1)
            AND points(index) <= tags(index)
            AND tags(index) <= points(index + 1))

  mesh_less_than(
      points: real_sequence,
      count: nat,
      bound: real): bool =
    FORALL (index: nat):
      index < count IMPLIES
        points(index + 1) - points(index) < bound

  riemann_sum(
      f: real_function,
      points, tags: real_sequence,
      count: nat): RECURSIVE real =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      riemann_sum(f, points, tags, count - 1)
        + f(tags(count - 1))
            * (points(count) - points(count - 1))
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  has_interval_integral(
      f: real_function,
      left, right, integral_value: real): bool =
    IF left = right THEN
      integral_value = 0
    ELSE
      left < right
        AND FORALL (epsilon_value: posreal):
          EXISTS (mesh_bound: posreal):
            FORALL
                (points, tags: real_sequence),
                (count: nat):
              (valid_tagged_partition(
                  left, right, points, tags, count)
                AND mesh_less_than(
                  points, count, mesh_bound))
              IMPLIES
                abs(
                  riemann_sum(f, points, tags, count)
                    - integral_value)
                  < epsilon_value
    ENDIF

  centered_square_integral_is(
      f: plane_function,
      P: point,
      integral_value: real): bool =
    EXISTS (vertical_integrals: real_function):
      (FORALL (x: real):
        x_coord(P) - room(P) <= x
          AND x <= x_coord(P) + room(P)
        IMPLIES
          has_interval_integral(
            LAMBDA (y: real):
              f((# x_coord := x, y_coord := y #)),
            y_coord(P) - room(P),
            y_coord(P) + room(P),
            vertical_integrals(x)))
        AND has_interval_integral(
          vertical_integrals,
          x_coord(P) - room(P),
          x_coord(P) + room(P),
          integral_value)

  putnam_1977_a6_solution: bool = TRUE

  putnam_1977_a6_statement: bool =
    ((FORALL (f: plane_function):
      continuous(f) IMPLIES
        ((FORALL (P: point):
          unit_square(P) IMPLIES
            centered_square_integral_is(f, P, 0))
        IMPLIES
          (FORALL (P: point):
            unit_square(P) IMPLIES f(P) = 0)))
      IFF putnam_1977_a6_solution)
END putnam_1977_a6

;; Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1977_b1:
;; the infinite product of (n^3-1)/(n^3+1) from n=2 converges to 2/3.
;; This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

;; For natural N, this is exactly the product over 2 <= n <= N.  It is 1
;; when N < 2, matching the empty-product convention in the source statements.
(defun putnam-1977-b1-product-prefix (n)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix n)))
  (if (or (not (natp n))
          (< n 2))
      1
    (* (putnam-1977-b1-product-prefix (- n 1))
       (/ (- (expt n 3) 1)
          (+ (expt n 3) 1)))))

(defun putnam-1977-b1-solution ()
  (/ 2 3))

;; Positive rational tolerances are cofinal among positive real tolerances.
;; Natural prefix indices are cofinal in Lean's integer indices, so this is
;; the epsilon definition of the same limit without adding a convergence rate.
(defun-sk putnam-1977-b1-tail-p (epsilon cutoff)
  (forall (n)
    (implies
     (and
      (natp n)
      (<= cutoff n))
     (< (abs
         (- (putnam-1977-b1-product-prefix n)
            (putnam-1977-b1-solution)))
        epsilon))))

(defun-sk putnam-1977-b1-cutoff-exists-p (epsilon)
  (exists (cutoff)
    (and
     (natp cutoff)
     (putnam-1977-b1-tail-p epsilon cutoff))))

(defun putnambench-putnam-1977-b1-statement (epsilon)
  (implies
   (and (rationalp epsilon)
        (< 0 epsilon))
   (putnam-1977-b1-cutoff-exists-p epsilon)))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

title: putnam_1977_b1
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1977_b1:
-- the infinite product from n = 2 of (n cubed - 1) / (n cubed + 1)
-- converges to 2 / 3. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; _*_)

infix 4 _!=_ _<=N_
infixr 3 _and_
infixr 2 _or_

data Bottom : Set where

Not : Set -> Set
Not A =
  A -> Bottom

_!=_ : {A : Set} -> A -> A -> Set
x != y =
  Not (x == y)

record _and_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data _or_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  left  : A -> A or B
  right : B -> A or B

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

data _<=N_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set where
  zero<=   : {n : Nat} -> zero <=N n
  suc<=suc : {m n : Nat} -> m <=N n -> suc m <=N suc n

record CompleteOrderedRealField (R : Set) : Set1 where
  field
    zeroR oneR : R
    addR multiplyR : R -> R -> R
    negateR inverseR : R -> R
    lessOrEqualR : R -> R -> Set
    fromNatR : Nat -> R

    oneR-not-zeroR :
      oneR != zeroR

    addR-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> addR x y == addR y x
    addR-associative :
      (x y z : R) -> addR (addR x y) z == addR x (addR y z)
    addR-zero :
      (x : R) -> addR x zeroR == x
    addR-inverse :
      (x : R) -> addR x (negateR x) == zeroR

    multiplyR-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> multiplyR x y == multiplyR y x
    multiplyR-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiplyR (multiplyR x y) z == multiplyR x (multiplyR y z)
    multiplyR-one :
      (x : R) -> multiplyR x oneR == x
    multiplyR-zero :
      (x : R) -> multiplyR x zeroR == zeroR
    distributeR :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiplyR x (addR y z) ==
      addR (multiplyR x y) (multiplyR x z)
    inverseR-zero :
      inverseR zeroR == zeroR
    multiplyR-inverse :
      (x : R) ->
      x != zeroR ->
      multiplyR x (inverseR x) == oneR

    order-reflexive :
      (x : R) -> lessOrEqualR x x
    order-transitive :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR x y ->
      lessOrEqualR y z ->
      lessOrEqualR x z
    order-antisymmetric :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR x y ->
      lessOrEqualR y x ->
      x == y
    order-total :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR x y or lessOrEqualR y x
    addR-order :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR x y ->
      lessOrEqualR (addR z x) (addR z y)
    multiplyR-nonnegative :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR zeroR x ->
      lessOrEqualR zeroR y ->
      lessOrEqualR zeroR (multiplyR x y)
    zeroR-less-than-oneR :
      lessOrEqualR zeroR oneR and zeroR != oneR

    fromNatR-zero :
      fromNatR zero == zeroR
    fromNatR-successor :
      (n : Nat) -> fromNatR (suc n) == addR (fromNatR n) oneR
    fromNatR-addition :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNatR (m + n) == addR (fromNatR m) (fromNatR n)
    fromNatR-multiplication :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNatR (m * n) == multiplyR (fromNatR m) (fromNatR n)
    fromNatR-injective :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNatR m == fromNatR n ->
      m == n

    archimedean :
      (x : R) ->
      Exists Nat (\ n -> lessOrEqualR x (fromNatR n))
    least-upper-bound :
      (P : R -> Set) ->
      Exists R P ->
      Exists R
        (\ upper ->
          (x : R) ->
          P x ->
          lessOrEqualR x upper) ->
      Exists R
        (\ supremum ->
          ((x : R) -> P x -> lessOrEqualR x supremum)
          and
          ((upper : R) ->
            ((x : R) -> P x -> lessOrEqualR x upper) ->
            lessOrEqualR supremum upper))

open CompleteOrderedRealField

oneN : Nat
oneN =
  suc zero

twoN : Nat
twoN =
  suc oneN

threeN : Nat
threeN =
  suc twoN

subtract :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
subtract reals x y =
  addR reals x (negateR reals y)

divide :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
divide reals x y =
  multiplyR reals x (inverseR reals y)

StrictLess :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
StrictLess reals x y =
  lessOrEqualR reals x y and x != y

CloseTo :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
CloseTo reals center radius x =
  StrictLess reals (subtract reals center radius) x
  and
  StrictLess reals x (addR reals center radius)

SequentialLimit :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  R ->
  Set
SequentialLimit {R} reals sequence limit =
  (epsilon : R) ->
  StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) epsilon ->
  Exists Nat
    (\ cutoff ->
      (n : Nat) ->
      cutoff <=N n ->
      CloseTo reals limit epsilon (sequence n))

naturalPower :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  Nat ->
  R
naturalPower reals x zero =
  oneR reals
naturalPower reals x (suc n) =
  multiplyR reals (naturalPower reals x n) x

productFactor :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Nat ->
  R
productFactor reals n =
  let
    cube = naturalPower reals (fromNatR reals n) threeN
  in
  divide reals
    (subtract reals cube (oneR reals))
    (addR reals cube (oneR reals))

partialProduct :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Nat ->
  R
partialProduct reals zero =
  oneR reals
partialProduct reals (suc zero) =
  oneR reals
partialProduct reals (suc (suc n)) =
  multiplyR reals
    (partialProduct reals (suc n))
    (productFactor reals (suc (suc n)))

twoThirds :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R
twoThirds reals =
  divide reals
    (fromNatR reals twoN)
    (fromNatR reals threeN)

putnam-1977-b1 : Set1
putnam-1977-b1 =
  (R : Set) ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) ->
  SequentialLimit reals
    (partialProduct reals)
    (twoThirds reals)

% Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1977_b1:
% the real infinite product of (n^3 - 1) / (n^3 + 1), starting at n = 2,
% converges to 2 / 3. This file contains no proof.

putnam_1977_b1: THEORY
BEGIN
  real_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> real]

  safe_div(numerator, denominator: real): real =
    IF denominator = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      numerator / denominator
    ENDIF

  product_term(index: nat): real =
    IF index <= 1 THEN
      1
    ELSE
      safe_div(
        (index :: real) ^ 3 - 1,
        (index :: real) ^ 3 + 1)
    ENDIF

  product_partial(count: nat): RECURSIVE real =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      1
    ELSE
      product_partial(count - 1) * product_term(count - 1)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  converges_to(sequence: real_sequence, value: real): bool =
    FORALL (epsilon_value: posreal):
      EXISTS (cutoff: nat):
        FORALL (count: nat):
          cutoff <= count IMPLIES
            abs(sequence(count) - value) < epsilon_value

  putnam_1977_b1_solution: real =
    safe_div(2, 3)

  putnam_1977_b1: bool =
    converges_to(
      LAMBDA (count: nat): product_partial(count),
      putnam_1977_b1_solution)
END putnam_1977_b1

import Mathlib

open RingHom Set Nat Filter Topology

abbrev putnam_1977_b3_solution : Prop := sorry
-- False
/--
An ordered triple $(a, b, c)$ of positive irrational numbers with $a + b + c = 1$ is considered $\textit{balanced}$ if all three elements are less than $\frac{1}{2}$. If a triple is not balanced, we can perform a ``balancing act'' $B$ defined by $B(a, b, c) = (f(a), f(b), f(c))$, where $f(x) = 2x - 1$ if $x > 1/2$ and $f(x) = 2x$ otherwise. Will finitely many iterations of this balancing act always eventually produce a balanced triple?
-/
theorem putnam_1977_b3
(P balanced: ℝ × ℝ × ℝ → Prop)
(B : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ → ℝ × ℝ × ℝ)
(hP : P = fun (a, b, c) => Irrational a ∧ Irrational b ∧ Irrational c ∧ a > 0 ∧ b > 0 ∧ c > 0 ∧ a + b + c = 1)
(hbalanced : balanced = fun (a, b, c) => a < 1/2 ∧ b < 1/2 ∧ c < 1/2)
(hB : B = fun (a, b, c) => (ite (a > 1/2) (2*a - 1) (2*a), ite (b > 1/2) (2*b - 1) (2*b), ite (c > 1/2) (2*c - 1) (2*c)))
: (∀ t : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ, P t → ∃ n : ℕ, balanced (B^[n] t)) ↔ putnam_1977_b3_solution :=
sorry

title: putnam_1977_b3
content:
(* Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench artifact putnam_1977_b3:
   eventual balancing of positive irrational real triples under a piecewise
   doubling map, with the answer that this does not always occur; this file
   contains no proof. *)

From Stdlib Require Import Reals QArith.

Open Scope R_scope.

Definition putnam_1977_b3_triple : Type :=
  (R * R * R)%type.

Definition putnam_1977_b3_irrational (x : R) : Prop :=
  ~ exists q : Q, x = Q2R q.

Definition putnam_1977_b3_positive_irrational
    (t : putnam_1977_b3_triple) : Prop :=
  let '(a, b, c) := t in
  putnam_1977_b3_irrational a /\
  putnam_1977_b3_irrational b /\
  putnam_1977_b3_irrational c /\
  a > 0 /\
  b > 0 /\
  c > 0 /\
  a + b + c = 1.

Definition putnam_1977_b3_balanced
    (t : putnam_1977_b3_triple) : Prop :=
  let '(a, b, c) := t in
  a < 1 / 2 /\ b < 1 / 2 /\ c < 1 / 2.

Definition putnam_1977_b3_step_coordinate (x : R) : R :=
  if Rlt_dec (1 / 2) x then 2 * x - 1 else 2 * x.

Definition putnam_1977_b3_balancing_act
    (t : putnam_1977_b3_triple) : putnam_1977_b3_triple :=
  let '(a, b, c) := t in
  (putnam_1977_b3_step_coordinate a,
   putnam_1977_b3_step_coordinate b,
   putnam_1977_b3_step_coordinate c).

Fixpoint putnam_1977_b3_iterate
    (B : putnam_1977_b3_triple -> putnam_1977_b3_triple)
    (n : nat)
    (t : putnam_1977_b3_triple) : putnam_1977_b3_triple :=
  match n with
  | O => t
  | S k => B (putnam_1977_b3_iterate B k t)
  end.

Definition putnam_1977_b3_solution : Prop := False.

Theorem putnam_1977_b3
    (P balanced : putnam_1977_b3_triple -> Prop)
    (B : putnam_1977_b3_triple -> putnam_1977_b3_triple)
    (hP : P = putnam_1977_b3_positive_irrational)
    (hbalanced : balanced = putnam_1977_b3_balanced)
    (hB : B = putnam_1977_b3_balancing_act) :
  (forall t : putnam_1977_b3_triple,
      P t ->
      exists n : nat,
        balanced (putnam_1977_b3_iterate B n t)) <->
  putnam_1977_b3_solution.
Admitted.
