content:
;; Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1978_a6:
;; fewer than 2*n^(3/2) unordered pairs among n distinct real-plane points
;; are exactly one unit apart. This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))

;; For each fixed finite configuration, its complete pattern of unit-distance
;; equalities and point-distinctness inequalities is first-order over real
;; closed fields. Hence a real counterexample exists exactly when one exists
;; over the real algebraic numbers. A single isolated algebraic number alpha
;; and rational polynomials in alpha encode every finite tuple of algebraic
;; coordinates, so this does not restrict the source's arbitrary real points.
;;
;; If m is the nonnegative number of unordered unit-distance pairs and n > 0,
;;
;;   m < 2*n^(3/2)  iff  m^2 < 4*n^3.
;;
;; The integer inequality below therefore removes the real power without
;; changing the strict bound. Rational polynomials use descending coefficient
;; order, and Sturm-Tarski queries decide equality at alpha exactly.

(defun putnam-1978-a6-rp-p (p)
  (if (consp p)
      (and (rationalp (car p))
           (putnam-1978-a6-rp-p (cdr p)))
    (equal p nil)))

(defun putnam-1978-a6-rp-normalize (p)
  (if (consp p)
      (if (equal (car p) 0)
          (putnam-1978-a6-rp-normalize (cdr p))
        p)
    nil))

(defun putnam-1978-a6-rp-neg (p)
  (if (consp p)
      (cons (- (car p))
            (putnam-1978-a6-rp-neg (cdr p)))
    nil))

(defun putnam-1978-a6-rp-add-raw (p q)
  (declare (xargs :measure (+ (acl2-count p) (acl2-count q))))
  (cond
   ((endp p) q)
   ((endp q) p)
   ((< (len p) (len q))
    (cons (car q)
          (putnam-1978-a6-rp-add-raw p (cdr q))))
   ((< (len q) (len p))
    (cons (car p)
          (putnam-1978-a6-rp-add-raw (cdr p) q)))
   (t
    (cons (+ (car p) (car q))
          (putnam-1978-a6-rp-add-raw (cdr p) (cdr q))))))

(defun putnam-1978-a6-rp-add (p q)
  (putnam-1978-a6-rp-normalize
   (putnam-1978-a6-rp-add-raw p q)))

(defun putnam-1978-a6-rp-sub (p q)
  (putnam-1978-a6-rp-add
   p (putnam-1978-a6-rp-neg q)))

(defun putnam-1978-a6-rp-scale (coefficient p)
  (if (consp p)
      (cons (* coefficient (car p))
            (putnam-1978-a6-rp-scale coefficient (cdr p)))
    nil))

(defun putnam-1978-a6-zeroes (n)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix n)))
  (if (zp n)
      nil
    (cons 0 (putnam-1978-a6-zeroes (- n 1)))))

(defun putnam-1978-a6-rp-scale-shift (coefficient p shift)
  (append
   (putnam-1978-a6-rp-scale coefficient p)
   (putnam-1978-a6-zeroes shift)))

(defun putnam-1978-a6-rp-mul-raw (p q)
  (if (consp p)
      (putnam-1978-a6-rp-add
       (putnam-1978-a6-rp-scale-shift
        (car p) q (len (cdr p)))
       (putnam-1978-a6-rp-mul-raw (cdr p) q))
    nil))

(defun putnam-1978-a6-rp-mul (p q)
  (putnam-1978-a6-rp-normalize
   (putnam-1978-a6-rp-mul-raw p q)))

(defun putnam-1978-a6-rp-square (p)
  (putnam-1978-a6-rp-mul p p))

(defun putnam-1978-a6-rp-eval-aux (p x accumulator)
  (if (consp p)
      (putnam-1978-a6-rp-eval-aux
       (cdr p) x (+ (* accumulator x) (car p)))
    accumulator))

(defun putnam-1978-a6-rp-eval (p x)
  (putnam-1978-a6-rp-eval-aux p x 0))

(defun putnam-1978-a6-rp-derivative-aux (p degree)
  (if (consp p)
      (if (zp degree)
          nil
        (cons (* degree (car p))
              (putnam-1978-a6-rp-derivative-aux
               (cdr p) (- degree 1))))
    nil))

(defun putnam-1978-a6-rp-derivative (p)
  (let ((p (putnam-1978-a6-rp-normalize p)))
    (putnam-1978-a6-rp-normalize
     (putnam-1978-a6-rp-derivative-aux
      p (nfix (- (len p) 1))))))

(defun putnam-1978-a6-rp-rem-fuel (p q fuel)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix fuel)))
  (let ((p (putnam-1978-a6-rp-normalize p))
        (q (putnam-1978-a6-rp-normalize q)))
    (if (or (zp fuel)
            (endp q)
            (< (len p) (len q)))
        p
      (putnam-1978-a6-rp-rem-fuel
       (putnam-1978-a6-rp-sub
        p
        (putnam-1978-a6-rp-scale-shift
         (/ (car p) (car q))
         q
         (- (len p) (len q))))
       q
       (- fuel 1)))))

(defun putnam-1978-a6-rp-rem (p q)
  (putnam-1978-a6-rp-rem-fuel
   p q (+ 1 (len (putnam-1978-a6-rp-normalize p)))))

(defun putnam-1978-a6-rp-sturm-tail (previous current fuel)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix fuel)))
  (let ((current (putnam-1978-a6-rp-normalize current)))
    (if (or (zp fuel) (endp current))
        nil
      (cons
       current
       (putnam-1978-a6-rp-sturm-tail
        current
        (putnam-1978-a6-rp-neg
         (putnam-1978-a6-rp-rem previous current))
        (- fuel 1))))))

(defun putnam-1978-a6-rp-sturm-sequence (p q)
  (let ((p (putnam-1978-a6-rp-normalize p))
        (q (putnam-1978-a6-rp-normalize q)))
    (if (endp p)
        nil
      (cons
       p
       (if (endp q)
           nil
         (cons
          q
          (putnam-1978-a6-rp-sturm-tail
           p q (+ 1 (len p) (len q)))))))))

(defun putnam-1978-a6-rational-sign (x)
  (cond ((< x 0) -1)
        ((< 0 x) 1)
        (t 0)))

(defun putnam-1978-a6-rp-variations-aux
    (polynomials x previous-sign)
  (if (consp polynomials)
      (let ((sign
             (putnam-1978-a6-rational-sign
              (putnam-1978-a6-rp-eval
               (car polynomials) x))))
        (if (equal sign 0)
            (putnam-1978-a6-rp-variations-aux
             (cdr polynomials) x previous-sign)
          (+ (if (and (not (equal previous-sign 0))
                      (not (equal sign previous-sign)))
                 1
               0)
             (putnam-1978-a6-rp-variations-aux
              (cdr polynomials) x sign))))
    0))

(defun putnam-1978-a6-rp-variations (polynomials x)
  (putnam-1978-a6-rp-variations-aux polynomials x 0))

(defun putnam-1978-a6-rp-cauchy-index (p q lower upper)
  (let ((sequence
         (putnam-1978-a6-rp-sturm-sequence p q)))
    (- (putnam-1978-a6-rp-variations sequence lower)
       (putnam-1978-a6-rp-variations sequence upper))))

(defun putnam-1978-a6-rp-root-count (p lower upper)
  (putnam-1978-a6-rp-cauchy-index
   p (putnam-1978-a6-rp-derivative p) lower upper))

(defun putnam-1978-a6-primitive-p (primitive lower upper)
  (and
   (putnam-1978-a6-rp-p primitive)
   (consp (putnam-1978-a6-rp-normalize primitive))
   (rationalp lower)
   (rationalp upper)
   (< lower upper)
   (not (equal
         (putnam-1978-a6-rp-eval primitive lower) 0))
   (not (equal
         (putnam-1978-a6-rp-eval primitive upper) 0))
   (equal
    (putnam-1978-a6-rp-root-count primitive lower upper)
    1)
   (not
    (equal
     (putnam-1978-a6-rp-cauchy-index
      primitive
      (putnam-1978-a6-rp-mul
       (putnam-1978-a6-rp-derivative primitive)
       (putnam-1978-a6-rp-derivative primitive))
      lower
      upper)
     0))))

(defun putnam-1978-a6-alg-sign
    (primitive lower upper value)
  (putnam-1978-a6-rp-cauchy-index
   primitive
   (putnam-1978-a6-rp-mul
    (putnam-1978-a6-rp-derivative primitive)
    value)
   lower
   upper))

(defun putnam-1978-a6-zero-at-alpha-p
    (primitive lower upper value)
  (equal
   (putnam-1978-a6-alg-sign
    primitive lower upper value)
   0))

(defun putnam-1978-a6-point-code-p (point)
  (and
   (true-listp point)
   (equal (len point) 2)
   (putnam-1978-a6-rp-p (nth 0 point))
   (putnam-1978-a6-rp-p (nth 1 point))))

(defun putnam-1978-a6-point-list-p (points)
  (if (consp points)
      (and
       (putnam-1978-a6-point-code-p (car points))
       (putnam-1978-a6-point-list-p (cdr points)))
    (equal points nil)))

(defun putnam-1978-a6-point-equal-p
    (primitive lower upper left right)
  (and
   (putnam-1978-a6-zero-at-alpha-p
    primitive lower upper
    (putnam-1978-a6-rp-sub
     (nth 0 left) (nth 0 right)))
   (putnam-1978-a6-zero-at-alpha-p
    primitive lower upper
    (putnam-1978-a6-rp-sub
     (nth 1 left) (nth 1 right)))))

(defun putnam-1978-a6-point-distinct-from-list-p
    (primitive lower upper point points)
  (if (consp points)
      (and
       (not
        (putnam-1978-a6-point-equal-p
         primitive lower upper point (car points)))
       (putnam-1978-a6-point-distinct-from-list-p
        primitive lower upper point (cdr points)))
    t))

(defun putnam-1978-a6-distinct-point-list-p
    (primitive lower upper points)
  (if (consp points)
      (and
       (putnam-1978-a6-point-distinct-from-list-p
        primitive lower upper (car points) (cdr points))
       (putnam-1978-a6-distinct-point-list-p
        primitive lower upper (cdr points)))
    t))

(defun putnam-1978-a6-distance-squared (left right)
  (putnam-1978-a6-rp-add
   (putnam-1978-a6-rp-square
    (putnam-1978-a6-rp-sub
     (nth 0 left) (nth 0 right)))
   (putnam-1978-a6-rp-square
    (putnam-1978-a6-rp-sub
     (nth 1 left) (nth 1 right)))))

(defun putnam-1978-a6-unit-distance-p
    (primitive lower upper left right)
  (putnam-1978-a6-zero-at-alpha-p
   primitive lower upper
   (putnam-1978-a6-rp-sub
    (putnam-1978-a6-distance-squared left right)
    (list 1))))

(defun putnam-1978-a6-unit-neighbor-count
    (primitive lower upper point points)
  (if (consp points)
      (+ (if
             (putnam-1978-a6-unit-distance-p
              primitive lower upper point (car points))
             1
           0)
         (putnam-1978-a6-unit-neighbor-count
          primitive lower upper point (cdr points)))
    0))

(defun putnam-1978-a6-unit-pair-count
    (primitive lower upper points)
  (if (consp points)
      (+ (putnam-1978-a6-unit-neighbor-count
          primitive lower upper (car points) (cdr points))
         (putnam-1978-a6-unit-pair-count
          primitive lower upper (cdr points)))
    0))

(defun putnambench-putnam-1978-a6-statement
    (primitive lower upper points n)
  (implies
   (and
    (putnam-1978-a6-primitive-p primitive lower upper)
    (natp n)
    (posp n)
    (true-listp points)
    (equal (len points) n)
    (putnam-1978-a6-point-list-p points)
    (putnam-1978-a6-distinct-point-list-p
     primitive lower upper points))
   (let ((unit-pairs
          (putnam-1978-a6-unit-pair-count
           primitive lower upper points)))
     (< (* unit-pairs unit-pairs)
        (* 4 (expt n 3))))))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

title: putnam_1978_a6
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1978_a6:
-- a nonempty finite set of n points in the real plane determines fewer than
-- 2 * n^(3/2) unordered pairs at Euclidean distance one. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

open import Agda.Primitive using (Level; _⊔_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; _*_)

infix 4 _!=_ _<N_
infixr 3 _and_
infixr 2 _or_

data Bottom : Set where

Not :
  {level : Level} ->
  Set level ->
  Set level
Not proposition =
  proposition -> Bottom

_!=_ :
  {level : Level} ->
  {A : Set level} ->
  A ->
  A ->
  Set level
x != y =
  Not (x == y)

record _and_
  {left-level right-level : Level}
  (A : Set left-level)
  (B : Set right-level) :
  Set (left-level ⊔ right-level) where

  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data _or_
  {left-level right-level : Level}
  (A : Set left-level)
  (B : Set right-level) :
  Set (left-level ⊔ right-level) where

  left  : A -> A or B
  right : B -> A or B

record Exists
  {element-level property-level : Level}
  (A : Set element-level)
  (P : A -> Set property-level) :
  Set (element-level ⊔ property-level) where

  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

data _<N_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set where
  zero<suc : {n : Nat} -> zero <N suc n
  suc<suc  : {m n : Nat} -> m <N n -> suc m <N suc n

data Fin : Nat -> Set where
  fzero : {n : Nat} -> Fin (suc n)
  fsuc  : {n : Nat} -> Fin n -> Fin (suc n)

record HasCardinality
  {element-level property-level : Level}
  {A : Set element-level}
  (member : A -> Set property-level)
  (cardinality : Nat) :
  Set (element-level ⊔ property-level) where

  field
    enumerate :
      Fin cardinality ->
      A
    enumerated-member :
      (index : Fin cardinality) ->
      member (enumerate index)
    enumeration-complete :
      (item : A) ->
      member item ->
      Exists (Fin cardinality)
        (\ index -> item == enumerate index)
    enumeration-injective :
      (left-index right-index : Fin cardinality) ->
      enumerate left-index == enumerate right-index ->
      left-index == right-index

record HasExtensionalCardinality
  {element-level equivalence-level property-level : Level}
  {A : Set element-level}
  (equivalent : A -> A -> Set equivalence-level)
  (member : A -> Set property-level)
  (cardinality : Nat) :
  Set (element-level ⊔ equivalence-level ⊔ property-level) where

  field
    enumerate :
      Fin cardinality ->
      A
    enumerated-member :
      (index : Fin cardinality) ->
      member (enumerate index)
    enumeration-complete :
      (item : A) ->
      member item ->
      Exists (Fin cardinality)
        (\ index -> equivalent item (enumerate index))
    enumeration-injective :
      (left-index right-index : Fin cardinality) ->
      equivalent (enumerate left-index) (enumerate right-index) ->
      left-index == right-index

record CompleteOrderedRealField (R : Set) : Set1 where
  field
    zeroR oneR : R
    add multiply : R -> R -> R
    negate inverse squareRoot : R -> R
    lessOrEqual : R -> R -> Set
    fromNat : Nat -> R

    one-not-zero :
      oneR != zeroR

    add-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> add x y == add y x
    add-associative :
      (x y z : R) -> add (add x y) z == add x (add y z)
    add-zero :
      (x : R) -> add x zeroR == x
    add-inverse :
      (x : R) -> add x (negate x) == zeroR

    multiply-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> multiply x y == multiply y x
    multiply-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply (multiply x y) z == multiply x (multiply y z)
    multiply-one :
      (x : R) -> multiply x oneR == x
    multiply-zero :
      (x : R) -> multiply x zeroR == zeroR
    distribute :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply x (add y z) ==
      add (multiply x y) (multiply x z)
    inverse-zero :
      inverse zeroR == zeroR
    multiply-inverse :
      (x : R) ->
      x != zeroR ->
      multiply x (inverse x) == oneR

    order-reflexive :
      (x : R) -> lessOrEqual x x
    order-transitive :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y z ->
      lessOrEqual x z
    order-antisymmetric :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y x ->
      x == y
    order-total :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y or lessOrEqual y x
    add-order :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual (add z x) (add z y)
    multiply-nonnegative :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR x ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR y ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR (multiply x y)
    zero-less-than-one :
      lessOrEqual zeroR oneR and zeroR != oneR

    fromNat-zero :
      fromNat zero == zeroR
    fromNat-successor :
      (n : Nat) -> fromNat (suc n) == add (fromNat n) oneR
    fromNat-addition :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m + n) == add (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-multiplication :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m * n) == multiply (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-injective :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat m == fromNat n ->
      m == n

    archimedean :
      (x : R) ->
      Exists Nat (\ n -> lessOrEqual x (fromNat n))
    least-upper-bound :
      (P : R -> Set) ->
      Exists R P ->
      Exists R
        (\ upper ->
          (x : R) ->
          P x ->
          lessOrEqual x upper) ->
      Exists R
        (\ supremum ->
          ((x : R) -> P x -> lessOrEqual x supremum)
          and
          ((upper : R) ->
            ((x : R) -> P x -> lessOrEqual x upper) ->
            lessOrEqual supremum upper))

    square-root-nonnegative :
      (x : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR (squareRoot x)
    square-root-square :
      (x : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR x ->
      multiply (squareRoot x) (squareRoot x) == x
    square-root-nonpositive :
      (x : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x zeroR ->
      squareRoot x == zeroR
    square-root-unique :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR y ->
      multiply y y == x ->
      y == squareRoot x

open CompleteOrderedRealField

subtract :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
subtract reals x y =
  add reals x (negate reals y)

divide :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
divide reals x y =
  multiply reals x (inverse reals y)

square :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R
square reals x =
  multiply reals x x

StrictLess :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
StrictLess reals x y =
  lessOrEqual reals x y and x != y

naturalPower :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  Nat ->
  R
naturalPower reals x zero =
  oneR reals
naturalPower reals x (suc n) =
  multiply reals (naturalPower reals x n) x

factorial : Nat -> Nat
factorial zero =
  suc zero
factorial (suc n) =
  suc n * factorial n

sumFirst :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Nat ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  R
sumFirst reals zero term =
  zeroR reals
sumFirst reals (suc n) term =
  add reals
    (sumFirst reals n term)
    (term n)

CloseTo :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
CloseTo reals center radius x =
  StrictLess reals (subtract reals center radius) x
  and
  StrictLess reals x (add reals center radius)

data _<=N_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set where
  zero<=N   : {n : Nat} -> zero <=N n
  suc<=sucN : {m n : Nat} -> m <=N n -> suc m <=N suc n

ConvergesTo :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  R ->
  Set
ConvergesTo reals sequence limit =
  (epsilon : _) ->
  StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) epsilon ->
  Exists Nat
    (\ cutoff ->
      (n : Nat) ->
      cutoff <=N n ->
      CloseTo reals limit epsilon (sequence n))

SeriesHasSum :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  R ->
  Set
SeriesHasSum reals terms limit =
  ConvergesTo reals
    (\ n -> sumFirst reals n terms)
    limit

exponentialTerm :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  Nat ->
  R
exponentialTerm reals x n =
  divide reals
    (naturalPower reals x n)
    (fromNat reals (factorial n))

ExponentialValue :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
ExponentialValue reals x value =
  SeriesHasSum reals
    (exponentialTerm reals x)
    value

record StandardRealPowers
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) :
  Set1 where

  field
    exponential logarithm : R -> R

    exponential-series :
      (x : R) ->
      ExponentialValue reals x (exponential x)

    exponential-positive :
      (x : R) ->
      StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) (exponential x)

    exponential-injective :
      (x y : R) ->
      exponential x == exponential y ->
      x == y

    exponential-logarithm :
      (x : R) ->
      StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) x ->
      exponential (logarithm x) == x

open StandardRealPowers

realPower :
  {R : Set} ->
  {reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R} ->
  StandardRealPowers reals ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
realPower {reals = reals} powers base exponent =
  exponential powers
    (multiply reals exponent (logarithm powers base))

record Point (R : Set) : Set where
  constructor point
  field
    x-coordinate : R
    y-coordinate : R

open Point

squaredDistance :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Point R ->
  Point R ->
  R
squaredDistance reals p q =
  add reals
    (square reals
      (subtract reals (x-coordinate p) (x-coordinate q)))
    (square reals
      (subtract reals (y-coordinate p) (y-coordinate q)))

distance :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Point R ->
  Point R ->
  R
distance reals p q =
  squareRoot reals (squaredDistance reals p q)

Subset :
  Set ->
  Set1
Subset A =
  A -> Set

SetEqual :
  {A : Set} ->
  Subset A ->
  Subset A ->
  Set
SetEqual left-set right-set =
  (x : _) ->
  (left-set x -> right-set x)
  and
  (right-set x -> left-set x)

TwoPointSet :
  {R : Set} ->
  Point R ->
  Point R ->
  Subset (Point R)
TwoPointSet p q x =
  (x == p) or (x == q)

UnitPair :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Subset (Point R) ->
  Subset (Point R) ->
  Set
UnitPair {R} reals S pair =
  Exists (Point R)
    (\ p ->
      S p
      and
      Exists (Point R)
        (\ q ->
          S q
          and
          SetEqual pair (TwoPointSet p q)
          and
          distance reals p q == oneR reals))

module Putnam1978A6Statement
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R)
  (powers : StandardRealPowers reals) where

  two : R
  two =
    fromNat reals (suc (suc zero))

  three : R
  three =
    fromNat reals (suc (suc (suc zero)))

  three-halves : R
  three-halves =
    divide reals three two

  bound : Nat -> R
  bound n =
    multiply reals two
      (realPower powers (fromNat reals n) three-halves)

  proposition : Set1
  proposition =
    (S : Subset (Point R)) ->
    (n : Nat) ->
    HasCardinality S n ->
    zero <N n ->
    Exists Nat
      (\ pair-count ->
        HasExtensionalCardinality
          SetEqual
          (UnitPair reals S)
          pair-count
        and
        StrictLess reals
          (fromNat reals pair-count)
          (bound n))

putnam-1978-a6 : Set1
putnam-1978-a6 =
  (R : Set) ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) ->
  (powers : StandardRealPowers reals) ->
  Putnam1978A6Statement.proposition reals powers

  fewer than twice n to the three-halves unordered pairs among n distinct
  points in the real plane are one unit apart. This file contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open pairTheory pred_setTheory realTheory transcTheory;

val putnam_1978_a6 =
  ``!S : (real # real) set. !n : num.
      let dist =
        \P Q : real # real.
          sqrt
            ((FST P - FST Q) pow 2 +
             (SND P - SND Q) pow 2)
      in
        n = CARD S /\ 0 < n /\ FINITE S
        ==>
        (&(CARD
             {pair : (real # real) set |
                ?P Q : real # real.
                  P IN S /\ Q IN S /\
                  pair = {P; Q} /\
                  dist P Q = 1}) : real) <
          2 * (&n : real) powr ((3 : real) / 2)``;

$(
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact
  putnam_1978_a6: fewer than twice n to the three-halves unordered pairs
  among n distinct points in the real plane are one unit apart. This file
  contains no proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  The real Euclidean plane is represented isometrically by CC, with complex
  absolute value giving Euclidean distance. s ranges over arbitrary finite
  subsets of CC with positive cardinality n.

  The restricted power set consists exactly of the unordered two-element
  subsets p of s whose two distinct elements are one unit apart. Hence its
  finite cardinality is the source number of unordered unit-distance pairs.
  Since n is positive, set.mm's complex-power expression n ^c (3 / 2)
  agrees with the source real power n^(3/2).

  The final declaration is the single unproved $a corpus statement; this
  database contains no $p proof statement.
$)

${
  $d n p s x y $.

  putnambench-putnam-1978-a6 $a |- A. n e. NN
    A. s e. Fin
      (
        (
          s C_ CC
          /\
          ( # ` s ) = n
        )
        ->
        (
          #
          `
          {
            p e. ~P s |
              (
                ( # ` p ) = 2
                /\
                A. x e. p A. y e. p
                  (
                    x =/= y
                    ->
                    ( abs ` ( x - y ) ) = 1
                  )
              )
          }
        )
        <
        (
          2
          x.
          (
            n
            ^c
            ( 3 / 2 )
          )
        )
      )
  $.
$}

% Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1978_a6:
% fewer than 2*n^(3/2) unordered pairs among n distinct real-plane points
% are at Euclidean distance one. This file contains no proof.

putnam_1978_a6: THEORY
BEGIN
  point: TYPE = [# x_coord: real, y_coord: real #]

  IMPORTING finite_sets[point], finite_sets_of_sets[point]

  point_set: TYPE = finite_set[point]
  pair_family: TYPE = finite_set[point_set]

  squared_distance(P, Q: point): real =
    (x_coord(P) - x_coord(Q)) ^ 2
      + (y_coord(P) - y_coord(Q)) ^ 2

  unit_distance_pairs(S: point_set): pair_family =
    intersection(
      powerset(S),
      {pair: point_set |
        card(pair) = 2
          AND EXISTS (P, Q: point):
            pair(P)
              AND pair(Q)
              AND squared_distance(P, Q) = 1})

  putnam_1978_a6: bool =
    FORALL (S: point_set), (n: nat):
      (n = card(S) AND n > 0)
      IMPLIES
        (card(unit_distance_pairs(S)) :: real) ^ 2
          < 4 * (n :: real) ^ 3
END putnam_1978_a6

;; Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1978_b2:
;; the positive double series with summand 1/(i*j*(i+j+2)) converges to
;; 7/4. This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

;; Exact rational sum over j = 1,...,UPPER for a fixed positive I.
(defun putnam-1978-b2-inner-sum (i upper)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix upper)))
  (if (zp upper)
      0
    (+ (/ 1
          (* i upper (+ i upper 2)))
       (putnam-1978-b2-inner-sum i (- upper 1)))))

;; Exact rational sum over the square 1 <= i,j <= N.
(defun putnam-1978-b2-square-sum-aux (remaining upper)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix remaining)))
  (if (zp remaining)
      0
    (+ (putnam-1978-b2-inner-sum remaining upper)
       (putnam-1978-b2-square-sum-aux
        (- remaining 1) upper))))

(defun putnam-1978-b2-square-sum (n)
  (if (natp n)
      (putnam-1978-b2-square-sum-aux n n)
    0))

;; For positive terms, convergence of these square partial sums is equivalent
;; to the iterated positive double sum in the Lean and Isabelle statements and
;; is exactly the sequence of square sums used by the Rocq statement.
;; Positive rational tolerances are cofinal among positive real tolerances,
;; while every displayed partial sum remains its exact rational value.
(defun-sk putnam-1978-b2-tail-p (epsilon cutoff)
  (forall (n)
    (implies
     (and
      (natp n)
      (<= cutoff n))
     (<
      (abs
       (- (putnam-1978-b2-square-sum n)
          (/ 7 4)))
      epsilon))))

(defun-sk putnam-1978-b2-cutoff-exists-p (epsilon)
  (exists (cutoff)
    (and
     (natp cutoff)
     (putnam-1978-b2-tail-p epsilon cutoff))))

(defun putnambench-putnam-1978-b2-statement (epsilon)
  (implies
   (and
    (rationalp epsilon)
    (< 0 epsilon))
   (putnam-1978-b2-cutoff-exists-p epsilon)))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

content:
-- Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1978_b2:
-- the double series over positive integers with summand
-- 1 / (i squared times j + 2ij + i times j squared) converges to 7 / 4.
-- This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; _*_)

infix 4 _!=_ _<=N_
infixr 3 _and_
infixr 2 _or_

data Bottom : Set where

Not : Set -> Set
Not A =
  A -> Bottom

_!=_ : {A : Set} -> A -> A -> Set
x != y =
  Not (x == y)

record _and_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data _or_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  left  : A -> A or B
  right : B -> A or B

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

data _<=N_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set where
  zero<=   : {n : Nat} -> zero <=N n
  suc<=suc : {m n : Nat} -> m <=N n -> suc m <=N suc n

record CompleteOrderedRealField (R : Set) : Set1 where
  field
    zeroR oneR : R
    addR multiplyR : R -> R -> R
    negateR inverseR : R -> R
    lessOrEqualR : R -> R -> Set
    fromNatR : Nat -> R

    oneR-not-zeroR :
      oneR != zeroR

    addR-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> addR x y == addR y x
    addR-associative :
      (x y z : R) -> addR (addR x y) z == addR x (addR y z)
    addR-zero :
      (x : R) -> addR x zeroR == x
    addR-inverse :
      (x : R) -> addR x (negateR x) == zeroR

    multiplyR-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> multiplyR x y == multiplyR y x
    multiplyR-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiplyR (multiplyR x y) z == multiplyR x (multiplyR y z)
    multiplyR-one :
      (x : R) -> multiplyR x oneR == x
    multiplyR-zero :
      (x : R) -> multiplyR x zeroR == zeroR
    distributeR :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiplyR x (addR y z) ==
      addR (multiplyR x y) (multiplyR x z)
    inverseR-zero :
      inverseR zeroR == zeroR
    multiplyR-inverse :
      (x : R) ->
      x != zeroR ->
      multiplyR x (inverseR x) == oneR

    order-reflexive :
      (x : R) -> lessOrEqualR x x
    order-transitive :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR x y ->
      lessOrEqualR y z ->
      lessOrEqualR x z
    order-antisymmetric :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR x y ->
      lessOrEqualR y x ->
      x == y
    order-total :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR x y or lessOrEqualR y x
    addR-order :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR x y ->
      lessOrEqualR (addR z x) (addR z y)
    multiplyR-nonnegative :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR zeroR x ->
      lessOrEqualR zeroR y ->
      lessOrEqualR zeroR (multiplyR x y)
    zeroR-less-than-oneR :
      lessOrEqualR zeroR oneR and zeroR != oneR

    fromNatR-zero :
      fromNatR zero == zeroR
    fromNatR-successor :
      (n : Nat) -> fromNatR (suc n) == addR (fromNatR n) oneR
    fromNatR-addition :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNatR (m + n) == addR (fromNatR m) (fromNatR n)
    fromNatR-multiplication :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNatR (m * n) == multiplyR (fromNatR m) (fromNatR n)
    fromNatR-injective :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNatR m == fromNatR n ->
      m == n

    archimedean :
      (x : R) ->
      Exists Nat (\ n -> lessOrEqualR x (fromNatR n))
    least-upper-bound :
      (P : R -> Set) ->
      Exists R P ->
      Exists R
        (\ upper ->
          (x : R) ->
          P x ->
          lessOrEqualR x upper) ->
      Exists R
        (\ supremum ->
          ((x : R) -> P x -> lessOrEqualR x supremum)
          and
          ((upper : R) ->
            ((x : R) -> P x -> lessOrEqualR x upper) ->
            lessOrEqualR supremum upper))

open CompleteOrderedRealField

oneN : Nat
oneN =
  suc zero

twoN : Nat
twoN =
  suc oneN

fourN : Nat
fourN =
  suc (suc (suc (suc zero)))

sevenN : Nat
sevenN =
  suc (suc (suc (suc (suc (suc (suc zero))))))

subtract :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
subtract reals x y =
  addR reals x (negateR reals y)

divide :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
divide reals x y =
  multiplyR reals x (inverseR reals y)

StrictLess :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
StrictLess reals x y =
  lessOrEqualR reals x y and x != y

CloseTo :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
CloseTo reals center radius x =
  StrictLess reals (subtract reals center radius) x
  and
  StrictLess reals x (addR reals center radius)

SequentialLimit :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  R ->
  Set
SequentialLimit {R} reals sequence limit =
  (epsilon : R) ->
  StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) epsilon ->
  Exists Nat
    (\ cutoff ->
      (n : Nat) ->
      cutoff <=N n ->
      CloseTo reals limit epsilon (sequence n))

sumFromOne :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Nat ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  R
sumFromOne reals zero term =
  zeroR reals
sumFromOne reals (suc n) term =
  addR reals
    (sumFromOne reals n term)
    (term (suc n))

denominator : Nat -> Nat -> Nat
denominator i j =
  i * i * j + twoN * i * j + i * j * j

seriesTerm :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Nat ->
  Nat ->
  R
seriesTerm reals i j =
  divide reals
    (oneR reals)
    (fromNatR reals (denominator i j))

squarePartialSum :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Nat ->
  R
squarePartialSum reals n =
  sumFromOne reals n
    (\ i ->
      sumFromOne reals n
        (\ j -> seriesTerm reals i j))

sevenFourths :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R
sevenFourths reals =
  divide reals
    (fromNatR reals sevenN)
    (fromNatR reals fourN)

putnam-1978-b2 : Set1
putnam-1978-b2 =
  (R : Set) ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) ->
  SequentialLimit reals
    (squarePartialSum reals)
    (sevenFourths reals)

  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact
  putnam_1978_b2: evaluation of a nested positive reciprocal series over

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(

  unbounded series sums, so the displayed expression is the iterated sum in
  the Lean and Isabelle sources, with exactly the same denominator.

  Every summand is nonnegative. Consequently, the iterated sum is equivalent
  to the limit of the increasing square partial sums used by the Rocq source,

  database contains no $p proof statement.

    (
      sum_ i e. NN
        (
          sum_ j e. NN
            (
              1
              /
              (
                ( ( i ^ 2 ) x. j )
                +

                  ( 2 x. i )
                  x.
                  j
                )
                +
                ( i x. ( j ^ 2 ) )

  $.

% Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1978_b2:
% the double series over positive integers with summand
% 1 / (i^2*j + 2*i*j + i*j^2) converges to 7/4. This file contains no proof.

putnam_1978_b2: THEORY
BEGIN
  safe_div(numerator, denominator: real): real =
    IF denominator = 0 THEN 0 ELSE numerator / denominator ENDIF

  series_term(i, j: nat): real =
    safe_div(
      1,
      (i :: real) ^ 2 * (j :: real)
        + 2 * (i :: real) * (j :: real)
        + (i :: real) * (j :: real) ^ 2)

  row_partial_sum(row, count: nat): RECURSIVE real =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      row_partial_sum(row, count - 1)
        + series_term(row, count)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  rectangular_partial_sum(
      rows, columns: nat): RECURSIVE real =
    IF rows = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      rectangular_partial_sum(rows - 1, columns)
        + row_partial_sum(rows, columns)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE rows

  converges_to(sequence: [nat -> real], value: real): bool =
    FORALL (epsilon_value: posreal):
      EXISTS (cutoff: nat):
        FORALL (count: nat):
          cutoff <= count IMPLIES
            abs(sequence(count) - value) < epsilon_value

  putnam_1978_b2: bool =
    converges_to(
      (LAMBDA (count: nat):
        rectangular_partial_sum(count, count)),
      7 / 4)
END putnam_1978_b2

import Mathlib

open Set Real Filter Topology Polynomial

/--
The polynomials $P_n(x)$ are defined by
\begin{align*}
P_1(x) &= 1 + x, \\
P_2(x) &= 1 + 2x, \\
P_{2n+1}(x) &= P_{2n}(x) + (n + 1) x P_{2n-1}(x), \\
P_{2n+2}(x) &= P_{2n+1}(x) + (n + 1) x P_{2n}(x).
\end{align*}
Let $a_n$ be the largest real root of $P_n(x)$. Prove that $a_n$ is strictly monotonically increasing and tends to zero.
-/
theorem putnam_1978_b3
(P : ℕ+ → Polynomial ℝ)
(hP1 : P 1 = 1 + X)
(hP2 : P 2 = 1 + 2 * X)
(hPodd : ∀ n, P (2 * n + 1) = P (2 * n) + C ((n : ℝ) + 1) * X * P (2 * n - 1))
(hPeven : ∀ n, P (2 * n + 2) = P (2 * n + 1) + C ((n : ℝ) + 1) * X * P (2 * n))
(a : ℕ+ → ℝ)
(haroot : ∀ n, (P n).eval (a n) = 0)
(haub : ∀ n, ∀ x, (P n).eval x = 0 → x ≤ a n)
: (StrictMono a ∧ Tendsto a atTop (𝓝 0)) :=
sorry

From mathcomp Require Import all_algebra all_ssreflect.
From mathcomp Require Import reals topology sequences normedtype.
From mathcomp Require Import classical_sets.

Set Implicit Arguments.
Unset Strict Implicit.
Unset Printing Implicit Defensive.
Import numFieldNormedType.Exports.

Local Open Scope ring_scope.
Local Open Scope classical_set_scope.

Variable R : realType.
Theorem putnam_1978_b3
    (P : nat -> {poly R})
    (hP1 : P 1%nat = 1%:P + 'X)
    (hP2 : P 2%nat = 1%:P + 2 * 'X)
    (hPodd : forall n : nat, ge n 1 -> P ((n.*2).+1) = P (n.*2) + (n.+1)%:R * 'X * P ((n.*2).-1))
    (hPeven : forall n : nat, ge n 1 -> P ((n.+1).*2) = P ((n.*2).+1) + (n.+1)%:R * 'X * P (n.*2))
    (a : nat -> R)
    (haroot : forall n : nat, ge n 1 -> (P n).[a n] = 0)
    (haub : forall n : nat, ge n 1 -> (forall x : R, (P n).[x] = 0 -> x <= a n))
    : (forall i j : nat, ge i 1 -> lt i j -> a i < a j) /\ (a @ \oo --> 0).
Proof. Admitted.

"HOL-Computational_Algebra.Polynomial"
begin

theorem putnam_1978_b3:
  fixes P :: "nat \<Rightarrow> (real poly)"
    and a :: "nat \<Rightarrow> real"
  assumes hP1 : "P 1 = monom 1 0 + monom 1 1"
    and hP2 : "P 2 = monom 1 0 + monom 2 1"
    and hPodd : "\<forall> n :: nat \<ge> 1. P (2 * n + 1) = P (2 * n) + (monom (real n + 1) 1) * P (2 * n - 1)"
    and hPeven : "\<forall> n :: nat \<ge> 1. P (2 * n + 2) = P (2 * n + 1) + (monom (real n + 1) 1) * P (2 * n)"
    and hamax : "\<forall> n :: nat \<ge> 1. a n = (GREATEST x :: real. poly (P n) x = 0)"
    and ha0 : "a 0 = -2"  
  shows "strict_mono a \<and> filterlim a (nhds 0) at_top"
  sorry

end

(*
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench artifact putnam_1978_b3:
  the largest real roots of the recursively defined polynomial sequence are
  strictly increasing and converge to zero. This file contains no proof.
*)

let statement =
  `!P:num->real->real a:num->real.
     (!x:real. P 1 x = &1 + x) /\
     (!x:real. P 2 x = &1 + &2 * x) /\
     (!n:num.
        1 <= n
        ==>
        !x:real.
          P (2 * n + 1) x =
          P (2 * n) x + &(n + 1) * x * P (2 * n - 1) x) /\
     (!n:num.
        1 <= n
        ==>
        !x:real.
          P (2 * n + 2) x =
          P (2 * n + 1) x + &(n + 1) * x * P (2 * n) x) /\
     (!n:num. 1 <= n ==> P n (a n) = &0) /\
     (!n:num.
        1 <= n
        ==> !x:real. P n x = &0 ==> x <= a n)
     ==>
     (!i j:num. 1 <= i /\ i < j ==> a i < a j) /\
     (!e:real.
        &0 < e
        ==> ?N:num.
              !n:num. N <= n ==> abs (a n) < e)`;;

title: putnam_1978_b3
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1978_b3:
;; recursively defined real polynomials have largest roots forming a strictly
;; increasing sequence that converges to zero. This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))

;; Scalars are represented in an arbitrary real closed ordered field.
;; Polynomials are canonical coefficient lists in ascending degree order, and
;; the source functions P and a are retained as unbounded tame function
;; objects. Real closed ordered fields agree on the algebraic and order facts
;; used here, and every root of these recursively determined rational
;; polynomials is algebraic over the prime field. Quantifying convergence over
;; positive rational tolerances is equivalent over the reals to quantifying
;; over all positive real tolerances because the positive rationals are cofinal
;; at zero. Thus no real value, sequence entry, or index range is replaced by a
;; finite or rational approximation.

(defun putnam-1978-b3-add (add left right)
  (apply$ add (list left right)))

(defun putnam-1978-b3-mul (mul left right)
  (apply$ mul (list left right)))

(defun putnam-1978-b3-neg (neg value)
  (apply$ neg (list value)))

(defun putnam-1978-b3-inv (inv value)
  (apply$ inv (list value)))

(defun putnam-1978-b3-lt (lt left right)
  (if (apply$ lt (list left right)) t nil))

(defun putnam-1978-b3-le (lt left right)
  (not (putnam-1978-b3-lt lt right left)))

(defun putnam-1978-b3-field-natural (n zero one add)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix n)))
  (if (zp n)
      zero
    (putnam-1978-b3-add
     add
     one
     (putnam-1978-b3-field-natural
      (- n 1) zero one add))))

(defun putnam-1978-b3-field-rational
    (value zero one add mul neg inv)
  (if (rationalp value)
      (let* ((magnitude (abs (numerator value)))
             (numerator-value
              (putnam-1978-b3-field-natural
               magnitude zero one add))
             (denominator-value
              (putnam-1978-b3-field-natural
               (denominator value) zero one add))
             (positive-value
              (putnam-1978-b3-mul
               mul
               numerator-value
               (putnam-1978-b3-inv
                inv denominator-value))))
        (if (< value 0)
            (putnam-1978-b3-neg neg positive-value)
          positive-value))
    zero))

(defun putnam-1978-b3-polynomial-coefficients-p
    (coefficients carrier)
  (if (consp coefficients)
      (and
       (apply$ carrier (list (car coefficients)))
       (putnam-1978-b3-polynomial-coefficients-p
        (cdr coefficients) carrier))
    (equal coefficients nil)))

(defun putnam-1978-b3-polynomial-p
    (coefficients carrier zero)
  (and
   (true-listp coefficients)
   (consp coefficients)
   (putnam-1978-b3-polynomial-coefficients-p
    coefficients carrier)
   (or
    (equal (len coefficients) 1)
    (not (equal (car (last coefficients)) zero)))))

(defun putnam-1978-b3-polynomial-normalize (coefficients zero)
  (if (consp coefficients)
      (let ((rest
             (putnam-1978-b3-polynomial-normalize
              (cdr coefficients) zero)))
        (if (and (endp rest)
                 (equal (car coefficients) zero))
            nil
          (cons (car coefficients) rest)))
    nil))

(defun putnam-1978-b3-polynomial-add-raw
    (left right add)
  (cond
   ((endp left) right)
   ((endp right) left)
   (t
    (cons
     (putnam-1978-b3-add add (car left) (car right))
     (putnam-1978-b3-polynomial-add-raw
      (cdr left) (cdr right) add)))))

(defun putnam-1978-b3-polynomial-add
    (left right zero add)
  (let ((sum
         (putnam-1978-b3-polynomial-normalize
          (putnam-1978-b3-polynomial-add-raw
           left right add)
          zero)))
    (if (endp sum)
        (list zero)
      sum)))

(defun putnam-1978-b3-polynomial-scale-raw
    (scalar coefficients mul)
  (if (consp coefficients)
      (cons
       (putnam-1978-b3-mul
        mul scalar (car coefficients))
       (putnam-1978-b3-polynomial-scale-raw
        scalar (cdr coefficients) mul))
    nil))

(defun putnam-1978-b3-polynomial-scale
    (scalar coefficients zero mul)
  (let ((product
         (putnam-1978-b3-polynomial-normalize
          (putnam-1978-b3-polynomial-scale-raw
           scalar coefficients mul)
          zero)))
    (if (endp product)
        (list zero)
      product)))

(defun putnam-1978-b3-polynomial-x-scale
    (scalar coefficients zero mul)
  (cons
   zero
   (putnam-1978-b3-polynomial-scale
    scalar coefficients zero mul)))

(defun putnam-1978-b3-polynomial-eval
    (coefficients x zero add mul)
  (if (endp coefficients)
      zero
    (putnam-1978-b3-add
     add
     (car coefficients)
     (putnam-1978-b3-mul
      mul
      x
      (putnam-1978-b3-polynomial-eval
       (cdr coefficients) x zero add mul)))))

(defun-sk putnam-1978-b3-field-laws-p
    (carrier zero one add mul neg inv)
  (forall
   (x y z)
   (implies
    (and
     (apply$ carrier (list x))
     (apply$ carrier (list y))
     (apply$ carrier (list z)))
    (and
     (apply$ carrier
             (list (putnam-1978-b3-add add x y)))
     (apply$ carrier
             (list (putnam-1978-b3-mul mul x y)))
     (apply$ carrier
             (list (putnam-1978-b3-neg neg x)))
     (apply$ carrier
             (list (putnam-1978-b3-inv inv x)))
     (equal
      (putnam-1978-b3-add
       add (putnam-1978-b3-add add x y) z)
      (putnam-1978-b3-add
       add x (putnam-1978-b3-add add y z)))
     (equal
      (putnam-1978-b3-mul
       mul (putnam-1978-b3-mul mul x y) z)
      (putnam-1978-b3-mul
       mul x (putnam-1978-b3-mul mul y z)))
     (equal
      (putnam-1978-b3-add add x y)
      (putnam-1978-b3-add add y x))
     (equal
      (putnam-1978-b3-mul mul x y)
      (putnam-1978-b3-mul mul y x))
     (equal (putnam-1978-b3-add add x zero) x)
     (equal
      (putnam-1978-b3-add
       add x (putnam-1978-b3-neg neg x))
      zero)
     (equal (putnam-1978-b3-mul mul x one) x)
     (implies
      (equal x zero)
      (equal (putnam-1978-b3-inv inv x) zero))
     (implies
      (not (equal x zero))
      (equal
       (putnam-1978-b3-mul
        mul x (putnam-1978-b3-inv inv x))
       one))
     (equal
      (putnam-1978-b3-mul
       mul x (putnam-1978-b3-add add y z))
      (putnam-1978-b3-add
       add
       (putnam-1978-b3-mul mul x y)
       (putnam-1978-b3-mul mul x z)))))))

(defun-sk putnam-1978-b3-order-laws-p
    (carrier zero add mul lt)
  (forall
   (x y z)
   (implies
    (and
     (apply$ carrier (list x))
     (apply$ carrier (list y))
     (apply$ carrier (list z)))
    (and
     (not (putnam-1978-b3-lt lt x x))
     (or
      (putnam-1978-b3-lt lt x y)
      (equal x y)
      (putnam-1978-b3-lt lt y x))
     (implies
      (and
       (putnam-1978-b3-lt lt x y)
       (putnam-1978-b3-lt lt y z))
      (putnam-1978-b3-lt lt x z))
     (implies
      (putnam-1978-b3-lt lt x y)
      (putnam-1978-b3-lt
       lt
       (putnam-1978-b3-add add x z)
       (putnam-1978-b3-add add y z)))
     (implies
      (and
       (putnam-1978-b3-lt lt zero x)
       (putnam-1978-b3-lt lt zero y))
      (putnam-1978-b3-lt
       lt zero (putnam-1978-b3-mul mul x y)))))))

(defun-sk putnam-1978-b3-square-root-laws-p
    (carrier zero mul lt square-root)
  (forall
   x
   (implies
    (and
     (apply$ carrier (list x))
     (not (putnam-1978-b3-lt lt x zero)))
    (let ((root (apply$ square-root (list x))))
      (and
       (apply$ carrier (list root))
       (not (putnam-1978-b3-lt lt root zero))
       (equal
        (putnam-1978-b3-mul mul root root)
        x))))))

(defun-sk putnam-1978-b3-odd-root-laws-p
    (carrier zero add mul odd-root)
  (forall
   coefficients
   (implies
    (and
     (putnam-1978-b3-polynomial-p
      coefficients carrier zero)
     (evenp (len coefficients)))
    (let ((root (apply$ odd-root (list coefficients))))
      (and
       (apply$ carrier (list root))
       (equal
        (putnam-1978-b3-polynomial-eval
         coefficients root zero add mul)
        zero))))))

(defun putnam-1978-b3-real-closed-field-p
    (carrier zero one add mul neg inv lt square-root odd-root)
  (and
   (tamep-functionp carrier)
   (tamep-functionp add)
   (tamep-functionp mul)
   (tamep-functionp neg)
   (tamep-functionp inv)
   (tamep-functionp lt)
   (tamep-functionp square-root)
   (tamep-functionp odd-root)
   (apply$ carrier (list zero))
   (apply$ carrier (list one))
   (not (equal zero one))
   (putnam-1978-b3-field-laws-p
    carrier zero one add mul neg inv)
   (putnam-1978-b3-order-laws-p
    carrier zero add mul lt)
   (putnam-1978-b3-square-root-laws-p
    carrier zero mul lt square-root)
   (putnam-1978-b3-odd-root-laws-p
    carrier zero add mul odd-root)))

(defun putnam-1978-b3-p-value (p n)
  (apply$ p (list n)))

(defun putnam-1978-b3-a-value (a n)
  (apply$ a (list n)))

(defun putnam-1978-b3-root-upper-bound-p
    (p a n x carrier zero add mul lt)
  (implies
   (and
    (apply$ carrier (list x))
    (equal
     (putnam-1978-b3-polynomial-eval
      (putnam-1978-b3-p-value p n)
      x zero add mul)
     zero))
   (putnam-1978-b3-le
    lt x (putnam-1978-b3-a-value a n))))

(defun-sk putnam-1978-b3-source-hypotheses-p
    (p a carrier zero one add mul lt)
  (forall
   (n x)
   (implies
    (posp n)
    (let* ((two-n (* 2 n))
           (n-plus-one
            (putnam-1978-b3-field-natural
             (+ n 1) zero one add))
           (pn (putnam-1978-b3-p-value p n))
           (an (putnam-1978-b3-a-value a n)))
      (and
       (putnam-1978-b3-polynomial-p
        pn carrier zero)
       (apply$ carrier (list an))
       (equal
        (putnam-1978-b3-polynomial-eval
         pn an zero add mul)
        zero)
       (putnam-1978-b3-root-upper-bound-p
        p a n x carrier zero add mul lt)
       (equal
        (putnam-1978-b3-p-value p (+ two-n 1))
        (putnam-1978-b3-polynomial-add
         (putnam-1978-b3-p-value p two-n)
         (putnam-1978-b3-polynomial-x-scale
          n-plus-one
          (putnam-1978-b3-p-value p (- two-n 1))
          zero mul)
         zero add))
       (equal
        (putnam-1978-b3-p-value p (+ two-n 2))
        (putnam-1978-b3-polynomial-add
         (putnam-1978-b3-p-value p (+ two-n 1))
         (putnam-1978-b3-polynomial-x-scale
          n-plus-one
          (putnam-1978-b3-p-value p two-n)
          zero mul)
         zero add)))))))

(defun putnam-1978-b3-sequences-p
    (p a carrier zero one add mul lt)
  (and
   (tamep-functionp p)
   (tamep-functionp a)
   (equal
    (putnam-1978-b3-p-value p 1)
    (list one one))
   (equal
    (putnam-1978-b3-p-value p 2)
    (list
     one
     (putnam-1978-b3-field-natural
      2 zero one add)))
   (putnam-1978-b3-source-hypotheses-p
    p a carrier zero one add mul lt)))

(defun-sk putnam-1978-b3-strictly-increasing-p
    (a lt)
  (forall
   (i j)
   (implies
    (and
     (posp i)
     (posp j)
     (< i j))
    (putnam-1978-b3-lt
     lt
     (putnam-1978-b3-a-value a i)
     (putnam-1978-b3-a-value a j)))))

(defun putnam-1978-b3-abs (value zero neg lt)
  (if (putnam-1978-b3-lt lt value zero)
      (putnam-1978-b3-neg neg value)
    value))

(defun-sk putnam-1978-b3-convergence-tail-p
    (a epsilon start zero neg lt)
  (forall
   n
   (implies
    (and
     (posp n)
     (natp start)
     (<= start n))
    (putnam-1978-b3-lt
     lt
     (putnam-1978-b3-abs
      (putnam-1978-b3-a-value a n)
      zero neg lt)
     epsilon))))

(defun-sk putnam-1978-b3-convergence-start-exists-p
    (a epsilon zero neg lt)
  (exists
   start
   (and
    (natp start)
    (putnam-1978-b3-convergence-tail-p
     a epsilon start zero neg lt))))

(defun-sk putnam-1978-b3-converges-to-zero-p
    (a zero one add mul neg inv lt)
  (forall
   epsilon
   (implies
    (and
     (rationalp epsilon)
     (< 0 epsilon))
    (putnam-1978-b3-convergence-start-exists-p
     a
     (putnam-1978-b3-field-rational
      epsilon zero one add mul neg inv)
     zero neg lt))))

(defun putnambench-putnam-1978-b3-statement
    (carrier zero one add mul neg inv lt square-root odd-root p a)
  (implies
   (and
    (putnam-1978-b3-real-closed-field-p
     carrier zero one add mul neg inv lt square-root odd-root)
    (putnam-1978-b3-sequences-p
     p a carrier zero one add mul lt))
   (and
    (putnam-1978-b3-strictly-increasing-p a lt)
    (putnam-1978-b3-converges-to-zero-p
     a zero one add mul neg inv lt))))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

-- Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1978_b3:
-- the greatest real roots of a recursively defined polynomial sequence are
-- strictly increasing and converge to zero. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.List using (List; []; _∷_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; _*_)

infix 4 _!=_ _<=N_
infixr 3 _and_
infixr 2 _or_

data Bottom : Set where

Not : Set -> Set
Not A =
  A -> Bottom

_!=_ : {A : Set} -> A -> A -> Set
x != y =
  Not (x == y)

record _and_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data _or_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  left  : A -> A or B
  right : B -> A or B

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

data _<=N_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set where
  zero<=   : {n : Nat} -> zero <=N n
  suc<=suc : {m n : Nat} -> m <=N n -> suc m <=N suc n

oneN : Nat
oneN =
  suc zero

twoN : Nat
twoN =
  suc oneN

Positive : Nat -> Set
Positive n =
  oneN <=N n

NatStrictLess : Nat -> Nat -> Set
NatStrictLess m n =
  suc m <=N n

natPredecessor : Nat -> Nat
natPredecessor zero =
  zero
natPredecessor (suc n) =
  n

record CompleteOrderedRealField (R : Set) : Set1 where
  field
    zeroR oneR : R
    add multiply : R -> R -> R
    negate inverse : R -> R
    lessOrEqual : R -> R -> Set
    fromNat : Nat -> R

    one-not-zero :
      oneR != zeroR

    add-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> add x y == add y x
    add-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      add (add x y) z == add x (add y z)
    add-zero :
      (x : R) -> add x zeroR == x
    add-inverse :
      (x : R) -> add x (negate x) == zeroR

    multiply-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> multiply x y == multiply y x
    multiply-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply (multiply x y) z ==
      multiply x (multiply y z)
    multiply-one :
      (x : R) -> multiply x oneR == x
    multiply-zero :
      (x : R) -> multiply x zeroR == zeroR
    distribute :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply x (add y z) ==
      add (multiply x y) (multiply x z)
    inverse-zero :
      inverse zeroR == zeroR
    multiply-inverse :
      (x : R) ->
      x != zeroR ->
      multiply x (inverse x) == oneR

    order-reflexive :
      (x : R) -> lessOrEqual x x
    order-transitive :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y z ->
      lessOrEqual x z
    order-antisymmetric :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y x ->
      x == y
    order-total :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y or lessOrEqual y x
    add-order :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual (add z x) (add z y)
    multiply-nonnegative :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR x ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR y ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR (multiply x y)
    zero-less-than-one :
      lessOrEqual zeroR oneR and zeroR != oneR

    fromNat-zero :
      fromNat zero == zeroR
    fromNat-successor :
      (n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (suc n) == add (fromNat n) oneR
    fromNat-addition :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m + n) == add (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-multiplication :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m * n) == multiply (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-injective :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat m == fromNat n ->
      m == n

    archimedean :
      (x : R) ->
      Exists Nat (\ n -> lessOrEqual x (fromNat n))
    least-upper-bound :
      (P : R -> Set) ->
      Exists R P ->
      Exists R
        (\ upper ->
          (x : R) ->
          P x ->
          lessOrEqual x upper) ->
      Exists R
        (\ supremum ->
          ((x : R) ->
            P x ->
            lessOrEqual x supremum)
          and
          ((upper : R) ->
            ((x : R) ->
              P x ->
              lessOrEqual x upper) ->
            lessOrEqual supremum upper))

open CompleteOrderedRealField

StrictLess :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
StrictLess reals x y =
  lessOrEqual reals x y and x != y

subtract :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
subtract reals x y =
  add reals x (negate reals y)

CloseTo :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
CloseTo reals center radius x =
  StrictLess reals (subtract reals center radius) x
  and
  StrictLess reals x (add reals center radius)

ConvergesTo :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  R ->
  Set
ConvergesTo {R} reals sequence limit =
  (epsilon : R) ->
  StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) epsilon ->
  Exists Nat
    (\ cutoff ->
      (n : Nat) ->
      cutoff <=N n ->
      CloseTo reals limit epsilon (sequence n))

Polynomial : Set -> Set
Polynomial R =
  List R

evaluate :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Polynomial R ->
  R ->
  R
evaluate reals [] x =
  zeroR reals
evaluate reals (coefficient ∷ coefficients) x =
  add reals coefficient
    (multiply reals x (evaluate reals coefficients x))

addPolynomials :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Polynomial R ->
  Polynomial R ->
  Polynomial R
addPolynomials reals [] ys =
  ys
addPolynomials reals xs [] =
  xs
addPolynomials reals (x ∷ xs) (y ∷ ys) =
  add reals x y ∷
  addPolynomials reals xs ys

scaleCoefficients :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  Polynomial R ->
  Polynomial R
scaleCoefficients reals scalar [] =
  []
scaleCoefficients reals scalar (coefficient ∷ coefficients) =
  multiply reals scalar coefficient ∷
  scaleCoefficients reals scalar coefficients

scaleByX :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  Polynomial R ->
  Polynomial R
scaleByX reals scalar [] =
  []
scaleByX reals scalar coefficients =
  zeroR reals ∷ scaleCoefficients reals scalar coefficients

PolynomialEqual :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Polynomial R ->
  Polynomial R ->
  Set
PolynomialEqual {R} reals xs ys =
  (x : R) ->
  evaluate reals xs x == evaluate reals ys x

IsRoot :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Polynomial R ->
  R ->
  Set
IsRoot reals polynomial x =
  evaluate reals polynomial x == zeroR reals

module Putnam1978B3Statement
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) where

  PolynomialRecurrence :
    (Nat -> Polynomial R) ->
    Set
  PolynomialRecurrence P =
    PolynomialEqual reals
      (P oneN)
      (oneR reals ∷ oneR reals ∷ [])
    and
    PolynomialEqual reals
      (P twoN)
      (oneR reals ∷ fromNat reals twoN ∷ [])
    and
    ((n : Nat) ->
      Positive n ->
      PolynomialEqual reals
        (P (twoN * n + oneN))
        (addPolynomials reals
          (P (twoN * n))
          (scaleByX reals
            (fromNat reals (suc n))
            (P (natPredecessor (twoN * n))))))
    and
    ((n : Nat) ->
      Positive n ->
      PolynomialEqual reals
        (P (twoN * n + twoN))
        (addPolynomials reals
          (P (twoN * n + oneN))
          (scaleByX reals
            (fromNat reals (suc n))
            (P (twoN * n)))))

  GreatestRootSequence :
    (Nat -> Polynomial R) ->
    (Nat -> R) ->
    Set
  GreatestRootSequence P a =
    (n : Nat) ->
    Positive n ->
    IsRoot reals (P n) (a n)
    and
    ((x : R) ->
      IsRoot reals (P n) x ->
      lessOrEqual reals x (a n))

  StrictlyIncreasingFromOne :
    (Nat -> R) ->
    Set
  StrictlyIncreasingFromOne a =
    (i j : Nat) ->
    Positive i ->
    NatStrictLess i j ->
    StrictLess reals (a i) (a j)

  proposition :
    (Nat -> Polynomial R) ->
    (Nat -> R) ->
    Set
  proposition P a =
    PolynomialRecurrence P ->
    GreatestRootSequence P a ->
    StrictlyIncreasingFromOne a
    and
    ConvergesTo reals a (zeroR reals)

putnam-1978-b3 : Set1
putnam-1978-b3 =
  (R : Set) ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) ->
  (P : Nat -> Polynomial R) ->
  (a : Nat -> R) ->
  Putnam1978B3Statement.proposition reals P a

(*
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench artifact putnam_1978_b3:
  recursively defined real polynomials have largest real roots that increase
  strictly and converge to zero. This file contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open arithmeticTheory realTheory real_topologyTheory polyTheory;

val putnam_1978_b3 =
  ``!P : num -> real list. !a : num -> real.
      P 1 = [1; 1] /\
      P 2 = [1; 2] /\
      (!n : num.
         1 <= n
         ==>
         P (2 * n + 1) =
           P (2 * n) + ([0; &(n + 1)] : real list) * P (2 * n - 1)) /\
      (!n : num.
         1 <= n
         ==>
         P (2 * n + 2) =
           P (2 * n + 1) + ([0; &(n + 1)] : real list) * P (2 * n)) /\
      (!n : num. 1 <= n ==> poly (P n) (a n) = 0) /\
      (!n : num. !x : real.
         1 <= n /\ poly (P n) x = 0
         ==>
         x <= a n)
      ==>
      ((!i j : num.
          1 <= i /\ i < j
          ==>
          a i < a j) /\
       (a --> 0) sequentially)``;

title: putnam_1978_b3
content:
$(
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact
  putnam_1978_b3: the largest real roots of a recursively defined sequence
  of real polynomials are strictly increasing and converge to zero. This
  file contains no proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  Poly1 ` RRfld is SetMM's ring of finite-support real univariate
  polynomials. The sequence p ranges over all functions from the positive
  integers NN into that ring, while a ranges over all positive-indexed real
  sequences. The operations var1, algSc, and eval1 are respectively the
  indeterminate, constant-polynomial embedding, and polynomial evaluation.

  The root hypotheses say both that a(n) is a root of p(n) and that every
  real root is at most a(n), exactly characterizing the largest real root.
  Strict increase is stated for every pair of positive indices, and the
  epsilon-threshold clause is convergence to zero at infinity.

  Isabelle extends a to index zero with a(0) = -2 and asks for strict
  monotonicity on all nonnegative indices. Since P(1) = 1 + X forces its
  largest real root a(1) to equal -1, that extension is bidirectionally
  equivalent to the positive-indexed formulation used here, in Lean, and
  in Rocq. The final declaration is the single unproved $a corpus statement;
  this database contains no $p proof statement.
$)

${
  $d a e i j m n p x $.

  putnambench-putnam-1978-b3 $a |-
    A. p e. ( ( Base ` ( Poly1 ` RRfld ) ) ^m NN )
    A. a e. ( RR ^m NN )
      (
        (
          (
            (
              ( p ` 1 )
              =
              (
                ( ( algSc ` ( Poly1 ` RRfld ) ) ` 1 )
                ( +g ` ( Poly1 ` RRfld ) )
                ( var1 ` RRfld )
              )
              /\
              ( p ` 2 )
              =
              (
                ( ( algSc ` ( Poly1 ` RRfld ) ) ` 1 )
                ( +g ` ( Poly1 ` RRfld ) )
                (
                  ( ( algSc ` ( Poly1 ` RRfld ) ) ` 2 )
                  ( .r ` ( Poly1 ` RRfld ) )
                  ( var1 ` RRfld )
                )
              )
            )
            /\
            (
              A. n e. NN
                (
                  ( p ` ( ( 2 x. n ) + 1 ) )
                  =
                  (
                    ( p ` ( 2 x. n ) )
                    ( +g ` ( Poly1 ` RRfld ) )
                    (
                      (
                        ( ( algSc ` ( Poly1 ` RRfld ) ) ` ( n + 1 ) )
                        ( .r ` ( Poly1 ` RRfld ) )
                        ( var1 ` RRfld )
                      )
                      ( .r ` ( Poly1 ` RRfld ) )
                      ( p ` ( ( 2 x. n ) - 1 ) )
                    )
                  )
                )
              /\
              A. n e. NN
                (
                  ( p ` ( ( 2 x. n ) + 2 ) )
                  =
                  (
                    ( p ` ( ( 2 x. n ) + 1 ) )
                    ( +g ` ( Poly1 ` RRfld ) )
                    (
                      (
                        ( ( algSc ` ( Poly1 ` RRfld ) ) ` ( n + 1 ) )
                        ( .r ` ( Poly1 ` RRfld ) )
                        ( var1 ` RRfld )
                      )
                      ( .r ` ( Poly1 ` RRfld ) )
                      ( p ` ( 2 x. n ) )
                    )
                  )
                )
            )
          )
          /\
          (
            A. n e. NN
              (
                (
                  ( ( eval1 ` RRfld ) ` ( p ` n ) )
                  `
                  ( a ` n )
                )
                =
                0
              )
            /\
            A. n e. NN
              A. x e. RR
                (
                  (
                    (
                      ( ( eval1 ` RRfld ) ` ( p ` n ) )
                      `
                      x
                    )
                    =
                    0
                  )
                  ->
                  x <_ ( a ` n )
                )
          )
        )
        ->
        (
          (
            A. i e. NN
              A. j e. NN
                (
                  i < j
                  ->
                  ( a ` i ) < ( a ` j )
                )
          )
          /\
          A. e e. RR
            (
              0 < e
              ->
              E. m e. NN
                A. n e. NN
                  (
                    m <_ n
                    ->
                    ( abs ` ( a ` n ) ) < e
                  )
            )
        )
      )
  $.
$}

title: putnam_1978_b3
content:
% Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1978_b3:
% the largest real roots of the recursively defined real polynomials form a
% strictly increasing sequence tending to zero. This file contains no proof.

putnam_1978_b3: THEORY
BEGIN
  coefficient_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> real]
  polynomial_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> coefficient_sequence]
  real_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> real]

  finite_polynomial_support(
      coefficients: coefficient_sequence): bool =
    EXISTS (degree: nat):
      FORALL (index: nat):
        degree < index IMPLIES coefficients(index) = 0

  polynomial_value(
      coefficients: coefficient_sequence,
      x: real,
      count: nat): RECURSIVE real =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      LET index: nat = count - 1 IN
        polynomial_value(coefficients, x, count - 1)
          + coefficients(index) * x ^ index
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  evaluates_to(
      coefficients: coefficient_sequence,
      x, value: real): bool =
    EXISTS (degree: nat):
      (FORALL (index: nat):
        degree < index IMPLIES coefficients(index) = 0)
      AND value =
        polynomial_value(coefficients, x, degree + 1)

  is_polynomial_sequence(P: polynomial_sequence): bool =
    FORALL (n: nat):
      1 <= n IMPLIES finite_polynomial_support(P(n))

  has_initial_polynomials(P: polynomial_sequence): bool =
    (FORALL (degree: nat):
      P(1)(degree) =
        (IF degree = 0 OR degree = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 ENDIF))
    AND
    (FORALL (degree: nat):
      P(2)(degree) =
        (IF degree = 0 THEN
           1
         ELSIF degree = 1 THEN
           2
         ELSE
           0
         ENDIF))

  satisfies_recurrence(P: polynomial_sequence): bool =
    (FORALL (n: nat):
      1 <= n IMPLIES
        FORALL (degree: nat):
          P(2 * n + 1)(degree) =
            P(2 * n)(degree)
              + (IF degree = 0 THEN
                   0
                 ELSE
                   ((n + 1) :: real)
                     * P(2 * n - 1)(degree - 1)
                 ENDIF))
    AND
    (FORALL (n: nat):
      1 <= n IMPLIES
        FORALL (degree: nat):
          P(2 * n + 2)(degree) =
            P(2 * n + 1)(degree)
              + (IF degree = 0 THEN
                   0
                 ELSE
                   ((n + 1) :: real)
                     * P(2 * n)(degree - 1)
                 ENDIF))

  gives_largest_real_roots(
      P: polynomial_sequence,
      a: real_sequence): bool =
    FORALL (n: nat):
      1 <= n IMPLIES
        (evaluates_to(P(n), a(n), 0)
          AND FORALL (x: real):
            evaluates_to(P(n), x, 0) IMPLIES x <= a(n))

  strictly_increasing_from_one(a: real_sequence): bool =
    FORALL (i, j: nat):
      (1 <= i AND i < j) IMPLIES a(i) < a(j)

  tends_to_zero(a: real_sequence): bool =
    FORALL (epsilon_value: posreal):
      EXISTS (cutoff: nat):
        FORALL (n: nat):
          cutoff <= n IMPLIES abs(a(n)) < epsilon_value

  putnam_1978_b3: bool =
    FORALL
        (P: polynomial_sequence),
        (a: real_sequence):
      (is_polynomial_sequence(P)
        AND has_initial_polynomials(P)
        AND satisfies_recurrence(P)
        AND gives_largest_real_roots(P, a))
      IMPLIES
        (strictly_increasing_from_one(a)
          AND tends_to_zero(a))
END putnam_1978_b3

import Mathlib

open Set Real Filter Topology Polynomial

/--
Show that we can find integers $a, b, c, d$ such that $a^2 + b^2 + c^2 + d^2 = abc + abd + acd + bcd$, and the smallest of $a, b, c, d$ is arbitrarily large.
-/
theorem putnam_1978_b4 :
  ∀ N : ℝ,
    ∃ a b c d : ℤ,
      a > N ∧ b > N ∧ c > N ∧ d > N ∧
      a ^ 2 + b ^ 2 + c ^ 2 + d ^ 2 = a * b * c + a * b * d + a * c * d + b * c * d :=
sorry

-- Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1978_b4:
-- four arbitrarily large integers satisfy a symmetric cubic Diophantine
-- equation equating their sum of squares with their triple products. This
-- file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Int using (Int; pos; negsuc)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; _*_)

infix 4 _!=_
infixl 6 _+Z_
infixl 7 _*Z_
infixr 3 _and_
infixr 2 _or_

data Bottom : Set where

Not : Set -> Set
Not A =
  A -> Bottom

_!=_ : {A : Set} -> A -> A -> Set
x != y =
  Not (x == y)

record _and_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data _or_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  left  : A -> A or B
  right : B -> A or B

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

record CompleteOrderedRealField (R : Set) : Set1 where
  field
    zeroR oneR : R
    add multiply : R -> R -> R
    negate inverse : R -> R
    lessOrEqual : R -> R -> Set
    fromNat : Nat -> R

    one-not-zero :
      oneR != zeroR

    add-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> add x y == add y x
    add-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      add (add x y) z == add x (add y z)
    add-zero :
      (x : R) -> add x zeroR == x
    add-inverse :
      (x : R) -> add x (negate x) == zeroR

    multiply-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> multiply x y == multiply y x
    multiply-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply (multiply x y) z ==
      multiply x (multiply y z)
    multiply-one :
      (x : R) -> multiply x oneR == x
    multiply-zero :
      (x : R) -> multiply x zeroR == zeroR
    distribute :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply x (add y z) ==
      add (multiply x y) (multiply x z)
    inverse-zero :
      inverse zeroR == zeroR
    multiply-inverse :
      (x : R) ->
      x != zeroR ->
      multiply x (inverse x) == oneR

    order-reflexive :
      (x : R) -> lessOrEqual x x
    order-transitive :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y z ->
      lessOrEqual x z
    order-antisymmetric :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y x ->
      x == y
    order-total :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y or lessOrEqual y x
    add-order :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual (add z x) (add z y)
    multiply-nonnegative :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR x ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR y ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR (multiply x y)
    zero-less-than-one :
      lessOrEqual zeroR oneR and zeroR != oneR

    fromNat-zero :
      fromNat zero == zeroR
    fromNat-successor :
      (n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (suc n) == add (fromNat n) oneR
    fromNat-addition :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m + n) == add (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-multiplication :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m * n) == multiply (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-injective :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat m == fromNat n ->
      m == n

    archimedean :
      (x : R) ->
      Exists Nat (\ n -> lessOrEqual x (fromNat n))
    least-upper-bound :
      (P : R -> Set) ->
      Exists R P ->
      Exists R
        (\ upper ->
          (x : R) ->
          P x ->
          lessOrEqual x upper) ->
      Exists R
        (\ supremum ->
          ((x : R) ->
            P x ->
            lessOrEqual x supremum)
          and
          ((upper : R) ->
            ((x : R) ->
              P x ->
              lessOrEqual x upper) ->
            lessOrEqual supremum upper))

open CompleteOrderedRealField

negative : Nat -> Int
negative zero =
  pos zero
negative (suc n) =
  negsuc n

difference : Nat -> Nat -> Int
difference zero zero =
  pos zero
difference (suc m) zero =
  pos (suc m)
difference zero (suc n) =
  negsuc n
difference (suc m) (suc n) =
  difference m n

_+Z_ : Int -> Int -> Int
pos m +Z pos n =
  pos (m + n)
pos m +Z negsuc n =
  difference m (suc n)
negsuc m +Z pos n =
  difference n (suc m)
negsuc m +Z negsuc n =
  negsuc (suc (m + n))

_*Z_ : Int -> Int -> Int
pos m *Z pos n =
  pos (m * n)
pos m *Z negsuc n =
  negative (m * suc n)
negsuc m *Z pos n =
  negative (suc m * n)
negsuc m *Z negsuc n =
  pos (suc m * suc n)

squareInt : Int -> Int
squareInt x =
  x *Z x

fromInt :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Int ->
  R
fromInt reals (pos n) =
  fromNat reals n
fromInt reals (negsuc n) =
  negate reals (fromNat reals (suc n))

StrictLess :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
StrictLess reals x y =
  lessOrEqual reals x y and x != y

equation : Int -> Int -> Int -> Int -> Set
equation a b c d =
  squareInt a +Z squareInt b +Z squareInt c +Z squareInt d
  ==
  a *Z b *Z c +Z a *Z b *Z d +Z a *Z c *Z d +Z b *Z c *Z d

Above :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  Int ->
  Set
Above reals bound x =
  StrictLess reals bound (fromInt reals x)

module Putnam1978B4Statement
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) where

  proposition : Set
  proposition =
    (N : R) ->
    Exists Int
      (\ a ->
        Exists Int
          (\ b ->
            Exists Int
              (\ c ->
                Exists Int
                  (\ d ->
                    Above reals N a
                    and
                    Above reals N b
                    and
                    Above reals N c
                    and
                    Above reals N d
                    and
                    equation a b c d))))

putnam-1978-b4 : Set1
putnam-1978-b4 =
  (R : Set) ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) ->
  Putnam1978B4Statement.proposition reals

;; Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1978_b5:
;; the quartic 4*x^4 - 4*x^2 + 1 maps [-1,1] into [0,1] and has the largest
;; possible leading coefficient among real quartics with that property. This
;; file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

;; Standard ACL2 has exact rational arithmetic but no primitive real sort.
;; For a rational-coefficient polynomial, requiring the interval inequalities
;; at every rational x in [-1,1] is equivalent, by continuity and density, to
;; requiring them at every real x in that interval.
;;
;; Restricting the universally quantified coefficient tuple to rationals is
;; also bidirectionally equivalent here. A rational counterexample is a real
;; counterexample. Conversely, from a real counterexample with leading
;; coefficient greater than 4, first replace p by
;;
;;   delta + (1 - 2*delta)*p
;;
;; for sufficiently small positive delta. This retains a leading coefficient
;; greater than 4 and gives a strict margin inside [0,1]. A sufficiently close
;; rational approximation to all five coefficients then preserves the margin,
;; the degree, and the strict leading-coefficient violation uniformly on
;; [-1,1]. Thus a real counterexample exists exactly when a rational one does.
;;
;; FN-EQUAL against the constant-true lambda retains the internal universal
;; quantifier over interval points; no finite sampling is used.

(defun putnam-1978-b5-quoted (object)
  (list 'quote object))

(defun putnam-1978-b5-and-terms (terms)
  (if (consp terms)
      (list 'if
            (car terms)
            (putnam-1978-b5-and-terms (cdr terms))
            (putnam-1978-b5-quoted nil))
    (putnam-1978-b5-quoted t)))

(defun putnam-1978-b5-implies-term (hypothesis conclusion)
  (list 'if
        hypothesis
        conclusion
        (putnam-1978-b5-quoted t)))

(defun putnam-1978-b5-add-term (left right)
  (list 'binary-+ left right))

(defun putnam-1978-b5-multiply-term (left right)
  (list 'binary-* left right))

(defun putnam-1978-b5-less-equal-term (left right)
  (list 'if
        (list '< right left)
        (putnam-1978-b5-quoted nil)
        (putnam-1978-b5-quoted t)))

(defun putnam-1978-b5-polynomial-value-term
    (a0 a1 a2 a3 a4 x)
  (putnam-1978-b5-add-term
   (putnam-1978-b5-quoted a0)
   (putnam-1978-b5-multiply-term
    x
    (putnam-1978-b5-add-term
     (putnam-1978-b5-quoted a1)
     (putnam-1978-b5-multiply-term
      x
      (putnam-1978-b5-add-term
       (putnam-1978-b5-quoted a2)
       (putnam-1978-b5-multiply-term
        x
        (putnam-1978-b5-add-term
         (putnam-1978-b5-quoted a3)
         (putnam-1978-b5-multiply-term
          x
          (putnam-1978-b5-quoted a4))))))))))

(defun putnam-1978-b5-interval-function
    (a0 a1 a2 a3 a4)
  (let ((value
         (putnam-1978-b5-polynomial-value-term
          a0 a1 a2 a3 a4 'x)))
    (list
     'lambda
     '(x)
     (putnam-1978-b5-implies-term
      (putnam-1978-b5-and-terms
       (list
        (list 'rationalp 'x)
        (putnam-1978-b5-less-equal-term
         (putnam-1978-b5-quoted -1) 'x)
        (putnam-1978-b5-less-equal-term
         'x (putnam-1978-b5-quoted 1))))
      (putnam-1978-b5-and-terms
       (list
        (putnam-1978-b5-less-equal-term
         (putnam-1978-b5-quoted 0) value)
        (putnam-1978-b5-less-equal-term
         value (putnam-1978-b5-quoted 1))))))))

(defun putnam-1978-b5-true-function ()
  (list 'lambda '(x) (putnam-1978-b5-quoted t)))

(defun putnam-1978-b5-admissible-p
    (a0 a1 a2 a3 a4)
  (let ((interval-function
         (putnam-1978-b5-interval-function
          a0 a1 a2 a3 a4)))
    (and
     (tamep-functionp interval-function)
     (fn-equal
      interval-function
      (putnam-1978-b5-true-function)))))

(defun putnambench-putnam-1978-b5-statement
    (a0 a1 a2 a3 a4)
  (and
   (not (equal 4 0))
   (putnam-1978-b5-admissible-p 1 0 -4 0 4)
   (implies
    (and
     (rationalp a0)
     (rationalp a1)
     (rationalp a2)
     (rationalp a3)
     (rationalp a4)
     (not (equal a4 0))
     (putnam-1978-b5-admissible-p a0 a1 a2 a3 a4))
    (<= a4 4))))

:q

          and
          ((upper : R) ->
            ((x : R) -> P x -> lessOrEqualR x upper) ->
            lessOrEqualR supremum upper))

open CompleteOrderedRealField

four : Nat
four = suc (suc (suc (suc zero)))

record PolynomialUpToFour (R : Set) : Set where
  constructor coefficients
  field
    coefficient0 : R
    coefficient1 : R
    coefficient2 : R
    coefficient3 : R
    coefficient4 : R

open PolynomialUpToFour

evaluate :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  PolynomialUpToFour R ->
  R ->
  R
evaluate reals p x =
  addR reals
    (coefficient0 p)
    (multiplyR reals x
      (addR reals
        (coefficient1 p)
        (multiplyR reals x
          (addR reals
            (coefficient2 p)
            (multiplyR reals x
              (addR reals
                (coefficient3 p)
                (multiplyR reals x (coefficient4 p))))))))

InClosedInterval :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
InClosedInterval reals lower upper x =
  lessOrEqualR reals lower x
  and
  lessOrEqualR reals x upper

QualifyingQuartic :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  PolynomialUpToFour R ->
  Set
QualifyingQuartic {R} reals p =
  coefficient4 p != zeroR reals
  and
  ((x : R) ->
    InClosedInterval reals
      (negateR reals (oneR reals))
      (oneR reals)
      x ->
    InClosedInterval reals
      (zeroR reals)
      (oneR reals)
      (evaluate reals p x))

solution :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  PolynomialUpToFour R
solution reals =
  coefficients
    (oneR reals)
    (zeroR reals)
    (negateR reals (fromNatR reals four))
    (zeroR reals)
    (fromNatR reals four)

putnam-1978-b5 : Set1
putnam-1978-b5 =
  (R : Set) ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) ->
  QualifyingQuartic reals (solution reals)
  and
  ((p : PolynomialUpToFour R) ->
    QualifyingQuartic reals p ->
    lessOrEqualR reals
      (coefficient4 p)
      (coefficient4 (solution reals)))
