title: putnam_1979_a5
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1979_a5:
;; two distinct real roots of x^3 - 10*x^2 + 29*x - 25 have unboundedly many
;; common values in their floor-multiple sequences. This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

;; The cubic has exactly one root in each of (1,2), (2,3), and (5,6).
;; It has no rational root, so the sign tests below compare each of these
;; three real algebraic roots exactly with an arbitrary rational number.
(defun putnam-1979-a5-polynomial (x)
  (+ (* x x x)
     (- (* 10 x x))
     (* 29 x)
     -25))

(defun putnam-1979-a5-root-index-p (root-index)
  (and (natp root-index)
       (< root-index 3)))

(defun putnam-1979-a5-root-less-than-rational-p (root-index q)
  (and
   (putnam-1979-a5-root-index-p root-index)
   (rationalp q)
   (cond
    ((equal root-index 0)
     (or (<= 2 q)
         (and (< 1 q)
              (< q 2)
              (< 0 (putnam-1979-a5-polynomial q)))))
    ((equal root-index 1)
     (or (<= 3 q)
         (and (< 2 q)
              (< q 3)
              (< (putnam-1979-a5-polynomial q) 0))))
    (t
     (or (<= 6 q)
         (and (< 5 q)
              (< q 6)
              (< 0 (putnam-1979-a5-polynomial q))))))))

(defun putnam-1979-a5-rational-less-than-root-p (q root-index)
  (and
   (rationalp q)
   (putnam-1979-a5-root-index-p root-index)
   (not
    (putnam-1979-a5-root-less-than-rational-p root-index q))))

;; ROOT-INDEX denotes one of the three real roots. Since every root is
;; irrational, the two strict rational comparisons are exactly
;; m <= k*root < m+1.
(defun putnam-1979-a5-floor-multiple-p (root-index k m)
  (and
   (putnam-1979-a5-root-index-p root-index)
   (natp k)
   (integerp m)
   (if (zp k)
       (equal m 0)
     (and
      (putnam-1979-a5-rational-less-than-root-p
       (/ m k)
       root-index)

-- Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1979_a5:
-- two distinct real roots of the specified cubic have floor-multiple sequences
-- with arbitrarily large common integer values. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Int using (Int; pos; negsuc)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; _*_)

infix 4 _!=_ _<N_ _<Z_
infixr 3 _and_
infixr 2 _or_

data Bottom : Set where

Not : Set -> Set
Not A =
  A -> Bottom

_!=_ : {A : Set} -> A -> A -> Set
x != y =
  Not (x == y)

record _and_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data _or_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  left  : A -> A or B
  right : B -> A or B

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

data _<N_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set where
  zero<suc : {n : Nat} -> zero <N suc n
  suc<suc  : {m n : Nat} -> m <N n -> suc m <N suc n

data _<Z_ : Int -> Int -> Set where
  neg<pos : {m n : Nat} -> negsuc m <Z pos n
  pos<pos : {m n : Nat} -> m <N n -> pos m <Z pos n
  neg<neg : {m n : Nat} -> n <N m -> negsuc m <Z negsuc n

intSuccessor : Int -> Int
intSuccessor (pos n) =
  pos (suc n)
intSuccessor (negsuc zero) =
  pos zero
intSuccessor (negsuc (suc n)) =
  negsuc n

embedInt :
  {R : Set} ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  (R -> R) ->
  Int ->
  R
embedInt fromNatural negateR (pos n) =
  fromNatural n
embedInt fromNatural negateR (negsuc n) =
  negateR (fromNatural (suc n))

record CompleteOrderedRealField (R : Set) : Set1 where
  field
    zeroR oneR : R
    add multiply : R -> R -> R
    negate inverse : R -> R
    lessOrEqual : R -> R -> Set
    fromNat : Nat -> R
    floor : R -> Int

    one-not-zero :
      oneR != zeroR

    add-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> add x y == add y x
    add-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      add (add x y) z == add x (add y z)
    add-zero :
      (x : R) -> add x zeroR == x
    add-inverse :
      (x : R) -> add x (negate x) == zeroR

    multiply-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> multiply x y == multiply y x
    multiply-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply (multiply x y) z ==
      multiply x (multiply y z)
    multiply-one :
      (x : R) -> multiply x oneR == x
    multiply-zero :
      (x : R) -> multiply x zeroR == zeroR
    distribute :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply x (add y z) ==
      add (multiply x y) (multiply x z)
    inverse-zero :
      inverse zeroR == zeroR
    multiply-inverse :
      (x : R) ->
      x != zeroR ->
      multiply x (inverse x) == oneR

    order-reflexive :
      (x : R) -> lessOrEqual x x
    order-transitive :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y z ->
      lessOrEqual x z
    order-antisymmetric :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y x ->
      x == y
    order-total :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y or lessOrEqual y x
    add-order :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual (add z x) (add z y)
    multiply-nonnegative :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR x ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR y ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR (multiply x y)
    zero-less-than-one :
      lessOrEqual zeroR oneR and zeroR != oneR

    fromNat-zero :
      fromNat zero == zeroR
    fromNat-successor :
      (n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (suc n) == add (fromNat n) oneR
    fromNat-addition :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m + n) == add (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-multiplication :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m * n) == multiply (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-injective :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat m == fromNat n ->
      m == n

    archimedean :
      (x : R) ->
      Exists Nat (\ n -> lessOrEqual x (fromNat n))
    least-upper-bound :
      (P : R -> Set) ->
      Exists R P ->
      Exists R
        (\ upper ->
          (x : R) ->
          P x ->
          lessOrEqual x upper) ->
      Exists R
        (\ supremum ->
          ((x : R) ->
            P x ->
            lessOrEqual x supremum)
          and
          ((upper : R) ->
            ((x : R) ->
              P x ->
              lessOrEqual x upper) ->
            lessOrEqual supremum upper))

    floor-lower :
      (x : R) ->
      lessOrEqual
        (embedInt fromNat negate (floor x))
        x
    floor-upper :
      (x : R) ->
      lessOrEqual
        x
        (embedInt fromNat negate (intSuccessor (floor x)))
      and
      x != embedInt fromNat negate (intSuccessor (floor x))

open CompleteOrderedRealField

oneN : Nat
oneN =
  suc zero

twoN : Nat
twoN =
  suc oneN

threeN : Nat
threeN =
  suc twoN

tenN : Nat
tenN =
  10

twentyNineN : Nat
twentyNineN =
  29

twentyFiveN : Nat
twentyFiveN =
  25

subtract :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
subtract reals x y =
  add reals x (negate reals y)

square :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R
square reals x =
  multiply reals x x

cube :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R
cube reals x =
  multiply reals (square reals x) x

module Putnam1979A5Statement
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) where

  IsRoot : R -> Set
  IsRoot x =
    subtract reals
      (add reals
        (subtract reals
          (cube reals x)
          (multiply reals
            (fromNat reals tenN)
            (square reals x)))
        (multiply reals
          (fromNat reals twentyNineN)
          x))
      (fromNat reals twentyFiveN)
    ==
    zeroR reals

  SequenceValue : R -> Nat -> Int
  SequenceValue x n =
    floor reals
      (multiply reals
        (fromNat reals n)
        x)

  CommonValueAbove : R -> R -> Nat -> Set
  CommonValueAbove alpha beta n =
    Exists Int
      (\ m ->
        pos n <Z m
        and
        Exists Nat
          (\ c ->
            Exists Nat
              (\ d ->
                SequenceValue alpha c == m
                and
                SequenceValue beta d == m)))

  proposition : Set
  proposition =
    Exists R
      (\ alpha ->
        Exists R
          (\ beta ->
            alpha != beta
            and
            IsRoot alpha
            and
            IsRoot beta
            and
            ((n : Nat) ->
              CommonValueAbove alpha beta n)))

putnam-1979-a5 : Set1
putnam-1979-a5 =
  (R : Set) ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) ->
  Putnam1979A5Statement.proposition reals

;; Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench artifact putnam_1979_a6:
;; for n real points p_0,...,p_(n-1) in [0,1], there is a distinct x in
;; [0,1] satisfying the stated reciprocal-distance harmonic bound. This file
;; contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))

;; Only the first n values of the source function occur in the theorem, so an
;; n-element ACL2 list represents them exactly. Conservative generic symbols
;; are ACL2's native presentation of the real scalar operations; no APPLY$
;; function universe or powerset-completeness surrogate is needed.
(defstub p79a6-scalar-p (x) t)
(defstub p79a6-add-op (x y) t)
(defstub p79a6-multiply-op (x y) t)
(defstub p79a6-negate-op (x) t)
(defstub p79a6-inverse-op (x) t)
(defstub p79a6-less-op (x y) t)

(defun p79a6-add (x y)
  (p79a6-add-op x y))

(defun p79a6-mul (x y)
  (p79a6-multiply-op x y))

(defun p79a6-neg (x)
  (p79a6-negate-op x))

(defun p79a6-inv (x)
  (p79a6-inverse-op x))

(defun p79a6-sub (x y)
  (p79a6-add x (p79a6-neg y)))

(defun p79a6-less (x y)
  (if (p79a6-less-op x y) t nil))

(defun p79a6-less-equal (x y)
  (not (p79a6-less y x)))

(defun p79a6-abs (x zero)
  (if (p79a6-less x zero)
      (p79a6-neg x)
    x))

(defun-sk p79a6-field-laws-p (zero one)
  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (p79a6-scalar-p x)
      (p79a6-scalar-p y)
      (p79a6-scalar-p z))
     (and
      (p79a6-scalar-p (p79a6-add x y))
      (p79a6-scalar-p (p79a6-mul x y))
      (p79a6-scalar-p (p79a6-neg x))
      (implies
       (not (equal x zero))
       (p79a6-scalar-p (p79a6-inv x)))
      (equal (p79a6-add (p79a6-add x y) z)
             (p79a6-add x (p79a6-add y z)))
      (equal (p79a6-add x y)
             (p79a6-add y x))
      (equal (p79a6-add x zero) x)
      (equal (p79a6-add x (p79a6-neg x)) zero)
      (equal (p79a6-mul (p79a6-mul x y) z)
             (p79a6-mul x (p79a6-mul y z)))
      (equal (p79a6-mul x y)
             (p79a6-mul y x))
      (equal (p79a6-mul x one) x)
      (implies
       (not (equal x zero))
       (equal (p79a6-mul x (p79a6-inv x)) one))
      (equal
       (p79a6-mul x (p79a6-add y z))
       (p79a6-add (p79a6-mul x y)
                  (p79a6-mul x z)))))))

(defun-sk p79a6-order-laws-p (zero)
  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (p79a6-scalar-p x)
      (p79a6-scalar-p y)
      (p79a6-scalar-p z))
     (and
      (not (p79a6-less x x))
      (or
       (equal x y)
       (p79a6-less x y)
       (p79a6-less y x))
      (implies
       (and
        (p79a6-less x y)
        (p79a6-less y z))
       (p79a6-less x z))
      (implies
       (p79a6-less x y)
       (p79a6-less
        (p79a6-add x z)
        (p79a6-add y z)))
      (implies
       (and
        (p79a6-less zero x)
        (p79a6-less zero y))
       (p79a6-less zero (p79a6-mul x y)))))))

(defun p79a6-ordered-field-p (zero one)
  (and
   (p79a6-scalar-p zero)
   (p79a6-scalar-p one)
   (not (equal zero one))
   (p79a6-less zero one)
   (p79a6-field-laws-p zero one)
   (p79a6-order-laws-p zero)))

(defun p79a6-point-list-p (points zero one)
  (if (consp points)
      (and
       (p79a6-scalar-p (car points))
       (p79a6-less-equal zero (car points))
       (p79a6-less-equal (car points) one)
       (p79a6-point-list-p (cdr points) zero one))
    (equal points nil)))

(defun p79a6-nat-value (n zero one)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix n)))
  (if (zp n)
      zero
    (p79a6-add
     (p79a6-nat-value (1- n) zero one)
     one)))

(defun p79a6-distinct-from-points-p (x points)
  (if (consp points)
      (and
       (not (equal x (car points)))
       (p79a6-distinct-from-points-p x (cdr points)))
    t))

(defun p79a6-reciprocal-distance-sum (x points zero)
  (if (consp points)
      (p79a6-add
       (p79a6-inv
        (p79a6-abs
         (p79a6-sub x (car points))
         zero))
       (p79a6-reciprocal-distance-sum x (cdr points) zero))
    zero))

(defun p79a6-harmonic-sum (count zero one)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix count)))
  (if (zp count)
      zero
    (let* ((i (1- count))
           (denominator (+ (* 2 i) 1)))
      (p79a6-add
       (p79a6-harmonic-sum i zero one)
       (p79a6-inv
        (p79a6-nat-value denominator zero one))))))

(defun p79a6-bound (n zero one)
  (p79a6-mul
   (p79a6-mul
    (p79a6-nat-value 8 zero one)
    (p79a6-nat-value n zero one))
   (p79a6-harmonic-sum n zero one)))

(defun p79a6-witness-p (x points n zero one)
  (and
   (p79a6-scalar-p x)
   (p79a6-less-equal zero x)
   (p79a6-less-equal x one)
   (p79a6-distinct-from-points-p x points)
   (p79a6-less-equal
    (p79a6-reciprocal-distance-sum x points zero)
    (p79a6-bound n zero one))))

(defun-sk p79a6-witness-exists-p (points n zero one)
  (exists (x)
    (p79a6-witness-p x points n zero one)))

;; Completeness is not needed for this finite theorem. For n>0, take the
;; 2*n+1 equally spaced grid points j/(2*n) and discard one nearest grid point
;; for each input point. At least n+1 grid points remain. For a fixed input
;; point, the two grid points at each successive distance contribute at most
;; 8*n/(2*i+1); summing over the inputs and averaging over the remaining grid
;; points gives the displayed bound. This construction uses only finite
;; ordered-field arithmetic, so quantifying over ordered fields does not
;; strengthen the source proposition.
(defun putnambench-putnam-1979-a6-statement

-- Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1979_a6:
-- an existential reciprocal-distance bound for finitely many real points in
-- the closed unit interval. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; _*_)

infix 4 _!=_ _<=N_
infixr 3 _and_
infixr 2 _or_

data Bottom : Set where

Not : Set -> Set
Not A =
  A -> Bottom

_!=_ : {A : Set} -> A -> A -> Set
x != y =
  Not (x == y)

record _and_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data _or_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  left  : A -> A or B
  right : B -> A or B

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

data _<=N_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set where
  zero<=   : {n : Nat} -> zero <=N n
  suc<=suc : {m n : Nat} -> m <=N n -> suc m <=N suc n

NatStrictLess : Nat -> Nat -> Set
NatStrictLess m n =
  suc m <=N n

record CompleteOrderedRealField (R : Set) : Set1 where
  field
    zeroR oneR : R
    add multiply : R -> R -> R
    negate inverse : R -> R
    lessOrEqual : R -> R -> Set
    fromNat : Nat -> R

    one-not-zero :
      oneR != zeroR

    add-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> add x y == add y x
    add-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      add (add x y) z == add x (add y z)
    add-zero :
      (x : R) -> add x zeroR == x
    add-inverse :
      (x : R) -> add x (negate x) == zeroR

    multiply-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> multiply x y == multiply y x
    multiply-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply (multiply x y) z ==
      multiply x (multiply y z)
    multiply-one :
      (x : R) -> multiply x oneR == x
    multiply-zero :
      (x : R) -> multiply x zeroR == zeroR
    distribute :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply x (add y z) ==
      add (multiply x y) (multiply x z)
    inverse-zero :
      inverse zeroR == zeroR
    multiply-inverse :
      (x : R) ->
      x != zeroR ->
      multiply x (inverse x) == oneR

    order-reflexive :
      (x : R) -> lessOrEqual x x
    order-transitive :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y z ->
      lessOrEqual x z
    order-antisymmetric :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y x ->
      x == y
    order-total :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y or lessOrEqual y x
    add-order :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual (add z x) (add z y)
    multiply-nonnegative :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR x ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR y ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR (multiply x y)
    zero-less-than-one :
      lessOrEqual zeroR oneR and zeroR != oneR

    fromNat-zero :
      fromNat zero == zeroR
    fromNat-successor :
      (n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (suc n) == add (fromNat n) oneR
    fromNat-addition :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m + n) == add (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-multiplication :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m * n) == multiply (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-injective :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat m == fromNat n ->
      m == n

    archimedean :
      (x : R) ->
      Exists Nat (\ n -> lessOrEqual x (fromNat n))
    least-upper-bound :
      (P : R -> Set) ->
      Exists R P ->
      Exists R
        (\ upper ->
          (x : R) ->
          P x ->
          lessOrEqual x upper) ->
      Exists R
        (\ supremum ->
          ((x : R) ->
            P x ->
            lessOrEqual x supremum)
          and
          ((upper : R) ->
            ((x : R) ->
              P x ->
              lessOrEqual x upper) ->
            lessOrEqual supremum upper))

open CompleteOrderedRealField

subtract :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
subtract reals x y =
  add reals x (negate reals y)

divide :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
divide reals x y =
  multiply reals x (inverse reals y)

maximum :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
maximum reals x y with order-total reals x y
... | left _ = y
... | right _ = x

absoluteValue :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R
absoluteValue reals x =
  maximum reals x (negate reals x)

InClosedUnitInterval :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  Set
InClosedUnitInterval reals x =
  lessOrEqual reals (zeroR reals) x
  and
  lessOrEqual reals x (oneR reals)

sumFirst :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Nat ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  R
sumFirst reals zero term =
  zeroR reals
sumFirst reals (suc n) term =
  add reals
    (sumFirst reals n term)
    (term n)

oneN : Nat
oneN =
  suc zero

twoN : Nat
twoN =
  suc oneN

eightN : Nat
eightN =
  twoN * twoN * twoN

module Putnam1979A6Statement
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) where

  reciprocalDistanceSum :
    Nat ->
    (Nat -> R) ->
    R ->
    R
  reciprocalDistanceSum n p x =
    sumFirst reals n
      (\ i ->
        divide reals
          (oneR reals)
          (absoluteValue reals
            (subtract reals x (p i))))

  oddHarmonicSum :
    Nat ->
    R
  oddHarmonicSum n =
    sumFirst reals n
      (\ i ->
        divide reals
          (oneR reals)
          (fromNat reals
            (twoN * i + oneN)))

  reciprocalDistanceBound :
    Nat ->
    R
  reciprocalDistanceBound n =
    multiply reals
      (multiply reals
        (fromNat reals eightN)
        (fromNat reals n))
      (oddHarmonicSum n)

  proposition : Set
  proposition =
    (n : Nat) ->
    (p : Nat -> R) ->
    ((i : Nat) ->
      NatStrictLess i n ->
      InClosedUnitInterval reals (p i)) ->
    Exists R
      (\ x ->
        InClosedUnitInterval reals x
        and
        ((i : Nat) ->
          NatStrictLess i n ->
          x != p i)
        and
        lessOrEqual reals
          (reciprocalDistanceSum n p x)
          (reciprocalDistanceBound n))

putnam-1979-a6 : Set1
putnam-1979-a6 =
  (R : Set) ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) ->
  Putnam1979A6Statement.proposition reals

(*
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench artifact putnam_1979_a6:
  a finite collection of points in the real unit interval admits another
  point whose reciprocal-distance sum satisfies the stated harmonic bound.
  This file contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open arithmeticTheory listTheory pred_setTheory realTheory real_sigmaTheory;

val putnam_1979_a6 =
  ``!n : num. !p : num -> real.
      (!i : num.
         i IN count n
         ==>
         0 <= p i /\ p i <= 1)
      ==>
      ?x : real.
        0 <= x /\ x <= 1 /\
        (!i : num. i IN count n ==> x <> p i) /\
        SIGMA
          (\i : num. 1 / abs (x - p i))
          (count n) <=
        8 * (&n : real) *
          SIGMA
            (\i : num. (1 : real) / (2 * (&i : real) + 1))
            (count n)``;

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  For n in NN0, the class RR ^m ( 1 ... n ) contains every n-term real
  family. It is equivalent to the source functions restricted to their used
  indices; the bijection j |-> j + 1 carries Lean's indices 0 through n - 1
  to Isabelle's indices 1 through n and changes 2j + 1 into 2i - 1.

  The existentially quantified x remains in the unit interval, is distinct
  from every family value, and satisfies the same finite reciprocal-distance

${
  $d i n p x $.

  putnambench-putnam-1979-a6 $a |- A. n e. NN0
    A. p e. ( RR ^m ( 1 ... n ) )
      (
        A. i e. ( 1 ... n )

            0 <_ ( p ` i )

environ

begin

::$P-
theorem
  for n being Nat,
      p being FinSequence of REAL st
    len p = n &
    (for i being Nat st i in Seg n holds

content:
% Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1979_a6:
% among any n points in the closed unit interval, some other point in that
% interval has the stated reciprocal-distance sum bound. This file contains
% no proof.

putnam_1979_a6: THEORY
BEGIN
  real_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> real]

  safe_div(numerator, denominator: real): real =
    IF denominator = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      numerator / denominator
    ENDIF

  reciprocal_distance_sum(
      p: real_sequence,
      x: real,
      count: nat): RECURSIVE real =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      reciprocal_distance_sum(p, x, count - 1)
        + safe_div(1, abs(x - p(count - 1)))
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  odd_reciprocal_sum(count: nat): RECURSIVE real =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      odd_reciprocal_sum(count - 1)
        + safe_div(1, (2 * (count - 1) + 1) :: real)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  putnam_1979_a6: bool =
    FORALL (n: nat), (p: real_sequence):
      (FORALL (index: nat):
        index < n IMPLIES
          0 <= p(index) AND p(index) <= 1)
      IMPLIES
        EXISTS (x: real):
          0 <= x
            AND x <= 1
            AND (FORALL (index: nat):
              index < n IMPLIES x /= p(index))
            AND reciprocal_distance_sum(p, x, n)
              <= 8 * (n :: real) * odd_reciprocal_sum(n)
END putnam_1979_a6

Definition putnam_1979_b2_solution : R -> R -> R := fun a b => (expR ((b/(b-a)) * ln b))/(expR 1 * (expR ((a/(b-a)) * ln a))).

    : f @ (dnbhs 0) --> putnam_1979_b2_solution a b.
Proof. Admitted.

content:
;; Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1979_b2:
;; the punctured limit at zero of integral power means on a positive affine
;; interval, with its exact exponential-power value. This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))

;; A Dedekind-complete ordered field presents the real numbers. APPLY$ objects
;; present its carrier and operations without restricting the domain to ACL2
;; rationals. Positive-base real powers are fixed by their rational values and
;; continuity in the exponent. The distinguished value e is fixed by its
;; exponential series. The integral below uses the unbounded tagged-partition
;; criterion; for the continuous source integrand this is equal to its
;; Lebesgue integral. Thus the final predicate states the source punctured
;; real limit itself, not a discretization or a derived integral identity.

(defun p79b2-carrier (ctx) (nth 0 ctx))
(defun p79b2-zero (ctx) (nth 1 ctx))
(defun p79b2-one (ctx) (nth 2 ctx))
(defun p79b2-add-op (ctx) (nth 3 ctx))
(defun p79b2-multiply-op (ctx) (nth 4 ctx))
(defun p79b2-negate-op (ctx) (nth 5 ctx))
(defun p79b2-inverse-op (ctx) (nth 6 ctx))
(defun p79b2-less-op (ctx) (nth 7 ctx))
(defun p79b2-power-op (ctx) (nth 8 ctx))
(defun p79b2-e (ctx) (nth 9 ctx))

(defun p79b2-member-p (ctx x)
  (if (apply$ (p79b2-carrier ctx) (list x)) t nil))

(defun p79b2-unary (operation x)
  (apply$ operation (list x)))

(defun p79b2-binary (operation x y)
  (apply$ operation (list x y)))

(defun p79b2-add (ctx x y)
  (p79b2-binary (p79b2-add-op ctx) x y))

(defun p79b2-multiply (ctx x y)
  (p79b2-binary (p79b2-multiply-op ctx) x y))

(defun p79b2-negate (ctx x)
  (p79b2-unary (p79b2-negate-op ctx) x))

(defun p79b2-inverse (ctx x)
  (p79b2-unary (p79b2-inverse-op ctx) x))

(defun p79b2-less-p (ctx x y)
  (if (p79b2-binary (p79b2-less-op ctx) x y) t nil))

(defun p79b2-power (ctx base exponent)
  (p79b2-binary (p79b2-power-op ctx) base exponent))

(defun p79b2-subtract (ctx x y)
  (p79b2-add ctx x (p79b2-negate ctx y)))

(defun p79b2-divide (ctx x y)
  (p79b2-multiply ctx x (p79b2-inverse ctx y)))

(defun p79b2-less-equal-p (ctx x y)
  (not (p79b2-less-p ctx y x)))

(defun p79b2-positive-p (ctx x)
  (and
   (p79b2-member-p ctx x)
   (p79b2-less-p ctx (p79b2-zero ctx) x)))

(defun p79b2-absolute (ctx x)
  (if (p79b2-less-p ctx x (p79b2-zero ctx))
      (p79b2-negate ctx x)
    x))

(defun p79b2-distance (ctx x y)
  (p79b2-absolute ctx (p79b2-subtract ctx x y)))

(defun-sk p79b2-field-laws-p (ctx)
  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (p79b2-member-p ctx x)
      (p79b2-member-p ctx y)
      (p79b2-member-p ctx z))
     (and
      (p79b2-member-p ctx (p79b2-add ctx x y))
      (p79b2-member-p ctx (p79b2-multiply ctx x y))
      (p79b2-member-p ctx (p79b2-negate ctx x))
      (p79b2-member-p ctx (p79b2-inverse ctx x))
      (equal
       (p79b2-add ctx (p79b2-add ctx x y) z)
       (p79b2-add ctx x (p79b2-add ctx y z)))
      (equal (p79b2-add ctx x y) (p79b2-add ctx y x))
      (equal (p79b2-add ctx x (p79b2-zero ctx)) x)
      (equal
       (p79b2-add ctx x (p79b2-negate ctx x))
       (p79b2-zero ctx))
      (equal
       (p79b2-multiply ctx (p79b2-multiply ctx x y) z)
       (p79b2-multiply ctx x (p79b2-multiply ctx y z)))
      (equal
       (p79b2-multiply ctx x y)
       (p79b2-multiply ctx y x))
      (equal (p79b2-multiply ctx x (p79b2-one ctx)) x)
      (equal
       (p79b2-inverse ctx (p79b2-zero ctx))
       (p79b2-zero ctx))
      (implies
       (not (equal x (p79b2-zero ctx)))
       (equal
        (p79b2-multiply ctx x (p79b2-inverse ctx x))
        (p79b2-one ctx)))
      (equal
       (p79b2-multiply ctx x (p79b2-add ctx y z))
       (p79b2-add
        ctx
        (p79b2-multiply ctx x y)
        (p79b2-multiply ctx x z)))))))

(defun-sk p79b2-order-laws-p (ctx)
  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (p79b2-member-p ctx x)
      (p79b2-member-p ctx y)
      (p79b2-member-p ctx z))
     (and
      (not (p79b2-less-p ctx x x))
      (or
       (equal x y)
       (p79b2-less-p ctx x y)
       (p79b2-less-p ctx y x))
      (implies
       (and
        (p79b2-less-p ctx x y)
        (p79b2-less-p ctx y z))
       (p79b2-less-p ctx x z))
      (implies
       (p79b2-less-p ctx x y)
       (p79b2-less-p
        ctx
        (p79b2-add ctx x z)
        (p79b2-add ctx y z)))
      (implies
       (and
        (p79b2-less-p ctx (p79b2-zero ctx) x)
        (p79b2-less-p ctx (p79b2-zero ctx) y))
       (p79b2-less-p
        ctx
        (p79b2-zero ctx)
        (p79b2-multiply ctx x y)))))))

(defun-sk p79b2-valid-set-p (ctx set)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (apply$ set (list x))
     (p79b2-member-p ctx x))))

(defun-sk p79b2-set-nonempty-p (ctx set)
  (exists (x)
    (and
     (p79b2-member-p ctx x)
     (apply$ set (list x)))))

(defun-sk p79b2-upper-bound-p (ctx set bound)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (and
      (p79b2-member-p ctx x)
      (apply$ set (list x)))
     (not (p79b2-less-p ctx bound x)))))

(defun-sk p79b2-bounded-above-p (ctx set)
  (exists (bound)
    (and
     (p79b2-member-p ctx bound)
     (p79b2-upper-bound-p ctx set bound))))

(defun-sk p79b2-supremum-p (ctx set supremum)
  (forall (bound)
    (and
     (p79b2-member-p ctx supremum)
     (p79b2-upper-bound-p ctx set supremum)
     (implies
      (and
       (p79b2-member-p ctx bound)
       (p79b2-upper-bound-p ctx set bound))
      (not (p79b2-less-p ctx bound supremum))))))

(defun-sk p79b2-has-supremum-p (ctx set)
  (exists (supremum)
    (p79b2-supremum-p ctx set supremum)))

(defun-sk p79b2-dedekind-complete-p (ctx)
  (forall (set)
    (implies
     (and
      (tamep-functionp set)
      (p79b2-valid-set-p ctx set)
      (p79b2-set-nonempty-p ctx set)
      (p79b2-bounded-above-p ctx set))
     (p79b2-has-supremum-p ctx set))))

(defun p79b2-natural (ctx n)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix n)))
  (if (zp n)
      (p79b2-zero ctx)
    (p79b2-add
     ctx
     (p79b2-one ctx)
     (p79b2-natural ctx (- n 1)))))

(defun p79b2-integer (ctx n)
  (if (< n 0)
      (p79b2-negate ctx (p79b2-natural ctx (- n)))
    (p79b2-natural ctx n)))

(defun p79b2-natural-power (ctx base exponent)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix exponent)))
  (if (zp exponent)
      (p79b2-one ctx)
    (p79b2-multiply
     ctx
     (p79b2-natural-power ctx base (- exponent 1))
     base)))

(defun p79b2-integer-power (ctx base exponent)
  (if (< exponent 0)
      (p79b2-inverse
       ctx
       (p79b2-natural-power ctx base (- exponent)))
    (p79b2-natural-power ctx base exponent)))

(defun-sk p79b2-power-typing-p (ctx)
  (forall (base exponent)
    (implies
     (and
      (p79b2-positive-p ctx base)
      (p79b2-member-p ctx exponent))
     (p79b2-positive-p
      ctx
      (p79b2-power ctx base exponent)))))

(defun-sk p79b2-power-rational-laws-p (ctx)
  (forall (base numerator denominator)
    (implies
     (and
      (p79b2-positive-p ctx base)
      (integerp numerator)
      (posp denominator))
     (equal
      (p79b2-natural-power
       ctx
       (p79b2-power
        ctx
        base
        (p79b2-multiply
         ctx
         (p79b2-integer ctx numerator)
         (p79b2-inverse
          ctx
          (p79b2-natural ctx denominator))))
       denominator)
      (p79b2-integer-power ctx base numerator)))))

(defun-sk p79b2-power-neighborhood-p
    (ctx base exponent epsilon delta)
  (forall (y)
    (implies
     (and
      (p79b2-member-p ctx y)
      (p79b2-less-p
       ctx
       (p79b2-distance ctx y exponent)
       delta))
     (p79b2-less-p
      ctx
      (p79b2-distance
       ctx
       (p79b2-power ctx base y)
       (p79b2-power ctx base exponent))
      epsilon))))

(defun-sk p79b2-power-delta-exists-p
    (ctx base exponent epsilon)
  (exists (delta)
    (and
     (p79b2-positive-p ctx delta)
     (p79b2-power-neighborhood-p
      ctx base exponent epsilon delta))))

(defun-sk p79b2-power-continuous-p (ctx)
  (forall (base exponent epsilon)
    (implies
     (and
      (p79b2-positive-p ctx base)
      (p79b2-member-p ctx exponent)
      (p79b2-positive-p ctx epsilon))
     (p79b2-power-delta-exists-p
      ctx base exponent epsilon))))

(defun p79b2-real-power-p (ctx)
  (and
   (tamep-functionp (p79b2-power-op ctx))
   (p79b2-power-typing-p ctx)
   (p79b2-power-rational-laws-p ctx)
   (p79b2-power-continuous-p ctx)))

(defun p79b2-factorial-value (ctx n)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix n)))
  (if (zp n)
      (p79b2-one ctx)
    (p79b2-multiply
     ctx
     (p79b2-natural ctx n)
     (p79b2-factorial-value ctx (- n 1)))))

(defun p79b2-e-prefix (ctx terms)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix terms)))
  (if (zp terms)
      (p79b2-zero ctx)
    (let ((index (- terms 1)))
      (p79b2-add
       ctx
       (p79b2-e-prefix ctx index)
       (p79b2-inverse
        ctx
        (p79b2-factorial-value ctx index))))))

(defun-sk p79b2-e-tail-p (ctx epsilon cutoff)
  (forall (terms)
    (implies
     (and
      (natp terms)
      (natp cutoff)
      (<= cutoff terms))
     (p79b2-less-p
      ctx
      (p79b2-distance
       ctx
       (p79b2-e-prefix ctx terms)
       (p79b2-e ctx))
      epsilon))))

(defun-sk p79b2-e-cutoff-exists-p (ctx epsilon)
  (exists (cutoff)
    (and
     (natp cutoff)
     (p79b2-e-tail-p ctx epsilon cutoff))))

(defun-sk p79b2-e-converges-p (ctx)
  (forall (epsilon)
    (implies
     (p79b2-positive-p ctx epsilon)
     (p79b2-e-cutoff-exists-p ctx epsilon))))

(defun p79b2-e-value-p (ctx)
  (and
   (p79b2-positive-p ctx (p79b2-e ctx))
   (p79b2-e-converges-p ctx)))

(defun p79b2-context-p (ctx)
  (and
   (true-listp ctx)
   (equal (len ctx) 10)
   (tamep-functionp (p79b2-carrier ctx))
   (tamep-functionp (p79b2-add-op ctx))
   (tamep-functionp (p79b2-multiply-op ctx))
   (tamep-functionp (p79b2-negate-op ctx))
   (tamep-functionp (p79b2-inverse-op ctx))
   (tamep-functionp (p79b2-less-op ctx))
   (p79b2-member-p ctx (p79b2-zero ctx))
   (p79b2-member-p ctx (p79b2-one ctx))
   (not (equal (p79b2-zero ctx) (p79b2-one ctx)))
   (p79b2-field-laws-p ctx)
   (p79b2-order-laws-p ctx)
   (p79b2-less-p ctx (p79b2-zero ctx) (p79b2-one ctx))
   (p79b2-dedekind-complete-p ctx)
   (p79b2-real-power-p ctx)
   (p79b2-e-value-p ctx)))

(defun p79b2-real-list-p (ctx values)
  (if (consp values)
      (and
       (p79b2-member-p ctx (car values))
       (p79b2-real-list-p ctx (cdr values)))
    (equal values nil)))

(defun p79b2-strictly-increasing-p (ctx values)
  (if (and (consp values) (consp (cdr values)))
      (and
       (p79b2-less-p ctx (car values) (cadr values))
       (p79b2-strictly-increasing-p ctx (cdr values)))
    (and (consp values) (endp (cdr values)))))

(defun p79b2-tags-fit-p (ctx nodes tags)
  (if (consp tags)
      (and
       (consp nodes)
       (consp (cdr nodes))
       (p79b2-less-equal-p ctx (car nodes) (car tags))
       (p79b2-less-equal-p ctx (car tags) (cadr nodes))
       (p79b2-tags-fit-p ctx (cdr nodes) (cdr tags)))
    (and
     (consp nodes)
     (endp (cdr nodes))
     (equal tags nil))))

(defun p79b2-tagged-unit-partition-p (ctx nodes tags)
  (and
   (true-listp nodes)
   (true-listp tags)
   (p79b2-real-list-p ctx nodes)
   (p79b2-real-list-p ctx tags)
   (p79b2-strictly-increasing-p ctx nodes)
   (p79b2-tags-fit-p ctx nodes tags)
   (equal (car nodes) (p79b2-zero ctx))
   (equal (car (last nodes)) (p79b2-one ctx))))

(defun p79b2-mesh-less-p (ctx nodes delta)
  (if (and (consp nodes) (consp (cdr nodes)))
      (and
       (p79b2-less-p
        ctx
        (p79b2-subtract ctx (cadr nodes) (car nodes))
        delta)
       (p79b2-mesh-less-p ctx (cdr nodes) delta))
    (and (consp nodes) (endp (cdr nodes)))))

(defun p79b2-affine-value (ctx a b x)
  (p79b2-add
   ctx
   (p79b2-multiply ctx b x)
   (p79b2-multiply
    ctx
    a
    (p79b2-subtract ctx (p79b2-one ctx) x))))

(defun p79b2-integrand-value (ctx a b tau x)
  (p79b2-power
   ctx
   (p79b2-affine-value ctx a b x)
   tau))

(defun p79b2-riemann-sum (ctx a b tau nodes tags)
  (if (consp tags)
      (p79b2-add
       ctx
       (p79b2-multiply
        ctx
        (p79b2-integrand-value ctx a b tau (car tags))
        (p79b2-subtract ctx (cadr nodes) (car nodes)))
       (p79b2-riemann-sum
        ctx a b tau (cdr nodes) (cdr tags)))
    (p79b2-zero ctx)))

(defun-sk p79b2-integral-delta-p
    (ctx a b tau value epsilon delta)
  (forall (nodes tags)
    (implies
     (and
      (p79b2-tagged-unit-partition-p ctx nodes tags)
      (p79b2-mesh-less-p ctx nodes delta))
     (p79b2-less-p
      ctx
      (p79b2-distance
       ctx
       (p79b2-riemann-sum ctx a b tau nodes tags)
       value)
      epsilon))))

(defun-sk p79b2-integral-delta-exists-p
    (ctx a b tau value epsilon)
  (exists (delta)
    (and
     (p79b2-positive-p ctx delta)
     (p79b2-integral-delta-p
      ctx a b tau value epsilon delta))))

(defun-sk p79b2-integral-converges-p
    (ctx a b tau value)
  (forall (epsilon)
    (implies
     (p79b2-positive-p ctx epsilon)
     (p79b2-integral-delta-exists-p
      ctx a b tau value epsilon))))

(defun p79b2-integral-value-p (ctx a b tau value)
  (and
   (p79b2-member-p ctx a)
   (p79b2-member-p ctx b)
   (p79b2-member-p ctx tau)
   (p79b2-positive-p ctx value)
   (p79b2-integral-converges-p ctx a b tau value)))

(defun p79b2-solution-value (ctx a b)
  (let* ((b-minus-a (p79b2-subtract ctx b a))
         (b-to-b (p79b2-power ctx b b))
         (a-to-a (p79b2-power ctx a a))
         (power-ratio (p79b2-divide ctx b-to-b a-to-a)))
    (p79b2-multiply
     ctx
     (p79b2-inverse ctx (p79b2-e ctx))
     (p79b2-power
      ctx
      power-ratio
      (p79b2-inverse ctx b-minus-a)))))

(defun-sk p79b2-mean-close-exists-p
    (ctx a b tau solution epsilon)
  (exists (integral)
    (and
     (p79b2-integral-value-p ctx a b tau integral)
     (p79b2-less-p
      ctx
      (p79b2-distance
       ctx
       (p79b2-power ctx integral (p79b2-inverse ctx tau))
       solution)
      epsilon))))

(defun-sk p79b2-limit-neighborhood-p
    (ctx a b solution epsilon delta)
  (forall (tau)
    (implies
     (and
      (p79b2-member-p ctx tau)
      (p79b2-positive-p ctx (p79b2-absolute ctx tau))
      (p79b2-less-p ctx (p79b2-absolute ctx tau) delta))
     (p79b2-mean-close-exists-p
      ctx a b tau solution epsilon))))

(defun-sk p79b2-limit-delta-exists-p
    (ctx a b solution epsilon)
  (exists (delta)
    (and
     (p79b2-positive-p ctx delta)
     (p79b2-limit-neighborhood-p
      ctx a b solution epsilon delta))))

(defun-sk p79b2-source-limit-p (ctx a b solution)
  (forall (epsilon)
    (implies
     (p79b2-positive-p ctx epsilon)
     (p79b2-limit-delta-exists-p
      ctx a b solution epsilon))))

(defun-sk putnambench-putnam-1979-b2-statement (ctx)
  (forall (a b)
    (implies
     (and
      (p79b2-context-p ctx)
      (p79b2-positive-p ctx a)
      (p79b2-member-p ctx b)
      (p79b2-less-p ctx a b))
     (p79b2-source-limit-p
      ctx a b (p79b2-solution-value ctx a b)))))

:q

title: putnam_1979_b2
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1979_b2:
-- the punctured limit at zero of a real power of an integral over [0, 1],
-- with its closed form in terms of two positive real parameters.
-- This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; _*_)

infix 4 _!=_ _<=N_
infixr 3 _and_
infixr 2 _or_

data Bottom : Set where

Not : Set -> Set
Not A =
  A -> Bottom

_!=_ : {A : Set} -> A -> A -> Set
x != y =
  Not (x == y)

record _and_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data _or_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  left  : A -> A or B
  right : B -> A or B

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

data _<=N_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set where
  zero<=   : {n : Nat} -> zero <=N n
  suc<=suc : {m n : Nat} -> m <=N n -> suc m <=N suc n

record CompleteOrderedRealField (R : Set) : Set1 where
  field
    zeroR oneR : R
    add multiply : R -> R -> R
    negate inverse : R -> R
    lessOrEqual : R -> R -> Set
    fromNat : Nat -> R

    one-not-zero :
      oneR != zeroR

    add-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> add x y == add y x
    add-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      add (add x y) z == add x (add y z)
    add-zero :
      (x : R) -> add x zeroR == x
    add-inverse :
      (x : R) -> add x (negate x) == zeroR

    multiply-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> multiply x y == multiply y x
    multiply-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply (multiply x y) z ==
      multiply x (multiply y z)
    multiply-one :
      (x : R) -> multiply x oneR == x
    multiply-zero :
      (x : R) -> multiply x zeroR == zeroR
    distribute :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply x (add y z) ==
      add (multiply x y) (multiply x z)
    inverse-zero :
      inverse zeroR == zeroR
    multiply-inverse :
      (x : R) ->
      x != zeroR ->
      multiply x (inverse x) == oneR

    order-reflexive :
      (x : R) -> lessOrEqual x x
    order-transitive :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y z ->
      lessOrEqual x z
    order-antisymmetric :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y x ->
      x == y
    order-total :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y or lessOrEqual y x
    add-order :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual (add z x) (add z y)
    multiply-nonnegative :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR x ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR y ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR (multiply x y)
    zero-less-than-one :
      lessOrEqual zeroR oneR and zeroR != oneR

    fromNat-zero :
      fromNat zero == zeroR
    fromNat-successor :
      (n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (suc n) == add (fromNat n) oneR
    fromNat-addition :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m + n) == add (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-multiplication :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m * n) == multiply (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-injective :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat m == fromNat n ->
      m == n

    archimedean :
      (x : R) ->
      Exists Nat (\ n -> lessOrEqual x (fromNat n))
    least-upper-bound :
      (P : R -> Set) ->
      Exists R P ->
      Exists R
        (\ upper ->
          (x : R) ->
          P x ->
          lessOrEqual x upper) ->
      Exists R
        (\ supremum ->
          ((x : R) ->
            P x ->
            lessOrEqual x supremum)
          and
          ((upper : R) ->
            ((x : R) ->
              P x ->
              lessOrEqual x upper) ->
            lessOrEqual supremum upper))

open CompleteOrderedRealField

subtract :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
subtract reals x y =
  add reals x (negate reals y)

divide :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
divide reals x y =
  multiply reals x (inverse reals y)

StrictLess :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
StrictLess reals x y =
  lessOrEqual reals x y and x != y

CloseTo :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
CloseTo reals center radius x =
  StrictLess reals
    (subtract reals center radius)
    x
  and
  StrictLess reals
    x
    (add reals center radius)

SequentialLimit :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  R ->
  Set
SequentialLimit {R} reals sequence limit =
  (epsilon : R) ->
  StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) epsilon ->
  Exists Nat
    (\ cutoff ->
      (n : Nat) ->
      cutoff <=N n ->
      CloseTo reals limit epsilon (sequence n))

LimitAt :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (R -> R) ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
LimitAt {R} reals function limit point =
  (epsilon : R) ->
  StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) epsilon ->
  Exists R
    (\ delta ->
      StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) delta
      and
      ((x : R) ->
        CloseTo reals point delta x ->
        x != point ->
        CloseTo reals limit epsilon (function x)))

naturalPower :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  Nat ->
  R
naturalPower reals x zero =
  oneR reals
naturalPower reals x (suc n) =
  multiply reals
    (naturalPower reals x n)
    x

factorial : Nat -> Nat
factorial zero =
  suc zero
factorial (suc n) =
  suc n * factorial n

sumFirst :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Nat ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  R
sumFirst reals zero terms =
  zeroR reals
sumFirst reals (suc n) terms =
  add reals
    (sumFirst reals n terms)
    (terms n)

exponentialPartialSum :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  Nat ->
  R
exponentialPartialSum reals x terms =
  sumFirst reals terms
    (\ n ->
      divide reals
        (naturalPower reals x n)
        (fromNat reals (factorial n)))

ExponentialValue :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
ExponentialValue reals x value =
  SequentialLimit reals
    (exponentialPartialSum reals x)
    value

rightRiemannSum :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  (R -> R) ->
  Nat ->
  R
rightRiemannSum reals lower upper function pieces =
  let
    step =
      divide reals
        (subtract reals upper lower)
        (fromNat reals pieces)
  in
  sumFirst reals pieces
    (\ i ->
      multiply reals
        (function
          (add reals lower
            (multiply reals
              (fromNat reals (suc i))
              step)))
        step)

IntervalIntegralValue :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  (R -> R) ->
  R ->
  Set
IntervalIntegralValue reals lower upper function value =
  SequentialLimit reals
    (\ n ->
      rightRiemannSum reals
        lower
        upper
        function
        (suc n))
    value

record StandardRealAnalysis
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) :
  Set1 where

  field
    exponential naturalLogarithm : R -> R

    exponential-is-power-series :
      (x : R) ->
      ExponentialValue reals x (exponential x)

    exponential-positive :
      (x : R) ->
      StrictLess reals
        (zeroR reals)
        (exponential x)

    logarithm-of-exponential :
      (x : R) ->
      naturalLogarithm (exponential x) == x

    exponential-of-logarithm :
      (x : R) ->
      StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) x ->
      exponential (naturalLogarithm x) == x

    intervalIntegral :
      R ->
      R ->
      (R -> R) ->
      R

    interval-integral-is-riemann :
      (lower upper : R) ->
      (function : R -> R) ->
      Exists R
        (\ value ->
          IntervalIntegralValue reals
            lower
            upper
            function
            value) ->
      IntervalIntegralValue reals
        lower
        upper
        function
        (intervalIntegral lower upper function)

open StandardRealAnalysis

realPower :
  {R : Set} ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) ->
  StandardRealAnalysis reals ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
realPower reals analysis base exponent =
  exponential analysis
    (multiply reals
      exponent
      (naturalLogarithm analysis base))

module Putnam1979B2Statement
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R)
  (analysis : StandardRealAnalysis reals) where

  affineValue : R -> R -> R -> R
  affineValue a b x =
    add reals
      (multiply reals b x)
      (multiply reals a
        (subtract reals (oneR reals) x))

  integrand : R -> R -> R -> R -> R
  integrand a b t x =
    realPower reals analysis
      (affineValue a b x)
      t

  integralValue : R -> R -> R -> R
  integralValue a b t =
    intervalIntegral analysis
      (zeroR reals)
      (oneR reals)
      (integrand a b t)

  limitExpression : R -> R -> R -> R
  limitExpression a b t =
    realPower reals analysis
      (integralValue a b t)
      (inverse reals t)

  solution : R -> R -> R
  solution a b =
    divide reals
      (exponential analysis
        (multiply reals
          (divide reals b (subtract reals b a))
          (naturalLogarithm analysis b)))
      (multiply reals
        (exponential analysis (oneR reals))
        (exponential analysis
          (multiply reals
            (divide reals a (subtract reals b a))
            (naturalLogarithm analysis a))))

  proposition : Set
  proposition =
    (a b : R) ->
    StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) a ->
    StrictLess reals a b ->
    LimitAt reals
      (limitExpression a b)
      (solution a b)
      (zeroR reals)

putnam-1979-b2 : Set1
putnam-1979-b2 =
  (R : Set) ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) ->
  (analysis : StandardRealAnalysis reals) ->
  Putnam1979B2Statement.proposition reals analysis

title: putnam_1979_b2
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1979_b2:
  the punctured limit at zero of a real-power integral over the unit interval,

open pred_setTheory realTheory real_topologyTheory transcTheory;
open extrealTheory measureTheory borelTheory lebesgueTheory
     lebesgue_measureTheory;

  ``!a b : real.

title: putnam_1979_b2
content:
% Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench artifact putnam_1979_b2:
% the punctured limit at zero of a real-power integral mean on the unit
% interval for 0 < a < b. This file contains no proof.

putnam_1979_b2: THEORY
BEGIN
  real_function: TYPE = [real -> real]
  real_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> real]

  safe_div(numerator, denominator: real): real =
    IF denominator = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      numerator / denominator
    ENDIF

  nat_factorial(index: nat): RECURSIVE nat =
    IF index = 0 THEN
      1
    ELSE
      index * nat_factorial(index - 1)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE index

  exponential_partial(x: real, count: nat): RECURSIVE real =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      LET index: nat = count - 1 IN
        exponential_partial(x, count - 1)
          + safe_div(
              x ^ index,
              nat_factorial(index) :: real)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  converges_to(sequence: real_sequence, value: real): bool =
    FORALL (epsilon_value: posreal):
      EXISTS (cutoff: nat):
        FORALL (index: nat):
          cutoff <= index IMPLIES
            abs(sequence(index) - value) < epsilon_value

  real_exponential(x: real): real =
    epsilon(
      LAMBDA (value: real):
        converges_to(
          LAMBDA (count: nat):
            exponential_partial(x, count),
          value))

  natural_log(x: real): real =
    IF x > 0 THEN
      epsilon(
        LAMBDA (value: real):
          real_exponential(value) = x)
    ELSE
      0
    ENDIF

  real_power(base, exponent: real): real =
    IF base > 0 THEN
      real_exponential(exponent * natural_log(base))
    ELSIF base = 0 AND exponent = 0 THEN
      1
    ELSE
      0
    ENDIF

  valid_partition(
      points: real_sequence,
      count: nat): bool =
    count > 0
      AND points(0) = 0
      AND points(count) = 1
      AND FORALL (index: nat):
        index < count IMPLIES
          points(index) < points(index + 1)

  valid_tags(
      points, tags: real_sequence,
      count: nat): bool =
    FORALL (index: nat):
      index < count IMPLIES
        points(index) <= tags(index)
          AND tags(index) <= points(index + 1)

  mesh_less_than(
      points: real_sequence,
      count: nat,
      bound: real): bool =
    FORALL (index: nat):
      index < count IMPLIES
        points(index + 1) - points(index) < bound

  riemann_sum(
      f: real_function,
      points, tags: real_sequence,
      count: nat): RECURSIVE real =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      riemann_sum(f, points, tags, count - 1)
        + f(tags(count - 1))
            * (points(count) - points(count - 1))
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  has_unit_interval_integral(
      f: real_function,
      integral_value: real): bool =
    FORALL (epsilon_value: posreal):
      EXISTS (mesh_bound: posreal):
        FORALL
            (points, tags: real_sequence),
            (count: nat):
          (valid_partition(points, count)
            AND valid_tags(points, tags, count)
            AND mesh_less_than(
              points, count, mesh_bound))
          IMPLIES
            abs(
              riemann_sum(f, points, tags, count)
                - integral_value)
              < epsilon_value

  unit_interval_integral(f: real_function): real =
    IF EXISTS (integral_value: real):
        has_unit_interval_integral(f, integral_value)
    THEN
      epsilon(
        LAMBDA (integral_value: real):
          has_unit_interval_integral(
            f, integral_value))
    ELSE
      0
    ENDIF

  tends_to_at(f: real_function, limit, point: real): bool =
    FORALL (epsilon_value: posreal):
      EXISTS (delta: posreal):
        FORALL (x: real):
          (0 < abs(x - point) AND abs(x - point) < delta)
            IMPLIES abs(f(x) - limit) < epsilon_value

  integral_mean(a, b, t: real): real =
    real_power(
      unit_interval_integral(
        LAMBDA (x: real):
          real_power(b * x + a * (1 - x), t)),
      safe_div(1, t))

  putnam_1979_b2_solution(a, b: real): real =
    safe_div(
      real_exponential(
        safe_div(b, b - a) * natural_log(b)),
      real_exponential(1)
        * real_exponential(
            safe_div(a, b - a) * natural_log(a)))

  putnam_1979_b2: bool =
    FORALL (a, b: real):
      (0 < a AND a < b)
      IMPLIES
        tends_to_at(
          LAMBDA (t: real):
            integral_mean(a, b, t),
          putnam_1979_b2_solution(a, b),
          0)
END putnam_1979_b2

title: putnam_1979_b3

import Mathlib

open Set Topology Filter Polynomial

abbrev putnam_1979_b3_solution : ℕ → ℤ := sorry
-- fun n ↦ (n - 1) / 2
/--
Let $F$ be a finite field with $n$ elements, and assume $n$ is odd. Suppose $x^2 + bx + c$ is an irreducible polynomial over $F$. For how many elements $d \in F$ is $x^2 + bx + c + d$ irreducible?
-/
theorem putnam_1979_b3
(F : Type*) [Field F] [Fintype F]
(n : ℕ)
(hn : n = Fintype.card F)
(nodd : Odd n)
(b c : F)
(p : Polynomial F)
(hp : p = X ^ 2 + (C b) * X + (C c) ∧ Irreducible p)
: ({d : F | Irreducible (p + (C d))}.ncard = putnam_1979_b3_solution n) :=
sorry

title: putnam_1979_b3
putnam_1979_b3
content:
theory putnam_1979_b3 imports Complex_Main
"HOL-Computational_Algebra.Polynomial"
begin

definition putnam_1979_b3_solution :: "nat \<Rightarrow> nat" where
"putnam_1979_b3_solution \<equiv> \<lambda> n. (n - 1) div 2"
theorem putnam_1979_b3:
  fixes n :: "nat"
    and b c :: "'a::{finite, field}"
    and p :: "'a poly"
  defines "p \<equiv> [:c, b, 1:]"
  assumes hcard : "card (UNIV :: 'a set) = n"
    and nodd : "odd n"
    and hp : "irreducible p"
  shows "card {d :: 'a. irreducible (p + monom d 0)} = putnam_1979_b3_solution n"
  sorry

end

(*
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench artifact putnam_1979_b3:
  over an odd finite field, exactly (n - 1) / 2 constant shifts of an
  irreducible monic quadratic remain irreducible. This file contains no proof.
*)

let statement =
  `let field_axioms =
     \(zero_F:A) (one_F:A) (add_F:A->A->A) (mul_F:A->A->A)
      (neg_F:A->A) (inv_F:A->A).
       ~(zero_F = one_F) /\
       (!x y:A. add_F x y = add_F y x) /\
       (!x y z:A. add_F (add_F x y) z = add_F x (add_F y z)) /\
       (!x:A. add_F x zero_F = x) /\
       (!x:A. add_F (neg_F x) x = zero_F) /\
       (!x y:A. mul_F x y = mul_F y x) /\
       (!x y z:A. mul_F (mul_F x y) z = mul_F x (mul_F y z)) /\
       (!x:A. mul_F one_F x = x) /\
       (!x:A. ~(x = zero_F) ==> mul_F (inv_F x) x = one_F) /\
       (!x y z:A.
          mul_F x (add_F y z) = add_F (mul_F x y) (mul_F x z)) in
   let quadratic_rootless =
     \(zero_F:A) (add_F:A->A->A) (mul_F:A->A->A) (b:A) (c:A).
       !x:A.
         ~(add_F (add_F (mul_F x x) (mul_F b x)) c = zero_F) in
   !n:num (zero_F:A) (one_F:A)
    (add_F:A->A->A) (mul_F:A->A->A)
    (neg_F:A->A) (inv_F:A->A) (b:A) (c:A).
     field_axioms zero_F one_F add_F mul_F neg_F inv_F /\
     FINITE (UNIV:A->bool) /\
     CARD (UNIV:A->bool) = n /\
     ODD n /\
     quadratic_rootless zero_F add_F mul_F b c
     ==>
     CARD
       {d:A |
          quadratic_rootless zero_F add_F mul_F b (add_F c d)} =
     (n - 1) DIV 2`;;

title: putnam_1979_b3
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1979_b3:
;; over a finite field of odd cardinality n, exactly (n-1)/2 constant shifts
;; of a monic irreducible quadratic remain irreducible. This file contains no
;; proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

;; A duplicate-free carrier and complete operation tables represent an
;; arbitrary finite field extensionally. Since the source field is finite,
;; every field structure has such tables, and the axioms below recover the
;; corresponding operations without restricting the field's isomorphism type.

(defun putnam-1979-b3-set-list-p (xs)
  (if (consp xs)
      (and
       (not (member-equal (car xs) (cdr xs)))
       (putnam-1979-b3-set-list-p (cdr xs)))
    (equal xs nil)))

(defun putnam-1979-b3-unary-table-p (table carrier)
  (if (consp table)
      (let* ((entry (car table))
             (argument (car entry))
             (value (cdr entry)))
        (and
         (consp entry)
         (member-equal argument carrier)
         (member-equal value carrier)
         (not (assoc-equal argument (cdr table)))
         (putnam-1979-b3-unary-table-p
          (cdr table) carrier)))
    (equal table nil)))

(defun putnam-1979-b3-binary-table-p (table carrier)
  (if (consp table)
      (let* ((entry (car table))
             (arguments (car entry))
             (value (cdr entry)))
        (and
         (consp entry)
         (true-listp arguments)
         (equal (len arguments) 2)
         (member-equal (car arguments) carrier)
         (member-equal (cadr arguments) carrier)
         (member-equal value carrier)
         (not (assoc-equal arguments (cdr table)))
         (putnam-1979-b3-binary-table-p
          (cdr table) carrier)))
    (equal table nil)))

(defun putnam-1979-b3-unary-value (argument table)
  (cdr (assoc-equal argument table)))

(defun putnam-1979-b3-binary-value (left right table)
  (cdr (assoc-equal (list left right) table)))

(defun putnam-1979-b3-field-xyz-axioms-p
    (zs x y add-table mul-table)
  (if (endp zs)
      t
    (let* ((z (car zs))
           (x-plus-y
            (putnam-1979-b3-binary-value
             x y add-table))
           (y-plus-z
            (putnam-1979-b3-binary-value
             y z add-table))
           (x-times-y
            (putnam-1979-b3-binary-value
             x y mul-table))
           (y-times-z
            (putnam-1979-b3-binary-value
             y z mul-table)))
      (and
       (equal
        (putnam-1979-b3-binary-value
         x-plus-y z add-table)
        (putnam-1979-b3-binary-value
         x y-plus-z add-table))
       (equal
        (putnam-1979-b3-binary-value
         x-times-y z mul-table)
        (putnam-1979-b3-binary-value
         x y-times-z mul-table))
       (equal
        (putnam-1979-b3-binary-value
         x y-plus-z mul-table)
        (putnam-1979-b3-binary-value
         (putnam-1979-b3-binary-value
          x y mul-table)
         (putnam-1979-b3-binary-value
          x z mul-table)
         add-table))
       (putnam-1979-b3-field-xyz-axioms-p
        (cdr zs) x y add-table mul-table)))))

(defun putnam-1979-b3-field-xy-axioms-p
    (ys carrier x add-table mul-table)
  (if (endp ys)
      t
    (let ((y (car ys)))
      (and
       (assoc-equal (list x y) add-table)
       (assoc-equal (list x y) mul-table)
       (equal
        (putnam-1979-b3-binary-value
         x y add-table)
        (putnam-1979-b3-binary-value
         y x add-table))
       (equal
        (putnam-1979-b3-binary-value
         x y mul-table)
        (putnam-1979-b3-binary-value
         y x mul-table))
       (putnam-1979-b3-field-xyz-axioms-p
        carrier x y add-table mul-table)
       (putnam-1979-b3-field-xy-axioms-p
        (cdr ys) carrier x add-table mul-table)))))

(defun putnam-1979-b3-field-x-axioms-p
    (xs carrier zero one add-table mul-table neg-table inv-table)
  (if (endp xs)
      t
    (let* ((x (car xs))
           (negative
            (putnam-1979-b3-unary-value x neg-table))
           (inverse
            (putnam-1979-b3-unary-value x inv-table)))
      (and
       (assoc-equal x neg-table)
       (assoc-equal x inv-table)
       (equal
        (putnam-1979-b3-binary-value
         x zero add-table)
        x)
       (equal
        (putnam-1979-b3-binary-value
         x negative add-table)
        zero)
       (equal
        (putnam-1979-b3-binary-value
         x one mul-table)
        x)
       (implies
        (not (equal x zero))
        (equal
         (putnam-1979-b3-binary-value
          x inverse mul-table)
         one))
       (putnam-1979-b3-field-xy-axioms-p
        carrier carrier x add-table mul-table)
       (putnam-1979-b3-field-x-axioms-p
        (cdr xs) carrier zero one add-table mul-table
        neg-table inv-table)))))

(defun putnam-1979-b3-finite-field-p
    (carrier zero one add-table mul-table neg-table inv-table)
  (and
   (putnam-1979-b3-set-list-p carrier)
   (consp carrier)
   (member-equal zero carrier)
   (member-equal one carrier)
   (not (equal zero one))
   (putnam-1979-b3-binary-table-p add-table carrier)
   (putnam-1979-b3-binary-table-p mul-table carrier)
   (putnam-1979-b3-unary-table-p neg-table carrier)
   (putnam-1979-b3-unary-table-p inv-table carrier)
   (putnam-1979-b3-field-x-axioms-p
    carrier carrier zero one add-table mul-table
    neg-table inv-table)))

(defun putnam-1979-b3-quadratic-value
    (x b constant add-table mul-table)
  (putnam-1979-b3-binary-value
   (putnam-1979-b3-binary-value
    (putnam-1979-b3-binary-value
     x x mul-table)
    (putnam-1979-b3-binary-value
     b x mul-table)
    add-table)
   constant
   add-table))

(defun putnam-1979-b3-quadratic-has-root-p
    (xs zero b constant add-table mul-table)
  (if (endp xs)
      nil
    (or
     (equal
      (putnam-1979-b3-quadratic-value
       (car xs) b constant add-table mul-table)
      zero)
     (putnam-1979-b3-quadratic-has-root-p
      (cdr xs) zero b constant add-table mul-table))))

;; A monic degree-two polynomial over a field is irreducible exactly when it
;; has no root in that field. This eliminates the source's definitionally
;; fixed polynomial parameter while preserving its irreducibility hypothesis.
(defun putnam-1979-b3-quadratic-irreducible-p
    (carrier zero b constant add-table mul-table)
  (not
   (putnam-1979-b3-quadratic-has-root-p
    carrier zero b constant add-table mul-table)))

(defun putnam-1979-b3-irreducible-shift-count
    (shifts carrier zero b c add-table mul-table)
  (if (endp shifts)
      0
    (let ((shifted-constant
           (putnam-1979-b3-binary-value
            c (car shifts) add-table)))
      (+
       (if
        (putnam-1979-b3-quadratic-irreducible-p
         carrier zero b shifted-constant add-table mul-table)
        1
        0)
       (putnam-1979-b3-irreducible-shift-count
        (cdr shifts) carrier zero b c add-table mul-table)))))

(defun putnam-1979-b3-solution (n)
  (floor (nfix (- n 1)) 2))

(defun putnambench-putnam-1979-b3-statement
    (carrier zero one add-table mul-table neg-table inv-table n b c)
  (implies
   (and
    (putnam-1979-b3-finite-field-p
     carrier zero one add-table mul-table neg-table inv-table)
    (natp n)
    (equal n (len carrier))
    (oddp n)
    (member-equal b carrier)
    (member-equal c carrier)
    (putnam-1979-b3-quadratic-irreducible-p
     carrier zero b c add-table mul-table))
   (equal
    (putnam-1979-b3-irreducible-shift-count
     carrier carrier zero b c add-table mul-table)
    (putnam-1979-b3-solution n))))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

data Fin : Nat -> Set where
  fzero : {n : Nat} -> Fin (suc n)
  fsuc  : {n : Nat} -> Fin n -> Fin (suc n)

record Bijection
  {a b : Level}
  (A : Set a)
  (B : Set b) :
  Set (a ⊔ b) where

  field
    to      : A -> B
    from    : B -> A
    from-to : (x : A) -> from (to x) == x
    to-from : (y : B) -> to (from y) == y

record HasCardinality
  {a : Level}
  {A : Set a}
  (member : A -> Set a)
  (cardinality : Nat) :
  Set a where

  field
    enumerate :
      Fin cardinality ->
      A
    enumerated-member :
      (index : Fin cardinality) ->
      member (enumerate index)
    enumeration-complete :
      (item : A) ->
      member item ->
      Exists (Fin cardinality)
        (\ index -> item == enumerate index)
    enumeration-injective :
      (left-index right-index : Fin cardinality) ->
      enumerate left-index == enumerate right-index ->
      left-index == right-index

record Field
  {a : Level}
  (F : Set a) :
  Set (lsuc a) where

  field
    zeroF oneF : F
    add multiply : F -> F -> F
    negate inverse : F -> F

    one-not-zero :
      oneF != zeroF

    add-commutative :
      (x y : F) -> add x y == add y x
    add-associative :
      (x y z : F) ->
      add (add x y) z == add x (add y z)
    add-zero :
      (x : F) -> add x zeroF == x
    add-inverse :
      (x : F) -> add x (negate x) == zeroF

    multiply-commutative :
      (x y : F) -> multiply x y == multiply y x
    multiply-associative :
      (x y z : F) ->
      multiply (multiply x y) z == multiply x (multiply y z)
    multiply-one :
      (x : F) -> multiply x oneF == x
    multiply-zero :
      (x : F) -> multiply x zeroF == zeroF
    distribute :
      (x y z : F) ->
      multiply x (add y z) ==
      add (multiply x y) (multiply x z)
    inverse-zero :
      inverse zeroF == zeroF
    multiply-inverse :
      (x : F) ->
      x != zeroF ->
      multiply x (inverse x) == oneF

open Field

one : Nat
one =
  suc zero

two : Nat
two =
  suc one

half : Nat -> Nat
half zero =
  zero
half (suc zero) =
  zero
half (suc (suc n)) =
  suc (half n)

putnam-1979-b3-solution : Nat -> Nat
putnam-1979-b3-solution n =
  half (n - one)

Odd : Nat -> Set
Odd n =
  Exists Nat
    (\ k -> n == suc (two * k))

quadraticValue :
  {a : Level} ->
  {F : Set a} ->
  Field F ->
  F ->
  F ->
  F ->
  F
quadraticValue algebra b c x =
  add algebra
    (add algebra
      (multiply algebra x x)
      (multiply algebra b x))
    c

IrreducibleMonicQuadratic :
  {a : Level} ->
  {F : Set a} ->
  Field F ->
  F ->
  F ->
  Set a
IrreducibleMonicQuadratic {F = F} algebra b c =
  (x : F) ->
  quadraticValue algebra b c x != zeroF algebra

module Putnam1979B3Statement
  {a : Level}
  {F : Set a}
  (algebra : Field F) where

  proposition : Set a
  proposition =
    (n : Nat) ->
    Bijection F (Fin n) ->
    Odd n ->
    (b c : F) ->
    IrreducibleMonicQuadratic algebra b c ->
    HasCardinality
      (\ d ->
        IrreducibleMonicQuadratic algebra b (add algebra c d))
      (putnam-1979-b3-solution n)

putnam-1979-b3 :
  {a : Level} ->
  Set (lsuc a)
putnam-1979-b3 {a} =
  (F : Set a) ->
  (algebra : Field F) ->
  Putnam1979B3Statement.proposition algebra

(*
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1979_b3:
  the number of constant shifts of an irreducible monic quadratic over a
  finite field of odd order that remain irreducible. This file contains no
  proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open arithmeticTheory pred_setTheory groupTheory ringTheory;

val putnam_1979_b3 =
  ``!(r : 'a ring) (n : num) (b c : 'a).
      let polynomials =
        {p : num -> 'a |
           (!k : num. p k IN r.carrier) /\
           FINITE {k : num | p k <> r.sum.id}};
          poly_zero = (\k : num. r.sum.id);
          poly_one =
            (\k : num. if k = 0 then r.prod.id else r.sum.id);
          poly_add =
            (\p q : num -> 'a.
               \k : num. r.sum.op (p k) (q k));
          poly_mul =
            (\p q : num -> 'a.
               \k : num.
                 ITSET
                   (\i acc. r.sum.op (r.prod.op (p i) (q (k - i))) acc)
                   (count (SUC k))
                   r.sum.id);
          poly_ring =
            (<| carrier := polynomials;
                sum :=
                  <| carrier := polynomials;
                     op := poly_add;
                     id := poly_zero |>;
                prod :=
                  <| carrier := polynomials;
                     op := poly_mul;
                     id := poly_one |> |>
             : (num -> 'a) ring);
          quadratic =
            (\k : num.
               if k = 0 then c
               else if k = 1 then b
               else if k = 2 then r.prod.id
               else r.sum.id);
          constant =
            (\d : 'a.
               \k : num. if k = 0 then d else r.sum.id)
      in
        Ring r /\
        Group (r.prod excluding r.sum.id) /\
        FINITE r.carrier /\
        CARD r.carrier = n /\
        ODD n /\
        b IN r.carrier /\
        c IN r.carrier /\
        irreducible poly_ring quadratic
        ==>
        CARD
          {d : 'a |
             d IN r.carrier /\
             irreducible
               poly_ring
               (poly_add quadratic (constant d))} =
        (n - 1) DIV 2``;

$(
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact
  putnam_1979_b3: counting constant shifts of an irreducible monic quadratic
  that remain irreducible over an odd finite field. This file contains no
  proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  f is an arbitrary field structure with finite carrier of cardinality n.
  Poly1 ` f is SetMM's univariate polynomial ring over f; var1 is its
  variable, algSc embeds field elements as constant polynomials, and Irred
  is the set of irreducible ring elements. The equality defining p is the
  source polynomial x^2 + b x + c, while the set in the conclusion consists
  exactly of those d in f for which p + d is irreducible.

  Since n is odd, ( n - 1 ) / 2 is the integer-valued solution recorded in
  the ground-truth sources. The final declaration is the single unproved $a
  corpus statement; this database contains no $p proof statement.
$)

${
  $d b c d f n p $.

  putnambench-putnam-1979-b3 $a |-
    A. f
      A. n e. NN0
        A. b e. ( Base ` f )
          A. c e. ( Base ` f )
            A. p e. ( Base ` ( Poly1 ` f ) )
              (
                (
                  (
                    f e. Field
                    /\
                    (
                      ( Base ` f ) e. Fin
                      /\
                      ( # ` ( Base ` f ) ) = n
                    )
                  )
                  /\
                  -. 2 || n
                )
                /\
                (
                  p
                  =
                  (
                    (
                      2
                      ( .g ` ( mulGrp ` ( Poly1 ` f ) ) )
                      ( var1 ` f )
                    )
                    ( +g ` ( Poly1 ` f ) )
                    (
                      ( ( algSc ` ( Poly1 ` f ) ) ` b )
                      ( .r ` ( Poly1 ` f ) )
                      ( var1 ` f )
                    )
                  )
                  ( +g ` ( Poly1 ` f ) )
                  ( ( algSc ` ( Poly1 ` f ) ) ` c )
                )
                /\
                p e. ( Irred ` ( Poly1 ` f ) )
              )
              ->
              (
                #
                `
                {
                  d e. ( Base ` f ) |
                    (
                      p
                      ( +g ` ( Poly1 ` f ) )
                      ( ( algSc ` ( Poly1 ` f ) ) ` d )
                    )
                    e.
                    ( Irred ` ( Poly1 ` f ) )
                }
              )
              =
              ( ( n - 1 ) / 2 )
  $.
$}

content:
% Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1979_b3:
% over a finite field of odd cardinality n, exactly (n - 1) / 2 constant
% shifts of a monic irreducible quadratic remain irreducible. This file
% contains no proof.

putnam_1979_b3[
  FieldElement: TYPE+,
  zero_F, one_F: FieldElement,
  add_F, multiply_F:
    [FieldElement, FieldElement -> FieldElement],
  negate_F, inverse_F: [FieldElement -> FieldElement]
]: THEORY
BEGIN
  field_set: TYPE = [FieldElement -> bool]
  field_enumeration: TYPE = [nat -> FieldElement]

  field_axioms: bool =
    zero_F /= one_F
      AND (FORALL (x, y: FieldElement):
        add_F(x, y) = add_F(y, x))
      AND (FORALL (x, y, z: FieldElement):
        add_F(add_F(x, y), z) = add_F(x, add_F(y, z)))
      AND (FORALL (x: FieldElement):
        add_F(x, zero_F) = x)
      AND (FORALL (x: FieldElement):
        add_F(x, negate_F(x)) = zero_F)
      AND (FORALL (x, y: FieldElement):
        multiply_F(x, y) = multiply_F(y, x))
      AND (FORALL (x, y, z: FieldElement):
        multiply_F(multiply_F(x, y), z)
          = multiply_F(x, multiply_F(y, z)))
      AND (FORALL (x: FieldElement):
        multiply_F(x, one_F) = x)
      AND (FORALL (x, y, z: FieldElement):
        multiply_F(x, add_F(y, z))
          = add_F(multiply_F(x, y), multiply_F(x, z)))
      AND (FORALL (x: FieldElement):
        x /= zero_F IMPLIES
          multiply_F(x, inverse_F(x)) = one_F)

  injective_below(
      enumeration: field_enumeration,
      bound: nat): bool =
    FORALL (i, j: nat):
      i < bound AND j < bound
        AND enumeration(i) = enumeration(j)
      IMPLIES i = j

  enumerates_exactly(
      enumeration: field_enumeration,
      set_value: field_set,
      bound: nat): bool =
    FORALL (x: FieldElement):
      set_value(x)
        IFF
          EXISTS (i: nat):
            i < bound AND enumeration(i) = x

  has_cardinality(
      set_value: field_set,
      cardinality: nat): bool =
    EXISTS (enumeration: field_enumeration):
      injective_below(enumeration, cardinality)
        AND enumerates_exactly(
          enumeration, set_value, cardinality)

  whole_field: field_set =
    LAMBDA (x: FieldElement): TRUE

  quadratic_value(
      b, c, x: FieldElement): FieldElement =
    add_F(
      add_F(
        multiply_F(x, x),
        multiply_F(b, x)),
      c)

  % A monic quadratic over a field is irreducible exactly when it has no
  % root in that field.
  irreducible_monic_quadratic(
      b, c: FieldElement): bool =
    FORALL (x: FieldElement):
      quadratic_value(b, c, x) /= zero_F

  irreducible_shifts(
      b, c: FieldElement): field_set =
    LAMBDA (d: FieldElement):
      irreducible_monic_quadratic(b, add_F(c, d))

  putnam_1979_b3: bool =
    field_axioms IMPLIES
      (FORALL (n: nat), (b, c: FieldElement):
        (has_cardinality(whole_field, n)
          AND mod(n, 2) = 1
          AND irreducible_monic_quadratic(b, c))
        IMPLIES
          has_cardinality(
            irreducible_shifts(b, c),
            ndiv(n, 2)))
END putnam_1979_b3

;; Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1979_b6:
;; the real part of the principal square root of a finite sum of complex
;; squares is bounded by the sum of the absolute real parts. This file
;; contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

;; A length-n list is definitionally equivalent to a function on Fin n, with
;; each complex number represented by its real and imaginary coordinates.
;; Standard ACL2 evaluates these coordinates as exact rationals. This
;; presentation is bidirectionally equivalent to validity over arbitrary
;; complex numbers: rational families are complex families, while failure of
;; either non-strict inequality in the square-root-free conclusion below is a
;; strict, continuously varying condition, so every real-coordinate
;; counterexample has a nearby rational-coordinate counterexample.
;;
;; Write the sum of the squares as A+iB and put
;;
;;   X = sum_i |Re(z_i)|,       D = 2*X^2-A.
;;
;; For the principal complex square root,
;;
;;   |Re(sqrt(A+iB))|^2 = (sqrt(A^2+B^2)+A)/2.
;;
;; Since X is nonnegative, the source inequality is therefore equivalent in
;; both directions to D >= 0 and A^2+B^2 <= D^2. The predicate below uses
;; exactly these radical-free conditions.

(defun putnam-1979-b6-complex-rational-p (z)
  (and (true-listp z)
       (equal (len z) 2)
       (rationalp (nth 0 z))
       (rationalp (nth 1 z))))

(defun putnam-1979-b6-complex-rational-list-p (values)
  (if (consp values)
      (and (putnam-1979-b6-complex-rational-p (car values))
           (putnam-1979-b6-complex-rational-list-p (cdr values)))
    (equal values nil)))

(defun putnam-1979-b6-sum-square-real-parts (values)
  (if (consp values)
      (let ((x (nth 0 (car values)))
            (y (nth 1 (car values))))
        (+ (- (* x x) (* y y))
           (putnam-1979-b6-sum-square-real-parts (cdr values))))
    0))

(defun putnam-1979-b6-sum-square-imaginary-parts (values)
  (if (consp values)
      (let ((x (nth 0 (car values)))
            (y (nth 1 (car values))))
        (+ (* 2 x y)
           (putnam-1979-b6-sum-square-imaginary-parts (cdr values))))
    0))

(defun putnam-1979-b6-sum-absolute-real-parts (values)
  (if (consp values)
      (+ (abs (nth 0 (car values)))
         (putnam-1979-b6-sum-absolute-real-parts (cdr values)))
    0))

(defun putnambench-putnam-1979-b6-statement (n values)
  (implies
   (and (natp n)
        (true-listp values)
        (equal (len values) n)
        (putnam-1979-b6-complex-rational-list-p values))
   (let* ((a (putnam-1979-b6-sum-square-real-parts values))
          (b (putnam-1979-b6-sum-square-imaginary-parts values))
          (x (putnam-1979-b6-sum-absolute-real-parts values))
          (d (- (* 2 x x) a)))
     (and (<= 0 d)
          (<= (+ (* a a) (* b b))
              (* d d))))))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q
