content:
-- Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1979_b6:
-- the real-part bound for the principal square root of a finite sum of
-- squares of complex numbers. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; _*_)

infix 4 _!=_
infixr 3 _and_
infixr 2 _or_

data Bottom : Set where

Not : Set -> Set
Not A =
  A -> Bottom

_!=_ : {A : Set} -> A -> A -> Set
x != y =
  Not (x == y)

record _and_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data _or_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  left  : A -> A or B
  right : B -> A or B

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

record CompleteOrderedRealField (R : Set) : Set1 where
  field
    zeroR oneR : R
    add multiply : R -> R -> R
    negate inverse : R -> R
    lessOrEqual : R -> R -> Set
    fromNat : Nat -> R

    one-not-zero :
      oneR != zeroR

    add-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> add x y == add y x
    add-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      add (add x y) z == add x (add y z)
    add-zero :
      (x : R) -> add x zeroR == x
    add-inverse :
      (x : R) -> add x (negate x) == zeroR

    multiply-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> multiply x y == multiply y x
    multiply-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply (multiply x y) z ==
      multiply x (multiply y z)
    multiply-one :
      (x : R) -> multiply x oneR == x
    multiply-zero :
      (x : R) -> multiply x zeroR == zeroR
    distribute :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply x (add y z) ==
      add (multiply x y) (multiply x z)
    inverse-zero :
      inverse zeroR == zeroR
    multiply-inverse :
      (x : R) ->
      x != zeroR ->
      multiply x (inverse x) == oneR

    order-reflexive :
      (x : R) -> lessOrEqual x x
    order-transitive :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y z ->
      lessOrEqual x z
    order-antisymmetric :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y x ->
      x == y
    order-total :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y or lessOrEqual y x
    add-order :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual (add z x) (add z y)
    multiply-nonnegative :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR x ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR y ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR (multiply x y)
    zero-less-than-one :
      lessOrEqual zeroR oneR and zeroR != oneR

    fromNat-zero :
      fromNat zero == zeroR
    fromNat-successor :
      (n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (suc n) == add (fromNat n) oneR
    fromNat-addition :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m + n) == add (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-multiplication :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m * n) == multiply (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-injective :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat m == fromNat n ->
      m == n

    archimedean :
      (x : R) ->
      Exists Nat (\ n -> lessOrEqual x (fromNat n))
    least-upper-bound :
      (P : R -> Set) ->
      Exists R P ->
      Exists R
        (\ upper ->
          (x : R) ->
          P x ->
          lessOrEqual x upper) ->
      Exists R
        (\ supremum ->
          ((x : R) ->
            P x ->
            lessOrEqual x supremum)
          and
          ((upper : R) ->
            ((x : R) ->
              P x ->
              lessOrEqual x upper) ->
            lessOrEqual supremum upper))

open CompleteOrderedRealField

maximum :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
maximum reals x y with order-total reals x y
... | left _ = y
... | right _ = x

absoluteValue :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R
absoluteValue reals x =
  maximum reals x (negate reals x)

sumFirst :
  {A : Set} ->
  A ->
  (A -> A -> A) ->
  Nat ->
  (Nat -> A) ->
  A
sumFirst identity combine zero term =
  identity
sumFirst identity combine (suc n) term =
  combine
    (sumFirst identity combine n term)
    (term n)

record Complex (R : Set) : Set where
  constructor complex
  field
    realPart      : R
    imaginaryPart : R

open Complex

complexZero :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Complex R
complexZero reals =
  complex (zeroR reals) (zeroR reals)

complexAdd :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Complex R ->
  Complex R ->
  Complex R
complexAdd reals z w =
  complex
    (add reals (realPart z) (realPart w))
    (add reals (imaginaryPart z) (imaginaryPart w))

complexMultiply :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Complex R ->
  Complex R ->
  Complex R
complexMultiply reals z w =
  complex
    (add reals
      (multiply reals (realPart z) (realPart w))
      (negate reals
        (multiply reals (imaginaryPart z) (imaginaryPart w))))
    (add reals
      (multiply reals (realPart z) (imaginaryPart w))
      (multiply reals (imaginaryPart z) (realPart w)))

complexSquare :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Complex R ->
  Complex R
complexSquare reals z =
  complexMultiply reals z z

record StandardComplexSquareRoot
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) :
  Set1 where

  field
    principalSquareRoot : Complex R -> Complex R

    principal-square-root-square :
      (z : Complex R) ->
      complexSquare reals (principalSquareRoot z) == z

    principal-square-root-real-nonnegative :
      (z : Complex R) ->
      lessOrEqual reals
        (zeroR reals)
        (realPart (principalSquareRoot z))

    principal-square-root-branch-tie :
      (z : Complex R) ->
      realPart (principalSquareRoot z) == zeroR reals ->
      lessOrEqual reals
        (zeroR reals)
        (imaginaryPart (principalSquareRoot z))

open StandardComplexSquareRoot

module Putnam1979B6Statement
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R)
  (roots : StandardComplexSquareRoot reals) where

  sumOfSquares :
    Nat ->
    (Nat -> Complex R) ->
    Complex R
  sumOfSquares n z =
    sumFirst
      (complexZero reals)
      (complexAdd reals)
      n
      (\ i -> complexSquare reals (z i))

  sumOfAbsoluteRealParts :
    Nat ->
    (Nat -> Complex R) ->
    R
  sumOfAbsoluteRealParts n z =
    sumFirst
      (zeroR reals)
      (add reals)
      n
      (\ i -> absoluteValue reals (realPart (z i)))

  proposition : Set
  proposition =
    (n : Nat) ->
    (z : Nat -> Complex R) ->
    lessOrEqual reals
      (absoluteValue reals
        (realPart
          (principalSquareRoot roots (sumOfSquares n z))))
      (sumOfAbsoluteRealParts n z)

putnam-1979-b6 : Set1
putnam-1979-b6 =
  (R : Set) ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) ->
  (roots : StandardComplexSquareRoot reals) ->
  Putnam1979B6Statement.proposition reals roots

title: putnam_1979_b6
content:
% Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1979_b6:
% the absolute real part of the principal square root of a finite sum of
% complex squares is bounded by the sum of the absolute real parts.
% This file contains no proof.

putnam_1979_b6: THEORY
BEGIN
  complex: TYPE = [# real_part: real, imag_part: real #]
  complex_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> complex]

  complex_zero: complex =
    (# real_part := 0, imag_part := 0 #)

  complex_add(z, w: complex): complex =
    (# real_part := real_part(z) + real_part(w),
       imag_part := imag_part(z) + imag_part(w) #)

  complex_mul(z, w: complex): complex =
    (# real_part := real_part(z) * real_part(w)
                       - imag_part(z) * imag_part(w),
       imag_part := real_part(z) * imag_part(w)
                       + imag_part(z) * real_part(w) #)

  principal_square_root_value(value, root: complex): bool =
    complex_mul(root, root) = value
      AND real_part(root) >= 0
      AND (real_part(root) > 0 OR imag_part(root) >= 0)

  principal_square_root(value: complex): complex =
    epsilon(
      LAMBDA (root: complex):
        principal_square_root_value(value, root))

  square_sum(
      values: complex_sequence,
      count: nat): RECURSIVE complex =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      complex_zero
    ELSE
      complex_add(
        square_sum(values, count - 1),
        complex_mul(values(count - 1), values(count - 1)))
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  absolute_real_part_sum(
      values: complex_sequence,
      count: nat): RECURSIVE real =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      absolute_real_part_sum(values, count - 1)
        + abs(real_part(values(count - 1)))
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  putnam_1979_b6: bool =
    FORALL (n: nat), (z: complex_sequence):
      abs(real_part(principal_square_root(square_sum(z, n))))
        <= absolute_real_part_sum(z, n)
END putnam_1979_b6

import Mathlib

abbrev putnam_1980_a2_solution : ℕ → ℕ → ℕ := sorry
-- (fun r s : ℕ => (1 + 4 * r + 6 * r ^ 2) * (1 + 4 * s + 6 * s ^ 2))
/--
Let $r$ and $s$ be positive integers. Derive a formula for the number of ordered quadruples $(a,b,c,d)$ of positive integers such that $3^r \cdot 7^s=\text{lcm}[a,b,c]=\text{lcm}[a,b,d]=\text{lcm}[a,c,d]=\text{lcm}[b,c,d]$. The answer should be a function of $r$ and $s$. (Note that $\text{lcm}[x,y,z]$ denotes the least common multiple of $x,y,z$.)
-/
theorem putnam_1980_a2
    (r s : ℕ)
    (abcdlcm : ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → Prop)
    (rspos : r > 0 ∧ s > 0)
    (habcdlcm : ∀ a b c d : ℕ, abcdlcm a b c d ↔
      (a > 0 ∧ b > 0 ∧ c > 0 ∧ d > 0 ∧
      (3 ^ r * 7 ^ s = Nat.lcm (Nat.lcm a b) c) ∧
      (3 ^ r * 7 ^ s = Nat.lcm (Nat.lcm a b) d) ∧
      (3 ^ r * 7 ^ s = Nat.lcm (Nat.lcm a c) d) ∧
      (3 ^ r * 7 ^ s = Nat.lcm (Nat.lcm b c) d))) :
    {(a, b, c, d) : ℕ × ℕ × ℕ × ℕ | abcdlcm a b c d}.encard = putnam_1980_a2_solution r s :=
  sorry

(defun putnam-1980-a2-gcd-search (left right candidate)

       left right (- candidate 1)))))

(defun putnam-1980-a2-gcd (left right)

   left right (if (< left right) left right)))

(defun putnam-1980-a2-lcm (left right)

     (putnam-1980-a2-gcd left right)))

(defun putnam-1980-a2-triple-lcm (x y z)
  (putnam-1980-a2-lcm
   (putnam-1980-a2-lcm x y)
   z))

(defun putnam-1980-a2-admissible-p (common-lcm a b c d)
  (and
   (natp common-lcm)
   (< 0 common-lcm)
   (natp a)
   (< 0 a)
   (natp b)
   (< 0 b)
   (natp c)
   (< 0 c)
   (natp d)
   (< 0 d)
   (equal common-lcm
          (putnam-1980-a2-triple-lcm a b c))
   (equal common-lcm
          (putnam-1980-a2-triple-lcm a b d))
   (equal common-lcm
          (putnam-1980-a2-triple-lcm a c d))
   (equal common-lcm
          (putnam-1980-a2-triple-lcm b c d))))

-- Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1980_a2:
-- the number of ordered quadruples of positive natural numbers for which every
-- triple has least common multiple 3^r * 7^s. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; _*_)

infix 4 _<=N_ _<N_ _divides_
infixr 8 _^_

data _<=N_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set where
  zero<= : {n : Nat} -> zero <=N n
  suc<=suc : {m n : Nat} -> m <=N n -> suc m <=N suc n

_<N_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set
m <N n = suc m <=N n

_^_ : Nat -> Nat -> Nat
base ^ zero = 1
base ^ suc exponent = base * (base ^ exponent)

record _divides_ (divisor dividend : Nat) : Set where
  field
    quotient : Nat
    equation : divisor * quotient == dividend

record IsTripleLCM (a b c l : Nat) : Set where
  field
    first-divides : a divides l
    second-divides : b divides l
    third-divides : c divides l
    least :
      (common : Nat) ->
      a divides common ->
      b divides common ->
      c divides common ->
      l divides common

data Fin : Nat -> Set where
  fzero : {n : Nat} -> Fin (suc n)
  fsuc : {n : Nat} -> Fin n -> Fin (suc n)

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value : A
    property : P value

record HasCardinality
  {A : Set}
  (P : A -> Set)
  (cardinality : Nat) :
  Set where

  field
    enumerate :
      Fin cardinality ->
      A
    enumerated-member :
      (index : Fin cardinality) ->
      P (enumerate index)
    enumeration-complete :
      (item : A) ->
      P item ->
      Exists (Fin cardinality)
        (\ index -> item == enumerate index)
    enumeration-injective :
      (left-index right-index : Fin cardinality) ->
      enumerate left-index == enumerate right-index ->
      left-index == right-index

record Quadruple : Set where
  constructor quadruple
  field
    first : Nat
    second : Nat
    third : Nat
    fourth : Nat

open Quadruple

target : Nat -> Nat -> Nat
target r s =
  (3 ^ r) * (7 ^ s)

record QualifyingQuadruple (r s : Nat) (q : Quadruple) : Set where
  field
    first-positive : zero <N first q
    second-positive : zero <N second q
    third-positive : zero <N third q
    fourth-positive : zero <N fourth q
    first-second-third-lcm :
      IsTripleLCM (first q) (second q) (third q) (target r s)
    first-second-fourth-lcm :
      IsTripleLCM (first q) (second q) (fourth q) (target r s)
    first-third-fourth-lcm :
      IsTripleLCM (first q) (third q) (fourth q) (target r s)
    second-third-fourth-lcm :
      IsTripleLCM (second q) (third q) (fourth q) (target r s)

putnam-1980-a2-solution : Nat -> Nat -> Nat
putnam-1980-a2-solution r s =
  (1 + 4 * r + 6 * (r ^ 2)) *
  (1 + 4 * s + 6 * (s ^ 2))

putnam-1980-a2 : Set
putnam-1980-a2 =
  (r s : Nat) ->
  zero <N r ->
  zero <N s ->
  HasCardinality
    (QualifyingQuadruple r s)
    (putnam-1980-a2-solution r s)

title: putnam_1980_a2
content:
% Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench artifact putnam_1980_a2:
% the number of ordered positive-integer quadruples for which every triple
% has least common multiple 3^r * 7^s has the stated formula. This file
% contains no proof.

putnam_1980_a2: THEORY
BEGIN
  quadruple: TYPE =
    [# first: nat, second: nat, third: nat, fourth: nat #]

  IMPORTING finite_sets[quadruple]

  nat_divides(divisor, value: nat): bool =
    EXISTS (quotient: nat):
      value = divisor * quotient

  is_nat_lcm(lcm_value, left, right: nat): bool =
    nat_divides(left, lcm_value)
      AND nat_divides(right, lcm_value)
      AND (FORALL (common_multiple: nat):
        nat_divides(left, common_multiple)
          AND nat_divides(right, common_multiple)
          IMPLIES nat_divides(lcm_value, common_multiple))

  triple_lcm_is(target, x, y, z: nat): bool =
    EXISTS (xy_lcm: nat):
      is_nat_lcm(xy_lcm, x, y)
        AND is_nat_lcm(target, xy_lcm, z)

  common_lcm(r, s: nat): nat =
    3 ^ r * 7 ^ s

  qualifying(q: quadruple, r, s: nat): bool =
    first(q) > 0
      AND second(q) > 0
      AND third(q) > 0
      AND fourth(q) > 0
      AND triple_lcm_is(
        common_lcm(r, s), first(q), second(q), third(q))
      AND triple_lcm_is(
        common_lcm(r, s), first(q), second(q), fourth(q))
      AND triple_lcm_is(
        common_lcm(r, s), first(q), third(q), fourth(q))
      AND triple_lcm_is(
        common_lcm(r, s), second(q), third(q), fourth(q))

  putnam_1980_a2_solution(r, s: nat): nat =
    (1 + 4 * r + 6 * r ^ 2) * (1 + 4 * s + 6 * s ^ 2)

  putnam_1980_a2: bool =
    FORALL (r, s: nat):
      r > 0 AND s > 0 IMPLIES
        EXISTS (solutions: finite_set[quadruple]):
          card(solutions) = putnam_1980_a2_solution(r, s)
            AND (FORALL (q: quadruple):
              solutions(q) IFF qualifying(q, r, s))
END putnam_1980_a2

putnam_1980_a3
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1980_a3:
;; the integral from 0 to pi/2 of 1/(1+tan(x)^sqrt(2)) equals pi/4.
;; This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

;; After x=(pi/2)u, the source equality is equivalent (because pi>0) to
;;
;;   integral_0^1 1/(1+tan(pi*u/2)^sqrt(2)) du = 1/2.
;;
;; The integrand on (0,1) extends continuously to the closed interval with
;; endpoint values 1 and 0, so its Lebesgue and Riemann integrals agree.
;; The functions below give an exact-rational diagonal approximation to that
;; normalized integral, rather than replacing the real integral by a fixed
;; finite quadrature.

(defun putnam-1980-a3-factorial (n)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix n)))
  (if (zp n)
      1
    (* n
       (putnam-1980-a3-factorial (- n 1)))))

;; With an even number of Leibniz summands this is a rational lower
;; approximation to pi, converging to pi as PRECISION tends to infinity.
(defun putnam-1980-a3-leibniz-prefix (terms)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix terms)))
  (if (zp terms)
      0
    (let* ((index (- terms 1))
           (sign (if (equal (mod index 2) 0) 1 -1)))
      (+ (putnam-1980-a3-leibniz-prefix index)
         (/ sign (+ (* 2 index) 1))))))

(defun putnam-1980-a3-pi-lower (precision)
  (* 4
     (putnam-1980-a3-leibniz-prefix
      (* 2 (nfix precision)))))

;; Rational bisection lower approximation to the nonnegative square root of 2.
(defun putnam-1980-a3-sqrt-two-lower-aux
    (steps lower upper)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix steps)))
  (if (zp steps)
      lower
    (let ((midpoint (/ (+ lower upper) 2)))
      (if (<= (* midpoint midpoint) 2)
          (putnam-1980-a3-sqrt-two-lower-aux
           (- steps 1) midpoint upper)
        (putnam-1980-a3-sqrt-two-lower-aux
         (- steps 1) lower midpoint)))))

(defun putnam-1980-a3-sqrt-two-lower (steps)
  (putnam-1980-a3-sqrt-two-lower-aux
   steps 1 2))

;; Maclaurin prefixes for sine and cosine. All calls below use arguments in
;; [0,pi/2) and an odd number of summands.
(defun putnam-1980-a3-sine-prefix (x terms)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix terms)))
  (if (zp terms)
      0
    (let* ((index (- terms 1))
           (degree (+ (* 2 index) 1))
           (sign (if (equal (mod index 2) 0) 1 -1)))
      (+ (putnam-1980-a3-sine-prefix x index)
         (/ (* sign (expt x degree))
            (putnam-1980-a3-factorial degree))))))

(defun putnam-1980-a3-cosine-prefix (x terms)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix terms)))
  (if (zp terms)
      0
    (let* ((index (- terms 1))
           (degree (* 2 index))
           (sign (if (equal (mod index 2) 0) 1 -1)))
      (+ (putnam-1980-a3-cosine-prefix x index)
         (/ (* sign (expt x degree))
            (putnam-1980-a3-factorial degree))))))

(defun putnam-1980-a3-tangent-prefix
    (angle terms)
  (/ (putnam-1980-a3-sine-prefix angle terms)
     (putnam-1980-a3-cosine-prefix angle terms)))

;; For positive rational X, z=(X-1)/(X+1) has |z|<1 and
;;
;;   log(X) = 2*sum_(k>=0) z^(2k+1)/(2k+1).
(defun putnam-1980-a3-log-prefix-aux (z terms)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix terms)))
  (if (zp terms)
      0
    (let* ((index (- terms 1))
           (degree (+ (* 2 index) 1)))
      (+ (putnam-1980-a3-log-prefix-aux z index)
         (/ (* 2 (expt z degree))
            degree)))))

(defun putnam-1980-a3-log-prefix (x terms)
  (if (and (rationalp x)
           (< 0 x))
      (putnam-1980-a3-log-prefix-aux
       (/ (- x 1) (+ x 1))
       terms)
    0))

;; Maclaurin prefix for exp. The diagonal below uses an odd number of
;; summands, hence an even highest degree; this prefix is positive even for
;; negative arguments.
(defun putnam-1980-a3-exp-prefix (x terms)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix terms)))
  (if (zp terms)
      0
    (let ((degree (- terms 1)))
      (+ (putnam-1980-a3-exp-prefix x degree)
         (/ (expt x degree)
            (putnam-1980-a3-factorial degree))))))

(defun putnam-1980-a3-fourth-power (n)
  (* n n n n))

(defun putnam-1980-a3-diagonal-terms (subdivisions)
  (+ 1
     (* 2
        (putnam-1980-a3-fourth-power
         subdivisions))))

(defun putnam-1980-a3-grid-integrand-prefix
    (index subdivisions)
  (if (and (posp subdivisions)
           (natp index)
           (< index subdivisions))
      (let* ((precision
              (putnam-1980-a3-fourth-power subdivisions))
             (series-terms
              (putnam-1980-a3-diagonal-terms subdivisions))
             (angle
              (* (/ index (* 2 subdivisions))
                 (putnam-1980-a3-pi-lower precision))))
        (if (zp index)
            1
          (let* ((tangent
                  (putnam-1980-a3-tangent-prefix
                   angle series-terms))
                 (log-tangent
                  (putnam-1980-a3-log-prefix
                   tangent precision))
                 (power
                  (putnam-1980-a3-exp-prefix
                   (* (putnam-1980-a3-sqrt-two-lower
                       subdivisions)
                      log-tangent)
                   series-terms)))
            (/ 1 (+ 1 power)))))
    0))

(defun putnam-1980-a3-riemann-sum-aux
    (index subdivisions)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix index)))
  (if (zp index)
      0
    (+ (putnam-1980-a3-grid-integrand-prefix
        index subdivisions)
       (putnam-1980-a3-riemann-sum-aux
        (- index 1) subdivisions))))

(defun putnam-1980-a3-riemann-sum (subdivisions)
  (if (posp subdivisions)
      (/ (putnam-1980-a3-riemann-sum-aux
          subdivisions subdivisions)
         subdivisions)
    0))

;; The normalized integrand is decreasing from 1 to 0, so its right Riemann
;; sums converge to its integral. On the selected diagonal, the rational
;; approximants to pi, sqrt(2), tan, log, and exp converge to the corresponding
;; real values as the subdivision count grows. The source integral identity
;; is stated through the plain epsilon definition of that joint limit. The
;; cutoff is existential; no numerical convergence rate is part of the
;; proposition.
(defun-sk putnam-1980-a3-tail-p (epsilon cutoff)
  (forall (subdivisions)
    (implies
     (and
      (natp subdivisions)
      (<= cutoff subdivisions))
     (< (abs
         (- (putnam-1980-a3-riemann-sum subdivisions)
            1/2))
        epsilon))))

(defun-sk putnam-1980-a3-cutoff-exists-p (epsilon)
  (exists (cutoff)
    (and
     (natp cutoff)
     (< 0 cutoff)
     (putnam-1980-a3-tail-p epsilon cutoff))))

(defun putnambench-putnam-1980-a3-statement
    (epsilon)
  (implies
   (and (rationalp epsilon)
        (< 0 epsilon))
   (putnam-1980-a3-cutoff-exists-p epsilon)))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

title: putnam_1980_a3
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1980_a3:
-- the integral over (0, pi / 2) of 1 / (1 + tan(x)^(sqrt 2)) equals pi / 4.
-- This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; _*_)

infix 4 _!=_ _<=N_
infixr 3 _and_
infixr 2 _or_

data Bottom : Set where

Not : Set -> Set
Not A =
  A -> Bottom

_!=_ : {A : Set} -> A -> A -> Set
x != y =
  Not (x == y)

record _and_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data _or_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  left  : A -> A or B
  right : B -> A or B

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

data _<=N_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set where
  zero<=   : {n : Nat} -> zero <=N n
  suc<=suc : {m n : Nat} -> m <=N n -> suc m <=N suc n

record CompleteOrderedRealField (R : Set) : Set1 where
  field
    zeroR oneR : R
    add multiply : R -> R -> R
    negate inverse : R -> R
    lessOrEqual : R -> R -> Set
    fromNat : Nat -> R

    one-not-zero :
      oneR != zeroR

    add-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> add x y == add y x
    add-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      add (add x y) z == add x (add y z)
    add-zero :
      (x : R) -> add x zeroR == x
    add-inverse :
      (x : R) -> add x (negate x) == zeroR

    multiply-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> multiply x y == multiply y x
    multiply-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply (multiply x y) z ==
      multiply x (multiply y z)
    multiply-one :
      (x : R) -> multiply x oneR == x
    multiply-zero :
      (x : R) -> multiply x zeroR == zeroR
    distribute :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply x (add y z) ==
      add (multiply x y) (multiply x z)
    inverse-zero :
      inverse zeroR == zeroR
    multiply-inverse :
      (x : R) ->
      x != zeroR ->
      multiply x (inverse x) == oneR

    order-reflexive :
      (x : R) -> lessOrEqual x x
    order-transitive :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y z ->
      lessOrEqual x z
    order-antisymmetric :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y x ->
      x == y
    order-total :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y or lessOrEqual y x
    add-order :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual (add z x) (add z y)
    multiply-nonnegative :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR x ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR y ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR (multiply x y)
    zero-less-than-one :
      lessOrEqual zeroR oneR and zeroR != oneR

    fromNat-zero :
      fromNat zero == zeroR
    fromNat-successor :
      (n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (suc n) == add (fromNat n) oneR
    fromNat-addition :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m + n) == add (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-multiplication :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m * n) == multiply (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-injective :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat m == fromNat n ->
      m == n

    archimedean :
      (x : R) ->
      Exists Nat (\ n -> lessOrEqual x (fromNat n))
    least-upper-bound :
      (P : R -> Set) ->
      Exists R P ->
      Exists R
        (\ upper ->
          (x : R) ->
          P x ->
          lessOrEqual x upper) ->
      Exists R
        (\ supremum ->
          ((x : R) ->
            P x ->
            lessOrEqual x supremum)
          and
          ((upper : R) ->
            ((x : R) ->
              P x ->
              lessOrEqual x upper) ->
            lessOrEqual supremum upper))

open CompleteOrderedRealField

oneN : Nat
oneN =
  suc zero

twoN : Nat
twoN =
  suc oneN

fourN : Nat
fourN =
  twoN + twoN

subtract :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
subtract reals x y =
  add reals x (negate reals y)

divide :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
divide reals x y =
  multiply reals x (inverse reals y)

StrictLess :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
StrictLess reals x y =
  lessOrEqual reals x y and x != y

CloseTo :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
CloseTo reals center radius x =
  StrictLess reals
    (subtract reals center radius)
    x
  and
  StrictLess reals
    x
    (add reals center radius)

naturalPower :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  Nat ->
  R
naturalPower reals x zero =
  oneR reals
naturalPower reals x (suc n) =
  multiply reals
    (naturalPower reals x n)
    x

factorial : Nat -> Nat
factorial zero =
  oneN
factorial (suc n) =
  suc n * factorial n

sumFirst :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Nat ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  R
sumFirst reals zero term =
  zeroR reals
sumFirst reals (suc n) term =
  add reals
    (sumFirst reals n term)
    (term n)

ConvergesTo :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  R ->
  Set
ConvergesTo {R} reals sequence limit =
  (epsilon : R) ->
  StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) epsilon ->
  Exists Nat
    (\ cutoff ->
      (n : Nat) ->
      cutoff <=N n ->
      CloseTo reals limit epsilon (sequence n))

SeriesHasSum :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  R ->
  Set
SeriesHasSum reals terms limit =
  ConvergesTo reals
    (\ n -> sumFirst reals n terms)
    limit

alternatingPower :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Nat ->
  R
alternatingPower reals n =
  naturalPower reals
    (negate reals (oneR reals))
    n

exponentialTerm :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  Nat ->
  R
exponentialTerm reals x n =
  divide reals
    (naturalPower reals x n)
    (fromNat reals (factorial n))

sineTerm :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  Nat ->
  R
sineTerm reals x n =
  divide reals
    (multiply reals
      (alternatingPower reals n)
      (naturalPower reals x (suc (twoN * n))))
    (fromNat reals (factorial (suc (twoN * n))))

cosineTerm :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  Nat ->
  R
cosineTerm reals x n =
  divide reals
    (multiply reals
      (alternatingPower reals n)
      (naturalPower reals x (twoN * n)))
    (fromNat reals (factorial (twoN * n)))

leibnizTerm :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Nat ->
  R
leibnizTerm reals n =
  divide reals
    (alternatingPower reals n)
    (fromNat reals (suc (twoN * n)))

ExponentialValue :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
ExponentialValue reals x value =
  SeriesHasSum reals
    (exponentialTerm reals x)
    value

record PiValue
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R)
  (value : R) : Set where
  field
    positive :
      StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) value
    leibniz-series :
      SeriesHasSum reals
        (leibnizTerm reals)
        (divide reals value (fromNat reals fourN))

record StandardRealAnalysis
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) : Set1 where
  field
    exponential logarithm : R -> R
    sine cosine squareRoot : R -> R
    pi : R

    exponential-series :
      (x : R) ->
      ExponentialValue reals x (exponential x)
    exponential-positive :
      (x : R) ->
      StrictLess reals
        (zeroR reals)
        (exponential x)
    exponential-injective :
      (x y : R) ->
      exponential x == exponential y ->
      x == y
    exponential-logarithm :
      (x : R) ->
      StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) x ->
      exponential (logarithm x) == x

    sine-series :
      (x : R) ->
      SeriesHasSum reals
        (sineTerm reals x)
        (sine x)
    cosine-series :
      (x : R) ->
      SeriesHasSum reals
        (cosineTerm reals x)
        (cosine x)

    square-root-nonnegative :
      (x : R) ->
      lessOrEqual reals (zeroR reals) x ->
      lessOrEqual reals (zeroR reals) (squareRoot x)
    square-root-square :
      (x : R) ->
      lessOrEqual reals (zeroR reals) x ->
      multiply reals (squareRoot x) (squareRoot x) == x

    pi-value :
      PiValue reals pi

open StandardRealAnalysis

realPower :
  {R : Set} ->
  {reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R} ->
  StandardRealAnalysis reals ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
realPower {reals = reals} analysis base exponent =
  exponential analysis
    (multiply reals
      exponent
      (logarithm analysis base))

tangent :
  {R : Set} ->
  {reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R} ->
  StandardRealAnalysis reals ->
  R ->
  R
tangent {reals = reals} analysis x =
  divide reals
    (sine analysis x)
    (cosine analysis x)

midpointRiemannSum :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  (R -> R) ->
  Nat ->
  R
midpointRiemannSum reals lower upper function pieces =
  let
    step =
      divide reals
        (subtract reals upper lower)
        (fromNat reals pieces)
    halfStep =
      divide reals
        step
        (fromNat reals twoN)
  in
  sumFirst reals pieces
    (\ i ->
      multiply reals
        (function
          (add reals lower
            (add reals
              (multiply reals
                (fromNat reals i)
                step)
              halfStep)))
        step)

OpenIntervalIntegralValue :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  (R -> R) ->
  R ->
  Set
OpenIntervalIntegralValue reals lower upper function value =
  ConvergesTo reals
    (\ n ->
      midpointRiemannSum reals
        lower
        upper
        function
        (suc n))
    value

module Putnam1980A3Statement
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R)
  (analysis : StandardRealAnalysis reals) where

  halfPi : R
  halfPi =
    divide reals
      (pi analysis)
      (fromNat reals twoN)

  squareRootTwo : R
  squareRootTwo =
    squareRoot analysis
      (fromNat reals twoN)

  integrand : R -> R
  integrand x =
    divide reals
      (oneR reals)
      (add reals
        (oneR reals)
        (realPower analysis
          (tangent analysis x)
          squareRootTwo))

  solution : R
  solution =
    divide reals
      (pi analysis)
      (fromNat reals fourN)

  proposition : Set
  proposition =
    OpenIntervalIntegralValue reals
      (zeroR reals)
      halfPi
      integrand
      solution

putnam-1980-a3 : Set1
putnam-1980-a3 =
  (R : Set) ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) ->
  (analysis : StandardRealAnalysis reals) ->
  Putnam1980A3Statement.proposition reals analysis

  pi / 2 as pi / 4. This file contains no proof.

  ``lebesgue$integral

$(
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact
  putnam_1980_a3: evaluation of the real integral of
  1 / (1 + tan(x)^sqrt(2)) from zero to pi/2 as pi/4. This file contains
  no proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  The interval ( 0 (,) ( _pi / 2 ) ) is the open real interval used
  explicitly by the Lean and Rocq sources. It gives the same Lebesgue
  integral as the endpoint-inclusive interval in the Isabelle source.

  On this interval tan(x) is a positive real number. Therefore set.mm's
  complex-power operation ^c is real-valued here and equals
  exp(sqrt(2) * log(tan(x))), exactly the real-power encoding shared by the
  sources. The right side is the explicit solution from the Rocq source and
  the solution annotations in the Lean and Isabelle sources.

  The final declaration is the single unproved $a corpus statement; this
  database contains no $p proof statement.
$)

putnambench-putnam-1980-a3 $a |- (
  S. ( 0 (,) ( _pi / 2 ) )
    (
      1
      /
      (
        1
        +
        (
          ( tan ` x )
          ^c
          ( sqrt ` 2 )
        )
      )
    )
    _d x
  =
  ( _pi / 4 )
) $.

title: putnam_1980_a3
content:
% Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench artifact putnam_1980_a3:
% the open-interval Lebesgue integral of 1 / (1 + tan(x)^(sqrt(2))) from
% 0 to pi/2 equals pi/4. This file contains no proof.

putnam_1980_a3: THEORY
BEGIN
  real_set: TYPE = [real -> bool]
  real_function: TYPE = [real -> real]
  real_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> real]
  real_set_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> real_set]

  safe_div(numerator, denominator: real): real =
    IF denominator = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      numerator / denominator
    ENDIF

  finite_sum(values: real_sequence, count: nat): RECURSIVE real =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      finite_sum(values, count - 1) + values(count - 1)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  converges_to(values: real_sequence, limit: real): bool =
    FORALL (epsilon_value: posreal):
      EXISTS (cutoff: nat):
        FORALL (count: nat):
          cutoff <= count IMPLIES
            abs(values(count) - limit) < epsilon_value

  nat_factorial(index: nat): RECURSIVE nat =
    IF index = 0 THEN
      1
    ELSE
      index * nat_factorial(index - 1)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE index

  exponential_partial(x: real, count: nat): RECURSIVE real =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      LET index: nat = count - 1 IN
        exponential_partial(x, count - 1)
          + safe_div(
              x ^ index,
              nat_factorial(index) :: real)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  real_exponential(x: real): real =
    epsilon(
      LAMBDA (value: real):
        converges_to(
          LAMBDA (count: nat):
            exponential_partial(x, count),
          value))

  natural_log(x: real): real =
    IF x > 0 THEN
      epsilon(
        LAMBDA (value: real):
          real_exponential(value) = x)
    ELSE
      0
    ENDIF

  real_power(base, exponent: real): real =
    IF base > 0 THEN
      real_exponential(exponent * natural_log(base))
    ELSIF base = 0 AND exponent = 0 THEN
      1
    ELSE
      0
    ENDIF

  alternating_sign(index: nat): RECURSIVE real =
    IF index = 0 THEN
      1
    ELSE
      -alternating_sign(index - 1)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE index

  sine_partial(x: real, count: nat): RECURSIVE real =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      LET index: nat = count - 1 IN
        sine_partial(x, count - 1)
          + safe_div(
              alternating_sign(index) * x ^ (2 * index + 1),
              nat_factorial(2 * index + 1) :: real)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  cosine_partial(x: real, count: nat): RECURSIVE real =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      LET index: nat = count - 1 IN
        cosine_partial(x, count - 1)
          + safe_div(
              alternating_sign(index) * x ^ (2 * index),
              nat_factorial(2 * index) :: real)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  real_sine(x: real): real =
    epsilon(
      LAMBDA (value: real):
        converges_to(
          LAMBDA (count: nat):
            sine_partial(x, count),
          value))

  real_cosine(x: real): real =
    epsilon(
      LAMBDA (value: real):
        converges_to(
          LAMBDA (count: nat):
            cosine_partial(x, count),
          value))

  real_tangent(x: real): real =
    safe_div(real_sine(x), real_cosine(x))

  leibniz_partial_sum(count: nat): RECURSIVE real =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      LET index: nat = count - 1 IN
        leibniz_partial_sum(count - 1)
          + safe_div(
              alternating_sign(index),
              (2 * index + 1) :: real)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  pi: real =
    epsilon(
      LAMBDA (value: real):
        converges_to(
          LAMBDA (count: nat):
            4 * leibniz_partial_sum(count),
          value))

  nonnegative_square_root(value: real): real =
    IF 0 <= value THEN
      epsilon(
        LAMBDA (root: real):
          0 <= root AND root * root = value)
    ELSE
      0
    ENDIF

  open_interval(left_endpoint, right_endpoint: real): real_set =
    LAMBDA (x: real):
      left_endpoint < x AND x < right_endpoint

  set_intersection(left_set, right_set: real_set): real_set =
    LAMBDA (x: real):
      left_set(x) AND right_set(x)

  set_difference(left_set, right_set: real_set): real_set =
    LAMBDA (x: real):
      left_set(x) AND NOT right_set(x)

  set_subset(left_set, right_set: real_set): bool =
    FORALL (x: real):
      left_set(x) IMPLIES right_set(x)

  bounded(covered: real_set): bool =
    EXISTS (bound: nonneg_real):
      FORALL (x: real):
        covered(x) IMPLIES abs(x) <= bound

  interval_length(left_endpoint, right_endpoint: real): real =
    IF left_endpoint < right_endpoint THEN
      right_endpoint - left_endpoint
    ELSE
      0
    ENDIF

  open_interval_cover(
      covered: real_set,
      left_endpoints, right_endpoints: real_sequence): bool =
    FORALL (x: real):
      covered(x) IMPLIES
        EXISTS (index: nat):
          left_endpoints(index) < x
            AND x < right_endpoints(index)

  cover_partial_length(
      left_endpoints, right_endpoints: real_sequence,
      count: nat): real =
    finite_sum(
      LAMBDA (index: nat):
        interval_length(
          left_endpoints(index),
          right_endpoints(index)),
      count)

  cover_has_total_length(
      left_endpoints, right_endpoints: real_sequence,
      total: real): bool =
    converges_to(
      LAMBDA (count: nat):
        cover_partial_length(
          left_endpoints, right_endpoints, count),
      total)

  has_outer_measure(
      covered: real_set,
      measure_value: real): bool =
    bounded(covered)
      AND measure_value >= 0
      AND (FORALL (epsilon_value: posreal):
        EXISTS
            (left_endpoints, right_endpoints: real_sequence),
            (total: real):
          open_interval_cover(
            covered, left_endpoints, right_endpoints)
            AND cover_has_total_length(
              left_endpoints, right_endpoints, total)
            AND total < measure_value + epsilon_value)
      AND (FORALL
          (left_endpoints, right_endpoints: real_sequence),
          (total: real):
        (open_interval_cover(
            covered, left_endpoints, right_endpoints)
          AND cover_has_total_length(
            left_endpoints, right_endpoints, total))
        IMPLIES measure_value <= total)

  lebesgue_measurable(measured_set: real_set): bool =
    bounded(measured_set)
      AND FORALL (test_set: real_set):
        bounded(test_set) IMPLIES
          EXISTS (whole, inside, outside: real):
            has_outer_measure(test_set, whole)
              AND has_outer_measure(
                set_intersection(test_set, measured_set),
                inside)
              AND has_outer_measure(
                set_difference(test_set, measured_set),
                outside)
              AND whole = inside + outside

  outer_measure_value(measured_set: real_set): real =
    epsilon(
      LAMBDA (measure_value: real):
        has_outer_measure(measured_set, measure_value))

  measurable_nonnegative_on(
      function_value: real_function,
      domain: real_set): bool =
    lebesgue_measurable(domain)
      AND (FORALL (x: real):
        domain(x) IMPLIES 0 <= function_value(x))
      AND FORALL (level: real):
        lebesgue_measurable(
          LAMBDA (x: real):
            domain(x) AND level < function_value(x))

  pairwise_disjoint_below(
      pieces: real_set_sequence,
      count: nat): bool =
    FORALL (left_index, right_index: nat):
      left_index < count
        AND right_index < count
        AND left_index /= right_index
      IMPLIES
        FORALL (x: real):
          NOT (pieces(left_index)(x)
            AND pieces(right_index)(x))

  simple_value(
      coefficients: real_sequence,
      pieces: real_set_sequence,
      count: nat,
      x: real): RECURSIVE real =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      simple_value(coefficients, pieces, count - 1, x)
        + IF pieces(count - 1)(x)
            THEN coefficients(count - 1)
          ELSE
            0
          ENDIF
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  simple_integral(
      coefficients: real_sequence,
      pieces: real_set_sequence,
      count: nat): RECURSIVE real =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      simple_integral(coefficients, pieces, count - 1)
        + coefficients(count - 1)
            * outer_measure_value(pieces(count - 1))
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  valid_simple_minorant(
      function_value: real_function,
      domain: real_set,
      coefficients: real_sequence,
      pieces: real_set_sequence,
      count: nat): bool =
    pairwise_disjoint_below(pieces, count)
      AND (FORALL (index: nat):
        index < count IMPLIES
          coefficients(index) >= 0
            AND lebesgue_measurable(pieces(index))
            AND set_subset(pieces(index), domain))
      AND FORALL (x: real):
        domain(x) IMPLIES
          simple_value(coefficients, pieces, count, x)
            <= function_value(x)

  finite_nonnegative_lebesgue_integral_on(
      function_value: real_function,
      domain: real_set,
      integral_value: real): bool =
    measurable_nonnegative_on(function_value, domain)
      AND integral_value >= 0
      AND (FORALL
          (coefficients: real_sequence),
          (pieces: real_set_sequence),
          (count: nat):
        valid_simple_minorant(
          function_value, domain,
          coefficients, pieces, count)
        IMPLIES
          simple_integral(coefficients, pieces, count)
            <= integral_value)
      AND (FORALL (epsilon_value: posreal):
        EXISTS
            (coefficients: real_sequence),
            (pieces: real_set_sequence),
            (count: nat):
          valid_simple_minorant(
            function_value, domain,
            coefficients, pieces, count)
            AND integral_value - epsilon_value
              < simple_integral(coefficients, pieces, count))

  integrand(x: real): real =
    safe_div(
      1,
      1
        + real_power(
            real_tangent(x),
            nonnegative_square_root(2)))

  putnam_1980_a3: bool =
    finite_nonnegative_lebesgue_integral_on(
      integrand,
      open_interval(0, pi / 2),
      pi / 4)
END putnam_1980_a3

import Mathlib

/--
\begin{enumerate}
\item[(a)] Prove that there exist integers $a,b,c$, not all zero and each of absolute value less than one million, such that $|a+b\sqrt{2}+c\sqrt{3}|<10^{-11}$.
\item[(b)] Let $a,b,c$ be integers, not all zero and each of absolute value less than one million. Prove that $|a+b\sqrt{2}+c\sqrt{3}|>10^{-21}$.
\end{enumerate}
-/
theorem putnam_1980_a4
    (abcvals : ℤ → ℤ → ℤ → Prop)
    (habcvals : ∀ a b c : ℤ, abcvals a b c ↔ ¬(a = 0 ∧ b = 0 ∧ c = 0) ∧ |a| < 1000000 ∧ |b| < 1000000 ∧ |c| < 1000000) :
    (∃ a b c : ℤ,
      abcvals a b c ∧
      |a + b * Real.sqrt 2 + c * Real.sqrt 3| < 10 ^ (-(11 : ℝ))) ∧
      (∀ a b c : ℤ, abcvals a b c → |a + b * Real.sqrt 2 + c * Real.sqrt 3| > 10 ^ (-(21 : ℝ))) :=
  sorry

: (exists (a b c : int), abcvals a b c /\ `|a%:~R + b%:~R * (@Num.sqrt R 2) + c%:~R * (@Num.sqrt R 3)| < 10^(-11)) /\ (forall (a b c : int), abcvals a b c -> `|a%:~R + b%:~R * (@Num.sqrt R 2) + c%:~R * (@Num.sqrt R 3)| > 10^(-21)).

title: putnam_1980_a4
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1980_a4:
;; bounded nonzero integer combinations of 1, sqrt(2), and sqrt(3) include
;; one with absolute value below 10^-11, while all have absolute value above
;; 10^-21. This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

;; Exact positivity for p + q*sqrt(2), using rational comparisons only.
(defun putnam-1980-a4-qsqrt2-positive-p (p q)
  (and
   (rationalp p)
   (rationalp q)
   (cond
    ((equal q 0)
     (< 0 p))
    ((< 0 q)
     (or (<= 0 p)
         (< (* p p) (* 2 q q))))
    (t
     (and (< 0 p)
          (< (* 2 q q) (* p p)))))))

;; Exact positivity for d + b*sqrt(2) + c*sqrt(3). If the first two
;; terms and c*sqrt(3) have opposite signs, squaring reduces the comparison
;; to one in Q(sqrt(2)); the sign checks make every squaring step reversible.
(defun putnam-1980-a4-qsqrt2-sqrt3-positive-p (d b c)
  (and
   (rationalp d)
   (rationalp b)
   (rationalp c)
   (let ((u-positive
          (putnam-1980-a4-qsqrt2-positive-p d b))
         (u-zero
          (and (equal d 0)
               (equal b 0))))
     (cond
      ((equal c 0)
       u-positive)
      ((< 0 c)
       (or
        u-positive
        u-zero
        (putnam-1980-a4-qsqrt2-positive-p
         (- (* 3 c c)
            (+ (* d d) (* 2 b b)))
         (- (* 2 d b)))))
      (t
       (and
        u-positive
        (putnam-1980-a4-qsqrt2-positive-p
         (- (+ (* d d) (* 2 b b))
            (* 3 c c))
         (* 2 d b))))))))

(defun putnam-1980-a4-abcvals-p (a b c)
  (and
   (integerp a)
   (integerp b)
   (integerp c)
   (not (and (equal a 0)
             (equal b 0)
             (equal c 0)))
   (< (abs a) 1000000)
   (< (abs b) 1000000)
   (< (abs c) 1000000)))

(defun putnam-1980-a4-absolute-less-p (a b c epsilon)
  (and
   (rationalp epsilon)
   (< 0 epsilon)
   (putnam-1980-a4-qsqrt2-sqrt3-positive-p
    (+ a epsilon) b c)
   (putnam-1980-a4-qsqrt2-sqrt3-positive-p
    (- epsilon a) (- b) (- c))))

content:
-- Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1980_a4:
-- upper and lower bounds for a nonzero bounded integer linear combination of
-- 1, sqrt 2, and sqrt 3. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Int using (Int; pos; negsuc)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; _*_)

infix 4 _!=_ _<N_
infixr 3 _and_
infixr 2 _or_

data Bottom : Set where

Not : Set -> Set
Not A =
  A -> Bottom

_!=_ : {A : Set} -> A -> A -> Set
x != y =
  Not (x == y)

record _and_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data _or_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  left  : A -> A or B
  right : B -> A or B

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

data _<N_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set where
  zero<succ : {n : Nat} -> zero <N suc n
  succ<succ : {m n : Nat} -> m <N n -> suc m <N suc n

record CompleteOrderedRealField (R : Set) : Set1 where
  field
    zeroR oneR : R
    add multiply : R -> R -> R
    negate inverse absoluteValue squareRoot : R -> R
    lessOrEqual : R -> R -> Set
    fromNat : Nat -> R

    one-not-zero :
      oneR != zeroR

    add-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> add x y == add y x
    add-associative :
      (x y z : R) -> add (add x y) z == add x (add y z)
    add-zero :
      (x : R) -> add x zeroR == x
    add-inverse :
      (x : R) -> add x (negate x) == zeroR

    multiply-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> multiply x y == multiply y x
    multiply-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply (multiply x y) z == multiply x (multiply y z)
    multiply-one :
      (x : R) -> multiply x oneR == x
    multiply-zero :
      (x : R) -> multiply x zeroR == zeroR
    distribute :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply x (add y z) ==
      add (multiply x y) (multiply x z)
    inverse-zero :
      inverse zeroR == zeroR
    multiply-inverse :
      (x : R) ->
      x != zeroR ->
      multiply x (inverse x) == oneR

    order-reflexive :
      (x : R) -> lessOrEqual x x
    order-transitive :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y z ->
      lessOrEqual x z
    order-antisymmetric :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y x ->
      x == y
    order-total :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y or lessOrEqual y x
    add-order :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual (add z x) (add z y)
    multiply-nonnegative :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR x ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR y ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR (multiply x y)
    zero-less-than-one :
      lessOrEqual zeroR oneR and zeroR != oneR

    fromNat-zero :
      fromNat zero == zeroR
    fromNat-successor :
      (n : Nat) -> fromNat (suc n) == add (fromNat n) oneR
    fromNat-addition :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m + n) == add (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-multiplication :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m * n) == multiply (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-injective :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat m == fromNat n ->
      m == n

    absolute-nonnegative :
      (x : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR (absoluteValue x)
    absolute-of-nonnegative :
      (x : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR x ->
      absoluteValue x == x
    absolute-of-nonpositive :
      (x : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x zeroR ->
      absoluteValue x == negate x

    square-root-nonnegative :
      (x : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR (squareRoot x)
    square-root-square :
      (x : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR x ->
      multiply (squareRoot x) (squareRoot x) == x
    square-root-nonpositive :
      (x : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x zeroR ->
      squareRoot x == zeroR
    square-root-unique :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR y ->
      multiply y y == x ->
      y == squareRoot x

    archimedean :
      (x : R) ->
      Exists Nat (\ n -> lessOrEqual x (fromNat n))
    least-upper-bound :
      (P : R -> Set) ->
      Exists R P ->
      Exists R
        (\ upper ->
          (x : R) ->
          P x ->
          lessOrEqual x upper) ->
      Exists R
        (\ supremum ->
          ((x : R) ->
            P x ->
            lessOrEqual x supremum)
          and
          ((upper : R) ->
            ((x : R) ->
              P x ->
              lessOrEqual x upper) ->
            lessOrEqual supremum upper))

open CompleteOrderedRealField

StrictLess :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
StrictLess reals x y =
  lessOrEqual reals x y and x != y

fromInt :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Int ->
  R
fromInt reals (pos n) =
  fromNat reals n
fromInt reals (negsuc n) =
  negate reals (fromNat reals (suc n))

absInt : Int -> Nat
absInt (pos n) =
  n
absInt (negsuc n) =
  suc n

power :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  Nat ->
  R
power reals x zero =
  oneR reals
power reals x (suc n) =
  multiply reals x (power reals x n)

tenToNegative :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Nat ->
  R
tenToNegative reals n =
  inverse reals
    (power reals (fromNat reals 10) n)

Admissible : Int -> Int -> Int -> Set
Admissible a b c =
  Not
    (a == pos zero
    and b == pos zero
    and c == pos zero)
  and absInt a <N 1000000
  and absInt b <N 1000000
  and absInt c <N 1000000

linearForm :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Int ->
  Int ->
  Int ->
  R
linearForm reals a b c =
  add reals
    (add reals
      (fromInt reals a)
      (multiply reals
        (fromInt reals b)
        (squareRoot reals (fromNat reals 2))))
    (multiply reals
      (fromInt reals c)
      (squareRoot reals (fromNat reals 3)))

putnam-1980-a4 : Set1
putnam-1980-a4 =
  (R : Set) ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) ->
  Exists Int
    (\ a ->
      Exists Int
        (\ b ->
          Exists Int
            (\ c ->
              Admissible a b c
              and
              StrictLess reals
                (absoluteValue reals (linearForm reals a b c))
                (tenToNegative reals 11))))
  and
  ((a b c : Int) ->
    Admissible a b c ->
    StrictLess reals
      (tenToNegative reals 21)
      (absoluteValue reals (linearForm reals a b c)))

(*
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench artifact putnam_1980_a4:
  existence of a bounded nonzero integer linear combination of 1, sqrt 2,
  and sqrt 3 below 10^-11, with all such combinations above 10^-21.
  This file contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open integerTheory realTheory intrealTheory transcTheory;

val putnam_1980_a4 =
  ``let abcvals =
      \a b c : int.
        ~(a = 0 /\ b = 0 /\ c = 0) /\
        Num (ABS a) < 1000000 /\
        Num (ABS b) < 1000000 /\
        Num (ABS c) < 1000000
    in
      (?a b c : int.
         abcvals a b c /\
         abs
           (real_of_int a +
            real_of_int b * sqrt 2 +
            real_of_int c * sqrt 3) <
           1 / ((10 : real) pow 11)) /\
      (!a b c : int.
         abcvals a b c
         ==>
         abs
           (real_of_int a +
            real_of_int b * sqrt 2 +
            real_of_int c * sqrt 3) >
           1 / ((10 : real) pow 21))``;

% bounded nonzero integer combinations of 1, sqrt(2), and sqrt(3) admit the
% stated approximation and strict lower bound. This file contains no proof.

putnam_1980_a4: THEORY
BEGIN
  sqrt_value(root, radicand: real): bool =
    0 <= root AND root * root = radicand

    NOT (a = 0 AND b = 0 AND c = 0)
      AND abs(a) < 1000000
      AND abs(b) < 1000000
      AND abs(c) < 1000000

  putnam_1980_a4: bool =
    EXISTS (sqrt_2, sqrt_3: real):
      sqrt_value(sqrt_2, 2)
        AND sqrt_value(sqrt_3, 3)
        AND
          (EXISTS (a, b, c: int):
            abcvals(a, b, c)
              AND abs(
                (a :: real)
                  + (b :: real) * sqrt_2
                  + (c :: real) * sqrt_3)
                < (1 :: real) / 100000000000)
        AND
          (FORALL (a, b, c: int):
            abcvals(a, b, c)
              IMPLIES
                abs(
                  (a :: real)
                    + (b :: real) * sqrt_2
                    + (c :: real) * sqrt_3)
                  > (1 :: real) / 1000000000000000000000)
END putnam_1980_a4

import Mathlib

/--
Let $P(t)$ be a nonconstant polynomial with real coefficients. Prove that the system of simultaneous equations $0=\int_0^xP(t)\sin t\,dt=\int_0^xP(t)\cos t\,dt$ has only finitely many real solutions $x$.
-/
theorem putnam_1980_a5
    (P : Polynomial ℝ)
    (Pnonconst : P.degree > 0) :
    Set.Finite {x : ℝ |
      0 = (∫ t in (0)..x, P.eval t * Real.sin t) ∧
      0 = (∫ t in (0)..x, P.eval t * Real.cos t)} :=
  sorry

From mathcomp Require Import all_algebra all_ssreflect.
From mathcomp Require Import reals trigo lebesgue_integral lebesgue_measure measure.
From mathcomp Require Import classical_sets cardinality.

Set Implicit Arguments.
Unset Strict Implicit.
Unset Printing Implicit Defensive.

Local Open Scope classical_set_scope.
Local Open Scope ring_scope.

Variable R : realType.
Definition mu := [the measure _ _ of @lebesgue_measure R].
Definition putnam_1980_a5_interval_integral (f : R -> R) (a b : R) : R :=
  if a <= b then
    \int[mu]_(t in [set t : R | a <= t <= b]) f t
  else
    - \int[mu]_(t in [set t : R | b <= t <= a]) f t.

Theorem putnam_1980_a5
    (P : {poly R})
    (Pnonconst : gtn (size P) (1%nat))
    : finite_set [set x : R |
        putnam_1980_a5_interval_integral (fun t => P.[t] * sin t) 0 x = 0 /\
        putnam_1980_a5_interval_integral (fun t => P.[t] * cos t) 0 x = 0].
Proof. Admitted.

content:
;; Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1980_a5:
;; finiteness of the real common-zero set of the sine- and cosine-weighted
;; oriented integrals of a nonconstant real polynomial. This file contains
;; no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))

;; Carriers, sets, and functions are tame APPLY$ function objects. FN-EQUAL
;; supplies unbounded universal quantification, and inequality with a
;; constant-false function supplies internal existential witnesses. The scalar
;; structure is a Dedekind-complete ordered field, hence a presentation of the
;; real field. Borel measure and lower integration are defined extensionally;
;; the interval-length law below selects Lebesgue measure. Sine and cosine are
;; fixed by their convergent real power series. Thus real coefficients, real
;; endpoints, functions, and sets are not replaced by rational data or finite
;; tables.

(defun ht099-quoted (object)
  (list 'quote object))

(defun ht099-term-list (terms)
  (if (consp terms)
      (list 'cons
            (car terms)
            (ht099-term-list (cdr terms)))
    (ht099-quoted nil)))

(defun ht099-apply-term (function-term arguments)
  (list 'apply$
        function-term
        (ht099-term-list arguments)))

(defun ht099-static-apply-term (function arguments)
  (ht099-apply-term
   (ht099-quoted function)
   arguments))

(defun ht099-and-terms (terms)
  (if (consp terms)
      (list 'if
            (car terms)
            (ht099-and-terms (cdr terms))
            (ht099-quoted nil))
    (ht099-quoted t)))

(defun ht099-or-terms (terms)
  (if (consp terms)
      (list 'if
            (car terms)
            (ht099-quoted t)
            (ht099-or-terms (cdr terms)))
    (ht099-quoted nil)))

(defun ht099-not-term (term)
  (list 'if term
        (ht099-quoted nil)
        (ht099-quoted t)))

(defun ht099-implies-term (hypothesis conclusion)
  (list 'if hypothesis conclusion (ht099-quoted t)))

(defun ht099-iff-term (left right)
  (list 'if left
        (list 'if right
              (ht099-quoted t)
              (ht099-quoted nil))
        (list 'if right
              (ht099-quoted nil)
              (ht099-quoted t))))

(defun ht099-true-function (formals)
  (list 'lambda formals (ht099-quoted t)))

(defun ht099-false-function (formals)
  (list 'lambda formals (ht099-quoted nil)))

(defun ht099-universal-p (function formals)
  (let ((always-true (ht099-true-function formals)))
    (and (tamep-functionp function)
         (tamep-functionp always-true)
         (fn-equal function always-true))))

(defun ht099-exists-p (function formals)
  (let ((always-false (ht099-false-function formals)))
    (and (tamep-functionp function)
         (tamep-functionp always-false)
         (not (fn-equal function always-false)))))

(defun ht099-member-p (predicate object)
  (if (apply$ predicate (list object)) t nil))

(defun ht099-unary-value (function object)
  (apply$ function (list object)))

(defun ht099-binary-value (function left right)
  (apply$ function (list left right)))

;; Sets and arbitrary functions.

(defun ht099-set-subset-function (carrier left right)
  (list
   'lambda '(x)
   (ht099-implies-term
    (ht099-and-terms
     (list
      (ht099-static-apply-term carrier '(x))
      (ht099-static-apply-term left '(x))))
    (ht099-static-apply-term right '(x)))))

(defun ht099-set-subset-p (carrier left right)
  (and
   (tamep-functionp carrier)
   (tamep-functionp left)
   (tamep-functionp right)
   (ht099-universal-p
    (ht099-set-subset-function carrier left right)
    '(x))))

(defun ht099-valid-set-p (carrier set)
  (and
   (tamep-functionp set)
   (ht099-set-subset-p carrier set carrier)))

(defun ht099-set-equiv-function (carrier left right)
  (list
   'lambda '(x)
   (ht099-implies-term
    (ht099-static-apply-term carrier '(x))
    (ht099-iff-term
     (ht099-static-apply-term left '(x))
     (ht099-static-apply-term right '(x))))))

(defun ht099-set-equiv-p (carrier left right)
  (and
   (ht099-valid-set-p carrier left)
   (ht099-valid-set-p carrier right)
   (ht099-universal-p
    (ht099-set-equiv-function carrier left right)
    '(x))))

(defun ht099-empty-set ()
  (list 'lambda '(x) (ht099-quoted nil)))

(defun ht099-full-set (carrier)
  (list 'lambda '(x)
        (ht099-static-apply-term carrier '(x))))

(defun ht099-complement-set (carrier set)
  (list
   'lambda '(x)
   (ht099-and-terms
    (list
     (ht099-static-apply-term carrier '(x))
     (ht099-not-term
      (ht099-static-apply-term set '(x)))))))

(defun ht099-function-values-function
    (domain-carrier codomain-carrier function)
  (list
   'lambda '(x)
   (ht099-implies-term
    (ht099-static-apply-term domain-carrier '(x))

(defun ht099-function-p

    '(x))))

;; A Dedekind-complete ordered field, used as an abstract presentation of R.

(defun ht099-field-laws-function
    (carrier zero one add multiply negate inverse)
  (let* ((xy-add (ht099-static-apply-term add '(x y)))
         (yz-add (ht099-static-apply-term add '(y z)))
         (xy-mul (ht099-static-apply-term multiply '(x y)))
         (yz-mul (ht099-static-apply-term multiply '(y z)))
         (neg-x (ht099-static-apply-term negate '(x)))
         (inv-x (ht099-static-apply-term inverse '(x))))
    (list
     'lambda '(x y z)
     (ht099-implies-term
      (ht099-and-terms
       (list
        (ht099-static-apply-term carrier '(x))
        (ht099-static-apply-term carrier '(y))
        (ht099-static-apply-term carrier '(z))))
      (ht099-and-terms
       (list
        (ht099-static-apply-term carrier (list xy-add))
        (ht099-static-apply-term carrier (list xy-mul))
        (ht099-static-apply-term carrier (list neg-x))
        (ht099-static-apply-term carrier (list inv-x))
        (list 'equal
              (ht099-static-apply-term add (list xy-add 'z))
              (ht099-static-apply-term add (list 'x yz-add)))
        (list 'equal xy-add
              (ht099-static-apply-term add '(y x)))
        (list 'equal
              (ht099-static-apply-term
               add (list 'x (ht099-quoted zero)))
              'x)
        (list 'equal
              (ht099-static-apply-term add (list 'x neg-x))
              (ht099-quoted zero))
        (list 'equal
              (ht099-static-apply-term multiply (list xy-mul 'z))
              (ht099-static-apply-term multiply (list 'x yz-mul)))
        (list 'equal xy-mul
              (ht099-static-apply-term multiply '(y x)))
        (list 'equal
              (ht099-static-apply-term
               multiply (list 'x (ht099-quoted one)))
              'x)
        (ht099-implies-term
         (list 'equal 'x (ht099-quoted zero))
         (list 'equal inv-x (ht099-quoted zero)))
        (ht099-implies-term
         (ht099-not-term
          (list 'equal 'x (ht099-quoted zero)))
         (list 'equal
               (ht099-static-apply-term
                multiply (list 'x inv-x))
               (ht099-quoted one)))
        (list 'equal
              (ht099-static-apply-term multiply (list 'x yz-add))
              (ht099-static-apply-term
               add
               (list
                (ht099-static-apply-term multiply '(x y))
                (ht099-static-apply-term multiply '(x z)))))))))))

(defun ht099-order-laws-function
    (carrier zero add multiply less)
  (let ((xy (ht099-static-apply-term less '(x y)))
        (yx (ht099-static-apply-term less '(y x)))
        (yz (ht099-static-apply-term less '(y z))))
    (list
     'lambda '(x y z)
     (ht099-implies-term
      (ht099-and-terms
       (list
        (ht099-static-apply-term carrier '(x))
        (ht099-static-apply-term carrier '(y))
        (ht099-static-apply-term carrier '(z))))
      (ht099-and-terms
       (list
        (ht099-not-term
         (ht099-static-apply-term less '(x x)))
        (ht099-or-terms
         (list xy yx (list 'equal 'x 'y)))
        (ht099-implies-term
         (ht099-and-terms (list xy yz))
         (ht099-static-apply-term less '(x z)))
        (ht099-implies-term
         xy
         (ht099-static-apply-term
          less
          (list
           (ht099-static-apply-term add '(x z))
           (ht099-static-apply-term add '(y z)))))
        (ht099-implies-term
         (ht099-and-terms
          (list
           (ht099-static-apply-term
            less (list (ht099-quoted zero) 'x))
           (ht099-static-apply-term
            less (list (ht099-quoted zero) 'y))))
         (ht099-static-apply-term
          less
          (list
           (ht099-quoted zero)
           (ht099-static-apply-term multiply '(x y)))))))))))

(defun ht099-upper-bound-function
    (carrier less set upper)
  (list
   'lambda '(x)
   (ht099-implies-term
    (ht099-and-terms
     (list
      (ht099-static-apply-term carrier '(x))
      (ht099-static-apply-term set '(x))))
    (ht099-not-term
     (ht099-static-apply-term
      less (list (ht099-quoted upper) 'x))))))

(defun ht099-upper-bound-p
    (carrier less set upper)
  (and
   (ht099-member-p carrier upper)
   (ht099-valid-set-p carrier set)
   (ht099-universal-p
    (ht099-upper-bound-function carrier less set upper)
    '(x))))

(defun ht099-set-nonempty-function (carrier set)
  (list
   'lambda '(x)
   (ht099-and-terms
    (list
     (ht099-static-apply-term carrier '(x))
     (ht099-static-apply-term set '(x))))))

(defun ht099-set-nonempty-p (carrier set)
  (and
   (ht099-valid-set-p carrier set)
   (ht099-exists-p
    (ht099-set-nonempty-function carrier set)
    '(x))))

(defun ht099-bounded-above-function
    (carrier less set)
  (list
   'lambda '(upper)
   (list 'ht099-upper-bound-p
         (ht099-quoted carrier)
         (ht099-quoted less)
         (ht099-quoted set)
         'upper)))

(defun ht099-bounded-above-p (carrier less set)
  (ht099-exists-p
   (ht099-bounded-above-function carrier less set)
   '(upper)))

(defun ht099-least-upper-bound-function
    (carrier less set supremum)
  (list
   'lambda '(upper)
   (ht099-implies-term
    (list 'ht099-upper-bound-p
          (ht099-quoted carrier)
          (ht099-quoted less)
          (ht099-quoted set)
          'upper)
    (ht099-not-term
     (ht099-static-apply-term
      less (list 'upper (ht099-quoted supremum)))))))

(defun ht099-least-upper-bound-p
    (carrier less set supremum)
  (and
   (ht099-upper-bound-p carrier less set supremum)
   (ht099-universal-p
    (ht099-least-upper-bound-function
     carrier less set supremum)
    '(upper))))

(defun ht099-completeness-function
    (carrier less supremum-operation)
  (list
   'lambda '(set)
   (ht099-implies-term
    (ht099-and-terms
     (list
      (list 'ht099-valid-set-p
            (ht099-quoted carrier) 'set)
      (list 'ht099-set-nonempty-p
            (ht099-quoted carrier) 'set)
      (list 'ht099-bounded-above-p
            (ht099-quoted carrier)
            (ht099-quoted less)
            'set)))
    (list 'ht099-least-upper-bound-p
          (ht099-quoted carrier)
          (ht099-quoted less)
          'set
          (ht099-static-apply-term
           supremum-operation '(set))))))

(defun ht099-real-field-p
    (carrier zero one add multiply negate inverse less supremum)
  (and
   (tamep-functionp carrier)
   (tamep-functionp add)
   (tamep-functionp multiply)
   (tamep-functionp negate)
   (tamep-functionp inverse)
   (tamep-functionp less)
   (tamep-functionp supremum)
   (ht099-member-p carrier zero)
   (ht099-member-p carrier one)
   (not (equal zero one))
   (ht099-universal-p
    (ht099-field-laws-function
     carrier zero one add multiply negate inverse)
    '(x y z))
   (ht099-universal-p
    (ht099-order-laws-function
     carrier zero add multiply less)
    '(x y z))
   (ht099-universal-p
    (ht099-completeness-function
     carrier less supremum)
    '(set))
   (ht099-binary-value less zero one)))

(defun ht099-scalar-absolute-value
    (less zero negate value)
  (if (ht099-binary-value less value zero)
      (ht099-unary-value negate value)
    value))
;; Sigma algebras.

(defun ht099-family-extensional-function (carrier family)

   'lambda '(left right)
   (ht099-implies-term
    (list 'ht099-set-equiv-p
          (ht099-quoted carrier)
          'left 'right)
    (ht099-iff-term
     (ht099-static-apply-term family '(left))
     (ht099-static-apply-term family '(right))))))

(defun ht099-family-members-valid-function (carrier family)

   'lambda '(set)

(defun ht099-family-of-sets-p (carrier family)

    (ht099-family-extensional-function carrier family)

    (ht099-family-members-valid-function carrier family)
    '(set))))

(defun ht099-sequence-union-member-function (sequence x)

    (list
     (list 'natp 'n)

      (ht099-static-apply-term sequence '(n))

(defun ht099-sequence-union-member-p (sequence x)

(defun ht099-sequence-union-set (carrier sequence)
  (list
   'lambda '(x)

    (list
     (ht099-static-apply-term carrier '(x))

           (ht099-quoted sequence)
           'x)))))

(defun ht099-sequence-of-sets-function (carrier sequence)
  (list
   'lambda '(n)
   (ht099-implies-term
    (list 'natp 'n)
    (list 'ht099-valid-set-p
          (ht099-quoted carrier)
          (ht099-static-apply-term sequence '(n))))))

(defun ht099-sequence-of-sets-p (carrier sequence)

(defun ht099-sequence-members-family-function (family sequence)

(defun ht099-sequence-members-family-p

(defun ht099-sigma-complement-function (carrier family)

(defun ht099-sigma-union-function (carrier family)

;; Extended nonnegative reals and countable sums.

(defun ht099-ennreal-p
    (value scalar-carrier scalar-zero scalar-less)
  (or
   (equal value :ht099-top)
   (and
    (consp value)
    (equal (car value) :ht099-finite)
    (ht099-member-p scalar-carrier (cdr value))
    (not
     (ht099-binary-value scalar-less (cdr value) scalar-zero)))))

(defun ht099-ennreal-finite (value)
  (cons :ht099-finite value))

(defun ht099-ennreal-zero (scalar-zero)
  (ht099-ennreal-finite scalar-zero))

(defun ht099-ennreal-less-p (left right scalar-less)
  (cond
   ((equal left :ht099-top) nil)
   ((equal right :ht099-top) t)
   (t
    (ht099-binary-value scalar-less (cdr left) (cdr right)))))

(defun ht099-ennreal-less-equal-p (left right scalar-less)
  (not (ht099-ennreal-less-p right left scalar-less)))

(defun ht099-ennreal-add (left right scalar-add)
  (if (or (equal left :ht099-top)
          (equal right :ht099-top))
      :ht099-top
    (ht099-ennreal-finite
     (ht099-binary-value scalar-add (cdr left) (cdr right)))))

(defun ht099-ennreal-multiply
    (left right scalar-zero scalar-multiply)
  (cond
   ((or (equal left (ht099-ennreal-zero scalar-zero))
        (equal right (ht099-ennreal-zero scalar-zero)))
    (ht099-ennreal-zero scalar-zero))
   ((or (equal left :ht099-top)
        (equal right :ht099-top))
    :ht099-top)
   (t
    (ht099-ennreal-finite
     (ht099-binary-value
      scalar-multiply (cdr left) (cdr right))))))

(defun ht099-finite-ennreal-sum
    (sequence count scalar-zero scalar-add)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix count)))
  (if (zp count)
      (ht099-ennreal-zero scalar-zero)
    (ht099-ennreal-add
     (ht099-finite-ennreal-sum
      sequence (- count 1) scalar-zero scalar-add)
     (ht099-unary-value sequence (- count 1))
     scalar-add)))

(defun ht099-sum-upper-bound-function
    (sequence total scalar-zero scalar-add scalar-less)
  (list
   'lambda '(count)
   (ht099-implies-term
    (list 'natp 'count)
    (list 'ht099-ennreal-less-equal-p
          (list 'ht099-finite-ennreal-sum
                (ht099-quoted sequence)
                'count
                (ht099-quoted scalar-zero)
                (ht099-quoted scalar-add))
          (ht099-quoted total)
          (ht099-quoted scalar-less)))))

(defun ht099-sum-upper-bound-p
    (sequence total scalar-zero scalar-add scalar-less)
  (ht099-universal-p
   (ht099-sum-upper-bound-function
    sequence total scalar-zero scalar-add scalar-less)
   '(count)))

(defun ht099-sum-least-function
    (sequence total scalar-carrier scalar-zero scalar-add scalar-less)
  (list
   'lambda '(bound)
   (ht099-implies-term
    (ht099-and-terms
     (list
      (list 'ht099-ennreal-p
            'bound
            (ht099-quoted scalar-carrier)
            (ht099-quoted scalar-zero)
            (ht099-quoted scalar-less))
      (list 'ht099-sum-upper-bound-p
            (ht099-quoted sequence)
            'bound
            (ht099-quoted scalar-zero)
            (ht099-quoted scalar-add)
            (ht099-quoted scalar-less))))
    (list 'ht099-ennreal-less-equal-p
          (ht099-quoted total)
          'bound
          (ht099-quoted scalar-less)))))

(defun ht099-countable-sum-p
    (sequence total
     scalar-carrier scalar-zero scalar-add scalar-less)
  (and
   (tamep-functionp sequence)
   (ht099-ennreal-p
    total scalar-carrier scalar-zero scalar-less)
   (ht099-sum-upper-bound-p
    sequence total scalar-zero scalar-add scalar-less)
   (ht099-universal-p
    (ht099-sum-least-function
     sequence total
     scalar-carrier scalar-zero scalar-add scalar-less)
    '(bound))))

;; Countably additive measures, including values on arbitrary subsets.

(defun ht099-measure-extensional-function (carrier measure)
  (list
   'lambda '(left right)
   (ht099-implies-term
    (list 'ht099-set-equiv-p
          (ht099-quoted carrier)
          'left 'right)
    (list 'equal
          (ht099-static-apply-term measure '(left))
          (ht099-static-apply-term measure '(right))))))

(defun ht099-measure-values-function
    (scalar-carrier scalar-zero scalar-less carrier measure)
  (list
   'lambda '(set)
   (ht099-implies-term
    (list 'ht099-valid-set-p
          (ht099-quoted carrier)
          'set)
    (list 'ht099-ennreal-p
          (ht099-static-apply-term measure '(set))
          (ht099-quoted scalar-carrier)
          (ht099-quoted scalar-zero)
          (ht099-quoted scalar-less)))))

(defun ht099-measure-sequence-values (measure sequence)
  (list
   'lambda '(n)
   (ht099-static-apply-term
    measure
    (list (ht099-static-apply-term sequence '(n))))))

(defun ht099-disjoint-sets-function (carrier left right)
  (list
   'lambda '(x)
   (ht099-implies-term
    (ht099-static-apply-term carrier '(x))
    (ht099-not-term
     (ht099-and-terms
      (list
       (ht099-static-apply-term left '(x))
       (ht099-static-apply-term right '(x))))))))

(defun ht099-disjoint-sets-p (carrier left right)
  (ht099-universal-p
   (ht099-disjoint-sets-function carrier left right)
   '(x)))

(defun ht099-pairwise-disjoint-function (carrier sequence)
  (list
   'lambda '(m n)
   (ht099-implies-term
    (ht099-and-terms
     (list
      (list 'natp 'm)
      (list 'natp 'n)
      (ht099-not-term (list 'equal 'm 'n))))
    (list 'ht099-disjoint-sets-p
          (ht099-quoted carrier)
          (ht099-static-apply-term sequence '(m))
          (ht099-static-apply-term sequence '(n))))))

(defun ht099-pairwise-disjoint-p (carrier sequence)
  (ht099-universal-p
   (ht099-pairwise-disjoint-function carrier sequence)
   '(m n)))

(defun ht099-countable-additivity-function
    (scalar-carrier scalar-zero scalar-add scalar-less
     carrier measurable measure)
  (list
   'lambda '(sequence)
   (ht099-implies-term
    (ht099-and-terms
     (list
      (list 'ht099-sequence-members-family-p
            (ht099-quoted carrier)
            (ht099-quoted measurable)
            'sequence)
      (list 'ht099-pairwise-disjoint-p
            (ht099-quoted carrier)
            'sequence)))
    (list 'ht099-countable-sum-p
          (list 'ht099-measure-sequence-values
                (ht099-quoted measure)
                'sequence)
          (ht099-static-apply-term
           measure
           (list
            (list 'ht099-sequence-union-set
                  (ht099-quoted carrier)
                  'sequence)))
          (ht099-quoted scalar-carrier)
          (ht099-quoted scalar-zero)
          (ht099-quoted scalar-add)
          (ht099-quoted scalar-less)))))

(defun ht099-measurable-superset-lower-bound-function
    (carrier measurable measure set lower scalar-less)
  (list
   'lambda '(superset)
   (ht099-implies-term
    (ht099-and-terms
     (list
      (ht099-static-apply-term measurable '(superset))
      (list 'ht099-set-subset-p
            (ht099-quoted carrier)
            (ht099-quoted set)
            'superset)))
    (list 'ht099-ennreal-less-equal-p
          (ht099-quoted lower)
          (ht099-static-apply-term measure '(superset))
          (ht099-quoted scalar-less)))))

(defun ht099-measurable-superset-lower-bound-p
    (carrier measurable measure set lower scalar-less)
  (ht099-universal-p
   (ht099-measurable-superset-lower-bound-function
    carrier measurable measure set lower scalar-less)

(defun ht099-outer-value-lower-function
    (scalar-carrier scalar-zero scalar-less
     carrier measurable measure set)

   'lambda '(lower)
   (ht099-implies-term
    (ht099-and-terms
     (list
      (list 'ht099-ennreal-p
            'lower
            (ht099-quoted scalar-carrier)
            (ht099-quoted scalar-zero)
            (ht099-quoted scalar-less))
      (list 'ht099-measurable-superset-lower-bound-p
            (ht099-quoted carrier)
            (ht099-quoted measurable)
            (ht099-quoted measure)
            (ht099-quoted set)
            'lower
            (ht099-quoted scalar-less))))
    (list 'ht099-ennreal-less-equal-p
          'lower
          (ht099-static-apply-term
           measure (list (ht099-quoted set)))
          (ht099-quoted scalar-less)))))

(defun ht099-outer-value-p
    (scalar-carrier scalar-zero scalar-less

   (ht099-measurable-superset-lower-bound-p
    carrier measurable measure set
    (ht099-unary-value measure set)

   (ht099-universal-p
    (ht099-outer-value-lower-function
     scalar-carrier scalar-zero scalar-less

(defun ht099-outer-values-function
    (scalar-carrier scalar-zero scalar-less

   'lambda '(set)
   (ht099-implies-term
    (list 'ht099-valid-set-p
          (ht099-quoted carrier)
          'set)
    (list 'ht099-outer-value-p
          (ht099-quoted scalar-carrier)
          (ht099-quoted scalar-zero)
          (ht099-quoted scalar-less)
          (ht099-quoted carrier)
          (ht099-quoted measurable)
          (ht099-quoted measure)
          'set))))

(defun ht099-measure-space-p
    (scalar-carrier scalar-zero scalar-add scalar-less
     carrier measurable measure)
  (and
   (ht099-sigma-algebra-p carrier measurable)
   (tamep-functionp measure)
   (ht099-universal-p
    (ht099-measure-extensional-function carrier measure)
    '(left right))
   (ht099-universal-p
    (ht099-measure-values-function
     scalar-carrier scalar-zero scalar-less carrier measure)
    '(set))
   (equal
    (ht099-unary-value measure (ht099-empty-set))
    (ht099-ennreal-zero scalar-zero))

        (cdr value)

    (real-zero real-negate real-less

  (and
   (ht099-ae-measurable-p

    real-carrier real-less function)
   (ht099-ennreal-less-p
    (apply$
     lintegral

       real-zero real-negate real-less function)))

        real-zero)
       (ht099-unary-value

          lintegral

           (ht099-real-negative-part-function

    real-zero))

(defun ht099-real-nat-value (n real-zero real-one real-add)

  (if (zp n)

     real-one)))

  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix exponent)))
  (if (zp exponent)
