     real-multiply
     value
     (ht099-real-power
      value (- exponent 1) real-one real-multiply))))

(defun ht099-real-factorial
    (n real-zero real-one real-add real-multiply)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix n)))
  (if (zp n)

     real-multiply

     (ht099-real-factorial

    (count x
     real-zero real-one real-add real-multiply real-inverse)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix count)))
  (if (zp count)
      real-zero
    (let* ((k (- count 1))
           (term
            (ht099-real-divide
             (ht099-real-power x k real-one real-multiply)
             (ht099-real-factorial
              k real-zero real-one real-add real-multiply)
             real-multiply real-inverse)))
      (ht099-binary-value
       real-add
       (ht099-exp-partial-sum
        k x
        real-zero real-one real-add real-multiply real-inverse)
       term))))

      (ht099-binary-value

        real-negate real-inverse)

     (ht099-quoted real-add)
     (ht099-quoted real-negate)
     (ht099-quoted real-less)
     (list
      'ht099-cos-partial-sum-sequence
      'x
      (ht099-quoted real-zero)
      (ht099-quoted real-one)
      (ht099-quoted real-add)
      (ht099-quoted real-multiply)
      (ht099-quoted real-negate)
      (ht099-quoted real-inverse))
     (ht099-static-apply-term cos '(x))))))

(defun ht099-sin-values-function
    (real-carrier real-zero real-one real-add real-multiply
     real-negate real-inverse real-less sin)
  (list
   'lambda '(x)
   (ht099-implies-term
    (ht099-static-apply-term real-carrier '(x))
    (list
     'ht099-real-tendsto-filter-p
     (list 'ht099-natural-carrier)
     (list 'ht099-sequential-filter)
     (ht099-quoted real-carrier)
     (ht099-quoted real-zero)
     (ht099-quoted real-add)
     (ht099-quoted real-negate)
     (ht099-quoted real-less)
     (list
      'ht099-sin-partial-sum-sequence
      'x
      (ht099-quoted real-zero)
      (ht099-quoted real-one)
      (ht099-quoted real-add)
      (ht099-quoted real-multiply)
      (ht099-quoted real-negate)
      (ht099-quoted real-inverse))
     (ht099-static-apply-term sin '(x))))))

(defun ht099-analytic-functions-p
    (real-carrier real-zero real-one real-add real-multiply
     real-negate real-inverse real-less exp sin cos)
  (and
   (ht099-function-p real-carrier real-carrier exp)
   (ht099-function-p real-carrier real-carrier sin)
   (ht099-function-p real-carrier real-carrier cos)
   (ht099-universal-p
    (ht099-exp-values-function
     real-carrier real-zero real-one real-add real-multiply
     real-negate real-inverse real-less exp)
    '(x))
   (ht099-universal-p
    (ht099-sin-values-function
     real-carrier real-zero real-one real-add real-multiply
     real-negate real-inverse real-less sin)
    '(x))
   (ht099-universal-p
   (ht099-cos-values-function
     real-carrier real-zero real-one real-add real-multiply
     real-negate real-inverse real-less cos)
    '(x))))

;; The imported analytic infrastructure above is shared statement machinery.
;; Only sine and cosine are needed for this artifact.

(defun putnam-1980-a5-trigonometric-functions-p
    (real-carrier real-zero real-one real-add real-multiply
     real-negate real-inverse real-less sin cos)
  (and
   (ht099-function-p real-carrier real-carrier sin)
   (ht099-function-p real-carrier real-carrier cos)
   (ht099-universal-p
    (ht099-sin-values-function
     real-carrier real-zero real-one real-add real-multiply
     real-negate real-inverse real-less sin)
    '(x))
   (ht099-universal-p
    (ht099-cos-values-function
     real-carrier real-zero real-one real-add real-multiply
     real-negate real-inverse real-less cos)
    '(x))))

;; Coefficients are in ascending-power order. Trailing zero coefficients are
;; harmless, and nonconstancy is the existence of a nonzero positive-degree
;; coefficient.

(defun putnam-1980-a5-coefficients-p (coefficients real-carrier)
  (if (consp coefficients)
      (and
       (ht099-member-p real-carrier (car coefficients))
       (putnam-1980-a5-coefficients-p
        (cdr coefficients) real-carrier))
    (equal coefficients nil)))

(defun putnam-1980-a5-positive-degree-coefficient-p
    (coefficients real-zero)
  (if (consp (cdr coefficients))
      (or
       (not (equal (cadr coefficients) real-zero))
       (putnam-1980-a5-positive-degree-coefficient-p
        (cdr coefficients) real-zero))
    nil))

(defun putnam-1980-a5-polynomial-value
    (coefficients x real-zero real-add real-multiply)
  (if (consp coefficients)
      (ht099-binary-value
       real-add
       (car coefficients)
       (ht099-binary-value
        real-multiply
        x
        (putnam-1980-a5-polynomial-value
         (cdr coefficients) x
         real-zero real-add real-multiply)))
    real-zero))

;; The half-open interval (a,b] is used to define oriented integrals:
;; integral_0^x f = integral_(0,x] f - integral_(x,0] f.

(defun putnam-1980-a5-ioc-set
    (real-carrier real-less lower upper)
  (list
   'lambda '(x)
   (ht099-and-terms
    (list
     (ht099-static-apply-term real-carrier '(x))
     (ht099-static-apply-term
      real-less (list (ht099-quoted lower) 'x))
     (ht099-not-term
      (ht099-static-apply-term
       real-less (list (ht099-quoted upper) 'x)))))))

(defun putnam-1980-a5-lebesgue-interval-law-function
    (real-carrier real-zero real-add real-negate real-less measure)
  (list
   'lambda '(a b)
   (ht099-implies-term
    (ht099-and-terms
     (list
      (ht099-static-apply-term real-carrier '(a))
      (ht099-static-apply-term real-carrier '(b))))
    (list
     'equal
     (ht099-static-apply-term
      measure
      (list
       (list 'putnam-1980-a5-ioc-set
             (ht099-quoted real-carrier)
             (ht099-quoted real-less)
             'a 'b)))
     (list
      'ht099-ennreal-finite
      (list
       'if
       (ht099-static-apply-term real-less '(a b))
       (ht099-static-apply-term
        real-add
        (list
         'b
         (ht099-static-apply-term real-negate '(a))))
       (ht099-quoted real-zero)))))))

(defun putnam-1980-a5-lebesgue-measure-p
    (real-carrier real-zero real-add real-negate real-less
     measurable measure)
  (and
   (ht099-measure-space-p
    real-carrier real-zero real-add real-less
    real-carrier measurable measure)
   (ht099-universal-p
    (putnam-1980-a5-lebesgue-interval-law-function
     real-carrier real-zero real-add real-negate real-less measure)
    '(a b))))

(defun putnam-1980-a5-restricted-integrand-function
    (real-carrier real-zero real-add real-multiply real-less
     coefficients trigonometric-function lower upper)
  (list
   'lambda '(t)
   (list
    'if
    (ht099-and-terms
     (list
      (ht099-static-apply-term real-carrier '(t))
      (ht099-static-apply-term
       real-less (list (ht099-quoted lower) 't))
      (ht099-not-term
       (ht099-static-apply-term
        real-less (list (ht099-quoted upper) 't)))))
    (ht099-static-apply-term
     real-multiply
     (list
      (list
       'putnam-1980-a5-polynomial-value
       (ht099-quoted coefficients)
       't
       (ht099-quoted real-zero)
       (ht099-quoted real-add)
       (ht099-quoted real-multiply))
      (ht099-static-apply-term trigonometric-function '(t))))
    (ht099-quoted real-zero))))

(defun putnam-1980-a5-set-integral
    (real-carrier real-zero real-add real-negate real-less
     measurable measure lintegral function)
  (ht099-real-integral-value
   real-zero real-add real-negate real-less
   real-carrier measurable measure real-carrier function lintegral))

(defun putnam-1980-a5-oriented-integral
    (real-carrier real-zero real-add real-multiply real-negate real-less
     measurable measure lintegral coefficients trigonometric-function x)
  (let
      ((forward
        (putnam-1980-a5-restricted-integrand-function
         real-carrier real-zero real-add real-multiply real-less
         coefficients trigonometric-function real-zero x))
       (backward
        (putnam-1980-a5-restricted-integrand-function
         real-carrier real-zero real-add real-multiply real-less
         coefficients trigonometric-function x real-zero)))
    (ht099-binary-value
     real-add
     (putnam-1980-a5-set-integral
      real-carrier real-zero real-add real-negate real-less
      measurable measure lintegral forward)
     (ht099-unary-value
      real-negate
      (putnam-1980-a5-set-integral
       real-carrier real-zero real-add real-negate real-less
       measurable measure lintegral backward)))))

(defun putnam-1980-a5-common-zero-p
    (real-carrier real-zero real-add real-multiply real-negate real-less
     measurable measure lintegral sin cos coefficients x)
  (and
   (ht099-member-p real-carrier x)
   (equal
    (putnam-1980-a5-oriented-integral
     real-carrier real-zero real-add real-multiply real-negate real-less
     measurable measure lintegral coefficients sin x)
    real-zero)
   (equal
    (putnam-1980-a5-oriented-integral
     real-carrier real-zero real-add real-multiply real-negate real-less
     measurable measure lintegral coefficients cos x)
    real-zero)))

;; A subset is finite exactly when some finite ACL2 list contains all of its
;; members. SOLUTIONS is internally existentially quantified in the final
;; statement; it is not an extra theorem parameter.

(defun-sk putnam-1980-a5-all-common-zeroes-listed-p
    (real-carrier real-zero real-add real-multiply real-negate real-less
     measurable measure lintegral sin cos coefficients solutions)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (putnam-1980-a5-common-zero-p
      real-carrier real-zero real-add real-multiply real-negate real-less
      measurable measure lintegral sin cos coefficients x)
     (member-equal x solutions))))

(defun-sk putnambench-putnam-1980-a5-statement
    (real-carrier real-zero real-one real-add real-multiply
     real-negate real-inverse real-less real-supremum
     real-topology measurable measure lintegral
     sin cos coefficients)
  (exists (solutions)
    (implies
     (and
      (ht099-real-field-p
       real-carrier real-zero real-one real-add real-multiply
       real-negate real-inverse real-less real-supremum)
      (ht099-order-topology-p
       real-carrier real-less real-topology)
      (ht099-borel-space-p
       real-carrier real-topology measurable)
      (putnam-1980-a5-lebesgue-measure-p
       real-carrier real-zero real-add real-negate real-less
       measurable measure)
      (ht099-lintegral-operation-p
       real-carrier real-zero real-add real-multiply real-less
       real-carrier measurable measure lintegral)
      (putnam-1980-a5-trigonometric-functions-p
       real-carrier real-zero real-one real-add real-multiply
       real-negate real-inverse real-less sin cos)
      (putnam-1980-a5-coefficients-p
       coefficients real-carrier)
      (putnam-1980-a5-positive-degree-coefficient-p
       coefficients real-zero))
     (and
      (true-listp solutions)
      (putnam-1980-a5-all-common-zeroes-listed-p
       real-carrier real-zero real-add real-multiply real-negate real-less
       measurable measure lintegral sin cos coefficients solutions)))))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

title: putnam_1980_a5
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1980_a5:
-- a nonconstant real polynomial has only finitely many endpoints where its
-- sine- and cosine-weighted integrals from zero both vanish. This file
-- contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module Putnam1980A5 where

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.List using (List; []; _∷_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; _*_)

infix 4 _!=_ _<=N_ _<N_
infixr 3 _and_
infixr 2 _or_

data Bottom : Set where

Not : Set -> Set
Not A =
  A -> Bottom

_!=_ : {A : Set} -> A -> A -> Set
x != y =
  Not (x == y)

record _and_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data _or_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  left  : A -> A or B
  right : B -> A or B

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

data _<=N_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set where
  zero<=   : {n : Nat} -> zero <=N n
  suc<=suc : {m n : Nat} -> m <=N n -> suc m <=N suc n

data _<N_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set where
  zero<suc : {n : Nat} -> zero <N suc n
  suc<suc  : {m n : Nat} -> m <N n -> suc m <N suc n

data Fin : Nat -> Set where
  fzero : {n : Nat} -> Fin (suc n)
  fsuc  : {n : Nat} -> Fin n -> Fin (suc n)

record HasCardinality
  {A : Set}
  (P : A -> Set)
  (cardinality : Nat) :
  Set where

  field
    enumerate :
      Fin cardinality ->
      A
    enumerated-member :
      (index : Fin cardinality) ->
      P (enumerate index)
    enumeration-complete :
      (x : A) ->
      P x ->
      Exists (Fin cardinality)
        (\ index -> x == enumerate index)
    enumeration-injective :
      (left-index right-index : Fin cardinality) ->
      enumerate left-index == enumerate right-index ->
      left-index == right-index

record FiniteSubset
  {A : Set}
  (P : A -> Set) :
  Set where

  field
    cardinality :
      Nat
    has-cardinality :
      HasCardinality P cardinality

record CompleteOrderedRealField (R : Set) : Set1 where
  field
    zeroR oneR : R
    add multiply : R -> R -> R
    negate inverse : R -> R
    lessOrEqual : R -> R -> Set
    fromNat : Nat -> R

    one-not-zero :
      oneR != zeroR

    add-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> add x y == add y x
    add-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      add (add x y) z == add x (add y z)
    add-zero :
      (x : R) -> add x zeroR == x
    add-inverse :
      (x : R) -> add x (negate x) == zeroR

    multiply-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> multiply x y == multiply y x
    multiply-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply (multiply x y) z ==
      multiply x (multiply y z)
    multiply-one :
      (x : R) -> multiply x oneR == x
    multiply-zero :
      (x : R) -> multiply x zeroR == zeroR
    distribute :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply x (add y z) ==
      add (multiply x y) (multiply x z)
    inverse-zero :
      inverse zeroR == zeroR
    multiply-inverse :
      (x : R) ->
      x != zeroR ->
      multiply x (inverse x) == oneR

    order-reflexive :
      (x : R) -> lessOrEqual x x
    order-transitive :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y z ->
      lessOrEqual x z
    order-antisymmetric :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y x ->
      x == y
    order-total :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y or lessOrEqual y x
    add-order :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual (add z x) (add z y)
    multiply-nonnegative :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR x ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR y ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR (multiply x y)
    zero-less-than-one :
      lessOrEqual zeroR oneR and zeroR != oneR

    fromNat-zero :
      fromNat zero == zeroR
    fromNat-successor :
      (n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (suc n) == add (fromNat n) oneR
    fromNat-addition :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m + n) == add (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-multiplication :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m * n) == multiply (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-injective :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat m == fromNat n ->
      m == n

    archimedean :
      (x : R) ->
      Exists Nat (\ n -> lessOrEqual x (fromNat n))
    least-upper-bound :
      (P : R -> Set) ->
      Exists R P ->
      Exists R
        (\ upper ->
          (x : R) ->
          P x ->
          lessOrEqual x upper) ->
      Exists R
        (\ supremum ->
          ((x : R) ->
            P x ->
            lessOrEqual x supremum)
          and
          ((upper : R) ->
            ((x : R) ->
              P x ->
              lessOrEqual x upper) ->
            lessOrEqual supremum upper))

open CompleteOrderedRealField

oneN : Nat
oneN =
  suc zero

twoN : Nat
twoN =
  suc oneN

subtract :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
subtract reals x y =
  add reals x (negate reals y)

divide :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
divide reals x y =
  multiply reals x (inverse reals y)

StrictLess :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
StrictLess reals x y =
  lessOrEqual reals x y and x != y

CloseTo :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
CloseTo reals center radius x =
  StrictLess reals
    (subtract reals center radius)
    x
  and
  StrictLess reals
    x
    (add reals center radius)

naturalPower :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  Nat ->
  R
naturalPower reals x zero =
  oneR reals
naturalPower reals x (suc n) =
  multiply reals
    (naturalPower reals x n)
    x

factorial : Nat -> Nat
factorial zero =
  oneN
factorial (suc n) =
  suc n * factorial n

sumFirst :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Nat ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  R
sumFirst reals zero term =
  zeroR reals
sumFirst reals (suc n) term =
  add reals
    (sumFirst reals n term)
    (term n)

ConvergesTo :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  R ->
  Set
ConvergesTo {R} reals sequence limit =
  (epsilon : R) ->
  StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) epsilon ->
  Exists Nat
    (\ cutoff ->
      (n : Nat) ->
      cutoff <=N n ->
      CloseTo reals limit epsilon (sequence n))

SeriesHasSum :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  R ->
  Set
SeriesHasSum reals terms limit =
  ConvergesTo reals
    (\ n -> sumFirst reals n terms)
    limit

alternatingPower :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Nat ->
  R
alternatingPower reals n =
  naturalPower reals
    (negate reals (oneR reals))
    n

sineTerm :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  Nat ->
  R
sineTerm reals x n =
  divide reals
    (multiply reals
      (alternatingPower reals n)
      (naturalPower reals x (suc (twoN * n))))
    (fromNat reals (factorial (suc (twoN * n))))

cosineTerm :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  Nat ->
  R
cosineTerm reals x n =
  divide reals
    (multiply reals
      (alternatingPower reals n)
      (naturalPower reals x (twoN * n)))
    (fromNat reals (factorial (twoN * n)))

record StandardTrigonometry
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) :
  Set1 where

  field
    sine cosine : R -> R
    sine-series :
      (x : R) ->
      SeriesHasSum reals
        (sineTerm reals x)
        (sine x)
    cosine-series :
      (x : R) ->
      SeriesHasSum reals
        (cosineTerm reals x)
        (cosine x)

open StandardTrigonometry

Polynomial : Set -> Set
Polynomial R =
  List R

coefficient :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Polynomial R ->
  Nat ->
  R
coefficient reals [] n =
  zeroR reals
coefficient reals (a ∷ coefficients) zero =
  a
coefficient reals (a ∷ coefficients) (suc n) =
  coefficient reals coefficients n

evaluate :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Polynomial R ->
  R ->
  R
evaluate reals [] x =
  zeroR reals
evaluate reals (a ∷ coefficients) x =
  add reals a
    (multiply reals x
      (evaluate reals coefficients x))

Nonconstant :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Polynomial R ->
  Set
Nonconstant reals polynomial =
  Exists Nat
    (\ degree ->
      zero <N degree
      and
      coefficient reals polynomial degree != zeroR reals)

rightRiemannSum :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  (R -> R) ->
  Nat ->
  R
rightRiemannSum reals lower upper function pieces =
  let
    step =
      divide reals
        (subtract reals upper lower)
        (fromNat reals pieces)
  in
  sumFirst reals pieces
    (\ i ->
      multiply reals
        (function
          (add reals lower
            (multiply reals
              (fromNat reals (suc i))
              step)))
        step)

IntervalIntegralValue :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  (R -> R) ->
  R ->
  Set
IntervalIntegralValue reals lower upper function value =
  ConvergesTo reals
    (\ n ->
      rightRiemannSum reals
        lower
        upper
        function
        (suc n))
    value

module Putnam1980A5Statement
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R)
  (trigonometry : StandardTrigonometry reals) where

  sineIntegrand :
    Polynomial R ->
    R ->
    R
  sineIntegrand polynomial t =
    multiply reals
      (evaluate reals polynomial t)
      (sine trigonometry t)

  cosineIntegrand :
    Polynomial R ->
    R ->
    R
  cosineIntegrand polynomial t =
    multiply reals
      (evaluate reals polynomial t)
      (cosine trigonometry t)

  SimultaneousZero :
    Polynomial R ->
    R ->
    Set
  SimultaneousZero polynomial x =
    IntervalIntegralValue reals
      (zeroR reals)
      x
      (sineIntegrand polynomial)
      (zeroR reals)
    and
    IntervalIntegralValue reals
      (zeroR reals)
      x
      (cosineIntegrand polynomial)
      (zeroR reals)

  proposition :
    Polynomial R ->
    Set
  proposition polynomial =
    Nonconstant reals polynomial ->
    FiniteSubset (SimultaneousZero polynomial)

putnam-1980-a5 : Set1
putnam-1980-a5 =
  (R : Set) ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) ->
  (trigonometry : StandardTrigonometry reals) ->
  (polynomial : Polynomial R) ->
  Putnam1980A5Statement.proposition
    reals
    trigonometry
    polynomial

title: putnam_1980_a5
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1980_a5:
  finiteness of the real endpoints at which both signed integrals of a
  nonconstant real polynomial times sine and cosine vanish. This file
  contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open pred_setTheory realTheory transcTheory integrationTheory polyTheory;

val putnam_1980_a5 =
  ``let integral_to =
      \x : real.
      \f : real -> real.
        if 0 <= x then
          integration$integral (interval [0, x]) f
        else
          ~(integration$integral (interval [x, 0]) f)
    in
      !P : real list.
        degree P > 0
        ==>
        FINITE
          {x : real |
             integral_to x (\t : real. poly P t * sin t) = 0 /\
             integral_to x (\t : real. poly P t * cos t) = 0}``;

title: putnam_1980_a5
content:
$(
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact
  putnam_1980_a5: a nonconstant real polynomial has only finitely many real
  endpoints where both its sine-weighted and cosine-weighted oriented
  integrals from zero vanish. This file contains no proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  Poly1 ` RRfld is set.mm's ring of finite-support univariate polynomials
  over the reals. The map algSc embeds real constants, so excluding its
  image says exactly that P is nonconstant. The map eval1 evaluates P.

  P80A5Integral P F x is the oriented integral from zero to x of
  P(t)F(t). For nonnegative x it is the Lebesgue integral over (0,x);
  for negative x it is the negative of the integral over (x,0). Endpoint
  inclusion is immaterial, so this is definitionally equivalent to the
  interval integrals in the Lean and Isabelle sources for every real x.

  The final declaration is the single unproved $a corpus statement; this
  database contains no $p proof statement.
$)

$c P80A5Integral $.

p80a5-integral-syntax $a class ( P80A5Integral P F x ) $.

${
  $d F P t x $.

  p80a5-integral-definition $a |- (
    ( P80A5Integral P F x )
    =
    if (
      0 <_ x ,
      S. ( 0 (,) x )
        (
          (
            (
              ( ( eval1 ` RRfld ) ` P )
              `
              t
            )
            x.
            ( F ` t )
          )
        )
        _d t ,
      -u
      S. ( x (,) 0 )
        (
          (
            (
              ( ( eval1 ` RRfld ) ` P )
              `
              t
            )
            x.
            ( F ` t )
          )
        )
        _d t
    )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d c p x $.

  putnambench-putnam-1980-a5 $a |-
    A. p e. ( Base ` ( Poly1 ` RRfld ) )
      (
        -.
        E. c e. RR
          p = ( ( algSc ` ( Poly1 ` RRfld ) ) ` c )
        ->
        {
          x e. RR |
          (
            ( P80A5Integral p sin x ) = 0
            /\
            ( P80A5Integral p cos x ) = 0
          )
        }
        e. Fin
      )
  $.
$}

title: putnam_1980_a5
content:
% Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1980_a5:
% a nonconstant real polynomial has only finitely many real upper endpoints
% where both integrals against sine and cosine vanish. This file contains no proof.

putnam_1980_a5: THEORY
BEGIN
  IMPORTING finite_sets[real]

  real_function: TYPE = [real -> real]
  real_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> real]

  safe_div(numerator, denominator: real): real =
    IF denominator = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      numerator / denominator
    ENDIF

  factorial(index: nat): RECURSIVE nat =
    IF index = 0 THEN
      1
    ELSE
      index * factorial(index - 1)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE index

  sine_partial(x: real, count: nat): RECURSIVE real =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      LET index: nat = count - 1 IN
        sine_partial(x, count - 1)
          + safe_div(
              ((-1 :: real) ^ index) * x ^ (2 * index + 1),
              factorial(2 * index + 1) :: real)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  cosine_partial(x: real, count: nat): RECURSIVE real =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      LET index: nat = count - 1 IN
        cosine_partial(x, count - 1)
          + safe_div(
              ((-1 :: real) ^ index) * x ^ (2 * index),
              factorial(2 * index) :: real)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  converges_to(sequence: real_sequence, value: real): bool =
    FORALL (epsilon_value: posreal):
      EXISTS (cutoff: nat):
        FORALL (index: nat):
          cutoff <= index IMPLIES
            abs(sequence(index) - value) < epsilon_value

  sine(x: real): real =
    epsilon(
      LAMBDA (value: real):
        converges_to(
          LAMBDA (count: nat): sine_partial(x, count),
          value))

  cosine(x: real): real =
    epsilon(
      LAMBDA (value: real):
        converges_to(
          LAMBDA (count: nat): cosine_partial(x, count),
          value))

  polynomial_value(p: list[real], x: real): RECURSIVE real =
    CASES p OF
      null: 0,
      cons(coefficient, tail):
        coefficient + x * polynomial_value(tail, x)
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE p BY <<

  polynomial_coefficient(
      p: list[real],
      degree: nat): RECURSIVE real =
    CASES p OF
      null: 0,
      cons(coefficient, tail):
        IF degree = 0 THEN
          coefficient
        ELSE
          polynomial_coefficient(tail, degree - 1)
        ENDIF
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE p BY <<

  nonconstant_polynomial(p: list[real]): bool =
    EXISTS (degree: nat):
      degree > 0 AND polynomial_coefficient(p, degree) /= 0

  valid_partition(
      lower, upper: real,
      points: real_sequence,
      count: nat): bool =
    IF lower = upper THEN
      count = 0 AND points(0) = lower
    ELSE
      count > 0
        AND points(0) = lower
        AND points(count) = upper
        AND (FORALL (index: nat):
          index < count IMPLIES
            points(index) < points(index + 1))
    ENDIF

  valid_tags(
      points, tags: real_sequence,
      count: nat): bool =
    FORALL (index: nat):
      index < count IMPLIES
        points(index) <= tags(index)
          AND tags(index) <= points(index + 1)

  mesh_less_than(
      points: real_sequence,
      count: nat,
      bound: real): bool =
    FORALL (index: nat):
      index < count IMPLIES
        points(index + 1) - points(index) < bound

  riemann_sum(
      f: real_function,
      points, tags: real_sequence,
      count: nat): RECURSIVE real =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      riemann_sum(f, points, tags, count - 1)
        + f(tags(count - 1))
            * (points(count) - points(count - 1))
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  has_integral_on_ordered_interval(
      f: real_function,
      integral_value, lower, upper: real): bool =
    lower <= upper
      AND FORALL (epsilon_value: posreal):
        EXISTS (mesh_bound: posreal):
          FORALL
              (points, tags: real_sequence),
              (count: nat):
            (valid_partition(lower, upper, points, count)
              AND valid_tags(points, tags, count)
              AND mesh_less_than(points, count, mesh_bound))
            IMPLIES
              abs(
                riemann_sum(f, points, tags, count)
                  - integral_value)
                < epsilon_value

  has_oriented_integral(
      f: real_function,
      integral_value, lower, upper: real): bool =
    IF lower <= upper THEN
      has_integral_on_ordered_interval(
        f, integral_value, lower, upper)
    ELSE
      has_integral_on_ordered_interval(
        f, -integral_value, upper, lower)
    ENDIF

  common_integral_zero(p: list[real], x: real): bool =
    has_oriented_integral(
      LAMBDA (t: real): polynomial_value(p, t) * sine(t),
      0, 0, x)
      AND has_oriented_integral(
        LAMBDA (t: real): polynomial_value(p, t) * cosine(t),
        0, 0, x)

  putnam_1980_a5: bool =
    FORALL (p: list[real]):
      nonconstant_polynomial(p) IMPLIES
        EXISTS (solutions: finite_set[real]):
          FORALL (x: real):
            solutions(x) IFF common_integral_zero(p, x)
END putnam_1980_a5

import Mathlib

-- Note: uses (ℝ → ℝ) instead of (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 → ℝ)
noncomputable abbrev putnam_1980_a6_solution : ℝ := sorry
-- 1 / Real.exp 1
/--
Let $C$ be the class of all real valued continuously differentiable functions $f$ on the interval $0 \leq x \leq 1$ with $f(0)=0$ and $f(1)=1$. Determine the largest real number $u$ such that $u \leq \int_0^1|f'(x)-f(x)|\,dx$ for all $f$ in $C$.
-/
theorem putnam_1980_a6
    (C : Set (ℝ → ℝ))
    (hC : C = {f : ℝ → ℝ | ContDiffOn ℝ 1 f (Set.Icc 0 1) ∧ f 0 = 0 ∧ f 1 = 1}) :
    IsGreatest
      {(u : ℝ) | ∀ f ∈ C, u ≤ (∫ x in Set.Ioo 0 1, |deriv f x - f x|)}
      putnam_1980_a6_solution :=
  sorry

title: putnam_1980_a6
content:
(* Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench artifact putnam_1980_a6:
   the greatest uniform lower bound of the integral of |f' - f| over
   continuously differentiable real functions on [0,1] with prescribed
   endpoint values; this file contains no proof. *)

From Stdlib Require Import Reals ClassicalEpsilon.

Open Scope R_scope.

Definition putnam_1980_a6_unit_interval (x : R) : Prop :=
  0 <= x <= 1.

Definition putnam_1980_a6_derivable_within
    (f : R -> R) (x d : R) : Prop :=
  forall epsilon : R,
    epsilon > 0 ->
    exists delta : R,
      delta > 0 /\
      forall y : R,
        putnam_1980_a6_unit_interval y ->
        y <> x ->
        Rabs (y - x) < delta ->
        Rabs ((f y - f x) / (y - x) - d) < epsilon.

Definition putnam_1980_a6_derivative
    (f : R -> R) (x : R) : R :=
  epsilon (inhabits (0 : R))
    (fun d : R => putnam_1980_a6_derivable_within f x d).

Definition putnam_1980_a6_continuous_on_unit
    (g : R -> R) : Prop :=
  forall x : R,
    putnam_1980_a6_unit_interval x ->
    forall epsilon : R,
      epsilon > 0 ->
      exists delta : R,
        delta > 0 /\
        forall y : R,
          putnam_1980_a6_unit_interval y ->
          Rabs (y - x) < delta ->
          Rabs (g y - g x) < epsilon.

Definition putnam_1980_a6_continuously_differentiable_on_unit
    (f : R -> R) : Prop :=
  (forall x : R,
      putnam_1980_a6_unit_interval x ->
      putnam_1980_a6_derivable_within
        f x (putnam_1980_a6_derivative f x)) /\
  putnam_1980_a6_continuous_on_unit
    (putnam_1980_a6_derivative f).

Definition putnam_1980_a6_solution : R :=
  1 / exp 1.

Definition putnam_1980_a6_integral_has_value
    (g : R -> R) (value : R) : Prop :=
  exists integrable : Riemann_integrable g 0 1,
    value = RiemannInt integrable.

Definition putnam_1980_a6_is_lower_bound
    (C : (R -> R) -> Prop) (u : R) : Prop :=
  forall f : R -> R,
    C f ->
    forall value : R,
      putnam_1980_a6_integral_has_value
        (fun x : R =>
          Rabs (putnam_1980_a6_derivative f x - f x))
        value ->
      u <= value.

Theorem putnam_1980_a6
    (C : (R -> R) -> Prop)
    (hC :
      forall f : R -> R,
        C f <->
        putnam_1980_a6_continuously_differentiable_on_unit f /\
        f 0 = 0 /\
        f 1 = 1) :
  putnam_1980_a6_is_lower_bound C putnam_1980_a6_solution /\
  forall u : R,
    putnam_1980_a6_is_lower_bound C u ->
    u <= putnam_1980_a6_solution.
Admitted.

content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench artifact putnam_1980_a6:
  the greatest uniform lower bound of the integral of |f' - f| over [0,1]
  for continuously differentiable real functions with f(0)=0 and f(1)=1 is
  1 / exp(1). This file contains no proof.
*)

let analysis_output = open_out "/dev/null";;
let analysis_formatter = Format.formatter_of_out_channel analysis_output;;
let analysis_loaded =
  Toploop.use_file analysis_formatter "Library/analysis.ml";;
Format.pp_print_flush analysis_formatter ();;
close_out analysis_output;;
if not analysis_loaded then failwith "failed to load Library/analysis.ml";;

let statement =
  `let interval = {x:real | &0 <= x /\ x <= &1} in
   let has_derivative_within =
     \(f:real->real) (d:real) (x:real).
       !e:real.
         &0 < e
         ==> ?delta:real.
               &0 < delta /\
               !y:real.
                 y IN interval /\
                 &0 < abs (y - x) /\
                 abs (y - x) < delta
                 ==> abs ((f y - f x) / (y - x) - d) < e in
   let derivative_on =
     \(f:real->real) (x:real).
       @d:real. has_derivative_within f d x in
   let continuous_on =
     \(g:real->real).
       !x:real.
         x IN interval
         ==> !e:real.
               &0 < e
               ==> ?delta:real.
                     &0 < delta /\
                     !y:real.
                       y IN interval /\ abs (y - x) < delta
                       ==> abs (g y - g x) < e in
   let class_c =
     \(f:real->real).
       (!x:real.
          x IN interval
          ==> has_derivative_within f (derivative_on f x) x) /\
       continuous_on (derivative_on f) /\
       f (&0) = &0 /\
       f (&1) = &1 in
   let admissible =
     \u:real.
       !f:real->real.
         class_c f
         ==> u <=
             integral(&0,&1)
               (\x. abs (derivative_on f x - f x)) in
   admissible (&1 / exp (&1)) /\
   (!u:real. admissible u ==> u <= &1 / exp (&1))`;;

title: putnam_1980_a6
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1980_a6:
;; 1/e is the greatest lower bound of the integral of |f'(x)-f(x)| over all
;; continuously differentiable real functions on [0,1] with f(0)=0 and
;; f(1)=1. This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))

;; Standard ACL2 has no primitive real-number or real-function sort. Following
;; the corpus convention, conservative interfaces present an arbitrary complete
;; ordered field, its arbitrary real-valued functions, and its arbitrary sets.
;; Every field, order, completeness, function-typing, differentiability, and
;; integration condition used by the statement is explicit below.

(defstub p80a6-real-p (r-type value) t)
(defstub p80a6-zero (r-type) t)
(defstub p80a6-one (r-type) t)
(defstub p80a6-add (r-type left right) t)
(defstub p80a6-mul (r-type left right) t)
(defstub p80a6-neg (r-type value) t)
(defstub p80a6-inv (r-type value) t)
(defstub p80a6-lt (r-type left right) t)
(defstub p80a6-function-value (r-type function argument) t)
(defstub p80a6-set-member-p (r-type set value) t)

(defun p80a6-sub (r-type x y)
  (p80a6-add r-type x (p80a6-neg r-type y)))

(defun p80a6-le (r-type x y)
  (not (p80a6-lt r-type y x)))

(defun p80a6-abs (r-type x)
  (if (p80a6-lt r-type x (p80a6-zero r-type))
      (p80a6-neg r-type x)
    x))

(defun p80a6-in-closed-unit-interval-p (r-type x)
  (and
   (p80a6-real-p r-type x)
   (p80a6-le r-type (p80a6-zero r-type) x)
   (p80a6-le r-type x (p80a6-one r-type))))

;; Complete ordered-field presentation of the real carrier.

(defun-sk p80a6-operation-closure-p (r-type)
  (forall (x y)
    (and
     (p80a6-real-p r-type (p80a6-zero r-type))
     (p80a6-real-p r-type (p80a6-one r-type))
     (implies
      (p80a6-real-p r-type x)
      (and
       (p80a6-real-p r-type (p80a6-neg r-type x))
       (p80a6-real-p r-type (p80a6-inv r-type x))))
     (implies
      (and
       (p80a6-real-p r-type x)
       (p80a6-real-p r-type y))
      (and
       (p80a6-real-p r-type (p80a6-add r-type x y))
       (p80a6-real-p r-type (p80a6-mul r-type x y)))))))

(defun-sk p80a6-unary-field-laws-p (r-type)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (p80a6-real-p r-type x)
     (let ((zero (p80a6-zero r-type))
           (one (p80a6-one r-type)))
       (and
        (equal (p80a6-add r-type zero x) x)
        (equal (p80a6-add r-type x zero) x)
        (equal (p80a6-add r-type x (p80a6-neg r-type x)) zero)
        (equal (p80a6-add r-type (p80a6-neg r-type x) x) zero)
        (equal (p80a6-mul r-type one x) x)
        (equal (p80a6-mul r-type x one) x)
        (implies
         (not (equal x zero))
         (and
          (equal (p80a6-mul r-type x (p80a6-inv r-type x)) one)
          (equal (p80a6-mul r-type (p80a6-inv r-type x) x) one))))))))

(defun-sk p80a6-binary-field-laws-p (r-type)
  (forall (x y)
    (implies
     (and
      (p80a6-real-p r-type x)
      (p80a6-real-p r-type y))
     (and
      (equal
       (p80a6-add r-type x y)
       (p80a6-add r-type y x))
      (equal
       (p80a6-mul r-type x y)
       (p80a6-mul r-type y x))))))

(defun-sk p80a6-ternary-field-laws-p (r-type)
  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (p80a6-real-p r-type x)
      (p80a6-real-p r-type y)
      (p80a6-real-p r-type z))
     (and
      (equal
       (p80a6-add r-type (p80a6-add r-type x y) z)
       (p80a6-add r-type x (p80a6-add r-type y z)))
      (equal
       (p80a6-mul r-type (p80a6-mul r-type x y) z)
       (p80a6-mul r-type x (p80a6-mul r-type y z)))
      (equal
       (p80a6-mul r-type x (p80a6-add r-type y z))
       (p80a6-add
        r-type
        (p80a6-mul r-type x y)
        (p80a6-mul r-type x z)))))))

(defun-sk p80a6-order-laws-p (r-type)
  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (p80a6-real-p r-type x)
      (p80a6-real-p r-type y)
      (p80a6-real-p r-type z))
     (and
      (not (p80a6-lt r-type x x))
      (implies
       (and
        (p80a6-lt r-type x y)
        (p80a6-lt r-type y z))
       (p80a6-lt r-type x z))
      (or
       (p80a6-lt r-type x y)
       (equal x y)
       (p80a6-lt r-type y x))
      (implies
       (p80a6-lt r-type x y)
       (p80a6-lt
        r-type
        (p80a6-add r-type x z)
        (p80a6-add r-type y z)))
      (implies
       (and
        (p80a6-lt r-type (p80a6-zero r-type) x)
        (p80a6-lt r-type (p80a6-zero r-type) y))
       (p80a6-lt
        r-type
        (p80a6-zero r-type)
        (p80a6-mul r-type x y)))))))

(defun-sk p80a6-valid-real-set-p (r-type set)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (p80a6-set-member-p r-type set x)
     (p80a6-real-p r-type x))))

(defun-sk p80a6-set-nonempty-p (r-type set)
  (exists (x)
    (and
     (p80a6-real-p r-type x)
     (p80a6-set-member-p r-type set x))))

(defun-sk p80a6-upper-bound-p (r-type set bound)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (p80a6-set-member-p r-type set x)
     (p80a6-le r-type x bound))))

(defun-sk p80a6-set-bounded-above-p (r-type set)
  (exists (bound)
    (and
     (p80a6-real-p r-type bound)
     (p80a6-upper-bound-p r-type set bound))))

(defun-sk p80a6-least-upper-bound-p
    (r-type set supremum)
  (forall (bound)
    (and
     (p80a6-real-p r-type supremum)
     (p80a6-upper-bound-p r-type set supremum)
     (implies
      (and
       (p80a6-real-p r-type bound)
       (p80a6-upper-bound-p r-type set bound))
      (p80a6-le r-type supremum bound)))))

(defun-sk p80a6-supremum-exists-p (r-type set)
  (exists (supremum)
    (and
     (p80a6-real-p r-type supremum)
     (p80a6-least-upper-bound-p
      r-type set supremum))))

(defun-sk p80a6-dedekind-complete-p (r-type)
  (forall (set)
    (implies
     (and
      (p80a6-valid-real-set-p r-type set)
      (p80a6-set-nonempty-p r-type set)
      (p80a6-set-bounded-above-p r-type set))
     (p80a6-supremum-exists-p r-type set))))

(defun p80a6-real-structure-p (r-type)
  (and
   (p80a6-operation-closure-p r-type)
   (p80a6-unary-field-laws-p r-type)
   (p80a6-binary-field-laws-p r-type)
   (p80a6-ternary-field-laws-p r-type)
   (p80a6-order-laws-p r-type)
   (not (equal (p80a6-zero r-type)
               (p80a6-one r-type)))
   (p80a6-lt
    r-type
    (p80a6-zero r-type)
    (p80a6-one r-type))
   (p80a6-dedekind-complete-p r-type)))

;; Exact characterization of e as the limit of sum_{k=0}^{n-1} 1/k!.

(defun p80a6-real-natural (r-type n)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix n)))
  (if (zp n)
      (p80a6-zero r-type)
    (p80a6-add
     r-type
     (p80a6-one r-type)
     (p80a6-real-natural r-type (1- n)))))

(defun p80a6-real-factorial (r-type n)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix n)))
  (if (zp n)
      (p80a6-one r-type)
    (p80a6-mul
     r-type
     (p80a6-real-natural r-type n)
     (p80a6-real-factorial r-type (1- n)))))

(defun p80a6-exp-partial-sum (r-type terms)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix terms)))
  (if (zp terms)
      (p80a6-zero r-type)
    (let ((index (1- terms)))
      (p80a6-add
       r-type
       (p80a6-exp-partial-sum r-type index)
       (p80a6-inv
        r-type
        (p80a6-real-factorial r-type index))))))

(defun-sk p80a6-exp-eventually-close-p
    (r-type e-value epsilon cutoff)
  (forall (terms)
    (implies
     (and
      (natp terms)
      (<= cutoff terms))
     (p80a6-lt
      r-type
      (p80a6-abs
       r-type
       (p80a6-sub
        r-type
        (p80a6-exp-partial-sum r-type terms)
        e-value))
      epsilon))))

(defun-sk p80a6-exp-cutoff-exists-p
    (r-type e-value epsilon)
  (exists (cutoff)
    (and
     (natp cutoff)
     (p80a6-exp-eventually-close-p
      r-type e-value epsilon cutoff))))

(defun-sk p80a6-exp-one-value-p (r-type e-value)
  (forall (epsilon)
    (implies
     (and
      (p80a6-real-p r-type epsilon)
      (p80a6-lt
       r-type
       (p80a6-zero r-type)
       epsilon))
     (p80a6-exp-cutoff-exists-p
      r-type e-value epsilon))))

;; Real-valued functions, continuity, and an interval-relative derivative.

(defun-sk p80a6-real-function-p (r-type function)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (p80a6-real-p r-type x)
     (p80a6-real-p
      r-type
      (p80a6-function-value r-type function x)))))

(defun-sk p80a6-continuity-neighborhood-p
    (r-type function x epsilon delta)
  (forall (y)
    (implies
     (and
      (p80a6-in-closed-unit-interval-p r-type y)
      (p80a6-lt
       r-type
       (p80a6-abs
        r-type
        (p80a6-sub r-type y x))
       delta))
     (p80a6-lt
      r-type
      (p80a6-abs
       r-type
       (p80a6-sub
        r-type
        (p80a6-function-value r-type function y)
        (p80a6-function-value r-type function x)))
      epsilon))))

(defun-sk p80a6-continuity-delta-exists-p
    (r-type function x epsilon)
  (exists (delta)
    (and
     (p80a6-real-p r-type delta)
     (p80a6-lt
      r-type
      (p80a6-zero r-type)
      delta)
     (p80a6-continuity-neighborhood-p
      r-type function x epsilon delta))))

(defun-sk p80a6-continuous-on-unit-interval-p
    (r-type function)
  (forall (x epsilon)
    (implies
     (and
      (p80a6-in-closed-unit-interval-p r-type x)
      (p80a6-real-p r-type epsilon)
      (p80a6-lt
       r-type
       (p80a6-zero r-type)
       epsilon))
     (p80a6-continuity-delta-exists-p
      r-type function x epsilon))))

(defun-sk p80a6-derivative-neighborhood-p
    (r-type function derivative x epsilon radius)
  (forall (y)
    (implies
     (and
      (p80a6-in-closed-unit-interval-p r-type y)
      (p80a6-lt
       r-type
       (p80a6-abs
        r-type
        (p80a6-sub r-type y x))
       radius))
     (p80a6-le
      r-type
      (p80a6-abs
       r-type
       (p80a6-sub
        r-type
        (p80a6-sub
         r-type
         (p80a6-function-value r-type function y)
         (p80a6-function-value r-type function x))
        (p80a6-mul
         r-type
         derivative
         (p80a6-sub r-type y x))))
      (p80a6-mul
       r-type
       epsilon
       (p80a6-abs
        r-type
        (p80a6-sub r-type y x)))))))

(defun-sk p80a6-derivative-radius-exists-p
    (r-type function derivative x epsilon)
  (exists (radius)
    (and
     (p80a6-real-p r-type radius)
     (p80a6-lt
      r-type
      (p80a6-zero r-type)
      radius)
     (p80a6-derivative-neighborhood-p
      r-type function derivative x epsilon radius))))

(defun-sk p80a6-has-derivative-within-p
    (r-type function derivative x)
  (forall (epsilon)
    (implies
     (and
      (p80a6-real-p r-type epsilon)
      (p80a6-lt
       r-type
       (p80a6-zero r-type)
       epsilon))
     (p80a6-derivative-radius-exists-p
      r-type function derivative x epsilon))))

(defun-sk p80a6-derivative-on-unit-interval-p
    (r-type function derivative-function)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (p80a6-in-closed-unit-interval-p r-type x)
     (p80a6-has-derivative-within-p
      r-type
      function
      (p80a6-function-value
       r-type derivative-function x)
      x))))

(defun p80a6-admissible-representation-p
    (r-type function derivative-function)
  (and
   (p80a6-real-function-p r-type function)
   (p80a6-real-function-p r-type derivative-function)
   (p80a6-derivative-on-unit-interval-p
    r-type function derivative-function)
   (p80a6-continuous-on-unit-interval-p
    r-type function)
   (p80a6-continuous-on-unit-interval-p
    r-type derivative-function)
   (equal
    (p80a6-function-value
     r-type function (p80a6-zero r-type))
    (p80a6-zero r-type))
   (equal
    (p80a6-function-value
     r-type function (p80a6-one r-type))
    (p80a6-one r-type))))

;; Gauge-integral definition for the continuous residual |f'-f|. On a compact
;; interval this equals the source interval Lebesgue integral.

(defun p80a6-residual-value
    (r-type function derivative-function x)
  (p80a6-abs
   r-type
   (p80a6-sub
    r-type
    (p80a6-function-value
     r-type derivative-function x)
    (p80a6-function-value r-type function x))))

(defun p80a6-tagged-piece-p (r-type piece)
  (and
   (true-listp piece)
   (equal (len piece) 3)
   (p80a6-real-p r-type (nth 0 piece))
   (p80a6-real-p r-type (nth 1 piece))
   (p80a6-real-p r-type (nth 2 piece))
   (p80a6-lt r-type (nth 1 piece) (nth 2 piece))
   (p80a6-le r-type (nth 1 piece) (nth 0 piece))
   (p80a6-le r-type (nth 0 piece) (nth 2 piece))))

(defun p80a6-tagged-division-tail-p
    (r-type division next-left)
  (if (endp division)
      (equal next-left (p80a6-one r-type))
    (let ((piece (car division)))
      (and
       (p80a6-tagged-piece-p r-type piece)
       (equal (nth 1 piece) next-left)
       (p80a6-tagged-division-tail-p
        r-type
        (cdr division)
        (nth 2 piece))))))

(defun p80a6-tagged-division-p (r-type division)
  (and
   (true-listp division)
   (p80a6-tagged-division-tail-p
    r-type division (p80a6-zero r-type))))

(defun p80a6-residual-riemann-sum
    (r-type function derivative-function division)
  (if (endp division)
      (p80a6-zero r-type)
    (let* ((piece (car division))
           (tag (nth 0 piece))
           (left (nth 1 piece))
           (right (nth 2 piece)))
      (p80a6-add
       r-type
       (p80a6-mul
        r-type
        (p80a6-residual-value
         r-type function derivative-function tag)
        (p80a6-sub r-type right left))
       (p80a6-residual-riemann-sum
        r-type
        function
        derivative-function
        (cdr division))))))

(defun-sk p80a6-positive-gauge-p (r-type gauge)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (p80a6-in-closed-unit-interval-p r-type x)
     (p80a6-lt
      r-type
      (p80a6-zero r-type)
      (p80a6-function-value r-type gauge x)))))

(defun p80a6-fine-tagged-division-p
    (r-type gauge division)
  (if (endp division)
      t
    (let* ((piece (car division))
           (tag (nth 0 piece))
           (left (nth 1 piece))
           (right (nth 2 piece))
           (gauge-at-tag
            (p80a6-function-value r-type gauge tag)))
      (and
       (p80a6-lt
        r-type
        (p80a6-sub r-type tag left)
        gauge-at-tag)
       (p80a6-lt
        r-type
        (p80a6-sub r-type right tag)
        gauge-at-tag)
       (p80a6-fine-tagged-division-p
        r-type gauge (cdr division))))))

(defun-sk p80a6-fine-division-exists-p
    (r-type gauge)
  (exists (division)
    (and
     (p80a6-tagged-division-p r-type division)
     (p80a6-fine-tagged-division-p
      r-type gauge division))))

(defun-sk p80a6-all-fine-sums-close-p
    (r-type function derivative-function
            integral gauge epsilon)
  (forall (division)
    (implies
     (and
      (p80a6-tagged-division-p r-type division)
      (p80a6-fine-tagged-division-p
       r-type gauge division))
     (p80a6-lt
      r-type
      (p80a6-abs
       r-type
       (p80a6-sub
        r-type
        (p80a6-residual-riemann-sum
         r-type function derivative-function division)
        integral))
      epsilon))))

(defun-sk p80a6-integral-gauge-exists-p
    (r-type function derivative-function
            integral epsilon)
  (exists (gauge)
    (and
     (p80a6-real-function-p r-type gauge)
     (p80a6-positive-gauge-p r-type gauge)
     (p80a6-fine-division-exists-p r-type gauge)
     (p80a6-all-fine-sums-close-p
      r-type
      function
      derivative-function
      integral
      gauge
      epsilon))))

(defun-sk p80a6-has-residual-integral-p
    (r-type function derivative-function integral)
  (forall (epsilon)
    (implies
     (and
      (p80a6-real-p r-type epsilon)
      (p80a6-lt
       r-type
       (p80a6-zero r-type)
       epsilon))
     (p80a6-integral-gauge-exists-p
      r-type
      function
      derivative-function
      integral
      epsilon))))

;; Direct characteristic predicate for the source set of real lower bounds,
;; followed by its greatest-element condition.

(defun-sk p80a6-lower-bound-p (r-type lower-bound)
  (forall (function derivative-function integral)
    (implies
     (and
      (p80a6-real-p r-type lower-bound)
      (p80a6-admissible-representation-p
       r-type function derivative-function)
      (p80a6-real-p r-type integral)
      (p80a6-has-residual-integral-p
       r-type function derivative-function integral))
     (p80a6-le r-type lower-bound integral))))

(defun-sk p80a6-dominates-all-lower-bounds-p
    (r-type greatest)
  (forall (lower-bound)
    (implies
     (and
      (p80a6-real-p r-type lower-bound)
      (p80a6-lower-bound-p r-type lower-bound))
     (p80a6-le r-type lower-bound greatest))))

(defun p80a6-greatest-lower-bound-p
    (r-type greatest)
  (and
   (p80a6-real-p r-type greatest)
   (p80a6-lower-bound-p r-type greatest)
   (p80a6-dominates-all-lower-bounds-p
    r-type greatest)))

(defun-sk putnambench-putnam-1980-a6-statement ()
  (forall (r-type e-value)
    (implies
     (and
      (p80a6-real-structure-p r-type)
      (p80a6-real-p r-type e-value)
      (p80a6-exp-one-value-p r-type e-value))
     (p80a6-greatest-lower-bound-p
      r-type
      (p80a6-inv r-type e-value)))))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

title: putnam_1980_a6
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1980_a6:
-- the greatest universal lower bound, equal to 1 / exp(1), for the integral
-- of |f' - f| over [0,1] among C1 real functions with f(0)=0 and f(1)=1.
-- This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; _*_)

infix 4 _!=_ _<=N_
infixr 3 _and_
infixr 2 _or_

data Bottom : Set where

Not : Set -> Set
Not A =
  A -> Bottom

_!=_ : {A : Set} -> A -> A -> Set
x != y =
  Not (x == y)

record _and_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data _or_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  left  : A -> A or B
  right : B -> A or B

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

data _<=N_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set where
  zero<=   : {n : Nat} -> zero <=N n
  suc<=suc : {m n : Nat} -> m <=N n -> suc m <=N suc n

record CompleteOrderedRealField (R : Set) : Set1 where
  field
    zeroR oneR : R
    add multiply : R -> R -> R
    negate inverse absoluteValue : R -> R
    lessOrEqual : R -> R -> Set
    fromNat : Nat -> R

    one-not-zero :
      oneR != zeroR

    add-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> add x y == add y x
    add-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      add (add x y) z == add x (add y z)
    add-zero :
      (x : R) -> add x zeroR == x
    add-inverse :
      (x : R) -> add x (negate x) == zeroR

    multiply-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> multiply x y == multiply y x
    multiply-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply (multiply x y) z ==
      multiply x (multiply y z)
    multiply-one :
      (x : R) -> multiply x oneR == x
    multiply-zero :
      (x : R) -> multiply x zeroR == zeroR
    distribute :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply x (add y z) ==
      add (multiply x y) (multiply x z)
    inverse-zero :
      inverse zeroR == zeroR
    multiply-inverse :
      (x : R) ->
      x != zeroR ->
      multiply x (inverse x) == oneR

    order-reflexive :
      (x : R) -> lessOrEqual x x
    order-transitive :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y z ->
      lessOrEqual x z
    order-antisymmetric :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y x ->
      x == y
    order-total :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y or lessOrEqual y x
    add-order :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual (add z x) (add z y)
    multiply-nonnegative :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR x ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR y ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR (multiply x y)
    zero-less-than-one :
      lessOrEqual zeroR oneR and zeroR != oneR

    absolute-nonnegative :
      (x : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR (absoluteValue x)
    absolute-of-nonnegative :
      (x : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR x ->
      absoluteValue x == x
    absolute-of-nonpositive :
      (x : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x zeroR ->
      absoluteValue x == negate x

    fromNat-zero :
      fromNat zero == zeroR
    fromNat-successor :
      (n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (suc n) == add (fromNat n) oneR
    fromNat-addition :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m + n) == add (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-multiplication :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m * n) == multiply (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-injective :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat m == fromNat n ->
      m == n

    archimedean :
      (x : R) ->
      Exists Nat (\ n -> lessOrEqual x (fromNat n))
    least-upper-bound :
      (P : R -> Set) ->
      Exists R P ->
      Exists R
        (\ upper ->
          (x : R) ->
          P x ->
          lessOrEqual x upper) ->
      Exists R
        (\ supremum ->
          ((x : R) ->
            P x ->
            lessOrEqual x supremum)
          and
          ((upper : R) ->
            ((x : R) ->
              P x ->
              lessOrEqual x upper) ->
            lessOrEqual supremum upper))

open CompleteOrderedRealField

subtract :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
subtract reals x y =
  add reals x (negate reals y)

divide :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
divide reals x y =
  multiply reals x (inverse reals y)

StrictLess :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
StrictLess reals x y =
  lessOrEqual reals x y and x != y

CloseTo :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
CloseTo reals center radius x =
  StrictLess reals
    (subtract reals center radius)
    x
  and
  StrictLess reals
    x
    (add reals center radius)

Between :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
Between reals lower upper x =
  lessOrEqual reals lower x
  and
  lessOrEqual reals x upper

ContinuousOnInterval :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  (R -> R) ->
  Set
ContinuousOnInterval {R} reals lower upper function =
  (point : R) ->
  Between reals lower upper point ->
  (epsilon : R) ->
  StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) epsilon ->
  Exists R
    (\ delta ->
      StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) delta
      and
      ((x : R) ->
        Between reals lower upper x ->
        CloseTo reals point delta x ->
        CloseTo reals
          (function point)
          epsilon
          (function x)))

differenceQuotient :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (R -> R) ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
differenceQuotient reals function point x =
  divide reals
    (subtract reals (function x) (function point))
    (subtract reals x point)

DerivativeWithinIntervalAt :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  (R -> R) ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
DerivativeWithinIntervalAt {R} reals lower upper function point derivative =
  (epsilon : R) ->
  StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) epsilon ->
  Exists R
    (\ delta ->
      StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) delta
      and
      ((x : R) ->
        Between reals lower upper x ->
        CloseTo reals point delta x ->
        x != point ->
        CloseTo reals derivative epsilon
          (differenceQuotient reals function point x)))

record C1UnitIntervalFunction
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R)
  (function : R -> R) :
  Set where

  field
    derivative : R -> R

    function-continuous :
      ContinuousOnInterval reals
        (zeroR reals)
        (oneR reals)
        function

    derivative-correct :
      (x : R) ->
      Between reals (zeroR reals) (oneR reals) x ->
      DerivativeWithinIntervalAt reals
        (zeroR reals)
        (oneR reals)
        function
        x
        (derivative x)

    derivative-continuous :
      ContinuousOnInterval reals
        (zeroR reals)
        (oneR reals)
        derivative

    value-at-zero :
      function (zeroR reals) == zeroR reals

    value-at-one :
      function (oneR reals) == oneR reals

open C1UnitIntervalFunction

oneN : Nat
oneN =
  suc zero

factorial : Nat -> Nat
factorial zero =
  oneN
factorial (suc n) =
  suc n * factorial n

naturalPower :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  Nat ->
  R
naturalPower reals x zero =
  oneR reals
naturalPower reals x (suc n) =
  multiply reals
    (naturalPower reals x n)
    x

sumFirst :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Nat ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  R
sumFirst reals zero terms =
  zeroR reals
sumFirst reals (suc n) terms =
  add reals
    (sumFirst reals n terms)
    (terms n)

ConvergesTo :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  R ->
  Set
ConvergesTo {R} reals sequence limit =
  (epsilon : R) ->
  StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) epsilon ->
  Exists Nat
    (\ cutoff ->
      (n : Nat) ->
      cutoff <=N n ->
      CloseTo reals limit epsilon (sequence n))

SeriesHasSum :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  R ->
  Set
SeriesHasSum reals terms limit =
  ConvergesTo reals
    (\ n -> sumFirst reals n terms)
    limit

exponentialTerm :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  Nat ->
  R
exponentialTerm reals x n =
  divide reals
    (naturalPower reals x n)
    (fromNat reals (factorial n))

record StandardExponential
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) :
  Set1 where

  field
    exponential : R -> R

    exponential-series :
      (x : R) ->
      SeriesHasSum reals
        (exponentialTerm reals x)
        (exponential x)

    exponential-positive :
      (x : R) ->
      StrictLess reals
        (zeroR reals)
        (exponential x)

open StandardExponential

midpointRiemannSum :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  (R -> R) ->
  Nat ->
  R
midpointRiemannSum reals lower upper function pieces =
  let
    two =
      fromNat reals (suc (suc zero))
    step =
      divide reals
        (subtract reals upper lower)
        (fromNat reals pieces)
    halfStep =
      divide reals step two
  in
  sumFirst reals pieces
    (\ i ->
      multiply reals
        (function
          (add reals lower
            (add reals
              (multiply reals
                (fromNat reals i)
                step)
              halfStep)))
        step)

IntervalIntegralValue :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  (R -> R) ->
  R ->
  Set
IntervalIntegralValue reals lower upper function value =
  ConvergesTo reals
    (\ n ->
      midpointRiemannSum reals
        lower
        upper
        function
        (suc n))
    value

record StandardIntervalIntegration
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) :
  Set1 where

  field
    intervalIntegral :
      R ->
      R ->
      (R -> R) ->
      R

    integral-of-continuous :
      (lower upper : R) ->
      (function : R -> R) ->
      lessOrEqual reals lower upper ->
      ContinuousOnInterval reals lower upper function ->
      IntervalIntegralValue reals
        lower
        upper
        function
        (intervalIntegral lower upper function)

open StandardIntervalIntegration

record IsGreatest
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R)
  (property : R -> Set)
  (greatest : R) :
  Set where

  field
    belongs :
      property greatest

    greatest-property :
      (x : R) ->
      property x ->
      lessOrEqual reals x greatest

module Putnam1980A6Statement
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R)
  (analysis : StandardExponential reals)
  (integration : StandardIntervalIntegration reals) where

  solution : R
  solution =
    divide reals
      (oneR reals)
      (exponential analysis (oneR reals))

  integrand :
    (function : R -> R) ->
    C1UnitIntervalFunction reals function ->
    R ->
    R
  integrand function admissible x =
    absoluteValue reals
      (subtract reals
        (derivative admissible x)
        (function x))

  objective :
    (function : R -> R) ->
    C1UnitIntervalFunction reals function ->
    R
  objective function admissible =
    intervalIntegral integration
      (zeroR reals)
      (oneR reals)
      (integrand function admissible)

  UniversalLowerBound : R -> Set
  UniversalLowerBound lower =
    (function : R -> R) ->
    (admissible : C1UnitIntervalFunction reals function) ->
    lessOrEqual reals lower (objective function admissible)

  proposition : Set
  proposition =
    IsGreatest reals UniversalLowerBound solution

putnam-1980-a6 : Set1
putnam-1980-a6 =
  (R : Set) ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) ->
  (analysis : StandardExponential reals) ->
  (integration : StandardIntervalIntegration reals) ->
  Putnam1980A6Statement.proposition reals analysis integration

(*
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1980_a6:
  the greatest uniform lower bound of the integral of the absolute difference
  between a continuously differentiable function's derivative and its value
  on the unit interval. This file contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open pred_setTheory realTheory real_topologyTheory transcTheory derivativeTheory;
open extrealTheory measureTheory borelTheory lebesgueTheory;
open lebesgue_measureTheory;

val putnam_1980_a6 =
  ``let unit_interval = interval [0, 1]
    in
    let C =
      \f : real -> real.
        f differentiable_on unit_interval /\
        (\x : real.
           vector_derivative f (at x within unit_interval))
          continuous_on unit_interval /\
        f 0 = 0 /\
        f 1 = 1
    in
    let integral_value =
      \f : real -> real.
        real
          (lebesgue$integral
             (restrict_space lebesgue unit_interval)
             (\x : real.
                Normal
                  (abs
                     (vector_derivative f (at x within unit_interval) -
                      f x))))
    in
    let solution = 1 / exp 1
    in
      (!f : real -> real.
         C f
         ==>
         solution <= integral_value f) /\
      (!u : real.
         (!f : real -> real.
            C f
            ==>
            u <= integral_value f)
         ==>
         u <= solution)``;

$(
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact
  putnam_1980_a6: the greatest real lower bound of the integral of
  |f'(x) - f(x)| over the unit interval, among continuously differentiable
  real functions with f(0) = 0 and f(1) = 1, is 1 / exp(1). This file
  contains no proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  F ranges over all total real-valued functions. Membership of its
  restriction to [0,1] in the order-one C^n class is set.mm's native
  formulation of continuous differentiability on that closed interval.
  On the open interval (0,1), the ordinary real derivative RR _D F agrees
  with the derivative of the restriction. Using the open interval in the
  Lebesgue integral is equivalent to the endpoint-inclusive source integral.

  The two conjuncts in the final assertion expand IsGreatest: 1 / exp(1)
  is a lower bound for every admissible function, and every real number with
  that lower-bound property is at most 1 / exp(1). The declaration is the
  single unproved $a corpus statement; this database contains no $p proof
  statement.
$)

${
  $d f u x $.

  putnambench-putnam-1980-a6 $a |- (
    (
      A. f e. ( RR ^m RR )
        (
          (
            (
              ( f |` ( 0 [,] 1 ) )
              e. ( ( C^n ` ( 0 [,] 1 ) ) ` 1 )
              /\
              ( f ` 0 ) = 0
            )
            /\
            ( f ` 1 ) = 1
          )
          ->
          ( 1 / ( exp ` 1 ) )
          <_
          S. ( 0 (,) 1 )
            (
              abs `
                (
                  ( ( RR _D f ) ` x )
                  -
                  ( f ` x )
                )
            )
            _d x
        )
      /\
      A. u e. RR
        (
          (
            A. f e. ( RR ^m RR )
              (
                (
                  (
                    ( f |` ( 0 [,] 1 ) )
                    e. ( ( C^n ` ( 0 [,] 1 ) ) ` 1 )
                    /\
                    ( f ` 0 ) = 0
                  )
                  /\
                  ( f ` 1 ) = 1
                )
                ->
                u
                <_
                S. ( 0 (,) 1 )
                  (
                    abs `
                      (
                        ( ( RR _D f ) ` x )
                        -
                        ( f ` x )
                      )
                  )
                  _d x
              )
          )
          ->
          u <_ ( 1 / ( exp ` 1 ) )
        )
    )
  ) $.
$}

title: putnam_1980_a6
content:
% Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench artifact putnam_1980_a6:
% the greatest universal lower bound of the unit-interval integral of
% |f'(x) - f(x)| over C1 real functions with f(0) = 0 and f(1) = 1 is
% 1/exp(1). This file contains no proof.

putnam_1980_a6: THEORY
BEGIN
  real_function: TYPE = [real -> real]
  real_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> real]

  safe_div(numerator, denominator: real): real =
    IF denominator = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      numerator / denominator
    ENDIF

  partial_sum(values: real_sequence, count: nat): RECURSIVE real =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      partial_sum(values, count - 1) + values(count - 1)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  nat_factorial(index: nat): RECURSIVE nat =
    IF index = 0 THEN
      1
    ELSE
      index * nat_factorial(index - 1)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE index

  series_sums_to(values: real_sequence, total: real): bool =
    FORALL (epsilon_value: posreal):
      EXISTS (cutoff: nat):
        FORALL (count: nat):
          cutoff <= count IMPLIES
            abs(partial_sum(values, count) - total) < epsilon_value

  exponential_terms(x: real): real_sequence =
    LAMBDA (index: nat):
      safe_div(
        x ^ index,
        nat_factorial(index) :: real)

  real_exponential(x: real): real =
    epsilon(
      LAMBDA (value: real):
        series_sums_to(exponential_terms(x), value))

  in_closed_unit_interval(x: real): bool =
    0 <= x AND x <= 1

  continuous_on_closed_unit_interval(f: real_function): bool =
    FORALL (x: real):
      in_closed_unit_interval(x) IMPLIES
        FORALL (epsilon_value: posreal):
          EXISTS (delta: posreal):
            FORALL (y: real):
              (in_closed_unit_interval(y)
                AND abs(y - x) < delta)
              IMPLIES
                abs(f(y) - f(x)) < epsilon_value

  has_derivative_within_closed_unit_interval(
      f: real_function,
      derivative, x: real): bool =
    FORALL (epsilon_value: posreal):
      EXISTS (delta: posreal):
        FORALL (y: real):
          (in_closed_unit_interval(y)
            AND NOT (y = x)
            AND abs(y - x) < delta)
          IMPLIES
            abs(
              f(y) - f(x)
                - derivative * (y - x))
              < epsilon_value * abs(y - x)

  continuously_differentiable_on_closed_unit_interval(
      f, derivative: real_function): bool =
    continuous_on_closed_unit_interval(f)
      AND continuous_on_closed_unit_interval(derivative)
      AND FORALL (x: real):
        in_closed_unit_interval(x) IMPLIES
          has_derivative_within_closed_unit_interval(
            f, derivative(x), x)

  valid_tagged_partition(
      points, tags: real_sequence,
      count: nat): bool =
    count > 0
      AND points(0) = 0
      AND points(count) = 1
      AND FORALL (index: nat):
        index < count IMPLIES
          (points(index) < points(index + 1)
            AND points(index) <= tags(index)
            AND tags(index) <= points(index + 1))

  mesh_less_than(
      points: real_sequence,
      count: nat,
      bound: real): bool =
    FORALL (index: nat):
      index < count IMPLIES
        points(index + 1) - points(index) < bound

  riemann_sum(
      f: real_function,
      points, tags: real_sequence,
      count: nat): RECURSIVE real =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      riemann_sum(f, points, tags, count - 1)
        + f(tags(count - 1))
            * (points(count) - points(count - 1))
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  has_unit_interval_integral(
      f: real_function,
      integral_value: real): bool =
    FORALL (epsilon_value: posreal):
      EXISTS (mesh_bound: posreal):
        FORALL
            (points, tags: real_sequence),
            (count: nat):
          (valid_tagged_partition(points, tags, count)
            AND mesh_less_than(points, count, mesh_bound))
          IMPLIES
            abs(
              riemann_sum(f, points, tags, count)
                - integral_value)
              < epsilon_value

  unit_interval_integral(f: real_function): real =
    IF EXISTS (integral_value: real):
        has_unit_interval_integral(f, integral_value)
    THEN
      epsilon(
        LAMBDA (integral_value: real):
          has_unit_interval_integral(f, integral_value))
    ELSE
      0
    ENDIF

  admissible(
      f, derivative: real_function): bool =
    continuously_differentiable_on_closed_unit_interval(f, derivative)
      AND f(0) = 0
      AND f(1) = 1

  universal_lower_bound(bound: real): bool =
    FORALL (f, derivative: real_function):
      admissible(f, derivative) IMPLIES
        bound <=
          unit_interval_integral(
            LAMBDA (x: real):
              abs(derivative(x) - f(x)))

  is_greatest_universal_lower_bound(value: real): bool =
    universal_lower_bound(value)
      AND FORALL (bound: real):
        universal_lower_bound(bound) IMPLIES bound <= value

  putnam_1980_a6_solution: real =
    safe_div(1, real_exponential(1))

  putnam_1980_a6: bool =
    is_greatest_universal_lower_bound(
      putnam_1980_a6_solution)
END putnam_1980_a6

title: putnam_1980_b1
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1980_b1:
;; the real constants c for which (exp(x) + exp(-x))/2 is at most
;; exp(c*x^2) for every real x are exactly those with c >= 1/2. This file
;; contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

;; Standard ACL2 has exact rational arithmetic but no primitive real
;; exponential. The rational Taylor prefixes below converge to exp(y).
(defun putnam-1980-b1-factorial (n)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix n)))
  (if (zp n)
      1
    (* n
       (putnam-1980-b1-factorial (- n 1)))))

(defun putnam-1980-b1-exp-prefix (y terms)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix terms)))
  (if (zp terms)
      0
    (let ((index (- terms 1)))
      (+ (putnam-1980-b1-exp-prefix y index)
         (/ (expt y index)
            (putnam-1980-b1-factorial index))))))

;; Multiplying the source inequality by exp(K), where
;;
;;   K = 1 + floor(|x| + |c*x^2|),
;;
;; gives
;;
;;   exp(K+x) + exp(K-x) <= 2*exp(K+c*x^2).
;;
;; All three Taylor arguments are nonnegative. Requiring every sufficiently
;; long pair of prefixes to satisfy the inequality up to every positive
;; rational tolerance is exactly the non-strict real inequality after taking
;; limits.
(defun putnam-1980-b1-shift (c x)
  (+ 1
     (floor (+ (abs x)
               (abs (* c x x)))
            1)))

(defun putnam-1980-b1-forward-approximant-p
    (c x epsilon left-terms right-terms)
  (let* ((shift (putnam-1980-b1-shift c x))
         (positive-x (+ shift x))
         (negative-x (- shift x))
         (quadratic (+ shift (* c x x))))
    (< (+ (putnam-1980-b1-exp-prefix
           positive-x left-terms)
          (putnam-1980-b1-exp-prefix
           negative-x left-terms))
       (+ (* 2
             (putnam-1980-b1-exp-prefix
              quadratic right-terms))
          epsilon))))

(defun-sk putnam-1980-b1-forward-tail-p
    (c x epsilon cutoff)
  (forall (left-terms right-terms)
    (implies
     (and
      (natp left-terms)
      (natp right-terms)
      (<= cutoff left-terms)
      (<= cutoff right-terms))
     (putnam-1980-b1-forward-approximant-p
      c x epsilon left-terms right-terms))))

(defun-sk putnam-1980-b1-forward-cutoff-exists-p
    (c x epsilon)
  (exists (cutoff)
    (and
     (natp cutoff)
     (< 0 cutoff)
     (putnam-1980-b1-forward-tail-p
      c x epsilon cutoff))))

(defun putnam-1980-b1-reverse-approximant-p
    (c x margin left-terms right-terms)
  (let* ((shift (putnam-1980-b1-shift c x))
         (positive-x (+ shift x))
         (negative-x (- shift x))
         (quadratic (+ shift (* c x x))))
    (< (+ (* 2
             (putnam-1980-b1-exp-prefix
              quadratic right-terms))
          margin)
       (+ (putnam-1980-b1-exp-prefix
           positive-x left-terms)
          (putnam-1980-b1-exp-prefix
           negative-x left-terms)))))

(defun-sk putnam-1980-b1-reverse-tail-p
    (c x margin cutoff)
  (forall (left-terms right-terms)
    (implies
     (and
      (natp left-terms)
      (natp right-terms)
      (<= cutoff left-terms)
      (<= cutoff right-terms))
     (putnam-1980-b1-reverse-approximant-p
      c x margin left-terms right-terms))))

;; For c < 1/2 the source asks only for some real counterexample. A strict
;; real counterexample persists at a nearby rational x, and a positive
;; rational margin can be placed below its gap. The existential below states
;; exactly that eventual strict prefix separation; it does not prescribe a
;; witness or a Taylor rate.
(defun-sk putnam-1980-b1-counterexample-exists-p (c)
  (exists (x margin cutoff)
    (and
     (rationalp x)
     (rationalp margin)
     (< 0 margin)
     (natp cutoff)
     (< 0 cutoff)
     (putnam-1980-b1-reverse-tail-p
      c x margin cutoff))))

;; Rational c and x suffice without narrowing the theorem. Continuity extends
;; the forward inequality from rational x to real x. Monotonicity in c extends
;; it from rational c >= 1/2 to every real c >= 1/2. If a real c is below
;; 1/2, choose a rational r with c < r < 1/2; a counterexample for r is also
;; one for c. Thus the two clauses below are bidirectionally equivalent to the
;; source characterization over all reals.
(defun putnambench-putnam-1980-b1-statement
    (c x epsilon)
  (and
   (implies
    (and (rationalp c)
         (<= 1/2 c)
         (rationalp x)
         (rationalp epsilon)
         (< 0 epsilon))
