-- Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1981_a3:
-- nonexistence of a finite real limit at positive infinity for an exponentially
-- normalized double interval integral of (exp x - exp y) / (x - y).
-- This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; _*_)

infix 4 _!=_ _<=N_
infixr 3 _and_
infixr 2 _or_
infix 1 _iff_

data Bottom : Set where

Not : Set -> Set
Not A =
  A -> Bottom

_!=_ : {A : Set} -> A -> A -> Set
x != y =
  Not (x == y)

record _and_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data _or_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  left  : A -> A or B
  right : B -> A or B

record _iff_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor equivalence
  field
    forward  : A -> B
    backward : B -> A

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

data _<=N_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set where
  zero<=   : {n : Nat} -> zero <=N n
  suc<=suc : {m n : Nat} -> m <=N n -> suc m <=N suc n

record CompleteOrderedRealField (R : Set) : Set1 where
  field
    zeroR oneR : R
    add multiply : R -> R -> R
    negate inverse : R -> R
    lessOrEqual : R -> R -> Set
    fromNat : Nat -> R

    one-not-zero :
      oneR != zeroR

    add-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> add x y == add y x
    add-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      add (add x y) z == add x (add y z)
    add-zero :
      (x : R) -> add x zeroR == x
    add-inverse :
      (x : R) -> add x (negate x) == zeroR

    multiply-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> multiply x y == multiply y x
    multiply-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply (multiply x y) z ==
      multiply x (multiply y z)
    multiply-one :
      (x : R) -> multiply x oneR == x
    multiply-zero :
      (x : R) -> multiply x zeroR == zeroR
    distribute :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply x (add y z) ==
      add (multiply x y) (multiply x z)
    inverse-zero :
      inverse zeroR == zeroR
    multiply-inverse :
      (x : R) ->
      x != zeroR ->
      multiply x (inverse x) == oneR

    order-reflexive :
      (x : R) -> lessOrEqual x x
    order-transitive :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y z ->
      lessOrEqual x z
    order-antisymmetric :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y x ->
      x == y
    order-total :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y or lessOrEqual y x
    add-order :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual (add z x) (add z y)
    multiply-nonnegative :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR x ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR y ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR (multiply x y)
    zero-less-than-one :
      lessOrEqual zeroR oneR and zeroR != oneR

    fromNat-zero :
      fromNat zero == zeroR
    fromNat-successor :
      (n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (suc n) == add (fromNat n) oneR
    fromNat-addition :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m + n) == add (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-multiplication :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m * n) == multiply (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-injective :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat m == fromNat n ->
      m == n

    archimedean :
      (x : R) ->
      Exists Nat (\ n -> lessOrEqual x (fromNat n))
    least-upper-bound :
      (P : R -> Set) ->
      Exists R P ->
      Exists R
        (\ upper ->
          (x : R) ->
          P x ->
          lessOrEqual x upper) ->
      Exists R
        (\ supremum ->
          ((x : R) ->
            P x ->
            lessOrEqual x supremum)
          and
          ((upper : R) ->
            ((x : R) ->
              P x ->
              lessOrEqual x upper) ->
            lessOrEqual supremum upper))

open CompleteOrderedRealField

subtract :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
subtract reals x y =
  add reals x (negate reals y)

divide :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
divide reals x y =
  multiply reals x (inverse reals y)

StrictLess :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
StrictLess reals x y =
  lessOrEqual reals x y and x != y

CloseTo :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
CloseTo reals center radius x =
  StrictLess reals
    (subtract reals center radius)
    x
  and
  StrictLess reals
    x
    (add reals center radius)

SequentialLimit :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  R ->
  Set
SequentialLimit {R} reals sequence limit =
  (epsilon : R) ->
  StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) epsilon ->
  Exists Nat
    (\ cutoff ->
      (n : Nat) ->
      cutoff <=N n ->
      CloseTo reals limit epsilon (sequence n))

LimitAtPositiveInfinity :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (R -> R) ->
  R ->
  Set
LimitAtPositiveInfinity {R} reals function limit =
  (epsilon : R) ->
  StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) epsilon ->
  Exists R
    (\ threshold ->
      (x : R) ->
      lessOrEqual reals threshold x ->
      CloseTo reals limit epsilon (function x))

naturalPower :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  Nat ->
  R
naturalPower reals x zero =
  oneR reals
naturalPower reals x (suc n) =
  multiply reals
    (naturalPower reals x n)
    x

factorial : Nat -> Nat
factorial zero =
  suc zero
factorial (suc n) =
  suc n * factorial n

sumFirst :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Nat ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  R
sumFirst reals zero terms =
  zeroR reals
sumFirst reals (suc n) terms =
  add reals
    (sumFirst reals n terms)
    (terms n)

exponentialPartialSum :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  Nat ->
  R
exponentialPartialSum reals x terms =
  sumFirst reals terms
    (\ n ->
      divide reals
        (naturalPower reals x n)
        (fromNat reals (factorial n)))

ExponentialValue :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
ExponentialValue reals x value =
  SequentialLimit reals
    (exponentialPartialSum reals x)
    value

rightRiemannSum :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  (R -> R) ->
  Nat ->
  R
rightRiemannSum reals lower upper function pieces =
  let
    step =
      divide reals
        (subtract reals upper lower)
        (fromNat reals pieces)
  in
  sumFirst reals pieces
    (\ i ->
      multiply reals
        (function
          (add reals lower
            (multiply reals
              (fromNat reals (suc i))
              step)))
        step)

IntervalIntegralValue :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  (R -> R) ->
  R ->
  Set
IntervalIntegralValue reals lower upper function value =
  SequentialLimit reals
    (\ n ->
      rightRiemannSum reals
        lower
        upper
        function
        (suc n))
    value

record StandardRealAnalysis
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) :
  Set1 where

  field
    exponential : R -> R

    exponential-is-power-series :
      (x : R) ->
      ExponentialValue reals x (exponential x)

    intervalIntegral :
      R ->
      R ->
      (R -> R) ->
      R

    interval-integral-is-riemann :
      (lower upper : R) ->
      (function : R -> R) ->
      Exists R
        (\ value ->
          IntervalIntegralValue reals
            lower
            upper
            function
            value) ->
      IntervalIntegralValue reals
        lower
        upper
        function
        (intervalIntegral lower upper function)

open StandardRealAnalysis

module Putnam1981A3Statement
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R)
  (analysis : StandardRealAnalysis reals) where

  integrand : R -> R -> R
  integrand y x =
    divide reals
      (subtract reals
        (exponential analysis x)
        (exponential analysis y))
      (subtract reals x y)

  innerIntegral : R -> R -> R
  innerIntegral t y =
    intervalIntegral analysis
      (zeroR reals)
      t
      (integrand y)

  doubleIntegral : R -> R
  doubleIntegral t =
    intervalIntegral analysis
      (zeroR reals)
      t
      (innerIntegral t)

  normalizedIntegral : R -> R
  normalizedIntegral t =
    multiply reals
      (exponential analysis (negate reals t))
      (doubleIntegral t)

  putnam-1981-a3-solution : Set
  putnam-1981-a3-solution =
    Bottom

  proposition : Set
  proposition =
    Exists R
      (\ limit ->
        LimitAtPositiveInfinity reals
          normalizedIntegral
          limit)
    iff
    putnam-1981-a3-solution

putnam-1981-a3 : Set1
putnam-1981-a3 =
  (R : Set) ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) ->
  (analysis : StandardRealAnalysis reals) ->
  Putnam1981A3Statement.proposition reals analysis

(*
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1981_a3:
  nonexistence of a finite limit at positive infinity for an exponentially
  scaled iterated integral of a divided difference of the exponential
  function. This file contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open pred_setTheory realTheory real_topologyTheory transcTheory
     integrationTheory;

val putnam_1981_a3 =
  ``let f =
      \t : real.
        exp (-t) *
        integration$integral (interval [0, t])
          (\y : real.
             integration$integral (interval [0, t])
               (\x : real. (exp x - exp y) / (x - y)))
    in
      ~(?L : real. (f --> L) at_posinfinity)``;

$(
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact
  putnam_1981_a3: nonexistence of a finite real limit at positive infinity
  for the specified exponentially scaled iterated integral. This file
  contains no proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  The nested S. binders are set.mm's real Lebesgue integrals. For positive
  t, the open interval (0,t) differs from the half-open or closed source
  intervals only at endpoints of measure zero. Values for negative t are
  irrelevant to the limit at positive infinity.

  The epsilon-threshold formula expands Tendsto atTop to a finite real L.
  Its outer negation is the source equivalence with the solution False.
  The declaration is the single unproved $a corpus statement; this database
  contains no $p proof statement.
$)

${
  $d L e m t x y $.

  putnambench-putnam-1981-a3 $a |- -. E. L e. RR
    A. e e. RR
      (
        0 < e
        ->
        E. m e. RR
          A. t e. RR
            (
              m <_ t
              ->
              (
                abs
                `
                (
                  (
                    ( exp ` ( -u t ) )
                    x.
                    S. ( 0 (,) t )
                      (
                        S. ( 0 (,) t )
                          (
                            (
                              ( exp ` x )
                              -
                              ( exp ` y )
                            )
                            /
                            ( x - y )
                          )
                          _d x
                      )
                      _d y
                  )
                  -
                  L
                )
              )
              < e
            )
      )
  $.
$}

title: putnam_1981_a3
content:
% Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1981_a3:
% whether the exponentially scaled double integral of
% (exp(x) - exp(y)) / (x - y) over [0,t]^2 has a finite limit as t tends to
% positive infinity. This file contains no proof.

putnam_1981_a3: THEORY
BEGIN
  real_function: TYPE = [real -> real]
  real_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> real]

  safe_div(numerator, denominator: real): real =
    IF denominator = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      numerator / denominator
    ENDIF

  nat_factorial(index: nat): RECURSIVE nat =
    IF index = 0 THEN
      1
    ELSE
      index * nat_factorial(index - 1)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE index

  exponential_partial(x: real, count: nat): RECURSIVE real =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      LET index: nat = count - 1 IN
        exponential_partial(x, count - 1)
          + safe_div(
              x ^ index,
              nat_factorial(index) :: real)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  sequence_converges_to(
      sequence: real_sequence,
      value: real): bool =
    FORALL (epsilon_value: posreal):
      EXISTS (cutoff: nat):
        FORALL (index: nat):
          cutoff <= index IMPLIES
            abs(sequence(index) - value) < epsilon_value

  real_exponential(x: real): real =
    epsilon(
      LAMBDA (value: real):
        sequence_converges_to(
          LAMBDA (count: nat):
            exponential_partial(x, count),
          value))

  valid_tagged_partition(
      left, right: real,
      points, tags: real_sequence,
      count: nat): bool =
    count > 0
      AND points(0) = left
      AND points(count) = right
      AND FORALL (index: nat):
        index < count IMPLIES
          (points(index) < points(index + 1)
            AND points(index) <= tags(index)
            AND tags(index) <= points(index + 1))

  mesh_less_than(
      points: real_sequence,
      count: nat,
      bound: real): bool =
    FORALL (index: nat):
      index < count IMPLIES
        points(index + 1) - points(index) < bound

  riemann_sum(
      function_value: real_function,
      points, tags: real_sequence,
      count: nat): RECURSIVE real =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      riemann_sum(
        function_value, points, tags, count - 1)
        + function_value(tags(count - 1))
            * (points(count) - points(count - 1))
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  has_interval_integral(
      function_value: real_function,
      left, right, integral_value: real): bool =
    left < right
      AND FORALL (epsilon_value: posreal):
        EXISTS (mesh_bound: posreal):
          FORALL
              (points, tags: real_sequence),
              (count: nat):
            (valid_tagged_partition(
                left, right, points, tags, count)
              AND mesh_less_than(
                points, count, mesh_bound))
            IMPLIES
              abs(
                riemann_sum(
                  function_value, points, tags, count)
                  - integral_value)
                < epsilon_value

  interval_integral(
      function_value: real_function,
      left, right: real): real =
    IF left = right THEN
      0
    ELSIF left < right THEN
      IF EXISTS (integral_value: real):
          has_interval_integral(
            function_value, left, right, integral_value)
      THEN
        epsilon(
          LAMBDA (integral_value: real):
            has_interval_integral(
              function_value, left, right, integral_value))
      ELSE
        0
      ENDIF
    ELSE
      IF EXISTS (integral_value: real):
          has_interval_integral(
            function_value, right, left, integral_value)
      THEN
        -epsilon(
          LAMBDA (integral_value: real):
            has_interval_integral(
              function_value, right, left, integral_value))
      ELSE
        0
      ENDIF
    ENDIF

  kernel(x, y: real): real =
    safe_div(
      real_exponential(x) - real_exponential(y),
      x - y)

  inner_integral(t, y: real): real =
    interval_integral(
      LAMBDA (x: real): kernel(x, y),
      0,
      t)

  double_integral(t: real): real =
    interval_integral(
      LAMBDA (y: real): inner_integral(t, y),
      0,
      t)

  scaled_double_integral(t: real): real =
    real_exponential(-t) * double_integral(t)

  converges_at_real_top(
      function_value: real_function,
      limit_value: real): bool =
    FORALL (epsilon_value: posreal):
      EXISTS (cutoff: real):
        FORALL (t: real):
          cutoff <= t IMPLIES
            abs(function_value(t) - limit_value)
              < epsilon_value

  putnam_1981_a3_solution: bool = FALSE

  putnam_1981_a3: bool =
    (EXISTS (limit_value: real):
      converges_at_real_top(
        scaled_double_integral, limit_value))
      IFF putnam_1981_a3_solution
END putnam_1981_a3

title: putnam_1981_a5

import Mathlib

open Topology Filter Set Polynomial Function

abbrev putnam_1981_a5_solution : Prop := True
/--
Let $P(x)$ be a polynomial with real coefficients; let $$Q(x) = (x^2 + 1)P(x)P'(x) + x((P(x))^2 + (P'(x))^2).$$
Given that $P$ has $n$ distinct real roots all greater than $1$, prove or disprove that $Q$ must have at least $2n - 1$ distinct real roots.
-/
theorem putnam_1981_a5
(Q : Polynomial ℝ → Polynomial ℝ)
(hQ : Q = fun P : Polynomial ℝ => (X^2 + 1)*P*(derivative P) + X*(P^2 + (derivative P)^2))
(n : Polynomial ℝ → ℝ)
(hn : n = fun P : Polynomial ℝ => ({x ∈ Ioi 1 | P.eval x = 0}.ncard : ℝ))
: (∀ P : Polynomial ℝ, {x : ℝ | (Q P).eval x = 0}.ncard ≥ 2*(n P) - 1) ↔ putnam_1981_a5_solution :=
sorry

title: putnam_1981_a5
content:
(* Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench artifact putnam_1981_a5:
   distinct real roots of a polynomial expression involving a polynomial and
   its derivative. This file contains no proof. *)

From Stdlib Require Import Reals List ClassicalDescription ClassicalEpsilon.

Import ListNotations.
Open Scope R_scope.

Definition putnam_1981_a5_polynomial : Type := list R.

Fixpoint putnam_1981_a5_eval
    (P : putnam_1981_a5_polynomial) (x : R) : R :=
  match P with
  | [] => 0
  | a :: P' => a + x * putnam_1981_a5_eval P' x
  end.

Fixpoint putnam_1981_a5_add
    (P Q : putnam_1981_a5_polynomial) : putnam_1981_a5_polynomial :=
  match P, Q with
  | [], Q' => Q'
  | P', [] => P'
  | a :: P', b :: Q' => (a + b) :: putnam_1981_a5_add P' Q'
  end.

Definition putnam_1981_a5_scale
    (a : R) (P : putnam_1981_a5_polynomial) :
    putnam_1981_a5_polynomial :=
  map (fun b : R => a * b) P.

Fixpoint putnam_1981_a5_mul
    (P Q : putnam_1981_a5_polynomial) : putnam_1981_a5_polynomial :=
  match P with
  | [] => []
  | a :: P' =>
      putnam_1981_a5_add
        (putnam_1981_a5_scale a Q)
        (0 :: putnam_1981_a5_mul P' Q)
  end.

Fixpoint putnam_1981_a5_derivative_coefficients
    (P : putnam_1981_a5_polynomial) (n : nat) :
    putnam_1981_a5_polynomial :=
  match P with
  | [] => []
  | a :: P' =>
      (INR n * a) ::
      putnam_1981_a5_derivative_coefficients P' (S n)
  end.

Definition putnam_1981_a5_derivative
    (P : putnam_1981_a5_polynomial) : putnam_1981_a5_polynomial :=
  match P with
  | [] => []
  | _ :: P' => putnam_1981_a5_derivative_coefficients P' 1%nat
  end.

Definition putnam_1981_a5_Q
    (P : putnam_1981_a5_polynomial) : putnam_1981_a5_polynomial :=
  let dP := putnam_1981_a5_derivative P in
  putnam_1981_a5_add
    (putnam_1981_a5_mul
      (putnam_1981_a5_mul [1; 0; 1] P) dP)
    (putnam_1981_a5_mul
      [0; 1]
      (putnam_1981_a5_add
        (putnam_1981_a5_mul P P)
        (putnam_1981_a5_mul dP dP))).

Definition putnam_1981_a5_has_cardinality
    (S : R -> Prop) (n : nat) : Prop :=
  exists xs : list R,
    NoDup xs /\
    (forall x : R, In x xs <-> S x) /\
    length xs = n.

Definition putnam_1981_a5_ncard (S : R -> Prop) : nat :=
  match excluded_middle_informative
          (exists n : nat, putnam_1981_a5_has_cardinality S n) with
  | left _ =>
      epsilon (inhabits 0%nat)
        (fun n : nat => putnam_1981_a5_has_cardinality S n)
  | right _ => 0%nat
  end.

Definition putnam_1981_a5_roots_above_one
    (P : putnam_1981_a5_polynomial) : R -> Prop :=
  fun x : R => 1 < x /\ putnam_1981_a5_eval P x = 0.

Definition putnam_1981_a5_roots
    (P : putnam_1981_a5_polynomial) : R -> Prop :=
  fun x : R => putnam_1981_a5_eval P x = 0.

Definition putnam_1981_a5_solution : Prop := True.

Theorem putnam_1981_a5 :
  (forall P : putnam_1981_a5_polynomial,
    INR
      (putnam_1981_a5_ncard
        (putnam_1981_a5_roots (putnam_1981_a5_Q P))) >=
    2 *
      INR
        (putnam_1981_a5_ncard
          (putnam_1981_a5_roots_above_one P)) - 1) <->
  putnam_1981_a5_solution.
Admitted.

title: putnam_1981_a5
content:
theory putnam_1981_a5 imports Complex_Main "HOL-Computational_Algebra.Polynomial"
begin

definition putnam_1981_a5_solution :: bool where
  "putnam_1981_a5_solution = True"
theorem putnam_1981_a5:
  fixes Q::"(real poly) \<Rightarrow> (real poly)" and n::"(real poly) \<Rightarrow> real"
  defines "Q \<equiv> \<lambda>P. [: 1, 0, 1 :] * P * (pderiv P) + [: 0, 1 :] * (P^2 + (pderiv P)^2)"
    and "n \<equiv> \<lambda>P. card {x::real. x > 1 \<and> (poly P x) = 0}"
  shows "(\<forall>P. card {x::real. poly (Q P) x = 0} \<ge> 2 * (n P) - 1) \<longleftrightarrow> putnam_1981_a5_solution"
  sorry

end

content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench artifact putnam_1981_a5:
  the lower bound on the number of distinct real roots of a polynomial
  expression involving a real polynomial and its derivative. This file
  contains no proof.
*)

let statement =
  `let has_derivative_at =
     \(f:real->real) (d:real) (x:real).
       !e:real.
         &0 < e
         ==> ?delta:real.
               &0 < delta /\
               !y:real.
                 &0 < abs (y - x) /\ abs (y - x) < delta
                 ==> abs ((f y - f x) / (y - x) - d) < e in
   let deriv =
     \(f:real->real) (x:real). @d:real. has_derivative_at f d x in
   let Q =
     \(P:real->real) (x:real).
       (x pow 2 + &1) * P x * deriv P x +
       x * ((P x) pow 2 + (deriv P x) pow 2) in
   let real_ncard =
     \s:real->bool. if FINITE s then &(CARD s) else &0 in
   let n =
     \(P:real->real). real_ncard {x:real | x > &1 /\ P x = &0} in
   ((!P:real->real.
       polynomial_function P
       ==> real_ncard {x:real | Q P x = &0} >= &2 * n P - &1) <=>
    T)`;;

title: putnam_1981_a5
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1981_a5:
;; every real polynomial P with n distinct roots greater than 1 gives
;; Q=(x^2+1)P P'+x(P^2+(P')^2) at least 2n-1 distinct real roots.
;; This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))

;; The statement is encoded by excluding its counterexamples. For any fixed
;; degrees and factor counts, existence of a counterexample is a first-order
;; sentence over real closed fields. Hence a real counterexample exists iff
;; one exists over the real algebraic numbers. Every finite tuple of real
;; algebraic numbers lies in Q(alpha) for one real algebraic alpha.
;;
;; PRIMITIVE with the rational interval (LOWER,UPPER) isolates alpha, and each
;; coefficient is a rational polynomial in alpha. Complete real factorizations
;; of P and Q list their distinct linear roots with positive multiplicities;
;; the remaining monic quadratic factors have negative discriminant. Thus the
;; linear lists count exactly all distinct real roots, without sampling roots,
;; bounding the degree, or restricting the source coefficients to rationals.

;; Rational polynomials in alpha use descending coefficient order.

(defun putnam-1981-a5-rp-p (p)
  (if (consp p)
      (and (rationalp (car p))
           (putnam-1981-a5-rp-p (cdr p)))
    (equal p nil)))

(defun putnam-1981-a5-rp-normalize (p)
  (if (consp p)
      (if (equal (car p) 0)
          (putnam-1981-a5-rp-normalize (cdr p))
        p)
    nil))

(defun putnam-1981-a5-rp-negate (p)
  (if (consp p)
      (cons (- (car p))
            (putnam-1981-a5-rp-negate (cdr p)))
    nil))

(defun putnam-1981-a5-rp-add-raw (p q)
  (declare (xargs :measure (+ (acl2-count p) (acl2-count q))))
  (cond
   ((endp p) q)
   ((endp q) p)
   ((< (len p) (len q))
    (cons (car q)
          (putnam-1981-a5-rp-add-raw p (cdr q))))
   ((< (len q) (len p))
    (cons (car p)
          (putnam-1981-a5-rp-add-raw (cdr p) q)))
   (t
    (cons (+ (car p) (car q))
          (putnam-1981-a5-rp-add-raw (cdr p) (cdr q))))))

(defun putnam-1981-a5-rp-add (p q)
  (putnam-1981-a5-rp-normalize
   (putnam-1981-a5-rp-add-raw p q)))

(defun putnam-1981-a5-rp-subtract (p q)
  (putnam-1981-a5-rp-add
   p (putnam-1981-a5-rp-negate q)))

(defun putnam-1981-a5-rp-scale (coefficient p)
  (if (consp p)
      (cons (* coefficient (car p))
            (putnam-1981-a5-rp-scale coefficient (cdr p)))
    nil))

(defun putnam-1981-a5-zeroes (n)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix n)))
  (if (zp n)
      nil
    (cons 0 (putnam-1981-a5-zeroes (- n 1)))))

(defun putnam-1981-a5-rp-scale-shift (coefficient p shift)
  (append
   (putnam-1981-a5-rp-scale coefficient p)
   (putnam-1981-a5-zeroes shift)))

(defun putnam-1981-a5-rp-multiply-raw (p q)
  (if (consp p)
      (putnam-1981-a5-rp-add
       (putnam-1981-a5-rp-scale-shift
        (car p) q (len (cdr p)))
       (putnam-1981-a5-rp-multiply-raw (cdr p) q))
    nil))

(defun putnam-1981-a5-rp-multiply (p q)
  (putnam-1981-a5-rp-normalize
   (putnam-1981-a5-rp-multiply-raw p q)))

(defun putnam-1981-a5-rp-eval-aux (p x accumulator)
  (if (consp p)
      (putnam-1981-a5-rp-eval-aux
       (cdr p) x (+ (* accumulator x) (car p)))
    accumulator))

(defun putnam-1981-a5-rp-eval (p x)
  (putnam-1981-a5-rp-eval-aux p x 0))

(defun putnam-1981-a5-rp-derivative-aux (p degree)
  (if (consp p)
      (if (zp degree)
          nil
        (cons (* degree (car p))
              (putnam-1981-a5-rp-derivative-aux
               (cdr p) (- degree 1))))
    nil))

(defun putnam-1981-a5-rp-derivative (p)
  (let ((normalized (putnam-1981-a5-rp-normalize p)))
    (putnam-1981-a5-rp-normalize
     (putnam-1981-a5-rp-derivative-aux
      normalized
      (nfix (- (len normalized) 1))))))

(defun putnam-1981-a5-rp-remainder-fuel (p q fuel)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix fuel)))
  (let ((p (putnam-1981-a5-rp-normalize p))
        (q (putnam-1981-a5-rp-normalize q)))
    (if (or (zp fuel)
            (endp q)
            (< (len p) (len q)))
        p
      (putnam-1981-a5-rp-remainder-fuel
       (putnam-1981-a5-rp-subtract
        p
        (putnam-1981-a5-rp-scale-shift
         (/ (car p) (car q))
         q
         (- (len p) (len q))))
       q
       (- fuel 1)))))

(defun putnam-1981-a5-rp-remainder (p q)
  (putnam-1981-a5-rp-remainder-fuel
   p q (+ 1 (len (putnam-1981-a5-rp-normalize p)))))

(defun putnam-1981-a5-rp-sturm-tail (previous current fuel)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix fuel)))
  (let ((current (putnam-1981-a5-rp-normalize current)))
    (if (or (zp fuel) (endp current))
        nil
      (cons
       current
       (putnam-1981-a5-rp-sturm-tail
        current
        (putnam-1981-a5-rp-negate
         (putnam-1981-a5-rp-remainder previous current))
        (- fuel 1))))))

(defun putnam-1981-a5-rp-sturm-sequence (p q)
  (let ((p (putnam-1981-a5-rp-normalize p))
        (q (putnam-1981-a5-rp-normalize q)))
    (if (endp p)
        nil
      (cons
       p
       (if (endp q)
           nil
         (cons
          q
          (putnam-1981-a5-rp-sturm-tail
           p q (+ 1 (len p) (len q)))))))))

(defun putnam-1981-a5-rational-sign (x)
  (cond ((< x 0) -1)
        ((< 0 x) 1)
        (t 0)))

(defun putnam-1981-a5-rp-variations-aux
    (polynomials x previous-sign)
  (if (consp polynomials)
      (let ((sign
             (putnam-1981-a5-rational-sign
              (putnam-1981-a5-rp-eval
               (car polynomials) x))))
        (if (equal sign 0)
            (putnam-1981-a5-rp-variations-aux
             (cdr polynomials) x previous-sign)
          (+ (if (and (not (equal previous-sign 0))
                      (not (equal sign previous-sign)))
                 1
               0)
             (putnam-1981-a5-rp-variations-aux
              (cdr polynomials) x sign))))
    0))

(defun putnam-1981-a5-rp-variations (polynomials x)
  (putnam-1981-a5-rp-variations-aux polynomials x 0))

(defun putnam-1981-a5-rp-cauchy-index (p q lower upper)
  (let ((sequence
         (putnam-1981-a5-rp-sturm-sequence p q)))
    (- (putnam-1981-a5-rp-variations sequence lower)
       (putnam-1981-a5-rp-variations sequence upper))))

(defun putnam-1981-a5-rp-root-count (p lower upper)
  (putnam-1981-a5-rp-cauchy-index
   p (putnam-1981-a5-rp-derivative p) lower upper))

(defun putnam-1981-a5-primitive-p (primitive lower upper)
  (and
   (putnam-1981-a5-rp-p primitive)
   (consp (putnam-1981-a5-rp-normalize primitive))
   (rationalp lower)
   (rationalp upper)
   (< lower upper)
   (not (equal
         (putnam-1981-a5-rp-eval primitive lower) 0))
   (not (equal
         (putnam-1981-a5-rp-eval primitive upper) 0))
   (equal
    (putnam-1981-a5-rp-root-count primitive lower upper)
    1)
   (equal
    (putnam-1981-a5-rp-cauchy-index
     primitive
     (putnam-1981-a5-rp-multiply
      (putnam-1981-a5-rp-derivative primitive)
      (putnam-1981-a5-rp-derivative primitive))
     lower
     upper)
    1)))

;; For the single isolated root alpha, this Sturm-Tarski query is the sign of
;; VALUE(alpha).
(defun putnam-1981-a5-algebraic-sign
    (primitive lower upper value)
  (putnam-1981-a5-rp-cauchy-index
   primitive
   (putnam-1981-a5-rp-multiply
    (putnam-1981-a5-rp-derivative primitive)
    value)
   lower
   upper))

(defun putnam-1981-a5-algebraic-zero-p
    (primitive lower upper value)
  (equal
   (putnam-1981-a5-algebraic-sign
    primitive lower upper value)
   0))

(defun putnam-1981-a5-algebraic-equal-p
    (primitive lower upper left right)
  (putnam-1981-a5-algebraic-zero-p
   primitive lower upper
   (putnam-1981-a5-rp-subtract left right)))

(defun putnam-1981-a5-algebraic-list-p (values)
  (if (consp values)
      (and (putnam-1981-a5-rp-p (car values))
           (putnam-1981-a5-algebraic-list-p (cdr values)))
    (equal values nil)))

;; Polynomials in x use ascending coefficient order. Each coefficient is a
;; rational polynomial in alpha.

(defun putnam-1981-a5-polynomial-normalize
    (primitive lower upper coefficients)
  (if (consp coefficients)
      (let ((tail
             (putnam-1981-a5-polynomial-normalize
              primitive lower upper (cdr coefficients))))
        (if (and (endp tail)
                 (putnam-1981-a5-algebraic-zero-p
                  primitive lower upper (car coefficients)))
            nil
          (cons (car coefficients) tail)))
    nil))

(defun putnam-1981-a5-polynomial-add (left right)
  (cond
   ((consp left)
    (if (consp right)
        (cons
         (putnam-1981-a5-rp-add (car left) (car right))
         (putnam-1981-a5-polynomial-add
          (cdr left) (cdr right)))
      left))
   (t right)))

(defun putnam-1981-a5-polynomial-negate (polynomial)
  (if (consp polynomial)
      (cons
       (putnam-1981-a5-rp-negate (car polynomial))
       (putnam-1981-a5-polynomial-negate
        (cdr polynomial)))
    nil))

(defun putnam-1981-a5-polynomial-subtract (left right)
  (putnam-1981-a5-polynomial-add
   left
   (putnam-1981-a5-polynomial-negate right)))

(defun putnam-1981-a5-polynomial-scale
    (coefficient polynomial)
  (if (consp polynomial)
      (cons
       (putnam-1981-a5-rp-multiply
        coefficient (car polynomial))
       (putnam-1981-a5-polynomial-scale
        coefficient (cdr polynomial)))
    nil))

(defun putnam-1981-a5-polynomial-multiply (left right)
  (if (consp left)
      (putnam-1981-a5-polynomial-add
       (putnam-1981-a5-polynomial-scale
        (car left) right)
       (cons
        nil
        (putnam-1981-a5-polynomial-multiply
         (cdr left) right)))
    nil))

(defun putnam-1981-a5-polynomial-power
    (polynomial exponent)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix exponent)))
  (if (zp exponent)
      (list (list 1))
    (putnam-1981-a5-polynomial-multiply
     polynomial
     (putnam-1981-a5-polynomial-power
      polynomial (- exponent 1)))))

(defun putnam-1981-a5-polynomial-derivative-aux
    (coefficients degree)
  (if (consp coefficients)
      (cons
       (putnam-1981-a5-rp-scale degree (car coefficients))
       (putnam-1981-a5-polynomial-derivative-aux
        (cdr coefficients) (+ degree 1)))
    nil))

(defun putnam-1981-a5-polynomial-derivative (polynomial)
  (if (consp polynomial)
      (putnam-1981-a5-polynomial-derivative-aux
       (cdr polynomial) 1)
    nil))

(defun putnam-1981-a5-polynomial-zero-at-alpha-p
    (primitive lower upper polynomial)
  (if (consp polynomial)
      (and
       (putnam-1981-a5-algebraic-zero-p
        primitive lower upper (car polynomial))
       (putnam-1981-a5-polynomial-zero-at-alpha-p
        primitive lower upper (cdr polynomial)))
    (equal polynomial nil)))

(defun putnam-1981-a5-polynomial-equal-at-alpha-p
    (primitive lower upper left right)
  (putnam-1981-a5-polynomial-zero-at-alpha-p
   primitive lower upper
   (putnam-1981-a5-polynomial-subtract left right)))

(defun putnam-1981-a5-q-polynomial (polynomial)
  (let* ((derivative
          (putnam-1981-a5-polynomial-derivative polynomial))
         (x-squared-plus-one
          (list (list 1) nil (list 1)))
         (x-polynomial
          (list nil (list 1))))
    (putnam-1981-a5-polynomial-add
     (putnam-1981-a5-polynomial-multiply
      x-squared-plus-one
      (putnam-1981-a5-polynomial-multiply
       polynomial derivative))
     (putnam-1981-a5-polynomial-multiply
      x-polynomial
      (putnam-1981-a5-polynomial-add
       (putnam-1981-a5-polynomial-multiply
        polynomial polynomial)
       (putnam-1981-a5-polynomial-multiply
        derivative derivative))))))

(defun putnam-1981-a5-positive-nat-list-p (values)
  (if (consp values)
      (and (posp (car values))
           (putnam-1981-a5-positive-nat-list-p (cdr values)))
    (equal values nil)))

(defun putnam-1981-a5-distinct-from-p
    (primitive lower upper value values)
  (if (consp values)
      (and
       (not
        (putnam-1981-a5-algebraic-equal-p
         primitive lower upper value (car values)))
       (putnam-1981-a5-distinct-from-p
        primitive lower upper value (cdr values)))
    (equal values nil)))

(defun putnam-1981-a5-pairwise-distinct-p
    (primitive lower upper values)
  (if (consp values)
      (and
       (putnam-1981-a5-distinct-from-p
        primitive lower upper (car values) (cdr values))
       (putnam-1981-a5-pairwise-distinct-p
        primitive lower upper (cdr values)))
    (equal values nil)))

(defun putnam-1981-a5-linear-factor (root)
  (list (putnam-1981-a5-rp-negate root)
        (list 1)))

(defun putnam-1981-a5-linear-product
    (roots multiplicities)
  (if (consp roots)
      (putnam-1981-a5-polynomial-multiply
       (putnam-1981-a5-polynomial-power
        (putnam-1981-a5-linear-factor (car roots))
        (car multiplicities))
       (putnam-1981-a5-linear-product
        (cdr roots) (cdr multiplicities)))
    (list (list 1))))

(defun putnam-1981-a5-quadratic-descriptor-p
    (quadratic)
  (and
   (true-listp quadratic)
   (equal (len quadratic) 2)
   (putnam-1981-a5-rp-p (car quadratic))
   (putnam-1981-a5-rp-p (cadr quadratic))))

(defun putnam-1981-a5-negative-discriminant-p
    (primitive lower upper quadratic)
  (let* ((b (car quadratic))
         (c (cadr quadratic))
         (discriminant
          (putnam-1981-a5-rp-subtract
           (putnam-1981-a5-rp-multiply b b)
           (putnam-1981-a5-rp-scale 4 c))))
    (< (putnam-1981-a5-algebraic-sign
        primitive lower upper discriminant)
       0)))

(defun putnam-1981-a5-quadratic-list-p
    (primitive lower upper quadratics)
  (if (consp quadratics)
      (and
       (putnam-1981-a5-quadratic-descriptor-p
        (car quadratics))
       (putnam-1981-a5-negative-discriminant-p
        primitive lower upper (car quadratics))
       (putnam-1981-a5-quadratic-list-p
        primitive lower upper (cdr quadratics)))
    (equal quadratics nil)))

(defun putnam-1981-a5-quadratic-factor (quadratic)
  (list (cadr quadratic)
        (car quadratic)
        (list 1)))

(defun putnam-1981-a5-quadratic-product
    (quadratics multiplicities)
  (if (consp quadratics)
      (putnam-1981-a5-polynomial-multiply
       (putnam-1981-a5-polynomial-power
        (putnam-1981-a5-quadratic-factor
         (car quadratics))
        (car multiplicities))
       (putnam-1981-a5-quadratic-product
        (cdr quadratics) (cdr multiplicities)))
    (list (list 1))))

(defun putnam-1981-a5-factorization-polynomial
    (scalar roots root-multiplicities
            quadratics quadratic-multiplicities)
  (putnam-1981-a5-polynomial-scale
   scalar
   (putnam-1981-a5-polynomial-multiply
    (putnam-1981-a5-linear-product
     roots root-multiplicities)
    (putnam-1981-a5-quadratic-product
     quadratics quadratic-multiplicities))))

(defun putnam-1981-a5-valid-factorization-p
    (primitive lower upper polynomial scalar
               roots root-multiplicities
               quadratics quadratic-multiplicities)
  (and
   (putnam-1981-a5-rp-p scalar)
   (not
    (putnam-1981-a5-algebraic-zero-p
     primitive lower upper scalar))
   (putnam-1981-a5-algebraic-list-p roots)
   (putnam-1981-a5-positive-nat-list-p
    root-multiplicities)
   (equal (len roots) (len root-multiplicities))
   (putnam-1981-a5-pairwise-distinct-p
    primitive lower upper roots)
   (putnam-1981-a5-quadratic-list-p
    primitive lower upper quadratics)
   (putnam-1981-a5-positive-nat-list-p
    quadratic-multiplicities)
   (equal
    (len quadratics)
    (len quadratic-multiplicities))
   (putnam-1981-a5-polynomial-equal-at-alpha-p
    primitive
    lower
    upper
    polynomial
    (putnam-1981-a5-factorization-polynomial
     scalar roots root-multiplicities
     quadratics quadratic-multiplicities))))

(defun putnam-1981-a5-roots-greater-than-one
    (primitive lower upper roots)
  (if (consp roots)
      (+ (if (< 0
                (putnam-1981-a5-algebraic-sign
                 primitive
                 lower
                 upper
                 (putnam-1981-a5-rp-subtract
                  (car roots) (list 1))))
             1
           0)
         (putnam-1981-a5-roots-greater-than-one
          primitive lower upper (cdr roots)))
    0))

(defun putnam-1981-a5-counterexample-p
    (primitive lower upper coefficients
               p-scalar p-roots p-root-multiplicities
               p-quadratics p-quadratic-multiplicities
               q-scalar q-roots q-root-multiplicities
               q-quadratics q-quadratic-multiplicities)
  (let* ((polynomial
          (putnam-1981-a5-polynomial-normalize
           primitive lower upper coefficients))
         (q-polynomial
          (putnam-1981-a5-polynomial-normalize
           primitive lower upper
           (putnam-1981-a5-q-polynomial polynomial)))
         (n
          (putnam-1981-a5-roots-greater-than-one
           primitive lower upper p-roots)))
    (and
     (putnam-1981-a5-algebraic-list-p coefficients)
     (putnam-1981-a5-valid-factorization-p
      primitive lower upper polynomial
      p-scalar p-roots p-root-multiplicities
      p-quadratics p-quadratic-multiplicities)
     (putnam-1981-a5-valid-factorization-p
      primitive lower upper q-polynomial
      q-scalar q-roots q-root-multiplicities
      q-quadratics q-quadratic-multiplicities)
     (< (len q-roots) (- (* 2 n) 1)))))

(defun putnambench-putnam-1981-a5-statement
    (primitive lower upper coefficients
               p-scalar p-roots p-root-multiplicities
               p-quadratics p-quadratic-multiplicities
               q-scalar q-roots q-root-multiplicities
               q-quadratics q-quadratic-multiplicities)
  (implies
   (putnam-1981-a5-primitive-p primitive lower upper)
   (not
    (putnam-1981-a5-counterexample-p
     primitive lower upper coefficients
     p-scalar p-roots p-root-multiplicities
     p-quadratics p-quadratic-multiplicities
     q-scalar q-roots q-root-multiplicities
     q-quadratics q-quadratic-multiplicities))))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

title: putnam_1981_a5
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1981_a5:
-- the polynomial Q(x) = (x^2 + 1)P(x)P'(x) + x(P(x)^2 + P'(x)^2)
-- has at least 2n - 1 distinct real roots when P has n distinct real roots
-- greater than 1. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.List using (List; []; _∷_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; _*_)

infix 4 _!=_
infixr 3 _and_
infixr 2 _or_

data Bottom : Set where

Not : Set -> Set
Not A =
  A -> Bottom

_!=_ : {A : Set} -> A -> A -> Set
x != y =
  Not (x == y)

record Top : Set where
  constructor truth

record _and_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data _or_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  left  : A -> A or B
  right : B -> A or B

record Iff (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor equivalence
  field
    forward  : A -> B
    backward : B -> A

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

data Fin : Nat -> Set where
  fzero : {n : Nat} -> Fin (suc n)
  fsuc  : {n : Nat} -> Fin n -> Fin (suc n)

record CompleteOrderedRealField (R : Set) : Set1 where
  field
    zeroR oneR : R
    add multiply : R -> R -> R
    negate inverse : R -> R
    lessOrEqual : R -> R -> Set
    fromNat : Nat -> R

    one-not-zero :
      oneR != zeroR

    add-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> add x y == add y x
    add-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      add (add x y) z == add x (add y z)
    add-zero :
      (x : R) -> add x zeroR == x
    add-inverse :
      (x : R) -> add x (negate x) == zeroR

    multiply-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> multiply x y == multiply y x
    multiply-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply (multiply x y) z ==
      multiply x (multiply y z)
    multiply-one :
      (x : R) -> multiply x oneR == x
    multiply-zero :
      (x : R) -> multiply x zeroR == zeroR
    distribute :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply x (add y z) ==
      add (multiply x y) (multiply x z)
    inverse-zero :
      inverse zeroR == zeroR
    multiply-inverse :
      (x : R) ->
      x != zeroR ->
      multiply x (inverse x) == oneR

    order-reflexive :
      (x : R) -> lessOrEqual x x
    order-transitive :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y z ->
      lessOrEqual x z
    order-antisymmetric :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y x ->
      x == y
    order-total :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y or lessOrEqual y x
    add-order :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual (add z x) (add z y)
    multiply-nonnegative :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR x ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR y ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR (multiply x y)
    zero-less-than-one :
      lessOrEqual zeroR oneR and zeroR != oneR

    fromNat-zero :
      fromNat zero == zeroR
    fromNat-successor :
      (n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (suc n) == add (fromNat n) oneR
    fromNat-addition :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m + n) == add (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-multiplication :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m * n) == multiply (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-injective :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat m == fromNat n ->
      m == n

    archimedean :
      (x : R) ->
      Exists Nat (\ n -> lessOrEqual x (fromNat n))
    least-upper-bound :
      (P : R -> Set) ->
      Exists R P ->
      Exists R
        (\ upper ->
          (x : R) ->
          P x ->
          lessOrEqual x upper) ->
      Exists R
        (\ supremum ->
          ((x : R) ->
            P x ->
            lessOrEqual x supremum)
          and
          ((upper : R) ->
            ((x : R) ->
              P x ->
              lessOrEqual x upper) ->
            lessOrEqual supremum upper))

open CompleteOrderedRealField

subtract :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
subtract reals x y =
  add reals x (negate reals y)

square :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R
square reals x =
  multiply reals x x

StrictLess :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
StrictLess reals x y =
  lessOrEqual reals x y and x != y

Polynomial : Set -> Set
Polynomial R =
  List R

evaluate :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Polynomial R ->
  R ->
  R
evaluate reals [] x =
  zeroR reals
evaluate reals (coefficient ∷ coefficients) x =
  add reals
    coefficient
    (multiply reals x (evaluate reals coefficients x))

derivativeValue :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Polynomial R ->
  R ->
  R
derivativeValue reals [] x =
  zeroR reals
derivativeValue reals (coefficient ∷ coefficients) x =
  add reals
    (evaluate reals coefficients x)
    (multiply reals x
      (derivativeValue reals coefficients x))

record HasCardinality
  {A : Set}
  (P : A -> Set)
  (cardinality : Nat) : Set where
  field
    enumerate :
      Fin cardinality -> A
    enumerated-member :
      (i : Fin cardinality) ->
      P (enumerate i)
    enumeration-complete :
      (x : A) ->
      P x ->
      Exists (Fin cardinality)
        (\ i -> x == enumerate i)
    enumeration-injective :
      (i j : Fin cardinality) ->
      enumerate i == enumerate j ->
      i == j

FinitePredicate :
  {A : Set} ->
  (A -> Set) ->
  Set
FinitePredicate P =
  Exists Nat (HasCardinality P)

NCardValue :
  {A : Set} ->
  (A -> Set) ->
  Nat ->
  Set
NCardValue P cardinality =
  HasCardinality P cardinality
  or
  (cardinality == zero
    and
    Not (FinitePredicate P))

module Putnam1981A5Statement
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) where

  oneN : Nat
  oneN =
    suc zero

  twoN : Nat
  twoN =
    suc oneN

  qValue :
    Polynomial R ->
    R ->
    R
  qValue P x =
    let
      p = evaluate reals P x
      p' = derivativeValue reals P x
    in
    add reals
      (multiply reals
        (add reals
          (square reals x)
          (oneR reals))
        (multiply reals p p'))
      (multiply reals x
        (add reals
          (square reals p)
          (square reals p')))

  RootsAboveOne :
    Polynomial R ->
    R ->
    Set
  RootsAboveOne P x =
    StrictLess reals (oneR reals) x
    and
    evaluate reals P x == zeroR reals

  QRoots :
    Polynomial R ->
    R ->
    Set
  QRoots P x =
    qValue P x == zeroR reals

  AtLeastTwiceMinusOne :
    Nat ->
    Nat ->
    Set
  AtLeastTwiceMinusOne n q-roots =
    lessOrEqual reals
      (subtract reals
        (multiply reals
          (fromNat reals twoN)
          (fromNat reals n))
        (oneR reals))
      (fromNat reals q-roots)

  universal-bound : Set
  universal-bound =
    (P : Polynomial R) ->
    Exists Nat
      (\ n ->
        NCardValue (RootsAboveOne P) n
        and
        Exists Nat
          (\ q-roots ->
            NCardValue (QRoots P) q-roots
            and
            AtLeastTwiceMinusOne n q-roots))

  proposition : Set
  proposition =
    Iff universal-bound Top

putnam-1981-a5 : Set1
putnam-1981-a5 =
  (R : Set) ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) ->
  Putnam1981A5Statement.proposition reals

(*
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1981_a5:
  the claimed lower bound on the number of distinct real roots of a polynomial
  built from a real polynomial and its derivative. This file contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open pred_setTheory realTheory polyTheory;

val putnam_1981_a5 =
  ``let Q =
      \P : real list.
        poly_add
          (poly_mul
             (poly_mul ([1; 0; 1] : real list) P)
             (diff P))
          (poly_mul
             ([0; 1] : real list)
             (poly_add
                (P poly_exp 2)
                ((diff P) poly_exp 2)))
    in
      let n =
        \P : real list.
          if FINITE {x : real | x > 1 /\ poly P x = 0}
          then &(CARD {x : real | x > 1 /\ poly P x = 0})
          else 0
      in
        ((!P : real list.
            (if FINITE {x : real | poly (Q P) x = 0}
             then &(CARD {x : real | poly (Q P) x = 0})
             else 0) >=
            2 * n P - 1)
         <=> T)``;

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  P81A5NCard implements the finite-cardinality convention used by
  Lean's Set.ncard and Isabelle's card: it is zero for an infinite
  set. P81A5Der is formal differentiation in the univariate
  polynomial ring over the real field, and P81A5Q is the polynomial
  construction in the problem. The final assertion states the claim
  directly because the source's annotated solution proposition is True.
  All declarations below are unproved $a statements; there is no $p
  proof declaration in this file.
$)

$c P81A5NCard P81A5Der P81A5Q $.

p81a5-der-syntax $a class P81A5Der $.
p81a5-q-syntax $a class P81A5Q $.

  ( p e. ( Base ` ( Poly1 ` RRfld ) ) |->
    ( ( ( ( ( 2 ( .g ` ( mulGrp ` ( Poly1 ` RRfld ) ) ) )

              ( 1r ` ( Poly1 ` RRfld ) ) )

${

title: putnam_1981_a5
content:
% Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1981_a5:
% the asserted lower bound on the number of distinct real roots of a
% polynomial expression involving a real polynomial and its derivative.
% This file contains no proof.

putnam_1981_a5: THEORY
BEGIN
  real_set: TYPE = [real -> bool]
  real_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> real]

  polynomial_value(p: list[real], x: real): RECURSIVE real =
    CASES p OF
      null: 0,
      cons(coefficient, tail):
        coefficient + x * polynomial_value(tail, x)
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE p BY <<

  polynomial_add(p, q: list[real]): RECURSIVE list[real] =
    CASES p OF
      null: q,
      cons(left_coefficient, left_tail):
        CASES q OF
          null: p,
          cons(right_coefficient, right_tail):
            cons(
              left_coefficient + right_coefficient,
              polynomial_add(left_tail, right_tail))
        ENDCASES
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE p BY <<

  polynomial_scale(value: real, p: list[real]): RECURSIVE list[real] =
    CASES p OF
      null: null,
      cons(coefficient, tail):
        cons(
          value * coefficient,
          polynomial_scale(value, tail))
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE p BY <<

  polynomial_multiply(p, q: list[real]): RECURSIVE list[real] =
    CASES p OF
      null: null,
      cons(coefficient, tail):
        polynomial_add(
          polynomial_scale(coefficient, q),
          cons(0, polynomial_multiply(tail, q)))
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE p BY <<

  derivative_from(
      p: list[real],
      degree: nat): RECURSIVE list[real] =
    CASES p OF
      null: null,
      cons(coefficient, tail):
        cons(
          (degree :: real) * coefficient,
          derivative_from(tail, degree + 1))
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE p BY <<

  polynomial_derivative(p: list[real]): list[real] =
    CASES p OF
      null: null,
      cons(coefficient, tail): derivative_from(tail, 1)
    ENDCASES

  X: list[real] = cons(0, cons(1, null))

  X_squared_plus_one: list[real] =
    cons(1, cons(0, cons(1, null)))

  Q(P: list[real]): list[real] =
    LET derivative: list[real] = polynomial_derivative(P) IN
      polynomial_add(
        polynomial_multiply(
          polynomial_multiply(X_squared_plus_one, P),
          derivative),
        polynomial_multiply(
          X,
          polynomial_add(
            polynomial_multiply(P, P),
            polynomial_multiply(derivative, derivative))))

  injective_below(
      enumeration: real_sequence,
      cardinality: nat): bool =
    FORALL (i, j: nat):
      (i < cardinality
        AND j < cardinality
        AND enumeration(i) = enumeration(j))
      IMPLIES i = j

  enumerates_exactly(
      enumeration: real_sequence,
      set_value: real_set,
      cardinality: nat): bool =
    FORALL (x: real):
      set_value(x) IFF
        EXISTS (index: nat):
          index < cardinality AND enumeration(index) = x

  has_cardinality(
      set_value: real_set,
      cardinality: nat): bool =
    EXISTS (enumeration: real_sequence):
      injective_below(enumeration, cardinality)
        AND enumerates_exactly(
          enumeration, set_value, cardinality)

  is_finite(set_value: real_set): bool =
    EXISTS (cardinality: nat):
      has_cardinality(set_value, cardinality)

  ncard_is(set_value: real_set, cardinality: nat): bool =
    has_cardinality(set_value, cardinality)
      OR (NOT is_finite(set_value) AND cardinality = 0)

  roots(P: list[real]): real_set =
    LAMBDA (x: real): polynomial_value(P, x) = 0

  roots_greater_than_one(P: list[real]): real_set =
    LAMBDA (x: real):
      x > 1 AND polynomial_value(P, x) = 0

  putnam_1981_a5_solution: bool = TRUE

  putnam_1981_a5_statement: bool =
    ((FORALL (P: list[real]), (q_count, p_count: nat):
      (ncard_is(roots(Q(P)), q_count)
        AND ncard_is(roots_greater_than_one(P), p_count))
      IMPLIES
        (q_count :: real) >= 2 * (p_count :: real) - 1)
      IFF putnam_1981_a5_solution)
END putnam_1981_a5

;; Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1981_b1:
;; the normalized double sum of 5*h^4 - 18*h^2*k^2 + 5*k^4 over
;; 1 <= h,k <= n converges to -1. This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(defun putnam-1981-b1-row-sum (h k)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix k)))
  (if (zp k)
      0
    (+ (- (+ (* 5 (expt h 4))
             (* 5 (expt k 4)))
          (* 18 (expt h 2) (expt k 2)))
       (putnam-1981-b1-row-sum h (- k 1)))))

(defun putnam-1981-b1-double-sum-aux (remaining n)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix remaining)))
  (if (zp remaining)
      0
    (+ (putnam-1981-b1-row-sum remaining n)
       (putnam-1981-b1-double-sum-aux
        (- remaining 1) n))))

(defun putnam-1981-b1-double-sum (n)
  (if (natp n)
      (putnam-1981-b1-double-sum-aux n n)
    0))

(defun putnam-1981-b1-sequence (n)
  (if (posp n)
      (/ (putnam-1981-b1-double-sum n)
         (expt n 5))
    0))

(defun putnam-1981-b1-solution ()
  -1)

;; Positive rational tolerances are cofinal among positive real tolerances,
;; so this is the epsilon definition of the source real-sequence limit.
(defun-sk putnam-1981-b1-tail-p (epsilon cutoff)
  (forall (n)
    (implies
     (and
      (natp n)
      (<= cutoff n))
     (< (abs
         (- (putnam-1981-b1-sequence n)
            (putnam-1981-b1-solution)))
        epsilon))))

(defun-sk putnam-1981-b1-cutoff-exists-p (epsilon)
  (exists (cutoff)
    (and
     (natp cutoff)
     (putnam-1981-b1-tail-p epsilon cutoff))))

(defun putnambench-putnam-1981-b1-statement (epsilon)
  (implies
   (and (rationalp epsilon)
        (< 0 epsilon))
   (putnam-1981-b1-cutoff-exists-p epsilon)))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

-- Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1981_b1:
-- the normalized double sum of 5h^4 - 18h^2k^2 + 5k^4 over 1 <= h,k <= n
-- converges to -1 as n tends to infinity. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module Putnam1981B1 where

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; _*_)

infix 4 _!=_ _<=N_
infixr 3 _and_
infixr 2 _or_

data Bottom : Set where

Not : Set -> Set
Not A =
  A -> Bottom

_!=_ : {A : Set} -> A -> A -> Set
x != y =
  Not (x == y)

record _and_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data _or_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  left  : A -> A or B
  right : B -> A or B

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

data _<=N_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set where
  zero<=N   : {n : Nat} -> zero <=N n
  suc<=sucN : {m n : Nat} -> m <=N n -> suc m <=N suc n

record CompleteOrderedRealField (R : Set) : Set1 where
  field
    zeroR oneR : R
    add multiply : R -> R -> R
    negate inverse : R -> R
    lessOrEqual : R -> R -> Set
    fromNat : Nat -> R

    one-not-zero :
      oneR != zeroR

    add-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> add x y == add y x
    add-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      add (add x y) z == add x (add y z)
    add-zero :
      (x : R) -> add x zeroR == x
    add-inverse :
      (x : R) -> add x (negate x) == zeroR

    multiply-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> multiply x y == multiply y x
    multiply-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply (multiply x y) z ==
      multiply x (multiply y z)
    multiply-one :
      (x : R) -> multiply x oneR == x
    multiply-zero :
      (x : R) -> multiply x zeroR == zeroR
    distribute :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply x (add y z) ==
      add (multiply x y) (multiply x z)
    inverse-zero :
      inverse zeroR == zeroR
    multiply-inverse :
      (x : R) ->
      x != zeroR ->
      multiply x (inverse x) == oneR

    order-reflexive :
      (x : R) -> lessOrEqual x x
    order-transitive :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y z ->
      lessOrEqual x z
    order-antisymmetric :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y x ->
      x == y
    order-total :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y or lessOrEqual y x
    add-order :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual (add z x) (add z y)
    multiply-nonnegative :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR x ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR y ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR (multiply x y)
    zero-less-than-one :
      lessOrEqual zeroR oneR and zeroR != oneR

    fromNat-zero :
      fromNat zero == zeroR
    fromNat-successor :
      (n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (suc n) == add (fromNat n) oneR
    fromNat-addition :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m + n) == add (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-multiplication :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m * n) == multiply (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-injective :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat m == fromNat n ->
      m == n

    archimedean :
      (x : R) ->
      Exists Nat (\ n -> lessOrEqual x (fromNat n))
    least-upper-bound :
      (P : R -> Set) ->
      Exists R P ->
      Exists R
        (\ upper ->
          (x : R) ->
          P x ->
          lessOrEqual x upper) ->
      Exists R
        (\ supremum ->
          ((x : R) ->
            P x ->
            lessOrEqual x supremum)
          and
          ((upper : R) ->
            ((x : R) ->
              P x ->
              lessOrEqual x upper) ->
            lessOrEqual supremum upper))

open CompleteOrderedRealField

subtract :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
subtract reals x y =
  add reals x (negate reals y)

divide :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
divide reals x y =
  multiply reals x (inverse reals y)

power :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  Nat ->
  R
power reals x zero =
  oneR reals
power reals x (suc n) =
  multiply reals (power reals x n) x

StrictLess :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
StrictLess reals x y =
  lessOrEqual reals x y and x != y

CloseTo :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
CloseTo reals center radius x =
  StrictLess reals
    (subtract reals center radius)
    x
  and
  StrictLess reals
    x
    (add reals center radius)

ConvergesTo :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  R ->
  Set
ConvergesTo {R} reals sequence limit =
  (epsilon : R) ->
  StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) epsilon ->
  Exists Nat
    (\ cutoff ->
      (n : Nat) ->
      cutoff <=N n ->
      CloseTo reals limit epsilon (sequence n))

sumFirst :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Nat ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  R
sumFirst reals zero term =
  zeroR reals
sumFirst reals (suc n) term =
  add reals
    (sumFirst reals n term)
    (term n)

sumOneThrough :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Nat ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  R
sumOneThrough reals n term =
  sumFirst reals n (\ i -> term (suc i))

twoN : Nat
twoN =
  suc (suc zero)

fourN : Nat
fourN =
  twoN + twoN

fiveN : Nat
fiveN =
  suc fourN

eighteenN : Nat
eighteenN =
  suc (suc (fourN * fourN))

module Putnam1981B1Statement
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) where

  summand : Nat -> Nat -> R
  summand h k =
    add reals
      (subtract reals
        (multiply reals
          (fromNat reals fiveN)
          (power reals (fromNat reals h) fourN))
        (multiply reals
          (fromNat reals eighteenN)
          (multiply reals
            (power reals (fromNat reals h) twoN)
            (power reals (fromNat reals k) twoN))))
      (multiply reals
        (fromNat reals fiveN)
        (power reals (fromNat reals k) fourN))

  doubleSum : Nat -> R
  doubleSum n =
    sumOneThrough reals n
      (\ h ->
        sumOneThrough reals n
          (\ k -> summand h k))

  sequence : Nat -> R
  sequence n =
    divide reals
      (doubleSum n)
      (power reals (fromNat reals n) fiveN)

  solution : R
  solution =
    negate reals (oneR reals)

  proposition : Set
  proposition =
    ConvergesTo reals sequence solution

putnam-1981-b1 : Set1
putnam-1981-b1 =
  (R : Set) ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) ->
  Putnam1981B1Statement.proposition reals

  the normalized double sum of a quartic polynomial over indices from one
  through n converges to negative one. This file contains no proof.

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;

val putnam_1981_b1 =

        (1 / ((&n : real) pow 5)) *
        SIGMA
          (\h : num.
             SIGMA
               (\k : num.
                  5 * (&h : real) pow 4 -
                  18 * (&h : real) pow 2 * (&k : real) pow 2 +
                  5 * (&k : real) pow 4)

$(

                +

$}

title: putnam_1981_b1
content:
% Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench artifact putnam_1981_b1:
% the normalized double sum of 5*h^4 - 18*h^2*k^2 + 5*k^4 over
% 1 <= h,k <= n converges to -1. This file contains no proof.

putnam_1981_b1: THEORY
BEGIN
  real_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> real]

  safe_div(numerator, denominator: real): real =
    IF denominator = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      numerator / denominator
    ENDIF

  inner_sum(h, count: nat): RECURSIVE real =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      inner_sum(h, count - 1)
        + 5 * (h :: real) ^ 4
        - 18 * (h :: real) ^ 2 * (count :: real) ^ 2
        + 5 * (count :: real) ^ 4
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  double_sum(h_count, upper_bound: nat): RECURSIVE real =
    IF h_count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      double_sum(h_count - 1, upper_bound)
        + inner_sum(h_count, upper_bound)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE h_count

  normalized(count: nat): real =
    safe_div(double_sum(count, count), (count :: real) ^ 5)

  converges_to(values: real_sequence, limit: real): bool =
    FORALL (epsilon_value: posreal):
      EXISTS (cutoff: nat):
        FORALL (count: nat):
          cutoff <= count IMPLIES
            abs(values(count) - limit) < epsilon_value

  putnam_1981_b1: bool =
    converges_to(normalized, -1)
END putnam_1981_b1

import Mathlib

open Topology Filter Set Polynomial Function

noncomputable abbrev putnam_1981_b2_solution : ℝ := 12 - 8 * Real.sqrt 2
/--
Determine the minimum value attained by $$(r - 1)^2 + (\frac{s}{r} - 1)^2 + (\frac{t}{s} - 1)^2 + (\frac{4}{t} - 1)^2$$ across all choices of real $r$, $s$, and $t$ that satisfy $1 \le r \le s \le t \le 4$.
-/
theorem putnam_1981_b2
    (P : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ → Prop)
    (hP : P = fun (r, s, t) => 1 ≤ r ∧ r ≤ s ∧ s ≤ t ∧ t ≤ 4)
    (f : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ → ℝ)
    (hf : f = fun (r, s, t) => (r - 1)^2 + (s/r - 1)^2 + (t/s - 1)^2 + (4/t - 1)^2) :
    IsLeast {y | ∃ r s t, P (r, s, t) ∧ f (r, s, t) = y} putnam_1981_b2_solution :=
  sorry

Require Import Reals.
Open Scope R.
Definition putnam_1981_b2_solution := 12 - 8 * sqrt 2.
Theorem putnam_1981_b2
    (f : R -> R -> R -> R := fun a b c => pow (a-1) 2 + pow (b / a - 1) 2 + pow (c / b - 1) 2 + pow (4 / c - 1) 2)
    : (forall (a b c: R), 1 <= a /\ a <= b /\ b <= c /\ c <= 4 -> putnam_1981_b2_solution <= f a b c) /\
    (exists (a b c: R), 1 <= a /\ a <= b /\ b <= c /\ c <= 4 /\ putnam_1981_b2_solution = f a b c).
Proof. Admitted.

(*
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench artifact putnam_1981_b2:
  the minimum value of a four-term sum of squared successive ratios over
  real numbers satisfying 1 <= r <= s <= t <= 4. This file contains no proof.
*)

let statement =
  `let feasible =
     \r s t:real.
       &1 <= r /\ r <= s /\ s <= t /\ t <= &4 in
   let objective =
     \r s t:real.
       (r - &1) pow 2 +
       (s / r - &1) pow 2 +
       (t / s - &1) pow 2 +
       (&4 / t - &1) pow 2 in
   let solution = &12 - &8 * sqrt (&2) in
   (!r s t:real.
      feasible r s t
      ==> solution <= objective r s t) /\
   (?r s t:real.
      feasible r s t /\
      objective r s t = solution)`;;

title: putnam_1981_b2
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1981_b2:
;; the minimum of a four-term sum of squared successive ratios over real
;; numbers 1 <= r <= s <= t <= 4 is 12 - 8*sqrt(2). This file contains no
;; proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

;; These conservative interfaces present scalar operations on an arbitrary
;; carrier.  The statement predicate below explicitly requires that carrier
;; to be a real-closed ordered field and that SQRT-TWO denote its positive
;; square root of two.  Real-closed fields have the same first-order ordered
;; field theory as the reals, so this preserves the source quantification over
;; all real r, s, and t; no rational or finite subcarrier is used.

(defstub p81b2-member-p (real-type value) t)
(defstub p81b2-zero (real-type) t)
(defstub p81b2-one (real-type) t)
(defstub p81b2-add (real-type left right) t)
(defstub p81b2-multiply (real-type left right) t)
(defstub p81b2-negate (real-type value) t)
(defstub p81b2-inverse (real-type value) t)
(defstub p81b2-less (real-type left right) t)
(defstub p81b2-sqrt-two (real-type) t)

(defun p81b2-r-add (real-type left right)
  (p81b2-add real-type left right))

(defun p81b2-r-multiply (real-type left right)
  (p81b2-multiply real-type left right))

(defun p81b2-r-negate (real-type value)
  (p81b2-negate real-type value))

(defun p81b2-r-inverse (real-type value)
  (p81b2-inverse real-type value))

(defun p81b2-r-subtract (real-type left right)
  (p81b2-r-add
   real-type left (p81b2-r-negate real-type right)))

(defun p81b2-r-divide (real-type numerator denominator)
  (p81b2-r-multiply
   real-type numerator (p81b2-r-inverse real-type denominator)))

(defun p81b2-leq (real-type left right)
  (not (p81b2-less real-type right left)))

(defun p81b2-square (real-type value)
  (p81b2-r-multiply real-type value value))

(defun p81b2-two (real-type)
  (p81b2-r-add
   real-type
   (p81b2-one real-type)
   (p81b2-one real-type)))

(defun p81b2-four (real-type)
  (let ((two (p81b2-two real-type)))
    (p81b2-r-add real-type two two)))

(defun p81b2-eight (real-type)
  (let ((four (p81b2-four real-type)))
    (p81b2-r-add real-type four four)))

(defun p81b2-twelve (real-type)
  (p81b2-r-add
   real-type
   (p81b2-eight real-type)
   (p81b2-four real-type)))

(defun-sk p81b2-field-laws-p (real-type)
  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (p81b2-member-p real-type x)
      (p81b2-member-p real-type y)
      (p81b2-member-p real-type z))
     (let* ((zero (p81b2-zero real-type))
            (one (p81b2-one real-type))
            (xy-add (p81b2-r-add real-type x y))
            (yz-add (p81b2-r-add real-type y z))
            (xy-mul (p81b2-r-multiply real-type x y))
            (yz-mul (p81b2-r-multiply real-type y z))
            (neg-x (p81b2-r-negate real-type x))
            (inv-x (p81b2-r-inverse real-type x)))
       (and
        (p81b2-member-p real-type xy-add)
        (p81b2-member-p real-type xy-mul)
        (p81b2-member-p real-type neg-x)
        (p81b2-member-p real-type inv-x)
        (equal
         (p81b2-r-add real-type xy-add z)
         (p81b2-r-add real-type x yz-add))
        (equal xy-add (p81b2-r-add real-type y x))
        (equal (p81b2-r-add real-type x zero) x)
        (equal (p81b2-r-add real-type x neg-x) zero)
        (equal
         (p81b2-r-multiply real-type xy-mul z)
         (p81b2-r-multiply real-type x yz-mul))
        (equal xy-mul (p81b2-r-multiply real-type y x))
        (equal (p81b2-r-multiply real-type x one) x)
        (implies
         (equal x zero)
         (equal inv-x zero))
        (implies
         (not (equal x zero))
         (equal
          (p81b2-r-multiply real-type x inv-x)
          one))
        (equal
         (p81b2-r-multiply real-type x yz-add)
         (p81b2-r-add
          real-type
          (p81b2-r-multiply real-type x y)
          (p81b2-r-multiply real-type x z))))))))

(defun-sk p81b2-order-laws-p (real-type)
  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (p81b2-member-p real-type x)
      (p81b2-member-p real-type y)
      (p81b2-member-p real-type z))
     (let ((zero (p81b2-zero real-type)))
       (and
        (not (p81b2-less real-type x x))
        (or
         (p81b2-less real-type x y)
         (equal x y)
         (p81b2-less real-type y x))
        (implies
         (and
          (p81b2-less real-type x y)
          (p81b2-less real-type y z))
         (p81b2-less real-type x z))
        (implies
         (p81b2-less real-type x y)
         (p81b2-less
          real-type
          (p81b2-r-add real-type x z)
          (p81b2-r-add real-type y z)))
        (implies
         (and
          (p81b2-less real-type zero x)
          (p81b2-less real-type zero y))
         (p81b2-less
          real-type
          zero
          (p81b2-r-multiply real-type x y))))))))

;; One standard first-order characterization of real-closed ordered fields:
;; every nonnegative element is a square and every odd-degree polynomial has
;; a root.  Coefficient lists are constant-term first.

(defun p81b2-polynomial-p (real-type coefficients)
  (if (consp coefficients)
      (and
       (p81b2-member-p real-type (car coefficients))
       (p81b2-polynomial-p real-type (cdr coefficients)))
    (equal coefficients nil)))

(defun p81b2-leading-coefficient (coefficients)
  (if (consp (cdr coefficients))
      (p81b2-leading-coefficient (cdr coefficients))
    (car coefficients)))

(defun p81b2-polynomial-value
    (real-type coefficients value)
  (if (consp coefficients)
      (p81b2-r-add
       real-type
       (car coefficients)
       (p81b2-r-multiply
        real-type
        value
        (p81b2-polynomial-value
         real-type (cdr coefficients) value)))
    (p81b2-zero real-type)))

(defun p81b2-odd-degree-polynomial-p
    (real-type coefficients)
  (and
   (consp coefficients)
   (true-listp coefficients)
   (p81b2-polynomial-p real-type coefficients)
   (oddp (1- (len coefficients)))
   (not
    (equal
     (p81b2-leading-coefficient coefficients)
     (p81b2-zero real-type)))))

-- Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1981_b2:
-- the minimum of a four-term sum of squared successive relative increments
-- over real numbers 1 <= r <= s <= t <= 4 is 12 - 8 * sqrt 2.
-- This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module Putnam1981B2 where

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; _*_)

infix 4 _!=_
infixr 3 _and_
infixr 2 _or_

data Bottom : Set where

Not : Set -> Set
Not A =
  A -> Bottom

_!=_ : {A : Set} -> A -> A -> Set
x != y =
  Not (x == y)

record _and_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data _or_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  left  : A -> A or B
  right : B -> A or B

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

record CompleteOrderedRealField (R : Set) : Set1 where
  field
    zeroR oneR : R
    add multiply : R -> R -> R
    negate inverse squareRoot : R -> R
    lessOrEqual : R -> R -> Set
    fromNat : Nat -> R

    one-not-zero :
      oneR != zeroR

    add-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> add x y == add y x
    add-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      add (add x y) z == add x (add y z)
    add-zero :
      (x : R) -> add x zeroR == x
    add-inverse :
      (x : R) -> add x (negate x) == zeroR

    multiply-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> multiply x y == multiply y x
    multiply-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply (multiply x y) z ==
      multiply x (multiply y z)
    multiply-one :
      (x : R) -> multiply x oneR == x
    multiply-zero :
      (x : R) -> multiply x zeroR == zeroR
    distribute :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply x (add y z) ==
      add (multiply x y) (multiply x z)
    inverse-zero :
      inverse zeroR == zeroR
    multiply-inverse :
      (x : R) ->
      x != zeroR ->
      multiply x (inverse x) == oneR

    order-reflexive :
      (x : R) -> lessOrEqual x x
    order-transitive :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y z ->
      lessOrEqual x z
    order-antisymmetric :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y x ->
      x == y
    order-total :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y or lessOrEqual y x
    add-order :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual (add z x) (add z y)
    multiply-nonnegative :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR x ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR y ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR (multiply x y)
    zero-less-than-one :
      lessOrEqual zeroR oneR and zeroR != oneR

    fromNat-zero :
      fromNat zero == zeroR
    fromNat-successor :
      (n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (suc n) == add (fromNat n) oneR
    fromNat-addition :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m + n) == add (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-multiplication :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m * n) == multiply (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-injective :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat m == fromNat n ->
      m == n

    archimedean :
      (x : R) ->
      Exists Nat (\ n -> lessOrEqual x (fromNat n))
    least-upper-bound :
      (P : R -> Set) ->
      Exists R P ->
      Exists R
        (\ upper ->
          (x : R) ->
          P x ->
          lessOrEqual x upper) ->
      Exists R
        (\ supremum ->
          ((x : R) ->
            P x ->
            lessOrEqual x supremum)
          and
          ((upper : R) ->
            ((x : R) ->
              P x ->
              lessOrEqual x upper) ->
            lessOrEqual supremum upper))

    square-root-nonnegative :
      (x : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR (squareRoot x)
    square-root-square :
      (x : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR x ->
      multiply (squareRoot x) (squareRoot x) == x
    square-root-nonpositive :
      (x : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x zeroR ->
      squareRoot x == zeroR
    square-root-unique :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR y ->
      multiply y y == x ->
      y == squareRoot x

open CompleteOrderedRealField

subtract :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
subtract reals x y =
  add reals x (negate reals y)

divide :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
divide reals x y =
  multiply reals x (inverse reals y)

square :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R
square reals x =
  multiply reals x x

module Putnam1981B2Statement
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) where

  twoN : Nat
  twoN =
    suc (suc zero)

  fourN : Nat
  fourN =
    twoN + twoN

  eightN : Nat
  eightN =
    fourN + fourN

  twelveN : Nat
  twelveN =
    eightN + fourN

  two four eight twelve : R
  two =
    fromNat reals twoN
  four =
    fromNat reals fourN
  eight =
    fromNat reals eightN
  twelve =
    fromNat reals twelveN

  Feasible : R -> R -> R -> Set
  Feasible r s t =
    lessOrEqual reals (oneR reals) r
    and
    lessOrEqual reals r s
    and
    lessOrEqual reals s t
    and
    lessOrEqual reals t four

  objective : R -> R -> R -> R
  objective r s t =
    add reals
      (add reals
        (square reals
          (subtract reals r (oneR reals)))
        (square reals
          (subtract reals
            (divide reals s r)
            (oneR reals))))
      (add reals
        (square reals
          (subtract reals
            (divide reals t s)
            (oneR reals)))
        (square reals
          (subtract reals
            (divide reals four t)
            (oneR reals))))

  solution : R
  solution =
    subtract reals
      twelve
      (multiply reals eight (squareRoot reals two))

  IsMinimumValue : R -> Set
  IsMinimumValue minimum =
    ((r s t : R) ->
      Feasible r s t ->
      lessOrEqual reals minimum (objective r s t))
    and
    Exists R
      (\ r ->
        Exists R
          (\ s ->
            Exists R
              (\ t ->
                Feasible r s t
                and
                minimum == objective r s t)))

  proposition : Set
  proposition =
    IsMinimumValue solution

putnam-1981-b2 : Set1
putnam-1981-b2 =
  (R : Set) ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) ->
  Putnam1981B2Statement.proposition reals

(*
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1981_b2:
  the minimum of a four-term sum of squared successive ratio deviations over
  real numbers satisfying 1 <= r <= s <= t <= 4. This file contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open realTheory transcTheory;

val putnam_1981_b2 =
  ``let feasible =
      \r s t : real.
        1 <= r /\ r <= s /\ s <= t /\ t <= 4
    in
    let objective =
      \r s t : real.
        (r - 1) pow 2 +
        (s / r - 1) pow 2 +
        (t / s - 1) pow 2 +
        (4 / t - 1) pow 2
    in
    let solution = 12 - 8 * sqrt 2
    in
      (!r s t : real.
         feasible r s t ==> solution <= objective r s t) /\
      (?r s t : real.
         feasible r s t /\ solution = objective r s t)``;

% Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench artifact putnam_1981_b2:
% the minimum of the stated four-term squared-ratio expression over
% 1 <= r <= s <= t <= 4 is 12 - 8*sqrt(2). This file contains no proof.

putnam_1981_b2: THEORY
BEGIN
  sqrt_value(root, radicand: real): bool =
    0 <= root AND root * root = radicand

  safe_div(numerator, denominator: real): real =
    IF denominator = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      numerator / denominator
    ENDIF

  feasible(r, s, t: real): bool =
    1 <= r AND r <= s AND s <= t AND t <= 4

  objective(r, s, t: real): real =
    (r - 1) ^ 2
      + (safe_div(s, r) - 1) ^ 2
      + (safe_div(t, s) - 1) ^ 2
      + (safe_div(4, t) - 1) ^ 2

  is_minimum_value(value: real): bool =
    (FORALL (r, s, t: real):
      feasible(r, s, t) IMPLIES value <= objective(r, s, t))
      AND
        (EXISTS (r, s, t: real):
          feasible(r, s, t) AND value = objective(r, s, t))

  putnam_1981_b2: bool =
    EXISTS (sqrt_2: real):
      sqrt_value(sqrt_2, 2)
        AND is_minimum_value(12 - 8 * sqrt_2)
END putnam_1981_b2

/--
Prove that, for infinitely many positive integers $n$, all primes $p$ that divide $n^2 + 3$ also divide $k^2 + 3$ for some integer $k$ such that $k^2 < n$.

theorem putnam_1981_b3
    (P : ℕ → Prop)

    ∀ n : ℕ, ∃ m : ℕ, (m : ℤ) > n ∧ P m :=
  sorry
