;; Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1981_b3:
;; the natural numbers n for which every prime divisor of n^2+3 already
;; divides k^2+3 for some natural k with k^2<n are unbounded. This file
;; contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(defun putnam-1981-b3-no-divisor-through-p (p candidate)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix candidate)))
  (if (or (not (natp candidate))
          (<= candidate 1))
      t
    (and
     (not (equal (mod p candidate) 0))
     (putnam-1981-b3-no-divisor-through-p
      p (- candidate 1)))))

(defun putnam-1981-b3-prime-p (p)
  (and
   (natp p)
   (< 1 p)
   (putnam-1981-b3-no-divisor-through-p
    p (- p 1))))

;; The witness k remains an internal existentially quantified natural.
(defun-sk putnam-1981-b3-small-witness-exists-p (p m)
  (exists (k)
    (and
     (natp k)
     (< (* k k) m)
     (equal
      (mod (+ (* k k) 3) p)
      0))))

;; This is the source predicate P, expanded definitionally. Quantifying over
;; all ACL2 objects with the prime predicate in the antecedent is exactly
;; quantification over natural primes.
(defun-sk putnam-1981-b3-qualifying-p (m)
  (forall (p)
    (implies
     (and
      (putnam-1981-b3-prime-p p)
      (equal
       (mod (+ (* m m) 3) p)
       0))
     (putnam-1981-b3-small-witness-exists-p
      p m))))

;; The source conclusion is genuinely unbounded: for each natural n, the
;; witness m is existentially quantified with no prescribed upper bound.
(defun-sk putnam-1981-b3-larger-qualifying-exists-p (n)
  (exists (m)
    (and
     (natp m)
     (< n m)
     (putnam-1981-b3-qualifying-p m))))

(defun-sk putnambench-putnam-1981-b3-statement ()
  (forall (n)
    (implies
     (natp n)
     (putnam-1981-b3-larger-qualifying-exists-p
      n))))

-- Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1981_b3:
-- infinitely many positive natural numbers n have the property that every
-- prime divisor p of n^2 + 3 also divides k^2 + 3 for some natural k with
-- k^2 < n. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; _*_)

infix 4 _<=_ _<_ _divides_
infixr 3 _and_
infixr 2 _or_

data _<=_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set where
  zero<= : {n : Nat} -> zero <= n
  suc<=suc : {m n : Nat} -> m <= n -> suc m <= suc n

_<_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set
m < n =
  suc m <= n

record _and_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data _or_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  left  : A -> A or B
  right : B -> A or B

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

record _divides_ (divisor dividend : Nat) : Set where
  field
    quotient          : Nat
    division-equation : dividend == divisor * quotient

one : Nat
one =
  suc zero

two : Nat
two =
  suc one

three : Nat
three =
  suc two

record Prime (p : Nat) : Set where
  field
    at-least-two : two <= p
    only-trivial-divisors :
      (d : Nat) ->
      d divides p ->
      (d == one) or (d == p)

squarePlusThree : Nat -> Nat
squarePlusThree n =
  n * n + three

PutnamProperty : Nat -> Set
PutnamProperty n =
  (p : Nat) ->
  (Prime p and (p divides squarePlusThree n)) ->
  Exists Nat
    (\ k ->
      (p divides squarePlusThree k)
      and
      (k * k < n))

putnam-1981-b3 : Set
putnam-1981-b3 =
  (n : Nat) ->
  Exists Nat
    (\ m ->
      (n < m)
      and
      PutnamProperty m)

$(
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact
  putnam_1981_b3: unboundedly many nonnegative integers n have the property
  that every prime divisor p of n^2 + 3 also divides k^2 + 3 for some
  nonnegative integer k with k^2 < n. This file contains no proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  NN0 is SetMM's class of nonnegative integers, Prime is its class of
  natural prime numbers, and || is integer divisibility. Restricting p to
  Prime is equivalent to the sources' implication guarded by primality.
  Natural and integer divisibility agree for the nonnegative expressions
  used here.

  The source predicate P is inlined at m. The existential witness k remains
  inside the universal quantifier over prime divisors, and the outer
  forall-exists statement says exactly that the satisfying integers are
  unbounded. The final declaration is the single unproved $a corpus
  statement; this database contains no $p proof statement.
$)

${
  $d k m n p $.

  putnambench-putnam-1981-b3 $a |-
    A. n e. NN0
      E. m e. NN0
        (
          n < m
          /\
          A. p e. Prime
            (
              p || ( ( m ^ 2 ) + 3 )
              ->
              E. k e. NN0
                (
                  ( k ^ 2 ) < m
                  /\
                  p || ( ( k ^ 2 ) + 3 )
                )
            )
        )
  $.
$}

title: putnam_1981_b3
content:
% Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1981_b3:
% the natural numbers n for which every prime divisor of n^2 + 3 also divides
% some k^2 + 3 with k^2 < n are unbounded. This file contains no proof.

putnam_1981_b3: THEORY
BEGIN

  nat_divides(divisor, value: nat): bool =
    EXISTS (quotient: nat):
      value = divisor * quotient

  prime_nat(value: nat): bool =
    value >= 2
      AND FORALL (divisor: posnat):
        nat_divides(divisor, value)
          IMPLIES divisor = 1 OR divisor = value

  qualifying(value: nat): bool =
    FORALL (p: nat):
      (prime_nat(p) AND nat_divides(p, value ^ 2 + 3))
        IMPLIES
          EXISTS (k: nat):
            nat_divides(p, k ^ 2 + 3)
              AND k ^ 2 < value

  putnam_1981_b3: bool =
    FORALL (n: nat):
      EXISTS (m: nat):
        m > n AND qualifying(m)

END putnam_1981_b3

title: putnam_1981_b4
content:
import Mathlib

open Topology Filter Set Polynomial Function

abbrev putnam_1981_b4_solution : Prop := False
/--
Let $V$ be a set of $5$ by $7$ matrices, with real entries and with the property that $rA+sB \in V$ whenever $A,B \in V$ and $r$ and $s$ are scalars (i.e., real numbers). \emph{Prove or disprove} the following assertion: If $V$ contains matrices of ranks $0$, $1$, $2$, $4$, and $5$, then it also contains a matrix of rank $3$. [The rank of a nonzero matrix $M$ is the largest $k$ such that the entries of some $k$ rows and some $k$ columns form a $k$ by $k$ matrix with a nonzero determinant.]
-/
theorem putnam_1981_b4
    (VAB : Set (Matrix (Fin 5) (Fin 7) ℝ) → Prop)
    (Vrank : Set (Matrix (Fin 5) (Fin 7) ℝ) → ℕ → Prop)
    (hVAB : ∀ V, VAB V = (∀ A ∈ V, ∀ B ∈ V, ∀ r s : ℝ, r • A + s • B ∈ V))
    (hVrank : ∀ V k, Vrank V k = ∃ A ∈ V, A.rank = k) :
    putnam_1981_b4_solution ↔
    (∀ V,
      VAB V → Vrank V 0 → Vrank V 1 →
      Vrank V 2 → Vrank V 4 → Vrank V 5 →
    Vrank V 3) :=
  sorry

title: putnam_1981_b4
content:
(* Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench artifact putnam_1981_b4:
   real linear subspaces of 5 by 7 matrices and the existence of matrices of
   specified ranks. This file contains no proof. *)

From Stdlib Require Import Lists.List Arith.PeanoNat Vectors.Fin Reals.

Import ListNotations.
Open Scope R_scope.

Definition putnam_1981_b4_matrix : Type :=
  Fin.t 5 -> Fin.t 7 -> R.

Definition putnam_1981_b4_linear_combination
    (r : R) (A : putnam_1981_b4_matrix)
    (s : R) (B : putnam_1981_b4_matrix) :
    putnam_1981_b4_matrix :=
  fun i j => r * A i j + s * B i j.

Fixpoint putnam_1981_b4_sum (xs : list R) : R :=
  match xs with
  | [] => 0
  | x :: rest => x + putnam_1981_b4_sum rest
  end.

Definition putnam_1981_b4_delete_nth
    {T : Type} (j : nat) (xs : list T) : list T :=
  firstn j xs ++ skipn (S j) xs.

Definition putnam_1981_b4_cofactor_sign (j : nat) : R :=
  if Nat.even j then 1 else -1.

Fixpoint putnam_1981_b4_det
    (n : nat) (M : list (list R)) {struct n} : R :=
  match n with
  | O => 1
  | S k =>
      match M with
      | [] => 0
      | row :: rows =>
          putnam_1981_b4_sum
            (map
              (fun j : nat =>
                putnam_1981_b4_cofactor_sign j *
                nth j row 0 *
                putnam_1981_b4_det k
                  (map (putnam_1981_b4_delete_nth j) rows))
              (seq 0 (S k)))
      end
  end.

Definition putnam_1981_b4_minor
    (A : putnam_1981_b4_matrix)
    (rows : list (Fin.t 5))
    (cols : list (Fin.t 7)) : list (list R) :=
  map (fun i => map (fun j => A i j) cols) rows.

Definition putnam_1981_b4_rank_at_least
    (A : putnam_1981_b4_matrix) (k : nat) : Prop :=
  exists rows : list (Fin.t 5),
    exists cols : list (Fin.t 7),
      length rows = k /\
      length cols = k /\
      NoDup rows /\
      NoDup cols /\
      putnam_1981_b4_det k
        (putnam_1981_b4_minor A rows cols) <> 0.

Definition putnam_1981_b4_rank
    (A : putnam_1981_b4_matrix) (k : nat) : Prop :=
  putnam_1981_b4_rank_at_least A k /\
  forall l : nat,
    (k < l)%nat ->
    ~ putnam_1981_b4_rank_at_least A l.

Definition putnam_1981_b4_is_linear_set
    (V : putnam_1981_b4_matrix -> Prop) : Prop :=
  forall A : putnam_1981_b4_matrix,
    V A ->
    forall B : putnam_1981_b4_matrix,
      V B ->
      forall r s : R,
        V (putnam_1981_b4_linear_combination r A s B).

Definition putnam_1981_b4_solution : Prop := False.

Theorem putnam_1981_b4
    (VAB : (putnam_1981_b4_matrix -> Prop) -> Prop)
    (Vrank : (putnam_1981_b4_matrix -> Prop) -> nat -> Prop)
    (hVAB :
      forall V : putnam_1981_b4_matrix -> Prop,
        VAB V <-> putnam_1981_b4_is_linear_set V)
    (hVrank :
      forall (V : putnam_1981_b4_matrix -> Prop) (k : nat),
        Vrank V k <->
        exists A : putnam_1981_b4_matrix,
          V A /\ putnam_1981_b4_rank A k) :
  putnam_1981_b4_solution <->
  forall V : putnam_1981_b4_matrix -> Prop,
    VAB V ->
    Vrank V 0%nat ->
    Vrank V 1%nat ->
    Vrank V 2%nat ->
    Vrank V 4%nat ->
    Vrank V 5%nat ->
    Vrank V 3%nat.
Admitted.

title: putnam_1981_b4
content:
theory putnam_1981_b4 imports
Complex_Main
"HOL-Analysis.Finite_Cartesian_Product"
"HOL-Analysis.Cartesian_Space"
begin

definition putnam_1981_b4_solution :: bool where
  "putnam_1981_b4_solution = False"
theorem putnam_1981_b4:
  fixes VAB :: "(real^7^5) set \<Rightarrow> bool"
  and Vrank :: "(real^7^5) set \<Rightarrow> nat \<Rightarrow> bool"
  defines "VAB \<equiv> \<lambda> V :: (real^7^5) set. \<forall> A \<in> V. \<forall> B \<in> V. \<forall> r s :: real. r *\<^sub>R A + s *\<^sub>R B \<in> V"
  and "Vrank \<equiv> \<lambda> (V :: (real^7^5) set) (k :: nat). \<exists> A \<in> V. rank A = k"
  shows "(\<forall> V :: (real^7^5) set. (VAB V \<and> Vrank V 0 \<and> Vrank V 1 \<and> Vrank V 2 \<and> Vrank V 4 \<and> Vrank V 5) \<longrightarrow> Vrank V 3) \<longleftrightarrow> putnam_1981_b4_solution"
  sorry

end

title: putnam_1981_b4
putnam_1981_b4
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1981_b4:
;; the assertion that every real linear subspace of 5-by-7 matrices containing
;; ranks 0, 1, 2, 4, and 5 also contains rank 3 is false. This file contains
;; no proof or counterexample construction.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))

;; Standard ACL2 has no primitive carrier for arbitrary real values. These
;; conservative interfaces describe a complete Archimedean ordered field,
;; hence the real field up to ordered-field isomorphism. Matrices are flat
;; row-major lists of 35 carrier elements.

(defstub putnam-1981-b4-real-p (real-type value) t)
(defstub putnam-1981-b4-zero (real-type) t)
(defstub putnam-1981-b4-one (real-type) t)
(defstub putnam-1981-b4-add (real-type left right) t)
(defstub putnam-1981-b4-mul (real-type left right) t)
(defstub putnam-1981-b4-neg (real-type value) t)
(defstub putnam-1981-b4-inv (real-type value) t)
(defstub putnam-1981-b4-less (real-type left right) t)
(defstub putnam-1981-b4-integer-embed (real-type value) t)
(defstub putnam-1981-b4-supremum (real-type set) t)

(defun putnam-1981-b4-leq (real-type left right)
  (not (putnam-1981-b4-less real-type right left)))

(defun putnam-1981-b4-real-set-member-p (set value)
  (if (apply$ set (list value)) t nil))

(defun-sk putnam-1981-b4-field-laws-p (real-type)
  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (putnam-1981-b4-real-p real-type x)
      (putnam-1981-b4-real-p real-type y)
      (putnam-1981-b4-real-p real-type z))
     (let* ((zero (putnam-1981-b4-zero real-type))
            (one (putnam-1981-b4-one real-type))
            (x-plus-y (putnam-1981-b4-add real-type x y))
            (y-plus-z (putnam-1981-b4-add real-type y z))
            (x-times-y (putnam-1981-b4-mul real-type x y))
            (y-times-z (putnam-1981-b4-mul real-type y z))
            (minus-x (putnam-1981-b4-neg real-type x))
            (inverse-x (putnam-1981-b4-inv real-type x)))
       (and
        (putnam-1981-b4-real-p real-type x-plus-y)
        (putnam-1981-b4-real-p real-type x-times-y)
        (putnam-1981-b4-real-p real-type minus-x)
        (putnam-1981-b4-real-p real-type inverse-x)
        (equal
         (putnam-1981-b4-add real-type x-plus-y z)
         (putnam-1981-b4-add real-type x y-plus-z))
        (equal x-plus-y (putnam-1981-b4-add real-type y x))
        (equal (putnam-1981-b4-add real-type x zero) x)
        (equal (putnam-1981-b4-add real-type x minus-x) zero)
        (equal
         (putnam-1981-b4-mul real-type x-times-y z)
         (putnam-1981-b4-mul real-type x y-times-z))
        (equal x-times-y (putnam-1981-b4-mul real-type y x))
        (equal (putnam-1981-b4-mul real-type x one) x)
        (implies
         (equal x zero)
         (equal inverse-x zero))
        (implies
         (not (equal x zero))
         (equal
          (putnam-1981-b4-mul real-type x inverse-x)
          one))
        (equal
         (putnam-1981-b4-mul real-type x y-plus-z)
         (putnam-1981-b4-add
          real-type
          (putnam-1981-b4-mul real-type x y)
          (putnam-1981-b4-mul real-type x z))))))))

(defun-sk putnam-1981-b4-order-laws-p (real-type)
  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (putnam-1981-b4-real-p real-type x)
      (putnam-1981-b4-real-p real-type y)
      (putnam-1981-b4-real-p real-type z))
     (let ((zero (putnam-1981-b4-zero real-type)))
       (and
        (not (putnam-1981-b4-less real-type x x))
        (or
         (putnam-1981-b4-less real-type x y)
         (equal x y)
         (putnam-1981-b4-less real-type y x))
        (implies
         (and
          (putnam-1981-b4-less real-type x y)
          (putnam-1981-b4-less real-type y z))
         (putnam-1981-b4-less real-type x z))
        (implies
         (putnam-1981-b4-less real-type x y)
         (putnam-1981-b4-less
          real-type
          (putnam-1981-b4-add real-type x z)
          (putnam-1981-b4-add real-type y z)))
        (implies
         (and
          (putnam-1981-b4-less real-type zero x)
          (putnam-1981-b4-less real-type zero y))
         (putnam-1981-b4-less
          real-type
          zero
          (putnam-1981-b4-mul real-type x y))))))))

(defun-sk putnam-1981-b4-integer-embedding-laws-p
    (real-type)
  (forall (m n)
    (implies
     (and (integerp m) (integerp n))
     (and
      (putnam-1981-b4-real-p
       real-type
       (putnam-1981-b4-integer-embed real-type m))
      (equal
       (putnam-1981-b4-integer-embed real-type (+ m n))
       (putnam-1981-b4-add
        real-type
        (putnam-1981-b4-integer-embed real-type m)
        (putnam-1981-b4-integer-embed real-type n)))
      (equal
       (putnam-1981-b4-integer-embed real-type (* m n))
       (putnam-1981-b4-mul
        real-type
        (putnam-1981-b4-integer-embed real-type m)
        (putnam-1981-b4-integer-embed real-type n)))
      (iff
       (< m n)
       (putnam-1981-b4-less
        real-type
        (putnam-1981-b4-integer-embed real-type m)
        (putnam-1981-b4-integer-embed real-type n)))))))

(defun-sk putnam-1981-b4-valid-real-set-p
    (real-type set)
  (forall (value)
    (implies
     (putnam-1981-b4-real-set-member-p set value)
     (putnam-1981-b4-real-p real-type value))))

(defun-sk putnam-1981-b4-upper-bound-p
    (real-type set upper)
  (forall (value)
    (implies
     (and
      (putnam-1981-b4-real-p real-type value)
      (putnam-1981-b4-real-set-member-p set value))
     (putnam-1981-b4-leq real-type value upper))))

(defun-sk putnam-1981-b4-real-set-nonempty-p
    (real-type set)
  (exists (value)
    (and
     (putnam-1981-b4-real-p real-type value)
     (putnam-1981-b4-real-set-member-p set value))))

(defun-sk putnam-1981-b4-real-set-bounded-p
    (real-type set)
  (exists (upper)
    (and
     (putnam-1981-b4-real-p real-type upper)
     (putnam-1981-b4-upper-bound-p
      real-type set upper))))

(defun-sk putnam-1981-b4-least-upper-bound-p
    (real-type set supremum)
  (forall (upper)
    (implies
     (and
      (putnam-1981-b4-real-p real-type upper)
      (putnam-1981-b4-upper-bound-p
       real-type set upper))
     (putnam-1981-b4-leq
      real-type supremum upper))))

(defun-sk putnam-1981-b4-completeness-p (real-type)
  (forall (set)
    (implies
     (and
      (tamep-functionp set)
      (putnam-1981-b4-valid-real-set-p real-type set)
      (putnam-1981-b4-real-set-nonempty-p real-type set)
      (putnam-1981-b4-real-set-bounded-p real-type set))
     (let ((supremum
            (putnam-1981-b4-supremum real-type set)))
       (and
        (putnam-1981-b4-real-p real-type supremum)
        (putnam-1981-b4-upper-bound-p
         real-type set supremum)
        (putnam-1981-b4-least-upper-bound-p
         real-type set supremum))))))

(defun-sk putnam-1981-b4-archimedean-witness-p
    (real-type value)
  (exists (n)
    (and
     (natp n)
     (putnam-1981-b4-less
      real-type
      value
      (putnam-1981-b4-integer-embed real-type n)))))

(defun-sk putnam-1981-b4-archimedean-p (real-type)
  (forall (value)
    (implies
     (putnam-1981-b4-real-p real-type value)
     (putnam-1981-b4-archimedean-witness-p
      real-type value))))

(defun putnam-1981-b4-real-field-p (real-type)
  (let ((zero (putnam-1981-b4-zero real-type))
        (one (putnam-1981-b4-one real-type)))
    (and
     (putnam-1981-b4-real-p real-type zero)
     (putnam-1981-b4-real-p real-type one)
     (not (equal zero one))
     (putnam-1981-b4-field-laws-p real-type)
     (putnam-1981-b4-order-laws-p real-type)
     (putnam-1981-b4-less real-type zero one)
     (equal
      (putnam-1981-b4-integer-embed real-type 0)
      zero)
     (equal
      (putnam-1981-b4-integer-embed real-type 1)
      one)
     (putnam-1981-b4-integer-embedding-laws-p real-type)
     (putnam-1981-b4-completeness-p real-type)
     (putnam-1981-b4-archimedean-p real-type))))

;; Every subspace of the 35-dimensional matrix space has a finite spanning
;; list. Quantifying over all such lists is therefore equivalent to
;; quantifying over all real linear subspaces, without second-order set
;; parameters.

(defun putnam-1981-b4-real-list-p (real-type values)
  (if (consp values)
      (and
       (putnam-1981-b4-real-p real-type (car values))
       (putnam-1981-b4-real-list-p real-type (cdr values)))
    (equal values nil)))

(defun putnam-1981-b4-matrix-p (real-type matrix)
  (and
   (true-listp matrix)
   (equal (len matrix) 35)
   (putnam-1981-b4-real-list-p real-type matrix)))

(defun putnam-1981-b4-basis-p (real-type basis)
  (if (consp basis)
      (and
       (putnam-1981-b4-matrix-p real-type (car basis))
       (putnam-1981-b4-basis-p real-type (cdr basis)))
    (equal basis nil)))

(defun putnam-1981-b4-repeat (value count)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix count)))
  (if (zp count)
      nil
    (cons value
          (putnam-1981-b4-repeat value (- count 1)))))

(defun putnam-1981-b4-zero-matrix (real-type)
  (putnam-1981-b4-repeat
   (putnam-1981-b4-zero real-type)
   35))

(defun putnam-1981-b4-scale-matrix
    (real-type scalar matrix)
  (if (consp matrix)
      (cons
       (putnam-1981-b4-mul
        real-type scalar (car matrix))
       (putnam-1981-b4-scale-matrix
        real-type scalar (cdr matrix)))
    nil))

(defun putnam-1981-b4-add-matrices
    (real-type left right)
  (if (and (consp left) (consp right))
      (cons
       (putnam-1981-b4-add
        real-type (car left) (car right))
       (putnam-1981-b4-add-matrices
        real-type (cdr left) (cdr right)))
    nil))

(defun putnam-1981-b4-coefficients-p
    (real-type coefficients basis)
  (if (consp basis)
      (and
       (consp coefficients)
       (putnam-1981-b4-real-p
        real-type (car coefficients))
       (putnam-1981-b4-coefficients-p
        real-type (cdr coefficients) (cdr basis)))
    (equal coefficients nil)))

(defun putnam-1981-b4-linear-combination
    (real-type coefficients basis)
  (if (consp basis)
      (putnam-1981-b4-add-matrices
       real-type
       (putnam-1981-b4-scale-matrix
        real-type (car coefficients) (car basis))
       (putnam-1981-b4-linear-combination
        real-type (cdr coefficients) (cdr basis)))
    (putnam-1981-b4-zero-matrix real-type)))

;; Rank is the largest size of a nonzero minor, exactly as in the informal
;; problem. Rows and columns are selected by duplicate-free bounded lists.

(defun putnam-1981-b4-range-from (start count)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix count)))
  (if (zp count)
      nil
    (cons start
          (putnam-1981-b4-range-from
           (+ start 1) (- count 1)))))

(defun putnam-1981-b4-prefix-each (item lists)
  (if (consp lists)
      (cons
       (cons item (car lists))
       (putnam-1981-b4-prefix-each item (cdr lists)))
    nil))

(defun putnam-1981-b4-insert-everywhere (item values)
  (if (consp values)
      (cons
       (cons item values)
       (putnam-1981-b4-prefix-each
        (car values)
        (putnam-1981-b4-insert-everywhere
         item (cdr values))))
    (list (list item))))

(defun putnam-1981-b4-insert-into-each (item lists)
  (if (consp lists)
      (append
       (putnam-1981-b4-insert-everywhere
        item (car lists))
       (putnam-1981-b4-insert-into-each
        item (cdr lists)))
    nil))

(defun putnam-1981-b4-permutations (values)
  (if (consp values)
      (putnam-1981-b4-insert-into-each
       (car values)
       (putnam-1981-b4-permutations (cdr values)))
    (list nil)))

(defun putnam-1981-b4-count-greater (item values)
  (if (consp values)
      (+ (if (> item (car values)) 1 0)
         (putnam-1981-b4-count-greater
          item (cdr values)))
    0))

(defun putnam-1981-b4-inversion-count (permutation)
  (if (consp permutation)
      (+ (putnam-1981-b4-count-greater
          (car permutation) (cdr permutation))
         (putnam-1981-b4-inversion-count
          (cdr permutation)))
    0))

(defun putnam-1981-b4-minor-entries
    (matrix size rows columns index remaining)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix remaining)))
  (if (zp remaining)
      nil
    (let* ((minor-row (floor index size))
           (minor-column (mod index size))
           (source-row (nth minor-row rows))
           (source-column (nth minor-column columns)))
      (cons
       (nth (+ (* source-row 7) source-column) matrix)
       (putnam-1981-b4-minor-entries
        matrix size rows columns
        (+ index 1) (- remaining 1))))))

(defun putnam-1981-b4-diagonal-product
    (real-type matrix size permutation row)
  (if (consp permutation)
      (putnam-1981-b4-mul
       real-type
       (nth (+ (* row size) (car permutation)) matrix)
       (putnam-1981-b4-diagonal-product
        real-type matrix size (cdr permutation) (+ row 1)))
    (putnam-1981-b4-one real-type)))

(defun putnam-1981-b4-determinant-sum
    (real-type matrix size permutations)
  (if (consp permutations)
      (let* ((permutation (car permutations))
             (product
              (putnam-1981-b4-diagonal-product
               real-type matrix size permutation 0))
             (signed-product
              (if (evenp
                   (putnam-1981-b4-inversion-count permutation))
                  product
                (putnam-1981-b4-neg real-type product))))
        (putnam-1981-b4-add
         real-type
         signed-product
         (putnam-1981-b4-determinant-sum
          real-type matrix size (cdr permutations))))
    (putnam-1981-b4-zero real-type)))

(defun putnam-1981-b4-determinant
    (real-type matrix size)
  (putnam-1981-b4-determinant-sum
   real-type
   matrix
   size
   (putnam-1981-b4-permutations
    (putnam-1981-b4-range-from 0 size))))

(defun putnam-1981-b4-bounded-nat-list-p
    (values bound)
  (if (consp values)
      (and
       (natp (car values))
       (< (car values) bound)
       (putnam-1981-b4-bounded-nat-list-p
        (cdr values) bound))
    (equal values nil)))

(defun putnam-1981-b4-valid-selection-p
    (values bound size)
  (and
   (true-listp values)
   (equal (len values) size)
   (putnam-1981-b4-bounded-nat-list-p values bound)
   (no-duplicatesp-equal values)))

(defun-sk putnam-1981-b4-has-nonzero-minor-p
    (real-type matrix size)
  (exists (rows columns)
    (and
     (natp size)
     (<= size 5)
     (putnam-1981-b4-valid-selection-p rows 5 size)
     (putnam-1981-b4-valid-selection-p columns 7 size)
     (not
      (equal
       (putnam-1981-b4-determinant
        real-type
        (putnam-1981-b4-minor-entries
         matrix size rows columns 0 (* size size))
        size)
       (putnam-1981-b4-zero real-type))))))

(defun-sk putnam-1981-b4-no-larger-minor-p
    (real-type matrix rank-value)
  (forall (larger-size)
    (implies
     (and
      (natp larger-size)
      (< rank-value larger-size)
      (<= larger-size 5))
     (not
      (putnam-1981-b4-has-nonzero-minor-p
       real-type matrix larger-size)))))

(defun putnam-1981-b4-matrix-has-rank-p
    (real-type matrix rank-value)
  (and
   (putnam-1981-b4-matrix-p real-type matrix)
   (natp rank-value)
   (<= rank-value 5)
   (putnam-1981-b4-has-nonzero-minor-p
    real-type matrix rank-value)
   (putnam-1981-b4-no-larger-minor-p
    real-type matrix rank-value)))

(defun-sk putnam-1981-b4-span-contains-rank-p
    (real-type basis rank-value)
  (exists (coefficients)
    (and
     (putnam-1981-b4-coefficients-p
      real-type coefficients basis)
     (putnam-1981-b4-matrix-has-rank-p
      real-type
      (putnam-1981-b4-linear-combination
       real-type coefficients basis)
      rank-value))))

(defun-sk putnam-1981-b4-universal-assertion-p
    (real-type)
  (forall (basis)
    (implies
     (and
      (putnam-1981-b4-basis-p real-type basis)
      (putnam-1981-b4-span-contains-rank-p
       real-type basis 0)
      (putnam-1981-b4-span-contains-rank-p
       real-type basis 1)
      (putnam-1981-b4-span-contains-rank-p
       real-type basis 2)
      (putnam-1981-b4-span-contains-rank-p
       real-type basis 4)
      (putnam-1981-b4-span-contains-rank-p
       real-type basis 5))
     (putnam-1981-b4-span-contains-rank-p
      real-type basis 3))))

(defun putnambench-putnam-1981-b4-statement (real-type)
  (implies
   (putnam-1981-b4-real-field-p real-type)
   (iff
    (putnam-1981-b4-universal-assertion-p real-type)
    nil)))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

title: putnam_1981_b4
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1981_b4:
-- the assertion that a real linear subspace of 5 by 7 matrices containing
-- ranks 0, 1, 2, 4, and 5 must also contain rank 3 is false.
-- This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

open import Agda.Primitive using (Level; _⊔_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; _*_)

infix 4 _!=_
infixr 3 _and_

data Bottom : Set where

Not :
  {a : Level} ->
  Set a ->
  Set a
Not A =
  A -> Bottom

_!=_ : {A : Set} -> A -> A -> Set
x != y =
  Not (x == y)

record _and_
  {a b : Level}
  (A : Set a)
  (B : Set b) :
  Set (a ⊔ b) where

  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data _or_
  {a b : Level}
  (A : Set a)
  (B : Set b) :
  Set (a ⊔ b) where

  left  : A -> A or B
  right : B -> A or B

record Iff
  {a b : Level}
  (A : Set a)
  (B : Set b) :
  Set (a ⊔ b) where

  constructor equivalence
  field
    forward  : A -> B
    backward : B -> A

record Exists
  {a p : Level}
  (A : Set a)
  (property : A -> Set p) :
  Set (a ⊔ p) where

  constructor witness
  field
    value     : A
    satisfies : property value

record CompleteOrderedRealField (R : Set) : Set1 where
  field
    zeroR oneR : R
    add multiply : R -> R -> R
    negate inverse : R -> R
    lessOrEqual : R -> R -> Set
    fromNat : Nat -> R

    one-not-zero :
      oneR != zeroR

    add-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> add x y == add y x
    add-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      add (add x y) z == add x (add y z)
    add-zero :
      (x : R) -> add x zeroR == x
    add-inverse :
      (x : R) -> add x (negate x) == zeroR

    multiply-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> multiply x y == multiply y x
    multiply-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply (multiply x y) z ==
      multiply x (multiply y z)
    multiply-one :
      (x : R) -> multiply x oneR == x
    multiply-zero :
      (x : R) -> multiply x zeroR == zeroR
    distribute :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply x (add y z) ==
      add (multiply x y) (multiply x z)
    inverse-zero :
      inverse zeroR == zeroR
    multiply-inverse :
      (x : R) ->
      x != zeroR ->
      multiply x (inverse x) == oneR

    order-reflexive :
      (x : R) -> lessOrEqual x x
    order-transitive :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y z ->
      lessOrEqual x z
    order-antisymmetric :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y x ->
      x == y
    order-total :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y or lessOrEqual y x
    add-order :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual (add z x) (add z y)
    multiply-nonnegative :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR x ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR y ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR (multiply x y)
    zero-less-than-one :
      lessOrEqual zeroR oneR and zeroR != oneR

    fromNat-zero :
      fromNat zero == zeroR
    fromNat-successor :
      (n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (suc n) == add (fromNat n) oneR
    fromNat-addition :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m + n) == add (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-multiplication :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m * n) == multiply (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-injective :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat m == fromNat n ->
      m == n

    archimedean :
      (x : R) ->
      Exists Nat (\ n -> lessOrEqual x (fromNat n))
    least-upper-bound :
      (P : R -> Set) ->
      Exists R P ->
      Exists R
        (\ upper ->
          (x : R) ->
          P x ->
          lessOrEqual x upper) ->
      Exists R
        (\ supremum ->
          ((x : R) ->
            P x ->
            lessOrEqual x supremum)
          and
          ((upper : R) ->
            ((x : R) ->
              P x ->
              lessOrEqual x upper) ->
            lessOrEqual supremum upper))

open CompleteOrderedRealField

data Fin : Nat -> Set where
  fzero : {n : Nat} -> Fin (suc n)
  fsuc  : {n : Nat} -> Fin n -> Fin (suc n)

Matrix : Set -> Nat -> Nat -> Set
Matrix R rows columns =
  Fin rows -> Fin columns -> R

Predicate : Set -> Set1
Predicate A =
  A -> Set

sumFin :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  {n : Nat} ->
  (Fin n -> R) ->
  R
sumFin reals {zero} term =
  zeroR reals
sumFin reals {suc n} term =
  add reals
    (term fzero)
    (sumFin reals (\ i -> term (fsuc i)))

skip :
  {n : Nat} ->
  Fin (suc n) ->
  Fin n ->
  Fin (suc n)
skip {zero} removed ()
skip {suc n} fzero i =
  fsuc i
skip {suc n} (fsuc removed) fzero =
  fzero
skip {suc n} (fsuc removed) (fsuc i) =
  fsuc (skip removed i)

firstRowMinor :
  {R : Set} {n : Nat} ->
  Matrix R (suc n) (suc n) ->
  Fin (suc n) ->
  Matrix R n n
firstRowMinor A removedColumn i j =
  A (fsuc i) (skip removedColumn j)

alternatingSign :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  {n : Nat} ->
  Fin n ->
  R
alternatingSign reals fzero =
  oneR reals
alternatingSign reals (fsuc i) =
  negate reals (alternatingSign reals i)

determinant :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  {n : Nat} ->
  Matrix R n n ->
  R
determinant reals {zero} A =
  oneR reals
determinant reals {suc n} A =
  sumFin reals
    (\ column ->
      multiply reals
        (alternatingSign reals column)
        (multiply reals
          (A fzero column)
          (determinant reals (firstRowMinor A column))))

Injective :
  {A B : Set} ->
  (A -> B) ->
  Set
Injective f =
  (x y : _) ->
  f x == f y ->
  x == y

submatrix :
  {R : Set} {rows columns k : Nat} ->
  Matrix R rows columns ->
  (Fin k -> Fin rows) ->
  (Fin k -> Fin columns) ->
  Matrix R k k
submatrix A selectedRows selectedColumns i j =
  A (selectedRows i) (selectedColumns j)

RankAtLeast :
  {R : Set} {rows columns : Nat} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Matrix R rows columns ->
  Nat ->
  Set
RankAtLeast {rows = rows} {columns = columns} reals A k =
  Exists (Fin k -> Fin rows)
    (\ selectedRows ->
      Injective selectedRows
      and
      Exists (Fin k -> Fin columns)
        (\ selectedColumns ->
          Injective selectedColumns
          and
          determinant reals
            (submatrix A selectedRows selectedColumns)
          !=
          zeroR reals))

HasRank :
  {R : Set} {rows columns : Nat} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Matrix R rows columns ->
  Nat ->
  Set
HasRank reals A k =
  RankAtLeast reals A k
  and
  Not (RankAtLeast reals A (suc k))

zeroN : Nat
zeroN =
  zero

oneN : Nat
oneN =
  suc zeroN

twoN : Nat
twoN =
  suc oneN

threeN : Nat
threeN =
  suc twoN

fourN : Nat
fourN =
  suc threeN

fiveN : Nat
fiveN =
  suc fourN

sixN : Nat
sixN =
  suc fiveN

sevenN : Nat
sevenN =
  suc sixN

linearCombination :
  {R : Set} {rows columns : Nat} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  Matrix R rows columns ->
  R ->
  Matrix R rows columns ->
  Matrix R rows columns
linearCombination reals r A s B i j =
  add reals
    (multiply reals r (A i j))
    (multiply reals s (B i j))

ClosedUnderLinearCombinations :
  {R : Set} {rows columns : Nat} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Predicate (Matrix R rows columns) ->
  Set
ClosedUnderLinearCombinations reals V =
  (A B : _) ->
  V A ->
  V B ->
  (r s : _) ->
  V (linearCombination reals r A s B)

ContainsRank :
  {R : Set} {rows columns : Nat} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Predicate (Matrix R rows columns) ->
  Nat ->
  Set
ContainsRank reals V k =
  Exists _
    (\ A ->
      V A
      and
      HasRank reals A k)

Assertion :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Set1
Assertion {R} reals =
  (V : Predicate (Matrix R fiveN sevenN)) ->
  ClosedUnderLinearCombinations reals V ->
  ContainsRank reals V zeroN ->
  ContainsRank reals V oneN ->
  ContainsRank reals V twoN ->
  ContainsRank reals V fourN ->
  ContainsRank reals V fiveN ->
  ContainsRank reals V threeN

putnam-1981-b4-solution : Set
putnam-1981-b4-solution =
  Bottom

putnam-1981-b4 : Set1
putnam-1981-b4 =
  (R : Set) ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) ->
  Iff
    (Assertion reals)
    putnam-1981-b4-solution

title: putnam_1981_b4
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1981_b4:
  the falsity of the assertion that a real 5 by 7 matrix subspace containing
  ranks 0, 1, 2, 4, and 5 must also contain rank 3. This file contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open arithmeticTheory listTheory rich_listTheory sortingTheory;
open pred_setTheory fcpTheory realTheory real_sigmaTheory matrixTheory;

val putnam_1981_b4 =
  ``let valid_indices =
      \bound k : num.
      \xs : num list.
        LENGTH xs = k /\
        ALL_DISTINCT xs /\
        EVERY (\i : num. i < bound) xs
    in
    let minor_det =
      \A : real['N]['M].
      \rows cols : num list.
        let k = LENGTH rows
        in
          SIGMA
            (\p : num list.
               (-1 : real) pow
                 CARD
                   {ij : num # num |
                      FST ij < SND ij /\
                      SND ij < k /\
                      EL (SND ij) p < EL (FST ij) p} *
               REAL_PROD_IMAGE
                 (\i : num.
                    A ' (EL i rows) ' (EL (EL i p) cols))
                 (count k))
            {p : num list | PERM p (GENLIST I k)}
    in
    let has_nonzero_minor =
      \A : real['N]['M].
      \k : num.
        ?rows cols : num list.
          valid_indices 5 k rows /\
          valid_indices 7 k cols /\
          minor_det A rows cols <> 0
    in
    let has_rank =
      \A : real['N]['M].
      \k : num.
        has_nonzero_minor A k /\
        ~has_nonzero_minor A (SUC k)
    in
    let VAB =
      \V : real['N]['M] set.
        !A B : real['N]['M].
        !r s : real.
          A IN V /\ B IN V ==> r * A + s * B IN V
    in
      dimindex (:'M) = 5 /\
      dimindex (:'N) = 7
      ==>
      ((!V : real['N]['M] set.
          VAB V /\
          (?A : real['N]['M]. A IN V /\ has_rank A 0) /\
          (?A : real['N]['M]. A IN V /\ has_rank A 1) /\
          (?A : real['N]['M]. A IN V /\ has_rank A 2) /\
          (?A : real['N]['M]. A IN V /\ has_rank A 4) /\
          (?A : real['N]['M]. A IN V /\ has_rank A 5)
          ==>
          ?A : real['N]['M]. A IN V /\ has_rank A 3)
       <=>
       F)``;

title: putnam_1981_b4
content:
$(
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact
  putnam_1981_b4: the assertion that every real linear subspace of five-by-
  seven matrices containing ranks zero, one, two, four, and five also
  contains rank three is false. This file contains no proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  P81B4Rows and P81B4Cols are the Fin 5 and Fin 7 index sets, and
  P81B4Matrices is the full set of real five-by-seven matrices.

  P81B4Minor A k says that A has a nonzero k-by-k minor. The k = 0
  disjunct is the standard nonzero empty minor. For positive k, R and C
  select k rows and k columns, and f reindexes the selected columns by R;
  changing f can only change the determinant by a sign. Thus
  P81B4Rank A k is exactly the source rank definition: k is the largest
  size of a nonzero minor.

  P81B4Linear V states closure under every real linear combination r A + s B.
  The final assertion is the negation of the proposed universal implication,
  matching the source's specified solution False. All declarations are
  unproved $a statement encodings; this database contains no $p proof.
$)

$c
  P81B4Rows P81B4Cols P81B4Matrices
  P81B4Minor P81B4Rank P81B4Linear
$.

p81b4-rows-syntax $a class P81B4Rows $.
p81b4-cols-syntax $a class P81B4Cols $.
p81b4-matrices-syntax $a class P81B4Matrices $.
p81b4-minor-syntax $a wff ( P81B4Minor A k ) $.
p81b4-rank-syntax $a wff ( P81B4Rank A k ) $.
p81b4-linear-syntax $a wff ( P81B4Linear V ) $.

p81b4-rows-definition $a |- P81B4Rows = ( 0 ..^ 5 ) $.
p81b4-cols-definition $a |- P81B4Cols = ( 0 ..^ 7 ) $.
p81b4-matrices-definition $a |- P81B4Matrices =
  ( RR ^m ( P81B4Rows X. P81B4Cols ) )
$.

${
  $d A C R f i j k $.

  p81b4-minor-definition $a |- (
    ( P81B4Minor A k )
    <->
    (
      k = 0
      \/
      E. R e. ~P P81B4Rows
        E. C e. ~P P81B4Cols
          (
            (
              ( ( # ` R ) = k /\ ( # ` C ) = k )
              /\
              E. f
                (
                  f : R -1-1-onto-> C
                  /\
                  (
                    (
                      ( R maDet RRfld )
                      `
                      (
                        i e. R , j e. R |->
                          ( A ` <. i , ( f ` j ) >. )
                      )
                    )
                    =/=
                    0
                  )
                )
            )
          )
    )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d A k $.

  p81b4-rank-definition $a |- (
    ( P81B4Rank A k )
    <->
    (
      k e. NN0
      /\
      (
        ( P81B4Minor A k )
        /\
        -. ( P81B4Minor A ( k + 1 ) )
      )
    )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d A B V i j r s $.

  p81b4-linear-definition $a |- (
    ( P81B4Linear V )
    <->
    A. A e. V
      A. B e. V
        A. r e. RR
          A. s e. RR
            (
              i e. P81B4Rows , j e. P81B4Cols |->
                (
                  ( r x. ( A ` <. i , j >. ) )
                  +
                  ( s x. ( B ` <. i , j >. ) )
                )
            )
            e. V
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d A V $.

  putnambench-putnam-1981-b4 $a |- -.
    A. V e. ~P P81B4Matrices
      (
        (
          ( P81B4Linear V )
          /\
          (
            E. A e. V ( P81B4Rank A 0 )
            /\
            (
              E. A e. V ( P81B4Rank A 1 )
              /\
              (
                E. A e. V ( P81B4Rank A 2 )
                /\
                (
                  E. A e. V ( P81B4Rank A 4 )
                  /\
                  E. A e. V ( P81B4Rank A 5 )
                )
              )
            )
          )
        )
        ->
        E. A e. V ( P81B4Rank A 3 )
      )
  $.
$}

title: putnam_1981_b4
content:
% Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1981_b4:
% whether every real linear subspace of 5-by-7 matrices containing matrices
% of ranks 0, 1, 2, 4, and 5 must also contain one of rank 3. This file
% contains no proof.

putnam_1981_b4: THEORY
BEGIN
  row_index: TYPE = below(5)
  column_index: TYPE = below(7)

  matrix: TYPE = [row_index, column_index -> real]
  matrix_set: TYPE = [matrix -> bool]
  square_matrix: TYPE = [nat, nat -> real]
  row_selector: TYPE = [nat -> row_index]
  column_selector: TYPE = [nat -> column_index]

  quotient_aux(
      numerator, denominator, fuel: nat): RECURSIVE nat =
    IF fuel = 0
        OR denominator = 0
        OR numerator < denominator THEN
      0
    ELSE
      1
        + quotient_aux(
            numerator - denominator,
            denominator,
            fuel - 1)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE fuel

  remainder_aux(
      numerator, denominator, fuel: nat): RECURSIVE nat =
    IF fuel = 0
        OR denominator = 0
        OR numerator < denominator THEN
      numerator
    ELSE
      remainder_aux(
        numerator - denominator,
        denominator,
        fuel - 1)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE fuel

  safe_ndiv(numerator, denominator: nat): nat =
    quotient_aux(
      numerator,
      denominator,
      numerator + 1)

  safe_mod(numerator, denominator: nat): nat =
    IF denominator = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      remainder_aux(
        numerator,
        denominator,
        numerator + 1)
    ENDIF

  function_code_count(n: nat): nat =
    IF n = 0 THEN 1 ELSE n ^ n ENDIF

  permutation_entry(code, row, n: nat): nat =
    IF n = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      safe_mod(safe_ndiv(code, n ^ row), n)
    ENDIF

  permutation_code(code, n: nat): bool =
    code < function_code_count(n)
      AND (FORALL (row_1, row_2: nat):
        (row_1 < n
          AND row_2 < n
          AND permutation_entry(code, row_1, n)
            = permutation_entry(code, row_2, n))
        IMPLIES row_1 = row_2)

  pair_row(pair, n: nat): nat =
    safe_ndiv(pair, n)

  pair_column(pair, n: nat): nat =
    safe_mod(pair, n)

  inversion_at(code, pair, n: nat): bool =
    pair_row(pair, n) < n
      AND pair_column(pair, n) < n
      AND pair_row(pair, n) < pair_column(pair, n)
      AND permutation_entry(code, pair_row(pair, n), n)
        > permutation_entry(code, pair_column(pair, n), n)

  count_true(
      property: [nat -> bool],
      count: nat): RECURSIVE nat =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      count_true(property, count - 1)
        + IF property(count - 1) THEN 1 ELSE 0 ENDIF
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  inversion_count(code, n: nat): nat =
    count_true(
      (LAMBDA (pair: nat): inversion_at(code, pair, n)),
      n * n)

  permutation_sign(code, n: nat): real =
    IF mod(inversion_count(code, n), 2) = 0 THEN
      1
    ELSE
      -1
    ENDIF

  permutation_product(
      A: square_matrix,
      code, n, count: nat): RECURSIVE real =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      1
    ELSE
      permutation_product(A, code, n, count - 1)
        * A(
            count - 1,
            permutation_entry(code, count - 1, n))
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  determinant_sum(
      A: square_matrix,
      n, limit: nat): RECURSIVE real =
    IF limit = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      LET code: nat = limit - 1 IN
        determinant_sum(A, n, limit - 1)
          + IF permutation_code(code, n) THEN
              permutation_sign(code, n)
                * permutation_product(A, code, n, n)
            ELSE
              0
            ENDIF
    ENDIF
  MEASURE limit

  determinant(A: square_matrix, n: nat): real =
    determinant_sum(A, n, function_code_count(n))

  injective_rows_below(rows: row_selector, count: nat): bool =
    FORALL (i, j: nat):
      (i < count AND j < count AND rows(i) = rows(j))
        IMPLIES i = j

  injective_columns_below(
      columns: column_selector,
      count: nat): bool =
    FORALL (i, j: nat):
      (i < count AND j < count AND columns(i) = columns(j))
        IMPLIES i = j

  minor_matrix(
      A: matrix,
      rows: row_selector,
      columns: column_selector): square_matrix =
    LAMBDA (i, j: nat): A(rows(i), columns(j))

  has_nonzero_minor(A: matrix, size: nat): bool =
    size <= 5
      AND EXISTS
          (rows: row_selector),
          (columns: column_selector):
        injective_rows_below(rows, size)
          AND injective_columns_below(columns, size)
          AND determinant(
            minor_matrix(A, rows, columns), size) /= 0

  matrix_has_rank(A: matrix, rank_value: nat): bool =
    rank_value <= 5
      AND has_nonzero_minor(A, rank_value)
      AND FORALL (larger_size: nat):
        (rank_value < larger_size AND larger_size <= 5)
          IMPLIES NOT has_nonzero_minor(A, larger_size)

  linear_combination(
      r, s: real,
      A, B: matrix): matrix =
    LAMBDA (row: row_index), (column: column_index):
      r * A(row, column) + s * B(row, column)

  closed_under_linear_combinations(V: matrix_set): bool =
    FORALL
        (A, B: matrix),
        (r, s: real):
      (V(A) AND V(B))
        IMPLIES V(linear_combination(r, s, A, B))

  contains_rank(V: matrix_set, rank_value: nat): bool =
    EXISTS (A: matrix):
      V(A) AND matrix_has_rank(A, rank_value)

  putnam_1981_b4_solution: bool = FALSE

  putnam_1981_b4: bool =
    (FORALL (V: matrix_set):
      (closed_under_linear_combinations(V)
        AND contains_rank(V, 0)
        AND contains_rank(V, 1)
        AND contains_rank(V, 2)
        AND contains_rank(V, 4)
        AND contains_rank(V, 5))
      IMPLIES contains_rank(V, 3))
      IFF putnam_1981_b4_solution
END putnam_1981_b4

import Mathlib

open Topology Filter Set Polynomial Function

abbrev putnam_1981_b5_solution : Prop := True
/--
Let $B(n)$ be the number of ones in the base two expression for the positive integer $n$. For example, $B(6)=B(110_2)=2$ and $B(15)=B(1111_2)=4$. Determine whether or not $\exp \left(\sum_{n=1}^\infty \frac{B(n)}{n(n+1)}\right)$ is a rational number. Here $\exp(x)$ denotes $e^x$.
-/
theorem putnam_1981_b5
(sumbits : List ℕ → ℤ)
(B : ℕ → ℤ)
(hsumbits : ∀ bits : List ℕ, sumbits bits = ∑ i : Fin bits.length, (bits[i] : ℤ))
(hB : ∀ n > 0, B n = sumbits (Nat.digits 2 n))
: (∃ q : ℚ, Real.exp (∑' n : Set.Ici 1, B n / ((n : ℝ) * ((n : ℝ) + 1))) = q) ↔ putnam_1981_b5_solution :=
sorry

Local Coercion Raxioms.INR : nat >-> Rdefinitions.R.

Definition putnam_1981_b5_solution := True.
Theorem putnam_1981_b5
    (f := fix count_ones (n : positive) : nat :=
        match n with
        | xH => 1
        | xO n' => count_ones n'
        | xI n' => 1 + count_ones n'
    end)
    (k := Series (fun n => Rdefinitions.Rdiv (f (Pos.of_nat n)) (n + pow n 2)))
    : exists (a b: nat), Rtrigo_def.exp k = Rdefinitions.Rdiv a b <-> putnam_1981_b5_solution.
Proof. Admitted.

;; Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1981_b5:
;; whether the exponential of the infinite real series formed from binary
;; digit counts is rational. This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

;; For natural N, all nonzero binary digits have indices below N. This helper
;; sums those digits while recursing on the explicit digit count.
(defun putnam-1981-b5-binary-one-count-through (n digit-count)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix digit-count)))
  (if (zp digit-count)
      0
    (let ((index (- digit-count 1)))
      (+ (mod (floor n (expt 2 index)) 2)
         (putnam-1981-b5-binary-one-count-through
          n index)))))

;; The number B(N) of ones in the base-two expansion of N.
(defun putnam-1981-b5-binary-one-count (n)
  (putnam-1981-b5-binary-one-count-through n (nfix n)))

;; The exact rational partial sum
;;
;;   sum_(n=1)^terms B(n)/(n*(n+1)).
(defun putnam-1981-b5-series-prefix (terms)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix terms)))
  (if (zp terms)
      0
    (+ (putnam-1981-b5-series-prefix (- terms 1))
       (/ (putnam-1981-b5-binary-one-count terms)
          (* terms (+ terms 1))))))

(defun putnam-1981-b5-factorial (n)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix n)))
  (if (zp n)
      1
    (* n (putnam-1981-b5-factorial (- n 1)))))

;; The first TERMS terms of the defining power series for exp(X).
(defun putnam-1981-b5-exp-series-prefix (x terms)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix terms)))
  (if (zp terms)
      0
    (let ((index (- terms 1)))
      (+ (putnam-1981-b5-exp-series-prefix x index)
         (/ (expt x index)
            (putnam-1981-b5-factorial index))))))

;; The rational sequence obtained by applying increasingly long exponential
;; power-series prefixes to increasingly long source-series prefixes.
;; This diagonal sequence converges to
;;
;;   exp(sum_(n=1)^infinity B(n)/(n*(n+1))).
(defun putnam-1981-b5-exp-name-value (index)
  (putnam-1981-b5-exp-series-prefix
   (putnam-1981-b5-series-prefix (nfix index))
   (+ 1 (nfix index))))

(defun-sk putnam-1981-b5-exp-limit-tail-p
    (q epsilon cutoff)
  (forall (index)
    (implies
     (and (natp index)
          (<= cutoff index))
     (< (abs (- (putnam-1981-b5-exp-name-value index)
                q))
        epsilon))))

(defun-sk putnam-1981-b5-exp-limit-cutoff-exists-p
    (q epsilon)
  (exists (cutoff)
    (and (natp cutoff)
         (putnam-1981-b5-exp-limit-tail-p
          q epsilon cutoff))))

;; Equality of the represented real exponential with the rational Q.
(defun-sk putnam-1981-b5-exp-limit-p (q)
  (forall (epsilon)
    (implies
     (and (rationalp epsilon)
          (< 0 epsilon))
     (putnam-1981-b5-exp-limit-cutoff-exists-p
      q epsilon))))

;; The rational witness remains internal, as in the source existential.
(defun-sk putnam-1981-b5-exp-is-rational-p ()
  (exists (q)
    (and (rationalp q)
         (putnam-1981-b5-exp-limit-p q))))

(defun putnam-1981-b5-solution ()
  t)

;; The rational Cauchy name above denotes the same real exponential as the
;; source expression: rational partial sums name the source series, and the
;; exponential power series is continuous. Thus this is a definitional
;; Cauchy-name rendering of the source biconditional, not a rational-domain
;; restriction or a precomputed limit identity.
(defun putnambench-putnam-1981-b5-statement ()
  (iff (putnam-1981-b5-exp-is-rational-p)
       (putnam-1981-b5-solution)))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

title: putnam_1981_b5
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1981_b5:
-- the exponential of the infinite series whose nth term uses the number of
-- ones in the binary expansion of n is rational. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

open import Agda.Builtin.Bool using (Bool; false; true)
open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Int using (Int; pos; negsuc)
open import Agda.Builtin.List using (List; []; _∷_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using
  (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; _*_; div-helper; mod-helper)

infix 4 _!=_ _<=N_
infixr 3 _and_
infixr 2 _or_

data Bottom : Set where

record Top : Set where
  constructor top

Not : Set -> Set
Not A =
  A -> Bottom

_!=_ : {A : Set} -> A -> A -> Set
x != y =
  Not (x == y)

record _and_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data _or_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  left  : A -> A or B
  right : B -> A or B

record Iff (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor equivalence
  field
    forward  : A -> B
    backward : B -> A

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

data _<=N_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set where
  zero<=N   : {n : Nat} -> zero <=N n
  suc<=sucN : {m n : Nat} -> m <=N n -> suc m <=N suc n

record CompleteOrderedRealField (R : Set) : Set1 where
  field
    zeroR oneR : R
    add multiply : R -> R -> R
    negate inverse : R -> R
    lessOrEqual : R -> R -> Set
    fromNat : Nat -> R

    one-not-zero :
      oneR != zeroR

    add-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> add x y == add y x
    add-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      add (add x y) z == add x (add y z)
    add-zero :
      (x : R) -> add x zeroR == x
    add-inverse :
      (x : R) -> add x (negate x) == zeroR

    multiply-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> multiply x y == multiply y x
    multiply-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply (multiply x y) z ==
      multiply x (multiply y z)
    multiply-one :
      (x : R) -> multiply x oneR == x
    multiply-zero :
      (x : R) -> multiply x zeroR == zeroR
    distribute :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply x (add y z) ==
      add (multiply x y) (multiply x z)
    inverse-zero :
      inverse zeroR == zeroR
    multiply-inverse :
      (x : R) ->
      x != zeroR ->
      multiply x (inverse x) == oneR

    order-reflexive :
      (x : R) -> lessOrEqual x x
    order-transitive :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y z ->
      lessOrEqual x z
    order-antisymmetric :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y x ->
      x == y
    order-total :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y or lessOrEqual y x
    add-order :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual (add z x) (add z y)
    multiply-nonnegative :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR x ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR y ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR (multiply x y)
    zero-less-than-one :
      lessOrEqual zeroR oneR and zeroR != oneR

    fromNat-zero :
      fromNat zero == zeroR
    fromNat-successor :
      (n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (suc n) == add (fromNat n) oneR
    fromNat-addition :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m + n) == add (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-multiplication :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m * n) == multiply (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-injective :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat m == fromNat n ->
      m == n

    archimedean :
      (x : R) ->
      Exists Nat (\ n -> lessOrEqual x (fromNat n))
    least-upper-bound :
      (P : R -> Set) ->
      Exists R P ->
      Exists R
        (\ upper ->
          (x : R) ->
          P x ->
          lessOrEqual x upper) ->
      Exists R
        (\ supremum ->
          ((x : R) ->
            P x ->
            lessOrEqual x supremum)
          and
          ((upper : R) ->
            ((x : R) ->
              P x ->
              lessOrEqual x upper) ->
            lessOrEqual supremum upper))

open CompleteOrderedRealField

fromInt :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Int ->
  R
fromInt reals (pos n) =
  fromNat reals n
fromInt reals (negsuc n) =
  negate reals (fromNat reals (suc n))

subtract :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
subtract reals x y =
  add reals x (negate reals y)

divide :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
divide reals x y =
  multiply reals x (inverse reals y)

StrictLess :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
StrictLess reals x y =
  lessOrEqual reals x y and x != y

CloseTo :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
CloseTo reals center radius x =
  StrictLess reals
    (subtract reals center radius)
    x
  and
  StrictLess reals
    x
    (add reals center radius)

naturalPower :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  Nat ->
  R
naturalPower reals x zero =
  oneR reals
naturalPower reals x (suc n) =
  multiply reals
    (naturalPower reals x n)
    x

oneN : Nat
oneN =
  suc zero

twoN : Nat
twoN =
  suc oneN

factorial : Nat -> Nat
factorial zero =
  oneN
factorial (suc n) =
  suc n * factorial n

sumFirst :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Nat ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  R
sumFirst reals zero term =
  zeroR reals
sumFirst reals (suc n) term =
  add reals
    (sumFirst reals n term)
    (term n)

ConvergesTo :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  R ->
  Set
ConvergesTo {R} reals sequence limit =
  (epsilon : R) ->
  StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) epsilon ->
  Exists Nat
    (\ cutoff ->
      (n : Nat) ->
      cutoff <=N n ->
      CloseTo reals limit epsilon (sequence n))

SeriesHasSum :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  R ->
  Set
SeriesHasSum reals terms limit =
  ConvergesTo reals
    (\ n -> sumFirst reals n terms)
    limit

exponentialTerm :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  Nat ->
  R
exponentialTerm reals x n =
  divide reals
    (naturalPower reals x n)
    (fromNat reals (factorial n))

record StandardExponential
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) :
  Set1 where

  field
    exponential : R -> R
    exponential-series :
      (x : R) ->
      SeriesHasSum reals
        (exponentialTerm reals x)
        (exponential x)

open StandardExponential

natLess : Nat -> Nat -> Bool
natLess zero zero =
  false
natLess zero (suc n) =
  true
natLess (suc m) zero =
  false
natLess (suc m) (suc n) =
  natLess m n

naturalDiv : Nat -> Nat -> Nat
naturalDiv numerator zero =
  zero
naturalDiv numerator (suc denominator) =
  div-helper zero denominator numerator denominator

naturalMod : Nat -> Nat -> Nat
naturalMod numerator zero =
  zero
naturalMod numerator (suc denominator) =
  mod-helper zero denominator numerator denominator

binaryDigitsWithFuel : Nat -> Nat -> List Nat
binaryDigitsWithFuel zero n =
  n ∷ []
binaryDigitsWithFuel (suc fuel) n with natLess n twoN
... | true =
  n ∷ []
... | false =
  naturalMod n twoN ∷
  binaryDigitsWithFuel fuel (naturalDiv n twoN)

binaryDigits : Nat -> List Nat
binaryDigits n =
  binaryDigitsWithFuel n n

sumDigits : List Nat -> Nat
sumDigits [] =
  zero
sumDigits (digit ∷ digits) =
  digit + sumDigits digits

binaryOneCount : Nat -> Nat
binaryOneCount n =
  sumDigits (binaryDigits n)

record Rational : Set where
  constructor fraction
  field
    numerator             : Int
    denominator-minus-one : Nat

open Rational

denominator : Rational -> Nat
denominator q =
  suc (denominator-minus-one q)

rationalValue :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Rational ->
  R
rationalValue reals q =
  divide reals
    (fromInt reals (numerator q))
    (fromNat reals (denominator q))

IsRational :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  Set
IsRational reals x =
  Exists Rational
    (\ q -> x == rationalValue reals q)

module Putnam1981B5Statement
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R)
  (standardExponential : StandardExponential reals) where

  seriesTerm : Nat -> R
  seriesTerm n =
    divide reals
      (fromNat reals (binaryOneCount (suc n)))
      (fromNat reals ((suc n) * suc (suc n)))

  RationalExponentialOfSeries : Set
  RationalExponentialOfSeries =
    Exists R
      (\ seriesValue ->
        SeriesHasSum reals seriesTerm seriesValue
        and
        IsRational reals
          (exponential standardExponential seriesValue))

  solution : Set
  solution =
    Top

title: putnam_1981_b5
content:
% Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1981_b5:
% the exponential of the infinite series formed from binary one-counts is
% rational, matching the cataloged answer True. This file contains no proof.

putnam_1981_b5: THEORY
BEGIN
  real_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> real]

  safe_div(numerator, denominator: real): real =
    IF denominator = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      numerator / denominator
    ENDIF

  bit_count_below(n, count: nat): RECURSIVE nat =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      LET index: nat = count - 1 IN
        bit_count_below(n, count - 1)
          + IF mod(ndiv(n, 2 ^ index), 2) = 1 THEN
              1
            ELSE
              0
            ENDIF
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  binary_ones(n: nat): nat =
    bit_count_below(n, n + 1)

  partial_sum(values: real_sequence, count: nat): RECURSIVE real =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      partial_sum(values, count - 1) + values(count - 1)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  series_sums_to(values: real_sequence, total: real): bool =
    FORALL (epsilon_value: posreal):
      EXISTS (cutoff: nat):
        FORALL (count: nat):
          cutoff <= count IMPLIES
            abs(partial_sum(values, count) - total) < epsilon_value

  binary_series_terms: real_sequence =
    LAMBDA (index: nat):
      safe_div(
        binary_ones(index + 1) :: real,
        ((index + 1) :: real) * ((index + 2) :: real))

  nat_factorial(index: nat): RECURSIVE nat =
    IF index = 0 THEN
      1
    ELSE
      index * nat_factorial(index - 1)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE index

  exponential_terms(x: real): real_sequence =
    LAMBDA (index: nat):
      safe_div(
        x ^ index,
        nat_factorial(index) :: real)

  exponential_value(x, value: real): bool =
    series_sums_to(exponential_terms(x), value)

  putnam_1981_b5_solution: bool = TRUE

  putnam_1981_b5: bool =
    (EXISTS
        (series_total, exponential_total: real),
        (q: rat):
      series_sums_to(binary_series_terms, series_total)
        AND exponential_value(series_total, exponential_total)
        AND exponential_total = (q :: real))
      IFF putnam_1981_b5_solution
END putnam_1981_b5

theorem putnam_1982_a2
(B : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ)
(hB : B = fun (n : ℕ) (x : ℝ) ↦ ∑ k ∈ Finset.Icc 1 n, (k : ℝ) ^ x)

(hf : f = fun n ↦ B n (logb n 2) / (n * logb 2 n) ^ 2)
: (∃ L : ℝ, Tendsto (fun N ↦ ∑ j ∈ Finset.Icc 2 N, f j) atTop (𝓝 L)) ↔ putnam_1982_a2_solution :=
sorry

content:
;; Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1982_a2:
;; convergence of the real series whose nth term uses
;; B_n(x) = sum_(k=1)^n k^x at x = log_n(2), divided by
;; (n*log_2(n))^2. This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))

;; For positive rational x, this is the finite atanh-series prefix
;;
;;   2 * sum_(j < terms) z^(2j+1)/(2j+1),  z = (x-1)/(x+1),
;;
;; which converges to the real logarithm of x.
(defun putnam-1982-a2-log-atanh-prefix (z terms)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix terms)))
  (if (zp terms)
      0
    (let* ((index (- terms 1))
           (exponent (+ (* 2 index) 1)))
      (+ (putnam-1982-a2-log-atanh-prefix z index)
         (/ (* 2 (expt z exponent))
            exponent)))))

(defun putnam-1982-a2-log-prefix (x terms)
  (if (and (rationalp x)
           (< 0 x)
           (natp terms))
      (putnam-1982-a2-log-atanh-prefix
       (/ (- x 1) (+ x 1))
       terms)
    0))

(defun putnam-1982-a2-factorial (n)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix n)))
  (if (zp n)
      1
    (* n
       (putnam-1982-a2-factorial (- n 1)))))

;; This exact rational Taylor prefix converges to exp(x).
(defun putnam-1982-a2-exp-prefix (x terms)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix terms)))
  (if (zp terms)
      0
    (let ((index (- terms 1)))
      (+ (putnam-1982-a2-exp-prefix x index)
         (/ (expt x index)
            (putnam-1982-a2-factorial index))))))

;; The limit as PRECISION tends to infinity is
;;
;;   base^(log_n 2) = exp(log(base) * log(2) / log(n)).
(defun putnam-1982-a2-power-approx
    (base n precision)
  (if (and (natp base)
           (< 0 base)
           (natp n)
           (<= 2 n)
           (posp precision))
      (let* ((log-base
              (putnam-1982-a2-log-prefix base precision))
             (log-two
              (putnam-1982-a2-log-prefix 2 precision))
             (log-n
              (putnam-1982-a2-log-prefix n precision))
             (exponent (* log-base (/ log-two log-n))))
        (putnam-1982-a2-exp-prefix exponent precision))
    0))

(defun putnam-1982-a2-b-approx-aux
    (n remaining precision)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix remaining)))
  (if (zp remaining)
      0
    (+ (putnam-1982-a2-b-approx-aux
        n (- remaining 1) precision)
       (putnam-1982-a2-power-approx
        remaining n precision))))

;; This converges to B_n(log_n 2) with exactly the source range 1 <= k <= n.
(defun putnam-1982-a2-b-approx (n precision)
  (if (and (posp n)
           (posp precision))
      (putnam-1982-a2-b-approx-aux n n precision)
    0))

;; This converges to
;;
;;   B_n(log_n 2) / (n * log_2(n))^2.
(defun putnam-1982-a2-term-approx (n precision)
  (if (and (natp n)
           (<= 2 n)
           (posp precision))
      (let* ((log-two
              (putnam-1982-a2-log-prefix 2 precision))
             (log-n
              (putnam-1982-a2-log-prefix n precision))
             (log-base-two-n (/ log-n log-two))
             (denominator
              (expt (* n log-base-two-n) 2)))
        (/ (putnam-1982-a2-b-approx n precision)
           denominator))
    0))

(defun putnam-1982-a2-series-prefix-approx
    (upper precision)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix upper)))
  (if (or (not (natp upper))
          (< upper 2))
      0
    (+ (putnam-1982-a2-series-prefix-approx
        (- upper 1) precision)
       (putnam-1982-a2-term-approx upper precision))))

;; For every fixed UPPER, increasing PRECISION makes the preceding exact
;; rational expression converge to the source real partial sum through UPPER.
;; This follows definitionally from the atanh series for log, the Taylor
;; series for exp, and the finite k- and n-sums above.  In particular, no
;; single diagonal choice of precision is substituted for the real sequence.
;;
;; The next predicate states that the exact real distance between two such
;; Cauchy names is strictly below EPSILON.  The positive rational MARGIN makes
;; strictness exact: the approximating distances are eventually below
;; EPSILON-MARGIN.  Both MARGIN and the unbounded precision cutoff remain
;; internal existential witnesses.
(defun-sk putnam-1982-a2-approximation-tail-p
    (left-index right-index epsilon margin precision-cutoff)
  (forall (precision)
    (implies
     (and (natp precision)
          (<= precision-cutoff precision))
     (< (abs
         (- (putnam-1982-a2-series-prefix-approx
             left-index precision)
            (putnam-1982-a2-series-prefix-approx
             right-index precision)))
        (- epsilon margin)))))

(defun-sk putnam-1982-a2-exact-distance-within-p
    (left-index right-index epsilon)
  (exists (margin precision-cutoff)
    (and (rationalp margin)
         (< 0 margin)
         (< margin epsilon)
         (posp precision-cutoff)
         (putnam-1982-a2-approximation-tail-p
          left-index
          right-index
          epsilon
          margin
          precision-cutoff))))

;; This is the Cauchy criterion for the exact real partial sums represented by
;; the full precision-indexed names, not for a selected rational diagonal.
;; Completeness of the reals and cofinality of positive rational tolerances
;; make it bidirectionally equivalent to existence of the source's real limit.
(defun-sk putnam-1982-a2-cauchy-tail-p
    (epsilon cutoff)
  (forall (left-index right-index)
    (implies
     (and (natp left-index)
          (<= cutoff left-index)
          (natp right-index)
          (<= cutoff right-index))
     (putnam-1982-a2-exact-distance-within-p
      left-index right-index epsilon))))

(defun-sk putnam-1982-a2-cauchy-cutoff-exists-p
    (epsilon)
  (exists (cutoff)
    (and (natp cutoff)
         (putnam-1982-a2-cauchy-tail-p
          epsilon cutoff))))

(defun-sk putnambench-putnam-1982-a2-statement ()
  (forall (epsilon)
    (implies
     (and (rationalp epsilon)
          (< 0 epsilon))
     (putnam-1982-a2-cauchy-cutoff-exists-p
      epsilon))))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

title: putnam_1982_a2
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1982_a2:
-- the series formed from finite real-power sums B_n(log_n 2), normalized by
-- (n log_2 n)^2, converges. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; _*_)

infix 4 _!=_ _<=N_
infixr 3 _and_
infixr 2 _or_

data Bottom : Set where

record Top : Set where
  constructor top

Not : Set -> Set
Not A =
  A -> Bottom

_!=_ : {A : Set} -> A -> A -> Set
x != y =
  Not (x == y)

record _and_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data _or_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  left  : A -> A or B
  right : B -> A or B

record Iff (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor equivalence
  field
    forward  : A -> B
    backward : B -> A

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

data _<=N_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set where
  zero<=N   : {n : Nat} -> zero <=N n
  suc<=sucN : {m n : Nat} -> m <=N n -> suc m <=N suc n

record CompleteOrderedRealField (R : Set) : Set1 where
  field
    zeroR oneR : R
    add multiply : R -> R -> R
    negate inverse : R -> R
    lessOrEqual : R -> R -> Set
    fromNat : Nat -> R

    one-not-zero :
      oneR != zeroR

    add-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> add x y == add y x
    add-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      add (add x y) z == add x (add y z)
    add-zero :
      (x : R) -> add x zeroR == x
    add-inverse :
      (x : R) -> add x (negate x) == zeroR

    multiply-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> multiply x y == multiply y x
    multiply-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply (multiply x y) z ==
      multiply x (multiply y z)
    multiply-one :
      (x : R) -> multiply x oneR == x
    multiply-zero :
      (x : R) -> multiply x zeroR == zeroR
    distribute :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply x (add y z) ==
      add (multiply x y) (multiply x z)
    inverse-zero :
      inverse zeroR == zeroR
    multiply-inverse :
      (x : R) ->
      x != zeroR ->
      multiply x (inverse x) == oneR

    order-reflexive :
      (x : R) -> lessOrEqual x x
    order-transitive :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y z ->
      lessOrEqual x z
    order-antisymmetric :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y x ->
      x == y
    order-total :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y or lessOrEqual y x
    add-order :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual (add z x) (add z y)
    multiply-nonnegative :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR x ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR y ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR (multiply x y)
    zero-less-than-one :
      lessOrEqual zeroR oneR and zeroR != oneR

    fromNat-zero :
      fromNat zero == zeroR
    fromNat-successor :
      (n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (suc n) == add (fromNat n) oneR
    fromNat-addition :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m + n) == add (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-multiplication :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m * n) == multiply (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-injective :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat m == fromNat n ->
      m == n

    archimedean :
      (x : R) ->
      Exists Nat (\ n -> lessOrEqual x (fromNat n))
    least-upper-bound :
      (P : R -> Set) ->
      Exists R P ->
      Exists R
        (\ upper ->
          (x : R) ->
          P x ->
          lessOrEqual x upper) ->
      Exists R
        (\ supremum ->
          ((x : R) ->
            P x ->
            lessOrEqual x supremum)
          and
          ((upper : R) ->
            ((x : R) ->
              P x ->
              lessOrEqual x upper) ->
            lessOrEqual supremum upper))

open CompleteOrderedRealField

oneN : Nat
oneN =
  suc zero

twoN : Nat
twoN =
  suc oneN

subtract :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
subtract reals x y =
  add reals x (negate reals y)

divide :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
divide reals x y =
  multiply reals x (inverse reals y)

StrictLess :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
StrictLess reals x y =
  lessOrEqual reals x y and x != y

CloseTo :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
CloseTo reals center radius x =
  StrictLess reals
    (subtract reals center radius)
    x
  and
  StrictLess reals
    x
    (add reals center radius)

naturalPower :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  Nat ->
  R
naturalPower reals x zero =
  oneR reals
naturalPower reals x (suc n) =
  multiply reals
    (naturalPower reals x n)
    x

factorial : Nat -> Nat
factorial zero =
  oneN
factorial (suc n) =
  suc n * factorial n

sumFirst :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Nat ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  R
sumFirst reals zero term =
  zeroR reals
sumFirst reals (suc n) term =
  add reals
    (sumFirst reals n term)
    (term n)

sumThrough :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Nat ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  R
sumThrough reals zero term =
  zeroR reals
sumThrough reals (suc n) term =
  add reals
    (sumThrough reals n term)
    (term (suc n))

ConvergesTo :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  R ->
  Set
ConvergesTo {R} reals sequence limit =
  (epsilon : R) ->
  StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) epsilon ->
  Exists Nat
    (\ cutoff ->
      (n : Nat) ->
      cutoff <=N n ->
      CloseTo reals limit epsilon (sequence n))

SeriesHasSum :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  R ->
  Set
SeriesHasSum reals terms limit =
  ConvergesTo reals
    (\ n -> sumFirst reals n terms)
    limit

exponentialTerm :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  Nat ->
  R
exponentialTerm reals x n =
  divide reals
    (naturalPower reals x n)
    (fromNat reals (factorial n))

ExponentialValue :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
ExponentialValue reals x value =
  SeriesHasSum reals
    (exponentialTerm reals x)
    value

record StandardRealPowers
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) :
  Set1 where

  field
    exponential logarithm : R -> R

    exponential-series :
      (x : R) ->
      ExponentialValue reals x (exponential x)

    exponential-positive :
      (x : R) ->
      StrictLess reals
        (zeroR reals)
        (exponential x)

    exponential-injective :
      (x y : R) ->
      exponential x == exponential y ->
      x == y

    exponential-logarithm :
      (x : R) ->
      StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) x ->
      exponential (logarithm x) == x

open StandardRealPowers

realPower :
  {R : Set} ->
  {reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R} ->
  StandardRealPowers reals ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
realPower {reals = reals} powers base exponent =
  exponential powers
    (multiply reals exponent (logarithm powers base))

logBase :
  {R : Set} ->
  {reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R} ->
  StandardRealPowers reals ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
logBase {reals = reals} powers base argument =
  divide reals
    (logarithm powers argument)
    (logarithm powers base)

module Putnam1982A2Statement
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R)
  (powers : StandardRealPowers reals) where

  B :
    Nat ->
    R ->
    R
  B n x =
    sumThrough reals n
      (\ k ->
        realPower powers
          (fromNat reals k)
          x)

  f :
    Nat ->
    R
  f n =
    divide reals
      (B n
        (logBase powers
          (fromNat reals n)
          (fromNat reals twoN)))
      (naturalPower reals
        (multiply reals
          (fromNat reals n)
          (logBase powers
            (fromNat reals twoN)
            (fromNat reals n)))
        twoN)

  partialTailSum :
    Nat ->
    R
  partialTailSum zero =
    zeroR reals
  partialTailSum (suc zero) =
    zeroR reals
  partialTailSum (suc (suc n)) =
    add reals
      (partialTailSum (suc n))
      (f (suc (suc n)))

  SeriesConverges : Set
  SeriesConverges =
    Exists R
      (\ limit ->
        ConvergesTo reals partialTailSum limit)

  solution : Set
  solution =
    Top

  proposition : Set
  proposition =
    Iff SeriesConverges solution

putnam-1982-a2 : Set1
putnam-1982-a2 =
  (R : Set) ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) ->
  (powers : StandardRealPowers reals) ->
  Putnam1982A2Statement.proposition reals powers

(*
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench artifact putnam_1982_a2:
  convergence of the series defined from finite real-power sums evaluated at
  logarithms of 2 with varying bases. This file contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open arithmeticTheory pred_setTheory realTheory real_sigmaTheory;
open real_topologyTheory transcTheory;

val putnam_1982_a2 =
  ``let b =
      \n : num. \x : real.
        SIGMA
          (\k : num. (&k : real) powr x)
          (IMAGE SUC (count n))
    in
      let f =
        \n : num.
          b n (ln 2 / ln (&n : real)) /
          (((&n : real) * (ln (&n : real) / ln 2)) pow 2)
      in
        ((?L : real.
            ((\N : num.
                SIGMA
                  (\j : num. f j)
                  (IMAGE (\i : num. i + 2) (count (N - 1)))) --> L)
              sequentially)
         <=> T)``;

$(

  finite sum is B_n(log_n 2) over k = 1 through n. SetMM's ^c is real

  and ~~> is the standard real-sequence convergence relation.

  The denominator is (n log_2 n)^2, as in the published problem, Lean, and

  this database contains no $p proof statement.

  putnambench-putnam-1982-a2 $a |-
    E. L e. RR
      (
        N e. NN0 |->
          sum_ n e. ( 2 ... N )
            (
              (
                sum_ k e. ( 1 ... n )
                  ( k ^c ( n logb 2 ) )
              )
              /
              (
                (
                  n
                  x.
                  ( 2 logb n )
                )
                ^
                2
              )
            )
      )

$}
