title: putnam_1982_a2
content:
% Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1982_a2:
% convergence of the series whose nth term is B_n(log_n 2) divided by
% (n log_2 n)^2, where B_n(x) is the sum of k^x from 1 through n.
% This file contains no proof.

putnam_1982_a2: THEORY
BEGIN
  real_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> real]

  putnam_1982_a2_solution: bool = TRUE

  safe_div(numerator, denominator: real): real =
    IF denominator = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      numerator / denominator
    ENDIF

  nat_factorial(index: nat): RECURSIVE nat =
    IF index = 0 THEN
      1
    ELSE
      index * nat_factorial(index - 1)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE index

  exponential_partial(x: real, count: nat): RECURSIVE real =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      LET index: nat = count - 1 IN
        exponential_partial(x, count - 1)
          + safe_div(
              x ^ index,
              nat_factorial(index) :: real)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  converges_to(sequence: real_sequence, value: real): bool =
    FORALL (epsilon_value: posreal):
      EXISTS (cutoff: nat):
        FORALL (index: nat):
          cutoff <= index IMPLIES
            abs(sequence(index) - value) < epsilon_value

  real_exponential(x: real): real =
    epsilon(
      LAMBDA (value: real):
        converges_to(
          LAMBDA (count: nat):
            exponential_partial(x, count),
          value))

  natural_log(x: real): real =
    IF x > 0 THEN
      epsilon(
        LAMBDA (value: real):
          real_exponential(value) = x)
    ELSE
      0
    ENDIF

  real_power(base, exponent: real): real =
    IF base > 0 THEN
      real_exponential(exponent * natural_log(base))
    ELSIF base = 0 AND exponent = 0 THEN
      1
    ELSE
      0
    ENDIF

  logarithm(base, argument: real): real =
    safe_div(natural_log(argument), natural_log(base))

  B(n: nat, x: real): RECURSIVE real =
    IF n = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      B(n - 1, x) + real_power(n :: real, x)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE n

  f(n: nat): real =
    safe_div(
      B(n, logarithm(n :: real, 2)),
      ((n :: real) * logarithm(2, n :: real)) ^ 2)

  series_partial_sum(n: nat): RECURSIVE real =
    IF n < 2 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      series_partial_sum(n - 1) + f(n)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE n

  putnam_1982_a2: bool =
    (EXISTS (limit: real):
      converges_to(series_partial_sum, limit))
      IFF putnam_1982_a2_solution
END putnam_1982_a2

content:
;; Statement-only formalization of the PutnamBench corpus artifact
;; putnam_1982_a3: the improper real integral of
;; (arctan(pi*x) - arctan(x))/x equals (pi/2)*log(pi). This file contains no
;; proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))

;; The conservative interfaces below present an arbitrary real carrier,
;; its ordered-field operations, arbitrary subsets, and the distinguished
;; analytic functions occurring in the statement.

(defstub putnam-1982-a3-real-p (real-type value) t)
(defstub putnam-1982-a3-zero (real-type) t)
(defstub putnam-1982-a3-one (real-type) t)
(defstub putnam-1982-a3-add (real-type left right) t)
(defstub putnam-1982-a3-mul (real-type left right) t)
(defstub putnam-1982-a3-neg (real-type value) t)
(defstub putnam-1982-a3-inv (real-type value) t)
(defstub putnam-1982-a3-lt (real-type left right) t)

(defstub putnam-1982-a3-set-member-p (real-type set value) t)

(defstub putnam-1982-a3-pi (real-type) t)
(defstub putnam-1982-a3-arctan (real-type value) t)
(defstub putnam-1982-a3-log (real-type value) t)
(defstub putnam-1982-a3-prefix-integral (real-type upper) t)

(defun putnam-1982-a3-sub (real-type x y)
  (putnam-1982-a3-add
   real-type x (putnam-1982-a3-neg real-type y)))

(defun putnam-1982-a3-le (real-type x y)
  (not (putnam-1982-a3-lt real-type y x)))

(defun putnam-1982-a3-div (real-type x y)
  (putnam-1982-a3-mul
   real-type x (putnam-1982-a3-inv real-type y)))

(defun putnam-1982-a3-abs (real-type x)
  (if (putnam-1982-a3-lt
       real-type x (putnam-1982-a3-zero real-type))
      (putnam-1982-a3-neg real-type x)
    x))

(defun putnam-1982-a3-two (real-type)
  (putnam-1982-a3-add
   real-type
   (putnam-1982-a3-one real-type)
   (putnam-1982-a3-one real-type)))

(defun putnam-1982-a3-four (real-type)
  (putnam-1982-a3-add
   real-type
   (putnam-1982-a3-two real-type)
   (putnam-1982-a3-two real-type)))

(defun putnam-1982-a3-nat-value (real-type n)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix n)))
  (if (zp n)
      (putnam-1982-a3-zero real-type)
    (putnam-1982-a3-add
     real-type
     (putnam-1982-a3-one real-type)
     (putnam-1982-a3-nat-value real-type (1- n)))))

;; A complete Archimedean ordered-field presentation of the real numbers.

(defun-sk putnam-1982-a3-operation-closure-p (real-type)
  (forall (x y)
    (and
     (putnam-1982-a3-real-p
      real-type (putnam-1982-a3-zero real-type))
     (putnam-1982-a3-real-p
      real-type (putnam-1982-a3-one real-type))
     (implies
      (putnam-1982-a3-real-p real-type x)
      (and
       (putnam-1982-a3-real-p
        real-type (putnam-1982-a3-neg real-type x))
       (putnam-1982-a3-real-p
        real-type (putnam-1982-a3-inv real-type x))))
     (implies
      (and
       (putnam-1982-a3-real-p real-type x)
       (putnam-1982-a3-real-p real-type y))
      (and
       (putnam-1982-a3-real-p
        real-type (putnam-1982-a3-add real-type x y))
       (putnam-1982-a3-real-p
        real-type (putnam-1982-a3-mul real-type x y)))))))

(defun-sk putnam-1982-a3-unary-field-laws-p (real-type)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (putnam-1982-a3-real-p real-type x)
     (let ((zero (putnam-1982-a3-zero real-type))
           (one (putnam-1982-a3-one real-type)))
       (and
        (equal (putnam-1982-a3-add real-type zero x) x)
        (equal (putnam-1982-a3-add real-type x zero) x)
        (equal
         (putnam-1982-a3-add
          real-type x (putnam-1982-a3-neg real-type x))
         zero)
        (equal (putnam-1982-a3-mul real-type one x) x)
        (equal (putnam-1982-a3-mul real-type x one) x)
        (implies
         (equal x zero)
         (equal (putnam-1982-a3-inv real-type x) zero))
        (implies
         (not (equal x zero))
         (equal
          (putnam-1982-a3-mul
           real-type x (putnam-1982-a3-inv real-type x))
          one)))))))

(defun-sk putnam-1982-a3-binary-field-laws-p (real-type)
  (forall (x y)
    (implies
     (and
      (putnam-1982-a3-real-p real-type x)
      (putnam-1982-a3-real-p real-type y))
     (and
      (equal
       (putnam-1982-a3-add real-type x y)
       (putnam-1982-a3-add real-type y x))
      (equal
       (putnam-1982-a3-mul real-type x y)
       (putnam-1982-a3-mul real-type y x))))))

(defun-sk putnam-1982-a3-ternary-field-laws-p (real-type)
  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (putnam-1982-a3-real-p real-type x)
      (putnam-1982-a3-real-p real-type y)
      (putnam-1982-a3-real-p real-type z))
     (and
      (equal
       (putnam-1982-a3-add
        real-type (putnam-1982-a3-add real-type x y) z)
       (putnam-1982-a3-add
        real-type x (putnam-1982-a3-add real-type y z)))
      (equal
       (putnam-1982-a3-mul
        real-type (putnam-1982-a3-mul real-type x y) z)
       (putnam-1982-a3-mul
        real-type x (putnam-1982-a3-mul real-type y z)))
      (equal
       (putnam-1982-a3-mul
        real-type x (putnam-1982-a3-add real-type y z))
       (putnam-1982-a3-add
        real-type
        (putnam-1982-a3-mul real-type x y)
        (putnam-1982-a3-mul real-type x z)))))))

(defun-sk putnam-1982-a3-order-laws-p (real-type)
  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (putnam-1982-a3-real-p real-type x)
      (putnam-1982-a3-real-p real-type y)
      (putnam-1982-a3-real-p real-type z))
     (and
      (not (putnam-1982-a3-lt real-type x x))
      (implies
       (and
        (putnam-1982-a3-lt real-type x y)
        (putnam-1982-a3-lt real-type y z))
       (putnam-1982-a3-lt real-type x z))
      (or
       (putnam-1982-a3-lt real-type x y)
       (equal x y)
       (putnam-1982-a3-lt real-type y x))
      (implies
       (putnam-1982-a3-lt real-type x y)
       (putnam-1982-a3-lt
        real-type
        (putnam-1982-a3-add real-type x z)
        (putnam-1982-a3-add real-type y z)))
      (implies
       (and
        (putnam-1982-a3-lt
         real-type (putnam-1982-a3-zero real-type) x)
        (putnam-1982-a3-lt
         real-type (putnam-1982-a3-zero real-type) y))
       (putnam-1982-a3-lt
        real-type
        (putnam-1982-a3-zero real-type)
        (putnam-1982-a3-mul real-type x y)))))))

(defun-sk putnam-1982-a3-valid-real-set-p (real-type set)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (putnam-1982-a3-set-member-p real-type set x)
     (putnam-1982-a3-real-p real-type x))))

(defun-sk putnam-1982-a3-set-nonempty-p (real-type set)
  (exists (x)
    (and
     (putnam-1982-a3-real-p real-type x)
     (putnam-1982-a3-set-member-p real-type set x))))

(defun-sk putnam-1982-a3-upper-bound-p (real-type set bound)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (putnam-1982-a3-set-member-p real-type set x)
     (putnam-1982-a3-le real-type x bound))))

(defun-sk putnam-1982-a3-bounded-above-p (real-type set)
  (exists (bound)
    (and
     (putnam-1982-a3-real-p real-type bound)
     (putnam-1982-a3-upper-bound-p real-type set bound))))

(defun-sk putnam-1982-a3-least-upper-bound-p
    (real-type set supremum)
  (forall (bound)
    (and
     (putnam-1982-a3-real-p real-type supremum)
     (putnam-1982-a3-upper-bound-p real-type set supremum)
     (implies
      (and
       (putnam-1982-a3-real-p real-type bound)
       (putnam-1982-a3-upper-bound-p real-type set bound))
      (putnam-1982-a3-le real-type supremum bound)))))

(defun-sk putnam-1982-a3-supremum-exists-p (real-type set)
  (exists (supremum)
    (putnam-1982-a3-least-upper-bound-p
     real-type set supremum)))

(defun-sk putnam-1982-a3-dedekind-complete-p (real-type)
  (forall (set)
    (implies
     (and
      (putnam-1982-a3-valid-real-set-p real-type set)
      (putnam-1982-a3-set-nonempty-p real-type set)
      (putnam-1982-a3-bounded-above-p real-type set))
     (putnam-1982-a3-supremum-exists-p real-type set))))

(defun-sk putnam-1982-a3-archimedean-witness-p
    (real-type x)
  (exists (n)
    (and
     (natp n)
     (putnam-1982-a3-lt
      real-type x (putnam-1982-a3-nat-value real-type n)))))

(defun-sk putnam-1982-a3-archimedean-p (real-type)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (putnam-1982-a3-real-p real-type x)
     (putnam-1982-a3-archimedean-witness-p real-type x))))

(defun putnam-1982-a3-real-structure-p (real-type)
  (and
   (putnam-1982-a3-operation-closure-p real-type)
   (putnam-1982-a3-unary-field-laws-p real-type)
   (putnam-1982-a3-binary-field-laws-p real-type)
   (putnam-1982-a3-ternary-field-laws-p real-type)
   (putnam-1982-a3-order-laws-p real-type)
   (not
    (equal
     (putnam-1982-a3-zero real-type)
     (putnam-1982-a3-one real-type)))
   (putnam-1982-a3-lt
    real-type
    (putnam-1982-a3-zero real-type)
    (putnam-1982-a3-one real-type))
   (putnam-1982-a3-dedekind-complete-p real-type)
   (putnam-1982-a3-archimedean-p real-type)))

;; Exact compact-interval integrals are represented by convergence of uniform
;; midpoint Riemann sums. This gives every integral a concrete, nonvacuous
;; approximation sequence without quantifying over coded gauge functions.

(defun putnam-1982-a3-integrand-value
    (real-type kind x)
  (cond
   ((equal kind :arctan-kernel)
    (putnam-1982-a3-inv
     real-type
     (putnam-1982-a3-add
      real-type
      (putnam-1982-a3-one real-type)
      (putnam-1982-a3-mul
       real-type x x))))
   ((equal kind :log-kernel)
    (putnam-1982-a3-inv real-type x))
   ((equal kind :main-integrand)
    (putnam-1982-a3-div
     real-type
     (putnam-1982-a3-sub
      real-type
      (putnam-1982-a3-arctan
       real-type
       (putnam-1982-a3-mul
        real-type
        (putnam-1982-a3-pi real-type)
        x))
      (putnam-1982-a3-arctan real-type x))
     x))
   (t (putnam-1982-a3-zero real-type))))

(defun putnam-1982-a3-midpoint
    (real-type a b index subdivisions)
  (putnam-1982-a3-add
   real-type
   a
   (putnam-1982-a3-mul
    real-type
    (putnam-1982-a3-sub real-type b a)
    (putnam-1982-a3-div
     real-type
     (putnam-1982-a3-nat-value
      real-type (+ (* 2 index) 1))
     (putnam-1982-a3-nat-value
      real-type (* 2 subdivisions))))))

(defun putnam-1982-a3-midpoint-sum-aux
    (real-type kind a b remaining subdivisions)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix remaining)))
  (if (zp remaining)
      (putnam-1982-a3-zero real-type)
    (let* ((index (- remaining 1))
           (x (putnam-1982-a3-midpoint
               real-type a b index subdivisions))
           (width
            (putnam-1982-a3-div
             real-type
             (putnam-1982-a3-sub real-type b a)
             (putnam-1982-a3-nat-value
              real-type subdivisions))))
      (putnam-1982-a3-add
       real-type
       (putnam-1982-a3-mul
        real-type
        (putnam-1982-a3-integrand-value
         real-type kind x)
        width)
       (putnam-1982-a3-midpoint-sum-aux
        real-type kind a b index subdivisions)))))

(defun putnam-1982-a3-riemann-sum
    (real-type kind a b subdivisions)
  (if (posp subdivisions)
      (putnam-1982-a3-midpoint-sum-aux
       real-type kind a b subdivisions subdivisions)
    (putnam-1982-a3-zero real-type)))

(defun-sk putnam-1982-a3-integral-sums-tail-p
    (real-type kind integral a b epsilon cutoff)
  (forall (subdivisions)
    (implies
     (and
      (natp subdivisions)
      (<= cutoff subdivisions))
     (putnam-1982-a3-lt
      real-type
      (putnam-1982-a3-abs
       real-type
       (putnam-1982-a3-sub
        real-type
        (putnam-1982-a3-riemann-sum
         real-type kind a b subdivisions)
        integral))
      epsilon))))

(defun-sk putnam-1982-a3-integral-cutoff-exists-p
    (real-type kind integral a b epsilon)
  (exists (cutoff)
    (and
     (posp cutoff)
     (putnam-1982-a3-integral-sums-tail-p
      real-type kind integral a b epsilon cutoff))))

(defun-sk putnam-1982-a3-integral-sums-converge-p
    (real-type kind integral a b)
  (forall (epsilon)
    (implies
     (and
      (putnam-1982-a3-real-p real-type epsilon)
      (putnam-1982-a3-lt
       real-type
       (putnam-1982-a3-zero real-type)
       epsilon))
     (putnam-1982-a3-integral-cutoff-exists-p
      real-type kind integral a b epsilon))))

(defun putnam-1982-a3-has-midpoint-integral-p
    (real-type kind integral a b)
  (and
   (putnam-1982-a3-real-p real-type a)
   (putnam-1982-a3-real-p real-type b)
   (putnam-1982-a3-le real-type a b)
   (putnam-1982-a3-real-p real-type integral)
   (putnam-1982-a3-integral-sums-converge-p
    real-type kind integral a b)))

;; Exact definitions of the source constants and functions. On the positive
;; arguments used here, arctan(y) is the integral of 1/(1+x^2) from 0 to y,
;; pi is 4*arctan(1), and log(y) is the integral of 1/x from 1 to y.

(defun-sk putnam-1982-a3-arctan-definition-p (real-type)
  (forall (y)
    (implies
     (and
      (putnam-1982-a3-real-p real-type y)
      (putnam-1982-a3-le
       real-type (putnam-1982-a3-zero real-type) y))
     (putnam-1982-a3-has-midpoint-integral-p
      real-type
      :arctan-kernel
      (putnam-1982-a3-arctan real-type y)
      (putnam-1982-a3-zero real-type)
      y))))

(defun putnam-1982-a3-pi-definition-p (real-type)
  (let ((pi-value (putnam-1982-a3-pi real-type))
        (one (putnam-1982-a3-one real-type)))
    (and
     (putnam-1982-a3-real-p real-type pi-value)
     (putnam-1982-a3-lt real-type one pi-value)
     (equal
      pi-value
      (putnam-1982-a3-mul
       real-type
       (putnam-1982-a3-four real-type)
       (putnam-1982-a3-arctan real-type one))))))

(defun-sk putnam-1982-a3-log-definition-p (real-type)
  (forall (y)
    (implies
     (and
      (putnam-1982-a3-real-p real-type y)
      (putnam-1982-a3-le
       real-type (putnam-1982-a3-one real-type) y))
     (putnam-1982-a3-has-midpoint-integral-p
      real-type
      :log-kernel
      (putnam-1982-a3-log real-type y)
      (putnam-1982-a3-one real-type)
      y))))

(defun-sk putnam-1982-a3-prefix-definition-p (real-type)
  (forall (upper)
    (implies
     (and
      (putnam-1982-a3-real-p real-type upper)
      (putnam-1982-a3-le
       real-type (putnam-1982-a3-zero real-type) upper))
     (putnam-1982-a3-has-midpoint-integral-p
      real-type
      :main-integrand
      (putnam-1982-a3-prefix-integral real-type upper)
      (putnam-1982-a3-zero real-type)
      upper))))

(defun putnam-1982-a3-solution (real-type)
  (putnam-1982-a3-div
   real-type
   (putnam-1982-a3-mul
    real-type
    (putnam-1982-a3-pi real-type)
    (putnam-1982-a3-log
     real-type (putnam-1982-a3-pi real-type)))
   (putnam-1982-a3-two real-type)))

;; The source at-top convergence quantifier, over all real upper endpoints.

(defun-sk putnam-1982-a3-eventually-close-p
    (real-type epsilon threshold)
  (forall (upper)
    (implies
     (and
      (putnam-1982-a3-real-p real-type upper)
      (putnam-1982-a3-le real-type threshold upper))
     (putnam-1982-a3-lt
      real-type
      (putnam-1982-a3-abs
       real-type
       (putnam-1982-a3-sub
        real-type
        (putnam-1982-a3-prefix-integral real-type upper)
        (putnam-1982-a3-solution real-type)))
      epsilon))))

(defun-sk putnam-1982-a3-threshold-exists-p
    (real-type epsilon)
  (exists (threshold)
    (and
     (putnam-1982-a3-real-p real-type threshold)
     (putnam-1982-a3-le
      real-type (putnam-1982-a3-zero real-type) threshold)
     (putnam-1982-a3-eventually-close-p
      real-type epsilon threshold))))

(defun-sk putnam-1982-a3-improper-limit-p (real-type)
  (forall (epsilon)
    (implies
     (and
      (putnam-1982-a3-real-p real-type epsilon)
      (putnam-1982-a3-lt
       real-type
       (putnam-1982-a3-zero real-type)
       epsilon))
     (putnam-1982-a3-threshold-exists-p
      real-type epsilon))))

(defun-sk putnambench-putnam-1982-a3-statement ()
  (forall (real-type)
    (implies
     (and
      (putnam-1982-a3-real-structure-p real-type)
      (putnam-1982-a3-arctan-definition-p real-type)
      (putnam-1982-a3-pi-definition-p real-type)
      (putnam-1982-a3-log-definition-p real-type)
      (putnam-1982-a3-prefix-definition-p real-type))
     (putnam-1982-a3-improper-limit-p real-type))))

title: putnam_1982_a3
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1982_a3:
-- the improper integral from zero to positive infinity of
-- (arctan (pi x) - arctan x) / x equals (pi / 2) log pi.
-- This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; _*_)

infix 4 _!=_ _<=N_
infixr 3 _and_
infixr 2 _or_

data Bottom : Set where

Not : Set -> Set
Not A =
  A -> Bottom

_!=_ : {A : Set} -> A -> A -> Set
x != y =
  Not (x == y)

record _and_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data _or_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  left  : A -> A or B
  right : B -> A or B

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

data _<=N_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set where
  zero<=N   : {n : Nat} -> zero <=N n
  suc<=sucN : {m n : Nat} -> m <=N n -> suc m <=N suc n

record CompleteOrderedRealField (R : Set) : Set1 where
  field
    zeroR oneR : R
    add multiply : R -> R -> R
    negate inverse : R -> R
    lessOrEqual : R -> R -> Set
    fromNat : Nat -> R

    one-not-zero :
      oneR != zeroR

    add-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> add x y == add y x
    add-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      add (add x y) z == add x (add y z)
    add-zero :
      (x : R) -> add x zeroR == x
    add-inverse :
      (x : R) -> add x (negate x) == zeroR

    multiply-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> multiply x y == multiply y x
    multiply-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply (multiply x y) z ==
      multiply x (multiply y z)
    multiply-one :
      (x : R) -> multiply x oneR == x
    multiply-zero :
      (x : R) -> multiply x zeroR == zeroR
    distribute :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply x (add y z) ==
      add (multiply x y) (multiply x z)
    inverse-zero :
      inverse zeroR == zeroR
    multiply-inverse :
      (x : R) ->
      x != zeroR ->
      multiply x (inverse x) == oneR

    order-reflexive :
      (x : R) -> lessOrEqual x x
    order-transitive :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y z ->
      lessOrEqual x z
    order-antisymmetric :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y x ->
      x == y
    order-total :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y or lessOrEqual y x
    add-order :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual (add z x) (add z y)
    multiply-nonnegative :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR x ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR y ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR (multiply x y)
    zero-less-than-one :
      lessOrEqual zeroR oneR and zeroR != oneR

    fromNat-zero :
      fromNat zero == zeroR
    fromNat-successor :
      (n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (suc n) == add (fromNat n) oneR
    fromNat-addition :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m + n) == add (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-multiplication :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m * n) == multiply (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-injective :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat m == fromNat n ->
      m == n

    archimedean :
      (x : R) ->
      Exists Nat (\ n -> lessOrEqual x (fromNat n))
    least-upper-bound :
      (P : R -> Set) ->
      Exists R P ->
      Exists R
        (\ upper ->
          (x : R) ->
          P x ->
          lessOrEqual x upper) ->
      Exists R
        (\ supremum ->
          ((x : R) ->
            P x ->
            lessOrEqual x supremum)
          and
          ((upper : R) ->
            ((x : R) ->
              P x ->
              lessOrEqual x upper) ->
            lessOrEqual supremum upper))

open CompleteOrderedRealField

oneN : Nat
oneN =
  suc zero

twoN : Nat
twoN =
  suc oneN

fourN : Nat
fourN =
  twoN + twoN

subtract :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
subtract reals x y =
  add reals x (negate reals y)

divide :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
divide reals x y =
  multiply reals x (inverse reals y)

StrictLess :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
StrictLess reals x y =
  lessOrEqual reals x y and x != y

CloseTo :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
CloseTo reals center radius x =
  StrictLess reals
    (subtract reals center radius)
    x
  and
  StrictLess reals
    x
    (add reals center radius)

ConvergesTo :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  R ->
  Set
ConvergesTo {R} reals sequence limit =
  (epsilon : R) ->
  StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) epsilon ->
  Exists Nat
    (\ cutoff ->
      (n : Nat) ->
      cutoff <=N n ->
      CloseTo reals limit epsilon (sequence n))

LimitAtPositiveInfinity :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (R -> R) ->
  R ->
  Set
LimitAtPositiveInfinity {R} reals function limit =
  (epsilon : R) ->
  StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) epsilon ->
  Exists R
    (\ threshold ->
      (x : R) ->
      lessOrEqual reals threshold x ->
      CloseTo reals limit epsilon (function x))

naturalPower :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  Nat ->
  R
naturalPower reals x zero =
  oneR reals
naturalPower reals x (suc n) =
  multiply reals
    (naturalPower reals x n)
    x

factorial : Nat -> Nat
factorial zero =
  oneN
factorial (suc n) =
  suc n * factorial n

sumFirst :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Nat ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  R
sumFirst reals zero term =
  zeroR reals
sumFirst reals (suc n) term =
  add reals
    (sumFirst reals n term)
    (term n)

SeriesHasSum :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  R ->
  Set
SeriesHasSum reals terms limit =
  ConvergesTo reals
    (\ n -> sumFirst reals n terms)
    limit

alternatingPower :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Nat ->
  R
alternatingPower reals n =
  naturalPower reals
    (negate reals (oneR reals))
    n

exponentialTerm :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  Nat ->
  R
exponentialTerm reals x n =
  divide reals
    (naturalPower reals x n)
    (fromNat reals (factorial n))

sineTerm :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  Nat ->
  R
sineTerm reals x n =
  divide reals
    (multiply reals
      (alternatingPower reals n)
      (naturalPower reals x (suc (twoN * n))))
    (fromNat reals (factorial (suc (twoN * n))))

cosineTerm :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  Nat ->
  R
cosineTerm reals x n =
  divide reals
    (multiply reals
      (alternatingPower reals n)
      (naturalPower reals x (twoN * n)))
    (fromNat reals (factorial (twoN * n)))

leibnizTerm :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Nat ->
  R
leibnizTerm reals n =
  divide reals
    (alternatingPower reals n)
    (fromNat reals (suc (twoN * n)))

ExponentialValue :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
ExponentialValue reals x value =
  SeriesHasSum reals
    (exponentialTerm reals x)
    value

record PiValue
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R)
  (value : R) : Set where
  field
    positive :
      StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) value
    leibniz-series :
      SeriesHasSum reals
        (leibnizTerm reals)
        (divide reals value (fromNat reals fourN))

midpointRiemannSum :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  (R -> R) ->
  Nat ->
  R
midpointRiemannSum reals lower upper function pieces =
  let
    step =
      divide reals
        (subtract reals upper lower)
        (fromNat reals pieces)
    halfStep =
      divide reals
        step
        (fromNat reals twoN)
  in
  sumFirst reals pieces
    (\ i ->
      multiply reals
        (function
          (add reals lower
            (add reals
              (multiply reals
                (fromNat reals i)
                step)
              halfStep)))
        step)

IntervalIntegralValue :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  (R -> R) ->
  R ->
  Set
IntervalIntegralValue reals lower upper function value =
  ConvergesTo reals
    (\ n ->
      midpointRiemannSum reals
        lower
        upper
        function
        (suc n))
    value

record StandardRealAnalysis
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) : Set1 where
  field
    exponential logarithm : R -> R
    sine cosine arctangent : R -> R
    pi : R

    exponential-series :
      (x : R) ->
      ExponentialValue reals x (exponential x)
    exponential-positive :
      (x : R) ->
      StrictLess reals
        (zeroR reals)
        (exponential x)
    exponential-injective :
      (x y : R) ->
      exponential x == exponential y ->
      x == y
    exponential-logarithm :
      (x : R) ->
      StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) x ->
      exponential (logarithm x) == x

    sine-series :
      (x : R) ->
      SeriesHasSum reals
        (sineTerm reals x)
        (sine x)
    cosine-series :
      (x : R) ->
      SeriesHasSum reals
        (cosineTerm reals x)
        (cosine x)

    pi-value :
      PiValue reals pi

    arctangent-range :
      (x : R) ->
      StrictLess reals
        (negate reals
          (divide reals pi (fromNat reals twoN)))
        (arctangent x)
      and
      StrictLess reals
        (arctangent x)
        (divide reals pi (fromNat reals twoN))
    arctangent-cosine-nonzero :
      (x : R) ->
      cosine (arctangent x) != zeroR reals
    tangent-arctangent :
      (x : R) ->
      divide reals
        (sine (arctangent x))
        (cosine (arctangent x))
      ==
      x

    intervalIntegral :
      R ->
      R ->
      (R -> R) ->
      R
    interval-integral-is-riemann :
      (lower upper : R) ->
      (function : R -> R) ->
      Exists R
        (\ value ->
          IntervalIntegralValue reals
            lower
            upper
            function
            value) ->
      IntervalIntegralValue reals
        lower
        upper
        function
        (intervalIntegral lower upper function)

open StandardRealAnalysis

module Putnam1982A3Statement
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R)
  (analysis : StandardRealAnalysis reals) where

  integrand : R -> R
  integrand x =
    divide reals
      (subtract reals
        (arctangent analysis
          (multiply reals (pi analysis) x))
        (arctangent analysis x))
      x

  partialIntegral : R -> R
  partialIntegral t =
    intervalIntegral analysis
      (zeroR reals)
      t
      integrand

  solution : R
  solution =
    multiply reals
      (divide reals
        (pi analysis)
        (fromNat reals twoN))
      (logarithm analysis (pi analysis))

  proposition : Set
  proposition =
    LimitAtPositiveInfinity reals
      partialIntegral
      solution

putnam-1982-a3 : Set1
putnam-1982-a3 =
  (R : Set) ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) ->
  (analysis : StandardRealAnalysis reals) ->
  Putnam1982A3Statement.proposition reals analysis

title: putnam_1982_a3
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1982_a3:
  evaluation of the improper integral from zero to positive infinity of
  (arctan (pi * x) - arctan x) / x as (pi / 2) * ln pi.
  This file contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open pred_setTheory realTheory real_topologyTheory transcTheory
     integrationTheory;

val putnam_1982_a3 =
  ``((\t : real.
       integration$integral (interval [0, t])
         (\x : real. (atn (pi * x) - atn x) / x)) -->
     (pi / 2) * ln pi)
    at_posinfinity``;

title: putnam_1982_a3
content:
$(
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact
  putnam_1982_a3: evaluation of an improper real integral involving
  arctangent as one half pi times the natural logarithm of pi. This file
  contains no proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  The binder S. ( 0 (,) t ) F _d x is set.mm's real Lebesgue integral.
  For positive t, omitting the endpoints does not change the source interval
  integral. Values at nonpositive t are irrelevant to the limit at positive
  infinity.

  The relation ~~>r is set.mm's limit at positive infinity for a
  real-indexed function. The displayed limit is the explicit solution
  (pi / 2) * log(pi) given by the Rocq source and by the solution annotations
  in the Lean and Isabelle sources. The declaration is the single unproved
  $a corpus statement; this database contains no $p proof statement.
$)

${
  $d t x $.

  putnambench-putnam-1982-a3 $a |-
    (
      t e. RR |->
        S. ( 0 (,) t )
          (
            (
              ( arctan ` ( _pi x. x ) )
              -
              ( arctan ` x )
            )
            /
            x
          )
          _d x
    )
    ~~>r
    (
      ( _pi / 2 )
      x.
      ( log ` _pi )
    )
  $.
$}

title: putnam_1982_a3
content:
% Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1982_a3:
% the improper integral of (atan(pi*x) - atan(x)) / x on the nonnegative
% real axis equals (pi / 2) * ln(pi). This file contains no proof.

putnam_1982_a3: THEORY
BEGIN
  real_function: TYPE = [real -> real]
  real_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> real]

  safe_div(numerator, denominator: real): real =
    IF denominator = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      numerator / denominator
    ENDIF

  converges_to(sequence: real_sequence, value: real): bool =
    FORALL (epsilon_value: posreal):
      EXISTS (cutoff: nat):
        FORALL (index: nat):
          cutoff <= index IMPLIES
            abs(sequence(index) - value) < epsilon_value

  nat_factorial(index: nat): RECURSIVE nat =
    IF index = 0 THEN
      1
    ELSE
      index * nat_factorial(index - 1)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE index

  alternating_sign(index: nat): RECURSIVE real =
    IF index = 0 THEN
      1
    ELSE
      -alternating_sign(index - 1)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE index

  exponential_partial(x: real, count: nat): RECURSIVE real =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      LET index: nat = count - 1 IN
        exponential_partial(x, count - 1)
          + safe_div(
              x ^ index,
              nat_factorial(index) :: real)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  sine_partial(x: real, count: nat): RECURSIVE real =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      LET index: nat = count - 1 IN
        sine_partial(x, count - 1)
          + safe_div(
              alternating_sign(index) * x ^ (2 * index + 1),
              nat_factorial(2 * index + 1) :: real)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  cosine_partial(x: real, count: nat): RECURSIVE real =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      LET index: nat = count - 1 IN
        cosine_partial(x, count - 1)
          + safe_div(
              alternating_sign(index) * x ^ (2 * index),
              nat_factorial(2 * index) :: real)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  leibniz_partial_sum(count: nat): RECURSIVE real =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      LET index: nat = count - 1 IN
        leibniz_partial_sum(count - 1)
          + safe_div(
              alternating_sign(index),
              (2 * index + 1) :: real)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  real_exponential(x: real): real =
    epsilon(
      LAMBDA (value: real):
        converges_to(
          LAMBDA (count: nat):
            exponential_partial(x, count),
          value))

  real_sine(x: real): real =
    epsilon(
      LAMBDA (value: real):
        converges_to(
          LAMBDA (count: nat):
            sine_partial(x, count),
          value))

  real_cosine(x: real): real =
    epsilon(
      LAMBDA (value: real):
        converges_to(
          LAMBDA (count: nat):
            cosine_partial(x, count),
          value))

  pi: real =
    epsilon(
      LAMBDA (value: real):
        converges_to(
          LAMBDA (count: nat):
            4 * leibniz_partial_sum(count),
          value))

  natural_log(x: real): real =
    IF x > 0 THEN
      epsilon(
        LAMBDA (value: real):
          real_exponential(value) = x)
    ELSE
      0
    ENDIF

  real_tangent(x: real): real =
    safe_div(real_sine(x), real_cosine(x))

  real_arctangent(x: real): real =
    epsilon(
      LAMBDA (angle: real):
        -pi / 2 < angle
          AND angle < pi / 2
          AND real_tangent(angle) = x)

  integrand(x: real): real =
    safe_div(
      real_arctangent(pi * x) - real_arctangent(x),
      x)

  valid_tagged_partition(
      left, right: real,
      points, tags: real_sequence,
      count: nat): bool =
    count > 0
      AND points(0) = left
      AND points(count) = right
      AND FORALL (index: nat):
        index < count IMPLIES
          (points(index) < points(index + 1)
            AND points(index) <= tags(index)
            AND tags(index) <= points(index + 1))

  mesh_less_than(
      points: real_sequence,
      count: nat,
      bound: real): bool =
    FORALL (index: nat):
      index < count IMPLIES
        points(index + 1) - points(index) < bound

  riemann_sum(
      function_value: real_function,
      points, tags: real_sequence,
      count: nat): RECURSIVE real =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      riemann_sum(
        function_value, points, tags, count - 1)
        + function_value(tags(count - 1))
            * (points(count) - points(count - 1))
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  has_interval_integral(
      function_value: real_function,
      left, right, integral_value: real): bool =
    left < right
      AND FORALL (epsilon_value: posreal):
        EXISTS (mesh_bound: posreal):
          FORALL
              (points, tags: real_sequence),
              (count: nat):
            (valid_tagged_partition(
                left, right, points, tags, count)
              AND mesh_less_than(
                points, count, mesh_bound))
            IMPLIES
              abs(
                riemann_sum(
                  function_value, points, tags, count)
                  - integral_value)
                < epsilon_value

  interval_integral(
      function_value: real_function,
      left, right: real): real =
    IF left = right THEN
      0
    ELSIF left < right THEN
      IF EXISTS (integral_value: real):
          has_interval_integral(
            function_value, left, right, integral_value)
      THEN
        epsilon(
          LAMBDA (integral_value: real):
            has_interval_integral(
              function_value, left, right, integral_value))
      ELSE
        0
      ENDIF
    ELSE
      IF EXISTS (integral_value: real):
          has_interval_integral(
            function_value, right, left, integral_value)
      THEN
        -epsilon(
          LAMBDA (integral_value: real):
            has_interval_integral(
              function_value, right, left, integral_value))
      ELSE
        0
      ENDIF
    ENDIF

  truncated_integral(t: real): real =
    interval_integral(integrand, 0, t)

  converges_at_real_top(
      function_value: real_function,
      limit_value: real): bool =
    FORALL (epsilon_value: posreal):
      EXISTS (cutoff: real):
        FORALL (t: real):
          cutoff <= t IMPLIES
            abs(function_value(t) - limit_value)
              < epsilon_value

  putnam_1982_a3_solution: real =
    (pi / 2) * natural_log(pi)

  putnam_1982_a3: bool =
    converges_at_real_top(
      truncated_integral,
      putnam_1982_a3_solution)
END putnam_1982_a3

-- Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1982_a5:
-- positive integers with bounded numerator sum and rational sum below one
-- have deficit greater than 1 / 1983 cubed. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; _*_)

infix 4 _!=_ _<=N_ _<N_
infixr 3 _and_
infixr 2 _or_

data Bottom : Set where

Not : Set -> Set
Not A = A -> Bottom

_!=_ : {A : Set} -> A -> A -> Set
x != y = Not (x == y)

record _and_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data _or_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  left  : A -> A or B
  right : B -> A or B

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

data _<=N_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set where
  zero<=   : {n : Nat} -> zero <=N n
  suc<=suc : {m n : Nat} -> m <=N n -> suc m <=N suc n

_<N_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set
m <N n = suc m <=N n

record CompleteOrderedRealField (R : Set) : Set1 where
  field
    zeroR oneR : R
    addR multiplyR : R -> R -> R
    negateR inverseR : R -> R
    lessOrEqualR : R -> R -> Set
    fromNatR : Nat -> R

    oneR-not-zeroR :
      oneR != zeroR

    addR-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> addR x y == addR y x
    addR-associative :
      (x y z : R) -> addR (addR x y) z == addR x (addR y z)
    addR-zero :
      (x : R) -> addR x zeroR == x
    addR-inverse :
      (x : R) -> addR x (negateR x) == zeroR

    multiplyR-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> multiplyR x y == multiplyR y x
    multiplyR-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiplyR (multiplyR x y) z == multiplyR x (multiplyR y z)
    multiplyR-one :
      (x : R) -> multiplyR x oneR == x
    multiplyR-zero :
      (x : R) -> multiplyR x zeroR == zeroR
    distributeR :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiplyR x (addR y z) ==
      addR (multiplyR x y) (multiplyR x z)
    inverseR-zero :
      inverseR zeroR == zeroR
    multiplyR-inverse :
      (x : R) ->
      x != zeroR ->
      multiplyR x (inverseR x) == oneR

    order-reflexive :
      (x : R) -> lessOrEqualR x x
    order-transitive :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR x y ->
      lessOrEqualR y z ->
      lessOrEqualR x z
    order-antisymmetric :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR x y ->
      lessOrEqualR y x ->
      x == y
    order-total :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR x y or lessOrEqualR y x
    addR-order :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR x y ->
      lessOrEqualR (addR z x) (addR z y)
    multiplyR-nonnegative :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR zeroR x ->
      lessOrEqualR zeroR y ->
      lessOrEqualR zeroR (multiplyR x y)
    zeroR-less-than-oneR :
      lessOrEqualR zeroR oneR and zeroR != oneR

    fromNatR-zero :
      fromNatR zero == zeroR
    fromNatR-successor :
      (n : Nat) -> fromNatR (suc n) == addR (fromNatR n) oneR
    fromNatR-addition :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNatR (m + n) == addR (fromNatR m) (fromNatR n)
    fromNatR-multiplication :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNatR (m * n) == multiplyR (fromNatR m) (fromNatR n)
    fromNatR-injective :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNatR m == fromNatR n ->
      m == n

    archimedean :
      (x : R) ->
      Exists Nat (\ n -> lessOrEqualR x (fromNatR n))
    least-upper-bound :
      (P : R -> Set) ->
      Exists R P ->
      Exists R
        (\ upper ->
          (x : R) ->
          P x ->
          lessOrEqualR x upper) ->
      Exists R
        (\ supremum ->
          ((x : R) -> P x -> lessOrEqualR x supremum)
          and
          ((upper : R) ->
            ((x : R) -> P x -> lessOrEqualR x upper) ->
            lessOrEqualR supremum upper))

open CompleteOrderedRealField

subtract :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
subtract reals x y =
  addR reals x (negateR reals y)

divide :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
divide reals x y =
  multiplyR reals x (inverseR reals y)

cube :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R
cube reals x =
  multiplyR reals (multiplyR reals x x) x

StrictLess :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
StrictLess reals x y =
  lessOrEqualR reals x y and x != y

module Putnam1982A5Statement
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) where

  fraction : Nat -> Nat -> R
  fraction numerator denominator =
    divide reals
      (fromNatR reals numerator)
      (fromNatR reals denominator)

  deficit : Nat -> Nat -> Nat -> Nat -> R
  deficit a b c d =
    subtract reals
      (subtract reals
        (oneR reals)
        (fraction a b))
      (fraction c d)

  lowerBound : R
  lowerBound =
    divide reals
      (oneR reals)
      (cube reals (fromNatR reals 1983))

  proposition : Set
  proposition =
    (a b c d : Nat) ->
    zero <N a ->
    zero <N b ->
    zero <N c ->
    zero <N d ->
    a + c <=N 1982 ->
    StrictLess reals
      (addR reals (fraction a b) (fraction c d))
      (oneR reals) ->
    StrictLess reals
      lowerBound
      (deficit a b c d)

putnam-1982-a5 : Set1
putnam-1982-a5 =
  (R : Set) ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) ->
  Putnam1982A5Statement.proposition reals

import Mathlib

open Set Function Filter Topology Polynomial Real

abbrev putnam_1982_a6_solution : Prop := False
/--
Let $b$ be a bijection from the positive integers to the positive integers. Also, let $x_1, x_2, x_3, \dots$ be an infinite sequence of real numbers with the following properties:
\begin{enumerate}
\item
$|x_n|$ is a strictly decreasing function of $n$;
\item
$\lim_{n \rightarrow \infty} |b(n) - n| \cdot |x_n| = 0$;
\item
$\lim_{n \rightarrow \infty}\sum_{k = 1}^{n} x_k = 1$.
\end{enumerate}
Prove or disprove: these conditions imply that $$\lim_{n \rightarrow \infty} \sum_{k = 1}^{n} x_{b(k)} = 1.$$
-/
theorem putnam_1982_a6 :
  (∀ b : ℕ → ℕ,
    ∀ x : ℕ → ℝ,
      BijOn b (Ici 1) (Ici 1) →
      StrictAntiOn (fun n : ℕ => |x n|) (Ici 1) →
      Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => |b n - (n : ℤ)| * |x n|) atTop (𝓝 0) →
      Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => ∑ k ∈ Finset.Icc 1 n, x k) atTop (𝓝 1) →
      Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => ∑ k ∈ Finset.Icc 1 n, x (b k)) atTop (𝓝 1))
  ↔ putnam_1982_a6_solution :=
sorry

Require Import Nat Reals ZArith Coquelicot.Coquelicot.
Open Scope R.
Definition putnam_1982_a6_solution := False.

Definition putnam_1982_a6_positive_bijection (b : nat -> nat) : Prop :=
  (forall n : nat, (0 < n)%nat -> (0 < b n)%nat) /\
  (forall i j : nat,
    (0 < i)%nat ->
    (0 < j)%nat ->
    b i = b j ->
    i = j) /\
  (forall y : nat,
    (0 < y)%nat ->
    exists x : nat, (0 < x)%nat /\ b x = y).

Theorem putnam_1982_a6
    : (forall (b : nat -> nat) (a : nat -> R),
        putnam_1982_a6_positive_bijection b ->
        (forall i j : nat,
          (0 < i < j)%nat ->
          Rabs (a i) > Rabs (a j)) ->
        is_lim_seq
          (fun n => sum_n_m a 1 n)
          1 ->

(in-package "ACL2")

;; Standard ACL2's scalar domain is rational. A rational-valued counterexample
;; is also a real-valued counterexample, so it suffices for this disproof
;; problem. The witnesses remain internally existential: the statement does
;; not prescribe a particular sequence, permutation, or convergence modulus.

(defun putnam-1982-a6-value (function n)
  (apply$ function (list n)))

(defun-sk putnam-1982-a6-positive-integer-map-p (function)
  (forall (n)
    (implies
     (posp n)
     (posp (putnam-1982-a6-value function n)))))

(defun-sk putnam-1982-a6-inverse-laws-p
    (permutation inverse)
  (forall (n)
    (implies
     (posp n)
     (and
      (equal
       (putnam-1982-a6-value
        permutation
        (putnam-1982-a6-value inverse n))
       n)
      (equal
       (putnam-1982-a6-value
        inverse
        (putnam-1982-a6-value permutation n))
       n)))))

(defun putnam-1982-a6-bijection-p
    (permutation inverse)
  (and
   (tamep-functionp permutation)
   (tamep-functionp inverse)
   (putnam-1982-a6-positive-integer-map-p permutation)
   (putnam-1982-a6-positive-integer-map-p inverse)
   (putnam-1982-a6-inverse-laws-p permutation inverse)))

(defun-sk putnam-1982-a6-rational-sequence-p (sequence)
  (forall (n)

     (posp n)
     (rationalp
      (putnam-1982-a6-value sequence n)))))

    (sequence)
  (forall (i j)
    (implies
     (and
      (posp i)
      (posp j)
      (< i j))

        (abs (putnam-1982-a6-value sequence i))))))

  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix count)))
  (if (zp count)
      0

    (permutation sequence count)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix count)))
  (if (zp count)
      0

        sequence
        (putnam-1982-a6-value permutation count)))))

    (permutation sequence epsilon cutoff)
  (forall (n)

(defun-sk putnam-1982-a6-original-tail-p

        epsilon))))

(defun-sk putnam-1982-a6-original-cutoff-exists-p

      permutation sequence epsilon cutoff))))

(defun-sk putnam-1982-a6-rearranged-not-tends-to-one-p
    (permutation sequence)
  (exists (epsilon)
    (and
     (rationalp epsilon)
     (< 0 epsilon)
     (putnam-1982-a6-rearranged-infinitely-often-away-p
      permutation sequence epsilon))))

(defun putnam-1982-a6-counterexample-p
    (permutation inverse sequence)
  (and
   (putnam-1982-a6-bijection-p permutation inverse)
   (tamep-functionp sequence)
   (putnam-1982-a6-rational-sequence-p sequence)
   (putnam-1982-a6-strictly-decreasing-magnitude-p sequence)
   (putnam-1982-a6-displacement-tends-to-zero-p
    permutation sequence)

   (putnam-1982-a6-rearranged-not-tends-to-one-p

-- Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1982_a6:
-- the proposed preservation of a convergent real series under permutations
-- with decreasing term magnitudes and vanishing displacement-weighted terms
-- is false. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; _*_)

infix 4 _!=_ _<=N_
infixr 3 _and_
infixr 2 _or_

data Bottom : Set where

Not : Set -> Set
Not A =
  A -> Bottom

_!=_ : {A : Set} -> A -> A -> Set
x != y =
  Not (x == y)

record _and_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data _or_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  left  : A -> A or B
  right : B -> A or B

record Iff (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor equivalence
  field
    forward  : A -> B
    backward : B -> A

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

data _<=N_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set where
  zero<=N   : {n : Nat} -> zero <=N n
  suc<=sucN : {m n : Nat} -> m <=N n -> suc m <=N suc n

NatStrictLess : Nat -> Nat -> Set
NatStrictLess m n =
  suc m <=N n

oneN : Nat
oneN =
  suc zero

Positive : Nat -> Set
Positive n =
  oneN <=N n

record PositiveBijection (b : Nat -> Nat) : Set where
  field
    maps-positive :
      (n : Nat) ->
      Positive n ->
      Positive (b n)

    injective-on-positive :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      Positive m ->
      Positive n ->
      b m == b n ->
      m == n

    surjective-on-positive :
      (n : Nat) ->
      Positive n ->
      Exists Nat
        (\ m ->
          Positive m
          and
          b m == n)

record CompleteOrderedRealField (R : Set) : Set1 where
  field
    zeroR oneR : R
    add multiply : R -> R -> R
    negate inverse absoluteValue : R -> R
    lessOrEqual : R -> R -> Set
    fromNat : Nat -> R

    one-not-zero :
      oneR != zeroR

    add-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> add x y == add y x
    add-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      add (add x y) z == add x (add y z)
    add-zero :
      (x : R) -> add x zeroR == x
    add-inverse :
      (x : R) -> add x (negate x) == zeroR

    multiply-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> multiply x y == multiply y x
    multiply-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply (multiply x y) z ==
      multiply x (multiply y z)
    multiply-one :
      (x : R) -> multiply x oneR == x
    multiply-zero :
      (x : R) -> multiply x zeroR == zeroR
    distribute :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply x (add y z) ==
      add (multiply x y) (multiply x z)
    inverse-zero :
      inverse zeroR == zeroR
    multiply-inverse :
      (x : R) ->
      x != zeroR ->
      multiply x (inverse x) == oneR

    order-reflexive :
      (x : R) -> lessOrEqual x x
    order-transitive :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y z ->
      lessOrEqual x z
    order-antisymmetric :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y x ->
      x == y
    order-total :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y or lessOrEqual y x
    add-order :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual (add z x) (add z y)
    multiply-nonnegative :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR x ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR y ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR (multiply x y)
    zero-less-than-one :
      lessOrEqual zeroR oneR and zeroR != oneR

    absolute-nonnegative :
      (x : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR (absoluteValue x)
    absolute-of-nonnegative :
      (x : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR x ->
      absoluteValue x == x
    absolute-of-nonpositive :
      (x : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x zeroR ->
      absoluteValue x == negate x

    fromNat-zero :
      fromNat zero == zeroR
    fromNat-successor :
      (n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (suc n) == add (fromNat n) oneR
    fromNat-addition :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m + n) == add (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-multiplication :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m * n) == multiply (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-injective :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat m == fromNat n ->
      m == n

    archimedean :
      (x : R) ->
      Exists Nat
        (\ n ->
          lessOrEqual x (fromNat n))
    least-upper-bound :
      (P : R -> Set) ->
      Exists R P ->
      Exists R
        (\ upper ->
          (x : R) ->
          P x ->
          lessOrEqual x upper) ->
      Exists R
        (\ supremum ->
          ((x : R) ->
            P x ->
            lessOrEqual x supremum)
          and
          ((upper : R) ->
            ((x : R) ->
              P x ->
              lessOrEqual x upper) ->
            lessOrEqual supremum upper))

open CompleteOrderedRealField

subtract :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
subtract reals x y =
  add reals x (negate reals y)

StrictLess :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
StrictLess reals x y =
  lessOrEqual reals x y and x != y

CloseTo :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
CloseTo reals center radius x =
  StrictLess reals
    (subtract reals center radius)
    x
  and
  StrictLess reals
    x
    (add reals center radius)

ConvergesTo :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  R ->
  Set
ConvergesTo {R} reals sequence limit =
  (epsilon : R) ->
  StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) epsilon ->
  Exists Nat
    (\ cutoff ->
      (n : Nat) ->
      cutoff <=N n ->
      CloseTo reals limit epsilon (sequence n))

sumFromOneThrough :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  Nat ->
  R
sumFromOneThrough reals term zero =
  zeroR reals
sumFromOneThrough reals term (suc n) =
  add reals
    (sumFromOneThrough reals term n)
    (term (suc n))

naturalAbsoluteDifference : Nat -> Nat -> Nat
naturalAbsoluteDifference zero n =
  n
naturalAbsoluteDifference (suc m) zero =
  suc m
naturalAbsoluteDifference (suc m) (suc n) =
  naturalAbsoluteDifference m n

StrictlyDecreasingAbsolute :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  Set
StrictlyDecreasingAbsolute reals x =
  (m n : Nat) ->
  Positive m ->
  Positive n ->
  NatStrictLess m n ->
  StrictLess reals
    (absoluteValue reals (x n))
    (absoluteValue reals (x m))

module Putnam1982A6Statement
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) where

  displacementTerm :
    (Nat -> Nat) ->
    (Nat -> R) ->
    Nat ->
    R
  displacementTerm b x n =
    multiply reals
      (fromNat reals
        (naturalAbsoluteDifference (b n) n))
      (absoluteValue reals (x n))

  partialSums :
    (Nat -> R) ->
    Nat ->
    R
  partialSums x n =
    sumFromOneThrough reals x n

  rearrangedPartialSums :
    (Nat -> Nat) ->
    (Nat -> R) ->
    Nat ->
    R
  rearrangedPartialSums b x n =
    sumFromOneThrough reals
      (\ k -> x (b k))
      n

  RearrangementClaim : Set
  RearrangementClaim =
    (b : Nat -> Nat) ->
    (x : Nat -> R) ->
    PositiveBijection b ->
    StrictlyDecreasingAbsolute reals x ->
    ConvergesTo reals
      (displacementTerm b x)
      (zeroR reals) ->
    ConvergesTo reals
      (partialSums x)
      (oneR reals) ->
    ConvergesTo reals
      (rearrangedPartialSums b x)
      (oneR reals)

  solution : Set
  solution =
    Bottom

  proposition : Set
  proposition =
    Iff RearrangementClaim solution

putnam-1982-a6 : Set1
putnam-1982-a6 =
  (R : Set) ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) ->
  Putnam1982A6Statement.proposition reals

% Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1982_a6:
% whether a positive-integer permutation preserves the limit of a real series
% under strict magnitude decrease and vanishing weighted displacement. This
% file contains no proof.

putnam_1982_a6: THEORY
BEGIN
  natural_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> nat]
  real_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> real]

  positive_integer_bijection(b: natural_sequence): bool =
    (FORALL (n: nat):
      n >= 1 IMPLIES b(n) >= 1)
      AND (FORALL (i, j: nat):
        (i >= 1 AND j >= 1 AND b(i) = b(j))
          IMPLIES i = j)
      AND (FORALL (value: nat):
        value >= 1 IMPLIES
          EXISTS (index: nat):
            index >= 1 AND b(index) = value)

  strictly_decreasing_magnitudes(x: real_sequence): bool =
    FORALL (i, j: nat):
      (i >= 1 AND i < j) IMPLIES
        abs(x(j)) < abs(x(i))

  partial_sum(x: real_sequence, count: nat): RECURSIVE real =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      partial_sum(x, count - 1) + x(count)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  permuted_partial_sum(
      b: natural_sequence,
      x: real_sequence,
      count: nat): RECURSIVE real =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      permuted_partial_sum(b, x, count - 1) + x(b(count))
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  converges_to(sequence: real_sequence, value: real): bool =
    FORALL (epsilon_value: posreal):
      EXISTS (cutoff: nat):
        FORALL (index: nat):
          cutoff <= index IMPLIES
            abs(sequence(index) - value) < epsilon_value

  weighted_displacement(
      b: natural_sequence,
      x: real_sequence): real_sequence =
    LAMBDA (index: nat):
      abs((b(index) :: real) - (index :: real)) * abs(x(index))

  putnam_1982_a6_solution: bool = FALSE

  putnam_1982_a6: bool =
    (FORALL (b: natural_sequence), (x: real_sequence):
      (positive_integer_bijection(b)
        AND strictly_decreasing_magnitudes(x)
        AND converges_to(weighted_displacement(b, x), 0)
        AND converges_to(
          LAMBDA (count: nat): partial_sum(x, count),
          1))
      IMPLIES
        converges_to(
          LAMBDA (count: nat):
            permuted_partial_sum(b, x, count),
          1))
      IFF putnam_1982_a6_solution
END putnam_1982_a6

import Mathlib

open Set Function Filter Topology Polynomial Real

noncomputable abbrev putnam_1982_b2_solution : Polynomial ℝ :=
  C Real.pi * (2 * X - 1) ^ 2
/--
Let $A(x, y)$ denote the number of points $(m, n)$ with integer coordinates $m$ and $n$ where $m^2 + n^2 \le x^2 + y^2$. Also, let $g = \sum_{k = 0}^{\infty} e^{-k^2}$. Express the value $$\int_{-\infty}^{\infty}\int_{-\infty}^{\infty} A(x, y)e^{-x^2 - y^2} dx dy$$ as a polynomial in $g$.
-/
theorem putnam_1982_b2
(A : ℝ × ℝ → ℕ)
(g I : ℝ)
(hA : A = fun (x, y) => {(m, n) : ℤ × ℤ | m^2 + n^2 ≤ x^2 + y^2}.ncard)
(hg : g = ∑' k : ℕ, Real.exp (-k^2))
(hI : I = ∫ y : ℝ, ∫ x : ℝ, A (x, y) * Real.exp (-x^2 - y^2))
: I = putnam_1982_b2_solution.eval g :=
sorry

title: putnam_1982_b2
content:
(* Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench artifact putnam_1982_b2:
   evaluation of a Gaussian double integral weighted by the number of
   integer lattice points in a disk as a polynomial in a Gaussian series.
   This file contains no proof. *)

From Stdlib Require Import
  Reals ZArith Ensembles Finite_sets RiemannInt SeqSeries
  ClassicalEpsilon List.

Open Scope R_scope.

Definition putnam_1982_b2_lattice_points
    (x y : R) : Ensemble (Z * Z) :=
  fun p : Z * Z =>
    IZR (fst p) ^ 2 + IZR (snd p) ^ 2 <= x ^ 2 + y ^ 2.

Definition putnam_1982_b2_series_value
    (f : nat -> R) : R :=
  epsilon (inhabits (0 : R))
    (fun value : R => infinite_sum f value).

Definition putnam_1982_b2_finite_integral
    (f : R -> R) (a b : R) : R :=
  epsilon (inhabits (0 : R))
    (fun value : R =>
      exists h : Riemann_integrable f a b,
        value = RiemannInt h).

Definition putnam_1982_b2_whole_line_integral
    (f : R -> R) : R :=
  epsilon (inhabits (0 : R))
    (fun value : R =>
      Un_cv
        (fun n : nat =>
          putnam_1982_b2_finite_integral
            f (- INR n) (INR n))
        value).

Definition putnam_1982_b2_real_polynomial := list R.

Fixpoint putnam_1982_b2_polynomial_eval
    (p : putnam_1982_b2_real_polynomial) (x : R) : R :=
  match p with
  | nil => 0
  | coefficient :: rest =>
      coefficient + x * putnam_1982_b2_polynomial_eval rest x
  end.

Definition putnam_1982_b2_solution
    : putnam_1982_b2_real_polynomial :=
  PI :: (-4 * PI) :: (4 * PI) :: nil.

Theorem putnam_1982_b2
    (A : R * R -> nat)
    (g I : R)
    (hA : forall x y : R,
      cardinal (Z * Z)
        (putnam_1982_b2_lattice_points x y)
        (A (x, y)))
    (hg : g =
      putnam_1982_b2_series_value
        (fun k : nat => exp (- (INR k) ^ 2)))
    (hI : I =
      putnam_1982_b2_whole_line_integral
        (fun y : R =>
          putnam_1982_b2_whole_line_integral
            (fun x : R =>
              INR (A (x, y)) * exp (- x ^ 2 - y ^ 2)))) :
  I = putnam_1982_b2_polynomial_eval putnam_1982_b2_solution g.
Admitted.

title: putnam_1982_b2
putnam_1982_b2
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1982_b2:
;; the Gaussian integral of the integer-lattice point count in a centered
;; disk equals pi times the square of twice a Gaussian series minus one.
;; This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))

;; Standard ACL2 has exact rationals but no primitive completed real field.
;; The functions below are rational approximants used inside an unbounded
;; limit definition.  The source variables A, g, and I are uniquely fixed by
;; their defining hypotheses, so they are eliminated definitionally.

;; For 0 <= T < SCALE, (1-T/SCALE)^SCALE converges upward to exp(-T).
(defun putnam-1982-b2-gaussian-approx (t-value scale)
  (if (and (rationalp t-value)
           (<= 0 t-value)
           (natp scale)
           (< 0 scale)
           (< t-value scale))
      (expt (- 1 (/ t-value scale)) scale)
    0))

;; With TERMS summands, this is four times the corresponding Leibniz prefix
;; for pi.  Every value is rational and the prefixes converge to pi.
(defun putnam-1982-b2-leibniz-prefix (terms)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix terms)))
  (if (zp terms)
      0
    (let* ((index (- terms 1))
           (sign (if (equal (mod index 2) 0) 1 -1)))
      (+ (putnam-1982-b2-leibniz-prefix index)
         (/ sign (+ (* 2 index) 1))))))

(defun putnam-1982-b2-pi-prefix (terms)
  (* 4 (putnam-1982-b2-leibniz-prefix terms)))

;; Count integer pairs in the disk through the finite square
;; [-BOUND,BOUND]^2.  Calls from the integral use BOUND=2*RADIUS; throughout
;; the integration square this contains every integer pair satisfying the
;; disk inequality, so the count is exactly the source function A(x,y).
(defun putnam-1982-b2-lattice-row-count
    (m-coordinate n-count bound radius-squared)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix n-count)))
  (if (zp n-count)
      0
    (let* ((index (- n-count 1))
           (n-coordinate (- index bound)))
      (+ (if (<= (+ (* m-coordinate m-coordinate)
                     (* n-coordinate n-coordinate))
                  radius-squared)
             1
           0)
         (putnam-1982-b2-lattice-row-count
          m-coordinate index bound radius-squared)))))

(defun putnam-1982-b2-lattice-count-rows
    (m-count n-count bound radius-squared)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix m-count)))
  (if (zp m-count)
      0
    (let* ((index (- m-count 1))
           (m-coordinate (- index bound)))
      (+ (putnam-1982-b2-lattice-row-count
          m-coordinate n-count bound radius-squared)
         (putnam-1982-b2-lattice-count-rows
          index n-count bound radius-squared)))))

(defun putnam-1982-b2-lattice-count (x y radius)
  (let* ((radius-squared (+ (* x x) (* y y)))
         (bound (* 2 radius))
         (coordinate-count (+ 1 (* 2 bound))))
    (putnam-1982-b2-lattice-count-rows
     coordinate-count coordinate-count bound radius-squared)))

;; Midpoints of the uniform mesh on [-RADIUS,RADIUS].
(defun putnam-1982-b2-grid-coordinate
    (index radius subdivisions)
  (/ (- (+ (* 2 index) 1)
        (* 2 radius subdivisions))
     (* 2 subdivisions)))

(defun putnam-1982-b2-integral-row-sum
    (x-count y radius subdivisions scale)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix x-count)))
  (if (zp x-count)
      0
    (let* ((index (- x-count 1))
           (x (putnam-1982-b2-grid-coordinate
               index radius subdivisions))
           (radius-squared (+ (* x x) (* y y))))
      (+ (* (putnam-1982-b2-lattice-count x y radius)
            (putnam-1982-b2-gaussian-approx
             radius-squared scale))
         (putnam-1982-b2-integral-row-sum
          index y radius subdivisions scale)))))

(defun putnam-1982-b2-integral-grid-sum
    (y-count side-count radius subdivisions scale)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix y-count)))
  (if (zp y-count)
      0
    (let* ((index (- y-count 1))
           (y (putnam-1982-b2-grid-coordinate
               index radius subdivisions)))
      (+ (putnam-1982-b2-integral-row-sum
          side-count y radius subdivisions scale)
         (putnam-1982-b2-integral-grid-sum
          index side-count radius subdivisions scale)))))

;; This midpoint sum retains the source integrand A(x,y)*exp(-x^2-y^2).
;; Increasing RADIUS removes the Gaussian tail, increasing SUBDIVISIONS
;; resolves the finitely many circle discontinuities in each square, and
;; increasing SCALE removes the rational exponential approximation error.
(defun putnam-1982-b2-integral-approx
    (radius subdivisions scale)
  (if (and (posp radius)
           (posp subdivisions)
           (posp scale))
      (let ((side-count (* 2 radius subdivisions)))
        (/ (putnam-1982-b2-integral-grid-sum
            side-count side-count radius subdivisions scale)
           (* subdivisions subdivisions)))
    0))

;; Exact rational prefixes for g=sum_(k>=0) exp(-k^2).
(defun putnam-1982-b2-g-prefix (terms scale)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix terms)))
  (if (zp terms)
      0
    (let ((index (- terms 1)))
      (+ (putnam-1982-b2-g-prefix index scale)
         (putnam-1982-b2-gaussian-approx
          (* index index) scale)))))

;; The source solution polynomial is pi*(2*X-1)^2.
(defun putnam-1982-b2-solution-approx
    (g-terms pi-terms scale)
  (let ((two-g-minus-one
         (- (* 2 (putnam-1982-b2-g-prefix g-terms scale))
            1)))
    (* (putnam-1982-b2-pi-prefix pi-terms)
       two-g-minus-one
       two-g-minus-one)))

;; No numerical convergence modulus is assumed.  For fixed finite data,
;; SCALE tending to infinity gives the exact exponential values.  Then
;; SUBDIVISIONS tending to infinity gives the integral on a fixed square.
;; Finally RADIUS tends to infinity while G-TERMS and PI-TERMS tend to
;; infinity.  Thus the nested predicates below state equality of the exact
;; iterated limits, not a bounded finite approximation.  The square midpoint
;; integrals converge to the source Lebesgue integral because the integrand
;; is bounded and Riemann integrable on every square; its discontinuities
;; there lie on finitely many circles.  The nonnegative Gaussian tail makes
;; the expanding-square limit the full integral.  Positive rational
;; tolerances are cofinal among positive real tolerances.

(defun-sk putnam-1982-b2-scale-tail-p
    (epsilon radius subdivisions g-terms pi-terms scale-cutoff)
  (forall (scale)
    (implies
     (and
      (posp scale)
      (<= scale-cutoff scale))
     (< (abs
         (- (putnam-1982-b2-integral-approx
             radius subdivisions scale)
            (putnam-1982-b2-solution-approx
             g-terms pi-terms scale)))
        epsilon))))

(defun-sk putnam-1982-b2-scale-cutoff-exists-p
    (epsilon radius subdivisions g-terms pi-terms)
  (exists (scale-cutoff)
    (and
     (posp scale-cutoff)
     (putnam-1982-b2-scale-tail-p
      epsilon radius subdivisions g-terms pi-terms
      scale-cutoff))))

(defun-sk putnam-1982-b2-subdivision-tail-p
    (epsilon radius g-terms pi-terms subdivisions-cutoff)
  (forall (subdivisions)
    (implies
     (and
      (posp subdivisions)
      (<= subdivisions-cutoff subdivisions))
     (putnam-1982-b2-scale-cutoff-exists-p
      epsilon radius subdivisions g-terms pi-terms))))

(defun-sk putnam-1982-b2-subdivision-cutoff-exists-p
    (epsilon radius g-terms pi-terms)
  (exists (subdivisions-cutoff)
    (and
     (posp subdivisions-cutoff)
     (putnam-1982-b2-subdivision-tail-p
      epsilon radius g-terms pi-terms
      subdivisions-cutoff))))

(defun-sk putnam-1982-b2-outer-tail-p
    (epsilon radius-cutoff g-terms-cutoff pi-terms-cutoff)
  (forall (radius g-terms pi-terms)
    (implies
     (and
      (posp radius)
      (<= radius-cutoff radius)
      (posp g-terms)
      (<= g-terms-cutoff g-terms)
      (posp pi-terms)
      (<= pi-terms-cutoff pi-terms))
     (putnam-1982-b2-subdivision-cutoff-exists-p
      epsilon radius g-terms pi-terms))))

(defun-sk putnam-1982-b2-outer-cutoffs-exist-p (epsilon)
  (exists (radius-cutoff g-terms-cutoff pi-terms-cutoff)
    (and
     (posp radius-cutoff)
     (posp g-terms-cutoff)
     (posp pi-terms-cutoff)
     (putnam-1982-b2-outer-tail-p
      epsilon radius-cutoff g-terms-cutoff
      pi-terms-cutoff))))

(defun-sk putnambench-putnam-1982-b2-statement ()
  (forall (epsilon)
    (implies
     (and
      (rationalp epsilon)
      (< 0 epsilon))
     (putnam-1982-b2-outer-cutoffs-exist-p
      epsilon))))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

title: putnam_1982_b2
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1982_b2:
-- the Gaussian-weighted double integral of the number of integer lattice
-- points in a centered disk equals pi times (2g - 1)^2, where g is the
-- Gaussian series over the natural numbers. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Int using (Int; pos; negsuc)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; _*_)

infix 4 _!=_ _<=N_
infixr 3 _and_
infixr 2 _or_

data Bottom : Set where

Not : Set -> Set
Not A =
  A -> Bottom

_!=_ : {A : Set} -> A -> A -> Set
x != y =
  Not (x == y)

record _and_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data _or_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  left  : A -> A or B
  right : B -> A or B

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

record Pair (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor pair
  field
    firstOf  : A
    secondOf : B

open Pair

data _<=N_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set where
  zero<=   : {n : Nat} -> zero <=N n
  suc<=suc : {m n : Nat} -> m <=N n -> suc m <=N suc n

data Fin : Nat -> Set where
  fzero : {n : Nat} -> Fin (suc n)
  fsuc  : {n : Nat} -> Fin n -> Fin (suc n)

record HasCardinality
  {A : Set}
  (P : A -> Set)
  (cardinality : Nat) :
  Set where

  field
    enumerate :
      Fin cardinality ->
      A
    enumerated-member :
      (index : Fin cardinality) ->
      P (enumerate index)
    enumeration-complete :
      (x : A) ->
      P x ->
      Exists (Fin cardinality)
        (\ index -> x == enumerate index)
    enumeration-injective :
      (left-index right-index : Fin cardinality) ->
      enumerate left-index == enumerate right-index ->
      left-index == right-index

record CompleteOrderedRealField (R : Set) : Set1 where
  field
    zeroR oneR : R
    add multiply : R -> R -> R
    negate inverse : R -> R
    lessOrEqual : R -> R -> Set
    fromNat : Nat -> R

    one-not-zero :
      oneR != zeroR

    add-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> add x y == add y x
    add-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      add (add x y) z == add x (add y z)
    add-zero :
      (x : R) -> add x zeroR == x
    add-inverse :
      (x : R) -> add x (negate x) == zeroR

    multiply-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> multiply x y == multiply y x
    multiply-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply (multiply x y) z ==
      multiply x (multiply y z)
    multiply-one :
      (x : R) -> multiply x oneR == x
    multiply-zero :
      (x : R) -> multiply x zeroR == zeroR
    distribute :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply x (add y z) ==
      add (multiply x y) (multiply x z)
    inverse-zero :
      inverse zeroR == zeroR
    multiply-inverse :
      (x : R) ->
      x != zeroR ->
      multiply x (inverse x) == oneR

    order-reflexive :
      (x : R) -> lessOrEqual x x
    order-transitive :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y z ->
      lessOrEqual x z
    order-antisymmetric :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y x ->
      x == y
    order-total :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y or lessOrEqual y x
    add-order :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual (add z x) (add z y)
    multiply-nonnegative :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR x ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR y ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR (multiply x y)
    zero-less-than-one :
      lessOrEqual zeroR oneR and zeroR != oneR

    fromNat-zero :
      fromNat zero == zeroR
    fromNat-successor :
      (n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (suc n) == add (fromNat n) oneR
    fromNat-addition :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m + n) == add (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-multiplication :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m * n) == multiply (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-injective :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat m == fromNat n ->
      m == n

    archimedean :
      (x : R) ->
      Exists Nat (\ n -> lessOrEqual x (fromNat n))
    least-upper-bound :
      (P : R -> Set) ->
      Exists R P ->
      Exists R
        (\ upper ->
          (x : R) ->
          P x ->
          lessOrEqual x upper) ->
      Exists R
        (\ supremum ->
          ((x : R) ->
            P x ->
            lessOrEqual x supremum)
          and
          ((upper : R) ->
            ((x : R) ->
              P x ->
              lessOrEqual x upper) ->
            lessOrEqual supremum upper))

open CompleteOrderedRealField

oneN : Nat
oneN =
  suc zero

twoN : Nat
twoN =
  suc oneN

fourN : Nat
fourN =
  twoN + twoN

subtract :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
subtract reals x y =
  add reals x (negate reals y)

divide :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
divide reals x y =
  multiply reals x (inverse reals y)

square :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R
square reals x =
  multiply reals x x

StrictLess :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
StrictLess reals x y =
  lessOrEqual reals x y and x != y

CloseTo :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
CloseTo reals center radius x =
  StrictLess reals
    (subtract reals center radius)
    x
  and
  StrictLess reals
    x
    (add reals center radius)

integerToReal :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Int ->
  R
integerToReal reals (pos n) =
  fromNat reals n
integerToReal reals (negsuc n) =
  negate reals (fromNat reals (suc n))

naturalPower :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  Nat ->
  R
naturalPower reals x zero =
  oneR reals
naturalPower reals x (suc n) =
  multiply reals
    (naturalPower reals x n)
    x

factorial : Nat -> Nat
factorial zero =
  oneN
factorial (suc n) =
  suc n * factorial n

sumFirst :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Nat ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  R
sumFirst reals zero terms =
  zeroR reals
sumFirst reals (suc n) terms =
  add reals
    (sumFirst reals n terms)
    (terms n)

ConvergesTo :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  R ->
  Set
ConvergesTo {R} reals sequence limit =
  (epsilon : R) ->
  StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) epsilon ->
  Exists Nat
    (\ cutoff ->
      (n : Nat) ->
      cutoff <=N n ->
      CloseTo reals limit epsilon (sequence n))

SeriesHasSum :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  R ->
  Set
SeriesHasSum reals terms limit =
  ConvergesTo reals
    (\ n -> sumFirst reals n terms)
    limit

alternatingPower :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Nat ->
  R
alternatingPower reals n =
  naturalPower reals
    (negate reals (oneR reals))
    n

exponentialTerm :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  Nat ->
  R
exponentialTerm reals x n =
  divide reals
    (naturalPower reals x n)
    (fromNat reals (factorial n))

leibnizTerm :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Nat ->
  R
leibnizTerm reals n =
  divide reals
    (alternatingPower reals n)
    (fromNat reals (suc (twoN * n)))

record PiValue
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R)
  (value : R) :
  Set where

  field
    positive :
      StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) value
    leibniz-series :
      SeriesHasSum reals
        (leibnizTerm reals)
        (divide reals value (fromNat reals fourN))

record StandardRealAnalysis
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) :
  Set1 where

  field
    exponential : R -> R
    pi : R

    exponential-series :
      (x : R) ->
      SeriesHasSum reals
        (exponentialTerm reals x)
        (exponential x)

    pi-value :
      PiValue reals pi

open StandardRealAnalysis

midpointRiemannSum :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  (R -> R) ->
  Nat ->
  R
midpointRiemannSum reals lower upper function pieces =
  let
    step =
      divide reals
        (subtract reals upper lower)
        (fromNat reals pieces)
    halfStep =
      divide reals
        step
        (fromNat reals twoN)
  in
  sumFirst reals pieces
    (\ i ->
      multiply reals
        (function
          (add reals lower
            (add reals
              (multiply reals
                (fromNat reals i)
                step)
              halfStep)))
        step)

IntervalIntegralValue :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  (R -> R) ->
  R ->
  Set
IntervalIntegralValue reals lower upper function value =
  ConvergesTo reals
    (\ n ->
      midpointRiemannSum reals
        lower
        upper
        function
        (suc n))
    value

WholeLineIntegralValue :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (R -> R) ->
  R ->
  Set
WholeLineIntegralValue {R} reals function value =
  Exists (Nat -> R)
    (\ partialIntegrals ->
      ((n : Nat) ->
        IntervalIntegralValue reals
          (negate reals (fromNat reals n))
          (fromNat reals n)
          function
          (partialIntegrals n))
      and
      ConvergesTo reals partialIntegrals value)

record IteratedWholeLineIntegralValue
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R)
  (function : R -> R -> R)
  (value : R) :
  Set where

  field
    innerValues :
      R ->
      R
    inner-integrals :
      (y : R) ->
      WholeLineIntegralValue reals
        (\ x -> function x y)
        (innerValues y)
    outer-integral :
      WholeLineIntegralValue reals
        innerValues
        value

LatticePointCount :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (R -> R -> Nat) ->
  Set
LatticePointCount {R} reals A =
  (x y : R) ->
  HasCardinality
    (\ latticePoint ->
      lessOrEqual reals
        (add reals
          (square reals
            (integerToReal reals (firstOf latticePoint)))
          (square reals
            (integerToReal reals (secondOf latticePoint))))
        (add reals
          (square reals x)
          (square reals y)))
    (A x y)

module Putnam1982B2Statement
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R)
  (analysis : StandardRealAnalysis reals)
  (A : R -> R -> Nat) where

  gaussianSeriesTerm :
    Nat ->
    R
  gaussianSeriesTerm n =
    exponential analysis
      (negate reals
        (square reals (fromNat reals n)))

  integrand :
    R ->
    R ->
    R
  integrand x y =
    multiply reals
      (fromNat reals (A x y))
      (exponential analysis
        (negate reals
          (add reals
            (square reals x)
            (square reals y))))

  solution :
    R ->
    R
  solution g =
    multiply reals
      (pi analysis)
      (square reals
        (subtract reals
          (multiply reals
            (fromNat reals twoN)
            g)
          (oneR reals)))

putnam-1982-b2 : Set1
putnam-1982-b2 =
  (R : Set) ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) ->
  (analysis : StandardRealAnalysis reals) ->
  (A : R -> R -> Nat) ->
  (g I : R) ->
  LatticePointCount reals A ->
  SeriesHasSum reals
    (Putnam1982B2Statement.gaussianSeriesTerm reals analysis A)
    g ->
  IteratedWholeLineIntegralValue reals
    (Putnam1982B2Statement.integrand reals analysis A)
    I ->
  I ==
  Putnam1982B2Statement.solution reals analysis A g
