(*
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench artifact putnam_1982_b5:
  convergence of the iterated logarithm-base sequence for x greater than
  e^e and continuity of its real limit function. This file contains no proof.
*)

let statement =
  `let domain = {x:real | exp (exp (&1)) < x} in
   let converges_to =
     \(u:num->real) (l:real).
       !e:real.
         &0 < e
         ==> ?N:num.
               !n:num. N <= n ==> abs (u n - l) < e in
   let continuous_on =
     \(g:real->real) (s:real->bool).
       !x:real.
         x IN s
         ==> !e:real.
               &0 < e
               ==> ?d:real.
                     &0 < d /\
                     !y:real.
                       y IN s /\ abs (y - x) < d
                       ==> abs (g y - g x) < e in
   !S:real->num->real.
     (!x:real.
        x IN domain
        ==> S x 0 = exp (&1) /\
            (!n:num. S x (n + 1) = ln x / ln (S x n)))
     ==> (!x:real.
            x IN domain
            ==> ?L:real. converges_to (S x) L) /\
         (!g:real->real.
            (!x:real. x IN domain ==> converges_to (S x) (g x))
            ==> continuous_on g domain)`;;

title: putnam_1982_b5
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1982_b5:
;; iterated real logarithms for x > e^e converge, and their pointwise limit
;; function is continuous on that open interval. This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))

;; The context presents a Dedekind-complete ordered field, hence the real
;; field up to ordered-field isomorphism. Its exponential is characterized by
;; E' = E and E(0) = 1, and its logarithm by the standard real extension of
;; the inverse of E. Tame APPLY$ objects retain the source's arbitrary
;; real-valued sequence and limit function. All limits and continuity claims
;; are expanded into their epsilon definitions.

(defun p82b5-member-p (carrier x)
  (if (apply$ carrier (list x)) t nil))

(defun p82b5-unary-value (function x)
  (apply$ function (list x)))

(defun p82b5-binary-value (function x y)
  (apply$ function (list x y)))

(defun-sk p82b5-valid-set-p (carrier set)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (apply$ set (list x))
     (p82b5-member-p carrier x))))

(defun-sk p82b5-real-function-p (carrier function)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (p82b5-member-p carrier x)
     (p82b5-member-p
      carrier
      (p82b5-unary-value function x)))))

(defun-sk p82b5-real-sequence-family-p (carrier sequence)
  (forall (x n)
    (implies
     (and
      (p82b5-member-p carrier x)
      (natp n))
     (p82b5-member-p
      carrier
      (p82b5-binary-value sequence x n)))))

(defun-sk p82b5-field-laws-p
    (carrier add multiply negate inverse zero one)
  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (p82b5-member-p carrier x)
      (p82b5-member-p carrier y)
      (p82b5-member-p carrier z))
     (and
      (p82b5-member-p carrier
                      (p82b5-binary-value add x y))
      (p82b5-member-p carrier
                      (p82b5-binary-value multiply x y))
      (p82b5-member-p carrier
                      (p82b5-unary-value negate x))
      (p82b5-member-p carrier
                      (p82b5-unary-value inverse x))
      (equal
       (p82b5-binary-value
        add (p82b5-binary-value add x y) z)
       (p82b5-binary-value
        add x (p82b5-binary-value add y z)))
      (equal
       (p82b5-binary-value add x y)
       (p82b5-binary-value add y x))
      (equal (p82b5-binary-value add x zero) x)
      (equal
       (p82b5-binary-value
        add x (p82b5-unary-value negate x))
       zero)
      (equal
       (p82b5-binary-value
        multiply (p82b5-binary-value multiply x y) z)
       (p82b5-binary-value
        multiply x (p82b5-binary-value multiply y z)))
      (equal
       (p82b5-binary-value multiply x y)
       (p82b5-binary-value multiply y x))
      (equal (p82b5-binary-value multiply x one) x)
      (implies
       (equal x zero)
       (equal (p82b5-unary-value inverse x) zero))
      (implies
       (not (equal x zero))
       (equal
        (p82b5-binary-value
         multiply x (p82b5-unary-value inverse x))
        one))
      (equal
       (p82b5-binary-value
        multiply x (p82b5-binary-value add y z))
       (p82b5-binary-value
        add
        (p82b5-binary-value multiply x y)
        (p82b5-binary-value multiply x z)))))))

(defun-sk p82b5-order-laws-p
    (carrier add multiply zero less)
  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (p82b5-member-p carrier x)
      (p82b5-member-p carrier y)
      (p82b5-member-p carrier z))
     (and
      (not (p82b5-binary-value less x x))
      (or
       (equal x y)
       (p82b5-binary-value less x y)
       (p82b5-binary-value less y x))
      (implies
       (and
        (p82b5-binary-value less x y)
        (p82b5-binary-value less y z))
       (p82b5-binary-value less x z))
      (implies
       (p82b5-binary-value less x y)
       (p82b5-binary-value
        less
        (p82b5-binary-value add x z)
        (p82b5-binary-value add y z)))
      (implies
       (and
        (p82b5-binary-value less zero x)
        (p82b5-binary-value less zero y))
       (p82b5-binary-value
        less zero (p82b5-binary-value multiply x y)))))))

(defun-sk p82b5-set-nonempty-p (carrier set)
  (exists (x)
    (and
     (p82b5-member-p carrier x)
     (apply$ set (list x)))))

(defun-sk p82b5-upper-bound-p
    (carrier less set bound)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (and
      (p82b5-member-p carrier x)
      (apply$ set (list x)))
     (not (p82b5-binary-value less bound x)))))

(defun-sk p82b5-bounded-above-p
    (carrier less set)
  (exists (bound)
    (and
     (p82b5-member-p carrier bound)
     (p82b5-upper-bound-p
      carrier less set bound))))

(defun-sk p82b5-least-upper-bound-p
    (carrier less set supremum)
  (forall (bound)
    (implies
     (and
      (p82b5-member-p carrier bound)
      (p82b5-upper-bound-p carrier less set bound))
     (not (p82b5-binary-value less bound supremum)))))

(defun p82b5-supremum-p
    (carrier less set supremum)
  (and
   (p82b5-member-p carrier supremum)
   (p82b5-upper-bound-p carrier less set supremum)
   (p82b5-least-upper-bound-p
    carrier less set supremum)))

(defun-sk p82b5-has-supremum-p
    (carrier less set)
  (exists (supremum)
    (p82b5-supremum-p
     carrier less set supremum)))

(defun-sk p82b5-dedekind-complete-p
    (carrier less)
  (forall (set)
    (implies
     (and
      (tamep-functionp set)
      (p82b5-valid-set-p carrier set)
      (p82b5-set-nonempty-p carrier set)
      (p82b5-bounded-above-p carrier less set))
     (p82b5-has-supremum-p carrier less set))))

(defun p82b5-real-field-p
    (carrier zero one add multiply negate inverse less)
  (and
   (tamep-functionp carrier)
   (tamep-functionp add)
   (tamep-functionp multiply)
   (tamep-functionp negate)
   (tamep-functionp inverse)
   (tamep-functionp less)
   (p82b5-member-p carrier zero)
   (p82b5-member-p carrier one)
   (not (equal zero one))
   (p82b5-field-laws-p
    carrier add multiply negate inverse zero one)
   (p82b5-order-laws-p
    carrier add multiply zero less)
   (p82b5-binary-value less zero one)
   (p82b5-dedekind-complete-p carrier less)))

;; The outer context is (field-context exponential logarithm).

(defun p82b5-field-context (ctx)
  (nth 0 ctx))

(defun p82b5-r-carrier (ctx)
  (nth 0 (p82b5-field-context ctx)))

(defun p82b5-r-zero (ctx)
  (nth 1 (p82b5-field-context ctx)))

(defun p82b5-r-one (ctx)
  (nth 2 (p82b5-field-context ctx)))

(defun p82b5-r-add (ctx)
  (nth 3 (p82b5-field-context ctx)))

(defun p82b5-r-mul (ctx)
  (nth 4 (p82b5-field-context ctx)))

(defun p82b5-r-neg (ctx)
  (nth 5 (p82b5-field-context ctx)))

(defun p82b5-r-inv (ctx)
  (nth 6 (p82b5-field-context ctx)))

(defun p82b5-r-lt (ctx)
  (nth 7 (p82b5-field-context ctx)))

(defun p82b5-r-exp (ctx)
  (nth 1 ctx))

(defun p82b5-r-log (ctx)
  (nth 2 ctx))

(defun p82b5-field-context-p (field-context)
  (and
   (true-listp field-context)
   (equal (len field-context) 8)
   (p82b5-real-field-p
    (nth 0 field-context)
    (nth 1 field-context)
    (nth 2 field-context)
    (nth 3 field-context)
    (nth 4 field-context)
    (nth 5 field-context)
    (nth 6 field-context)
    (nth 7 field-context))))

(defun p82b5-r-add-value (ctx x y)
  (p82b5-binary-value (p82b5-r-add ctx) x y))

(defun p82b5-r-neg-value (ctx x)
  (p82b5-unary-value (p82b5-r-neg ctx) x))

(defun p82b5-r-sub-value (ctx x y)
  (p82b5-r-add-value
   ctx x (p82b5-r-neg-value ctx y)))

(defun p82b5-r-mul-value (ctx x y)
  (p82b5-binary-value (p82b5-r-mul ctx) x y))

(defun p82b5-r-inv-value (ctx x)
  (p82b5-unary-value (p82b5-r-inv ctx) x))

(defun p82b5-r-div-value (ctx numerator denominator)
  (p82b5-r-mul-value
   ctx numerator (p82b5-r-inv-value ctx denominator)))

(defun p82b5-r-lt-p (ctx x y)
  (if (p82b5-binary-value (p82b5-r-lt ctx) x y)
      t nil))

(defun p82b5-r-le-p (ctx x y)
  (not (p82b5-r-lt-p ctx y x)))

(defun p82b5-r-abs-value (ctx x)
  (if (p82b5-r-lt-p ctx x (p82b5-r-zero ctx))
      (p82b5-r-neg-value ctx x)
    x))

(defun p82b5-positive-real-p (ctx x)
  (and
   (p82b5-member-p (p82b5-r-carrier ctx) x)
   (p82b5-r-lt-p ctx (p82b5-r-zero ctx) x)))

;; Epsilon-delta differentiability over the presented real field.

(defun-sk p82b5-derivative-neighborhood-p
    (ctx function derivative x epsilon radius)
  (forall (y)
    (implies
     (and
      (p82b5-member-p (p82b5-r-carrier ctx) y)
      (p82b5-r-lt-p
       ctx
       (p82b5-r-abs-value
        ctx (p82b5-r-sub-value ctx y x))
       radius))
     (p82b5-r-le-p
      ctx
      (p82b5-r-abs-value
       ctx
       (p82b5-r-sub-value
        ctx
        (p82b5-r-sub-value
         ctx
         (p82b5-unary-value function y)
         (p82b5-unary-value function x))
        (p82b5-r-mul-value
         ctx derivative
         (p82b5-r-sub-value ctx y x))))
      (p82b5-r-mul-value
       ctx epsilon
       (p82b5-r-abs-value
        ctx (p82b5-r-sub-value ctx y x)))))))

(defun-sk p82b5-derivative-radius-exists-p
    (ctx function derivative x epsilon)
  (exists (radius)
    (and
     (p82b5-positive-real-p ctx radius)
     (p82b5-derivative-neighborhood-p
      ctx function derivative x epsilon radius))))

(defun-sk p82b5-has-derivative-at-p
    (ctx function derivative x)
  (forall (epsilon)
    (implies
     (p82b5-positive-real-p ctx epsilon)
     (p82b5-derivative-radius-exists-p
      ctx function derivative x epsilon))))

(defun-sk p82b5-global-derivative-values-p
    (ctx function derivative-function)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (p82b5-member-p (p82b5-r-carrier ctx) x)
     (p82b5-has-derivative-at-p
      ctx
      function
      (p82b5-unary-value derivative-function x)
      x))))

(defun p82b5-global-derivative-function-p
    (ctx function derivative-function)
  (and
   (tamep-functionp function)
   (tamep-functionp derivative-function)
   (p82b5-real-function-p
    (p82b5-r-carrier ctx) function)
   (p82b5-real-function-p
    (p82b5-r-carrier ctx) derivative-function)
   (p82b5-global-derivative-values-p
    ctx function derivative-function)))

(defun p82b5-exponential-function-p (ctx exponential)
  (and
   (p82b5-global-derivative-function-p
    ctx exponential exponential)
   (equal
    (p82b5-unary-value exponential (p82b5-r-zero ctx))
    (p82b5-r-one ctx))))

;; Real.log is zero at zero, even under negation, and is the inverse of exp
;; on the positive reals. These equations characterize the total real
;; logarithm used by Real.logb in the source statement.

(defun-sk p82b5-logarithm-laws-p
    (ctx exponential logarithm)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (p82b5-member-p (p82b5-r-carrier ctx) x)
     (and
      (p82b5-member-p
       (p82b5-r-carrier ctx)
       (p82b5-unary-value logarithm x))
      (p82b5-positive-real-p
       ctx (p82b5-unary-value exponential x))
      (equal
       (p82b5-unary-value
        logarithm (p82b5-unary-value exponential x))
       x)
      (implies
       (equal x (p82b5-r-zero ctx))
       (equal
        (p82b5-unary-value logarithm x)
        (p82b5-r-zero ctx)))
      (implies
       (p82b5-r-lt-p ctx x (p82b5-r-zero ctx))
       (equal
        (p82b5-unary-value logarithm x)
        (p82b5-unary-value
         logarithm (p82b5-r-neg-value ctx x))))
      (implies
       (p82b5-positive-real-p ctx x)
       (equal
        (p82b5-unary-value
         exponential (p82b5-unary-value logarithm x))
        x))))))

(defun p82b5-context-p (ctx)
  (and
   (true-listp ctx)
   (equal (len ctx) 3)
   (p82b5-field-context-p (p82b5-field-context ctx))
   (tamep-functionp (p82b5-r-exp ctx))
   (tamep-functionp (p82b5-r-log ctx))
   (p82b5-exponential-function-p
    ctx (p82b5-r-exp ctx))
   (p82b5-logarithm-laws-p
    ctx (p82b5-r-exp ctx) (p82b5-r-log ctx))))

(defun p82b5-e-value (ctx)
  (p82b5-unary-value
   (p82b5-r-exp ctx) (p82b5-r-one ctx)))

(defun p82b5-threshold (ctx)
  (p82b5-unary-value
   (p82b5-r-exp ctx) (p82b5-e-value ctx)))

(defun p82b5-domain-p (ctx x)
  (and
   (p82b5-member-p (p82b5-r-carrier ctx) x)
   (p82b5-r-lt-p ctx (p82b5-threshold ctx) x)))

(defun p82b5-log-base-value (ctx base x)
  (p82b5-r-div-value
   ctx
   (p82b5-unary-value (p82b5-r-log ctx) x)
   (p82b5-unary-value (p82b5-r-log ctx) base)))

;; The source recurrence u_0 = e and u_(n+1) = log_(u_n)(x).

(defun-sk p82b5-recurrence-at-x-p (ctx sequence x)
  (forall (n)
    (implies
     (natp n)
     (equal
      (p82b5-binary-value sequence x (+ n 1))
      (p82b5-log-base-value
       ctx
       (p82b5-binary-value sequence x n)
       x)))))

(defun-sk p82b5-recurrence-p (ctx sequence)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (p82b5-domain-p ctx x)
     (and
      (equal
       (p82b5-binary-value sequence x 0)
       (p82b5-e-value ctx))
      (p82b5-recurrence-at-x-p
       ctx sequence x)))))

;; Sequential convergence S(x,n) -> limit.

(defun-sk p82b5-convergence-tail-p
    (ctx sequence x limit epsilon cutoff)
  (forall (n)
    (implies
     (and
      (natp n)
      (<= cutoff n))
     (p82b5-r-lt-p
      ctx
      (p82b5-r-abs-value
       ctx
       (p82b5-r-sub-value
        ctx
        (p82b5-binary-value sequence x n)
        limit))
      epsilon))))

(defun-sk p82b5-convergence-cutoff-exists-p
    (ctx sequence x limit epsilon)
  (exists (cutoff)
    (and
     (natp cutoff)
     (p82b5-convergence-tail-p
      ctx sequence x limit epsilon cutoff))))

(defun-sk p82b5-converges-to-p
    (ctx sequence x limit)
  (forall (epsilon)
    (implies
     (p82b5-positive-real-p ctx epsilon)
     (p82b5-convergence-cutoff-exists-p
      ctx sequence x limit epsilon))))

(defun-sk p82b5-limit-exists-p
    (ctx sequence x)
  (exists (limit)
    (and
     (p82b5-member-p (p82b5-r-carrier ctx) limit)
     (p82b5-converges-to-p
      ctx sequence x limit))))

(defun-sk p82b5-pointwise-limit-p
    (ctx sequence g)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (p82b5-domain-p ctx x)
     (p82b5-converges-to-p
      ctx sequence x (p82b5-unary-value g x)))))

;; Epsilon-delta continuity of g relative to the open domain x > e^e.

(defun-sk p82b5-continuity-neighborhood-p
    (ctx g x epsilon radius)
  (forall (y)
    (implies
     (and
      (p82b5-domain-p ctx y)
      (p82b5-r-lt-p
       ctx
       (p82b5-r-abs-value
        ctx (p82b5-r-sub-value ctx y x))
       radius))
     (p82b5-r-lt-p
      ctx
      (p82b5-r-abs-value
       ctx
       (p82b5-r-sub-value
        ctx
        (p82b5-unary-value g y)
        (p82b5-unary-value g x)))
      epsilon))))

(defun-sk p82b5-continuity-radius-exists-p
    (ctx g x epsilon)
  (exists (radius)
    (and
     (p82b5-positive-real-p ctx radius)
     (p82b5-continuity-neighborhood-p
      ctx g x epsilon radius))))

(defun-sk p82b5-continuous-within-at-p
    (ctx g x)
  (forall (epsilon)
    (implies
     (p82b5-positive-real-p ctx epsilon)
     (p82b5-continuity-radius-exists-p
      ctx g x epsilon))))

(defun-sk p82b5-continuous-on-domain-p (ctx g)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (p82b5-domain-p ctx x)
     (p82b5-continuous-within-at-p
      ctx g x))))

;; The source has two conclusions: the recurrence converges at every point of
;; the domain, and any function g to which it converges pointwise is continuous
;; on that domain.

(defun-sk p82b5-all-limits-exist-p (ctx sequence)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (p82b5-domain-p ctx x)
     (p82b5-limit-exists-p ctx sequence x))))

(defun p82b5-source-conclusion-p (ctx sequence g)
  (and
   (p82b5-all-limits-exist-p ctx sequence)
   (implies
    (p82b5-pointwise-limit-p ctx sequence g)
    (p82b5-continuous-on-domain-p ctx g))))

(defun putnambench-putnam-1982-b5-statement
    (ctx sequence g)
  (implies
   (and
    (p82b5-context-p ctx)
    (tamep-functionp sequence)
    (tamep-functionp g)
    (p82b5-real-sequence-family-p
     (p82b5-r-carrier ctx) sequence)
    (p82b5-real-function-p
     (p82b5-r-carrier ctx) g)
    (p82b5-recurrence-p ctx sequence))
   (p82b5-source-conclusion-p
    ctx sequence g)))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

title: putnam_1982_b5
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1982_b5:
-- convergence of logarithmic iteration for x greater than e^e and continuity
-- of the resulting limit function. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module Putnam1982B5 where

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; _*_)

infix 4 _!=_ _<=N_
infixr 3 _and_
infixr 2 _or_

data Bottom : Set where

Not : Set -> Set
Not A =
  A -> Bottom

_!=_ : {A : Set} -> A -> A -> Set
x != y =
  Not (x == y)

record _and_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data _or_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  left  : A -> A or B
  right : B -> A or B

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

data _<=N_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set where
  zero<=N   : {n : Nat} -> zero <=N n
  suc<=sucN : {m n : Nat} -> m <=N n -> suc m <=N suc n

record CompleteOrderedRealField (R : Set) : Set1 where
  field
    zeroR oneR : R
    add multiply : R -> R -> R
    negate inverse : R -> R
    lessOrEqual : R -> R -> Set
    fromNat : Nat -> R

    one-not-zero :
      oneR != zeroR

    add-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> add x y == add y x
    add-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      add (add x y) z == add x (add y z)
    add-zero :
      (x : R) -> add x zeroR == x
    add-inverse :
      (x : R) -> add x (negate x) == zeroR

    multiply-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> multiply x y == multiply y x
    multiply-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply (multiply x y) z ==
      multiply x (multiply y z)
    multiply-one :
      (x : R) -> multiply x oneR == x
    multiply-zero :
      (x : R) -> multiply x zeroR == zeroR
    distribute :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply x (add y z) ==
      add (multiply x y) (multiply x z)
    inverse-zero :
      inverse zeroR == zeroR
    multiply-inverse :
      (x : R) ->
      x != zeroR ->
      multiply x (inverse x) == oneR

    order-reflexive :
      (x : R) -> lessOrEqual x x
    order-transitive :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y z ->
      lessOrEqual x z
    order-antisymmetric :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y x ->
      x == y
    order-total :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y or lessOrEqual y x
    add-order :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual (add z x) (add z y)
    multiply-nonnegative :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR x ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR y ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR (multiply x y)
    zero-less-than-one :
      lessOrEqual zeroR oneR and zeroR != oneR

    fromNat-zero :
      fromNat zero == zeroR
    fromNat-successor :
      (n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (suc n) == add (fromNat n) oneR
    fromNat-addition :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m + n) == add (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-multiplication :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m * n) == multiply (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-injective :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat m == fromNat n ->
      m == n

    archimedean :
      (x : R) ->
      Exists Nat (\ n -> lessOrEqual x (fromNat n))
    least-upper-bound :
      (P : R -> Set) ->
      Exists R P ->
      Exists R
        (\ upper ->
          (x : R) ->
          P x ->
          lessOrEqual x upper) ->
      Exists R
        (\ supremum ->
          ((x : R) ->
            P x ->
            lessOrEqual x supremum)
          and
          ((upper : R) ->
            ((x : R) ->
              P x ->
              lessOrEqual x upper) ->
            lessOrEqual supremum upper))

open CompleteOrderedRealField

subtract :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
subtract reals x y =
  add reals x (negate reals y)

divide :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
divide reals x y =
  multiply reals x (inverse reals y)

maximum :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
maximum reals x y with order-total reals x y
... | left _ = y
... | right _ = x

absoluteValue :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R
absoluteValue reals x =
  maximum reals x (negate reals x)

StrictLess :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
StrictLess reals x y =
  lessOrEqual reals x y and x != y

Close :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
Close reals center radius x =
  StrictLess reals
    (absoluteValue reals (subtract reals x center))
    radius

naturalPower :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  Nat ->
  R
naturalPower reals x zero =
  oneR reals
naturalPower reals x (suc n) =
  multiply reals
    (naturalPower reals x n)
    x

factorial : Nat -> Nat
factorial zero =
  suc zero
factorial (suc n) =
  suc n * factorial n

sumFirst :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Nat ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  R
sumFirst reals zero term =
  zeroR reals
sumFirst reals (suc n) term =
  add reals
    (sumFirst reals n term)
    (term n)

ConvergesTo :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  R ->
  Set
ConvergesTo {R} reals sequence limit =
  (epsilon : R) ->
  StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) epsilon ->
  Exists Nat
    (\ cutoff ->
      (n : Nat) ->
      cutoff <=N n ->
      Close reals limit epsilon (sequence n))

SeriesHasSum :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  R ->
  Set
SeriesHasSum reals terms limit =
  ConvergesTo reals
    (\ n -> sumFirst reals n terms)
    limit

exponentialTerm :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  Nat ->
  R
exponentialTerm reals x n =
  divide reals
    (naturalPower reals x n)
    (fromNat reals (factorial n))

record StandardExponentialLogarithm
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) :
  Set1 where

  field
    exponential logarithm : R -> R

    exponential-series :
      (x : R) ->
      SeriesHasSum reals
        (exponentialTerm reals x)
        (exponential x)
    exponential-positive :
      (x : R) ->
      StrictLess reals
        (zeroR reals)
        (exponential x)
    logarithm-exponential :
      (x : R) ->
      logarithm (exponential x) == x
    exponential-logarithm :
      (x : R) ->
      StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) x ->
      exponential (logarithm x) == x

open StandardExponentialLogarithm

module Putnam1982B5Statement
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R)
  (transcendentals : StandardExponentialLogarithm reals) where

  e : R
  e =
    exponential transcendentals (oneR reals)

  threshold : R
  threshold =
    exponential transcendentals e

  InDomain : R -> Set
  InDomain x =
    StrictLess reals threshold x

  logarithmBase : R -> R -> R
  logarithmBase base x =
    divide reals
      (logarithm transcendentals x)
      (logarithm transcendentals base)

  SequenceRule : (R -> Nat -> R) -> Set
  SequenceRule sequence =
    (x : R) ->
    InDomain x ->
    (sequence x zero == e)
    and
    ((n : Nat) ->
      sequence x (suc n) ==
      logarithmBase (sequence x n) x)

  ContinuousOn : (R -> R) -> Set
  ContinuousOn function =
    (x : R) ->
    InDomain x ->
    (epsilon : R) ->
    StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) epsilon ->
    Exists R
      (\ delta ->
        StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) delta
        and
        ((y : R) ->
          InDomain y ->
          Close reals x delta y ->
          Close reals (function x) epsilon (function y)))

  proposition : Set
  proposition =
    (sequence : R -> Nat -> R) ->
    SequenceRule sequence ->
    (limitFunction : R -> R) ->
    ((x : R) ->
      InDomain x ->
      Exists R
        (\ limit ->
          ConvergesTo reals (sequence x) limit))
    and
    (((x : R) ->
      InDomain x ->
      ConvergesTo reals
        (sequence x)
        (limitFunction x)) ->
      ContinuousOn limitFunction)

putnam-1982-b5 : Set1
putnam-1982-b5 =
  (R : Set) ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) ->
  (transcendentals : StandardExponentialLogarithm reals) ->
  Putnam1982B5Statement.proposition reals transcendentals

(*
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1982_b5:
  convergence of an iterated logarithm sequence and continuity of its limit
  function for real x greater than exp (exp 1). This file contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open arithmeticTheory pred_setTheory realTheory real_topologyTheory
     transcTheory;

val putnam_1982_b5 =
  ``!S : real -> num -> real.
      (!x : real.
         exp (exp 1) < x
         ==>
         S x 0 = exp 1 /\
         !n : num.
           S x (n + 1) = ln x / ln (S x n))
      ==>
      ?g : real -> real.
        (!x : real.
           exp (exp 1) < x
           ==>
           ((\n : num. S x n) --> g x) sequentially) /\
        g continuous_on {y : real | exp (exp 1) < y}``;

  u_0 = e, u_(n+1) = log base u_n of x for x greater than e^e, and
  continuity of its real limit as a function of x. This file contains no

$(

  The source set T is inlined as the open interval
  ( exp(exp(1)), +infinity ). Real.logb u x and the Rocq recurrence are both
  represented by (log x) / (log u).

  The first conclusion retains the real limit existentially at every x in
  T. The second quantifies over every total real function G whose values are
  those limits and asserts continuity of its restriction to T. Since real
  sequence limits are unique, this is equivalent to continuity of the
  canonical limit function used by the Rocq source. Relative continuity on
  this open interval is equivalent to pointwise real continuity at each of

  The final declaration is the single unproved $a corpus statement; this
  database contains no $p proof statement.

${
  $d G L S n x $.

title: putnam_1982_b5
content:
% Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1982_b5:
% for x greater than e^e, the sequence starting at e and iterating the
% logarithm of x to the preceding base converges, and its limit depends
% continuously on x. This file contains no proof.

putnam_1982_b5: THEORY
BEGIN
  real_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> real]
  real_function: TYPE = [real -> real]

  safe_div(numerator, denominator: real): real =
    IF denominator = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      numerator / denominator
    ENDIF

  converges_to(sequence: real_sequence, value: real): bool =
    FORALL (epsilon_value: posreal):
      EXISTS (cutoff: nat):
        FORALL (index: nat):
          cutoff <= index IMPLIES
            abs(sequence(index) - value) < epsilon_value

  nat_factorial(index: nat): RECURSIVE nat =
    IF index = 0 THEN
      1
    ELSE
      index * nat_factorial(index - 1)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE index

  exponential_partial(x: real, count: nat): RECURSIVE real =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      LET index: nat = count - 1 IN
        exponential_partial(x, count - 1)
          + safe_div(
              x ^ index,
              nat_factorial(index) :: real)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  real_exponential(x: real): real =
    epsilon(
      LAMBDA (value: real):
        converges_to(
          LAMBDA (count: nat):
            exponential_partial(x, count),
          value))

  natural_log(x: real): real =
    IF x > 0 THEN
      epsilon(
        LAMBDA (value: real):
          real_exponential(value) = x)
    ELSE
      0
    ENDIF

  log_with_base(base, argument: real): real =
    safe_div(natural_log(argument), natural_log(base))

  iterated_log_sequence(x: real, index: nat): RECURSIVE real =
    IF index = 0 THEN
      real_exponential(1)
    ELSE
      log_with_base(
        iterated_log_sequence(x, index - 1),
        x)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE index

  in_domain(x: real): bool =
    x > real_exponential(real_exponential(1))

  limit_function(x: real): real =
    epsilon(
      LAMBDA (value: real):
        converges_to(
          LAMBDA (index: nat):
            iterated_log_sequence(x, index),
          value))

  continuous_on_domain(f: real_function): bool =
    FORALL (x: real):
      in_domain(x) IMPLIES
        FORALL (epsilon_value: posreal):
          EXISTS (delta: posreal):
            FORALL (y: real):
              (in_domain(y) AND abs(y - x) < delta)
                IMPLIES abs(f(y) - f(x)) < epsilon_value

  putnam_1982_b5: bool =
    (FORALL (x: real):
      in_domain(x) IMPLIES
        EXISTS (limit_value: real):
          converges_to(
            LAMBDA (index: nat):
              iterated_log_sequence(x, index),
            limit_value))
      AND continuous_on_domain(limit_function)
END putnam_1982_b5

;; exactly 2301 positive integers divide at least one of 10^40 and 20^30.
;; This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

;; Every positive divisor of either fixed number is at most that number, and
;; 20^30 < 10^40. Thus counting through 10^40 is exactly the cardinality of
;; the source set, not a restriction of its domain.
(defun putnam-1983-a1-divisor-of-either-p (n)
  (and
   (posp n)
   (or (equal (mod (expt 10 40) n) 0)
       (equal (mod (expt 20 30) n) 0))))

(defun putnam-1983-a1-count-through (candidate)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix candidate)))
  (if (zp candidate)
      0
    (+ (if (putnam-1983-a1-divisor-of-either-p candidate)
           1
         0)
       (putnam-1983-a1-count-through (- candidate 1)))))

(defun putnambench-putnam-1983-a1-statement ()
  (equal
   (putnam-1983-a1-count-through (expt 10 40))
   2301))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

-- exactly 2301 positive integers divide at least one of 10^40 and 20^30.
-- This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _*_)

infixr 3 _and_
infixr 2 _or_

record _and_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data _or_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  left  : A -> A or B
  right : B -> A or B

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

data Positive : Nat -> Set where
  positive : {n : Nat} -> Positive (suc n)

data Fin : Nat -> Set where
  fzero : {n : Nat} -> Fin (suc n)
  fsuc  : {n : Nat} -> Fin n -> Fin (suc n)

record HasCardinality
  {A : Set}
  (P : A -> Set)
  (cardinality : Nat) :
  Set where

  field
    enumerate :
      Fin cardinality ->
      A
    enumerated-member :
      (index : Fin cardinality) ->
      P (enumerate index)
    enumeration-complete :
      (x : A) ->
      P x ->
      Exists (Fin cardinality)
        (\ index -> x == enumerate index)
    enumeration-injective :
      (left-index right-index : Fin cardinality) ->
      enumerate left-index == enumerate right-index ->
      left-index == right-index

one : Nat
one =
  suc zero

power : Nat -> Nat -> Nat
power base zero =
  one
power base (suc exponent) =
  base * power base exponent

Divides : Nat -> Nat -> Set
Divides divisor number =
  Exists Nat
    (\ factor -> divisor * factor == number)

EligibleDivisor : Nat -> Set
EligibleDivisor n =
  Positive n
  and
  (Divides n (power 10 40)
   or
   Divides n (power 20 30))

putnam-1983-a1-solution : Nat
putnam-1983-a1-solution =
  2301

putnam-1983-a1 : Set
putnam-1983-a1 =
  HasCardinality
    EligibleDivisor
    putnam-1983-a1-solution

;; Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1983_a3:
;; for every odd prime p, the polynomial
;; F(n) = 1 + 2*n + 3*n^2 + ... + (p-1)*n^(p-2) takes incongruent values
;; modulo p at distinct residues. This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(defun putnam-1983-a3-no-divisor-through-p (p candidate)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix candidate)))
  (if (or (not (natp candidate))
          (<= candidate 1))
      t
    (and
     (not (equal (mod p candidate) 0))
     (putnam-1983-a3-no-divisor-through-p
      p (- candidate 1)))))

(defun putnam-1983-a3-prime-p (p)
  (and
   (natp p)
   (< 1 p)
   (putnam-1983-a3-no-divisor-through-p
    p (- p 1))))

;; With TERMS = p-1, the descending recursion sums exactly the exponents
;; 0,...,p-2 in the source definition of F.
(defun putnam-1983-a3-polynomial-sum (n terms)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix terms)))
  (if (zp terms)
      0
    (let ((index (- terms 1)))
      (+ (* terms (expt n index))
         (putnam-1983-a3-polynomial-sum
          n index)))))

(defun putnam-1983-a3-polynomial (p n)
  (if (natp p)
      (putnam-1983-a3-polynomial-sum
       n (- p 1))
    0))

;; The ground truths use the complete residue systems {0,...,p-1} and
;; {1,...,p}. This predicate uses the former; replacing residue 0 by p leaves
;; every integer-coefficient polynomial value unchanged modulo p.
(defun putnambench-putnam-1983-a3-statement (p a b)
  (implies
   (and
    (putnam-1983-a3-prime-p p)
    (equal (mod p 2) 1)
    (natp a)
    (< a p)
    (natp b)
    (< b p)
    (not (equal a b)))
   (not
    (equal
     (mod (putnam-1983-a3-polynomial p a) p)
     (mod (putnam-1983-a3-polynomial p b) p)))))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

-- Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1983_a3:
-- for an odd prime p, the polynomial with coefficient i + 1 on n^i is
-- injective modulo p on a complete residue system. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using
  (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; _-_; _*_; mod-helper)

infix 4 _<=_ _<_ _!=_ _divides_
infixr 2 _or_

data Bottom : Set where

Not : Set -> Set
Not A =
  A -> Bottom

_!=_ : {A : Set} -> A -> A -> Set
x != y =
  Not (x == y)

data _<=_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set where
  zero<= : {n : Nat} -> zero <= n
  suc<=suc : {m n : Nat} -> m <= n -> suc m <= suc n

_<_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set
m < n =
  suc m <= n

data _or_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  left  : A -> A or B
  right : B -> A or B

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

record _divides_ (divisor dividend : Nat) : Set where
  field
    quotient          : Nat
    division-equation : dividend == divisor * quotient

one : Nat
one =
  suc zero

two : Nat
two =
  suc one

record Prime (p : Nat) : Set where
  field
    at-least-two : two <= p
    only-trivial-divisors :
      (d : Nat) ->
      d divides p ->
      (d == one) or (d == p)

Odd : Nat -> Set
Odd p =
  Exists Nat
    (\ k -> p == two * k + one)

power : Nat -> Nat -> Nat
power base zero =
  one
power base (suc exponent) =
  base * power base exponent

sumFirst : Nat -> (Nat -> Nat) -> Nat
sumFirst zero term =
  zero
sumFirst (suc count) term =
  sumFirst count term + term count

polynomialValue : Nat -> Nat -> Nat
polynomialValue p n =
  sumFirst (p - one)
    (\ i -> (i + one) * power n i)

naturalMod : Nat -> Nat -> Nat
naturalMod numerator zero =
  numerator
naturalMod numerator (suc denominator) =
  mod-helper zero denominator numerator denominator

ModEq : Nat -> Nat -> Nat -> Set
ModEq modulus left-value right-value =
  naturalMod left-value modulus == naturalMod right-value modulus

putnam-1983-a3 : Set
putnam-1983-a3 =
  (p : Nat) ->
  (F : Nat -> Nat) ->
  Odd p ->
  Prime p ->
  ((n : Nat) -> F n == polynomialValue p n) ->
  (a b : Nat) ->
  a < p ->
  b < p ->
  a != b ->
  Not (ModEq p (F a) (F b))

$(
  NN0 is set.mm's class of nonnegative integers, Prime is its class of
  natural primes, and ( 0 ..^ p ) is the residue representative set
  {0,...,p-1}. The function hypothesis gives
  F(n) = sum_(i=0)^(p-2) (i+1)n^i for every nonnegative integer n.

  sending p to 0) gives the same injectivity statement because the
  polynomial's remainder depends only on its input residue. The final

  contains no $p proof statement.

${
  $d F a b i n p $.

    A. F e. ( NN0 ^m NN0 )

            p e. Prime
            /\
            ( p mod 2 ) = 1

          A. n e. NN0
            ( F ` n )

            sum_ i e. ( 0 ..^ ( p - 1 ) )

          A. b e. ( 0 ..^ p )

              a =/= b

  $.

% Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1983_a3:
% for an odd prime p, the polynomial 1 + 2*n + ... + (p-1)*n^(p-2)
% takes incongruent values modulo p on distinct residues. This file contains no proof.

putnam_1983_a3: THEORY
BEGIN
  nat_divides(divisor: posnat, value: nat): bool =
    EXISTS (quotient: nat):
      value = divisor * quotient

  prime_nat(value: nat): bool =
    value >= 2
      AND FORALL (divisor: posnat):
        nat_divides(divisor, value)
          IMPLIES divisor = 1 OR divisor = value

  odd_nat(value: nat): bool =
    EXISTS (k: nat):
      value = 2 * k + 1

  weighted_power_sum(n, term_count: nat): RECURSIVE nat =
    IF term_count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      LET index: nat = term_count - 1 IN
        weighted_power_sum(n, term_count - 1)
          + term_count * n ^ index
    ENDIF
  MEASURE term_count

  putnam_1983_a3: bool =
    FORALL (p: nat), (F: [nat -> nat]):
      (odd_nat(p)
        AND prime_nat(p)
        AND FORALL (n: nat):
          F(n) = weighted_power_sum(n, p - 1))
      IMPLIES
        FORALL (a, b: nat):
          (a < p AND b < p AND a /= b)
            IMPLIES mod(F(a), p) /= mod(F(b), p)
END putnam_1983_a3

data Bottom : Set where

Not : Set -> Set
Not A =

_!=_ : {A : Set} -> A -> A -> Set
x != y =

data _<_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set where
  zero<suc : {n : Nat} -> zero < suc n
  suc<suc  : {m n : Nat} -> m < n -> suc m < suc n

one : Nat
one =
  suc zero

two : Nat
two =

three : Nat
three =
  suc two

six : Nat
six =

negative : Nat -> Int
negative zero =
  pos zero
negative (suc n) =
  negsuc n

difference : Nat -> Nat -> Int
difference zero zero =
  pos zero
difference (suc m) zero =
  pos (suc m)
difference zero (suc n) =
  negsuc n
difference (suc m) (suc n) =
  difference m n

addInt : Int -> Int -> Int
addInt (pos m) (pos n) =
  pos (m + n)
addInt (pos m) (negsuc n) =
  difference m (suc n)
addInt (negsuc m) (pos n) =
  difference n (suc m)
addInt (negsuc m) (negsuc n) =
  negsuc (suc (m + n))

multiplyInt : Int -> Int -> Int

  pos (m * n)
multiplyInt (pos m) (negsuc n) =
  negative (m * suc n)
multiplyInt (negsuc m) (pos n) =
  negative (suc m * n)
multiplyInt (negsuc m) (negsuc n) =
  pos (suc m * suc n)

powerInt x (suc n) =

choose n zero =
  one
choose zero (suc r) =

choose (suc n) (suc r) =

sumFromOneThroughInt (suc n) term =

  sumFromOneThroughInt (two * k - one)

        (pos (choose m (three * j - one))))

% Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1983_a4:
% for m = 6*k - 1 with positive natural k, the alternating sum of binomial
% coefficients indexed by 3*j - 1 is nonzero. This file contains no proof.

putnam_1983_a4: THEORY
BEGIN
  binomial_coefficient(n, r: nat): RECURSIVE nat =
    IF r = 0 THEN
      1
    ELSIF n = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      binomial_coefficient(n - 1, r - 1)
        + binomial_coefficient(n - 1, r)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE n

  nat_subtract(n, r: nat): nat =
    IF r <= n THEN n - r ELSE 0 ENDIF

  alternating_sign(exponent: nat): RECURSIVE int =
    IF exponent = 0 THEN
      1
    ELSE
      -alternating_sign(exponent - 1)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE exponent

  alternating_binomial_sum(m, upper: nat): RECURSIVE int =
    IF upper = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      alternating_binomial_sum(m, upper - 1)
        + alternating_sign(upper + 1)
          * (binomial_coefficient(
              m,
              nat_subtract(3 * upper, 1)) :: int)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE upper

  putnam_1983_a4: bool =
    FORALL (k, m: nat), (S: int):
      (k > 0
        AND m = nat_subtract(6 * k, 1)
        AND S = alternating_binomial_sum(
          m,
          nat_subtract(2 * k, 1)))
      IMPLIES S /= 0
END putnam_1983_a4

;; Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1983_a5:
;; existence of a positive real alpha such that floor(alpha^n)-n is even for
;; every positive natural number n. This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))

;; The arguments of the final predicate present a Dedekind-complete ordered
;; field, hence a copy of the real field. Operations and carrier membership are
;; represented by the repository's tame APPLY$ function objects, while every
;; source quantifier, including the existential quantifier over alpha, remains
;; inside DEFUN-SK predicates.

(defun putnam-1983-a5-member-p (carrier value)
  (if (apply$ carrier (list value)) t nil))

(defun putnam-1983-a5-unary (operation value)
  (apply$ operation (list value)))

(defun putnam-1983-a5-binary (operation left right)
  (apply$ operation (list left right)))

(defun-sk putnam-1983-a5-field-laws-p
    (carrier zero one add multiply negate inverse)
  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (putnam-1983-a5-member-p carrier x)
      (putnam-1983-a5-member-p carrier y)
      (putnam-1983-a5-member-p carrier z))
     (let* ((xy-add
             (putnam-1983-a5-binary add x y))
            (yz-add
             (putnam-1983-a5-binary add y z))
            (xy-multiply
             (putnam-1983-a5-binary multiply x y))
            (yz-multiply
             (putnam-1983-a5-binary multiply y z))
            (negative-x
             (putnam-1983-a5-unary negate x))
            (inverse-x
             (putnam-1983-a5-unary inverse x)))
       (and
        (putnam-1983-a5-member-p carrier xy-add)
        (putnam-1983-a5-member-p carrier xy-multiply)
        (putnam-1983-a5-member-p carrier negative-x)
        (putnam-1983-a5-member-p carrier inverse-x)
        (equal
         (putnam-1983-a5-binary add xy-add z)
         (putnam-1983-a5-binary add x yz-add))
        (equal
         xy-add
         (putnam-1983-a5-binary add y x))
        (equal
         (putnam-1983-a5-binary add x zero)
         x)
        (equal
         (putnam-1983-a5-binary add x negative-x)
         zero)
        (equal
         (putnam-1983-a5-binary multiply xy-multiply z)
         (putnam-1983-a5-binary multiply x yz-multiply))
        (equal
         xy-multiply
         (putnam-1983-a5-binary multiply y x))
        (equal
         (putnam-1983-a5-binary multiply x one)
         x)
        (implies
         (equal x zero)
         (equal inverse-x zero))
        (implies
         (not (equal x zero))
         (equal
          (putnam-1983-a5-binary multiply x inverse-x)
          one))
        (equal
         (putnam-1983-a5-binary multiply x yz-add)
         (putnam-1983-a5-binary
          add
          (putnam-1983-a5-binary multiply x y)
          (putnam-1983-a5-binary multiply x z))))))))

(defun-sk putnam-1983-a5-order-laws-p
    (carrier zero add multiply less)
  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (putnam-1983-a5-member-p carrier x)
      (putnam-1983-a5-member-p carrier y)
      (putnam-1983-a5-member-p carrier z))
     (and
      (not (putnam-1983-a5-binary less x x))
      (or
       (equal x y)
       (putnam-1983-a5-binary less x y)
       (putnam-1983-a5-binary less y x))
      (implies
       (and
        (putnam-1983-a5-binary less x y)
        (putnam-1983-a5-binary less y z))
       (putnam-1983-a5-binary less x z))
      (implies
       (putnam-1983-a5-binary less x y)
       (putnam-1983-a5-binary
        less
        (putnam-1983-a5-binary add x z)
        (putnam-1983-a5-binary add y z)))
      (implies
       (and
        (putnam-1983-a5-binary less zero x)
        (putnam-1983-a5-binary less zero y))
       (putnam-1983-a5-binary
        less
        zero
        (putnam-1983-a5-binary multiply x y)))))))

(defun-sk putnam-1983-a5-valid-set-p (carrier set)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (apply$ set (list x))
     (putnam-1983-a5-member-p carrier x))))

(defun-sk putnam-1983-a5-set-nonempty-p (carrier set)
  (exists (x)
    (and
     (putnam-1983-a5-member-p carrier x)
     (apply$ set (list x)))))

(defun-sk putnam-1983-a5-upper-bound-p
    (carrier less set bound)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (and
      (putnam-1983-a5-member-p carrier x)
      (apply$ set (list x)))
     (not
      (putnam-1983-a5-binary less bound x)))))

(defun-sk putnam-1983-a5-bounded-above-p
    (carrier less set)
  (exists (bound)
    (and
     (putnam-1983-a5-member-p carrier bound)
     (putnam-1983-a5-upper-bound-p
      carrier less set bound))))

(defun-sk putnam-1983-a5-least-upper-bound-p
    (carrier less set supremum)
  (forall (bound)
    (and
     (putnam-1983-a5-member-p carrier supremum)
     (putnam-1983-a5-upper-bound-p
      carrier less set supremum)
     (implies
      (and
       (putnam-1983-a5-member-p carrier bound)
       (putnam-1983-a5-upper-bound-p
        carrier less set bound))
      (not
       (putnam-1983-a5-binary
        less bound supremum))))))

(defun-sk putnam-1983-a5-has-supremum-p
    (carrier less set)
  (exists (supremum)
    (putnam-1983-a5-least-upper-bound-p
     carrier less set supremum)))

(defun-sk putnam-1983-a5-dedekind-complete-p
    (carrier less)
  (forall (set)
    (implies
     (and
      (tamep-functionp set)
      (putnam-1983-a5-valid-set-p carrier set)
      (putnam-1983-a5-set-nonempty-p carrier set)
      (putnam-1983-a5-bounded-above-p
       carrier less set))
     (putnam-1983-a5-has-supremum-p
      carrier less set))))

(defun putnam-1983-a5-real-field-p
    (carrier zero one add multiply negate inverse less)
  (and
   (tamep-functionp carrier)
   (tamep-functionp add)
   (tamep-functionp multiply)
   (tamep-functionp negate)
   (tamep-functionp inverse)
   (tamep-functionp less)
   (putnam-1983-a5-member-p carrier zero)
   (putnam-1983-a5-member-p carrier one)
   (not (equal zero one))
   (putnam-1983-a5-field-laws-p
    carrier zero one add multiply negate inverse)
   (putnam-1983-a5-order-laws-p
    carrier zero add multiply less)
   (putnam-1983-a5-binary less zero one)
   (putnam-1983-a5-dedekind-complete-p
    carrier less)))

(defun putnam-1983-a5-natural-value
    (n zero one add)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix n)))
  (if (zp n)
      zero
    (putnam-1983-a5-binary
     add
     one
     (putnam-1983-a5-natural-value
      (1- n) zero one add))))

(defun putnam-1983-a5-integer-value
    (integer zero one add negate)
  (if (and (integerp integer)
           (< integer 0))
      (putnam-1983-a5-unary
       negate
       (putnam-1983-a5-natural-value
        (- integer) zero one add))
    (putnam-1983-a5-natural-value
     (nfix integer) zero one add)))

(defun putnam-1983-a5-power
    (base exponent one multiply)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix exponent)))
  (if (zp exponent)
      one
    (putnam-1983-a5-binary
     multiply
     base
     (putnam-1983-a5-power
      base (1- exponent) one multiply))))

(defun putnam-1983-a5-less-equal-p (less left right)
  (not (putnam-1983-a5-binary less right left)))

;; K is floor(X) exactly when the embedded integer K is at most X and X is
;; strictly below the embedded integer K+1.
(defun putnam-1983-a5-floor-value-p
    (x k zero one add negate less)
  (and
   (integerp k)
   (let ((embedded-k
          (putnam-1983-a5-integer-value
           k zero one add negate))
         (embedded-successor
          (putnam-1983-a5-integer-value
           (+ k 1) zero one add negate)))
     (and
      (putnam-1983-a5-less-equal-p
       less embedded-k x)
      (putnam-1983-a5-binary
       less x embedded-successor)))))

(defun-sk putnam-1983-a5-floor-parity-at-n-p
    (alpha n zero one add multiply negate less)
  (exists (k)
    (and
     (putnam-1983-a5-floor-value-p
      (putnam-1983-a5-power alpha n one multiply)
      k zero one add negate less)
     (equal (mod (- k n) 2) 0))))

(defun-sk putnam-1983-a5-alpha-property-p
    (alpha zero one add multiply negate less)
  (forall (n)
    (implies
     (and
      (natp n)
      (< 0 n))
     (putnam-1983-a5-floor-parity-at-n-p
      alpha n zero one add multiply negate less))))

(defun-sk putnam-1983-a5-exists-alpha-p
    (carrier zero one add multiply negate less)
  (exists (alpha)
    (and
     (putnam-1983-a5-member-p carrier alpha)
     (putnam-1983-a5-binary less zero alpha)
     (putnam-1983-a5-alpha-property-p
      alpha zero one add multiply negate less))))

;; The structural antecedent is ACL2's untyped presentation of the source's
;; fixed real-number type. For every such presentation, the conclusion is
;; exactly the source existential statement, with no witness exposed as an
;; external parameter and no formula for its floors assumed.
(defun putnambench-putnam-1983-a5-statement
    (carrier zero one add multiply negate inverse less)
  (implies
   (putnam-1983-a5-real-field-p
    carrier zero one add multiply negate inverse less)
   (putnam-1983-a5-exists-alpha-p
    carrier zero one add multiply negate less)))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

-- Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1983_a5:
-- there exists a positive real number whose floor at every positive natural
-- power differs from the exponent by an even integer. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Int using (Int; pos; negsuc)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; _*_)

infix 4 _!=_
infixr 3 _and_
infixr 2 _or_

data Bottom : Set where

Not : Set -> Set
Not A =
  A -> Bottom

_!=_ : {A : Set} -> A -> A -> Set
x != y =
  Not (x == y)

record _and_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data _or_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  left  : A -> A or B
  right : B -> A or B

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

data Positive : Nat -> Set where
  positive : {n : Nat} -> Positive (suc n)

intSuccessor : Int -> Int
intSuccessor (pos n) =
  pos (suc n)
intSuccessor (negsuc zero) =
  pos zero
intSuccessor (negsuc (suc n)) =
  negsuc n

embedInt :
  {R : Set} ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  (R -> R) ->
  Int ->
  R
embedInt fromNatural negateR (pos n) =
  fromNatural n
embedInt fromNatural negateR (negsuc n) =
  negateR (fromNatural (suc n))

record CompleteOrderedRealField (R : Set) : Set1 where
  field
    zeroR oneR : R
    add multiply : R -> R -> R
    negate inverse : R -> R
    lessOrEqual : R -> R -> Set
    fromNat : Nat -> R
    floor : R -> Int

    one-not-zero :
      oneR != zeroR

    add-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> add x y == add y x
    add-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      add (add x y) z == add x (add y z)
    add-zero :
      (x : R) -> add x zeroR == x
    add-inverse :
      (x : R) -> add x (negate x) == zeroR

    multiply-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> multiply x y == multiply y x
    multiply-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply (multiply x y) z ==
      multiply x (multiply y z)
    multiply-one :
      (x : R) -> multiply x oneR == x
    multiply-zero :
      (x : R) -> multiply x zeroR == zeroR
    distribute :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply x (add y z) ==
      add (multiply x y) (multiply x z)
    inverse-zero :
      inverse zeroR == zeroR
    multiply-inverse :
      (x : R) ->
      x != zeroR ->
      multiply x (inverse x) == oneR

    order-reflexive :
      (x : R) -> lessOrEqual x x
    order-transitive :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y z ->
      lessOrEqual x z
    order-antisymmetric :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y x ->
      x == y
    order-total :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y or lessOrEqual y x
    add-order :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual (add z x) (add z y)
    multiply-nonnegative :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR x ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR y ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR (multiply x y)
    zero-less-than-one :
      lessOrEqual zeroR oneR and zeroR != oneR

    fromNat-zero :
      fromNat zero == zeroR
    fromNat-successor :
      (n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (suc n) == add (fromNat n) oneR
    fromNat-addition :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m + n) == add (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-multiplication :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m * n) == multiply (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-injective :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat m == fromNat n ->
      m == n

    archimedean :
      (x : R) ->
      Exists Nat (\ n -> lessOrEqual x (fromNat n))
    least-upper-bound :
      (P : R -> Set) ->
      Exists R P ->
      Exists R
        (\ upper ->
          (x : R) ->
          P x ->
          lessOrEqual x upper) ->
      Exists R
        (\ supremum ->
          ((x : R) ->
            P x ->
            lessOrEqual x supremum)
          and
          ((upper : R) ->
            ((x : R) ->
              P x ->
              lessOrEqual x upper) ->
            lessOrEqual supremum upper))

    floor-lower :
      (x : R) ->
      lessOrEqual
        (embedInt fromNat negate (floor x))
        x
    floor-upper :
      (x : R) ->
      lessOrEqual
        x
        (embedInt fromNat negate (intSuccessor (floor x)))
      and
      x != embedInt fromNat negate (intSuccessor (floor x))

open CompleteOrderedRealField

StrictLess :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
StrictLess reals x y =
  lessOrEqual reals x y and x != y

negativeInt : Nat -> Int
negativeInt zero =
  pos zero
negativeInt (suc n) =
  negsuc n

differenceInt : Nat -> Nat -> Int
differenceInt zero zero =
  pos zero
differenceInt (suc m) zero =
  pos (suc m)
differenceInt zero (suc n) =
  negsuc n
differenceInt (suc m) (suc n) =
  differenceInt m n

addInt : Int -> Int -> Int
addInt (pos m) (pos n) =
  pos (m + n)
addInt (pos m) (negsuc n) =
  differenceInt m (suc n)
addInt (negsuc m) (pos n) =
  differenceInt n (suc m)
addInt (negsuc m) (negsuc n) =
  negsuc (suc (m + n))

negateInt : Int -> Int
negateInt (pos n) =
  negativeInt n
negateInt (negsuc n) =
  pos (suc n)

subtractInt : Int -> Int -> Int
subtractInt x y =
  addInt x (negateInt y)

Even : Int -> Set
Even z =
  Exists Int (\ k -> z == addInt k k)

naturalPower :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  Nat ->
  R
naturalPower reals x zero =
  oneR reals
naturalPower reals x (suc n) =
  multiply reals x (naturalPower reals x n)

module Putnam1983A5Statement
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) where

  proposition : Set
  proposition =
    Exists R
      (\ alpha ->
        StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) alpha
        and
        ((n : Nat) ->
          Positive n ->
          Even
            (subtractInt
              (floor reals (naturalPower reals alpha n))
              (pos n))))

putnam-1983-a5 : Set1
putnam-1983-a5 =
  (R : Set) ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) ->
  Putnam1983A5Statement.proposition reals

% existence of a positive real alpha such that floor(alpha^n) - n is even
% for every positive natural number n. This file contains no proof.

putnam_1983_a5: THEORY
BEGIN
  integer_even(value: int): bool =
    EXISTS (factor: int):
      value = 2 * factor

  putnam_1983_a5_solution: bool = TRUE

  putnam_1983_a5_statement: bool =
    (EXISTS (alpha: real):
      alpha > 0
        AND FORALL (n: nat):
          n > 0 IMPLIES
            integer_even(

      IFF putnam_1983_a5_solution
END putnam_1983_a5

import Mathlib

open Nat Filter Topology Real

noncomputable abbrev putnam_1983_a6_solution : ℝ := sorry
-- 2 / 9
/--
Let $T$ be the triangle with vertices $(0, 0)$, $(a, 0)$, and $(0, a)$. Find $\lim_{a \to \infty} a^4 \exp(-a^3) \int_T \exp(x^3+y^3) \, dx \, dy$.
-/
theorem putnam_1983_a6
(F : ℝ → ℝ)
(hF : F = fun a ↦ (a ^ 4 / exp (a ^ 3)) * ∫ x in (0)..a, ∫ y in (0)..(a - x), exp (x ^ 3 + y ^ 3))
: (Tendsto F atTop (𝓝 putnam_1983_a6_solution)) :=
sorry

title: putnam_1983_a6
putnam_1983_a6
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1983_a6:
;; the normalized real exponential integral over the triangle with vertices
;; (0,0), (a,0), and (0,a) tends to 2/9 as a tends to infinity.
;; This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))

;; Ordinary ACL2 has no native real-analysis type. These conservative
;; function symbols present one arbitrary real field and its exponential.
;; Every algebraic, order, completeness, and exponential law used to identify
;; that presentation with the real numbers is explicit in the statement.

(defstub p83a6-real-p (x) t)
(defstub p83a6-add (x y) t)
(defstub p83a6-mul (x y) t)
(defstub p83a6-neg (x) t)
(defstub p83a6-inv (x) t)
(defstub p83a6-lt (x y) t)
(defstub p83a6-exp (x) t)

(defun p83a6-zero () 0)
(defun p83a6-one () 1)

(defun p83a6-sub (x y)
  (p83a6-add x (p83a6-neg y)))

(defun p83a6-div (x y)
  (p83a6-mul x (p83a6-inv y)))

(defun p83a6-le (x y)
  (not (p83a6-lt y x)))

(defun p83a6-abs (x)
  (if (p83a6-lt x (p83a6-zero))
      (p83a6-neg x)
    x))

(defun p83a6-positive-real-p (x)
  (and
   (p83a6-real-p x)
   (p83a6-lt (p83a6-zero) x)))

(defun-sk p83a6-field-laws-p ()
  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (p83a6-real-p x)
      (p83a6-real-p y)
      (p83a6-real-p z))
     (and
      (p83a6-real-p (p83a6-add x y))
      (p83a6-real-p (p83a6-mul x y))
      (p83a6-real-p (p83a6-neg x))
      (p83a6-real-p (p83a6-inv x))
      (equal
       (p83a6-add (p83a6-add x y) z)
       (p83a6-add x (p83a6-add y z)))
      (equal (p83a6-add x y)
             (p83a6-add y x))
      (equal (p83a6-add x (p83a6-zero)) x)
      (equal (p83a6-add x (p83a6-neg x))
             (p83a6-zero))
      (equal
       (p83a6-mul (p83a6-mul x y) z)
       (p83a6-mul x (p83a6-mul y z)))
      (equal (p83a6-mul x y)
             (p83a6-mul y x))
      (equal (p83a6-mul x (p83a6-one)) x)
      (implies
       (equal x (p83a6-zero))
       (equal (p83a6-inv x) (p83a6-zero)))
      (implies
       (not (equal x (p83a6-zero)))
       (equal
        (p83a6-mul x (p83a6-inv x))
        (p83a6-one)))
      (equal
       (p83a6-mul x (p83a6-add y z))
       (p83a6-add
        (p83a6-mul x y)
        (p83a6-mul x z)))))))

(defun-sk p83a6-order-laws-p ()
  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (p83a6-real-p x)
      (p83a6-real-p y)
      (p83a6-real-p z))
     (and
      (not (p83a6-lt x x))
      (or
       (equal x y)
       (p83a6-lt x y)
       (p83a6-lt y x))
      (implies
       (and (p83a6-lt x y)
            (p83a6-lt y z))
       (p83a6-lt x z))
      (implies
       (p83a6-lt x y)
       (p83a6-lt
        (p83a6-add x z)
        (p83a6-add y z)))
      (implies
       (and
        (p83a6-lt (p83a6-zero) x)
        (p83a6-lt (p83a6-zero) y))
       (p83a6-lt
        (p83a6-zero)
        (p83a6-mul x y)))))))

;; Dedekind completeness ranges over ACL2 APPLY$ function objects representing
;; subsets of the carrier.

(defun-sk p83a6-valid-set-p (set)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (apply$ set (list x))
     (p83a6-real-p x))))

(defun-sk p83a6-set-nonempty-p (set)
  (exists (x)
    (and
     (p83a6-real-p x)
     (apply$ set (list x)))))

(defun-sk p83a6-upper-bound-p (set bound)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (and
      (p83a6-real-p x)
      (apply$ set (list x)))
     (p83a6-le x bound))))

(defun-sk p83a6-bounded-above-p (set)
  (exists (bound)
    (and
     (p83a6-real-p bound)
     (p83a6-upper-bound-p set bound))))

(defun-sk p83a6-least-upper-bound-p (set supremum)
  (forall (bound)
    (implies
     (and
      (p83a6-real-p bound)
      (p83a6-upper-bound-p set bound))
     (p83a6-le supremum bound))))

(defun p83a6-supremum-p (set supremum)
  (and
   (p83a6-real-p supremum)
   (p83a6-upper-bound-p set supremum)
   (p83a6-least-upper-bound-p set supremum)))

(defun-sk p83a6-has-supremum-p (set)
  (exists (supremum)
    (p83a6-supremum-p set supremum)))

(defun-sk p83a6-dedekind-complete-p ()
  (forall (set)
    (implies
     (and
      (tamep-functionp set)
      (p83a6-valid-set-p set)
      (p83a6-set-nonempty-p set)
      (p83a6-bounded-above-p set))
     (p83a6-has-supremum-p set))))

;; Requiring exp(0)=1 and exp'=exp under the epsilon-delta derivative below
;; characterizes the real exponential without a finite Taylor approximation.

(defun-sk p83a6-exp-derivative-neighborhood-p
    (x epsilon radius)
  (forall (z)
    (implies
     (and
      (p83a6-real-p z)
      (p83a6-lt
       (p83a6-abs (p83a6-sub z x))
       radius))
     (p83a6-le
      (p83a6-abs
       (p83a6-sub
        (p83a6-sub
         (p83a6-exp z)
         (p83a6-exp x))
        (p83a6-mul
         (p83a6-exp x)
         (p83a6-sub z x))))
      (p83a6-mul
       epsilon
       (p83a6-abs (p83a6-sub z x)))))))

(defun-sk p83a6-exp-derivative-radius-exists-p
    (x epsilon)
  (exists (radius)
    (and
     (p83a6-positive-real-p radius)
     (p83a6-exp-derivative-neighborhood-p
      x epsilon radius))))

(defun-sk p83a6-exp-has-derivative-p (x)
  (forall (epsilon)
    (implies
     (p83a6-positive-real-p epsilon)
     (p83a6-exp-derivative-radius-exists-p
      x epsilon))))

(defun-sk p83a6-exponential-derivative-values-p ()
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (p83a6-real-p x)
     (p83a6-exp-has-derivative-p x))))

(defun-sk p83a6-exponential-typed-p ()
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (p83a6-real-p x)
     (p83a6-real-p (p83a6-exp x)))))

(defun p83a6-real-context-p ()
  (and
   (p83a6-real-p (p83a6-zero))
   (p83a6-real-p (p83a6-one))
   (not (equal (p83a6-zero) (p83a6-one)))
   (p83a6-field-laws-p)
   (p83a6-order-laws-p)
   (p83a6-lt (p83a6-zero) (p83a6-one))
   (p83a6-dedekind-complete-p)
   (p83a6-exponential-typed-p)
   (equal (p83a6-exp (p83a6-zero))
          (p83a6-one))
   (p83a6-exponential-derivative-values-p)))

(defun p83a6-nat-cast (n)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix n)))
  (if (zp n)
      (p83a6-zero)
    (p83a6-add
     (p83a6-one)
     (p83a6-nat-cast (- n 1)))))

(defun p83a6-pow (x n)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix n)))
  (if (zp n)
      (p83a6-one)
    (p83a6-mul
     x
     (p83a6-pow x (- n 1)))))

(defun p83a6-grid-fraction (index subdivisions)
  (p83a6-div
   (p83a6-nat-cast index)
   (p83a6-nat-cast subdivisions)))

(defun p83a6-inner-grid-point
    (a x index subdivisions)
  (p83a6-mul
   (p83a6-sub a x)
   (p83a6-grid-fraction index subdivisions)))

(defun p83a6-integrand (x y)
  (p83a6-exp
   (p83a6-add
    (p83a6-pow x 3)
    (p83a6-pow y 3))))

(defun p83a6-inner-sum
    (a x subdivisions remaining)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix remaining)))
  (if (zp remaining)
      (p83a6-zero)
    (let ((y
           (p83a6-inner-grid-point
            a x remaining subdivisions)))
      (p83a6-add
       (p83a6-integrand x y)
       (p83a6-inner-sum
        a x subdivisions (- remaining 1))))))

(defun p83a6-inner-integral-approx
    (a x subdivisions)
  (p83a6-mul
   (p83a6-div
    (p83a6-sub a x)
    (p83a6-nat-cast subdivisions))
   (p83a6-inner-sum
    a x subdivisions subdivisions)))

(defun p83a6-outer-grid-point
    (a index subdivisions)
  (p83a6-mul
   a
   (p83a6-grid-fraction index subdivisions)))

(defun p83a6-outer-sum
    (a subdivisions remaining)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix remaining)))
  (if (zp remaining)
      (p83a6-zero)
    (let ((x
           (p83a6-outer-grid-point
            a remaining subdivisions)))
      (p83a6-add
       (p83a6-inner-integral-approx
        a x subdivisions)
       (p83a6-outer-sum
        a subdivisions (- remaining 1))))))

;; For positive a this is the nested uniform right-endpoint Riemann sum for
;; integral_0^a integral_0^(a-x) exp(x^3+y^3) dy dx. The predicate below is
;; its unbounded limit, not a finite quadrature or an asserted error bound.

(defun p83a6-double-integral-approx
    (a subdivisions)
  (if (posp subdivisions)
      (p83a6-mul
       (p83a6-div
        a
        (p83a6-nat-cast subdivisions))
       (p83a6-outer-sum
        a subdivisions subdivisions))
    (p83a6-zero)))

(defun-sk p83a6-integral-tail-p
    (a integral epsilon cutoff)
  (forall (subdivisions)
    (implies
     (and
      (posp subdivisions)
      (<= cutoff subdivisions))
     (p83a6-lt
      (p83a6-abs
       (p83a6-sub
        (p83a6-double-integral-approx
         a subdivisions)
        integral))
      epsilon))))

(defun-sk p83a6-integral-cutoff-exists-p
    (a integral epsilon)
  (exists (cutoff)
    (and
     (posp cutoff)
     (p83a6-integral-tail-p
      a integral epsilon cutoff))))

(defun-sk p83a6-integral-converges-to-p
    (a integral)
  (forall (epsilon)
    (implies
     (p83a6-positive-real-p epsilon)
     (p83a6-integral-cutoff-exists-p
      a integral epsilon))))

(defun p83a6-integral-value-p (a integral)
  (and
   (p83a6-real-p integral)
   (p83a6-integral-converges-to-p
    a integral)))

(defun p83a6-normalized-value (a integral)
  (p83a6-mul
   (p83a6-div
    (p83a6-pow a 4)
    (p83a6-exp (p83a6-pow a 3)))
   integral))

(defun p83a6-solution ()
  (p83a6-div
   (p83a6-nat-cast 2)
   (p83a6-nat-cast 9)))

(defun-sk p83a6-value-close-at-p
    (a epsilon)
  (exists (integral)
    (and
     (p83a6-integral-value-p a integral)
     (p83a6-lt
      (p83a6-abs
       (p83a6-sub
        (p83a6-normalized-value a integral)
        (p83a6-solution)))
      epsilon))))

(defun-sk p83a6-limit-tail-p
    (epsilon threshold)
  (forall (a)
    (implies
     (and
      (p83a6-real-p a)
      (p83a6-le threshold a))
     (p83a6-value-close-at-p
      a epsilon))))

(defun-sk p83a6-limit-threshold-exists-p
    (epsilon)
  (exists (threshold)
    (and
     (p83a6-positive-real-p threshold)
     (p83a6-limit-tail-p
      epsilon threshold))))

(defun-sk p83a6-normalized-integral-tends-to-solution-p ()
  (forall (epsilon)
    (implies
     (p83a6-positive-real-p epsilon)
     (p83a6-limit-threshold-exists-p
      epsilon))))

(defun putnambench-putnam-1983-a6-statement ()
  (implies
   (p83a6-real-context-p)
   (p83a6-normalized-integral-tends-to-solution-p)))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

title: putnam_1983_a6
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench artifact
-- putnambench__agda__putnam_1983_a6: the scaled exponential integral over
-- the triangle with vertices (0,0), (a,0), and (0,a) tends to 2/9 as a tends
-- to positive infinity. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; _*_)

infix 4 _!=_ _<=N_
infixr 3 _and_
infixr 2 _or_

data Bottom : Set where

Not : Set -> Set
Not A =
  A -> Bottom

_!=_ : {A : Set} -> A -> A -> Set
x != y =
  Not (x == y)

record _and_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data _or_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  left  : A -> A or B
  right : B -> A or B

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

data _<=N_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set where
  zero<=N   : {n : Nat} -> zero <=N n
  suc<=sucN : {m n : Nat} -> m <=N n -> suc m <=N suc n

record CompleteOrderedRealField (R : Set) : Set1 where
  field
    zeroR oneR : R
    add multiply : R -> R -> R
    negate inverse : R -> R
    lessOrEqual : R -> R -> Set
    fromNat : Nat -> R

    one-not-zero :
      oneR != zeroR

    add-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> add x y == add y x
    add-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      add (add x y) z == add x (add y z)
    add-zero :
      (x : R) -> add x zeroR == x
    add-inverse :
      (x : R) -> add x (negate x) == zeroR

    multiply-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> multiply x y == multiply y x
    multiply-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply (multiply x y) z ==
      multiply x (multiply y z)
    multiply-one :
      (x : R) -> multiply x oneR == x
    multiply-zero :
      (x : R) -> multiply x zeroR == zeroR
    distribute :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply x (add y z) ==
      add (multiply x y) (multiply x z)
    inverse-zero :
      inverse zeroR == zeroR
    multiply-inverse :
      (x : R) ->
      x != zeroR ->
      multiply x (inverse x) == oneR

    order-reflexive :
      (x : R) -> lessOrEqual x x
    order-transitive :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y z ->
      lessOrEqual x z
    order-antisymmetric :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y x ->
      x == y
    order-total :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y or lessOrEqual y x
    add-order :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual (add z x) (add z y)
    multiply-nonnegative :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR x ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR y ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR (multiply x y)
    zero-less-than-one :
      lessOrEqual zeroR oneR and zeroR != oneR

    fromNat-zero :
      fromNat zero == zeroR
    fromNat-successor :
      (n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (suc n) == add (fromNat n) oneR
    fromNat-addition :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m + n) == add (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-multiplication :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m * n) == multiply (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-injective :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat m == fromNat n ->
      m == n

    archimedean :
      (x : R) ->
      Exists Nat (\ n -> lessOrEqual x (fromNat n))
    least-upper-bound :
      (P : R -> Set) ->
      Exists R P ->
      Exists R
        (\ upper ->
          (x : R) ->
          P x ->
          lessOrEqual x upper) ->
      Exists R
        (\ supremum ->
          ((x : R) ->
            P x ->
            lessOrEqual x supremum)
          and
          ((upper : R) ->
            ((x : R) ->
              P x ->
              lessOrEqual x upper) ->
            lessOrEqual supremum upper))

open CompleteOrderedRealField

oneN : Nat
oneN =
  suc zero

twoN : Nat
twoN =
  suc oneN

threeN : Nat
threeN =
  suc twoN

fourN : Nat
fourN =
  suc threeN

nineN : Nat
nineN =
  threeN * threeN

subtract :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
subtract reals x y =
  add reals x (negate reals y)

divide :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
divide reals x y =
  multiply reals x (inverse reals y)

StrictLess :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
StrictLess reals x y =
  lessOrEqual reals x y and x != y

CloseTo :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
CloseTo reals center radius x =
  StrictLess reals
    (subtract reals center radius)
    x
  and
  StrictLess reals
    x
    (add reals center radius)

ConvergesTo :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  R ->
  Set
ConvergesTo {R} reals sequence limit =
  (epsilon : R) ->
  StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) epsilon ->
  Exists Nat
    (\ cutoff ->
      (n : Nat) ->
      cutoff <=N n ->
      CloseTo reals limit epsilon (sequence n))

LimitAtPositiveInfinity :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (R -> R) ->
  R ->
  Set
LimitAtPositiveInfinity {R} reals function limit =
  (epsilon : R) ->
  StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) epsilon ->
  Exists R
    (\ threshold ->
      (x : R) ->
      lessOrEqual reals threshold x ->
      CloseTo reals limit epsilon (function x))

naturalPower :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  Nat ->
  R
naturalPower reals x zero =
  oneR reals
naturalPower reals x (suc n) =
  multiply reals
    (naturalPower reals x n)
    x

factorial : Nat -> Nat
factorial zero =
  oneN
factorial (suc n) =
  suc n * factorial n

sumFirst :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Nat ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  R
sumFirst reals zero terms =
  zeroR reals
sumFirst reals (suc n) terms =
  add reals
    (sumFirst reals n terms)
    (terms n)

SeriesHasSum :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  R ->
  Set
SeriesHasSum reals terms limit =
  ConvergesTo reals
    (\ n -> sumFirst reals n terms)
    limit

exponentialTerm :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  Nat ->
  R
exponentialTerm reals x n =
  divide reals
    (naturalPower reals x n)
    (fromNat reals (factorial n))

record StandardExponential
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) :
  Set1 where

  field
    exponential : R -> R
    exponential-series :
      (x : R) ->
      SeriesHasSum reals
        (exponentialTerm reals x)
        (exponential x)

open StandardExponential

midpointRiemannSum :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  (R -> R) ->
  Nat ->
  R
midpointRiemannSum reals lower upper function pieces =
  let
    step =
      divide reals
        (subtract reals upper lower)
        (fromNat reals pieces)
    halfStep =
      divide reals
        step
        (fromNat reals twoN)
  in
  sumFirst reals pieces
    (\ i ->
      multiply reals
        (function
          (add reals lower
            (add reals
              (multiply reals
                (fromNat reals i)
                step)
              halfStep)))
        step)

IntervalIntegralValue :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  (R -> R) ->
  R ->
  Set
IntervalIntegralValue reals lower upper function value =
  ConvergesTo reals
    (\ n ->
      midpointRiemannSum reals
        lower
        upper
        function
        (suc n))
    value

record IteratedTriangleIntegralValue
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R)
  (realExp : StandardExponential reals)
  (a value : R) :
  Set where

  field
    innerValues :
      R ->
      R
    inner-integrals :
      (x : R) ->
      IntervalIntegralValue reals
        (zeroR reals)
        (subtract reals a x)
        (\ y ->
          exponential realExp
            (add reals
              (naturalPower reals x threeN)
              (naturalPower reals y threeN)))
        (innerValues x)
    outer-integral :
      IntervalIntegralValue reals
        (zeroR reals)
        a
        innerValues
        value

module Putnam1983A6Statement
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R)
  (realExp : StandardExponential reals) where

  scale :
    R ->
    R
  scale a =
    divide reals
      (naturalPower reals a fourN)
      (exponential realExp
        (naturalPower reals a threeN))

  ScaledTriangleIntegralValue :
    R ->
    R ->
    Set
  ScaledTriangleIntegralValue a value =
    Exists R
      (\ integral ->
        IteratedTriangleIntegralValue
          reals
          realExp
          a
          integral
        and
        value ==
          multiply reals
            (scale a)
            integral)

  solution :
    R
  solution =
    divide reals
      (fromNat reals twoN)
      (fromNat reals nineN)

  proposition :
    Set
  proposition =
    (F : R -> R) ->
    ((a : R) ->
      ScaledTriangleIntegralValue a (F a)) ->
    LimitAtPositiveInfinity reals
      F
      solution

putnam-1983-a6 : Set1
putnam-1983-a6 =
  (R : Set) ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) ->
  (realExp : StandardExponential reals) ->
  Putnam1983A6Statement.proposition reals realExp

(*
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1983_a6:
  evaluation of the positive-infinity limit of an exponentially normalized
  iterated integral over a right triangle. This file contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open pred_setTheory realTheory real_topologyTheory transcTheory
     integrationTheory;

val putnam_1983_a6 =
  ``let F =
      \a : real.
        (a pow 4 / exp (a pow 3)) *
        integration$integral (interval [0, a])
          (\x : real.
             integration$integral (interval [0, a - x])
               (\y : real. exp (x pow 3 + y pow 3)))
    in
      (F --> (2 / 9 : real)) at_posinfinity``;

$(
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact
  putnam_1983_a6: evaluation as 2/9 of the positive-infinity limit of an
  exponentially scaled double integral over a right triangle. This file
  contains no proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  The nested S. binders are set.mm's real Lebesgue integrals. For positive
  a, the open intervals omit only boundary points of the source triangle,
  which does not change the integral. Values at nonpositive a are irrelevant
  to the limit at positive infinity.

  The relation ~~>r is set.mm's limit at positive infinity for a
  real-indexed function. The value 2 / 9 is specified by the Rocq source and
  by the solution annotations in the Lean and Isabelle sources. The final
  declaration is the single unproved $a corpus statement; this database
  contains no $p proof statement.
$)

${
  $d a x y $.

  putnambench-putnam-1983-a6 $a |-
    (
      a e. RR |->
        (
          (
            ( a ^ 4 )
            /
            ( exp ` ( a ^ 3 ) )
          )
          x.
          S. ( 0 (,) a )
            (
              S. ( 0 (,) ( a - x ) )
                ( exp ` ( ( x ^ 3 ) + ( y ^ 3 ) ) )
                _d y
            )
            _d x
        )
    )
    ~~>r
    ( 2 / 9 )
  $.
$}
