title: putnam_1983_b6
putnam_1983_b6
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1983_b6:
;; a nontrivial complex root of unity of order dividing 2^n+1 admits two
;; integer polynomials whose squared values sum to -1. This file contains no
;; proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))

;; If alpha has order d, then d>1 and d divides 2^n+1. Conversely every such
;; d has primitive complex d-th roots. An integer polynomial vanishes at one
;; primitive d-th root exactly when it is divisible by the cyclotomic
;; polynomial Phi_d; Galois conjugacy makes this independent of the chosen
;; primitive root. Thus D is an exact representation of the source alpha up
;; to the equivalence relevant to the conclusion, not a finite approximation.

(defun putnam-1983-b6-poly-normalize (coefficients)
  (if (consp coefficients)
      (let ((tail
             (putnam-1983-b6-poly-normalize
              (cdr coefficients))))
        (if (and (equal (car coefficients) 0)
                 (not (consp tail)))
            nil
          (cons (car coefficients) tail)))
    nil))

(defun putnam-1983-b6-poly-add (left right)
  (cond
   ((consp left)
    (if (consp right)
        (cons (+ (car left) (car right))
              (putnam-1983-b6-poly-add
               (cdr left) (cdr right)))
      left))
   (t right)))

(defun putnam-1983-b6-poly-scale (scalar polynomial)
  (if (consp polynomial)
      (cons (* scalar (car polynomial))
            (putnam-1983-b6-poly-scale
             scalar (cdr polynomial)))
    nil))

(defun putnam-1983-b6-poly-subtract (left right)
  (putnam-1983-b6-poly-normalize
   (putnam-1983-b6-poly-add
    left
    (putnam-1983-b6-poly-scale -1 right))))

(defun putnam-1983-b6-poly-shift (polynomial amount)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix amount)))
  (if (zp amount)
      polynomial
    (cons 0
          (putnam-1983-b6-poly-shift
           polynomial (- amount 1)))))

(defun putnam-1983-b6-poly-multiply (left right)
  (if (consp left)
      (putnam-1983-b6-poly-add
       (putnam-1983-b6-poly-scale (car left) right)
       (putnam-1983-b6-poly-shift
        (putnam-1983-b6-poly-multiply
         (cdr left) right)
        1))
    nil))

(defun putnam-1983-b6-x-power-minus-one (exponent)
  (if (zp exponent)
      nil
    (cons -1
          (putnam-1983-b6-poly-shift
           (list 1)
           (- exponent 1)))))

(defun putnam-1983-b6-no-divisor-through-p (n candidate)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix candidate)))
  (if (and (natp n)
           (natp candidate)
           (< 1 candidate))
      (and (not (equal (mod n candidate) 0))
           (putnam-1983-b6-no-divisor-through-p
            n (- candidate 1)))
    t))

(defun putnam-1983-b6-primep (n)
  (and (natp n)
       (< 1 n)
       (putnam-1983-b6-no-divisor-through-p
        n (- n 1))))

;; This trial-division definition is the ordinary Moebius function.
(defun putnam-1983-b6-moebius-through
    (n candidate odd-prime-count-p)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix candidate)))
  (if (zp candidate)
      (if odd-prime-count-p -1 1)
    (if (and
         (putnam-1983-b6-primep candidate)
         (equal (mod n candidate) 0))
        (if (equal
             (mod n (* candidate candidate))
             0)
            0
          (putnam-1983-b6-moebius-through
           n
           (- candidate 1)
           (not odd-prime-count-p)))
      (putnam-1983-b6-moebius-through
       n (- candidate 1) odd-prime-count-p))))

(defun putnam-1983-b6-moebius (n)
  (if (posp n)
      (putnam-1983-b6-moebius-through n n nil)
    0))

;; Phi_d = product_{k|d} (x^k-1)^mu(d/k). The two functions collect the
;; positive and negative Moebius exponents separately.
(defun putnam-1983-b6-cyclotomic-numerator-through
    (d candidate)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix candidate)))
  (if (zp candidate)
      (list 1)
    (let ((tail
           (putnam-1983-b6-cyclotomic-numerator-through
            d (- candidate 1))))
      (if (and
           (equal (mod d candidate) 0)
           (equal
            (putnam-1983-b6-moebius
             (floor d candidate))
            1))
          (putnam-1983-b6-poly-multiply
           (putnam-1983-b6-x-power-minus-one candidate)
           tail)
        tail))))

(defun putnam-1983-b6-cyclotomic-denominator-through
    (d candidate)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix candidate)))
  (if (zp candidate)
      (list 1)
    (let ((tail
           (putnam-1983-b6-cyclotomic-denominator-through
            d (- candidate 1))))
      (if (and
           (equal (mod d candidate) 0)
           (equal
            (putnam-1983-b6-moebius
             (floor d candidate))
            -1))
          (putnam-1983-b6-poly-multiply
           (putnam-1983-b6-x-power-minus-one candidate)
           tail)
        tail))))

(defun putnam-1983-b6-poly-leading-coefficient (polynomial)
  (if (consp polynomial)
      (if (consp (cdr polynomial))
          (putnam-1983-b6-poly-leading-coefficient
           (cdr polynomial))
        (car polynomial))
    0))

(defun putnam-1983-b6-poly-monomial (coefficient exponent)
  (putnam-1983-b6-poly-shift
   (list coefficient)
   exponent))

;; The denominator above is monic and divides the numerator. The explicit
;; step bound makes long division a total ACL2 function.
(defun putnam-1983-b6-poly-divide-monic-steps
    (numerator denominator steps)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix steps)))
  (let* ((numerator
          (putnam-1983-b6-poly-normalize numerator))
         (denominator
          (putnam-1983-b6-poly-normalize denominator)))
    (if (or (zp steps)
            (not (consp denominator))
            (< (len numerator) (len denominator)))
        nil
      (let* ((coefficient
              (putnam-1983-b6-poly-leading-coefficient
               numerator))
             (shift
              (- (len numerator) (len denominator)))
             (term
              (putnam-1983-b6-poly-monomial
               coefficient shift))
             (remainder
              (putnam-1983-b6-poly-subtract
               numerator
               (putnam-1983-b6-poly-multiply
                term denominator))))
        (putnam-1983-b6-poly-add
         term
         (putnam-1983-b6-poly-divide-monic-steps
          remainder denominator (- steps 1)))))))

(defun putnam-1983-b6-cyclotomic-polynomial (d)
  (if (posp d)
      (let* ((numerator
              (putnam-1983-b6-cyclotomic-numerator-through
               d d))
             (denominator
              (putnam-1983-b6-cyclotomic-denominator-through
               d d)))
        (putnam-1983-b6-poly-normalize
         (putnam-1983-b6-poly-divide-monic-steps
          numerator denominator (len numerator))))
    nil))

(defun putnam-1983-b6-integer-polynomial-p (coefficients)
  (if (consp coefficients)
      (and
       (integerp (car coefficients))
       (putnam-1983-b6-integer-polynomial-p
        (cdr coefficients)))
    (equal coefficients nil)))

;; In Z[x]/(Phi_d), the displayed identity is exactly
;; p(alpha)^2 + q(alpha)^2 = -1 for a primitive d-th root alpha. The
;; existential quotient R is internal to the conclusion and witnesses
;; divisibility by Phi_d; it is not an extra theorem parameter.
(defun putnam-1983-b6-polynomial-identity-p (d p q r)
  (equal
   (putnam-1983-b6-poly-normalize
    (putnam-1983-b6-poly-add
     (putnam-1983-b6-poly-multiply p p)
     (putnam-1983-b6-poly-add
      (putnam-1983-b6-poly-multiply q q)
      (list 1))))
   (putnam-1983-b6-poly-normalize
    (putnam-1983-b6-poly-multiply
     (putnam-1983-b6-cyclotomic-polynomial d)
     r))))

(defun-sk putnam-1983-b6-polynomial-witnesses-exist-p (d)
  (exists (p q r)
    (and
     (putnam-1983-b6-integer-polynomial-p p)
     (putnam-1983-b6-integer-polynomial-p q)
     (putnam-1983-b6-integer-polynomial-p r)
     (putnam-1983-b6-polynomial-identity-p d p q r))))

(defun putnambench-putnam-1983-b6-statement (n d)
  (implies
   (and
    (natp n)
    (< 0 n)
    (natp d)
    (< 1 d)
    (equal (mod (+ (expt 2 n) 1) d) 0))
   (putnam-1983-b6-polynomial-witnesses-exist-p d)))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

title: putnam_1983_b6
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1983_b6:
-- a nontrivial (2^n + 1)-st root of unity admits two
-- integer-coefficient polynomials whose values have squares summing to -1.
-- This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Int using (Int; pos; negsuc)
open import Agda.Builtin.List using (List; []; _∷_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; _*_)

infix 4 _!=_ _<=N_ _<N_
infixr 3 _and_
infixr 2 _or_

data Bottom : Set where

Not : Set -> Set
Not A =
  A -> Bottom

_!=_ : {A : Set} -> A -> A -> Set
x != y =
  Not (x == y)

record _and_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data _or_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  left  : A -> A or B
  right : B -> A or B

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

data _<=N_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set where
  zero<=N   : {n : Nat} -> zero <=N n
  suc<=sucN : {m n : Nat} -> m <=N n -> suc m <=N suc n

_<N_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set
m <N n =
  suc m <=N n

record CompleteOrderedRealField (R : Set) : Set1 where
  field
    zeroR oneR : R
    add multiply : R -> R -> R
    negate inverse : R -> R
    lessOrEqual : R -> R -> Set
    fromNat : Nat -> R

    one-not-zero :
      oneR != zeroR

    add-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> add x y == add y x
    add-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      add (add x y) z == add x (add y z)
    add-zero :
      (x : R) -> add x zeroR == x
    add-inverse :
      (x : R) -> add x (negate x) == zeroR

    multiply-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> multiply x y == multiply y x
    multiply-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply (multiply x y) z ==
      multiply x (multiply y z)
    multiply-one :
      (x : R) -> multiply x oneR == x
    multiply-zero :
      (x : R) -> multiply x zeroR == zeroR
    distribute :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply x (add y z) ==
      add (multiply x y) (multiply x z)
    inverse-zero :
      inverse zeroR == zeroR
    multiply-inverse :
      (x : R) ->
      x != zeroR ->
      multiply x (inverse x) == oneR

    order-reflexive :
      (x : R) -> lessOrEqual x x
    order-transitive :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y z ->
      lessOrEqual x z
    order-antisymmetric :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y x ->
      x == y
    order-total :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y or lessOrEqual y x
    add-order :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual (add z x) (add z y)
    multiply-nonnegative :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR x ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR y ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR (multiply x y)
    zero-less-than-one :
      lessOrEqual zeroR oneR and zeroR != oneR

    fromNat-zero :
      fromNat zero == zeroR
    fromNat-successor :
      (n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (suc n) == add (fromNat n) oneR
    fromNat-addition :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m + n) == add (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-multiplication :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m * n) == multiply (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-injective :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat m == fromNat n ->
      m == n

    archimedean :
      (x : R) ->
      Exists Nat (\ n -> lessOrEqual x (fromNat n))
    least-upper-bound :
      (P : R -> Set) ->
      Exists R P ->
      Exists R
        (\ upper ->
          (x : R) ->
          P x ->
          lessOrEqual x upper) ->
      Exists R
        (\ supremum ->
          ((x : R) ->
            P x ->
            lessOrEqual x supremum)
          and
          ((upper : R) ->
            ((x : R) ->
              P x ->
              lessOrEqual x upper) ->
            lessOrEqual supremum upper))

open CompleteOrderedRealField

oneN : Nat
oneN =
  suc zero

twoN : Nat
twoN =
  suc oneN

naturalPower : Nat -> Nat -> Nat
naturalPower base zero =
  oneN
naturalPower base (suc exponent) =
  base * naturalPower base exponent

integerToReal :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Int ->
  R
integerToReal reals (pos n) =
  fromNat reals n
integerToReal reals (negsuc n) =
  negate reals (fromNat reals (suc n))

record Complex (R : Set) : Set where
  constructor complex
  field
    realPart      : R
    imaginaryPart : R

open Complex

complexZero :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Complex R
complexZero reals =
  complex (zeroR reals) (zeroR reals)

complexOne :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Complex R
complexOne reals =
  complex (oneR reals) (zeroR reals)

complexNegativeOne :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Complex R
complexNegativeOne reals =
  complex (negate reals (oneR reals)) (zeroR reals)

embedInteger :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Int ->
  Complex R
embedInteger reals coefficient =
  complex (integerToReal reals coefficient) (zeroR reals)

complexAdd :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Complex R ->
  Complex R ->
  Complex R
complexAdd reals z w =
  complex
    (add reals (realPart z) (realPart w))
    (add reals (imaginaryPart z) (imaginaryPart w))

complexNegate :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Complex R ->
  Complex R
complexNegate reals z =
  complex
    (negate reals (realPart z))
    (negate reals (imaginaryPart z))

complexSubtract :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Complex R ->
  Complex R ->
  Complex R
complexSubtract reals z w =
  complexAdd reals z (complexNegate reals w)

complexMultiply :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Complex R ->
  Complex R ->
  Complex R
complexMultiply reals z w =
  complex
    (add reals
      (multiply reals (realPart z) (realPart w))
      (negate reals
        (multiply reals (imaginaryPart z) (imaginaryPart w))))
    (add reals
      (multiply reals (realPart z) (imaginaryPart w))
      (multiply reals (imaginaryPart z) (realPart w)))

complexSquare :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Complex R ->
  Complex R
complexSquare reals z =
  complexMultiply reals z z

complexPower :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Complex R ->
  Nat ->
  Complex R
complexPower reals z zero =
  complexOne reals
complexPower reals z (suc exponent) =
  complexMultiply reals
    (complexPower reals z exponent)
    z

Polynomial : Set
Polynomial =
  List Int

polynomialValue :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Polynomial ->
  Complex R ->
  Complex R
polynomialValue reals [] z =
  complexZero reals
polynomialValue reals (coefficient ∷ coefficients) z =
  complexAdd reals
    (embedInteger reals coefficient)
    (complexMultiply reals z
      (polynomialValue reals coefficients z))

module Putnam1983B6Statement
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) where

  rootExponent : Nat -> Nat
  rootExponent n =
    naturalPower twoN n + oneN

  IsNontrivialRoot : Nat -> Complex R -> Set
  IsNontrivialRoot n alpha =
    complexSubtract reals
      (complexPower reals alpha (rootExponent n))
      (complexOne reals)
    ==
    complexZero reals
    and
    alpha != complexOne reals

  HasPolynomialWitnesses : Complex R -> Set
  HasPolynomialWitnesses alpha =
    Exists Polynomial
      (\ p ->
        Exists Polynomial
          (\ q ->
            complexAdd reals
              (complexSquare reals (polynomialValue reals p alpha))
              (complexSquare reals (polynomialValue reals q alpha))
            ==
            complexNegativeOne reals))

  proposition : Set
  proposition =
    (n : Nat) ->
    zero <N n ->
    (alpha : Complex R) ->
    IsNontrivialRoot n alpha ->
    HasPolynomialWitnesses alpha

putnam-1983-b6 : Set1
putnam-1983-b6 =
  (R : Set) ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) ->
  Putnam1983B6Statement.proposition reals

(*
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1983_b6:
  integer-coefficient polynomials whose squared values at a nontrivial
  complex (2^n + 1)-st root of unity sum to -1. This file contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open arithmeticTheory integerTheory listTheory realTheory intrealTheory
     complexTheory;

val putnam_1983_b6 =
  ``let eval_int_poly =
      \coeffs : int list.
      \z : complex.
        FOLDR
          (\a acc. complex_of_real (real_of_int a) + z * acc)
          0 coeffs
    in
      !n : num. !alpha : complex.
        0 < n /\
        alpha pow ((2 : num) ** n + 1) - 1 = 0 /\
        alpha <> 1
        ==>
        ?p q : int list.
          eval_int_poly p alpha pow 2 +
          eval_int_poly q alpha pow 2 = -1``;

title: putnam_1983_b6
content:
$(
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact
  putnam_1983_b6: for every positive integer n and nontrivial complex
  (2^n + 1)-st root of unity, two integer-coefficient polynomials have
  squared values summing to -1. This file contains no proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  P and Q are complete integer-valued coefficient functions on NN0. The
  internally existential bounds d and e require the respective coefficient
  functions to vanish above those bounds, so they represent exactly arbitrary
  polynomials over ZZ, including the zero polynomial. The finite sums are
  their evaluations at the complex number a. This finite-support coefficient
  encoding is bidirectionally equivalent to the polynomial objects in the
  Lean and Isabelle sources.

  The final declaration is the single unproved $a corpus statement; this
  database contains no $p proof statement.
$)

${
  $d P Q a d e k n $.

  putnambench-putnam-1983-b6 $a |-
    A. n e. NN
      A. a e. CC
        (
          (
            (
              ( a ^ ( ( 2 ^ n ) + 1 ) )
              -
              1
            )
            =
            0
            /\
            a =/= 1
          )
          ->
          E. P e. ( ZZ ^m NN0 )
            E. Q e. ( ZZ ^m NN0 )
              E. d e. NN0
                E. e e. NN0
                  (
                    (
                      A. k e. NN0
                        ( d < k -> ( P ` k ) = 0 )
                      /\
                      A. k e. NN0
                        ( e < k -> ( Q ` k ) = 0 )
                    )
                    /\
                    (
                      (
                        sum_ k e. ( 0 ... d )
                          ( ( P ` k ) x. ( a ^ k ) )
                      )
                      ^ 2
                    )
                    +
                    (
                      (
                        sum_ k e. ( 0 ... e )
                          ( ( Q ` k ) x. ( a ^ k ) )
                      )
                      ^ 2
                    )
                    =
                    ( -u 1 )
                  )
        )
  $.
$}

title: putnam_1983_b6
content:
% Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1983_b6:
% positive n and a nontrivial complex (2^n + 1)-st root of unity admit two
% integer-coefficient polynomials whose squared values sum to -1. This file
% contains no proof.

putnam_1983_b6: THEORY
BEGIN
  complex: TYPE = [# real_part: real, imag_part: real #]
  integer_coefficient_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> int]

  complex_zero: complex =
    (# real_part := 0, imag_part := 0 #)

  complex_one: complex =
    (# real_part := 1, imag_part := 0 #)

  complex_minus_one: complex =
    (# real_part := -1, imag_part := 0 #)

  complex_of_integer(value: int): complex =
    (# real_part := (value :: real), imag_part := 0 #)

  complex_neg(z: complex): complex =
    (# real_part := -real_part(z),
       imag_part := -imag_part(z) #)

  complex_add(z, w: complex): complex =
    (# real_part := real_part(z) + real_part(w),
       imag_part := imag_part(z) + imag_part(w) #)

  complex_sub(z, w: complex): complex =
    complex_add(z, complex_neg(w))

  complex_mul(z, w: complex): complex =
    (# real_part := real_part(z) * real_part(w)
                       - imag_part(z) * imag_part(w),
       imag_part := real_part(z) * imag_part(w)
                       + imag_part(z) * real_part(w) #)

  complex_power(z: complex, exponent: nat): RECURSIVE complex =
    IF exponent = 0 THEN
      complex_one
    ELSE
      complex_mul(complex_power(z, exponent - 1), z)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE exponent

  integer_polynomial_value(
      coefficients: integer_coefficient_sequence,
      z: complex,
      count: nat): RECURSIVE complex =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      complex_zero
    ELSE
      LET k: nat = count - 1 IN
        complex_add(
          integer_polynomial_value(coefficients, z, count - 1),
          complex_mul(
            complex_of_integer(coefficients(k)),
            complex_power(z, k)))
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  integer_polynomial_evaluates_to(
      coefficients: integer_coefficient_sequence,
      z, value: complex): bool =
    EXISTS (degree_bound: nat):
      (FORALL (k: nat):
        degree_bound < k IMPLIES coefficients(k) = 0)
      AND value =
        integer_polynomial_value(
          coefficients,
          z,
          degree_bound + 1)

  putnam_1983_b6: bool =
    FORALL (n: nat), (alpha: complex):
      (n > 0
        AND complex_sub(
          complex_power(alpha, 2 ^ n + 1),
          complex_one) = complex_zero
        AND alpha /= complex_one)
      IMPLIES
        EXISTS
            (p, q: integer_coefficient_sequence),
            (p_value, q_value: complex):
          integer_polynomial_evaluates_to(p, alpha, p_value)
            AND integer_polynomial_evaluates_to(q, alpha, q_value)
            AND complex_add(
              complex_power(p_value, 2),
              complex_power(q_value, 2))
                = complex_minus_one
END putnam_1983_b6

;; Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1984_a2:
;; the infinite series with kth term
;; 6^k/((3^(k+1)-2^(k+1))*(3^k-2^k)), starting at k=1, sums to
;; the rational number 2. This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(defun putnam-1984-a2-series-term (k)
  (if (posp k)
      (/ (expt 6 k)
         (* (- (expt 3 (+ k 1))
               (expt 2 (+ k 1)))
            (- (expt 3 k)
               (expt 2 k))))
    0))

;; This is the exact rational sum over 1 <= k <= TERMS. The Rocq source
;; starts at k=0, where its totalized real division makes the extra term zero.
(defun putnam-1984-a2-series-prefix (terms)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix terms)))
  (if (zp terms)
      0
    (+ (putnam-1984-a2-series-prefix (- terms 1))
       (putnam-1984-a2-series-term terms))))

(defun putnam-1984-a2-solution ()
  2)

;; Positive rational tolerances are cofinal among positive real tolerances,
;; so this is the epsilon definition of the source infinite-series equality.
(defun-sk putnam-1984-a2-tail-p (epsilon cutoff)
  (forall (terms)
    (implies
     (and
      (natp terms)
      (<= cutoff terms))
     (< (abs
         (- (putnam-1984-a2-series-prefix terms)
            (putnam-1984-a2-solution)))
        epsilon))))

(defun-sk putnam-1984-a2-cutoff-exists-p (epsilon)
  (exists (cutoff)
    (and
     (natp cutoff)
     (putnam-1984-a2-tail-p epsilon cutoff))))

(defun putnambench-putnam-1984-a2-statement (epsilon)
  (implies
   (and (rationalp epsilon)
        (< 0 epsilon))
   (putnam-1984-a2-cutoff-exists-p epsilon)))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

title: putnam_1984_a2
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1984_a2:
-- the infinite series with term 6^k / ((3^(k+1)-2^(k+1))(3^k-2^k))
-- equals 2; its totalized k=0 term is zero, matching the tail from k=1.
-- This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; _*_)

infix 4 _!=_ _<=N_
infixr 3 _and_
infixr 2 _or_

data Bottom : Set where

Not : Set -> Set
Not A =
  A -> Bottom

_!=_ : {A : Set} -> A -> A -> Set
x != y =
  Not (x == y)

record _and_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data _or_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  left  : A -> A or B
  right : B -> A or B

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

data _<=N_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set where
  zero<=   : {n : Nat} -> zero <=N n
  suc<=suc : {m n : Nat} -> m <=N n -> suc m <=N suc n

record CompleteOrderedRealField (R : Set) : Set1 where
  field
    zeroR oneR : R
    add multiply : R -> R -> R
    negate inverse : R -> R
    lessOrEqual : R -> R -> Set
    fromNat : Nat -> R

    one-not-zero :
      oneR != zeroR

    add-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> add x y == add y x
    add-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      add (add x y) z == add x (add y z)
    add-zero :
      (x : R) -> add x zeroR == x
    add-inverse :
      (x : R) -> add x (negate x) == zeroR

    multiply-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> multiply x y == multiply y x
    multiply-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply (multiply x y) z ==
      multiply x (multiply y z)
    multiply-one :
      (x : R) -> multiply x oneR == x
    multiply-zero :
      (x : R) -> multiply x zeroR == zeroR
    distribute :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply x (add y z) ==
      add (multiply x y) (multiply x z)
    inverse-zero :
      inverse zeroR == zeroR
    multiply-inverse :
      (x : R) ->
      x != zeroR ->
      multiply x (inverse x) == oneR

    order-reflexive :
      (x : R) -> lessOrEqual x x
    order-transitive :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y z ->
      lessOrEqual x z
    order-antisymmetric :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y x ->
      x == y
    order-total :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y or lessOrEqual y x
    add-order :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual (add z x) (add z y)
    multiply-nonnegative :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR x ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR y ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR (multiply x y)
    zero-less-than-one :
      lessOrEqual zeroR oneR and zeroR != oneR

    fromNat-zero :
      fromNat zero == zeroR
    fromNat-successor :
      (n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (suc n) == add (fromNat n) oneR
    fromNat-addition :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m + n) == add (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-multiplication :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m * n) == multiply (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-injective :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat m == fromNat n ->
      m == n

    archimedean :
      (x : R) ->
      Exists Nat (\ n -> lessOrEqual x (fromNat n))
    least-upper-bound :
      (P : R -> Set) ->
      Exists R P ->
      Exists R
        (\ upper ->
          (x : R) ->
          P x ->
          lessOrEqual x upper) ->
      Exists R
        (\ supremum ->
          ((x : R) ->
            P x ->
            lessOrEqual x supremum)
          and
          ((upper : R) ->
            ((x : R) ->
              P x ->
              lessOrEqual x upper) ->
            lessOrEqual supremum upper))

open CompleteOrderedRealField

oneN : Nat
oneN =
  suc zero

twoN : Nat
twoN =
  suc oneN

threeN : Nat
threeN =
  suc twoN

sixN : Nat
sixN =
  threeN + threeN

subtract :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
subtract reals x y =
  add reals x (negate reals y)

divide :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
divide reals x y =
  multiply reals x (inverse reals y)

StrictLess :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
StrictLess reals x y =
  lessOrEqual reals x y and x != y

CloseTo :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
CloseTo reals center radius x =
  StrictLess reals
    (subtract reals center radius)
    x
  and
  StrictLess reals
    x
    (add reals center radius)

naturalPower :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  Nat ->
  R
naturalPower reals x zero =
  oneR reals
naturalPower reals x (suc n) =
  multiply reals
    (naturalPower reals x n)
    x

sumFirst :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Nat ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  R
sumFirst reals zero terms =
  zeroR reals
sumFirst reals (suc n) terms =
  add reals
    (sumFirst reals n terms)
    (terms n)

ConvergesTo :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  R ->
  Set
ConvergesTo {R} reals sequence limit =
  (epsilon : R) ->
  StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) epsilon ->
  Exists Nat
    (\ cutoff ->
      (n : Nat) ->
      cutoff <=N n ->
      CloseTo reals limit epsilon (sequence n))

SeriesHasSum :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  R ->
  Set
SeriesHasSum reals terms limit =
  ConvergesTo reals
    (\ n -> sumFirst reals n terms)
    limit

seriesTerm :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Nat ->
  R
seriesTerm reals k =
  divide reals
    (naturalPower reals (fromNat reals sixN) k)
    (multiply reals
      (subtract reals
        (naturalPower reals (fromNat reals threeN) (suc k))
        (naturalPower reals (fromNat reals twoN) (suc k)))
      (subtract reals
        (naturalPower reals (fromNat reals threeN) k)
        (naturalPower reals (fromNat reals twoN) k)))

putnam-1984-a2 : Set1
putnam-1984-a2 =
  (R : Set) ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) ->
  SeriesHasSum reals
    (seriesTerm reals)
    (fromNat reals twoN)

$(
  For positive n, the finite sum is the partial sum from k = 1 through n
  of the series in the Lean and Isabelle sources. Its terms are rational
  numbers, and viewing those partial sums in RR preserves their ordinary
  rational-series convergence and value.

  The Rocq source instead starts at k = 0, where its totalized real division
  makes the term zero because the second denominator factor is 1 - 1.
  Removing that zero term gives exactly the same sequence of partial sums.
  The value 2 is explicit in Rocq and in the Lean and Isabelle solution
  annotations. The final declaration is the single unproved $a corpus
  statement; this database contains no $p proof statement.
$)

${
  $d k n $.

  putnambench-putnam-1984-a2 $a |-
    (
      n e. NN |->
        sum_ k e. ( 1 ... n )
          (
            ( 6 ^ k )
            /
            (
              (
                ( 3 ^ ( k + 1 ) )
                -
                ( 2 ^ ( k + 1 ) )
              )
              x.
              (
                ( 3 ^ k )
                -
                ( 2 ^ k )
              )
            )
          )
    )
    ~~>
    2
  $.
$}

title: putnam_1984_a2
content:
% Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1984_a2:
% the real series with kth term 6^k divided by
% (3^(k+1) - 2^(k+1)) * (3^k - 2^k) sums to 2. This file contains no proof.

putnam_1984_a2: THEORY
BEGIN
  real_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> real]

  safe_div(numerator, denominator: real): real =
    IF denominator = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      numerator / denominator
    ENDIF

  series_term(index: nat): real =
    safe_div(
      (6 :: real) ^ index,
      ((3 :: real) ^ (index + 1) - (2 :: real) ^ (index + 1))
        * ((3 :: real) ^ index - (2 :: real) ^ index))

  partial_sum(values: real_sequence, count: nat): RECURSIVE real =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      partial_sum(values, count - 1) + values(count - 1)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  converges_to(sequence: real_sequence, value: real): bool =
    FORALL (epsilon_value: posreal):
      EXISTS (cutoff: nat):
        FORALL (count: nat):
          cutoff <= count IMPLIES
            abs(sequence(count) - value) < epsilon_value

  putnam_1984_a2: bool =
    converges_to(
      LAMBDA (count: nat):
        partial_sum(series_term, count),
      2)
END putnam_1984_a2

title: putnam_1984_a3
content:
import Mathlib

open Topology Filter

noncomputable abbrev putnam_1984_a3_solution : MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ := sorry
-- (MvPolynomial.X 2) ^ 2 * ((MvPolynomial.X 0) ^ 2 - (MvPolynomial.X 1) ^ 2)
/--
Let $n$ be a positive integer. Let $a,b,x$ be real numbers, with $a \neq b$, and let $M_n$ denote the $2n \times 2n$ matrix whose $(i,j)$ entry $m_{ij}$ is given by
\[
m_{ij}=\begin{cases}
x & \text{if }i=j, \\
a & \text{if }i \neq j\text{ and }i+j\text{ is even}, \\
b & \text{if }i \neq j\text{ and }i+j\text{ is odd}.
\end{cases}
\]
Thus, for example, $M_2=\begin{pmatrix} x & b & a & b \\ b & x & b & a \\ a & b & x & b \\ b & a & b & x \end{pmatrix}$. Express $\lim_{x \to a} \det M_n/(x-a)^{2n-2}$ as a polynomial in $a$, $b$, and $n$, where $\det M_n$ denotes the determinant of $M_n$.
-/
theorem putnam_1984_a3
(n : ℕ)
(a b : ℝ)
(Mn : ℝ → Matrix (Fin (2 * n)) (Fin (2 * n)) ℝ)
(polyabn : Fin 3 → ℝ)
(npos : n > 0)
(aneb : a ≠ b)
(hMn : Mn = fun x : ℝ => fun i j : Fin (2 * n) => if i = j then x else if Even (i.1 + j.1) then a else b)
(hpolyabn : polyabn 0 = a ∧ polyabn 1 = b ∧ polyabn 2 = n)
: Tendsto (fun x : ℝ => (Mn x).det / (x - a) ^ (2 * n - 2)) (𝓝[≠] a) (𝓝 (MvPolynomial.eval polyabn putnam_1984_a3_solution)) :=
sorry

title: putnam_1984_a3
content:
(* Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench artifact putnam_1984_a3:
   the punctured limit of a determinant of a parity-patterned real matrix;
   this file contains no proof. *)

From Stdlib Require Import Reals List Arith.

Import ListNotations.
Open Scope R_scope.

Fixpoint putnam_1984_a3_sum (xs : list R) : R :=
  match xs with
  | [] => 0
  | x :: rest => x + putnam_1984_a3_sum rest
  end.

Definition putnam_1984_a3_delete_nth
    {T : Type} (j : nat) (xs : list T) : list T :=
  firstn j xs ++ skipn (S j) xs.

Definition putnam_1984_a3_cofactor_sign (j : nat) : R :=
  if Nat.even j then 1 else -1.

Fixpoint putnam_1984_a3_det
    (m : nat) (M : list (list R)) {struct m} : R :=
  match m with
  | O => 1
  | S k =>
      match M with
      | [] => 0
      | row :: rows =>
          putnam_1984_a3_sum
            (map
              (fun j : nat =>
                putnam_1984_a3_cofactor_sign j *
                nth j row 0 *
                putnam_1984_a3_det k
                  (map (putnam_1984_a3_delete_nth j) rows))
              (seq 0 (S k)))
      end
  end.

Definition putnam_1984_a3_matrix
    (n : nat) (a b x : R) : list (list R) :=
  map
    (fun i : nat =>
      map
        (fun j : nat =>
          if Nat.eqb i j then x
          else if Nat.even (i + j) then a
          else b)
        (seq 0 (2 * n)))
    (seq 0 (2 * n)).

Definition putnam_1984_a3_punctured_limit
    (f : R -> R) (c l : R) : Prop :=
  forall eps : R,
    0 < eps ->
    exists delta : R,
      0 < delta /\
      forall x : R,
        0 < Rabs (x - c) < delta ->
        Rabs (f x - l) < eps.

Theorem putnam_1984_a3
    (n : nat)
    (a b : R)
    (npos : (0 < n)%nat)
    (aneb : a <> b) :
  putnam_1984_a3_punctured_limit
    (fun x : R =>
      putnam_1984_a3_det (2 * n)
        (putnam_1984_a3_matrix n a b x) /
      (x - a) ^ (2 * n - 2))
    a
    ((INR n) ^ 2 * (a ^ 2 - b ^ 2)).
Admitted.

theory putnam_1984_a3 imports Complex_Main
"HOL-Computational_Algebra.Polynomial"
"HOL-Analysis.Finite_Cartesian_Product"
"HOL-Analysis.Determinants"
begin

definition putnam_1984_a3_solution :: "real poly poly poly" where "putnam_1984_a3_solution \<equiv> undefined"
(* (monom 1 2) * ([:[:monom 1 2:]:] - [:monom 1 2:]) *)
theorem putnam_1984_a3:
  fixes n :: "nat"
    and a b :: "real"
    and Mn :: "real \<Rightarrow> (real^'i^'i)"
    and ni :: "'i \<Rightarrow> nat"
  defines "Mn \<equiv> \<lambda> x :: real. \<chi> i j :: 'i. if i = j then x else if even (ni i + ni j) then a else b"
  assumes hij : "CARD('i) = 2*n"
    and hn : "bij_betw ni (UNIV :: 'i set) {1..2*n}"
    and npos : "n > 0"
    and aneb : "a \<noteq> b"
  shows "filterlim (\<lambda> x :: real. det (Mn x) / (x - a) ^ (2 * n - 2)) (nhds (poly (poly (poly putnam_1984_a3_solution [:[:(n::real):]:]) [:b:]) a)) (at a)"
  sorry

end

(*
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1984_a3:
  the punctured limit at a of a normalized determinant of a parity-patterned
  2n by 2n real matrix. This file contains no proof.
*)

let statement =
  `let ndet =
     \(A:num->num->real) n.
       sum {p:num->num |
              BIJ p (0..n-1) (0..n-1) /\
              (!i:num. ~(i IN 0..n-1) ==> p i = i)}
           (\p.
              (if EVEN
                    (CARD
                      {(i,j) |
                         i < n /\ j < n /\ i < j /\ p j < p i})
               then &1
               else -- &1) *
              product (0..n-1) (\i. A i (p i))) in
   let tends_at_punctured =
     \(f:real->real) a l.
       !e:real.
         &0 < e
         ==> ?d:real.
               &0 < d /\
               !x:real.
                 &0 < abs (x - a) /\ abs (x - a) < d
                 ==> abs (f x - l) < e in
   !n:num. !a b:real.
     0 < n /\ ~(a = b)
     ==> tends_at_punctured
           (\x:real.
              ndet
                (\i j:num.
                   if i = j then x
                   else if EVEN (i + j) then a
                   else b)
                (2 * n) /
              ((x - a) pow (2 * n - 2)))
           a
           ((&n pow 2) * (a pow 2 - b pow 2))`;;

title: putnam_1984_a3
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1984_a3:
;; the punctured real limit of a parity-patterned 2n-by-2n determinant,
;; expressed as the polynomial n^2*(a^2-b^2). This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

;; Variables 0, 1, and 2 below are the formal indeterminates A, B, and
;; H = X-A. A monomial is a sorted list of variable indices, with repetition
;; denoting powers. A polynomial is a canonical sorted list of
;; (monomial . rational-coefficient) pairs.
;;
;; For fixed positive n, let D(A,B,H) be the determinant of the source matrix
;; after substituting X=A+H. The source limit is equivalent to saying that
;;
;;   D(A,B,H) - H^(2*n-2) * n^2*(A^2-B^2)
;;
;; has H-order greater than 2*n-2. One direction follows by evaluating the
;; formal identity at arbitrary real A and B. Conversely, if the source limit
;; holds for every real A != B, every coefficient through that H-degree
;; vanishes on the open set A != B and is therefore the zero polynomial.
;; Thus this formal-polynomial encoding is bidirectionally equivalent to the
;; arbitrary-real statement and does not restrict A or B to rational values.

(defun putnam-1984-a3-monomial-multiply (left right)
  (declare (xargs :measure
                  (+ (acl2-count left) (acl2-count right))))
  (cond
   ((endp left) right)
   ((endp right) left)
   ((<= (car left) (car right))
    (cons (car left)
          (putnam-1984-a3-monomial-multiply
           (cdr left) right)))
   (t
    (cons (car right)
          (putnam-1984-a3-monomial-multiply
           left (cdr right))))))

(defun putnam-1984-a3-polynomial-insert
    (monomial coefficient polynomial)
  (cond
   ((equal coefficient 0) polynomial)
   ((endp polynomial)
    (list (cons monomial coefficient)))
   ((equal monomial (caar polynomial))
    (let ((sum (+ coefficient (cdar polynomial))))
      (if (equal sum 0)
          (cdr polynomial)
        (cons (cons monomial sum)
              (cdr polynomial)))))
   ((lexorder monomial (caar polynomial))
    (cons (cons monomial coefficient) polynomial))
   (t
    (cons (car polynomial)
          (putnam-1984-a3-polynomial-insert
           monomial coefficient (cdr polynomial))))))

(defun putnam-1984-a3-polynomial-add (left right)
  (if (endp left)
      right
    (putnam-1984-a3-polynomial-add
     (cdr left)
     (putnam-1984-a3-polynomial-insert
      (caar left) (cdar left) right))))

(defun putnam-1984-a3-polynomial-negate (polynomial)
  (if (endp polynomial)
      nil
    (cons
     (cons (caar polynomial) (- (cdar polynomial)))
     (putnam-1984-a3-polynomial-negate
      (cdr polynomial)))))

(defun putnam-1984-a3-polynomial-subtract (left right)
  (putnam-1984-a3-polynomial-add
   left
   (putnam-1984-a3-polynomial-negate right)))

(defun putnam-1984-a3-polynomial-scale (scalar polynomial)
  (if (or (equal scalar 0)
          (endp polynomial))
      nil
    (cons
     (cons (caar polynomial)
           (* scalar (cdar polynomial)))
     (putnam-1984-a3-polynomial-scale
      scalar (cdr polynomial)))))

(defun putnam-1984-a3-polynomial-multiply-term
    (monomial coefficient polynomial)
  (if (endp polynomial)
      nil
    (putnam-1984-a3-polynomial-insert
     (putnam-1984-a3-monomial-multiply
      monomial (caar polynomial))
     (* coefficient (cdar polynomial))
     (putnam-1984-a3-polynomial-multiply-term
      monomial coefficient (cdr polynomial)))))

(defun putnam-1984-a3-polynomial-multiply (left right)
  (if (endp left)
      nil
    (putnam-1984-a3-polynomial-add
     (putnam-1984-a3-polynomial-multiply-term
      (caar left) (cdar left) right)
     (putnam-1984-a3-polynomial-multiply
      (cdr left) right))))

(defun putnam-1984-a3-polynomial-power (polynomial exponent)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix exponent)))
  (if (zp exponent)
      (list (cons nil 1))
    (putnam-1984-a3-polynomial-multiply
     polynomial
     (putnam-1984-a3-polynomial-power
      polynomial (- exponent 1)))))

(defun putnam-1984-a3-polynomial-variable (index)
  (list (cons (list index) 1)))

(defun putnam-1984-a3-indices (n)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix n)))
  (if (zp n)
      nil
    (cons (- n 1)
          (putnam-1984-a3-indices (- n 1)))))

(defun putnam-1984-a3-prepend-each (value lists)
  (if (endp lists)
      nil
    (cons
     (cons value (car lists))
     (putnam-1984-a3-prepend-each
      value (cdr lists)))))

(defun putnam-1984-a3-insert-everywhere (value values)
  (if (endp values)
      (list (list value))
    (cons
     (cons value values)
     (putnam-1984-a3-prepend-each
      (car values)
      (putnam-1984-a3-insert-everywhere
       value (cdr values))))))

(defun putnam-1984-a3-insert-into-permutations
    (value permutations)
  (if (endp permutations)
      nil
    (append
     (putnam-1984-a3-insert-everywhere
      value (car permutations))
     (putnam-1984-a3-insert-into-permutations
      value (cdr permutations)))))

(defun putnam-1984-a3-permutations (values)
  (if (endp values)
      (list nil)
    (putnam-1984-a3-insert-into-permutations
     (car values)
     (putnam-1984-a3-permutations (cdr values)))))

(defun putnam-1984-a3-smaller-count (value values)
  (if (endp values)
      0
    (+ (if (< (car values) value) 1 0)
       (putnam-1984-a3-smaller-count
        value (cdr values)))))

(defun putnam-1984-a3-inversion-count (permutation)
  (if (endp permutation)
      0
    (+ (putnam-1984-a3-smaller-count
        (car permutation) (cdr permutation))
       (putnam-1984-a3-inversion-count
        (cdr permutation)))))

(defun putnam-1984-a3-permutation-sign (permutation)
  (if (equal
       (mod (putnam-1984-a3-inversion-count permutation) 2)
       0)
      1
    -1))

;; Zero-based and one-based indices give the same parity for i+j, so this is
;; definitionally the matrix shared by the Lean and Isabelle sources.
(defun putnam-1984-a3-entry (row column)
  (let ((a (putnam-1984-a3-polynomial-variable 0))
        (b (putnam-1984-a3-polynomial-variable 1))
        (h (putnam-1984-a3-polynomial-variable 2)))
    (if (equal row column)
        (putnam-1984-a3-polynomial-add a h)
      (if (equal (mod (+ row column) 2) 0)
          a
        b))))

(defun putnam-1984-a3-determinant-product
    (row permutation)
  (if (endp permutation)
      (list (cons nil 1))
    (putnam-1984-a3-polynomial-multiply
     (putnam-1984-a3-entry row (car permutation))
     (putnam-1984-a3-determinant-product
      (+ row 1) (cdr permutation)))))

(defun putnam-1984-a3-determinant-sum (permutations)
  (if (endp permutations)
      nil
    (putnam-1984-a3-polynomial-add
     (putnam-1984-a3-polynomial-scale
      (putnam-1984-a3-permutation-sign
       (car permutations))
      (putnam-1984-a3-determinant-product
       0 (car permutations)))
     (putnam-1984-a3-determinant-sum
      (cdr permutations)))))

(defun putnam-1984-a3-determinant (n)
  (putnam-1984-a3-determinant-sum
   (putnam-1984-a3-permutations
    (putnam-1984-a3-indices (* 2 n)))))

(defun putnam-1984-a3-solution (n)
  (let* ((a (putnam-1984-a3-polynomial-variable 0))
         (b (putnam-1984-a3-polynomial-variable 1))
         (a-squared
          (putnam-1984-a3-polynomial-power a 2))
         (b-squared
          (putnam-1984-a3-polynomial-power b 2)))
    (putnam-1984-a3-polynomial-scale
     (* n n)
     (putnam-1984-a3-polynomial-subtract
      a-squared b-squared))))

(defun putnam-1984-a3-h-degree (monomial)
  (if (endp monomial)
      0
    (+ (if (equal (car monomial) 2) 1 0)
       (putnam-1984-a3-h-degree (cdr monomial)))))

(defun putnam-1984-a3-h-order-greater-p
    (polynomial degree)
  (if (endp polynomial)
      t
    (and
     (< degree
        (putnam-1984-a3-h-degree (caar polynomial)))
     (putnam-1984-a3-h-order-greater-p
      (cdr polynomial) degree))))

(defun putnambench-putnam-1984-a3-statement (n)
  (implies
   (and (natp n)
        (< 0 n))
   (let* ((degree (- (* 2 n) 2))
          (h (putnam-1984-a3-polynomial-variable 2))
          (claimed-leading-term
           (putnam-1984-a3-polynomial-multiply
            (putnam-1984-a3-polynomial-power h degree)
            (putnam-1984-a3-solution n)))
          (remainder
           (putnam-1984-a3-polynomial-subtract
            (putnam-1984-a3-determinant n)
            claimed-leading-term)))
     (putnam-1984-a3-h-order-greater-p
      remainder degree))))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

title: putnam_1984_a3
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1984_a3:
-- the punctured limit of a normalized determinant of the parity-patterned
-- 2n by 2n real matrix equals n squared times (a squared minus b squared).
-- This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; _-_; _*_)

infix 4 _!=_
infixr 3 _and_
infixr 2 _or_

data Bottom : Set where

Not : Set -> Set
Not A =
  A -> Bottom

_!=_ : {A : Set} -> A -> A -> Set
x != y =
  Not (x == y)

record _and_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data _or_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  left  : A -> A or B
  right : B -> A or B

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

data Positive : Nat -> Set where
  positive : {n : Nat} -> Positive (suc n)

data Fin : Nat -> Set where
  fzero : {n : Nat} -> Fin (suc n)
  fsuc  : {n : Nat} -> Fin n -> Fin (suc n)

finToNat : {n : Nat} -> Fin n -> Nat
finToNat fzero =
  zero
finToNat (fsuc i) =
  suc (finToNat i)

data Comparison : Set where
  less    : Comparison
  equal   : Comparison
  greater : Comparison

compareFin :
  {n : Nat} ->
  Fin n ->
  Fin n ->
  Comparison
compareFin fzero fzero =
  equal
compareFin fzero (fsuc j) =
  less
compareFin (fsuc i) fzero =
  greater
compareFin (fsuc i) (fsuc j) =
  compareFin i j

data Parity : Set where
  even odd : Parity

oppositeParity : Parity -> Parity
oppositeParity even =
  odd
oppositeParity odd =
  even

parity : Nat -> Parity
parity zero =
  even
parity (suc n) =
  oppositeParity (parity n)

record CompleteOrderedRealField (R : Set) : Set1 where
  field
    zeroR oneR : R
    add multiply : R -> R -> R
    negate inverse : R -> R
    lessOrEqual : R -> R -> Set
    fromNat : Nat -> R

    one-not-zero :
      oneR != zeroR

    add-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> add x y == add y x
    add-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      add (add x y) z == add x (add y z)
    add-zero :
      (x : R) -> add x zeroR == x
    add-inverse :
      (x : R) -> add x (negate x) == zeroR

    multiply-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> multiply x y == multiply y x
    multiply-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply (multiply x y) z ==
      multiply x (multiply y z)
    multiply-one :
      (x : R) -> multiply x oneR == x
    multiply-zero :
      (x : R) -> multiply x zeroR == zeroR
    distribute :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply x (add y z) ==
      add (multiply x y) (multiply x z)
    inverse-zero :
      inverse zeroR == zeroR
    multiply-inverse :
      (x : R) ->
      x != zeroR ->
      multiply x (inverse x) == oneR

    order-reflexive :
      (x : R) -> lessOrEqual x x
    order-transitive :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y z ->
      lessOrEqual x z
    order-antisymmetric :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y x ->
      x == y
    order-total :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y or lessOrEqual y x
    add-order :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual (add z x) (add z y)
    multiply-nonnegative :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR x ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR y ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR (multiply x y)
    zero-less-than-one :
      lessOrEqual zeroR oneR and zeroR != oneR

    fromNat-zero :
      fromNat zero == zeroR
    fromNat-successor :
      (n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (suc n) == add (fromNat n) oneR
    fromNat-addition :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m + n) == add (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-multiplication :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m * n) == multiply (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-injective :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat m == fromNat n ->
      m == n

    archimedean :
      (x : R) ->
      Exists Nat (\ n -> lessOrEqual x (fromNat n))
    least-upper-bound :
      (P : R -> Set) ->
      Exists R P ->
      Exists R
        (\ upper ->
          (x : R) ->
          P x ->
          lessOrEqual x upper) ->
      Exists R
        (\ supremum ->
          ((x : R) ->
            P x ->
            lessOrEqual x supremum)
          and
          ((upper : R) ->
            ((x : R) ->
              P x ->
              lessOrEqual x upper) ->
            lessOrEqual supremum upper))

open CompleteOrderedRealField

oneN : Nat
oneN =
  suc zero

twoN : Nat
twoN =
  suc oneN

subtract :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
subtract reals x y =
  add reals x (negate reals y)

divide :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
divide reals x y =
  multiply reals x (inverse reals y)

StrictLess :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
StrictLess reals x y =
  lessOrEqual reals x y and x != y

CloseTo :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
CloseTo reals center radius x =
  StrictLess reals
    (subtract reals center radius)
    x
  and
  StrictLess reals
    x
    (add reals center radius)

LimitAt :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (R -> R) ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
LimitAt {R} reals function limit point =
  (epsilon : R) ->
  StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) epsilon ->
  Exists R
    (\ delta ->
      StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) delta
      and
      ((x : R) ->
        CloseTo reals point delta x ->
        x != point ->
        CloseTo reals limit epsilon (function x)))

naturalPower :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  Nat ->
  R
naturalPower reals x zero =
  oneR reals
naturalPower reals x (suc n) =
  multiply reals
    (naturalPower reals x n)
    x

sumFin :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  {n : Nat} ->
  (Fin n -> R) ->
  R
sumFin reals {zero} term =
  zeroR reals
sumFin reals {suc n} term =
  add reals
    (term fzero)
    (sumFin reals (\ i -> term (fsuc i)))

Matrix : Set -> Nat -> Set
Matrix R n =
  Fin n -> Fin n -> R

skip :
  {n : Nat} ->
  Fin (suc n) ->
  Fin n ->
  Fin (suc n)
skip {zero} column ()
skip {suc n} fzero k =
  fsuc k
skip {suc n} (fsuc column) fzero =
  fzero
skip {suc n} (fsuc column) (fsuc k) =
  fsuc (skip column k)

firstRowMinor :
  {R : Set} {n : Nat} ->
  Matrix R (suc n) ->
  Fin (suc n) ->
  Matrix R n
firstRowMinor A column i j =
  A (fsuc i) (skip column j)

alternatingSign :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  {n : Nat} ->
  Fin n ->
  R
alternatingSign reals fzero =
  oneR reals
alternatingSign reals (fsuc i) =
  negate reals (alternatingSign reals i)

determinant :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  {n : Nat} ->
  Matrix R n ->
  R
determinant reals {zero} A =
  oneR reals
determinant reals {suc n} A =
  sumFin reals
    (\ column ->
      multiply reals
        (alternatingSign reals column)
        (multiply reals
          (A fzero column)
          (determinant reals (firstRowMinor A column))))

offDiagonalEntry :
  {R : Set} {n : Nat} ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Fin n ->
  Fin n ->
  R
offDiagonalEntry a b i j with parity (finToNat i + finToNat j)
... | even =
  a
... | odd =
  b

putnamMatrix :
  {R : Set} ->
  (n : Nat) ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Matrix R (twoN * n)
putnamMatrix n a b x i j with compareFin i j
... | less =
  offDiagonalEntry a b i j
... | equal =
  x
... | greater =
  offDiagonalEntry a b i j

module Putnam1984A3Statement
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) where

  quotient :
    Nat ->
    R ->
    R ->
    R ->
    R
  quotient n a b x =
    divide reals
      (determinant reals (putnamMatrix n a b x))
      (naturalPower reals
        (subtract reals x a)
        ((twoN * n) - twoN))

  solution :
    Nat ->
    R ->
    R ->
    R
  solution n a b =
    multiply reals
      (naturalPower reals (fromNat reals n) twoN)
      (subtract reals
        (naturalPower reals a twoN)
        (naturalPower reals b twoN))

  proposition : Set
  proposition =
    (n : Nat) ->
    Positive n ->
    (a b : R) ->
    a != b ->
    LimitAt reals
      (quotient n a b)
      (solution n a b)
      a

putnam-1984-a3 : Set1
putnam-1984-a3 =
  (R : Set) ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) ->
  Putnam1984A3Statement.proposition reals

title: putnam_1984_a3
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1984_a3:
  the punctured limit at a of the determinant quotient for the 2n by 2n real
  matrix whose off-diagonal entries alternate between a and b according to
  index parity is n squared times (a squared minus b squared). This file
  contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open arithmeticTheory fcpTheory realTheory real_topologyTheory;
open determinantTheory;

val putnam_1984_a3 =
  ``!n : num. !a b : real. !Mn : real -> real['N]['N].
      dimindex (:'N) = 2 * n /\
      0 < n /\
      a <> b /\
      Mn =
        (\x : real.
           FCP i j.
             if i = j then x
             else if EVEN (i + j) then a
             else b)
      ==>
      ((\x : real.
          determinant$det (Mn x) / (x - a) pow (2 * n - 2)) -->
       (&n : real) pow 2 * (a pow 2 - b pow 2))
        (at a)``;

content:
$(
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact
  putnam_1984_a3: evaluation of a punctured real limit involving the
  determinant of a parity-patterned two-n-by-two-n matrix. This file
  contains no proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  The matrix is indexed by 0 through 2n - 1, matching the Lean Fin
  indexing. Its diagonal entries are x; an off-diagonal entry is a when
  the sum of its indices is even and b otherwise. The Isabelle source
  uses indices 1 through 2n; shifting every index by one preserves both
  the parity of each index sum and the determinant.

  The limCC relation expresses the punctured two-sided limit, so the
  totalized value of the displayed quotient at x = a is irrelevant.
  The annotated solution polynomial evaluates to n^2 (a^2 - b^2).
  The final $a assertion is the statement encoding; no $p proof is
  supplied.
$)

${
  $d a b i j n x $.

  putnambench-putnam-1984-a3 $a |-
    A. n e. NN
      A. a e. RR
        A. b e. RR
          ( a =/= b ->
            ( ( n ^ 2 ) x. ( ( a ^ 2 ) - ( b ^ 2 ) ) ) e.
              ( ( x e. RR |->
                    ( ( ( ( 0 ..^ ( 2 x. n ) ) maDet RRfld ) `
                          ( i e. ( 0 ..^ ( 2 x. n ) ) ,
                            j e. ( 0 ..^ ( 2 x. n ) ) |->
                              if ( i = j , x ,
                                if ( ( ( i + j ) mod 2 ) = 0 ,
                                  a , b ) ) ) )
                      / ( ( x - a ) ^ ( ( 2 x. n ) - 2 ) ) ) )
                limCC a ) ) $.
$}

title: putnam_1984_a3
content:
% Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1984_a3:
% the punctured limit at a of a normalized determinant of a parity-patterned
% 2n-by-2n real matrix equals n^2 times (a^2 - b^2). This file contains no
% proof.

putnam_1984_a3: THEORY
BEGIN
  square_matrix: TYPE = [nat, nat -> real]
  real_function: TYPE = [real -> real]

  safe_div(numerator, denominator: real): real =
    IF denominator = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      numerator / denominator
    ENDIF

  quotient_aux(
      numerator, denominator, fuel: nat): RECURSIVE nat =
    IF fuel = 0
        OR denominator = 0
        OR numerator < denominator THEN
      0
    ELSE
      1
        + quotient_aux(
            numerator - denominator,
            denominator,
            fuel - 1)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE fuel

  remainder_aux(
      numerator, denominator, fuel: nat): RECURSIVE nat =
    IF fuel = 0
        OR denominator = 0
        OR numerator < denominator THEN
      numerator
    ELSE
      remainder_aux(
        numerator - denominator,
        denominator,
        fuel - 1)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE fuel

  safe_ndiv(numerator, denominator: nat): nat =
    quotient_aux(
      numerator,
      denominator,
      numerator + 1)

  safe_mod(numerator, denominator: nat): nat =
    IF denominator = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      remainder_aux(
        numerator,
        denominator,
        numerator + 1)
    ENDIF

  function_code_count(size: nat): nat =
    IF size = 0 THEN 1 ELSE size ^ size ENDIF

  permutation_entry(code, row, size: nat): nat =
    IF size = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      safe_mod(safe_ndiv(code, size ^ row), size)
    ENDIF

  permutation_code(code, size: nat): bool =
    code < function_code_count(size)
      AND (FORALL (row_1, row_2: nat):
        (row_1 < size
          AND row_2 < size
          AND permutation_entry(code, row_1, size)
            = permutation_entry(code, row_2, size))
        IMPLIES row_1 = row_2)

  pair_row(pair, size: nat): nat =
    safe_ndiv(pair, size)

  pair_column(pair, size: nat): nat =
    safe_mod(pair, size)

  inversion_at(code, pair, size: nat): bool =
    pair_row(pair, size) < size
      AND pair_column(pair, size) < size
      AND pair_row(pair, size) < pair_column(pair, size)
      AND permutation_entry(code, pair_row(pair, size), size)
        > permutation_entry(code, pair_column(pair, size), size)

  count_true(
      property: [nat -> bool],
      count: nat): RECURSIVE nat =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      count_true(property, count - 1)
        + IF property(count - 1) THEN 1 ELSE 0 ENDIF
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  inversion_count(code, size: nat): nat =
    count_true(
      (LAMBDA (pair: nat): inversion_at(code, pair, size)),
      size * size)

  permutation_sign(code, size: nat): real =
    IF mod(inversion_count(code, size), 2) = 0 THEN
      1
    ELSE
      -1
    ENDIF

  permutation_product(
      A: square_matrix,
      code, size, count: nat): RECURSIVE real =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      1
    ELSE
      permutation_product(A, code, size, count - 1)
        * A(
            count - 1,
            permutation_entry(code, count - 1, size))
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  determinant_sum(
      A: square_matrix,
      size, limit: nat): RECURSIVE real =
    IF limit = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      LET code: nat = limit - 1 IN
        determinant_sum(A, size, limit - 1)
          + IF permutation_code(code, size) THEN
              permutation_sign(code, size)
                * permutation_product(A, code, size, size)
            ELSE
              0
            ENDIF
    ENDIF
  MEASURE limit

  determinant(A: square_matrix, size: nat): real =
    determinant_sum(A, size, function_code_count(size))

  putnam_matrix(n: nat, a, b, x: real): square_matrix =
    LAMBDA (i, j: nat):
      IF i = j THEN
        x
      ELSIF mod(i + j, 2) = 0 THEN
        a
      ELSE
        b
      ENDIF

  normalized_determinant(n: nat, a, b, x: real): real =
    IF n = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      safe_div(
        determinant(putnam_matrix(n, a, b, x), 2 * n),
        (x - a) ^ (2 * n - 2))
    ENDIF

  tends_to_at(f: real_function, limit, point: real): bool =
    FORALL (epsilon_value: posreal):
      EXISTS (delta: posreal):
        FORALL (x: real):
          (0 < abs(x - point) AND abs(x - point) < delta)
            IMPLIES abs(f(x) - limit) < epsilon_value

  putnam_1984_a3_solution(n: nat, a, b: real): real =
    (n :: real) ^ 2 * (a ^ 2 - b ^ 2)

  putnam_1984_a3: bool =
    FORALL (n: nat), (a, b: real):
      (n > 0 AND a /= b)
      IMPLIES
        tends_to_at(
          LAMBDA (x: real):
            normalized_determinant(n, a, b, x),
          putnam_1984_a3_solution(n, a, b),
          a)
END putnam_1984_a3

import Mathlib

open Topology Filter Nat

abbrev putnam_1984_a5_solution : ℕ × ℕ × ℕ × ℕ × ℕ := sorry
-- (1, 9, 8, 4, 25)
/--
Let $R$ be the region consisting of all triples $(x,y,z)$ of nonnegative real numbers satisfying $x+y+z \leq 1$. Let $w=1-x-y-z$. Express the value of the triple integral $\iiint_R x^1y^9z^8w^4\,dx\,dy\,dz$ in the form $a!b!c!d!/n!$, where $a$, $b$, $c$, $d$, and $n$ are positive integers.
-/
theorem putnam_1984_a5
    (R : Set (Fin 3 → ℝ))
    (w : (Fin 3 → ℝ) → ℝ)
    (hR : R = {p | (∀ i : Fin 3, p i ≥ 0) ∧ p 0 + p 1 + p 2 ≤ 1})
    (hw : ∀ p, w p = 1 - p 0 - p 1 - p 2) :
      let (a, b, c, d, n) := putnam_1984_a5_solution;
      a > 0 ∧ b > 0 ∧ c > 0 ∧ d > 0 ∧ n > 0 ∧
      (∫ p in R, (p 0) ^ 1 * (p 1) ^ 9 * (p 2) ^ 8 * (w p) ^ 4 = ((a)! * (b)! * (c)! * (d)! : ℝ) / (n)!) :=
  sorry

Require Import Reals Factorial Coquelicot.Coquelicot.
Open Scope R.
Definition putnam_1984_a5_solution := INR (fact 9 * fact 8 * fact 4) / INR (fact 25).
Theorem putnam_1984_a5
    : RInt (fun z => RInt (fun y => RInt (fun x => x * pow y 9 * pow z 8 * pow (1 - x - y - z) 4) 0 (1 - y - z)) 0 (1 - z)) 0 1 = putnam_1984_a5_solution.
Proof. Admitted.

theory putnam_1984_a5 imports Complex_Main
"HOL-Analysis.Finite_Cartesian_Product"
"HOL-Analysis.Set_Integral"

begin

definition putnam_1984_a5_solution :: "nat \<times> nat \<times> nat \<times> nat \<times> nat" where "putnam_1984_a5_solution \<equiv> undefined"
(* (1, 9, 8, 4, 25) *)
theorem putnam_1984_a5:
  fixes R :: "(real \<times> real \<times> real) set"
    and w :: "(real \<times> real \<times> real) \<Rightarrow> real"
  defines "R \<equiv> {(x :: real, y :: real, z :: real). x \<ge> 0 \<and> y \<ge> 0 \<and> z \<ge> 0 \<and> x + y + z \<le> 1}"
    and "w \<equiv> \<lambda> (x :: real, y :: real, z :: real). 1 - x - y - z"
  shows "let (a, b, c, d, n) = putnam_1984_a5_solution in a > 0 \<and> b > 0 \<and> c > 0 \<and> d > 0 \<and> n > 0 \<and> 
set_lebesgue_integral lebesgue R (\<lambda> (x, y, z). x^1 * y^9 * z^8 * (w (x, y, z))^4) = fact a * fact b * fact c * fact d / fact n"
  sorry

end

;; Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1984_a5:
;; the real triple integral of x*y^9*z^8*(1-x-y-z)^4 over the nonnegative
;; unit simplex equals 1!*9!*8!*4!/25!. This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(defun putnam-1984-a5-factorial (n)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix n)))
  (if (zp n)
      1
    (* n (putnam-1984-a5-factorial (- n 1)))))

(defun putnam-1984-a5-solution ()
  (list 1 9 8 4 25))

(defun putnam-1984-a5-solution-value ()
  (let* ((solution (putnam-1984-a5-solution))
         (a (nth 0 solution))
         (b (nth 1 solution))
         (c (nth 2 solution))
         (d (nth 3 solution))
         (n (nth 4 solution)))
    (/ (* (putnam-1984-a5-factorial a)
          (putnam-1984-a5-factorial b)
          (putnam-1984-a5-factorial c)
          (putnam-1984-a5-factorial d))
       (putnam-1984-a5-factorial n))))

;; Extend the source integrand by zero from the simplex to the unit cube.
;; The arguments are grid indices, so every sampled value is exact rational
;; arithmetic even though the limit denotes the source's real integral.
(defun putnam-1984-a5-grid-integrand
    (x-index y-index z-index subdivisions)
  (if (posp subdivisions)
      (let* ((x (/ x-index subdivisions))
             (y (/ y-index subdivisions))
             (z (/ z-index subdivisions))
             (w (- 1 (+ x y z))))
        (if (<= 0 w)
            (* x
               (expt y 9)
               (expt z 8)
               (expt w 4))
          0))
    0))

(defun putnam-1984-a5-z-sum
    (x-index y-index remaining-z subdivisions)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix remaining-z)))
  (if (zp remaining-z)
      0
    (+ (putnam-1984-a5-grid-integrand
        x-index y-index remaining-z subdivisions)
       (putnam-1984-a5-z-sum
        x-index y-index (- remaining-z 1) subdivisions))))

(defun putnam-1984-a5-yz-sum
    (x-index remaining-y subdivisions)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix remaining-y)))
  (if (zp remaining-y)
      0
    (+ (putnam-1984-a5-z-sum
        x-index remaining-y subdivisions subdivisions)
       (putnam-1984-a5-yz-sum
        x-index (- remaining-y 1) subdivisions))))

(defun putnam-1984-a5-xyz-sum
    (remaining-x subdivisions)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix remaining-x)))
  (if (zp remaining-x)
      0
    (+ (putnam-1984-a5-yz-sum
        remaining-x subdivisions subdivisions)
       (putnam-1984-a5-xyz-sum
        (- remaining-x 1) subdivisions))))

(defun putnam-1984-a5-riemann-sum (subdivisions)
  (if (posp subdivisions)
      (/ (putnam-1984-a5-xyz-sum
          subdivisions subdivisions)
         (expt subdivisions 3))
    0))

;; Positive rational tolerances are cofinal among positive real tolerances.
;; Thus convergence of these exact rational grid sums states the real
;; Lebesgue (equivalently Riemann) integral equality without adding a rate.
(defun-sk putnam-1984-a5-tail-p (epsilon cutoff)
  (forall (subdivisions)
    (implies
     (and
      (natp subdivisions)
      (<= cutoff subdivisions))
     (< (abs
         (- (putnam-1984-a5-riemann-sum subdivisions)
            (putnam-1984-a5-solution-value)))
        epsilon))))

(defun-sk putnam-1984-a5-cutoff-exists-p (epsilon)
  (exists (cutoff)
    (and
     (natp cutoff)
     (< 0 cutoff)
     (putnam-1984-a5-tail-p epsilon cutoff))))

(defun putnambench-putnam-1984-a5-statement (epsilon)
  (implies
   (and (rationalp epsilon)
        (< 0 epsilon))
   (let* ((solution (putnam-1984-a5-solution))
          (a (nth 0 solution))
          (b (nth 1 solution))
          (c (nth 2 solution))
          (d (nth 3 solution))
          (n (nth 4 solution)))
     (and (< 0 a)
          (< 0 b)
          (< 0 c)
          (< 0 d)
          (< 0 n)
          (putnam-1984-a5-cutoff-exists-p epsilon)))))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

content:
-- Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact
-- putnambench__agda__putnam_1984_a5: evaluation of the monomial integral
-- over the nonnegative real three-simplex as a quotient of factorials.
-- This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; _*_)

infix 4 _!=_ _<N_ _<=N_
infixr 3 _and_
infixr 2 _or_

data Bottom : Set where

Not : Set -> Set
Not A =
  A -> Bottom

_!=_ : {A : Set} -> A -> A -> Set
x != y =
  Not (x == y)

record _and_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data _or_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  left  : A -> A or B
  right : B -> A or B

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

data _<N_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set where
  zero<succ : {n : Nat} -> zero <N suc n
  succ<succ : {m n : Nat} -> m <N n -> suc m <N suc n

data _<=N_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set where
  zero<=N   : {n : Nat} -> zero <=N n
  suc<=sucN : {m n : Nat} -> m <=N n -> suc m <=N suc n

record CompleteOrderedRealField (R : Set) : Set1 where
  field
    zeroR oneR : R
    add multiply : R -> R -> R
    negate inverse : R -> R
    lessOrEqual : R -> R -> Set
    fromNat : Nat -> R

    one-not-zero :
      oneR != zeroR

    add-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> add x y == add y x
    add-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      add (add x y) z == add x (add y z)
    add-zero :
      (x : R) -> add x zeroR == x
    add-inverse :
      (x : R) -> add x (negate x) == zeroR

    multiply-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> multiply x y == multiply y x
    multiply-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply (multiply x y) z ==
      multiply x (multiply y z)
    multiply-one :
      (x : R) -> multiply x oneR == x
    multiply-zero :
      (x : R) -> multiply x zeroR == zeroR
    distribute :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply x (add y z) ==
      add (multiply x y) (multiply x z)
    inverse-zero :
      inverse zeroR == zeroR
    multiply-inverse :
      (x : R) ->
      x != zeroR ->
      multiply x (inverse x) == oneR

    order-reflexive :
      (x : R) -> lessOrEqual x x
    order-transitive :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y z ->
      lessOrEqual x z
    order-antisymmetric :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y x ->
      x == y
    order-total :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y or lessOrEqual y x
    add-order :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual (add z x) (add z y)
    multiply-nonnegative :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR x ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR y ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR (multiply x y)
    zero-less-than-one :
      lessOrEqual zeroR oneR and zeroR != oneR

    fromNat-zero :
      fromNat zero == zeroR
    fromNat-successor :
      (n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (suc n) == add (fromNat n) oneR
    fromNat-addition :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m + n) == add (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-multiplication :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m * n) == multiply (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-injective :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat m == fromNat n ->
      m == n

    archimedean :
      (x : R) ->
      Exists Nat (\ n -> lessOrEqual x (fromNat n))
    least-upper-bound :
      (P : R -> Set) ->
      Exists R P ->
      Exists R
        (\ upper ->
          (x : R) ->
          P x ->
          lessOrEqual x upper) ->
      Exists R
        (\ supremum ->
          ((x : R) ->
            P x ->
            lessOrEqual x supremum)
          and
          ((upper : R) ->
            ((x : R) ->
              P x ->
              lessOrEqual x upper) ->
            lessOrEqual supremum upper))

open CompleteOrderedRealField

oneN : Nat
oneN =
  suc zero

twoN : Nat
twoN =
  suc oneN

threeN : Nat
threeN =
  suc twoN

fourN : Nat
fourN =
  suc threeN

fiveN : Nat
fiveN =
  suc fourN

eightN : Nat
eightN =
  fourN + fourN

nineN : Nat
nineN =
  suc eightN

twentyFiveN : Nat
twentyFiveN =
  fiveN * fiveN

subtract :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
subtract reals x y =
  add reals x (negate reals y)

divide :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
divide reals x y =
  multiply reals x (inverse reals y)

StrictLess :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
StrictLess reals x y =
  lessOrEqual reals x y and x != y

CloseTo :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
CloseTo reals center radius x =
  StrictLess reals
    (subtract reals center radius)
    x
  and
  StrictLess reals
    x
    (add reals center radius)

ConvergesTo :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  R ->
  Set
ConvergesTo {R} reals sequence limit =
  (epsilon : R) ->
  StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) epsilon ->
  Exists Nat
    (\ cutoff ->
      (n : Nat) ->
      cutoff <=N n ->
      CloseTo reals limit epsilon (sequence n))

Between :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
Between reals lower upper x =
  lessOrEqual reals lower x
  and
  lessOrEqual reals x upper

naturalPower :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  Nat ->
  R
naturalPower reals x zero =
  oneR reals
naturalPower reals x (suc n) =
  multiply reals
    (naturalPower reals x n)
    x

factorial : Nat -> Nat
factorial zero =
  oneN
factorial (suc n) =
  suc n * factorial n

sumFirst :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Nat ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  R
sumFirst reals zero terms =
  zeroR reals
sumFirst reals (suc n) terms =
  add reals
    (sumFirst reals n terms)
    (terms n)

midpointRiemannSum :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  (R -> R) ->
  Nat ->
  R
midpointRiemannSum reals lower upper function pieces =
  let
    step =
      divide reals
        (subtract reals upper lower)
        (fromNat reals pieces)
    halfStep =
      divide reals
        step
        (fromNat reals twoN)
  in
  sumFirst reals pieces
    (\ i ->
      multiply reals
        (function
          (add reals lower
            (add reals
              (multiply reals
                (fromNat reals i)
                step)
              halfStep)))
        step)

IntervalIntegralValue :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  (R -> R) ->
  R ->
  Set
IntervalIntegralValue reals lower upper function value =
  ConvergesTo reals
    (\ n ->
      midpointRiemannSum reals
        lower
        upper
        function
        (suc n))
    value

simplexRemainder :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
simplexRemainder reals x y z =
  subtract reals
    (subtract reals
      (subtract reals
        (oneR reals)
        x)
      y)
    z

integrand :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
integrand reals x y z =
  multiply reals
    (naturalPower reals x oneN)
    (multiply reals
      (naturalPower reals y nineN)
      (multiply reals
        (naturalPower reals z eightN)
        (naturalPower reals
          (simplexRemainder reals x y z)
          fourN)))

record IteratedSimplexIntegralValue
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R)
  (integralValue : R) :
  Set where

  field
    xIntegralValues :
      R ->
      R ->
      R

    x-integrals :
      (z : R) ->
      Between reals
        (zeroR reals)
        (oneR reals)
        z ->
      (y : R) ->
      Between reals
        (zeroR reals)
        (subtract reals (oneR reals) z)
        y ->
      IntervalIntegralValue reals
        (zeroR reals)
        (subtract reals
          (subtract reals (oneR reals) y)
          z)
        (\ x -> integrand reals x y z)
        (xIntegralValues z y)

    yIntegralValues :
      R ->
      R

    y-integrals :
      (z : R) ->
      Between reals
        (zeroR reals)
        (oneR reals)
        z ->
      IntervalIntegralValue reals
        (zeroR reals)
        (subtract reals (oneR reals) z)
        (xIntegralValues z)
        (yIntegralValues z)

    z-integral :
      IntervalIntegralValue reals
        (zeroR reals)
        (oneR reals)
        yIntegralValues
        integralValue

factorialAnswer :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R
factorialAnswer reals =
  divide reals
    (multiply reals
      (multiply reals
        (multiply reals
          (fromNat reals (factorial oneN))
          (fromNat reals (factorial nineN)))
        (fromNat reals (factorial eightN)))
      (fromNat reals (factorial fourN)))
    (fromNat reals (factorial twentyFiveN))

putnam-1984-a5 : Set1
putnam-1984-a5 =
  (R : Set) ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) ->
  (zero <N oneN)
  and
  (zero <N nineN)
  and
  (zero <N eightN)
  and
  (zero <N fourN)
  and
  (zero <N twentyFiveN)
  and
  IteratedSimplexIntegralValue reals
    (factorialAnswer reals)

  evaluation of a monomial triple integral over the nonnegative unit simplex
  as a quotient of factorials. This file contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open arithmeticTheory pred_setTheory realTheory integrationTheory;

val putnam_1984_a5 =
  ``0 < (1 : num) /\ 0 < (9 : num) /\ 0 < (8 : num) /\
    0 < (4 : num) /\ 0 < (25 : num) /\
    integration$integral (interval [0, 1])
      (\z : real.
         integration$integral (interval [0, 1 - z])
           (\y : real.
              integration$integral (interval [0, 1 - y - z])
                (\x : real.
                   x pow 1 * y pow 9 * z pow 8 *
                   (1 - x - y - z) pow 4))) =
    (&(FACT 1) * &(FACT 9) * &(FACT 8) * &(FACT 4)) / &(FACT 25)``;

$(
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact
  putnam_1984_a5: evaluation of a factorial-weighted monomial integral over
  the nonnegative three-dimensional unit simplex. This file contains no
  proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  The nested S. binders are set.mm's real Lebesgue integrals. Their closed
  intervals describe exactly the simplex slices

    0 <= z <= 1,  0 <= y <= 1-z,  0 <= x <= 1-y-z.

  The integrand is x^1 y^9 z^8 (1-x-y-z)^4. The right side retains all four
  positive factorial parameters from the Lean and Isabelle answer tuple;
  its 1! factor is one, so it is the same value as the Rocq expression
  9! 8! 4! / 25!. The final declaration is the single unproved $a corpus
  statement; this database contains no $p proof statement.
$)

${
  $d x y z $.

  putnambench-putnam-1984-a5 $a |-
    S. ( 0 [,] 1 )
      (
        S. ( 0 [,] ( 1 - z ) )
          (
            S. ( 0 [,] ( ( 1 - y ) - z ) )
              (
                (
                  (
                    (
                      ( x ^ 1 )
                      x.
                      ( y ^ 9 )
                    )
                    x.
                    ( z ^ 8 )
                  )
                  x.
                  ( ( ( ( 1 - x ) - y ) - z ) ^ 4 )
                )
              )
              _d x
          )
          _d y
      )
      _d z
    =
    (
      (
        (
          (
            ( ! ` 1 )
            x.
            ( ! ` 9 )
          )
          x.
          ( ! ` 8 )
        )
        x.
        ( ! ` 4 )
      )
      /
      ( ! ` ; 2 5 )
    )
  $.
$}
