  natural bound n there is an index i at least n with a(i) mod 100 = k.

  explicit solution inlined. The final declaration is the single unproved
  $a corpus statement; this database contains no $p proof declaration.

${
  $d a i k n $.

  putnambench-putnam-1985-a4 $a |-
    A. a e. ( NN0 ^m NN0 )
      (
        (
          ( a ` 1 ) = 3
          /\
          A. i e. NN

        ->
        {
          k e. ( 0 ..^ ; ; 1 0 0 ) |

            (
              n <_ i
              /\
              ( ( a ` i ) mod ; ; 1 0 0 ) = k

            IFF putnam_1985_a4_solution(residue))

(in-package "ACL2")

;; Standard ACL2 has exact rationals rather than primitive completed reals.
;; The functions below give the source integral a canonical rational Cauchy
;; name: Machin prefixes approximate pi, Taylor prefixes approximate cosine,
;; and midpoint sums approximate the finite-interval integral. Using one
;; precision parameter is a cofinal diagonal through these three limits.

(defun putnam-1985-a5-arctan-prefix (z terms)

  (if (zp terms)
      0
    (let* ((index (- terms 1))
           (degree (+ (* 2 index) 1))
           (sign (if (equal (mod index 2) 0) 1 -1)))

    (* n (putnam-1985-a5-factorial (- n 1)))))

  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix terms)))
  (if (zp terms)

    (let* ((index (- terms 1))
           (degree (* 2 index))
           (sign (if (equal (mod index 2) 0) 1 -1)))
      (+ (putnam-1985-a5-cosine-prefix x index)
         (/ (* sign (expt x degree))
            (putnam-1985-a5-factorial degree))))))

    (m x cosine-terms)

      1
    (* (putnam-1985-a5-cosine-prefix
        (* m x) cosine-terms)
       (putnam-1985-a5-cosine-product
        (- m 1) x cosine-terms))))

    (index pi-value subdivisions)

    (remaining m pi-value subdivisions cosine-terms)

-- Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1985_a5:
-- classification of the nonzero integrals over [0, 2*pi] of the products
-- cos(x) cos(2*x) ... cos(m*x), for 1 <= m <= 10. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; _*_)

infix 4 _!=_ _<=N_
infixr 3 _and_
infixr 2 _or_
infix 1 _iff_

data Bottom : Set where

Not : Set -> Set
Not A =
  A -> Bottom

_!=_ : {A : Set} -> A -> A -> Set
x != y =
  Not (x == y)

record _and_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data _or_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  left  : A -> A or B
  right : B -> A or B

record _iff_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor iff
  field
    forward  : A -> B
    backward : B -> A

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

data _<=N_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set where
  zero<=N   : {n : Nat} -> zero <=N n
  suc<=sucN : {m n : Nat} -> m <=N n -> suc m <=N suc n

oneN : Nat
oneN =
  suc zero

twoN : Nat
twoN =
  suc oneN

threeN : Nat
threeN =
  suc twoN

fourN : Nat
fourN =
  suc threeN

fiveN : Nat
fiveN =
  suc fourN

sixN : Nat
sixN =
  suc fiveN

sevenN : Nat
sevenN =
  suc sixN

eightN : Nat
eightN =
  suc sevenN

nineN : Nat
nineN =
  suc eightN

tenN : Nat
tenN =
  suc nineN

record CompleteOrderedRealField (R : Set) : Set1 where
  field
    zeroR oneR : R
    add multiply : R -> R -> R
    negate inverse : R -> R
    lessOrEqual : R -> R -> Set
    fromNat : Nat -> R

    one-not-zero :
      oneR != zeroR

    add-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> add x y == add y x
    add-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      add (add x y) z == add x (add y z)
    add-zero :
      (x : R) -> add x zeroR == x
    add-inverse :
      (x : R) -> add x (negate x) == zeroR

    multiply-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> multiply x y == multiply y x
    multiply-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply (multiply x y) z ==
      multiply x (multiply y z)
    multiply-one :
      (x : R) -> multiply x oneR == x
    multiply-zero :
      (x : R) -> multiply x zeroR == zeroR
    distribute :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply x (add y z) ==
      add (multiply x y) (multiply x z)
    inverse-zero :
      inverse zeroR == zeroR
    multiply-inverse :
      (x : R) ->
      x != zeroR ->
      multiply x (inverse x) == oneR

    order-reflexive :
      (x : R) -> lessOrEqual x x
    order-transitive :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y z ->
      lessOrEqual x z
    order-antisymmetric :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y x ->
      x == y
    order-total :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y or lessOrEqual y x
    add-order :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual (add z x) (add z y)
    multiply-nonnegative :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR x ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR y ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR (multiply x y)
    zero-less-than-one :
      lessOrEqual zeroR oneR and zeroR != oneR

    fromNat-zero :
      fromNat zero == zeroR
    fromNat-successor :
      (n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (suc n) == add (fromNat n) oneR
    fromNat-addition :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m + n) == add (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-multiplication :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m * n) == multiply (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-injective :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat m == fromNat n ->
      m == n

    archimedean :
      (x : R) ->
      Exists Nat (\ n -> lessOrEqual x (fromNat n))
    least-upper-bound :
      (P : R -> Set) ->
      Exists R P ->
      Exists R
        (\ upper ->
          (x : R) ->
          P x ->
          lessOrEqual x upper) ->
      Exists R
        (\ supremum ->
          ((x : R) ->
            P x ->
            lessOrEqual x supremum)
          and
          ((upper : R) ->
            ((x : R) ->
              P x ->
              lessOrEqual x upper) ->
            lessOrEqual supremum upper))

open CompleteOrderedRealField

subtract :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
subtract reals x y =
  add reals x (negate reals y)

divide :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
divide reals x y =
  multiply reals x (inverse reals y)

StrictLess :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
StrictLess reals x y =
  lessOrEqual reals x y and x != y

CloseTo :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
CloseTo reals center radius x =
  StrictLess reals
    (subtract reals center radius)
    x
  and
  StrictLess reals
    x
    (add reals center radius)

naturalPower :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  Nat ->
  R
naturalPower reals x zero =
  oneR reals
naturalPower reals x (suc n) =
  multiply reals
    (naturalPower reals x n)
    x

factorial : Nat -> Nat
factorial zero =
  oneN
factorial (suc n) =
  suc n * factorial n

sumFirst :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Nat ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  R
sumFirst reals zero terms =
  zeroR reals
sumFirst reals (suc n) terms =
  add reals
    (sumFirst reals n terms)
    (terms n)

ConvergesTo :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  R ->
  Set
ConvergesTo {R} reals sequence limit =
  (epsilon : R) ->
  StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) epsilon ->
  Exists Nat
    (\ cutoff ->
      (n : Nat) ->
      cutoff <=N n ->
      CloseTo reals limit epsilon (sequence n))

SeriesHasSum :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  R ->
  Set
SeriesHasSum reals terms limit =
  ConvergesTo reals
    (\ n -> sumFirst reals n terms)
    limit

alternatingPower :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Nat ->
  R
alternatingPower reals n =
  naturalPower reals
    (negate reals (oneR reals))
    n

cosineTerm :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  Nat ->
  R
cosineTerm reals x n =
  divide reals
    (multiply reals
      (alternatingPower reals n)
      (naturalPower reals x (twoN * n)))
    (fromNat reals (factorial (twoN * n)))

leibnizTerm :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Nat ->
  R
leibnizTerm reals n =
  divide reals
    (alternatingPower reals n)
    (fromNat reals (suc (twoN * n)))

record StandardCosine
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) : Set1 where
  field
    cosine : R -> R
    pi : R
    cosine-series :
      (x : R) ->
      SeriesHasSum reals
        (cosineTerm reals x)
        (cosine x)
    pi-positive :
      StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) pi
    pi-leibniz-series :
      SeriesHasSum reals
        (leibnizTerm reals)
        (divide reals pi (fromNat reals fourN))

open StandardCosine

cosineProduct :
  {R : Set} ->
  {reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R} ->
  StandardCosine reals ->
  Nat ->
  R ->
  R
cosineProduct {reals = reals} trigonometry zero x =
  oneR reals
cosineProduct {reals = reals} trigonometry (suc m) x =
  multiply reals
    (cosineProduct trigonometry m x)
    (cosine trigonometry
      (multiply reals
        (fromNat reals (suc m))
        x))

rightRiemannSum :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  (R -> R) ->
  Nat ->
  R
rightRiemannSum reals lower upper function pieces =
  let
    step =
      divide reals
        (subtract reals upper lower)
        (fromNat reals pieces)
  in
  sumFirst reals pieces
    (\ i ->
      multiply reals
        (function
          (add reals lower
            (multiply reals
              (fromNat reals (suc i))
              step)))
        step)

IntervalIntegralValue :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  (R -> R) ->
  R ->
  Set
IntervalIntegralValue reals lower upper function value =
  ConvergesTo reals
    (\ n ->
      rightRiemannSum reals
        lower
        upper
        function
        (suc n))
    value

IntegralAssignment :
  {R : Set} ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) ->
  StandardCosine reals ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  Set
IntegralAssignment reals trigonometry I =
  (m : Nat) ->
  IntervalIntegralValue reals
    (zeroR reals)
    (multiply reals
      (fromNat reals twoN)
      (pi trigonometry))
    (cosineProduct trigonometry m)
    (I m)

InRange : Nat -> Set
InRange m =
  oneN <=N m and m <=N tenN

InAnswer : Nat -> Set
InAnswer m =
  m == threeN or
  m == fourN or
  m == sevenN or
  m == eightN

putnam-1985-a5 : Set1
putnam-1985-a5 =
  (R : Set) ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) ->
  (trigonometry : StandardCosine reals) ->
  (I : Nat -> R) ->
  IntegralAssignment reals trigonometry I ->
  (m : Nat) ->
  InRange m ->
  _iff_ (I m != zeroR reals) (InAnswer m)

(*
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1985_a5:
  classification of the integers from 1 through 10 for which the integral
  from 0 to 2 pi of the product cos(x) cos(2x) ... cos(mx) is nonzero. This
  file contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open arithmeticTheory pred_setTheory realTheory real_sigmaTheory transcTheory
     integrationTheory;

val putnam_1985_a5 =
  ``let I =
      \m : num.
        integration$integral (interval [0, 2 * pi])
          (\x : real.
             real_sigma$product
               (count m)
               (\i : num. cos (&(i + 1) * x)))
    in
      !m : num.
        1 <= m /\ m <= 10
        ==>
        (I m <> 0 <=>
         m = 3 \/ m = 4 \/ m = 7 \/ m = 8)``;

$(

  putnam_1985_a5: classification of the integers from 1 through 10 for which
  the integral from 0 to 2 pi of the product of cos(k x) for 1 <= k <= m is
  nonzero. This file contains no proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  Set.mm's 1 ... m is the inclusive natural-number index interval, prod_ is
  its finite product, and S. is the real Lebesgue integral. Thus the left
  side of the biconditional is exactly I_m != 0 for the source integrand
  cos(x) cos(2x) ... cos(mx). The right side inlines the explicit solution
  predicate from the Rocq ground truth, equivalently the set {3, 4, 7, 8}
  identified by the other sources.

  The final declaration is the single unproved $a corpus statement; this
  database contains no $p proof statement.
$)

${
  $d k m x $.

  putnambench-putnam-1985-a5 $a |-
    A. m e. ( 1 ... ; 1 0 )
      (
        (
          S. ( 0 [,] ( 2 x. _pi ) )
            (
              prod_ k e. ( 1 ... m )
                ( cos ` ( k x. x ) )
            )
            _d x
        )
        =/=
        0
        <->
        (
          m = 3
          \/
          (
            m = 4
            \/
            (
              m = 7
              \/
              m = 8
            )
          )
        )
      )
  $.
$}

title: putnam_1985_a5
content:
% Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1985_a5:
% for 1 <= m <= 10, the integral from 0 to 2*pi of the product of cos(k*x)
% for k = 1,...,m is nonzero exactly when m is 3, 4, 7, or 8. This file
% contains no proof.

putnam_1985_a5: THEORY
BEGIN
  real_function: TYPE = [real -> real]
  real_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> real]

  safe_div(numerator, denominator: real): real =
    IF denominator = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      numerator / denominator
    ENDIF

  factorial(index: nat): RECURSIVE nat =
    IF index = 0 THEN
      1
    ELSE
      index * factorial(index - 1)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE index

  cosine_partial(x: real, count: nat): RECURSIVE real =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      LET index: nat = count - 1 IN
        cosine_partial(x, count - 1)
          + safe_div(
              ((-1 :: real) ^ index) * x ^ (2 * index),
              factorial(2 * index) :: real)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  converges_to(sequence: real_sequence, value: real): bool =
    FORALL (epsilon_value: posreal):
      EXISTS (cutoff: nat):
        FORALL (index: nat):
          cutoff <= index IMPLIES
            abs(sequence(index) - value) < epsilon_value

  cosine(x: real): real =
    epsilon(
      LAMBDA (value: real):
        converges_to(
          LAMBDA (count: nat): cosine_partial(x, count),
          value))

  pi: real =
    epsilon(
      LAMBDA (value: real):
        3 < value
          AND value < 4
          AND cosine(value / 2) = 0)

  cosine_product(m: nat, x: real): RECURSIVE real =
    IF m = 0 THEN
      1
    ELSE
      cosine_product(m - 1, x) * cosine((m :: real) * x)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE m

  valid_partition(
      lower, upper: real,
      points: real_sequence,
      count: nat): bool =
    IF lower = upper THEN
      count = 0 AND points(0) = lower
    ELSE
      count > 0
        AND points(0) = lower
        AND points(count) = upper
        AND (FORALL (index: nat):
          index < count IMPLIES
            points(index) < points(index + 1))
    ENDIF

  valid_tags(
      points, tags: real_sequence,
      count: nat): bool =
    FORALL (index: nat):
      index < count IMPLIES
        points(index) <= tags(index)
          AND tags(index) <= points(index + 1)

  mesh_less_than(
      points: real_sequence,
      count: nat,
      bound: real): bool =
    FORALL (index: nat):
      index < count IMPLIES
        points(index + 1) - points(index) < bound

  riemann_sum(
      f: real_function,
      points, tags: real_sequence,
      count: nat): RECURSIVE real =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      riemann_sum(f, points, tags, count - 1)
        + f(tags(count - 1))
            * (points(count) - points(count - 1))
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  has_interval_integral(
      f: real_function,
      integral_value, lower, upper: real): bool =
    lower <= upper
      AND FORALL (epsilon_value: posreal):
        EXISTS (mesh_bound: posreal):
          FORALL
              (points, tags: real_sequence),
              (count: nat):
            (valid_partition(lower, upper, points, count)
              AND valid_tags(points, tags, count)
              AND mesh_less_than(points, count, mesh_bound))
            IMPLIES
              abs(
                riemann_sum(f, points, tags, count)
                  - integral_value)
                < epsilon_value

  interval_integral(
      f: real_function,
      lower, upper: real): real =
    IF EXISTS (integral_value: real):
        has_interval_integral(f, integral_value, lower, upper)
    THEN
      epsilon(
        LAMBDA (integral_value: real):
          has_interval_integral(f, integral_value, lower, upper))
    ELSE
      0
    ENDIF

  putnam_1985_a5_solution(m: nat): bool =
    m = 3 OR m = 4 OR m = 7 OR m = 8

  putnam_1985_a5: bool =
    FORALL (m: nat):
      (1 <= m AND m <= 10) IMPLIES
        (interval_integral(
          LAMBDA (x: real): cosine_product(m, x),
          0,
          2 * pi) /= 0
          IFF putnam_1985_a5_solution(m))
END putnam_1985_a5

import Mathlib

open Set Filter Topology Real Polynomial

noncomputable abbrev putnam_1985_a6_solution : Polynomial ℝ := sorry
-- 6 * X ^ 2 + 5 * X + 1
/--
If $p(x)= a_0 + a_1 x + \cdots + a_m x^m$ is a polynomial with real coefficients $a_i$, then set
\[
\Gamma(p(x)) = a_0^2 + a_1^2 + \cdots + a_m^2.
\]
Let $F(x) = 3x^2+7x+2$. Find, with proof, a polynomial $g(x)$ with real coefficients such that
\begin{enumerate}
\item[(i)] $g(0)=1$, and
\item[(ii)] $\Gamma(f(x)^n) = \Gamma(g(x)^n)$
\end{enumerate}
for every integer $n \geq 1$.
-/
theorem putnam_1985_a6
  (Γ : Polynomial ℝ → ℝ)
  (f : Polynomial ℝ)
  (hΓ : Γ = fun p ↦ ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (p.natDegree + 1), coeff p k ^ 2)
  (hf : f = 3 * X ^ 2 + 7 * X + 2) :
  let g := putnam_1985_a6_solution;
  g.eval 0 = 1 ∧ ∀ n : ℕ, n ≥ 1 → Γ (f ^ n) = Γ (g ^ n) :=
sorry

From mathcomp Require Import all_ssreflect all_algebra.
From mathcomp Require Import reals.

Set Implicit Arguments.

Open Scope ring_scope.

Variable R : realType.
Definition putnam_1985_a6_solution : {poly R} := 6 * 'X ^ 2 + 5 * 'X + 1.
Theorem putnam_1985_a6
    (Gamma : {poly R} -> R := fun p => \sum_(i <- p) (i ^+ 2))
    (f : {poly R} := 3 * 'X ^ 2 + 7 * 'X + 2)
    : let g := putnam_1985_a6_solution in
      g.[0] = 1 /\ forall n : nat, ge n 1 -> Gamma (f ^ n) = Gamma (g ^ n).
Proof. Admitted.

(*
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1985_a6:
  equality of the sums of squared coefficients of every positive power of
  two specified real quadratic polynomials. This file contains no proof.
*)

needs "Library/iter.ml";;

let statement =
  `let pmul =
     \p q:num->real. \k:num.
       sum (0..k) (\i:num. p i * q (k - i)) in
   let ppow =
     \p:num->real. \n:num.
       ITER n (pmul p) (\k:num. if k = 0 then &1 else &0) in
   let gamma =
     \p:num->real.
       sum {k:num | ~(p k = &0)} (\k:num. (p k) pow 2) in
   let f =
     \k:num.
       if k = 0 then &2
       else if k = 1 then &7
       else if k = 2 then &3
       else &0 in
   let g =
     \k:num.
       if k = 0 then &1
       else if k = 1 then &5
       else if k = 2 then &6
       else &0 in
   g 0 = &1 /\
   (!n:num.
      1 <= n
      ==> gamma (ppow f n) = gamma (ppow g n))`;;

title: putnam_1985_a6
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1985_a6:
;; the coefficient-square sums of every positive power of 3*x^2+7*x+2 and
;; 6*x^2+5*x+1 are equal, with the latter polynomial taking value 1 at zero.
;; This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

;; Coefficients are stored in ascending degree order. Both source polynomials
;; have integer coefficients, and addition, multiplication, powering, and the
;; coefficient-square sum preserve integrality. Thus these exact coefficient
;; lists compute the same polynomials and Gamma values as the source real
;; polynomial operations under the canonical embedding of integers into the
;; reals; no arbitrary real coefficient domain is restricted.

(defun putnam-1985-a6-poly-add (left right)
  (cond
   ((consp left)
    (if (consp right)
        (cons (+ (car left) (car right))
              (putnam-1985-a6-poly-add
               (cdr left) (cdr right)))
      left))
   (t right)))

(defun putnam-1985-a6-poly-scale (scalar polynomial)
  (if (consp polynomial)
      (cons (* scalar (car polynomial))
            (putnam-1985-a6-poly-scale
             scalar (cdr polynomial)))
    nil))

(defun putnam-1985-a6-poly-multiply (left right)
  (if (consp left)
      (putnam-1985-a6-poly-add
       (putnam-1985-a6-poly-scale (car left) right)
       (cons 0
             (putnam-1985-a6-poly-multiply
              (cdr left) right)))
    nil))

(defun putnam-1985-a6-poly-power (polynomial exponent)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix exponent)))
  (if (zp exponent)
      (list 1)
    (putnam-1985-a6-poly-multiply
     polynomial
     (putnam-1985-a6-poly-power
      polynomial (- exponent 1)))))

(defun putnam-1985-a6-gamma (polynomial)
  (if (consp polynomial)
      (+ (* (car polynomial) (car polynomial))
         (putnam-1985-a6-gamma (cdr polynomial)))
    0))

(defun putnambench-putnam-1985-a6-statement (n)
  (implies
   (and (natp n)
        (<= 1 n))
   (let ((f '(2 7 3))
         (g '(1 5 6)))
     (and
      (equal (car g) 1)
      (equal
       (putnam-1985-a6-gamma
        (putnam-1985-a6-poly-power f n))
       (putnam-1985-a6-gamma
        (putnam-1985-a6-poly-power g n)))))))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

title: putnam_1985_a6
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1985_a6:
-- the real polynomials 3x^2 + 7x + 2 and 6x^2 + 5x + 1 have equal sums of
-- squared coefficients in every positive power, and the latter has value one
-- at zero. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.List using (List; []; _∷_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; _*_)

infix 4 _!=_
infixr 3 _and_
infixr 2 _or_

data Bottom : Set where

Not : Set -> Set
Not A =
  A -> Bottom

_!=_ : {A : Set} -> A -> A -> Set
x != y =
  Not (x == y)

record _and_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data _or_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  left  : A -> A or B
  right : B -> A or B

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

data Positive : Nat -> Set where
  positive : {n : Nat} -> Positive (suc n)

record CompleteOrderedRealField (R : Set) : Set1 where
  field
    zeroR oneR : R
    add multiply : R -> R -> R
    negate inverse : R -> R
    lessOrEqual : R -> R -> Set
    fromNat : Nat -> R

    one-not-zero :
      oneR != zeroR

    add-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> add x y == add y x
    add-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      add (add x y) z == add x (add y z)
    add-zero :
      (x : R) -> add x zeroR == x
    add-inverse :
      (x : R) -> add x (negate x) == zeroR

    multiply-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> multiply x y == multiply y x
    multiply-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply (multiply x y) z ==
      multiply x (multiply y z)
    multiply-one :
      (x : R) -> multiply x oneR == x
    multiply-zero :
      (x : R) -> multiply x zeroR == zeroR
    distribute :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply x (add y z) ==
      add (multiply x y) (multiply x z)
    inverse-zero :
      inverse zeroR == zeroR
    multiply-inverse :
      (x : R) ->
      x != zeroR ->
      multiply x (inverse x) == oneR

    order-reflexive :
      (x : R) -> lessOrEqual x x
    order-transitive :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y z ->
      lessOrEqual x z
    order-antisymmetric :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y x ->
      x == y
    order-total :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y or lessOrEqual y x
    add-order :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual (add z x) (add z y)
    multiply-nonnegative :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR x ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR y ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR (multiply x y)
    zero-less-than-one :
      lessOrEqual zeroR oneR and zeroR != oneR

    fromNat-zero :
      fromNat zero == zeroR
    fromNat-successor :
      (n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (suc n) == add (fromNat n) oneR
    fromNat-addition :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m + n) == add (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-multiplication :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m * n) == multiply (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-injective :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat m == fromNat n ->
      m == n

    archimedean :
      (x : R) ->
      Exists Nat
        (\ n ->
          lessOrEqual x (fromNat n))
    least-upper-bound :
      (P : R -> Set) ->
      Exists R P ->
      Exists R
        (\ upper ->
          (x : R) ->
          P x ->
          lessOrEqual x upper) ->
      Exists R
        (\ supremum ->
          ((x : R) ->
            P x ->
            lessOrEqual x supremum)
          and
          ((upper : R) ->
            ((x : R) ->
              P x ->
              lessOrEqual x upper) ->
            lessOrEqual supremum upper))

open CompleteOrderedRealField

Polynomial : Set -> Set
Polynomial R =
  List R

addPolynomial :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Polynomial R ->
  Polynomial R ->
  Polynomial R
addPolynomial reals [] q =
  q
addPolynomial reals p [] =
  p
addPolynomial reals (a ∷ p) (b ∷ q) =
  add reals a b ∷ addPolynomial reals p q

scalePolynomial :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  Polynomial R ->
  Polynomial R
scalePolynomial reals c [] =
  []
scalePolynomial reals c (a ∷ p) =
  multiply reals c a ∷ scalePolynomial reals c p

multiplyPolynomial :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Polynomial R ->
  Polynomial R ->
  Polynomial R
multiplyPolynomial reals [] q =
  []
multiplyPolynomial reals (a ∷ p) q =
  addPolynomial reals
    (scalePolynomial reals a q)
    (zeroR reals ∷ multiplyPolynomial reals p q)

powerPolynomial :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Polynomial R ->
  Nat ->
  Polynomial R
powerPolynomial reals p zero =
  oneR reals ∷ []
powerPolynomial reals p (suc n) =
  multiplyPolynomial reals p (powerPolynomial reals p n)

evaluatePolynomial :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Polynomial R ->
  R ->
  R
evaluatePolynomial reals [] x =
  zeroR reals
evaluatePolynomial reals (a ∷ p) x =
  add reals a
    (multiply reals x (evaluatePolynomial reals p x))

coefficientSquareSum :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Polynomial R ->
  R
coefficientSquareSum reals [] =
  zeroR reals
coefficientSquareSum reals (a ∷ p) =
  add reals
    (multiply reals a a)
    (coefficientSquareSum reals p)

module Putnam1985A6Statement
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) where

  f : Polynomial R
  f =
    fromNat reals 2 ∷
    fromNat reals 7 ∷
    fromNat reals 3 ∷
    []

  g : Polynomial R
  g =
    fromNat reals 1 ∷
    fromNat reals 5 ∷
    fromNat reals 6 ∷
    []

  Gamma : Polynomial R -> R
  Gamma =
    coefficientSquareSum reals

  proposition : Set
  proposition =
    evaluatePolynomial reals g (zeroR reals) == oneR reals
    and
    ((n : Nat) ->
      Positive n ->
      Gamma (powerPolynomial reals f n)
      ==
      Gamma (powerPolynomial reals g n))

putnam-1985-a6 : Set1
putnam-1985-a6 =
  (R : Set) ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) ->
  Putnam1985A6Statement.proposition reals

(*
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1985_a6:
  a real polynomial with constant term one whose positive integer powers have
  the same sum of squared coefficients as those of 3x^2 + 7x + 2. This file
  contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open arithmeticTheory listTheory realTheory polyTheory;

val putnam_1985_a6 =
  ``!(Gamma : real list -> real) (f : real list).
      Gamma =
        (\p : real list.
           FOLDR (\a acc. a pow 2 + acc) 0 p) /\
      f = [2; 7; 3]
      ==>
      let g = ([1; 5; 6] : real list)
      in
        poly g 0 = 1 /\
        !n : num.
          1 <= n
          ==>
          Gamma (f poly_exp n) = Gamma (g poly_exp n)``;

content:
$(
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact
  putnam_1985_a6: the real polynomials 3x^2 + 7x + 2 and
  6x^2 + 5x + 1 have equal sums of squared coefficients in every
  positive integral power, and the latter polynomial has value 1 at zero.
  This file contains no proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  Poly1 ` RRfld is set.mm's ring of finite-support univariate real
  polynomials, var1 is its indeterminate, and algSc embeds real constants.
  P85A6F and P85A6G are respectively the source polynomial f and the explicit
  solution g recorded by every ground-truth source.

  The coefficient map coe1 sends a polynomial to its complete NN0-indexed
  coefficient function. Because this function has finite support, summing its
  squared values over NN0 is definitionally the source quantity Gamma. The
  exponentiation in the final assertion is polynomial-ring exponentiation,
  and NN is exactly the source range of natural n with n >= 1.

  All declarations below are unproved $a statement encodings; this database
  contains no $p proof declaration.
$)

$c P85A6F P85A6G P85A6Gamma $.

p85a6-f-syntax $a class P85A6F $.
p85a6-g-syntax $a class P85A6G $.
p85a6-gamma-syntax $a class P85A6Gamma $.

p85a6-f-definition $a |- P85A6F =
  (
    (
      (
        ( ( algSc ` ( Poly1 ` RRfld ) ) ` 3 )
        ( .r ` ( Poly1 ` RRfld ) )
        (
          2
          ( .g ` ( mulGrp ` ( Poly1 ` RRfld ) ) )
          ( var1 ` RRfld )
        )
      )
      ( +g ` ( Poly1 ` RRfld ) )
      (
        ( ( algSc ` ( Poly1 ` RRfld ) ) ` 7 )
        ( .r ` ( Poly1 ` RRfld ) )
        ( var1 ` RRfld )
      )
    )
    ( +g ` ( Poly1 ` RRfld ) )
    ( ( algSc ` ( Poly1 ` RRfld ) ) ` 2 )
  ) $.

p85a6-g-definition $a |- P85A6G =
  (
    (
      (
        ( ( algSc ` ( Poly1 ` RRfld ) ) ` 6 )
        ( .r ` ( Poly1 ` RRfld ) )
        (
          2
          ( .g ` ( mulGrp ` ( Poly1 ` RRfld ) ) )
          ( var1 ` RRfld )
        )
      )
      ( +g ` ( Poly1 ` RRfld ) )
      (
        ( ( algSc ` ( Poly1 ` RRfld ) ) ` 5 )
        ( .r ` ( Poly1 ` RRfld ) )
        ( var1 ` RRfld )
      )
    )
    ( +g ` ( Poly1 ` RRfld ) )
    ( ( algSc ` ( Poly1 ` RRfld ) ) ` 1 )
  ) $.

${
  $d k p $.

  p85a6-gamma-definition $a |- P85A6Gamma =
    (
      p e. ( Base ` ( Poly1 ` RRfld ) ) |->
        sum_ k e. NN0
          ( ( ( ( coe1 ` p ) ` k ) ) ^ 2 )
    ) $.
$}

putnambench-putnam-1985-a6 $a |- (
  (
    ( ( ( eval1 ` RRfld ) ` P85A6G ) ` 0 )
    =
    1
  )
  /\
  A. n e. NN
    (
      P85A6Gamma
      `
      (
        n
        ( .g ` ( mulGrp ` ( Poly1 ` RRfld ) ) )
        P85A6F
      )
    )
    =
    (
      P85A6Gamma
      `
      (
        n
        ( .g ` ( mulGrp ` ( Poly1 ` RRfld ) ) )
        P85A6G
      )
    )
  ) $.

title: putnam_1985_a6
content:
% Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench artifact putnam_1985_a6:
% the polynomial g(x) = 6x^2 + 5x + 1 has constant value one at zero and,
% for every positive power, the same sum of squared coefficients as
% f(x) = 3x^2 + 7x + 2. This file contains no proof.

putnam_1985_a6: THEORY
BEGIN
  polynomial_value(
      polynomial: list[real],
      x: real): RECURSIVE real =
    CASES polynomial OF
      null: 0,
      cons(coefficient, tail):
        coefficient + x * polynomial_value(tail, x)
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE polynomial BY <<

  polynomial_add(
      left, right: list[real]): RECURSIVE list[real] =
    CASES left OF
      null: right,
      cons(left_coefficient, left_tail):
        CASES right OF
          null: left,
          cons(right_coefficient, right_tail):
            cons(
              left_coefficient + right_coefficient,
              polynomial_add(left_tail, right_tail))
        ENDCASES
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE left BY <<

  polynomial_scale(
      scalar: real,
      polynomial: list[real]): RECURSIVE list[real] =
    CASES polynomial OF
      null: null,
      cons(coefficient, tail):
        cons(
          scalar * coefficient,
          polynomial_scale(scalar, tail))
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE polynomial BY <<

  polynomial_multiply(
      left, right: list[real]): RECURSIVE list[real] =
    CASES left OF
      null: null,
      cons(coefficient, tail):
        polynomial_add(
          polynomial_scale(coefficient, right),
          cons(0, polynomial_multiply(tail, right)))
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE left BY <<

  polynomial_power(
      polynomial: list[real],
      exponent: nat): RECURSIVE list[real] =
    IF exponent = 0 THEN
      cons(1, null)
    ELSE
      polynomial_multiply(
        polynomial,
        polynomial_power(polynomial, exponent - 1))
    ENDIF
  MEASURE exponent

  gamma(polynomial: list[real]): RECURSIVE real =
    CASES polynomial OF
      null: 0,
      cons(coefficient, tail):
        coefficient ^ 2 + gamma(tail)
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE polynomial BY <<

  f: list[real] =
    cons(2, cons(7, cons(3, null)))

  putnam_1985_a6_solution: list[real] =
    cons(1, cons(5, cons(6, null)))

  putnam_1985_a6: bool =
    polynomial_value(putnam_1985_a6_solution, 0) = 1
      AND (FORALL (n: nat):
        n >= 1 IMPLIES
          gamma(polynomial_power(f, n))
            = gamma(
                polynomial_power(
                  putnam_1985_a6_solution, n)))
END putnam_1985_a6

title: putnam_1985_b1
content:
(* Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench artifact putnam_1985_b1:
   the five distinct integer roots -2, -1, 0, 1, 2 minimize the number of
   nonzero coefficients in their monic real quintic. This file contains no
   proof. *)

From Stdlib Require Import Reals ZArith Lists.List.

Open Scope R_scope.

Record putnam_1985_b1_roots : Type := {
  putnam_1985_b1_m1 : Z;
  putnam_1985_b1_m2 : Z;
  putnam_1985_b1_m3 : Z;
  putnam_1985_b1_m4 : Z;
  putnam_1985_b1_m5 : Z
}.

Definition putnam_1985_b1_distinct
    (m : putnam_1985_b1_roots) : Prop :=
  putnam_1985_b1_m1 m <> putnam_1985_b1_m2 m /\
  putnam_1985_b1_m1 m <> putnam_1985_b1_m3 m /\
  putnam_1985_b1_m1 m <> putnam_1985_b1_m4 m /\
  putnam_1985_b1_m1 m <> putnam_1985_b1_m5 m /\
  putnam_1985_b1_m2 m <> putnam_1985_b1_m3 m /\
  putnam_1985_b1_m2 m <> putnam_1985_b1_m4 m /\
  putnam_1985_b1_m2 m <> putnam_1985_b1_m5 m /\
  putnam_1985_b1_m3 m <> putnam_1985_b1_m4 m /\
  putnam_1985_b1_m3 m <> putnam_1985_b1_m5 m /\
  putnam_1985_b1_m4 m <> putnam_1985_b1_m5 m.

Definition putnam_1985_b1_linear_factor (root : Z) : list R :=
  (- IZR root) :: 1 :: nil.

Fixpoint putnam_1985_b1_poly_add
    (p q : list R) : list R :=
  match p, q with
  | nil, q' => q'
  | p', nil => p'
  | a :: p', b :: q' =>
      (a + b) :: putnam_1985_b1_poly_add p' q'
  end.

Fixpoint putnam_1985_b1_poly_scale
    (a : R) (p : list R) : list R :=
  match p with
  | nil => nil
  | b :: p' => (a * b) :: putnam_1985_b1_poly_scale a p'
  end.

Fixpoint putnam_1985_b1_poly_mul
    (p q : list R) : list R :=
  match p with
  | nil => nil
  | a :: p' =>
      putnam_1985_b1_poly_add
        (putnam_1985_b1_poly_scale a q)
        (0 :: putnam_1985_b1_poly_mul p' q)
  end.

Definition putnam_1985_b1_polynomial
    (m : putnam_1985_b1_roots) : list R :=
  putnam_1985_b1_poly_mul
    (putnam_1985_b1_linear_factor (putnam_1985_b1_m1 m))
    (putnam_1985_b1_poly_mul
      (putnam_1985_b1_linear_factor (putnam_1985_b1_m2 m))
      (putnam_1985_b1_poly_mul
        (putnam_1985_b1_linear_factor (putnam_1985_b1_m3 m))
        (putnam_1985_b1_poly_mul
          (putnam_1985_b1_linear_factor (putnam_1985_b1_m4 m))
          (putnam_1985_b1_linear_factor (putnam_1985_b1_m5 m))))).

Fixpoint putnam_1985_b1_nonzero_coefficients
    (p : list R) : nat :=
  match p with
  | nil => O
  | a :: p' =>
      if Req_EM_T a 0
      then putnam_1985_b1_nonzero_coefficients p'
      else S (putnam_1985_b1_nonzero_coefficients p')
  end.

Definition putnam_1985_b1_solution : putnam_1985_b1_roots :=
  {| putnam_1985_b1_m1 := (-2)%Z;
     putnam_1985_b1_m2 := (-1)%Z;
     putnam_1985_b1_m3 := 0%Z;
     putnam_1985_b1_m4 := 1%Z;
     putnam_1985_b1_m5 := 2%Z |}.

Theorem putnam_1985_b1 :
  putnam_1985_b1_distinct putnam_1985_b1_solution /\
  forall m : putnam_1985_b1_roots,
    putnam_1985_b1_distinct m ->
    (putnam_1985_b1_nonzero_coefficients
       (putnam_1985_b1_polynomial putnam_1985_b1_solution) <=
     putnam_1985_b1_nonzero_coefficients
       (putnam_1985_b1_polynomial m))%nat.
Admitted.

(*
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1985_b1:
  the five distinct integers -2, -1, 0, 1, 2 minimize the number of nonzero
  coefficients in their associated product of five monic linear factors.
  This file contains no proof.
*)

let statement =
  `let pmul =
     \p q:num->real. \k:num.
       sum (0..k) (\i:num. p i * q (k - i)) in
   let linear =
     \m:int. \k:num.
       if k = 0 then --(real_of_int m)
       else if k = 1 then &1
       else &0 in
   let p =
     \m1 m2 m3 m4 m5:int.
       pmul
         (pmul
           (pmul
             (pmul (linear m1) (linear m2))
             (linear m3))
           (linear m4))
         (linear m5) in
   let numnzcoeff =
     \q:num->real. CARD {k:num | ~(q k = &0)} in
   {--(&2:int), --(&1:int), (&0:int), (&1:int), (&2:int)} HAS_SIZE 5 /\
   (!a b c d e:int.
      {a,b,c,d,e} HAS_SIZE 5
      ==> numnzcoeff
            (p (--(&2:int)) (--(&1:int)) (&0:int) (&1:int) (&2:int))
          <= numnzcoeff (p a b c d e))`;;

title: putnam_1985_b1
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1985_b1:
;; the five distinct integers -2,-1,0,1,2 minimize the number of nonzero
;; coefficients of a monic polynomial with five distinct integer roots.
;; This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(defun putnam-1985-b1-integer-list-p (values)
  (if (consp values)
      (and (integerp (car values))
           (putnam-1985-b1-integer-list-p (cdr values)))
    (equal values nil)))

(defun putnam-1985-b1-distinct-from-p (value values)
  (if (consp values)
      (and (not (equal value (car values)))
           (putnam-1985-b1-distinct-from-p value (cdr values)))
    t))

(defun putnam-1985-b1-pairwise-distinct-p (values)
  (if (consp values)
      (and (putnam-1985-b1-distinct-from-p
            (car values) (cdr values))
           (putnam-1985-b1-pairwise-distinct-p (cdr values)))
    t))

;; If COEFFICIENTS lists c_0,...,c_n in ascending degree order, this returns
;; the coefficient list of (x-M)*(c_0+c_1*x+...+c_n*x^n).
(defun putnam-1985-b1-multiply-linear
    (coefficients m previous)
  (if (consp coefficients)
      (cons (+ (* (- m) (car coefficients)) previous)
            (putnam-1985-b1-multiply-linear
             (cdr coefficients) m (car coefficients)))
    (list previous)))

(defun putnam-1985-b1-polynomial-from-roots (roots)
  (if (consp roots)
      (putnam-1985-b1-multiply-linear
       (putnam-1985-b1-polynomial-from-roots (cdr roots))
       (car roots)
       0)
    (list 1)))

(defun putnam-1985-b1-count-nonzero (coefficients)
  (if (consp coefficients)
      (+ (if (equal (car coefficients) 0) 0 1)
         (putnam-1985-b1-count-nonzero (cdr coefficients)))
    0))

(defun putnam-1985-b1-solution ()
  (list -2 -1 0 1 2))

;; A length-five integer list is canonically the source function Fin 5 -> Z.
;; Expanding the five linear factors gives integer coefficients, whose
;; embedding into the reals preserves exactly which coefficients are zero.
(defun putnambench-putnam-1985-b1-statement (roots)
  (let ((solution (putnam-1985-b1-solution)))
    (and
     (putnam-1985-b1-pairwise-distinct-p solution)
     (implies
      (and
       (true-listp roots)
       (equal (len roots) 5)
       (putnam-1985-b1-integer-list-p roots)
       (putnam-1985-b1-pairwise-distinct-p roots))
      (<=
       (putnam-1985-b1-count-nonzero
        (putnam-1985-b1-polynomial-from-roots solution))
       (putnam-1985-b1-count-nonzero
        (putnam-1985-b1-polynomial-from-roots roots)))))))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

-- Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1985_b1:
-- the distinct integers -2, -1, 0, 1, 2 minimize the number of nonzero
-- coefficients in a monic polynomial having five distinct integer roots.
-- This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

open import Agda.Builtin.Bool using (Bool; false; true)
open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Int using (Int; pos; negsuc)
open import Agda.Builtin.List using (List; []; _∷_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; _*_)

infix 4 _<=N_
infixr 3 _and_

record _and_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data _<=N_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set where
  zero<=N   : {n : Nat} -> zero <=N n
  suc<=sucN : {m n : Nat} -> m <=N n -> suc m <=N suc n

data Fin5 : Set where
  i0 i1 i2 i3 i4 : Fin5

Injective : {A B : Set} -> (A -> B) -> Set
Injective f =
  (x y : _) ->
  f x == f y ->
  x == y

negative : Nat -> Int
negative zero =
  pos zero
negative (suc n) =
  negsuc n

negateInt : Int -> Int
negateInt (pos zero) =
  pos zero
negateInt (pos (suc n)) =
  negsuc n
negateInt (negsuc n) =
  pos (suc n)

difference : Nat -> Nat -> Int
difference zero zero =
  pos zero
difference (suc m) zero =
  pos (suc m)
difference zero (suc n) =
  negsuc n
difference (suc m) (suc n) =
  difference m n

addInt : Int -> Int -> Int
addInt (pos m) (pos n) =
  pos (m + n)
addInt (pos m) (negsuc n) =
  difference m (suc n)
addInt (negsuc m) (pos n) =
  difference n (suc m)
addInt (negsuc m) (negsuc n) =
  negsuc (suc (m + n))

multiplyInt : Int -> Int -> Int
multiplyInt (pos m) (pos n) =
  pos (m * n)
multiplyInt (pos m) (negsuc n) =
  negative (m * suc n)
multiplyInt (negsuc m) (pos n) =
  negative (suc m * n)
multiplyInt (negsuc m) (negsuc n) =
  pos (suc m * suc n)

natEqual : Nat -> Nat -> Bool
natEqual zero zero =
  true
natEqual zero (suc n) =
  false
natEqual (suc m) zero =
  false
natEqual (suc m) (suc n) =
  natEqual m n

intEqual : Int -> Int -> Bool
intEqual (pos m) (pos n) =
  natEqual m n
intEqual (pos m) (negsuc n) =
  false
intEqual (negsuc m) (pos n) =
  false
intEqual (negsuc m) (negsuc n) =
  natEqual m n

Polynomial : Set
Polynomial =
  List Int

addPolynomial : Polynomial -> Polynomial -> Polynomial
addPolynomial [] q =
  q
addPolynomial p [] =
  p
addPolynomial (a ∷ p) (b ∷ q) =
  addInt a b ∷ addPolynomial p q

scalePolynomial : Int -> Polynomial -> Polynomial
scalePolynomial c [] =
  []
scalePolynomial c (a ∷ p) =
  multiplyInt c a ∷ scalePolynomial c p

multiplyPolynomial : Polynomial -> Polynomial -> Polynomial
multiplyPolynomial [] q =
  []
multiplyPolynomial (a ∷ p) q =
  addPolynomial
    (scalePolynomial a q)
    (pos zero ∷ multiplyPolynomial p q)

oneN : Nat
oneN =
  suc zero

onePolynomial : Polynomial
onePolynomial =
  pos oneN ∷ []

linearFactor : Int -> Polynomial
linearFactor root =
  negateInt root ∷ pos oneN ∷ []

polynomialFromRoots : (Fin5 -> Int) -> Polynomial
polynomialFromRoots roots =
  multiplyPolynomial
    (linearFactor (roots i0))
    (multiplyPolynomial
      (linearFactor (roots i1))
      (multiplyPolynomial
        (linearFactor (roots i2))
        (multiplyPolynomial
          (linearFactor (roots i3))
          (multiplyPolynomial
            (linearFactor (roots i4))
            onePolynomial))))

nonzeroCoefficientCount : Polynomial -> Nat
nonzeroCoefficientCount [] =
  zero
nonzeroCoefficientCount (coefficient ∷ coefficients)
  with intEqual coefficient (pos zero)
... | true =
  nonzeroCoefficientCount coefficients
... | false =
  suc (nonzeroCoefficientCount coefficients)

solution : Fin5 -> Int
solution i0 =
  negsuc oneN
solution i1 =
  negsuc zero
solution i2 =
  pos zero
solution i3 =
  pos oneN
solution i4 =
  pos (suc oneN)

putnam-1985-b1 : Set
putnam-1985-b1 =
  Injective solution
  and
  ((roots : Fin5 -> Int) ->
    Injective roots ->
    nonzeroCoefficientCount (polynomialFromRoots solution)
    <=N
    nonzeroCoefficientCount (polynomialFromRoots roots))

(*
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1985_b1:
  the five distinct integers -2, -1, 0, 1, and 2 minimize the number of
  nonzero coefficients in their monic real polynomial among all choices of
  five distinct integer roots. This file contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open arithmeticTheory integerTheory intrealTheory listTheory realTheory
     polyTheory;

val putnam_1985_b1 =
  ``let putnam_1985_b1_solution = ([~2; ~1; 0; 1; 2] : int list)
    in
    let factor =
      \m : int. ([~(real_of_int m); 1] : real list)
    in
    let p =
      \m1 m2 m3 m4 m5 : int.
        poly_mul (factor m1)
          (poly_mul (factor m2)
            (poly_mul (factor m3)
              (poly_mul (factor m4) (factor m5))))
    in
    let numnzcoeff =
      \P : real list. LENGTH (FILTER (\c : real. c <> 0) P)
    in
      ALL_DISTINCT putnam_1985_b1_solution /\
      !a b c d e : int.
        ALL_DISTINCT [a; b; c; d; e]
        ==>
        numnzcoeff (p (~2) (~1) 0 1 2) <=
        numnzcoeff (p a b c d e)``;

title: putnam_1985_b1
content:
$(
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact
  putnam_1985_b1: the five distinct integers -2, -1, 0, 1, and 2 minimize
  the number of nonzero coefficients of the product of the corresponding
  five monic linear real polynomials among all five distinct integers.
  This file contains no proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  The half-open ordinal interval 0 ..^ 5 is the carrier Fin 5, and
  P85B1Solution is the source solution i |-> i - 2. P85B1Poly maps an
  arbitrary integer-valued function on that carrier to the product
  prod_i (X - m_i) in set.mm's finite-support univariate polynomial ring
  over the real field. The integer values are canonically real and algSc
  embeds them as constant polynomials.

  P85B1Nnz is the cardinality of the support of the complete NN0-indexed
  coefficient function. Every polynomial has finite support, and every
  P85B1Poly value is monic and nonzero, so this is exactly the source count
  over indices through natDegree/degree. The final assertion requires the
  displayed solution to be injective and compares its count with every
  injective integer-valued function on Fin 5.

  All declarations below are unproved $a statement encodings; this database
  contains no $p proof declaration.
$)

$c P85B1Solution P85B1Poly P85B1Nnz $.

p85b1-solution-syntax $a class P85B1Solution $.
p85b1-poly-syntax $a class P85B1Poly $.
p85b1-nnz-syntax $a class P85B1Nnz $.

${
  p85b1-solution-definition $a |- P85B1Solution =
    ( i e. ( 0 ..^ 5 ) |-> ( i - 2 ) ) $.
$}

${
  p85b1-poly-definition $a |- P85B1Poly =
    (
      m e. ( ZZ ^m ( 0 ..^ 5 ) ) |->
        (
          (
            (
              (
                (
                  ( var1 ` RRfld )
                  ( -g ` ( Poly1 ` RRfld ) )
                  (
                    ( algSc ` ( Poly1 ` RRfld ) )
                    `
                    ( m ` 0 )
                  )
                )
                ( .r ` ( Poly1 ` RRfld ) )
                (
                  ( var1 ` RRfld )
                  ( -g ` ( Poly1 ` RRfld ) )
                  (
                    ( algSc ` ( Poly1 ` RRfld ) )
                    `
                    ( m ` 1 )
                  )
                )
              )
              ( .r ` ( Poly1 ` RRfld ) )
              (
                ( var1 ` RRfld )
                ( -g ` ( Poly1 ` RRfld ) )
                (
                  ( algSc ` ( Poly1 ` RRfld ) )
                  `
                  ( m ` 2 )
                )
              )
            )
            ( .r ` ( Poly1 ` RRfld ) )
            (
              ( var1 ` RRfld )
              ( -g ` ( Poly1 ` RRfld ) )
              (
                ( algSc ` ( Poly1 ` RRfld ) )
                `
                ( m ` 3 )
              )
            )
          )
          ( .r ` ( Poly1 ` RRfld ) )
          (
            ( var1 ` RRfld )
            ( -g ` ( Poly1 ` RRfld ) )
            (
              ( algSc ` ( Poly1 ` RRfld ) )
              `
              ( m ` 4 )
            )
          )
        )
    ) $.
$}

${
  $d j p $.

  p85b1-nnz-definition $a |- P85B1Nnz =
    (
      p e. ( Base ` ( Poly1 ` RRfld ) ) |->
        (
          # `
          {
            j e. NN0 |
            ( ( coe1 ` p ) ` j ) =/= 0
          }
        )
    ) $.
$}

${
  putnambench-putnam-1985-b1 $a |- (
    P85B1Solution : ( 0 ..^ 5 ) -1-1-> ZZ
    /\
    A. m e. ( ZZ ^m ( 0 ..^ 5 ) )
      (
        m : ( 0 ..^ 5 ) -1-1-> ZZ
        ->
        (
          P85B1Nnz
          `
          ( P85B1Poly ` P85B1Solution )
        )
        <_
        (
          P85B1Nnz
          `
          ( P85B1Poly ` m )
        )
      )
  ) $.
$}

title: putnam_1985_b1
content:
% Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench artifact putnam_1985_b1:
% the distinct integers -2, -1, 0, 1, 2 minimize the number of nonzero
% coefficients in a monic real polynomial with five distinct integer roots.
% This file contains no proof.

putnam_1985_b1: THEORY
BEGIN
  integer_entries(values: list[real]): RECURSIVE bool =
    CASES values OF
      null: TRUE,
      cons(value, tail):
        integer?(value) AND integer_entries(tail)
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE values BY <<

  distinct_entries(values: list[real]): RECURSIVE bool =
    CASES values OF
      null: TRUE,
      cons(value, tail):
        NOT member(value, tail) AND distinct_entries(tail)
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE values BY <<

  polynomial_add(
      left, right: list[real]): RECURSIVE list[real] =
    CASES left OF
      null: right,
      cons(left_coefficient, left_tail):
        CASES right OF
          null: left,
          cons(right_coefficient, right_tail):
            cons(
              left_coefficient + right_coefficient,
              polynomial_add(left_tail, right_tail))
        ENDCASES
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE left BY <<

  polynomial_scale(
      scalar: real,
      polynomial: list[real]): RECURSIVE list[real] =
    CASES polynomial OF
      null: null,
      cons(coefficient, tail):
        cons(
          scalar * coefficient,
          polynomial_scale(scalar, tail))
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE polynomial BY <<

  polynomial_multiply(
      left, right: list[real]): RECURSIVE list[real] =
    CASES left OF
      null: null,
      cons(coefficient, tail):
        polynomial_add(
          polynomial_scale(coefficient, right),
          cons(0, polynomial_multiply(tail, right)))
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE left BY <<

  linear_factor(root: real): list[real] =
    cons[real](
      (0 :: real) - root,
      cons[real]((1 :: real), null[real]))

  root_polynomial(roots: list[real]): RECURSIVE list[real] =
    CASES roots OF
      null: cons(1, null),
      cons(root, tail):
        polynomial_multiply(
          linear_factor(root),
          root_polynomial(tail))
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE roots BY <<

  nonzero_coefficient_count(
      polynomial: list[real]): RECURSIVE nat =
    CASES polynomial OF
      null: 0,
      cons(coefficient, tail):
        (IF coefficient = 0 THEN 0 ELSE 1 ENDIF)
          + nonzero_coefficient_count(tail)
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE polynomial BY <<

  putnam_1985_b1_solution: list[real] =
    cons[real](
      (0 :: real) - (2 :: real),
      cons[real](
        (0 :: real) - (1 :: real),
        cons[real](
          (0 :: real),
          cons[real](
            (1 :: real),
            cons[real]((2 :: real), null[real])))))

  putnam_1985_b1: bool =
    length(putnam_1985_b1_solution) = 5
      AND integer_entries(putnam_1985_b1_solution)
      AND distinct_entries(putnam_1985_b1_solution)
      AND (FORALL (roots: list[real]):
        (length(roots) = 5
          AND integer_entries(roots)
          AND distinct_entries(roots))
          IMPLIES
            nonzero_coefficient_count(
              root_polynomial(putnam_1985_b1_solution))
              <= nonzero_coefficient_count(root_polynomial(roots)))
END putnam_1985_b1

import Mathlib

open Set Filter Topology Real Polynomial Function

abbrev putnam_1985_b2_solution : ℕ → ℕ := sorry
-- fun n ↦ ite (n = 101) 99 0
/--
Define polynomials $f_n(x)$ for $n \geq 0$ by $f_0(x)=1$, $f_n(0)=0$ for $n \geq 1$, and
\[
\frac{d}{dx} f_{n+1}(x) = (n+1)f_n(x+1)
\]
for $n \geq 0$. Find, with proof, the explicit factorization of $f_{100}(1)$ into powers of distinct primes.
-/
theorem putnam_1985_b2
  (f : ℕ -> Polynomial ℕ)
  (hf0x : f 0 = 1)
  (hfn0 : ∀ n ≥ 1, (f n).eval 0 = 0)
  (hfderiv : ∀ n : ℕ, derivative (f (n + 1)) = (n + 1) * (Polynomial.comp (f n) (X + 1)))
  : Nat.factorization ((f 100).eval 1) = putnam_1985_b2_solution :=
sorry

Require Import Nat List Reals Coquelicot.Coquelicot ZArith Znumtheory.
Open Scope R.
Definition putnam_1985_b2_solution := repeat 101%nat 99.
Theorem putnam_1985_b2
    (f : nat -> R -> R)
    (polyf : forall n : nat, exists p : nat -> R, exists deg : nat, f n = fun x : R => sum_n (fun m : nat => (p m) * x ^ m) deg)
    (hf0x : f O = fun x => 1)
    (hfn0 : forall n : nat, ge n 1 -> f n 0 = 0)
    (hfderiv : forall n : nat, forall x : R, Derive (f (S n)) x = (INR n + 1) * f n (x + 1))
    : (forall n : nat, In n putnam_1985_b2_solution -> prime (Z.of_nat n)) /\ exists a : nat, INR a = f 100%nat 1 /\ fold_left mul putnam_1985_b2_solution 1%nat = a.
Proof. Admitted.

(*
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1985_b2:
  the explicit prime-power factorization of f_100(1) for a recursively
  differentiated sequence of real polynomials. This file contains no proof.
*)

let statement =
  `let has_derivative_at =
     \(g:real->real) (d:real) (x:real).
       !e:real.
         &0 < e
         ==> ?delta:real.
               &0 < delta /\
               !y:real.
                 &0 < abs (y - x) /\ abs (y - x) < delta
                 ==> abs ((g y - g x) / (y - x) - d) < e in
   !f:num->real->real.
     (!n:num. polynomial_function (f n)) /\
     f 0 = (\x:real. &1) /\
     (!n:num. 1 <= n ==> f n (&0) = &0) /\
     (!n:num. !x:real.
        has_derivative_at (f (n + 1)) (&(n + 1) * f n (x + &1)) x)
     ==> prime 101 /\
         f 100 (&1) = &(101 EXP 99)`;;

title: putnam_1985_b2
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1985_b2:
;; the prime factorization of f_100(1) for the recursively differentiated
;; polynomial sequence is 101^99. This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

;; Formal polynomials are coefficient lists in ascending degree order.
;; ACL2's exact rationals contain the natural coefficients of the source
;; polynomials, and equality of these lists is equality of formal polynomials.
(defun putnam-1985-b2-polynomial-add (left right)
  (cond
   ((endp left) right)
   ((endp right) left)
   (t
    (cons (+ (car left) (car right))
          (putnam-1985-b2-polynomial-add
           (cdr left) (cdr right))))))

(defun putnam-1985-b2-polynomial-scale (scalar polynomial)
  (if (endp polynomial)
      nil
    (cons (* scalar (car polynomial))
          (putnam-1985-b2-polynomial-scale
           scalar (cdr polynomial)))))

;; With PREVIOUS initially zero, this multiplies a polynomial by X+1.
(defun putnam-1985-b2-multiply-x-plus-one
    (polynomial previous)
  (if (consp polynomial)
      (cons (+ (car polynomial) previous)
            (putnam-1985-b2-multiply-x-plus-one
             (cdr polynomial) (car polynomial)))
    (if (equal previous 0)
        nil
      (list previous))))

;; Horner recursion computes p(X+1) as a formal polynomial.
(defun putnam-1985-b2-compose-shift-one (polynomial)
  (if (consp polynomial)
      (putnam-1985-b2-polynomial-add
       (list (car polynomial))
       (putnam-1985-b2-multiply-x-plus-one
        (putnam-1985-b2-compose-shift-one (cdr polynomial))
        0))
    nil))

(defun putnam-1985-b2-antiderivative-coefficients
    (polynomial divisor)
  (if (consp polynomial)
      (cons (/ (car polynomial) divisor)
            (putnam-1985-b2-antiderivative-coefficients
             (cdr polynomial) (+ divisor 1)))
    nil))

;; This is the unique formal antiderivative with constant coefficient zero.
(defun putnam-1985-b2-antiderivative-zero (polynomial)
  (cons
   0
   (putnam-1985-b2-antiderivative-coefficients polynomial 1)))

;; The source hypotheses uniquely determine this sequence: f_0=1, and for
;; n>0, f_n has zero constant coefficient and derivative
;; n*f_(n-1)(X+1). Conversely these definitions satisfy exactly those
;; hypotheses, so eliminating the external sequence parameter is
;; bidirectionally equivalent.
(defun putnam-1985-b2-polynomial (n)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix n)))
  (if (or (not (natp n)) (zp n))
      (list 1)
    (putnam-1985-b2-antiderivative-zero
     (putnam-1985-b2-polynomial-scale
      n
      (putnam-1985-b2-compose-shift-one
       (putnam-1985-b2-polynomial (- n 1)))))))

(defun putnam-1985-b2-polynomial-evaluate (polynomial value)
  (if (consp polynomial)
      (+ (car polynomial)
         (* value
            (putnam-1985-b2-polynomial-evaluate
             (cdr polynomial) value)))
    0))

(defun putnam-1985-b2-no-divisor-from-p (n divisor)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix (- n divisor))))
  (if (and (natp n)
           (natp divisor)
           (<= 2 divisor)
           (< divisor n))
      (and
       (not (equal (mod n divisor) 0))
       (putnam-1985-b2-no-divisor-from-p n (+ divisor 1)))
    t))

(defun putnam-1985-b2-primep (n)

    (putnam-1985-b2-polynomial-evaluate

    (expt 101 99))))

-- Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1985_b2:
-- a polynomial sequence defined by its initial value, zero constant terms,
-- and a derivative-shift recurrence has f_100(1) = 101^99, with 101 prime.
-- This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.List using (List; []; _∷_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; _*_)

infix 4 _!=_ _<=N_ _divides_
infixr 3 _and_
infixr 2 _or_

data Bottom : Set where

Not : Set -> Set
Not A =
  A -> Bottom

_!=_ : {A : Set} -> A -> A -> Set
x != y =
  Not (x == y)

record _and_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data _or_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  left  : A -> A or B
  right : B -> A or B

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

data _<=N_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set where
  zero<=N   : {n : Nat} -> zero <=N n
  suc<=sucN : {m n : Nat} -> m <=N n -> suc m <=N suc n

record _divides_ (divisor dividend : Nat) : Set where
  field
    quotient : Nat
    equation : divisor * quotient == dividend

record Prime (n : Nat) : Set where
  field
    at-least-two :
      2 <=N n
    divisor-is-trivial :
      (d : Nat) ->
      d divides n ->
      d == 1 or d == n

record CompleteOrderedRealField (R : Set) : Set1 where
  field
    zeroR oneR : R
    add multiply : R -> R -> R
    negate inverse : R -> R
    lessOrEqual : R -> R -> Set
    fromNat : Nat -> R

    one-not-zero :
      oneR != zeroR

    add-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> add x y == add y x
    add-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      add (add x y) z == add x (add y z)
    add-zero :
      (x : R) -> add x zeroR == x
    add-inverse :
      (x : R) -> add x (negate x) == zeroR

    multiply-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> multiply x y == multiply y x
    multiply-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply (multiply x y) z ==
      multiply x (multiply y z)
    multiply-one :
      (x : R) -> multiply x oneR == x
    multiply-zero :
      (x : R) -> multiply x zeroR == zeroR
    distribute :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply x (add y z) ==
      add (multiply x y) (multiply x z)
    inverse-zero :
      inverse zeroR == zeroR
    multiply-inverse :
      (x : R) ->
      x != zeroR ->
      multiply x (inverse x) == oneR

    order-reflexive :
      (x : R) -> lessOrEqual x x
    order-transitive :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y z ->
      lessOrEqual x z
    order-antisymmetric :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y x ->
      x == y
    order-total :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y or lessOrEqual y x
    add-order :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual (add z x) (add z y)
    multiply-nonnegative :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR x ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR y ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR (multiply x y)
    zero-less-than-one :
      lessOrEqual zeroR oneR and zeroR != oneR

    fromNat-zero :
      fromNat zero == zeroR
    fromNat-successor :
      (n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (suc n) == add (fromNat n) oneR
    fromNat-addition :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m + n) == add (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-multiplication :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m * n) == multiply (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-injective :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat m == fromNat n ->
      m == n

    archimedean :
      (x : R) ->
      Exists Nat
        (\ n ->
          lessOrEqual x (fromNat n))
    least-upper-bound :
      (P : R -> Set) ->
      Exists R P ->
      Exists R
        (\ upper ->
          (x : R) ->
          P x ->
          lessOrEqual x upper) ->
      Exists R
        (\ supremum ->
          ((x : R) ->
            P x ->
            lessOrEqual x supremum)
          and
          ((upper : R) ->
            ((x : R) ->
              P x ->
              lessOrEqual x upper) ->
            lessOrEqual supremum upper))

open CompleteOrderedRealField

oneN : Nat
oneN =
  suc zero

powerNat : Nat -> Nat -> Nat
powerNat base zero =
  oneN
powerNat base (suc exponent) =
  base * powerNat base exponent

Polynomial : Set -> Set
Polynomial R =
  List R

evaluatePolynomial :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Polynomial R ->
  R ->
  R
evaluatePolynomial reals [] x =
  zeroR reals
evaluatePolynomial reals (coefficient ∷ coefficients) x =
  add reals
    coefficient
    (multiply reals x
      (evaluatePolynomial reals coefficients x))

PolynomialEqual :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Polynomial R ->
  Polynomial R ->
  Set
PolynomialEqual {R} reals p q =
  (x : R) ->
  evaluatePolynomial reals p x ==
  evaluatePolynomial reals q x

derivativeFrom :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Nat ->
  Polynomial R ->
  Polynomial R
derivativeFrom reals degree [] =
  []
derivativeFrom reals degree (coefficient ∷ coefficients) =
  multiply reals
    (fromNat reals degree)
    coefficient
  ∷
  derivativeFrom reals (suc degree) coefficients

derivativePolynomial :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Polynomial R ->
  Polynomial R
derivativePolynomial reals [] =
  []
derivativePolynomial reals (constant ∷ coefficients) =
  derivativeFrom reals oneN coefficients

module Putnam1985B2Statement
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) where

  InitialValue :
    (Nat -> Polynomial R) ->
    Set
  InitialValue f =
    PolynomialEqual reals
      (f zero)
      (oneR reals ∷ [])

  ZeroConstantTerms :
    (Nat -> Polynomial R) ->
    Set
  ZeroConstantTerms f =
    (n : Nat) ->
    oneN <=N n ->
    evaluatePolynomial reals (f n) (zeroR reals) ==
    zeroR reals

  DerivativeRecurrence :
    (Nat -> Polynomial R) ->
    Set
  DerivativeRecurrence f =
    (n : Nat) ->
    (x : R) ->
    evaluatePolynomial reals
      (derivativePolynomial reals (f (suc n)))
      x
    ==
    multiply reals
      (fromNat reals (suc n))
      (evaluatePolynomial reals
        (f n)
        (add reals x (oneR reals)))

  proposition : Set
  proposition =
    (f : Nat -> Polynomial R) ->
    InitialValue f ->
    ZeroConstantTerms f ->
    DerivativeRecurrence f ->
    Prime 101
    and
    (evaluatePolynomial reals
      (f 100)
      (oneR reals)
    ==
    fromNat reals (powerNat 101 99))

putnam-1985-b2 : Set1
putnam-1985-b2 =
  (R : Set) ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) ->
  Putnam1985B2Statement.proposition reals

  recursively defined polynomials have f_100(1) equal to 101^99, giving its
  explicit prime factorization. This file contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open arithmeticTheory realTheory polyTheory;

val putnam_1985_b2 =
  ``!(f : num -> real list).
      (!x : real. poly (f 0) x = 1) /\
      (!n : num. 1 <= n ==> poly (f n) 0 = 0) /\
      (!n : num. !x : real.
         poly (diff (f (SUC n))) x =

% Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1985_b2:
% the recursively defined polynomial sequence has f_100(1) factored as
% ninety-nine copies of the prime 101. This file contains no proof.

putnam_1985_b2: THEORY
BEGIN
  polynomial: TYPE = list[real]
  polynomial_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> polynomial]

  polynomial_coefficient(
      p: polynomial,
      degree: nat): RECURSIVE real =
    CASES p OF
      null: 0,
      cons(coefficient, tail):
        IF degree = 0 THEN
          coefficient
        ELSE
          polynomial_coefficient(tail, degree - 1)
        ENDIF
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE p BY <<

  polynomial_equal(left, right: polynomial): bool =
    FORALL (degree: nat):
      polynomial_coefficient(left, degree)
        = polynomial_coefficient(right, degree)

  polynomial_value(p: polynomial, x: real): RECURSIVE real =
    CASES p OF
      null: 0,
      cons(coefficient, tail):
        coefficient + x * polynomial_value(tail, x)
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE p BY <<

  derivative_coefficients(
      p: polynomial,
      degree: nat): RECURSIVE polynomial =
    CASES p OF
      null: null,
      cons(coefficient, tail):
        cons(
          (degree :: real) * coefficient,
          derivative_coefficients(tail, degree + 1))
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE p BY <<

  polynomial_derivative(p: polynomial): polynomial =
    CASES p OF
      null: null,
      cons(coefficient, tail):
        derivative_coefficients(tail, 1)
    ENDCASES

  repeat_nat(value, count: nat): RECURSIVE list[nat] =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      null
    ELSE
      cons(value, repeat_nat(value, count - 1))
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  list_product(values: list[nat]): RECURSIVE nat =
    CASES values OF
      null: 1,
      cons(value, tail):
        value * list_product(tail)
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE values BY <<

  prime_nat(value: nat): bool =
    value >= 2
      AND FORALL (divisor: posnat):
        (EXISTS (quotient: nat):
          value = divisor * quotient)
        IMPLIES divisor = 1 OR divisor = value

  all_prime(values: list[nat]): RECURSIVE bool =
    CASES values OF
      null: TRUE,
      cons(value, tail):
        prime_nat(value) AND all_prime(tail)
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE values BY <<

  putnam_1985_b2_solution: list[nat] =
    repeat_nat(101, 99)

  putnam_1985_b2: bool =
    FORALL (f: polynomial_sequence):
      (polynomial_equal(f(0), cons(1, null))
        AND (FORALL (n: nat):
          n >= 1 IMPLIES polynomial_value(f(n), 0) = 0)
        AND (FORALL (n: nat), (x: real):
          polynomial_value(
            polynomial_derivative(f(n + 1)), x)
            = ((n + 1) :: real)
                * polynomial_value(f(n), x + 1)))
      IMPLIES
        all_prime(putnam_1985_b2_solution)
          AND EXISTS (a: nat):
            polynomial_value(f(100), 1) = (a :: real)
              AND list_product(putnam_1985_b2_solution) = a
END putnam_1985_b2

: (∃ m n, m > 0 ∧ n > 0 ∧ a m n > m * n) :=

;; Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1985_b3:
;; every positive-integer array in which each positive integer occurs exactly
;; eight times has an entry a(m,n) greater than m*n at positive indices. This
;; file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))

;; DEFSTUB introduces an arbitrary binary function conservatively. ACL2
;; functional instantiation makes the theorem generic over every array
;; satisfying the hypotheses, without APPLY$'s tame-function restriction.

(defstub putnam-1985-b3-array (m n) t)

(defun putnam-1985-b3-array-value (m n)
  (putnam-1985-b3-array m n))

(defun-sk putnam-1985-b3-positive-array-p ()
  (forall (m n)
    (implies
     (and
      (natp m)
      (natp n))
     (and
      (natp (putnam-1985-b3-array-value m n))
      (< 0 (putnam-1985-b3-array-value m n))))))

;; A duplicate-free list of length eight enumerates a fiber exactly when each
;; listed positive pair maps to K and every positive pair mapping to K occurs
;; in the list. This is equivalent to cardinality eight without bounding the
;; index domain or exposing the enumeration as a statement parameter.

(defun putnam-1985-b3-positive-pair-p (pair)
  (and
   (consp pair)
   (posp (car pair))
   (posp (cdr pair))))

(defun putnam-1985-b3-pairs-map-to-p (k pairs)
  (if (consp pairs)
      (and
       (putnam-1985-b3-positive-pair-p (car pairs))
       (equal
        (putnam-1985-b3-array-value
         (car (car pairs)) (cdr (car pairs)))
        k)
       (putnam-1985-b3-pairs-map-to-p
        k (cdr pairs)))
    (equal pairs nil)))

(defun-sk putnam-1985-b3-all-preimages-listed-p
    (k pairs)
  (forall (m n)
    (implies
     (and
      (posp m)
      (posp n)
     (equal
       (putnam-1985-b3-array-value m n)
       k))
     (member-equal (cons m n) pairs))))

(defun putnam-1985-b3-eight-preimage-witnesses-p
    (k pairs)
  (and
   (true-listp pairs)
   (equal (len pairs) 8)
   (no-duplicatesp-equal pairs)
   (putnam-1985-b3-pairs-map-to-p k pairs)
   (putnam-1985-b3-all-preimages-listed-p
    k pairs)))

(defun-sk putnam-1985-b3-exactly-eight-preimages-p
    (k)
  (exists (pairs)
    (putnam-1985-b3-eight-preimage-witnesses-p
     k pairs)))

(defun-sk putnam-1985-b3-each-positive-occurs-eight-times-p
    ()
  (forall (k)
    (implies
     (posp k)
     (putnam-1985-b3-exactly-eight-preimages-p
      k))))

(defun-sk putnam-1985-b3-large-entry-exists-p ()
  (exists (m n)
    (and
     (posp m)
     (posp n)
     (<
      (* m n)
      (putnam-1985-b3-array-value m n)))))

(defun putnambench-putnam-1985-b3-statement ()
  (implies
   (and
    (putnam-1985-b3-positive-array-p)
    (putnam-1985-b3-each-positive-occurs-eight-times-p))

-- Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1985_b3:
-- a positive-integer array in which every positive integer occurs at exactly
-- eight positive index pairs has some entry a(m,n) greater than m*n.
-- This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _*_)

infix 4 _<=N_ _<N_
infixr 3 _and_

record _and_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

data _<=N_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set where
  zero<=N   : {n : Nat} -> zero <=N n
  suc<=sucN : {m n : Nat} -> m <=N n -> suc m <=N suc n

_<N_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set
m <N n =
  suc m <=N n

record Pair : Set where
  constructor pair
  field
    first-coordinate  : Nat
    second-coordinate : Nat

open Pair

data Fin : Nat -> Set where
  fzero : {n : Nat} -> Fin (suc n)
  fsuc  : {n : Nat} -> Fin n -> Fin (suc n)

eightN : Nat
eightN =
  8

record HasCardinality
  (S : Pair -> Set)
  (cardinality : Nat) :
  Set where

  field
    enumerate :
      Fin cardinality ->
      Pair
    enumerated-member :
      (index : Fin cardinality) ->
      S (enumerate index)
    enumeration-complete :
      (entry : Pair) ->
      S entry ->
      Exists (Fin cardinality)
        (\ index -> entry == enumerate index)
    enumeration-injective :
      (left-index right-index : Fin cardinality) ->
      enumerate left-index == enumerate right-index ->
      left-index == right-index

Fiber :
  (Nat -> Nat -> Nat) ->
  Nat ->
  Pair ->
  Set
Fiber a k entry =
  zero <N first-coordinate entry
  and
  zero <N second-coordinate entry
  and
  a (first-coordinate entry) (second-coordinate entry) == k

putnam-1985-b3 : Set
putnam-1985-b3 =
  (a : Nat -> Nat -> Nat) ->
  ((m n : Nat) ->
    zero <N a m n) ->
  ((k : Nat) ->
    zero <N k ->
    HasCardinality (Fiber a k) eightN) ->
  Exists Nat
    (\ m ->
      Exists Nat
        (\ n ->
          zero <N m
          and
          zero <N n
          and
          m * n <N a m n))

(*
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1985_b3:
  a positive-integer array in which every positive integer occurs exactly
  eight times has an entry greater than the product of its positive indices.
  This file contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open arithmeticTheory pairTheory pred_setTheory;

val putnam_1985_b3 =
  ``!a : num -> num -> num.
      (!m n : num. 0 < a m n) /\
      (!k : num.
         0 < k
         ==>
         FINITE
           {p : num # num |
              0 < FST p /\
              0 < SND p /\
              a (FST p) (SND p) = k} /\
         CARD
           {p : num # num |
              0 < FST p /\
              0 < SND p /\
              a (FST p) (SND p) = k} = 8)
      ==>
      ?m n : num.
        0 < m /\ 0 < n /\ m * n < a m n``;

$(
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact
  putnam_1985_b3: a doubly indexed positive-integer array in which every
  positive integer occurs exactly eight times at positive indices has an
  entry a(m,n) greater than m times n for some positive m and n. This file
  contains no proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  A ranges over all functions from NN0 X. NN0 to NN, which is equivalent to
  the source natural-valued array together with its everywhere-positivity
  assumption. Restricting k, m, and n to NN is equivalent to the source
  guards that those naturals are positive. SetMM's # operator equals 8
  exactly when the displayed occurrence set has eight elements, so the
  infinite index domain is not bounded or replaced by a finite table.

  The ordered-pair variable t represents the two positive indices, with 1st
  and 2nd recovering m and n. The final declaration is the single unproved
  $a corpus statement; this database contains no $p proof statement.
$)

${
  $d A k t $.

  putnambench-putnam-1985-b3 $a |-
    A. A e. ( NN ^m ( NN0 X. NN0 ) )
      (
        A. k e. NN
          (
            (
              #
              `
              {
                t e. ( NN X. NN ) |
                ( A ` t ) = k
              }
            )
            =
            8
          )
        ->
        E. t e. ( NN X. NN )
          (
            (
              ( 1st ` t )
              x.
              ( 2nd ` t )
            )
            <
            ( A ` t )
          )
      )
  $.
$}

title: putnam_1985_b3
content:
% Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1985_b3:
% a positive-integer array in which every positive integer occurs exactly
% eight times has an entry a(m,n) greater than m*n at positive indices.
% This file contains no proof.

putnam_1985_b3: THEORY
BEGIN
  index_pair: TYPE = [# row: nat, column: nat #]
  natural_array: TYPE = [nat, nat -> nat]
  pair_set: TYPE = [index_pair -> bool]
  pair_enumeration: TYPE = [nat -> index_pair]

  positive_fiber(
      a: natural_array,
      k: nat): pair_set =
    LAMBDA (p: index_pair):
      row(p) > 0
        AND column(p) > 0
        AND a(row(p), column(p)) = k

  injective_below(
      enumeration: pair_enumeration,
      bound: nat): bool =
    FORALL (i, j: nat):
      (i < bound
        AND j < bound
        AND enumeration(i) = enumeration(j))
      IMPLIES i = j

  enumerates_exactly(
      enumeration: pair_enumeration,
      set_value: pair_set,
      bound: nat): bool =
    FORALL (p: index_pair):
      set_value(p)
        IFF
          EXISTS (position: nat):
            position < bound
              AND enumeration(position) = p

  has_cardinality(
      set_value: pair_set,
      cardinality: nat): bool =
    EXISTS (enumeration: pair_enumeration):
      injective_below(enumeration, cardinality)
        AND enumerates_exactly(
          enumeration, set_value, cardinality)

  putnam_1985_b3: bool =
    FORALL (a: natural_array):
      ((FORALL (m, n: nat):
          a(m, n) > 0)
        AND
        (FORALL (k: nat):
          k > 0 IMPLIES
            has_cardinality(positive_fiber(a, k), 8)))
      IMPLIES
        EXISTS (m, n: nat):
          m > 0
            AND n > 0
            AND a(m, n) > m * n
END putnam_1985_b3
