putnam_1985_b5
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1985_b5:
;; the improper real integral of t^(-1/2)*exp(-1985*(t+t^(-1))) over the
;; positive half-line equals sqrt(pi/1985)*exp(-3970). This file contains no
;; proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

;; Standard ACL2 has exact rationals rather than primitive completed reals.
;; The definitions below give independent rational Cauchy names for the
;; source integral and its stated value. Under t=x^2, the source integral is
;;
;;   2 * integral_0^infinity exp(-1985*(x^2+x^(-2))) dx.
;;
;; Thus the expanding midpoint sums retain the original integrand through an
;; exact change of variables; they are not a fixed finite quadrature.

(defun putnam-1985-b5-exp-negative-approx (y scale)
  (if (and (rationalp y)
           (<= 0 y)
           (posp scale)
           (< y scale))
      (expt (- 1 (/ y scale)) scale)
    0))

(defun putnam-1985-b5-grid-point
    (index radius subdivisions)
  (let* ((lower (/ 1 radius))
         (width (- radius lower)))
    (+ lower
       (/ (* width (+ (* 2 index) 1))
          (* 2 subdivisions)))))

(defun putnam-1985-b5-integrand-approx
    (x scale)
  (if (and (rationalp x)
           (< 0 x))
      (* 2
         (putnam-1985-b5-exp-negative-approx
          (* 1985
             (+ (* x x)
                (/ 1 (* x x))))
          scale))
    0))

(defun putnam-1985-b5-midpoint-sum
    (remaining radius subdivisions scale)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix remaining)))
  (if (zp remaining)
      0
    (let* ((index (- remaining 1))
           (x (putnam-1985-b5-grid-point
               index radius subdivisions)))
      (+ (putnam-1985-b5-integrand-approx x scale)
         (putnam-1985-b5-midpoint-sum
          index radius subdivisions scale)))))

(defun putnam-1985-b5-integral-approx
    (radius subdivisions scale)
  (if (and (posp radius)
           (posp subdivisions)
           (posp scale))
      (let ((width (- radius (/ 1 radius))))
        (* (/ width subdivisions)
           (putnam-1985-b5-midpoint-sum
            subdivisions radius subdivisions scale)))
    0))

;; Machin's identity gives
;;
;;   pi = 16*arctan(1/5) - 4*arctan(1/239).
;;
;; These alternating Taylor prefixes are exact rationals converging to pi.
(defun putnam-1985-b5-arctan-prefix (z terms)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix terms)))
  (if (zp terms)
      0
    (let* ((index (- terms 1))
           (degree (+ (* 2 index) 1))
           (sign (if (equal (mod index 2) 0) 1 -1)))
      (+ (putnam-1985-b5-arctan-prefix z index)
         (/ (* sign (expt z degree))
            degree)))))

(defun putnam-1985-b5-pi-prefix (terms)
  (- (* 16
        (putnam-1985-b5-arctan-prefix (/ 1 5) terms))
     (* 4
        (putnam-1985-b5-arctan-prefix (/ 1 239) terms))))

;; Rational bisection gives the nonnegative square root of the rational
;; Machin prefix divided by 1985. All relevant radicands lie between 0 and 1.
(defun putnam-1985-b5-sqrt-lower-aux
    (radicand steps lower upper)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix steps)))
  (if (zp steps)
      lower
    (let ((midpoint (/ (+ lower upper) 2)))
      (if (<= (* midpoint midpoint) radicand)
          (putnam-1985-b5-sqrt-lower-aux
           radicand (- steps 1) midpoint upper)
        (putnam-1985-b5-sqrt-lower-aux
         radicand (- steps 1) lower midpoint)))))

(defun putnam-1985-b5-sqrt-pi-over-1985-approx
    (pi-terms sqrt-steps)
  (putnam-1985-b5-sqrt-lower-aux
   (/ (putnam-1985-b5-pi-prefix pi-terms) 1985)
   sqrt-steps
   0
   1))

(defun putnam-1985-b5-solution-approx
    (scale pi-terms sqrt-steps)
  (* (putnam-1985-b5-sqrt-pi-over-1985-approx
      pi-terms sqrt-steps)
     (putnam-1985-b5-exp-negative-approx 3970 scale)))

;; This is the directed-limit statement itself, without imposing a particular
;; convergence rate. For each tolerance there is an outer radius after which,
;; for each fixed radius, sufficiently accurate quadrature, exponential, pi,
;; and square-root approximations agree to that tolerance. Allowing the inner
;; cutoffs to depend on the radius is essential for the improper integral.

(defun-sk putnam-1985-b5-all-precisions-close-p
    (epsilon radius subdivisions-cutoff scale-cutoff
             pi-terms-cutoff sqrt-steps-cutoff)
  (forall (subdivisions scale pi-terms sqrt-steps)
    (implies
     (and
      (natp subdivisions)
      (<= subdivisions-cutoff subdivisions)
      (natp scale)
      (<= scale-cutoff scale)
      (natp pi-terms)
      (<= pi-terms-cutoff pi-terms)
      (natp sqrt-steps)
      (<= sqrt-steps-cutoff sqrt-steps))
     (< (abs
         (- (putnam-1985-b5-integral-approx
             radius subdivisions scale)
            (putnam-1985-b5-solution-approx
             scale pi-terms sqrt-steps)))
        epsilon))))

(defun-sk putnam-1985-b5-precision-cutoffs-exist-p
    (epsilon radius)
  (exists
   (subdivisions-cutoff scale-cutoff
                        pi-terms-cutoff sqrt-steps-cutoff)
   (and
    (posp subdivisions-cutoff)
    (posp scale-cutoff)
    (posp pi-terms-cutoff)
    (posp sqrt-steps-cutoff)
    (putnam-1985-b5-all-precisions-close-p
     epsilon radius subdivisions-cutoff scale-cutoff
     pi-terms-cutoff sqrt-steps-cutoff))))

(defun-sk putnam-1985-b5-radius-tail-p
    (epsilon radius-cutoff)
  (forall (radius)
    (implies
     (and
      (natp radius)
      (<= radius-cutoff radius))
     (putnam-1985-b5-precision-cutoffs-exist-p
      epsilon radius))))

(defun-sk putnam-1985-b5-radius-cutoff-exists-p (epsilon)
  (exists (radius-cutoff)
    (and
     (posp radius-cutoff)
     (putnam-1985-b5-radius-tail-p
      epsilon radius-cutoff))))

(defun putnambench-putnam-1985-b5-statement (epsilon)
  (implies
   (and
    (rationalp epsilon)
    (< 0 epsilon))
   (putnam-1985-b5-radius-cutoff-exists-p epsilon)))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

title: putnam_1985_b5
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1985_b5:
-- assuming the Gaussian integral over the real line is sqrt pi, the improper
-- integral from zero to infinity of t^(-1/2) exp(-1985(t + t^(-1))) has the
-- value sqrt(pi / 1985) exp(-3970). This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; _*_)

infix 4 _!=_ _<=N_
infixr 3 _and_
infixr 2 _or_

data Bottom : Set where

Not : Set -> Set
Not A =
  A -> Bottom

_!=_ : {A : Set} -> A -> A -> Set
x != y =
  Not (x == y)

record _and_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data _or_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  left  : A -> A or B
  right : B -> A or B

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

data _<=N_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set where
  zero<=   : {n : Nat} -> zero <=N n
  suc<=suc : {m n : Nat} -> m <=N n -> suc m <=N suc n

record CompleteOrderedRealField (R : Set) : Set1 where
  field
    zeroR oneR : R
    add multiply : R -> R -> R
    negate inverse : R -> R
    lessOrEqual : R -> R -> Set
    fromNat : Nat -> R

    one-not-zero :
      oneR != zeroR

    add-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> add x y == add y x
    add-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      add (add x y) z == add x (add y z)
    add-zero :
      (x : R) -> add x zeroR == x
    add-inverse :
      (x : R) -> add x (negate x) == zeroR

    multiply-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> multiply x y == multiply y x
    multiply-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply (multiply x y) z ==
      multiply x (multiply y z)
    multiply-one :
      (x : R) -> multiply x oneR == x
    multiply-zero :
      (x : R) -> multiply x zeroR == zeroR
    distribute :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply x (add y z) ==
      add (multiply x y) (multiply x z)
    inverse-zero :
      inverse zeroR == zeroR
    multiply-inverse :
      (x : R) ->
      x != zeroR ->
      multiply x (inverse x) == oneR

    order-reflexive :
      (x : R) -> lessOrEqual x x
    order-transitive :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y z ->
      lessOrEqual x z
    order-antisymmetric :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y x ->
      x == y
    order-total :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y or lessOrEqual y x
    add-order :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual (add z x) (add z y)
    multiply-nonnegative :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR x ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR y ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR (multiply x y)
    zero-less-than-one :
      lessOrEqual zeroR oneR and zeroR != oneR

    fromNat-zero :
      fromNat zero == zeroR
    fromNat-successor :
      (n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (suc n) == add (fromNat n) oneR
    fromNat-addition :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m + n) == add (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-multiplication :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m * n) == multiply (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-injective :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat m == fromNat n ->
      m == n

    archimedean :
      (x : R) ->
      Exists Nat (\ n -> lessOrEqual x (fromNat n))
    least-upper-bound :
      (P : R -> Set) ->
      Exists R P ->
      Exists R
        (\ upper ->
          (x : R) ->
          P x ->
          lessOrEqual x upper) ->
      Exists R
        (\ supremum ->
          ((x : R) ->
            P x ->
            lessOrEqual x supremum)
          and
          ((upper : R) ->
            ((x : R) ->
              P x ->
              lessOrEqual x upper) ->
            lessOrEqual supremum upper))

open CompleteOrderedRealField

oneN : Nat
oneN =
  suc zero

twoN : Nat
twoN =
  suc oneN

fourN : Nat
fourN =
  twoN + twoN

subtract :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
subtract reals x y =
  add reals x (negate reals y)

divide :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
divide reals x y =
  multiply reals x (inverse reals y)

square :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R
square reals x =
  multiply reals x x

StrictLess :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
StrictLess reals x y =
  lessOrEqual reals x y and x != y

CloseTo :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
CloseTo reals center radius x =
  StrictLess reals
    (subtract reals center radius)
    x
  and
  StrictLess reals
    x
    (add reals center radius)

naturalPower :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  Nat ->
  R
naturalPower reals x zero =
  oneR reals
naturalPower reals x (suc n) =
  multiply reals
    (naturalPower reals x n)
    x

factorial : Nat -> Nat
factorial zero =
  oneN
factorial (suc n) =
  suc n * factorial n

sumFirst :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Nat ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  R
sumFirst reals zero term =
  zeroR reals
sumFirst reals (suc n) term =
  add reals
    (sumFirst reals n term)
    (term n)

ConvergesTo :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  R ->
  Set
ConvergesTo {R} reals sequence limit =
  (epsilon : R) ->
  StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) epsilon ->
  Exists Nat
    (\ cutoff ->
      (n : Nat) ->
      cutoff <=N n ->
      CloseTo reals limit epsilon (sequence n))

SeriesHasSum :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  R ->
  Set
SeriesHasSum reals terms limit =
  ConvergesTo reals
    (\ n -> sumFirst reals n terms)
    limit

alternatingPower :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Nat ->
  R
alternatingPower reals n =
  naturalPower reals
    (negate reals (oneR reals))
    n

exponentialTerm :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  Nat ->
  R
exponentialTerm reals x n =
  divide reals
    (naturalPower reals x n)
    (fromNat reals (factorial n))

leibnizTerm :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Nat ->
  R
leibnizTerm reals n =
  divide reals
    (alternatingPower reals n)
    (fromNat reals (suc (twoN * n)))

ExponentialValue :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
ExponentialValue reals x value =
  SeriesHasSum reals
    (exponentialTerm reals x)
    value

record PiValue
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R)
  (value : R) : Set where
  field
    positive :
      StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) value
    leibniz-series :
      SeriesHasSum reals
        (leibnizTerm reals)
        (divide reals value (fromNat reals fourN))

record StandardRealAnalysis
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) : Set1 where
  field
    exponential logarithm squareRoot : R -> R
    pi : R

    exponential-series :
      (x : R) ->
      ExponentialValue reals x (exponential x)
    exponential-positive :
      (x : R) ->
      StrictLess reals
        (zeroR reals)
        (exponential x)
    exponential-injective :
      (x y : R) ->
      exponential x == exponential y ->
      x == y
    exponential-logarithm :
      (x : R) ->
      StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) x ->
      exponential (logarithm x) == x

    square-root-nonnegative :
      (x : R) ->
      lessOrEqual reals (zeroR reals) x ->
      lessOrEqual reals (zeroR reals) (squareRoot x)
    square-root-square :
      (x : R) ->
      lessOrEqual reals (zeroR reals) x ->
      multiply reals (squareRoot x) (squareRoot x) == x
    square-root-unique :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual reals (zeroR reals) x ->
      lessOrEqual reals (zeroR reals) y ->
      multiply reals y y == x ->
      y == squareRoot x

    pi-value :
      PiValue reals pi

open StandardRealAnalysis

realPower :
  {R : Set} ->
  {reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R} ->
  StandardRealAnalysis reals ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
realPower {reals = reals} analysis base exponent =
  exponential analysis
    (multiply reals
      exponent
      (logarithm analysis base))

midpointRiemannSum :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  (R -> R) ->
  Nat ->
  R
midpointRiemannSum reals lower upper function pieces =
  let
    step =
      divide reals
        (subtract reals upper lower)
        (fromNat reals pieces)
    halfStep =
      divide reals
        step
        (fromNat reals twoN)
  in
  sumFirst reals pieces
    (\ i ->
      multiply reals
        (function
          (add reals lower
            (add reals
              (multiply reals
                (fromNat reals i)
                step)
              halfStep)))
        step)

FiniteIntervalIntegralValue :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  (R -> R) ->
  R ->
  Set
FiniteIntervalIntegralValue reals lower upper function value =
  ConvergesTo reals
    (\ n ->
      midpointRiemannSum reals
        lower
        upper
        function
        (suc n))
    value

positiveCutoffIntegral :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (R -> R) ->
  Nat ->
  Nat ->
  R
positiveCutoffIntegral reals function cutoff pieces =
  midpointRiemannSum reals
    (zeroR reals)
    (fromNat reals cutoff)
    function
    (suc pieces)

PositiveImproperIntegralValue :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (R -> R) ->
  R ->
  Set
PositiveImproperIntegralValue reals function value =
  ConvergesTo reals
    (\ cutoff ->
      midpointRiemannSum reals
        (zeroR reals)
        (fromNat reals cutoff)
        function
        (suc (cutoff * cutoff)))
    value

WholeLineIntegralValue :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (R -> R) ->
  R ->
  Set
WholeLineIntegralValue reals function value =
  ConvergesTo reals
    (\ cutoff ->
      midpointRiemannSum reals
        (negate reals (fromNat reals cutoff))
        (fromNat reals cutoff)
        function
        (suc (cutoff * cutoff)))
    value

module Putnam1985B5Statement
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R)
  (analysis : StandardRealAnalysis reals) where

  fiveN : Nat
  fiveN =
    suc fourN

  tenN : Nat
  tenN =
    fiveN + fiveN

  nineteenN : Nat
  nineteenN =
    tenN + (fourN + fiveN)

  eightyFiveN : Nat
  eightyFiveN =
    (fourN * (tenN + tenN)) + fiveN

  oneThousandN : Nat
  oneThousandN =
    tenN * tenN * tenN

  nineteenHundredN : Nat
  nineteenHundredN =
    nineteenN * (tenN * tenN)

  nineteenEightyFiveN : Nat
  nineteenEightyFiveN =
    nineteenHundredN + eightyFiveN

  threeThousandNineHundredSeventyN : Nat
  threeThousandNineHundredSeventyN =
    nineteenEightyFiveN + nineteenEightyFiveN

  minusOneHalf : R
  minusOneHalf =
    negate reals
      (divide reals
        (oneR reals)
        (fromNat reals twoN))

  gaussian : R -> R
  gaussian x =
    exponential analysis
      (negate reals (square reals x))

  integrand : R -> R
  integrand t =
    multiply reals
      (realPower analysis t minusOneHalf)
      (exponential analysis
        (negate reals
          (multiply reals
            (fromNat reals nineteenEightyFiveN)
            (add reals t (inverse reals t)))))

  gaussianValue : R
  gaussianValue =
    squareRoot analysis (pi analysis)

  solution : R
  solution =
    multiply reals
      (squareRoot analysis
        (divide reals
          (pi analysis)
          (fromNat reals nineteenEightyFiveN)))
      (exponential analysis
        (negate reals
          (fromNat reals threeThousandNineHundredSeventyN)))

  proposition : Set
  proposition =
    WholeLineIntegralValue reals gaussian gaussianValue ->
    PositiveImproperIntegralValue reals integrand solution

putnam-1985-b5 : Set1
putnam-1985-b5 =
  (R : Set) ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) ->
  (analysis : StandardRealAnalysis reals) ->
  Putnam1985B5Statement.proposition reals analysis

title: putnam_1985_b5
content:
% Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1985_b5:
% assuming the Gaussian integral equals sqrt(pi), the improper integral of
% t^(-1/2) * exp(-1985 * (t + t^(-1))) on the positive real axis equals
% sqrt(pi / 1985) * exp(-3970). This file contains no proof.

putnam_1985_b5: THEORY
BEGIN
  real_function: TYPE = [real -> real]
  real_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> real]
  positive_real_function: TYPE = [posreal -> real]

  safe_div(numerator, denominator: real): real =
    IF denominator = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      numerator / denominator
    ENDIF

  nat_factorial(index: nat): RECURSIVE nat =
    IF index = 0 THEN
      1
    ELSE
      index * nat_factorial(index - 1)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE index

  alternating_sign(index: nat): RECURSIVE real =
    IF index = 0 THEN
      1
    ELSE
      -alternating_sign(index - 1)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE index

  exponential_partial(x: real, count: nat): RECURSIVE real =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      LET index: nat = count - 1 IN
        exponential_partial(x, count - 1)
          + safe_div(
              x ^ index,
              nat_factorial(index) :: real)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  leibniz_partial_sum(count: nat): RECURSIVE real =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      LET index: nat = count - 1 IN
        leibniz_partial_sum(count - 1)
          + safe_div(
              alternating_sign(index),
              (2 * index + 1) :: real)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  converges_to(sequence: real_sequence, value: real): bool =
    FORALL (epsilon_value: posreal):
      EXISTS (cutoff: nat):
        FORALL (index: nat):
          cutoff <= index IMPLIES
            abs(sequence(index) - value) < epsilon_value

  real_exponential(x: real): real =
    epsilon(
      LAMBDA (value: real):
        converges_to(
          LAMBDA (count: nat):
            exponential_partial(x, count),
          value))

  is_pi(value: real): bool =
    converges_to(
      LAMBDA (count: nat):
        4 * leibniz_partial_sum(count),
      value)

  pi: real =
    epsilon(
      LAMBDA (value: real):
        is_pi(value))

  nonnegative_sqrt(x: real): real =
    IF x >= 0 THEN
      epsilon(
        LAMBDA (root: real):
          root >= 0 AND root * root = x)
    ELSE
      0
    ENDIF

  inverse_sqrt_on_positive(t: real): real =
    IF t > 0 THEN
      safe_div(1, nonnegative_sqrt(t))
    ELSE
      0
    ENDIF

  gaussian_integrand(x: real): real =
    real_exponential(-(x ^ 2))

  target_integrand(t: real): real =
    inverse_sqrt_on_positive(t)
      * real_exponential(
          -1985 * (t + safe_div(1, t)))

  valid_tagged_partition(
      left, right: real,
      points, tags: real_sequence,
      count: nat): bool =
    count > 0
      AND points(0) = left
      AND points(count) = right
      AND FORALL (index: nat):
        index < count IMPLIES
          (points(index) < points(index + 1)
            AND points(index) <= tags(index)
            AND tags(index) <= points(index + 1))

  mesh_less_than(
      points: real_sequence,
      count: nat,
      bound: real): bool =
    FORALL (index: nat):
      index < count IMPLIES
        points(index + 1) - points(index) < bound

  riemann_sum(
      function_value: real_function,
      points, tags: real_sequence,
      count: nat): RECURSIVE real =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      riemann_sum(
        function_value, points, tags, count - 1)
        + function_value(tags(count - 1))
            * (points(count) - points(count - 1))
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  has_interval_integral(
      function_value: real_function,
      left, right, integral_value: real): bool =
    left < right
      AND FORALL (epsilon_value: posreal):
        EXISTS (mesh_bound: posreal):
          FORALL
              (points, tags: real_sequence),
              (count: nat):
            (valid_tagged_partition(
                left, right, points, tags, count)
              AND mesh_less_than(
                points, count, mesh_bound))
            IMPLIES
              abs(
                riemann_sum(
                  function_value, points, tags, count)
                  - integral_value)
                < epsilon_value

  interval_integral(
      function_value: real_function,
      left, right: real): real =
    IF left = right THEN
      0
    ELSIF left < right THEN
      IF EXISTS (integral_value: real):
          has_interval_integral(
            function_value, left, right, integral_value)
      THEN
        epsilon(
          LAMBDA (integral_value: real):
            has_interval_integral(
              function_value, left, right, integral_value))
      ELSE
        0
      ENDIF
    ELSE
      IF EXISTS (integral_value: real):
          has_interval_integral(
            function_value, right, left, integral_value)
      THEN
        -epsilon(
          LAMBDA (integral_value: real):
            has_interval_integral(
              function_value, right, left, integral_value))
      ELSE
        0
      ENDIF
    ENDIF

  converges_at_real_top(
      values: positive_real_function,
      limit_value: real): bool =
    FORALL (epsilon_value: posreal):
      EXISTS (cutoff: posreal):
        FORALL (radius: posreal):
          cutoff <= radius IMPLIES
            abs(values(radius) - limit_value) < epsilon_value

  gaussian_integral_value(value: real): bool =
    converges_at_real_top(
      LAMBDA (radius: posreal):
        interval_integral(
          gaussian_integrand, -radius, radius),
      value)

  target_integral_value(value: real): bool =
    converges_at_real_top(
      LAMBDA (radius: posreal):
        interval_integral(
          target_integrand, 0, radius),
      value)

  putnam_1985_b5_solution: real =
    nonnegative_sqrt(safe_div(pi, 1985))
      * real_exponential(-3970)

  putnam_1985_b5: bool =
    gaussian_integral_value(nonnegative_sqrt(pi))
      IMPLIES
        target_integral_value(putnam_1985_b5_solution)
END putnam_1985_b5

title: putnam_1985_b6
content:
(* Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench artifact putnam_1985_b6:
   a finite group of real square matrices whose traces sum to zero has matrix
   sum equal to the zero matrix. This file contains no proof. *)

From Stdlib Require Import Lists.List Vectors.Fin Reals.

Import ListNotations.
Open Scope R_scope.

Definition putnam_1985_b6_matrix (n : nat) : Type :=
  Fin.t n -> Fin.t n -> R.

Definition putnam_1985_b6_matrix_eq {n : nat}
    (A B : putnam_1985_b6_matrix n) : Prop :=
  forall i j : Fin.t n, A i j = B i j.

Fixpoint putnam_1985_b6_fin_sum
    (n : nat) : (Fin.t n -> R) -> R :=
  match n as k return (Fin.t k -> R) -> R with
  | O => fun _ => 0
  | S k =>
      fun f =>
        f Fin.F1 +
        putnam_1985_b6_fin_sum k (fun i => f (Fin.FS i))
  end.

Definition putnam_1985_b6_matrix_zero
    (n : nat) : putnam_1985_b6_matrix n :=
  fun _ _ => 0.

Definition putnam_1985_b6_matrix_identity
    (n : nat) : putnam_1985_b6_matrix n :=
  fun i j => if Fin.eq_dec i j then 1 else 0.

Definition putnam_1985_b6_matrix_add {n : nat}
    (A B : putnam_1985_b6_matrix n) : putnam_1985_b6_matrix n :=
  fun i j => A i j + B i j.

Definition putnam_1985_b6_matrix_mul {n : nat}
    (A B : putnam_1985_b6_matrix n) : putnam_1985_b6_matrix n :=
  fun i j =>
    putnam_1985_b6_fin_sum n (fun k => A i k * B k j).

Definition putnam_1985_b6_trace {n : nat}
    (A : putnam_1985_b6_matrix n) : R :=
  putnam_1985_b6_fin_sum n (fun i => A i i).

Fixpoint putnam_1985_b6_matrix_sum {n : nat}
    (G : list (putnam_1985_b6_matrix n)) : putnam_1985_b6_matrix n :=
  match G with
  | [] => putnam_1985_b6_matrix_zero n
  | A :: rest =>
      putnam_1985_b6_matrix_add A
        (putnam_1985_b6_matrix_sum rest)
  end.

Fixpoint putnam_1985_b6_trace_sum {n : nat}
    (G : list (putnam_1985_b6_matrix n)) : R :=
  match G with
  | [] => 0
  | A :: rest =>
      putnam_1985_b6_trace A + putnam_1985_b6_trace_sum rest
  end.

Definition putnam_1985_b6_member {n : nat}
    (A : putnam_1985_b6_matrix n)
    (G : list (putnam_1985_b6_matrix n)) : Prop :=
  exists B : putnam_1985_b6_matrix n,
    In B G /\ putnam_1985_b6_matrix_eq A B.

Fixpoint putnam_1985_b6_nodup {n : nat}
    (G : list (putnam_1985_b6_matrix n)) : Prop :=
  match G with
  | [] => True
  | A :: rest =>
      ~ putnam_1985_b6_member A rest /\
      putnam_1985_b6_nodup rest
  end.

Theorem putnam_1985_b6
    (n : nat)
    (npos : (0 < n)%nat)
    (G : list (putnam_1985_b6_matrix n))
    (Gnodup : putnam_1985_b6_nodup G)
    (groupG :
      (forall g h : putnam_1985_b6_matrix n,
        putnam_1985_b6_member g G ->
        putnam_1985_b6_member h G ->
        putnam_1985_b6_member (putnam_1985_b6_matrix_mul g h) G) /\
      putnam_1985_b6_member (putnam_1985_b6_matrix_identity n) G /\
      (forall g : putnam_1985_b6_matrix n,
        putnam_1985_b6_member g G ->
        exists h : putnam_1985_b6_matrix n,
          putnam_1985_b6_member h G /\
          putnam_1985_b6_matrix_eq
            (putnam_1985_b6_matrix_mul g h)
            (putnam_1985_b6_matrix_identity n)))
    (hG : putnam_1985_b6_trace_sum G = 0) :
  putnam_1985_b6_matrix_eq
    (putnam_1985_b6_matrix_sum G)
    (putnam_1985_b6_matrix_zero n).
Admitted.

theory putnam_1985_b6 imports Complex_Main "HOL-Analysis.Finite_Cartesian_Product" "HOL-Analysis.Determinants"
begin

theorem putnam_1985_b6:
  fixes n::nat and G::"(real^'a^'a) set"
  assumes npos : "n > 0"
    and acard : "CARD('a) = n"
    and Gfin : "finite G"
    and groupG : "(\<forall>g \<in> G. \<forall>h \<in> G. g ** h \<in> G) \<and> (1 \<in> G) \<and> (\<forall>g \<in> G. \<exists>h \<in> G. g ** h = 1)"
    and hG : "(\<Sum>M \<in> G. trace M) = 0"
  shows "(\<Sum>M \<in> G. M) = 0"
  sorry

end

title: putnam_1985_b6
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1985_b6:
  a finite group of real square matrices has zero matrix sum when the sum of
  the matrices' traces is zero. This file contains no proof.
*)

let statement =
  `let matrix_mul =
     \A B:real^N^N.
       (lambda i j.
          sum (1..dimindex(:N)) (\k. A$i$k * B$k$j)):real^N^N in
   let identity_matrix =
     (lambda i j. if i = j then &1 else &0):real^N^N in
   let zero_matrix =
     (lambda i j. &0):real^N^N in
   let matrix_trace =
     \A:real^N^N. sum (1..dimindex(:N)) (\i. A$i$i) in
   let matrix_sum =
     \G:(real^N^N)->bool.
       (lambda i j. sum G (\M:real^N^N. M$i$j)):real^N^N in
   !n:num. !G:(real^N^N)->bool.
     dimindex(:N) = n /\
     0 < n /\
     FINITE G /\
     (!g:real^N^N.
        g IN G ==> !h:real^N^N. h IN G ==> matrix_mul g h IN G) /\
     identity_matrix IN G /\
     (!g:real^N^N.
        g IN G
        ==> ?h:real^N^N.
              h IN G /\ matrix_mul g h = identity_matrix) /\
     sum G matrix_trace = &0
     ==> matrix_sum G = zero_matrix`;;

title: putnam_1985_b6
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1985_b6:
;; a finite group of real square matrices whose traces sum to zero has zero
;; matrix sum. This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))

;; The scalar interface presents an arbitrary real-closed ordered field.
;; Matrices below contain arbitrary carrier values, so the statement directly
;; ranges over all finite real matrix groups rather than an algebraic subset.

(defstub putnam-1985-b6-real-p (real-type value) t)
(defstub putnam-1985-b6-zero (real-type) t)
(defstub putnam-1985-b6-one (real-type) t)
(defstub putnam-1985-b6-add (real-type left right) t)
(defstub putnam-1985-b6-mul (real-type left right) t)
(defstub putnam-1985-b6-neg (real-type value) t)
(defstub putnam-1985-b6-inv (real-type value) t)
(defstub putnam-1985-b6-less (real-type left right) t)

(defun putnam-1985-b6-leq (real-type left right)
  (not (putnam-1985-b6-less real-type right left)))

(defun-sk putnam-1985-b6-field-laws-p (real-type)
  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (putnam-1985-b6-real-p real-type x)
      (putnam-1985-b6-real-p real-type y)
      (putnam-1985-b6-real-p real-type z))
     (let* ((zero (putnam-1985-b6-zero real-type))
            (one (putnam-1985-b6-one real-type))
            (x-plus-y (putnam-1985-b6-add real-type x y))
            (y-plus-z (putnam-1985-b6-add real-type y z))
            (x-times-y (putnam-1985-b6-mul real-type x y))
            (y-times-z (putnam-1985-b6-mul real-type y z))
            (minus-x (putnam-1985-b6-neg real-type x))
            (inverse-x (putnam-1985-b6-inv real-type x)))
       (and
        (putnam-1985-b6-real-p real-type x-plus-y)
        (putnam-1985-b6-real-p real-type x-times-y)
        (putnam-1985-b6-real-p real-type minus-x)
        (putnam-1985-b6-real-p real-type inverse-x)
        (equal
         (putnam-1985-b6-add real-type x-plus-y z)
         (putnam-1985-b6-add real-type x y-plus-z))
        (equal x-plus-y (putnam-1985-b6-add real-type y x))
        (equal (putnam-1985-b6-add real-type x zero) x)
        (equal (putnam-1985-b6-add real-type x minus-x) zero)
        (equal
         (putnam-1985-b6-mul real-type x-times-y z)
         (putnam-1985-b6-mul real-type x y-times-z))
        (equal x-times-y (putnam-1985-b6-mul real-type y x))
        (equal (putnam-1985-b6-mul real-type x one) x)
        (implies
         (equal x zero)
         (equal inverse-x zero))
        (implies
         (not (equal x zero))
         (equal
          (putnam-1985-b6-mul real-type x inverse-x)
          one))
        (equal
         (putnam-1985-b6-mul real-type x y-plus-z)
         (putnam-1985-b6-add
          real-type
          (putnam-1985-b6-mul real-type x y)
          (putnam-1985-b6-mul real-type x z))))))))

(defun-sk putnam-1985-b6-order-laws-p (real-type)
  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (putnam-1985-b6-real-p real-type x)
      (putnam-1985-b6-real-p real-type y)
      (putnam-1985-b6-real-p real-type z))
     (let ((zero (putnam-1985-b6-zero real-type)))
       (and
        (not (putnam-1985-b6-less real-type x x))
        (or
         (putnam-1985-b6-less real-type x y)
         (equal x y)
         (putnam-1985-b6-less real-type y x))
        (implies
         (and
          (putnam-1985-b6-less real-type x y)
          (putnam-1985-b6-less real-type y z))
         (putnam-1985-b6-less real-type x z))
        (implies
         (putnam-1985-b6-less real-type x y)
         (putnam-1985-b6-less
          real-type
          (putnam-1985-b6-add real-type x z)
          (putnam-1985-b6-add real-type y z)))
        (implies
         (and
          (putnam-1985-b6-less real-type zero x)
          (putnam-1985-b6-less real-type zero y))
         (putnam-1985-b6-less
          real-type
          zero
          (putnam-1985-b6-mul real-type x y))))))))

(defun putnam-1985-b6-real-list-p (real-type values)
  (if (consp values)
      (and
       (putnam-1985-b6-real-p real-type (car values))
       (putnam-1985-b6-real-list-p real-type (cdr values)))
    (equal values nil)))

(defun putnam-1985-b6-polynomial-value
    (real-type coefficients x)
  (if (consp coefficients)
      (putnam-1985-b6-add
       real-type
       (car coefficients)
       (putnam-1985-b6-mul
        real-type
        x
        (putnam-1985-b6-polynomial-value
         real-type (cdr coefficients) x)))
    (putnam-1985-b6-zero real-type)))

(defun-sk putnam-1985-b6-square-root-exists-p
    (real-type x)
  (exists (root)
    (and
     (putnam-1985-b6-real-p real-type root)
     (putnam-1985-b6-leq
      real-type (putnam-1985-b6-zero real-type) root)
     (equal
      (putnam-1985-b6-mul real-type root root)
      x))))

(defun-sk putnam-1985-b6-square-root-property-p
    (real-type)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (and
      (putnam-1985-b6-real-p real-type x)
      (putnam-1985-b6-leq
       real-type (putnam-1985-b6-zero real-type) x))
     (putnam-1985-b6-square-root-exists-p
      real-type x))))

(defun putnam-1985-b6-odd-degree-polynomial-p
    (real-type coefficients)
  (and
   (true-listp coefficients)
   (<= 2 (len coefficients))
   (evenp (len coefficients))
   (putnam-1985-b6-real-list-p real-type coefficients)
   (not
    (equal
     (car (last coefficients))
     (putnam-1985-b6-zero real-type)))))

(defun-sk putnam-1985-b6-polynomial-root-exists-p
    (real-type coefficients)
  (exists (root)
    (and
     (putnam-1985-b6-real-p real-type root)
     (equal
      (putnam-1985-b6-polynomial-value
       real-type coefficients root)
      (putnam-1985-b6-zero real-type)))))

(defun-sk putnam-1985-b6-odd-degree-root-property-p
    (real-type)
  (forall (coefficients)
    (implies
     (putnam-1985-b6-odd-degree-polynomial-p
      real-type coefficients)
     (putnam-1985-b6-polynomial-root-exists-p
      real-type coefficients))))

(defun putnam-1985-b6-real-closed-field-p (real-type)
  (let ((zero (putnam-1985-b6-zero real-type))
        (one (putnam-1985-b6-one real-type)))
    (and
     (putnam-1985-b6-real-p real-type zero)
     (putnam-1985-b6-real-p real-type one)
     (not (equal zero one))
     (putnam-1985-b6-field-laws-p real-type)
     (putnam-1985-b6-order-laws-p real-type)
     (putnam-1985-b6-less real-type zero one)
     (putnam-1985-b6-square-root-property-p real-type)
     (putnam-1985-b6-odd-degree-root-property-p real-type))))

;; Matrices are flat row-major true lists of n*n arbitrary carrier values.

(defun putnam-1985-b6-matrix-p (real-type n matrix)
  (and
   (natp n)
   (true-listp matrix)
   (equal (len matrix) (* n n))
   (putnam-1985-b6-real-list-p real-type matrix)))

(defun putnam-1985-b6-matrix-list-p
    (real-type n matrices)
  (if (consp matrices)
      (and
       (putnam-1985-b6-matrix-p
        real-type n (car matrices))
       (putnam-1985-b6-matrix-list-p
        real-type n (cdr matrices)))
    (equal matrices nil)))

(defun putnam-1985-b6-zero-list (real-type count)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix count)))
  (if (zp count)
      nil
    (cons
     (putnam-1985-b6-zero real-type)
     (putnam-1985-b6-zero-list
      real-type (- count 1)))))

(defun putnam-1985-b6-zero-matrix (real-type n)
  (putnam-1985-b6-zero-list real-type (* n n)))

(defun putnam-1985-b6-identity-entries
    (real-type n index remaining)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix remaining)))
  (if (zp remaining)
      nil
    (let ((row (floor (nfix index) n))
          (column (mod (nfix index) n)))
      (cons
       (if (equal row column)
           (putnam-1985-b6-one real-type)
         (putnam-1985-b6-zero real-type))
       (putnam-1985-b6-identity-entries
        real-type n (+ index 1) (- remaining 1))))))

(defun putnam-1985-b6-identity-matrix (real-type n)
  (if (posp n)
      (putnam-1985-b6-identity-entries
       real-type n 0 (* n n))
    nil))

(defun putnam-1985-b6-matrix-add
    (real-type left right)
  (if (consp left)
      (cons
       (putnam-1985-b6-add
        real-type (car left) (car right))
       (putnam-1985-b6-matrix-add
        real-type (cdr left) (cdr right)))
    nil))

(defun putnam-1985-b6-dot-product
    (real-type n row column left right k)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix k)))
  (if (zp k)
      (putnam-1985-b6-zero real-type)
    (let* ((index (- k 1))
           (left-entry
            (nth (+ (* row n) index) left))
           (right-entry
            (nth (+ (* index n) column) right)))
      (putnam-1985-b6-add
       real-type
       (putnam-1985-b6-mul
        real-type left-entry right-entry)
       (putnam-1985-b6-dot-product
        real-type n row column left right index)))))

(defun putnam-1985-b6-matrix-product-entries
    (real-type n left right index remaining)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix remaining)))
  (if (zp remaining)
      nil
    (let ((row (floor (nfix index) n))
          (column (mod (nfix index) n)))
      (cons
       (putnam-1985-b6-dot-product
        real-type n row column left right n)
       (putnam-1985-b6-matrix-product-entries
        real-type
        n
        left
        right
        (+ index 1)
        (- remaining 1))))))

(defun putnam-1985-b6-matrix-product
    (real-type n left right)
  (if (posp n)
      (putnam-1985-b6-matrix-product-entries
       real-type n left right 0 (* n n))
    nil))

(defun putnam-1985-b6-trace-aux
    (real-type n matrix index remaining)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix remaining)))
  (if (zp remaining)
      (putnam-1985-b6-zero real-type)
    (putnam-1985-b6-add
     real-type
     (nth (+ (* index n) index) matrix)
     (putnam-1985-b6-trace-aux
      real-type n matrix (+ index 1) (- remaining 1)))))

(defun putnam-1985-b6-trace (real-type n matrix)
  (putnam-1985-b6-trace-aux
   real-type n matrix 0 n))

(defun putnam-1985-b6-trace-sum
    (real-type n matrices)
  (if (consp matrices)
      (putnam-1985-b6-add
       real-type
       (putnam-1985-b6-trace
        real-type n (car matrices))
       (putnam-1985-b6-trace-sum
        real-type n (cdr matrices)))
    (putnam-1985-b6-zero real-type)))

(defun putnam-1985-b6-matrix-sum
    (real-type n matrices)
  (if (consp matrices)
      (putnam-1985-b6-matrix-add
       real-type
       (car matrices)
       (putnam-1985-b6-matrix-sum
        real-type n (cdr matrices)))
    (putnam-1985-b6-zero-matrix real-type n)))

;; The list has set semantics through no-duplicatesp-equal. Closure,
;; identity, and a right inverse inside the list reproduce groupG exactly.

(defun putnam-1985-b6-products-in-group-p
    (real-type n left rights group)
  (if (consp rights)
      (and
       (member-equal
        (putnam-1985-b6-matrix-product
         real-type n left (car rights))
        group)
       (putnam-1985-b6-products-in-group-p
        real-type n left (cdr rights) group))
    t))

(defun putnam-1985-b6-closed-p
    (real-type n remaining group)
  (if (consp remaining)
      (and
       (putnam-1985-b6-products-in-group-p
        real-type n (car remaining) group group)
       (putnam-1985-b6-closed-p
        real-type n (cdr remaining) group))
    t))

(defun putnam-1985-b6-right-inverse-in-group-p
    (real-type n matrix candidates identity)
  (if (consp candidates)
      (or
       (equal
        (putnam-1985-b6-matrix-product
         real-type n matrix (car candidates))
        identity)
       (putnam-1985-b6-right-inverse-in-group-p
        real-type
        n
        matrix
        (cdr candidates)
        identity))
    nil))

(defun putnam-1985-b6-all-right-inverses-p
    (real-type n remaining group identity)
  (if (consp remaining)
      (and
       (putnam-1985-b6-right-inverse-in-group-p
        real-type n (car remaining) group identity)
       (putnam-1985-b6-all-right-inverses-p
        real-type n (cdr remaining) group identity))
    t))

(defun putnam-1985-b6-group-p
    (real-type n matrices)
  (let ((identity
         (putnam-1985-b6-identity-matrix real-type n)))
    (and
     (true-listp matrices)
     (putnam-1985-b6-matrix-list-p
      real-type n matrices)
     (no-duplicatesp-equal matrices)
     (putnam-1985-b6-closed-p
      real-type n matrices matrices)
     (member-equal identity matrices)
     (putnam-1985-b6-all-right-inverses-p
      real-type n matrices matrices identity))))

(defun putnambench-putnam-1985-b6-statement
    (real-type n matrices)
  (implies
   (and
    (putnam-1985-b6-real-closed-field-p real-type)
    (posp n)
    (putnam-1985-b6-group-p real-type n matrices)
    (equal
     (putnam-1985-b6-trace-sum
      real-type n matrices)
     (putnam-1985-b6-zero real-type)))
   (equal
    (putnam-1985-b6-matrix-sum
     real-type n matrices)
    (putnam-1985-b6-zero-matrix real-type n))))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

title: putnam_1985_b6
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1985_b6:
-- a finite group of real square matrices whose traces sum to zero has matrix
-- sum equal to the zero matrix. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

open import Agda.Builtin.Bool using (Bool; true; false)
open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; _*_)

infix 4 _!=_
infixr 3 _and_
infixr 2 _or_

data Bottom : Set where

Not : Set -> Set
Not A =
  A -> Bottom

_!=_ : {A : Set} -> A -> A -> Set
x != y =
  Not (x == y)

record _and_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data _or_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  left  : A -> A or B
  right : B -> A or B

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

data Positive : Nat -> Set where
  positive : {n : Nat} -> Positive (suc n)

data Fin : Nat -> Set where
  fzero : {n : Nat} -> Fin (suc n)
  fsuc  : {n : Nat} -> Fin n -> Fin (suc n)

finEqual :
  {n : Nat} ->
  Fin n ->
  Fin n ->
  Bool
finEqual fzero fzero =
  true
finEqual fzero (fsuc j) =
  false
finEqual (fsuc i) fzero =
  false
finEqual (fsuc i) (fsuc j) =
  finEqual i j

ifThenElse :
  {A : Set} ->
  Bool ->
  A ->
  A ->
  A
ifThenElse true when-true when-false =
  when-true
ifThenElse false when-true when-false =
  when-false

record CompleteOrderedRealField (R : Set) : Set1 where
  field
    zeroR oneR : R
    add multiply : R -> R -> R
    negate inverse : R -> R
    lessOrEqual : R -> R -> Set
    fromNat : Nat -> R

    one-not-zero :
      oneR != zeroR

    add-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> add x y == add y x
    add-associative :
      (x y z : R) -> add (add x y) z == add x (add y z)
    add-zero :
      (x : R) -> add x zeroR == x
    add-inverse :
      (x : R) -> add x (negate x) == zeroR

    multiply-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> multiply x y == multiply y x
    multiply-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply (multiply x y) z == multiply x (multiply y z)
    multiply-one :
      (x : R) -> multiply x oneR == x
    multiply-zero :
      (x : R) -> multiply x zeroR == zeroR
    distribute :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply x (add y z) ==
      add (multiply x y) (multiply x z)
    inverse-zero :
      inverse zeroR == zeroR
    multiply-inverse :
      (x : R) ->
      x != zeroR ->
      multiply x (inverse x) == oneR

    order-reflexive :
      (x : R) -> lessOrEqual x x
    order-transitive :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y z ->
      lessOrEqual x z
    order-antisymmetric :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y x ->
      x == y
    order-total :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y or lessOrEqual y x
    add-order :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual (add z x) (add z y)
    multiply-nonnegative :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR x ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR y ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR (multiply x y)
    zero-less-than-one :
      lessOrEqual zeroR oneR and zeroR != oneR

    fromNat-zero :
      fromNat zero == zeroR
    fromNat-successor :
      (n : Nat) -> fromNat (suc n) == add (fromNat n) oneR
    fromNat-addition :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m + n) == add (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-multiplication :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m * n) == multiply (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-injective :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat m == fromNat n ->
      m == n

    archimedean :
      (x : R) ->
      Exists Nat (\ n -> lessOrEqual x (fromNat n))
    least-upper-bound :
      (P : R -> Set) ->
      Exists R P ->
      Exists R
        (\ upper ->
          (x : R) ->
          P x ->
          lessOrEqual x upper) ->
      Exists R
        (\ supremum ->
          ((x : R) ->
            P x ->
            lessOrEqual x supremum)
          and
          ((upper : R) ->
            ((x : R) ->
              P x ->
              lessOrEqual x upper) ->
            lessOrEqual supremum upper))

open CompleteOrderedRealField

Matrix :
  Set ->
  Nat ->
  Set
Matrix R n =
  Fin n -> Fin n -> R

MatrixEqual :
  {R : Set} {n : Nat} ->
  Matrix R n ->
  Matrix R n ->
  Set
MatrixEqual {n = n} A B =
  (i j : Fin n) ->
  A i j == B i j

sumFin :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  {n : Nat} ->
  (Fin n -> R) ->
  R
sumFin reals {zero} term =
  zeroR reals
sumFin reals {suc n} term =
  add reals
    (term fzero)
    (sumFin reals (\ i -> term (fsuc i)))

zeroMatrix :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  {n : Nat} ->
  Matrix R n
zeroMatrix reals i j =
  zeroR reals

identityMatrix :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  {n : Nat} ->
  Matrix R n
identityMatrix reals i j =
  ifThenElse
    (finEqual i j)
    (oneR reals)
    (zeroR reals)

matrixMultiply :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  {n : Nat} ->
  Matrix R n ->
  Matrix R n ->
  Matrix R n
matrixMultiply reals A B i j =
  sumFin reals
    (\ k -> multiply reals (A i k) (B k j))

trace :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  {n : Nat} ->
  Matrix R n ->
  R
trace reals A =
  sumFin reals (\ i -> A i i)

record FiniteMatrixSet
  (R : Set)
  (n : Nat) :
  Set where

  field
    cardinality :
      Nat
    enumerate :
      Fin cardinality ->
      Matrix R n
    enumeration-injective :
      (i j : Fin cardinality) ->
      MatrixEqual (enumerate i) (enumerate j) ->
      i == j

open FiniteMatrixSet

matrixSum :
  {R : Set} {n : Nat} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  FiniteMatrixSet R n ->
  Matrix R n
matrixSum reals G i j =
  sumFin reals
    (\ k -> enumerate G k i j)

ClosedUnderMultiplication :
  {R : Set} {n : Nat} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  FiniteMatrixSet R n ->
  Set
ClosedUnderMultiplication reals G =
  (i j : Fin (cardinality G)) ->
  Exists (Fin (cardinality G))
    (\ k ->
      MatrixEqual
        (matrixMultiply reals (enumerate G i) (enumerate G j))
        (enumerate G k))

IdentityBelongs :
  {R : Set} {n : Nat} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  FiniteMatrixSet R n ->
  Set
IdentityBelongs reals G =
  Exists (Fin (cardinality G))
    (\ i ->
      MatrixEqual
        (enumerate G i)
        (identityMatrix reals))

RightInversesBelong :
  {R : Set} {n : Nat} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  FiniteMatrixSet R n ->
  Set
RightInversesBelong reals G =
  (i : Fin (cardinality G)) ->
  Exists (Fin (cardinality G))
    (\ j ->
      MatrixEqual
        (matrixMultiply reals (enumerate G i) (enumerate G j))
        (identityMatrix reals))

GroupUnderMultiplication :
  {R : Set} {n : Nat} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  FiniteMatrixSet R n ->
  Set
GroupUnderMultiplication reals G =
  ClosedUnderMultiplication reals G
  and
  IdentityBelongs reals G
  and
  RightInversesBelong reals G

putnam-1985-b6 : Set1
putnam-1985-b6 =
  (R : Set) ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) ->
  (n : Nat) ->
  Positive n ->
  (G : FiniteMatrixSet R n) ->
  GroupUnderMultiplication reals G ->
  sumFin reals
    (\ k -> trace reals (enumerate G k))
    == zeroR reals ->
  MatrixEqual
    (matrixSum reals G)
    (zeroMatrix reals)

(*
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1985_b6:
  a finite group of positive-dimensional real square matrices with zero total
  trace has zero matrix sum. This file contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open arithmeticTheory pred_setTheory fcpTheory realTheory real_sigmaTheory;
open matrixTheory;

val putnam_1985_b6 =
  ``let matrix_trace =
      \A : real['N]['N].
        SIGMA
          (\i : num. A ' i ' i)
          (count (dimindex (:'N)))
    in
    let matrix_sum =
      \G : real['N]['N] set.
        ITSET
          (\A acc. matrix$matrix_add A acc)
          G
          (matrix$mat 0)
    in
      !n : num. !G : real['N]['N] set.
        0 < n /\
        dimindex (:'N) = n /\
        FINITE G /\
        (!A : real['N]['N].
           A IN G
           ==>
           !B : real['N]['N].
             B IN G
             ==>
             matrix$matrix_mul A B IN G) /\
        matrix$mat 1 IN G /\
        (!A : real['N]['N].
           A IN G
           ==>
           ?B : real['N]['N].
             B IN G /\
             matrix$matrix_mul A B = matrix$mat 1) /\
        SIGMA matrix_trace G = 0
        ==>
        matrix_sum G = matrix$mat 0``;

$(
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact
  putnam_1985_b6: a finite group of real square matrices with zero total
  trace has zero matrix sum. This file contains no proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  The positive natural n has canonical index carrier 0 ..^ n, and G ranges
  over finite subsets of the full set of real-valued matrices on that
  carrier. RRfld maMul is SetMM's matrix multiplication. The group
  hypotheses state closure, membership of the actual identity matrix, and
  a right inverse in G for every member.

  Both trace and matrix addition are rendered by their finite coordinate
  sums. Thus the scalar hypothesis is the sum over G of the diagonal sums,
  while the conclusion says coordinatewise that the sum of all matrices in
  G is the zero matrix. The final declaration is the single unproved $a
  corpus statement; this database contains no $p proof statement.
$)

${
  $d G M g h i j n $.

  putnambench-putnam-1985-b6 $a |-
    A. n e. NN
      A. G e.
        ~P
        (
          RR
          ^m
          ( ( 0 ..^ n ) X. ( 0 ..^ n ) )
        )
        (
          (
            G e. Fin
            /\
            (
              A. g e. G
                A. h e. G
                  (
                    g
                    (
                      RRfld
                      maMul
                      <.
                        ( 0 ..^ n ) ,
                        ( 0 ..^ n ) ,
                        ( 0 ..^ n )
                      >.
                    )
                    h
                  )
                  e. G
              /\
              (
                (
                  i e. ( 0 ..^ n ) , j e. ( 0 ..^ n ) |->
                    if ( i = j , 1 , 0 )
                )
                e. G
                /\
                A. g e. G
                  E. h e. G
                    (
                      g
                      (
                        RRfld
                        maMul
                        <.
                          ( 0 ..^ n ) ,
                          ( 0 ..^ n ) ,
                          ( 0 ..^ n )
                        >.
                      )
                      h
                    )
                    =
                    (
                      i e. ( 0 ..^ n ) , j e. ( 0 ..^ n ) |->
                        if ( i = j , 1 , 0 )
                    )
              )
            )
            /\
            (
              sum_ M e. G
                sum_ i e. ( 0 ..^ n )
                  ( M ` <. i , i >. )
            )
            =
            0
          )
          ->
          (
            i e. ( 0 ..^ n ) , j e. ( 0 ..^ n ) |->
              sum_ M e. G
                ( M ` <. i , j >. )
          )
          =
          (
            i e. ( 0 ..^ n ) , j e. ( 0 ..^ n ) |->
              0
          )
        )
  $.
$}

title: putnam_1985_b6
content:
% Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1985_b6:
% a finite multiplicative group of positive-dimensional real square matrices
% with zero total trace has zero matrix sum. This file contains no proof.

putnam_1985_b6[n: posnat]: THEORY
BEGIN
  matrix: TYPE = [below(n), below(n) -> real]

  IMPORTING finite_sets[matrix]

  bounded_real_sum(
      values: [below(n) -> real],
      count: nat): RECURSIVE real =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      bounded_real_sum(values, count - 1)
        + IF count <= n THEN
            values(count - 1)
          ELSE
            0
          ENDIF
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  zero_matrix: matrix =
    LAMBDA (row, column: below(n)): 0

  identity_matrix: matrix =
    LAMBDA (row, column: below(n)):
      IF row = column THEN 1 ELSE 0 ENDIF

  matrix_add(A, B: matrix): matrix =
    LAMBDA (row, column: below(n)):
      A(row, column) + B(row, column)

  matrix_multiply(A, B: matrix): matrix =
    LAMBDA (row, column: below(n)):
      bounded_real_sum(
        LAMBDA (index: below(n)):
          A(row, index) * B(index, column),
        n)

  matrix_trace(A: matrix): real =
    bounded_real_sum(
      LAMBDA (index: below(n)): A(index, index),
      n)

  distinct_entries(values: list[matrix]): RECURSIVE bool =
    CASES values OF
      null: TRUE,
      cons(value, tail):
        NOT member(value, tail) AND distinct_entries(tail)
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE values BY <<

  enumerates_set(
      values: list[matrix],
      G: finite_set[matrix]): bool =
    distinct_entries(values)
      AND (FORALL (A: matrix):
        G(A) IFF member(A, values))

  matrix_list_sum(values: list[matrix]): RECURSIVE matrix =
    CASES values OF
      null: zero_matrix,
      cons(value, tail):
        matrix_add(value, matrix_list_sum(tail))
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE values BY <<

  trace_list_sum(values: list[matrix]): RECURSIVE real =
    CASES values OF
      null: 0,
      cons(value, tail):
        matrix_trace(value) + trace_list_sum(tail)
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE values BY <<

  finite_matrix_sum(
      G: finite_set[matrix],
      total: matrix): bool =
    EXISTS (values: list[matrix]):
      enumerates_set(values, G)
        AND matrix_list_sum(values) = total

  finite_trace_sum(
      G: finite_set[matrix],
      total: real): bool =
    EXISTS (values: list[matrix]):
      enumerates_set(values, G)
        AND trace_list_sum(values) = total

  is_multiplicative_group(G: finite_set[matrix]): bool =
    (FORALL (A, B: matrix):
      G(A) AND G(B) IMPLIES G(matrix_multiply(A, B)))
      AND G(identity_matrix)
      AND (FORALL (A: matrix):
        G(A) IMPLIES
          EXISTS (B: matrix):
            G(B)
              AND matrix_multiply(A, B) = identity_matrix)

  putnam_1985_b6: bool =
    FORALL (G: finite_set[matrix]):
      (is_multiplicative_group(G)
        AND finite_trace_sum(G, 0))
      IMPLIES finite_matrix_sum(G, zero_matrix)
END putnam_1985_b6

;; Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1986_a1:
;; the greatest value of x^3 - 3*x over real x satisfying
;; x^4 + 36 <= 13*x^2 is 18. This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

;; Standard ACL2 has exact rational arithmetic rather than a primitive real
;; sort. The constraint factors as
;;
;;   (x^2 - 4)*(x^2 - 9) <= 0,
;;
;; so its real solution set is [-3,-2] union [2,3]. The objective is a
;; polynomial, rational points are dense in both intervals, and the value 18
;; is attained at the rational point x = 3. Consequently the rational
;; greatest-value predicate below and the source real predicate imply each
;; other: restriction gives one direction, while density and continuity give
;; the other without changing the maximum.

(defun putnam-1986-a1-objective (x)
  (- (* x x x)
     (* 3 x)))

(defun putnam-1986-a1-admissible-p (x)
  (and
   (rationalp x)
   (<= (+ (* x x x x) 36)
       (* 13 x x))))

(defun putnambench-putnam-1986-a1-statement (competitor)
  (and
   (putnam-1986-a1-admissible-p 3)
   (equal (putnam-1986-a1-objective 3) 18)
   (implies
    (putnam-1986-a1-admissible-p competitor)
    (<= (putnam-1986-a1-objective competitor)
        18))))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

content:
-- Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1986_a1:
-- the cubic x^3 - 3x has maximum value 18 among all real x satisfying
-- x^4 + 36 <= 13x^2. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; _*_)

infix 4 _!=_
infixr 3 _and_
infixr 2 _or_

data Bottom : Set where

Not : Set -> Set
Not A =
  A -> Bottom

_!=_ : {A : Set} -> A -> A -> Set
x != y =
  Not (x == y)

record _and_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data _or_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  left  : A -> A or B
  right : B -> A or B

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

record CompleteOrderedRealField (R : Set) : Set1 where
  field
    zeroR oneR : R
    add multiply : R -> R -> R
    negate inverse : R -> R
    lessOrEqual : R -> R -> Set
    fromNat : Nat -> R

    one-not-zero :
      oneR != zeroR

    add-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> add x y == add y x
    add-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      add (add x y) z == add x (add y z)
    add-zero :
      (x : R) -> add x zeroR == x
    add-inverse :
      (x : R) -> add x (negate x) == zeroR

    multiply-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> multiply x y == multiply y x
    multiply-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply (multiply x y) z ==
      multiply x (multiply y z)
    multiply-one :
      (x : R) -> multiply x oneR == x
    multiply-zero :
      (x : R) -> multiply x zeroR == zeroR
    distribute :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply x (add y z) ==
      add (multiply x y) (multiply x z)
    inverse-zero :
      inverse zeroR == zeroR
    multiply-inverse :
      (x : R) ->
      x != zeroR ->
      multiply x (inverse x) == oneR

    order-reflexive :
      (x : R) -> lessOrEqual x x
    order-transitive :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y z ->
      lessOrEqual x z
    order-antisymmetric :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y x ->
      x == y
    order-total :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y or lessOrEqual y x
    add-order :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual (add z x) (add z y)
    multiply-nonnegative :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR x ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR y ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR (multiply x y)
    zero-less-than-one :
      lessOrEqual zeroR oneR and zeroR != oneR

    fromNat-zero :
      fromNat zero == zeroR
    fromNat-successor :
      (n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (suc n) == add (fromNat n) oneR
    fromNat-addition :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m + n) == add (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-multiplication :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m * n) == multiply (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-injective :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat m == fromNat n ->
      m == n

    archimedean :
      (x : R) ->
      Exists Nat (\ n -> lessOrEqual x (fromNat n))
    least-upper-bound :
      (P : R -> Set) ->
      Exists R P ->
      Exists R
        (\ upper ->
          (x : R) ->
          P x ->
          lessOrEqual x upper) ->
      Exists R
        (\ supremum ->
          ((x : R) ->
            P x ->
            lessOrEqual x supremum)
          and
          ((upper : R) ->
            ((x : R) ->
              P x ->
              lessOrEqual x upper) ->
            lessOrEqual supremum upper))

open CompleteOrderedRealField

twoN : Nat
twoN =
  suc (suc zero)

threeN : Nat
threeN =
  suc twoN

fourN : Nat
fourN =
  suc threeN

sixN : Nat
sixN =
  threeN + threeN

twelveN : Nat
twelveN =
  sixN + sixN

thirteenN : Nat
thirteenN =
  suc twelveN

eighteenN : Nat
eighteenN =
  sixN + (sixN + sixN)

thirtySixN : Nat
thirtySixN =
  eighteenN + eighteenN

subtract :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
subtract reals x y =
  add reals x (negate reals y)

naturalPower :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  Nat ->
  R
naturalPower reals x zero =
  oneR reals
naturalPower reals x (suc n) =
  multiply reals
    (naturalPower reals x n)
    x

module Putnam1986A1Statement
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) where

  feasible : R -> Set
  feasible x =
    lessOrEqual reals
      (add reals
        (naturalPower reals x fourN)
        (fromNat reals thirtySixN))
      (multiply reals
        (fromNat reals thirteenN)
        (naturalPower reals x twoN))

  objective : R -> R
  objective x =
    subtract reals
      (naturalPower reals x threeN)
      (multiply reals
        (fromNat reals threeN)
        x)

  IsMaximumValue : R -> Set
  IsMaximumValue maximum =
    ((x : R) ->
      feasible x ->
      lessOrEqual reals (objective x) maximum)
    and
    Exists R
      (\ x ->
        feasible x
        and
        objective x == maximum)

  proposition : Set
  proposition =
    IsMaximumValue (fromNat reals eighteenN)

putnam-1986-a1 : Set1
putnam-1986-a1 =
  (R : Set) ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) ->
  Putnam1986A1Statement.proposition reals

content:
;; Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1986_a3:
;; evaluation of the infinite real series of arccot(n^2+n+1) as pi/2. This
;; file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

;; For 0 <= X <= 1, these exact rational alternating-series prefixes converge
;; to the real arctangent of X.
(defun putnam-1986-a3-arctan-prefix (x terms)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix terms)))
  (if (zp terms)
      0
    (let* ((index (- terms 1))
           (exponent (+ (* 2 index) 1))
           (sign (if (equal (mod index 2) 0) 1 -1)))
      (+ (putnam-1986-a3-arctan-prefix x index)
         (/ (* sign (expt x exponent))
            exponent)))))

;; The source argument n^2+n+1 is at least one. On the required interval
;; (0,pi/2], its arccotangent is arctan(1/(n^2+n+1)). Thus this is an exact
;; rational prefix for the corresponding source summand.
(defun putnam-1986-a3-summand-prefix (n arctan-terms)
  (putnam-1986-a3-arctan-prefix
   (/ 1 (+ (* n n) n 1))
   arctan-terms))

;; Exact rational approximation to the source partial sum over
;; n=0,...,SUM-TERMS-1.
(defun putnam-1986-a3-series-prefix
    (sum-terms arctan-terms)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix sum-terms)))
  (if (zp sum-terms)
      0
    (let ((n (- sum-terms 1)))
      (+ (putnam-1986-a3-series-prefix
          n arctan-terms)
         (putnam-1986-a3-summand-prefix
          n arctan-terms)))))

;; Machin's identity gives
;;   pi/2 = 8*arctan(1/5) - 2*arctan(1/239).
;; Hence these exact rational values form an independent Cauchy name for the
;; source solution pi/2.
(defun putnam-1986-a3-pi-half-prefix (terms)
  (- (* 8
        (putnam-1986-a3-arctan-prefix (/ 1 5) terms))
     (* 2
        (putnam-1986-a3-arctan-prefix (/ 1 239) terms))))

;; On (0,pi/2], cot is injective and cot(theta)=t is equivalent to
;; tan(theta)=1/t for t>0. Thus the canonical arctangent Cauchy name above
;; eliminates the source's uniquely characterized arccot without choosing an
;; additional function. Positive rational tolerances are cofinal among
;; positive real tolerances.
;;
;; The precision needed for the finitely many arctangent summands may depend
;; on the outer partial-sum index. All cutoffs are existential, so the
;; statement asserts only equality of the two limits and no particular rate.
(defun-sk putnam-1986-a3-precision-tail-p
    (epsilon sum-terms precision-cutoff)
  (forall (arctan-terms pi-terms)
    (implies
     (and
      (natp arctan-terms)
      (<= precision-cutoff arctan-terms)
      (natp pi-terms)
      (<= precision-cutoff pi-terms))
     (<
      (abs
       (- (putnam-1986-a3-series-prefix
           sum-terms arctan-terms)
          (putnam-1986-a3-pi-half-prefix pi-terms)))
      epsilon))))

(defun-sk putnam-1986-a3-precision-cutoff-exists-p
    (epsilon sum-terms)
  (exists (precision-cutoff)
    (and
     (posp precision-cutoff)
     (putnam-1986-a3-precision-tail-p
      epsilon sum-terms precision-cutoff))))

(defun-sk putnam-1986-a3-series-tail-p
    (epsilon sum-cutoff)
  (forall (sum-terms)
    (implies
     (and
      (natp sum-terms)
      (<= sum-cutoff sum-terms))
     (putnam-1986-a3-precision-cutoff-exists-p
      epsilon sum-terms))))

(defun-sk putnam-1986-a3-sum-cutoff-exists-p (epsilon)
  (exists (sum-cutoff)
    (and
     (posp sum-cutoff)
     (putnam-1986-a3-series-tail-p
      epsilon sum-cutoff))))

(defun-sk putnambench-putnam-1986-a3-statement ()
  (forall (epsilon)
    (implies
     (and
      (rationalp epsilon)
      (< 0 epsilon))
     (putnam-1986-a3-sum-cutoff-exists-p epsilon))))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

title: putnam_1986_a3
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1986_a3:
-- the arccotangent series at n^2 + n + 1 converges to pi / 2, where arccot
-- takes nonnegative reals into (0, pi / 2] and inverts cot. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; _*_)

infix 4 _!=_ _<=N_
infixr 3 _and_
infixr 2 _or_

data Bottom : Set where

Not : Set -> Set
Not A =
  A -> Bottom

_!=_ : {A : Set} -> A -> A -> Set
x != y =
  Not (x == y)

record _and_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data _or_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  left  : A -> A or B
  right : B -> A or B

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

data _<=N_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set where
  zero<=N   : {n : Nat} -> zero <=N n
  suc<=sucN : {m n : Nat} -> m <=N n -> suc m <=N suc n

record CompleteOrderedRealField (R : Set) : Set1 where
  field
    zeroR oneR : R
    add multiply : R -> R -> R
    negate inverse : R -> R
    lessOrEqual : R -> R -> Set
    fromNat : Nat -> R

    one-not-zero :
      oneR != zeroR

    add-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> add x y == add y x
    add-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      add (add x y) z == add x (add y z)
    add-zero :
      (x : R) -> add x zeroR == x
    add-inverse :
      (x : R) -> add x (negate x) == zeroR

    multiply-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> multiply x y == multiply y x
    multiply-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply (multiply x y) z ==
      multiply x (multiply y z)
    multiply-one :
      (x : R) -> multiply x oneR == x
    multiply-zero :
      (x : R) -> multiply x zeroR == zeroR
    distribute :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply x (add y z) ==
      add (multiply x y) (multiply x z)
    inverse-zero :
      inverse zeroR == zeroR
    multiply-inverse :
      (x : R) ->
      x != zeroR ->
      multiply x (inverse x) == oneR

    order-reflexive :
      (x : R) -> lessOrEqual x x
    order-transitive :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y z ->
      lessOrEqual x z
    order-antisymmetric :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y x ->
      x == y
    order-total :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y or lessOrEqual y x
    add-order :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual (add z x) (add z y)
    multiply-nonnegative :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR x ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR y ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR (multiply x y)
    zero-less-than-one :
      lessOrEqual zeroR oneR and zeroR != oneR

    fromNat-zero :
      fromNat zero == zeroR
    fromNat-successor :
      (n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (suc n) == add (fromNat n) oneR
    fromNat-addition :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m + n) == add (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-multiplication :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m * n) == multiply (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-injective :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat m == fromNat n ->
      m == n

    archimedean :
      (x : R) ->
      Exists Nat (\ n -> lessOrEqual x (fromNat n))
    least-upper-bound :
      (P : R -> Set) ->
      Exists R P ->
      Exists R
        (\ upper ->
          (x : R) ->
          P x ->
          lessOrEqual x upper) ->
      Exists R
        (\ supremum ->
          ((x : R) ->
            P x ->
            lessOrEqual x supremum)
          and
          ((upper : R) ->
            ((x : R) ->
              P x ->
              lessOrEqual x upper) ->
            lessOrEqual supremum upper))

open CompleteOrderedRealField

oneN : Nat
oneN =
  suc zero

twoN : Nat
twoN =
  suc oneN

fourN : Nat
fourN =
  twoN + twoN

subtract :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
subtract reals x y =
  add reals x (negate reals y)

divide :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
divide reals x y =
  multiply reals x (inverse reals y)

StrictLess :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
StrictLess reals x y =
  lessOrEqual reals x y and x != y

CloseTo :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
CloseTo reals center radius x =
  StrictLess reals
    (subtract reals center radius)
    x
  and
  StrictLess reals
    x
    (add reals center radius)

ConvergesTo :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  R ->
  Set
ConvergesTo {R} reals sequence limit =
  (epsilon : R) ->
  StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) epsilon ->
  Exists Nat
    (\ cutoff ->
      (n : Nat) ->
      cutoff <=N n ->
      CloseTo reals limit epsilon (sequence n))

naturalPower :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  Nat ->
  R
naturalPower reals x zero =
  oneR reals
naturalPower reals x (suc n) =
  multiply reals
    (naturalPower reals x n)
    x

factorial : Nat -> Nat
factorial zero =
  oneN
factorial (suc n) =
  suc n * factorial n

sumFirst :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Nat ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  R
sumFirst reals zero term =
  zeroR reals
sumFirst reals (suc n) term =
  add reals
    (sumFirst reals n term)
    (term n)

SeriesHasSum :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  R ->
  Set
SeriesHasSum reals terms limit =
  ConvergesTo reals
    (\ n -> sumFirst reals n terms)
    limit

alternatingPower :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Nat ->
  R
alternatingPower reals n =
  naturalPower reals
    (negate reals (oneR reals))
    n

sineTerm :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  Nat ->
  R
sineTerm reals x n =
  divide reals
    (multiply reals
      (alternatingPower reals n)
      (naturalPower reals x (suc (twoN * n))))
    (fromNat reals (factorial (suc (twoN * n))))

cosineTerm :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  Nat ->
  R
cosineTerm reals x n =
  divide reals
    (multiply reals
      (alternatingPower reals n)
      (naturalPower reals x (twoN * n)))
    (fromNat reals (factorial (twoN * n)))

leibnizTerm :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Nat ->
  R
leibnizTerm reals n =
  divide reals
    (alternatingPower reals n)
    (fromNat reals (suc (twoN * n)))

record PiValue
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R)
  (value : R) : Set where
  field
    positive :
      StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) value
    leibniz-series :
      SeriesHasSum reals
        (leibnizTerm reals)
        (divide reals value (fromNat reals fourN))

record StandardRealAnalysis
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) : Set1 where
  field
    sine cosine : R -> R
    pi : R

    sine-series :
      (x : R) ->
      SeriesHasSum reals
        (sineTerm reals x)
        (sine x)
    cosine-series :
      (x : R) ->
      SeriesHasSum reals
        (cosineTerm reals x)
        (cosine x)
    pi-value :
      PiValue reals pi

open StandardRealAnalysis

module Putnam1986A3Statement
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R)
  (analysis : StandardRealAnalysis reals) where

  halfPi : R
  halfPi =
    divide reals
      (pi analysis)
      (fromNat reals twoN)

  cotangent : R -> R
  cotangent x =
    divide reals
      (cosine analysis x)
      (sine analysis x)

  IsArccotangent : (R -> R) -> Set
  IsArccotangent arccotangent =
    (t : R) ->
    lessOrEqual reals (zeroR reals) t ->
    (StrictLess reals
      (zeroR reals)
      (arccotangent t)
    and
    lessOrEqual reals
      (arccotangent t)
      halfPi)
    and
    cotangent (arccotangent t) == t

  seriesTerm : (R -> R) -> Nat -> R
  seriesTerm arccotangent n =
    arccotangent
      (fromNat reals
        (n * n + n + oneN))

  proposition : Set
  proposition =
    (arccotangent : R -> R) ->
    IsArccotangent arccotangent ->
    SeriesHasSum reals
      (seriesTerm arccotangent)
      halfPi

putnam-1986-a3 : Set1
putnam-1986-a3 =
  (R : Set) ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) ->
  (analysis : StandardRealAnalysis reals) ->
  Putnam1986A3Statement.proposition reals analysis

$(
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact
  putnam_1986_a3: the real series of positive-branch arccotangents at
  n^2 + n + 1 sums to pi / 2. This file contains no proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  A ranges over all total real-valued functions. Its antecedent is exactly
  the source characterization of arccot on nonnegative reals: A(t) lies in
  (0, pi/2] and cot(A(t)) = t. SetMM's cot is the standard cotangent,
  definitionally equal to cos(x) / sin(x) on this interval, so the separate
  cot function and its defining equality in the Lean and Rocq sources have
  been eliminated without changing the proposition.

  The sum over NN0 is SetMM's convergent infinite real-series sum. Its nth
  term is A(n^2 + n + 1), with the natural index canonically regarded as a
  real argument. The right side is the explicit Rocq solution and the value
  annotated in the Lean and Isabelle sources. The final declaration is the
  single unproved $a corpus statement; this database contains no $p proof
  declaration.
$)

${
  $d A n t $.

  putnambench-putnam-1986-a3 $a |- A. A e. ( RR ^m RR )
    (
      A. t e. RR
        (
          0 <_ t
          ->
          (
            0 < ( A ` t )
            /\
            (
              ( A ` t ) <_ ( _pi / 2 )
              /\
              ( cot ` ( A ` t ) ) = t
            )
          )
        )
      ->
      (
        sum_ n e. NN0
          ( A ` ( ( ( n ^ 2 ) + n ) + 1 ) )
      )
      =
      ( _pi / 2 )
    )
  $.
$}
