title: putnam_1986_a3
content:
% Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench artifact putnam_1986_a3:
% the infinite series of principal positive arccotangents of n^2 + n + 1
% sums to pi / 2. This file contains no proof.

putnam_1986_a3: THEORY
BEGIN
  real_function: TYPE = [real -> real]
  real_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> real]

  safe_div(numerator, denominator: real): real =
    IF denominator = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      numerator / denominator
    ENDIF

  nat_factorial(index: nat): RECURSIVE nat =
    IF index = 0 THEN
      1
    ELSE
      index * nat_factorial(index - 1)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE index

  sine_partial(x: real, count: nat): RECURSIVE real =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      LET index: nat = count - 1 IN
        sine_partial(x, count - 1)
          + safe_div(
              ((-1 :: real) ^ index) * x ^ (2 * index + 1),
              nat_factorial(2 * index + 1) :: real)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  cosine_partial(x: real, count: nat): RECURSIVE real =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      LET index: nat = count - 1 IN
        cosine_partial(x, count - 1)
          + safe_div(
              ((-1 :: real) ^ index) * x ^ (2 * index),
              nat_factorial(2 * index) :: real)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  partial_sum(values: real_sequence, count: nat): RECURSIVE real =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      partial_sum(values, count - 1) + values(count - 1)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  converges_to(sequence: real_sequence, value: real): bool =
    FORALL (epsilon_value: posreal):
      EXISTS (cutoff: nat):
        FORALL (index: nat):
          cutoff <= index IMPLIES
            abs(sequence(index) - value) < epsilon_value

  series_sums_to(values: real_sequence, total: real): bool =
    converges_to(
      LAMBDA (count: nat): partial_sum(values, count),
      total)

  sine(x: real): real =
    epsilon(
      LAMBDA (value: real):
        converges_to(
          LAMBDA (count: nat): sine_partial(x, count),
          value))

  cosine(x: real): real =
    epsilon(
      LAMBDA (value: real):
        converges_to(
          LAMBDA (count: nat): cosine_partial(x, count),
          value))

  pi: real =
    epsilon(
      LAMBDA (value: real):
        3 < value
          AND value < 4
          AND cosine(value / 2) = 0)

  cotangent_definition(cot: real_function): bool =
    cot = (LAMBDA (theta: real):
      safe_div(cosine(theta), sine(theta)))

  principal_arccot(
      cot, arccot: real_function): bool =
    FORALL (t: real):
      t >= 0 IMPLIES
        0 < arccot(t)
          AND arccot(t) <= pi / 2
          AND cot(arccot(t)) = t

  arccot_series_terms(arccot: real_function): real_sequence =
    LAMBDA (index: nat):
      arccot(
        (index :: real) ^ 2
          + (index :: real)
          + 1)

  putnam_1986_a3_solution: real = pi / 2

  putnam_1986_a3: bool =
    FORALL (cot, arccot: real_function):
      (cotangent_definition(cot)
        AND principal_arccot(cot, arccot))
      IMPLIES
        series_sums_to(
          arccot_series_terms(arccot),
          putnam_1986_a3_solution)
END putnam_1986_a3

title: putnam_1986_a4
content:
import Mathlib

open  Real Equiv

abbrev putnam_1986_a4_solution : ℚ × ℚ × ℚ × ℚ × ℚ × ℚ × ℚ := sorry
-- (1, 4, 2, 3, -4, 2, 1)
/--
A \emph{transversal} of an $n\times n$ matrix $A$ consists of $n$ entries of $A$, no two in the same row or column. Let $f(n)$ be the number of $n \times n$ matrices $A$ satisfying the following two conditions:
\begin{enumerate}
\item[(a)] Each entry $\alpha_{i,j}$ of $A$ is in the set
$\{-1,0,1\}$.
\item[(b)] The sum of the $n$ entries of a transversal is the same for all transversals of $A$.
\end{enumerate}
An example of such a matrix $A$ is
\[
A = \left( \begin{array}{ccc} -1 & 0 & -1 \\ 0 & 1 & 0 \\ 0 & 1 & 0
\end{array}
\right).
\]
Determine with proof a formula for $f(n)$ of the form
\[
f(n) = a_1 b_1^n + a_2 b_2^n + a_3 b_3^n + a_4,
\]
where the $a_i$'s and $b_i$'s are rational numbers.
-/
theorem putnam_1986_a4
  (f : ℕ → ℕ)
  (hf : f = fun n ↦
    Set.ncard {A : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℤ |
    (∀ i j : Fin n, A i j ∈ ({-1, 0, 1} : Set ℤ)) ∧
    ∃ S : ℤ, ∀ ϕ : Perm (Fin n), ∑ i : Fin n, A i (ϕ i) = S}) :
  let (a1, b1, a2, b2, a3, b3, a4) := putnam_1986_a4_solution;
  (∀ n > 0, f n = a1 * b1 ^ n + a2 * b2 ^ n + a3 * b3 ^ n + a4) :=
sorry

title: putnam_1986_a4
content:
(* Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench artifact putnam_1986_a4:
   counting square matrices with entries in {-1, 0, 1} whose transversal
   sums are all equal, and giving the resulting closed formula. This file
   contains no proof. *)

From Stdlib Require Import ZArith QArith Qpower.
From mathcomp Require Import all_ssreflect.

Set Implicit Arguments.
Unset Strict Implicit.
Unset Printing Implicit Defensive.

Definition putnam_1986_a4_entry {n : nat}
    (A : {ffun ('I_n * 'I_n) -> 'I_3}) (i j : 'I_n) : Z :=
  match nat_of_ord (A (i, j)) with
  | O => (-1)%Z
  | S O => 0%Z
  | _ => 1%Z
  end.

Fixpoint putnam_1986_a4_sum_indices {n : nat}
    (A : {ffun ('I_n * 'I_n) -> 'I_3})
    (p : {ffun 'I_n -> 'I_n}) (indices : seq 'I_n) : Z :=
  match indices with
  | [::] => 0%Z
  | i :: remaining =>
      (putnam_1986_a4_entry A i (p i) +
       putnam_1986_a4_sum_indices A p remaining)%Z
  end.

Definition putnam_1986_a4_transversal_sum {n : nat}
    (A : {ffun ('I_n * 'I_n) -> 'I_3})
    (p : {ffun 'I_n -> 'I_n}) : Z :=
  putnam_1986_a4_sum_indices A p (enum 'I_n).

Definition putnam_1986_a4_permutation {n : nat}
    (p : {ffun 'I_n -> 'I_n}) : bool :=
  [forall i : 'I_n,
    [forall j : 'I_n, (p i == p j) ==> (i == j)]].

Definition putnam_1986_a4_admissible {n : nat}
    (A : {ffun ('I_n * 'I_n) -> 'I_3}) : bool :=
  [forall p : {ffun 'I_n -> 'I_n},
    [forall q : {ffun 'I_n -> 'I_n},
      (putnam_1986_a4_permutation p &&
       putnam_1986_a4_permutation q) ==>
      Z.eqb (putnam_1986_a4_transversal_sum A p)
            (putnam_1986_a4_transversal_sum A q)]].

Definition putnam_1986_a4_solution (n : nat) : Q :=
  (4 ^ Z.of_nat n + 2 * (3 ^ Z.of_nat n) -
   4 * (2 ^ Z.of_nat n) + 1)%Q.

Theorem putnam_1986_a4 (n : nat) (hn : (0 < n)%nat) :
  (inject_Z
     (Z.of_nat
       #|[pred A : {ffun ('I_n * 'I_n) -> 'I_3} |
           putnam_1986_a4_admissible A]|) ==
   putnam_1986_a4_solution n)%Q.
Admitted.

content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1986_a4:
  the count of n by n matrices with entries in {-1,0,1} whose transversal
  sums are all equal, together with its closed formula. This file contains no
  proof.
*)

let statement =
  `let admissible_matrix =
     \n:num. \A:num->num->int.
       (!i j:num.
          i < n /\ j < n
          ==> A i j = --(&1:int) \/ A i j = &0 \/ A i j = &1) /\
       (!i j:num.
          ~(i < n /\ j < n)
          ==> A i j = &0) /\
       (?S:int.
          !p:num->num.
            BIJ p (0..n-1) (0..n-1)
            ==> isum (0..n-1) (\i. A i (p i)) = S) in
   let f =
     \n:num.
       CARD {A:num->num->int | admissible_matrix n A} in
   !n:num.
     0 < n
     ==> (&(f n):int) =
         (&4:int) pow n +
         &2 * ((&3:int) pow n) -
         &4 * ((&2:int) pow n) +
         &1`;;

title: putnam_1986_a4
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1986_a4:
;; the number of n by n matrices over {-1,0,1} whose transversal sums are all
;; equal has the stated four-term exponential formula. This file contains no
;; proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

;; A code in [0,3^(n^2)) has exactly n^2 base-three digits. Mapping the digit
;; 0, 1, or 2 at position row*n+column to -1, 0, or 1 gives a bijection with
;; all n by n matrices in the source set.
(defun putnam-1986-a4-matrix-entry
    (matrix-code n row column)
  (- (mod
      (floor matrix-code
             (expt 3 (+ (* row n) column)))
      3)
     1))

(defun putnam-1986-a4-range-from (start count)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix count)))
  (if (zp count)
      nil
    (cons start
          (putnam-1986-a4-range-from
           (+ start 1) (- count 1)))))

(defun putnam-1986-a4-prefix-each (value lists)
  (if (endp lists)
      nil
    (cons (cons value (car lists))
          (putnam-1986-a4-prefix-each
           value (cdr lists)))))

(defun putnam-1986-a4-insert-everywhere (value values)
  (if (endp values)
      (list (list value))
    (cons (cons value values)
          (putnam-1986-a4-prefix-each
           (car values)
           (putnam-1986-a4-insert-everywhere
            value (cdr values))))))

(defun putnam-1986-a4-insert-into-each
    (value permutations)
  (if (endp permutations)
      nil
    (append
     (putnam-1986-a4-insert-everywhere
      value (car permutations))
     (putnam-1986-a4-insert-into-each
      value (cdr permutations)))))

;; For the duplicate-free index list 0,...,n-1, these are exactly the
;; permutations of the columns, hence exactly the source transversals.
(defun putnam-1986-a4-permutations (values)
  (if (endp values)
      (list nil)
    (putnam-1986-a4-insert-into-each
     (car values)
     (putnam-1986-a4-permutations
      (cdr values)))))

(defun putnam-1986-a4-transversal-sum
    (matrix-code n permutation row)
  (if (endp permutation)
      0
    (+ (putnam-1986-a4-matrix-entry
        matrix-code n row (car permutation))
       (putnam-1986-a4-transversal-sum
        matrix-code n (cdr permutation) (+ row 1)))))

(defun putnam-1986-a4-all-transversal-sums-equal-p
    (matrix-code n reference-sum permutations)
  (if (endp permutations)
      t
    (and
     (equal
      (putnam-1986-a4-transversal-sum
       matrix-code n (car permutations) 0)
      reference-sum)
     (putnam-1986-a4-all-transversal-sums-equal-p
      matrix-code n reference-sum (cdr permutations)))))

;; The permutation list is nonempty. Therefore the source existential common
;; sum S is equivalent to requiring every transversal sum to equal the sum for
;; its first permutation; the witness remains internal to this predicate.
(defun putnam-1986-a4-good-matrix-code-p (matrix-code n)
  (let* ((indices
          (putnam-1986-a4-range-from 0 n))
         (permutations
          (putnam-1986-a4-permutations indices))
         (reference-sum
          (putnam-1986-a4-transversal-sum
           matrix-code n (car permutations) 0)))
    (putnam-1986-a4-all-transversal-sums-equal-p
     matrix-code n reference-sum permutations)))

(defun putnam-1986-a4-count-good-matrix-codes
    (code-count n)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix code-count)))
  (if (zp code-count)
      0
    (let ((matrix-code (- code-count 1)))
      (+ (if (putnam-1986-a4-good-matrix-code-p
              matrix-code n)
             1
           0)
         (putnam-1986-a4-count-good-matrix-codes
          matrix-code n)))))

(defun putnam-1986-a4-matrix-count (n)
  (if (natp n)
      (putnam-1986-a4-count-good-matrix-codes
       (expt 3 (* n n))
       n)
    0))

;; The free argument N universally ranges over the positive dimensions from
;; the source theorem. The displayed expression instantiates the catalogued
;; solution (a1,b1,a2,b2,a3,b3,a4) = (1,4,2,3,-4,2,1).
(defun putnambench-putnam-1986-a4-statement (n)
  (implies
   (and (natp n)
        (< 0 n))
   (equal
    (putnam-1986-a4-matrix-count n)
    (+ (expt 4 n)
       (* 2 (expt 3 n))
       (* -4 (expt 2 n))
       1))))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

title: putnam_1986_a4
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1986_a4:
-- counting {-1, 0, 1}-valued square integer matrices whose transversal sums
-- are independent of the transversal. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module Putnam1986A4 where

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Int using (Int; pos; negsuc)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; _*_)

infix 4 _!=_
infixl 6 _+Z_
infixl 7 _*Z_
infixr 3 _and_

data Bottom : Set where

Not : Set -> Set
Not A =
  A -> Bottom

_!=_ : {A : Set} -> A -> A -> Set
x != y =
  Not (x == y)

record _and_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

data Positive : Nat -> Set where
  positive : {n : Nat} -> Positive (suc n)

data Fin : Nat -> Set where
  fzero : {n : Nat} -> Fin (suc n)
  fsuc  : {n : Nat} -> Fin n -> Fin (suc n)

negative : Nat -> Int
negative zero =
  pos zero
negative (suc n) =
  negsuc n

difference : Nat -> Nat -> Int
difference zero zero =
  pos zero
difference (suc m) zero =
  pos (suc m)
difference zero (suc n) =
  negsuc n
difference (suc m) (suc n) =
  difference m n

_+Z_ : Int -> Int -> Int
pos m +Z pos n =
  pos (m + n)
pos m +Z negsuc n =
  difference m (suc n)
negsuc m +Z pos n =
  difference n (suc m)
negsuc m +Z negsuc n =
  negsuc (suc (m + n))

_*Z_ : Int -> Int -> Int
pos m *Z pos n =
  pos (m * n)
pos m *Z negsuc n =
  negative (m * suc n)
negsuc m *Z pos n =
  negative (suc m * n)
negsuc m *Z negsuc n =
  pos (suc m * suc n)

oneZ : Int
oneZ =
  pos 1

twoZ : Int
twoZ =
  pos 2

threeZ : Int
threeZ =
  pos 3

fourZ : Int
fourZ =
  pos 4

minusFourZ : Int
minusFourZ =
  negsuc 3

powerInt : Int -> Nat -> Int
powerInt base zero =
  oneZ
powerInt base (suc exponent) =
  powerInt base exponent *Z base

data AllowedEntry : Int -> Set where
  minus-one-entry : AllowedEntry (negsuc zero)
  zero-entry      : AllowedEntry (pos zero)
  one-entry       : AllowedEntry (pos (suc zero))

Matrix : Nat -> Set
Matrix n =
  Fin n -> Fin n -> Int

MatrixEqual :
  {n : Nat} ->
  Matrix n ->
  Matrix n ->
  Set
MatrixEqual {n} A B =
  (i j : Fin n) ->
  A i j == B i j

Injective :
  {A B : Set} ->
  (A -> B) ->
  Set
Injective {A} f =
  (x y : A) ->
  f x == f y ->
  x == y

Surjective :
  {A B : Set} ->
  (A -> B) ->
  Set
Surjective {A} {B} f =
  (y : B) ->
  Exists A (\ x -> f x == y)

IsPermutation :
  {n : Nat} ->
  (Fin n -> Fin n) ->
  Set
IsPermutation permutation =
  Injective permutation
  and
  Surjective permutation

sumFinInt :
  {n : Nat} ->
  (Fin n -> Int) ->
  Int
sumFinInt {zero} term =
  pos zero
sumFinInt {suc n} term =
  term fzero +Z
  sumFinInt (\ i -> term (fsuc i))

HasConstantTransversalSum :
  {n : Nat} ->
  Matrix n ->
  Set
HasConstantTransversalSum {n} A =
  Exists Int
    (\ sum ->
      (permutation : Fin n -> Fin n) ->
      IsPermutation permutation ->
      sumFinInt (\ i -> A i (permutation i)) == sum)

AdmissibleMatrix :
  {n : Nat} ->
  Matrix n ->
  Set
AdmissibleMatrix {n} A =
  ((i j : Fin n) -> AllowedEntry (A i j))
  and
  HasConstantTransversalSum A

record MatrixCount (n count : Nat) : Set where
  field
    enumerate :
      Fin count ->
      Matrix n
    enumerated-admissible :
      (index : Fin count) ->
      AdmissibleMatrix (enumerate index)
    enumeration-complete :
      (A : Matrix n) ->
      AdmissibleMatrix A ->
      Exists (Fin count)
        (\ index -> MatrixEqual A (enumerate index))
    enumeration-injective :
      (left-index right-index : Fin count) ->
      MatrixEqual
        (enumerate left-index)
        (enumerate right-index) ->
      left-index == right-index

putnam-1986-a4-formula : Nat -> Int
putnam-1986-a4-formula n =
  powerInt fourZ n +Z
  twoZ *Z powerInt threeZ n +Z
  minusFourZ *Z powerInt twoZ n +Z
  oneZ

FormulaCount : Nat -> Nat -> Set
FormulaCount n count =
  pos count == putnam-1986-a4-formula n

putnam-1986-a4 : Set
putnam-1986-a4 =
  (f : Nat -> Nat) ->
  ((n : Nat) -> MatrixCount n (f n)) ->
  (n : Nat) ->
  Positive n ->
  FormulaCount n (f n)

title: putnam_1986_a4
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench artifact putnam_1986_a4:
  the number of n by n matrices with entries in {-1, 0, 1} whose
  transversal sums are all equal has the specified rational-exponential
  formula for every positive n. This file contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open arithmeticTheory integerTheory pred_setTheory ratTheory;

val putnam_1986_a4 =
  ``!f : num -> num.
      (!n : num.
         f n =
           CARD
             {A : num -> num -> int |
                (!i j : num.
                   i < n /\ j < n
                   ==>
                   (A i j = ~1 \/ A i j = 0 \/ A i j = 1)) /\
                (!i j : num.
                   n <= i \/ n <= j
                   ==>
                   A i j = 0) /\
                (?S : int.
                   !p : num -> num.
                     BIJ p (count n) (count n)
                     ==>
                     ITSET
                       (\i : num. \acc : int. A i (p i) + acc)
                       (count n)
                       0 = S)})
      ==>
      !n : num.
        0 < n
        ==>
        rat_of_num (f n) =
          1q * rat_expn 4q n +
          2q * rat_expn 3q n +
          ~4q * rat_expn 2q n +
          1q``;

title: putnam_1986_a4
content:
$(
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact
  putnam_1986_a4: the number of n-by-n matrices over {-1, 0, 1} whose
  permutation-transversal sums are all equal has the stated exponential
  closed form for every positive integer n. This file contains no proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  The carrier ( 1 ... n ) represents Fin n. A matrix is represented as a
  total function from the Cartesian square of this carrier to
  { -u 1 , 0 , 1 }, and a transversal is selected by a bijection p of the
  carrier. The internally existential integer S is shared by every such
  permutation, exactly expressing equality of all transversal sums.

  The right side is the source coefficient tuple (1, 4, 2, 3, -4, 2, 1)
  expanded as 4^n + 2*3^n - 4*2^n + 1. The final declaration is the single
  unproved $a corpus statement; this database contains no $p proof statement.
$)

${
  $d A S i n p $.

  putnambench-putnam-1986-a4 $a |- A. n e. NN
    (
      (
        #
        `
        {
          A e.
            (
              { -u 1 , 0 , 1 }
              ^m
              ( ( 1 ... n ) X. ( 1 ... n ) )
            )
          |
          E. S e. ZZ
            A. p
              (
                p : ( 1 ... n ) -1-1-onto-> ( 1 ... n )
                ->
                (
                  sum_ i e. ( 1 ... n )
                    ( A ` <. i , ( p ` i ) >. )
                )
                =
                S
              )
        }
      )
      =
      (
        (
          (
            ( 4 ^ n )
            +
            ( 2 x. ( 3 ^ n ) )
          )
          -
          ( 4 x. ( 2 ^ n ) )
        )
        +
        1
      )
    )
  $.
$}

title: putnam_1986_a4
content:
:: Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench artifact putnam_1986_a4:
:: the number of n by n matrices with entries in {-1,0,1} whose sums along
:: all permutation transversals are equal has a specified exponential closed
:: form. This file contains no proof.

environ
  vocabularies TARSKI, XBOOLE_0, ZFMISC_1, SUBSET_1, RELAT_1, FUNCT_1,
    FUNCT_2, PARTFUN1, FINSEQ_1, FINSEQ_2, MATRIX_0, MATRIX_1, NUMBERS,
    NAT_1, INT_1, CARD_1, XCMPLX_0, XREAL_0, XXREAL_0, ORDINAL1,
    FINSET_1, NEWTON, ARYTM_1, ARYTM_3, CARD_3, VALUED_0, VALUED_1,
    RVSUM_1;
  notations TARSKI, XBOOLE_0, ZFMISC_1, SUBSET_1, ORDINAL1, CARD_1,
    NUMBERS, XCMPLX_0, XREAL_0, XXREAL_0, INT_1, NAT_1, NAT_D, RELAT_1,
    FUNCT_1, RELSET_1, PARTFUN1, FUNCT_2, FINSEQ_1, FINSEQ_2, MATRIX_0,
    MATRIX_1, FINSET_1, NEWTON, RVSUM_1;
  constructors RELSET_1, PARTFUN1, FINSEQ_4, MATRIX_1, NAT_1, NAT_D,
    NEWTON, RVSUM_1, FINSEQOP, FINSET_1;
  registrations XBOOLE_0, SUBSET_1, RELAT_1, FUNCT_1, RELSET_1, FUNCT_2,
    PARTFUN1, FINSEQ_1, FINSEQ_2, MATRIX_0, MATRIX_1, FINSET_1, ORDINAL1,
    CARD_1, NUMBERS, XCMPLX_0, XREAL_0, XXREAL_0, NAT_1, INT_1, NEWTON,
    VALUED_0, VALUED_1, RVSUM_1, MEMBERED, FRAENKEL;
  requirements BOOLE, SUBSET, NUMERALS, ARITHM, REAL;
  definitions TARSKI;
  equalities FINSEQ_1, MATRIX_0;
  expansions TARSKI, FINSEQ_1;

begin

::$P-
theorem
  for f being Function of NAT,NAT st
    (for n being Nat holds
      f.n = card {M where M is Matrix of n,INT :
        (for i,j being Nat st [i,j] in Indices M holds
          M*(i,j) = -1 or M*(i,j) = 0 or M*(i,j) = 1) &
        (ex S being Integer st
          for p being FinSequence of NAT st
            p is Permutation of Seg n
          holds
            ex terms being FinSequence of INT st
              len terms = n &
              (for i being Nat st i in Seg n holds
                terms.i = M*(i,p.i)) &
              Sum terms = S)})
  holds
    for n being Nat st 0 < n holds
      (f.n qua Integer) =
        (4 qua Integer) |^ n +
        2 * ((3 qua Integer) |^ n) -
        4 * ((2 qua Integer) |^ n) + 1
proof
end;
::$P+

title: putnam_1986_a4
content:
% Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1986_a4:
% the number of n-by-n matrices with entries in {-1, 0, 1} whose transversal
% sums are all equal is 4^n + 2*3^n - 4*2^n + 1. This file contains no proof.

putnam_1986_a4: THEORY
BEGIN
  solution: TYPE =
    [# a1: rat, b1: rat, a2: rat, b2: rat,
       a3: rat, b3: rat, a4: rat #]

  putnam_1986_a4_solution: solution =
    (# a1 := 1, b1 := 4, a2 := 2, b2 := 3,
       a3 := -4, b3 := 2, a4 := 1 #)

  matrix_code_count(n: nat): nat =
    3 ^ (n * n)

  matrix_digit(code, n, i, j: nat): nat =
    mod(ndiv(code, 3 ^ (i * n + j)), 3)

  matrix_entry(code, n, i, j: nat): int =
    IF matrix_digit(code, n, i, j) = 0 THEN
      -1
    ELSIF matrix_digit(code, n, i, j) = 1 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      1
    ENDIF

  quotient_aux(
      numerator, denominator, fuel: nat): RECURSIVE nat =
    IF fuel = 0
        OR denominator = 0
        OR numerator < denominator THEN
      0
    ELSE
      1
        + quotient_aux(
            numerator - denominator,
            denominator,
            fuel - 1)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE fuel

  remainder_aux(
      numerator, denominator, fuel: nat): RECURSIVE nat =
    IF fuel = 0
        OR denominator = 0
        OR numerator < denominator THEN
      numerator
    ELSE
      remainder_aux(
        numerator - denominator,
        denominator,
        fuel - 1)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE fuel

  safe_ndiv(numerator, denominator: nat): nat =
    quotient_aux(
      numerator,
      denominator,
      numerator + 1)

  safe_mod(numerator, denominator: nat): nat =
    IF denominator = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      remainder_aux(
        numerator,
        denominator,
        numerator + 1)
    ENDIF

  permutation_code_count(n: nat): nat =
    IF n = 0 THEN 1 ELSE n ^ n ENDIF

  permutation_entry(code, row, n: nat): nat =
    IF n = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      safe_mod(safe_ndiv(code, n ^ row), n)
    ENDIF

  permutation_code(code, n: nat): bool =
    code < permutation_code_count(n)
      AND (FORALL (row_1, row_2: nat):
        (row_1 < n
          AND row_2 < n
          AND permutation_entry(code, row_1, n)
            = permutation_entry(code, row_2, n))
        IMPLIES row_1 = row_2)

  transversal_sum(
      matrix_code, permutation, n, count: nat): RECURSIVE int =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      transversal_sum(matrix_code, permutation, n, count - 1)
        + matrix_entry(
            matrix_code,
            n,
            count - 1,
            permutation_entry(permutation, count - 1, n))
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  has_constant_transversal_sum(matrix_code, n: nat): bool =
    EXISTS (S: int):
      FORALL (permutation: nat):
        permutation_code(permutation, n)
          IMPLIES transversal_sum(matrix_code, permutation, n, n) = S

  qualifying_matrix_count(
      n, limit: nat): RECURSIVE nat =
    IF limit = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      qualifying_matrix_count(n, limit - 1)
        + IF has_constant_transversal_sum(limit - 1, n) THEN
            1
          ELSE
            0
          ENDIF
    ENDIF
  MEASURE limit

  f(n: nat): nat =
    qualifying_matrix_count(n, matrix_code_count(n))

  putnam_1986_a4: bool =
    FORALL (n: nat):
      n > 0 IMPLIES
        (f(n) :: rat)
          = LET s: solution = putnam_1986_a4_solution IN
              a1(s) * b1(s) ^ n
                + a2(s) * b2(s) ^ n
                + a3(s) * b3(s) ^ n
                + a4(s)
END putnam_1986_a4

title: putnam_1986_a5
content:
import Mathlib

/--
Suppose $f_1(x),f_2(x),\dots,f_n(x)$ are functions of $n$ real variables $x=(x_1,\dots,x_n)$ with continuous second-order partial derivatives everywhere on $\mathbb{R}^n$. Suppose further that there are constants $c_{ij}$ such that $\frac{\partial f_i}{\partial x_j}-\frac{\partial f_j}{\partial x_i}=c_{ij}$ for all $i$ and $j$, $1 \leq i \leq n$, $1 \leq j \leq n$. Prove that there is a function $g(x)$ on $\mathbb{R}^n$ such that $f_i+\partial g/\partial x_i$ is linear for all $i$, $1 \leq i \leq n$. (A linear function is one of the form $a_0+a_1x_1+a_2x_2+\dots+a_nx_n$.)
-/
theorem putnam_1986_a5
  (n : ℕ) (hn : 1 ≤ n)
  (f : Fin n → ((Fin n → ℝ) → ℝ))
  (hf : ∀ i, ContDiff ℝ 2 (f i))
  (C : Fin n → Fin n → ℝ)
  (hf' : ∀ i j : Fin n, ∀ x : Fin n → ℝ, fderiv ℝ (f i) x (Pi.single j 1) - fderiv ℝ (f j) x (Pi.single i 1) = C i j)
  : ∃ g : (Fin n → ℝ) → ℝ, ∀ i : Fin n, IsLinearMap ℝ (λ x ↦ f i x + fderiv ℝ g x (Pi.single i 1)) :=
  sorry

title: putnam_1986_a5
content:
(* Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench artifact putnam_1986_a5:
   functions on a positive-dimensional real coordinate space whose
   cross-partial differences are constant admit a scalar adjustment making
   every component linear; this file contains no proof. *)

From Stdlib Require Import
  Vectors.Fin
  Reals
  ClassicalDescription
  ClassicalEpsilon.

Open Scope R_scope.

Definition putnam_1986_a5_vector (n : nat) : Type :=
  Fin.t n -> R.

Fixpoint putnam_1986_a5_fin_sum
    (n : nat) : (Fin.t n -> R) -> R :=
  match n as k return (Fin.t k -> R) -> R with
  | O => fun _ => 0
  | S k =>
      fun u =>
        u Fin.F1 +
        putnam_1986_a5_fin_sum k (fun i => u (Fin.FS i))
  end.

Definition putnam_1986_a5_distance {n : nat}
    (x y : putnam_1986_a5_vector n) : R :=
  sqrt
    (putnam_1986_a5_fin_sum n
      (fun i : Fin.t n => (x i - y i) ^ 2)).

Definition putnam_1986_a5_replace {n : nat}
    (x : putnam_1986_a5_vector n)
    (i : Fin.t n) (xi : R) : putnam_1986_a5_vector n :=
  fun j : Fin.t n =>
    if Fin.eq_dec j i then xi else x j.

Definition putnam_1986_a5_real_derivative
    (u : R -> R) (x : R) : R :=
  match excluded_middle_informative
          (exists d : R, derivable_pt_lim u x d) with
  | left _ =>
      epsilon (inhabits 0)
        (fun d : R => derivable_pt_lim u x d)
  | right _ => 0
  end.

Definition putnam_1986_a5_partial_derivative {n : nat}
    (u : putnam_1986_a5_vector n -> R)
  (i : Fin.t n) : putnam_1986_a5_vector n -> R :=
  fun x =>
    putnam_1986_a5_real_derivative
      (fun xi : R => u (putnam_1986_a5_replace x i xi))
      (x i).

Definition putnam_1986_a5_continuous {n : nat}
    (u : putnam_1986_a5_vector n -> R) : Prop :=
  forall x : putnam_1986_a5_vector n,
    forall eps : R,
      eps > 0 ->
      exists delta : R,
        delta > 0 /\
        forall y : putnam_1986_a5_vector n,
          putnam_1986_a5_distance y x < delta ->
          Rabs (u y - u x) < eps.

Definition putnam_1986_a5_twice_continuously_differentiable {n : nat}
  (u : putnam_1986_a5_vector n -> R) : Prop :=
  (forall (i : Fin.t n) (x : putnam_1986_a5_vector n),
      derivable_pt_lim
        (fun xi : R => u (putnam_1986_a5_replace x i xi))
        (x i)
        (putnam_1986_a5_partial_derivative u i x)) /\
  (forall (i j : Fin.t n) (x : putnam_1986_a5_vector n),
      derivable_pt_lim
        (fun xj : R =>
          putnam_1986_a5_partial_derivative u i
            (putnam_1986_a5_replace x j xj))
        (x j)
        (putnam_1986_a5_partial_derivative
          (putnam_1986_a5_partial_derivative u i) j x)) /\
  (forall i j : Fin.t n,
      putnam_1986_a5_continuous
        (putnam_1986_a5_partial_derivative
          (putnam_1986_a5_partial_derivative u i) j)).

Definition putnam_1986_a5_linear {n : nat}
    (u : putnam_1986_a5_vector n -> R) : Prop :=
  (forall x y : putnam_1986_a5_vector n,
      u (fun i : Fin.t n => x i + y i) = u x + u y) /\
  (forall (a : R) (x : putnam_1986_a5_vector n),
      u (fun i : Fin.t n => a * x i) = a * u x).

Theorem putnam_1986_a5
    (n : nat)
    (hn : (1 <= n)%nat)
    (f : Fin.t n -> putnam_1986_a5_vector n -> R)
    (hf :
      forall i : Fin.t n,
        putnam_1986_a5_twice_continuously_differentiable (f i))
    (C : Fin.t n -> Fin.t n -> R)
    (hf' :
      forall (i j : Fin.t n) (x : putnam_1986_a5_vector n),
        putnam_1986_a5_partial_derivative (f i) j x -
        putnam_1986_a5_partial_derivative (f j) i x =
        C i j) :
  exists g : putnam_1986_a5_vector n -> R,
    forall i : Fin.t n,
      putnam_1986_a5_linear
        (fun x : putnam_1986_a5_vector n =>
          f i x + putnam_1986_a5_partial_derivative g i x).
Admitted.

title: putnam_1986_a5
content:
theory putnam_1986_a5 imports Complex_Main
"HOL-Analysis.Finite_Cartesian_Product"
"HOL-Analysis.Derivative"
begin

theorem putnam_1986_a5:
  fixes n :: "nat"
    and f :: "(real^'n \<Rightarrow> real)^'n"
    and xrepl :: "(real^'n) \<Rightarrow> 'n \<Rightarrow> real \<Rightarrow> real^'n"
    and partderiv :: "(real^'n \<Rightarrow> real) \<Rightarrow> 'n \<Rightarrow> (real^'n \<Rightarrow> real)"
  defines "xrepl \<equiv> \<lambda> (x :: real^'n) (i :: 'n) (xi :: real). \<chi> j :: 'n. if j = i then xi else x$j"
    and "partderiv \<equiv> \<lambda> (func :: real^'n \<Rightarrow> real) (i :: 'n). \<lambda> x :: real^'n. deriv (\<lambda> xi :: real. func (xrepl x i xi)) (x$i)"
  assumes hcard : "CARD('n) = n"
    and npos : "n \<ge> 1"
    and hfpartial1 : "\<forall> i j :: 'n. \<forall> x :: real^'n.
      (\<lambda> xj :: real. (f$i) (xrepl x j xj)) differentiable at (x$j)"
    and hfpartial2 : "\<forall> i j1 j2 :: 'n. \<forall> x :: real^'n.
      (\<lambda> xj :: real. partderiv (f$i) j1 (xrepl x j2 xj))
        differentiable at (x$j2)"
    and hfpartial2cont : "\<forall> i j1 j2 :: 'n.
      continuous_on UNIV (partderiv (partderiv (f$i) j1) j2)"
    and hfc : "\<exists> c :: real^'n^'n. \<forall> i j :: 'n. partderiv (f$i) j - partderiv (f$j) i = (\<lambda> x :: real^'n. c$i$j)"
  shows "\<exists> g :: real^'n \<Rightarrow> real. \<forall> i :: 'n. linear (\<lambda> x :: real^'n. (f$i) x + partderiv g i x)"
  sorry

end

title: putnam_1986_a5
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench artifact putnam_1986_a5:
  a vector field with continuous second-order partial derivatives and
  constant cross-partial differences has a scalar correction making every
  component linear. This file contains no proof.
*)

let statement =
  `let xrepl =
     \(x:real^N) (i:num) (t:real).
       (lambda k. if k = i then t else x$k):real^N in
   let has_derivative_at =
     \(h:real->real) (d:real) (a:real).
       !e:real.
         &0 < e
         ==> ?delta:real.
               &0 < delta /\
               !y:real.
                 &0 < abs (y - a) /\ abs (y - a) < delta
                 ==> abs ((h y - h a) / (y - a) - d) < e in
   let partial =
     \(h:real^N->real) (i:num) (x:real^N).
       @d:real.
         has_derivative_at
           (\t:real. h (xrepl x i t)) d (x$i) in
   let continuous =
     \(h:real^N->real).
       !x:real^N. !e:real.
         &0 < e
         ==> ?delta:real.
               &0 < delta /\
               !y:real^N.
                 (!k:num.
                    1 <= k /\ k <= dimindex(:N)
                    ==> abs (y$k - x$k) < delta)
                 ==> abs (h y - h x) < e in
   let contdiff2 =
     \(h:real^N->real).
       (!i:num. 1 <= i /\ i <= dimindex(:N)
                ==> !x:real^N.
                      has_derivative_at
                        (\t:real. h (xrepl x i t))
                        (partial h i x) (x$i)) /\
       (!i:num. 1 <= i /\ i <= dimindex(:N)
                ==> continuous (partial h i)) /\
       (!i j:num.
          1 <= i /\ i <= dimindex(:N) /\
          1 <= j /\ j <= dimindex(:N)
          ==> !x:real^N.
                has_derivative_at
                  (\t:real. partial h i (xrepl x j t))
                  (partial (partial h i) j x) (x$j)) /\
       (!i j:num.
          1 <= i /\ i <= dimindex(:N) /\
          1 <= j /\ j <= dimindex(:N)
          ==> continuous (partial (partial h i) j)) in
   let linear_real =
     \(h:real^N->real).
       ?a:real^N.
         !x:real^N.
           h x =
           sum (1..dimindex(:N)) (\k:num. a$k * x$k) in
   !n:num. !f:real^N->real^N.
     dimindex(:N) = n /\
     1 <= n /\
     (!i:num.
        1 <= i /\ i <= n
        ==> contdiff2 (\x:real^N. (f x)$i)) /\
     (?c:real^N^N.
        !i j:num.
          1 <= i /\ i <= n /\ 1 <= j /\ j <= n
          ==> !x:real^N.
                partial (\y:real^N. (f y)$i) j x -
                partial (\y:real^N. (f y)$j) i x =
                c$i$j)
     ==> ?g:real^N->real.
           !i:num.
             1 <= i /\ i <= n
             ==> linear_real
                   (\x:real^N.
                      (f x)$i + partial g i x)`;;

title: putnam_1986_a5
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1986_a5:
;; a C2 vector field on R^n whose antisymmetric first-partial differences are
;; constant admits a scalar function whose gradient makes every component
;; linear. This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))

;; Reals are rational regular Cauchy names, vectors are length-n lists of such
;; names, and arbitrary extensional functions are tame APPLY$ objects.
;; FN-EQUAL supplies unbounded universal quantification; inequality with a
;; constant-false function supplies internal existential quantification.
;;
;; The internally quantified first- and second-partial fields express the C2
;; hypothesis by coordinate difference quotients and joint continuity on all
;; of R^n. The conclusion internally quantifies both g and the field of its
;; totalized coordinate derivatives, matching Mathlib's totalized FDERIV.

(defun putnam-1986-a5-quoted (object)
  (list 'quote object))

(defun putnam-1986-a5-term-list (terms)
  (if (consp terms)
      (list 'cons
            (car terms)
            (putnam-1986-a5-term-list (cdr terms)))
    nil))

(defun putnam-1986-a5-apply-term (function arguments)
  (list 'apply$
        (putnam-1986-a5-quoted function)
        (putnam-1986-a5-term-list arguments)))

(defun putnam-1986-a5-apply-object-term
    (function-term arguments)
  (list 'apply$
        function-term
        (putnam-1986-a5-term-list arguments)))

(defun putnam-1986-a5-and-terms (terms)
  (if (consp terms)
      (list 'if
            (car terms)
            (putnam-1986-a5-and-terms (cdr terms))
            (putnam-1986-a5-quoted nil))
    (putnam-1986-a5-quoted t)))

(defun putnam-1986-a5-implies-term (hypothesis conclusion)
  (list 'if
        hypothesis
        conclusion
        (putnam-1986-a5-quoted t)))

(defun putnam-1986-a5-not-term (term)
  (list 'if
        term
        (putnam-1986-a5-quoted nil)
        (putnam-1986-a5-quoted t)))

(defun putnam-1986-a5-add-term (left right)
  (list 'binary-+ left right))

(defun putnam-1986-a5-negate-term (value)
  (list 'unary-- value))

(defun putnam-1986-a5-subtract-term (left right)
  (putnam-1986-a5-add-term
   left
   (putnam-1986-a5-negate-term right)))

(defun putnam-1986-a5-multiply-term (left right)
  (list 'binary-* left right))

(defun putnam-1986-a5-divide-term (numerator denominator)
  (putnam-1986-a5-multiply-term
   numerator
   (list 'unary-/ denominator)))

(defun putnam-1986-a5-absolute-term (value)
  (list 'if
        (list '< value (putnam-1986-a5-quoted 0))
        (putnam-1986-a5-negate-term value)
        value))

(defun putnam-1986-a5-less-equal-term (left right)
  (list 'if
        (list '< right left)
        (putnam-1986-a5-quoted nil)
        (putnam-1986-a5-quoted t)))

(defun putnam-1986-a5-minimum-term (left right)
  (list 'if
        (list '< left right)
        left
        right))

(defun putnam-1986-a5-positive-rational-term (value)
  (putnam-1986-a5-and-terms
   (list
    (list 'rationalp value)
    (list '< (putnam-1986-a5-quoted 0) value))))

(defun putnam-1986-a5-true-function (formals)
  (list 'lambda
        formals
        (putnam-1986-a5-quoted t)))

(defun putnam-1986-a5-real-value-term (name precision)
  (putnam-1986-a5-apply-term name (list precision)))

(defun putnam-1986-a5-object-real-value-term
    (name-term precision)
  (putnam-1986-a5-apply-object-term
   name-term
   (list precision)))

(defun putnam-1986-a5-real-cauchy-function (name)
  (let* ((left
          (putnam-1986-a5-real-value-term name 'epsilon))
         (right
          (putnam-1986-a5-real-value-term name 'eta))
         (distance
          (putnam-1986-a5-absolute-term
           (putnam-1986-a5-subtract-term left right))))
    (list
     'lambda
     '(epsilon eta)
     (putnam-1986-a5-implies-term
      (putnam-1986-a5-and-terms
       (list
        (putnam-1986-a5-positive-rational-term 'epsilon)
        (putnam-1986-a5-positive-rational-term 'eta)))
      (putnam-1986-a5-and-terms
       (list
        (list 'rationalp left)
        (list 'rationalp right)
        (putnam-1986-a5-less-equal-term
         distance
         (putnam-1986-a5-add-term
          'epsilon 'eta))))))))

(defun putnam-1986-a5-real-name-p (name)
  (and
   (tamep-functionp name)
   (fn-equal
    (putnam-1986-a5-real-cauchy-function name)
    (putnam-1986-a5-true-function
     '(epsilon eta)))))

;; Sampling both names at eta/4 makes the universal inequality equivalent to
;; the represented real distance being at most BOUND.
(defun putnam-1986-a5-real-distance-function
    (left-name right-name bound)
  (let* ((precision
          (putnam-1986-a5-multiply-term
           (putnam-1986-a5-quoted 1/4)
           'eta))
         (left
          (putnam-1986-a5-real-value-term
           left-name precision))
         (right
          (putnam-1986-a5-real-value-term
           right-name precision))
         (distance
          (putnam-1986-a5-absolute-term
           (putnam-1986-a5-subtract-term left right))))
    (list
     'lambda
     '(eta)
     (putnam-1986-a5-implies-term
      (putnam-1986-a5-positive-rational-term 'eta)
      (putnam-1986-a5-and-terms
       (list
        (list 'rationalp left)
        (list 'rationalp right)
        (putnam-1986-a5-less-equal-term
         distance
         (putnam-1986-a5-add-term
          (putnam-1986-a5-quoted bound)
          'eta))))))))

(defun putnam-1986-a5-real-distance-at-most-p
    (left-name right-name bound)
  (and
   (rationalp bound)
   (putnam-1986-a5-real-name-p left-name)
   (putnam-1986-a5-real-name-p right-name)
   (fn-equal
    (putnam-1986-a5-real-distance-function
     left-name right-name bound)
    (putnam-1986-a5-true-function '(eta)))))

(defun putnam-1986-a5-real-equal-p
    (left-name right-name)
  (putnam-1986-a5-real-distance-at-most-p
   left-name right-name 0))

(defun putnam-1986-a5-unary-output-function
    (function)
  (let ((output
         (putnam-1986-a5-apply-term function (list 'x))))
    (list
     'lambda
     '(x)
     (putnam-1986-a5-implies-term
      (list 'putnam-1986-a5-real-name-p 'x)
      (list 'putnam-1986-a5-real-name-p output)))))

(defun putnam-1986-a5-unary-extensional-function
    (function)
  (let ((left-output
         (putnam-1986-a5-apply-term
          function (list 'x-left)))
        (right-output
         (putnam-1986-a5-apply-term
          function (list 'x-right))))
    (list
     'lambda
     '(x-left x-right)
     (putnam-1986-a5-implies-term
      (list 'putnam-1986-a5-real-equal-p
            'x-left 'x-right)
      (list 'putnam-1986-a5-real-equal-p
            left-output right-output)))))

(defun putnam-1986-a5-real-function-p (function)
  (and
   (tamep-functionp function)
   (fn-equal
    (putnam-1986-a5-unary-output-function function)
    (putnam-1986-a5-true-function '(x)))
   (fn-equal
    (putnam-1986-a5-unary-extensional-function function)
    (putnam-1986-a5-true-function
     '(x-left x-right)))))

(defun putnam-1986-a5-rational-shift-name (name shift)
  (let ((value
         (putnam-1986-a5-object-real-value-term
          (putnam-1986-a5-quoted name)
          (putnam-1986-a5-multiply-term
           (putnam-1986-a5-quoted 1/2)
           'precision))))
    (list
     'lambda
     '(precision)
     (putnam-1986-a5-add-term
      value
      (putnam-1986-a5-quoted shift)))))

(defun putnam-1986-a5-constant-name (value)
  (list
   'lambda
   '(precision)
   (putnam-1986-a5-quoted value)))

(defun putnam-1986-a5-real-negate-name (name)
  (let ((value
         (putnam-1986-a5-object-real-value-term
          (putnam-1986-a5-quoted name)
          'precision)))
    (list
     'lambda
     '(precision)
     (putnam-1986-a5-negate-term value))))

(defun putnam-1986-a5-real-scale-name (name scalar)
  (let* ((sample-precision
          (putnam-1986-a5-divide-term
           'precision
           (putnam-1986-a5-add-term
            (putnam-1986-a5-quoted 1)
            (putnam-1986-a5-absolute-term
             (putnam-1986-a5-quoted scalar)))))
         (value
          (putnam-1986-a5-object-real-value-term
           (putnam-1986-a5-quoted name)
           sample-precision)))
    (list
     'lambda
     '(precision)
     (putnam-1986-a5-multiply-term
      (putnam-1986-a5-quoted scalar)
      value))))

(defun putnam-1986-a5-real-product-name (left-name right-name)
  (let* ((left-coarse
          (putnam-1986-a5-object-real-value-term
           (putnam-1986-a5-quoted left-name)
           (putnam-1986-a5-quoted 1)))
         (right-coarse
          (putnam-1986-a5-object-real-value-term
           (putnam-1986-a5-quoted right-name)
           (putnam-1986-a5-quoted 1)))
         (scale
          (putnam-1986-a5-multiply-term
           (putnam-1986-a5-quoted 64)
           (putnam-1986-a5-add-term
            (putnam-1986-a5-quoted 1)
            (putnam-1986-a5-add-term
             (putnam-1986-a5-absolute-term left-coarse)
             (putnam-1986-a5-absolute-term right-coarse)))))
         (sample-precision
          (putnam-1986-a5-minimum-term
           (putnam-1986-a5-quoted 1)
           (putnam-1986-a5-divide-term
            'precision scale)))
         (left-value
          (putnam-1986-a5-object-real-value-term
           (putnam-1986-a5-quoted left-name)
           sample-precision))
         (right-value
          (putnam-1986-a5-object-real-value-term
           (putnam-1986-a5-quoted right-name)
           sample-precision)))
    (list
     'lambda
     '(precision)
     (putnam-1986-a5-multiply-term
      left-value right-value))))

(defun putnam-1986-a5-real-absolute-name (name)
  (let ((value
         (putnam-1986-a5-object-real-value-term
          (putnam-1986-a5-quoted name)
          'precision)))
    (list
     'lambda
     '(precision)
     (putnam-1986-a5-absolute-term value))))

(defun putnam-1986-a5-real-less-equal-function
    (left-name right-name)
  (let* ((sample-precision
          (putnam-1986-a5-multiply-term
           (putnam-1986-a5-quoted 1/4)
           'eta))
         (left
          (putnam-1986-a5-real-value-term
           left-name sample-precision))
         (right
          (putnam-1986-a5-real-value-term
           right-name sample-precision)))
    (list
     'lambda
     '(eta)
     (putnam-1986-a5-implies-term
      (putnam-1986-a5-positive-rational-term 'eta)
      (putnam-1986-a5-less-equal-term
       left
       (putnam-1986-a5-add-term right 'eta))))))

(defun putnam-1986-a5-real-less-equal-p
    (left-name right-name)
  (and
   (putnam-1986-a5-real-name-p left-name)
   (putnam-1986-a5-real-name-p right-name)
   (fn-equal
    (putnam-1986-a5-real-less-equal-function
     left-name right-name)
    (putnam-1986-a5-true-function '(eta)))))

(defun putnam-1986-a5-positive-witness-p
    (epsilon name)
  (and
   (rationalp epsilon)
   (< 0 epsilon)
   (putnam-1986-a5-real-less-equal-p
    (putnam-1986-a5-constant-name epsilon)
    name)))

(defun putnam-1986-a5-positive-witness-failure-function
    (name)
  (list
   'lambda
   '(epsilon)
   (list
    'if
    (list 'putnam-1986-a5-positive-witness-p
          'epsilon
          (putnam-1986-a5-quoted name))
    (putnam-1986-a5-quoted nil)
    (putnam-1986-a5-quoted t))))

(defun putnam-1986-a5-real-positive-p (name)
  (let ((failure
         (putnam-1986-a5-positive-witness-failure-function
          name))
        (always-true
         (putnam-1986-a5-true-function '(epsilon))))
    (and
     (putnam-1986-a5-real-name-p name)
     (tamep-functionp failure)
     (tamep-functionp always-true)
     (not (fn-equal failure always-true)))))

(defun putnam-1986-a5-real-add-name
    (left-name right-name)
  (let* ((sample-precision
          (putnam-1986-a5-multiply-term
           (putnam-1986-a5-quoted 1/4)
           'precision))
         (left
          (putnam-1986-a5-object-real-value-term
           (putnam-1986-a5-quoted left-name)
           sample-precision))
         (right
          (putnam-1986-a5-object-real-value-term
           (putnam-1986-a5-quoted right-name)
           sample-precision)))
    (list
     'lambda
     '(precision)
     (putnam-1986-a5-add-term left right))))

(defun putnam-1986-a5-false-function (formals)
  (list 'lambda formals (putnam-1986-a5-quoted nil)))

(defun putnam-1986-a5-universal-p (function formals)
  (let ((always-true
         (putnam-1986-a5-true-function formals)))
    (and
     (tamep-functionp function)
     (tamep-functionp always-true)
     (fn-equal function always-true))))

(defun putnam-1986-a5-exists-p (function formals)
  (let ((always-false
         (putnam-1986-a5-false-function formals)))
    (and
     (tamep-functionp function)
     (tamep-functionp always-false)
     (not (fn-equal function always-false)))))

(defun putnam-1986-a5-real-subtract-name
    (left-name right-name)
  (putnam-1986-a5-real-add-name
   left-name
   (putnam-1986-a5-real-negate-name right-name)))

;; Exact finite-dimensional real vectors.

(defun putnam-1986-a5-real-list-p (values)
  (if (consp values)
      (and
       (putnam-1986-a5-real-name-p (car values))
       (putnam-1986-a5-real-list-p (cdr values)))
    (equal values nil)))

(defun putnam-1986-a5-vector-p (vector n)
  (and
   (natp n)
   (true-listp vector)
   (equal (len vector) n)
   (putnam-1986-a5-real-list-p vector)))

(defun putnam-1986-a5-vector-equal-p (left right)
  (if (consp left)
      (and
       (consp right)
       (putnam-1986-a5-real-equal-p
        (car left) (car right))
       (putnam-1986-a5-vector-equal-p
        (cdr left) (cdr right)))
    (equal right nil)))

(defun putnam-1986-a5-vector-close-p
    (left right bound)
  (if (consp left)
      (and
       (consp right)
       (putnam-1986-a5-real-distance-at-most-p
        (car left) (car right) bound)
       (putnam-1986-a5-vector-close-p
        (cdr left) (cdr right) bound))
    (equal right nil)))

(defun putnam-1986-a5-vector-add (left right)
  (if (and (consp left) (consp right))
      (cons
       (putnam-1986-a5-real-add-name
        (car left) (car right))
       (putnam-1986-a5-vector-add
        (cdr left) (cdr right)))
    nil))

(defun putnam-1986-a5-vector-smul (scalar vector)
  (if (consp vector)
      (cons
       (putnam-1986-a5-real-product-name
        scalar (car vector))
       (putnam-1986-a5-vector-smul
        scalar (cdr vector)))
    nil))

(defun putnam-1986-a5-vector-rational-shift
    (vector index shift)
  (if (consp vector)
      (if (zp index)
          (cons
           (putnam-1986-a5-rational-shift-name
            (car vector) shift)
           (cdr vector))
        (cons
         (car vector)
         (putnam-1986-a5-vector-rational-shift
          (cdr vector) (- index 1) shift)))
    nil))

(defun putnam-1986-a5-index-p (index n)
  (and (natp index) (< index n)))

         (putnam-1986-a5-apply-term function '(i x))))
    (list
     'lambda '(i x)
     (putnam-1986-a5-implies-term
      (putnam-1986-a5-and-terms
       (list
        (list 'putnam-1986-a5-index-p
              'i (putnam-1986-a5-quoted n))
        (list 'putnam-1986-a5-vector-p
              'x (putnam-1986-a5-quoted n))))
      (list 'putnam-1986-a5-real-name-p output)))))

(defun putnam-1986-a5-component-extensional-function

(defun putnam-1986-a5-component-function-p

    (putnam-1986-a5-component-output-function

    '(i x))

    (putnam-1986-a5-component-extensional-function

    '(i x-left x-right))))

(defun putnam-1986-a5-scalar-output-function
    (n function)

    (list
     'lambda '(x)
     (putnam-1986-a5-implies-term

(defun putnam-1986-a5-scalar-function-p
    (n function)

   (tamep-functionp function)

    (putnam-1986-a5-scalar-output-function

    (putnam-1986-a5-scalar-extensional-function

    '(x-left x-right))))

(defun putnam-1986-a5-first-field-output-function

        (list 'putnam-1986-a5-index-p

        (list 'putnam-1986-a5-vector-p

(defun putnam-1986-a5-first-field-extensional-function

        (list 'putnam-1986-a5-index-p

        (list 'putnam-1986-a5-index-p
              'j (putnam-1986-a5-quoted n))
        (list 'putnam-1986-a5-vector-p
              'x-left (putnam-1986-a5-quoted n))
        (list 'putnam-1986-a5-vector-p
              'x-right (putnam-1986-a5-quoted n))
        (list 'putnam-1986-a5-vector-equal-p

(defun putnam-1986-a5-first-field-p (n field)
  (and

(defun putnam-1986-a5-second-field-output-function

     (putnam-1986-a5-implies-term
      (putnam-1986-a5-and-terms
       (list
        (list 'putnam-1986-a5-index-p
              'i (putnam-1986-a5-quoted n))
        (list 'putnam-1986-a5-index-p
              'j (putnam-1986-a5-quoted n))
        (list 'putnam-1986-a5-index-p
              'k (putnam-1986-a5-quoted n))
        (list 'putnam-1986-a5-vector-p

(defun putnam-1986-a5-second-field-extensional-function
    (n field)
  (let ((left
         (putnam-1986-a5-apply-term
          field '(i j k x-left)))
        (right
         (putnam-1986-a5-apply-term
          field '(i j k x-right))))
    (list
     'lambda '(i j k x-left x-right)
     (putnam-1986-a5-implies-term
      (putnam-1986-a5-and-terms
       (list
        (list 'putnam-1986-a5-index-p
              'i (putnam-1986-a5-quoted n))

              'j (putnam-1986-a5-quoted n))
        (list 'putnam-1986-a5-index-p
              'k (putnam-1986-a5-quoted n))
        (list 'putnam-1986-a5-vector-p
              'x-left (putnam-1986-a5-quoted n))
        (list 'putnam-1986-a5-vector-p
              'x-right (putnam-1986-a5-quoted n))
        (list 'putnam-1986-a5-vector-equal-p
              'x-left 'x-right)))
      (list 'putnam-1986-a5-real-equal-p
            left right)))))

(defun putnam-1986-a5-second-field-p (n field)
  (and
   (tamep-functionp field)
   (putnam-1986-a5-universal-p
    (putnam-1986-a5-second-field-output-function
     n field)
    '(i j k x))
   (putnam-1986-a5-universal-p
    (putnam-1986-a5-second-field-extensional-function

   'lambda '(delta)
   (list 'putnam-1986-a5-frechet-delta-p
         (putnam-1986-a5-quoted n)
         (putnam-1986-a5-quoted function)
         (putnam-1986-a5-quoted x)
         (putnam-1986-a5-quoted gradient)
         (putnam-1986-a5-quoted epsilon)

(defun putnam-1986-a5-has-frechet-row
    (n function x gradient)
  (list
   'lambda '(epsilon)
   (putnam-1986-a5-implies-term
    (putnam-1986-a5-positive-rational-term
     'epsilon)
    (list 'putnam-1986-a5-exists-p
          (list 'putnam-1986-a5-frechet-radius-function
                (putnam-1986-a5-quoted n)
                (putnam-1986-a5-quoted function)
                (putnam-1986-a5-quoted x)
                (putnam-1986-a5-quoted gradient)
                'epsilon)

(defun putnam-1986-a5-has-frechet-p
    (n function x gradient)
  (and
   (putnam-1986-a5-vector-p gradient n)
   (putnam-1986-a5-universal-p
    (putnam-1986-a5-has-frechet-row
     n function x gradient)
    '(epsilon))))

(defun putnam-1986-a5-frechet-witness-function
    (n function x)
  (list
   'lambda '(gradient)
   (list 'putnam-1986-a5-has-frechet-p
         (putnam-1986-a5-quoted n)
         (putnam-1986-a5-quoted function)
         (putnam-1986-a5-quoted x)
         'gradient)))

(defun putnam-1986-a5-frechet-exists-p
    (n function x)
  (putnam-1986-a5-exists-p
   (putnam-1986-a5-frechet-witness-function
    n function x)
   '(gradient)))

(defun putnam-1986-a5-total-value-witness-p
    (n function x j value gradient)
  (and
   (putnam-1986-a5-has-frechet-p
    n function x gradient)
   (putnam-1986-a5-real-equal-p

(defun putnam-1986-a5-total-value-witness-function

  (list
   'lambda '(gradient)
   (list 'putnam-1986-a5-total-value-witness-p
         (putnam-1986-a5-quoted n)
         (putnam-1986-a5-quoted function)
         (putnam-1986-a5-quoted x)
         (putnam-1986-a5-quoted j)

(defun putnam-1986-a5-total-partial-value-p
    (n function x j value)
  (if (putnam-1986-a5-frechet-exists-p
       n function x)
      (putnam-1986-a5-exists-p
       (putnam-1986-a5-total-value-witness-function
        n function x j value)
       '(gradient))
    (putnam-1986-a5-real-equal-p
     value
     (putnam-1986-a5-constant-name 0))))

(defun putnam-1986-a5-total-field-row
    (n function field)
  (list
   'lambda '(j x)
   (putnam-1986-a5-implies-term
    (putnam-1986-a5-and-terms
     (list
      (list 'putnam-1986-a5-index-p
            'j (putnam-1986-a5-quoted n))
      (list 'putnam-1986-a5-vector-p
            'x (putnam-1986-a5-quoted n))))
    (list 'putnam-1986-a5-total-partial-value-p
          (putnam-1986-a5-quoted n)
          (putnam-1986-a5-quoted function)
          'x 'j
          (putnam-1986-a5-apply-term
           field '(j x))))))

(defun putnam-1986-a5-total-field-p
    (n function field)
  (and
   (putnam-1986-a5-component-function-p n field)
   (putnam-1986-a5-universal-p
    (putnam-1986-a5-total-field-row
     n function field)
    '(j x))))

(defun putnam-1986-a5-adjusted-value
    (function total-field i x)
  (putnam-1986-a5-real-add-name
   (apply$ function (list i x))
   (apply$ total-field (list i x))))

(defun putnam-1986-a5-linearity-row
    (n function total-field)
  (list
   'lambda '(i x y scalar)
   (putnam-1986-a5-implies-term
    (putnam-1986-a5-and-terms
     (list
      (list 'putnam-1986-a5-index-p
            'i (putnam-1986-a5-quoted n))
      (list 'putnam-1986-a5-vector-p
            'x (putnam-1986-a5-quoted n))
      (list 'putnam-1986-a5-vector-p
            'y (putnam-1986-a5-quoted n))
      (list 'putnam-1986-a5-real-name-p 'scalar)))
    (putnam-1986-a5-and-terms
     (list
      (list 'putnam-1986-a5-real-equal-p
            (list 'putnam-1986-a5-adjusted-value
                  (putnam-1986-a5-quoted function)
                  (putnam-1986-a5-quoted total-field)
                  'i
                  (list 'putnam-1986-a5-vector-add
                        'x 'y))
            (list 'putnam-1986-a5-real-add-name
                  (list 'putnam-1986-a5-adjusted-value
                        (putnam-1986-a5-quoted function)
                        (putnam-1986-a5-quoted total-field)
                        'i 'x)
                  (list 'putnam-1986-a5-adjusted-value
                        (putnam-1986-a5-quoted function)
                        (putnam-1986-a5-quoted total-field)
                        'i 'y)))
      (list 'putnam-1986-a5-real-equal-p
            (list 'putnam-1986-a5-adjusted-value
                  (putnam-1986-a5-quoted function)
                  (putnam-1986-a5-quoted total-field)
                  'i
                  (list 'putnam-1986-a5-vector-smul
                        'scalar 'x))
            (list 'putnam-1986-a5-real-product-name
                  'scalar
                  (list 'putnam-1986-a5-adjusted-value
                        (putnam-1986-a5-quoted function)
                        (putnam-1986-a5-quoted total-field)
                        'i 'x))))))))

(defun putnam-1986-a5-adjusted-linear-p
    (n function total-field)
  (putnam-1986-a5-universal-p
   (putnam-1986-a5-linearity-row
    n function total-field)
   '(i x y scalar)))

(defun putnam-1986-a5-solution-witness-p
    (n function scalar-function total-field)
  (and
   (putnam-1986-a5-scalar-function-p
    n scalar-function)
   (putnam-1986-a5-total-field-p
    n scalar-function total-field)
   (putnam-1986-a5-adjusted-linear-p
    n function total-field)))

(defun putnam-1986-a5-solution-witness-function
    (n function)
  (list
   'lambda '(scalar-function total-field)
   (list 'putnam-1986-a5-solution-witness-p
         (putnam-1986-a5-quoted n)
         (putnam-1986-a5-quoted function)
         'scalar-function
         'total-field)))

(defun putnam-1986-a5-conclusion-p (n function)
  (putnam-1986-a5-exists-p
   (putnam-1986-a5-solution-witness-function
    n function)
   '(scalar-function total-field)))

(defun putnambench-putnam-1986-a5-statement
    (n function constants)
  (implies
   (putnam-1986-a5-hypothesis-p
    n function constants)

title: putnam_1986_a5
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1986_a5:
-- a real vector field with continuous second partial derivatives and constant
-- skew first-partial differences admits a potential correction whose components
-- are linear. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module Putnam1986A5 where

open import Agda.Builtin.Bool using (Bool; false; true)
open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; _*_)

infix 4 _!=_
infixr 3 _and_
infixr 2 _or_

data Bottom : Set where

Not : Set -> Set
Not A =
  A -> Bottom

_!=_ : {A : Set} -> A -> A -> Set
x != y =
  Not (x == y)

record _and_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data _or_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  left  : A -> A or B
  right : B -> A or B

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

data Positive : Nat -> Set where
  positive : {n : Nat} -> Positive (suc n)

data Fin : Nat -> Set where
  fzero : {n : Nat} -> Fin (suc n)
  fsuc  : {n : Nat} -> Fin n -> Fin (suc n)

finEqual :
  {n : Nat} ->
  Fin n ->
  Fin n ->
  Bool
finEqual fzero fzero =
  true
finEqual fzero (fsuc j) =
  false
finEqual (fsuc i) fzero =
  false
finEqual (fsuc i) (fsuc j) =
  finEqual i j

record CompleteOrderedRealField (R : Set) : Set1 where
  field
    zeroR oneR : R
    add multiply : R -> R -> R
    negate inverse : R -> R
    lessOrEqual : R -> R -> Set
    fromNat : Nat -> R

    one-not-zero :
      oneR != zeroR

    add-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> add x y == add y x
    add-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      add (add x y) z == add x (add y z)
    add-zero :
      (x : R) -> add x zeroR == x
    add-inverse :
      (x : R) -> add x (negate x) == zeroR

    multiply-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> multiply x y == multiply y x
    multiply-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply (multiply x y) z ==
      multiply x (multiply y z)
    multiply-one :
      (x : R) -> multiply x oneR == x
    multiply-zero :
      (x : R) -> multiply x zeroR == zeroR
    distribute :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply x (add y z) ==
      add (multiply x y) (multiply x z)
    inverse-zero :
      inverse zeroR == zeroR
    multiply-inverse :
      (x : R) ->
      x != zeroR ->
      multiply x (inverse x) == oneR

    order-reflexive :
      (x : R) -> lessOrEqual x x
    order-transitive :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y z ->
      lessOrEqual x z
    order-antisymmetric :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y x ->
      x == y
    order-total :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y or lessOrEqual y x
    add-order :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual (add z x) (add z y)
    multiply-nonnegative :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR x ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR y ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR (multiply x y)
    zero-less-than-one :
      lessOrEqual zeroR oneR and zeroR != oneR

    fromNat-zero :
      fromNat zero == zeroR
    fromNat-successor :
      (n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (suc n) == add (fromNat n) oneR
    fromNat-addition :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m + n) == add (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-multiplication :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m * n) == multiply (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-injective :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat m == fromNat n ->
      m == n

    archimedean :
      (x : R) ->
      Exists Nat
        (\ n ->
          lessOrEqual x (fromNat n))
    least-upper-bound :
      (P : R -> Set) ->
      Exists R P ->
      Exists R
        (\ upper ->
          (x : R) ->
          P x ->
          lessOrEqual x upper) ->
      Exists R
        (\ supremum ->
          ((x : R) ->
            P x ->
            lessOrEqual x supremum)
          and
          ((upper : R) ->
            ((x : R) ->
              P x ->
              lessOrEqual x upper) ->
            lessOrEqual supremum upper))

open CompleteOrderedRealField

subtract :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
subtract reals x y =
  add reals x (negate reals y)

divide :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
divide reals x y =
  multiply reals x (inverse reals y)

StrictLess :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
StrictLess reals x y =
  lessOrEqual reals x y and x != y

CloseTo :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
CloseTo reals center radius x =
  StrictLess reals
    (subtract reals center radius)
    x
  and
  StrictLess reals
    x
    (add reals center radius)

differenceQuotient :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (R -> R) ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
differenceQuotient reals function point x =
  divide reals
    (subtract reals (function x) (function point))
    (subtract reals x point)

DerivativeAt :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (R -> R) ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
DerivativeAt {R} reals function point derivativeValue =
  (epsilon : R) ->
  StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) epsilon ->
  Exists R
    (\ delta ->
      StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) delta
      and
      ((x : R) ->
        CloseTo reals point delta x ->
        x != point ->
        CloseTo reals derivativeValue epsilon
          (differenceQuotient reals function point x)))

HasDerivativeAt :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (R -> R) ->
  R ->
  Set
HasDerivativeAt {R} reals function point =
  Exists R
    (\ derivativeValue ->
      DerivativeAt reals function point derivativeValue)

record StandardRealCalculus
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) : Set1 where

  field
    derivative : (R -> R) -> R -> R

    derivative-when-differentiable :
      (function : R -> R) ->
      (point : R) ->
      HasDerivativeAt reals function point ->
      DerivativeAt reals
        function
        point
        (derivative function point)

    derivative-when-not-differentiable :
      (function : R -> R) ->
      (point : R) ->
      Not (HasDerivativeAt reals function point) ->
      derivative function point == zeroR reals

open StandardRealCalculus

Vector :
  Nat ->
  Set ->
  Set
Vector n R =
  Fin n -> R

replaceCoordinate :
  {n : Nat} {R : Set} ->
  Vector n R ->
  Fin n ->
  R ->
  Vector n R
replaceCoordinate x i value j with finEqual i j
... | true =
  value
... | false =
  x j

zeroVector :
  {n : Nat} {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Vector n R
zeroVector reals i =
  zeroR reals

addVector :
  {n : Nat} {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Vector n R ->
  Vector n R ->
  Vector n R
addVector reals x y i =
  add reals (x i) (y i)

scaleVector :
  {n : Nat} {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  Vector n R ->
  Vector n R
scaleVector reals scalar x i =
  multiply reals scalar (x i)

VectorClose :
  {n : Nat} {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Vector n R ->
  R ->
  Vector n R ->
  Set
VectorClose {n} reals center radius x =
  (i : Fin n) ->
  CloseTo reals (center i) radius (x i)

ContinuousVectorFunction :
  {n : Nat} {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (Vector n R -> R) ->
  Set
ContinuousVectorFunction {n} {R} reals function =
  (point : Vector n R) ->
  (epsilon : R) ->
  StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) epsilon ->
  Exists R
    (\ delta ->
      StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) delta
      and
      ((x : Vector n R) ->
        VectorClose reals point delta x ->
        CloseTo reals
          (function point)
          epsilon
          (function x)))

partialDerivative :
  {n : Nat} {R : Set} ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) ->
  StandardRealCalculus reals ->
  (Vector n R -> R) ->
  Fin n ->
  Vector n R ->
  R
partialDerivative reals calculus function i x =
  derivative calculus
    (\ coordinate ->
      function (replaceCoordinate x i coordinate))
    (x i)

HasPartialDerivativeAt :
  {n : Nat} {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (Vector n R -> R) ->
  Fin n ->
  Vector n R ->
  Set
HasPartialDerivativeAt reals function i x =
  HasDerivativeAt reals
    (\ coordinate ->
      function (replaceCoordinate x i coordinate))
    (x i)

FirstPartialsExist :
  {n : Nat} {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (Vector n R -> R) ->
  Set
FirstPartialsExist {n} {R} reals function =
  (i : Fin n) ->
  (x : Vector n R) ->
  HasPartialDerivativeAt reals function i x

FirstPartialsContinuous :
  {n : Nat} {R : Set} ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) ->
  StandardRealCalculus reals ->
  (Vector n R -> R) ->
  Set
FirstPartialsContinuous {n} reals calculus function =
  (i : Fin n) ->
  ContinuousVectorFunction reals
    (partialDerivative reals calculus function i)

SecondPartialsExist :
  {n : Nat} {R : Set} ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) ->
  StandardRealCalculus reals ->
  (Vector n R -> R) ->
  Set
SecondPartialsExist {n} {R} reals calculus function =
  (i j : Fin n) ->
  (x : Vector n R) ->
  HasPartialDerivativeAt reals
    (partialDerivative reals calculus function i)
    j
    x

SecondPartialsContinuous :
  {n : Nat} {R : Set} ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) ->
  StandardRealCalculus reals ->
  (Vector n R -> R) ->
  Set
SecondPartialsContinuous {n} reals calculus function =
  (i j : Fin n) ->
  ContinuousVectorFunction reals
    (partialDerivative reals calculus
      (partialDerivative reals calculus function i)
      j)

HasContinuousSecondPartials :
  {n : Nat} {R : Set} ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) ->
  StandardRealCalculus reals ->
  (Vector n R -> R) ->
  Set
HasContinuousSecondPartials reals calculus function =
  FirstPartialsExist reals function
  and
  FirstPartialsContinuous reals calculus function
  and
  SecondPartialsExist reals calculus function
  and
  SecondPartialsContinuous reals calculus function

FunctionEqual :
  {A B : Set} ->
  (A -> B) ->
  (A -> B) ->
  Set
FunctionEqual {A} f g =
  (x : A) ->
  f x == g x

IsLinearFunction :
  {n : Nat} {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (Vector n R -> R) ->
  Set
IsLinearFunction {n} {R} reals function =
  ((x y : Vector n R) ->
    function (addVector reals x y) ==
    add reals (function x) (function y))
  and
  ((scalar : R) ->
    (x : Vector n R) ->
    function (scaleVector reals scalar x) ==
    multiply reals scalar (function x))

ConstantSkewPartialDifferences :
  {n : Nat} {R : Set} ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) ->
  StandardRealCalculus reals ->
  (Fin n -> Vector n R -> R) ->
  Set
ConstantSkewPartialDifferences {n} {R} reals calculus f =
  Exists (Fin n -> Fin n -> R)
    (\ constants ->
      (i j : Fin n) ->
      (x : Vector n R) ->
      subtract reals
        (partialDerivative reals calculus (f i) j x)
        (partialDerivative reals calculus (f j) i x)
      ==
      constants i j)

CorrectedComponent :
  {n : Nat} {R : Set} ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) ->
  StandardRealCalculus reals ->
  (Fin n -> Vector n R -> R) ->
  (Vector n R -> R) ->
  Fin n ->
  Vector n R ->
  R
CorrectedComponent reals calculus f g i x =
  add reals
    (f i x)
    (partialDerivative reals calculus g i x)

putnam-1986-a5 : Set1
putnam-1986-a5 =
  (R : Set) ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) ->
  (calculus : StandardRealCalculus reals) ->
  (n : Nat) ->
  Positive n ->
  (f : Fin n -> Vector n R -> R) ->
  ((i : Fin n) ->
    HasContinuousSecondPartials reals calculus (f i)) ->
  ConstantSkewPartialDifferences reals calculus f ->
  Exists (Vector n R -> R)
    (\ g ->
      (i : Fin n) ->
      IsLinearFunction reals
        (CorrectedComponent reals calculus f g i))

title: putnam_1986_a5
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1986_a5:
  a finite-dimensional real vector field with continuous second partial
  derivatives and constant antisymmetric first-partial differences admits a
  scalar correction whose components are linear. This file contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open arithmeticTheory pred_setTheory fcpTheory realTheory real_sigmaTheory;
open real_topologyTheory limTheory;

val putnam_1986_a5 =
  ``let xrepl =
      \x : real['N].
      \i : num.
      \xi : real.
        FCP k. if k = i then xi else x ' k
    in
    let partderiv =
      \func : real['N] -> real.
      \i : num.
      \x : real['N].
        diffn 1 (\xi : real. func (xrepl x i xi)) (x ' i)
    in
    let sqdist =
      \x y : real['N].
        REAL_SUM_IMAGE
          (\k : num. (x ' k - y ' k) pow 2)
          (count (dimindex (:'N)))
    in
    let euclidean_continuous =
      \h : real['N] -> real.
        !x : real['N].
        !e : real.
          0 < e
          ==>
          ?d : real.
            0 < d /\
            !y : real['N].
              sqdist x y < d ==> abs (h y - h x) < e
    in
    let has_continuous_second_partials =
      \func : real['N] -> real.
        (!i : num.
         !x : real['N].
           i < dimindex (:'N)
           ==>
           higher_differentiable
             1
             (\xi : real. func (xrepl x i xi))
             (x ' i)) /\
        (!i j : num.
         !x : real['N].
           i < dimindex (:'N) /\
           j < dimindex (:'N)
           ==>
           higher_differentiable
             1
             (\xj : real.
                partderiv func i (xrepl x j xj))
             (x ' j)) /\
        (!i j : num.
           i < dimindex (:'N) /\
           j < dimindex (:'N)
           ==>
           euclidean_continuous
             (\x : real['N].
                partderiv (partderiv func i) j x))
    in
    let addv =
      \x y : real['N].
        FCP k. x ' k + y ' k
    in
    let smulv =
      \a : real.
      \x : real['N].
        FCP k. a * x ' k
    in
    let is_linear =
      \h : real['N] -> real.
        (!x y : real['N].
           h (addv x y) = h x + h y) /\
        (!a : real.
         !x : real['N].
           h (smulv a x) = a * h x)
    in
      !n : num.
      !f : (real['N] -> real)['N].
        dimindex (:'N) = n /\
        0 < n /\
        (!i : num.
           i < n ==> has_continuous_second_partials (f ' i)) /\
        (?c : real['N]['N].
           !i j : num.
             i < n /\ j < n
             ==>
             !x : real['N].
               partderiv (f ' i) j x -
                 partderiv (f ' j) i x =
               c ' i ' j)
        ==>
        ?g : real['N] -> real.
          !i : num.
            i < n
            ==>
            is_linear
              (\x : real['N].
                 (f ' i) x + partderiv g i x)``;

title: putnam_1986_a5
content:
$(
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact
  putnam_1986_a5: a real vector field with continuous second-order partial
  derivatives and constant antisymmetric first-partial differences admits a
  scalar potential correction whose components are linear. This file
  contains no proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  For n in NN, P86A5V n is the full real coordinate space on 1 ... n.
  P86A5Repl replaces one coordinate, P86A5Slice is the resulting real
  one-variable slice, and P86A5Part is its native set.mm derivative at the
  original coordinate. The zero fallback makes P86A5Part total, as are the
  derivative operators in the Lean and Isabelle sources; the fallback is
  inactive for the vector-field components under P86A5C2.

  P86A5C2 requires every first and second coordinate partial derivative to
  exist everywhere and every second-partial function to be continuous in the
  standard finite product topology on RR^(1...n). This is the coordinate
  characterization of global C^2 regularity in finite-dimensional real
  space. P86A5Linear expands real linearity as additivity and scalar
  homogeneity. The constants and the potential remain internally
  existentially quantified. All declarations are unproved $a statement
  encodings; this database contains no $p proof declaration.
$)

$c
  P86A5V P86A5Top P86A5Repl P86A5Slice P86A5Part
  P86A5D1 P86A5D2 P86A5C2 P86A5Linear
$.

p86a5-vector-space-syntax $a class ( P86A5V n ) $.
p86a5-vector-topology-syntax $a class ( P86A5Top n ) $.
p86a5-replace-syntax $a class ( P86A5Repl n x i r ) $.
p86a5-slice-syntax $a class ( P86A5Slice n F i x ) $.
p86a5-partial-syntax $a class ( P86A5Part n F i x ) $.
p86a5-first-partial-function-syntax $a class ( P86A5D1 n F i ) $.
p86a5-second-partial-function-syntax $a class ( P86A5D2 n F i j ) $.
p86a5-c2-syntax $a wff ( P86A5C2 n F ) $.
p86a5-linear-syntax $a wff ( P86A5Linear n F ) $.

p86a5-vector-space-definition $a |- (
  P86A5V n
) = (
  RR ^m ( 1 ... n )
) $.

p86a5-vector-topology-definition $a |- (
  P86A5Top n
) = (
  Xt_ `
    (
      ( 1 ... n )
      X.
      { ( TopOpen ` RRfld ) }
    )
) $.

${
  $d i j n r x $.

  p86a5-replace-definition $a |- (
    P86A5Repl n x i r
  ) = (
    j e. ( 1 ... n ) |->
      if (
        j = i ,
        r ,
        ( x ` j )
      )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d F i n r x $.

  p86a5-slice-definition $a |- (
    P86A5Slice n F i x
  ) = (
    r e. RR |->
      ( F ` ( P86A5Repl n x i r ) )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d F i n x $.

  p86a5-partial-definition $a |- (
    P86A5Part n F i x
  ) = if (
    ( x ` i ) e.
      dom
        (
          RR _D
            ( P86A5Slice n F i x )
        ) ,
    (
      (
        RR _D
          ( P86A5Slice n F i x )
      )
      ` ( x ` i )
    ) ,
    0
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d F i n x $.

  p86a5-first-partial-function-definition $a |- (
    P86A5D1 n F i
  ) = (
    x e. ( P86A5V n ) |->
      ( P86A5Part n F i x )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d F i j n x $.

  p86a5-second-partial-function-definition $a |- (
    P86A5D2 n F i j
  ) = (
    x e. ( P86A5V n ) |->
      (
        P86A5Part
          n
          ( P86A5D1 n F i )
          j
          x
      )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d F i j n x $.

  p86a5-c2-definition $a |- (
    ( P86A5C2 n F )
    <->
    (
      F e. ( RR ^m ( P86A5V n ) )
      /\
      (
        A. i e. ( 1 ... n )
          A. x e. ( P86A5V n )
            ( x ` i ) e.
              dom
                (
                  RR _D
                    ( P86A5Slice n F i x )
                )
        /\
        A. i e. ( 1 ... n )
          A. j e. ( 1 ... n )
            (
              A. x e. ( P86A5V n )
                ( x ` j ) e.
                  dom
                    (
                      RR _D
                        (
                          P86A5Slice
                            n
                            ( P86A5D1 n F i )
                            j
                            x
                        )
                    )
              /\
              ( P86A5D2 n F i j ) e.
                (
                  ( P86A5Top n )
                  Cn
                  ( TopOpen ` RRfld )
                )
            )
      )
    )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d F a i n x y $.

  p86a5-linear-definition $a |- (
    ( P86A5Linear n F )
    <->
    (
      F e. ( RR ^m ( P86A5V n ) )
      /\
      (
        A. x e. ( P86A5V n )
          A. y e. ( P86A5V n )
            ( F `
              (
                i e. ( 1 ... n ) |->
                  ( ( x ` i ) + ( y ` i ) )
              )
            )
            =
            ( ( F ` x ) + ( F ` y ) )
        /\
        A. a e. RR
          A. x e. ( P86A5V n )
            ( F `
              (
                i e. ( 1 ... n ) |->
                  ( a x. ( x ` i ) )
              )
            )
            =
            ( a x. ( F ` x ) )
      )
    )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d C F g i j n x $.

  putnambench-putnam-1986-a5 $a |-
    A. n e. NN
      A. F e.
        (
          ( RR ^m ( P86A5V n ) )
          ^m
          ( 1 ... n )
        )
        (
          (
            (
              A. i e. ( 1 ... n )
                ( P86A5C2 n ( F ` i ) )
              /\
              E. C e.
                (
                  ( RR ^m ( 1 ... n ) )
                  ^m
                  ( 1 ... n )
                )
                A. i e. ( 1 ... n )
                  A. j e. ( 1 ... n )
                    A. x e. ( P86A5V n )
                      (
                        (
                          P86A5Part
                            n
                            ( F ` i )
                            j
                            x
                        )
                        -
                        (
                          P86A5Part
                            n
                            ( F ` j )
                            i
                            x
                        )
                      )
                      =
                      ( ( C ` i ) ` j )
            )
          )
          ->
          E. g e. ( RR ^m ( P86A5V n ) )
            A. i e. ( 1 ... n )
              (
                P86A5Linear
                  n
                  (
                    x e. ( P86A5V n ) |->
                      (
                        ( ( F ` i ) ` x )
                        +
                        ( P86A5Part n g i x )
                      )
                  )
              )
        )
  $.
$}

begin

::$P-
theorem
  for n being non zero Element of NAT,
      f being Function of Seg n,Funcs(REAL n,REAL),
      C being Function of [:Seg n,Seg n:],REAL st
    (for i being Nat st i in Seg n holds
      ex fi being Function of REAL n,REAL st
        fi = f.i &

            is_partial_differentiable_on [#](REAL n),k &

              `partial|([#](REAL n),k)) &

              d2 is_continuous_in y) &

      ex fi,fj being Function of REAL n,REAL st
        fi = f.i & fj = f.j &
        for x being Element of REAL n holds

  holds
    ex g being Function of REAL n,REAL st
      for i being Nat st i in Seg n holds
        ex fi,h being Function of REAL n,REAL st
          fi = f.i &
          (for x being Element of REAL n holds
            h.x = fi.x + partdiff(g,x,i)) &
          (for x,y being Element of REAL n holds
            h.(x+y) = h.x + h.y) &
          (for a being Real, x being Element of REAL n holds
            h.(a*x) = a*h.x)
