  (cond
   ((equal (putnam-1986-b5-term-coefficient term) 0)
    polynomial)
   ((endp polynomial)
    (list term))
   ((putnam-1986-b5-same-exponents-p term (car polynomial))
    (let ((coefficient
           (+ (putnam-1986-b5-term-coefficient term)
              (putnam-1986-b5-term-coefficient
               (car polynomial)))))
      (if (equal coefficient 0)
          (cdr polynomial)
        (cons
         (putnam-1986-b5-make-term-like term coefficient)
         (cdr polynomial)))))
   ((putnam-1986-b5-exponents-less-p term (car polynomial))
    (cons term polynomial))
   (t
    (cons
     (car polynomial)
     (putnam-1986-b5-insert-term term (cdr polynomial))))))

(defun putnam-1986-b5-polynomial-add (left right)
  (if (consp left)
      (putnam-1986-b5-insert-term
       (car left)
       (putnam-1986-b5-polynomial-add (cdr left) right))
    right))

(defun putnam-1986-b5-multiply-terms (left right)
  (list
   (+ (putnam-1986-b5-term-ex left)
      (putnam-1986-b5-term-ex right))
   (+ (putnam-1986-b5-term-ey left)
      (putnam-1986-b5-term-ey right))
   (+ (putnam-1986-b5-term-ez left)
      (putnam-1986-b5-term-ez right))
   (* (putnam-1986-b5-term-coefficient left)
      (putnam-1986-b5-term-coefficient right))))

(defun putnam-1986-b5-polynomial-times-term (polynomial term)
  (if (consp polynomial)
      (putnam-1986-b5-insert-term
       (putnam-1986-b5-multiply-terms (car polynomial) term)

        (cdr polynomial) term))

(defun putnam-1986-b5-polynomial-mul (left right)

      (putnam-1986-b5-polynomial-add
       (putnam-1986-b5-polynomial-times-term right (car left))

(defun putnam-1986-b5-polynomial-scale (coefficient polynomial)
  (if (consp polynomial)
      (let ((scaled
             (* coefficient
                (putnam-1986-b5-term-coefficient
                 (car polynomial)))))
        (if (equal scaled 0)
            (putnam-1986-b5-polynomial-scale
             coefficient (cdr polynomial))
          (cons
           (putnam-1986-b5-make-term-like
            (car polynomial) scaled)
           (putnam-1986-b5-polynomial-scale
            coefficient (cdr polynomial)))))

(defun putnam-1986-b5-polynomial-square (polynomial)
  (putnam-1986-b5-polynomial-mul polynomial polynomial))

(defun putnam-1986-b5-f-polynomial (p q r)
  (putnam-1986-b5-polynomial-add
   (putnam-1986-b5-polynomial-square p)
   (putnam-1986-b5-polynomial-add
    (putnam-1986-b5-polynomial-square q)
    (putnam-1986-b5-polynomial-add
     (putnam-1986-b5-polynomial-square r)
     (putnam-1986-b5-polynomial-mul
      p
      (putnam-1986-b5-polynomial-mul q r))))))

(defun putnam-1986-b5-polynomial-coefficient
    (ex ey ez polynomial)
  (if (consp polynomial)
      (if (and
           (equal ex
                  (putnam-1986-b5-term-ex (car polynomial)))
           (equal ey
                  (putnam-1986-b5-term-ey (car polynomial)))
           (equal ez
                  (putnam-1986-b5-term-ez (car polynomial))))
          (putnam-1986-b5-term-coefficient (car polynomial))
        (putnam-1986-b5-polynomial-coefficient
         ex ey ez (cdr polynomial)))
    0))

(defun putnam-1986-b5-x-polynomial ()
  (list (list 1 0 0 1)))

(defun putnam-1986-b5-y-polynomial ()
  (list (list 0 1 0 1)))

(defun putnam-1986-b5-z-polynomial ()
  (list (list 0 0 1 1)))

(defun putnam-1986-b5-polynomial-set-subset-p (left right)
  (if (consp left)
      (and
       (member-equal (car left) right)
       (putnam-1986-b5-polynomial-set-subset-p
        (cdr left) right))
    t))

(defun putnam-1986-b5-polynomial-set-equal-p (left right)
  (and
   (putnam-1986-b5-polynomial-set-subset-p left right)
   (putnam-1986-b5-polynomial-set-subset-p right left)))

(defun putnam-1986-b5-permitted-polynomial-set-p (candidate)
  (let* ((x (putnam-1986-b5-x-polynomial))
         (y (putnam-1986-b5-y-polynomial))
         (z (putnam-1986-b5-z-polynomial))
         (minus-x (putnam-1986-b5-polynomial-scale -1 x))
         (minus-y (putnam-1986-b5-polynomial-scale -1 y))
         (minus-z (putnam-1986-b5-polynomial-scale -1 z)))
    (or
     (putnam-1986-b5-polynomial-set-equal-p
      candidate (list x y z))
     (putnam-1986-b5-polynomial-set-equal-p
      candidate (list x minus-y minus-z))
     (putnam-1986-b5-polynomial-set-equal-p
      candidate (list minus-x y minus-z))
     (putnam-1986-b5-polynomial-set-equal-p
      candidate (list minus-x minus-y z)))))

;; Equality of sparse polynomials is checked coefficientwise. Since these
;; rational-coefficient polynomials canonically embed into R[X,Y,Z], this
;; states the existence of a real-polynomial counterexample without selecting
;; a particular witness in the statement.
(defun-sk putnam-1986-b5-preserves-f-p (p q r)
  (forall (ex ey ez)
    (implies
     (and (natp ex) (natp ey) (natp ez))
     (let* ((x (putnam-1986-b5-x-polynomial))
            (y (putnam-1986-b5-y-polynomial))
            (z (putnam-1986-b5-z-polynomial))
            (original (putnam-1986-b5-f-polynomial x y z))
            (transformed (putnam-1986-b5-f-polynomial p q r)))
       (equal
        (putnam-1986-b5-polynomial-coefficient
         ex ey ez transformed)
        (putnam-1986-b5-polynomial-coefficient
         ex ey ez original))))))

(defun-sk putnam-1986-b5-counterexample-exists-p ()
  (exists (p q r)
    (and
     (putnam-1986-b5-polynomial-p p)
     (putnam-1986-b5-polynomial-p q)
     (putnam-1986-b5-polynomial-p r)
     (putnam-1986-b5-preserves-f-p p q r)
     (not
      (putnam-1986-b5-permitted-polynomial-set-p
       (list p q r))))))

;; The source answer is False, equivalently the proposed universal
;; classification has a counterexample.
(defun putnambench-putnam-1986-b5-statement ()
  (putnam-1986-b5-counterexample-exists-p))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

title: putnam_1986_b5
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1986_b5:
-- the assertion that every real polynomial self-map preserving
-- x^2 + y^2 + z^2 + xyz is an even-sign permutation of the coordinates is false.
-- This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.List using (List; []; _∷_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; _*_)

infix 4 _!=_
infixr 3 _and_
infixr 2 _or_

data Bottom : Set where

Not : Set -> Set
Not A =
  A -> Bottom

_!=_ : {A : Set} -> A -> A -> Set
x != y =
  Not (x == y)

record _and_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data _or_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  left  : A -> A or B
  right : B -> A or B

record Iff (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor equivalence
  field
    forward  : A -> B
    backward : B -> A

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

record CompleteOrderedRealField (R : Set) : Set1 where
  field
    zeroR oneR : R
    add multiply : R -> R -> R
    negate inverse : R -> R
    lessOrEqual : R -> R -> Set
    fromNat : Nat -> R

    one-not-zero :
      oneR != zeroR

    add-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> add x y == add y x
    add-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      add (add x y) z == add x (add y z)
    add-zero :
      (x : R) -> add x zeroR == x
    add-inverse :
      (x : R) -> add x (negate x) == zeroR

    multiply-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> multiply x y == multiply y x
    multiply-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply (multiply x y) z ==
      multiply x (multiply y z)
    multiply-one :
      (x : R) -> multiply x oneR == x
    multiply-zero :
      (x : R) -> multiply x zeroR == zeroR
    distribute :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply x (add y z) ==
      add (multiply x y) (multiply x z)
    inverse-zero :
      inverse zeroR == zeroR
    multiply-inverse :
      (x : R) ->
      x != zeroR ->
      multiply x (inverse x) == oneR

    order-reflexive :
      (x : R) -> lessOrEqual x x
    order-transitive :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y z ->
      lessOrEqual x z
    order-antisymmetric :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y x ->
      x == y
    order-total :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y or lessOrEqual y x
    add-order :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual (add z x) (add z y)
    multiply-nonnegative :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR x ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR y ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR (multiply x y)
    zero-less-than-one :
      lessOrEqual zeroR oneR and zeroR != oneR

    fromNat-zero :
      fromNat zero == zeroR
    fromNat-successor :
      (n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (suc n) == add (fromNat n) oneR
    fromNat-addition :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m + n) == add (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-multiplication :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m * n) == multiply (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-injective :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat m == fromNat n ->
      m == n

    archimedean :
      (x : R) ->
      Exists Nat
        (\ n ->
          lessOrEqual x (fromNat n))
    least-upper-bound :
      (P : R -> Set) ->
      Exists R P ->
      Exists R
        (\ upper ->
          (x : R) ->
          P x ->
          lessOrEqual x upper) ->
      Exists R
        (\ supremum ->
          ((x : R) ->
            P x ->
            lessOrEqual x supremum)
          and
          ((upper : R) ->
            ((x : R) ->
              P x ->
              lessOrEqual x upper) ->
            lessOrEqual supremum upper))

open CompleteOrderedRealField

record Monomial (R : Set) : Set where
  constructor monomial
  field
    coefficient : R
    xExponent   : Nat
    yExponent   : Nat
    zExponent   : Nat

open Monomial

Polynomial : Set -> Set
Polynomial R =
  List (Monomial R)

module Putnam1986B5Statement
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) where

  infix 4 _~=P_

  power : R -> Nat -> R
  power x zero =
    oneR reals
  power x (suc n) =
    multiply reals x (power x n)

  evaluateMonomial :
    Monomial R ->
    R ->
    R ->
    R ->
    R
  evaluateMonomial term x y z =
    multiply reals
      (coefficient term)
      (multiply reals
        (power x (xExponent term))
        (multiply reals
          (power y (yExponent term))
          (power z (zExponent term))))

  evaluate :
    Polynomial R ->
    R ->
    R ->
    R ->
    R
  evaluate [] x y z =
    zeroR reals
  evaluate (term ∷ terms) x y z =
    add reals
      (evaluateMonomial term x y z)
      (evaluate terms x y z)

  _~=P_ :
    Polynomial R ->
    Polynomial R ->
    Set
  p ~=P q =
    (x y z : R) ->
    evaluate p x y z == evaluate q x y z

  xCoordinate : Polynomial R
  xCoordinate =
    monomial (oneR reals) (suc zero) zero zero ∷ []

  yCoordinate : Polynomial R
  yCoordinate =
    monomial (oneR reals) zero (suc zero) zero ∷ []

  zCoordinate : Polynomial R
  zCoordinate =
    monomial (oneR reals) zero zero (suc zero) ∷ []

  negativeXCoordinate : Polynomial R
  negativeXCoordinate =
    monomial (negate reals (oneR reals)) (suc zero) zero zero ∷ []

  negativeYCoordinate : Polynomial R
  negativeYCoordinate =
    monomial (negate reals (oneR reals)) zero (suc zero) zero ∷ []

  negativeZCoordinate : Polynomial R
  negativeZCoordinate =
    monomial (negate reals (oneR reals)) zero zero (suc zero) ∷ []

  fValue : R -> R -> R -> R
  fValue x y z =
    add reals
      (multiply reals x x)
      (add reals
        (multiply reals y y)
        (add reals
          (multiply reals z z)
          (multiply reals (multiply reals x y) z)))

  PreservesF :
    Polynomial R ->
    Polynomial R ->
    Polynomial R ->
    Set
  PreservesF p q r =
    (x y z : R) ->
    fValue
      (evaluate p x y z)
      (evaluate q x y z)
      (evaluate r x y z)
    ==
    fValue x y z

  data IsPermutationOf
    (p q r a b c : Polynomial R) : Set where

    order-abc :
      p ~=P a ->
      q ~=P b ->
      r ~=P c ->
      IsPermutationOf p q r a b c

    order-acb :
      p ~=P a ->
      q ~=P c ->
      r ~=P b ->
      IsPermutationOf p q r a b c

    order-bac :
      p ~=P b ->
      q ~=P a ->
      r ~=P c ->
      IsPermutationOf p q r a b c

    order-bca :
      p ~=P b ->
      q ~=P c ->
      r ~=P a ->
      IsPermutationOf p q r a b c

    order-cab :
      p ~=P c ->
      q ~=P a ->
      r ~=P b ->
      IsPermutationOf p q r a b c

    order-cba :
      p ~=P c ->
      q ~=P b ->
      r ~=P a ->
      IsPermutationOf p q r a b c

  AllowedSignedCoordinatePermutation :
    Polynomial R ->
    Polynomial R ->
    Polynomial R ->
    Set
  AllowedSignedCoordinatePermutation p q r =
    IsPermutationOf
      p q r
      xCoordinate yCoordinate zCoordinate
    or
    IsPermutationOf
      p q r
      xCoordinate negativeYCoordinate negativeZCoordinate
    or
    IsPermutationOf
      p q r
      negativeXCoordinate yCoordinate negativeZCoordinate
    or
    IsPermutationOf
      p q r
      negativeXCoordinate negativeYCoordinate zCoordinate

  ClassificationClaim : Set
  ClassificationClaim =
    (p q r : Polynomial R) ->
    PreservesF p q r ->
    AllowedSignedCoordinatePermutation p q r

  solution : Set
  solution =
    Bottom

  proposition : Set
  proposition =
    Iff ClassificationClaim solution

putnam-1986-b5 : Set1
putnam-1986-b5 =
  (R : Set) ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) ->
  Putnam1986B5Statement.proposition reals

title: putnam_1986_b5
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1986_b5:
  the assertion that every real-polynomial triple preserving
  x^2 + y^2 + z^2 + xyz is an allowed signed coordinate permutation is false.
  This file contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open pred_setTheory realTheory real_sigmaTheory;

val putnam_1986_b5 =
  ``let support =
      \p : num # (num # num) -> real.
        {ijk : num # (num # num) | p ijk <> 0}
    in
    let polynomial =
      \p : num # (num # num) -> real.
        FINITE (support p)
    in
    let eval =
      \p : num # (num # num) -> real.
      \x y z : real.
        REAL_SUM_IMAGE
          (\ijk : num # (num # num).
             p ijk *
             x pow (FST ijk) *
             y pow (FST (SND ijk)) *
             z pow (SND (SND ijk)))
          (support p)
    in
    let xpoly =
      \ijk : num # (num # num).
        if ijk = (1, (0, 0)) then (1 : real) else 0
    in
    let ypoly =
      \ijk : num # (num # num).
        if ijk = (0, (1, 0)) then (1 : real) else 0
    in
    let zpoly =
      \ijk : num # (num # num).
        if ijk = (0, (0, 1)) then (1 : real) else 0
    in
    let negpoly =
      \p : num # (num # num) -> real.
      \ijk : num # (num # num).
        -p ijk
    in
    let f =
      \ijk : num # (num # num).
        if ijk = (2, (0, 0)) \/
           ijk = (0, (2, 0)) \/
           ijk = (0, (0, 2)) \/
           ijk = (1, (1, 1))
        then (1 : real)
        else 0
    in
    let perms =
      {s : (num # (num # num) -> real) set |
         s = {xpoly; ypoly; zpoly} \/
         s = {xpoly; negpoly ypoly; negpoly zpoly} \/
         s = {negpoly xpoly; ypoly; negpoly zpoly} \/
         s = {negpoly xpoly; negpoly ypoly; zpoly}}
    in
    let putnam_1986_b5_solution = F
    in
      ((!p q r : num # (num # num) -> real.
          polynomial p /\
          polynomial q /\
          polynomial r /\
          (!x y z : real.
             eval f x y z =
             eval f (eval p x y z) (eval q x y z) (eval r x y z))
          ==>
          {p; q; r} IN perms)
       <=>
       putnam_1986_b5_solution)``;

title: putnam_1986_b5
content:
$(
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact
  putnam_1986_b5: the assertion that every real polynomial self-map preserving
  x^2 + y^2 + z^2 + xyz is a permutation of the coordinate polynomials with
  zero or two minus signs is false. This file contains no proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  The ordinal 3o is the three-element variable-index set. Thus
  ( 3o mPoly RRfld ) is set.mm's ring of arbitrary finite-support
  polynomials in three variables over the real field, ( 3o eval RRfld )
  evaluates such a polynomial at an assignment in ( RR ^m 3o ), and
  ( 3o mVar RRfld ) gives the three coordinate polynomials.

  The antecedent inlines preservation of
  f(x,y,z) = x^2 + y^2 + z^2 + xyz at every real triple. The four set
  equalities are exactly membership of {p,q,r} in the source set perms;
  unordered triple equality retains all coordinate permutations. The outer
  negation is the source biconditional with its specified solution False.

  The final declaration is the single unproved $a corpus statement; this
  database contains no $p proof statement.
$)

${
  $d a p q r $.

  putnambench-putnam-1986-b5 $a |- -.
    A. p e. ( Base ` ( 3o mPoly RRfld ) )
      A. q e. ( Base ` ( 3o mPoly RRfld ) )
        A. r e. ( Base ` ( 3o mPoly RRfld ) )
          (
            A. a e. ( RR ^m 3o )
              (
                (
                  (
                    (
                      (
                        ( ( ( 3o eval RRfld ) ` p ) ` a )
                        ^
                        2
                      )
                      +
                      (
                        ( ( ( 3o eval RRfld ) ` q ) ` a )
                        ^
                        2
                      )
                    )
                    +
                    (
                      ( ( ( 3o eval RRfld ) ` r ) ` a )
                      ^
                      2
                    )
                  )
                  +
                  (
                    (
                      ( ( ( 3o eval RRfld ) ` p ) ` a )
                      x.
                      ( ( ( 3o eval RRfld ) ` q ) ` a )
                    )
                    x.
                    ( ( ( 3o eval RRfld ) ` r ) ` a )
                  )
                )
                =
                (
                  (
                    (
                      ( ( a ` 0 ) ^ 2 )
                      +
                      ( ( a ` 1 ) ^ 2 )
                    )
                    +
                    ( ( a ` 2 ) ^ 2 )
                  )
                  +
                  (
                    (
                      ( a ` 0 )
                      x.
                      ( a ` 1 )
                    )
                    x.
                    ( a ` 2 )
                  )
                )
              )
            ->
            (
              { p , q , r }
              =
              {
                ( ( 3o mVar RRfld ) ` 0 ) ,
                ( ( 3o mVar RRfld ) ` 1 ) ,
                ( ( 3o mVar RRfld ) ` 2 )
              }
              \/
              (
                { p , q , r }
                =
                {
                  ( ( 3o mVar RRfld ) ` 0 ) ,
                  (
                    ( -g ` ( 3o mPoly RRfld ) )
                    `
                    ( ( 3o mVar RRfld ) ` 1 )
                  ) ,
                  (
                    ( -g ` ( 3o mPoly RRfld ) )
                    `
                    ( ( 3o mVar RRfld ) ` 2 )
                  )
                }
                \/
                (
                  { p , q , r }
                  =
                  {
                    (
                      ( -g ` ( 3o mPoly RRfld ) )
                      `
                      ( ( 3o mVar RRfld ) ` 0 )
                    ) ,
                    ( ( 3o mVar RRfld ) ` 1 ) ,
                    (
                      ( -g ` ( 3o mPoly RRfld ) )
                      `
                      ( ( 3o mVar RRfld ) ` 2 )
                    )
                  }
                  \/
                  { p , q , r }
                  =
                  {
                    (
                      ( -g ` ( 3o mPoly RRfld ) )
                      `
                      ( ( 3o mVar RRfld ) ` 0 )
                    ) ,
                    (
                      ( -g ` ( 3o mPoly RRfld ) )
                      `
                      ( ( 3o mVar RRfld ) ` 1 )
                    ) ,
                    ( ( 3o mVar RRfld ) ` 2 )
                  }
                )
              )
            )
          )
  $.
$}

title: putnam_1986_b5
content:
% Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1986_b5:
% the assertion classifying all real trivariate polynomial symmetries of
% x^2 + y^2 + z^2 + xyz as signed coordinate permutations is false. This file
% contains no proof.

putnam_1986_b5: THEORY
BEGIN
  coefficient_table: TYPE = [nat, nat, nat -> real]

  polynomial: TYPE =
    [# coefficients: coefficient_table,
       support_bound: nat #]

  coefficient(
      p: polynomial,
      i, j, k: nat): real =
    IF i <= support_bound(p)
        AND j <= support_bound(p)
        AND k <= support_bound(p) THEN
      coefficients(p)(i, j, k)
    ELSE
      0
    ENDIF

  sum_z(
      p: polynomial,
      x, y, z: real,
      i, j, count: nat): RECURSIVE real =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      sum_z(p, x, y, z, i, j, count - 1)
        + coefficient(p, i, j, count - 1)
            * x ^ i * y ^ j * z ^ (count - 1)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  sum_y(
      p: polynomial,
      x, y, z: real,
      i, count: nat): RECURSIVE real =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      sum_y(p, x, y, z, i, count - 1)
        + sum_z(
            p,
            x,
            y,
            z,
            i,
            count - 1,
            support_bound(p) + 1)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  sum_x(
      p: polynomial,
      x, y, z: real,
      count: nat): RECURSIVE real =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      sum_x(p, x, y, z, count - 1)
        + sum_y(
            p,
            x,
            y,
            z,
            count - 1,
            support_bound(p) + 1)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  polynomial_value(
      p: polynomial,
      x, y, z: real): real =
    sum_x(p, x, y, z, support_bound(p) + 1)

  f_value(x, y, z: real): real =
    x ^ 2 + y ^ 2 + z ^ 2 + x * y * z

  unit_sign(sign: int): bool =
    sign = 1 OR sign = -1

  signed_x(p: polynomial, sign: int): bool =
    unit_sign(sign)
      AND FORALL (i, j, k: nat):
        coefficient(p, i, j, k)
          = IF i = 1 AND j = 0 AND k = 0 THEN
              (sign :: real)
            ELSE
              0
            ENDIF

  signed_y(p: polynomial, sign: int): bool =
    unit_sign(sign)
      AND FORALL (i, j, k: nat):
        coefficient(p, i, j, k)
          = IF i = 0 AND j = 1 AND k = 0 THEN
              (sign :: real)
            ELSE
              0
            ENDIF

  signed_z(p: polynomial, sign: int): bool =
    unit_sign(sign)
      AND FORALL (i, j, k: nat):
        coefficient(p, i, j, k)
          = IF i = 0 AND j = 0 AND k = 1 THEN
              (sign :: real)
            ELSE
              0
            ENDIF

  signed_coordinate_permutation(
      p, q, r: polynomial): bool =
    EXISTS (sx, sy, sz: int):
      unit_sign(sx)
        AND unit_sign(sy)
        AND unit_sign(sz)
        AND sx * sy * sz = 1
        AND ((signed_x(p, sx)
              AND signed_y(q, sy)
              AND signed_z(r, sz))
          OR (signed_x(p, sx)
              AND signed_z(q, sz)
              AND signed_y(r, sy))
          OR (signed_y(p, sy)
              AND signed_x(q, sx)
              AND signed_z(r, sz))
          OR (signed_y(p, sy)
              AND signed_z(q, sz)
              AND signed_x(r, sx))
          OR (signed_z(p, sz)
              AND signed_x(q, sx)
              AND signed_y(r, sy))
          OR (signed_z(p, sz)
              AND signed_y(q, sy)
              AND signed_x(r, sx)))

  preserves_f(p, q, r: polynomial): bool =
    FORALL (x, y, z: real):
      f_value(
        polynomial_value(p, x, y, z),
        polynomial_value(q, x, y, z),
        polynomial_value(r, x, y, z))
        = f_value(x, y, z)

  classification_assertion: bool =
    FORALL (p, q, r: polynomial):
      preserves_f(p, q, r)
        IMPLIES signed_coordinate_permutation(p, q, r)

  putnam_1986_b5_solution: bool = FALSE

  putnam_1986_b5: bool =
    classification_assertion IFF putnam_1986_b5_solution
END putnam_1986_b5

Suppose $A,B,C,D$ are $n \times n$ matrices with entries in a field $F$, satisfying the conditions that $AB^T$ and $CD^T$ are symmetric and $AD^T - BC^T = I$. Here $I$ is the $n \times n$ identity matrix, and if $M$ is an $n \times n$ matrix, $M^T$ is its transpose. Prove that $A^T D - C^T B = I$.
-/
theorem putnam_1986_b6
(n : ℕ)
(npos : n > 0)
(F : Type*) [Field F]
(A B C D : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) F)
(hsymm : IsSymm (A * Bᵀ) ∧ IsSymm (C * Dᵀ))
(hid : A * Dᵀ - B * Cᵀ = 1)
: (Aᵀ * D - Cᵀ * B = 1) :=
sorry

title: putnam_1986_b6
content:
(* Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench artifact putnam_1986_b6:
   square matrices over a field whose products A B^T and C D^T are symmetric
   and satisfy A D^T - B C^T = I also satisfy A^T D - C^T B = I. This file
   contains no proof. *)

From Stdlib Require Import Arith.PeanoNat Vectors.Fin.

Record putnam_1986_b6_field (F : Type) : Type := {
  putnam_1986_b6_zero : F;
  putnam_1986_b6_one : F;
  putnam_1986_b6_add : F -> F -> F;
  putnam_1986_b6_mul : F -> F -> F;
  putnam_1986_b6_opp : F -> F;
  putnam_1986_b6_inv : F -> F;
  putnam_1986_b6_add_assoc :
    forall x y z : F,
      putnam_1986_b6_add x (putnam_1986_b6_add y z) =
      putnam_1986_b6_add (putnam_1986_b6_add x y) z;
  putnam_1986_b6_add_comm :
    forall x y : F,
      putnam_1986_b6_add x y = putnam_1986_b6_add y x;
  putnam_1986_b6_add_zero_l :
    forall x : F,
      putnam_1986_b6_add putnam_1986_b6_zero x = x;
  putnam_1986_b6_add_opp_l :
    forall x : F,
      putnam_1986_b6_add (putnam_1986_b6_opp x) x =
      putnam_1986_b6_zero;
  putnam_1986_b6_mul_assoc :
    forall x y z : F,
      putnam_1986_b6_mul x (putnam_1986_b6_mul y z) =
      putnam_1986_b6_mul (putnam_1986_b6_mul x y) z;
  putnam_1986_b6_mul_comm :
    forall x y : F,
      putnam_1986_b6_mul x y = putnam_1986_b6_mul y x;
  putnam_1986_b6_mul_one_l :
    forall x : F,
      putnam_1986_b6_mul putnam_1986_b6_one x = x;
  putnam_1986_b6_mul_add_distr_l :
    forall x y z : F,
      putnam_1986_b6_mul x (putnam_1986_b6_add y z) =
      putnam_1986_b6_add
        (putnam_1986_b6_mul x y)
        (putnam_1986_b6_mul x z);
  putnam_1986_b6_one_neq_zero :
    putnam_1986_b6_one <> putnam_1986_b6_zero;
  putnam_1986_b6_inv_zero :
    putnam_1986_b6_inv putnam_1986_b6_zero =
    putnam_1986_b6_zero;
  putnam_1986_b6_inv_mul_cancel :
    forall x : F,
      x <> putnam_1986_b6_zero ->
      putnam_1986_b6_mul (putnam_1986_b6_inv x) x =
      putnam_1986_b6_one
}.

Arguments putnam_1986_b6_zero {F} _.
Arguments putnam_1986_b6_one {F} _.
Arguments putnam_1986_b6_add {F} _ _ _.
Arguments putnam_1986_b6_mul {F} _ _ _.
Arguments putnam_1986_b6_opp {F} _ _.

Definition putnam_1986_b6_matrix (F : Type) (n : nat) : Type :=
  Fin.t n -> Fin.t n -> F.

Fixpoint putnam_1986_b6_sum {F : Type}
    (zero : F) (add : F -> F -> F) (n : nat) :
    (Fin.t n -> F) -> F :=
  match n as m return (Fin.t m -> F) -> F with
  | O => fun _ => zero
  | S m =>
      fun f =>
        add (f Fin.F1)
          (putnam_1986_b6_sum zero add m
            (fun i : Fin.t m => f (Fin.FS i)))
  end.

Definition putnam_1986_b6_transpose {F : Type} {n : nat}
    (A : putnam_1986_b6_matrix F n) :
    putnam_1986_b6_matrix F n :=
  fun i j => A j i.

Definition putnam_1986_b6_matrix_mul {F : Type} {n : nat}
    (field : putnam_1986_b6_field F)
    (A B : putnam_1986_b6_matrix F n) :
    putnam_1986_b6_matrix F n :=
  fun i j =>
    putnam_1986_b6_sum
      (putnam_1986_b6_zero field)
      (putnam_1986_b6_add field)
      n
      (fun k => putnam_1986_b6_mul field (A i k) (B k j)).

Definition putnam_1986_b6_matrix_sub {F : Type} {n : nat}
    (field : putnam_1986_b6_field F)
    (A B : putnam_1986_b6_matrix F n) :
    putnam_1986_b6_matrix F n :=
  fun i j =>
    putnam_1986_b6_add field
      (A i j) (putnam_1986_b6_opp field (B i j)).

Definition putnam_1986_b6_identity {F : Type} {n : nat}
    (field : putnam_1986_b6_field F) :
    putnam_1986_b6_matrix F n :=
  fun i j =>
    if Fin.eq_dec i j
    then putnam_1986_b6_one field
    else putnam_1986_b6_zero field.

Definition putnam_1986_b6_matrix_eq {F : Type} {n : nat}
    (A B : putnam_1986_b6_matrix F n) : Prop :=
  forall i j : Fin.t n, A i j = B i j.

Theorem putnam_1986_b6
    (n : nat)
    (npos : (0 < n)%nat)
    (F : Type)
    (field : putnam_1986_b6_field F)
    (A B C D : putnam_1986_b6_matrix F n)
    (hsymm_AB :
      putnam_1986_b6_matrix_eq
        (putnam_1986_b6_matrix_mul
          field A (putnam_1986_b6_transpose B))
        (putnam_1986_b6_transpose
          (putnam_1986_b6_matrix_mul
            field A (putnam_1986_b6_transpose B))))
    (hsymm_CD :
      putnam_1986_b6_matrix_eq
        (putnam_1986_b6_matrix_mul
          field C (putnam_1986_b6_transpose D))
        (putnam_1986_b6_transpose
          (putnam_1986_b6_matrix_mul
            field C (putnam_1986_b6_transpose D))))
    (hid :
      putnam_1986_b6_matrix_eq
        (putnam_1986_b6_matrix_sub field
          (putnam_1986_b6_matrix_mul
            field A (putnam_1986_b6_transpose D))
          (putnam_1986_b6_matrix_mul
            field B (putnam_1986_b6_transpose C)))
        (putnam_1986_b6_identity field)) :
  putnam_1986_b6_matrix_eq
    (putnam_1986_b6_matrix_sub field
      (putnam_1986_b6_matrix_mul
        field (putnam_1986_b6_transpose A) D)
      (putnam_1986_b6_matrix_mul
        field (putnam_1986_b6_transpose C) B))
    (putnam_1986_b6_identity field).
Admitted.

title: putnam_1986_b6
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench artifact putnam_1986_b6:
  a matrix identity over an arbitrary field under symmetry hypotheses for
  two products involving transposes. This file contains no proof.
*)

let statement =
  `let field_axioms =
     \(zero_F:A) (one_F:A) (add_F:A->A->A) (mul_F:A->A->A)
      (neg_F:A->A) (inv_F:A->A).
       ~(zero_F = one_F) /\
       (!x y:A. add_F x y = add_F y x) /\
       (!x y z:A. add_F (add_F x y) z = add_F x (add_F y z)) /\
       (!x:A. add_F x zero_F = x) /\
       (!x:A. add_F (neg_F x) x = zero_F) /\
       (!x y:A. mul_F x y = mul_F y x) /\
       (!x y z:A. mul_F (mul_F x y) z = mul_F x (mul_F y z)) /\
       (!x:A. mul_F one_F x = x) /\
       (!x:A. ~(x = zero_F) ==> mul_F (inv_F x) x = one_F) /\
       (!x y z:A.
          mul_F x (add_F y z) =
          add_F (mul_F x y) (mul_F x z)) in
   let matrix_mul =
     \(zero_F:A) (add_F:A->A->A) (mul_F:A->A->A)
      (M:I->I->A) (N:I->I->A).
       \i j:I.
         ITSET
           (\k:I. \acc:A. add_F (mul_F (M i k) (N k j)) acc)
           (UNIV:I->bool) zero_F in
   let matrix_transpose =
     \(M:I->I->A). \i j:I. M j i in
   let matrix_sub =
     \(add_F:A->A->A) (neg_F:A->A)
      (M:I->I->A) (N:I->I->A).
       \i j:I. add_F (M i j) (neg_F (N i j)) in
   let identity_matrix =
     \(zero_F:A) (one_F:A). \i j:I. if i = j then one_F else zero_F in
   !n:num (zero_F:A) (one_F:A)
    (add_F:A->A->A) (mul_F:A->A->A)
    (neg_F:A->A) (inv_F:A->A)
    (A:I->I->A) (B:I->I->A) (C:I->I->A) (D:I->I->A).
     field_axioms zero_F one_F add_F mul_F neg_F inv_F /\
     FINITE (UNIV:I->bool) /\
     CARD (UNIV:I->bool) = n /\
     0 < n /\
     matrix_mul zero_F add_F mul_F A (matrix_transpose B) =
       matrix_transpose
         (matrix_mul zero_F add_F mul_F A (matrix_transpose B)) /\
     matrix_mul zero_F add_F mul_F C (matrix_transpose D) =
       matrix_transpose
         (matrix_mul zero_F add_F mul_F C (matrix_transpose D)) /\
     matrix_sub add_F neg_F
       (matrix_mul zero_F add_F mul_F A (matrix_transpose D))
       (matrix_mul zero_F add_F mul_F B (matrix_transpose C)) =
       identity_matrix zero_F one_F
     ==>
     matrix_sub add_F neg_F
       (matrix_mul zero_F add_F mul_F (matrix_transpose A) D)
       (matrix_mul zero_F add_F mul_F (matrix_transpose C) B) =
       identity_matrix zero_F one_F`;;

title: putnam_1986_b6
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1986_b6:
;; for square matrices A, B, C, and D over an arbitrary field, symmetry of
;; A*B^T and C*D^T together with A*D^T-B*C^T=I implies
;; A^T*D-C^T*B=I. This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))

;; These conservative generic symbols represent an arbitrary field and four
;; arbitrary matrix-entry functions. No APPLY$ executability restriction is
;; imposed on the field operations or matrices.

(defstub putnam-1986-b6-carrier (x) t)
(defstub putnam-1986-b6-add (x y) t)
(defstub putnam-1986-b6-multiply (x y) t)
(defstub putnam-1986-b6-negate (x) t)
(defstub putnam-1986-b6-inverse (x) t)
(defstub putnam-1986-b6-a (i j) t)
(defstub putnam-1986-b6-b (i j) t)
(defstub putnam-1986-b6-c (i j) t)
(defstub putnam-1986-b6-d (i j) t)

(defun putnam-1986-b6-member-p (x)
  (if (putnam-1986-b6-carrier x) t nil))

(defun-sk putnam-1986-b6-field-laws-p (zero one)
  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (putnam-1986-b6-member-p x)
      (putnam-1986-b6-member-p y)
      (putnam-1986-b6-member-p z))
     (and
      (putnam-1986-b6-member-p
       (putnam-1986-b6-add x y))
      (putnam-1986-b6-member-p
       (putnam-1986-b6-multiply x y))
      (putnam-1986-b6-member-p
       (putnam-1986-b6-negate x))
      (putnam-1986-b6-member-p
       (putnam-1986-b6-inverse x))
      (equal
       (putnam-1986-b6-add
        (putnam-1986-b6-add x y)
        z)
       (putnam-1986-b6-add
        x
        (putnam-1986-b6-add y z)))
      (equal
       (putnam-1986-b6-multiply
        (putnam-1986-b6-multiply x y)
        z)
       (putnam-1986-b6-multiply
        x
        (putnam-1986-b6-multiply y z)))
      (equal
       (putnam-1986-b6-add x y)
       (putnam-1986-b6-add y x))
      (equal
       (putnam-1986-b6-multiply x y)
       (putnam-1986-b6-multiply y x))
      (equal
       (putnam-1986-b6-add x zero)
       x)
      (equal
       (putnam-1986-b6-add
        x
        (putnam-1986-b6-negate x))
       zero)
      (equal
       (putnam-1986-b6-multiply x one)
       x)
      (implies
       (equal x zero)
       (equal
        (putnam-1986-b6-inverse x)
        zero))
      (implies
       (not (equal x zero))
       (equal
        (putnam-1986-b6-multiply
         x
         (putnam-1986-b6-inverse x))
        one))
      (equal
       (putnam-1986-b6-multiply
        x
        (putnam-1986-b6-add y z))
       (putnam-1986-b6-add
        (putnam-1986-b6-multiply x y)
        (putnam-1986-b6-multiply x z)))))))

(defun-sk putnam-1986-b6-matrix-entries-p (n)
  (forall (i j)
    (implies
     (and (natp i) (< i n)
          (natp j) (< j n))
     (and
      (putnam-1986-b6-member-p
       (putnam-1986-b6-a i j))
      (putnam-1986-b6-member-p
       (putnam-1986-b6-b i j))
      (putnam-1986-b6-member-p
       (putnam-1986-b6-c i j))
      (putnam-1986-b6-member-p

title: putnam_1986_b6
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1986_b6:
-- a square-matrix identity over an arbitrary field, assuming two products are
-- symmetric and a related difference is the identity. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

open import Agda.Primitive using (Level; lsuc)
open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc)

infix 4 _!=_

data Bottom : Set where

Not :
  {a : Level} ->
  Set a ->
  Set a
Not A =
  A -> Bottom

_!=_ :
  {a : Level} {A : Set a} ->
  A ->
  A ->
  Set a
x != y =
  Not (x == y)

data Positive : Nat -> Set where
  positive : {n : Nat} -> Positive (suc n)

data Fin : Nat -> Set where
  fzero : {n : Nat} -> Fin (suc n)
  fsuc  : {n : Nat} -> Fin n -> Fin (suc n)

record Field
  {a : Level}
  (F : Set a) :
  Set a where

  field
    zeroF oneF : F
    add multiply : F -> F -> F
    negate inverse : F -> F

    zero-not-one :
      zeroF != oneF

    add-commutative :
      (x y : F) ->
      add x y == add y x
    add-associative :
      (x y z : F) ->
      add (add x y) z == add x (add y z)
    add-zero :
      (x : F) ->
      add x zeroF == x
    add-inverse :
      (x : F) ->
      add x (negate x) == zeroF

    multiply-commutative :
      (x y : F) ->
      multiply x y == multiply y x
    multiply-associative :
      (x y z : F) ->
      multiply (multiply x y) z == multiply x (multiply y z)
    multiply-one :
      (x : F) ->
      multiply x oneF == x
    distribute :
      (x y z : F) ->
      multiply x (add y z) ==
      add (multiply x y) (multiply x z)
    multiply-inverse :
      (x : F) ->
      x != zeroF ->
      multiply x (inverse x) == oneF

open Field

Matrix :
  {a : Level} ->
  Set a ->
  Nat ->
  Set a
Matrix F n =
  Fin n -> Fin n -> F

MatrixEqual :
  {a : Level} {F : Set a} {n : Nat} ->
  Matrix F n ->
  Matrix F n ->
  Set a
MatrixEqual {n = n} A B =
  (i j : Fin n) ->
  A i j == B i j

sumFin :
  {a : Level} {F : Set a} ->
  Field F ->
  {n : Nat} ->
  (Fin n -> F) ->
  F
sumFin fieldStructure {zero} term =
  zeroF fieldStructure
sumFin fieldStructure {suc n} term =
  add fieldStructure
    (term fzero)
    (sumFin fieldStructure (\ i -> term (fsuc i)))

transpose :
  {a : Level} {F : Set a} {n : Nat} ->
  Matrix F n ->
  Matrix F n
transpose A i j =
  A j i

matrixMultiply :
  {a : Level} {F : Set a} {n : Nat} ->
  Field F ->
  Matrix F n ->
  Matrix F n ->
  Matrix F n
matrixMultiply fieldStructure A B i j =
  sumFin fieldStructure
    (\ k -> multiply fieldStructure (A i k) (B k j))

matrixSubtract :
  {a : Level} {F : Set a} {n : Nat} ->
  Field F ->
  Matrix F n ->
  Matrix F n ->
  Matrix F n
matrixSubtract fieldStructure A B i j =
  add fieldStructure
    (A i j)
    (negate fieldStructure (B i j))

identityMatrix :
  {a : Level} {F : Set a} {n : Nat} ->
  Field F ->
  Matrix F n
identityMatrix fieldStructure fzero fzero =
  oneF fieldStructure
identityMatrix fieldStructure fzero (fsuc j) =
  zeroF fieldStructure
identityMatrix fieldStructure (fsuc i) fzero =
  zeroF fieldStructure
identityMatrix fieldStructure (fsuc i) (fsuc j) =
  identityMatrix fieldStructure i j

Symmetric :
  {a : Level} {F : Set a} {n : Nat} ->
  Matrix F n ->
  Set a
Symmetric A =
  MatrixEqual A (transpose A)

putnam-1986-b6 :
  {a : Level} ->
  Set (lsuc a)
putnam-1986-b6 {a} =
  (n : Nat) ->
  Positive n ->
  (F : Set a) ->
  (fieldStructure : Field F) ->
  (A B C D : Matrix F n) ->
  Symmetric
    (matrixMultiply fieldStructure A (transpose B)) ->
  Symmetric
    (matrixMultiply fieldStructure C (transpose D)) ->
  MatrixEqual
    (matrixSubtract fieldStructure
      (matrixMultiply fieldStructure A (transpose D))
      (matrixMultiply fieldStructure B (transpose C)))
    (identityMatrix fieldStructure) ->
  MatrixEqual
    (matrixSubtract fieldStructure
      (matrixMultiply fieldStructure (transpose A) D)
      (matrixMultiply fieldStructure (transpose C) B))
    (identityMatrix fieldStructure)

(*
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1986_b6:
  a transpose identity for square matrices over an arbitrary field, assuming
  two matrix products are symmetric and a mixed-product difference is the
  identity matrix. This file contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open arithmeticTheory pred_setTheory;

val putnam_1986_b6 =
  ``!(n : num) (zeroR oneR : 'a)
      (addR mulR : 'a -> 'a -> 'a)
      (negR invR : 'a -> 'a)
      (A B C D : 'i -> 'i -> 'a).
      let field_axioms =
        zeroR <> oneR /\
        (!x. addR zeroR x = x) /\
        (!x. addR (negR x) x = zeroR) /\
        (!x y. addR x y = addR y x) /\
        (!x y z. addR (addR x y) z = addR x (addR y z)) /\
        (!x. mulR oneR x = x) /\
        (!x y. mulR x y = mulR y x) /\
        (!x y z. mulR (mulR x y) z = mulR x (mulR y z)) /\
        (!x y z.
           mulR x (addR y z) = addR (mulR x y) (mulR x z)) /\
        (!x. x <> zeroR ==> mulR (invR x) x = oneR)
      in
      let matrix_transpose =
        \M : 'i -> 'i -> 'a. \i j. M j i
      in
      let matrix_mul =
        \M N : 'i -> 'i -> 'a. \i j.
          ITSET
            (\k acc. addR (mulR (M i k) (N k j)) acc)
            (UNIV : 'i set) zeroR
      in
      let matrix_sub =
        \M N : 'i -> 'i -> 'a. \i j.
          addR (M i j) (negR (N i j))
      in
      let matrix_one =
        \i : 'i. \j : 'i. if i = j then oneR else zeroR
      in
        field_axioms /\
        FINITE (UNIV : 'i set) /\
        0 < n /\
        CARD (UNIV : 'i set) = n /\
        matrix_mul A (matrix_transpose B) =
          matrix_transpose (matrix_mul A (matrix_transpose B)) /\
        matrix_mul C (matrix_transpose D) =
          matrix_transpose (matrix_mul C (matrix_transpose D)) /\
        matrix_sub
          (matrix_mul A (matrix_transpose D))
          (matrix_mul B (matrix_transpose C)) =
          matrix_one
        ==>
        matrix_sub
          (matrix_mul (matrix_transpose A) D)
          (matrix_mul (matrix_transpose C) B) =
          matrix_one``;

$(
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact
  putnam_1986_b6: four square matrices over an arbitrary field satisfying
  two symmetry conditions and a block inverse identity satisfy the
  corresponding transposed identity. This file contains no proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  The positive natural n has index carrier 0 ..^ n. For every SetMM field
  structure F, Base ` ( ( 0 ..^ n ) Mat F ) is exactly the set of square
  matrices on that carrier with entries in Base ` F. The operation .r of
  this matrix ring is matrix multiplication, tpos is matrix transpose, -g
  is matrix subtraction, and 1r is the identity matrix.

  Thus the two first conjuncts state that A times transpose B and C times
  transpose D are symmetric. The third conjunct and the conclusion are the
  source matrix identities. The final declaration is the single unproved
  $a corpus statement; this database contains no $p proof statement.
$)

${
  $d A B C D F n $.

  putnambench-putnam-1986-b6 $a |-
    A. n e. NN
      A. F
        A. A e. ( Base ` ( ( 0 ..^ n ) Mat F ) )
          A. B e. ( Base ` ( ( 0 ..^ n ) Mat F ) )
            A. C e. ( Base ` ( ( 0 ..^ n ) Mat F ) )
              A. D e. ( Base ` ( ( 0 ..^ n ) Mat F ) )
                (
                  F e. Field
                  ->
                  (
                    (
                      (
                        (
                          A
                          ( .r ` ( ( 0 ..^ n ) Mat F ) )
                          tpos B
                        )
                        =
                        tpos
                        (
                          A
                          ( .r ` ( ( 0 ..^ n ) Mat F ) )
                          tpos B
                        )
                      )
                      /\
                      (
                        (
                          C
                          ( .r ` ( ( 0 ..^ n ) Mat F ) )
                          tpos D
                        )
                        =
                        tpos
                        (
                          C
                          ( .r ` ( ( 0 ..^ n ) Mat F ) )
                          tpos D
                        )
                      )
                    )
                    /\
                    (
                      (
                        A
                        ( .r ` ( ( 0 ..^ n ) Mat F ) )
                        tpos D
                      )
                      ( -g ` ( ( 0 ..^ n ) Mat F ) )
                      (
                        B
                        ( .r ` ( ( 0 ..^ n ) Mat F ) )
                        tpos C
                      )
                    )
                    =
                    ( 1r ` ( ( 0 ..^ n ) Mat F ) )
                  )
                  ->
                  (
                    (
                      tpos A
                      ( .r ` ( ( 0 ..^ n ) Mat F ) )
                      D
                    )
                    ( -g ` ( ( 0 ..^ n ) Mat F ) )
                    (
                      tpos C
                      ( .r ` ( ( 0 ..^ n ) Mat F ) )
                      B
                    )
                  )
                  =
                  ( 1r ` ( ( 0 ..^ n ) Mat F ) )
                )
  $.
$}

title: putnam_1986_b6
content:
% Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1986_b6:
% an identity for four square matrices over an arbitrary field, assuming two
% matrix products are symmetric and a mixed-product difference is the identity.
% This file contains no proof.

putnam_1986_b6[
  n: posnat,
  FieldElement: TYPE+,
  zero_F, one_F: FieldElement,
  add_F, multiply_F:
    [FieldElement, FieldElement -> FieldElement],
  negate_F, inverse_F: [FieldElement -> FieldElement]
]: THEORY
BEGIN
  index: TYPE = below(n)
  matrix: TYPE = [index, index -> FieldElement]

  field_axioms: bool =
    zero_F /= one_F
      AND (FORALL (x, y: FieldElement):
        add_F(x, y) = add_F(y, x))
      AND (FORALL (x, y, z: FieldElement):
        add_F(add_F(x, y), z) = add_F(x, add_F(y, z)))
      AND (FORALL (x: FieldElement):
        add_F(x, zero_F) = x)
      AND (FORALL (x: FieldElement):
        add_F(x, negate_F(x)) = zero_F)
      AND (FORALL (x, y: FieldElement):
        multiply_F(x, y) = multiply_F(y, x))
      AND (FORALL (x, y, z: FieldElement):
        multiply_F(multiply_F(x, y), z)
          = multiply_F(x, multiply_F(y, z)))
      AND (FORALL (x: FieldElement):
        multiply_F(x, one_F) = x)
      AND (FORALL (x, y, z: FieldElement):
        multiply_F(x, add_F(y, z))
          = add_F(multiply_F(x, y), multiply_F(x, z)))
      AND (FORALL (x: FieldElement):
        x /= zero_F IMPLIES
          multiply_F(x, inverse_F(x)) = one_F)

  bounded_field_sum(
      values: [index -> FieldElement],
      count: nat): RECURSIVE FieldElement =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      zero_F
    ELSE
      add_F(
        bounded_field_sum(values, count - 1),
        IF count <= n THEN
          values(count - 1)
        ELSE
          zero_F
        ENDIF)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  matrix_transpose(A: matrix): matrix =
    LAMBDA (row, column: index):
      A(column, row)

  matrix_multiply(A, B: matrix): matrix =
    LAMBDA (row, column: index):
      bounded_field_sum(
        LAMBDA (inner: index):
          multiply_F(A(row, inner), B(inner, column)),
        n)

  matrix_subtract(A, B: matrix): matrix =
    LAMBDA (row, column: index):
      add_F(A(row, column), negate_F(B(row, column)))

  identity_matrix: matrix =
    LAMBDA (row, column: index):
      IF row = column THEN one_F ELSE zero_F ENDIF

  symmetric(A: matrix): bool =
    A = matrix_transpose(A)

  putnam_1986_b6: bool =
    field_axioms IMPLIES
      (FORALL (A, B, C, D: matrix):
        (symmetric(
           matrix_multiply(A, matrix_transpose(B)))
          AND symmetric(
            matrix_multiply(C, matrix_transpose(D)))
          AND matrix_subtract(
            matrix_multiply(A, matrix_transpose(D)),
            matrix_multiply(B, matrix_transpose(C)))
              = identity_matrix)
        IMPLIES
          matrix_subtract(
            matrix_multiply(matrix_transpose(A), D),
            matrix_multiply(matrix_transpose(C), B))
              = identity_matrix)
END putnam_1986_b6

import Mathlib

/--
Curves $A$, $B$, $C$, and $D$ are defined in the plane as follows:
\begin{align*}
A&=\left\{ (x,y):x^2-y^2=\frac{x}{x^2+y^2} \right\}, \\
B&=\left\{ (x,y):2xy+\frac{y}{x^2+y^2}=3 \right\}, \\
C&=\left\{ (x,y):x^3-3xy^2+3y=1 \right\}, \\
D&=\left\{ (x,y):3x^2y-3x-y^3=0 \right\}.
\end{align*}
Prove that $A \cap B=C \cap D$.
-/
theorem putnam_1987_a1
(A B C D : Set (ℝ × ℝ))
(hA : A = {(x, y) : ℝ × ℝ | x ^ 2 + y ^ 2 ≠ 0 ∧ x ^ 2 - y ^ 2 = x / (x ^ 2 + y ^ 2)})
(hB : B = {(x, y) : ℝ × ℝ | x ^ 2 + y ^ 2 ≠ 0 ∧ 2 * x * y + y / (x ^ 2 + y ^ 2) = 3})
(hC : C = {(x, y) : ℝ × ℝ | x ^ 3 - 3 * x * y ^ 2 + 3 * y = 1})
(hD : D = {(x, y) : ℝ × ℝ | 3 * x ^ 2 * y - 3 * x - y ^ 3 = 0})
: A ∩ B = C ∩ D := sorry

(* Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench artifact putnam_1987_a1:
   equality of the intersections of four real plane curves defined by
   polynomial and reciprocal equations. This file contains no proof. *)

From Stdlib Require Import Reals Ensembles.

Open Scope R_scope.

Definition putnam_1987_a1_point : Type := (R * R)%type.

Theorem putnam_1987_a1
    (A B C D : Ensemble putnam_1987_a1_point)
    (hA :
      Same_set putnam_1987_a1_point A
        (fun p : putnam_1987_a1_point =>
          fst p ^ 2 + snd p ^ 2 <> 0 /\
          fst p ^ 2 - snd p ^ 2 =
            fst p / (fst p ^ 2 + snd p ^ 2)))
    (hB :
      Same_set putnam_1987_a1_point B
        (fun p : putnam_1987_a1_point =>
          fst p ^ 2 + snd p ^ 2 <> 0 /\
          2 * fst p * snd p +
            snd p / (fst p ^ 2 + snd p ^ 2) = 3))
    (hC :
      Same_set putnam_1987_a1_point C
        (fun p : putnam_1987_a1_point =>
          fst p ^ 3 - 3 * fst p * snd p ^ 2 + 3 * snd p = 1))
    (hD :
      Same_set putnam_1987_a1_point D
        (fun p : putnam_1987_a1_point =>
          3 * fst p ^ 2 * snd p - 3 * fst p - snd p ^ 3 = 0)) :
  Same_set putnam_1987_a1_point
    (Intersection putnam_1987_a1_point A B)
    (Intersection putnam_1987_a1_point C D).
Admitted.

(*

  equality of the intersection of two rational plane curves with the
  intersection of two cubic plane curves. This file contains no proof.
*)

let statement =
  `!A B C D:(real#real)->bool.
     A =
       {p:real#real |
          ~((FST p) pow 2 + (SND p) pow 2 = &0) /\
          (FST p) pow 2 - (SND p) pow 2 =
          FST p / ((FST p) pow 2 + (SND p) pow 2)} /\
     B =
       {p:real#real |
          ~((FST p) pow 2 + (SND p) pow 2 = &0) /\
          &2 * FST p * SND p +
          SND p / ((FST p) pow 2 + (SND p) pow 2) = &3} /\
     C =
       {p:real#real |
          (FST p) pow 3 - &3 * FST p * (SND p) pow 2 +
          &3 * SND p = &1} /\
     D =
       {p:real#real |
          &3 * (FST p) pow 2 * SND p - &3 * FST p -
          (SND p) pow 3 = &0}
     ==> A INTER B = C INTER D`;;

content:
;; Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1987_a1:
;; the intersections of four explicitly defined real plane curves are equal.
;; This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))

;; The scalar interface presents an arbitrary real-closed ordered field.
;; Unlike a fixed algebraic-number encoding, its carrier ranges over every
;; scalar in the field. The final assertion is the literal pointwise
;; equivalence of the two intersections. It contains no root-isolation or
;; decision-procedure claims.

(defstub putnam-1987-a1-real-p (real-type value) t)
(defstub putnam-1987-a1-zero (real-type) t)
(defstub putnam-1987-a1-one (real-type) t)
(defstub putnam-1987-a1-add (real-type left right) t)
(defstub putnam-1987-a1-mul (real-type left right) t)
(defstub putnam-1987-a1-neg (real-type value) t)
(defstub putnam-1987-a1-inv (real-type value) t)
(defstub putnam-1987-a1-less (real-type left right) t)

(defun putnam-1987-a1-leq (real-type left right)
  (not (putnam-1987-a1-less real-type right left)))

(defun putnam-1987-a1-sub (real-type left right)
  (putnam-1987-a1-add
   real-type left (putnam-1987-a1-neg real-type right)))

(defun putnam-1987-a1-div (real-type numerator denominator)
  (putnam-1987-a1-mul
   real-type numerator (putnam-1987-a1-inv real-type denominator)))

(defun-sk putnam-1987-a1-field-laws-p (real-type)
  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (putnam-1987-a1-real-p real-type x)
      (putnam-1987-a1-real-p real-type y)
      (putnam-1987-a1-real-p real-type z))
     (let* ((zero (putnam-1987-a1-zero real-type))
            (one (putnam-1987-a1-one real-type))
            (x-plus-y (putnam-1987-a1-add real-type x y))
            (y-plus-z (putnam-1987-a1-add real-type y z))
            (x-times-y (putnam-1987-a1-mul real-type x y))
            (y-times-z (putnam-1987-a1-mul real-type y z))
            (minus-x (putnam-1987-a1-neg real-type x))
            (inverse-x (putnam-1987-a1-inv real-type x)))
       (and
        (putnam-1987-a1-real-p real-type x-plus-y)
        (putnam-1987-a1-real-p real-type x-times-y)
        (putnam-1987-a1-real-p real-type minus-x)
        (putnam-1987-a1-real-p real-type inverse-x)
        (equal
         (putnam-1987-a1-add real-type x-plus-y z)
         (putnam-1987-a1-add real-type x y-plus-z))
        (equal x-plus-y (putnam-1987-a1-add real-type y x))
        (equal (putnam-1987-a1-add real-type x zero) x)
        (equal (putnam-1987-a1-add real-type x minus-x) zero)
        (equal
         (putnam-1987-a1-mul real-type x-times-y z)
         (putnam-1987-a1-mul real-type x y-times-z))
        (equal x-times-y (putnam-1987-a1-mul real-type y x))
        (equal (putnam-1987-a1-mul real-type x one) x)
        (implies
         (equal x zero)
         (equal inverse-x zero))
        (implies
         (not (equal x zero))
         (equal
          (putnam-1987-a1-mul real-type x inverse-x)
          one))
        (equal
         (putnam-1987-a1-mul real-type x y-plus-z)
         (putnam-1987-a1-add
          real-type
          (putnam-1987-a1-mul real-type x y)
          (putnam-1987-a1-mul real-type x z))))))))

(defun-sk putnam-1987-a1-order-laws-p (real-type)
  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (putnam-1987-a1-real-p real-type x)
      (putnam-1987-a1-real-p real-type y)
      (putnam-1987-a1-real-p real-type z))
     (let ((zero (putnam-1987-a1-zero real-type)))
       (and
        (not (putnam-1987-a1-less real-type x x))
        (or
         (putnam-1987-a1-less real-type x y)
         (equal x y)
         (putnam-1987-a1-less real-type y x))
        (implies
         (and
          (putnam-1987-a1-less real-type x y)
          (putnam-1987-a1-less real-type y z))
         (putnam-1987-a1-less real-type x z))
        (implies
         (putnam-1987-a1-less real-type x y)
         (putnam-1987-a1-less
          real-type
          (putnam-1987-a1-add real-type x z)
          (putnam-1987-a1-add real-type y z)))
        (implies
         (and
          (putnam-1987-a1-less real-type zero x)
          (putnam-1987-a1-less real-type zero y))
         (putnam-1987-a1-less
          real-type
          zero
          (putnam-1987-a1-mul real-type x y))))))))

(defun putnam-1987-a1-real-list-p (real-type values)
  (if (consp values)
      (and
       (putnam-1987-a1-real-p real-type (car values))
       (putnam-1987-a1-real-list-p real-type (cdr values)))
    (equal values nil)))

(defun putnam-1987-a1-polynomial-value
    (real-type coefficients x)
  (if (consp coefficients)
      (putnam-1987-a1-add
       real-type
       (car coefficients)
       (putnam-1987-a1-mul
        real-type
        x
        (putnam-1987-a1-polynomial-value
         real-type (cdr coefficients) x)))
    (putnam-1987-a1-zero real-type)))

(defun-sk putnam-1987-a1-square-root-exists-p
    (real-type x)
  (exists (root)
    (and
     (putnam-1987-a1-real-p real-type root)
     (putnam-1987-a1-leq
      real-type (putnam-1987-a1-zero real-type) root)
     (equal
      (putnam-1987-a1-mul real-type root root)
      x))))

(defun-sk putnam-1987-a1-square-root-property-p
    (real-type)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (and
      (putnam-1987-a1-real-p real-type x)
      (putnam-1987-a1-leq
       real-type (putnam-1987-a1-zero real-type) x))
     (putnam-1987-a1-square-root-exists-p
      real-type x))))

(defun putnam-1987-a1-odd-degree-polynomial-p
    (real-type coefficients)
  (and
   (true-listp coefficients)
   (<= 2 (len coefficients))
   (evenp (len coefficients))
   (putnam-1987-a1-real-list-p real-type coefficients)
   (not
    (equal
     (car (last coefficients))
     (putnam-1987-a1-zero real-type)))))

(defun-sk putnam-1987-a1-polynomial-root-exists-p
    (real-type coefficients)
  (exists (root)
    (and
     (putnam-1987-a1-real-p real-type root)
     (equal
      (putnam-1987-a1-polynomial-value
       real-type coefficients root)
      (putnam-1987-a1-zero real-type)))))

(defun-sk putnam-1987-a1-odd-degree-root-property-p
    (real-type)
  (forall (coefficients)
    (implies
     (putnam-1987-a1-odd-degree-polynomial-p
      real-type coefficients)
     (putnam-1987-a1-polynomial-root-exists-p
      real-type coefficients))))

(defun putnam-1987-a1-real-closed-field-p (real-type)
  (let ((zero (putnam-1987-a1-zero real-type))
        (one (putnam-1987-a1-one real-type)))
    (and
     (putnam-1987-a1-real-p real-type zero)
     (putnam-1987-a1-real-p real-type one)
     (not (equal zero one))
     (putnam-1987-a1-field-laws-p real-type)
     (putnam-1987-a1-order-laws-p real-type)
     (putnam-1987-a1-less real-type zero one)
     (putnam-1987-a1-square-root-property-p real-type)
     (putnam-1987-a1-odd-degree-root-property-p real-type))))

(defun putnam-1987-a1-natural (real-type n)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix n)))
  (if (zp n)
      (putnam-1987-a1-zero real-type)
    (putnam-1987-a1-add
     real-type
     (putnam-1987-a1-one real-type)
     (putnam-1987-a1-natural real-type (- n 1)))))

(defun putnam-1987-a1-square (real-type x)
  (putnam-1987-a1-mul real-type x x))

(defun putnam-1987-a1-cube (real-type x)
  (putnam-1987-a1-mul
   real-type x (putnam-1987-a1-square real-type x)))

(defun putnam-1987-a1-radius-squared (real-type x y)
  (putnam-1987-a1-add
   real-type
   (putnam-1987-a1-square real-type x)
   (putnam-1987-a1-square real-type y)))

(defun putnam-1987-a1-in-a-p (real-type x y)
  (let ((radius-squared
         (putnam-1987-a1-radius-squared real-type x y)))
    (and
     (not (equal radius-squared
                 (putnam-1987-a1-zero real-type)))
     (equal
      (putnam-1987-a1-sub
       real-type
       (putnam-1987-a1-square real-type x)
       (putnam-1987-a1-square real-type y))
      (putnam-1987-a1-div real-type x radius-squared)))))

(defun putnam-1987-a1-in-b-p (real-type x y)
  (let ((radius-squared
         (putnam-1987-a1-radius-squared real-type x y))
        (two (putnam-1987-a1-natural real-type 2))
        (three (putnam-1987-a1-natural real-type 3)))
    (and
     (not (equal radius-squared
                 (putnam-1987-a1-zero real-type)))
     (equal
      (putnam-1987-a1-add
       real-type
       (putnam-1987-a1-mul
        real-type
        (putnam-1987-a1-mul real-type two x)
        y)
       (putnam-1987-a1-div real-type y radius-squared))
      three))))

(defun putnam-1987-a1-in-c-p (real-type x y)
  (let ((one (putnam-1987-a1-one real-type))
        (three (putnam-1987-a1-natural real-type 3)))
    (equal
     (putnam-1987-a1-add
      real-type
      (putnam-1987-a1-sub
       real-type
       (putnam-1987-a1-cube real-type x)
       (putnam-1987-a1-mul
        real-type
        (putnam-1987-a1-mul real-type three x)
        (putnam-1987-a1-square real-type y)))
      (putnam-1987-a1-mul real-type three y))
     one)))

(defun putnam-1987-a1-in-d-p (real-type x y)
  (let ((zero (putnam-1987-a1-zero real-type))
        (three (putnam-1987-a1-natural real-type 3)))
    (equal
     (putnam-1987-a1-sub
      real-type
      (putnam-1987-a1-sub
       real-type
       (putnam-1987-a1-mul
        real-type
        (putnam-1987-a1-mul
         real-type
         three
         (putnam-1987-a1-square real-type x))
        y)
       (putnam-1987-a1-mul real-type three x))
      (putnam-1987-a1-cube real-type y))
     zero)))

(defun putnambench-putnam-1987-a1-statement (real-type x y)
  (implies
   (and
    (putnam-1987-a1-real-closed-field-p real-type)
    (putnam-1987-a1-real-p real-type x)
    (putnam-1987-a1-real-p real-type y))
   (equal
    (and
     (putnam-1987-a1-in-a-p real-type x y)
     (putnam-1987-a1-in-b-p real-type x y))
    (and
     (putnam-1987-a1-in-c-p real-type x y)
     (putnam-1987-a1-in-d-p real-type x y)))))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

content:
-- Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1987_a1:
-- the intersection of the rationally defined real plane curves A and B equals
-- the intersection of the cubic curves C and D. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; _*_)

infix 4 _!=_
infixr 3 _and_
infixr 2 _or_
infix 1 _iff_

data Bottom : Set where

Not : Set -> Set
Not A =
  A -> Bottom

_!=_ : {A : Set} -> A -> A -> Set
x != y =
  Not (x == y)

record _and_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

record _iff_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor iff
  field
    forward  : A -> B
    backward : B -> A

data _or_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  left  : A -> A or B
  right : B -> A or B

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

record CompleteOrderedRealField (R : Set) : Set1 where
  field
    zeroR oneR : R
    add multiply : R -> R -> R
    negate inverse : R -> R
    lessOrEqual : R -> R -> Set
    fromNat : Nat -> R

    one-not-zero :
      oneR != zeroR

    add-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> add x y == add y x
    add-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      add (add x y) z == add x (add y z)
    add-zero :
      (x : R) -> add x zeroR == x
    add-inverse :
      (x : R) -> add x (negate x) == zeroR

    multiply-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> multiply x y == multiply y x
    multiply-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply (multiply x y) z ==
      multiply x (multiply y z)
    multiply-one :
      (x : R) -> multiply x oneR == x
    multiply-zero :
      (x : R) -> multiply x zeroR == zeroR
    distribute :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply x (add y z) ==
      add (multiply x y) (multiply x z)
    inverse-zero :
      inverse zeroR == zeroR
    multiply-inverse :
      (x : R) ->
      x != zeroR ->
      multiply x (inverse x) == oneR

    order-reflexive :
      (x : R) -> lessOrEqual x x
    order-transitive :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y z ->
      lessOrEqual x z
    order-antisymmetric :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y x ->
      x == y
    order-total :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y or lessOrEqual y x
    add-order :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual (add z x) (add z y)
    multiply-nonnegative :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR x ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR y ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR (multiply x y)
    zero-less-than-one :
      lessOrEqual zeroR oneR and zeroR != oneR

    fromNat-zero :
      fromNat zero == zeroR
    fromNat-successor :
      (n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (suc n) == add (fromNat n) oneR
    fromNat-addition :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m + n) == add (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-multiplication :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m * n) == multiply (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-injective :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat m == fromNat n ->
      m == n

    archimedean :
      (x : R) ->
      Exists Nat (\ n -> lessOrEqual x (fromNat n))
    least-upper-bound :
      (P : R -> Set) ->
      Exists R P ->
      Exists R
        (\ upper ->
          (x : R) ->
          P x ->
          lessOrEqual x upper) ->
      Exists R
        (\ supremum ->
          ((x : R) ->
            P x ->
            lessOrEqual x supremum)
          and
          ((upper : R) ->
            ((x : R) ->
              P x ->
              lessOrEqual x upper) ->
            lessOrEqual supremum upper))

open CompleteOrderedRealField

subtract :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
subtract reals x y =
  add reals x (negate reals y)

divide :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
divide reals x y =
  multiply reals x (inverse reals y)

naturalPower :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  Nat ->
  R
naturalPower reals x zero =
  oneR reals
naturalPower reals x (suc n) =
  multiply reals
    (naturalPower reals x n)
    x

PlaneSet : Set -> Set1
PlaneSet R =
  R -> R -> Set

Intersection :
  {R : Set} ->
  PlaneSet R ->
  PlaneSet R ->
  PlaneSet R
Intersection left-set right-set x y =
  left-set x y and right-set x y

SamePlaneSet :
  {R : Set} ->
  PlaneSet R ->
  PlaneSet R ->
  Set
SamePlaneSet {R = R} left-set right-set =
  (x y : R) ->
  _iff_ (left-set x y) (right-set x y)

module Putnam1987A1Statement
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) where

  squareSum : R -> R -> R
  squareSum x y =
    add reals
      (naturalPower reals x 2)
      (naturalPower reals y 2)

  curveA : PlaneSet R
  curveA x y =
    squareSum x y != zeroR reals
    and
    subtract reals
      (naturalPower reals x 2)
      (naturalPower reals y 2)
    ==
    divide reals x (squareSum x y)

  curveB : PlaneSet R
  curveB x y =
    squareSum x y != zeroR reals
    and
    add reals
      (multiply reals
        (multiply reals (fromNat reals 2) x)
        y)
      (divide reals y (squareSum x y))
    ==
    fromNat reals 3

  curveC : PlaneSet R
  curveC x y =
    add reals
      (subtract reals
        (naturalPower reals x 3)
        (multiply reals
          (fromNat reals 3)
          (multiply reals
            x
            (naturalPower reals y 2))))
      (multiply reals (fromNat reals 3) y)
    ==
    oneR reals

  curveD : PlaneSet R
  curveD x y =
    subtract reals
      (subtract reals
        (multiply reals
          (multiply reals
            (fromNat reals 3)
            (naturalPower reals x 2))
          y)
        (multiply reals (fromNat reals 3) x))
      (naturalPower reals y 3)
    ==
    zeroR reals

  proposition : Set
  proposition =
    SamePlaneSet
      (Intersection curveA curveB)
      (Intersection curveC curveD)

putnam-1987-a1 : Set1
putnam-1987-a1 =
  (R : Set) ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) ->
  Putnam1987A1Statement.proposition reals

(*
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1987_a1:
  four plane curves defined by rational and cubic equations have equal
  pairwise intersections. This file contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open arithmeticTheory pairTheory pred_setTheory realTheory;

val putnam_1987_a1 =
  ``!(A B C D : (real # real) set).
      A =
        {p : real # real |
           FST p pow 2 + SND p pow 2 <> 0 /\
           FST p pow 2 - SND p pow 2 =
             FST p / (FST p pow 2 + SND p pow 2)} /\
      B =
        {p : real # real |
           FST p pow 2 + SND p pow 2 <> 0 /\
           2 * FST p * SND p +
             SND p / (FST p pow 2 + SND p pow 2) = 3} /\
      C =
        {p : real # real |
           FST p pow 3 - 3 * FST p * SND p pow 2 + 3 * SND p = 1} /\
      D =
        {p : real # real |
           3 * FST p pow 2 * SND p - 3 * FST p - SND p pow 3 = 0}
      ==>
      A INTER B = C INTER D``;

    D = {[x,y] where x,y is Real :
      3*x*x*y - 3*x - y*y*y = ((1 qua Real) - 1)}
  holds A /\ B = C /\ D

% Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1987_a1:
% the intersection of two rationally defined real plane curves equals the
% intersection of two cubic real plane curves. This file contains no proof.

putnam_1987_a1: THEORY
BEGIN
  point: TYPE = [# x_coord: real, y_coord: real #]
  point_set: TYPE = [point -> bool]

  radial_square(P: point): real =
    x_coord(P) ^ 2 + y_coord(P) ^ 2

  real_quotient(numerator, denominator: real): real =
    IF denominator = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      numerator / denominator
    ENDIF

  curve_a: point_set =
    LAMBDA (P: point):
      radial_square(P) /= 0
        AND x_coord(P) ^ 2 - y_coord(P) ^ 2
          = real_quotient(x_coord(P), radial_square(P))

  curve_b: point_set =
    LAMBDA (P: point):
      radial_square(P) /= 0
        AND 2 * x_coord(P) * y_coord(P)
          + real_quotient(y_coord(P), radial_square(P)) = 3

  curve_c: point_set =
    LAMBDA (P: point):
      x_coord(P) ^ 3
        - 3 * x_coord(P) * y_coord(P) ^ 2
        + 3 * y_coord(P) = 1

  curve_d: point_set =
    LAMBDA (P: point):
      3 * x_coord(P) ^ 2 * y_coord(P)
        - 3 * x_coord(P)
        - y_coord(P) ^ 3 = 0

  set_intersection(left_set, right_set: point_set): point_set =
    LAMBDA (P: point):
      left_set(P) AND right_set(P)

  putnam_1987_a1: bool =
    set_intersection(curve_a, curve_b)
      = set_intersection(curve_c, curve_d)
END putnam_1987_a1

/--
The sequence of digits $123456789101112131415161718192021 \dots$ is obtained by writing the positive integers in order. If the $10^n$-th digit in this sequence occurs in the part of the sequence in which the $m$-digit numbers are placed, define $f(n)$ to be $m$.     (hseqsize : ∀ i ≥ 1, ∀ j : Fin ((Nat.digits 10 i).length), seqsize (seqind i + j) = (Nat.digits 10 i).length)
    (hf : ∀ n : ℕ, f n = seqsize (10 ^ n)) :

From Stdlib Require Import Arith.PeanoNat Lists.List.

Fixpoint putnam_1987_a2_decimal_digits_fuel
    (fuel n : nat) : list nat :=
  match fuel with
  | O => nil
  | S fuel' =>
      if Nat.ltb n 10
      then n :: nil
      else
        Nat.modulo n 10
          :: putnam_1987_a2_decimal_digits_fuel fuel' (Nat.div n 10)
  end.

Definition putnam_1987_a2_num_digits (n : nat) : nat :=
  length (putnam_1987_a2_decimal_digits_fuel (S n) n).

Definition putnam_1987_a2_solution : nat := 1984.

    (seqind seqsize f : nat -> nat)
    (hseqind :
      seqind 1 = 1 /\
      forall i : nat,
        (2 <= i)%nat ->
        seqind i =
          seqind (i - 1) + putnam_1987_a2_num_digits (i - 1))
    (hseqsize :
      forall i : nat,

        forall j : nat,
          (j < putnam_1987_a2_num_digits i)%nat ->
          seqsize (seqind i + j) = putnam_1987_a2_num_digits i)
    (hf :
      forall n : nat,

  f 1987 = putnam_1987_a2_solution.

-- Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1987_a2:
-- in the concatenation of the positive integers, the digit at position
-- 10^1987 lies in the block of 1984-digit integers. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module Putnam1987A2 where

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; _-_; _*_)

infix 4 _<=N_ _<N_
infixr 3 _and_

record _and_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data _<=N_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set where
  zero<=N   : {n : Nat} -> zero <=N n
  suc<=sucN : {m n : Nat} -> m <=N n -> suc m <=N suc n

_<N_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set
m <N n =
  suc m <=N n

one : Nat
one =
  suc zero

two : Nat
two =
  suc one

ten : Nat
ten =
  10

power : Nat -> Nat -> Nat
power base zero =
  one
power base (suc exponent) =
  base * power base exponent

record DecimalDigitCount (n digits : Nat) : Set where
  constructor decimal-digit-count
  field
    exponent   : Nat
    count      : digits == suc exponent
    lower-bound : power ten exponent <=N n
    upper-bound : n <N power ten (suc exponent)

putnam-1987-a2 : Set
putnam-1987-a2 =
  (seqind seqsize f numdigits : Nat -> Nat) ->
  (seqind one == one
   and
   ((i : Nat) ->
     two <=N i ->
     seqind i == seqind (i - one) + numdigits (i - one))) ->
  ((i : Nat) ->
    one <=N i ->
    (j : Nat) ->
    j <N numdigits i ->
    seqsize (seqind i + j) == numdigits i) ->
  ((n : Nat) ->
    f n == seqsize (power ten n)) ->
  ((n : Nat) ->
    one <=N n ->
    DecimalDigitCount n (numdigits n)) ->
  f 1987 == 1984

% Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench artifact putnam_1987_a2:
% the 10^1987-th digit in the concatenation of the positive integers occurs
% within the block of 1984-digit integers. This file contains no proof.

putnam_1987_a2: THEORY
BEGIN
  natural_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> nat]

  decimal_digit_count(number, digits: nat): bool =
    number > 0
      AND digits > 0
      AND 10 ^ (digits - 1) <= number
      AND number < 10 ^ digits

  valid_start_indices(
      seqind, numdigits: natural_sequence): bool =
    seqind(1) = 1
      AND (FORALL (i: nat):
        i >= 2 IMPLIES
          seqind(i) = seqind(i - 1) + numdigits(i - 1))

  valid_block_sizes(
      seqind, seqsize, numdigits: natural_sequence): bool =
    FORALL (i: nat):
      i >= 1 IMPLIES
        (FORALL (j: nat):
          j < numdigits(i) IMPLIES
            seqsize(seqind(i) + j) = numdigits(i))

  valid_f(seqsize, f: natural_sequence): bool =
    FORALL (n: nat):
      f(n) = seqsize(10 ^ n)

  valid_digit_counts(numdigits: natural_sequence): bool =
    FORALL (n: nat):
      n >= 1 IMPLIES decimal_digit_count(n, numdigits(n))

  putnam_1987_a2_solution: nat = 1984

  putnam_1987_a2: bool =
    FORALL
        (seqind, seqsize, f, numdigits: natural_sequence):
      (valid_start_indices(seqind, numdigits)
        AND valid_block_sizes(seqind, seqsize, numdigits)
        AND valid_f(seqsize, f)
        AND valid_digit_counts(numdigits))
      IMPLIES f(1987) = putnam_1987_a2_solution
END putnam_1987_a2
