;; Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1987_a3:
;; classification of two positivity implications for twice-differentiable
;; real solutions of a second-order exponential ODE. This file contains no
;; proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

;; For any source solution f, put f(x)=exp(x)*q(x). Since exp(x) is positive,
;;
;;   f'' - 2*f' + f = exp(x)*q'',
;;   f > 0             iff q > 0,
;;   f' > 0            iff q + q' > 0.
;;
;; Thus the source ODE is equivalent to q''=2. Its twice-differentiable real
;; solutions are exactly q(x)=x^2+a*x+b, and every such polynomial gives a
;; source solution. This is a bidirectional normal-form equivalence, not a
;; restriction to polynomial source functions.

(defun putnam-1987-a3-quadratic (a b x)
  (+ (* x x) (* a x) b))

(defun putnam-1987-a3-quadratic-derivative (a x)
  (+ (* 2 x) a))

(defun putnam-1987-a3-first-derivative-factor (a b x)
  (+ (putnam-1987-a3-quadratic a b x)
     (putnam-1987-a3-quadratic-derivative a x)))

(defun putnam-1987-a3-second-derivative-factor (a b x)
  (+ (putnam-1987-a3-quadratic a b x)
     (* 2 (putnam-1987-a3-quadratic-derivative a x))
     2))

(defun putnam-1987-a3-ode-factor (a b x)
  (+ (putnam-1987-a3-second-derivative-factor a b x)
     (* -2
        (putnam-1987-a3-first-derivative-factor a b x))
     (putnam-1987-a3-quadratic a b x)))

;; The first source implication is false. The internal witness
;; f(x)=exp(x)*(x^2+1) satisfies the ODE and is strictly positive, while
;; f'(-1)=0. The pointwise polynomial identities below express all three
;; facts without exposing the existential function witness as a parameter.
(defun putnam-1987-a3-first-counterexample-at-p (x)
  (and
   (equal (putnam-1987-a3-ode-factor 0 1 x) 2)
   (< 0 (putnam-1987-a3-quadratic 0 1 x))
   (equal
    (putnam-1987-a3-first-derivative-factor 0 1 -1)
    0)))

;; A monic real quadratic x^2+linear*x+constant is positive at every real x
;; exactly when its discriminant is negative.
(defun putnam-1987-a3-positive-monic-quadratic-p
    (linear constant)
  (< (* linear linear)
     (* 4 constant)))

;; For q=x^2+a*x+b, the factor q+q' is
;;
;;   x^2+(a+2)*x+(a+b).
;;
;; Its strict positivity therefore says a^2+4 < 4*b, which directly implies
;; a^2 < 4*b, the strict positivity criterion for q. This is exactly the
;; second source implication in the normal form above.
(defun putnam-1987-a3-second-normal-form-p (a b)
  (implies
   (putnam-1987-a3-positive-monic-quadratic-p
    (+ a 2)
    (+ a b))
   (putnam-1987-a3-positive-monic-quadratic-p
    a b)))

;; ACL2's exact ordered field is rational. The counterexample has rational
;; coefficients, and the second clause is the ordered-field implication
;; a^2+4<4*b => a^2<4*b. Hence its universal rational closure and universal
;; real closure are bidirectionally equivalent; no real counterexample can be
;; lost by this exact algebraic presentation.
(defun putnambench-putnam-1987-a3-statement (a b x)
  (implies
   (and (rationalp a)
        (rationalp b)
        (rationalp x))
   (and
    (putnam-1987-a3-first-counterexample-at-p x)
    (putnam-1987-a3-second-normal-form-p a b))))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

title: putnam_1987_a3
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1987_a3:
-- the two proposed positivity implications for solutions of
-- f'' - 2 f' + f = 2 exp(x) are respectively false and true.
-- This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; _*_)

infix 4 _!=_ _<=N_
infixr 3 _and_
infixr 2 _or_

data Bottom : Set where

record Top : Set where
  constructor trivial

Not : Set -> Set
Not A =
  A -> Bottom

_!=_ : {A : Set} -> A -> A -> Set
x != y =
  Not (x == y)

record _and_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data _or_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  left  : A -> A or B
  right : B -> A or B

record Iff (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor equivalence
  field
    forward  : A -> B
    backward : B -> A

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

data _<=N_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set where
  zero<=   : {n : Nat} -> zero <=N n
  suc<=suc : {m n : Nat} -> m <=N n -> suc m <=N suc n

record CompleteOrderedRealField (R : Set) : Set1 where
  field
    zeroR oneR : R
    add multiply : R -> R -> R
    negate inverse : R -> R
    lessOrEqual : R -> R -> Set
    fromNat : Nat -> R

    one-not-zero :
      oneR != zeroR

    add-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> add x y == add y x
    add-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      add (add x y) z == add x (add y z)
    add-zero :
      (x : R) -> add x zeroR == x
    add-inverse :
      (x : R) -> add x (negate x) == zeroR

    multiply-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> multiply x y == multiply y x
    multiply-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply (multiply x y) z ==
      multiply x (multiply y z)
    multiply-one :
      (x : R) -> multiply x oneR == x
    multiply-zero :
      (x : R) -> multiply x zeroR == zeroR
    distribute :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply x (add y z) ==
      add (multiply x y) (multiply x z)
    inverse-zero :
      inverse zeroR == zeroR
    multiply-inverse :
      (x : R) ->
      x != zeroR ->
      multiply x (inverse x) == oneR

    order-reflexive :
      (x : R) -> lessOrEqual x x
    order-transitive :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y z ->
      lessOrEqual x z
    order-antisymmetric :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y x ->
      x == y
    order-total :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y or lessOrEqual y x
    add-order :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual (add z x) (add z y)
    multiply-nonnegative :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR x ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR y ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR (multiply x y)
    zero-less-than-one :
      lessOrEqual zeroR oneR and zeroR != oneR

    fromNat-zero :
      fromNat zero == zeroR
    fromNat-successor :
      (n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (suc n) == add (fromNat n) oneR
    fromNat-addition :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m + n) == add (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-multiplication :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m * n) == multiply (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-injective :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat m == fromNat n ->
      m == n

    archimedean :
      (x : R) ->
      Exists Nat
        (\ n ->
          lessOrEqual x (fromNat n))
    least-upper-bound :
      (P : R -> Set) ->
      Exists R P ->
      Exists R
        (\ upper ->
          (x : R) ->
          P x ->
          lessOrEqual x upper) ->
      Exists R
        (\ supremum ->
          ((x : R) ->
            P x ->
            lessOrEqual x supremum)
          and
          ((upper : R) ->
            ((x : R) ->
              P x ->
              lessOrEqual x upper) ->
            lessOrEqual supremum upper))

open CompleteOrderedRealField

oneN : Nat
oneN =
  suc zero

twoN : Nat
twoN =
  suc oneN

subtract :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
subtract reals x y =
  add reals x (negate reals y)

divide :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
divide reals x y =
  multiply reals x (inverse reals y)

StrictLess :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
StrictLess reals x y =
  lessOrEqual reals x y and x != y

Positive :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  Set
Positive reals x =
  StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) x

CloseTo :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
CloseTo reals center radius x =
  StrictLess reals
    (subtract reals center radius)
    x
  and
  StrictLess reals
    x
    (add reals center radius)

naturalPower :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  Nat ->
  R
naturalPower reals x zero =
  oneR reals
naturalPower reals x (suc n) =
  multiply reals
    (naturalPower reals x n)
    x

factorial : Nat -> Nat
factorial zero =
  oneN
factorial (suc n) =
  suc n * factorial n

partialSum :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  Nat ->
  R
partialSum reals terms zero =
  zeroR reals
partialSum reals terms (suc n) =
  add reals
    (partialSum reals terms n)
    (terms n)

ConvergesTo :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  R ->
  Set
ConvergesTo {R} reals sequence limit =
  (epsilon : R) ->
  Positive reals epsilon ->
  Exists Nat
    (\ cutoff ->
      (n : Nat) ->
      cutoff <=N n ->
      CloseTo reals limit epsilon (sequence n))

SeriesHasSum :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  R ->
  Set
SeriesHasSum reals terms value =
  ConvergesTo reals
    (partialSum reals terms)
    value

exponentialTerm :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  Nat ->
  R
exponentialTerm reals x n =
  divide reals
    (naturalPower reals x n)
    (fromNat reals (factorial n))

ExponentialValue :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
ExponentialValue reals x value =
  SeriesHasSum reals
    (exponentialTerm reals x)
    value

differenceQuotient :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (R -> R) ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
differenceQuotient reals function point x =
  divide reals
    (subtract reals (function x) (function point))
    (subtract reals x point)

DerivativeAt :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (R -> R) ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
DerivativeAt {R} reals function point derivativeValue =
  (epsilon : R) ->
  Positive reals epsilon ->
  Exists R
    (\ delta ->
      Positive reals delta
      and
      ((x : R) ->
        CloseTo reals point delta x ->
        x != point ->
        CloseTo reals derivativeValue epsilon
          (differenceQuotient reals function point x)))

HasDerivativeAt :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (R -> R) ->
  R ->
  Set
HasDerivativeAt {R} reals function point =
  Exists R
    (\ derivativeValue ->
      DerivativeAt reals function point derivativeValue)

record StandardRealCalculus
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) : Set1 where

  field
    derivative : (R -> R) -> R -> R

    derivative-when-differentiable :
      (function : R -> R) ->
      (point : R) ->
      HasDerivativeAt reals function point ->
      DerivativeAt reals
        function
        point
        (derivative function point)

    derivative-when-not-differentiable :
      (function : R -> R) ->
      (point : R) ->
      Not (HasDerivativeAt reals function point) ->
      derivative function point == zeroR reals

open StandardRealCalculus

record StandardExponential
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) : Set1 where

  field
    exponential : R -> R

    exponential-series :
      (x : R) ->
      ExponentialValue reals x (exponential x)

open StandardExponential

module Putnam1987A3Statement
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R)
  (calculus : StandardRealCalculus reals)
  (analysis : StandardExponential reals) where

  firstDerivative : (R -> R) -> R -> R
  firstDerivative function =
    derivative calculus function

  secondDerivative : (R -> R) -> R -> R
  secondDerivative function =
    derivative calculus (firstDerivative function)

  TwiceDifferentiableAt : (R -> R) -> R -> Set
  TwiceDifferentiableAt function x =
    HasDerivativeAt reals function x
    and
    HasDerivativeAt reals (firstDerivative function) x

  SatisfiesEquationAt : (R -> R) -> R -> Set
  SatisfiesEquationAt function x =
    add reals
      (subtract reals
        (secondDerivative function x)
        (multiply reals
          (fromNat reals twoN)
          (firstDerivative function x)))
      (function x)
    ==
    multiply reals
      (fromNat reals twoN)
      (exponential analysis x)

  PositiveFunctionHypothesis : (R -> R) -> Set
  PositiveFunctionHypothesis function =
    (x : R) ->
    TwiceDifferentiableAt function x
    and
    SatisfiesEquationAt function x
    and
    Positive reals (function x)

  PositiveDerivativeHypothesis : (R -> R) -> Set
  PositiveDerivativeHypothesis function =
    (x : R) ->
    TwiceDifferentiableAt function x
    and
    SatisfiesEquationAt function x
    and
    Positive reals (firstDerivative function x)

  PositiveFunctionsHavePositiveDerivative : Set
  PositiveFunctionsHavePositiveDerivative =
    (function : R -> R) ->
    PositiveFunctionHypothesis function ->
    (x : R) ->
    Positive reals (firstDerivative function x)

  PositiveDerivativesGivePositiveFunction : Set
  PositiveDerivativesGivePositiveFunction =
    (function : R -> R) ->
    PositiveDerivativeHypothesis function ->
    (x : R) ->
    Positive reals (function x)

  proposition : Set
  proposition =
    Iff PositiveFunctionsHavePositiveDerivative Bottom
    and
    Iff PositiveDerivativesGivePositiveFunction Top

putnam-1987-a3 : Set1
putnam-1987-a3 =
  (R : Set) ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) ->
  (calculus : StandardRealCalculus reals) ->
  (analysis : StandardExponential reals) ->
  Putnam1987A3Statement.proposition reals calculus analysis

title: putnam_1987_a3
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench artifact putnam_1987_a3:
  the paired truth-value classification of positivity and monotonicity
  implications for solutions of y'' - 2 y' + y = 2 exp x. This file contains
  no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open realTheory limTheory transcTheory;

(*
  diffn and higher_differentiable are constants from limTheory. In
  particular, diffn is the iterated derivative selected from diffl, and
  higher_differentiable requires the corresponding derivative to exist at
  every order through the requested one.
*)

val putnam_1987_a3 =
  ``(((!f : real -> real.
         (!x : real.
            higher_differentiable 1 f x /\
            higher_differentiable 2 f x /\
            diffn 2 f x - 2 * diffn 1 f x + f x = 2 * exp x /\
            0 < f x)
         ==>
         !x : real. 0 < diffn 1 f x)
      <=> F) /\
     ((!g : real -> real.
         (!x : real.
            higher_differentiable 1 g x /\
            higher_differentiable 2 g x /\
            diffn 2 g x - 2 * diffn 1 g x + g x = 2 * exp x /\
            0 < diffn 1 g x)
         ==>
         !x : real. 0 < g x)
      <=> T))``;

(* Reject accidental parser free variables in this closed statement. *)
val _ =
  if null (free_vars putnam_1987_a3) then ()
  else raise Fail "putnam_1987_a3 contains an unresolved free variable";

content:
$(
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact
  putnam_1987_a3: classification of two positivity implications for globally
  twice-differentiable real solutions of a second-order differential equation,
  with the first implication false and the second true. This file contains no
  proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  RR ^m RR is the class of all total real functions. Membership of each real
  x in the domains of the first two entries of ( RR Dn f ) or ( RR Dn g )
  expresses the two pointwise derivative-existence assumptions. The two
  biconditionals retain the source solution pair ( False , True ) literally
  as SetMM's logical constants F. and T. The final declaration is the single
  unproved $a corpus statement; this database contains no $p declaration.
$)

${
  $d f x $.
  $d g x $.

  putnambench-putnam-1987-a3 $a |- (
    (
      (
        A. f e. ( RR ^m RR )
          (
            (
              A. x e. RR
                (
                  x e. dom ( ( RR Dn f ) ` 1 )
                  /\
                  x e. dom ( ( RR Dn f ) ` 2 )
                  /\
                  (
                    (
                      (
                        ( ( ( RR Dn f ) ` 2 ) ` x )
                        -
                        (
                          2
                          x.
                          ( ( ( RR Dn f ) ` 1 ) ` x )
                        )
                      )
                      +
                      ( f ` x )
                    )
                    =
                    ( 2 x. ( exp ` x ) )
                  )
                  /\
                  0 < ( f ` x )
                )
            )
            ->
            A. x e. RR
              0 < ( ( ( RR Dn f ) ` 1 ) ` x )
          )
      )
      <-> F.
    )
    /\
    (
      (
        A. g e. ( RR ^m RR )
          (
            (
              A. x e. RR
                (
                  x e. dom ( ( RR Dn g ) ` 1 )
                  /\
                  x e. dom ( ( RR Dn g ) ` 2 )
                  /\
                  (
                    (
                      (
                        ( ( ( RR Dn g ) ` 2 ) ` x )
                        -
                        (
                          2
                          x.
                          ( ( ( RR Dn g ) ` 1 ) ` x )
                        )
                      )
                      +
                      ( g ` x )
                    )
                    =
                    ( 2 x. ( exp ` x ) )
                  )
                  /\
                  0 < ( ( ( RR Dn g ) ` 1 ) ` x )
                )
            )
            ->
            A. x e. RR
              0 < ( g ` x )
          )
      )
      <-> T.
    )
  ) $.
$}

title: putnam_1987_a3
content:
% Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1987_a3:
% the truth values of two global implications relating positivity and
% monotonicity for real solutions of y'' - 2*y' + y = 2*exp(x).
% This file contains no proof.

putnam_1987_a3: THEORY
BEGIN
  real_function: TYPE = [real -> real]
  real_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> real]

  safe_div(numerator, denominator: real): real =
    IF denominator = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      numerator / denominator
    ENDIF

  nat_factorial(index: nat): RECURSIVE nat =
    IF index = 0 THEN
      1
    ELSE
      index * nat_factorial(index - 1)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE index

  exponential_partial(x: real, count: nat): RECURSIVE real =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      LET index: nat = count - 1 IN
        exponential_partial(x, count - 1)
          + safe_div(
              x ^ index,
              nat_factorial(index) :: real)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  converges_to(sequence: real_sequence, value: real): bool =
    FORALL (epsilon_value: posreal):
      EXISTS (cutoff: nat):
        FORALL (index: nat):
          cutoff <= index IMPLIES
            abs(sequence(index) - value) < epsilon_value

  real_exponential(x: real): real =
    epsilon(
      LAMBDA (value: real):
        converges_to(
          LAMBDA (count: nat):
            exponential_partial(x, count),
          value))

  has_derivative_at(
      f: real_function,
      derivative, x: real): bool =
    FORALL (epsilon_value: posreal):
      EXISTS (delta: posreal):
        FORALL (h: real):
          (NOT (h = 0) AND abs(h) < delta)
            IMPLIES
              abs(
                f(x + h) - f(x)
                  - derivative * h)
                < epsilon_value * abs(h)

  differentiable_at(f: real_function, x: real): bool =
    EXISTS (derivative: real):
      has_derivative_at(f, derivative, x)

  derivative_value(f: real_function, x: real): real =
    IF differentiable_at(f, x) THEN
      epsilon(
        LAMBDA (derivative: real):
          has_derivative_at(f, derivative, x))
    ELSE
      0
    ENDIF

  derivative_function(f: real_function): real_function =
    LAMBDA (x: real): derivative_value(f, x)

  twice_differentiable_at(
      f: real_function,
      x: real): bool =
    differentiable_at(f, x)
      AND differentiable_at(derivative_function(f), x)

  satisfies_differential_equation_at(
      f: real_function,
      x: real): bool =
    derivative_value(derivative_function(f), x)
        - 2 * derivative_value(f, x)
        + f(x)
      = 2 * real_exponential(x)

  positive_solution_implies_increasing: bool =
    FORALL (f: real_function):
      (FORALL (x: real):
        twice_differentiable_at(f, x)
          AND satisfies_differential_equation_at(f, x)
          AND f(x) > 0)
      IMPLIES
        FORALL (x: real):
          derivative_value(f, x) > 0

  increasing_solution_implies_positive: bool =
    FORALL (g: real_function):
      (FORALL (x: real):
        twice_differentiable_at(g, x)
          AND satisfies_differential_equation_at(g, x)
          AND derivative_value(g, x) > 0)
      IMPLIES
        FORALL (x: real):
          g(x) > 0

  putnam_1987_a3: bool =
    (positive_solution_implies_increasing IFF FALSE)
      AND
    (increasing_solution_implies_positive IFF TRUE)
END putnam_1987_a3

title: putnam_1987_a4
content:
import Mathlib

open MvPolynomial Real

noncomputable abbrev putnam_1987_a4_solution : ℂ := sorry
-- (5 / 3) * sqrt 30
/--
Let $P$ be a polynomial, with real coefficients, in three variables and $F$ be a function of two variables such that
\[
P(ux, uy, uz) = u^2 F(y-x,z-x) \quad \mbox{for all real $x,y,z,u$},
\]
and such that $P(1,0,0)=4$, $P(0,1,0)=5$, and $P(0,0,1)=6$. Also let $A,B,C$ be complex numbers with $P(A,B,C)=0$ and $|B-A|=10$. Find $|C-A|$.
-/
theorem putnam_1987_a4
(P : MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℂ)
(hPreal : ∀ i : Fin 3 →₀ ℕ, (coeff i P).im = 0)
(F : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ)
(vars : ℂ → ℂ → ℂ → (Fin 3 → ℂ))
(hvars : vars = fun a b c ↦ fun i ↦ ite (i = 0) a (ite (i = 1) b c))
(h : ∀ x y z u : ℝ, eval (vars (u * x) (u * y) (u * z)) P = u ^ 2 * F (y - x) (z - x))
(hPval : eval (vars 1 0 0) P = 4 ∧ eval (vars 0 1 0) P = 5 ∧ eval (vars 0 0 1) P = 6)
(A B C : ℂ)
(hPABC : eval (vars A B C) P = 0)
(habs : ‖B - A‖ = 10)
: (‖C - A‖ = putnam_1987_a4_solution) :=
sorry

title: putnam_1987_a4
content:
(* Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench artifact putnam_1987_a4:
   the distance forced by a real-coefficient trivariate polynomial satisfying
   a homogeneous translation identity and three prescribed values. This file
   contains no proof. *)

From Stdlib Require Import Reals Arith.PeanoNat.

Open Scope R_scope.

Definition putnam_1987_a4_complex : Type := (R * R)%type.

Definition putnam_1987_a4_of_real
    (x : R) : putnam_1987_a4_complex :=
  (x, 0).

Definition putnam_1987_a4_complex_add
    (z w : putnam_1987_a4_complex) : putnam_1987_a4_complex :=
  (fst z + fst w, snd z + snd w).

Definition putnam_1987_a4_complex_neg
    (z : putnam_1987_a4_complex) : putnam_1987_a4_complex :=
  (- fst z, - snd z).

Definition putnam_1987_a4_complex_sub
    (z w : putnam_1987_a4_complex) : putnam_1987_a4_complex :=
  putnam_1987_a4_complex_add z (putnam_1987_a4_complex_neg w).

Definition putnam_1987_a4_complex_mul
    (z w : putnam_1987_a4_complex) : putnam_1987_a4_complex :=
  (fst z * fst w - snd z * snd w,
   fst z * snd w + snd z * fst w).

Fixpoint putnam_1987_a4_complex_pow
    (z : putnam_1987_a4_complex) (n : nat) :
    putnam_1987_a4_complex :=
  match n with
  | O => putnam_1987_a4_of_real 1
  | S m =>
      putnam_1987_a4_complex_mul z
        (putnam_1987_a4_complex_pow z m)
  end.

Definition putnam_1987_a4_complex_norm
    (z : putnam_1987_a4_complex) : R :=
  sqrt (fst z ^ 2 + snd z ^ 2).

Record putnam_1987_a4_polynomial : Type := {
  putnam_1987_a4_coefficient : nat -> nat -> nat -> R;
  putnam_1987_a4_x_bound : nat;
  putnam_1987_a4_y_bound : nat;
  putnam_1987_a4_z_bound : nat;
  putnam_1987_a4_vanishes_outside :
    forall i j k : nat,
      Nat.lt putnam_1987_a4_x_bound i \/
      Nat.lt putnam_1987_a4_y_bound j \/
      Nat.lt putnam_1987_a4_z_bound k ->
      putnam_1987_a4_coefficient i j k = 0
}.

Fixpoint putnam_1987_a4_complex_sum_to
    (n : nat) (term : nat -> putnam_1987_a4_complex) :
    putnam_1987_a4_complex :=
  match n with
  | O => term O
  | S m =>
      putnam_1987_a4_complex_add
        (putnam_1987_a4_complex_sum_to m term) (term (S m))
  end.

Definition putnam_1987_a4_eval
    (P : putnam_1987_a4_polynomial)
    (x y z : putnam_1987_a4_complex) :
    putnam_1987_a4_complex :=
  putnam_1987_a4_complex_sum_to
    (putnam_1987_a4_x_bound P)
    (fun i : nat =>
      putnam_1987_a4_complex_sum_to
        (putnam_1987_a4_y_bound P)
        (fun j : nat =>
          putnam_1987_a4_complex_sum_to
            (putnam_1987_a4_z_bound P)
            (fun k : nat =>
              putnam_1987_a4_complex_mul
                (putnam_1987_a4_of_real
                  (putnam_1987_a4_coefficient P i j k))
                (putnam_1987_a4_complex_mul
                  (putnam_1987_a4_complex_pow x i)
                  (putnam_1987_a4_complex_mul
                    (putnam_1987_a4_complex_pow y j)
                    (putnam_1987_a4_complex_pow z k)))))).

Definition putnam_1987_a4_solution : R :=
  (5 / 3) * sqrt 30.

Theorem putnam_1987_a4
    (P : putnam_1987_a4_polynomial)
    (F : R -> R -> R)
    (h :
      forall x y z u : R,
        putnam_1987_a4_eval P
          (putnam_1987_a4_of_real (u * x))
          (putnam_1987_a4_of_real (u * y))
          (putnam_1987_a4_of_real (u * z)) =
        putnam_1987_a4_of_real (u ^ 2 * F (y - x) (z - x)))
    (hPval :
      putnam_1987_a4_eval P
        (putnam_1987_a4_of_real 1)
        (putnam_1987_a4_of_real 0)
        (putnam_1987_a4_of_real 0) =
          putnam_1987_a4_of_real 4 /\
      putnam_1987_a4_eval P
        (putnam_1987_a4_of_real 0)
        (putnam_1987_a4_of_real 1)
        (putnam_1987_a4_of_real 0) =
          putnam_1987_a4_of_real 5 /\
      putnam_1987_a4_eval P
        (putnam_1987_a4_of_real 0)
        (putnam_1987_a4_of_real 0)
        (putnam_1987_a4_of_real 1) =
          putnam_1987_a4_of_real 6)
    (A B Cpoint : putnam_1987_a4_complex)
    (hPABC :
      putnam_1987_a4_eval P A B Cpoint =
        putnam_1987_a4_of_real 0)
    (habs :
      putnam_1987_a4_complex_norm
        (putnam_1987_a4_complex_sub B A) = 10) :
  putnam_1987_a4_complex_norm
    (putnam_1987_a4_complex_sub Cpoint A) =
      putnam_1987_a4_solution.
Admitted.

title: putnam_1987_a4
content:
theory putnam_1987_a4 imports Complex_Main "HOL-Computational_Algebra.Polynomial"
begin

definition putnam_1987_a4_solution::real where "putnam_1987_a4_solution \<equiv> undefined"
(* (5/3) * sqrt 30 *)
theorem putnam_1987_a4:
  fixes P::"complex poly poly poly" and F::"real\<Rightarrow>real\<Rightarrow>real" and a b c::complex
  assumes hPreal : "\<forall>i j k::nat. Im (coeff (coeff (coeff P k) j) i) = 0"
    and h : "\<forall>x y z u::real. (poly (poly (poly P [:[: u * z :]:]) [: u * y :]) (u * x)) = u^2 * F (y-x) (z-x)"
    and hPval1 : "(poly (poly (poly P [:[: 0 :] :]) [: 0 :]) 1) = 4"
    and hPval2 : "(poly (poly (poly P [:[: 0 :] :]) [: 1 :]) 0) = 5"
    and hPval3 : "(poly (poly (poly P [:[: 1 :] :]) [: 0 :]) 0) = 6"
    and hPabc : "(poly (poly (poly P [:[: c :] :]) [: b :]) a) = 0"
    and habs : "norm (b - a) = 10"
  shows "norm (c - a) = putnam_1987_a4_solution"
  sorry

end

title: putnam_1987_a4
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench artifact putnam_1987_a4:
  the distance from one coordinate of a complex zero of a real-coefficient
  trivariate polynomial satisfying a scaling identity and three specified
  values. This file contains no proof.
*)

let cpoly_output = open_out "/dev/null";;
let cpoly_formatter = Format.formatter_of_out_channel cpoly_output;;
let previous_file_loader = !Hol_loader.file_loader;;
Hol_loader.file_loader :=
  (fun path -> Toploop.use_file cpoly_formatter path);;
let cpoly_loaded =
  Toploop.use_file cpoly_formatter "Complex/cpoly.ml";;
Hol_loader.file_loader := previous_file_loader;;
Format.pp_print_flush cpoly_formatter ();;
close_out cpoly_output;;
if not cpoly_loaded then failwith "failed to load Complex/cpoly.ml";;

let statement =
  `let eval3 =
     \P:((complex list)list)list.
       \x y z:complex.
         poly
           (MAP
             (\q:(complex list)list.
                poly (MAP (\p:complex list. poly p x) q) y)
             P)
           z in
   let real_coefficients =
     \P:((complex list)list)list.
       !q p a.
         MEM q P /\ MEM p q /\ MEM a p
         ==> Im a = &0 in
   let putnam_1987_a4_solution = (&5 / &3) * sqrt(&30) in
   !P:((complex list)list)list.
   !f:real->real->real.
   !A B C:complex.
     real_coefficients P /\
     (!x y z u:real.
        eval3 P (Cx(u * x)) (Cx(u * y)) (Cx(u * z)) =
        Cx(u pow 2 * f (y - x) (z - x))) /\
     eval3 P (Cx(&1)) (Cx(&0)) (Cx(&0)) = Cx(&4) /\
     eval3 P (Cx(&0)) (Cx(&1)) (Cx(&0)) = Cx(&5) /\
     eval3 P (Cx(&0)) (Cx(&0)) (Cx(&1)) = Cx(&6) /\
     eval3 P A B C = Cx(&0) /\
     norm (B - A) = &10
     ==> norm (C - A) = putnam_1987_a4_solution`;;

title: putnam_1987_a4
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1987_a4:
;; an arbitrary real-coefficient polynomial satisfying a universal homogeneity
;; and difference identity determines the distance from A to C for arbitrary
;; complex zeros A, B, and C with |B-A| = 10. This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))

;; DEFSTUB introduces conservative generic symbols rather than executable
;; surrogates. Their explicit laws below present an arbitrary real closed
;; ordered field, and P is an arbitrary finite list of trivariate monomials.
;; Such lists represent exactly the finite-support real polynomials. Complex
;; numbers are definitionally pairs of field elements. The identity itself
;; gives F(s,t) = P(0,s,t) by taking x = 0 and u = 1, so eliminating F yields
;; a pure first-order field assertion. Real closed fields are elementarily
;; equivalent, making this presentation bidirectionally equivalent to the
;; source assertion over R and C while retaining F and its full quantifier.

(defstub putnam-1987-a4-real-p (x) t)
(defstub putnam-1987-a4-add (x y) t)
(defstub putnam-1987-a4-multiply (x y) t)
(defstub putnam-1987-a4-negate (x) t)
(defstub putnam-1987-a4-inverse (x) t)
(defstub putnam-1987-a4-less (x y) t)
(defstub putnam-1987-a4-square-root (x) t)
(defstub putnam-1987-a4-f (x y) t)

(defun putnam-1987-a4-subtract (x y)
  (putnam-1987-a4-add
   x
   (putnam-1987-a4-negate y)))

(defun putnam-1987-a4-field-natural (n zero one)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix n)))
  (if (zp n)
      zero
    (putnam-1987-a4-add
     one
     (putnam-1987-a4-field-natural
      (- n 1) zero one))))

(defun putnam-1987-a4-field-rational
    (numerator denominator zero one)
  (putnam-1987-a4-multiply
   (putnam-1987-a4-field-natural
    numerator zero one)
   (putnam-1987-a4-inverse
    (putnam-1987-a4-field-natural
     denominator zero one))))

(defun-sk putnam-1987-a4-field-laws-p (zero one)
  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (putnam-1987-a4-real-p x)
      (putnam-1987-a4-real-p y)
      (putnam-1987-a4-real-p z))
     (and
      (putnam-1987-a4-real-p
       (putnam-1987-a4-add x y))
      (putnam-1987-a4-real-p
       (putnam-1987-a4-multiply x y))
      (putnam-1987-a4-real-p
       (putnam-1987-a4-negate x))
      (putnam-1987-a4-real-p
       (putnam-1987-a4-inverse x))
      (equal
       (putnam-1987-a4-add
        (putnam-1987-a4-add x y)
        z)
       (putnam-1987-a4-add
        x
        (putnam-1987-a4-add y z)))
      (equal
       (putnam-1987-a4-multiply
        (putnam-1987-a4-multiply x y)
        z)
       (putnam-1987-a4-multiply
        x
        (putnam-1987-a4-multiply y z)))
      (equal
       (putnam-1987-a4-add x y)
       (putnam-1987-a4-add y x))
      (equal
       (putnam-1987-a4-multiply x y)
       (putnam-1987-a4-multiply y x))
      (equal
       (putnam-1987-a4-add x zero)
       x)
      (equal
       (putnam-1987-a4-add
        x
        (putnam-1987-a4-negate x))
       zero)
      (equal
       (putnam-1987-a4-multiply x one)
       x)
      (implies
       (equal x zero)
       (equal
        (putnam-1987-a4-inverse x)
        zero))
      (implies
       (not (equal x zero))
       (equal
        (putnam-1987-a4-multiply
         x
         (putnam-1987-a4-inverse x))
        one))
      (equal
       (putnam-1987-a4-multiply
        x
        (putnam-1987-a4-add y z))
       (putnam-1987-a4-add
        (putnam-1987-a4-multiply x y)
        (putnam-1987-a4-multiply x z)))))))

(defun-sk putnam-1987-a4-order-laws-p (zero)
  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (putnam-1987-a4-real-p x)
      (putnam-1987-a4-real-p y)
      (putnam-1987-a4-real-p z))
     (and
      (not (putnam-1987-a4-less x x))
      (or
       (putnam-1987-a4-less x y)
       (equal x y)
       (putnam-1987-a4-less y x))
      (implies
       (and
        (putnam-1987-a4-less x y)
        (putnam-1987-a4-less y z))
       (putnam-1987-a4-less x z))
      (implies
       (putnam-1987-a4-less x y)
       (putnam-1987-a4-less
        (putnam-1987-a4-add x z)
        (putnam-1987-a4-add y z)))
      (implies
       (and
        (putnam-1987-a4-less zero x)
        (putnam-1987-a4-less zero y))
       (putnam-1987-a4-less
        zero
        (putnam-1987-a4-multiply x y)))))))

(defun-sk putnam-1987-a4-square-root-laws-p (zero)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (and
      (putnam-1987-a4-real-p x)
      (not (putnam-1987-a4-less x zero)))
     (let ((root
            (putnam-1987-a4-square-root x)))
       (and
        (putnam-1987-a4-real-p root)
        (not (putnam-1987-a4-less root zero))
        (equal
         (putnam-1987-a4-multiply root root)
         x))))))

(defun putnam-1987-a4-real-list-p (values)
  (if (consp values)
      (and
       (putnam-1987-a4-real-p (car values))
       (putnam-1987-a4-real-list-p (cdr values)))
    (equal values nil)))

(defun putnam-1987-a4-univariate-polynomial-p
    (coefficients zero)
  (and
   (true-listp coefficients)
   (consp coefficients)
   (putnam-1987-a4-real-list-p coefficients)
   (or
    (equal (len coefficients) 1)
    (not
     (equal
      (car (last coefficients))
      zero)))))

(defun putnam-1987-a4-univariate-eval
    (coefficients x zero)
  (if (consp coefficients)
      (putnam-1987-a4-add
       (car coefficients)
       (putnam-1987-a4-multiply
        x
        (putnam-1987-a4-univariate-eval
         (cdr coefficients) x zero)))
    zero))

(defun-sk putnam-1987-a4-odd-root-exists-p
    (coefficients zero)
  (exists (root)
    (and
     (putnam-1987-a4-real-p root)
     (equal
      (putnam-1987-a4-univariate-eval
       coefficients root zero)
      zero))))

(defun-sk putnam-1987-a4-odd-root-laws-p (zero)
  (forall (coefficients)
    (implies
     (and
      (putnam-1987-a4-univariate-polynomial-p
       coefficients zero)
      (evenp (len coefficients)))
     (putnam-1987-a4-odd-root-exists-p
      coefficients zero))))

(defun putnam-1987-a4-real-closed-field-p (zero one)
  (and
   (putnam-1987-a4-real-p zero)
   (putnam-1987-a4-real-p one)
   (not (equal zero one))
   (putnam-1987-a4-field-laws-p zero one)
   (putnam-1987-a4-order-laws-p zero)
   (putnam-1987-a4-square-root-laws-p zero)
   (putnam-1987-a4-odd-root-laws-p zero)))

(defun-sk putnam-1987-a4-f-real-valued-p ()
  (forall (x y)
    (implies
     (and
      (putnam-1987-a4-real-p x)
      (putnam-1987-a4-real-p y))
     (putnam-1987-a4-real-p
      (putnam-1987-a4-f x y)))))

;; A monomial is (coefficient x-exponent y-exponent z-exponent).

(defun putnam-1987-a4-monomial-p (monomial)
  (and
   (true-listp monomial)
   (equal (len monomial) 4)
   (putnam-1987-a4-real-p (nth 0 monomial))
   (natp (nth 1 monomial))
   (natp (nth 2 monomial))
   (natp (nth 3 monomial))))

(defun putnam-1987-a4-polynomial-p (polynomial)
  (if (consp polynomial)
      (and
       (putnam-1987-a4-monomial-p
        (car polynomial))
       (putnam-1987-a4-polynomial-p
        (cdr polynomial)))
    (equal polynomial nil)))

(defun putnam-1987-a4-power (x n one)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix n)))
  (if (zp n)
      one
    (putnam-1987-a4-multiply
     x
     (putnam-1987-a4-power
      x (- n 1) one))))

(defun putnam-1987-a4-monomial-real-eval
    (monomial x y z one)
  (putnam-1987-a4-multiply
   (nth 0 monomial)
   (putnam-1987-a4-multiply
    (putnam-1987-a4-power
     x (nth 1 monomial) one)
    (putnam-1987-a4-multiply
     (putnam-1987-a4-power
      y (nth 2 monomial) one)
     (putnam-1987-a4-power
      z (nth 3 monomial) one)))))

(defun putnam-1987-a4-polynomial-real-eval
    (polynomial x y z zero one)
  (if (consp polynomial)
      (putnam-1987-a4-add
       (putnam-1987-a4-monomial-real-eval
        (car polynomial) x y z one)
       (putnam-1987-a4-polynomial-real-eval
        (cdr polynomial) x y z zero one))
    zero))

(defun putnam-1987-a4-complex-add (left right)
  (cons
   (putnam-1987-a4-add
    (car left) (car right))
   (putnam-1987-a4-add
    (cdr left) (cdr right))))

(defun putnam-1987-a4-complex-multiply (left right)
  (cons
   (putnam-1987-a4-subtract
    (putnam-1987-a4-multiply
     (car left) (car right))
    (putnam-1987-a4-multiply
     (cdr left) (cdr right)))
   (putnam-1987-a4-add
    (putnam-1987-a4-multiply
     (car left) (cdr right))
    (putnam-1987-a4-multiply
     (cdr left) (car right)))))

(defun putnam-1987-a4-complex-power
    (value n zero one)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix n)))
  (if (zp n)
      (cons one zero)
    (putnam-1987-a4-complex-multiply
     value
     (putnam-1987-a4-complex-power
      value (- n 1) zero one))))

(defun putnam-1987-a4-monomial-complex-eval
    (monomial x y z zero one)
  (putnam-1987-a4-complex-multiply
   (cons (nth 0 monomial) zero)
   (putnam-1987-a4-complex-multiply
    (putnam-1987-a4-complex-power
     x (nth 1 monomial) zero one)
    (putnam-1987-a4-complex-multiply
     (putnam-1987-a4-complex-power
      y (nth 2 monomial) zero one)
     (putnam-1987-a4-complex-power
      z (nth 3 monomial) zero one)))))

(defun putnam-1987-a4-polynomial-complex-eval
    (polynomial x y z zero one)
  (if (consp polynomial)
      (putnam-1987-a4-complex-add
       (putnam-1987-a4-monomial-complex-eval
        (car polynomial) x y z zero one)
       (putnam-1987-a4-polynomial-complex-eval
        (cdr polynomial) x y z zero one))
    (cons zero zero)))

(defun putnam-1987-a4-complex-zero-p (value zero)
  (and
   (equal (car value) zero)
   (equal (cdr value) zero)))

(defun putnam-1987-a4-distance
    (left-real left-imag right-real right-imag)
  (let ((real-difference
         (putnam-1987-a4-subtract
          left-real right-real))
        (imaginary-difference
         (putnam-1987-a4-subtract
          left-imag right-imag)))
    (putnam-1987-a4-square-root
     (putnam-1987-a4-add
      (putnam-1987-a4-multiply
       real-difference real-difference)
      (putnam-1987-a4-multiply
       imaginary-difference imaginary-difference)))))

(defun-sk putnam-1987-a4-universal-identity-p
    (polynomial zero one)
  (forall (x y z u)
    (implies
     (and
      (putnam-1987-a4-real-p x)
      (putnam-1987-a4-real-p y)
      (putnam-1987-a4-real-p z)
      (putnam-1987-a4-real-p u))
     (equal
      (putnam-1987-a4-polynomial-real-eval
       polynomial
       (putnam-1987-a4-multiply u x)
       (putnam-1987-a4-multiply u y)
       (putnam-1987-a4-multiply u z)
       zero one)
      (putnam-1987-a4-multiply
       (putnam-1987-a4-multiply u u)
       (putnam-1987-a4-f
        (putnam-1987-a4-subtract y x)
        (putnam-1987-a4-subtract z x)))))))

(defun putnam-1987-a4-coordinate-values-p
    (polynomial zero one)
  (and
   (equal
    (putnam-1987-a4-polynomial-real-eval
     polynomial one zero zero zero one)
    (putnam-1987-a4-field-natural
     4 zero one))
   (equal
    (putnam-1987-a4-polynomial-real-eval
     polynomial zero one zero zero one)
    (putnam-1987-a4-field-natural
     5 zero one))
   (equal
    (putnam-1987-a4-polynomial-real-eval
     polynomial zero zero one zero one)
    (putnam-1987-a4-field-natural
     6 zero one))))

(defun putnam-1987-a4-complex-root-p
    (polynomial
     a-real a-imag b-real b-imag c-real c-imag
     zero one)
  (putnam-1987-a4-complex-zero-p
   (putnam-1987-a4-polynomial-complex-eval
    polynomial
    (cons a-real a-imag)
    (cons b-real b-imag)
    (cons c-real c-imag)
    zero one)
   zero))

(defun-sk putnambench-putnam-1987-a4-statement ()
  (forall
   (polynomial zero one
               a-real a-imag
               b-real b-imag
               c-real c-imag)
   (implies
    (and
     (putnam-1987-a4-real-closed-field-p
      zero one)
     (putnam-1987-a4-f-real-valued-p)
     (putnam-1987-a4-polynomial-p
      polynomial)
     (putnam-1987-a4-real-list-p
      (list
       a-real a-imag
       b-real b-imag
       c-real c-imag))

title: putnam_1987_a4
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1987_a4:
-- a real-coefficient polynomial in three variables satisfying a homogeneous
-- translation identity and three prescribed values determines the distance
-- from a complex zero to be (5 / 3) times sqrt 30. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; _*_)

infix 4 _!=_ _<=N_ _<N_
infixr 3 _and_
infixr 2 _or_

data Bottom : Set where

Not : Set -> Set
Not A =
  A -> Bottom

_!=_ : {A : Set} -> A -> A -> Set
x != y =
  Not (x == y)

record _and_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data _or_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  left  : A -> A or B
  right : B -> A or B

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

data _<=N_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set where
  zero<=N   : {n : Nat} -> zero <=N n
  suc<=sucN : {m n : Nat} -> m <=N n -> suc m <=N suc n

_<N_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set
m <N n =
  suc m <=N n

data Fin : Nat -> Set where
  fzero : {n : Nat} -> Fin (suc n)
  fsuc  : {n : Nat} -> Fin n -> Fin (suc n)

finToNat : {n : Nat} -> Fin n -> Nat
finToNat fzero =
  zero
finToNat (fsuc i) =
  suc (finToNat i)

record CompleteOrderedRealField (R : Set) : Set1 where
  field
    zeroR oneR : R
    add multiply : R -> R -> R
    negate inverse squareRoot : R -> R
    lessOrEqual : R -> R -> Set
    fromNat : Nat -> R

    one-not-zero :
      oneR != zeroR

    add-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> add x y == add y x
    add-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      add (add x y) z == add x (add y z)
    add-zero :
      (x : R) -> add x zeroR == x
    add-inverse :
      (x : R) -> add x (negate x) == zeroR

    multiply-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> multiply x y == multiply y x
    multiply-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply (multiply x y) z ==
      multiply x (multiply y z)
    multiply-one :
      (x : R) -> multiply x oneR == x
    multiply-zero :
      (x : R) -> multiply x zeroR == zeroR
    distribute :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply x (add y z) ==
      add (multiply x y) (multiply x z)
    inverse-zero :
      inverse zeroR == zeroR
    multiply-inverse :
      (x : R) ->
      x != zeroR ->
      multiply x (inverse x) == oneR

    order-reflexive :
      (x : R) -> lessOrEqual x x
    order-transitive :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y z ->
      lessOrEqual x z
    order-antisymmetric :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y x ->
      x == y
    order-total :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y or lessOrEqual y x
    add-order :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual (add z x) (add z y)
    multiply-nonnegative :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR x ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR y ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR (multiply x y)
    zero-less-than-one :
      lessOrEqual zeroR oneR and zeroR != oneR

    fromNat-zero :
      fromNat zero == zeroR
    fromNat-successor :
      (n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (suc n) == add (fromNat n) oneR
    fromNat-addition :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m + n) == add (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-multiplication :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m * n) == multiply (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-injective :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat m == fromNat n ->
      m == n

    archimedean :
      (x : R) ->
      Exists Nat (\ n -> lessOrEqual x (fromNat n))
    least-upper-bound :
      (P : R -> Set) ->
      Exists R P ->
      Exists R
        (\ upper ->
          (x : R) ->
          P x ->
          lessOrEqual x upper) ->
      Exists R
        (\ supremum ->
          ((x : R) ->
            P x ->
            lessOrEqual x supremum)
          and
          ((upper : R) ->
            ((x : R) ->
              P x ->
              lessOrEqual x upper) ->
            lessOrEqual supremum upper))

    square-root-nonnegative :
      (x : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR (squareRoot x)
    square-root-square :
      (x : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR x ->
      multiply (squareRoot x) (squareRoot x) == x
    square-root-nonpositive :
      (x : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x zeroR ->
      squareRoot x == zeroR
    square-root-unique :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR y ->
      multiply y y == x ->
      y == squareRoot x

open CompleteOrderedRealField

subtract :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
subtract reals x y =
  add reals x (negate reals y)

divide :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
divide reals x y =
  multiply reals x (inverse reals y)

square :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R
square reals x =
  multiply reals x x

record Complex (R : Set) : Set where
  constructor complex
  field
    realPart      : R
    imaginaryPart : R

open Complex

complexZero :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Complex R
complexZero reals =
  complex (zeroR reals) (zeroR reals)

complexOne :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Complex R
complexOne reals =
  complex (oneR reals) (zeroR reals)

embedReal :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  Complex R
embedReal reals x =
  complex x (zeroR reals)

complexAdd :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Complex R ->
  Complex R ->
  Complex R
complexAdd reals z w =
  complex
    (add reals (realPart z) (realPart w))
    (add reals (imaginaryPart z) (imaginaryPart w))

complexNegate :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Complex R ->
  Complex R
complexNegate reals z =
  complex
    (negate reals (realPart z))
    (negate reals (imaginaryPart z))

complexSubtract :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Complex R ->
  Complex R ->
  Complex R
complexSubtract reals z w =
  complexAdd reals z (complexNegate reals w)

complexMultiply :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Complex R ->
  Complex R ->
  Complex R
complexMultiply reals z w =
  complex
    (add reals
      (multiply reals (realPart z) (realPart w))
      (negate reals
        (multiply reals (imaginaryPart z) (imaginaryPart w))))
    (add reals
      (multiply reals (realPart z) (imaginaryPart w))
      (multiply reals (imaginaryPart z) (realPart w)))

complexPower :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Complex R ->
  Nat ->
  Complex R
complexPower reals z zero =
  complexOne reals
complexPower reals z (suc n) =
  complexMultiply reals (complexPower reals z n) z

complexSquaredModulus :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Complex R ->
  R
complexSquaredModulus reals z =
  add reals
    (square reals (realPart z))
    (square reals (imaginaryPart z))

complexModulus :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Complex R ->
  R
complexModulus reals z =
  squareRoot reals (complexSquaredModulus reals z)

sumFinComplex :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  {n : Nat} ->
  (Fin n -> Complex R) ->
  Complex R
sumFinComplex reals {zero} terms =
  complexZero reals
sumFinComplex reals {suc n} terms =
  complexAdd reals
    (terms fzero)
    (sumFinComplex reals (\ i -> terms (fsuc i)))

sumThroughComplex :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (bound : Nat) ->
  (Nat -> Complex R) ->
  Complex R
sumThroughComplex reals bound term =
  sumFinComplex reals {suc bound}
    (\ i -> term (finToNat i))

record Polynomial3
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) : Set where
  field
    coefficient : Nat -> Nat -> Nat -> Complex R
    degreeBound : Nat
    coefficient-outside-bound :
      (i j k : Nat) ->
      (degreeBound <N i
        or
        (degreeBound <N j or degreeBound <N k)) ->
      coefficient i j k == complexZero reals

open Polynomial3

evaluatePolynomial3 :
  {R : Set} ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) ->
  Polynomial3 reals ->
  Complex R ->
  Complex R ->
  Complex R ->
  Complex R
evaluatePolynomial3 reals polynomial x y z =
  sumThroughComplex reals
    (degreeBound polynomial)
    (\ i ->
      sumThroughComplex reals
        (degreeBound polynomial)
        (\ j ->
          sumThroughComplex reals
            (degreeBound polynomial)
            (\ k ->
              complexMultiply reals
                (coefficient polynomial i j k)
                (complexMultiply reals
                  (complexPower reals x i)
                  (complexMultiply reals
                    (complexPower reals y j)
                    (complexPower reals z k))))))

RealCoefficients :
  {R : Set} ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) ->
  Polynomial3 reals ->
  Set
RealCoefficients reals polynomial =
  (i j k : Nat) ->
  imaginaryPart (coefficient polynomial i j k) == zeroR reals

module Putnam1987A4Statement
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) where

  oneN : Nat
  oneN =
    suc zero

  twoN : Nat
  twoN =
    suc oneN

  threeN : Nat
  threeN =
    suc twoN

  fourN : Nat
  fourN =
    suc threeN

  fiveN : Nat
  fiveN =
    suc fourN

  sixN : Nat
  sixN =
    suc fiveN

  tenN : Nat
  tenN =
    fiveN + fiveN

  thirtyN : Nat
  thirtyN =
    fiveN * sixN

  four five six ten thirty : R
  four =
    fromNat reals fourN
  five =
    fromNat reals fiveN
  six =
    fromNat reals sixN
  ten =
    fromNat reals tenN
  thirty =
    fromNat reals thirtyN

  solution : R
  solution =
    multiply reals
      (divide reals five (fromNat reals threeN))
      (squareRoot reals thirty)

  proposition : Set
  proposition =
    (P : Polynomial3 reals) ->
    RealCoefficients reals P ->
    (F : R -> R -> R) ->
    ((x y z u : R) ->
      evaluatePolynomial3 reals P
        (embedReal reals (multiply reals u x))
        (embedReal reals (multiply reals u y))
        (embedReal reals (multiply reals u z))
      ==
      embedReal reals
        (multiply reals
          (square reals u)
          (F
            (subtract reals y x)
            (subtract reals z x)))) ->
    evaluatePolynomial3 reals P
      (embedReal reals (oneR reals))
      (complexZero reals)
      (complexZero reals)
      == embedReal reals four ->
    evaluatePolynomial3 reals P
      (complexZero reals)
      (embedReal reals (oneR reals))
      (complexZero reals)
      == embedReal reals five ->
    evaluatePolynomial3 reals P
      (complexZero reals)
      (complexZero reals)
      (embedReal reals (oneR reals))
      == embedReal reals six ->
    (A B C : Complex R) ->
    evaluatePolynomial3 reals P A B C == complexZero reals ->
    complexModulus reals (complexSubtract reals B A) == ten ->
    complexModulus reals (complexSubtract reals C A) == solution

putnam-1987-a4 : Set1
putnam-1987-a4 =
  (R : Set) ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) ->
  Putnam1987A4Statement.proposition reals

title: putnam_1987_a4
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1987_a4:
  a real-coefficient polynomial in three variables with the stated scaling
  identity and axis values determines the distance from A to C at a complex
  zero. This file contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open arithmeticTheory pairTheory pred_setTheory realTheory transcTheory
     complexTheory;

val putnam_1987_a4 =
  ``let support =
      \P : num # (num # num) -> complex.
        {ijk : num # (num # num) | P ijk <> 0}
    in
    let polynomial =
      \P : num # (num # num) -> complex.
        FINITE (support P)
    in
    let eval =
      \P : num # (num # num) -> complex.
      \x y z : complex.
        ITSET
          (\ijk acc.
             P ijk *
             x pow (FST ijk) *
             y pow (FST (SND ijk)) *
             z pow (SND (SND ijk)) +
             acc)
          (support P)
          (0 : complex)
    in
    let putnam_1987_a4_solution = (5 / 3) * sqrt 30
    in
      !P : num # (num # num) -> complex.
      !F : real -> real -> real.
      !A B C : complex.
        polynomial P /\
        (!ijk : num # (num # num). IM (P ijk) = 0) /\
        (!x y z u : real.
           eval P
             (complex_of_real (u * x))
             (complex_of_real (u * y))
             (complex_of_real (u * z)) =
           complex_of_real (u pow 2 * F (y - x) (z - x))) /\
        eval P 1 0 0 = 4 /\
        eval P 0 1 0 = 5 /\
        eval P 0 0 1 = 6 /\
        eval P A B C = 0 /\
        modu (B - A) = 10
        ==>
        modu (C - A) = putnam_1987_a4_solution``;

title: putnam_1987_a4
content:
$(
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact
  putnam_1987_a4: a real-coefficient polynomial in three variables satisfying
  the specified scaling identity and evaluations determines the distance
  between two of three complex inputs. This file contains no proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  The ordinal 3o is the three-element variable-index set. Thus
  ( 3o mPoly CCfld ) is set.mm's ring of arbitrary finite-support
  polynomials in three variables over the complex field, and
  ( 3o eval CCfld ) evaluates such a polynomial at a complex assignment.
  A polynomial in this ring is its coefficient function on exponent maps;
  requiring every coefficient to belong to RR is exactly the source
  real-coefficient condition. Since 3o is finite, every map in
  ( NN0 ^m 3o ) is a valid finite-support exponent map.

  f remains an arbitrary curried total function from RR x RR to RR. The
  coordinate maps send 0, 1, and 2 to the displayed first, second, and third
  arguments, so all evaluations and the universal scaling identity retain
  their source order. Complex modulus is set.mm's abs, and the conclusion
  inlines the annotated source solution (5 / 3) * sqrt(30).

  The final declaration is the single unproved $a corpus statement; this
  database contains no $p proof statement.
$)

${
  $d a b c e f i p u x y z $.

  putnambench-putnam-1987-a4 $a |-
    A. p e. ( Base ` ( 3o mPoly CCfld ) )
      A. f e. ( ( RR ^m RR ) ^m RR )
        A. a e. CC A. b e. CC A. c e. CC
          (
            (
              A. e e. ( NN0 ^m 3o )
                ( p ` e ) e. RR
              /\
              A. x e. RR A. y e. RR A. z e. RR A. u e. RR
                (
                  (
                    ( ( 3o eval CCfld ) ` p )
                    `
                    (
                      i e. 3o |->
                        if (
                          i = (/) ,
                          ( u x. x ) ,
                          if ( i = 1o , ( u x. y ) , ( u x. z ) )
                        )
                    )
                  )
                  =
                  (
                    ( u ^ 2 )
                    x.
                    ( ( f ` ( y - x ) ) ` ( z - x ) )
                  )
                )
              /\
              (
                ( ( 3o eval CCfld ) ` p )
                `
                (
                  i e. 3o |->
                    if ( i = (/) , 1 , if ( i = 1o , 0 , 0 ) )
                )
              )
              =
              4
              /\
              (
                ( ( 3o eval CCfld ) ` p )
                `
                (
                  i e. 3o |->
                    if ( i = (/) , 0 , if ( i = 1o , 1 , 0 ) )
                )
              )
              =
              5
              /\
              (
                ( ( 3o eval CCfld ) ` p )
                `
                (
                  i e. 3o |->
                    if ( i = (/) , 0 , if ( i = 1o , 0 , 1 ) )
                )
              )
              =
              6
              /\
              (
                ( ( 3o eval CCfld ) ` p )
                `
                (
                  i e. 3o |->
                    if ( i = (/) , a , if ( i = 1o , b , c ) )
                )
              )
              =
              0
              /\
              ( abs ` ( b - a ) ) = ( 5 + 5 )
            )
            ->
            (
              ( abs ` ( c - a ) )
              =
              ( ( 5 / 3 ) x. ( sqrt ` ( 5 x. 6 ) ) )
            )
          )
  $.
$}

    polyEval.((1 qua Complex),(0 qua Complex),(0 qua Complex)) =
