    polyEval.((0 qua Complex),(1 qua Complex),(0 qua Complex)) =
      (5 qua Complex) &
    polyEval.((0 qua Complex),(0 qua Complex),(1 qua Complex)) =
      (6 qua Complex) &
    polyEval.(A,B,C) = (0 qua Complex) &
    |.B-A.| = 10
  holds |.C-A.| = (5/3) * sqrt 30
proof
end;
::$P+

title: putnam_1987_a4
content:
% Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1987_a4:
% a real-coefficient polynomial in three variables satisfying the stated
% scaling law and axis values determines the distance from a complex zero
% to be (5/3)*sqrt(30). This file contains no proof.

putnam_1987_a4: THEORY
BEGIN
  complex: TYPE = [# real_part: real, imag_part: real #]
  coefficient_table: TYPE = [nat, nat, nat -> real]

  % The bound belongs to each polynomial; it is not a corpus-wide degree
  % cutoff. Every finitely supported trivariate polynomial has some maximum
  % coordinate exponent and therefore fits in one such cube. Conversely,
  % masking coefficients outside that cube yields finite support.
  polynomial: TYPE =
    [# coefficients: coefficient_table,
       support_bound: nat #]

  complex_zero: complex =
    (# real_part := 0, imag_part := 0 #)

  complex_one: complex =
    (# real_part := 1, imag_part := 0 #)

  complex_of_real(value: real): complex =
    (# real_part := value, imag_part := 0 #)

  complex_neg(value: complex): complex =
    (# real_part := -real_part(value),
       imag_part := -imag_part(value) #)

  complex_add(left, right: complex): complex =
    (# real_part := real_part(left) + real_part(right),
       imag_part := imag_part(left) + imag_part(right) #)

  complex_sub(left, right: complex): complex =
    complex_add(left, complex_neg(right))

  complex_mul(left, right: complex): complex =
    (# real_part :=
         real_part(left) * real_part(right)
           - imag_part(left) * imag_part(right),
       imag_part :=
         real_part(left) * imag_part(right)
           + imag_part(left) * real_part(right) #)

  complex_scale(scalar: real, value: complex): complex =
    complex_mul(complex_of_real(scalar), value)

  complex_power(value: complex, exponent: nat): RECURSIVE complex =
    IF exponent = 0 THEN
      complex_one
    ELSE
      complex_mul(complex_power(value, exponent - 1), value)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE exponent

  coefficient(
      p: polynomial,
      i, j, k: nat): real =
    IF i <= support_bound(p)
        AND j <= support_bound(p)
        AND k <= support_bound(p) THEN
      coefficients(p)(i, j, k)
    ELSE
      0
    ENDIF

  sum_z(
      p: polynomial,
      x, y, z: complex,
      i, j, count: nat): RECURSIVE complex =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      complex_zero
    ELSE
      LET k: nat = count - 1 IN
        complex_add(
          sum_z(p, x, y, z, i, j, count - 1),
          complex_scale(
            coefficient(p, i, j, k),
            complex_mul(
              complex_mul(
                complex_power(x, i),
                complex_power(y, j)),
              complex_power(z, k))))
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  sum_y(
      p: polynomial,
      x, y, z: complex,
      i, count: nat): RECURSIVE complex =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      complex_zero
    ELSE
      complex_add(
        sum_y(p, x, y, z, i, count - 1),
        sum_z(
          p,
          x,
          y,
          z,
          i,
          count - 1,
          support_bound(p) + 1))
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  sum_x(
      p: polynomial,
      x, y, z: complex,
      count: nat): RECURSIVE complex =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      complex_zero
    ELSE
      complex_add(
        sum_x(p, x, y, z, count - 1),
        sum_y(
          p,
          x,
          y,
          z,
          count - 1,
          support_bound(p) + 1))
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  polynomial_value(
      p: polynomial,
      x, y, z: complex): complex =
    sum_x(p, x, y, z, support_bound(p) + 1)

  nonnegative_square_root(value: real): real =
    IF 0 <= value THEN
      epsilon(
        LAMBDA (root: real):
          0 <= root AND root * root = value)
    ELSE
      0
    ENDIF

  squared_modulus(value: complex): real =
    real_part(value) ^ 2 + imag_part(value) ^ 2

  complex_modulus(value: complex): real =
    nonnegative_square_root(squared_modulus(value))

  putnam_1987_a4_solution: real =
    (5 / 3) * nonnegative_square_root(30)

  putnam_1987_a4: bool =
    FORALL
        (P: polynomial),
        (F: [real, real -> real]),
        (A, B, C: complex):
      ((FORALL (x, y, z, u: real):
          polynomial_value(
            P,
            complex_of_real(u * x),
            complex_of_real(u * y),
            complex_of_real(u * z))
            = complex_of_real(
                u ^ 2 * F(y - x, z - x)))
        AND polynomial_value(
              P,
              complex_of_real(1),
              complex_zero,
              complex_zero)
            = complex_of_real(4)
        AND polynomial_value(
              P,
              complex_zero,
              complex_of_real(1),
              complex_zero)
            = complex_of_real(5)
        AND polynomial_value(
              P,
              complex_zero,
              complex_zero,
              complex_of_real(1))
            = complex_of_real(6)
        AND polynomial_value(P, A, B, C) = complex_zero
        AND complex_modulus(complex_sub(B, A)) = 10)
      IMPLIES
        complex_modulus(complex_sub(C, A))
          = putnam_1987_a4_solution
END putnam_1987_a4

title: putnam_1987_a5
content:
import Mathlib

abbrev putnam_1987_a5_solution : Prop := sorry
-- False
/--
Let $\vec{G}(x,y)=\left(\frac{-y}{x^2+4y^2},\frac{x}{x^2+4y^2},0\right)$. Prove or disprove that there is a vector-valued function $\vec{F}(x,y,z)=(M(x,y,z),N(x,y,z),P(x,y,z))$ with the following properties:
\begin{enumerate}
\item[(i)] $M$, $N$, $P$ have continuous partial derivatives for all $(x,y,z) \neq (0,0,0)$;
\item[(ii)] $\text{Curl}\,\vec{F}=\vec{0}$ for all $(x,y,z) \neq (0,0,0)$;
\item[(iii)] $\vec{F}(x,y,0)=\vec{G}(x,y)$.
\end{enumerate}
-/
theorem putnam_1987_a5
    (curl : ((Fin 3 → ℝ) → (Fin 3 → ℝ)) → ((Fin 3 → ℝ) → (Fin 3 → ℝ)))
    (curl_def : ∀ f x, curl f x = ![
      fderiv ℝ f x (Pi.single 1 1) 2 - fderiv ℝ f x (Pi.single 2 1) 1,
      fderiv ℝ f x (Pi.single 2 1) 0 - fderiv ℝ f x (Pi.single 0 1) 2,
      fderiv ℝ f x (Pi.single 0 1) 1 - fderiv ℝ f x (Pi.single 1 1) 0])
    (G : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → (Fin 3 → ℝ))
    (G_def : ∀ x y, G ![x, y] = ![(-y / (x ^ 2 + 4 * y ^ 2)), (x / (x ^ 2 + 4 * y ^ 2)), 0]) :
    (∃ F : (Fin 3 → ℝ) → (Fin 3 → ℝ),
      ContDiffOn ℝ 1 F {v | v ≠ ![0,0,0]} ∧
      (∀ x, x ≠ 0 → curl F x = 0) ∧
      ∀ x y, F ![x, y, 0] = G ![x, y]) ↔ putnam_1987_a5_solution :=
  sorry

title: putnam_1987_a5
content:
(* Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench artifact putnam_1987_a5:
   nonexistence of a continuously partially differentiable curl-free vector
   field on punctured three-space with a prescribed trace on the coordinate
   plane; this file contains no proof. *)

From Stdlib Require Import
  Reals
  ClassicalDescription
  ClassicalEpsilon.

Open Scope R_scope.

Inductive putnam_1987_a5_coordinate : Type :=
  | putnam_1987_a5_x
  | putnam_1987_a5_y
  | putnam_1987_a5_z.

Record putnam_1987_a5_vector : Type := {
  putnam_1987_a5_vector_x : R;
  putnam_1987_a5_vector_y : R;
  putnam_1987_a5_vector_z : R
}.

Definition putnam_1987_a5_vector_of
    (x y z : R) : putnam_1987_a5_vector :=
  {|
    putnam_1987_a5_vector_x := x;
    putnam_1987_a5_vector_y := y;
    putnam_1987_a5_vector_z := z
  |}.

Definition putnam_1987_a5_component
    (v : putnam_1987_a5_vector)
    (i : putnam_1987_a5_coordinate) : R :=
  match i with
  | putnam_1987_a5_x => putnam_1987_a5_vector_x v
  | putnam_1987_a5_y => putnam_1987_a5_vector_y v
  | putnam_1987_a5_z => putnam_1987_a5_vector_z v
  end.

Definition putnam_1987_a5_zero : putnam_1987_a5_vector :=
  putnam_1987_a5_vector_of 0 0 0.

Definition putnam_1987_a5_replace
    (v : putnam_1987_a5_vector)
    (i : putnam_1987_a5_coordinate)
    (value : R) : putnam_1987_a5_vector :=
  match i with
  | putnam_1987_a5_x =>
      putnam_1987_a5_vector_of
        value
        (putnam_1987_a5_vector_y v)
        (putnam_1987_a5_vector_z v)
  | putnam_1987_a5_y =>
      putnam_1987_a5_vector_of
        (putnam_1987_a5_vector_x v)
        value
        (putnam_1987_a5_vector_z v)
  | putnam_1987_a5_z =>
      putnam_1987_a5_vector_of
        (putnam_1987_a5_vector_x v)
        (putnam_1987_a5_vector_y v)
        value
  end.

Definition putnam_1987_a5_distance
    (u v : putnam_1987_a5_vector) : R :=
  sqrt
    ((putnam_1987_a5_vector_x u - putnam_1987_a5_vector_x v) ^ 2 +
     (putnam_1987_a5_vector_y u - putnam_1987_a5_vector_y v) ^ 2 +
     (putnam_1987_a5_vector_z u - putnam_1987_a5_vector_z v) ^ 2).

Definition putnam_1987_a5_real_derivative
    (f : R -> R) (x : R) : R :=
  match excluded_middle_informative
          (exists d : R, derivable_pt_lim f x d) with
  | left _ =>
      epsilon (inhabits 0)
        (fun d : R => derivable_pt_lim f x d)
  | right _ => 0
  end.

Definition putnam_1987_a5_partial_derivative
    (f : putnam_1987_a5_vector -> R)
    (i : putnam_1987_a5_coordinate)
    (v : putnam_1987_a5_vector) : R :=
  putnam_1987_a5_real_derivative
    (fun value : R =>
      f (putnam_1987_a5_replace v i value))
    (putnam_1987_a5_component v i).

Definition putnam_1987_a5_continuous_on_punctured
    (f : putnam_1987_a5_vector -> R) : Prop :=
  forall v : putnam_1987_a5_vector,
    v <> putnam_1987_a5_zero ->
    forall eps : R,
      eps > 0 ->
      exists delta : R,
        delta > 0 /\
        forall w : putnam_1987_a5_vector,
          w <> putnam_1987_a5_zero ->
          putnam_1987_a5_distance w v < delta ->
          Rabs (f w - f v) < eps.

Definition putnam_1987_a5_continuously_partially_differentiable
    (F : putnam_1987_a5_vector -> putnam_1987_a5_vector) : Prop :=
  (forall
      (output input : putnam_1987_a5_coordinate)
      (v : putnam_1987_a5_vector),
      v <> putnam_1987_a5_zero ->
      derivable_pt_lim
        (fun value : R =>
          putnam_1987_a5_component
            (F (putnam_1987_a5_replace v input value))
            output)
        (putnam_1987_a5_component v input)
        (putnam_1987_a5_partial_derivative
          (fun w : putnam_1987_a5_vector =>
            putnam_1987_a5_component (F w) output)
          input v)) /\
  (forall output input : putnam_1987_a5_coordinate,
      putnam_1987_a5_continuous_on_punctured
        (fun v : putnam_1987_a5_vector =>
          putnam_1987_a5_partial_derivative
            (fun w : putnam_1987_a5_vector =>
              putnam_1987_a5_component (F w) output)
            input v)).

Definition putnam_1987_a5_curl
    (F : putnam_1987_a5_vector -> putnam_1987_a5_vector)
    (v : putnam_1987_a5_vector) : putnam_1987_a5_vector :=
  putnam_1987_a5_vector_of
    (putnam_1987_a5_partial_derivative
       (fun w =>
         putnam_1987_a5_vector_z (F w))
       putnam_1987_a5_y v -
     putnam_1987_a5_partial_derivative
       (fun w =>
         putnam_1987_a5_vector_y (F w))
       putnam_1987_a5_z v)
    (putnam_1987_a5_partial_derivative
       (fun w =>
         putnam_1987_a5_vector_x (F w))
       putnam_1987_a5_z v -
     putnam_1987_a5_partial_derivative
       (fun w =>
         putnam_1987_a5_vector_z (F w))
       putnam_1987_a5_x v)
    (putnam_1987_a5_partial_derivative
       (fun w =>
         putnam_1987_a5_vector_y (F w))
       putnam_1987_a5_x v -
     putnam_1987_a5_partial_derivative
       (fun w =>
         putnam_1987_a5_vector_x (F w))
       putnam_1987_a5_y v).

Definition putnam_1987_a5_G
    (x y : R) : putnam_1987_a5_vector :=
  putnam_1987_a5_vector_of
    (- y / (x ^ 2 + 4 * y ^ 2))
    (x / (x ^ 2 + 4 * y ^ 2))
    0.

Definition putnam_1987_a5_solution : Prop := False.

Theorem putnam_1987_a5 :
  ((exists F : putnam_1987_a5_vector -> putnam_1987_a5_vector,
      putnam_1987_a5_continuously_partially_differentiable F /\
      (forall v : putnam_1987_a5_vector,
        v <> putnam_1987_a5_zero ->
        putnam_1987_a5_curl F v = putnam_1987_a5_zero) /\
      (forall x y : R,
        F (putnam_1987_a5_vector_of x y 0) =
        putnam_1987_a5_G x y)) <->
   putnam_1987_a5_solution).
Admitted.

title: putnam_1987_a5
content:
theory putnam_1987_a5 imports Complex_Main
"HOL-Analysis.Cartesian_Space"
"HOL-Analysis.Derivative"
begin

definition putnam_1987_a5_solution :: "bool" where
"putnam_1987_a5_solution \<equiv> False"
theorem putnam_1987_a5:
  fixes G :: "real^2 \<Rightarrow> real^3"
    and vrepl :: "real^3 \<Rightarrow> 3 \<Rightarrow> real \<Rightarrow> real^3"
    and partderiv :: "(real^3 \<Rightarrow> real) \<Rightarrow> 3 \<Rightarrow> (real^3 \<Rightarrow> real)"
    and Fprop1 Fprop2 Fprop3 :: "(real^3 \<Rightarrow> real)^3 \<Rightarrow> bool"
  defines "G \<equiv> \<lambda> v :: real^2. vector [-v$2 / ((v$1)^2 + 4*(v$2)^2), v$1 / ((v$1)^2 + 4*(v$2)^2), 0]"
    and "vrepl \<equiv> \<lambda> (v :: real^3) (i :: 3) (vi :: real). \<chi> j :: 3. if j = i then vi else v$j"
    and "partderiv \<equiv> \<lambda> (Fi :: real^3 \<Rightarrow> real) (j :: 3). \<lambda> v :: real^3. deriv (\<lambda> vj :: real. Fi (vrepl v j vj)) (v$j)"
    and "Fprop1 \<equiv> \<lambda> F :: (real^3 \<Rightarrow> real)^3.
      (\<forall> i :: 3. \<forall> j :: 3. \<forall> v \<noteq> 0.
        (\<lambda> vj :: real. (F$i) (vrepl v j vj)) differentiable at (v$j)) \<and>
      (\<forall> i :: 3. \<forall> j :: 3.
        continuous_on (UNIV - {0}) (partderiv (F$i) j))"
    and "Fprop2 \<equiv> \<lambda> F :: (real^3 \<Rightarrow> real)^3. \<forall> v \<noteq> 0. (vector [(partderiv (F$3) 2 - partderiv (F$2) 3) v, (partderiv (F$1) 3 - partderiv (F$3) 1) v, (partderiv (F$2) 1 - partderiv (F$1) 2) v] :: real^3) = 0"
    and "Fprop3 \<equiv> \<lambda> F :: (real^3 \<Rightarrow> real)^3. \<forall> x y :: real.
      x \<noteq> 0 \<or> y \<noteq> 0 \<longrightarrow>
      (\<chi> i :: 3. (F$i) (vector [x, y, 0])) = G (vector [x, y])"
  shows "(\<exists> F :: (real^3 \<Rightarrow> real)^3. Fprop1 F \<and> Fprop2 F \<and> Fprop3 F) \<longleftrightarrow> putnam_1987_a5_solution"
  sorry

end

title: putnam_1987_a5
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1987_a5:
  nonexistence of a vector field with continuous partial derivatives and zero
  curl on punctured three-space whose restriction to the coordinate plane is
  the prescribed rational field. This file contains no proof.
*)

let statement =
  `let punctured = {x:real^3 | ~(x = vec 0)} in
   let xrepl =
     \(x:real^3) (i:num) (t:real).
       (lambda k. if k = i then t else x$k):real^3 in
   let has_derivative_at =
     \(h:real->real) (d:real) (a:real).
       !e:real.
         &0 < e
         ==> ?delta:real.
               &0 < delta /\
               !y:real.
                 &0 < abs (y - a) /\ abs (y - a) < delta
                 ==> abs ((h y - h a) / (y - a) - d) < e in
   let partial =
     \(h:real^3->real) (i:num) (x:real^3).
       @d:real.
         has_derivative_at
           (\t:real. h (xrepl x i t)) d (x$i) in
   let continuous_on_punctured =
     \(h:real^3->real).
       !x:real^3.
         x IN punctured
         ==> !e:real.
               &0 < e
               ==> ?delta:real.
                     &0 < delta /\
                     !y:real^3.
                       y IN punctured /\
                       (!k:num.
                          1 <= k /\ k <= 3
                          ==> abs (y$k - x$k) < delta)
                       ==> abs (h y - h x) < e in
   let c1_on_punctured =
     \(field:real^3->real^3).
       (!i j:num.
          1 <= i /\ i <= 3 /\ 1 <= j /\ j <= 3
          ==> !x:real^3.
                x IN punctured
                ==> has_derivative_at
                      (\t:real. (field (xrepl x j t))$i)
                      (partial (\y:real^3. (field y)$i) j x)
                      (x$j)) /\
       (!i j:num.
          1 <= i /\ i <= 3 /\ 1 <= j /\ j <= 3
          ==> continuous_on_punctured
                (partial (\x:real^3. (field x)$i) j)) in
   let curl =
     \(field:real^3->real^3) (x:real^3).
       (lambda i.
          if i = 1 then
            partial (\y:real^3. (field y)$3) 2 x -
            partial (\y:real^3. (field y)$2) 3 x
          else if i = 2 then
            partial (\y:real^3. (field y)$1) 3 x -
            partial (\y:real^3. (field y)$3) 1 x
          else
            partial (\y:real^3. (field y)$2) 1 x -
            partial (\y:real^3. (field y)$1) 2 x):real^3 in
   let G =
     \(v:real^2).
       (lambda i.
          if i = 1 then
            --(v$2) / ((v$1) pow 2 + &4 * (v$2) pow 2)
          else if i = 2 then
            (v$1) / ((v$1) pow 2 + &4 * (v$2) pow 2)
          else &0):real^3 in
   ~(?field:real^3->real^3.
       c1_on_punctured field /\
       (!x:real^3. x IN punctured ==> curl field x = vec 0) /\
       (!x y:real.
          field ((lambda i.
                    if i = 1 then x else if i = 2 then y else &0):real^3) =
          G ((lambda i.
                if i = 1 then x else y):real^2)))`;;

title: putnam_1987_a5
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1987_a5:
;; no continuously differentiable real vector field on punctured real
;; three-space is curl-free there and restricts on z = 0 to
;; (-y/(x^2+4y^2), x/(x^2+4y^2), 0). This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))

;; Reals are rational regular Cauchy names, vectors are length-three lists of
;; such names, and arbitrary extensional functions are tame APPLY$ objects.
;; FN-EQUAL supplies unbounded universal quantification; inequality with a
;; constant-false function supplies internal existential quantification.
;;
;; The vector field and its first-partial field are quantified together.
;; Coordinate difference quotients and joint continuity on the punctured
;; domain express the source C1 condition. The boundary equations multiply by
;; x^2+4y^2 away from the origin and explicitly use zero at the origin, exactly
;; matching the source provers' total real division.

(defun putnam-1987-a5-quoted (object)
  (list 'quote object))

(defun putnam-1987-a5-term-list (terms)
  (if (consp terms)
      (list 'cons
            (car terms)
            (putnam-1987-a5-term-list (cdr terms)))
    nil))

(defun putnam-1987-a5-apply-term (function arguments)
  (list 'apply$
        (putnam-1987-a5-quoted function)
        (putnam-1987-a5-term-list arguments)))

(defun putnam-1987-a5-apply-object-term
    (function-term arguments)
  (list 'apply$
        function-term
        (putnam-1987-a5-term-list arguments)))

(defun putnam-1987-a5-and-terms (terms)
  (if (consp terms)
      (list 'if
            (car terms)
            (putnam-1987-a5-and-terms (cdr terms))
            (putnam-1987-a5-quoted nil))
    (putnam-1987-a5-quoted t)))

(defun putnam-1987-a5-implies-term (hypothesis conclusion)
  (list 'if
        hypothesis
        conclusion
        (putnam-1987-a5-quoted t)))

(defun putnam-1987-a5-not-term (term)
  (list 'if
        term
        (putnam-1987-a5-quoted nil)
        (putnam-1987-a5-quoted t)))

(defun putnam-1987-a5-add-term (left right)
  (list 'binary-+ left right))

(defun putnam-1987-a5-negate-term (value)
  (list 'unary-- value))

(defun putnam-1987-a5-subtract-term (left right)
  (putnam-1987-a5-add-term
   left
   (putnam-1987-a5-negate-term right)))

(defun putnam-1987-a5-multiply-term (left right)
  (list 'binary-* left right))

(defun putnam-1987-a5-divide-term (numerator denominator)
  (putnam-1987-a5-multiply-term
   numerator
   (list 'unary-/ denominator)))

(defun putnam-1987-a5-absolute-term (value)
  (list 'if
        (list '< value (putnam-1987-a5-quoted 0))
        (putnam-1987-a5-negate-term value)
        value))

(defun putnam-1987-a5-less-equal-term (left right)
  (list 'if
        (list '< right left)
        (putnam-1987-a5-quoted nil)
        (putnam-1987-a5-quoted t)))

(defun putnam-1987-a5-minimum-term (left right)
  (list 'if
        (list '< left right)
        left
        right))

(defun putnam-1987-a5-positive-rational-term (value)
  (putnam-1987-a5-and-terms
   (list
    (list 'rationalp value)
    (list '< (putnam-1987-a5-quoted 0) value))))

(defun putnam-1987-a5-true-function (formals)
  (list 'lambda
        formals
        (putnam-1987-a5-quoted t)))

(defun putnam-1987-a5-real-value-term (name precision)
  (putnam-1987-a5-apply-term name (list precision)))

(defun putnam-1987-a5-object-real-value-term
    (name-term precision)
  (putnam-1987-a5-apply-object-term
   name-term
   (list precision)))

(defun putnam-1987-a5-real-cauchy-function (name)
  (let* ((left
          (putnam-1987-a5-real-value-term name 'epsilon))
         (right
          (putnam-1987-a5-real-value-term name 'eta))
         (distance
          (putnam-1987-a5-absolute-term
           (putnam-1987-a5-subtract-term left right))))
    (list
     'lambda
     '(epsilon eta)
     (putnam-1987-a5-implies-term
      (putnam-1987-a5-and-terms
       (list
        (putnam-1987-a5-positive-rational-term 'epsilon)
        (putnam-1987-a5-positive-rational-term 'eta)))
      (putnam-1987-a5-and-terms
       (list
        (list 'rationalp left)
        (list 'rationalp right)
        (putnam-1987-a5-less-equal-term
         distance
         (putnam-1987-a5-add-term
          'epsilon 'eta))))))))

(defun putnam-1987-a5-real-name-p (name)
  (and
   (tamep-functionp name)
   (fn-equal
    (putnam-1987-a5-real-cauchy-function name)
    (putnam-1987-a5-true-function
     '(epsilon eta)))))

;; Sampling both names at eta/4 makes the universal inequality equivalent to
;; the represented real distance being at most BOUND.
(defun putnam-1987-a5-real-distance-function
    (left-name right-name bound)
  (let* ((precision
          (putnam-1987-a5-multiply-term
           (putnam-1987-a5-quoted 1/4)
           'eta))
         (left
          (putnam-1987-a5-real-value-term
           left-name precision))
         (right
          (putnam-1987-a5-real-value-term
           right-name precision))
         (distance
          (putnam-1987-a5-absolute-term
           (putnam-1987-a5-subtract-term left right))))
    (list
     'lambda
     '(eta)
     (putnam-1987-a5-implies-term
      (putnam-1987-a5-positive-rational-term 'eta)
      (putnam-1987-a5-and-terms
       (list
        (list 'rationalp left)
        (list 'rationalp right)
        (putnam-1987-a5-less-equal-term
         distance
         (putnam-1987-a5-add-term
          (putnam-1987-a5-quoted bound)
          'eta))))))))

(defun putnam-1987-a5-real-distance-at-most-p
    (left-name right-name bound)
  (and
   (rationalp bound)
   (putnam-1987-a5-real-name-p left-name)
   (putnam-1987-a5-real-name-p right-name)
   (fn-equal
    (putnam-1987-a5-real-distance-function
     left-name right-name bound)
    (putnam-1987-a5-true-function '(eta)))))

(defun putnam-1987-a5-real-equal-p
    (left-name right-name)
  (putnam-1987-a5-real-distance-at-most-p
   left-name right-name 0))

(defun putnam-1987-a5-unary-output-function
    (function)
  (let ((output
         (putnam-1987-a5-apply-term function (list 'x))))
    (list
     'lambda
     '(x)
     (putnam-1987-a5-implies-term
      (list 'putnam-1987-a5-real-name-p 'x)
      (list 'putnam-1987-a5-real-name-p output)))))

(defun putnam-1987-a5-unary-extensional-function

         (putnam-1987-a5-apply-term
          function (list 'x-left)))
        (right-output
         (putnam-1987-a5-apply-term
          function (list 'x-right))))
    (list
     'lambda
     '(x-left x-right)
     (putnam-1987-a5-implies-term
      (list 'putnam-1987-a5-real-equal-p
            'x-left 'x-right)
      (list 'putnam-1987-a5-real-equal-p
            left-output right-output)))))

(defun putnam-1987-a5-real-function-p (function)

    (putnam-1987-a5-unary-output-function function)
    (putnam-1987-a5-true-function '(x)))

    (putnam-1987-a5-unary-extensional-function function)

     '(x-left x-right)))))

(defun putnam-1987-a5-rational-shift-name (name shift)

          'precision)))
    (list
     'lambda
     '(precision)
     (putnam-1987-a5-negate-term value))))

(defun putnam-1987-a5-real-scale-name (name scalar)
  (let* ((sample-precision
          (putnam-1987-a5-divide-term

           (putnam-1987-a5-add-term
            (putnam-1987-a5-quoted 1)

           (putnam-1987-a5-quoted 1)))

          (putnam-1987-a5-multiply-term
           (putnam-1987-a5-quoted 64)
           (putnam-1987-a5-add-term
            (putnam-1987-a5-quoted 1)
            (putnam-1987-a5-add-term
             (putnam-1987-a5-absolute-term left-coarse)
             (putnam-1987-a5-absolute-term right-coarse)))))
         (sample-precision
          (putnam-1987-a5-minimum-term
           (putnam-1987-a5-quoted 1)
           (putnam-1987-a5-divide-term
            'precision scale)))
         (left-value
          (putnam-1987-a5-object-real-value-term
           (putnam-1987-a5-quoted left-name)

         (right-value
          (putnam-1987-a5-object-real-value-term

     'lambda
     '(eta)

      (putnam-1987-a5-positive-rational-term 'eta)
      (putnam-1987-a5-less-equal-term

       (putnam-1987-a5-add-term right 'eta))))))

    (left-name right-name)

   (putnam-1987-a5-real-name-p left-name)
   (putnam-1987-a5-real-name-p right-name)

    (putnam-1987-a5-true-function '(eta)))))

    (epsilon name)
  (and
   (rationalp epsilon)
   (< 0 epsilon)
   (putnam-1987-a5-real-less-equal-p
    (putnam-1987-a5-constant-name epsilon)
    name)))

(defun putnam-1987-a5-positive-witness-failure-function
    (name)
  (list
   'lambda
   '(epsilon)
   (list
    'if
    (list 'putnam-1987-a5-positive-witness-p
          'epsilon
          (putnam-1987-a5-quoted name))
    (putnam-1987-a5-quoted nil)
    (putnam-1987-a5-quoted t))))

(defun putnam-1987-a5-real-positive-p (name)
  (let ((failure
         (putnam-1987-a5-positive-witness-failure-function
          name))
        (always-true
         (putnam-1987-a5-true-function '(epsilon))))
    (and
     (putnam-1987-a5-real-name-p name)
     (tamep-functionp failure)
     (tamep-functionp always-true)
     (not (fn-equal failure always-true)))))

(defun putnam-1987-a5-real-add-name
    (left-name right-name)
  (let* ((sample-precision
          (putnam-1987-a5-multiply-term
           (putnam-1987-a5-quoted 1/4)
           'precision))
         (left
          (putnam-1987-a5-object-real-value-term
           (putnam-1987-a5-quoted left-name)

         (right
          (putnam-1987-a5-object-real-value-term

    (list

     (putnam-1987-a5-add-term left right))))

(defun putnam-1987-a5-false-function (formals)
  (list 'lambda formals (putnam-1987-a5-quoted nil)))

(defun putnam-1987-a5-universal-p (function formals)
  (let ((always-true
         (putnam-1987-a5-true-function formals)))
    (and
     (tamep-functionp function)
     (tamep-functionp always-true)
     (fn-equal function always-true))))

  (let ((always-false
         (putnam-1987-a5-false-function formals)))

     (tamep-functionp function)

     (not (fn-equal function always-false)))))

;; Exact finite-dimensional real vectors.

(defun putnam-1987-a5-real-list-p (values)
  (if (consp values)
      (and
       (putnam-1987-a5-real-name-p (car values))
       (putnam-1987-a5-real-list-p (cdr values)))
    (equal values nil)))

(defun putnam-1987-a5-vector-p (vector n)
  (and
   (natp n)
   (true-listp vector)
   (equal (len vector) n)
   (putnam-1987-a5-real-list-p vector)))

(defun putnam-1987-a5-vector-equal-p (left right)
  (if (consp left)
      (and
       (consp right)
       (putnam-1987-a5-real-equal-p
        (car left) (car right))
       (putnam-1987-a5-vector-equal-p
        (cdr left) (cdr right)))
    (equal right nil)))

  (if (consp vector)
      (and
       (putnam-1987-a5-real-equal-p
        (car vector)
        (putnam-1987-a5-constant-name 0))
       (putnam-1987-a5-vector-zero-p (cdr vector)))
    (equal vector nil)))

(defun putnam-1987-a5-vector-nonzero-p (vector n)
  (and
   (putnam-1987-a5-vector-p vector n)
   (not (putnam-1987-a5-vector-zero-p vector))))

(defun putnam-1987-a5-vector-close-p
    (left right bound)
  (if (consp left)
      (and
       (consp right)
       (putnam-1987-a5-real-distance-at-most-p
        (car left) (car right) bound)
       (putnam-1987-a5-vector-close-p
        (cdr left) (cdr right) bound))
    (equal right nil)))

(defun putnam-1987-a5-vector-add (left right)
  (if (and (consp left) (consp right))
      (cons
       (putnam-1987-a5-real-add-name
        (car left) (car right))
       (putnam-1987-a5-vector-add
        (cdr left) (cdr right)))
    nil))

(defun putnam-1987-a5-vector-smul (scalar vector)
  (if (consp vector)
      (cons
       (putnam-1987-a5-real-product-name
        scalar (car vector))
       (putnam-1987-a5-vector-smul
        scalar (cdr vector)))
    nil))

(defun putnam-1987-a5-vector-rational-shift
    (vector index shift)
  (if (consp vector)
      (if (zp index)
          (cons
           (putnam-1987-a5-rational-shift-name
            (car vector) shift)
           (cdr vector))
        (cons
         (car vector)
         (putnam-1987-a5-vector-rational-shift
          (cdr vector) (- index 1) shift)))
    nil))

  (and (natp index) (< index n)))

title: putnam_1987_a5
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1987_a5:
-- nonexistence of a continuously partially differentiable curl-free real
-- vector field off the origin with the prescribed trace on the xy-plane.
-- This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; _*_)

infix 4 _!=_
infixr 3 _and_
infixr 2 _or_

data Bottom : Set where

Not : Set -> Set
Not A =
  A -> Bottom

_!=_ : {A : Set} -> A -> A -> Set
x != y =
  Not (x == y)

record _and_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data _or_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  left  : A -> A or B
  right : B -> A or B

record Iff (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor equivalence
  field
    forward  : A -> B
    backward : B -> A

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

record CompleteOrderedRealField (R : Set) : Set1 where
  field
    zeroR oneR : R
    add multiply : R -> R -> R
    negate inverse : R -> R
    lessOrEqual : R -> R -> Set
    fromNat : Nat -> R

    one-not-zero :
      oneR != zeroR

    add-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> add x y == add y x
    add-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      add (add x y) z == add x (add y z)
    add-zero :
      (x : R) -> add x zeroR == x
    add-inverse :
      (x : R) -> add x (negate x) == zeroR

    multiply-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> multiply x y == multiply y x
    multiply-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply (multiply x y) z ==
      multiply x (multiply y z)
    multiply-one :
      (x : R) -> multiply x oneR == x
    multiply-zero :
      (x : R) -> multiply x zeroR == zeroR
    distribute :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply x (add y z) ==
      add (multiply x y) (multiply x z)
    inverse-zero :
      inverse zeroR == zeroR
    multiply-inverse :
      (x : R) ->
      x != zeroR ->
      multiply x (inverse x) == oneR

    order-reflexive :
      (x : R) -> lessOrEqual x x
    order-transitive :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y z ->
      lessOrEqual x z
    order-antisymmetric :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y x ->
      x == y
    order-total :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y or lessOrEqual y x
    add-order :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual (add z x) (add z y)
    multiply-nonnegative :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR x ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR y ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR (multiply x y)
    zero-less-than-one :
      lessOrEqual zeroR oneR and zeroR != oneR

    fromNat-zero :
      fromNat zero == zeroR
    fromNat-successor :
      (n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (suc n) == add (fromNat n) oneR
    fromNat-addition :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m + n) == add (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-multiplication :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m * n) == multiply (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-injective :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat m == fromNat n ->
      m == n

    archimedean :
      (x : R) ->
      Exists Nat
        (\ n ->
          lessOrEqual x (fromNat n))
    least-upper-bound :
      (P : R -> Set) ->
      Exists R P ->
      Exists R
        (\ upper ->
          (x : R) ->
          P x ->
          lessOrEqual x upper) ->
      Exists R
        (\ supremum ->
          ((x : R) ->
            P x ->
            lessOrEqual x supremum)
          and
          ((upper : R) ->
            ((x : R) ->
              P x ->
              lessOrEqual x upper) ->
            lessOrEqual supremum upper))

open CompleteOrderedRealField

fourN : Nat
fourN =
  suc (suc (suc (suc zero)))

subtract :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
subtract reals x y =
  add reals x (negate reals y)

divide :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
divide reals x y =
  multiply reals x (inverse reals y)

square :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R
square reals x =
  multiply reals x x

StrictLess :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
StrictLess reals x y =
  lessOrEqual reals x y and x != y

CloseTo :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
CloseTo reals center radius x =
  StrictLess reals
    (subtract reals center radius)
    x
  and
  StrictLess reals
    x
    (add reals center radius)

differenceQuotient :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (R -> R) ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
differenceQuotient reals function point x =
  divide reals
    (subtract reals (function x) (function point))
    (subtract reals x point)

DerivativeAt :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (R -> R) ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
DerivativeAt {R} reals function point derivativeValue =
  (epsilon : R) ->
  StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) epsilon ->
  Exists R
    (\ delta ->
      StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) delta
      and
      ((x : R) ->
        CloseTo reals point delta x ->
        x != point ->
        CloseTo reals derivativeValue epsilon
          (differenceQuotient reals function point x)))

HasDerivativeAt :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (R -> R) ->
  R ->
  Set
HasDerivativeAt {R} reals function point =
  Exists R
    (\ derivativeValue ->
      DerivativeAt reals function point derivativeValue)

record StandardRealCalculus
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) : Set1 where

  field
    derivative : (R -> R) -> R -> R

    derivative-when-differentiable :
      (function : R -> R) ->
      (point : R) ->
      HasDerivativeAt reals function point ->
      DerivativeAt reals
        function
        point
        (derivative function point)

    derivative-when-not-differentiable :
      (function : R -> R) ->
      (point : R) ->
      Not (HasDerivativeAt reals function point) ->
      derivative function point == zeroR reals

open StandardRealCalculus

record Vector3 (R : Set) : Set where
  constructor vector3
  field
    xCoordinate : R
    yCoordinate : R
    zCoordinate : R

open Vector3

zeroVector3 :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Vector3 R
zeroVector3 reals =
  vector3
    (zeroR reals)
    (zeroR reals)
    (zeroR reals)

replaceX :
  {R : Set} ->
  Vector3 R ->
  R ->
  Vector3 R
replaceX point x =
  vector3 x (yCoordinate point) (zCoordinate point)

replaceY :
  {R : Set} ->
  Vector3 R ->
  R ->
  Vector3 R
replaceY point y =
  vector3 (xCoordinate point) y (zCoordinate point)

replaceZ :
  {R : Set} ->
  Vector3 R ->
  R ->
  Vector3 R
replaceZ point z =
  vector3 (xCoordinate point) (yCoordinate point) z

VectorClose :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Vector3 R ->
  R ->
  Vector3 R ->
  Set
VectorClose reals center radius point =
  CloseTo reals
    (xCoordinate center)
    radius
    (xCoordinate point)
  and
  CloseTo reals
    (yCoordinate center)
    radius
    (yCoordinate point)
  and
  CloseTo reals
    (zCoordinate center)
    radius
    (zCoordinate point)

Punctured :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Vector3 R ->
  Set
Punctured reals point =
  point != zeroVector3 reals

ContinuousOnPuncturedAt :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (Vector3 R -> R) ->
  Vector3 R ->
  Set
ContinuousOnPuncturedAt {R} reals function point =
  Punctured reals point ->
  (epsilon : R) ->
  StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) epsilon ->
  Exists R
    (\ delta ->
      StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) delta
      and
      ((nearby : Vector3 R) ->
        Punctured reals nearby ->
        VectorClose reals point delta nearby ->
        CloseTo reals
          (function point)
          epsilon
          (function nearby)))

ContinuousOnPunctured :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (Vector3 R -> R) ->
  Set
ContinuousOnPunctured {R} reals function =
  (point : Vector3 R) ->
  ContinuousOnPuncturedAt reals function point

partialX :
  {R : Set} ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) ->
  StandardRealCalculus reals ->
  (Vector3 R -> R) ->
  Vector3 R ->
  R
partialX reals calculus function point =
  derivative calculus
    (\ x -> function (replaceX point x))
    (xCoordinate point)

partialY :
  {R : Set} ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) ->
  StandardRealCalculus reals ->
  (Vector3 R -> R) ->
  Vector3 R ->
  R
partialY reals calculus function point =
  derivative calculus
    (\ y -> function (replaceY point y))
    (yCoordinate point)

partialZ :
  {R : Set} ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) ->
  StandardRealCalculus reals ->
  (Vector3 R -> R) ->
  Vector3 R ->
  R
partialZ reals calculus function point =
  derivative calculus
    (\ z -> function (replaceZ point z))
    (zCoordinate point)

HasPartialXAt :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (Vector3 R -> R) ->
  Vector3 R ->
  Set
HasPartialXAt reals function point =
  HasDerivativeAt reals
    (\ x -> function (replaceX point x))
    (xCoordinate point)

HasPartialYAt :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (Vector3 R -> R) ->
  Vector3 R ->
  Set
HasPartialYAt reals function point =
  HasDerivativeAt reals
    (\ y -> function (replaceY point y))
    (yCoordinate point)

HasPartialZAt :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (Vector3 R -> R) ->
  Vector3 R ->
  Set
HasPartialZAt reals function point =
  HasDerivativeAt reals
    (\ z -> function (replaceZ point z))
    (zCoordinate point)

HasContinuousPartialsOffOrigin :
  {R : Set} ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) ->
  StandardRealCalculus reals ->
  (Vector3 R -> R) ->
  Set
HasContinuousPartialsOffOrigin {R} reals calculus function =
  ((point : Vector3 R) ->
    Punctured reals point ->
    HasPartialXAt reals function point
    and
    HasPartialYAt reals function point
    and
    HasPartialZAt reals function point)
  and
  ContinuousOnPunctured reals
    (partialX reals calculus function)
  and
  ContinuousOnPunctured reals
    (partialY reals calculus function)
  and
  ContinuousOnPunctured reals
    (partialZ reals calculus function)

VectorField :
  Set ->
  Set
VectorField R =
  Vector3 R -> Vector3 R

firstComponent :
  {R : Set} ->
  VectorField R ->
  Vector3 R ->
  R
firstComponent vectorField point =
  xCoordinate (vectorField point)

secondComponent :
  {R : Set} ->
  VectorField R ->
  Vector3 R ->
  R
secondComponent vectorField point =
  yCoordinate (vectorField point)

thirdComponent :
  {R : Set} ->
  VectorField R ->
  Vector3 R ->
  R
thirdComponent vectorField point =
  zCoordinate (vectorField point)

VectorFieldHasContinuousPartialsOffOrigin :
  {R : Set} ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) ->
  StandardRealCalculus reals ->
  VectorField R ->
  Set
VectorFieldHasContinuousPartialsOffOrigin reals calculus vectorField =
  HasContinuousPartialsOffOrigin reals calculus
    (firstComponent vectorField)
  and
  HasContinuousPartialsOffOrigin reals calculus
    (secondComponent vectorField)
  and
  HasContinuousPartialsOffOrigin reals calculus
    (thirdComponent vectorField)

CurlFreeOffOrigin :
  {R : Set} ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) ->
  StandardRealCalculus reals ->
  VectorField R ->
  Set
CurlFreeOffOrigin {R} reals calculus vectorField =
  (point : Vector3 R) ->
  Punctured reals point ->
  subtract reals
    (partialY reals calculus (thirdComponent vectorField) point)
    (partialZ reals calculus (secondComponent vectorField) point)
  ==
  zeroR reals
  and
  subtract reals
    (partialZ reals calculus (firstComponent vectorField) point)
    (partialX reals calculus (thirdComponent vectorField) point)
  ==
  zeroR reals
  and
  subtract reals
    (partialX reals calculus (secondComponent vectorField) point)
    (partialY reals calculus (firstComponent vectorField) point)
  ==
  zeroR reals

prescribedDenominator :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
prescribedDenominator reals x y =
  add reals
    (square reals x)
    (multiply reals
      (fromNat reals fourN)
      (square reals y))

prescribedTrace :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Vector3 R
prescribedTrace reals x y =
  vector3
    (divide reals
      (negate reals y)
      (prescribedDenominator reals x y))
    (divide reals
      x
      (prescribedDenominator reals x y))
    (zeroR reals)

HasPrescribedTrace :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  VectorField R ->
  Set
HasPrescribedTrace {R} reals vectorField =
  (x y : R) ->
  vectorField (vector3 x y (zeroR reals)) ==
  prescribedTrace reals x y

Putnam1987A5Existence :
  {R : Set} ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) ->
  StandardRealCalculus reals ->
  Set
Putnam1987A5Existence {R} reals calculus =
  Exists (VectorField R)
    (\ vectorField ->
      VectorFieldHasContinuousPartialsOffOrigin
        reals calculus vectorField
      and
      CurlFreeOffOrigin reals calculus vectorField
      and
      HasPrescribedTrace reals vectorField)

putnam-1987-a5 : Set1
putnam-1987-a5 =
  (R : Set) ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) ->
  (calculus : StandardRealCalculus reals) ->
  Iff
    (Putnam1987A5Existence reals calculus)
    Bottom

title: putnam_1987_a5
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1987_a5:
  nonexistence of a continuously partially differentiable curl-free vector
  field on punctured three-space with a prescribed singular planar trace.
  This file contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open arithmeticTheory pairTheory pred_setTheory realTheory;
open real_topologyTheory limTheory;

val putnam_1987_a5 =
  ``let origin = (0, (0, 0)) : real # (real # real)
    in
    let coord =
      \v : real # (real # real).
      \i : num.
        if i = 0 then FST v
        else if i = 1 then FST (SND v)
        else SND (SND v)
    in
    let replace =
      \v : real # (real # real).
      \i : num.
      \t : real.
        if i = 0 then (t, (coord v 1, coord v 2))
        else if i = 1 then (coord v 0, (t, coord v 2))
        else (coord v 0, (coord v 1, t))
    in
    let component =
      \V : (real # (real # real)) -> (real # (real # real)).
      \i : num.
      \v : real # (real # real).
        coord (V v) i
    in
    let partderiv =
      \h : (real # (real # real)) -> real.
      \j : num.
      \v : real # (real # real).
        diffn 1 (\t : real. h (replace v j t)) (coord v j)
    in
    let sqdist =
      \v w : real # (real # real).
        (coord w 0 - coord v 0) pow 2 +
        (coord w 1 - coord v 1) pow 2 +
        (coord w 2 - coord v 2) pow 2
    in
    let continuous_on_punctured =
      \h : (real # (real # real)) -> real.
        !v : real # (real # real).
          v <> origin
          ==>
          !e : real.
            0 < e
            ==>
            ?d : real.
              0 < d /\
              !w : real # (real # real).
                w <> origin /\ sqdist v w < d
                ==>
                abs (h w - h v) < e
    in
    let has_continuous_partials =
      \V : (real # (real # real)) -> (real # (real # real)).
        !i j : num.
          i < 3 /\ j < 3
          ==>
          (!v : real # (real # real).
             v <> origin
             ==>
             higher_differentiable
               1
               (\t : real. component V i (replace v j t))
               (coord v j)) /\
          continuous_on_punctured (partderiv (component V i) j)
    in
    let curl_zero =
      \V : (real # (real # real)) -> (real # (real # real)).
        !v : real # (real # real).
          v <> origin
          ==>
          partderiv (component V 2) 1 v -
            partderiv (component V 1) 2 v = 0 /\
          partderiv (component V 0) 2 v -
            partderiv (component V 2) 0 v = 0 /\
          partderiv (component V 1) 0 v -
            partderiv (component V 0) 1 v = 0
    in
    let has_prescribed_trace =
      \V : (real # (real # real)) -> (real # (real # real)).
        !x y : real.
          V (x, (y, 0)) =
            (-y / (x pow 2 + 4 * y pow 2),
             (x / (x pow 2 + 4 * y pow 2), 0))
    in
      ((?V : (real # (real # real)) -> (real # (real # real)).
          has_continuous_partials V /\
          curl_zero V /\
          has_prescribed_trace V)
       <=> F)``;

title: putnam_1987_a5
content:
$(
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact
  putnam_1987_a5: nonexistence of a continuously differentiable real
  three-dimensional vector field with zero curl off the origin and a
  prescribed rational trace on the coordinate plane. This file contains no
  proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  P87A5I is the coordinate set 1 ... 3, P87A5V3 is the full real
  three-dimensional coordinate space, and P87A5Top is its standard finite
  product topology. P87A5Punctured removes only the zero vector.

  P87A5Repl replaces one coordinate, P87A5Slice is the resulting
  real-valued one-variable component slice, and P87A5Part is its native
  set.mm derivative at the original coordinate. The zero fallback makes the
  partial-derivative operator total and is inactive under P87A5C1.
  P87A5C1 requires all first coordinate partials to exist on the punctured
  space and their restrictions to be continuous there. Since the punctured
  space is open in finite-dimensional real space, this is equivalent to the
  source's C1 condition.

  P87A5CurlZero expands the three coordinate equations for zero curl.
  P87A5Trace inlines the uniquely specified source function G, eliminating
  only its definitional parameter. Its two quotients are explicitly
  totalized to zero when the common denominator vanishes, matching Lean,
  Rocq, HOL Light, and the PVS safe_div definition at (0,0). The final
  biconditional retains the annotated source solution False as F. All
  declarations are unproved $a statement encodings; this database contains
  no $p declaration.
$)

$c
  P87A5I P87A5V3 P87A5Top P87A5Zero P87A5Punctured
  P87A5Repl P87A5Vec P87A5Slice P87A5Part P87A5D1
  P87A5C1 P87A5CurlZero P87A5Trace
$.

p87a5-index-syntax $a class P87A5I $.
p87a5-vector-space-syntax $a class P87A5V3 $.
p87a5-vector-topology-syntax $a class P87A5Top $.
p87a5-zero-vector-syntax $a class P87A5Zero $.
p87a5-punctured-space-syntax $a class P87A5Punctured $.
p87a5-replace-syntax $a class ( P87A5Repl x i r ) $.
p87a5-vector-syntax $a class ( P87A5Vec x y z ) $.
p87a5-slice-syntax $a class ( P87A5Slice F i j x ) $.
p87a5-partial-syntax $a class ( P87A5Part F i j x ) $.
p87a5-first-partial-function-syntax $a class ( P87A5D1 F i j ) $.
p87a5-c1-syntax $a wff ( P87A5C1 F ) $.
p87a5-zero-curl-syntax $a wff ( P87A5CurlZero F ) $.
p87a5-trace-syntax $a wff ( P87A5Trace F ) $.

p87a5-index-definition $a |- P87A5I = ( 1 ... 3 ) $.

p87a5-vector-space-definition $a |- P87A5V3 = ( RR ^m P87A5I ) $.

p87a5-vector-topology-definition $a |- P87A5Top = (
  Xt_ `
    (
      P87A5I
      X.
      { ( TopOpen ` RRfld ) }
    )
) $.

${
  p87a5-zero-vector-definition $a |- P87A5Zero = (
    k e. P87A5I |-> 0
  ) $.
$}

p87a5-punctured-space-definition $a |- P87A5Punctured = (
  P87A5V3 \ { P87A5Zero }
) $.

${
  $d i k r x $.

  p87a5-replace-definition $a |- (
    P87A5Repl x i r
  ) = (
    k e. P87A5I |->
      if (
        k = i ,
        r ,
        ( x ` k )
      )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d k x y z $.

  p87a5-vector-definition $a |- (
    P87A5Vec x y z
  ) = (
    k e. P87A5I |->
      if (
        k = 1 ,
        x ,
        if (
          k = 2 ,
          y ,
          z
        )
      )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d F i j r x $.

  p87a5-slice-definition $a |- (
    P87A5Slice F i j x
  ) = (
    r e. RR |->
      (
        (
          F
          `
          ( P87A5Repl x j r )
        )
        ` i
      )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d F i j x $.

  p87a5-partial-definition $a |- (
    P87A5Part F i j x
  ) = if (
    ( x ` j ) e.
      dom
        (
          RR _D
            ( P87A5Slice F i j x )
        ) ,
    (
      (
        RR _D
          ( P87A5Slice F i j x )
      )
      ` ( x ` j )
    ) ,
    0
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d F i j x $.

  p87a5-first-partial-function-definition $a |- (
    P87A5D1 F i j
  ) = (
    x e. P87A5V3 |->
      ( P87A5Part F i j x )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d F i j x $.

  p87a5-c1-definition $a |- (
    ( P87A5C1 F )
    <->
    (
      F e. ( P87A5V3 ^m P87A5V3 )
      /\
      (
        A. i e. P87A5I
          A. j e. P87A5I
            A. x e. P87A5Punctured
              ( x ` j ) e.
                dom
                  (
                    RR _D
                      ( P87A5Slice F i j x )
                  )
        /\
        A. i e. P87A5I
          A. j e. P87A5I
            (
              ( P87A5D1 F i j )
              |`
              P87A5Punctured
            )
            e.
            (
              ( P87A5Top |`t P87A5Punctured )
              Cn
              ( TopOpen ` RRfld )
            )
      )
    )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d F x $.

  p87a5-zero-curl-definition $a |- (
    ( P87A5CurlZero F )
    <->
    A. x e. P87A5Punctured
      (
        (
          ( P87A5Part F 3 2 x )
          -
          ( P87A5Part F 2 3 x )
        )
        =
        0
        /\
        (
          (
            ( P87A5Part F 1 3 x )
            -
            ( P87A5Part F 3 1 x )
          )
          =
          0
          /\
          (
            (
              ( P87A5Part F 2 1 x )
              -
              ( P87A5Part F 1 2 x )
            )
            =
            0
          )
        )
      )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d F x y $.

  p87a5-trace-definition $a |- (
    ( P87A5Trace F )
    <->
    A. x e. RR
      A. y e. RR
        (
          F
          `
          ( P87A5Vec x y 0 )
        )
        =
        (
          P87A5Vec
            if (
              (
                ( x ^ 2 )
                +
                ( 4 x. ( y ^ 2 ) )
              )
              =
              0 ,
              0 ,
              (
                ( -u y )
                /
                (
                  ( x ^ 2 )
                  +
                  ( 4 x. ( y ^ 2 ) )
                )
              )
            )
            if (
              (
                ( x ^ 2 )
                +
                ( 4 x. ( y ^ 2 ) )
              )
              =
              0 ,
              0 ,
              (
                x
                /
                (
                  ( x ^ 2 )
                  +
                  ( 4 x. ( y ^ 2 ) )
                )
              )
            )
            0
        )
  ) $.
$}

${
  putnambench-putnam-1987-a5 $a |- (
    E. f e. ( P87A5V3 ^m P87A5V3 )
      (
        ( P87A5C1 f )
        /\
        (
          ( P87A5CurlZero f )
          /\
          ( P87A5Trace f )
        )
      )
    <->
    F.
  ) $.
$}

title: putnam_1987_a5
content:
% Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1987_a5:
% nonexistence of a C1 real vector field on punctured three-space with zero
% curl and the specified singular planar trace. This file contains no proof.

putnam_1987_a5: THEORY
BEGIN
  coordinate: TYPE = below(3)
  vector: TYPE = [coordinate -> real]
  scalar_field: TYPE = [vector -> real]
  vector_field: TYPE = [vector -> vector]
  partial_field: TYPE = [coordinate, coordinate -> scalar_field]

  zero_vector: vector =
    LAMBDA (i: coordinate): 0

  vector3(x, y, z: real): vector =
    LAMBDA (i: coordinate):
      IF i = 0 THEN
        x
      ELSIF i = 1 THEN
        y
      ELSE
        z
      ENDIF

  safe_div(numerator, denominator: real): real =
    IF denominator = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      numerator / denominator
    ENDIF

  prescribed_trace(x, y: real): vector =
    LAMBDA (i: coordinate):
      IF i = 0 THEN
        safe_div(-y, x ^ 2 + 4 * y ^ 2)
      ELSIF i = 1 THEN
        safe_div(x, x ^ 2 + 4 * y ^ 2)
      ELSE
        0
      ENDIF

  replace_coordinate(
      x: vector,
      i: coordinate,
      value: real): vector =
    LAMBDA (j: coordinate):
      IF j = i THEN value ELSE x(j) ENDIF

  vectors_close(x, y: vector, radius: real): bool =
    FORALL (i: coordinate):
      abs(x(i) - y(i)) < radius

  punctured(x: vector): bool =
    x /= zero_vector

  has_partial_derivative_at(
      f: scalar_field,
      i: coordinate,
      derivative: real,
      x: vector): bool =
    FORALL (epsilon_value: posreal):
      EXISTS (delta: posreal):
        FORALL (h: real):
          (h /= 0 AND abs(h) < delta)
            IMPLIES
              abs(
                f(replace_coordinate(x, i, x(i) + h))
                  - f(x)
                  - derivative * h)
                < epsilon_value * abs(h)

  continuous_on_punctured(f: scalar_field): bool =
    FORALL (x: vector):
      punctured(x) IMPLIES
        FORALL (epsilon_value: posreal):
          EXISTS (delta: posreal):
            FORALL (y: vector):
              (punctured(y) AND vectors_close(y, x, delta))
                IMPLIES
                  abs(f(y) - f(x)) < epsilon_value

  continuously_partially_differentiable(
      F: vector_field,
      D: partial_field): bool =
    (FORALL
        (component, input: coordinate),
        (x: vector):
      punctured(x) IMPLIES
        has_partial_derivative_at(
          LAMBDA (v: vector): F(v)(component),
          input,
          D(component, input)(x),
          x))
      AND
    (FORALL (component, input: coordinate):
      continuous_on_punctured(D(component, input)))

  curl_zero_on_punctured(D: partial_field): bool =
    FORALL (x: vector):
      punctured(x) IMPLIES
        D(2, 1)(x) - D(1, 2)(x) = 0
          AND D(0, 2)(x) - D(2, 0)(x) = 0
          AND D(1, 0)(x) - D(0, 1)(x) = 0

  has_prescribed_trace(F: vector_field): bool =
    FORALL (x, y: real):
      F(vector3(x, y, 0)) = prescribed_trace(x, y)

  putnam_1987_a5_solution: bool = FALSE

  putnam_1987_a5: bool =
    (EXISTS (F: vector_field), (D: partial_field):
      continuously_partially_differentiable(F, D)
        AND curl_zero_on_punctured(D)
        AND has_prescribed_trace(F))
      IFF putnam_1987_a5_solution
END putnam_1987_a5
