import Mathlib

open MvPolynomial Real Nat

abbrev putnam_1987_a6_solution : Set ℝ := sorry
-- {x : ℝ | x > 0 ∧ x < 25}
/--
For each positive integer $n$, let $a(n)$ be the number of zeroes in the base $3$ representation of $n$. For which positive real numbers $x$ does the series
\[
\sum_{n=1}^\infty \frac{x^{a(n)}}{n^3}
\]
converge?
-/
theorem putnam_1987_a6
(a : ℕ → ℕ)
(ha : a = fun n ↦ {i | (digits 3 n).get i = 0}.ncard)
: ({x : ℝ | x > 0 ∧ Summable (fun n ↦ x ^ (a n) / (n ^ 3))} = putnam_1987_a6_solution) :=
sorry

title: putnam_1987_a6
content:
(* Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench artifact putnam_1987_a6:
   convergence of a series weighted by zero digits in base 3; this file
   contains no proof. *)

From Stdlib Require Import Reals List Arith.PeanoNat SeqSeries.

Open Scope R_scope.

Fixpoint putnam_1987_a6_digits_b3_fuel
    (fuel n : nat) : list nat :=
  match fuel with
  | O => nil
  | S fuel' =>
      if Nat.ltb n 3
      then cons n nil
      else cons (Nat.modulo n 3)
                (putnam_1987_a6_digits_b3_fuel fuel' (Nat.div n 3))
  end.

Definition putnam_1987_a6_digits_b3 (n : nat) : list nat :=
  putnam_1987_a6_digits_b3_fuel (S n) n.

Fixpoint putnam_1987_a6_count_zeros (digits : list nat) : nat :=
  match digits with
  | nil => O
  | cons d rest =>
      if Nat.eqb d 0
      then S (putnam_1987_a6_count_zeros rest)
      else putnam_1987_a6_count_zeros rest
  end.

Definition putnam_1987_a6_zero_count (n : nat) : nat :=
  putnam_1987_a6_count_zeros (putnam_1987_a6_digits_b3 n).

Definition putnam_1987_a6_solution (x : R) : Prop :=
  0 < x /\ x < 25.

Definition putnam_1987_a6_summable (u : nat -> R) : Prop :=
  exists limit : R, Un_cv (fun n : nat => sum_f_R0 u n) limit.

Theorem putnam_1987_a6 :
  forall x : R,
    (0 < x /\
     putnam_1987_a6_summable
       (fun k : nat =>
          x ^ putnam_1987_a6_zero_count (S k) /
          INR (S k) ^ 3)) <->
    putnam_1987_a6_solution x.
Admitted.

title: putnam_1987_a6
content:
theory putnam_1987_a6 imports Complex_Main
begin

definition putnam_1987_a6_solution::"real set" where "putnam_1987_a6_solution \<equiv> undefined"
(*  { x. x > 0 \<and> x < 25 } *)
fun digits_b3::"nat \<Rightarrow> nat list" where
  "digits_b3 n = (if n < 3 then [n] else ([n mod 3::nat] @ digits_b3 (n div 3::nat)))"
theorem putnam_1987_a6:
  fixes a::"nat\<Rightarrow>nat"
  defines "a \<equiv> \<lambda>n. card {i::nat. i < length (digits_b3 n) \<and> (digits_b3 n)!i = 0}"
  shows "putnam_1987_a6_solution = {x::real. x > 0 \<and> summable (\<lambda>n. x^(a n) / n^3)}"
  sorry

end

title: putnam_1987_a6
putnam_1987_a6
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1987_a6:
;; the positive real numbers for which the series x^(a(n))/n^3 converges,
;; where a(n) counts zeroes in the base-3 digits of n, are exactly 0 < x < 25.
;; This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))

;; ACL2 has no primitive carrier containing every real number. Following the
;; repository's statement-only convention for real analysis, the conservative
;; interfaces below describe an arbitrary Dedekind-complete Archimedean ordered
;; field, hence the real field up to ordered-field isomorphism. All carrier,
;; algebraic, order, completeness, and convergence conditions are explicit;
;; no real is replaced by a rational or by a finite table.

(defstub putnam-1987-a6-real-p (real-type value) t)
(defstub putnam-1987-a6-zero (real-type) t)
(defstub putnam-1987-a6-one (real-type) t)
(defstub putnam-1987-a6-add (real-type left right) t)
(defstub putnam-1987-a6-mul (real-type left right) t)
(defstub putnam-1987-a6-neg (real-type value) t)
(defstub putnam-1987-a6-inv (real-type value) t)
(defstub putnam-1987-a6-less (real-type left right) t)
(defstub putnam-1987-a6-supremum (real-type set) t)

(defun putnam-1987-a6-leq (real-type left right)
  (not (putnam-1987-a6-less real-type right left)))

(defun putnam-1987-a6-sub (real-type left right)
  (putnam-1987-a6-add
   real-type
   left
   (putnam-1987-a6-neg real-type right)))

(defun putnam-1987-a6-div (real-type numerator denominator)
  (putnam-1987-a6-mul
   real-type
   numerator
   (putnam-1987-a6-inv real-type denominator)))

(defun putnam-1987-a6-abs (real-type value)
  (if (putnam-1987-a6-less
       real-type value (putnam-1987-a6-zero real-type))
      (putnam-1987-a6-neg real-type value)
    value))

(defun putnam-1987-a6-positive-p (real-type value)
  (and
   (putnam-1987-a6-real-p real-type value)
   (putnam-1987-a6-less
    real-type (putnam-1987-a6-zero real-type) value)))

(defun putnam-1987-a6-real-set-member-p (set value)
  (if (apply$ set (list value)) t nil))

(defun-sk putnam-1987-a6-valid-real-set-p (real-type set)
  (forall (value)
    (implies
     (putnam-1987-a6-real-set-member-p set value)
     (putnam-1987-a6-real-p real-type value))))

;; Complete ordered-field structure.

(defun-sk putnam-1987-a6-field-laws-p (real-type)
  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (putnam-1987-a6-real-p real-type x)
      (putnam-1987-a6-real-p real-type y)
      (putnam-1987-a6-real-p real-type z))
     (let* ((zero (putnam-1987-a6-zero real-type))
            (one (putnam-1987-a6-one real-type))
            (xy-add (putnam-1987-a6-add real-type x y))
            (yz-add (putnam-1987-a6-add real-type y z))
            (xy-mul (putnam-1987-a6-mul real-type x y))
            (yz-mul (putnam-1987-a6-mul real-type y z))
            (neg-x (putnam-1987-a6-neg real-type x))
            (inv-x (putnam-1987-a6-inv real-type x)))
       (and
        (putnam-1987-a6-real-p real-type xy-add)
        (putnam-1987-a6-real-p real-type xy-mul)
        (putnam-1987-a6-real-p real-type neg-x)
        (putnam-1987-a6-real-p real-type inv-x)
        (equal
         (putnam-1987-a6-add real-type xy-add z)
         (putnam-1987-a6-add real-type x yz-add))
        (equal xy-add (putnam-1987-a6-add real-type y x))
        (equal (putnam-1987-a6-add real-type x zero) x)
        (equal (putnam-1987-a6-add real-type x neg-x) zero)
        (equal
         (putnam-1987-a6-mul real-type xy-mul z)
         (putnam-1987-a6-mul real-type x yz-mul))
        (equal xy-mul (putnam-1987-a6-mul real-type y x))
        (equal (putnam-1987-a6-mul real-type x one) x)
        (implies
         (equal x zero)
         (equal inv-x zero))
        (implies
         (not (equal x zero))
         (equal
          (putnam-1987-a6-mul real-type x inv-x)
          one))
        (equal
         (putnam-1987-a6-mul real-type x yz-add)
         (putnam-1987-a6-add
          real-type
          (putnam-1987-a6-mul real-type x y)
          (putnam-1987-a6-mul real-type x z))))))))

(defun-sk putnam-1987-a6-order-laws-p (real-type)
  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (putnam-1987-a6-real-p real-type x)
      (putnam-1987-a6-real-p real-type y)
      (putnam-1987-a6-real-p real-type z))
     (let ((zero (putnam-1987-a6-zero real-type)))
       (and
        (not (putnam-1987-a6-less real-type x x))
        (or
         (putnam-1987-a6-less real-type x y)
         (equal x y)
         (putnam-1987-a6-less real-type y x))
        (implies
         (and
          (putnam-1987-a6-less real-type x y)
          (putnam-1987-a6-less real-type y z))
         (putnam-1987-a6-less real-type x z))
        (implies
         (putnam-1987-a6-less real-type x y)
         (putnam-1987-a6-less
          real-type
          (putnam-1987-a6-add real-type x z)
          (putnam-1987-a6-add real-type y z)))
        (implies
         (and
          (putnam-1987-a6-less real-type zero x)
          (putnam-1987-a6-less real-type zero y))
         (putnam-1987-a6-less
          real-type
          zero
          (putnam-1987-a6-mul real-type x y))))))))

(defun-sk putnam-1987-a6-upper-bound-p
    (real-type set upper)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (and
      (putnam-1987-a6-real-p real-type x)
      (putnam-1987-a6-real-set-member-p set x))
     (putnam-1987-a6-leq real-type x upper))))

(defun-sk putnam-1987-a6-real-set-nonempty-p
    (real-type set)
  (exists (x)
    (and
     (putnam-1987-a6-real-p real-type x)
     (putnam-1987-a6-real-set-member-p set x))))

(defun-sk putnam-1987-a6-real-set-bounded-p
    (real-type set)
  (exists (upper)
    (and
     (putnam-1987-a6-real-p real-type upper)
     (putnam-1987-a6-upper-bound-p
      real-type set upper))))

(defun-sk putnam-1987-a6-least-upper-bound-p
    (real-type set supremum)
  (forall (upper)
    (implies
     (and
      (putnam-1987-a6-real-p real-type upper)
      (putnam-1987-a6-upper-bound-p
       real-type set upper))
     (putnam-1987-a6-leq
      real-type supremum upper))))

(defun-sk putnam-1987-a6-completeness-p (real-type)
  (forall (set)
    (implies
     (and
      (tamep-functionp set)
      (putnam-1987-a6-valid-real-set-p real-type set)
      (putnam-1987-a6-real-set-nonempty-p real-type set)
      (putnam-1987-a6-real-set-bounded-p real-type set))
     (let ((supremum
            (putnam-1987-a6-supremum real-type set)))
       (and
        (putnam-1987-a6-real-p real-type supremum)
        (putnam-1987-a6-upper-bound-p
         real-type set supremum)
        (putnam-1987-a6-least-upper-bound-p
         real-type set supremum))))))

(defun putnam-1987-a6-r-nat (real-type n)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix n)))
  (if (zp n)
      (putnam-1987-a6-zero real-type)
    (putnam-1987-a6-add
     real-type
     (putnam-1987-a6-one real-type)
     (putnam-1987-a6-r-nat real-type (1- n)))))

(defun-sk putnam-1987-a6-archimedean-witness-p
    (real-type value)
  (exists (n)
    (and
     (natp n)
     (putnam-1987-a6-less
      real-type
      value
      (putnam-1987-a6-r-nat real-type n)))))

(defun-sk putnam-1987-a6-archimedean-p (real-type)
  (forall (value)
    (implies
     (putnam-1987-a6-real-p real-type value)
     (putnam-1987-a6-archimedean-witness-p
      real-type value))))

(defun putnam-1987-a6-real-field-p (real-type)
  (let ((zero (putnam-1987-a6-zero real-type))
        (one (putnam-1987-a6-one real-type)))
    (and
     (putnam-1987-a6-real-p real-type zero)
     (putnam-1987-a6-real-p real-type one)
     (not (equal zero one))
     (putnam-1987-a6-field-laws-p real-type)
     (putnam-1987-a6-order-laws-p real-type)
     (putnam-1987-a6-less real-type zero one)
     (putnam-1987-a6-completeness-p real-type)
     (putnam-1987-a6-archimedean-p real-type))))

;; Exact base-3 zero count. The fuel is internal and exceeds the number of
;; recursive base-3 divisions for every natural input.

(defun putnam-1987-a6-zero-digits-aux (n fuel)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix fuel)))
  (cond
   ((or (not (natp n))
        (zp fuel))
    0)
   ((< n 3)
    (if (equal n 0) 1 0))
   (t
    (+ (if (equal (mod n 3) 0) 1 0)
       (putnam-1987-a6-zero-digits-aux
        (floor n 3)
        (1- fuel))))))

(defun putnam-1987-a6-zero-digits (n)
  (if (natp n)
      (putnam-1987-a6-zero-digits-aux n (+ n 1))
    0))

(defun putnam-1987-a6-r-power
    (real-type base exponent)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix exponent)))
  (if (zp exponent)
      (putnam-1987-a6-one real-type)
    (putnam-1987-a6-mul
     real-type
     base
     (putnam-1987-a6-r-power
      real-type base (1- exponent)))))

(defun putnam-1987-a6-term (real-type x n)
  (if (natp n)
      (putnam-1987-a6-div
       real-type
       (putnam-1987-a6-r-power
        real-type
        x
        (putnam-1987-a6-zero-digits n))
       (putnam-1987-a6-r-power
        real-type
        (putnam-1987-a6-r-nat real-type n)
        3))
    (putnam-1987-a6-zero real-type)))

;; Sum over 0 <= n < TERMS. At n = 0 the field inverse of zero is zero,
;; matching the totalized division used by the Lean and Isabelle statements;
;; consequently this is the same series as the published sum from n = 1.

(defun putnam-1987-a6-prefix-sum
    (real-type x terms)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix terms)))
  (if (zp terms)
      (putnam-1987-a6-zero real-type)
    (let ((index (1- terms)))
      (putnam-1987-a6-add
       real-type
       (putnam-1987-a6-prefix-sum
        real-type x index)
       (putnam-1987-a6-term
        real-type x index)))))

;; Literal epsilon-N convergence of the partial sums to an internally
;; existentially quantified real limit.

(defun-sk putnam-1987-a6-limit-tail-p
    (real-type x limit epsilon cutoff)
  (forall (terms)
    (implies
     (and
      (natp terms)
      (natp cutoff)
      (<= cutoff terms))
     (putnam-1987-a6-less
      real-type
      (putnam-1987-a6-abs
       real-type
       (putnam-1987-a6-sub
        real-type
        (putnam-1987-a6-prefix-sum
         real-type x terms)
        limit))
      epsilon))))

(defun-sk putnam-1987-a6-limit-cutoff-p
    (real-type x limit epsilon)
  (exists (cutoff)
    (and
     (natp cutoff)
     (putnam-1987-a6-limit-tail-p
      real-type x limit epsilon cutoff))))

(defun-sk putnam-1987-a6-converges-to-p
    (real-type x limit)
  (forall (epsilon)
    (implies
     (putnam-1987-a6-positive-p real-type epsilon)
     (putnam-1987-a6-limit-cutoff-p
      real-type x limit epsilon))))

(defun-sk putnam-1987-a6-summable-p (real-type x)
  (exists (limit)
    (and
     (putnam-1987-a6-real-p real-type limit)
     (putnam-1987-a6-converges-to-p
      real-type x limit))))

;; Equality of the two source sets is expressed extensionally, without taking
;; 0 < x < 25 as an assumption: every real x is in the positive convergence
;; set if and only if it lies in the open interval (0,25).

(defun-sk putnam-1987-a6-classification-p (real-type)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (putnam-1987-a6-real-p real-type x)
     (iff
      (and
       (putnam-1987-a6-positive-p real-type x)
       (putnam-1987-a6-summable-p real-type x))
      (and
       (putnam-1987-a6-positive-p real-type x)
       (putnam-1987-a6-less
        real-type
        x
        (putnam-1987-a6-r-nat real-type 25)))))))

(defun putnambench-putnam-1987-a6-statement (real-type)
  (implies
   (putnam-1987-a6-real-field-p real-type)
   (putnam-1987-a6-classification-p real-type)))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

title: putnam_1987_a6
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1987_a6:
-- the positive real numbers for which the series x^(a(n))/n^3 converges,
-- where a(n) counts zeroes in the base-3 digits of n, are exactly 0 < x < 25.
-- This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

open import Agda.Builtin.Bool using (Bool; false; true)
open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using
  (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; _*_; div-helper; mod-helper)

infix 4 _!=_ _<=N_
infixr 3 _and_
infixr 2 _or_

data Bottom : Set where

Not : Set -> Set
Not A =
  A -> Bottom

_!=_ : {A : Set} -> A -> A -> Set
x != y =
  Not (x == y)

record _and_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data _or_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  left  : A -> A or B
  right : B -> A or B

record Iff (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor equivalence
  field
    forward  : A -> B
    backward : B -> A

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

data _<=N_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set where
  zero<=   : {n : Nat} -> zero <=N n
  suc<=suc : {m n : Nat} -> m <=N n -> suc m <=N suc n

record CompleteOrderedRealField (R : Set) : Set1 where
  field
    zeroR oneR : R
    add multiply : R -> R -> R
    negate inverse : R -> R
    lessOrEqual : R -> R -> Set
    fromNat : Nat -> R

    one-not-zero :
      oneR != zeroR

    add-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> add x y == add y x
    add-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      add (add x y) z == add x (add y z)
    add-zero :
      (x : R) -> add x zeroR == x
    add-inverse :
      (x : R) -> add x (negate x) == zeroR

    multiply-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> multiply x y == multiply y x
    multiply-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply (multiply x y) z ==
      multiply x (multiply y z)
    multiply-one :
      (x : R) -> multiply x oneR == x
    multiply-zero :
      (x : R) -> multiply x zeroR == zeroR
    distribute :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply x (add y z) ==
      add (multiply x y) (multiply x z)
    inverse-zero :
      inverse zeroR == zeroR
    multiply-inverse :
      (x : R) ->
      x != zeroR ->
      multiply x (inverse x) == oneR

    order-reflexive :
      (x : R) -> lessOrEqual x x
    order-transitive :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y z ->
      lessOrEqual x z
    order-antisymmetric :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y x ->
      x == y
    order-total :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y or lessOrEqual y x
    add-order :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual (add z x) (add z y)
    multiply-nonnegative :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR x ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR y ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR (multiply x y)
    zero-less-than-one :
      lessOrEqual zeroR oneR and zeroR != oneR

    fromNat-zero :
      fromNat zero == zeroR
    fromNat-successor :
      (n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (suc n) == add (fromNat n) oneR
    fromNat-addition :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m + n) == add (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-multiplication :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m * n) == multiply (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-injective :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat m == fromNat n ->
      m == n

    archimedean :
      (x : R) ->
      Exists Nat
        (\ n ->
          lessOrEqual x (fromNat n))
    least-upper-bound :
      (P : R -> Set) ->
      Exists R P ->
      Exists R
        (\ upper ->
          (x : R) ->
          P x ->
          lessOrEqual x upper) ->
      Exists R
        (\ supremum ->
          ((x : R) ->
            P x ->
            lessOrEqual x supremum)
          and
          ((upper : R) ->
            ((x : R) ->
              P x ->
              lessOrEqual x upper) ->
            lessOrEqual supremum upper))

open CompleteOrderedRealField

oneN : Nat
oneN =
  suc zero

threeN : Nat
threeN =
  suc (suc (suc zero))

twentyFiveN : Nat
twentyFiveN =
  25

natEqual : Nat -> Nat -> Bool
natEqual zero zero =
  true
natEqual zero (suc n) =
  false
natEqual (suc m) zero =
  false
natEqual (suc m) (suc n) =
  natEqual m n

natLess : Nat -> Nat -> Bool
natLess zero zero =
  false
natLess zero (suc n) =
  true
natLess (suc m) zero =
  false
natLess (suc m) (suc n) =
  natLess m n

naturalDiv : Nat -> Nat -> Nat
naturalDiv numerator zero =
  zero
naturalDiv numerator (suc denominator) =
  div-helper zero denominator numerator denominator

naturalMod : Nat -> Nat -> Nat
naturalMod numerator zero =
  zero
naturalMod numerator (suc denominator) =
  mod-helper zero denominator numerator denominator

zeroIndicator : Nat -> Nat
zeroIndicator n with natEqual n zero
... | false =
  zero
... | true =
  oneN

ternaryZeroCountWithFuel : Nat -> Nat -> Nat
ternaryZeroCountWithFuel zero n =
  zero
ternaryZeroCountWithFuel (suc fuel) n with natLess n threeN
... | true =
  zeroIndicator n
... | false =
  zeroIndicator (naturalMod n threeN) +
  ternaryZeroCountWithFuel fuel (naturalDiv n threeN)

ternaryZeroCount : Nat -> Nat
ternaryZeroCount zero =
  oneN
ternaryZeroCount (suc n) =
  ternaryZeroCountWithFuel (suc n) (suc n)

subtract :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
subtract reals x y =
  add reals x (negate reals y)

divide :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
divide reals x y =
  multiply reals x (inverse reals y)

StrictLess :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
StrictLess reals x y =
  lessOrEqual reals x y and x != y

CloseTo :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
CloseTo reals center radius x =
  StrictLess reals
    (subtract reals center radius)
    x
  and
  StrictLess reals
    x
    (add reals center radius)

naturalPower :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  Nat ->
  R
naturalPower reals x zero =
  oneR reals
naturalPower reals x (suc n) =
  multiply reals
    (naturalPower reals x n)
    x

sumFirst :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Nat ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  R
sumFirst reals zero term =
  zeroR reals
sumFirst reals (suc n) term =
  add reals
    (sumFirst reals n term)
    (term n)

ConvergesTo :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  R ->
  Set
ConvergesTo {R} reals sequence limit =
  (epsilon : R) ->
  StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) epsilon ->
  Exists Nat
    (\ cutoff ->
      (n : Nat) ->
      cutoff <=N n ->
      CloseTo reals limit epsilon (sequence n))

SeriesHasSum :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  R ->
  Set
SeriesHasSum reals terms limit =
  ConvergesTo reals
    (\ n -> sumFirst reals n terms)
    limit

Subset :
  Set ->
  Set1
Subset A =
  A -> Set

SetEqual :
  {A : Set} ->
  Subset A ->
  Subset A ->
  Set
SetEqual left-set right-set =
  (x : _) ->
  Iff (left-set x) (right-set x)

module Putnam1987A6Statement
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) where

  seriesTerm :
    (Nat -> Nat) ->
    R ->
    Nat ->
    R
  seriesTerm a x n =
    let
      positiveIndex = suc n
    in
    divide reals
      (naturalPower reals x (a positiveIndex))
      (fromNat reals
        (positiveIndex * positiveIndex * positiveIndex))

  SeriesConverges :
    (Nat -> Nat) ->
    R ->
    Set
  SeriesConverges a x =
    Exists R
      (\ limit ->
        SeriesHasSum reals
          (seriesTerm a x)
          limit)

  positiveConvergenceSet :
    (Nat -> Nat) ->
    Subset R
  positiveConvergenceSet a x =
    StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) x
    and
    SeriesConverges a x

  solutionSet : Subset R
  solutionSet x =
    StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) x
    and
    StrictLess reals
      x
      (fromNat reals twentyFiveN)

  proposition : Set
  proposition =
    (a : Nat -> Nat) ->
    ((n : Nat) ->
      a (suc n) == ternaryZeroCount (suc n)) ->
    SetEqual
      (positiveConvergenceSet a)
      solutionSet

putnam-1987-a6 : Set1
putnam-1987-a6 =
  (R : Set) ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) ->
  Putnam1987A6Statement.proposition reals

title: putnam_1987_a6
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1987_a6:
  convergence of the series x^(a(n))/n^3, where a(n) counts zeroes in the
  base-3 representation of n. This file contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open arithmeticTheory listTheory numposrepTheory pred_setTheory realTheory
     seqTheory;

val putnam_1987_a6 =
  ``let digits_b3 =
      \n : num. if n = 0 then [0] else n2l 3 n
    in
    let a =
      \n : num.
        LENGTH (FILTER (\d : num. d = 0) (digits_b3 n))
    in
      {x : real |
         0 < x /\
         summable
           (\n : num.
              x pow (a n) / ((&n : real) pow 3))} =
      {x : real | 0 < x /\ x < 25}``;

title: putnam_1987_a6
content:
$(
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact
  putnam_1987_a6: the positive real parameters for which the series whose
  nth term is x raised to the number of zeroes in the base-three expansion
  of n, divided by n cubed, converges. This file contains no proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  For positive n, P87A6A(n) counts the nonnegative positions k at or below
  the leading base-three digit for which floor(n / 3^k) modulo 3 is zero.
  Thus it is exactly the number of zeroes in the base-three representation
  used by both ground-truth sources. Restricting the series index to NN
  removes only their n = 0 term, which is zero because real division by zero
  is totalized to zero.

  In set.mm an unbounded sum belongs to RR exactly when its real partial sums
  converge. Therefore the left side is the source set of positive real x for
  which the series is summable, and the right side is its annotated solution
  set 0 < x < 25. All declarations are unproved $a statement encodings; this
  database contains no $p proof declaration.
$)

$c P87A6A $.

p87a6-a-syntax $a class P87A6A $.

${
  $d k n $.

  p87a6-a-definition $a |- P87A6A =
    (
      n e. NN |->
        (
          # `
          {
            k e. NN0 |
            (
              ( 3 ^ k ) <_ n
              /\
              (
                (
                  ( |_ ` ( n / ( 3 ^ k ) ) )
                  mod
                  3
                )
                =
                0
              )
            )
          }
        )
    )
  $.
$}

${
  $d n x $.

  putnambench-putnam-1987-a6 $a |-
    {
      x e. RR |
      (
        0 < x
        /\
        (
          sum_ n e. NN
            (
              ( x ^ ( P87A6A ` n ) )
              /
              ( n ^ 3 )
            )
        )
        e. RR
      )
    }
    =
    {
      x e. RR |
      (
        0 < x
        /\
        x < ; 2 5
      )
    }
  $.
$}

begin

::$P-
theorem
  for a being Function of NAT,NAT st
    (for n being Nat holds
      a.n = card {i where i is Element of NAT :

  holds

::$P+

title: putnam_1987_a6
content:
% Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1987_a6:
% the positive real parameters for which the series determined by the number
% of zeroes in base-3 expansions converges are exactly those below 25. This
% file contains no proof.

putnam_1987_a6: THEORY
BEGIN
  real_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> real]

  safe_div(numerator, denominator: real): real =
    IF denominator = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      numerator / denominator
    ENDIF

  zero_digits_below(
      n, count: nat): RECURSIVE nat =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      LET index: nat = count - 1,
          quotient: nat = ndiv(n, 3 ^ index)
      IN
        zero_digits_below(n, count - 1)
          + IF quotient > 0 AND mod(quotient, 3) = 0 THEN
              1
            ELSE
              0
            ENDIF
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  base3_zero_count(n: nat): nat =
    zero_digits_below(n, n + 1)

  partial_sum(
      values: real_sequence,
      count: nat): RECURSIVE real =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      partial_sum(values, count - 1) + values(count - 1)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  series_converges(values: real_sequence): bool =
    EXISTS (total: real):
      FORALL (epsilon_value: posreal):
        EXISTS (cutoff: nat):
          FORALL (count: nat):
            cutoff <= count IMPLIES
              abs(partial_sum(values, count) - total)
                < epsilon_value

  series_terms(x: real): real_sequence =
    LAMBDA (index: nat):
      LET n: nat = index + 1 IN
        safe_div(
          x ^ base3_zero_count(n),
          (n :: real) ^ 3)

  putnam_1987_a6_solution(x: real): bool =
    x > 0 AND x < 25

  putnam_1987_a6: bool =
    FORALL (x: real):
      (x > 0 AND series_converges(series_terms(x)))
        IFF putnam_1987_a6_solution(x)
END putnam_1987_a6

title: putnam_1987_b1
putnam_1987_b1
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1987_b1:
;; the real interval integral from 2 to 4 of the quotient formed from the
;; square roots of log(9-x) and log(x+3) equals 1. This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))

;; Ordinary ACL2 has exact rational arithmetic but no primitive real numbers.
;; The definitions below therefore give the source integrand a concrete exact
;; Cauchy-real presentation, with no abstract carrier or uninterpreted real
;; operation.
;;
;; For 1 < Y, LOG-PREFIX is the exact rational prefix of
;;
;;   log(Y) = 2 * sum_(j>=0) z^(2j+1)/(2j+1),  z=(Y-1)/(Y+1).
;;
;; On all arguments used here, 5 <= Y <= 7 and hence 0 < z <= 3/4. If ETA is
;; positive rational, 8*denominator(ETA) terms make the geometric tail smaller
;; than ETA. SQRT-LOG-APPROX then applies rational bisection on [0,2]. Its
;; logarithm precision and bisection depth make it a regular rational Cauchy
;; name for sqrt(log(Y)), uniformly for 5 <= Y <= 7. MAIN-APPROX consequently
;; is a uniform rational Cauchy name for the exact source integrand on [2,4].

(defun p87b1-positive-rational-p (value)
  (and
   (rationalp value)
   (< 0 value)))

(defun p87b1-effective-precision (precision)
  (if (and
       (p87b1-positive-rational-p precision)
       (< precision 1))
      precision
    1))

(defun p87b1-log-prefix (y terms)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix terms)))
  (if (zp terms)
      0
    (let* ((index (1- terms))
           (exponent (+ (* 2 index) 1))
           (ratio (/ (- y 1) (+ y 1))))
      (+ (p87b1-log-prefix y index)
         (/ (* 2 (expt ratio exponent))
            exponent)))))

(defun p87b1-log-terms (precision)
  (if (p87b1-positive-rational-p precision)
      (* 8 (denominator precision))
    1))

(defun p87b1-log-approx (y precision)
  (if (and
       (rationalp y)
       (< 1 y)
       (p87b1-positive-rational-p precision))
      (p87b1-log-prefix
       y
       (p87b1-log-terms precision))
    0))

(defun p87b1-sqrt-bisection
    (radicand steps lower upper)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix steps)))
  (if (zp steps)
      lower
    (let ((midpoint (/ (+ lower upper) 2)))
      (if (<= (* midpoint midpoint) radicand)
          (p87b1-sqrt-bisection
           radicand (1- steps) midpoint upper)
        (p87b1-sqrt-bisection
         radicand (1- steps) lower midpoint)))))

(defun p87b1-sqrt-log-approx (y precision)
  (if (and
       (rationalp y)
       (<= 5 y)
       (<= y 7)
       (p87b1-positive-rational-p precision))
      (let* ((eta (p87b1-effective-precision precision))
             (log-precision (/ (* eta eta) 64))
             (radicand
              (p87b1-log-approx y log-precision))
             (steps (* 8 (denominator eta))))
        (p87b1-sqrt-bisection
         radicand steps 0 2))
    0))

(defun p87b1-main-approx (x precision)
  (if (and
       (rationalp x)
       (<= 2 x)
       (<= x 4)
       (p87b1-positive-rational-p precision))
      (let* ((eta (p87b1-effective-precision precision))
             (root-precision (/ eta 1024))
             (left-root
              (p87b1-sqrt-log-approx
               (- 9 x) root-precision))
             (right-root
              (p87b1-sqrt-log-approx
               (+ x 3) root-precision)))
        (/ left-root (+ left-root right-root)))
    0))

;; A tagged piece is (tag left right). A tagged division is an arbitrary
;; finite rational partition of [2,4], with one rational tag in each closed
;; subinterval. No fixed grid, midpoint choice, or finite carrier is used.

(defun p87b1-tagged-piece-p (piece)
  (and
   (true-listp piece)
   (equal (len piece) 3)
   (rationalp (nth 0 piece))
   (rationalp (nth 1 piece))
   (rationalp (nth 2 piece))
   (< (nth 1 piece) (nth 2 piece))
   (<= (nth 1 piece) (nth 0 piece))
   (<= (nth 0 piece) (nth 2 piece))))

(defun p87b1-tagged-division-tail-p
    (division next-left)
  (if (endp division)
      (equal next-left 4)
    (let ((piece (car division)))
      (and
       (p87b1-tagged-piece-p piece)
       (equal (nth 1 piece) next-left)
       (p87b1-tagged-division-tail-p
        (cdr division) (nth 2 piece))))))

(defun p87b1-tagged-division-p (division)
  (and
   (true-listp division)
   (p87b1-tagged-division-tail-p division 2)))

(defun p87b1-mesh-below-p (delta division)
  (if (endp division)
      t
    (let* ((piece (car division))
           (left (nth 1 piece))
           (right (nth 2 piece)))
      (and
       (< (- right left) delta)
       (p87b1-mesh-below-p
        delta (cdr division))))))

(defun p87b1-riemann-sum-approx
    (division epsilon)
  (if (endp division)
      0
    (let* ((piece (car division))
           (tag (nth 0 piece))
           (left (nth 1 piece))
           (right (nth 2 piece))
           (value-precision (/ epsilon 64)))
      (+ (* (p87b1-main-approx tag value-precision)
            (- right left))
         (p87b1-riemann-sum-approx
          (cdr division) epsilon)))))

(defun-sk p87b1-mesh-division-exists-p (delta)
  (exists (division)
    (and
     (p87b1-tagged-division-p division)
     (p87b1-mesh-below-p delta division))))

(defun-sk p87b1-all-mesh-sums-close-p
    (epsilon delta)
  (forall (division)
    (implies
     (and
      (p87b1-tagged-division-p division)
      (p87b1-mesh-below-p delta division))
     (< (abs
         (- (p87b1-riemann-sum-approx
             division epsilon)
            1))
        (* 3/4 epsilon)))))

(defun-sk p87b1-integral-delta-exists-p (epsilon)
  (exists (delta)
    (and
     (p87b1-positive-rational-p delta)
     (p87b1-mesh-division-exists-p delta)
     (p87b1-all-mesh-sums-close-p
      epsilon delta))))

;; Bidirectional equivalence with the source integral:
;;
;; * the atanh prefixes converge uniformly to log on [5,7];
;; * rational bisection and the explicit precision budgets make MAIN-APPROX
;;   converge uniformly to the displayed continuous real integrand on [2,4];
;; * its approximate Riemann sum differs from the exact sum by < epsilon/4;
;; * rational tagged partitions are dense among all tagged partitions, and
;;   uniform continuity makes their all-partitions epsilon-mesh criterion
;;   equivalent in both directions to the ordinary real Riemann integral;
;; * continuity on [2,4] makes that Riemann integral equal to the interval
;;   Lebesgue integral used by Lean and Isabelle.
;;
;; The 3*epsilon/4 margin absorbs the Cauchy-name error in both directions.
;; Thus the predicate below states exactly that the source integral equals 1,
;; rather than asserting a finite quadrature or a rational-domain analogue.

(defun-sk putnambench-putnam-1987-b1-statement ()
  (forall (epsilon)
    (implies
     (p87b1-positive-rational-p epsilon)
     (p87b1-integral-delta-exists-p epsilon))))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

title: putnam_1987_b1
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1987_b1:
-- evaluation as 1 of an integral involving square roots of logarithms.
-- This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; _*_)

infix 4 _!=_ _<=N_
infixr 3 _and_
infixr 2 _or_

data Bottom : Set where

Not : Set -> Set
Not A =
  A -> Bottom

_!=_ : {A : Set} -> A -> A -> Set
x != y =
  Not (x == y)

record _and_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data _or_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  left  : A -> A or B
  right : B -> A or B

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

data _<=N_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set where
  zero<=N   : {n : Nat} -> zero <=N n
  suc<=sucN : {m n : Nat} -> m <=N n -> suc m <=N suc n

record CompleteOrderedRealField (R : Set) : Set1 where
  field
    zeroR oneR : R
    add multiply : R -> R -> R
    negate inverse : R -> R
    lessOrEqual : R -> R -> Set
    fromNat : Nat -> R

    one-not-zero :
      oneR != zeroR

    add-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> add x y == add y x
    add-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      add (add x y) z == add x (add y z)
    add-zero :
      (x : R) -> add x zeroR == x
    add-inverse :
      (x : R) -> add x (negate x) == zeroR

    multiply-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> multiply x y == multiply y x
    multiply-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply (multiply x y) z ==
      multiply x (multiply y z)
    multiply-one :
      (x : R) -> multiply x oneR == x
    multiply-zero :
      (x : R) -> multiply x zeroR == zeroR
    distribute :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply x (add y z) ==
      add (multiply x y) (multiply x z)
    inverse-zero :
      inverse zeroR == zeroR
    multiply-inverse :
      (x : R) ->
      x != zeroR ->
      multiply x (inverse x) == oneR

    order-reflexive :
      (x : R) -> lessOrEqual x x
    order-transitive :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y z ->
      lessOrEqual x z
    order-antisymmetric :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y x ->
      x == y
    order-total :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y or lessOrEqual y x
    add-order :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual (add z x) (add z y)
    multiply-nonnegative :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR x ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR y ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR (multiply x y)
    zero-less-than-one :
      lessOrEqual zeroR oneR and zeroR != oneR

    fromNat-zero :
      fromNat zero == zeroR
    fromNat-successor :
      (n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (suc n) == add (fromNat n) oneR
    fromNat-addition :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m + n) == add (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-multiplication :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m * n) == multiply (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-injective :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat m == fromNat n ->
      m == n

    archimedean :
      (x : R) ->
      Exists Nat (\ n -> lessOrEqual x (fromNat n))
    least-upper-bound :
      (P : R -> Set) ->
      Exists R P ->
      Exists R
        (\ upper ->
          (x : R) ->
          P x ->
          lessOrEqual x upper) ->
      Exists R
        (\ supremum ->
          ((x : R) ->
            P x ->
            lessOrEqual x supremum)
          and
          ((upper : R) ->
            ((x : R) ->
              P x ->
              lessOrEqual x upper) ->
            lessOrEqual supremum upper))

open CompleteOrderedRealField

oneN : Nat
oneN =
  suc zero

twoN : Nat
twoN =
  suc oneN

threeN : Nat
threeN =
  suc twoN

fourN : Nat
fourN =
  suc threeN

eightN : Nat
eightN =
  fourN + fourN

nineN : Nat
nineN =
  suc eightN

subtract :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
subtract reals x y =
  add reals x (negate reals y)

divide :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
divide reals x y =
  multiply reals x (inverse reals y)

StrictLess :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
StrictLess reals x y =
  lessOrEqual reals x y and x != y

CloseTo :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
CloseTo reals center radius x =
  StrictLess reals
    (subtract reals center radius)
    x
  and
  StrictLess reals
    x
    (add reals center radius)

ConvergesTo :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  R ->
  Set
ConvergesTo {R} reals sequence limit =
  (epsilon : R) ->
  StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) epsilon ->
  Exists Nat
    (\ cutoff ->
      (n : Nat) ->
      cutoff <=N n ->
      CloseTo reals limit epsilon (sequence n))

sumFirst :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Nat ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  R
sumFirst reals zero terms =
  zeroR reals
sumFirst reals (suc n) terms =
  add reals
    (sumFirst reals n terms)
    (terms n)

midpointRiemannSum :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  (R -> R) ->
  Nat ->
  R
midpointRiemannSum reals lower upper function pieces =
  let
    step =
      divide reals
        (subtract reals upper lower)
        (fromNat reals pieces)
    halfStep =
      divide reals
        step
        (fromNat reals twoN)
  in
  sumFirst reals pieces
    (\ i ->
      multiply reals
        (function
          (add reals lower
            (add reals
              (multiply reals
                (fromNat reals i)
                step)
              halfStep)))
        step)

IntervalIntegralValue :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  (R -> R) ->
  R ->
  Set
IntervalIntegralValue reals lower upper function value =
  ConvergesTo reals
    (\ n ->
      midpointRiemannSum reals
        lower
        upper
        function
        (suc n))
    value

record StandardLogarithmAndSquareRoot
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) :
  Set1 where

  field
    logarithm squareRoot : R -> R

    logarithm-value :
      (x : R) ->
      StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) x ->
      IntervalIntegralValue reals
        (oneR reals)
        x
        (inverse reals)
        (logarithm x)

    square-root-nonnegative :
      (x : R) ->
      lessOrEqual reals (zeroR reals) x ->
      lessOrEqual reals (zeroR reals) (squareRoot x)

    square-root-square :
      (x : R) ->
      lessOrEqual reals (zeroR reals) x ->
      multiply reals (squareRoot x) (squareRoot x) == x

    square-root-unique :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual reals (zeroR reals) x ->
      lessOrEqual reals (zeroR reals) y ->
      multiply reals y y == x ->
      y == squareRoot x

open StandardLogarithmAndSquareRoot

integrand :
  {R : Set} ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) ->
  StandardLogarithmAndSquareRoot reals ->
  R ->
  R
integrand reals analysis x =
  let
    leftRoot =
      squareRoot analysis
        (logarithm analysis
          (subtract reals
            (fromNat reals nineN)
            x))
    rightRoot =
      squareRoot analysis
        (logarithm analysis
          (add reals x (fromNat reals threeN)))
  in
  divide reals
    leftRoot
    (add reals leftRoot rightRoot)

putnam-1987-b1 : Set1
putnam-1987-b1 =
  (R : Set) ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) ->
  (analysis : StandardLogarithmAndSquareRoot reals) ->
  IntervalIntegralValue reals
    (fromNat reals twoN)
    (fromNat reals fourN)
    (integrand reals analysis)
    (oneR reals)

title: putnam_1987_b1
content:
% Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1987_b1:
% the interval integral from 2 to 4 of the quotient of the square roots of
% logarithms in the stated symmetric integrand equals 1. This file contains no proof.

putnam_1987_b1: THEORY
BEGIN
  real_function: TYPE = [real -> real]
  real_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> real]

  safe_div(numerator, denominator: real): real =
    IF denominator = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      numerator / denominator
    ENDIF

  nat_factorial(index: nat): RECURSIVE nat =
    IF index = 0 THEN
      1
    ELSE
      index * nat_factorial(index - 1)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE index

  exponential_partial(x: real, count: nat): RECURSIVE real =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      LET index: nat = count - 1 IN
        exponential_partial(x, count - 1)
          + safe_div(
              x ^ index,
              nat_factorial(index) :: real)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  converges_to(sequence: real_sequence, value: real): bool =
    FORALL (epsilon_value: posreal):
      EXISTS (cutoff: nat):
        FORALL (index: nat):
          cutoff <= index IMPLIES
            abs(sequence(index) - value) < epsilon_value

  real_exponential(x: real): real =
    epsilon(
      LAMBDA (value: real):
        converges_to(
          LAMBDA (count: nat):
            exponential_partial(x, count),
          value))

  natural_log(x: real): real =
    IF x > 0 THEN
      epsilon(
        LAMBDA (value: real):
          real_exponential(value) = x)
    ELSE
      0
    ENDIF

  nonnegative_sqrt(x: real): real =
    IF x >= 0 THEN
      epsilon(
        LAMBDA (root: real):
          root >= 0 AND root * root = x)
    ELSE
      0
    ENDIF

  integrand(x: real): real =
    LET left_root: real =
          nonnegative_sqrt(natural_log(9 - x)),
        right_root: real =
          nonnegative_sqrt(natural_log(x + 3))
    IN
      safe_div(left_root, left_root + right_root)

  valid_tagged_partition(
      left, right: real,
      points, tags: real_sequence,
      count: nat): bool =
    count > 0
      AND points(0) = left
      AND points(count) = right
      AND FORALL (index: nat):
        index < count IMPLIES
          (points(index) < points(index + 1)
            AND points(index) <= tags(index)
            AND tags(index) <= points(index + 1))

  mesh_less_than(
      points: real_sequence,
      count: nat,
      bound: real): bool =
    FORALL (index: nat):
      index < count IMPLIES
        points(index + 1) - points(index) < bound

  riemann_sum(
      function_value: real_function,
      points, tags: real_sequence,
      count: nat): RECURSIVE real =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      riemann_sum(
        function_value, points, tags, count - 1)
        + function_value(tags(count - 1))
            * (points(count) - points(count - 1))
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  has_interval_integral(
      function_value: real_function,
      left, right, integral_value: real): bool =
    left < right
      AND FORALL (epsilon_value: posreal):
        EXISTS (mesh_bound: posreal):
          FORALL
              (points, tags: real_sequence),
              (count: nat):
            (valid_tagged_partition(
                left, right, points, tags, count)
              AND mesh_less_than(
                points, count, mesh_bound))
            IMPLIES
              abs(
                riemann_sum(
                  function_value, points, tags, count)
                  - integral_value)
                < epsilon_value

  interval_integral(
      function_value: real_function,
      left, right: real): real =
    IF left = right THEN
      0
    ELSIF left < right THEN
      IF EXISTS (integral_value: real):
          has_interval_integral(
            function_value, left, right, integral_value)
      THEN
        epsilon(
          LAMBDA (integral_value: real):
            has_interval_integral(
              function_value, left, right, integral_value))
      ELSE
        0
      ENDIF
    ELSE
      IF EXISTS (integral_value: real):
          has_interval_integral(
            function_value, right, left, integral_value)
      THEN
        -epsilon(
          LAMBDA (integral_value: real):
            has_interval_integral(
              function_value, right, left, integral_value))
      ELSE
        0
      ENDIF
    ENDIF

  putnam_1987_b1_solution: real = 1

  putnam_1987_b1: bool =
    interval_integral(integrand, 2, 4)
      = putnam_1987_b1_solution
END putnam_1987_b1

import Mathlib

open MvPolynomial Real Nat

/--
Let $r, s$ and $t$ be integers with $0 \leq r$, $0 \leq s$ and $r+s \leq t$. Prove that
\[
\frac{\binom s0}{\binom tr}
+ \frac{\binom s1}{\binom{t}{r+1}} + \cdots
+ \frac{\binom ss}{\binom{t}{r+s}}
= \frac{t+1}{(t+1-s)\binom{t-s}{r}}.
\]
-/
theorem putnam_1987_b2
(r s t : ℕ)
(hsum : r + s ≤ t)
: (∑ i : Finset.range (s + 1), (choose s i : ℚ) / (choose t (r + i)) = ((t + 1) : ℚ) / ((t + 1 - s) * choose (t - s) r)) :=
sorry

;; Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1987_b2:
;; for natural r, s, and t with r+s <= t, the finite sum of ratios of
;; binomial coefficients has the stated rational closed form. This file
;; contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

;; Pascal recursion represents the natural-number binomial coefficient.
(defun putnam-1987-b2-binomial-coefficient (n k)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix n)))
  (if (or (zp k)
          (zp n))
      (if (zp k) 1 0)
    (+ (putnam-1987-b2-binomial-coefficient (- n 1) k)
       (putnam-1987-b2-binomial-coefficient
        (- n 1) (- k 1)))))

;; This inclusive recursion enumerates i = 0 through upper. Under the
;; statement hypotheses and upper <= s, r+i <= t, so every denominator is a
;; positive binomial coefficient and ACL2 division is exact rational division.
(defun putnam-1987-b2-sum-through (r s total upper)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix upper)))
  (let ((term
         (/ (putnam-1987-b2-binomial-coefficient s upper)
            (putnam-1987-b2-binomial-coefficient
             total (+ r upper)))))
    (if (zp upper)
        term
      (+ (putnam-1987-b2-sum-through
          r s total (- upper 1))
         term))))

(defun putnambench-putnam-1987-b2-statement (r s total)
  (implies
   (and (natp r)
        (natp s)
        (natp total)
        (<= (+ r s) total))
   (equal
    (putnam-1987-b2-sum-through r s total s)
    (/ (+ total 1)
       (* (nfix (- (+ total 1) s))
          (putnam-1987-b2-binomial-coefficient
           (nfix (- total s))
           r))))))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

title: putnam_1987_b2
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1987_b2:
-- for natural r, s, and t with r + s <= t, an inclusive sum of rational
-- binomial-coefficient quotients equals a closed rational expression.
-- This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module Putnam1987B2 where

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; _-_; _*_)

infix 4 _<=N_ _~Q_

data _<=N_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set where
  zero<=N   : {n : Nat} -> zero <=N n
  suc<=sucN : {m n : Nat} -> m <=N n -> suc m <=N suc n

one : Nat
one =
  suc zero

pred : Nat -> Nat
pred zero =
  zero
pred (suc n) =
  n

choose : Nat -> Nat -> Nat
choose n zero =
  one
choose zero (suc k) =
  zero
choose (suc n) (suc k) =
  choose n (suc k) + choose n k

record NonnegativeRational : Set where
  constructor fraction
  field
    numerator             : Nat
    denominator-minus-one : Nat

open NonnegativeRational

denominator : NonnegativeRational -> Nat
denominator q =
  suc (denominator-minus-one q)

_~Q_ : NonnegativeRational -> NonnegativeRational -> Set
x ~Q y =
  numerator x * denominator y ==
  numerator y * denominator x

zeroQ : NonnegativeRational
zeroQ =
  fraction zero zero

addQ : NonnegativeRational -> NonnegativeRational -> NonnegativeRational
addQ x y =
  fraction
    (numerator x * denominator y +
     numerator y * denominator x)
    (pred (denominator x * denominator y))

naturalRatio : Nat -> Nat -> NonnegativeRational
naturalRatio numerator-value denominator-value =
  fraction numerator-value (pred denominator-value)

sumThroughQ :
  Nat ->
  (Nat -> NonnegativeRational) ->
  NonnegativeRational
sumThroughQ zero term =
  term zero
sumThroughQ (suc bound) term =
  addQ
    (sumThroughQ bound term)
    (term (suc bound))

binomialQuotientSum :
  Nat ->
  Nat ->
  Nat ->
  NonnegativeRational
binomialQuotientSum r s t =
  sumThroughQ s
    (\ i ->
      naturalRatio
        (choose s i)
        (choose t (r + i)))

closedExpression :
  Nat ->
  Nat ->
  Nat ->
  NonnegativeRational
closedExpression r s t =
  naturalRatio
    (t + one)
    ((t + one - s) * choose (t - s) r)

putnam-1987-b2 : Set
putnam-1987-b2 =
  (r s t : Nat) ->
  r + s <=N t ->
  binomialQuotientSum r s t ~Q
  closedExpression r s t

  putnam_1987_b2: a finite sum of ratios of binomial coefficients equals

  with r + s at most t. This file contains no proof.

$(
  SetMM's NN0 is the class of nonnegative integers, 0 ... s is the inclusive
  interval from 0 through s, _C is the binomial coefficient operation, and
  sum_ is finite summation. Division is complex division; because all
  numerator and denominator terms are natural numbers, this is the canonical
  rational-valued interpretation used by the Lean and Rocq sources. Under the
  stated inequality, the natural subtractions t - s and t + 1 - s agree with
  ordinary integer subtraction.

  database contains no $p proof declaration.

${

  putnambench-putnam-1987-b2 $a |-
    A. r e. NN0
      A. s e. NN0
        A. t e. NN0
          (
            ( r + s ) <_ t
            ->
            (
              sum_ i e. ( 0 ... s )
                (
                  ( s _C i )
                  /
                  ( t _C ( r + i ) )
                )
            )
            =
            (
              ( t + 1 )
              /
              (
                ( ( t + 1 ) - s )
                x.
                ( ( t - s ) _C r )
              )

% Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1987_b2:
% a finite sum of ratios of binomial coefficients has the stated closed form
% when r, s, and t are natural numbers with r + s <= t. This file contains no proof.

putnam_1987_b2: THEORY
BEGIN
  binomial_coefficient(n, k: nat): RECURSIVE nat =
    IF k = 0 THEN
      1
    ELSIF n = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      binomial_coefficient(n - 1, k - 1)
        + binomial_coefficient(n - 1, k)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE n

  safe_div(numerator, denominator: real): real =
    IF denominator = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      numerator / denominator
    ENDIF

  binomial_quotient_sum(
      r, s, t, term_count: nat): RECURSIVE real =
    IF term_count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      LET i: nat = term_count - 1 IN
        binomial_quotient_sum(r, s, t, term_count - 1)
          + safe_div(
              (binomial_coefficient(s, i) :: real),
              (binomial_coefficient(t, r + i) :: real))
    ENDIF
  MEASURE term_count

  putnam_1987_b2: bool =
    FORALL (r, s, t: nat):
      r + s <= t IMPLIES
        binomial_quotient_sum(r, s, t, s + 1)
          = safe_div(
              ((t + 1) :: real),
              ((t + 1 - s) :: real)
                * (binomial_coefficient(t - s, r) :: real))
END putnam_1987_b2

open MvPolynomial Real Nat

/--
Let $F$ be a field in which $1+1 \neq 0$. Show that the set of solutions to the equation $x^2+y^2=1$ with $x$ and $y$ in $F$ is given by $(x,y)=(1,0)$ and $(x,y)=\left(\frac{r^2-1}{r^2+1},\frac{2r}{r^2+1}\right)$, where $r$ runs through the elements of $F$ such that $r^2 \neq -1$.
-/
theorem putnam_1987_b3
(F : Type*) [Field F]
(hF : (1 : F) + 1 ≠ 0)
: {(x, y) : F × F | x ^ 2 + y ^ 2 = 1} = {(1, 0)} ∪ {((r ^ 2 - 1) / (r ^ 2 + 1), (2 * r) / (r ^ 2 + 1)) | r ∈ {r' : F | r' ^ 2 ≠ -1}} :=
sorry

(* Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench artifact putnam_1987_b3:
   the rational parametrization, over any field of characteristic not two,
   of all solutions to x^2 + y^2 = 1. This file contains no proof. *)

From Stdlib Require Import Ensembles.

Record putnam_1987_b3_field (F : Type) : Type := {
  putnam_1987_b3_zero : F;
  putnam_1987_b3_one : F;
  putnam_1987_b3_add : F -> F -> F;
  putnam_1987_b3_mul : F -> F -> F;
  putnam_1987_b3_opp : F -> F;
  putnam_1987_b3_inv : F -> F;
  putnam_1987_b3_add_assoc :
    forall x y z : F,
      putnam_1987_b3_add x (putnam_1987_b3_add y z) =
      putnam_1987_b3_add (putnam_1987_b3_add x y) z;
  putnam_1987_b3_add_comm :
    forall x y : F,
      putnam_1987_b3_add x y = putnam_1987_b3_add y x;
  putnam_1987_b3_add_zero_l :
    forall x : F,
      putnam_1987_b3_add putnam_1987_b3_zero x = x;
  putnam_1987_b3_add_opp_l :
    forall x : F,
      putnam_1987_b3_add (putnam_1987_b3_opp x) x =
      putnam_1987_b3_zero;
  putnam_1987_b3_mul_assoc :
    forall x y z : F,
      putnam_1987_b3_mul x (putnam_1987_b3_mul y z) =
      putnam_1987_b3_mul (putnam_1987_b3_mul x y) z;
  putnam_1987_b3_mul_comm :
    forall x y : F,
      putnam_1987_b3_mul x y = putnam_1987_b3_mul y x;
  putnam_1987_b3_mul_one_l :
    forall x : F,
      putnam_1987_b3_mul putnam_1987_b3_one x = x;
  putnam_1987_b3_mul_add_distr_l :
    forall x y z : F,
      putnam_1987_b3_mul x (putnam_1987_b3_add y z) =
      putnam_1987_b3_add
        (putnam_1987_b3_mul x y)
        (putnam_1987_b3_mul x z);
  putnam_1987_b3_one_neq_zero :
    putnam_1987_b3_one <> putnam_1987_b3_zero;
  putnam_1987_b3_inv_zero :
    putnam_1987_b3_inv putnam_1987_b3_zero =
    putnam_1987_b3_zero;
  putnam_1987_b3_inv_mul_cancel :
    forall x : F,
      x <> putnam_1987_b3_zero ->
      putnam_1987_b3_mul (putnam_1987_b3_inv x) x =
      putnam_1987_b3_one
}.

Arguments putnam_1987_b3_zero {F} _.
Arguments putnam_1987_b3_one {F} _.
Arguments putnam_1987_b3_add {F} _ _ _.
Arguments putnam_1987_b3_mul {F} _ _ _.
Arguments putnam_1987_b3_opp {F} _ _.
Arguments putnam_1987_b3_inv {F} _ _.

Definition putnam_1987_b3_sub {F : Type}
    (field : putnam_1987_b3_field F) (x y : F) : F :=
  putnam_1987_b3_add field x (putnam_1987_b3_opp field y).

Definition putnam_1987_b3_square {F : Type}
    (field : putnam_1987_b3_field F) (x : F) : F :=
  putnam_1987_b3_mul field x x.

Definition putnam_1987_b3_div {F : Type}
    (field : putnam_1987_b3_field F) (x y : F) : F :=
  putnam_1987_b3_mul field x (putnam_1987_b3_inv field y).

Definition putnam_1987_b3_unit_circle {F : Type}
    (field : putnam_1987_b3_field F) : Ensemble (F * F) :=
  fun p : F * F =>
    putnam_1987_b3_add field
      (putnam_1987_b3_square field (fst p))
      (putnam_1987_b3_square field (snd p)) =
    putnam_1987_b3_one field.

Definition putnam_1987_b3_parametrization {F : Type}
    (field : putnam_1987_b3_field F) : Ensemble (F * F) :=
  fun p : F * F =>
    p = (putnam_1987_b3_one field, putnam_1987_b3_zero field) \/
    exists r : F,
      putnam_1987_b3_square field r <>
        putnam_1987_b3_opp field (putnam_1987_b3_one field) /\
      p =
        (putnam_1987_b3_div field
           (putnam_1987_b3_sub field
             (putnam_1987_b3_square field r)
             (putnam_1987_b3_one field))
           (putnam_1987_b3_add field
             (putnam_1987_b3_square field r)
             (putnam_1987_b3_one field)),
         putnam_1987_b3_div field
           (putnam_1987_b3_mul field
             (putnam_1987_b3_add field
               (putnam_1987_b3_one field)
               (putnam_1987_b3_one field))
             r)
           (putnam_1987_b3_add field
             (putnam_1987_b3_square field r)
             (putnam_1987_b3_one field))).

Theorem putnam_1987_b3 :
  forall (F : Type) (field : putnam_1987_b3_field F),
    putnam_1987_b3_add field
      (putnam_1987_b3_one field)
      (putnam_1987_b3_one field) <>
    putnam_1987_b3_zero field ->
    Same_set (F * F)
      (putnam_1987_b3_unit_circle field)
      (putnam_1987_b3_parametrization field).
Admitted.

      (putnam-1987-b3-member-p

      (equal

        z)

        x
        (putnam-1987-b3-add y z)))
      (equal

        (putnam-1987-b3-multiply x y)

      (equal

       (putnam-1987-b3-add y x))
      (equal
       (putnam-1987-b3-multiply x y)
       (putnam-1987-b3-multiply y x))

       x)
      (equal
       (putnam-1987-b3-add
        x
        (putnam-1987-b3-negate x))
       zero)
      (equal
       (putnam-1987-b3-multiply x one)
       x)
      (implies

        (putnam-1987-b3-multiply x y)

    (putnam-1987-b3-multiply y y))

-- Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1987_b3:
-- the unit circle over any field of characteristic not two is exactly the
-- singleton (1, 0) together with its standard rational parametrization.
-- This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)

infix 4 _!=_
infixr 3 _and_
infixr 2 _or_
infix 1 _iff_

data Bottom : Set where

Not : Set -> Set
Not A =
  A -> Bottom

_!=_ : {A : Set} -> A -> A -> Set
x != y =
  Not (x == y)

record _and_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data _or_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  left  : A -> A or B
  right : B -> A or B

record _iff_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor equivalence
  field
    forward  : A -> B
    backward : B -> A

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

record Field (F : Set) : Set1 where
  field
    zeroF oneF : F
    add multiply : F -> F -> F
    negate inverse : F -> F

    one-not-zero :
      oneF != zeroF

    add-commutative :
      (x y : F) ->
      add x y == add y x
    add-associative :
      (x y z : F) ->
      add (add x y) z == add x (add y z)
    add-zero :
      (x : F) ->
      add x zeroF == x
    add-inverse :
      (x : F) ->
      add x (negate x) == zeroF

    multiply-commutative :
      (x y : F) ->
      multiply x y == multiply y x
    multiply-associative :
      (x y z : F) ->
      multiply (multiply x y) z ==
      multiply x (multiply y z)
    multiply-one :
      (x : F) ->
      multiply x oneF == x
    multiply-zero :
      (x : F) ->
      multiply x zeroF == zeroF
    distribute :
      (x y z : F) ->
      multiply x (add y z) ==
      add (multiply x y) (multiply x z)

    inverse-zero :
      inverse zeroF == zeroF
    multiply-inverse :
      (x : F) ->
      x != zeroF ->
      multiply x (inverse x) == oneF

open Field

square :
  {F : Set} ->
  Field F ->
  F ->
  F
square algebra x =
  multiply algebra x x

subtract :
  {F : Set} ->
  Field F ->
  F ->
  F ->
  F
subtract algebra x y =
  add algebra x (negate algebra y)

divide :
  {F : Set} ->
  Field F ->
  F ->
  F ->
  F
divide algebra x y =
  multiply algebra x (inverse algebra y)

module Putnam1987B3Statement
  {F : Set}
  (algebra : Field F) where

  two : F
  two =
    add algebra (oneF algebra) (oneF algebra)

  UnitCircle : F -> F -> Set
  UnitCircle x y =
    add algebra
      (square algebra x)
      (square algebra y)
    ==
    oneF algebra

  EligibleParameter : F -> Set
  EligibleParameter r =
    square algebra r != negate algebra (oneF algebra)

  parameterX : F -> F
  parameterX r =
    divide algebra
      (subtract algebra
        (square algebra r)
        (oneF algebra))
      (add algebra
        (square algebra r)
        (oneF algebra))

  parameterY : F -> F
  parameterY r =
    divide algebra
      (multiply algebra two r)
      (add algebra
        (square algebra r)
        (oneF algebra))

  ParametrizedPoint : F -> F -> Set
  ParametrizedPoint x y =
    Exists F
      (\ r ->
        EligibleParameter r
        and
        x == parameterX r
        and
        y == parameterY r)

  ListedPoint : F -> F -> Set
  ListedPoint x y =
    (x == oneF algebra and y == zeroF algebra)
    or
    ParametrizedPoint x y

  proposition : Set
  proposition =
    (x y : F) ->
    UnitCircle x y iff ListedPoint x y

putnam-1987-b3 : Set1
putnam-1987-b3 =
  (F : Set) ->
  (algebra : Field F) ->
  add algebra (oneF algebra) (oneF algebra) != zeroF algebra ->
  Putnam1987B3Statement.proposition algebra

val putnam_1987_b3 =
  ``!(zeroR oneR : 'a)
      (addR mulR : 'a -> 'a -> 'a)
      (negR invR : 'a -> 'a).
      let field_axioms =
        (zeroR <> oneR /\
         (!x. addR zeroR x = x) /\
         (!x. addR (negR x) x = zeroR) /\
         (!x y. addR x y = addR y x) /\
         (!x y z. addR (addR x y) z = addR x (addR y z)) /\
         (!x. mulR oneR x = x) /\
         (!x y. mulR x y = mulR y x) /\

         (!x y z.

         (!x. x <> zeroR ==> mulR (invR x) x = oneR))
      in
      let square = \x : 'a. mulR x x;
          sub = \x y : 'a. addR x (negR y);

        ({(oneR, zeroR)} UNION
         {p : 'a # 'a |
            ?r : 'a.
              square r <> negR oneR /\
              p =
                (divide
                   (sub (square r) oneR)
                   (addR (square r) oneR),

                   (mulR (addR oneR oneR) r)

title: putnam_1987_b3
content:
% Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1987_b3:
% over any field in which 1 + 1 is nonzero, the unit circle is exactly (1, 0)
% together with its standard rational parametrization. This file contains no proof.

putnam_1987_b3[
  FieldElement: TYPE+,
  zero_F, one_F: FieldElement,
  add_F, multiply_F:
    [FieldElement, FieldElement -> FieldElement],
  negate_F, inverse_F: [FieldElement -> FieldElement]
]: THEORY
BEGIN
  field_axioms: bool =
    zero_F /= one_F
      AND (FORALL (x, y: FieldElement):
        add_F(x, y) = add_F(y, x))
      AND (FORALL (x, y, z: FieldElement):
        add_F(add_F(x, y), z) = add_F(x, add_F(y, z)))
      AND (FORALL (x: FieldElement):
        add_F(x, zero_F) = x)
      AND (FORALL (x: FieldElement):
        add_F(x, negate_F(x)) = zero_F)
      AND (FORALL (x, y: FieldElement):
        multiply_F(x, y) = multiply_F(y, x))
      AND (FORALL (x, y, z: FieldElement):
        multiply_F(multiply_F(x, y), z)
          = multiply_F(x, multiply_F(y, z)))
      AND (FORALL (x: FieldElement):
        multiply_F(x, one_F) = x)
      AND (FORALL (x, y, z: FieldElement):
        multiply_F(x, add_F(y, z))
          = add_F(multiply_F(x, y), multiply_F(x, z)))
      AND (FORALL (x: FieldElement):
        x /= zero_F IMPLIES
          multiply_F(x, inverse_F(x)) = one_F)

  square_F(x: FieldElement): FieldElement =
    multiply_F(x, x)

  subtract_F(x, y: FieldElement): FieldElement =
    add_F(x, negate_F(y))

  divide_F(x, y: FieldElement): FieldElement =
    multiply_F(x, inverse_F(y))

  circle_solution(x, y: FieldElement): bool =
    add_F(square_F(x), square_F(y)) = one_F

  admissible_parameter(r: FieldElement): bool =
    square_F(r) /= negate_F(one_F)

  parameter_x(r: FieldElement): FieldElement =
    divide_F(
      subtract_F(square_F(r), one_F),
      add_F(square_F(r), one_F))

  parameter_y(r: FieldElement): FieldElement =
    divide_F(
      multiply_F(add_F(one_F, one_F), r),
      add_F(square_F(r), one_F))

  putnam_1987_b3: bool =
    (field_axioms
      AND add_F(one_F, one_F) /= zero_F)
    IMPLIES
      (FORALL (x, y: FieldElement):
        circle_solution(x, y)
          IFF
            ((x = one_F AND y = zero_F)
              OR (EXISTS (r: FieldElement):
                admissible_parameter(r)
                  AND x = parameter_x(r)
                  AND y = parameter_y(r))))
END putnam_1987_b3

import Mathlib

open MvPolynomial Real Nat Filter Topology

abbrev putnam_1987_b4_solution : Prop × ℝ × Prop × ℝ := sorry
-- (True, -1, True, 0)
/--
Let $(x_1,y_1) = (0.8, 0.6)$ and let $x_{n+1} = x_n \cos y_n - y_n \sin y_n$ and $y_{n+1}= x_n \sin y_n + y_n \cos y_n$ for $n=1,2,3,\dots$. For each of $\lim_{n\to \infty} x_n$ and $\lim_{n \to \infty} y_n$, prove that the limit exists and find it or prove that the limit does not exist.
-/
theorem putnam_1987_b4
    (x y : ℕ → ℝ)
    (hxy1 : (x 1, y 1) = (0.8, 0.6))
    (hx : ∀ n ≥ 1, x (n + 1) = (x n) * cos (y n) - (y n) * sin (y n))
    (hy : ∀ n ≥ 1, y (n + 1) = (x n) * sin (y n) + (y n) * cos (y n)) :
    let (existsx, limx, existsy, limy) := putnam_1987_b4_solution
    ((∃ c : ℝ, Tendsto x atTop (𝓝 c)) → existsx) ∧
    (existsx → Tendsto x atTop (𝓝 limx)) ∧
    ((∃ c : ℝ, Tendsto y atTop (𝓝 c)) → existsy) ∧
    (existsy → Tendsto y atTop (𝓝 limy)) :=
  sorry

Require Import Reals Coquelicot.Coquelicot.
Open Scope R.
Definition putnam_1987_b4_solution := (True, -1, True, 0).
Theorem putnam_1987_b4
    (A := fix a (n: nat) : (R * R) :=
        match n with
        | O => (0.8, 0.6)
        | (S n') => 
            let (xn, yn) := a n' in
            (xn * cos yn - yn * sin yn, xn * sin yn + yn * cos yn)
    end)
    : let '(existsx, limx, existsy, limy) := putnam_1987_b4_solution in
    (ex_lim_seq (fun n => fst (A n)) <-> existsx) /\
    (existsx -> Lim_seq (fun n => fst (A n)) = limx) /\
    (ex_lim_seq (fun n => snd (A n)) <-> existsy) /\
    (existsy -> Lim_seq (fun n => snd (A n)) = limy).
Proof. Admitted.

;; Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1987_b4:
;; the real planar sine-cosine recurrence from (4/5, 3/5) converges coordinatewise
;; to (-1, 0). This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))

;; REAL-TYPE indexes an arbitrary presentation of an Archimedean ordered field.
;; Such a field has a unique order-preserving embedding into the real numbers.
;; Sine and cosine are fixed, rather than assumed opaque, by convergence of
;; their complete power series.  The two conservative sequence interfaces are
;; arbitrary functions on the natural numbers; all typing, recurrence, and
;; convergence conditions occur explicitly in the statement predicate.

(defstub putnam-1987-b4-member-p (real-type value) t)
(defstub putnam-1987-b4-zero (real-type) t)
(defstub putnam-1987-b4-one (real-type) t)
(defstub putnam-1987-b4-add (real-type left right) t)
(defstub putnam-1987-b4-multiply (real-type left right) t)
(defstub putnam-1987-b4-negate (real-type value) t)
(defstub putnam-1987-b4-inverse (real-type value) t)
(defstub putnam-1987-b4-less (real-type left right) t)
(defstub putnam-1987-b4-sine (real-type value) t)
(defstub putnam-1987-b4-cosine (real-type value) t)
(defstub putnam-1987-b4-x (real-type index) t)
(defstub putnam-1987-b4-y (real-type index) t)

(defun putnam-1987-b4-r-add (real-type left right)
  (putnam-1987-b4-add real-type left right))

(defun putnam-1987-b4-r-multiply (real-type left right)
  (putnam-1987-b4-multiply real-type left right))

(defun putnam-1987-b4-r-negate (real-type value)
  (putnam-1987-b4-negate real-type value))

(defun putnam-1987-b4-r-inverse (real-type value)
  (putnam-1987-b4-inverse real-type value))

(defun putnam-1987-b4-r-subtract (real-type left right)
  (putnam-1987-b4-r-add
   real-type
   left
   (putnam-1987-b4-r-negate real-type right)))

(defun putnam-1987-b4-r-divide (real-type numerator denominator)
  (putnam-1987-b4-r-multiply
   real-type
   numerator
   (putnam-1987-b4-r-inverse real-type denominator)))

(defun putnam-1987-b4-r-absolute-value (real-type value)
  (if (putnam-1987-b4-less
       real-type value (putnam-1987-b4-zero real-type))
      (putnam-1987-b4-r-negate real-type value)
    value))

(defun putnam-1987-b4-r-nat (real-type n)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix n)))
  (if (zp n)
      (putnam-1987-b4-zero real-type)
    (putnam-1987-b4-r-add
     real-type
     (putnam-1987-b4-one real-type)
     (putnam-1987-b4-r-nat real-type (1- n)))))

(defun putnam-1987-b4-r-power (real-type base exponent)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix exponent)))
  (if (zp exponent)
      (putnam-1987-b4-one real-type)
    (putnam-1987-b4-r-multiply
     real-type
     base
     (putnam-1987-b4-r-power
      real-type base (1- exponent)))))

(defun putnam-1987-b4-r-factorial (real-type n)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix n)))
  (if (zp n)
      (putnam-1987-b4-one real-type)
    (putnam-1987-b4-r-multiply
     real-type
     (putnam-1987-b4-r-nat real-type n)
     (putnam-1987-b4-r-factorial
      real-type (1- n)))))

(defun-sk putnam-1987-b4-field-laws-p (real-type)
  (forall (a b c)
    (implies
     (and
      (putnam-1987-b4-member-p real-type a)
      (putnam-1987-b4-member-p real-type b)
      (putnam-1987-b4-member-p real-type c))
     (let* ((zero (putnam-1987-b4-zero real-type))
            (one (putnam-1987-b4-one real-type))
            (a-plus-b
             (putnam-1987-b4-r-add real-type a b))
            (b-plus-c
             (putnam-1987-b4-r-add real-type b c))
            (a-times-b
             (putnam-1987-b4-r-multiply real-type a b))
            (b-times-c
             (putnam-1987-b4-r-multiply real-type b c))
            (negative-a
             (putnam-1987-b4-r-negate real-type a))
            (inverse-a
             (putnam-1987-b4-r-inverse real-type a)))
       (and
        (putnam-1987-b4-member-p real-type a-plus-b)
        (putnam-1987-b4-member-p real-type a-times-b)
        (putnam-1987-b4-member-p real-type negative-a)
        (putnam-1987-b4-member-p real-type inverse-a)
        (equal
         (putnam-1987-b4-r-add real-type a-plus-b c)
         (putnam-1987-b4-r-add real-type a b-plus-c))
        (equal
         a-plus-b
         (putnam-1987-b4-r-add real-type b a))
        (equal
         (putnam-1987-b4-r-add real-type a zero)
         a)
        (equal
         (putnam-1987-b4-r-add real-type a negative-a)
         zero)
        (equal
         (putnam-1987-b4-r-multiply real-type a-times-b c)
         (putnam-1987-b4-r-multiply real-type a b-times-c))
        (equal
         a-times-b
         (putnam-1987-b4-r-multiply real-type b a))
        (equal
         (putnam-1987-b4-r-multiply real-type a one)
         a)
        (implies
         (equal a zero)
         (equal inverse-a zero))
        (implies
         (not (equal a zero))
         (equal
          (putnam-1987-b4-r-multiply
           real-type a inverse-a)
          one))
        (equal
         (putnam-1987-b4-r-multiply real-type a b-plus-c)
         (putnam-1987-b4-r-add
          real-type
          (putnam-1987-b4-r-multiply real-type a b)
          (putnam-1987-b4-r-multiply real-type a c))))))))

(defun-sk putnam-1987-b4-order-laws-p (real-type)
  (forall (a b c)
    (implies
     (and
      (putnam-1987-b4-member-p real-type a)
      (putnam-1987-b4-member-p real-type b)
      (putnam-1987-b4-member-p real-type c))
     (let ((zero (putnam-1987-b4-zero real-type)))
       (and
        (not (putnam-1987-b4-less real-type a a))
        (or
         (equal a b)
         (putnam-1987-b4-less real-type a b)
         (putnam-1987-b4-less real-type b a))
        (implies
         (and
          (putnam-1987-b4-less real-type a b)
          (putnam-1987-b4-less real-type b c))
         (putnam-1987-b4-less real-type a c))
        (implies
         (putnam-1987-b4-less real-type a b)
         (putnam-1987-b4-less
          real-type
          (putnam-1987-b4-r-add real-type a c)
          (putnam-1987-b4-r-add real-type b c)))
        (implies
         (and
          (putnam-1987-b4-less real-type zero a)
          (putnam-1987-b4-less real-type zero b))
         (putnam-1987-b4-less
          real-type
          zero
          (putnam-1987-b4-r-multiply real-type a b))))))))

(defun-sk putnam-1987-b4-archimedean-bound-exists-p
    (real-type value)
  (exists (n)
    (and
     (natp n)
     (putnam-1987-b4-less
      real-type
      value
      (putnam-1987-b4-r-nat real-type n)))))

(defun-sk putnam-1987-b4-archimedean-p (real-type)
  (forall (value)
    (implies
     (putnam-1987-b4-member-p real-type value)
     (putnam-1987-b4-archimedean-bound-exists-p
      real-type value))))

(defun putnam-1987-b4-real-field-p (real-type)
  (let ((zero (putnam-1987-b4-zero real-type))
        (one (putnam-1987-b4-one real-type)))
    (and
     (putnam-1987-b4-member-p real-type zero)
     (putnam-1987-b4-member-p real-type one)
     (not (equal zero one))
     (putnam-1987-b4-field-laws-p real-type)
     (putnam-1987-b4-order-laws-p real-type)
     (putnam-1987-b4-less real-type zero one)
     (putnam-1987-b4-archimedean-p real-type))))

(defun putnam-1987-b4-sine-term (real-type x index)
  (let* ((exponent (+ (* 2 index) 1))
         (unsigned
          (putnam-1987-b4-r-divide
           real-type
           (putnam-1987-b4-r-power
            real-type x exponent)
           (putnam-1987-b4-r-factorial
            real-type exponent))))
    (if (equal (mod index 2) 0)
        unsigned
      (putnam-1987-b4-r-negate real-type unsigned))))

(defun putnam-1987-b4-cosine-term (real-type x index)
  (let* ((exponent (* 2 index))
         (unsigned
          (putnam-1987-b4-r-divide
           real-type
           (putnam-1987-b4-r-power
            real-type x exponent)
           (putnam-1987-b4-r-factorial
            real-type exponent))))
    (if (equal (mod index 2) 0)
        unsigned
      (putnam-1987-b4-r-negate real-type unsigned))))

(defun putnam-1987-b4-sine-prefix (real-type x terms)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix terms)))
  (if (zp terms)
      (putnam-1987-b4-zero real-type)
    (let ((index (1- terms)))
      (putnam-1987-b4-r-add
       real-type
       (putnam-1987-b4-sine-prefix real-type x index)

        real-type x index)))))

(defun putnam-1987-b4-cosine-prefix (real-type x terms)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix terms)))
  (if (zp terms)
      (putnam-1987-b4-zero real-type)
    (let ((index (1- terms)))
      (putnam-1987-b4-r-add
       real-type
       (putnam-1987-b4-cosine-prefix real-type x index)
       (putnam-1987-b4-cosine-term

    (real-type x epsilon cutoff)
  (forall (terms)
    (implies
     (and
      (natp terms)
      (<= cutoff terms))
     (putnam-1987-b4-less
      real-type
      (putnam-1987-b4-r-absolute-value
       real-type
       (putnam-1987-b4-r-subtract
        real-type
        (putnam-1987-b4-sine-prefix

        (putnam-1987-b4-sine real-type x)))
      epsilon))))

    (real-type x epsilon)
  (exists (cutoff)
    (and
     (natp cutoff)

  (forall (epsilon)
    (implies
     (and
      (putnam-1987-b4-member-p real-type epsilon)
      (putnam-1987-b4-less
       real-type
       (putnam-1987-b4-zero real-type)
       epsilon))
     (putnam-1987-b4-sine-cutoff-exists-p

    (real-type x epsilon cutoff)
  (forall (terms)
    (implies
     (and
      (natp terms)
      (<= cutoff terms))
     (putnam-1987-b4-less

        real-type
        (putnam-1987-b4-cosine-prefix
