title: putnam_1987_b4
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1987_b4:
-- the recursively rotated real coordinate sequences converge respectively
-- to -1 and 0. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; _*_)

infix 4 _!=_ _<=N_
infixr 3 _and_
infixr 2 _or_

data Bottom : Set where

Not : Set -> Set
Not A =
  A -> Bottom

_!=_ : {A : Set} -> A -> A -> Set
x != y =
  Not (x == y)

record _and_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data _or_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  left  : A -> A or B
  right : B -> A or B

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

data _<=N_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set where
  zero<=N   : {n : Nat} -> zero <=N n
  suc<=sucN : {m n : Nat} -> m <=N n -> suc m <=N suc n

record CompleteOrderedRealField (R : Set) : Set1 where
  field
    zeroR oneR : R
    add multiply : R -> R -> R
    negate inverse : R -> R
    lessOrEqual : R -> R -> Set
    fromNat : Nat -> R

    one-not-zero :
      oneR != zeroR

    add-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> add x y == add y x
    add-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      add (add x y) z == add x (add y z)
    add-zero :
      (x : R) -> add x zeroR == x
    add-inverse :
      (x : R) -> add x (negate x) == zeroR

    multiply-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> multiply x y == multiply y x
    multiply-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply (multiply x y) z ==
      multiply x (multiply y z)
    multiply-one :
      (x : R) -> multiply x oneR == x
    multiply-zero :
      (x : R) -> multiply x zeroR == zeroR
    distribute :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply x (add y z) ==
      add (multiply x y) (multiply x z)
    inverse-zero :
      inverse zeroR == zeroR
    multiply-inverse :
      (x : R) ->
      x != zeroR ->
      multiply x (inverse x) == oneR

    order-reflexive :
      (x : R) -> lessOrEqual x x
    order-transitive :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y z ->
      lessOrEqual x z
    order-antisymmetric :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y x ->
      x == y
    order-total :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y or lessOrEqual y x
    add-order :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual (add z x) (add z y)
    multiply-nonnegative :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR x ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR y ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR (multiply x y)
    zero-less-than-one :
      lessOrEqual zeroR oneR and zeroR != oneR

    fromNat-zero :
      fromNat zero == zeroR
    fromNat-successor :
      (n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (suc n) == add (fromNat n) oneR
    fromNat-addition :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m + n) == add (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-multiplication :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m * n) == multiply (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-injective :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat m == fromNat n ->
      m == n

    archimedean :
      (x : R) ->
      Exists Nat
        (\ n ->
          lessOrEqual x (fromNat n))
    least-upper-bound :
      (P : R -> Set) ->
      Exists R P ->
      Exists R
        (\ upper ->
          (x : R) ->
          P x ->
          lessOrEqual x upper) ->
      Exists R
        (\ supremum ->
          ((x : R) ->
            P x ->
            lessOrEqual x supremum)
          and
          ((upper : R) ->
            ((x : R) ->
              P x ->
              lessOrEqual x upper) ->
            lessOrEqual supremum upper))

open CompleteOrderedRealField

oneN : Nat
oneN =
  suc zero

twoN : Nat
twoN =
  suc oneN

threeN : Nat
threeN =
  suc twoN

fourN : Nat
fourN =
  suc threeN

fiveN : Nat
fiveN =
  suc fourN

subtract :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
subtract reals x y =
  add reals x (negate reals y)

divide :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
divide reals x y =
  multiply reals x (inverse reals y)

StrictLess :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
StrictLess reals x y =
  lessOrEqual reals x y and x != y

CloseTo :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
CloseTo reals center radius x =
  StrictLess reals
    (subtract reals center radius)
    x
  and
  StrictLess reals
    x
    (add reals center radius)

ConvergesTo :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  R ->
  Set
ConvergesTo {R} reals sequence limit =
  (epsilon : R) ->
  StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) epsilon ->
  Exists Nat
    (\ cutoff ->
      (n : Nat) ->
      cutoff <=N n ->
      CloseTo reals limit epsilon (sequence n))

naturalPower :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  Nat ->
  R
naturalPower reals x zero =
  oneR reals
naturalPower reals x (suc n) =
  multiply reals
    (naturalPower reals x n)
    x

factorial : Nat -> Nat
factorial zero =
  oneN
factorial (suc n) =
  suc n * factorial n

sumFirst :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Nat ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  R
sumFirst reals zero term =
  zeroR reals
sumFirst reals (suc n) term =
  add reals
    (sumFirst reals n term)
    (term n)

SeriesHasSum :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  R ->
  Set
SeriesHasSum reals terms limit =
  ConvergesTo reals
    (\ n -> sumFirst reals n terms)
    limit

alternatingPower :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Nat ->
  R
alternatingPower reals n =
  naturalPower reals
    (negate reals (oneR reals))
    n

cosineTerm :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  Nat ->
  R
cosineTerm reals x n =
  divide reals
    (multiply reals
      (alternatingPower reals n)
      (naturalPower reals x (twoN * n)))
    (fromNat reals (factorial (twoN * n)))

sineTerm :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  Nat ->
  R
sineTerm reals x n =
  divide reals
    (multiply reals
      (alternatingPower reals n)
      (naturalPower reals x (suc (twoN * n))))
    (fromNat reals (factorial (suc (twoN * n))))

record StandardSineAndCosine
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) : Set1 where
  field
    sine cosine : R -> R

    sine-series :
      (x : R) ->
      SeriesHasSum reals
        (sineTerm reals x)
        (sine x)

    cosine-series :
      (x : R) ->
      SeriesHasSum reals
        (cosineTerm reals x)
        (cosine x)

open StandardSineAndCosine

module Putnam1987B4Statement
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R)
  (trigonometry : StandardSineAndCosine reals) where

  fourFifths : R
  fourFifths =
    divide reals
      (fromNat reals fourN)
      (fromNat reals fiveN)

  threeFifths : R
  threeFifths =
    divide reals
      (fromNat reals threeN)
      (fromNat reals fiveN)

  XStep : (Nat -> R) -> (Nat -> R) -> Set
  XStep x y =
    (n : Nat) ->
    oneN <=N n ->
    x (suc n) ==
    subtract reals
      (multiply reals
        (x n)
        (cosine trigonometry (y n)))
      (multiply reals
        (y n)
        (sine trigonometry (y n)))

  YStep : (Nat -> R) -> (Nat -> R) -> Set
  YStep x y =
    (n : Nat) ->
    oneN <=N n ->
    y (suc n) ==
    add reals
      (multiply reals
        (x n)
        (sine trigonometry (y n)))
      (multiply reals
        (y n)
        (cosine trigonometry (y n)))

  proposition : Set
  proposition =
    (x y : Nat -> R) ->
    x oneN == fourFifths ->
    y oneN == threeFifths ->
    XStep x y ->
    YStep x y ->
    ConvergesTo reals x (negate reals (oneR reals))
    and
    ConvergesTo reals y (zeroR reals)

putnam-1987-b4 : Set1
putnam-1987-b4 =
  (R : Set) ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) ->
  (trigonometry : StandardSineAndCosine reals) ->
  Putnam1987B4Statement.proposition reals trigonometry

(*
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1987_b4:
  the two real sequences defined by the given trigonometric recurrence
  converge respectively to negative one and zero. This file contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open arithmeticTheory realTheory real_topologyTheory transcTheory;

val putnam_1987_b4 =
  ``!x y : num -> real.
      x 1 = 4 / 5 /\
      y 1 = 3 / 5 /\
      (!n : num.
         1 <= n
         ==>
         x (n + 1) =
           x n * cos (y n) - y n * sin (y n)) /\
      (!n : num.
         1 <= n
         ==>
         y (n + 1) =
           x n * sin (y n) + y n * cos (y n))
      ==>
      (x --> (~1 : real)) sequentially /\
      (y --> 0) sequentially``;

$(

  putnam_1987_b4: convergence and values of the two real sequences defined
  by the stated coupled trigonometric recurrence. This file contains no proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  X and Y range over arbitrary real-valued sequences indexed by the
  nonnegative integers. The initial pair (0.8, 0.6) is written exactly as
  (4/5, 3/5), and quantification over NN imposes both recurrences at precisely
  the source indices n >= 1.

  The conclusions use set.mm's real-sequence convergence relation. Inlining
  the annotated solution (True, -1, True, 0) reduces the source result to
  convergence of X to -1 and Y to 0. The final declaration is the single
  unproved $a corpus statement; this database contains no $p proof statement.
$)

${
  $d X Y n $.

  putnambench-putnam-1987-b4 $a |-
    A. X e. ( RR ^m NN0 )
    A. Y e. ( RR ^m NN0 )
      (

            /\

              ( X ` ( n + 1 ) )

title: putnam_1987_b4
content:
% Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1987_b4:
% the real sequences beginning at (4/5, 3/5) and updated by rotation through
% angle y(n) converge to -1 and 0, respectively. This file contains no proof.

putnam_1987_b4: THEORY
BEGIN
  real_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> real]

  safe_div(numerator, denominator: real): real =
    IF denominator = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      numerator / denominator
    ENDIF

  factorial(index: nat): RECURSIVE nat =
    IF index = 0 THEN
      1
    ELSE
      index * factorial(index - 1)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE index

  sine_partial(x: real, count: nat): RECURSIVE real =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      LET index: nat = count - 1 IN
        sine_partial(x, count - 1)
          + safe_div(
              ((-1 :: real) ^ index) * x ^ (2 * index + 1),
              factorial(2 * index + 1) :: real)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  cosine_partial(x: real, count: nat): RECURSIVE real =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      LET index: nat = count - 1 IN
        cosine_partial(x, count - 1)
          + safe_div(
              ((-1 :: real) ^ index) * x ^ (2 * index),
              factorial(2 * index) :: real)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  converges_to(sequence: real_sequence, value: real): bool =
    FORALL (epsilon_value: posreal):
      EXISTS (cutoff: nat):
        FORALL (index: nat):
          cutoff <= index IMPLIES
            abs(sequence(index) - value) < epsilon_value

  sine(x: real): real =
    epsilon(
      LAMBDA (value: real):
        converges_to(
          LAMBDA (count: nat): sine_partial(x, count),
          value))

  cosine(x: real): real =
    epsilon(
      LAMBDA (value: real):
        converges_to(
          LAMBDA (count: nat): cosine_partial(x, count),
          value))

  putnam_1987_b4: bool =
    FORALL (x, y: real_sequence):
      (x(1) = (4 :: real) / 5
        AND y(1) = (3 :: real) / 5
        AND (FORALL (n: nat):
          n >= 1 IMPLIES
            x(n + 1) =
              x(n) * cosine(y(n)) - y(n) * sine(y(n)))
        AND (FORALL (n: nat):
          n >= 1 IMPLIES
            y(n + 1) =
              x(n) * sine(y(n)) + y(n) * cosine(y(n))))
      IMPLIES
        converges_to(x, -1)
          AND converges_to(y, 0)
END putnam_1987_b4

title: putnam_1987_b5
content:
import Mathlib

open MvPolynomial Real Nat Filter Topology

/--
Let $O_n$ be the $n$-dimensional vector $(0,0,\cdots, 0)$. Let $M$ be a $2n \times n$ matrix of complex numbers such that whenever $(z_1, z_2, \dots, z_{2n})M = O_n$, with complex $z_i$, not all zero, then at least one of the $z_i$ is not real. Prove that for arbitrary real numbers $r_1, r_2, \dots, r_{2n}$, there are complex numbers $w_1, w_2, \dots, w_n$ such that
\[
\mathrm{re}\left[ M \left( \begin{array}{c} w_1 \\ \vdots \\ w_n \end{array} \right) \right] = \left( \begin{array}{c} r_1 \\ \vdots \\ r_{2n} \end{array} \right).
\]
(Note: if $C$ is a matrix of complex numbers, $\mathrm{re}(C)$ is the matrix whose entries are the real parts of the entries of $C$.)
-/
theorem putnam_1987_b5
(n : ℕ)
(npos : n > 0)
(M : Matrix (Fin (2 * n)) (Fin n) ℂ)
(hM : ∀ z : Matrix (Fin 1) (Fin (2 * n)) ℂ, z * M = 0 → (¬∀ i : Fin (2 * n), z 0 i = 0) → ∃ i : Fin (2 * n), (z 0 i).im ≠ 0)
: (∀ r : Matrix (Fin (2 * n)) (Fin 1) ℝ, ∃ w : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin 1) ℂ, ∀ i : (Fin (2 * n)), ((M * w) i 0).re = r i 0) :=
sorry

title: putnam_1987_b5
content:
(* Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench artifact putnam_1987_b5:
   surjectivity of the real-part map induced by a complex 2n-by-n matrix
   under a condition on its nonzero left-kernel vectors. This file contains no proof. *)

From Stdlib Require Import Vectors.Fin Reals.

Open Scope R_scope.

Record putnam_1987_b5_complex : Type := putnam_1987_b5_Complex {
  putnam_1987_b5_real_part : R;
  putnam_1987_b5_imaginary_part : R
}.

Definition putnam_1987_b5_Czero : putnam_1987_b5_complex :=
  putnam_1987_b5_Complex 0 0.

Definition putnam_1987_b5_Cadd
    (z w : putnam_1987_b5_complex) : putnam_1987_b5_complex :=
  putnam_1987_b5_Complex
    (putnam_1987_b5_real_part z + putnam_1987_b5_real_part w)
    (putnam_1987_b5_imaginary_part z + putnam_1987_b5_imaginary_part w).

Definition putnam_1987_b5_Cmul
    (z w : putnam_1987_b5_complex) : putnam_1987_b5_complex :=
  putnam_1987_b5_Complex
    (putnam_1987_b5_real_part z * putnam_1987_b5_real_part w -
       putnam_1987_b5_imaginary_part z * putnam_1987_b5_imaginary_part w)
    (putnam_1987_b5_real_part z * putnam_1987_b5_imaginary_part w +
       putnam_1987_b5_imaginary_part z * putnam_1987_b5_real_part w).

Fixpoint putnam_1987_b5_fin_sum
    (n : nat) : (Fin.t n -> putnam_1987_b5_complex) ->
                putnam_1987_b5_complex :=
  match n as k return
      (Fin.t k -> putnam_1987_b5_complex) -> putnam_1987_b5_complex with
  | O => fun _ => putnam_1987_b5_Czero
  | S k =>
      fun f =>
        putnam_1987_b5_Cadd
          (f Fin.F1)
          (putnam_1987_b5_fin_sum k (fun i => f (Fin.FS i)))
  end.

Definition putnam_1987_b5_matrix (rows cols : nat) : Type :=
  Fin.t rows -> Fin.t cols -> putnam_1987_b5_complex.

Definition putnam_1987_b5_row_times_matrix
    {rows cols : nat}
    (z : Fin.t rows -> putnam_1987_b5_complex)
    (M : putnam_1987_b5_matrix rows cols)
    (j : Fin.t cols) : putnam_1987_b5_complex :=
  putnam_1987_b5_fin_sum rows
    (fun i => putnam_1987_b5_Cmul (z i) (M i j)).

Definition putnam_1987_b5_matrix_times_column
    {rows cols : nat}
    (M : putnam_1987_b5_matrix rows cols)
    (w : Fin.t cols -> putnam_1987_b5_complex)
    (i : Fin.t rows) : putnam_1987_b5_complex :=
  putnam_1987_b5_fin_sum cols
    (fun j => putnam_1987_b5_Cmul (M i j) (w j)).

Theorem putnam_1987_b5
    (n : nat)
    (npos : (0 < n)%nat)
    (M : putnam_1987_b5_matrix (2 * n) n)
    (hM :
      forall z : Fin.t (2 * n) -> putnam_1987_b5_complex,
        (forall j : Fin.t n,
          putnam_1987_b5_row_times_matrix z M j =
            putnam_1987_b5_Czero) ->
        (~ forall i : Fin.t (2 * n), z i = putnam_1987_b5_Czero) ->
        exists i : Fin.t (2 * n),
          putnam_1987_b5_imaginary_part (z i) <> 0) :
  forall r : Fin.t (2 * n) -> R,
    exists w : Fin.t n -> putnam_1987_b5_complex,
      forall i : Fin.t (2 * n),
        putnam_1987_b5_real_part
          (putnam_1987_b5_matrix_times_column M w i) = r i.
Admitted.

theory putnam_1987_b5 imports Complex_Main "HOL-Analysis.Finite_Cartesian_Product"
begin

theorem putnam_1987_b5:
  fixes n::nat and M::"complex^'a^'b"
  assumes matsize : "CARD('a) = n \<and> CARD('b) = 2 * n"
    and npos : "n > 0"
    and hM : "\<forall>z::(complex^'b^1). (\<forall> i. (z ** M)$1$i = 0)
       \<longrightarrow> (\<not>(\<forall>i. z$1$i = 0)) \<longrightarrow> (\<exists>i. Im (z$1$i) \<noteq> 0)"
  shows "\<forall>r::(real^1^'b). \<exists>w::(complex^1^'a). \<forall>i. Re ((M**w)$i$1) = r$i$1"
  sorry

end

title: putnam_1987_b5
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1987_b5:
  surjectivity onto real vectors of the real part of a complex rectangular
  matrix map under the stated row-kernel condition. This file contains no proof.
*)

let complex_output = open_out "/dev/null";;
let complex_formatter = Format.formatter_of_out_channel complex_output;;
let complex_loaded =
  Toploop.use_file complex_formatter "Complex/complexnumbers.ml";;
Format.pp_print_flush complex_formatter ();;
close_out complex_output;;
if not complex_loaded then
  failwith "failed to load Complex/complexnumbers.ml";;

let statement =
  `!n:num. !M:num->num->complex.
     0 < n /\
     (!z:num->complex.
        (!j:num.
           j < n
           ==>
           iterate ((+):complex->complex->complex)
             {i:num | i < 2 * n} (\i. z i * M i j) =
           Cx(&0))
        ==>
        (~(!i:num. i < 2 * n ==> z i = Cx(&0))
         ==>
         ?i:num. i < 2 * n /\ ~(Im (z i) = &0)))
     ==>
     !r:num->real.
       ?w:num->complex.
         !i:num.
           i < 2 * n
           ==>
           Re
             (iterate ((+):complex->complex->complex)
                {j:num | j < n} (\j. M i j * w j)) =
           r i`;;

title: putnam_1987_b5
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1987_b5:
;; a complex 2n-by-n matrix whose left kernel has no nonzero real vector
;; has a surjective real-part map onto the real 2n-vectors.
;; This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))

;; The scalar domain is an arbitrary real closed ordered field.  Real closed
;; fields have the same first-order theory as the reals, and for each positive
;; n the matrix assertion below is first-order.  Thus this presentation is
;; bidirectionally equivalent to the source statement over R and C.
;;
;; Complex values are exact pairs of field elements.  Matrices and vectors are
;; exact finite row-major lists of the source dimensions.  DEFUN-SK keeps the
;; universal kernel vector, every real target vector, and the existential
;; complex preimage internal to the statement.  In particular, entries range
;; over the whole represented field, not an algebraic or rational subfield.

(defun p87b5-r-carrier (ctx) (nth 0 ctx))
(defun p87b5-r-zero (ctx) (nth 1 ctx))
(defun p87b5-r-one (ctx) (nth 2 ctx))
(defun p87b5-r-add (ctx) (nth 3 ctx))
(defun p87b5-r-mul (ctx) (nth 4 ctx))
(defun p87b5-r-neg (ctx) (nth 5 ctx))
(defun p87b5-r-inv (ctx) (nth 6 ctx))
(defun p87b5-r-lt (ctx) (nth 7 ctx))

(defun p87b5-member-p (ctx x)
  (if (apply$ (p87b5-r-carrier ctx) (list x)) t nil))

(defun p87b5-unary-value (operation x)
  (apply$ operation (list x)))

(defun p87b5-binary-value (operation x y)
  (apply$ operation (list x y)))

(defun p87b5-add (ctx x y)
  (p87b5-binary-value (p87b5-r-add ctx) x y))

(defun p87b5-mul (ctx x y)
  (p87b5-binary-value (p87b5-r-mul ctx) x y))

(defun p87b5-neg (ctx x)
  (p87b5-unary-value (p87b5-r-neg ctx) x))

(defun p87b5-inv (ctx x)
  (p87b5-unary-value (p87b5-r-inv ctx) x))

(defun p87b5-lt-p (ctx x y)
  (if (p87b5-binary-value (p87b5-r-lt ctx) x y) t nil))

(defun-sk p87b5-field-laws-p (ctx)
  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (p87b5-member-p ctx x)
      (p87b5-member-p ctx y)
      (p87b5-member-p ctx z))
     (and
      (p87b5-member-p ctx (p87b5-add ctx x y))
      (p87b5-member-p ctx (p87b5-mul ctx x y))
      (p87b5-member-p ctx (p87b5-neg ctx x))
      (p87b5-member-p ctx (p87b5-inv ctx x))
      (equal
       (p87b5-add ctx (p87b5-add ctx x y) z)
       (p87b5-add ctx x (p87b5-add ctx y z)))
      (equal (p87b5-add ctx x y) (p87b5-add ctx y x))
      (equal (p87b5-add ctx x (p87b5-r-zero ctx)) x)
      (equal
       (p87b5-add ctx x (p87b5-neg ctx x))
       (p87b5-r-zero ctx))
      (equal
       (p87b5-mul ctx (p87b5-mul ctx x y) z)
       (p87b5-mul ctx x (p87b5-mul ctx y z)))
      (equal (p87b5-mul ctx x y) (p87b5-mul ctx y x))
      (equal (p87b5-mul ctx x (p87b5-r-one ctx)) x)
      (implies
       (equal x (p87b5-r-zero ctx))
       (equal (p87b5-inv ctx x) (p87b5-r-zero ctx)))
      (implies
       (not (equal x (p87b5-r-zero ctx)))
       (equal
        (p87b5-mul ctx x (p87b5-inv ctx x))
        (p87b5-r-one ctx)))
      (equal
       (p87b5-mul ctx x (p87b5-add ctx y z))
       (p87b5-add
        ctx
        (p87b5-mul ctx x y)
        (p87b5-mul ctx x z)))))))

(defun-sk p87b5-order-laws-p (ctx)
  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (p87b5-member-p ctx x)
      (p87b5-member-p ctx y)
      (p87b5-member-p ctx z))
     (and
      (not (p87b5-lt-p ctx x x))
      (or
       (equal x y)
       (p87b5-lt-p ctx x y)
       (p87b5-lt-p ctx y x))
      (implies
       (and
        (p87b5-lt-p ctx x y)
        (p87b5-lt-p ctx y z))
       (p87b5-lt-p ctx x z))
      (implies
       (p87b5-lt-p ctx x y)
       (p87b5-lt-p
        ctx
        (p87b5-add ctx x z)
        (p87b5-add ctx y z)))
      (implies
       (and
        (p87b5-lt-p ctx (p87b5-r-zero ctx) x)
        (p87b5-lt-p ctx (p87b5-r-zero ctx) y))
       (p87b5-lt-p
        ctx
        (p87b5-r-zero ctx)
        (p87b5-mul ctx x y)))))))

(defun p87b5-carrier-list-p (values ctx)
  (if (endp values)
      (equal values nil)
    (and
     (p87b5-member-p ctx (car values))
     (p87b5-carrier-list-p (cdr values) ctx))))

(defun p87b5-polynomial-p (coefficients ctx)
  (and
   (true-listp coefficients)
   (consp coefficients)
   (p87b5-carrier-list-p coefficients ctx)
   (or
    (equal (len coefficients) 1)
    (not
     (equal
      (car (last coefficients))
      (p87b5-r-zero ctx))))))

(defun p87b5-polynomial-eval (ctx coefficients x)
  (if (endp coefficients)
      (p87b5-r-zero ctx)
    (p87b5-add
     ctx
     (car coefficients)
     (p87b5-mul
      ctx
      x
      (p87b5-polynomial-eval ctx (cdr coefficients) x)))))

(defun-sk p87b5-square-root-exists-p (ctx x)
  (exists (root)
    (and
     (p87b5-member-p ctx root)
     (equal (p87b5-mul ctx root root) x))))

(defun-sk p87b5-odd-root-exists-p (ctx coefficients)
  (exists (root)
    (and
     (p87b5-member-p ctx root)
     (equal
      (p87b5-polynomial-eval ctx coefficients root)
      (p87b5-r-zero ctx)))))

(defun-sk p87b5-real-closed-laws-p (ctx)
  (forall (x coefficients)
    (and
     (implies
      (and
       (p87b5-member-p ctx x)
       (not (p87b5-lt-p ctx x (p87b5-r-zero ctx))))
      (p87b5-square-root-exists-p ctx x))
     (implies
      (and
       (p87b5-polynomial-p coefficients ctx)
       (evenp (len coefficients)))
      (p87b5-odd-root-exists-p ctx coefficients)))))

(defun p87b5-real-closed-field-p (ctx)
  (and
   (true-listp ctx)
   (equal (len ctx) 8)
   (tamep-functionp (p87b5-r-carrier ctx))
   (tamep-functionp (p87b5-r-add ctx))
   (tamep-functionp (p87b5-r-mul ctx))
   (tamep-functionp (p87b5-r-neg ctx))
   (tamep-functionp (p87b5-r-inv ctx))
   (tamep-functionp (p87b5-r-lt ctx))
   (p87b5-member-p ctx (p87b5-r-zero ctx))
   (p87b5-member-p ctx (p87b5-r-one ctx))
   (not (equal (p87b5-r-zero ctx) (p87b5-r-one ctx)))
   (p87b5-field-laws-p ctx)
   (p87b5-order-laws-p ctx)
   (p87b5-lt-p ctx (p87b5-r-zero ctx) (p87b5-r-one ctx))
   (p87b5-real-closed-laws-p ctx)))

(defun p87b5-complex-p (value ctx)
  (and
   (true-listp value)
   (equal (len value) 2)
   (p87b5-member-p ctx (car value))
   (p87b5-member-p ctx (cadr value))))

(defun p87b5-complex-list-p (values ctx)
  (if (endp values)
      (equal values nil)
    (and
     (p87b5-complex-p (car values) ctx)
     (p87b5-complex-list-p (cdr values) ctx))))

(defun p87b5-complex-vector-p (vector length ctx)
  (and
   (natp length)
   (true-listp vector)
   (equal (len vector) length)
   (p87b5-complex-list-p vector ctx)))

(defun p87b5-real-vector-p (vector length ctx)
  (and
   (natp length)
   (true-listp vector)
   (equal (len vector) length)
   (p87b5-carrier-list-p vector ctx)))

(defun p87b5-complex-matrix-p (matrix rows columns ctx)
  (and
   (natp rows)
   (natp columns)
   (true-listp matrix)
   (equal (len matrix) (* rows columns))
   (p87b5-complex-list-p matrix ctx)))

(defun p87b5-complex-zero (ctx)
  (list (p87b5-r-zero ctx) (p87b5-r-zero ctx)))

(defun p87b5-complex-add (ctx left right)
  (list
   (p87b5-add ctx (car left) (car right))
   (p87b5-add ctx (cadr left) (cadr right))))

(defun p87b5-complex-mul (ctx left right)
  (list
   (p87b5-add
    ctx
    (p87b5-mul ctx (car left) (car right))
    (p87b5-neg
     ctx
     (p87b5-mul ctx (cadr left) (cadr right))))
   (p87b5-add
    ctx
    (p87b5-mul ctx (car left) (cadr right))
    (p87b5-mul ctx (cadr left) (car right)))))

(defun p87b5-left-product-entry
    (ctx vector matrix columns column row remaining)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix remaining)))
  (if (zp remaining)
      (p87b5-complex-zero ctx)
    (p87b5-complex-add
     ctx
     (p87b5-complex-mul
      ctx
      (nth row vector)
      (nth (+ (* row columns) column) matrix))
     (p87b5-left-product-entry
      ctx vector matrix columns column
      (+ row 1) (- remaining 1)))))

(defun p87b5-left-product-zero-p
    (ctx vector matrix rows columns column remaining)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix remaining)))
  (if (zp remaining)
      t
    (and
     (equal
      (p87b5-left-product-entry
       ctx vector matrix columns column 0 rows)
      (p87b5-complex-zero ctx))
     (p87b5-left-product-zero-p
      ctx vector matrix rows columns
      (+ column 1) (- remaining 1)))))

(defun p87b5-complex-vector-zero-p (ctx vector)
  (if (endp vector)
      t
    (and
     (equal (car vector) (p87b5-complex-zero ctx))
     (p87b5-complex-vector-zero-p ctx (cdr vector)))))

(defun p87b5-has-nonreal-coordinate-p (ctx vector)
  (if (endp vector)
      nil
    (or
     (not (equal (cadar vector) (p87b5-r-zero ctx)))
     (p87b5-has-nonreal-coordinate-p ctx (cdr vector)))))

(defun-sk p87b5-kernel-condition-p (ctx n matrix)
  (forall (z)
    (implies
     (and
      (p87b5-complex-vector-p z (* 2 n) ctx)
      (p87b5-left-product-zero-p
       ctx z matrix (* 2 n) n 0 n)
      (not (p87b5-complex-vector-zero-p ctx z)))
     (p87b5-has-nonreal-coordinate-p ctx z))))

(defun p87b5-right-product-entry
    (ctx matrix vector columns row column remaining)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix remaining)))
  (if (zp remaining)
      (p87b5-complex-zero ctx)
    (p87b5-complex-add
     ctx
     (p87b5-complex-mul
      ctx
      (nth (+ (* row columns) column) matrix)
      (nth column vector))
     (p87b5-right-product-entry
      ctx matrix vector columns row
      (+ column 1) (- remaining 1)))))

(defun p87b5-real-part-equations-p
    (ctx matrix vector target columns row remaining)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix remaining)))
  (if (zp remaining)
      t
    (and
     (equal
      (car
       (p87b5-right-product-entry
        ctx matrix vector columns row 0 columns))
      (nth row target))
     (p87b5-real-part-equations-p
      ctx matrix vector target columns
      (+ row 1) (- remaining 1)))))

(defun p87b5-preimage-p (ctx n matrix target vector)
  (and
   (p87b5-complex-vector-p vector n ctx)
   (p87b5-real-part-equations-p
    ctx matrix vector target n 0 (* 2 n))))

(defun-sk p87b5-target-has-preimage-p (ctx n matrix target)
  (exists (vector)
    (p87b5-preimage-p ctx n matrix target vector)))

(defun-sk p87b5-surjective-real-part-p (ctx n matrix)
  (forall (target)
    (implies
     (p87b5-real-vector-p target (* 2 n) ctx)
     (p87b5-target-has-preimage-p
      ctx n matrix target))))

(defun putnambench-putnam-1987-b5-statement (ctx n matrix)
  (implies
   (and
    (p87b5-real-closed-field-p ctx)
    (posp n)
    (p87b5-complex-matrix-p matrix (* 2 n) n ctx)
    (p87b5-kernel-condition-p ctx n matrix))
   (p87b5-surjective-real-part-p ctx n matrix)))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

title: putnam_1987_b5
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1987_b5:
-- a 2n by n complex matrix whose nonzero left-kernel vectors cannot be
-- entirely real has real-part image equal to every real 2n-vector.
-- This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; _*_)

infix 4 _!=_
infixr 3 _and_
infixr 2 _or_

data Bottom : Set where

Not : Set -> Set
Not A =
  A -> Bottom

_!=_ : {A : Set} -> A -> A -> Set
x != y =
  Not (x == y)

record _and_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data _or_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  left  : A -> A or B
  right : B -> A or B

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

data Positive : Nat -> Set where
  positive : {n : Nat} -> Positive (suc n)

data Fin : Nat -> Set where
  fzero : {n : Nat} -> Fin (suc n)
  fsuc  : {n : Nat} -> Fin n -> Fin (suc n)

record CompleteOrderedRealField (R : Set) : Set1 where
  field
    zeroR oneR : R
    add multiply : R -> R -> R
    negate inverse : R -> R
    lessOrEqual : R -> R -> Set
    fromNat : Nat -> R

    one-not-zero :
      oneR != zeroR

    add-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> add x y == add y x
    add-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      add (add x y) z == add x (add y z)
    add-zero :
      (x : R) -> add x zeroR == x
    add-inverse :
      (x : R) -> add x (negate x) == zeroR

    multiply-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> multiply x y == multiply y x
    multiply-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply (multiply x y) z ==
      multiply x (multiply y z)
    multiply-one :
      (x : R) -> multiply x oneR == x
    multiply-zero :
      (x : R) -> multiply x zeroR == zeroR
    distribute :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply x (add y z) ==
      add (multiply x y) (multiply x z)
    inverse-zero :
      inverse zeroR == zeroR
    multiply-inverse :
      (x : R) ->
      x != zeroR ->
      multiply x (inverse x) == oneR

    order-reflexive :
      (x : R) -> lessOrEqual x x
    order-transitive :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y z ->
      lessOrEqual x z
    order-antisymmetric :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y x ->
      x == y
    order-total :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y or lessOrEqual y x
    add-order :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual (add z x) (add z y)
    multiply-nonnegative :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR x ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR y ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR (multiply x y)
    zero-less-than-one :
      lessOrEqual zeroR oneR and zeroR != oneR

    fromNat-zero :
      fromNat zero == zeroR
    fromNat-successor :
      (n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (suc n) == add (fromNat n) oneR
    fromNat-addition :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m + n) == add (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-multiplication :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m * n) == multiply (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-injective :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat m == fromNat n ->
      m == n

    archimedean :
      (x : R) ->
      Exists Nat (\ n -> lessOrEqual x (fromNat n))
    least-upper-bound :
      (P : R -> Set) ->
      Exists R P ->
      Exists R
        (\ upper ->
          (x : R) ->
          P x ->
          lessOrEqual x upper) ->
      Exists R
        (\ supremum ->
          ((x : R) ->
            P x ->
            lessOrEqual x supremum)
          and
          ((upper : R) ->
            ((x : R) ->
              P x ->
              lessOrEqual x upper) ->
            lessOrEqual supremum upper))

open CompleteOrderedRealField

record Complex (R : Set) : Set where
  constructor complex
  field
    realPart      : R
    imaginaryPart : R

open Complex

complexZero :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Complex R
complexZero reals =
  complex (zeroR reals) (zeroR reals)

complexAdd :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Complex R ->
  Complex R ->
  Complex R
complexAdd reals z w =
  complex
    (add reals (realPart z) (realPart w))
    (add reals (imaginaryPart z) (imaginaryPart w))

complexMultiply :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Complex R ->
  Complex R ->
  Complex R
complexMultiply reals z w =
  complex
    (add reals
      (multiply reals (realPart z) (realPart w))
      (negate reals
        (multiply reals (imaginaryPart z) (imaginaryPart w))))
    (add reals
      (multiply reals (realPart z) (imaginaryPart w))
      (multiply reals (imaginaryPart z) (realPart w)))

sumFinComplex :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  {n : Nat} ->
  (Fin n -> Complex R) ->
  Complex R
sumFinComplex reals {zero} terms =
  complexZero reals
sumFinComplex reals {suc n} terms =
  complexAdd reals
    (terms fzero)
    (sumFinComplex reals (\ i -> terms (fsuc i)))

Vector : Set -> Nat -> Set
Vector A n =
  Fin n -> A

Matrix : Set -> Nat -> Nat -> Set
Matrix A rows columns =
  Fin rows -> Fin columns -> A

rowTimesMatrix :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  {rows columns : Nat} ->
  Vector (Complex R) rows ->
  Matrix (Complex R) rows columns ->
  Vector (Complex R) columns
rowTimesMatrix reals z M column =
  sumFinComplex reals
    (\ row ->
      complexMultiply reals
        (z row)
        (M row column))

matrixTimesColumn :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  {rows columns : Nat} ->
  Matrix (Complex R) rows columns ->
  Vector (Complex R) columns ->
  Vector (Complex R) rows
matrixTimesColumn reals M w row =
  sumFinComplex reals
    (\ column ->
      complexMultiply reals
        (M row column)
        (w column))

twoN : Nat
twoN =
  suc (suc zero)

LeftKernelCondition :
  {R : Set} ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) ->
  (n : Nat) ->
  Matrix (Complex R) (twoN * n) n ->
  Set
LeftKernelCondition {R} reals n M =
  (z : Vector (Complex R) (twoN * n)) ->
  ((column : Fin n) ->
    rowTimesMatrix reals z M column == complexZero reals) ->
  Not
    ((row : Fin (twoN * n)) ->
      z row == complexZero reals) ->
  Exists (Fin (twoN * n))
    (\ row ->
      imaginaryPart (z row) != zeroR reals)

module Putnam1987B5Statement
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) where

  proposition : Set
  proposition =
    (n : Nat) ->
    Positive n ->
    (M : Matrix (Complex R) (twoN * n) n) ->
    LeftKernelCondition reals n M ->
    (r : Vector R (twoN * n)) ->
    Exists (Vector (Complex R) n)
      (\ w ->
        (row : Fin (twoN * n)) ->
        realPart (matrixTimesColumn reals M w row) == r row)

putnam-1987-b5 : Set1
putnam-1987-b5 =
  (R : Set) ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) ->
  Putnam1987B5Statement.proposition reals

title: putnam_1987_b5
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1987_b5:
  a 2n by n complex matrix whose left kernel contains no nonzero real vector
  maps complex n-vectors onto all real 2n-vectors after taking real parts.
  This file contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open arithmeticTheory pred_setTheory realTheory complexTheory;

val putnam_1987_b5 =
  ``let complex_sum =
      \(s : num set) (f : num -> complex).
        ITSET (\i acc. f i + acc) s (0 : complex)
    in
      !n : num. !M : num -> num -> complex.
        0 < n /\
        (!z : num -> complex.
           (!j : num.
              j < n
              ==>
              complex_sum
                (count (2 * n))
                (\i : num. z i * M i j) = 0)
           ==>
           ~(!i : num. i < 2 * n ==> z i = 0)
           ==>
           ?i : num. i < 2 * n /\ IM (z i) <> 0)
        ==>
        !r : num -> real.
          ?w : num -> complex.
            !i : num.
              i < 2 * n
              ==>
              RE
                (complex_sum
                   (count n)
                   (\j : num. M i j * w j)) = r i``;

$(
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact
  putnam_1987_b5: a complex 2n-by-n matrix whose nonzero left-kernel
  vectors cannot be entirely real has a real-part map surjective onto
  all real 2n-vectors. This file contains no proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  The zero-based carriers 0 ..^ n and 0 ..^ ( 2 x. n ) represent Fin n
  and Fin (2*n). The matrix M is a total row-indexed family of total
  column functions. Both matrix products from the sources are expanded
  as finite sums: z times M in the hypothesis and M times w in the
  conclusion. Re and Im are SetMM's real- and imaginary-part functions.

  The final declaration is the single unproved $a corpus statement; this
  database contains no $p proof declaration.
$)

${
  $d M i j n r w z $.

  putnambench-putnam-1987-b5 $a |-
    A. n e. NN
      A. M e.
        (
          ( CC ^m ( 0 ..^ n ) )
          ^m
          ( 0 ..^ ( 2 x. n ) )
        )
        (
          (
            A. z e. ( CC ^m ( 0 ..^ ( 2 x. n ) ) )
              (
                A. j e. ( 0 ..^ n )
                  (
                    sum_ i e. ( 0 ..^ ( 2 x. n ) )
                      (
                        ( z ` i )
                        x.
                        ( ( M ` i ) ` j )
                      )
                  )
                  =
                  0
                ->
                (
                  -. A. i e. ( 0 ..^ ( 2 x. n ) )
                    ( z ` i ) = 0
                  ->
                  E. i e. ( 0 ..^ ( 2 x. n ) )
                    ( Im ` ( z ` i ) ) =/= 0
                )
              )
          )
          ->
          A. r e. ( RR ^m ( 0 ..^ ( 2 x. n ) ) )
            E. w e. ( CC ^m ( 0 ..^ n ) )
              A. i e. ( 0 ..^ ( 2 x. n ) )
                (
                  Re
                  `
                  (
                    sum_ j e. ( 0 ..^ n )
                      (
                        ( ( M ` i ) ` j )
                        x.
                        ( w ` j )
                      )

                )
                =

title: putnam_1987_b5
content:
% Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1987_b5:
% a complex 2n-by-n matrix whose nonzero left-kernel vectors are not all real
% has real-part map onto all real 2n-vectors. This file contains no proof.

putnam_1987_b5[n: posnat]: THEORY
BEGIN
  complex: TYPE = [# real_part: real, imag_part: real #]

  row_index: TYPE = below(2 * n)
  column_index: TYPE = below(n)

  matrix: TYPE = [row_index, column_index -> complex]
  row_vector: TYPE = [row_index -> complex]
  column_vector: TYPE = [column_index -> complex]
  real_column_vector: TYPE = [row_index -> real]

  complex_zero: complex =
    (# real_part := 0, imag_part := 0 #)

  complex_add(left, right: complex): complex =
    (# real_part := real_part(left) + real_part(right),
       imag_part := imag_part(left) + imag_part(right) #)

  complex_mul(left, right: complex): complex =
    (# real_part :=
         real_part(left) * real_part(right)
           - imag_part(left) * imag_part(right),
       imag_part :=
         real_part(left) * imag_part(right)
           + imag_part(left) * real_part(right) #)

  left_product_sum(
      z: row_vector,
      M: matrix,
      column: column_index,
      count: nat): RECURSIVE complex =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      complex_zero
    ELSE
      complex_add(
        left_product_sum(z, M, column, count - 1),
        IF count <= 2 * n THEN
          complex_mul(z(count - 1), M(count - 1, column))
        ELSE
          complex_zero
        ENDIF)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  matrix_vector_sum(
      M: matrix,
      w: column_vector,
      row: row_index,
      count: nat): RECURSIVE complex =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      complex_zero
    ELSE
      complex_add(
        matrix_vector_sum(M, w, row, count - 1),
        IF count <= n THEN
          complex_mul(M(row, count - 1), w(count - 1))
        ELSE
          complex_zero
        ENDIF)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  left_product(
      z: row_vector,
      M: matrix,
      column: column_index): complex =
    left_product_sum(z, M, column, 2 * n)

  matrix_vector_product(
      M: matrix,
      w: column_vector,
      row: row_index): complex =
    matrix_vector_sum(M, w, row, n)

  left_kernel_condition(M: matrix): bool =
    FORALL (z: row_vector):
      ((FORALL (column: column_index):
          left_product(z, M, column) = complex_zero)
        AND NOT (FORALL (row: row_index):
          z(row) = complex_zero))
      IMPLIES
        EXISTS (row: row_index):
          imag_part(z(row)) /= 0

  putnam_1987_b5: bool =
    FORALL (M: matrix):
      left_kernel_condition(M)
        IMPLIES
          FORALL (r: real_column_vector):
            EXISTS (w: column_vector):
              FORALL (row: row_index):
                real_part(matrix_vector_product(M, w, row)) = r(row)
END putnam_1987_b5

title: putnam_1987_b6
content:
import Mathlib

open MvPolynomial Real Nat Filter Topology

/--
Let $F$ be the field of $p^2$ elements, where $p$ is an odd prime. Suppose $S$ is a set of $(p^2-1)/2$ distinct nonzero elements of $F$ with the property that for each $a\neq 0$ in $F$, exactly one of $a$ and $-a$ is in $S$. Let $N$ be the number of elements in the intersection $S \cap \{2a: a \in S\}$. Prove that $N$ is even.
-/
theorem putnam_1987_b6
    (p : ℕ)
    (F : Type*) [Field F] [Fintype F]
    (S : Set F)
    (hp : Odd p ∧ Nat.Prime p)
    (Fcard : Fintype.card F = p ^ 2)
    (Snz : ∀ x ∈ S, x ≠ 0)
    (Scard : S.ncard = ((p : ℤ) ^ 2 - 1) / 2)
    (hS : ∀ a : F, a ≠ 0 → Xor' (a ∈ S) (-a ∈ S)) :
    (Even ((S ∩ {x | ∃ a ∈ S, x = 2 * a}).ncard)) :=
  sorry

title: putnam_1987_b6
content:
(* Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1987_b6:
   parity of the intersection of a sign-representative subset of the finite
   field of p^2 elements with its doubled image. This file contains no proof. *)

From Stdlib Require Import Field Lists.List Arith.PeanoNat.

Record putnam_1987_b6_finite_field : Type := {
  ff_carrier : Type;
  ff_zero : ff_carrier;
  ff_one : ff_carrier;
  ff_add : ff_carrier -> ff_carrier -> ff_carrier;
  ff_mul : ff_carrier -> ff_carrier -> ff_carrier;
  ff_sub : ff_carrier -> ff_carrier -> ff_carrier;
  ff_opp : ff_carrier -> ff_carrier;
  ff_div : ff_carrier -> ff_carrier -> ff_carrier;
  ff_inv : ff_carrier -> ff_carrier;
  ff_field_theory :
    field_theory
      ff_zero ff_one ff_add ff_mul ff_sub ff_opp ff_div ff_inv eq;
  ff_elements : list ff_carrier;
  ff_elements_nodup : NoDup ff_elements;
  ff_elements_complete : forall x : ff_carrier, In x ff_elements
}.

Arguments ff_zero {_}.
Arguments ff_add {_} _ _.
Arguments ff_opp {_} _.

Definition putnam_1987_b6_prime (p : nat) : Prop :=
  (2 <= p)%nat /\
  forall d : nat, Nat.divide d p -> d = 1%nat \/ d = p.

Definition putnam_1987_b6_has_cardinality
    {A : Type} (S : A -> Prop) (n : nat) : Prop :=
  exists xs : list A,
    NoDup xs /\
    (forall x : A, In x xs <-> S x) /\
    length xs = n.

Definition putnam_1987_b6_has_even_cardinality
    {A : Type} (S : A -> Prop) : Prop :=
  exists xs : list A,
    NoDup xs /\
    (forall x : A, In x xs <-> S x) /\
    Nat.Even (length xs).

Theorem putnam_1987_b6
    (p : nat)
    (F : putnam_1987_b6_finite_field)
    (S : ff_carrier F -> Prop)
    (hp : Nat.Odd p /\ putnam_1987_b6_prime p)
    (Fcard : length (ff_elements F) = Nat.pow p 2)
    (Snz : forall x : ff_carrier F, S x -> x <> ff_zero)
    (Scard :
      putnam_1987_b6_has_cardinality
        S (Nat.div (Nat.pow p 2 - 1) 2))
    (hS : forall a : ff_carrier F,
      a <> ff_zero ->
      (S a /\ ~ S (ff_opp a)) \/ (~ S a /\ S (ff_opp a))) :
  putnam_1987_b6_has_even_cardinality
    (fun x : ff_carrier F =>
      S x /\
      exists a : ff_carrier F, S a /\ x = ff_add a a).
Admitted.

theorem putnam_1987_b6:

    and hS : "\<forall>a::'a. a \<in> carrier F \<longrightarrow> a \<noteq> \<zero>\<^bsub>F\<^esub> \<longrightarrow> \<not>((a \<in> S) \<longleftrightarrow> ((\<ominus>\<^bsub>F\<^esub> a) \<in> S))"

title: putnam_1987_b6
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1987_b6:
  parity of the overlap between a sign-representative subset of a finite
  field of order p^2 and its image under doubling. This file contains no proof.
*)

let statement =
  `let field_axioms =
     \(zero_F:A) (one_F:A) (add_F:A->A->A) (mul_F:A->A->A)
      (neg_F:A->A) (inv_F:A->A).
       ~(zero_F = one_F) /\
       (!x y:A. add_F x y = add_F y x) /\
       (!x y z:A. add_F (add_F x y) z = add_F x (add_F y z)) /\
       (!x:A. add_F x zero_F = x) /\
       (!x:A. add_F (neg_F x) x = zero_F) /\
       (!x y:A. mul_F x y = mul_F y x) /\
       (!x y z:A. mul_F (mul_F x y) z = mul_F x (mul_F y z)) /\
       (!x:A. mul_F one_F x = x) /\
       (!x:A. ~(x = zero_F) ==> mul_F (inv_F x) x = one_F) /\
       (!x y z:A.
          mul_F x (add_F y z) =
          add_F (mul_F x y) (mul_F x z)) in
   !p:num (zero_F:A) (one_F:A)
    (add_F:A->A->A) (mul_F:A->A->A)
    (neg_F:A->A) (inv_F:A->A) (S:A->bool).
     ODD p /\
     prime p /\
     field_axioms zero_F one_F add_F mul_F neg_F inv_F /\
     FINITE (UNIV:A->bool) /\
     CARD (UNIV:A->bool) = p EXP 2 /\
     (!x:A. x IN S ==> ~(x = zero_F)) /\
     CARD S = (p EXP 2 - 1) DIV 2 /\
     (!a:A.
        ~(a = zero_F)
        ==> ~((a IN S) <=> (neg_F a IN S)))
     ==>
     EVEN
       (CARD
         (S INTER
          {x:A | ?a:A. a IN S /\ x = add_F a a}))`;;

title: putnam_1987_b6
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1987_b6:
;; in a field of odd-prime-square order, an orientation of the nonzero
;; additive-inverse pairs meets its doubled image in an even number of
;; elements. This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

;; CARRIER and S are duplicate-free enumerations of the finite field and its
;; distinguished subset. ADD, MUL, NEG, and INV are ACL2 function objects,
;; rather than operation tables. Every finite field and subset in the source
;; has such an enumeration and tame finite-function presentation, while the
;; predicates below recover exactly the induced field structure and set.

(defun putnam-1987-b6-no-divisor-through-p (p candidate)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix candidate)))
  (if (or (not (natp candidate))
          (<= candidate 1))
      t
    (and
     (not (equal (mod p candidate) 0))
     (putnam-1987-b6-no-divisor-through-p
      p (- candidate 1)))))

(defun putnam-1987-b6-prime-p (p)
  (and
   (natp p)
   (< 1 p)
   (putnam-1987-b6-no-divisor-through-p
    p (- p 1))))

(defun putnam-1987-b6-unary (function x)
  (apply$ function (list x)))

(defun putnam-1987-b6-binary (function x y)
  (apply$ function (list x y)))

(defun putnam-1987-b6-subset-p (xs carrier)
  (if (endp xs)
      t
    (and
     (member-equal (car xs) carrier)
     (putnam-1987-b6-subset-p (cdr xs) carrier))))

(defun putnam-1987-b6-unary-closed-p
    (xs carrier function)
  (if (endp xs)
      t
    (and
     (member-equal
      (putnam-1987-b6-unary function (car xs))
      carrier)
     (putnam-1987-b6-unary-closed-p
      (cdr xs) carrier function))))

(defun putnam-1987-b6-binary-row-closed-p
    (x ys carrier function)
  (if (endp ys)
      t
    (and
     (member-equal
      (putnam-1987-b6-binary function x (car ys))
      carrier)
     (putnam-1987-b6-binary-row-closed-p
      x (cdr ys) carrier function))))

(defun putnam-1987-b6-binary-closed-p
    (xs carrier function)
  (if (endp xs)
      t
    (and
     (putnam-1987-b6-binary-row-closed-p
      (car xs) carrier carrier function)
     (putnam-1987-b6-binary-closed-p
      (cdr xs) carrier function))))

(defun putnam-1987-b6-commutative-row-p
    (x ys function)
  (if (endp ys)
      t
    (and
     (equal
      (putnam-1987-b6-binary function x (car ys))
      (putnam-1987-b6-binary function (car ys) x))
     (putnam-1987-b6-commutative-row-p
      x (cdr ys) function))))

(defun putnam-1987-b6-commutative-p
    (xs carrier function)
  (if (endp xs)
      t
    (and
     (putnam-1987-b6-commutative-row-p
      (car xs) carrier function)
     (putnam-1987-b6-commutative-p
      (cdr xs) carrier function))))

(defun putnam-1987-b6-associative-third-p
    (x y zs function)
  (if (endp zs)
      t
    (and
     (equal
      (putnam-1987-b6-binary
       function
       (putnam-1987-b6-binary function x y)
       (car zs))
      (putnam-1987-b6-binary
       function
       x
       (putnam-1987-b6-binary function y (car zs))))
     (putnam-1987-b6-associative-third-p
      x y (cdr zs) function))))

(defun putnam-1987-b6-associative-second-p
    (x ys carrier function)
  (if (endp ys)
      t
    (and
     (putnam-1987-b6-associative-third-p
      x (car ys) carrier function)
     (putnam-1987-b6-associative-second-p
      x (cdr ys) carrier function))))

(defun putnam-1987-b6-associative-p
    (xs carrier function)

      t
    (and
     (putnam-1987-b6-associative-second-p
      (car xs) carrier carrier function)
     (putnam-1987-b6-associative-p
      (cdr xs) carrier function))))

(defun putnam-1987-b6-distributive-third-p
    (x y zs add mul)

      t
    (and
     (equal
      (putnam-1987-b6-binary
       mul
       x
       (putnam-1987-b6-binary add y (car zs)))
      (putnam-1987-b6-binary
       add
       (putnam-1987-b6-binary mul x y)
       (putnam-1987-b6-binary mul x (car zs))))
     (putnam-1987-b6-distributive-third-p
      x y (cdr zs) add mul))))

(defun putnam-1987-b6-distributive-second-p
    (x ys carrier add mul)
  (if (endp ys)

     (putnam-1987-b6-distributive-third-p
      x (car ys) carrier add mul)
     (putnam-1987-b6-distributive-second-p
      x (cdr ys) carrier add mul))))

(defun putnam-1987-b6-distributive-p
    (xs carrier add mul)
  (if (endp xs)
      t
    (and
     (putnam-1987-b6-distributive-second-p
      (car xs) carrier carrier add mul)
     (putnam-1987-b6-distributive-p
      (cdr xs) carrier add mul))))

(defun putnam-1987-b6-identity-inverse-laws-p
    (xs zero one add mul neg inv)
  (if (endp xs)
      t
    (let* ((x (car xs))
           (negative-x
            (putnam-1987-b6-unary neg x))
           (inverse-x
            (putnam-1987-b6-unary inv x)))
      (and
       (equal
        (putnam-1987-b6-binary add x zero)
        x)
       (equal
        (putnam-1987-b6-binary add x negative-x)
        zero)
       (equal
        (putnam-1987-b6-binary mul x one)
        x)
       (if (equal x zero)
           (equal inverse-x zero)
         (equal
          (putnam-1987-b6-binary mul x inverse-x)
          one))
       (putnam-1987-b6-identity-inverse-laws-p
        (cdr xs) zero one add mul neg inv)))))

    (carrier zero one add mul neg inv)

   (true-listp carrier)
   (consp carrier)
   (no-duplicatesp-equal carrier)
   (member-equal zero carrier)
   (member-equal one carrier)
   (not (equal zero one))
   (tamep-functionp add)
   (tamep-functionp mul)
   (tamep-functionp neg)
   (tamep-functionp inv)
   (putnam-1987-b6-unary-closed-p
    carrier carrier neg)
   (putnam-1987-b6-unary-closed-p
    carrier carrier inv)
   (putnam-1987-b6-binary-closed-p
    carrier carrier add)
   (putnam-1987-b6-binary-closed-p
    carrier carrier mul)
   (putnam-1987-b6-commutative-p
    carrier carrier add)
   (putnam-1987-b6-commutative-p
    carrier carrier mul)
   (putnam-1987-b6-associative-p
    carrier carrier add)
   (putnam-1987-b6-associative-p
    carrier carrier mul)
   (putnam-1987-b6-distributive-p
    carrier carrier add mul)
   (putnam-1987-b6-identity-inverse-laws-p
    carrier zero one add mul neg inv)))

(defun putnam-1987-b6-all-nonzero-p (xs zero)
  (if (endp xs)
      t
    (and
     (not (equal (car xs) zero))
     (putnam-1987-b6-all-nonzero-p
      (cdr xs) zero))))

(defun putnam-1987-b6-oriented-p
    (xs s zero neg)
  (if (endp xs)
      t
    (let* ((x (car xs))
           (negative-x
            (putnam-1987-b6-unary neg x)))
      (and
       (if (equal x zero)
           t
         (if (member-equal x s)
             (not (member-equal negative-x s))
           (member-equal negative-x s)))
       (putnam-1987-b6-oriented-p
        (cdr xs) s zero neg)))))

(defun putnam-1987-b6-doubled-member-p
    (x s add)
  (if (endp s)
      nil
    (or
     (equal
      x
      (putnam-1987-b6-binary
       add (car s) (car s)))
     (putnam-1987-b6-doubled-member-p
      x (cdr s) add))))

(defun putnam-1987-b6-intersection-count
    (carrier s add)
  (if (endp carrier)
      0
    (+
     (if (and
          (member-equal (car carrier) s)
          (putnam-1987-b6-doubled-member-p
           (car carrier) s add))
         1
       0)
     (putnam-1987-b6-intersection-count
      (cdr carrier) s add))))

(defun putnambench-putnam-1987-b6-statement
    (p carrier zero one add mul neg inv s)
  (implies
   (and
    (putnam-1987-b6-prime-p p)
    (equal (mod p 2) 1)
    (putnam-1987-b6-field-p
     carrier zero one add mul neg inv)
    (equal (len carrier) (* p p))
    (true-listp s)
    (no-duplicatesp-equal s)
    (putnam-1987-b6-subset-p s carrier)
    (putnam-1987-b6-all-nonzero-p s zero)
    (equal (* 2 (len s))
           (- (* p p) 1))
    (putnam-1987-b6-oriented-p
     carrier s zero neg))
   (evenp
    (putnam-1987-b6-intersection-count
     carrier s add))))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

title: putnam_1987_b6
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1987_b6:
-- in a finite field of odd prime-square order, the elements of a sign-choice
-- set that are doubles of elements of the same set have even cardinality.
-- This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; _-_; _*_)
open import Agda.Primitive using (Level; lsuc; _⊔_)

infix 4 _!=_ _<=N_
infixr 3 _and_
infixr 2 _or_ _xor_

data Bottom : Set where

Not :
  {a : Level} ->
  Set a ->
  Set a
Not proposition =
  proposition -> Bottom

_!=_ :
  {a : Level} ->
  {A : Set a} ->
  A ->
  A ->
  Set a
x != y =
  Not (x == y)

record _and_
  {a b : Level}
  (A : Set a)
  (B : Set b) :
  Set (a ⊔ b) where

  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data _or_
  {a b : Level}
  (A : Set a)
  (B : Set b) :
  Set (a ⊔ b) where

  left  : A -> A or B
  right : B -> A or B

data _xor_
  {a b : Level}
  (A : Set a)
  (B : Set b) :
  Set (a ⊔ b) where

  only-left  : A -> Not B -> A xor B
  only-right : Not A -> B -> A xor B

record Exists
  {a p : Level}
  (A : Set a)
  (P : A -> Set p) :
  Set (a ⊔ p) where

  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

data _<=N_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set where
  zero<=N   : {n : Nat} -> zero <=N n
  suc<=sucN : {m n : Nat} -> m <=N n -> suc m <=N suc n

data Fin : Nat -> Set where
  fzero : {n : Nat} -> Fin (suc n)
  fsuc  : {n : Nat} -> Fin n -> Fin (suc n)

record Bijection
  {a b : Level}
  (A : Set a)
  (B : Set b) :
  Set (a ⊔ b) where

  field
    to      : A -> B
    from    : B -> A
    from-to : (x : A) -> from (to x) == x
    to-from : (y : B) -> to (from y) == y

record HasCardinality
  {a : Level}
  {A : Set a}
  (member : A -> Set a)
  (cardinality : Nat) :
  Set a where

  field
    enumerate :
      Fin cardinality ->
      A
    enumerated-member :
      (index : Fin cardinality) ->
      member (enumerate index)
    enumeration-complete :
      (item : A) ->
      member item ->
      Exists (Fin cardinality)
        (\ index -> item == enumerate index)
    enumeration-injective :
      (left-index right-index : Fin cardinality) ->
      enumerate left-index == enumerate right-index ->
      left-index == right-index

record Field
  {a : Level}
  (F : Set a) :
  Set (lsuc a) where

  field
    zeroF oneF : F
    add multiply : F -> F -> F
    negate inverse : F -> F

    one-not-zero :
      oneF != zeroF

    add-commutative :
      (x y : F) -> add x y == add y x
    add-associative :
      (x y z : F) ->
      add (add x y) z == add x (add y z)
    add-zero :
      (x : F) -> add x zeroF == x
    add-inverse :
      (x : F) -> add x (negate x) == zeroF

    multiply-commutative :
      (x y : F) -> multiply x y == multiply y x
    multiply-associative :
      (x y z : F) ->
      multiply (multiply x y) z ==
      multiply x (multiply y z)
    multiply-one :
      (x : F) -> multiply x oneF == x
    multiply-zero :
      (x : F) -> multiply x zeroF == zeroF
    distribute :
      (x y z : F) ->
      multiply x (add y z) ==
      add (multiply x y) (multiply x z)
    inverse-zero :
      inverse zeroF == zeroF
    multiply-inverse :
      (x : F) ->
      x != zeroF ->
      multiply x (inverse x) == oneF

open Field

one : Nat
one =
  suc zero

two : Nat
two =
  suc one

half : Nat -> Nat
half zero =
  zero
half (suc zero) =
  zero
half (suc (suc n)) =
  suc (half n)

Odd : Nat -> Set
Odd n =
  Exists Nat
    (\ k -> n == suc (two * k))

Divides : Nat -> Nat -> Set
Divides divisor n =
  Exists Nat
    (\ quotient -> n == divisor * quotient)

Prime : Nat -> Set
Prime n =
  two <=N n
  and
  ((divisor : Nat) ->
    Divides divisor n ->
    divisor == one or divisor == n)

EvenCardinality :
  {a : Level} ->
  {A : Set a} ->
  (A -> Set a) ->
  Set a
EvenCardinality member =
  Exists Nat
    (\ k -> HasCardinality member (two * k))

module Putnam1987B6Statement
  {a : Level}
  {F : Set a}
  (algebra : Field F) where

  intersectionWithDoubles :
    (F -> Set a) ->
    F ->
    Set a
  intersectionWithDoubles member x =
    member x
    and
    Exists F
      (\ y ->
        member y
        and
        x == add algebra y y)

  proposition : Set (lsuc a)
  proposition =
    (p : Nat) ->
    Odd p and Prime p ->
    Bijection F (Fin (p * p)) ->
    (S : F -> Set a) ->
    ((x : F) ->
      S x ->
      x != zeroF algebra) ->
    HasCardinality S (half ((p * p) - one)) ->
    ((x : F) ->
      x != zeroF algebra ->
      S x xor S (negate algebra x)) ->
    EvenCardinality (intersectionWithDoubles S)

putnam-1987-b6 :
  {a : Level} ->
  Set (lsuc a)
putnam-1987-b6 {a} =
  (F : Set a) ->
  (algebra : Field F) ->
  Putnam1987B6Statement.proposition algebra

title: putnam_1987_b6
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1987_b6:
  a half-set of the nonzero elements of a field of odd prime-square order
  meets its additive double in an even number of elements. This file contains
  no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open arithmeticTheory pred_setTheory groupTheory ringTheory;

val putnam_1987_b6 =
  ``!(p : num) (r : 'a ring) (S : 'a set).
      ODD p /\
      prime p /\
      Ring r /\
      Group (r.prod excluding r.sum.id) /\
      FINITE r.carrier /\
      CARD r.carrier = p EXP 2 /\
      S SUBSET r.carrier /\
      (!x : 'a. x IN S ==> x <> r.sum.id) /\
      CARD S = (p EXP 2 - 1) DIV 2 /\
      (!a : 'a.
         a IN r.carrier /\ a <> r.sum.id
         ==>
         ~((a IN S) <=> (r.sum.inv a IN S)))
      ==>
      EVEN
        (CARD
           (S INTER
            {x : 'a |
               x IN r.carrier /\
               ?a : 'a. a IN S /\ x = r.sum.op a a}))``;

content:
$(
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact
  putnam_1987_b6: parity of the intersection of a half-system of nonzero
  elements in a field of odd prime-square order with its doubles. This file
  contains no proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  F ranges over SetMM field structures, Base ` F is the field carrier, and
  +g, -g, and 0g are its addition, subtraction, and zero. The hypotheses
  preserve the finite carrier of cardinality p^2, the subset S of nonzero
  elements, and its exact cardinality (p^2 - 1) / 2.

  For each nonzero carrier element a, negating the biconditional says exactly
  one of a and -a belongs to S. The restricted class in the conclusion is the
  source set of doubles a + a with a in S, and remainder zero modulo two is
  equivalent to even finite cardinality. Since p is odd, the displayed
  natural-number quotient agrees with the integer and real presentations in
  the ground-truth sources. The final declaration is the single unproved $a
  corpus statement; this database contains no $p proof declaration.
$)

${
  $d F S a p x $.

  putnambench-putnam-1987-b6 $a |-
    A. p e. NN0 A. F A. S
      (
        (
          (
            (
              (
                p e. Prime
                /\
                ( p mod 2 ) = 1
              )
              /\
              (
                F e. Field
                /\
                (
                  ( Base ` F ) e. Fin
                  /\
                  ( # ` ( Base ` F ) ) = ( p ^ 2 )
                )
              )
            )
            /\
            (
              S C_ ( Base ` F )
              /\
              (
                A. x e. S x =/= ( 0g ` F )
                /\
                ( # ` S ) = ( ( ( p ^ 2 ) - 1 ) / 2 )
              )
            )
          )
          /\
          A. a e. ( Base ` F )
            (
              a =/= ( 0g ` F )
              ->
              -.
              (
                a e. S
                <->
                ( ( 0g ` F ) ( -g ` F ) a ) e. S
              )
            )
        )
        ->
        (
          (
            #
            `
            (
              S
              i^i
              {
                x e. ( Base ` F ) |
                E. a e. S x = ( a ( +g ` F ) a )
              }
            )
          )
          mod
          2
        )
        =
        0
      )
  $.
$}

::$P-
theorem

    p is prime &

    card the carrier of F = p * p &

title: putnam_1987_b6
content:
% Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1987_b6:
% in a field of odd prime-square order, a set choosing exactly one of each
% nonzero pair a and -a meets its doubled image in an even number of elements.
% This file contains no proof.

putnam_1987_b6[
  FieldElement: TYPE+,
  zero_F, one_F: FieldElement,
  add_F, multiply_F:
    [FieldElement, FieldElement -> FieldElement],
  negate_F, inverse_F: [FieldElement -> FieldElement]
]: THEORY
BEGIN
  field_set: TYPE = [FieldElement -> bool]
  field_enumeration: TYPE = [nat -> FieldElement]

  field_axioms: bool =
    zero_F /= one_F
      AND (FORALL (x, y: FieldElement):
        add_F(x, y) = add_F(y, x))
      AND (FORALL (x, y, z: FieldElement):
        add_F(add_F(x, y), z) = add_F(x, add_F(y, z)))
      AND (FORALL (x: FieldElement):
        add_F(x, zero_F) = x)
      AND (FORALL (x: FieldElement):
        add_F(x, negate_F(x)) = zero_F)
      AND (FORALL (x, y: FieldElement):
        multiply_F(x, y) = multiply_F(y, x))
      AND (FORALL (x, y, z: FieldElement):
        multiply_F(multiply_F(x, y), z)
          = multiply_F(x, multiply_F(y, z)))
      AND (FORALL (x: FieldElement):
        multiply_F(x, one_F) = x)
      AND (FORALL (x, y, z: FieldElement):
        multiply_F(x, add_F(y, z))
          = add_F(multiply_F(x, y), multiply_F(x, z)))
      AND (FORALL (x: FieldElement):
        x /= zero_F IMPLIES
          multiply_F(x, inverse_F(x)) = one_F)

  injective_below(
      enumeration: field_enumeration,
      bound: nat): bool =
    FORALL (i, j: nat):
      i < bound
        AND j < bound
        AND enumeration(i) = enumeration(j)
      IMPLIES i = j

  enumerates_exactly(
      enumeration: field_enumeration,
      set_value: field_set,
      bound: nat): bool =
    FORALL (x: FieldElement):
      set_value(x)
        IFF
          EXISTS (i: nat):
            i < bound AND enumeration(i) = x

  has_cardinality(
      set_value: field_set,
      cardinality: nat): bool =
    EXISTS (enumeration: field_enumeration):
      injective_below(enumeration, cardinality)
        AND enumerates_exactly(
          enumeration, set_value, cardinality)

  whole_field: field_set =
    LAMBDA (x: FieldElement): TRUE

  nat_subtract(n, k: nat): nat =
    IF k <= n THEN n - k ELSE 0 ENDIF

  nat_divides(divisor, value: nat): bool =
    EXISTS (quotient: nat):
      value = divisor * quotient

  prime_nat(p: nat): bool =
    p > 1
      AND (FORALL (divisor: nat):
        nat_divides(divisor, p)
          IMPLIES divisor = 1 OR divisor = p)

  doubled_image(S: field_set): field_set =
    LAMBDA (x: FieldElement):
      EXISTS (a: FieldElement):
        S(a) AND x = add_F(a, a)

  intersection_with_doubled_image(S: field_set): field_set =
    LAMBDA (x: FieldElement):
      S(x) AND doubled_image(S)(x)

  even_cardinality(set_value: field_set): bool =
    EXISTS (cardinality: nat):
      has_cardinality(set_value, cardinality)
        AND mod(cardinality, 2) = 0

  putnam_1987_b6: bool =
    field_axioms IMPLIES
      FORALL (p: nat), (S: field_set):
        (mod(p, 2) = 1
          AND prime_nat(p)
          AND has_cardinality(whole_field, p ^ 2)
          AND (FORALL (x: FieldElement):
            S(x) IMPLIES x /= zero_F)
          AND has_cardinality(
            S, ndiv(nat_subtract(p ^ 2, 1), 2))
          AND (FORALL (a: FieldElement):
            a /= zero_F IMPLIES
              (S(a) AND NOT S(negate_F(a)))
                OR (NOT S(a) AND S(negate_F(a)))))
        IMPLIES
          even_cardinality(
            intersection_with_doubled_image(S))
END putnam_1987_b6

title: putnam_1988_a1
content:
(* Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1988_a1:
   the planar Lebesgue area of the region satisfying
   |x| - |y| <= 1 and |y| <= 1 is 6; this file contains no proof. *)

From Stdlib Require Import Reals.

Open Scope R_scope.

Definition point := (R * R)%type.
Definition point_set := point -> Prop.

Definition same_set (A B : point_set) : Prop :=
  forall p : point, A p <-> B p.

Definition putnam_1988_a1_region : point_set :=
  fun p : point =>
    Rabs (fst p) - Rabs (snd p) <= 1 /\
    Rabs (snd p) <= 1.

Record open_rectangle : Type := {
  rectangle_x_lower : R;
  rectangle_x_upper : R;
  rectangle_y_lower : R;
  rectangle_y_upper : R
}.

Definition in_open_rectangle
    (rectangle : open_rectangle) (p : point) : Prop :=
  rectangle_x_lower rectangle < fst p <
    rectangle_x_upper rectangle /\
  rectangle_y_lower rectangle < snd p <
    rectangle_y_upper rectangle.

Definition rectangle_area (rectangle : open_rectangle) : R :=
  Rmax 0
    (rectangle_x_upper rectangle - rectangle_x_lower rectangle) *
  Rmax 0
    (rectangle_y_upper rectangle - rectangle_y_lower rectangle).

Definition rectangles_cover
    (A : point_set) (rectangles : nat -> open_rectangle) : Prop :=
  forall p : point,
    A p ->
    exists n : nat, in_open_rectangle (rectangles n) p.

Fixpoint partial_rectangle_area
    (rectangles : nat -> open_rectangle) (n : nat) : R :=
  match n with
  | O => 0
  | S k =>
      partial_rectangle_area rectangles k +
      rectangle_area (rectangles k)
  end.

(* The countable-open-rectangle characterization of finite planar Lebesgue
   outer measure; on this closed region it is planar Lebesgue measure. *)
Definition has_planar_lebesgue_measure
    (A : point_set) (area : R) : Prop :=
  0 <= area /\
  (forall rectangles : nat -> open_rectangle,
    rectangles_cover A rectangles ->
    forall lower : R,
      lower < area ->
      exists n : nat,

    (remaining subdivisions)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix remaining)))
  (if (zp remaining)

    (+ (putnam-1988-a1-row-count
        (putnam-1988-a1-midpoint
         -2 4 remaining subdivisions)

  (if (posp subdivisions)
      (/ (* 8
            (putnam-1988-a1-region-count
             subdivisions subdivisions))
         (* subdivisions subdivisions))
    0))

-- Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1988_a1:
-- the planar region satisfying |x| - |y| <= 1 and |y| <= 1 has Lebesgue
-- area six. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; _*_)

infix 4 _!=_ _<=N_
infixr 3 _and_
infixr 2 _or_

data Bottom : Set where

Not : Set -> Set
Not A =
  A -> Bottom

_!=_ : {A : Set} -> A -> A -> Set
x != y =
  Not (x == y)

record _and_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data _or_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  left  : A -> A or B
  right : B -> A or B

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

data _<=N_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set where
  zero<=N   : {n : Nat} -> zero <=N n
  suc<=sucN : {m n : Nat} -> m <=N n -> suc m <=N suc n

record CompleteOrderedRealField (R : Set) : Set1 where
  field
    zeroR oneR : R
    add multiply : R -> R -> R
    negate inverse : R -> R
    lessOrEqual : R -> R -> Set
    fromNat : Nat -> R

    one-not-zero :
      oneR != zeroR

    add-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> add x y == add y x
    add-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      add (add x y) z == add x (add y z)
    add-zero :
      (x : R) -> add x zeroR == x
    add-inverse :
      (x : R) -> add x (negate x) == zeroR

    multiply-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> multiply x y == multiply y x
    multiply-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply (multiply x y) z ==
      multiply x (multiply y z)
    multiply-one :
      (x : R) -> multiply x oneR == x
    multiply-zero :
      (x : R) -> multiply x zeroR == zeroR
    distribute :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply x (add y z) ==
      add (multiply x y) (multiply x z)
    inverse-zero :
      inverse zeroR == zeroR
    multiply-inverse :
      (x : R) ->
      x != zeroR ->
      multiply x (inverse x) == oneR

    order-reflexive :
      (x : R) -> lessOrEqual x x
    order-transitive :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y z ->
      lessOrEqual x z
    order-antisymmetric :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y x ->
      x == y
    order-total :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y or lessOrEqual y x
    add-order :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual (add z x) (add z y)
    multiply-nonnegative :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR x ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR y ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR (multiply x y)
    zero-less-than-one :
      lessOrEqual zeroR oneR and zeroR != oneR

    fromNat-zero :
      fromNat zero == zeroR
    fromNat-successor :
      (n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (suc n) == add (fromNat n) oneR
    fromNat-addition :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m + n) == add (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-multiplication :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m * n) == multiply (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-injective :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat m == fromNat n ->
      m == n

    archimedean :
      (x : R) ->
      Exists Nat (\ n -> lessOrEqual x (fromNat n))
    least-upper-bound :
      (P : R -> Set) ->
      Exists R P ->
      Exists R
        (\ upper ->
          (x : R) ->
          P x ->
          lessOrEqual x upper) ->
      Exists R
        (\ supremum ->
          ((x : R) ->
            P x ->
            lessOrEqual x supremum)
          and
          ((upper : R) ->
            ((x : R) ->
              P x ->
              lessOrEqual x upper) ->
            lessOrEqual supremum upper))

open CompleteOrderedRealField

subtract :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
subtract reals x y =
  add reals x (negate reals y)

StrictLess :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
StrictLess reals x y =
  lessOrEqual reals x y and x != y

record Point (R : Set) : Set where
  constructor point
  field
    x-coordinate : R
    y-coordinate : R

open Point

Region : Set -> Set1
Region R =
  Point R -> Set

AbsoluteValue :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
AbsoluteValue reals x absolute =
  (lessOrEqual reals (zeroR reals) x and absolute == x)
  or
  (lessOrEqual reals x (zeroR reals) and
    absolute == negate reals x)

targetRegion :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Region R
targetRegion {R} reals p =
  Exists R
    (\ absolute-x ->
      AbsoluteValue reals (x-coordinate p) absolute-x
      and
      Exists R
        (\ absolute-y ->
          AbsoluteValue reals (y-coordinate p) absolute-y
          and
          lessOrEqual reals
            (subtract reals absolute-x absolute-y)
            (oneR reals)
          and
          lessOrEqual reals
            absolute-y
            (oneR reals)))

record Rectangle (R : Set) : Set where
  constructor rectangle
  field
    lower-x upper-x : R
    lower-y upper-y : R

open Rectangle

ValidRectangle :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Rectangle R ->
  Set
ValidRectangle reals box =
  lessOrEqual reals (lower-x box) (upper-x box)
  and
  lessOrEqual reals (lower-y box) (upper-y box)

RectangleContains :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Rectangle R ->
  Point R ->
  Set
RectangleContains reals box p =
  StrictLess reals (lower-x box) (x-coordinate p)
  and
  StrictLess reals (x-coordinate p) (upper-x box)
  and
  StrictLess reals (lower-y box) (y-coordinate p)
  and
  StrictLess reals (y-coordinate p) (upper-y box)

rectangleArea :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Rectangle R ->
  R
rectangleArea reals box =
  multiply reals
    (subtract reals (upper-x box) (lower-x box))
    (subtract reals (upper-y box) (lower-y box))

RectangleCover : Set -> Set
RectangleCover R =
  Nat -> Rectangle R

ValidCover :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  RectangleCover R ->
  Set
ValidCover reals cover =
  (n : Nat) ->
  ValidRectangle reals (cover n)

Covers :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  RectangleCover R ->
  Region R ->
  Set
Covers {R} reals cover body =
  (p : Point R) ->
  body p ->
  Exists Nat
    (\ n -> RectangleContains reals (cover n) p)

coverPartialArea :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  RectangleCover R ->
  Nat ->
  R
coverPartialArea reals cover zero =
  rectangleArea reals (cover zero)
coverPartialArea reals cover (suc n) =
  add reals
    (coverPartialArea reals cover n)
    (rectangleArea reals (cover (suc n)))

SequentialLimit :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  R ->
  Set
SequentialLimit {R} reals sequence limit =
  (epsilon : R) ->
  StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) epsilon ->
  Exists Nat
    (\ cutoff ->
      (n : Nat) ->
      cutoff <=N n ->
      StrictLess reals
        (subtract reals limit epsilon)
        (sequence n)
      and
      StrictLess reals
        (sequence n)
        (add reals limit epsilon))

CoverTotal :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  RectangleCover R ->
  R ->
  Set
CoverTotal reals cover total =
  SequentialLimit reals
    (coverPartialArea reals cover)
    total

CoverCost :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Region R ->
  R ->
  Set
CoverCost {R} reals body total =
  Exists (RectangleCover R)
    (\ cover ->
      ValidCover reals cover
      and
      Covers reals cover body
      and
      CoverTotal reals cover total)

LowerBound :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (R -> Set) ->
  R ->
  Set
LowerBound reals values bound =
  (value : _) ->
  values value ->
  lessOrEqual reals bound value

GreatestLowerBound :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (R -> Set) ->
  R ->
  Set
GreatestLowerBound {R} reals values infimum =
  LowerBound reals values infimum
  and
  ((bound : R) ->
    LowerBound reals values bound ->
    lessOrEqual reals bound infimum)

LebesgueOuterArea :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Region R ->
  R ->
  Set
LebesgueOuterArea reals body area =
  GreatestLowerBound reals (CoverCost reals body) area

six : Nat
six =
  suc (suc (suc (suc (suc (suc zero)))))

module Putnam1988A1Statement
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) where

  proposition : Set
  proposition =
    LebesgueOuterArea reals
      (targetRegion reals)
      (fromNat reals six)

putnam-1988-a1 : Set1
putnam-1988-a1 =
  (R : Set) ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) ->
  Putnam1988A1Statement.proposition reals

% Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1988_a1:
% the planar region satisfying |x| - |y| <= 1 and |y| <= 1 has Lebesgue area 6.
% This file contains no proof.

putnam_1988_a1: THEORY
BEGIN
  point: TYPE = [# x_coord: real, y_coord: real #]
  planar_region: TYPE = [point -> bool]
  real_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> real]

  box: TYPE =
    [# left: real, right: real, bottom: real, top: real #]
  box_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> box]

  in_open_box(p: point, b: box): bool =
    left(b) < x_coord(p)
      AND x_coord(p) < right(b)
      AND bottom(b) < y_coord(p)
      AND y_coord(p) < top(b)

  box_area(b: box): real =
    IF left(b) < right(b) AND bottom(b) < top(b) THEN
      (right(b) - left(b)) * (top(b) - bottom(b))
    ELSE
      0
    ENDIF

  partial_box_area(
      boxes: box_sequence,
      count: nat): RECURSIVE real =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      partial_box_area(boxes, count - 1)
        + box_area(boxes(count - 1))
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  converges_to(sequence: real_sequence, value: real): bool =
    FORALL (epsilon_value: posreal):
      EXISTS (cutoff: nat):
        FORALL (index: nat):
          cutoff <= index IMPLIES
            abs(sequence(index) - value) < epsilon_value

  covers(region: planar_region, boxes: box_sequence): bool =
    FORALL (p: point):
      region(p) IMPLIES
        EXISTS (index: nat):
          in_open_box(p, boxes(index))

  cover_has_total_area(
      region: planar_region,
      boxes: box_sequence,
      total: real): bool =
    covers(region, boxes)
      AND converges_to(
        LAMBDA (count: nat):
          partial_box_area(boxes, count),
        total)

  has_lebesgue_outer_area(
      region: planar_region,
      area: real): bool =
    0 <= area
      AND (FORALL (boxes: box_sequence), (total: real):
        cover_has_total_area(region, boxes, total)
          IMPLIES area <= total)
      AND (FORALL (epsilon_value: posreal):
        EXISTS (boxes: box_sequence), (total: real):
          cover_has_total_area(region, boxes, total)
            AND total < area + epsilon_value)

  putnam_1988_a1_solution: real = 6

  putnam_1988_a1: bool =
    FORALL (R: planar_region):
      R = (LAMBDA (p: point):
        abs(x_coord(p)) - abs(y_coord(p)) <= 1
          AND abs(y_coord(p)) <= 1)
      IMPLIES
        has_lebesgue_outer_area(
          R, putnam_1988_a1_solution)
END putnam_1988_a1

title: putnam_1988_a2

import Mathlib

open Set

abbrev putnam_1988_a2_solution : Prop := sorry
-- True
/--
A not uncommon calculus mistake is to believe that the product rule for derivatives says that $(fg)' = f'g'$. If $f(x)=e^{x^2}$, determine, with proof, whether there exists an open interval $(a,b)$ and a nonzero function $g$ defined on $(a,b)$ such that this wrong product rule is true for $x$ in $(a,b)$.
-/
theorem putnam_1988_a2
    (f : ℝ → ℝ)
    (hf : f = fun x ↦ Real.exp (x ^ 2)) :
    putnam_1988_a2_solution ↔
    (∃ a b : ℝ,
      a < b ∧
      ∃ g : ℝ → ℝ,
        (∃ x ∈ Ioo a b, g x ≠ 0) ∧
        DifferentiableOn ℝ g (Ioo a b) ∧
        ∀ x ∈ Ioo a b, deriv (fun y ↦ f y * g y) x = (deriv f x) * (deriv g x)) :=
  sorry
