Require Import Basics Reals Coquelicot.Coquelicot.
Open Scope R.
Definition putnam_1988_a2_solution := True.
Theorem putnam_1988_a2
    (f : R -> R := fun x => exp (pow x 2))
    : (exists (a b: R) (g: R -> R), a < b /\ 
    (exists x: R, a < x < b /\ g x <> 0) /\
    forall (x: R), a < x < b -> ex_derive g x /\ Derive (fun y => f y * g y) x = (Derive f x) * (Derive g x))
    <-> putnam_1988_a2_solution.
Proof. Admitted.

(\<exists> x \<in> {a<..<b}. g x \<noteq> 0) \<and> g differentiable_on {a<..<b} \<and> (\<forall> x \<in> {a<..<b}. deriv (\<lambda> y. f y * g y) x = (deriv f x) * (deriv g x)))) \<longleftrightarrow> putnam_1988_a2_solution"

title: putnam_1988_a2
putnam_1988_a2
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1988_a2:
;; for f(x) = exp(x^2), there is an open interval and a nonzero differentiable
;; real function g on which (f*g)' = f'*g'. This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))

;; Arbitrary sets and functions are tame APPLY$ function objects. FN-EQUAL
;; supplies unbounded universal quantification, and inequality with a
;; constant-false function supplies internal existential quantification.
;; The scalar context is a Dedekind-complete ordered field, hence a
;; presentation of the real field. The exponential is fixed by its exact
;; power series, and derivatives are expanded by their epsilon-delta
;; definition. The interval endpoints and function g remain internal
;; existential witnesses.

(defun p1988a2-quoted (object)
  (list 'quote object))

(defun p1988a2-term-list (terms)
  (if (consp terms)
      (list 'cons
            (car terms)
            (p1988a2-term-list (cdr terms)))
    (p1988a2-quoted nil)))

(defun p1988a2-apply-term (function-term arguments)
  (list 'apply$
        function-term
        (p1988a2-term-list arguments)))

(defun p1988a2-static-apply-term (function arguments)
  (p1988a2-apply-term
   (p1988a2-quoted function)
   arguments))

(defun p1988a2-and-terms (terms)
  (if (consp terms)
      (list 'if
            (car terms)
            (p1988a2-and-terms (cdr terms))
            (p1988a2-quoted nil))
    (p1988a2-quoted t)))

(defun p1988a2-or-terms (terms)
  (if (consp terms)
      (list 'if
            (car terms)
            (p1988a2-quoted t)
            (p1988a2-or-terms (cdr terms)))
    (p1988a2-quoted nil)))

(defun p1988a2-not-term (term)
  (list 'if term
        (p1988a2-quoted nil)
        (p1988a2-quoted t)))

(defun p1988a2-implies-term (hypothesis conclusion)
  (list 'if hypothesis conclusion (p1988a2-quoted t)))

(defun p1988a2-true-function (formals)
  (list 'lambda formals (p1988a2-quoted t)))

(defun p1988a2-false-function (formals)
  (list 'lambda formals (p1988a2-quoted nil)))

(defun p1988a2-universal-p (function formals)
  (let ((always-true (p1988a2-true-function formals)))
    (and (tamep-functionp function)
         (tamep-functionp always-true)
         (fn-equal function always-true))))

(defun p1988a2-exists-p (function formals)
  (let ((always-false (p1988a2-false-function formals)))
    (and (tamep-functionp function)
         (tamep-functionp always-false)
         (not (fn-equal function always-false)))))

(defun p1988a2-member-p (predicate object)
  (if (apply$ predicate (list object)) t nil))

(defun p1988a2-unary-value (function object)
  (apply$ function (list object)))

(defun p1988a2-binary-value (function left right)
  (apply$ function (list left right)))

;; Arbitrary real-valued functions and arbitrary subsets of the real carrier.

(defun p1988a2-function-values-function (carrier function)
  (list
   'lambda '(x)
   (p1988a2-implies-term
    (p1988a2-static-apply-term carrier '(x))
    (p1988a2-static-apply-term
     carrier
     (list (p1988a2-static-apply-term function '(x)))))))

(defun p1988a2-real-function-p (carrier function)
  (and
   (tamep-functionp function)
   (p1988a2-universal-p
    (p1988a2-function-values-function carrier function)
    '(x))))

(defun p1988a2-set-subset-carrier-function (carrier set)
  (list
   'lambda '(x)
   (p1988a2-implies-term
    (p1988a2-static-apply-term set '(x))
    (p1988a2-static-apply-term carrier '(x)))))

(defun p1988a2-valid-set-p (carrier set)
  (and
   (tamep-functionp set)
   (p1988a2-universal-p
    (p1988a2-set-subset-carrier-function carrier set)
    '(x))))

;; A Dedekind-complete ordered field, used as an abstract presentation of R.

(defun p1988a2-field-laws-function
    (carrier zero one add multiply negate inverse)
  (let* ((xy-add (p1988a2-static-apply-term add '(x y)))
         (yz-add (p1988a2-static-apply-term add '(y z)))
         (xy-mul (p1988a2-static-apply-term multiply '(x y)))
         (yz-mul (p1988a2-static-apply-term multiply '(y z)))
         (neg-x (p1988a2-static-apply-term negate '(x)))
         (inv-x (p1988a2-static-apply-term inverse '(x))))
    (list
     'lambda '(x y z)
     (p1988a2-implies-term
      (p1988a2-and-terms
       (list
        (p1988a2-static-apply-term carrier '(x))
        (p1988a2-static-apply-term carrier '(y))
        (p1988a2-static-apply-term carrier '(z))))
      (p1988a2-and-terms
       (list
        (p1988a2-static-apply-term carrier (list xy-add))
        (p1988a2-static-apply-term carrier (list xy-mul))
        (p1988a2-static-apply-term carrier (list neg-x))
        (p1988a2-static-apply-term carrier (list inv-x))
        (list 'equal
              (p1988a2-static-apply-term add (list xy-add 'z))
              (p1988a2-static-apply-term add (list 'x yz-add)))
        (list 'equal xy-add
              (p1988a2-static-apply-term add '(y x)))
        (list 'equal
              (p1988a2-static-apply-term
               add (list 'x (p1988a2-quoted zero)))
              'x)
        (list 'equal
              (p1988a2-static-apply-term add (list 'x neg-x))
              (p1988a2-quoted zero))
        (list 'equal
              (p1988a2-static-apply-term multiply (list xy-mul 'z))
              (p1988a2-static-apply-term multiply (list 'x yz-mul)))
        (list 'equal xy-mul
              (p1988a2-static-apply-term multiply '(y x)))
        (list 'equal
              (p1988a2-static-apply-term
               multiply (list 'x (p1988a2-quoted one)))
              'x)
        (p1988a2-implies-term
         (list 'equal 'x (p1988a2-quoted zero))
         (list 'equal inv-x (p1988a2-quoted zero)))
        (p1988a2-implies-term
         (p1988a2-not-term
          (list 'equal 'x (p1988a2-quoted zero)))
         (list 'equal
               (p1988a2-static-apply-term
                multiply (list 'x inv-x))
               (p1988a2-quoted one)))
        (list 'equal
              (p1988a2-static-apply-term multiply (list 'x yz-add))
              (p1988a2-static-apply-term
               add
               (list
                (p1988a2-static-apply-term multiply '(x y))
                (p1988a2-static-apply-term multiply '(x z)))))))))))

(defun p1988a2-order-laws-function
    (carrier zero add multiply less)
  (let ((xy (p1988a2-static-apply-term less '(x y)))
        (yx (p1988a2-static-apply-term less '(y x)))
        (yz (p1988a2-static-apply-term less '(y z))))
    (list
     'lambda '(x y z)
     (p1988a2-implies-term
      (p1988a2-and-terms
       (list
        (p1988a2-static-apply-term carrier '(x))
        (p1988a2-static-apply-term carrier '(y))
        (p1988a2-static-apply-term carrier '(z))))
      (p1988a2-and-terms
       (list
        (p1988a2-not-term
         (p1988a2-static-apply-term less '(x x)))
        (p1988a2-or-terms
         (list xy yx (list 'equal 'x 'y)))
        (p1988a2-implies-term
         (p1988a2-and-terms (list xy yz))
         (p1988a2-static-apply-term less '(x z)))
        (p1988a2-implies-term
         xy
         (p1988a2-static-apply-term
          less
          (list
           (p1988a2-static-apply-term add '(x z))
           (p1988a2-static-apply-term add '(y z)))))
        (p1988a2-implies-term
         (p1988a2-and-terms
          (list
           (p1988a2-static-apply-term
            less (list (p1988a2-quoted zero) 'x))
           (p1988a2-static-apply-term
            less (list (p1988a2-quoted zero) 'y))))
         (p1988a2-static-apply-term
          less
          (list
           (p1988a2-quoted zero)
           (p1988a2-static-apply-term multiply '(x y)))))))))))

(defun p1988a2-upper-bound-function
    (carrier less set upper)
  (list
   'lambda '(x)
   (p1988a2-implies-term
    (p1988a2-and-terms
     (list
      (p1988a2-static-apply-term carrier '(x))
      (p1988a2-static-apply-term set '(x))))
    (p1988a2-not-term
     (p1988a2-static-apply-term
      less (list (p1988a2-quoted upper) 'x))))))

(defun p1988a2-upper-bound-p
    (carrier less set upper)
  (and
   (p1988a2-member-p carrier upper)
   (p1988a2-valid-set-p carrier set)
   (p1988a2-universal-p
    (p1988a2-upper-bound-function carrier less set upper)
    '(x))))

(defun p1988a2-set-nonempty-function (carrier set)
  (list
   'lambda '(x)
   (p1988a2-and-terms
    (list
     (p1988a2-static-apply-term carrier '(x))
     (p1988a2-static-apply-term set '(x))))))

(defun p1988a2-set-nonempty-p (carrier set)
  (and
   (p1988a2-valid-set-p carrier set)
   (p1988a2-exists-p
    (p1988a2-set-nonempty-function carrier set)
    '(x))))

(defun p1988a2-bounded-above-function
    (carrier less set)
  (list
   'lambda '(upper)
   (list 'p1988a2-upper-bound-p
         (p1988a2-quoted carrier)
         (p1988a2-quoted less)
         (p1988a2-quoted set)
         'upper)))

(defun p1988a2-bounded-above-p (carrier less set)
  (p1988a2-exists-p
   (p1988a2-bounded-above-function carrier less set)
   '(upper)))

(defun p1988a2-least-upper-bound-function
    (carrier less set supremum)
  (list
   'lambda '(upper)
   (p1988a2-implies-term
    (list 'p1988a2-upper-bound-p
          (p1988a2-quoted carrier)
          (p1988a2-quoted less)
          (p1988a2-quoted set)
          'upper)
    (p1988a2-not-term
     (p1988a2-static-apply-term
      less (list 'upper (p1988a2-quoted supremum)))))))

(defun p1988a2-least-upper-bound-p
    (carrier less set supremum)
  (and
   (p1988a2-upper-bound-p carrier less set supremum)
   (p1988a2-universal-p
    (p1988a2-least-upper-bound-function
     carrier less set supremum)
    '(upper))))

(defun p1988a2-completeness-function
    (carrier less supremum-operation)
  (list
   'lambda '(set)
   (p1988a2-implies-term
    (p1988a2-and-terms
     (list
      (list 'p1988a2-valid-set-p
            (p1988a2-quoted carrier) 'set)
      (list 'p1988a2-set-nonempty-p
            (p1988a2-quoted carrier) 'set)
      (list 'p1988a2-bounded-above-p
            (p1988a2-quoted carrier)
            (p1988a2-quoted less)
            'set)))
    (list 'p1988a2-least-upper-bound-p
          (p1988a2-quoted carrier)
          (p1988a2-quoted less)
          'set
          (p1988a2-static-apply-term
           supremum-operation '(set))))))

(defun p1988a2-real-field-p
    (carrier zero one add multiply negate inverse less supremum)
  (and
   (tamep-functionp carrier)
   (tamep-functionp add)
   (tamep-functionp multiply)
   (tamep-functionp negate)
   (tamep-functionp inverse)
   (tamep-functionp less)
   (tamep-functionp supremum)
   (p1988a2-member-p carrier zero)
   (p1988a2-member-p carrier one)
   (not (equal zero one))
   (p1988a2-universal-p
    (p1988a2-field-laws-function
     carrier zero one add multiply negate inverse)
    '(x y z))
   (p1988a2-universal-p
    (p1988a2-order-laws-function
     carrier zero add multiply less)
    '(x y z))
   (p1988a2-universal-p
    (p1988a2-completeness-function
     carrier less supremum)
    '(set))
   (p1988a2-binary-value less zero one)))

;; Real-field context and arithmetic.

(defun p1988a2-r-carrier (ctx) (nth 0 ctx))
(defun p1988a2-r-zero (ctx) (nth 1 ctx))
(defun p1988a2-r-one (ctx) (nth 2 ctx))
(defun p1988a2-r-add (ctx) (nth 3 ctx))
(defun p1988a2-r-mul (ctx) (nth 4 ctx))
(defun p1988a2-r-neg (ctx) (nth 5 ctx))
(defun p1988a2-r-inv (ctx) (nth 6 ctx))
(defun p1988a2-r-lt (ctx) (nth 7 ctx))
(defun p1988a2-r-sup (ctx) (nth 8 ctx))

(defun p1988a2-context-p (ctx)
  (and
   (true-listp ctx)
   (equal (len ctx) 9)
   (p1988a2-real-field-p
    (p1988a2-r-carrier ctx)
    (p1988a2-r-zero ctx)
    (p1988a2-r-one ctx)
    (p1988a2-r-add ctx)
    (p1988a2-r-mul ctx)
    (p1988a2-r-neg ctx)
    (p1988a2-r-inv ctx)
    (p1988a2-r-lt ctx)
    (p1988a2-r-sup ctx))))

(defun p1988a2-r-add-value (ctx left right)
  (p1988a2-binary-value (p1988a2-r-add ctx) left right))

(defun p1988a2-r-neg-value (ctx value)
  (p1988a2-unary-value (p1988a2-r-neg ctx) value))

(defun p1988a2-r-sub-value (ctx left right)
  (p1988a2-r-add-value
   ctx left (p1988a2-r-neg-value ctx right)))

(defun p1988a2-r-mul-value (ctx left right)
  (p1988a2-binary-value (p1988a2-r-mul ctx) left right))

(defun p1988a2-r-inv-value (ctx value)
  (p1988a2-unary-value (p1988a2-r-inv ctx) value))

(defun p1988a2-r-div-value (ctx numerator denominator)
  (p1988a2-r-mul-value
   ctx numerator (p1988a2-r-inv-value ctx denominator)))

(defun p1988a2-r-lt-p (ctx left right)
  (if (p1988a2-binary-value
       (p1988a2-r-lt ctx) left right)
      t nil))

(defun p1988a2-r-le-p (ctx left right)
  (not (p1988a2-r-lt-p ctx right left)))

(defun p1988a2-r-abs-value (ctx value)
  (if (p1988a2-r-lt-p ctx value (p1988a2-r-zero ctx))
      (p1988a2-r-neg-value ctx value)
    value))

(defun p1988a2-positive-real-p (ctx value)
  (and
   (p1988a2-member-p (p1988a2-r-carrier ctx) value)
   (p1988a2-r-lt-p ctx (p1988a2-r-zero ctx) value)))

;; The real exponential, defined by sum_{k=0}^\infty x^k/k!.

(defun p1988a2-r-nat-value (ctx n)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix n)))
  (if (zp n)
      (p1988a2-r-zero ctx)
    (p1988a2-r-add-value
     ctx
     (p1988a2-r-nat-value ctx (- n 1))
     (p1988a2-r-one ctx))))

(defun p1988a2-r-power (ctx value exponent)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix exponent)))
  (if (zp exponent)
      (p1988a2-r-one ctx)
    (p1988a2-r-mul-value
     ctx
     value
     (p1988a2-r-power ctx value (- exponent 1)))))

(defun p1988a2-r-factorial (ctx n)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix n)))
  (if (zp n)
      (p1988a2-r-one ctx)
    (p1988a2-r-mul-value
     ctx
     (p1988a2-r-nat-value ctx n)
     (p1988a2-r-factorial ctx (- n 1)))))

(defun p1988a2-sequence-values-function (ctx sequence)
  (list
   'lambda '(n)
   (p1988a2-implies-term
    (list 'natp 'n)
    (p1988a2-static-apply-term
     (p1988a2-r-carrier ctx)
     (list (p1988a2-static-apply-term sequence '(n)))))))

(defun p1988a2-real-sequence-p (ctx sequence)
  (and
   (tamep-functionp sequence)
   (p1988a2-universal-p
    (p1988a2-sequence-values-function ctx sequence)
    '(n))))

(defun p1988a2-convergence-tail-function
    (ctx sequence limit epsilon start)
  (list
   'lambda '(n)
   (p1988a2-implies-term
    (p1988a2-and-terms
     (list
      (list 'natp 'n)
      (list '<= (p1988a2-quoted start) 'n)))
    (list 'p1988a2-r-lt-p
          (p1988a2-quoted ctx)
          (list 'p1988a2-r-abs-value
                (p1988a2-quoted ctx)
                (list 'p1988a2-r-sub-value
                      (p1988a2-quoted ctx)
                      (p1988a2-static-apply-term sequence '(n))
                      (p1988a2-quoted limit)))
          (p1988a2-quoted epsilon)))))

(defun p1988a2-convergence-tail-p
    (ctx sequence limit epsilon start)
  (and
   (natp start)
   (p1988a2-universal-p
    (p1988a2-convergence-tail-function
     ctx sequence limit epsilon start)
    '(n))))

(defun p1988a2-convergence-start-function
    (ctx sequence limit epsilon)
  (list
   'lambda '(start)
   (list 'p1988a2-convergence-tail-p
         (p1988a2-quoted ctx)
         (p1988a2-quoted sequence)
         (p1988a2-quoted limit)
         (p1988a2-quoted epsilon)
         'start)))

(defun p1988a2-convergence-epsilon-function
    (ctx sequence limit)
  (list
   'lambda '(epsilon)
   (p1988a2-implies-term
    (list 'p1988a2-positive-real-p
          (p1988a2-quoted ctx) 'epsilon)
    (list 'p1988a2-exists-p
          (list 'p1988a2-convergence-start-function
                (p1988a2-quoted ctx)
                (p1988a2-quoted sequence)
                (p1988a2-quoted limit)
                'epsilon)
          (p1988a2-quoted '(start))))))

(defun p1988a2-converges-p (ctx sequence limit)
  (and
   (p1988a2-real-sequence-p ctx sequence)
   (p1988a2-member-p (p1988a2-r-carrier ctx) limit)
   (p1988a2-universal-p
    (p1988a2-convergence-epsilon-function
     ctx sequence limit)
    '(epsilon))))

(defun p1988a2-exp-partial-sum (ctx count x)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix count)))
  (if (zp count)
      (p1988a2-r-zero ctx)
    (let* ((index (- count 1))
           (term
            (p1988a2-r-div-value
             ctx
             (p1988a2-r-power ctx x index)
             (p1988a2-r-factorial ctx index))))
      (p1988a2-r-add-value
       ctx
       (p1988a2-exp-partial-sum ctx index x)
       term))))

(defun p1988a2-exp-partial-sum-sequence (ctx x)
  (list
   'lambda '(n)
   (list 'if
         (list 'natp 'n)
         (list 'p1988a2-exp-partial-sum
               (p1988a2-quoted ctx)
               'n
               (p1988a2-quoted x))
         (p1988a2-quoted (p1988a2-r-zero ctx)))))

(defun p1988a2-exp-values-function (ctx exponential)
  (list
   'lambda '(x)
   (p1988a2-implies-term
    (p1988a2-static-apply-term
     (p1988a2-r-carrier ctx) '(x))
    (list 'p1988a2-converges-p
          (p1988a2-quoted ctx)
          (list 'p1988a2-exp-partial-sum-sequence
                (p1988a2-quoted ctx)
                'x)
          (p1988a2-static-apply-term exponential '(x))))))

(defun p1988a2-exponential-operation-p (ctx exponential)
  (and
   (p1988a2-real-function-p
    (p1988a2-r-carrier ctx) exponential)
   (p1988a2-universal-p
    (p1988a2-exp-values-function ctx exponential)
    '(x))))

;; Closed and open intervals.

(defun p1988a2-ioo-set (ctx a b)
  (list
   'lambda '(x)
   (p1988a2-and-terms
    (list
     (p1988a2-static-apply-term
      (p1988a2-r-carrier ctx) '(x))
     (p1988a2-static-apply-term
      (p1988a2-r-lt ctx)
      (list (p1988a2-quoted a) 'x))
     (p1988a2-static-apply-term
      (p1988a2-r-lt ctx)
      (list 'x (p1988a2-quoted b)))))))

(defun p1988a2-icc-set (ctx a b)
  (list
   'lambda '(x)
   (p1988a2-and-terms
    (list
     (p1988a2-static-apply-term
      (p1988a2-r-carrier ctx) '(x))
     (p1988a2-not-term
      (p1988a2-static-apply-term
       (p1988a2-r-lt ctx)
       (list 'x (p1988a2-quoted a))))
     (p1988a2-not-term
      (p1988a2-static-apply-term
       (p1988a2-r-lt ctx)
       (list (p1988a2-quoted b) 'x)))))))

;; Continuity within the closed interval [a,b].

(defun p1988a2-continuity-point-function
    (ctx function a b x epsilon radius)
  (list
   'lambda '(y)
   (p1988a2-implies-term
    (p1988a2-and-terms
     (list
      (p1988a2-static-apply-term
       (p1988a2-icc-set ctx a b) '(y))
      (list 'p1988a2-r-lt-p
            (p1988a2-quoted ctx)
            (list 'p1988a2-r-abs-value
                  (p1988a2-quoted ctx)
                  (list 'p1988a2-r-sub-value
                        (p1988a2-quoted ctx)
                        'y
                        (p1988a2-quoted x)))
            (p1988a2-quoted radius))))
    (list 'p1988a2-r-lt-p
          (p1988a2-quoted ctx)
          (list 'p1988a2-r-abs-value
                (p1988a2-quoted ctx)
                (list 'p1988a2-r-sub-value
                      (p1988a2-quoted ctx)
                      (p1988a2-static-apply-term function '(y))
                      (p1988a2-static-apply-term
                       function
                       (list (p1988a2-quoted x)))))

(defun p1988a2-continuity-radius-function
    (ctx function a b x epsilon)
  (list
   'lambda '(radius)
   (p1988a2-and-terms
    (list
     (list 'p1988a2-positive-real-p
           (p1988a2-quoted ctx) 'radius)
     (list 'p1988a2-universal-p
           (list 'p1988a2-continuity-point-function
                 (p1988a2-quoted ctx)
                 (p1988a2-quoted function)
                 (p1988a2-quoted a)
                 (p1988a2-quoted b)
                 (p1988a2-quoted x)

(defun p1988a2-continuity-epsilon-function
    (ctx function a b x)
  (list
   'lambda '(epsilon)
   (p1988a2-implies-term
    (list 'p1988a2-positive-real-p
          (p1988a2-quoted ctx) 'epsilon)
    (list 'p1988a2-exists-p
          (list 'p1988a2-continuity-radius-function
                (p1988a2-quoted ctx)
                (p1988a2-quoted function)
                (p1988a2-quoted a)
                (p1988a2-quoted b)
                (p1988a2-quoted x)
                'epsilon)

(defun p1988a2-continuous-on-row-function
    (ctx function a b)
  (list
   'lambda '(x)
   (p1988a2-implies-term
    (p1988a2-static-apply-term
     (p1988a2-icc-set ctx a b) '(x))
    (list 'p1988a2-universal-p
          (list 'p1988a2-continuity-epsilon-function
                (p1988a2-quoted ctx)
                (p1988a2-quoted function)
                (p1988a2-quoted a)
                (p1988a2-quoted b)
                'x)
          (p1988a2-quoted '(epsilon))))))

(defun p1988a2-continuous-on-icc-p
    (ctx function a b)
  (p1988a2-universal-p
   (p1988a2-continuous-on-row-function
    ctx function a b)
   '(x)))

;; HasDerivAt in epsilon-delta form:
;; |f(y)-f(x)-d*(y-x)| <= epsilon*|y-x| near x.

(defun p1988a2-derivative-point-function
    (ctx function derivative x epsilon radius)
  (list
   'lambda '(y)
   (p1988a2-implies-term
    (p1988a2-and-terms
     (list
      (p1988a2-static-apply-term
       (p1988a2-r-carrier ctx) '(y))
      (list 'p1988a2-r-lt-p
            (p1988a2-quoted ctx)
            (list 'p1988a2-r-abs-value
                  (p1988a2-quoted ctx)
                  (list 'p1988a2-r-sub-value
                        (p1988a2-quoted ctx)
                        'y
                        (p1988a2-quoted x)))
            (p1988a2-quoted radius))))
    (list 'p1988a2-r-le-p
          (p1988a2-quoted ctx)
          (list 'p1988a2-r-abs-value
                (p1988a2-quoted ctx)
                (list 'p1988a2-r-sub-value
                      (p1988a2-quoted ctx)
                      (list 'p1988a2-r-sub-value
                            (p1988a2-quoted ctx)
                            (p1988a2-static-apply-term function '(y))
                            (p1988a2-static-apply-term
                             function
                             (list (p1988a2-quoted x))))
                      (list 'p1988a2-r-mul-value
                            (p1988a2-quoted ctx)
                            (p1988a2-quoted derivative)
                            (list 'p1988a2-r-sub-value
                                  (p1988a2-quoted ctx)

          (list 'p1988a2-r-mul-value
                (p1988a2-quoted ctx)

                      (p1988a2-quoted ctx)

                            (p1988a2-quoted ctx)
                            'y
                            (p1988a2-quoted x))))))))

(defun p1988a2-derivative-radius-function
    (ctx function derivative x epsilon)
  (list
   'lambda '(radius)
   (p1988a2-and-terms
    (list
     (list 'p1988a2-positive-real-p
           (p1988a2-quoted ctx) 'radius)
     (list 'p1988a2-universal-p
           (list 'p1988a2-derivative-point-function
                 (p1988a2-quoted ctx)
                 (p1988a2-quoted function)
                 (p1988a2-quoted derivative)
                 (p1988a2-quoted x)
                 (p1988a2-quoted epsilon)
                 'radius)
           (p1988a2-quoted '(y)))))))

(defun p1988a2-derivative-epsilon-function
    (ctx function derivative x)
  (list
   'lambda '(epsilon)
   (p1988a2-implies-term
    (list 'p1988a2-positive-real-p
          (p1988a2-quoted ctx) 'epsilon)
    (list 'p1988a2-exists-p
          (list 'p1988a2-derivative-radius-function
                (p1988a2-quoted ctx)
                (p1988a2-quoted function)
                (p1988a2-quoted derivative)
                (p1988a2-quoted x)
                'epsilon)
          (p1988a2-quoted '(radius))))))

(defun p1988a2-has-derivative-at-p
    (ctx function derivative x)
  (and
   (p1988a2-member-p (p1988a2-r-carrier ctx) derivative)
   (p1988a2-member-p (p1988a2-r-carrier ctx) x)
   (p1988a2-universal-p
    (p1988a2-derivative-epsilon-function
     ctx function derivative x)
    '(epsilon))))

(defun p1988a2-derivative-witness-function
    (ctx function x)
  (list
   'lambda '(derivative)
   (list 'p1988a2-has-derivative-at-p
         (p1988a2-quoted ctx)
         (p1988a2-quoted function)
         'derivative
         (p1988a2-quoted x))))

(defun p1988a2-differentiable-at-p
    (ctx function x)
  (p1988a2-exists-p
   (p1988a2-derivative-witness-function
    ctx function x)
   '(derivative)))

(defun p1988a2-f-function (ctx exponential)
  (list
   'lambda '(x)
   (p1988a2-static-apply-term
    exponential
    (list
     (list 'p1988a2-r-mul-value
           (p1988a2-quoted ctx)
           'x
           'x)))))

(defun p1988a2-product-function (ctx left right)
  (list
   'lambda '(x)
   (list 'p1988a2-r-mul-value
         (p1988a2-quoted ctx)
         (p1988a2-static-apply-term left '(x))
         (p1988a2-static-apply-term right '(x)))))

(defun p1988a2-nonzero-witness-function (ctx g a b)
  (list
   'lambda '(x)
   (p1988a2-and-terms
    (list
     (p1988a2-static-apply-term
      (p1988a2-ioo-set ctx a b) '(x))
     (p1988a2-not-term
      (list 'equal
            (p1988a2-static-apply-term g '(x))
            (p1988a2-quoted (p1988a2-r-zero ctx))))))))

(defun p1988a2-point-derivative-witness-function
    (ctx f g product x)
  (list
   'lambda '(g-derivative f-derivative product-derivative)
   (p1988a2-and-terms
    (list
     (list 'p1988a2-has-derivative-at-p
           (p1988a2-quoted ctx)
           (p1988a2-quoted g)
           'g-derivative
           (p1988a2-quoted x))
     (list 'p1988a2-has-derivative-at-p
           (p1988a2-quoted ctx)
           (p1988a2-quoted f)
           'f-derivative
           (p1988a2-quoted x))
     (list 'p1988a2-has-derivative-at-p
           (p1988a2-quoted ctx)
           (p1988a2-quoted product)
           'product-derivative
           (p1988a2-quoted x))
     (list 'equal
           'product-derivative
           (list 'p1988a2-r-mul-value
                 (p1988a2-quoted ctx)
                 'f-derivative
                 'g-derivative))))))

(defun p1988a2-point-condition-function
    (ctx f g product a b)
  (list
   'lambda '(x)
   (p1988a2-implies-term
    (p1988a2-static-apply-term
     (p1988a2-ioo-set ctx a b) '(x))
    (list 'p1988a2-exists-p
          (list 'p1988a2-point-derivative-witness-function
                (p1988a2-quoted ctx)
                (p1988a2-quoted f)
                (p1988a2-quoted g)
                (p1988a2-quoted product)

(defun p1988a2-interval-witness-function (ctx exponential)
  (let ((f (p1988a2-f-function ctx exponential)))
    (list
     'lambda '(a b g)
     (p1988a2-and-terms
      (list
       (p1988a2-static-apply-term
        (p1988a2-r-carrier ctx) '(a))
       (p1988a2-static-apply-term
        (p1988a2-r-carrier ctx) '(b))
       (p1988a2-static-apply-term
        (p1988a2-r-lt ctx) '(a b))
       (list 'p1988a2-real-function-p
             (p1988a2-quoted (p1988a2-r-carrier ctx))
             'g)
       (list 'p1988a2-exists-p
             (list 'p1988a2-nonzero-witness-function
                   (p1988a2-quoted ctx)

                   'b)

       (list 'p1988a2-universal-p
             (list 'p1988a2-point-condition-function
                   (p1988a2-quoted ctx)
                   (p1988a2-quoted f)

(defun putnambench-putnam-1988-a2-solution ()
  t)

(defun putnambench-putnam-1988-a2-statement (ctx exponential)

    (p1988a2-context-p ctx)

title: putnam_1988_a2
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1988_a2:
-- for f(x) = exp(x^2), there is an open interval and a function nonzero
-- somewhere on it satisfying the erroneous product rule (fg)' = f'g'
-- throughout the interval. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module Putnam1988A2 where

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; _*_)

infix 4 _!=_ _<=N_
infixr 3 _and_
infixr 2 _or_

data Bottom : Set where

Not : Set -> Set
Not A =
  A -> Bottom

_!=_ : {A : Set} -> A -> A -> Set
x != y =
  Not (x == y)

record _and_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data _or_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  left  : A -> A or B
  right : B -> A or B

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

data _<=N_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set where
  zero<=N   : {n : Nat} -> zero <=N n
  suc<=sucN : {m n : Nat} -> m <=N n -> suc m <=N suc n

record CompleteOrderedRealField (R : Set) : Set1 where
  field
    zeroR oneR : R
    add multiply : R -> R -> R
    negate inverse : R -> R
    lessOrEqual : R -> R -> Set
    fromNat : Nat -> R

    one-not-zero :
      oneR != zeroR

    add-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> add x y == add y x
    add-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      add (add x y) z == add x (add y z)
    add-zero :
      (x : R) -> add x zeroR == x
    add-inverse :
      (x : R) -> add x (negate x) == zeroR

    multiply-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> multiply x y == multiply y x
    multiply-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply (multiply x y) z ==
      multiply x (multiply y z)
    multiply-one :
      (x : R) -> multiply x oneR == x
    multiply-zero :
      (x : R) -> multiply x zeroR == zeroR
    distribute :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply x (add y z) ==
      add (multiply x y) (multiply x z)
    inverse-zero :
      inverse zeroR == zeroR
    multiply-inverse :
      (x : R) ->
      x != zeroR ->
      multiply x (inverse x) == oneR

    order-reflexive :
      (x : R) -> lessOrEqual x x
    order-transitive :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y z ->
      lessOrEqual x z
    order-antisymmetric :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y x ->
      x == y
    order-total :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y or lessOrEqual y x
    add-order :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual (add z x) (add z y)
    multiply-nonnegative :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR x ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR y ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR (multiply x y)
    zero-less-than-one :
      lessOrEqual zeroR oneR and zeroR != oneR

    fromNat-zero :
      fromNat zero == zeroR
    fromNat-successor :
      (n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (suc n) == add (fromNat n) oneR
    fromNat-addition :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m + n) == add (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-multiplication :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m * n) == multiply (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-injective :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat m == fromNat n ->
      m == n

    archimedean :
      (x : R) ->
      Exists Nat (\ n -> lessOrEqual x (fromNat n))
    least-upper-bound :
      (P : R -> Set) ->
      Exists R P ->
      Exists R
        (\ upper ->
          (x : R) ->
          P x ->
          lessOrEqual x upper) ->
      Exists R
        (\ supremum ->
          ((x : R) ->
            P x ->
            lessOrEqual x supremum)
          and
          ((upper : R) ->
            ((x : R) ->
              P x ->
              lessOrEqual x upper) ->
            lessOrEqual supremum upper))

open CompleteOrderedRealField

subtract :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
subtract reals x y =
  add reals x (negate reals y)

divide :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
divide reals x y =
  multiply reals x (inverse reals y)

StrictLess :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
StrictLess reals x y =
  lessOrEqual reals x y and x != y

OpenInterval :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
OpenInterval reals a b x =
  StrictLess reals a x and StrictLess reals x b

CloseTo :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
CloseTo reals center radius x =
  StrictLess reals
    (subtract reals center radius)
    x
  and
  StrictLess reals
    x
    (add reals center radius)

naturalPower :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  Nat ->
  R
naturalPower reals x zero =
  oneR reals
naturalPower reals x (suc n) =
  multiply reals
    (naturalPower reals x n)
    x

factorial : Nat -> Nat
factorial zero =
  suc zero
factorial (suc n) =
  suc n * factorial n

sumFirst :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Nat ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  R
sumFirst reals zero term =
  zeroR reals
sumFirst reals (suc n) term =
  add reals
    (sumFirst reals n term)
    (term n)

ConvergesTo :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  R ->
  Set
ConvergesTo {R} reals sequence limit =
  (epsilon : R) ->
  StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) epsilon ->
  Exists Nat
    (\ cutoff ->
      (n : Nat) ->
      cutoff <=N n ->
      CloseTo reals limit epsilon (sequence n))

SeriesHasSum :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  R ->
  Set
SeriesHasSum reals terms limit =
  ConvergesTo reals
    (\ n -> sumFirst reals n terms)
    limit

exponentialTerm :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  Nat ->
  R
exponentialTerm reals x n =
  divide reals
    (naturalPower reals x n)
    (fromNat reals (factorial n))

ExponentialValue :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
ExponentialValue reals x value =
  SeriesHasSum reals
    (exponentialTerm reals x)
    value

record StandardExponential
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) :
  Set1 where

  field
    exponential : R -> R
    exponential-series :
      (x : R) ->
      ExponentialValue reals x (exponential x)

open StandardExponential

differenceQuotient :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (R -> R) ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
differenceQuotient reals function point x =
  divide reals
    (subtract reals (function x) (function point))
    (subtract reals x point)

DerivativeAt :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (R -> R) ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
DerivativeAt {R} reals function point derivativeValue =
  (epsilon : R) ->
  StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) epsilon ->
  Exists R
    (\ delta ->
      StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) delta
      and
      ((x : R) ->
        CloseTo reals point delta x ->
        x != point ->
        CloseTo reals derivativeValue epsilon
          (differenceQuotient reals function point x)))

HasDerivativeAt :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (R -> R) ->
  R ->
  Set
HasDerivativeAt {R} reals function point =
  Exists R
    (\ derivativeValue ->
      DerivativeAt reals function point derivativeValue)

record StandardRealCalculus
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) :
  Set1 where

  field
    derivative : (R -> R) -> R -> R

    derivative-when-differentiable :
      (function : R -> R) ->
      (point : R) ->
      HasDerivativeAt reals function point ->
      DerivativeAt reals
        function
        point
        (derivative function point)

    derivative-when-not-differentiable :
      (function : R -> R) ->
      (point : R) ->
      Not (HasDerivativeAt reals function point) ->
      derivative function point == zeroR reals

open StandardRealCalculus

two : Nat
two =
  suc (suc zero)

square :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R
square reals x =
  naturalPower reals x two

pointwiseProduct :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (R -> R) ->
  (R -> R) ->
  R ->
  R
pointwiseProduct reals f g x =
  multiply reals (f x) (g x)

module Putnam1988A2Statement
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R)
  (realExp : StandardExponential reals)
  (calculus : StandardRealCalculus reals) where

  targetFunction : R -> R
  targetFunction x =
    exponential realExp (square reals x)

  proposition : Set
  proposition =
    Exists R
      (\ a ->
        Exists R
          (\ b ->
            StrictLess reals a b
            and
            Exists (R -> R)
              (\ g ->
                Exists R
                  (\ x ->
                    OpenInterval reals a b x
                    and
                    g x != zeroR reals)
                and
                ((x : R) ->
                  OpenInterval reals a b x ->
                  HasDerivativeAt reals g x)
                and
                ((x : R) ->
                  OpenInterval reals a b x ->
                  derivative calculus
                    (pointwiseProduct reals targetFunction g)
                    x
                  ==
                  multiply reals
                    (derivative calculus targetFunction x)
                    (derivative calculus g x)))))

putnam-1988-a2 : Set1
putnam-1988-a2 =
  (R : Set) ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) ->
  (realExp : StandardExponential reals) ->
  (calculus : StandardRealCalculus reals) ->
  Putnam1988A2Statement.proposition reals realExp calculus

title: putnam_1988_a2
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1988_a2:
  existence on a nonempty open real interval of a nonzero differentiable
  function satisfying the erroneous product-derivative identity for
  f(x) = exp(x^2). This file contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open realTheory limTheory transcTheory;

val putnam_1988_a2 =
  ``let f = \x : real. exp (x pow 2)
    in
      ((?a b : real.
          a < b /\
          ?g : real -> real.
            (?x : real. a < x /\ x < b /\ g x <> 0) /\
            (!x : real.
               a < x /\ x < b
               ==>
               g differentiable x) /\
            (!x : real.
               a < x /\ x < b
               ==>
               diffn 1 (\y : real. f y * g y) x =
                 diffn 1 f x * diffn 1 g x))
       <=> T)``;

title: putnam_1988_a2
content:
$(
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact
  putnam_1988_a2: for f(x) = exp(x^2), there exists an open real interval
  and a real function g, nonzero somewhere and differentiable on that
  interval, such that the incorrect product rule (fg)' = f'g' holds
  throughout the interval. This file contains no proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  The source solution constant is defined or annotated as True, so its
  biconditional with the existence claim is logically equivalent to the
  existence claim asserted below. The witnesses a, b, and g remain internal.

  RR ^m RR is the class of all total real-valued functions. Membership of x
  in dom ( RR _D g ) expresses differentiability of g at x. The other two
  derivative functions are applied to the explicit maps y |-> exp(y^2) and
  y |-> exp(y^2) g(y), preserving the source derivative equality pointwise.
  The final declaration is a single unproved $a statement.
$)

${
  $d a b g x y $.

  putnambench-putnam-1988-a2 $a |- E. a e. RR E. b e. RR
    (
      a < b
      /\
      E. g e. ( RR ^m RR )
        (
          E. x e. ( a (,) b ) ( g ` x ) =/= 0
          /\
          A. x e. ( a (,) b )
            (
              x e. dom ( RR _D g )
              /\
              (
                (
                  RR
                  _D
                  (
                    y e. RR |->
                      (
                        ( exp ` ( y ^ 2 ) )
                        x.
                        ( g ` y )
                      )
                  )
                )
                ` x
              )
              =
              (
                (
                  (
                    RR
                    _D
                    ( y e. RR |-> ( exp ` ( y ^ 2 ) ) )
                  )
                  ` x
                )
                x.
                ( ( RR _D g ) ` x )
              )
            )
        )
    )
  $.
$}

:: existence on an open real interval of a nonzero differentiable function
:: satisfying the erroneous product-rule identity for exp(x^2).
:: This file contains no proof.

  vocabularies NUMBERS, RCOMP_1, SUBSET_1, REAL_1, COMPLEX1, NEWTON,
    ARYTM_3, RELAT_1, CARD_1, PARTFUN1, SEQ_1, TAYLOR_1, XXREAL_1,

    FDIFF_1, SEQFUNC, NEWTON, SIN_COS, TAYLOR_1, ABIAN, SQUARE_1;
  constructors ARYTM_0, REAL_1, NAT_1, SEQ_2, RCOMP_1, RFUNCT_2,
    LIMFUNC1, FDIFF_1, COMSEQ_3, SIN_COS, ABIAN, TAYLOR_1, SEQFUNC,
    SERIES_1, VALUED_1, RELSET_1, COMSEQ_2, SQUARE_1;

    XBOOLE_0, VALUED_0, VALUED_1, FUNCT_2, NEWTON, SIN_COS, INT_1,
    ORDINAL1, SQUARE_1;
  requirements SUBSET, REAL, BOOLE, NUMERALS, ARITHM;
  definitions TAYLOR_1;
  equalities XCMPLX_0, VALUED_1, SUBSET_1, SQUARE_1;
  expansions TAYLOR_1;
  theorems XBOOLE_1, ABSVALUE, PARTFUN1, XCMPLX_1, RELAT_1, RCOMP_1,
    SEQ_1, SEQ_2, SIN_COS, SERIES_1, FUNCT_1, RFUNCT_2, NAT_1, NEWTON,
    POWER, FDIFF_1, FDIFF_2, TAYLOR_1, SIN_COS2, XREAL_1, RFUNCT_1,
    ABIAN, COMPLEX1, XXREAL_0, VALUED_1, FUNCT_2, XREAL_0, ORDINAL1;
  schemes NAT_1;

begin

::$P-
theorem
  for f being Function of REAL,REAL st
    (for x being Real holds f.x = exp_R.(x^2))
  holds
    ex a,b being Real,
       g being Function of REAL,REAL st
      a < b &
      (ex x being Real st a < x & x < b & g.x <> 0) &
      (for x being Real st a < x & x < b holds
        g is_differentiable_in x) &
      (for x being Real st a < x & x < b holds
        diff(f(#)g,x) = diff(f,x) * diff(g,x))
proof
end;
::$P+

title: putnam_1988_a2
content:
% Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1988_a2:
% for f(x) = exp(x^2), an open interval admits a nonzero differentiable real
% function g satisfying the erroneous identity (f*g)' = f'*g'. This file
% contains no proof.

putnam_1988_a2: THEORY
BEGIN
  real_function: TYPE = [real -> real]
  real_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> real]

  safe_div(numerator, denominator: real): real =
    IF denominator = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      numerator / denominator
    ENDIF

  nat_factorial(index: nat): RECURSIVE nat =
    IF index = 0 THEN
      1
    ELSE
      index * nat_factorial(index - 1)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE index

  exponential_partial(x: real, count: nat): RECURSIVE real =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      LET index: nat = count - 1 IN
        exponential_partial(x, count - 1)
          + safe_div(
              x ^ index,
              nat_factorial(index) :: real)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  converges_to(sequence: real_sequence, value: real): bool =
    FORALL (epsilon_value: posreal):
      EXISTS (cutoff: nat):
        FORALL (index: nat):
          cutoff <= index IMPLIES
            abs(sequence(index) - value) < epsilon_value

  real_exponential(x: real): real =
    epsilon(
      LAMBDA (value: real):
        converges_to(
          LAMBDA (count: nat):
            exponential_partial(x, count),
          value))

  given_function: real_function =
    LAMBDA (x: real): real_exponential(x ^ 2)

  has_derivative_at(
      f: real_function,
      derivative, x: real): bool =
    FORALL (epsilon_value: posreal):
      EXISTS (delta: posreal):
        FORALL (h: real):
          (NOT (h = 0) AND abs(h) < delta)
            IMPLIES
              abs(
                f(x + h) - f(x)
                  - derivative * h)
                < epsilon_value * abs(h)

  differentiable_at(f: real_function, x: real): bool =
    EXISTS (derivative: real):
      has_derivative_at(f, derivative, x)

  derivative_value(f: real_function, x: real): real =
    IF differentiable_at(f, x) THEN
      epsilon(
        LAMBDA (derivative: real):
          has_derivative_at(f, derivative, x))
    ELSE
      0
    ENDIF

  in_open_interval(x, a, b: real): bool =
    a < x AND x < b

  differentiable_on_open_interval(
      f: real_function,
      a, b: real): bool =
    FORALL (x: real):
      in_open_interval(x, a, b)
        IMPLIES differentiable_at(f, x)

  putnam_1988_a2_solution: bool = TRUE

  putnam_1988_a2: bool =
    (EXISTS (a, b: real), (g: real_function):
      a < b
        AND (EXISTS (x: real):
          in_open_interval(x, a, b) AND g(x) /= 0)
        AND differentiable_on_open_interval(g, a, b)
        AND (FORALL (x: real):
          in_open_interval(x, a, b)
            IMPLIES
              derivative_value(
                LAMBDA (y: real):
                  given_function(y) * g(y),
                x)
              =
              derivative_value(given_function, x)
                * derivative_value(g, x)))
    IFF putnam_1988_a2_solution
END putnam_1988_a2

title: putnam_1988_a3
content:
import Mathlib

open Set Filter Topology

abbrev putnam_1988_a3_solution : Set ℝ := sorry
-- {x | x > 1 / 2}
/--
Determine, with proof, the set of real numbers $x$ for which
\[
\sum_{n=1}^\infty \left( \frac{1}{n} \csc \frac{1}{n} - 1 \right)^x
\]
converges.
-/
theorem putnam_1988_a3
: {x : ℝ | ∃ L : ℝ, Tendsto (fun t ↦ ∑ n ∈ Finset.Icc (1 : ℕ) t, (((1 / n) / Real.sin (1 / n) - 1) ^ x)) atTop (𝓝 L)} = putnam_1988_a3_solution :=
sorry

title: putnam_1988_a3
content:
Require Import Reals Coquelicot.Coquelicot.
Open Scope R.
Definition putnam_1988_a3_solution (a: R) := a > 1/2.
Theorem putnam_1988_a3
   : forall (a: R), ex_finite_lim_seq (fun m => sum_n_m (fun n => Rpower (1/INR n * (1 / sin (1/INR n)) - 1) a) 1 m) <-> putnam_1988_a3_solution a.
Proof. Admitted.

title: putnam_1988_a3
content:
theory putnam_1988_a3 imports
Complex_Main
begin

definition putnam_1988_a3_solution :: "real set" where
"putnam_1988_a3_solution \<equiv> {x :: real. x > 1 / 2}"
theorem putnam_1988_a3:
  shows "{x :: real. convergent (\<lambda> t :: nat.
    \<Sum> n = 1..t. ((1 / real n) / sin (1 / real n) - 1) powr x)}
    = putnam_1988_a3_solution"
  sorry

end

title: putnam_1988_a3
putnam_1988_a3
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1988_a3:
;; classification of the real exponents for which the series with terms
;; (((1/n) / sin(1/n)) - 1)^x converges. This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))

;; A Dedekind-complete ordered field presents the real numbers.  SINE is fixed
;; by convergence of its Taylor series, and positive-base real powers are fixed
;; by their rational values and continuity in the exponent.  The resulting
;; definitions represent the exact source functions rather than rational
;; approximations to them.

(defun putnam-1988-a3-member-p (carrier x)
  (if (apply$ carrier (list x)) t nil))

(defun putnam-1988-a3-unary (operation x)
  (apply$ operation (list x)))

(defun putnam-1988-a3-binary (operation x y)
  (apply$ operation (list x y)))

(defun putnam-1988-a3-positive-p (carrier less zero x)
  (and
   (putnam-1988-a3-member-p carrier x)
   (apply$ less (list zero x))))

(defun-sk putnam-1988-a3-field-laws-p
    (carrier zero one add multiply negate inverse)
  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (putnam-1988-a3-member-p carrier x)
      (putnam-1988-a3-member-p carrier y)
      (putnam-1988-a3-member-p carrier z))
     (and
      (putnam-1988-a3-member-p
       carrier (putnam-1988-a3-binary add x y))
      (putnam-1988-a3-member-p
       carrier (putnam-1988-a3-binary multiply x y))
      (putnam-1988-a3-member-p
       carrier (putnam-1988-a3-unary negate x))
      (putnam-1988-a3-member-p
       carrier (putnam-1988-a3-unary inverse x))
      (equal
       (putnam-1988-a3-binary
        add (putnam-1988-a3-binary add x y) z)
       (putnam-1988-a3-binary
        add x (putnam-1988-a3-binary add y z)))
      (equal
       (putnam-1988-a3-binary add x y)
       (putnam-1988-a3-binary add y x))
      (equal (putnam-1988-a3-binary add x zero) x)
      (equal
       (putnam-1988-a3-binary
        add x (putnam-1988-a3-unary negate x))
       zero)
      (equal
       (putnam-1988-a3-binary
        multiply (putnam-1988-a3-binary multiply x y) z)
       (putnam-1988-a3-binary
        multiply x (putnam-1988-a3-binary multiply y z)))
      (equal
       (putnam-1988-a3-binary multiply x y)
       (putnam-1988-a3-binary multiply y x))
      (equal (putnam-1988-a3-binary multiply x one) x)
      (equal (putnam-1988-a3-unary inverse zero) zero)
      (implies
       (not (equal x zero))
       (equal
        (putnam-1988-a3-binary
         multiply x (putnam-1988-a3-unary inverse x))
        one))
      (equal
       (putnam-1988-a3-binary
        multiply x (putnam-1988-a3-binary add y z))
       (putnam-1988-a3-binary
        add
        (putnam-1988-a3-binary multiply x y)
        (putnam-1988-a3-binary multiply x z)))))))

(defun-sk putnam-1988-a3-order-laws-p
    (carrier zero add multiply less)
  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (putnam-1988-a3-member-p carrier x)
      (putnam-1988-a3-member-p carrier y)
      (putnam-1988-a3-member-p carrier z))
     (and
      (not (apply$ less (list x x)))
      (or
       (equal x y)
       (apply$ less (list x y))
       (apply$ less (list y x)))
      (implies
       (and
        (apply$ less (list x y))
        (apply$ less (list y z)))
       (apply$ less (list x z)))
      (implies
       (apply$ less (list x y))
       (apply$
        less
        (list
         (putnam-1988-a3-binary add x z)
         (putnam-1988-a3-binary add y z))))
      (implies
       (and
        (apply$ less (list zero x))
        (apply$ less (list zero y)))
       (apply$
        less
        (list
         zero
         (putnam-1988-a3-binary multiply x y))))))))

(defun-sk putnam-1988-a3-set-nonempty-p (carrier set)
  (exists (x)
    (and
     (putnam-1988-a3-member-p carrier x)
     (apply$ set (list x)))))

(defun-sk putnam-1988-a3-upper-bound-p
    (carrier less set bound)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (and
      (putnam-1988-a3-member-p carrier x)
      (apply$ set (list x)))
     (not (apply$ less (list bound x))))))

(defun-sk putnam-1988-a3-bounded-above-p
    (carrier less set)
  (exists (bound)
    (and
     (putnam-1988-a3-member-p carrier bound)
     (putnam-1988-a3-upper-bound-p
      carrier less set bound))))

(defun-sk putnam-1988-a3-supremum-p
    (carrier less set supremum)
  (forall (bound)
    (and
     (putnam-1988-a3-member-p carrier supremum)
     (putnam-1988-a3-upper-bound-p
      carrier less set supremum)
     (implies
      (and
       (putnam-1988-a3-member-p carrier bound)
       (putnam-1988-a3-upper-bound-p
        carrier less set bound))
      (not (apply$ less (list bound supremum)))))))

(defun-sk putnam-1988-a3-has-supremum-p
    (carrier less set)
  (exists (supremum)
    (putnam-1988-a3-supremum-p
     carrier less set supremum)))

(defun-sk putnam-1988-a3-dedekind-complete-p
    (carrier less)
  (forall (set)
    (implies
     (and
      (tamep-functionp set)
      (putnam-1988-a3-set-nonempty-p carrier set)
      (putnam-1988-a3-bounded-above-p carrier less set))
     (putnam-1988-a3-has-supremum-p
      carrier less set))))

(defun putnam-1988-a3-real-field-p
    (carrier zero one add multiply negate inverse less)
  (and
   (tamep-functionp carrier)
   (tamep-functionp add)
   (tamep-functionp multiply)
   (tamep-functionp negate)
   (tamep-functionp inverse)
   (tamep-functionp less)
   (putnam-1988-a3-member-p carrier zero)
   (putnam-1988-a3-member-p carrier one)
   (not (equal zero one))
   (putnam-1988-a3-field-laws-p
    carrier zero one add multiply negate inverse)
   (putnam-1988-a3-order-laws-p
    carrier zero add multiply less)
   (apply$ less (list zero one))
   (putnam-1988-a3-dedekind-complete-p carrier less)))

(defun putnam-1988-a3-natural (n zero one add)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix n)))
  (if (zp n)
      zero
    (putnam-1988-a3-binary
     add one
     (putnam-1988-a3-natural (- n 1) zero one add))))

(defun putnam-1988-a3-integer
    (n zero one add negate)
  (if (< n 0)
      (putnam-1988-a3-unary
       negate
       (putnam-1988-a3-natural (- n) zero one add))
    (putnam-1988-a3-natural n zero one add)))

(defun putnam-1988-a3-natural-power
    (base exponent one multiply)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix exponent)))
  (if (zp exponent)
      one
    (putnam-1988-a3-binary
     multiply
     (putnam-1988-a3-natural-power
      base (- exponent 1) one multiply)
     base)))

(defun putnam-1988-a3-integer-power
    (base exponent one multiply inverse)
  (if (< exponent 0)
      (putnam-1988-a3-unary
       inverse
       (putnam-1988-a3-natural-power
        base (- exponent) one multiply))
    (putnam-1988-a3-natural-power
     base exponent one multiply)))

(defun putnam-1988-a3-rational
    (numerator denominator zero one add multiply negate inverse)
  (putnam-1988-a3-binary
   multiply
   (putnam-1988-a3-integer
    numerator zero one add negate)
   (putnam-1988-a3-unary
    inverse
    (putnam-1988-a3-natural denominator zero one add))))

(defun putnam-1988-a3-absolute (zero negate less x)
  (if (apply$ less (list x zero))
      (putnam-1988-a3-unary negate x)
    x))

(defun putnam-1988-a3-distance
    (zero add negate less x y)
  (putnam-1988-a3-absolute
   zero negate less
   (putnam-1988-a3-binary
    add x (putnam-1988-a3-unary negate y))))

(defun-sk putnam-1988-a3-power-typing-p
    (carrier zero less power)
  (forall (base exponent)
    (implies
     (and
      (putnam-1988-a3-positive-p carrier less zero base)
      (putnam-1988-a3-member-p carrier exponent))
     (putnam-1988-a3-positive-p
      carrier less zero
      (putnam-1988-a3-binary power base exponent)))))

(defun-sk putnam-1988-a3-power-rational-laws-p
    (carrier zero one add multiply negate inverse less power)
  (forall (base numerator denominator)
    (implies
     (and
      (putnam-1988-a3-positive-p carrier less zero base)
      (integerp numerator)
      (posp denominator))
     (equal
      (putnam-1988-a3-natural-power
       (putnam-1988-a3-binary
        power
        base
        (putnam-1988-a3-rational
         numerator denominator
         zero one add multiply negate inverse))
       denominator one multiply)
      (putnam-1988-a3-integer-power
       base numerator one multiply inverse)))))

(defun-sk putnam-1988-a3-power-neighborhood-p
    (carrier zero add negate less power
     base exponent epsilon delta)
  (forall (y)
    (implies
     (and
      (putnam-1988-a3-member-p carrier y)
      (apply$
       less
       (list
        (putnam-1988-a3-distance
         zero add negate less y exponent)
        delta)))
     (apply$
      less
      (list
       (putnam-1988-a3-distance
        zero add negate less
        (putnam-1988-a3-binary power base y)
        (putnam-1988-a3-binary power base exponent))
       epsilon)))))

(defun-sk putnam-1988-a3-power-delta-exists-p
    (carrier zero add negate less power
     base exponent epsilon)
  (exists (delta)
    (and
     (putnam-1988-a3-positive-p carrier less zero delta)
     (putnam-1988-a3-power-neighborhood-p
      carrier zero add negate less power
      base exponent epsilon delta))))

(defun-sk putnam-1988-a3-power-continuous-p
    (carrier zero add negate less power)
  (forall (base exponent epsilon)
    (implies
     (and
      (putnam-1988-a3-positive-p carrier less zero base)
      (putnam-1988-a3-member-p carrier exponent)
      (putnam-1988-a3-positive-p carrier less zero epsilon))
     (putnam-1988-a3-power-delta-exists-p
      carrier zero add negate less power
      base exponent epsilon))))

(defun putnam-1988-a3-real-power-p
    (carrier zero one add multiply negate inverse less power)
  (and
   (tamep-functionp power)
   (putnam-1988-a3-power-typing-p
    carrier zero less power)
   (putnam-1988-a3-power-rational-laws-p
    carrier zero one add multiply negate inverse less power)
   (putnam-1988-a3-power-continuous-p
    carrier zero add negate less power)))

(defun putnam-1988-a3-factorial (n)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix n)))
  (if (zp n)
      1
    (* n (putnam-1988-a3-factorial (- n 1)))))

(defun putnam-1988-a3-sine-prefix
    (x terms zero one add multiply negate inverse)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix terms)))
  (if (zp terms)
      zero
    (let* ((index (- terms 1))
           (exponent (+ (* 2 index) 1))
           (sign
            (if (equal (mod index 2) 0)
                one
              (putnam-1988-a3-unary negate one)))
           (power
            (putnam-1988-a3-natural-power
             x exponent one multiply))
           (factorial
            (putnam-1988-a3-natural
             (putnam-1988-a3-factorial exponent)
             zero one add))
           (term
            (putnam-1988-a3-binary
             multiply
             sign
             (putnam-1988-a3-binary
              multiply
              power
              (putnam-1988-a3-unary inverse factorial)))))
      (putnam-1988-a3-binary
       add
       (putnam-1988-a3-sine-prefix
        x index zero one add multiply negate inverse)
       term))))

(defun-sk putnam-1988-a3-sine-typing-p
    (carrier sine)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (putnam-1988-a3-member-p carrier x)
     (putnam-1988-a3-member-p
      carrier (putnam-1988-a3-unary sine x)))))

(defun-sk putnam-1988-a3-sine-tail-p
    (carrier zero one add multiply negate inverse less sine
     x epsilon cutoff)
  (forall (terms)
    (implies
     (and
      (natp terms)
      (<= cutoff terms))
     (apply$
      less
      (list
       (putnam-1988-a3-distance
        zero add negate less
        (putnam-1988-a3-sine-prefix
         x terms zero one add multiply negate inverse)
        (putnam-1988-a3-unary sine x))
       epsilon)))))

(defun-sk putnam-1988-a3-sine-cutoff-exists-p
    (carrier zero one add multiply negate inverse less sine
     x epsilon)
  (exists (cutoff)
    (and
     (natp cutoff)
     (putnam-1988-a3-sine-tail-p
      carrier zero one add multiply negate inverse less sine
      x epsilon cutoff))))

(defun-sk putnam-1988-a3-sine-series-p
    (carrier zero one add multiply negate inverse less sine)
  (forall (x epsilon)
    (implies
     (and
      (putnam-1988-a3-member-p carrier x)
      (putnam-1988-a3-positive-p carrier less zero epsilon))
     (putnam-1988-a3-sine-cutoff-exists-p
      carrier zero one add multiply negate inverse less sine
      x epsilon))))

(defun putnam-1988-a3-real-sine-p
    (carrier zero one add multiply negate inverse less sine)
  (and
   (tamep-functionp sine)
   (putnam-1988-a3-sine-typing-p carrier sine)
   (putnam-1988-a3-sine-series-p
    carrier zero one add multiply negate inverse less sine)))

(defun putnam-1988-a3-source-base
    (n zero one add multiply negate inverse sine)
  (let* ((n-value
          (putnam-1988-a3-natural n zero one add))
         (reciprocal

title: putnam_1988_a3
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1988_a3:
-- the series sum from n = 1 of ((1/n) / sin(1/n) - 1)^x converges exactly
-- for real exponents x greater than 1/2. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; _*_)

infix 4 _!=_ _<=N_
infixr 3 _and_
infixr 2 _or_

data Bottom : Set where

Not : Set -> Set
Not A =
  A -> Bottom

_!=_ : {A : Set} -> A -> A -> Set
x != y =
  Not (x == y)

record _and_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data _or_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  left  : A -> A or B
  right : B -> A or B

record Iff (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor equivalence
  field
    forward  : A -> B
    backward : B -> A

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

data _<=N_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set where
  zero<=   : {n : Nat} -> zero <=N n
  suc<=suc : {m n : Nat} -> m <=N n -> suc m <=N suc n

record CompleteOrderedRealField (R : Set) : Set1 where
  field
    zeroR oneR : R
    add multiply : R -> R -> R
    negate inverse : R -> R
    lessOrEqual : R -> R -> Set
    fromNat : Nat -> R

    one-not-zero :
      oneR != zeroR

    add-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> add x y == add y x
    add-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      add (add x y) z == add x (add y z)
    add-zero :
      (x : R) -> add x zeroR == x
    add-inverse :
      (x : R) -> add x (negate x) == zeroR

    multiply-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> multiply x y == multiply y x
    multiply-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply (multiply x y) z ==
      multiply x (multiply y z)
    multiply-one :
      (x : R) -> multiply x oneR == x
    multiply-zero :
      (x : R) -> multiply x zeroR == zeroR
    distribute :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply x (add y z) ==
      add (multiply x y) (multiply x z)
    inverse-zero :
      inverse zeroR == zeroR
    multiply-inverse :
      (x : R) ->
      x != zeroR ->
      multiply x (inverse x) == oneR

    order-reflexive :
      (x : R) -> lessOrEqual x x
    order-transitive :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y z ->
      lessOrEqual x z
    order-antisymmetric :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y x ->
      x == y
    order-total :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y or lessOrEqual y x
    add-order :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual (add z x) (add z y)
    multiply-nonnegative :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR x ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR y ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR (multiply x y)
    zero-less-than-one :
      lessOrEqual zeroR oneR and zeroR != oneR

    fromNat-zero :
      fromNat zero == zeroR
    fromNat-successor :
      (n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (suc n) == add (fromNat n) oneR
    fromNat-addition :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m + n) == add (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-multiplication :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m * n) == multiply (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-injective :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat m == fromNat n ->
      m == n

    archimedean :
      (x : R) ->
      Exists Nat (\ n -> lessOrEqual x (fromNat n))
    least-upper-bound :
      (P : R -> Set) ->
      Exists R P ->
      Exists R
        (\ upper ->
          (x : R) ->
          P x ->
          lessOrEqual x upper) ->
      Exists R
        (\ supremum ->
          ((x : R) ->
            P x ->
            lessOrEqual x supremum)
          and
          ((upper : R) ->
            ((x : R) ->
              P x ->
              lessOrEqual x upper) ->
            lessOrEqual supremum upper))

open CompleteOrderedRealField

oneN : Nat
oneN =
  suc zero

twoN : Nat
twoN =
  suc oneN

subtract :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
subtract reals x y =
  add reals x (negate reals y)

divide :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
divide reals x y =
  multiply reals x (inverse reals y)

StrictLess :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
StrictLess reals x y =
  lessOrEqual reals x y and x != y

CloseTo :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
CloseTo reals center radius x =
  StrictLess reals
    (subtract reals center radius)
    x
  and
  StrictLess reals
    x
    (add reals center radius)

naturalPower :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  Nat ->
  R
naturalPower reals x zero =
  oneR reals
naturalPower reals x (suc n) =
  multiply reals
    (naturalPower reals x n)
    x

factorial : Nat -> Nat
factorial zero =
  oneN
factorial (suc n) =
  suc n * factorial n

sumFirst :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Nat ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  R
sumFirst reals zero term =
  zeroR reals
sumFirst reals (suc n) term =
  add reals
    (sumFirst reals n term)
    (term n)

sumThrough :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Nat ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  R
sumThrough reals zero term =
  zeroR reals
sumThrough reals (suc n) term =
  add reals
    (sumThrough reals n term)
    (term (suc n))

ConvergesTo :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  R ->
  Set
ConvergesTo {R} reals sequence limit =
  (epsilon : R) ->
  StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) epsilon ->
  Exists Nat
    (\ cutoff ->
      (n : Nat) ->
      cutoff <=N n ->
      CloseTo reals limit epsilon (sequence n))

Converges :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  Set
Converges {R} reals sequence =
  Exists R
    (\ limit -> ConvergesTo reals sequence limit)

SeriesHasSum :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  R ->
  Set
SeriesHasSum reals terms limit =
  ConvergesTo reals
    (\ n -> sumFirst reals n terms)
    limit

alternatingPower :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Nat ->
  R
alternatingPower reals n =
  naturalPower reals
    (negate reals (oneR reals))
    n

exponentialTerm :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  Nat ->
  R
exponentialTerm reals x n =
  divide reals
    (naturalPower reals x n)
    (fromNat reals (factorial n))

sineTerm :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  Nat ->
  R
sineTerm reals x n =
  divide reals
    (multiply reals
      (alternatingPower reals n)
      (naturalPower reals x (suc (twoN * n))))
    (fromNat reals (factorial (suc (twoN * n))))

ExponentialValue :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
ExponentialValue reals x value =
  SeriesHasSum reals
    (exponentialTerm reals x)
    value

record StandardRealAnalysis
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) : Set1 where
  field
    exponential logarithm sine : R -> R

    exponential-series :
      (x : R) ->
      ExponentialValue reals x (exponential x)
    exponential-positive :
      (x : R) ->
      StrictLess reals
        (zeroR reals)
        (exponential x)
    exponential-injective :
      (x y : R) ->
      exponential x == exponential y ->
      x == y
    exponential-logarithm :
      (x : R) ->
      StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) x ->
      exponential (logarithm x) == x

    sine-series :
      (x : R) ->
      SeriesHasSum reals
        (sineTerm reals x)
        (sine x)

open StandardRealAnalysis

realPower :
  {R : Set} ->
  {reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R} ->
  StandardRealAnalysis reals ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
realPower {reals = reals} analysis base exponent =
  exponential analysis
    (multiply reals
      exponent
      (logarithm analysis base))

module Putnam1988A3Statement
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R)
  (analysis : StandardRealAnalysis reals) where

  reciprocalNat : Nat -> R
  reciprocalNat n =
    divide reals
      (oneR reals)
      (fromNat reals n)

  baseTerm : Nat -> R
  baseTerm n =
    subtract reals
      (divide reals
        (reciprocalNat n)
        (sine analysis (reciprocalNat n)))
      (oneR reals)

  seriesTerm : R -> Nat -> R
  seriesTerm x n =
    realPower analysis (baseTerm n) x

  partialSum : R -> Nat -> R
  partialSum x t =
    sumThrough reals t (seriesTerm x)

  half : R
  half =
    divide reals
      (oneR reals)
      (fromNat reals twoN)

  solution : R -> Set
  solution x =
    StrictLess reals half x

  proposition : Set
  proposition =
    (x : R) ->
    Iff
      (Converges reals (partialSum x))
      (solution x)

putnam-1988-a3 : Set1
putnam-1988-a3 =
  (R : Set) ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) ->
  (analysis : StandardRealAnalysis reals) ->
  Putnam1988A3Statement.proposition reals analysis

(*
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1988_a3:
  the real exponents for which the series with terms
  ((1/n) / sin(1/n) - 1)^x converges are exactly those greater than one half.
  This file contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open arithmeticTheory pred_setTheory realTheory real_sigmaTheory;
open real_topologyTheory transcTheory;

val putnam_1988_a3 =
  ``!x : real.
      (?L : real.
         ((\t : num.
             SIGMA
               (\n : num.
                  (((1 : real) / &n) / sin ((1 : real) / &n) - 1) powr x)
               (IMAGE SUC (count t))) --> L)
           sequentially)
      <=>
      x > 1 / 2``;

$(
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact
  putnam_1988_a3: the real exponents for which the series with terms
  (((1/n) / sin(1/n)) - 1)^x converges are exactly those greater than
  one half. This file contains no proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  For n in NN0, the inclusive interval 1 ... n is empty at zero and otherwise
  gives exactly the source partial sum. The internally existential real L and
  set.mm's sequence-limit relation express convergence without externalizing
  a witness. Each summand uses set.mm's complex power ^c; its base is positive
  for every positive integer n, so ^c agrees with the source real power.

  The Lean and Rocq formulas, the Lean problem text, and all three solution
  specifications place the exponent on each summand. The Isabelle theorem
  instead places powr x outside the finite sum, which conflicts with its own
  adjacent solution specification x > 1/2. The assertion below preserves the
  resulting unambiguous common intended series statement.

  The final declaration is the single unproved $a corpus statement; this
  database contains no $p proof statement.
$)

${
  $d L m n x $.

  putnambench-putnam-1988-a3 $a |- A. x e. RR
    (
      E. L e. RR
        (
          n e. NN0 |->
            sum_ m e. ( 1 ... n )
              (
                (
                  (
                    ( 1 / m )
                    /
                    ( sin ` ( 1 / m ) )
                  )
                  -
                  1
                )
                ^c
                x
              )
        )
        ~~>
        L
      <->
      ( 1 / 2 ) < x
    )
  $.
$}

title: putnam_1988_a3
content:
% Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1988_a3:
% the real exponents for which the series with terms
% ((1/n) / sin(1/n) - 1)^x converges are exactly those greater than one half.
% This file contains no proof.

putnam_1988_a3: THEORY
BEGIN
  real_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> real]

  safe_div(numerator, denominator: real): real =
    IF denominator = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      numerator / denominator
    ENDIF

  nat_factorial(index: nat): RECURSIVE nat =
    IF index = 0 THEN
      1
    ELSE
      index * nat_factorial(index - 1)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE index

  converges_to(sequence: real_sequence, value: real): bool =
    FORALL (epsilon_value: posreal):
      EXISTS (cutoff: nat):
        FORALL (index: nat):
          cutoff <= index IMPLIES
            abs(sequence(index) - value) < epsilon_value

  sine_partial(x: real, count: nat): RECURSIVE real =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      LET index: nat = count - 1 IN
        sine_partial(x, count - 1)
          + safe_div(
              ((-1 :: real) ^ index) * x ^ (2 * index + 1),
              nat_factorial(2 * index + 1) :: real)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  sine(x: real): real =
    epsilon(
      LAMBDA (value: real):
        converges_to(
          LAMBDA (count: nat):
            sine_partial(x, count),
          value))

  exponential_partial(x: real, count: nat): RECURSIVE real =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      LET index: nat = count - 1 IN
        exponential_partial(x, count - 1)
          + safe_div(
              x ^ index,
              nat_factorial(index) :: real)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  real_exponential(x: real): real =
    epsilon(
      LAMBDA (value: real):
        converges_to(
          LAMBDA (count: nat):
            exponential_partial(x, count),
          value))

  natural_log(x: real): real =
    IF x > 0 THEN
      epsilon(
        LAMBDA (value: real):
          real_exponential(value) = x)
    ELSE
      0
    ENDIF

  real_power(base, exponent: real): real =
    IF base > 0 THEN
      real_exponential(exponent * natural_log(base))
    ELSIF base = 0 AND exponent = 0 THEN
      1
    ELSE
      0
    ENDIF

  series_term(x: real, index: nat): real =
    LET n: nat = index + 1,
        angle: real = safe_div(1, n :: real)
    IN
      real_power(
        safe_div(angle, sine(angle)) - 1,
        x)

  partial_sum(x: real, count: nat): RECURSIVE real =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      partial_sum(x, count - 1)
        + series_term(x, count - 1)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  series_converges(x: real): bool =
    EXISTS (total: real):
      converges_to(
        LAMBDA (count: nat):
          partial_sum(x, count),
        total)

  putnam_1988_a3_solution(x: real): bool =
    x > 1 / 2

  putnam_1988_a3: bool =
    FORALL (x: real):
      series_converges(x)
        IFF putnam_1988_a3_solution(x)
END putnam_1988_a3

/--
Prove that there exists a \emph{unique} function $f$ from the set $\mathrm{R}^+$ of positive real numbers to $\mathrm{R}^+$ such that
\[
f(f(x)) = 6x-f(x)
\]
and
\[
f(x)>0
\]
for all $x>0$.
-/
theorem putnam_1988_a5
: (∃ f : ℝ → ℝ, (∀ x > 0, f (f x) = 6 * x - f x ∧ f x > 0) ∧ (∀ g : ℝ → ℝ, (∀ x > 0, g (g x) = 6 * x - g x ∧ g x > 0) → (∀ x > 0, f x = g x))) :=
sorry

  existence and uniqueness on the positive reals of a positive-valued

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))

;; The scalar symbols conservatively present an arbitrary Archimedean ordered
;; field with its rational embedding, the exact real-algebraic structure used
;; by this statement. The competitor is an arbitrary unary function symbol,
;; so the final implication is generic over every competing real function and
;; does not replace that quantifier by a recurrence or a finite function code.

(defstub putnam-1988-a5-add-op (x y) t)

(defun putnam-1988-a5-add (x y)

(defun putnam-1988-a5-subtract (x y)

   x

(defun putnam-1988-a5-positive-p (x)
  (and
   (putnam-1988-a5-scalar-p x)
   (putnam-1988-a5-less
    (putnam-1988-a5-zero)
    x)))

(defun-sk putnam-1988-a5-field-laws-p ()
  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (putnam-1988-a5-scalar-p x)
      (putnam-1988-a5-scalar-p y)
      (putnam-1988-a5-scalar-p z))

      (putnam-1988-a5-scalar-p
       (putnam-1988-a5-add x y))

      (putnam-1988-a5-scalar-p

      (equal

        (putnam-1988-a5-multiply x y)
        z)

        x

        (putnam-1988-a5-rational-embed q)

        (putnam-1988-a5-rational-embed q)
        (putnam-1988-a5-rational-embed r)))

(defun-sk putnam-1988-a5-archimedean-p ()
  (forall (x)

  (and
   (putnam-1988-a5-scalar-p
    (putnam-1988-a5-zero))

    (putnam-1988-a5-one))
   (not
    (equal

    (putnam-1988-a5-rational-embed 0)

    (putnam-1988-a5-one))

    (putnam-1988-a5-zero)
    (putnam-1988-a5-one))

(defun putnam-1988-a5-six-times (x)

   (putnam-1988-a5-rational-embed 6)

(defun putnam-1988-a5-function-value (function x)

(defun-sk putnam-1988-a5-function-real-valued-p (function)

        (putnam-1988-a5-function-value function x))
       (putnam-1988-a5-subtract
        (putnam-1988-a5-six-times x)
        (putnam-1988-a5-function-value function x)))))))

(defun putnam-1988-a5-solution-p (function)

   (tamep-functionp function)

   (putnam-1988-a5-function-equations-p function)))

(defun-sk putnam-1988-a5-agrees-on-positive-reals-p
