title: putnam_1988_a5
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1988_a5:
-- existence and uniqueness on positive real inputs of a positive-valued
-- function satisfying f(f(x)) = 6x - f(x). This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; _*_)

infix 4 _!=_
infixr 3 _and_
infixr 2 _or_

data Bottom : Set where

Not : Set -> Set
Not A =
  A -> Bottom

_!=_ : {A : Set} -> A -> A -> Set
x != y =
  Not (x == y)

record _and_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data _or_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  left  : A -> A or B
  right : B -> A or B

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

record CompleteOrderedRealField (R : Set) : Set1 where
  field
    zeroR oneR : R
    add multiply : R -> R -> R
    negate inverse : R -> R
    lessOrEqual : R -> R -> Set
    fromNat : Nat -> R

    one-not-zero :
      oneR != zeroR

    add-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> add x y == add y x
    add-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      add (add x y) z == add x (add y z)
    add-zero :
      (x : R) -> add x zeroR == x
    add-inverse :
      (x : R) -> add x (negate x) == zeroR

    multiply-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> multiply x y == multiply y x
    multiply-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply (multiply x y) z ==
      multiply x (multiply y z)
    multiply-one :
      (x : R) -> multiply x oneR == x
    multiply-zero :
      (x : R) -> multiply x zeroR == zeroR
    distribute :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply x (add y z) ==
      add (multiply x y) (multiply x z)
    inverse-zero :
      inverse zeroR == zeroR
    multiply-inverse :
      (x : R) ->
      x != zeroR ->
      multiply x (inverse x) == oneR

    order-reflexive :
      (x : R) -> lessOrEqual x x
    order-transitive :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y z ->
      lessOrEqual x z
    order-antisymmetric :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y x ->
      x == y
    order-total :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y or lessOrEqual y x
    add-order :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual (add z x) (add z y)
    multiply-nonnegative :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR x ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR y ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR (multiply x y)
    zero-less-than-one :
      lessOrEqual zeroR oneR and zeroR != oneR

    fromNat-zero :
      fromNat zero == zeroR
    fromNat-successor :
      (n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (suc n) == add (fromNat n) oneR
    fromNat-addition :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m + n) == add (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-multiplication :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m * n) == multiply (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-injective :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat m == fromNat n ->
      m == n

    archimedean :
      (x : R) ->
      Exists Nat
        (\ n ->
          lessOrEqual x (fromNat n))
    least-upper-bound :
      (P : R -> Set) ->
      Exists R P ->
      Exists R
        (\ upper ->
          (x : R) ->
          P x ->
          lessOrEqual x upper) ->
      Exists R
        (\ supremum ->
          ((x : R) ->
            P x ->
            lessOrEqual x supremum)
          and
          ((upper : R) ->
            ((x : R) ->
              P x ->
              lessOrEqual x upper) ->
            lessOrEqual supremum upper))

open CompleteOrderedRealField

subtract :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
subtract reals x y =
  add reals x (negate reals y)

StrictLess :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
StrictLess reals x y =
  lessOrEqual reals x y and x != y

module Putnam1988A5Statement
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) where

  six : R
  six =
    fromNat reals
      (suc (suc (suc (suc (suc (suc zero))))))

  Positive : R -> Set
  Positive x =
    StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) x

  SatisfiesEquation : (R -> R) -> Set
  SatisfiesEquation function =
    (x : R) ->
    Positive x ->
    function (function x) ==
      subtract reals
        (multiply reals six x)
        (function x)
    and
    Positive (function x)

  AgreesOnPositiveInputs :
    (R -> R) ->
    (R -> R) ->
    Set
  AgreesOnPositiveInputs leftFunction rightFunction =
    (x : R) ->
    Positive x ->
    leftFunction x == rightFunction x

  proposition : Set
  proposition =
    Exists (R -> R)
      (\ function ->
        SatisfiesEquation function
        and
        ((otherFunction : R -> R) ->
          SatisfiesEquation otherFunction ->
          AgreesOnPositiveInputs function otherFunction))

putnam-1988-a5 : Set1
putnam-1988-a5 =
  (R : Set) ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) ->
  Putnam1988A5Statement.proposition reals

title: putnam_1988_a5

(*
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1988_a5:
  existence and uniqueness on the positive reals of a positive real-valued
  function satisfying f(f(x)) = 6x - f(x). This file contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open realTheory;

val putnam_1988_a5 =
  ``?f : real -> real.
      (!x : real.
         0 < x
         ==>
         f (f x) = 6 * x - f x /\ 0 < f x) /\
      (!g : real -> real.
         (!x : real.
            0 < x
            ==>
            g (g x) = 6 * x - g x /\ 0 < g x)
         ==>
         !x : real. 0 < x ==> f x = g x)``;

title: putnam_1988_a5
content:
$(
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact
  putnam_1988_a5: existence and uniqueness on the positive reals of a
  positive-valued real function satisfying f(f(x)) = 6x - f(x).
  This file contains no proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  F and G range over all total real-valued functions. The functional
  equation, positivity condition, and equality used for uniqueness are all
  restricted to the full open positive-real interval ( 0 (,) +oo ), so
  values at nonpositive inputs remain unconstrained as in the Lean and
  Isabelle sources.

  The Rocq source instead fixes every nonpositive value to zero. Restriction
  to the positive reals and extension by zero are inverse on its admissible
  functions, so its whole-function uniqueness is equivalent to the
  positive-domain uniqueness asserted here. The final declaration is the
  single unproved $a corpus statement; this database contains no $p proof
  statement.
$)

${
  $d F G x $.

  putnambench-putnam-1988-a5 $a |-
    E. F e. ( RR ^m RR )
      (
        A. x e. ( 0 (,) +oo )
          (
            ( F ` ( F ` x ) )
            =
            ( ( 6 x. x ) - ( F ` x ) )
            /\
            0 < ( F ` x )
          )
        /\
        A. G e. ( RR ^m RR )
          (
            A. x e. ( 0 (,) +oo )
              (
                ( G ` ( G ` x ) )
                =
                ( ( 6 x. x ) - ( G ` x ) )
                /\
                0 < ( G ` x )
              )
            ->
            A. x e. ( 0 (,) +oo )
              ( F ` x ) = ( G ` x )
          )
      )
  $.
$}

title: putnam_1988_a5
content:
% Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1988_a5:
% existence and uniqueness on the positive reals of a positive-valued real
% function satisfying f(f(x)) = 6*x - f(x). This file contains no proof.

putnam_1988_a5: THEORY
BEGIN
  real_function: TYPE = [real -> real]

  positive_solution(f: real_function): bool =
    FORALL (x: real):
      x > 0 IMPLIES
        (f(f(x)) = 6 * x - f(x)
          AND f(x) > 0)

  putnam_1988_a5: bool =
    EXISTS (f: real_function):
      positive_solution(f)
        AND (FORALL (g: real_function):
          positive_solution(g) IMPLIES
            (FORALL (x: real):
              x > 0 IMPLIES f(x) = g(x)))
END putnam_1988_a5

import Mathlib

open Set Filter Topology

abbrev putnam_1988_a6_solution : Prop := sorry
-- True
/--
If a linear transformation $A$ on an $n$-dimensional vector space has $n+1$ eigenvectors such that any $n$ of them are linearly independent, does it follow that $A$ is a scalar multiple of the identity? Prove your answer.
-/
theorem putnam_1988_a6
: (∀ (F V : Type*) (_ : Field F) (_ : AddCommGroup V) (_ : Module F V) (_ : FiniteDimensional F V) (n : ℕ) (A : Module.End F V) (evecs : Set V), (n = Module.finrank F V ∧ evecs ⊆ {v : V | ∃ f : F, A.HasEigenvector f v} ∧ evecs.encard = n + 1 ∧ (∀ sevecs : Fin n → V, (Set.range sevecs ⊆ evecs ∧ (Set.range sevecs).encard = n) → LinearIndependent F sevecs)) → (∃ c : F, A = c • LinearMap.id)) ↔ putnam_1988_a6_solution :=
sorry

(* Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1988_a6:
   a linear operator on an n-dimensional vector space with n+1 eigenvectors,
   every n of which are linearly independent, is a scalar multiple of the
   identity. This file contains no proof. *)

From Stdlib Require Import Arith List.

Record putnam_1988_a6_field : Type := {
  p88_field_carrier : Type;
  p88_field_zero : p88_field_carrier;
  p88_field_one : p88_field_carrier;
  p88_field_add :
    p88_field_carrier -> p88_field_carrier -> p88_field_carrier;
  p88_field_mul :
    p88_field_carrier -> p88_field_carrier -> p88_field_carrier;
  p88_field_opp : p88_field_carrier -> p88_field_carrier;
  p88_field_inv : p88_field_carrier -> p88_field_carrier;
  p88_field_add_assoc :
    forall x y z,
      p88_field_add x (p88_field_add y z) =
      p88_field_add (p88_field_add x y) z;
  p88_field_add_comm :
    forall x y, p88_field_add x y = p88_field_add y x;
  p88_field_add_zero :
    forall x, p88_field_add p88_field_zero x = x;
  p88_field_add_opp :
    forall x, p88_field_add (p88_field_opp x) x = p88_field_zero;
  p88_field_mul_assoc :
    forall x y z,
      p88_field_mul x (p88_field_mul y z) =
      p88_field_mul (p88_field_mul x y) z;
  p88_field_mul_comm :
    forall x y, p88_field_mul x y = p88_field_mul y x;
  p88_field_mul_one :
    forall x, p88_field_mul p88_field_one x = x;
  p88_field_mul_add :
    forall x y z,
      p88_field_mul x (p88_field_add y z) =
      p88_field_add (p88_field_mul x y) (p88_field_mul x z);
  p88_field_zero_neq_one : p88_field_zero <> p88_field_one;
  p88_field_mul_inv :
    forall x,
      x <> p88_field_zero ->
      p88_field_mul (p88_field_inv x) x = p88_field_one
}.

Record putnam_1988_a6_vector_space
    (F : putnam_1988_a6_field) : Type := {
  p88_vector_carrier : Type;
  p88_vector_zero : p88_vector_carrier;
  p88_vector_add :
    p88_vector_carrier -> p88_vector_carrier -> p88_vector_carrier;
  p88_vector_opp : p88_vector_carrier -> p88_vector_carrier;
  p88_vector_scale :
    p88_field_carrier F ->
    p88_vector_carrier ->
    p88_vector_carrier;
  p88_vector_add_assoc :
    forall x y z,
      p88_vector_add x (p88_vector_add y z) =
      p88_vector_add (p88_vector_add x y) z;
  p88_vector_add_comm :
    forall x y, p88_vector_add x y = p88_vector_add y x;
  p88_vector_add_zero :
    forall x, p88_vector_add p88_vector_zero x = x;
  p88_vector_add_opp :
    forall x, p88_vector_add (p88_vector_opp x) x = p88_vector_zero;
  p88_scale_vector_add :
    forall a x y,
      p88_vector_scale a (p88_vector_add x y) =
      p88_vector_add (p88_vector_scale a x) (p88_vector_scale a y);
  p88_scale_field_add :
    forall a b x,
      p88_vector_scale (p88_field_add F a b) x =
      p88_vector_add (p88_vector_scale a x) (p88_vector_scale b x);
  p88_scale_assoc :
    forall a b x,
      p88_vector_scale a (p88_vector_scale b x) =
      p88_vector_scale (p88_field_mul F a b) x;
  p88_scale_one :
    forall x, p88_vector_scale (p88_field_one F) x = x
}.

Record putnam_1988_a6_linear_map
    (F : putnam_1988_a6_field)
    (V : putnam_1988_a6_vector_space F) : Type := {
  p88_linear_apply :
    p88_vector_carrier F V -> p88_vector_carrier F V;
  p88_linear_add :
    forall x y,
      p88_linear_apply (p88_vector_add F V x y) =
      p88_vector_add F V (p88_linear_apply x) (p88_linear_apply y);
  p88_linear_scale :
    forall a x,
      p88_linear_apply (p88_vector_scale F V a x) =
      p88_vector_scale F V a (p88_linear_apply x)
}.

Fixpoint putnam_1988_a6_linear_combination
    (F : putnam_1988_a6_field)
    (V : putnam_1988_a6_vector_space F)
    (coefficients : list (p88_field_carrier F))
    (vectors : list (p88_vector_carrier F V))
    : p88_vector_carrier F V :=
  match coefficients, vectors with
  | a :: coefficients', v :: vectors' =>
      p88_vector_add F V
        (p88_vector_scale F V a v)
        (putnam_1988_a6_linear_combination
          F V coefficients' vectors')
  | _, _ => p88_vector_zero F V
  end.

Definition putnam_1988_a6_linearly_independent
    (F : putnam_1988_a6_field)
    (V : putnam_1988_a6_vector_space F)
    (vectors : list (p88_vector_carrier F V)) : Prop :=
  forall coefficients : list (p88_field_carrier F),
    length coefficients = length vectors ->
    putnam_1988_a6_linear_combination F V coefficients vectors =
      p88_vector_zero F V ->
    Forall (fun coefficient => coefficient = p88_field_zero F) coefficients.

Definition putnam_1988_a6_spans
    (F : putnam_1988_a6_field)
    (V : putnam_1988_a6_vector_space F)
    (vectors : list (p88_vector_carrier F V)) : Prop :=
  forall v : p88_vector_carrier F V,
    exists coefficients : list (p88_field_carrier F),
      length coefficients = length vectors /\
      putnam_1988_a6_linear_combination F V coefficients vectors = v.

Definition putnam_1988_a6_exact_dimension
    (F : putnam_1988_a6_field)
    (V : putnam_1988_a6_vector_space F)
    (n : nat) : Prop :=
  exists basis : list (p88_vector_carrier F V),
    length basis = n /\
    putnam_1988_a6_linearly_independent F V basis /\
    putnam_1988_a6_spans F V basis.

Definition putnam_1988_a6_has_cardinality
    {A : Type} (members : A -> Prop) (n : nat) : Prop :=
  exists elements : list A,
    NoDup elements /\
    length elements = n /\
    forall x : A, In x elements <-> members x.

Definition putnam_1988_a6_is_eigenvector
    (F : putnam_1988_a6_field)
    (V : putnam_1988_a6_vector_space F)
    (A : putnam_1988_a6_linear_map F V)
    (v : p88_vector_carrier F V) : Prop :=
  v <> p88_vector_zero F V /\
  exists eigenvalue : p88_field_carrier F,
    p88_linear_apply F V A v =
      p88_vector_scale F V eigenvalue v.

Definition putnam_1988_a6_every_n_independent
    (F : putnam_1988_a6_field)
    (V : putnam_1988_a6_vector_space F)
    (n : nat)
    (eigenvectors : p88_vector_carrier F V -> Prop) : Prop :=
  forall vectors : list (p88_vector_carrier F V),
    length vectors = n ->
    NoDup vectors ->
    (forall v, In v vectors -> eigenvectors v) ->
    putnam_1988_a6_linearly_independent F V vectors.

Definition putnam_1988_a6_solution : Prop := True.

Theorem putnam_1988_a6 :
  (forall
      (F : putnam_1988_a6_field)
      (V : putnam_1988_a6_vector_space F)
      (n : nat)
      (A : putnam_1988_a6_linear_map F V)
      (eigenvectors : p88_vector_carrier F V -> Prop),
    putnam_1988_a6_exact_dimension F V n /\
    (forall v,
      eigenvectors v ->
      putnam_1988_a6_is_eigenvector F V A v) /\
    putnam_1988_a6_has_cardinality eigenvectors (S n) /\
    putnam_1988_a6_every_n_independent F V n eigenvectors ->
    exists scalar : p88_field_carrier F,
      forall v : p88_vector_carrier F V,
        p88_linear_apply F V A v =
        p88_vector_scale F V scalar v)
  <-> putnam_1988_a6_solution.
Admitted.

title: putnam_1988_a6
content:
theory putnam_1988_a6 imports
Complex_Main
"HOL-Algebra.Ring"
"HOL-Analysis.Finite_Cartesian_Product"
begin

definition putnam_1988_a6_solution :: bool where
"putnam_1988_a6_solution \<equiv> True"
theorem putnam_1988_a6:
  shows "(\<forall> (F :: ('a,'m) ring_scheme) (V :: ('b,'n) ring_scheme) (scale :: 'a \<Rightarrow> 'b \<Rightarrow> 'b) (A :: 'b \<Rightarrow> 'b) (n :: nat). 
          n > 0 \<and> field F \<and> abelian_group V \<and>
          (\<forall> a \<in> carrier F. \<forall> b \<in> carrier F. \<forall> x \<in> carrier V. \<forall> y \<in> carrier V.
          scale a x \<in> carrier V \<and> A x \<in> carrier V \<and>
          scale a (x \<oplus>\<^bsub>V\<^esub> y) = scale a x \<oplus>\<^bsub>V\<^esub> scale a y \<and> scale (a \<oplus>\<^bsub>F\<^esub> b) x = scale a x \<oplus>\<^bsub>V\<^esub> scale b x \<and> 
          scale a (scale b x) = scale (a \<otimes>\<^bsub>F\<^esub> b) x \<and> scale \<one>\<^bsub>F\<^esub> x = x \<and> 
          A (scale a x \<oplus>\<^bsub>V\<^esub> scale b y) = scale a (A x) \<oplus>\<^bsub>V\<^esub> scale b (A y)) \<and>
          (\<exists> basis :: 'b list.
          set basis \<subseteq> carrier V \<and> length basis = n \<and> card (set basis) = n \<and>
          (\<forall> coeffs :: 'a list. set coeffs \<subseteq> carrier F \<and> length coeffs = n \<and>
          (\<Oplus>\<^bsub>V\<^esub> i \<in> {0..<n}. scale (coeffs!i) (basis!i)) = \<zero>\<^bsub>V\<^esub>
          \<longrightarrow> (\<forall> i \<in> {0..<n}. coeffs!i = \<zero>\<^bsub>F\<^esub>)) \<and>
          (\<forall> x \<in> carrier V. \<exists> coeffs :: 'a list.
          set coeffs \<subseteq> carrier F \<and> length coeffs = n \<and>
          x = (\<Oplus>\<^bsub>V\<^esub> i \<in> {0..<n}. scale (coeffs!i) (basis!i)))) \<and>
          (\<exists> evecs \<subseteq> ((carrier V) - {\<zero>\<^bsub>V\<^esub>}). card evecs = n + 1 \<and> (\<forall> evec \<in> evecs. \<exists> a \<in> carrier F. A evec = scale a evec) \<and>
          (\<forall> sevecs :: 'b list. set sevecs \<subseteq> evecs \<and> length sevecs = n \<and> card (set sevecs) = n \<longrightarrow>
          (\<forall> coeffs :: 'a list. set coeffs \<subseteq> carrier F \<and> length coeffs = n \<and> 
          (\<Oplus>\<^bsub>V\<^esub> i \<in> {0..<n}. scale (coeffs!i) (sevecs!i)) = \<zero>\<^bsub>V\<^esub> \<longrightarrow> (\<forall> i \<in> {0..<n}. coeffs!i = \<zero>\<^bsub>F\<^esub>))))
          \<longrightarrow> (\<exists> a \<in> carrier F. \<forall> x \<in> carrier V. A x = scale a x))
          \<longleftrightarrow> putnam_1988_a6_solution"
  sorry

end

title: putnam_1988_a6
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1988_a6:
  a linear endomorphism of an n-dimensional vector space with n+1
  eigenvectors, every n of which are linearly independent, is a scalar
  multiple of the identity. This file contains no proof.
*)

let statement =
  `!n:num (zero_F:A) (one_F:A)
    (add_F:A->A->A) (mul_F:A->A->A)
    (neg_F:A->A) (inv_F:A->A)
    (zero_V:V) (add_V:V->V->V) (neg_V:V->V)
    (smul:A->V->V) (Aop:V->V) (evecs:V->bool).
     let field_axioms =
       (~(zero_F = one_F) /\
       (!x y:A. add_F x y = add_F y x) /\
       (!x y z:A. add_F (add_F x y) z = add_F x (add_F y z)) /\
       (!x:A. add_F x zero_F = x) /\
       (!x:A. add_F (neg_F x) x = zero_F) /\
       (!x y:A. mul_F x y = mul_F y x) /\
       (!x y z:A. mul_F (mul_F x y) z = mul_F x (mul_F y z)) /\
       (!x:A. mul_F one_F x = x) /\
       (!x:A. ~(x = zero_F) ==> mul_F (inv_F x) x = one_F) /\
       (!x y z:A.
          mul_F x (add_F y z) =
          add_F (mul_F x y) (mul_F x z))) in
     let vector_space_axioms =
       ((!x y:V. add_V x y = add_V y x) /\
       (!x y z:V. add_V (add_V x y) z = add_V x (add_V y z)) /\
       (!x:V. add_V x zero_V = x) /\
       (!x:V. add_V (neg_V x) x = zero_V) /\
       (!a:A. !x y:V.
          smul a (add_V x y) = add_V (smul a x) (smul a y)) /\
       (!a b:A. !x:V.
          smul (add_F a b) x = add_V (smul a x) (smul b x)) /\
       (!a b:A. !x:V.
          smul (mul_F a b) x = smul a (smul b x)) /\
       (!x:V. smul one_F x = x)) in
     let linear_combination =
       \(coeff:num->A) (vectors:num->V).
         ITSET
           (\i:num. \acc:V.
              add_V (smul (coeff i) (vectors i)) acc)
           {i:num | i < n} zero_V in
     let linearly_independent =
       \(vectors:num->V).
         !coeff:num->A.
           linear_combination coeff vectors = zero_V
           ==> !i:num. i < n ==> coeff i = zero_F in
     let basis =
       \(vectors:num->V).
         linearly_independent vectors /\
         (!x:V.
            ?coeff:num->A. linear_combination coeff vectors = x) in
     field_axioms /\
     vector_space_axioms /\
     (!a b:A. !x y:V.
        Aop (add_V (smul a x) (smul b y)) =
        add_V (smul a (Aop x)) (smul b (Aop y))) /\
     (?vectors:num->V. basis vectors) /\
     evecs HAS_SIZE (n + 1) /\
     (!v:V.
        v IN evecs
        ==> ~(v = zero_V) /\ ?a:A. Aop v = smul a v) /\
     (!vectors:num->V.
        IMAGE vectors {i:num | i < n} SUBSET evecs /\
        CARD (IMAGE vectors {i:num | i < n}) = n
        ==> linearly_independent vectors)
     ==> ?c:A. !x:V. Aop x = smul c x`;;

title: putnam_1988_a6
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1988_a6:
;; an endomorphism of an n-dimensional vector space with n+1 eigenvectors,
;; every n of which are linearly independent, is scalar. This file contains
;; no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))

;; Choosing a basis identifies every n-dimensional space over F with F^n.
;; Under this identification the endomorphism is an n by n matrix. A finite
;; list exactly represents the source's finite eigenvector set. Every n-element
;; subset is obtained by deleting one entry, and it is independent exactly
;; when its determinant is nonzero.
;;
;; For a nonzero vector v, Av is a scalar multiple of v exactly when, at the
;; first nonzero coordinate j, Av equals ((Av)_j / v_j) v. Thus the source's
;; eigenvalue witnesses remain internal. Likewise, a matrix is a scalar
;; multiple of the identity exactly when its off-diagonal entries are zero and
;; all diagonal entries equal its first diagonal entry. These equivalences
;; eliminate both existential scalar quantifiers without exposing witnesses.
;;
;; CARRIER and the field operations are ACL2 function objects. FN-EQUAL
;; against a constant-T lambda expresses the field laws over the entire
;; represented carrier; the carrier is not enumerated or restricted to be
;; finite. This presentation is counterexample-equivalent to the arbitrary
;; source field quantifier. Any failure uses only the finitely many entries of
;; the matrix and eigenvectors, so it descends to their finitely generated
;; subfield, which has a tame effective ACL2 presentation. Conversely, every
;; represented field is a source field.

(defun putnam-1988-a6-quoted (object)
  (list 'quote object))

(defun putnam-1988-a6-apply1-term (function argument)
  (list
   'apply$
   (putnam-1988-a6-quoted function)
   (list 'cons argument nil)))

(defun putnam-1988-a6-apply2-term (function left right)
  (list
   'apply$
   (putnam-1988-a6-quoted function)
   (list 'cons left (list 'cons right nil))))

(defun putnam-1988-a6-carrier-term (carrier element)
  (putnam-1988-a6-apply1-term carrier element))

(defun putnam-1988-a6-operation-term
    (operation left right)
  (putnam-1988-a6-apply2-term operation left right))

(defun putnam-1988-a6-and-term (terms)
  (if (endp terms)
      (putnam-1988-a6-quoted t)
    (list
     'if
     (car terms)
     (putnam-1988-a6-and-term (cdr terms))
     (putnam-1988-a6-quoted nil))))

(defun putnam-1988-a6-implies-term (antecedent consequent)
  (list
   'if
   antecedent
   consequent
   (putnam-1988-a6-quoted t)))

(defun putnam-1988-a6-true-function (formals)
  (list
   'lambda
   formals
   (putnam-1988-a6-quoted t)))

(defun putnam-1988-a6-field-laws-function
    (carrier zero one add mul neg inv)
  (let* ((x 'x)
         (y 'y)
         (z 'z)
         (qzero (putnam-1988-a6-quoted zero))
         (qone (putnam-1988-a6-quoted one))
         (add-xy
          (putnam-1988-a6-operation-term add x y))
         (add-yz
          (putnam-1988-a6-operation-term add y z))
         (mul-xy
          (putnam-1988-a6-operation-term mul x y))
         (mul-yz
          (putnam-1988-a6-operation-term mul y z))
         (neg-x
          (putnam-1988-a6-apply1-term neg x))
         (inv-x
          (putnam-1988-a6-apply1-term inv x))
         (all-in-carrier
          (putnam-1988-a6-and-term
           (list
            (putnam-1988-a6-carrier-term carrier x)
            (putnam-1988-a6-carrier-term carrier y)
            (putnam-1988-a6-carrier-term carrier z))))
         (laws
          (putnam-1988-a6-and-term
           (list
            (putnam-1988-a6-carrier-term carrier add-xy)
            (putnam-1988-a6-carrier-term carrier mul-xy)
            (putnam-1988-a6-carrier-term carrier neg-x)
            (putnam-1988-a6-carrier-term carrier inv-x)
            (list
             'equal
             (putnam-1988-a6-operation-term add add-xy z)
             (putnam-1988-a6-operation-term add x add-yz))
            (list
             'equal
             (putnam-1988-a6-operation-term mul mul-xy z)
             (putnam-1988-a6-operation-term mul x mul-yz))
            (list
             'equal
             add-xy
             (putnam-1988-a6-operation-term add y x))
            (list
             'equal
             mul-xy
             (putnam-1988-a6-operation-term mul y x))
            (list
             'equal
             (putnam-1988-a6-operation-term add x qzero)
             x)
            (list
             'equal
             (putnam-1988-a6-operation-term add x neg-x)
             qzero)
            (list
             'equal
             (putnam-1988-a6-operation-term mul x qone)
             x)
            (putnam-1988-a6-implies-term
             (list 'equal x qzero)
             (list 'equal inv-x qzero))
            (putnam-1988-a6-implies-term
             (list 'if
                   (list 'equal x qzero)
                   (putnam-1988-a6-quoted nil)
                   (putnam-1988-a6-quoted t))
             (list
              'equal
              (putnam-1988-a6-operation-term mul x inv-x)
              qone))
            (list
             'equal
             (putnam-1988-a6-operation-term mul x add-yz)
             (putnam-1988-a6-operation-term
              add
              (putnam-1988-a6-operation-term mul x y)
              (putnam-1988-a6-operation-term mul x z)))))))
    (list
     'lambda
     '(x y z)
     (putnam-1988-a6-implies-term all-in-carrier laws))))

(defun putnam-1988-a6-field-p
    (carrier zero one add mul neg inv)
  (and
   (tamep-functionp carrier)
   (tamep-functionp add)
   (tamep-functionp mul)
   (tamep-functionp neg)
   (tamep-functionp inv)
   (apply$ carrier (list zero))
   (apply$ carrier (list one))
   (not (equal zero one))
   (fn-equal
    (putnam-1988-a6-field-laws-function
     carrier zero one add mul neg inv)
    (putnam-1988-a6-true-function '(x y z)))))

(defun putnam-1988-a6-field-add (add x y)
  (apply$ add (list x y)))

(defun putnam-1988-a6-field-mul (mul x y)
  (apply$ mul (list x y)))

(defun putnam-1988-a6-field-neg (neg x)
  (apply$ neg (list x)))

(defun putnam-1988-a6-field-inv (inv x)
  (apply$ inv (list x)))

(defun putnam-1988-a6-vector-p (vector n carrier)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix n)))
  (if (zp n)
      (equal vector nil)
    (and
     (consp vector)
     (apply$ carrier (list (car vector)))
     (putnam-1988-a6-vector-p
      (cdr vector) (- n 1) carrier))))

(defun putnam-1988-a6-matrix-rows-p
    (matrix width remaining carrier)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix remaining)))
  (if (zp remaining)
      (equal matrix nil)
    (and
     (consp matrix)
     (putnam-1988-a6-vector-p
      (car matrix) width carrier)
     (putnam-1988-a6-matrix-rows-p
      (cdr matrix) width (- remaining 1) carrier))))

(defun putnam-1988-a6-matrix-p (matrix n carrier)
  (putnam-1988-a6-matrix-rows-p
   matrix n n carrier))

(defun putnam-1988-a6-vector-list-p
    (vectors n carrier)
  (if (endp vectors)
      (equal vectors nil)
    (and
     (putnam-1988-a6-vector-p (car vectors) n carrier)
     (putnam-1988-a6-vector-list-p
      (cdr vectors) n carrier))))

(defun putnam-1988-a6-vector-zero-p (vector zero)
  (if (endp vector)
      t
    (and
     (equal (car vector) zero)
     (putnam-1988-a6-vector-zero-p (cdr vector) zero))))

(defun putnam-1988-a6-dot-product
    (left right zero add mul)
  (if (endp left)
      zero
    (putnam-1988-a6-field-add
     add
     (putnam-1988-a6-field-mul
      mul (car left) (car right))
     (putnam-1988-a6-dot-product
      (cdr left) (cdr right) zero add mul))))

(defun putnam-1988-a6-matrix-vector
    (matrix vector zero add mul)
  (if (endp matrix)
      nil
    (cons
     (putnam-1988-a6-dot-product
      (car matrix) vector zero add mul)
     (putnam-1988-a6-matrix-vector
      (cdr matrix) vector zero add mul))))

(defun putnam-1988-a6-first-nonzero-index
    (vector zero)
  (if (endp vector)
      0
    (if (equal (car vector) zero)
        (+ 1
           (putnam-1988-a6-first-nonzero-index
            (cdr vector) zero))
      0)))

(defun putnam-1988-a6-scalar-vector-equal-p
    (image vector scalar mul)
  (if (endp vector)
      (equal image nil)
    (and
     (consp image)
     (equal
      (car image)
      (putnam-1988-a6-field-mul
       mul scalar (car vector)))
     (putnam-1988-a6-scalar-vector-equal-p
      (cdr image) (cdr vector) scalar mul))))

(defun putnam-1988-a6-eigenvector-p
    (matrix vector zero add mul inv)
  (if (putnam-1988-a6-vector-zero-p vector zero)
      nil
    (let* ((image
            (putnam-1988-a6-matrix-vector
             matrix vector zero add mul))
           (index
            (putnam-1988-a6-first-nonzero-index
             vector zero))
           (scalar
            (putnam-1988-a6-field-mul
             mul
             (nth index image)
             (putnam-1988-a6-field-inv
              inv (nth index vector)))))
      (putnam-1988-a6-scalar-vector-equal-p
       image vector scalar mul))))

(defun putnam-1988-a6-all-eigenvectors-p
    (vectors matrix zero add mul inv)
  (if (endp vectors)
      t
    (and
     (putnam-1988-a6-eigenvector-p
      matrix (car vectors) zero add mul inv)
     (putnam-1988-a6-all-eigenvectors-p
      (cdr vectors) matrix zero add mul inv))))

(defun putnam-1988-a6-insert-at
    (value position values)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix position)))
  (if (zp position)
      (cons value values)
    (cons
     (car values)
     (putnam-1988-a6-insert-at
      value (- position 1) (cdr values)))))

(defun putnam-1988-a6-insert-everywhere
    (value values position remaining)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix remaining)))
  (if (zp remaining)
      nil
    (cons
     (putnam-1988-a6-insert-at value position values)
     (putnam-1988-a6-insert-everywhere
      value values (+ position 1) (- remaining 1)))))

(defun putnam-1988-a6-insert-into-permutations
    (value permutations width)
  (if (endp permutations)
      nil
    (append
     (putnam-1988-a6-insert-everywhere
      value (car permutations) 0 width)
     (putnam-1988-a6-insert-into-permutations
      value (cdr permutations) width))))

(defun putnam-1988-a6-permutations (n)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix n)))
  (if (zp n)
      (list nil)
    (putnam-1988-a6-insert-into-permutations
     (- n 1)
     (putnam-1988-a6-permutations (- n 1))
     n)))

(defun putnam-1988-a6-count-smaller (value values)
  (if (endp values)
      0
    (+ (if (< (car values) value) 1 0)
       (putnam-1988-a6-count-smaller
        value (cdr values)))))

(defun putnam-1988-a6-inversion-count (permutation)
  (if (endp permutation)
      0
    (+ (putnam-1988-a6-count-smaller
        (car permutation) (cdr permutation))
       (putnam-1988-a6-inversion-count
        (cdr permutation)))))

(defun putnam-1988-a6-permutation-product
    (matrix permutation one mul)
  (if (endp permutation)
      one
    (putnam-1988-a6-field-mul
     mul
     (nth (car permutation) (car matrix))
     (putnam-1988-a6-permutation-product
      (cdr matrix) (cdr permutation) one mul))))

(defun putnam-1988-a6-determinant-sum
    (matrix permutations zero one add mul neg)
  (if (endp permutations)
      zero
    (let* ((permutation (car permutations))
           (product
            (putnam-1988-a6-permutation-product
             matrix permutation one mul))
           (signed-product
            (if (evenp
                 (putnam-1988-a6-inversion-count
                  permutation))
                product
              (putnam-1988-a6-field-neg neg product))))
      (putnam-1988-a6-field-add
       add
       signed-product
       (putnam-1988-a6-determinant-sum
        matrix (cdr permutations)
        zero one add mul neg)))))

(defun putnam-1988-a6-determinant
    (matrix n zero one add mul neg)
  (putnam-1988-a6-determinant-sum
   matrix
   (putnam-1988-a6-permutations n)
   zero one add mul neg))

(defun putnam-1988-a6-remove-nth
    (position values)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix position)))
  (if (zp position)
      (cdr values)
    (cons
     (car values)
     (putnam-1988-a6-remove-nth
      (- position 1) (cdr values)))))

(defun putnam-1988-a6-all-deletions-independent-p
    (vectors position remaining n zero one add mul neg)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix remaining)))
  (if (zp remaining)
      t
    (and
     (not
      (equal
       (putnam-1988-a6-determinant
        (putnam-1988-a6-remove-nth position vectors)
        n zero one add mul neg)
       zero))
     (putnam-1988-a6-all-deletions-independent-p
      vectors (+ position 1) (- remaining 1)
      n zero one add mul neg))))

(defun putnam-1988-a6-scalar-row-p
    (row row-index column-index scalar zero)
  (if (endp row)
      t
    (and
     (equal
      (car row)
      (if (equal row-index column-index)
          scalar
        zero))
     (putnam-1988-a6-scalar-row-p
      (cdr row) row-index (+ column-index 1)
      scalar zero))))

(defun putnam-1988-a6-scalar-matrix-rows-p
    (matrix row-index scalar zero)
  (if (endp matrix)
      t
    (and
     (putnam-1988-a6-scalar-row-p
      (car matrix) row-index 0 scalar zero)
     (putnam-1988-a6-scalar-matrix-rows-p
      (cdr matrix) (+ row-index 1) scalar zero))))

(defun putnam-1988-a6-scalar-matrix-p (matrix zero)
  (putnam-1988-a6-scalar-matrix-rows-p
   matrix 0 (car (car matrix)) zero))

(defun putnambench-putnam-1988-a6-statement
    (n carrier zero one add mul neg inv matrix eigenvectors)
  (implies
   (and
    (natp n)
    (< 0 n)
    (putnam-1988-a6-field-p
     carrier zero one add mul neg inv)
    (putnam-1988-a6-matrix-p matrix n carrier)
    (true-listp eigenvectors)
    (equal (len eigenvectors) (+ n 1))
    (no-duplicatesp-equal eigenvectors)
    (putnam-1988-a6-vector-list-p
     eigenvectors n carrier)
    (putnam-1988-a6-all-eigenvectors-p
     eigenvectors matrix zero add mul inv)
    (putnam-1988-a6-all-deletions-independent-p
     eigenvectors 0 (+ n 1) n
     zero one add mul neg))
   (putnam-1988-a6-scalar-matrix-p matrix zero)))

:q

title: putnam_1988_a6
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1988_a6:
-- a finite-dimensional linear endomorphism with n+1 eigenvectors, every n of
-- which are linearly independent, is scalar multiplication. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

open import Agda.Primitive using (Level; lsuc; _⊔_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc)

infix 4 _!=_
infixr 3 _and_

data Bottom : Set where

Not :
  {a : Level} ->
  Set a ->
  Set a
Not A =
  A -> Bottom

_!=_ :
  {a : Level} ->
  {A : Set a} ->
  A ->
  A ->
  Set a
x != y =
  Not (x == y)

record _and_
  {a b : Level}
  (A : Set a)
  (B : Set b) :
  Set (a ⊔ b) where

  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

record Exists
  {a p : Level}
  (A : Set a)
  (P : A -> Set p) :
  Set (a ⊔ p) where

  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

data Fin : Nat -> Set where
  fzero : {n : Nat} -> Fin (suc n)
  fsuc  : {n : Nat} -> Fin n -> Fin (suc n)

Injective :
  {a b : Level} ->
  {A : Set a} ->
  {B : Set b} ->
  (A -> B) ->
  Set (a ⊔ b)
Injective function =
  (x y : _) ->
  function x == function y ->
  x == y

record HasCardinality
  {a p : Level}
  {A : Set a}
  (member : A -> Set p)
  (cardinality : Nat) :
  Set (a ⊔ p) where

  field
    enumerate :
      Fin cardinality ->
      A
    enumerated-member :
      (index : Fin cardinality) ->
      member (enumerate index)
    enumeration-complete :
      (item : A) ->
      member item ->
      Exists (Fin cardinality)
        (\ index -> item == enumerate index)
    enumeration-injective :
      Injective enumerate

record Field
  {f : Level}
  (F : Set f) :
  Set (lsuc f) where

  field
    zeroF oneF : F
    addF multiplyF : F -> F -> F
    negateF inverseF : F -> F

    one-not-zero :
      oneF != zeroF

    add-commutative :
      (x y : F) ->
      addF x y == addF y x
    add-associative :
      (x y z : F) ->
      addF (addF x y) z == addF x (addF y z)
    add-zero :
      (x : F) ->
      addF x zeroF == x
    add-inverse :
      (x : F) ->
      addF x (negateF x) == zeroF

    multiply-commutative :
      (x y : F) ->
      multiplyF x y == multiplyF y x
    multiply-associative :
      (x y z : F) ->
      multiplyF (multiplyF x y) z ==
      multiplyF x (multiplyF y z)
    multiply-one :
      (x : F) ->
      multiplyF x oneF == x
    distribute :
      (x y z : F) ->
      multiplyF x (addF y z) ==
      addF (multiplyF x y) (multiplyF x z)
    multiply-inverse :
      (x : F) ->
      x != zeroF ->
      multiplyF x (inverseF x) == oneF

open Field

record VectorSpace
  {f v : Level}
  {F : Set f}
  (fieldStructure : Field F)
  (V : Set v) :
  Set (lsuc (f ⊔ v)) where

  field
    zeroV : V
    addV : V -> V -> V
    negateV : V -> V
    smul : F -> V -> V

    addV-commutative :
      (x y : V) ->
      addV x y == addV y x
    addV-associative :
      (x y z : V) ->
      addV (addV x y) z == addV x (addV y z)
    addV-zero :
      (x : V) ->
      addV x zeroV == x
    addV-inverse :
      (x : V) ->
      addV x (negateV x) == zeroV

    smul-addV :
      (a : F) ->
      (x y : V) ->
      smul a (addV x y) ==
      addV (smul a x) (smul a y)
    addF-smul :
      (a b : F) ->
      (x : V) ->
      smul (addF fieldStructure a b) x ==
      addV (smul a x) (smul b x)
    multiplyF-smul :
      (a b : F) ->
      (x : V) ->
      smul (multiplyF fieldStructure a b) x ==
      smul a (smul b x)
    oneF-smul :
      (x : V) ->
      smul (oneF fieldStructure) x == x

open VectorSpace

record Endomorphism
  {f v : Level}
  {F : Set f}
  {V : Set v}
  (fieldStructure : Field F)
  (space : VectorSpace fieldStructure V) :
  Set (lsuc (f ⊔ v)) where

  field
    apply : V -> V
    map-add :
      (x y : V) ->
      apply (addV space x y) ==
      addV space (apply x) (apply y)
    map-smul :
      (a : F) ->
      (x : V) ->
      apply (smul space a x) ==
      smul space a (apply x)

open Endomorphism

sumFin :
  {f v : Level} ->
  {F : Set f} ->
  {V : Set v} ->
  (fieldStructure : Field F) ->
  (space : VectorSpace fieldStructure V) ->
  {n : Nat} ->
  (Fin n -> V) ->
  V
sumFin fieldStructure space {zero} terms =
  zeroV space
sumFin fieldStructure space {suc n} terms =
  addV space
    (terms fzero)
    (sumFin fieldStructure space
      (\ index -> terms (fsuc index)))

module Putnam1988A6Statement
  {f v p : Level}
  {F : Set f}
  {V : Set v}
  (fieldStructure : Field F)
  (space : VectorSpace fieldStructure V) where

  linearCombination :
    {n : Nat} ->
    (Fin n -> F) ->
    (Fin n -> V) ->
    V
  linearCombination coefficients vectors =
    sumFin fieldStructure space
      (\ index ->
        smul space
          (coefficients index)
          (vectors index))

  LinearIndependent :
    {n : Nat} ->
    (Fin n -> V) ->
    Set (f ⊔ v)
  LinearIndependent vectors =
    (coefficients : Fin _ -> F) ->
    linearCombination coefficients vectors == zeroV space ->
    (index : Fin _) ->
    coefficients index == zeroF fieldStructure

  Spans :
    {n : Nat} ->
    (Fin n -> V) ->
    Set (f ⊔ v)
  Spans vectors =
    (x : V) ->
    Exists (Fin _ -> F)
      (\ coefficients ->
        linearCombination coefficients vectors == x)

  HasDimension :
    Nat ->
    Set (f ⊔ v)
  HasDimension n =
    Exists (Fin n -> V)
      (\ basis ->
        LinearIndependent basis
        and
        Spans basis)

  Eigenvector :
    Endomorphism fieldStructure space ->
    V ->
    Set (f ⊔ v)
  Eigenvector A vector =
    vector != zeroV space
    and
    Exists F
      (\ eigenvalue ->
        apply A vector ==
        smul space eigenvalue vector)

  EveryNIndependent :
    (n : Nat) ->
    (V -> Set p) ->
    Set (f ⊔ v ⊔ p)
  EveryNIndependent n member =
    (selection : Fin n -> V) ->
    ((index : Fin n) -> member (selection index)) ->
    Injective selection ->
    LinearIndependent selection

  ScalarEndomorphism :
    Endomorphism fieldStructure space ->
    F ->
    Set v
  ScalarEndomorphism A scalar =
    (x : V) ->
    apply A x == smul space scalar x

  proposition :
    Set (lsuc (f ⊔ v ⊔ p))
  proposition =
    (n : Nat) ->
    (A : Endomorphism fieldStructure space) ->
    (eigenvectors : V -> Set p) ->
    HasDimension n ->
    ((vector : V) ->
      eigenvectors vector ->
      Eigenvector A vector) ->
    HasCardinality eigenvectors (suc n) ->
    EveryNIndependent n eigenvectors ->
    Exists F (ScalarEndomorphism A)

putnam-1988-a6 :
  {f v p : Level} ->
  Set (lsuc (f ⊔ v ⊔ p))
putnam-1988-a6 {f} {v} {p} =
  (F : Set f) ->
  (V : Set v) ->
  (fieldStructure : Field F) ->
  (space : VectorSpace fieldStructure V) ->
  Putnam1988A6Statement.proposition {p = p} fieldStructure space

title: putnam_1988_a6
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1988_a6:
  a linear endomorphism of an n-dimensional vector space with n+1 nonzero
  eigenvectors, every n of which are linearly independent, is a scalar
  multiple of the identity. This file contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open arithmeticTheory listTheory pred_setTheory;

val putnam_1988_a6 =
  ``let is_field =
      \(zeroF : 'f) (oneF : 'f)
       (addF : 'f -> 'f -> 'f) (mulF : 'f -> 'f -> 'f)
       (negF : 'f -> 'f) (invF : 'f -> 'f).
        zeroF <> oneF /\
        (!a b : 'f. addF a b = addF b a) /\
        (!a b c : 'f. addF (addF a b) c = addF a (addF b c)) /\
        (!a : 'f. addF zeroF a = a) /\
        (!a : 'f. addF (negF a) a = zeroF) /\
        (!a b : 'f. mulF a b = mulF b a) /\
        (!a b c : 'f. mulF (mulF a b) c = mulF a (mulF b c)) /\
        (!a : 'f. mulF oneF a = a) /\
        (!a b c : 'f.
           mulF a (addF b c) = addF (mulF a b) (mulF a c)) /\
        (!a : 'f. a <> zeroF ==> mulF (invF a) a = oneF)
    in
    let is_vector_space =
      \(zeroF : 'f) (oneF : 'f)
       (addF : 'f -> 'f -> 'f) (mulF : 'f -> 'f -> 'f)
       (zeroV : 'v) (addV : 'v -> 'v -> 'v) (negV : 'v -> 'v)
       (smul : 'f -> 'v -> 'v).
        (!x y : 'v. addV x y = addV y x) /\
        (!x y z : 'v. addV (addV x y) z = addV x (addV y z)) /\
        (!x : 'v. addV zeroV x = x) /\
        (!x : 'v. addV (negV x) x = zeroV) /\
        (!a : 'f. !x y : 'v.
           smul a (addV x y) = addV (smul a x) (smul a y)) /\
        (!a b : 'f. !x : 'v.
           smul (addF a b) x = addV (smul a x) (smul b x)) /\
        (!a b : 'f. !x : 'v.
           smul (mulF a b) x = smul a (smul b x)) /\
        (!x : 'v. smul oneF x = x)
    in
    let is_linear =
      \(addV : 'v -> 'v -> 'v) (smul : 'f -> 'v -> 'v)
       (A : 'v -> 'v).
        (!x y : 'v. A (addV x y) = addV (A x) (A y)) /\
        (!a : 'f. !x : 'v. A (smul a x) = smul a (A x))
    in
    let lincomb =
      \(zeroV : 'v) (addV : 'v -> 'v -> 'v)
       (smul : 'f -> 'v -> 'v) (m : num)
       (coeff : num -> 'f) (vec : num -> 'v).
        FOLDL
          (\acc i. addV acc (smul (coeff i) (vec i)))
          zeroV
          (GENLIST (\i. i) m)
    in
    let independent =
      \(zeroF : 'f) (zeroV : 'v) (addV : 'v -> 'v -> 'v)
       (smul : 'f -> 'v -> 'v) (s : 'v -> bool).
        !m : num. !vec : num -> 'v. !coeff : num -> 'f.
          (!i : num. i < m ==> s (vec i)) /\
          (!i j : num.
             i < m /\ j < m /\ vec i = vec j ==> i = j) /\
          lincomb zeroV addV smul m coeff vec = zeroV
          ==>
          !i : num. i < m ==> coeff i = zeroF
    in
    let has_dimension =
      \(zeroF : 'f) (zeroV : 'v) (addV : 'v -> 'v -> 'v)
       (smul : 'f -> 'v -> 'v) (n : num).
        ?basis : 'v list.
          LENGTH basis = n /\
          ALL_DISTINCT basis /\
          independent zeroF zeroV addV smul
            (\x : 'v. MEM x basis) /\
          !x : 'v.
            ?coeff : num -> 'f.
              lincomb zeroV addV smul n coeff
                (\i : num. EL i basis) = x
    in
    let putnam_1988_a6_solution = T
    in
      (!(zeroF : 'f) (oneF : 'f)
         (addF : 'f -> 'f -> 'f) (mulF : 'f -> 'f -> 'f)
         (negF : 'f -> 'f) (invF : 'f -> 'f)
         (zeroV : 'v) (addV : 'v -> 'v -> 'v) (negV : 'v -> 'v)
         (smul : 'f -> 'v -> 'v) (n : num) (A : 'v -> 'v)
         (evecs : 'v -> bool).
          is_field zeroF oneF addF mulF negF invF /\
          is_vector_space zeroF oneF addF mulF
            zeroV addV negV smul /\
          is_linear addV smul A /\
          has_dimension zeroF zeroV addV smul n /\
          FINITE evecs /\
          CARD evecs = n + 1 /\
          (!v : 'v.
             evecs v ==>
             v <> zeroV /\
             ?a : 'f. A v = smul a v) /\
          (!s : 'v -> bool.
             s SUBSET evecs /\ FINITE s /\ CARD s = n
             ==>
             independent zeroF zeroV addV smul s)
          ==>
          ?c : 'f. !x : 'v. A x = smul c x)
      <=>
      putnam_1988_a6_solution``;

title: putnam_1988_a6
content:
$(
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact
  putnam_1988_a6: a finite-dimensional linear endomorphism with n+1
  eigenvectors such that every n of them are linearly independent is a
  scalar multiple of the identity. This file contains no proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  V ranges over SetMM vector-space structures whose scalar structure is a
  field, Base ` V is the vector carrier, and dim ` V is its dimension.
  A belongs to the SetMM class of linear endomorphisms V LMHom V. The set E
  consists of n+1 nonzero eigenvectors, with the eigenvalue witness remaining
  internally existential.

  The source condition on every injective Fin n-indexed selection is written
  in the equivalent form that every n-element subset S of E belongs to
  LIndS ` V. The conclusion is the pointwise form of equality between A and
  a scalar multiple of the identity. The source solution proposition is
  annotated as True, so its biconditional reduces to the assertion below.
  The n = 0 case is vacuous because a zero-dimensional vector space has no
  nonzero eigenvector, matching the positive-dimension Isabelle formulation.
  The final declaration is a single unproved $a corpus statement; this
  database contains no $p proof declaration.
$)

${
  $d A E S V c n x $.

  putnambench-putnam-1988-a6 $a |-
    A. V A. n e. NN0 A. A e. ( V LMHom V ) A. E
      (
        (
          (
            V e. LVec
            /\
            ( Scalar ` V ) e. Field
          )
          /\
          (
            ( dim ` V ) = n
            /\
            (
              E
              C_
              {
                x e. ( ( Base ` V ) \ { ( 0g ` V ) } ) |
                E. c e. ( Base ` ( Scalar ` V ) )
                  ( A ` x ) = ( c ( .s ` V ) x )
              }
              /\
              (
                ( # ` E ) = ( n + 1 )
                /\
                A. S
                  (
                    (
                      S C_ E
                      /\
                      ( # ` S ) = n
                    )
                    ->
                    S e. ( LIndS ` V )
                  )
              )
            )
          )
        )
        ->
        E. c e. ( Base ` ( Scalar ` V ) )
          A. x e. ( Base ` V )
            ( A ` x ) = ( c ( .s ` V ) x )
      )
  $.
$}

title: putnam_1988_a6
content:
% Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1988_a6:
% a linear endomorphism of an n-dimensional vector space with n+1 eigenvectors,
% every n of which are linearly independent, is scalar. This file contains no proof.

putnam_1988_a6[
  FieldElement, Vector: TYPE+,
  zero_F, one_F: FieldElement,
  add_F, multiply_F:
    [FieldElement, FieldElement -> FieldElement],
  negate_F, inverse_F: [FieldElement -> FieldElement],
  zero_V: Vector,
  add_V: [Vector, Vector -> Vector],
  negate_V: [Vector -> Vector],
  scale: [FieldElement, Vector -> Vector]
]: THEORY
BEGIN
  IMPORTING finite_sets[Vector]

  vector_set: TYPE = finite_set[Vector]
  vector_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> Vector]
  scalar_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> FieldElement]
  endomorphism: TYPE = [Vector -> Vector]

  field_axioms: bool =
    zero_F /= one_F
      AND (FORALL (a, b: FieldElement):
        add_F(a, b) = add_F(b, a))
      AND (FORALL (a, b, c: FieldElement):
        add_F(add_F(a, b), c) = add_F(a, add_F(b, c)))
      AND (FORALL (a: FieldElement):
        add_F(a, zero_F) = a)
      AND (FORALL (a: FieldElement):
        add_F(a, negate_F(a)) = zero_F)
      AND (FORALL (a, b: FieldElement):
        multiply_F(a, b) = multiply_F(b, a))
      AND (FORALL (a, b, c: FieldElement):
        multiply_F(multiply_F(a, b), c)
          = multiply_F(a, multiply_F(b, c)))
      AND (FORALL (a: FieldElement):
        multiply_F(a, one_F) = a)
      AND (FORALL (a, b, c: FieldElement):
        multiply_F(a, add_F(b, c))
          = add_F(multiply_F(a, b), multiply_F(a, c)))
      AND (FORALL (a: FieldElement):
        a /= zero_F IMPLIES
          multiply_F(a, inverse_F(a)) = one_F)

  vector_space_axioms: bool =
    (FORALL (u, v: Vector):
      add_V(u, v) = add_V(v, u))
      AND (FORALL (u, v, w: Vector):
        add_V(add_V(u, v), w) = add_V(u, add_V(v, w)))
      AND (FORALL (v: Vector):
        add_V(v, zero_V) = v)
      AND (FORALL (v: Vector):
        add_V(v, negate_V(v)) = zero_V)
      AND (FORALL (a: FieldElement), (u, v: Vector):
        scale(a, add_V(u, v))
          = add_V(scale(a, u), scale(a, v)))
      AND (FORALL (a, b: FieldElement), (v: Vector):
        scale(add_F(a, b), v)
          = add_V(scale(a, v), scale(b, v)))
      AND (FORALL (a, b: FieldElement), (v: Vector):
        scale(multiply_F(a, b), v)
          = scale(a, scale(b, v)))
      AND (FORALL (v: Vector):
        scale(one_F, v) = v)

  linear_combination(
      vectors: vector_sequence,
      coefficients: scalar_sequence,
      count: nat): RECURSIVE Vector =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      zero_V
    ELSE
      add_V(
        linear_combination(vectors, coefficients, count - 1),
        scale(coefficients(count - 1), vectors(count - 1)))
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  injective_below(
      vectors: vector_sequence,
      bound: nat): bool =
    FORALL (i, j: nat):
      i < bound AND j < bound AND vectors(i) = vectors(j)
        IMPLIES i = j

  enumerates_exactly(
      vectors: vector_sequence,
      set_value: vector_set,
      bound: nat): bool =
    injective_below(vectors, bound)
      AND (FORALL (v: Vector):
        set_value(v)
          IFF
            EXISTS (i: nat):
              i < bound AND vectors(i) = v)

  finite_subset(
      left, right: vector_set): bool =
    FORALL (v: Vector):
      left(v) IMPLIES right(v)

  linearly_independent(
      set_value: vector_set): bool =
    FORALL
        (vectors: vector_sequence),
        (coefficients: scalar_sequence):
      (enumerates_exactly(vectors, set_value, card(set_value))
        AND linear_combination(
          vectors, coefficients, card(set_value)) = zero_V)
      IMPLIES
        (FORALL (i: nat):
          i < card(set_value)
            IMPLIES coefficients(i) = zero_F)

  spans_space(
      set_value: vector_set): bool =
    FORALL (v: Vector):
      EXISTS
          (vectors: vector_sequence),
          (coefficients: scalar_sequence):
        enumerates_exactly(vectors, set_value, card(set_value))
          AND linear_combination(
            vectors, coefficients, card(set_value)) = v

  has_dimension(n: nat): bool =
    EXISTS (basis: vector_set):
      card(basis) = n
        AND linearly_independent(basis)
        AND spans_space(basis)

  linear(A: endomorphism): bool =
    (FORALL (u, v: Vector):
      A(add_V(u, v)) = add_V(A(u), A(v)))
      AND (FORALL (a: FieldElement), (v: Vector):
        A(scale(a, v)) = scale(a, A(v)))

  eigenvector(A: endomorphism, v: Vector): bool =
    v /= zero_V
      AND EXISTS (eigenvalue: FieldElement):
        A(v) = scale(eigenvalue, v)

  every_n_linearly_independent(
      evecs: vector_set,
      n: nat): bool =
    FORALL (chosen: vector_set):
      (finite_subset(chosen, evecs) AND card(chosen) = n)
        IMPLIES linearly_independent(chosen)

  scalar_endomorphism(A: endomorphism): bool =
    EXISTS (scalar: FieldElement):
      FORALL (v: Vector):
        A(v) = scale(scalar, v)

  putnam_1988_a6_solution: bool = TRUE

  putnam_1988_a6: bool =
    ((field_axioms AND vector_space_axioms)
      IMPLIES
        (FORALL
            (n: nat),
            (A: endomorphism),
            (evecs: vector_set):
          (has_dimension(n)
            AND linear(A)
            AND card(evecs) = n + 1
            AND (FORALL (v: Vector):
              evecs(v) IMPLIES eigenvector(A, v))
            AND every_n_linearly_independent(evecs, n))
          IMPLIES scalar_endomorphism(A)))
      IFF putnam_1988_a6_solution
END putnam_1988_a6

;; Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1988_b1:
;; every composite positive integer is xy+xz+yz+1 for positive integers
;; x, y, and z. This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

;; If n = x*y+x*z+y*z+1 with x,y,z positive, then each of x,y,z is
;; strictly less than n. Thus the searches through n below are exactly the
;; source's internal existential quantifiers, not a restriction of them.

(defun putnam-1988-b1-positive-z-through-p (n x y z)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix z)))
  (if (and (integerp n)
           (posp x)
           (posp y)
           (natp z))
      (or
       (and
        (posp z)
        (equal n
               (+ (* x y)
                  (* x z)
                  (* y z)
                  1)))
       (and
        (not (zp z))
        (putnam-1988-b1-positive-z-through-p
         n x y (- z 1))))
    nil))

(defun putnam-1988-b1-positive-yz-through-p (n x y)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix y)))
  (if (and (integerp n)
           (posp x)
           (natp y))
      (or
       (and
        (posp y)
        (putnam-1988-b1-positive-z-through-p n x y n))
       (and
        (not (zp y))
        (putnam-1988-b1-positive-yz-through-p
         n x (- y 1))))
    nil))

(defun putnam-1988-b1-positive-xyz-through-p (n x)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix x)))
  (if (and (integerp n)
           (natp x))
      (or
       (and
        (posp x)
        (putnam-1988-b1-positive-yz-through-p n x n))
       (and
        (not (zp x))
        (putnam-1988-b1-positive-xyz-through-p
         n (- x 1))))
    nil))

(defun putnambench-putnam-1988-b1-statement (a b)
  (implies
   (and
    (integerp a)
    (integerp b)
    (<= 2 a)
    (<= 2 b))
   (putnam-1988-b1-positive-xyz-through-p
    (* a b)
    (* a b))))

:q

title: putnam_1988_b1
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1988_b1:
-- every product of two integers at least 2 is xy + xz + yz + 1 for some
-- positive integers x, y, and z. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Int using (Int; pos; negsuc)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; _*_)

infixr 3 _and_

record _and_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

data Positive : Int -> Set where
  positive :
    {n : Nat} ->
    Positive (pos (suc n))

data AtLeastTwo : Int -> Set where
  at-least-two :
    {n : Nat} ->
    AtLeastTwo (pos (suc (suc n)))

negative : Nat -> Int
negative zero =
  pos zero
negative (suc n) =
  negsuc n

difference : Nat -> Nat -> Int
difference zero zero =
  pos zero
difference (suc m) zero =
  pos (suc m)
difference zero (suc n) =
  negsuc n
difference (suc m) (suc n) =
  difference m n

addInt : Int -> Int -> Int
addInt (pos m) (pos n) =
  pos (m + n)
addInt (pos m) (negsuc n) =
  difference m (suc n)
addInt (negsuc m) (pos n) =
  difference n (suc m)
addInt (negsuc m) (negsuc n) =
  negsuc (suc (m + n))

multiplyInt : Int -> Int -> Int
multiplyInt (pos m) (pos n) =
  pos (m * n)
multiplyInt (pos m) (negsuc n) =
  negative (m * suc n)
multiplyInt (negsuc m) (pos n) =
  negative (suc m * n)
multiplyInt (negsuc m) (negsuc n) =
  pos (suc m * suc n)

oneZ : Int
oneZ =
  pos (suc zero)

putnam-1988-b1 : Set
putnam-1988-b1 =
  (a b : Int) ->
  AtLeastTwo a ->
  AtLeastTwo b ->
  Exists Int
    (\ x ->
      Exists Int
        (\ y ->
          Exists Int
            (\ z ->
              Positive x
              and
              Positive y
              and
              Positive z
              and
              multiplyInt a b
              ==
              addInt
                (addInt
                  (addInt
                    (multiplyInt x y)
                    (multiplyInt x z))
                  (multiplyInt y z))
                oneZ)))

$(
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact
  putnam_1988_b1: every product of two integers at least 2 is expressible
  as xy + xz + yz + 1 for positive integers x, y, and z. This file
  contains no proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  SetMM's ZZ and NN are the integers and positive integers, respectively.
  Thus binding x, y, and z over NN is definitionally equivalent to binding
  them over ZZ and requiring each to be greater than 0.

  The Lean and Isabelle sources quantify the factors a and b explicitly.
  The Rocq source instead quantifies n > 3 with n nonprime. These
  formulations are equivalent: a product of integers a,b >= 2 is a
  nonprime integer greater than 3, and every nonprime integer greater than
  3 has such a factorization. The final declaration is the single unproved
  $a corpus statement; this database contains no $p proof statement.
$)

${
  $d a b x y z $.

  putnambench-putnam-1988-b1 $a |-
    A. a e. ZZ A. b e. ZZ
      (
        ( 2 <_ a /\ 2 <_ b )
        ->
        E. x e. NN E. y e. NN E. z e. NN
          (
            ( a x. b )
            =
            (
              (
                ( ( x x. y ) + ( x x. z ) )
                +
                ( y x. z )
              )
              +
              1
            )
          )
      )
  $.
$}

;; Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1988_b2:
;; for arbitrary real x and nonnegative real y, the displayed quadratic
;; hypothesis implies the displayed quadratic conclusion. This file contains
;; no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))

;; The scalar interface presents an arbitrary real-closed ordered field.
;; Every variable below ranges directly over its carrier. The final formula is
;; first-order in the ordered-field language, so real-closed-field transfer
;; makes its universal closure equivalent to the source statement over R.

(defstub putnam-1988-b2-real-p (real-type value) t)
(defstub putnam-1988-b2-zero (real-type) t)
(defstub putnam-1988-b2-one (real-type) t)
(defstub putnam-1988-b2-add (real-type left right) t)
(defstub putnam-1988-b2-mul (real-type left right) t)
(defstub putnam-1988-b2-neg (real-type value) t)
(defstub putnam-1988-b2-inv (real-type value) t)
(defstub putnam-1988-b2-less (real-type left right) t)

(defun putnam-1988-b2-leq (real-type left right)
  (not (putnam-1988-b2-less real-type right left)))

(defun-sk putnam-1988-b2-field-laws-p (real-type)
  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (putnam-1988-b2-real-p real-type x)
      (putnam-1988-b2-real-p real-type y)
      (putnam-1988-b2-real-p real-type z))
     (let* ((zero (putnam-1988-b2-zero real-type))
            (one (putnam-1988-b2-one real-type))
            (x-plus-y (putnam-1988-b2-add real-type x y))
            (y-plus-z (putnam-1988-b2-add real-type y z))
            (x-times-y (putnam-1988-b2-mul real-type x y))
            (y-times-z (putnam-1988-b2-mul real-type y z))
            (minus-x (putnam-1988-b2-neg real-type x))
            (inverse-x (putnam-1988-b2-inv real-type x)))
       (and
        (putnam-1988-b2-real-p real-type x-plus-y)
        (putnam-1988-b2-real-p real-type x-times-y)
        (putnam-1988-b2-real-p real-type minus-x)
        (putnam-1988-b2-real-p real-type inverse-x)
        (equal
         (putnam-1988-b2-add real-type x-plus-y z)
         (putnam-1988-b2-add real-type x y-plus-z))
        (equal x-plus-y (putnam-1988-b2-add real-type y x))
        (equal (putnam-1988-b2-add real-type x zero) x)
        (equal (putnam-1988-b2-add real-type x minus-x) zero)
        (equal
         (putnam-1988-b2-mul real-type x-times-y z)
         (putnam-1988-b2-mul real-type x y-times-z))
        (equal x-times-y (putnam-1988-b2-mul real-type y x))
        (equal (putnam-1988-b2-mul real-type x one) x)
        (implies
         (equal x zero)
         (equal inverse-x zero))
        (implies
         (not (equal x zero))
         (equal
          (putnam-1988-b2-mul real-type x inverse-x)
          one))
        (equal
         (putnam-1988-b2-mul real-type x y-plus-z)
         (putnam-1988-b2-add
          real-type
          (putnam-1988-b2-mul real-type x y)
          (putnam-1988-b2-mul real-type x z))))))))

(defun-sk putnam-1988-b2-order-laws-p (real-type)
  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (putnam-1988-b2-real-p real-type x)
      (putnam-1988-b2-real-p real-type y)
      (putnam-1988-b2-real-p real-type z))
     (let ((zero (putnam-1988-b2-zero real-type)))
       (and
        (not (putnam-1988-b2-less real-type x x))
        (or
         (putnam-1988-b2-less real-type x y)
         (equal x y)
         (putnam-1988-b2-less real-type y x))
        (implies
         (and
          (putnam-1988-b2-less real-type x y)
          (putnam-1988-b2-less real-type y z))
         (putnam-1988-b2-less real-type x z))
        (implies
         (putnam-1988-b2-less real-type x y)
         (putnam-1988-b2-less
          real-type
          (putnam-1988-b2-add real-type x z)
          (putnam-1988-b2-add real-type y z)))
        (implies
         (and
          (putnam-1988-b2-less real-type zero x)
          (putnam-1988-b2-less real-type zero y))
         (putnam-1988-b2-less
          real-type
          zero
          (putnam-1988-b2-mul real-type x y))))))))

(defun putnam-1988-b2-real-list-p (real-type values)
  (if (consp values)
      (and
       (putnam-1988-b2-real-p real-type (car values))
       (putnam-1988-b2-real-list-p real-type (cdr values)))
    (equal values nil)))

(defun putnam-1988-b2-polynomial-value
    (real-type coefficients x)
  (if (consp coefficients)
      (putnam-1988-b2-add
       real-type
       (car coefficients)
       (putnam-1988-b2-mul
        real-type
        x
        (putnam-1988-b2-polynomial-value
         real-type (cdr coefficients) x)))
    (putnam-1988-b2-zero real-type)))

(defun-sk putnam-1988-b2-square-root-exists-p
    (real-type x)
  (exists (root)
    (and
     (putnam-1988-b2-real-p real-type root)
     (putnam-1988-b2-leq
      real-type (putnam-1988-b2-zero real-type) root)
     (equal
      (putnam-1988-b2-mul real-type root root)

(defun-sk putnam-1988-b2-square-root-property-p
    (real-type)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (and
      (putnam-1988-b2-real-p real-type x)
      (putnam-1988-b2-leq
       real-type (putnam-1988-b2-zero real-type) x))
     (putnam-1988-b2-square-root-exists-p
      real-type x))))

(defun putnam-1988-b2-odd-degree-polynomial-p
    (real-type coefficients)
  (and
   (true-listp coefficients)
   (<= 2 (len coefficients))
   (evenp (len coefficients))
   (putnam-1988-b2-real-list-p real-type coefficients)
   (not
    (equal
     (car (last coefficients))
     (putnam-1988-b2-zero real-type)))))

(defun-sk putnam-1988-b2-polynomial-root-exists-p

-- Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1988_b2:
-- nonnegative real y satisfying y * (y + 1) <= (x + 1)^2 also satisfies
-- y * (y - 1) <= x^2. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; _*_)

infix 4 _!=_
infixr 3 _and_
infixr 2 _or_

data Bottom : Set where

Not : Set -> Set
Not A =
  A -> Bottom

_!=_ : {A : Set} -> A -> A -> Set
x != y =
  Not (x == y)

record _and_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data _or_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  left  : A -> A or B
  right : B -> A or B

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

record CompleteOrderedRealField (R : Set) : Set1 where
  field
    zeroR oneR : R
    add multiply : R -> R -> R
    negate inverse : R -> R
    lessOrEqual : R -> R -> Set
    fromNat : Nat -> R

    one-not-zero :
      oneR != zeroR

    add-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> add x y == add y x
    add-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      add (add x y) z == add x (add y z)
    add-zero :
      (x : R) -> add x zeroR == x
    add-inverse :
      (x : R) -> add x (negate x) == zeroR

    multiply-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> multiply x y == multiply y x
    multiply-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply (multiply x y) z ==
      multiply x (multiply y z)
    multiply-one :
      (x : R) -> multiply x oneR == x
    multiply-zero :
      (x : R) -> multiply x zeroR == zeroR
    distribute :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply x (add y z) ==
      add (multiply x y) (multiply x z)
    inverse-zero :
      inverse zeroR == zeroR
    multiply-inverse :
      (x : R) ->
      x != zeroR ->
      multiply x (inverse x) == oneR

    order-reflexive :
      (x : R) -> lessOrEqual x x
    order-transitive :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y z ->
      lessOrEqual x z
    order-antisymmetric :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y x ->
      x == y
    order-total :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y or lessOrEqual y x
    add-order :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual (add z x) (add z y)
    multiply-nonnegative :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR x ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR y ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR (multiply x y)
    zero-less-than-one :
      lessOrEqual zeroR oneR and zeroR != oneR

    fromNat-zero :
      fromNat zero == zeroR
    fromNat-successor :
      (n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (suc n) == add (fromNat n) oneR
    fromNat-addition :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m + n) == add (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-multiplication :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m * n) == multiply (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-injective :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat m == fromNat n ->
      m == n

    archimedean :
      (x : R) ->
      Exists Nat (\ n -> lessOrEqual x (fromNat n))
    least-upper-bound :
      (P : R -> Set) ->
      Exists R P ->
      Exists R
        (\ upper ->
          (x : R) ->
          P x ->
          lessOrEqual x upper) ->
      Exists R
        (\ supremum ->
          ((x : R) ->
            P x ->
            lessOrEqual x supremum)
          and
          ((upper : R) ->
            ((x : R) ->
              P x ->
              lessOrEqual x upper) ->
            lessOrEqual supremum upper))

open CompleteOrderedRealField

subtract :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
subtract reals x y =
  add reals x (negate reals y)

square :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R
square reals x =
  multiply reals x x

module Putnam1988B2Statement
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) where

  hypothesis : R -> R -> Set
  hypothesis x y =
    lessOrEqual reals (zeroR reals) y
    and
    lessOrEqual reals
      (multiply reals y (add reals y (oneR reals)))
      (square reals (add reals x (oneR reals)))

  conclusion : R -> R -> Set
  conclusion x y =
    lessOrEqual reals
      (multiply reals y (subtract reals y (oneR reals)))
      (square reals x)

  proposition : Set
  proposition =
    (x y : R) ->
    hypothesis x y ->
    conclusion x y

putnam-1988-b2 : Set1
putnam-1988-b2 =
  (R : Set) ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) ->
  Putnam1988B2Statement.proposition reals

import Mathlib

open Set Filter Topology

noncomputable abbrev putnam_1988_b3_solution : ℝ := sorry
-- (1 + Real.sqrt 3) / 2
/--
For every $n$ in the set $N=\{1,2,\dots\}$ of positive integers, let $r_n$ be the minimum value of $|c-d \sqrt{3}|$ for all nonnegative integers $c$ and $d$ with $c+d=n$. Find, with proof, the smallest positive real number $g$ with $r_n \leq g$ for all $n \in N$.
-/
theorem putnam_1988_b3
    (r : ℤ → ℝ)
    (hr : ∀ n ≥ 1,
      (∃ c d : ℤ,
        (c ≥ 0 ∧ d ≥ 0) ∧
        c + d = n ∧ r n = |c - d * Real.sqrt 3|) ∧
        (∀ c d : ℤ, (c ≥ 0 ∧ d ≥ 0 ∧ c + d = n) → |c - d * Real.sqrt 3| ≥ r n))
    : IsLeast {g : ℝ | g > 0 ∧ (∀ n : ℤ, n ≥ 1 → r n ≤ g)} putnam_1988_b3_solution :=
  sorry

   !r:int->real.
