title: putnam_1988_b3
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1988_b3:
;; the least positive uniform bound for the minima of |c-d*sqrt(3)| over
;; nonnegative integers c,d with fixed positive sum. This file contains no
;; proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))

;; A pair (a,b) denotes a+b*sqrt(3). All coefficients used below are rational.
;; Since sqrt(3) is irrational, its sign is decided exactly by comparing the
;; rational squares a^2 and 3*b^2.

(defun putnam-1988-b3-q3-positive-p (a b)
  (and
   (rationalp a)
   (rationalp b)
   (cond
    ((< b 0)
     (and
      (< 0 a)
      (< (* 3 b b) (* a a))))
    ((< 0 b)
     (or
      (<= 0 a)
      (< (* a a) (* 3 b b))))
    (t
     (< 0 a)))))

(defun putnam-1988-b3-quoted (object)
  (list 'quote object))

(defun putnam-1988-b3-and-terms (terms)
  (if (consp terms)
      (list
       'if
       (car terms)
       (putnam-1988-b3-and-terms (cdr terms))
       (putnam-1988-b3-quoted nil))
    (putnam-1988-b3-quoted t)))

(defun putnam-1988-b3-implies-term (hypothesis conclusion)
  (list
   'if
   hypothesis
   conclusion
   (putnam-1988-b3-quoted t)))

(defun putnam-1988-b3-not-term (term)
  (list
   'if
   term
   (putnam-1988-b3-quoted nil)
   (putnam-1988-b3-quoted t)))

(defun putnam-1988-b3-add-term (left right)
  (list 'binary-+ left right))

(defun putnam-1988-b3-negate-term (value)
  (list 'unary-- value))

(defun putnam-1988-b3-subtract-term (left right)
  (putnam-1988-b3-add-term
   left
   (putnam-1988-b3-negate-term right)))

(defun putnam-1988-b3-multiply-term (left right)
  (list 'binary-* left right))

(defun putnam-1988-b3-square-term (value)
  (putnam-1988-b3-multiply-term value value))

(defun putnam-1988-b3-less-equal-term (left right)
  (list
   'if
   (list '< right left)
   (putnam-1988-b3-quoted nil)
   (putnam-1988-b3-quoted t)))

;; This generated term is true exactly when a+b*sqrt(3) is nonnegative.
(defun putnam-1988-b3-q3-nonnegative-term (a b)
  (let ((zero
         (putnam-1988-b3-quoted 0))
        (a-square
         (putnam-1988-b3-square-term a))
        (three-b-square
         (putnam-1988-b3-multiply-term
          (putnam-1988-b3-quoted 3)
          (putnam-1988-b3-square-term b))))
    (list
     'if
     (list '< b zero)
     (list
      'if
      (list '< zero a)
      (list '< three-b-square a-square)
      (putnam-1988-b3-quoted nil))
     (list
      'if
      (list '< zero b)
      (list
       'if
       (list '< a zero)
       (list '< a-square three-b-square)
       (putnam-1988-b3-quoted t))
      (putnam-1988-b3-less-equal-term zero a)))))

(defun putnam-1988-b3-positive-integer-term (value)
  (putnam-1988-b3-and-terms
   (list
    (list 'integerp value)
    (putnam-1988-b3-less-equal-term
     (putnam-1988-b3-quoted 1)
     value))))

;; For x=c-d*sqrt(3), |x| <= a+b*sqrt(3) is the conjunction
;; x <= a+b*sqrt(3) and -x <= a+b*sqrt(3).
(defun putnam-1988-b3-absolute-bound-term
    (c d bound-a bound-b)
  (putnam-1988-b3-and-terms
   (list
    (putnam-1988-b3-q3-nonnegative-term
     (putnam-1988-b3-subtract-term bound-a c)
     (putnam-1988-b3-add-term bound-b d))
    (putnam-1988-b3-q3-nonnegative-term
     (putnam-1988-b3-add-term bound-a c)
     (putnam-1988-b3-subtract-term bound-b d)))))

(defun putnam-1988-b3-singleton-term (value)
  (list
   'cons
   value
   (putnam-1988-b3-quoted nil)))

(defun putnam-1988-b3-index-range-term (n)
  (list
   'from-to-by
   (putnam-1988-b3-quoted 0)
   n
   (putnam-1988-b3-quoted 1)))

(defun putnam-1988-b3-finite-exists-term
    (witness-function n)
  (list
   'thereis$+
   (putnam-1988-b3-quoted witness-function)
   (putnam-1988-b3-singleton-term n)
   (putnam-1988-b3-index-range-term n)))

(defun putnam-1988-b3-true-function ()
  (list
   'lambda
   '(n)
   (putnam-1988-b3-quoted t)))

(defun putnam-1988-b3-false-function ()
  (list
   'lambda
   '(n)
   (putnam-1988-b3-quoted nil)))

;; For positive n, FROM-TO-BY enumerates exactly d=0,...,n and c=n-d.
;; THEREIS$+ therefore retains the source's finite existential quantifier
;; without nesting an unbounded FN-EQUAL quantifier inside a generated lambda.
(defun putnam-1988-b3-solution-witness-function ()
  (let* ((n
          (list 'car 'globals))
         (c
          (putnam-1988-b3-subtract-term n 'd)))
    (list
     'lambda
     '(globals d)
     (putnam-1988-b3-absolute-bound-term
      c
      'd
      (putnam-1988-b3-quoted 1/2)
      (putnam-1988-b3-quoted 1/2)))))

(defun putnam-1988-b3-solution-upper-function ()
  (let ((witness-function
         (putnam-1988-b3-solution-witness-function)))
    (list
     'lambda
     '(n)
     (putnam-1988-b3-implies-term
      (putnam-1988-b3-positive-integer-term 'n)
      (putnam-1988-b3-finite-exists-term
       witness-function
       'n)))))

(defun putnam-1988-b3-solution-is-upper-p ()
  (let ((witness-function
         (putnam-1988-b3-solution-witness-function))
        (upper-function
         (putnam-1988-b3-solution-upper-function)))
    (and
     (tamep-functionp witness-function)
     (tamep-functionp upper-function)
     (fn-equal
      upper-function
      (putnam-1988-b3-true-function)))))

;; The source hypothesis uniquely determines r(n) as the finite minimum over
;; d=0,...,n. Thus r(n)>g exactly when no enumerated d has absolute value <=g.
(defun putnam-1988-b3-below-bound-witness-function (g)
  (let* ((n
          (list 'car 'globals))
         (c
          (putnam-1988-b3-subtract-term n 'd)))
    (list
     'lambda
     '(globals d)
     (putnam-1988-b3-absolute-bound-term
      c
      'd
      (putnam-1988-b3-quoted g)
      (putnam-1988-b3-quoted 0)))))

(defun putnam-1988-b3-lower-counterexample-function (g)
  (let ((witness-function
         (putnam-1988-b3-below-bound-witness-function g)))
    (list
     'lambda
     '(n)
     (putnam-1988-b3-and-terms
      (list
       (putnam-1988-b3-positive-integer-term 'n)
       (putnam-1988-b3-not-term
        (putnam-1988-b3-finite-exists-term
         witness-function
         'n)))))))

(defun putnam-1988-b3-lower-counterexample-exists-p (g)
  (let ((witness-function
         (putnam-1988-b3-below-bound-witness-function g))
        (counterexample-function
         (putnam-1988-b3-lower-counterexample-function g)))
    (and
     (tamep-functionp witness-function)
     (tamep-functionp counterexample-function)
     (not
      (fn-equal
       counterexample-function
       (putnam-1988-b3-false-function))))))

;; It is enough, and is equivalent, to test rational lower candidates g.
;; If a real g<(1+sqrt(3))/2 were an upper bound, rational density would give
;; a rational q strictly between g and the proposed least bound; q would also
;; be an upper bound. Conversely, every rational upper bound is a real one.
(defun putnambench-putnam-1988-b3-statement (g)
  (and
   (putnam-1988-b3-q3-positive-p 1/2 1/2)
   (putnam-1988-b3-solution-is-upper-p)
   (implies
    (and
     (rationalp g)
     (< 0 g)
     (putnam-1988-b3-q3-positive-p
      (- 1/2 g)
      1/2))
    (putnam-1988-b3-lower-counterexample-exists-p g))))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

title: putnam_1988_b3
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench artifact
-- putnambench__agda__putnam_1988_b3: the minimum of |c - d * sqrt 3| over
-- nonnegative integer pairs with c + d = n has least positive uniform upper
-- bound (1 + sqrt 3) / 2. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Int using (Int; pos; negsuc)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; _*_)

infix 4 _!=_ _<=N_ _<=Z_
infixr 3 _and_
infixr 2 _or_

data Bottom : Set where

Not : Set -> Set
Not A =
  A -> Bottom

_!=_ : {A : Set} -> A -> A -> Set
x != y =
  Not (x == y)

record _and_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data _or_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  left  : A -> A or B
  right : B -> A or B

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

data _<=N_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set where
  zero<=N   : {n : Nat} -> zero <=N n
  suc<=sucN : {m n : Nat} -> m <=N n -> suc m <=N suc n

data _<=Z_ : Int -> Int -> Set where
  negative<=positive :
    {m n : Nat} ->
    negsuc m <=Z pos n
  positive<=positive :
    {m n : Nat} ->
    m <=N n ->
    pos m <=Z pos n
  negative<=negative :
    {m n : Nat} ->
    n <=N m ->
    negsuc m <=Z negsuc n

difference : Nat -> Nat -> Int
difference zero zero =
  pos zero
difference (suc m) zero =
  pos (suc m)
difference zero (suc n) =
  negsuc n
difference (suc m) (suc n) =
  difference m n

addInt : Int -> Int -> Int
addInt (pos m) (pos n) =
  pos (m + n)
addInt (pos m) (negsuc n) =
  difference m (suc n)
addInt (negsuc m) (pos n) =
  difference n (suc m)
addInt (negsuc m) (negsuc n) =
  negsuc (suc (m + n))

record CompleteOrderedRealField (R : Set) : Set1 where
  field
    zeroR oneR : R
    add multiply : R -> R -> R
    negate inverse squareRoot : R -> R
    lessOrEqual : R -> R -> Set
    fromNat : Nat -> R

    one-not-zero :
      oneR != zeroR

    add-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> add x y == add y x
    add-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      add (add x y) z == add x (add y z)
    add-zero :
      (x : R) -> add x zeroR == x
    add-inverse :
      (x : R) -> add x (negate x) == zeroR

    multiply-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> multiply x y == multiply y x
    multiply-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply (multiply x y) z ==
      multiply x (multiply y z)
    multiply-one :
      (x : R) -> multiply x oneR == x
    multiply-zero :
      (x : R) -> multiply x zeroR == zeroR
    distribute :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply x (add y z) ==
      add (multiply x y) (multiply x z)
    inverse-zero :
      inverse zeroR == zeroR
    multiply-inverse :
      (x : R) ->
      x != zeroR ->
      multiply x (inverse x) == oneR

    order-reflexive :
      (x : R) -> lessOrEqual x x
    order-transitive :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y z ->
      lessOrEqual x z
    order-antisymmetric :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y x ->
      x == y
    order-total :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y or lessOrEqual y x
    add-order :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual (add z x) (add z y)
    multiply-nonnegative :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR x ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR y ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR (multiply x y)
    zero-less-than-one :
      lessOrEqual zeroR oneR and zeroR != oneR

    fromNat-zero :
      fromNat zero == zeroR
    fromNat-successor :
      (n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (suc n) == add (fromNat n) oneR
    fromNat-addition :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m + n) == add (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-multiplication :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m * n) == multiply (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-injective :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat m == fromNat n ->
      m == n

    archimedean :
      (x : R) ->
      Exists Nat (\ n -> lessOrEqual x (fromNat n))
    least-upper-bound :
      (P : R -> Set) ->
      Exists R P ->
      Exists R
        (\ upper ->
          (x : R) ->
          P x ->
          lessOrEqual x upper) ->
      Exists R
        (\ supremum ->
          ((x : R) ->
            P x ->
            lessOrEqual x supremum)
          and
          ((upper : R) ->
            ((x : R) ->
              P x ->
              lessOrEqual x upper) ->
            lessOrEqual supremum upper))

    square-root-nonnegative :
      (x : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR (squareRoot x)
    square-root-square :
      (x : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR x ->
      multiply (squareRoot x) (squareRoot x) == x
    square-root-nonpositive :
      (x : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x zeroR ->
      squareRoot x == zeroR
    square-root-unique :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR y ->
      multiply y y == x ->
      y == squareRoot x

open CompleteOrderedRealField

zeroZ : Int
zeroZ =
  pos zero

oneZ : Int
oneZ =
  pos (suc zero)

oneN : Nat
oneN =
  suc zero

twoN : Nat
twoN =
  suc oneN

threeN : Nat
threeN =
  suc twoN

fromInt :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Int ->
  R
fromInt reals (pos n) =
  fromNat reals n
fromInt reals (negsuc n) =
  negate reals (fromNat reals (suc n))

subtract :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
subtract reals x y =
  add reals x (negate reals y)

divide :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
divide reals x y =
  multiply reals x (inverse reals y)

maximum :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
maximum reals x y with order-total reals x y
... | left _ = y
... | right _ = x

absoluteValue :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R
absoluteValue reals x =
  maximum reals x (negate reals x)

StrictLess :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
StrictLess reals x y =
  lessOrEqual reals x y and x != y

module Putnam1988B3Statement
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) where

  sqrtThree : R
  sqrtThree =
    squareRoot reals (fromNat reals threeN)

  solution : R
  solution =
    divide reals
      (add reals (oneR reals) sqrtThree)
      (fromNat reals twoN)

  PairValue :
    Int ->
    Int ->
    R
  PairValue c d =
    absoluteValue reals
      (subtract reals
        (fromInt reals c)
        (multiply reals
          (fromInt reals d)
          sqrtThree))

  IsMinimumValue :
    (Int -> R) ->
    Set
  IsMinimumValue r =
    (n : Int) ->
    oneZ <=Z n ->
    Exists Int
      (\ c ->
        Exists Int
          (\ d ->
            zeroZ <=Z c
            and zeroZ <=Z d
            and addInt c d == n
            and r n == PairValue c d))
    and
    ((c d : Int) ->
      zeroZ <=Z c ->
      zeroZ <=Z d ->
      addInt c d == n ->
      lessOrEqual reals (r n) (PairValue c d))

  IsLeastPositiveUniformUpperBound :
    (Int -> R) ->
    R ->
    Set
  IsLeastPositiveUniformUpperBound r bound =
    StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) bound
    and
    ((n : Int) ->
      oneZ <=Z n ->
      lessOrEqual reals (r n) bound)
    and
    ((g : R) ->
      StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) g ->
      ((n : Int) ->
        oneZ <=Z n ->
        lessOrEqual reals (r n) g) ->
      lessOrEqual reals bound g)

  proposition : Set
  proposition =
    (r : Int -> R) ->
    IsMinimumValue r ->
    IsLeastPositiveUniformUpperBound r solution

putnam-1988-b3 : Set1
putnam-1988-b3 =
  (R : Set) ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) ->
  Putnam1988B3Statement.proposition reals

title: putnam_1988_b3
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1988_b3:
  the least positive uniform upper bound for the minima of
  |c - d * sqrt 3| over nonnegative integer pairs with fixed positive sum is
  (1 + sqrt 3) / 2. This file contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open integerTheory realTheory intrealTheory transcTheory;

val putnam_1988_b3 =
  ``!r : int -> real.
      (!n : int.
         1 <= n
         ==>
         (?c d : int.
            0 <= c /\ 0 <= d /\ c + d = n /\
            r n =
              abs
                (real_of_int c -
                 real_of_int d * sqrt 3)) /\
         (!c d : int.
            0 <= c /\ 0 <= d /\ c + d = n
            ==>
            r n <=
              abs
                (real_of_int c -
                 real_of_int d * sqrt 3)))
      ==>
      let solution = (1 + sqrt 3) / 2
      in
        0 < solution /\
        (!n : int. 1 <= n ==> r n <= solution) /\
        (!g : real.
           0 < g /\
           (!n : int. 1 <= n ==> r n <= g)
           ==>
           solution <= g)``;

title: putnam_1988_b3
content:
$(
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact
  putnam_1988_b3: the least positive uniform upper bound for the minima of
  |c - d sqrt(3)| over nonnegative integers c,d with fixed positive sum is
  (1 + sqrt(3)) / 2. This file contains no proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  F ranges over all total real-valued functions on the integers. For every
  positive integer n, the antecedent says both that F(n) is attained by some
  nonnegative integers c,d with c+d=n and that F(n) is no greater than every
  value from such a pair. Thus F(n) is exactly the source minimum r_n.

  The conclusion expands IsLeast for (1 + sqrt(3))/2: this number is positive,
  bounds every F(n), and is at most every other positive real uniform bound.
  Restricting n to NN and c,d to NN0 is equivalent to the source integer
  inequalities n>=1 and c,d>=0. Set.mm's principal square root and complex
  modulus agree with the real square root and real absolute value here.

  The final declaration is the single unproved $a corpus statement; this
  database contains no $p proof statement.
$)

${
  $d F c d g n $.

  putnambench-putnam-1988-b3 $a |- A. F e. ( RR ^m ZZ )
    (
      A. n e. NN
        (
          (
            E. c e. NN0 E. d e. NN0
              (
                ( c + d ) = n
                /\
                ( F ` n )
                =
                ( abs ` ( c - ( d x. ( sqrt ` 3 ) ) ) )
              )
          )
          /\
          A. c e. NN0 A. d e. NN0
            (
              ( c + d ) = n
              ->
              ( F ` n )
              <_
              ( abs ` ( c - ( d x. ( sqrt ` 3 ) ) ) )
            )
        )
      ->
      (
        (
          0 < ( ( 1 + ( sqrt ` 3 ) ) / 2 )
          /\
          A. n e. NN
            ( F ` n ) <_ ( ( 1 + ( sqrt ` 3 ) ) / 2 )
        )
        /\
        A. g e. RR
          (
            (
              0 < g
              /\
              A. n e. NN ( F ` n ) <_ g
            )
            ->
            ( ( 1 + ( sqrt ` 3 ) ) / 2 ) <_ g
          )
      )
    )
  $.
$}

content:
:: Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1988_b3:
:: the least positive uniform upper bound for the minima of |c-d*sqrt(3)|
:: over nonnegative integer pairs with fixed positive sum. This file contains
:: no proof.

environ
  vocabularies TARSKI, XBOOLE_0, SUBSET_1, RELAT_1, FUNCT_1, FUNCT_2,
    PARTFUN1, NUMBERS, XREAL_0, XCMPLX_0, COMPLEX1, CARD_1, XXREAL_0,
    ARYTM_1,
    ARYTM_3, SQUARE_1, REAL_1, INT_1, NAT_1, VALUED_1;
  notations TARSKI, XBOOLE_0, SUBSET_1, RELAT_1, FUNCT_1, PARTFUN1,
    RELSET_1, FUNCT_2, ORDINAL1, NUMBERS, XCMPLX_0, XREAL_0, REAL_1,
    INT_1, COMPLEX1, SQUARE_1, XXREAL_0;
  constructors FUNCT_1, PARTFUN1, RELSET_1, FUNCT_2, REAL_1, SQUARE_1,
    COMPLEX1, INT_1, XXREAL_0;
  registrations XBOOLE_0, SUBSET_1, RELAT_1, FUNCT_1, PARTFUN1, RELSET_1,
    FUNCT_2, NUMBERS, XXREAL_0, MEMBERED, VALUED_0, VALUED_1,
    XCMPLX_0, XREAL_0, SQUARE_1, ORDINAL1, NAT_1, INT_1;
  requirements REAL, NUMERALS, SUBSET, BOOLE, ARITHM;

begin

::$P-
theorem
  for r being Function of INT,REAL st
    (for n being Integer st n >= 1 holds
      (ex c,d being Integer st
        c >= 0 & d >= 0 & c + d = n &
        r/.n = |.(c qua Real) - (d qua Real) * sqrt 3.|) &
      (for c,d being Integer st
        c >= 0 & d >= 0 & c + d = n
      holds
        |.(c qua Real) - (d qua Real) * sqrt 3.| >= r/.n))
  holds
    (1 + sqrt 3) / 2 > 0 &
    (for n being Integer st n >= 1 holds
      r/.n <= (1 + sqrt 3) / 2) &
    (for g being Real st
      g > 0 &
      (for n being Integer st n >= 1 holds r/.n <= g)
    holds
      g >= (1 + sqrt 3) / 2)
proof
end;
::$P+

title: putnam_1988_b3
content:
% Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1988_b3:
% for each positive integer n, r(n) is the minimum of |c - d*sqrt(3)| over
% nonnegative integers c,d with c+d=n, and the least positive uniform upper
% bound of these minima is (1+sqrt(3))/2. This file contains no proof.

putnam_1988_b3: THEORY
BEGIN
  integer_real_function: TYPE = [int -> real]

  sqrt_value(root, radicand: real): bool =
    0 <= root AND root * root = radicand

  is_minimum_for_index(
      r: integer_real_function,
      n: int,
      sqrt_three: real): bool =
    (EXISTS (c, d: int):
      c >= 0
        AND d >= 0
        AND c + d = n
        AND r(n) =
          abs((c :: real) - (d :: real) * sqrt_three))
      AND
        (FORALL (c, d: int):
          (c >= 0 AND d >= 0 AND c + d = n)
            IMPLIES
              r(n) <=
                abs((c :: real) - (d :: real) * sqrt_three))

  positive_uniform_upper_bound(
      r: integer_real_function,
      bound: real): bool =
    bound > 0
      AND FORALL (n: int):
        n >= 1 IMPLIES r(n) <= bound

  least_positive_uniform_upper_bound(
      r: integer_real_function,
      value: real): bool =
    positive_uniform_upper_bound(r, value)
      AND FORALL (bound: real):
        positive_uniform_upper_bound(r, bound)
          IMPLIES value <= bound

  putnam_1988_b3_solution(sqrt_three: real): real =
    (1 + sqrt_three) / 2

  putnam_1988_b3: bool =
    EXISTS (sqrt_three: real):
      sqrt_value(sqrt_three, 3)
        AND FORALL (r: integer_real_function):
          (FORALL (n: int):
            n >= 1 IMPLIES
              is_minimum_for_index(r, n, sqrt_three))
            IMPLIES
              least_positive_uniform_upper_bound(
                r, putnam_1988_b3_solution(sqrt_three))
END putnam_1988_b3

import Mathlib

open Set Filter Topology

/--
Prove that if $\sum_{n=1}^\infty a_n$ is a convergent series of positive real numbers, then so is $\sum_{n=1}^\infty (a_n)^{n/(n+1)}$.
-/
theorem putnam_1988_b4
    (a : ℕ → ℝ)
    (IsPosConv : (ℕ → ℝ) → Prop)
    (IsPosConv_def : ∀ a' : ℕ → ℝ, IsPosConv a' ↔
      (∀ n ≥ 1, a' n > 0) ∧
      (∃ s : ℝ, Tendsto (fun N : ℕ => ∑ n : Set.Icc 1 N, a' n) atTop (𝓝 s))) :
    (IsPosConv a) → IsPosConv (fun n : ℕ => (a n) ^ ((n : ℝ) / (n + 1))) :=
  sorry

Require Import Reals Coquelicot.Coquelicot.
Open Scope R.
Theorem putnam_1988_b4
    (a : nat -> R)
    (appos : (nat -> R) -> Prop := fun a' : nat -> R => forall n : nat, ge n 1 -> a' n > 0)
    (apconv : (nat -> R) -> Prop := fun a' : nat -> R => ex_finite_lim_seq (fun N => sum_n_m a' 1 N))
    (apposconv : (nat -> R) -> Prop := fun a' => appos a' /\ apconv a')
    : apposconv a -> apposconv (fun n => Rpower (a n) (INR n/(INR n + 1))).
Proof. Admitted.

theorem putnam_1988_b4:
  fixes a :: "nat \<Rightarrow> real"
  and appos :: "(nat \<Rightarrow> real) \<Rightarrow> bool"
  and apconv :: "(nat \<Rightarrow> real) \<Rightarrow> bool"
  and apposconv :: "(nat \<Rightarrow> real) \<Rightarrow> bool"
  defines "appos \<equiv> \<lambda> a' :: nat \<Rightarrow> real. \<forall> n \<ge> 1. a' n > 0"
  and "apconv \<equiv> \<lambda> a' :: nat \<Rightarrow> real. convergent (\<lambda> N :: nat. \<Sum> n = 1..N. a' n)"
  and "apposconv \<equiv> \<lambda> a'. appos a' \<and> apconv a'"
  shows "apposconv a \<longrightarrow> apposconv (\<lambda> n :: nat. (a n) powr (n / (n + 1)))" 
  sorry

end

title: putnam_1988_b4
putnam_1988_b4
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1988_b4:
;; a positive real series remains convergent after replacing each term a_n by
;; a_n raised to the exponent n/(n+1). This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))

;; The real numbers are presented as an arbitrary Dedekind-complete ordered
;; field. Sequences, subsets, and operations are tame APPLY$ function objects,
;; so none is replaced by a finite table. For positive x, the value
;; x^(n/(n+1)) is characterized equivalently as the unique positive y such
;; that y^(n+1) = x^n.

(defun p88b4-member-p (carrier x)
  (if (apply$ carrier (list x)) t nil))

(defun p88b4-unary (operation x)
  (apply$ operation (list x)))

(defun p88b4-binary (operation x y)
  (apply$ operation (list x y)))

(defun p88b4-positive-p (carrier less zero x)
  (and
   (p88b4-member-p carrier x)
   (apply$ less (list zero x))))

(defun-sk p88b4-field-laws-p
    (carrier add multiply negate inverse zero one)
  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (p88b4-member-p carrier x)
      (p88b4-member-p carrier y)
      (p88b4-member-p carrier z))
     (and
      (p88b4-member-p carrier
                      (p88b4-binary add x y))
      (p88b4-member-p carrier
                      (p88b4-binary multiply x y))
      (p88b4-member-p carrier
                      (p88b4-unary negate x))
      (p88b4-member-p carrier
                      (p88b4-unary inverse x))
      (equal
       (p88b4-binary add (p88b4-binary add x y) z)
       (p88b4-binary add x (p88b4-binary add y z)))
      (equal (p88b4-binary add x y)
             (p88b4-binary add y x))
      (equal (p88b4-binary add x zero) x)
      (equal (p88b4-binary add x (p88b4-unary negate x))
             zero)
      (equal
       (p88b4-binary multiply
                     (p88b4-binary multiply x y)
                     z)
       (p88b4-binary multiply
                     x
                     (p88b4-binary multiply y z)))
      (equal (p88b4-binary multiply x y)
             (p88b4-binary multiply y x))
      (equal (p88b4-binary multiply x one) x)
      (implies
       (equal x zero)
       (equal (p88b4-unary inverse x) zero))
      (implies
       (not (equal x zero))
       (equal
        (p88b4-binary multiply
                      x
                      (p88b4-unary inverse x))
        one))
      (equal
       (p88b4-binary multiply
                     x
                     (p88b4-binary add y z))
       (p88b4-binary
        add
        (p88b4-binary multiply x y)
        (p88b4-binary multiply x z)))))))

(defun-sk p88b4-order-laws-p
    (carrier add multiply zero less)
  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (p88b4-member-p carrier x)
      (p88b4-member-p carrier y)
      (p88b4-member-p carrier z))
     (and
      (not (apply$ less (list x x)))
      (or
       (equal x y)
       (apply$ less (list x y))
       (apply$ less (list y x)))
      (implies
       (and
        (apply$ less (list x y))
        (apply$ less (list y z)))
       (apply$ less (list x z)))
      (implies
       (apply$ less (list x y))
       (apply$
        less
        (list
         (p88b4-binary add x z)
         (p88b4-binary add y z))))
      (implies
       (and
        (apply$ less (list zero x))
        (apply$ less (list zero y)))
       (apply$
        less
        (list zero
              (p88b4-binary multiply x y))))))))

(defun-sk p88b4-set-nonempty-p (carrier set)
  (exists (x)
    (and
     (p88b4-member-p carrier x)
     (apply$ set (list x)))))

(defun-sk p88b4-upper-bound-p (carrier less set bound)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (and
      (p88b4-member-p carrier x)
      (apply$ set (list x)))
     (not (apply$ less (list bound x))))))

(defun-sk p88b4-bounded-above-p (carrier less set)
  (exists (bound)
    (and
     (p88b4-member-p carrier bound)
     (p88b4-upper-bound-p carrier less set bound))))

(defun-sk p88b4-least-upper-bound-p
    (carrier less set supremum)
  (forall (bound)
    (implies
     (and
      (p88b4-member-p carrier bound)
      (p88b4-upper-bound-p carrier less set bound))
     (not (apply$ less (list bound supremum))))))

(defun p88b4-supremum-p (carrier less set supremum)
  (and
   (p88b4-member-p carrier supremum)
   (p88b4-upper-bound-p carrier less set supremum)
   (p88b4-least-upper-bound-p
    carrier less set supremum)))

(defun-sk p88b4-has-supremum-p (carrier less set)
  (exists (supremum)
    (p88b4-supremum-p carrier less set supremum)))

(defun-sk p88b4-dedekind-complete-p (carrier less)
  (forall (set)
    (implies
     (and
      (tamep-functionp set)
      (p88b4-set-nonempty-p carrier set)
      (p88b4-bounded-above-p carrier less set))
     (p88b4-has-supremum-p carrier less set))))

(defun p88b4-real-field-p
    (carrier add multiply negate inverse zero one less)
  (and
   (tamep-functionp carrier)
   (tamep-functionp add)
   (tamep-functionp multiply)
   (tamep-functionp negate)
   (tamep-functionp inverse)
   (tamep-functionp less)
   (p88b4-member-p carrier zero)
   (p88b4-member-p carrier one)
   (not (equal zero one))
   (p88b4-field-laws-p
    carrier add multiply negate inverse zero one)
   (p88b4-order-laws-p
    carrier add multiply zero less)
   (apply$ less (list zero one))
   (p88b4-dedekind-complete-p carrier less)))

(defun p88b4-field-power (base exponent one multiply)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix exponent)))
  (if (zp exponent)
      one
    (p88b4-binary
     multiply
     base
     (p88b4-field-power
      base (1- exponent) one multiply))))

(defun-sk p88b4-fractional-power-laws-p
    (carrier multiply zero one less fractional-power)
  (forall (x n)
    (implies
     (and
      (p88b4-positive-p carrier less zero x)
      (natp n))
     (let ((y (apply$ fractional-power (list x n))))
       (and
        (p88b4-positive-p carrier less zero y)
        (equal
         (p88b4-field-power
          y (+ n 1) one multiply)
         (p88b4-field-power
          x n one multiply)))))))

(defun p88b4-fractional-power-operation-p
    (carrier multiply zero one less fractional-power)
  (and
   (tamep-functionp fractional-power)
   (p88b4-fractional-power-laws-p
    carrier multiply zero one less fractional-power)))

(defun p88b4-term
    (sequence fractional-power one transformedp n)
  (if transformedp
      (if (zp n)
          one
        (apply$
         fractional-power
         (list (apply$ sequence (list n)) n)))
    (apply$ sequence (list n))))

(defun-sk p88b4-sequence-values-p
    (carrier sequence fractional-power one transformedp)
  (forall (n)
    (implies
     (natp n)
     (p88b4-member-p
      carrier
      (p88b4-term
       sequence fractional-power one transformedp n)))))

(defun-sk p88b4-positive-terms-p
    (carrier less zero sequence fractional-power one transformedp)
  (forall (n)
    (implies
     (and
      (natp n)
      (<= 1 n))
     (p88b4-positive-p
      carrier less zero
      (p88b4-term
       sequence fractional-power one transformedp n)))))

(defun p88b4-partial-sum
    (count sequence fractional-power transformedp
     zero one add)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix count)))
  (if (zp count)
      zero
    (p88b4-binary
     add
     (p88b4-partial-sum
      (1- count)
      sequence fractional-power transformedp
      zero one add)
     (p88b4-term
      sequence fractional-power one transformedp count))))

(defun p88b4-absolute-value (zero negate less x)
  (if (apply$ less (list x zero))
      (p88b4-unary negate x)
    x))

(defun p88b4-distance
    (add negate zero less x y)
  (p88b4-absolute-value
   zero negate less
   (p88b4-binary
    add x (p88b4-unary negate y))))

(defun-sk p88b4-convergence-tail-p
    (sequence fractional-power transformedp
     zero one add negate less limit epsilon cutoff)
  (forall (n)
    (implies
     (and
      (natp n)
      (<= cutoff n))
     (apply$
      less
      (list
       (p88b4-distance
        add negate zero less
        (p88b4-partial-sum
         n sequence fractional-power transformedp
         zero one add)
        limit)
       epsilon)))))

(defun-sk p88b4-convergence-cutoff-exists-p
    (sequence fractional-power transformedp
     zero one add negate less limit epsilon)
  (exists (cutoff)
    (and
     (natp cutoff)
     (p88b4-convergence-tail-p
      sequence fractional-power transformedp
      zero one add negate less limit epsilon cutoff))))

(defun-sk p88b4-partial-sums-converge-to-p
    (carrier sequence fractional-power transformedp
     zero one add negate less limit)
  (forall (epsilon)
    (implies
     (p88b4-positive-p carrier less zero epsilon)
     (p88b4-convergence-cutoff-exists-p
      sequence fractional-power transformedp
      zero one add negate less limit epsilon))))

(defun-sk p88b4-series-limit-exists-p
    (carrier sequence fractional-power transformedp
     zero one add negate less)
  (exists (limit)
    (and
     (p88b4-member-p carrier limit)
     (p88b4-partial-sums-converge-to-p
      carrier sequence fractional-power transformedp
      zero one add negate less limit))))

(defun p88b4-positive-convergent-series-p
    (carrier sequence fractional-power transformedp
     zero one add negate less)
  (and
   (tamep-functionp sequence)
   (p88b4-sequence-values-p
    carrier sequence fractional-power one transformedp)
   (p88b4-positive-terms-p
    carrier less zero
    sequence fractional-power one transformedp)
   (p88b4-series-limit-exists-p
    carrier sequence fractional-power transformedp
    zero one add negate less)))

(defun putnambench-putnam-1988-b4-statement
    (real-carrier real-add real-multiply real-negate real-inverse
     real-zero real-one real-less sequence fractional-power)
  (implies
   (and
    (p88b4-real-field-p
     real-carrier real-add real-multiply real-negate real-inverse
     real-zero real-one real-less)
    (p88b4-fractional-power-operation-p
     real-carrier real-multiply real-zero real-one real-less
     fractional-power)
    (p88b4-positive-convergent-series-p
     real-carrier sequence fractional-power nil
     real-zero real-one real-add real-negate real-less))
   (p88b4-positive-convergent-series-p
    real-carrier sequence fractional-power t
    real-zero real-one real-add real-negate real-less)))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

title: putnam_1988_b4
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1988_b4:
-- a convergent series of positive real terms remains positive and convergent
-- after raising its nth term to the real exponent n / (n + 1).
-- This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; _*_)

infix 4 _!=_ _<=N_
infixr 3 _and_
infixr 2 _or_

data Bottom : Set where

Not : Set -> Set
Not A =
  A -> Bottom

_!=_ : {A : Set} -> A -> A -> Set
x != y =
  Not (x == y)

record _and_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data _or_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  left  : A -> A or B
  right : B -> A or B

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

data _<=N_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set where
  zero<=N   : {n : Nat} -> zero <=N n
  suc<=sucN : {m n : Nat} -> m <=N n -> suc m <=N suc n

record CompleteOrderedRealField (R : Set) : Set1 where
  field
    zeroR oneR : R
    add multiply : R -> R -> R
    negate inverse : R -> R
    lessOrEqual : R -> R -> Set
    fromNat : Nat -> R

    one-not-zero :
      oneR != zeroR

    add-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> add x y == add y x
    add-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      add (add x y) z == add x (add y z)
    add-zero :
      (x : R) -> add x zeroR == x
    add-inverse :
      (x : R) -> add x (negate x) == zeroR

    multiply-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> multiply x y == multiply y x
    multiply-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply (multiply x y) z ==
      multiply x (multiply y z)
    multiply-one :
      (x : R) -> multiply x oneR == x
    multiply-zero :
      (x : R) -> multiply x zeroR == zeroR
    distribute :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply x (add y z) ==
      add (multiply x y) (multiply x z)
    inverse-zero :
      inverse zeroR == zeroR
    multiply-inverse :
      (x : R) ->
      x != zeroR ->
      multiply x (inverse x) == oneR

    order-reflexive :
      (x : R) -> lessOrEqual x x
    order-transitive :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y z ->
      lessOrEqual x z
    order-antisymmetric :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y x ->
      x == y
    order-total :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y or lessOrEqual y x
    add-order :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual (add z x) (add z y)
    multiply-nonnegative :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR x ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR y ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR (multiply x y)
    zero-less-than-one :
      lessOrEqual zeroR oneR and zeroR != oneR

    fromNat-zero :
      fromNat zero == zeroR
    fromNat-successor :
      (n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (suc n) == add (fromNat n) oneR
    fromNat-addition :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m + n) == add (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-multiplication :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m * n) == multiply (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-injective :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat m == fromNat n ->
      m == n

    archimedean :
      (x : R) ->
      Exists Nat (\ n -> lessOrEqual x (fromNat n))
    least-upper-bound :
      (P : R -> Set) ->
      Exists R P ->
      Exists R
        (\ upper ->
          (x : R) ->
          P x ->
          lessOrEqual x upper) ->
      Exists R
        (\ supremum ->
          ((x : R) ->
            P x ->
            lessOrEqual x supremum)
          and
          ((upper : R) ->
            ((x : R) ->
              P x ->
              lessOrEqual x upper) ->
            lessOrEqual supremum upper))

open CompleteOrderedRealField

oneN : Nat
oneN =
  suc zero

subtract :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
subtract reals x y =
  add reals x (negate reals y)

divide :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
divide reals x y =
  multiply reals x (inverse reals y)

StrictLess :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
StrictLess reals x y =
  lessOrEqual reals x y and x != y

CloseTo :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
CloseTo reals center radius x =
  StrictLess reals
    (subtract reals center radius)
    x
  and
  StrictLess reals
    x
    (add reals center radius)

sumFirst :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Nat ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  R
sumFirst reals zero term =
  zeroR reals
sumFirst reals (suc n) term =
  add reals
    (sumFirst reals n term)
    (term n)

sumFromOneThrough :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  Nat ->
  R
sumFromOneThrough reals term zero =
  zeroR reals
sumFromOneThrough reals term (suc n) =
  add reals
    (sumFromOneThrough reals term n)
    (term (suc n))

ConvergesTo :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  R ->
  Set
ConvergesTo {R} reals sequence limit =
  (epsilon : R) ->
  StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) epsilon ->
  Exists Nat
    (\ cutoff ->
      (n : Nat) ->
      cutoff <=N n ->
      CloseTo reals limit epsilon (sequence n))

Converges :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  Set
Converges {R} reals sequence =
  Exists R
    (\ limit -> ConvergesTo reals sequence limit)

SeriesConvergesFromOne :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  Set
SeriesConvergesFromOne reals term =
  Converges reals
    (sumFromOneThrough reals term)

naturalPower :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  Nat ->
  R
naturalPower reals x zero =
  oneR reals
naturalPower reals x (suc n) =
  multiply reals
    (naturalPower reals x n)
    x

factorial : Nat -> Nat
factorial zero =
  oneN
factorial (suc n) =
  suc n * factorial n

exponentialTerm :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  Nat ->
  R
exponentialTerm reals x n =
  divide reals
    (naturalPower reals x n)
    (fromNat reals (factorial n))

ExponentialValue :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
ExponentialValue reals x value =
  ConvergesTo reals
    (\ n -> sumFirst reals n (exponentialTerm reals x))
    value

record StandardRealPowers
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) :
  Set1 where

  field
    exponential logarithm : R -> R

    exponential-series :
      (x : R) ->
      ExponentialValue reals x (exponential x)

    exponential-positive :
      (x : R) ->
      StrictLess reals
        (zeroR reals)
        (exponential x)

    exponential-injective :
      (x y : R) ->
      exponential x == exponential y ->
      x == y

    exponential-logarithm :
      (x : R) ->
      StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) x ->
      exponential (logarithm x) == x

open StandardRealPowers

realPower :
  {R : Set} ->
  {reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R} ->
  StandardRealPowers reals ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
realPower {reals = reals} powers base exponent =
  exponential powers
    (multiply reals exponent (logarithm powers base))

PositiveSequence :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  Set
PositiveSequence reals a =
  (n : Nat) ->
  oneN <=N n ->
  StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) (a n)

PositiveConvergentSeries :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  Set
PositiveConvergentSeries reals a =
  PositiveSequence reals a
  and
  SeriesConvergesFromOne reals a

module Putnam1988B4Statement
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R)
  (powers : StandardRealPowers reals) where

  transformedTerm : (Nat -> R) -> Nat -> R
  transformedTerm a n =
    realPower powers
      (a n)
      (divide reals
        (fromNat reals n)
        (fromNat reals (suc n)))

  proposition : Set
  proposition =
    (a : Nat -> R) ->
    PositiveConvergentSeries reals a ->
    PositiveConvergentSeries reals (transformedTerm a)

putnam-1988-b4 : Set1
putnam-1988-b4 =
  (R : Set) ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) ->
  (powers : StandardRealPowers reals) ->
  Putnam1988B4Statement.proposition reals powers

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open arithmeticTheory pred_setTheory realTheory real_sigmaTheory;

val putnam_1988_b4 =

        (?s : real.
           ((\N : num.
               SIGMA a (IMAGE SUC (count N))) --> s) sequentially)
    in

  convergent series of positive terms after replacing a_n by

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  A ranges over every total real-valued sequence indexed by the nonnegative
  integers. Positivity is required at exactly the positive indices, and each
  existential real limit together with set.mm's real-sequence convergence
  relation expresses convergence of the partial sums from 1 through n.

  Since every base occurring in either series is positive, set.mm's complex
  power A(n) ^c (n/(n+1)) agrees with the source real power. Inlining the

  equivalence. The final declaration is the single unproved $a corpus

${
  $d A B C k n $.

  putnambench-putnam-1988-b4 $a |- A. A e. ( RR ^m NN0 )

title: putnam_1988_b4
content:
% Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1988_b4:
% a convergent series of positive real terms remains convergent after raising
% its nth term to the real exponent n/(n+1). This file contains no proof.

putnam_1988_b4: THEORY
BEGIN
  real_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> real]

  safe_div(numerator, denominator: real): real =
    IF denominator = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      numerator / denominator
    ENDIF

  converges_to(sequence: real_sequence, value: real): bool =
    FORALL (epsilon_value: posreal):
      EXISTS (cutoff: nat):
        FORALL (index: nat):
          cutoff <= index IMPLIES
            abs(sequence(index) - value) < epsilon_value

  nat_factorial(index: nat): RECURSIVE nat =
    IF index = 0 THEN
      1
    ELSE
      index * nat_factorial(index - 1)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE index

  exponential_partial(x: real, count: nat): RECURSIVE real =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      LET index: nat = count - 1 IN
        exponential_partial(x, count - 1)
          + safe_div(
              x ^ index,
              nat_factorial(index) :: real)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  real_exponential(x: real): real =
    epsilon(
      LAMBDA (value: real):
        converges_to(
          LAMBDA (count: nat):
            exponential_partial(x, count),
          value))

  natural_log(x: real): real =
    IF x > 0 THEN
      epsilon(
        LAMBDA (value: real):
          real_exponential(value) = x)
    ELSE
      0
    ENDIF

  real_power(base, exponent: real): real =
    IF base > 0 THEN
      real_exponential(exponent * natural_log(base))
    ELSIF base = 0 AND exponent = 0 THEN
      1
    ELSE
      0
    ENDIF

  series_partial_sum(
      values: real_sequence,
      upper_index: nat): RECURSIVE real =
    IF upper_index = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      series_partial_sum(values, upper_index - 1)
        + values(upper_index)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE upper_index

  series_converges(values: real_sequence): bool =
    EXISTS (total: real):
      converges_to(
        LAMBDA (upper_index: nat):
          series_partial_sum(values, upper_index),
        total)

  positive_from_one(values: real_sequence): bool =
    FORALL (index: nat):
      index >= 1 IMPLIES values(index) > 0

  positive_convergent(values: real_sequence): bool =
    positive_from_one(values) AND series_converges(values)

  transformed(values: real_sequence): real_sequence =
    LAMBDA (index: nat):
      real_power(
        values(index),
        safe_div(index :: real, (index + 1) :: real))

  putnam_1988_b4: bool =
    FORALL (a: real_sequence):
      positive_convergent(a)
        IMPLIES positive_convergent(transformed(a))
END putnam_1988_b4

title: putnam_1988_b5
content:
import Mathlib

open Set Filter Topology

abbrev putnam_1988_b5_solution : ℕ → ℕ := sorry
-- (fun n : ℕ => 2 * n)
/--
For positive integers $n$, let $M_n$ be the $2n+1$ by $2n+1$ skew-symmetric matrix for which each entry in the first $n$ subdiagonals below the main diagonal is $1$ and each of the remaining entries below the main diagonal is $-1$. Find, with proof, the rank of $M_n$. (According to one definition, the rank of a matrix is the largest $k$ such that there is a $k \times k$ submatrix with nonzero determinant.) One may note that
\begin{align*}
M_1&=\begin{pmatrix} 0 & -1 & 1 \\ 1 & 0 & -1 \\ -1 & 1 & 0 \end{pmatrix} \\
M_2&=\begin{pmatrix} 0 & -1 & -1 & 1 & 1 \\ 1 & 0 & -1 & -1 & 1 \\ 1 & 1 & 0 & -1 & -1 \\ -1 & 1 & 1 & 0 & -1 \\ -1 & -1 & 1 & 1 & 0 \end{pmatrix}.
\end{align*}
-/
theorem putnam_1988_b5
    (n : ℕ) (hn : n > 0)
    (Mn : Matrix (Fin (2 * n + 1)) (Fin (2 * n + 1)) ℝ)
    (Mnskewsymm : ∀ i j, Mn i j = -(Mn j i))
    (hMn1 : ∀ i j, (1 ≤ (i.1 : ℤ) - j.1 ∧ (i.1 : ℤ) - j.1 ≤ n) → Mn i j = 1)
    (hMnn1 : ∀ i j, (i.1 : ℤ) - j.1 > n → Mn i j = -1) :
    Mn.rank = putnam_1988_b5_solution n :=
  sorry

(* Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1988_b5:
   the rank of the prescribed odd-dimensional skew-symmetric real matrix is
   twice the positive integer parameter. This file contains no proof. *)

From Stdlib Require Import Lists.List Arith.PeanoNat Vectors.Fin Reals ZArith.

Import ListNotations.
Open Scope R_scope.

Definition putnam_1988_b5_matrix (n : nat) : Type :=
  Fin.t n -> Fin.t n -> R.

Fixpoint putnam_1988_b5_sum (xs : list R) : R :=
  match xs with
  | [] => 0
  | x :: rest => x + putnam_1988_b5_sum rest
  end.

Definition putnam_1988_b5_delete_nth
    {T : Type} (j : nat) (xs : list T) : list T :=
  firstn j xs ++ skipn (S j) xs.

Definition putnam_1988_b5_cofactor_sign (j : nat) : R :=
  if Nat.even j then 1 else -1.

Fixpoint putnam_1988_b5_det
    (n : nat) (M : list (list R)) {struct n} : R :=
  match n with
  | O => 1
  | S k =>
      match M with
      | [] => 0
      | row :: rows =>
          putnam_1988_b5_sum
            (map
              (fun j : nat =>
                putnam_1988_b5_cofactor_sign j *
                nth j row 0 *
                putnam_1988_b5_det k
                  (map (putnam_1988_b5_delete_nth j) rows))
              (seq 0 (S k)))
      end
  end.

Definition putnam_1988_b5_minor
    {n : nat}
    (M : putnam_1988_b5_matrix n)
    (rows cols : list (Fin.t n)) : list (list R) :=
  map (fun i => map (fun j => M i j) cols) rows.

Definition putnam_1988_b5_rank_at_least
    {n : nat} (M : putnam_1988_b5_matrix n) (k : nat) : Prop :=
  exists rows cols : list (Fin.t n),
    length rows = k /\
    length cols = k /\
    NoDup rows /\
    NoDup cols /\
    putnam_1988_b5_det k (putnam_1988_b5_minor M rows cols) <> 0.

Definition putnam_1988_b5_rank
    {n : nat} (M : putnam_1988_b5_matrix n) (k : nat) : Prop :=
  putnam_1988_b5_rank_at_least M k /\
  forall l : nat,
    (k < l)%nat ->
    ~ putnam_1988_b5_rank_at_least M l.

Definition putnam_1988_b5_index
    {n : nat} (i : Fin.t n) : Z :=
  Z.of_nat (proj1_sig (Fin.to_nat i)).

Definition putnam_1988_b5_solution (n : nat) : nat :=
  (2 * n)%nat.

Theorem putnam_1988_b5
    (n : nat)
    (hn : (0 < n)%nat)
    (Mn : putnam_1988_b5_matrix (2 * n + 1))
    (Mnskewsymm :
      forall i j : Fin.t (2 * n + 1),
        Mn i j = - Mn j i)
    (hMn1 :
      forall i j : Fin.t (2 * n + 1),
        (1 <= putnam_1988_b5_index i - putnam_1988_b5_index j)%Z /\
        (putnam_1988_b5_index i - putnam_1988_b5_index j
          <= Z.of_nat n)%Z ->
        Mn i j = 1)
    (hMnn1 :
      forall i j : Fin.t (2 * n + 1),
        (Z.of_nat n
          < putnam_1988_b5_index i - putnam_1988_b5_index j)%Z ->
        Mn i j = -1) :
  putnam_1988_b5_rank Mn (putnam_1988_b5_solution n).
Admitted.

;; Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1988_b5:
;; the prescribed (2n+1)-square skew-symmetric matrix has real rank 2n for
;; every positive integer n. This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

;; The source hypotheses uniquely determine every entry: diagonal entries are
;; zero, entries d places below the diagonal are 1 for 1 <= d <= n and -1
;; for n < d <= 2n, and upper entries follow by skew symmetry. Thus the
;; canonical integer matrix below is bidirectionally equivalent to quantifying
;; over source matrices satisfying those hypotheses.
;;
;; Integer determinants embed faithfully into the reals. For a
;; (2n+1)-square matrix, real rank 2n is equivalent to a zero full determinant
;; together with a nonzero 2n-by-2n minor. The finite searches below keep the
;; existential choice of that minor internal to the statement.

(defun putnam-1988-b5-range-from (start count)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix count)))
  (if (zp count)
      nil
    (cons start
          (putnam-1988-b5-range-from
           (+ start 1) (- count 1)))))

(defun putnam-1988-b5-entry (n row column)
  (cond
   ((equal row column) 0)
   ((> row column)
    (if (<= (- row column) n) 1 -1))
   ((<= (- column row) n) -1)
   (t 1)))

(defun putnam-1988-b5-prefix-each (item lists)
  (if (endp lists)
      nil
    (cons
     (cons item (car lists))
     (putnam-1988-b5-prefix-each item (cdr lists)))))

(defun putnam-1988-b5-insert-everywhere (item list)
  (if (endp list)
      (list (list item))
    (cons
     (cons item list)
     (putnam-1988-b5-prefix-each
      (car list)
      (putnam-1988-b5-insert-everywhere
       item (cdr list))))))

(defun putnam-1988-b5-insert-into-each (item lists)
  (if (endp lists)
      nil
    (append
     (putnam-1988-b5-insert-everywhere
      item (car lists))
     (putnam-1988-b5-insert-into-each
      item (cdr lists)))))

(defun putnam-1988-b5-permutations (list)
  (if (endp list)
      (list nil)
    (putnam-1988-b5-insert-into-each
     (car list)
     (putnam-1988-b5-permutations (cdr list)))))

(defun putnam-1988-b5-count-greater (item list)
  (if (endp list)
      0
    (+ (if (> item (car list)) 1 0)
       (putnam-1988-b5-count-greater
        item (cdr list)))))

(defun putnam-1988-b5-inversion-count (permutation)
  (if (endp permutation)
      0
    (+ (putnam-1988-b5-count-greater
        (car permutation) (cdr permutation))
       (putnam-1988-b5-inversion-count
        (cdr permutation)))))

(defun putnam-1988-b5-diagonal-product
    (n rows column-permutation)
  (if (endp rows)
      1
    (* (putnam-1988-b5-entry
        n (car rows) (car column-permutation))
       (putnam-1988-b5-diagonal-product
        n (cdr rows) (cdr column-permutation)))))

(defun putnam-1988-b5-determinant-sum
    (n rows column-permutations)
  (if (endp column-permutations)
      0
    (let* ((permutation (car column-permutations))
           (product
            (putnam-1988-b5-diagonal-product
             n rows permutation))
           (signed-product
            (if (evenp
                 (putnam-1988-b5-inversion-count
                  permutation))
                product
              (- product))))
      (+ signed-product
         (putnam-1988-b5-determinant-sum
          n rows (cdr column-permutations))))))

(defun putnam-1988-b5-determinant (n rows columns)
  (putnam-1988-b5-determinant-sum
   n
   rows
   (putnam-1988-b5-permutations columns)))

(defun putnam-1988-b5-combinations (values size)
  (if (or (zp size) (endp values))
      (if (zp size) (list nil) nil)
    (append
     (putnam-1988-b5-prefix-each
      (car values)
      (putnam-1988-b5-combinations
       (cdr values) (- size 1)))
     (putnam-1988-b5-combinations
      (cdr values) size))))

(defun putnam-1988-b5-nonzero-column-minor-p
    (n rows column-choices)
  (if (endp column-choices)
      nil
    (or
     (not
      (equal
       (putnam-1988-b5-determinant
        n rows (car column-choices))
       0))
     (putnam-1988-b5-nonzero-column-minor-p
      n rows (cdr column-choices)))))

(defun putnam-1988-b5-nonzero-minor-p
    (n row-choices column-choices)
  (if (endp row-choices)
      nil
    (or
     (putnam-1988-b5-nonzero-column-minor-p
      n (car row-choices) column-choices)
     (putnam-1988-b5-nonzero-minor-p
      n (cdr row-choices) column-choices))))

(defun putnam-1988-b5-rank-is-2n-p (n)
  (let* ((dimension (+ (* 2 n) 1))
         (minor-size (* 2 n))
         (indices
          (putnam-1988-b5-range-from 0 dimension))
         (row-choices
          (putnam-1988-b5-combinations
           indices minor-size))
         (column-choices
          (putnam-1988-b5-combinations
           indices minor-size)))
    (and
     (equal
      (putnam-1988-b5-determinant
       n indices indices)
      0)
     (putnam-1988-b5-nonzero-minor-p
      n row-choices column-choices))))

(defun putnambench-putnam-1988-b5-statement (n)
  (implies
   (and (natp n)
        (< 0 n))
   (putnam-1988-b5-rank-is-2n-p n)))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

-- Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1988_b5:
-- the prescribed skew-symmetric real matrix of odd size 2n+1 has rank 2n.
-- This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; _*_)

infix 4 _!=_ _<=N_
infixr 3 _and_
infixr 2 _or_

data Bottom : Set where

Not : Set -> Set
Not A =
  A -> Bottom

_!=_ : {A : Set} -> A -> A -> Set
x != y =
  Not (x == y)

record _and_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data _or_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  left  : A -> A or B
  right : B -> A or B

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

data _<=N_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set where
  zero<=N   : {n : Nat} -> zero <=N n
  suc<=sucN : {m n : Nat} -> m <=N n -> suc m <=N suc n

data Fin : Nat -> Set where
  fzero : {n : Nat} -> Fin (suc n)
  fsuc  : {n : Nat} -> Fin n -> Fin (suc n)

toNat : {n : Nat} -> Fin n -> Nat
toNat fzero =
  zero
toNat (fsuc i) =
  suc (toNat i)

subtractNat : Nat -> Nat -> Nat
subtractNat m zero =
  m
subtractNat zero (suc n) =
  zero
subtractNat (suc m) (suc n) =
  subtractNat m n

record CompleteOrderedRealField (R : Set) : Set1 where
  field
    zeroR oneR : R
    add multiply : R -> R -> R
    negate inverse : R -> R
    lessOrEqual : R -> R -> Set
    fromNat : Nat -> R

    one-not-zero :
      oneR != zeroR

    add-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> add x y == add y x
    add-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      add (add x y) z == add x (add y z)
    add-zero :
      (x : R) -> add x zeroR == x
    add-inverse :
      (x : R) -> add x (negate x) == zeroR

    multiply-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> multiply x y == multiply y x
    multiply-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply (multiply x y) z ==
      multiply x (multiply y z)
    multiply-one :
      (x : R) -> multiply x oneR == x
    multiply-zero :
      (x : R) -> multiply x zeroR == zeroR
    distribute :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply x (add y z) ==
      add (multiply x y) (multiply x z)
    inverse-zero :
      inverse zeroR == zeroR
    multiply-inverse :
      (x : R) ->
      x != zeroR ->
      multiply x (inverse x) == oneR

    order-reflexive :
      (x : R) -> lessOrEqual x x
    order-transitive :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y z ->
      lessOrEqual x z
    order-antisymmetric :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y x ->
      x == y
    order-total :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y or lessOrEqual y x
    add-order :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual (add z x) (add z y)
    multiply-nonnegative :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR x ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR y ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR (multiply x y)
    zero-less-than-one :
      lessOrEqual zeroR oneR and zeroR != oneR

    fromNat-zero :
      fromNat zero == zeroR
    fromNat-successor :
      (n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (suc n) == add (fromNat n) oneR
    fromNat-addition :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m + n) == add (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-multiplication :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m * n) == multiply (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-injective :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat m == fromNat n ->
      m == n

    archimedean :
      (x : R) ->
      Exists Nat (\ n -> lessOrEqual x (fromNat n))
    least-upper-bound :
      (P : R -> Set) ->
      Exists R P ->
      Exists R
        (\ upper ->
          (x : R) ->
          P x ->
          lessOrEqual x upper) ->
      Exists R
        (\ supremum ->
          ((x : R) ->
            P x ->
            lessOrEqual x supremum)
          and
          ((upper : R) ->
            ((x : R) ->
              P x ->
              lessOrEqual x upper) ->
            lessOrEqual supremum upper))

open CompleteOrderedRealField

Matrix : Set -> Nat -> Nat -> Set
Matrix R rows columns =
  Fin rows -> Fin columns -> R

sumFin :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  {n : Nat} ->
  (Fin n -> R) ->
  R
sumFin reals {zero} term =
  zeroR reals
sumFin reals {suc n} term =
  add reals
    (term fzero)
    (sumFin reals (\ i -> term (fsuc i)))

skip :
  {n : Nat} ->
  Fin (suc n) ->
  Fin n ->
  Fin (suc n)
skip {zero} removed ()
skip {suc n} fzero i =
  fsuc i
skip {suc n} (fsuc removed) fzero =
  fzero
skip {suc n} (fsuc removed) (fsuc i) =
  fsuc (skip removed i)

firstRowMinor :
  {R : Set} {n : Nat} ->
  Matrix R (suc n) (suc n) ->
  Fin (suc n) ->
  Matrix R n n
firstRowMinor A removedColumn i j =
  A (fsuc i) (skip removedColumn j)

alternatingSign :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  {n : Nat} ->
  Fin n ->
  R
alternatingSign reals fzero =
  oneR reals
alternatingSign reals (fsuc i) =
  negate reals (alternatingSign reals i)

determinant :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  {n : Nat} ->
  Matrix R n n ->
  R
determinant reals {zero} A =
  oneR reals
determinant reals {suc n} A =
  sumFin reals
    (\ column ->
      multiply reals
        (alternatingSign reals column)
        (multiply reals
          (A fzero column)
          (determinant reals (firstRowMinor A column))))

Injective :
  {A B : Set} ->
  (A -> B) ->
  Set
Injective f =
  (x y : _) ->
  f x == f y ->
  x == y

submatrix :
  {R : Set} {rows columns k : Nat} ->
  Matrix R rows columns ->
  (Fin k -> Fin rows) ->
  (Fin k -> Fin columns) ->
  Matrix R k k
submatrix A selectedRows selectedColumns i j =
  A (selectedRows i) (selectedColumns j)

RankAtLeast :
  {R : Set} {rows columns : Nat} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Matrix R rows columns ->
  Nat ->
  Set
RankAtLeast {rows = rows} {columns = columns} reals A k =
  Exists (Fin k -> Fin rows)
    (\ selectedRows ->
      Injective selectedRows
      and
      Exists (Fin k -> Fin columns)
        (\ selectedColumns ->
          Injective selectedColumns
          and
          determinant reals
            (submatrix A selectedRows selectedColumns)
          !=
          zeroR reals))

HasRank :
  {R : Set} {rows columns : Nat} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Matrix R rows columns ->
  Nat ->
  Set
HasRank reals A k =
  RankAtLeast reals A k
  and
  Not (RankAtLeast reals A (suc k))

twoN : Nat
twoN =
  suc (suc zero)

matrixSize : Nat -> Nat
matrixSize n =
  suc (twoN * n)

rankValue : Nat -> Nat
rankValue n =
  twoN * n

PositiveNat : Nat -> Set
PositiveNat n =
  suc zero <=N n

SkewSymmetric :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  {n : Nat} ->
  Matrix R n n ->
  Set
SkewSymmetric reals A =
  (i j : _) ->
  A i j == negate reals (A j i)

FirstSubdiagonalsAreOne :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (n : Nat) ->
  Matrix R (matrixSize n) (matrixSize n) ->
  Set
FirstSubdiagonalsAreOne reals n A =
  (i j : Fin (matrixSize n)) ->
  (suc (toNat j) <=N toNat i)
  and
  (subtractNat (toNat i) (toNat j) <=N n) ->
  A i j == oneR reals

RemainingLowerEntriesAreNegativeOne :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (n : Nat) ->
  Matrix R (matrixSize n) (matrixSize n) ->
  Set
RemainingLowerEntriesAreNegativeOne reals n A =
  (i j : Fin (matrixSize n)) ->
  suc n <=N subtractNat (toNat i) (toNat j) ->
  A i j == negate reals (oneR reals)

putnam-1988-b5 : Set1
putnam-1988-b5 =
  (R : Set) ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) ->
  (n : Nat) ->
  PositiveNat n ->
  (Mn : Matrix R (matrixSize n) (matrixSize n)) ->
  SkewSymmetric reals Mn ->
  FirstSubdiagonalsAreOne reals n Mn ->
  RemainingLowerEntriesAreNegativeOne reals n Mn ->
  HasRank reals Mn (rankValue n)

(*
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1988_b5:
  the specified odd-order real skew-symmetric matrix has rank twice its
  positive integer parameter. This file contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open arithmeticTheory listTheory rich_listTheory sortingTheory;
open pred_setTheory realTheory real_sigmaTheory;

val putnam_1988_b5 =
  ``let valid_indices =
      \bound k : num.
      \xs : num list.
        LENGTH xs = k /\
        ALL_DISTINCT xs /\
        EVERY (\i : num. i < bound) xs
    in
    let minor_det =
      \A : num -> num -> real.
      \rows cols : num list.
        let k = LENGTH rows
        in
          SIGMA
            (\p : num list.
               (-1 : real) pow
                 CARD
                   {ij : num # num |
                      FST ij < SND ij /\
                      SND ij < k /\
                      EL (SND ij) p < EL (FST ij) p} *
               REAL_PROD_IMAGE
                 (\i : num.
                    A (EL i rows) (EL (EL i p) cols))
                 (count k))
            {p : num list | PERM p (GENLIST I k)}
    in
    let has_nonzero_minor =
      \bound : num.
      \A : num -> num -> real.
      \k : num.
        ?rows cols : num list.
          valid_indices bound k rows /\
          valid_indices bound k cols /\
          minor_det A rows cols <> 0
    in
    let has_rank =
      \bound : num.
      \A : num -> num -> real.
      \k : num.
        has_nonzero_minor bound A k /\
        (!l : num.
           k < l
           ==>
           ~has_nonzero_minor bound A l)
    in
      !n : num. !Mn : num -> num -> real.
        0 < n /\
        (!i j : num.
           i < 2 * n + 1 /\ j < 2 * n + 1
           ==>
           Mn i j = -(Mn j i)) /\
        (!i j : num.
           i < 2 * n + 1 /\ j < 2 * n + 1 /\
           j < i /\ i <= j + n
           ==>
           Mn i j = 1) /\
        (!i j : num.
           i < 2 * n + 1 /\ j < 2 * n + 1 /\
           j + n < i
           ==>
           Mn i j = -1)
        ==>
        has_rank (2 * n + 1) Mn (2 * n)``;

title: putnam_1988_b5
content:
$(
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact
  putnam_1988_b5: the rank of the real skew-symmetric matrix of odd order
  2n+1 whose first n lower subdiagonals are 1 and whose remaining lower
  entries are -1. This file contains no proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  The carrier 0 ..^ (2n+1) represents Fin (2*n+1). A matrix is represented
  as a real-valued function on the Cartesian square of that carrier. Thus the
  zero-based indices here are exactly the Lean indices; shifting the
  Isabelle indices 1,...,2n+1 down by one preserves their differences and
  simultaneously reindexes rows and columns.

  P88B5Minor A n k says that A has a nonzero k-by-k minor. For positive k,
  R and C select k rows and k columns, and f reindexes the selected columns
  by R; changing f can only change the determinant by a sign. P88B5Rank is
  therefore the standard largest-nonzero-minor rank specified in the source.

  The three antecedent clauses state skew-symmetry, value 1 when
  1 <= i-j <= n, and value -1 when i-j > n. The annotated source solution
  putnam_1988_b5_solution n = 2*n is inlined in the conclusion. Every
  declaration below is an unproved $a statement encoding; there is no $p
  proof declaration.
$)

$c P88B5Minor P88B5Rank $.

p88b5-minor-syntax $a wff ( P88B5Minor A n k ) $.
p88b5-rank-syntax $a wff ( P88B5Rank A n k ) $.

${
  $d A C R f i j k n $.

  p88b5-minor-definition $a |- (
    ( P88B5Minor A n k )
    <->
    (
      k = 0
      \/
      E. R e. ~P ( 0 ..^ ( ( 2 x. n ) + 1 ) )
        E. C e. ~P ( 0 ..^ ( ( 2 x. n ) + 1 ) )
          (
            (

content:
% Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1988_b5:
% the specified odd-dimensional real skew-symmetric band matrix has rank
% exactly 2n. This file contains no proof.

putnam_1988_b5[n: posnat]: THEORY
BEGIN
  matrix_index: TYPE = below(2 * n + 1)
  independent_index: TYPE = below(2 * n)

  matrix: TYPE = [matrix_index, matrix_index -> real]
  selected_columns: TYPE = [independent_index -> matrix_index]
  selected_coefficients: TYPE = [independent_index -> real]
  full_coefficients: TYPE = [matrix_index -> real]

  selected_column_sum(
      M: matrix,
      columns: selected_columns,
      coefficients: selected_coefficients,
      row: matrix_index,
      count: nat): RECURSIVE real =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      selected_column_sum(
        M, columns, coefficients, row, count - 1)
        + IF count <= 2 * n THEN
            coefficients(count - 1)
              * M(row, columns(count - 1))
          ELSE
            0
          ENDIF
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  full_column_sum(
      M: matrix,
      coefficients: full_coefficients,
      row: matrix_index,
      count: nat): RECURSIVE real =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      full_column_sum(M, coefficients, row, count - 1)
        + IF count <= 2 * n + 1 THEN
            coefficients(count - 1) * M(row, count - 1)
          ELSE
            0
          ENDIF
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  injective_selection(columns: selected_columns): bool =
    FORALL (left, right: independent_index):
      columns(left) = columns(right) IMPLIES left = right

  selected_columns_independent(
      M: matrix,
      columns: selected_columns): bool =
    FORALL (coefficients: selected_coefficients):
      (FORALL (row: matrix_index):
        selected_column_sum(
          M, columns, coefficients, row, 2 * n) = 0)
      IMPLIES
        (FORALL (index: independent_index):
          coefficients(index) = 0)

  all_columns_dependent(M: matrix): bool =
    EXISTS (coefficients: full_coefficients):
      (EXISTS (index: matrix_index):
        coefficients(index) /= 0)
        AND (FORALL (row: matrix_index):
          full_column_sum(
            M, coefficients, row, 2 * n + 1) = 0)

  has_rank_2n(M: matrix): bool =
    all_columns_dependent(M)
      AND EXISTS (columns: selected_columns):
        injective_selection(columns)
          AND selected_columns_independent(M, columns)

  specified_matrix(M: matrix): bool =
    (FORALL (i, j: matrix_index):
      M(i, j) = -M(j, i))
      AND (FORALL (i, j: matrix_index):
        (j < i AND i <= j + n) IMPLIES M(i, j) = 1)
      AND (FORALL (i, j: matrix_index):
        j + n < i IMPLIES M(i, j) = -1)

  putnam_1988_b5_solution: nat = 2 * n

  putnam_1988_b5: bool =
    FORALL (M: matrix):
      specified_matrix(M) IMPLIES has_rank_2n(M)
END putnam_1988_b5

;; Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1988_b6:
;; infinitely many integer affine maps preserve triangular-number membership
;; on every positive integer in both directions. This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

;; For a nonnegative integer z, any nonnegative m satisfying
;; 2*z=m*(m+1) has m<=z unless z=0, when m=0. Thus this finite search is
;; exactly the source existential definition of triangular numbers.
(defun putnam-1988-b6-triangular-through-p (z candidate)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix candidate)))
  (if (and (integerp z)
           (<= 0 z)
           (natp candidate))
      (or
       (equal (* 2 z)
              (* candidate (+ candidate 1)))
       (and
        (not (zp candidate))
        (putnam-1988-b6-triangular-through-p
         z (- candidate 1))))
    nil))

(defun putnam-1988-b6-triangular-p (z)
  (and
   (integerp z)
   (<= 0 z)
   (putnam-1988-b6-triangular-through-p z (nfix z))))

;; This predicate retains the source's arbitrary integer pair and unbounded
;; universal quantifier over all positive integer inputs.
(defun-sk putnam-1988-b6-preserves-triangular-p (a b)
  (forall (input)
    (implies
     (and
      (integerp input)
      (< 0 input))
     (equal
      (putnam-1988-b6-triangular-p
       (+ (* a input) b))
      (putnam-1988-b6-triangular-p input)))))

(defun putnam-1988-b6-qualifying-pair-p (a b)
  (and
   (integerp a)
   (integerp b)
   (putnam-1988-b6-preserves-triangular-p a b)))

;; A subset of Z x Z is infinite exactly when its values of |a|+|b| are
;; unbounded, since every such bounded set of integer pairs is finite.
;; DEFUN-SK keeps the qualifying pair existentially quantified inside the
;; statement rather than exposing a chosen solution family.
(defun-sk putnam-1988-b6-pair-above-bound-exists-p (bound)
  (exists (a b)
    (and
     (putnam-1988-b6-qualifying-pair-p a b)
     (< bound (+ (abs a) (abs b))))))

(defun putnambench-putnam-1988-b6-statement (bound)
  (implies
   (natp bound)
   (putnam-1988-b6-pair-above-bound-exists-p bound)))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

-- Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1988_b6:
-- infinitely many ordered pairs of integers whose affine maps preserve
-- triangular-number membership on positive integers. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Int using (Int; pos; negsuc)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; _*_)

data Bottom : Set where

Not : Set -> Set
Not A =
  A -> Bottom

record Iff (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor equivalence
  field
    forward  : A -> B
    backward : B -> A

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

record Pair (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor _,_
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

open Pair

data Fin : Nat -> Set where
  fzero : {n : Nat} -> Fin (suc n)
  fsuc  : {n : Nat} -> Fin n -> Fin (suc n)

Injective : {A B : Set} -> (A -> B) -> Set
Injective f =
  (x y : _) ->
  f x == f y ->
  x == y

record HasCardinality
  {A : Set}
  (member : A -> Set)
  (cardinality : Nat) :
  Set where

  field
    enumerate :
      Fin cardinality ->
      A
    enumerated-member :
      (index : Fin cardinality) ->
      member (enumerate index)
    enumeration-complete :
      (item : A) ->
      member item ->
      Exists (Fin cardinality)
        (\ index -> item == enumerate index)
    enumeration-injective :
      Injective enumerate

negative : Nat -> Int
negative zero =
  pos zero
negative (suc n) =
  negsuc n

difference : Nat -> Nat -> Int
difference zero zero =
  pos zero
difference (suc m) zero =
  pos (suc m)
difference zero (suc n) =
  negsuc n
difference (suc m) (suc n) =
  difference m n

addInt : Int -> Int -> Int
addInt (pos m) (pos n) =
  pos (m + n)
addInt (pos m) (negsuc n) =
  difference m (suc n)
addInt (negsuc m) (pos n) =
  difference n (suc m)
addInt (negsuc m) (negsuc n) =
  negsuc (suc (m + n))

multiplyInt : Int -> Int -> Int
multiplyInt (pos m) (pos n) =
  pos (m * n)
multiplyInt (pos m) (negsuc n) =
  negative (m * suc n)
multiplyInt (negsuc m) (pos n) =
  negative (suc m * n)
multiplyInt (negsuc m) (negsuc n) =
  pos (suc m * suc n)

oneN : Nat
oneN =
  suc zero

twoN : Nat
twoN =
  suc oneN

twoZ : Int
twoZ =
  pos twoN

data PositiveInteger : Int -> Set where
  positive : {n : Nat} -> PositiveInteger (pos (suc n))

Triangular : Int -> Set
Triangular t =
  Exists Nat
    (\ n ->
      multiplyInt twoZ t
      ==
      multiplyInt (pos n) (pos (n + oneN)))

IntegerPair : Set
IntegerPair =
  Pair Int Int

Qualifies : IntegerPair -> Set
Qualifies pair =
  (t : Int) ->
  PositiveInteger t ->
  Iff
    (Triangular
      (addInt
        (multiplyInt (first pair) t)
        (second pair)))
    (Triangular t)

Infinite : {A : Set} -> (A -> Set) -> Set
Infinite member =
  Not
    (Exists Nat
      (\ cardinality ->
        HasCardinality member cardinality))

putnam-1988-b6 : Set
putnam-1988-b6 =
  Infinite Qualifies

(* Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1989_a1:
   the number of primes whose usual base-10 digits alternate between 1 and 0,
   beginning and ending with 1, is 1; this file contains no proof. *)

From Stdlib Require Import Arith.PeanoNat Lists.List.

Import ListNotations.

Fixpoint putnam_1989_a1_decimal_digits_fuel
    (fuel n : nat) : list nat :=
  match fuel with
  | O => []
  | S fuel' =>
      if Nat.ltb n 10
      then [n]
      else
        Nat.modulo n 10 ::
        putnam_1989_a1_decimal_digits_fuel fuel' (Nat.div n 10)
  end.

Definition putnam_1989_a1_decimal_digits (n : nat) : list nat :=
  putnam_1989_a1_decimal_digits_fuel (S n) n.

Definition putnam_1989_a1_prime (p : nat) : Prop :=
  (2 <= p)%nat /\
  forall d : nat,
    Nat.divide d p ->
    d = 1%nat \/ d = p.

Definition putnam_1989_a1_alternating_digits
    (digits : list nat) : Prop :=
  Nat.Odd (length digits) /\
  forall i : nat,
    (i < length digits)%nat ->
    nth i digits 0 =
      if Nat.even i then 1%nat else 0%nat.

Definition putnam_1989_a1_qualifying_prime (p : nat) : Prop :=
  putnam_1989_a1_prime p /\
  putnam_1989_a1_alternating_digits
    (putnam_1989_a1_decimal_digits p).

Definition putnam_1989_a1_has_cardinality
    (P : nat -> Prop) (cardinality : nat) : Prop :=
  exists enumeration : list nat,
    NoDup enumeration /\
    (forall p : nat, In p enumeration <-> P p) /\
    length enumeration = cardinality.

Definition putnam_1989_a1_solution : nat := 1%nat.

Theorem putnam_1989_a1 :
  putnam_1989_a1_has_cardinality
    putnam_1989_a1_qualifying_prime
    putnam_1989_a1_solution.
Admitted.

;; the cardinality of the primes whose base-10 digits alternate 1 and 0,
;; beginning and ending with 1, equals the supplied solution 1. This file
;; contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(defun putnam-1989-a1-solution ()
  1)

;; A(k) has 2*k+1 decimal digits and satisfies A(0)=1 and
;; A(k+1)=100*A(k)+1. Hence its values are exactly the positive integers
;; whose usual base-10 digits alternate 1 and 0, beginning and ending with 1.
(defun putnam-1989-a1-alternating-number (k)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix k)))
  (if (zp k)
      1
    (+ 1
       (* 100
          (putnam-1989-a1-alternating-number (- k 1))))))

(defun-sk putnam-1989-a1-alternating-positive-integer-p (p)
  (exists (k)
    (and
     (natp k)
     (equal
      p
      (putnam-1989-a1-alternating-number k)))))

;; For a natural number, testing every candidate divisor below it is exactly
;; the usual definition of primality.
(defun putnam-1989-a1-no-divisor-through-p (n divisor)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix divisor)))
  (if (or (not (natp divisor))
          (<= divisor 1))
      t
    (and
     (not (equal (mod n divisor) 0))
     (putnam-1989-a1-no-divisor-through-p
      n (- divisor 1)))))

(defun putnam-1989-a1-prime-p (n)
  (and
   (natp n)
   (< 1 n)
   (putnam-1989-a1-no-divisor-through-p
    n (- n 1))))

(defun putnam-1989-a1-counted-prime-p (p)
  (and
   (putnam-1989-a1-prime-p p)
   (putnam-1989-a1-alternating-positive-integer-p p)))

(defun putnam-1989-a1-listed-primes-p (members)
  (if (consp members)
      (and
       (putnam-1989-a1-counted-prime-p (car members))
       (putnam-1989-a1-listed-primes-p (cdr members)))
    (equal members nil)))

(defun-sk putnam-1989-a1-all-counted-primes-listed-p (members)
  (forall (p)
    (implies
     (putnam-1989-a1-counted-prime-p p)
     (member-equal p members))))

;; A duplicate-free list of length COUNT that contains exactly all members of
;; the unbounded source set is a bijective encoding of cardinality COUNT.
(defun putnam-1989-a1-cardinality-witness-p (count members)
  (and
   (natp count)
   (true-listp members)
   (equal (len members) count)
   (no-duplicatesp-equal members)
   (putnam-1989-a1-listed-primes-p members)
   (putnam-1989-a1-all-counted-primes-listed-p members)))

(defun-sk putnam-1989-a1-cardinality-p (count)
  (exists (members)
    (putnam-1989-a1-cardinality-witness-p
     count members)))

(defun putnambench-putnam-1989-a1-statement ()
  (putnam-1989-a1-cardinality-p
   (putnam-1989-a1-solution)))
