-- Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1989_a1:
-- exactly one positive prime has an ordinary base-10 representation alternating
-- 1s and 0s, beginning and ending with 1. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; _*_)

infix 4 _<=N_ _divides_
infixr 3 _and_
infixr 2 _or_

record _and_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data _or_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  left  : A -> A or B
  right : B -> A or B

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

data _<=N_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set where
  zero<=N   : {n : Nat} -> zero <=N n
  suc<=sucN : {m n : Nat} -> m <=N n -> suc m <=N suc n

record _divides_ (divisor dividend : Nat) : Set where
  constructor divisibility
  field
    quotient          : Nat
    division-equation : dividend == divisor * quotient

one : Nat
one =
  suc zero

two : Nat
two =
  suc one

hundred : Nat
hundred =
  100

record Prime (p : Nat) : Set where
  field
    at-least-two :
      two <=N p
    only-trivial-divisors :
      (d : Nat) ->
      d divides p ->
      (d == one) or (d == p)

alternatingDecimal : Nat -> Nat
alternatingDecimal zero =
  one
alternatingDecimal (suc pairs) =
  hundred * alternatingDecimal pairs + one

AlternatingPrime : Nat -> Set
AlternatingPrime p =
  Prime p
  and
  Exists Nat
    (\ pairs -> p == alternatingDecimal pairs)

data Fin : Nat -> Set where
  fzero : {n : Nat} -> Fin (suc n)
  fsuc  : {n : Nat} -> Fin n -> Fin (suc n)

record HasCardinality
  {A : Set}
  (P : A -> Set)
  (cardinality : Nat) :
  Set where

  field
    enumerate :
      Fin cardinality ->
      A
    enumerated-member :
      (index : Fin cardinality) ->
      P (enumerate index)
    enumeration-complete :
      (item : A) ->
      P item ->
      Exists (Fin cardinality)
        (\ index -> item == enumerate index)
    enumeration-injective :
      (left-index right-index : Fin cardinality) ->
      enumerate left-index == enumerate right-index ->
      left-index == right-index

putnam-1989-a1 : Set
putnam-1989-a1 =
  HasCardinality AlternatingPrime one

    #
    `

      p e. Prime |
      E. k e. NN0

% Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1989_a1:
% exactly one positive prime has a usual base-10 numeral whose digits alternate
% 1 and 0, beginning and ending with 1. This file contains no proof.

putnam_1989_a1: THEORY
BEGIN
  IMPORTING finite_sets[nat]

  nat_divides(divisor: posnat, value: nat): bool =
    EXISTS (quotient: nat):
      value = divisor * quotient

  prime_nat(value: nat): bool =
    value >= 2
      AND FORALL (divisor: posnat):
        nat_divides(divisor, value)
          IMPLIES divisor = 1 OR divisor = value

  decimal_length(value: nat): nat =
    IF value = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      epsilon(
        LAMBDA (length: nat):
          0 < length
            AND 10 ^ (length - 1) <= value
            AND value < 10 ^ length)
    ENDIF

  decimal_digit(value, position: nat): nat =
    epsilon(
      LAMBDA (digit: nat):
        digit < 10
          AND EXISTS (higher, lower: nat):
            lower < 10 ^ position
              AND value =
                higher * 10 ^ (position + 1)
                  + digit * 10 ^ position
                  + lower)

  alternating_decimal(value: nat): bool =
    value > 0
      AND mod(decimal_length(value), 2) = 1
      AND (FORALL (position: nat):
        position < decimal_length(value)
          IMPLIES
            decimal_digit(value, position) =
              IF mod(position, 2) = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 ENDIF)

  qualifying(value: nat): bool =
    prime_nat(value) AND alternating_decimal(value)

  putnam_1989_a1_solution: nat = 1

  putnam_1989_a1: bool =
    EXISTS (solutions: finite_set[nat]):
      card(solutions) = putnam_1989_a1_solution
        AND (FORALL (value: nat):
          solutions(value) IFF qualifying(value))
END putnam_1989_a1

;; Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1989_a2:
;; evaluation of a double real integral of the exponential of the maximum of
;; two quadratic terms over a positive rectangle. This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

;; For nonnegative rational z, (1+z/n)^n is a rational Cauchy name for exp(z).
(defun putnam-1989-a2-exp-approx (z precision)
  (if (posp precision)
      (expt (+ 1 (/ z precision)) precision)
    0))

(defun putnam-1989-a2-max (x y)
  (if (< x y) y x))

(defun putnam-1989-a2-exponent (a b x y)
  (let ((bx (* b x))
        (ay (* a y)))
    (putnam-1989-a2-max (* bx bx) (* ay ay))))

(defun putnam-1989-a2-row-sum
    (a b x remaining subdivisions)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix remaining)))
  (if (zp remaining)
      0
    (let ((y (/ (* b remaining) subdivisions)))
      (+ (putnam-1989-a2-exp-approx
          (putnam-1989-a2-exponent a b x y)
          subdivisions)
         (putnam-1989-a2-row-sum
          a b x (- remaining 1) subdivisions)))))

(defun putnam-1989-a2-double-sum
    (a b remaining subdivisions)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix remaining)))
  (if (zp remaining)
      0
    (let ((x (/ (* a remaining) subdivisions)))
      (+ (putnam-1989-a2-row-sum
          a b x subdivisions subdivisions)
         (putnam-1989-a2-double-sum
          a b (- remaining 1) subdivisions)))))

;; This right grid sum uses the original source integrand on [0,a] by [0,b].
;; Both the grid and exponential precision are unbounded, so it denotes the
;; source real integral rather than a finite-table approximation.
(defun putnam-1989-a2-integral-approx (a b subdivisions)
  (if (and (rationalp a)
           (< 0 a)
           (rationalp b)
           (< 0 b)
           (posp subdivisions))
      (* (/ a subdivisions)
         (/ b subdivisions)
         (putnam-1989-a2-double-sum
          a b subdivisions subdivisions))
    0))

(defun putnam-1989-a2-solution-approx (a b precision)
  (if (and (rationalp a)
           (< 0 a)
           (rationalp b)
           (< 0 b)
           (posp precision))
      (/ (- (putnam-1989-a2-exp-approx
             (* a a b b)
             precision)
            1)
         (* a b))
    0))

;; Positive rationals are dense in the positive reals, and both sides of the
;; source equality are continuous in a and b there. Positive rational
;; tolerances are cofinal among positive real tolerances. The diagonal grid
;; and exponential approximations converge to the two source expressions.
;; Existential cutoffs state only their equality, without an added rate.
(defun-sk putnam-1989-a2-tail-p
    (a b epsilon cutoff)
  (forall (subdivisions)
    (implies
     (and
      (natp subdivisions)
      (<= cutoff subdivisions))
     (< (abs
         (- (putnam-1989-a2-integral-approx
             a b subdivisions)
            (putnam-1989-a2-solution-approx
             a b subdivisions)))
        epsilon))))

(defun-sk putnam-1989-a2-cutoff-exists-p
    (a b epsilon)
  (exists (cutoff)
    (and
     (posp cutoff)
     (putnam-1989-a2-tail-p
      a b epsilon cutoff))))

(defun-sk putnambench-putnam-1989-a2-statement (a b)
  (forall (epsilon)
    (implies
     (and
      (rationalp a)
      (< 0 a)
      (rationalp b)
      (< 0 b)
      (rationalp epsilon)
      (< 0 epsilon))
     (putnam-1989-a2-cutoff-exists-p
      a b epsilon))))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

content:
-- Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1989_a2:
-- the double integral of exp(max(b^2 x^2, a^2 y^2)) over a positive
-- rectangle has the stated closed form. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module Main where

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; _*_)

infix 4 _!=_ _<=N_
infixr 3 _and_
infixr 2 _or_

data Bottom : Set where

Not : Set -> Set
Not A =
  A -> Bottom

_!=_ : {A : Set} -> A -> A -> Set
x != y =
  Not (x == y)

record _and_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data _or_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  left  : A -> A or B
  right : B -> A or B

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

data _<=N_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set where
  zero<=N   : {n : Nat} -> zero <=N n
  suc<=sucN : {m n : Nat} -> m <=N n -> suc m <=N suc n

record CompleteOrderedRealField (R : Set) : Set1 where
  field
    zeroR oneR : R
    add multiply : R -> R -> R
    negate inverse : R -> R
    lessOrEqual : R -> R -> Set
    fromNat : Nat -> R

    one-not-zero :
      oneR != zeroR

    add-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> add x y == add y x
    add-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      add (add x y) z == add x (add y z)
    add-zero :
      (x : R) -> add x zeroR == x
    add-inverse :
      (x : R) -> add x (negate x) == zeroR

    multiply-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> multiply x y == multiply y x
    multiply-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply (multiply x y) z ==
      multiply x (multiply y z)
    multiply-one :
      (x : R) -> multiply x oneR == x
    multiply-zero :
      (x : R) -> multiply x zeroR == zeroR
    distribute :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply x (add y z) ==
      add (multiply x y) (multiply x z)
    inverse-zero :
      inverse zeroR == zeroR
    multiply-inverse :
      (x : R) ->
      x != zeroR ->
      multiply x (inverse x) == oneR

    order-reflexive :
      (x : R) -> lessOrEqual x x
    order-transitive :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y z ->
      lessOrEqual x z
    order-antisymmetric :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y x ->
      x == y
    order-total :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y or lessOrEqual y x
    add-order :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual (add z x) (add z y)
    multiply-nonnegative :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR x ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR y ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR (multiply x y)
    zero-less-than-one :
      lessOrEqual zeroR oneR and zeroR != oneR

    fromNat-zero :
      fromNat zero == zeroR
    fromNat-successor :
      (n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (suc n) == add (fromNat n) oneR
    fromNat-addition :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m + n) == add (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-multiplication :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m * n) == multiply (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-injective :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat m == fromNat n ->
      m == n

    archimedean :
      (x : R) ->
      Exists Nat (\ n -> lessOrEqual x (fromNat n))
    least-upper-bound :
      (P : R -> Set) ->
      Exists R P ->
      Exists R
        (\ upper ->
          (x : R) ->
          P x ->
          lessOrEqual x upper) ->
      Exists R
        (\ supremum ->
          ((x : R) ->
            P x ->
            lessOrEqual x supremum)
          and
          ((upper : R) ->
            ((x : R) ->
              P x ->
              lessOrEqual x upper) ->
            lessOrEqual supremum upper))

open CompleteOrderedRealField

oneN : Nat
oneN =
  suc zero

twoN : Nat
twoN =
  suc oneN

subtract :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
subtract reals x y =
  add reals x (negate reals y)

divide :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
divide reals x y =
  multiply reals x (inverse reals y)

square :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R
square reals x =
  multiply reals x x

StrictLess :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
StrictLess reals x y =
  lessOrEqual reals x y and x != y

CloseTo :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
CloseTo reals center radius x =
  StrictLess reals
    (subtract reals center radius)
    x
  and
  StrictLess reals
    x
    (add reals center radius)

naturalPower :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  Nat ->
  R
naturalPower reals x zero =
  oneR reals
naturalPower reals x (suc n) =
  multiply reals
    (naturalPower reals x n)
    x

factorial : Nat -> Nat
factorial zero =
  oneN
factorial (suc n) =
  suc n * factorial n

sumFirst :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Nat ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  R
sumFirst reals zero term =
  zeroR reals
sumFirst reals (suc n) term =
  add reals
    (sumFirst reals n term)
    (term n)

ConvergesTo :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  R ->
  Set
ConvergesTo {R} reals sequence limit =
  (epsilon : R) ->
  StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) epsilon ->
  Exists Nat
    (\ cutoff ->
      (n : Nat) ->
      cutoff <=N n ->
      CloseTo reals limit epsilon (sequence n))

SeriesHasSum :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  R ->
  Set
SeriesHasSum reals terms limit =
  ConvergesTo reals
    (\ n -> sumFirst reals n terms)
    limit

exponentialTerm :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  Nat ->
  R
exponentialTerm reals x n =
  divide reals
    (naturalPower reals x n)
    (fromNat reals (factorial n))

record StandardExponentialAndMaximum
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) : Set1 where
  field
    exponential : R -> R
    maximum : R -> R -> R

    exponential-series :
      (x : R) ->
      SeriesHasSum reals
        (exponentialTerm reals x)
        (exponential x)

    maximum-left :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual reals y x ->
      maximum x y == x
    maximum-right :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual reals x y ->
      maximum x y == y

open StandardExponentialAndMaximum

midpoint :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Nat ->
  Nat ->
  R
midpoint reals lower upper pieces index =
  let
    step =
      divide reals
        (subtract reals upper lower)
        (fromNat reals pieces)
    halfStep =
      divide reals
        step
        (fromNat reals twoN)
  in
  add reals lower
    (add reals
      (multiply reals
        (fromNat reals index)
        step)
      halfStep)

rectangleMidpointSum :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  (R -> R -> R) ->
  Nat ->
  R
rectangleMidpointSum reals xLower xUpper yLower yUpper function pieces =
  let
    xStep =
      divide reals
        (subtract reals xUpper xLower)
        (fromNat reals pieces)
    yStep =
      divide reals
        (subtract reals yUpper yLower)
        (fromNat reals pieces)
  in
  sumFirst reals pieces
    (\ i ->
      multiply reals
        (sumFirst reals pieces
          (\ j ->
            multiply reals
              (function
                (midpoint reals xLower xUpper pieces i)
                (midpoint reals yLower yUpper pieces j))
              yStep))
        xStep)

RectangleIntegralValue :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  (R -> R -> R) ->
  R ->
  Set
RectangleIntegralValue
  reals xLower xUpper yLower yUpper function value =
  ConvergesTo reals
    (\ n ->
      rectangleMidpointSum reals
        xLower
        xUpper
        yLower
        yUpper
        function
        (suc n))
    value

module Putnam1989A2Statement
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R)
  (analysis : StandardExponentialAndMaximum reals) where

  parameterizedIntegrand : R -> R -> R -> R -> R
  parameterizedIntegrand a b x y =
    exponential analysis
      (maximum analysis
        (square reals (multiply reals b x))
        (square reals (multiply reals a y)))

  solution : R -> R -> R
  solution a b =
    divide reals
      (subtract reals
        (exponential analysis
          (square reals (multiply reals a b)))
        (oneR reals))
      (multiply reals a b)

  proposition : R -> R -> Set
  proposition a b =
    StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) a ->
    StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) b ->
    RectangleIntegralValue reals
      (zeroR reals)
      a
      (zeroR reals)
      b
      (parameterizedIntegrand a b)
      (solution a b)

putnam-1989-a2 : Set1
putnam-1989-a2 =
  (R : Set) ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) ->
  (analysis : StandardExponentialAndMaximum reals) ->
  (a b : R) ->
  Putnam1989A2Statement.proposition reals analysis a b

(*
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1989_a2:
  evaluation of a double integral of the exponential of a maximum over a
  positive rectangular region. This file contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open pred_setTheory realTheory transcTheory integrationTheory;

val putnam_1989_a2 =
  ``!a b : real.
      0 < a /\ 0 < b
      ==>
      integration$integral (interval [0, a])
        (\x : real.
           integration$integral (interval [0, b])
             (\y : real.
                exp
                  (max (b pow 2 * x pow 2)
                       (a pow 2 * y pow 2)))) =
      (exp (a pow 2 * b pow 2) - 1) / (a * b)``;

$(
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact
  putnam_1989_a2: evaluation of an iterated real integral over a positive
  rectangle whose integrand is the exponential of the maximum of two
  quadratic terms. This file contains no proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  The nested S. binders are set.mm's real Lebesgue integrals. The closed
  intervals agree directly with the Isabelle rectangle and Rocq bounds;
  replacing them by the Lean source's open intervals changes only boundary
  sets of Lebesgue measure zero.

  The conditional if ( u <_ v , v , u ) is max(u,v). The right side is the
  explicit solution defined by the Rocq source and recorded in the Lean and
  Isabelle solution annotations. The final declaration is the single
  unproved $a corpus statement; this database contains no $p proof statement.
$)

${
  $d a b x y $.

  putnambench-putnam-1989-a2 $a |-
    A. a e. RR A. b e. RR
      (
        (
          0 < a
          /\
          0 < b
        )
        ->
        S. ( 0 [,] a )
          (
            S. ( 0 [,] b )
              (
                exp
                `
                if (
                  (
                    ( b ^ 2 )
                    x.
                    ( x ^ 2 )
                  )
                  <_
                  (
                    ( a ^ 2 )
                    x.
                    ( y ^ 2 )
                  ) ,
                  (
                    ( a ^ 2 )
                    x.
                    ( y ^ 2 )
                  ) ,
                  (
                    ( b ^ 2 )
                    x.
                    ( x ^ 2 )
                  )
                )
              )
              _d y
          )
          _d x
        =
        (
          (
            exp
            `
            (
              ( a ^ 2 )
              x.
              ( b ^ 2 )
            )
          )
          -
          1
        )
        /
        ( a x. b )
      )
  $.
$}

begin

::$P-
theorem
  for a,b being Real st 0 < a & 0 < b holds
    ex I,J being Subset of REAL,
       outer being Function of REAL,REAL st
      I = {x where x is Real : 0 <= x & x <= a} &
      J = {y where y is Real : 0 <= y & y <= b} &

title: putnam_1989_a2
content:
% Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1989_a2:
% for positive real a and b, the iterated integral of exp(max((b*x)^2,
% (a*y)^2)) over [0,a] x [0,b] has the stated closed form. This file contains no proof.

putnam_1989_a2: THEORY
BEGIN
  real_function: TYPE = [real -> real]
  real_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> real]

  safe_div(numerator, denominator: real): real =
    IF denominator = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      numerator / denominator
    ENDIF

  nat_factorial(index: nat): RECURSIVE nat =
    IF index = 0 THEN
      1
    ELSE
      index * nat_factorial(index - 1)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE index

  exponential_partial(x: real, count: nat): RECURSIVE real =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      LET index: nat = count - 1 IN
        exponential_partial(x, count - 1)
          + safe_div(
              x ^ index,
              nat_factorial(index) :: real)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  sequence_converges_to(
      sequence: real_sequence,
      value: real): bool =
    FORALL (epsilon_value: posreal):
      EXISTS (cutoff: nat):
        FORALL (index: nat):
          cutoff <= index IMPLIES
            abs(sequence(index) - value) < epsilon_value

  real_exponential(x: real): real =
    epsilon(
      LAMBDA (value: real):
        sequence_converges_to(
          LAMBDA (count: nat):
            exponential_partial(x, count),
          value))

  real_max(left, right: real): real =
    IF left >= right THEN left ELSE right ENDIF

  valid_tagged_partition(
      left, right: real,
      points, tags: real_sequence,
      count: nat): bool =
    count > 0
      AND points(0) = left
      AND points(count) = right
      AND FORALL (index: nat):
        index < count IMPLIES
          (points(index) < points(index + 1)
            AND points(index) <= tags(index)
            AND tags(index) <= points(index + 1))

  mesh_less_than(
      points: real_sequence,
      count: nat,
      bound: real): bool =
    FORALL (index: nat):
      index < count IMPLIES
        points(index + 1) - points(index) < bound

  riemann_sum(
      function_value: real_function,
      points, tags: real_sequence,
      count: nat): RECURSIVE real =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      riemann_sum(
        function_value, points, tags, count - 1)
        + function_value(tags(count - 1))
            * (points(count) - points(count - 1))
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  has_interval_integral(
      function_value: real_function,
      left, right, integral_value: real): bool =
    left < right
      AND FORALL (epsilon_value: posreal):
        EXISTS (mesh_bound: posreal):
          FORALL
              (points, tags: real_sequence),
              (count: nat):
            (valid_tagged_partition(
                left, right, points, tags, count)
              AND mesh_less_than(
                points, count, mesh_bound))
            IMPLIES
              abs(
                riemann_sum(
                  function_value, points, tags, count)
                  - integral_value)
                < epsilon_value

  interval_integral(
      function_value: real_function,
      left, right: real): real =
    IF left = right THEN
      0
    ELSIF left < right THEN
      IF EXISTS (integral_value: real):
          has_interval_integral(
            function_value, left, right, integral_value)
      THEN
        epsilon(
          LAMBDA (integral_value: real):
            has_interval_integral(
              function_value, left, right, integral_value))
      ELSE
        0
      ENDIF
    ELSE
      IF EXISTS (integral_value: real):
          has_interval_integral(
            function_value, right, left, integral_value)
      THEN
        -epsilon(
          LAMBDA (integral_value: real):
            has_interval_integral(
              function_value, right, left, integral_value))
      ELSE
        0
      ENDIF
    ENDIF

  integrand(a, b, x, y: real): real =
    real_exponential(
      real_max((b * x) ^ 2, (a * y) ^ 2))

  inner_integral(a, b, x: real): real =
    interval_integral(
      LAMBDA (y: real): integrand(a, b, x, y),
      0,
      b)

  iterated_integral(a, b: real): real =
    interval_integral(
      LAMBDA (x: real): inner_integral(a, b, x),
      0,
      a)

  putnam_1989_a2_solution(a, b: real): real =
    safe_div(
      real_exponential((a * b) ^ 2) - 1,
      a * b)

  putnam_1989_a2: bool =
    FORALL (a, b: real):
      (a > 0 AND b > 0)
        IMPLIES
          iterated_integral(a, b)
            = putnam_1989_a2_solution(a, b)
END putnam_1989_a2

title: putnam_1989_a3
putnam_1989_a3
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1989_a3:
;; every complex root of 11*z^10 + 10*i*z^9 + 10*i*z - 11 has modulus 1.
;; This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))

;; Writing z=x+i*y turns the hypothesis into two integer-polynomial
;; equalities and the conclusion into x^2+y^2=1. Thus a counterexample is a
;; first-order formula over real closed fields, so a real counterexample
;; exists if and only if one exists over the real algebraic numbers.
;;
;; Every pair of real algebraic numbers lies in Q(alpha) for one real
;; algebraic alpha. A rational polynomial and rational isolating interval
;; encode alpha, while rational polynomials in alpha encode x and y. The
;; Sturm-Tarski queries below decide equality at alpha exactly. Consequently,
;; universal closure of the final predicate covers every complex z without
;; narrowing the source domain to ACL2's complex rationals.

;; Rational polynomials in alpha use descending coefficient order.

(defun putnam-1989-a3-rp-p (polynomial)
  (if (consp polynomial)
      (and (rationalp (car polynomial))
           (putnam-1989-a3-rp-p (cdr polynomial)))
    (equal polynomial nil)))

(defun putnam-1989-a3-rp-normalize (polynomial)
  (if (consp polynomial)
      (if (equal (car polynomial) 0)
          (putnam-1989-a3-rp-normalize (cdr polynomial))
        polynomial)
    nil))

(defun putnam-1989-a3-rp-neg (polynomial)
  (if (consp polynomial)
      (cons (- (car polynomial))
            (putnam-1989-a3-rp-neg (cdr polynomial)))
    nil))

(defun putnam-1989-a3-rp-add-raw (left right)
  (declare (xargs :measure (+ (acl2-count left) (acl2-count right))))
  (cond
   ((endp left) right)
   ((endp right) left)
   ((< (len left) (len right))
    (cons (car right)
          (putnam-1989-a3-rp-add-raw left (cdr right))))
   ((< (len right) (len left))
    (cons (car left)
          (putnam-1989-a3-rp-add-raw (cdr left) right)))
   (t
    (cons (+ (car left) (car right))
          (putnam-1989-a3-rp-add-raw
           (cdr left) (cdr right))))))

(defun putnam-1989-a3-rp-add (left right)
  (putnam-1989-a3-rp-normalize
   (putnam-1989-a3-rp-add-raw left right)))

(defun putnam-1989-a3-rp-sub (left right)
  (putnam-1989-a3-rp-add
   left (putnam-1989-a3-rp-neg right)))

(defun putnam-1989-a3-rp-scale (scalar polynomial)
  (if (consp polynomial)
      (cons (* scalar (car polynomial))
            (putnam-1989-a3-rp-scale scalar (cdr polynomial)))
    nil))

(defun putnam-1989-a3-zeroes (count)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix count)))
  (if (zp count)
      nil
    (cons 0 (putnam-1989-a3-zeroes (- count 1)))))

(defun putnam-1989-a3-rp-scale-shift (scalar polynomial shift)
  (append (putnam-1989-a3-rp-scale scalar polynomial)
          (putnam-1989-a3-zeroes shift)))

(defun putnam-1989-a3-rp-mul-raw (left right)
  (if (consp left)
      (putnam-1989-a3-rp-add
       (putnam-1989-a3-rp-scale-shift
        (car left) right (len (cdr left)))
       (putnam-1989-a3-rp-mul-raw (cdr left) right))
    nil))

(defun putnam-1989-a3-rp-mul (left right)
  (putnam-1989-a3-rp-normalize
   (putnam-1989-a3-rp-mul-raw left right)))

(defun putnam-1989-a3-rp-eval-aux
    (polynomial value accumulator)
  (if (consp polynomial)
      (putnam-1989-a3-rp-eval-aux
       (cdr polynomial)
       value
       (+ (* accumulator value) (car polynomial)))
    accumulator))

(defun putnam-1989-a3-rp-eval (polynomial value)
  (putnam-1989-a3-rp-eval-aux polynomial value 0))

(defun putnam-1989-a3-rp-derivative-aux
    (polynomial degree)
  (if (consp polynomial)
      (if (zp degree)
          nil
        (cons (* degree (car polynomial))
              (putnam-1989-a3-rp-derivative-aux
               (cdr polynomial) (- degree 1))))
    nil))

(defun putnam-1989-a3-rp-derivative (polynomial)
  (let ((polynomial
         (putnam-1989-a3-rp-normalize polynomial)))
    (putnam-1989-a3-rp-normalize
     (putnam-1989-a3-rp-derivative-aux
      polynomial (nfix (- (len polynomial) 1))))))

(defun putnam-1989-a3-rp-rem-fuel
    (dividend divisor fuel)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix fuel)))
  (let ((dividend
         (putnam-1989-a3-rp-normalize dividend))
        (divisor
         (putnam-1989-a3-rp-normalize divisor)))
    (if (or (zp fuel)
            (endp divisor)
            (< (len dividend) (len divisor)))
        dividend
      (putnam-1989-a3-rp-rem-fuel
       (putnam-1989-a3-rp-sub
        dividend
        (putnam-1989-a3-rp-scale-shift
         (/ (car dividend) (car divisor))
         divisor
         (- (len dividend) (len divisor))))
       divisor
       (- fuel 1)))))

(defun putnam-1989-a3-rp-rem (dividend divisor)
  (putnam-1989-a3-rp-rem-fuel
   dividend
   divisor
   (+ 1 (len (putnam-1989-a3-rp-normalize dividend)))))

(defun putnam-1989-a3-rp-sturm-tail
    (previous current fuel)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix fuel)))
  (let ((current (putnam-1989-a3-rp-normalize current)))
    (if (or (zp fuel) (endp current))
        nil
      (cons
       current
       (putnam-1989-a3-rp-sturm-tail
        current
        (putnam-1989-a3-rp-neg
         (putnam-1989-a3-rp-rem previous current))
        (- fuel 1))))))

(defun putnam-1989-a3-rp-sturm-sequence
    (polynomial second)
  (let ((polynomial
         (putnam-1989-a3-rp-normalize polynomial))
        (second
         (putnam-1989-a3-rp-normalize second)))
    (if (endp polynomial)
        nil
      (cons
       polynomial
       (if (endp second)
           nil
         (cons
          second
          (putnam-1989-a3-rp-sturm-tail
           polynomial
           second
           (+ 1 (len polynomial) (len second)))))))))

(defun putnam-1989-a3-rational-sign (value)
  (cond ((< value 0) -1)
        ((< 0 value) 1)
        (t 0)))

(defun putnam-1989-a3-rp-variations-aux
    (polynomials value previous-sign)
  (if (consp polynomials)
      (let ((sign
             (putnam-1989-a3-rational-sign
              (putnam-1989-a3-rp-eval
               (car polynomials) value))))
        (if (equal sign 0)
            (putnam-1989-a3-rp-variations-aux
             (cdr polynomials) value previous-sign)
          (+ (if (and (not (equal previous-sign 0))
                      (not (equal sign previous-sign)))
                 1
               0)
             (putnam-1989-a3-rp-variations-aux
              (cdr polynomials) value sign))))
    0))

(defun putnam-1989-a3-rp-variations
    (polynomials value)
  (putnam-1989-a3-rp-variations-aux
   polynomials value 0))

(defun putnam-1989-a3-rp-cauchy-index
    (polynomial second lower upper)
  (let ((sequence
         (putnam-1989-a3-rp-sturm-sequence
          polynomial second)))
    (- (putnam-1989-a3-rp-variations sequence lower)
       (putnam-1989-a3-rp-variations sequence upper))))

(defun putnam-1989-a3-rp-root-count
    (polynomial lower upper)
  (putnam-1989-a3-rp-cauchy-index
   polynomial
   (putnam-1989-a3-rp-derivative polynomial)
   lower
   upper))

(defun putnam-1989-a3-primitive-p
    (primitive lower upper)
  (and
   (putnam-1989-a3-rp-p primitive)
   (consp (putnam-1989-a3-rp-normalize primitive))
   (rationalp lower)
   (rationalp upper)
   (< lower upper)
   (not
    (equal
     (putnam-1989-a3-rp-eval primitive lower)
     0))
   (not
    (equal
     (putnam-1989-a3-rp-eval primitive upper)
     0))
   (equal
    (putnam-1989-a3-rp-root-count
     primitive lower upper)
    1)
   (not
    (equal
     (putnam-1989-a3-rp-cauchy-index
      primitive
      (putnam-1989-a3-rp-mul
       (putnam-1989-a3-rp-derivative primitive)
       (putnam-1989-a3-rp-derivative primitive))
      lower

   primitive

    polynomial)
   lower

  (if (zp exponent)

     value

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; _*_)

infix 4 _!=_
infixr 3 _and_
infixr 2 _or_

data Bottom : Set where

Not : Set -> Set
Not A =
  A -> Bottom

_!=_ : {A : Set} -> A -> A -> Set
x != y =
  Not (x == y)

record _and_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data _or_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  left  : A -> A or B
  right : B -> A or B

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

record CompleteOrderedRealField (R : Set) : Set1 where
  field
    zeroR oneR : R
    add multiply : R -> R -> R
    negate inverse squareRoot : R -> R
    lessOrEqual : R -> R -> Set
    fromNat : Nat -> R

    one-not-zero :
      oneR != zeroR

    add-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> add x y == add y x
    add-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      add (add x y) z == add x (add y z)
    add-zero :
      (x : R) -> add x zeroR == x
    add-inverse :
      (x : R) -> add x (negate x) == zeroR

    multiply-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> multiply x y == multiply y x
    multiply-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply (multiply x y) z ==
      multiply x (multiply y z)
    multiply-one :
      (x : R) -> multiply x oneR == x
    multiply-zero :
      (x : R) -> multiply x zeroR == zeroR
    distribute :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply x (add y z) ==
      add (multiply x y) (multiply x z)
    inverse-zero :
      inverse zeroR == zeroR
    multiply-inverse :
      (x : R) ->
      x != zeroR ->
      multiply x (inverse x) == oneR

    order-reflexive :
      (x : R) -> lessOrEqual x x
    order-transitive :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y z ->
      lessOrEqual x z
    order-antisymmetric :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y x ->
      x == y
    order-total :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y or lessOrEqual y x
    add-order :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual (add z x) (add z y)
    multiply-nonnegative :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR x ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR y ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR (multiply x y)
    zero-less-than-one :
      lessOrEqual zeroR oneR and zeroR != oneR

    fromNat-zero :
      fromNat zero == zeroR
    fromNat-successor :
      (n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (suc n) == add (fromNat n) oneR
    fromNat-addition :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m + n) == add (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-multiplication :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m * n) == multiply (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-injective :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat m == fromNat n ->
      m == n

    archimedean :
      (x : R) ->
      Exists Nat (\ n -> lessOrEqual x (fromNat n))
    least-upper-bound :
      (P : R -> Set) ->
      Exists R P ->
      Exists R
        (\ upper ->
          (x : R) ->
          P x ->
          lessOrEqual x upper) ->
      Exists R
        (\ supremum ->
          ((x : R) ->
            P x ->
            lessOrEqual x supremum)
          and
          ((upper : R) ->
            ((x : R) ->
              P x ->
              lessOrEqual x upper) ->
            lessOrEqual supremum upper))

    square-root-nonnegative :
      (x : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR (squareRoot x)
    square-root-square :
      (x : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR x ->
      multiply (squareRoot x) (squareRoot x) == x
    square-root-nonpositive :
      (x : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x zeroR ->
      squareRoot x == zeroR
    square-root-unique :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR y ->
      multiply y y == x ->
      y == squareRoot x

open CompleteOrderedRealField

record Complex (R : Set) : Set where
  constructor complex
  field
    realPart      : R
    imaginaryPart : R

open Complex

complexZero :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Complex R
complexZero reals =
  complex (zeroR reals) (zeroR reals)

complexOne :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Complex R
complexOne reals =
  complex (oneR reals) (zeroR reals)

embedNatural :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Nat ->
  Complex R
embedNatural reals n =
  complex (fromNat reals n) (zeroR reals)

imaginaryUnit :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Complex R
imaginaryUnit reals =
  complex (zeroR reals) (oneR reals)

complexAdd :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Complex R ->
  Complex R ->
  Complex R
complexAdd reals z w =
  complex
    (add reals (realPart z) (realPart w))
    (add reals (imaginaryPart z) (imaginaryPart w))

complexNegate :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Complex R ->
  Complex R
complexNegate reals z =
  complex
    (negate reals (realPart z))
    (negate reals (imaginaryPart z))

complexSubtract :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Complex R ->
  Complex R ->
  Complex R
complexSubtract reals z w =
  complexAdd reals z (complexNegate reals w)

complexMultiply :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Complex R ->
  Complex R ->
  Complex R
complexMultiply reals z w =
  complex
    (add reals
      (multiply reals (realPart z) (realPart w))
      (negate reals
        (multiply reals (imaginaryPart z) (imaginaryPart w))))
    (add reals
      (multiply reals (realPart z) (imaginaryPart w))
      (multiply reals (imaginaryPart z) (realPart w)))

complexPower :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Complex R ->
  Nat ->
  Complex R
complexPower reals z zero =
  complexOne reals
complexPower reals z (suc exponent) =
  complexMultiply reals
    (complexPower reals z exponent)
    z

complexSquaredModulus :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Complex R ->
  R
complexSquaredModulus reals z =
  add reals
    (multiply reals (realPart z) (realPart z))
    (multiply reals (imaginaryPart z) (imaginaryPart z))

complexModulus :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Complex R ->
  R
complexModulus reals z =
  squareRoot reals (complexSquaredModulus reals z)

oneN : Nat
oneN =
  suc zero

twoN : Nat
twoN =
  suc oneN

threeN : Nat
threeN =
  suc twoN

fourN : Nat
fourN =
  suc threeN

fiveN : Nat
fiveN =
  suc fourN

sixN : Nat
sixN =
  suc fiveN

sevenN : Nat
sevenN =
  suc sixN

eightN : Nat
eightN =
  suc sevenN

nineN : Nat
nineN =
  suc eightN

tenN : Nat
tenN =
  suc nineN

elevenN : Nat
elevenN =
  suc tenN

module Putnam1989A3Statement
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) where

  tenI : Complex R
  tenI =
    complexMultiply reals
      (embedNatural reals tenN)
      (imaginaryUnit reals)

  polynomialValue : Complex R -> Complex R
  polynomialValue z =
    complexSubtract reals
      (complexAdd reals
        (complexAdd reals
          (complexMultiply reals
            (embedNatural reals elevenN)
            (complexPower reals z tenN))
          (complexMultiply reals
            tenI
            (complexPower reals z nineN)))
        (complexMultiply reals tenI z))
      (embedNatural reals elevenN)

  proposition : Set
  proposition =
    (z : Complex R) ->
    polynomialValue z == complexZero reals ->
    complexModulus reals z == oneR reals

putnam-1989-a3 : Set1
putnam-1989-a3 =
  (R : Set) ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) ->

% Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1989_a3:
% every complex root of 11*z^10 + 10*i*z^9 + 10*i*z - 11 has modulus one.
% This file contains no proof.

putnam_1989_a3: THEORY
BEGIN
  complex: TYPE = [# real_part: real, imag_part: real #]

  complex_zero: complex =
    (# real_part := 0, imag_part := 0 #)

  complex_one: complex =
    (# real_part := 1, imag_part := 0 #)

  complex_i: complex =
    (# real_part := 0, imag_part := 1 #)

  complex_of_real(value: real): complex =
    (# real_part := value, imag_part := 0 #)

  complex_neg(value: complex): complex =
    (# real_part := -real_part(value),
       imag_part := -imag_part(value) #)

  complex_add(left, right: complex): complex =
    (# real_part := real_part(left) + real_part(right),
       imag_part := imag_part(left) + imag_part(right) #)

  complex_sub(left, right: complex): complex =
    complex_add(left, complex_neg(right))

  complex_mul(left, right: complex): complex =
    (# real_part :=
         real_part(left) * real_part(right)
           - imag_part(left) * imag_part(right),
       imag_part :=
         real_part(left) * imag_part(right)
           + imag_part(left) * real_part(right) #)

  complex_power(value: complex, exponent: nat): RECURSIVE complex =
    IF exponent = 0 THEN
      complex_one
    ELSE
      complex_mul(complex_power(value, exponent - 1), value)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE exponent

  nonnegative_square_root(value: real): real =
    IF 0 <= value THEN
      epsilon(
        LAMBDA (root: real):
          0 <= root AND root * root = value)
    ELSE
      0
    ENDIF

  squared_modulus(value: complex): real =
    real_part(value) ^ 2 + imag_part(value) ^ 2

  complex_modulus(value: complex): real =
    nonnegative_square_root(squared_modulus(value))

  polynomial_value(z: complex): complex =
    complex_sub(
      complex_add(
        complex_add(
          complex_mul(
            complex_of_real(11),
            complex_power(z, 10)),
          complex_mul(
            complex_mul(complex_of_real(10), complex_i),
            complex_power(z, 9))),
        complex_mul(
          complex_mul(complex_of_real(10), complex_i),
          z)),
      complex_of_real(11))

  putnam_1989_a3: bool =
    FORALL (z: complex):
      polynomial_value(z) = complex_zero
        IMPLIES complex_modulus(z) = 1
END putnam_1989_a3

import Mathlib

open Nat

-- Needed to make the `ite` below work; one *less* than the default!
-- https://leanprover.zulipchat.com/#narrow/channel/270676-lean4/topic/Success.20is.20not.20monotone.20in.20.60synthInstance.2EmaxSize.60/near/491823649
set_option synthInstance.maxSize 127

/--
Let $\alpha=1+a_1x+a_2x^2+\cdots$ be a formal power series with coefficients in the field of two elements. Let
\[
a_n =
\begin{cases}
1 & \parbox{2in}{if every block of zeros in the binary expansion of $n$ has an even number of zeros in the block} \\[.3in]
0 & \text{otherwise.}
\end{cases}
\]
(For example, $a_{36}=1$ because $36=100100_2$ and $a_{20}=0$ because $20=10100_2.$) Prove that $\alpha^3+x\alpha+1=0.$
-/
theorem putnam_1989_a6
(F : Type*) [Field F] [Fintype F]
(hF : Fintype.card F = 2)
(α : PowerSeries F)
(hα : ∀ n : ℕ, let bin := [1] ++ (digits 2 n) ++ [1]; PowerSeries.coeff n α = ite (∀ i j : Fin bin.length, i < j → bin.get i = 1 → bin.get j = 1 → (∀ k, i < k → k < j → bin.get k = 0) → Even ((j : ℕ) - (i : ℕ) - 1)) 1 0)
: (α ^ 3 + PowerSeries.X * α + 1 = 0) :=
sorry

(* Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1989_a6:
   a binary-defined formal power series over the field with two elements
   satisfies a cubic power-series identity. This file contains no proof. *)

From Stdlib Require Import Arith.PeanoNat Bool.Bool Lists.List.

Import ListNotations.

Record putnam_1989_a6_field : Type := {
  p89_field_carrier : Type;
  p89_field_zero : p89_field_carrier;
  p89_field_one : p89_field_carrier;
  p89_field_add :
    p89_field_carrier -> p89_field_carrier -> p89_field_carrier;
  p89_field_mul :
    p89_field_carrier -> p89_field_carrier -> p89_field_carrier;
  p89_field_opp : p89_field_carrier -> p89_field_carrier;
  p89_field_inv : p89_field_carrier -> p89_field_carrier;
  p89_field_add_assoc :
    forall x y z,
      p89_field_add x (p89_field_add y z) =
      p89_field_add (p89_field_add x y) z;
  p89_field_add_comm :
    forall x y, p89_field_add x y = p89_field_add y x;
  p89_field_add_zero :
    forall x, p89_field_add p89_field_zero x = x;
  p89_field_add_opp :
    forall x, p89_field_add (p89_field_opp x) x = p89_field_zero;
  p89_field_mul_assoc :
    forall x y z,
      p89_field_mul x (p89_field_mul y z) =
      p89_field_mul (p89_field_mul x y) z;
  p89_field_mul_comm :
    forall x y, p89_field_mul x y = p89_field_mul y x;
  p89_field_mul_one :
    forall x, p89_field_mul p89_field_one x = x;
  p89_field_mul_add :
    forall x y z,
      p89_field_mul x (p89_field_add y z) =
      p89_field_add (p89_field_mul x y) (p89_field_mul x z);
  p89_field_zero_neq_one : p89_field_zero <> p89_field_one;
  p89_field_mul_inv :
    forall x,
      x <> p89_field_zero ->
      p89_field_mul (p89_field_inv x) x = p89_field_one
}.

Definition putnam_1989_a6_has_two_elements
    (F : putnam_1989_a6_field) : Prop :=
  forall x : p89_field_carrier F,
    x = p89_field_zero F \/ x = p89_field_one F.

Definition putnam_1989_a6_fps
    (F : putnam_1989_a6_field) : Type :=
  nat -> p89_field_carrier F.

Fixpoint putnam_1989_a6_sum_upto
    (F : putnam_1989_a6_field)
    (n : nat)
    (term : nat -> p89_field_carrier F)
    : p89_field_carrier F :=
  match n with
  | O => term O
  | S k =>
      p89_field_add F
        (putnam_1989_a6_sum_upto F k term)
        (term (S k))
  end.

Definition putnam_1989_a6_fps_add
    (F : putnam_1989_a6_field)
    (a b : putnam_1989_a6_fps F)
    : putnam_1989_a6_fps F :=
  fun n => p89_field_add F (a n) (b n).

Definition putnam_1989_a6_fps_mul
    (F : putnam_1989_a6_field)
    (a b : putnam_1989_a6_fps F)
    : putnam_1989_a6_fps F :=
  fun n =>
    putnam_1989_a6_sum_upto F n
      (fun i => p89_field_mul F (a i) (b (Nat.sub n i))).

Definition putnam_1989_a6_fps_zero
    (F : putnam_1989_a6_field)
    : putnam_1989_a6_fps F :=
  fun _ => p89_field_zero F.

Definition putnam_1989_a6_fps_one
    (F : putnam_1989_a6_field)
    : putnam_1989_a6_fps F :=
  fun n =>
    if Nat.eqb n O
    then p89_field_one F
    else p89_field_zero F.

Definition putnam_1989_a6_fps_X
    (F : putnam_1989_a6_field)
    : putnam_1989_a6_fps F :=
  fun n =>
    if Nat.eqb n 1
    then p89_field_one F
    else p89_field_zero F.

Definition putnam_1989_a6_fps_cube
    (F : putnam_1989_a6_field)
    (a : putnam_1989_a6_fps F)
    : putnam_1989_a6_fps F :=
  putnam_1989_a6_fps_mul F
    (putnam_1989_a6_fps_mul F a a) a.

Definition putnam_1989_a6_fps_eq
    (F : putnam_1989_a6_field)
    (a b : putnam_1989_a6_fps F) : Prop :=
  forall n : nat, a n = b n.

Fixpoint putnam_1989_a6_binary_digits_fuel
    (fuel n : nat) : list nat :=
  match fuel with
  | O => []
  | S fuel' =>
      if Nat.eqb n O
      then []
      else
        Nat.modulo n 2 ::
        putnam_1989_a6_binary_digits_fuel fuel' (Nat.div n 2)
  end.

Definition putnam_1989_a6_binary_digits (n : nat) : list nat :=
  putnam_1989_a6_binary_digits_fuel (S n) n.

Definition putnam_1989_a6_zeros_between
    (bin : list nat) (i j : nat) : bool :=
  forallb
    (fun k =>
      orb
        (negb (andb (Nat.ltb i k) (Nat.ltb k j)))
        (Nat.eqb (nth k bin O) O))
    (seq O (length bin)).

Definition putnam_1989_a6_pair_condition
    (bin : list nat) (i j : nat) : bool :=
  let endpoints_and_zero_block :=
    andb
      (Nat.ltb i j)
      (andb
        (Nat.eqb (nth i bin O) 1)
        (andb
          (Nat.eqb (nth j bin O) 1)
          (putnam_1989_a6_zeros_between bin i j))) in
  orb
    (negb endpoints_and_zero_block)
    (Nat.even (Nat.sub (Nat.sub j i) 1)).

Definition putnam_1989_a6_all_zero_blocks_even
    (bin : list nat) : bool :=
  let indices := seq O (length bin) in
  forallb
    (fun i =>
      forallb
        (fun j => putnam_1989_a6_pair_condition bin i j)
        indices)
    indices.

Definition putnam_1989_a6_coefficient_is_one (n : nat) : bool :=
  putnam_1989_a6_all_zero_blocks_even
    (1 :: (putnam_1989_a6_binary_digits n ++ [1])).

Theorem putnam_1989_a6
    (F : putnam_1989_a6_field)
    (hF : putnam_1989_a6_has_two_elements F)
    (alpha : putnam_1989_a6_fps F)
    (h_alpha :
      forall n : nat,
        alpha n =
          if putnam_1989_a6_coefficient_is_one n
          then p89_field_one F
          else p89_field_zero F) :
  putnam_1989_a6_fps_eq F
    (putnam_1989_a6_fps_add F
      (putnam_1989_a6_fps_add F
        (putnam_1989_a6_fps_cube F alpha)
        (putnam_1989_a6_fps_mul F
          (putnam_1989_a6_fps_X F) alpha))
      (putnam_1989_a6_fps_one F))
    (putnam_1989_a6_fps_zero F).
Admitted.

theorem putnam_1989_a6:
  fixes \<alpha> :: "('a::field) fps"
  and X :: "'a fps"

  and "X \<equiv> Abs_fps (\<lambda> n :: nat. if n = 1 then 1 else 0)"
  assumes hF: "CARD ('a) = 2"

(*
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1989_a6:
  a binary-coefficient formal power series defined by even zero-block lengths
  in binary expansions satisfies a cubic identity. This file contains no proof.
*)

let statement =
  `let binary_digits =
     \(n:num) (ds:num list).
       (!i:num. i < LENGTH ds ==> EL i ds < 2) /\
       ITLIST (\d acc. d + 2 * acc) ds 0 = n /\
       (n = 0 <=> ds = []) /\
       (0 < n ==> LAST ds = 1) in
   let digits =
     \n:num. @ds:num list. binary_digits n ds in
   let good =
     \n:num.
       let bin = CONS 1 (APPEND (digits n) [1]) in
       !i j:num.
         i < LENGTH bin /\
         j < LENGTH bin /\
         i < j /\
         EL i bin = 1 /\
         EL j bin = 1 /\
         (!k:num. i < k /\ k < j ==> EL k bin = 0)
         ==> EVEN (j - i - 1) in
   let ps_add =
     \(a:num->bool) (b:num->bool) (n:num). ~(a n <=> b n) in
   let ps_mul =
     \(a:num->bool) (b:num->bool) (n:num).
       ODD (CARD {k:num | k <= n /\ a k /\ b (n - k)}) in
   let ps_one = \n:num. n = 0 in
   let ps_X = \n:num. n = 1 in
   let alpha = \n:num. good n in
   !n:num.
     ps_add
       (ps_add
         (ps_mul (ps_mul alpha alpha) alpha)
         (ps_mul ps_X alpha))
       ps_one n =
     F`;;

;; Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1989_a6:
;; the binary zero-block coefficient series over the field with two elements
;; satisfies its stated cubic formal-power-series identity. This file contains
;; no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))

;; Every field with two elements is uniquely isomorphic to GF(2), and this
;; isomorphism fixes 0 and 1. Thus bits with arithmetic modulo 2 preserve the
;; source coefficient definition and all formal-power-series operations.
;;
;; The source binary digit list is least-significant-bit first and has a 1
;; adjoined at each end. Scanning the digits from low to high therefore checks
;; exactly that each intervening block of zeroes has even length. The final
;; EVENP check accounts for the adjoined high-end 1.

(defun putnam-1989-a6-even-zero-blocks-aux (n zero-count fuel)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix fuel)))
  (if (or (zp n) (zp fuel))
      (evenp zero-count)
    (if (equal (mod n 2) 0)
        (putnam-1989-a6-even-zero-blocks-aux
         (floor n 2) (+ zero-count 1) (- fuel 1))
      (and
       (evenp zero-count)
       (putnam-1989-a6-even-zero-blocks-aux
        (floor n 2) 0 (- fuel 1))))))

(defun putnam-1989-a6-alpha-coefficient (n)
  (if (and (natp n)
           (putnam-1989-a6-even-zero-blocks-aux n 0 n))
      1
    0))

;; For fixed I and TOTAL, sum alpha_i alpha_j alpha_(TOTAL-j) over
;; 0 <= j <= TOTAL. All these sums are finite coefficient convolutions.

(defun putnam-1989-a6-cube-row (i total j)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix j)))
  (let ((term
         (* (putnam-1989-a6-alpha-coefficient i)
            (putnam-1989-a6-alpha-coefficient j)
            (putnam-1989-a6-alpha-coefficient (- total j)))))
    (if (zp j)
        term
      (+ term
         (putnam-1989-a6-cube-row
          i total (- j 1))))))

;; Sum the rows for 0 <= i <= n. This is the coefficient of x^n in alpha^3.

(defun putnam-1989-a6-cube-coefficient-aux (n i)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix i)))
  (let* ((remaining (- n i))
         (row
          (putnam-1989-a6-cube-row
           i remaining remaining)))
    (if (zp i)
        row
      (+ row
         (putnam-1989-a6-cube-coefficient-aux
          n (- i 1))))))

(defun putnam-1989-a6-cube-coefficient (n)
  (if (natp n)
      (putnam-1989-a6-cube-coefficient-aux n n)
    0))

;; Equality of formal power series is coefficientwise equality. The universal
;; closure in N of this predicate is therefore exactly
;;
;;   alpha^3 + X*alpha + 1 = 0
;;
;; over GF(2). Alpha has been eliminated only because the source hypotheses
;; determine every one of its coefficients uniquely.

(defun putnambench-putnam-1989-a6-statement (n)
  (implies
   (natp n)
   (equal
    (mod
     (+ (putnam-1989-a6-cube-coefficient n)
        (if (zp n)
            0
          (putnam-1989-a6-alpha-coefficient (- n 1)))
        (if (equal n 0) 1 0))
     2)
    0)))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

title: putnam_1989_a6
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1989_a6:
-- the binary-digit formal power series over the field with two elements
-- satisfies alpha cubed plus X times alpha plus one equals zero.
-- This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

open import Agda.Builtin.Bool using (Bool; false; true)
open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.List using (List; []; _∷_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using
  (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; _*_; _-_; div-helper; mod-helper)

infix 4 _!=_

data Bottom : Set where

Not : Set -> Set
Not A =
  A -> Bottom

_!=_ : {A : Set} -> A -> A -> Set
x != y =
  Not (x == y)

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

data Fin : Nat -> Set where
  fzero : {n : Nat} -> Fin (suc n)
  fsuc  : {n : Nat} -> Fin n -> Fin (suc n)

record HasCardinality
  {A : Set}
  (cardinality : Nat) :
  Set where

  field
    enumerate :
      Fin cardinality ->
      A
    enumeration-complete :
      (x : A) ->
      Exists (Fin cardinality)
        (\ index -> enumerate index == x)
    enumeration-injective :
      (left-index right-index : Fin cardinality) ->
      enumerate left-index == enumerate right-index ->
      left-index == right-index

record Field (F : Set) : Set1 where
  field
    zeroF oneF : F
    add multiply : F -> F -> F
    negate inverse : F -> F

    one-not-zero :
      oneF != zeroF

    add-commutative :
      (x y : F) ->
      add x y == add y x
    add-associative :
      (x y z : F) ->
      add (add x y) z == add x (add y z)
    add-zero :
      (x : F) ->
      add x zeroF == x
    add-inverse :
      (x : F) ->
      add x (negate x) == zeroF

    multiply-commutative :
      (x y : F) ->
      multiply x y == multiply y x
    multiply-associative :
      (x y z : F) ->
      multiply (multiply x y) z ==
      multiply x (multiply y z)
    multiply-one :
      (x : F) ->
      multiply x oneF == x
    multiply-zero :
      (x : F) ->
      multiply x zeroF == zeroF
    distribute :
      (x y z : F) ->
      multiply x (add y z) ==
      add (multiply x y) (multiply x z)
    inverse-zero :
      inverse zeroF == zeroF
    multiply-inverse :
      (x : F) ->
      x != zeroF ->
      multiply x (inverse x) == oneF

open Field

oneN : Nat
oneN =
  suc zero

twoN : Nat
twoN =
  suc oneN

threeN : Nat
threeN =
  suc twoN

natLess : Nat -> Nat -> Bool
natLess zero zero =
  false
natLess zero (suc n) =
  true
natLess (suc m) zero =
  false
natLess (suc m) (suc n) =
  natLess m n

naturalDiv : Nat -> Nat -> Nat
naturalDiv numerator zero =
  zero
naturalDiv numerator (suc denominator) =
  div-helper zero denominator numerator denominator

naturalMod : Nat -> Nat -> Nat
naturalMod numerator zero =
  zero
naturalMod numerator (suc denominator) =
  mod-helper zero denominator numerator denominator

append : {A : Set} -> List A -> List A -> List A
append [] right =
  right
append (x ∷ left) right =
  x ∷ append left right

binaryDigitsWithFuel : Nat -> Nat -> List Nat
binaryDigitsWithFuel zero n =
  []
binaryDigitsWithFuel (suc fuel) zero =
  []
binaryDigitsWithFuel (suc fuel) (suc n) =
  naturalMod (suc n) twoN ∷
  binaryDigitsWithFuel fuel (naturalDiv (suc n) twoN)

binaryDigits : Nat -> List Nat
binaryDigits zero =
  []
binaryDigits (suc n) =
  binaryDigitsWithFuel (suc n) (suc n)

toggle : Bool -> Bool
toggle false =
  true
toggle true =
  false

evenZeroBlocksFrom : Bool -> List Nat -> Bool
evenZeroBlocksFrom parity [] =
  true
evenZeroBlocksFrom parity (zero ∷ digits) =
  evenZeroBlocksFrom (toggle parity) digits
evenZeroBlocksFrom false (suc digit ∷ digits) =
  evenZeroBlocksFrom false digits
evenZeroBlocksFrom true (suc digit ∷ digits) =
  false

augmentedBinaryDigits : Nat -> List Nat
augmentedBinaryDigits n =
  oneN ∷ append (binaryDigits n) (oneN ∷ [])

everyZeroBlockEven : Nat -> Bool
everyZeroBlockEven n =
  evenZeroBlocksFrom false (augmentedBinaryDigits n)

PowerSeries : Set -> Set
PowerSeries F =
  Nat -> F

SeriesEqual :
  {F : Set} ->
  PowerSeries F ->
  PowerSeries F ->
  Set
SeriesEqual left right =
  (n : Nat) ->
  left n == right n

seriesZero :
  {F : Set} ->
  Field F ->
  PowerSeries F
seriesZero algebra n =
  zeroF algebra

seriesOne :
  {F : Set} ->
  Field F ->
  PowerSeries F
seriesOne algebra zero =
  oneF algebra
seriesOne algebra (suc n) =
  zeroF algebra

seriesX :
  {F : Set} ->
  Field F ->
  PowerSeries F
seriesX algebra zero =
  zeroF algebra
seriesX algebra (suc zero) =
  oneF algebra
seriesX algebra (suc (suc n)) =
  zeroF algebra

seriesAdd :
  {F : Set} ->
  Field F ->
  PowerSeries F ->
  PowerSeries F ->
  PowerSeries F
seriesAdd algebra left right n =
  add algebra (left n) (right n)

sumThrough :
  {F : Set} ->
  Field F ->
  Nat ->
  (Nat -> F) ->
  F
sumThrough algebra zero term =
  term zero
sumThrough algebra (suc n) term =
  add algebra
    (sumThrough algebra n term)
    (term (suc n))

seriesMultiply :
  {F : Set} ->
  Field F ->
  PowerSeries F ->
  PowerSeries F ->
  PowerSeries F
seriesMultiply algebra left right n =
  sumThrough algebra n
    (\ k ->
      multiply algebra
        (left k)
        (right (n - k)))

seriesPower :
  {F : Set} ->
  Field F ->
  PowerSeries F ->
  Nat ->
  PowerSeries F
seriesPower algebra series zero =
  seriesOne algebra
seriesPower algebra series (suc n) =
  seriesMultiply algebra
    (seriesPower algebra series n)
    series

coefficientValue :
  {F : Set} ->
  Field F ->
  Nat ->
  F
coefficientValue algebra n with everyZeroBlockEven n
... | false =
  zeroF algebra
... | true =
  oneF algebra

CoefficientSpecification :
  {F : Set} ->
  Field F ->
  PowerSeries F ->
  Set
CoefficientSpecification algebra alpha =
  (n : Nat) ->
  alpha n == coefficientValue algebra n

formalEquation :
  {F : Set} ->
  Field F ->
  PowerSeries F ->
  Set
formalEquation algebra alpha =
  SeriesEqual
    (seriesAdd algebra
      (seriesAdd algebra
        (seriesPower algebra alpha threeN)
        (seriesMultiply algebra
          (seriesX algebra)
          alpha))
      (seriesOne algebra))
    (seriesZero algebra)

putnam-1989-a6 : Set1
putnam-1989-a6 =
  (F : Set) ->
  (algebra : Field F) ->
  HasCardinality {A = F} twoN ->
  (alpha : PowerSeries F) ->
  CoefficientSpecification algebra alpha ->
  formalEquation algebra alpha

(*
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1989_a6:
  a binary-zero-block formal power series over a field of two elements
  satisfies a cubic equation. This file contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open arithmeticTheory listTheory numposrepTheory pred_setTheory;
open groupTheory ringTheory;

val putnam_1989_a6 =
  ``!(r : 'a ring) (alpha : num -> 'a).
      let series_zero =
        \n : num. r.sum.id
      in
      let series_one =
        \n : num. if n = 0 then r.prod.id else r.sum.id
      in
      let series_X =
        \n : num. if n = 1 then r.prod.id else r.sum.id
      in
      let series_add =
        \f g : num -> 'a. \n : num. r.sum.op (f n) (g n)
      in
      let series_mul =
        \f g : num -> 'a. \n : num.
          ITSET
            (\i acc.
               r.sum.op (r.prod.op (f i) (g (n - i))) acc)
            (count (SUC n))
            r.sum.id
      in
      let coefficient =
        \n : num.
          let digits =
            if n = 0 then [] else REVERSE (num_to_bin_list n)
          in
          let bin = [1] ++ digits ++ [1]
          in
            if
              !i j : num.
                i < LENGTH bin /\
                j < LENGTH bin /\
                i < j /\
                EL i bin = 1 /\
                EL j bin = 1 /\
                (!k : num.
                   i < k /\ k < j ==> EL k bin = 0)
                ==>
                EVEN (j - i - 1)
            then r.prod.id
            else r.sum.id
      in
        Ring r /\
        Group (r.prod excluding r.sum.id) /\
        FINITE r.carrier /\
        CARD r.carrier = 2 /\
        (!n : num. alpha n = coefficient n)
        ==>
        series_add
          (series_add
             (series_mul (series_mul alpha alpha) alpha)
             (series_mul series_X alpha))
          series_one =
        series_zero``;

$(
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact
  putnam_1989_a6: a formal power series over a field of two elements,
  defined by even-length zero blocks in binary expansions, satisfies a
  cubic power-series identity. This file contains no proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  P89A6Good is the set of nonnegative integers whose augmented little-endian
  binary digit list [1] ++ digits(2,n) ++ [1] has an even number of zeros
  between every pair of consecutive ones. For positive n, l is its exact
  binary length; for n = 0, l = 0. Positions 0 and l+1 are the two sentinel
  ones, while position i with 1 <= i <= l is the (i-1)-st binary digit.

  PwSer1 ` F is SetMM's complete univariate formal-power-series ring over the
  arbitrary field structure F, coe1 is its full NN0-indexed coefficient map,
  and var1 ` F is the series variable X. Thus the hypothesis defines every
  coefficient of alpha exactly as in the sources, and the conclusion is
  alpha^3 + X*alpha + 1 = 0 in that power-series ring. All declarations are
  unproved $a statement encodings; this database contains no $p proof
  declaration.
$)

$c P89A6Good $.

p89a6-good-syntax $a class P89A6Good $.

${
  $d i j k l n $.

  p89a6-good-definition $a |- P89A6Good =
    {
      n e. NN0 |
      E. l e. NN0
        (
          (
            (
              n = 0
              /\
              l = 0
            )
            \/
            (
              n e. NN
              /\
              (
                ( 2 ^ ( l - 1 ) ) <_ n
                /\
                n < ( 2 ^ l )
              )
            )
          )
          /\
          A. i e. ( 0 ... ( l + 1 ) )
            A. j e. ( 0 ... ( l + 1 ) )
              (
                (
                  i < j
                  /\
                  (
                    (
                      i = 0
                      \/
                      i = ( l + 1 )
                    )
                    \/
                    (
                      ( ( |_ ` ( n / ( 2 ^ ( i - 1 ) ) ) ) mod 2 )
                      =
                      1
                    )
                  )
                )
                /\
                (
                  (
                    (
                      j = 0
                      \/
                      j = ( l + 1 )
                    )
                    \/
                    (
                      ( ( |_ ` ( n / ( 2 ^ ( j - 1 ) ) ) ) mod 2 )
                      =
                      1
                    )
                  )
                  /\
                  A. k e. ( 0 ... ( l + 1 ) )
                    (
                      (
                        i < k
                        /\
                        k < j
                      )
                      ->
                      (
                        ( ( |_ ` ( n / ( 2 ^ ( k - 1 ) ) ) ) mod 2 )
                        =
                        0
                      )
                    )
                )
                ->
                2 || ( ( j - i ) - 1 )
              )
        )
    }
  $.
$}

${
  $d F a n $.

  putnambench-putnam-1989-a6 $a |-
    A. F
      A. a e. ( Base ` ( PwSer1 ` F ) )
        (
          (
            (
              F e. Field
              /\
              (
                ( Base ` F ) e. Fin
                /\
                ( # ` ( Base ` F ) ) = 2
              )
            )
            /\
            A. n e. NN0
              ( ( coe1 ` a ) ` n )
              =
              if (
                n e. P89A6Good ,
                ( 1r ` F ) ,
                ( 0g ` F )
              )
          )
          ->
          (
            (
              (
                3
                ( .g ` ( mulGrp ` ( PwSer1 ` F ) ) )
                a
              )
              ( +g ` ( PwSer1 ` F ) )
              (
                ( var1 ` F )
                ( .r ` ( PwSer1 ` F ) )
                a
              )
            )
            ( +g ` ( PwSer1 ` F ) )
            ( 1r ` ( PwSer1 ` F ) )
          )
          =
          ( 0g ` ( PwSer1 ` F ) )
        )
  $.
$}

title: putnam_1989_a6
content:
% Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1989_a6:
% the binary zero-block formal power series over a field with two elements
% satisfies alpha^3 + X*alpha + 1 = 0. This file contains no proof.

putnam_1989_a6[
  FieldElement: TYPE+,
  zero_F, one_F: FieldElement,
  add_F, multiply_F:
    [FieldElement, FieldElement -> FieldElement],
  negate_F, inverse_F: [FieldElement -> FieldElement]
]: THEORY
BEGIN
  field_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> FieldElement]
  formal_power_series: TYPE = [nat -> FieldElement]

  field_axioms: bool =
    zero_F /= one_F
      AND (FORALL (x, y: FieldElement):
        add_F(x, y) = add_F(y, x))
      AND (FORALL (x, y, z: FieldElement):
        add_F(add_F(x, y), z) = add_F(x, add_F(y, z)))
      AND (FORALL (x: FieldElement):
        add_F(x, zero_F) = x)
      AND (FORALL (x: FieldElement):
        add_F(x, negate_F(x)) = zero_F)
      AND (FORALL (x, y: FieldElement):
        multiply_F(x, y) = multiply_F(y, x))
      AND (FORALL (x, y, z: FieldElement):
        multiply_F(multiply_F(x, y), z)
          = multiply_F(x, multiply_F(y, z)))
      AND (FORALL (x: FieldElement):
        multiply_F(x, one_F) = x)
      AND (FORALL (x, y, z: FieldElement):
        multiply_F(x, add_F(y, z))
          = add_F(multiply_F(x, y), multiply_F(x, z)))
      AND (FORALL (x: FieldElement):
        x /= zero_F IMPLIES
          multiply_F(x, inverse_F(x)) = one_F)

  injective_below(
      enumeration: field_sequence,
      cardinality: nat): bool =
    FORALL (i, j: nat):
      (i < cardinality
        AND j < cardinality
        AND enumeration(i) = enumeration(j))
      IMPLIES i = j

  enumerates_carrier(
      enumeration: field_sequence,
      cardinality: nat): bool =
    FORALL (x: FieldElement):
      EXISTS (i: nat):
        i < cardinality AND enumeration(i) = x

  carrier_has_cardinality(cardinality: nat): bool =
    EXISTS (enumeration: field_sequence):
      injective_below(enumeration, cardinality)
        AND enumerates_carrier(enumeration, cardinality)

  binary_length_is(n, digit_count: nat): bool =
    (n = 0 AND digit_count = 0)
      OR (n > 0
        AND digit_count > 0
        AND 2 ^ (digit_count - 1) <= n
        AND n < 2 ^ digit_count)

  padded_bit_is_one(
      n, digit_count, position: nat): bool =
    position = 0
      OR position = digit_count + 1
      OR (position > 0
        AND position <= digit_count
        AND mod(
          ndiv(n, 2 ^ (position - 1)),
          2) = 1)

  every_zero_block_has_even_length(n: nat): bool =
    EXISTS (digit_count: nat):
      binary_length_is(n, digit_count)
        AND FORALL (i, j: nat):
          (i < digit_count + 2
            AND j < digit_count + 2
            AND i < j
            AND padded_bit_is_one(n, digit_count, i)
            AND padded_bit_is_one(n, digit_count, j)
            AND (FORALL (k: nat):
              i < k AND k < j IMPLIES
                NOT padded_bit_is_one(
                  n, digit_count, k)))
          IMPLIES mod(j - i - 1, 2) = 0

  is_binary_zero_block_series(
      alpha: formal_power_series): bool =
    FORALL (n: nat):
      alpha(n) =
        IF every_zero_block_has_even_length(n) THEN
          one_F
        ELSE
          zero_F
        ENDIF

  finite_field_sum(
      values: field_sequence,
      count: nat): RECURSIVE FieldElement =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      zero_F
    ELSE
      add_F(
        finite_field_sum(values, count - 1),
        values(count - 1))
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  series_add(
      left, right: formal_power_series):
      formal_power_series =
    LAMBDA (n: nat):
      add_F(left(n), right(n))

  series_multiply(
      left, right: formal_power_series):
      formal_power_series =
    LAMBDA (n: nat):
      finite_field_sum(
        LAMBDA (k: nat):
          IF k <= n THEN
            multiply_F(left(k), right(n - k))
          ELSE
            zero_F
          ENDIF,
        n + 1)

  zero_series: formal_power_series =
    LAMBDA (n: nat): zero_F

  one_series: formal_power_series =
    LAMBDA (n: nat):
      IF n = 0 THEN one_F ELSE zero_F ENDIF

  X_series: formal_power_series =
    LAMBDA (n: nat):
      IF n = 1 THEN one_F ELSE zero_F ENDIF

  series_equal(
      left, right: formal_power_series): bool =
    FORALL (n: nat): left(n) = right(n)

  target_equation(alpha: formal_power_series): bool =
    series_equal(
      series_add(
        series_add(
          series_multiply(
            series_multiply(alpha, alpha),
            alpha),
          series_multiply(X_series, alpha)),
        one_series),
      zero_series)

  putnam_1989_a6: bool =
    (field_axioms AND carrier_has_cardinality(2))
      IMPLIES
        FORALL (alpha: formal_power_series):
          is_binary_zero_block_series(alpha)
            IMPLIES target_equation(alpha)
END putnam_1989_a6

title: putnam_1989_b1
content:
import Mathlib

open Nat MeasureTheory

abbrev putnam_1989_b1_solution : ℤ × ℤ × ℤ × ℤ := sorry
-- (4, 2, -5, 3)
/--
A dart, thrown at random, hits a square target. Assuming that any two parts of the target of equal area are equally likely to be hit, find the probability that the point hit is nearer to the center than to any edge. Express your answer in the form $(a\sqrt{b}+c)/d$, where $a$, $b$, $c$, $d$ are integers and $b$, $d$ are positive.
-/
theorem putnam_1989_b1
    (square Scloser perimeter: Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)))
    (center : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
    (square_def : square = {p | ∀ i : Fin 2, p i ∈ Set.Icc 0 1})
    (perimeter_def : perimeter = {p ∈ square | p 0 = 0 ∨ p 0 = 1 ∨ p 1 = 0 ∨ p 1 = 1})
    (center_def : center =  WithLp.toLp 2 (fun i : Fin 2 => 1 / 2))
    (hScloser : Scloser = {p ∈ square | ∀ q ∈ perimeter, dist p center < dist p q}) :
    let (a, b, c, d) := putnam_1989_b1_solution;
    b > 0 ∧ d > 0 ∧ (¬∃ n : ℤ, n^2 = b) ∧
    (volume Scloser).toReal / (volume square).toReal = (a * Real.sqrt b + c) / d :=
  sorry

title: putnam_1989_b1
content:
(* Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench artifact putnam_1989_b1:
   the planar area probability that a point of the unit square is closer to
   its center than to every boundary point, expressed in normalized quadratic
   irrational form. This file contains no proof. *)

From Stdlib Require Import Reals ZArith ClassicalEpsilon.

Local Open Scope R_scope.

Definition putnam_1989_b1_point := (R * R)%type.
Definition putnam_1989_b1_region := putnam_1989_b1_point -> Prop.

Definition putnam_1989_b1_distance
    (p q : putnam_1989_b1_point) : R :=
  sqrt ((fst p - fst q) ^ 2 + (snd p - snd q) ^ 2).

Definition putnam_1989_b1_square : putnam_1989_b1_region :=
  fun p =>
    0 <= fst p <= 1 /\
    0 <= snd p <= 1.

Definition putnam_1989_b1_boundary : putnam_1989_b1_region :=
  fun p =>
    putnam_1989_b1_square p /\
    (fst p = 0 \/ fst p = 1 \/ snd p = 0 \/ snd p = 1).

Definition putnam_1989_b1_center : putnam_1989_b1_point :=
  (1 / 2, 1 / 2).

Definition putnam_1989_b1_closer : putnam_1989_b1_region :=
  fun p =>
    putnam_1989_b1_square p /\
    forall q : putnam_1989_b1_point,
      putnam_1989_b1_boundary q ->
      putnam_1989_b1_distance p putnam_1989_b1_center <
      putnam_1989_b1_distance p q.

Record putnam_1989_b1_open_rectangle := {
  putnam_1989_b1_x_lower : R;
  putnam_1989_b1_x_upper : R;
  putnam_1989_b1_y_lower : R;
  putnam_1989_b1_y_upper : R
}.

Definition putnam_1989_b1_in_open_rectangle
    (rectangle : putnam_1989_b1_open_rectangle)
    (p : putnam_1989_b1_point) : Prop :=
  putnam_1989_b1_x_lower rectangle < fst p <
    putnam_1989_b1_x_upper rectangle /\
  putnam_1989_b1_y_lower rectangle < snd p <
    putnam_1989_b1_y_upper rectangle.

Definition putnam_1989_b1_rectangle_area
    (rectangle : putnam_1989_b1_open_rectangle) : R :=
  Rmax 0
    (putnam_1989_b1_x_upper rectangle -
     putnam_1989_b1_x_lower rectangle) *
  Rmax 0
    (putnam_1989_b1_y_upper rectangle -
     putnam_1989_b1_y_lower rectangle).

Definition putnam_1989_b1_rectangles_cover
    (region : putnam_1989_b1_region)
    (rectangles : nat -> putnam_1989_b1_open_rectangle) : Prop :=
  forall p : putnam_1989_b1_point,
    region p ->
    exists n : nat,
      putnam_1989_b1_in_open_rectangle (rectangles n) p.

Fixpoint putnam_1989_b1_partial_area
    (rectangles : nat -> putnam_1989_b1_open_rectangle)
    (n : nat) : R :=
  match n with
  | O => 0
  | S k =>
      putnam_1989_b1_partial_area rectangles k +
      putnam_1989_b1_rectangle_area (rectangles k)
  end.

Definition putnam_1989_b1_converges_to
    (sequence : nat -> R) (limit : R) : Prop :=
  forall epsilon : R,
    0 < epsilon ->
    exists N : nat,
      forall n : nat,
        (N <= n)%nat ->
        Rabs (sequence n - limit) < epsilon.

Definition putnam_1989_b1_cover_cost
    (region : putnam_1989_b1_region) (cost : R) : Prop :=
  exists rectangles : nat -> putnam_1989_b1_open_rectangle,
    putnam_1989_b1_rectangles_cover region rectangles /\
    putnam_1989_b1_converges_to
      (putnam_1989_b1_partial_area rectangles) cost.

Definition putnam_1989_b1_is_outer_area
    (region : putnam_1989_b1_region) (area : R) : Prop :=
  (forall cost : R,
      putnam_1989_b1_cover_cost region cost ->
      area <= cost) /\
  (forall lower_bound : R,
      (forall cost : R,
          putnam_1989_b1_cover_cost region cost ->
          lower_bound <= cost) ->
      lower_bound <= area).

Definition putnam_1989_b1_area
    (region : putnam_1989_b1_region) : R :=
  epsilon (inhabits 0) (putnam_1989_b1_is_outer_area region).

Definition putnam_1989_b1_solution : (Z * Z * Z * Z)%type :=
  (4%Z, 2%Z, (-5)%Z, 3%Z).

Definition putnam_1989_b1_squarefree (b : Z) : Prop :=
  forall n k : Z,
    (b = n * n * k)%Z ->
    (Z.abs n = 1)%Z.

Theorem putnam_1989_b1 :
  let '(a, b, c, d) := putnam_1989_b1_solution in
  (0 < b)%Z /\
  (0 < d)%Z /\
  ~ (exists n : Z, (n * n = b)%Z) /\
  putnam_1989_b1_squarefree b /\
  (Z.gcd (Z.gcd (Z.abs a) (Z.abs c)) (Z.abs d) = 1)%Z /\
  putnam_1989_b1_area putnam_1989_b1_closer /
    putnam_1989_b1_area putnam_1989_b1_square =
    (IZR a * sqrt (IZR b) + IZR c) / IZR d.
Admitted.
