(*
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1989_b3:
  moments of a rapidly decaying function satisfying a dilation differential
  equation, including their formula and normalized convergence. This file
  contains no proof.
*)

let analysis_output = open_out "/dev/null";;
let analysis_formatter = Format.formatter_of_out_channel analysis_output;;
let analysis_loaded =
  Toploop.use_file analysis_formatter "Library/transc.ml";;
Format.pp_print_flush analysis_formatter ();;
close_out analysis_output;;
if not analysis_loaded then failwith "failed to load Library/transc.ml";;

let statement =
  `let tends_at_posinfinity =
     \(g:real->real) (l:real).
       !e:real.
         &0 < e
         ==> ?B:real.
               !b:real. B <= b ==> abs (g b - l) < e in
   let differentiable_on =
     \(g:real->real) (s:real->bool).
       !a:real.
         a IN s
         ==> ?d:real.
               !e:real.
                 &0 < e
                 ==> ?delta:real.
                       &0 < delta /\
                       !y:real.
                         y IN s /\
                         &0 < abs (y - a) /\
                         abs (y - a) < delta
                         ==> abs ((g y - g a) / (y - a) - d) < e in
   let moment =
     \(g:real->real) (n:num) (r:real).
       tends_at_posinfinity
         (\b:real. integral(&0,b) (\x:real. x pow n * g x))
         r in
   let putnam_1989_b3_solution =
     \n:num. \c:real.
       c * &(FACT n) /
       ((&3) pow n *
        product (1..n) (\m:num. &1 - inv ((&2) pow m))) in
   !f:real->real. !mu:num->real.
     differentiable_on f {x:real | &0 <= x} /\
     (!x:real.
        &0 < x
        ==> (f diffl (-- &3 * f x + &6 * f (&2 * x))) x) /\
     (!x:real. &0 <= x ==> abs (f x) <= exp (--(sqrt x))) /\
     (!n:num. moment f n (mu n))
     ==>
     (!n:num. mu n = putnam_1989_b3_solution n (mu 0)) /\
     (?L:real.
        (\n:num. mu n * (&3) pow n / &(FACT n)) tends_num_real L) /\
     (((\n:num. mu n * (&3) pow n / &(FACT n)) tends_num_real &0)
      ==> mu 0 = &0)`;;

title: putnam_1989_b3
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1989_b3:
;; moments of a differentiable, rapidly decaying solution of a real
;; differential-dilation equation. This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))

;; The context presents a Dedekind-complete ordered field, hence the real
;; field up to ordered-field isomorphism, together with its exponential and
;; nonnegative square-root functions. Tame APPLY$ objects represent the
;; arbitrary function and moment sequence. DEFUN-SK keeps all unbounded
;; mathematical quantifiers and analytic witnesses internal to the statement.

(defun p89b3-member-p (carrier x)
  (if (apply$ carrier (list x)) t nil))

(defun p89b3-unary-value (function x)
  (apply$ function (list x)))

(defun p89b3-binary-value (function x y)
  (apply$ function (list x y)))

(defun-sk p89b3-valid-set-p (carrier set)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (apply$ set (list x))
     (p89b3-member-p carrier x))))

(defun-sk p89b3-real-function-p (carrier function)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (p89b3-member-p carrier x)
     (p89b3-member-p
      carrier
      (p89b3-unary-value function x)))))

(defun-sk p89b3-real-sequence-p (carrier sequence)
  (forall (n)
    (implies
     (natp n)
     (p89b3-member-p
      carrier
      (p89b3-unary-value sequence n)))))

(defun-sk p89b3-field-laws-p
    (carrier add multiply negate inverse zero one)
  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (p89b3-member-p carrier x)
      (p89b3-member-p carrier y)
      (p89b3-member-p carrier z))
     (and
      (p89b3-member-p carrier
                      (p89b3-binary-value add x y))
      (p89b3-member-p carrier
                      (p89b3-binary-value multiply x y))
      (p89b3-member-p carrier
                      (p89b3-unary-value negate x))
      (p89b3-member-p carrier
                      (p89b3-unary-value inverse x))
      (equal
       (p89b3-binary-value
        add (p89b3-binary-value add x y) z)
       (p89b3-binary-value
        add x (p89b3-binary-value add y z)))
      (equal
       (p89b3-binary-value add x y)
       (p89b3-binary-value add y x))
      (equal (p89b3-binary-value add x zero) x)
      (equal
       (p89b3-binary-value
        add x (p89b3-unary-value negate x))
       zero)
      (equal
       (p89b3-binary-value
        multiply (p89b3-binary-value multiply x y) z)
       (p89b3-binary-value
        multiply x (p89b3-binary-value multiply y z)))
      (equal
       (p89b3-binary-value multiply x y)
       (p89b3-binary-value multiply y x))
      (equal (p89b3-binary-value multiply x one) x)
      (implies
       (equal x zero)
       (equal (p89b3-unary-value inverse x) zero))
      (implies
       (not (equal x zero))
       (equal
        (p89b3-binary-value
         multiply x (p89b3-unary-value inverse x))
        one))
      (equal
       (p89b3-binary-value
        multiply x (p89b3-binary-value add y z))
       (p89b3-binary-value
        add
        (p89b3-binary-value multiply x y)
        (p89b3-binary-value multiply x z)))))))

(defun-sk p89b3-order-laws-p
    (carrier add multiply zero less)
  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (p89b3-member-p carrier x)
      (p89b3-member-p carrier y)
      (p89b3-member-p carrier z))
     (and
      (not (p89b3-binary-value less x x))
      (or
       (equal x y)
       (p89b3-binary-value less x y)
       (p89b3-binary-value less y x))
      (implies
       (and
        (p89b3-binary-value less x y)
        (p89b3-binary-value less y z))
       (p89b3-binary-value less x z))
      (implies
       (p89b3-binary-value less x y)
       (p89b3-binary-value
        less
        (p89b3-binary-value add x z)
        (p89b3-binary-value add y z)))
      (implies
       (and
        (p89b3-binary-value less zero x)
        (p89b3-binary-value less zero y))
       (p89b3-binary-value
        less zero (p89b3-binary-value multiply x y)))))))

(defun-sk p89b3-set-nonempty-p (carrier set)
  (exists (x)
    (and
     (p89b3-member-p carrier x)
     (apply$ set (list x)))))

(defun-sk p89b3-upper-bound-p
    (carrier less set bound)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (and
      (p89b3-member-p carrier x)
      (apply$ set (list x)))
     (not (p89b3-binary-value less bound x)))))

(defun-sk p89b3-bounded-above-p
    (carrier less set)
  (exists (bound)
    (and
     (p89b3-member-p carrier bound)
     (p89b3-upper-bound-p carrier less set bound))))

(defun-sk p89b3-least-upper-bound-p
    (carrier less set supremum)
  (forall (bound)
    (implies
     (and
      (p89b3-member-p carrier bound)
      (p89b3-upper-bound-p carrier less set bound))
     (not (p89b3-binary-value less bound supremum)))))

(defun p89b3-supremum-p
    (carrier less set supremum)
  (and
   (p89b3-member-p carrier supremum)
   (p89b3-upper-bound-p carrier less set supremum)
   (p89b3-least-upper-bound-p
    carrier less set supremum)))

(defun-sk p89b3-has-supremum-p
    (carrier less set)
  (exists (supremum)
    (p89b3-supremum-p carrier less set supremum)))

(defun-sk p89b3-dedekind-complete-p
    (carrier less)
  (forall (set)
    (implies
     (and
      (tamep-functionp set)
      (p89b3-valid-set-p carrier set)
      (p89b3-set-nonempty-p carrier set)
      (p89b3-bounded-above-p carrier less set))
     (p89b3-has-supremum-p carrier less set))))

(defun p89b3-real-field-p
    (carrier zero one add multiply negate inverse less)
  (and
   (tamep-functionp carrier)
   (tamep-functionp add)
   (tamep-functionp multiply)
   (tamep-functionp negate)
   (tamep-functionp inverse)
   (tamep-functionp less)
   (p89b3-member-p carrier zero)
   (p89b3-member-p carrier one)
   (not (equal zero one))
   (p89b3-field-laws-p
    carrier add multiply negate inverse zero one)
   (p89b3-order-laws-p
    carrier add multiply zero less)
   (p89b3-binary-value less zero one)
   (p89b3-dedekind-complete-p carrier less)))

;; The outer context is (field-context exponential square-root).

(defun p89b3-field-context (ctx)
  (nth 0 ctx))

(defun p89b3-r-carrier (ctx)
  (nth 0 (p89b3-field-context ctx)))

(defun p89b3-r-zero (ctx)
  (nth 1 (p89b3-field-context ctx)))

(defun p89b3-r-one (ctx)
  (nth 2 (p89b3-field-context ctx)))

(defun p89b3-r-add (ctx)
  (nth 3 (p89b3-field-context ctx)))

(defun p89b3-r-mul (ctx)
  (nth 4 (p89b3-field-context ctx)))

(defun p89b3-r-neg (ctx)
  (nth 5 (p89b3-field-context ctx)))

(defun p89b3-r-inv (ctx)
  (nth 6 (p89b3-field-context ctx)))

(defun p89b3-r-lt (ctx)
  (nth 7 (p89b3-field-context ctx)))

(defun p89b3-r-exp (ctx)
  (nth 1 ctx))

(defun p89b3-r-sqrt (ctx)
  (nth 2 ctx))

(defun p89b3-field-context-p (field-context)
  (and
   (true-listp field-context)
   (equal (len field-context) 8)
   (p89b3-real-field-p
    (nth 0 field-context)
    (nth 1 field-context)
    (nth 2 field-context)
    (nth 3 field-context)
    (nth 4 field-context)
    (nth 5 field-context)
    (nth 6 field-context)
    (nth 7 field-context))))

(defun p89b3-r-add-value (ctx x y)
  (p89b3-binary-value (p89b3-r-add ctx) x y))

(defun p89b3-r-neg-value (ctx x)
  (p89b3-unary-value (p89b3-r-neg ctx) x))

(defun p89b3-r-sub-value (ctx x y)
  (p89b3-r-add-value
   ctx x (p89b3-r-neg-value ctx y)))

(defun p89b3-r-mul-value (ctx x y)
  (p89b3-binary-value (p89b3-r-mul ctx) x y))

(defun p89b3-r-inv-value (ctx x)
  (p89b3-unary-value (p89b3-r-inv ctx) x))

(defun p89b3-r-div-value (ctx numerator denominator)
  (p89b3-r-mul-value
   ctx numerator (p89b3-r-inv-value ctx denominator)))

(defun p89b3-r-lt-p (ctx x y)
  (if (p89b3-binary-value (p89b3-r-lt ctx) x y)
      t nil))

(defun p89b3-r-le-p (ctx x y)
  (not (p89b3-r-lt-p ctx y x)))

(defun p89b3-r-abs-value (ctx x)
  (if (p89b3-r-lt-p ctx x (p89b3-r-zero ctx))
      (p89b3-r-neg-value ctx x)
    x))

(defun p89b3-positive-real-p (ctx x)
  (and
   (p89b3-member-p (p89b3-r-carrier ctx) x)
   (p89b3-r-lt-p ctx (p89b3-r-zero ctx) x)))

(defun p89b3-nonnegative-real-p (ctx x)
  (and
   (p89b3-member-p (p89b3-r-carrier ctx) x)
   (p89b3-r-le-p ctx (p89b3-r-zero ctx) x)))

(defun p89b3-r-nat (ctx n)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix n)))
  (if (zp n)
      (p89b3-r-zero ctx)
    (p89b3-r-add-value
     ctx
     (p89b3-r-one ctx)
     (p89b3-r-nat ctx (1- n)))))

(defun p89b3-r-pow (ctx x n)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix n)))
  (if (zp n)
      (p89b3-r-one ctx)
    (p89b3-r-mul-value
     ctx x (p89b3-r-pow ctx x (1- n)))))

(defun p89b3-r-factorial (ctx n)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix n)))
  (if (zp n)
      (p89b3-r-one ctx)
    (p89b3-r-mul-value
     ctx
     (p89b3-r-nat ctx n)
     (p89b3-r-factorial ctx (1- n)))))

(defun p89b3-solution-product (ctx n)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix n)))
  (if (zp n)
      (p89b3-r-one ctx)
    (p89b3-r-mul-value
     ctx
     (p89b3-solution-product ctx (1- n))
     (p89b3-r-sub-value
      ctx
      (p89b3-r-one ctx)
      (p89b3-r-inv-value
       ctx
       (p89b3-r-pow
        ctx (p89b3-r-nat ctx 2) n))))))

(defun p89b3-solution-value (ctx n c)
  (p89b3-r-div-value
   ctx
   (p89b3-r-mul-value
    ctx c (p89b3-r-factorial ctx n))
   (p89b3-r-mul-value
    ctx
    (p89b3-r-pow
     ctx (p89b3-r-nat ctx 3) n)
    (p89b3-solution-product ctx n))))

(defun p89b3-normalized-value (ctx moments n)
  (p89b3-r-div-value
   ctx
   (p89b3-r-mul-value
    ctx
    (p89b3-unary-value moments n)
    (p89b3-r-pow
     ctx (p89b3-r-nat ctx 3) n))
   (p89b3-r-factorial ctx n)))

;; Global epsilon-delta derivatives characterize the exponential function.

(defun-sk p89b3-global-derivative-neighborhood-p
    (ctx function derivative x epsilon radius)
  (forall (y)
    (implies
     (and
      (p89b3-member-p (p89b3-r-carrier ctx) y)
      (p89b3-r-lt-p
       ctx
       (p89b3-r-abs-value
        ctx (p89b3-r-sub-value ctx y x))
       radius))
     (p89b3-r-le-p
      ctx
      (p89b3-r-abs-value
       ctx
       (p89b3-r-sub-value
        ctx
        (p89b3-r-sub-value
         ctx
         (p89b3-unary-value function y)
         (p89b3-unary-value function x))
        (p89b3-r-mul-value
         ctx derivative
         (p89b3-r-sub-value ctx y x))))
      (p89b3-r-mul-value
       ctx epsilon
       (p89b3-r-abs-value
        ctx (p89b3-r-sub-value ctx y x)))))))

(defun-sk p89b3-global-derivative-radius-exists-p
    (ctx function derivative x epsilon)
  (exists (radius)
    (and
     (p89b3-positive-real-p ctx radius)
     (p89b3-global-derivative-neighborhood-p
      ctx function derivative x epsilon radius))))

(defun-sk p89b3-has-global-derivative-at-p
    (ctx function derivative x)
  (forall (epsilon)
    (implies
     (p89b3-positive-real-p ctx epsilon)
     (p89b3-global-derivative-radius-exists-p
      ctx function derivative x epsilon))))

(defun-sk p89b3-global-derivative-values-p
    (ctx function derivative-function)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (p89b3-member-p (p89b3-r-carrier ctx) x)
     (p89b3-has-global-derivative-at-p
      ctx
      function
      (p89b3-unary-value derivative-function x)
      x))))

(defun p89b3-global-derivative-function-p
    (ctx function derivative-function)
  (and
   (tamep-functionp function)
   (tamep-functionp derivative-function)
   (p89b3-real-function-p
    (p89b3-r-carrier ctx) function)
   (p89b3-real-function-p
    (p89b3-r-carrier ctx) derivative-function)
   (p89b3-global-derivative-values-p
    ctx function derivative-function)))

(defun p89b3-exponential-function-p (ctx exponential)
  (and
   (p89b3-global-derivative-function-p
    ctx exponential exponential)
   (equal
    (p89b3-unary-value exponential (p89b3-r-zero ctx))
    (p89b3-r-one ctx))))

(defun-sk p89b3-square-root-laws-p (ctx square-root)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (p89b3-member-p (p89b3-r-carrier ctx) x)
     (and
      (p89b3-member-p
       (p89b3-r-carrier ctx)
       (p89b3-unary-value square-root x))
      (implies
       (p89b3-r-le-p ctx (p89b3-r-zero ctx) x)
       (and
        (p89b3-r-le-p
         ctx
         (p89b3-r-zero ctx)
         (p89b3-unary-value square-root x))
        (equal
         (p89b3-r-mul-value
          ctx
          (p89b3-unary-value square-root x)
          (p89b3-unary-value square-root x))
         x)))))))

(defun p89b3-context-p (ctx)
  (and
   (true-listp ctx)
   (equal (len ctx) 3)
   (p89b3-field-context-p (p89b3-field-context ctx))
   (tamep-functionp (p89b3-r-exp ctx))
   (tamep-functionp (p89b3-r-sqrt ctx))
   (p89b3-exponential-function-p
    ctx (p89b3-r-exp ctx))
   (p89b3-square-root-laws-p
    ctx (p89b3-r-sqrt ctx))))

;; Differentiability relative to [0,infinity). At positive points this is the
;; usual derivative because they are interior points of the half-line.

(defun-sk p89b3-relative-derivative-neighborhood-p
    (ctx function derivative x epsilon radius)
  (forall (y)
    (implies
     (and
      (p89b3-nonnegative-real-p ctx y)
      (p89b3-r-lt-p
       ctx
       (p89b3-r-abs-value
        ctx (p89b3-r-sub-value ctx y x))
       radius))
     (p89b3-r-le-p
      ctx
      (p89b3-r-abs-value
       ctx
       (p89b3-r-sub-value
        ctx
        (p89b3-r-sub-value
         ctx
         (p89b3-unary-value function y)
         (p89b3-unary-value function x))
        (p89b3-r-mul-value
         ctx derivative
         (p89b3-r-sub-value ctx y x))))
      (p89b3-r-mul-value
       ctx epsilon
       (p89b3-r-abs-value
        ctx (p89b3-r-sub-value ctx y x)))))))

(defun-sk p89b3-relative-derivative-radius-exists-p
    (ctx function derivative x epsilon)
  (exists (radius)
    (and
     (p89b3-positive-real-p ctx radius)
     (p89b3-relative-derivative-neighborhood-p
      ctx function derivative x epsilon radius))))

(defun-sk p89b3-has-relative-derivative-at-p
    (ctx function derivative x)
  (forall (epsilon)
    (implies
     (p89b3-positive-real-p ctx epsilon)
     (p89b3-relative-derivative-radius-exists-p
      ctx function derivative x epsilon))))

(defun-sk p89b3-relative-derivative-exists-at-p
    (ctx function x)
  (exists (derivative)
    (and
     (p89b3-member-p (p89b3-r-carrier ctx) derivative)
     (p89b3-has-relative-derivative-at-p
      ctx function derivative x))))

(defun-sk p89b3-differentiable-on-nonnegative-p
    (ctx function)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (p89b3-nonnegative-real-p ctx x)
     (p89b3-relative-derivative-exists-at-p
      ctx function x))))

(defun p89b3-differential-equation-value (ctx function x)
  (p89b3-r-add-value
   ctx
   (p89b3-r-mul-value
    ctx
    (p89b3-r-neg-value
     ctx (p89b3-r-nat ctx 3))
    (p89b3-unary-value function x))
   (p89b3-r-mul-value
    ctx
    (p89b3-r-nat ctx 6)
    (p89b3-unary-value
     function
     (p89b3-r-mul-value
      ctx (p89b3-r-nat ctx 2) x)))))

(defun-sk p89b3-differential-equation-p
    (ctx function)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (p89b3-positive-real-p ctx x)
     (p89b3-has-relative-derivative-at-p
      ctx
      function
      (p89b3-differential-equation-value
       ctx function x)
      x))))

(defun-sk p89b3-decay-bound-p (ctx function)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (p89b3-nonnegative-real-p ctx x)
     (p89b3-r-le-p
      ctx
      (p89b3-r-abs-value
       ctx (p89b3-unary-value function x))
      (p89b3-unary-value
       (p89b3-r-exp ctx)
       (p89b3-r-neg-value
        ctx
        (p89b3-unary-value
         (p89b3-r-sqrt ctx) x)))))))

;; On each bounded interval the moment is the limit of uniform left Riemann
;; sums. Differentiability makes the integrand continuous there, so this is
;; equal to the source Lebesgue integral. The outer limit is the improper
;; integral over (0,infinity).

(defun p89b3-riemann-width (ctx subdivisions radius)
  (p89b3-r-div-value
   ctx radius (p89b3-r-nat ctx subdivisions)))

(defun p89b3-riemann-point
    (ctx index subdivisions radius)
  (p89b3-r-mul-value
   ctx
   (p89b3-r-nat ctx index)
   (p89b3-riemann-width ctx subdivisions radius)))

(defun p89b3-moment-integrand-value
    (ctx function n x)
  (p89b3-r-mul-value
   ctx
   (p89b3-r-pow ctx x n)
   (p89b3-unary-value function x)))

(defun p89b3-riemann-sum-aux
    (ctx remaining subdivisions radius function n)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix remaining)))
  (if (zp remaining)
      (p89b3-r-zero ctx)
    (let* ((index (1- remaining))
           (width
            (p89b3-riemann-width
             ctx subdivisions radius))
           (point
            (p89b3-riemann-point
             ctx index subdivisions radius))
           (summand
            (p89b3-r-mul-value
             ctx
             width
             (p89b3-moment-integrand-value
              ctx function n point))))
      (p89b3-r-add-value
       ctx
       (p89b3-riemann-sum-aux
        ctx index subdivisions radius function n)
       summand))))

(defun p89b3-riemann-sum
    (ctx subdivisions radius function n)
  (if (posp subdivisions)
      (p89b3-riemann-sum-aux
       ctx subdivisions subdivisions radius function n)
    (p89b3-r-zero ctx)))

(defun-sk p89b3-riemann-tail-p
    (ctx function n radius value epsilon cutoff)
  (forall (subdivisions)
    (implies
     (and
      (posp subdivisions)
      (<= cutoff subdivisions))
     (p89b3-r-lt-p
      ctx
      (p89b3-r-abs-value
       ctx
       (p89b3-r-sub-value
        ctx
        (p89b3-riemann-sum
         ctx subdivisions radius function n)
        value))
      epsilon))))

(defun-sk p89b3-riemann-cutoff-exists-p
    (ctx function n radius value epsilon)
  (exists (cutoff)
    (and
     (posp cutoff)
     (p89b3-riemann-tail-p
      ctx function n radius value epsilon cutoff))))

(defun-sk p89b3-bounded-moment-integral-p
    (ctx function n radius value)
  (forall (epsilon)
    (implies
     (p89b3-positive-real-p ctx epsilon)
     (p89b3-riemann-cutoff-exists-p
      ctx function n radius value epsilon))))

(defun-sk p89b3-moment-at-radius-close-p
    (ctx function n radius limit epsilon)
  (exists (value)
    (and
     (p89b3-member-p (p89b3-r-carrier ctx) value)
     (p89b3-bounded-moment-integral-p
      ctx function n radius value)
     (p89b3-r-lt-p
      ctx
      (p89b3-r-abs-value
       ctx (p89b3-r-sub-value ctx value limit))
      epsilon))))

(defun-sk p89b3-improper-moment-tail-p
    (ctx function n limit epsilon cutoff)
  (forall (radius)
    (implies
     (and
      (p89b3-nonnegative-real-p ctx radius)
      (p89b3-r-le-p ctx cutoff radius))
     (p89b3-moment-at-radius-close-p
      ctx function n radius limit epsilon))))

(defun-sk p89b3-improper-moment-cutoff-exists-p
    (ctx function n limit epsilon)
  (exists (cutoff)
    (and
     (p89b3-positive-real-p ctx cutoff)
     (p89b3-improper-moment-tail-p
      ctx function n limit epsilon cutoff))))

(defun-sk p89b3-improper-moment-p
    (ctx function n limit)
  (forall (epsilon)
    (implies
     (p89b3-positive-real-p ctx epsilon)
     (p89b3-improper-moment-cutoff-exists-p
      ctx function n limit epsilon))))

(defun-sk p89b3-moments-definition-p
    (ctx function moments)
  (forall (n)
    (implies
     (natp n)
     (p89b3-improper-moment-p
      ctx
      function
      n
      (p89b3-unary-value moments n)))))

(defun-sk p89b3-solution-formula-p (ctx moments)
  (forall (n)
    (implies
     (natp n)
     (equal
      (p89b3-unary-value moments n)
      (p89b3-solution-value
       ctx n (p89b3-unary-value moments 0))))))

(defun-sk p89b3-normalized-convergence-tail-p
    (ctx moments limit epsilon cutoff)
  (forall (n)
    (implies
     (and
      (natp n)
      (<= cutoff n))
     (p89b3-r-lt-p
      ctx
      (p89b3-r-abs-value
       ctx
       (p89b3-r-sub-value
        ctx
        (p89b3-normalized-value ctx moments n)
        limit))
      epsilon))))

(defun-sk p89b3-normalized-convergence-cutoff-exists-p
    (ctx moments limit epsilon)
  (exists (cutoff)
    (and
     (natp cutoff)
     (p89b3-normalized-convergence-tail-p
      ctx moments limit epsilon cutoff))))

(defun-sk p89b3-normalized-converges-to-p
    (ctx moments limit)
  (forall (epsilon)
    (implies
     (p89b3-positive-real-p ctx epsilon)
     (p89b3-normalized-convergence-cutoff-exists-p
      ctx moments limit epsilon))))

(defun-sk p89b3-normalized-limit-exists-p
    (ctx moments)
  (exists (limit)
    (and
     (p89b3-member-p (p89b3-r-carrier ctx) limit)
     (p89b3-normalized-converges-to-p
      ctx moments limit))))

(defun putnambench-putnam-1989-b3-statement
    (ctx function moments)
  (implies
   (and
    (p89b3-context-p ctx)
    (tamep-functionp function)
    (tamep-functionp moments)
    (p89b3-real-function-p
     (p89b3-r-carrier ctx) function)
    (p89b3-real-sequence-p
     (p89b3-r-carrier ctx) moments)
    (p89b3-differentiable-on-nonnegative-p
     ctx function)
    (p89b3-differential-equation-p
     ctx function)
    (p89b3-decay-bound-p
     ctx function)
    (p89b3-moments-definition-p
     ctx function moments))
   (and
    (p89b3-solution-formula-p ctx moments)
    (p89b3-normalized-limit-exists-p ctx moments)
    (implies
     (p89b3-normalized-converges-to-p
      ctx moments (p89b3-r-zero ctx))
     (equal
      (p89b3-unary-value moments 0)
      (p89b3-r-zero ctx))))))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

title: putnam_1989_b3
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1989_b3:
-- the moment formula and normalized-moment convergence for a differentiable
-- real function satisfying a dilation differential equation and decay bound.
-- This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; _*_)

infix 4 _!=_ _<=N_
infixr 3 _and_
infixr 2 _or_

data Bottom : Set where

Not : Set -> Set
Not A =
  A -> Bottom

_!=_ : {A : Set} -> A -> A -> Set
x != y =
  Not (x == y)

record _and_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data _or_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  left  : A -> A or B
  right : B -> A or B

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

data _<=N_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set where
  zero<=   : {n : Nat} -> zero <=N n
  suc<=suc : {m n : Nat} -> m <=N n -> suc m <=N suc n

record CompleteOrderedRealField (R : Set) : Set1 where
  field
    zeroR oneR : R
    add multiply : R -> R -> R
    negate inverse : R -> R
    lessOrEqual : R -> R -> Set
    fromNat : Nat -> R

    one-not-zero :
      oneR != zeroR

    add-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> add x y == add y x
    add-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      add (add x y) z == add x (add y z)
    add-zero :
      (x : R) -> add x zeroR == x
    add-inverse :
      (x : R) -> add x (negate x) == zeroR

    multiply-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> multiply x y == multiply y x
    multiply-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply (multiply x y) z ==
      multiply x (multiply y z)
    multiply-one :
      (x : R) -> multiply x oneR == x
    multiply-zero :
      (x : R) -> multiply x zeroR == zeroR
    distribute :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply x (add y z) ==
      add (multiply x y) (multiply x z)
    inverse-zero :
      inverse zeroR == zeroR
    multiply-inverse :
      (x : R) ->
      x != zeroR ->
      multiply x (inverse x) == oneR

    order-reflexive :
      (x : R) -> lessOrEqual x x
    order-transitive :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y z ->
      lessOrEqual x z
    order-antisymmetric :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y x ->
      x == y
    order-total :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y or lessOrEqual y x
    add-order :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual (add z x) (add z y)
    multiply-nonnegative :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR x ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR y ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR (multiply x y)
    zero-less-than-one :
      lessOrEqual zeroR oneR and zeroR != oneR

    fromNat-zero :
      fromNat zero == zeroR
    fromNat-successor :
      (n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (suc n) == add (fromNat n) oneR
    fromNat-addition :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m + n) == add (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-multiplication :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m * n) == multiply (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-injective :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat m == fromNat n ->
      m == n

    archimedean :
      (x : R) ->
      Exists Nat (\ n -> lessOrEqual x (fromNat n))
    least-upper-bound :
      (P : R -> Set) ->
      Exists R P ->
      Exists R
        (\ upper ->
          (x : R) ->
          P x ->
          lessOrEqual x upper) ->
      Exists R
        (\ supremum ->
          ((x : R) ->
            P x ->
            lessOrEqual x supremum)
          and
          ((upper : R) ->
            ((x : R) ->
              P x ->
              lessOrEqual x upper) ->
            lessOrEqual supremum upper))

open CompleteOrderedRealField

oneN : Nat
oneN =
  suc zero

twoN : Nat
twoN =
  suc oneN

threeN : Nat
threeN =
  suc twoN

subtract :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
subtract reals x y =
  add reals x (negate reals y)

divide :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
divide reals x y =
  multiply reals x (inverse reals y)

StrictLess :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
StrictLess reals x y =
  lessOrEqual reals x y and x != y

CloseTo :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
CloseTo reals center radius x =
  StrictLess reals
    (subtract reals center radius)
    x
  and
  StrictLess reals
    x
    (add reals center radius)

maximum :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
maximum reals x y with order-total reals x y
... | left _ =
  y
... | right _ =
  x

absoluteValue :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R
absoluteValue reals x =
  maximum reals x (negate reals x)

naturalPower :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  Nat ->
  R
naturalPower reals x zero =
  oneR reals
naturalPower reals x (suc n) =
  multiply reals
    (naturalPower reals x n)
    x

factorial : Nat -> Nat
factorial zero =
  oneN
factorial (suc n) =
  suc n * factorial n

sumFirst :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Nat ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  R
sumFirst reals zero terms =
  zeroR reals
sumFirst reals (suc n) terms =
  add reals
    (sumFirst reals n terms)
    (terms n)

ConvergesTo :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  R ->
  Set
ConvergesTo {R} reals sequence limit =
  (epsilon : R) ->
  StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) epsilon ->
  Exists Nat
    (\ cutoff ->
      (n : Nat) ->
      cutoff <=N n ->
      CloseTo reals limit epsilon (sequence n))

SeriesHasSum :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  R ->
  Set
SeriesHasSum reals terms limit =
  ConvergesTo reals
    (\ n -> sumFirst reals n terms)
    limit

exponentialTerm :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  Nat ->
  R
exponentialTerm reals x n =
  divide reals
    (naturalPower reals x n)
    (fromNat reals (factorial n))

record StandardExponentialAndSquareRoot
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) :
  Set1 where

  field
    exponential squareRoot : R -> R

    exponential-series :
      (x : R) ->
      SeriesHasSum reals
        (exponentialTerm reals x)
        (exponential x)

    square-root-nonnegative :
      (x : R) ->
      lessOrEqual reals (zeroR reals) x ->
      lessOrEqual reals (zeroR reals) (squareRoot x)
    square-root-square :
      (x : R) ->
      lessOrEqual reals (zeroR reals) x ->
      multiply reals (squareRoot x) (squareRoot x) == x
    square-root-unique :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual reals (zeroR reals) x ->
      lessOrEqual reals (zeroR reals) y ->
      multiply reals y y == x ->
      y == squareRoot x

open StandardExponentialAndSquareRoot

differenceQuotient :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (R -> R) ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
differenceQuotient reals function point x =
  divide reals
    (subtract reals (function x) (function point))
    (subtract reals x point)

DerivativeAt :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (R -> R) ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
DerivativeAt {R} reals function point derivativeValue =
  (epsilon : R) ->
  StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) epsilon ->
  Exists R
    (\ delta ->
      StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) delta
      and
      ((x : R) ->
        CloseTo reals point delta x ->
        x != point ->
        CloseTo reals derivativeValue epsilon
          (differenceQuotient reals function point x)))

DerivativeWithinNonnegativeAt :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (R -> R) ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
DerivativeWithinNonnegativeAt
  {R} reals function point derivativeValue =
  (epsilon : R) ->
  StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) epsilon ->
  Exists R
    (\ delta ->
      StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) delta
      and
      ((x : R) ->
        lessOrEqual reals (zeroR reals) x ->
        CloseTo reals point delta x ->
        x != point ->
        CloseTo reals derivativeValue epsilon
          (differenceQuotient reals function point x)))

DifferentiableOnNonnegative :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (R -> R) ->
  Set
DifferentiableOnNonnegative {R} reals function =
  (x : R) ->
  lessOrEqual reals (zeroR reals) x ->
  Exists R
    (\ derivativeValue ->
      DerivativeWithinNonnegativeAt
        reals function x derivativeValue)

rightRiemannSum :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  (R -> R) ->
  Nat ->
  R
rightRiemannSum reals lower upper function pieces =
  let
    step =
      divide reals
        (subtract reals upper lower)
        (fromNat reals pieces)
  in
  sumFirst reals pieces
    (\ i ->
      multiply reals
        (function
          (add reals lower
            (multiply reals
              (fromNat reals (suc i))
              step)))
        step)

IntervalIntegralValue :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  (R -> R) ->
  R ->
  Set
IntervalIntegralValue reals lower upper function value =
  ConvergesTo reals
    (\ n ->
      rightRiemannSum reals
        lower
        upper
        function
        (suc n))
    value

NonnegativeImproperIntegralValue :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (R -> R) ->
  R ->
  Set
NonnegativeImproperIntegralValue {R} reals function value =
  Exists (Nat -> R)
    (\ partialIntegrals ->
      ((n : Nat) ->
        IntervalIntegralValue reals
          (zeroR reals)
          (fromNat reals n)
          function
          (partialIntegrals n))
      and
      ConvergesTo reals partialIntegrals value)

record StandardNonnegativeImproperIntegration
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) :
  Set1 where

  field
    improperIntegral :
      (R -> R) ->
      R

    integral-correct :
      (function : R -> R) ->
      (value : R) ->
      NonnegativeImproperIntegralValue reals function value ->
      improperIntegral function == value

    integral-totalized-at-zero :
      (function : R -> R) ->
      Not
        (Exists R
          (NonnegativeImproperIntegralValue reals function)) ->
      improperIntegral function == zeroR reals

open StandardNonnegativeImproperIntegration

factorProduct :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Nat ->
  R
factorProduct reals zero =
  oneR reals
factorProduct reals (suc n) =
  multiply reals
    (factorProduct reals n)
    (subtract reals
      (oneR reals)
      (inverse reals
        (naturalPower reals
          (fromNat reals twoN)
          (suc n))))

momentSolution :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Nat ->
  R ->
  R
momentSolution reals n initialMoment =
  divide reals
    (multiply reals
      initialMoment
      (fromNat reals (factorial n)))
    (multiply reals
      (naturalPower reals (fromNat reals threeN) n)
      (factorProduct reals n))

momentIntegrand :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (R -> R) ->
  Nat ->
  R ->
  R
momentIntegrand reals function n x =
  multiply reals
    (naturalPower reals x n)
    (function x)

normalizedMoment :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  Nat ->
  R
normalizedMoment reals moments n =
  divide reals
    (multiply reals
      (moments n)
      (naturalPower reals (fromNat reals threeN) n))
    (fromNat reals (factorial n))

module Putnam1989B3Statement
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R)
  (analysis : StandardExponentialAndSquareRoot reals)
  (integration : StandardNonnegativeImproperIntegration reals) where

  differentialEquation :
    (R -> R) ->
    Set
  differentialEquation function =
    (x : R) ->
    StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) x ->
    DerivativeWithinNonnegativeAt reals function x
      (add reals
        (negate reals
          (multiply reals
            (fromNat reals threeN)
            (function x)))
        (multiply reals
          (fromNat reals (threeN + threeN))
          (function
            (multiply reals
              (fromNat reals twoN)
              x))))

  decayBound :
    (R -> R) ->
    Set
  decayBound function =
    (x : R) ->
    lessOrEqual reals (zeroR reals) x ->
    lessOrEqual reals
      (absoluteValue reals (function x))
      (exponential analysis
        (negate reals (squareRoot analysis x)))

  momentsDefined :
    (R -> R) ->
    (Nat -> R) ->
    Set
  momentsDefined function moments =
    (n : Nat) ->
    moments n ==
    improperIntegral integration
      (momentIntegrand reals function n)

  conclusion :
    (Nat -> R) ->
    Set
  conclusion moments =
    ((n : Nat) ->
      moments n ==
      momentSolution reals n (moments zero))
    and
    Exists R
      (\ limit ->
        ConvergesTo reals
          (normalizedMoment reals moments)
          limit)
    and
    (ConvergesTo reals
      (normalizedMoment reals moments)
      (zeroR reals) ->
      moments zero == zeroR reals)

  proposition : Set
  proposition =
    (function : R -> R) ->
    DifferentiableOnNonnegative reals function ->
    differentialEquation function ->
    decayBound function ->
    (moments : Nat -> R) ->
    momentsDefined function moments ->
    conclusion moments

putnam-1989-b3 : Set1
putnam-1989-b3 =
  (R : Set) ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) ->
  (analysis : StandardExponentialAndSquareRoot reals) ->
  (integration : StandardNonnegativeImproperIntegration reals) ->
  Putnam1989B3Statement.proposition
    reals
    analysis
    integration

title: putnam_1989_b3
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1989_b3:
  the moments of a rapidly decaying differentiable function satisfying the
  stated dilation differential equation have an explicit product formula,
  and their factorial scaling has the specified convergence behavior.
  This file contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open arithmeticTheory pred_setTheory realTheory real_topologyTheory limTheory
     transcTheory derivativeTheory real_sigmaTheory;
open extrealTheory measureTheory lebesgueTheory lebesgue_measureTheory;

val putnam_1989_b3 =
  ``!f : real -> real.
      let nonnegative_reals = {x : real | 0 <= x}
      in
      let positive_reals = {x : real | 0 < x}
      in
      let moment =
        \n : num.
          let halfline = restrict_space lebesgue positive_reals
          in
          let integrand =
            \x : real. Normal (x pow n * f x)
          in
            if lebesgue$integrable halfline integrand then
              real (lebesgue$integral halfline integrand)
            else
              0
      in
      let solution =
        \n : num. \c : real.
          c * &(FACT n) /
          ((3 : real) pow n *
           REAL_PROD_IMAGE
             (\m : num. 1 - inv ((2 : real) pow m))
             (IMAGE SUC (count n)))
      in
      let scaled =
        \n : num. moment n * (3 : real) pow n / &(FACT n)
      in
        f differentiable_on nonnegative_reals /\
        (!x : real.
           0 < x
           ==>
           (f diffl (-3 * f x + 6 * f (2 * x))) x) /\
        (!x : real.
           0 <= x
           ==>
           abs (f x) <= exp (-sqrt x))
        ==>
        (!n : num. moment n = solution n (moment 0)) /\
        (?L : real. (scaled --> L) sequentially) /\
        ((scaled --> 0) sequentially ==> moment 0 = 0)``;

$(
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact
  putnam_1989_b3: moment identities and normalized-moment convergence for a
  rapidly decaying real function satisfying a differential-functional
  equation on the nonnegative half-line. This file contains no proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  f is an arbitrary total real-valued function and g is its NN0-indexed real
  moment sequence. The first premise expresses differentiability
  relative to [0,+infinity); on its positive interior, the ordinary real
  derivative satisfies f'(x) = -3 f(x) + 6 f(2x). This relative formulation
  is the Isabelle statement and the problem text. It is equivalent for this
  theorem to Lean's global differentiability premise: a differentiable
  function on the half-line can be extended differentiably to the negative
  half-line without changing any hypothesis, moment, or conclusion here.

  The Lebesgue integral over (0,+infinity) defines every moment g(n). The
  first conclusion gives the resolved closed formula
  g(0)n!/(3^n product_(m=1)^n(1-2^(-m))). The two final clauses preserve
  existence of a real limit for g(n) 3^n / n! and the implication that
  convergence to zero forces g(0) = 0.

  The final declaration is the single unproved $a corpus statement; this
  database contains no $p proof statement.
$)

${
  $d f g l m n x y $.

  putnambench-putnam-1989-b3 $a |-
    A. f e. ( RR ^m RR )
      A. g e. ( RR ^m NN0 )
        (
          (
            (
              A. x e. ( 0 [,) +oo )
                E. y e. RR
                  x
                  (
                    ( 0 [,) +oo )
                    _D
                    ( f |` ( 0 [,) +oo ) )
                  )
                  y
              /\
              A. x e. RR
                (
                  0 < x
                  ->
                  (
                    x e. dom ( RR _D f )
                    /\
                    ( ( RR _D f ) ` x )
                    =
                    (
                      ( ( -u 3 ) x. ( f ` x ) )
                      +
                      ( 6 x. ( f ` ( 2 x. x ) ) )
                    )
                  )
                )
            )
            /\
            (
              A. x e. RR
                (
                  0 <_ x
                  ->
                  ( abs ` ( f ` x ) )
                  <_
                  ( exp ` ( -u ( sqrt ` x ) ) )
                )
              /\
              A. n e. NN0
                ( g ` n )
                =
                S. ( 0 (,) +oo )
                  ( ( x ^ n ) x. ( f ` x ) )
                  _d x
            )
          )
          ->
          (
            (
              A. n e. NN0
                ( g ` n )
                =
                (
                  ( ( g ` 0 ) x. ( ! ` n ) )
                  /
                  (
                    ( 3 ^ n )
                    x.
                    prod_ m e. ( 1 ... n )
                      ( 1 - ( 2 ^ ( -u m ) ) )
                  )
                )
              /\
              E. l e. RR
                (
                  n e. NN0 |->
                    (
                      ( ( g ` n ) x. ( 3 ^ n ) )
                      /
                      ( ! ` n )
                    )
                )
                ~~>
                l
            )
            /\
            (
              (
                n e. NN0 |->
                  (
                    ( ( g ` n ) x. ( 3 ^ n ) )
                    /
                    ( ! ` n )
                  )
              )
              ~~>
              0
              ->
              ( g ` 0 ) = 0
            )
          )
        )
  $.
$}

      PARTFUN2, RCOMP_1, RFUNCT_2, FDIFF_1, LIMFUNC1, FDIFF_12, MEASURE5,
      MEASURE6, MESFUNC1, MESFUNC5, MESFUNC6, MEASUR12, INTEGRA5, EXTREAL1,
      BINOP_2;
 registrations XBOOLE_0, SUBSET_1, RELAT_1, FUNCT_1, RELSET_1,
      FUNCT_2, NUMBERS, CARD_1, XXREAL_0, MEMBERED, VALUED_0,
      VALUED_1, XCMPLX_0, XREAL_0, ORDINAL1, NAT_1, INT_1, NEWTON,
      PREPOWER, POWER, SQUARE_1, SIN_COS, FINSEQ_1, FINSEQ_2, RVSUM_1,

 requirements REAL, NUMERALS, SUBSET, BOOLE, ARITHM;
 definitions TARSKI, XBOOLE_0;
 expansions TARSKI, XBOOLE_0, RELAT_1;

begin

::$P-
theorem
  for A being non empty Interval,
      f being Function of REAL,REAL,
      mu being Real_Sequence st
    A = right_closed_halfline 0 &
    f is_differentiable_on_interval A &
    (for x being Real st 0 < x holds
      diff(f,x) = -3 * f.x + 6 * f.(2*x)) &
    (for x being Real st x in A holds
      |.f.x.| <= exp_R.(-sqrt x)) &
    (for n being Nat holds
      ex g being Function of REAL,REAL st
        (for x being Real st x in A holds
          g.x = (x |^ n) * f.x) &
        mu.n = Integral(L-Meas,g|A))
  holds
    ex factorials being Real_Sequence st
      factorials.0 = 1 &
      (for n being Nat holds
        factorials.(n+1) =
          factorials.n * ((n+1) qua Real)) &
      (for n being Nat holds
        ex denominators being Real_Sequence st
          denominators.0 = 1 &
          (for m being Nat st m < n holds
            denominators.(m+1) =
              denominators.m *
                (1 - 2 to_power (-((m+1) qua Real)))) &
          mu.n =
            mu.0 * factorials.n /
              (((3 qua Real) |^ n) * denominators.n)) &
      ex s being Real_Sequence st
        (for n being Nat holds
          s.n =
            mu.n * ((3 qua Real) |^ n) / factorials.n) &
        s is convergent &
        (lim s = 0 implies mu.0 = 0)
proof
end;
::$P+

title: putnam_1989_b3
content:
% Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1989_b3:
% moments of a differentiable function on the nonnegative real axis satisfying
% a dilation differential equation and rapid decay obey an explicit product
% formula and a normalized convergence criterion. This file contains no proof.

putnam_1989_b3: THEORY
BEGIN
  real_function: TYPE = [real -> real]
  real_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> real]
  positive_real_function: TYPE = [posreal -> real]

  safe_div(numerator, denominator: real): real =
    IF denominator = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      numerator / denominator
    ENDIF

  nat_factorial(index: nat): RECURSIVE nat =
    IF index = 0 THEN
      1
    ELSE
      index * nat_factorial(index - 1)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE index

  finite_solution_product(index: nat): RECURSIVE real =
    IF index = 0 THEN
      1
    ELSE
      finite_solution_product(index - 1)
        * (1 - safe_div(1, (2 :: real) ^ index))
    ENDIF
  MEASURE index

  putnam_1989_b3_solution(index: nat, initial: real): real =
    safe_div(
      initial * (nat_factorial(index) :: real),
      (3 :: real) ^ index * finite_solution_product(index))

  exponential_partial(x: real, count: nat): RECURSIVE real =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      LET index: nat = count - 1 IN
        exponential_partial(x, count - 1)
          + safe_div(
              x ^ index,
              nat_factorial(index) :: real)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  sequence_converges_to(
      sequence: real_sequence,
      limit_value: real): bool =
    FORALL (epsilon_value: posreal):
      EXISTS (cutoff: nat):
        FORALL (index: nat):
          cutoff <= index IMPLIES
            abs(sequence(index) - limit_value) < epsilon_value

  real_exponential(x: real): real =
    epsilon(
      LAMBDA (value: real):
        sequence_converges_to(
          LAMBDA (count: nat):
            exponential_partial(x, count),
          value))

  nonnegative_sqrt(x: real): real =
    IF x >= 0 THEN
      epsilon(
        LAMBDA (root: real):
          root >= 0 AND root * root = x)
    ELSE
      0
    ENDIF

  has_derivative_at(
      f: real_function,
      derivative, x: real): bool =
    FORALL (epsilon_value: posreal):
      EXISTS (delta: posreal):
        FORALL (h: real):
          (h /= 0 AND abs(h) < delta)
            IMPLIES
              abs(
                f(x + h) - f(x) - derivative * h)
                < epsilon_value * abs(h)

  has_derivative_within_nonnegative(
      f: real_function,
      derivative, x: real): bool =
    FORALL (epsilon_value: posreal):
      EXISTS (delta: posreal):
        FORALL (y: real):
          (y >= 0
            AND y /= x
            AND abs(y - x) < delta)
          IMPLIES
            abs(
              f(y) - f(x) - derivative * (y - x))
              < epsilon_value * abs(y - x)

  differentiable_on_nonnegative(f: real_function): bool =
    FORALL (x: real):
      x >= 0 IMPLIES
        EXISTS (derivative: real):
          has_derivative_within_nonnegative(
            f, derivative, x)

  satisfies_differential_equation(f: real_function): bool =
    FORALL (x: real):
      x > 0 IMPLIES
        has_derivative_at(
          f, -3 * f(x) + 6 * f(2 * x), x)

  satisfies_decay_bound(f: real_function): bool =
    FORALL (x: real):
      x >= 0 IMPLIES
        abs(f(x))
          <= real_exponential(-nonnegative_sqrt(x))

  valid_tagged_partition(
      left, right: real,
      points, tags: real_sequence,
      count: nat): bool =
    count > 0
      AND points(0) = left
      AND points(count) = right
      AND FORALL (index: nat):
        index < count IMPLIES
          (points(index) < points(index + 1)
            AND points(index) <= tags(index)
            AND tags(index) <= points(index + 1))

  mesh_less_than(
      points: real_sequence,
      count: nat,
      bound: real): bool =
    FORALL (index: nat):
      index < count IMPLIES
        points(index + 1) - points(index) < bound

  riemann_sum(
      f: real_function,
      points, tags: real_sequence,
      count: nat): RECURSIVE real =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      riemann_sum(f, points, tags, count - 1)
        + f(tags(count - 1))
            * (points(count) - points(count - 1))
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  has_interval_integral(
      f: real_function,
      left, right, integral_value: real): bool =
    left < right
      AND FORALL (epsilon_value: posreal):
        EXISTS (mesh_bound: posreal):
          FORALL
              (points, tags: real_sequence),
              (count: nat):
            (valid_tagged_partition(
                left, right, points, tags, count)
              AND mesh_less_than(
                points, count, mesh_bound))
            IMPLIES
              abs(
                riemann_sum(f, points, tags, count)
                  - integral_value)
                < epsilon_value

  interval_integral(
      f: real_function,
      left, right: real): real =
    IF EXISTS (integral_value: real):
        has_interval_integral(
          f, left, right, integral_value)
    THEN
      epsilon(
        LAMBDA (integral_value: real):
          has_interval_integral(
            f, left, right, integral_value))
    ELSE
      0
    ENDIF

  converges_at_real_top(
      values: positive_real_function,
      limit_value: real): bool =
    FORALL (epsilon_value: posreal):
      EXISTS (cutoff: posreal):
        FORALL (radius: posreal):
          cutoff <= radius IMPLIES
            abs(values(radius) - limit_value) < epsilon_value

  moment_integrand(
      f: real_function,
      degree: nat): real_function =
    LAMBDA (x: real): x ^ degree * f(x)

  has_improper_moment(
      f: real_function,
      degree: nat,

    (C : Ensemble (Ensemble nat)) : Prop :=

      Same_set nat A B.

      (forall A B : Ensemble nat,
          In (Ensemble nat) C A ->
          In (Ensemble nat) C B ->
          ~ Same_set nat A B ->
          Finite nat (Intersection nat A B))) <->
  putnam_1989_b4_solution.
Admitted.

;; there exists an uncountable collection of nonempty subsets of a countably
;; infinite set such that distinct members have finite intersection. This file
;; contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))

;; The natural numbers are the canonical countably infinite carrier. Subsets
;; and their family are tame APPLY$ predicates, with explicit extensionality.
;; DEFUN-SK keeps the family and all auxiliary witnesses internally quantified.
;; Countability is existence of an extensional injection into the naturals.
;; A subset of the naturals is finite exactly when it has a natural bound.

(defun putnam-1989-b4-member-p (predicate object)
  (if (apply$ predicate (list object))
      t
    nil))

(defun putnam-1989-b4-value (function object)
  (apply$ function (list object)))

(defun-sk putnam-1989-b4-members-are-natural-p (set)
  (forall (object)
    (implies
     (putnam-1989-b4-member-p set object)
     (natp object))))

(defun putnam-1989-b4-nat-set-p (set)
  (and
   (tamep-functionp set)
   (putnam-1989-b4-members-are-natural-p set)))

(defun-sk putnam-1989-b4-nat-set-equiv-p (left right)
  (forall (n)
    (implies
     (natp n)
     (iff
      (putnam-1989-b4-member-p left n)
      (putnam-1989-b4-member-p right n)))))

(defun-sk putnam-1989-b4-family-members-valid-p (family)
  (forall (set)
    (implies
     (putnam-1989-b4-member-p family set)
     (putnam-1989-b4-nat-set-p set))))

(defun-sk putnam-1989-b4-family-extensional-p (family)
  (forall (left right)
    (implies
     (and
      (putnam-1989-b4-nat-set-p left)
      (putnam-1989-b4-nat-set-p right)
      (putnam-1989-b4-nat-set-equiv-p left right))
     (iff
      (putnam-1989-b4-member-p family left)
      (putnam-1989-b4-member-p family right)))))

(defun putnam-1989-b4-family-of-nat-sets-p (family)
  (and
   (tamep-functionp family)
   (putnam-1989-b4-family-members-valid-p family)
   (putnam-1989-b4-family-extensional-p family)))

(defun-sk putnam-1989-b4-nat-set-nonempty-p (set)
  (exists (n)
    (and
     (natp n)
     (putnam-1989-b4-member-p set n))))

(defun-sk putnam-1989-b4-all-members-nonempty-p (family)
  (forall (set)
    (implies
     (putnam-1989-b4-member-p family set)
     (putnam-1989-b4-nat-set-nonempty-p set))))

(defun-sk putnam-1989-b4-intersection-bounded-p
    (left right bound)
  (forall (n)
    (implies
     (and
      (natp n)
      (putnam-1989-b4-member-p left n)
      (putnam-1989-b4-member-p right n))
     (< n bound))))

(defun-sk putnam-1989-b4-intersection-finite-p (left right)
  (exists (bound)
    (and
     (natp bound)
     (putnam-1989-b4-intersection-bounded-p
      left right bound))))

(defun-sk putnam-1989-b4-pairwise-finite-intersections-p (family)
  (forall (left right)
    (implies
     (and
      (putnam-1989-b4-member-p family left)
      (putnam-1989-b4-member-p family right)
      (not
       (putnam-1989-b4-nat-set-equiv-p left right)))
     (putnam-1989-b4-intersection-finite-p left right))))

;; An encoding represents a function on extensional subsets: it is invariant
;; under set equivalence, maps family members to naturals, and is injective on
;; the family modulo extensional equality.

(defun-sk putnam-1989-b4-countable-encoding-laws-p
    (family encoding)
  (forall (left right)
    (and
     (implies
      (putnam-1989-b4-member-p family left)
      (natp
       (putnam-1989-b4-value encoding left)))
     (implies
      (and
       (putnam-1989-b4-member-p family left)
       (putnam-1989-b4-member-p family right)
       (putnam-1989-b4-nat-set-equiv-p left right))
      (equal
       (putnam-1989-b4-value encoding left)
       (putnam-1989-b4-value encoding right)))
     (implies
      (and
       (putnam-1989-b4-member-p family left)
       (putnam-1989-b4-member-p family right)
       (equal
        (putnam-1989-b4-value encoding left)
        (putnam-1989-b4-value encoding right)))
      (putnam-1989-b4-nat-set-equiv-p left right)))))

(defun putnam-1989-b4-countable-encoding-p
    (family encoding)
  (and
   (tamep-functionp encoding)
   (putnam-1989-b4-countable-encoding-laws-p
    family encoding)))

(defun-sk putnam-1989-b4-family-countable-p (family)
  (exists (encoding)
    (putnam-1989-b4-countable-encoding-p
     family encoding)))

(defun-sk putnambench-putnam-1989-b4-statement ()
  (exists (family)
    (and
     (putnam-1989-b4-family-of-nat-sets-p family)
     (not
      (putnam-1989-b4-family-countable-p family))
     (putnam-1989-b4-all-members-nonempty-p family)
     (putnam-1989-b4-pairwise-finite-intersections-p

-- Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1989_b4:
-- a countably infinite set has an uncountable collection of nonempty subsets
-- whose pairwise intersections are finite. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module Putnam1989B4 where

open import Agda.Builtin.List using (List; []; _∷_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat)

data Bottom : Set where

Not : Set -> Set
Not A =
  A -> Bottom

Not1 : Set1 -> Set1
Not1 A =
  A -> Bottom

record Iff (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor equivalence
  field
    forward  : A -> B
    backward : B -> A

record Iff1 (A B : Set1) : Set1 where
  constructor equivalence1
  field
    forward1  : A -> B
    backward1 : B -> A

record Truth1 : Set1 where
  constructor true1

Subset : Set -> Set1
Subset A =
  A -> Set

Family : Set1
Family =
  Subset Nat -> Set

ExtensionalEqual :
  {A : Set} ->
  Subset A ->
  Subset A ->
  Set
ExtensionalEqual {A} left right =
  (x : A) ->
  Iff (left x) (right x)

data Member {A : Set} (x : A) : List A -> Set where
  at-head :
    {xs : List A} ->
    Member x (x ∷ xs)
  in-tail :
    {y : A} ->
    {xs : List A} ->
    Member x xs ->
    Member x (y ∷ xs)

emptySubset : Subset Nat
emptySubset _ =
  Bottom

NonemptySubset : Subset Nat -> Set
NonemptySubset subset =
  Not (ExtensionalEqual subset emptySubset)

record ExistsNat (property : Nat -> Set) : Set where
  field
    witness : Nat
    holds   : property witness

record FiniteIntersection
  (left right : Subset Nat) :
  Set where

  field
    elements : List Nat
    complete :
      (x : Nat) ->
      left x ->
      right x ->
      Member x elements

record CountableFamily (collection : Family) : Set1 where
  field
    enumerate : Nat -> Subset Nat
    covered :
      (subset : Subset Nat) ->
      collection subset ->
      ExistsNat
        (\ n -> ExtensionalEqual subset (enumerate n))

record AlmostDisjointUncountableFamily : Set1 where
  field
    collection : Family
    uncountable :
      Not1 (CountableFamily collection)
    members-nonempty :
      (subset : Subset Nat) ->
      collection subset ->
      NonemptySubset subset
    pairwise-finite-intersections :
      (left right : Subset Nat) ->
      collection left ->
      collection right ->
      Not (ExtensionalEqual left right) ->
      FiniteIntersection left right

putnam-1989-b4 : Set1
putnam-1989-b4 =
  Iff1 AlmostDisjointUncountableFamily Truth1

% Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1989_b4:
% an uncountable family of nonempty subsets of a countably infinite set can
% have finite intersection between every two distinct members. This file
% contains no proof.

putnam_1989_b4: THEORY
BEGIN
  natural_set: TYPE = [nat -> bool]
  natural_set_family: TYPE = [natural_set -> bool]
  natural_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> nat]
  natural_set_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> natural_set]

  nonempty(set_value: natural_set): bool =
    EXISTS (element: nat):
      set_value(element)

  intersection(
      left, right: natural_set): natural_set =
    LAMBDA (element: nat):
      left(element) AND right(element)

  finite_natural_set(set_value: natural_set): bool =
    EXISTS (enumeration: natural_sequence), (bound: nat):
      FORALL (element: nat):
        set_value(element)
          IFF
            EXISTS (index: nat):
              index < bound
                AND enumeration(index) = element

  countable_family(family: natural_set_family): bool =
    EXISTS (enumeration: natural_set_sequence):
      FORALL (set_value: natural_set):
        family(set_value)
          IMPLIES
            EXISTS (index: nat):
              enumeration(index) = set_value

  admissible_family(family: natural_set_family): bool =
    NOT countable_family(family)
      AND
        (FORALL (set_value: natural_set):
          family(set_value) IMPLIES nonempty(set_value))
      AND
        (FORALL (left, right: natural_set):
          family(left)
            AND family(right)
            AND left /= right
          IMPLIES
            finite_natural_set(intersection(left, right)))

  putnam_1989_b4_solution: bool = TRUE

  putnam_1989_b4: bool =
    (EXISTS (family: natural_set_family):
      admissible_family(family))
    IFF putnam_1989_b4_solution
END putnam_1989_b4

import Mathlib

open Nat Filter Topology Set ProbabilityTheory

-- Note: uses (ℝ → ℝ) instead of (Set.Icc 0 1 → ℝ)
/--
Let $(x_1,x_2,\dots,x_n)$ be a point chosen at random from the $n$-dimensional region defined by $0< x_1< x_2<\dots< x_n<1$. Let $f$ be a continuous function on $[0,1]$ with $f(1)=0$. Set $x_0=0$ and $x_{n+1}=1$. Show that the expected value of the Riemann sum $\sum_{i=0}^n (x_{i+1}-x_i)f(x_{i+1})$ is $\int_0^1 f(t)P(t)\,dt$, where $P$ is a polynomial of degree $n$, independent of $f$, with $0 \leq P(t) \leq 1$ for $0 \leq t \leq 1$.
-/
theorem putnam_1989_b6
    (n : ℕ) [NeZero n]
    (I : (Fin n → ℝ) → Fin (n + 2) → ℝ)
    (I_def : ∀ x, I x = Fin.cons 0 (Fin.snoc x 1))
    (X : Set (Fin n → ℝ))
    (X_def : ∀ x, x ∈ X ↔ 0 < x 0 ∧ x (-1) < 1 ∧ StrictMono x)
    (S : (ℝ → ℝ) → (Fin (n + 2) → ℝ) → ℝ)
    (S_def : ∀ f x, S f x = ∑ i : Fin n.succ, (x i.succ - x i.castSucc) * f (x i.succ)) :
    ∃ P : Polynomial ℝ,
      P.degree = n ∧
      (∀ t ∈ Icc 0 1, P.eval t ∈ Icc 0 1) ∧
      (∀ f : ℝ → ℝ, f 1 = 0 → ContinuousOn f (Icc 0 1) →
        ∫ x, S f (I x) ∂ℙ[|X] = ∫ t in (0)..1, f t * P.eval t) :=
  sorry

title: putnam_1989_b6
content:
(* Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench artifact putnam_1989_b6:
   the expected right-endpoint Riemann sum on an ordered simplex is an
   integral against a bounded polynomial of the same dimension. This file
   contains no proof. *)

From Stdlib Require Import Reals RiemannInt.

Open Scope R_scope.

Definition putnam_1989_b6_update
    (x : nat -> R) (i : nat) (y : R) : nat -> R :=
  fun j => if Nat.eq_dec j i then y else x j.

Fixpoint putnam_1989_b6_simplex_integral
    (integral : (R -> R) -> R -> R -> R)
    (remaining index : nat) (lower : R)
    (g : (nat -> R) -> R) (x : nat -> R) : R :=
  match remaining with
  | O => g x
  | S k =>
      integral
        (fun y =>
           putnam_1989_b6_simplex_integral
             integral k (S index) y g
             (putnam_1989_b6_update x index y))
        lower 1
  end.

Definition putnam_1989_b6_uniform_expectation
    (integral : (R -> R) -> R -> R -> R)
    (n : nat) (g : (nat -> R) -> R) : R :=
  putnam_1989_b6_simplex_integral
    integral n 1 0 g (fun _ => 0) /
  putnam_1989_b6_simplex_integral
    integral n 1 0 (fun _ => 1) (fun _ => 0).

Definition putnam_1989_b6_represents_riemann_integral
    (integral : (R -> R) -> R -> R -> R) : Prop :=
  forall (f : R -> R) (a b : R)
         (pr : Riemann_integrable f a b),
    integral f a b = RiemannInt pr.

Definition putnam_1989_b6_extended
    (n : nat) (x : nat -> R) (i : nat) : R :=
  if Nat.eq_dec i O then 0
  else if Nat.eq_dec i (S n) then 1
  else x i.

Definition putnam_1989_b6_sum
    (n : nat) (f : R -> R) (x : nat -> R) : R :=
  sum_f_R0
    (fun i =>
       (putnam_1989_b6_extended n x (S i) -
        putnam_1989_b6_extended n x i) *
       f (putnam_1989_b6_extended n x (S i)))
    n.

Definition putnam_1989_b6_polynomial_value
    (p : nat -> R) (n : nat) (t : R) : R :=
  sum_f_R0 (fun i => p i * t ^ i) n.

Definition putnam_1989_b6_exact_degree
    (p : nat -> R) (n : nat) : Prop :=
  p n <> 0 /\ forall k : nat, (n < k)%nat -> p k = 0.

Definition putnam_1989_b6_continuous_on_unit
    (f : R -> R) : Prop :=
  forall t : R, 0 <= t <= 1 -> continuity_pt f t.

Theorem putnam_1989_b6 :
  forall integral : (R -> R) -> R -> R -> R,
  putnam_1989_b6_represents_riemann_integral integral ->
  forall n : nat, (1 <= n)%nat ->
  exists p : nat -> R,
    putnam_1989_b6_exact_degree p n /\
    (forall t : R, 0 <= t <= 1 ->
       0 <= putnam_1989_b6_polynomial_value p n t <= 1) /\
    (forall f : R -> R,
       f 1 = 0 ->
       putnam_1989_b6_continuous_on_unit f ->
       putnam_1989_b6_uniform_expectation
         integral n (putnam_1989_b6_sum n f) =
       integral
         (fun t => f t * putnam_1989_b6_polynomial_value p n t)
         0 1).
Proof.
Admitted.
