title: putnam_1991_b6
putnam_1991_b6
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1991_b6:
;; for positive real a and b, |log(a/b)| is the greatest cutoff for the
;; stated hyperbolic-sine interpolation inequality. This file contains no
;; proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))

;; The context presents a Dedekind-complete ordered field, hence the real
;; field up to ordered-field isomorphism, together with its exponential and
;; logarithm. Arbitrary subsets and functions are tame APPLY$ function
;; objects. The exponential is characterized by exp(0)=1 and exp'=exp, and
;; logarithm is its inverse on the positive reals. Thus real powers and sinh
;; below are definitions of the source operations, not rational or finite
;; approximations.

(defun p91b6-member-p (carrier x)
  (if (apply$ carrier (list x)) t nil))

(defun p91b6-unary-value (function x)
  (apply$ function (list x)))

(defun p91b6-binary-value (function x y)
  (apply$ function (list x y)))

(defun-sk p91b6-valid-set-p (carrier set)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (apply$ set (list x))
     (p91b6-member-p carrier x))))

(defun-sk p91b6-real-function-p (carrier function)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (p91b6-member-p carrier x)
     (p91b6-member-p
      carrier
      (p91b6-unary-value function x)))))

(defun-sk p91b6-field-laws-p
    (carrier add multiply negate inverse zero one)
  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (p91b6-member-p carrier x)
      (p91b6-member-p carrier y)
      (p91b6-member-p carrier z))
     (and
      (p91b6-member-p
       carrier (p91b6-binary-value add x y))
      (p91b6-member-p
       carrier (p91b6-binary-value multiply x y))
      (p91b6-member-p
       carrier (p91b6-unary-value negate x))
      (p91b6-member-p
       carrier (p91b6-unary-value inverse x))
      (equal
       (p91b6-binary-value
        add (p91b6-binary-value add x y) z)
       (p91b6-binary-value
        add x (p91b6-binary-value add y z)))
      (equal
       (p91b6-binary-value add x y)
       (p91b6-binary-value add y x))
      (equal (p91b6-binary-value add x zero) x)
      (equal
       (p91b6-binary-value
        add x (p91b6-unary-value negate x))
       zero)
      (equal
       (p91b6-binary-value
        multiply (p91b6-binary-value multiply x y) z)
       (p91b6-binary-value
        multiply x (p91b6-binary-value multiply y z)))
      (equal
       (p91b6-binary-value multiply x y)
       (p91b6-binary-value multiply y x))
      (equal
       (p91b6-binary-value multiply x one)
       x)
      (implies
       (equal x zero)
       (equal (p91b6-unary-value inverse x) zero))
      (implies
       (not (equal x zero))
       (equal
        (p91b6-binary-value
         multiply x (p91b6-unary-value inverse x))
        one))
      (equal
       (p91b6-binary-value
        multiply x (p91b6-binary-value add y z))
       (p91b6-binary-value
        add
        (p91b6-binary-value multiply x y)
        (p91b6-binary-value multiply x z)))))))

(defun-sk p91b6-order-laws-p
    (carrier add multiply zero less)
  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (p91b6-member-p carrier x)
      (p91b6-member-p carrier y)
      (p91b6-member-p carrier z))
     (and
      (not (p91b6-binary-value less x x))
      (or
       (equal x y)
       (p91b6-binary-value less x y)
       (p91b6-binary-value less y x))
      (implies
       (and
        (p91b6-binary-value less x y)
        (p91b6-binary-value less y z))
       (p91b6-binary-value less x z))
      (implies
       (p91b6-binary-value less x y)
       (p91b6-binary-value
        less
        (p91b6-binary-value add x z)
        (p91b6-binary-value add y z)))
      (implies
       (and
        (p91b6-binary-value less zero x)
        (p91b6-binary-value less zero y))
       (p91b6-binary-value
        less zero
        (p91b6-binary-value multiply x y)))))))

(defun-sk p91b6-set-nonempty-p (carrier set)
  (exists (x)
    (and
     (p91b6-member-p carrier x)
     (apply$ set (list x)))))

(defun-sk p91b6-upper-bound-p
    (carrier less set bound)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (and
      (p91b6-member-p carrier x)
      (apply$ set (list x)))
     (not (p91b6-binary-value less bound x)))))

(defun-sk p91b6-bounded-above-p
    (carrier less set)
  (exists (bound)
    (and
     (p91b6-member-p carrier bound)
     (p91b6-upper-bound-p
      carrier less set bound))))

(defun-sk p91b6-least-upper-bound-p
    (carrier less set supremum)
  (forall (bound)
    (implies
     (and
      (p91b6-member-p carrier bound)
      (p91b6-upper-bound-p carrier less set bound))
     (not (p91b6-binary-value less bound supremum)))))

(defun p91b6-supremum-p
    (carrier less set supremum)
  (and
   (p91b6-member-p carrier supremum)
   (p91b6-upper-bound-p carrier less set supremum)
   (p91b6-least-upper-bound-p
    carrier less set supremum)))

(defun-sk p91b6-has-supremum-p
    (carrier less set)
  (exists (supremum)
    (p91b6-supremum-p
     carrier less set supremum)))

(defun-sk p91b6-dedekind-complete-p
    (carrier less)
  (forall (set)
    (implies
     (and
      (tamep-functionp set)
      (p91b6-valid-set-p carrier set)
      (p91b6-set-nonempty-p carrier set)
      (p91b6-bounded-above-p carrier less set))
     (p91b6-has-supremum-p carrier less set))))

(defun p91b6-real-field-p
    (carrier zero one add multiply negate inverse less)
  (and
   (tamep-functionp carrier)
   (tamep-functionp add)
   (tamep-functionp multiply)
   (tamep-functionp negate)
   (tamep-functionp inverse)
   (tamep-functionp less)
   (p91b6-member-p carrier zero)
   (p91b6-member-p carrier one)
   (not (equal zero one))
   (p91b6-field-laws-p
    carrier add multiply negate inverse zero one)
   (p91b6-order-laws-p
    carrier add multiply zero less)
   (p91b6-binary-value less zero one)
   (p91b6-dedekind-complete-p carrier less)))

;; The outer context is (field-context exponential logarithm), where the
;; field context is (carrier zero one add multiply negate inverse less).

(defun p91b6-field-context (ctx)
  (nth 0 ctx))

(defun p91b6-r-carrier (ctx)
  (nth 0 (p91b6-field-context ctx)))

(defun p91b6-r-zero (ctx)
  (nth 1 (p91b6-field-context ctx)))

(defun p91b6-r-one (ctx)
  (nth 2 (p91b6-field-context ctx)))

(defun p91b6-r-add (ctx)
  (nth 3 (p91b6-field-context ctx)))

(defun p91b6-r-mul (ctx)
  (nth 4 (p91b6-field-context ctx)))

(defun p91b6-r-neg (ctx)
  (nth 5 (p91b6-field-context ctx)))

(defun p91b6-r-inv (ctx)
  (nth 6 (p91b6-field-context ctx)))

(defun p91b6-r-lt (ctx)
  (nth 7 (p91b6-field-context ctx)))

(defun p91b6-r-exp (ctx)
  (nth 1 ctx))

(defun p91b6-r-log (ctx)
  (nth 2 ctx))

(defun p91b6-field-context-p (field-context)
  (and
   (true-listp field-context)
   (equal (len field-context) 8)
   (p91b6-real-field-p
    (nth 0 field-context)
    (nth 1 field-context)
    (nth 2 field-context)
    (nth 3 field-context)
    (nth 4 field-context)
    (nth 5 field-context)
    (nth 6 field-context)
    (nth 7 field-context))))

(defun p91b6-r-add-value (ctx x y)
  (p91b6-binary-value (p91b6-r-add ctx) x y))

(defun p91b6-r-neg-value (ctx x)
  (p91b6-unary-value (p91b6-r-neg ctx) x))

(defun p91b6-r-sub-value (ctx x y)
  (p91b6-r-add-value
   ctx x (p91b6-r-neg-value ctx y)))

(defun p91b6-r-mul-value (ctx x y)
  (p91b6-binary-value (p91b6-r-mul ctx) x y))

(defun p91b6-r-inv-value (ctx x)
  (p91b6-unary-value (p91b6-r-inv ctx) x))

(defun p91b6-r-div-value (ctx x y)
  (p91b6-r-mul-value
   ctx x (p91b6-r-inv-value ctx y)))

(defun p91b6-r-lt-p (ctx x y)
  (if (p91b6-binary-value (p91b6-r-lt ctx) x y)
      t nil))

(defun p91b6-r-le-p (ctx x y)
  (not (p91b6-r-lt-p ctx y x)))

(defun p91b6-r-abs-value (ctx x)
  (if (p91b6-r-lt-p ctx x (p91b6-r-zero ctx))
      (p91b6-r-neg-value ctx x)
    x))

(defun p91b6-positive-real-p (ctx x)
  (and
   (p91b6-member-p (p91b6-r-carrier ctx) x)
   (p91b6-r-lt-p ctx (p91b6-r-zero ctx) x)))

(defun p91b6-r-two (ctx)
  (p91b6-r-add-value
   ctx (p91b6-r-one ctx) (p91b6-r-one ctx)))

;; HasDerivAt in epsilon-delta form:
;; |f(z)-f(x)-d(z-x)| <= epsilon*|z-x| near x.

(defun-sk p91b6-derivative-neighborhood-p
    (ctx function derivative x epsilon radius)
  (forall (z)
    (implies
     (and
      (p91b6-member-p (p91b6-r-carrier ctx) z)
      (p91b6-r-lt-p
       ctx
       (p91b6-r-abs-value
        ctx (p91b6-r-sub-value ctx z x))
       radius))
     (p91b6-r-le-p
      ctx
      (p91b6-r-abs-value
       ctx
       (p91b6-r-sub-value
        ctx
        (p91b6-r-sub-value
         ctx
         (p91b6-unary-value function z)
         (p91b6-unary-value function x))
        (p91b6-r-mul-value
         ctx derivative
         (p91b6-r-sub-value ctx z x))))
      (p91b6-r-mul-value
       ctx epsilon
       (p91b6-r-abs-value
        ctx (p91b6-r-sub-value ctx z x)))))))

(defun-sk p91b6-derivative-radius-exists-p
    (ctx function derivative x epsilon)
  (exists (radius)
    (and
     (p91b6-positive-real-p ctx radius)
     (p91b6-derivative-neighborhood-p
      ctx function derivative x epsilon radius))))

(defun-sk p91b6-has-derivative-at-p
    (ctx function derivative x)
  (forall (epsilon)
    (implies
     (p91b6-positive-real-p ctx epsilon)

title: putnam_1991_b6
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact
-- putnambench__agda__putnam_1991_b6: for positive real a and b, the greatest
-- radius for the stated hyperbolic-sine inequality is |log (a / b)|.
-- This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; _*_)

infix 4 _!=_ _<=N_
infixr 3 _and_
infixr 2 _or_

data Bottom : Set where

Not : Set -> Set
Not A =
  A -> Bottom

_!=_ : {A : Set} -> A -> A -> Set
x != y =
  Not (x == y)

record _and_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data _or_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  left  : A -> A or B
  right : B -> A or B

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

data _<=N_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set where
  zero<=N   : {n : Nat} -> zero <=N n
  suc<=sucN : {m n : Nat} -> m <=N n -> suc m <=N suc n

record CompleteOrderedRealField (R : Set) : Set1 where
  field
    zeroR oneR : R
    add multiply : R -> R -> R
    negate inverse absoluteValue : R -> R
    lessOrEqual : R -> R -> Set
    fromNat : Nat -> R

    one-not-zero :
      oneR != zeroR

    add-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> add x y == add y x
    add-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      add (add x y) z == add x (add y z)
    add-zero :
      (x : R) -> add x zeroR == x
    add-inverse :
      (x : R) -> add x (negate x) == zeroR

    multiply-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> multiply x y == multiply y x
    multiply-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply (multiply x y) z ==
      multiply x (multiply y z)
    multiply-one :
      (x : R) -> multiply x oneR == x
    multiply-zero :
      (x : R) -> multiply x zeroR == zeroR
    distribute :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply x (add y z) ==
      add (multiply x y) (multiply x z)
    inverse-zero :
      inverse zeroR == zeroR
    multiply-inverse :
      (x : R) ->
      x != zeroR ->
      multiply x (inverse x) == oneR

    order-reflexive :
      (x : R) -> lessOrEqual x x
    order-transitive :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y z ->
      lessOrEqual x z
    order-antisymmetric :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y x ->
      x == y
    order-total :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y or lessOrEqual y x
    add-order :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual (add z x) (add z y)
    multiply-nonnegative :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR x ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR y ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR (multiply x y)
    zero-less-than-one :
      lessOrEqual zeroR oneR and zeroR != oneR

    absolute-nonnegative :
      (x : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR (absoluteValue x)
    absolute-of-nonnegative :
      (x : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR x ->
      absoluteValue x == x
    absolute-of-nonpositive :
      (x : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x zeroR ->
      absoluteValue x == negate x

    fromNat-zero :
      fromNat zero == zeroR
    fromNat-successor :
      (n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (suc n) == add (fromNat n) oneR
    fromNat-addition :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m + n) == add (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-multiplication :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m * n) == multiply (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-injective :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat m == fromNat n ->
      m == n

    archimedean :
      (x : R) ->
      Exists Nat (\ n -> lessOrEqual x (fromNat n))
    least-upper-bound :
      (P : R -> Set) ->
      Exists R P ->
      Exists R
        (\ upper ->
          (x : R) ->
          P x ->
          lessOrEqual x upper) ->
      Exists R
        (\ supremum ->
          ((x : R) ->
            P x ->
            lessOrEqual x supremum)
          and
          ((upper : R) ->
            ((x : R) ->
              P x ->
              lessOrEqual x upper) ->
            lessOrEqual supremum upper))

open CompleteOrderedRealField

oneN : Nat
oneN =
  suc zero

twoN : Nat
twoN =
  suc oneN

subtract :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
subtract reals x y =
  add reals x (negate reals y)

divide :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
divide reals x y =
  multiply reals x (inverse reals y)

StrictLess :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
StrictLess reals x y =
  lessOrEqual reals x y and x != y

CloseTo :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
CloseTo reals center radius x =
  StrictLess reals
    (subtract reals center radius)
    x
  and
  StrictLess reals
    x
    (add reals center radius)

ConvergesTo :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  R ->
  Set
ConvergesTo {R} reals sequence limit =
  (epsilon : R) ->
  StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) epsilon ->
  Exists Nat
    (\ cutoff ->
      (n : Nat) ->
      cutoff <=N n ->
      CloseTo reals limit epsilon (sequence n))

naturalPower :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  Nat ->
  R
naturalPower reals x zero =
  oneR reals
naturalPower reals x (suc n) =
  multiply reals
    (naturalPower reals x n)
    x

factorial : Nat -> Nat
factorial zero =
  oneN
factorial (suc n) =
  suc n * factorial n

sumFirst :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Nat ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  R
sumFirst reals zero term =
  zeroR reals
sumFirst reals (suc n) term =
  add reals
    (sumFirst reals n term)
    (term n)

SeriesHasSum :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  R ->
  Set
SeriesHasSum reals terms limit =
  ConvergesTo reals
    (\ n -> sumFirst reals n terms)
    limit

exponentialTerm :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  Nat ->
  R
exponentialTerm reals x n =
  divide reals
    (naturalPower reals x n)
    (fromNat reals (factorial n))

ExponentialValue :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
ExponentialValue reals x value =
  SeriesHasSum reals
    (exponentialTerm reals x)
    value

record StandardRealPowers
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) :
  Set1 where

  field
    exponential logarithm : R -> R

    exponential-series :
      (x : R) ->
      ExponentialValue reals x (exponential x)

    exponential-positive :
      (x : R) ->
      StrictLess reals
        (zeroR reals)
        (exponential x)

    exponential-injective :
      (x y : R) ->
      exponential x == exponential y ->
      x == y

    exponential-logarithm :
      (x : R) ->
      StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) x ->
      exponential (logarithm x) == x

open StandardRealPowers

realPower :
  {R : Set} ->
  {reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R} ->
  StandardRealPowers reals ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
realPower {reals = reals} powers base exponent =
  exponential powers
    (multiply reals exponent (logarithm powers base))

hyperbolicSine :
  {R : Set} ->
  {reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R} ->
  StandardRealPowers reals ->
  R ->
  R
hyperbolicSine {reals = reals} powers x =
  divide reals
    (subtract reals
      (exponential powers x)
      (exponential powers (negate reals x)))
    (fromNat reals twoN)

record IsGreatest
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R)
  (property : R -> Set)
  (greatest : R) :
  Set where

  field
    belongs :
      property greatest

    greatest-property :
      (x : R) ->
      property x ->
      lessOrEqual reals x greatest

module Putnam1991B6Statement
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R)
  (powers : StandardRealPowers reals) where

  InOpenUnitInterval : R -> Set
  InOpenUnitInterval x =
    StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) x
    and
    StrictLess reals x (oneR reals)

  leftSide : R -> R -> R -> R
  leftSide a b x =
    multiply reals
      (realPower powers a x)
      (realPower powers b
        (subtract reals (oneR reals) x))

  rightSide : R -> R -> R -> R -> R
  rightSide a b u x =
    add reals
      (multiply reals a
        (divide reals
          (hyperbolicSine powers
            (multiply reals u x))
          (hyperbolicSine powers u)))
      (multiply reals b
        (divide reals
          (hyperbolicSine powers
            (multiply reals u
              (subtract reals (oneR reals) x)))
          (hyperbolicSine powers u)))

  AdmissibleRadius : R -> R -> R -> Set
  AdmissibleRadius a b c =
    (u : R) ->
    (StrictLess reals
      (zeroR reals)
      (absoluteValue reals u)
    and
    lessOrEqual reals
      (absoluteValue reals u)
      c) ->
    (x : R) ->
    InOpenUnitInterval x ->
    lessOrEqual reals
      (leftSide a b x)
      (rightSide a b u x)

  solution : R -> R -> R
  solution a b =
    absoluteValue reals
      (logarithm powers
        (divide reals a b))

  proposition : Set
  proposition =
    (a b : R) ->
    (StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) a
      and
      StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) b) ->
    IsGreatest reals
      (AdmissibleRadius a b)
      (solution a b)

putnam-1991-b6 : Set1
putnam-1991-b6 =
  (R : Set) ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) ->
  (powers : StandardRealPowers reals) ->
  Putnam1991B6Statement.proposition reals powers

title: putnam_1991_b6
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1991_b6:
  the largest bound on a real parameter for a weighted hyperbolic-sine
  inequality between positive real numbers. This file contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open realTheory transcTheory;

val putnam_1991_b6 =
  ``!a b : real.
      0 < a /\ 0 < b
      ==>
      let sinh =
        \z : real. (exp z - exp (~z)) / 2
      in
      let admissible =
        \c : real.
          !u : real.
            0 < abs u /\ abs u <= c
            ==>
            !x : real.
              0 < x /\ x < 1
              ==>
              a powr x * b powr (1 - x) <=
                a * (sinh (u * x) / sinh u) +
                b * (sinh (u * (1 - x)) / sinh u)
      in
      let solution = abs (ln (a / b))
      in
        admissible solution /\
        !c : real. admissible c ==> c <= solution``;

title: putnam_1991_b6
content:
$(
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact
  putnam_1991_b6: the largest real bound for a hyperbolic-sine inequality
  between positive real numbers is the absolute logarithm of their ratio.
  This file contains no proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  For positive real bases, exp(x log(a)) and exp((1-x) log(b)) are exactly
  the real powers a^x and b^(1-x) used by the sources. The two conjuncts
  expand IsGreatest: the explicit value |log(a/b)| satisfies the inequality
  for every permitted real u and x, and every real c satisfying the same
  universal condition is at most that value.

  The final declaration is the single unproved $a corpus statement; this
  database contains no $p proof statement.
$)

${
  $d a b c u x $.

  putnambench-putnam-1991-b6 $a |- A. a e. RR A. b e. RR
    (
      (
        0 < a
        /\
        0 < b
      )
      ->
      (
        A. u e. RR
          (
            (
              0 < ( abs ` u )
              /\
              ( abs ` u )
                <_
                ( abs ` ( log ` ( a / b ) ) )
            )
            ->
            A. x e. RR
              (
                (
                  0 < x
                  /\
                  x < 1
                )
                ->
                (
                  (
                    ( exp ` ( x x. ( log ` a ) ) )
                    x.
                    (
                      exp
                      `
                      (
                        ( 1 - x )
                        x.
                        ( log ` b )
                      )
                    )
                  )
                  <_
                  (
                    (
                      a
                      x.
                      (
                        ( sinh ` ( u x. x ) )
                        /
                        ( sinh ` u )
                      )
                    )
                    +
                    (
                      b
                      x.
                      (
                        ( sinh ` ( u x. ( 1 - x ) ) )
                        /
                        ( sinh ` u )
                      )
                    )
                  )
                )
              )
          )
        /\
        A. c e. RR
          (
            (
              A. u e. RR
                (
                  (
                    0 < ( abs ` u )
                    /\
                    ( abs ` u ) <_ c
                  )
                  ->
                  A. x e. RR
                    (
                      (
                        0 < x
                        /\
                        x < 1
                      )
                      ->
                      (
                        (
                          ( exp ` ( x x. ( log ` a ) ) )
                          x.
                          (
                            exp
                            `
                            (
                              ( 1 - x )
                              x.
                              ( log ` b )
                            )
                          )
                        )
                        <_
                        (
                          (
                            a
                            x.
                            (
                              ( sinh ` ( u x. x ) )
                              /
                              ( sinh ` u )
                            )
                          )
                          +
                          (
                            b
                            x.
                            (
                              ( sinh ` ( u x. ( 1 - x ) ) )
                              /
                              ( sinh ` u )
                            )
                          )
                        )
                      )
                    )
                )
            )
            ->
            c <_ ( abs ` ( log ` ( a / b ) ) )
          )
      )
    )
  $.
$}

title: putnam_1991_b6
content:
:: Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1991_b6:
:: for positive real a and b, the largest real c for which the stated
:: hyperbolic-sine inequality holds for all 0 < |u| <= c and 0 < x < 1
:: is |ln(a/b)|. This file contains no proof.

environ
  vocabularies TARSKI, XBOOLE_0, SUBSET_1, RELAT_1, FUNCT_1, FUNCT_2,
    PARTFUN1, NUMBERS, XREAL_0, COMPLEX1, CARD_1, XXREAL_0, XXREAL_1,
    ARYTM_1, ARYTM_3, REAL_1, INT_1, NAT_1, VALUED_0, VALUED_1,
    ORDINAL1, NEWTON, PREPOWER, POWER, SIN_COS, SIN_COS2, TAYLOR_1;
  notations TARSKI, XBOOLE_0, SUBSET_1, RELAT_1, FUNCT_1, RELSET_1,
    PARTFUN1, FUNCT_2, ORDINAL1, CARD_1, NUMBERS, XCMPLX_0, XREAL_0,
    REAL_1, INT_1, COMPLEX1, XXREAL_0, NEWTON, PREPOWER, POWER,
    VALUED_0, SIN_COS, TAYLOR_1, SIN_COS2;
  constructors FUNCT_1, RELSET_1, FUNCT_2, CARD_1, REAL_1, COMPLEX1,
    INT_1, XXREAL_0, NAT_1, NEWTON, PREPOWER, POWER, SIN_COS,
    TAYLOR_1, SIN_COS2, BINOP_2;
  registrations XBOOLE_0, SUBSET_1, RELAT_1, FUNCT_1, RELSET_1,
    FUNCT_2, NUMBERS, CARD_1, XXREAL_0, MEMBERED, VALUED_0,
    VALUED_1, XCMPLX_0, XREAL_0, ORDINAL1, NAT_1, INT_1, NEWTON,
    PREPOWER, POWER, SIN_COS;
  requirements REAL, NUMERALS, SUBSET, BOOLE, ARITHM;

begin

::$P-
theorem
  for a,b being Real st 0 < a & 0 < b holds
    (for u,x being Real st
      0 < |.u.| & |.u.| <= |.log(number_e,a / b).| & 0 < x & x < 1
    holds
      ex sux,su1x,su being Real st
        sux = sinh(u * x) &
        su1x = sinh(u * (1 - x)) &
        su = sinh(u) &
        (a to_power x) * (b to_power (1 - x)) <=
          a * (sux / su) + b * (su1x / su)) &
    (for c being Real st
      (for u,x being Real st
        0 < |.u.| & |.u.| <= c & 0 < x & x < 1
      holds
        ex sux,su1x,su being Real st
          sux = sinh(u * x) &
          su1x = sinh(u * (1 - x)) &
          su = sinh(u) &
          (a to_power x) * (b to_power (1 - x)) <=
            a * (sux / su) + b * (su1x / su))
    holds c <= |.log(number_e,a / b).|)
proof
end;

% Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1991_b6:
% for positive real a and b, the largest real c for which the stated
% hyperbolic-sine inequality holds is abs(ln(a / b)). This file contains no
% proof.

putnam_1991_b6: THEORY
BEGIN
  safe_div(numerator, denominator: real): real =
    IF denominator = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      numerator / denominator
    ENDIF

  nat_factorial(index: nat): RECURSIVE nat =
    IF index = 0 THEN
      1
    ELSE
      index * nat_factorial(index - 1)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE index

  exponential_partial(x: real, count: nat): RECURSIVE real =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      LET index: nat = count - 1 IN
        exponential_partial(x, count - 1)
          + safe_div(
              x ^ index,
              nat_factorial(index) :: real)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  converges_to(sequence: [nat -> real], value: real): bool =
    FORALL (epsilon_value: posreal):
      EXISTS (cutoff: nat):
        FORALL (index: nat):
          cutoff <= index IMPLIES
            abs(sequence(index) - value) < epsilon_value

  exponential_value(argument, value: real): bool =
    converges_to(
      (LAMBDA (count: nat):
        exponential_partial(argument, count)),
      value)

  natural_log_value(argument, value: real): bool =
    argument > 0
      AND exponential_value(value, argument)

  real_power_value(base, exponent, value: real): bool =
    base > 0
      AND EXISTS (log_base: real):
        natural_log_value(base, log_base)
          AND exponential_value(exponent * log_base, value)

  hyperbolic_sine_value(argument, value: real): bool =
    EXISTS (positive_exp, negative_exp: real):
      exponential_value(argument, positive_exp)
        AND exponential_value(-argument, negative_exp)
        AND value = (positive_exp - negative_exp) / 2

  admissible(c, a, b: real): bool =
    FORALL (u: real):
      (0 < abs(u) AND abs(u) <= c)
      IMPLIES
        FORALL (x: real):
          (0 < x AND x < 1)
          IMPLIES
            EXISTS
                (a_to_x, b_to_one_minus_x,
                 sinh_ux, sinh_u_one_minus_x, sinh_u: real):
              real_power_value(a, x, a_to_x)
                AND real_power_value(
                  b, 1 - x, b_to_one_minus_x)
                AND hyperbolic_sine_value(
                  u * x, sinh_ux)
                AND hyperbolic_sine_value(
                  u * (1 - x), sinh_u_one_minus_x)
                AND hyperbolic_sine_value(u, sinh_u)
                AND sinh_u /= 0
                AND a_to_x * b_to_one_minus_x
                  <= a * safe_div(sinh_ux, sinh_u)
                    + b * safe_div(
                        sinh_u_one_minus_x, sinh_u)

  putnam_1991_b6: bool =
    FORALL (a, b: real):
      (a > 0 AND b > 0)
      IMPLIES
        EXISTS (log_ratio: real):
          natural_log_value(
            safe_div(a, b), log_ratio)
            AND admissible(abs(log_ratio), a, b)
            AND (FORALL (c: real):
              admissible(c, a, b)
                IMPLIES c <= abs(log_ratio))
END putnam_1991_b6

;; the function n |-> 1 - n is exactly the integer-valued function on the
;; integers satisfying the two given composition identities and f(0) = 1.

(in-package "ACL2")

;; F is an ACL2 function object evaluated by APPLY$. This is the repository's
;; statement encoding for the arbitrary source function f : Z -> Z; it does
;; not replace the function by a finite table. FN-EQUAL against the constant
;; true function retains each universal quantifier over all integers.

(defun putnam-1992-a1-quoted (object)
  (list 'quote object))

(defun putnam-1992-a1-term-list (terms)
  (if (consp terms)
      (list 'cons
            (car terms)
            (putnam-1992-a1-term-list (cdr terms)))
    nil))

(defun putnam-1992-a1-apply-term (function arguments)
  (list 'apply$
        (putnam-1992-a1-quoted function)
        (putnam-1992-a1-term-list arguments)))

(defun putnam-1992-a1-implies-term (hypothesis conclusion)
  (list 'if
        hypothesis
        conclusion
        (putnam-1992-a1-quoted t)))

(defun putnam-1992-a1-add-term (left right)

   left

  (list 'lambda
        '(n)
        (putnam-1992-a1-quoted t)))

   (tamep-functionp predicate)
   (fn-equal
    predicate
    (putnam-1992-a1-true-function))))

(defun putnam-1992-a1-integer-valued-function (f)
  (let ((value
         (putnam-1992-a1-apply-term f '(n))))
    (list
     'lambda
     '(n)

      (list 'integerp 'n)
      (list 'integerp value)))))

         (putnam-1992-a1-apply-term f '(n)))
        (solution-value
         (putnam-1992-a1-subtract-term
          (putnam-1992-a1-quoted 1)
          'n)))
    (list
     'lambda
     '(n)
     (putnam-1992-a1-implies-term
      (list 'integerp 'n)
      (list 'equal value solution-value)))))

          (putnam-1992-a1-apply-term f '(n)))
         (value-of-value

    (list
     'lambda

      (list 'integerp 'n)
      (list 'equal value-of-value 'n)))))

  (let* ((n-plus-two
          (putnam-1992-a1-add-term
           'n
           (putnam-1992-a1-quoted 2)))
         (value-at-n-plus-two
          (putnam-1992-a1-apply-term f (list n-plus-two)))

          (putnam-1992-a1-add-term
           value-at-n-plus-two
           (putnam-1992-a1-quoted 2)))
         (composed-value
          (putnam-1992-a1-apply-term f (list shifted-value))))
    (list
     'lambda
     '(n)
     (putnam-1992-a1-implies-term
      (list 'integerp 'n)
      (list 'equal composed-value 'n)))))

(defun putnam-1992-a1-integer-valued-p (f)
  (putnam-1992-a1-universal-p
   (putnam-1992-a1-integer-valued-function f)))

(defun putnam-1992-a1-equals-solution-p (f)
  (putnam-1992-a1-universal-p
   (putnam-1992-a1-solution-equality-function f)))

(defun putnam-1992-a1-involution-p (f)

   (putnam-1992-a1-involution-function f)))

(defun putnam-1992-a1-shifted-composition-p (f)

   (putnam-1992-a1-shifted-composition-function f)))

(defun putnambench-putnam-1992-a1-statement (f)

   (and
    (tamep-functionp f)
    (putnam-1992-a1-integer-valued-p f))

-- Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1992_a1:
-- an integer-valued function is n mapped to 1 - n exactly when it satisfies
-- the stated two functional equations and f(0) = 1.
-- This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Int using (Int; pos; negsuc)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_)

infixr 3 _and_

record _and_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

record Iff (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor equivalence
  field
    forward  : A -> B
    backward : B -> A

negative : Nat -> Int
negative zero =
  pos zero
negative (suc n) =
  negsuc n

difference : Nat -> Nat -> Int
difference zero zero =
  pos zero
difference (suc m) zero =
  pos (suc m)
difference zero (suc n) =
  negsuc n
difference (suc m) (suc n) =
  difference m n

addInt : Int -> Int -> Int
addInt (pos m) (pos n) =
  pos (m + n)
addInt (pos m) (negsuc n) =
  difference m (suc n)
addInt (negsuc m) (pos n) =
  difference n (suc m)
addInt (negsuc m) (negsuc n) =
  negsuc (suc (m + n))

negateInt : Int -> Int
negateInt (pos n) =
  negative n
negateInt (negsuc n) =
  pos (suc n)

subtractInt : Int -> Int -> Int
subtractInt x y =
  addInt x (negateInt y)

zeroZ : Int
zeroZ =
  pos zero

oneZ : Int
oneZ =
  pos (suc zero)

twoZ : Int
twoZ =
  pos (suc (suc zero))

putnam-1992-a1 : Set
putnam-1992-a1 =
  (f : Int -> Int) ->
  Iff
    ((n : Int) ->
      f n == subtractInt oneZ n)
    (((n : Int) ->
      f (f n) == n)
    and
    ((n : Int) ->
      f (addInt (f (addInt n twoZ)) twoZ) == n)
    and
    f zeroZ == oneZ)

;;

;; function, rather than a rational approximation to its values.
(defun putnam-1992-a2-shifted-product (y remaining)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix remaining)))
  (if (zp remaining)

       (putnam-1992-a2-shifted-product
        y (- remaining 1)))))

     (putnam-1992-a2-factorial 1992)))

  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix remaining)))
  (if (zp remaining)
      0

       (putnam-1992-a2-reciprocal-sum

  (* (putnam-1992-a2-coefficient y)
     (putnam-1992-a2-reciprocal-sum y 1992)))

;; interval integral because the displayed integrand is a polynomial: the
;; apparent denominators cancel against the shifted product.
(defun putnam-1992-a2-riemann-sum-aux (grid remaining)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix remaining)))
  (if (zp remaining)

    (+ (putnam-1992-a2-integrand (/ remaining grid))
       (putnam-1992-a2-riemann-sum-aux
        grid (- remaining 1)))))

         grid)

;; does not bake a particular error estimate into the benchmark statement.
(defun-sk putnam-1992-a2-tail-p (epsilon cutoff)
  (forall (grid)
    (implies
     (and (natp grid)
          (<= cutoff grid))

-- Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1992_a2:
-- the integral involving the 1992nd generalized binomial coefficient and the
-- harmonic sum from 1 through 1992 equals 1992. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; _*_)

infix 4 _!=_ _<=N_
infixr 3 _and_
infixr 2 _or_

data Bottom : Set where

Not : Set -> Set
Not A =
  A -> Bottom

_!=_ : {A : Set} -> A -> A -> Set
x != y =
  Not (x == y)

record _and_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data _or_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  left  : A -> A or B
  right : B -> A or B

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

data _<=N_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set where
  zero<=N   : {n : Nat} -> zero <=N n
  suc<=sucN : {m n : Nat} -> m <=N n -> suc m <=N suc n

record CompleteOrderedRealField (R : Set) : Set1 where
  field
    zeroR oneR : R
    add multiply : R -> R -> R
    negate inverse : R -> R
    lessOrEqual : R -> R -> Set
    fromNat : Nat -> R

    one-not-zero :
      oneR != zeroR

    add-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> add x y == add y x
    add-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      add (add x y) z == add x (add y z)
    add-zero :
      (x : R) -> add x zeroR == x
    add-inverse :
      (x : R) -> add x (negate x) == zeroR

    multiply-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> multiply x y == multiply y x
    multiply-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply (multiply x y) z ==
      multiply x (multiply y z)
    multiply-one :
      (x : R) -> multiply x oneR == x
    multiply-zero :
      (x : R) -> multiply x zeroR == zeroR
    distribute :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply x (add y z) ==
      add (multiply x y) (multiply x z)
    inverse-zero :
      inverse zeroR == zeroR
    multiply-inverse :
      (x : R) ->
      x != zeroR ->
      multiply x (inverse x) == oneR

    order-reflexive :
      (x : R) -> lessOrEqual x x
    order-transitive :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y z ->
      lessOrEqual x z
    order-antisymmetric :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y x ->
      x == y
    order-total :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y or lessOrEqual y x
    add-order :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual (add z x) (add z y)
    multiply-nonnegative :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR x ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR y ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR (multiply x y)
    zero-less-than-one :
      lessOrEqual zeroR oneR and zeroR != oneR

    fromNat-zero :
      fromNat zero == zeroR
    fromNat-successor :
      (n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (suc n) == add (fromNat n) oneR
    fromNat-addition :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m + n) == add (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-multiplication :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m * n) == multiply (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-injective :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat m == fromNat n ->
      m == n

    archimedean :
      (x : R) ->
      Exists Nat (\ n -> lessOrEqual x (fromNat n))
    least-upper-bound :
      (P : R -> Set) ->
      Exists R P ->
      Exists R
        (\ upper ->
          (x : R) ->
          P x ->
          lessOrEqual x upper) ->
      Exists R
        (\ supremum ->
          ((x : R) ->
            P x ->
            lessOrEqual x supremum)
          and
          ((upper : R) ->
            ((x : R) ->
              P x ->
              lessOrEqual x upper) ->
            lessOrEqual supremum upper))

open CompleteOrderedRealField

subtract :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
subtract reals x y =
  add reals x (negate reals y)

divide :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
divide reals x y =
  multiply reals x (inverse reals y)

StrictLess :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
StrictLess reals x y =
  lessOrEqual reals x y and x != y

CloseTo :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
CloseTo reals center radius x =
  StrictLess reals
    (subtract reals center radius)
    x
  and
  StrictLess reals
    x
    (add reals center radius)

ConvergesTo :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  R ->
  Set
ConvergesTo {R} reals sequence limit =
  (epsilon : R) ->
  StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) epsilon ->
  Exists Nat
    (\ cutoff ->
      (n : Nat) ->
      cutoff <=N n ->
      CloseTo reals limit epsilon (sequence n))

factorial : Nat -> Nat
factorial zero =
  suc zero
factorial (suc n) =
  suc n * factorial n

sumFirst :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Nat ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  R
sumFirst reals zero term =
  zeroR reals
sumFirst reals (suc n) term =
  add reals
    (sumFirst reals n term)
    (term n)

productFirst :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Nat ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  R
productFirst reals zero term =
  oneR reals
productFirst reals (suc n) term =
  multiply reals
    (productFirst reals n term)
    (term n)

generalizedBinomialCoefficient1992 :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R
generalizedBinomialCoefficient1992 reals alpha =
  divide reals
    (productFirst reals 1992
      (\ k ->
        subtract reals alpha (fromNat reals k)))
    (fromNat reals (factorial 1992))

harmonicSum1992 :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R
harmonicSum1992 reals y =
  sumFirst reals 1992
    (\ k ->
      inverse reals
        (add reals y (fromNat reals (suc k))))

putnamIntegrand :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R
putnamIntegrand reals y =
  multiply reals
    (generalizedBinomialCoefficient1992 reals
      (subtract reals (negate reals y) (oneR reals)))
    (harmonicSum1992 reals y)

riemannStep :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Nat ->
  R
riemannStep reals lower upper pieces =
  divide reals
    (subtract reals upper lower)
    (fromNat reals pieces)

rightRiemannSum :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  (R -> R) ->
  Nat ->
  R
rightRiemannSum reals lower upper function pieces =
  let
    step = riemannStep reals lower upper pieces
  in
  sumFirst reals pieces
    (\ i ->
      multiply reals
        (function
          (add reals lower
            (multiply reals
              (fromNat reals (suc i))
              step)))
        step)

IntervalIntegralValue :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  (R -> R) ->
  R ->
  Set
IntervalIntegralValue reals lower upper function value =
  ConvergesTo reals
    (\ n ->
      rightRiemannSum reals lower upper function (suc n))
    value

putnam-1992-a2 : Set1
putnam-1992-a2 =
  (R : Set) ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) ->
  IntervalIntegralValue reals
    (zeroR reals)
    (oneR reals)
    (putnamIntegrand reals)
    (fromNat reals 1992)

content:
% Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1992_a2:
% the integral involving the 1992nd Taylor coefficient of (1 + x)^alpha
% and a finite reciprocal sum evaluates to 1992. This file contains no proof.

putnam_1992_a2: THEORY
BEGIN
  real_function: TYPE = [real -> real]
  real_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> real]

  safe_div(numerator, denominator: real): real =
    IF denominator = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      numerator / denominator
    ENDIF

  nat_factorial(index: nat): RECURSIVE nat =
    IF index = 0 THEN
      1
    ELSE
      index * nat_factorial(index - 1)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE index

  exponential_partial(x: real, count: nat): RECURSIVE real =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      LET index: nat = count - 1 IN
        exponential_partial(x, count - 1)
          + safe_div(
              x ^ index,
              nat_factorial(index) :: real)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  converges_to(sequence: real_sequence, value: real): bool =
    FORALL (epsilon_value: posreal):
      EXISTS (cutoff: nat):
        FORALL (index: nat):
          cutoff <= index IMPLIES
            abs(sequence(index) - value) < epsilon_value

  real_exponential(x: real): real =
    epsilon(
      LAMBDA (value: real):
        converges_to(
          LAMBDA (count: nat):
            exponential_partial(x, count),
          value))

  natural_log(x: real): real =
    IF x > 0 THEN
      epsilon(
        LAMBDA (value: real):
          real_exponential(value) = x)
    ELSE
      0
    ENDIF

  real_power(base, exponent: real): real =
    IF base > 0 THEN
      real_exponential(exponent * natural_log(base))
    ELSIF base = 0 AND exponent = 0 THEN
      1
    ELSE
      0
    ENDIF

  has_derivative_at(
      f: real_function,
      derivative, x: real): bool =
    FORALL (epsilon_value: posreal):
      EXISTS (delta: posreal):
        FORALL (h: real):
          (NOT (h = 0) AND abs(h) < delta)
            IMPLIES
              abs(
                f(x + h) - f(x)
                  - derivative * h)
                < epsilon_value * abs(h)

  differentiable_at(f: real_function, x: real): bool =
    EXISTS (derivative: real):
      has_derivative_at(f, derivative, x)

  derivative_value(f: real_function, x: real): real =
    IF differentiable_at(f, x) THEN
      epsilon(
        LAMBDA (derivative: real):
          has_derivative_at(f, derivative, x))
    ELSE
      0
    ENDIF

  derivative_function(f: real_function): real_function =
    LAMBDA (x: real): derivative_value(f, x)

  iterated_derivative(
      f: real_function,
      order: nat): RECURSIVE real_function =
    IF order = 0 THEN
      f
    ELSE
      derivative_function(
        iterated_derivative(f, order - 1))
    ENDIF
  MEASURE order

  taylor_coefficient(
      f: real_function,
      order: nat): real =
    safe_div(
      iterated_derivative(f, order)(0),
      nat_factorial(order) :: real)

  C(alpha: real): real =
    taylor_coefficient(
      LAMBDA (x: real):
        real_power(1 + x, alpha),
      1992)

  reciprocal_sum(y: real, count: nat): RECURSIVE real =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      reciprocal_sum(y, count - 1)
        + safe_div(1, y + (count :: real))
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  integrand(y: real): real =
    C(-y - 1) * reciprocal_sum(y, 1992)

  valid_tagged_partition(
      left, right: real,
      points, tags: real_sequence,
      count: nat): bool =
    count > 0
      AND points(0) = left
      AND points(count) = right
      AND FORALL (index: nat):
        index < count IMPLIES
          (points(index) < points(index + 1)
            AND points(index) <= tags(index)
            AND tags(index) <= points(index + 1))

  mesh_less_than(
      points: real_sequence,
      count: nat,
      bound: real): bool =
    FORALL (index: nat):
      index < count IMPLIES
        points(index + 1) - points(index) < bound

  riemann_sum(
      function_value: real_function,
      points, tags: real_sequence,
      count: nat): RECURSIVE real =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      riemann_sum(
        function_value, points, tags, count - 1)
        + function_value(tags(count - 1))
            * (points(count) - points(count - 1))
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  has_interval_integral(
      function_value: real_function,
      left, right, integral_value: real): bool =
    left < right
      AND FORALL (epsilon_value: posreal):
        EXISTS (mesh_bound: posreal):
          FORALL
              (points, tags: real_sequence),
              (count: nat):
            (valid_tagged_partition(
                left, right, points, tags, count)
              AND mesh_less_than(
                points, count, mesh_bound))
            IMPLIES
              abs(
                riemann_sum(
                  function_value, points, tags, count)
                  - integral_value)
                < epsilon_value

  putnam_1992_a2: bool =
    has_interval_integral(integrand, 0, 1, 1992)
END putnam_1992_a2

;; Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1992_a3:
;; for each positive natural m, the positive natural solutions (n,x,y) of
;; (x^2+y^2)^m = (x*y)^n with n coprime to m are classified exactly.
;; This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(defun putnam-1992-a3-gcd (a b)
  (declare (xargs :measure (+ (nfix a) (nfix b))))
  (if (and (natp a) (natp b))
      (cond
       ((equal a 0) b)
       ((equal b 0) a)
       ((< a b)
        (putnam-1992-a3-gcd a (- b a)))
       (t
        (putnam-1992-a3-gcd (- a b) b)))
    0))

(defun putnam-1992-a3-source-condition-p (m n x y)
  (and
   (posp n)
   (posp x)
   (posp y)
   (equal (putnam-1992-a3-gcd n m) 1)
   (equal
    (expt (+ (expt x 2)
             (expt y 2))
          m)
    (expt (* x y) n))))

;; In the source existential, m = 2*r uniquely determines the natural
;; witness r. Under the natural-domain hypothesis, r = floor(m/2), so this
;; definition is bidirectionally equivalent without exposing that witness as
;; an additional statement parameter.
(defun putnam-1992-a3-solution-p (m n x y)
  (let ((r (floor m 2)))
    (and
     (equal m (* 2 r))
     (equal x (expt 2 r))
     (equal y (expt 2 r))
     (equal n (+ (* 2 r) 1)))))

(defun putnambench-putnam-1992-a3-statement (m n x y)
  (implies
   (and
    (natp m)
    (natp n)
    (natp x)
    (natp y)
    (< 0 m))
   (iff
    (putnam-1992-a3-solution-p m n x y)
    (putnam-1992-a3-source-condition-p m n x y))))

-- Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1992_a3
-- (putnambench__agda__putnam_1992_a3): classification of the positive
-- integer solutions to (x^2 + y^2)^m = (xy)^n with n coprime to m.
-- This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; _*_)

infix 4 _divides_
infixr 3 _and_

record _and_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

record Iff (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor equivalence
  field
    forward  : A -> B
    backward : B -> A

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

data Positive : Nat -> Set where
  positive : (n : Nat) -> Positive (suc n)

record _divides_ (divisor dividend : Nat) : Set where
  field
    quotient : Nat
    division-equation : divisor * quotient == dividend

record IsGCD (a b gcd : Nat) : Set where
  field
    divides-left :
      gcd divides a
    divides-right :
      gcd divides b
    greatest :
      (common-divisor : Nat) ->
      common-divisor divides a ->
      common-divisor divides b ->
      common-divisor divides gcd

one : Nat
one =
  suc zero

two : Nat
two =
  suc one

Coprime : Nat -> Nat -> Set
Coprime a b =
  IsGCD a b one

power : Nat -> Nat -> Nat
power base zero =
  one
power base (suc exponent) =
  base * power base exponent

Solution : Nat -> Nat -> Nat -> Nat -> Set
Solution x y n m =
  Exists Nat
    (\ r ->
      x == power two r
      and
      y == power two r
      and
      n == two * r + one
      and
      m == two * r)

SatisfiesEquation : Nat -> Nat -> Nat -> Nat -> Set
SatisfiesEquation n x y m =
  Positive n
  and
  Positive x
  and
  Positive y
  and
  Coprime n m
  and
  power (power x two + power y two) m
    == power (x * y) n

putnam-1992-a3 : Set
putnam-1992-a3 =
  (m : Nat) ->
  Positive m ->
  (n x y : Nat) ->
  Iff
    (Solution x y n m)
    (SatisfiesEquation n x y m)

  retains the source assumption that m is positive. The right side inlines
  the documented solution: for an internal natural witness r, m = 2r,
  n = 2r+1, and x = y = 2^r.

  This pointwise biconditional is extensionally equivalent to the
  Lean/Isabelle equality between the set of solution triples and the
  documented solution set, and directly matches the Rocq formulation.
  The final declaration is a single unproved $a statement encoding; this
  database contains no $p proof declaration.
$)

${
  $d m n r x y $.

  putnambench-putnam-1992-a3 $a |-
    A. m e. NN0
      (
        0 < m
        ->
        A. n e. NN0 A. x e. NN0 A. y e. NN0
          (
            (
              (
                0 < n
                /\
                (
                  0 < x

                    0 < y
                    /\
                    (
                      ( n gcd m ) = 1
                      /\
                      ( ( ( x ^ 2 ) + ( y ^ 2 ) ) ^ m )

                      ( ( x x. y ) ^ n )
                    )
                  )

              <->
              E. r e. NN0
                (
                  x = ( 2 ^ r )
                  /\
                  (
                    y = ( 2 ^ r )
                    /\
                    (
                      n = ( ( 2 x. r ) + 1 )
                      /\
                      m = ( 2 x. r )
                    )
                  )
                )
            )
          )
      )
  $.
$}

title: putnam_1992_a3
content:
% Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1992_a3:
% classification of the positive natural triples satisfying the stated
% exponential Diophantine equation with a coprimality condition. This file
% contains no proof.

putnam_1992_a3: THEORY
BEGIN
  nat_divides(divisor: posnat, value: nat): bool =
    EXISTS (quotient: nat):
      value = divisor * quotient

  coprime_nat(first, second: nat): bool =
    FORALL (divisor: posnat):
      nat_divides(divisor, first)
        AND nat_divides(divisor, second)
        IMPLIES divisor = 1

  qualifying(m, n, x, y: nat): bool =
    n > 0
      AND x > 0
      AND y > 0
      AND coprime_nat(n, m)
      AND (x ^ 2 + y ^ 2) ^ m = (x * y) ^ n

  putnam_1992_a3_solution(x, y, n, m: nat): bool =
    EXISTS (r: nat):
      x = 2 ^ r
        AND y = 2 ^ r
        AND n = 2 * r + 1
        AND m = 2 * r

  putnam_1992_a3: bool =
    FORALL (m: nat):
      m > 0 IMPLIES
        FORALL (n, x, y: nat):
          putnam_1992_a3_solution(x, y, n, m)
            IFF qualifying(m, n, x, y)
END putnam_1992_a3

Theorem putnam_1992_a4
    (f : R -> R)

;; Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1992_a4:
;; the derivatives at zero of an infinitely differentiable real function
;; whose values at 1/n equal n^2/(n^2+1). This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))

;; JET is a function object whose value at (k,x,epsilon) is a rational
;; epsilon-approximation to the kth derivative at the rational point x.
;; COMPACT-MODULUS and DERIVATIVE-RADIUS give uniform continuity and uniform
;; difference-quotient moduli on each bounded interval. The matrices below
;; quantify over every positive rational tolerance and every rational point.
;;
;; Regular Cauchy names denote exact real values, not rational-valued
;; restrictions. Uniform continuity on all bounded rational intervals gives
;; unique continuous extensions to R. Uniform convergence of the successive
;; difference quotients on those intervals says exactly that level k+1 is the
;; derivative of level k after extension. Thus such a JET is equivalent to an
;; infinitely differentiable real function together with its derivative
;; tower; every smooth source function supplies such names and moduli.
;; The moduli are internally existential function objects, so the statement's
;; only external function parameter is the source derivative jet.

(defun putnam-1992-a4-quoted (object)
  (list 'quote object))

(defun putnam-1992-a4-term-list (terms)
  (if (consp terms)
      (list 'cons
            (car terms)
            (putnam-1992-a4-term-list (cdr terms)))
    nil))

(defun putnam-1992-a4-apply-term (function arguments)
  (list 'apply$
        (putnam-1992-a4-quoted function)
        (putnam-1992-a4-term-list arguments)))

(defun putnam-1992-a4-and-terms (terms)
  (if (consp terms)
      (list 'if
            (car terms)
            (putnam-1992-a4-and-terms (cdr terms))
            (putnam-1992-a4-quoted nil))
    (putnam-1992-a4-quoted t)))

(defun putnam-1992-a4-implies-term (hypothesis conclusion)
  (list 'if
        hypothesis
        conclusion
        (putnam-1992-a4-quoted t)))

(defun putnam-1992-a4-add-term (left right)
  (list 'binary-+ left right))

(defun putnam-1992-a4-negate-term (value)
  (list 'unary-- value))

(defun putnam-1992-a4-subtract-term (left right)
  (putnam-1992-a4-add-term
   left
   (putnam-1992-a4-negate-term right)))

(defun putnam-1992-a4-multiply-term (left right)
  (list 'binary-* left right))

(defun putnam-1992-a4-divide-term (numerator denominator)
  (putnam-1992-a4-multiply-term
   numerator
   (list 'unary-/ denominator)))

(defun putnam-1992-a4-absolute-term (value)
  (list 'if
        (list '< value 0)
        (putnam-1992-a4-negate-term value)
        value))

(defun putnam-1992-a4-less-equal-term (left right)
  (list 'if
        (list '< right left)
        (putnam-1992-a4-quoted nil)
        (putnam-1992-a4-quoted t)))

(defun putnam-1992-a4-positive-rational-term (value)
  (putnam-1992-a4-and-terms
   (list
    (list 'rationalp value)
    (list '< 0 value))))

(defun putnam-1992-a4-positive-natural-term (value)
  (putnam-1992-a4-and-terms
   (list
    (list 'natp value)
    (list '< 0 value))))

(defun putnam-1992-a4-in-bounded-interval-term
    (value bound)
  (putnam-1992-a4-and-terms
   (list
    (putnam-1992-a4-less-equal-term
     (putnam-1992-a4-negate-term bound)
     value)
    (putnam-1992-a4-less-equal-term value bound))))

(defun putnam-1992-a4-true-function (formals)
  (list 'lambda
        formals
        (putnam-1992-a4-quoted t)))

(defun putnam-1992-a4-jet-cauchy-function (jet)
  (let* ((left
          (putnam-1992-a4-apply-term
           jet '(order x epsilon)))
         (right
          (putnam-1992-a4-apply-term
           jet '(order x eta)))
         (distance
          (putnam-1992-a4-absolute-term
           (putnam-1992-a4-subtract-term left right))))
    (list
     'lambda
     '(order x epsilon eta)
     (putnam-1992-a4-implies-term
      (putnam-1992-a4-and-terms
       (list
        (list 'natp 'order)
        (list 'rationalp 'x)
        (putnam-1992-a4-positive-rational-term 'epsilon)
        (putnam-1992-a4-positive-rational-term 'eta)))
      (putnam-1992-a4-and-terms
       (list
        (list 'rationalp left)
        (list 'rationalp right)
        (putnam-1992-a4-less-equal-term
         distance
         (putnam-1992-a4-add-term
          'epsilon 'eta))))))))

(defun putnam-1992-a4-compact-modulus-function
    (compact-modulus)
  (let ((delta
         (putnam-1992-a4-apply-term
          compact-modulus '(order bound epsilon))))
    (list
     'lambda
     '(order bound epsilon)
     (putnam-1992-a4-implies-term
      (putnam-1992-a4-and-terms
       (list
        (list 'natp 'order)
        (putnam-1992-a4-positive-natural-term 'bound)
        (putnam-1992-a4-positive-rational-term 'epsilon)))
      (putnam-1992-a4-positive-rational-term delta)))))

(defun putnam-1992-a4-compact-continuity-function
    (jet compact-modulus)
  (let* ((delta
          (putnam-1992-a4-apply-term
           compact-modulus '(order bound epsilon)))
         (quarter-epsilon
          (putnam-1992-a4-multiply-term 1/4 'epsilon))
         (left
          (putnam-1992-a4-apply-term
           jet (list 'order 'x quarter-epsilon)))
         (right
          (putnam-1992-a4-apply-term
           jet (list 'order 'y quarter-epsilon)))
         (coordinate-distance
          (putnam-1992-a4-absolute-term
           (putnam-1992-a4-subtract-term 'x 'y)))
         (value-distance
          (putnam-1992-a4-absolute-term
           (putnam-1992-a4-subtract-term left right))))
    (list
     'lambda
     '(order bound x y epsilon)
     (putnam-1992-a4-implies-term
      (putnam-1992-a4-and-terms
       (list
        (list 'natp 'order)
        (putnam-1992-a4-positive-natural-term 'bound)
        (list 'rationalp 'x)
        (list 'rationalp 'y)
        (putnam-1992-a4-in-bounded-interval-term
         'x 'bound)
        (putnam-1992-a4-in-bounded-interval-term
         'y 'bound)
        (putnam-1992-a4-positive-rational-term 'epsilon)
        (putnam-1992-a4-positive-rational-term delta)
        (list '< coordinate-distance delta)))
      (putnam-1992-a4-and-terms
       (list
        (list 'rationalp left)
        (list 'rationalp right)
        (putnam-1992-a4-less-equal-term
         value-distance 'epsilon)))))))

(defun putnam-1992-a4-derivative-radius-function
    (derivative-radius)
  (let ((delta
         (putnam-1992-a4-apply-term
          derivative-radius '(order bound epsilon))))
    (list
     'lambda
     '(order bound epsilon)
     (putnam-1992-a4-implies-term
      (putnam-1992-a4-and-terms
       (list
        (list 'natp 'order)
        (putnam-1992-a4-positive-natural-term 'bound)
        (putnam-1992-a4-positive-rational-term 'epsilon)))
      (putnam-1992-a4-positive-rational-term delta)))))

(defun putnam-1992-a4-successive-derivative-function
    (jet derivative-radius)
  (let* ((delta
          (putnam-1992-a4-apply-term
           derivative-radius '(order bound epsilon)))
         (absolute-h
          (putnam-1992-a4-absolute-term 'h))
         (x-plus-h
          (putnam-1992-a4-add-term 'x 'h))
         (value-tolerance
          (putnam-1992-a4-multiply-term
           1/8
           (putnam-1992-a4-multiply-term
            'epsilon absolute-h)))
         (derivative-tolerance
          (putnam-1992-a4-multiply-term 1/4 'epsilon))
         (right-value
          (putnam-1992-a4-apply-term
           jet (list 'order x-plus-h value-tolerance)))
         (left-value
          (putnam-1992-a4-apply-term
           jet (list 'order 'x value-tolerance)))
         (next-value
          (putnam-1992-a4-apply-term
           jet
           (list
            (putnam-1992-a4-add-term 'order 1)
            'x
            derivative-tolerance)))
         (difference-quotient
          (putnam-1992-a4-divide-term
           (putnam-1992-a4-subtract-term
            right-value left-value)
           'h))
         (derivative-error
          (putnam-1992-a4-absolute-term
           (putnam-1992-a4-subtract-term
            difference-quotient next-value))))
    (list
     'lambda
     '(order bound x epsilon h)
     (putnam-1992-a4-implies-term
      (putnam-1992-a4-and-terms
       (list
        (list 'natp 'order)
        (putnam-1992-a4-positive-natural-term 'bound)
        (list 'rationalp 'x)
        (putnam-1992-a4-positive-rational-term 'epsilon)
        (list 'rationalp 'h)
        (list 'not (list 'equal 'h 0))
        (putnam-1992-a4-positive-rational-term delta)
        (putnam-1992-a4-in-bounded-interval-term
         'x 'bound)
        (putnam-1992-a4-in-bounded-interval-term
         x-plus-h 'bound)
        (list '< absolute-h delta)))
      (putnam-1992-a4-and-terms
       (list
        (list 'rationalp right-value)
        (list 'rationalp left-value)
        (list 'rationalp next-value)
        (putnam-1992-a4-less-equal-term
         derivative-error 'epsilon)))))))

(defun putnam-1992-a4-smooth-witness-p
    (jet compact-modulus derivative-radius)
  (and
   (tamep-functionp compact-modulus)
   (tamep-functionp derivative-radius)
   (fn-equal
    (putnam-1992-a4-compact-modulus-function
     compact-modulus)
    (putnam-1992-a4-true-function
     '(order bound epsilon)))
   (fn-equal
    (putnam-1992-a4-compact-continuity-function
     jet compact-modulus)
    (putnam-1992-a4-true-function
     '(order bound x y epsilon)))
   (fn-equal
    (putnam-1992-a4-derivative-radius-function
     derivative-radius)
    (putnam-1992-a4-true-function
     '(order bound epsilon)))
   (fn-equal
    (putnam-1992-a4-successive-derivative-function
     jet derivative-radius)
    (putnam-1992-a4-true-function
     '(order bound x epsilon h)))))

(defun-sk putnam-1992-a4-smooth-witness-exists-p (jet)
  (exists (compact-modulus derivative-radius)
    (putnam-1992-a4-smooth-witness-p
     jet compact-modulus derivative-radius)))

(defun putnam-1992-a4-smooth-jet-p (jet)
  (and
   (tamep-functionp jet)
   (fn-equal
    (putnam-1992-a4-jet-cauchy-function jet)
    (putnam-1992-a4-true-function
     '(order x epsilon eta)))
   (putnam-1992-a4-smooth-witness-exists-p jet)))

(defun putnam-1992-a4-factorial (n)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix n)))
  (if (zp n)
      1
    (* n
       (putnam-1992-a4-factorial (- n 1)))))

(defun putnam-1992-a4-solution (order)
  (if (and (natp order)
           (evenp order))
      (* (expt -1 (floor order 2))
         (putnam-1992-a4-factorial order))
    0))

(defun-sk putnam-1992-a4-interpolation-p (jet)
  (forall (n epsilon)
    (implies
     (and
      (natp n)
      (< 0 n)
      (rationalp epsilon)
      (< 0 epsilon))
     (let* ((n-square (* n n))
            (sample-point (/ 1 n))
            (sample-value (/ n-square (+ n-square 1)))
            (jet-value
             (apply$ jet (list 0 sample-point epsilon))))
       (and
        (rationalp jet-value)
        (<= (abs (- jet-value sample-value))
            epsilon))))))

(defun-sk putnam-1992-a4-conclusion-p (jet)
  (forall (order epsilon)
    (implies
     (and
      (natp order)
      (< 0 order)
      (rationalp epsilon)
      (< 0 epsilon))
     (let ((jet-value
            (apply$ jet (list order 0 epsilon))))
       (and
        (rationalp jet-value)
        (<=
         (abs
          (- jet-value
             (putnam-1992-a4-solution order)))
         epsilon))))))

(defun putnambench-putnam-1992-a4-statement (jet)
  (implies
   (and
    (putnam-1992-a4-smooth-jet-p jet)
    (putnam-1992-a4-interpolation-p jet))
   (putnam-1992-a4-conclusion-p jet)))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

content:
-- Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1992_a4
-- (putnambench__agda__putnam_1992_a4): derivatives at zero of a smooth real
-- function prescribed at the reciprocal positive integers. This file contains
-- no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; _*_)

infix 4 _!=_
infixr 3 _and_
infixr 2 _or_

data Bottom : Set where

Not : Set -> Set
Not A =
  A -> Bottom

_!=_ : {A : Set} -> A -> A -> Set
x != y =
  Not (x == y)

record _and_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data _or_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  left  : A -> A or B
  right : B -> A or B

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

data Positive : Nat -> Set where
  positive : (n : Nat) -> Positive (suc n)

record CompleteOrderedRealField (R : Set) : Set1 where
  field
    zeroR oneR : R
    add multiply : R -> R -> R
    negate inverse : R -> R
    lessOrEqual : R -> R -> Set
    fromNat : Nat -> R

    one-not-zero :
      oneR != zeroR

    add-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> add x y == add y x
    add-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      add (add x y) z == add x (add y z)
    add-zero :
      (x : R) -> add x zeroR == x
    add-inverse :
      (x : R) -> add x (negate x) == zeroR

    multiply-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> multiply x y == multiply y x
    multiply-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply (multiply x y) z ==
      multiply x (multiply y z)
    multiply-one :
      (x : R) -> multiply x oneR == x
    multiply-zero :
      (x : R) -> multiply x zeroR == zeroR
    distribute :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply x (add y z) ==
      add (multiply x y) (multiply x z)
    inverse-zero :
      inverse zeroR == zeroR
    multiply-inverse :
      (x : R) ->
      x != zeroR ->
      multiply x (inverse x) == oneR

    order-reflexive :
      (x : R) -> lessOrEqual x x
    order-transitive :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y z ->
      lessOrEqual x z
    order-antisymmetric :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y x ->
      x == y
    order-total :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y or lessOrEqual y x
    add-order :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual (add z x) (add z y)
    multiply-nonnegative :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR x ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR y ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR (multiply x y)
    zero-less-than-one :
      lessOrEqual zeroR oneR and zeroR != oneR

    fromNat-zero :
      fromNat zero == zeroR
    fromNat-successor :
      (n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (suc n) == add (fromNat n) oneR
    fromNat-addition :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m + n) == add (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-multiplication :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m * n) == multiply (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-injective :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat m == fromNat n ->
      m == n

    archimedean :
      (x : R) ->
      Exists Nat (\ n -> lessOrEqual x (fromNat n))
    least-upper-bound :
      (P : R -> Set) ->
      Exists R P ->
      Exists R
        (\ upper ->
          (x : R) ->
          P x ->
          lessOrEqual x upper) ->
      Exists R
        (\ supremum ->
          ((x : R) ->
            P x ->
            lessOrEqual x supremum)
          and
          ((upper : R) ->
            ((x : R) ->
              P x ->
              lessOrEqual x upper) ->
            lessOrEqual supremum upper))

open CompleteOrderedRealField

subtract :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
subtract reals x y =
  add reals x (negate reals y)

divide :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
divide reals x y =
  multiply reals x (inverse reals y)

square :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R
square reals x =
  multiply reals x x

naturalPower :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  Nat ->
  R
naturalPower reals base zero =
  oneR reals
naturalPower reals base (suc exponent) =
  multiply reals base (naturalPower reals base exponent)

factorial : Nat -> Nat
factorial zero =
  suc zero
factorial (suc n) =
  suc n * factorial n

half : Nat -> Nat
half zero =
  zero
half (suc zero) =
  zero
half (suc (suc n)) =
  suc (half n)

data Parity : Set where
  evenParity oddParity : Parity

oppositeParity : Parity -> Parity
oppositeParity evenParity =
  oddParity
oppositeParity oddParity =
  evenParity

parity : Nat -> Parity
parity zero =
  evenParity
parity (suc n) =
  oppositeParity (parity n)

putnam-1992-a4-solution :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Nat ->
  R
putnam-1992-a4-solution reals k with parity k
... | evenParity =
  multiply reals
    (naturalPower reals
      (negate reals (oneR reals))
      (half k))
    (fromNat reals (factorial k))
... | oddParity =
  zeroR reals

StrictLess :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
StrictLess reals x y =
  lessOrEqual reals x y and x != y

CloseTo :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
CloseTo reals center radius x =
  StrictLess reals
    (subtract reals center radius)
    x
  and
  StrictLess reals
    x
    (add reals center radius)

ContinuousAt :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (R -> R) ->
  R ->
  Set
ContinuousAt {R} reals function point =
  (epsilon : R) ->
  StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) epsilon ->
  Exists R
    (\ delta ->
      StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) delta
      and
      ((x : R) ->
        CloseTo reals point delta x ->
        CloseTo reals
          (function point)
          epsilon
          (function x)))

Continuous :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (R -> R) ->
  Set
Continuous {R} reals function =
  (point : R) ->
  ContinuousAt reals function point

differenceQuotient :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (R -> R) ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
differenceQuotient reals function point x =
  divide reals
    (subtract reals (function x) (function point))
    (subtract reals x point)

DerivativeAt :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (R -> R) ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
DerivativeAt {R} reals function point derivative =
  (epsilon : R) ->
  StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) epsilon ->
  Exists R
    (\ delta ->
      StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) delta
      and
      ((x : R) ->
        CloseTo reals point delta x ->
        x != point ->
        CloseTo reals derivative epsilon
          (differenceQuotient reals function point x)))

record SmoothDerivativeTower
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R)
  (function : R -> R)
  (derivatives : Nat -> R -> R) :
  Set where

  field
    order-zero :
      (x : R) ->
      derivatives zero x == function x

    derivative-step :
      (k : Nat) ->
      (x : R) ->
      DerivativeAt reals
        (derivatives k)
        x
        (derivatives (suc k) x)

    every-order-continuous :
      (k : Nat) ->
      Continuous reals (derivatives k)

InfinitelyDifferentiable :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (R -> R) ->
  Set
InfinitelyDifferentiable {R} reals function =
  Exists (Nat -> R -> R)
    (SmoothDerivativeTower reals function)

SampleValues :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (R -> R) ->
  Set
SampleValues {R} reals function =
  (n : Nat) ->
  Positive n ->
  function
    (divide reals
      (oneR reals)
      (fromNat reals n))
  ==
  divide reals
    (square reals (fromNat reals n))
    (add reals
      (square reals (fromNat reals n))
      (oneR reals))

DerivativeValueAtOrder :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (R -> R) ->
  Nat ->
  R ->
  Set
DerivativeValueAtOrder {R} reals function k derivativeValue =
  (derivatives : Nat -> R -> R) ->
  SmoothDerivativeTower reals function derivatives ->
  derivatives k (zeroR reals) == derivativeValue

putnam-1992-a4 : Set1
putnam-1992-a4 =
  (R : Set) ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) ->
  (f : R -> R) ->
  InfinitelyDifferentiable reals f ->
  SampleValues reals f ->
  (k : Nat) ->
  Positive k ->
  DerivativeValueAtOrder reals f k
    (putnam-1992-a4-solution reals k)

  the values at zero of every positive-order derivative of a smooth real
  function prescribed on the reciprocal positive integers. This file contains
  no proof.

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open arithmeticTheory realTheory limTheory;

val putnam_1992_a4 =
  ``let solution =
      \k : num.
        if EVEN k
        then (-1 : real) pow (k DIV 2) * &(FACT k)
        else 0
    in
      !f : real -> real.
        (!k : num. !x : real. higher_differentiable k f x) /\
        (!n : num.
           0 < n
           ==>
           f (1 / &n) = (&n pow 2) / (&n pow 2 + 1))
        ==>
        !k : num.
          0 < k
          ==>
          diffn k f 0 = solution k``;

$(

  putnam_1992_a4: determination of every positive-order derivative at zero
  of a smooth real function prescribed at the reciprocal positive integers.
  This file contains no proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  RR ^m RR is set.mm's class of total real-valued functions on the reals.
  Membership in the intersection of the range of ( C^n ` RR ) states that
  the function is continuously differentiable to every nonnegative order.
  The class ( RR Dn F ) is its sequence of iterated real derivatives.

  Quantifying n and k over NN is equivalent to the source restrictions
  n > 0 and k > 0. Divisibility of k by two selects the even derivative
  formula (-1)^(k/2) k!; the odd derivatives are zero. The final declaration
  is the single unproved $a corpus statement; this database contains no $p
  proof statement.
$)

${
  $d F k n $.

  putnambench-putnam-1992-a4 $a |- A. F e. ( RR ^m RR )
    (
      (
        F e. |^| ran ( C^n ` RR )
        /\
        A. n e. NN
          ( F ` ( 1 / n ) )
          =
          (
            ( n ^ 2 )
            /
            ( ( n ^ 2 ) + 1 )
          )
      )
      ->
      A. k e. NN
        ( ( ( RR Dn F ) ` k ) ` 0 )
        =
        if (
          2 || k ,
          (
            ( ( -u 1 ) ^ ( k / 2 ) )
            x.
            ( ! ` k )
          ) ,
          0
        )
    )
  $.
$}

title: putnam_1992_a4
content:
% Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1992_a4:
% the derivatives at zero of a smooth real function prescribed at every
% positive reciprocal are the alternating even factorials and vanish in odd
% orders. This file contains no proof.

putnam_1992_a4: THEORY
BEGIN
  real_function: TYPE = [real -> real]

  safe_div(numerator, denominator: real): real =
    IF denominator = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      numerator / denominator
    ENDIF

  nat_factorial(index: nat): RECURSIVE nat =
    IF index = 0 THEN
      1
    ELSE
      index * nat_factorial(index - 1)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE index

  continuous(f: real_function): bool =
    FORALL (x: real), (epsilon_value: posreal):
      EXISTS (delta: posreal):
        FORALL (z: real):
          abs(z - x) < delta IMPLIES
            abs(f(z) - f(x)) < epsilon_value

  has_derivative_at(
      f: real_function,
      derivative, x: real): bool =
    FORALL (epsilon_value: posreal):
      EXISTS (delta: posreal):
        FORALL (h: real):
          (NOT (h = 0) AND abs(h) < delta)
            IMPLIES
              abs(
                f(x + h) - f(x)
                  - derivative * h)
                < epsilon_value * abs(h)

  differentiable_at(f: real_function, x: real): bool =
    EXISTS (derivative: real):
      has_derivative_at(f, derivative, x)

  derivative_value(f: real_function, x: real): real =
    IF differentiable_at(f, x) THEN
      epsilon(
        LAMBDA (derivative: real):
          has_derivative_at(f, derivative, x))
    ELSE
      0
    ENDIF

  derivative_function(f: real_function): real_function =
    LAMBDA (x: real): derivative_value(f, x)

  iterated_derivative(
      f: real_function,
      order: nat): RECURSIVE real_function =
    IF order = 0 THEN
      f
    ELSE
      derivative_function(
        iterated_derivative(f, order - 1))
    ENDIF
  MEASURE order

  continuously_differentiable(f: real_function): bool =
    (FORALL (x: real): differentiable_at(f, x))
      AND continuous(derivative_function(f))

  infinitely_continuously_differentiable(
      f: real_function): bool =
    FORALL (order: nat):
      continuously_differentiable(
        iterated_derivative(f, order))

  putnam_1992_a4_solution(order: nat): real =
    IF mod(order, 2) = 1 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      ((-1 :: real) ^ ndiv(order, 2))
        * (nat_factorial(order) :: real)
    ENDIF

  putnam_1992_a4: bool =
    FORALL (f: real_function):
      (infinitely_continuously_differentiable(f)
        AND FORALL (n: nat):
          n > 0 IMPLIES
            f(safe_div(1, n :: real))
              = safe_div(
                  (n :: real) ^ 2,
                  (n :: real) ^ 2 + 1))
      IMPLIES
        FORALL (order: nat):
          order > 0 IMPLIES
            iterated_derivative(f, order)(0)
              = putnam_1992_a4_solution(order)
END putnam_1992_a4

import Mathlib

open Topology Filter Nat Function

/--
For each positive integer $n$, let $a_n = 0$ (or $1$) if the number of $1$'s in the binary representation of $n$ is even (or odd), respectively. Show that there do not exist positive integers $k$ and $m$ such that
\[
a_{k+j} = a_{k+m+j} = a_{k+2m+j},
\]
for $0 \leq j \leq m-1$.
-/
theorem putnam_1992_a5
  (a : ℕ → ℕ)
  (ha : a = fun n ↦ ite (Even {i | (digits 2 n).get i = 1}.ncard) 0 1) :
  ¬∃ k > 0, ∃ m > 0, ∀ j ≤ m - 1,
    a (k + j) = a (k + m + j) ∧ a (k + m + j) = a (k + 2 * m + j) :=
sorry

    (a : positive -> nat := fun n => (k n) mod 2)
    : ~ exists (k m: nat), gt k 0 /\ gt m 0 /\ forall (j: nat), j <= m - 1 -> a (Pos.of_nat (k + j)) = a (Pos.of_nat (k + m + j)) /\ a (Pos.of_nat (k + m + j)) = a (Pos.of_nat (k + 2 * m + j)).
