;; Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1992_a5:
;; the parity-of-binary-one-count sequence contains no three consecutive equal
;; blocks of the same positive length. This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

;; Repeated division by two reads every binary digit of a natural number. The
;; fuel starts at n, so it cannot expire before the quotient reaches zero.
(defun putnam-1992-a5-binary-one-count-aux (n fuel)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix fuel)))
  (if (or (zp n)
          (zp fuel))
      0
    (+ (mod n 2)
       (putnam-1992-a5-binary-one-count-aux
        (floor n 2)
        (- fuel 1)))))

(defun putnam-1992-a5-sequence-value (n)
  (mod
   (putnam-1992-a5-binary-one-count-aux
    (nfix n)
    (nfix n))
   2))

;; This checks the source equality for exactly j = 0,...,m-1.
(defun putnam-1992-a5-three-equal-blocks-p (k m remaining)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix remaining)))
  (if (zp remaining)
      t
    (let* ((j (- remaining 1))
           (first
            (putnam-1992-a5-sequence-value (+ k j)))
           (second
            (putnam-1992-a5-sequence-value (+ k m j)))
           (third
            (putnam-1992-a5-sequence-value
             (+ k (* 2 m) j))))
      (and
       (equal first second)
       (equal second third)
       (putnam-1992-a5-three-equal-blocks-p
        k m j)))))

;; ACL2 implicitly universally closes the formal parameters. Thus this is
;; exactly the classical equivalence
;;   not (exists positive k,m, all j<m satisfy P)
;; iff
;;   for all k,m, positive(k,m) implies not (all j<m satisfy P).
(defun putnambench-putnam-1992-a5-statement (k m)
  (implies
   (and
    (posp k)
    (posp m))
   (not
    (putnam-1992-a5-three-equal-blocks-p
     k m m))))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

-- Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1992_a5
-- (putnambench__agda__putnam_1992_a5): the binary-one parity sequence has no
-- three consecutive equal blocks whose common positive length is also the
-- offset between their starting positions. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; _-_; _*_)

infix 4 _<=N_
infixr 3 _and_

data Bottom : Set where

Not : Set -> Set
Not A =
  A -> Bottom

record _and_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

data _<=N_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set where
  zero<=N   : {n : Nat} -> zero <=N n
  suc<=sucN : {m n : Nat} -> m <=N n -> suc m <=N suc n

data Positive : Nat -> Set where
  positive : (n : Nat) -> Positive (suc n)

data Bit : Set where
  zeroBit oneBit : Bit

toggle : Bit -> Bit
toggle zeroBit =
  oneBit
toggle oneBit =
  zeroBit

double : Nat -> Nat
double n =
  n + n

record IsBinaryOneParitySequence (a : Nat -> Bit) : Set where
  field
    value-at-zero :
      a zero == zeroBit

    value-at-even-index :
      (n : Nat) ->
      a (double n) == a n

    value-at-odd-index :
      (n : Nat) ->
      a (suc (double n)) == toggle (a n)

one : Nat
one =
  suc zero

two : Nat
two =
  suc one

ThreeEqualBlocks :
  (Nat -> Bit) ->
  Nat ->
  Nat ->
  Set
ThreeEqualBlocks a k m =
  (j : Nat) ->
  j <=N (m - one) ->
  a (k + j) == a (k + m + j)
  and
  a (k + m + j) == a (k + two * m + j)

HasThreeEqualBlocks :
  (Nat -> Bit) ->
  Set
HasThreeEqualBlocks a =
  Exists Nat
    (\ k ->
      Positive k
      and
      Exists Nat
        (\ m ->
          Positive m
          and
          ThreeEqualBlocks a k m))

putnam-1992-a5 : Set
putnam-1992-a5 =
  (a : Nat -> Bit) ->
  IsBinaryOneParitySequence a ->
  Not (HasThreeEqualBlocks a)

$(

  recurrence forces its values to be 0 and 1 and is bidirectionally equivalent
  to the source definition by parity of the number of 1 digits in the binary
  expansion: appending a binary 0 preserves that parity, while appending a
  binary 1 reverses it; conversely, induction on the binary expansion gives
  exactly the displayed recurrence from the digit-parity definition.

  SetMM's NN is the class of positive integers, and 0 ... (m - 1) is the
  inclusive range of source indices j. The final declaration is the single

                ( ( k + m ) + j )
              )
              =
              (
                a

% Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1992_a5:
% the parity-of-binary-digit sequence has no three consecutive equal blocks
% of the same positive length. This file contains no proof.

putnam_1992_a5: THEORY
BEGIN
  binary_one_count_aux(fuel, n: nat): RECURSIVE nat =
    IF fuel = 0 OR n = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      mod(n, 2)
        + binary_one_count_aux(fuel - 1, ndiv(n, 2))
    ENDIF
  MEASURE fuel

  binary_one_count(n: nat): nat =
    binary_one_count_aux(n, n)

  binary_parity(n: nat): nat =
    mod(binary_one_count(n), 2)

  putnam_1992_a5: bool =
    NOT EXISTS (k, m: posnat):
      FORALL (j: nat):
        j <= m - 1 IMPLIES
          binary_parity(k + j) =
            binary_parity(k + m + j)
          AND binary_parity(k + m + j) =
            binary_parity(k + 2 * m + j)
END putnam_1992_a5

title: putnam_1992_b1
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1992_b1:
;; the least number of distinct averages of two distinct elements of an
;; n-element real set, for n >= 2, is 2n - 3. This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

;; A finite set of reals is represented by rational coordinate vectors in a
;; basis of its finite-dimensional Q-span. Equality of points and equality of
;; pair sums are preserved by this representation. Conversely, any finite
;; family of rational vectors embeds into the reals by evaluating coordinates
;; at a Q-linearly independent real tuple, again preserving exactly those
;; equalities. Finally, division by 2 is injective, so distinct pair sums and
;; distinct pair averages have the same cardinality. Thus this is a
;; bidirectional encoding of arbitrary finite real sets, not a restriction to
;; rational points.

(defun putnam-1992-b1-rational-vector-p (vector width)
  (if (consp vector)
      (and (rationalp (car vector))
           (putnam-1992-b1-rational-vector-p
            (cdr vector) (- width 1)))
    (and (equal vector nil)
         (equal width 0))))

(defun putnam-1992-b1-point-list-p (points width)
  (if (consp points)
      (and (putnam-1992-b1-rational-vector-p
            (car points) width)
           (putnam-1992-b1-point-list-p
            (cdr points) width))
    (equal points nil)))

(defun putnam-1992-b1-vector-add (left right)
  (if (and (consp left) (consp right))
      (cons (+ (car left) (car right))
            (putnam-1992-b1-vector-add
             (cdr left) (cdr right)))
    nil))

(defun putnam-1992-b1-sums-with-first (point remaining)
  (if (consp remaining)
      (cons (putnam-1992-b1-vector-add
             point (car remaining))
            (putnam-1992-b1-sums-with-first
             point (cdr remaining)))
    nil))

(defun putnam-1992-b1-pair-sums (points)
  (if (consp points)
      (append
       (putnam-1992-b1-sums-with-first
        (car points) (cdr points))
       (putnam-1992-b1-pair-sums (cdr points)))
    nil))

(defun putnam-1992-b1-distinct-values (values)
  (if (consp values)
      (if (member-equal (car values) (cdr values))
          (putnam-1992-b1-distinct-values (cdr values))
        (cons (car values)
              (putnam-1992-b1-distinct-values
               (cdr values))))
    nil))

(defun putnam-1992-b1-average-count (points)
  (len
   (putnam-1992-b1-distinct-values
    (putnam-1992-b1-pair-sums points))))

(defun putnam-1992-b1-witness-points (count)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix count)))
  (if (zp count)
      nil
    (cons (list (- count 1))
          (putnam-1992-b1-witness-points
           (- count 1)))))

(defun putnam-1992-b1-solution (n)
  (- (* 2 n) 3))

;; The first conjunct is the universal lower bound for every n-element real
;; set. The second constructs the real set {0,...,n-1}, whose distinct
;; pair-average count is 2n-3, and therefore supplies the internal witness
;; that the lower bound is attained.
(defun putnambench-putnam-1992-b1-statement
    (n points width)
  (implies
   (and (natp n)
        (<= 2 n))
   (and
    (implies
     (and
      (natp width)
      (true-listp points)
      (equal (len points) n)
      (putnam-1992-b1-point-list-p points width)
      (no-duplicatesp-equal points))
     (<=
      (putnam-1992-b1-solution n)
      (putnam-1992-b1-average-count points)))
    (equal
     (putnam-1992-b1-average-count
      (putnam-1992-b1-witness-points n))
     (putnam-1992-b1-solution n)))))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

-- Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1992_b1:
-- among all sets of n distinct real numbers, the least number of distinct
-- averages of two different elements is 2 * n - 3. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module Putnam1992B1 where

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; _-_; _*_)
open import Agda.Primitive using (Level; _⊔_)

infix 4 _!=_ _<=N_
infixr 3 _and_
infixr 2 _or_

data Bottom : Set where

Not :
  {ell : Level} ->
  Set ell ->
  Set ell
Not A =
  A -> Bottom

_!=_ :
  {ell : Level} ->
  {A : Set ell} ->
  A ->
  A ->
  Set ell
x != y =
  Not (x == y)

record _and_
  {left-level right-level : Level}
  (A : Set left-level)
  (B : Set right-level) :
  Set (left-level ⊔ right-level) where

  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data _or_
  {left-level right-level : Level}
  (A : Set left-level)
  (B : Set right-level) :
  Set (left-level ⊔ right-level) where

  left  : A -> A or B
  right : B -> A or B

record Exists
  {element-level property-level : Level}
  (A : Set element-level)
  (property : A -> Set property-level) :
  Set (element-level ⊔ property-level) where

  constructor witness
  field
    value     : A
    satisfies : property value

data _<=N_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set where
  zero<=N   : {n : Nat} -> zero <=N n
  suc<=sucN : {m n : Nat} -> m <=N n -> suc m <=N suc n

data Fin : Nat -> Set where
  fzero : {n : Nat} -> Fin (suc n)
  fsuc  : {n : Nat} -> Fin n -> Fin (suc n)

record HasCardinality
  {A : Set}
  (P : A -> Set)
  (cardinality : Nat) :
  Set where

  field
    enumerate :
      Fin cardinality ->
      A
    enumerated-member :
      (index : Fin cardinality) ->
      P (enumerate index)
    enumeration-complete :
      (item : A) ->
      P item ->
      Exists (Fin cardinality)
        (\ index -> item == enumerate index)
    enumeration-injective :
      (left-index right-index : Fin cardinality) ->
      enumerate left-index == enumerate right-index ->
      left-index == right-index

record CompleteOrderedRealField (R : Set) : Set1 where
  field
    zeroR oneR : R
    add multiply : R -> R -> R
    negate inverse : R -> R
    lessOrEqual : R -> R -> Set
    fromNat : Nat -> R

    one-not-zero :
      oneR != zeroR

    add-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> add x y == add y x
    add-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      add (add x y) z == add x (add y z)
    add-zero :
      (x : R) -> add x zeroR == x
    add-inverse :
      (x : R) -> add x (negate x) == zeroR

    multiply-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> multiply x y == multiply y x
    multiply-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply (multiply x y) z ==
      multiply x (multiply y z)
    multiply-one :
      (x : R) -> multiply x oneR == x
    multiply-zero :
      (x : R) -> multiply x zeroR == zeroR
    distribute :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply x (add y z) ==
      add (multiply x y) (multiply x z)
    inverse-zero :
      inverse zeroR == zeroR
    multiply-inverse :
      (x : R) ->
      x != zeroR ->
      multiply x (inverse x) == oneR

    order-reflexive :
      (x : R) -> lessOrEqual x x
    order-transitive :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y z ->
      lessOrEqual x z
    order-antisymmetric :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y x ->
      x == y
    order-total :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y or lessOrEqual y x
    add-order :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual (add z x) (add z y)
    multiply-nonnegative :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR x ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR y ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR (multiply x y)
    zero-less-than-one :
      lessOrEqual zeroR oneR and zeroR != oneR

    fromNat-zero :
      fromNat zero == zeroR
    fromNat-successor :
      (n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (suc n) == add (fromNat n) oneR
    fromNat-addition :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m + n) == add (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-multiplication :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m * n) == multiply (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-injective :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat m == fromNat n ->
      m == n

    archimedean :
      (x : R) ->
      Exists Nat
        (\ n -> lessOrEqual x (fromNat n))
    least-upper-bound :
      (P : R -> Set) ->
      Exists R P ->
      Exists R
        (\ upper ->
          (x : R) ->
          P x ->
          lessOrEqual x upper) ->
      Exists R
        (\ supremum ->
          ((x : R) ->
            P x ->
            lessOrEqual x supremum)
          and
          ((upper : R) ->
            ((x : R) ->
              P x ->
              lessOrEqual x upper) ->
            lessOrEqual supremum upper))

open CompleteOrderedRealField

oneN : Nat
oneN =
  suc zero

twoN : Nat
twoN =
  suc oneN

threeN : Nat
threeN =
  suc twoN

divide :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
divide reals numerator denominator =
  multiply reals numerator (inverse reals denominator)

putnam-1992-b1-solution : Nat -> Nat
putnam-1992-b1-solution n =
  (twoN * n) - threeN

module Putnam1992B1Statement
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) where

  RealSubset : Set1
  RealSubset =
    R -> Set

  AverageSet :
    RealSubset ->
    RealSubset
  AverageSet S x =
    Exists R
      (\ a ->
        S a
        and
        Exists R
          (\ b ->
            S b
            and
            a != b
            and
            divide reals
              (add reals a b)
              (fromNat reals twoN)
            == x))

  AttainableAverageCount :
    Nat ->
    Nat ->
    Set1
  AttainableAverageCount n count =
    Exists RealSubset
      (\ S ->
        HasCardinality S n
        and
        HasCardinality (AverageSet S) count)

  record IsLeastAverageCount
    (n least : Nat) :
    Set1 where

    field
      attainable :
        AttainableAverageCount n least
      lower-bound :
        (count : Nat) ->
        AttainableAverageCount n count ->
        least <=N count

  proposition :
    Nat ->
    Set1
  proposition n =
    twoN <=N n ->
    IsLeastAverageCount
      n
      (putnam-1992-b1-solution n)

putnam-1992-b1 : Set1
putnam-1992-b1 =
  (R : Set) ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) ->
  (n : Nat) ->
  Putnam1992B1Statement.proposition reals n

BEGIN
  IMPORTING finite_sets[real]

  is_distinct_pair_average_set(
      S, A: finite_set[real]): bool =
    FORALL (x: real):

        EXISTS (a, b: real):
          S(a) AND S(b) AND a /= b
            AND x = (a + b) / 2

          card(S) = n
            AND is_distinct_pair_average_set(S, A)
            AND card(A) = 2 * n - 3)
        AND (FORALL (S, A: finite_set[real]):
          card(S) = n
            AND is_distinct_pair_average_set(S, A)
            IMPLIES 2 * n - 3 <= card(A))
END putnam_1992_b1

import Mathlib

open Topology Filter Nat Function Polynomial

/--
For nonnegative integers $n$ and $k$, define $Q(n, k)$ to be the coefficient of $x^k$ in the expansion of $(1 + x + x^2 + x^3)^n$. Prove that
\[
Q(n, k) = \sum_{j=0}^k \binom{n}{j} \binom{n}{k-2j},
\]
where $\binom{a}{b}$ is the standard binomial coefficient. (Reminder: For integers $a$ and $b$ with $a \geq 0$, $\binom{a}{b} = \frac{a!}{b!(a-b)!}$ for $0 \leq b \leq a$, with $\binom{a}{b} = 0$ otherwise.)
-/
theorem putnam_1992_b2
    (Q : ℕ → ℕ → ℕ)
    (hQ : Q = fun n k ↦ coeff ((1 + X + X ^ 2 + X ^ 3) ^ n) k)
    (n k : ℕ) :
    Q n k = ∑ j ∈ Finset.Iic k, choose n j * (if 2 * j ≤ k then choose n (k - 2 * j) else 0) :=
  sorry

(* Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench artifact putnam_1992_b2:
   coefficients of powers of 1 + x + x^2 + x^3 as a binomial sum.
   This file contains no proof. *)

From mathcomp Require Import all_ssreflect.

Set Implicit Arguments.
Unset Strict Implicit.
Unset Printing Implicit Defensive.

Local Open Scope nat_scope.

Definition putnam_1992_b2_polynomial : Type := seq nat.

Definition putnam_1992_b2_coefficient
    (p : putnam_1992_b2_polynomial) (k : nat) : nat :=
  nth 0 p k.

Definition putnam_1992_b2_multiply
    (p q : putnam_1992_b2_polynomial) : putnam_1992_b2_polynomial :=
  map
    (fun k =>
      \sum_(0 <= i < k.+1)
        (putnam_1992_b2_coefficient p i *
         putnam_1992_b2_coefficient q (k - i)))

(*
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench artifact putnam_1992_b2:
  the coefficient formula for powers of the polynomial 1 + x + x^2 + x^3
  as a finite binomial convolution. This file contains no proof.
*)

let statement =
  `let choose =
     \n r:num.
       if r <= n then FACT n DIV (FACT r * FACT (n - r)) else 0 in
   let pmul =
     \p q:num->num. \k:num.
       nsum (0..k) (\i:num. p i * q (k - i)) in
   let ppow =
     \p:num->num. \n:num.
       ITER n (pmul p) (\k:num. if k = 0 then 1 else 0) in
   let base =
     \k:num. if k <= 3 then 1 else 0 in
   let Q =
     \n k:num. ppow base n k in
   !n k:num.
     Q n k =
     nsum (0..k)
       (\j. choose n j *
            (if 2 * j <= k then choose n (k - 2 * j) else 0))`;;

;; Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1992_b2:
;; the coefficient of x^k in (1+x+x^2+x^3)^n equals a finite sum of products
;; of natural-number binomial coefficients. This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

;; Pascal recursion with zero outside 0 <= k <= n is the standard natural
;; binomial coefficient used by the source statements.
(defun putnam-1992-b2-choose (n k)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix n)))
  (if (and (natp n)
           (natp k))
      (cond
       ((zp k) 1)
       ((zp n) 0)
       (t
        (+ (putnam-1992-b2-choose (- n 1) (- k 1))
           (putnam-1992-b2-choose (- n 1) k))))
    0))

;; Multiplication by 1+x+x^2+x^3 gives this exact recurrence for the
;; coefficient of x^k in (1+x+x^2+x^3)^n.
(defun putnam-1992-b2-coefficient (n k)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix n)))
  (if (and (natp n)
           (natp k))
      (if (zp n)
          (if (zp k) 1 0)
        (+ (putnam-1992-b2-coefficient (- n 1) k)
           (if (<= 1 k)
               (putnam-1992-b2-coefficient (- n 1) (- k 1))
             0)
           (if (<= 2 k)
               (putnam-1992-b2-coefficient (- n 1) (- k 2))
             0)
           (if (<= 3 k)
               (putnam-1992-b2-coefficient (- n 1) (- k 3))
             0)))
    0))

;; Inclusive sum over j from 0 through J. The source summand is zero when
;; 2*j > k, matching the explicit conditional in both ground-truth files.
(defun putnam-1992-b2-sum-through (n k j)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix j)))
  (if (and (natp n)
           (natp k)
           (natp j))
      (if (zp j)
          (* (putnam-1992-b2-choose n 0)
             (putnam-1992-b2-choose n k))
        (+ (* (putnam-1992-b2-choose n j)
              (if (<= (* 2 j) k)
                  (putnam-1992-b2-choose n (- k (* 2 j)))
                0))
           (putnam-1992-b2-sum-through n k (- j 1))))
    0))

;; The source function Q is eliminated by substituting its defining
;; polynomial coefficient. Universal closure over N and K is represented by
;; the free arguments of this predicate-valued statement definition.
(defun putnambench-putnam-1992-b2-statement (n k)
  (implies
   (and (natp n)
        (natp k))
   (equal
    (putnam-1992-b2-coefficient n k)
    (putnam-1992-b2-sum-through n k k))))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

title: putnam_1992_b2
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1992_b2
-- (putnambench__agda__putnam_1992_b2): the coefficient of x^k in
-- (1 + x + x^2 + x^3)^n equals the stated finite binomial sum.
-- This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

open import Agda.Builtin.Bool using (Bool; false; true)
open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.List using (List; []; _∷_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; _-_; _*_)

one : Nat
one =
  suc zero

two : Nat
two =
  suc one

choose : Nat -> Nat -> Nat
choose n zero =
  one
choose zero (suc k) =
  zero
choose (suc n) (suc k) =
  choose n (suc k) + choose n k

lessOrEqual : Nat -> Nat -> Bool
lessOrEqual zero n =
  true
lessOrEqual (suc m) zero =
  false
lessOrEqual (suc m) (suc n) =
  lessOrEqual m n

ifNat : Bool -> Nat -> Nat -> Nat
ifNat true when-true when-false =
  when-true
ifNat false when-true when-false =
  when-false

sumThrough : Nat -> (Nat -> Nat) -> Nat
sumThrough zero term =
  term zero
sumThrough (suc n) term =
  sumThrough n term + term (suc n)

Polynomial : Set
Polynomial =
  List Nat

coefficient : Polynomial -> Nat -> Nat
coefficient [] k =
  zero
coefficient (a ∷ coefficients) zero =
  a
coefficient (a ∷ coefficients) (suc k) =
  coefficient coefficients k

addPolynomial : Polynomial -> Polynomial -> Polynomial
addPolynomial [] q =
  q
addPolynomial p [] =
  p
addPolynomial (a ∷ p) (b ∷ q) =
  (a + b) ∷ addPolynomial p q

scalePolynomial : Nat -> Polynomial -> Polynomial
scalePolynomial scalar [] =
  []
scalePolynomial scalar (a ∷ p) =
  (scalar * a) ∷ scalePolynomial scalar p

multiplyPolynomial : Polynomial -> Polynomial -> Polynomial
multiplyPolynomial [] q =
  []
multiplyPolynomial (a ∷ p) q =
  addPolynomial
    (scalePolynomial a q)
    (zero ∷ multiplyPolynomial p q)

onePolynomial : Polynomial
onePolynomial =
  one ∷ []

powerPolynomial : Polynomial -> Nat -> Polynomial
powerPolynomial p zero =
  onePolynomial
powerPolynomial p (suc n) =
  multiplyPolynomial p (powerPolynomial p n)

basePolynomial : Polynomial
basePolynomial =
  one ∷ one ∷ one ∷ one ∷ []

Q : Nat -> Nat -> Nat
Q n k =
  coefficient (powerPolynomial basePolynomial n) k

binomialSummand : Nat -> Nat -> Nat -> Nat
binomialSummand n k j =
  choose n j
  *
  ifNat
    (lessOrEqual (two * j) k)
    (choose n (k - two * j))
    zero

putnam-1992-b2 : Set
putnam-1992-b2 =
  (n k : Nat) ->
  Q n k == sumThrough k (binomialSummand n k)

(*
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1992_b2:
  the coefficient of x^k in (1 + x + x^2 + x^3)^n as a finite sum of
  products of binomial coefficients. This file contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open arithmeticTheory combinatoricsTheory pred_setTheory;

val putnam_1992_b2 =
  ``let base =
      \i : num. if i <= 3 then 1 else 0
    in
      let multiply =
        \p q : num -> num.
          \m : num.
            SIGMA
              (\i : num. p i * q (m - i))
              (count (SUC m))
      in
        let one =
          \i : num. if i = 0 then 1 else 0
        in
          !Q : num -> num -> num.
            Q =
              (\n k : num.
                 FUNPOW
                   (\p : num -> num. multiply p base)
                   n
                   one
                   k)
            ==>
            !n k : num.
              Q n k =
              SIGMA
                (\j : num.
                   binomial n j *
                   (if 2 * j <= k
                    then binomial n (k - 2 * j)
                    else 0))
                (count (SUC k))``;

  equivalent to the source definition of Q.

  the source index range, binomial coefficient, and finite sum. Set.mm's
  binomial coefficient is zero outside its standard range, while the explicit
  conditional preserves the source's truncated natural subtraction.

  The final declaration is the single unproved $a corpus statement; this
  database contains no $p proof declaration.

${

  putnambench-putnam-1992-b2 $a |-
    A. Q e. ( ( NN0 ^m NN0 ) ^m NN0 )
      (
        A. n e. NN0

                (

                  (

                        ( +g ` ( Poly1 ` ZZring ) )

                      )

                      (

% Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1992_b2:
% the coefficient of x^k in (1 + x + x^2 + x^3)^n equals a finite sum of
% products of binomial coefficients. This file contains no proof.

putnam_1992_b2: THEORY
BEGIN
  binomial_coefficient(n, k: nat): RECURSIVE nat =
    IF k = 0 THEN
      1
    ELSIF n = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      binomial_coefficient(n - 1, k - 1)
        + binomial_coefficient(n - 1, k)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE n

  polynomial_power_coefficient(n, k: nat): RECURSIVE nat =
    IF n = 0 THEN
      IF k = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 ENDIF
    ELSE
      polynomial_power_coefficient(n - 1, k)
        + IF k >= 1 THEN
            polynomial_power_coefficient(n - 1, k - 1)
          ELSE
            0
          ENDIF
        + IF k >= 2 THEN
            polynomial_power_coefficient(n - 1, k - 2)
          ELSE
            0
          ENDIF
        + IF k >= 3 THEN
            polynomial_power_coefficient(n - 1, k - 3)
          ELSE
            0
          ENDIF
    ENDIF
  MEASURE n

  Q(n, k: nat): nat =
    polynomial_power_coefficient(n, k)

  binomial_identity_sum(n, k, count: nat): RECURSIVE nat =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      LET j: nat = count - 1
      IN
        binomial_identity_sum(n, k, count - 1)
          + binomial_coefficient(n, j)
              * IF 2 * j <= k THEN
                  binomial_coefficient(n, k - 2 * j)
                ELSE
                  0
                ENDIF
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  putnam_1992_b2: bool =
    FORALL (n, k: nat):
      Q(n, k) = binomial_identity_sum(n, k, k + 1)
END putnam_1992_b2

(* Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench artifact putnam_1992_b3:
   the planar Lebesgue area of the real pairs whose recursively defined
   sequence converges is 4 + pi. This file contains no proof. *)

From Stdlib Require Import Reals SeqSeries.

Open Scope R_scope.

Definition putnam_1992_b3_point : Type := (R * R)%type.

Definition putnam_1992_b3_point_set : Type :=
  putnam_1992_b3_point -> Prop.

Record putnam_1992_b3_open_rectangle : Type := {
  putnam_1992_b3_x_lower : R;
  putnam_1992_b3_x_upper : R;
  putnam_1992_b3_y_lower : R;
  putnam_1992_b3_y_upper : R
}.

Definition putnam_1992_b3_in_open_rectangle
    (rectangle : putnam_1992_b3_open_rectangle)
    (p : putnam_1992_b3_point) : Prop :=
  putnam_1992_b3_x_lower rectangle < fst p <
    putnam_1992_b3_x_upper rectangle /\
  putnam_1992_b3_y_lower rectangle < snd p <
    putnam_1992_b3_y_upper rectangle.

Definition putnam_1992_b3_rectangle_area
    (rectangle : putnam_1992_b3_open_rectangle) : R :=
  Rmax 0
    (putnam_1992_b3_x_upper rectangle -
     putnam_1992_b3_x_lower rectangle) *
  Rmax 0
    (putnam_1992_b3_y_upper rectangle -
     putnam_1992_b3_y_lower rectangle).

Definition putnam_1992_b3_rectangles_cover
    (A : putnam_1992_b3_point_set)
    (rectangles : nat -> putnam_1992_b3_open_rectangle) : Prop :=
  forall p : putnam_1992_b3_point,
    A p ->
    exists n : nat,
      putnam_1992_b3_in_open_rectangle (rectangles n) p.

Fixpoint putnam_1992_b3_partial_rectangle_area
    (rectangles : nat -> putnam_1992_b3_open_rectangle)
    (n : nat) : R :=
  match n with
  | O => 0
  | S k =>
      putnam_1992_b3_partial_rectangle_area rectangles k +
      putnam_1992_b3_rectangle_area (rectangles k)
  end.

(* Equality with finite planar Lebesgue outer measure, expressed through
   countable open-rectangle covers. *)
Definition putnam_1992_b3_has_planar_lebesgue_measure
    (A : putnam_1992_b3_point_set) (area : R) : Prop :=
  0 <= area /\
  (forall rectangles : nat -> putnam_1992_b3_open_rectangle,
    putnam_1992_b3_rectangles_cover A rectangles ->
    forall lower : R,
      lower < area ->
      exists n : nat,
        lower <
        putnam_1992_b3_partial_rectangle_area rectangles n) /\
  (forall epsilon : R,
    0 < epsilon ->
    exists rectangles : nat -> putnam_1992_b3_open_rectangle,
      putnam_1992_b3_rectangles_cover A rectangles /\
      forall n : nat,
        putnam_1992_b3_partial_rectangle_area rectangles n <
        area + epsilon).

Definition putnam_1992_b3_convergence_region
    (a : putnam_1992_b3_point -> nat -> R)
    : putnam_1992_b3_point_set :=
  fun p : putnam_1992_b3_point =>
    exists L : R, Un_cv (a p) L.

Definition putnam_1992_b3_solution : R := 4 + PI.

Theorem putnam_1992_b3
    (a : putnam_1992_b3_point -> nat -> R)
    (ha :
      forall p : putnam_1992_b3_point,
        a p O = fst p /\
        forall n : nat,
          a p (S n) =
          ((a p n) ^ 2 + (snd p) ^ 2) / 2) :
  putnam_1992_b3_has_planar_lebesgue_measure
    (putnam_1992_b3_convergence_region a)
    putnam_1992_b3_solution.
Admitted.

(*
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1992_b3:
  the Lebesgue area of the real parameter pairs for which a recursively
  defined sequence converges is 4 + pi. This file contains no proof.
*)

let statement =
  `let cover_bound =
     \(s:(real#real)->bool) (B:real).
       &0 <= B /\
       ?xl xu yl yu:num->real.
         (!k:num. xl k <= xu k /\ yl k <= yu k) /\
         (!p:real#real.
            p IN s
            ==> ?k:num.
                  xl k < FST p /\ FST p < xu k /\
                  yl k < SND p /\ SND p < yu k) /\
         (!N:num.
            sum (0..N)
              (\k:num. (xu k - xl k) * (yu k - yl k)) <= B) in
   let outer_measure =
     \(s:(real#real)->bool).
       inf {B:real | cover_bound s B} in
   let pi =
     outer_measure
       {p:real#real |
          (FST p) pow 2 + (SND p) pow 2 < &1} in
   let putnam_1992_b3_solution = &4 + pi in
   !a:(real#real)->num->real.
     (!p:real#real.
        a p 0 = FST p /\
        (!n:num.
           a p (n + 1) =
           ((a p n) pow 2 + (SND p) pow 2) / &2))
     ==> outer_measure
           {p:real#real |
              ?L:real.
                !e:real.
                  &0 < e
                  ==> ?N:num.
                        !n:num.
                          N <= n ==> abs (a p n - L) < e} =
         putnam_1992_b3_solution`;;

title: putnam_1992_b3
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1992_b3:
;; the Lebesgue area of the real points whose recursively defined sequence
;; converges is 4 plus pi. This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))

;; A Dedekind-complete ordered field presents the real scalars up to the
;; unique ordered-field isomorphism. Points are pairs over that field, and the
;; sequence family is an unbounded tame APPLY$ function object. All recurrence
;; and convergence quantifiers remain explicit.
;;
;; For a bounded planar set, Lebesgue outer area is equivalently the infimum
;; of the convergent total areas of countable open axis-aligned rectangle
;; covers. The two outer-area predicates below use this definition directly,
;; so neither the real plane nor the measured sets are replaced by finite
;; grids or rational samples. Pi is defined as the outer area of the open unit
;; disk, which is the standard geometric definition in any presentation of
;; the real field.

(defun p92b3-member-p (carrier x)
  (if (apply$ carrier (list x)) t nil))

(defun p92b3-unary-value (operation x)
  (apply$ operation (list x)))

(defun p92b3-binary-value (operation x y)
  (apply$ operation (list x y)))

(defun-sk p92b3-valid-scalar-set-p (carrier set)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (apply$ set (list x))
     (p92b3-member-p carrier x))))

(defun-sk p92b3-field-laws-p
    (carrier add multiply negate inverse zero one)
  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (p92b3-member-p carrier x)
      (p92b3-member-p carrier y)
      (p92b3-member-p carrier z))
     (and
      (p92b3-member-p carrier
                      (p92b3-binary-value add x y))
      (p92b3-member-p carrier
                      (p92b3-binary-value multiply x y))
      (p92b3-member-p carrier
                      (p92b3-unary-value negate x))
      (implies
       (not (equal x zero))
       (p92b3-member-p carrier
                       (p92b3-unary-value inverse x)))
      (equal
       (p92b3-binary-value
        add (p92b3-binary-value add x y) z)
       (p92b3-binary-value
        add x (p92b3-binary-value add y z)))
      (equal
       (p92b3-binary-value add x y)
       (p92b3-binary-value add y x))
      (equal (p92b3-binary-value add x zero) x)
      (equal
       (p92b3-binary-value add x (p92b3-unary-value negate x))
       zero)
      (equal
       (p92b3-binary-value
        multiply (p92b3-binary-value multiply x y) z)
       (p92b3-binary-value
        multiply x (p92b3-binary-value multiply y z)))
      (equal
       (p92b3-binary-value multiply x y)
       (p92b3-binary-value multiply y x))
      (equal (p92b3-binary-value multiply x one) x)
      (implies
       (not (equal x zero))
       (equal
        (p92b3-binary-value
         multiply x (p92b3-unary-value inverse x))
        one))
      (equal
       (p92b3-binary-value
        multiply x (p92b3-binary-value add y z))
       (p92b3-binary-value
        add
        (p92b3-binary-value multiply x y)
        (p92b3-binary-value multiply x z)))))))

(defun-sk p92b3-order-laws-p
    (carrier add multiply zero less)
  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (p92b3-member-p carrier x)
      (p92b3-member-p carrier y)
      (p92b3-member-p carrier z))
     (and
      (not (p92b3-binary-value less x x))
      (or
       (equal x y)
       (p92b3-binary-value less x y)
       (p92b3-binary-value less y x))
      (implies
       (and
        (p92b3-binary-value less x y)
        (p92b3-binary-value less y z))
       (p92b3-binary-value less x z))
      (implies
       (p92b3-binary-value less x y)
       (p92b3-binary-value
        less
        (p92b3-binary-value add x z)
        (p92b3-binary-value add y z)))
      (implies
       (and
        (p92b3-binary-value less zero x)
        (p92b3-binary-value less zero y))
       (p92b3-binary-value
        less zero (p92b3-binary-value multiply x y)))))))

(defun-sk p92b3-scalar-set-nonempty-p (carrier set)
  (exists (x)
    (and
     (p92b3-member-p carrier x)
     (apply$ set (list x)))))

(defun-sk p92b3-upper-bound-p (carrier less set bound)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (and
      (p92b3-member-p carrier x)
      (apply$ set (list x)))
     (not (p92b3-binary-value less bound x)))))

(defun-sk p92b3-bounded-above-p (carrier less set)
  (exists (bound)
    (and
     (p92b3-member-p carrier bound)
     (p92b3-upper-bound-p carrier less set bound))))

(defun-sk p92b3-supremum-p (carrier less set supremum)
  (forall (bound)
    (and
     (p92b3-member-p carrier supremum)
     (p92b3-upper-bound-p carrier less set supremum)
     (implies
      (and
       (p92b3-member-p carrier bound)
       (p92b3-upper-bound-p carrier less set bound))
      (not (p92b3-binary-value less bound supremum))))))

(defun-sk p92b3-has-supremum-p (carrier less set)
  (exists (supremum)
    (p92b3-supremum-p carrier less set supremum)))

(defun-sk p92b3-dedekind-complete-p (carrier less)
  (forall (set)
    (implies
     (and
      (tamep-functionp set)
      (p92b3-valid-scalar-set-p carrier set)
      (p92b3-scalar-set-nonempty-p carrier set)
      (p92b3-bounded-above-p carrier less set))
     (p92b3-has-supremum-p carrier less set))))

(defun p92b3-real-field-p
    (carrier add multiply negate inverse zero one less)
  (and
   (tamep-functionp carrier)
   (tamep-functionp add)
   (tamep-functionp multiply)
   (tamep-functionp negate)
   (tamep-functionp inverse)
   (tamep-functionp less)
   (p92b3-member-p carrier zero)
   (p92b3-member-p carrier one)
   (not (equal zero one))
   (p92b3-field-laws-p
    carrier add multiply negate inverse zero one)
   (p92b3-order-laws-p carrier add multiply zero less)
   (p92b3-binary-value less zero one)
   (p92b3-dedekind-complete-p carrier less)))

(defun p92b3-r-carrier (ctx) (nth 0 ctx))
(defun p92b3-r-zero (ctx) (nth 1 ctx))
(defun p92b3-r-one (ctx) (nth 2 ctx))
(defun p92b3-r-add (ctx) (nth 3 ctx))
(defun p92b3-r-mul (ctx) (nth 4 ctx))
(defun p92b3-r-neg (ctx) (nth 5 ctx))
(defun p92b3-r-inv (ctx) (nth 6 ctx))
(defun p92b3-r-lt (ctx) (nth 7 ctx))

(defun p92b3-context-p (ctx)
  (and
   (true-listp ctx)
   (equal (len ctx) 8)
   (p92b3-real-field-p
    (p92b3-r-carrier ctx)
    (p92b3-r-add ctx)
    (p92b3-r-mul ctx)
    (p92b3-r-neg ctx)
    (p92b3-r-inv ctx)
    (p92b3-r-zero ctx)
    (p92b3-r-one ctx)
    (p92b3-r-lt ctx))))

(defun p92b3-r-add-value (ctx x y)
  (p92b3-binary-value (p92b3-r-add ctx) x y))

(defun p92b3-r-mul-value (ctx x y)
  (p92b3-binary-value (p92b3-r-mul ctx) x y))

(defun p92b3-r-neg-value (ctx x)
  (p92b3-unary-value (p92b3-r-neg ctx) x))

(defun p92b3-r-inv-value (ctx x)
  (p92b3-unary-value (p92b3-r-inv ctx) x))

(defun p92b3-r-sub-value (ctx x y)
  (p92b3-r-add-value ctx x (p92b3-r-neg-value ctx y)))

(defun p92b3-r-lt-p (ctx x y)
  (if (p92b3-binary-value (p92b3-r-lt ctx) x y) t nil))

(defun p92b3-r-le-p (ctx x y)
  (not (p92b3-r-lt-p ctx y x)))

(defun p92b3-r-abs-value (ctx x)
  (if (p92b3-r-lt-p ctx x (p92b3-r-zero ctx))
      (p92b3-r-neg-value ctx x)
    x))

(defun p92b3-positive-real-p (ctx x)
  (and
   (p92b3-member-p (p92b3-r-carrier ctx) x)
   (p92b3-r-lt-p ctx (p92b3-r-zero ctx) x)))

(defun p92b3-nonnegative-real-p (ctx x)
  (and
   (p92b3-member-p (p92b3-r-carrier ctx) x)
   (p92b3-r-le-p ctx (p92b3-r-zero ctx) x)))

(defun p92b3-two (ctx)
  (p92b3-r-add-value
   ctx (p92b3-r-one ctx) (p92b3-r-one ctx)))

(defun p92b3-four (ctx)
  (p92b3-r-add-value
   ctx (p92b3-two ctx) (p92b3-two ctx)))

(defun p92b3-half (ctx)
  (p92b3-r-inv-value ctx (p92b3-two ctx)))

(defun p92b3-point-p (ctx point)
  (and
   (true-listp point)
   (equal (len point) 2)
   (p92b3-member-p (p92b3-r-carrier ctx) (nth 0 point))
   (p92b3-member-p (p92b3-r-carrier ctx) (nth 1 point))))

(defun p92b3-sequence-value (family point n)
  (apply$ family (list point n)))

(defun-sk p92b3-real-sequence-family-p (ctx family)
  (forall (point n)
    (implies
     (and
      (p92b3-point-p ctx point)
      (natp n))
     (p92b3-member-p
      (p92b3-r-carrier ctx)
      (p92b3-sequence-value family point n)))))

(defun-sk p92b3-recurrence-p (ctx family)
  (forall (point n)
    (implies
     (and
      (p92b3-point-p ctx point)
      (natp n))
     (and
      (implies
       (equal n 0)
       (equal
        (p92b3-sequence-value family point 0)
        (nth 0 point)))
      (equal
       (p92b3-sequence-value family point (+ n 1))
       (p92b3-r-mul-value
        ctx
        (p92b3-r-add-value
         ctx
         (p92b3-r-mul-value
          ctx
          (p92b3-sequence-value family point n)
          (p92b3-sequence-value family point n))
         (p92b3-r-mul-value
          ctx (nth 1 point) (nth 1 point)))
        (p92b3-half ctx)))))))

(defun-sk p92b3-limit-tail-p
    (ctx family point limit epsilon cutoff)
  (forall (n)
    (implies
     (and
      (natp n)
      (<= cutoff n))
     (p92b3-r-lt-p
      ctx
      (p92b3-r-abs-value
       ctx
       (p92b3-r-sub-value
        ctx
        (p92b3-sequence-value family point n)
        limit))
      epsilon))))

(defun-sk p92b3-limit-cutoff-exists-p
    (ctx family point limit epsilon)
  (exists (cutoff)
    (and
     (natp cutoff)
     (p92b3-limit-tail-p
      ctx family point limit epsilon cutoff))))

(defun-sk p92b3-converges-to-p (ctx family point limit)
  (forall (epsilon)
    (implies
     (p92b3-positive-real-p ctx epsilon)
     (p92b3-limit-cutoff-exists-p
      ctx family point limit epsilon))))

(defun-sk p92b3-converges-p (ctx family point)
  (exists (limit)
    (and
     (p92b3-member-p (p92b3-r-carrier ctx) limit)
     (p92b3-converges-to-p ctx family point limit))))

;; A rectangle is (x-lower x-upper y-lower y-upper), with open sides.

(defun p92b3-rectangle-p (ctx rectangle)
  (and
   (true-listp rectangle)
   (equal (len rectangle) 4)
   (p92b3-member-p
    (p92b3-r-carrier ctx) (nth 0 rectangle))
   (p92b3-member-p
    (p92b3-r-carrier ctx) (nth 1 rectangle))
   (p92b3-member-p
    (p92b3-r-carrier ctx) (nth 2 rectangle))
   (p92b3-member-p
    (p92b3-r-carrier ctx) (nth 3 rectangle))
   (p92b3-r-lt-p ctx (nth 0 rectangle) (nth 1 rectangle))
   (p92b3-r-lt-p ctx (nth 2 rectangle) (nth 3 rectangle))))

(defun p92b3-point-in-rectangle-p (ctx point rectangle)
  (and
   (p92b3-point-p ctx point)
   (p92b3-rectangle-p ctx rectangle)
   (p92b3-r-lt-p ctx (nth 0 rectangle) (nth 0 point))
   (p92b3-r-lt-p ctx (nth 0 point) (nth 1 rectangle))
   (p92b3-r-lt-p ctx (nth 2 rectangle) (nth 1 point))
   (p92b3-r-lt-p ctx (nth 1 point) (nth 3 rectangle))))

(defun p92b3-rectangle-area (ctx rectangle)
  (p92b3-r-mul-value
   ctx
   (p92b3-r-sub-value
    ctx (nth 1 rectangle) (nth 0 rectangle))
   (p92b3-r-sub-value
    ctx (nth 3 rectangle) (nth 2 rectangle))))

(defun p92b3-cover-rectangle (cover n)
  (apply$ cover (list n)))

(defun-sk p92b3-valid-rectangle-cover-sequence-p (ctx cover)
  (forall (n)
    (implies
     (natp n)
     (p92b3-rectangle-p
      ctx (p92b3-cover-rectangle cover n)))))

(defun p92b3-cover-partial-area (ctx cover count)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix count)))
  (if (zp count)
      (p92b3-r-zero ctx)
    (let ((index (- (nfix count) 1)))
      (p92b3-r-add-value
       ctx
       (p92b3-cover-partial-area ctx cover index)
       (p92b3-rectangle-area
        ctx (p92b3-cover-rectangle cover index))))))

(defun-sk p92b3-cover-area-tail-p
    (ctx cover total epsilon cutoff)
  (forall (count)
    (implies
     (and
      (natp count)
      (<= cutoff count))
     (p92b3-r-lt-p
      ctx
      (p92b3-r-abs-value
       ctx
       (p92b3-r-sub-value
        ctx
        (p92b3-cover-partial-area ctx cover count)
        total))
      epsilon))))

(defun-sk p92b3-cover-area-cutoff-exists-p
    (ctx cover total epsilon)
  (exists (cutoff)
    (and
     (natp cutoff)
     (p92b3-cover-area-tail-p
      ctx cover total epsilon cutoff))))

(defun-sk p92b3-cover-area-converges-to-p
    (ctx cover total)
  (forall (epsilon)
    (implies
     (p92b3-positive-real-p ctx epsilon)
     (p92b3-cover-area-cutoff-exists-p
      ctx cover total epsilon))))

(defun p92b3-finite-cover-cost-p (ctx cover total)
  (and
   (tamep-functionp cover)
   (p92b3-valid-rectangle-cover-sequence-p ctx cover)
   (p92b3-nonnegative-real-p ctx total)
   (p92b3-cover-area-converges-to-p ctx cover total)))

(defun-sk p92b3-region-point-covered-p
    (ctx family cover point)
  (exists (n)
    (and
     (natp n)
     (p92b3-point-in-rectangle-p
      ctx point (p92b3-cover-rectangle cover n)))))

(defun-sk p92b3-region-cover-p (ctx family cover)
  (forall (point)
    (implies
     (and
      (p92b3-point-p ctx point)
      (p92b3-converges-p ctx family point))
     (p92b3-region-point-covered-p
      ctx family cover point))))

(defun p92b3-unit-disk-point-p (ctx point)
  (and
   (p92b3-point-p ctx point)
   (p92b3-r-lt-p
    ctx
    (p92b3-r-add-value
     ctx
     (p92b3-r-mul-value
      ctx (nth 0 point) (nth 0 point))
     (p92b3-r-mul-value
      ctx (nth 1 point) (nth 1 point)))
    (p92b3-r-one ctx))))

(defun-sk p92b3-unit-disk-point-covered-p
    (ctx cover point)
  (exists (n)
    (and
     (natp n)
     (p92b3-point-in-rectangle-p
      ctx point (p92b3-cover-rectangle cover n)))))

(defun-sk p92b3-unit-disk-cover-p (ctx cover)
  (forall (point)
    (implies
     (p92b3-unit-disk-point-p ctx point)
     (p92b3-unit-disk-point-covered-p
      ctx cover point))))

;; AREA is the infimum of all finite total costs of countable open-rectangle
;; covers: it is a lower bound, and covers occur within every positive
;; epsilon above it.

(defun-sk p92b3-region-area-lower-bound-p
    (ctx family area)
  (forall (cover total)
    (implies
     (and
      (p92b3-finite-cover-cost-p ctx cover total)
      (p92b3-region-cover-p ctx family cover))
     (p92b3-r-le-p ctx area total))))

(defun-sk p92b3-region-near-cover-exists-p
    (ctx family area epsilon)
  (exists (cover total)
    (and
     (p92b3-finite-cover-cost-p ctx cover total)
     (p92b3-region-cover-p ctx family cover)
     (p92b3-r-lt-p
      ctx total (p92b3-r-add-value ctx area epsilon)))))

(defun-sk p92b3-region-near-covers-p
    (ctx family area)
  (forall (epsilon)
    (implies
     (p92b3-positive-real-p ctx epsilon)
     (p92b3-region-near-cover-exists-p
      ctx family area epsilon))))

(defun p92b3-region-outer-area-p (ctx family area)
  (and
   (p92b3-nonnegative-real-p ctx area)
   (p92b3-region-area-lower-bound-p ctx family area)
   (p92b3-region-near-covers-p ctx family area)))

(defun-sk p92b3-unit-disk-area-lower-bound-p (ctx area)
  (forall (cover total)
    (implies
     (and
      (p92b3-finite-cover-cost-p ctx cover total)
      (p92b3-unit-disk-cover-p ctx cover))
     (p92b3-r-le-p ctx area total))))

(defun-sk p92b3-unit-disk-near-cover-exists-p
    (ctx area epsilon)
  (exists (cover total)
    (and
     (p92b3-finite-cover-cost-p ctx cover total)
     (p92b3-unit-disk-cover-p ctx cover)
     (p92b3-r-lt-p
      ctx total (p92b3-r-add-value ctx area epsilon)))))

(defun-sk p92b3-unit-disk-near-covers-p (ctx area)
  (forall (epsilon)
    (implies
     (p92b3-positive-real-p ctx epsilon)
     (p92b3-unit-disk-near-cover-exists-p
      ctx area epsilon))))

(defun p92b3-unit-disk-outer-area-p (ctx area)
  (and
   (p92b3-nonnegative-real-p ctx area)
   (p92b3-unit-disk-area-lower-bound-p ctx area)
   (p92b3-unit-disk-near-covers-p ctx area)))

(defun-sk putnambench-putnam-1992-b3-statement (ctx family)
  (exists (region-area unit-disk-area)
    (implies
     (and
      (p92b3-context-p ctx)
      (tamep-functionp family)
      (p92b3-real-sequence-family-p ctx family)
      (p92b3-recurrence-p ctx family))
     (and
      (p92b3-region-outer-area-p
       ctx family region-area)
      (p92b3-unit-disk-outer-area-p
       ctx unit-disk-area)
      (equal
       region-area
       (p92b3-r-add-value
        ctx (p92b3-four ctx) unit-disk-area))))))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

title: putnam_1992_b3
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1992_b3
-- (putnambench__agda__putnam_1992_b3): the Lebesgue area of the real-plane
-- parameters for which a recursively defined quadratic sequence converges.
-- This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; _*_)

infix 4 _!=_ _<=N_
infixr 3 _and_
infixr 2 _or_

data Bottom : Set where

Not : Set -> Set
Not A =
  A -> Bottom

_!=_ : {A : Set} -> A -> A -> Set
x != y =
  Not (x == y)

record _and_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data _or_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  left  : A -> A or B
  right : B -> A or B

record Iff (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor equivalence
  field
    forward  : A -> B
    backward : B -> A

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

data _<=N_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set where
  zero<=N   : {n : Nat} -> zero <=N n
  suc<=sucN : {m n : Nat} -> m <=N n -> suc m <=N suc n

record CompleteOrderedRealField (R : Set) : Set1 where
  field
    zeroR oneR : R
    add multiply : R -> R -> R
    negate inverse : R -> R
    lessOrEqual : R -> R -> Set
    fromNat : Nat -> R

    one-not-zero :
      oneR != zeroR

    add-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> add x y == add y x
    add-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      add (add x y) z == add x (add y z)
    add-zero :
      (x : R) -> add x zeroR == x
    add-inverse :
      (x : R) -> add x (negate x) == zeroR

    multiply-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> multiply x y == multiply y x
    multiply-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply (multiply x y) z ==
      multiply x (multiply y z)
    multiply-one :
      (x : R) -> multiply x oneR == x
    multiply-zero :
      (x : R) -> multiply x zeroR == zeroR
    distribute :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply x (add y z) ==
      add (multiply x y) (multiply x z)
    inverse-zero :
      inverse zeroR == zeroR
    multiply-inverse :
      (x : R) ->
      x != zeroR ->
      multiply x (inverse x) == oneR

    order-reflexive :
      (x : R) -> lessOrEqual x x
    order-transitive :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y z ->
      lessOrEqual x z
    order-antisymmetric :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y x ->
      x == y
    order-total :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y or lessOrEqual y x
    add-order :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual (add z x) (add z y)
    multiply-nonnegative :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR x ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR y ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR (multiply x y)
    zero-less-than-one :
      lessOrEqual zeroR oneR and zeroR != oneR

    fromNat-zero :
      fromNat zero == zeroR
    fromNat-successor :
      (n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (suc n) == add (fromNat n) oneR
    fromNat-addition :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m + n) == add (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-multiplication :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m * n) == multiply (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-injective :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat m == fromNat n ->
      m == n

    archimedean :
      (x : R) ->
      Exists Nat (\ n -> lessOrEqual x (fromNat n))
    least-upper-bound :
      (P : R -> Set) ->
      Exists R P ->
      Exists R
        (\ upper ->
          (x : R) ->
          P x ->
          lessOrEqual x upper) ->
      Exists R
        (\ supremum ->
          ((x : R) ->
            P x ->
            lessOrEqual x supremum)
          and
          ((upper : R) ->
            ((x : R) ->
              P x ->
              lessOrEqual x upper) ->
            lessOrEqual supremum upper))

open CompleteOrderedRealField

subtract :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
subtract reals x y =
  add reals x (negate reals y)

divide :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
divide reals x y =
  multiply reals x (inverse reals y)

square :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R
square reals x =
  multiply reals x x

StrictLess :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
StrictLess reals x y =
  lessOrEqual reals x y and x != y

CloseTo :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
CloseTo reals center radius x =
  StrictLess reals
    (subtract reals center radius)
    x
  and
  StrictLess reals
    x
    (add reals center radius)

ConvergesTo :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  R ->
  Set
ConvergesTo {R} reals sequence limit =
  (epsilon : R) ->
  StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) epsilon ->
  Exists Nat
    (\ cutoff ->
      (n : Nat) ->
      cutoff <=N n ->
      CloseTo reals limit epsilon (sequence n))

oneN : Nat
oneN =
  suc zero

twoN : Nat
twoN =
  suc oneN

threeN : Nat
threeN =
  suc twoN

fourN : Nat
fourN =
  suc threeN

sumFirst :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Nat ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  R
sumFirst reals zero terms =
  zeroR reals
sumFirst reals (suc n) terms =
  add reals
    (sumFirst reals n terms)
    (terms n)

alternatingUnit :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Nat ->
  R
alternatingUnit reals zero =
  oneR reals
alternatingUnit reals (suc n) =
  negate reals (alternatingUnit reals n)

oddNatural : Nat -> Nat
oddNatural n =
  suc (n + n)

leibnizTerm :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Nat ->
  R
leibnizTerm reals n =
  divide reals
    (alternatingUnit reals n)
    (fromNat reals (oddNatural n))

piApproximation :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Nat ->
  R
piApproximation reals n =
  multiply reals
    (fromNat reals fourN)
    (sumFirst reals (suc n) (leibnizTerm reals))

record StandardRealAnalysis (R : Set) : Set1 where
  field
    algebra : CompleteOrderedRealField R
    pi : R
    pi-leibniz-limit :
      ConvergesTo algebra
        (piApproximation algebra)
        pi

open StandardRealAnalysis

record Point (R : Set) : Set where
  constructor point
  field
    firstCoordinate  : R
    secondCoordinate : R

open Point

Region : Set -> Set1
Region R =
  Point R -> Set

Empty :
  {R : Set} ->
  Region R
Empty _ =
  Bottom

Complement :
  {R : Set} ->
  Region R ->
  Region R
Complement body p =
  Not (body p)

Intersect :
  {R : Set} ->
  Region R ->
  Region R ->
  Region R
Intersect leftBody rightBody p =
  leftBody p and rightBody p

UnionAll :
  {R : Set} ->
  (Nat -> Region R) ->
  Region R
UnionAll bodies p =
  Exists Nat (\ n -> bodies n p)

Disjoint :
  {R : Set} ->
  Region R ->
  Region R ->
  Set
Disjoint {R} leftBody rightBody =
  (p : Point R) ->
  leftBody p ->
  rightBody p ->
  Bottom

PairwiseDisjoint :
  {R : Set} ->
  (Nat -> Region R) ->
  Set
PairwiseDisjoint bodies =
  (m n : Nat) ->
  m != n ->
  Disjoint (bodies m) (bodies n)

addPoint :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Point R ->
  Point R ->
  Point R
addPoint reals p q =
  point
    (add reals
      (firstCoordinate p)
      (firstCoordinate q))
    (add reals
      (secondCoordinate p)
      (secondCoordinate q))

translateRegion :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Point R ->
  Region R ->
  Region R
translateRegion {R} reals offset body p =
  Exists (Point R)
    (\ q ->
      body q
      and
      p == addPoint reals offset q)

HalfOpenBox :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Point R ->
  Point R ->
  Region R
HalfOpenBox reals lower upper p =
  (lessOrEqual reals
    (firstCoordinate lower)
    (firstCoordinate p)
  and
  StrictLess reals
    (firstCoordinate p)
    (firstCoordinate upper))
  and
  (lessOrEqual reals
    (secondCoordinate lower)
    (secondCoordinate p)
  and
  StrictLess reals
    (secondCoordinate p)
    (secondCoordinate upper))

data ExtendedNonnegative (R : Set) : Set where
  finite   : R -> ExtendedNonnegative R
  infinity : ExtendedNonnegative R

data ExtendedLessOrEqual
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) :
  ExtendedNonnegative R ->
  ExtendedNonnegative R ->
  Set where

  finite<=finite :
    {x y : R} ->
    lessOrEqual reals x y ->
    ExtendedLessOrEqual reals (finite x) (finite y)

  finite<=infinity :
    {x : R} ->
    ExtendedLessOrEqual reals (finite x) infinity

  infinity<=infinity :
    ExtendedLessOrEqual reals infinity infinity

addExtended :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  ExtendedNonnegative R ->
  ExtendedNonnegative R ->
  ExtendedNonnegative R
addExtended reals infinity rightValue =
  infinity
addExtended reals (finite x) infinity =
  infinity
addExtended reals (finite x) (finite y) =
  finite (add reals x y)

sumFirstExtended :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Nat ->
  (Nat -> ExtendedNonnegative R) ->
  ExtendedNonnegative R
sumFirstExtended reals zero term =
  finite (zeroR reals)
sumFirstExtended reals (suc n) term =
  addExtended reals
    (sumFirstExtended reals n term)
    (term n)

UpperBoundExtended :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (Nat -> ExtendedNonnegative R) ->
  ExtendedNonnegative R ->
  Set
UpperBoundExtended reals values bound =
  (n : Nat) ->
  ExtendedLessOrEqual reals (values n) bound

LeastUpperBoundExtended :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (Nat -> ExtendedNonnegative R) ->
  ExtendedNonnegative R ->
  Set
LeastUpperBoundExtended reals values supremum =
  UpperBoundExtended reals values supremum
  and
  ((upper : ExtendedNonnegative _) ->
    UpperBoundExtended reals values upper ->
    ExtendedLessOrEqual reals supremum upper)

record StandardPlaneLebesgueMeasure
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) :
  Set1 where

  field
    measurable : Region R -> Set
    volume : Region R -> ExtendedNonnegative R

    measurable-empty :
      measurable Empty
    measurable-complement :
      (body : Region R) ->
      measurable body ->
      measurable (Complement body)
    measurable-countable-union :
      (bodies : Nat -> Region R) ->
      ((n : Nat) -> measurable (bodies n)) ->
      measurable (UnionAll bodies)
    measurable-intersection :
      (leftBody rightBody : Region R) ->
      measurable leftBody ->
      measurable rightBody ->
      measurable (Intersect leftBody rightBody)
    measurable-translation :
      (offset : Point R) ->
      (body : Region R) ->
      measurable body ->
      measurable (translateRegion reals offset body)
    measurable-box :
      (lower upper : Point R) ->
      measurable (HalfOpenBox reals lower upper)

    volume-congruent :
      (leftBody rightBody : Region R) ->
      ((p : Point R) ->
        Iff (leftBody p) (rightBody p)) ->
      volume leftBody == volume rightBody
    volume-empty :
      volume Empty == finite (zeroR reals)
    volume-nonnegative :
      (body : Region R) ->
      measurable body ->
      ExtendedLessOrEqual reals
        (finite (zeroR reals))
        (volume body)
    volume-countable-additive :
      (bodies : Nat -> Region R) ->
      ((n : Nat) -> measurable (bodies n)) ->
      PairwiseDisjoint bodies ->
      LeastUpperBoundExtended reals
        (\ count ->
          sumFirstExtended reals count
            (\ n -> volume (bodies n)))
        (volume (UnionAll bodies))
    volume-translation-invariant :
      (offset : Point R) ->
      (body : Region R) ->
      measurable body ->
      volume (translateRegion reals offset body) ==
      volume body
    volume-box :
      (lower upper : Point R) ->
      lessOrEqual reals
        (firstCoordinate lower)
        (firstCoordinate upper) ->
      lessOrEqual reals
        (secondCoordinate lower)
        (secondCoordinate upper) ->
      volume (HalfOpenBox reals lower upper) ==
      finite
        (multiply reals
          (subtract reals
            (firstCoordinate upper)
            (firstCoordinate lower))
          (subtract reals
            (secondCoordinate upper)
            (secondCoordinate lower)))

open StandardPlaneLebesgueMeasure

module Putnam1992B3Statement
  {R : Set}
  (analysis : StandardRealAnalysis R)
  (lebesgue : StandardPlaneLebesgueMeasure (algebra analysis)) where

  reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R
  reals =
    algebra analysis

  Recurrence :
    (Point R -> Nat -> R) ->
    Set
  Recurrence a =
    (p : Point R) ->
    a p zero == firstCoordinate p
    and
    ((n : Nat) ->
      a p (suc n) ==
      divide reals
        (add reals
          (square reals (a p n))
          (square reals (secondCoordinate p)))
        (fromNat reals twoN))

  ConvergenceRegion :
    (Point R -> Nat -> R) ->
    Region R
  ConvergenceRegion a p =
    Exists R (\ limit -> ConvergesTo reals (a p) limit)

  solution : R
  solution =
    add reals
      (fromNat reals fourN)
      (pi analysis)

  proposition : Set
  proposition =
    (a : Point R -> Nat -> R) ->
    Recurrence a ->
    volume lebesgue (ConvergenceRegion a) ==
    finite solution

putnam-1992-b3 : Set1
putnam-1992-b3 =
  (R : Set) ->
  (analysis : StandardRealAnalysis R) ->
  (lebesgue : StandardPlaneLebesgueMeasure (algebra analysis)) ->
  Putnam1992B3Statement.proposition analysis lebesgue

(*
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1992_b3:
  the planar Lebesgue measure of the initial points whose recursively defined
  real sequence converges is 4 + pi. This file contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open arithmeticTheory pairTheory pred_setTheory realTheory real_topologyTheory;
open transcTheory extrealTheory measureTheory lebesgue_measureTheory
     martingaleTheory;

val putnam_1992_b3 =
  ``!a : (real # real) -> num -> real.
      (!p : real # real.
         a p 0 = FST p /\
         !n : num.
           a p (n + 1) =
             ((a p n) pow 2 + (SND p) pow 2) / 2)
      ==>
      measure
        (prod_measure_space lebesgue lebesgue)
        {p : real # real |
          ?L : real. (a p --> L) sequentially} =
      Normal (4 + pi)``;

title: putnam_1992_b3
content:
$(
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact
  putnam_1992_b3: the Lebesgue area of the real-plane parameters for which
  the recursively defined real sequence converges. This file contains no
  proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  P92B3Index is the two-coordinate index set {0,1}, and P92B3Plane is the
  full real plane represented as real-valued functions on that set.
  P92B3Converges A P says that the NN0-indexed real sequence assigned by A
  to P has an internally existential real limit. P92B3Region A is exactly
  the set of plane parameters satisfying that convergence predicate, and
  P92B3Area A is its two-dimensional Lebesgue measure via set.mm's voln.

  The final assertion substitutes the resolved area 4 + pi, universally
  quantifies the arbitrary sequence family, and retains the complete source
  recurrence as its antecedent. Every declaration is an unproved $a
  statement, and this database contains no $p proof declaration.
$)

$c P92B3Index P92B3Plane P92B3Converges P92B3Region P92B3Area $.

p92b3-index-syntax $a class P92B3Index $.
p92b3-plane-syntax $a class P92B3Plane $.
p92b3-converges-syntax $a wff ( P92B3Converges A P ) $.
p92b3-region-syntax $a class ( P92B3Region A ) $.
p92b3-area-syntax $a class ( P92B3Area A ) $.

p92b3-index-definition $a |- P92B3Index = ( 0 ... 1 ) $.

p92b3-plane-definition $a |- P92B3Plane = ( RR ^m P92B3Index ) $.

${
  $d A P l n $.

  p92b3-converges-definition $a |- (
    ( P92B3Converges A P )
    <->
    E. l e. RR
      (
        n e. NN0 |->
          ( ( A ` P ) ` n )
      )
      ~~>
      l
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d A p $.

  p92b3-region-definition $a |- (
    P92B3Region A
  ) = {
    p e. P92B3Plane |
      ( P92B3Converges A p )
  } $.
$}

p92b3-area-definition $a |- (
  P92B3Area A
) = (
  ( voln ` P92B3Index )
  `
  ( P92B3Region A )
) $.

${
  $d a n p $.

  putnambench-putnam-1992-b3 $a |-
    A. a e. ( ( RR ^m NN0 ) ^m P92B3Plane )
      (
        A. p e. P92B3Plane
          (
            ( ( a ` p ) ` 0 ) = ( p ` 0 )
            /\
            A. n e. NN0
              ( ( a ` p ) ` ( n + 1 ) )
              =
              (
                (
                  ( ( ( a ` p ) ` n ) ^ 2 )
                  +
                  ( ( p ` 1 ) ^ 2 )
                )
                /
                2
              )
          )
        ->
        ( 4 + _pi ) = ( P92B3Area a )
      )
  $.
$}

title: putnam_1992_b3
content:
% Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1992_b3:
% for the stated real recurrence, the planar region of initial points whose
% sequences converge has Lebesgue area 4 + pi. This file contains no proof.

putnam_1992_b3: THEORY
BEGIN
  point: TYPE = [# x_coord: real, y_coord: real #]
  planar_region: TYPE = [point -> bool]
  real_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> real]
  sequence_family: TYPE = [point -> real_sequence]

  box: TYPE =
    [# left: real, right: real, bottom: real, top: real #]
  box_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> box]

  satisfies_recurrence(a: sequence_family): bool =
    FORALL (p: point):
      a(p)(0) = x_coord(p)
        AND FORALL (n: nat):
          a(p)(n + 1)
            = (a(p)(n) ^ 2 + y_coord(p) ^ 2) / 2

  converges_to(sequence: real_sequence, value: real): bool =
    FORALL (epsilon_value: posreal):
      EXISTS (cutoff: nat):
        FORALL (index: nat):
          cutoff <= index IMPLIES
            abs(sequence(index) - value) < epsilon_value

  convergence_region(a: sequence_family): planar_region =
    LAMBDA (p: point):
      EXISTS (limit_value: real):
        converges_to(a(p), limit_value)

  in_open_box(p: point, rectangle: box): bool =
    left(rectangle) < x_coord(p)
      AND x_coord(p) < right(rectangle)
      AND bottom(rectangle) < y_coord(p)
      AND y_coord(p) < top(rectangle)

  box_area(rectangle: box): real =
    IF left(rectangle) < right(rectangle)
        AND bottom(rectangle) < top(rectangle)
    THEN
      (right(rectangle) - left(rectangle))
        * (top(rectangle) - bottom(rectangle))
    ELSE
      0
    ENDIF

  partial_box_area(
      boxes: box_sequence,
      count: nat): RECURSIVE real =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      partial_box_area(boxes, count - 1)
        + box_area(boxes(count - 1))
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  covers(region: planar_region, boxes: box_sequence): bool =
    FORALL (p: point):
      region(p) IMPLIES
        EXISTS (index: nat):
          in_open_box(p, boxes(index))

  cover_has_total_area(
      region: planar_region,
      boxes: box_sequence,
      total: real): bool =
    covers(region, boxes)
      AND converges_to(
        LAMBDA (count: nat):
          partial_box_area(boxes, count),
        total)

  has_lebesgue_outer_area(
      region: planar_region,
      area: real): bool =
    0 <= area
      AND (FORALL (boxes: box_sequence), (total: real):
        cover_has_total_area(region, boxes, total)
          IMPLIES area <= total)
      AND (FORALL (epsilon_value: posreal):
        EXISTS (boxes: box_sequence), (total: real):
          cover_has_total_area(region, boxes, total)
            AND total < area + epsilon_value)

  alternating_sign(index: nat): RECURSIVE real =
    IF index = 0 THEN
      1
    ELSE
      -alternating_sign(index - 1)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE index

  leibniz_partial_sum(count: nat): RECURSIVE real =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      LET index: nat = count - 1 IN
        leibniz_partial_sum(count - 1)
          + alternating_sign(index)
              / ((2 * index + 1) :: real)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  is_pi(value: real): bool =
    converges_to(
      LAMBDA (count: nat):
        4 * leibniz_partial_sum(count),
      value)

  pi: real =
    epsilon(
      LAMBDA (value: real):
        is_pi(value))

  putnam_1992_b3: bool =
    FORALL (a: sequence_family):
      satisfies_recurrence(a) IMPLIES
        has_lebesgue_outer_area(
          convergence_region(a),
          4 + pi)
END putnam_1992_b3

title: putnam_1992_b4
content:
import Mathlib

open Topology Filter Nat Function Polynomial

abbrev putnam_1992_b4_solution : ℕ := 3984
/--
Let $p(x)$ be a nonzero polynomial of degree less than $1992$ having no nonconstant factor in common with $x^3 - x$. Let
\[
\frac{d^{1992}}{dx^{1992}} \left( \frac{p(x)}{x^3 - x} \right) = \frac{f(x)}{g(x)}
\]
for polynomials $f(x)$ and $g(x)$. Find the smallest possible degree of $f(x)$.
-/
theorem putnam_1992_b4
  (IsValid : Polynomial ℝ → Prop)
  (pair : Polynomial ℝ → Polynomial ℝ → Prop)
  (IsValid_def : ∀ p, IsValid p ↔ p ≠ 0 ∧ p.degree < 1992 ∧ IsCoprime p (X ^ 3 - X))
  (hpair : ∀ p f, pair p f ↔ ∃ g : Polynomial ℝ, g ≠ 0 ∧
    ∀ x : ℝ, x ≠ -1 → x ≠ 0 → x ≠ 1 → g.eval x ≠ 0 →
      iteratedDeriv 1992 (fun y ↦ p.eval y / (y ^ 3 - y)) x =
        f.eval x / g.eval x) :
  IsLeast {k : ℕ | ∃ p f, IsValid p ∧ pair p f ∧ k = f.degree} putnam_1992_b4_solution :=
sorry

title: putnam_1992_b4
content:
(* Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1992_b4:
   the least numerator degree after differentiating p(x)/(x^3-x) 1992 times,
   for nonzero p of degree below 1992 coprime to x^3-x, is 3984. This file
   contains no proof. *)

From Coq Require Import Reals ClassicalEpsilon ClassicalDescription.

Open Scope R_scope.

Record putnam_1992_b4_polynomial : Type := {
  putnam_1992_b4_coeff : nat -> R;
  putnam_1992_b4_bound : nat;
  putnam_1992_b4_finite :
    forall n : nat,
      (putnam_1992_b4_bound < n)%nat ->
      putnam_1992_b4_coeff n = 0
}.

Definition putnam_1992_b4_eval
    (p : putnam_1992_b4_polynomial) (x : R) : R :=
  sum_f_R0
    (fun n : nat => putnam_1992_b4_coeff p n * x ^ n)
    (putnam_1992_b4_bound p).

Definition putnam_1992_b4_zero
    (p : putnam_1992_b4_polynomial) : Prop :=
  forall n : nat, putnam_1992_b4_coeff p n = 0.

Definition putnam_1992_b4_degree
    (p : putnam_1992_b4_polynomial) (d : nat) : Prop :=
  (putnam_1992_b4_zero p /\ d = 0%nat) \/
  (putnam_1992_b4_coeff p d <> 0 /\
   forall n : nat,
     (d < n)%nat ->
     putnam_1992_b4_coeff p n = 0).

Definition putnam_1992_b4_product_coeff
    (p q : putnam_1992_b4_polynomial) (n : nat) : R :=
  sum_f_R0
    (fun k : nat =>
       putnam_1992_b4_coeff p k *
       putnam_1992_b4_coeff q (n - k)%nat)
    n.

Definition putnam_1992_b4_divides
    (d p : putnam_1992_b4_polynomial) : Prop :=
  exists q : putnam_1992_b4_polynomial,
    forall n : nat,
      putnam_1992_b4_coeff p n =
      putnam_1992_b4_product_coeff d q n.

Definition putnam_1992_b4_x3_minus_x_coeff (n : nat) : R :=
  match n with
  | 1%nat => -1
  | 3%nat => 1
  | _ => 0
  end.

Definition putnam_1992_b4_divides_x3_minus_x
    (d : putnam_1992_b4_polynomial) : Prop :=
  exists q : putnam_1992_b4_polynomial,
    forall n : nat,
      putnam_1992_b4_x3_minus_x_coeff n =
      putnam_1992_b4_product_coeff d q n.

Definition putnam_1992_b4_constant
    (p : putnam_1992_b4_polynomial) : Prop :=
  forall n : nat,
    (0 < n)%nat ->
    putnam_1992_b4_coeff p n = 0.

Definition putnam_1992_b4_coprime_x3_minus_x
    (p : putnam_1992_b4_polynomial) : Prop :=
  forall d : putnam_1992_b4_polynomial,
    putnam_1992_b4_divides d p ->
    putnam_1992_b4_divides_x3_minus_x d ->
    putnam_1992_b4_constant d.

Definition putnam_1992_b4_total_derivative
    (f : R -> R) (x : R) : R :=
  match excluded_middle_informative
          (exists d : R, derivable_pt_lim f x d) with
  | left _ =>
      epsilon (inhabits (0 : R))
        (fun d : R => derivable_pt_lim f x d)
  | right _ => 0
  end.

Fixpoint putnam_1992_b4_iterated_derivative
    (n : nat) (f : R -> R) : R -> R :=
  match n with
  | O => f
  | S k =>
      fun x : R =>
        putnam_1992_b4_total_derivative
          (putnam_1992_b4_iterated_derivative k f) x
  end.

Definition putnam_1992_b4_valid
    (p : putnam_1992_b4_polynomial) : Prop :=
  ~ putnam_1992_b4_zero p /\
  (exists d : nat,
      putnam_1992_b4_degree p d /\
      (d < 1992)%nat) /\
  putnam_1992_b4_coprime_x3_minus_x p.

Definition putnam_1992_b4_pair
    (p f : putnam_1992_b4_polynomial) : Prop :=
  exists g : putnam_1992_b4_polynomial,
    ~ putnam_1992_b4_zero g /\
    forall x : R,
      x <> -1 ->
      x <> 0 ->
      x <> 1 ->
      putnam_1992_b4_eval g x <> 0 ->
      putnam_1992_b4_iterated_derivative 1992
        (fun y : R =>
           putnam_1992_b4_eval p y / (y ^ 3 - y)) x =
      putnam_1992_b4_eval f x / putnam_1992_b4_eval g x.

Definition putnam_1992_b4_solution : nat := 3984%nat.

Theorem putnam_1992_b4 :
  (exists p f : putnam_1992_b4_polynomial,
      putnam_1992_b4_valid p /\
      putnam_1992_b4_pair p f /\
      putnam_1992_b4_degree f putnam_1992_b4_solution) /\
  (forall (p f : putnam_1992_b4_polynomial) (d : nat),
      putnam_1992_b4_valid p ->
      putnam_1992_b4_pair p f ->
      putnam_1992_b4_degree f d ->
      (putnam_1992_b4_solution <= d)%nat).
Admitted.

"HOL-Computational_Algebra.Polynomial"
"HOL-Analysis.Derivative"
begin

definition putnam_1992_b4_solution :: nat where
  "putnam_1992_b4_solution \<equiv> 3984"
(* 3984 *)
theorem putnam_1992_b4:
  fixes valid :: "(real poly) \<Rightarrow> bool"
  and pair :: "(real poly) \<Rightarrow> (real poly) \<Rightarrow> bool"
  and min :: nat
  defines "valid \<equiv> (\<lambda>p::real poly. p \<noteq> 0 \<and> degree p < 1992 \<and> coprime p (monom 1 3 - monom 1 1))"
  and "pair \<equiv> (\<lambda>p f::real poly. \<exists>g::real poly. g \<noteq> 0 \<and>
    (\<forall>x::real. x \<noteq> -1 \<longrightarrow> x \<noteq> 0 \<longrightarrow> x \<noteq> 1 \<longrightarrow> poly g x \<noteq> 0 \<longrightarrow>
      (deriv^^1992) (\<lambda>y::real. poly p y / (y^3 - y)) x = poly f x / poly g x))"
  and "min \<equiv> LEAST fdeg::nat. (\<exists>p f::real poly. valid p \<and> pair p f \<and> fdeg = degree f)"
  shows "min = putnam_1992_b4_solution"
  sorry

end
