;; Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1992_b4:
;; the smallest numerator degree after differentiating p(x)/(x^3-x) 1992
;; times, over all admissible real polynomials p, is 3984. This file contains
;; no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

;; Formal polynomials are coefficient lists in ascending degree order.
;;
;; Put q=x^3-x. For every source polynomial p of degree below 1992, division
;; gives p=h*q+r with deg(h)<1989 and deg(r)<3. The 1992nd derivative of h
;; vanishes, so the source optimization depends exactly on r=a+b*x+c*x^2.
;; Coprimeness with q is equivalent to r being nonzero at -1, 0, and 1.
;;
;; If N_k/q^(k+1) is the kth derivative of r/q away from those three roots,
;; then
;;
;;   N_(k+1) = N_k' * q - (k+1) * N_k * q'.
;;
;; A pair f,g represents the derivative exactly when
;;
;;              f * q^1993 = N_1992 * g.
;;
;; This polynomial identity is equivalent to equality of the rational
;; functions on their common natural domain.
;;
;; The final predicate is universally closed over rational a, b, and c.
;; This is equivalent to the closed real statement, rather than a rational
;; specialization. A failure of the lower bound or root nonvanishing consists
;; of homogeneous rational linear equations in (a,b,c), together with the
;; three rational linear inequations expressing admissibility. Any real point
;; in such a rational linear subspace can be replaced by a rational point
;; avoiding those three hyperplanes. Conversely, every rational failure is a
;; real failure.

(defun putnam-1992-b4-polynomial-p (polynomial)
  (if (consp polynomial)
      (and
       (rationalp (car polynomial))
       (putnam-1992-b4-polynomial-p (cdr polynomial)))
    (equal polynomial nil)))

(defun putnam-1992-b4-polynomial-normalize (polynomial)
  (if (consp polynomial)
      (let ((tail
             (putnam-1992-b4-polynomial-normalize
              (cdr polynomial))))
        (if (and (endp tail)
                 (equal (car polynomial) 0))
            nil
          (cons (car polynomial) tail)))
    nil))

(defun putnam-1992-b4-polynomial-add-raw (left right)
  (cond
   ((endp left) right)
   ((endp right) left)
   (t
    (cons (+ (car left) (car right))
          (putnam-1992-b4-polynomial-add-raw
           (cdr left) (cdr right))))))

(defun putnam-1992-b4-polynomial-add (left right)
  (putnam-1992-b4-polynomial-normalize
   (putnam-1992-b4-polynomial-add-raw left right)))

(defun putnam-1992-b4-polynomial-negate (polynomial)
  (if (consp polynomial)
      (cons (- (car polynomial))
            (putnam-1992-b4-polynomial-negate
             (cdr polynomial)))
    nil))

(defun putnam-1992-b4-polynomial-subtract (left right)
  (putnam-1992-b4-polynomial-add
   left
   (putnam-1992-b4-polynomial-negate right)))

(defun putnam-1992-b4-polynomial-scale (scalar polynomial)
  (if (consp polynomial)
      (cons (* scalar (car polynomial))
            (putnam-1992-b4-polynomial-scale
             scalar (cdr polynomial)))
    nil))

(defun putnam-1992-b4-polynomial-multiply-raw (left right)
  (if (consp left)
      (putnam-1992-b4-polynomial-add
       (putnam-1992-b4-polynomial-scale (car left) right)
       (cons
        0
        (putnam-1992-b4-polynomial-multiply-raw
         (cdr left) right)))
    nil))

(defun putnam-1992-b4-polynomial-multiply (left right)
  (putnam-1992-b4-polynomial-normalize
   (putnam-1992-b4-polynomial-multiply-raw left right)))

(defun putnam-1992-b4-polynomial-power (polynomial exponent)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix exponent)))
  (if (zp exponent)
      (list 1)
    (putnam-1992-b4-polynomial-multiply
     polynomial
     (putnam-1992-b4-polynomial-power
      polynomial (- exponent 1)))))

(defun putnam-1992-b4-polynomial-derivative-aux
    (coefficients multiplier)
  (if (consp coefficients)
      (cons
       (* multiplier (car coefficients))
       (putnam-1992-b4-polynomial-derivative-aux
        (cdr coefficients) (+ multiplier 1)))
    nil))

(defun putnam-1992-b4-polynomial-derivative (polynomial)
  (putnam-1992-b4-polynomial-normalize
   (putnam-1992-b4-polynomial-derivative-aux
    (cdr polynomial) 1)))

(defun putnam-1992-b4-polynomial-evaluate (polynomial x)
  (if (consp polynomial)
      (+ (car polynomial)
         (* x
            (putnam-1992-b4-polynomial-evaluate
             (cdr polynomial) x)))
    0))

(defun putnam-1992-b4-polynomial-degree (polynomial)
  (let ((normalized
         (putnam-1992-b4-polynomial-normalize polynomial)))
    (if (consp normalized)
        (- (len normalized) 1)
      0)))

(defun putnam-1992-b4-q ()
  (list 0 -1 0 1))

(defun putnam-1992-b4-q-derivative ()
  (list -1 0 3))

(defun putnam-1992-b4-numerator-step
    (numerator denominator-power)
  (putnam-1992-b4-polynomial-subtract
   (putnam-1992-b4-polynomial-multiply
    (putnam-1992-b4-polynomial-derivative numerator)
    (putnam-1992-b4-q))
   (putnam-1992-b4-polynomial-scale
    denominator-power
    (putnam-1992-b4-polynomial-multiply
     numerator
     (putnam-1992-b4-q-derivative)))))

(defun putnam-1992-b4-iterated-numerator
    (numerator remaining denominator-power)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix remaining)))
  (if (zp remaining)
      (putnam-1992-b4-polynomial-normalize numerator)
    (putnam-1992-b4-iterated-numerator
     (putnam-1992-b4-numerator-step
      numerator denominator-power)
     (- remaining 1)
     (+ denominator-power 1))))

(defun putnam-1992-b4-root-coprime-p (polynomial)
  (and
   (not
    (equal
     (putnam-1992-b4-polynomial-evaluate polynomial -1)
     0))
   (not
    (equal
     (putnam-1992-b4-polynomial-evaluate polynomial 0)
     0))
   (not
    (equal
     (putnam-1992-b4-polynomial-evaluate polynomial 1)
     0))))

(defun putnam-1992-b4-valid-remainder-p (a b c)
  (and
   (rationalp a)
   (rationalp b)
   (rationalp c)
   (putnam-1992-b4-root-coprime-p (list a b c))))

(defun putnam-1992-b4-representation-p (a b c f g)
  (let* ((numerator
          (putnam-1992-b4-iterated-numerator
           (list a b c) 1992 1))
         (denominator
          (putnam-1992-b4-polynomial-power
           (putnam-1992-b4-q) 1993)))
    (and
     (putnam-1992-b4-polynomial-p f)
     (putnam-1992-b4-polynomial-p g)
     (consp (putnam-1992-b4-polynomial-normalize g))
     (equal
      (putnam-1992-b4-polynomial-multiply f denominator)
      (putnam-1992-b4-polynomial-multiply numerator g)))))

(defun-sk putnam-1992-b4-lower-bound-p (a b c)
  (forall (f g)
    (implies
     (putnam-1992-b4-representation-p a b c f g)
     (<=
      3984
      (putnam-1992-b4-polynomial-degree f)))))

(defun-sk putnam-1992-b4-attainment-exists-p ()
  (exists (a b c f g)
    (and
     (putnam-1992-b4-valid-remainder-p a b c)
     (putnam-1992-b4-representation-p a b c f g)
     (equal
      (putnam-1992-b4-polynomial-degree f)
      3984))))

(defun putnambench-putnam-1992-b4-statement (a b c)
  (and
   (implies
    (putnam-1992-b4-valid-remainder-p a b c)
    (putnam-1992-b4-lower-bound-p a b c))
   (putnam-1992-b4-attainment-exists-p)))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

title: putnam_1992_b4
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1992_b4
-- (putnambench__agda__putnam_1992_b4): the least numerator degree after
-- differentiating p(x)/(x^3-x) 1992 times. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.List using (List; []; _∷_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; _*_)

infix 4 _!=_ _<=N_ _<N_
infixr 3 _and_
infixr 2 _or_

data Bottom : Set where

Not : Set -> Set
Not A =
  A -> Bottom

_!=_ : {A : Set} -> A -> A -> Set
x != y =
  Not (x == y)

record _and_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data _or_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  left  : A -> A or B
  right : B -> A or B

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

data _<=N_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set where
  zero<=N   : {n : Nat} -> zero <=N n
  suc<=sucN : {m n : Nat} -> m <=N n -> suc m <=N suc n

_<N_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set
m <N n =
  suc m <=N n

record CompleteOrderedRealField (R : Set) : Set1 where
  field
    zeroR oneR : R
    add multiply : R -> R -> R
    negate inverse : R -> R
    lessOrEqual : R -> R -> Set
    fromNat : Nat -> R

    one-not-zero :
      oneR != zeroR

    add-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> add x y == add y x
    add-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      add (add x y) z == add x (add y z)
    add-zero :
      (x : R) -> add x zeroR == x
    add-inverse :
      (x : R) -> add x (negate x) == zeroR

    multiply-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> multiply x y == multiply y x
    multiply-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply (multiply x y) z ==
      multiply x (multiply y z)
    multiply-one :
      (x : R) -> multiply x oneR == x
    multiply-zero :
      (x : R) -> multiply x zeroR == zeroR
    distribute :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply x (add y z) ==
      add (multiply x y) (multiply x z)
    inverse-zero :
      inverse zeroR == zeroR
    multiply-inverse :
      (x : R) ->
      x != zeroR ->
      multiply x (inverse x) == oneR

    order-reflexive :
      (x : R) -> lessOrEqual x x
    order-transitive :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y z ->
      lessOrEqual x z
    order-antisymmetric :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y x ->
      x == y
    order-total :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y or lessOrEqual y x
    add-order :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual (add z x) (add z y)
    multiply-nonnegative :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR x ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR y ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR (multiply x y)
    zero-less-than-one :
      lessOrEqual zeroR oneR and zeroR != oneR

    fromNat-zero :
      fromNat zero == zeroR
    fromNat-successor :
      (n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (suc n) == add (fromNat n) oneR
    fromNat-addition :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m + n) == add (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-multiplication :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m * n) == multiply (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-injective :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat m == fromNat n ->
      m == n

    archimedean :
      (x : R) ->
      Exists Nat
        (\ n -> lessOrEqual x (fromNat n))
    least-upper-bound :
      (P : R -> Set) ->
      Exists R P ->
      Exists R
        (\ upper ->
          (x : R) ->
          P x ->
          lessOrEqual x upper) ->
      Exists R
        (\ supremum ->
          ((x : R) ->
            P x ->
            lessOrEqual x supremum)
          and
          ((upper : R) ->
            ((x : R) ->
              P x ->
              lessOrEqual x upper) ->
            lessOrEqual supremum upper))

open CompleteOrderedRealField

subtract :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
subtract reals x y =
  add reals x (negate reals y)

divide :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
divide reals numerator denominator =
  multiply reals numerator (inverse reals denominator)

StrictLess :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
StrictLess reals x y =
  lessOrEqual reals x y and x != y

CloseTo :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
CloseTo reals center radius x =
  StrictLess reals
    (subtract reals center radius)
    x
  and
  StrictLess reals
    x
    (add reals center radius)

DifferenceQuotient :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (R -> R) ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
DifferenceQuotient reals function point x =
  divide reals
    (subtract reals (function x) (function point))
    (subtract reals x point)

DerivativeAt :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (R -> R) ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
DerivativeAt {R} reals function point derivative =
  (epsilon : R) ->
  StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) epsilon ->
  Exists R
    (\ delta ->
      StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) delta
      and
      ((x : R) ->
        CloseTo reals point delta x ->
        x != point ->
        CloseTo reals derivative epsilon
          (DifferenceQuotient reals function point x)))

DerivativeValue :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (R -> R) ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
DerivativeValue {R} reals function point value =
  DerivativeAt reals function point value
  or
  (value == zeroR reals
  and
  Not
    (Exists R
      (\ candidate ->
        DerivativeAt reals function point candidate)))

TotalDerivative :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (R -> R) ->
  (R -> R) ->
  Set
TotalDerivative {R} reals function derivative =
  (x : R) ->
  DerivativeValue reals function x (derivative x)

EqFunction :
  {A B : Set} ->
  (A -> B) ->
  (A -> B) ->
  Set
EqFunction f g =
  (x : _) ->
  f x == g x

IteratedDerivative :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Nat ->
  (R -> R) ->
  (R -> R) ->
  Set
IteratedDerivative reals zero function result =
  EqFunction function result
IteratedDerivative {R = R} reals (suc n) function result =
  Exists (R -> R)
    (\ previous ->
      IteratedDerivative reals n function previous
      and
      TotalDerivative reals previous result)

module Putnam1992B4Statement
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) where

  Polynomial : Set
  Polynomial =
    List R

  coefficient : Polynomial -> Nat -> R
  coefficient [] n =
    zeroR reals
  coefficient (c ∷ coefficients) zero =
    c
  coefficient (c ∷ coefficients) (suc n) =
    coefficient coefficients n

  PolynomialEqual :
    Polynomial ->
    Polynomial ->
    Set
  PolynomialEqual p q =
    (n : Nat) ->
    coefficient p n == coefficient q n

  zeroPolynomial : Polynomial
  zeroPolynomial =
    []

  onePolynomial : Polynomial
  onePolynomial =
    oneR reals ∷ []

  X : Polynomial
  X =
    zeroR reals ∷ oneR reals ∷ []

  addPolynomial :
    Polynomial ->
    Polynomial ->
    Polynomial
  addPolynomial [] q =
    q
  addPolynomial p [] =
    p
  addPolynomial (a ∷ p) (b ∷ q) =
    add reals a b ∷ addPolynomial p q

  negatePolynomial :
    Polynomial ->
    Polynomial
  negatePolynomial [] =
    []
  negatePolynomial (a ∷ p) =
    negate reals a ∷ negatePolynomial p

  subtractPolynomial :
    Polynomial ->
    Polynomial ->
    Polynomial
  subtractPolynomial p q =
    addPolynomial p (negatePolynomial q)

  scalePolynomial :
    R ->
    Polynomial ->
    Polynomial
  scalePolynomial scalar [] =
    []
  scalePolynomial scalar (a ∷ p) =
    multiply reals scalar a ∷ scalePolynomial scalar p

  multiplyPolynomial :
    Polynomial ->
    Polynomial ->
    Polynomial
  multiplyPolynomial [] q =
    []
  multiplyPolynomial (a ∷ p) q =
    addPolynomial
      (scalePolynomial a q)
      (zeroR reals ∷ multiplyPolynomial p q)

  powerPolynomial :
    Polynomial ->
    Nat ->
    Polynomial
  powerPolynomial p zero =
    onePolynomial
  powerPolynomial p (suc n) =
    multiplyPolynomial p (powerPolynomial p n)

  cubicMinusX : Polynomial
  cubicMinusX =
    subtractPolynomial (powerPolynomial X 3) X

  evaluatePolynomial :
    Polynomial ->
    R ->
    R
  evaluatePolynomial [] x =
    zeroR reals
  evaluatePolynomial (a ∷ p) x =
    add reals a
      (multiply reals x (evaluatePolynomial p x))

  PolynomialNonzero :
    Polynomial ->
    Set
  PolynomialNonzero p =
    Not (PolynomialEqual p zeroPolynomial)

  Degree :
    Polynomial ->
    Nat ->
    Set
  Degree p n =
    (PolynomialEqual p zeroPolynomial and n == zero)
    or
    (coefficient p n != zeroR reals
    and
    ((k : Nat) ->
      n <N k ->
      coefficient p k == zeroR reals))

  Divides :
    Polynomial ->
    Polynomial ->
    Set
  Divides divisor dividend =
    Exists Polynomial
      (\ quotient ->
        PolynomialEqual dividend
          (multiplyPolynomial divisor quotient))

  Coprime :
    Polynomial ->
    Polynomial ->
    Set
  Coprime p q =
    (commonDivisor : Polynomial) ->
    Divides commonDivisor p ->
    Divides commonDivisor q ->
    Degree commonDivisor zero

  Valid :
    Polynomial ->
    Set
  Valid p =
    PolynomialNonzero p
    and
    Exists Nat
      (\ degree ->
        Degree p degree
        and
        degree <N 1992)
    and
    Coprime p cubicMinusX

  cubicDenominatorValue :
    R ->
    R
  cubicDenominatorValue x =
    subtract reals
      (multiply reals x (multiply reals x x))
      x

  initialFunction :
    Polynomial ->
    R ->
    R
  initialFunction p x =
    divide reals
      (evaluatePolynomial p x)
      (cubicDenominatorValue x)

  rationalFunction :
    Polynomial ->
    Polynomial ->
    R ->
    R
  rationalFunction numerator denominator x =
    divide reals
      (evaluatePolynomial numerator x)
      (evaluatePolynomial denominator x)

  Pair :
    Polynomial ->
    Polynomial ->
    Set
  Pair p f =
    Exists Polynomial
      (\ g ->
        PolynomialNonzero g
        and
        Exists (R -> R)
          (\ derivative1992 ->
            IteratedDerivative reals 1992
              (initialFunction p)
              derivative1992
            and
            ((x : R) ->
              x != negate reals (oneR reals) ->
              x != zeroR reals ->
              x != oneR reals ->
              evaluatePolynomial g x != zeroR reals ->
              derivative1992 x == rationalFunction f g x)))

  AttainableDegree :
    Nat ->
    Set
  AttainableDegree degree =
    Exists Polynomial
      (\ p ->
        Exists Polynomial
          (\ f ->
            Valid p
            and
            Pair p f
            and
            Degree f degree))

  IsLeast :
    (Nat -> Set) ->
    Nat ->
    Set
  IsLeast property least =
    property least
    and
    ((candidate : Nat) ->
      property candidate ->
      least <=N candidate)

  proposition : Set
  proposition =
    IsLeast AttainableDegree 3984

putnam-1992-b4 : Set1
putnam-1992-b4 =
  (R : Set) ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) ->
  Putnam1992B4Statement.proposition reals

(*
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1992_b4:
  the smallest possible numerator degree after differentiating the specified
  rational function 1992 times is 3984. This file contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open arithmeticTheory realTheory polyTheory limTheory;

val putnam_1992_b4 =
  ``let valid =
      \p : real list.
        poly p <> poly [] /\
        degree p < 1992 /\
        !d : real list.
          d poly_divides p /\
          d poly_divides ([0; ~1; 0; 1] : real list)
          ==>
          degree d = 0
    in
    let pair =
      \p f : real list.
        ?g : real list.
          poly g <> poly [] /\
          !x : real.
            x <> ~1 /\ x <> 0 /\ x <> 1 /\ poly g x <> 0
            ==>
            diffn 1992
              (\y : real. poly p y / (y pow 3 - y)) x =
            poly f x / poly g x
    in
      (?p f : real list.
         valid p /\
         pair p f /\
         degree f = 3984) /\
      (!p f : real list.
         valid p /\
         pair p f
         ==>
         3984 <= degree f)``;

$(
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact
  putnam_1992_b4: the least possible numerator degree after differentiating
  p(x)/(x^3-x) 1992 times, for the specified coprime real polynomials, is
  3984. Derivatives are taken on the rational function's natural domain,
  excluding the poles -1, 0, and 1, and equality with f/g is required
  wherever both rational functions are defined. This file contains no proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  P92B4Poly is set.mm's finite-support univariate polynomial ring over the
  reals, P92B4Q is x^3-x in that ring, and P92B4Domain is its natural real
  domain. P92B4Valid says that p is nonzero, has no coefficient in degree
  1992 or above, and is coprime to P92B4Q. Coprimality is expressed by the
  equivalent Bezout identity over RR[x].

  Set.mm's native RR Dn operator iterates the partial real derivative. The
  domain condition requires the source quotient to be 1992-times
  differentiable at every point of P92B4Domain. P92B4Pair compares that
  derivative with f/g exactly where both rational functions are defined:
  x lies in P92B4Domain and g(x) is nonzero. The denominator g must also be a
  nonzero polynomial. No arbitrary totalized values are imposed at poles.

  P92B4Degree(f,k) says that k is the exact degree of the nonzero polynomial
  f. The final assertion is the explicit IsLeast characterization at the
  ground-truth solution annotation 3984: that degree is attained, and it is
  no greater than any other attainable numerator degree. All declarations
  are unproved $a statement encodings; this database contains no $p proof
  declaration.
$)

$c P92B4Poly P92B4Q P92B4Domain P92B4Valid P92B4Pair P92B4Degree $.

p92b4-poly-syntax $a class P92B4Poly $.
p92b4-q-syntax $a class P92B4Q $.
p92b4-domain-syntax $a class P92B4Domain $.
p92b4-valid-syntax $a wff ( P92B4Valid p ) $.
p92b4-pair-syntax $a wff ( P92B4Pair p f ) $.
p92b4-degree-syntax $a wff ( P92B4Degree f k ) $.

p92b4-poly-definition $a |- P92B4Poly =
  ( Base ` ( Poly1 ` RRfld ) ) $.

p92b4-q-definition $a |- P92B4Q =
  (
    (
      3
      ( .g ` ( mulGrp ` ( Poly1 ` RRfld ) ) )
      ( var1 ` RRfld )
    )
    ( -g ` ( Poly1 ` RRfld ) )
    ( var1 ` RRfld )
  ) $.

p92b4-domain-definition $a |- P92B4Domain =
  ( RR \ { -u 1 , 0 , 1 } ) $.

${
  $d a p $.
  $d b p $.
  $d j p $.

  p92b4-valid-definition $a |- (
    ( P92B4Valid p )
    <->
    (
      p =/= ( 0g ` ( Poly1 ` RRfld ) )
      /\
      (
        A. j e. NN0
          (
            ; ; ; 1 9 9 2 <_ j
            ->
            ( ( coe1 ` p ) ` j ) = 0
          )
        /\
        E. a e. P92B4Poly E. b e. P92B4Poly
          (
            (
              (
                a
                ( .r ` ( Poly1 ` RRfld ) )
                p
              )
              ( +g ` ( Poly1 ` RRfld ) )
              (
                b
                ( .r ` ( Poly1 ` RRfld ) )
                P92B4Q
              )
            )
            =
            ( 1r ` ( Poly1 ` RRfld ) )
          )
      )
    )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d f g $.
  $d f x $.
  $d g p $.
  $d g x $.
  $d p x $.

  p92b4-pair-definition $a |- (
    ( P92B4Pair p f )
    <->
    E. g e. P92B4Poly
      (
        g =/= ( 0g ` ( Poly1 ` RRfld ) )
        /\
        (
          P92B4Domain
          C_
          dom
          (
            (
              RR
              Dn
              (
                x e. P92B4Domain |->
                  (
                    ( ( ( eval1 ` RRfld ) ` p ) ` x )
                    /
                    ( ( x ^ 3 ) - x )
                  )
              )
            )
            `
            ; ; ; 1 9 9 2
          )
          /\
          A. x e. P92B4Domain
            (
              ( ( ( eval1 ` RRfld ) ` g ) ` x ) =/= 0
              ->
              (
                (
                  (
                    RR
                    Dn
                    (
                      x e. P92B4Domain |->
                        (
                          ( ( ( eval1 ` RRfld ) ` p ) ` x )
                          /
                          ( ( x ^ 3 ) - x )
                        )
                    )
                  )
                  `
                  ; ; ; 1 9 9 2
                )
                `
                x
              )
              =
              (
                ( ( ( eval1 ` RRfld ) ` f ) ` x )
                /
                ( ( ( eval1 ` RRfld ) ` g ) ` x )
              )
            )
        )
      )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d f j $.
  $d f k $.
  $d j k $.

  p92b4-degree-definition $a |- (
    ( P92B4Degree f k )
    <->
    (
      ( ( coe1 ` f ) ` k ) =/= 0
      /\
      A. j e. NN0
        (
          k < j
          ->
          ( ( coe1 ` f ) ` j ) = 0
        )
    )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d f k $.
  $d k p $.

  putnambench-putnam-1992-b4 $a |- (
    E. p e. P92B4Poly E. f e. P92B4Poly
      (
        ( P92B4Valid p )
        /\
        (
          ( P92B4Pair p f )
          /\
          ( P92B4Degree f ; ; ; 3 9 8 4 )
        )
      )
    /\
    A. k e. NN0
      (
        E. p e. P92B4Poly E. f e. P92B4Poly
          (
            ( P92B4Valid p )
            /\
            (
              ( P92B4Pair p f )
              /\
              ( P92B4Degree f k )

        ; ; ; 3 9 8 4 <_ k

title: putnam_1992_b4
content:
% Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench artifact putnam_1992_b4:
% the least possible numerator degree after differentiating 1992 times a
% rational function p(x)/(x^3-x), under the stated polynomial coprimality
% and degree conditions, is 3984. This file contains no proof.

putnam_1992_b4: THEORY
BEGIN
  coefficient_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> real]
  real_function: TYPE = [real -> real]

  support_bounded(
      coefficients: coefficient_sequence,
      bound: nat): bool =
    FORALL (index: nat):
      bound < index IMPLIES coefficients(index) = 0

  is_polynomial(coefficients: coefficient_sequence): bool =
    EXISTS (bound: nat):
      support_bounded(coefficients, bound)

  polynomial_bound(
      coefficients: coefficient_sequence): nat =
    IF is_polynomial(coefficients) THEN
      epsilon(
        LAMBDA (bound: nat):
          support_bounded(coefficients, bound))
    ELSE
      0
    ENDIF

  polynomial_partial_value(
      coefficients: coefficient_sequence,
      x: real,
      count: nat): RECURSIVE real =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      LET index: nat = count - 1 IN
        polynomial_partial_value(
          coefficients, x, count - 1)
          + coefficients(index) * x ^ index
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  polynomial_value(
      coefficients: coefficient_sequence,
      x: real): real =
    polynomial_partial_value(
      coefficients,
      x,
      polynomial_bound(coefficients) + 1)

  has_degree(
      coefficients: coefficient_sequence,
      degree: nat): bool =
    coefficients(degree) /= 0
      AND support_bounded(coefficients, degree)

  nonzero_polynomial(
      coefficients: coefficient_sequence): bool =
    is_polynomial(coefficients)
      AND EXISTS (degree: nat):
        has_degree(coefficients, degree)

  coprime_to_x_cubed_minus_x(
      coefficients: coefficient_sequence): bool =
    polynomial_value(coefficients, -1) /= 0
      AND polynomial_value(coefficients, 0) /= 0
      AND polynomial_value(coefficients, 1) /= 0

  valid_polynomial(
      coefficients: coefficient_sequence): bool =
    (EXISTS (degree: nat):
      degree < 1992
        AND has_degree(coefficients, degree))
      AND coprime_to_x_cubed_minus_x(coefficients)

  safe_div(numerator, denominator: real): real =
    IF denominator = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      numerator / denominator
    ENDIF

  has_derivative_at(
      f: real_function,
      derivative, x: real): bool =
    FORALL (epsilon_value: posreal):
      EXISTS (delta: posreal):
        FORALL (h: real):
          (h /= 0 AND abs(h) < delta)
            IMPLIES
              abs(f(x + h) - f(x) - derivative * h)
                < epsilon_value * abs(h)

  differentiable_at(f: real_function, x: real): bool =
    EXISTS (derivative: real):
      has_derivative_at(f, derivative, x)

  derivative_value(f: real_function, x: real): real =
    IF differentiable_at(f, x) THEN
      epsilon(
        LAMBDA (derivative: real):
          has_derivative_at(f, derivative, x))
    ELSE
      0
    ENDIF

  derivative_function(f: real_function): real_function =
    LAMBDA (x: real):
      derivative_value(f, x)

  iterated_derivative(
      f: real_function,
      order: nat): RECURSIVE real_function =
    IF order = 0 THEN
      f
    ELSE
      derivative_function(
        iterated_derivative(f, order - 1))
    ENDIF
  MEASURE order

  forms_numerator_pair(
      p, f: coefficient_sequence): bool =
    is_polynomial(p)
      AND is_polynomial(f)
      AND EXISTS (g: coefficient_sequence):
        nonzero_polynomial(g)
          AND FORALL (x: real):
            (x /= -1
              AND x /= 0
              AND x /= 1
              AND polynomial_value(g, x) /= 0)
            IMPLIES
              iterated_derivative(
                LAMBDA (y: real):
                  safe_div(
                    polynomial_value(p, y),
                    y ^ 3 - y),
                1992)(x)
                =
              safe_div(
                polynomial_value(f, x),
                polynomial_value(g, x))

  possible_numerator_degree(degree: nat): bool =
    EXISTS (p, f: coefficient_sequence):
      valid_polynomial(p)
        AND forms_numerator_pair(p, f)
        AND has_degree(f, degree)

  putnam_1992_b4_solution: nat = 3984

  putnam_1992_b4: bool =
    possible_numerator_degree(putnam_1992_b4_solution)
      AND FORALL (degree: nat):
        degree < putnam_1992_b4_solution IMPLIES
          NOT possible_numerator_degree(degree)
END putnam_1992_b4

content:
(* Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1992_b5:
   boundedness of the factorial-normalized determinants of the prescribed
   rational matrices; this file contains no proof. *)

From Stdlib Require Import QArith Qabs Lists.List Arith.PeanoNat Arith.Factorial.

Import ListNotations.
Open Scope Q_scope.

Fixpoint putnam_1992_b5_sum (xs : list Q) : Q :=
  match xs with
  | [] => 0
  | x :: rest => x + putnam_1992_b5_sum rest
  end.

Definition putnam_1992_b5_delete_nth
    {A : Type} (j : nat) (xs : list A) : list A :=
  firstn j xs ++ skipn (S j) xs.

Definition putnam_1992_b5_cofactor_sign (j : nat) : Q :=
  if Nat.even j then 1 else -1.

Fixpoint putnam_1992_b5_det
    (n : nat) (M : list (list Q)) {struct n} : Q :=
  match n with
  | O => 1
  | S k =>
      match M with
      | [] => 0
      | row :: rows =>
          putnam_1992_b5_sum
            (map
              (fun j : nat =>
                putnam_1992_b5_cofactor_sign j *
                nth j row 0 *
                putnam_1992_b5_det k
                  (map (putnam_1992_b5_delete_nth j) rows))
              (seq 0 (S k)))
      end
  end.

Definition putnam_1992_b5_matrix (n : nat) : list (list Q) :=
  map
    (fun i : nat =>
      map
        (fun j : nat =>
          if Nat.eqb i j
          then inject_Z (Z.of_nat ((i + 3)%nat))
          else 1)
        (seq 0 n))
    (seq 0 n).

Definition putnam_1992_b5_D (n : nat) : Q :=
  putnam_1992_b5_det
    (n - 1)%nat
    (putnam_1992_b5_matrix (n - 1)%nat).

Definition putnam_1992_b5_bounded : Prop :=
  exists r : Q,
    forall x : Q,
      (exists n : nat,
        (2 <= n)%nat /\
        putnam_1992_b5_D n /
          inject_Z (Z.of_nat (fact n)) = x) ->
      Qabs x <= r.

Definition putnam_1992_b5_solution : Prop := False.

Theorem putnam_1992_b5 :
  putnam_1992_b5_solution <-> putnam_1992_b5_bounded.
Admitted.

(*
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1992_b5:
  boundedness of the rational sequence of factorial-normalized determinants
  with diagonal entries 3 through n+1 and all off-diagonal entries 1. This
  file contains no proof.
*)

let statement =
  `let ndet =
     \(A:num->num->real) n.
       sum {p:num->num |
              BIJ p (0..n-1) (0..n-1) /\
              (!i:num. ~(i IN 0..n-1) ==> p i = i)}
           (\p.
              (if EVEN
                    (CARD
                      {(i,j) |
                         i < n /\ j < n /\ i < j /\ p j < p i})
               then &1
               else -- &1) *
              product (0..n-1) (\i. A i (p i))) in
   let D =
     \n:num.
       ndet
         (\i j:num. if i = j then &(i + 3) else &1)
         (n - 1) in
   let putnam_1992_b5_solution = F in
   ((?r:real.
       !n:num.
         2 <= n
         ==> abs (D n / &(FACT n)) <= r)
    <=> putnam_1992_b5_solution)`;;

title: putnam_1992_b5

;; Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1992_b5:
;; the determinant ratios D_n/n! for the specified (n-1)-square matrices are
;; unbounded, so the boundedness question has answer False. This file contains
;; no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))

;; D_n is represented by the exact Leibniz determinant over all permutations
;; of the columns 0,...,n-2. The entry at (i,j) is i+3 on the diagonal and 1
;; off the diagonal, exactly as in both source statements.

(defun putnam-1992-b5-indices (count)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix count)))
  (if (zp count)
      nil
    (cons (- count 1)
          (putnam-1992-b5-indices (- count 1)))))

(defun putnam-1992-b5-prepend-each (value lists)
  (if (endp lists)
      nil
    (cons
     (cons value (car lists))
     (putnam-1992-b5-prepend-each value (cdr lists)))))

(defun putnam-1992-b5-insert-everywhere (value values)
  (if (endp values)
      (list (list value))
    (cons
     (cons value values)
     (putnam-1992-b5-prepend-each
      (car values)
      (putnam-1992-b5-insert-everywhere
       value (cdr values))))))

(defun putnam-1992-b5-insert-into-permutations
    (value permutations)
  (if (endp permutations)
      nil
    (append
     (putnam-1992-b5-insert-everywhere
      value (car permutations))
     (putnam-1992-b5-insert-into-permutations
      value (cdr permutations)))))

(defun putnam-1992-b5-permutations (values)
  (if (endp values)
      (list nil)
    (putnam-1992-b5-insert-into-permutations
     (car values)
     (putnam-1992-b5-permutations (cdr values)))))

(defun putnam-1992-b5-count-smaller (value values)
  (if (endp values)
      0
    (+ (if (< (car values) value) 1 0)
       (putnam-1992-b5-count-smaller value (cdr values)))))

(defun putnam-1992-b5-inversion-count (permutation)
  (if (endp permutation)
      0
    (+ (putnam-1992-b5-count-smaller
        (car permutation) (cdr permutation))
       (putnam-1992-b5-inversion-count
        (cdr permutation)))))

(defun putnam-1992-b5-permutation-sign (permutation)
  (if (equal
       (mod (putnam-1992-b5-inversion-count permutation) 2)
       0)
      1
    -1))

(defun putnam-1992-b5-entry (row column)
  (if (equal row column)
      (+ row 3)
    1))

(defun putnam-1992-b5-determinant-product
    (row permutation)
  (if (endp permutation)
      1
    (* (putnam-1992-b5-entry row (car permutation))
       (putnam-1992-b5-determinant-product
        (+ row 1) (cdr permutation)))))

(defun putnam-1992-b5-determinant-sum (permutations)
  (if (endp permutations)
      0
    (+ (* (putnam-1992-b5-permutation-sign
           (car permutations))
          (putnam-1992-b5-determinant-product
           0 (car permutations)))
       (putnam-1992-b5-determinant-sum
        (cdr permutations)))))

(defun putnam-1992-b5-determinant (n)
  (putnam-1992-b5-determinant-sum
   (putnam-1992-b5-permutations
    (putnam-1992-b5-indices (- n 1)))))

(defun putnam-1992-b5-factorial (n)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix n)))
  (if (zp n)
      1
    (* n (putnam-1992-b5-factorial (- n 1)))))

(defun putnam-1992-b5-exceeds-bound-p (bound n)
  (and
   (natp n)
   (<= 2 n)
   (< bound
      (abs
       (/ (putnam-1992-b5-determinant n)
          (putnam-1992-b5-factorial n))))))

;; The annotated answer is False. Negating boundedness directly says that
;; every rational bound is exceeded in absolute value by some source term.
(defun-sk putnam-1992-b5-counterexample-exists-p (bound)
  (exists (n)
    (putnam-1992-b5-exceeds-bound-p bound n)))

(defun putnambench-putnam-1992-b5-statement (bound)
  (implies
   (rationalp bound)
   (putnam-1992-b5-counterexample-exists-p bound)))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

title: putnam_1992_b5
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1992_b5
-- (putnambench__agda__putnam_1992_b5): the rational sequence obtained by
-- dividing the prescribed determinants by n factorial is unbounded. This file
-- contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module Putnam1992B5 where

open import Agda.Builtin.Bool using (Bool; false; true)
open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Int using (Int; pos; negsuc)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; _*_)

infix 4 _!=_ _<=N_
infixr 3 _and_
infixr 2 _or_

data Bottom : Set where

Not : Set -> Set
Not A =
  A -> Bottom

_!=_ : {A : Set} -> A -> A -> Set
x != y =
  Not (x == y)

record _and_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data _or_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  left  : A -> A or B
  right : B -> A or B

record Iff (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor equivalence
  field
    forward  : A -> B
    backward : B -> A

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

data _<=N_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set where
  zero<=N   : {n : Nat} -> zero <=N n
  suc<=sucN : {m n : Nat} -> m <=N n -> suc m <=N suc n

record RationalField (Q : Set) : Set1 where
  field
    zeroQ oneQ : Q
    add multiply : Q -> Q -> Q
    negate inverse : Q -> Q
    lessOrEqual : Q -> Q -> Set
    fromNat : Nat -> Q
    fromInt : Int -> Q

    one-not-zero :
      oneQ != zeroQ

    add-commutative :
      (x y : Q) -> add x y == add y x
    add-associative :
      (x y z : Q) ->
      add (add x y) z == add x (add y z)
    add-zero :
      (x : Q) -> add x zeroQ == x
    add-inverse :
      (x : Q) -> add x (negate x) == zeroQ

    multiply-commutative :
      (x y : Q) -> multiply x y == multiply y x
    multiply-associative :
      (x y z : Q) ->
      multiply (multiply x y) z ==
      multiply x (multiply y z)
    multiply-one :
      (x : Q) -> multiply x oneQ == x
    multiply-zero :
      (x : Q) -> multiply x zeroQ == zeroQ
    distribute :
      (x y z : Q) ->
      multiply x (add y z) ==
      add (multiply x y) (multiply x z)
    inverse-zero :
      inverse zeroQ == zeroQ
    multiply-inverse :
      (x : Q) ->
      x != zeroQ ->
      multiply x (inverse x) == oneQ

    order-reflexive :
      (x : Q) -> lessOrEqual x x
    order-transitive :
      (x y z : Q) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y z ->
      lessOrEqual x z
    order-antisymmetric :
      (x y : Q) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y x ->
      x == y
    order-total :
      (x y : Q) ->
      lessOrEqual x y or lessOrEqual y x
    add-order :
      (x y z : Q) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual (add z x) (add z y)
    multiply-nonnegative :
      (x y : Q) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroQ x ->
      lessOrEqual zeroQ y ->
      lessOrEqual zeroQ (multiply x y)
    zero-less-than-one :
      lessOrEqual zeroQ oneQ and zeroQ != oneQ

    fromNat-zero :
      fromNat zero == zeroQ
    fromNat-successor :
      (n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (suc n) == add (fromNat n) oneQ
    fromNat-addition :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m + n) == add (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-multiplication :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m * n) == multiply (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-injective :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat m == fromNat n ->
      m == n

    fromInt-nonnegative :
      (n : Nat) ->
      fromInt (pos n) == fromNat n
    fromInt-negative :
      (n : Nat) ->
      fromInt (negsuc n) == negate (fromNat (suc n))

    every-element-is-ratio :
      (x : Q) ->
      Exists Int
        (\ numerator ->
          Exists Nat
            (\ denominator-minus-one ->
              x ==
              multiply
                (fromInt numerator)
                (inverse
                  (fromNat (suc denominator-minus-one)))))

open RationalField

divide :
  {Q : Set} ->
  RationalField Q ->
  Q ->
  Q ->
  Q
divide rationals x y =
  multiply rationals x (inverse rationals y)

data Fin : Nat -> Set where
  fzero : {n : Nat} -> Fin (suc n)
  fsuc  : {n : Nat} -> Fin n -> Fin (suc n)

toNat : {n : Nat} -> Fin n -> Nat
toNat fzero =
  zero
toNat (fsuc i) =
  suc (toNat i)

sameFin : {n : Nat} -> Fin n -> Fin n -> Bool
sameFin fzero fzero =
  true
sameFin fzero (fsuc j) =
  false
sameFin (fsuc i) fzero =
  false
sameFin (fsuc i) (fsuc j) =
  sameFin i j

ifBool : {A : Set} -> Bool -> A -> A -> A
ifBool true whenTrue whenFalse =
  whenTrue
ifBool false whenTrue whenFalse =
  whenFalse

predecessor : Nat -> Nat
predecessor zero =
  zero
predecessor (suc n) =
  n

Matrix : Set -> Nat -> Nat -> Set
Matrix Q rows columns =
  Fin rows -> Fin columns -> Q

sumFin :
  {Q : Set} ->
  RationalField Q ->
  {n : Nat} ->
  (Fin n -> Q) ->
  Q
sumFin rationals {zero} term =
  zeroQ rationals
sumFin rationals {suc n} term =
  add rationals
    (term fzero)
    (sumFin rationals (\ i -> term (fsuc i)))

skip :
  {n : Nat} ->
  Fin (suc n) ->
  Fin n ->
  Fin (suc n)
skip {zero} removed ()
skip {suc n} fzero i =
  fsuc i
skip {suc n} (fsuc removed) fzero =
  fzero
skip {suc n} (fsuc removed) (fsuc i) =
  fsuc (skip removed i)

firstRowMinor :
  {Q : Set} {n : Nat} ->
  Matrix Q (suc n) (suc n) ->
  Fin (suc n) ->
  Matrix Q n n
firstRowMinor A removedColumn i j =
  A (fsuc i) (skip removedColumn j)

alternatingSign :
  {Q : Set} ->
  RationalField Q ->
  {n : Nat} ->
  Fin n ->
  Q
alternatingSign rationals fzero =
  oneQ rationals
alternatingSign rationals (fsuc i) =
  negate rationals (alternatingSign rationals i)

determinant :
  {Q : Set} ->
  RationalField Q ->
  {n : Nat} ->
  Matrix Q n n ->
  Q
determinant rationals {zero} A =
  oneQ rationals
determinant rationals {suc n} A =
  sumFin rationals
    (\ column ->
      multiply rationals
        (alternatingSign rationals column)
        (multiply rationals
          (A fzero column)
          (determinant rationals (firstRowMinor A column))))

three : Nat
three =
  suc (suc (suc zero))

two : Nat
two =
  suc (suc zero)

prescribedMatrix :
  {Q : Set} ->
  RationalField Q ->
  (n : Nat) ->
  Matrix Q (predecessor n) (predecessor n)
prescribedMatrix rationals n i j =
  ifBool
    (sameFin i j)
    (fromNat rationals (toNat i + three))
    (oneQ rationals)

factorial : Nat -> Nat
factorial zero =
  suc zero
factorial (suc n) =
  suc n * factorial n

NormalizedDeterminant :
  {Q : Set} ->
  RationalField Q ->
  (Nat -> Q) ->
  Nat ->
  Q
NormalizedDeterminant rationals D n =
  divide rationals
    (D n)
    (fromNat rationals (factorial n))

AbsoluteValueAtMost :
  {Q : Set} ->
  RationalField Q ->
  Q ->
  Q ->
  Set
AbsoluteValueAtMost rationals x bound =
  lessOrEqual rationals (negate rationals x) bound
  and
  lessOrEqual rationals x bound

BoundedNormalizedDeterminants :
  {Q : Set} ->
  RationalField Q ->
  (Nat -> Q) ->
  Set
BoundedNormalizedDeterminants rationals D =
  Exists _
    (\ bound ->
      (n : Nat) ->
      two <=N n ->
      AbsoluteValueAtMost rationals
        (NormalizedDeterminant rationals D n)
        bound)

putnam-1992-b5-solution : Set
putnam-1992-b5-solution =
  Bottom

putnam-1992-b5 : Set1
putnam-1992-b5 =
  (Q : Set) ->
  (rationals : RationalField Q) ->
  (D : Nat -> Q) ->
  ((n : Nat) ->
    D n ==
    determinant rationals (prescribedMatrix rationals n)) ->
  Iff
    (BoundedNormalizedDeterminants rationals D)
    putnam-1992-b5-solution

(*
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1992_b5:
  whether the factorial-normalized determinants of the specified growing
  diagonal matrices form a bounded sequence. This file contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open arithmeticTheory listTheory rich_listTheory sortingTheory;
open pred_setTheory realTheory real_sigmaTheory;

val putnam_1992_b5 =
  ``!D : num -> real.
      (!n : num.
         D n =
         SIGMA
           (\p : num list.
              (-1 : real) pow
                CARD
                  {ij : num # num |
                     FST ij < SND ij /\
                     SND ij < n - 1 /\
                     EL (SND ij) p < EL (FST ij) p} *
              REAL_PROD_IMAGE
                (\i : num.
                   if i = EL i p then &(i + 3) else 1)
                (count (n - 1)))
           {p : num list | PERM p (GENLIST I (n - 1))})
      ==>
      let putnam_1992_b5_solution = F
      in
        ((?B : real.
            !n : num.
              2 <= n
              ==>
              abs (D n / &(FACT n)) <= B)
         <=>
         putnam_1992_b5_solution)``;

content:
$(
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact
  putnam_1992_b5: boundedness of the rational sequence obtained by dividing
  the determinant of the specified variable-size matrix by n factorial,
  identified with the source's solution proposition. This file contains no
  proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  For n in NN0, 0 ..^ (n - 1) is the (n-1)-element carrier corresponding
  to Fin (n - 1). The binary map has entry i + 3 on the diagonal and 1 off
  the diagonal, and maDet over RRfld is its determinant. Although maDet is
  taken over the real field, every entry is rational and D is required to be
  QQ-valued, so this is exactly the rational determinant in the Lean source
  and the integer determinant coerced to QQ in the Isabelle source.

  The internal rational witness r and the universal quantification over all
  n at least 2 state boundedness of the full displayed set, without imposing
  a finite carrier or choosing a bound externally. The resolved answer is
  False, so the final biconditional asserts that this boundedness proposition
  is false. The declaration is an unproved $a statement encoding, and this
  database contains no $p proof statement.
$)

${
  $d d i j n r $.

  putnambench-putnam-1992-b5 $a |-
    A. d e. ( QQ ^m NN0 )
      (
        A. n e. NN0
          ( d ` n )
          =
          (
            (
              ( ( 0 ..^ ( n - 1 ) ) maDet RRfld )
              `
              (
                i e. ( 0 ..^ ( n - 1 ) ) ,
                j e. ( 0 ..^ ( n - 1 ) ) |->
                  if ( i = j , ( i + 3 ) , 1 )
              )
            )
          )
        ->
        (
          F.
          <->
          E. r e. QQ
            A. n e. NN0
              (
                2 <_ n
                ->
                (
                  abs
                  `
                  (
                    ( d ` n )
                    /
                    ( ! ` n )
                  )
                )
                <_
                r
              )
        )
      )
  $.
$}

title: putnam_1992_b5
content:
% Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1992_b5:
% whether the rational sequence obtained by dividing the stated determinants
% by n factorial is bounded. This file contains no proof.

putnam_1992_b5: THEORY
BEGIN
  rational_matrix: TYPE = [nat, nat -> rat]
  rational_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> rat]

  nat_predecessor(n: nat): nat =
    IF n = 0 THEN 0 ELSE n - 1 ENDIF

  safe_div(numerator, denominator: rat): rat =
    IF denominator = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      numerator / denominator
    ENDIF

  quotient_aux(
      numerator, denominator, fuel: nat): RECURSIVE nat =
    IF fuel = 0
        OR denominator = 0
        OR numerator < denominator THEN
      0
    ELSE
      1
        + quotient_aux(
            numerator - denominator,
            denominator,
            fuel - 1)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE fuel

  remainder_aux(
      numerator, denominator, fuel: nat): RECURSIVE nat =
    IF fuel = 0
        OR denominator = 0
        OR numerator < denominator THEN
      numerator
    ELSE
      remainder_aux(
        numerator - denominator,
        denominator,
        fuel - 1)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE fuel

  safe_ndiv(numerator, denominator: nat): nat =
    quotient_aux(
      numerator,
      denominator,
      numerator + 1)

  safe_mod(numerator, denominator: nat): nat =
    IF denominator = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      remainder_aux(
        numerator,
        denominator,
        numerator + 1)
    ENDIF

  function_code_count(size: nat): nat =
    IF size = 0 THEN 1 ELSE size ^ size ENDIF

  permutation_entry(code, row, size: nat): nat =
    IF size = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      safe_mod(safe_ndiv(code, size ^ row), size)
    ENDIF

  permutation_code(code, size: nat): bool =
    code < function_code_count(size)
      AND (FORALL (row_1, row_2: nat):
        (row_1 < size
          AND row_2 < size
          AND permutation_entry(code, row_1, size)
            = permutation_entry(code, row_2, size))
        IMPLIES row_1 = row_2)

  pair_row(pair, size: nat): nat =
    safe_ndiv(pair, size)

  pair_column(pair, size: nat): nat =
    safe_mod(pair, size)

  inversion_at(code, pair, size: nat): bool =
    pair_row(pair, size) < size
      AND pair_column(pair, size) < size
      AND pair_row(pair, size) < pair_column(pair, size)
      AND permutation_entry(code, pair_row(pair, size), size)
        > permutation_entry(code, pair_column(pair, size), size)

  count_true(
      property: [nat -> bool],
      count: nat): RECURSIVE nat =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      count_true(property, count - 1)
        + IF property(count - 1) THEN 1 ELSE 0 ENDIF
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  inversion_count(code, size: nat): nat =
    count_true(
      (LAMBDA (pair: nat): inversion_at(code, pair, size)),
      size * size)

  permutation_sign(code, size: nat): rat =
    IF mod(inversion_count(code, size), 2) = 0 THEN
      1
    ELSE
      -1
    ENDIF

  permutation_product(
      A: rational_matrix,
      code, size, count: nat): RECURSIVE rat =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      1
    ELSE
      permutation_product(A, code, size, count - 1)
        * A(
            count - 1,
            permutation_entry(code, count - 1, size))
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  determinant_sum(
      A: rational_matrix,
      size, limit: nat): RECURSIVE rat =
    IF limit = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      LET code: nat = limit - 1 IN
        determinant_sum(A, size, limit - 1)
          + IF permutation_code(code, size) THEN
              permutation_sign(code, size)
                * permutation_product(A, code, size, size)
            ELSE
              0
            ENDIF
    ENDIF
  MEASURE limit

  determinant(A: rational_matrix, size: nat): rat =
    determinant_sum(A, size, function_code_count(size))

  putnam_matrix: rational_matrix =
    LAMBDA (row, column: nat):
      IF row = column THEN
        (row + 3) :: rat
      ELSE
        1
      ENDIF

  nat_factorial(index: nat): RECURSIVE nat =
    IF index = 0 THEN
      1
    ELSE
      index * nat_factorial(index - 1)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE index

  is_determinant_sequence(D: rational_sequence): bool =
    FORALL (n: nat):
      D(n) = determinant(putnam_matrix, nat_predecessor(n))

  normalized_values_bounded(D: rational_sequence): bool =
    EXISTS (bound: rat):
      FORALL (n: nat):
        n >= 2 IMPLIES
          abs(safe_div(D(n), nat_factorial(n) :: rat)) <= bound

  putnam_1992_b5_solution: bool = FALSE

  putnam_1992_b5: bool =
    FORALL (D: rational_sequence):
      is_determinant_sequence(D) IMPLIES (
        normalized_values_bounded(D)
          IFF putnam_1992_b5_solution)
END putnam_1992_b5

import Mathlib

open Topology Filter Nat Function Polynomial

/--
Let $M$ be a set of real $n \times n$ matrices such that
\begin{itemize}
\item[(i)] $I \in M$, where $I$ is the $n \times n$ identity matrix;
\item[(ii)] if $A \in M$ and $B \in M$, then either $AB \in M$ or $-AB \in M$, but not both;
\item[(iii)] if $A \in M$ and $B \in M$, then either $AB = BA$ or $AB = -BA$;
\item[(iv)] if $A \in M$ and $A \neq I$, there is at least one $B \in M$ such that $AB = -BA$.
\end{itemize}
Prove that $M$ contains at most $n^2$ matrices.
-/
theorem putnam_1992_b6
  (n : ℕ)
  (npos : 0 < n)
  (M : Set (Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ))
  (h1 : 1 ∈ M)
  (h2 : ∀ A ∈ M, ∀ B ∈ M, Xor' (A * B ∈ M) (-A * B ∈ M))
  (h3 : ∀ A ∈ M, ∀ B ∈ M, (A * B = B * A) ∨ (A * B = -B * A))
  (h4 : ∀ A ∈ M, A ≠ 1 → ∃ B ∈ M, A * B = -B * A) :
  M.encard ≤ n ^ 2 :=
sorry

title: putnam_1992_b6
content:
(* Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1992_b6:
   a set of real square matrices satisfying signed-product closure and
   commute-or-anticommute conditions has cardinality at most n squared.
   This file contains no proof. *)

From Stdlib Require Import Reals Vectors.Fin Vectors.Vector Ensembles
  Finite_sets Arith.PeanoNat.

Open Scope R_scope.

Fixpoint putnam_1992_b6_vector_of_fn
    {A : Type} (n : nat) : (Fin.t n -> A) -> Vector.t A n :=
  match n as m return (Fin.t m -> A) -> Vector.t A m with
  | O => fun _ => Vector.nil A
  | S k =>
      fun f =>
        Vector.cons A (f Fin.F1) k
          (putnam_1992_b6_vector_of_fn k (fun i => f (Fin.FS i)))
  end.

Fixpoint putnam_1992_b6_fin_sum
    (n : nat) :
    (Fin.t n -> RbaseSymbolsImpl.R) -> RbaseSymbolsImpl.R :=
  match n as m return
    (Fin.t m -> RbaseSymbolsImpl.R) -> RbaseSymbolsImpl.R with
  | O => fun _ => 0
  | S k =>
      fun f =>
        f Fin.F1 +
        putnam_1992_b6_fin_sum k (fun i => f (Fin.FS i))
  end.

Definition putnam_1992_b6_matrix (n : nat) : Type :=
  Vector.t (Vector.t RbaseSymbolsImpl.R n) n.

Definition putnam_1992_b6_matrix_of_fn
    (n : nat)
    (f : Fin.t n -> Fin.t n -> RbaseSymbolsImpl.R) :
    putnam_1992_b6_matrix n :=
  putnam_1992_b6_vector_of_fn n
    (fun i => putnam_1992_b6_vector_of_fn n (f i)).

Definition putnam_1992_b6_entry
    {n : nat} (A : putnam_1992_b6_matrix n)
    (i j : Fin.t n) : RbaseSymbolsImpl.R :=
  Vector.nth (Vector.nth A i) j.

Definition putnam_1992_b6_identity
    (n : nat) : putnam_1992_b6_matrix n :=
  putnam_1992_b6_matrix_of_fn n
    (fun i j => if Fin.eq_dec i j then 1 else 0).

Definition putnam_1992_b6_neg
    {n : nat} (A : putnam_1992_b6_matrix n) :
    putnam_1992_b6_matrix n :=
  putnam_1992_b6_matrix_of_fn n
    (fun i j => - putnam_1992_b6_entry A i j).

Definition putnam_1992_b6_mul
    {n : nat} (A B : putnam_1992_b6_matrix n) :
    putnam_1992_b6_matrix n :=
  putnam_1992_b6_matrix_of_fn n
    (fun i j =>
      putnam_1992_b6_fin_sum n
        (fun k =>
          putnam_1992_b6_entry A i k *
          putnam_1992_b6_entry B k j)).

Theorem putnam_1992_b6
    (n : nat)
    (npos : (0 < n)%nat)
    (M : Ensemble (putnam_1992_b6_matrix n))
    (h1 : M (putnam_1992_b6_identity n))
    (h2 :
      forall A B : putnam_1992_b6_matrix n,
        M A ->
        M B ->
        (M (putnam_1992_b6_mul A B) /\
         ~ M (putnam_1992_b6_neg (putnam_1992_b6_mul A B))) \/
        (~ M (putnam_1992_b6_mul A B) /\
         M (putnam_1992_b6_neg (putnam_1992_b6_mul A B))))
    (h3 :
      forall A B : putnam_1992_b6_matrix n,
        M A ->
        M B ->
        putnam_1992_b6_mul A B = putnam_1992_b6_mul B A \/
        putnam_1992_b6_mul A B =
          putnam_1992_b6_neg (putnam_1992_b6_mul B A))
    (h4 :
      forall A : putnam_1992_b6_matrix n,
        M A ->
        A <> putnam_1992_b6_identity n ->
        exists B : putnam_1992_b6_matrix n,
          M B /\
          putnam_1992_b6_mul A B =
            putnam_1992_b6_neg (putnam_1992_b6_mul B A)) :
  exists k : nat,
    cardinal (putnam_1992_b6_matrix n) M k /\
    (k <= Nat.pow n 2)%nat.
Admitted.

title: putnam_1992_b6
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1992_b6:
  signed closure, commutation or anticommutation, and the cardinality bound
  for a set of real square matrices. This file contains no proof.
*)

let statement =
  `let matrix_mul =
     \A B:real^N^N.
       (lambda i j.
          sum (1..dimindex(:N)) (\k. A$i$k * B$k$j)):real^N^N in
   let matrix_neg =
     \A:real^N^N.
       (lambda i j. --(A$i$j)):real^N^N in
   let identity_matrix =
     (lambda i j. if i = j then &1 else &0):real^N^N in
   let exclusive_or =
     \p q:bool. (p \/ q) /\ ~(p /\ q) in
   !n:num. !M:(real^N^N)->bool.
     dimindex(:N) = n /\
     0 < n /\
     identity_matrix IN M /\
     (!A:real^N^N.
        A IN M
        ==> !B:real^N^N.
              B IN M
              ==> exclusive_or
                    (matrix_mul A B IN M)
                    (matrix_neg (matrix_mul A B) IN M)) /\
     (!A:real^N^N.
        A IN M
        ==> !B:real^N^N.
              B IN M
              ==> matrix_mul A B = matrix_mul B A \/
                  matrix_mul A B = matrix_neg (matrix_mul B A)) /\
     (!A:real^N^N.
        A IN M /\ ~(A = identity_matrix)
        ==> ?B:real^N^N.
              B IN M /\
              matrix_mul A B = matrix_neg (matrix_mul B A))
     ==> FINITE M /\ CARD M <= n EXP 2`;;

title: putnam_1992_b6
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench artifact putnam_1992_b6:
;; a family of n-by-n matrices satisfying the signed closure and
;; anticommutation hypotheses has at most n^2 members. This file contains no
;; proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))

;; Matrices are ordinary finite ACL2 lists. The scalar operations and the
;; matrix-family predicate are conservative generic symbols, which is ACL2's
;; native way to state a theorem uniformly over an arbitrary field and an
;; arbitrary set. No function codes, axioms, or bounded surrogate family are
;; introduced.
(defstub p1992b6-scalar-p (x) t)
(defstub p1992b6-add-op (x y) t)
(defstub p1992b6-multiply-op (x y) t)
(defstub p1992b6-negate-op (x) t)
(defstub p1992b6-inverse-op (x) t)
(defstub p1992b6-family-member-p (matrix) t)

(defun p1992b6-add (x y)
  (p1992b6-add-op x y))

(defun p1992b6-mul (x y)
  (p1992b6-multiply-op x y))

(defun p1992b6-neg (x)
  (p1992b6-negate-op x))

(defun p1992b6-inv (x)
  (p1992b6-inverse-op x))

(defun-sk p1992b6-field-laws-p (zero one)
  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (p1992b6-scalar-p x)
      (p1992b6-scalar-p y)
      (p1992b6-scalar-p z))
     (and
      (p1992b6-scalar-p (p1992b6-add x y))
      (p1992b6-scalar-p (p1992b6-mul x y))
      (p1992b6-scalar-p (p1992b6-neg x))
      (implies
       (not (equal x zero))
       (p1992b6-scalar-p (p1992b6-inv x)))
      (equal (p1992b6-add (p1992b6-add x y) z)
             (p1992b6-add x (p1992b6-add y z)))
      (equal (p1992b6-add x y)
             (p1992b6-add y x))
      (equal (p1992b6-add x zero) x)
      (equal (p1992b6-add x (p1992b6-neg x)) zero)
      (equal (p1992b6-mul (p1992b6-mul x y) z)
             (p1992b6-mul x (p1992b6-mul y z)))
      (equal (p1992b6-mul x y)
             (p1992b6-mul y x))
      (equal (p1992b6-mul x one) x)
      (implies
       (not (equal x zero))
       (equal (p1992b6-mul x (p1992b6-inv x)) one))
      (equal
       (p1992b6-mul x (p1992b6-add y z))
       (p1992b6-add (p1992b6-mul x y)
                    (p1992b6-mul x z)))))))

(defun p1992b6-field-p (zero one)
  (and
   (p1992b6-scalar-p zero)
   (p1992b6-scalar-p one)
   (not (equal zero one))
   ;; The real field has characteristic zero; only characteristic two is a
   ;; material degeneracy for the signed matrix hypotheses.
   (not (equal (p1992b6-add one one) zero))
   (p1992b6-field-laws-p zero one)))

(defun p1992b6-scalar-list-p (row n)
  (if (zp n)
      (endp row)
    (and
     (consp row)
     (p1992b6-scalar-p (car row))
     (p1992b6-scalar-list-p (cdr row) (1- n)))))

(defun p1992b6-matrix-p (matrix n)
  (if (zp n)
      (endp matrix)
    (and
     (consp matrix)
     (p1992b6-scalar-list-p (car matrix) n)
     (p1992b6-matrix-p (cdr matrix) (1- n)))))

(defun p1992b6-dot-product (left right row column remaining zero)
  (if (zp remaining)
      zero
    (p1992b6-add
     (p1992b6-mul
      (nth (- (len (car left)) remaining) (nth row left))
      (nth column
           (nth (- (len right) remaining) right)))
     (p1992b6-dot-product
      left right row column (1- remaining) zero))))

(defun p1992b6-product-row-aux
    (left right row column remaining n zero)
  (if (zp remaining)
      nil
    (cons
     (p1992b6-dot-product left right row column n zero)
     (p1992b6-product-row-aux
      left right row (1+ column) (1- remaining) n zero))))

(defun p1992b6-product-matrix-aux
    (left right row remaining n zero)
  (if (zp remaining)
      nil
    (cons
     (p1992b6-product-row-aux left right row 0 n n zero)
     (p1992b6-product-matrix-aux
      left right (1+ row) (1- remaining) n zero))))

(defun p1992b6-product (left right n zero)
  (p1992b6-product-matrix-aux left right 0 n n zero))

(defun p1992b6-negate-row (row)
  (if (endp row)
      nil
    (cons
     (p1992b6-neg (car row))
     (p1992b6-negate-row (cdr row)))))

(defun p1992b6-negate-matrix (matrix)
  (if (endp matrix)
      nil
    (cons
     (p1992b6-negate-row (car matrix))
     (p1992b6-negate-matrix (cdr matrix)))))

(defun p1992b6-identity-row-aux
    (row column remaining zero one)
  (if (zp remaining)
      nil
    (cons
     (if (equal row column) one zero)
     (p1992b6-identity-row-aux
      row (1+ column) (1- remaining) zero one))))

(defun p1992b6-identity-aux
    (row remaining n zero one)
  (if (zp remaining)
      nil
    (cons
     (p1992b6-identity-row-aux row 0 n zero one)
     (p1992b6-identity-aux
      (1+ row) (1- remaining) n zero one))))

(defun p1992b6-identity (n zero one)
  (p1992b6-identity-aux 0 n n zero one))

(defun p1992b6-exclusive-or (left right)
  (if left (not right) (if right t nil)))

(defun-sk p1992b6-signed-closure-p (n zero)
  (forall (a b)
    (implies
     (and
      (p1992b6-matrix-p a n)
      (p1992b6-matrix-p b n)
      (p1992b6-family-member-p a)
      (p1992b6-family-member-p b))
     (let* ((ab (p1992b6-product a b n zero))
            (negative-ab (p1992b6-negate-matrix ab)))
       (p1992b6-exclusive-or
        (p1992b6-family-member-p ab)
        (p1992b6-family-member-p negative-ab))))))

(defun-sk p1992b6-commute-or-anticommute-p (n zero)
  (forall (a b)
    (implies
     (and
      (p1992b6-matrix-p a n)
      (p1992b6-matrix-p b n)
      (p1992b6-family-member-p a)
      (p1992b6-family-member-p b))
     (let ((ab (p1992b6-product a b n zero))
           (ba (p1992b6-product b a n zero)))
       (or
        (equal ab ba)
        (equal ab (p1992b6-negate-matrix ba)))))))

(defun-sk p1992b6-anticommuting-witness-exists-p
    (a n zero)
  (exists (b)
    (and
     (p1992b6-matrix-p b n)
     (p1992b6-family-member-p b)
     (equal
      (p1992b6-product a b n zero)
      (p1992b6-negate-matrix
       (p1992b6-product b a n zero))))))

(defun-sk p1992b6-nonidentity-anticommutes-p
    (n zero one)
  (forall (a)
    (implies
     (and
      (p1992b6-matrix-p a n)
      (p1992b6-family-member-p a)
      (not (equal a (p1992b6-identity n zero one))))
     (p1992b6-anticommuting-witness-exists-p a n zero))))

(defun p1992b6-family-list-p (matrices n)
  (if (endp matrices)
      t
    (and
     (p1992b6-matrix-p (car matrices) n)
     (p1992b6-family-member-p (car matrices))
     (p1992b6-family-list-p (cdr matrices) n))))

(defun-sk p1992b6-too-many-members-p (n)
  (exists (matrices)
    (and
     (true-listp matrices)
     (equal (len matrices) (1+ (* n n)))
     (no-duplicatesp-equal matrices)
     (p1992b6-family-list-p matrices n))))

(defun putnambench-putnam-1992-b6-statement
    (n zero one)
  (implies
   (and
    (natp n)
    (< 0 n)
    (p1992b6-field-p zero one)
    (p1992b6-family-member-p
     (p1992b6-identity n zero one))
    (p1992b6-signed-closure-p n zero)
    (p1992b6-commute-or-anticommute-p n zero)
    (p1992b6-nonidentity-anticommutes-p n zero one))
   (not (p1992b6-too-many-members-p n))))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

title: putnam_1992_b6
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1992_b6
-- (putnambench__agda__putnam_1992_b6): a set of real square matrices satisfying
-- exclusive signed closure and pairwise commutation up to sign has cardinality
-- at most n squared. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

open import Agda.Builtin.Bool using (Bool; false; true)
open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; _*_)

infix 4 _!=_ _<=N_
infixr 3 _and_
infixr 2 _or_

data Bottom : Set where

Not : Set -> Set
Not A =
  A -> Bottom

_!=_ : {A : Set} -> A -> A -> Set
x != y =
  Not (x == y)

record _and_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data _or_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  left  : A -> A or B
  right : B -> A or B

record Iff (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor equivalence
  field
    forward  : A -> B
    backward : B -> A

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

Xor : Set -> Set -> Set
Xor A B =
  (A or B) and Not (A and B)

data _<=N_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set where
  zero<=N   : {n : Nat} -> zero <=N n
  suc<=sucN : {m n : Nat} -> m <=N n -> suc m <=N suc n

data Positive : Nat -> Set where
  positive : (n : Nat) -> Positive (suc n)

data Fin : Nat -> Set where
  fzero : {n : Nat} -> Fin (suc n)
  fsuc  : {n : Nat} -> Fin n -> Fin (suc n)

record CompleteOrderedRealField (R : Set) : Set1 where
  field
    zeroR oneR : R
    add multiply : R -> R -> R
    negate inverse : R -> R
    lessOrEqual : R -> R -> Set
    fromNat : Nat -> R

    one-not-zero :
      oneR != zeroR

    add-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> add x y == add y x
    add-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      add (add x y) z == add x (add y z)
    add-zero :
      (x : R) -> add x zeroR == x
    add-inverse :
      (x : R) -> add x (negate x) == zeroR

    multiply-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> multiply x y == multiply y x
    multiply-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply (multiply x y) z ==
      multiply x (multiply y z)
    multiply-one :
      (x : R) -> multiply x oneR == x
    multiply-zero :
      (x : R) -> multiply x zeroR == zeroR
    distribute :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply x (add y z) ==
      add (multiply x y) (multiply x z)
    inverse-zero :
      inverse zeroR == zeroR
    multiply-inverse :
      (x : R) ->
      x != zeroR ->
      multiply x (inverse x) == oneR

    order-reflexive :
      (x : R) -> lessOrEqual x x
    order-transitive :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y z ->
      lessOrEqual x z
    order-antisymmetric :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y x ->
      x == y
    order-total :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y or lessOrEqual y x
    add-order :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual (add z x) (add z y)
    multiply-nonnegative :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR x ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR y ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR (multiply x y)
    zero-less-than-one :
      lessOrEqual zeroR oneR and zeroR != oneR

    fromNat-zero :
      fromNat zero == zeroR
    fromNat-successor :
      (n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (suc n) == add (fromNat n) oneR
    fromNat-addition :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m + n) == add (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-multiplication :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m * n) == multiply (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-injective :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat m == fromNat n ->
      m == n

    archimedean :
      (x : R) ->
      Exists Nat (\ n -> lessOrEqual x (fromNat n))
    least-upper-bound :
      (P : R -> Set) ->
      Exists R P ->
      Exists R
        (\ upper ->
          (x : R) ->
          P x ->
          lessOrEqual x upper) ->
      Exists R
        (\ supremum ->
          ((x : R) ->
            P x ->
            lessOrEqual x supremum)
          and
          ((upper : R) ->
            ((x : R) ->
              P x ->
              lessOrEqual x upper) ->
            lessOrEqual supremum upper))

open CompleteOrderedRealField

sameFin : {n : Nat} -> Fin n -> Fin n -> Bool
sameFin fzero fzero =
  true
sameFin fzero (fsuc j) =
  false
sameFin (fsuc i) fzero =
  false
sameFin (fsuc i) (fsuc j) =
  sameFin i j

ifBool : {A : Set} -> Bool -> A -> A -> A
ifBool true whenTrue whenFalse =
  whenTrue
ifBool false whenTrue whenFalse =
  whenFalse

Matrix : Set -> Nat -> Set
Matrix R n =
  Fin n -> Fin n -> R

MatrixEqual :
  {R : Set} {n : Nat} ->
  Matrix R n ->
  Matrix R n ->
  Set
MatrixEqual {n = n} A B =
  (i j : Fin n) ->
  A i j == B i j

MatrixSetExtensional :
  {R : Set} {n : Nat} ->
  (Matrix R n -> Set) ->
  Set
MatrixSetExtensional M =
  (A B : _) ->
  MatrixEqual A B ->
  Iff (M A) (M B)

sumFin :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  {n : Nat} ->
  (Fin n -> R) ->
  R
sumFin reals {zero} term =
  zeroR reals
sumFin reals {suc n} term =
  add reals
    (term fzero)
    (sumFin reals (\ i -> term (fsuc i)))

identityMatrix :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  {n : Nat} ->
  Matrix R n
identityMatrix reals i j =
  ifBool
    (sameFin i j)
    (oneR reals)
    (zeroR reals)

matrixNegate :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  {n : Nat} ->
  Matrix R n ->
  Matrix R n
matrixNegate reals A i j =
  negate reals (A i j)

matrixMultiply :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  {n : Nat} ->
  Matrix R n ->
  Matrix R n ->
  Matrix R n
matrixMultiply reals A B i j =
  sumFin reals
    (\ k -> multiply reals (A i k) (B k j))

record HasExtensionalCardinality
  {A : Set}
  (equivalent : A -> A -> Set)
  (member : A -> Set)
  (cardinality : Nat) :
  Set where

  field
    enumerate :
      Fin cardinality ->
      A
    enumerated-member :
      (index : Fin cardinality) ->
      member (enumerate index)
    enumeration-complete :
      (item : A) ->
      member item ->
      Exists (Fin cardinality)
        (\ index -> equivalent item (enumerate index))
    enumeration-injective :
      (left-index right-index : Fin cardinality) ->
      equivalent (enumerate left-index) (enumerate right-index) ->
      left-index == right-index

CardinalityAtMost :
  {A : Set} ->
  (equivalent : A -> A -> Set) ->
  (member : A -> Set) ->
  Nat ->
  Set
CardinalityAtMost equivalent member bound =
  Exists Nat
    (\ cardinality ->
      HasExtensionalCardinality equivalent member cardinality
      and
      cardinality <=N bound)

putnam-1992-b6 : Set1
putnam-1992-b6 =
  (R : Set) ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) ->
  (n : Nat) ->
  Positive n ->
  (M : Matrix R n -> Set) ->
  MatrixSetExtensional M ->
  M (identityMatrix reals) ->
  ((A B : Matrix R n) ->
    M A ->
    M B ->
    Xor
      (M (matrixMultiply reals A B))
      (M (matrixMultiply reals (matrixNegate reals A) B))) ->
  ((A B : Matrix R n) ->
    M A ->
    M B ->
    MatrixEqual
      (matrixMultiply reals A B)
      (matrixMultiply reals B A)
    or
    MatrixEqual
      (matrixMultiply reals A B)
      (matrixMultiply reals (matrixNegate reals B) A)) ->
  ((A : Matrix R n) ->
    M A ->
    Not (MatrixEqual A (identityMatrix reals)) ->
    Exists (Matrix R n)
      (\ B ->
        M B
        and
        MatrixEqual
          (matrixMultiply reals A B)
          (matrixMultiply reals (matrixNegate reals B) A))) ->
  CardinalityAtMost MatrixEqual M (n * n)

title: putnam_1992_b6
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1992_b6:
  a set of real square matrices satisfying exclusive signed closure and
  commute-or-anticommute conditions has at most n squared elements. This file
  contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open arithmeticTheory pred_setTheory fcpTheory realTheory real_sigmaTheory;
open matrixTheory;

val putnam_1992_b6 =
  ``!n : num. !M : real['N]['N] set.
      0 < n /\
      dimindex (:'N) = n /\
      matrix$mat 1 IN M /\
      (!A B : real['N]['N].
         A IN M /\ B IN M
         ==>
         ((A ** B IN M) <> ((~A) ** B IN M))) /\
      (!A B : real['N]['N].
         A IN M /\ B IN M
         ==>
         A ** B = B ** A \/ A ** B = (~B) ** A) /\
      (!A : real['N]['N].
         A IN M /\ A <> matrix$mat 1
         ==>
         ?B : real['N]['N].
           B IN M /\ A ** B = (~B) ** A)
      ==>
      FINITE M /\ CARD M <= n EXP 2``;

$(
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact
  putnam_1992_b6: a cardinality bound for a set of real square matrices
  satisfying signed-product closure and commutation conditions. This file
  contains no proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  For positive n, P92B6Index n is the n-element carrier corresponding to
  Fin n, and P92B6Matrices n is the full set of real n-by-n matrices.
  P92B6Identity n and P92B6Neg n are respectively the identity matrix and
  pointwise additive negation, while P92B6Mul n is SetMM's real matrix
  multiplication on this carrier.

  Negating the biconditional in the second hypothesis says that exactly one
  of AB and (-A)B belongs to M. The remaining hypotheses retain the source
  commute-or-anticommute alternatives and the internal anticommuting witness.
  SetMM's cardinality is infinite on infinite sets, so its finite upper bound
  by n^2 is equivalent to the source extended-cardinality conclusion.
  Every declaration is an unproved $a statement encoding; this database
  contains no $p proof declaration.
$)

$c
  P92B6Index P92B6Matrices P92B6Identity P92B6Neg P92B6Mul
$.

p92b6-index-syntax $a class P92B6Index $.
p92b6-matrices-syntax $a class P92B6Matrices $.
p92b6-identity-syntax $a class P92B6Identity $.
p92b6-neg-syntax $a class P92B6Neg $.
p92b6-mul-syntax $a class P92B6Mul $.

${
  p92b6-index-definition $a |- P92B6Index =
    ( n e. NN |-> ( 0 ..^ n ) )
  $.
$}

${
  p92b6-matrices-definition $a |- P92B6Matrices =
    ( n e. NN |->
      (
        RR
        ^m
        (
          ( P92B6Index ` n )
          X.
          ( P92B6Index ` n )
        )
      )
    )
  $.
$}

${
  $d i j n $.

  p92b6-identity-definition $a |- P92B6Identity =
    ( n e. NN |->
      (
        i e. ( P92B6Index ` n ) ,
        j e. ( P92B6Index ` n ) |->
          if ( i = j , 1 , 0 )
      )
    )
  $.
$}

${
  $d A i j n $.

  p92b6-neg-definition $a |- P92B6Neg =
    ( n e. NN |->
      (
        A e. ( P92B6Matrices ` n ) |->
          (
            i e. ( P92B6Index ` n ) ,
            j e. ( P92B6Index ` n ) |->
              ( -u ( A ` <. i , j >. ) )
          )
      )
    )
  $.
$}

${
  p92b6-mul-definition $a |- P92B6Mul =
    ( n e. NN |->
      (
        RRfld
        maMul
        <.
          ( P92B6Index ` n ) ,
          ( P92B6Index ` n ) ,
          ( P92B6Index ` n )
        >.
      )
    )
  $.
$}

${
  $d A B M n $.

  putnambench-putnam-1992-b6 $a |-
    A. n e. NN
      A. M e. ~P ( P92B6Matrices ` n )
        (
          (
            ( P92B6Identity ` n ) e. M
            /\
            (
              A. A e. M
                A. B e. M
                  -.
                  (
                    (
                      A
                      ( P92B6Mul ` n )
                      B
                    )
                    e. M
                    <->
                    (
                      (
                        ( P92B6Neg ` n )
                        ` A
                      )
                      ( P92B6Mul ` n )
                      B
                    )
                    e. M
                  )
              /\
              (
                A. A e. M
                  A. B e. M
                    (
                      (
                        A
                        ( P92B6Mul ` n )
                        B
                      )
                      =
                      (
                        B
                        ( P92B6Mul ` n )
                        A
                      )
                      \/
                      (
                        A
                        ( P92B6Mul ` n )
                        B
                      )
                      =
                      (
                        (
                          ( P92B6Neg ` n )
                          ` B
                        )
                        ( P92B6Mul ` n )
                        A
                      )
                    )
                /\
                A. A e. M
                  (
                    A =/= ( P92B6Identity ` n )
                    ->
                    E. B e. M
                      (
                        A
                        ( P92B6Mul ` n )
                        B
                      )
                      =
                      (
                        (
                          ( P92B6Neg ` n )
                          ` B
                        )
                        ( P92B6Mul ` n )
                        A
                      )
                  )
              )
            )
          )
          ->
          ( # ` M ) <_ ( n ^ 2 )
        )
  $.
$}

title: putnam_1992_b6
content:
% Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1992_b6:
% a set of real n-by-n matrices with exclusive signed closure, pairwise
% commuting or anticommuting products, and nonidentity anticommuting witnesses
% has at most n^2 elements. This file contains no proof.

putnam_1992_b6: THEORY
BEGIN
  matrix(n: posnat): TYPE = [below(n), below(n) -> real]
  matrix_set(n: posnat): TYPE = [matrix(n) -> bool]

  bounded_real_sum(
      n: posnat,
      values: [below(n) -> real],
      count: nat): RECURSIVE real =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      bounded_real_sum(n, values, count - 1)
        + IF count <= n THEN
            values(count - 1)
          ELSE
            0
          ENDIF
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  identity_matrix(n: posnat): matrix(n) =
    LAMBDA (row, column: below(n)):
      IF row = column THEN 1 ELSE 0 ENDIF

  matrix_negate(n: posnat)(A: matrix(n)): matrix(n) =
    LAMBDA (row, column: below(n)):
      -A(row, column)

  matrix_multiply(n: posnat)(A, B: matrix(n)): matrix(n) =
    LAMBDA (row, column: below(n)):
      bounded_real_sum(
        n,
        LAMBDA (inner: below(n)):
          A(row, inner) * B(inner, column),
        n)

  exclusive_or(left, right: bool): bool =
    (left OR right) AND NOT (left AND right)

  has_more_than_square_elements(
      n: posnat,
      M: matrix_set(n)): bool =
    EXISTS
        (enumeration: [below(n * n + 1) -> matrix(n)]):
      (FORALL (index: below(n * n + 1)):
        M(enumeration(index)))
        AND
          (FORALL (left, right: below(n * n + 1)):
            enumeration(left) = enumeration(right)
              IMPLIES left = right)

  putnam_1992_b6: bool =
    FORALL (n: posnat), (M: matrix_set(n)):
      (M(identity_matrix(n))
        AND
          (FORALL (A, B: matrix(n)):
            (M(A) AND M(B))
              IMPLIES
                exclusive_or(
                  M(matrix_multiply(n)(A, B)),
                  M(
                    matrix_multiply(
                      n)(
                      matrix_negate(n)(A),
                      B))))
        AND
          (FORALL (A, B: matrix(n)):
            (M(A) AND M(B))
              IMPLIES
                (matrix_multiply(n)(A, B)
                    = matrix_multiply(n)(B, A)
                  OR
                    matrix_multiply(n)(A, B)
                      = matrix_multiply(
                          n)(
                          matrix_negate(n)(B),
                          A)))
        AND
          (FORALL (A: matrix(n)):
            (M(A) AND A /= identity_matrix(n))
              IMPLIES
                EXISTS (B: matrix(n)):
                  M(B)
                    AND matrix_multiply(n)(A, B)
                      = matrix_multiply(
                          n)(
                          matrix_negate(n)(B),
                          A)))
      IMPLIES NOT has_more_than_square_elements(n, M)
END putnam_1992_b6
