title: putnam_1996_a6
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1996_a6:
;; classification of the continuous real functions satisfying
;; f(x) = f(x^2 + c) for a positive real constant c. This file contains no
;; proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))

;; The context presents a Dedekind-complete ordered field, hence the real
;; field up to ordered-field isomorphism. APPLY$ objects represent arbitrary
;; carrier predicates, subsets, operations, and real-valued functions, while
;; DEFUN-SK keeps all source quantifiers internal to the statement.

(defun putnam-1996-a6-member-p (carrier value)
  (if (apply$ carrier (list value)) t nil))

(defun putnam-1996-a6-unary-value (operation value)
  (apply$ operation (list value)))

(defun putnam-1996-a6-binary-value (operation left right)
  (apply$ operation (list left right)))

(defun-sk putnam-1996-a6-valid-set-p (carrier set)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (apply$ set (list x))
     (putnam-1996-a6-member-p carrier x))))

(defun-sk putnam-1996-a6-real-function-p (carrier function)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (putnam-1996-a6-member-p carrier x)
     (putnam-1996-a6-member-p
      carrier
      (putnam-1996-a6-unary-value function x)))))

(defun-sk putnam-1996-a6-field-laws-p
    (carrier zero one add multiply negate inverse)
  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (putnam-1996-a6-member-p carrier x)
      (putnam-1996-a6-member-p carrier y)
      (putnam-1996-a6-member-p carrier z))
     (let* ((xy-add
             (putnam-1996-a6-binary-value add x y))
            (yz-add
             (putnam-1996-a6-binary-value add y z))
            (xy-multiply
             (putnam-1996-a6-binary-value multiply x y))
            (yz-multiply
             (putnam-1996-a6-binary-value multiply y z))
            (negative-x
             (putnam-1996-a6-unary-value negate x))
            (inverse-x
             (putnam-1996-a6-unary-value inverse x)))
       (and
        (putnam-1996-a6-member-p carrier xy-add)
        (putnam-1996-a6-member-p carrier xy-multiply)
        (putnam-1996-a6-member-p carrier negative-x)
        (putnam-1996-a6-member-p carrier inverse-x)
        (equal
         (putnam-1996-a6-binary-value add xy-add z)
         (putnam-1996-a6-binary-value add x yz-add))
        (equal
         xy-add
         (putnam-1996-a6-binary-value add y x))
        (equal
         (putnam-1996-a6-binary-value add x zero)
         x)
        (equal
         (putnam-1996-a6-binary-value add x negative-x)
         zero)
        (equal
         (putnam-1996-a6-binary-value multiply xy-multiply z)
         (putnam-1996-a6-binary-value multiply x yz-multiply))
        (equal
         xy-multiply
         (putnam-1996-a6-binary-value multiply y x))
        (equal
         (putnam-1996-a6-binary-value multiply x one)
         x)
        (implies
         (equal x zero)
         (equal inverse-x zero))
        (implies
         (not (equal x zero))
         (equal
          (putnam-1996-a6-binary-value multiply x inverse-x)
          one))
        (equal
         (putnam-1996-a6-binary-value multiply x yz-add)
         (putnam-1996-a6-binary-value
          add
          (putnam-1996-a6-binary-value multiply x y)
          (putnam-1996-a6-binary-value multiply x z))))))))

(defun-sk putnam-1996-a6-order-laws-p
    (carrier zero add multiply less)
  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (putnam-1996-a6-member-p carrier x)
      (putnam-1996-a6-member-p carrier y)
      (putnam-1996-a6-member-p carrier z))
     (and
      (not (putnam-1996-a6-binary-value less x x))
      (or
       (equal x y)
       (putnam-1996-a6-binary-value less x y)
       (putnam-1996-a6-binary-value less y x))
      (implies
       (and
        (putnam-1996-a6-binary-value less x y)
        (putnam-1996-a6-binary-value less y z))
       (putnam-1996-a6-binary-value less x z))
      (implies
       (putnam-1996-a6-binary-value less x y)
       (putnam-1996-a6-binary-value
        less
        (putnam-1996-a6-binary-value add x z)
        (putnam-1996-a6-binary-value add y z)))
      (implies
       (and
        (putnam-1996-a6-binary-value less zero x)
        (putnam-1996-a6-binary-value less zero y))
       (putnam-1996-a6-binary-value
        less
        zero
        (putnam-1996-a6-binary-value multiply x y)))))))

(defun-sk putnam-1996-a6-set-nonempty-p (carrier set)
  (exists (x)
    (and
     (putnam-1996-a6-member-p carrier x)
     (apply$ set (list x)))))

(defun-sk putnam-1996-a6-upper-bound-p
    (carrier less set bound)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (and
      (putnam-1996-a6-member-p carrier x)
      (apply$ set (list x)))
     (not
      (putnam-1996-a6-binary-value less bound x)))))

(defun-sk putnam-1996-a6-bounded-above-p
    (carrier less set)
  (exists (bound)
    (and
     (putnam-1996-a6-member-p carrier bound)
     (putnam-1996-a6-upper-bound-p
      carrier less set bound))))

(defun-sk putnam-1996-a6-supremum-p
    (carrier less set supremum)
  (forall (bound)
    (and
     (putnam-1996-a6-member-p carrier supremum)
     (putnam-1996-a6-upper-bound-p
      carrier less set supremum)
     (implies
      (and
       (putnam-1996-a6-member-p carrier bound)
       (putnam-1996-a6-upper-bound-p
        carrier less set bound))
      (not
       (putnam-1996-a6-binary-value
        less bound supremum))))))

(defun-sk putnam-1996-a6-has-supremum-p
    (carrier less set)
  (exists (supremum)
    (putnam-1996-a6-supremum-p
     carrier less set supremum)))

(defun-sk putnam-1996-a6-dedekind-complete-p
    (carrier less)
  (forall (set)
    (implies
     (and
      (tamep-functionp set)
      (putnam-1996-a6-valid-set-p carrier set)
      (putnam-1996-a6-set-nonempty-p carrier set)
      (putnam-1996-a6-bounded-above-p
       carrier less set))
     (putnam-1996-a6-has-supremum-p
      carrier less set))))

(defun putnam-1996-a6-real-field-p
    (carrier zero one add multiply negate inverse less)
  (and
   (tamep-functionp carrier)
   (tamep-functionp add)
   (tamep-functionp multiply)
   (tamep-functionp negate)
   (tamep-functionp inverse)
   (tamep-functionp less)
   (putnam-1996-a6-member-p carrier zero)
   (putnam-1996-a6-member-p carrier one)
   (not (equal zero one))
   (putnam-1996-a6-field-laws-p
    carrier zero one add multiply negate inverse)
   (putnam-1996-a6-order-laws-p
    carrier zero add multiply less)
   (putnam-1996-a6-binary-value less zero one)
   (putnam-1996-a6-dedekind-complete-p
    carrier less)))

;; Real-field context and arithmetic.

(defun putnam-1996-a6-r-carrier (ctx) (nth 0 ctx))
(defun putnam-1996-a6-r-zero (ctx) (nth 1 ctx))
(defun putnam-1996-a6-r-one (ctx) (nth 2 ctx))
(defun putnam-1996-a6-r-add (ctx) (nth 3 ctx))
(defun putnam-1996-a6-r-multiply (ctx) (nth 4 ctx))
(defun putnam-1996-a6-r-negate (ctx) (nth 5 ctx))
(defun putnam-1996-a6-r-inverse (ctx) (nth 6 ctx))
(defun putnam-1996-a6-r-less (ctx) (nth 7 ctx))

(defun putnam-1996-a6-context-p (ctx)
  (and
   (true-listp ctx)
   (equal (len ctx) 8)
   (putnam-1996-a6-real-field-p
    (putnam-1996-a6-r-carrier ctx)
    (putnam-1996-a6-r-zero ctx)
    (putnam-1996-a6-r-one ctx)
    (putnam-1996-a6-r-add ctx)
    (putnam-1996-a6-r-multiply ctx)
    (putnam-1996-a6-r-negate ctx)
    (putnam-1996-a6-r-inverse ctx)
    (putnam-1996-a6-r-less ctx))))

(defun putnam-1996-a6-r-add-value (ctx left right)
  (putnam-1996-a6-binary-value
   (putnam-1996-a6-r-add ctx) left right))

(defun putnam-1996-a6-r-multiply-value (ctx left right)
  (putnam-1996-a6-binary-value
   (putnam-1996-a6-r-multiply ctx) left right))

(defun putnam-1996-a6-r-negate-value (ctx value)
  (putnam-1996-a6-unary-value
   (putnam-1996-a6-r-negate ctx) value))

(defun putnam-1996-a6-r-inverse-value (ctx value)
  (putnam-1996-a6-unary-value
   (putnam-1996-a6-r-inverse ctx) value))

(defun putnam-1996-a6-r-subtract-value (ctx left right)
  (putnam-1996-a6-r-add-value
   ctx left (putnam-1996-a6-r-negate-value ctx right)))

(defun putnam-1996-a6-r-less-p (ctx left right)
  (if (putnam-1996-a6-binary-value
       (putnam-1996-a6-r-less ctx) left right)
      t
    nil))

(defun putnam-1996-a6-r-less-equal-p (ctx left right)
  (not (putnam-1996-a6-r-less-p ctx right left)))

(defun putnam-1996-a6-r-absolute-value (ctx value)
  (if (putnam-1996-a6-r-less-p
       ctx value (putnam-1996-a6-r-zero ctx))
      (putnam-1996-a6-r-negate-value ctx value)
    value))

(defun putnam-1996-a6-positive-real-p (ctx value)
  (and
   (putnam-1996-a6-member-p
    (putnam-1996-a6-r-carrier ctx) value)
   (putnam-1996-a6-r-less-p
    ctx (putnam-1996-a6-r-zero ctx) value)))

(defun putnam-1996-a6-r-natural (n ctx)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix n)))
  (if (zp n)
      (putnam-1996-a6-r-zero ctx)
    (putnam-1996-a6-r-add-value
     ctx
     (putnam-1996-a6-r-one ctx)
     (putnam-1996-a6-r-natural (1- n) ctx))))

(defun putnam-1996-a6-r-quarter (ctx)
  (putnam-1996-a6-r-inverse-value
   ctx
   (putnam-1996-a6-r-natural 4 ctx)))

(defun putnam-1996-a6-function-value (function x)
  (putnam-1996-a6-unary-value function x))

(defun putnam-1996-a6-square-plus-c (ctx x c)
  (putnam-1996-a6-r-add-value
   ctx
   (putnam-1996-a6-r-multiply-value ctx x x)
   c))

(defun putnam-1996-a6-icc-member-p (ctx left right x)
  (and
   (putnam-1996-a6-member-p
    (putnam-1996-a6-r-carrier ctx) x)
   (putnam-1996-a6-r-less-equal-p ctx left x)
   (putnam-1996-a6-r-less-equal-p ctx x right)))

;; Epsilon-delta continuity on the whole real field.

(defun-sk putnam-1996-a6-global-neighborhood-p
    (ctx function x epsilon radius)
  (forall (y)
    (implies
     (and
      (putnam-1996-a6-member-p
       (putnam-1996-a6-r-carrier ctx) y)
      (putnam-1996-a6-r-less-p
       ctx
       (putnam-1996-a6-r-absolute-value
        ctx
        (putnam-1996-a6-r-subtract-value ctx y x))
       radius))
     (putnam-1996-a6-r-less-p
      ctx
      (putnam-1996-a6-r-absolute-value
       ctx
       (putnam-1996-a6-r-subtract-value
        ctx
        (putnam-1996-a6-function-value function y)
        (putnam-1996-a6-function-value function x)))
      epsilon))))

(defun-sk putnam-1996-a6-global-radius-exists-p
    (ctx function x epsilon)
  (exists (radius)
    (and
     (putnam-1996-a6-positive-real-p ctx radius)
     (putnam-1996-a6-global-neighborhood-p
      ctx function x epsilon radius))))

(defun-sk putnam-1996-a6-continuous-at-p
    (ctx function x)
  (forall (epsilon)
    (implies
     (putnam-1996-a6-positive-real-p ctx epsilon)
     (putnam-1996-a6-global-radius-exists-p
      ctx function x epsilon))))

(defun-sk putnam-1996-a6-continuous-p
    (ctx function)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (putnam-1996-a6-member-p
      (putnam-1996-a6-r-carrier ctx) x)
     (putnam-1996-a6-continuous-at-p
      ctx function x))))

;; Epsilon-delta continuity relative to the closed interval [0,c].

(defun-sk putnam-1996-a6-icc-neighborhood-p
    (ctx function c x epsilon radius)
  (forall (y)
    (implies
     (and
      (putnam-1996-a6-icc-member-p
       ctx (putnam-1996-a6-r-zero ctx) c y)
      (putnam-1996-a6-r-less-p
       ctx
       (putnam-1996-a6-r-absolute-value
        ctx
        (putnam-1996-a6-r-subtract-value ctx y x))
       radius))
     (putnam-1996-a6-r-less-p
      ctx
      (putnam-1996-a6-r-absolute-value
       ctx
       (putnam-1996-a6-r-subtract-value
        ctx
        (putnam-1996-a6-function-value function y)
        (putnam-1996-a6-function-value function x)))
      epsilon))))

(defun-sk putnam-1996-a6-icc-radius-exists-p
    (ctx function c x epsilon)
  (exists (radius)
    (and
     (putnam-1996-a6-positive-real-p ctx radius)
     (putnam-1996-a6-icc-neighborhood-p
      ctx function c x epsilon radius))))

(defun-sk putnam-1996-a6-continuous-within-icc-at-p
    (ctx function c x)
  (forall (epsilon)
    (implies
     (putnam-1996-a6-positive-real-p ctx epsilon)
     (putnam-1996-a6-icc-radius-exists-p
      ctx function c x epsilon))))

(defun-sk putnam-1996-a6-continuous-on-icc-p
    (ctx function c)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (putnam-1996-a6-icc-member-p
      ctx (putnam-1996-a6-r-zero ctx) c x)
     (putnam-1996-a6-continuous-within-icc-at-p
      ctx function c x))))

;; Functional equations and the two branches of the classified solution set.

(defun-sk putnam-1996-a6-equation-on-all-reals-p
    (ctx function c)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (putnam-1996-a6-member-p
      (putnam-1996-a6-r-carrier ctx) x)
     (equal
      (putnam-1996-a6-function-value function x)
      (putnam-1996-a6-function-value
       function
       (putnam-1996-a6-square-plus-c ctx x c))))))

(defun-sk putnam-1996-a6-equation-on-positive-reals-p
    (ctx function c)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (putnam-1996-a6-positive-real-p ctx x)
     (equal
      (putnam-1996-a6-function-value function x)
      (putnam-1996-a6-function-value
       function
       (putnam-1996-a6-square-plus-c ctx x c))))))

(defun-sk putnam-1996-a6-even-on-negative-reals-p
    (ctx function)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (and
      (putnam-1996-a6-member-p
       (putnam-1996-a6-r-carrier ctx) x)
      (putnam-1996-a6-r-less-p
       ctx x (putnam-1996-a6-r-zero ctx)))
     (equal
      (putnam-1996-a6-function-value function x)
      (putnam-1996-a6-function-value
       function
       (putnam-1996-a6-r-negate-value ctx x))))))

(defun-sk putnam-1996-a6-constant-value-p
    (ctx function value)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (putnam-1996-a6-member-p
      (putnam-1996-a6-r-carrier ctx) x)
     (equal
      (putnam-1996-a6-function-value function x)
      value))))

(defun-sk putnam-1996-a6-constant-function-p
    (ctx function)
  (exists (value)
    (and
     (putnam-1996-a6-member-p
      (putnam-1996-a6-r-carrier ctx) value)
     (putnam-1996-a6-constant-value-p
      ctx function value))))

(defun putnam-1996-a6-large-c-solution-p
    (ctx function c)
  (and
   (putnam-1996-a6-continuous-on-icc-p
    ctx function c)
   (equal
    (putnam-1996-a6-function-value
     function (putnam-1996-a6-r-zero ctx))
    (putnam-1996-a6-function-value function c))
   (putnam-1996-a6-equation-on-positive-reals-p
    ctx function c)
   (putnam-1996-a6-even-on-negative-reals-p
    ctx function)))

(defun putnam-1996-a6-solution-p (ctx function c)
  (if (putnam-1996-a6-r-less-equal-p
       ctx c (putnam-1996-a6-r-quarter ctx))
      (putnam-1996-a6-constant-function-p
       ctx function)
    (putnam-1996-a6-large-c-solution-p
     ctx function c)))

(defun putnambench-putnam-1996-a6-statement
    (ctx c function)
  (implies
   (and
    (putnam-1996-a6-context-p ctx)
    (putnam-1996-a6-positive-real-p ctx c)
    (tamep-functionp function)
    (putnam-1996-a6-real-function-p
     (putnam-1996-a6-r-carrier ctx) function))
   (iff
    (and
     (putnam-1996-a6-continuous-p
      ctx function)
     (putnam-1996-a6-equation-on-all-reals-p
      ctx function c))
    (putnam-1996-a6-solution-p
     ctx function c))))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

title: putnam_1996_a6
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1996_a6
-- (putnambench__agda__putnam_1996_a6): classification of continuous real
-- functions satisfying f(x) = f(x squared + c). This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; _*_)

infix 4 _!=_
infixr 3 _and_
infixr 2 _or_

data Bottom : Set where

Not : Set -> Set
Not A =
  A -> Bottom

_!=_ : {A : Set} -> A -> A -> Set
x != y =
  Not (x == y)

record _and_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data _or_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  left  : A -> A or B
  right : B -> A or B

record Iff (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor equivalence
  field
    forward  : A -> B
    backward : B -> A

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

Predicate : Set -> Set1
Predicate A =
  A -> Set

record CompleteOrderedRealField (R : Set) : Set1 where
  field
    zeroR oneR : R
    add multiply : R -> R -> R
    negate inverse : R -> R
    lessOrEqual : R -> R -> Set
    fromNat : Nat -> R

    one-not-zero :
      oneR != zeroR

    add-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> add x y == add y x
    add-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      add (add x y) z == add x (add y z)
    add-zero :
      (x : R) -> add x zeroR == x
    add-inverse :
      (x : R) -> add x (negate x) == zeroR

    multiply-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> multiply x y == multiply y x
    multiply-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply (multiply x y) z ==
      multiply x (multiply y z)
    multiply-one :
      (x : R) -> multiply x oneR == x
    multiply-zero :
      (x : R) -> multiply x zeroR == zeroR
    distribute :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply x (add y z) ==
      add (multiply x y) (multiply x z)
    inverse-zero :
      inverse zeroR == zeroR
    multiply-inverse :
      (x : R) ->
      x != zeroR ->
      multiply x (inverse x) == oneR

    order-reflexive :
      (x : R) -> lessOrEqual x x
    order-transitive :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y z ->
      lessOrEqual x z
    order-antisymmetric :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y x ->
      x == y
    order-total :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y or lessOrEqual y x
    add-order :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual (add z x) (add z y)
    multiply-nonnegative :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR x ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR y ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR (multiply x y)
    zero-less-than-one :
      lessOrEqual zeroR oneR and zeroR != oneR

    fromNat-zero :
      fromNat zero == zeroR
    fromNat-successor :
      (n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (suc n) == add (fromNat n) oneR
    fromNat-addition :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m + n) == add (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-multiplication :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m * n) == multiply (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-injective :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat m == fromNat n ->
      m == n

    archimedean :
      (x : R) ->
      Exists Nat (\ n -> lessOrEqual x (fromNat n))
    least-upper-bound :
      (P : Predicate R) ->
      Exists R P ->
      Exists R
        (\ upper ->
          (x : R) ->
          P x ->
          lessOrEqual x upper) ->
      Exists R
        (\ supremum ->
          ((x : R) ->
            P x ->
            lessOrEqual x supremum)
          and
          ((upper : R) ->
            ((x : R) ->
              P x ->
              lessOrEqual x upper) ->
            lessOrEqual supremum upper))

open CompleteOrderedRealField

subtract :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
subtract reals x y =
  add reals x (negate reals y)

divide :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
divide reals x y =
  multiply reals x (inverse reals y)

square :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R
square reals x =
  multiply reals x x

StrictLess :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
StrictLess reals x y =
  lessOrEqual reals x y and x != y

CloseTo :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
CloseTo reals center radius x =
  StrictLess reals
    (subtract reals center radius)
    x
  and
  StrictLess reals
    x
    (add reals center radius)

ContinuousWithinAt :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (R -> R) ->
  Predicate R ->
  R ->
  Set
ContinuousWithinAt {R} reals function domain point =
  (epsilon : R) ->
  StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) epsilon ->
  Exists R
    (\ delta ->
      StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) delta
      and
      ((x : R) ->
        domain x ->
        CloseTo reals point delta x ->
        CloseTo reals
          (function point)
          epsilon
          (function x)))

ContinuousOn :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (R -> R) ->
  Predicate R ->
  Set
ContinuousOn {R} reals function domain =
  (x : R) ->
  domain x ->
  ContinuousWithinAt reals function domain x

Continuous :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (R -> R) ->
  Set
Continuous {R} reals function =
  (x : R) ->
  ContinuousWithinAt reals function (\ _ -> Top) x
  where
  record Top : Set where
    constructor top

ClosedInterval :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Predicate R
ClosedInterval reals lower upper x =
  lessOrEqual reals lower x
  and
  lessOrEqual reals x upper

fourN : Nat
fourN =
  suc (suc (suc (suc zero)))

oneQuarter :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R
oneQuarter reals =
  divide reals
    (oneR reals)
    (fromNat reals fourN)

ConstantFunction :
  {R : Set} ->
  (R -> R) ->
  Set
ConstantFunction {R} function =
  Exists R
    (\ value ->
      (x : R) ->
      function x == value)

FunctionalEquation :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  (R -> R) ->
  Set
FunctionalEquation reals c function =
  (x : _) ->
  function x ==
  function
    (add reals
      (square reals x)
      c)

module Putnam1996A6Statement
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) where

  LowParameterSolution :
    R ->
    (R -> R) ->
    Set
  LowParameterSolution c function =
    lessOrEqual reals c (oneQuarter reals)
    and
    ConstantFunction function

  HighParameterSolution :
    R ->
    (R -> R) ->
    Set
  HighParameterSolution c function =
    Not (lessOrEqual reals c (oneQuarter reals))
    and
    ContinuousOn reals function
      (ClosedInterval reals (zeroR reals) c)
    and
    function (zeroR reals) == function c
    and
    ((x : R) ->
      StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) x ->
      function x ==
      function
        (add reals
          (square reals x)
          c))
    and
    ((x : R) ->
      StrictLess reals x (zeroR reals) ->
      function x == function (negate reals x))

  Solution :
    R ->
    (R -> R) ->
    Set
  Solution c function =
    LowParameterSolution c function
    or
    HighParameterSolution c function

  proposition : Set
  proposition =
    (c : R) ->
    (function : R -> R) ->
    StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) c ->
    Iff
      (Continuous reals function
        and
        FunctionalEquation reals c function)
      (Solution c function)

putnam-1996-a6 : Set1
putnam-1996-a6 =
  (R : Set) ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) ->
  Putnam1996A6Statement.proposition reals

title: putnam_1996_a6
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1996_a6:
  classification, according to whether c is at most one quarter, of the
  continuous real functions satisfying f(x) = f(x^2 + c). This file contains
  no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open pred_setTheory realTheory real_topologyTheory;

val putnam_1996_a6 =
  ``!c : real.
      0 < c
      ==>
      !f : real -> real.
        (f continuous_on UNIV /\
         (!x : real. f x = f (x pow 2 + c)))
        <=>
        if c <= 1 / 4 then
          ?d : real. !x : real. f x = d
        else
          f continuous_on interval [0, c] /\
          f 0 = f c /\
          (!x : real. 0 < x ==> f x = f (x pow 2 + c)) /\
          (!x : real. x < 0 ==> f x = f (~x))``;

title: putnam_1996_a6
content:
$(
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact
  putnam_1996_a6: classification of the continuous real functions satisfying
  f(x) = f(x^2 + c) for a positive real parameter c. This file contains no
  proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  P96A6RTop is the standard topology on the real numbers. All functions f
  are arbitrary total maps from RR to RR. The left side states global
  continuity and the functional equation on every real input.

  The right side expands the source solution definition. For c at most one
  quarter, f is pointwise constant. For c greater than one quarter, the
  restriction of f to the closed interval from zero to c is continuous,
  its endpoint values agree, the functional equation holds on positive
  inputs, and f is even on negative inputs. These two real-order cases are
  exhaustive and disjoint.

  The final declaration is the single unproved $a corpus statement; this
  database contains no $p proof declaration.
$)

$c P96A6RTop $.

p96a6-real-topology-syntax $a class P96A6RTop $.

p96a6-real-topology-definition $a |- P96A6RTop =
  ( TopOpen ` RRfld )
$.

${
  $d c d f x $.

  putnambench-putnam-1996-a6 $a |-
    A. c e. RR
      A. f e. ( RR ^m RR )
        (
          0 < c
          ->
          (
            (
              f e. ( P96A6RTop Cn P96A6RTop )
              /\
              A. x e. RR
                ( f ` x )
                =
                ( f ` ( ( x ^ 2 ) + c ) )
            )
            <->
            (
              (
                c <_ ( 1 / 4 )
                /\
                E. d e. RR
                  A. x e. RR
                    ( f ` x ) = d
              )
              \/
              (
                ( 1 / 4 ) < c
                /\
                (
                  ( f |` ( 0 [,] c ) )
                  e.
                  (
                    ( P96A6RTop |`t ( 0 [,] c ) )
                    Cn
                    P96A6RTop
                  )
                  /\
                  (
                    ( f ` 0 ) = ( f ` c )
                    /\
                    (
                      A. x e. RR
                        (
                          0 < x
                          ->
                          ( f ` x )
                          =
                          ( f ` ( ( x ^ 2 ) + c ) )
                        )
                      /\
                      A. x e. RR
                        (
                          x < 0
                          ->
                          ( f ` x ) = ( f ` ( -u x ) )
                        )
                    )
                  )
                )
              )
            )
          )
        )
  $.
$}

title: putnam_1996_a6
content:
:: Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1996_a6:
:: the complete classification of continuous real functions satisfying
:: f(x) = f(x^2+c) for a positive real parameter c. This file contains no proof.

environ

  vocabularies NUMBERS, REAL_1, COMPLEX1, SUBSET_1, SEQ_1, PARTFUN1,
    ARYTM_3, XXREAL_1, TARSKI, RELAT_1, ORDINAL2, FUNCT_1, CARD_1,

title: putnam_1996_a6

% Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1996_a6:
% the continuous real functions satisfying f(x) = f(x^2 + c) are classified
% according to whether the positive real parameter c is at most 1/4.
% This file contains no proof.

putnam_1996_a6: THEORY
BEGIN
  real_function: TYPE = [real -> real]

  continuous(f: real_function): bool =
    FORALL (x: real), (epsilon_value: posreal):
      EXISTS (delta: posreal):
        FORALL (y: real):
          abs(y - x) < delta IMPLIES
            abs(f(y) - f(x)) < epsilon_value

  continuous_on_closed_interval(
      f: real_function,
      a, b: real): bool =
    FORALL (x: real):
      (a <= x AND x <= b) IMPLIES
        FORALL (epsilon_value: posreal):
          EXISTS (delta: posreal):
            FORALL (y: real):
              ((a <= y AND y <= b)
                AND abs(y - x) < delta)
                IMPLIES
                  abs(f(y) - f(x)) < epsilon_value

  putnam_1996_a6_solution(c: real, f: real_function): bool =
    IF c <= 1 / 4 THEN
      EXISTS (d: real):
        FORALL (x: real):
          f(x) = d
    ELSE
      continuous_on_closed_interval(f, 0, c)
        AND f(0) = f(c)
        AND (FORALL (x: real):
          x > 0 IMPLIES
            f(x) = f(x ^ 2 + c))
        AND (FORALL (x: real):
          x < 0 IMPLIES
            f(x) = f(-x))
    ENDIF

  putnam_1996_a6: bool =
    FORALL (c: real), (f: real_function):
      c > 0 IMPLIES
        ((continuous(f)
          AND (FORALL (x: real):
            f(x) = f(x ^ 2 + c)))
          IFF putnam_1996_a6_solution(c, f))
END putnam_1996_a6

(npos : n ≥ 1)

(* Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench artifact putnam_1996_b1:
   counting the minimal finite subsets of {1,...,n} that contain their own
   cardinality; this file contains no proof. *)

From Stdlib Require Import List Sorting.Sorted Arith.PeanoNat Finite_sets.

Definition putnam_1996_b1_canonical_set (s : list nat) : Prop :=
  StronglySorted Nat.lt s.

Definition putnam_1996_b1_included
    (s t : list nat) : Prop :=
  forall x : nat, List.In x s -> List.In x t.

Definition putnam_1996_b1_proper_subset
    (s t : list nat) : Prop :=
  putnam_1996_b1_included s t /\
  exists x : nat, List.In x t /\ ~ List.In x s.

Definition putnam_1996_b1_selfish (s : list nat) : Prop :=
  List.In (List.length s) s.

Definition putnam_1996_b1_bounded
    (n : nat) (s : list nat) : Prop :=
  forall x : nat,
    List.In x s ->
    1 <= x /\ x <= n.

Definition putnam_1996_b1_minimal_selfish
    (n : nat) (s : list nat) : Prop :=
  putnam_1996_b1_canonical_set s /\
  putnam_1996_b1_bounded n s /\
  putnam_1996_b1_selfish s /\
  forall ss : list nat,
    putnam_1996_b1_canonical_set ss ->
    putnam_1996_b1_proper_subset ss s ->
    ~ putnam_1996_b1_selfish ss.

Fixpoint putnam_1996_b1_fibonacci_pair (n : nat) : nat * nat :=
  match n with
  | O => (O, 1)
  | S k =>
      let '(a, b) := putnam_1996_b1_fibonacci_pair k in
      (b, a + b)
  end.

Definition putnam_1996_b1_solution (n : nat) : nat :=
  fst (putnam_1996_b1_fibonacci_pair n).

Theorem putnam_1996_b1
    (n : nat)
    (npos : 1 <= n) :
  cardinal
    (list nat)
    (putnam_1996_b1_minimal_selfish n)
    (putnam_1996_b1_solution n).
Admitted.

title: putnam_1996_b1

;; Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1996_b1:
;; the number of minimal selfish subsets of {1,...,n}, for positive natural
;; n, is the nth Fibonacci number. This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

;; The list (1 ... n) is a duplicate-free enumeration of the source interval.
;; Its recursively generated powerset contains each extensional subset exactly
;; once. Thus list length is set cardinality, and the searches below range over
;; all source subsets and all proper subsets without externalizing witnesses.

(defun putnam-1996-b1-one-through (n)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix n)))
  (if (or (not (natp n))
          (zp n))
      nil
    (append
     (putnam-1996-b1-one-through (- n 1))
     (list n))))

(defun putnam-1996-b1-adjoin-to-each (element sets)
  (if (endp sets)
      nil
    (cons
     (cons element (car sets))
     (putnam-1996-b1-adjoin-to-each
      element (cdr sets)))))

(defun putnam-1996-b1-powerset (carrier)
  (if (endp carrier)
      (list nil)
    (let ((tail-powerset
           (putnam-1996-b1-powerset (cdr carrier))))
      (append
       tail-powerset
       (putnam-1996-b1-adjoin-to-each
        (car carrier) tail-powerset)))))

(defun putnam-1996-b1-subsetp-equal (left right)
  (if (endp left)
      t
    (and
     (member-equal (car left) right)
     (putnam-1996-b1-subsetp-equal
      (cdr left) right))))

(defun putnam-1996-b1-proper-subset-p (left right)
  (and
   (putnam-1996-b1-subsetp-equal left right)
   (not
    (putnam-1996-b1-subsetp-equal right left))))

(defun putnam-1996-b1-selfish-p (subset)
  (member-equal (len subset) subset))

(defun putnam-1996-b1-no-proper-selfish-subset-p
    (candidates subset)
  (if (endp candidates)
      t
    (and
     (implies
      (putnam-1996-b1-proper-subset-p
       (car candidates) subset)
      (not
       (putnam-1996-b1-selfish-p
        (car candidates))))
     (putnam-1996-b1-no-proper-selfish-subset-p
      (cdr candidates) subset))))

(defun putnam-1996-b1-minimal-selfish-p (subset)
  (and
   (putnam-1996-b1-selfish-p subset)
   (putnam-1996-b1-no-proper-selfish-subset-p
    (putnam-1996-b1-powerset subset)
    subset)))

(defun putnam-1996-b1-count-minimal-selfish (subsets)
  (if (endp subsets)
      0
    (+
     (if (putnam-1996-b1-minimal-selfish-p
          (car subsets))
         1
       0)
     (putnam-1996-b1-count-minimal-selfish
      (cdr subsets)))))

;; This is the source solution recurrence: F(0)=0, F(1)=1, and
;; F(n+2)=F(n)+F(n+1).
(defun putnam-1996-b1-fibonacci (n)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix n)))
  (if (or (not (natp n))
          (zp n))
      0
    (if (equal n 1)
        1
      (+
       (putnam-1996-b1-fibonacci (- n 1))
       (putnam-1996-b1-fibonacci (- n 2))))))

(defun putnambench-putnam-1996-b1-statement (n)
  (implies
   (and
    (natp n)
    (<= 1 n))
   (equal
    (putnam-1996-b1-count-minimal-selfish
     (putnam-1996-b1-powerset
      (putnam-1996-b1-one-through n)))
    (putnam-1996-b1-fibonacci n))))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

-- Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1996_b1:
-- the number of minimal finite subsets of {1,...,n} that contain their own
-- cardinality is the nth Fibonacci number. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

open import Agda.Builtin.Bool using (Bool; true)
open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_)

infix 4 _<=N_
infixr 3 _and_

data Bottom : Set where

Not : Set -> Set
Not A =
  A -> Bottom

record _and_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

data _<=N_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set where
  zero<=N   : {n : Nat} -> zero <=N n
  suc<=sucN : {m n : Nat} -> m <=N n -> suc m <=N suc n

data Fin : Nat -> Set where
  fzero : {n : Nat} -> Fin (suc n)
  fsuc  : {n : Nat} -> Fin n -> Fin (suc n)

record HasCardinality
  {A : Set}
  (member : A -> Set)
  (cardinality : Nat) :
  Set where

  field
    enumerate :
      Fin cardinality ->
      A
    enumerated-member :
      (index : Fin cardinality) ->
      member (enumerate index)
    enumeration-complete :
      (item : A) ->
      member item ->
      Exists (Fin cardinality)
        (\ index -> item == enumerate index)
    enumeration-injective :
      (left-index right-index : Fin cardinality) ->
      enumerate left-index == enumerate right-index ->
      left-index == right-index

record FiniteNatSet : Set where
  constructor finiteNatSet
  field
    membership      : Nat -> Bool
    size            : Nat
    has-cardinality :
      HasCardinality
        (\ n -> membership n == true)
        size

open FiniteNatSet

SameFiniteNatSet :
  FiniteNatSet ->
  FiniteNatSet ->
  Set
SameFiniteNatSet left right =
  (n : Nat) ->
  membership left n == membership right n

SubsetOf :
  FiniteNatSet ->
  FiniteNatSet ->
  Set
SubsetOf left right =
  (n : Nat) ->
  membership left n == true ->
  membership right n == true

StrictSubset :
  FiniteNatSet ->
  FiniteNatSet ->
  Set
StrictSubset left right =
  SubsetOf left right
  and
  Not (SubsetOf right left)

one : Nat
one =
  suc zero

InInterval :
  Nat ->
  Nat ->
  Set
InInterval upper n =
  one <=N n
  and
  n <=N upper

ContainedInInterval :
  Nat ->
  FiniteNatSet ->
  Set
ContainedInInterval upper set =
  (n : Nat) ->
  membership set n == true ->
  InInterval upper n

Selfish :
  FiniteNatSet ->
  Set
Selfish set =
  membership set (size set) == true

MinimalSelfishWithin :
  Nat ->
  FiniteNatSet ->
  Set
MinimalSelfishWithin upper set =
  ContainedInInterval upper set
  and
  Selfish set
  and
  ((subset : FiniteNatSet) ->
    StrictSubset subset set ->
    Not (Selfish subset))

record HasExtensionalCardinality
  {A : Set}
  (member : A -> Set)
  (equivalent : A -> A -> Set)
  (cardinality : Nat) :
  Set where

  field
    enumerate :
      Fin cardinality ->
      A
    enumerated-member :
      (index : Fin cardinality) ->
      member (enumerate index)
    enumeration-complete :
      (item : A) ->
      member item ->
      Exists (Fin cardinality)
        (\ index -> equivalent item (enumerate index))
    enumeration-injective :
      (left-index right-index : Fin cardinality) ->
      equivalent (enumerate left-index) (enumerate right-index) ->
      left-index == right-index

fibonacci : Nat -> Nat
fibonacci zero =
  zero
fibonacci (suc zero) =
  one
fibonacci (suc (suc n)) =
  fibonacci n + fibonacci (suc n)

putnam-1996-b1-solution :
  Nat ->
  Nat
putnam-1996-b1-solution =
  fibonacci

putnam-1996-b1 : Set
putnam-1996-b1 =
  (n : Nat) ->
  one <=N n ->
  HasExtensionalCardinality
    (MinimalSelfishWithin n)
    SameFiniteNatSet
    (putnam-1996-b1-solution n)

% Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1996_b1:
% the number of minimal selfish subsets of the natural numbers from 1 through
% n, where a set is selfish when it contains its cardinality. This file contains no proof.

putnam_1996_b1: THEORY
BEGIN
  IMPORTING
    finite_sets[nat],
    finite_sets_of_sets[nat]

  natural_set: TYPE = finite_set[nat]
  natural_set_family: TYPE = finite_set[natural_set]

  fibonacci(index: nat): RECURSIVE nat =
    IF index = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSIF index = 1 THEN
      1
    ELSE
      fibonacci(index - 1) + fibonacci(index - 2)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE index

  putnam_1996_b1_solution(n: nat): nat =
    fibonacci(n)

  is_one_through(universe: natural_set, n: nat): bool =
    FORALL (j: nat):
      universe(j) IFF (1 <= j AND j <= n)

  selfish(S: natural_set): bool =
    S(card(S))

  minimal_selfish_subsets(
      universe: natural_set): natural_set_family =
    intersection(
      powerset(universe),
      {S: natural_set |
        selfish(S)
          AND
            (FORALL (SS: natural_set):
              strict_subset?(SS, S) IMPLIES NOT selfish(SS))})

  putnam_1996_b1: bool =
    FORALL (n: nat):
      n >= 1 IMPLIES
        EXISTS (universe: natural_set):
          is_one_through(universe, n)
            AND card(minimal_selfish_subsets(universe))
              = putnam_1996_b1_solution(n)
END putnam_1996_b1

       (putnam-1996-b2-factorial (- n 1)))))

;; For natural K, this exact rational prefix is
;;   sum_(j < TERMS) K^j/j!,
;; and increases to exp(K).
(defun putnam-1996-b2-exp-lower (k terms)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix terms)))
  (if (zp terms)
      0
    (let ((degree (- terms 1)))
      (+ (putnam-1996-b2-exp-lower k degree)
         (/ (expt k degree)
            (putnam-1996-b2-factorial degree))))))

;; When TERMS > K, the omitted Taylor tail begins with K^TERMS/TERMS!,
;; and successive-term ratios are at most K/(TERMS+1). Thus this is an
;; exact rational upper enclosure for exp(K), converging to exp(K).
(defun putnam-1996-b2-exp-upper (k terms)
  (if (and (natp k)
           (natp terms)
           (< k terms))
      (+ (putnam-1996-b2-exp-lower k terms)
         (* (/ (expt k terms)
               (putnam-1996-b2-factorial terms))
            (/ (+ terms 1)
               (- (+ terms 1) k))))
    0))

;; Put M=2*N-1, U=2*N+1, and P=1*3*...*M. Positivity makes the two
;; source inequalities equivalent, after squaring, to
;;
;;   M^M < P^2*exp(M)  and  P^2*exp(U) < U^U.
;;
;; For positive integer K, exp(K) is transcendental, so neither comparison
;; can be equality. Consequently the first strict inequality is equivalent
;; to M^M being at most every rational upper enclosure of P^2*exp(M), and
;; the second is equivalent to every rational lower enclosure of P^2*exp(U)
;; being at most U^U. TERMS is therefore a universal precision probe, not an
;; existential witness; ranging over all TERMS > U gives exactly the two
;; source real inequalities.
(defun putnambench-putnam-1996-b2-statement (n terms)
  (implies
   (and (posp n)
        (natp terms)
        (< (+ (* 2 n) 1) terms))
   (let* ((m (- (* 2 n) 1))
          (u (+ (* 2 n) 1))
          (product (putnam-1996-b2-odd-product n))
          (product-squared (* product product)))
     (and
      (<= (expt m m)
          (* product-squared
             (putnam-1996-b2-exp-upper m terms)))
      (<= (* product-squared
             (putnam-1996-b2-exp-lower u terms))
          (expt u u))))))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

title: putnam_1996_b2
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1996_b2:
-- for every positive integer n, the product 1 * 3 * ... * (2n - 1) lies
-- strictly between the stated real-power bounds involving exp(1).
-- This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module Main where

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; _*_)

infix 4 _!=_ _<=N_ _<N_
infixr 3 _and_
infixr 2 _or_

data Bottom : Set where

Not : Set -> Set
Not A =
  A -> Bottom

_!=_ : {A : Set} -> A -> A -> Set
x != y =
  Not (x == y)

record _and_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data _or_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  left  : A -> A or B
  right : B -> A or B

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

data _<=N_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set where
  zero<=N   : {n : Nat} -> zero <=N n
  suc<=sucN : {m n : Nat} -> m <=N n -> suc m <=N suc n

data _<N_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set where
  zero<sucN : {n : Nat} -> zero <N suc n
  suc<sucN  : {m n : Nat} -> m <N n -> suc m <N suc n

record CompleteOrderedRealField (R : Set) : Set1 where
  field
    zeroR oneR : R
    add multiply : R -> R -> R
    negate inverse : R -> R
    lessOrEqual : R -> R -> Set
    fromNat : Nat -> R

    one-not-zero :
      oneR != zeroR

    add-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> add x y == add y x
    add-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      add (add x y) z == add x (add y z)
    add-zero :
      (x : R) -> add x zeroR == x
    add-inverse :
      (x : R) -> add x (negate x) == zeroR

    multiply-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> multiply x y == multiply y x
    multiply-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply (multiply x y) z ==
      multiply x (multiply y z)
    multiply-one :
      (x : R) -> multiply x oneR == x
    multiply-zero :
      (x : R) -> multiply x zeroR == zeroR
    distribute :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply x (add y z) ==
      add (multiply x y) (multiply x z)
    inverse-zero :
      inverse zeroR == zeroR
    multiply-inverse :
      (x : R) ->
      x != zeroR ->
      multiply x (inverse x) == oneR

    order-reflexive :
      (x : R) -> lessOrEqual x x
    order-transitive :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y z ->
      lessOrEqual x z
    order-antisymmetric :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y x ->
      x == y
    order-total :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y or lessOrEqual y x
    add-order :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual (add z x) (add z y)
    multiply-nonnegative :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR x ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR y ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR (multiply x y)
    zero-less-than-one :
      lessOrEqual zeroR oneR and zeroR != oneR

    fromNat-zero :
      fromNat zero == zeroR
    fromNat-successor :
      (n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (suc n) == add (fromNat n) oneR
    fromNat-addition :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m + n) == add (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-multiplication :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m * n) == multiply (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-injective :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat m == fromNat n ->
      m == n

    archimedean :
      (x : R) ->
      Exists Nat
        (\ n ->
          lessOrEqual x (fromNat n))
    least-upper-bound :
      (P : R -> Set) ->
      Exists R P ->
      Exists R
        (\ upper ->
          (x : R) ->
          P x ->
          lessOrEqual x upper) ->
      Exists R
        (\ supremum ->
          ((x : R) ->
            P x ->
            lessOrEqual x supremum)
          and
          ((upper : R) ->
            ((x : R) ->
              P x ->
              lessOrEqual x upper) ->
            lessOrEqual supremum upper))

open CompleteOrderedRealField

oneN : Nat
oneN =
  suc zero

twoN : Nat
twoN =
  suc oneN

subtract :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
subtract reals x y =
  add reals x (negate reals y)

divide :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
divide reals x y =
  multiply reals x (inverse reals y)

StrictLess :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
StrictLess reals x y =
  lessOrEqual reals x y and x != y

CloseTo :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
CloseTo reals center radius x =
  StrictLess reals
    (subtract reals center radius)
    x
  and
  StrictLess reals
    x
    (add reals center radius)

naturalPower :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  Nat ->
  R
naturalPower reals x zero =
  oneR reals
naturalPower reals x (suc n) =
  multiply reals
    (naturalPower reals x n)
    x

factorial : Nat -> Nat
factorial zero =
  oneN
factorial (suc n) =
  suc n * factorial n

sumFirst :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Nat ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  R
sumFirst reals zero term =
  zeroR reals
sumFirst reals (suc n) term =
  add reals
    (sumFirst reals n term)
    (term n)

ConvergesTo :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  R ->
  Set
ConvergesTo {R} reals sequence limit =
  (epsilon : R) ->
  StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) epsilon ->
  Exists Nat
    (\ cutoff ->
      (n : Nat) ->
      cutoff <=N n ->
      CloseTo reals limit epsilon (sequence n))

SeriesHasSum :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  R ->
  Set
SeriesHasSum reals terms limit =
  ConvergesTo reals
    (\ n -> sumFirst reals n terms)
    limit

exponentialTerm :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  Nat ->
  R
exponentialTerm reals x n =
  divide reals
    (naturalPower reals x n)
    (fromNat reals (factorial n))

ExponentialValue :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
ExponentialValue reals x value =
  SeriesHasSum reals
    (exponentialTerm reals x)
    value

record StandardRealPowers
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) :
  Set1 where

  field
    exponential logarithm : R -> R

    exponential-series :
      (x : R) ->
      ExponentialValue reals x (exponential x)

    exponential-positive :
      (x : R) ->
      StrictLess reals
        (zeroR reals)
        (exponential x)

    exponential-injective :
      (x y : R) ->
      exponential x == exponential y ->
      x == y

    exponential-logarithm :
      (x : R) ->
      StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) x ->
      exponential (logarithm x) == x

open StandardRealPowers

realPower :
  {R : Set} ->
  {reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R} ->
  StandardRealPowers reals ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
realPower {reals = reals} powers base exponent =
  exponential powers
    (multiply reals exponent (logarithm powers base))

twiceMinusOne : Nat -> Nat
twiceMinusOne zero =
  zero
twiceMinusOne (suc n) =
  suc (n + n)

twicePlusOne : Nat -> Nat
twicePlusOne n =
  suc (n + n)

oddProduct :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Nat ->
  R
oddProduct reals zero =
  oneR reals
oddProduct reals (suc n) =
  multiply reals
    (oddProduct reals n)
    (fromNat reals (twicePlusOne n))

module Putnam1996B2Statement
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R)
  (powers : StandardRealPowers reals) where

  e : R
  e =
    exponential powers (oneR reals)

  lowerBound : Nat -> R
  lowerBound n =
    let
      odd = fromNat reals (twiceMinusOne n)
    in
    realPower powers
      (divide reals odd e)
      (divide reals odd (fromNat reals twoN))

  upperBound : Nat -> R
  upperBound n =
    let
      odd = fromNat reals (twicePlusOne n)
    in
    realPower powers
      (divide reals odd e)
      (divide reals odd (fromNat reals twoN))

  proposition : Nat -> Set
  proposition n =
    zero <N n ->
    StrictLess reals
      (lowerBound n)
      (oddProduct reals n)
    and
    StrictLess reals
      (oddProduct reals n)
      (upperBound n)

putnam-1996-b2 : Set1
putnam-1996-b2 =
  (R : Set) ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) ->
  (powers : StandardRealPowers reals) ->
  (n : Nat) ->
  Putnam1996B2Statement.proposition reals powers n

% Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1996_b2:
% for every positive integer n, the product 1 * 3 * ... * (2n - 1) lies
% strictly between the stated real-power bounds involving e. This file
% contains no proof.

putnam_1996_b2: THEORY
BEGIN
  real_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> real]

  safe_div(numerator, denominator: real): real =
    IF denominator = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      numerator / denominator
    ENDIF

  nat_factorial(index: nat): RECURSIVE nat =
    IF index = 0 THEN
      1
    ELSE
      index * nat_factorial(index - 1)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE index

  exponential_partial(x: real, count: nat): RECURSIVE real =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      LET index: nat = count - 1 IN
        exponential_partial(x, count - 1)
          + safe_div(
              x ^ index,
              nat_factorial(index) :: real)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  converges_to(sequence: real_sequence, value: real): bool =
    FORALL (epsilon_value: posreal):
      EXISTS (cutoff: nat):
        FORALL (index: nat):
          cutoff <= index IMPLIES
            abs(sequence(index) - value) < epsilon_value

  real_exponential(x: real): real =
    epsilon(
      LAMBDA (value: real):
        converges_to(
          LAMBDA (count: nat):
            exponential_partial(x, count),
          value))

  natural_log(x: real): real =
    IF x > 0 THEN
      epsilon(
        LAMBDA (value: real):
          real_exponential(value) = x)
    ELSE
      0
    ENDIF

  real_power(base, exponent: real): real =
    IF base > 0 THEN
      real_exponential(exponent * natural_log(base))
    ELSIF base = 0 AND exponent = 0 THEN
      1
    ELSE
      0
    ENDIF

  odd_product(n: nat): RECURSIVE real =
    IF n = 0 THEN
      1
    ELSE
      odd_product(n - 1) * ((2 * n - 1) :: real)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE n

  putnam_1996_b2: bool =
    FORALL (n: nat):
      n > 0 IMPLIES
        real_power(
          safe_div(
            (2 * n - 1) :: real,
            real_exponential(1)),
          ((2 * n - 1) :: real) / 2)
          < odd_product(n)
        AND odd_product(n)
          < real_power(
              safe_div(
                (2 * n + 1) :: real,
                real_exponential(1)),
              ((2 * n + 1) :: real) / 2)
END putnam_1996_b2

import Mathlib

open Function

-- Note: uses (ℕ → ℕ) instead of (Fin n → ℕ)
abbrev putnam_1996_b3_solution : ℕ → ℕ := sorry
-- (fun n : ℕ => (2 * n ^ 3 + 3 * n ^ 2 - 11 * n + 18) / 6)
/--
Given that $\{x_1,x_2,\ldots,x_n\}=\{1,2,\ldots,n\}$, find, with proof, the largest possible value, as a function of $n$ (with $n \geq 2$), of $x_1x_2+x_2x_3+\cdots+x_{n-1}x_n+x_nx_1$.
-/
theorem putnam_1996_b3
  (n : ℕ) (hn : n ≥ 2) :
  IsGreatest
  {k | ∃ x : ℕ → ℤ,
    (x '' (Finset.range n) = Set.Icc (1 : ℤ) n) ∧
    ∑ i : Fin n, x i * x ((i + 1) % n) = k}
  (putnam_1996_b3_solution n) :=
sorry

Require Import Reals Coquelicot.Hierarchy Nat.
Definition putnam_1996_b3_solution : nat -> R := (fun n => (2 * INR n ^ 3 + 3 * INR n ^ 2 - 11 * INR n + 18) / 6).
Theorem putnam_1996_b3
    (n : nat)
    (xset : (nat -> nat) -> Prop := (fun x : nat -> nat => forall y : nat, (le 1 y /\ le y n) -> exists! i, (le 0 i /\ le i (n - 1)) /\ x i = y))
    (xsum : (nat -> nat) -> R := (fun x : nat -> nat => sum_n (fun i : nat => INR (x i) * INR (x ((i + 1) mod n))) (n - 1)))
    (nge2 : ge n 2)
    : (exists x : nat -> nat, xset x /\ xsum x = putnam_1996_b3_solution n) /\ (forall x : nat -> nat, xset x -> xsum x <= putnam_1996_b3_solution n).
Proof. Admitted.

  (2n^3 + 3n^2 - 11n + 18) / 6 for n at least two. This file contains no proof.

;; Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1996_b3:
;; for n at least 2, the greatest cyclic adjacent-product sum over all
;; permutations of 1 through n has the stated cubic value. This file contains
;; no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

;; Restricting a source function x to indices 0,...,n-1 gives exactly one
;; permutation list below, and every such list extends to a source function
;; arbitrarily outside those indices. Thus this finite representation is
;; bidirectionally equivalent to the function-based source statement.

(defun putnam-1996-b3-one-through (n)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix n)))
  (if (or (not (natp n))
          (zp n))
      nil
    (append
     (putnam-1996-b3-one-through (- n 1))
     (list n))))

(defun putnam-1996-b3-prepend-each (value lists)
  (if (endp lists)
      nil
    (cons
     (cons value (car lists))
     (putnam-1996-b3-prepend-each value (cdr lists)))))

(defun putnam-1996-b3-insert-everywhere (value values)
  (if (endp values)
      (list (list value))
    (cons
     (cons value values)
     (putnam-1996-b3-prepend-each
      (car values)
      (putnam-1996-b3-insert-everywhere
       value (cdr values))))))

(defun putnam-1996-b3-insert-into-permutations
    (value permutations)
  (if (endp permutations)
      nil
    (append
     (putnam-1996-b3-insert-everywhere
      value (car permutations))
     (putnam-1996-b3-insert-into-permutations

-- Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1996_b3
-- (putnambench__agda__putnam_1996_b3): the largest cyclic adjacent-product
-- sum over permutations of 1 through n has the stated cubic value. This file
-- contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using
  (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; _-_; _*_; div-helper; mod-helper)

infix 4 _<=N_
infixr 3 _and_

record _and_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

data _<=N_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set where
  zero<=N   : {n : Nat} -> zero <=N n
  suc<=sucN : {m n : Nat} -> m <=N n -> suc m <=N suc n

data Fin : Nat -> Set where
  fzero : {n : Nat} -> Fin (suc n)
  fsuc  : {n : Nat} -> Fin n -> Fin (suc n)

finToNat : {n : Nat} -> Fin n -> Nat
finToNat fzero =
  zero
finToNat (fsuc i) =
  suc (finToNat i)

naturalDiv : Nat -> Nat -> Nat
naturalDiv numerator zero =
  zero
naturalDiv numerator (suc denominator) =
  div-helper zero denominator numerator denominator

naturalMod : Nat -> Nat -> Nat
naturalMod numerator zero =
  zero
naturalMod numerator (suc denominator) =
  mod-helper zero denominator numerator denominator

sumFinNat :
  {n : Nat} ->
  (Fin n -> Nat) ->
  Nat
sumFinNat {zero} terms =
  zero
sumFinNat {suc n} terms =
  terms fzero + sumFinNat (\ i -> terms (fsuc i))

oneN : Nat
oneN =
  suc zero

twoN : Nat
twoN =
  suc oneN

sixN : Nat
sixN =
  6

InOneThrough :
  Nat ->
  Nat ->
  Set
InOneThrough n value =
  oneN <=N value
  and
  value <=N n

PermutationOfOneThrough :
  Nat ->
  (Nat -> Nat) ->
  Set
PermutationOfOneThrough n x =
  ((i : Fin n) ->
    InOneThrough n (x (finToNat i)))
  and
  ((value : Nat) ->
    InOneThrough n value ->
    Exists (Fin n)
      (\ i -> x (finToNat i) == value))

CyclicAdjacentProductSum :
  Nat ->
  (Nat -> Nat) ->
  Nat
CyclicAdjacentProductSum n x =
  sumFinNat {n}
    (\ i ->
      x (finToNat i)
      *
      x (naturalMod (suc (finToNat i)) n))

putnam-1996-b3-solution :
  Nat ->
  Nat
putnam-1996-b3-solution n =
  naturalDiv
    (((2 * n * n * n) + (3 * n * n) + 18) - (11 * n))
    sixN

record IsGreatestCyclicSum
  (n maximum : Nat) :
  Set where

  field
    attained :
      Exists (Nat -> Nat)
        (\ x ->
          PermutationOfOneThrough n x
          and
          CyclicAdjacentProductSum n x == maximum)

    upper-bound :
      (x : Nat -> Nat) ->
      PermutationOfOneThrough n x ->
      CyclicAdjacentProductSum n x <=N maximum

putnam-1996-b3 : Set
putnam-1996-b3 =
  (n : Nat) ->
  twoN <=N n ->
  IsGreatestCyclicSum n (putnam-1996-b3-solution n)

(*
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1996_b3:
  the largest cyclic sum of adjacent products over permutations of the
  integers from 1 through n. This file contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open arithmeticTheory pred_setTheory;

val putnam_1996_b3 =
  ``!n : num.
      2 <= n
      ==>
      let values = IMAGE SUC (count n)
      in
      let cyclic_sum =
        \x : num -> num.
          SIGMA
            (\i : num. x i * x ((i + 1) MOD n))
            (count n)
      in
      let solution =
        (2 * n ** 3 + 3 * n ** 2 + 18 - 11 * n) DIV 6
      in
        (?x : num -> num.
           IMAGE x (count n) = values /\
           cyclic_sum x = solution) /\
        (!x : num -> num.
           IMAGE x (count n) = values
           ==>
           cyclic_sum x <= solution)``;

  putnam_1996_b3: for every integer n at least two, the largest cyclic
  adjacent-product sum over permutations of 1 through n has the stated
  cubic closed form. This file contains no proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  The carrier 0 ..^ n consists of the n indices 0 through n - 1, and
  1 ... n consists of the n values 1 through n. Thus a bijection x between
  these carriers is exactly a source sequence whose entries are a
  permutation of 1 through n. The summand at i multiplies x(i) by the next
  cyclic entry x((i+1) mod n).

  The first conjunct states that some permutation attains the displayed
  value. The second states that every permutation has cyclic sum at most
  that value. Together they are the source greatest-value assertion, with
  the annotated solution inlined. The final declaration is a single
  unproved $a corpus statement; this database contains no $p proof.
$)

${
  $d i n x $.

  putnambench-putnam-1996-b3 $a |- A. n e. NN
    (
      2 <_ n
      ->
      (
        E. x
          (
            x : ( 0 ..^ n ) -1-1-onto-> ( 1 ... n )
            /\
            (
              sum_ i e. ( 0 ..^ n )
                ( ( x ` i ) x. ( x ` ( ( i + 1 ) mod n ) ) )
            )
            =
            (
              (
                (
                  ( 2 x. ( n ^ 3 ) )
                  +
                  ( 3 x. ( n ^ 2 ) )
                )
                -
                ( ; 1 1 x. n )
              )
              +
              ; 1 8
            )
            /
            6
          )
        /\
        A. x
          (
            x : ( 0 ..^ n ) -1-1-onto-> ( 1 ... n )
            ->
            (
              sum_ i e. ( 0 ..^ n )
                ( ( x ` i ) x. ( x ` ( ( i + 1 ) mod n ) ) )

            (

                (
                  ( 2 x. ( n ^ 3 ) )
                  +
                  ( 3 x. ( n ^ 2 ) )
                )
                -
                ( ; 1 1 x. n )
              )
              +
              ; 1 8
            )

title: putnam_1996_b3
content:
% Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1996_b3:
% the maximum cyclic sum of adjacent products over permutations of 1 through n
% is (2*n^3 + 3*n^2 - 11*n + 18)/6 for n at least two. This file contains no
% proof.

putnam_1996_b3: THEORY
BEGIN
  natural_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> nat]

  permutation_of_first_n(
      x: natural_sequence,
      n: nat): bool =
    FORALL (value: nat):
      (EXISTS (index: nat):
        index < n AND x(index) = value)
      IFF (1 <= value AND value <= n)

  cyclic_successor(index, n: nat): nat =
    IF index + 1 = n THEN 0 ELSE index + 1 ENDIF

  cyclic_product_sum(
      x: natural_sequence,
      n, count: nat): RECURSIVE nat =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      cyclic_product_sum(x, n, count - 1)
        + x(count - 1)
            * x(cyclic_successor(count - 1, n))
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  objective(x: natural_sequence, n: nat): real =
    cyclic_product_sum(x, n, n) :: real

  putnam_1996_b3_solution(n: nat): real =
    (2 * (n :: real) ^ 3
      + 3 * (n :: real) ^ 2
      - 11 * (n :: real)
      + 18) / 6

  putnam_1996_b3: bool =
    FORALL (n: nat):
      n >= 2 IMPLIES
        (EXISTS (x: natural_sequence):
          permutation_of_first_n(x, n)
            AND objective(x, n) = putnam_1996_b3_solution(n))
        AND
          (FORALL (x: natural_sequence):
            permutation_of_first_n(x, n)
              IMPLIES
                objective(x, n) <= putnam_1996_b3_solution(n))
END putnam_1996_b3

import Mathlib

abbrev putnam_1996_b4_solution : Prop := sorry
-- False
/--
For any square matrix $A$, we can define $\sin A$ by the usual power series: $\sin A=\sum_{n=0}^\infty \frac{(-1)^n}{(2n+1)!}A^{2n+1}$. Prove or disprove: there exists a $2 \times 2$ matrix $A$ with real entries such that $\sin A=\begin{pmatrix} 1 & 1996 \\ 0 & 1 \end{pmatrix}$.
-/
theorem putnam_1996_b4
(matsin : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ → Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ)
(mat1996 : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ)
(hmatsin : ∀ A, matsin A = ∑' n : ℕ, ((-(1 : ℝ)) ^ n / (2 * n + 1)!) • A ^ (2 * n + 1))
(hmat1996 : mat1996 0 0 = 1 ∧ mat1996 0 1 = 1996 ∧ mat1996 1 0 = 0 ∧ mat1996 1 1 = 1)
: (∃ A, matsin A = mat1996) ↔ putnam_1996_b4_solution :=
sorry

Open Scope R.
Definition putnam_1996_b4_solution := False.
Theorem putnam_1996_b4
    (Mmultn := fix Mmult_n {T : Ring} {n : nat} (A : matrix n n) (p : nat) :=
        match p with
        | O => mk_matrix n n (fun i j : nat => if Nat.eqb i j then one else zero)
        | S p' => @Mmult T n n n A (Mmult_n A p')
    end)
    (scale_c : R -> matrix 2 2 -> matrix 2 2 := fun c A =>  mk_matrix 2 2 (fun i j => c * coeff_mat 0 A i j))
    (sinA_mat : nat -> matrix 2 2 -> matrix 2 2 := fun n A => scale_c ((pow (-1) n) / INR (fact (2 * n + 1))) (Mmultn A (Nat.add (Nat.mul 2 n) 1)))
    : (exists (A: matrix 2 2), 
    Series (fun n => coeff_mat 0 (sinA_mat n A) 0 0) = 1    /\
    Series (fun n => coeff_mat 0 (sinA_mat n A) 0 1) = 1996 /\
    Series (fun n => coeff_mat 0 (sinA_mat n A) 1 0) = 0    /\
    Series (fun n => coeff_mat 0 (sinA_mat n A) 1 1) = 1)   <->
    putnam_1996_b4_solution.
Proof. Admitted.

content:
;; Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1996_b4:
;; no real 2 by 2 matrix has matrix sine, defined by its exact power series,
;; equal to the matrix with rows (1, 1996) and (0, 1). This file contains no
;; proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))

;; The arguments of the final predicate present a Dedekind-complete ordered
;; field, hence a copy of the real field. Tame APPLY$ objects retain arbitrary
;; carrier elements and subsets, while DEFUN-SK supplies unbounded first-order
;; quantification. A 2 by 2 matrix is represented by its four entries.

(defun putnam-1996-b4-member-p (carrier value)
  (if (apply$ carrier (list value)) t nil))

(defun putnam-1996-b4-unary (operation value)
  (apply$ operation (list value)))

(defun putnam-1996-b4-binary (operation left right)
  (apply$ operation (list left right)))

(defun-sk putnam-1996-b4-field-laws-p
    (carrier zero one add multiply negate inverse)
  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (putnam-1996-b4-member-p carrier x)
      (putnam-1996-b4-member-p carrier y)
      (putnam-1996-b4-member-p carrier z))
     (let* ((xy-add
             (putnam-1996-b4-binary add x y))
            (yz-add
             (putnam-1996-b4-binary add y z))
            (xy-multiply
             (putnam-1996-b4-binary multiply x y))
            (yz-multiply
             (putnam-1996-b4-binary multiply y z))
            (negative-x
             (putnam-1996-b4-unary negate x))
            (inverse-x
             (putnam-1996-b4-unary inverse x)))
       (and
        (putnam-1996-b4-member-p carrier xy-add)
        (putnam-1996-b4-member-p carrier xy-multiply)
        (putnam-1996-b4-member-p carrier negative-x)
        (putnam-1996-b4-member-p carrier inverse-x)
        (equal
         (putnam-1996-b4-binary add xy-add z)
         (putnam-1996-b4-binary add x yz-add))
        (equal xy-add
               (putnam-1996-b4-binary add y x))
        (equal
         (putnam-1996-b4-binary add x zero)
         x)
        (equal
         (putnam-1996-b4-binary add x negative-x)
         zero)
        (equal
         (putnam-1996-b4-binary multiply xy-multiply z)
         (putnam-1996-b4-binary multiply x yz-multiply))
        (equal
         xy-multiply
         (putnam-1996-b4-binary multiply y x))
        (equal
         (putnam-1996-b4-binary multiply x one)
         x)
        (implies
         (equal x zero)
         (equal inverse-x zero))
        (implies
         (not (equal x zero))
         (equal
          (putnam-1996-b4-binary multiply x inverse-x)
          one))
        (equal
         (putnam-1996-b4-binary multiply x yz-add)
         (putnam-1996-b4-binary
          add
          (putnam-1996-b4-binary multiply x y)
          (putnam-1996-b4-binary multiply x z))))))))

(defun-sk putnam-1996-b4-order-laws-p
    (carrier zero add multiply less)
  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (putnam-1996-b4-member-p carrier x)
      (putnam-1996-b4-member-p carrier y)
      (putnam-1996-b4-member-p carrier z))
     (and
      (not (putnam-1996-b4-binary less x x))
      (or
       (equal x y)
       (putnam-1996-b4-binary less x y)
       (putnam-1996-b4-binary less y x))
      (implies
       (and
        (putnam-1996-b4-binary less x y)
        (putnam-1996-b4-binary less y z))
       (putnam-1996-b4-binary less x z))
      (implies
       (putnam-1996-b4-binary less x y)
       (putnam-1996-b4-binary
        less
        (putnam-1996-b4-binary add x z)
        (putnam-1996-b4-binary add y z)))
      (implies
       (and
        (putnam-1996-b4-binary less zero x)
        (putnam-1996-b4-binary less zero y))
       (putnam-1996-b4-binary
        less
        zero
        (putnam-1996-b4-binary multiply x y)))))))

(defun-sk putnam-1996-b4-valid-set-p (carrier set)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (apply$ set (list x))
     (putnam-1996-b4-member-p carrier x))))

(defun-sk putnam-1996-b4-set-nonempty-p (carrier set)
  (exists (x)
    (and
     (putnam-1996-b4-member-p carrier x)
     (apply$ set (list x)))))

(defun-sk putnam-1996-b4-upper-bound-p
    (carrier less set bound)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (and
      (putnam-1996-b4-member-p carrier x)
      (apply$ set (list x)))
     (not
      (putnam-1996-b4-binary less bound x)))))

(defun-sk putnam-1996-b4-bounded-above-p
    (carrier less set)
  (exists (bound)
    (and
     (putnam-1996-b4-member-p carrier bound)
     (putnam-1996-b4-upper-bound-p
      carrier less set bound))))

(defun-sk putnam-1996-b4-least-upper-bound-p
    (carrier less set supremum)
  (forall (bound)
    (and
     (putnam-1996-b4-member-p carrier supremum)
     (putnam-1996-b4-upper-bound-p
      carrier less set supremum)
     (implies
      (and
       (putnam-1996-b4-member-p carrier bound)
       (putnam-1996-b4-upper-bound-p
        carrier less set bound))
      (not
       (putnam-1996-b4-binary
        less bound supremum))))))

(defun-sk putnam-1996-b4-has-supremum-p
    (carrier less set)
  (exists (supremum)
    (putnam-1996-b4-least-upper-bound-p
     carrier less set supremum)))

(defun-sk putnam-1996-b4-dedekind-complete-p
    (carrier less)
  (forall (set)
    (implies
     (and
      (tamep-functionp set)
      (putnam-1996-b4-valid-set-p carrier set)
      (putnam-1996-b4-set-nonempty-p carrier set)
      (putnam-1996-b4-bounded-above-p
       carrier less set))
     (putnam-1996-b4-has-supremum-p
      carrier less set))))

(defun putnam-1996-b4-real-field-p
    (carrier zero one add multiply negate inverse less)
  (and
   (tamep-functionp carrier)
   (tamep-functionp add)
   (tamep-functionp multiply)
   (tamep-functionp negate)
   (tamep-functionp inverse)
   (tamep-functionp less)
   (putnam-1996-b4-member-p carrier zero)
   (putnam-1996-b4-member-p carrier one)
   (not (equal zero one))
   (putnam-1996-b4-field-laws-p
    carrier zero one add multiply negate inverse)
   (putnam-1996-b4-order-laws-p
    carrier zero add multiply less)
   (putnam-1996-b4-binary less zero one)
   (putnam-1996-b4-dedekind-complete-p
    carrier less)))

(defun putnam-1996-b4-r-add (add left right)
  (putnam-1996-b4-binary add left right))

(defun putnam-1996-b4-r-multiply (multiply left right)
  (putnam-1996-b4-binary multiply left right))

(defun putnam-1996-b4-r-negate (negate value)
  (putnam-1996-b4-unary negate value))

(defun putnam-1996-b4-r-absolute-value
    (zero negate less value)
  (if (putnam-1996-b4-binary less value zero)
      (putnam-1996-b4-r-negate negate value)
    value))

(defun putnam-1996-b4-r-nat (n zero one add)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix n)))
  (if (zp n)
      zero
    (putnam-1996-b4-r-add
     add
     one
     (putnam-1996-b4-r-nat
      (1- n) zero one add))))

(defun putnam-1996-b4-r-factorial
    (n zero one add multiply)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix n)))

title: putnam_1996_b4
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1996_b4
-- (putnambench__agda__putnam_1996_b4): no real 2 by 2 matrix has matrix sine
-- equal to the matrix with rows (1, 1996) and (0, 1). This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module Main where

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; _*_)

infix 4 _!=_ _<=N_
infixr 3 _and_
infixr 2 _or_

data Bottom : Set where

Not : Set -> Set
Not A =
  A -> Bottom

_!=_ : {A : Set} -> A -> A -> Set
x != y =
  Not (x == y)

record _and_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data _or_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  left  : A -> A or B
  right : B -> A or B

record Iff (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor equivalence
  field
    forward  : A -> B
    backward : B -> A

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

data _<=N_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set where
  zero<=N   : {n : Nat} -> zero <=N n
  suc<=sucN : {m n : Nat} -> m <=N n -> suc m <=N suc n

data Fin : Nat -> Set where
  fzero : {n : Nat} -> Fin (suc n)
  fsuc  : {n : Nat} -> Fin n -> Fin (suc n)

record CompleteOrderedRealField (R : Set) : Set1 where
  field
    zeroR oneR : R
    add multiply : R -> R -> R
    negate inverse : R -> R
    lessOrEqual : R -> R -> Set
    fromNat : Nat -> R

    one-not-zero :
      oneR != zeroR

    add-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> add x y == add y x
    add-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      add (add x y) z == add x (add y z)
    add-zero :
      (x : R) -> add x zeroR == x
    add-inverse :
      (x : R) -> add x (negate x) == zeroR

    multiply-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> multiply x y == multiply y x
    multiply-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply (multiply x y) z ==
      multiply x (multiply y z)
    multiply-one :
      (x : R) -> multiply x oneR == x
    multiply-zero :
      (x : R) -> multiply x zeroR == zeroR
    distribute :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply x (add y z) ==
      add (multiply x y) (multiply x z)
    inverse-zero :
      inverse zeroR == zeroR
    multiply-inverse :
      (x : R) ->
      x != zeroR ->
      multiply x (inverse x) == oneR

    order-reflexive :
      (x : R) -> lessOrEqual x x
    order-transitive :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y z ->
      lessOrEqual x z
    order-antisymmetric :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y x ->
      x == y
    order-total :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y or lessOrEqual y x
    add-order :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual (add z x) (add z y)
    multiply-nonnegative :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR x ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR y ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR (multiply x y)
    zero-less-than-one :
      lessOrEqual zeroR oneR and zeroR != oneR

    fromNat-zero :
      fromNat zero == zeroR
    fromNat-successor :
      (n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (suc n) == add (fromNat n) oneR
    fromNat-addition :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m + n) == add (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-multiplication :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m * n) == multiply (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-injective :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat m == fromNat n ->
      m == n

    archimedean :
      (x : R) ->
      Exists Nat (\ n -> lessOrEqual x (fromNat n))
    least-upper-bound :
      (P : R -> Set) ->
      Exists R P ->
      Exists R
        (\ upper ->
          (x : R) ->
          P x ->
          lessOrEqual x upper) ->
      Exists R
        (\ supremum ->
          ((x : R) ->
            P x ->
            lessOrEqual x supremum)
          and
          ((upper : R) ->
            ((x : R) ->
              P x ->
              lessOrEqual x upper) ->
            lessOrEqual supremum upper))

open CompleteOrderedRealField

oneN : Nat
oneN =
  suc zero

twoN : Nat
twoN =
  suc oneN

subtract :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
subtract reals x y =
  add reals x (negate reals y)

divide :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
divide reals x y =
  multiply reals x (inverse reals y)

StrictLess :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
StrictLess reals x y =
  lessOrEqual reals x y and x != y

CloseTo :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
CloseTo reals center radius x =
  StrictLess reals
    (subtract reals center radius)
    x
  and
  StrictLess reals
    x
    (add reals center radius)

ConvergesTo :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  R ->
  Set
ConvergesTo {R} reals sequence limit =
  (epsilon : R) ->
  StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) epsilon ->
  Exists Nat
    (\ cutoff ->
      (n : Nat) ->
      cutoff <=N n ->
      CloseTo reals limit epsilon (sequence n))

sumFirst :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Nat ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  R
sumFirst reals zero terms =
  zeroR reals
sumFirst reals (suc n) terms =
  add reals
    (sumFirst reals n terms)
    (terms n)

SeriesHasSum :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  R ->
  Set
SeriesHasSum reals terms limit =
  ConvergesTo reals
    (\ n -> sumFirst reals n terms)
    limit

factorial : Nat -> Nat
factorial zero =
  oneN
factorial (suc n) =
  suc n * factorial n

naturalPower :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  Nat ->
  R
naturalPower reals x zero =
  oneR reals
naturalPower reals x (suc n) =
  multiply reals
    (naturalPower reals x n)
    x

alternatingPower :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Nat ->
  R
alternatingPower reals n =
  naturalPower reals
    (negate reals (oneR reals))
    n

Matrix :
  Set ->
  Nat ->
  Nat ->
  Set
Matrix R rows columns =
  Fin rows -> Fin columns -> R

sumFin :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  {n : Nat} ->
  (Fin n -> R) ->
  R
sumFin reals {zero} terms =
  zeroR reals
sumFin reals {suc n} terms =
  add reals
    (terms fzero)
    (sumFin reals (\ i -> terms (fsuc i)))

matrixMultiply :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  {rows middle columns : Nat} ->
  Matrix R rows middle ->
  Matrix R middle columns ->
  Matrix R rows columns
matrixMultiply reals A B i j =
  sumFin reals
    (\ k -> multiply reals (A i k) (B k j))

identityTwo :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Matrix R twoN twoN
identityTwo reals fzero fzero =
  oneR reals
identityTwo reals fzero (fsuc fzero) =
  zeroR reals
identityTwo reals (fsuc fzero) fzero =
  zeroR reals
identityTwo reals (fsuc fzero) (fsuc fzero) =
  oneR reals

matrixPower :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Matrix R twoN twoN ->
  Nat ->
  Matrix R twoN twoN
matrixPower reals A zero =
  identityTwo reals
matrixPower reals A (suc n) =
  matrixMultiply reals A (matrixPower reals A n)

matrixSineTerm :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Matrix R twoN twoN ->
  Fin twoN ->
  Fin twoN ->
  Nat ->
  R
matrixSineTerm reals A i j n =
  divide reals
    (multiply reals
      (alternatingPower reals n)
      (matrixPower reals A (suc (twoN * n)) i j))
    (fromNat reals (factorial (suc (twoN * n))))

targetMatrix :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Matrix R twoN twoN
targetMatrix reals fzero fzero =
  oneR reals
targetMatrix reals fzero (fsuc fzero) =
  fromNat reals 1996
targetMatrix reals (fsuc fzero) fzero =
  zeroR reals
targetMatrix reals (fsuc fzero) (fsuc fzero) =
  oneR reals

MatrixSineEqualsTarget :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Matrix R twoN twoN ->
  Set
MatrixSineEqualsTarget reals A =
  (i j : Fin twoN) ->
  SeriesHasSum reals
    (matrixSineTerm reals A i j)
    (targetMatrix reals i j)

putnam-1996-b4-solution : Set
putnam-1996-b4-solution =
  Bottom

putnam-1996-b4 : Set1
putnam-1996-b4 =
  (R : Set) ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) ->
  Iff
    (Exists (Matrix R twoN twoN)
      (MatrixSineEqualsTarget reals))
    putnam-1996-b4-solution

(*

  no real 2 by 2 matrix has matrix sine, defined by its usual power series,
  equal to the matrix [[1, 1996], [0, 1]]. This file contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open arithmeticTheory fcpTheory realTheory real_sigmaTheory seqTheory;
open matrixTheory;

val putnam_1996_b4 =
  ``let matrix_pow =
      \A : real['N]['N].
        \n : num.
          FUNPOW
            (\B : real['N]['N]. matrix$matrix_mul A B)
            n
            (matrix$mat 1)
    in
    let matsin =
      \A : real['N]['N].
        ((FCP i j.
            suminf
              (\n : num.
                 ((~1 : real) pow n / &(FACT (2 * n + 1))) *
                 (matrix_pow A (2 * n + 1)) ' i ' j)) :
          real['N]['N])
    in
    let mat1996 =
      ((FCP i j.
          if i = 0 /\ j = 0 then 1
          else if i = 0 /\ j = 1 then 1996
          else if i = 1 /\ j = 0 then 0
          else if i = 1 /\ j = 1 then 1
          else 0) :
        real['N]['N])
    in
    let putnam_1996_b4_solution = F
    in
      dimindex (:'N) = 2
      ==>
      ((?A : real['N]['N]. matsin A = mat1996) <=>
       putnam_1996_b4_solution)``;

% the nonexistence of a real 2-by-2 matrix whose matrix sine, defined by its

putnam_1996_b4: THEORY
BEGIN
  coordinate: TYPE = below(2)
  matrix: TYPE = [coordinate, coordinate -> real]
  matrix_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> matrix]

  safe_div(numerator, denominator: real): real =
    IF denominator = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
