let previous_file_loader = !Hol_loader.file_loader;;
Hol_loader.file_loader :=
  (fun path -> Toploop.use_file transc_formatter path);;
let transc_loaded =
  Toploop.use_file transc_formatter "Library/transc.ml";;
Hol_loader.file_loader := previous_file_loader;;
Format.pp_print_flush transc_formatter ();;
close_out transc_output;;
if not transc_loaded then failwith "failed to load Library/transc.ml";;

let statement =
  `let cover_bound =
     \(S:real^2->bool) (M:real).
       &0 <= M /\
       ?xl xu yl yu:num->real.
         (!k:num. xl k <= xu k /\ yl k <= yu k) /\
         (!p:real^2.
            p IN S
            ==> ?k:num.
                  xl k < p$1 /\ p$1 < xu k /\
                  yl k < p$2 /\ p$2 < yu k) /\
         (!N:num.
            sum (0..N)
              (\k:num. (xu k - xl k) * (yu k - yl k)) <= M) in
   let outer_area =
     \(S:real^2->bool).
       inf {M:real | cover_bound S M} in
   let quadrant =
     \P:real^2.
       P$1 > &0 /\ P$2 > &0 /\
       (P$1) pow 2 + (P$2) pow 2 = &1 in
   let isarc =
     \P Q:real^2.
       quadrant P /\ quadrant Q /\ P$1 > Q$1 in
   let arc =
     \P Q:real^2.
       {R:real^2 | quadrant R /\ P$1 > R$1 /\ R$1 > Q$1} in
   let A =
     \P Q:real^2.
       outer_area
         {S:real^2 |
            ?R:real^2.
              R IN arc P Q /\
              R$1 = S$1 /\ R$2 > S$2 /\ S$2 > &0} in
   let B =
     \P Q:real^2.
       outer_area
         {S:real^2 |
            ?R:real^2.
              R IN arc P Q /\
              R$2 = S$2 /\ R$1 > S$1 /\ S$1 > &0} in
   ?f:real->real.
     !P Q:real^2.
       isarc P Q
       ==> A P Q + B P Q =
           f (atn (Q$2 / Q$1) - atn (P$2 / P$1))`;;

title: putnam_1998_a2
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1998_a2:
;; for first-quadrant unit-circle arcs, the sum of the two specified Lebesgue
;; areas depends only on the arc length. This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))

;; ACL2 has no primitive complete real field or Lebesgue measure.  The
;; conservative interfaces below present those objects, and every field,
;; completeness, set, sigma-algebra, additivity, invariance, normalization,
;; measurability, and finiteness property used by the statement is an explicit
;; hypothesis of the final predicate.  Arbitrary scalar subsets, plane
;; subsets, and countable families are represented extensionally by tame
;; APPLY$ function objects; none is replaced by a finite table.

(defstub p98a2-real-p (real-type value) t)
(defstub p98a2-zero (real-type) t)
(defstub p98a2-one (real-type) t)
(defstub p98a2-add (real-type left right) t)
(defstub p98a2-mul (real-type left right) t)
(defstub p98a2-neg (real-type value) t)
(defstub p98a2-inv (real-type value) t)
(defstub p98a2-less (real-type left right) t)

(defstub p98a2-empty-set (real-type) t)
(defstub p98a2-complement-set (real-type set) t)
(defstub p98a2-union-sequence-set (real-type sequence) t)
(defstub p98a2-unit-square-set (real-type) t)
(defstub p98a2-translate-set
  (real-type shift-x shift-y set)
  t)
(defstub p98a2-below-arc-set
  (real-type p-x p-y q-x q-y)
  t)
(defstub p98a2-left-of-arc-set
  (real-type p-x p-y q-x q-y)
  t)
(defstub p98a2-measurable-p (real-type set) t)
(defstub p98a2-measure (real-type set) t)

(defun p98a2-scalar-set-member-p (set value)
  (if (apply$ set (list value)) t nil))

(defun p98a2-plane-set-p (set)
  (tamep-functionp set))

(defun p98a2-plane-member-p (set x y)
  (if (apply$ set (list x y)) t nil))

(defun p98a2-sequence-set (sequence n)
  (apply$ sequence (list n)))

(defun p98a2-leq (real-type left right)
  (not (p98a2-less real-type right left)))

(defun p98a2-sub (real-type left right)
  (p98a2-add real-type left (p98a2-neg real-type right)))

(defun p98a2-square (real-type value)
  (p98a2-mul real-type value value))

(defun-sk p98a2-field-laws-p (real-type)
  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and (p98a2-real-p real-type x)
          (p98a2-real-p real-type y)
          (p98a2-real-p real-type z))
     (let* ((zero (p98a2-zero real-type))
            (one (p98a2-one real-type))
            (xy-add (p98a2-add real-type x y))
            (yz-add (p98a2-add real-type y z))
            (xy-mul (p98a2-mul real-type x y))
            (yz-mul (p98a2-mul real-type y z))
            (neg-x (p98a2-neg real-type x))
            (inv-x (p98a2-inv real-type x)))
       (and
        (p98a2-real-p real-type xy-add)
        (p98a2-real-p real-type xy-mul)
        (p98a2-real-p real-type neg-x)
        (p98a2-real-p real-type inv-x)
        (equal (p98a2-add real-type xy-add z)
               (p98a2-add real-type x yz-add))
        (equal xy-add (p98a2-add real-type y x))
        (equal (p98a2-add real-type x zero) x)
        (equal (p98a2-add real-type x neg-x) zero)
        (equal (p98a2-mul real-type xy-mul z)
               (p98a2-mul real-type x yz-mul))
        (equal xy-mul (p98a2-mul real-type y x))
        (equal (p98a2-mul real-type x one) x)
        (implies (equal x zero)
                 (equal inv-x zero))
        (implies
         (not (equal x zero))
         (equal (p98a2-mul real-type x inv-x) one))
        (equal
         (p98a2-mul real-type x yz-add)
         (p98a2-add
          real-type
          (p98a2-mul real-type x y)
          (p98a2-mul real-type x z))))))))

(defun-sk p98a2-order-laws-p (real-type)
  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and (p98a2-real-p real-type x)
          (p98a2-real-p real-type y)
          (p98a2-real-p real-type z))
     (let ((zero (p98a2-zero real-type)))
       (and
        (not (p98a2-less real-type x x))
        (or (p98a2-less real-type x y)
            (equal x y)
            (p98a2-less real-type y x))
        (implies
         (and (p98a2-less real-type x y)
              (p98a2-less real-type y z))
         (p98a2-less real-type x z))
        (implies
         (p98a2-less real-type x y)
         (p98a2-less
          real-type
          (p98a2-add real-type x z)
          (p98a2-add real-type y z)))
        (implies
         (and (p98a2-less real-type zero x)
              (p98a2-less real-type zero y))
         (p98a2-less
          real-type
          zero
          (p98a2-mul real-type x y))))))))

(defun-sk p98a2-valid-scalar-set-p (real-type set)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (p98a2-scalar-set-member-p set x)
     (p98a2-real-p real-type x))))

(defun-sk p98a2-upper-bound-p (real-type set upper)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (and (p98a2-real-p real-type x)
          (p98a2-scalar-set-member-p set x))
     (p98a2-leq real-type x upper))))

(defun-sk p98a2-scalar-set-nonempty-p (real-type set)
  (exists (x)
    (and (p98a2-real-p real-type x)
         (p98a2-scalar-set-member-p set x))))

(defun-sk p98a2-scalar-set-bounded-p (real-type set)
  (exists (upper)
    (and (p98a2-real-p real-type upper)
         (p98a2-upper-bound-p real-type set upper))))

(defun-sk p98a2-least-upper-bound-p
    (real-type set supremum)
  (forall (upper)
    (implies
     (and (p98a2-real-p real-type upper)
          (p98a2-upper-bound-p real-type set upper))
     (p98a2-leq real-type supremum upper))))

(defun p98a2-supremum-p
    (real-type set supremum)
  (and
   (p98a2-real-p real-type supremum)
   (p98a2-upper-bound-p real-type set supremum)
   (p98a2-least-upper-bound-p
    real-type set supremum)))

(defun-sk p98a2-has-supremum-p
    (real-type set)
  (exists (supremum)
    (p98a2-supremum-p
     real-type set supremum)))

(defun-sk p98a2-completeness-p (real-type)
  (forall (set)
    (implies
     (and (tamep-functionp set)
          (p98a2-valid-scalar-set-p real-type set)
          (p98a2-scalar-set-nonempty-p real-type set)
          (p98a2-scalar-set-bounded-p real-type set))
     (p98a2-has-supremum-p
      real-type set))))

(defun p98a2-real-field-p (real-type)
  (let ((zero (p98a2-zero real-type))
        (one (p98a2-one real-type)))
    (and
     (p98a2-real-p real-type zero)
     (p98a2-real-p real-type one)
     (not (equal zero one))
     (p98a2-field-laws-p real-type)
     (p98a2-order-laws-p real-type)
     (p98a2-less real-type zero one)
     (p98a2-completeness-p real-type))))

;; Coordinates inline EuclideanSpace R (Fin 2).  On unit vectors the dot
;; product is cos of their inner-product angle.  Since all relevant angles
;; lie strictly between 0 and pi/2, dot product is an injective code for arc
;; length.  Thus existence of a real function of this code is bidirectionally
;; equivalent to existence of a real function of the source arc angle, after
;; extending either function arbitrarily away from attained values.

(defun p98a2-first-quadrant-unit-point-p
    (real-type x y)
  (let ((zero (p98a2-zero real-type))
        (one (p98a2-one real-type)))
    (and
     (p98a2-real-p real-type x)
     (p98a2-real-p real-type y)
     (p98a2-less real-type zero x)
     (p98a2-less real-type zero y)
     (equal
      (p98a2-add
       real-type
       (p98a2-square real-type x)
       (p98a2-square real-type y))
      one))))

(defun p98a2-is-arc-p
    (real-type p-x p-y q-x q-y)
  (and
   (p98a2-first-quadrant-unit-point-p
    real-type p-x p-y)
   (p98a2-first-quadrant-unit-point-p
    real-type q-x q-y)
   (p98a2-less real-type q-x p-x)))

(defun p98a2-arc-length-code
    (real-type p-x p-y q-x q-y)
  (p98a2-add
   real-type
   (p98a2-mul real-type p-x q-x)
   (p98a2-mul real-type p-y q-y)))

;; Exact extensional definitions of the two planar regions from the source.

(defun-sk p98a2-below-member-witness-p
    (real-type p-x p-y q-x q-y s-x s-y)
  (exists (r-x r-y)
    (and
     (p98a2-first-quadrant-unit-point-p
      real-type r-x r-y)
     (p98a2-less real-type r-x p-x)
     (p98a2-less real-type q-x r-x)
     (equal r-x s-x)
     (p98a2-less real-type s-y r-y)
     (p98a2-less real-type
                   (p98a2-zero real-type)
                   s-y))))

(defun-sk p98a2-left-member-witness-p
    (real-type p-x p-y q-x q-y s-x s-y)
  (exists (r-x r-y)
    (and
     (p98a2-first-quadrant-unit-point-p
      real-type r-x r-y)
     (p98a2-less real-type r-x p-x)
     (p98a2-less real-type q-x r-x)
     (equal r-y s-y)
     (p98a2-less real-type s-x r-x)
     (p98a2-less real-type
                   (p98a2-zero real-type)
                   s-x))))

(defun-sk p98a2-plane-sets-equiv-p
    (real-type left right)
  (forall (x y)
    (implies
     (and (p98a2-real-p real-type x)
          (p98a2-real-p real-type y))
     (iff
      (p98a2-plane-member-p left x y)
      (p98a2-plane-member-p right x y)))))

(defun-sk p98a2-plane-set-sequence-p
    (sequence)
  (forall (n)
    (implies
     (natp n)
     (p98a2-plane-set-p
      (p98a2-sequence-set sequence n)))))

(defun-sk p98a2-union-member-exists-p
    (sequence x y)
  (exists (n)
    (and
     (natp n)
     (p98a2-plane-member-p
      (p98a2-sequence-set sequence n)
      x y))))

(defun-sk p98a2-empty-set-law-p (real-type)
  (forall (x y)
    (implies
     (and (p98a2-real-p real-type x)
          (p98a2-real-p real-type y))
     (and
      (p98a2-plane-set-p
       (p98a2-empty-set real-type))
      (not
       (p98a2-plane-member-p
        (p98a2-empty-set real-type)
        x y))))))

(defun-sk p98a2-complement-set-law-p (real-type)
  (forall (set x y)
    (implies
     (and (p98a2-plane-set-p set)
          (p98a2-real-p real-type x)
          (p98a2-real-p real-type y))
     (and
      (p98a2-plane-set-p
       (p98a2-complement-set real-type set))
      (iff
       (p98a2-plane-member-p
        (p98a2-complement-set real-type set)
        x y)
       (not
        (p98a2-plane-member-p
         set x y)))))))

(defun-sk p98a2-union-set-law-p (real-type)
  (forall (sequence x y)
    (implies
     (and (tamep-functionp sequence)
          (p98a2-plane-set-sequence-p sequence)
          (p98a2-real-p real-type x)
          (p98a2-real-p real-type y))
     (and
      (p98a2-plane-set-p
       (p98a2-union-sequence-set real-type sequence))
      (iff
       (p98a2-plane-member-p
        (p98a2-union-sequence-set real-type sequence)
        x y)
       (p98a2-union-member-exists-p
        sequence x y))))))

(defun-sk p98a2-unit-square-law-p (real-type)
  (forall (x y)
    (let ((zero (p98a2-zero real-type))
          (one (p98a2-one real-type)))
      (implies
       (and (p98a2-real-p real-type x)
            (p98a2-real-p real-type y))
       (and
        (p98a2-plane-set-p
         (p98a2-unit-square-set real-type))
        (iff
         (p98a2-plane-member-p
          (p98a2-unit-square-set real-type)
          x y)
         (and
          (p98a2-leq real-type zero x)
          (p98a2-less real-type x one)
          (p98a2-leq real-type zero y)
          (p98a2-less real-type y one))))))))

(defun-sk p98a2-translate-set-law-p (real-type)
  (forall (set shift-x shift-y x y)
    (implies
     (and (p98a2-plane-set-p set)
          (p98a2-real-p real-type shift-x)
          (p98a2-real-p real-type shift-y)
          (p98a2-real-p real-type x)
          (p98a2-real-p real-type y))
     (and
      (p98a2-plane-set-p
       (p98a2-translate-set
        real-type shift-x shift-y set))
      (iff
       (p98a2-plane-member-p
        (p98a2-translate-set
         real-type shift-x shift-y set)
        x y)
       (p98a2-plane-member-p
        set
        (p98a2-sub real-type x shift-x)
        (p98a2-sub real-type y shift-y)))))))

(defun-sk p98a2-below-arc-set-law-p (real-type)
  (forall (p-x p-y q-x q-y s-x s-y)
    (implies
     (and
      (p98a2-real-p real-type p-x)
      (p98a2-real-p real-type p-y)
      (p98a2-real-p real-type q-x)
      (p98a2-real-p real-type q-y)
      (p98a2-real-p real-type s-x)
     (p98a2-real-p real-type s-y))
     (and
      (p98a2-plane-set-p
       (p98a2-below-arc-set
        real-type p-x p-y q-x q-y))
      (iff
       (p98a2-plane-member-p
        (p98a2-below-arc-set
         real-type p-x p-y q-x q-y)
        s-x s-y)
       (p98a2-below-member-witness-p
        real-type p-x p-y q-x q-y s-x s-y))))))

(defun-sk p98a2-left-of-arc-set-law-p (real-type)
  (forall (p-x p-y q-x q-y s-x s-y)
    (implies
     (and
      (p98a2-real-p real-type p-x)
      (p98a2-real-p real-type p-y)
      (p98a2-real-p real-type q-x)
      (p98a2-real-p real-type q-y)
      (p98a2-real-p real-type s-x)
     (p98a2-real-p real-type s-y))
     (and
      (p98a2-plane-set-p
       (p98a2-left-of-arc-set
        real-type p-x p-y q-x q-y))
      (iff
       (p98a2-plane-member-p
        (p98a2-left-of-arc-set
         real-type p-x p-y q-x q-y)
        s-x s-y)
       (p98a2-left-member-witness-p
        real-type p-x p-y q-x q-y s-x s-y))))))

(defun p98a2-set-constructor-laws-p (real-type)
  (and
   (p98a2-empty-set-law-p real-type)
   (p98a2-complement-set-law-p real-type)
   (p98a2-union-set-law-p real-type)
   (p98a2-unit-square-law-p real-type)
   (p98a2-translate-set-law-p real-type)
   (p98a2-below-arc-set-law-p real-type)
   (p98a2-left-of-arc-set-law-p real-type)))

(defun-sk p98a2-measurable-sequence-elements-p
    (real-type sequence)
  (forall (n)
    (implies
     (natp n)
     (and
      (p98a2-plane-set-p
       (p98a2-sequence-set sequence n))
      (p98a2-measurable-p
       real-type
       (p98a2-sequence-set sequence n))))))

(defun p98a2-measurable-sequence-p
    (real-type sequence)
  (and
   (tamep-functionp sequence)
   (p98a2-plane-set-sequence-p sequence)
   (p98a2-measurable-sequence-elements-p
    real-type sequence)))

(defun p98a2-distance-square
    (real-type x y u v)
  (p98a2-add
   real-type
   (p98a2-square
    real-type
    (p98a2-sub real-type u x))
   (p98a2-square
    real-type
    (p98a2-sub real-type v y))))

(defun-sk p98a2-ball-contained-p
    (real-type set x y radius)
  (forall (u v)
    (implies
     (and
      (p98a2-real-p real-type u)
      (p98a2-real-p real-type v)
      (p98a2-less
       real-type
       (p98a2-distance-square
        real-type x y u v)
       (p98a2-square real-type radius)))
     (p98a2-plane-member-p set u v))))

(defun-sk p98a2-interior-point-p
    (real-type set x y)
  (exists (radius)
    (and
     (p98a2-real-p real-type radius)
     (p98a2-less
      real-type
      (p98a2-zero real-type)
      radius)
     (p98a2-ball-contained-p
      real-type set x y radius))))

(defun-sk p98a2-open-set-p
    (real-type set)
  (forall (x y)
    (implies
     (and
      (p98a2-real-p real-type x)
      (p98a2-real-p real-type y)
      (p98a2-plane-member-p set x y))
     (p98a2-interior-point-p
      real-type set x y))))

(defun-sk p98a2-open-sets-measurable-p
    (real-type)
  (forall (set)
    (implies
     (and
      (p98a2-plane-set-p set)
      (p98a2-open-set-p real-type set))
     (p98a2-measurable-p real-type set))))

(defun-sk p98a2-sigma-algebra-laws-p (real-type)
  (forall (set sequence)
    (and
     (p98a2-measurable-p
     real-type
     (p98a2-empty-set real-type))
     (implies
      (p98a2-measurable-p real-type set)
      (and
       (p98a2-plane-set-p set)
       (p98a2-measurable-p
        real-type
        (p98a2-complement-set real-type set))))
     (implies
      (p98a2-measurable-sequence-p real-type sequence)
      (p98a2-measurable-p
       real-type
       (p98a2-union-sequence-set
        real-type sequence))))))

;; Extended nonnegative real values and countable sums.

(defun p98a2-ennreal-p (real-type value)
  (or
   (equal value :p98a2-top)
   (and
    (consp value)
    (equal (car value) :p98a2-finite)
    (p98a2-real-p real-type (cdr value))
    (p98a2-leq
     real-type
     (p98a2-zero real-type)
     (cdr value)))))

(defun p98a2-ennreal-finite (value)
  (cons :p98a2-finite value))

(defun p98a2-ennreal-zero (real-type)
  (p98a2-ennreal-finite (p98a2-zero real-type)))

(defun p98a2-ennreal-add (real-type left right)
  (if
   (or (equal left :p98a2-top)
       (equal right :p98a2-top))
   :p98a2-top
   (p98a2-ennreal-finite
    (p98a2-add real-type (cdr left) (cdr right)))))

(defun p98a2-ennreal-leq (real-type left right)
  (cond
   ((equal right :p98a2-top) t)
   ((equal left :p98a2-top) nil)
   (t
    (p98a2-leq
     real-type (cdr left) (cdr right)))))

(defun p98a2-partial-measure-sum
    (real-type sequence count)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix count)))
  (if
   (zp count)
   (p98a2-ennreal-zero real-type)
   (p98a2-ennreal-add
    real-type
    (p98a2-partial-measure-sum
     real-type sequence (1- count))
    (p98a2-measure
     real-type
     (p98a2-sequence-set
      sequence (1- count))))))

(defun-sk p98a2-sum-upper-bound-p
    (real-type sequence total)
  (forall (count)
    (implies
     (natp count)
     (p98a2-ennreal-leq
      real-type
      (p98a2-partial-measure-sum
       real-type sequence count)
      total))))

(defun-sk p98a2-countable-sum-least-p
    (real-type sequence total)
  (forall (bound)
    (implies
     (and
      (p98a2-ennreal-p real-type bound)
      (p98a2-sum-upper-bound-p
       real-type sequence bound))
     (p98a2-ennreal-leq
      real-type total bound))))

(defun p98a2-infinite-sum-p
    (real-type sequence total)
  (and
   (p98a2-ennreal-p real-type total)
   (p98a2-sum-upper-bound-p
    real-type sequence total)
   (p98a2-countable-sum-least-p
    real-type sequence total)))

(defun-sk p98a2-disjoint-sets-p
    (real-type left right)
  (forall (x y)
    (implies
     (and
      (p98a2-real-p real-type x)
      (p98a2-real-p real-type y))
     (not
      (and
       (p98a2-plane-member-p
        left x y)
       (p98a2-plane-member-p
        right x y))))))

(defun-sk p98a2-pairwise-disjoint-p
    (real-type sequence)
  (forall (m n)
    (implies
     (and
      (natp m)
      (natp n)
      (not (equal m n)))
     (p98a2-disjoint-sets-p
      real-type
      (p98a2-sequence-set sequence m)
      (p98a2-sequence-set sequence n)))))

(defun-sk p98a2-measure-values-p (real-type)
  (forall (set)
    (implies
     (p98a2-plane-set-p set)
     (p98a2-ennreal-p
      real-type
      (p98a2-measure real-type set)))))

(defun-sk p98a2-measure-extensional-p (real-type)
  (forall (left right)
    (implies
     (and
      (p98a2-plane-set-p left)
      (p98a2-plane-set-p right)
      (p98a2-plane-sets-equiv-p
       real-type left right))
     (equal
      (p98a2-measure real-type left)
      (p98a2-measure real-type right)))))

(defun-sk p98a2-countable-additivity-p (real-type)
  (forall (sequence)
    (implies
     (and
      (p98a2-measurable-sequence-p
       real-type sequence)
      (p98a2-pairwise-disjoint-p
       real-type sequence))
     (p98a2-infinite-sum-p
      real-type
      sequence
      (p98a2-measure
       real-type
       (p98a2-union-sequence-set
        real-type sequence))))))

(defun-sk p98a2-translation-invariance-p (real-type)
  (forall (shift-x shift-y set)
    (implies
     (and
      (p98a2-real-p real-type shift-x)
      (p98a2-real-p real-type shift-y)
      (p98a2-measurable-p real-type set))
     (equal
      (p98a2-measure
       real-type
       (p98a2-translate-set
        real-type shift-x shift-y set))
      (p98a2-measure real-type set)))))

(defun p98a2-finite-measure-p (real-type set)
  (let ((value (p98a2-measure real-type set)))
    (and
     (consp value)
     (equal (car value) :p98a2-finite)
     (p98a2-real-p real-type (cdr value)))))

(defun p98a2-measure-to-real (real-type set)
  (let ((value (p98a2-measure real-type set)))
    (if
     (and
      (consp value)
      (equal (car value) :p98a2-finite)
      (p98a2-real-p real-type (cdr value)))
     (cdr value)
     (p98a2-zero real-type))))

(defun-sk p98a2-arc-regions-measurable-finite-p
    (real-type)
  (forall (p-x p-y q-x q-y)
    (implies
     (p98a2-is-arc-p
      real-type p-x p-y q-x q-y)
     (let
         ((below
           (p98a2-below-arc-set
            real-type p-x p-y q-x q-y))
          (left
           (p98a2-left-of-arc-set
            real-type p-x p-y q-x q-y)))
       (and
        (p98a2-measurable-p real-type below)
        (p98a2-measurable-p real-type left)
        (p98a2-finite-measure-p real-type below)
        (p98a2-finite-measure-p real-type left))))))

(defun p98a2-lebesgue-plane-p (real-type)
  (and
   (p98a2-set-constructor-laws-p real-type)
   (p98a2-sigma-algebra-laws-p real-type)
   (p98a2-open-sets-measurable-p real-type)
   (p98a2-measure-values-p real-type)
   (p98a2-measure-extensional-p real-type)
   (equal
    (p98a2-measure
     real-type
     (p98a2-empty-set real-type))
    (p98a2-ennreal-zero real-type))
   (p98a2-countable-additivity-p real-type)
   (p98a2-translation-invariance-p real-type)
   (p98a2-measurable-p
    real-type
    (p98a2-unit-square-set real-type))
   (equal
    (p98a2-measure
     real-type
     (p98a2-unit-square-set real-type))
    (p98a2-ennreal-finite
     (p98a2-one real-type)))
   (p98a2-arc-regions-measurable-finite-p real-type)))

(defun p98a2-area-sum
    (real-type p-x p-y q-x q-y)
  (p98a2-add
   real-type
   (p98a2-measure-to-real
    real-type
    (p98a2-below-arc-set
     real-type p-x p-y q-x q-y))
   (p98a2-measure-to-real
    real-type
    (p98a2-left-of-arc-set
     real-type p-x p-y q-x q-y))))

;; The source's existential f : R -> R is expressed without restricting the
;; function space: a value factors through the arc-length code exactly when it
;; is constant on every fiber of that code.  Fiber constancy implies the
;; source existential by assigning the common value on attained codes and an
;; arbitrary real value elsewhere; the converse follows by substitution.

(defun-sk p98a2-area-sum-fiber-constant-p
    (real-type)
  (forall
   (p-x p-y q-x q-y
        r-x r-y s-x s-y)
   (implies
    (and
     (p98a2-is-arc-p
      real-type p-x p-y q-x q-y)
     (p98a2-is-arc-p
      real-type r-x r-y s-x s-y)
     (equal
      (p98a2-arc-length-code
       real-type p-x p-y q-x q-y)
      (p98a2-arc-length-code
       real-type r-x r-y s-x s-y)))
    (equal
     (p98a2-area-sum
      real-type p-x p-y q-x q-y)
     (p98a2-area-sum
      real-type r-x r-y s-x s-y)))))

(defun putnambench-putnam-1998-a2-statement
    (real-type)
  (implies
   (and
    (p98a2-real-field-p real-type)
    (p98a2-lebesgue-plane-p real-type))
   (p98a2-area-sum-fiber-constant-p real-type)))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

title: putnam_1998_a2
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1998_a2:
-- for a first-quadrant arc of the unit circle, the sum of the areas below and
-- to its left depends only on the arc's angular length. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; _*_)

infix 4 _!=_ _<=N_
infixr 3 _and_

data Bottom : Set where

Not : Set -> Set
Not A =
  A -> Bottom

_!=_ : {A : Set} -> A -> A -> Set
x != y =
  Not (x == y)

record _and_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data Either (A B : Set) : Set where
  left  : A -> Either A B
  right : B -> Either A B

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

data _<=N_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set where
  zero<=N   : {n : Nat} -> zero <=N n
  suc<=sucN : {m n : Nat} -> m <=N n -> suc m <=N suc n

record CompleteOrderedRealField (R : Set) : Set1 where
  field
    zeroR oneR : R
    add multiply : R -> R -> R
    negate inverse : R -> R
    lessOrEqual : R -> R -> Set
    fromNat : Nat -> R

    one-not-zero :
      oneR != zeroR

    add-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> add x y == add y x
    add-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      add (add x y) z == add x (add y z)
    add-zero :
      (x : R) -> add x zeroR == x
    add-inverse :
      (x : R) -> add x (negate x) == zeroR

    multiply-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> multiply x y == multiply y x
    multiply-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply (multiply x y) z ==
      multiply x (multiply y z)
    multiply-one :
      (x : R) -> multiply x oneR == x
    multiply-zero :
      (x : R) -> multiply x zeroR == zeroR
    distribute :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply x (add y z) ==
      add (multiply x y) (multiply x z)
    inverse-zero :
      inverse zeroR == zeroR
    multiply-inverse :
      (x : R) ->
      x != zeroR ->
      multiply x (inverse x) == oneR

    order-reflexive :
      (x : R) -> lessOrEqual x x
    order-transitive :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y z ->
      lessOrEqual x z
    order-antisymmetric :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y x ->
      x == y
    order-total :
      (x y : R) ->
      Either (lessOrEqual x y) (lessOrEqual y x)
    add-order :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual (add z x) (add z y)
    multiply-nonnegative :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR x ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR y ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR (multiply x y)
    zero-less-than-one :
      lessOrEqual zeroR oneR and zeroR != oneR

    fromNat-zero :
      fromNat zero == zeroR
    fromNat-successor :
      (n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (suc n) == add (fromNat n) oneR
    fromNat-addition :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m + n) == add (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-multiplication :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m * n) == multiply (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-injective :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat m == fromNat n ->
      m == n

    archimedean :
      (x : R) ->
      Exists Nat (\ n -> lessOrEqual x (fromNat n))
    least-upper-bound :
      (P : R -> Set) ->
      Exists R P ->
      Exists R
        (\ upper ->
          (x : R) ->
          P x ->
          lessOrEqual x upper) ->
      Exists R
        (\ supremum ->
          ((x : R) ->
            P x ->
            lessOrEqual x supremum)
          and
          ((upper : R) ->
            ((x : R) ->
              P x ->
              lessOrEqual x upper) ->
            lessOrEqual supremum upper))

open CompleteOrderedRealField

oneN : Nat
oneN =
  suc zero

twoN : Nat
twoN =
  suc oneN

subtract :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
subtract reals x y =
  add reals x (negate reals y)

divide :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
divide reals x y =
  multiply reals x (inverse reals y)

square :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R
square reals x =
  multiply reals x x

StrictLess :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
StrictLess reals x y =
  lessOrEqual reals x y and x != y

CloseTo :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
CloseTo reals center radius x =
  StrictLess reals
    (subtract reals center radius)
    x
  and
  StrictLess reals
    x
    (add reals center radius)

sumFirst :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Nat ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  R
sumFirst reals zero term =
  zeroR reals
sumFirst reals (suc n) term =
  add reals
    (sumFirst reals n term)
    (term n)

ConvergesTo :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  R ->
  Set
ConvergesTo {R} reals sequence limit =
  (epsilon : R) ->
  StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) epsilon ->
  Exists Nat
    (\ cutoff ->
      (n : Nat) ->
      cutoff <=N n ->
      CloseTo reals limit epsilon (sequence n))

SeriesHasSum :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  R ->
  Set
SeriesHasSum reals terms total =
  ConvergesTo reals
    (\ n -> sumFirst reals n terms)
    total

record StandardSquareRoot
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) :
  Set1 where

  field
    squareRoot : R -> R

    square-root-nonnegative :
      (x : R) ->
      lessOrEqual reals (zeroR reals) (squareRoot x)
    square-root-square :
      (x : R) ->
      lessOrEqual reals (zeroR reals) x ->
      square reals (squareRoot x) == x
    square-root-nonpositive :
      (x : R) ->
      lessOrEqual reals x (zeroR reals) ->
      squareRoot x == zeroR reals
    square-root-unique :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual reals (zeroR reals) y ->
      square reals y == x ->
      squareRoot x == y

open StandardSquareRoot

naturalPower :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  Nat ->
  R
naturalPower reals x zero =
  oneR reals
naturalPower reals x (suc n) =
  multiply reals
    (naturalPower reals x n)
    x

rightRiemannSum :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  (R -> R) ->
  Nat ->
  R
rightRiemannSum reals lower upper function pieces =
  let
    step =
      divide reals
        (subtract reals upper lower)
        (fromNat reals pieces)
  in
  sumFirst reals pieces
    (\ i ->
      multiply reals
        (function
          (add reals lower
            (multiply reals
              (fromNat reals (suc i))
              step)))
        step)

IntervalIntegralValue :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  (R -> R) ->
  R ->
  Set
IntervalIntegralValue reals lower upper function value =
  ConvergesTo reals
    (\ n ->
      rightRiemannSum reals
        lower
        upper
        function
        (suc n))
    value

arctangentIntegrand :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R
arctangentIntegrand reals x =
  inverse reals
    (add reals
      (oneR reals)
      (naturalPower reals x twoN))

record StandardArctangent
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) :
  Set1 where

  field
    arctangent : R -> R

    arctangent-integral :
      (x : R) ->
      lessOrEqual reals (zeroR reals) x ->
      IntervalIntegralValue reals
        (zeroR reals)
        x
        (arctangentIntegrand reals)
        (arctangent x)

open StandardArctangent

record Point (R : Set) : Set where
  constructor point
  field
    x-coordinate : R
    y-coordinate : R

open Point

Region : Set -> Set1
Region R =
  Point R -> Set

record Rectangle (R : Set) : Set where
  constructor rectangle
  field
    lower-x : R
    upper-x : R
    lower-y : R
    upper-y : R

open Rectangle

ValidRectangle :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Rectangle R ->
  Set
ValidRectangle reals box =
  lessOrEqual reals (lower-x box) (upper-x box)
  and
  lessOrEqual reals (lower-y box) (upper-y box)

RectangleContains :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Rectangle R ->
  Point R ->
  Set
RectangleContains reals box p =
  lessOrEqual reals (lower-x box) (x-coordinate p)
  and
  lessOrEqual reals (x-coordinate p) (upper-x box)
  and
  lessOrEqual reals (lower-y box) (y-coordinate p)
  and
  lessOrEqual reals (y-coordinate p) (upper-y box)

rectangleArea :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Rectangle R ->
  R
rectangleArea reals box =
  multiply reals
    (subtract reals (upper-x box) (lower-x box))
    (subtract reals (upper-y box) (lower-y box))

RectangleCover : Set -> Set
RectangleCover R =
  Nat -> Rectangle R

ValidCover :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  RectangleCover R ->
  Set
ValidCover reals cover =
  (n : Nat) ->
  ValidRectangle reals (cover n)

Covers :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  RectangleCover R ->
  Region R ->
  Set
Covers {R} reals cover region =
  (p : Point R) ->
  region p ->
  Exists Nat
    (\ n -> RectangleContains reals (cover n) p)

CoverHasCost :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  RectangleCover R ->
  R ->
  Set
CoverHasCost reals cover total =
  SeriesHasSum reals
    (\ n -> rectangleArea reals (cover n))
    total

CoverCost :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Region R ->
  R ->
  Set
CoverCost {R} reals region total =
  Exists (RectangleCover R)
    (\ cover ->
      ValidCover reals cover
      and
      Covers reals cover region
      and
      CoverHasCost reals cover total)

LowerBound :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (R -> Set) ->
  R ->
  Set
LowerBound {R} reals values bound =
  (candidate : R) ->
  values candidate ->
  lessOrEqual reals bound candidate

GreatestLowerBound :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (R -> Set) ->
  R ->
  Set
GreatestLowerBound {R} reals values infimum =
  LowerBound reals values infimum
  and
  ((bound : R) ->
    LowerBound reals values bound ->
    lessOrEqual reals bound infimum)

LebesgueOuterArea :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Region R ->
  R ->
  Set
LebesgueOuterArea reals region area =
  GreatestLowerBound reals (CoverCost reals region) area

BoundedRegion :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Region R ->
  Set
BoundedRegion {R} reals region =
  Exists R
    (\ bound ->
      lessOrEqual reals (zeroR reals) bound
      and
      ((p : Point R) ->
        region p ->
        lessOrEqual reals
          (negate reals bound)
          (x-coordinate p)
        and
        lessOrEqual reals
          (x-coordinate p)
          bound
        and
        lessOrEqual reals
          (negate reals bound)
          (y-coordinate p)
        and
        lessOrEqual reals
          (y-coordinate p)
          bound))

record StandardLebesguePlane
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) :
  Set1 where

  field
    area : Region R -> R
    area-characterization :
      (region : Region R) ->
      BoundedRegion reals region ->
      LebesgueOuterArea reals region (area region)

open StandardLebesguePlane

squaredDistance :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Point R ->
  Point R ->
  R
squaredDistance reals p q =
  add reals
    (square reals
      (subtract reals (x-coordinate p) (x-coordinate q)))
    (square reals
      (subtract reals (y-coordinate p) (y-coordinate q)))

distance :
  {R : Set} ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) ->
  StandardSquareRoot reals ->
  Point R ->
  Point R ->
  R
distance reals roots p q =
  squareRoot roots (squaredDistance reals p q)

module Putnam1998A2Statement
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R)
  (roots : StandardSquareRoot reals)
  (angles : StandardArctangent reals)
  (lebesgue : StandardLebesguePlane reals) where

  origin : Point R
  origin =
    point (zeroR reals) (zeroR reals)

  Quadrant : Region R
  Quadrant p =
    StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) (x-coordinate p)
    and
    StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) (y-coordinate p)
    and
    distance reals roots origin p == oneR reals

  IsArc : Point R -> Point R -> Set
  IsArc p q =
    Quadrant p
    and
    Quadrant q
    and
    StrictLess reals (x-coordinate q) (x-coordinate p)

  Arc : Point R -> Point R -> Region R
  Arc p q r =
    Quadrant r
    and
    StrictLess reals (x-coordinate r) (x-coordinate p)
    and
    StrictLess reals (x-coordinate q) (x-coordinate r)

  BelowArc : Point R -> Point R -> Region R
  BelowArc p q s =
    Exists (Point R)
      (\ r ->
        Arc p q r
        and
        x-coordinate r == x-coordinate s
        and
        StrictLess reals (y-coordinate s) (y-coordinate r)
        and
        StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) (y-coordinate s))

  LeftOfArc : Point R -> Point R -> Region R
  LeftOfArc p q s =
    Exists (Point R)
      (\ r ->
        Arc p q r
        and
        y-coordinate r == y-coordinate s
        and
        StrictLess reals (x-coordinate s) (x-coordinate r)
        and
        StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) (x-coordinate s))

  areaA : Point R -> Point R -> R
  areaA p q =
    area lebesgue (BelowArc p q)

  areaB : Point R -> Point R -> R
  areaB p q =
    area lebesgue (LeftOfArc p q)

  angularLength : Point R -> Point R -> R
  angularLength p q =
    subtract reals
      (arctangent angles
        (divide reals
          (y-coordinate q)
          (x-coordinate q)))
      (arctangent angles
        (divide reals
          (y-coordinate p)
          (x-coordinate p)))

  proposition : Set
  proposition =
    Exists (R -> R)
      (\ f ->
        (p q : Point R) ->
        IsArc p q ->
        add reals (areaA p q) (areaB p q) ==
        f (angularLength p q))

putnam-1998-a2 : Set1
putnam-1998-a2 =
  (R : Set) ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) ->
  (roots : StandardSquareRoot reals) ->
  (angles : StandardArctangent reals) ->
  (lebesgue : StandardLebesguePlane reals) ->
  Putnam1998A2Statement.proposition reals roots angles lebesgue

content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1998_a2:
  for a first-quadrant arc of the unit circle, the sum of the areas below and
  to the left of the arc depends only on its arc length. This file contains no
  proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open pairTheory pred_setTheory realTheory transcTheory;
open extrealTheory measureTheory lebesgue_measureTheory martingaleTheory;

val putnam_1998_a2 =
  ``let quadrant =
      \P : real # real.
        0 < FST P /\ 0 < SND P /\
        FST P pow 2 + SND P pow 2 = 1
    in
    let isarc =
      \P Q : real # real.
        quadrant P /\ quadrant Q /\ FST Q < FST P
    in
    let arc =
      \P Q : real # real.
        {R : real # real |
          quadrant R /\ FST R < FST P /\ FST Q < FST R}
    in
    let A =
      \P Q : real # real.
        real
          (measure
            (prod_measure_space lebesgue lebesgue)
            {X : real # real |
              ?R : real # real.
                R IN arc P Q /\
                FST R = FST X /\
                SND X < SND R /\
                0 < SND X})
    in
    let B =
      \P Q : real # real.
        real
          (measure
            (prod_measure_space lebesgue lebesgue)
            {X : real # real |
              ?R : real # real.
                R IN arc P Q /\
                SND R = SND X /\
                FST X < FST R /\
                0 < FST X})
    in
      ?f : real -> real.
        !P Q : real # real.
          isarc P Q
          ==>
          A P Q + B P Q =
            f (atn (SND Q / FST Q) - atn (SND P / FST P))``;

title: putnam_1998_a2
content:
$(
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact
  putnam_1998_a2: for a unit-circle arc in the open first quadrant, the
  sum of the areas below and to the left of the arc depends only on its
  angular length. This file contains no proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  P98A2R2 is the real coordinate plane, P98A2Norm is its Euclidean norm,
  and P98A2Quadrant is the open-first-quadrant part of the unit circle.
  P98A2Arc P Q is the open arc selected by P_1 > R_1 > Q_1.
  P98A2AreaA and P98A2AreaB are the two-dimensional Lebesgue measures of
  the source regions, using set.mm's finite-dimensional volume function
  voln. P98A2Length is the positive first-quadrant angular difference.

  The source's quadrant, isarc, arc, A, and B parameters are eliminated by
  their displayed definitions. The final declaration is the single unproved
  $a corpus statement; this database contains no $p proof statement.
$)

$c P98A2I P98A2R2 P98A2Norm P98A2Quadrant P98A2IsArc $.
$c P98A2Arc P98A2AreaA P98A2AreaB P98A2Length $.

p98a2-index-syntax $a class P98A2I $.
p98a2-plane-syntax $a class P98A2R2 $.
p98a2-norm-syntax $a class ( P98A2Norm P ) $.
p98a2-quadrant-syntax $a wff ( P98A2Quadrant P ) $.
p98a2-isarc-syntax $a wff ( P98A2IsArc P Q ) $.
p98a2-arc-syntax $a class ( P98A2Arc P Q ) $.
p98a2-area-a-syntax $a class ( P98A2AreaA P Q ) $.
p98a2-area-b-syntax $a class ( P98A2AreaB P Q ) $.
p98a2-length-syntax $a class ( P98A2Length P Q ) $.

p98a2-index-definition $a |- P98A2I = ( 1 ... 2 ) $.

p98a2-plane-definition $a |- P98A2R2 = ( RR ^m P98A2I ) $.

${
  $d P j $.

  p98a2-norm-definition $a |- (
    P98A2Norm P
  ) = (
    sqrt
    `
    (
      sum_ j e. P98A2I
        ( ( P ` j ) ^ 2 )
    )
  ) $.
$}

p98a2-quadrant-definition $a |- (
  ( P98A2Quadrant P )
  <->
  (
    P e. P98A2R2
    /\
    (
      (
        0 < ( P ` 1 )
        /\
        0 < ( P ` 2 )
      )
      /\
      ( P98A2Norm P ) = 1
    )
  )
) $.

p98a2-isarc-definition $a |- (
  ( P98A2IsArc P Q )
  <->
  (
    ( P98A2Quadrant P )
    /\
    (
      ( P98A2Quadrant Q )
      /\
      ( Q ` 1 ) < ( P ` 1 )
    )
  )
) $.

${
  $d P Q r $.

  p98a2-arc-definition $a |- (
    P98A2Arc P Q
  ) = {
    r e. P98A2R2 |
    (
      ( P98A2Quadrant r )
      /\
      (
        ( r ` 1 ) < ( P ` 1 )
        /\
        ( Q ` 1 ) < ( r ` 1 )
      )
    )
  } $.
$}

${
  $d P Q r s $.

  p98a2-area-a-definition $a |- (
    P98A2AreaA P Q
  ) = (
    ( voln ` P98A2I )
    `
    {
      s e. P98A2R2 |
      E. r e. ( P98A2Arc P Q )
        (
          ( r ` 1 ) = ( s ` 1 )
          /\
          (
            ( s ` 2 ) < ( r ` 2 )
            /\
            0 < ( s ` 2 )
          )
        )
    }
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d P Q r s $.

  p98a2-area-b-definition $a |- (
    P98A2AreaB P Q
  ) = (
    ( voln ` P98A2I )
    `
    {
      s e. P98A2R2 |
      E. r e. ( P98A2Arc P Q )
        (
          ( r ` 2 ) = ( s ` 2 )
          /\
          (
            ( s ` 1 ) < ( r ` 1 )
            /\
            0 < ( s ` 1 )
          )
        )
    }
  ) $.
$}

p98a2-length-definition $a |- (
  P98A2Length P Q
) = (
  (
    arctan
    `
    (
      ( Q ` 2 )
      /
      ( Q ` 1 )
    )
  )
  -
  (
    arctan
    `
    (
      ( P ` 2 )
      /
      ( P ` 1 )
    )
  )
) $.

${
  $d f p q $.

  putnambench-putnam-1998-a2 $a |-
    E. f e. ( RR ^m RR )
      A. p e. P98A2R2 A. q e. P98A2R2
        (
          ( P98A2IsArc p q )
          ->
          (
            (
              ( P98A2AreaA p q )
              +
              ( P98A2AreaB p q )
            )
            =
            ( f ` ( P98A2Length p q ) )
          )
        )
  $.
$}

title: putnam_1998_a2
content:
% Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1998_a2:
% for a first-quadrant arc of the unit circle, the sum of the areas below and
% to the left of the arc depends only on its central angle (equivalently, its
% arc length), not on its position. This file contains no proof.

putnam_1998_a2: THEORY
BEGIN
  point: TYPE = [# x_coord: real, y_coord: real #]
  planar_region: TYPE = [point -> bool]
  real_function: TYPE = [real -> real]
  real_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> real]

  box: TYPE =
    [# left: real, right: real, bottom: real, top: real #]
  box_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> box]

  safe_div(numerator, denominator: real): real =
    IF denominator = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      numerator / denominator
    ENDIF

  squared_norm(P: point): real =
    x_coord(P) ^ 2 + y_coord(P) ^ 2

  first_quadrant_unit_circle(P: point): bool =
    x_coord(P) > 0
      AND y_coord(P) > 0
      AND squared_norm(P) = 1

  is_arc(P, Q: point): bool =
    first_quadrant_unit_circle(P)
      AND first_quadrant_unit_circle(Q)
      AND x_coord(P) > x_coord(Q)

  open_arc(P, Q: point): planar_region =
    LAMBDA (R: point):
      first_quadrant_unit_circle(R)
        AND x_coord(P) > x_coord(R)
        AND x_coord(R) > x_coord(Q)

  below_arc_region(P, Q: point): planar_region =
    LAMBDA (S: point):
      EXISTS (R: point):
        open_arc(P, Q)(R)
          AND x_coord(R) = x_coord(S)
          AND y_coord(R) > y_coord(S)
          AND y_coord(S) > 0

  left_of_arc_region(P, Q: point): planar_region =
    LAMBDA (S: point):
      EXISTS (R: point):
        open_arc(P, Q)(R)
          AND y_coord(R) = y_coord(S)
          AND x_coord(R) > x_coord(S)
          AND x_coord(S) > 0

  in_open_box(P: point, rectangle: box): bool =
    left(rectangle) < x_coord(P)
      AND x_coord(P) < right(rectangle)
      AND bottom(rectangle) < y_coord(P)
      AND y_coord(P) < top(rectangle)

  box_area(rectangle: box): real =
    IF left(rectangle) < right(rectangle)
        AND bottom(rectangle) < top(rectangle)
    THEN
      (right(rectangle) - left(rectangle))
        * (top(rectangle) - bottom(rectangle))
    ELSE
      0
    ENDIF

  partial_box_area(
      boxes: box_sequence,
      count: nat): RECURSIVE real =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      partial_box_area(boxes, count - 1)
        + box_area(boxes(count - 1))
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  converges_to(sequence: real_sequence, value: real): bool =
    FORALL (epsilon_value: posreal):
      EXISTS (cutoff: nat):
        FORALL (index: nat):
          cutoff <= index IMPLIES
            abs(sequence(index) - value) < epsilon_value

  covers(region: planar_region, boxes: box_sequence): bool =
    FORALL (P: point):
      region(P) IMPLIES
        EXISTS (index: nat):
          in_open_box(P, boxes(index))

  cover_has_total_area(
      region: planar_region,
      boxes: box_sequence,
      total: real): bool =
    covers(region, boxes)
      AND converges_to(
        LAMBDA (count: nat):
          partial_box_area(boxes, count),
        total)

  is_lebesgue_outer_area(
      region: planar_region,
      area: real): bool =
    0 <= area
      AND (FORALL (boxes: box_sequence), (total: real):
        cover_has_total_area(region, boxes, total)
          IMPLIES area <= total)
      AND (FORALL (epsilon_value: posreal):
        EXISTS (boxes: box_sequence), (total: real):
          cover_has_total_area(region, boxes, total)
            AND total < area + epsilon_value)

  lebesgue_area(region: planar_region): real =
    epsilon(
      LAMBDA (area: real):
        is_lebesgue_outer_area(region, area))

  valid_partition(
      lower, upper: real,
      points: real_sequence,
      count: nat): bool =
    IF lower = upper THEN
      count = 0 AND points(0) = lower
    ELSE
      count > 0
        AND points(0) = lower
        AND points(count) = upper
        AND (FORALL (index: nat):
          index < count IMPLIES
            points(index) < points(index + 1))
    ENDIF

  valid_tags(
      points, tags: real_sequence,
      count: nat): bool =
    FORALL (index: nat):
      index < count IMPLIES
        points(index) <= tags(index)
          AND tags(index) <= points(index + 1)

  mesh_less_than(
      points: real_sequence,
      count: nat,
      bound: real): bool =
    FORALL (index: nat):
      index < count IMPLIES
        points(index + 1) - points(index) < bound

  riemann_sum(
      f: real_function,
      points, tags: real_sequence,
      count: nat): RECURSIVE real =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      riemann_sum(f, points, tags, count - 1)
        + f(tags(count - 1))
            * (points(count) - points(count - 1))
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  has_integral_on_ordered_interval(
      f: real_function,
      integral_value, lower, upper: real): bool =
    lower <= upper
      AND FORALL (epsilon_value: posreal):
        EXISTS (mesh_bound: posreal):
          FORALL
              (points, tags: real_sequence),
              (count: nat):
            (valid_partition(lower, upper, points, count)
              AND valid_tags(points, tags, count)
              AND mesh_less_than(points, count, mesh_bound))
            IMPLIES
              abs(
                riemann_sum(f, points, tags, count)
                  - integral_value)
                < epsilon_value

  has_oriented_integral(
      f: real_function,
      integral_value, lower, upper: real): bool =
    IF lower <= upper THEN
      has_integral_on_ordered_interval(
        f, integral_value, lower, upper)
    ELSE
      has_integral_on_ordered_interval(
        f, -integral_value, upper, lower)
    ENDIF

  arctangent_integrand(t: real): real =
    safe_div(1, 1 + t ^ 2)

  arctangent(x: real): real =
    epsilon(
      LAMBDA (value: real):
        has_oriented_integral(
          arctangent_integrand, value, 0, x))

  arc_angle(P, Q: point): real =
    arctangent(safe_div(y_coord(Q), x_coord(Q)))
      - arctangent(safe_div(y_coord(P), x_coord(P)))

  putnam_1998_a2: bool =
    EXISTS (f: real_function):
      FORALL (P, Q: point):
        is_arc(P, Q) IMPLIES
          lebesgue_area(below_arc_region(P, Q))
            + lebesgue_area(left_of_arc_region(P, Q))
            = f(arc_angle(P, Q))
END putnam_1998_a2

import Mathlib

/--
Let $f$ be a real function on the real line with continuous third derivative.  Prove that there exists a point $a$ such that \[f(a)\cdot f'(a) \cdot f''(a) \cdot f'''(a)\geq 0 .\]
-/
theorem putnam_1998_a3
(f : ℝ → ℝ)
(hf : ContDiff ℝ 3 f)
: ∃ a : ℝ, (f a) * (deriv f a) * (iteratedDeriv 2 f a) * (iteratedDeriv 3 f a) ≥ 0 :=
sorry

    (f : R -> R)
    (hf : (forall x : R, ex_derive f x /\ ex_derive_n f 2 x /\ ex_derive_n f 3 x) /\ continuity (Derive_n f 3))
    : exists (a: R), (Derive_n f 0) a * (Derive_n f 1) a * (Derive_n f 2) a * (Derive_n f 3) a >= 0.

title: putnam_1998_a3
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1998_a3:
  a real function with continuous third derivative has a real point where the
  product of its derivatives of orders zero through three is nonnegative.
  This file contains no proof.
*)

let statement =
  `let has_derivative =
     \(g:real->real) (l:real) (x:real).
       !e:real.
         &0 < e
         ==> ?d:real.
               &0 < d /\
               !y:real.
                 &0 < abs (y - x) /\ abs (y - x) < d
                 ==> abs ((g y - g x) / (y - x) - l) < e in
   let continuous =
     \(g:real->real).
       !x e:real.
         &0 < e
         ==> ?d:real.
               &0 < d /\
               !y:real.
                 abs (y - x) < d ==> abs (g y - g x) < e in
   !f:real->real.
     let f1 = \x:real. @l:real. has_derivative f l x in
     let f2 = \x:real. @l:real. has_derivative f1 l x in
     let f3 = \x:real. @l:real. has_derivative f2 l x in
     (!x:real. has_derivative f (f1 x) x) /\
     (!x:real. has_derivative f1 (f2 x) x) /\
     (!x:real. has_derivative f2 (f3 x) x) /\
     continuous f3
     ==> ?a:real. f a * f1 a * f2 a * f3 a >= &0`;;

title: putnam_1998_a3
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1998_a3:
;; every real-valued function on the real line with continuous third
;; derivative has a point where f, f', f'', and f''' have nonnegative product.
;; This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))

;; The scalar arguments present a Dedekind-complete ordered field, hence a
;; presentation of the real numbers. Tame APPLY$ objects present arbitrary
;; real-valued functions. The three derivative functions and the concluding
;; point remain internally existentially quantified; differentiation and
;; continuity are expanded by their epsilon-delta definitions.

(defun p1998a3-member-p (carrier x)
  (if (apply$ carrier (list x)) t nil))

(defun p1998a3-unary (operation x)
  (apply$ operation (list x)))

(defun p1998a3-binary (operation x y)
  (apply$ operation (list x y)))

(defun p1998a3-subtract (add negate x y)
  (p1998a3-binary add x (p1998a3-unary negate y)))

(defun p1998a3-less-equal-p (less x y)
  (not (apply$ less (list y x))))

(defun p1998a3-absolute (less negate zero x)
  (if (apply$ less (list x zero))
      (p1998a3-unary negate x)
    x))

(defun-sk p1998a3-field-laws-p
    (carrier zero one add multiply negate inverse)
  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (p1998a3-member-p carrier x)
      (p1998a3-member-p carrier y)
      (p1998a3-member-p carrier z))
     (and
      (p1998a3-member-p
       carrier (p1998a3-binary add x y))
      (p1998a3-member-p
       carrier (p1998a3-binary multiply x y))
      (p1998a3-member-p
       carrier (p1998a3-unary negate x))
      (implies
       (not (equal x zero))
       (p1998a3-member-p
        carrier (p1998a3-unary inverse x)))
      (equal
       (p1998a3-binary add
                       (p1998a3-binary add x y)
                       z)
       (p1998a3-binary add
                       x
                       (p1998a3-binary add y z)))
      (equal
       (p1998a3-binary add x y)
       (p1998a3-binary add y x))
      (equal (p1998a3-binary add x zero) x)
      (equal
       (p1998a3-binary add x (p1998a3-unary negate x))
       zero)
      (equal
       (p1998a3-binary multiply
                       (p1998a3-binary multiply x y)
                       z)
       (p1998a3-binary multiply
                       x
                       (p1998a3-binary multiply y z)))
      (equal
       (p1998a3-binary multiply x y)
       (p1998a3-binary multiply y x))
      (equal (p1998a3-binary multiply x one) x)
      (implies
       (not (equal x zero))
       (equal
        (p1998a3-binary
         multiply x (p1998a3-unary inverse x))
        one))
      (equal
       (p1998a3-binary
        multiply x (p1998a3-binary add y z))
       (p1998a3-binary
        add
        (p1998a3-binary multiply x y)
        (p1998a3-binary multiply x z)))))))

(defun-sk p1998a3-order-laws-p
    (carrier zero add multiply less)
  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (p1998a3-member-p carrier x)
      (p1998a3-member-p carrier y)
      (p1998a3-member-p carrier z))
     (and
      (not (apply$ less (list x x)))
      (or
       (equal x y)
       (apply$ less (list x y))
       (apply$ less (list y x)))
      (implies
       (and
        (apply$ less (list x y))
        (apply$ less (list y z)))
       (apply$ less (list x z)))
      (implies
       (apply$ less (list x y))
       (apply$
        less
        (list
         (p1998a3-binary add x z)
         (p1998a3-binary add y z))))
      (implies
       (and
        (apply$ less (list zero x))
        (apply$ less (list zero y)))
       (apply$
        less
        (list
         zero
         (p1998a3-binary multiply x y))))))))

(defun-sk p1998a3-set-nonempty-p (carrier set)
  (exists (x)
    (and
     (p1998a3-member-p carrier x)
     (apply$ set (list x)))))

(defun-sk p1998a3-upper-bound-p
    (carrier less set bound)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (and
      (p1998a3-member-p carrier x)
      (apply$ set (list x)))
     (p1998a3-less-equal-p less x bound))))

(defun-sk p1998a3-bounded-above-p
    (carrier less set)
  (exists (bound)
    (and
     (p1998a3-member-p carrier bound)
     (p1998a3-upper-bound-p
      carrier less set bound))))

(defun-sk p1998a3-supremum-p
    (carrier less set supremum)
  (forall (bound)
    (and
     (p1998a3-member-p carrier supremum)
     (p1998a3-upper-bound-p
      carrier less set supremum)
     (implies
      (and
       (p1998a3-member-p carrier bound)
       (p1998a3-upper-bound-p
        carrier less set bound))
      (p1998a3-less-equal-p
       less supremum bound)))))

(defun-sk p1998a3-has-supremum-p
    (carrier less set)
  (exists (supremum)
    (p1998a3-supremum-p
     carrier less set supremum)))

(defun-sk p1998a3-dedekind-complete-p
    (carrier less)
  (forall (set)
    (implies
     (and
      (tamep-functionp set)
      (p1998a3-set-nonempty-p carrier set)
      (p1998a3-bounded-above-p carrier less set))
     (p1998a3-has-supremum-p
      carrier less set))))

(defun p1998a3-real-field-p
    (carrier zero one add multiply negate inverse less)
  (and
   (tamep-functionp carrier)
   (tamep-functionp add)
   (tamep-functionp multiply)
   (tamep-functionp negate)
   (tamep-functionp inverse)
   (tamep-functionp less)
   (p1998a3-member-p carrier zero)
   (p1998a3-member-p carrier one)
   (not (equal zero one))
   (p1998a3-field-laws-p
    carrier zero one add multiply negate inverse)
   (p1998a3-order-laws-p
    carrier zero add multiply less)
   (apply$ less (list zero one))
   (p1998a3-dedekind-complete-p carrier less)))

(defun-sk p1998a3-real-function-p
    (carrier function)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (p1998a3-member-p carrier x)
     (p1998a3-member-p
      carrier (apply$ function (list x))))))

(defun p1998a3-positive-p
    (carrier zero less x)
  (and
   (p1998a3-member-p carrier x)
   (apply$ less (list zero x))))

;; Global epsilon-delta continuity on the real carrier.

(defun-sk p1998a3-continuity-neighborhood-p
    (carrier zero add negate less function x epsilon delta)
  (forall (y)
    (implies
     (and
      (p1998a3-member-p carrier y)
      (apply$
       less
       (list
        (p1998a3-absolute
         less negate zero
         (p1998a3-subtract add negate y x))
        delta)))
     (apply$
      less
      (list
       (p1998a3-absolute
        less negate zero
        (p1998a3-subtract
         add negate
         (apply$ function (list y))
         (apply$ function (list x))))
       epsilon)))))

(defun-sk p1998a3-continuity-radius-exists-p
    (carrier zero add negate less function x epsilon)
  (exists (delta)
    (and
     (p1998a3-positive-p carrier zero less delta)
     (p1998a3-continuity-neighborhood-p
      carrier zero add negate less
      function x epsilon delta))))

(defun-sk p1998a3-continuous-at-p
    (carrier zero add negate less function x)
  (forall (epsilon)
    (implies
     (p1998a3-positive-p
      carrier zero less epsilon)
     (p1998a3-continuity-radius-exists-p
      carrier zero add negate less
      function x epsilon))))

(defun-sk p1998a3-continuous-p
    (carrier zero add negate less function)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (p1998a3-member-p carrier x)
     (p1998a3-continuous-at-p
      carrier zero add negate less function x))))

;; The derivative relation is expressed without division:
;; |g(y) - g(x) - d * (y - x)| <= epsilon * |y - x|
;; throughout a sufficiently small neighborhood of x.

(defun-sk p1998a3-derivative-neighborhood-p
    (carrier zero add multiply negate less
     function x derivative epsilon delta)
  (forall (y)
    (implies
     (and
      (p1998a3-member-p carrier y)
      (apply$
       less
       (list
        (p1998a3-absolute
         less negate zero
         (p1998a3-subtract add negate y x))
        delta)))
     (p1998a3-less-equal-p
      less
      (p1998a3-absolute
       less negate zero
       (p1998a3-subtract
        add negate
        (p1998a3-subtract
         add negate
         (apply$ function (list y))
         (apply$ function (list x)))
        (p1998a3-binary
         multiply derivative
         (p1998a3-subtract add negate y x))))
      (p1998a3-binary
       multiply epsilon
       (p1998a3-absolute
        less negate zero
        (p1998a3-subtract add negate y x)))))))

(defun-sk p1998a3-derivative-radius-exists-p
    (carrier zero add multiply negate less
     function x derivative epsilon)
  (exists (delta)
    (and
     (p1998a3-positive-p carrier zero less delta)
     (p1998a3-derivative-neighborhood-p
      carrier zero add multiply negate less
      function x derivative epsilon delta))))

(defun-sk p1998a3-derivative-epsilon-condition-p
    (carrier zero add multiply negate less
     function x derivative)
  (forall (epsilon)
    (implies
     (p1998a3-positive-p carrier zero less epsilon)
     (p1998a3-derivative-radius-exists-p
      carrier zero add multiply negate less
      function x derivative epsilon))))

(defun p1998a3-has-derivative-at-p
    (carrier zero add multiply negate less
     function x derivative)
  (and
   (p1998a3-member-p carrier x)
   (p1998a3-member-p carrier derivative)
   (p1998a3-derivative-epsilon-condition-p
    carrier zero add multiply negate less
    function x derivative)))

(defun-sk p1998a3-derivative-function-p
    (carrier zero add multiply negate less
     function derivative-function)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (p1998a3-member-p carrier x)
     (p1998a3-has-derivative-at-p
      carrier zero add multiply negate less
      function x
      (apply$ derivative-function (list x))))))

(defun p1998a3-c3-chain-p
    (carrier zero add multiply negate less
     function f1 f2 f3)
  (and
   (tamep-functionp function)
   (tamep-functionp f1)
   (tamep-functionp f2)
   (tamep-functionp f3)
   (p1998a3-real-function-p carrier function)
   (p1998a3-real-function-p carrier f1)
   (p1998a3-real-function-p carrier f2)
   (p1998a3-real-function-p carrier f3)
   (p1998a3-derivative-function-p
    carrier zero add multiply negate less
    function f1)
   (p1998a3-derivative-function-p
    carrier zero add multiply negate less
    f1 f2)
   (p1998a3-derivative-function-p
    carrier zero add multiply negate less
    f2 f3)
   (p1998a3-continuous-p
    carrier zero add negate less f3)))

(defun-sk p1998a3-c3-witnesses-p
    (carrier zero add multiply negate less function)
  (exists (f1 f2 f3)
    (p1998a3-c3-chain-p
     carrier zero add multiply negate less
     function f1 f2 f3)))

(defun p1998a3-fourfold-product
    (multiply function f1 f2 f3 x)
  (p1998a3-binary
   multiply
   (p1998a3-binary
    multiply
    (p1998a3-binary
     multiply
     (apply$ function (list x))
     (apply$ f1 (list x)))
    (apply$ f2 (list x)))
   (apply$ f3 (list x))))

(defun-sk p1998a3-good-point-witnesses-p
    (carrier zero add multiply negate less function)
  (exists (f1 f2 f3 x)
    (and
     (p1998a3-c3-chain-p
      carrier zero add multiply negate less
      function f1 f2 f3)
     (p1998a3-member-p carrier x)
     (p1998a3-less-equal-p
      less zero
      (p1998a3-fourfold-product
       multiply function f1 f2 f3 x)))))

(defun putnambench-putnam-1998-a3-statement
    (real-carrier real-zero real-one real-add real-multiply
     real-negate real-inverse real-less function)
  (implies
   (and
   (p1998a3-real-field-p
     real-carrier real-zero real-one real-add real-multiply
     real-negate real-inverse real-less)
    (tamep-functionp function)
    (p1998a3-real-function-p real-carrier function)
    (p1998a3-c3-witnesses-p
     real-carrier real-zero real-add real-multiply
     real-negate real-less function))
   (p1998a3-good-point-witnesses-p
    real-carrier real-zero real-add real-multiply
    real-negate real-less function)))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

title: putnam_1998_a3
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1998_a3
-- (putnambench__agda__putnam_1998_a3): every real function with a continuous
-- third derivative has a point where the product of its values through its
-- third derivative is nonnegative. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; _*_)

infix 4 _!=_
infixr 3 _and_
infixr 2 _or_

data Bottom : Set where

Not : Set -> Set
Not A =
  A -> Bottom

_!=_ : {A : Set} -> A -> A -> Set
x != y =
  Not (x == y)

record _and_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data _or_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  left  : A -> A or B
  right : B -> A or B

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

record CompleteOrderedRealField (R : Set) : Set1 where
  field
    zeroR oneR : R
    add multiply : R -> R -> R
    negate inverse : R -> R
    lessOrEqual : R -> R -> Set
    fromNat : Nat -> R

    one-not-zero :
      oneR != zeroR

    add-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> add x y == add y x
    add-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      add (add x y) z == add x (add y z)
    add-zero :
      (x : R) -> add x zeroR == x
    add-inverse :
      (x : R) -> add x (negate x) == zeroR

    multiply-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> multiply x y == multiply y x
    multiply-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply (multiply x y) z ==
      multiply x (multiply y z)
    multiply-one :
      (x : R) -> multiply x oneR == x
    multiply-zero :
      (x : R) -> multiply x zeroR == zeroR
    distribute :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply x (add y z) ==
      add (multiply x y) (multiply x z)
    inverse-zero :
      inverse zeroR == zeroR
    multiply-inverse :
      (x : R) ->
      x != zeroR ->
      multiply x (inverse x) == oneR

    order-reflexive :
      (x : R) -> lessOrEqual x x
    order-transitive :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y z ->
      lessOrEqual x z
    order-antisymmetric :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y x ->
      x == y
    order-total :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y or lessOrEqual y x
    add-order :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual (add z x) (add z y)
    multiply-nonnegative :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR x ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR y ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR (multiply x y)
    zero-less-than-one :
      lessOrEqual zeroR oneR and zeroR != oneR

    fromNat-zero :
      fromNat zero == zeroR
    fromNat-successor :
      (n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (suc n) == add (fromNat n) oneR
    fromNat-addition :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m + n) == add (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-multiplication :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m * n) == multiply (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-injective :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat m == fromNat n ->
      m == n

    archimedean :
      (x : R) ->
      Exists Nat
        (\ n ->
          lessOrEqual x (fromNat n))
    least-upper-bound :
      (P : R -> Set) ->
      Exists R P ->
      Exists R
        (\ upper ->
          (x : R) ->
          P x ->
          lessOrEqual x upper) ->
      Exists R
        (\ supremum ->
          ((x : R) ->
            P x ->
            lessOrEqual x supremum)
          and
          ((upper : R) ->
            ((x : R) ->
              P x ->
              lessOrEqual x upper) ->
            lessOrEqual supremum upper))

open CompleteOrderedRealField

subtract :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
subtract reals x y =
  add reals x (negate reals y)

divide :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
divide reals x y =
  multiply reals x (inverse reals y)

StrictLess :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
StrictLess reals x y =
  lessOrEqual reals x y and x != y

CloseTo :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
CloseTo reals center radius x =
  StrictLess reals
    (subtract reals center radius)
    x
  and
  StrictLess reals
    x
    (add reals center radius)

ContinuousAt :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (R -> R) ->
  R ->
  Set
ContinuousAt {R} reals function point =
  (epsilon : R) ->
  StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) epsilon ->
  Exists R
    (\ delta ->
      StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) delta
      and
      ((x : R) ->
        CloseTo reals point delta x ->
        CloseTo reals
          (function point)
          epsilon
          (function x)))

Continuous :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (R -> R) ->
  Set
Continuous {R} reals function =
  (point : R) ->
  ContinuousAt reals function point

differenceQuotient :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (R -> R) ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
differenceQuotient reals function point x =
  divide reals
    (subtract reals (function x) (function point))
    (subtract reals x point)

DerivativeAt :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (R -> R) ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
DerivativeAt {R} reals function point derivativeValue =
  (epsilon : R) ->
  StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) epsilon ->
  Exists R
    (\ delta ->
      StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) delta
      and
      ((x : R) ->
        CloseTo reals point delta x ->
        x != point ->
        CloseTo reals derivativeValue epsilon
          (differenceQuotient reals function point x)))

record ContinuousThirdDerivative
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R)
  (function : R -> R) :
  Set where

  field
    firstDerivative : R -> R
    secondDerivative : R -> R
    thirdDerivative : R -> R

    first-derivative-correct :
      (x : R) ->
      DerivativeAt reals
        function
        x
        (firstDerivative x)

    second-derivative-correct :
      (x : R) ->
      DerivativeAt reals
        firstDerivative
        x
        (secondDerivative x)

    third-derivative-correct :
      (x : R) ->
      DerivativeAt reals
        secondDerivative
        x
        (thirdDerivative x)

    third-derivative-continuous :
      Continuous reals thirdDerivative

open ContinuousThirdDerivative

putnam-1998-a3 : Set1
putnam-1998-a3 =
  (R : Set) ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) ->
  (f : R -> R) ->
  (smooth : ContinuousThirdDerivative reals f) ->
  Exists R
    (\ a ->
      lessOrEqual reals
        (zeroR reals)
        (multiply reals
          (multiply reals
            (multiply reals
              (f a)
              (firstDerivative smooth a))
            (secondDerivative smooth a))
          (thirdDerivative smooth a)))

(*
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench artifact putnam_1998_a3:
  a real function with continuous third derivative has a point where the
  product of its value and first three derivatives is nonnegative. This file
  contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open pred_setTheory realTheory real_topologyTheory limTheory;

val putnam_1998_a3 =
  ``!f : real -> real.
      (!x : real. higher_differentiable 3 f x) /\
      (\x : real. diffn 3 f x) continuous_on UNIV
      ==>
      ?a : real.
        0 <= f a * diffn 1 f a * diffn 2 f a * diffn 3 f a``;

title: putnam_1998_a3
content:
$(
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact
  putnam_1998_a3: every three-times continuously differentiable real
  function has a real point where the product of its value and first three
  derivatives is nonnegative. This file contains no proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  RR ^m RR is the class of all total real-valued functions. Membership in
  ( ( C^n ` RR ) ` 3 ) is set.mm's native assertion of global continuous
  differentiability through order three, and the entries of ( RR Dn f ) are
  the iterated real derivatives. The witness a remains internally
  existential over the full real line. The final declaration is the single
  unproved $a corpus statement; this database contains no $p proof statement.
$)

${
  $d a f $.

  putnambench-putnam-1998-a3 $a |-
    A. f e. ( RR ^m RR )
      (
        f e. ( ( C^n ` RR ) ` 3 )
        ->
        E. a e. RR
          0
          <_
          (
            (
              (
                ( f ` a )
                x.
                ( ( ( RR Dn f ) ` 1 ) ` a )
              )
              x.
              ( ( ( RR Dn f ) ` 2 ) ` a )
            )
            x.
            ( ( ( RR Dn f ) ` 3 ) ` a )
          )
      )
  $.
$}

title: putnam_1998_a3
content:
% Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1998_a3:
% every real function with a continuous third derivative has a point where
% the product of its values and its first three derivatives is nonnegative.
% This file contains no proof.

putnam_1998_a3: THEORY
BEGIN
  real_function: TYPE = [real -> real]

  continuous(f: real_function): bool =
    FORALL (x: real), (epsilon_value: posreal):
      EXISTS (delta: posreal):
        FORALL (z: real):
          abs(z - x) < delta IMPLIES
            abs(f(z) - f(x)) < epsilon_value

  has_derivative_at(
      f: real_function,
      derivative, x: real): bool =
    FORALL (epsilon_value: posreal):
      EXISTS (delta: posreal):
        FORALL (h: real):
          (NOT (h = 0) AND abs(h) < delta)
            IMPLIES
              abs(
                f(x + h) - f(x)
                  - derivative * h)
                < epsilon_value * abs(h)

  differentiable_at(f: real_function, x: real): bool =
    EXISTS (derivative: real):
      has_derivative_at(f, derivative, x)

  derivative_value(f: real_function, x: real): real =
    IF differentiable_at(f, x) THEN
      epsilon(
        LAMBDA (derivative: real):
          has_derivative_at(f, derivative, x))
    ELSE
      0
    ENDIF

  derivative_function(f: real_function): real_function =
    LAMBDA (x: real): derivative_value(f, x)

  continuously_differentiable(f: real_function): bool =
    (FORALL (x: real): differentiable_at(f, x))
      AND continuous(derivative_function(f))

  continuously_three_times_differentiable(
      f: real_function): bool =
    continuously_differentiable(f)
      AND continuously_differentiable(
        derivative_function(f))
      AND continuously_differentiable(
        derivative_function(
          derivative_function(f)))

  putnam_1998_a3: bool =
    FORALL (f: real_function):
      continuously_three_times_differentiable(f)
        IMPLIES
          EXISTS (a: real):
            f(a)
                * derivative_function(f)(a)

-- {n | n ≡ 1 [MOD 6]}
/--
Let $A_1=0$ and $A_2=1$. For $n>2$, the number $A_n$ is defined by concatenating the decimal expansions of $A_{n-1}$ and $A_{n-2}$ from left to right.  For example $A_3=A_2 A_1=10$, $A_4=A_3 A_2 = 101$, $A_5=A_4 A_3 = 10110$, and so forth.  Determine all $n$ such that $11$ divides $A_n$.

    (A : ℕ → List ℕ)
    (hA1 : A 1 = [0])
    (hA2 : A 2 = [1])
    (hA : ∀ n > 0, A (n + 2) = A (n + 1) ++ A n) :
    {n | 1 ≤ n ∧ 11 ∣ Nat.ofDigits 10 (A n).reverse} = putnam_1998_a4_solution :=

(defun putnam-1998-a4-digits (n)

  (cond

-- the recursively concatenated decimal strings divisible by 11 occur exactly at
-- indices congruent to 1 modulo 6. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module Main where

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.List using (List; []; _∷_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; _*_)

infix 2 _iff_
infixr 3 _and_
infixr 5 _++_
infix 4 _<=_ _divides_

record _and_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

record _iff_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor equivalence
  field
    forward  : A -> B
    backward : B -> A

record Exists (A : Set) (property : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value : A
    holds : property value

data _<=_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set where
  zero<= : {n : Nat} -> zero <= n
  suc<=suc : {m n : Nat} -> m <= n -> suc m <= suc n

record _divides_ (divisor dividend : Nat) : Set where
  constructor quotient
  field
    factor : Nat
    equation : divisor * factor == dividend

_++_ : {A : Set} -> List A -> List A -> List A
[] ++ ys = ys
(x ∷ xs) ++ ys = x ∷ (xs ++ ys)

fromDigitsAcc : Nat -> List Nat -> Nat
fromDigitsAcc accumulator [] =
  accumulator
fromDigitsAcc accumulator (digit ∷ digits) =
  fromDigitsAcc (10 * accumulator + digit) digits

fromDigits : List Nat -> Nat
fromDigits digits =
  fromDigitsAcc zero digits

CongruentOneModSix : Nat -> Set
CongruentOneModSix n =
  Exists Nat (\ q -> n == 1 + 6 * q)

putnam-1998-a4 : Set
putnam-1998-a4 =
  (A : Nat -> List Nat) ->
  A 1 == 0 ∷ [] ->
  A 2 == 1 ∷ [] ->
  ((n : Nat) ->
    1 <= n ->
    A (n + 2) == A (n + 1) ++ A n) ->
  (n : Nat) ->
  ((1 <= n) and (11 divides fromDigits (A n)))
    iff CongruentOneModSix n

  sequence generated from 0 and 1 by concatenating the preceding two words.
  This file contains no proof.

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  a ranges over all sequences of finite words of nonnegative integers, exactly
  representing the source type nat -> list nat without restricting words to
  finite tables or to a smaller digit type. The recurrence is imposed at every
  positive index, with singleton words representing the initial lists [0] and
  [1].

  For a word W, the finite sum of W(i) times 10^i is Isabelle's from_digits
  fold. Lean and Rocq use the reverse coefficient order for the ordinary
  left-to-right decimal value. Modulo 11, since 10 is congruent to -1,
  reversing any finite coefficient word multiplies its alternating sum by a
  sign, so the two values are divisible by 11 simultaneously. The right-hand
  set is Rocq's explicit solution n congruent to 1 modulo 6; such indices are
  automatically positive. The final declaration is a single unproved $a
  corpus statement, and this database contains no $p proof statement.
$)

${
  $d a i n $.

  putnambench-putnam-1998-a4 $a |-
    A. a e. ( Word NN0 ^m NN0 )
      (
        (
          ( a ` 1 ) = <" 0 ">
          /\
          (

            /\
            A. n e. NN

            ||
            sum_ i e. ( 0 ..^ ( # ` ( a ` n ) ) )
              ( ( ( a ` n ) ` i ) x. ( ; 1 0 ^ i ) )

        =
        { n e. NN0 | ( n mod 6 ) = 1 }

  $.
$}

% Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1998_a4:
% the decimal-concatenation recurrence and the characterization modulo six
% of indices whose resulting number is divisible by eleven. This file contains no proof.

putnam_1998_a4: THEORY
BEGIN
  digit_word: TYPE = list[nat]
  digit_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> digit_word]

  decimal_value(digits: digit_word): RECURSIVE nat =
    CASES digits OF
      null: 0,
      cons(digit, tail):
        digit * 10 ^ length(tail) + decimal_value(tail)
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE digits BY <<

  nat_divides(divisor: posnat, value: nat): bool =
    EXISTS (quotient: nat):
      value = divisor * quotient

  valid_sequence(A: digit_sequence): bool =
    A(1) = cons[nat](0, null[nat])
      AND A(2) = cons[nat](1, null[nat])
      AND (FORALL (n: nat):
        n > 0 IMPLIES
          A(n + 2) = append(A(n + 1), A(n)))

  putnam_1998_a4_solution(n: nat): bool =
    mod(n, 6) = 1

  putnam_1998_a4: bool =
    FORALL (A: digit_sequence):
      valid_sequence(A) IMPLIES
        (FORALL (n: nat):
          (n >= 1
            AND nat_divides(11, decimal_value(A(n))))
          IFF putnam_1998_a4_solution(n))
END putnam_1998_a4
