(* Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench artifact putnam_1998_a5:
   a finite cover of a planar set by positive-radius open discs has a
   pairwise disjoint subcollection whose tripled discs still cover the set.
   This file contains no proof. *)

From Stdlib Require Import Reals Arith.PeanoNat.

Open Scope R_scope.

Definition putnam_1998_a5_point := (R * R)%type.
Definition putnam_1998_a5_point_set :=
  putnam_1998_a5_point -> Prop.

Definition putnam_1998_a5_squared_distance
    (p q : putnam_1998_a5_point) : R :=
  (fst p - fst q) ^ 2 + (snd p - snd q) ^ 2.

Definition putnam_1998_a5_open_disc
    (center : putnam_1998_a5_point)
    (radius : R)
    (p : putnam_1998_a5_point) : Prop :=
  putnam_1998_a5_squared_distance p center < radius ^ 2.

Theorem putnam_1998_a5
    (k : nat)
    (c : nat -> putnam_1998_a5_point)
    (r : nat -> R)
    (E : putnam_1998_a5_point_set)
    (hr : forall i : nat, (i < k)%nat -> 0 < r i)
    (hE :
      forall p : putnam_1998_a5_point,
        E p ->
        exists i : nat,
          (i < k)%nat /\
          putnam_1998_a5_open_disc (c i) (r i) p) :
  exists (n : nat) (t : nat -> nat),
    (n <= k)%nat /\
    (forall i : nat, (i < n)%nat -> (t i < k)%nat) /\
    (forall i j : nat,
      (i < n)%nat ->
      (j < n)%nat ->
      i <> j ->
      forall p : putnam_1998_a5_point,
        ~ (putnam_1998_a5_open_disc (c (t i)) (r (t i)) p /\
           putnam_1998_a5_open_disc (c (t j)) (r (t j)) p)) /\
    forall p : putnam_1998_a5_point,
      E p ->

        (i < n)%nat /\

      (putnam-1998-a5-real-p x)
      (putnam-1998-a5-real-p y)
      (putnam-1998-a5-real-p z))
     (and
      (not (putnam-1998-a5-lt x x))
      (or
       (equal x y)
       (putnam-1998-a5-lt x y)
       (putnam-1998-a5-lt y x))
      (implies
       (and
        (putnam-1998-a5-lt x y)
        (putnam-1998-a5-lt y z))
       (putnam-1998-a5-lt x z))
      (implies
       (putnam-1998-a5-lt x y)
       (putnam-1998-a5-lt
        (putnam-1998-a5-add x z)
        (putnam-1998-a5-add y z)))
      (implies
       (and
        (putnam-1998-a5-lt (putnam-1998-a5-zero) x)
        (putnam-1998-a5-lt (putnam-1998-a5-zero) y))
       (putnam-1998-a5-lt
        (putnam-1998-a5-zero)
        (putnam-1998-a5-mul x y)))))))

(defun putnam-1998-a5-real-list-p (values)
  (if (consp values)
      (and
       (putnam-1998-a5-real-p (car values))
       (putnam-1998-a5-real-list-p (cdr values)))
    (equal values nil)))

;; Coefficients are stored in ascending degree order.
(defun putnam-1998-a5-polynomial-eval
    (coefficients x)
  (if (consp coefficients)
      (putnam-1998-a5-add
       (car coefficients)
       (putnam-1998-a5-mul
        x
        (putnam-1998-a5-polynomial-eval
         (cdr coefficients) x)))
    (putnam-1998-a5-zero)))

(defun putnam-1998-a5-odd-degree-polynomial-p
    (coefficients)
  (and
   (true-listp coefficients)
   (consp coefficients)
   (putnam-1998-a5-real-list-p coefficients)
   (evenp (len coefficients))
   (not
    (equal
     (car (last coefficients))
     (putnam-1998-a5-zero)))))

(defun-sk putnam-1998-a5-square-root-laws-p ()
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (and
      (putnam-1998-a5-real-p x)
      (not
       (putnam-1998-a5-lt
        x
        (putnam-1998-a5-zero))))
     (and
      (putnam-1998-a5-real-p
       (putnam-1998-a5-sqrt x))
      (equal
       (putnam-1998-a5-square
        (putnam-1998-a5-sqrt x))
       x)))))

(defun-sk putnam-1998-a5-odd-root-laws-p ()
  (forall (coefficients)
    (implies
     (putnam-1998-a5-odd-degree-polynomial-p
      coefficients)
     (and
      (putnam-1998-a5-real-p
       (putnam-1998-a5-odd-root coefficients))
      (equal
       (putnam-1998-a5-polynomial-eval
        coefficients
        (putnam-1998-a5-odd-root coefficients))
       (putnam-1998-a5-zero))))))

(defun putnam-1998-a5-real-closed-field-p ()
  (and
   (putnam-1998-a5-real-p
    (putnam-1998-a5-zero))
   (putnam-1998-a5-real-p
    (putnam-1998-a5-one))
   (not
    (equal
     (putnam-1998-a5-zero)
     (putnam-1998-a5-one)))
   (putnam-1998-a5-lt
    (putnam-1998-a5-zero)
    (putnam-1998-a5-one))
   (putnam-1998-a5-field-laws-p)
   (putnam-1998-a5-order-laws-p)
   (putnam-1998-a5-square-root-laws-p)
   (putnam-1998-a5-odd-root-laws-p)))

;; A disc is the three-element list (center-x center-y radius).

(defun putnam-1998-a5-disc-x (disc)
  (nth 0 disc))

(defun putnam-1998-a5-disc-y (disc)
  (nth 1 disc))

(defun putnam-1998-a5-disc-radius (disc)
  (nth 2 disc))

(defun putnam-1998-a5-disc-p (disc)
  (and
   (true-listp disc)
   (equal (len disc) 3)
   (putnam-1998-a5-real-p
    (putnam-1998-a5-disc-x disc))
   (putnam-1998-a5-real-p
    (putnam-1998-a5-disc-y disc))
   (putnam-1998-a5-real-p
    (putnam-1998-a5-disc-radius disc))
   (putnam-1998-a5-lt
    (putnam-1998-a5-zero)
    (putnam-1998-a5-disc-radius disc))))

(defun putnam-1998-a5-disc-list-p (discs)
  (if (consp discs)
      (and
       (putnam-1998-a5-disc-p (car discs))
       (putnam-1998-a5-disc-list-p (cdr discs)))
    (equal discs nil)))

(defun putnam-1998-a5-point-in-scaled-ball-p
    (x y disc scale)
  (let ((dx
         (putnam-1998-a5-sub
          x
          (putnam-1998-a5-disc-x disc)))
        (dy
         (putnam-1998-a5-sub
          y
          (putnam-1998-a5-disc-y disc)))
        (scaled-radius
         (putnam-1998-a5-mul
          scale
          (putnam-1998-a5-disc-radius disc))))
    (putnam-1998-a5-lt
     (putnam-1998-a5-add
      (putnam-1998-a5-square dx)
      (putnam-1998-a5-square dy))
     (putnam-1998-a5-square scaled-radius))))

(defun putnam-1998-a5-point-in-some-ball-p
    (x y discs)
  (if (consp discs)
      (or
       (putnam-1998-a5-point-in-scaled-ball-p
        x y (car discs) (putnam-1998-a5-one))
       (putnam-1998-a5-point-in-some-ball-p
        x y (cdr discs)))
    nil))

(defun-sk putnam-1998-a5-source-cover-p (discs)
  (forall (x y)
    (implies
     (and
      (putnam-1998-a5-real-p x)
      (putnam-1998-a5-real-p y)
      (putnam-1998-a5-e-member-p x y))
     (putnam-1998-a5-point-in-some-ball-p
      x y discs))))

(defun-sk putnam-1998-a5-balls-disjoint-p
    (left right)
  (forall (x y)
    (implies
     (and
      (putnam-1998-a5-real-p x)
      (putnam-1998-a5-real-p y))
     (not
      (and
       (putnam-1998-a5-point-in-scaled-ball-p
        x y left (putnam-1998-a5-one))
       (putnam-1998-a5-point-in-scaled-ball-p
        x y right (putnam-1998-a5-one)))))))

(defun putnam-1998-a5-index-list-p
    (indices disc-count)
  (if (consp indices)
      (and
       (natp (car indices))
       (< (car indices) disc-count)
       (putnam-1998-a5-index-list-p
        (cdr indices) disc-count))
    (equal indices nil)))

(defun putnam-1998-a5-disjoint-from-indices-p
    (index indices discs)
  (if (consp indices)
      (and
       (putnam-1998-a5-balls-disjoint-p
        (nth index discs)
        (nth (car indices) discs))
       (putnam-1998-a5-disjoint-from-indices-p
        index (cdr indices) discs))
    t))

(defun putnam-1998-a5-pairwise-disjoint-p
    (indices discs)
  (if (consp indices)
      (and
       (putnam-1998-a5-disjoint-from-indices-p
        (car indices) (cdr indices) discs)
       (putnam-1998-a5-pairwise-disjoint-p
        (cdr indices) discs))
    t))

(defun putnam-1998-a5-point-in-selected-triple-p
    (x y indices discs)
  (if (consp indices)
      (or
       (putnam-1998-a5-point-in-scaled-ball-p
        x
        y
        (nth (car indices) discs)
        (putnam-1998-a5-three))
       (putnam-1998-a5-point-in-selected-triple-p
        x y (cdr indices) discs))
    nil))

(defun-sk putnam-1998-a5-target-cover-p
    (indices discs)
  (forall (x y)
    (implies
     (and
      (putnam-1998-a5-real-p x)
      (putnam-1998-a5-real-p y)
      (putnam-1998-a5-e-member-p x y))
     (putnam-1998-a5-point-in-selected-triple-p
      x y indices discs))))

(defun putnam-1998-a5-selection-p
    (indices discs)
  (and
   (putnam-1998-a5-index-list-p
    indices (len discs))
   (<= (len indices) (len discs))
   (putnam-1998-a5-pairwise-disjoint-p
    indices discs)
   (putnam-1998-a5-target-cover-p
    indices discs)))

;; The subcollection is an internal existential witness, exactly as in the
;; source theorem; no particular selection algorithm is asserted.
(defun-sk putnam-1998-a5-selection-exists-p
    (discs)
  (exists (indices)
    (putnam-1998-a5-selection-p indices discs)))

(defun putnambench-putnam-1998-a5-statement
    (discs)
  (implies
   (and
    (putnam-1998-a5-real-closed-field-p)
    (putnam-1998-a5-disc-list-p discs)
    (putnam-1998-a5-source-cover-p discs))
   (putnam-1998-a5-selection-exists-p discs)))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

title: putnam_1998_a5
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1998_a5
-- (putnambench__agda__putnam_1998_a5): a finite open-disk cover in the real
-- plane has a pairwise-disjoint subcollection whose triple-radius disks cover
-- the original set. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; _*_)

infix 4 _!=_ _<=N_
infixr 3 _and_
infixr 2 _or_

data Bottom : Set where

Not : Set -> Set
Not A =
  A -> Bottom

_!=_ : {A : Set} -> A -> A -> Set
x != y =
  Not (x == y)

record _and_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data _or_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  left  : A -> A or B
  right : B -> A or B

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

data Fin : Nat -> Set where
  fzero : {n : Nat} -> Fin (suc n)
  fsuc  : {n : Nat} -> Fin n -> Fin (suc n)

data _<=N_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set where
  zero<=N   : {n : Nat} -> zero <=N n
  suc<=sucN : {m n : Nat} -> m <=N n -> suc m <=N suc n

oneN : Nat
oneN =
  suc zero

twoN : Nat
twoN =
  suc oneN

threeN : Nat
threeN =
  suc twoN

record CompleteOrderedRealField (R : Set) : Set1 where
  field
    zeroR oneR : R
    add multiply : R -> R -> R
    negate inverse squareRoot : R -> R
    lessOrEqual : R -> R -> Set
    fromNat : Nat -> R
    supremum infimum : (R -> Set) -> R

    one-not-zero :
      oneR != zeroR

    add-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> add x y == add y x
    add-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      add (add x y) z == add x (add y z)
    add-zero :
      (x : R) -> add x zeroR == x
    add-inverse :
      (x : R) -> add x (negate x) == zeroR

    multiply-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> multiply x y == multiply y x
    multiply-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply (multiply x y) z ==
      multiply x (multiply y z)
    multiply-one :
      (x : R) -> multiply x oneR == x
    multiply-zero :
      (x : R) -> multiply x zeroR == zeroR
    distribute :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply x (add y z) ==
      add (multiply x y) (multiply x z)
    inverse-zero :
      inverse zeroR == zeroR
    multiply-inverse :
      (x : R) ->
      x != zeroR ->
      multiply x (inverse x) == oneR

    order-reflexive :
      (x : R) -> lessOrEqual x x
    order-transitive :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y z ->
      lessOrEqual x z
    order-antisymmetric :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y x ->
      x == y
    order-total :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y or lessOrEqual y x
    add-order :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual (add z x) (add z y)
    multiply-nonnegative :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR x ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR y ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR (multiply x y)
    zero-less-than-one :
      lessOrEqual zeroR oneR and zeroR != oneR

    fromNat-zero :
      fromNat zero == zeroR
    fromNat-successor :
      (n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (suc n) == add (fromNat n) oneR
    fromNat-addition :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m + n) == add (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-multiplication :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m * n) == multiply (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-injective :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat m == fromNat n ->
      m == n

    archimedean :
      (x : R) ->
      Exists Nat
        (\ n -> lessOrEqual x (fromNat n))

    supremum-property :
      (P : R -> Set) ->
      Exists R P ->
      Exists R
        (\ upper ->
          (x : R) ->
          P x ->
          lessOrEqual x upper) ->
      ((x : R) ->
        P x ->
        lessOrEqual x (supremum P))
      and
      ((upper : R) ->
        ((x : R) ->
          P x ->
          lessOrEqual x upper) ->
        lessOrEqual (supremum P) upper)

    infimum-property :
      (P : R -> Set) ->
      Exists R P ->
      Exists R
        (\ lower ->
          (x : R) ->
          P x ->
          lessOrEqual lower x) ->
      ((x : R) ->
        P x ->
        lessOrEqual (infimum P) x)
      and
      ((lower : R) ->
        ((x : R) ->
          P x ->
          lessOrEqual lower x) ->
        lessOrEqual lower (infimum P))

    square-root-nonnegative :
      (x : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR (squareRoot x)
    square-root-square :
      (x : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR x ->
      multiply (squareRoot x) (squareRoot x) == x
    square-root-nonpositive :
      (x : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x zeroR ->
      squareRoot x == zeroR
    square-root-unique :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR y ->
      multiply y y == x ->
      y == squareRoot x

open CompleteOrderedRealField

subtract :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
subtract reals x y =
  add reals x (negate reals y)

square :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R
square reals x =
  multiply reals x x

StrictLess :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
StrictLess reals x y =
  lessOrEqual reals x y and x != y

record Point (R : Set) : Set where
  constructor point
  field
    x-coordinate : R
    y-coordinate : R

open Point

squaredDistance :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Point R ->
  Point R ->
  R
squaredDistance reals p q =
  add reals
    (square reals
      (subtract reals (x-coordinate p) (x-coordinate q)))
    (square reals
      (subtract reals (y-coordinate p) (y-coordinate q)))

distance :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Point R ->
  Point R ->
  R
distance reals p q =
  squareRoot reals (squaredDistance reals p q)

Subset : Set -> Set1
Subset R =
  Point R -> Set

OpenDisk :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Point R ->
  R ->
  Subset R
OpenDisk reals center radius p =
  StrictLess reals (distance reals center p) radius

Disjoint :
  {R : Set} ->
  Subset R ->
  Subset R ->
  Set
Disjoint leftSet rightSet =
  (p : _) ->
  Not (leftSet p and rightSet p)

module Putnam1998A5Statement
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) where

  PositiveRadii :
    {k : Nat} ->
    (Fin k -> R) ->
    Set
  PositiveRadii {k} radii =
    (i : Fin k) ->
    StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) (radii i)

  CoveredBy :
    {k : Nat} ->
    (Fin k -> Point R) ->
    (Fin k -> R) ->
    Subset R ->
    Set
  CoveredBy {k} centers radii E =
    (p : Point R) ->
    E p ->
    Exists (Fin k)
      (\ i ->
        OpenDisk reals (centers i) (radii i) p)

  SelectedPairwiseDisjoint :
    {k n : Nat} ->
    (Fin k -> Point R) ->
    (Fin k -> R) ->
    (Fin n -> Fin k) ->
    Set
  SelectedPairwiseDisjoint {n = n} centers radii select =
    (i j : Fin n) ->
    i != j ->
    Disjoint
      (OpenDisk reals
        (centers (select i))
        (radii (select i)))
      (OpenDisk reals
        (centers (select j))
        (radii (select j)))

  CoveredByTripleDisks :
    {k n : Nat} ->
    (Fin k -> Point R) ->
    (Fin k -> R) ->
    (Fin n -> Fin k) ->
    Subset R ->
    Set
  CoveredByTripleDisks {n = n} centers radii select E =
    (p : Point R) ->
    E p ->
    Exists (Fin n)
      (\ i ->
        OpenDisk reals
          (centers (select i))
          (multiply reals
            (fromNat reals threeN)
            (radii (select i)))
          p)

  proposition : Set1
  proposition =
    (k : Nat) ->
    (centers : Fin k -> Point R) ->
    (radii : Fin k -> R) ->
    PositiveRadii radii ->
    (E : Subset R) ->
    CoveredBy centers radii E ->
    Exists Nat
      (\ n ->
        Exists (Fin n -> Fin k)
          (\ select ->
            n <=N k
            and
            SelectedPairwiseDisjoint centers radii select
            and
            CoveredByTripleDisks centers radii select E))

putnam-1998-a5 : Set1
putnam-1998-a5 =
  (R : Set) ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) ->
  Putnam1998A5Statement.proposition reals

title: putnam_1998_a5
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1998_a5:
  a finite cover of a plane set by positive-radius open discs has a pairwise
  disjoint subcollection whose triple-radius discs still cover the set. This
  file contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open arithmeticTheory pairTheory pred_setTheory realTheory;

val putnam_1998_a5 =
  ``let open_disc =
      \(centre : real # real) (radius : real).
        {P : real # real |
           (FST P - FST centre) pow 2 +
           (SND P - SND centre) pow 2 < radius pow 2}
    in
      !k : num.
      !c : num -> real # real.
      !r : num -> real.
      !E : (real # real) set.
        (!i : num. i IN count k ==> 0 < r i) /\
        E SUBSET
          BIGUNION (IMAGE (\i. open_disc (c i) (r i)) (count k))
        ==>
        ?n : num. ?t : num -> num.
          n <= k /\
          IMAGE t (count n) SUBSET count k /\
          (!i j : num.
             i IN count n /\ j IN count n /\ i <> j
             ==>
             DISJOINT
               (open_disc (c (t i)) (r (t i)))
               (open_disc (c (t j)) (r (t j)))) /\
          E SUBSET
            BIGUNION
              (IMAGE
                 (\i. open_disc (c (t i)) (3 * (r (t i))))
                 (count n))``;

title: putnam_1998_a5
content:
$(
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact
  putnam_1998_a5: a finite family of positive-radius open discs covering a
  set in the real plane has a pairwise disjoint subcollection whose
  triple-radius discs still cover the set. This file contains no proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  P98A5R2 is the real coordinate plane, P98A5Dist is Euclidean distance,
  and P98A5Ball is the corresponding open ball. The carrier 0 ..^ k has
  exactly k elements and represents Fin k.

  The functions c and r give every center and positive radius on that
  carrier, while e ranges over arbitrary subsets of the plane. The witness
  t is a total selection from 0 ..^ n into the original carrier. Its
  selected open balls are pairwise disjoint, and the union of the selected
  balls after multiplying every radius by three contains e. This is the
  finite-index formulation common to the Lean and Isabelle sources.

  The final declaration is the single unproved $a corpus statement; this
  database contains no $p proof statement.
$)

$c P98A5I P98A5R2 P98A5Dist P98A5Ball $.

p98a5-index-syntax $a class P98A5I $.
p98a5-plane-syntax $a class P98A5R2 $.
p98a5-distance-syntax $a class ( P98A5Dist A B ) $.
p98a5-ball-syntax $a class ( P98A5Ball A B ) $.

p98a5-index-definition $a |- P98A5I = ( 1 ... 2 ) $.

p98a5-plane-definition $a |- P98A5R2 = ( RR ^m P98A5I ) $.

${
  $d A B j $.

  p98a5-distance-definition $a |- (
    P98A5Dist A B
  ) = (
    sqrt
    `
    (
      sum_ j e. P98A5I
        ( ( ( A ` j ) - ( B ` j ) ) ^ 2 )
    )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d A B x $.

  p98a5-ball-definition $a |- (
    P98A5Ball A B
  ) = {
    x e. P98A5R2 |
      ( P98A5Dist A x ) < B
  } $.
$}

${
  $d c e i j k n r t $.

  putnambench-putnam-1998-a5 $a |-
    A. k e. NN0
    A. c e. ( P98A5R2 ^m ( 0 ..^ k ) )
    A. r e. ( RR ^m ( 0 ..^ k ) )
    A. e e. ~P P98A5R2
      (
        (
          A. i e. ( 0 ..^ k ) 0 < ( r ` i )
          /\
          e C_
            U_ i e. ( 0 ..^ k )
              ( P98A5Ball ( c ` i ) ( r ` i ) )
        )
        ->
        E. n e. NN0
          E. t e. ( ( 0 ..^ k ) ^m ( 0 ..^ n ) )
            (
              n <_ k
              /\
              (
                A. i e. ( 0 ..^ n )
                  A. j e. ( 0 ..^ n )
                    (
                      i =/= j
                      ->
                      (
                        (
                          P98A5Ball
                            ( c ` ( t ` i ) )
                            ( r ` ( t ` i ) )
                        )
                        i^i
                        (
                          P98A5Ball
                            ( c ` ( t ` j ) )
                            ( r ` ( t ` j ) )
                        )
                      )
                      =
                      (/)
                    )
                /\
                e C_
                  U_ i e. ( 0 ..^ n )
                    (
                      P98A5Ball
                        ( c ` ( t ` i ) )
                        ( 3 x. ( r ` ( t ` i ) ) )
                    )
              )
            )
      )
  $.
$}

environ

 vocabularies ALGSTR_0, ARYTM_1, ARYTM_3, CARD_1, COMPLEX1, EUCLID,
      FINSEQ_1, FINSEQ_2, FINSET_1, FUNCT_1, FUNCT_2, METRIC_1, NAT_1,

title: putnam_1998_a5
content:
% Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1998_a5:
% a finite family of positive-radius open discs covering a planar set has a
% pairwise disjoint subfamily whose radius-tripled discs still cover that set.
% This file contains no proof.

putnam_1998_a5: THEORY
BEGIN
  point: TYPE = [# x_coord: real, y_coord: real #]
  point_set: TYPE = [point -> bool]
  point_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> point]
  real_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> real]
  index_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> nat]

  squared_distance(P, Q: point): real =
    (x_coord(P) - x_coord(Q)) ^ 2
      + (y_coord(P) - y_coord(Q)) ^ 2

  in_open_disc(P, center: point, radius: real): bool =
    squared_distance(P, center) < radius ^ 2

  covers_below(
      E: point_set,
      centers: point_sequence,
      radii: real_sequence,
      count: nat): bool =
    FORALL (P: point):
      E(P) IMPLIES
        EXISTS (i: nat):
          i < count
            AND in_open_disc(P, centers(i), radii(i))

  selects_below(
      selection: index_sequence,
      selected_count, family_count: nat): bool =
    FORALL (i: nat):
      i < selected_count IMPLIES selection(i) < family_count

  selected_discs_pairwise_disjoint(
      centers: point_sequence,
      radii: real_sequence,
      selection: index_sequence,
      selected_count: nat): bool =
    FORALL (i, j: nat):
      (i < selected_count
        AND j < selected_count
        AND i /= j)
      IMPLIES
        FORALL (P: point):
          NOT (
            in_open_disc(
              P, centers(selection(i)), radii(selection(i)))
            AND in_open_disc(
              P, centers(selection(j)), radii(selection(j))))

  tripled_discs_cover(
      E: point_set,
      centers: point_sequence,
      radii: real_sequence,
      selection: index_sequence,
      selected_count: nat): bool =
    FORALL (P: point):
      E(P) IMPLIES
        EXISTS (i: nat):
          i < selected_count
            AND in_open_disc(
              P,
              centers(selection(i)),
              3 * radii(selection(i)))

  putnam_1998_a5: bool =
    FORALL
        (k: nat),
        (centers: point_sequence),
        (radii: real_sequence),
        (E: point_set):
      ((FORALL (i: nat):
          i < k IMPLIES radii(i) > 0)
        AND covers_below(E, centers, radii, k))
      IMPLIES
        EXISTS (n: nat), (selection: index_sequence):
          n <= k
            AND selects_below(selection, n, k)
            AND selected_discs_pairwise_disjoint(
              centers, radii, selection, n)
            AND tripled_discs_cover(
              E, centers, radii, selection, n)
END putnam_1998_a5

title: putnam_1998_a6
content:
import Mathlib

open Set Function Metric
open scoped InnerProductSpace

/--
Let $A, B, C$ denote distinct points with integer coordinates in $\mathbb R^2$. Prove that if
\[(|AB|+|BC|)^2<8\cdot [ABC]+1\]
then $A, B, C$ are three vertices of a square. Here $|XY|$ is the length of segment $XY$ and $[ABC]$ is the area of triangle $ABC$.
-/
theorem putnam_1998_a6
(A B C : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
(hint : ∀ i : Fin 2, ∃ a b c : ℤ, A i = a ∧ B i = b ∧ C i = c)
(htriangle : A ≠ B ∧ A ≠ C ∧ B ≠ C)
(harea : (dist A B + dist B C) ^ 2 < 8 * (MeasureTheory.volume (convexHull ℝ {A, B, C})).toReal + 1)
(threesquare : (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) → (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) → (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) → Prop)
(threesquare_def : threesquare = fun P Q R ↦ dist Q P = dist Q R ∧ ⟪P - Q, R - Q⟫_ℝ = 0)
: (threesquare A B C ∨ threesquare B C A ∨ threesquare C A B) :=
sorry

title: putnam_1998_a6
content:
(* Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1998_a6:
   three distinct lattice points in the Euclidean plane satisfying the stated
   two-side-length and triangle-area inequality form three vertices of a
   square. This file contains no proof. *)

From Stdlib Require Import Reals ZArith.

Open Scope R_scope.

Definition putnam_1998_a6_point : Type := (R * R)%type.

Definition putnam_1998_a6_subtract
    (p q : putnam_1998_a6_point) : putnam_1998_a6_point :=
  (fst p - fst q, snd p - snd q).

Definition putnam_1998_a6_dot
    (p q : putnam_1998_a6_point) : R :=
  fst p * fst q + snd p * snd q.

Definition putnam_1998_a6_distance
    (p q : putnam_1998_a6_point) : R :=
  sqrt ((fst p - fst q) ^ 2 + (snd p - snd q) ^ 2).

Definition putnam_1998_a6_triangle_area
    (a b c : putnam_1998_a6_point) : R :=
  Rabs
    ((fst b - fst a) * (snd c - snd a) -
     (snd b - snd a) * (fst c - fst a)) / 2.

Definition putnam_1998_a6_lattice_point
    (p : putnam_1998_a6_point) : Prop :=
  exists x y : Z, p = (IZR x, IZR y).

Definition putnam_1998_a6_three_square
    (p q r : putnam_1998_a6_point) : Prop :=
  putnam_1998_a6_distance q p = putnam_1998_a6_distance q r /\
  putnam_1998_a6_dot
    (putnam_1998_a6_subtract p q)
    (putnam_1998_a6_subtract r q) = 0.

Theorem putnam_1998_a6
    (A B C : putnam_1998_a6_point)
    (hinteger :
      putnam_1998_a6_lattice_point A /\
      putnam_1998_a6_lattice_point B /\
      putnam_1998_a6_lattice_point C)
    (hdistinct : A <> B /\ A <> C /\ B <> C)
    (harea :
      (putnam_1998_a6_distance A B +
       putnam_1998_a6_distance B C) ^ 2 <
      8 * putnam_1998_a6_triangle_area A B C + 1) :
  putnam_1998_a6_three_square A B C \/
  putnam_1998_a6_three_square B C A \/
  putnam_1998_a6_three_square C A B.
Admitted.

theorem putnam_1998_a6:

(*
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1998_a6:
  three distinct lattice points in the real plane satisfying a two-side
  distance-area inequality form three vertices of a square. This file contains
  no proof.
*)

let statement =
  `let squared_distance =
     \(P:real^2) (Q:real^2).
       (P$1 - Q$1) pow 2 + (P$2 - Q$2) pow 2 in
   let distance =
     \(P:real^2) (Q:real^2). sqrt (squared_distance P Q) in
   let inner_product =
     \(P:real^2) (Q:real^2).
       P$1 * Q$1 + P$2 * Q$2 in
   let triangle_area =
     \(P:real^2) (Q:real^2) (R:real^2).
       abs ((Q$1 - P$1) * (R$2 - P$2) -
            (Q$2 - P$2) * (R$1 - P$1)) / &2 in
   !A B C:real^2.
   !threesquare:real^2->real^2->real^2->bool.
     (!i:num.
        1 <= i /\ i <= 2
        ==> ?a b c:int.
              A$i = real_of_int a /\
              B$i = real_of_int b /\
              C$i = real_of_int c) /\
     ~(A = B) /\ ~(A = C) /\ ~(B = C) /\
     (distance A B + distance B C) pow 2 <
       &8 * triangle_area A B C + &1 /\
     threesquare =
       (\P Q R.
          distance Q P = distance Q R /\
          inner_product
            (lambda i. P$i - Q$i)
            (lambda i. R$i - Q$i) = &0)
     ==>
     threesquare A B C \/
     threesquare B C A \/
     threesquare C A B`;;

title: putnam_1998_a6
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1998_a6:
;; three distinct lattice points satisfying the stated perimeter-area
;; inequality are three vertices of a square. This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

;; The source's integer-coordinate hypotheses identify A, B, and C
;; bijectively with the six integer coordinates used below. If U and V are
;; the squared lengths AB^2 and BC^2, and DELTA is the absolute orientation
;; determinant (twice the triangle area), then the source inequality is
;;
;;   U + V + 2*sqrt(U*V) < 4*DELTA + 1.
;;
;; With GAP = 4*DELTA + 1 - U - V and U,V >= 0, this is equivalent in both
;; directions to GAP > 0 and 4*U*V < GAP^2. Thus the predicate below uses
;; exact integer arithmetic without restricting or approximating the source
;; real inequality. Equal distances are likewise equivalent to equal squared
;; distances, and the source's threesquare predicate is unfolded definitionally.

(defun putnam-1998-a6-square (x)
  (* x x))

(defun putnam-1998-a6-distance-squared (left right)
  (+ (putnam-1998-a6-square
      (- (nth 0 left) (nth 0 right)))
     (putnam-1998-a6-square
      (- (nth 1 left) (nth 1 right)))))

(defun putnam-1998-a6-dot-at (left vertex right)
  (+ (* (- (nth 0 left) (nth 0 vertex))
        (- (nth 0 right) (nth 0 vertex)))
     (* (- (nth 1 left) (nth 1 vertex))
        (- (nth 1 right) (nth 1 vertex)))))

(defun putnam-1998-a6-orientation (a b c)
  (- (* (- (nth 0 b) (nth 0 a))
        (- (nth 1 c) (nth 1 a)))
     (* (- (nth 1 b) (nth 1 a))
        (- (nth 0 c) (nth 0 a)))))

(defun putnam-1998-a6-area-bound-p (a b c)
  (let* ((u (putnam-1998-a6-distance-squared a b))
         (v (putnam-1998-a6-distance-squared b c))
         (twice-area
          (abs (putnam-1998-a6-orientation a b c)))
         (gap (- (- (+ (* 4 twice-area) 1) u) v)))
    (and
     (< 0 gap)
     (< (* 4 u v)
        (putnam-1998-a6-square gap)))))

(defun putnam-1998-a6-three-square-p (left vertex right)
  (and
   (equal
    (putnam-1998-a6-distance-squared vertex left)
    (putnam-1998-a6-distance-squared vertex right))
   (equal (putnam-1998-a6-dot-at left vertex right) 0)))

(defun putnambench-putnam-1998-a6-statement
    (a-x a-y b-x b-y c-x c-y)
  (let ((a (list a-x a-y))
        (b (list b-x b-y))
        (c (list c-x c-y)))
    (implies
     (and
      (integerp a-x)
      (integerp a-y)
      (integerp b-x)
      (integerp b-y)
      (integerp c-x)
      (integerp c-y)
      (not (equal a b))
      (not (equal a c))
      (not (equal b c))
      (putnam-1998-a6-area-bound-p a b c))
     (or
      (putnam-1998-a6-three-square-p a b c)
      (putnam-1998-a6-three-square-p b c a)
      (putnam-1998-a6-three-square-p c a b)))))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

title: putnam_1998_a6
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1998_a6
-- (putnambench__agda__putnam_1998_a6): distinct lattice points in the real
-- plane satisfying the stated length-area inequality form three vertices of
-- a square. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Int using (Int; pos; negsuc)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; _*_)

infix 4 _!=_
infixr 3 _and_
infixr 2 _or_

data Bottom : Set where

Not : Set -> Set
Not A =
  A -> Bottom

_!=_ : {A : Set} -> A -> A -> Set
x != y =
  Not (x == y)

record _and_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data _or_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  left  : A -> A or B
  right : B -> A or B

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

record CompleteOrderedRealField (R : Set) : Set1 where
  field
    zeroR oneR : R
    add multiply : R -> R -> R
    negate inverse squareRoot : R -> R
    lessOrEqual : R -> R -> Set
    fromNat : Nat -> R
    supremum infimum : (R -> Set) -> R

    one-not-zero :
      oneR != zeroR

    add-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> add x y == add y x
    add-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      add (add x y) z == add x (add y z)
    add-zero :
      (x : R) -> add x zeroR == x
    add-inverse :
      (x : R) -> add x (negate x) == zeroR

    multiply-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> multiply x y == multiply y x
    multiply-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply (multiply x y) z ==
      multiply x (multiply y z)
    multiply-one :
      (x : R) -> multiply x oneR == x
    multiply-zero :
      (x : R) -> multiply x zeroR == zeroR
    distribute :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply x (add y z) ==
      add (multiply x y) (multiply x z)
    inverse-zero :
      inverse zeroR == zeroR
    multiply-inverse :
      (x : R) ->
      x != zeroR ->
      multiply x (inverse x) == oneR

    order-reflexive :
      (x : R) -> lessOrEqual x x
    order-transitive :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y z ->
      lessOrEqual x z
    order-antisymmetric :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y x ->
      x == y
    order-total :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y or lessOrEqual y x
    add-order :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual (add z x) (add z y)
    multiply-nonnegative :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR x ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR y ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR (multiply x y)
    zero-less-than-one :
      lessOrEqual zeroR oneR and zeroR != oneR

    fromNat-zero :
      fromNat zero == zeroR
    fromNat-successor :
      (n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (suc n) == add (fromNat n) oneR
    fromNat-addition :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m + n) == add (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-multiplication :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m * n) == multiply (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-injective :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat m == fromNat n ->
      m == n

    archimedean :
      (x : R) ->
      Exists Nat
        (\ n -> lessOrEqual x (fromNat n))

    supremum-property :
      (P : R -> Set) ->
      Exists R P ->
      Exists R
        (\ upper ->
          (x : R) ->
          P x ->
          lessOrEqual x upper) ->
      ((x : R) ->
        P x ->
        lessOrEqual x (supremum P))
      and
      ((upper : R) ->
        ((x : R) ->
          P x ->
          lessOrEqual x upper) ->
        lessOrEqual (supremum P) upper)

    infimum-property :
      (P : R -> Set) ->
      Exists R P ->
      Exists R
        (\ lower ->
          (x : R) ->
          P x ->
          lessOrEqual lower x) ->
      ((x : R) ->
        P x ->
        lessOrEqual (infimum P) x)
      and
      ((lower : R) ->
        ((x : R) ->
          P x ->
          lessOrEqual lower x) ->
        lessOrEqual lower (infimum P))

    square-root-nonnegative :
      (x : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR (squareRoot x)
    square-root-square :
      (x : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR x ->
      multiply (squareRoot x) (squareRoot x) == x
    square-root-nonpositive :
      (x : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x zeroR ->
      squareRoot x == zeroR
    square-root-unique :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR y ->
      multiply y y == x ->
      y == squareRoot x

open CompleteOrderedRealField

subtract :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
subtract reals x y =
  add reals x (negate reals y)

square :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R
square reals x =
  multiply reals x x

fromInt :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Int ->
  R
fromInt reals (pos n) =
  fromNat reals n
fromInt reals (negsuc n) =
  negate reals (fromNat reals (suc n))

StrictLess :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
StrictLess reals x y =
  lessOrEqual reals x y and x != y

oneN : Nat
oneN =
  suc zero

twoN : Nat
twoN =
  suc oneN

eightN : Nat
eightN =
  suc (suc (suc (suc (suc (suc (suc oneN))))))

half :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R
half reals =
  inverse reals (fromNat reals twoN)

record Point (R : Set) : Set where
  constructor point
  field
    x-coordinate : R
    y-coordinate : R

open Point

squaredDistance :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Point R ->
  Point R ->
  R
squaredDistance reals p q =
  add reals
    (square reals
      (subtract reals (x-coordinate p) (x-coordinate q)))
    (square reals
      (subtract reals (y-coordinate p) (y-coordinate q)))

distance :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Point R ->
  Point R ->
  R
distance reals p q =
  squareRoot reals (squaredDistance reals p q)

doubleSignedArea :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Point R ->
  Point R ->
  Point R ->
  R
doubleSignedArea reals a b c =
  subtract reals
    (multiply reals
      (subtract reals (x-coordinate b) (x-coordinate a))
      (subtract reals (y-coordinate c) (y-coordinate a)))
    (multiply reals
      (subtract reals (y-coordinate b) (y-coordinate a))
      (subtract reals (x-coordinate c) (x-coordinate a)))

triangleArea :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Point R ->
  Point R ->
  Point R ->
  R
triangleArea reals a b c =
  multiply reals
    (half reals)
    (squareRoot reals
      (square reals (doubleSignedArea reals a b c)))

dotAt :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Point R ->
  Point R ->
  Point R ->
  R
dotAt reals q p r =
  add reals
    (multiply reals
      (subtract reals (x-coordinate p) (x-coordinate q))
      (subtract reals (x-coordinate r) (x-coordinate q)))
    (multiply reals
      (subtract reals (y-coordinate p) (y-coordinate q))
      (subtract reals (y-coordinate r) (y-coordinate q)))

module Putnam1998A6Statement
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) where

  IntegerCoordinates :
    Point R ->
    Point R ->
    Point R ->
    Set
  IntegerCoordinates A B C =
    Exists Int
      (\ a ->
        Exists Int
          (\ b ->
            Exists Int
              (\ c ->
                x-coordinate A == fromInt reals a
                and
                x-coordinate B == fromInt reals b
                and
                x-coordinate C == fromInt reals c)))
    and
    Exists Int
      (\ a ->
        Exists Int
          (\ b ->
            Exists Int
              (\ c ->
                y-coordinate A == fromInt reals a
                and
                y-coordinate B == fromInt reals b
                and
                y-coordinate C == fromInt reals c)))

  Distinct :
    Point R ->
    Point R ->
    Point R ->
    Set
  Distinct A B C =
    A != B and A != C and B != C

  AreaBound :
    Point R ->
    Point R ->
    Point R ->
    Set
  AreaBound A B C =
    StrictLess reals
      (square reals
        (add reals
          (distance reals A B)
          (distance reals B C)))
      (add reals
        (multiply reals
          (fromNat reals eightN)
          (triangleArea reals A B C))
        (oneR reals))

  ThreeSquare :
    Point R ->
    Point R ->
    Point R ->
    Set
  ThreeSquare P Q R' =
    distance reals Q P == distance reals Q R'
    and
    dotAt reals Q P R' == zeroR reals

  proposition : Set
  proposition =
    (A B C : Point R) ->
    IntegerCoordinates A B C ->
    Distinct A B C ->
    AreaBound A B C ->
    ThreeSquare A B C
    or

(*
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1998_a6:
  distinct integer-coordinate points whose stated distance and triangle-area
  inequality forces them to be three vertices of a square. This file contains
  no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open integerTheory pairTheory pred_setTheory realTheory intrealTheory
     transcTheory;
open extrealTheory measureTheory lebesgue_measureTheory martingaleTheory;

val putnam_1998_a6 =
  ``let lattice_point =
      \P : real # real.
        ?x y : int.
          P = (real_of_int x, real_of_int y)
    in
    let dist =
      \P Q : real # real.
        sqrt ((FST P - FST Q) pow 2 + (SND P - SND Q) pow 2)
    in
    let convex_hull_three =
      \A B C : real # real.
        {X : real # real |
          ?u v w : real.
            0 <= u /\ 0 <= v /\ 0 <= w /\
            u + v + w = 1 /\
            X =
              (u * FST A + v * FST B + w * FST C,
               u * SND A + v * SND B + w * SND C)}
    in
    let triangle_area =
      \A B C : real # real.
        real
          (measure
            (prod_measure_space lebesgue lebesgue)
            (convex_hull_three A B C))
    in
    let threesquare =
      \P Q R : real # real.
        dist Q P = dist Q R /\
        (FST P - FST Q) * (FST R - FST Q) +
          (SND P - SND Q) * (SND R - SND Q) = 0
    in
      !A B C : real # real.
        lattice_point A /\
        lattice_point B /\
        lattice_point C /\
        A <> B /\ A <> C /\ B <> C /\
        (dist A B + dist B C) pow 2 <
          8 * triangle_area A B C + 1
        ==>
        threesquare A B C \/
        threesquare B C A \/
        threesquare C A B``;

content:
$(
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact
  putnam_1998_a6: distinct integer-coordinate points in the real plane
  satisfying the stated distance and triangle-area inequality are three
  vertices of a square. This file contains no proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  P98A6I is the two-coordinate index set and P98A6R2 is the real plane.
  P98A6Dist is Euclidean distance. P98A6Hull is the convex hull of three
  points via nonnegative barycentric coordinates, and P98A6Area is its
  planar Lebesgue measure through set.mm's finite-dimensional volume.
  P98A6ThreeSquare P Q R states that the rays from Q to P and R have equal
  length and zero inner product, so P, Q, and R are three consecutive
  vertices of a square.

  Quantification over ZZ-valued functions on P98A6I is equivalent to the
  real-plane point type together with the integer-coordinate hypothesis in
  the Lean and Isabelle sources. The final declaration is the single
  unproved $a corpus statement; this database contains no $p proof statement.
$)

$c P98A6I P98A6R2 P98A6Dist P98A6Hull P98A6Area P98A6Dot
   P98A6ThreeSquare $.

p98a6-index-syntax $a class P98A6I $.
p98a6-plane-syntax $a class P98A6R2 $.
p98a6-distance-syntax $a class ( P98A6Dist A B ) $.
p98a6-hull-syntax $a class ( P98A6Hull A B C ) $.
p98a6-area-syntax $a class ( P98A6Area A B C ) $.
p98a6-dot-syntax $a class ( P98A6Dot A B C ) $.
p98a6-three-square-syntax $a wff ( P98A6ThreeSquare A B C ) $.

p98a6-index-definition $a |- P98A6I = ( 1 ... 2 ) $.

p98a6-plane-definition $a |- P98A6R2 = ( RR ^m P98A6I ) $.

${
  $d A B j $.

  p98a6-distance-definition $a |- (
    P98A6Dist A B
  ) = (
    sqrt
    `
    (
      sum_ j e. P98A6I
        ( ( ( A ` j ) - ( B ` j ) ) ^ 2 )
    )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d A B C j u v w x $.

  p98a6-hull-definition $a |- (
    P98A6Hull A B C
  ) = {
    x e. P98A6R2 |
    E. u e. RR E. v e. RR E. w e. RR
      (
        (
          0 <_ u
          /\
          (
            0 <_ v
            /\
            0 <_ w
          )
        )
        /\
        (
          ( ( u + v ) + w ) = 1
          /\
          x =
            (
              j e. P98A6I |->
                (
                  (
                    ( u x. ( A ` j ) )
                    +
                    ( v x. ( B ` j ) )
                  )
                  +
                  ( w x. ( C ` j ) )
                )
            )
        )
      )
  } $.
$}

p98a6-area-definition $a |- (
  P98A6Area A B C
) = (
  ( voln ` P98A6I )
  `
  ( P98A6Hull A B C )
) $.

${
  $d A B C j $.

  p98a6-dot-definition $a |- (
    P98A6Dot A B C
  ) = (
    sum_ j e. P98A6I
      (
        ( ( A ` j ) - ( B ` j ) )
        x.
        ( ( C ` j ) - ( B ` j ) )
      )
  ) $.
$}

p98a6-three-square-definition $a |- (
  ( P98A6ThreeSquare A B C )
  <->
  (
    ( P98A6Dist B A ) = ( P98A6Dist B C )
    /\
    ( P98A6Dot A B C ) = 0
  )
) $.

${
  $d a b c $.

  putnambench-putnam-1998-a6 $a |-
    A. a e. ( ZZ ^m P98A6I )
    A. b e. ( ZZ ^m P98A6I )
    A. c e. ( ZZ ^m P98A6I )
      (
        (
          (
            a =/= b
            /\
            (
              a =/= c
              /\
              b =/= c
            )
          )
          /\
          (
            ( ( P98A6Dist a b ) + ( P98A6Dist b c ) ) ^ 2
            <
            ( ( 8 x. ( P98A6Area a b c ) ) + 1 )
          )
        )
        ->
        (
          ( P98A6ThreeSquare a b c )
          \/
          (
            ( P98A6ThreeSquare b c a )
            \/
            ( P98A6ThreeSquare c a b )
          )
        )
      )
  $.
$}

title: putnam_1998_a6
content:
% Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1998_a6:
% distinct integer-coordinate points in the real plane satisfying the stated
% length-area inequality are three vertices of a square. This file contains no proof.

putnam_1998_a6: THEORY
BEGIN
  point: TYPE = [# x_coord: real, y_coord: real #]

  integer_point(P: point): bool =
    EXISTS (m, n: int):
      x_coord(P) = (m :: real)
        AND y_coord(P) = (n :: real)

  squared_distance(P, Q: point): real =
    (x_coord(P) - x_coord(Q)) ^ 2
      + (y_coord(P) - y_coord(Q)) ^ 2

  distance(P, Q: point): real =
    epsilon(
      LAMBDA (length: real):
        0 <= length
          AND length * length = squared_distance(P, Q))

  cross_from(P, Q, R: point): real =
    (x_coord(Q) - x_coord(P)) * (y_coord(R) - y_coord(P))
      - (y_coord(Q) - y_coord(P)) * (x_coord(R) - x_coord(P))

  triangle_area(P, Q, R: point): real =
    abs(cross_from(P, Q, R)) / 2

  dot_at(P, Q, R: point): real =
    (x_coord(P) - x_coord(Q)) * (x_coord(R) - x_coord(Q))
      + (y_coord(P) - y_coord(Q)) * (y_coord(R) - y_coord(Q))

  three_square_vertices(P, Q, R: point): bool =
    distance(Q, P) = distance(Q, R)
      AND dot_at(P, Q, R) = 0

  putnam_1998_a6: bool =
    FORALL (A, B, C: point):
      (integer_point(A)
        AND integer_point(B)
        AND integer_point(C)
        AND A /= B
        AND A /= C
        AND B /= C
        AND (distance(A, B) + distance(B, C)) ^ 2
          < 8 * triangle_area(A, B, C) + 1)
      IMPLIES
        (three_square_vertices(A, B, C)
          OR three_square_vertices(B, C, A)
          OR three_square_vertices(C, A, B))
END putnam_1998_a6

;; Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1998_b1:
;; the minimum over positive real x of the given quotient involving x and
;; 1/x is 6. This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(defun putnam-1998-b1-value (x)
  (/ (- (- (expt (+ x (/ 1 x)) 6)
           (+ (expt x 6)
              (/ 1 (expt x 6))))
        2)
     (+ (expt (+ x (/ 1 x)) 3)
        (+ (expt x 3)
           (/ 1 (expt x 3))))))

(defun putnam-1998-b1-admissible-p (x)
  (and (rationalp x)
       (< 0 x)))

;; Standard ACL2 has exact rational arithmetic rather than a primitive real
;; sort. On x > 0 the denominator is strictly positive, so the source quotient
;; is continuous. Positive rationals are dense in the positive reals; hence
;; its lower bound is 6 on all positive reals exactly when it is 6 on all
;; positive rationals. The exact rational point x = 1 supplies the source's
;; internal attainment witness. Thus the two clauses below are
;; bidirectionally equivalent to the source assertion that the real minimum
;; is 6, without replacing the real domain by a rational minimum problem.
;; This argument applies to the fixed displayed quotient expanded above; an
;; arbitrary function that could behave differently at irrational points is
;; neither introduced nor quantified by this statement.
(defun putnambench-putnam-1998-b1-statement (x)
  (and
   (putnam-1998-b1-admissible-p 1)
   (equal (putnam-1998-b1-value 1) 6)
   (implies
    (putnam-1998-b1-admissible-p x)
    (<= 6 (putnam-1998-b1-value x)))))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

content:
-- Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1998_b1
-- (putnambench__agda__putnam_1998_b1): the minimum over positive real x of
-- the stated quotient involving powers of x + 1/x is 6. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; _*_)

infix 4 _!=_
infixr 3 _and_
infixr 2 _or_

data Bottom : Set where

Not : Set -> Set
Not A =
  A -> Bottom

_!=_ : {A : Set} -> A -> A -> Set
x != y =
  Not (x == y)

record _and_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data _or_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  left  : A -> A or B
  right : B -> A or B

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

record CompleteOrderedRealField (R : Set) : Set1 where
  field
    zeroR oneR : R
    add multiply : R -> R -> R
    negate inverse : R -> R
    lessOrEqual : R -> R -> Set
    fromNat : Nat -> R

    one-not-zero :
      oneR != zeroR

    add-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> add x y == add y x
    add-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      add (add x y) z == add x (add y z)
    add-zero :
      (x : R) -> add x zeroR == x
    add-inverse :
      (x : R) -> add x (negate x) == zeroR

    multiply-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> multiply x y == multiply y x
    multiply-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply (multiply x y) z ==
      multiply x (multiply y z)
    multiply-one :
      (x : R) -> multiply x oneR == x
    multiply-zero :
      (x : R) -> multiply x zeroR == zeroR
    distribute :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply x (add y z) ==
      add (multiply x y) (multiply x z)
    inverse-zero :
      inverse zeroR == zeroR
    multiply-inverse :
      (x : R) ->
      x != zeroR ->
      multiply x (inverse x) == oneR

    order-reflexive :
      (x : R) -> lessOrEqual x x
    order-transitive :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y z ->
      lessOrEqual x z
    order-antisymmetric :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y x ->
      x == y
    order-total :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y or lessOrEqual y x
    add-order :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual (add z x) (add z y)
    multiply-nonnegative :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR x ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR y ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR (multiply x y)
    zero-less-than-one :
      lessOrEqual zeroR oneR and zeroR != oneR

    fromNat-zero :
      fromNat zero == zeroR
    fromNat-successor :
      (n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (suc n) == add (fromNat n) oneR
    fromNat-addition :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m + n) == add (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-multiplication :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m * n) == multiply (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-injective :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat m == fromNat n ->
      m == n

    archimedean :
      (x : R) ->
      Exists Nat (\ n -> lessOrEqual x (fromNat n))
    least-upper-bound :
      (P : R -> Set) ->
      Exists R P ->
      Exists R
        (\ upper ->
          (x : R) ->
          P x ->
          lessOrEqual x upper) ->
      Exists R
        (\ supremum ->
          ((x : R) ->
            P x ->
            lessOrEqual x supremum)
          and
          ((upper : R) ->
            ((x : R) ->
              P x ->
              lessOrEqual x upper) ->
            lessOrEqual supremum upper))

open CompleteOrderedRealField

subtract :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
subtract reals x y =
  add reals x (negate reals y)

divide :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
divide reals x y =
  multiply reals x (inverse reals y)

naturalPower :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  Nat ->
  R
naturalPower reals x zero =
  oneR reals
naturalPower reals x (suc n) =
  multiply reals
    (naturalPower reals x n)
    x

StrictLess :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
StrictLess reals x y =
  lessOrEqual reals x y and x != y

module Putnam1998B1Statement
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) where

  oneN : Nat
  oneN =
    suc zero

  twoN : Nat
  twoN =
    suc oneN

  threeN : Nat
  threeN =
    suc twoN

  sixN : Nat
  sixN =
    threeN + threeN

  two six : R
  two =
    fromNat reals twoN
  six =
    fromNat reals sixN

  reciprocal : R -> R
  reciprocal x =
    divide reals (oneR reals) x

  objective : R -> R
  objective x =
    divide reals
      (subtract reals
        (subtract reals
          (naturalPower reals
            (add reals x (reciprocal x))
            sixN)
          (add reals
            (naturalPower reals x sixN)
            (reciprocal
              (naturalPower reals x sixN))))
        two)
      (add reals
        (naturalPower reals
          (add reals x (reciprocal x))
          threeN)
        (add reals
          (naturalPower reals x threeN)
          (reciprocal
            (naturalPower reals x threeN))))

  Positive : R -> Set
  Positive x =
    StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) x

  IsMinimumValue : R -> Set
  IsMinimumValue minimum =
    ((x : R) ->
      Positive x ->
      lessOrEqual reals minimum (objective x))
    and
    Exists R
      (\ x ->
        Positive x
        and
        objective x == minimum)

  proposition : Set
  proposition =
    IsMinimumValue six

putnam-1998-b1 : Set1
putnam-1998-b1 =
  (R : Set) ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) ->
  Putnam1998B1Statement.proposition reals

% Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1998_b1:
% the minimum over positive real x of the stated rational expression in x
% and its reciprocal is 6. This file contains no proof.

putnam_1998_b1: THEORY
BEGIN
  safe_div(numerator, denominator: real): real =
    IF denominator = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      numerator / denominator
    ENDIF

  objective(x: real): real =
    safe_div(
      (x + safe_div(1, x)) ^ 6
        - (x ^ 6 + safe_div(1, x ^ 6))
        - 2,
      (x + safe_div(1, x)) ^ 3
        + (x ^ 3 + safe_div(1, x ^ 3)))

  is_minimum_value(value: real): bool =
    (FORALL (x: real):
      x > 0 IMPLIES value <= objective(x))
      AND
        (EXISTS (x: real):
          x > 0 AND value = objective(x))

  putnam_1998_b1_solution: real = 6

  putnam_1998_b1: bool =
    is_minimum_value(putnam_1998_b1_solution)
END putnam_1998_b1

(* Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1998_b2:
   the minimum perimeter of a nondegenerate triangle with one vertex at a
   given point, one on the x-axis, and one on the line y = x. This file
   contains no proof. *)

From Stdlib Require Import Reals.

Open Scope R_scope.

Definition putnam_1998_b2_distance
    (p q : (R * R)%type) : R :=
  sqrt ((fst p - fst q) ^ 2 + (snd p - snd q) ^ 2).

Definition putnam_1998_b2_perimeter
    (a b c x : R) : R :=
  putnam_1998_b2_distance (a, b) (c, 0) +
  putnam_1998_b2_distance (c, 0) (x, x) +
  putnam_1998_b2_distance (a, b) (x, x).

Definition putnam_1998_b2_nondegenerate
    (a b c x : R) : Prop :=
  putnam_1998_b2_distance (a, b) (c, 0) +
    putnam_1998_b2_distance (c, 0) (x, x) >
    putnam_1998_b2_distance (a, b) (x, x) /\
  putnam_1998_b2_distance (a, b) (c, 0) +
    putnam_1998_b2_distance (a, b) (x, x) >
    putnam_1998_b2_distance (c, 0) (x, x) /\
  putnam_1998_b2_distance (c, 0) (x, x) +
    putnam_1998_b2_distance (a, b) (x, x) >
    putnam_1998_b2_distance (a, b) (c, 0).

Definition putnam_1998_b2_candidate_perimeter
    (a b : R) (p : R) : Prop :=
  exists c x : R,
    p = putnam_1998_b2_perimeter a b c x /\
    putnam_1998_b2_nondegenerate a b c x.

Definition putnam_1998_b2_is_infimum
    (S : R -> Prop) (m : R) : Prop :=
  (forall p : R, S p -> m <= p) /\
  (forall lower : R,
      (forall p : R, S p -> lower <= p) ->
      lower <= m).

Definition putnam_1998_b2_solution (a b : R) : R :=
  sqrt (2 * a ^ 2 + 2 * b ^ 2).

Theorem putnam_1998_b2
    (a b : R)
    (hab : 0 < b /\ b < a) :
  putnam_1998_b2_is_infimum
    (putnam_1998_b2_candidate_perimeter a b)
    (putnam_1998_b2_solution a b).
Admitted.

(*

  the minimum perimeter of a triangle with vertices at (a,b), on the x-axis,
  and on the line y = x. This file contains no proof.
*)

let statement =
  `let edge_ac =
     \a b c:real.
       sqrt ((a - c) pow 2 + (b - &0) pow 2) in
   let edge_cx =
     \c x:real.
       sqrt ((c - x) pow 2 + (&0 - x) pow 2) in
   let edge_ax =
     \a b x:real.
       sqrt ((a - x) pow 2 + (b - x) pow 2) in
   !a b:real.
     &0 < b /\ b < a
     ==>
     inf
       {p:real |
          ?c x:real.
            p = edge_ac a b c + edge_cx c x + edge_ax a b x /\
            edge_ac a b c + edge_cx c x > edge_ax a b x /\
            edge_ac a b c + edge_ax a b x > edge_cx c x /\
            edge_cx c x + edge_ax a b x > edge_ac a b c} =
     sqrt (&2 * a pow 2 + &2 * b pow 2)`;;

;; for 0 < b < a, the infimum perimeter of nondegenerate triangles with
;; vertices (a,b), (c,0), and (x,x) is sqrt(2*a^2 + 2*b^2). This file contains
;; no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

;; The conservative interfaces below present an arbitrary real-closed ordered
;; field.  After expanding the displayed infimum into its greatest-lower-bound
;; definition, the source proposition is a closed first-order ordered-field
;; sentence.  Real-closed fields have the same first-order theory as the reals,
;; and the real algebraic numbers give a non-vacuous countable model inside
;; ACL2's value universe.  Thus the full-carrier quantifiers below preserve the
;; arbitrary-real domain without rational probes, finite tables, or an external
;; minimizing witness.

(defstub p98b2-member-p (real-type value) t)
(defstub p98b2-zero (real-type) t)
(defstub p98b2-one (real-type) t)
(defstub p98b2-add (real-type left right) t)
(defstub p98b2-multiply (real-type left right) t)
(defstub p98b2-negate (real-type value) t)
(defstub p98b2-inverse (real-type value) t)
(defstub p98b2-less (real-type left right) t)
(defstub p98b2-square-root (real-type value) t)

(defun p98b2-r-add (real-type left right)
  (p98b2-add real-type left right))

(defun p98b2-r-multiply (real-type left right)
  (p98b2-multiply real-type left right))

(defun p98b2-r-negate (real-type value)
  (p98b2-negate real-type value))

(defun p98b2-r-inverse (real-type value)
  (p98b2-inverse real-type value))

(defun p98b2-r-subtract (real-type left right)
  (p98b2-r-add
   real-type left (p98b2-r-negate real-type right)))

(defun p98b2-leq (real-type left right)
  (not (p98b2-less real-type right left)))

(defun p98b2-square (real-type value)
  (p98b2-r-multiply real-type value value))

(defun p98b2-two (real-type)
  (p98b2-r-add
   real-type
   (p98b2-one real-type)
   (p98b2-one real-type)))

(defun-sk p98b2-field-laws-p (real-type)
  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (p98b2-member-p real-type x)
      (p98b2-member-p real-type y)
      (p98b2-member-p real-type z))
     (let* ((zero (p98b2-zero real-type))
            (one (p98b2-one real-type))
            (xy-add (p98b2-r-add real-type x y))
            (yz-add (p98b2-r-add real-type y z))
            (xy-mul (p98b2-r-multiply real-type x y))
            (yz-mul (p98b2-r-multiply real-type y z))
            (neg-x (p98b2-r-negate real-type x))
            (inv-x (p98b2-r-inverse real-type x)))
       (and
        (p98b2-member-p real-type xy-add)
        (p98b2-member-p real-type xy-mul)
        (p98b2-member-p real-type neg-x)
        (p98b2-member-p real-type inv-x)
        (equal
         (p98b2-r-add real-type xy-add z)
         (p98b2-r-add real-type x yz-add))
        (equal xy-add (p98b2-r-add real-type y x))
        (equal (p98b2-r-add real-type x zero) x)
        (equal (p98b2-r-add real-type x neg-x) zero)
        (equal
         (p98b2-r-multiply real-type xy-mul z)
         (p98b2-r-multiply real-type x yz-mul))
        (equal xy-mul (p98b2-r-multiply real-type y x))
        (equal (p98b2-r-multiply real-type x one) x)
        (implies
         (equal x zero)
         (equal inv-x zero))
        (implies
         (not (equal x zero))
         (equal
          (p98b2-r-multiply real-type x inv-x)
          one))
        (equal
         (p98b2-r-multiply real-type x yz-add)
         (p98b2-r-add
          real-type
          (p98b2-r-multiply real-type x y)
          (p98b2-r-multiply real-type x z))))))))

(defun-sk p98b2-order-laws-p (real-type)
  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (p98b2-member-p real-type x)
      (p98b2-member-p real-type y)
      (p98b2-member-p real-type z))
     (let ((zero (p98b2-zero real-type)))
       (and
        (not (p98b2-less real-type x x))
        (or
         (p98b2-less real-type x y)
         (equal x y)
         (p98b2-less real-type y x))
        (implies
         (and
          (p98b2-less real-type x y)
          (p98b2-less real-type y z))
         (p98b2-less real-type x z))
        (implies
         (p98b2-less real-type x y)
         (p98b2-less
          real-type
          (p98b2-r-add real-type x z)
          (p98b2-r-add real-type y z)))
        (implies
         (and
          (p98b2-less real-type zero x)
          (p98b2-less real-type zero y))
         (p98b2-less
          real-type
          zero
          (p98b2-r-multiply real-type x y))))))))

;; One first-order characterization of real-closed ordered fields: every
;; nonnegative element is a square and every odd-degree polynomial has a root.
;; Coefficient lists are constant-term first.

(defun p98b2-polynomial-p (real-type coefficients)
  (if (consp coefficients)
      (and
       (p98b2-member-p real-type (car coefficients))
       (p98b2-polynomial-p real-type (cdr coefficients)))
    (equal coefficients nil)))

(defun p98b2-leading-coefficient (coefficients)
  (if (consp (cdr coefficients))
      (p98b2-leading-coefficient (cdr coefficients))
    (car coefficients)))

(defun p98b2-polynomial-value
    (real-type coefficients value)
  (if (consp coefficients)
      (p98b2-r-add
       real-type
       (car coefficients)
       (p98b2-r-multiply
        real-type
        value
        (p98b2-polynomial-value
         real-type (cdr coefficients) value)))
    (p98b2-zero real-type)))

(defun p98b2-odd-degree-polynomial-p
    (real-type coefficients)
  (and
   (consp coefficients)
   (true-listp coefficients)
   (p98b2-polynomial-p real-type coefficients)
   (oddp (1- (len coefficients)))
   (not
    (equal
     (p98b2-leading-coefficient coefficients)
     (p98b2-zero real-type)))))

(defun-sk p98b2-nonnegative-square-root-exists-p
    (real-type value)
  (exists (root)

     (p98b2-member-p real-type root)
     (equal
      (p98b2-square real-type root)

(defun-sk p98b2-positive-elements-are-squares-p

      (p98b2-member-p real-type value)

(defun-sk p98b2-polynomial-root-exists-p

     (p98b2-member-p real-type root)

      (p98b2-zero real-type)))))

(defun-sk p98b2-odd-polynomials-have-roots-p
    (real-type)
  (forall (coefficients)
    (implies
     (p98b2-odd-degree-polynomial-p
      real-type coefficients)
     (p98b2-polynomial-root-exists-p
      real-type coefficients))))

;; This fixes the square-root symbol to the source's principal real square
;; root, including its conventional zero value on negative arguments.

(defun-sk p98b2-square-root-laws-p (real-type)
  (forall (value)
    (implies
     (p98b2-member-p real-type value)
     (let ((zero (p98b2-zero real-type))
           (root (p98b2-square-root real-type value)))
       (and
        (p98b2-member-p real-type root)

            (equal root zero)
          (and
           (p98b2-leq real-type zero root)
           (equal
            (p98b2-square real-type root)
            value))))))))

(defun p98b2-real-closed-field-p (real-type)
  (let ((zero (p98b2-zero real-type))
        (one (p98b2-one real-type)))
    (and
     (p98b2-member-p real-type zero)
     (p98b2-member-p real-type one)
     (not (equal zero one))
     (p98b2-field-laws-p real-type)
     (p98b2-order-laws-p real-type)
     (p98b2-less real-type zero one)
     (p98b2-positive-elements-are-squares-p real-type)
     (p98b2-odd-polynomials-have-roots-p real-type)
     (p98b2-square-root-laws-p real-type))))

(defun p98b2-distance
    (real-type left-x left-y right-x right-y)
  (let ((delta-x
         (p98b2-r-subtract real-type left-x right-x))
        (delta-y
         (p98b2-r-subtract real-type left-y right-y)))
    (p98b2-square-root
     real-type

      real-type
      (p98b2-square real-type delta-x)
      (p98b2-square real-type delta-y)))))

(defun p98b2-first-side (real-type a b c)
  (p98b2-distance
   real-type

   real-type

   real-type

    real-type
    (p98b2-second-side real-type c x)
    (p98b2-third-side real-type a b x))))

(defun p98b2-admissible-p (real-type a b c x)

   (p98b2-member-p real-type c)
   (p98b2-member-p real-type x)
   (let ((first (p98b2-first-side real-type a b c))
         (second (p98b2-second-side real-type c x))
         (third (p98b2-third-side real-type a b x)))

      (p98b2-less
       real-type
       third
       (p98b2-r-add real-type first second))
      (p98b2-less
       real-type
       second
       (p98b2-r-add real-type first third))
      (p98b2-less
       real-type
       first
       (p98b2-r-add real-type second third))))))

(defun p98b2-solution (real-type a b)
  (let ((two (p98b2-two real-type)))
    (p98b2-square-root
     real-type
     (p98b2-r-add
      real-type
      (p98b2-r-multiply

;; definition of the source sInf, not an approximation or an attainment

(defun-sk p98b2-lower-bound-p

(defun-sk p98b2-greatest-lower-bound-p

  (forall (bound)
    (implies
     (and
      (p98b2-member-p real-type bound)
      (p98b2-lower-bound-p real-type a b bound))

(defun p98b2-is-infimum-p

   (p98b2-member-p real-type candidate)
   (p98b2-lower-bound-p real-type a b candidate)

    distribute :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply x (add y z) ==
      add (multiply x y) (multiply x z)
    inverse-zero :
      inverse zeroR == zeroR
    multiply-inverse :
      (x : R) ->
      x != zeroR ->
      multiply x (inverse x) == oneR

    order-reflexive :
      (x : R) -> lessOrEqual x x
    order-transitive :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y z ->
      lessOrEqual x z
    order-antisymmetric :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y x ->
      x == y
    order-total :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y or lessOrEqual y x
    add-order :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual (add z x) (add z y)
    multiply-nonnegative :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR x ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR y ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR (multiply x y)
    zero-less-than-one :
      lessOrEqual zeroR oneR and zeroR != oneR

    fromNat-zero :
      fromNat zero == zeroR
    fromNat-successor :
      (n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (suc n) == add (fromNat n) oneR
    fromNat-addition :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m + n) == add (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-multiplication :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m * n) == multiply (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-injective :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat m == fromNat n ->
      m == n

    archimedean :
      (x : R) ->
      Exists Nat
        (\ n -> lessOrEqual x (fromNat n))

    supremum-property :
      (P : R -> Set) ->
      Exists R P ->
      Exists R
        (\ upper ->
          (x : R) ->
          P x ->
          lessOrEqual x upper) ->
      ((x : R) ->
        P x ->
        lessOrEqual x (supremum P))
      and
      ((upper : R) ->
        ((x : R) ->
          P x ->
          lessOrEqual x upper) ->
        lessOrEqual (supremum P) upper)

    infimum-property :
      (P : R -> Set) ->
      Exists R P ->
      Exists R
        (\ lower ->
          (x : R) ->
          P x ->
          lessOrEqual lower x) ->
      ((x : R) ->
        P x ->
        lessOrEqual (infimum P) x)
      and
      ((lower : R) ->
        ((x : R) ->
          P x ->
          lessOrEqual lower x) ->
        lessOrEqual lower (infimum P))

    square-root-nonnegative :
      (x : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR (squareRoot x)
    square-root-square :
      (x : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR x ->
      multiply (squareRoot x) (squareRoot x) == x
    square-root-nonpositive :
      (x : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x zeroR ->
      squareRoot x == zeroR
    square-root-unique :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR y ->
      multiply y y == x ->
      y == squareRoot x

open CompleteOrderedRealField

subtract :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
subtract reals x y =
  add reals x (negate reals y)

square :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R
square reals x =
  multiply reals x x

StrictLess :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
StrictLess reals x y =
  lessOrEqual reals x y and x != y

record Point (R : Set) : Set where
  constructor point
  field
    x-coordinate : R
    y-coordinate : R

open Point

squaredDistance :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Point R ->
  Point R ->
  R
squaredDistance reals p q =
  add reals
    (square reals
      (subtract reals (x-coordinate p) (x-coordinate q)))
    (square reals
      (subtract reals (y-coordinate p) (y-coordinate q)))

distance :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Point R ->
  Point R ->
  R
distance reals p q =
  squareRoot reals (squaredDistance reals p q)

module Putnam1998B2Statement
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) where

  twoN : Nat
  twoN =
    suc (suc zero)

  two : R
  two =
    fromNat reals twoN

  fixedPoint : R -> R -> Point R
  fixedPoint a b =
    point a b

  axisPoint : R -> Point R
  axisPoint c =
    point c (zeroR reals)

  diagonalPoint : R -> Point R
  diagonalPoint x =
    point x x

  firstSide : R -> R -> R -> R
  firstSide a b c =
    distance reals (fixedPoint a b) (axisPoint c)

  secondSide : R -> R -> R
  secondSide c x =
    distance reals (axisPoint c) (diagonalPoint x)

  thirdSide : R -> R -> R -> R
  thirdSide a b x =
    distance reals (fixedPoint a b) (diagonalPoint x)

  perimeter : R -> R -> R -> R -> R
  perimeter a b c x =
    add reals
      (add reals
        (firstSide a b c)
        (secondSide c x))
      (thirdSide a b x)

  IsTriangle : R -> R -> R -> R -> Set
  IsTriangle a b c x =
    StrictLess reals
      (thirdSide a b x)
      (add reals
        (firstSide a b c)
        (secondSide c x))
    and
    StrictLess reals
      (secondSide c x)
      (add reals
        (firstSide a b c)
        (thirdSide a b x))
    and
    StrictLess reals
      (firstSide a b c)
      (add reals
        (secondSide c x)
        (thirdSide a b x))

  FeasiblePerimeter : R -> R -> R -> Set
  FeasiblePerimeter a b d =
    Exists R
      (\ c ->
        Exists R
          (\ x ->
            d == perimeter a b c x
            and
            IsTriangle a b c x))

  solution : R -> R -> R
  solution a b =
    squareRoot reals
      (add reals
        (multiply reals two (square reals a))
        (multiply reals two (square reals b)))

  proposition : Set
  proposition =
    (a b : R) ->
    StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) b
    and
    StrictLess reals b a ->
    infimum reals (FeasiblePerimeter a b) == solution a b

putnam-1998-b2 : Set1
putnam-1998-b2 =
  (R : Set) ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) ->
  Putnam1998B2Statement.proposition reals

(*
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1998_b2:
  the minimum perimeter of a nondegenerate triangle with one fixed vertex,
  one vertex on the x-axis, and one on the line y = x. This file contains no
  proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open pairTheory realTheory transcTheory;

val putnam_1998_b2 =
  ``!a b : real.
      0 < b /\ b < a
      ==>
      let dist =
        \P Q : real # real.
          sqrt ((FST P - FST Q) pow 2 + (SND P - SND Q) pow 2)
      in
      let perimeter =
        \c x : real.
          dist (a, b) (c, 0) +
          dist (c, 0) (x, x) +
          dist (a, b) (x, x)
      in
      let valid_triangle =
        \c x : real.
          dist (a, b) (c, 0) + dist (c, 0) (x, x) >
            dist (a, b) (x, x) /\
          dist (a, b) (c, 0) + dist (a, b) (x, x) >
            dist (c, 0) (x, x) /\
          dist (c, 0) (x, x) + dist (a, b) (x, x) >
            dist (a, b) (c, 0)
      in
      let solution = sqrt (2 * a pow 2 + 2 * b pow 2)
      in
        (!c x : real.
           valid_triangle c x ==> solution <= perimeter c x) /\
        (?c x : real.
           valid_triangle c x /\ perimeter c x = solution)``;

% Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1998_b2:
% for 0 < b < a, the infimum perimeter of nondegenerate triangles with
% vertices (a,b), (c,0), and (x,x) is sqrt(2*a^2 + 2*b^2). This file contains
% no proof.

putnam_1998_b2: THEORY
BEGIN
  sqrt_value(root, radicand: real): bool =
    0 <= root AND root * root = radicand

  perimeter_value(a, b, c, x, value: real): bool =
    EXISTS (first_side, second_side, third_side: real):
      sqrt_value(
        first_side,
        (a - c) ^ 2 + b ^ 2)
        AND sqrt_value(
          second_side,
          (c - x) ^ 2 + x ^ 2)
        AND sqrt_value(
          third_side,
          (a - x) ^ 2 + (b - x) ^ 2)
        AND value = first_side + second_side + third_side
        AND first_side + second_side > third_side
        AND first_side + third_side > second_side
        AND second_side + third_side > first_side

  attainable_perimeter(a, b, value: real): bool =
    EXISTS (c, x: real):
      perimeter_value(a, b, c, x, value)

  is_lower_bound(a, b, bound: real): bool =
    FORALL (value: real):
      attainable_perimeter(a, b, value)
        IMPLIES bound <= value

  is_infimum(a, b, value: real): bool =
    is_lower_bound(a, b, value)
      AND FORALL (bound: real):
        is_lower_bound(a, b, bound)
          IMPLIES bound <= value

  putnam_1998_b2: bool =
    FORALL (a, b: real):
      (0 < b AND b < a)
        IMPLIES
          EXISTS (solution: real):
            sqrt_value(
              solution,
              2 * a ^ 2 + 2 * b ^ 2)
              AND is_infimum(a, b, solution)
END putnam_1998_b2

Require Import List Nat ZArith.

Definition putnam_1998_b4_solution (m n : nat) : Prop :=
  forall m2 n2 : nat,
    (m mod (2 ^ m2) = 0%nat /\
     m mod (2 ^ (m2 + 1)) <> 0%nat /\
     n mod (2 ^ n2) = 0%nat /\
     n mod (2 ^ (n2 + 1)) <> 0%nat) ->
    m2 <> n2.

Definition putnam_1998_b4_term (m n i : nat) : Z :=
  if Nat.even (i / m + i / n) then 1%Z else (-1)%Z.

Definition putnam_1998_b4_sum (m n : nat) : Z :=
  List.fold_right Z.add 0%Z
    (List.map (putnam_1998_b4_term m n) (List.seq 0 (m * n))).

Theorem putnam_1998_b4
    (hsum : nat -> nat -> Z := putnam_1998_b4_sum) :
  forall m n : nat,
    (m > 0 /\ n > 0)%nat ->
    (hsum m n = 0%Z <-> putnam_1998_b4_solution m n).
Proof. Admitted.

title: putnam_1998_b4
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1998_b4:
;; for positive natural m and n, an alternating floor-quotient sum vanishes
;; exactly when m and n have different 2-adic valuations. This file contains
;; no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

;; For positive n, this is the greatest exponent k such that 2^k divides n.
(defun putnam-1998-b4-two-adic-valuation (n)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix n)))
  (if (and (posp n)
           (equal (mod n 2) 0))
      (+ 1
         (putnam-1998-b4-two-adic-valuation
          (floor n 2)))
    0))

;; Inclusive sum from i = 0 through upper of
;; (-1)^(floor(i/m) + floor(i/n)).
(defun putnam-1998-b4-alternating-sum-through (m n upper)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix upper)))
  (let ((term
         (expt -1
               (+ (floor upper m)
                  (floor upper n)))))
    (if (zp upper)
        term
      (+ (putnam-1998-b4-alternating-sum-through
          m n (- upper 1))
         term))))

(defun putnam-1998-b4-solution-p (m n)
  (not
   (equal
    (putnam-1998-b4-two-adic-valuation m)
    (putnam-1998-b4-two-adic-valuation n))))

(defun putnambench-putnam-1998-b4-statement (m n)
  (implies
   (and (posp m)
        (posp n))
   (iff
    (equal
     (putnam-1998-b4-alternating-sum-through
      m n (- (* m n) 1))
     0)
    (putnam-1998-b4-solution-p m n))))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

-- Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1998_b4
-- (putnambench__agda__putnam_1998_b4): the alternating floor-quotient sum
-- vanishes exactly when the two positive integers have different 2-adic
-- valuations. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Int using (Int; pos; negsuc)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using
  (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; _*_; div-helper)

infix 4 _!=_
infixr 3 _and_
infixr 2 _iff_

data Bottom : Set where

Not : Set -> Set
Not A =
  A -> Bottom

_!=_ : {A : Set} -> A -> A -> Set
x != y =
  Not (x == y)

record _and_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

record _iff_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor equivalence
  field
    forward  : A -> B
    backward : B -> A

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

data Positive : Nat -> Set where
  positive : (n : Nat) -> Positive (suc n)

one : Nat
one =
  suc zero

two : Nat
two =
  suc one

naturalDiv : Nat -> Nat -> Nat
naturalDiv numerator zero =
  zero
naturalDiv numerator (suc denominator) =
  div-helper zero denominator numerator denominator

naturalPower : Nat -> Nat -> Nat
naturalPower base zero =
  one
naturalPower base (suc exponent) =
  base * naturalPower base exponent

Divides : Nat -> Nat -> Set
Divides divisor number =
  Exists Nat
    (\ quotient -> divisor * quotient == number)

ExactTwoAdicExponent : Nat -> Nat -> Set
ExactTwoAdicExponent number exponent =
  Divides (naturalPower two exponent) number
  and
  Not (Divides (naturalPower two (suc exponent)) number)

TwoAdicValuationsDiffer : Nat -> Nat -> Set
TwoAdicValuationsDiffer m n =
  Exists Nat
    (\ mExponent ->
      ExactTwoAdicExponent m mExponent
      and
      Exists Nat
        (\ nExponent ->
          ExactTwoAdicExponent n nExponent
          and
          mExponent != nExponent))

negativeNat : Nat -> Int
negativeNat zero =
  pos zero
negativeNat (suc n) =
  negsuc n

differenceNat : Nat -> Nat -> Int
differenceNat zero zero =
  pos zero
differenceNat (suc m) zero =
  pos (suc m)
differenceNat zero (suc n) =
  negsuc n
differenceNat (suc m) (suc n) =
  differenceNat m n

negateInt : Int -> Int
negateInt (pos n) =
  negativeNat n
negateInt (negsuc n) =
  pos (suc n)

addInt : Int -> Int -> Int
addInt (pos m) (pos n) =
  pos (m + n)

negativeOnePower (suc exponent) =
  negateInt (negativeOnePower exponent)

sumFirstInt (suc length) term =

  an alternating floor-quotient sum for two positive integers vanishes exactly
  when their 2-adic valuations differ. This file contains no proof.

val putnam_1998_b4 =

        divides (2 EXP k) x /\
        ~(divides (2 EXP (k + 1)) x)

      !m n : num.
        0 < m /\ 0 < n

           (\i : num. \acc : int.

           (count (m * n))

           exact_power_of_two_divisor b n /\

  by the two floor quotients vanishes, characterized by unequal exact powers
  of two dividing the integers. This file contains no proof.

$(

  n: 2^r divides m but 2^(r+1) does not, and similarly for n. Their inequality
