% Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1998_b4:
% the alternating floor-quotient sum for positive integers m and n vanishes
% exactly when their 2-adic valuations differ. This file contains no proof.

putnam_1998_b4: THEORY
BEGIN
  nat_divides(divisor, value: nat): bool =
    EXISTS (quotient: nat):
      value = divisor * quotient

  exact_two_exponent(value, exponent: nat): bool =
    nat_divides(2 ^ exponent, value)
      AND NOT nat_divides(2 ^ (exponent + 1), value)

  putnam_1998_b4_solution(m, n: posnat): bool =
    EXISTS (m_exponent, n_exponent: nat):
      exact_two_exponent(m, m_exponent)
        AND exact_two_exponent(n, n_exponent)
        AND m_exponent /= n_exponent

  alternating_term(index: nat, m, n: posnat): int =
    IF mod(ndiv(index, m) + ndiv(index, n), 2) = 0 THEN
      1
    ELSE
      -1
    ENDIF

  alternating_sum(m, n: posnat, count: nat): RECURSIVE int =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      alternating_sum(m, n, count - 1)
        + alternating_term(count - 1, m, n)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  putnam_1998_b4_statement: bool =
    FORALL (m, n: posnat):
      alternating_sum(m, n, m * n) = 0
        IFF putnam_1998_b4_solution(m, n)
END putnam_1998_b4

;; Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1998_b5:
;; the thousandth digit after the decimal point of the square root of the
;; 1998-digit decimal repunit is 1. This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

;; This is sum_{i=0}^{digits-1} 10^i, matching the source definition of N.
(defun putnam-1998-b5-repunit-sum (digits)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix digits)))
  (if (zp digits)
      0
    (+ (expt 10 (- digits 1))
       (putnam-1998-b5-repunit-sum (- digits 1)))))

;; For natural X, descending from X returns the unique natural M satisfying
;; M^2 <= X < (M+1)^2, hence exactly floor(sqrt(X)).
(defun putnam-1998-b5-isqrt-search (x candidate)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix candidate)))
  (if (or (not (natp x))
          (not (natp candidate)))
      0
    (if (<= (* candidate candidate) x)
        candidate
      (putnam-1998-b5-isqrt-search
       x (- candidate 1)))))

(defun putnam-1998-b5-isqrt (x)
  (if (natp x)
      (putnam-1998-b5-isqrt-search x x)
    0))

;; Since 10^1000 is positive,
;;
;;   floor(10^1000 * sqrt(N))
;;     = floor(sqrt(N * 10^2000)).
;;
;; Thus this exact integer computation is bidirectionally equivalent to the
;; source real square-root floor; it does not approximate or restrict it.
(defun putnam-1998-b5-scaled-root-floor (n)
  (if (natp n)
      (putnam-1998-b5-isqrt
       (* n (expt 10 2000)))
    0))

(defun putnambench-putnam-1998-b5-statement (n)
  (implies
   (and (natp n)
        (equal n (putnam-1998-b5-repunit-sum 1998)))
   (equal
    (mod (putnam-1998-b5-scaled-root-floor n) 10)
    1)))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

fromInt reals (pos n) =

  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) :

    floor-upper :

naturalPower : Nat -> Nat -> Nat

;; Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1998_b6:
;; every integer-coefficient monic cubic has a positive integer input at which
;; its real square root is not an integer. This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(defun putnam-1998-b6-polynomial-value (a b c n)
  (+ (* n n n)
     (* a n n)
     (* b n)
     c))

(defun-sk putnam-1998-b6-integer-square-p (value)
  (exists (root)
    (and
     (integerp root)
     (equal value (* root root)))))

(defun putnam-1998-b6-sqrt-not-integer-p (a b c n)
  (let ((value
         (putnam-1998-b6-polynomial-value a b c n)))
    (and
     (integerp n)
     (< 0 n)
     (not (putnam-1998-b6-integer-square-p value)))))

(defun-sk putnam-1998-b6-witness-exists-p (a b c)
  (exists (n)
    (putnam-1998-b6-sqrt-not-integer-p a b c n)))

(defun putnambench-putnam-1998-b6-statement (a b c)
  (implies
   (and
    (integerp a)
    (integerp b)
    (integerp c))
   (putnam-1998-b6-witness-exists-p a b c)))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

title: putnam_1998_b6
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1998_b6
-- (putnambench__agda__putnam_1998_b6): every integer-coefficient monic cubic
-- takes a non-square value at some positive integer. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Int using (Int; pos; negsuc)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; _*_)

infix 4 _!=_
infixl 6 _+Z_
infixl 7 _*Z_
infixr 3 _and_

data Bottom : Set where

Not : Set -> Set
Not A =
  A -> Bottom

_!=_ : {A : Set} -> A -> A -> Set
x != y =
  Not (x == y)

record _and_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

negative : Nat -> Int
negative zero =
  pos zero
negative (suc n) =
  negsuc n

difference : Nat -> Nat -> Int
difference zero zero =
  pos zero
difference (suc m) zero =
  pos (suc m)
difference zero (suc n) =
  negsuc n
difference (suc m) (suc n) =
  difference m n

_+Z_ : Int -> Int -> Int
pos m +Z pos n =
  pos (m + n)
pos m +Z negsuc n =
  difference m (suc n)
negsuc m +Z pos n =
  difference n (suc m)
negsuc m +Z negsuc n =
  negsuc (suc (m + n))

_*Z_ : Int -> Int -> Int
pos m *Z pos n =
  pos (m * n)
pos m *Z negsuc n =
  negative (m * suc n)
negsuc m *Z pos n =
  negative (suc m * n)
negsuc m *Z negsuc n =
  pos (suc m * suc n)

data PositiveInteger : Int -> Set where
  positive : {n : Nat} -> PositiveInteger (pos (suc n))

cubicValue : Int -> Int -> Int -> Int -> Int
cubicValue a b c n =
  n *Z n *Z n +Z a *Z n *Z n +Z b *Z n +Z c

NotIntegerSquare : Int -> Set
NotIntegerSquare value =
  (m : Int) ->
  value != m *Z m

putnam-1998-b6 : Set
putnam-1998-b6 =
  (a b c : Int) ->
  Exists Int
    (\ n ->
      PositiveInteger n
      and
      NotIntegerSquare (cubicValue a b c n))

(*
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1998_b6:
  for every integer cubic with leading coefficient 1, some positive integer
  input gives a value that is not an integer square. This file contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open integerTheory;

val putnam_1998_b6 =
  ``!a b c : int.
      ?n : int.
        0 < n /\
        ~(?k : int.
            n * n * n + a * n * n + b * n + c = k * k)``;

title: putnam_1998_b6
content:
$(
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact
  putnam_1998_b6: every integer-coefficient monic cubic has a positive
  integer input whose value is not an integer square. This file contains no
  proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  ZZ and NN are SetMM's classes of integers and positive integers. The
  square condition is stated directly in integer arithmetic. This also handles
  negative cubic values correctly: no negative integer is an integer square.

  The final declaration is the single unproved $a corpus statement; this
  database contains no $p proof statement.
$)

${
  $d a b c k n $.

  putnambench-putnam-1998-b6 $a |-
    A. a e. ZZ A. b e. ZZ A. c e. ZZ
      E. n e. NN
        A. k e. ZZ
          (
            (
              ( n ^ 3 )
              +
              ( a x. ( n ^ 2 ) )
            )
            +
            (
              ( b x. n )
              +
              c
            )
          )
          =/=
          ( k x. k )
  $.
$}

environ

    NUMBERS, XREAL_0, XCMPLX_0, COMPLEX1, CARD_1, XXREAL_0, ARYTM_1,

title: putnam_1998_b6
content:
% Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1998_b6:
% for every integer cubic x^3 + a*x^2 + b*x + c, some positive integer
% argument gives a value that is not an integer square. This file contains no proof.

putnam_1998_b6: THEORY
BEGIN
  cubic_value(n, a, b, c: int): int =
    n ^ 3 + a * n ^ 2 + b * n + c

  perfect_square(value: int): bool =
    EXISTS (root: int):
      value = root * root

  putnam_1998_b6: bool =
    FORALL (a, b, c: int):
      EXISTS (n: int):
        n > 0
          AND NOT perfect_square(cubic_value(n, a, b, c))
END putnam_1998_b6

import Mathlib

-- Note: The actual problem asks to "find" such polynomials as well - but the solution does not give a set of all possible solutions. Hence, we would need to do the analysis ourselves, the following formalization should work.
abbrev putnam_1999_a1_solution : Prop := sorry
-- True
/--
Find polynomials $f(x)$,$g(x)$, and $h(x)$, if they exist, such that for all $x$, \[|f(x)|-|g(x)|+h(x) = \begin{cases} -1 & \mbox{if $x<-1$} \\3x+2 & \mbox{if $-1 \leq x \leq 0$} \\-2x+2 & \mbox{if $x>0$.}\end{cases}\]?
-/
theorem putnam_1999_a1
: putnam_1999_a1_solution ↔ ∃ f g h : Polynomial ℝ, ∀ x : ℝ, |f.eval x| - |g.eval x| + h.eval x = if x < -1 then -1 else (if (x ≤ 0) then 3 * x + 2 else -2 * x + 2) :=
sorry

title: putnam_1999_a1
content:
(* Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1999_a1:
   existence of three real polynomials whose absolute-value combination equals
   a specified piecewise linear function; this file contains no proof. *)

From Stdlib Require Import Reals List.

Open Scope R_scope.

Definition putnam_1999_a1_polynomial : Type := list R.

Fixpoint putnam_1999_a1_eval
    (p : putnam_1999_a1_polynomial) (x : R) : R :=
  match p with
  | nil => 0
  | coefficient :: remaining =>
      coefficient + x * putnam_1999_a1_eval remaining x
  end.

Definition putnam_1999_a1_solution : Prop := True.

Theorem putnam_1999_a1 :
  putnam_1999_a1_solution <->
  exists f g h : putnam_1999_a1_polynomial,
    forall x : R,
      Rabs (putnam_1999_a1_eval f x) -
      Rabs (putnam_1999_a1_eval g x) +
      putnam_1999_a1_eval h x =
      if Rlt_dec x (-1) then
        -1
      else if Rle_dec x 0 then
        3 * x + 2
      else
        -2 * x + 2.
Admitted.

theory putnam_1999_a1 imports
Complex_Main
"HOL-Computational_Algebra.Polynomial"
begin

(* Note: The actual problem asks to "find" such polynomials as well - but the solution does not give a set of all possible solutions *)
(* So we would need to do the analysis ourselves, the following formalization should work. *)
definition putnam_1999_a1_solution :: bool where "putnam_1999_a1_solution \<equiv> undefined"
(* True *)
theorem putnam_1999_a1:
  shows "putnam_1999_a1_solution \<longleftrightarrow> (\<exists> f g h :: real poly. \<forall> x :: real. \<bar>poly f x\<bar> - \<bar>poly g x\<bar> + poly h x = (if x < -1 then -1 else (if x \<le> 0 then 3 * x + 2 else -2 * x + 2)))"

(*
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1999_a1:
  existence of three real polynomials whose signed combination of absolute
  values agrees everywhere with a specified piecewise-linear function. This
  file contains no proof.
*)

let statement =
  `let eval =
     \p:real list. \x:real.
       ITLIST (\c acc. c + x * acc) p (&0) in
   let putnam_1999_a1_solution = T in
   putnam_1999_a1_solution <=>
   (?f g h:real list.
      !x:real.
        abs (eval f x) - abs (eval g x) + eval h x =
        if x < --(&1) then --(&1)
        else if x <= &0 then &3 * x + &2
        else --(&2) * x + &2)`;;

title: putnam_1999_a1
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1999_a1:
;; existence of three real polynomials whose signed absolute values equal the
;; specified continuous three-piece linear function. This file contains no
;; proof and does not prescribe a particular polynomial witness.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))

;; The scalar symbols present an arbitrary real-closed ordered field. Real
;; closedness is stated by the standard two conditions: every positive scalar
;; has a square root, and every odd-degree polynomial has a root. This is
;; first-order equivalent to the real field for the polynomial formula below.

(defstub p1999a1-scalar-p (x) t)
(defstub p1999a1-add-op (x y) t)
(defstub p1999a1-multiply-op (x y) t)
(defstub p1999a1-negate-op (x) t)
(defstub p1999a1-inverse-op (x) t)
(defstub p1999a1-less-op (x y) t)
(defstub p1999a1-zero () t)
(defstub p1999a1-one () t)

(defun p1999a1-add (x y)
  (p1999a1-add-op x y))

(defun p1999a1-multiply (x y)
  (p1999a1-multiply-op x y))

(defun p1999a1-negate (x)
  (p1999a1-negate-op x))

(defun p1999a1-inverse (x)
  (p1999a1-inverse-op x))

(defun p1999a1-subtract (x y)
  (p1999a1-add x (p1999a1-negate y)))

(defun p1999a1-less (x y)
  (if (p1999a1-less-op x y) t nil))

(defun p1999a1-positive-p (x)
  (and
   (p1999a1-scalar-p x)
   (p1999a1-less (p1999a1-zero) x)))

(defun-sk p1999a1-field-laws-p ()
  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (p1999a1-scalar-p x)
      (p1999a1-scalar-p y)
      (p1999a1-scalar-p z))
     (and
      (p1999a1-scalar-p (p1999a1-add x y))
      (p1999a1-scalar-p (p1999a1-multiply x y))
      (p1999a1-scalar-p (p1999a1-negate x))
      (implies
       (not (equal x (p1999a1-zero)))
       (p1999a1-scalar-p (p1999a1-inverse x)))
      (equal
       (p1999a1-add (p1999a1-add x y) z)
       (p1999a1-add x (p1999a1-add y z)))
      (equal
       (p1999a1-add x y)
       (p1999a1-add y x))
      (equal
       (p1999a1-add x (p1999a1-zero))
       x)
      (equal
       (p1999a1-add x (p1999a1-negate x))
       (p1999a1-zero))
      (equal
       (p1999a1-multiply
        (p1999a1-multiply x y) z)
       (p1999a1-multiply
        x (p1999a1-multiply y z)))
      (equal
       (p1999a1-multiply x y)
       (p1999a1-multiply y x))
      (equal
       (p1999a1-multiply x (p1999a1-one))
       x)
      (implies
       (not (equal x (p1999a1-zero)))
       (equal
        (p1999a1-multiply x (p1999a1-inverse x))
        (p1999a1-one)))
      (equal
       (p1999a1-multiply x (p1999a1-add y z))
       (p1999a1-add
        (p1999a1-multiply x y)
        (p1999a1-multiply x z)))))))

(defun-sk p1999a1-order-laws-p ()
  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (p1999a1-scalar-p x)
      (p1999a1-scalar-p y)
      (p1999a1-scalar-p z))
     (and
      (not (p1999a1-less x x))
      (or
       (equal x y)
       (p1999a1-less x y)
       (p1999a1-less y x))
      (implies
       (and
        (p1999a1-less x y)
        (p1999a1-less y z))
       (p1999a1-less x z))
      (implies
       (p1999a1-less x y)
       (p1999a1-less
        (p1999a1-add x z)
        (p1999a1-add y z)))
      (implies
       (and
        (p1999a1-less (p1999a1-zero) x)
        (p1999a1-less (p1999a1-zero) y))
       (p1999a1-less
        (p1999a1-zero)
        (p1999a1-multiply x y)))))))

(defun p1999a1-carrier-list-p (coefficients)
  (if (consp coefficients)
      (and
       (p1999a1-scalar-p (car coefficients))
       (p1999a1-carrier-list-p (cdr coefficients)))
    (equal coefficients nil)))

;; Coefficients are stored in increasing degree order.
(defun p1999a1-polynomial-value (coefficients x)
  (if (consp coefficients)
      (p1999a1-add
       (car coefficients)
       (p1999a1-multiply
        x
        (p1999a1-polynomial-value
         (cdr coefficients) x)))
    (p1999a1-zero)))

(defun p1999a1-polynomial-p (coefficients)
  (and
   (true-listp coefficients)
   (p1999a1-carrier-list-p coefficients)))

(defun p1999a1-odd-degree-polynomial-p (coefficients)
  (and
   (p1999a1-polynomial-p coefficients)
   (consp coefficients)
   ;; Degree LEN-1 is odd exactly when LEN is even.
   (evenp (len coefficients))
   (not
    (equal
     (car (last coefficients))
     (p1999a1-zero)))))

(defun-sk p1999a1-square-root-exists-p (x)
  (exists (root)
    (and
     (p1999a1-scalar-p root)
     (equal
      (p1999a1-multiply root root)
      x))))

(defun-sk p1999a1-positive-square-roots-p ()
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (p1999a1-positive-p x)
     (p1999a1-square-root-exists-p x))))

(defun-sk p1999a1-polynomial-root-exists-p
    (coefficients)
  (exists (root)
    (and
     (p1999a1-scalar-p root)
     (equal
      (p1999a1-polynomial-value
       coefficients root)
      (p1999a1-zero)))))

(defun-sk p1999a1-odd-polynomial-roots-p ()
  (forall (coefficients)
    (implies
     (p1999a1-odd-degree-polynomial-p coefficients)
     (p1999a1-polynomial-root-exists-p
      coefficients))))

(defun p1999a1-real-closed-field-p ()
  (and
   (p1999a1-scalar-p (p1999a1-zero))
   (p1999a1-scalar-p (p1999a1-one))
   (not
    (equal (p1999a1-zero) (p1999a1-one)))
   (p1999a1-less (p1999a1-zero) (p1999a1-one))
   (p1999a1-field-laws-p)
   (p1999a1-order-laws-p)
   (p1999a1-positive-square-roots-p)
   (p1999a1-odd-polynomial-roots-p)))

(defun p1999a1-two ()
  (p1999a1-add
   (p1999a1-one)
   (p1999a1-one)))

(defun p1999a1-three ()
  (p1999a1-add
   (p1999a1-two)
   (p1999a1-one)))

(defun p1999a1-minus-one ()
  (p1999a1-negate (p1999a1-one)))

(defun p1999a1-absolute-value (x)
  (if (p1999a1-less x (p1999a1-zero))
      (p1999a1-negate x)
    x))

(defun p1999a1-source-value (x)
  (if (p1999a1-less x (p1999a1-minus-one))
      (p1999a1-minus-one)
    (if (not (p1999a1-less (p1999a1-zero) x))
        (p1999a1-add
         (p1999a1-multiply (p1999a1-three) x)
         (p1999a1-two))
      (p1999a1-add
       (p1999a1-negate
        (p1999a1-multiply (p1999a1-two) x))
       (p1999a1-two)))))

(defun p1999a1-candidate-value (f g h x)
  (p1999a1-add
   (p1999a1-subtract
    (p1999a1-absolute-value
     (p1999a1-polynomial-value f x))
    (p1999a1-absolute-value
     (p1999a1-polynomial-value g x)))
   (p1999a1-polynomial-value h x)))

(defun-sk p1999a1-polynomial-identity-p (f g h)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (p1999a1-scalar-p x)
     (equal
      (p1999a1-candidate-value f g h x)
      (p1999a1-source-value x)))))

(defun p1999a1-polynomial-witness-p (f g h)
  (and
   (p1999a1-polynomial-p f)
   (p1999a1-polynomial-p g)
   (p1999a1-polynomial-p h)
   (p1999a1-polynomial-identity-p f g h)))

(defun-sk p1999a1-polynomials-exist-p ()
  (exists (f g h)
    (p1999a1-polynomial-witness-p f g h)))

(defun putnambench-putnam-1999-a1-statement ()
  (implies
   (p1999a1-real-closed-field-p)
   (p1999a1-polynomials-exist-p)))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

title: putnam_1999_a1
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1999_a1:
-- three real polynomials exist whose absolute-value combination equals the
-- specified piecewise-linear function on every real input. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.List using (List; []; _∷_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; _*_)

infix 4 _!=_
infixr 3 _and_
infixr 2 _or_

data Bottom : Set where

Not : Set -> Set
Not A =
  A -> Bottom

_!=_ : {A : Set} -> A -> A -> Set
x != y =
  Not (x == y)

record _and_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data _or_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  left  : A -> A or B
  right : B -> A or B

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

record CompleteOrderedRealField (R : Set) : Set1 where
  field
    zeroR oneR : R
    add multiply : R -> R -> R
    negate inverse : R -> R
    lessOrEqual : R -> R -> Set
    fromNat : Nat -> R

    one-not-zero :
      oneR != zeroR

    add-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> add x y == add y x
    add-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      add (add x y) z == add x (add y z)
    add-zero :
      (x : R) -> add x zeroR == x
    add-inverse :
      (x : R) -> add x (negate x) == zeroR

    multiply-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> multiply x y == multiply y x
    multiply-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply (multiply x y) z ==
      multiply x (multiply y z)
    multiply-one :
      (x : R) -> multiply x oneR == x
    multiply-zero :
      (x : R) -> multiply x zeroR == zeroR
    distribute :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply x (add y z) ==
      add (multiply x y) (multiply x z)
    inverse-zero :
      inverse zeroR == zeroR
    multiply-inverse :
      (x : R) ->
      x != zeroR ->
      multiply x (inverse x) == oneR

    order-reflexive :
      (x : R) -> lessOrEqual x x
    order-transitive :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y z ->
      lessOrEqual x z
    order-antisymmetric :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y x ->
      x == y
    order-total :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y or lessOrEqual y x
    add-order :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual (add z x) (add z y)
    multiply-nonnegative :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR x ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR y ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR (multiply x y)
    zero-less-than-one :
      lessOrEqual zeroR oneR and zeroR != oneR

    fromNat-zero :
      fromNat zero == zeroR
    fromNat-successor :
      (n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (suc n) == add (fromNat n) oneR
    fromNat-addition :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m + n) == add (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-multiplication :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m * n) == multiply (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-injective :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat m == fromNat n ->
      m == n

    archimedean :
      (x : R) ->
      Exists Nat
        (\ n ->
          lessOrEqual x (fromNat n))
    least-upper-bound :
      (P : R -> Set) ->
      Exists R P ->
      Exists R
        (\ upper ->
          (x : R) ->
          P x ->
          lessOrEqual x upper) ->
      Exists R
        (\ supremum ->
          ((x : R) ->
            P x ->
            lessOrEqual x supremum)
          and
          ((upper : R) ->
            ((x : R) ->
              P x ->
              lessOrEqual x upper) ->
            lessOrEqual supremum upper))

open CompleteOrderedRealField

subtract :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
subtract reals x y =
  add reals x (negate reals y)

maximum :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
maximum reals x y with order-total reals x y
... | left _ =
  y
... | right _ =
  x

absoluteValue :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R
absoluteValue reals x =
  maximum reals x (negate reals x)

StrictLess :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
StrictLess reals x y =
  lessOrEqual reals x y and x != y

Polynomial : Set -> Set
Polynomial R =
  List R

evaluatePolynomial :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Polynomial R ->
  R ->
  R
evaluatePolynomial reals [] x =
  zeroR reals
evaluatePolynomial reals (coefficient ∷ coefficients) x =
  add reals
    coefficient
    (multiply reals x
      (evaluatePolynomial reals coefficients x))

module Putnam1999A1Statement
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) where

  negativeOne : R
  negativeOne =
    negate reals (oneR reals)

  two : R
  two =
    fromNat reals 2

  three : R
  three =
    fromNat reals 3

  leftHandSide :
    Polynomial R ->
    Polynomial R ->
    Polynomial R ->
    R ->
    R
  leftHandSide f g h x =
    add reals
      (subtract reals
        (absoluteValue reals (evaluatePolynomial reals f x))
        (absoluteValue reals (evaluatePolynomial reals g x)))
      (evaluatePolynomial reals h x)

  middleValue : R -> R
  middleValue x =
    add reals
      (multiply reals three x)
      two

  rightValue : R -> R
  rightValue x =
    add reals
      (multiply reals (negate reals two) x)
      two

  MatchesPiecewiseFunction :
    Polynomial R ->
    Polynomial R ->
    Polynomial R ->
    Set
  MatchesPiecewiseFunction f g h =
    (x : R) ->
    (StrictLess reals x negativeOne ->
      leftHandSide f g h x == negativeOne)
    and
    (((lessOrEqual reals negativeOne x
      and lessOrEqual reals x (zeroR reals)) ->
      leftHandSide f g h x == middleValue x)
    and
    (StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) x ->
      leftHandSide f g h x == rightValue x))

  proposition : Set
  proposition =
    Exists (Polynomial R)
      (\ f ->
        Exists (Polynomial R)
          (\ g ->
            Exists (Polynomial R)
              (\ h ->
                MatchesPiecewiseFunction f g h)))

putnam-1999-a1 : Set1
putnam-1999-a1 =
  (R : Set) ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) ->
  Putnam1999A1Statement.proposition reals

(*
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1999_a1:
  existence of three real polynomials whose combination of absolute values
  equals the specified piecewise-linear function on every real input. This
  file contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open realTheory polyTheory;

val putnam_1999_a1 =
  ``let putnam_1999_a1_solution = T
    in
      ((?f g h : real list.
          !x : real.
            abs (poly f x) - abs (poly g x) + poly h x =
              if x < ~1 then ~1
              else if x <= 0 then 3 * x + 2
              else ~2 * x + 2)
       <=>
       putnam_1999_a1_solution)``;

$(
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact
  putnam_1999_a1: existence of three real polynomials whose absolute-value
  combination equals the specified three-piece linear function on the real
  line. This file contains no proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  Base ` ( Poly1 ` RRfld ) is set.mm's ring of finite-support univariate
  real polynomials, and eval1 evaluates such a polynomial at a real input.
  The source solution annotation is True, so its biconditional with the
  existential proposition is represented by that proposition itself.

  The outer conditional separates x < -1 from x >= -1, and the inner
  conditional separates x <= 0 from x > 0. Thus the three branches and both
  endpoint conventions agree exactly with the Lean and Isabelle sources.
  The final declaration is the single unproved $a corpus statement; this
  database contains no $p proof statement.
$)

${
  $d f g h x $.

  putnambench-putnam-1999-a1 $a |-
    E. f e. ( Base ` ( Poly1 ` RRfld ) )
      E. g e. ( Base ` ( Poly1 ` RRfld ) )
        E. h e. ( Base ` ( Poly1 ` RRfld ) )
          A. x e. RR
            (
              (
                (
                  abs
                  `
                  ( ( ( eval1 ` RRfld ) ` f ) ` x )
                )
                -
                (
                  abs
                  `
                  ( ( ( eval1 ` RRfld ) ` g ) ` x )
                )
              )
              +
              ( ( ( eval1 ` RRfld ) ` h ) ` x )
            )
            =
            if
            (
              x < ( -u 1 ) ,
              ( -u 1 ) ,
              if
              (
                x <_ 0 ,
                ( ( 3 x. x ) + 2 ) ,
                ( ( ( -u 2 ) x. x ) + 2 )
              )
            )
  $.
$}

title: putnam_1999_a1
content:
% Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1999_a1:
% existence of three real polynomials whose absolute-value combination equals
% the specified piecewise linear function. This file contains no proof.

putnam_1999_a1: THEORY
BEGIN
  real_polynomial: TYPE = list[real]

  polynomial_value(
      polynomial: real_polynomial,
      x: real): RECURSIVE real =
    CASES polynomial OF
      null: 0,
      cons(coefficient, tail):
        coefficient + x * polynomial_value(tail, x)
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE polynomial BY <<

  putnam_1999_a1: bool =
    EXISTS (f, g, h: real_polynomial):
      FORALL (x: real):
        abs(polynomial_value(f, x))
          - abs(polynomial_value(g, x))
          + polynomial_value(h, x)
        = IF x < -1 THEN
            -1
          ELSIF x <= 0 THEN
            3 * x + 2
          ELSE
            -2 * x + 2
          ENDIF
END putnam_1999_a1

Let $p(x)$ be a polynomial that is nonnegative for all real $x$.  Prove that for some $k$, there are polynomials $f_1(x),\dots,f_k(x$) such that \[p(x) =  \sum_{j=1}^k (f_j(x))^2.\]

theorem putnam_1999_a2
(p : Polynomial ℝ)
(hp : ∀ x, p.eval x ≥ 0)
: ∃ᵉ (k) (f : Fin k → Polynomial ℝ),
    k > 0 ∧
    ∀ x : ℝ, p.eval x = ∑ j : Fin k, ((f j).eval x) ^ 2 :=

title: putnam_1999_a2

;; Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1999_a2:
;; every real polynomial that is nonnegative on the real line is a finite sum
;; of squares of real polynomials. This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

;; The real coefficient domain is presented as a real closed ordered field.
;; The square-root and odd-degree-root laws are the standard algebraic
;; characterization of real closedness.  Polynomials are canonical nonempty
;; coefficient lists in ascending degree order.
;;
;; This is bidirectionally equivalent to the source statement: the reals form
;; such a field, while completeness of real closed fields transfers this
;; first-order polynomial assertion between any real closed field and the
;; reals. Canonical coefficient-list equality is polynomial equality because
;; every ordered field is infinite.
;;
;; ACL2 function objects supply the field operations and the canonical
;; polynomial operations.  FN-EQUAL against a constant-T function expresses
;; universal quantification over the whole represented field.  The concluding
;; NOT/FN-EQUAL is an internal existential quantifier over a nonempty finite
;; list of polynomial coefficient lists; no decomposition is a parameter of
;; the statement predicate. Such lists are equivalent to finite indexed
;; families; an empty sum for the zero polynomial is replaced by the one-term
;; family containing the zero polynomial.

(defun putnam-1999-a2-quoted (object)
  (list 'quote object))

(defun putnam-1999-a2-apply1-term (function argument)
  (list
   'apply$
   (putnam-1999-a2-quoted function)
   (list 'cons argument nil)))

(defun putnam-1999-a2-apply2-term (function left right)
  (list
   'apply$
   (putnam-1999-a2-quoted function)
   (list 'cons left (list 'cons right nil))))

(defun putnam-1999-a2-and-term (terms)
  (if (endp terms)
      (putnam-1999-a2-quoted t)
    (list
     'if
     (car terms)
     (putnam-1999-a2-and-term (cdr terms))
     (putnam-1999-a2-quoted nil))))

(defun putnam-1999-a2-or-term (terms)
  (if (endp terms)
      (putnam-1999-a2-quoted nil)
    (list
     'if
     (car terms)
     (putnam-1999-a2-quoted t)
     (putnam-1999-a2-or-term (cdr terms)))))

(defun putnam-1999-a2-not-term (term)
  (list
   'if
   term
   (putnam-1999-a2-quoted nil)
   (putnam-1999-a2-quoted t)))

(defun putnam-1999-a2-implies-term (antecedent consequent)
  (list
   'if
   antecedent
   consequent
   (putnam-1999-a2-quoted t)))

(defun putnam-1999-a2-true-function (formals)
  (list
   'lambda
   formals
   (putnam-1999-a2-quoted t)))

(defun putnam-1999-a2-carrier-term (carrier element)
  (putnam-1999-a2-apply1-term carrier element))

(defun putnam-1999-a2-operation-term (operation left right)
  (putnam-1999-a2-apply2-term operation left right))

(defun putnam-1999-a2-all-coefficients-function ()
  '(lambda (loop$-gvars loop$-ivars)
     (apply$ (car loop$-gvars)
             (cons loop$-ivars 'nil))))

(defun putnam-1999-a2-all-coefficients-term
    (carrier coefficients)
  (list
   'always$+
   (putnam-1999-a2-quoted
    (putnam-1999-a2-all-coefficients-function))
   (list 'cons
         (putnam-1999-a2-quoted carrier)
         nil)
   coefficients))

(defun putnam-1999-a2-polynomial-term
    (carrier zero coefficients)
  (putnam-1999-a2-and-term
   (list
    (list 'true-listp coefficients)
    (list 'consp coefficients)
    (putnam-1999-a2-all-coefficients-term
     carrier coefficients)
    (putnam-1999-a2-or-term
     (list
      (list 'equal
            (list 'len coefficients)
            (putnam-1999-a2-quoted 1))
      (putnam-1999-a2-not-term
       (list 'equal
             (list 'car (list 'last coefficients))
             (putnam-1999-a2-quoted zero))))))))

(defun putnam-1999-a2-all-polynomials-function
    (carrier zero)
  (list
   'lambda
   '(loop$-gvars loop$-ivars)
   (putnam-1999-a2-polynomial-term
    carrier zero 'loop$-ivars)))

(defun putnam-1999-a2-all-polynomials-term
    (carrier zero polynomials)
  (list
   'always$+
   (putnam-1999-a2-quoted
    (putnam-1999-a2-all-polynomials-function
     carrier zero))
   (putnam-1999-a2-quoted nil)
   polynomials))

(defun putnam-1999-a2-field-laws-function
    (carrier zero one add mul neg inv)
  (let* ((x 'x)
         (y 'y)
         (z 'z)
         (qzero (putnam-1999-a2-quoted zero))
         (qone (putnam-1999-a2-quoted one))
         (add-xy
          (putnam-1999-a2-operation-term add x y))
         (add-yz
          (putnam-1999-a2-operation-term add y z))
         (mul-xy
          (putnam-1999-a2-operation-term mul x y))
         (mul-yz
          (putnam-1999-a2-operation-term mul y z))
         (neg-x
          (putnam-1999-a2-apply1-term neg x))
         (inv-x
          (putnam-1999-a2-apply1-term inv x))
         (domain
          (putnam-1999-a2-and-term
           (list
            (putnam-1999-a2-carrier-term carrier x)
            (putnam-1999-a2-carrier-term carrier y)
            (putnam-1999-a2-carrier-term carrier z))))
         (laws
          (putnam-1999-a2-and-term
           (list
            (putnam-1999-a2-carrier-term carrier add-xy)
            (putnam-1999-a2-carrier-term carrier mul-xy)
            (putnam-1999-a2-carrier-term carrier neg-x)
            (putnam-1999-a2-carrier-term carrier inv-x)
            (list
             'equal
             (putnam-1999-a2-operation-term add add-xy z)
             (putnam-1999-a2-operation-term add x add-yz))
            (list
             'equal
             (putnam-1999-a2-operation-term mul mul-xy z)
             (putnam-1999-a2-operation-term mul x mul-yz))
            (list
             'equal
             add-xy
             (putnam-1999-a2-operation-term add y x))
            (list
             'equal
             mul-xy
             (putnam-1999-a2-operation-term mul y x))
            (list
             'equal
             (putnam-1999-a2-operation-term add x qzero)
             x)
            (list
             'equal
             (putnam-1999-a2-operation-term add x neg-x)
             qzero)
            (list
             'equal
             (putnam-1999-a2-operation-term mul x qone)
             x)
            (putnam-1999-a2-implies-term
             (list 'equal x qzero)
             (list 'equal inv-x qzero))
            (putnam-1999-a2-implies-term
             (putnam-1999-a2-not-term
              (list 'equal x qzero))
             (list
              'equal
              (putnam-1999-a2-operation-term mul x inv-x)
              qone))
            (list
             'equal
             (putnam-1999-a2-operation-term mul x add-yz)
             (putnam-1999-a2-operation-term
              add
              (putnam-1999-a2-operation-term mul x y)
              (putnam-1999-a2-operation-term mul x z)))))))
    (list
     'lambda
     '(x y z)
     (putnam-1999-a2-implies-term domain laws))))

(defun putnam-1999-a2-order-laws-function
    (carrier zero add mul lt)
  (let* ((x 'x)
         (y 'y)
         (z 'z)
         (qzero (putnam-1999-a2-quoted zero))
         (lt-xy
          (putnam-1999-a2-operation-term lt x y))
         (lt-yx
          (putnam-1999-a2-operation-term lt y x))
         (lt-yz
          (putnam-1999-a2-operation-term lt y z))
         (lt-xz
          (putnam-1999-a2-operation-term lt x z))
         (domain
          (putnam-1999-a2-and-term
           (list
            (putnam-1999-a2-carrier-term carrier x)
            (putnam-1999-a2-carrier-term carrier y)
            (putnam-1999-a2-carrier-term carrier z))))
         (laws
          (putnam-1999-a2-and-term
           (list
            (putnam-1999-a2-not-term
             (putnam-1999-a2-operation-term lt x x))
            (putnam-1999-a2-or-term
             (list
              lt-xy
              (list 'equal x y)
              lt-yx))
            (putnam-1999-a2-implies-term
             (putnam-1999-a2-and-term
              (list lt-xy lt-yz))
             lt-xz)
            (putnam-1999-a2-implies-term
             lt-xy
             (putnam-1999-a2-operation-term
              lt
              (putnam-1999-a2-operation-term add x z)
              (putnam-1999-a2-operation-term add y z)))
            (putnam-1999-a2-implies-term
             (putnam-1999-a2-and-term
              (list
               (putnam-1999-a2-operation-term lt qzero x)
               (putnam-1999-a2-operation-term lt qzero y)))
             (putnam-1999-a2-operation-term
              lt
              qzero
              (putnam-1999-a2-operation-term mul x y)))))))
    (list
     'lambda
     '(x y z)
     (putnam-1999-a2-implies-term domain laws))))

(defun putnam-1999-a2-square-root-laws-function
    (carrier zero mul lt square-root)
  (let* ((x 'x)
         (qzero (putnam-1999-a2-quoted zero))
         (root
          (putnam-1999-a2-apply1-term square-root x))
         (domain
          (putnam-1999-a2-and-term
           (list
            (putnam-1999-a2-carrier-term carrier x)
            (putnam-1999-a2-not-term
             (putnam-1999-a2-operation-term lt x qzero)))))
         (laws
          (putnam-1999-a2-and-term
           (list
            (putnam-1999-a2-carrier-term carrier root)
            (list
             'equal
             (putnam-1999-a2-operation-term mul root root)
             x)))))
    (list
     'lambda
     '(x)
     (putnam-1999-a2-implies-term domain laws))))

(defun putnam-1999-a2-evaluation-laws-function
    (carrier zero add mul evaluate)
  (let* ((coefficient 'coefficient)
         (rest 'rest)
         (x 'x)
         (qzero (putnam-1999-a2-quoted zero))
         (domain
          (putnam-1999-a2-and-term
           (list
            (putnam-1999-a2-carrier-term
             carrier coefficient)
            (list 'true-listp rest)
            (putnam-1999-a2-all-coefficients-term
             carrier rest)
            (putnam-1999-a2-carrier-term carrier x))))
         (empty-law
          (putnam-1999-a2-implies-term
           (putnam-1999-a2-carrier-term carrier x)
           (list
            'equal
            (putnam-1999-a2-operation-term
             evaluate
             (putnam-1999-a2-quoted nil)
             x)
            qzero)))
         (recursive-value
          (putnam-1999-a2-operation-term
           add
           coefficient
           (putnam-1999-a2-operation-term
            mul
            x
            (putnam-1999-a2-operation-term
             evaluate rest x))))
         (recursive-law
          (putnam-1999-a2-implies-term
           domain
           (putnam-1999-a2-and-term
            (list
             (putnam-1999-a2-carrier-term
              carrier
              (putnam-1999-a2-operation-term
               evaluate
               (list 'cons coefficient rest)
               x))
             (list
              'equal
              (putnam-1999-a2-operation-term
               evaluate
               (list 'cons coefficient rest)
               x)
              recursive-value))))))
    (list
     'lambda
     '(coefficient rest x)
     (putnam-1999-a2-and-term
      (list empty-law recursive-law)))))

(defun putnam-1999-a2-odd-root-laws-function
    (carrier zero evaluate odd-root)
  (let* ((coefficients 'coefficients)
         (root
          (putnam-1999-a2-apply1-term
           odd-root coefficients))
         (domain
          (putnam-1999-a2-and-term
           (list
            (putnam-1999-a2-polynomial-term
             carrier zero coefficients)
            (list 'evenp (list 'len coefficients)))))
         (laws
          (putnam-1999-a2-and-term
           (list
            (putnam-1999-a2-carrier-term carrier root)
            (list
             'equal
             (putnam-1999-a2-operation-term
              evaluate coefficients root)
             (putnam-1999-a2-quoted zero))))))
    (list
     'lambda

-- Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1999_a2
-- (putnambench__agda__putnam_1999_a2): every real polynomial that is
-- nonnegative on the real line is a finite nonempty sum of squares of real
-- polynomials. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.List using (List; []; _∷_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; _*_)

infix 4 _!=_
infixr 3 _and_
infixr 2 _or_

data Bottom : Set where

Not : Set -> Set
Not A =
  A -> Bottom

_!=_ : {A : Set} -> A -> A -> Set
x != y =
  Not (x == y)

record _and_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data _or_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  left  : A -> A or B
  right : B -> A or B

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

data Positive : Nat -> Set where
  positive : {n : Nat} -> Positive (suc n)

data Fin : Nat -> Set where
  fzero : {n : Nat} -> Fin (suc n)
  fsuc  : {n : Nat} -> Fin n -> Fin (suc n)

record CompleteOrderedRealField (R : Set) : Set1 where
  field
    zeroR oneR : R
    add multiply : R -> R -> R
    negate inverse : R -> R
    lessOrEqual : R -> R -> Set
    fromNat : Nat -> R

    one-not-zero :
      oneR != zeroR

    add-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> add x y == add y x
    add-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      add (add x y) z == add x (add y z)
    add-zero :
      (x : R) -> add x zeroR == x
    add-inverse :
      (x : R) -> add x (negate x) == zeroR

    multiply-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> multiply x y == multiply y x
    multiply-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply (multiply x y) z ==
      multiply x (multiply y z)
    multiply-one :
      (x : R) -> multiply x oneR == x
    multiply-zero :
      (x : R) -> multiply x zeroR == zeroR
    distribute :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply x (add y z) ==
      add (multiply x y) (multiply x z)
    inverse-zero :
      inverse zeroR == zeroR
    multiply-inverse :
      (x : R) ->
      x != zeroR ->
      multiply x (inverse x) == oneR

    order-reflexive :
      (x : R) -> lessOrEqual x x
    order-transitive :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y z ->
      lessOrEqual x z
    order-antisymmetric :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y x ->
      x == y
    order-total :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y or lessOrEqual y x
    add-order :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual (add z x) (add z y)
    multiply-nonnegative :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR x ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR y ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR (multiply x y)
    zero-less-than-one :
      lessOrEqual zeroR oneR and zeroR != oneR

    fromNat-zero :
      fromNat zero == zeroR
    fromNat-successor :
      (n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (suc n) == add (fromNat n) oneR
    fromNat-addition :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m + n) == add (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-multiplication :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m * n) == multiply (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-injective :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat m == fromNat n ->
      m == n

    archimedean :
      (x : R) ->
      Exists Nat
        (\ n ->
          lessOrEqual x (fromNat n))
    least-upper-bound :
      (P : R -> Set) ->
      Exists R P ->
      Exists R
        (\ upper ->
          (x : R) ->
          P x ->
          lessOrEqual x upper) ->
      Exists R
        (\ supremum ->
          ((x : R) ->
            P x ->
            lessOrEqual x supremum)
          and
          ((upper : R) ->
            ((x : R) ->
              P x ->
              lessOrEqual x upper) ->
            lessOrEqual supremum upper))

open CompleteOrderedRealField

Polynomial : Set -> Set
Polynomial R =
  List R

evaluatePolynomial :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Polynomial R ->
  R ->
  R
evaluatePolynomial reals [] x =
  zeroR reals
evaluatePolynomial reals (a ∷ p) x =
  add reals a
    (multiply reals x (evaluatePolynomial reals p x))

sumFin :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  {n : Nat} ->
  (Fin n -> R) ->
  R
sumFin reals {zero} terms =
  zeroR reals
sumFin reals {suc n} terms =
  add reals
    (terms fzero)
    (sumFin reals (\ i -> terms (fsuc i)))

putnam-1999-a2 : Set1
putnam-1999-a2 =
  (R : Set) ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) ->
  (p : Polynomial R) ->
  ((x : R) ->
    lessOrEqual reals
      (zeroR reals)
      (evaluatePolynomial reals p x)) ->
  Exists Nat
    (\ k ->
      Positive k
      and
      Exists (Fin k -> Polynomial R)
        (\ f ->
          (x : R) ->
          evaluatePolynomial reals p x
          ==
          sumFin reals
            (\ i ->
              multiply reals
                (evaluatePolynomial reals (f i) x)
                (evaluatePolynomial reals (f i) x))))

  putnam_1999_a2: every real polynomial that is nonnegative on the real

  coefficients are real. Restriction to real inputs gives exactly the source
  real polynomials, with equality preserved because a real polynomial is
  determined by its values on the infinite set RR.

  The positive integer k and the map f internally encode a nonempty finite
  family indexed by 1 through k. This is equivalent to the finite-set form:
  a set can be enumerated, while repeated members of a finite family can be
  combined using real square roots of their positive multiplicities.

  The final declaration is the single unproved $a corpus statement; this
  database contains no $p proof statement.
$)

${
  $d f j k p x $.

  putnambench-putnam-1999-a2 $a |-
    A. p e. ( Poly ` RR )
      (
        A. x e. RR 0 <_ ( p ` x )
        ->
        E. k e. NN
          E. f e. ( ( Poly ` RR ) ^m ( 1 ... k ) )
            A. x e. RR
              ( p ` x )
              =
              sum_ j e. ( 1 ... k )
                ( ( ( f ` j ) ` x ) ^ 2 )
      )
  $.
$}

% Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1999_a2:
% every real polynomial that is nonnegative on the real line is a finite
% nonempty sum of squares of real polynomials. This file contains no proof.

putnam_1999_a2: THEORY
BEGIN
  real_polynomial: TYPE = list[real]
  polynomial_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> real_polynomial]

  polynomial_value(
      polynomial: real_polynomial,
      x: real): RECURSIVE real =
    CASES polynomial OF
      null: 0,
      cons(coefficient, tail):
        coefficient + x * polynomial_value(tail, x)
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE polynomial BY <<

  sum_of_polynomial_squares(
      polynomials: polynomial_sequence,
      x: real,
      count: nat): RECURSIVE real =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      sum_of_polynomial_squares(polynomials, x, count - 1)
        + polynomial_value(polynomials(count - 1), x) ^ 2
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  putnam_1999_a2: bool =
    FORALL (p: real_polynomial):
      (FORALL (x: real): polynomial_value(p, x) >= 0)
      IMPLIES
        EXISTS (k: posnat), (f: polynomial_sequence):
          FORALL (x: real):
            polynomial_value(p, x)
              = sum_of_polynomial_squares(f, x, k)
END putnam_1999_a2

import Mathlib

open Filter Topology Metric

/--
Consider the power series expansion \[\frac{1}{1-2x-x^2} = \sum_{n=0}^\infty a_n x^n.\] Prove that, for each integer $n\geq 0$, there is an integer $m$ such that \[a_n^2 + a_{n+1}^2 = a_m .\]
-/
theorem putnam_1999_a3
    (f : ℝ → ℝ)
    (hf : f = fun x ↦ 1 / (1 - 2 * x - x ^ 2))
    (a : ℕ → ℝ)
    (hf' : ∀ᶠ x in 𝓝 0, Tendsto (fun N : ℕ ↦ ∑ n ∈ Finset.range N, (a n) * x ^ n) atTop (𝓝 (f x)))
    (n : ℕ) :
    ∃ m : ℕ, (a n) ^ 2 + (a (n + 1)) ^ 2 = a m :=
  sorry

;; coefficients of 1/(1-2x-x^2) have two consecutive squares summing to
;; another coefficient. This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(defstub putnam-1999-a3-a (n) t)

;; Comparing coefficients in
;;

;; Conversely, this recurrence gives the source generating function in a
;; neighborhood of zero. The recurrence is therefore an exact algebraic
;; normalization of the analytic premise, but remains an explicit hypothesis
;; on the arbitrary sequence rather than a definition of one chosen sequence.

(defun putnam-1999-a3-initial-coefficients-p ()
  (and
   (equal (putnam-1999-a3-a 0) 1)
   (equal (putnam-1999-a3-a 1) 2)))

  (forall
   (k)

    (natp k)
    (equal
     (putnam-1999-a3-a (+ k 2))
     (+
      (* 2 (putnam-1999-a3-a (+ k 1)))
      (putnam-1999-a3-a k))))))

;; Keep the source's existential m internal. In particular, no witness search
;; or closed-form coefficient construction is built into the proposition.

(defun-sk putnam-1999-a3-conclusion-p (n)

   (m)

    (natp m)
    (equal
     (+

    negate inverse : R -> R

    add-associative :

    add-zero :

    add-inverse :

  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->

% Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1999_a3:
% coefficients of the local real power-series expansion of 1/(1-2x-x^2)
% have each adjacent squared sum occurring again as a coefficient. This file
% contains no proof.

putnam_1999_a3: THEORY
BEGIN
  real_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> real]

  safe_div(numerator, denominator: real): real =
    IF denominator = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      numerator / denominator
    ENDIF

  partial_sum(
      a: real_sequence,
      x: real,
      count: nat): RECURSIVE real =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      partial_sum(a, x, count - 1)
        + a(count - 1) * x ^ (count - 1)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  converges_to(sequence: real_sequence, value: real): bool =
    FORALL (epsilon_value: posreal):
      EXISTS (cutoff: nat):
        FORALL (count: nat):
          cutoff <= count IMPLIES
            abs(sequence(count) - value) < epsilon_value

  rational_function(x: real): real =
    safe_div(1, 1 - 2 * x - x ^ 2)

  has_local_power_series_expansion(a: real_sequence): bool =
    EXISTS (radius: posreal):
      FORALL (x: real):
        abs(x) < radius IMPLIES
          converges_to(
            LAMBDA (count: nat):
              partial_sum(a, x, count),
            rational_function(x))

  putnam_1999_a3: bool =
    FORALL (a: real_sequence):
      has_local_power_series_expansion(a) IMPLIES
        FORALL (n: nat):
          EXISTS (m: nat):
            a(n) ^ 2 + a(n + 1) ^ 2 = a(m)
END putnam_1999_a3

           (natp n)

    x

StrictLess :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
StrictLess reals x y =
  lessOrEqual reals x y and x != y

CloseTo :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
CloseTo reals center radius x =
  StrictLess reals
    (subtract reals center radius)
    x
  and
  StrictLess reals
    x
    (add reals center radius)

sumFirst :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Nat ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  R
sumFirst reals zero term =
  zeroR reals
sumFirst reals (suc n) term =
  add reals
    (sumFirst reals n term)
    (term n)

ConvergesTo :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  R ->
  Set
ConvergesTo {R} reals sequence limit =
  (epsilon : R) ->
  StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) epsilon ->
  Exists Nat
    (\ cutoff ->
      (n : Nat) ->
      cutoff <=N n ->
      CloseTo reals limit epsilon (sequence n))

SeriesHasSum :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  R ->
  Set
SeriesHasSum reals terms limit =
  ConvergesTo reals
    (\ n -> sumFirst reals n terms)
    limit

IteratedSeriesHasSum :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (Nat -> Nat -> R) ->
  R ->
  Set
IteratedSeriesHasSum {R} reals terms total =
  Exists (Nat -> R)
    (\ innerSums ->
      ((m : Nat) ->
        SeriesHasSum reals
          (terms m)
          (innerSums m))
      and
      SeriesHasSum reals innerSums total)

putnamTerm :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Nat ->
  Nat ->
  R
putnamTerm reals m n =
  let
    m1 = suc m
    n1 = suc n
    three = fromNat reals threeN
    threeToM1 = naturalPower reals three m1
    threeToN1 = naturalPower reals three n1
  in
  divide reals
    (multiply reals
      (naturalPower reals (fromNat reals m1) twoN)
      (fromNat reals n1))
    (multiply reals
      threeToM1
      (add reals
        (multiply reals
          (fromNat reals n1)
          threeToM1)
        (multiply reals
          (fromNat reals m1)
          threeToN1)))

nineThirtySeconds :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R
nineThirtySeconds reals =
  divide reals
    (fromNat reals nineN)
    (fromNat reals thirtyTwoN)

putnam-1999-a4 : Set1
putnam-1999-a4 =
  (R : Set) ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) ->
  IteratedSeriesHasSum reals
    (putnamTerm reals)
    (nineThirtySeconds reals)

(*
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1999_a4:
  the iterated real series with terms
  m^2*n / (3^m*(n*3^m + m*3^n)) equals 9/32. This file contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open arithmeticTheory realTheory seqTheory;

val putnam_1999_a4 =
  ``suminf
      (\m : num.
         suminf
           (\n : num.
              ((&(m + 1) : real) pow 2 * &(n + 1)) /
              ((3 : real) pow (m + 1) *
               (&(n + 1) * (3 : real) pow (m + 1) +
                &(m + 1) * (3 : real) pow (n + 1))))) =
    9 / 32``;

title: putnam_1999_a4
content:
$(
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact
  putnam_1999_a4: evaluation as 9 / 32 of an iterated real series over two
  positive-integer indices. This file contains no proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  SetMM's NN0 is the class of nonnegative integers. The successor shifts
  m + 1 and n + 1 therefore give exactly the positive indices in the
  displayed Putnam series.

  The two unbounded sum_ binders are SetMM's convergent infinite real-series
  sums. Their nesting preserves the source order: for each m, first sum over
  n, and then sum those values over m. The summand and its denominator are
  transcribed directly, and the right side is the explicit Rocq solution and
  the value annotated in the Lean and Isabelle sources.

  The final declaration is the single unproved $a corpus statement; this
  database contains no $p proof statement.
$)

${
  $d m n $.

  putnambench-putnam-1999-a4 $a |-
    (
      sum_ m e. NN0
        (
          sum_ n e. NN0
            (
              (
                ( ( m + 1 ) ^ 2 )
                x.
                ( n + 1 )
              )
              /
              (
                ( 3 ^ ( m + 1 ) )
                x.
                (
                  (
                    ( n + 1 )
                    x.
                    ( 3 ^ ( m + 1 ) )
                  )
                  +
                  (
                    ( m + 1 )
                    x.
                    ( 3 ^ ( n + 1 ) )
                  )
                )
              )
            )
        )
    )
    =
    ( 9 / ( 2 ^ 5 ) )
  $.
$}

:: m^2*n / (3^m*(n*3^m + m*3^n)) has value 9/32. This file contains no proof.

environ

    NUMBERS, XREAL_0, COMPLEX1, CARD_1, XXREAL_0, ARYTM_1, ARYTM_3,

    FUNCT_2, ORDINAL1, CARD_1, NUMBERS, XCMPLX_0, XREAL_0, REAL_1,
    INT_1, COMPLEX1, SQUARE_1, XXREAL_0, NEWTON, NAT_1, SEQ_1,
    SEQ_2, COMSEQ_2, SEQM_3, SEQ_4, PREPOWER, ABIAN, XXREAL_2,
    POWER, SERIES_1;
  constructors FUNCT_1, RELSET_1, FUNCT_2, CARD_1, REAL_1, SQUARE_1,
    COMPLEX1, INT_1, XXREAL_0, NEWTON, NAT_1, SEQ_2, SEQM_3, SEQ_4,
    PREPOWER, ABIAN, BINOP_2, COMSEQ_2, POWER, SERIES_1;
  registrations XBOOLE_0, SUBSET_1, RELAT_1, FUNCT_1, RELSET_1,
    FUNCT_2, NUMBERS, CARD_1, XXREAL_0, MEMBERED, VALUED_0, VALUED_1,
    XCMPLX_0, XREAL_0, SQUARE_1, ORDINAL1, NAT_1, INT_1, NEWTON,
    PREPOWER, SEQ_4, ABIAN;

begin

::$P-
theorem
  for outer being Real_Sequence st
    (for m being Nat holds
      ex inner being Real_Sequence st
        (for n being Nat holds

              (((3 qua Real) |^ (m + 1)) *

title: putnam_1999_a4
content:
% Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1999_a4:
% the iterated double series over positive integers with summand
% m^2*n / (3^m*(n*3^m + m*3^n)) converges to 9/32. This file contains no proof.

putnam_1999_a4: THEORY
BEGIN
  real_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> real]

  safe_div(numerator, denominator: real): real =
    IF denominator = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      numerator / denominator
    ENDIF

  series_term(m, n: nat): real =
    safe_div(
      ((m + 1) :: real) ^ 2 * ((n + 1) :: real),
      (3 :: real) ^ (m + 1)
        * (((n + 1) :: real) * (3 :: real) ^ (m + 1)
            + ((m + 1) :: real) * (3 :: real) ^ (n + 1)))

  row_partial_sum(m, count: nat): RECURSIVE real =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      row_partial_sum(m, count - 1)
        + series_term(m, count - 1)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  outer_partial_sum(
      row_sums: real_sequence, count: nat): RECURSIVE real =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      outer_partial_sum(row_sums, count - 1)
        + row_sums(count - 1)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  converges_to(sequence: real_sequence, value: real): bool =
    FORALL (epsilon_value: posreal):
      EXISTS (cutoff: nat):
        FORALL (index: nat):
          cutoff <= index IMPLIES
            abs(sequence(index) - value) < epsilon_value

  putnam_1999_a4: bool =
    EXISTS (row_sums: real_sequence):
      (FORALL (m: nat):
        converges_to(
          LAMBDA (count: nat):
            row_partial_sum(m, count),
          row_sums(m)))
      AND converges_to(
        LAMBDA (count: nat):
          outer_partial_sum(row_sums, count),
        (9 :: real) / 32)
END putnam_1999_a4

title: putnam_1999_a5
putnam_1999_a5
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1999_a5:
;; a uniform real constant bounds the value at zero of every degree-1999 real
;; polynomial by its L1 integral on [-1,1]. This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))

;; A context below is a Dedekind-complete ordered field, hence isomorphic to
;; the real field. Coefficient lists contain arbitrary elements of its carrier,
;; not rational approximations. The interval integral is characterized by the
;; limit of all sufficiently fine right-endpoint Riemann sums. For polynomial
;; absolute values this is exactly the source interval Lebesgue integral.

(defun p99a5-member-p (carrier x)
  (if (apply$ carrier (list x)) t nil))

(defun p99a5-unary-value (operation x)
  (apply$ operation (list x)))

(defun p99a5-binary-value (operation x y)
  (apply$ operation (list x y)))

(defun-sk p99a5-valid-set-p (carrier set)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (apply$ set (list x))
     (p99a5-member-p carrier x))))

(defun-sk p99a5-field-laws-p
    (carrier add multiply negate inverse zero one)
  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (p99a5-member-p carrier x)
      (p99a5-member-p carrier y)
      (p99a5-member-p carrier z))
     (and
      (p99a5-member-p
       carrier (p99a5-binary-value add x y))
      (p99a5-member-p
       carrier (p99a5-binary-value multiply x y))
      (p99a5-member-p
       carrier (p99a5-unary-value negate x))
      (implies
       (not (equal x zero))
       (p99a5-member-p
        carrier (p99a5-unary-value inverse x)))
      (equal
       (p99a5-binary-value
        add (p99a5-binary-value add x y) z)
       (p99a5-binary-value
        add x (p99a5-binary-value add y z)))
      (equal
       (p99a5-binary-value add x y)
       (p99a5-binary-value add y x))
      (equal
       (p99a5-binary-value add x zero)
       x)
      (equal
       (p99a5-binary-value
        add x (p99a5-unary-value negate x))
       zero)
      (equal
       (p99a5-binary-value
        multiply
        (p99a5-binary-value multiply x y)
        z)
       (p99a5-binary-value
        multiply
        x
        (p99a5-binary-value multiply y z)))
      (equal
       (p99a5-binary-value multiply x y)
       (p99a5-binary-value multiply y x))
      (equal
       (p99a5-binary-value multiply x one)
       x)
      (implies
       (not (equal x zero))
       (equal
        (p99a5-binary-value
         multiply x (p99a5-unary-value inverse x))
        one))
      (equal
       (p99a5-binary-value
        multiply x (p99a5-binary-value add y z))
       (p99a5-binary-value
        add
        (p99a5-binary-value multiply x y)
        (p99a5-binary-value multiply x z)))))))

(defun-sk p99a5-order-laws-p
    (carrier add multiply zero less)
  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (p99a5-member-p carrier x)
      (p99a5-member-p carrier y)
      (p99a5-member-p carrier z))
     (and
      (not (p99a5-binary-value less x x))
      (or
       (equal x y)
       (p99a5-binary-value less x y)
       (p99a5-binary-value less y x))
      (implies
       (and
        (p99a5-binary-value less x y)
        (p99a5-binary-value less y z))
       (p99a5-binary-value less x z))
      (implies
       (p99a5-binary-value less x y)
       (p99a5-binary-value
        less
        (p99a5-binary-value add x z)
        (p99a5-binary-value add y z)))
      (implies
       (and
        (p99a5-binary-value less zero x)
        (p99a5-binary-value less zero y))
       (p99a5-binary-value
        less
        zero
        (p99a5-binary-value multiply x y)))))))

(defun-sk p99a5-set-nonempty-p (carrier set)
  (exists (x)
    (and
     (p99a5-member-p carrier x)
     (apply$ set (list x)))))

(defun-sk p99a5-upper-bound-p
    (carrier less set bound)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (and
      (p99a5-member-p carrier x)
      (apply$ set (list x)))
     (not
      (p99a5-binary-value less bound x)))))

(defun-sk p99a5-bounded-above-p
    (carrier less set)
  (exists (bound)
    (and
     (p99a5-member-p carrier bound)
     (p99a5-upper-bound-p
      carrier less set bound))))

(defun-sk p99a5-supremum-p
    (carrier less set supremum)
  (forall (bound)
    (and
     (p99a5-member-p carrier supremum)
     (p99a5-upper-bound-p
      carrier less set supremum)
     (implies
      (and
       (p99a5-member-p carrier bound)
       (p99a5-upper-bound-p
        carrier less set bound))
      (not
       (p99a5-binary-value
        less bound supremum))))))

(defun-sk p99a5-has-supremum-p
    (carrier less set)
  (exists (supremum)
    (p99a5-supremum-p
     carrier less set supremum)))

(defun-sk p99a5-dedekind-complete-p
    (carrier less)
  (forall (set)
    (implies
     (and
      (tamep-functionp set)
      (p99a5-valid-set-p carrier set)
      (p99a5-set-nonempty-p carrier set)
      (p99a5-bounded-above-p carrier less set))
     (p99a5-has-supremum-p
      carrier less set))))

(defun p99a5-real-field-p
    (carrier add multiply negate inverse zero one less)
  (and
   (tamep-functionp carrier)
   (tamep-functionp add)
   (tamep-functionp multiply)
   (tamep-functionp negate)
   (tamep-functionp inverse)
   (tamep-functionp less)
   (p99a5-member-p carrier zero)
   (p99a5-member-p carrier one)
   (not (equal zero one))
   (p99a5-field-laws-p
    carrier add multiply negate inverse zero one)
   (p99a5-order-laws-p
    carrier add multiply zero less)
   (p99a5-binary-value less zero one)
   (p99a5-dedekind-complete-p carrier less)))

(defun p99a5-r-carrier (ctx) (nth 0 ctx))
(defun p99a5-r-zero (ctx) (nth 1 ctx))
(defun p99a5-r-one (ctx) (nth 2 ctx))
(defun p99a5-r-add (ctx) (nth 3 ctx))
(defun p99a5-r-mul (ctx) (nth 4 ctx))
(defun p99a5-r-neg (ctx) (nth 5 ctx))
(defun p99a5-r-inv (ctx) (nth 6 ctx))
(defun p99a5-r-lt (ctx) (nth 7 ctx))

(defun p99a5-context-p (ctx)
  (and
   (true-listp ctx)
   (equal (len ctx) 8)
   (p99a5-real-field-p
    (p99a5-r-carrier ctx)
    (p99a5-r-add ctx)
    (p99a5-r-mul ctx)
    (p99a5-r-neg ctx)
    (p99a5-r-inv ctx)
    (p99a5-r-zero ctx)
    (p99a5-r-one ctx)
    (p99a5-r-lt ctx))))

(defun p99a5-r-add-value (ctx x y)
  (p99a5-binary-value (p99a5-r-add ctx) x y))

(defun p99a5-r-mul-value (ctx x y)
  (p99a5-binary-value (p99a5-r-mul ctx) x y))

(defun p99a5-r-neg-value (ctx x)
  (p99a5-unary-value (p99a5-r-neg ctx) x))

(defun p99a5-r-inv-value (ctx x)
  (p99a5-unary-value (p99a5-r-inv ctx) x))

(defun p99a5-r-sub-value (ctx x y)
  (p99a5-r-add-value
   ctx x (p99a5-r-neg-value ctx y)))

(defun p99a5-r-div-value (ctx x y)
  (p99a5-r-mul-value
   ctx x (p99a5-r-inv-value ctx y)))

(defun p99a5-r-lt-p (ctx x y)
  (if (p99a5-binary-value
       (p99a5-r-lt ctx) x y)
      t nil))

(defun p99a5-r-le-p (ctx x y)
  (not (p99a5-r-lt-p ctx y x)))

(defun p99a5-r-abs-value (ctx x)
  (if (p99a5-r-lt-p
       ctx x (p99a5-r-zero ctx))
      (p99a5-r-neg-value ctx x)
    x))

(defun p99a5-positive-real-p (ctx x)
  (and
   (p99a5-member-p (p99a5-r-carrier ctx) x)
   (p99a5-r-lt-p
    ctx (p99a5-r-zero ctx) x)))

(defun p99a5-carrier-list-p (ctx values)
  (if (consp values)
      (and
       (p99a5-member-p
        (p99a5-r-carrier ctx) (car values))
       (p99a5-carrier-list-p ctx (cdr values)))
    (equal values nil)))

(defun p99a5-degree-1999-polynomial-p
    (ctx coefficients)
  (and
   (true-listp coefficients)
   (equal (len coefficients) 2000)
   (p99a5-carrier-list-p ctx coefficients)
   (not
    (equal
     (car (last coefficients))
     (p99a5-r-zero ctx)))))

(defun p99a5-polynomial-value
    (ctx coefficients x)
  (if (consp coefficients)
      (p99a5-r-add-value
       ctx
       (car coefficients)
       (p99a5-r-mul-value
        ctx
        x
        (p99a5-polynomial-value
         ctx (cdr coefficients) x)))
    (p99a5-r-zero ctx)))

(defun p99a5-nat-cast (ctx n)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix n)))
  (if (zp n)
      (p99a5-r-zero ctx)
    (p99a5-r-add-value
     ctx
     (p99a5-r-one ctx)
     (p99a5-nat-cast ctx (- n 1)))))

(defun p99a5-two (ctx)
  (p99a5-r-add-value
   ctx
   (p99a5-r-one ctx)
   (p99a5-r-one ctx)))

(defun p99a5-minus-one (ctx)
  (p99a5-r-neg-value
   ctx (p99a5-r-one ctx)))

(defun p99a5-grid-point
    (ctx subdivisions index)
  (p99a5-r-add-value
   ctx
   (p99a5-minus-one ctx)
   (p99a5-r-mul-value
    ctx
    (p99a5-two ctx)
    (p99a5-r-div-value
     ctx
     (p99a5-nat-cast ctx index)
     (p99a5-nat-cast ctx subdivisions)))))

(defun p99a5-riemann-sum-terms
    (ctx coefficients subdivisions remaining)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix remaining)))
  (if (zp remaining)
      (p99a5-r-zero ctx)
    (p99a5-r-add-value
     ctx
     (p99a5-r-abs-value
      ctx
      (p99a5-polynomial-value
       ctx
       coefficients
       (p99a5-grid-point
        ctx subdivisions remaining)))
     (p99a5-riemann-sum-terms
      ctx coefficients subdivisions (- remaining 1)))))

(defun p99a5-riemann-approx
    (ctx coefficients subdivisions)
  (if (posp subdivisions)
      (p99a5-r-mul-value
       ctx
       (p99a5-r-div-value
        ctx
        (p99a5-two ctx)
        (p99a5-nat-cast ctx subdivisions))
       (p99a5-riemann-sum-terms
        ctx coefficients subdivisions subdivisions))
    (p99a5-r-zero ctx)))

(defun-sk p99a5-integral-tail-p
    (ctx coefficients integral epsilon cutoff)
  (forall (subdivisions)
    (implies
     (and
      (posp subdivisions)
      (<= cutoff subdivisions))
     (p99a5-r-lt-p
      ctx
      (p99a5-r-abs-value
       ctx
       (p99a5-r-sub-value
        ctx
        (p99a5-riemann-approx
         ctx coefficients subdivisions)
        integral))
      epsilon))))

(defun-sk p99a5-integral-cutoff-exists-p
    (ctx coefficients integral epsilon)
  (exists (cutoff)
    (and
     (posp cutoff)
     (p99a5-integral-tail-p
      ctx coefficients integral epsilon cutoff))))

(defun-sk p99a5-integral-converges-to-p
    (ctx coefficients integral)
  (forall (epsilon)
    (implies
     (p99a5-positive-real-p ctx epsilon)
     (p99a5-integral-cutoff-exists-p
      ctx coefficients integral epsilon))))

(defun p99a5-integral-value-p
    (ctx coefficients integral)
  (and
   (p99a5-member-p
    (p99a5-r-carrier ctx) integral)
   (p99a5-integral-converges-to-p
    ctx coefficients integral)))

title: putnam_1999_a5
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1999_a5
-- (putnambench__agda__putnam_1999_a5): a uniform integral bound for the
-- value at zero of every real polynomial of degree 1999. This file contains
-- no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.List using (List; []; _∷_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; _*_)

infix 4 _!=_ _<=N_
infixr 3 _and_
infixr 2 _or_

data Bottom : Set where

Not : Set -> Set
Not A =
  A -> Bottom

_!=_ : {A : Set} -> A -> A -> Set
x != y =
  Not (x == y)

record _and_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data _or_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  left  : A -> A or B
  right : B -> A or B

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

data _<=N_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set where
  zero<=N   : {n : Nat} -> zero <=N n
  suc<=sucN : {m n : Nat} -> m <=N n -> suc m <=N suc n

record CompleteOrderedRealField (R : Set) : Set1 where
  field
    zeroR oneR : R
    add multiply : R -> R -> R
    negate inverse absoluteValue : R -> R
    lessOrEqual : R -> R -> Set
    fromNat : Nat -> R

    one-not-zero :
      oneR != zeroR

    add-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> add x y == add y x
    add-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      add (add x y) z == add x (add y z)
    add-zero :
      (x : R) -> add x zeroR == x
    add-inverse :
      (x : R) -> add x (negate x) == zeroR

    multiply-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> multiply x y == multiply y x
    multiply-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply (multiply x y) z ==
      multiply x (multiply y z)
    multiply-one :
      (x : R) -> multiply x oneR == x
    multiply-zero :
      (x : R) -> multiply x zeroR == zeroR
    distribute :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply x (add y z) ==
      add (multiply x y) (multiply x z)
    inverse-zero :
      inverse zeroR == zeroR
    multiply-inverse :
      (x : R) ->
      x != zeroR ->
      multiply x (inverse x) == oneR

    order-reflexive :
      (x : R) -> lessOrEqual x x
    order-transitive :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y z ->
      lessOrEqual x z
    order-antisymmetric :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y x ->
      x == y
    order-total :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y or lessOrEqual y x
    add-order :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual (add z x) (add z y)
    multiply-nonnegative :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR x ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR y ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR (multiply x y)
    zero-less-than-one :
      lessOrEqual zeroR oneR and zeroR != oneR

    absolute-nonnegative :
      (x : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR (absoluteValue x)
    absolute-of-nonnegative :
      (x : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR x ->
      absoluteValue x == x
    absolute-of-nonpositive :
      (x : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x zeroR ->
      absoluteValue x == negate x

    fromNat-zero :
      fromNat zero == zeroR
    fromNat-successor :
      (n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (suc n) == add (fromNat n) oneR
    fromNat-addition :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m + n) == add (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-multiplication :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m * n) == multiply (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-injective :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat m == fromNat n ->
      m == n

    archimedean :
      (x : R) ->
      Exists Nat
        (\ n ->
          lessOrEqual x (fromNat n))
    least-upper-bound :
      (P : R -> Set) ->
      Exists R P ->
      Exists R
        (\ upper ->
          (x : R) ->
          P x ->
          lessOrEqual x upper) ->
      Exists R
        (\ supremum ->
          ((x : R) ->
            P x ->
            lessOrEqual x supremum)
          and
          ((upper : R) ->
            ((x : R) ->
              P x ->
              lessOrEqual x upper) ->
            lessOrEqual supremum upper))

open CompleteOrderedRealField

subtract :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
subtract reals x y =
  add reals x (negate reals y)

divide :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
divide reals x y =
  multiply reals x (inverse reals y)

StrictLess :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
StrictLess reals x y =
  lessOrEqual reals x y and x != y

CloseTo :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
CloseTo reals center radius x =
  StrictLess reals
    (subtract reals center radius)
    x
  and
  StrictLess reals
    x
    (add reals center radius)

sumFirst :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Nat ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  R
sumFirst reals zero terms =
  zeroR reals
sumFirst reals (suc n) terms =
  add reals
    (sumFirst reals n terms)
    (terms n)

ConvergesTo :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  R ->
  Set
ConvergesTo {R} reals sequence limit =
  (epsilon : R) ->
  StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) epsilon ->
  Exists Nat
    (\ cutoff ->
      (n : Nat) ->
      cutoff <=N n ->
      CloseTo reals limit epsilon (sequence n))

midpointRiemannSum :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  (R -> R) ->
  Nat ->
  R
midpointRiemannSum reals lower upper function pieces =
  let
    two =
      fromNat reals (suc (suc zero))
    step =
      divide reals
        (subtract reals upper lower)
        (fromNat reals pieces)
    halfStep =
      divide reals step two
  in
  sumFirst reals pieces
    (\ i ->
      multiply reals
        (function
          (add reals lower
            (add reals
              (multiply reals
                (fromNat reals i)
                step)
              halfStep)))
        step)

IntervalIntegralValue :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  (R -> R) ->
  R ->
  Set
IntervalIntegralValue reals lower upper function value =
  ConvergesTo reals
    (\ n ->
      midpointRiemannSum reals
        lower
        upper
        function
        (suc n))
    value

Polynomial : Set -> Set
Polynomial R =
  List R

coefficient :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Polynomial R ->
  Nat ->
  R
coefficient reals [] n =
  zeroR reals
coefficient reals (c ∷ coefficients) zero =
  c
coefficient reals (c ∷ coefficients) (suc n) =
  coefficient reals coefficients n

DegreeExactly :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Polynomial R ->
  Nat ->
  Set
DegreeExactly reals polynomial degree =
  coefficient reals polynomial degree != zeroR reals
  and
  ((index : Nat) ->
    suc degree <=N index ->
    coefficient reals polynomial index == zeroR reals)

evaluatePolynomial :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Polynomial R ->
  R ->
  R
evaluatePolynomial reals [] x =
  zeroR reals
evaluatePolynomial reals (c ∷ coefficients) x =
  add reals
    c
    (multiply reals
      x
      (evaluatePolynomial reals coefficients x))

negativeOne :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R
negativeOne reals =
  negate reals (oneR reals)

absolutePolynomialValue :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Polynomial R ->
  R ->
  R
absolutePolynomialValue reals polynomial x =
  absoluteValue reals
    (evaluatePolynomial reals polynomial x)

putnam-1999-a5 : Set1
putnam-1999-a5 =
  (R : Set) ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) ->
  Exists R
    (\ constant ->
      (polynomial : Polynomial R) ->
      DegreeExactly reals polynomial 1999 ->
      Exists R
        (\ integralValue ->
          IntervalIntegralValue reals
            (negativeOne reals)
            (oneR reals)
            (absolutePolynomialValue reals polynomial)
            integralValue
          and
          lessOrEqual reals
            (absolutePolynomialValue reals
              polynomial
              (zeroR reals))
            (multiply reals constant integralValue)))

% Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench artifact putnam_1999_a5:
% a uniform constant bounds the absolute value at zero of every real
% polynomial of degree 1999 by its absolute-value integral on [-1, 1].
% This file contains no proof.

putnam_1999_a5: THEORY
BEGIN
  real_function: TYPE = [real -> real]
  real_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> real]
  coefficient_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> real]

  polynomial_value(
      coefficients: coefficient_sequence,
      count: nat,
      x: real): RECURSIVE real =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      polynomial_value(coefficients, count - 1, x)
        + coefficients(count - 1) * x ^ (count - 1)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  degree_1999(coefficients: coefficient_sequence): bool =
    coefficients(1999) /= 0

  valid_tagged_partition(
      left, right: real,
      points, tags: real_sequence,
      count: nat): bool =
    count > 0
      AND points(0) = left
      AND points(count) = right
      AND FORALL (index: nat):
        index < count IMPLIES
          (points(index) < points(index + 1)
            AND points(index) <= tags(index)
            AND tags(index) <= points(index + 1))

  mesh_less_than(
      points: real_sequence,
      count: nat,
      bound: real): bool =
    FORALL (index: nat):
      index < count IMPLIES
        points(index + 1) - points(index) < bound

  riemann_sum(
      function_value: real_function,
      points, tags: real_sequence,
      count: nat): RECURSIVE real =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      riemann_sum(
        function_value, points, tags, count - 1)
        + function_value(tags(count - 1))
            * (points(count) - points(count - 1))
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  has_interval_integral(
      function_value: real_function,
      left, right, integral_value: real): bool =
    left < right
      AND FORALL (epsilon_value: posreal):
        EXISTS (mesh_bound: posreal):
          FORALL
              (points, tags: real_sequence),
              (count: nat):
            (valid_tagged_partition(
                left, right, points, tags, count)
              AND mesh_less_than(
                points, count, mesh_bound))
            IMPLIES
              abs(
                riemann_sum(
                  function_value, points, tags, count)
                  - integral_value)
                < epsilon_value

  interval_integral(
      function_value: real_function,
      left, right: real): real =
    IF left = right THEN
      0
    ELSIF left < right THEN
      IF EXISTS (integral_value: real):
          has_interval_integral(
            function_value, left, right, integral_value)
      THEN
        epsilon(
          LAMBDA (integral_value: real):
            has_interval_integral(
              function_value, left, right, integral_value))
      ELSE
        0
      ENDIF
    ELSE
      IF EXISTS (integral_value: real):
          has_interval_integral(
            function_value, right, left, integral_value)
      THEN
        -epsilon(
          LAMBDA (integral_value: real):
            has_interval_integral(
              function_value, right, left, integral_value))
      ELSE
        0
      ENDIF
    ENDIF

  absolute_polynomial(
      coefficients: coefficient_sequence): real_function =
    LAMBDA (x: real):
      abs(polynomial_value(coefficients, 2000, x))

  putnam_1999_a5: bool =
    EXISTS (C: real):
      FORALL (coefficients: coefficient_sequence):
        degree_1999(coefficients) IMPLIES
          abs(polynomial_value(coefficients, 2000, 0))
            <= C
              * interval_integral(
                  absolute_polynomial(coefficients), -1, 1)
END putnam_1999_a5

/--
The sequence $(a_n)_{n\geq 1}$ is defined by $a_1=1, a_2=2, a_3=24,$ and, for $n\geq 4$, \[a_n = \frac{6a_{n-1}^2a_{n-3} - 8a_{n-1}a_{n-2}^2}{a_{n-2}a_{n-3}}.\] Show that, for all n, $a_n$ is an integer multiple of $n$.

(ha1 : a 1 = 1)
(ha2 : a 2 = 2)
(ha3 : a 3 = 24)

: ∀ n, n ≥ 1 → (∃ k : ℤ, a n = k * n) :=
sorry
