;; Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1999_a6:
;; every term of a specified nonlinear real recurrence is an integer multiple
;; of its positive index. This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

;; The hypotheses uniquely determine all positive-index terms from 1, 2, 24.
;; Since these values are rational and the recurrence uses only field
;; operations, every determined real value is the image of the exact rational
;; computed below. ACL2 division by zero is total with reciprocal zero, as in
;; the source fields, so this substitution is bidirectionally equivalent even
;; without a separate nonzero-denominator hypothesis.
(defun putnam-1999-a6-next (x y z)
  (/ (- (* 6 (* (* z z) x))
        (* 8 (* z (* y y))))
     (* y x)))

;; With X = a_i, Y = a_(i+1), and Z = a_(i+2), one step shifts the window
;; and computes a_(i+3). Starting with i = 1 makes STEPS = n-1 return a_n.
(defun putnam-1999-a6-sequence-from (steps x y z)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix steps)))
  (if (zp steps)
      x
    (putnam-1999-a6-sequence-from
     (- steps 1)
     y
     z
     (putnam-1999-a6-next x y z))))

(defun putnam-1999-a6-sequence (n)
  (if (posp n)
      (putnam-1999-a6-sequence-from (- n 1) 1 2 24)
    0))

;; For positive integer N, INTEGERP(a_N / N) holds exactly when there exists
;; an integer K with a_N = K*N; the existential witness remains internal.
(defun putnambench-putnam-1999-a6-statement (n)
  (implies
   (posp n)
   (integerp
    (/ (putnam-1999-a6-sequence n) n))))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

Not A =
  A -> Bottom

_!=_ : {A : Set} -> A -> A -> Set
x != y =
  Not (x == y)

record _and_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data _or_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  left  : A -> A or B
  right : B -> A or B

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

data _<=N_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set where
  zero<=N   : {n : Nat} -> zero <=N n
  suc<=sucN : {m n : Nat} -> m <=N n -> suc m <=N suc n

record CompleteOrderedRealField (R : Set) : Set1 where
  field
    zeroR oneR : R
    add multiply : R -> R -> R
    negate inverse : R -> R
    lessOrEqual : R -> R -> Set
    fromNat : Nat -> R

    one-not-zero :
      oneR != zeroR

    add-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> add x y == add y x
    add-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      add (add x y) z == add x (add y z)
    add-zero :
      (x : R) -> add x zeroR == x
    add-inverse :
      (x : R) -> add x (negate x) == zeroR

    multiply-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> multiply x y == multiply y x
    multiply-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply (multiply x y) z ==
      multiply x (multiply y z)
    multiply-one :
      (x : R) -> multiply x oneR == x
    multiply-zero :
      (x : R) -> multiply x zeroR == zeroR
    distribute :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply x (add y z) ==
      add (multiply x y) (multiply x z)
    inverse-zero :
      inverse zeroR == zeroR
    multiply-inverse :
      (x : R) ->
      x != zeroR ->
      multiply x (inverse x) == oneR

    order-reflexive :
      (x : R) -> lessOrEqual x x
    order-transitive :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y z ->
      lessOrEqual x z
    order-antisymmetric :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y x ->
      x == y
    order-total :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y or lessOrEqual y x
    add-order :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual (add z x) (add z y)
    multiply-nonnegative :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR x ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR y ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR (multiply x y)
    zero-less-than-one :
      lessOrEqual zeroR oneR and zeroR != oneR

    fromNat-zero :
      fromNat zero == zeroR
    fromNat-successor :
      (n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (suc n) == add (fromNat n) oneR
    fromNat-addition :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m + n) == add (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-multiplication :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m * n) == multiply (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-injective :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat m == fromNat n ->
      m == n

    archimedean :
      (x : R) ->
      Exists Nat
        (\ n ->
          lessOrEqual x (fromNat n))
    least-upper-bound :
      (P : R -> Set) ->
      Exists R P ->
      Exists R
        (\ upper ->
          (x : R) ->
          P x ->
          lessOrEqual x upper) ->
      Exists R
        (\ supremum ->
          ((x : R) ->
            P x ->
            lessOrEqual x supremum)
          and
          ((upper : R) ->
            ((x : R) ->
              P x ->
              lessOrEqual x upper) ->
            lessOrEqual supremum upper))

open CompleteOrderedRealField

fromInt :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Int ->
  R
fromInt reals (pos n) =
  fromNat reals n
fromInt reals (negsuc n) =
  negate reals (fromNat reals (suc n))

subtract :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
subtract reals x y =
  add reals x (negate reals y)

divide :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
divide reals x y =
  multiply reals x (inverse reals y)

square :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R
square reals x =
  multiply reals x x

oneN : Nat
oneN =
  suc zero

twoN : Nat
twoN =
  suc oneN

threeN : Nat
threeN =
  suc twoN

fourN : Nat
fourN =
  suc threeN

sixN : Nat
sixN =
  suc (suc fourN)

eightN : Nat
eightN =
  twoN * fourN

twentyFourN : Nat
twentyFourN =
  threeN * eightN

module Putnam1999A6Statement
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) where

  record InitialValues (a : Nat -> R) : Set where
    field
      value-one :
        a oneN == oneR reals
      value-two :
        a twoN == fromNat reals twoN
      value-three :
        a threeN == fromNat reals twentyFourN

  recurrenceValue :
    (Nat -> R) ->
    Nat ->
    R
  recurrenceValue a n =
    divide reals
      (subtract reals
        (multiply reals
          (multiply reals
            (fromNat reals sixN)
            (square reals (a (n - oneN))))
          (a (n - threeN)))
        (multiply reals
          (multiply reals
            (fromNat reals eightN)
            (a (n - oneN)))
          (square reals (a (n - twoN)))))
      (multiply reals
        (a (n - twoN))
        (a (n - threeN)))

  Recurrence : (Nat -> R) -> Set
  Recurrence a =
    (n : Nat) ->
    fourN <=N n ->
    a n == recurrenceValue a n

  IntegerMultipleOfIndex :
    (Nat -> R) ->
    Nat ->
    Set
  IntegerMultipleOfIndex a n =
    Exists Int
      (\ k ->
        a n ==
        multiply reals
          (fromInt reals k)
          (fromNat reals n))

  proposition : Set
  proposition =
    (a : Nat -> R) ->
    InitialValues a ->
    Recurrence a ->
    (n : Nat) ->
    oneN <=N n ->
    IntegerMultipleOfIndex a n

putnam-1999-a6 : Set1
putnam-1999-a6 =
  (R : Set) ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) ->
  Putnam1999A6Statement.proposition reals

(*
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1999_a6:
  a real sequence satisfying the specified rational recurrence has every
  positive-indexed term equal to an integer multiple of its index. This file
  contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open arithmeticTheory integerTheory realTheory intrealTheory;

val putnam_1999_a6 =
  ``!a : num -> real.
      a 1 = 1 /\
      a 2 = 2 /\
      a 3 = 24 /\
      (!n : num.
         4 <= n
         ==>
         a n =
           (6 * (a (n - 1)) pow 2 * a (n - 3) -
            8 * a (n - 1) * (a (n - 2)) pow 2) /
           (a (n - 2) * a (n - 3)))
      ==>
      !n : num.
        1 <= n
        ==>
        ?k : int.
          a n = real_of_int k * (&n : real)``;

title: putnam_1999_a6
content:
$(
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact
  putnam_1999_a6: every real sequence with initial values 1, 2, and 24 and
  the specified rational recurrence has each positive-indexed term equal to
  an integer multiple of its index. This file contains no proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  A ranges over every real-valued sequence indexed by the nonnegative
  integers. The recurrence is imposed exactly at the natural indices n >= 4,
  and uses set.mm's real arithmetic and division. The conclusion retains the
  existential integer multiplier inside the universal positive-index
  quantifier.

  Lean declares A on all integers, but its assumptions and conclusion only
  apply A to nonnegative indices. Restriction to NN0 and arbitrary extension
  back to ZZ therefore give a bidirectional equivalence with that formulation.
  The Rocq source presents the same sequence with zero-based indexing, so its
  A(n) = (n+1)k conclusion corresponds to the one-based Isabelle and Lean
  formulation used here. The final declaration is the single unproved $a
  corpus statement; this database contains no $p proof statement.
$)

${
  $d A k n $.

  putnambench-putnam-1999-a6 $a |- A. A e. ( RR ^m NN0 )
    (
      (
        (
          (
            ( A ` 1 ) = 1
            /\
            ( A ` 2 ) = 2
          )
          /\
          ( A ` 3 ) = ; 2 4
        )
        /\
        A. n e. NN
          (
            4 <_ n
            ->
            ( A ` n )
            =
            (
              (
                (
                  (
                    6
                    x.
                    ( ( A ` ( n - 1 ) ) ^ 2 )
                  )
                  x.
                  ( A ` ( n - 3 ) )
                )
                -
                (
                  (
                    8
                    x.
                    ( A ` ( n - 1 ) )
                  )
                  x.
                  ( ( A ` ( n - 2 ) ) ^ 2 )
                )
              )
              /
              (
                ( A ` ( n - 2 ) )
                x.
                ( A ` ( n - 3 ) )
              )
            )
          )
      )
      ->
      A. n e. NN
        E. k e. ZZ
          ( A ` n ) = ( k x. n )
    )
  $.
$}

title: putnam_1999_a6
content:
% Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1999_a6:
% every positive-index term of the specified real recurrence sequence is an
% integer multiple of its index. This file contains no proof.

putnam_1999_a6: THEORY
BEGIN
  real_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> real]

  real_quotient(numerator, denominator: real): real =
    IF denominator = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      numerator / denominator
    ENDIF

  putnam_1999_a6: bool =
    FORALL (a: real_sequence):
      (a(1) = 1
        AND a(2) = 2
        AND a(3) = 24
        AND (FORALL (n: nat):
          n >= 4 IMPLIES
            a(n) =
              real_quotient(
                6 * a(n - 1) ^ 2 * a(n - 3)
                  - 8 * a(n - 1) * a(n - 2) ^ 2,
                a(n - 2) * a(n - 3))))
      IMPLIES
        FORALL (n: nat):
          n >= 1 IMPLIES
            EXISTS (k: int):
              a(n) = (k :: real) * (n :: real)
END putnam_1999_a6

import Mathlib

open Filter Topology Metric

/--
Let $P(x)$ be a polynomial of degree $n$ such that $P(x)=Q(x)P''(x)$, where $Q(x)$ is a quadratic polynomial and $P''(x)$ is the second derivative of $P(x)$.  Show that if $P(x)$ has at least two distinct roots then it must have $n$ distinct roots.
-/
theorem putnam_1999_b2
  (P Q : Polynomial ℂ)
  (hQ : Q.natDegree = 2)
  (hP : ∀ x : ℂ, P.eval x = (Q.eval x) * (Polynomial.derivative^[2] P).eval x) :
  (∃ x1 x2, x1 ≠ x2 ∧ P.eval x1 = 0 ∧ P.eval x2 = 0) →
  (∃ f : Fin (P.natDegree) → ℂ,
    (∀ i j, i ≠ j → f i ≠ f j) ∧
    (∀ i, P.eval (f i) = 0)) :=
sorry

    (P Q : {poly R[i]})
    (hQ : size Q = 3%nat)
    (hP : forall x : R[i], P.[x] = Q.[x] * (P^`(2)).[x])
    : (exists x1 x2 : R[i], x1 <> x2 /\ P.[x1] = 0 /\ P.[x2] = 0) ->
        (exists f : seq R[i], size f = (size P).-1 /\ uniq f /\ all (fun x => P.[x] == 0) f).
Proof. Admitted.

content:
;; Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1999_b2:
;; a complex polynomial satisfying P = Q P'' with quadratic Q has as many
;; distinct roots as its degree whenever it has two distinct roots. This file
;; contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

;; Complex coefficients are represented through an arbitrary algebraically
;; closed field of characteristic zero.  Algebraic closure is presented by a
;; root-selection function for nonconstant polynomials, and characteristic
;; zero by the canonical embedding of the natural numbers.  These choices add
;; operations but no mathematical assumptions: choice supplies the selector,
;; and the natural embedding is unique.
;;
;; Canonical nonempty coefficient lists use ascending degree order.  The
;; evaluation laws make pointwise equality below exactly the source identity.
;; Algebraically closed fields of characteristic zero are elementarily
;; equivalent to the complex numbers, so this field-generic finite-polynomial
;; formulation is bidirectionally equivalent to the source statement.
;;
;; FN-EQUAL against a constant-T function expresses universal quantification
;; over the represented field.  Negated FN-EQUAL with a failure predicate
;; expresses the source's internal existential quantifiers for the two roots
;; and for the list of degree-many distinct roots.  Every generated traversal
;; lambda specializes its function positions to quoted tame function objects.

(defun putnam-1999-b2-quoted (object)
  (list 'quote object))

(defun putnam-1999-b2-apply1-term (function argument)
  (list
   'apply$
   (putnam-1999-b2-quoted function)
   (list 'cons argument nil)))

(defun putnam-1999-b2-apply2-term (function left right)
  (list
   'apply$
   (putnam-1999-b2-quoted function)
   (list 'cons left (list 'cons right nil))))

(defun putnam-1999-b2-and-term (terms)
  (if (endp terms)
      (putnam-1999-b2-quoted t)
    (list
     'if
     (car terms)
     (putnam-1999-b2-and-term (cdr terms))
     (putnam-1999-b2-quoted nil))))

(defun putnam-1999-b2-or-term (terms)
  (if (endp terms)
      (putnam-1999-b2-quoted nil)
    (list
     'if
     (car terms)
     (putnam-1999-b2-quoted t)
     (putnam-1999-b2-or-term (cdr terms)))))

(defun putnam-1999-b2-not-term (term)
  (list
   'if
   term
   (putnam-1999-b2-quoted nil)
   (putnam-1999-b2-quoted t)))

(defun putnam-1999-b2-implies-term (antecedent consequent)
  (list
   'if
   antecedent
   consequent
   (putnam-1999-b2-quoted t)))

(defun putnam-1999-b2-true-function (formals)
  (list
   'lambda
   formals
   (putnam-1999-b2-quoted t)))

(defun putnam-1999-b2-carrier-term (carrier element)
  (putnam-1999-b2-apply1-term carrier element))

(defun putnam-1999-b2-operation-term (operation left right)
  (putnam-1999-b2-apply2-term operation left right))

(defun putnam-1999-b2-all-coefficients-function (carrier)
  (list
   'lambda
   '(loop$-gvars loop$-ivars)
   (putnam-1999-b2-carrier-term
    carrier 'loop$-ivars)))

(defun putnam-1999-b2-all-coefficients-term
    (carrier coefficients)
  (list
   'always$+
   (putnam-1999-b2-quoted
    (putnam-1999-b2-all-coefficients-function
     carrier))
   (putnam-1999-b2-quoted nil)
   coefficients))

(defun putnam-1999-b2-polynomial-term
    (carrier zero coefficients)
  (putnam-1999-b2-and-term
   (list
    (list 'true-listp coefficients)
    (list 'consp coefficients)
    (putnam-1999-b2-all-coefficients-term
     carrier coefficients)
    (putnam-1999-b2-or-term
     (list
      (list 'equal
            (list 'len coefficients)
            (putnam-1999-b2-quoted 1))
      (putnam-1999-b2-not-term
       (list 'equal
             (list 'car (list 'last coefficients))
             (putnam-1999-b2-quoted zero))))))))

(defun putnam-1999-b2-field-laws-function
    (carrier zero one add mul neg inv)
  (let* ((x 'x)
         (y 'y)
         (z 'z)
         (qzero (putnam-1999-b2-quoted zero))
         (qone (putnam-1999-b2-quoted one))
         (add-xy
          (putnam-1999-b2-operation-term add x y))
         (add-yz
          (putnam-1999-b2-operation-term add y z))
         (mul-xy
          (putnam-1999-b2-operation-term mul x y))
         (mul-yz
          (putnam-1999-b2-operation-term mul y z))
         (neg-x
          (putnam-1999-b2-apply1-term neg x))
         (inv-x
          (putnam-1999-b2-apply1-term inv x))
         (domain
          (putnam-1999-b2-and-term
           (list
            (putnam-1999-b2-carrier-term carrier x)
            (putnam-1999-b2-carrier-term carrier y)
            (putnam-1999-b2-carrier-term carrier z))))
         (laws
          (putnam-1999-b2-and-term
           (list
            (putnam-1999-b2-carrier-term carrier add-xy)
            (putnam-1999-b2-carrier-term carrier mul-xy)
            (putnam-1999-b2-carrier-term carrier neg-x)
            (putnam-1999-b2-carrier-term carrier inv-x)
            (list
             'equal
             (putnam-1999-b2-operation-term add add-xy z)
             (putnam-1999-b2-operation-term add x add-yz))
            (list
             'equal
             (putnam-1999-b2-operation-term mul mul-xy z)
             (putnam-1999-b2-operation-term mul x mul-yz))
            (list
             'equal
             add-xy
             (putnam-1999-b2-operation-term add y x))
            (list
             'equal
             mul-xy
             (putnam-1999-b2-operation-term mul y x))
            (list
             'equal
             (putnam-1999-b2-operation-term add x qzero)
             x)
            (list
             'equal
             (putnam-1999-b2-operation-term add x neg-x)
             qzero)
            (list
             'equal
             (putnam-1999-b2-operation-term mul x qone)
             x)
            (putnam-1999-b2-implies-term
             (list 'equal x qzero)
             (list 'equal inv-x qzero))
            (putnam-1999-b2-implies-term
             (putnam-1999-b2-not-term
              (list 'equal x qzero))
             (list
              'equal
              (putnam-1999-b2-operation-term mul x inv-x)
              qone))
            (list
             'equal
             (putnam-1999-b2-operation-term mul x add-yz)
             (putnam-1999-b2-operation-term
              add
              (putnam-1999-b2-operation-term mul x y)
              (putnam-1999-b2-operation-term mul x z)))))))
    (list
     'lambda
     '(x y z)
     (putnam-1999-b2-implies-term domain laws))))

(defun putnam-1999-b2-natural-embedding-laws-function
    (carrier zero one add natural-embedding)
  (let* ((n 'n)
         (qzero (putnam-1999-b2-quoted zero))
         (qone (putnam-1999-b2-quoted one))
         (embedded-n
          (putnam-1999-b2-apply1-term natural-embedding n))
         (embedded-next
          (putnam-1999-b2-apply1-term
           natural-embedding
           (list 'binary-+ n (putnam-1999-b2-quoted 1))))
         (successor-law
          (list
           'equal
           embedded-next
           (putnam-1999-b2-operation-term
            add embedded-n qone)))
         (positive-n
          (list '< (putnam-1999-b2-quoted 0) n))
         (laws
          (putnam-1999-b2-and-term
           (list
            (list
             'equal
             (putnam-1999-b2-apply1-term
              natural-embedding
              (putnam-1999-b2-quoted 0))
             qzero)
            (putnam-1999-b2-implies-term
             (list 'natp n)
             (putnam-1999-b2-and-term
              (list
               (putnam-1999-b2-carrier-term
                carrier embedded-n)
               successor-law
               (putnam-1999-b2-implies-term
                positive-n
                (putnam-1999-b2-not-term
                 (list 'equal embedded-n qzero))))))))))
    (list 'lambda '(n) laws)))

(defun putnam-1999-b2-evaluation-laws-function
    (carrier zero add mul evaluate)
  (let* ((coefficient 'coefficient)
         (rest 'rest)
         (x 'x)
         (qzero (putnam-1999-b2-quoted zero))
         (domain
          (putnam-1999-b2-and-term
           (list
            (putnam-1999-b2-carrier-term
             carrier coefficient)
            (list 'true-listp rest)
            (putnam-1999-b2-all-coefficients-term
             carrier rest)
            (putnam-1999-b2-carrier-term carrier x))))
         (empty-law
          (putnam-1999-b2-implies-term
           (putnam-1999-b2-carrier-term carrier x)
           (list
            'equal
            (putnam-1999-b2-operation-term
             evaluate
             (putnam-1999-b2-quoted nil)
             x)
            qzero)))
         (recursive-value
          (putnam-1999-b2-operation-term
           add
           coefficient
           (putnam-1999-b2-operation-term
            mul
            x
            (putnam-1999-b2-operation-term
             evaluate rest x))))
         (recursive-law
          (putnam-1999-b2-implies-term
           domain
           (putnam-1999-b2-and-term
            (list
             (putnam-1999-b2-carrier-term
              carrier
              (putnam-1999-b2-operation-term
               evaluate
               (list 'cons coefficient rest)
               x))
             (list
              'equal
              (putnam-1999-b2-operation-term
               evaluate
               (list 'cons coefficient rest)

title: putnam_1999_b2
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1999_b2
-- (putnambench__agda__putnam_1999_b2): a complex polynomial satisfying
-- P(x) = Q(x)P''(x) for quadratic Q has degree-many distinct roots if it has
-- two distinct roots. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; _*_)

infix 4 _!=_ _<=N_ _<N_
infixr 3 _and_
infixr 2 _or_

data Bottom : Set where

Not : Set -> Set
Not A =
  A -> Bottom

_!=_ : {A : Set} -> A -> A -> Set
x != y =
  Not (x == y)

record _and_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data _or_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  left  : A -> A or B
  right : B -> A or B

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

data _<=N_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set where
  zero<=N   : {n : Nat} -> zero <=N n
  suc<=sucN : {m n : Nat} -> m <=N n -> suc m <=N suc n

_<N_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set
m <N n =
  suc m <=N n

data Fin : Nat -> Set where
  fzero : {n : Nat} -> Fin (suc n)
  fsuc  : {n : Nat} -> Fin n -> Fin (suc n)

finToNat : {n : Nat} -> Fin n -> Nat
finToNat fzero =
  zero
finToNat (fsuc i) =
  suc (finToNat i)

twoN : Nat
twoN =
  suc (suc zero)

record CompleteOrderedRealField (R : Set) : Set1 where
  field
    zeroR oneR : R
    add multiply : R -> R -> R
    negate inverse : R -> R
    lessOrEqual : R -> R -> Set
    fromNat : Nat -> R

    one-not-zero :
      oneR != zeroR

    add-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> add x y == add y x
    add-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      add (add x y) z == add x (add y z)
    add-zero :
      (x : R) -> add x zeroR == x
    add-inverse :
      (x : R) -> add x (negate x) == zeroR

    multiply-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> multiply x y == multiply y x
    multiply-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply (multiply x y) z ==
      multiply x (multiply y z)
    multiply-one :
      (x : R) -> multiply x oneR == x
    multiply-zero :
      (x : R) -> multiply x zeroR == zeroR
    distribute :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply x (add y z) ==
      add (multiply x y) (multiply x z)
    inverse-zero :
      inverse zeroR == zeroR
    multiply-inverse :
      (x : R) ->
      x != zeroR ->
      multiply x (inverse x) == oneR

    order-reflexive :
      (x : R) -> lessOrEqual x x
    order-transitive :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y z ->
      lessOrEqual x z
    order-antisymmetric :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y x ->
      x == y
    order-total :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y or lessOrEqual y x
    add-order :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual (add z x) (add z y)
    multiply-nonnegative :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR x ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR y ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR (multiply x y)
    zero-less-than-one :
      lessOrEqual zeroR oneR and zeroR != oneR

    fromNat-zero :
      fromNat zero == zeroR
    fromNat-successor :
      (n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (suc n) == add (fromNat n) oneR
    fromNat-addition :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m + n) == add (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-multiplication :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m * n) == multiply (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-injective :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat m == fromNat n ->
      m == n

    archimedean :
      (x : R) ->
      Exists Nat
        (\ n -> lessOrEqual x (fromNat n))
    least-upper-bound :
      (P : R -> Set) ->
      Exists R P ->
      Exists R
        (\ upper ->
          (x : R) ->
          P x ->
          lessOrEqual x upper) ->
      Exists R
        (\ supremum ->
          ((x : R) ->
            P x ->
            lessOrEqual x supremum)
          and
          ((upper : R) ->
            ((x : R) ->
              P x ->
              lessOrEqual x upper) ->
            lessOrEqual supremum upper))

open CompleteOrderedRealField

record Complex (R : Set) : Set where
  constructor complex
  field
    realPart      : R
    imaginaryPart : R

open Complex

complexZero :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Complex R
complexZero reals =
  complex (zeroR reals) (zeroR reals)

complexAdd :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Complex R ->
  Complex R ->
  Complex R
complexAdd reals z w =
  complex
    (add reals (realPart z) (realPart w))
    (add reals (imaginaryPart z) (imaginaryPart w))

complexMultiply :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Complex R ->
  Complex R ->
  Complex R
complexMultiply reals z w =
  complex
    (add reals
      (multiply reals (realPart z) (realPart w))
      (negate reals
        (multiply reals (imaginaryPart z) (imaginaryPart w))))
    (add reals
      (multiply reals (realPart z) (imaginaryPart w))
      (multiply reals (imaginaryPart z) (realPart w)))

complexOne :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Complex R
complexOne reals =
  complex (oneR reals) (zeroR reals)

complexFromNat :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Nat ->
  Complex R
complexFromNat reals n =
  complex (fromNat reals n) (zeroR reals)

complexPower :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Complex R ->
  Nat ->
  Complex R
complexPower reals z zero =
  complexOne reals
complexPower reals z (suc n) =
  complexMultiply reals (complexPower reals z n) z

sumFinComplex :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  {n : Nat} ->
  (Fin n -> Complex R) ->
  Complex R
sumFinComplex reals {zero} terms =
  complexZero reals
sumFinComplex reals {suc n} terms =
  complexAdd reals
    (terms fzero)
    (sumFinComplex reals (\ i -> terms (fsuc i)))

record Polynomial
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) : Set where
  field
    coefficient : Nat -> Complex R
    degree      : Nat

    higher-coefficients-zero :
      (k : Nat) ->
      degree <N k ->
      coefficient k == complexZero reals

    leading-or-zero :
      coefficient degree != complexZero reals
      or
      (((k : Nat) ->
        coefficient k == complexZero reals)
      and
      degree == zero)

open Polynomial

polynomialValue :
  {R : Set} ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) ->
  Polynomial reals ->
  Complex R ->
  Complex R
polynomialValue reals polynomial z =
  sumFinComplex reals
    {suc (degree polynomial)}
    (\ i ->
      complexMultiply reals
        (coefficient polynomial (finToNat i))
        (complexPower reals z (finToNat i)))

secondDerivativeValue :
  {R : Set} ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) ->
  Polynomial reals ->
  Complex R ->
  Complex R
secondDerivativeValue reals polynomial z =
  sumFinComplex reals
    {suc (degree polynomial)}
    (\ i ->
      let n = finToNat i
      in
      complexMultiply reals
        (complexFromNat reals
          ((suc n) * (suc (suc n))))
        (complexMultiply reals
          (coefficient polynomial (suc (suc n)))
          (complexPower reals z n)))

module Putnam1999B2Statement
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) where

  Quadratic :
    Polynomial reals ->
    Set
  Quadratic Q =
    degree Q == twoN

  PolynomialEquation :
    Polynomial reals ->
    Polynomial reals ->
    Set
  PolynomialEquation P Q =
    (x : Complex R) ->
    polynomialValue reals P x ==
    complexMultiply reals
      (polynomialValue reals Q x)
      (secondDerivativeValue reals P x)

  IsRoot :
    Polynomial reals ->
    Complex R ->
    Set
  IsRoot P z =
    polynomialValue reals P z == complexZero reals

  HasTwoDistinctRoots :
    Polynomial reals ->
    Set
  HasTwoDistinctRoots P =
    Exists (Complex R)
      (\ x1 ->
        Exists (Complex R)
          (\ x2 ->
            x1 != x2
            and
            IsRoot P x1
            and
            IsRoot P x2))

  HasDegreeManyDistinctRoots :
    Polynomial reals ->
    Set
  HasDegreeManyDistinctRoots P =
    Exists (Fin (degree P) -> Complex R)
      (\ roots ->
        ((i j : Fin (degree P)) ->
          i != j ->
          roots i != roots j)
        and
        ((i : Fin (degree P)) ->
          IsRoot P (roots i)))

  proposition : Set
  proposition =
    (P Q : Polynomial reals) ->
    Quadratic Q ->
    PolynomialEquation P Q ->
    HasTwoDistinctRoots P ->
    HasDegreeManyDistinctRoots P

putnam-1999-b2 : Set1
putnam-1999-b2 =
  (R : Set) ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) ->
  Putnam1999B2Statement.proposition reals

title: putnam_1999_b2
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1999_b2:
  a complex polynomial satisfying P(x) = Q(x) P''(x) for a quadratic Q has
  degree-many distinct roots if it has two distinct roots. This file contains
  no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open arithmeticTheory pred_setTheory complexTheory monoidTheory ringTheory;
open polynomialTheory polyDerivativeTheory;

val putnam_1999_b2 =
  ``let cr : complex ring =
      <| carrier := UNIV;
         sum := <| carrier := UNIV; id := 0; op := complex_add |>;
         prod := <| carrier := UNIV; id := 1; op := complex_mul |> |>
    in
      !P Q : complex poly.
        Poly cr P /\
        Poly cr Q /\
        poly_deg cr Q = 2 /\
        (!x : complex.
           poly_eval cr P x =
             poly_eval cr Q x *
             poly_eval cr (poly_diff cr (poly_diff cr P)) x)
        ==>
        ((?x1 x2 : complex.
            x1 <> x2 /\
            poly_eval cr P x1 = 0 /\
            poly_eval cr P x2 = 0)
         ==>
         ?f : num -> complex.
           INJ f (count (poly_deg cr P)) UNIV /\
           !i : num.
             i < poly_deg cr P
             ==>
             poly_eval cr P (f i) = 0)``;

title: putnam_1999_b2
content:
$(
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact
  putnam_1999_b2: a complex polynomial P satisfying P(x) = Q(x) P''(x)
  for a quadratic complex polynomial Q has degree(P) distinct complex roots
  whenever P has two distinct complex roots. This file contains no proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  Poly ` CC is SetMM's set of complex polynomial functions, deg is their
  natural-valued polynomial degree (including the zero-polynomial convention),
  and ( ( CC Dn P ) ` 2 ) is the second complex derivative of P.

  The final existential set S has exactly deg(P) elements and consists only
  of roots of P. This is equivalent to the injective Fin-indexed family and
  duplicate-free sequence formulations in the other corpus languages.
  The declaration below is an unproved $a statement; there is no $p proof
  declaration in this file.
$)

${
  $d P Q S x y z $.

  putnambench-putnam-1999-b2 $a |-
    A. P e. ( Poly ` CC )
      A. Q e. ( Poly ` CC )
        (
          (
            ( deg ` Q ) = 2
            /\
            A. z e. CC
              ( P ` z )
              =
              (
                ( Q ` z )
                x.
                ( ( ( CC Dn P ) ` 2 ) ` z )
              )
          )
          ->
          (
            (
              E. x e. CC
                E. y e. CC
                  (
                    x =/= y
                    /\
                    (
                      ( P ` x ) = 0
                      /\
                      ( P ` y ) = 0
                    )
                  )
            )
            ->
            E. S e. ~P CC
              (
                ( # ` S ) = ( deg ` P )
                /\
                A. z e. S ( P ` z ) = 0
              )
          )
        )
  $.
$}

title: putnam_1999_b2
content:
% Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench artifact putnam_1999_b2:
% a complex polynomial satisfying P(x) = Q(x)P''(x) for a quadratic Q has
% degree-many distinct roots if it has two distinct roots. This file contains
% no proof.

putnam_1999_b2: THEORY
BEGIN
  complex: TYPE = [# real_part: real, imag_part: real #]
  coefficient_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> complex]
  complex_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> complex]

  complex_zero: complex =
    (# real_part := 0, imag_part := 0 #)

  complex_one: complex =
    (# real_part := 1, imag_part := 0 #)

  complex_add(x, y: complex): complex =
    (# real_part := real_part(x) + real_part(y),
       imag_part := imag_part(x) + imag_part(y) #)

  complex_mul(x, y: complex): complex =
    (# real_part := real_part(x) * real_part(y)
                       - imag_part(x) * imag_part(y),
       imag_part := real_part(x) * imag_part(y)
                       + imag_part(x) * real_part(y) #)

  complex_nat_mul(multiplier: nat, z: complex): complex =
    (# real_part := multiplier * real_part(z),
       imag_part := multiplier * imag_part(z) #)

  complex_power(z: complex, exponent: nat): RECURSIVE complex =
    IF exponent = 0 THEN
      complex_one
    ELSE
      complex_mul(complex_power(z, exponent - 1), z)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE exponent

  polynomial_value(
      coefficients: coefficient_sequence,
      z: complex,
      count: nat): RECURSIVE complex =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      complex_zero
    ELSE
      LET k: nat = count - 1 IN
        complex_add(
          polynomial_value(coefficients, z, count - 1),
          complex_mul(coefficients(k), complex_power(z, k)))
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  second_derivative_value(
      coefficients: coefficient_sequence,
      z: complex,
      count: nat): RECURSIVE complex =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      complex_zero
    ELSE
      LET k: nat = count - 1 IN
        complex_add(
          second_derivative_value(coefficients, z, count - 1),
          complex_mul(
            complex_nat_mul(
              (k + 2) * (k + 1),
              coefficients(k + 2)),
            complex_power(z, k)))
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  zero_polynomial(coefficients: coefficient_sequence): bool =
    FORALL (k: nat): coefficients(k) = complex_zero

  canonical_polynomial(
      coefficients: coefficient_sequence,
      degree: nat): bool =
    (degree = 0 AND zero_polynomial(coefficients))
      OR
    (coefficients(degree) /= complex_zero
      AND FORALL (k: nat):
        degree < k IMPLIES coefficients(k) = complex_zero)

  has_degree_many_distinct_roots(
      coefficients: coefficient_sequence,
      degree: nat): bool =
    EXISTS (roots: complex_sequence):
      (FORALL (i, j: nat):
        (i < degree AND j < degree AND i /= j)
          IMPLIES roots(i) /= roots(j))
      AND
      (FORALL (i: nat):
        i < degree IMPLIES
          polynomial_value(coefficients, roots(i), degree + 1)
            = complex_zero)

  putnam_1999_b2: bool =
    FORALL (P, Q: coefficient_sequence), (degree: nat):
      (canonical_polynomial(P, degree)
        AND canonical_polynomial(Q, 2)
        AND (FORALL (z: complex):
          polynomial_value(P, z, degree + 1)
            = complex_mul(
                polynomial_value(Q, z, 3),
                second_derivative_value(P, z, degree + 1))))
      IMPLIES
        ((EXISTS (x1, x2: complex):
          x1 /= x2
            AND polynomial_value(P, x1, degree + 1) = complex_zero
            AND polynomial_value(P, x2, degree + 1) = complex_zero)
          IMPLIES has_degree_many_distinct_roots(P, degree))
END putnam_1999_b2

title: putnam_1999_b3
content:
import Mathlib

open Filter Topology Metric

abbrev putnam_1999_b3_solution : ℝ := sorry
-- 3
/--
Let $A=\{(x,y):0\leq x,y<1\}$.  For $(x,y)\in A$, let \[S(x,y) = \sum_{\frac{1}{2}\leq \frac{m}{n}\leq 2} x^m y^n,\] where the sum ranges over all pairs $(m,n)$ of positive integers satisfying the indicated inequalities.  Evaluate \[\lim_{(x,y)\rightarrow (1,1), (x,y)\in A} (1-xy^2)(1-x^2y)S(x,y).\]
-/
theorem putnam_1999_b3
(A : Set (ℝ × ℝ))
(hA : A = {xy | 0 ≤ xy.1 ∧ xy.1 < 1 ∧ 0 ≤ xy.2 ∧ xy.2 < 1})
(S : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ)
(hS : S = fun x y => ∑' m : ℕ, ∑' n : ℕ, if (m > 0 ∧ n > 0 ∧ (1 : ℝ)/2 ≤ (m : ℝ)/n ∧ (m : ℝ)/n ≤ 2) then x^m * y^n else 0)
: Tendsto (fun xy : (ℝ × ℝ) => (1 - xy.1 * xy.2^2) * (1 - xy.1^2 * xy.2) * (S xy.1 xy.2)) (𝓝[A] ⟨1,1⟩) (𝓝 putnam_1999_b3_solution) :=
sorry

content:
(* Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1999_b3:
   evaluation of a restricted two-variable limit involving a doubly infinite
   power series over positive integer pairs; this file contains no proof. *)

From Stdlib Require Import Reals SeqSeries ClassicalEpsilon.

Open Scope R_scope.

Definition putnam_1999_b3_solution : R := 3.

Definition putnam_1999_b3_term
    (x y : R) (m n : nat) : R :=
  if Nat.eq_dec m O then 0
  else if Nat.eq_dec n O then 0
  else if Rle_dec (1 / 2) (INR m / INR n) then
    if Rle_dec (INR m / INR n) 2 then
      x ^ m * y ^ n
    else 0
  else 0.

Definition putnam_1999_b3_series_value (f : nat -> R) : R :=
  epsilon (inhabits (0 : R))
    (fun value : R => infinite_sum f value).

Definition putnam_1999_b3_series (x y : R) : R :=
  putnam_1999_b3_series_value
    (fun m : nat =>
      putnam_1999_b3_series_value
        (fun n : nat => putnam_1999_b3_term x y m n)).

Definition putnam_1999_b3_restricted_limit
    (A : (R * R)%type -> Prop)
    (f : (R * R)%type -> R)
    (l : R) : Prop :=
  forall eps : R,
    0 < eps ->
    exists delta : R,
      0 < delta /\
      forall xy : (R * R)%type,
        A xy ->
        sqrt ((fst xy - 1) ^ 2 + (snd xy - 1) ^ 2) < delta ->
        Rabs (f xy - l) < eps.

Theorem putnam_1999_b3
    (A : (R * R)%type -> Prop)
    (S : R -> R -> R)
    (hA : A =
      fun xy : (R * R)%type =>
        0 <= fst xy /\ fst xy < 1 /\
        0 <= snd xy /\ snd xy < 1)
    (hS : S = putnam_1999_b3_series) :
  putnam_1999_b3_restricted_limit A
    (fun xy : (R * R)%type =>
      (1 - fst xy * (snd xy) ^ 2) *
      (1 - (fst xy) ^ 2 * snd xy) *
      S (fst xy) (snd xy))
    putnam_1999_b3_solution.
Admitted.

begin

definition putnam_1999_b3_solution :: real where
  "putnam_1999_b3_solution \<equiv> 3"
(* 3 *)
theorem putnam_1999_b3:
  fixes A :: "(real \<times> real) set"
  and S :: "real \<Rightarrow> real \<Rightarrow> real"
  defines "A \<equiv> {xy :: real \<times> real. 0 \<le> (fst xy) \<and> (fst xy) < 1 \<and> 0 \<le> (snd xy) \<and> (snd xy) < 1}"
  and "S \<equiv> \<lambda>x y. \<Sum>m :: nat. \<Sum>n :: nat.
    (if m > 0 \<and> n > 0 \<and>
      (1::real) / 2 \<le> real m / real n \<and> real m / real n \<le> 2
     then x ^ m * y ^ n else 0)"
  shows "filterlim (\<lambda> xy :: real \<times> real. (1 - (fst xy) * (snd xy) ^ 2) * (1 - (fst xy) ^ 2 * (snd xy)) * (S (fst xy) (snd xy))) (nhds putnam_1999_b3_solution) (at (1, 1) within A)"
  sorry

end

(*
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1999_b3:
  evaluation of a two-variable limit involving a double power series over
  positive integer pairs whose ratio lies between one half and two. This file
  contains no proof.
*)

let analysis_output = open_out "/dev/null";;
let analysis_formatter = Format.formatter_of_out_channel analysis_output;;
let analysis_loaded =
  Toploop.use_file analysis_formatter "Library/analysis.ml";;
Format.pp_print_flush analysis_formatter ();;
close_out analysis_output;;
if not analysis_loaded then failwith "failed to load Library/analysis.ml";;

let statement =
  `let A =
     \(xy:real#real).
       &0 <= FST xy /\ FST xy < &1 /\
       &0 <= SND xy /\ SND xy < &1 in
   let S =
     \x y:real.
       suminf
         (\m:num.
            suminf
              (\n:num.
                 if 0 < m /\ 0 < n /\
                    &1 / &2 <= &m / &n /\ &m / &n <= &2
                 then x pow m * y pow n
                 else &0)) in
   let tends_within_A =
     \(f:real#real->real) (l:real).
       !e:real.
         &0 < e
         ==> ?d:real.
               &0 < d /\
               !xy:real#real.
                 A xy /\
                 &0 <
                   max (abs (FST xy - &1)) (abs (SND xy - &1)) /\
                 max (abs (FST xy - &1)) (abs (SND xy - &1)) < d
                 ==> abs (f xy - l) < e in
   let putnam_1999_b3_solution = &3 in
   tends_within_A
     (\xy:real#real.
        (&1 - FST xy * (SND xy) pow 2) *
        (&1 - (FST xy) pow 2 * SND xy) *
        S (FST xy) (SND xy))
     putnam_1999_b3_solution`;;

title: putnam_1999_b3
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1999_b3:
;; the two-variable boundary limit of an iterated real power series over
;; positive integer pairs whose coordinate ratio lies between 1/2 and 2.
;; This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))

;; A Dedekind-complete ordered field presents the real numbers up to their
;; unique ordered-field isomorphism. Tame APPLY$ function objects retain the
;; arbitrary real-valued function S and arbitrary subsets used by
;; completeness; DEFUN-SK supplies all unbounded quantifiers.

(defun p99b3-member-p (carrier x)
  (if (apply$ carrier (list x)) t nil))

(defun p99b3-unary-value (operation x)
  (apply$ operation (list x)))

(defun p99b3-binary-value (operation x y)
  (apply$ operation (list x y)))

(defun-sk p99b3-valid-set-p (carrier set)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (apply$ set (list x))
     (p99b3-member-p carrier x))))

(defun-sk p99b3-field-laws-p
    (carrier add multiply negate inverse zero one)
  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (p99b3-member-p carrier x)
      (p99b3-member-p carrier y)
      (p99b3-member-p carrier z))
     (and
      (p99b3-member-p carrier
                      (p99b3-binary-value add x y))
      (p99b3-member-p carrier
                      (p99b3-binary-value multiply x y))
      (p99b3-member-p carrier
                      (p99b3-unary-value negate x))
      (p99b3-member-p carrier
                      (p99b3-unary-value inverse x))
      (equal
       (p99b3-binary-value
        add (p99b3-binary-value add x y) z)
       (p99b3-binary-value
        add x (p99b3-binary-value add y z)))
      (equal
       (p99b3-binary-value add x y)
       (p99b3-binary-value add y x))
      (equal (p99b3-binary-value add x zero) x)
      (equal
       (p99b3-binary-value
        add x (p99b3-unary-value negate x))
       zero)
      (equal
       (p99b3-binary-value
        multiply (p99b3-binary-value multiply x y) z)
       (p99b3-binary-value
        multiply x (p99b3-binary-value multiply y z)))
      (equal
       (p99b3-binary-value multiply x y)
       (p99b3-binary-value multiply y x))
      (equal (p99b3-binary-value multiply x one) x)
      (implies
       (equal x zero)
       (equal (p99b3-unary-value inverse x) zero))
      (implies
       (not (equal x zero))
       (equal
        (p99b3-binary-value
         multiply x (p99b3-unary-value inverse x))
        one))
      (equal
       (p99b3-binary-value
        multiply x (p99b3-binary-value add y z))
       (p99b3-binary-value
        add
        (p99b3-binary-value multiply x y)
        (p99b3-binary-value multiply x z)))))))

(defun-sk p99b3-order-laws-p
    (carrier add multiply zero less)
  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (p99b3-member-p carrier x)
      (p99b3-member-p carrier y)
      (p99b3-member-p carrier z))
     (and
      (not (p99b3-binary-value less x x))
      (or
       (equal x y)
       (p99b3-binary-value less x y)
       (p99b3-binary-value less y x))
      (implies
       (and
        (p99b3-binary-value less x y)
        (p99b3-binary-value less y z))
       (p99b3-binary-value less x z))
      (implies
       (p99b3-binary-value less x y)
       (p99b3-binary-value
        less
        (p99b3-binary-value add x z)
        (p99b3-binary-value add y z)))
      (implies
       (and
        (p99b3-binary-value less zero x)
        (p99b3-binary-value less zero y))
       (p99b3-binary-value
        less
        zero
        (p99b3-binary-value multiply x y)))))))

(defun-sk p99b3-set-nonempty-p (carrier set)
  (exists (x)
    (and
     (p99b3-member-p carrier x)
     (apply$ set (list x)))))

(defun-sk p99b3-upper-bound-p
    (carrier less set bound)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (and
      (p99b3-member-p carrier x)
      (apply$ set (list x)))
     (not (p99b3-binary-value less bound x)))))

(defun-sk p99b3-bounded-above-p
    (carrier less set)
  (exists (bound)
    (and
     (p99b3-member-p carrier bound)
     (p99b3-upper-bound-p
      carrier less set bound))))

(defun-sk p99b3-least-upper-bound-p
    (carrier less set supremum)
  (forall (bound)
    (implies
     (and
      (p99b3-member-p carrier bound)
      (p99b3-upper-bound-p carrier less set bound))
     (not
      (p99b3-binary-value less bound supremum)))))

(defun p99b3-supremum-p
    (carrier less set supremum)
  (and
   (p99b3-member-p carrier supremum)
   (p99b3-upper-bound-p carrier less set supremum)
   (p99b3-least-upper-bound-p
    carrier less set supremum)))

(defun-sk p99b3-has-supremum-p
    (carrier less set)
  (exists (supremum)
    (p99b3-supremum-p
     carrier less set supremum)))

(defun-sk p99b3-dedekind-complete-p
    (carrier less)
  (forall (set)
    (implies
     (and
      (tamep-functionp set)
      (p99b3-valid-set-p carrier set)
      (p99b3-set-nonempty-p carrier set)
      (p99b3-bounded-above-p carrier less set))
     (p99b3-has-supremum-p
      carrier less set))))

(defun p99b3-real-field-p
    (carrier zero one add multiply negate inverse less)
  (and
   (tamep-functionp carrier)
   (tamep-functionp add)
   (tamep-functionp multiply)
   (tamep-functionp negate)
   (tamep-functionp inverse)
   (tamep-functionp less)
   (p99b3-member-p carrier zero)
   (p99b3-member-p carrier one)
   (not (equal zero one))
   (p99b3-field-laws-p
    carrier add multiply negate inverse zero one)
   (p99b3-order-laws-p
    carrier add multiply zero less)
   (p99b3-binary-value less zero one)
   (p99b3-dedekind-complete-p carrier less)))

;; The context is
;; (carrier zero one add multiply negate inverse less).

(defun p99b3-r-carrier (ctx) (nth 0 ctx))
(defun p99b3-r-zero (ctx) (nth 1 ctx))
(defun p99b3-r-one (ctx) (nth 2 ctx))
(defun p99b3-r-add (ctx) (nth 3 ctx))
(defun p99b3-r-mul (ctx) (nth 4 ctx))
(defun p99b3-r-neg (ctx) (nth 5 ctx))
(defun p99b3-r-inv (ctx) (nth 6 ctx))
(defun p99b3-r-lt (ctx) (nth 7 ctx))

(defun p99b3-context-p (ctx)
  (and
   (true-listp ctx)
   (equal (len ctx) 8)
   (p99b3-real-field-p
    (p99b3-r-carrier ctx)
    (p99b3-r-zero ctx)
    (p99b3-r-one ctx)
    (p99b3-r-add ctx)
    (p99b3-r-mul ctx)
    (p99b3-r-neg ctx)
    (p99b3-r-inv ctx)
    (p99b3-r-lt ctx))))

(defun p99b3-r-add-value (ctx x y)
  (p99b3-binary-value (p99b3-r-add ctx) x y))

(defun p99b3-r-mul-value (ctx x y)
  (p99b3-binary-value (p99b3-r-mul ctx) x y))

(defun p99b3-r-neg-value (ctx x)
  (p99b3-unary-value (p99b3-r-neg ctx) x))

(defun p99b3-r-sub-value (ctx x y)
  (p99b3-r-add-value
   ctx x (p99b3-r-neg-value ctx y)))

(defun p99b3-r-lt-p (ctx x y)
  (if (p99b3-binary-value (p99b3-r-lt ctx) x y)
      t nil))

(defun p99b3-r-le-p (ctx x y)
  (not (p99b3-r-lt-p ctx y x)))

(defun p99b3-r-abs-value (ctx x)
  (if (p99b3-r-lt-p ctx x (p99b3-r-zero ctx))
      (p99b3-r-neg-value ctx x)
    x))

(defun p99b3-positive-real-p (ctx x)
  (and
   (p99b3-member-p (p99b3-r-carrier ctx) x)
   (p99b3-r-lt-p ctx (p99b3-r-zero ctx) x)))

(defun p99b3-three (ctx)
  (p99b3-r-add-value
   ctx
   (p99b3-r-one ctx)
   (p99b3-r-add-value
    ctx
    (p99b3-r-one ctx)
    (p99b3-r-one ctx))))

(defun p99b3-r-power (ctx base exponent)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix exponent)))
  (if (zp exponent)
      (p99b3-r-one ctx)
    (p99b3-r-mul-value
     ctx
     base
     (p99b3-r-power ctx base (1- exponent)))))

;; For positive M and N, N <= 2*M and M <= 2*N are exactly the source
;; inequalities 1/2 <= M/N <= 2.

(defun p99b3-wedge-p (m n)
  (and
   (posp m)
   (posp n)
   (<= n (* 2 m))
   (<= m (* 2 n))))

(defun p99b3-term (ctx x y m n)
  (if (p99b3-wedge-p m n)
      (p99b3-r-mul-value
       ctx
       (p99b3-r-power ctx x m)
       (p99b3-r-power ctx y n))
    (p99b3-r-zero ctx)))

(defun p99b3-row-prefix (ctx x y m count)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix count)))
  (if (zp count)
      (p99b3-r-zero ctx)
    (p99b3-r-add-value
     ctx
     (p99b3-row-prefix ctx x y m (1- count))
     (p99b3-term ctx x y m count))))

(defun-sk p99b3-row-convergence-tail-p
    (ctx x y m limit epsilon cutoff)
  (forall (count)
    (implies
     (and
      (natp count)
      (<= cutoff count))
     (p99b3-r-lt-p
      ctx
      (p99b3-r-abs-value
       ctx
       (p99b3-r-sub-value
        ctx
        (p99b3-row-prefix ctx x y m count)
        limit))
      epsilon))))

(defun-sk p99b3-row-cutoff-exists-p
    (ctx x y m limit epsilon)
  (exists (cutoff)
    (and
     (natp cutoff)
     (p99b3-row-convergence-tail-p
      ctx x y m limit epsilon cutoff))))

(defun-sk p99b3-row-sums-to-p
    (ctx x y m limit)
  (forall (epsilon)
    (implies
     (p99b3-positive-real-p ctx epsilon)
     (p99b3-row-cutoff-exists-p
      ctx x y m limit epsilon))))

(defun-sk p99b3-row-summable-p
    (ctx x y m)
  (exists (limit)
    (and
     (p99b3-member-p (p99b3-r-carrier ctx) limit)
     (p99b3-row-sums-to-p
      ctx x y m limit))))

;; This is the standard totalized infinite-sum convention: a convergent row
;; has its unique limit, and a non-summable row has value zero.

(defun p99b3-row-tsum-p
    (ctx x y m value)
  (and
   (p99b3-member-p (p99b3-r-carrier ctx) value)
   (if (p99b3-row-summable-p ctx x y m)
       (p99b3-row-sums-to-p ctx x y m value)
     (equal value (p99b3-r-zero ctx)))))

(defun-sk p99b3-row-tsums-values-p
    (ctx x y row-tsums)
  (forall (m)
    (implies
     (natp m)
     (p99b3-row-tsum-p
      ctx x y m (apply$ row-tsums (list m))))))

(defun p99b3-row-tsums-function-p
    (ctx x y row-tsums)
  (and
   (tamep-functionp row-tsums)
   (p99b3-row-tsums-values-p
    ctx x y row-tsums)))

(defun p99b3-outer-prefix
    (ctx row-tsums count)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix count)))
  (if (zp count)
      (p99b3-r-zero ctx)
    (p99b3-r-add-value
     ctx
     (p99b3-outer-prefix
      ctx row-tsums (1- count))
     (apply$ row-tsums (list count)))))

(defun-sk p99b3-outer-convergence-tail-p
    (ctx row-tsums limit epsilon cutoff)
  (forall (count)
    (implies
     (and
      (natp count)
      (<= cutoff count))
     (p99b3-r-lt-p
      ctx
      (p99b3-r-abs-value
       ctx
       (p99b3-r-sub-value
        ctx
        (p99b3-outer-prefix ctx row-tsums count)
        limit))
      epsilon))))

(defun-sk p99b3-outer-cutoff-exists-p
    (ctx row-tsums limit epsilon)
  (exists (cutoff)
    (and
     (natp cutoff)
     (p99b3-outer-convergence-tail-p
      ctx row-tsums limit epsilon cutoff))))

(defun-sk p99b3-outer-sums-to-p
    (ctx row-tsums limit)
  (forall (epsilon)
    (implies
     (p99b3-positive-real-p ctx epsilon)
     (p99b3-outer-cutoff-exists-p
      ctx row-tsums limit epsilon))))

(defun-sk p99b3-outer-summable-p
    (ctx row-tsums)
  (exists (limit)
    (and
     (p99b3-member-p (p99b3-r-carrier ctx) limit)
     (p99b3-outer-sums-to-p
      ctx row-tsums limit))))

;; The existential row-tsums function keeps the inner-sum witnesses internal.
;; The outer totalization then represents exactly Sum_m (Sum_n term(m,n)).

(defun-sk p99b3-iterated-tsum-p
    (ctx x y total)
  (exists (row-tsums)
    (and
     (p99b3-row-tsums-function-p
      ctx x y row-tsums)
     (if (p99b3-outer-summable-p ctx row-tsums)
         (p99b3-outer-sums-to-p
          ctx row-tsums total)
       (equal total (p99b3-r-zero ctx))))))

(defun p99b3-series-value (series x y)
  (apply$ series (list x y)))

(defun-sk p99b3-series-definition-p
    (ctx series)
  (forall (x y)
    (implies
     (and
      (p99b3-member-p (p99b3-r-carrier ctx) x)
      (p99b3-member-p (p99b3-r-carrier ctx) y))
     (let ((value (p99b3-series-value series x y)))
       (and
        (p99b3-member-p
         (p99b3-r-carrier ctx) value)
        (p99b3-iterated-tsum-p
         ctx x y value))))))

(defun p99b3-in-source-domain-p (ctx x y)
  (and
   (p99b3-member-p (p99b3-r-carrier ctx) x)
   (p99b3-member-p (p99b3-r-carrier ctx) y)
   (p99b3-r-le-p ctx (p99b3-r-zero ctx) x)
   (p99b3-r-lt-p ctx x (p99b3-r-one ctx))
   (p99b3-r-le-p ctx (p99b3-r-zero ctx) y)
   (p99b3-r-lt-p ctx y (p99b3-r-one ctx))))

(defun p99b3-normalized-value
    (ctx series x y)
  (let* ((one (p99b3-r-one ctx))
         (x-y-squared
          (p99b3-r-mul-value
           ctx x (p99b3-r-power ctx y 2)))
         (x-squared-y
          (p99b3-r-mul-value
           ctx (p99b3-r-power ctx x 2) y)))
    (p99b3-r-mul-value
     ctx
     (p99b3-r-sub-value ctx one x-y-squared)
     (p99b3-r-mul-value
      ctx
      (p99b3-r-sub-value ctx one x-squared-y)
      (p99b3-series-value series x y)))))

;; Coordinatewise neighborhoods give the product topology on R x R, so this
;; epsilon-delta predicate is equivalent to the source filter limit within A.

(defun-sk p99b3-limit-neighborhood-p
    (ctx series epsilon delta)
  (forall (x y)
    (implies
     (and
      (p99b3-in-source-domain-p ctx x y)
      (p99b3-r-lt-p
       ctx
       (p99b3-r-abs-value
        ctx
        (p99b3-r-sub-value
         ctx x (p99b3-r-one ctx)))
       delta)
      (p99b3-r-lt-p
       ctx
       (p99b3-r-abs-value
        ctx
        (p99b3-r-sub-value
         ctx y (p99b3-r-one ctx)))
       delta))
     (p99b3-r-lt-p
      ctx
      (p99b3-r-abs-value
       ctx
       (p99b3-r-sub-value
        ctx
        (p99b3-normalized-value
         ctx series x y)
        (p99b3-three ctx)))
      epsilon))))

(defun-sk p99b3-limit-delta-exists-p
    (ctx series epsilon)
  (exists (delta)
    (and
     (p99b3-positive-real-p ctx delta)
     (p99b3-limit-neighborhood-p
      ctx series epsilon delta))))

(defun-sk p99b3-limit-is-three-p
    (ctx series)
  (forall (epsilon)
    (implies
     (p99b3-positive-real-p ctx epsilon)
     (p99b3-limit-delta-exists-p
      ctx series epsilon))))

(defun putnambench-putnam-1999-b3-statement
    (ctx series)
  (implies
   (and
    (p99b3-context-p ctx)
    (tamep-functionp series)
    (p99b3-series-definition-p ctx series))
   (p99b3-limit-is-three-p ctx series)))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

title: putnam_1999_b3
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1999_b3
-- (putnambench__agda__putnam_1999_b3): a two-variable limit involving an
-- iterated power series over positive integer pairs with bounded ratio is 3.
-- This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

open import Agda.Builtin.Bool using (Bool; true; false)
open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; _*_)

infix 4 _!=_ _<=N_
infixr 3 _and_
infixr 2 _or_

data Bottom : Set where

Not : Set -> Set
Not A =
  A -> Bottom

_!=_ : {A : Set} -> A -> A -> Set
x != y =
  Not (x == y)

record _and_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data _or_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  left  : A -> A or B
  right : B -> A or B

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

data _<=N_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set where
  zero<=N   : {n : Nat} -> zero <=N n
  suc<=sucN : {m n : Nat} -> m <=N n -> suc m <=N suc n

record CompleteOrderedRealField (R : Set) : Set1 where
  field
    zeroR oneR : R
    add multiply : R -> R -> R
    negate inverse : R -> R
    lessOrEqual : R -> R -> Set
    fromNat : Nat -> R

    one-not-zero :
      oneR != zeroR

    add-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> add x y == add y x
    add-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      add (add x y) z == add x (add y z)
    add-zero :
      (x : R) -> add x zeroR == x
    add-inverse :
      (x : R) -> add x (negate x) == zeroR

    multiply-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> multiply x y == multiply y x
    multiply-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply (multiply x y) z ==
      multiply x (multiply y z)
    multiply-one :
      (x : R) -> multiply x oneR == x
    multiply-zero :
      (x : R) -> multiply x zeroR == zeroR
    distribute :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply x (add y z) ==
      add (multiply x y) (multiply x z)
    inverse-zero :
      inverse zeroR == zeroR
    multiply-inverse :
      (x : R) ->
      x != zeroR ->
      multiply x (inverse x) == oneR

    order-reflexive :
      (x : R) -> lessOrEqual x x
    order-transitive :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y z ->
      lessOrEqual x z
    order-antisymmetric :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y x ->
      x == y
    order-total :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y or lessOrEqual y x
    add-order :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual (add z x) (add z y)
    multiply-nonnegative :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR x ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR y ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR (multiply x y)
    zero-less-than-one :
      lessOrEqual zeroR oneR and zeroR != oneR

    fromNat-zero :
      fromNat zero == zeroR
    fromNat-successor :
      (n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (suc n) == add (fromNat n) oneR
    fromNat-addition :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m + n) == add (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-multiplication :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m * n) == multiply (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-injective :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat m == fromNat n ->
      m == n

    archimedean :
      (x : R) ->
      Exists Nat
        (\ n ->
          lessOrEqual x (fromNat n))
    least-upper-bound :
      (P : R -> Set) ->
      Exists R P ->
      Exists R
        (\ upper ->
          (x : R) ->
          P x ->
          lessOrEqual x upper) ->
      Exists R
        (\ supremum ->
          ((x : R) ->
            P x ->
            lessOrEqual x supremum)
          and
          ((upper : R) ->
            ((x : R) ->
              P x ->
              lessOrEqual x upper) ->
            lessOrEqual supremum upper))

open CompleteOrderedRealField

oneN : Nat
oneN =
  suc zero

twoN : Nat
twoN =
  suc oneN

threeN : Nat
threeN =
  suc twoN

subtract :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
subtract reals x y =
  add reals x (negate reals y)

naturalPower :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  Nat ->
  R
naturalPower reals x zero =
  oneR reals
naturalPower reals x (suc n) =
  multiply reals
    (naturalPower reals x n)
    x

StrictLess :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
StrictLess reals x y =
  lessOrEqual reals x y and x != y

Positive :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  Set
Positive reals x =
  StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) x

CloseTo :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
CloseTo reals center radius x =
  StrictLess reals
    (subtract reals center radius)
    x
  and
  StrictLess reals
    x
    (add reals center radius)

lessEqualBool : Nat -> Nat -> Bool
lessEqualBool zero n =
  true
lessEqualBool (suc m) zero =
  false
lessEqualBool (suc m) (suc n) =
  lessEqualBool m n

andBool : Bool -> Bool -> Bool
andBool true b =
  b
andBool false b =
  false

ifBool :
  {A : Set} ->
  Bool ->
  A ->
  A ->
  A
ifBool true whenTrue whenFalse =
  whenTrue
ifBool false whenTrue whenFalse =
  whenFalse

admissibleIndex : Nat -> Nat -> Bool
admissibleIndex m n =
  andBool
    (lessEqualBool oneN m)
    (andBool
      (lessEqualBool oneN n)
      (andBool
        (lessEqualBool n (twoN * m))
        (lessEqualBool m (twoN * n))))

putnamTerm :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Nat ->
  Nat ->
  R
putnamTerm reals x y m n =
  ifBool
    (admissibleIndex m n)
    (multiply reals
      (naturalPower reals x m)
      (naturalPower reals y n))
    (zeroR reals)

sumFirst :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Nat ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  R
sumFirst reals zero terms =
  zeroR reals
sumFirst reals (suc n) terms =
  add reals
    (sumFirst reals n terms)
    (terms n)

ConvergesTo :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  R ->
  Set
ConvergesTo {R} reals sequence limit =
  (epsilon : R) ->
  Positive reals epsilon ->
  Exists Nat
    (\ cutoff ->
      (n : Nat) ->
      cutoff <=N n ->
      CloseTo reals limit epsilon (sequence n))

SeriesHasSum :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  R ->
  Set
SeriesHasSum reals terms total =
  ConvergesTo reals
    (\ n -> sumFirst reals n terms)
    total

TotalSeriesValue :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  R ->
  Set
TotalSeriesValue {R} reals terms value =
  SeriesHasSum reals terms value
  or
  (Not
    (Exists R
      (\ candidate ->
        SeriesHasSum reals terms candidate))
  and
  value == zeroR reals)

IteratedTotalSeriesValue :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (Nat -> Nat -> R) ->
  R ->
  Set
IteratedTotalSeriesValue {R} reals terms total =
  Exists (Nat -> R)
    (\ innerValues ->
      ((m : Nat) ->
        TotalSeriesValue reals
          (terms m)
          (innerValues m))
      and
      TotalSeriesValue reals innerValues total)

UnitSquare :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
UnitSquare reals x y =
  lessOrEqual reals (zeroR reals) x
  and
  StrictLess reals x (oneR reals)
  and
  lessOrEqual reals (zeroR reals) y
  and
  StrictLess reals y (oneR reals)

limitExpression :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (R -> R -> R) ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
limitExpression reals S x y =
  multiply reals
    (multiply reals
      (subtract reals
        (oneR reals)
        (multiply reals
          x
          (naturalPower reals y twoN)))
      (subtract reals
        (oneR reals)
        (multiply reals
          (naturalPower reals x twoN)
          y)))
    (S x y)

LimitWithinUnitSquare :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (R -> R -> R) ->
  R ->
  Set
LimitWithinUnitSquare {R} reals function limit =
  (epsilon : R) ->
  Positive reals epsilon ->
  Exists R
    (\ delta ->
      Positive reals delta
      and
      ((x y : R) ->
        UnitSquare reals x y ->
        CloseTo reals (oneR reals) delta x ->
        CloseTo reals (oneR reals) delta y ->
        CloseTo reals limit epsilon (function x y)))

putnam-1999-b3 : Set1
putnam-1999-b3 =
  (R : Set) ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) ->
  (S : R -> R -> R) ->
  ((x y : R) ->
    IteratedTotalSeriesValue reals
      (putnamTerm reals x y)
      (S x y)) ->
  LimitWithinUnitSquare reals
    (limitExpression reals S)
    (fromNat reals threeN)

title: putnam_1999_b3
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1999_b3:
  the two-variable limit at (1,1), within the half-open unit square, of a
  normalized double power series over positive integer pairs whose ratio lies
  between 1/2 and 2 is 3. This file contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open arithmeticTheory pairTheory pred_setTheory realTheory seqTheory
     transcTheory;

val putnam_1999_b3 =
  ``let A =
      {xy : real # real |
         0 <= FST xy /\ FST xy < 1 /\
         0 <= SND xy /\ SND xy < 1}
    in
    let S =
      \(x : real) (y : real).
        suminf
          (\m : num.
             suminf
               (\n : num.
                  if 0 < m /\ 0 < n /\
                     1 / 2 <= (&m : real) / &n /\
                     (&m : real) / &n <= 2
                  then x pow m * y pow n
                  else 0))
    in
    let dist =
      \xy : real # real.
        sqrt
          ((FST xy - 1) pow 2 +
           (SND xy - 1) pow 2)
    in
      !e : real.
        0 < e
        ==>
        ?d : real.
          0 < d /\
          !xy : real # real.
            xy IN A /\
            0 < dist xy /\
            dist xy < d
            ==>
            abs
              ((1 - FST xy * SND xy pow 2) *
               (1 - FST xy pow 2 * SND xy) *
               S (FST xy) (SND xy) -
               3) < e``;

title: putnam_1999_b3
content:
$(
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact
  putnam_1999_b3: a restricted two-variable real limit involving an
  iterated power series over positive index pairs. This file contains no
  proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  P99B3Series(x,y) is the source's iterated sum over
  nonnegative integer indices, with the summand set to zero unless both
  indices are positive and their real ratio lies between 1/2 and 2.

  The final assertion expands convergence within
  A = { (x,y) in RR X. RR | 0 <= x < 1 and 0 <= y < 1 } into an
  epsilon-delta condition. Coordinatewise open delta-neighborhoods form a
  neighborhood basis for the product topology on RR X. RR, so this is
  equivalent to the source Tendsto/filterlim statement.

  Every declaration is an unproved $a statement, and this database contains
  no $p proof statement.
$)

$c P99B3Series $.

p99b3-series-syntax $a class ( P99B3Series x y ) $.

${
  $d m n x y $.

  p99b3-series-definition $a |- (
    ( P99B3Series x y )
    =
    (
      sum_ m e. NN0
        (
          sum_ n e. NN0
            if (
              (
                ( 0 < m /\ 0 < n )
                /\
                (
                  ( 1 / 2 ) <_ ( m / n )
                  /\
                  ( m / n ) <_ 2
                )
              ) ,
              ( ( x ^ m ) x. ( y ^ n ) ) ,
              0
            )
        )
    )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d d e x y $.

  putnambench-putnam-1999-b3 $a |-
    A. e e. RR
      (
        0 < e
        ->
        E. d e. RR
          (
            0 < d
            /\
            A. x e. RR A. y e. RR
              (
                (
                  (
                    ( 0 <_ x /\ x < 1 )
                    /\
                    ( 0 <_ y /\ y < 1 )
                  )
                  /\
                  (
                    ( abs ` ( x - 1 ) ) < d
                    /\
                    ( abs ` ( y - 1 ) ) < d
                  )
                )
                ->
                (
                  abs
                  `
                  (
                    (
                      (
                        (
                          1
                          -
                          ( x x. ( y ^ 2 ) )
                        )
                        x.
                        (
                          1
                          -
                          ( ( x ^ 2 ) x. y )
                        )
                      )
                      x.
                      ( P99B3Series x y )
                    )
                    -
                    3
                  )
                )
                < e
              )
          )
      )
  $.
$}

title: putnam_1999_b3
content:
:: Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1999_b3:
:: the normalized iterated real power series over positive integer pairs with
:: ratio between one half and two has boundary limit 3 at (1,1) within the
:: half-open unit square. This file contains no proof.

environ
  vocabularies TARSKI, XBOOLE_0, SUBSET_1, RELAT_1, FUNCT_1, FUNCT_2,
    NUMBERS, XREAL_0, XCMPLX_0, COMPLEX1, CARD_1, XXREAL_0, ARYTM_1,
    ARYTM_3, REAL_1, NAT_1, ORDINAL1, VALUED_0, VALUED_1, NEWTON,
    PREPOWER, SEQ_1, SEQ_2, ORDINAL2, SEQ_4, SERIES_1, ZFMISC_1;
  notations TARSKI, XBOOLE_0, SUBSET_1, ZFMISC_1, XTUPLE_0, RELAT_1,
    FUNCT_1, RELSET_1, FUNCT_2, ORDINAL1, CARD_1, NUMBERS, XCMPLX_0,
    XREAL_0, REAL_1, COMPLEX1, XXREAL_0, NEWTON, NAT_1, SEQ_1, SEQ_2,
    COMSEQ_2, SEQM_3, SEQ_4, PREPOWER, SERIES_1;
  constructors FUNCT_1, RELSET_1, FUNCT_2, CARD_1, REAL_1, COMPLEX1,
    NEWTON, NAT_1, SEQ_2, SEQM_3, SEQ_4, PREPOWER, COMSEQ_2, SERIES_1,
    ZFMISC_1, XTUPLE_0, BINOP_2;
  registrations XBOOLE_0, SUBSET_1, RELAT_1, FUNCT_1, RELSET_1,
    FUNCT_2, NUMBERS, CARD_1, XXREAL_0, MEMBERED, VALUED_0, VALUED_1,
    XCMPLX_0, XREAL_0, ORDINAL1, NAT_1, NEWTON, PREPOWER, SEQ_4;
  requirements REAL, NUMERALS, SUBSET, BOOLE, ARITHM;

begin

::$P-
theorem
  for S being Function of [:REAL,REAL:],REAL st
    (for x,y being Real holds
      ex rows being Real_Sequence st
        (for m being Nat holds
          ex terms being Real_Sequence st
            (for n being Nat holds
              (0 < m & 0 < n &
                (1 qua Real) / 2 <=
                  (m qua Real) / (n qua Real) &
                (m qua Real) / (n qua Real) <= 2
              implies
                terms.n = (x |^ m) * (y |^ n)) &
              (not (0 < m & 0 < n &
                (1 qua Real) / 2 <=
                  (m qua Real) / (n qua Real) &
                (m qua Real) / (n qua Real) <= 2)
              implies terms.n = 0)) &
            ((Partial_Sums(terms) is convergent &
                rows.m = lim Partial_Sums(terms)) or
              (Partial_Sums(terms) is not convergent &
                rows.m = 0))) &
        ((Partial_Sums(rows) is convergent &
            S.([x,y]) = lim Partial_Sums(rows)) or
          (Partial_Sums(rows) is not convergent &
            S.([x,y]) = 0)))
  holds
    for epsilon being Real st 0 < epsilon holds
      ex delta being Real st
        0 < delta &
        for x,y being Real st
          0 <= x & x < 1 & 0 <= y & y < 1 &
          |.x - 1.| < delta & |.y - 1.| < delta
        holds
          |.(1 - x * (y |^ 2)) *
              (1 - (x |^ 2) * y) * S.([x,y]) - 3.| < epsilon
proof
end;
::$P+

title: putnam_1999_b3
content:
% Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1999_b3:
% the iterated positive-integer double power series in the sector
% 1/2 <= m/n <= 2 has the stated normalized limit as (x,y) approaches
% (1,1) within 0 <= x,y < 1. This file contains no proof.

putnam_1999_b3: THEORY
BEGIN
  real_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> real]

  safe_div(numerator, denominator: real): real =
    IF denominator = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      numerator / denominator
    ENDIF

  partial_sum(
      values: real_sequence,
      count: nat): RECURSIVE real =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      partial_sum(values, count - 1) + values(count - 1)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  series_sums_to(values: real_sequence, total: real): bool =
    FORALL (epsilon_value: posreal):
      EXISTS (cutoff: nat):
        FORALL (count: nat):
          cutoff <= count IMPLIES
            abs(partial_sum(values, count) - total) < epsilon_value

  series_value(values: real_sequence): real =
    IF EXISTS (total: real): series_sums_to(values, total) THEN
      epsilon(
        LAMBDA (total: real):
          series_sums_to(values, total))
    ELSE
      0
    ENDIF

  admissible_indices(m, n: nat): bool =
    m > 0
      AND n > 0
      AND safe_div(1, 2) <= safe_div(m :: real, n :: real)
      AND safe_div(m :: real, n :: real) <= 2

  series_term(m, n: nat, x, y: real): real =
    IF admissible_indices(m, n) THEN
      x ^ m * y ^ n
    ELSE
      0
    ENDIF

  inner_series_value(m: nat, x, y: real): real =
    series_value(
      LAMBDA (n: nat):
        series_term(m, n, x, y))

  S(x, y: real): real =
    series_value(
      LAMBDA (m: nat):
        inner_series_value(m, x, y))

  unit_square(x, y: real): bool =
    0 <= x AND x < 1 AND 0 <= y AND y < 1

  squared_distance_to_one(x, y: real): real =
    (x - 1) ^ 2 + (y - 1) ^ 2

  normalized_series(x, y: real): real =
    (1 - x * y ^ 2) * (1 - x ^ 2 * y) * S(x, y)

  tends_to_three_within_unit_square: bool =
    FORALL (epsilon_value: posreal):
      EXISTS (delta: posreal):
        FORALL (x, y: real):
          (unit_square(x, y)
            AND squared_distance_to_one(x, y) < delta ^ 2)
          IMPLIES
            abs(normalized_series(x, y) - 3) < epsilon_value

  putnam_1999_b3: bool =
    tends_to_three_within_unit_square
END putnam_1999_b3

import Mathlib

open Filter Topology Metric

noncomputable abbrev putnam_1999_b5_solution : ℕ → ℝ := sorry
-- fun n => 1 - n^2/4
/--
For an integer $n\geq 3$, let $\theta=2\pi/n$.  Evaluate the determinant of the $n\times n$ matrix $I+A$, where $I$ is the $n\times n$ identity matrix and $A=(a_{jk})$ has entries $a_{jk}=\cos(j\theta+k\theta)$ for all $j,k$.
-/
theorem putnam_1999_b5
  (n : ℕ)
  (hn : n ≥ 3)
  (theta : ℝ)
  (htheta : theta = 2 * Real.pi / n)
  (A : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ)
  (hA : A = fun j k => Real.cos ((j.1 + 1) * theta + (k.1 + 1) * theta)) :
  (1 + A).det = putnam_1999_b5_solution n :=
sorry

content:
(* Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_1999_b5:
   the determinant of the identity plus an n-by-n cosine matrix indexed from
   1 through n. This file contains no proof. *)

From Stdlib Require Import Reals List Arith.PeanoNat.

Open Scope R_scope.

Fixpoint putnam_1999_b5_insert_everywhere
    (x : nat) (xs : list nat) : list (list nat) :=
  match xs with
  | nil => (x :: nil) :: nil
  | y :: ys =>
      (x :: y :: ys) ::
      map (cons y) (putnam_1999_b5_insert_everywhere x ys)
  end.

Fixpoint putnam_1999_b5_permutations
    (xs : list nat) : list (list nat) :=
  match xs with
  | nil => nil :: nil
  | x :: ys =>
      flat_map (putnam_1999_b5_insert_everywhere x)
        (putnam_1999_b5_permutations ys)
  end.

Fixpoint putnam_1999_b5_inversions_from
    (x : nat) (xs : list nat) : nat :=
  match xs with
  | nil => O
  | y :: ys =>
      (if Nat.ltb y x then 1%nat else O) +
      putnam_1999_b5_inversions_from x ys
  end.

Fixpoint putnam_1999_b5_inversions
    (xs : list nat) : nat :=
  match xs with
  | nil => O
  | x :: ys =>
      putnam_1999_b5_inversions_from x ys +
      putnam_1999_b5_inversions ys
  end.

Definition putnam_1999_b5_permutation_sign
    (p : list nat) : R :=
  if Nat.even (putnam_1999_b5_inversions p) then 1 else -1.

Fixpoint putnam_1999_b5_permutation_product
    (M : nat -> nat -> R) (rows columns : list nat) : R :=
  match rows, columns with
  | i :: is, j :: js =>
      M i j * putnam_1999_b5_permutation_product M is js
  | _, _ => 1
  end.

Fixpoint putnam_1999_b5_real_sum (xs : list R) : R :=
  match xs with
  | nil => 0
  | x :: ys => x + putnam_1999_b5_real_sum ys
  end.

Definition putnam_1999_b5_determinant
    (n : nat) (M : nat -> nat -> R) : R :=
  putnam_1999_b5_real_sum
    (map
      (fun p =>
        putnam_1999_b5_permutation_sign p *
        putnam_1999_b5_permutation_product M (seq O n) p)
      (putnam_1999_b5_permutations (seq O n))).

Definition putnam_1999_b5_solution (n : nat) : R :=
  1 - (INR n) ^ 2 / 4.

Theorem putnam_1999_b5
    (n : nat)
    (hn : (3 <= n)%nat)
    (theta : R)
    (htheta : theta = 2 * PI / INR n)
    (A : nat -> nat -> R)
    (hA : forall i j : nat,
      (i < n)%nat ->
      (j < n)%nat ->
      A i j =
        cos (INR (S i) * theta + INR (S j) * theta)) :
  putnam_1999_b5_determinant n
    (fun i j : nat =>
      (if Nat.eq_dec i j then 1 else 0) + A i j) =
  putnam_1999_b5_solution n.
Admitted.

theory putnam_1999_b5 imports
Complex_Main
"HOL-Analysis.Finite_Cartesian_Product"
"HOL-Analysis.Determinants"
begin

definition putnam_1999_b5_solution :: "nat \<Rightarrow> real" where "putnam_1999_b5_solution \<equiv> undefined"
(* \<lambda> n. 1 - n ^ 2 / 4 *)
theorem putnam_1999_b5:
  fixes n :: nat
  and theta :: real
  and A :: "real^'n^'n"
  and idx :: "'n \<Rightarrow> nat"
  defines "theta \<equiv> 2 * pi / n"
  and "A \<equiv> \<chi> j k. cos (idx j * theta + idx k * theta)"
  assumes hn: "n \<ge> 3"
  and hncard: "CARD('n) = n"
  and idxbij: "\<forall> i \<in> {1..n}. \<exists>! m :: 'n. idx m = i"
  shows "det (mat 1 + A) = putnam_1999_b5_solution n"
  sorry

end
