title: putnam_2000_a4
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2000_a4
-- (putnambench__agda__putnam_2000_a4): convergence of the improper real
-- integral from zero to positive infinity of sin(x) sin(x^2).
-- This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; _*_)

infix 4 _!=_ _<=N_
infixr 3 _and_
infixr 2 _or_

data Bottom : Set where

Not : Set -> Set
Not A =
  A -> Bottom

_!=_ : {A : Set} -> A -> A -> Set
x != y =
  Not (x == y)

record _and_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data _or_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  left  : A -> A or B
  right : B -> A or B

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

data _<=N_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set where
  zero<=N   : {n : Nat} -> zero <=N n
  suc<=sucN : {m n : Nat} -> m <=N n -> suc m <=N suc n

record CompleteOrderedRealField (R : Set) : Set1 where
  field
    zeroR oneR : R
    add multiply : R -> R -> R
    negate inverse : R -> R
    lessOrEqual : R -> R -> Set
    fromNat : Nat -> R

    one-not-zero :
      oneR != zeroR

    add-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> add x y == add y x
    add-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      add (add x y) z == add x (add y z)
    add-zero :
      (x : R) -> add x zeroR == x
    add-inverse :
      (x : R) -> add x (negate x) == zeroR

    multiply-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> multiply x y == multiply y x
    multiply-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply (multiply x y) z ==
      multiply x (multiply y z)
    multiply-one :
      (x : R) -> multiply x oneR == x
    multiply-zero :
      (x : R) -> multiply x zeroR == zeroR
    distribute :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply x (add y z) ==
      add (multiply x y) (multiply x z)
    inverse-zero :
      inverse zeroR == zeroR
    multiply-inverse :
      (x : R) ->
      x != zeroR ->
      multiply x (inverse x) == oneR

    order-reflexive :
      (x : R) -> lessOrEqual x x
    order-transitive :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y z ->
      lessOrEqual x z
    order-antisymmetric :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y x ->
      x == y
    order-total :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y or lessOrEqual y x
    add-order :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual (add z x) (add z y)
    multiply-nonnegative :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR x ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR y ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR (multiply x y)
    zero-less-than-one :
      lessOrEqual zeroR oneR and zeroR != oneR

    fromNat-zero :
      fromNat zero == zeroR
    fromNat-successor :
      (n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (suc n) == add (fromNat n) oneR
    fromNat-addition :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m + n) == add (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-multiplication :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m * n) == multiply (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-injective :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat m == fromNat n ->
      m == n

    archimedean :
      (x : R) ->
      Exists Nat
        (\ n ->
          lessOrEqual x (fromNat n))
    least-upper-bound :
      (P : R -> Set) ->
      Exists R P ->
      Exists R
        (\ upper ->
          (x : R) ->
          P x ->
          lessOrEqual x upper) ->
      Exists R
        (\ supremum ->
          ((x : R) ->
            P x ->
            lessOrEqual x supremum)
          and
          ((upper : R) ->
            ((x : R) ->
              P x ->
              lessOrEqual x upper) ->
            lessOrEqual supremum upper))

open CompleteOrderedRealField

oneN : Nat
oneN =
  suc zero

twoN : Nat
twoN =
  suc oneN

subtract :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
subtract reals x y =
  add reals x (negate reals y)

divide :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
divide reals x y =
  multiply reals x (inverse reals y)

StrictLess :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
StrictLess reals x y =
  lessOrEqual reals x y and x != y

CloseTo :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
CloseTo reals center radius x =
  StrictLess reals
    (subtract reals center radius)
    x
  and
  StrictLess reals
    x
    (add reals center radius)

ConvergesTo :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  R ->
  Set
ConvergesTo {R} reals sequence limit =
  (epsilon : R) ->
  StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) epsilon ->
  Exists Nat
    (\ cutoff ->
      (n : Nat) ->
      cutoff <=N n ->
      CloseTo reals limit epsilon (sequence n))

LimitAtPositiveInfinity :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (R -> R) ->
  R ->
  Set
LimitAtPositiveInfinity {R} reals function limit =
  (epsilon : R) ->
  StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) epsilon ->
  Exists R
    (\ threshold ->
      (upper : R) ->
      lessOrEqual reals threshold upper ->
      CloseTo reals limit epsilon (function upper))

naturalPower :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  Nat ->
  R
naturalPower reals x zero =
  oneR reals
naturalPower reals x (suc n) =
  multiply reals
    (naturalPower reals x n)
    x

factorial : Nat -> Nat
factorial zero =
  oneN
factorial (suc n) =
  suc n * factorial n

sumFirst :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Nat ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  R
sumFirst reals zero term =
  zeroR reals
sumFirst reals (suc n) term =
  add reals
    (sumFirst reals n term)
    (term n)

SeriesHasSum :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  R ->
  Set
SeriesHasSum reals terms limit =
  ConvergesTo reals
    (\ n -> sumFirst reals n terms)
    limit

alternatingPower :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Nat ->
  R
alternatingPower reals n =
  naturalPower reals
    (negate reals (oneR reals))
    n

sineTerm :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  Nat ->
  R
sineTerm reals x n =
  divide reals
    (multiply reals
      (alternatingPower reals n)
      (naturalPower reals x (suc (twoN * n))))
    (fromNat reals (factorial (suc (twoN * n))))

midpointRiemannSum :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  (R -> R) ->
  Nat ->
  R
midpointRiemannSum reals lower upper function pieces =
  let
    step =
      divide reals
        (subtract reals upper lower)
        (fromNat reals pieces)
    halfStep =
      divide reals
        step
        (fromNat reals twoN)
  in
  sumFirst reals pieces
    (\ i ->
      multiply reals
        (function
          (add reals lower
            (add reals
              (multiply reals
                (fromNat reals i)
                step)
              halfStep)))
        step)

IntervalIntegralValue :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  (R -> R) ->
  R ->
  Set
IntervalIntegralValue reals lower upper function value =
  ConvergesTo reals
    (\ n ->
      midpointRiemannSum reals
        lower
        upper
        function
        (suc n))
    value

record StandardRealAnalysis
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) : Set1 where
  field
    sine : R -> R

    sine-series :
      (x : R) ->
      SeriesHasSum reals
        (sineTerm reals x)
        (sine x)

    intervalIntegral :
      R ->
      R ->
      (R -> R) ->
      R

    interval-integral-is-riemann :

title: putnam_2000_a4
content:
% Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2000_a4:
% the improper integral from zero to B of sin(x) sin(x^2) converges as B
% tends to positive infinity. This file contains no proof.

putnam_2000_a4: THEORY
BEGIN
  real_function: TYPE = [real -> real]
  real_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> real]

  converges_to(sequence: real_sequence, value: real): bool =
    FORALL (epsilon_value: posreal):
      EXISTS (cutoff: nat):
        FORALL (index: nat):
          cutoff <= index IMPLIES
            abs(sequence(index) - value) < epsilon_value

  converges_at_real_top(
      function_value: real_function,
      limit_value: real): bool =
    FORALL (epsilon_value: posreal):
      EXISTS (cutoff: real):
        FORALL (x: real):
          cutoff <= x IMPLIES
            abs(function_value(x) - limit_value)
              < epsilon_value

  safe_div(numerator, denominator: real): real =
    IF denominator = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      numerator / denominator
    ENDIF

  nat_factorial(index: nat): RECURSIVE nat =
    IF index = 0 THEN
      1
    ELSE
      index * nat_factorial(index - 1)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE index

  alternating_sign(index: nat): RECURSIVE real =
    IF index = 0 THEN
      1
    ELSE
      -alternating_sign(index - 1)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE index

  sine_partial(x: real, count: nat): RECURSIVE real =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      LET index: nat = count - 1 IN
        sine_partial(x, count - 1)
          + safe_div(
              alternating_sign(index)
                * x ^ (2 * index + 1),
              nat_factorial(2 * index + 1) :: real)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  real_sine(x: real): real =
    IF EXISTS (value: real):
        converges_to(
          LAMBDA (count: nat): sine_partial(x, count),
          value)
    THEN
      epsilon(
        LAMBDA (value: real):
          converges_to(
            LAMBDA (count: nat): sine_partial(x, count),
            value))
    ELSE
      0
    ENDIF

  integrand(x: real): real =
    real_sine(x) * real_sine(x ^ 2)

  valid_tagged_partition(
      left, right: real,
      points, tags: real_sequence,
      count: nat): bool =
    count > 0
      AND points(0) = left
      AND points(count) = right
      AND FORALL (index: nat):
        index < count IMPLIES
          (points(index) < points(index + 1)
            AND points(index) <= tags(index)
            AND tags(index) <= points(index + 1))

  mesh_less_than(
      points: real_sequence,
      count: nat,
      bound: real): bool =
    FORALL (index: nat):
      index < count IMPLIES
        points(index + 1) - points(index) < bound

  riemann_sum(
      function_value: real_function,
      points, tags: real_sequence,
      count: nat): RECURSIVE real =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      riemann_sum(
        function_value, points, tags, count - 1)
        + function_value(tags(count - 1))
            * (points(count) - points(count - 1))
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  has_interval_integral(
      function_value: real_function,
      left, right, integral_value: real): bool =
    left < right
      AND FORALL (epsilon_value: posreal):
        EXISTS (mesh_bound: posreal):
          FORALL
              (points, tags: real_sequence),
              (count: nat):
            (valid_tagged_partition(
                left, right, points, tags, count)
              AND mesh_less_than(
                points, count, mesh_bound))
            IMPLIES
              abs(
                riemann_sum(
                  function_value, points, tags, count)
                  - integral_value)
                < epsilon_value

  interval_integral(
      function_value: real_function,
      left, right: real): real =
    IF left = right THEN
      0
    ELSIF left < right THEN
      IF EXISTS (integral_value: real):
          has_interval_integral(
            function_value, left, right, integral_value)
      THEN
        epsilon(
          LAMBDA (integral_value: real):
            has_interval_integral(
              function_value, left, right, integral_value))
      ELSE
        0
      ENDIF
    ELSE
      IF EXISTS (integral_value: real):
          has_interval_integral(
            function_value, right, left, integral_value)
      THEN
        -epsilon(
          LAMBDA (integral_value: real):
            has_interval_integral(
              function_value, right, left, integral_value))
      ELSE
        0
      ENDIF
    ENDIF

  partial_integral(upper: real): real =
    interval_integral(integrand, 0, upper)

  putnam_2000_a4: bool =
    EXISTS (limit_value: real):
      converges_at_real_top(partial_integral, limit_value)
END putnam_2000_a4

(* Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench artifact putnam_2000_a5:
   three distinct integer lattice points on a circle have two points separated
   by at least the real cube root of the radius. This file contains no proof. *)

From Stdlib Require Import Vectors.Fin Reals ZArith.

Open Scope R_scope.

Definition putnam_2000_a5_point := (R * R)%type.

Definition putnam_2000_a5_distance
    (p q : putnam_2000_a5_point) : R :=
  sqrt ((fst p - fst q) ^ 2 + (snd p - snd q) ^ 2).

Definition putnam_2000_a5_integer_point
    (p : putnam_2000_a5_point) : Prop :=
  exists a b : Z,
    fst p = IZR a /\ snd p = IZR b.

Theorem putnam_2000_a5
    (r : R)
    (z : putnam_2000_a5_point)
    (p : Fin.t 3 -> putnam_2000_a5_point)
    (rpos : r > 0)
    (pdiff :
      forall n m : Fin.t 3,
        n <> m -> p n <> p m)
    (pint :
      forall n : Fin.t 3,
        putnam_2000_a5_integer_point (p n))
    (pcirc :
      forall n : Fin.t 3,
        putnam_2000_a5_distance (p n) z = r) :
  exists n m : Fin.t 3,
    n <> m /\
    putnam_2000_a5_distance (p n) (p m) >= Rpower r (1 / 3).
Admitted.

;; Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2000_a5:
;; among three distinct lattice points on a positive-radius circle, two are
;; separated by at least the cube root of the radius. This file contains no
;; proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

;; Let D be the determinant of the two edge vectors from P0. Three distinct
;; points lie on a positive-radius circle exactly when D is nonzero. In that
;; case the circle is unique, its center has rational coordinates, and
;;
;;   r^2 = (d01 * d02 * d12) / (4 * D^2),
;;
;; where dij is the squared distance between Pi and Pj. Thus eliminating the
;; source's real center and positive radius does not restrict its instances.
;; Since distances and r are nonnegative,
;;
;;   dist(Pi,Pj) >= r^(1/3)
;;
;; is bidirectionally equivalent, after squaring and cubing, to
;;
;;   4 * D^2 * dij^3 >= d01 * d02 * d12.
;;
;; The disjunction below ranges over all three unordered pairs, exactly
;; encoding the source's existential conclusion without square or cube roots.

(defun putnam-2000-a5-distance-squared (left-x left-y right-x right-y)
  (+ (* (- left-x right-x) (- left-x right-x))
     (* (- left-y right-y) (- left-y right-y))))

(defun putnam-2000-a5-determinant (x0 y0 x1 y1 x2 y2)
  (- (* (- x1 x0) (- y2 y0))
     (* (- y1 y0) (- x2 x0))))

(defun putnam-2000-a5-pair-bound-p
    (distance-squared determinant-squared side-product)
  (<= side-product
      (* 4
         determinant-squared
         distance-squared
         distance-squared
         distance-squared)))

(defun putnambench-putnam-2000-a5-statement
    (x0 y0 x1 y1 x2 y2)
  (let* ((d01 (putnam-2000-a5-distance-squared x0 y0 x1 y1))
         (d02 (putnam-2000-a5-distance-squared x0 y0 x2 y2))
         (d12 (putnam-2000-a5-distance-squared x1 y1 x2 y2))
         (determinant
          (putnam-2000-a5-determinant x0 y0 x1 y1 x2 y2))
         (determinant-squared (* determinant determinant))
         (side-product (* d01 d02 d12)))
    (implies
     (and
      (integerp x0)
      (integerp y0)
      (integerp x1)
      (integerp y1)
      (integerp x2)
      (integerp y2)
      (not (and (equal x0 x1) (equal y0 y1)))
      (not (and (equal x0 x2) (equal y0 y2)))
      (not (and (equal x1 x2) (equal y1 y2)))
      (not (equal determinant 0)))
     (or
      (putnam-2000-a5-pair-bound-p
       d01 determinant-squared side-product)
      (putnam-2000-a5-pair-bound-p
       d02 determinant-squared side-product)
      (putnam-2000-a5-pair-bound-p
       d12 determinant-squared side-product)))))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

-- Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2000_a5:
-- among three distinct lattice points on a positive-radius circle in the real
-- plane, two are separated by at least the cube root of the radius. This file
-- contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module Putnam2000A5 where

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Int using (Int; pos; negsuc)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; _*_)

infix 4 _!=_
infixr 3 _and_
infixr 2 _or_

data Bottom : Set where

Not : Set -> Set
Not A =
  A -> Bottom

_!=_ : {A : Set} -> A -> A -> Set
x != y =
  Not (x == y)

record _and_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data _or_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  left  : A -> A or B
  right : B -> A or B

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

data Fin : Nat -> Set where
  fzero : {n : Nat} -> Fin (suc n)
  fsuc  : {n : Nat} -> Fin n -> Fin (suc n)

record CompleteOrderedRealField (R : Set) : Set1 where
  field
    zeroR oneR : R
    add multiply : R -> R -> R
    negate inverse squareRoot cubeRoot : R -> R
    lessOrEqual : R -> R -> Set
    fromNat : Nat -> R

    one-not-zero :
      oneR != zeroR

    add-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> add x y == add y x
    add-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      add (add x y) z == add x (add y z)
    add-zero :
      (x : R) ->
      add x zeroR == x
    add-inverse :
      (x : R) ->
      add x (negate x) == zeroR

    multiply-commutative :
      (x y : R) ->
      multiply x y == multiply y x
    multiply-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply (multiply x y) z ==
      multiply x (multiply y z)
    multiply-one :
      (x : R) ->
      multiply x oneR == x
    multiply-zero :
      (x : R) ->
      multiply x zeroR == zeroR
    distribute :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply x (add y z) ==
      add (multiply x y) (multiply x z)
    inverse-zero :
      inverse zeroR == zeroR
    multiply-inverse :
      (x : R) ->
      x != zeroR ->
      multiply x (inverse x) == oneR

    order-reflexive :
      (x : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x x
    order-transitive :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y z ->
      lessOrEqual x z
    order-antisymmetric :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y x ->
      x == y
    order-total :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y or lessOrEqual y x
    add-order :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual (add z x) (add z y)
    multiply-nonnegative :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR x ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR y ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR (multiply x y)
    zero-less-than-one :
      lessOrEqual zeroR oneR and zeroR != oneR

    fromNat-zero :
      fromNat zero == zeroR
    fromNat-successor :
      (n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (suc n) == add (fromNat n) oneR
    fromNat-addition :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m + n) == add (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-multiplication :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m * n) == multiply (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-injective :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat m == fromNat n ->
      m == n

    archimedean :
      (x : R) ->
      Exists Nat
        (\ n ->
          lessOrEqual x (fromNat n))
    least-upper-bound :
      (P : R -> Set) ->
      Exists R P ->
      Exists R
        (\ upper ->
          (x : R) ->
          P x ->
          lessOrEqual x upper) ->
      Exists R
        (\ supremum ->
          ((x : R) ->
            P x ->
            lessOrEqual x supremum)
          and
          ((upper : R) ->
            ((x : R) ->
              P x ->
              lessOrEqual x upper) ->
            lessOrEqual supremum upper))

    square-root-nonnegative :
      (x : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR (squareRoot x)
    square-root-square :
      (x : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR x ->
      multiply (squareRoot x) (squareRoot x) == x
    square-root-nonpositive :
      (x : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x zeroR ->
      squareRoot x == zeroR
    square-root-unique :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR y ->
      multiply y y == x ->
      y == squareRoot x

    cube-root-nonnegative :
      (x : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR x ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR (cubeRoot x)
    cube-root-cube :
      (x : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR x ->
      multiply
        (multiply (cubeRoot x) (cubeRoot x))
        (cubeRoot x)
      ==
      x
    cube-root-unique :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR x ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR y ->
      multiply (multiply y y) y == x ->
      y == cubeRoot x

open CompleteOrderedRealField

fromInt :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Int ->
  R
fromInt reals (pos n) =
  fromNat reals n
fromInt reals (negsuc n) =
  negate reals (fromNat reals (suc n))

subtract :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
subtract reals x y =
  add reals x (negate reals y)

square :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R
square reals x =
  multiply reals x x

StrictLess :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
StrictLess reals x y =
  lessOrEqual reals x y and x != y

record Point (R : Set) : Set where
  constructor point
  field
    x-coordinate : R
    y-coordinate : R

open Point

squaredDistance :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Point R ->
  Point R ->
  R
squaredDistance reals p q =
  add reals
    (square reals
      (subtract reals
        (x-coordinate p)
        (x-coordinate q)))
    (square reals
      (subtract reals
        (y-coordinate p)
        (y-coordinate q)))

distance :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Point R ->
  Point R ->
  R
distance reals p q =
  squareRoot reals (squaredDistance reals p q)

IntegerCoordinate :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  Set
IntegerCoordinate reals x =
  Exists Int
    (\ z ->
      x == fromInt reals z)

LatticePoint :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Point R ->
  Set
LatticePoint reals p =
  IntegerCoordinate reals (x-coordinate p)
  and
  IntegerCoordinate reals (y-coordinate p)

three : Nat
three =
  suc (suc (suc zero))

module Putnam2000A5Statement
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) where

  proposition : Set
  proposition =
    (radius : R) ->
    (center : Point R) ->
    (points : Fin three -> Point R) ->
    StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) radius ->
    ((i j : Fin three) ->
      i != j ->
      points i != points j) ->
    ((i : Fin three) ->
      LatticePoint reals (points i)) ->
    ((i : Fin three) ->
      distance reals center (points i) == radius) ->
    Exists (Fin three)
      (\ i ->
        Exists (Fin three)
          (\ j ->
            i != j
            and
            lessOrEqual reals
              (cubeRoot reals radius)
              (distance reals (points i) (points j))))

putnam-2000-a5 : Set1
putnam-2000-a5 =
  (R : Set) ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) ->
  Putnam2000A5Statement.proposition reals

title: putnam_2000_a5

% Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2000_a5:
% three distinct integer-coordinate points on a circle of positive radius
% contain a pair separated by at least the cube root of the radius. This file
% contains no proof.

putnam_2000_a5: THEORY
BEGIN
  vertex: TYPE = below(3)
  point: TYPE = [# x_coord: real, y_coord: real #]
  configuration: TYPE = [vertex -> point]

  integer_point(P: point): bool =
    EXISTS (m, n: int):
      x_coord(P) = (m :: real)
        AND y_coord(P) = (n :: real)

  squared_distance(P, Q: point): real =
    (x_coord(P) - x_coord(Q)) ^ 2
      + (y_coord(P) - y_coord(Q)) ^ 2

  distance_value(distance: real, P, Q: point): bool =
    0 <= distance
      AND distance ^ 2 = squared_distance(P, Q)

  cube_root_value(root, radicand: real): bool =
    0 <= root AND root ^ 3 = radicand

  on_circle(center: point, radius: real, P: point): bool =
    distance_value(radius, P, center)

  putnam_2000_a5: bool =
    FORALL (r: real), (z: point), (p: configuration):
      (r > 0
        AND (FORALL (i, j: vertex):
          i /= j IMPLIES p(i) /= p(j))
        AND (FORALL (i: vertex):
          integer_point(p(i)))
        AND (FORALL (i: vertex):
          on_circle(z, r, p(i))))
      IMPLIES
        EXISTS
            (i, j: vertex),
            (distance, cube_root: real):
          i /= j
            AND distance_value(distance, p(i), p(j))
            AND cube_root_value(cube_root, r)
            AND distance >= cube_root
END putnam_2000_a5

title: putnam_2000_a6
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2000_a6:
;; an integer-polynomial orbit starting at zero can return to zero at a
;; positive time only if its first or second iterate is zero. This file
;; contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

;; A polynomial in Z[x] is represented uniquely by its finite list of
;; coefficients in ascending degree order. NIL represents the zero polynomial,
;; and a nonzero polynomial has a nonzero final coefficient.
(defun putnam-2000-a6-integer-list-p (values)
  (if (consp values)
      (and (integerp (car values))
           (putnam-2000-a6-integer-list-p (cdr values)))
    (equal values nil)))

(defun putnam-2000-a6-integer-polynomial-p (coefficients)
  (and
   (putnam-2000-a6-integer-list-p coefficients)
   (or (endp coefficients)
       (not (equal (car (last coefficients)) 0)))))

;; Horner evaluation is definitionally evaluation of the represented
;; integer-coefficient polynomial.
(defun putnam-2000-a6-polynomial-evaluate (coefficients value)
  (if (consp coefficients)
      (+ (car coefficients)
         (* value
            (putnam-2000-a6-polynomial-evaluate
             (cdr coefficients) value)))
    0))

;; This is the unique sequence satisfying a_0 = 0 and
;; a_(n+1) = f(a_n), so the source sequence parameter and its recurrence
;; assumptions are eliminated definitionally.
(defun putnam-2000-a6-iterate (coefficients steps)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix steps)))
  (if (zp steps)
      0
    (putnam-2000-a6-polynomial-evaluate
     coefficients
     (putnam-2000-a6-iterate coefficients (- steps 1)))))

;; Since the conclusion is independent of m,
;;
;;   (exists m > 0, a_m = 0) -> Q
;;
;; is bidirectionally equivalent to the pointwise universal form
;;
;;   forall m > 0, a_m = 0 -> Q.
;;
;; ACL2 implicitly universally quantifies the arguments of this predicate.
(defun putnambench-putnam-2000-a6-statement (coefficients m)
  (implies
   (and
    (putnam-2000-a6-integer-polynomial-p coefficients)
    (natp m)
    (< 0 m)
    (equal
     (putnam-2000-a6-iterate coefficients m)
     0))
   (or
    (equal
     (putnam-2000-a6-iterate coefficients 1)
     0)
    (equal
     (putnam-2000-a6-iterate coefficients 2)
     0))))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

-- Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2000_a6:
-- an integer polynomial iterated from zero can return to zero at a positive
-- index only if its first or second iterate is zero. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Int using (Int; pos; negsuc)
open import Agda.Builtin.List using (List; []; _∷_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; _*_)

infixr 3 _and_
infixr 2 _or_

record _and_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data _or_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  left  : A -> A or B
  right : B -> A or B

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

data Positive : Nat -> Set where
  positive : {n : Nat} -> Positive (suc n)

difference : Nat -> Nat -> Int
difference zero zero =
  pos zero
difference (suc m) zero =
  pos (suc m)
difference zero (suc n) =
  negsuc n
difference (suc m) (suc n) =
  difference m n

negative : Nat -> Int
negative zero =
  pos zero
negative (suc n) =
  negsuc n

addInt : Int -> Int -> Int
addInt (pos m) (pos n) =
  pos (m + n)
addInt (pos m) (negsuc n) =
  difference m (suc n)
addInt (negsuc m) (pos n) =
  difference n (suc m)
addInt (negsuc m) (negsuc n) =
  negsuc (suc (m + n))

multiplyInt : Int -> Int -> Int
multiplyInt (pos m) (pos n) =
  pos (m * n)
multiplyInt (pos m) (negsuc n) =
  negative (m * suc n)
multiplyInt (negsuc m) (pos n) =
  negative (suc m * n)
multiplyInt (negsuc m) (negsuc n) =
  pos (suc m * suc n)

Polynomial : Set
Polynomial =
  List Int

evaluatePolynomial : Polynomial -> Int -> Int
evaluatePolynomial [] x =
  pos zero
evaluatePolynomial (coefficient ∷ coefficients) x =
  addInt coefficient
    (multiplyInt x (evaluatePolynomial coefficients x))

putnam-2000-a6 : Set
putnam-2000-a6 =
  (f : Polynomial) ->
  (a : Nat -> Int) ->
  a zero == pos zero ->
  ((n : Nat) ->
    a (suc n) == evaluatePolynomial f (a n)) ->
  Exists Nat
    (\ m ->
      Positive m
      and
      a m == pos zero) ->
  (a (suc zero) == pos zero)
  or
  (a (suc (suc zero)) == pos zero)

;; Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2000_b1:
;; integer triples with an odd entry admit an integer linear combination
;; that is odd on at least four sevenths of the indices. This file contains
;; no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

;; Lists of length N represent the three functions on Fin N exactly. Only
;; parity matters in an integer linear combination modulo 2, so any integer
;; coefficient triple can be replaced by its residues in {0,1}^3, and every
;; such residue triple is itself an integer triple. Thus the eight cases in
;; the statement are bidirectionally equivalent to the source existential
;; quantifier over integers r, s, and t. The scaled inequality
;; 7*count >= 4*N is exactly count >= (4*N)/7 over the reals.

(defun putnam-2000-b1-integer-list-p (values)
  (if (consp values)
      (and
       (integerp (car values))
       (putnam-2000-b1-integer-list-p (cdr values)))
    (equal values nil)))

(defun putnam-2000-b1-input-odd-p (a b c)
  (declare (xargs :measure (len a)))
  (if (consp a)
      (and
       (or
        (not (equal (mod (car a) 2) 0))
        (not (equal (mod (car b) 2) 0))
        (not (equal (mod (car c) 2) 0)))
       (putnam-2000-b1-input-odd-p
        (cdr a) (cdr b) (cdr c)))
    (and (equal a nil)
         (equal b nil)
         (equal c nil))))

(defun putnam-2000-b1-odd-count (a b c r s coefficient-t)
  (declare (xargs :measure (len a)))
  (if (consp a)
      (+
       (if
        (not
         (equal
          (mod
           (+ (* r (car a))
              (* s (car b))
              (* coefficient-t (car c)))
           2)
          0))
        1
        0)
       (putnam-2000-b1-odd-count
        (cdr a) (cdr b) (cdr c) r s coefficient-t))
    0))

(defun putnam-2000-b1-four-sevenths-p
    (n a b c r s coefficient-t)
  (<=
   (* 4 n)
   (* 7
      (putnam-2000-b1-odd-count
       a b c r s coefficient-t))))

(defun putnambench-putnam-2000-b1-statement (n a b c)
  (implies
   (and
    (posp n)
    (true-listp a)
    (true-listp b)
    (true-listp c)
    (equal (len a) n)
    (equal (len b) n)
    (equal (len c) n)
    (putnam-2000-b1-integer-list-p a)
    (putnam-2000-b1-integer-list-p b)
    (putnam-2000-b1-integer-list-p c)
    (putnam-2000-b1-input-odd-p a b c))
   (or
    (putnam-2000-b1-four-sevenths-p n a b c 0 0 0)
    (putnam-2000-b1-four-sevenths-p n a b c 0 0 1)
    (putnam-2000-b1-four-sevenths-p n a b c 0 1 0)
    (putnam-2000-b1-four-sevenths-p n a b c 0 1 1)
    (putnam-2000-b1-four-sevenths-p n a b c 1 0 0)
    (putnam-2000-b1-four-sevenths-p n a b c 1 0 1)
    (putnam-2000-b1-four-sevenths-p n a b c 1 1 0)
    (putnam-2000-b1-four-sevenths-p n a b c 1 1 1))))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

-- Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2000_b1:
-- among integer triples with at least one odd coordinate, some integer linear
-- combination is odd on at least four sevenths of the finite index set. This
-- file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module Putnam2000B1 where

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Int using (Int; pos; negsuc)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; _*_)

infix 4 _<=N_
infixr 3 _and_
infixr 2 _or_

record _and_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data _or_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  left  : A -> A or B
  right : B -> A or B

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

data _<=N_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set where
  zero<=N   : {n : Nat} -> zero <=N n
  suc<=sucN : {m n : Nat} -> m <=N n -> suc m <=N suc n

data Fin : Nat -> Set where
  fzero : {n : Nat} -> Fin (suc n)
  fsuc  : {n : Nat} -> Fin n -> Fin (suc n)

record HasCardinality
  {A : Set}
  (member : A -> Set)
  (cardinality : Nat) :
  Set where

  field
    enumerate :
      Fin cardinality ->
      A
    enumerated-member :
      (index : Fin cardinality) ->
      member (enumerate index)
    enumeration-complete :
      (item : A) ->
      member item ->
      Exists (Fin cardinality)
        (\ index -> item == enumerate index)
    enumeration-injective :
      (left-index right-index : Fin cardinality) ->
      enumerate left-index == enumerate right-index ->
      left-index == right-index

difference : Nat -> Nat -> Int
difference zero zero =
  pos zero
difference (suc m) zero =
  pos (suc m)
difference zero (suc n) =
  negsuc n
difference (suc m) (suc n) =
  difference m n

negative : Nat -> Int
negative zero =
  pos zero
negative (suc n) =
  negsuc n

addInt : Int -> Int -> Int
addInt (pos m) (pos n) =
  pos (m + n)
addInt (pos m) (negsuc n) =
  difference m (suc n)
addInt (negsuc m) (pos n) =
  difference n (suc m)
addInt (negsuc m) (negsuc n) =
  negsuc (suc (m + n))

multiplyInt : Int -> Int -> Int
multiplyInt (pos m) (pos n) =
  pos (m * n)
multiplyInt (pos m) (negsuc n) =
  negative (m * suc n)
multiplyInt (negsuc m) (pos n) =
  negative (suc m * n)
multiplyInt (negsuc m) (negsuc n) =
  pos (suc m * suc n)

data Odd : Int -> Set where
  positive-odd :
    (k : Nat) ->
    Odd (pos (suc (k + k)))
  negative-odd :
    (k : Nat) ->
    Odd (negsuc (k + k))

one : Nat
one =
  suc zero

two : Nat
two =
  suc one

four : Nat
four =
  two + two

seven : Nat
seven =
  suc (suc (suc (suc (suc (suc one)))))

linearCombination :
  {N : Nat} ->
  (Fin N -> Int) ->
  (Fin N -> Int) ->
  (Fin N -> Int) ->
  Int ->
  Int ->
  Int ->
  Fin N ->
  Int
linearCombination a b c r s t j =
  addInt
    (addInt
      (multiplyInt r (a j))
      (multiplyInt s (b j)))
    (multiplyInt t (c j))

putnam-2000-b1 : Set
putnam-2000-b1 =
  (N : Nat) ->
  (a b c : Fin N -> Int) ->
  one <=N N ->
  ((j : Fin N) ->
    Odd (a j) or Odd (b j) or Odd (c j)) ->
  Exists Int
    (\ r ->
      Exists Int
        (\ s ->
          Exists Int
            (\ t ->
              Exists Nat
                (\ count ->
                  HasCardinality
                    (\ j ->
                      Odd
                        (linearCombination
                          a b c r s t j))
                    count
                  and
                  (four * N) <=N (seven * count)))))

% Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2000_b1:
% integer triples with an odd coordinate admit integer coefficients making at
% least four sevenths of the resulting linear combinations odd. This file contains no proof.

putnam_2000_b1: THEORY
BEGIN
  IMPORTING finite_sets[nat]

  integer_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> int]

  odd_integer(value: int): bool =
    EXISTS (half: int):
      value = 2 * half + 1

  admissible(
      N: nat,
      a, b, c: integer_sequence): bool =
    N >= 1
      AND (FORALL (j: nat):
        j < N IMPLIES
          (odd_integer(a(j))
            OR odd_integer(b(j))
            OR odd_integer(c(j))))

  exact_odd_indices(
      N: nat,
      a, b, c: integer_sequence,
      r, s, t: int,
      indices: finite_set[nat]): bool =
    FORALL (j: nat):
      indices(j) IFF
        (j < N
          AND odd_integer(
            r * a(j) + s * b(j) + t * c(j)))

  putnam_2000_b1: bool =
    FORALL (N: nat),
           (a, b, c: integer_sequence):
      admissible(N, a, b, c)
        IMPLIES
          EXISTS (r, s, t: int),
                 (indices: finite_set[nat]):
            exact_odd_indices(N, a, b, c, r, s, t, indices)
              AND 4 * N <= 7 * card(indices)
END putnam_2000_b1

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using
  (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; _*_; mod-helper)

data _<=_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set where
  zero<= : {n : Nat} -> zero <= n
  suc<=suc : {m n : Nat} -> m <= n -> suc m <= suc n

record _divides_ (divisor dividend : Nat) : Set where
  field
    quotient : Nat
    division-equation : divisor * quotient == dividend

one : Nat
one =
  suc zero

choose : Nat -> Nat -> Nat
choose n zero =
  one
choose zero (suc k) =
  zero
choose (suc n) (suc k) =
  choose n (suc k) + choose n k

naturalMod : Nat -> Nat -> Nat
naturalMod numerator zero =
  zero
naturalMod numerator (suc denominator) =
  mod-helper zero denominator numerator denominator

gcdWithFuel : Nat -> Nat -> Nat -> Nat
gcdWithFuel zero a b =
  a
gcdWithFuel (suc fuel) a zero =
  a
gcdWithFuel (suc fuel) a (suc b) =
  gcdWithFuel fuel (suc b) (naturalMod a (suc b))

naturalGCD : Nat -> Nat -> Nat
naturalGCD a b =
  gcdWithFuel (suc (a + b)) a b

putnam-2000-b2 : Set
putnam-2000-b2 =
  (m n : Nat) ->
  one <= m ->
  m <= n ->
  n divides (naturalGCD m n * choose n m)

% Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2000_b2:
% for all natural numbers 1 <= m <= n, n divides the greatest common divisor
% of m and n times the binomial coefficient (n choose m). This file contains no proof.

putnam_2000_b2: THEORY
BEGIN
  nat_divides(divisor, value: nat): bool =
    EXISTS (quotient: nat):
      value = divisor * quotient

  subtractive_gcd(left, right: nat): RECURSIVE nat =
    IF left = 0 THEN
      right
    ELSIF right = 0 THEN
      left
    ELSIF left <= right THEN
      subtractive_gcd(left, right - left)
    ELSE
      subtractive_gcd(left - right, right)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE left + right

  binomial_coefficient(n, k: nat): RECURSIVE nat =
    IF k = 0 THEN
      1
    ELSIF n = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      binomial_coefficient(n - 1, k - 1)
        + binomial_coefficient(n - 1, k)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE n

  putnam_2000_b2: bool =
    FORALL (m, n: nat):
      (m >= 1 AND n >= m)
        IMPLIES
          nat_divides(
            n,
            subtractive_gcd(m, n) * binomial_coefficient(n, m))
END putnam_2000_b2

import Mathlib
