title: putnam_2003_a1
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2003_a1:
;; for every positive integer n, exactly n finite nondecreasing sequences of
;; positive integers sum to n and have last term at most one greater than the
;; first term. This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

;; A source function with witness k is determined by its nonzero prefix of
;; length k, since every later value is zero. Conversely, every nonempty list
;; counted below extends uniquely by zeros to such a function. Positivity and
;; sum n force both the prefix length and every entry to be at most n, so the
;; finite enumeration through n is exactly the source cardinality.

(defun putnam-2003-a1-positive-integer-list-p (values)
  (if (consp values)
      (and
       (posp (car values))
       (putnam-2003-a1-positive-integer-list-p
        (cdr values)))
    (equal values nil)))

(defun putnam-2003-a1-sum (values)
  (if (consp values)
      (+ (car values)
         (putnam-2003-a1-sum (cdr values)))
    0))

(defun putnam-2003-a1-nondecreasing-p (values)
  (if (and (consp values)
           (consp (cdr values)))
      (and
       (<= (car values) (cadr values))
       (putnam-2003-a1-nondecreasing-p
        (cdr values)))
    t))

(defun putnam-2003-a1-valid-sequence-p (values n)
  (and
   (consp values)
   (putnam-2003-a1-positive-integer-list-p values)
   (equal (putnam-2003-a1-sum values) n)
   (putnam-2003-a1-nondecreasing-p values)
   (<= (car (last values))
       (+ (car values) 1))))

(defun putnam-2003-a1-prepend-to-each (value sequences)
  (if (consp sequences)
      (cons
       (cons value (car sequences))
       (putnam-2003-a1-prepend-to-each
        value (cdr sequences)))
    nil))

(defun putnam-2003-a1-prepend-values-through
    (value sequences)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix value)))
  (if (zp value)
      nil
    (append
     (putnam-2003-a1-prepend-to-each
      value sequences)
     (putnam-2003-a1-prepend-values-through
      (- value 1) sequences))))

(defun putnam-2003-a1-positive-lists-exact
    (length bound)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix length)))
  (if (zp length)
      (list nil)
    (putnam-2003-a1-prepend-values-through
     bound
     (putnam-2003-a1-positive-lists-exact
      (- length 1) bound))))

(defun putnam-2003-a1-positive-lists-through
    (maximum-length bound)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix maximum-length)))
  (if (zp maximum-length)
      nil
    (append
     (putnam-2003-a1-positive-lists-exact
      maximum-length bound)
     (putnam-2003-a1-positive-lists-through
      (- maximum-length 1) bound))))

(defun putnam-2003-a1-count-valid
    (sequences n)
  (if (consp sequences)
      (+ (if (putnam-2003-a1-valid-sequence-p
              (car sequences) n)
             1
           0)
         (putnam-2003-a1-count-valid
          (cdr sequences) n))
    0))

(defun putnam-2003-a1-sequence-count (n)
  (if (natp n)
      (putnam-2003-a1-count-valid
       (putnam-2003-a1-positive-lists-through n n)
       n)
    0))

(defun putnambench-putnam-2003-a1-statement (n)
  (implies
   (posp n)
   (equal
    (putnam-2003-a1-sequence-count n)
    n)))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

-- Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2003_a1
-- (putnambench__agda__putnam_2003_a1): every positive integer n has exactly n
-- nondecreasing positive-integer compositions whose last part is at most one
-- greater than the first. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module Putnam2003A1 where

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.List using (List; []; _∷_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_)

infix 4 _<=_

data _<=_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set where
  zero<= :
    {n : Nat} ->
    zero <= n
  suc<=suc :
    {m n : Nat} ->
    m <= n ->
    suc m <= suc n

data Fin : Nat -> Set where
  fzero :
    {n : Nat} ->
    Fin (suc n)
  fsuc :
    {n : Nat} ->
    Fin n ->
    Fin (suc n)

record Exists
  (A : Set)
  (P : A -> Set) :
  Set where

  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

record HasCardinality
  {A : Set}
  (member : A -> Set)
  (cardinality : Nat) :
  Set where

  field
    enumerate :
      Fin cardinality ->
      A
    enumerated-member :
      (index : Fin cardinality) ->
      member (enumerate index)
    enumeration-complete :
      (item : A) ->
      member item ->
      Exists (Fin cardinality)
        (\ index -> item == enumerate index)
    enumeration-injective :
      (left-index right-index : Fin cardinality) ->
      enumerate left-index == enumerate right-index ->
      left-index == right-index

data Positive : Nat -> Set where
  positive :
    {n : Nat} ->
    Positive (suc n)

data NonEmpty {A : Set} : List A -> Set where
  nonempty :
    {x : A} {xs : List A} ->
    NonEmpty (x ∷ xs)

data All {A : Set} (P : A -> Set) : List A -> Set where
  all-empty :
    All P []
  all-cons :
    {x : A} {xs : List A} ->
    P x ->
    All P xs ->
    All P (x ∷ xs)

data NonDecreasing : List Nat -> Set where
  nondecreasing-empty :
    NonDecreasing []
  nondecreasing-singleton :
    {x : Nat} ->
    NonDecreasing (x ∷ [])
  nondecreasing-cons :
    {x y : Nat} {xs : List Nat} ->
    x <= y ->
    NonDecreasing (y ∷ xs) ->
    NonDecreasing (x ∷ y ∷ xs)

sum : List Nat -> Nat
sum [] =
  zero
sum (x ∷ xs) =
  x + sum xs

head : List Nat -> Nat
head [] =
  zero
head (x ∷ xs) =
  x

last : List Nat -> Nat
last [] =
  zero
last (x ∷ []) =
  x
last (x ∷ y ∷ xs) =
  last (y ∷ xs)

record IsPutnamComposition
  (n : Nat)
  (parts : List Nat) :
  Set where

  field
    positive-length :
      NonEmpty parts
    positive-parts :
      All Positive parts
    ordered-parts :
      NonDecreasing parts
    correct-sum :
      sum parts == n
    endpoint-bound :
      last parts <= head parts + suc zero

putnam-2003-a1 : Set
putnam-2003-a1 =
  (n : Nat) ->
  Positive n ->
  HasCardinality (IsPutnamComposition n) n

$(
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact
  putnam_2003_a1: the number of nondecreasing decompositions of a positive
  integer whose largest part is at most one above the smallest is the integer
  itself. This file contains no proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  A decomposition with k parts is represented by a function a from the
  one-based finite interval 1 ... k to NN. This is in bijection with the
  zero-based Fin k families and the finite lists in the ground-truth sources.
  Since every such function is a subset of NN X. NN, the surrounding power
  set is only a set-sized ambient carrier and imposes no additional bound.

  The finite sum gives n, the half-open interval 1 ..^ k indexes exactly the
  adjacent pairs, and the final inequality bounds the largest part by the
  smallest plus one. Distinct lengths give functions with distinct domains,
  so the restricted class counts exactly the requested decompositions. The
  right side inlines the explicit solution function from the Rocq source.
  The final declaration is the single unproved $a corpus statement; this
  database contains no $p proof statement.
$)

${
  $d a i k n $.

  putnambench-putnam-2003-a1 $a |- A. n e. NN
    (
      (
        #
        `
        {
          a e. ~P ( NN X. NN )
          |
          E. k e. NN
            (
              a e. ( NN ^m ( 1 ... k ) )
              /\
              (
                (
                  sum_ i e. ( 1 ... k )
                    ( a ` i )
                )
                =
                n
                /\
                (
                  A. i e. ( 1 ..^ k )
                    ( a ` i ) <_ ( a ` ( i + 1 ) )
                  /\
                  ( a ` k ) <_ ( ( a ` 1 ) + 1 )
                )
              )
            )
        }
      )
      =
      n
    )
  $.
$}

% Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench artifact putnam_2003_a1:
% for every positive integer n, exactly n eventually-zero sequences encode
% nondecreasing positive summands whose largest is at most the smallest plus one.
% This file contains no proof.

putnam_2003_a1: THEORY
BEGIN
  integer_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> int]
  integer_sequence_set: TYPE = [integer_sequence -> bool]
  sequence_enumeration: TYPE = [nat -> integer_sequence]

  prefix_sum(
      values: integer_sequence,
      count: nat): RECURSIVE int =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      prefix_sum(values, count - 1) + values(count - 1)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  admissible_sequence(
      values: integer_sequence,
      n: nat): bool =
    EXISTS (k: nat):
      k > 0
        AND prefix_sum(values, k) = (n :: int)
        AND (FORALL (i: nat):
          i < k IMPLIES values(i) > 0)
        AND (FORALL (i: nat):
          i + 1 < k IMPLIES values(i) <= values(i + 1))
        AND values(k - 1) <= values(0) + 1
        AND (FORALL (i: nat):
          i >= k IMPLIES values(i) = 0)

  admissible_sequences(n: nat): integer_sequence_set =
    LAMBDA (values: integer_sequence):
      admissible_sequence(values, n)

  injective_below(
      enumeration: sequence_enumeration,
      cardinality: nat): bool =
    FORALL (i, j: nat):
      i < cardinality
        AND j < cardinality
        AND enumeration(i) = enumeration(j)
      IMPLIES i = j

  enumerates_exactly(
      enumeration: sequence_enumeration,
      set_value: integer_sequence_set,
      cardinality: nat): bool =
    FORALL (values: integer_sequence):
      set_value(values)
        IFF
          EXISTS (position: nat):
            position < cardinality
              AND enumeration(position) = values

  has_cardinality(
      set_value: integer_sequence_set,
      cardinality: nat): bool =
    EXISTS (enumeration: sequence_enumeration):
      injective_below(enumeration, cardinality)
        AND enumerates_exactly(
          enumeration, set_value, cardinality)

  putnam_2003_a1: bool =
    FORALL (n: nat):
      n > 0 IMPLIES
        has_cardinality(admissible_sequences(n), n)
END putnam_2003_a1

content:
;; Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2003_a2:
;; the geometric mean of coordinatewise sums of two finite nonnegative real
;; sequences dominates the sum of their geometric means. This file contains
;; no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))

;; For each positive list length n, introduce the unique nonnegative n-th
;; roots x, y, and z of product(a_i), product(b_i), and product(a_i+b_i).
;; The source inequality is then exactly x+y <= z. The root variables below
;; are universally quantified graph variables constrained by these defining
;; equations, not existential witnesses moved out of the conclusion.
;;
;; This reformulation is first-order over real closed fields for each n.
;; Consequently a real counterexample exists iff a real-algebraic one exists.
;; Every finite tuple of real algebraic entries and roots lies in Q(alpha) for
;; one real algebraic alpha. Rational polynomials in alpha, with alpha given
;; by a rational isolating interval, therefore preserve the arbitrary real
;; domain rather than restricting the source sequences to rational inputs.
;; Sturm-Tarski queries decide equality and order exactly.

;; Rational polynomials in alpha use descending coefficient order.

(defun putnam-2003-a2-rp-p (p)
  (if (consp p)
      (and (rationalp (car p))
           (putnam-2003-a2-rp-p (cdr p)))
    (equal p nil)))

(defun putnam-2003-a2-rp-normalize (p)
  (if (consp p)
      (if (equal (car p) 0)
          (putnam-2003-a2-rp-normalize (cdr p))
        p)
    nil))

(defun putnam-2003-a2-rp-neg (p)
  (if (consp p)
      (cons (- (car p))
            (putnam-2003-a2-rp-neg (cdr p)))
    nil))

(defun putnam-2003-a2-rp-add-raw (p q)
  (declare (xargs :measure (+ (acl2-count p) (acl2-count q))))
  (cond
   ((endp p) q)
   ((endp q) p)
   ((< (len p) (len q))
    (cons (car q)
          (putnam-2003-a2-rp-add-raw p (cdr q))))
   ((< (len q) (len p))
    (cons (car p)
          (putnam-2003-a2-rp-add-raw (cdr p) q)))
   (t
    (cons (+ (car p) (car q))
          (putnam-2003-a2-rp-add-raw (cdr p) (cdr q))))))

(defun putnam-2003-a2-rp-add (p q)
  (putnam-2003-a2-rp-normalize
   (putnam-2003-a2-rp-add-raw p q)))

(defun putnam-2003-a2-rp-sub (p q)
  (putnam-2003-a2-rp-add
   p (putnam-2003-a2-rp-neg q)))

(defun putnam-2003-a2-rp-scale (coefficient p)
  (if (consp p)
      (cons (* coefficient (car p))
            (putnam-2003-a2-rp-scale coefficient (cdr p)))
    nil))

(defun putnam-2003-a2-zeroes (n)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix n)))
  (if (zp n)
      nil
    (cons 0 (putnam-2003-a2-zeroes (- n 1)))))

(defun putnam-2003-a2-rp-scale-shift (coefficient p shift)
  (append
   (putnam-2003-a2-rp-scale coefficient p)
   (putnam-2003-a2-zeroes shift)))

(defun putnam-2003-a2-rp-mul-raw (p q)
  (if (consp p)
      (putnam-2003-a2-rp-add
       (putnam-2003-a2-rp-scale-shift
        (car p) q (len (cdr p)))
       (putnam-2003-a2-rp-mul-raw (cdr p) q))
    nil))

(defun putnam-2003-a2-rp-mul (p q)
  (putnam-2003-a2-rp-normalize
   (putnam-2003-a2-rp-mul-raw p q)))

(defun putnam-2003-a2-rp-eval-aux (p x accumulator)
  (if (consp p)
      (putnam-2003-a2-rp-eval-aux
       (cdr p) x (+ (* accumulator x) (car p)))
    accumulator))

(defun putnam-2003-a2-rp-eval (p x)
  (putnam-2003-a2-rp-eval-aux p x 0))

(defun putnam-2003-a2-rp-derivative-aux (p degree)
  (if (consp p)
      (if (zp degree)
          nil
        (cons (* degree (car p))
              (putnam-2003-a2-rp-derivative-aux
               (cdr p) (- degree 1))))
    nil))

(defun putnam-2003-a2-rp-derivative (p)
  (let ((p (putnam-2003-a2-rp-normalize p)))
    (putnam-2003-a2-rp-normalize
     (putnam-2003-a2-rp-derivative-aux
      p (nfix (- (len p) 1))))))

(defun putnam-2003-a2-rp-rem-fuel (p q fuel)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix fuel)))
  (let ((p (putnam-2003-a2-rp-normalize p))
        (q (putnam-2003-a2-rp-normalize q)))
    (if (or (zp fuel)
            (endp q)
            (< (len p) (len q)))
        p
      (putnam-2003-a2-rp-rem-fuel
       (putnam-2003-a2-rp-sub
        p
        (putnam-2003-a2-rp-scale-shift
         (/ (car p) (car q))
         q
         (- (len p) (len q))))
       q
       (- fuel 1)))))

(defun putnam-2003-a2-rp-rem (p q)
  (putnam-2003-a2-rp-rem-fuel
   p q (+ 1 (len (putnam-2003-a2-rp-normalize p)))))

(defun putnam-2003-a2-rp-sturm-tail (previous current fuel)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix fuel)))
  (let ((current (putnam-2003-a2-rp-normalize current)))
    (if (or (zp fuel) (endp current))
        nil
      (cons
       current
       (putnam-2003-a2-rp-sturm-tail
        current
        (putnam-2003-a2-rp-neg
         (putnam-2003-a2-rp-rem previous current))
        (- fuel 1))))))

(defun putnam-2003-a2-rp-sturm-sequence (p q)
  (let ((p (putnam-2003-a2-rp-normalize p))
        (q (putnam-2003-a2-rp-normalize q)))
    (if (endp p)
        nil
      (cons
       p
       (if (endp q)
           nil
         (cons
          q
          (putnam-2003-a2-rp-sturm-tail
           p q (+ 1 (len p) (len q)))))))))

(defun putnam-2003-a2-rational-sign (x)
  (cond ((< x 0) -1)
        ((< 0 x) 1)
        (t 0)))

(defun putnam-2003-a2-rp-variations-aux
    (polynomials x previous-sign)
  (if (consp polynomials)
      (let ((sign
             (putnam-2003-a2-rational-sign
              (putnam-2003-a2-rp-eval
               (car polynomials) x))))
        (if (equal sign 0)
            (putnam-2003-a2-rp-variations-aux
             (cdr polynomials) x previous-sign)
          (+ (if (and (not (equal previous-sign 0))
                      (not (equal sign previous-sign)))
                 1
               0)
             (putnam-2003-a2-rp-variations-aux
              (cdr polynomials) x sign))))
    0))

(defun putnam-2003-a2-rp-variations (polynomials x)
  (putnam-2003-a2-rp-variations-aux polynomials x 0))

(defun putnam-2003-a2-rp-cauchy-index (p q lower upper)
  (let ((sequence
         (putnam-2003-a2-rp-sturm-sequence p q)))
    (- (putnam-2003-a2-rp-variations sequence lower)
       (putnam-2003-a2-rp-variations sequence upper))))

(defun putnam-2003-a2-rp-root-count (p lower upper)
  (putnam-2003-a2-rp-cauchy-index
   p (putnam-2003-a2-rp-derivative p) lower upper))

(defun putnam-2003-a2-primitive-p (primitive lower upper)
  (and
   (putnam-2003-a2-rp-p primitive)
   (consp (putnam-2003-a2-rp-normalize primitive))
   (rationalp lower)
   (rationalp upper)
   (< lower upper)
   (not (equal
         (putnam-2003-a2-rp-eval primitive lower) 0))
   (not (equal
         (putnam-2003-a2-rp-eval primitive upper) 0))
   (equal
    (putnam-2003-a2-rp-root-count primitive lower upper)
    1)
   (not
    (equal
     (putnam-2003-a2-rp-cauchy-index
      primitive
      (putnam-2003-a2-rp-mul
       (putnam-2003-a2-rp-derivative primitive)
       (putnam-2003-a2-rp-derivative primitive))
      lower
      upper)
     0))))

;; For the isolated simple root alpha, this query is sign(value(alpha)).
(defun putnam-2003-a2-algebraic-sign
    (primitive lower upper value)
  (putnam-2003-a2-rp-cauchy-index
   primitive
   (putnam-2003-a2-rp-mul
    (putnam-2003-a2-rp-derivative primitive)
    value)
   lower
   upper))

(defun putnam-2003-a2-algebraic-equal-p
    (primitive lower upper left right)
  (equal
   (putnam-2003-a2-algebraic-sign
    primitive lower upper
    (putnam-2003-a2-rp-sub left right))
   0))

(defun putnam-2003-a2-algebraic-nonnegative-p
    (primitive lower upper value)
  (not
   (equal
    (putnam-2003-a2-algebraic-sign
     primitive lower upper value)
    -1)))

(defun putnam-2003-a2-algebraic-list-p (values)
  (if (consp values)
      (and
       (putnam-2003-a2-rp-p (car values))
       (putnam-2003-a2-algebraic-list-p (cdr values)))
    (equal values nil)))

(defun putnam-2003-a2-nonnegative-list-p
    (primitive lower upper values)
  (if (consp values)
      (and
       (putnam-2003-a2-algebraic-nonnegative-p
        primitive lower upper (car values))
       (putnam-2003-a2-nonnegative-list-p
        primitive lower upper (cdr values)))
    (equal values nil)))

(defun putnam-2003-a2-pointwise-sum (left right)
  (if (and (consp left) (consp right))
      (cons
       (putnam-2003-a2-rp-add (car left) (car right))
       (putnam-2003-a2-pointwise-sum
        (cdr left) (cdr right)))
    nil))

(defun putnam-2003-a2-product (values)
  (if (consp values)
      (putnam-2003-a2-rp-mul
       (car values)
       (putnam-2003-a2-product (cdr values)))
    (list 1)))

(defun putnam-2003-a2-power (value exponent)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix exponent)))
  (if (zp exponent)
      (list 1)
    (putnam-2003-a2-rp-mul
     value
     (putnam-2003-a2-power value (- exponent 1)))))

(defun putnam-2003-a2-nonnegative-root-p
    (primitive lower upper radicand exponent root)
  (and
   (putnam-2003-a2-algebraic-nonnegative-p
    primitive lower upper root)
   (putnam-2003-a2-algebraic-equal-p
    primitive lower upper
    (putnam-2003-a2-power root exponent)
    radicand)))

(defun putnambench-putnam-2003-a2-statement
    (primitive lower upper a b a-root b-root sum-root)
  (let* ((n (len a))
         (a-product (putnam-2003-a2-product a))
         (b-product (putnam-2003-a2-product b))
         (sum-product
          (putnam-2003-a2-product
           (putnam-2003-a2-pointwise-sum a b))))
    (implies
     (and
      (putnam-2003-a2-primitive-p primitive lower upper)
      (consp a)
      (equal (len b) n)
      (putnam-2003-a2-algebraic-list-p a)
      (putnam-2003-a2-algebraic-list-p b)
      (putnam-2003-a2-nonnegative-list-p
       primitive lower upper a)
      (putnam-2003-a2-nonnegative-list-p
       primitive lower upper b)
      (putnam-2003-a2-rp-p a-root)
      (putnam-2003-a2-rp-p b-root)
      (putnam-2003-a2-rp-p sum-root)
      (putnam-2003-a2-nonnegative-root-p
       primitive lower upper a-product n a-root)
      (putnam-2003-a2-nonnegative-root-p
       primitive lower upper b-product n b-root)
      (putnam-2003-a2-nonnegative-root-p
       primitive lower upper sum-product n sum-root))
     (putnam-2003-a2-algebraic-nonnegative-p
      primitive lower upper
      (putnam-2003-a2-rp-sub
       sum-root
       (putnam-2003-a2-rp-add a-root b-root))))))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

title: putnam_2003_a2
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2003_a2
-- (putnambench__agda__putnam_2003_a2): Minkowski's inequality for the nth
-- roots of products of two finite families of nonnegative real numbers.
-- This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module Putnam2003A2 where

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; _*_)

infix 4 _!=_
infixr 3 _and_
infixr 2 _or_

data Bottom : Set where

Not : Set -> Set
Not A =
  A -> Bottom

_!=_ : {A : Set} -> A -> A -> Set
x != y =
  Not (x == y)

record _and_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data _or_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  left  : A -> A or B
  right : B -> A or B

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

data Positive : Nat -> Set where
  positive :
    {n : Nat} ->
    Positive (suc n)

data Fin : Nat -> Set where
  fzero :
    {n : Nat} ->
    Fin (suc n)
  fsuc :
    {n : Nat} ->
    Fin n ->
    Fin (suc n)

record CompleteOrderedRealField (R : Set) : Set1 where
  field
    zeroR oneR : R
    add multiply : R -> R -> R
    negate inverse : R -> R
    lessOrEqual : R -> R -> Set
    fromNat : Nat -> R

    one-not-zero :
      oneR != zeroR

    add-commutative :
      (x y : R) ->
      add x y == add y x
    add-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      add (add x y) z == add x (add y z)
    add-zero :
      (x : R) ->
      add x zeroR == x
    add-inverse :
      (x : R) ->
      add x (negate x) == zeroR

    multiply-commutative :
      (x y : R) ->
      multiply x y == multiply y x
    multiply-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply (multiply x y) z ==
      multiply x (multiply y z)
    multiply-one :
      (x : R) ->
      multiply x oneR == x
    multiply-zero :
      (x : R) ->
      multiply x zeroR == zeroR
    distribute :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply x (add y z) ==
      add (multiply x y) (multiply x z)
    inverse-zero :
      inverse zeroR == zeroR
    multiply-inverse :
      (x : R) ->
      x != zeroR ->
      multiply x (inverse x) == oneR

    order-reflexive :
      (x : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x x
    order-transitive :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y z ->
      lessOrEqual x z
    order-antisymmetric :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y x ->
      x == y
    order-total :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y or lessOrEqual y x
    add-order :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual (add z x) (add z y)
    multiply-nonnegative :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR x ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR y ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR (multiply x y)
    zero-less-than-one :
      lessOrEqual zeroR oneR and zeroR != oneR

    fromNat-zero :
      fromNat zero == zeroR
    fromNat-successor :
      (n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (suc n) == add (fromNat n) oneR
    fromNat-addition :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m + n) == add (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-multiplication :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m * n) == multiply (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-injective :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat m == fromNat n ->
      m == n

    archimedean :
      (x : R) ->
      Exists Nat
        (\ n ->
          lessOrEqual x (fromNat n))
    least-upper-bound :
      (P : R -> Set) ->
      Exists R P ->
      Exists R
        (\ upper ->
          (x : R) ->
          P x ->
          lessOrEqual x upper) ->
      Exists R
        (\ supremum ->
          ((x : R) ->
            P x ->
            lessOrEqual x supremum)
          and
          ((upper : R) ->
            ((x : R) ->
              P x ->
              lessOrEqual x upper) ->
            lessOrEqual supremum upper))

open CompleteOrderedRealField

naturalPower :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  Nat ->
  R
naturalPower reals x zero =
  oneR reals
naturalPower reals x (suc n) =
  multiply reals
    (naturalPower reals x n)
    x

productFin :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  {n : Nat} ->
  (Fin n -> R) ->
  R
productFin reals {zero} term =
  oneR reals
productFin reals {suc n} term =
  multiply reals
    (term fzero)
    (productFin reals (\ i -> term (fsuc i)))

record StandardPositiveNthRoots
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) :
  Set1 where

  field
    nthRoot :
      (n : Nat) ->
      Positive n ->
      R ->
      R

    nth-root-nonnegative :
      (n : Nat) ->
      (hn : Positive n) ->
      (x : R) ->
      lessOrEqual reals (zeroR reals) x ->
      lessOrEqual reals
        (zeroR reals)
        (nthRoot n hn x)

    nth-root-power :
      (n : Nat) ->
      (hn : Positive n) ->
      (x : R) ->
      lessOrEqual reals (zeroR reals) x ->
      naturalPower reals (nthRoot n hn x) n == x

    nth-root-unique :
      (n : Nat) ->
      (hn : Positive n) ->
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual reals (zeroR reals) x ->
      lessOrEqual reals (zeroR reals) y ->
      naturalPower reals y n == x ->
      y == nthRoot n hn x

open StandardPositiveNthRoots

module Putnam2003A2Statement
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R)
  (roots : StandardPositiveNthRoots reals) where

  proposition : Set
  proposition =
    (n : Nat) ->
    (hn : Positive n) ->
    (a b : Fin n -> R) ->
    ((i : Fin n) ->
      lessOrEqual reals (zeroR reals) (a i)
      and
      lessOrEqual reals (zeroR reals) (b i)) ->
    lessOrEqual reals
      (add reals
        (nthRoot roots n hn (productFin reals a))
        (nthRoot roots n hn (productFin reals b)))
      (nthRoot roots n hn
        (productFin reals
          (\ i -> add reals (a i) (b i))))

putnam-2003-a2 : Set1
putnam-2003-a2 =
  (R : Set) ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) ->
  (roots : StandardPositiveNthRoots reals) ->
  Putnam2003A2Statement.proposition reals roots

(*
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2003_a2:
  the Minkowski inequality for the geometric means of two finite sequences
  of nonnegative real numbers. This file contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open arithmeticTheory pred_setTheory realTheory real_sigmaTheory transcTheory;

val putnam_2003_a2 =
  ``!n : num. !a b : num -> real.
      0 < n /\
      (!i : num. i < n ==> 0 <= a i /\ 0 <= b i)
      ==>
      REAL_PROD_IMAGE a (count n) powr (1 / &n) +
        REAL_PROD_IMAGE b (count n) powr (1 / &n) <=
      REAL_PROD_IMAGE
        (\i : num. a i + b i)
        (count n) powr (1 / &n)``;

title: putnam_2003_a2
content:
$(
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact
  putnam_2003_a2: the sum of the geometric means of two finite families of
  nonnegative real numbers is at most the geometric mean of their pointwise
  sums. This file contains no proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  RR ^m ( 1 ... n ) is the class of all real-valued functions on the
  one-based n-element interval. This is in bijection with the Fin n and
  zero-based families in the ground-truth sources, and finite products are
  unchanged by that reindexing.

  Each displayed product is nonnegative, and n is positive. Therefore
  set.mm's complex-power operation ^c with exponent 1 / n is real-valued
  and equals the source nonnegative real nth-root operation, including at
  product zero. The final declaration is the single unproved $a corpus
  statement; this database contains no $p proof statement.
$)

${
  $d a b i n $.

  putnambench-putnam-2003-a2 $a |- A. n e. NN
    A. a e. ( RR ^m ( 1 ... n ) )
      A. b e. ( RR ^m ( 1 ... n ) )
        (
          A. i e. ( 1 ... n )
            (
              0 <_ ( a ` i )
              /\
              0 <_ ( b ` i )
            )
          ->
          (
            (
              (
                prod_ i e. ( 1 ... n )
                  ( a ` i )
              )
              ^c
              ( 1 / n )
            )
            +
            (
              (
                prod_ i e. ( 1 ... n )
                  ( b ` i )
              )
              ^c
              ( 1 / n )
            )
          )
          <_
          (
            (
              prod_ i e. ( 1 ... n )
                ( ( a ` i ) + ( b ` i ) )
            )
            ^c
            ( 1 / n )
          )
        )
  $.
$}

:: Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2003_a2:

:: of nonnegative real numbers. This file contains no proof.

environ
  vocabularies TARSKI, XBOOLE_0, SUBSET_1, RELAT_1, FUNCT_1, FUNCT_2,
    NUMBERS, XREAL_0, XCMPLX_0, COMPLEX1, CARD_1, XXREAL_0, ARYTM_1,
    ARYTM_3, REAL_1, INT_1, NAT_1, VALUED_0, VALUED_1, FINSEQ_1,
    FINSEQ_2, ORDINAL1, CARD_3, RVSUM_1, POWER;
  notations TARSKI, XBOOLE_0, SUBSET_1, RELAT_1, FUNCT_1, RELSET_1,
    FUNCT_2, ORDINAL1, CARD_1, NUMBERS, XCMPLX_0, XREAL_0, REAL_1,
    INT_1, COMPLEX1, XXREAL_0, PARTFUN1, FINSEQ_1, FINSEQ_2,
    VALUED_0, VALUED_1, NAT_1, RVSUM_1, POWER;
  constructors FUNCT_1, PARTFUN1, RELSET_1, FUNCT_2, REAL_1, COMPLEX1,
    INT_1, XXREAL_0, NAT_1, FINSEQ_2, RVSUM_1, FINSEQOP, POWER;
  registrations XBOOLE_0, SUBSET_1, RELAT_1, FUNCT_1, RELSET_1,
    FUNCT_2, NUMBERS, CARD_1, XXREAL_0, MEMBERED, VALUED_0, VALUED_1,
    XCMPLX_0, XREAL_0, ORDINAL1, NAT_1, INT_1, FINSEQ_1, FINSEQ_2,
    RVSUM_1;
  requirements REAL, NUMERALS, SUBSET, BOOLE, ARITHM;

begin

::$P-
theorem
  for n being Nat, a,b being FinSequence of REAL st
    n > 0 &
    len a = n &
    len b = n &
    (for k being Nat st k in Seg n holds
      a.k >= 0 & b.k >= 0)
  holds
    (Product a) to_power ((1 qua Real) / (n qua Real)) +
      (Product b) to_power ((1 qua Real) / (n qua Real)) <=
    (Product (a + b)) to_power ((1 qua Real) / (n qua Real))
proof
end;
::$P+

title: putnam_2003_a2
content:
% Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2003_a2:
% Minkowski's product inequality for the geometric means of two finite
% sequences of nonnegative real numbers. This file contains no proof.

putnam_2003_a2: THEORY
BEGIN
  real_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> real]

  prefix_product(values: real_sequence, count: nat): RECURSIVE real =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      1
    ELSE
      prefix_product(values, count - 1) * values(count - 1)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  nonnegative_nth_root(radicand: real, degree: posnat): real =
    epsilon(
      LAMBDA (root: real):
        0 <= root AND root ^ degree = radicand)

  putnam_2003_a2: bool =
    FORALL (n: posnat), (a, b: real_sequence):
      (FORALL (i: nat):
        i < n IMPLIES 0 <= a(i) AND 0 <= b(i))
      IMPLIES
        nonnegative_nth_root(prefix_product(a, n), n)
          + nonnegative_nth_root(prefix_product(b, n), n)
        <= nonnegative_nth_root(
             prefix_product(
               LAMBDA (i: nat): a(i) + b(i),
               n),
             n)
END putnam_2003_a2

title: putnam_2003_a3
content:
Require Import Reals Coquelicot.Coquelicot.
Definition putnam_2003_a3_solution := 2 * sqrt 2 - 1.
Theorem putnam_2003_a3
    (f : R -> R := fun x => Rabs (sin x + cos x + tan x + 1 / tan x + 1 / cos x  + 1 / sin x))
    : (exists x : R, f x = putnam_2003_a3_solution) /\ (forall x : R, f x >= putnam_2003_a3_solution).
Proof. Admitted.

theory putnam_2003_a3 imports Complex_Main
begin

definition putnam_2003_a3_solution::real where "putnam_2003_a3_solution \<equiv> undefined"
(* 2 * sqrt 2 - 1 *)
theorem putnam_2003_a3:
  fixes f::"real\<Rightarrow>real"
  defines "f \<equiv> \<lambda>x::real. abs(sin x + cos x + tan x + 1 / tan x + 1 / cos x + 1 / sin x)"
  shows "putnam_2003_a3_solution = (LEAST y. \<exists>x::real. f x = y)"
  sorry

end

title: putnam_2003_a3
putnam_2003_a3
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2003_a3:
;; the exact minimum over real x of
;; |sin(x)+cos(x)+tan(x)+cot(x)+sec(x)+csc(x)| is 2*sqrt(2)-1.
;; This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))

;; Ordinary ACL2 has no primitive completed-real carrier.  The conservative
;; interfaces below present one without replacing it by ACL2's rationals.
;; Every ordered-field, completeness, Archimedean, square-root, sine, and
;; cosine condition used to identify the standard real operations is an
;; explicit hypothesis of the final predicate.

(defstub putnam-2003-a3-real-p (real-type value) t)
(defstub putnam-2003-a3-zero (real-type) t)
(defstub putnam-2003-a3-one (real-type) t)
(defstub putnam-2003-a3-add (real-type left right) t)
(defstub putnam-2003-a3-mul (real-type left right) t)
(defstub putnam-2003-a3-neg (real-type value) t)
(defstub putnam-2003-a3-inv (real-type value) t)
(defstub putnam-2003-a3-less (real-type left right) t)
(defstub putnam-2003-a3-sin (real-type value) t)
(defstub putnam-2003-a3-cos (real-type value) t)
(defstub putnam-2003-a3-sqrt (real-type value) t)

(defstub putnam-2003-a3-supremum (real-type set) t)

;; Tame unary ACL2 function objects are the repository's unbounded predicate
;; representation for scalar subsets.  Membership is restricted to the real
;; carrier, so completeness is not weakened by an unconstrained family-of-
;; sets tag.

(defun putnam-2003-a3-scalar-set-p (real-type set)
  (declare (ignore real-type))
  (tamep-functionp set))

(defun putnam-2003-a3-scalar-set-member-p
    (real-type set value)
  (and
   (putnam-2003-a3-real-p real-type value)
   (if (apply$ set (list value)) t nil)))

(defun putnam-2003-a3-leq (real-type left right)
  (not (putnam-2003-a3-less real-type right left)))

(defun putnam-2003-a3-positive-p (real-type value)
  (and
   (putnam-2003-a3-real-p real-type value)
   (putnam-2003-a3-less
    real-type (putnam-2003-a3-zero real-type) value)))

(defun putnam-2003-a3-sub (real-type left right)
  (putnam-2003-a3-add
   real-type left (putnam-2003-a3-neg real-type right)))

(defun putnam-2003-a3-div (real-type numerator denominator)
  (putnam-2003-a3-mul
   real-type
   numerator
   (putnam-2003-a3-inv real-type denominator)))

(defun putnam-2003-a3-abs (real-type value)
  (if (putnam-2003-a3-less
       real-type value (putnam-2003-a3-zero real-type))
      (putnam-2003-a3-neg real-type value)
    value))

(defun putnam-2003-a3-nat (real-type n)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix n)))
  (if (zp n)
      (putnam-2003-a3-zero real-type)
    (putnam-2003-a3-add
     real-type
     (putnam-2003-a3-one real-type)
     (putnam-2003-a3-nat real-type (1- n)))))

(defun putnam-2003-a3-power (real-type base exponent)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix exponent)))
  (if (zp exponent)
      (putnam-2003-a3-one real-type)
    (putnam-2003-a3-mul
     real-type
     base
     (putnam-2003-a3-power real-type base (1- exponent)))))

(defun putnam-2003-a3-factorial (real-type n)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix n)))
  (if (zp n)
      (putnam-2003-a3-one real-type)
    (putnam-2003-a3-mul
     real-type
     (putnam-2003-a3-nat real-type n)
     (putnam-2003-a3-factorial real-type (1- n)))))

;; A Dedekind-complete Archimedean ordered field is, up to its unique ordered
;; field isomorphism, the real field.  The inverse is totalized at zero, as in
;; the source provers.

(defun-sk putnam-2003-a3-field-laws-p (real-type)
  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (putnam-2003-a3-real-p real-type x)
      (putnam-2003-a3-real-p real-type y)
      (putnam-2003-a3-real-p real-type z))
     (let* ((zero (putnam-2003-a3-zero real-type))
            (one (putnam-2003-a3-one real-type))
            (xy-add (putnam-2003-a3-add real-type x y))
            (yz-add (putnam-2003-a3-add real-type y z))
            (xy-mul (putnam-2003-a3-mul real-type x y))
            (yz-mul (putnam-2003-a3-mul real-type y z))
            (neg-x (putnam-2003-a3-neg real-type x))
            (inv-x (putnam-2003-a3-inv real-type x)))
       (and
        (putnam-2003-a3-real-p real-type xy-add)
        (putnam-2003-a3-real-p real-type xy-mul)
        (putnam-2003-a3-real-p real-type neg-x)
        (putnam-2003-a3-real-p real-type inv-x)
        (equal
         (putnam-2003-a3-add real-type xy-add z)
         (putnam-2003-a3-add real-type x yz-add))
        (equal xy-add (putnam-2003-a3-add real-type y x))
        (equal (putnam-2003-a3-add real-type x zero) x)
        (equal (putnam-2003-a3-add real-type x neg-x) zero)
        (equal
         (putnam-2003-a3-mul real-type xy-mul z)
         (putnam-2003-a3-mul real-type x yz-mul))
        (equal xy-mul (putnam-2003-a3-mul real-type y x))
        (equal (putnam-2003-a3-mul real-type x one) x)
        (implies (equal x zero) (equal inv-x zero))
        (implies
         (not (equal x zero))
         (equal
          (putnam-2003-a3-mul real-type x inv-x)
          one))
        (equal
         (putnam-2003-a3-mul real-type x yz-add)
         (putnam-2003-a3-add
          real-type
          (putnam-2003-a3-mul real-type x y)
          (putnam-2003-a3-mul real-type x z))))))))

(defun-sk putnam-2003-a3-order-laws-p (real-type)
  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (putnam-2003-a3-real-p real-type x)
      (putnam-2003-a3-real-p real-type y)
      (putnam-2003-a3-real-p real-type z))
     (let ((zero (putnam-2003-a3-zero real-type)))
       (and
        (not (putnam-2003-a3-less real-type x x))
        (or
         (putnam-2003-a3-less real-type x y)
         (equal x y)
         (putnam-2003-a3-less real-type y x))
        (implies
         (and
          (putnam-2003-a3-less real-type x y)
          (putnam-2003-a3-less real-type y z))
         (putnam-2003-a3-less real-type x z))
        (implies
         (putnam-2003-a3-less real-type x y)
         (putnam-2003-a3-less
          real-type
          (putnam-2003-a3-add real-type x z)
          (putnam-2003-a3-add real-type y z)))
        (implies
         (and
          (putnam-2003-a3-less real-type zero x)
          (putnam-2003-a3-less real-type zero y))
         (putnam-2003-a3-less
          real-type
          zero
          (putnam-2003-a3-mul real-type x y))))))))

(defun-sk putnam-2003-a3-upper-bound-p
    (real-type set upper)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (and
      (putnam-2003-a3-real-p real-type x)
      (putnam-2003-a3-scalar-set-member-p real-type set x))
     (putnam-2003-a3-leq real-type x upper))))

(defun-sk putnam-2003-a3-set-nonempty-p (real-type set)
  (exists (x)
    (and
     (putnam-2003-a3-real-p real-type x)
     (putnam-2003-a3-scalar-set-member-p real-type set x))))

(defun-sk putnam-2003-a3-set-bounded-above-p
    (real-type set)
  (exists (upper)
    (and
     (putnam-2003-a3-real-p real-type upper)
     (putnam-2003-a3-upper-bound-p real-type set upper))))

(defun-sk putnam-2003-a3-least-upper-bound-p
    (real-type set supremum)
  (forall (upper)
    (implies
     (and
      (putnam-2003-a3-real-p real-type upper)
      (putnam-2003-a3-upper-bound-p real-type set upper))
     (putnam-2003-a3-leq real-type supremum upper))))

(defun-sk putnam-2003-a3-completeness-p (real-type)
  (forall (set)
    (implies
     (and
      (putnam-2003-a3-scalar-set-p real-type set)
      (putnam-2003-a3-set-nonempty-p real-type set)
      (putnam-2003-a3-set-bounded-above-p real-type set))
     (let ((supremum
            (putnam-2003-a3-supremum real-type set)))
       (and
        (putnam-2003-a3-real-p real-type supremum)
        (putnam-2003-a3-upper-bound-p
         real-type set supremum)
        (putnam-2003-a3-least-upper-bound-p
         real-type set supremum))))))

(defun-sk putnam-2003-a3-archimedean-bound-exists-p
    (real-type x)
  (exists (n)
    (and
     (natp n)
     (putnam-2003-a3-less
      real-type x (putnam-2003-a3-nat real-type n)))))

(defun-sk putnam-2003-a3-archimedean-p (real-type)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (putnam-2003-a3-real-p real-type x)
     (putnam-2003-a3-archimedean-bound-exists-p
      real-type x))))

(defun putnam-2003-a3-real-field-p (real-type)
  (let ((zero (putnam-2003-a3-zero real-type))
        (one (putnam-2003-a3-one real-type)))
    (and
     (putnam-2003-a3-real-p real-type zero)
     (putnam-2003-a3-real-p real-type one)
     (not (equal zero one))
     (putnam-2003-a3-field-laws-p real-type)
     (putnam-2003-a3-order-laws-p real-type)
     (putnam-2003-a3-less real-type zero one)
     (putnam-2003-a3-completeness-p real-type)
     (putnam-2003-a3-archimedean-p real-type))))

;; Sine and cosine are characterized as the limits of their exact Taylor
;; partial sums.  Quantification over every positive real epsilon makes these
;; equalities exact rather than numerical approximations.

(defun putnam-2003-a3-sin-prefix (real-type x terms)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix terms)))
  (if (zp terms)
      (putnam-2003-a3-zero real-type)
    (let* ((index (1- terms))
           (exponent (+ (* 2 index) 1))
           (unsigned
            (putnam-2003-a3-div
             real-type
             (putnam-2003-a3-power real-type x exponent)
             (putnam-2003-a3-factorial
              real-type exponent)))
           (term
            (if (evenp index)
                unsigned
              (putnam-2003-a3-neg real-type unsigned))))
      (putnam-2003-a3-add
       real-type
       (putnam-2003-a3-sin-prefix real-type x index)
       term))))

(defun putnam-2003-a3-cos-prefix (real-type x terms)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix terms)))
  (if (zp terms)
      (putnam-2003-a3-zero real-type)
    (let* ((index (1- terms))
           (exponent (* 2 index))
           (unsigned
            (putnam-2003-a3-div
             real-type
             (putnam-2003-a3-power real-type x exponent)
             (putnam-2003-a3-factorial
              real-type exponent)))
           (term
            (if (evenp index)
                unsigned
              (putnam-2003-a3-neg real-type unsigned))))
      (putnam-2003-a3-add
       real-type
       (putnam-2003-a3-cos-prefix real-type x index)
       term))))

(defun-sk putnam-2003-a3-sin-tail-p
    (real-type x epsilon cutoff)
  (forall (terms)
    (implies
     (and
      (natp terms)
      (natp cutoff)
      (<= cutoff terms))
     (putnam-2003-a3-less
      real-type
      (putnam-2003-a3-abs
       real-type
       (putnam-2003-a3-sub
        real-type
        (putnam-2003-a3-sin-prefix real-type x terms)
        (putnam-2003-a3-sin real-type x)))
      epsilon))))

(defun-sk putnam-2003-a3-cos-tail-p
    (real-type x epsilon cutoff)
  (forall (terms)
    (implies
     (and
      (natp terms)
      (natp cutoff)
      (<= cutoff terms))
     (putnam-2003-a3-less
      real-type
      (putnam-2003-a3-abs
       real-type
       (putnam-2003-a3-sub
        real-type
        (putnam-2003-a3-cos-prefix real-type x terms)
        (putnam-2003-a3-cos real-type x)))
      epsilon))))

(defun-sk putnam-2003-a3-sin-cutoff-exists-p
    (real-type x epsilon)
  (exists (cutoff)
    (and
     (natp cutoff)
     (putnam-2003-a3-sin-tail-p
      real-type x epsilon cutoff))))

(defun-sk putnam-2003-a3-cos-cutoff-exists-p
    (real-type x epsilon)
  (exists (cutoff)
    (and
     (natp cutoff)
     (putnam-2003-a3-cos-tail-p
      real-type x epsilon cutoff))))

(defun-sk putnam-2003-a3-analytic-functions-p (real-type)
  (forall (x epsilon)
    (implies
     (putnam-2003-a3-real-p real-type x)
     (and
      (putnam-2003-a3-real-p
       real-type (putnam-2003-a3-sin real-type x))
      (putnam-2003-a3-real-p
       real-type (putnam-2003-a3-cos real-type x))
      (implies
       (putnam-2003-a3-positive-p real-type epsilon)
       (and
        (putnam-2003-a3-sin-cutoff-exists-p
         real-type x epsilon)
        (putnam-2003-a3-cos-cutoff-exists-p
         real-type x epsilon)))))))

;; The square-root interface is the source provers' total nonnegative square
;; root, including value zero on negative inputs.

(defun-sk putnam-2003-a3-square-root-p (real-type)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (putnam-2003-a3-real-p real-type x)
     (let ((zero (putnam-2003-a3-zero real-type))
           (root (putnam-2003-a3-sqrt real-type x)))
       (and
        (putnam-2003-a3-real-p real-type root)
        (implies
         (putnam-2003-a3-less real-type x zero)
         (equal root zero))
        (implies
         (not (putnam-2003-a3-less real-type x zero))
         (and
          (putnam-2003-a3-leq real-type zero root)
          (equal
           (putnam-2003-a3-mul real-type root root)
           x))))))))

(defun putnam-2003-a3-context-p (real-type)
  (and
   (putnam-2003-a3-real-field-p real-type)
   (putnam-2003-a3-analytic-functions-p real-type)
   (putnam-2003-a3-square-root-p real-type)))

;; This is the source expression itself.  TAN is SIN/COS, while COT, SEC,
;; and CSC are respectively 1/TAN, 1/COS, and 1/SIN.  Totalized inverse at
;; zero matches Lean, Isabelle, and Rocq.

(defun putnam-2003-a3-value (real-type x)
  (let* ((one (putnam-2003-a3-one real-type))
         (sine (putnam-2003-a3-sin real-type x))
         (cosine (putnam-2003-a3-cos real-type x))
         (tangent
          (putnam-2003-a3-div real-type sine cosine))
         (cotangent
          (putnam-2003-a3-div real-type one tangent))
         (secant
          (putnam-2003-a3-div real-type one cosine))
         (cosecant
          (putnam-2003-a3-div real-type one sine)))
    (putnam-2003-a3-abs
     real-type
     (putnam-2003-a3-add
      real-type
      sine
      (putnam-2003-a3-add
       real-type
       cosine
       (putnam-2003-a3-add
        real-type
        tangent
        (putnam-2003-a3-add
         real-type
         cotangent
         (putnam-2003-a3-add
          real-type secant cosecant))))))))

(defun-sk putnam-2003-a3-attained-p
    (real-type solution)
  (exists (x)
    (and
     (putnam-2003-a3-real-p real-type x)
     (equal
      (putnam-2003-a3-value real-type x)
      solution))))

(defun-sk putnam-2003-a3-lower-bound-p
    (real-type solution)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (putnam-2003-a3-real-p real-type x)
     (putnam-2003-a3-leq
      real-type
      solution
      (putnam-2003-a3-value real-type x)))))

;; The conclusion is exactly IsLeast(range f, 2*sqrt(2)-1): the first clause
;; states membership in the range, and the second compares the same exact
;; value with every real input.

(defun-sk putnambench-putnam-2003-a3-statement ()
  (forall (real-type)
    (implies
     (putnam-2003-a3-context-p real-type)
     (let* ((one (putnam-2003-a3-one real-type))
            (two (putnam-2003-a3-add real-type one one))
            (sqrt-two
             (putnam-2003-a3-sqrt real-type two))
            (solution
             (putnam-2003-a3-sub
              real-type
              (putnam-2003-a3-mul
               real-type two sqrt-two)
              one)))
       (and
        (putnam-2003-a3-real-p real-type solution)
        (putnam-2003-a3-attained-p real-type solution)
        (putnam-2003-a3-lower-bound-p
         real-type solution))))))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

title: putnam_2003_a3
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2003_a3
-- (putnambench__agda__putnam_2003_a3): the global minimum over real x of
-- |sin x + cos x + tan x + cot x + sec x + csc x| is 2 * sqrt 2 - 1.
-- This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module Putnam2003A3 where

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; _*_)

infix 4 _!=_ _<=N_
infixr 3 _and_
infixr 2 _or_

data Bottom : Set where

Not : Set -> Set
Not A =
  A -> Bottom

_!=_ : {A : Set} -> A -> A -> Set
x != y =
  Not (x == y)

record _and_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data _or_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  left  : A -> A or B
  right : B -> A or B

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

data _<=N_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set where
  zero<=N   : {n : Nat} -> zero <=N n
  suc<=sucN : {m n : Nat} -> m <=N n -> suc m <=N suc n

oneN : Nat
oneN =
  suc zero

twoN : Nat
twoN =
  suc oneN

record CompleteOrderedRealField (R : Set) : Set1 where
  field
    zeroR oneR : R
    add multiply : R -> R -> R
    negate inverse : R -> R
    lessOrEqual : R -> R -> Set
    fromNat : Nat -> R

    one-not-zero :
      oneR != zeroR

    add-commutative :
      (x y : R) ->
      add x y == add y x
    add-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      add (add x y) z == add x (add y z)
    add-zero :
      (x : R) ->
      add x zeroR == x
    add-inverse :
      (x : R) ->
      add x (negate x) == zeroR

    multiply-commutative :
      (x y : R) ->
      multiply x y == multiply y x
    multiply-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply (multiply x y) z ==
      multiply x (multiply y z)
    multiply-one :
      (x : R) ->
      multiply x oneR == x
    multiply-zero :
      (x : R) ->
      multiply x zeroR == zeroR
    distribute :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply x (add y z) ==
      add (multiply x y) (multiply x z)
    inverse-zero :
      inverse zeroR == zeroR
    multiply-inverse :
      (x : R) ->
      x != zeroR ->
      multiply x (inverse x) == oneR

    order-reflexive :
      (x : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x x
    order-transitive :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y z ->
      lessOrEqual x z
    order-antisymmetric :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y x ->
      x == y
    order-total :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y or lessOrEqual y x
    add-order :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual (add z x) (add z y)
    multiply-nonnegative :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR x ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR y ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR (multiply x y)
    zero-less-than-one :
      lessOrEqual zeroR oneR and zeroR != oneR

    fromNat-zero :
      fromNat zero == zeroR
    fromNat-successor :
      (n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (suc n) == add (fromNat n) oneR
    fromNat-addition :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m + n) == add (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-multiplication :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m * n) == multiply (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-injective :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat m == fromNat n ->
      m == n

    archimedean :
      (x : R) ->
      Exists Nat
        (\ n ->
          lessOrEqual x (fromNat n))
    least-upper-bound :
      (P : R -> Set) ->
      Exists R P ->
      Exists R
        (\ upper ->
          (x : R) ->
          P x ->
          lessOrEqual x upper) ->
      Exists R
        (\ supremum ->
          ((x : R) ->
            P x ->
            lessOrEqual x supremum)
          and
          ((upper : R) ->
            ((x : R) ->
              P x ->
              lessOrEqual x upper) ->
            lessOrEqual supremum upper))

open CompleteOrderedRealField

subtract :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
subtract reals x y =
  add reals x (negate reals y)

divide :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
divide reals x y =
  multiply reals x (inverse reals y)

StrictLess :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
StrictLess reals x y =
  lessOrEqual reals x y and x != y

maximum :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
maximum reals x y with order-total reals x y
... | left _ = y
... | right _ = x

absoluteValue :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R
absoluteValue reals x =
  maximum reals x (negate reals x)

CloseTo :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
CloseTo reals center radius x =
  StrictLess reals
    (subtract reals center radius)
    x
  and
  StrictLess reals
    x
    (add reals center radius)

naturalPower :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  Nat ->
  R
naturalPower reals x zero =
  oneR reals
naturalPower reals x (suc n) =
  multiply reals
    (naturalPower reals x n)
    x

factorial : Nat -> Nat
factorial zero =
  oneN
factorial (suc n) =
  suc n * factorial n

sumFirst :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Nat ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  R
sumFirst reals zero terms =
  zeroR reals
sumFirst reals (suc n) terms =
  add reals
    (sumFirst reals n terms)
    (terms n)

ConvergesTo :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  R ->
  Set
ConvergesTo {R} reals sequence limit =
  (epsilon : R) ->
  StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) epsilon ->
  Exists Nat
    (\ cutoff ->
      (n : Nat) ->
      cutoff <=N n ->
      CloseTo reals limit epsilon (sequence n))

SeriesHasSum :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  R ->
  Set
SeriesHasSum reals terms limit =
  ConvergesTo reals
    (\ n -> sumFirst reals n terms)
    limit

alternatingPower :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Nat ->
  R
alternatingPower reals n =
  naturalPower reals
    (negate reals (oneR reals))
    n

sineTerm :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  Nat ->
  R
sineTerm reals x n =
  divide reals
    (multiply reals
      (alternatingPower reals n)
      (naturalPower reals x (suc (twoN * n))))
    (fromNat reals (factorial (suc (twoN * n))))

cosineTerm :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  Nat ->
  R
cosineTerm reals x n =
  divide reals
    (multiply reals
      (alternatingPower reals n)
      (naturalPower reals x (twoN * n)))
    (fromNat reals (factorial (twoN * n)))

record StandardRealAnalysis
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) :
  Set1 where

  field
    sine cosine squareRoot : R -> R

    sine-series :
      (x : R) ->
      SeriesHasSum reals
        (sineTerm reals x)
        (sine x)

    cosine-series :
      (x : R) ->
      SeriesHasSum reals
        (cosineTerm reals x)
        (cosine x)

    square-root-nonnegative :
      (x : R) ->
      lessOrEqual reals (zeroR reals) x ->
      lessOrEqual reals
        (zeroR reals)
        (squareRoot x)

    square-root-square :
      (x : R) ->
      lessOrEqual reals (zeroR reals) x ->
      multiply reals
        (squareRoot x)
        (squareRoot x)
      == x

open StandardRealAnalysis

tangent :
  {R : Set} ->
  {reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R} ->
  StandardRealAnalysis reals ->
  R ->
  R
tangent {reals = reals} analysis x =
  divide reals
    (sine analysis x)
    (cosine analysis x)

record IsGlobalMinimum
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R)
  (function : R -> R)
  (minimum : R) :
  Set where

  field
    attained :
      Exists R
        (\ x ->
          function x == minimum)

    lower-bound :
      (x : R) ->
      lessOrEqual reals minimum (function x)

module Putnam2003A3Statement
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R)
  (analysis : StandardRealAnalysis reals) where

  trigonometricExpression : R -> R
  trigonometricExpression x =
    absoluteValue reals
      (add reals
        (add reals
          (add reals
            (sine analysis x)
            (cosine analysis x))
          (tangent analysis x))
        (add reals
          (divide reals
            (oneR reals)
            (tangent analysis x))
          (add reals
            (divide reals
              (oneR reals)
              (cosine analysis x))
            (divide reals
              (oneR reals)
              (sine analysis x)))))

  solution : R
  solution =
    subtract reals
      (multiply reals
        (fromNat reals twoN)
        (squareRoot analysis (fromNat reals twoN)))
      (oneR reals)

  proposition : Set
  proposition =
    IsGlobalMinimum reals
      trigonometricExpression
      solution

putnam-2003-a3 : Set1
putnam-2003-a3 =
  (R : Set) ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) ->
  (analysis : StandardRealAnalysis reals) ->
  Putnam2003A3Statement.proposition reals analysis

(*
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2003_a3:
  the minimum over real x of the absolute value of the stated sum of
  trigonometric functions and reciprocals is 2 * sqrt 2 - 1. This file
  contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open realTheory transcTheory;

val putnam_2003_a3 =
  ``let f =
      \x : real.
        abs
          (sin x + cos x + tan x +
           1 / tan x + 1 / cos x + 1 / sin x)
    in
    let m = 2 * sqrt 2 - 1
    in
      (?x : real. f x = m) /\
      (!x : real. m <= f x)``;

$(
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact
  putnam_2003_a3: the minimum over real x of the absolute value of the sum of
  sin(x), cos(x), tan(x), cot(x), sec(x), and csc(x) is
  2 * sqrt(2) - 1. This file contains no proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  P03A3Inv0 is the totalized real reciprocal used by the Lean and Rocq
  sources: it is zero at zero and the ordinary reciprocal elsewhere.
  Accordingly, tangent is expanded as sin(x) times P03A3Inv0(cos(x)); this
  preserves the source values at every real x, including zeros of sine or
  cosine, despite set.mm's partial ordinary division and tangent.

  The antecedent is the source pointwise definition of F. The conclusion
  expands IsLeast of its range into attainment of 2 * sqrt(2) - 1 and the
  corresponding lower bound for every real input. The final declaration is
  the single unproved $a corpus statement; this database contains no $p proof
  statement.
$)

$c P03A3Inv0 $.

p03a3-total-reciprocal-syntax $a class P03A3Inv0 $.

${
  p03a3-total-reciprocal-definition $a |- P03A3Inv0 =
    ( z e. RR |-> if ( z = 0 , 0 , ( 1 / z ) ) )
  $.
$}

${
  $d F x $.

  putnambench-putnam-2003-a3 $a |-
    A. F e. ( RR ^m RR )
      (
        A. x e. RR
          ( F ` x )
          =
          (
            abs
            `
            (
              (
                (
                  (
                    (
                      ( sin ` x )
                      +
                      ( cos ` x )
                    )
                    +
                    (
                      ( sin ` x )
                      x.
                      ( P03A3Inv0 ` ( cos ` x ) )
                    )
                  )
                  +
                  (
                    P03A3Inv0
                    `
                    (
                      ( sin ` x )
                      x.
                      ( P03A3Inv0 ` ( cos ` x ) )
                    )
                  )
                )
                +
                ( P03A3Inv0 ` ( cos ` x ) )
              )
              +
              ( P03A3Inv0 ` ( sin ` x ) )
            )
          )
        ->
        (
          E. x e. RR
            ( F ` x ) = ( ( 2 x. ( sqrt ` 2 ) ) - 1 )
          /\
          A. x e. RR
            ( ( 2 x. ( sqrt ` 2 ) ) - 1 ) <_ ( F ` x )
        )
      )
  $.
$}

title: putnam_2003_a3
content:
% Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2003_a3:
% the minimum over real x of |sin x + cos x + tan x + cot x + sec x + csc x|
% is 2 * sqrt(2) - 1. This file contains no proof.

putnam_2003_a3: THEORY
BEGIN
  safe_div(numerator, denominator: real): real =
    IF denominator = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      numerator / denominator
    ENDIF

  nat_factorial(index: nat): RECURSIVE nat =
    IF index = 0 THEN
      1
    ELSE
      index * nat_factorial(index - 1)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE index

  converges_to(sequence: [nat -> real], value: real): bool =
    FORALL (epsilon_value: posreal):
      EXISTS (cutoff: nat):
        FORALL (index: nat):
          cutoff <= index IMPLIES
            abs(sequence(index) - value) < epsilon_value

  sine_partial(x: real, count: nat): RECURSIVE real =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      LET index: nat = count - 1 IN
        sine_partial(x, count - 1)
          + safe_div(
              ((-1 :: real) ^ index) * x ^ (2 * index + 1),
              nat_factorial(2 * index + 1) :: real)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  cosine_partial(x: real, count: nat): RECURSIVE real =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      LET index: nat = count - 1 IN
        cosine_partial(x, count - 1)
          + safe_div(
              ((-1 :: real) ^ index) * x ^ (2 * index),
              nat_factorial(2 * index) :: real)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  sine(x: real): real =
    epsilon(
      LAMBDA (value: real):
        converges_to(
          LAMBDA (count: nat): sine_partial(x, count),
          value))

  cosine(x: real): real =
    epsilon(
      LAMBDA (value: real):
        converges_to(
          LAMBDA (count: nat): cosine_partial(x, count),
          value))

  tangent(x: real): real =
    safe_div(sine(x), cosine(x))

  objective(x: real): real =
    abs(
      sine(x)
        + cosine(x)
        + tangent(x)
        + safe_div(1, tangent(x))
        + safe_div(1, cosine(x))
        + safe_div(1, sine(x)))

  sqrt_value(root, radicand: real): bool =
    0 <= root AND root * root = radicand

  is_minimum_value(value: real): bool =
    (EXISTS (x: real): objective(x) = value)
      AND (FORALL (x: real): value <= objective(x))

  putnam_2003_a3: bool =
    EXISTS (sqrt_two: real):
      sqrt_value(sqrt_two, 2)
        AND is_minimum_value(2 * sqrt_two - 1)
END putnam_2003_a3

(*

  pointwise absolute-value domination between two real quadratic polynomials
  implies the corresponding domination of their discriminants in absolute
  value. This file contains no proof.
*)

     ~(a = &0) /\ ~(A = &0) /\

title: putnam_2003_a4
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2003_a4:
;; pointwise absolute-value domination of two real quadratic polynomials
;; implies domination of the absolute values of their discriminants. This
;; file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

;; The source theorem is a first-order sentence over the real ordered field.
;; We present its domain as an arbitrary real closed ordered field. The square
;; root and odd-degree-root laws below are the standard algebraic
;; characterization of real closedness, so completeness of real closed fields
;; makes this presentation bidirectionally equivalent to the source statement
;; over the reals. ACL2 function objects supply the field operations, and
;; FN-EQUAL against a constant-T function preserves the internal universal
;; quantifier over every real x in the pointwise hypothesis.

(defun putnam-2003-a4-quoted (object)
  (list 'quote object))

(defun putnam-2003-a4-apply1-term (function argument)
  (list
   'apply$
   (putnam-2003-a4-quoted function)
   (list 'cons argument nil)))

(defun putnam-2003-a4-apply2-term (function left right)
  (list
   'apply$
   (putnam-2003-a4-quoted function)
   (list 'cons left (list 'cons right nil))))

(defun putnam-2003-a4-and-term (terms)
  (if (endp terms)
      (putnam-2003-a4-quoted t)
    (list
     'if
     (car terms)
     (putnam-2003-a4-and-term (cdr terms))
     (putnam-2003-a4-quoted nil))))

(defun putnam-2003-a4-or-term (terms)
  (if (endp terms)
      (putnam-2003-a4-quoted nil)
    (list
     'if
     (car terms)
     (putnam-2003-a4-quoted t)
     (putnam-2003-a4-or-term (cdr terms)))))

(defun putnam-2003-a4-not-term (term)
  (list
   'if
   term
   (putnam-2003-a4-quoted nil)
   (putnam-2003-a4-quoted t)))

(defun putnam-2003-a4-implies-term (antecedent consequent)
  (list
   'if
   antecedent
   consequent
   (putnam-2003-a4-quoted t)))

(defun putnam-2003-a4-true-function (formals)
  (list
   'lambda
   formals
   (putnam-2003-a4-quoted t)))

(defun putnam-2003-a4-carrier-term (carrier element)
  (putnam-2003-a4-apply1-term carrier element))

(defun putnam-2003-a4-operation-term (operation left right)
  (putnam-2003-a4-apply2-term operation left right))

(defun putnam-2003-a4-all-coefficients-function (carrier)
  (list
   'lambda
   '(loop$-gvars loop$-ivars)
   (putnam-2003-a4-carrier-term
    carrier 'loop$-ivars)))

(defun putnam-2003-a4-all-coefficients-term
    (carrier coefficients)
  (list
   'always$+
   (putnam-2003-a4-quoted
    (putnam-2003-a4-all-coefficients-function
     carrier))
   (putnam-2003-a4-quoted nil)
   coefficients))

(defun putnam-2003-a4-polynomial-term
    (carrier zero coefficients)
  (putnam-2003-a4-and-term
   (list
    (list 'true-listp coefficients)
    (list 'consp coefficients)
    (putnam-2003-a4-all-coefficients-term
     carrier coefficients)
    (putnam-2003-a4-or-term
     (list
      (list 'equal
            (list 'len coefficients)
            (putnam-2003-a4-quoted 1))
      (putnam-2003-a4-not-term
       (list 'equal
             (list 'car (list 'last coefficients))
             (putnam-2003-a4-quoted zero))))))))

(defun putnam-2003-a4-field-laws-function
    (carrier zero one add mul neg inv)
  (let* ((x 'x)
         (y 'y)
         (z 'z)
         (qzero (putnam-2003-a4-quoted zero))
         (qone (putnam-2003-a4-quoted one))
         (add-xy
          (putnam-2003-a4-operation-term add x y))
         (add-yz
          (putnam-2003-a4-operation-term add y z))
         (mul-xy
          (putnam-2003-a4-operation-term mul x y))
         (mul-yz
          (putnam-2003-a4-operation-term mul y z))
         (neg-x
          (putnam-2003-a4-apply1-term neg x))
         (inv-x
          (putnam-2003-a4-apply1-term inv x))
         (domain
          (putnam-2003-a4-and-term
           (list
            (putnam-2003-a4-carrier-term carrier x)
            (putnam-2003-a4-carrier-term carrier y)
            (putnam-2003-a4-carrier-term carrier z))))
         (laws
          (putnam-2003-a4-and-term
           (list
            (putnam-2003-a4-carrier-term carrier add-xy)
            (putnam-2003-a4-carrier-term carrier mul-xy)
            (putnam-2003-a4-carrier-term carrier neg-x)
            (putnam-2003-a4-carrier-term carrier inv-x)
            (list
             'equal
             (putnam-2003-a4-operation-term add add-xy z)
             (putnam-2003-a4-operation-term add x add-yz))
            (list
             'equal
             (putnam-2003-a4-operation-term mul mul-xy z)
             (putnam-2003-a4-operation-term mul x mul-yz))
            (list
             'equal
             add-xy
             (putnam-2003-a4-operation-term add y x))
            (list
             'equal
             mul-xy
             (putnam-2003-a4-operation-term mul y x))
            (list
             'equal
             (putnam-2003-a4-operation-term add x qzero)
             x)
            (list
             'equal
             (putnam-2003-a4-operation-term add x neg-x)
             qzero)
            (list
             'equal
             (putnam-2003-a4-operation-term mul x qone)
             x)
            (putnam-2003-a4-implies-term
             (list 'equal x qzero)
             (list 'equal inv-x qzero))
            (putnam-2003-a4-implies-term
             (putnam-2003-a4-not-term
              (list 'equal x qzero))
             (list
              'equal
              (putnam-2003-a4-operation-term mul x inv-x)
              qone))
            (list
             'equal
             (putnam-2003-a4-operation-term mul x add-yz)
             (putnam-2003-a4-operation-term
              add
              (putnam-2003-a4-operation-term mul x y)
              (putnam-2003-a4-operation-term mul x z)))))))
    (list
     'lambda
     '(x y z)
     (putnam-2003-a4-implies-term domain laws))))

(defun putnam-2003-a4-order-laws-function
    (carrier zero add mul lt)
  (let* ((x 'x)
         (y 'y)
         (z 'z)
         (qzero (putnam-2003-a4-quoted zero))
         (lt-xy
          (putnam-2003-a4-operation-term lt x y))
         (lt-yx
          (putnam-2003-a4-operation-term lt y x))
         (lt-yz
          (putnam-2003-a4-operation-term lt y z))
         (lt-xz
          (putnam-2003-a4-operation-term lt x z))
         (domain
          (putnam-2003-a4-and-term
           (list
            (putnam-2003-a4-carrier-term carrier x)
            (putnam-2003-a4-carrier-term carrier y)
            (putnam-2003-a4-carrier-term carrier z))))
         (laws
          (putnam-2003-a4-and-term
           (list
            (putnam-2003-a4-not-term
             (putnam-2003-a4-operation-term lt x x))
            (putnam-2003-a4-or-term
             (list
              lt-xy
              (list 'equal x y)
              lt-yx))
            (putnam-2003-a4-implies-term
             (putnam-2003-a4-and-term
              (list lt-xy lt-yz))
             lt-xz)
            (putnam-2003-a4-implies-term
             lt-xy
             (putnam-2003-a4-operation-term
              lt
              (putnam-2003-a4-operation-term add x z)
              (putnam-2003-a4-operation-term add y z)))
            (putnam-2003-a4-implies-term
             (putnam-2003-a4-and-term
              (list
               (putnam-2003-a4-operation-term lt qzero x)
               (putnam-2003-a4-operation-term lt qzero y)))
             (putnam-2003-a4-operation-term
              lt
              qzero
              (putnam-2003-a4-operation-term mul x y)))))))
    (list
     'lambda
     '(x y z)
     (putnam-2003-a4-implies-term domain laws))))

(defun putnam-2003-a4-square-root-laws-function
    (carrier zero mul lt square-root)
  (let* ((x 'x)
         (qzero (putnam-2003-a4-quoted zero))
         (root
          (putnam-2003-a4-apply1-term square-root x))
         (domain
          (putnam-2003-a4-and-term
           (list
            (putnam-2003-a4-carrier-term carrier x)
            (putnam-2003-a4-not-term
             (putnam-2003-a4-operation-term lt x qzero)))))
         (laws
          (putnam-2003-a4-and-term
           (list
            (putnam-2003-a4-carrier-term carrier root)

title: putnam_2003_a4
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2003_a4
-- (putnambench__agda__putnam_2003_a4): pointwise absolute-value domination
-- between real quadratic polynomials implies domination of their absolute
-- discriminants. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module Putnam2003A4 where

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc)

infix 4 _!=_
infixr 3 _and_
infixr 2 _or_

data Bottom : Set where

Not : Set -> Set
Not A =
  A -> Bottom

_!=_ : {A : Set} -> A -> A -> Set
x != y =
  Not (x == y)

record _and_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data _or_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  left  : A -> A or B
  right : B -> A or B

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

record CompleteOrderedRealField (R : Set) : Set1 where
  field
    zeroR oneR : R
    add multiply : R -> R -> R
    negate inverse absoluteValue : R -> R
    lessOrEqual : R -> R -> Set
    fromNat : Nat -> R

    one-not-zero :
      oneR != zeroR

    add-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> add x y == add y x
    add-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      add (add x y) z == add x (add y z)
    add-zero :
      (x : R) -> add x zeroR == x
    add-inverse :
      (x : R) -> add x (negate x) == zeroR

    multiply-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> multiply x y == multiply y x
    multiply-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply (multiply x y) z ==
      multiply x (multiply y z)
    multiply-one :
      (x : R) -> multiply x oneR == x
    multiply-zero :
      (x : R) -> multiply x zeroR == zeroR
    distribute :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply x (add y z) ==
      add (multiply x y) (multiply x z)
    inverse-zero :
      inverse zeroR == zeroR
    multiply-inverse :
      (x : R) ->
      x != zeroR ->
      multiply x (inverse x) == oneR

    order-reflexive :
      (x : R) -> lessOrEqual x x
    order-transitive :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y z ->
      lessOrEqual x z
    order-antisymmetric :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y x ->
      x == y
    order-total :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y or lessOrEqual y x
    add-order :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual (add z x) (add z y)
    multiply-nonnegative :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR x ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR y ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR (multiply x y)
    zero-less-than-one :
      lessOrEqual zeroR oneR and zeroR != oneR

    absolute-nonnegative :
      (x : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR (absoluteValue x)
    absolute-of-nonnegative :
      (x : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR x ->
      absoluteValue x == x
    absolute-of-nonpositive :
      (x : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x zeroR ->
      absoluteValue x == negate x

    fromNat-zero :
      fromNat zero == zeroR
    fromNat-successor :
      (n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (suc n) == add (fromNat n) oneR
    fromNat-injective :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat m == fromNat n ->
      m == n

    archimedean :
      (x : R) ->
      Exists Nat (\ n -> lessOrEqual x (fromNat n))
    least-upper-bound :
      (P : R -> Set) ->
      Exists R P ->
      Exists R
        (\ upper ->
          (x : R) ->
          P x ->
          lessOrEqual x upper) ->
      Exists R
        (\ supremum ->
          ((x : R) ->
            P x ->
            lessOrEqual x supremum)
          and
          ((upper : R) ->
            ((x : R) ->
              P x ->
              lessOrEqual x upper) ->
            lessOrEqual supremum upper))

open CompleteOrderedRealField

four : Nat
four =
  suc (suc (suc (suc zero)))

subtract :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
subtract reals x y =
  add reals x (negate reals y)

square :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R
square reals x =
  multiply reals x x

quadraticValue :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
quadraticValue reals a b c x =
  add reals
    (add reals
      (multiply reals a (square reals x))
      (multiply reals b x))
    c

discriminant :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
discriminant reals a b c =
  subtract reals
    (square reals b)
    (multiply reals
      (multiply reals (fromNat reals four) a)
      c)

module Putnam2003A4Statement
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) where

  proposition : Set
  proposition =
    (a b c A B C : R) ->
    a != zeroR reals ->
    A != zeroR reals ->
    ((x : R) ->
      lessOrEqual reals
        (absoluteValue reals
          (quadraticValue reals a b c x))
        (absoluteValue reals
          (quadraticValue reals A B C x))) ->
    lessOrEqual reals
      (absoluteValue reals
        (discriminant reals a b c))
      (absoluteValue reals
        (discriminant reals A B C))

putnam-2003-a4 : Set1
putnam-2003-a4 =
  (R : Set) ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) ->
  Putnam2003A4Statement.proposition reals

(*
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2003_a4:
  pointwise absolute-value domination between two real quadratic polynomials
  implies the corresponding domination of their discriminants. This file
  contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open realTheory;

val putnam_2003_a4 =
  ``!a b c A B C : real.
      a <> 0 /\
      A <> 0 /\
      (!x : real.
         abs (a * x pow 2 + b * x + c) <=
         abs (A * x pow 2 + B * x + C))

      abs (b pow 2 - 4 * a * c) <=
      abs (B pow 2 - 4 * A * C)``;

$(
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact
  putnam_2003_a4: pointwise absolute-value domination between two real
  quadratic polynomials implies domination of the absolute values of their
  discriminants, assuming both leading coefficients are nonzero. This file
  contains no proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  SetMM's RR is the full class of real numbers, abs agrees with real absolute
  value on RR, and <_ is the non-strict real order here. All six coefficients
  remain universally quantified, as does the point x in the domination
  hypothesis.

  The final declaration is the single unproved $a corpus statement; this
  database contains no $p proof statement.
$)

${
  $d A B C a b c x $.

  putnambench-putnam-2003-a4 $a |-
    A. a e. RR A. b e. RR A. c e. RR
    A. A e. RR A. B e. RR A. C e. RR
      (
        (
          (
            a =/= 0
            /\
            A =/= 0
          )
          /\
          A. x e. RR
            (
              abs
              `
              (
                (
                  ( a x. ( x ^ 2 ) )
                  +
                  ( b x. x )
                )
                +
                c
              )
            )
            <_
            (
              abs
              `
              (
                (
                  ( A x. ( x ^ 2 ) )
                  +
                  ( B x. x )
                )
                +
                C
              )
            )
        )
        ->
        (
          abs
          `
          (
            ( b ^ 2 )
            -
            ( ( 4 x. a ) x. c )
          )
        )
        <_
        (
          abs
          `
          (
            ( B ^ 2 )
            -
            ( ( 4 x. A ) x. C )
          )
        )
      )
  $.
$}

% Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2003_a4:
% pointwise absolute-value domination between two real quadratics with nonzero

  putnam_2003_a4: bool =
    FORALL (left_a, left_b, left_c, right_a, right_b, right_c: real):
      (left_a /= 0
        AND right_a /= 0
        AND (FORALL (x: real):
          abs(left_a * x ^ 2 + left_b * x + left_c)
