-- Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2004_b6
-- (putnambench__agda__putnam_2004_b6): a positive-integer set whose positive
-- difference set has unbounded successive gaps has asymptotic density zero.
-- This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module Putnam2004B6 where

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; _-_; _*_)

infix 4 _!=_ _<=N_ _<N_
infixr 3 _and_
infixr 2 _or_

data Bottom : Set where

Not : Set -> Set
Not A =
  A -> Bottom

_!=_ : {A : Set} -> A -> A -> Set
x != y =
  Not (x == y)

record _and_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data _or_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  left  : A -> A or B
  right : B -> A or B

record Iff (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor equivalence
  field
    forward  : A -> B
    backward : B -> A

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

data _<=N_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set where
  zero<=N   : {n : Nat} -> zero <=N n
  suc<=sucN : {m n : Nat} -> m <=N n -> suc m <=N suc n

_<N_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set
m <N n =
  suc m <=N n

data Fin : Nat -> Set where
  fzero : {n : Nat} -> Fin (suc n)
  fsuc  : {n : Nat} -> Fin n -> Fin (suc n)

Predicate : Set -> Set1
Predicate A =
  A -> Set

record HasCardinality
  {A : Set}
  (S : Predicate A)
  (cardinality : Nat) :
  Set where

  field
    enumerate :
      Fin cardinality ->
      A

    enumerated-member :
      (i : Fin cardinality) ->
      S (enumerate i)

    enumeration-complete :
      (x : A) ->
      S x ->
      Exists (Fin cardinality)
        (\ i -> x == enumerate i)

    enumeration-injective :
      (i j : Fin cardinality) ->
      enumerate i == enumerate j ->
      i == j

record CompleteOrderedRealField (R : Set) : Set1 where
  field
    zeroR oneR : R
    add multiply : R -> R -> R
    negate inverse : R -> R
    lessOrEqual : R -> R -> Set
    fromNat : Nat -> R

    one-not-zero :
      oneR != zeroR

    add-commutative :
      (x y : R) ->
      add x y == add y x
    add-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      add (add x y) z == add x (add y z)
    add-zero :
      (x : R) ->
      add x zeroR == x
    add-inverse :
      (x : R) ->
      add x (negate x) == zeroR

    multiply-commutative :
      (x y : R) ->
      multiply x y == multiply y x
    multiply-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply (multiply x y) z ==
      multiply x (multiply y z)
    multiply-one :
      (x : R) ->
      multiply x oneR == x
    multiply-zero :
      (x : R) ->
      multiply x zeroR == zeroR
    distribute :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply x (add y z) ==
      add (multiply x y) (multiply x z)
    inverse-zero :
      inverse zeroR == zeroR
    multiply-inverse :
      (x : R) ->
      x != zeroR ->
      multiply x (inverse x) == oneR

    order-reflexive :
      (x : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x x
    order-transitive :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y z ->
      lessOrEqual x z
    order-antisymmetric :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y x ->
      x == y
    order-total :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y or lessOrEqual y x
    add-order :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual (add z x) (add z y)
    multiply-nonnegative :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR x ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR y ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR (multiply x y)
    zero-less-than-one :
      lessOrEqual zeroR oneR and zeroR != oneR

    fromNat-zero :
      fromNat zero == zeroR
    fromNat-successor :
      (n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (suc n) == add (fromNat n) oneR
    fromNat-addition :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m + n) == add (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-multiplication :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m * n) == multiply (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-injective :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat m == fromNat n ->
      m == n

    archimedean :
      (x : R) ->
      Exists Nat
        (\ n -> lessOrEqual x (fromNat n))

    least-upper-bound :
      (P : R -> Set) ->
      Exists R P ->
      Exists R
        (\ upper ->
          (x : R) ->
          P x ->
          lessOrEqual x upper) ->
      Exists R
        (\ supremum ->
          ((x : R) ->
            P x ->
            lessOrEqual x supremum)
          and
          ((upper : R) ->
            ((x : R) ->
              P x ->
              lessOrEqual x upper) ->
            lessOrEqual supremum upper))

open CompleteOrderedRealField

subtract :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
subtract reals x y =
  add reals x (negate reals y)

divide :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
divide reals x y =
  multiply reals x (inverse reals y)

StrictLess :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
StrictLess reals x y =
  lessOrEqual reals x y and x != y

CloseTo :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
CloseTo reals center radius x =
  StrictLess reals
    (subtract reals center radius)
    x
  and
  StrictLess reals
    x
    (add reals center radius)

LimitAtPositiveInfinity :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (R -> R) ->
  R ->
  Set
LimitAtPositiveInfinity {R} reals function limit =
  (epsilon : R) ->
  StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) epsilon ->
  Exists R
    (\ threshold ->
      (x : R) ->
      lessOrEqual reals threshold x ->
      CloseTo reals limit epsilon (function x))

Positive : Nat -> Set
Positive n =
  zero <N n

module Putnam2004B6Statement
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) where

  CountsAtMost :
    Predicate Nat ->
    (R -> Nat) ->
    Set
  CountsAtMost A N =
    (x : R) ->
    HasCardinality
      (\ a ->
        A a
        and
        lessOrEqual reals (fromNat reals a) x)
      (N x)

  IsPositiveDifferenceSet :
    Predicate Nat ->
    Predicate Nat ->
    Set
  IsPositiveDifferenceSet A B =
    (d : Nat) ->
    Iff
      (B d)
      (Positive d
      and
      Exists Nat
        (\ a ->
          A a
          and
          Exists Nat
            (\ aPrime ->
              A aPrime
              and
              d == a - aPrime)))

  IsIncreasingEnumeration :
    Predicate Nat ->
    (Nat -> Nat) ->
    Set
  IsIncreasingEnumeration B b =
    ((d : Nat) ->
      Iff
        (B d)
        (Exists Nat (\ i -> b i == d)))
    and
    ((i : Nat) ->
      b i <N b (suc i))

  HasUnboundedGaps :
    (Nat -> Nat) ->
    Set
  HasUnboundedGaps b =
    (r : Nat) ->
    Exists Nat
      (\ i ->
        r <=N (b (suc i) - b i))

  proposition : Set1
  proposition =
    (A B : Predicate Nat) ->
    (N : R -> Nat) ->
    (b : Nat -> Nat) ->
    Exists Nat A ->
    ((a : Nat) -> A a -> Positive a) ->
    CountsAtMost A N ->
    IsPositiveDifferenceSet A B ->
    IsIncreasingEnumeration B b ->
    HasUnboundedGaps b ->
    LimitAtPositiveInfinity reals
      (\ x ->
        divide reals
          (fromNat reals (N x))
          x)
      (zeroR reals)

putnam-2004-b6 : Set1
putnam-2004-b6 =
  (R : Set) ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) ->
  Putnam2004B6Statement.proposition reals

title: putnam_2004_b6
content:
% Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2004_b6:
% a nonempty set of positive integers whose positive differences have
% unbounded consecutive gaps has counting function of asymptotic density zero.
% This file contains no proof.

putnam_2004_b6: THEORY
BEGIN
  natural_set: TYPE = [nat -> bool]
  natural_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> nat]
  real_counting_function: TYPE = [real -> nat]

  injective_below(
      enumeration: natural_sequence,
      cardinality: nat): bool =
    FORALL (i, j: nat):
      i < cardinality
        AND j < cardinality
        AND enumeration(i) = enumeration(j)
      IMPLIES i = j

  enumerates_exactly(
      enumeration: natural_sequence,
      set_value: natural_set,
      cardinality: nat): bool =
    FORALL (value: nat):
      set_value(value)
        IFF
          EXISTS (position: nat):
            position < cardinality
              AND enumeration(position) = value

  has_cardinality(
      set_value: natural_set,
      cardinality: nat): bool =
    EXISTS (enumeration: natural_sequence):
      injective_below(enumeration, cardinality)
        AND enumerates_exactly(
          enumeration, set_value, cardinality)

  bounded_members(A: natural_set, x: real): natural_set =
    LAMBDA (a: nat):
      A(a) AND (a :: real) <= x

  is_counting_function(
      A: natural_set,
      N: real_counting_function): bool =
    FORALL (x: real):
      has_cardinality(bounded_members(A, x), N(x))

  is_positive_difference_set(
      A, B: natural_set): bool =
    FORALL (difference: nat):
      B(difference)
        IFF
          difference > 0
            AND EXISTS (a, a_prime: nat):
              A(a)
                AND A(a_prime)
                AND difference = a - a_prime

  is_increasing_enumeration(
      B: natural_set,
      b: natural_sequence): bool =
    (FORALL (difference: nat):
      B(difference)
        IFF EXISTS (index: nat):
          b(index) = difference)
      AND
        (FORALL (index: nat):
          b(index) < b(index + 1))

  has_unbounded_gaps(b: natural_sequence): bool =
    FORALL (bound: nat):
      EXISTS (index: nat):
        b(index + 1) - b(index) >= bound

  safe_real_division(
      numerator, denominator: real): real =
    IF denominator = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      numerator / denominator
    ENDIF

  density_tends_to_zero(
      N: real_counting_function): bool =
    FORALL (epsilon_value: posreal):
      EXISTS (cutoff: real):
        FORALL (x: real):
          cutoff <= x IMPLIES
            abs(
              safe_real_division(N(x) :: real, x))
              < epsilon_value

  putnam_2004_b6: bool =
    FORALL
        (A, B: natural_set),
        (N: real_counting_function),
        (b: natural_sequence):
      ((EXISTS (a: nat): A(a))
        AND (FORALL (a: nat):
          A(a) IMPLIES a > 0)
        AND is_counting_function(A, N)
        AND is_positive_difference_set(A, B)
        AND is_increasing_enumeration(B, b))
      IMPLIES
        (has_unbounded_gaps(b)
          IMPLIES density_tends_to_zero(N))
END putnam_2004_b6

;; Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2005_a1:
;; every positive integer is a finite nonempty sum of numbers 2^r * 3^s with
;; natural exponents, with no distinct summand dividing another. This file
;; contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

;; Every summand is positive, so a decomposition of n has length at most n.
;; Also, 2^r * 3^s <= n implies r <= n and s <= n. Thus enumerating nonempty
;; lists of at most n exponent pairs, with both exponents at most n, is
;; bidirectionally equivalent to the source's existential quantification.

(defun putnam-2005-a1-pairs-with-first-through-second (first second)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix second)))
  (if (zp second)
      (list (cons (nfix first) 0))
    (cons
     (cons (nfix first) second)
     (putnam-2005-a1-pairs-with-first-through-second
      first
      (- second 1)))))

(defun putnam-2005-a1-pairs-through-first (first bound)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix first)))
  (if (zp first)
      (putnam-2005-a1-pairs-with-first-through-second
       0 bound)
    (append
     (putnam-2005-a1-pairs-with-first-through-second
      first bound)
     (putnam-2005-a1-pairs-through-first
      (- first 1)
      bound))))

(defun putnam-2005-a1-prepend-pair-to-each (pair sequences)
  (if (consp sequences)
      (cons
       (cons pair (car sequences))
       (putnam-2005-a1-prepend-pair-to-each
        pair
        (cdr sequences)))
    nil))

(defun putnam-2005-a1-prepend-each-pair (pairs sequences)
  (if (consp pairs)
      (append
       (putnam-2005-a1-prepend-pair-to-each
        (car pairs)
        sequences)
       (putnam-2005-a1-prepend-each-pair
        (cdr pairs)
        sequences))
    nil))

(defun putnam-2005-a1-sequences-exact (length pairs)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix length)))
  (if (zp length)
      (list nil)
    (putnam-2005-a1-prepend-each-pair
     pairs
     (putnam-2005-a1-sequences-exact
      (- length 1)
      pairs))))

(defun putnam-2005-a1-sequences-through (length pairs)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix length)))
  (if (zp length)
      nil
    (append
     (putnam-2005-a1-sequences-exact length pairs)
     (putnam-2005-a1-sequences-through
      (- length 1)
      pairs))))

(defun putnam-2005-a1-exponent-pair-p (pair)
  (and (consp pair)
       (natp (car pair))
       (natp (cdr pair))))

(defun putnam-2005-a1-term (pair)
  (* (expt 2 (car pair))
     (expt 3 (cdr pair))))

(defun putnam-2005-a1-divides-p (divisor value)
  (and (posp divisor)
       (integerp value)
       (equal (mod value divisor) 0)))

(defun putnam-2005-a1-compatible-with-sequence-p
    (pair sequence)
  (if (consp sequence)
      (let ((term (putnam-2005-a1-term pair))
            (other (putnam-2005-a1-term (car sequence))))
        (and
         (not (putnam-2005-a1-divides-p term other))
         (not (putnam-2005-a1-divides-p other term))
         (putnam-2005-a1-compatible-with-sequence-p
          pair
          (cdr sequence))))
    (equal sequence nil)))

(defun putnam-2005-a1-pairwise-nondividing-p (sequence)
  (if (consp sequence)
      (and
       (putnam-2005-a1-compatible-with-sequence-p
        (car sequence)
        (cdr sequence))
       (putnam-2005-a1-pairwise-nondividing-p
        (cdr sequence)))
    (equal sequence nil)))

(defun putnam-2005-a1-exponent-pair-list-p (sequence)
  (if (consp sequence)
      (and
       (putnam-2005-a1-exponent-pair-p (car sequence))
       (putnam-2005-a1-exponent-pair-list-p
        (cdr sequence)))
    (equal sequence nil)))

(defun putnam-2005-a1-sum (sequence)
  (if (consp sequence)
      (+ (putnam-2005-a1-term (car sequence))
         (putnam-2005-a1-sum (cdr sequence)))
    0))

(defun putnam-2005-a1-valid-decomposition-p (sequence n)
  (and
   (consp sequence)
   (putnam-2005-a1-exponent-pair-list-p sequence)
   (equal (putnam-2005-a1-sum sequence) n)
   (putnam-2005-a1-pairwise-nondividing-p sequence)))

(defun putnam-2005-a1-some-valid-decomposition-p
    (sequences n)
  (if (consp sequences)
      (or
       (putnam-2005-a1-valid-decomposition-p
        (car sequences)
        n)
       (putnam-2005-a1-some-valid-decomposition-p
        (cdr sequences)
        n))
    nil))

(defun putnam-2005-a1-decomposition-exists-p (n)
  (and
   (posp n)
   (let ((pairs
          (putnam-2005-a1-pairs-through-first n n)))
     (putnam-2005-a1-some-valid-decomposition-p
      (putnam-2005-a1-sequences-through n pairs)
      n))))

(defun putnambench-putnam-2005-a1-statement (n)
  (implies
   (and (integerp n)
        (< 0 n))
   (putnam-2005-a1-decomposition-exists-p n)))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

-- Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2005_a1
-- (putnambench__agda__putnam_2005_a1): every positive integer is a finite sum
-- of numbers 2^r * 3^s with nonnegative exponents, with no summand dividing
-- another. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module Putnam2005A1 where

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Int using (Int; pos)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; _*_)

infix 4 _!=_ _divides_
infixr 3 _and_

data Bottom : Set where

Not : Set -> Set
Not A =
  A -> Bottom

_!=_ : {A : Set} -> A -> A -> Set
x != y =
  Not (x == y)

record _and_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

data Fin : Nat -> Set where
  fzero : {n : Nat} -> Fin (suc n)
  fsuc  : {n : Nat} -> Fin n -> Fin (suc n)

record _divides_ (divisor dividend : Nat) : Set where
  constructor divisibility
  field
    quotient : Nat
    equation : divisor * quotient == dividend

one : Nat
one =
  suc zero

two : Nat
two =
  suc one

three : Nat
three =
  suc two

naturalPower : Nat -> Nat -> Nat
naturalPower base zero =
  one
naturalPower base (suc exponent) =
  naturalPower base exponent * base

sumFin :
  {k : Nat} ->
  (Fin k -> Nat) ->
  Nat
sumFin {zero} term =
  zero
sumFin {suc k} term =
  term fzero + sumFin (\ i -> term (fsuc i))

summand :
  {k : Nat} ->
  (Fin k -> Fin two -> Nat) ->
  Fin k ->
  Nat
summand exponents i =
  naturalPower two (exponents i fzero) *
  naturalPower three (exponents i (fsuc fzero))

PairwiseNondividing :
  {k : Nat} ->
  (Fin k -> Fin two -> Nat) ->
  Set
PairwiseNondividing {k} exponents =
  (i j : Fin k) ->
  i != j ->
  Not (summand exponents i divides summand exponents j)

PositiveInteger : Int -> Set
PositiveInteger n =
  Exists Nat (\ predecessor -> n == pos (suc predecessor))

putnam-2005-a1 : Set
putnam-2005-a1 =
  (n : Int) ->
  PositiveInteger n ->
  Exists Nat
    (\ k ->
      Exists (Fin k -> Fin two -> Nat)
        (\ exponents ->
          (n == pos (sumFin (summand exponents)))
          and
          PairwiseNondividing exponents))

% Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2005_a1:
% every positive integer is a nonempty finite sum of numbers of the form
% 2^r * 3^s, with nonnegative exponents, such that no distinct summand
% divides another. This file contains no proof.

putnam_2005_a1: THEORY
BEGIN
  exponent_coordinate: TYPE = below(2)
  exponent_pair: TYPE = [exponent_coordinate -> nat]
  exponent_table: TYPE = [nat -> exponent_pair]

  summand(exponents: exponent_table, index: nat): nat =
    2 ^ exponents(index)(0) * 3 ^ exponents(index)(1)

  finite_sum(
      exponents: exponent_table,
      count: nat): RECURSIVE nat =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      finite_sum(exponents, count - 1)
        + summand(exponents, count - 1)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  nat_divides(divisor, value: nat): bool =
    EXISTS (quotient: nat):
      value = divisor * quotient

  putnam_2005_a1: bool =
    FORALL (n: int):
      n > 0 IMPLIES
        EXISTS (count: posnat), (exponents: exponent_table):
          n = (finite_sum(exponents, count) :: int)
            AND
              (FORALL (i, j: nat):
                i < count AND j < count AND i /= j IMPLIES
                  NOT nat_divides(
                    summand(exponents, i),
                    summand(exponents, j)))
END putnam_2005_a1

title: putnam_2005_a2

import Mathlib

open Nat Set

-- uses (ℕ → ℤ × ℤ) instead of (Icc 1 (3 * n) → ℤ × ℤ)
abbrev putnam_2005_a2_solution : ℕ → ℕ := sorry
-- fun n ↦ if n = 1 then 0 else 2 ^ (n - 2)
/--
Let $\mathbf{S} = \{(a,b) | a = 1, 2, \dots,n, b = 1,2,3\}$.
A \emph{rook tour} of $\mathbf{S}$ is a polygonal path made up of line segments connecting points $p_1, p_2, \dots, p_{3n}$ in sequence such that
\begin{enumerate}
\item[(i)] $p_i \in \mathbf{S}$,
\item[(ii)] $p_i$ and $p_{i+1}$ are a unit distance apart, for
$1 \leq i <3n$,
\item[(iii)] for each $p \in \mathbf{S}$ there is a unique $i$ such that
$p_i = p$.
\end{enumerate}
How many rook tours are there that begin at $(1,1)$
and end at $(n,1)$?
-/
theorem putnam_2005_a2
(n : ℕ)
(npos : n > 0)
(S : Set (ℤ × ℤ))
(unit : ℤ × ℤ → ℤ × ℤ → Prop)
(rooktour : (ℕ → ℤ × ℤ) → Prop)
(hS : S = prod (Icc 1 (n : ℤ)) (Icc 1 3))
(hunit : unit = fun (a, b) (c, d) ↦ a = c ∧ |d - b| = 1 ∨ b = d ∧ |c - a| = 1)
(hrooktour : rooktour = fun p ↦ (∀ P ∈ S, ∃! i, i ∈ Icc 1 (3 * n) ∧ p i = P) ∧ (∀ i ∈ Icc 1 (3 * n - 1), unit (p i) (p (i + 1))) ∧ p 0 = 0 ∧ ∀ i > 3 * n, p i = 0)
: ({p : ℕ → ℤ × ℤ | rooktour p ∧ p 1 = (1, 1) ∧ p (3 * n) = ((n : ℤ), 1)}.encard = putnam_2005_a2_solution n) :=
sorry

title: putnam_2005_a2
content:
(* Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2005_a2:
   the number of unit-step rook tours through every point of an n-by-3
   integer grid, from (1,1) to (n,1). This file contains no proof. *)

From Stdlib Require Import Arith.PeanoNat Lists.List ZArith.

Open Scope Z_scope.

Definition putnam_2005_a2_point : Type := (Z * Z)%type.

Definition putnam_2005_a2_board
    (n : nat) (P : putnam_2005_a2_point) : Prop :=
  let '(a, b) := P in
  1 <= a <= Z.of_nat n /\ 1 <= b <= 3.

Definition putnam_2005_a2_unit
    (P Q : putnam_2005_a2_point) : Prop :=
  let '(a, b) := P in
  let '(c, d) := Q in
  (a = c /\ Z.abs (d - b) = 1) \/
  (b = d /\ Z.abs (c - a) = 1).

Definition putnam_2005_a2_same_path
    (p q : nat -> putnam_2005_a2_point) : Prop :=
  forall i : nat, p i = q i.

Fixpoint putnam_2005_a2_pairwise_distinct
    {A : Type} (equiv : A -> A -> Prop) (xs : list A) : Prop :=
  match xs with
  | nil => True
  | cons x tail =>
      (forall y : A, In y tail -> ~ equiv x y) /\
      putnam_2005_a2_pairwise_distinct equiv tail
  end.

Definition putnam_2005_a2_has_cardinality
    {A : Type} (equiv : A -> A -> Prop)
    (P : A -> Prop) (cardinality : nat) : Prop :=
  exists representatives : list A,
    putnam_2005_a2_pairwise_distinct equiv representatives /\
    (forall x : A,
        P x <->
        exists representative : A,
          In representative representatives /\
          equiv x representative) /\
    length representatives = cardinality.

Definition putnam_2005_a2_rook_tour
    (n : nat) (p : nat -> putnam_2005_a2_point) : Prop :=
  (forall P : putnam_2005_a2_point,
      putnam_2005_a2_board n P ->
      exists i : nat,
        ((1 <= i <= 3 * n)%nat /\ p i = P) /\
        forall j : nat,
          ((1 <= j <= 3 * n)%nat /\ p j = P) ->
          j = i) /\
  (forall i : nat,
      (1 <= i <= 3 * n - 1)%nat ->
      putnam_2005_a2_unit (p i) (p (i + 1)%nat)) /\
  p 0%nat = (0, 0) /\
  forall i : nat,
    (3 * n < i)%nat ->
    p i = (0, 0).

Definition putnam_2005_a2_qualifying_tour
    (n : nat) (p : nat -> putnam_2005_a2_point) : Prop :=
  putnam_2005_a2_rook_tour n p /\
  p 1%nat = (1, 1) /\
  p (3 * n)%nat = (Z.of_nat n, 1).

Definition putnam_2005_a2_solution (n : nat) : nat :=
  if Nat.eqb n 1%nat
  then 0%nat
  else Nat.pow 2%nat (n - 2)%nat.

Theorem putnam_2005_a2 :
  forall n : nat,
    (0 < n)%nat ->
    putnam_2005_a2_has_cardinality
      putnam_2005_a2_same_path
      (putnam_2005_a2_qualifying_tour n)
      (putnam_2005_a2_solution n).
Admitted.

(* uses (nat \<Rightarrow> (int \<times> int)) instead of ({1..(3*n)} \<Rightarrow> (int \<times> int)) *)
definition putnam_2005_a2_solution :: "nat \<Rightarrow> nat" where "putnam_2005_a2_solution \<equiv> undefined"
(* (\<lambda>n::nat. if n = 1 then 0 else 2 ^ (n - 2)) *)
theorem putnam_2005_a2:
  fixes n :: nat
  and S :: "(int \<times> int) set"
  and unit :: "(int \<times> int) \<Rightarrow> (int \<times> int) \<Rightarrow> bool"
  and rooktour :: "(nat \<Rightarrow> (int \<times> int)) \<Rightarrow> bool"
  assumes npos: "n > 0"
  defines "S \<equiv> {1..n} \<times> {1..3}"
  and "unit \<equiv> (\<lambda>(a::int,b::int)(c::int,d::int). (a = c \<and> \<bar>d - b\<bar> = 1) \<or> (b = d \<and> \<bar>c - a\<bar> = 1))"
  and "rooktour \<equiv> (\<lambda>p::nat\<Rightarrow>(int\<times>int). (\<forall>P\<in>S. \<exists>!i::nat\<in>{1..(3*n)}. p i = P) \<and> (\<forall>i::nat\<in>{1..(3*n-1)}. unit (p i) (p (i+1))) \<and> p 0 = (0, 0) \<and> (\<forall>i::nat>(3*n). p i = (0, 0)))"

  the number of rook tours of an n-by-3 integer grid that start at (1,1) and
  end at (n,1). This file contains no proof.
*)

let statement =
  `!n:num.
     0 < n
     ==>
     let grid =
       {p:int#int |
          (&1:int) <= FST p /\ FST p <= &n /\
          (&1:int) <= SND p /\ SND p <= &3} in
     let unit =
       \p q:int#int.
         (FST p = FST q /\ abs (SND q - SND p) = &1) \/
         (SND p = SND q /\ abs (FST q - FST p) = &1) in
     let rooktour =
       \p:num->int#int.
         (!P:int#int.
            P IN grid
            ==> ?!i:num. i IN (1..3 * n) /\ p i = P) /\
         (!i:num.
            i IN (1..3 * n - 1)
            ==> unit (p i) (p (i + 1))) /\
         p 0 = ((&0:int),(&0:int)) /\
         (!i:num. 3 * n < i ==> p i = ((&0:int),(&0:int))) in

       {p:num->int#int |

title: putnam_2005_a2
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2005_a2:
;; the number of rook tours through every point of an n by 3 integer grid,
;; starting at (1,1) and ending at (n,1), is 0 for n=1 and 2^(n-2) otherwise.
;; This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))

;; The source represents a tour by a total function on the naturals, with
;; value (0,0) at index 0 and at every index above 3*n. Its values at indices
;; 1 through 3*n contain every grid point exactly once. Consequently, taking
;; that finite prefix is a bijection from the source functions to the paths
;; counted below; conversely every counted path has a unique total extension
;; with the required zero values. This finite list is therefore an exact
;; encoding of the source function set, not a restriction to finite tables.

(defun putnam-2005-a2-grid-point-p (point n)
  (and
   (consp point)
   (integerp (car point))
   (integerp (cdr point))
   (<= 1 (car point))
   (<= (car point) n)
   (<= 1 (cdr point))
   (<= (cdr point) 3)))

;; REMAINING is the number of still-unfilled path positions. Each recursive
;; branch chooses one of the four unit-distance neighbors that lies in the
;; grid and has not occurred earlier in the path. Starting with 3*n-1
;; remaining positions forces the final path to contain all 3*n grid points
;; exactly once.
(defun putnam-2005-a2-count-from
    (n current visited remaining)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix remaining)))
  (if (zp remaining)
      (if (equal current (cons n 1)) 1 0)
    (let* ((row (car current))
           (column (cdr current))
           (right (cons (+ row 1) column))
           (left (cons (- row 1) column))
           (up (cons row (+ column 1)))
           (down (cons row (- column 1))))
      (+
       (if (and
            (putnam-2005-a2-grid-point-p right n)
            (not (member-equal right visited)))
           (putnam-2005-a2-count-from
            n right (cons right visited) (- remaining 1))
         0)
       (if (and
            (putnam-2005-a2-grid-point-p left n)
            (not (member-equal left visited)))
           (putnam-2005-a2-count-from
            n left (cons left visited) (- remaining 1))
         0)
       (if (and
            (putnam-2005-a2-grid-point-p up n)
            (not (member-equal up visited)))
           (putnam-2005-a2-count-from
            n up (cons up visited) (- remaining 1))
         0)
       (if (and
            (putnam-2005-a2-grid-point-p down n)
            (not (member-equal down visited)))
           (putnam-2005-a2-count-from
            n down (cons down visited) (- remaining 1))
         0)))))

(defun putnam-2005-a2-rook-tour-count (n)
  (if (and (natp n) (< 0 n))
      (let ((start (cons 1 1)))
        (putnam-2005-a2-count-from
         n start (list start) (- (* 3 n) 1)))
    0))

(defun putnam-2005-a2-solution (n)
  (if (equal n 1)
      0
    (expt 2 (nfix (- n 2)))))

(defun putnambench-putnam-2005-a2-statement (n)
  (implies
   (and (natp n) (< 0 n))
   (equal
    (putnam-2005-a2-rook-tour-count n)
    (putnam-2005-a2-solution n))))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

title: putnam_2005_a2
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2005_a2
-- (putnambench__agda__putnam_2005_a2): the number of unit-step rook tours
-- through every point of an n by 3 integer grid, from (1,1) to (n,1).
-- This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module Putnam2005A2 where

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Int using (Int; pos; negsuc)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _-_; _*_)

infix 4 _<=N_ _<N_
infixr 3 _and_
infixr 2 _or_

record _and_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first-proof  : A
    second-proof : B

data _or_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  left  : A -> A or B
  right : B -> A or B

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

record ExistsUnique (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  field
    unique-value    : A
    unique-property : P unique-value
    uniqueness      : (other : A) -> P other -> other == unique-value

data _<=N_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set where
  zero<=N   : {n : Nat} -> zero <=N n
  suc<=sucN : {m n : Nat} -> m <=N n -> suc m <=N suc n

_<N_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set
m <N n =
  suc m <=N n

record Pair (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor _,_
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

open Pair

data Fin : Nat -> Set where
  fzero : {n : Nat} -> Fin (suc n)
  fsuc  : {n : Nat} -> Fin n -> Fin (suc n)

record HasExtensionalCardinality
  {A : Set}
  (equivalent : A -> A -> Set)
  (member : A -> Set)
  (cardinality : Nat) :
  Set where

  field
    enumerate :
      Fin cardinality ->
      A

    enumerated-member :
      (index : Fin cardinality) ->
      member (enumerate index)

    enumeration-complete :
      (item : A) ->
      member item ->
      Exists (Fin cardinality)
        (\ index -> equivalent item (enumerate index))

    enumeration-injective :
      (left-index right-index : Fin cardinality) ->
      equivalent (enumerate left-index) (enumerate right-index) ->
      left-index == right-index

one : Nat
one =
  suc zero

two : Nat
two =
  suc one

three : Nat
three =
  suc two

power : Nat -> Nat -> Nat
power base zero =
  one
power base (suc exponent) =
  power base exponent * base

Positive : Nat -> Set
Positive n =
  one <=N n

InClosedInterval : Nat -> Nat -> Nat -> Set
InClosedInterval lower upper x =
  lower <=N x and x <=N upper

Point : Set
Point =
  Pair Int Int

GridColumn : Nat -> Int -> Set
GridColumn n coordinate =
  Exists Nat
    (\ predecessor ->
      coordinate == pos (suc predecessor)
      and
      suc predecessor <=N n)

GridRow : Int -> Set
GridRow coordinate =
  coordinate == pos one
  or
  coordinate == pos two
  or
  coordinate == pos three

GridPoint : Nat -> Point -> Set
GridPoint n point =
  GridColumn n (first point)
  and
  GridRow (second point)

successorInt : Int -> Int
successorInt (pos n) =
  pos (suc n)
successorInt (negsuc zero) =
  pos zero
successorInt (negsuc (suc n)) =
  negsuc n

AdjacentIntegers : Int -> Int -> Set
AdjacentIntegers x y =
  successorInt x == y
  or
  successorInt y == x

UnitStep : Point -> Point -> Set
UnitStep left-point right-point =
  (first left-point == first right-point
  and
  AdjacentIntegers (second left-point) (second right-point))
  or
  (second left-point == second right-point
  and
  AdjacentIntegers (first left-point) (first right-point))

zeroPoint : Point
zeroPoint =
  pos zero , pos zero

RookTour : Nat -> (Nat -> Point) -> Set
RookTour n path =
  ((point : Point) ->
    GridPoint n point ->
    ExistsUnique Nat
      (\ index ->
        InClosedInterval one (three * n) index
        and
        path index == point))
  and
  ((index : Nat) ->
    InClosedInterval one (three * n - one) index ->
    UnitStep (path index) (path (suc index)))
  and
  path zero == zeroPoint
  and
  ((index : Nat) ->
    three * n <N index ->
    path index == zeroPoint)

StartsAndEndsCorrectly : Nat -> (Nat -> Point) -> Set
StartsAndEndsCorrectly n path =
  path one == (pos one , pos one)
  and
  path (three * n) == (pos n , pos one)

ValidTour : Nat -> (Nat -> Point) -> Set
ValidTour n path =
  RookTour n path
  and
  StartsAndEndsCorrectly n path

SameTour : (Nat -> Point) -> (Nat -> Point) -> Set
SameTour left-path right-path =
  (index : Nat) ->
  left-path index == right-path index

putnam-2005-a2-solution : Nat -> Nat
putnam-2005-a2-solution zero =
  zero
putnam-2005-a2-solution (suc zero) =
  zero
putnam-2005-a2-solution (suc (suc predecessor)) =
  power two predecessor

putnam-2005-a2 : Set
putnam-2005-a2 =
  (n : Nat) ->
  Positive n ->
  HasExtensionalCardinality
    SameTour
    (ValidTour n)
    (putnam-2005-a2-solution n)

title: putnam_2005_a2
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2005_a2:
  the number of unit-step rook tours visiting every point of an n-by-3
  integer grid exactly once, starting at (1,1) and ending at (n,1).
  This file contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open arithmeticTheory integerTheory pred_setTheory;

val putnam_2005_a2 =
  ``!n : num.
      0 < n
      ==>
      let S =
        {ab : int # int |
           1 <= FST ab /\ FST ab <= int_of_num n /\
           1 <= SND ab /\ SND ab <= 3}
      in
      let indices = IMAGE SUC (count (3 * n))
      in
      let unit =
        \ab : int # int. \cd : int # int.
          (FST ab = FST cd /\ ABS (SND cd - SND ab) = 1) \/
          (SND ab = SND cd /\ ABS (FST cd - FST ab) = 1)
      in
      let rooktour =
        \p : num -> int # int.
          (!P : int # int.
             P IN S
             ==>
             ?!i : num. i IN indices /\ p i = P) /\
          (!i : num.
             i IN IMAGE SUC (count (3 * n - 1))
             ==>
             unit (p i) (p (i + 1))) /\
          p 0 = (0, 0) /\
          (!i : num. 3 * n < i ==> p i = (0, 0))
      in
      let tours =
        {p : num -> int # int |
           rooktour p /\
           p 1 = (1, 1) /\
           p (3 * n) = (int_of_num n, 1)}
      in
        FINITE tours /\
        CARD tours = if n = 1 then 0 else 2 EXP (n - 2)``;

  grid from (1,1) to (n,1). This file contains no proof.

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  A tour is represented by a bijection p from 1 ... 3n onto the grid
  (1 ... n) X. (1 ... 3). This is equivalent to the source's total
  natural-indexed function: restrict it to 1 ... 3n, or extend this finite
  function by the ordered pair (0,0) outside that interval.

  The restricted universal condition says that consecutive points share one
  coordinate and differ by one in the other. The endpoint conditions are
  literal. The right side is the explicit solution recorded with the source
  statement. The final declaration is the single unproved $a corpus
  statement; this database contains no $p proof statement.
$)

${
  $d i n p $.

  putnambench-putnam-2005-a2 $a |- A. n e. NN
    (
      (
        #
        `
        {
          p e.
            (
              ( ( 1 ... n ) X. ( 1 ... 3 ) )
              ^m
              ( 1 ... ( 3 x. n ) )
            )
          |
          (
            p
            :
            ( 1 ... ( 3 x. n ) )
            -1-1-onto->
            ( ( 1 ... n ) X. ( 1 ... 3 ) )
            /\
            (
              (
                ( p ` 1 ) = <. 1 , 1 >.
                /\
                ( p ` ( 3 x. n ) ) = <. n , 1 >.
              )
              /\
              A. i e. ( 1 ... ( ( 3 x. n ) - 1 ) )
                (
                  (
                    (
                      ( 1st ` ( p ` i ) )
                      =
                      ( 1st ` ( p ` ( i + 1 ) ) )
                      /\
                      (
                        abs
                        `
                        (
                          ( 2nd ` ( p ` ( i + 1 ) ) )
                          -
                          ( 2nd ` ( p ` i ) )
                        )
                      )
                      =
                      1
                    )
                    \/
                    (
                      ( 2nd ` ( p ` i ) )
                      =
                      ( 2nd ` ( p ` ( i + 1 ) ) )
                      /\
                      (
                        abs
                        `
                        (
                          ( 1st ` ( p ` ( i + 1 ) ) )
                          -
                          ( 1st ` ( p ` i ) )
                        )
                      )
                      =
                      1
                    )
                  )
                )
            )
          )
        }
      )
      =
      if
      (
        n = 1 ,
        0 ,
        ( 2 ^ ( n - 2 ) )
      )
    )
  $.
$}

content:
% Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2005_a2:
% the number of rook tours through every point of an n-by-3 integer grid,
% starting at (1, 1) and ending at (n, 1), is 0 for n = 1 and 2^(n-2)
% otherwise. This file contains no proof.

putnam_2005_a2: THEORY
BEGIN
  point: TYPE = [# x_coord: int, y_coord: int #]
  tour: TYPE = [nat -> point]

  IMPORTING finite_sets[tour]

  origin: point = (# x_coord := 0, y_coord := 0 #)

  grid_point(P: point, n: posnat): bool =
    1 <= x_coord(P)
      AND x_coord(P) <= n
      AND 1 <= y_coord(P)
      AND y_coord(P) <= 3

  unit_apart(P, Q: point): bool =
    (x_coord(P) = x_coord(Q)
      AND abs(y_coord(Q) - y_coord(P)) = 1)
      OR
    (y_coord(P) = y_coord(Q)
      AND abs(x_coord(Q) - x_coord(P)) = 1)

  visits_exactly_once(
      p: tour,
      n: posnat,
      P: point): bool =
    EXISTS (i: nat):
      1 <= i
        AND i <= 3 * n
        AND p(i) = P
        AND (FORALL (j: nat):
          (1 <= j AND j <= 3 * n AND p(j) = P)
            IMPLIES j = i)

  rook_tour(p: tour, n: posnat): bool =
    (FORALL (P: point):
      grid_point(P, n) IMPLIES visits_exactly_once(p, n, P))
      AND
    (FORALL (i: nat):
      (1 <= i AND i < 3 * n)
        IMPLIES unit_apart(p(i), p(i + 1)))
      AND p(0) = origin
      AND (FORALL (i: nat):
        i > 3 * n IMPLIES p(i) = origin)

  qualifying(p: tour, n: posnat): bool =
    rook_tour(p, n)
      AND p(1) = (# x_coord := 1, y_coord := 1 #)
      AND p(3 * n) = (# x_coord := n, y_coord := 1 #)

  putnam_2005_a2_solution(n: posnat): nat =
    IF n = 1 THEN 0 ELSE 2 ^ (n - 2) ENDIF

  putnam_2005_a2: bool =
    FORALL (n: posnat):
      EXISTS (solutions: finite_set[tour]):
        card(solutions) = putnam_2005_a2_solution(n)
          AND (FORALL (p: tour):
            solutions(p) IFF qualifying(p, n))
END putnam_2005_a2

import Mathlib

open Nat Set

/--
Let $p(z)$ be a polynomial of degree $n$ all of whose zeros have absolute value $1$ in the complex plane. Put $g(z)=p(z)/z^{n/2}$. Show that all zeros of $g'(z)=0$ have absolute value $1$.
-/
theorem putnam_2005_a3
    (p : Polynomial ℂ)
    (n : ℕ)
    (hn : 0 < n)
    (g : ℂ → ℂ)
    (pdeg : p.degree = n)
    (pzeros : ∀ z : ℂ, p.eval z = 0 → ‖z‖ = 1)
    (hg : ∀ z : ℂ, g z = (p.eval z) / z ^ ((n : ℂ) / 2))
    (z : ℂ)
    (hz : z ≠ 0 ∧ DifferentiableAt ℂ g z ∧ deriv g z = 0) :
    ‖z‖ = 1 :=
  sorry

Require Import Reals Coquelicot.Coquelicot. From Coqtail Require Import Cpow Canalysis_def.
Theorem putnam_2005_a3
    (csqrt : C -> C)
    (c : nat -> C)
    (n : nat)
    (hn : gt n 0)
    (hdegree : c n <> 0)
    (p : C -> C := fun z : C => sum_n (fun i => c i * z^i) n)
    (g : C -> C := fun z : C => p z / csqrt (z^n))
    (pzeros : forall z : C, p z = 0 -> norm z = 1%R)
    (hcsqrt : forall z : C, (csqrt z)^2 = z /\ Re (csqrt z) >= 0 /\ (Re (csqrt z) = 0%R -> Im (csqrt z) >= 0%R)) 
    : forall z : C,
      z <> 0 ->
      Canalysis_def.derivable_pt_lim g z 0 ->
      norm z = 1%R.
Proof. Admitted.

    and n :: nat
    and g :: "complex \<Rightarrow> complex"
    and z :: "complex"
  assumes pdeg : "degree p = n"
    and pzeros : "\<forall>z::complex. (poly p z = 0 \<longrightarrow> norm z = 1)"
    and hg : "\<forall>z::complex. g z = (poly p z) / csqrt (z^n)"

    and hz : "z \<noteq> 0 \<and> (g has_field_derivative 0) (at z)"

putnam_2005_a3
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2005_a3:
;; every nonzero differentiable critical point of the quotient of a
;; positive-degree complex polynomial p by either principal z^(n/2) or
;; principal csqrt(z^n), when every zero of p is on the unit circle, is on
;; the unit circle. This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))

;; Complex numbers are pairs over a represented real closed field, and a
;; polynomial is a canonical nonempty coefficient list in ascending degree
;; order. FN-EQUAL expresses universal quantification over all field pairs.
;; This is not a restriction to ACL2's rational or complex-rational numbers:
;; the assertion is first-order over real closed fields, so real-closed-field
;; completeness transfers it bidirectionally between the reals and any such
;; represented field.
;;
;; The parameter g is eliminated only through its pointwise definition. The
;; denominator-mode parameter is restricted to :COMPLEX-POWER (the Lean
;; principal z^(n/2)) or :SQRT-POWER (the Isabelle/Rocq principal
;; csqrt(z^n)). Principal square root and complex division are defined below
;; from the represented ordered real closed field.
;;
;; Crucially, the source's differentiability hypothesis is not replaced by a
;; derived polynomial equation. A tame Skolem function supplies delta for
;; each positive epsilon, and FN-EQUAL universally checks every complex
;; increment h. The squared-norm inequality
;;
;;   |g(z+h)-g(z)|^2 < epsilon^2 * |h|^2
;;
;; is exactly the epsilon-delta definition that g is complex differentiable
;; at z with derivative zero. Finally, |z|=1 is represented exactly by
;; Re(z)^2+Im(z)^2=1.

(defun putnam-2005-a3-quoted (object)
  (list 'quote object))

(defun putnam-2005-a3-apply1-term (function argument)
  (list
   'apply$
   (putnam-2005-a3-quoted function)
   (list 'cons argument nil)))

(defun putnam-2005-a3-apply2-term (function left right)
  (list
   'apply$
   (putnam-2005-a3-quoted function)
   (list 'cons left (list 'cons right nil))))

(defun putnam-2005-a3-and-term (terms)
  (if (endp terms)
      (putnam-2005-a3-quoted t)
    (list
     'if
     (car terms)
     (putnam-2005-a3-and-term (cdr terms))
     (putnam-2005-a3-quoted nil))))

(defun putnam-2005-a3-or-term (terms)
  (if (endp terms)
      (putnam-2005-a3-quoted nil)
    (list
     'if
     (car terms)
     (putnam-2005-a3-quoted t)
     (putnam-2005-a3-or-term (cdr terms)))))

(defun putnam-2005-a3-not-term (term)
  (list
   'if
   term
   (putnam-2005-a3-quoted nil)
   (putnam-2005-a3-quoted t)))

(defun putnam-2005-a3-implies-term (antecedent consequent)
  (list
   'if
   antecedent
   consequent
   (putnam-2005-a3-quoted t)))

(defun putnam-2005-a3-true-function (formals)
  (list
   'lambda
   formals
   (putnam-2005-a3-quoted t)))

(defun putnam-2005-a3-carrier-term (carrier element)
  (putnam-2005-a3-apply1-term carrier element))

(defun putnam-2005-a3-operation-term (operation left right)
  (putnam-2005-a3-apply2-term operation left right))

(defun putnam-2005-a3-all-real-coefficients-function
    (carrier)
  (list
   'lambda
   '(loop$-gvars loop$-ivars)
   (putnam-2005-a3-carrier-term
    carrier 'loop$-ivars)))

(defun putnam-2005-a3-all-real-coefficients-term
    (carrier coefficients)
  (list
   'always$+
   (putnam-2005-a3-quoted
    (putnam-2005-a3-all-real-coefficients-function
     carrier))
   (putnam-2005-a3-quoted nil)
   coefficients))

(defun putnam-2005-a3-real-polynomial-term
    (carrier zero coefficients)
  (putnam-2005-a3-and-term
   (list
    (list 'true-listp coefficients)
    (list 'consp coefficients)
    (putnam-2005-a3-all-real-coefficients-term
     carrier coefficients)
    (putnam-2005-a3-or-term
     (list
      (list 'equal
            (list 'len coefficients)
            (putnam-2005-a3-quoted 1))
      (putnam-2005-a3-not-term
       (list 'equal
             (list 'car (list 'last coefficients))
             (putnam-2005-a3-quoted zero))))))))

(defun putnam-2005-a3-second-term (value)
  (list 'car (list 'cdr value)))

(defun putnam-2005-a3-complex-pair-term (real imaginary)
  (list 'cons real (list 'cons imaginary nil)))

(defun putnam-2005-a3-complex-term-p (carrier value)
  (putnam-2005-a3-and-term
   (list
    (list 'true-listp value)
    (list 'equal
          (list 'len value)
          (putnam-2005-a3-quoted 2))
    (putnam-2005-a3-carrier-term
     carrier (list 'car value))
    (putnam-2005-a3-carrier-term
     carrier (putnam-2005-a3-second-term value)))))

(defun putnam-2005-a3-complex-add-term (add left right)
  (putnam-2005-a3-complex-pair-term
   (putnam-2005-a3-operation-term
    add (list 'car left) (list 'car right))
   (putnam-2005-a3-operation-term
    add
    (putnam-2005-a3-second-term left)
    (putnam-2005-a3-second-term right))))

(defun putnam-2005-a3-complex-mul-term
    (add mul neg left right)
  (putnam-2005-a3-complex-pair-term
   (putnam-2005-a3-operation-term
    add
    (putnam-2005-a3-operation-term
     mul (list 'car left) (list 'car right))
    (putnam-2005-a3-apply1-term
     neg
     (putnam-2005-a3-operation-term
      mul
      (putnam-2005-a3-second-term left)
      (putnam-2005-a3-second-term right))))
   (putnam-2005-a3-operation-term
    add
    (putnam-2005-a3-operation-term
     mul
     (list 'car left)
     (putnam-2005-a3-second-term right))
    (putnam-2005-a3-operation-term
     mul
     (putnam-2005-a3-second-term left)
     (list 'car right)))))

(defun putnam-2005-a3-all-complex-coefficients-function
    (carrier)
  (list
   'lambda
   '(loop$-gvars loop$-ivars)
   (putnam-2005-a3-complex-term-p
    carrier 'loop$-ivars)))

(defun putnam-2005-a3-all-complex-coefficients-term
    (carrier coefficients)
  (list
   'always$+
   (putnam-2005-a3-quoted
    (putnam-2005-a3-all-complex-coefficients-function
     carrier))
   (putnam-2005-a3-quoted nil)
   coefficients))

(defun putnam-2005-a3-field-laws-function
    (carrier zero one add mul neg inv)
  (let* ((x 'x)
         (y 'y)
         (z 'z)
         (qzero (putnam-2005-a3-quoted zero))
         (qone (putnam-2005-a3-quoted one))
         (add-xy
          (putnam-2005-a3-operation-term add x y))
         (add-yz
          (putnam-2005-a3-operation-term add y z))
         (mul-xy
          (putnam-2005-a3-operation-term mul x y))
         (mul-yz
          (putnam-2005-a3-operation-term mul y z))
         (neg-x
          (putnam-2005-a3-apply1-term neg x))
         (inv-x
          (putnam-2005-a3-apply1-term inv x))
         (domain
          (putnam-2005-a3-and-term
           (list
            (putnam-2005-a3-carrier-term carrier x)
            (putnam-2005-a3-carrier-term carrier y)
            (putnam-2005-a3-carrier-term carrier z))))
         (laws
          (putnam-2005-a3-and-term
           (list
            (putnam-2005-a3-carrier-term carrier add-xy)
            (putnam-2005-a3-carrier-term carrier mul-xy)
            (putnam-2005-a3-carrier-term carrier neg-x)
            (putnam-2005-a3-carrier-term carrier inv-x)
            (list
             'equal
             (putnam-2005-a3-operation-term add add-xy z)
             (putnam-2005-a3-operation-term add x add-yz))
            (list
             'equal
             (putnam-2005-a3-operation-term mul mul-xy z)
             (putnam-2005-a3-operation-term mul x mul-yz))
            (list
             'equal
             add-xy
             (putnam-2005-a3-operation-term add y x))
            (list
             'equal
             mul-xy
             (putnam-2005-a3-operation-term mul y x))
            (list
             'equal
             (putnam-2005-a3-operation-term add x qzero)
             x)
            (list
             'equal
             (putnam-2005-a3-operation-term add x neg-x)
             qzero)
            (list
             'equal
             (putnam-2005-a3-operation-term mul x qone)
             x)
            (putnam-2005-a3-implies-term
             (list 'equal x qzero)
             (list 'equal inv-x qzero))
            (putnam-2005-a3-implies-term
             (putnam-2005-a3-not-term
              (list 'equal x qzero))
             (list
              'equal
              (putnam-2005-a3-operation-term mul x inv-x)
              qone))
            (list
             'equal
             (putnam-2005-a3-operation-term mul x add-yz)
             (putnam-2005-a3-operation-term
              add
              (putnam-2005-a3-operation-term mul x y)
              (putnam-2005-a3-operation-term mul x z)))))))
    (list
     'lambda
     '(x y z)
     (putnam-2005-a3-implies-term domain laws))))

(defun putnam-2005-a3-order-laws-function
    (carrier zero add mul lt)
  (let* ((x 'x)
         (y 'y)
         (z 'z)
         (qzero (putnam-2005-a3-quoted zero))
         (lt-xy
          (putnam-2005-a3-operation-term lt x y))
         (lt-yx
          (putnam-2005-a3-operation-term lt y x))
         (lt-yz
          (putnam-2005-a3-operation-term lt y z))
         (lt-xz
          (putnam-2005-a3-operation-term lt x z))
         (domain
          (putnam-2005-a3-and-term
           (list
            (putnam-2005-a3-carrier-term carrier x)
            (putnam-2005-a3-carrier-term carrier y)
            (putnam-2005-a3-carrier-term carrier z))))
         (laws
          (putnam-2005-a3-and-term
           (list
            (putnam-2005-a3-not-term
             (putnam-2005-a3-operation-term lt x x))
            (putnam-2005-a3-or-term
             (list
              lt-xy
              (list 'equal x y)
              lt-yx))
            (putnam-2005-a3-implies-term
             (putnam-2005-a3-and-term
              (list lt-xy lt-yz))
             lt-xz)
            (putnam-2005-a3-implies-term
             lt-xy
             (putnam-2005-a3-operation-term
              lt
              (putnam-2005-a3-operation-term add x z)
              (putnam-2005-a3-operation-term add y z)))
            (putnam-2005-a3-implies-term
             (putnam-2005-a3-and-term
              (list
               (putnam-2005-a3-operation-term lt qzero x)
               (putnam-2005-a3-operation-term lt qzero y)))
             (putnam-2005-a3-operation-term
              lt
              qzero
              (putnam-2005-a3-operation-term mul x y)))))))
    (list
     'lambda
     '(x y z)
     (putnam-2005-a3-implies-term domain laws))))

(defun putnam-2005-a3-square-root-laws-function
    (carrier zero mul lt square-root)
  (let* ((x 'x)
         (qzero (putnam-2005-a3-quoted zero))
         (root
          (putnam-2005-a3-apply1-term square-root x))
         (domain
          (putnam-2005-a3-and-term
           (list
            (putnam-2005-a3-carrier-term carrier x)
            (putnam-2005-a3-not-term
             (putnam-2005-a3-operation-term lt x qzero)))))
         (laws
          (putnam-2005-a3-and-term
           (list
            (putnam-2005-a3-carrier-term carrier root)
            (putnam-2005-a3-not-term
             (putnam-2005-a3-operation-term lt root qzero))
            (list
             'equal
             (putnam-2005-a3-operation-term mul root root)
             x)))))
    (list
     'lambda
     '(x)
     (putnam-2005-a3-implies-term domain laws))))

(defun putnam-2005-a3-real-evaluation-laws-function
    (carrier zero add mul real-evaluate)
  (let* ((coefficient 'coefficient)
         (rest 'rest)
         (x 'x)
         (qzero (putnam-2005-a3-quoted zero))
         (domain
          (putnam-2005-a3-and-term
           (list
            (putnam-2005-a3-carrier-term
             carrier coefficient)
            (list 'true-listp rest)
            (putnam-2005-a3-all-real-coefficients-term
             carrier rest)
            (putnam-2005-a3-carrier-term carrier x))))
         (empty-law
          (putnam-2005-a3-implies-term
           (putnam-2005-a3-carrier-term carrier x)
           (list
            'equal
            (putnam-2005-a3-operation-term
             real-evaluate
             (putnam-2005-a3-quoted nil)
             x)
            qzero)))
         (recursive-value
          (putnam-2005-a3-operation-term
           add
           coefficient
           (putnam-2005-a3-operation-term
            mul
            x
            (putnam-2005-a3-operation-term
             real-evaluate rest x))))
         (recursive-law
          (putnam-2005-a3-implies-term
           domain
           (putnam-2005-a3-and-term
            (list
             (putnam-2005-a3-carrier-term
              carrier
              (putnam-2005-a3-operation-term
               real-evaluate
               (list 'cons coefficient rest)
               x))
             (list
              'equal
              (putnam-2005-a3-operation-term
               real-evaluate
               (list 'cons coefficient rest)
               x)
              recursive-value))))))
    (list
     'lambda
     '(coefficient rest x)
     (putnam-2005-a3-and-term
      (list empty-law recursive-law)))))

(defun putnam-2005-a3-odd-root-laws-function
    (carrier zero real-evaluate odd-root)
  (let* ((coefficients 'coefficients)
         (root
          (putnam-2005-a3-apply1-term
           odd-root coefficients))
         (domain
          (putnam-2005-a3-and-term
           (list
            (putnam-2005-a3-real-polynomial-term
             carrier zero coefficients)
            (list 'evenp (list 'len coefficients)))))
         (laws
          (putnam-2005-a3-and-term
           (list
            (putnam-2005-a3-carrier-term carrier root)
            (list
             'equal
             (putnam-2005-a3-operation-term
              real-evaluate coefficients root)
             (putnam-2005-a3-quoted zero))))))
    (list
     'lambda
     '(coefficients)
     (putnam-2005-a3-implies-term domain laws))))

(defun putnam-2005-a3-real-closed-field-p
    (carrier zero one add mul neg inv lt square-root
             real-evaluate odd-root)
  (and
   (tamep-functionp carrier)
   (tamep-functionp add)
   (tamep-functionp mul)
   (tamep-functionp neg)
   (tamep-functionp inv)
   (tamep-functionp lt)
   (tamep-functionp square-root)
   (tamep-functionp real-evaluate)
   (tamep-functionp odd-root)
   (apply$ carrier (list zero))
   (apply$ carrier (list one))
   (not (equal zero one))
   (fn-equal
    (putnam-2005-a3-field-laws-function
     carrier zero one add mul neg inv)
    (putnam-2005-a3-true-function '(x y z)))
   (fn-equal
    (putnam-2005-a3-order-laws-function
     carrier zero add mul lt)
    (putnam-2005-a3-true-function '(x y z)))
   (fn-equal
    (putnam-2005-a3-square-root-laws-function
     carrier zero mul lt square-root)
    (putnam-2005-a3-true-function '(x)))
   (fn-equal
    (putnam-2005-a3-real-evaluation-laws-function
     carrier zero add mul real-evaluate)
    (putnam-2005-a3-true-function
     '(coefficient rest x)))
   (fn-equal
    (putnam-2005-a3-odd-root-laws-function
     carrier zero real-evaluate odd-root)
    (putnam-2005-a3-true-function '(coefficients)))))

(defun putnam-2005-a3-complex-p (value carrier)
  (and
   (true-listp value)
   (equal (len value) 2)
   (apply$ carrier (list (car value)))
   (apply$ carrier (list (cadr value)))))

(defun putnam-2005-a3-complex-zero-p (value zero)
  (and
   (equal (car value) zero)
   (equal (cadr value) zero)))

(defun putnam-2005-a3-complex-add (left right add)
  (list
   (apply$ add (list (car left) (car right)))
   (apply$ add (list (cadr left) (cadr right)))))

(defun putnam-2005-a3-complex-mul
    (left right add mul neg)
  (let* ((ac (apply$ mul (list (car left) (car right))))
         (bd (apply$ mul (list (cadr left) (cadr right))))
         (ad (apply$ mul (list (car left) (cadr right))))
         (bc (apply$ mul (list (cadr left) (car right)))))
    (list
     (apply$ add (list ac (apply$ neg (list bd))))
     (apply$ add (list ad bc)))))

(defun putnam-2005-a3-field-natural
    (n zero one add)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix n)))
  (if (zp n)
      zero
    (apply$
     add
     (list
      one
      (putnam-2005-a3-field-natural
       (- n 1) zero one add)))))

(defun putnam-2005-a3-complex-scale
    (scalar value mul)
  (list
   (apply$ mul (list scalar (car value)))
   (apply$ mul (list scalar (cadr value)))))

(defun putnam-2005-a3-complex-coefficient-list-p
    (coefficients carrier)
  (if (endp coefficients)
      (equal coefficients nil)
    (and
     (putnam-2005-a3-complex-p
      (car coefficients) carrier)
     (putnam-2005-a3-complex-coefficient-list-p
      (cdr coefficients) carrier))))

(defun putnam-2005-a3-complex-polynomial-p
    (coefficients carrier zero)
  (and
   (true-listp coefficients)
   (consp coefficients)
   (putnam-2005-a3-complex-coefficient-list-p
    coefficients carrier)
   (or
    (equal (len coefficients) 1)
    (not
     (putnam-2005-a3-complex-zero-p
      (car (last coefficients)) zero)))))

(defun putnam-2005-a3-complex-evaluation-laws-function
    (carrier zero add mul neg complex-evaluate)
  (let* ((coefficient 'coefficient)
         (rest 'rest)
         (x 'x)
         (y 'y)
         (z
          (putnam-2005-a3-complex-pair-term x y))
         (complex-zero
          (putnam-2005-a3-complex-pair-term
           (putnam-2005-a3-quoted zero)
           (putnam-2005-a3-quoted zero)))
         (domain
          (putnam-2005-a3-and-term
           (list
            (putnam-2005-a3-complex-term-p
             carrier coefficient)
            (list 'true-listp rest)
            (putnam-2005-a3-all-complex-coefficients-term
             carrier rest)
            (putnam-2005-a3-carrier-term carrier x)
            (putnam-2005-a3-carrier-term carrier y))))
         (empty-law
          (putnam-2005-a3-implies-term
           (putnam-2005-a3-and-term
            (list
             (putnam-2005-a3-carrier-term carrier x)
             (putnam-2005-a3-carrier-term carrier y)))
           (list
            'equal
            (putnam-2005-a3-operation-term
             complex-evaluate
             (putnam-2005-a3-quoted nil)
             z)
            complex-zero)))
         (recursive-value
          (putnam-2005-a3-complex-add-term
           add
           coefficient
           (putnam-2005-a3-complex-mul-term
            add mul neg
            z
            (putnam-2005-a3-operation-term
             complex-evaluate rest z))))
         (evaluated
          (putnam-2005-a3-operation-term
           complex-evaluate
           (list 'cons coefficient rest)
           z))
         (recursive-law
          (putnam-2005-a3-implies-term
           domain
           (putnam-2005-a3-and-term
            (list
             (putnam-2005-a3-complex-term-p
              carrier evaluated)
             (list 'equal evaluated recursive-value))))))
    (list
     'lambda
     '(coefficient rest x y)
     (putnam-2005-a3-and-term
      (list empty-law recursive-law)))))

(defun putnam-2005-a3-complex-poly-derivative-aux
    (coefficients degree zero one add mul)
  (if (consp coefficients)
      (cons
       (putnam-2005-a3-complex-scale
        (putnam-2005-a3-field-natural

    (coefficients zero one add mul)

(defun putnam-2005-a3-norm-squared (value add mul)
  (apply$
   add
   (list
    (apply$ mul (list (car value) (car value)))
    (apply$ mul (list (cadr value) (cadr value))))))

(defun putnam-2005-a3-root-condition-function
    (carrier zero one add mul complex-evaluate coefficients)
  (let* ((x 'x)
         (y 'y)
         (qone (putnam-2005-a3-quoted one))

          (putnam-2005-a3-quoted coefficients))
         (z
          (putnam-2005-a3-complex-pair-term x y))
         (value

         (domain

            (putnam-2005-a3-carrier-term carrier x)

           'equal
           value
           (putnam-2005-a3-complex-pair-term
            (putnam-2005-a3-quoted zero)
            (putnam-2005-a3-quoted zero))))

          (list

            add
            (putnam-2005-a3-operation-term mul x x)

    (list

(defun putnam-2005-a3-all-roots-on-unit-circle-p

    carrier zero one add mul complex-evaluate coefficients)

(defun putnam-2005-a3-complex-power
    (z n zero one add mul neg)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix n)))
  (if (zp n)
      (list one zero)
    (putnam-2005-a3-complex-mul
     z
     (putnam-2005-a3-complex-power
      z (- n 1) zero one add mul neg)
     add mul neg)))

(defun putnam-2005-a3-field-sub (left right add neg)
  (apply$
   add
   (list left (apply$ neg (list right)))))

(defun putnam-2005-a3-field-half
    (value one add mul inv)
  (apply$
   mul
   (list
    value
    (apply$
     inv
     (list (apply$ add (list one one)))))))

(defun putnam-2005-a3-complex-principal-sqrt
    (z zero one add mul neg inv lt square-root)
  (let* ((real-part (car z))
         (imaginary-part (cadr z))
         (radius
          (apply$
           square-root
           (list
            (putnam-2005-a3-norm-squared z add mul))))
         (real-square
          (putnam-2005-a3-field-half
           (apply$ add (list radius real-part))
           one add mul inv))
         (imaginary-square
          (putnam-2005-a3-field-half
           (putnam-2005-a3-field-sub
            radius real-part add neg)
           one add mul inv))
         (root-real
          (apply$ square-root (list real-square)))
         (root-imaginary-magnitude
          (apply$ square-root (list imaginary-square)))
         (root-imaginary
          (if (apply$ lt (list imaginary-part zero))
              (apply$ neg (list root-imaginary-magnitude))
            root-imaginary-magnitude)))
    (list root-real root-imaginary)))

(defun putnam-2005-a3-complex-inverse
    (z add mul neg inv)
  (let ((inverse-norm
         (apply$
          inv
          (list
           (putnam-2005-a3-norm-squared z add mul)))))
    (list
     (apply$ mul (list (car z) inverse-norm))
     (apply$
      mul
      (list
       (apply$ neg (list (cadr z)))
       inverse-norm)))))

(defun putnam-2005-a3-complex-divide
    (numerator denominator add mul neg inv)
  (putnam-2005-a3-complex-mul
   numerator
   (putnam-2005-a3-complex-inverse
    denominator add mul neg inv)
   add mul neg))

(defun putnam-2005-a3-denominator
    (denominator-mode n z zero one add mul neg inv lt square-root)
  (if (equal denominator-mode :complex-power)
      (if (evenp n)
          (putnam-2005-a3-complex-power
           z (floor n 2) zero one add mul neg)
        (putnam-2005-a3-complex-mul
         (putnam-2005-a3-complex-power
          z (floor n 2) zero one add mul neg)
         (putnam-2005-a3-complex-principal-sqrt
          z zero one add mul neg inv lt square-root)
         add mul neg))
    (putnam-2005-a3-complex-principal-sqrt
     (putnam-2005-a3-complex-power
      z n zero one add mul neg)
     zero one add mul neg inv lt square-root)))

(defun putnam-2005-a3-quotient-value
    (denominator-mode coefficients n z zero one add mul neg inv lt
                      square-root complex-evaluate)
  (putnam-2005-a3-complex-divide
   (apply$ complex-evaluate (list coefficients z))
   (putnam-2005-a3-denominator
    denominator-mode n z zero one add mul neg inv lt square-root)
   add mul neg inv))

(defun putnam-2005-a3-critical-sample-p
    (carrier zero one add mul neg inv lt square-root complex-evaluate
             critical-delta denominator-mode coefficients n z
             epsilon h-real h-imaginary)
  (if (and
       (apply$ carrier (list epsilon))
       (apply$ carrier (list h-real))
       (apply$ carrier (list h-imaginary))
       (apply$ lt (list zero epsilon)))
      (let* ((delta
              (apply$ critical-delta (list epsilon)))
             (h (list h-real h-imaginary))
             (h-norm-squared
              (putnam-2005-a3-norm-squared h add mul))
             (delta-squared
              (apply$ mul (list delta delta)))
             (epsilon-squared
              (apply$ mul (list epsilon epsilon)))
             (z-plus-h
              (putnam-2005-a3-complex-add z h add))
             (value-at-z
              (putnam-2005-a3-quotient-value
               denominator-mode coefficients n z
               zero one add mul neg inv lt square-root
               complex-evaluate))
             (value-at-z-plus-h
              (putnam-2005-a3-quotient-value
               denominator-mode coefficients n z-plus-h
               zero one add mul neg inv lt square-root
               complex-evaluate))
             (difference
              (putnam-2005-a3-complex-add
               value-at-z-plus-h
               (list
                (apply$ neg (list (car value-at-z)))
                (apply$ neg (list (cadr value-at-z))))
               add))
             (difference-norm-squared
              (putnam-2005-a3-norm-squared difference add mul)))
        (and
         (apply$ carrier (list delta))
         (apply$ lt (list zero delta))
         (implies
          (and
           (apply$ lt (list zero h-norm-squared))
           (apply$ lt
                   (list h-norm-squared delta-squared)))
          (apply$
           lt
           (list
            difference-norm-squared
            (apply$
             mul
             (list epsilon-squared h-norm-squared)))))))
    t))

(defun putnam-2005-a3-critical-condition-function
    (carrier zero one add mul neg inv lt square-root complex-evaluate
             critical-delta denominator-mode coefficients n z)
  (list
   'lambda
   '(epsilon h-real h-imaginary)
   (list
    'putnam-2005-a3-critical-sample-p
    (putnam-2005-a3-quoted carrier)
    (putnam-2005-a3-quoted zero)
    (putnam-2005-a3-quoted one)
    (putnam-2005-a3-quoted add)
    (putnam-2005-a3-quoted mul)
    (putnam-2005-a3-quoted neg)
    (putnam-2005-a3-quoted inv)
    (putnam-2005-a3-quoted lt)
    (putnam-2005-a3-quoted square-root)
    (putnam-2005-a3-quoted complex-evaluate)
    (putnam-2005-a3-quoted critical-delta)
    (putnam-2005-a3-quoted denominator-mode)
    (putnam-2005-a3-quoted coefficients)
    (putnam-2005-a3-quoted n)
    (putnam-2005-a3-quoted z)
    'epsilon
    'h-real
    'h-imaginary)))

(defun putnam-2005-a3-differentiable-critical-point-p
    (carrier zero one add mul neg inv lt square-root complex-evaluate
             critical-delta denominator-mode coefficients n z)
  (and
   (tamep-functionp critical-delta)
   (fn-equal
    (putnam-2005-a3-critical-condition-function
     carrier zero one add mul neg inv lt square-root complex-evaluate
     critical-delta denominator-mode coefficients n z)
    (putnam-2005-a3-true-function
     '(epsilon h-real h-imaginary)))))

(defun putnambench-putnam-2005-a3-statement
    (carrier zero one add mul neg inv lt square-root
             real-evaluate odd-root complex-evaluate
             critical-delta denominator-mode coefficients n z)
  (implies
   (and
    (putnam-2005-a3-real-closed-field-p
     carrier zero one add mul neg inv lt square-root
     real-evaluate odd-root)
    (putnam-2005-a3-complex-evaluator-p
     carrier zero add mul neg complex-evaluate)
    (or
     (equal denominator-mode :complex-power)
     (equal denominator-mode :sqrt-power))
    (natp n)
    (< 0 n)
    (putnam-2005-a3-complex-polynomial-p
     coefficients carrier zero)
    (equal (len coefficients) (+ 1 n))
    (putnam-2005-a3-all-roots-on-unit-circle-p
     carrier zero one add mul complex-evaluate coefficients)
    (putnam-2005-a3-complex-p z carrier)
    (not (putnam-2005-a3-complex-zero-p z zero))

    (putnam-2005-a3-norm-squared z add mul)

title: putnam_2005_a3
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2005_a3:
-- every nonzero critical point of a positive-degree complex polynomial divided
-- by the corresponding half-natural power lies on the unit circle when all
-- polynomial zeros lie there. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module Putnam2005A3 where

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; _*_)

infix 4 _!=_ _<N_
infixr 3 _and_
infixr 2 _or_

data Bottom : Set where

Not : Set -> Set
Not A =
  A -> Bottom

_!=_ : {A : Set} -> A -> A -> Set
x != y =
  Not (x == y)

record _and_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data _or_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  left  : A -> A or B
  right : B -> A or B

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

data _<N_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set where
  zero<suc : {n : Nat} -> zero <N suc n
  suc<suc  : {m n : Nat} -> m <N n -> suc m <N suc n

record CompleteOrderedRealField (R : Set) : Set1 where
  field
    zeroR oneR : R
    addR multiplyR : R -> R -> R
    negateR inverseR squareRootR : R -> R
    lessOrEqualR : R -> R -> Set
    fromNatR : Nat -> R

    oneR-not-zeroR :
      oneR != zeroR

    addR-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> addR x y == addR y x
    addR-associative :
      (x y z : R) -> addR (addR x y) z == addR x (addR y z)
    addR-zero :
      (x : R) -> addR x zeroR == x
    addR-inverse :
      (x : R) -> addR x (negateR x) == zeroR

    multiplyR-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> multiplyR x y == multiplyR y x
    multiplyR-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiplyR (multiplyR x y) z ==
      multiplyR x (multiplyR y z)
    multiplyR-one :
      (x : R) -> multiplyR x oneR == x
    multiplyR-zero :
      (x : R) -> multiplyR x zeroR == zeroR
    distributeR :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiplyR x (addR y z) ==
      addR (multiplyR x y) (multiplyR x z)
    inverseR-zero :
      inverseR zeroR == zeroR
    multiplyR-inverse :
      (x : R) ->
      x != zeroR ->
      multiplyR x (inverseR x) == oneR

    order-reflexive :
      (x : R) -> lessOrEqualR x x
    order-transitive :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR x y ->
      lessOrEqualR y z ->
      lessOrEqualR x z
    order-antisymmetric :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR x y ->
      lessOrEqualR y x ->
      x == y
    order-total :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR x y or lessOrEqualR y x
    addR-order :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR x y ->
      lessOrEqualR (addR z x) (addR z y)
    multiplyR-nonnegative :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR zeroR x ->
      lessOrEqualR zeroR y ->
      lessOrEqualR zeroR (multiplyR x y)
    zeroR-less-than-oneR :
      lessOrEqualR zeroR oneR and zeroR != oneR

    fromNatR-zero :
      fromNatR zero == zeroR
    fromNatR-successor :
      (n : Nat) ->
      fromNatR (suc n) == addR (fromNatR n) oneR
    fromNatR-addition :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNatR (m + n) == addR (fromNatR m) (fromNatR n)
    fromNatR-multiplication :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNatR (m * n) == multiplyR (fromNatR m) (fromNatR n)
    fromNatR-injective :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNatR m == fromNatR n ->
      m == n

    archimedean :
      (x : R) ->
      Exists Nat (\ n -> lessOrEqualR x (fromNatR n))
    least-upper-bound :
      (P : R -> Set) ->
      Exists R P ->
      Exists R
        (\ upper ->
          (x : R) ->
          P x ->
          lessOrEqualR x upper) ->
      Exists R
        (\ supremum ->
          ((x : R) ->
            P x ->
            lessOrEqualR x supremum)
          and
          ((upper : R) ->
            ((x : R) ->
              P x ->
              lessOrEqualR x upper) ->
            lessOrEqualR supremum upper))

    square-rootR-nonnegative :
      (x : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR zeroR (squareRootR x)
    square-rootR-square :
      (x : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR zeroR x ->
      multiplyR (squareRootR x) (squareRootR x) == x
    square-rootR-nonpositive :
      (x : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR x zeroR ->
      squareRootR x == zeroR
    square-rootR-unique :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR zeroR y ->
      multiplyR y y == x ->
      y == squareRootR x

open CompleteOrderedRealField

StrictLess :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
StrictLess reals x y =
  lessOrEqualR reals x y and x != y

record Complex (R : Set) : Set where
  constructor complex
  field
    realPart      : R
    imaginaryPart : R

open Complex

complexZero :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Complex R
complexZero reals =
  complex (zeroR reals) (zeroR reals)

complexOne :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Complex R
complexOne reals =
  complex (oneR reals) (zeroR reals)

complexAdd :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Complex R ->
  Complex R ->
  Complex R
complexAdd reals z w =
  complex
    (addR reals (realPart z) (realPart w))
    (addR reals (imaginaryPart z) (imaginaryPart w))

complexNegate :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Complex R ->
  Complex R
complexNegate reals z =
  complex
    (negateR reals (realPart z))
    (negateR reals (imaginaryPart z))

complexSubtract :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Complex R ->
  Complex R ->
  Complex R
complexSubtract reals z w =
  complexAdd reals z (complexNegate reals w)

complexMultiply :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Complex R ->
  Complex R ->
  Complex R
complexMultiply reals z w =
  complex
    (addR reals
      (multiplyR reals (realPart z) (realPart w))
      (negateR reals
        (multiplyR reals (imaginaryPart z) (imaginaryPart w))))
    (addR reals
      (multiplyR reals (realPart z) (imaginaryPart w))
      (multiplyR reals (imaginaryPart z) (realPart w)))

complexSquaredModulus :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Complex R ->
  R
complexSquaredModulus reals z =
  addR reals
    (multiplyR reals (realPart z) (realPart z))
    (multiplyR reals (imaginaryPart z) (imaginaryPart z))

complexModulus :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Complex R ->
  R
complexModulus reals z =
  squareRootR reals (complexSquaredModulus reals z)

complexInverse :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Complex R ->
  Complex R
complexInverse reals z =
  let denominator = complexSquaredModulus reals z
  in
  complex
    (multiplyR reals
      (realPart z)
      (inverseR reals denominator))
    (negateR reals
      (multiplyR reals
        (imaginaryPart z)
        (inverseR reals denominator)))

complexDivide :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Complex R ->
  Complex R ->
  Complex R
complexDivide reals z w =
  complexMultiply reals z (complexInverse reals w)

complexNaturalPower :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Complex R ->
  Nat ->
  Complex R
complexNaturalPower reals z zero =
  complexOne reals
complexNaturalPower reals z (suc n) =
  complexMultiply reals (complexNaturalPower reals z n) z

record StandardComplexSquareRoot
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) : Set1 where

  field
    squareRootC : Complex R -> Complex R
    squareRootC-square :
      (z : Complex R) ->
      complexMultiply reals (squareRootC z) (squareRootC z) == z
    squareRootC-real-nonnegative :
      (z : Complex R) ->
      lessOrEqualR reals
        (zeroR reals)
        (realPart (squareRootC z))
    squareRootC-imaginary-nonnegative-when-real-zero :
      (z : Complex R) ->
      realPart (squareRootC z) == zeroR reals ->
      lessOrEqualR reals
        (zeroR reals)
        (imaginaryPart (squareRootC z))

open StandardComplexSquareRoot

complexHalfNaturalPower :
  {R : Set} ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) ->
  StandardComplexSquareRoot reals ->
  Complex R ->
  Nat ->
  Complex R
complexHalfNaturalPower reals roots z zero =
  complexOne reals
complexHalfNaturalPower reals roots z (suc zero) =
  squareRootC roots z
complexHalfNaturalPower reals roots z (suc (suc n)) =
  complexMultiply reals z
    (complexHalfNaturalPower reals roots z n)

sumInclusive :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Nat ->
  (Nat -> Complex R) ->
  Complex R
sumInclusive reals zero term =
  term zero
sumInclusive reals (suc n) term =
  complexAdd reals
    (sumInclusive reals n term)
    (term (suc n))

record PolynomialOfDegree
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R)
  (degree : Nat) : Set where

  field
    coefficient : Nat -> Complex R
    coefficients-above-degree :
      (k : Nat) ->
      degree <N k ->
      coefficient k == complexZero reals
    leading-coefficient-nonzero :
      coefficient degree != complexZero reals

open PolynomialOfDegree

evaluate :
  {R : Set} ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) ->
  {degree : Nat} ->
  PolynomialOfDegree reals degree ->
  Complex R ->
  Complex R
evaluate reals {degree} polynomial z =
  sumInclusive reals degree
    (\ k ->
      complexMultiply reals
        (coefficient polynomial k)
        (complexNaturalPower reals z k))

ComplexDerivativeAt :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (Complex R -> Complex R) ->
  Complex R ->
  Complex R ->
  Set
ComplexDerivativeAt {R} reals function point derivativeValue =
  (epsilon : R) ->
  StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) epsilon ->
  Exists R
    (\ delta ->
      StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) delta
      and
      ((z : Complex R) ->
        StrictLess reals
          (complexModulus reals
            (complexSubtract reals z point))
          delta ->
        z != point ->
        StrictLess reals
          (complexModulus reals
            (complexSubtract reals
              (complexDivide reals
                (complexSubtract reals
                  (function z)
                  (function point))
                (complexSubtract reals z point))
              derivativeValue))
          epsilon))

module Putnam2005A3Statement
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R)
  (roots : StandardComplexSquareRoot reals)
  (n : Nat)
  (polynomial : PolynomialOfDegree reals n)
  (g : Complex R -> Complex R) where

  GDefinition : Set
  GDefinition =
    (z : Complex R) ->
    g z ==
    complexDivide reals
      (evaluate reals polynomial z)
      (complexHalfNaturalPower reals roots z n)

  AllPolynomialZerosOnUnitCircle : Set
  AllPolynomialZerosOnUnitCircle =
    (z : Complex R) ->
    evaluate reals polynomial z == complexZero reals ->
    complexModulus reals z == oneR reals

  proposition : Set
  proposition =
    zero <N n ->
    AllPolynomialZerosOnUnitCircle ->
    GDefinition ->
    (z : Complex R) ->
    z != complexZero reals ->
    ComplexDerivativeAt reals g z (complexZero reals) ->
    complexModulus reals z == oneR reals

putnam-2005-a3 : Set1
putnam-2005-a3 =
  (R : Set) ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) ->
  (roots : StandardComplexSquareRoot reals) ->
  (n : Nat) ->
  (polynomial : PolynomialOfDegree reals n) ->
  (g : Complex R -> Complex R) ->
  Putnam2005A3Statement.proposition
    reals
    roots
    n
    polynomial
    g

title: putnam_2005_a3
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2005_a3:
  critical points of a normalized complex polynomial divided by its
  degree-dependent half-power lie on the unit circle when all polynomial
  zeros do. This file contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open arithmeticTheory pred_setTheory realTheory complexTheory;

val putnam_2005_a3 =
  ``!p : num -> complex. !n : num. !g : complex -> complex. !z : complex.
      0 < n /\
      p n <> 0 /\
      (!k : num. n < k ==> p k = 0) /\
      (!w : complex.
         ITSET
           (\k acc. p k * w pow k + acc)
           (count (SUC n))
           (0 : complex) = 0
         ==>
         modu w = 1) /\
      (!w : complex.
         g w =
           ITSET
             (\k acc. p k * w pow k + acc)
             (count (SUC n))
             (0 : complex) /
           (@r : complex.
              r pow 2 = w pow n /\
              0 <= RE r /\
              (RE r = 0 ==> 0 <= IM r))) /\
      z <> 0 /\
      (!e : real.
         0 < e
         ==>
         ?delta : real.
           0 < delta /\
           !w : complex.
             0 < modu (w - z) /\ modu (w - z) < delta
             ==>
             modu ((g w - g z) / (w - z)) < e)
      ==>
      modu z = 1``;
