content:
;; Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2005_b3:
;; positive differentiable real functions satisfying a derivative functional
;; equation are exactly a constrained family of positive power functions.
;; This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))

;; The context presents a Dedekind-complete ordered field, hence the real
;; field up to ordered-field isomorphism, together with its standard
;; exponential and logarithm. Tame APPLY$ objects retain the arbitrary
;; real-valued function. DEFUN-SK keeps all unbounded mathematical
;; quantifiers internal. Derivatives use the epsilon-delta definition, and
;; positive-base real powers are definitionally exp(d * log(x)).

(defun p05b3-member-p (carrier x)
  (if (apply$ carrier (list x)) t nil))

(defun p05b3-unary-value (function x)
  (apply$ function (list x)))

(defun p05b3-binary-value (function x y)
  (apply$ function (list x y)))

(defun-sk p05b3-valid-set-p (carrier set)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (apply$ set (list x))
     (p05b3-member-p carrier x))))

(defun-sk p05b3-real-function-p (carrier function)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (p05b3-member-p carrier x)
     (p05b3-member-p
      carrier
      (p05b3-unary-value function x)))))

(defun-sk p05b3-field-laws-p
    (carrier add multiply negate inverse zero one)
  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (p05b3-member-p carrier x)
      (p05b3-member-p carrier y)
      (p05b3-member-p carrier z))
     (and
      (p05b3-member-p carrier
                      (p05b3-binary-value add x y))
      (p05b3-member-p carrier
                      (p05b3-binary-value multiply x y))
      (p05b3-member-p carrier
                      (p05b3-unary-value negate x))
      (p05b3-member-p carrier
                      (p05b3-unary-value inverse x))
      (equal
       (p05b3-binary-value
        add (p05b3-binary-value add x y) z)
       (p05b3-binary-value
        add x (p05b3-binary-value add y z)))
      (equal
       (p05b3-binary-value add x y)
       (p05b3-binary-value add y x))
      (equal (p05b3-binary-value add x zero) x)
      (equal
       (p05b3-binary-value
        add x (p05b3-unary-value negate x))
       zero)
      (equal
       (p05b3-binary-value
        multiply (p05b3-binary-value multiply x y) z)
       (p05b3-binary-value
        multiply x (p05b3-binary-value multiply y z)))
      (equal
       (p05b3-binary-value multiply x y)
       (p05b3-binary-value multiply y x))
      (equal (p05b3-binary-value multiply x one) x)
      (implies
       (equal x zero)
       (equal (p05b3-unary-value inverse x) zero))
      (implies
       (not (equal x zero))
       (equal
        (p05b3-binary-value
         multiply x (p05b3-unary-value inverse x))
        one))
      (equal
       (p05b3-binary-value
        multiply x (p05b3-binary-value add y z))
       (p05b3-binary-value
        add
        (p05b3-binary-value multiply x y)
        (p05b3-binary-value multiply x z)))))))

(defun-sk p05b3-order-laws-p
    (carrier add multiply zero less)
  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (p05b3-member-p carrier x)
      (p05b3-member-p carrier y)
      (p05b3-member-p carrier z))
     (and
      (not (p05b3-binary-value less x x))
      (or
       (equal x y)
       (p05b3-binary-value less x y)
       (p05b3-binary-value less y x))
      (implies
       (and
        (p05b3-binary-value less x y)
        (p05b3-binary-value less y z))
       (p05b3-binary-value less x z))
      (implies
       (p05b3-binary-value less x y)
       (p05b3-binary-value
        less
        (p05b3-binary-value add x z)
        (p05b3-binary-value add y z)))
      (implies
       (and
        (p05b3-binary-value less zero x)
        (p05b3-binary-value less zero y))
       (p05b3-binary-value
        less zero (p05b3-binary-value multiply x y)))))))

(defun-sk p05b3-set-nonempty-p (carrier set)
  (exists (x)
    (and
     (p05b3-member-p carrier x)
     (apply$ set (list x)))))

(defun-sk p05b3-upper-bound-p
    (carrier less set bound)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (and
      (p05b3-member-p carrier x)
      (apply$ set (list x)))
     (not (p05b3-binary-value less bound x)))))

(defun-sk p05b3-bounded-above-p
    (carrier less set)
  (exists (bound)
    (and
     (p05b3-member-p carrier bound)
     (p05b3-upper-bound-p
      carrier less set bound))))

(defun-sk p05b3-least-upper-bound-p
    (carrier less set supremum)
  (forall (bound)
    (implies
     (and
      (p05b3-member-p carrier bound)
      (p05b3-upper-bound-p carrier less set bound))
     (not (p05b3-binary-value less bound supremum)))))

(defun p05b3-supremum-p
    (carrier less set supremum)
  (and
   (p05b3-member-p carrier supremum)
   (p05b3-upper-bound-p carrier less set supremum)
   (p05b3-least-upper-bound-p
    carrier less set supremum)))

(defun-sk p05b3-has-supremum-p
    (carrier less set)
  (exists (supremum)
    (p05b3-supremum-p
     carrier less set supremum)))

(defun-sk p05b3-dedekind-complete-p
    (carrier less)
  (forall (set)
    (implies
     (and
      (tamep-functionp set)
      (p05b3-valid-set-p carrier set)
      (p05b3-set-nonempty-p carrier set)
      (p05b3-bounded-above-p carrier less set))
     (p05b3-has-supremum-p carrier less set))))

(defun p05b3-real-field-p
    (carrier zero one add multiply negate inverse less)
  (and
   (tamep-functionp carrier)
   (tamep-functionp add)
   (tamep-functionp multiply)
   (tamep-functionp negate)
   (tamep-functionp inverse)
   (tamep-functionp less)
   (p05b3-member-p carrier zero)
   (p05b3-member-p carrier one)
   (not (equal zero one))
   (p05b3-field-laws-p
    carrier add multiply negate inverse zero one)
   (p05b3-order-laws-p
    carrier add multiply zero less)
   (p05b3-binary-value less zero one)
   (p05b3-dedekind-complete-p carrier less)))

;; The outer context is (field-context exponential logarithm).

(defun p05b3-field-context (ctx)
  (nth 0 ctx))

(defun p05b3-r-carrier (ctx)
  (nth 0 (p05b3-field-context ctx)))

(defun p05b3-r-zero (ctx)
  (nth 1 (p05b3-field-context ctx)))

(defun p05b3-r-one (ctx)
  (nth 2 (p05b3-field-context ctx)))

(defun p05b3-r-add (ctx)
  (nth 3 (p05b3-field-context ctx)))

(defun p05b3-r-mul (ctx)
  (nth 4 (p05b3-field-context ctx)))

(defun p05b3-r-neg (ctx)
  (nth 5 (p05b3-field-context ctx)))

(defun p05b3-r-inv (ctx)
  (nth 6 (p05b3-field-context ctx)))

(defun p05b3-r-lt (ctx)
  (nth 7 (p05b3-field-context ctx)))

(defun p05b3-r-exp (ctx)
  (nth 1 ctx))

(defun p05b3-r-log (ctx)
  (nth 2 ctx))

(defun p05b3-field-context-p (field-context)
  (and
   (true-listp field-context)
   (equal (len field-context) 8)
   (p05b3-real-field-p
    (nth 0 field-context)
    (nth 1 field-context)
    (nth 2 field-context)
    (nth 3 field-context)
    (nth 4 field-context)
    (nth 5 field-context)
    (nth 6 field-context)
    (nth 7 field-context))))

(defun p05b3-r-add-value (ctx x y)
  (p05b3-binary-value (p05b3-r-add ctx) x y))

(defun p05b3-r-neg-value (ctx x)
  (p05b3-unary-value (p05b3-r-neg ctx) x))

(defun p05b3-r-sub-value (ctx x y)
  (p05b3-r-add-value
   ctx x (p05b3-r-neg-value ctx y)))

(defun p05b3-r-mul-value (ctx x y)
  (p05b3-binary-value (p05b3-r-mul ctx) x y))

(defun p05b3-r-inv-value (ctx x)
  (p05b3-unary-value (p05b3-r-inv ctx) x))

(defun p05b3-r-div-value (ctx numerator denominator)
  (p05b3-r-mul-value
   ctx numerator (p05b3-r-inv-value ctx denominator)))

(defun p05b3-r-lt-p (ctx x y)
  (if (p05b3-binary-value (p05b3-r-lt ctx) x y)
      t nil))

(defun p05b3-r-le-p (ctx x y)
  (not (p05b3-r-lt-p ctx y x)))

(defun p05b3-r-abs-value (ctx x)
  (if (p05b3-r-lt-p ctx x (p05b3-r-zero ctx))
      (p05b3-r-neg-value ctx x)
    x))

(defun p05b3-positive-real-p (ctx x)
  (and
   (p05b3-member-p (p05b3-r-carrier ctx) x)
   (p05b3-r-lt-p ctx (p05b3-r-zero ctx) x)))

;; HasDerivAt in epsilon-delta form:
;; |f(y)-f(x)-d*(y-x)| <= epsilon*|y-x| near x.

(defun-sk p05b3-derivative-neighborhood-p
    (ctx function derivative x epsilon radius)
  (forall (y)
    (implies
     (and
      (p05b3-member-p (p05b3-r-carrier ctx) y)
      (p05b3-r-lt-p
       ctx
       (p05b3-r-abs-value
        ctx (p05b3-r-sub-value ctx y x))
       radius))
     (p05b3-r-le-p
      ctx
      (p05b3-r-abs-value
       ctx
       (p05b3-r-sub-value
        ctx
        (p05b3-r-sub-value
         ctx
         (p05b3-unary-value function y)
         (p05b3-unary-value function x))
        (p05b3-r-mul-value
         ctx derivative
         (p05b3-r-sub-value ctx y x))))
      (p05b3-r-mul-value
       ctx epsilon
       (p05b3-r-abs-value
        ctx (p05b3-r-sub-value ctx y x)))))))

(defun-sk p05b3-derivative-radius-exists-p
    (ctx function derivative x epsilon)
  (exists (radius)
    (and
     (p05b3-positive-real-p ctx radius)
     (p05b3-derivative-neighborhood-p
      ctx function derivative x epsilon radius))))

(defun-sk p05b3-derivative-epsilon-p
    (ctx function derivative x)
  (forall (epsilon)
    (implies
     (p05b3-positive-real-p ctx epsilon)
     (p05b3-derivative-radius-exists-p
      ctx function derivative x epsilon))))

(defun p05b3-has-derivative-at-p
    (ctx function derivative x)
  (and
   (p05b3-member-p (p05b3-r-carrier ctx) derivative)
   (p05b3-member-p (p05b3-r-carrier ctx) x)
   (p05b3-derivative-epsilon-p
    ctx function derivative x)))

(defun-sk p05b3-derivative-exists-at-p
    (ctx function x)
  (exists (derivative)
    (p05b3-has-derivative-at-p
     ctx function derivative x)))

(defun-sk p05b3-differentiable-on-positive-p
    (ctx function)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (p05b3-positive-real-p ctx x)
     (p05b3-derivative-exists-at-p
      ctx function x))))

;; The differential initial-value problem E' = E, E(0) = 1 characterizes the
;; standard real exponential. LOG is its inverse on the positive reals.

(defun-sk p05b3-exponential-laws-p (ctx)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (p05b3-member-p (p05b3-r-carrier ctx) x)
     (and
      (p05b3-positive-real-p
       ctx (p05b3-unary-value (p05b3-r-exp ctx) x))
      (p05b3-has-derivative-at-p
       ctx
       (p05b3-r-exp ctx)
       (p05b3-unary-value (p05b3-r-exp ctx) x)
       x)))))

(defun p05b3-exponential-function-p (ctx)
  (and
   (tamep-functionp (p05b3-r-exp ctx))
   (p05b3-real-function-p
    (p05b3-r-carrier ctx) (p05b3-r-exp ctx))
   (equal
    (p05b3-unary-value
     (p05b3-r-exp ctx) (p05b3-r-zero ctx))
    (p05b3-r-one ctx))
   (p05b3-exponential-laws-p ctx)))

(defun-sk p05b3-logarithm-laws-p (ctx)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (p05b3-member-p (p05b3-r-carrier ctx) x)
     (and
      (equal
       (p05b3-unary-value
        (p05b3-r-log ctx)
        (p05b3-unary-value (p05b3-r-exp ctx) x))
       x)
      (implies
       (p05b3-positive-real-p ctx x)
       (equal
        (p05b3-unary-value
         (p05b3-r-exp ctx)
         (p05b3-unary-value (p05b3-r-log ctx) x))
        x))))))

(defun p05b3-logarithm-function-p (ctx)
  (and
   (tamep-functionp (p05b3-r-log ctx))
   (p05b3-real-function-p
    (p05b3-r-carrier ctx) (p05b3-r-log ctx))
   (p05b3-logarithm-laws-p ctx)))

(defun p05b3-context-p (ctx)
  (and
   (true-listp ctx)
   (equal (len ctx) 3)
   (p05b3-field-context-p (p05b3-field-context ctx))
   (p05b3-exponential-function-p ctx)
   (p05b3-logarithm-function-p ctx)))

(defun p05b3-real-power-value (ctx base exponent)
  (p05b3-unary-value
   (p05b3-r-exp ctx)
   (p05b3-r-mul-value
    ctx exponent
    (p05b3-unary-value (p05b3-r-log ctx) base))))

(defun-sk p05b3-positive-values-p (ctx function)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (p05b3-positive-real-p ctx x)
     (p05b3-positive-real-p
      ctx (p05b3-unary-value function x)))))

;; The equation uses HasDerivAt at a/x with derivative x/f(x). Under the
;; differentiability hypothesis, uniqueness of real derivatives makes this
;; bidirectionally equivalent to deriv(f, a/x) = x/f(x).

(defun-sk p05b3-functional-equation-at-p
    (ctx function a)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (p05b3-positive-real-p ctx x)
     (p05b3-has-derivative-at-p
      ctx
      function
      (p05b3-r-div-value
       ctx x (p05b3-unary-value function x))
      (p05b3-r-div-value ctx a x)))))

(defun-sk p05b3-functional-equation-exists-p
    (ctx function)
  (exists (a)
    (and
     (p05b3-positive-real-p ctx a)
     (p05b3-functional-equation-at-p
      ctx function a))))

(defun-sk p05b3-power-family-at-p
    (ctx function c d)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (p05b3-positive-real-p ctx x)
     (equal
      (p05b3-unary-value function x)
      (p05b3-r-mul-value
       ctx c (p05b3-real-power-value ctx x d))))))

(defun-sk p05b3-solution-p (ctx function)
  (exists (c d)
    (and
     (p05b3-positive-real-p ctx c)
     (p05b3-positive-real-p ctx d)
     (implies
      (equal d (p05b3-r-one ctx))
      (equal c (p05b3-r-one ctx)))
     (p05b3-power-family-at-p
      ctx function c d))))

(defun putnambench-putnam-2005-b3-statement
    (ctx function)
  (implies
   (and
    (p05b3-context-p ctx)
    (tamep-functionp function)
    (p05b3-real-function-p
     (p05b3-r-carrier ctx) function)
    (p05b3-positive-values-p ctx function)
    (p05b3-differentiable-on-positive-p
     ctx function))
   (equal
    (p05b3-functional-equation-exists-p
     ctx function)
    (p05b3-solution-p ctx function))))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

title: putnam_2005_b3
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2005_b3
-- (putnambench__agda__putnam_2005_b3): classification of positive
-- differentiable functions satisfying a reciprocal-argument derivative
-- equation as positive real power functions. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module Putnam2005B3 where

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; _*_)

infix 4 _!=_
infixr 3 _and_
infix 2 _iff_

data Bottom : Set where

Not : Set -> Set
Not A =
  A -> Bottom

_!=_ : {A : Set} -> A -> A -> Set
x != y =
  Not (x == y)

record _and_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

record _iff_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor equivalence
  field
    forward  : A -> B
    backward : B -> A

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

data _or_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  left  : A -> A or B
  right : B -> A or B

record CompleteOrderedRealField (R : Set) : Set1 where
  field
    zeroR oneR : R
    add multiply : R -> R -> R
    negate inverse : R -> R
    lessOrEqual : R -> R -> Set
    fromNat : Nat -> R

    one-not-zero :
      oneR != zeroR

    add-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> add x y == add y x
    add-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      add (add x y) z == add x (add y z)
    add-zero :
      (x : R) -> add x zeroR == x
    add-inverse :
      (x : R) -> add x (negate x) == zeroR

    multiply-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> multiply x y == multiply y x
    multiply-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply (multiply x y) z ==
      multiply x (multiply y z)
    multiply-one :
      (x : R) -> multiply x oneR == x
    multiply-zero :
      (x : R) -> multiply x zeroR == zeroR
    distribute :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply x (add y z) ==
      add (multiply x y) (multiply x z)
    inverse-zero :
      inverse zeroR == zeroR
    multiply-inverse :
      (x : R) ->
      x != zeroR ->
      multiply x (inverse x) == oneR

    order-reflexive :
      (x : R) -> lessOrEqual x x
    order-transitive :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y z ->
      lessOrEqual x z
    order-antisymmetric :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y x ->
      x == y
    order-total :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y or lessOrEqual y x
    add-order :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual (add z x) (add z y)
    multiply-nonnegative :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR x ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR y ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR (multiply x y)
    zero-less-than-one :
      lessOrEqual zeroR oneR and zeroR != oneR

    fromNat-zero :
      fromNat zero == zeroR
    fromNat-successor :
      (n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (suc n) == add (fromNat n) oneR
    fromNat-addition :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m + n) == add (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-multiplication :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m * n) == multiply (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-injective :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat m == fromNat n ->
      m == n

    archimedean :
      (x : R) ->
      Exists Nat
        (\ n ->
          lessOrEqual x (fromNat n))
    least-upper-bound :
      (P : R -> Set) ->
      Exists R P ->
      Exists R
        (\ upper ->
          (x : R) ->
          P x ->
          lessOrEqual x upper) ->
      Exists R
        (\ supremum ->
          ((x : R) ->
            P x ->
            lessOrEqual x supremum)
          and
          ((upper : R) ->
            ((x : R) ->
              P x ->
              lessOrEqual x upper) ->
            lessOrEqual supremum upper))

open CompleteOrderedRealField

subtract :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
subtract reals x y =
  add reals x (negate reals y)

divide :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
divide reals x y =
  multiply reals x (inverse reals y)

StrictLess :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
StrictLess reals x y =
  lessOrEqual reals x y and x != y

CloseTo :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
CloseTo reals center radius x =
  StrictLess reals
    (subtract reals center radius)
    x
  and
  StrictLess reals
    x
    (add reals center radius)

naturalPower :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  Nat ->
  R
naturalPower reals x zero =
  oneR reals
naturalPower reals x (suc n) =
  multiply reals
    (naturalPower reals x n)
    x

factorial : Nat -> Nat
factorial zero =
  suc zero
factorial (suc n) =
  suc n * factorial n

sumFirst :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Nat ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  R
sumFirst reals zero term =
  zeroR reals
sumFirst reals (suc n) term =
  add reals
    (sumFirst reals n term)
    (term n)

data _<=N_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set where
  zero<=N   : {n : Nat} -> zero <=N n
  suc<=sucN : {m n : Nat} -> m <=N n -> suc m <=N suc n

ConvergesTo :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  R ->
  Set
ConvergesTo {R} reals sequence limit =
  (epsilon : R) ->
  StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) epsilon ->
  Exists Nat
    (\ cutoff ->
      (n : Nat) ->
      cutoff <=N n ->
      CloseTo reals limit epsilon (sequence n))

SeriesHasSum :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  R ->
  Set
SeriesHasSum reals terms limit =
  ConvergesTo reals
    (\ n -> sumFirst reals n terms)
    limit

exponentialTerm :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  Nat ->
  R
exponentialTerm reals x n =
  divide reals
    (naturalPower reals x n)
    (fromNat reals (factorial n))

ExponentialValue :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
ExponentialValue reals x value =
  SeriesHasSum reals
    (exponentialTerm reals x)
    value

record StandardRealPowers
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) :
  Set1 where

  field
    exponential logarithm : R -> R

    exponential-series :
      (x : R) ->
      ExponentialValue reals x (exponential x)

    exponential-positive :
      (x : R) ->
      StrictLess reals
        (zeroR reals)
        (exponential x)

    exponential-injective :
      (x y : R) ->
      exponential x == exponential y ->
      x == y

    exponential-logarithm :
      (x : R) ->
      StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) x ->
      exponential (logarithm x) == x

open StandardRealPowers

realPower :
  {R : Set}
  {reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R} ->
  StandardRealPowers reals ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
realPower {reals = reals} powers base exponent =
  exponential powers
    (multiply reals exponent (logarithm powers base))

differenceQuotient :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (R -> R) ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
differenceQuotient reals function point x =
  divide reals
    (subtract reals (function x) (function point))
    (subtract reals x point)

DerivativeAt :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (R -> R) ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
DerivativeAt {R} reals function point derivative =
  (epsilon : R) ->
  StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) epsilon ->
  Exists R
    (\ delta ->
      StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) delta
      and
      ((x : R) ->
        CloseTo reals point delta x ->
        x != point ->
        CloseTo reals derivative epsilon
          (differenceQuotient reals function point x)))

PositiveValuedOnPositiveReals :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (R -> R) ->
  Set
PositiveValuedOnPositiveReals {R} reals function =
  (x : R) ->
  StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) x ->
  StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) (function x)

DifferentiableOnPositiveReals :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (R -> R) ->
  Set
DifferentiableOnPositiveReals {R} reals function =
  (x : R) ->
  StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) x ->
  Exists R
    (\ derivative ->
      DerivativeAt reals function x derivative)

module Putnam2005B3Statement
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R)
  (powers : StandardRealPowers reals)
  (function : R -> R) where

  ReciprocalDerivativeEquation : Set
  ReciprocalDerivativeEquation =
    Exists R
      (\ a ->
        StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) a
        and
        ((x : R) ->
          StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) x ->
          DerivativeAt reals
            function
            (divide reals a x)
            (divide reals x (function x))))

  PositivePowerFunction : Set
  PositivePowerFunction =
    Exists R
      (\ c ->
        Exists R
          (\ d ->
            StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) c
            and
            StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) d
            and
            (d == oneR reals -> c == oneR reals)
            and
            ((x : R) ->
              StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) x ->
              function x ==
              multiply reals c (realPower powers x d))))

  proposition : Set
  proposition =
    ReciprocalDerivativeEquation iff PositivePowerFunction

putnam-2005-b3 : Set1
putnam-2005-b3 =
  (R : Set) ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) ->
  (powers : StandardRealPowers reals) ->
  (function : R -> R) ->
  PositiveValuedOnPositiveReals reals function ->
  DifferentiableOnPositiveReals reals function ->
  Putnam2005B3Statement.proposition reals powers function

title: putnam_2005_b3
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2005_b3:
  the classification of positive differentiable functions on the positive
  reals satisfying a derivative functional equation. This file contains no
  proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open pred_setTheory realTheory real_topologyTheory transcTheory derivativeTheory;

val putnam_2005_b3 =
  ``!f : real -> real.
      ((!x : real. 0 < x ==> 0 < f x) /\
       f differentiable_on {x : real | 0 < x})
      ==>
      ((?a : real.
          0 < a /\
          !x : real.
            0 < x
            ==>
            vector_derivative f (at (a / x)) = x / f x)
       <=>
       ?c d : real.
         0 < c /\
         0 < d /\
         (d = 1 ==> c = 1) /\
         !x : real.
           0 < x ==> f x = c * x powr d)``;

title: putnam_2005_b3
content:
$(
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact
  putnam_2005_b3: classification of positive differentiable functions on
  the positive reals satisfying a reciprocal-argument derivative equation
  as positive constant multiples of positive real powers. This file contains
  no proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  RR ^m RR is the class of total real-valued functions. The hypotheses
  restrict positivity and membership in the domain of set.mm's real
  derivative to positive inputs, exactly representing a differentiable
  function from (0,+infinity) to (0,+infinity). Since a and x are positive,
  a / x is also in that derivative domain.

  On positive x, set.mm's complex-power expression x ^c d agrees with the
  real power exp(d log x). The right side inlines the source solution set:
  c and d are positive, d = 1 implies c = 1, and F(x) = c x^d for every
  positive x. All witnesses remain internally existentially quantified.
  The final declaration is the single unproved $a corpus statement; this
  database contains no $p proof statement.
$)

${

% Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2005_b3:
% positive differentiable functions on the positive reals satisfying the
% stated derivative equation are exactly the normalized positive real power
% functions. This file contains no proof.

putnam_2005_b3: THEORY
BEGIN
  real_function: TYPE = [real -> real]

  safe_div(numerator, denominator: real): real =
    IF denominator = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      numerator / denominator
    ENDIF

  nat_factorial(index: nat): RECURSIVE nat =
    IF index = 0 THEN
      1
    ELSE
      index * nat_factorial(index - 1)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE index

  exponential_partial(x: real, count: nat): RECURSIVE real =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      LET index: nat = count - 1 IN
        exponential_partial(x, count - 1)
          + safe_div(
              x ^ index,
              nat_factorial(index) :: real)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  converges_to(sequence: [nat -> real], value: real): bool =
    FORALL (epsilon_value: posreal):
      EXISTS (cutoff: nat):
        FORALL (index: nat):
          cutoff <= index IMPLIES
            abs(sequence(index) - value) < epsilon_value

  exponential_value(argument, value: real): bool =
    converges_to(
      (LAMBDA (count: nat):
        exponential_partial(argument, count)),
      value)

  natural_log_value(argument, value: real): bool =
    argument > 0
      AND exponential_value(value, argument)

  real_power_value(base, exponent, value: real): bool =
    base > 0
      AND EXISTS (log_base: real):
        natural_log_value(base, log_base)
          AND exponential_value(exponent * log_base, value)

  has_derivative_at(
      f: real_function,
      derivative, point: real): bool =
    FORALL (epsilon_value: posreal):
      EXISTS (delta: posreal):
        FORALL (h: real):
          (NOT (h = 0) AND abs(h) < delta)
            IMPLIES
              abs(
                f(point + h) - f(point)
                  - derivative * h)
                < epsilon_value * abs(h)

  positive_on_positive_reals(f: real_function): bool =
    FORALL (x: real):
      x > 0 IMPLIES f(x) > 0

  differentiable_on_positive_reals(f: real_function): bool =
    FORALL (x: real):
      x > 0 IMPLIES
        EXISTS (derivative: real):
          has_derivative_at(f, derivative, x)

  satisfies_derivative_equation(f: real_function): bool =
    EXISTS (a: real):
      a > 0
        AND FORALL (x: real):
          x > 0 IMPLIES
            has_derivative_at(
              f,
              safe_div(x, f(x)),
              safe_div(a, x))

  putnam_2005_b3_solution(f: real_function): bool =
    EXISTS (c, d: real):
      c > 0
        AND d > 0
        AND (d = 1 IMPLIES c = 1)
        AND FORALL (x: real):
          x > 0 IMPLIES
            EXISTS (x_to_d: real):
              real_power_value(x, d, x_to_d)
                AND f(x) = c * x_to_d

  putnam_2005_b3: bool =
    FORALL (f: real_function):
      (positive_on_positive_reals(f)
        AND differentiable_on_positive_reals(f))
      IMPLIES
        (satisfies_derivative_equation(f)
          IFF putnam_2005_b3_solution(f))
END putnam_2005_b3

;; Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2005_b4:
;; for positive integers m and n, the number of integer n-tuples whose sum of
;; absolute values is at most m is unchanged when m and n are exchanged. This
;; file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

;; For fixed M, a base-(2M+1) digit D represents the integer D-M. Codes below
;; (2M+1)^N therefore represent all integer N-tuples in [-M,M]^N bijectively.

(defun putnam-2005-b4-coordinate (code index m)
  (let* ((base (+ (* 2 (nfix m)) 1))
         (digit (mod (floor (nfix code) (expt base (nfix index)))
                     base)))
    (- digit (nfix m))))

(defun putnam-2005-b4-absolute-sum (code coordinate-count m)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix coordinate-count)))
  (if (zp coordinate-count)
      0
    (let ((index (- coordinate-count 1)))
      (+ (abs (putnam-2005-b4-coordinate code index m))
         (putnam-2005-b4-absolute-sum code index m)))))

(defun putnam-2005-b4-count-codes (candidate-count n m)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix candidate-count)))
  (if (zp candidate-count)
      0
    (let ((code (- candidate-count 1)))
      (+ (if (<= (putnam-2005-b4-absolute-sum code n m)
                 (nfix m))
             1
           0)
         (putnam-2005-b4-count-codes code n m)))))

(defun putnam-2005-b4-tuple-count (m n)
  (let* ((fixed-m (nfix m))
         (fixed-n (nfix n))
         (base (+ (* 2 fixed-m) 1)))
    (putnam-2005-b4-count-codes
     (expt base fixed-n)
     fixed-n
     fixed-m)))

(defun putnambench-putnam-2005-b4-statement (m n)
  (implies
   (and (natp m)
        (< 0 m)
        (natp n)
        (< 0 n))
   (equal (putnam-2005-b4-tuple-count m n)
          (putnam-2005-b4-tuple-count n m))))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

-- Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2005_b4
-- (putnambench__agda__putnam_2005_b4): symmetry in the number of integer
-- tuples of fixed positive length whose sum of absolute values is bounded
-- by a positive integer. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module Putnam2005B4 where

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Int using (Int; pos; negsuc)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_)

infix 4 _<=N_
infixr 5 _::_

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

data _<=N_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set where
  zero<=N   : {n : Nat} -> zero <=N n
  suc<=sucN : {m n : Nat} -> m <=N n -> suc m <=N suc n

data Fin : Nat -> Set where
  fzero : {n : Nat} -> Fin (suc n)
  fsuc  : {n : Nat} -> Fin n -> Fin (suc n)

data Vec (A : Set) : Nat -> Set where
  []   : Vec A zero
  _::_ : {n : Nat} -> A -> Vec A n -> Vec A (suc n)

record HasCardinality
  {A : Set}
  (member : A -> Set)
  (cardinality : Nat) :
  Set where

  field
    enumerate :
      Fin cardinality ->
      A

    enumerated-member :
      (index : Fin cardinality) ->
      member (enumerate index)

    enumeration-complete :
      (item : A) ->
      member item ->
      Exists (Fin cardinality)
        (\ index -> item == enumerate index)

    enumeration-injective :
      (left-index right-index : Fin cardinality) ->
      enumerate left-index == enumerate right-index ->
      left-index == right-index

one : Nat
one =
  suc zero

Positive : Nat -> Set
Positive n =
  one <=N n

absoluteValue : Int -> Nat
absoluteValue (pos n) =
  n
absoluteValue (negsuc n) =
  suc n

sumAbsoluteValues :
  {n : Nat} ->
  Vec Int n ->
  Nat
sumAbsoluteValues [] =
  zero
sumAbsoluteValues (x :: xs) =
  absoluteValue x + sumAbsoluteValues xs

BoundedTuple :
  {n : Nat} ->
  Nat ->
  Vec Int n ->
  Set
BoundedTuple bound tuple =
  sumAbsoluteValues tuple <=N bound

CountsBoundedTuples :
  (Nat -> Nat -> Nat) ->
  Set
CountsBoundedTuples f =
  (m n : Nat) ->
  Positive m ->
  Positive n ->
  HasCardinality
    (BoundedTuple {n = n} m)
    (f m n)

putnam-2005-b4 : Set
putnam-2005-b4 =
  (m n : Nat) ->
  Positive m ->
  Positive n ->
  (f : Nat -> Nat -> Nat) ->
  CountsBoundedTuples f ->
  f m n == f n m

content:
% Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2005_b4:
% for positive integers m and n, the number of integer n-tuples whose sum of
% coordinate absolute values is at most m is symmetric in m and n. This file
% contains no proof.

putnam_2005_b4: THEORY
BEGIN
  integer_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> int]
  integer_sequence_set: TYPE = [integer_sequence -> bool]
  sequence_enumeration: TYPE = [nat -> integer_sequence]
  count_function: TYPE = [posnat, posnat -> nat]

  absolute_prefix_sum(
      values: integer_sequence,
      count: nat): RECURSIVE int =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      absolute_prefix_sum(values, count - 1)
        + abs(values(count - 1))
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  canonical_tuple(
      values: integer_sequence,
      length: posnat): bool =
    FORALL (index: nat):
      length <= index IMPLIES values(index) = 0

  admissible_tuple(
      values: integer_sequence,
      bound, length: posnat): bool =
    canonical_tuple(values, length)
      AND absolute_prefix_sum(values, length) <= bound

  admissible_tuples(
      bound, length: posnat): integer_sequence_set =
    LAMBDA (values: integer_sequence):
      admissible_tuple(values, bound, length)

  injective_below(
      enumeration: sequence_enumeration,
      cardinality: nat): bool =
    FORALL (i, j: nat):
      i < cardinality
        AND j < cardinality
        AND enumeration(i) = enumeration(j)
      IMPLIES i = j

  enumerates_exactly(
      enumeration: sequence_enumeration,
      set_value: integer_sequence_set,
      cardinality: nat): bool =
    FORALL (values: integer_sequence):
      set_value(values)
        IFF EXISTS (position: nat):
          position < cardinality
            AND enumeration(position) = values

  has_cardinality(
      set_value: integer_sequence_set,
      cardinality: nat): bool =
    EXISTS (enumeration: sequence_enumeration):
      injective_below(enumeration, cardinality)
        AND enumerates_exactly(
          enumeration, set_value, cardinality)

  counts_admissible_tuples(f: count_function): bool =
    FORALL (bound, length: posnat):
      has_cardinality(
        admissible_tuples(bound, length),
        f(bound, length))

  putnam_2005_b4: bool =
    FORALL (m, n: posnat), (f: count_function):
      counts_admissible_tuples(f)
        IMPLIES f(m, n) = f(n, m)
END putnam_2005_b4

(* Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2005_b5:
   a real multivariate polynomial that is harmonic and divisible by the sum
   of the squares of its variables is identically zero. This file contains
   no proof. *)

From Stdlib Require Import Reals Lists.List Vectors.Fin Arith.PeanoNat.

Import ListNotations.
Open Scope R_scope.

Definition putnam_2005_b5_polynomial (n : nat) : Type :=
  list (RbaseSymbolsImpl.R * (Fin.t n -> nat)).

Fixpoint putnam_2005_b5_fin_product
    (n : nat) :
    (Fin.t n -> RbaseSymbolsImpl.R) -> RbaseSymbolsImpl.R :=
  match n as m return
    (Fin.t m -> RbaseSymbolsImpl.R) -> RbaseSymbolsImpl.R with
  | O => fun _ => 1
  | S k =>
      fun f =>
        f Fin.F1 *
        putnam_2005_b5_fin_product k (fun i => f (Fin.FS i))
  end.

Fixpoint putnam_2005_b5_fin_enum
    (n : nat) : list (Fin.t n) :=
  match n with
  | O => []
  | S k => Fin.F1 :: List.map Fin.FS (putnam_2005_b5_fin_enum k)
  end.

Fixpoint putnam_2005_b5_eval
    {n : nat}
    (P : putnam_2005_b5_polynomial n)
    (x : Fin.t n -> RbaseSymbolsImpl.R) : RbaseSymbolsImpl.R :=
  match P with
  | [] => 0
  | term :: rest =>
      fst term *
        putnam_2005_b5_fin_product n
          (fun i => x i ^ snd term i) +
      putnam_2005_b5_eval rest x
  end.

Definition putnam_2005_b5_polynomial_eq
    {n : nat}
    (P Q : putnam_2005_b5_polynomial n) : Prop :=
  forall x : Fin.t n -> RbaseSymbolsImpl.R,
    putnam_2005_b5_eval P x = putnam_2005_b5_eval Q x.

Definition putnam_2005_b5_zero
    (n : nat) : putnam_2005_b5_polynomial n :=
  [].

Definition putnam_2005_b5_term_mul
    {n : nat}
    (a b : RbaseSymbolsImpl.R * (Fin.t n -> nat)) :
    RbaseSymbolsImpl.R * (Fin.t n -> nat) :=
  (fst a * fst b,
   fun i => Nat.add (snd a i) (snd b i)).

Fixpoint putnam_2005_b5_mul_by_term
    {n : nat}
    (a : RbaseSymbolsImpl.R * (Fin.t n -> nat))
    (Q : putnam_2005_b5_polynomial n) :
    putnam_2005_b5_polynomial n :=
  match Q with
  | [] => []
  | b :: rest =>
      putnam_2005_b5_term_mul a b ::
      putnam_2005_b5_mul_by_term a rest
  end.

Fixpoint putnam_2005_b5_polynomial_mul
    {n : nat}
    (P Q : putnam_2005_b5_polynomial n) :
    putnam_2005_b5_polynomial n :=
  match P with
  | [] => []
  | a :: rest =>
      putnam_2005_b5_mul_by_term a Q ++
      putnam_2005_b5_polynomial_mul rest Q
  end.

Fixpoint putnam_2005_b5_partial_derivative
    {n : nat}
    (i : Fin.t n)
    (P : putnam_2005_b5_polynomial n) :
    putnam_2005_b5_polynomial n :=
  match P with
  | [] => []
  | term :: rest =>
      (fst term * INR (snd term i),
       fun j =>
         if Fin.eq_dec j i
         then Nat.pred (snd term j)
         else snd term j) ::
      putnam_2005_b5_partial_derivative i rest
  end.

Definition putnam_2005_b5_second_partial
    {n : nat}
    (i : Fin.t n)
    (P : putnam_2005_b5_polynomial n) :
    putnam_2005_b5_polynomial n :=
  putnam_2005_b5_partial_derivative i
    (putnam_2005_b5_partial_derivative i P).

Definition putnam_2005_b5_laplacian
    {n : nat}
    (P : putnam_2005_b5_polynomial n) :
    putnam_2005_b5_polynomial n :=
  List.flat_map
    (fun i => putnam_2005_b5_second_partial i P)
    (putnam_2005_b5_fin_enum n).

Definition putnam_2005_b5_square_variable
    {n : nat}
    (i : Fin.t n) :
    RbaseSymbolsImpl.R * (Fin.t n -> nat) :=
  (1,
   fun j => if Fin.eq_dec j i then 2%nat else 0%nat).

Definition putnam_2005_b5_sum_squares
    (n : nat) : putnam_2005_b5_polynomial n :=
  List.map putnam_2005_b5_square_variable
    (putnam_2005_b5_fin_enum n).

Theorem putnam_2005_b5
    (n : nat)
    (npos : (0 < n)%nat)
    (P : putnam_2005_b5_polynomial n)
    (hderiv :
      putnam_2005_b5_polynomial_eq
        (putnam_2005_b5_laplacian P)
        (putnam_2005_b5_zero n))
    (hsumsq :
      exists Q : putnam_2005_b5_polynomial n,
        putnam_2005_b5_polynomial_eq
          (putnam_2005_b5_polynomial_mul
            (putnam_2005_b5_sum_squares n) Q)
          P) :
  putnam_2005_b5_polynomial_eq P (putnam_2005_b5_zero n).
Proof.
Admitted.
