theory putnam_2005_b5 imports Complex_Main
"HOL-Analysis.Derivative"
begin

theorem putnam_2005_b5:
  fixes n :: nat
    and P :: "('n::finite \<Rightarrow> real) \<Rightarrow> real"
    and ispoly :: "(('n \<Rightarrow> real) \<Rightarrow> real) \<Rightarrow> bool"
    and P2deriv :: "'n \<Rightarrow> ('n \<Rightarrow> real) \<Rightarrow> real"
    and Psumsq :: "('n \<Rightarrow> real) \<Rightarrow> real"
  defines "ispoly \<equiv> (\<lambda>P'::('n\<Rightarrow>real)\<Rightarrow>real. (\<exists>l::(real\<times>('n\<Rightarrow>nat)) list. \<forall>x::'n\<Rightarrow>real. P' x = (\<Sum>j::nat=0..((length l)-1). (fst (l!j)) * (\<Prod>i::'n\<in>UNIV. (x i) ^ ((snd (l!j)) i)))))"
    and "P2deriv \<equiv> (\<lambda>(i::'n)(x::'n\<Rightarrow>real). (deriv^^2) (\<lambda>xi::real. P (\<lambda>i'::'n. if i' = i then xi else x i')) (x i))"
    and "Psumsq \<equiv> (\<lambda>x::'n\<Rightarrow>real. (\<Sum>i::'n\<in>UNIV. (x i)^2))"
  assumes npos: "n > 0"
    and pncard: "CARD('n) = n"
    and Ppoly: "ispoly P"
    and hderiv: "\<forall>x::'n\<Rightarrow>real. (\<Sum>i::'n\<in>UNIV. P2deriv i x) = 0"
    and hsumsq: "\<exists>Q::('n\<Rightarrow>real)\<Rightarrow>real. ispoly Q \<and> (\<forall>x::'n\<Rightarrow>real. (Psumsq x) * (Q x) = P x)"
  shows "P = (\<lambda>x::'n\<Rightarrow>real. 0)"
  sorry

end

title: putnam_2005_b5
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2005_b5:
  a real multivariate polynomial that is harmonic and divisible by the sum
  of the squares of its variables is identically zero. This file contains no
  proof.
*)

let statement =
  `let xrepl =
     \(x:real^N) (i:num) (t:real).
       (lambda k. if k = i then t else x$k):real^N in
   let has_derivative_at =
     \(h:real->real) (d:real) (a:real).
       !e:real.
         &0 < e
         ==> ?delta:real.
               &0 < delta /\
               !y:real.
                 &0 < abs (y - a) /\ abs (y - a) < delta
                 ==> abs ((h y - h a) / (y - a) - d) < e in
   let partial =
     \(P:real^N->real) (i:num) (x:real^N).
       @d:real.
         has_derivative_at
           (\t:real. P (xrepl x i t)) d (x$i) in
   let coordinate_second_derivative =
     \(P:real^N->real) (i:num) (x:real^N).
       partial (\y:real^N. partial P i y) i x in
   let is_polynomial =
     \(P:real^N->real).
       ?s:(num^N)->bool. ?c:(num^N)->real.
         FINITE s /\
         !x:real^N.
           P x =
           sum s
             (\m:num^N.
                c m *
                product (1..dimindex(:N))
                  (\i:num. (x$i) pow (m$i))) in
   !n:num. !P:real^N->real.
     dimindex(:N) = n /\
     0 < n /\
     is_polynomial P /\
     (!x:real^N.
        sum (1..n) (\i:num. coordinate_second_derivative P i x) = &0) /\
     (?Q:real^N->real.
        is_polynomial Q /\
        !x:real^N.
          sum (1..n) (\i:num. (x$i) pow 2) * Q x = P x)
     ==> P = (\x:real^N. &0)`;;

title: putnam_2005_b5
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2005_b5:
;; a real multivariate polynomial that is harmonic and divisible by the sum
;; of the squares of its variables is identically zero. This file contains no
;; proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))

;; Coefficients live in a represented real closed field. Sparse polynomials
;; are canonical lists of (coefficient exponent-vector) terms, ordered
;; lexicographically by exponent vector. This is an exact representation of
;; real multivariate polynomials, not a restriction to ACL2 rationals.
;;
;; The formal Laplacian is computed term by term. Divisibility by
;; x_0^2+...+x_(n-1)^2 is decided by the standard single-divisor multivariate
;; division algorithm. Since the divisor is monic, zero remainder is
;; equivalent to the source's internal existential polynomial quotient.

(defun putnam-2005-b5-quoted (object)
  (list 'quote object))

(defun putnam-2005-b5-apply1-term (function argument)
  (list
   'apply$
   (putnam-2005-b5-quoted function)
   (list 'cons argument nil)))

(defun putnam-2005-b5-apply2-term (function left right)
  (list
   'apply$
   (putnam-2005-b5-quoted function)
   (list 'cons left (list 'cons right nil))))

(defun putnam-2005-b5-and-term (terms)
  (if (endp terms)
      (putnam-2005-b5-quoted t)
    (list
     'if
     (car terms)
     (putnam-2005-b5-and-term (cdr terms))
     (putnam-2005-b5-quoted nil))))

(defun putnam-2005-b5-or-term (terms)
  (if (endp terms)
      (putnam-2005-b5-quoted nil)
    (list
     'if
     (car terms)
     (putnam-2005-b5-quoted t)
     (putnam-2005-b5-or-term (cdr terms)))))

(defun putnam-2005-b5-not-term (term)
  (list
   'if
   term
   (putnam-2005-b5-quoted nil)
   (putnam-2005-b5-quoted t)))

(defun putnam-2005-b5-implies-term (antecedent consequent)
  (list
   'if
   antecedent
   consequent
   (putnam-2005-b5-quoted t)))

(defun putnam-2005-b5-true-function (formals)
  (list
   'lambda
   formals
   (putnam-2005-b5-quoted t)))

(defun putnam-2005-b5-carrier-term (carrier element)
  (putnam-2005-b5-apply1-term carrier element))

(defun putnam-2005-b5-operation-term (operation left right)
  (putnam-2005-b5-apply2-term operation left right))

(defun putnam-2005-b5-all-coefficients-function (carrier)
  (list
   'lambda
   '(loop$-gvars loop$-ivars)
   (putnam-2005-b5-apply1-term
    carrier 'loop$-ivars)))

(defun putnam-2005-b5-all-coefficients-term
    (carrier coefficients)
  (list
   'always$+
   (putnam-2005-b5-quoted
    (putnam-2005-b5-all-coefficients-function
     carrier))
   (putnam-2005-b5-quoted nil)
   coefficients))

(defun putnam-2005-b5-univariate-polynomial-term
    (carrier zero coefficients)
  (putnam-2005-b5-and-term
   (list
    (list 'true-listp coefficients)
    (list 'consp coefficients)
    (putnam-2005-b5-all-coefficients-term
     carrier coefficients)
    (putnam-2005-b5-or-term
     (list
      (list 'equal
            (list 'len coefficients)
            (putnam-2005-b5-quoted 1))
      (putnam-2005-b5-not-term
       (list 'equal
             (list 'car (list 'last coefficients))
             (putnam-2005-b5-quoted zero))))))))

(defun putnam-2005-b5-field-laws-function
    (carrier zero one add mul neg inv)
  (let* ((x 'x)
         (y 'y)
         (z 'z)
         (qzero (putnam-2005-b5-quoted zero))
         (qone (putnam-2005-b5-quoted one))
         (add-xy
          (putnam-2005-b5-operation-term add x y))
         (add-yz
          (putnam-2005-b5-operation-term add y z))
         (mul-xy
          (putnam-2005-b5-operation-term mul x y))
         (mul-yz
          (putnam-2005-b5-operation-term mul y z))
         (neg-x
          (putnam-2005-b5-apply1-term neg x))
         (inv-x
          (putnam-2005-b5-apply1-term inv x))
         (domain
          (putnam-2005-b5-and-term
           (list
            (putnam-2005-b5-carrier-term carrier x)
            (putnam-2005-b5-carrier-term carrier y)
            (putnam-2005-b5-carrier-term carrier z))))
         (laws
          (putnam-2005-b5-and-term
           (list
            (putnam-2005-b5-carrier-term carrier add-xy)
            (putnam-2005-b5-carrier-term carrier mul-xy)
            (putnam-2005-b5-carrier-term carrier neg-x)
            (putnam-2005-b5-carrier-term carrier inv-x)
            (list
             'equal
             (putnam-2005-b5-operation-term add add-xy z)
             (putnam-2005-b5-operation-term add x add-yz))
            (list
             'equal
             (putnam-2005-b5-operation-term mul mul-xy z)
             (putnam-2005-b5-operation-term mul x mul-yz))
            (list
             'equal
             add-xy
             (putnam-2005-b5-operation-term add y x))
            (list
             'equal
             mul-xy
             (putnam-2005-b5-operation-term mul y x))
            (list
             'equal
             (putnam-2005-b5-operation-term add x qzero)
             x)
            (list
             'equal
             (putnam-2005-b5-operation-term add x neg-x)
             qzero)
            (list
             'equal
             (putnam-2005-b5-operation-term mul x qone)
             x)
            (putnam-2005-b5-implies-term
             (list 'equal x qzero)
             (list 'equal inv-x qzero))
            (putnam-2005-b5-implies-term
             (putnam-2005-b5-not-term
              (list 'equal x qzero))
             (list
              'equal
              (putnam-2005-b5-operation-term mul x inv-x)
              qone))
            (list
             'equal
             (putnam-2005-b5-operation-term mul x add-yz)
             (putnam-2005-b5-operation-term
              add
              (putnam-2005-b5-operation-term mul x y)
              (putnam-2005-b5-operation-term mul x z)))))))
    (list
     'lambda
     '(x y z)
     (putnam-2005-b5-implies-term domain laws))))

(defun putnam-2005-b5-order-laws-function
    (carrier zero add mul lt)
  (let* ((x 'x)
         (y 'y)
         (z 'z)
         (qzero (putnam-2005-b5-quoted zero))
         (lt-xy
          (putnam-2005-b5-operation-term lt x y))
         (lt-yx
          (putnam-2005-b5-operation-term lt y x))
         (lt-yz
          (putnam-2005-b5-operation-term lt y z))
         (lt-xz
          (putnam-2005-b5-operation-term lt x z))
         (domain
          (putnam-2005-b5-and-term
           (list
            (putnam-2005-b5-carrier-term carrier x)
            (putnam-2005-b5-carrier-term carrier y)
            (putnam-2005-b5-carrier-term carrier z))))
         (laws
          (putnam-2005-b5-and-term
           (list
            (putnam-2005-b5-not-term
             (putnam-2005-b5-operation-term lt x x))
            (putnam-2005-b5-or-term
             (list
              lt-xy
              (list 'equal x y)
              lt-yx))
            (putnam-2005-b5-implies-term
             (putnam-2005-b5-and-term
              (list lt-xy lt-yz))
             lt-xz)
            (putnam-2005-b5-implies-term
             lt-xy
             (putnam-2005-b5-operation-term
              lt
              (putnam-2005-b5-operation-term add x z)
              (putnam-2005-b5-operation-term add y z)))
            (putnam-2005-b5-implies-term
             (putnam-2005-b5-and-term
              (list
               (putnam-2005-b5-operation-term lt qzero x)
               (putnam-2005-b5-operation-term lt qzero y)))
             (putnam-2005-b5-operation-term
              lt
              qzero
              (putnam-2005-b5-operation-term mul x y)))))))
    (list
     'lambda
     '(x y z)
     (putnam-2005-b5-implies-term domain laws))))

(defun putnam-2005-b5-square-root-laws-function
    (carrier zero mul lt square-root)
  (let* ((x 'x)
         (qzero (putnam-2005-b5-quoted zero))
         (root
          (putnam-2005-b5-apply1-term square-root x))
         (domain
          (putnam-2005-b5-and-term
           (list
            (putnam-2005-b5-carrier-term carrier x)
            (putnam-2005-b5-not-term
             (putnam-2005-b5-operation-term lt x qzero)))))
         (laws
          (putnam-2005-b5-and-term
           (list
            (putnam-2005-b5-carrier-term carrier root)
            (list
             'equal
             (putnam-2005-b5-operation-term mul root root)
             x)))))
    (list
     'lambda
     '(x)
     (putnam-2005-b5-implies-term domain laws))))

(defun putnam-2005-b5-evaluation-laws-function
    (carrier zero add mul evaluate)
  (let* ((coefficient 'coefficient)
         (rest 'rest)
         (x 'x)
         (qzero (putnam-2005-b5-quoted zero))
         (domain
          (putnam-2005-b5-and-term
           (list
            (putnam-2005-b5-carrier-term
             carrier coefficient)
            (list 'true-listp rest)
            (putnam-2005-b5-all-coefficients-term
             carrier rest)
            (putnam-2005-b5-carrier-term carrier x))))
         (empty-law
          (putnam-2005-b5-implies-term
           (putnam-2005-b5-carrier-term carrier x)
           (list
            'equal
            (putnam-2005-b5-operation-term
             evaluate
             (putnam-2005-b5-quoted nil)
             x)
            qzero)))
         (recursive-value
          (putnam-2005-b5-operation-term
           add
           coefficient
           (putnam-2005-b5-operation-term
            mul
            x
            (putnam-2005-b5-operation-term
             evaluate rest x))))
         (recursive-law
          (putnam-2005-b5-implies-term
           domain
           (putnam-2005-b5-and-term
            (list
             (putnam-2005-b5-carrier-term
              carrier
              (putnam-2005-b5-operation-term
               evaluate
               (list 'cons coefficient rest)
               x))
             (list
              'equal
              (putnam-2005-b5-operation-term
               evaluate
               (list 'cons coefficient rest)
               x)
              recursive-value))))))
    (list
     'lambda
     '(coefficient rest x)
     (putnam-2005-b5-and-term
      (list empty-law recursive-law)))))

(defun putnam-2005-b5-odd-root-laws-function
    (carrier zero evaluate odd-root)
  (let* ((coefficients 'coefficients)
         (root
          (putnam-2005-b5-apply1-term
           odd-root coefficients))
         (domain
          (putnam-2005-b5-and-term
           (list
            (putnam-2005-b5-univariate-polynomial-term
             carrier zero coefficients)
            (list 'evenp (list 'len coefficients)))))
         (laws
          (putnam-2005-b5-and-term
           (list
            (putnam-2005-b5-carrier-term carrier root)
            (list
             'equal
             (putnam-2005-b5-operation-term
              evaluate coefficients root)
             (putnam-2005-b5-quoted zero))))))
    (list
     'lambda
     '(coefficients)
     (putnam-2005-b5-implies-term domain laws))))

(defun putnam-2005-b5-real-closed-field-p
    (carrier zero one add mul neg inv lt square-root
             evaluate odd-root)
  (let* ((field-laws
          (putnam-2005-b5-field-laws-function
           carrier zero one add mul neg inv))
         (order-laws
          (putnam-2005-b5-order-laws-function
           carrier zero add mul lt))
         (square-root-laws
          (putnam-2005-b5-square-root-laws-function
           carrier zero mul lt square-root))
         (evaluation-laws
          (putnam-2005-b5-evaluation-laws-function
           carrier zero add mul evaluate))
         (odd-root-laws
          (putnam-2005-b5-odd-root-laws-function
           carrier zero evaluate odd-root))
         (true-ternary
          (putnam-2005-b5-true-function '(x y z)))
         (true-unary
          (putnam-2005-b5-true-function '(x)))
         (true-evaluation
          (putnam-2005-b5-true-function
           '(coefficient rest x)))
         (true-polynomial
          (putnam-2005-b5-true-function '(coefficients))))
    (and
     (tamep-functionp carrier)
     (tamep-functionp add)
     (tamep-functionp mul)
     (tamep-functionp neg)
     (tamep-functionp inv)
     (tamep-functionp lt)
     (tamep-functionp square-root)
     (tamep-functionp evaluate)
     (tamep-functionp odd-root)
     (tamep-functionp field-laws)
     (tamep-functionp order-laws)
     (tamep-functionp square-root-laws)
     (tamep-functionp evaluation-laws)
     (tamep-functionp odd-root-laws)
     (tamep-functionp true-ternary)
     (tamep-functionp true-unary)
     (tamep-functionp true-evaluation)
     (tamep-functionp true-polynomial)
     (apply$ carrier (list zero))
     (apply$ carrier (list one))
     (not (equal zero one))
     (fn-equal field-laws true-ternary)
     (fn-equal order-laws true-ternary)
     (fn-equal square-root-laws true-unary)
     (fn-equal evaluation-laws true-evaluation)
     (fn-equal odd-root-laws true-polynomial))))

(defun putnam-2005-b5-nat-listp (values)
  (if (consp values)
      (and (natp (car values))
           (putnam-2005-b5-nat-listp (cdr values)))
    (equal values nil)))

(defun putnam-2005-b5-exponents-gt (left right)
  (if (consp left)
      (cond
       ((< (nfix (car right)) (nfix (car left))) t)
       ((< (nfix (car left)) (nfix (car right))) nil)
       (t
        (putnam-2005-b5-exponents-gt
         (cdr left) (cdr right))))
    nil))

(defun putnam-2005-b5-term-p
    (term n carrier zero)
  (and
   (true-listp term)
   (equal (len term) 2)
   (apply$ carrier (list (car term)))
   (not (equal (car term) zero))
   (true-listp (cadr term))
   (equal (len (cadr term)) n)
   (putnam-2005-b5-nat-listp (cadr term))))

(defun putnam-2005-b5-polynomial-p
    (polynomial n carrier zero)
  (if (consp polynomial)
      (and
       (putnam-2005-b5-term-p
        (car polynomial) n carrier zero)
       (or
        (endp (cdr polynomial))
        (putnam-2005-b5-exponents-gt
         (cadar polynomial)
         (cadadr polynomial)))
       (putnam-2005-b5-polynomial-p
        (cdr polynomial) n carrier zero))
    (equal polynomial nil)))

(defun putnam-2005-b5-field-natural
    (n zero one add)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix n)))
  (if (zp n)
      zero
    (apply$
     add
     (list
      one
      (putnam-2005-b5-field-natural
       (- n 1) zero one add)))))

(defun putnam-2005-b5-exponents-add (left right)
  (if (consp left)
      (cons
       (+ (nfix (car left)) (nfix (car right)))
       (putnam-2005-b5-exponents-add
        (cdr left) (cdr right)))
    nil))

(defun putnam-2005-b5-exponents-divide-p
    (divisor dividend)
  (if (consp divisor)
      (and
       (<= (nfix (car divisor)) (nfix (car dividend)))
       (putnam-2005-b5-exponents-divide-p
        (cdr divisor) (cdr dividend)))
    t))

(defun putnam-2005-b5-exponents-subtract
    (dividend divisor)
  (if (consp dividend)
      (cons
       (- (nfix (car dividend)) (nfix (car divisor)))
       (putnam-2005-b5-exponents-subtract
        (cdr dividend) (cdr divisor)))
    nil))

(defun putnam-2005-b5-insert-term
    (term polynomial add zero)
  (let ((coefficient (car term))
        (exponents (cadr term)))
    (cond
     ((equal coefficient zero)
      polynomial)
     ((endp polynomial)
      (list term))
     ((equal exponents (cadar polynomial))
      (let ((new-coefficient
             (apply$
              add
              (list coefficient (caar polynomial)))))
        (if (equal new-coefficient zero)
            (cdr polynomial)
          (cons
           (list new-coefficient exponents)
           (cdr polynomial)))))
     ((putnam-2005-b5-exponents-gt
       exponents (cadar polynomial))
      (cons term polynomial))
     (t
      (cons
       (car polynomial)
       (putnam-2005-b5-insert-term
        term (cdr polynomial) add zero))))))

(defun putnam-2005-b5-poly-add
    (left right add zero)
  (if (consp left)
      (putnam-2005-b5-insert-term
       (car left)
       (putnam-2005-b5-poly-add
        (cdr left) right add zero)
       add zero)
    right))

(defun putnam-2005-b5-poly-neg
    (polynomial neg)
  (if (consp polynomial)
      (cons
       (list
        (apply$ neg (list (caar polynomial)))
        (cadar polynomial))
       (putnam-2005-b5-poly-neg
        (cdr polynomial) neg))
    nil))

(defun putnam-2005-b5-poly-sub
    (left right add neg zero)
  (putnam-2005-b5-poly-add
   left
   (putnam-2005-b5-poly-neg right neg)
   add zero))

(defun putnam-2005-b5-monomial-times-poly
    (term polynomial mul add zero)
  (if (or (equal (car term) zero)
          (endp polynomial))
      nil
    (putnam-2005-b5-insert-term
     (list
      (apply$ mul (list (car term) (caar polynomial)))
      (putnam-2005-b5-exponents-add
       (cadr term) (cadar polynomial)))
     (putnam-2005-b5-monomial-times-poly
      term (cdr polynomial) mul add zero)
     add zero)))

(defun putnam-2005-b5-poly-mul
    (left right add mul zero)
  (if (consp left)
      (putnam-2005-b5-poly-add
       (putnam-2005-b5-monomial-times-poly
        (car left) right mul add zero)
       (putnam-2005-b5-poly-mul
        (cdr left) right add mul zero)
       add zero)
    nil))

(defun putnam-2005-b5-total-degree (exponents)
  (if (consp exponents)
      (+ (nfix (car exponents))
         (putnam-2005-b5-total-degree (cdr exponents)))
    0))

(defun putnam-2005-b5-max-total-degree (polynomial)
  (if (consp polynomial)
      (max
       (putnam-2005-b5-total-degree (cadar polynomial))
       (putnam-2005-b5-max-total-degree (cdr polynomial)))
    0))

(defun putnam-2005-b5-zero-exponents (n)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix n)))
  (if (zp n)
      nil
    (cons
     0
     (putnam-2005-b5-zero-exponents (- n 1)))))

(defun putnam-2005-b5-unit-square-exponents
    (n index)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix n)))
  (if (zp n)
      nil
    (if (zp index)
        (cons
         2
         (putnam-2005-b5-zero-exponents (- n 1)))
      (cons
       0
       (putnam-2005-b5-unit-square-exponents
        (- n 1) (- index 1))))))

(defun putnam-2005-b5-sum-squares-aux
    (remaining index n one add zero)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix remaining)))
  (if (zp remaining)
      nil
    (putnam-2005-b5-insert-term
     (list
      one
      (putnam-2005-b5-unit-square-exponents
       n index))
     (putnam-2005-b5-sum-squares-aux
      (- remaining 1) (+ 1 (nfix index))
      n one add zero)
     add zero)))

(defun putnam-2005-b5-sum-squares
    (n one add zero)
  (putnam-2005-b5-sum-squares-aux
   n 0 n one add zero))

(defun putnam-2005-b5-lower-exponent-by-two
    (exponents index)
  (if (consp exponents)
      (if (zp index)
          (cons (- (nfix (car exponents)) 2)
                (cdr exponents))
        (cons
         (car exponents)
         (putnam-2005-b5-lower-exponent-by-two
          (cdr exponents) (- (nfix index) 1))))
    nil))

(defun putnam-2005-b5-second-derivative-term
    (term index zero one add mul)
  (let* ((exponents (cadr term))
         (exponent (nfix (nth index exponents))))
    (if (< exponent 2)
        nil
      (let* ((k
              (putnam-2005-b5-field-natural
               exponent zero one add))
             (k-minus-one
              (putnam-2005-b5-field-natural
               (- exponent 1) zero one add))
             (factor
              (apply$ mul (list k k-minus-one)))
             (coefficient
              (apply$ mul (list (car term) factor))))
        (list
         coefficient
         (putnam-2005-b5-lower-exponent-by-two
          exponents index))))))

(defun putnam-2005-b5-second-derivative
    (polynomial index zero one add mul)
  (if (consp polynomial)
      (let ((term
             (putnam-2005-b5-second-derivative-term
              (car polynomial) index zero one add mul)))
        (if (consp term)
            (putnam-2005-b5-insert-term
             term
             (putnam-2005-b5-second-derivative
              (cdr polynomial) index zero one add mul)
             add zero)
          (putnam-2005-b5-second-derivative
           (cdr polynomial) index zero one add mul)))
    nil))

(defun putnam-2005-b5-laplacian-aux
    (remaining index polynomial zero one add mul)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix remaining)))
  (if (zp remaining)
      nil
    (putnam-2005-b5-poly-add
     (putnam-2005-b5-second-derivative
      polynomial index zero one add mul)
     (putnam-2005-b5-laplacian-aux
      (- remaining 1) (+ 1 (nfix index))
      polynomial zero one add mul)
     add zero)))

(defun putnam-2005-b5-laplacian
    (n polynomial zero one add mul)
  (putnam-2005-b5-laplacian-aux
   n 0 polynomial zero one add mul))

(defun putnam-2005-b5-divides-fuel
    (dividend divisor add mul neg inv zero fuel)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix fuel)))
  (cond
   ((endp dividend) t)
   ((or (zp fuel) (endp divisor)) nil)
   ((not
     (putnam-2005-b5-exponents-divide-p
      (cadar divisor) (cadar dividend)))
    nil)
   (t
    (let* ((quotient-coefficient
            (apply$
             mul
             (list
              (caar dividend)
              (apply$ inv (list (caar divisor))))))
           (quotient-exponents
            (putnam-2005-b5-exponents-subtract
             (cadar dividend) (cadar divisor)))
           (multiple
            (putnam-2005-b5-monomial-times-poly
             (list quotient-coefficient quotient-exponents)
             divisor mul add zero))
           (reduced
            (putnam-2005-b5-poly-sub
             dividend multiple add neg zero)))
      (putnam-2005-b5-divides-fuel
       reduced divisor add mul neg inv zero
       (- fuel 1))))))

(defun putnam-2005-b5-divides-p
    (divisor dividend n add mul neg inv zero)
  (let* ((degree
          (putnam-2005-b5-max-total-degree dividend))
         (fuel
          (expt (+ 1 degree) (nfix n))))
    (putnam-2005-b5-divides-fuel
     dividend divisor add mul neg inv zero fuel)))

(defun putnambench-putnam-2005-b5-statement
    (carrier zero one add mul neg inv lt square-root
             evaluate odd-root n polynomial)
  (implies
   (and
    (putnam-2005-b5-real-closed-field-p
     carrier zero one add mul neg inv lt square-root
     evaluate odd-root)
    (natp n)
    (< 0 n)
    (putnam-2005-b5-polynomial-p
     polynomial n carrier zero)
    (equal
     (putnam-2005-b5-laplacian
      n polynomial zero one add mul)
     nil)
    (putnam-2005-b5-divides-p
     (putnam-2005-b5-sum-squares
      n one add zero)
     polynomial n add mul neg inv zero))
   (equal polynomial nil)))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

title: putnam_2005_b5
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2005_b5
-- (putnambench__agda__putnam_2005_b5): a harmonic real multivariate
-- polynomial divisible by the sum of the squares of its variables is
-- identically zero. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module Putnam2005B5 where

open import Agda.Builtin.Bool using (Bool; true; false)
open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.List using (List; []; _∷_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; _*_)

infix 4 _!=_
infixr 3 _and_
infixr 2 _or_

data Bottom : Set where

Not : Set -> Set
Not A =
  A -> Bottom

_!=_ : {A : Set} -> A -> A -> Set
x != y =
  Not (x == y)

record _and_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data _or_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  left  : A -> A or B
  right : B -> A or B

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

data Fin : Nat -> Set where
  fzero : {n : Nat} -> Fin (suc n)
  fsuc  : {n : Nat} -> Fin n -> Fin (suc n)

data PositiveNat : Nat -> Set where
  positive : {n : Nat} -> PositiveNat (suc n)

record CompleteOrderedRealField (R : Set) : Set1 where
  field
    zeroR oneR : R
    add multiply : R -> R -> R
    negate inverse : R -> R
    lessOrEqual : R -> R -> Set
    fromNat : Nat -> R

    one-not-zero :
      oneR != zeroR

    add-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> add x y == add y x
    add-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      add (add x y) z == add x (add y z)
    add-zero :
      (x : R) -> add x zeroR == x
    add-inverse :
      (x : R) -> add x (negate x) == zeroR

    multiply-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> multiply x y == multiply y x
    multiply-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply (multiply x y) z ==
      multiply x (multiply y z)
    multiply-one :
      (x : R) -> multiply x oneR == x
    multiply-zero :
      (x : R) -> multiply x zeroR == zeroR
    distribute :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply x (add y z) ==
      add (multiply x y) (multiply x z)
    inverse-zero :
      inverse zeroR == zeroR
    multiply-inverse :
      (x : R) ->
      x != zeroR ->
      multiply x (inverse x) == oneR

    order-reflexive :
      (x : R) -> lessOrEqual x x
    order-transitive :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y z ->
      lessOrEqual x z
    order-antisymmetric :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y x ->
      x == y
    order-total :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y or lessOrEqual y x
    add-order :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual (add z x) (add z y)
    multiply-nonnegative :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR x ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR y ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR (multiply x y)
    zero-less-than-one :
      lessOrEqual zeroR oneR and zeroR != oneR

    fromNat-zero :
      fromNat zero == zeroR
    fromNat-successor :
      (n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (suc n) == add (fromNat n) oneR
    fromNat-addition :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m + n) == add (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-multiplication :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m * n) == multiply (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-injective :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat m == fromNat n ->
      m == n

    archimedean :
      (x : R) ->
      Exists Nat
        (\ n ->
          lessOrEqual x (fromNat n))
    least-upper-bound :
      (P : R -> Set) ->
      Exists R P ->
      Exists R
        (\ upper ->
          (x : R) ->
          P x ->
          lessOrEqual x upper) ->
      Exists R
        (\ supremum ->
          ((x : R) ->
            P x ->
            lessOrEqual x supremum)
          and
          ((upper : R) ->
            ((x : R) ->
              P x ->
              lessOrEqual x upper) ->
            lessOrEqual supremum upper))

open CompleteOrderedRealField

sameFin :
  {n : Nat} ->
  Fin n ->
  Fin n ->
  Bool
sameFin fzero fzero =
  true
sameFin fzero (fsuc j) =
  false
sameFin (fsuc i) fzero =
  false
sameFin (fsuc i) (fsuc j) =
  sameFin i j

choose :
  {A : Set} ->
  Bool ->
  A ->
  A ->
  A
choose true whenTrue whenFalse =
  whenTrue
choose false whenTrue whenFalse =
  whenFalse

predecessor : Nat -> Nat
predecessor zero =
  zero
predecessor (suc n) =
  n

power :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  Nat ->
  R
power reals x zero =
  oneR reals
power reals x (suc exponent) =
  multiply reals x (power reals x exponent)

sumFin :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  {n : Nat} ->
  (Fin n -> R) ->
  R
sumFin reals {zero} terms =
  zeroR reals
sumFin reals {suc n} terms =
  add reals
    (terms fzero)
    (sumFin reals (\ i -> terms (fsuc i)))

productFin :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  {n : Nat} ->
  (Fin n -> R) ->
  R
productFin reals {zero} terms =
  oneR reals
productFin reals {suc n} terms =
  multiply reals
    (terms fzero)
    (productFin reals (\ i -> terms (fsuc i)))

record Monomial (R : Set) (n : Nat) : Set where
  constructor monomial
  field
    coefficient : R
    exponents   : Fin n -> Nat

open Monomial

Polynomial : Set -> Nat -> Set
Polynomial R n =
  List (Monomial R n)

evaluateMonomial :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  {n : Nat} ->
  Monomial R n ->
  (Fin n -> R) ->
  R
evaluateMonomial reals term point =
  multiply reals
    (coefficient term)
    (productFin reals
      (\ i ->
        power reals
          (point i)
          (exponents term i)))

evaluatePolynomial :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  {n : Nat} ->
  Polynomial R n ->
  (Fin n -> R) ->
  R
evaluatePolynomial reals [] point =
  zeroR reals
evaluatePolynomial reals (term ∷ terms) point =
  add reals
    (evaluateMonomial reals term point)
    (evaluatePolynomial reals terms point)

lowerExponent :
  {n : Nat} ->
  Fin n ->
  (Fin n -> Nat) ->
  Fin n ->
  Nat
lowerExponent selected powers index =
  choose
    (sameFin selected index)
    (predecessor (powers index))
    (powers index)

differentiateMonomial :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  {n : Nat} ->
  Fin n ->
  Monomial R n ->
  Monomial R n
differentiateMonomial reals selected term =
  monomial
    (multiply reals
      (coefficient term)
      (fromNat reals (exponents term selected)))
    (lowerExponent selected (exponents term))

partialDerivative :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  {n : Nat} ->
  Fin n ->
  Polynomial R n ->
  Polynomial R n
partialDerivative reals selected [] =
  []
partialDerivative reals selected (term ∷ terms) =
  differentiateMonomial reals selected term
  ∷ partialDerivative reals selected terms

PolynomialEqual :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  {n : Nat} ->
  Polynomial R n ->
  Polynomial R n ->
  Set
PolynomialEqual reals P Q =
  (point : _) ->
  evaluatePolynomial reals P point ==
  evaluatePolynomial reals Q point

Harmonic :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  {n : Nat} ->
  Polynomial R n ->
  Set
Harmonic reals P =
  (point : _) ->
  sumFin reals
    (\ i ->
      evaluatePolynomial reals
        (partialDerivative reals i
          (partialDerivative reals i P))
        point)
  ==
  zeroR reals

radiusSquared :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  {n : Nat} ->
  (Fin n -> R) ->
  R
radiusSquared reals point =
  sumFin reals
    (\ i ->
      multiply reals
        (point i)
        (point i))

RadiusSquaredDivides :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  {n : Nat} ->
  Polynomial R n ->
  Set
RadiusSquaredDivides {R} reals {n} P =
  Exists (Polynomial R n)
    (\ Q ->
      (point : Fin n -> R) ->
      multiply reals
        (radiusSquared reals point)
        (evaluatePolynomial reals Q point)
      ==
      evaluatePolynomial reals P point)

putnam-2005-b5 : Set1
putnam-2005-b5 =
  (R : Set) ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) ->
  (n : Nat) ->
  PositiveNat n ->
  (P : Polynomial R n) ->
  Harmonic reals P ->
  RadiusSquaredDivides reals P ->
  PolynomialEqual reals P []

title: putnam_2005_b5
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2005_b5:
  a real multivariate polynomial with zero Laplacian that is divisible by the
  sum of the squares of its variables is identically zero. This file contains
  no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open arithmeticTheory pairTheory pred_setTheory realTheory real_sigmaTheory;

val putnam_2005_b5 =
  ``let support =
      \P : (num -> num) -> real.
        {a : num -> num | P a <> 0}
    in
    let polynomial =
      \n : num.
      \P : (num -> num) -> real.
        FINITE (support P) /\
        !a : num -> num.
          a IN support P
          ==>
          !i : num. n <= i ==> a i = 0
    in
    let basis_square =
      \i : num.
      \j : num.
        if j = i then 2 else 0
    in
    let sum_squares =
      \n : num.
      \a : num -> num.
        REAL_SUM_IMAGE
          (\i : num. if a = basis_square i then 1 else 0)
          (count n)
    in
    let partial =
      \i : num.
      \P : (num -> num) -> real.
      \a : num -> num.
        &(SUC (a i)) *
        P (\j : num. if j = i then SUC (a i) else a j)
    in
    let poly_mul =
      \P Q : (num -> num) -> real.
      \a : num -> num.
        REAL_SUM_IMAGE
          (\PQ : (num -> num) # (num -> num).
             P (FST PQ) * Q (SND PQ))
          {PQ : (num -> num) # (num -> num) |
             PQ IN support P CROSS support Q /\
             !i : num. a i = (FST PQ) i + (SND PQ) i}
    in
      !n : num.
      !P : (num -> num) -> real.
        0 < n /\
        polynomial n P /\
        (!a : num -> num.
           REAL_SUM_IMAGE
             (\i : num. partial i (partial i P) a)
             (count n) =
           0) /\
        (?Q : (num -> num) -> real.
           polynomial n Q /\
           !a : num -> num.
             P a = poly_mul (sum_squares n) Q a)
        ==>
        P = (\a : num -> num. 0)``;

title: putnam_2005_b5
content:
$(
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact
  putnam_2005_b5: a harmonic multivariate real polynomial divisible by the
  sum of the squares of its coordinate variables is identically zero. This
  file contains no proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  For n in NN, the ordinal n is the n-element variable-index set. Thus
  ( n mPoly RRfld ) is set.mm's ring of arbitrary finite-support
  multivariate polynomials over the real field, ( n mVar RRfld ) gives its
  coordinate polynomials, and ( n mPSDer RRfld ) gives formal partial
  differentiation.

  Each gsum is taken in the polynomial ring. The first hypothesis is exactly
  the vanishing sum of the second partial derivatives. The internally
  existential polynomial Q in the second hypothesis states that the sum of
  the coordinate squares divides P. The conclusion identifies P with the
  additive zero of the same polynomial ring.

  The final declaration is the single unproved $a corpus statement; this
  database contains no $p proof statement.
$)

${
  $d P Q i n $.

  putnambench-putnam-2005-b5 $a |-
    A. n e. NN
      A. P e. ( Base ` ( n mPoly RRfld ) )
        (
          (
            (
              ( n mPoly RRfld )
              gsum
              (
                i e. n |->
                  (
                    ( ( n mPSDer RRfld ) ` i )
                    `
                    (
                      ( ( n mPSDer RRfld ) ` i )
                      `
                      P
                    )
                  )
              )
            )
            =
            ( 0g ` ( n mPoly RRfld ) )
            /\
            E. Q e. ( Base ` ( n mPoly RRfld ) )
              (
                (
                  (
                    ( n mPoly RRfld )
                    gsum
                    (
                      i e. n |->
                        (
                          ( ( n mVar RRfld ) ` i )
                          ( .r ` ( n mPoly RRfld ) )
                          ( ( n mVar RRfld ) ` i )
                        )
                    )
                  )
                  ( .r ` ( n mPoly RRfld ) )
                  Q
                )
                =
                P
              )
          )
          ->
          P = ( 0g ` ( n mPoly RRfld ) )
        )
  $.
$}

title: putnam_2005_b5
content:
:: Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2005_b5:
:: a positive-dimensional real multivariate polynomial with zero formal
:: Laplacian and divisible by the sum of the squares of its variables is zero.
:: This file contains no proof.

environ

 vocabularies NUMBERS, NAT_1, FINSEQ_1, RELAT_1, FUNCT_1, XBOOLE_0,
      SUBSET_1, TARSKI, CARD_1, XCMPLX_0, XREAL_0, XXREAL_0, ORDINAL1,
      ARYTM_1, ARYTM_3, STRUCT_0, ALGSTR_0, RLVECT_1, VECTSP_1,
      POLYNOM1, PRE_POLY, FINSET_1, CARD_3, SUPINF_2, MESFUNC1, VALUED_0,
      FVSUM_1;
 notations TARSKI, XBOOLE_0, SUBSET_1, ORDINAL1, NUMBERS, XCMPLX_0,
      XREAL_0, XXREAL_0, NAT_1, RELAT_1, FUNCT_1, FINSEQ_1, STRUCT_0,
      ALGSTR_0, RLVECT_1, VECTSP_1, VALUED_0, VALUED_1, PRE_POLY,
      POLYNOM1;
 constructors REAL_1, NAT_1, RELSET_1, FINSOP_1, RLVECT_1, FVSUM_1,
      VALUED_1, PRE_POLY, POLYNOM1;
 registrations XBOOLE_0, ORDINAL1, RELAT_1, FUNCT_1, NUMBERS, XREAL_0,
      NAT_1, FINSEQ_1, STRUCT_0, VECTSP_1, VALUED_0, VALUED_1,
      POLYNOM1, PRE_POLY;
 requirements NUMERALS, BOOLE, SUBSET, REAL, ARITHM;
 equalities STRUCT_0, ALGSTR_0;

begin

::$P-
theorem
  for n being non zero Element of NAT,
      P being Polynomial of n,F_Real st
    (for b being bag of n holds
      ex d being non empty FinSequence of the carrier of F_Real,
         s being FinSequence of the carrier of F_Real st
        len d = n &
        len s = n + 1 &
        s.1 = 0.F_Real &
        (for i being Nat st i in Seg n holds
          ex k,m being Nat, a,c being Element of F_Real,
             e,shifted being bag of n st
            k in n &
            i = k + 1 &
            m = b.k &
            a = m + 2 &
            c = m + 1 &
            (for j being Nat st j in n holds
              (j = k implies e.j = 2) &
              (j <> k implies e.j = 0)) &
            shifted = b + e &
            d.i = (P.shifted) * a * c) &
        (for i being Nat st i in Seg n holds
          ex u,v,w being Element of F_Real st
            u = s.i &
            v = d.i &
            w = s.(i + 1) &
            w = u + v) &
        s.(n + 1) = 0.F_Real) &
    (ex R,Q being Polynomial of n,F_Real st
      P = R *' Q &
      for b being bag of n holds
        ((ex i being Nat st
            i in n &
            b.i = 2 &
            for j being Nat st j in n & j <> i holds b.j = 0)
          implies R.b = 1.F_Real) &
        ((not ex i being Nat st
            i in n &
            b.i = 2 &
            for j being Nat st j in n & j <> i holds b.j = 0)
          implies R.b = 0.F_Real))
  holds
    P = 0_(n,F_Real)
proof
end;
::$P+

title: putnam_2005_b5
content:
% Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2005_b5:
% a harmonic real polynomial in a positive number of variables that is
% divisible by the sum of the variable squares is identically zero. This file
% contains no proof.

putnam_2005_b5[n: posnat]: THEORY
BEGIN
  coordinate: TYPE = below(n)
  exponent: TYPE = [coordinate -> nat]
  polynomial: TYPE = [exponent -> real]

  bounded_nat_sum(
      values: [coordinate -> nat],
      count: nat): RECURSIVE nat =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      bounded_nat_sum(values, count - 1)
        + IF count <= n THEN values(count - 1) ELSE 0 ENDIF
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  bounded_real_sum(
      values: [coordinate -> real],
      count: nat): RECURSIVE real =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      bounded_real_sum(values, count - 1)
        + IF count <= n THEN values(count - 1) ELSE 0 ENDIF
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  total_degree(e: exponent): nat =
    bounded_nat_sum(e, n)

  is_polynomial(P: polynomial): bool =
    EXISTS (degree_bound: nat):
      FORALL (e: exponent):
        total_degree(e) > degree_bound IMPLIES P(e) = 0

  increment_exponent(
      e: exponent,
      i: coordinate,
      amount: nat): exponent =
    LAMBDA (j: coordinate):
      IF j = i THEN e(j) + amount ELSE e(j) ENDIF

  decrement_exponent(
      e: exponent,
      i: coordinate,
      amount: nat): exponent =
    LAMBDA (j: coordinate):
      IF j = i THEN
        IF amount <= e(j) THEN e(j) - amount ELSE 0 ENDIF
      ELSE
        e(j)
      ENDIF

  second_partial_coefficient(
      P: polynomial,
      i: coordinate,
      e: exponent): real =
    (((e(i) + 2) * (e(i) + 1)) :: real)
      * P(increment_exponent(e, i, 2))

  laplacian_coefficient(
      P: polynomial,
      e: exponent): real =
    bounded_real_sum(
      LAMBDA (i: coordinate):
        second_partial_coefficient(P, i, e),
      n)

  sum_of_squares_product_coefficient(
      Q: polynomial,
      e: exponent): real =
    bounded_real_sum(
      LAMBDA (i: coordinate):
        IF e(i) >= 2 THEN
          Q(decrement_exponent(e, i, 2))
        ELSE
          0
        ENDIF,
      n)

  putnam_2005_b5: bool =
    FORALL (P: polynomial):
      (is_polynomial(P)
        AND (FORALL (e: exponent):
          laplacian_coefficient(P, e) = 0)
        AND (EXISTS (Q: polynomial):
          is_polynomial(Q)
            AND (FORALL (e: exponent):
              P(e) =
                sum_of_squares_product_coefficient(Q, e))))
      IMPLIES
        FORALL (e: exponent):
          P(e) = 0
END putnam_2005_b5

import Mathlib

open Nat Set

/--
Let $S_n$ denote the set of all permutations of the numbers $1,2,\dots,n$. For $\pi \in S_n$, let $\sigma(\pi)=1$ if $\pi$ is an even permutation and $\sigma(\pi)=-1$ if $\pi$ is an odd permutation. Also, let $\nu(\pi)$ denote the number of fixed points of $\pi$. Show that $\sum_{\pi \in S_n} \frac{\sigma(\pi)}{\nu(\pi)+1}=(-1)^{n+1}\frac{n}{n+1}$.
-/
theorem putnam_2005_b6
(n : ℕ)
(v : Equiv.Perm (Fin n) → ℕ)
(npos : n ≥ 1)
(hv : ∀ p : Equiv.Perm (Fin n), v p = Set.encard {i : Fin n | p i = i})
: (∑ p : Equiv.Perm (Fin n), (Equiv.Perm.signAux p : ℤ) / (v p + 1 : ℝ)) = (-1) ^ (n + 1) * (n / (n + 1 : ℝ)) :=
sorry

title: putnam_2005_b6
content:
(* Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench artifact putnam_2005_b6:
   the parity-signed sum of reciprocals of one plus the fixed-point count
   over all permutations of n elements; this file contains no proof. *)

From Stdlib Require Import Reals Lists.List Arith.PeanoNat.

Import ListNotations.
Open Scope R_scope.

Fixpoint putnam_2005_b6_insert_everywhere
    (x : nat) (p : list nat) : list (list nat) :=
  match p with
  | [] => [[x]]
  | y :: ys =>
      (x :: y :: ys) ::
      map (fun q => y :: q)
        (putnam_2005_b6_insert_everywhere x ys)
  end.

Fixpoint putnam_2005_b6_permutations
    (n : nat) : list (list nat) :=
  match n with
  | O => [[]]
  | S k =>
      flat_map (putnam_2005_b6_insert_everywhere k)
        (putnam_2005_b6_permutations k)
  end.

Fixpoint putnam_2005_b6_count_less
    (x : nat) (p : list nat) : nat :=
  match p with
  | [] => O
  | y :: ys =>
      (if Nat.ltb y x then 1 else 0) +
      putnam_2005_b6_count_less x ys
  end.

Fixpoint putnam_2005_b6_inversions
    (p : list nat) : nat :=
  match p with
  | [] => O
  | x :: xs =>
      putnam_2005_b6_count_less x xs +
      putnam_2005_b6_inversions xs
  end.

Fixpoint putnam_2005_b6_fixed_from
    (i : nat) (p : list nat) : nat :=
  match p with
  | [] => O
  | x :: xs =>
      (if Nat.eqb x i then 1 else 0) +
      putnam_2005_b6_fixed_from (S i) xs
  end.

Definition putnam_2005_b6_sign (p : list nat) : R :=
  if Nat.even (putnam_2005_b6_inversions p) then 1 else -1.

Definition putnam_2005_b6_term (p : list nat) : R :=
  putnam_2005_b6_sign p /
  INR (S (putnam_2005_b6_fixed_from 0 p)).

Definition putnam_2005_b6_sum (n : nat) : R :=
  fold_right Rplus 0
    (map putnam_2005_b6_term
      (putnam_2005_b6_permutations n)).

Theorem putnam_2005_b6 :
  forall n : nat,
    (0 < n)%nat ->
    putnam_2005_b6_sum n =
      (-1) ^ (n + 1) * INR n / INR (n + 1).
Admitted.

(*
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2005_b6:
  the signed sum over permutations of {1,...,n}, weighted by the reciprocal
  of one more than each permutation's number of fixed points. This file
  contains no proof.
*)

let statement =
  `!n:num.
     1 <= n
     ==>
     let permutation_sign =
       \p:num->num.
         if EVEN
              (CARD
                {ij:num#num |
                   FST ij IN (1..n) /\
                   SND ij IN (1..n) /\
                   FST ij < SND ij /\
                   p (SND ij) < p (FST ij)})
         then &1
         else -- &1 in
     sum
       {p:num->num |
          (!x:num. ~(x IN (1..n)) ==> p x = x) /\
          (!y:num. ?!x:num. p x = y)}
       (\p:num->num.
          permutation_sign p /
          (&(CARD {i:num | i IN (1..n) /\ p i = i}) + &1)) =
     ((-- &1) pow (n + 1) * &n) / (&n + &1)`;;

title: putnam_2005_b6
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2005_b6:
;; the signed sum over permutations of 1 through n, weighted by the reciprocal
;; of one plus the number of fixed points, equals (-1)^(n+1)*n/(n+1).
;; This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))

;; A permutation is its image list in the canonical domain order 1,...,n.
;; Insertion generates every such list exactly once. This is bijective with
;; permutations of Fin n and with permutations of the naturals supported on
;; {1,...,n}; the latter extend each list uniquely by fixing all other values.

(defun putnam-2005-b6-range-from (start count)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix count)))
  (if (zp count)
      nil
    (cons start
          (putnam-2005-b6-range-from
           (+ start 1)
           (- count 1)))))

(defun putnam-2005-b6-prefix-each (item lists)
  (if (consp lists)
      (cons
       (cons item (car lists))
       (putnam-2005-b6-prefix-each item (cdr lists)))
    nil))

(defun putnam-2005-b6-insert-everywhere (item list)
  (if (consp list)
      (cons
       (cons item list)
       (putnam-2005-b6-prefix-each
        (car list)
        (putnam-2005-b6-insert-everywhere
         item (cdr list))))
    (list (list item))))

(defun putnam-2005-b6-insert-into-each (item lists)
  (if (consp lists)
      (append
       (putnam-2005-b6-insert-everywhere
        item (car lists))
       (putnam-2005-b6-insert-into-each
        item (cdr lists)))
    nil))

(defun putnam-2005-b6-permutations (list)
  (if (consp list)
      (putnam-2005-b6-insert-into-each
       (car list)
       (putnam-2005-b6-permutations (cdr list)))
    (list nil)))

;; Inversion parity is the usual sign of the represented permutation.
(defun putnam-2005-b6-count-greater (item list)
  (if (consp list)
      (+ (if (> item (car list)) 1 0)
         (putnam-2005-b6-count-greater item (cdr list)))
    0))

(defun putnam-2005-b6-inversion-count (permutation)
  (if (consp permutation)
      (+ (putnam-2005-b6-count-greater
          (car permutation)
          (cdr permutation))
         (putnam-2005-b6-inversion-count
          (cdr permutation)))
    0))

(defun putnam-2005-b6-sign (permutation)
  (if (evenp
       (putnam-2005-b6-inversion-count permutation))
      1
    -1))

(defun putnam-2005-b6-fixed-point-count
    (permutation expected)
  (if (consp permutation)
      (+ (if (equal (car permutation) expected) 1 0)
         (putnam-2005-b6-fixed-point-count
          (cdr permutation)
          (+ expected 1)))
    0))

(defun putnam-2005-b6-signed-fixed-point-sum
    (permutations)
  (if (consp permutations)
      (let ((permutation (car permutations)))
        (+
         (/ (putnam-2005-b6-sign permutation)
            (+ (putnam-2005-b6-fixed-point-count
                permutation 1)
               1))
         (putnam-2005-b6-signed-fixed-point-sum
          (cdr permutations))))
    0))

(defun putnam-2005-b6-left-side (n)
  (putnam-2005-b6-signed-fixed-point-sum
   (putnam-2005-b6-permutations
    (putnam-2005-b6-range-from 1 n))))

(defun putnam-2005-b6-right-side (n)
  (* (if (evenp (+ n 1)) 1 -1)
     (/ n (+ n 1))))

(defun putnambench-putnam-2005-b6-statement (n)
  (implies
   (and (natp n)
        (< 0 n))
   (equal
    (putnam-2005-b6-left-side n)
    (putnam-2005-b6-right-side n))))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

title: putnam_2005_b6
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2005_b6
-- (putnambench__agda__putnam_2005_b6): the signed sum over permutations,
-- weighted by one plus the number of fixed points, has the stated rational
-- value. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module Putnam2005B6 where

open import Agda.Builtin.Bool using (Bool; false; true)
open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Int using (Int; negsuc; pos)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; _+_; _-_; _*_; suc; zero)

infix 4 _<=N_ _~Q_
infixr 5 _::_

data _<=N_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set where
  zero<=N   : {n : Nat} -> zero <=N n
  suc<=sucN : {m n : Nat} -> m <=N n -> suc m <=N suc n

data Fin : Nat -> Set where
  fzero : {n : Nat} -> Fin (suc n)
  fsuc  : {n : Nat} -> Fin n -> Fin (suc n)

data Vec (A : Set) : Nat -> Set where
  []   : Vec A zero
  _::_ : {n : Nat} -> A -> Vec A n -> Vec A (suc n)

one : Nat
one =
  suc zero

Positive : Nat -> Set
Positive n =
  one <=N n

toNat : {n : Nat} -> Fin n -> Nat
toNat fzero =
  zero
toNat (fsuc index) =
  suc (toNat index)

weakenFin : {n : Nat} -> Fin n -> Fin (suc n)
weakenFin fzero =
  fzero
weakenFin (fsuc index) =
  fsuc (weakenFin index)

lastFin : (n : Nat) -> Fin (suc n)
lastFin zero =
  fzero
lastFin (suc n) =
  fsuc (lastFin n)

mapVec :
  {A B : Set} ->
  {n : Nat} ->
  (A -> B) ->
  Vec A n ->
  Vec B n
mapVec f [] =
  []
mapVec f (x :: xs) =
  f x :: mapVec f xs

insertAt :
  {A : Set} ->
  {n : Nat} ->
  Fin (suc n) ->
  A ->
  Vec A n ->
  Vec A (suc n)
insertAt fzero x xs =
  x :: xs
insertAt (fsuc position) x (y :: ys) =
  y :: insertAt position x ys

data PermutationCode : Nat -> Set where
  empty  : PermutationCode zero
  insert :
    {n : Nat} ->
    Fin (suc n) ->
    PermutationCode n ->
    PermutationCode (suc n)

oneLine :
  {n : Nat} ->
  PermutationCode n ->
  Vec (Fin n) n
oneLine empty =
  []
oneLine (insert {n} position permutation) =
  insertAt
    position
    (lastFin n)
    (mapVec weakenFin (oneLine permutation))

sameFin :
  {n : Nat} ->
  Fin n ->
  Fin n ->
  Bool
sameFin fzero fzero =
  true
sameFin fzero (fsuc right) =
  false
sameFin (fsuc left) fzero =
  false
sameFin (fsuc left) (fsuc right) =
  sameFin left right

incrementIf : Bool -> Nat -> Nat
incrementIf true n =
  suc n
incrementIf false n =
  n

countMatching :
  {length total : Nat} ->
  (Fin length -> Fin total) ->
  Vec (Fin total) length ->
  Nat
countMatching {zero} position [] =
  zero
countMatching {suc length} position (x :: xs) =
  incrementIf
    (sameFin x (position fzero))
    (countMatching
      (\ index -> position (fsuc index))
      xs)

fixedPointCount :
  {n : Nat} ->
  PermutationCode n ->
  Nat
fixedPointCount permutation =
  countMatching
    (\ index -> index)
    (oneLine permutation)

evenNat : Nat -> Bool
evenNat zero =
  true
evenNat (suc zero) =
  false
evenNat (suc (suc n)) =
  evenNat n

data Sign : Set where
  positive : Sign
  negative : Sign

flipSign : Sign -> Sign
flipSign positive =
  negative
flipSign negative =
  positive

multiplySign : Sign -> Sign -> Sign
multiplySign positive sign =
  sign
multiplySign negative sign =
  flipSign sign

signFromParity : Nat -> Sign
signFromParity n with evenNat n
... | true =
  positive
... | false =
  negative

permutationSign :
  {n : Nat} ->
  PermutationCode n ->
  Sign
permutationSign empty =
  positive
permutationSign (insert {n} position permutation) =
  multiplySign
    (signFromParity (n - toNat position))
    (permutationSign permutation)

negativeInt : Nat -> Int
negativeInt zero =
  pos zero
negativeInt (suc n) =
  negsuc n

signedNat : Sign -> Nat -> Int
signedNat positive n =
  pos n
signedNat negative n =
  negativeInt n

difference : Nat -> Nat -> Int
difference zero zero =
  pos zero
difference (suc m) zero =
  pos (suc m)
difference zero (suc n) =
  negsuc n
difference (suc m) (suc n) =
  difference m n

addInt : Int -> Int -> Int
addInt (pos m) (pos n) =
  pos (m + n)
addInt (pos m) (negsuc n) =
  difference m (suc n)
addInt (negsuc m) (pos n) =
  difference n (suc m)
addInt (negsuc m) (negsuc n) =
  negsuc (suc (m + n))

multiplyInt : Int -> Int -> Int
multiplyInt (pos m) (pos n) =
  pos (m * n)
multiplyInt (pos m) (negsuc n) =
  negativeInt (m * suc n)
multiplyInt (negsuc m) (pos n) =
  negativeInt (suc m * n)
multiplyInt (negsuc m) (negsuc n) =
  pos (suc m * suc n)

scaleInt : Int -> Nat -> Int
scaleInt integer natural =
  multiplyInt integer (pos natural)

predecessor : Nat -> Nat
predecessor zero =
  zero
predecessor (suc n) =
  n

record Rational : Set where
  constructor fraction
  field
    numerator             : Int
    denominator-minus-one : Nat

open Rational

denominator : Rational -> Nat
denominator rational =
  suc (denominator-minus-one rational)

_~Q_ : Rational -> Rational -> Set
left ~Q right =
  scaleInt (numerator left) (denominator right)
  ==
  scaleInt (numerator right) (denominator left)

zeroQ : Rational
zeroQ =
  fraction (pos zero) zero

addQ : Rational -> Rational -> Rational
addQ left right =
  fraction
    (addInt
      (scaleInt (numerator left) (denominator right))
      (scaleInt (numerator right) (denominator left)))
    (predecessor (denominator left * denominator right))

sumFin :
  {n : Nat} ->
  (Fin n -> Rational) ->
  Rational
sumFin {zero} term =
  zeroQ
sumFin {suc n} term =
  addQ
    (term fzero)
    (sumFin (\ index -> term (fsuc index)))

sumPermutations :
  (n : Nat) ->
  (PermutationCode n -> Rational) ->
  Rational
sumPermutations zero term =
  term empty
sumPermutations (suc n) term =
  sumFin
    (\ position ->
      sumPermutations n
        (\ permutation ->
          term (insert position permutation)))

permutationTerm :
  {n : Nat} ->
  PermutationCode n ->
  Rational
permutationTerm permutation =
  fraction
    (signedNat (permutationSign permutation) one)
    (fixedPointCount permutation)

rightSide : Nat -> Rational
rightSide n =
  fraction
    (signedNat (signFromParity (suc n)) n)
    n

putnam-2005-b6 : Set
putnam-2005-b6 =
  (n : Nat) ->
  Positive n ->
  sumPermutations n permutationTerm
  ~Q
  rightSide n

(*
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2005_b6:
  the signed sum over permutations of n elements, weighted by one plus each
  permutation's number of fixed points. This file contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open arithmeticTheory pred_setTheory permutesTheory realTheory real_sigmaTheory;

val putnam_2005_b6 =
  ``!n : num.
      0 < n
      ==>
      SIGMA
        (\p : num -> num.
           (if evenperm p then (1 : real) else ~(1 : real)) /
           (&(CARD {i : num | i < n /\ p i = i}) + 1))
        {p : num -> num | p permutes count n} =
      (-1 : real) pow (n + 1) * (&n : real) / &(n + 1)``;

content:
$(
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact
  putnam_2005_b6: a signed reciprocal fixed-point sum over all permutations
  of a positive finite set. This file contains no proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  For n in NN, the interval 1 ... n is an n-element carrier and the base of
  its symmetric group is exactly the set of all permutations of that carrier.
  SetMM's pmSgn is 1 on even permutations and -1 on odd permutations. The
  restricted class in the denominator is precisely the set of fixed points.
  Thus this is the source finite sum, with its rational values embedded in
  SetMM's number system.

  The final declaration is the single unproved $a corpus statement; this
  database contains no $p proof statement.
$)

${
  $d i n p $.

  putnambench-putnam-2005-b6 $a |- A. n e. NN
    (
      sum_ p e. ( Base ` ( SymGrp ` ( 1 ... n ) ) )
        (
          (
            ( pmSgn ` ( 1 ... n ) )
            `
            p
          )
          /
          (
            (
              #
              `
              {
                i e. ( 1 ... n )
                |
                ( p ` i ) = i
              }
            )
            +
            1
          )
        )
      =
      (
        ( -u 1 ^ ( n + 1 ) )
        x.
        ( n / ( n + 1 ) )
      )
    )
  $.
$}

title: putnam_2005_b6
content:
:: Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2005_b6:
:: the signed sum over all permutations of n elements, with each sign divided
:: by one plus the number of fixed points, has the stated value for every
:: positive n. This file contains no proof.

environ
  vocabularies TARSKI, XBOOLE_0, ZFMISC_1, SUBSET_1, RELAT_1, FUNCT_1,
    FUNCT_2, PARTFUN1, FINSEQ_1, FINSEQ_2, MATRIX_0, MATRIX_1, NUMBERS,
    NAT_1, INT_1, CARD_1, XCMPLX_0, XREAL_0, XXREAL_0, ORDINAL1,
    FINSET_1, NEWTON, ARYTM_1, ARYTM_3, CARD_3, VALUED_0, VALUED_1,
    RVSUM_1, ABIAN, REAL_1;
  notations TARSKI, XBOOLE_0, ZFMISC_1, SUBSET_1, ORDINAL1, CARD_1,
    NUMBERS, XCMPLX_0, XREAL_0, XXREAL_0, INT_1, NAT_1, NAT_D, RELAT_1,
    FUNCT_1, RELSET_1, PARTFUN1, FUNCT_2, FINSEQ_1, FINSEQ_2, MATRIX_0,
    MATRIX_1, FINSET_1, NEWTON, RVSUM_1, REAL_1;
  constructors RELSET_1, PARTFUN1, FINSEQ_4, MATRIX_1, NAT_1, NAT_D,
    NEWTON, RVSUM_1, FINSEQOP, FINSET_1, REAL_1;
  registrations XBOOLE_0, SUBSET_1, RELAT_1, FUNCT_1, RELSET_1, FUNCT_2,
    PARTFUN1, FINSEQ_1, FINSEQ_2, MATRIX_0, MATRIX_1, FINSET_1, ORDINAL1,
    CARD_1, NUMBERS, XCMPLX_0, XREAL_0, XXREAL_0, NAT_1, INT_1, NEWTON,
    VALUED_0, VALUED_1, RVSUM_1, MEMBERED, FRAENKEL;
  requirements BOOLE, SUBSET, NUMERALS, ARITHM, REAL;
  definitions TARSKI;
  equalities FINSEQ_1, MATRIX_0;
  expansions TARSKI, FINSEQ_1;

begin

::$P-
theorem
  for n being Nat st 0 < n holds
    ex perms being one-to-one FinSequence of NAT*,
       terms being FinSequence of REAL st
      rng perms = Permutations(n) &
      len terms = len perms &
      (for k being Nat st k in dom perms holds
        ex p being Permutation of Seg n, v being Nat st
          p = perms.k &
          v = card {i where i is Nat : i in Seg n & p.i = i} &
          (p is even implies
            terms.k =
              (1 qua Real) /
              ((v qua Real) + 1)) &
          (not p is even implies
            terms.k =
              (-1 qua Real) /
              ((v qua Real) + 1))) &
      Sum terms =
        (((-1 qua Real) |^ (n + 1)) *
          ((n qua Real) / ((n + 1) qua Real)))
proof
end;
::$P+

% Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2005_b6:
% the signed sum over permutations of n elements, weighted by one plus the
% number of fixed points, equals (-1)^(n+1) times n/(n+1). This file contains
% no proof.

putnam_2005_b6: THEORY
BEGIN
  quotient_aux(
      numerator, denominator, fuel: nat): RECURSIVE nat =
    IF fuel = 0
        OR denominator = 0
        OR numerator < denominator THEN
      0
    ELSE
      1
        + quotient_aux(
            numerator - denominator,
            denominator,
            fuel - 1)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE fuel

  remainder_aux(
      numerator, denominator, fuel: nat): RECURSIVE nat =
    IF fuel = 0
        OR denominator = 0
        OR numerator < denominator THEN
      numerator
    ELSE
      remainder_aux(
        numerator - denominator,
        denominator,
        fuel - 1)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE fuel

  safe_ndiv(numerator, denominator: nat): nat =
    quotient_aux(
      numerator,
      denominator,
      numerator + 1)

  safe_mod(numerator, denominator: nat): nat =
    IF denominator = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      remainder_aux(
        numerator,
        denominator,
        numerator + 1)
    ENDIF

  function_code_count(n: nat): nat =
    IF n = 0 THEN 1 ELSE n ^ n ENDIF

  permutation_entry(code, index, n: nat): nat =
    IF n = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      safe_mod(safe_ndiv(code, n ^ index), n)
    ENDIF

  permutation_code(code, n: nat): bool =
    code < function_code_count(n)
      AND (FORALL (i, j: nat):
        (i < n
          AND j < n
          AND permutation_entry(code, i, n)
            = permutation_entry(code, j, n))
        IMPLIES i = j)

  pair_row(pair, n: nat): nat =
    safe_ndiv(pair, n)

  pair_column(pair, n: nat): nat =
    safe_mod(pair, n)

  inversion_at(code, pair, n: nat): bool =
    pair_row(pair, n) < n
      AND pair_column(pair, n) < n
      AND pair_row(pair, n) < pair_column(pair, n)
      AND permutation_entry(code, pair_row(pair, n), n)
        > permutation_entry(code, pair_column(pair, n), n)

  count_true(
      property: [nat -> bool],
      count: nat): RECURSIVE nat =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      count_true(property, count - 1)
        + IF property(count - 1) THEN 1 ELSE 0 ENDIF
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  inversion_count(code, n: nat): nat =
    count_true(
      (LAMBDA (pair: nat): inversion_at(code, pair, n)),
      n * n)

  fixed_point_count(code, n: nat): nat =
    count_true(
      (LAMBDA (index: nat):
        index < n
          AND permutation_entry(code, index, n) = index),
      n)

  permutation_sign(code, n: nat): real =
    IF mod(inversion_count(code, n), 2) = 0 THEN
      1
    ELSE
      -1
    ENDIF

  signed_fixed_point_sum(
      n, limit: nat): RECURSIVE real =
    IF limit = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      LET code: nat = limit - 1 IN
        signed_fixed_point_sum(n, limit - 1)
          + IF permutation_code(code, n) THEN
              permutation_sign(code, n)
                / ((fixed_point_count(code, n) + 1) :: real)
            ELSE
              0
            ENDIF
    ENDIF
  MEASURE limit

  alternating_sign(exponent: nat): RECURSIVE real =
    IF exponent = 0 THEN
      1
    ELSE
      -alternating_sign(exponent - 1)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE exponent

  putnam_2005_b6: bool =
    FORALL (n: nat):
      n > 0 IMPLIES
        signed_fixed_point_sum(n, function_code_count(n))
          = alternating_sign(n + 1)
              * (n :: real) / ((n + 1) :: real)
END putnam_2005_b6

title: putnam_2006_a1
content:
(* Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2006_a1:
   the three-dimensional Lebesgue volume of the real region satisfying
   (x^2 + y^2 + z^2 + 8)^2 <= 36(x^2 + y^2) is 6*pi^2.
   This file contains no proof. *)

From Stdlib Require Import Reals.

Open Scope R_scope.

Definition putnam_2006_a1_point : Type := (R * (R * R))%type.
Definition putnam_2006_a1_point_set : Type :=
  putnam_2006_a1_point -> Prop.

Definition putnam_2006_a1_x (p : putnam_2006_a1_point) : R :=
  fst p.

Definition putnam_2006_a1_y (p : putnam_2006_a1_point) : R :=
  fst (snd p).

Definition putnam_2006_a1_z (p : putnam_2006_a1_point) : R :=
  snd (snd p).

Definition putnam_2006_a1_region : putnam_2006_a1_point_set :=
  fun p : putnam_2006_a1_point =>
    (putnam_2006_a1_x p ^ 2 +
     putnam_2006_a1_y p ^ 2 +
     putnam_2006_a1_z p ^ 2 + 8) ^ 2 <=
    36 *
    (putnam_2006_a1_x p ^ 2 +
     putnam_2006_a1_y p ^ 2).

Record putnam_2006_a1_open_box : Type := {
  putnam_2006_a1_x_lower : R;
  putnam_2006_a1_x_upper : R;
  putnam_2006_a1_y_lower : R;
  putnam_2006_a1_y_upper : R;
  putnam_2006_a1_z_lower : R;
  putnam_2006_a1_z_upper : R
}.

Definition putnam_2006_a1_in_open_box
    (box : putnam_2006_a1_open_box)
    (p : putnam_2006_a1_point) : Prop :=
  putnam_2006_a1_x_lower box < putnam_2006_a1_x p <
    putnam_2006_a1_x_upper box /\
  putnam_2006_a1_y_lower box < putnam_2006_a1_y p <
    putnam_2006_a1_y_upper box /\
  putnam_2006_a1_z_lower box < putnam_2006_a1_z p <
    putnam_2006_a1_z_upper box.

Definition putnam_2006_a1_box_volume
    (box : putnam_2006_a1_open_box) : R :=
  Rmax 0
    (putnam_2006_a1_x_upper box -
     putnam_2006_a1_x_lower box) *
  Rmax 0
    (putnam_2006_a1_y_upper box -
     putnam_2006_a1_y_lower box) *
  Rmax 0
    (putnam_2006_a1_z_upper box -
     putnam_2006_a1_z_lower box).

Definition putnam_2006_a1_boxes_cover
    (A : putnam_2006_a1_point_set)
    (boxes : nat -> putnam_2006_a1_open_box) : Prop :=
  forall p : putnam_2006_a1_point,
    A p ->
    exists n : nat, putnam_2006_a1_in_open_box (boxes n) p.

Fixpoint putnam_2006_a1_partial_box_volume
    (boxes : nat -> putnam_2006_a1_open_box)
    (n : nat) : R :=
  match n with
  | O => 0
  | S k =>
      putnam_2006_a1_partial_box_volume boxes k +
      putnam_2006_a1_box_volume (boxes k)
  end.

(* Equality with finite three-dimensional Lebesgue outer measure, expressed
   through countable open-box covers. On the closed region above, this is its
   three-dimensional Lebesgue measure. *)
Definition putnam_2006_a1_has_spatial_lebesgue_measure
    (A : putnam_2006_a1_point_set) (volume : R) : Prop :=
  0 <= volume /\
  (forall boxes : nat -> putnam_2006_a1_open_box,
    putnam_2006_a1_boxes_cover A boxes ->
    forall lower : R,
      lower < volume ->
      exists n : nat,
        lower < putnam_2006_a1_partial_box_volume boxes n) /\
  (forall epsilon : R,
    0 < epsilon ->
    exists boxes : nat -> putnam_2006_a1_open_box,
      putnam_2006_a1_boxes_cover A boxes /\
      forall n : nat,
        putnam_2006_a1_partial_box_volume boxes n <
        volume + epsilon).

Definition putnam_2006_a1_solution : R := 6 * PI ^ 2.

Theorem putnam_2006_a1 :
  putnam_2006_a1_has_spatial_lebesgue_measure
    putnam_2006_a1_region
    putnam_2006_a1_solution.
Admitted.
