title: putnam_2006_a1
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2006_a1:
  the Lebesgue volume of the region in real three-space defined by
  (x^2 + y^2 + z^2 + 8)^2 <= 36(x^2 + y^2) is 6 pi^2.
  This file contains no proof.
*)

needs "Library/transc.ml";;

let statement =
  `let cover_bound =
     \(s:(real#(real#real))->bool) (B:real).
       &0 <= B /\
       ?xl xu yl yu zl zu:num->real.
         (!k:num.
            xl k <= xu k /\ yl k <= yu k /\ zl k <= zu k) /\
         (!p:real#(real#real).
            p IN s
            ==> ?k:num.
                  xl k < FST p /\ FST p < xu k /\
                  yl k < FST (SND p) /\ FST (SND p) < yu k /\
                  zl k < SND (SND p) /\ SND (SND p) < zu k) /\
         (!N:num.
            sum (0..N)
              (\k:num.
                 (xu k - xl k) *
                 (yu k - yl k) *
                 (zu k - zl k)) <= B) in
   let lebesgue_outer_measure =
     \(s:(real#(real#real))->bool).
       inf {B:real | cover_bound s B} in
   lebesgue_outer_measure
     {p:real#(real#real) |
        (FST p pow 2 +
         FST (SND p) pow 2 +
         SND (SND p) pow 2 +
         &8) pow 2
        <= &36 * (FST p pow 2 + FST (SND p) pow 2)} =
   &6 * pi pow 2`;;

title: putnam_2006_a1
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2006_a1:
;; the three-dimensional Lebesgue volume of the real region
;; (x^2+y^2+z^2+8)^2 <= 36(x^2+y^2) is 6*pi^2. This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

;; Standard ACL2 has exact rational arithmetic but no primitive completed
;; real field or Lebesgue measure. The midpoint voxel sums below form an exact
;; rational Cauchy name for the source region's volume. The region is contained
;; in [-4,4] x [-4,4] x [-1,1], and every membership test uses the original
;; polynomial inequality, so this is not a restriction to rational points or
;; a finite sampling of the region.
;;
;; The boundary is the torus with major radius 3 and minor radius 1. A voxel
;; misclassified by its midpoint lies in a shrinking tubular neighborhood of
;; that boundary, so these midpoint sums converge to its Lebesgue volume.

(defun putnam-2006-a1-in-region-p (x y z)
  (let* ((radial-square (+ (* x x) (* y y)))
         (left-base (+ radial-square (* z z) 8)))
    (<= (* left-base left-base)
        (* 36 radial-square))))

;; Midpoints for the 8*N equal subintervals of [-4,4].
(defun putnam-2006-a1-xy-coordinate (index subdivisions)
  (if (posp subdivisions)
      (/ (- (+ (* 2 index) 1)
            (* 8 subdivisions))
         (* 2 subdivisions))
    0))

;; Midpoints for the 2*N equal subintervals of [-1,1].
(defun putnam-2006-a1-z-coordinate (index subdivisions)
  (if (posp subdivisions)
      (/ (- (+ (* 2 index) 1)
            (* 2 subdivisions))
         (* 2 subdivisions))
    0))

(defun putnam-2006-a1-x-count
    (remaining y z subdivisions)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix remaining)))
  (if (zp remaining)
      0
    (let* ((index (- (nfix remaining) 1))
           (x (putnam-2006-a1-xy-coordinate
               index subdivisions)))
      (+ (if (putnam-2006-a1-in-region-p x y z)
             1
           0)
         (putnam-2006-a1-x-count
          index y z subdivisions)))))

(defun putnam-2006-a1-y-count
    (remaining side-count z subdivisions)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix remaining)))
  (if (zp remaining)
      0
    (let* ((index (- (nfix remaining) 1))
           (y (putnam-2006-a1-xy-coordinate
               index subdivisions)))
      (+ (putnam-2006-a1-x-count
          side-count y z subdivisions)
         (putnam-2006-a1-y-count
          index side-count z subdivisions)))))

(defun putnam-2006-a1-z-count
    (remaining side-count subdivisions)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix remaining)))
  (if (zp remaining)
      0
    (let* ((index (- (nfix remaining) 1))
           (z (putnam-2006-a1-z-coordinate
               index subdivisions)))
      (+ (putnam-2006-a1-y-count
          side-count side-count z subdivisions)
         (putnam-2006-a1-z-count
          index side-count subdivisions)))))

;; Each voxel has side length 1/N and volume 1/N^3.
(defun putnam-2006-a1-volume-approx (subdivisions)
  (if (posp subdivisions)
      (let ((side-count (* 8 subdivisions))
            (height-count (* 2 subdivisions)))
        (/ (putnam-2006-a1-z-count
            height-count side-count subdivisions)
           (* subdivisions subdivisions subdivisions)))
    0))

;; Rational Leibniz prefixes converge to pi.
(defun putnam-2006-a1-leibniz-prefix (terms)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix terms)))
  (if (zp terms)
      0
    (let* ((index (- (nfix terms) 1))
           (sign (if (equal (mod index 2) 0) 1 -1)))
      (+ (putnam-2006-a1-leibniz-prefix index)
         (/ sign (+ (* 2 index) 1))))))

(defun putnam-2006-a1-pi-prefix (terms)
  (* 4 (putnam-2006-a1-leibniz-prefix terms)))

(defun putnam-2006-a1-solution-approx (terms)
  (let ((pi-approx (putnam-2006-a1-pi-prefix terms)))
    (* 6 pi-approx pi-approx)))

;; Positive rational tolerances are cofinal among positive real tolerances.
;; The source states an equality of limits and supplies no rate, so both
;; approximation cutoffs are existential and every later pair of
;; approximations must remain within the requested tolerance.

(defun-sk putnam-2006-a1-approximation-tail-p
    (epsilon subdivision-cutoff pi-cutoff)
  (forall (subdivisions pi-terms)
    (implies
     (and
      (natp subdivisions)
      (<= subdivision-cutoff subdivisions)
      (natp pi-terms)
      (<= pi-cutoff pi-terms))
     (< (abs
         (- (putnam-2006-a1-volume-approx subdivisions)
            (putnam-2006-a1-solution-approx pi-terms)))
        epsilon))))

(defun-sk putnam-2006-a1-cutoffs-exist-p (epsilon)
  (exists (subdivision-cutoff pi-cutoff)
    (and
     (posp subdivision-cutoff)
     (posp pi-cutoff)
     (putnam-2006-a1-approximation-tail-p
      epsilon subdivision-cutoff pi-cutoff))))

(defun-sk putnambench-putnam-2006-a1-statement ()
  (forall (epsilon)
    (implies
     (and
      (rationalp epsilon)
      (< 0 epsilon))
     (putnam-2006-a1-cutoffs-exist-p epsilon))))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

title: putnam_2006_a1
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2006_a1
-- (putnambench__agda__putnam_2006_a1): the Lebesgue volume of the real
-- polynomial region (x^2+y^2+z^2+8)^2 <= 36(x^2+y^2) is 6*pi^2.
-- This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module Putnam2006A1 where

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; _*_)

infix 4 _!=_ _<=N_
infixr 3 _and_
infixr 2 _or_

data Bottom : Set where

Not : Set -> Set
Not A =
  A -> Bottom

_!=_ : {A : Set} -> A -> A -> Set
x != y =
  Not (x == y)

record _and_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data _or_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  left  : A -> A or B
  right : B -> A or B

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

data _<=N_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set where
  zero<=   : {n : Nat} -> zero <=N n
  suc<=suc : {m n : Nat} -> m <=N n -> suc m <=N suc n

Predicate : Set -> Set1
Predicate A =
  A -> Set

record CompleteOrderedRealField (R : Set) : Set1 where
  field
    zeroR oneR : R
    add multiply : R -> R -> R
    negate inverse : R -> R
    lessOrEqual : R -> R -> Set
    fromNat : Nat -> R

    one-not-zero :
      oneR != zeroR

    add-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> add x y == add y x
    add-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      add (add x y) z == add x (add y z)
    add-zero :
      (x : R) -> add x zeroR == x
    add-inverse :
      (x : R) -> add x (negate x) == zeroR

    multiply-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> multiply x y == multiply y x
    multiply-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply (multiply x y) z ==
      multiply x (multiply y z)
    multiply-one :
      (x : R) -> multiply x oneR == x
    multiply-zero :
      (x : R) -> multiply x zeroR == zeroR
    distribute :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply x (add y z) ==
      add (multiply x y) (multiply x z)
    inverse-zero :
      inverse zeroR == zeroR
    multiply-inverse :
      (x : R) ->
      x != zeroR ->
      multiply x (inverse x) == oneR

    order-reflexive :
      (x : R) -> lessOrEqual x x
    order-transitive :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y z ->
      lessOrEqual x z
    order-antisymmetric :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y x ->
      x == y
    order-total :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y or lessOrEqual y x
    add-order :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual (add z x) (add z y)
    multiply-nonnegative :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR x ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR y ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR (multiply x y)
    zero-less-than-one :
      lessOrEqual zeroR oneR and zeroR != oneR

    fromNat-zero :
      fromNat zero == zeroR
    fromNat-successor :
      (n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (suc n) == add (fromNat n) oneR
    fromNat-addition :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m + n) == add (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-multiplication :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m * n) == multiply (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-injective :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat m == fromNat n ->
      m == n

    archimedean :
      (x : R) ->
      Exists Nat
        (\ n ->
          lessOrEqual x (fromNat n))
    least-upper-bound :
      (P : R -> Set) ->
      Exists R P ->
      Exists R
        (\ upper ->
          (x : R) ->
          P x ->
          lessOrEqual x upper) ->
      Exists R
        (\ supremum ->
          ((x : R) ->
            P x ->
            lessOrEqual x supremum)
          and
          ((upper : R) ->
            ((x : R) ->
              P x ->
              lessOrEqual x upper) ->
            lessOrEqual supremum upper))

open CompleteOrderedRealField

oneN : Nat
oneN =
  suc zero

twoN : Nat
twoN =
  suc oneN

fourN : Nat
fourN =
  twoN * twoN

sixN : Nat
sixN =
  suc (suc fourN)

eightN : Nat
eightN =
  twoN * fourN

thirtySixN : Nat
thirtySixN =
  sixN * sixN

subtract :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
subtract reals x y =
  add reals x (negate reals y)

divide :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
divide reals x y =
  multiply reals x (inverse reals y)

square :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R
square reals x =
  multiply reals x x

StrictLess :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
StrictLess reals x y =
  lessOrEqual reals x y and x != y

CloseTo :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
CloseTo reals center radius x =
  StrictLess reals
    (subtract reals center radius)
    x
  and
  StrictLess reals
    x
    (add reals center radius)

sumFirst :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Nat ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  R
sumFirst reals zero terms =
  zeroR reals
sumFirst reals (suc n) terms =
  add reals
    (sumFirst reals n terms)
    (terms n)

ConvergesTo :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  R ->
  Set
ConvergesTo reals sequence limit =
  (epsilon : _) ->
  StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) epsilon ->
  Exists Nat
    (\ cutoff ->
      (n : Nat) ->
      cutoff <=N n ->
      CloseTo reals limit epsilon (sequence n))

SeriesHasSum :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  R ->
  Set
SeriesHasSum reals terms total =
  ConvergesTo reals
    (\ n -> sumFirst reals n terms)
    total

alternatingSign :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Nat ->
  R
alternatingSign reals zero =
  oneR reals
alternatingSign reals (suc n) =
  negate reals (alternatingSign reals n)

piTerm :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Nat ->
  R
piTerm reals n =
  multiply reals
    (fromNat reals fourN)
    (divide reals
      (alternatingSign reals n)
      (fromNat reals (twoN * n + oneN)))

PiValue :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  Set
PiValue reals pi =
  SeriesHasSum reals (piTerm reals) pi

record Point3 (R : Set) : Set where
  constructor point3
  field
    xCoordinate : R
    yCoordinate : R
    zCoordinate : R

open Point3

record Box3
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) : Set where
  constructor box3
  field
    lowerX upperX : R
    lowerY upperY : R
    lowerZ upperZ : R
    validX : lessOrEqual reals lowerX upperX
    validY : lessOrEqual reals lowerY upperY
    validZ : lessOrEqual reals lowerZ upperZ

open Box3

BoxContains :
  {R : Set} ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) ->
  Box3 reals ->
  Point3 R ->
  Set
BoxContains reals box point =
  lessOrEqual reals (lowerX box) (xCoordinate point)
  and
  lessOrEqual reals (xCoordinate point) (upperX box)
  and
  lessOrEqual reals (lowerY box) (yCoordinate point)
  and
  lessOrEqual reals (yCoordinate point) (upperY box)
  and
  lessOrEqual reals (lowerZ box) (zCoordinate point)
  and
  lessOrEqual reals (zCoordinate point) (upperZ box)

BoxVolume :
  {R : Set} ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) ->
  Box3 reals ->
  R
BoxVolume reals box =
  multiply reals
    (subtract reals (upperX box) (lowerX box))
    (multiply reals
      (subtract reals (upperY box) (lowerY box))
      (subtract reals (upperZ box) (lowerZ box)))

record BoxCover
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R)
  (region : Predicate (Point3 R)) : Set1 where
  field
    coverBox :
      Nat ->
      Box3 reals
    covers :
      (point : Point3 R) ->
      region point ->
      Exists Nat
        (\ n ->
          BoxContains reals (coverBox n) point)

open BoxCover

CoverHasCost :
  {R : Set} ->
  {reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R} ->
  {region : Predicate (Point3 R)} ->
  BoxCover reals region ->
  R ->
  Set
CoverHasCost {reals = reals} cover cost =
  SeriesHasSum reals
    (\ n -> BoxVolume reals (coverBox cover n))
    cost

record IsLebesgueOuterVolume
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R)
  (region : Predicate (Point3 R))
  (volume : R) : Set1 where
  field
    lower-bound :
      (cover : BoxCover reals region) ->
      (cost : R) ->
      CoverHasCost cover cost ->
      lessOrEqual reals volume cost
    greatest-lower-bound :
      (lower : R) ->
      ((cover : BoxCover reals region) ->
        (cost : R) ->
        CoverHasCost cover cost ->
        lessOrEqual reals lower cost) ->
      lessOrEqual reals lower volume

module Putnam2006A1Statement
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) where

  region : Predicate (Point3 R)
  region point =
    let
      x = xCoordinate point
      y = yCoordinate point
      z = zCoordinate point
      radialSquare =
        add reals
          (square reals x)
          (square reals y)
      leftBase =
        add reals
          (add reals radialSquare (square reals z))
          (fromNat reals eightN)
    in
    lessOrEqual reals
      (square reals leftBase)
      (multiply reals
        (fromNat reals thirtySixN)
        radialSquare)

  answer : R -> R
  answer pi =
    multiply reals
      (fromNat reals sixN)
      (square reals pi)

  proposition : Set1
  proposition =
    (pi : R) ->
    PiValue reals pi ->
    IsLebesgueOuterVolume reals region (answer pi)

putnam-2006-a1 : Set1
putnam-2006-a1 =
  (R : Set) ->

% Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2006_a1:
% the Lebesgue volume of the real three-dimensional region satisfying
% (x^2 + y^2 + z^2 + 8)^2 <= 36 * (x^2 + y^2) is 6 * pi^2.
% This file contains no proof.

putnam_2006_a1: THEORY
BEGIN
  point: TYPE =
    [# x_coord: real, y_coord: real, z_coord: real #]
  spatial_region: TYPE = [point -> bool]
  real_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> real]

  box: TYPE =
    [# lower_x: real, upper_x: real,
       lower_y: real, upper_y: real,
       lower_z: real, upper_z: real #]
  box_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> box]

  region: spatial_region =
    LAMBDA (p: point):
      (x_coord(p) ^ 2
          + y_coord(p) ^ 2
          + z_coord(p) ^ 2
          + 8) ^ 2
        <= 36 * (x_coord(p) ^ 2 + y_coord(p) ^ 2)

  in_open_box(p: point, b: box): bool =
    lower_x(b) < x_coord(p)
      AND x_coord(p) < upper_x(b)
      AND lower_y(b) < y_coord(p)
      AND y_coord(p) < upper_y(b)
      AND lower_z(b) < z_coord(p)
      AND z_coord(p) < upper_z(b)

  box_volume(b: box): real =
    IF lower_x(b) < upper_x(b)
        AND lower_y(b) < upper_y(b)
        AND lower_z(b) < upper_z(b)
    THEN
      (upper_x(b) - lower_x(b))
        * (upper_y(b) - lower_y(b))
        * (upper_z(b) - lower_z(b))
    ELSE
      0
    ENDIF

  partial_box_volume(
      boxes: box_sequence,
      count: nat): RECURSIVE real =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      partial_box_volume(boxes, count - 1)
        + box_volume(boxes(count - 1))
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  converges_to(sequence: real_sequence, value: real): bool =
    FORALL (epsilon_value: posreal):
      EXISTS (cutoff: nat):
        FORALL (index: nat):
          cutoff <= index IMPLIES
            abs(sequence(index) - value) < epsilon_value

  covers(
      covered_region: spatial_region,
      boxes: box_sequence): bool =
    FORALL (p: point):
      covered_region(p) IMPLIES
        EXISTS (index: nat):
          in_open_box(p, boxes(index))

  cover_has_total_volume(
      covered_region: spatial_region,
      boxes: box_sequence,
      total: real): bool =
    covers(covered_region, boxes)
      AND converges_to(
        LAMBDA (count: nat):
          partial_box_volume(boxes, count),
        total)

  has_lebesgue_outer_volume(
      measured_region: spatial_region,
      volume: real): bool =
    0 <= volume
      AND (FORALL (boxes: box_sequence), (total: real):
        cover_has_total_volume(measured_region, boxes, total)
          IMPLIES volume <= total)
      AND (FORALL (epsilon_value: posreal):
        EXISTS (boxes: box_sequence), (total: real):
          cover_has_total_volume(measured_region, boxes, total)
            AND total < volume + epsilon_value)

  alternating_sign(index: nat): RECURSIVE real =
    IF index = 0 THEN
      1
    ELSE
      -alternating_sign(index - 1)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE index

  leibniz_partial_sum(count: nat): RECURSIVE real =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      LET index: nat = count - 1 IN
        leibniz_partial_sum(count - 1)
          + alternating_sign(index)
              / ((2 * index + 1) :: real)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  is_pi(value: real): bool =
    converges_to(
      LAMBDA (count: nat):
        4 * leibniz_partial_sum(count),
      value)

  pi: real =
    epsilon(
      LAMBDA (value: real):
        is_pi(value))

  putnam_2006_a1_solution: real =
    6 * pi ^ 2

  putnam_2006_a1: bool =
    has_lebesgue_outer_volume(
      region,
      putnam_2006_a1_solution)
END putnam_2006_a1

;; Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2006_a3:
;; the recursively defined integer sequence has 2005 consecutive
;; positive-indexed terms divisible by 2006. This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

;; The source hypotheses uniquely determine every positive-indexed term.
;; Writing n=k+1 in the recurrence gives
;;
;;   x(n) = x(n-1) + x(n-2006)  for n > 2006.
;;
;; The Lean source additionally fixes x(0)=0, but that value is never used:
;; k-2005 is positive whenever k>=2006. The definition below is therefore
;; the common positive-indexed sequence from the Lean and Isabelle sources,
;; reduced modulo 2006. Reduction modulo 2006 commutes with the recurrence,
;; and a source term is divisible by 2006 exactly when this residue is zero.
(defun putnam-2006-a3-term-mod-2006 (n)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix n)))
  (cond
   ((not (natp n)) 0)
   ((zp n) 0)
   ((<= n 2006) (mod n 2006))
   (t
    (mod
     (+ (putnam-2006-a3-term-mod-2006 (- n 1))
        (putnam-2006-a3-term-mod-2006 (- n 2006)))
     2006))))

(defun putnam-2006-a3-divisible-block-p (start count)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix count)))
  (if (or (not (natp start))
          (not (natp count)))
      nil
    (if (zp count)
        t
      (and
       (equal (putnam-2006-a3-term-mod-2006 start) 0)
       (putnam-2006-a3-divisible-block-p
        (+ start 1) (- count 1))))))

(defun-sk putnam-2006-a3-divisible-block-exists-p ()
  (exists
   (start)
   (and
    (natp start)
    (< 0 start)
    (putnam-2006-a3-divisible-block-p start 2005))))

;; The positive starting index remains genuinely existential, exactly as in
;; the source. No periodicity bound or precomputed witness is part of the
;; statement.
(defun putnambench-putnam-2006-a3-statement ()
  (putnam-2006-a3-divisible-block-exists-p))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

-- Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2006_a3
-- (putnambench__agda__putnam_2006_a3): the specified integer recurrence
-- has 2005 consecutive terms divisible by 2006. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module Putnam2006A3 where

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Int using (Int; pos; negsuc)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; _*_)

infix 4 _<=N_ _<N_ _<=Z_ _dividesZ_
infixl 6 _+Z_ _-Z_
infixl 7 _*Z_
infixr 3 _and_

record _and_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

data _<=N_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set where
  zero<=N   : {n : Nat} -> zero <=N n
  suc<=sucN : {m n : Nat} -> m <=N n -> suc m <=N suc n

_<N_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set
m <N n =
  suc m <=N n

data Positive : Nat -> Set where
  positive : {n : Nat} -> Positive (suc n)

negative : Nat -> Int
negative zero =
  pos zero
negative (suc n) =
  negsuc n

difference : Nat -> Nat -> Int
difference zero zero =
  pos zero
difference (suc m) zero =
  pos (suc m)
difference zero (suc n) =
  negsuc n
difference (suc m) (suc n) =
  difference m n

negateInt : Int -> Int
negateInt (pos n) =
  negative n
negateInt (negsuc n) =
  pos (suc n)

_+Z_ : Int -> Int -> Int
pos m +Z pos n =
  pos (m + n)
pos m +Z negsuc n =
  difference m (suc n)
negsuc m +Z pos n =
  difference n (suc m)
negsuc m +Z negsuc n =
  negsuc (suc (m + n))

_-Z_ : Int -> Int -> Int
x -Z y =
  x +Z negateInt y

_*Z_ : Int -> Int -> Int
pos m *Z pos n =
  pos (m * n)
pos m *Z negsuc n =
  negative (m * suc n)
negsuc m *Z pos n =
  negative (suc m * n)
negsuc m *Z negsuc n =
  pos (suc m * suc n)

_<=Z_ : Int -> Int -> Set
x <=Z y =
  Exists Nat
    (\ differenceMagnitude ->
      x +Z pos differenceMagnitude == y)

record _dividesZ_ (divisor dividend : Int) : Set where
  field
    quotient : Int
    division-equation :
      divisor *Z quotient == dividend

InitialValues : (Int -> Int) -> Set
InitialValues x =
  (k : Int) ->
  (pos zero <=Z k and k <=Z pos 2006) ->
  x k == k

Recurrence : (Int -> Int) -> Set
Recurrence x =
  (k : Int) ->
  pos 2006 <=Z k ->
  x (k +Z pos 1) ==
  x k +Z x (k -Z pos 2005)

ConsecutiveDivisibleTerms : (Int -> Int) -> Set
ConsecutiveDivisibleTerms x =
  Exists Nat
    (\ i ->
      Positive i
      and
      ((j : Nat) ->
        j <N 2005 ->
        pos 2006 dividesZ x (pos (i + j))))

putnam-2006-a3 : Set
putnam-2006-a3 =
  (x : Int -> Int) ->
  InitialValues x ->
  Recurrence x ->
  ConsecutiveDivisibleTerms x

title: putnam_2006_a3
content:
% Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2006_a3:
% every integer sequence with the stated initial values and recurrence has
% 2005 consecutive terms divisible by 2006. This file contains no proof.

putnam_2006_a3: THEORY
BEGIN
  integer_sequence: TYPE = [int -> int]

  int_divides(divisor, value: int): bool =
    EXISTS (quotient: int):
      value = divisor * quotient

  satisfies_recurrence(x: integer_sequence): bool =
    (FORALL (k: int):
      (1 <= k AND k <= 2006) IMPLIES x(k) = k)
      AND (FORALL (k: int):
        k >= 2006 IMPLIES
          x(k + 1) = x(k) + x(k - 2005))

  putnam_2006_a3: bool =
    FORALL (x: integer_sequence):
      satisfies_recurrence(x) IMPLIES
        EXISTS (i: int):
          i > 0
            AND (FORALL (j: int):
              (0 <= j AND j < 2005) IMPLIES
                int_divides(2006, x(i + j)))
END putnam_2006_a3

title: putnam_2006_a4
content:
import Mathlib

-- Note: uses (ℕ → ℕ) instead of (Equiv.Perm (Fin n))
noncomputable abbrev putnam_2006_a4_solution : ℕ → ℝ := sorry
-- (fun n : ℕ => (n + 1) / 3)
/--
Let $S=\{1,2,\dots,n\}$ for some integer $n>1$. Say a permutation $\pi$ of $S$ has a \emph{local maximum} at $k \in S$ if
\begin{enumerate}
\item[(i)] $\pi(k)>\pi(k+1)$ for $k=1$;
\item[(ii)] $\pi(k-1)<\pi(k)$ and $\pi(k)>\pi(k+1)$ for $1< k< n$;
\item[(iii)] $\pi(k-1)<\pi(k)$ for $k=n$.
\end{enumerate}
(For example, if $n=5$ and $\pi$ takes values at $1,2,3,4,5$ of $2,1,4,5,3$, then $\pi$ has a local maximum of 2 at $k=1$, and a local maximum of 5 at $k=4$.) What is the average number of local maxima of a permutation of $S$, averaging over all permutations of $S$?
-/
theorem putnam_2006_a4
(n : ℕ)
(pnat : Equiv.Perm (Fin n) → (ℕ → ℕ))
(pcount : Equiv.Perm (Fin n) → ℕ)
(ngt1 : n > 1)
(hpnat : ∀ p : Equiv.Perm (Fin n), ∀ k : Fin n, (pnat p) k = p k)
(hpcount : ∀ p : Equiv.Perm (Fin n), pcount p = {k : Fin n | (k.1 = 0 ∨ (pnat p) (k - 1) < (pnat p) k) ∧ (k = n - 1 ∨ (pnat p) k > (pnat p) (k + 1))}.encard)
: (∑ p : Equiv.Perm (Fin n), pcount p) / {p : Equiv.Perm (Fin n) | true}.ncard = putnam_2006_a4_solution n :=
sorry

title: putnam_2006_a4
content:
(* Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench artifact putnam_2006_a4:
   the average number of endpoint-aware local maxima among permutations of
   an n-element set. This file contains no proof. *)

From Stdlib Require Import Reals.
From mathcomp Require Import all_ssreflect.

Set Implicit Arguments.
Unset Strict Implicit.
Unset Printing Implicit Defensive.

Definition putnam_2006_a4_is_permutation {n : nat}
    (p : {ffun 'I_n -> 'I_n}) : bool :=
  [forall i : 'I_n,
    [forall j : 'I_n, (p i == p j) ==> (i == j)]].

Definition putnam_2006_a4_permutation_value {n : nat}
    (p : {ffun 'I_n -> 'I_n}) (i : nat) : nat :=
  match insub i with
  | Some k => nat_of_ord (p k)
  | None => 0
  end.

Definition putnam_2006_a4_is_local_maximum {n : nat}
    (p : {ffun 'I_n -> 'I_n}) (k : 'I_n) : bool :=
  ((nat_of_ord k == 0) ||
   (putnam_2006_a4_permutation_value p (nat_of_ord k - 1) <
    putnam_2006_a4_permutation_value p (nat_of_ord k))) &&
  ((nat_of_ord k == n - 1) ||
   (putnam_2006_a4_permutation_value p (nat_of_ord k) >
    putnam_2006_a4_permutation_value p (nat_of_ord k + 1))).

Definition putnam_2006_a4_local_maximum_count {n : nat}
    (p : {ffun 'I_n -> 'I_n}) : nat :=
  \sum_(k : 'I_n)
    (if putnam_2006_a4_is_local_maximum p k then 1 else 0).

Definition putnam_2006_a4_solution (n : nat) : R :=
  (INR n + 1) / 3.

Theorem putnam_2006_a4 (n : nat) (hn : (1 < n)%nat) :
  Rdiv
    (INR (\sum_(p : {ffun 'I_n -> 'I_n} |
                   putnam_2006_a4_is_permutation p)
           putnam_2006_a4_local_maximum_count p))
    (INR
      (#|[pred p : {ffun 'I_n -> 'I_n} |
           putnam_2006_a4_is_permutation p]|)) =
  putnam_2006_a4_solution n.
Admitted.

title: putnam_2006_a4
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2006_a4:
  the average number of local maxima among the values of a permutation of
  {1,...,n} is (n+1)/3 for every integer n greater than one. This file
  contains no proof.
*)

let statement =
  `let permutations =
     \n:num.
       {p:num->num |
          BIJ p (0..n-1) (0..n-1) /\
          (!i:num. ~(i IN (0..n-1)) ==> p i = i)} in
   let local_maxima =
     \n:num. \p:num->num.
       {k:num |
          k IN (0..n-1) /\
          (k = 0 \/ p (k-1) < p k) /\
          (k = n-1 \/ p k > p (k+1))} in
   !n:num.
     1 < n
     ==>
     sum (permutations n)
         (\p:num->num. &(CARD (local_maxima n p))) /
     &(CARD (permutations n)) =
     (&n + &1) / &3`;;

title: putnam_2006_a4
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2006_a4:
;; for every integer n greater than one, the average number of endpoint-aware
;; local maxima over all permutations of n elements is (n+1)/3. This file
;; contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

;; A permutation is represented by its image list on 0,...,n-1. The generator
;; below enumerates every such list exactly once. This is bijective with the
;; Fin n permutations in Lean and with the Isabelle permutations that fix all
;; indices at least n.

(defun putnam-2006-a4-range-from (start count)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix count)))
  (if (zp count)
      nil
    (cons start
          (putnam-2006-a4-range-from
           (+ start 1) (- count 1)))))

(defun putnam-2006-a4-prepend-to-each (value lists)
  (if (endp lists)
      nil
    (cons
     (cons value (car lists))
     (putnam-2006-a4-prepend-to-each
      value (cdr lists)))))

(defun putnam-2006-a4-insert-everywhere (value values)
  (if (endp values)
      (list (list value))
    (cons
     (cons value values)
     (putnam-2006-a4-prepend-to-each
      (car values)
      (putnam-2006-a4-insert-everywhere
       value (cdr values))))))

(defun putnam-2006-a4-insert-into-permutations
    (value permutations)
  (if (endp permutations)
      nil
    (append
     (putnam-2006-a4-insert-everywhere
      value (car permutations))
     (putnam-2006-a4-insert-into-permutations
      value (cdr permutations)))))

(defun putnam-2006-a4-permutations (values)
  (if (endp values)
      (list nil)
    (putnam-2006-a4-insert-into-permutations
     (car values)
     (putnam-2006-a4-permutations (cdr values)))))

;; PREVIOUS is the value immediately before the first element of REMAINING.
;; The final element needs only the left comparison; every earlier element
;; needs both strict comparisons.
(defun putnam-2006-a4-local-maxima-after-first
    (previous remaining)
  (if (endp remaining)
      0
    (if (endp (cdr remaining))
        (if (< previous (car remaining)) 1 0)
      (+ (if (and (< previous (car remaining))
                  (> (car remaining) (cadr remaining)))
             1
           0)
         (putnam-2006-a4-local-maxima-after-first
          (car remaining) (cdr remaining))))))

(defun putnam-2006-a4-local-maxima-count (permutation)
  (if (endp permutation)
      0
    (if (endp (cdr permutation))
        1
      (+ (if (> (car permutation) (cadr permutation))
             1
           0)
         (putnam-2006-a4-local-maxima-after-first
          (car permutation) (cdr permutation))))))

(defun putnam-2006-a4-total-local-maxima (permutations)
  (if (endp permutations)
      0
    (+ (putnam-2006-a4-local-maxima-count
        (car permutations))
       (putnam-2006-a4-total-local-maxima
        (cdr permutations)))))

(defun putnambench-putnam-2006-a4-statement (n)
  (implies
   (and (natp n)
        (< 1 n))
   (let* ((permutations
           (putnam-2006-a4-permutations
            (putnam-2006-a4-range-from 0 n)))
          (total-local-maxima
           (putnam-2006-a4-total-local-maxima
            permutations)))
     (equal
      (/ total-local-maxima (len permutations))
      (/ (+ n 1) 3)))))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

title: putnam_2006_a4
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2006_a4
-- (putnambench__agda__putnam_2006_a4): the average number of local maxima
-- among all permutations of an n-element set is (n + 1) / 3 for n > 1.
-- This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

open import Agda.Builtin.Bool using (Bool; true; false)
open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; _*_)

infix 4 _<N_
infixr 5 _::_

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

data _<=N_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set where
  zero<=N   : {n : Nat} -> zero <=N n
  suc<=sucN : {m n : Nat} -> m <=N n -> suc m <=N suc n

_<N_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set
m <N n =
  suc m <=N n

data Fin : Nat -> Set where
  fzero : {n : Nat} -> Fin (suc n)
  fsuc  : {n : Nat} -> Fin n -> Fin (suc n)

toNat : {n : Nat} -> Fin n -> Nat
toNat fzero =
  zero
toNat (fsuc i) =
  suc (toNat i)

data Vec (A : Set) : Nat -> Set where
  []   : Vec A zero
  _::_ : {n : Nat} -> A -> Vec A n -> Vec A (suc n)

lookup :
  {A : Set} ->
  {n : Nat} ->
  Vec A n ->
  Fin n ->
  A
lookup (x :: xs) fzero =
  x
lookup (x :: xs) (fsuc i) =
  lookup xs i

record HasCardinality
  {A : Set}
  (P : A -> Set)
  (cardinality : Nat) :
  Set where

  field
    enumerate :
      Fin cardinality ->
      A
    enumerated-member :
      (i : Fin cardinality) ->
      P (enumerate i)
    enumeration-complete :
      (x : A) ->
      P x ->
      Exists (Fin cardinality)
        (\ i -> x == enumerate i)
    enumeration-injective :
      (i j : Fin cardinality) ->
      enumerate i == enumerate j ->
      i == j

open HasCardinality

lessBool : Nat -> Nat -> Bool
lessBool zero zero =
  false
lessBool zero (suc n) =
  true
lessBool (suc m) zero =
  false
lessBool (suc m) (suc n) =
  lessBool m n

andBool : Bool -> Bool -> Bool
andBool true right =
  right
andBool false right =
  false

indicator : Bool -> Nat
indicator true =
  suc zero
indicator false =
  zero

firstPeak : Nat -> Nat -> Nat
firstPeak current next =
  indicator (lessBool next current)

interiorPeak : Nat -> Nat -> Nat -> Nat
interiorPeak previous current next =
  indicator
    (andBool
      (lessBool previous current)
      (lessBool next current))

lastPeak : Nat -> Nat -> Nat
lastPeak previous current =
  indicator (lessBool previous current)

tailPeakCount :
  {bound remaining : Nat} ->
  Nat ->
  Nat ->
  Vec (Fin bound) remaining ->
  Nat
tailPeakCount previous current [] =
  lastPeak previous current
tailPeakCount previous current (next :: rest) =
  interiorPeak previous current (toNat next)
  + tailPeakCount current (toNat next) rest

localMaximumCount :
  {n : Nat} ->
  Vec (Fin n) n ->
  Nat
localMaximumCount {zero} [] =
  zero
localMaximumCount {suc zero} (x :: []) =
  suc zero
localMaximumCount {suc (suc n)} (x :: y :: rest) =
  firstPeak (toNat x) (toNat y)
  + tailPeakCount (toNat x) (toNat y) rest

IsPermutation :
  {n : Nat} ->
  Vec (Fin n) n ->
  Set
IsPermutation {n} entries =
  (i j : Fin n) ->
  lookup entries i == lookup entries j ->
  i == j

sumFin :
  {n : Nat} ->
  (Fin n -> Nat) ->
  Nat
sumFin {zero} term =
  zero
sumFin {suc n} term =
  term fzero
  + sumFin (\ i -> term (fsuc i))

oneN : Nat
oneN =
  suc zero

threeN : Nat
threeN =
  suc (suc (suc zero))

module Putnam2006A4Statement where

  PermutationVector : Nat -> Set
  PermutationVector n =
    Vec (Fin n) n

  totalLocalMaxima :
    {n permutationCount : Nat} ->
    HasCardinality
      (IsPermutation {n})
      permutationCount ->
    Nat
  totalLocalMaxima allPermutations =
    sumFin
      (\ i ->
        localMaximumCount
          (enumerate allPermutations i))

  proposition : Set
  proposition =
    (n : Nat) ->
    oneN <N n ->
    (permutationCount : Nat) ->
    (allPermutations :
      HasCardinality
        (IsPermutation {n})
        permutationCount) ->
    threeN
      * totalLocalMaxima allPermutations
    ==
    suc n * permutationCount

putnam-2006-a4 : Set
putnam-2006-a4 =
  Putnam2006A4Statement.proposition

title: putnam_2006_a4
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2006_a4:
  the average number of endpoint-aware local maxima among permutations of
  n elements is (n + 1) / 3 for every n greater than one. This file contains
  no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open arithmeticTheory pred_setTheory permutesTheory realTheory real_sigmaTheory;

val putnam_2006_a4 =
  ``!n : num.
      1 < n
      ==>
      SIGMA
        (\p : num -> num.
           &(CARD
               {k : num |
                  k < n /\
                  (k = 0 \/ p (k - 1) < p k) /\
                  (k = n - 1 \/ p k > p (k + 1))}))
        {p : num -> num | p permutes count n} /
      &(CARD {p : num -> num | p permutes count n}) =
      (&(n + 1) : real) / 3``;

title: putnam_2006_a4
content:
$(
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact
  putnam_2006_a4: the average number of local maxima, including the
  one-sided endpoint cases, among permutations of a finite integer interval
  is (n + 1) / 3. This file contains no proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  For n > 1, the interval 1 ... n is the problem's set S, and the base of
  its symmetric group is exactly the set of all permutations of S. For each
  permutation p, the restricted class contains precisely its local-maximum
  positions: at 1 only the right comparison is required, at n only the left
  comparison is required, and at every interior position both are required.

  Its finite cardinality is therefore the local-maximum count. Summing that
  count over the symmetric group and dividing by the group's cardinality is
  the requested average. Shifting positions and values down by one gives the
  Fin n formulation in the Lean and Isabelle sources. The final declaration
  is the single unproved $a corpus statement; this database contains no $p
  proof declaration.
$)

${
  $d k n p $.

  putnambench-putnam-2006-a4 $a |- A. n e. NN
    (
      1 < n
      ->
      (
        (
          sum_ p e. ( Base ` ( SymGrp ` ( 1 ... n ) ) )
            (
              #
              `
              {
                k e. ( 1 ... n )
                |
                (
                  (
                    k = 1
                    \/
                    ( p ` ( k - 1 ) ) < ( p ` k )
                  )
                  /\
                  (
                    k = n
                    \/
                    ( p ` ( k + 1 ) ) < ( p ` k )
                  )
                )
              }
            )
        )
        /
        (
          #
          `
          ( Base ` ( SymGrp ` ( 1 ... n ) ) )
        )
      )
      =
      ( ( n + 1 ) / 3 )
    )
  $.
$}

title: putnam_2006_a4
content:
% Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2006_a4:
% the average number of endpoint-inclusive local maxima over permutations of
% n elements is (n + 1)/3 for n greater than one. This file contains no proof.

putnam_2006_a4: THEORY
BEGIN
  quotient_aux(
      numerator, denominator, fuel: nat): RECURSIVE nat =
    IF fuel = 0
        OR denominator = 0
        OR numerator < denominator THEN
      0
    ELSE
      1
        + quotient_aux(
            numerator - denominator,
            denominator,
            fuel - 1)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE fuel

  remainder_aux(
      numerator, denominator, fuel: nat): RECURSIVE nat =
    IF fuel = 0
        OR denominator = 0
        OR numerator < denominator THEN
      numerator
    ELSE
      remainder_aux(
        numerator - denominator,
        denominator,
        fuel - 1)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE fuel

  safe_ndiv(numerator, denominator: nat): nat =
    quotient_aux(
      numerator,
      denominator,
      numerator + 1)

  safe_mod(numerator, denominator: nat): nat =
    IF denominator = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      remainder_aux(
        numerator,
        denominator,
        numerator + 1)
    ENDIF

  function_code_count(n: nat): nat =
    IF n = 0 THEN 1 ELSE n ^ n ENDIF

  permutation_entry(code, index, n: nat): nat =
    IF n = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      safe_mod(safe_ndiv(code, n ^ index), n)
    ENDIF

  permutation_code(code, n: nat): bool =
    code < function_code_count(n)
      AND (FORALL (i, j: nat):
        (i < n
          AND j < n
          AND permutation_entry(code, i, n)
            = permutation_entry(code, j, n))
        IMPLIES i = j)

  local_maximum_at(code, index, n: nat): bool =
    index < n
      AND
        (index = 0
          OR permutation_entry(code, index - 1, n)
            < permutation_entry(code, index, n))
      AND
        (index + 1 = n
          OR permutation_entry(code, index, n)
            > permutation_entry(code, index + 1, n))

  count_true(
      property: [nat -> bool],
      count: nat): RECURSIVE nat =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      count_true(property, count - 1)
        + IF property(count - 1) THEN 1 ELSE 0 ENDIF
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  local_maximum_count(code, n: nat): nat =
    count_true(
      (LAMBDA (index: nat):
        local_maximum_at(code, index, n)),
      n)

  permutation_count(
      n, limit: nat): RECURSIVE nat =
    IF limit = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      LET code: nat = limit - 1 IN
        permutation_count(n, limit - 1)
          + IF permutation_code(code, n) THEN 1 ELSE 0 ENDIF
    ENDIF
  MEASURE limit

  local_maximum_sum(
      n, limit: nat): RECURSIVE nat =
    IF limit = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      LET code: nat = limit - 1 IN
        local_maximum_sum(n, limit - 1)
          + IF permutation_code(code, n) THEN
              local_maximum_count(code, n)
            ELSE
              0
            ENDIF
    ENDIF
  MEASURE limit

  putnam_2006_a4_solution(n: nat): real =
    ((n + 1) :: real) / 3

  putnam_2006_a4: bool =
    FORALL (n: nat):
      n > 1 IMPLIES
        (local_maximum_sum(
          n,
          function_code_count(n)) :: real)
          = putnam_2006_a4_solution(n)
            * (permutation_count(
              n,
              function_code_count(n)) :: real)
END putnam_2006_a4

import Mathlib

abbrev putnam_2006_a5_solution : ℕ → ℤ := sorry
-- (fun n : ℕ => if (n ≡ 1 [MOD 4]) then n else -n)
/--
Let $n$ be a positive odd integer and let $\theta$ be a real number such that $\theta/\pi$ is irrational. Set $a_k=\tan(\theta+k\pi/n)$, $k=1,2,\dots,n$. Prove that $\frac{a_1+a_2+\cdots+a_n}{a_1a_2 \cdots a_n}$ is an integer, and determine its value.
-/
theorem putnam_2006_a5
(n : ℕ)
(theta : ℝ)
(a : Set.Icc 1 n → ℝ)
(nodd : Odd n)
(thetairr : Irrational (theta / Real.pi))
(ha : ∀ k : Set.Icc 1 n, a k = Real.tan (theta + (k * Real.pi) / n))
: (∑ k : Set.Icc 1 n, a k) / (∏ k : Set.Icc 1 n, a k) = putnam_2006_a5_solution n :=
sorry

title: putnam_2006_a5

From mathcomp Require Import all_algebra all_ssreflect.
From mathcomp Require Import reals trigo.
From mathcomp Require Import classical_sets.

Set Implicit Arguments.
Unset Strict Implicit.
Unset Printing Implicit Defensive.

Local Open Scope ring_scope.
Local Open Scope classical_set_scope.

Variable R : realType.
Definition putnam_2006_a5_solution : nat -> int := fun n : nat => if n == 1 %[mod 4] then n%:Z else - n%:Z.
Theorem putnam_2006_a5
    (n : nat)
    (theta : R)
    (a : nat -> R)
    (nodd : odd n)
    (thetairr : ~ exists a b : int, b <> 0 /\ theta / pi = (a%:~R / b%:~R))
    (ha : forall k : nat, ge k 1 /\ ge n k -> a k = tan (theta + (k%:R * pi) / n%:R))
    : \sum_(1 <= k < n.+1) a k / \prod_(1 <= k < n.+1) a k = (putnam_2006_a5_solution n)%:~R.
Proof. Admitted.

theory putnam_2006_a5 imports Complex_Main
begin

(* uses (nat \<Rightarrow> real) instead of ({1..n} \<Rightarrow> real) *)
definition putnam_2006_a5_solution :: "nat \<Rightarrow> int" where "putnam_2006_a5_solution \<equiv> undefined"
(* (\<lambda>n::nat. if ([n = 1] (mod 4)) then n else -n) *)
theorem putnam_2006_a5:
  fixes n :: nat
  and theta :: real
  and a :: "nat \<Rightarrow> real"
  assumes nodd: "odd n"
  and thetairr: "theta/pi \<notin> \<rat>"
  and ha: "\<forall>k::nat\<in>{1..n}. a k = tan (theta + (k*pi)/n)"
  shows "(\<Sum>k::nat=1..n. a k) / (\<Prod>k::nat=1..n. a k) = putnam_2006_a5_solution n"
  sorry

end

title: putnam_2006_a5
putnam_2006_a5
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2006_a5:
;; for positive odd n and irrational theta/pi, the sum-to-product ratio of
;; tan(theta + k*pi/n), k = 1,...,n, is n or -n according to n modulo 4.
;; This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))

;; REAL-TYPE indexes an arbitrary presentation of an Archimedean ordered
;; field.  The conservative interfaces below supply no facts: all field,
;; order, pi, trigonometric, irrationality, and tangent-family conditions are
;; explicit in the statement predicate.  Pi is fixed by the convergent Machin
;; series, and sine and cosine are fixed by their complete power series.

(defstub p06a5-member-p (real-type value) t)
(defstub p06a5-zero (real-type) t)
(defstub p06a5-one (real-type) t)
(defstub p06a5-add (real-type left right) t)
(defstub p06a5-multiply (real-type left right) t)
(defstub p06a5-negate (real-type value) t)
(defstub p06a5-inverse (real-type value) t)
(defstub p06a5-less (real-type left right) t)
(defstub p06a5-pi (real-type) t)
(defstub p06a5-sine (real-type value) t)
(defstub p06a5-cosine (real-type value) t)
(defstub p06a5-a (real-type index) t)

(defun p06a5-r-add (real-type left right)
  (p06a5-add real-type left right))

(defun p06a5-r-multiply (real-type left right)
  (p06a5-multiply real-type left right))

(defun p06a5-r-negate (real-type value)
  (p06a5-negate real-type value))

(defun p06a5-r-inverse (real-type value)
  (p06a5-inverse real-type value))

(defun p06a5-r-subtract (real-type left right)
  (p06a5-r-add
   real-type
   left
   (p06a5-r-negate real-type right)))

(defun p06a5-r-divide (real-type numerator denominator)
  (p06a5-r-multiply
   real-type
   numerator
   (p06a5-r-inverse real-type denominator)))

(defun p06a5-r-absolute-value (real-type value)
  (if (p06a5-less real-type value (p06a5-zero real-type))
      (p06a5-r-negate real-type value)
    value))

(defun p06a5-r-nat (real-type n)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix n)))
  (if (zp n)
      (p06a5-zero real-type)
    (p06a5-r-add
     real-type
     (p06a5-one real-type)
     (p06a5-r-nat real-type (1- n)))))

(defun p06a5-r-int (real-type integer)
  (if (and (integerp integer)
           (< integer 0))
      (p06a5-r-negate
       real-type
       (p06a5-r-nat real-type (- integer)))
    (p06a5-r-nat real-type integer)))

(defun p06a5-r-power (real-type base exponent)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix exponent)))
  (if (zp exponent)
      (p06a5-one real-type)
    (p06a5-r-multiply
     real-type
     base
     (p06a5-r-power real-type base (1- exponent)))))

(defun p06a5-r-factorial (real-type n)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix n)))
  (if (zp n)
      (p06a5-one real-type)
    (p06a5-r-multiply
     real-type
     (p06a5-r-nat real-type n)
     (p06a5-r-factorial real-type (1- n)))))

(defun-sk p06a5-field-laws-p (real-type)
  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (p06a5-member-p real-type x)
      (p06a5-member-p real-type y)
      (p06a5-member-p real-type z))
     (let* ((zero (p06a5-zero real-type))
            (one (p06a5-one real-type))
            (x-plus-y (p06a5-r-add real-type x y))
            (y-plus-z (p06a5-r-add real-type y z))
            (x-times-y (p06a5-r-multiply real-type x y))
            (y-times-z (p06a5-r-multiply real-type y z))
            (minus-x (p06a5-r-negate real-type x))
            (inverse-x (p06a5-r-inverse real-type x)))
       (and
        (p06a5-member-p real-type x-plus-y)
        (p06a5-member-p real-type x-times-y)
        (p06a5-member-p real-type minus-x)
        (p06a5-member-p real-type inverse-x)
        (equal
         (p06a5-r-add real-type x-plus-y z)
         (p06a5-r-add real-type x y-plus-z))
        (equal x-plus-y (p06a5-r-add real-type y x))
        (equal (p06a5-r-add real-type x zero) x)
        (equal (p06a5-r-add real-type x minus-x) zero)
        (equal
         (p06a5-r-multiply real-type x-times-y z)
         (p06a5-r-multiply real-type x y-times-z))
        (equal x-times-y (p06a5-r-multiply real-type y x))
        (equal (p06a5-r-multiply real-type x one) x)
        (implies
         (equal x zero)
         (equal inverse-x zero))
        (implies
         (not (equal x zero))
         (equal
          (p06a5-r-multiply real-type x inverse-x)
          one))
        (equal
         (p06a5-r-multiply real-type x y-plus-z)
         (p06a5-r-add
          real-type
          (p06a5-r-multiply real-type x y)
          (p06a5-r-multiply real-type x z))))))))

(defun-sk p06a5-order-laws-p (real-type)
  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (p06a5-member-p real-type x)
      (p06a5-member-p real-type y)
      (p06a5-member-p real-type z))
     (let ((zero (p06a5-zero real-type)))
       (and
        (not (p06a5-less real-type x x))
        (or
         (p06a5-less real-type x y)
         (equal x y)
         (p06a5-less real-type y x))
        (implies
         (and
          (p06a5-less real-type x y)
          (p06a5-less real-type y z))
         (p06a5-less real-type x z))
        (implies
         (p06a5-less real-type x y)
         (p06a5-less
          real-type
          (p06a5-r-add real-type x z)
          (p06a5-r-add real-type y z)))
        (implies
         (and
          (p06a5-less real-type zero x)
          (p06a5-less real-type zero y))
         (p06a5-less
          real-type
          zero
          (p06a5-r-multiply real-type x y))))))))

(defun-sk p06a5-archimedean-bound-exists-p
    (real-type value)
  (exists (n)
    (and
     (natp n)
     (p06a5-less
      real-type
      value
      (p06a5-r-nat real-type n)))))

(defun-sk p06a5-archimedean-p (real-type)
  (forall (value)
    (implies
     (p06a5-member-p real-type value)
     (p06a5-archimedean-bound-exists-p
      real-type value))))

(defun p06a5-real-field-p (real-type)
  (let ((zero (p06a5-zero real-type))
        (one (p06a5-one real-type)))
    (and
     (p06a5-member-p real-type zero)
     (p06a5-member-p real-type one)
     (not (equal zero one))
     (p06a5-field-laws-p real-type)
     (p06a5-order-laws-p real-type)
     (p06a5-less real-type zero one)
     (p06a5-archimedean-p real-type))))

;; Machin's identity fixes the distinguished pi element exactly:
;; pi = 16*arctan(1/5) - 4*arctan(1/239).

(defun p06a5-arctan-prefix (real-type z terms)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix terms)))
  (if (zp terms)
      (p06a5-zero real-type)
    (let* ((index (1- terms))
           (exponent (+ (* 2 index) 1))
           (unsigned-term
            (p06a5-r-divide
             real-type
             (p06a5-r-power real-type z exponent)
             (p06a5-r-nat real-type exponent)))
           (term
            (if (equal (mod index 2) 0)
                unsigned-term
              (p06a5-r-negate real-type unsigned-term))))
      (p06a5-r-add
       real-type
       (p06a5-arctan-prefix real-type z index)
       term))))

(defun p06a5-pi-prefix (real-type terms)
  (let* ((one (p06a5-one real-type))
         (five (p06a5-r-nat real-type 5))
         (two-hundred-thirty-nine
          (p06a5-r-nat real-type 239))
         (sixteen (p06a5-r-nat real-type 16))
         (four (p06a5-r-nat real-type 4))
         (atan-one-fifth
          (p06a5-arctan-prefix
           real-type
           (p06a5-r-divide real-type one five)
           terms))
         (atan-one-over-two-hundred-thirty-nine
          (p06a5-arctan-prefix
           real-type
           (p06a5-r-divide
            real-type one two-hundred-thirty-nine)
           terms)))
    (p06a5-r-subtract
     real-type
     (p06a5-r-multiply real-type sixteen atan-one-fifth)
     (p06a5-r-multiply
      real-type four atan-one-over-two-hundred-thirty-nine))))

(defun-sk p06a5-pi-tail-p
    (real-type epsilon cutoff)
  (forall (terms)
    (implies
     (and
      (natp terms)
      (natp cutoff)
      (<= cutoff terms))
     (p06a5-less
      real-type
      (p06a5-r-absolute-value
       real-type
       (p06a5-r-subtract
        real-type
        (p06a5-pi-prefix real-type terms)
        (p06a5-pi real-type)))
      epsilon))))

(defun-sk p06a5-pi-cutoff-exists-p
    (real-type epsilon)
  (exists (cutoff)
    (and
     (natp cutoff)
     (p06a5-pi-tail-p real-type epsilon cutoff))))

(defun-sk p06a5-pi-converges-p (real-type)
  (forall (epsilon)
    (implies
     (and
      (p06a5-member-p real-type epsilon)
      (p06a5-less
       real-type (p06a5-zero real-type) epsilon))
     (p06a5-pi-cutoff-exists-p
      real-type epsilon))))

(defun p06a5-pi-value-p (real-type)
  (and
   (p06a5-member-p real-type (p06a5-pi real-type))
   (p06a5-less
    real-type
    (p06a5-zero real-type)
    (p06a5-pi real-type))
   (p06a5-pi-converges-p real-type)))

;; Sine and cosine are their full Taylor-series limits.

(defun p06a5-sine-term (real-type x index)
  (let* ((exponent (+ (* 2 index) 1))
         (unsigned
          (p06a5-r-divide
           real-type
           (p06a5-r-power real-type x exponent)
           (p06a5-r-factorial real-type exponent))))
    (if (equal (mod index 2) 0)
        unsigned
      (p06a5-r-negate real-type unsigned))))

(defun p06a5-cosine-term (real-type x index)
  (let* ((exponent (* 2 index))
         (unsigned
          (p06a5-r-divide
           real-type
           (p06a5-r-power real-type x exponent)
           (p06a5-r-factorial real-type exponent))))
    (if (equal (mod index 2) 0)
        unsigned
      (p06a5-r-negate real-type unsigned))))

(defun p06a5-sine-prefix (real-type x terms)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix terms)))
  (if (zp terms)
      (p06a5-zero real-type)
    (let ((index (1- terms)))
      (p06a5-r-add
       real-type
       (p06a5-sine-prefix real-type x index)
       (p06a5-sine-term real-type x index)))))

(defun p06a5-cosine-prefix (real-type x terms)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix terms)))
  (if (zp terms)
      (p06a5-zero real-type)
    (let ((index (1- terms)))
      (p06a5-r-add
       real-type
       (p06a5-cosine-prefix real-type x index)
       (p06a5-cosine-term real-type x index)))))

(defun-sk p06a5-sine-tail-p
    (real-type x epsilon cutoff)
  (forall (terms)
    (implies
     (and
      (natp terms)
      (natp cutoff)
      (<= cutoff terms))
     (p06a5-less
      real-type
      (p06a5-r-absolute-value
       real-type
       (p06a5-r-subtract
        real-type
        (p06a5-sine-prefix real-type x terms)
        (p06a5-sine real-type x)))
      epsilon))))

(defun-sk p06a5-sine-cutoff-exists-p
    (real-type x epsilon)
  (exists (cutoff)
    (and
     (natp cutoff)
     (p06a5-sine-tail-p
      real-type x epsilon cutoff))))

(defun-sk p06a5-sine-series-p (real-type x)
  (forall (epsilon)
    (implies
     (and
      (p06a5-member-p real-type epsilon)
      (p06a5-less
       real-type (p06a5-zero real-type) epsilon))
     (p06a5-sine-cutoff-exists-p
      real-type x epsilon))))

(defun-sk p06a5-cosine-tail-p
    (real-type x epsilon cutoff)
  (forall (terms)
    (implies
     (and
      (natp terms)
      (natp cutoff)
      (<= cutoff terms))
     (p06a5-less
      real-type
      (p06a5-r-absolute-value
       real-type
       (p06a5-r-subtract
        real-type
        (p06a5-cosine-prefix real-type x terms)
        (p06a5-cosine real-type x)))
      epsilon))))

(defun-sk p06a5-cosine-cutoff-exists-p
    (real-type x epsilon)
  (exists (cutoff)
    (and
     (natp cutoff)
     (p06a5-cosine-tail-p
      real-type x epsilon cutoff))))

(defun-sk p06a5-cosine-series-p (real-type x)
  (forall (epsilon)
    (implies
     (and
      (p06a5-member-p real-type epsilon)
      (p06a5-less
       real-type (p06a5-zero real-type) epsilon))
     (p06a5-cosine-cutoff-exists-p
      real-type x epsilon))))

(defun-sk p06a5-trigonometric-laws-p (real-type)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (p06a5-member-p real-type x)
     (and
      (p06a5-member-p
       real-type (p06a5-sine real-type x))
      (p06a5-member-p
       real-type (p06a5-cosine real-type x))
      (p06a5-sine-series-p real-type x)
      (p06a5-cosine-series-p real-type x)))))

(defun p06a5-tangent (real-type x)
  (p06a5-r-divide
   real-type
   (p06a5-sine real-type x)
   (p06a5-cosine real-type x)))

;; This is exactly theta/pi not being equal to any integer ratio p/q with
;; q nonzero; the existential witnesses remain internal to the predicate.

(defun-sk p06a5-rational-representation-exists-p
    (real-type value)
  (exists (numerator denominator)
    (and
     (integerp numerator)
     (integerp denominator)
     (not (equal denominator 0))
     (equal
      value
      (p06a5-r-divide
       real-type
       (p06a5-r-int real-type numerator)
       (p06a5-r-int real-type denominator))))))

(defun p06a5-irrational-p (real-type value)
  (not
   (p06a5-rational-representation-exists-p
    real-type value)))

(defun p06a5-angle (real-type n theta k)
  (p06a5-r-add
   real-type
   theta
   (p06a5-r-divide
    real-type
    (p06a5-r-multiply
     real-type
     (p06a5-r-nat real-type k)
     (p06a5-pi real-type))
    (p06a5-r-nat real-type n))))

(defun-sk p06a5-tangent-family-p
    (real-type n theta)
  (forall (k)
    (implies
     (and
      (natp k)
      (<= 1 k)
      (<= k n))
     (and
      (p06a5-member-p
       real-type (p06a5-a real-type k))
      (equal
       (p06a5-a real-type k)
       (p06a5-tangent
        real-type
        (p06a5-angle real-type n theta k)))))))

(defun p06a5-sum (real-type n)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix n)))
  (if (zp n)
      (p06a5-zero real-type)
    (p06a5-r-add
     real-type
     (p06a5-sum real-type (1- n))
     (p06a5-a real-type n))))

(defun p06a5-product (real-type n)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix n)))
  (if (zp n)
      (p06a5-one real-type)
    (p06a5-r-multiply
     real-type
     (p06a5-product real-type (1- n))
     (p06a5-a real-type n))))

(defun p06a5-solution (real-type n)
  (if (equal (mod n 4) 1)
      (p06a5-r-nat real-type n)
    (p06a5-r-negate
     real-type
     (p06a5-r-nat real-type n))))

(defun putnambench-putnam-2006-a5-statement
    (real-type n theta)
  (implies
   (and
    (p06a5-real-field-p real-type)
    (p06a5-pi-value-p real-type)
    (p06a5-trigonometric-laws-p real-type)
    (posp n)
    (oddp n)
    (p06a5-member-p real-type theta)
    (p06a5-irrational-p
     real-type
     (p06a5-r-divide
      real-type theta (p06a5-pi real-type)))
    (p06a5-tangent-family-p real-type n theta))
   (equal
    (p06a5-r-divide
     real-type
     (p06a5-sum real-type n)
     (p06a5-product real-type n))
    (p06a5-solution real-type n))))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q
