theory putnam_2006_b3 imports Complex_Main
"HOL-Analysis.Finite_Cartesian_Product"
begin

definition putnam_2006_b3_solution :: "nat \<Rightarrow> nat" where
  "putnam_2006_b3_solution \<equiv> (\<lambda>n. n choose 2 + 1)"
(* (\<lambda>n::nat. n choose 2 + 1) *)
theorem putnam_2006_b3:
  fixes IsLinearPartition :: "((real^2) set) \<Rightarrow> (((real^2) set) set) \<Rightarrow> bool"
    and L :: "((real^2) set) \<Rightarrow> nat"
    and n :: "nat"
  assumes IsLinearPartition_def : "\<forall> S AB. IsLinearPartition S AB \<longleftrightarrow>
    (card AB = 2 \<and> (\<exists> A \<in> AB. \<exists> B \<in> AB. 
      A \<noteq> B \<and> (A \<union> B = S) \<and> (A \<inter> B = {}) \<and>
        (\<exists> m b :: real.
          (\<forall> p \<in> A. p$2 > m*p$1 + b) \<and>
          (\<forall> p \<in> B. p$2 < m*p$1 + b))))"
    and hL : "\<forall> S. L S = card {AB. IsLinearPartition S AB}"
    and npos : "n > 0"
  shows "(GREATEST LSS::nat. (\<exists>S::(real^2) set. card S = n \<and> L S = LSS)) =
    putnam_2006_b3_solution n"
  sorry
  
end

title: putnam_2006_b3
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2006_b3:
  the maximum number of unordered bipartitions of an n-point planar set
  separated by a line is n choose 2 plus one. This file contains no proof.
*)

let binomial_output = open_out "/dev/null";;
let binomial_formatter = Format.formatter_of_out_channel binomial_output;;
let binomial_loaded =
  Toploop.use_file binomial_formatter "Library/binomial.ml";;
Format.pp_print_flush binomial_formatter ();;
close_out binomial_output;;
if not binomial_loaded then failwith "failed to load Library/binomial.ml";;

let statement =
  `let is_linear_partition =
     \(S:(real#real)->bool)
      (AB:((real#real)->bool)->bool).
       AB HAS_SIZE 2 /\
       ?A B:(real#real)->bool.
         A IN AB /\
         B IN AB /\
         ~(A = B) /\
         A UNION B = S /\
         A INTER B = {} /\
         ?m b:real.
           (!p:real#real.
              p IN A ==> m * FST p + b < SND p) /\
           (!p:real#real.
              p IN B ==> SND p < m * FST p + b) in
   let partition_count =
     \S:(real#real)->bool.
       CARD
         {AB:((real#real)->bool)->bool |
            is_linear_partition S AB} in
   let is_greatest =
     \(values:num->bool) (value:num).
       value IN values /\
       (!k:num. k IN values ==> k <= value) in
   !n:num.
     0 < n
     ==>
     is_greatest
       {k:num |
          ?S:(real#real)->bool.
            S HAS_SIZE n /\ partition_count S = k}
       (binom (n,2) + 1)`;;

title: putnam_2006_b3
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2006_b3:
;; the maximum number of unordered linear partitions of an n-point set in the
;; real plane is choose(n,2)+1. This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))

;; Standard ACL2 has no native completed real field.  The conservative
;; interfaces below present an arbitrary real closed ordered field, with every
;; field, order, closure, and real-closedness law explicit in the statement
;; predicate.  For each fixed n this is a finite first-order ordered-field
;; assertion, so completeness of the theory of real closed fields transfers it
;; bidirectionally between this presentation and the source's real field.
;;
;; A duplicate-free list represents the source finite point set extensionally.
;; A mask represents one subset and its complement.  Since n is positive,
;; requiring the first mask bit to be one selects exactly one representative
;; of each unordered partition.  Both orientations are tested against the
;; source's strict separator inequalities y > m*x+b and y < m*x+b.

(defstub putnam-2006-b3-real-p (x) t)
(defstub putnam-2006-b3-zero () t)
(defstub putnam-2006-b3-one () t)
(defstub putnam-2006-b3-add (x y) t)
(defstub putnam-2006-b3-mul (x y) t)
(defstub putnam-2006-b3-neg (x) t)
(defstub putnam-2006-b3-inv (x) t)
(defstub putnam-2006-b3-lt-op (x y) t)
(defstub putnam-2006-b3-square-root (x) t)
(defstub putnam-2006-b3-odd-root (coefficients) t)

(defun putnam-2006-b3-lt (x y)
  (if (putnam-2006-b3-lt-op x y) t nil))

(defun putnam-2006-b3-real-list-p (values)
  (if (consp values)
      (and
       (putnam-2006-b3-real-p (car values))
       (putnam-2006-b3-real-list-p (cdr values)))
    (equal values nil)))

;; Coefficients are stored in ascending degree order.
(defun putnam-2006-b3-polynomial-eval
    (coefficients x)
  (if (consp coefficients)
      (putnam-2006-b3-add
       (car coefficients)
       (putnam-2006-b3-mul
        x
        (putnam-2006-b3-polynomial-eval
         (cdr coefficients) x)))
    (putnam-2006-b3-zero)))

(defun putnam-2006-b3-odd-degree-polynomial-p
    (coefficients)
  (and
   (true-listp coefficients)
   (consp coefficients)
   (putnam-2006-b3-real-list-p coefficients)
   (evenp (len coefficients))
   (not
    (equal
     (car (last coefficients))
     (putnam-2006-b3-zero)))))

(defun-sk putnam-2006-b3-field-laws-p ()
  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (putnam-2006-b3-real-p x)
      (putnam-2006-b3-real-p y)
      (putnam-2006-b3-real-p z))
     (let ((xy-add (putnam-2006-b3-add x y))
           (yz-add (putnam-2006-b3-add y z))
           (xy-mul (putnam-2006-b3-mul x y))
           (yz-mul (putnam-2006-b3-mul y z))
           (neg-x (putnam-2006-b3-neg x))
           (inv-x (putnam-2006-b3-inv x)))
       (and
        (putnam-2006-b3-real-p xy-add)
        (putnam-2006-b3-real-p xy-mul)
        (putnam-2006-b3-real-p neg-x)
        (putnam-2006-b3-real-p inv-x)
        (equal
         (putnam-2006-b3-add xy-add z)
         (putnam-2006-b3-add x yz-add))
        (equal xy-add (putnam-2006-b3-add y x))
        (equal
         (putnam-2006-b3-add x (putnam-2006-b3-zero))
         x)
        (equal
         (putnam-2006-b3-add x neg-x)
         (putnam-2006-b3-zero))
        (equal
         (putnam-2006-b3-mul xy-mul z)
         (putnam-2006-b3-mul x yz-mul))
        (equal xy-mul (putnam-2006-b3-mul y x))
        (equal
         (putnam-2006-b3-mul x (putnam-2006-b3-one))
         x)
        (implies
         (equal x (putnam-2006-b3-zero))
         (equal inv-x (putnam-2006-b3-zero)))
        (implies
         (not (equal x (putnam-2006-b3-zero)))
         (equal
          (putnam-2006-b3-mul x inv-x)
          (putnam-2006-b3-one)))
        (equal
         (putnam-2006-b3-mul x yz-add)
         (putnam-2006-b3-add
          (putnam-2006-b3-mul x y)
          (putnam-2006-b3-mul x z))))))))

(defun-sk putnam-2006-b3-order-laws-p ()
  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (putnam-2006-b3-real-p x)
      (putnam-2006-b3-real-p y)
      (putnam-2006-b3-real-p z))
     (and
      (not (putnam-2006-b3-lt x x))
      (or
       (equal x y)
       (putnam-2006-b3-lt x y)
       (putnam-2006-b3-lt y x))
      (implies
       (and
        (putnam-2006-b3-lt x y)
        (putnam-2006-b3-lt y z))
       (putnam-2006-b3-lt x z))
      (implies
       (putnam-2006-b3-lt x y)
       (putnam-2006-b3-lt
        (putnam-2006-b3-add x z)
        (putnam-2006-b3-add y z)))
      (implies
       (and
        (putnam-2006-b3-lt (putnam-2006-b3-zero) x)
        (putnam-2006-b3-lt (putnam-2006-b3-zero) y))
       (putnam-2006-b3-lt
        (putnam-2006-b3-zero)
        (putnam-2006-b3-mul x y)))))))

(defun-sk putnam-2006-b3-square-root-laws-p ()
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (and
      (putnam-2006-b3-real-p x)
      (not
       (putnam-2006-b3-lt
        x
        (putnam-2006-b3-zero))))
     (let ((root (putnam-2006-b3-square-root x)))
       (and
        (putnam-2006-b3-real-p root)
        (equal
         (putnam-2006-b3-mul root root)
         x))))))

(defun-sk putnam-2006-b3-odd-root-laws-p ()
  (forall (coefficients)
    (implies
     (putnam-2006-b3-odd-degree-polynomial-p
      coefficients)
     (let ((root
            (putnam-2006-b3-odd-root coefficients)))
       (and
        (putnam-2006-b3-real-p root)
        (equal
         (putnam-2006-b3-polynomial-eval
          coefficients root)
         (putnam-2006-b3-zero)))))))

(defun putnam-2006-b3-real-closed-field-p ()
  (and
   (putnam-2006-b3-real-p (putnam-2006-b3-zero))
   (putnam-2006-b3-real-p (putnam-2006-b3-one))
   (not
    (equal
     (putnam-2006-b3-zero)
     (putnam-2006-b3-one)))
   (putnam-2006-b3-lt
    (putnam-2006-b3-zero)
    (putnam-2006-b3-one))
   (putnam-2006-b3-field-laws-p)
   (putnam-2006-b3-order-laws-p)
   (putnam-2006-b3-square-root-laws-p)
   (putnam-2006-b3-odd-root-laws-p)))

(defun putnam-2006-b3-point-p (point)
  (and
   (true-listp point)
   (equal (len point) 2)
   (putnam-2006-b3-real-p (nth 0 point))
   (putnam-2006-b3-real-p (nth 1 point))))

(defun putnam-2006-b3-point-list-p (points)
  (if (consp points)
      (and
       (putnam-2006-b3-point-p (car points))
       (putnam-2006-b3-point-list-p (cdr points)))
    (equal points nil)))

(defun putnam-2006-b3-point-finset-p (points n)
  (and
   (true-listp points)
   (putnam-2006-b3-point-list-p points)
   (no-duplicatesp-equal points)
   (equal (len points) n)))

(defun putnam-2006-b3-separated-by-line-p
    (points mask m b)
  (if (consp points)
      (let* ((point (car points))
             (x (nth 0 point))
             (y (nth 1 point))
             (line-height
              (putnam-2006-b3-add
               (putnam-2006-b3-mul m x)
               b)))
        (and
         (if (equal (mod mask 2) 1)
             (putnam-2006-b3-lt line-height y)
           (putnam-2006-b3-lt y line-height))
         (putnam-2006-b3-separated-by-line-p
          (cdr points)
          (floor mask 2)
          m
          b)))
    (equal points nil)))

(defun-sk putnam-2006-b3-separator-exists-p
    (points mask)
  (exists (m b)
    (and
     (putnam-2006-b3-real-p m)
     (putnam-2006-b3-real-p b)
     (putnam-2006-b3-separated-by-line-p
      points mask m b))))

(defun putnam-2006-b3-complement-mask (points mask)
  (- (- (expt 2 (len points)) 1)
     mask))

(defun putnam-2006-b3-linear-partition-p
    (points mask)
  (or
   (putnam-2006-b3-separator-exists-p
    points mask)
   (putnam-2006-b3-separator-exists-p
    points
    (putnam-2006-b3-complement-mask
     points mask))))

(defun putnam-2006-b3-linear-partition-count-through
    (points mask)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix mask)))
  (if (zp mask)
      0
    (+
     (if (and
          (equal (mod mask 2) 1)
          (putnam-2006-b3-linear-partition-p
           points mask))
         1
       0)
     (putnam-2006-b3-linear-partition-count-through
      points (- (nfix mask) 1)))))

(defun putnam-2006-b3-linear-partition-count (points)
  (putnam-2006-b3-linear-partition-count-through
   points
   (- (expt 2 (len points)) 1)))

(defun putnam-2006-b3-binomial-coefficient (n k)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix n)))
  (if (or (zp k)
          (zp n))
      (if (zp k) 1 0)
    (+
     (putnam-2006-b3-binomial-coefficient
      (- (nfix n) 1)
      k)
     (putnam-2006-b3-binomial-coefficient
      (- (nfix n) 1)
      (- (nfix k) 1)))))

(defun putnam-2006-b3-solution (n)
  (+ (putnam-2006-b3-binomial-coefficient n 2)
     1))

(defun-sk putnam-2006-b3-attaining-configuration-exists-p (n)
  (exists (witness)
    (and
     (putnam-2006-b3-point-finset-p witness n)
     (equal
      (putnam-2006-b3-linear-partition-count witness)
      (putnam-2006-b3-solution n)))))

;; Existence of an attaining configuration together with the universal upper
;; bound is exactly IsGreatest for the set of linear-partition counts.
(defun putnambench-putnam-2006-b3-statement (n points)
  (implies
   (and
    (putnam-2006-b3-real-closed-field-p)
    (natp n)
    (< 0 n))
   (and
    (putnam-2006-b3-attaining-configuration-exists-p n)
    (implies
     (putnam-2006-b3-point-finset-p points n)
     (<=
      (putnam-2006-b3-linear-partition-count points)
      (putnam-2006-b3-solution n))))))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

title: putnam_2006_b3
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2006_b3
-- (putnambench__agda__putnam_2006_b3): the maximum number of unordered
-- linear bipartitions of an n-point subset of the real plane is n choose 2
-- plus one. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module Putnam2006B3 where

open import Agda.Primitive using (Level; lsuc; _⊔_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; _*_)

infix 4 _!=_ _<=N_
infixr 3 _and_
infixr 2 _or_

data Bottom : Set where

Not :
  {a : Level} ->
  Set a ->
  Set a
Not A =
  A -> Bottom

_!=_ :
  {a : Level} {A : Set a} ->
  A ->
  A ->
  Set a
x != y =
  Not (x == y)

record _and_
  {a b : Level}
  (A : Set a)
  (B : Set b) :
  Set (a ⊔ b) where

  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data _or_
  {a b : Level}
  (A : Set a)
  (B : Set b) :
  Set (a ⊔ b) where

  left  : A -> A or B
  right : B -> A or B

record Iff
  {a b : Level}
  (A : Set a)
  (B : Set b) :
  Set (a ⊔ b) where

  constructor equivalence
  field
    forward  : A -> B
    backward : B -> A

record Exists
  {a p : Level}
  (A : Set a)
  (P : A -> Set p) :
  Set (a ⊔ p) where

  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

data _<=N_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set where
  zero<=N   : {n : Nat} -> zero <=N n
  suc<=sucN : {m n : Nat} -> m <=N n -> suc m <=N suc n

data Fin : Nat -> Set where
  fzero : {n : Nat} -> Fin (suc n)
  fsuc  : {n : Nat} -> Fin n -> Fin (suc n)

oneN : Nat
oneN =
  suc zero

twoN : Nat
twoN =
  suc oneN

Positive : Nat -> Set
Positive n =
  oneN <=N n

choose : Nat -> Nat -> Nat
choose n zero =
  oneN
choose zero (suc k) =
  zero
choose (suc n) (suc k) =
  choose n (suc k) + choose n k

record CompleteOrderedRealField (R : Set) : Set1 where
  field
    zeroR oneR : R
    add multiply : R -> R -> R
    negate inverse : R -> R
    lessOrEqual : R -> R -> Set
    fromNat : Nat -> R

    one-not-zero :
      oneR != zeroR

    add-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> add x y == add y x
    add-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      add (add x y) z == add x (add y z)
    add-zero :
      (x : R) -> add x zeroR == x
    add-inverse :
      (x : R) -> add x (negate x) == zeroR

    multiply-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> multiply x y == multiply y x
    multiply-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply (multiply x y) z ==
      multiply x (multiply y z)
    multiply-one :
      (x : R) -> multiply x oneR == x
    multiply-zero :
      (x : R) -> multiply x zeroR == zeroR
    distribute :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply x (add y z) ==
      add (multiply x y) (multiply x z)
    inverse-zero :
      inverse zeroR == zeroR
    multiply-inverse :
      (x : R) ->
      x != zeroR ->
      multiply x (inverse x) == oneR

    order-reflexive :
      (x : R) -> lessOrEqual x x
    order-transitive :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y z ->
      lessOrEqual x z
    order-antisymmetric :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y x ->
      x == y
    order-total :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y or lessOrEqual y x
    add-order :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual (add z x) (add z y)
    multiply-nonnegative :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR x ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR y ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR (multiply x y)
    zero-less-than-one :
      lessOrEqual zeroR oneR and zeroR != oneR

    fromNat-zero :
      fromNat zero == zeroR
    fromNat-successor :
      (n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (suc n) == add (fromNat n) oneR
    fromNat-addition :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m + n) == add (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-multiplication :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m * n) == multiply (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-injective :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat m == fromNat n ->
      m == n

    archimedean :
      (x : R) ->
      Exists Nat
        (\ n ->
          lessOrEqual x (fromNat n))
    least-upper-bound :
      (P : R -> Set) ->
      Exists R P ->
      Exists R
        (\ upper ->
          (x : R) ->
          P x ->
          lessOrEqual x upper) ->
      Exists R
        (\ supremum ->
          ((x : R) ->
            P x ->
            lessOrEqual x supremum)
          and
          ((upper : R) ->
            ((x : R) ->
              P x ->
              lessOrEqual x upper) ->
            lessOrEqual supremum upper))

open CompleteOrderedRealField

StrictLess :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
StrictLess reals x y =
  lessOrEqual reals x y and x != y

record Point (R : Set) : Set where
  constructor point
  field
    xCoordinate : R
    yCoordinate : R

open Point

PointEqual :
  {R : Set} ->
  Point R ->
  Point R ->
  Set
PointEqual p q =
  xCoordinate p == xCoordinate q
  and
  yCoordinate p == yCoordinate q

PointSet : Set -> Set1
PointSet R =
  Point R -> Set

SamePointSet :
  {R : Set} ->
  PointSet R ->
  PointSet R ->
  Set
SamePointSet {R} leftSet rightSet =
  (p : Point R) ->
  Iff (leftSet p) (rightSet p)

record SetFamily (R : Set) : Set1 where
  field
    contains :
      PointSet R ->
      Set
    contains-respects :
      (leftSet rightSet : PointSet R) ->
      SamePointSet leftSet rightSet ->
      Iff (contains leftSet) (contains rightSet)

open SetFamily

SameFamily :
  {R : Set} ->
  SetFamily R ->
  SetFamily R ->
  Set1
SameFamily {R} leftFamily rightFamily =
  (pointSet : PointSet R) ->
  Iff
    (contains leftFamily pointSet)
    (contains rightFamily pointSet)

record HasCardinality
  {a p e : Level}
  {A : Set a}
  (equivalent : A -> A -> Set e)
  (belongs : A -> Set p)
  (cardinality : Nat) :
  Set (a ⊔ p ⊔ e) where

  field
    enumerate :
      Fin cardinality ->
      A
    enumerated-belongs :
      (index : Fin cardinality) ->
      belongs (enumerate index)
    enumeration-complete :
      (item : A) ->
      belongs item ->
      Exists (Fin cardinality)
        (\ index ->
          equivalent item (enumerate index))
    enumeration-injective :
      (leftIndex rightIndex : Fin cardinality) ->
      equivalent
        (enumerate leftIndex)
        (enumerate rightIndex) ->
      leftIndex == rightIndex

PointSetCardinality :
  {R : Set} ->
  PointSet R ->
  Nat ->
  Set
PointSetCardinality pointSet cardinality =
  HasCardinality PointEqual pointSet cardinality

FamilyCardinality :
  {R : Set} ->
  SetFamily R ->
  Nat ->
  Set1
FamilyCardinality family cardinality =
  HasCardinality SamePointSet (contains family) cardinality

UnionIs :
  {R : Set} ->
  PointSet R ->
  PointSet R ->
  PointSet R ->
  Set
UnionIs {R} whole leftSet rightSet =
  (p : Point R) ->
  Iff
    (whole p)
    (leftSet p or rightSet p)

Disjoint :
  {R : Set} ->
  PointSet R ->
  PointSet R ->
  Set
Disjoint {R} leftSet rightSet =
  (p : Point R) ->
  Not (leftSet p and rightSet p)

LineSeparates :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  PointSet R ->
  PointSet R ->
  Set
LineSeparates {R} reals upperSet lowerSet =
  Exists R
    (\ slope ->
      Exists R
        (\ intercept ->
          ((p : Point R) ->
            upperSet p ->
            StrictLess reals
              (add reals
                (multiply reals slope (xCoordinate p))
                intercept)
              (yCoordinate p))
          and
          ((p : Point R) ->
            lowerSet p ->
            StrictLess reals
              (yCoordinate p)
              (add reals
                (multiply reals slope (xCoordinate p))
                intercept))))

IsLinearPartition :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  PointSet R ->
  SetFamily R ->
  Set1
IsLinearPartition {R} reals whole family =
  FamilyCardinality family twoN
  and
  Exists (PointSet R)
    (\ upperSet ->
      contains family upperSet
      and
      Exists (PointSet R)
        (\ lowerSet ->
          contains family lowerSet
          and
          Not (SamePointSet upperSet lowerSet)
          and
          UnionIs whole upperSet lowerSet
          and
          Disjoint upperSet lowerSet
          and
          LineSeparates reals upperSet lowerSet))

LinearPartitionCount :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  PointSet R ->
  Nat ->
  Set1
LinearPartitionCount {R} reals pointSet count =
  HasCardinality
    SameFamily
    (IsLinearPartition reals pointSet)
    count

putnam-2006-b3-solution : Nat -> Nat
putnam-2006-b3-solution n =
  choose n twoN + oneN

IsMaximumLinearPartitionCount :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Nat ->
  Nat ->
  Set1
IsMaximumLinearPartitionCount {R} reals n maximum =
  Exists (PointSet R)
    (\ pointSet ->
      PointSetCardinality pointSet n
      and
      LinearPartitionCount reals pointSet maximum)
  and
  ((pointSet : PointSet R) ->
    (count : Nat) ->
    PointSetCardinality pointSet n ->
    LinearPartitionCount reals pointSet count ->
    count <=N maximum)

putnam-2006-b3 : Set1
putnam-2006-b3 =
  (R : Set) ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) ->
  (n : Nat) ->
  Positive n ->
  IsMaximumLinearPartitionCount
    reals
    n
    (putnam-2006-b3-solution n)

content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2006_b3:
  the maximum number of unordered two-part partitions of an n-point planar
  set separated by a disjoint straight line is binomial n 2 + 1. This file
  contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open arithmeticTheory combinatoricsTheory pairTheory pred_setTheory realTheory;

val putnam_2006_b3 =
  ``!n : num.
      0 < n
      ==>
      let is_linear_partition =
        \(S : (real # real) set)
         (AB : ((real # real) set) set).
          CARD AB = 2 /\
          ?A B : (real # real) set.
            A IN AB /\
            B IN AB /\
            A <> B /\
            A UNION B = S /\
            DISJOINT A B /\
            ?m b : real.
              (!p : real # real.
                 p IN A ==> SND p > m * FST p + b) /\
              (!p : real # real.
                 p IN B ==> SND p < m * FST p + b)
      in
      let linear_partition_count =
        \S : (real # real) set.
          CARD
            {AB : ((real # real) set) set |
               is_linear_partition S AB}
      in
        (?S : (real # real) set.
           FINITE S /\
           CARD S = n /\
           linear_partition_count S = binomial n 2 + 1) /\
        (!S : (real # real) set.
           FINITE S /\
           CARD S = n
           ==>
           linear_partition_count S <= binomial n 2 + 1)``;

$(
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact
  putnam_2006_b3: the maximum number of unordered linear partitions of an
  n-point subset of the real plane is the binomial coefficient n choose 2
  plus one. This file contains no proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  P06B3Plane is the real plane represented by ordered pairs. For a subset S,
  P06B3LinearPartitions(S) consists of the two-element families {A,B} of
  subsets of S whose members are disjoint, cover S, and lie strictly on
  opposite sides of a nondegenerate affine line. This includes partitions
  with an empty part.

  The general equation a*x+b*y+c=0 includes vertical lines. On a finite set,
  it is equivalent to the source's graph-line encoding because a separating
  line can be perturbed without crossing any point. The final conjunction
  expands IsGreatest into attainment of the stated value and a universal
  upper bound. Every $a declaration is an unproved statement encoding; this
  database contains no $p proof declaration.
$)

$c P06B3Plane P06B3LinearPartitions $.

p06b3-plane-syntax $a class P06B3Plane $.
p06b3-linear-partitions-syntax $a class P06B3LinearPartitions $.

p06b3-plane-definition $a |- P06B3Plane = ( RR X. RR ) $.

${
  $d A B S T a b c p $.

  p06b3-linear-partitions-definition $a |- P06B3LinearPartitions =
    ( S e. ~P P06B3Plane |->
      {
        T e. ~P ( ~P S ) |
          (
            ( # ` T ) = 2
            /\
            E. A e. T
              E. B e. T
                (
                  A =/= B
                  /\
                  (
                    ( A u. B ) = S
                    /\
                    (
                      ( A i^i B ) = (/)
                      /\
                      E. a e. RR
                        E. b e. RR
                          E. c e. RR
                            (
                              (
                                a =/= 0
                                \/
                                b =/= 0
                              )
                              /\
                              (
                                A. p e. A
                                  0
                                  <
                                  (
                                    (
                                      ( a x. ( 1st ` p ) )
                                      +
                                      ( b x. ( 2nd ` p ) )
                                    )
                                    +
                                    c
                                  )
                                /\
                                A. p e. B
                                  (
                                    (
                                      ( a x. ( 1st ` p ) )
                                      +
                                      ( b x. ( 2nd ` p ) )
                                    )
                                    +
                                    c
                                  )
                                  <
                                  0
                              )
                            )
                    )
                  )
                )
          )
      }
    )
  $.
$}

${
  $d S n $.

  putnambench-putnam-2006-b3 $a |-
    A. n e. NN
      (
        E. S e. ~P P06B3Plane
          (
            ( # ` S ) = n
            /\
            (
              #
              `
              ( P06B3LinearPartitions ` S )
            )
            =
            ( ( n _C 2 ) + 1 )
          )
        /\
        A. S e. ~P P06B3Plane
          (
            ( # ` S ) = n
            ->
            (
              #
              `
              ( P06B3LinearPartitions ` S )
            )
            <_
            ( ( n _C 2 ) + 1 )
          )
      )
  $.
$}

environ

    FUNCT_2, RLVECT_1, PRE_TOPC, EUCLID, FINSEQ_1, FINSEQ_2, NEWTON;
  registrations XBOOLE_0, SUBSET_1, RELAT_1, FUNCT_1, RELSET_1, FUNCT_2,
    NUMBERS, XCMPLX_0, XREAL_0, XXREAL_0, NAT_1, ORDINAL1, CARD_1,
    FINSET_1, VALUED_0, STRUCT_0, PRE_TOPC, RLVECT_1, EUCLID, FINSEQ_1,
    FINSEQ_2, NEWTON, FRAENKEL;
  requirements REAL, NUMERALS, SUBSET, BOOLE, ARITHM;
  definitions TARSKI, XBOOLE_0;
  equalities STRUCT_0, RLVECT_1, EUCLID, FINSEQ_2;
  expansions TARSKI, XBOOLE_0;

begin

::$P-
theorem
  for n being Nat st 0 < n holds
    (ex S being finite Subset of TOP-REAL 2 st
      card S = n &
      card {AB where AB is Subset of bool S :
        card AB = 2 &
        ex A,B being Subset of S st
          A in AB & B in AB & A <> B &
          A \/ B = S & A /\ B = {} &
          ex m,b being Real st
            (for p being Element of REAL 2 st p in A holds
              p.2 > m * p.1 + b) &
            (for p being Element of REAL 2 st p in B holds
              p.2 < m * p.1 + b)}
        = (n choose 2) + 1) &
    (for S being finite Subset of TOP-REAL 2 st card S = n holds
      card {AB where AB is Subset of bool S :
        card AB = 2 &
        ex A,B being Subset of S st
          A in AB & B in AB & A <> B &
          A \/ B = S & A /\ B = {} &
          ex m,b being Real st
            (for p being Element of REAL 2 st p in A holds
              p.2 > m * p.1 + b) &
            (for p being Element of REAL 2 st p in B holds
              p.2 < m * p.1 + b)}
        c= (n choose 2) + 1)
proof
end;
::$P+

title: putnam_2006_b3
content:
% Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2006_b3:
% the maximum number of unordered linear partitions of an n-point set in the
% real plane is the binomial coefficient n choose 2 plus one. This file
% contains no proof.

putnam_2006_b3: THEORY
BEGIN
  point: TYPE = [# x_coord: real, y_coord: real #]

  IMPORTING finite_sets[point], finite_sets_of_sets[point]

  point_set: TYPE = finite_set[point]

  IMPORTING finite_sets[point_set], finite_sets_of_sets[point_set]

  linear_partition: TYPE = finite_set[point_set]
  linear_partition_family: TYPE = finite_set[linear_partition]

  all_subsets(S: point_set): linear_partition =
    powerset(S)

  is_linear_partition(
      S: point_set,
      AB: linear_partition): bool =
    card(AB) = 2
      AND EXISTS (A, B: point_set):
        AB(A)
          AND AB(B)
          AND A /= B
          AND
            (FORALL (P: point):
              S(P) IFF (A(P) OR B(P)))
          AND
            (FORALL (P: point):
              NOT (A(P) AND B(P)))
          AND
            (EXISTS (m, b: real):
              (FORALL (P: point):
                A(P) IMPLIES
                  y_coord(P) > m * x_coord(P) + b)
                AND
              (FORALL (P: point):
                B(P) IMPLIES
                  y_coord(P) < m * x_coord(P) + b))

  linear_partitions(S: point_set): linear_partition_family =
    intersection(
      powerset(all_subsets(S)),
      {AB: linear_partition | is_linear_partition(S, AB)})

  binomial_coefficient(n, k: nat): RECURSIVE nat =
    IF k = 0 THEN
      1
    ELSIF n = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      binomial_coefficient(n - 1, k - 1)
        + binomial_coefficient(n - 1, k)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE n

  putnam_2006_b3_solution(n: nat): nat =
    binomial_coefficient(n, 2) + 1

  putnam_2006_b3: bool =
    FORALL (n: nat):
      n > 0 IMPLIES
        (EXISTS (S: point_set):
          card(S) = n
            AND card(linear_partitions(S))
              = putnam_2006_b3_solution(n))
        AND
          (FORALL (S: point_set):
            card(S) = n IMPLIES
              card(linear_partitions(S))
                <= putnam_2006_b3_solution(n))
END putnam_2006_b3

title: putnam_2006_b4
content:
import Mathlib

noncomputable abbrev putnam_2006_b4_solution : ℕ → ℕ := sorry
-- fun k ↦ 2 ^ k
/--
Let $Z$ denote the set of points in $\mathbb{R}^n$ whose coordinates are $0$ or $1$. (Thus $Z$ has $2^n$ elements, which are the vertices of a unit hypercube in $\mathbb{R}^n$.) Given a vector subspace $V$ of $\mathbb{R}^n$, let $Z(V)$ denote the number of members of $Z$ that lie in $V$. Let $k$ be given, $0 \leq k \leq n$. Find the maximum, over all vector subspaces $V \subseteq \mathbb{R}^n$ of dimension $k$, of the number of points in $V \cap Z$.
-/
theorem putnam_2006_b4
    (n k : ℕ)
    (npos : n > 0)
    (hk : k ≤ n)
    (Z : Set (Fin n → ℝ))
    (hZ : Z = {P : Fin n → ℝ | ∀ j : Fin n, P j = 0 ∨ P j = 1}) :
    IsGreatest
      {y | ∃ V : Subspace ℝ (Fin n → ℝ), Module.rank ℝ V = k ∧ (Z ∩ V).ncard = y}
      (putnam_2006_b4_solution k) :=
  sorry

title: putnam_2006_b4
content:
(* Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2006_b4:
   the maximum number of Boolean-cube vertices lying in a k-dimensional real
   linear subspace of R^n is 2^k. This file contains no proof. *)

From Stdlib Require Import Reals Lists.List Vectors.Fin Arith.PeanoNat.

Open Scope R_scope.

Definition putnam_2006_b4_vector (n : nat) : Type :=
  Fin.t n -> RbaseSymbolsImpl.R.

Definition putnam_2006_b4_vector_eq {n : nat}
    (u v : putnam_2006_b4_vector n) : Prop :=
  forall i : Fin.t n, u i = v i.

Definition putnam_2006_b4_zero {n : nat} :
    putnam_2006_b4_vector n :=
  fun _ => 0.

Definition putnam_2006_b4_add {n : nat}
    (u v : putnam_2006_b4_vector n) :
    putnam_2006_b4_vector n :=
  fun i => u i + v i.

Definition putnam_2006_b4_scale {n : nat}
    (a : RbaseSymbolsImpl.R) (v : putnam_2006_b4_vector n) :
    putnam_2006_b4_vector n :=
  fun i => a * v i.

Fixpoint putnam_2006_b4_linear_combination {n : nat}
    (coefficients : list RbaseSymbolsImpl.R)
    (vectors : list (putnam_2006_b4_vector n)) :
    putnam_2006_b4_vector n :=
  match coefficients, vectors with
  | a :: coefficients', v :: vectors' =>
      putnam_2006_b4_add
        (putnam_2006_b4_scale a v)
        (putnam_2006_b4_linear_combination coefficients' vectors')
  | _, _ => putnam_2006_b4_zero
  end.

Definition putnam_2006_b4_is_subspace {n : nat}
    (V : putnam_2006_b4_vector n -> Prop) : Prop :=
  (forall u v,
    putnam_2006_b4_vector_eq u v ->
    V u ->
    V v) /\
  V putnam_2006_b4_zero /\
  (forall u v,
    V u ->
    V v ->
    V (putnam_2006_b4_add u v)) /\
  (forall (a : RbaseSymbolsImpl.R) v,
    V v ->
    V (putnam_2006_b4_scale a v)).

Definition putnam_2006_b4_linearly_independent {n : nat}
    (vectors : list (putnam_2006_b4_vector n)) : Prop :=
  forall coefficients : list RbaseSymbolsImpl.R,
    length coefficients = length vectors ->
    putnam_2006_b4_vector_eq
      (putnam_2006_b4_linear_combination coefficients vectors)
      putnam_2006_b4_zero ->
    Forall (fun coefficient => coefficient = 0) coefficients.

Definition putnam_2006_b4_spans {n : nat}
    (V : putnam_2006_b4_vector n -> Prop)
    (vectors : list (putnam_2006_b4_vector n)) : Prop :=
  forall v : putnam_2006_b4_vector n,
    V v ->
    exists coefficients : list RbaseSymbolsImpl.R,
      length coefficients = length vectors /\
      putnam_2006_b4_vector_eq
        (putnam_2006_b4_linear_combination coefficients vectors)
        v.

Definition putnam_2006_b4_has_dimension {n : nat}
    (V : putnam_2006_b4_vector n -> Prop)
    (k : nat) : Prop :=
  putnam_2006_b4_is_subspace V /\
  exists basis : list (putnam_2006_b4_vector n),
    length basis = k /\
    (forall v, In v basis -> V v) /\
    putnam_2006_b4_linearly_independent basis /\
    putnam_2006_b4_spans V basis.

Definition putnam_2006_b4_boolean_vertex {n : nat}
    (v : putnam_2006_b4_vector n) : Prop :=
  forall i : Fin.t n, v i = 0 \/ v i = 1.

Definition putnam_2006_b4_has_cardinality {n : nat}
    (members : putnam_2006_b4_vector n -> Prop)
    (cardinality : nat) : Prop :=
  exists enumeration :
      Fin.t cardinality -> putnam_2006_b4_vector n,
    (forall i j,
      putnam_2006_b4_vector_eq (enumeration i) (enumeration j) ->
      i = j) /\
    (forall v,
      members v <->
      exists i, putnam_2006_b4_vector_eq (enumeration i) v).

Definition putnam_2006_b4_intersection_counts
    (n k : nat) (count : nat) : Prop :=
  exists V : putnam_2006_b4_vector n -> Prop,
    putnam_2006_b4_has_dimension V k /\
    putnam_2006_b4_has_cardinality
      (fun v => putnam_2006_b4_boolean_vertex v /\ V v)
      count.

Definition putnam_2006_b4_is_greatest
    (values : nat -> Prop) (maximum : nat) : Prop :=
  values maximum /\
  forall value : nat, values value -> (value <= maximum)%nat.

Definition putnam_2006_b4_solution (k : nat) : nat :=
  Nat.pow 2 k.

Theorem putnam_2006_b4
    (n k : nat)
    (npos : (0 < n)%nat)
    (hk : (k <= n)%nat) :
  putnam_2006_b4_is_greatest
    (putnam_2006_b4_intersection_counts n k)
    (putnam_2006_b4_solution k).
Admitted.

definition putnam_2006_b4_solution :: "nat \<Rightarrow> nat" where "putnam_2006_b4_solution \<equiv> undefined"

theorem putnam_2006_b4:
  fixes n :: nat
  and k :: nat
  and Z :: "(real^'n) set"

  assumes npos: "n > 0"
  and pncard: "CARD('n) = n"

  shows "max = putnam_2006_b4_solution k"

title: putnam_2006_b4
putnam_2006_b4
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2006_b4:
;; the maximum number of Boolean vertices in a k-dimensional real linear
;; subspace of R^n is 2^k. This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

;; For a finite set S of Boolean vectors, containment in some k-dimensional
;; real subspace is equivalent (when k <= n) to real row rank at most k.
;; Because the entries are rational, rational row rank equals real row rank:
;; a nonzero rational minor witnesses either rank, while Gaussian elimination
;; over Q supplies all dependencies when the rank is smaller. Thus the
;; universal upper bound below is bidirectionally equivalent to the upper
;; bound over all real subspaces, without replacing R by Q.
;;
;; The elimination routine below is a definition of rational row rank: each
;; pivot step removes one nonzero row after invertible rational row
;; operations, and skipped columns do not change the row span. The attaining
;; point set remains existential rather than being replaced by the canonical
;; coordinate-cube witness.

(defun putnam-2006-b4-bit-p (value)
  (or (equal value 0)
      (equal value 1)))

(defun putnam-2006-b4-boolean-vector-p (vector width)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix width)))
  (if (zp width)
      (equal vector nil)
    (and (consp vector)
         (putnam-2006-b4-bit-p (car vector))
         (putnam-2006-b4-boolean-vector-p
          (cdr vector)
          (- width 1)))))

(defun putnam-2006-b4-boolean-vectors-p (vectors width)
  (if (consp vectors)
      (and (putnam-2006-b4-boolean-vector-p
            (car vectors)
            width)
           (putnam-2006-b4-boolean-vectors-p
            (cdr vectors)
            width))
    (equal vectors nil)))

(defun putnam-2006-b4-first-pivot-row (rows column)
  (if (consp rows)
      (if (equal (nth column (car rows)) 0)
          (putnam-2006-b4-first-pivot-row
           (cdr rows)
           column)
        (car rows))
    nil))

(defun putnam-2006-b4-remove-first-row (row rows)
  (if (consp rows)
      (if (equal row (car rows))
          (cdr rows)
        (cons (car rows)
              (putnam-2006-b4-remove-first-row
               row
               (cdr rows))))
    nil))

(defun putnam-2006-b4-eliminate-vector
    (row pivot factor)
  (if (and (consp row)
           (consp pivot))
      (cons (- (car row)
               (* factor (car pivot)))
            (putnam-2006-b4-eliminate-vector
             (cdr row)
             (cdr pivot)
             factor))
    nil))

(defun putnam-2006-b4-eliminate-rows
    (rows pivot column pivot-entry)
  (if (consp rows)
      (cons
       (putnam-2006-b4-eliminate-vector
        (car rows)
        pivot
        (/ (nth column (car rows))
           pivot-entry))
       (putnam-2006-b4-eliminate-rows
        (cdr rows)
        pivot
        column
        pivot-entry))
    nil))

(defun putnam-2006-b4-row-rank-aux
    (rows column columns-left)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix columns-left)))
  (if (or (zp columns-left)
          (endp rows))
      0
    (let ((pivot
           (putnam-2006-b4-first-pivot-row
            rows
            column)))
      (if (not pivot)
          (putnam-2006-b4-row-rank-aux
           rows
           (+ column 1)
           (- columns-left 1))
        (+ 1
           (putnam-2006-b4-row-rank-aux
            (putnam-2006-b4-eliminate-rows
             (putnam-2006-b4-remove-first-row
              pivot
              rows)
             pivot
             column
             (nth column pivot))
            (+ column 1)
            (- columns-left 1)))))))

(defun putnam-2006-b4-row-rank (rows width)
  (putnam-2006-b4-row-rank-aux rows 0 width))

(defun putnam-2006-b4-upper-bound-p
    (n k points)
  (implies
   (and
    (true-listp points)
    (no-duplicatesp-equal points)
    (putnam-2006-b4-boolean-vectors-p points n)
    (<= (putnam-2006-b4-row-rank points n) k))
   (<= (len points)
       (expt 2 k))))

(defun-sk putnam-2006-b4-upper-bound-all-p (n k)
  (forall
   (points)
   (putnam-2006-b4-upper-bound-p n k points)))

content:
-- Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2006_b4
-- (putnambench__agda__putnam_2006_b4): the maximum number of Boolean-cube
-- vertices in a k-dimensional real linear subspace of R^n is 2^k. This file
-- contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module Putnam2006B4 where

open import Agda.Primitive using (Level; _⊔_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _*_)

infix 4 _!=_ _<=N_
infixr 3 _and_
infixr 2 _or_

data Bottom : Set where

Not :
  {a : Level} ->
  Set a ->
  Set a
Not A =
  A -> Bottom

_!=_ :
  {a : Level} ->
  {A : Set a} ->
  A ->
  A ->
  Set a
x != y =
  Not (x == y)

record _and_
  {a b : Level}
  (A : Set a)
  (B : Set b) :
  Set (a ⊔ b) where

  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data _or_
  {a b : Level}
  (A : Set a)
  (B : Set b) :
  Set (a ⊔ b) where

  left  : A -> A or B
  right : B -> A or B

record Exists
  {a p : Level}
  (A : Set a)
  (P : A -> Set p) :
  Set (a ⊔ p) where

  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

data _<=N_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set where
  zero<=N   : {n : Nat} -> zero <=N n
  suc<=sucN : {m n : Nat} -> m <=N n -> suc m <=N suc n

Positive : Nat -> Set
Positive n =
  suc zero <=N n

data Fin : Nat -> Set where
  fzero : {n : Nat} -> Fin (suc n)
  fsuc  : {n : Nat} -> Fin n -> Fin (suc n)

Predicate : Set -> Set1
Predicate A =
  A -> Set

record HasCardinality
  {a r p : Level}
  {A : Set a}
  (equivalent : A -> A -> Set r)
  (member : A -> Set p)
  (cardinality : Nat) :
  Set (a ⊔ r ⊔ p) where

  field
    enumerate :
      Fin cardinality ->
      A

    enumerated-member :
      (index : Fin cardinality) ->
      member (enumerate index)

    enumeration-complete :
      (item : A) ->
      member item ->
      Exists (Fin cardinality)
        (\ index ->
          equivalent item (enumerate index))

    enumeration-injective :
      (leftIndex rightIndex : Fin cardinality) ->
      equivalent
        (enumerate leftIndex)
        (enumerate rightIndex) ->
      leftIndex == rightIndex

record CompleteOrderedRealField (R : Set) : Set1 where
  field
    zeroR oneR : R
    add multiply : R -> R -> R
    negate inverse : R -> R
    lessOrEqual : R -> R -> Set
    fromNat : Nat -> R

    one-not-zero :
      oneR != zeroR

    add-commutative :
      (x y : R) ->
      add x y == add y x
    add-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      add (add x y) z == add x (add y z)
    add-zero :
      (x : R) ->
      add x zeroR == x
    add-inverse :
      (x : R) ->
      add x (negate x) == zeroR

    multiply-commutative :
      (x y : R) ->
      multiply x y == multiply y x
    multiply-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply (multiply x y) z ==
      multiply x (multiply y z)
    multiply-one :
      (x : R) ->
      multiply x oneR == x
    multiply-zero :
      (x : R) ->
      multiply x zeroR == zeroR
    distribute :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply x (add y z) ==
      add (multiply x y) (multiply x z)
    inverse-zero :
      inverse zeroR == zeroR
    multiply-inverse :
      (x : R) ->
      x != zeroR ->
      multiply x (inverse x) == oneR

    order-reflexive :
      (x : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x x
    order-transitive :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y z ->
      lessOrEqual x z
    order-antisymmetric :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y x ->
      x == y
    order-total :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y or lessOrEqual y x
    add-order :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual (add z x) (add z y)
    multiply-nonnegative :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR x ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR y ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR (multiply x y)
    zero-less-than-one :
      lessOrEqual zeroR oneR and zeroR != oneR

    fromNat-zero :
      fromNat zero == zeroR
    fromNat-successor :
      (n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (suc n) == add (fromNat n) oneR
    fromNat-multiplication :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m * n) ==
      multiply (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-injective :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat m == fromNat n ->
      m == n

    archimedean :
      (x : R) ->
      Exists Nat
        (\ n ->
          lessOrEqual x (fromNat n))

    least-upper-bound :
      (P : R -> Set) ->
      Exists R P ->
      Exists R
        (\ upper ->
          (x : R) ->
          P x ->
          lessOrEqual x upper) ->
      Exists R
        (\ supremum ->
          ((x : R) ->
            P x ->
            lessOrEqual x supremum)
          and
          ((upper : R) ->
            ((x : R) ->
              P x ->
              lessOrEqual x upper) ->
            lessOrEqual supremum upper))

open CompleteOrderedRealField

Vector : Set -> Nat -> Set
Vector R n =
  Fin n -> R

VectorEqual :
  {R : Set} ->
  {n : Nat} ->
  Vector R n ->
  Vector R n ->
  Set
VectorEqual {n = n} leftVector rightVector =
  (coordinate : Fin n) ->
  leftVector coordinate == rightVector coordinate

zeroVector :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (n : Nat) ->
  Vector R n
zeroVector reals n coordinate =
  zeroR reals

addVector :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  {n : Nat} ->
  Vector R n ->
  Vector R n ->
  Vector R n
addVector reals leftVector rightVector coordinate =
  add reals
    (leftVector coordinate)
    (rightVector coordinate)

scaleVector :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  {n : Nat} ->
  R ->
  Vector R n ->
  Vector R n
scaleVector reals scalar vector coordinate =
  multiply reals scalar (vector coordinate)

record Subspace
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R)
  (n : Nat) :
  Set1 where

  field
    member :
      Predicate (Vector R n)

    zero-member :
      member (zeroVector reals n)

    add-member :
      (leftVector rightVector : Vector R n) ->
      member leftVector ->
      member rightVector ->
      member (addVector reals leftVector rightVector)

    scale-member :
      (scalar : R) ->
      (vector : Vector R n) ->
      member vector ->
      member (scaleVector reals scalar vector)

open Subspace

sumFin :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (n : Nat) ->
  (Fin n -> R) ->
  R
sumFin reals zero terms =
  zeroR reals
sumFin reals (suc n) terms =
  add reals
    (terms fzero)
    (sumFin reals n
      (\ index ->
        terms (fsuc index)))

linearCombination :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  {n k : Nat} ->
  (Fin k -> Vector R n) ->
  (Fin k -> R) ->
  Vector R n
linearCombination reals {k = k} basis coefficients coordinate =
  sumFin reals k
    (\ index ->
      multiply reals
        (coefficients index)
        (basis index coordinate))

LinearIndependent :
  {R : Set} ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) ->
  {n k : Nat} ->
  (Fin k -> Vector R n) ->
  Set
LinearIndependent reals {n = n} basis =
  (coefficients : Fin _ -> _) ->
  ((coordinate : Fin n) ->
    linearCombination reals basis coefficients coordinate ==
    zeroR reals) ->
  (index : Fin _) ->
  coefficients index == zeroR reals

Spans :
  {R : Set} ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) ->
  {n k : Nat} ->
  Subspace reals n ->
  (Fin k -> Vector R n) ->
  Set
Spans reals {n = n} subspace basis =
  (vector : Vector _ n) ->
  member subspace vector ->
  Exists (Fin _ -> _)
    (\ coefficients ->
      (coordinate : Fin n) ->
      linearCombination reals basis coefficients coordinate ==
      vector coordinate)

HasDimension :
  {R : Set} ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) ->
  {n : Nat} ->
  Subspace reals n ->
  Nat ->
  Set
HasDimension reals subspace k =
  Exists (Fin k -> Vector _ _)
    (\ basis ->
      ((index : Fin k) ->
        member subspace (basis index))
      and
      LinearIndependent reals basis
      and
      Spans reals subspace basis)

BooleanCube :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (n : Nat) ->
  Predicate (Vector R n)
BooleanCube reals n vector =
  (coordinate : Fin n) ->
  vector coordinate == zeroR reals
  or
  vector coordinate == oneR reals

CubeIntersection :
  {R : Set} ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) ->
  {n : Nat} ->
  Subspace reals n ->
  Predicate (Vector R n)
CubeIntersection reals {n} subspace vector =
  BooleanCube reals n vector
  and
  member subspace vector

oneN : Nat
oneN =
  suc zero

twoN : Nat
twoN =
  suc oneN

powerOfTwo : Nat -> Nat
powerOfTwo zero =
  oneN
powerOfTwo (suc exponent) =
  twoN * powerOfTwo exponent

module Putnam2006B4Statement
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) where

  IntersectionHasCardinality :
    {n : Nat} ->
    Subspace reals n ->
    Nat ->
    Set
  IntersectionHasCardinality {n} subspace cardinality =
    HasCardinality
      (VectorEqual {R = R} {n = n})
      (CubeIntersection reals subspace)
      cardinality

  AttainsMaximum :
    (n k : Nat) ->
    Set1
  AttainsMaximum n k =
    Exists (Subspace reals n)
      (\ subspace ->
        HasDimension reals subspace k
        and
        IntersectionHasCardinality
          subspace
          (powerOfTwo k))

  IsUpperBound :
    (n k : Nat) ->
    Set1
  IsUpperBound n k =
    (subspace : Subspace reals n) ->
    HasDimension reals subspace k ->
    (cardinality : Nat) ->
    IntersectionHasCardinality subspace cardinality ->
    cardinality <=N powerOfTwo k

  proposition : Set1
  proposition =
    (n k : Nat) ->
    Positive n ->
    k <=N n ->
    AttainsMaximum n k
    and
    IsUpperBound n k

putnam-2006-b4 : Set1
putnam-2006-b4 =
  (R : Set) ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) ->
  Putnam2006B4Statement.proposition reals

content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2006_b4:
  a k-dimensional real vector subspace contains at most 2^k vertices of the
  n-dimensional unit hypercube, and this bound is attained. This file contains
  no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open arithmeticTheory listTheory pred_setTheory fcpTheory realTheory;

val putnam_2006_b4 =
  ``!n k : num.
      dimindex (:'N) = n /\
      0 < n /\
      k <= n
      ==>
      let vzero = (FCP i. (0 : real)) : real['N]
      in
      let vadd =
        \(x : real['N]) (y : real['N]).
          FCP i. x ' i + y ' i
      in
      let smul =
        \(c : real) (x : real['N]).
          FCP i. c * x ' i
      in
      let lincomb =
        \(m : num) (coeff : num -> real) (vec : num -> real['N]).
          FOLDL
            (\acc i. vadd acc (smul (coeff i) (vec i)))
            vzero
            (GENLIST (\i. i) m)
      in
      let independent =
        \basis : real['N] list.
          !coeff : num -> real.
            lincomb (LENGTH basis) coeff (\i. EL i basis) = vzero
            ==>
            !i : num. i < LENGTH basis ==> coeff i = 0
      in
      let is_subspace =
        \V : real['N] set.
          vzero IN V /\
          (!x y : real['N].
             x IN V /\ y IN V ==> vadd x y IN V) /\
          (!c : real.
             !x : real['N].
               x IN V ==> smul c x IN V)
      in
      let has_dimension =
        \V : real['N] set.
        \d : num.
          ?basis : real['N] list.
            LENGTH basis = d /\
            ALL_DISTINCT basis /\
            (!i : num. i < d ==> EL i basis IN V) /\
            independent basis /\
            (!x : real['N].
               x IN V
               ==>
               ?coeff : num -> real.
                 lincomb d coeff (\i. EL i basis) = x)
      in
      let Z =
        {P : real['N] |
           !i : num.
             i < n ==> P ' i = 0 \/ P ' i = 1}
      in
        (?V : real['N] set.
           is_subspace V /\
           has_dimension V k /\
           CARD (Z INTER V) = 2 EXP k) /\
        (!V : real['N] set.
           is_subspace V /\
           has_dimension V k
           ==>
           CARD (Z INTER V) <= 2 EXP k)``;

title: putnam_2006_b4
content:
% Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2006_b4:
% the maximum number of vertices of the Boolean n-cube contained in a
% k-dimensional real linear subspace is 2^k. This file contains no proof.

putnam_2006_b4[n: posnat]: THEORY
BEGIN
  coordinate: TYPE = below(n)
  vector: TYPE = [coordinate -> real]
  vector_set: TYPE = [vector -> bool]
  basis_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> vector]
  coefficient_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> real]

  zero_vector: vector =
    LAMBDA (j: coordinate): 0

  vector_add(u, v: vector): vector =
    LAMBDA (j: coordinate): u(j) + v(j)

  scalar_multiply(a: real, v: vector): vector =
    LAMBDA (j: coordinate): a * v(j)

  is_subspace(V: vector_set): bool =
    V(zero_vector)
      AND
        (FORALL (u, v: vector):
          V(u) AND V(v) IMPLIES V(vector_add(u, v)))
      AND
        (FORALL (a: real), (v: vector):
          V(v) IMPLIES V(scalar_multiply(a, v)))

  linear_combination(
      B: basis_sequence,
      a: coefficient_sequence,
      count: nat): RECURSIVE vector =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      zero_vector
    ELSE
      vector_add(
        linear_combination(B, a, count - 1),
        scalar_multiply(a(count - 1), B(count - 1)))
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  linearly_independent_through(
      B: basis_sequence,
      count: nat): bool =
    FORALL (a: coefficient_sequence):
      linear_combination(B, a, count) = zero_vector
        IMPLIES
          (FORALL (index: nat):
            index < count IMPLIES a(index) = 0)

  spans_through(
      B: basis_sequence,
      count: nat,
      V: vector_set): bool =
    FORALL (v: vector):
      V(v) IFF
        EXISTS (a: coefficient_sequence):
          v = linear_combination(B, a, count)

  has_dimension(V: vector_set, count: nat): bool =
    EXISTS (B: basis_sequence):
      linearly_independent_through(B, count)
        AND spans_through(B, count, V)

  cube_vertex(code: nat): vector =
    LAMBDA (j: coordinate):
      IF mod(ndiv(code, 2 ^ j), 2) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE 1 ENDIF

  cube_intersection_count(
      V: vector_set,
      limit: nat): RECURSIVE nat =
    IF limit = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      cube_intersection_count(V, limit - 1)
        + IF V(cube_vertex(limit - 1)) THEN 1 ELSE 0 ENDIF
    ENDIF
  MEASURE limit

  putnam_2006_b4: bool =
    FORALL (k: nat):
      k <= n IMPLIES
        (EXISTS (V: vector_set):
          is_subspace(V)
            AND has_dimension(V, k)
            AND cube_intersection_count(V, 2 ^ n) = 2 ^ k)
        AND
          (FORALL (V: vector_set):
            is_subspace(V)
              AND has_dimension(V, k)
            IMPLIES cube_intersection_count(V, 2 ^ n) <= 2 ^ k)
END putnam_2006_b4

(* 1 / 16 *)
theorem putnam_2006_b5:
  fixes I :: "(real \<Rightarrow> real) \<Rightarrow> real"
  and J :: "(real \<Rightarrow> real) \<Rightarrow> real"
  defines "I \<equiv> \<lambda> f. set_lebesgue_integral lebesgue {0..1} (\<lambda> x. x ^ 2 * (f x))"
  and "J \<equiv> \<lambda> f. set_lebesgue_integral lebesgue {0..1} (\<lambda> x. x * (f x) ^ 2)"
  shows "(GREATEST y. \<exists> f. continuous_on {0..1} f \<and> I f - J f = y) = putnam_2006_b5_solution"
  sorry

end

title: putnam_2006_b5
putnam_2006_b5
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2006_b5:
;; the maximum of integral_0^1 x^2*f(x) dx minus integral_0^1 x*f(x)^2 dx
;; over continuous real functions is 1/16. This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))

;; The context presents a Dedekind-complete ordered field, hence the real
;; field up to ordered-field isomorphism. APPLY$ objects represent sets and
;; arbitrary real functions, while DEFUN-SK keeps the maximizing function,
;; integral values, and universal function quantifier internal. For continuous
;; functions on [0,1], the unbounded uniform Riemann-sum limits below equal the
;; source interval integrals, so no finite quadrature or rational restriction
;; is introduced.

(defun p06b5-member-p (carrier x)
  (if (apply$ carrier (list x)) t nil))

(defun p06b5-unary-value (operation x)
  (apply$ operation (list x)))

(defun p06b5-binary-value (operation x y)
  (apply$ operation (list x y)))

(defun-sk p06b5-valid-set-p (carrier set)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (apply$ set (list x))
     (p06b5-member-p carrier x))))

(defun-sk p06b5-real-function-p (carrier function)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (p06b5-member-p carrier x)
     (p06b5-member-p
      carrier
      (p06b5-unary-value function x)))))

(defun-sk p06b5-field-laws-p
    (carrier add multiply negate inverse zero one)
  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (p06b5-member-p carrier x)
      (p06b5-member-p carrier y)
      (p06b5-member-p carrier z))
     (and
      (p06b5-member-p
       carrier (p06b5-binary-value add x y))
      (p06b5-member-p
       carrier (p06b5-binary-value multiply x y))
      (p06b5-member-p
       carrier (p06b5-unary-value negate x))
      (p06b5-member-p
       carrier (p06b5-unary-value inverse x))
      (equal
       (p06b5-binary-value
        add (p06b5-binary-value add x y) z)
       (p06b5-binary-value
        add x (p06b5-binary-value add y z)))
      (equal
       (p06b5-binary-value add x y)
       (p06b5-binary-value add y x))
      (equal (p06b5-binary-value add x zero) x)
      (equal
       (p06b5-binary-value
        add x (p06b5-unary-value negate x))
       zero)
      (equal
       (p06b5-binary-value
        multiply
        (p06b5-binary-value multiply x y)
        z)
       (p06b5-binary-value
        multiply
        x
        (p06b5-binary-value multiply y z)))
      (equal
       (p06b5-binary-value multiply x y)
       (p06b5-binary-value multiply y x))
      (equal
       (p06b5-binary-value multiply x one)
       x)
      (implies
       (equal x zero)
       (equal (p06b5-unary-value inverse x) zero))
      (implies
       (not (equal x zero))
       (equal
        (p06b5-binary-value
         multiply x (p06b5-unary-value inverse x))
        one))
      (equal
       (p06b5-binary-value
        multiply x (p06b5-binary-value add y z))
       (p06b5-binary-value
        add
        (p06b5-binary-value multiply x y)
        (p06b5-binary-value multiply x z)))))))

(defun-sk p06b5-order-laws-p
    (carrier add multiply zero less)
  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (p06b5-member-p carrier x)
      (p06b5-member-p carrier y)
      (p06b5-member-p carrier z))
     (and
      (not (p06b5-binary-value less x x))
      (or
       (equal x y)
       (p06b5-binary-value less x y)
       (p06b5-binary-value less y x))
      (implies
       (and
        (p06b5-binary-value less x y)
        (p06b5-binary-value less y z))
       (p06b5-binary-value less x z))
      (implies
       (p06b5-binary-value less x y)
       (p06b5-binary-value
        less
        (p06b5-binary-value add x z)
        (p06b5-binary-value add y z)))
      (implies
       (and
        (p06b5-binary-value less zero x)
        (p06b5-binary-value less zero y))
       (p06b5-binary-value
        less
        zero
        (p06b5-binary-value multiply x y)))))))

(defun-sk p06b5-set-nonempty-p (carrier set)
  (exists (x)
    (and
     (p06b5-member-p carrier x)
     (apply$ set (list x)))))

(defun-sk p06b5-upper-bound-p
    (carrier less set bound)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (and
      (p06b5-member-p carrier x)
      (apply$ set (list x)))
     (not
      (p06b5-binary-value less bound x)))))

(defun-sk p06b5-bounded-above-p
    (carrier less set)
  (exists (bound)
    (and
     (p06b5-member-p carrier bound)
     (p06b5-upper-bound-p
      carrier less set bound))))

(defun-sk p06b5-least-upper-bound-p
    (carrier less set supremum)
  (forall (bound)
    (implies
     (and
      (p06b5-member-p carrier bound)
      (p06b5-upper-bound-p
       carrier less set bound))
     (not
      (p06b5-binary-value
       less bound supremum)))))

(defun p06b5-supremum-p
    (carrier less set supremum)
  (and
   (p06b5-member-p carrier supremum)
   (p06b5-upper-bound-p
    carrier less set supremum)
   (p06b5-least-upper-bound-p
    carrier less set supremum)))

(defun-sk p06b5-has-supremum-p
    (carrier less set)
  (exists (supremum)
    (p06b5-supremum-p
     carrier less set supremum)))

(defun-sk p06b5-dedekind-complete-p
    (carrier less)
  (forall (set)
    (implies
     (and
      (tamep-functionp set)
      (p06b5-valid-set-p carrier set)
      (p06b5-set-nonempty-p carrier set)
      (p06b5-bounded-above-p carrier less set))
     (p06b5-has-supremum-p
      carrier less set))))

(defun p06b5-real-field-p
    (carrier add multiply negate inverse zero one less)
  (and
   (tamep-functionp carrier)
   (tamep-functionp add)
   (tamep-functionp multiply)
   (tamep-functionp negate)
   (tamep-functionp inverse)
   (tamep-functionp less)
   (p06b5-member-p carrier zero)
   (p06b5-member-p carrier one)
   (not (equal zero one))
   (p06b5-field-laws-p
    carrier add multiply negate inverse zero one)
   (p06b5-order-laws-p
    carrier add multiply zero less)
   (p06b5-binary-value less zero one)
   (p06b5-dedekind-complete-p carrier less)))

;; Real-field context and arithmetic.

(defun p06b5-r-carrier (ctx) (nth 0 ctx))
(defun p06b5-r-zero (ctx) (nth 1 ctx))
(defun p06b5-r-one (ctx) (nth 2 ctx))
(defun p06b5-r-add (ctx) (nth 3 ctx))
(defun p06b5-r-mul (ctx) (nth 4 ctx))
(defun p06b5-r-neg (ctx) (nth 5 ctx))
(defun p06b5-r-inv (ctx) (nth 6 ctx))
(defun p06b5-r-lt (ctx) (nth 7 ctx))

(defun p06b5-context-p (ctx)
  (and
   (true-listp ctx)
   (equal (len ctx) 8)
   (p06b5-real-field-p
    (p06b5-r-carrier ctx)
    (p06b5-r-add ctx)
    (p06b5-r-mul ctx)
    (p06b5-r-neg ctx)
    (p06b5-r-inv ctx)
    (p06b5-r-zero ctx)
    (p06b5-r-one ctx)
    (p06b5-r-lt ctx))))

(defun p06b5-r-add-value (ctx x y)
  (p06b5-binary-value (p06b5-r-add ctx) x y))

(defun p06b5-r-mul-value (ctx x y)
  (p06b5-binary-value (p06b5-r-mul ctx) x y))

(defun p06b5-r-neg-value (ctx x)
  (p06b5-unary-value (p06b5-r-neg ctx) x))

(defun p06b5-r-inv-value (ctx x)
  (p06b5-unary-value (p06b5-r-inv ctx) x))

(defun p06b5-r-sub-value (ctx x y)
  (p06b5-r-add-value
   ctx x (p06b5-r-neg-value ctx y)))

(defun p06b5-r-div-value (ctx x y)
  (p06b5-r-mul-value
   ctx x (p06b5-r-inv-value ctx y)))

(defun p06b5-r-lt-p (ctx x y)
  (if (p06b5-binary-value
       (p06b5-r-lt ctx) x y)
      t nil))

(defun p06b5-r-le-p (ctx x y)
  (not (p06b5-r-lt-p ctx y x)))

(defun p06b5-r-abs-value (ctx x)
  (if (p06b5-r-lt-p
       ctx x (p06b5-r-zero ctx))
      (p06b5-r-neg-value ctx x)
    x))

(defun p06b5-positive-real-p (ctx x)
  (and
   (p06b5-member-p (p06b5-r-carrier ctx) x)
   (p06b5-r-lt-p
    ctx (p06b5-r-zero ctx) x)))

(defun p06b5-icc-member-p (ctx x)
  (and
   (p06b5-member-p (p06b5-r-carrier ctx) x)
   (p06b5-r-le-p ctx (p06b5-r-zero ctx) x)
   (p06b5-r-le-p ctx x (p06b5-r-one ctx))))

(defun p06b5-nat-cast (ctx n)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix n)))
  (if (zp n)
      (p06b5-r-zero ctx)
    (p06b5-r-add-value
     ctx
     (p06b5-r-one ctx)
     (p06b5-nat-cast ctx (- n 1)))))

(defun p06b5-solution (ctx)
  (p06b5-r-div-value
   ctx
   (p06b5-r-one ctx)
   (p06b5-nat-cast ctx 16)))

;; Relative epsilon-delta continuity on the closed unit interval.

(defun-sk p06b5-continuity-neighborhood-p
    (ctx function x epsilon radius)
  (forall (y)
    (implies
     (and
      (p06b5-icc-member-p ctx y)
      (p06b5-r-lt-p
       ctx
       (p06b5-r-abs-value
        ctx (p06b5-r-sub-value ctx y x))
       radius))
     (p06b5-r-lt-p
      ctx
      (p06b5-r-abs-value
       ctx
       (p06b5-r-sub-value
        ctx
        (p06b5-unary-value function y)
        (p06b5-unary-value function x)))
      epsilon))))

(defun-sk p06b5-continuity-radius-exists-p
    (ctx function x epsilon)
  (exists (radius)
    (and
     (p06b5-positive-real-p ctx radius)
     (p06b5-continuity-neighborhood-p
      ctx function x epsilon radius))))

(defun-sk p06b5-continuous-at-p
    (ctx function x)
  (forall (epsilon)
    (implies
     (p06b5-positive-real-p ctx epsilon)
     (p06b5-continuity-radius-exists-p
      ctx function x epsilon))))

(defun-sk p06b5-continuous-on-icc-p
    (ctx function)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (p06b5-icc-member-p ctx x)
     (p06b5-continuous-at-p
      ctx function x))))

(defun p06b5-admissible-function-p (ctx function)
  (and
   (tamep-functionp function)
   (p06b5-real-function-p
    (p06b5-r-carrier ctx) function)
   (p06b5-continuous-on-icc-p
    ctx function)))

;; Uniform right-endpoint Riemann sums for I(f) and J(f).

(defun p06b5-integrand-value
    (ctx function j-integral-p x)
  (let ((fx (p06b5-unary-value function x)))
    (if j-integral-p
        (p06b5-r-mul-value
         ctx x (p06b5-r-mul-value ctx fx fx))
      (p06b5-r-mul-value
       ctx
       (p06b5-r-mul-value ctx x x)
       fx))))

(defun p06b5-riemann-sum
    (ctx function j-integral-p subdivisions remaining)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix remaining)))
  (if (zp remaining)
      (p06b5-r-zero ctx)
    (let* ((denominator
            (p06b5-nat-cast ctx subdivisions))
           (numerator
            (p06b5-nat-cast ctx remaining))
           (point
            (p06b5-r-div-value
             ctx numerator denominator)))
      (p06b5-r-add-value
       ctx
       (p06b5-integrand-value
        ctx function j-integral-p point)
       (p06b5-riemann-sum
        ctx function j-integral-p subdivisions
        (- remaining 1))))))

(defun p06b5-integral-approx
    (ctx function j-integral-p subdivisions)
  (if (posp subdivisions)
      (p06b5-r-div-value
       ctx
       (p06b5-riemann-sum
        ctx function j-integral-p
        subdivisions subdivisions)
       (p06b5-nat-cast ctx subdivisions))
    (p06b5-r-zero ctx)))

(defun-sk p06b5-integral-tail-p
    (ctx function j-integral-p value epsilon cutoff)
  (forall (subdivisions)
    (implies
     (and
      (posp subdivisions)
      (<= cutoff subdivisions))
     (p06b5-r-lt-p
      ctx
      (p06b5-r-abs-value
       ctx
       (p06b5-r-sub-value
        ctx
        (p06b5-integral-approx
         ctx function j-integral-p subdivisions)
        value))
      epsilon))))

(defun-sk p06b5-integral-cutoff-exists-p
    (ctx function j-integral-p value epsilon)
  (exists (cutoff)
    (and
     (posp cutoff)
     (p06b5-integral-tail-p
      ctx function j-integral-p value epsilon cutoff))))

(defun-sk p06b5-integral-converges-to-p
    (ctx function j-integral-p value)
  (forall (epsilon)
    (implies
     (p06b5-positive-real-p ctx epsilon)
     (p06b5-integral-cutoff-exists-p
      ctx function j-integral-p value epsilon))))

(defun p06b5-integral-value-p
    (ctx function j-integral-p value)
  (and
   (p06b5-member-p (p06b5-r-carrier ctx) value)
   (p06b5-integral-converges-to-p
    ctx function j-integral-p value)))

(defun-sk p06b5-maximum-attained-p (ctx)
  (exists (function integral-i integral-j)
    (and
     (p06b5-admissible-function-p ctx function)
     (p06b5-integral-value-p
      ctx function nil integral-i)
     (p06b5-integral-value-p
      ctx function t integral-j)
     (equal
      (p06b5-r-sub-value
       ctx integral-i integral-j)
      (p06b5-solution ctx)))))

(defun-sk p06b5-function-objective-bounded-p
    (ctx function)
  (exists (integral-i integral-j)
    (and
     (p06b5-integral-value-p
      ctx function nil integral-i)
     (p06b5-integral-value-p
      ctx function t integral-j)
     (p06b5-r-le-p
      ctx
      (p06b5-r-sub-value
       ctx integral-i integral-j)
      (p06b5-solution ctx)))))

(defun-sk p06b5-all-objectives-bounded-p (ctx)
  (forall (function)
    (implies
     (p06b5-admissible-function-p ctx function)
     (p06b5-function-objective-bounded-p
      ctx function))))

(defun putnambench-putnam-2006-b5-statement (ctx)
  (implies
   (p06b5-context-p ctx)
   (and
    (p06b5-maximum-attained-p ctx)
    (p06b5-all-objectives-bounded-p ctx))))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

title: putnam_2006_b5
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2006_b5
-- (putnambench__agda__putnam_2006_b5): the maximum over continuous real
-- functions on [0,1] of the difference between the stated two integrals is
-- 1/16. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module Main where

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; _*_)

infix 4 _!=_ _<=N_
infixr 3 _and_
infixr 2 _or_

data Bottom : Set where

Not : Set -> Set
Not A =
  A -> Bottom

_!=_ : {A : Set} -> A -> A -> Set
x != y =
  Not (x == y)

record _and_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data _or_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  left  : A -> A or B
  right : B -> A or B

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

data _<=N_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set where
  zero<=N   : {n : Nat} -> zero <=N n
  suc<=sucN : {m n : Nat} -> m <=N n -> suc m <=N suc n

record CompleteOrderedRealField (R : Set) : Set1 where
  field
    zeroR oneR : R
    add multiply : R -> R -> R
    negate inverse : R -> R
    lessOrEqual : R -> R -> Set
    fromNat : Nat -> R

    one-not-zero :
      oneR != zeroR

    add-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> add x y == add y x
    add-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      add (add x y) z == add x (add y z)
    add-zero :
      (x : R) -> add x zeroR == x
    add-inverse :
      (x : R) -> add x (negate x) == zeroR

    multiply-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> multiply x y == multiply y x
    multiply-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply (multiply x y) z ==
      multiply x (multiply y z)
    multiply-one :
      (x : R) -> multiply x oneR == x
    multiply-zero :
      (x : R) -> multiply x zeroR == zeroR
    distribute :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply x (add y z) ==
      add (multiply x y) (multiply x z)
    inverse-zero :
      inverse zeroR == zeroR
    multiply-inverse :
      (x : R) ->
      x != zeroR ->
      multiply x (inverse x) == oneR

    order-reflexive :
      (x : R) -> lessOrEqual x x
    order-transitive :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y z ->
      lessOrEqual x z
    order-antisymmetric :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y x ->
      x == y
    order-total :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y or lessOrEqual y x
    add-order :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual (add z x) (add z y)
    multiply-nonnegative :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR x ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR y ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR (multiply x y)
    zero-less-than-one :
      lessOrEqual zeroR oneR and zeroR != oneR

    fromNat-zero :
      fromNat zero == zeroR
    fromNat-successor :
      (n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (suc n) == add (fromNat n) oneR
    fromNat-addition :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m + n) == add (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-multiplication :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m * n) == multiply (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-injective :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat m == fromNat n ->
      m == n

    archimedean :
      (x : R) ->
      Exists Nat (\ n -> lessOrEqual x (fromNat n))
    least-upper-bound :
      (P : R -> Set) ->
      Exists R P ->
      Exists R
        (\ upper ->
          (x : R) ->
          P x ->
          lessOrEqual x upper) ->
      Exists R
        (\ supremum ->
          ((x : R) ->
            P x ->
            lessOrEqual x supremum)
          and
          ((upper : R) ->
            ((x : R) ->
              P x ->
              lessOrEqual x upper) ->
            lessOrEqual supremum upper))

open CompleteOrderedRealField

subtract :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
subtract reals x y =
  add reals x (negate reals y)

divide :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
divide reals x y =
  multiply reals x (inverse reals y)

square :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R
square reals x =
  multiply reals x x

StrictLess :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
StrictLess reals x y =
  lessOrEqual reals x y and x != y

CloseTo :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
CloseTo reals center radius x =
  StrictLess reals
    (subtract reals center radius)
    x
  and
  StrictLess reals
    x
    (add reals center radius)

Between :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
Between reals lower upper x =
  lessOrEqual reals lower x
  and
  lessOrEqual reals x upper

ContinuousOnInterval :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  (R -> R) ->
  Set
ContinuousOnInterval {R} reals lower upper function =
  (point : R) ->
  Between reals lower upper point ->
  (epsilon : R) ->
  StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) epsilon ->
  Exists R
    (\ delta ->
      StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) delta
      and
      ((x : R) ->
        Between reals lower upper x ->
        CloseTo reals point delta x ->
        CloseTo reals
          (function point)
          epsilon
          (function x)))

sumFirst :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Nat ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  R
sumFirst reals zero terms =
  zeroR reals
sumFirst reals (suc n) terms =
  add reals
    (sumFirst reals n terms)
    (terms n)

ConvergesTo :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  R ->
  Set
ConvergesTo {R} reals sequence limit =
  (epsilon : R) ->
  StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) epsilon ->
  Exists Nat
    (\ cutoff ->
      (n : Nat) ->
      cutoff <=N n ->
      CloseTo reals limit epsilon (sequence n))

rightRiemannSum :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  (R -> R) ->
  Nat ->
  R
rightRiemannSum reals lower upper function pieces =
  let
    step =
      divide reals
        (subtract reals upper lower)
        (fromNat reals pieces)
  in
  sumFirst reals pieces
    (\ i ->
      multiply reals
        (function
          (add reals lower
            (multiply reals
              (fromNat reals (suc i))
              step)))
        step)

IntervalIntegralValue :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  (R -> R) ->
  R ->
  Set
IntervalIntegralValue reals lower upper function value =
  ConvergesTo reals
    (\ n ->
      rightRiemannSum reals
        lower
        upper
        function
        (suc n))
    value

record StandardIntervalIntegration
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) :
  Set1 where

  field
    intervalIntegral :
      R ->
      R ->
      (R -> R) ->
      R

    integral-of-continuous :
      (lower upper : R) ->
      (function : R -> R) ->
      lessOrEqual reals lower upper ->
      ContinuousOnInterval reals lower upper function ->
      IntervalIntegralValue reals
        lower
        upper
        function
        (intervalIntegral lower upper function)

open StandardIntervalIntegration

record IsGreatest
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R)
  (property : R -> Set)
  (greatest : R) :
  Set where

  field
    belongs :
      property greatest

    greatest-property :
      (x : R) ->
      property x ->
      lessOrEqual reals x greatest

module Putnam2006B5Statement
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R)
  (integration : StandardIntervalIntegration reals) where

  solution : R
  solution =
    divide reals
      (oneR reals)
      (fromNat reals 16)

  I : (R -> R) -> R
  I f =
    intervalIntegral integration
      (zeroR reals)
      (oneR reals)
      (\ x ->
        multiply reals
          (square reals x)
          (f x))

  J : (R -> R) -> R
  J f =
    intervalIntegral integration
      (zeroR reals)
      (oneR reals)
      (\ x ->
        multiply reals
          x
          (square reals (f x)))

  objective : (R -> R) -> R
  objective f =
    subtract reals (I f) (J f)

  AttainedValue : R -> Set
  AttainedValue y =
    Exists (R -> R)
      (\ f ->
        ContinuousOnInterval reals
          (zeroR reals)
          (oneR reals)
          f
        and
        objective f == y)

  proposition : Set
  proposition =
    IsGreatest reals AttainedValue solution

putnam-2006-b5 : Set1
putnam-2006-b5 =
  (R : Set) ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) ->
  (integration : StandardIntervalIntegration reals) ->
  Putnam2006B5Statement.proposition
    reals
    integration

(*
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2006_b5:
  the maximum of the difference between two weighted integrals associated
  with a continuous real function on the unit interval is 1/16. This file
  contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open pred_setTheory realTheory real_topologyTheory integrationTheory;

val putnam_2006_b5 =
  ``let unit_interval = interval [0, 1]
    in
    let I =
      \f : real -> real.
        integration$integral unit_interval
          (\x : real. x pow 2 * f x)
    in
    let J =
      \f : real -> real.
        integration$integral unit_interval
          (\x : real. x * f x pow 2)
    in
    let solution = (1 / 16 : real)
    in
      (?f : real -> real.
         f continuous_on unit_interval /\
         I f - J f = solution) /\
      (!f : real -> real.
         f continuous_on unit_interval
         ==>
         I f - J f <= solution)``;
