title: putnam_2006_b5
content:
% Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2006_b5:
% the maximum of the difference between the integrals of x^2*f(x) and
% x*f(x)^2 over continuous real functions on [0, 1] is 1/16.
% This file contains no proof.

putnam_2006_b5: THEORY
BEGIN
  real_function: TYPE = [real -> real]
  real_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> real]

  in_closed_unit_interval(x: real): bool =
    0 <= x AND x <= 1

  continuous_on_unit_interval(f: real_function): bool =
    FORALL (x: real):
      in_closed_unit_interval(x) IMPLIES
        FORALL (epsilon_value: posreal):
          EXISTS (delta: posreal):
            FORALL (z: real):
              (in_closed_unit_interval(z)
                AND abs(z - x) < delta)
              IMPLIES
                abs(f(z) - f(x)) < epsilon_value

  valid_partition(
      points: real_sequence,
      count: nat): bool =
    count > 0
      AND points(0) = 0
      AND points(count) = 1
      AND FORALL (index: nat):
        index < count IMPLIES
          points(index) < points(index + 1)

  valid_tags(
      points, tags: real_sequence,
      count: nat): bool =
    FORALL (index: nat):
      index < count IMPLIES
        points(index) <= tags(index)
          AND tags(index) <= points(index + 1)

  mesh_less_than(
      points: real_sequence,
      count: nat,
      bound: real): bool =
    FORALL (index: nat):
      index < count IMPLIES
        points(index + 1) - points(index) < bound

  riemann_sum(
      f: real_function,
      points, tags: real_sequence,
      count: nat): RECURSIVE real =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      riemann_sum(f, points, tags, count - 1)
        + f(tags(count - 1))
            * (points(count) - points(count - 1))
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  has_unit_interval_integral(
      f: real_function,
      integral_value: real): bool =
    FORALL (epsilon_value: posreal):
      EXISTS (mesh_bound: posreal):
        FORALL
            (points, tags: real_sequence),
            (count: nat):
          (valid_partition(points, count)
            AND valid_tags(points, tags, count)
            AND mesh_less_than(points, count, mesh_bound))
          IMPLIES
            abs(
              riemann_sum(f, points, tags, count)
                - integral_value)
              < epsilon_value

  objective_value(
      f: real_function,
      value: real): bool =
    EXISTS (I_value, J_value: real):
      has_unit_interval_integral(
        LAMBDA (x: real): x ^ 2 * f(x),
        I_value)
        AND has_unit_interval_integral(
          LAMBDA (x: real): x * f(x) ^ 2,
          J_value)
        AND value = I_value - J_value

  safe_div(numerator, denominator: real): real =
    IF denominator = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      numerator / denominator
    ENDIF

  putnam_2006_b5_solution: real =
    safe_div(1, 16)

  is_greatest_objective_value(maximum: real): bool =
    (EXISTS (f: real_function):
      continuous_on_unit_interval(f)
        AND objective_value(f, maximum))
      AND
        (FORALL (f: real_function), (value: real):
          (continuous_on_unit_interval(f)
            AND objective_value(f, value))
          IMPLIES value <= maximum)

  putnam_2006_b5: bool =
    is_greatest_objective_value(
      putnam_2006_b5_solution)
END putnam_2006_b5

theorem putnam_2006_b6

(hk : k > 1)
(a : ℕ → ℝ)
(ha0 : a 0 > 0)
(ha : ∀ n : ℕ, a (n + 1) = a n + 1/((a n)^((1 : ℝ)/k)))

content:
;; Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2006_b6:
;; the asymptotic limit of a positive real sequence defined by reciprocal
;; positive kth-root increments is ((k+1)/k)^k. This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))

;; This conservative generic symbol supplies a rational regular Cauchy name
;; for a_n at every natural n. It is an arbitrary function symbol, not a
;; rational-valued sequence or a finite table. Every real sequence admits such
;; a name, and every name satisfying P06B6-REGULAR-NAME-P determines a unique
;; real sequence.
;;
;; If d_n = a_(n+1)-a_n, positivity and
;;
;;   a_n * d_n^k = 1
;;
;; are equivalent to d_n being the positive reciprocal kth root of a_n. The
;; recurrence predicate states this equivalent relation through Cauchy-name
;; approximations. All universal and existential scopes, including the limit
;; cutoff, are internal DEFUN-SK quantifiers.

(defstub p06b6-a-approx (n epsilon) t)

(defun p06b6-positive-rational-p (x)
  (and
   (rationalp x)
   (< 0 x)))

(defun p06b6-minimum (left right)
  (if (< left right) left right))

(defun p06b6-value-bound (value-at-one)
  (+ 2 (abs value-at-one)))

(defun p06b6-solution (k)
  (expt (/ (+ k 1) k) k))

(defun-sk p06b6-regular-name-p ()
  (forall (n epsilon eta)
    (implies
     (and
      (natp n)
      (p06b6-positive-rational-p epsilon)
      (p06b6-positive-rational-p eta))
     (let ((at-epsilon
            (p06b6-a-approx n epsilon))
           (at-eta
            (p06b6-a-approx n eta)))
       (and
        (rationalp at-epsilon)
        (rationalp at-eta)
        (<=
         (abs (- at-epsilon at-eta))
         (+ epsilon eta)))))))

;; A positive rational lower margin valid at every precision is equivalent to
;; positivity of the represented initial real.

(defun-sk p06b6-initial-margin-p (margin)
  (forall (epsilon)
    (implies
     (p06b6-positive-rational-p epsilon)
     (let ((value
            (p06b6-a-approx 0 epsilon)))
       (and
        (rationalp value)
        (<= margin (+ value epsilon)))))))

(defun-sk p06b6-initial-positive-p ()
  (exists (margin)
    (and
     (p06b6-positive-rational-p margin)
     (p06b6-initial-margin-p margin))))

;; DELTA is small enough that regular-name errors in
;; a_n*(a_(n+1)-a_n)^k contribute at most half the requested tolerance.

(defun p06b6-recurrence-delta (n k epsilon)
  (let* ((current-at-one
          (p06b6-a-approx n 1))
         (next-at-one
          (p06b6-a-approx (+ n 1) 1))
         (current-bound
          (p06b6-value-bound current-at-one))
         (next-bound
          (p06b6-value-bound next-at-one))
         (difference-bound
          (+ 2 current-bound next-bound))
         (power-error-scale
          (+
           1
           (expt difference-bound k)
           (*
            2
            current-bound
            k
            (expt difference-bound (- k 1))))))
    (p06b6-minimum
     1
     (/ epsilon (* 2 power-error-scale)))))

(defun-sk p06b6-recurrence-p (k)
  (forall (n epsilon)
    (implies
     (and
      (natp n)
      (p06b6-positive-rational-p epsilon))
     (let* ((delta
             (p06b6-recurrence-delta
              n k epsilon))
            (current-at-one
             (p06b6-a-approx n 1))
            (next-at-one
             (p06b6-a-approx (+ n 1) 1))
            (current
             (p06b6-a-approx n delta))
            (next
             (p06b6-a-approx (+ n 1) delta))
            (difference (- next current))
            (residual
             (abs
              (-
               (* current
                  (expt difference k))
               1))))
       (and
        (p06b6-positive-rational-p delta)
        (rationalp current-at-one)
        (rationalp next-at-one)
        (rationalp current)
        (rationalp next)
        (<= 0 (+ difference (* 2 delta)))
        (<= residual epsilon))))))

;; The one-quarter name-error allowance and three-quarter comparison margin
;; give an epsilon-equivalent formulation of the usual real limit.

(defun p06b6-limit-delta (n k epsilon)
  (let* ((value-at-one
          (p06b6-a-approx n 1))
         (value-bound
          (+ 1 (p06b6-value-bound value-at-one)))
         (power-error-scale
          (+
           1
           (* (+ k 1)
              (expt value-bound k)))))
    (p06b6-minimum
     1
     (/ epsilon (* 4 power-error-scale)))))

(defun-sk p06b6-limit-tail-p
    (k epsilon cutoff)
  (forall (n)
    (implies
     (and
      (natp n)
      (<= cutoff n))
     (let* ((delta
             (p06b6-limit-delta n k epsilon))
            (value-at-one
             (p06b6-a-approx n 1))
            (value
             (p06b6-a-approx n delta))
            (quotient
             (/
              (expt value (+ k 1))
              (expt n k)))
            (distance
             (abs
              (- quotient
                 (p06b6-solution k)))))
       (and
        (p06b6-positive-rational-p delta)
        (rationalp value-at-one)
        (rationalp value)
        (< distance (* 3/4 epsilon)))))))

(defun-sk p06b6-limit-cutoff-exists-p
    (k epsilon)
  (exists (cutoff)
    (and
     (posp cutoff)
     (p06b6-limit-tail-p
      k epsilon cutoff))))

(defun-sk p06b6-limit-p (k)
  (forall (epsilon)
    (implies
     (p06b6-positive-rational-p epsilon)
     (p06b6-limit-cutoff-exists-p
      k epsilon))))

(defun-sk putnambench-putnam-2006-b6-statement ()
  (forall (k)
    (implies
     (and
      (natp k)
      (< 1 k)
      (p06b6-regular-name-p)
      (p06b6-initial-positive-p)
      (p06b6-recurrence-p k))
     (p06b6-limit-p k))))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

content:
-- Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2006_b6
-- (putnambench__agda__putnam_2006_b6): for k > 1, a positive-starting real
-- sequence with the specified kth-root recurrence has a normalized-power
-- limit equal to ((k + 1) / k)^k. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module Main where

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; _*_)

infix 4 _!=_ _<N_ _<=N_
infixr 3 _and_
infixr 2 _or_

data Bottom : Set where

Not : Set -> Set
Not A =
  A -> Bottom

_!=_ : {A : Set} -> A -> A -> Set
x != y =
  Not (x == y)

record _and_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data _or_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  left  : A -> A or B
  right : B -> A or B

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

data _<N_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set where
  zero<suc : {n : Nat} -> zero <N suc n
  suc<suc  : {m n : Nat} -> m <N n -> suc m <N suc n

data _<=N_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set where
  zero<=N   : {n : Nat} -> zero <=N n
  suc<=sucN : {m n : Nat} -> m <=N n -> suc m <=N suc n

record CompleteOrderedRealField (R : Set) : Set1 where
  field
    zeroR oneR : R
    add multiply : R -> R -> R
    negate inverse : R -> R
    lessOrEqual : R -> R -> Set
    fromNat : Nat -> R

    one-not-zero :
      oneR != zeroR

    add-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> add x y == add y x
    add-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      add (add x y) z == add x (add y z)
    add-zero :
      (x : R) -> add x zeroR == x
    add-inverse :
      (x : R) -> add x (negate x) == zeroR

    multiply-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> multiply x y == multiply y x
    multiply-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply (multiply x y) z ==
      multiply x (multiply y z)
    multiply-one :
      (x : R) -> multiply x oneR == x
    multiply-zero :
      (x : R) -> multiply x zeroR == zeroR
    distribute :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply x (add y z) ==
      add (multiply x y) (multiply x z)
    inverse-zero :
      inverse zeroR == zeroR
    multiply-inverse :
      (x : R) ->
      x != zeroR ->
      multiply x (inverse x) == oneR

    order-reflexive :
      (x : R) -> lessOrEqual x x
    order-transitive :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y z ->
      lessOrEqual x z
    order-antisymmetric :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y x ->
      x == y
    order-total :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y or lessOrEqual y x
    add-order :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual (add z x) (add z y)
    multiply-nonnegative :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR x ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR y ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR (multiply x y)
    zero-less-than-one :
      lessOrEqual zeroR oneR and zeroR != oneR

    fromNat-zero :
      fromNat zero == zeroR
    fromNat-successor :
      (n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (suc n) == add (fromNat n) oneR
    fromNat-addition :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m + n) == add (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-multiplication :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m * n) == multiply (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-injective :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat m == fromNat n ->
      m == n

    archimedean :
      (x : R) ->
      Exists Nat
        (\ n ->
          lessOrEqual x (fromNat n))
    least-upper-bound :
      (P : R -> Set) ->
      Exists R P ->
      Exists R
        (\ upper ->
          (x : R) ->
          P x ->
          lessOrEqual x upper) ->
      Exists R
        (\ supremum ->
          ((x : R) ->
            P x ->
            lessOrEqual x supremum)
          and
          ((upper : R) ->
            ((x : R) ->
              P x ->
              lessOrEqual x upper) ->
            lessOrEqual supremum upper))

open CompleteOrderedRealField

oneN : Nat
oneN =
  suc zero

subtract :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
subtract reals x y =
  add reals x (negate reals y)

divide :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
divide reals x y =
  multiply reals x (inverse reals y)

StrictLess :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
StrictLess reals x y =
  lessOrEqual reals x y and x != y

CloseTo :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
CloseTo reals center radius x =
  StrictLess reals
    (subtract reals center radius)
    x
  and
  StrictLess reals
    x
    (add reals center radius)

ConvergesTo :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  R ->
  Set
ConvergesTo {R} reals sequence limit =
  (epsilon : R) ->
  StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) epsilon ->
  Exists Nat
    (\ cutoff ->
      (n : Nat) ->
      cutoff <=N n ->
      CloseTo reals limit epsilon (sequence n))

naturalPower :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  Nat ->
  R
naturalPower reals x zero =
  oneR reals
naturalPower reals x (suc n) =
  multiply reals
    (naturalPower reals x n)
    x

PositiveKthRoot :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Nat ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
PositiveKthRoot reals k base root =
  StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) root
  and
  naturalPower reals root k == base

RootRecurrence :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Nat ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  Set
RootRecurrence {R} reals k a =
  (n : Nat) ->
  Exists R
    (\ root ->
      PositiveKthRoot reals k (a n) root
      and
      a (suc n) ==
        add reals
          (a n)
          (divide reals (oneR reals) root))

normalizedPower :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Nat ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  Nat ->
  R
normalizedPower reals k a n =
  divide reals
    (naturalPower reals (a n) (suc k))
    (naturalPower reals (fromNat reals n) k)

putnam-2006-b6-solution :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Nat ->
  R
putnam-2006-b6-solution reals k =
  naturalPower reals
    (divide reals
      (fromNat reals (suc k))
      (fromNat reals k))
    k

putnam-2006-b6 : Set1
putnam-2006-b6 =
  (R : Set) ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) ->
  (k : Nat) ->
  oneN <N k ->
  (a : Nat -> R) ->
  StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) (a zero) ->
  RootRecurrence reals k a ->
  ConvergesTo reals
    (normalizedPower reals k a)
    (putnam-2006-b6-solution reals k)

(*
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2006_b6:
  the limit of a normalized power of a positive real sequence defined by a
  reciprocal k-th-root recurrence. This file contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open arithmeticTheory realTheory real_topologyTheory transcTheory;

val putnam_2006_b6 =
  ``!k : num. !a : num -> real.
      1 < k /\
      0 < a 0 /\
      (!n : num.
         a (n + 1) =
           a n + 1 / (a n powr (1 / (&k : real))))
      ==>
      (((\n : num.
           a n pow (k + 1) / ((&n : real) pow k)) -->
        (((&(k + 1) : real) / (&k : real)) pow k))
       sequentially)``;

title: putnam_2006_b6
content:
$(
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact
  putnam_2006_b6: a positive real sequence defined by adding the reciprocal
  k-th root of its current term has a specified normalized power limit.
  This file contains no proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  The variable k ranges over the nonnegative integers, with the source
  hypothesis 1 < k, and a ranges over all NN0-indexed real sequences.
  For positive real bases, SetMM's complex power with exponent 1 / k is the
  positive real k-th root, so the recurrence is the source recurrence.

  The relation ~~> is SetMM's sequence convergence relation. Its right-hand
  side is the closed form ((k + 1) / k)^k supplied by the Putnam problem and
  the Rocq reference. The final declaration is the single unproved $a corpus
  statement; this database contains no $p proof statement.
$)

${
  $d a k n $.

  putnambench-putnam-2006-b6 $a |- A. k e. NN0
    (
      1 < k
      ->
      A. a e. ( RR ^m NN0 )
        (
          (
            0 < ( a ` 0 )
            /\
            A. n e. NN0
              ( a ` ( n + 1 ) )
              =
              (
                ( a ` n )
                +
                (
                  1
                  /
                  ( ( a ` n ) ^c ( 1 / k ) )
                )
              )
          )
          ->
          (
            n e. NN0 |->
              (
                ( ( a ` n ) ^ ( k + 1 ) )
                /
                ( n ^ k )
              )
          )
          ~~>
          ( ( ( k + 1 ) / k ) ^ k )
        )
    )
  $.
$}

environ

title: putnam_2006_b6
content:
% Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2006_b6:
% a positive real sequence defined by adding the reciprocal of its positive
% kth root has the stated normalized power limit. This file contains no proof.

putnam_2006_b6: THEORY
BEGIN
  real_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> real]

  safe_div(numerator, denominator: real): real =
    IF denominator = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      numerator / denominator
    ENDIF

  positive_kth_root(root, value: real, k: nat): bool =
    root > 0 AND root ^ k = value

  satisfies_recurrence(a: real_sequence, k: nat): bool =
    FORALL (n: nat):
      EXISTS (root: real):
        positive_kth_root(root, a(n), k)
          AND a(n + 1) = a(n) + safe_div(1, root)

  converges_to(sequence: real_sequence, value: real): bool =
    FORALL (epsilon_value: posreal):
      EXISTS (cutoff: nat):
        FORALL (n: nat):
          cutoff <= n IMPLIES
            abs(sequence(n) - value) < epsilon_value

  putnam_2006_b6_solution(k: nat): real =
    safe_div((k + 1) :: real, k :: real) ^ k

  putnam_2006_b6: bool =
    FORALL (k: nat), (a: real_sequence):
      (k > 1
        AND a(0) > 0
        AND satisfies_recurrence(a, k))
      IMPLIES
        converges_to(
          LAMBDA (n: nat):
            safe_div(a(n) ^ (k + 1), (n :: real) ^ k),
          putnam_2006_b6_solution(k))
END putnam_2006_b6

import Mathlib

abbrev putnam_2007_a1_solution : Set ℝ := sorry
-- {2 / 3, 3 / 2, (13 + √601) / 12, (13 - √601) / 12}

/--
Find all values of $\alpha$ for which the curves $y = \alpha*x^2 + \alpha*x + 1/24$ and $x = \alpha*y^2 + \alpha*y + 1/24$ are tangent to each other.
-/
theorem putnam_2007_a1
    (P : (ℝ → ℝ) → Prop)
    (P_def : ∀ f, P f ↔ ∃ x y, f x = y ∧ f y = x ∧ deriv f x * deriv f y = 1)
    (α : ℝ) :
    P (fun t ↦ α * t ^ 2 + α * t + 1 / 24) ↔ α ∈ putnam_2007_a1_solution :=
  sorry

title: putnam_2007_a1
content:
(* Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2007_a1:
   the real parameters for which two reflected quadratic curves are
   tangent at an intersection; this file contains no proof. *)

From Stdlib Require Import Reals.

Open Scope R_scope.

Definition putnam_2007_a1_curve (alpha t : R) : R :=
  alpha * t ^ 2 + alpha * t + 1 / 24.

Definition putnam_2007_a1_tangent_parameter (alpha : R) : Prop :=
  exists x y : R,
    putnam_2007_a1_curve alpha x = y /\
    putnam_2007_a1_curve alpha y = x /\
    (2 * alpha * x + alpha) * (2 * alpha * y + alpha) = 1.

Definition putnam_2007_a1_solution (alpha : R) : Prop :=
  alpha = 2 / 3 \/
  alpha = 3 / 2 \/
  alpha = (13 + sqrt 601) / 12 \/
  alpha = (13 - sqrt 601) / 12.

Theorem putnam_2007_a1 :
  forall alpha : R,
    putnam_2007_a1_tangent_parameter alpha <->
    putnam_2007_a1_solution alpha.
Admitted.

title: putnam_2007_a1
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2007_a1:
;; the real coefficients for which two mutually defined quadratic curves are
;; tangent, characterized by four explicit values. This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))

;; Ordinary ACL2 has no native carrier of all real numbers.  Following the
;; repository's statement-only convention, these conservative interfaces
;; describe an arbitrary real closed ordered field.  Every carrier, field,
;; order, and real-closedness law used below is an explicit hypothesis of the
;; statement predicate.  The source formula is first-order in the ordered-field
;; language, so the completeness of real closed fields gives a bidirectional
;; equivalence with its interpretation over the real numbers.
;;
;; P is inlined using P_def.  Thus alpha is still an arbitrary real-field
;; element, while the tangency witnesses x and y remain existentially
;; quantified inside the statement.  The last quadratic has precisely the
;; roots (13 + sqrt(601))/12 and (13 - sqrt(601))/12 in every real closed
;; ordered field.

(defstub putnam-2007-a1-real-p (real-type value) t)
(defstub putnam-2007-a1-zero (real-type) t)
(defstub putnam-2007-a1-one (real-type) t)
(defstub putnam-2007-a1-add (real-type left right) t)
(defstub putnam-2007-a1-mul (real-type left right) t)
(defstub putnam-2007-a1-neg (real-type value) t)
(defstub putnam-2007-a1-inv (real-type value) t)
(defstub putnam-2007-a1-less (real-type left right) t)

(defun putnam-2007-a1-sub (real-type left right)
  (putnam-2007-a1-add
   real-type
   left
   (putnam-2007-a1-neg real-type right)))

(defun putnam-2007-a1-div (real-type numerator denominator)
  (putnam-2007-a1-mul
   real-type
   numerator
   (putnam-2007-a1-inv real-type denominator)))

(defun putnam-2007-a1-r-nat (real-type n)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix n)))
  (if (zp n)
      (putnam-2007-a1-zero real-type)
    (putnam-2007-a1-add
     real-type
     (putnam-2007-a1-one real-type)
     (putnam-2007-a1-r-nat real-type (1- n)))))

;; Explicit ordered-field laws.

(defun-sk putnam-2007-a1-field-laws-p (real-type)
  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (putnam-2007-a1-real-p real-type x)
      (putnam-2007-a1-real-p real-type y)
      (putnam-2007-a1-real-p real-type z))
     (let* ((zero (putnam-2007-a1-zero real-type))
            (one (putnam-2007-a1-one real-type))
            (x-plus-y (putnam-2007-a1-add real-type x y))
            (y-plus-z (putnam-2007-a1-add real-type y z))
            (x-times-y (putnam-2007-a1-mul real-type x y))
            (y-times-z (putnam-2007-a1-mul real-type y z))
            (minus-x (putnam-2007-a1-neg real-type x))
            (inverse-x (putnam-2007-a1-inv real-type x)))
       (and
        (putnam-2007-a1-real-p real-type x-plus-y)
        (putnam-2007-a1-real-p real-type x-times-y)
        (putnam-2007-a1-real-p real-type minus-x)
        (putnam-2007-a1-real-p real-type inverse-x)
        (equal
         (putnam-2007-a1-add real-type x-plus-y z)
         (putnam-2007-a1-add real-type x y-plus-z))
        (equal
         x-plus-y
         (putnam-2007-a1-add real-type y x))
        (equal
         (putnam-2007-a1-add real-type x zero)
         x)
        (equal
         (putnam-2007-a1-add real-type x minus-x)
         zero)
        (equal
         (putnam-2007-a1-mul real-type x-times-y z)
         (putnam-2007-a1-mul real-type x y-times-z))
        (equal
         x-times-y
         (putnam-2007-a1-mul real-type y x))
        (equal
         (putnam-2007-a1-mul real-type x one)
         x)
        (implies
         (equal x zero)
         (equal inverse-x zero))
        (implies
         (not (equal x zero))
         (equal
          (putnam-2007-a1-mul real-type x inverse-x)
          one))
        (equal
         (putnam-2007-a1-mul real-type x y-plus-z)
         (putnam-2007-a1-add
          real-type
          (putnam-2007-a1-mul real-type x y)
          (putnam-2007-a1-mul real-type x z))))))))

(defun-sk putnam-2007-a1-order-laws-p (real-type)
  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (putnam-2007-a1-real-p real-type x)
      (putnam-2007-a1-real-p real-type y)
      (putnam-2007-a1-real-p real-type z))
     (let ((zero (putnam-2007-a1-zero real-type)))
       (and
        (not (putnam-2007-a1-less real-type x x))
        (or
         (putnam-2007-a1-less real-type x y)
         (equal x y)
         (putnam-2007-a1-less real-type y x))
        (implies
         (and
          (putnam-2007-a1-less real-type x y)
          (putnam-2007-a1-less real-type y z))
         (putnam-2007-a1-less real-type x z))
        (implies
         (putnam-2007-a1-less real-type x y)
         (putnam-2007-a1-less
          real-type
          (putnam-2007-a1-add real-type x z)
          (putnam-2007-a1-add real-type y z)))
        (implies
         (and
          (putnam-2007-a1-less real-type zero x)
          (putnam-2007-a1-less real-type zero y))
         (putnam-2007-a1-less
          real-type
          zero
          (putnam-2007-a1-mul real-type x y))))))))

;; The square-root and odd-degree-root properties are the standard algebraic
;; characterization of real closed ordered fields.

(defun-sk putnam-2007-a1-square-root-exists-p
    (real-type value)
  (exists (root)
    (and
     (putnam-2007-a1-real-p real-type root)
     (equal
      (putnam-2007-a1-mul real-type root root)
      value))))

(defun-sk putnam-2007-a1-square-root-law-p (real-type)
  (forall (value)
    (implies
     (and
      (putnam-2007-a1-real-p real-type value)
      (not
       (putnam-2007-a1-less
        real-type
        value
        (putnam-2007-a1-zero real-type))))
     (putnam-2007-a1-square-root-exists-p
      real-type value))))

(defun putnam-2007-a1-coefficient-list-p
    (real-type coefficients)
  (if (consp coefficients)
      (and
       (putnam-2007-a1-real-p
        real-type (car coefficients))
       (putnam-2007-a1-coefficient-list-p
        real-type (cdr coefficients)))
    (equal coefficients nil)))

;; Coefficients are in ascending degree order.
(defun putnam-2007-a1-polynomial-p
    (real-type coefficients)
  (and
   (true-listp coefficients)
   (consp coefficients)
   (putnam-2007-a1-coefficient-list-p
    real-type coefficients)
   (not
    (equal
     (car (last coefficients))
     (putnam-2007-a1-zero real-type)))))

(defun putnam-2007-a1-polynomial-eval
    (real-type coefficients value)
  (if (consp coefficients)
      (putnam-2007-a1-add
       real-type
       (car coefficients)
       (putnam-2007-a1-mul
        real-type
        value
        (putnam-2007-a1-polynomial-eval
         real-type (cdr coefficients) value)))
    (putnam-2007-a1-zero real-type)))

(defun-sk putnam-2007-a1-polynomial-root-exists-p
    (real-type coefficients)
  (exists (root)
    (and
     (putnam-2007-a1-real-p real-type root)
     (equal
      (putnam-2007-a1-polynomial-eval
       real-type coefficients root)
      (putnam-2007-a1-zero real-type)))))

(defun-sk putnam-2007-a1-odd-degree-root-law-p (real-type)
  (forall (coefficients)
    (implies
     (and
      (putnam-2007-a1-polynomial-p
       real-type coefficients)
      (evenp (len coefficients)))
     (putnam-2007-a1-polynomial-root-exists-p
      real-type coefficients))))

(defun putnam-2007-a1-real-closed-field-p (real-type)
  (let ((zero (putnam-2007-a1-zero real-type))
        (one (putnam-2007-a1-one real-type)))
    (and
     (putnam-2007-a1-real-p real-type zero)
     (putnam-2007-a1-real-p real-type one)
     (not (equal zero one))
     (putnam-2007-a1-field-laws-p real-type)
     (putnam-2007-a1-order-laws-p real-type)
     (putnam-2007-a1-less real-type zero one)
     (putnam-2007-a1-square-root-law-p real-type)
     (putnam-2007-a1-odd-degree-root-law-p real-type))))

;; The quadratic and its derivative, interpreted in the represented real field.

(defun putnam-2007-a1-quadratic
    (real-type alpha value)
  (putnam-2007-a1-add
   real-type
   (putnam-2007-a1-add
    real-type
    (putnam-2007-a1-mul
     real-type

-- Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2007_a1
-- (putnambench__agda__putnam_2007_a1): the real parameters for which the two
-- mutually defined quadratic curves are tangent are exactly the stated four
-- values. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module Putnam2007A1 where

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; _*_)

infix 4 _!=_
infixr 3 _and_
infixr 2 _or_

data Bottom : Set where

Not : Set -> Set
Not A =
  A -> Bottom

_!=_ : {A : Set} -> A -> A -> Set
x != y =
  Not (x == y)

record _and_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data _or_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  left  : A -> A or B
  right : B -> A or B

record Iff (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor equivalence
  field
    forward  : A -> B
    backward : B -> A

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

record CompleteOrderedRealField (R : Set) : Set1 where
  field
    zeroR oneR : R
    add multiply : R -> R -> R
    negate inverse squareRoot : R -> R
    lessOrEqual : R -> R -> Set
    fromNat : Nat -> R

    one-not-zero :
      oneR != zeroR

    add-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> add x y == add y x
    add-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      add (add x y) z == add x (add y z)
    add-zero :
      (x : R) -> add x zeroR == x
    add-inverse :
      (x : R) -> add x (negate x) == zeroR

    multiply-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> multiply x y == multiply y x
    multiply-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply (multiply x y) z ==
      multiply x (multiply y z)
    multiply-one :
      (x : R) -> multiply x oneR == x
    multiply-zero :
      (x : R) -> multiply x zeroR == zeroR
    distribute :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply x (add y z) ==
      add (multiply x y) (multiply x z)
    inverse-zero :
      inverse zeroR == zeroR
    multiply-inverse :
      (x : R) ->
      x != zeroR ->
      multiply x (inverse x) == oneR

    order-reflexive :
      (x : R) -> lessOrEqual x x
    order-transitive :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y z ->
      lessOrEqual x z
    order-antisymmetric :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y x ->
      x == y
    order-total :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y or lessOrEqual y x
    add-order :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual (add z x) (add z y)
    multiply-nonnegative :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR x ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR y ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR (multiply x y)
    zero-less-than-one :
      lessOrEqual zeroR oneR and zeroR != oneR

    fromNat-zero :
      fromNat zero == zeroR
    fromNat-successor :
      (n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (suc n) == add (fromNat n) oneR
    fromNat-addition :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m + n) == add (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-multiplication :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m * n) == multiply (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-injective :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat m == fromNat n ->
      m == n

    archimedean :
      (x : R) ->
      Exists Nat (\ n -> lessOrEqual x (fromNat n))
    least-upper-bound :
      (P : R -> Set) ->
      Exists R P ->
      Exists R
        (\ upper ->
          (x : R) ->
          P x ->
          lessOrEqual x upper) ->
      Exists R
        (\ supremum ->
          ((x : R) ->
            P x ->
            lessOrEqual x supremum)
          and
          ((upper : R) ->
            ((x : R) ->
              P x ->
              lessOrEqual x upper) ->
            lessOrEqual supremum upper))

    square-root-nonnegative :
      (x : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR (squareRoot x)
    square-root-square :
      (x : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR x ->
      multiply (squareRoot x) (squareRoot x) == x
    square-root-nonpositive :
      (x : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x zeroR ->
      squareRoot x == zeroR
    square-root-unique :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR y ->
      multiply y y == x ->
      y == squareRoot x

open CompleteOrderedRealField

subtract :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
subtract reals x y =
  add reals x (negate reals y)

divide :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
divide reals x y =
  multiply reals x (inverse reals y)

square :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R
square reals x =
  multiply reals x x

fraction :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Nat ->
  Nat ->
  R
fraction reals numerator denominator =
  divide reals
    (fromNat reals numerator)
    (fromNat reals denominator)

quadratic :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
quadratic reals alpha t =
  add reals
    (add reals
      (multiply reals alpha (square reals t))
      (multiply reals alpha t))
    (fraction reals 1 24)

quadraticDerivative :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
quadraticDerivative reals alpha t =
  add reals
    (multiply reals
      (multiply reals (fromNat reals 2) alpha)
      t)
    alpha

TangentQuadraticCurves :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  Set
TangentQuadraticCurves {R} reals alpha =
  Exists R
    (\ x ->
      Exists R
        (\ y ->
          quadratic reals alpha x == y
          and
          quadratic reals alpha y == x
          and
          multiply reals
            (quadraticDerivative reals alpha x)
            (quadraticDerivative reals alpha y)
          == oneR reals))

Putnam2007A1Solution :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  Set
Putnam2007A1Solution reals alpha =
  alpha == fraction reals 2 3
  or
  alpha == fraction reals 3 2
  or
  alpha ==
    divide reals
      (add reals
        (fromNat reals 13)
        (squareRoot reals (fromNat reals 601)))
      (fromNat reals 12)
  or
  alpha ==
    divide reals
      (subtract reals
        (fromNat reals 13)
        (squareRoot reals (fromNat reals 601)))
      (fromNat reals 12)

putnam-2007-a1 : Set1
putnam-2007-a1 =
  (R : Set) ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) ->
  (alpha : R) ->
  Iff
    (TangentQuadraticCurves reals alpha)
    (Putnam2007A1Solution reals alpha)

  quadratic(alpha, t: real): real =
    alpha * t ^ 2 + alpha * t + 1 / 24

  quadratic_derivative(alpha, t: real): real =
    2 * alpha * t + alpha

  tangent_condition(alpha: real): bool =
    EXISTS (x, y: real):
      quadratic(alpha, x) = y
        AND quadratic(alpha, y) = x
        AND quadratic_derivative(alpha, x)
              * quadratic_derivative(alpha, y)
            = 1

  solution_parameter(alpha: real): bool =
    alpha = 2 / 3
      OR alpha = 3 / 2
      OR EXISTS (root: real):
        0 <= root
          AND root * root = 601
          AND (alpha = (13 + root) / 12
            OR alpha = (13 - root) / 12)

  putnam_2007_a1: bool =
    FORALL (alpha: real):
      tangent_condition(alpha) IFF solution_parameter(alpha)
END putnam_2007_a1

title: putnam_2007_a2
content:
(* Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2007_a2:
   four is the least planar Lebesgue area of a convex set meeting both
   branches of each hyperbola xy = 1 and xy = -1; this file contains no proof. *)

From Stdlib Require Import Reals.

Open Scope R_scope.

Definition putnam_2007_a2_point := (R * R)%type.
Definition putnam_2007_a2_point_set := putnam_2007_a2_point -> Prop.

Definition putnam_2007_a2_affine_combination
    (t : R) (p q : putnam_2007_a2_point) : putnam_2007_a2_point :=
  ((1 - t) * fst p + t * fst q,
   (1 - t) * snd p + t * snd q).

Definition putnam_2007_a2_convex
    (S : putnam_2007_a2_point_set) : Prop :=
  forall (p q : putnam_2007_a2_point) (t : R),
    S p ->
    S q ->
    0 <= t <= 1 ->
    S (putnam_2007_a2_affine_combination t p q).

Definition putnam_2007_a2_admissible
    (S : putnam_2007_a2_point_set) : Prop :=
  putnam_2007_a2_convex S /\
  (exists p : putnam_2007_a2_point,
    S p /\ 0 < fst p /\ 0 < snd p /\ fst p * snd p = 1) /\
  (exists p : putnam_2007_a2_point,
    S p /\ fst p < 0 /\ snd p < 0 /\ fst p * snd p = 1) /\
  (exists p : putnam_2007_a2_point,
    S p /\ fst p < 0 /\ 0 < snd p /\ fst p * snd p = -1) /\
  (exists p : putnam_2007_a2_point,
    S p /\ 0 < fst p /\ snd p < 0 /\ fst p * snd p = -1).

Record putnam_2007_a2_open_rectangle : Type := {
  putnam_2007_a2_x_lower : R;
  putnam_2007_a2_x_upper : R;
  putnam_2007_a2_y_lower : R;
  putnam_2007_a2_y_upper : R
}.

Definition putnam_2007_a2_in_open_rectangle
    (rectangle : putnam_2007_a2_open_rectangle)
    (p : putnam_2007_a2_point) : Prop :=
  putnam_2007_a2_x_lower rectangle < fst p <
    putnam_2007_a2_x_upper rectangle /\
  putnam_2007_a2_y_lower rectangle < snd p <
    putnam_2007_a2_y_upper rectangle.

Definition putnam_2007_a2_rectangle_area
    (rectangle : putnam_2007_a2_open_rectangle) : R :=
  Rmax 0
    (putnam_2007_a2_x_upper rectangle -
     putnam_2007_a2_x_lower rectangle) *
  Rmax 0
    (putnam_2007_a2_y_upper rectangle -
     putnam_2007_a2_y_lower rectangle).

Definition putnam_2007_a2_rectangles_cover
    (S : putnam_2007_a2_point_set)
    (rectangles : nat -> putnam_2007_a2_open_rectangle) : Prop :=
  forall p : putnam_2007_a2_point,
    S p ->
    exists n : nat,
      putnam_2007_a2_in_open_rectangle (rectangles n) p.

Fixpoint putnam_2007_a2_partial_rectangle_area
    (rectangles : nat -> putnam_2007_a2_open_rectangle)
    (n : nat) : R :=
  match n with
  | O => 0
  | S k =>
      putnam_2007_a2_partial_rectangle_area rectangles k +
      putnam_2007_a2_rectangle_area (rectangles k)
  end.

(* The countable-open-rectangle characterization of finite planar Lebesgue
   outer measure. *)
Definition putnam_2007_a2_has_planar_lebesgue_measure
    (S : putnam_2007_a2_point_set) (area : R) : Prop :=
  0 <= area /\
  (forall rectangles : nat -> putnam_2007_a2_open_rectangle,
    putnam_2007_a2_rectangles_cover S rectangles ->
    forall lower : R,
      lower < area ->
      exists n : nat,
        lower <
          putnam_2007_a2_partial_rectangle_area rectangles n) /\
  (forall epsilon : R,
    0 < epsilon ->
    exists rectangles : nat -> putnam_2007_a2_open_rectangle,
      putnam_2007_a2_rectangles_cover S rectangles /\
      forall n : nat,
        putnam_2007_a2_partial_rectangle_area rectangles n <
          area + epsilon).

Definition putnam_2007_a2_is_least_possible_area (area : R) : Prop :=
  (exists S : putnam_2007_a2_point_set,
    putnam_2007_a2_admissible S /\
    putnam_2007_a2_has_planar_lebesgue_measure S area) /\
  (forall (S : putnam_2007_a2_point_set) (candidate_area : R),
    putnam_2007_a2_admissible S ->
    putnam_2007_a2_has_planar_lebesgue_measure S candidate_area ->
    area <= candidate_area).

Theorem putnam_2007_a2 :
  putnam_2007_a2_is_least_possible_area 4.
Admitted.

  `let convex_planar =
     \(S:(real#real)->bool).
       !p q:real#real.
         p IN S /\ q IN S
         ==> !t:real.
               &0 <= t /\ t <= &1
               ==> ((&1 - t) * FST p + t * FST q,
                    (&1 - t) * SND p + t * SND q) IN S in
   let meets_all_branches =
     \(S:(real#real)->bool).
       (?p:real#real.
          p IN S /\
          &0 < FST p /\ &0 < SND p /\ FST p * SND p = &1) /\
       (?p:real#real.
          p IN S /\
          FST p < &0 /\ SND p < &0 /\ FST p * SND p = &1) /\
       (?p:real#real.
          p IN S /\
          FST p < &0 /\ &0 < SND p /\ FST p * SND p = -- &1) /\
       (?p:real#real.
          p IN S /\
          &0 < FST p /\ SND p < &0 /\ FST p * SND p = -- &1) in
   let cover_bound =
     \(S:(real#real)->bool) (B:real).
       &0 <= B /\
       ?xl xu yl yu:num->real.
         (!k:num. xl k <= xu k /\ yl k <= yu k) /\
         (!p:real#real.
            p IN S
            ==> ?k:num.
                  xl k < FST p /\ FST p < xu k /\
                  yl k < SND p /\ SND p < yu k) /\
         (!N:num.
            sum (0..N)
              (\k:num.
                 (xu k - xl k) * (yu k - yl k)) <= B) in
   let has_finite_area =
     \(S:(real#real)->bool) (area:real).
       (?B:real. cover_bound S B) /\
       area = inf {B:real | cover_bound S B} in
   let admissible =
     \(S:(real#real)->bool).
       convex_planar S /\ meets_all_branches S in
   (?S:(real#real)->bool. admissible S /\ has_finite_area S (&4)) /\
   (!y:real.
      (?S:(real#real)->bool. admissible S /\ has_finite_area S y)
      ==> &4 <= y)`;;

title: putnam_2007_a2
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2007_a2:
;; the least Lebesgue area of a convex subset of the real plane meeting both
;; branches of xy = 1 and both branches of xy = -1 is 4. This file contains
;; no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))

;; A Dedekind-complete ordered field presents the real numbers up to their
;; unique ordered-field isomorphism. Plane points are exact coordinate pairs,
;; and arbitrary planar sets and countable rectangle covers are unbounded tame
;; APPLY$ function objects.
;;
;; Planar Lebesgue outer area is the infimum of the convergent total areas of
;; countable open axis-aligned rectangle covers. Thus the lower-bound predicate
;; below also covers sets of infinite area. Since every convex subset of the
;; real plane is Lebesgue measurable, this outer-area formulation is
;; bidirectionally equivalent to the source use of volume. The final two
;; clauses are exactly membership and universal minimality for IsLeast at 4.

(defun p07a2-member-p (carrier value)
  (if (apply$ carrier (list value)) t nil))

(defun p07a2-unary-value (operation value)
  (apply$ operation (list value)))

(defun p07a2-binary-value (operation left right)
  (apply$ operation (list left right)))

(defun-sk p07a2-valid-scalar-set-p (carrier set)
  (forall (value)
    (implies
     (apply$ set (list value))
     (p07a2-member-p carrier value))))

(defun-sk p07a2-field-laws-p
    (carrier add multiply negate inverse zero one)
  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (p07a2-member-p carrier x)
      (p07a2-member-p carrier y)
      (p07a2-member-p carrier z))
     (and
      (p07a2-member-p
       carrier (p07a2-binary-value add x y))
      (p07a2-member-p
       carrier (p07a2-binary-value multiply x y))
      (p07a2-member-p
       carrier (p07a2-unary-value negate x))
      (implies
       (not (equal x zero))
       (p07a2-member-p
        carrier (p07a2-unary-value inverse x)))
      (equal
       (p07a2-binary-value
        add (p07a2-binary-value add x y) z)
       (p07a2-binary-value
        add x (p07a2-binary-value add y z)))
      (equal
       (p07a2-binary-value add x y)
       (p07a2-binary-value add y x))
      (equal (p07a2-binary-value add x zero) x)
      (equal
       (p07a2-binary-value
        add x (p07a2-unary-value negate x))
       zero)
      (equal
       (p07a2-binary-value
        multiply (p07a2-binary-value multiply x y) z)
       (p07a2-binary-value
        multiply x (p07a2-binary-value multiply y z)))
      (equal
       (p07a2-binary-value multiply x y)
       (p07a2-binary-value multiply y x))
      (equal (p07a2-binary-value multiply x one) x)
      (implies
       (equal x zero)
       (equal (p07a2-unary-value inverse x) zero))
      (implies
       (not (equal x zero))
       (equal
        (p07a2-binary-value
         multiply x (p07a2-unary-value inverse x))
        one))
      (equal
       (p07a2-binary-value
        multiply x (p07a2-binary-value add y z))
       (p07a2-binary-value
        add
        (p07a2-binary-value multiply x y)
        (p07a2-binary-value multiply x z)))))))

(defun-sk p07a2-order-laws-p
    (carrier add multiply zero less)
  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (p07a2-member-p carrier x)
      (p07a2-member-p carrier y)
      (p07a2-member-p carrier z))
     (and
      (not (p07a2-binary-value less x x))
      (or
       (equal x y)
       (p07a2-binary-value less x y)
       (p07a2-binary-value less y x))
      (implies
       (and
        (p07a2-binary-value less x y)
        (p07a2-binary-value less y z))
       (p07a2-binary-value less x z))
      (implies
       (p07a2-binary-value less x y)
       (p07a2-binary-value
        less
        (p07a2-binary-value add x z)
        (p07a2-binary-value add y z)))
      (implies
       (and
        (p07a2-binary-value less zero x)
        (p07a2-binary-value less zero y))
       (p07a2-binary-value
        less zero (p07a2-binary-value multiply x y)))))))

(defun-sk p07a2-scalar-set-nonempty-p (carrier set)
  (exists (value)
    (and
     (p07a2-member-p carrier value)
     (apply$ set (list value)))))

(defun-sk p07a2-upper-bound-p (carrier less set bound)
  (forall (value)
    (implies
     (and
      (p07a2-member-p carrier value)
      (apply$ set (list value)))
     (not (p07a2-binary-value less bound value)))))

(defun-sk p07a2-bounded-above-p (carrier less set)
  (exists (bound)
    (and
     (p07a2-member-p carrier bound)
     (p07a2-upper-bound-p carrier less set bound))))

(defun-sk p07a2-supremum-p (carrier less set supremum)
  (forall (bound)
    (and
     (p07a2-member-p carrier supremum)
     (p07a2-upper-bound-p carrier less set supremum)
     (implies
      (and
       (p07a2-member-p carrier bound)
       (p07a2-upper-bound-p carrier less set bound))
      (not (p07a2-binary-value less bound supremum))))))

(defun-sk p07a2-has-supremum-p (carrier less set)
  (exists (supremum)
    (p07a2-supremum-p carrier less set supremum)))

(defun-sk p07a2-dedekind-complete-p (carrier less)
  (forall (set)
    (implies
     (and
      (tamep-functionp set)
      (p07a2-valid-scalar-set-p carrier set)
      (p07a2-scalar-set-nonempty-p carrier set)
      (p07a2-bounded-above-p carrier less set))
     (p07a2-has-supremum-p carrier less set))))

(defun p07a2-real-field-p
    (carrier add multiply negate inverse zero one less)
  (and
   (tamep-functionp carrier)
   (tamep-functionp add)
   (tamep-functionp multiply)
   (tamep-functionp negate)
   (tamep-functionp inverse)
   (tamep-functionp less)
   (p07a2-member-p carrier zero)
   (p07a2-member-p carrier one)
   (not (equal zero one))
   (p07a2-field-laws-p
    carrier add multiply negate inverse zero one)
   (p07a2-order-laws-p carrier add multiply zero less)
   (p07a2-binary-value less zero one)
   (p07a2-dedekind-complete-p carrier less)))

(defun p07a2-r-carrier (ctx) (nth 0 ctx))
(defun p07a2-r-zero (ctx) (nth 1 ctx))
(defun p07a2-r-one (ctx) (nth 2 ctx))
(defun p07a2-r-add (ctx) (nth 3 ctx))
(defun p07a2-r-mul (ctx) (nth 4 ctx))
(defun p07a2-r-neg (ctx) (nth 5 ctx))
(defun p07a2-r-inv (ctx) (nth 6 ctx))
(defun p07a2-r-lt (ctx) (nth 7 ctx))

(defun p07a2-context-p (ctx)
  (and
   (true-listp ctx)
   (equal (len ctx) 8)
   (p07a2-real-field-p
    (p07a2-r-carrier ctx)
    (p07a2-r-add ctx)
    (p07a2-r-mul ctx)
    (p07a2-r-neg ctx)
    (p07a2-r-inv ctx)
    (p07a2-r-zero ctx)
    (p07a2-r-one ctx)
    (p07a2-r-lt ctx))))

(defun p07a2-r-add-value (ctx left right)
  (p07a2-binary-value (p07a2-r-add ctx) left right))

(defun p07a2-r-mul-value (ctx left right)
  (p07a2-binary-value (p07a2-r-mul ctx) left right))

(defun p07a2-r-neg-value (ctx value)
  (p07a2-unary-value (p07a2-r-neg ctx) value))

(defun p07a2-r-sub-value (ctx left right)
  (p07a2-r-add-value
   ctx left (p07a2-r-neg-value ctx right)))

(defun p07a2-r-lt-p (ctx left right)
  (if (p07a2-binary-value
       (p07a2-r-lt ctx) left right)
      t
    nil))

(defun p07a2-r-le-p (ctx left right)
  (not (p07a2-r-lt-p ctx right left)))

(defun p07a2-r-abs-value (ctx value)
  (if (p07a2-r-lt-p
       ctx value (p07a2-r-zero ctx))
      (p07a2-r-neg-value ctx value)
    value))

(defun p07a2-positive-real-p (ctx value)
  (and
   (p07a2-member-p (p07a2-r-carrier ctx) value)
   (p07a2-r-lt-p
    ctx (p07a2-r-zero ctx) value)))

(defun p07a2-nonnegative-real-p (ctx value)
  (and
   (p07a2-member-p (p07a2-r-carrier ctx) value)
   (p07a2-r-le-p
    ctx (p07a2-r-zero ctx) value)))

(defun p07a2-two (ctx)
  (p07a2-r-add-value
   ctx (p07a2-r-one ctx) (p07a2-r-one ctx)))

(defun p07a2-four (ctx)
  (let ((two (p07a2-two ctx)))
    (p07a2-r-add-value ctx two two)))

(defun p07a2-point-p (ctx point)
  (and
   (true-listp point)
   (equal (len point) 2)
   (p07a2-member-p
    (p07a2-r-carrier ctx) (nth 0 point))
   (p07a2-member-p
    (p07a2-r-carrier ctx) (nth 1 point))))

(defun p07a2-set-member-p (set point)
  (if (apply$ set (list point)) t nil))

(defun-sk p07a2-valid-plane-set-p (ctx set)
  (forall (point)
    (implies
     (p07a2-set-member-p set point)
     (p07a2-point-p ctx point))))

(defun p07a2-scale-point (ctx scalar point)
  (list
   (p07a2-r-mul-value ctx scalar (nth 0 point))
   (p07a2-r-mul-value ctx scalar (nth 1 point))))

(defun p07a2-add-points (ctx left right)
  (list
   (p07a2-r-add-value
    ctx (nth 0 left) (nth 0 right))
   (p07a2-r-add-value
    ctx (nth 1 left) (nth 1 right))))

(defun-sk p07a2-convex-set-p (ctx set)
  (forall (a b left right)
    (implies
     (and
      (p07a2-nonnegative-real-p ctx a)
      (p07a2-nonnegative-real-p ctx b)
      (equal
       (p07a2-r-add-value ctx a b)
       (p07a2-r-one ctx))
      (p07a2-point-p ctx left)
      (p07a2-point-p ctx right)
      (p07a2-set-member-p set left)
      (p07a2-set-member-p set right))
     (p07a2-set-member-p
      set
      (p07a2-add-points
       ctx
       (p07a2-scale-point ctx a left)
       (p07a2-scale-point ctx b right))))))

(defun-sk p07a2-first-branch-positive-p (ctx set)
  (exists (x y)
    (and
     (p07a2-member-p (p07a2-r-carrier ctx) x)
     (p07a2-member-p (p07a2-r-carrier ctx) y)
     (p07a2-r-lt-p ctx (p07a2-r-zero ctx) x)
     (p07a2-r-lt-p ctx (p07a2-r-zero ctx) y)
     (equal
      (p07a2-r-mul-value ctx x y)
      (p07a2-r-one ctx))
     (p07a2-set-member-p set (list x y)))))

(defun-sk p07a2-first-branch-negative-p (ctx set)
  (exists (x y)
    (and
     (p07a2-member-p (p07a2-r-carrier ctx) x)
     (p07a2-member-p (p07a2-r-carrier ctx) y)
     (p07a2-r-lt-p ctx x (p07a2-r-zero ctx))
     (p07a2-r-lt-p ctx y (p07a2-r-zero ctx))
     (equal
      (p07a2-r-mul-value ctx x y)
      (p07a2-r-one ctx))
     (p07a2-set-member-p set (list x y)))))

(defun-sk p07a2-second-branch-upper-p (ctx set)
  (exists (x y)
    (and
     (p07a2-member-p (p07a2-r-carrier ctx) x)
     (p07a2-member-p (p07a2-r-carrier ctx) y)
     (p07a2-r-lt-p ctx x (p07a2-r-zero ctx))
     (p07a2-r-lt-p ctx (p07a2-r-zero ctx) y)
     (equal
      (p07a2-r-mul-value ctx x y)
      (p07a2-r-neg-value ctx (p07a2-r-one ctx)))
     (p07a2-set-member-p set (list x y)))))

(defun-sk p07a2-second-branch-lower-p (ctx set)
  (exists (x y)
    (and
     (p07a2-member-p (p07a2-r-carrier ctx) x)
     (p07a2-member-p (p07a2-r-carrier ctx) y)
     (p07a2-r-lt-p ctx (p07a2-r-zero ctx) x)
     (p07a2-r-lt-p ctx y (p07a2-r-zero ctx))
     (equal
      (p07a2-r-mul-value ctx x y)
      (p07a2-r-neg-value ctx (p07a2-r-one ctx)))
     (p07a2-set-member-p set (list x y)))))

(defun p07a2-feasible-set-p (ctx set)
  (and
   (tamep-functionp set)
   (p07a2-valid-plane-set-p ctx set)
   (p07a2-convex-set-p ctx set)
   (p07a2-first-branch-positive-p ctx set)
   (p07a2-first-branch-negative-p ctx set)
   (p07a2-second-branch-upper-p ctx set)
   (p07a2-second-branch-lower-p ctx set)))

;; A rectangle is (x-lower x-upper y-lower y-upper). Membership uses strict
;; inequalities, so a degenerate rectangle is empty and has area zero.

(defun p07a2-rectangle-p (ctx rectangle)
  (and
   (true-listp rectangle)
   (equal (len rectangle) 4)
   (p07a2-member-p
    (p07a2-r-carrier ctx) (nth 0 rectangle))
   (p07a2-member-p
    (p07a2-r-carrier ctx) (nth 1 rectangle))
   (p07a2-member-p
    (p07a2-r-carrier ctx) (nth 2 rectangle))
   (p07a2-member-p
    (p07a2-r-carrier ctx) (nth 3 rectangle))
   (p07a2-r-le-p
    ctx (nth 0 rectangle) (nth 1 rectangle))
   (p07a2-r-le-p
    ctx (nth 2 rectangle) (nth 3 rectangle))))

(defun p07a2-point-in-rectangle-p (ctx point rectangle)
  (and
   (p07a2-point-p ctx point)
   (p07a2-rectangle-p ctx rectangle)
   (p07a2-r-lt-p
    ctx (nth 0 rectangle) (nth 0 point))
   (p07a2-r-lt-p
    ctx (nth 0 point) (nth 1 rectangle))
   (p07a2-r-lt-p
    ctx (nth 2 rectangle) (nth 1 point))
   (p07a2-r-lt-p
    ctx (nth 1 point) (nth 3 rectangle))))

(defun p07a2-rectangle-area (ctx rectangle)
  (p07a2-r-mul-value
   ctx
   (p07a2-r-sub-value
    ctx (nth 1 rectangle) (nth 0 rectangle))
   (p07a2-r-sub-value
    ctx (nth 3 rectangle) (nth 2 rectangle))))

(defun p07a2-cover-rectangle (cover index)
  (apply$ cover (list index)))

(defun-sk p07a2-valid-rectangle-cover-sequence-p
    (ctx cover)
  (forall (index)
    (implies
     (natp index)
     (p07a2-rectangle-p
      ctx (p07a2-cover-rectangle cover index)))))

(defun p07a2-cover-partial-area (ctx cover count)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix count)))
  (if (zp count)
      (p07a2-r-zero ctx)
    (let ((index (- (nfix count) 1)))
      (p07a2-r-add-value
       ctx
       (p07a2-cover-partial-area ctx cover index)
       (p07a2-rectangle-area
        ctx (p07a2-cover-rectangle cover index))))))

(defun-sk p07a2-cover-area-tail-p
    (ctx cover total epsilon cutoff)
  (forall (count)
    (implies
     (and
      (natp count)
      (natp cutoff)
      (<= cutoff count))
     (p07a2-r-lt-p
      ctx
      (p07a2-r-abs-value
       ctx
       (p07a2-r-sub-value
        ctx
        (p07a2-cover-partial-area ctx cover count)
        total))
      epsilon))))

(defun-sk p07a2-cover-area-cutoff-exists-p
    (ctx cover total epsilon)
  (exists (cutoff)
    (and
     (natp cutoff)
     (p07a2-cover-area-tail-p
      ctx cover total epsilon cutoff))))

(defun-sk p07a2-cover-area-converges-to-p
    (ctx cover total)
  (forall (epsilon)
    (implies
     (p07a2-positive-real-p ctx epsilon)
     (p07a2-cover-area-cutoff-exists-p
      ctx cover total epsilon))))

(defun p07a2-finite-cover-cost-p (ctx cover total)
  (and
   (tamep-functionp cover)
   (p07a2-valid-rectangle-cover-sequence-p ctx cover)
   (p07a2-nonnegative-real-p ctx total)
   (p07a2-cover-area-converges-to-p
    ctx cover total)))

(defun-sk p07a2-set-point-covered-p
    (ctx cover point)
  (exists (index)
    (and
     (natp index)
     (p07a2-point-in-rectangle-p
      ctx point (p07a2-cover-rectangle cover index)))))

(defun-sk p07a2-set-cover-p (ctx set cover)
  (forall (point)
    (implies
     (and
      (p07a2-point-p ctx point)
      (p07a2-set-member-p set point))
     (p07a2-set-point-covered-p
      ctx cover point))))

;; AREA is the infimum of all finite total costs of countable open-rectangle
;; covers: it is a lower bound, and covers occur within every positive
;; epsilon above it.

(defun-sk p07a2-area-lower-bound-p (ctx set area)
  (forall (cover total)
    (implies
     (and
      (p07a2-finite-cover-cost-p ctx cover total)
      (p07a2-set-cover-p ctx set cover))
     (p07a2-r-le-p ctx area total))))

(defun-sk p07a2-near-cover-exists-p
    (ctx set area epsilon)
  (exists (cover total)
    (and
     (p07a2-finite-cover-cost-p ctx cover total)
     (p07a2-set-cover-p ctx set cover)
     (p07a2-r-lt-p
      ctx total (p07a2-r-add-value ctx area epsilon)))))

(defun-sk p07a2-near-covers-p (ctx set area)
  (forall (epsilon)
    (implies
     (p07a2-positive-real-p ctx epsilon)
     (p07a2-near-cover-exists-p
      ctx set area epsilon))))

(defun p07a2-outer-area-p (ctx set area)
  (and
   (p07a2-nonnegative-real-p ctx area)
   (p07a2-area-lower-bound-p ctx set area)
   (p07a2-near-covers-p ctx set area)))

(defun-sk p07a2-four-attained-p (ctx)
  (exists (set)
    (and
     (p07a2-feasible-set-p ctx set)
     (p07a2-outer-area-p
      ctx set (p07a2-four ctx)))))

(defun-sk p07a2-four-lower-bound-p (ctx)
  (forall (set)
    (implies
     (p07a2-feasible-set-p ctx set)
     (p07a2-area-lower-bound-p
      ctx set (p07a2-four ctx)))))

(defun-sk putnambench-putnam-2007-a2-statement ()
  (forall (ctx)
    (implies
     (p07a2-context-p ctx)
     (and
      (p07a2-four-attained-p ctx)
      (p07a2-four-lower-bound-p ctx)))))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

title: putnam_2007_a2
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2007_a2
-- (putnambench__agda__putnam_2007_a2): the least Lebesgue area of a convex
-- planar set meeting both branches of xy = 1 and both branches of xy = -1
-- is four. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module Putnam2007A2 where

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; _*_)

infix 4 _!=_ _<=N_
infixr 3 _and_
infixr 2 _or_

data Bottom : Set where

Not : Set -> Set
Not A =
  A -> Bottom

_!=_ : {A : Set} -> A -> A -> Set
x != y =
  Not (x == y)

record _and_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data _or_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  left  : A -> A or B
  right : B -> A or B

record Iff (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor equivalence
  field
    forward  : A -> B
    backward : B -> A

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

data _<=N_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set where
  zero<=   : {n : Nat} -> zero <=N n
  suc<=suc : {m n : Nat} -> m <=N n -> suc m <=N suc n

record CompleteOrderedRealField (R : Set) : Set1 where
  field
    zeroR oneR : R
    add multiply : R -> R -> R
    negate inverse : R -> R
    lessOrEqual : R -> R -> Set
    fromNat : Nat -> R

    one-not-zero :
      oneR != zeroR

    add-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> add x y == add y x
    add-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      add (add x y) z == add x (add y z)
    add-zero :
      (x : R) -> add x zeroR == x
    add-inverse :
      (x : R) -> add x (negate x) == zeroR
    negate-involutive :
      (x : R) -> negate (negate x) == x

    multiply-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> multiply x y == multiply y x
    multiply-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply (multiply x y) z ==
      multiply x (multiply y z)
    multiply-one :
      (x : R) -> multiply x oneR == x
    multiply-zero :
      (x : R) -> multiply x zeroR == zeroR
    distribute :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply x (add y z) ==
      add (multiply x y) (multiply x z)
    inverse-zero :
      inverse zeroR == zeroR
    multiply-inverse :
      (x : R) ->
      x != zeroR ->
      multiply x (inverse x) == oneR

    order-reflexive :
      (x : R) -> lessOrEqual x x
    order-transitive :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y z ->
      lessOrEqual x z
    order-antisymmetric :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y x ->
      x == y
    order-total :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y or lessOrEqual y x
    add-order :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual (add z x) (add z y)
    multiply-nonnegative :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR x ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR y ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR (multiply x y)
    zero-less-than-one :
      lessOrEqual zeroR oneR and zeroR != oneR

    fromNat-zero :
      fromNat zero == zeroR
    fromNat-successor :
      (n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (suc n) == add (fromNat n) oneR
    fromNat-addition :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m + n) == add (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-multiplication :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m * n) == multiply (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-injective :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat m == fromNat n ->
      m == n

    archimedean :
      (x : R) ->
      Exists Nat (\ n -> lessOrEqual x (fromNat n))
    least-upper-bound :
      (P : R -> Set) ->
      Exists R P ->
      Exists R
        (\ upper ->
          (x : R) ->
          P x ->
          lessOrEqual x upper) ->
      Exists R
        (\ supremum ->
          ((x : R) ->
            P x ->
            lessOrEqual x supremum)
          and
          ((upper : R) ->
            ((x : R) ->
              P x ->
              lessOrEqual x upper) ->
            lessOrEqual supremum upper))

open CompleteOrderedRealField

subtract :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
subtract reals x y =
  add reals x (negate reals y)

StrictLess :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
StrictLess reals x y =
  lessOrEqual reals x y and x != y

record Point (R : Set) : Set where
  constructor point
  field
    firstCoordinate  : R
    secondCoordinate : R

open Point

Region : Set -> Set1
Region R =
  Point R -> Set

addPoint :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Point R ->
  Point R ->
  Point R
addPoint reals p q =
  point
    (add reals
      (firstCoordinate p)
      (firstCoordinate q))
    (add reals
      (secondCoordinate p)
      (secondCoordinate q))

scalePoint :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  Point R ->
  Point R
scalePoint reals scalar p =
  point
    (multiply reals scalar (firstCoordinate p))
    (multiply reals scalar (secondCoordinate p))

linearCombination :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  Point R ->
  Point R ->
  Point R
linearCombination reals t p q =
  addPoint reals
    (scalePoint reals t p)
    (scalePoint reals
      (subtract reals (oneR reals) t)
      q)

Convex :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Region R ->
  Set
Convex {R} reals body =
  (p q : Point R) ->
  body p ->
  body q ->
  (t : R) ->
  lessOrEqual reals (zeroR reals) t ->
  lessOrEqual reals t (oneR reals) ->
  body (linearCombination reals t p q)

Empty :
  {R : Set} ->
  Region R
Empty _ =
  Bottom

Complement :
  {R : Set} ->
  Region R ->
  Region R
Complement body p =
  Not (body p)

UnionAll :
  {R : Set} ->
  (Nat -> Region R) ->
  Region R
UnionAll bodies p =
  Exists Nat (\ n -> bodies n p)

Disjoint :
  {R : Set} ->
  Region R ->
  Region R ->
  Set
Disjoint {R} leftBody rightBody =
  (p : Point R) ->
  leftBody p ->
  rightBody p ->
  Bottom

PairwiseDisjoint :
  {R : Set} ->
  (Nat -> Region R) ->
  Set
PairwiseDisjoint bodies =
  (m n : Nat) ->
  m != n ->
  Disjoint (bodies m) (bodies n)

translateRegion :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Point R ->
  Region R ->
  Region R
translateRegion {R} reals offset body p =
  Exists (Point R)
    (\ q ->
      body q
      and
      p == addPoint reals offset q)

HalfOpenBox :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Point R ->
  Point R ->
  Region R
HalfOpenBox reals lower upper p =
  (lessOrEqual reals
    (firstCoordinate lower)
    (firstCoordinate p)
  and
  StrictLess reals
    (firstCoordinate p)
    (firstCoordinate upper))
  and
  (lessOrEqual reals
    (secondCoordinate lower)
    (secondCoordinate p)
  and
  StrictLess reals
    (secondCoordinate p)
    (secondCoordinate upper))

data ExtendedNonnegative (R : Set) : Set where
  finite   : R -> ExtendedNonnegative R
  infinity : ExtendedNonnegative R

data ExtendedLessOrEqual
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) :
  ExtendedNonnegative R ->
  ExtendedNonnegative R ->
  Set where

  finite<=finite :
    {x y : R} ->
    lessOrEqual reals x y ->
    ExtendedLessOrEqual reals (finite x) (finite y)

  finite<=infinity :
    {x : R} ->
    ExtendedLessOrEqual reals (finite x) infinity

  infinity<=infinity :
    ExtendedLessOrEqual reals infinity infinity

addExtended :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  ExtendedNonnegative R ->
  ExtendedNonnegative R ->
  ExtendedNonnegative R
addExtended reals infinity rightValue =
  infinity
addExtended reals (finite x) infinity =
  infinity
addExtended reals (finite x) (finite y) =
  finite (add reals x y)

sumFirstExtended :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Nat ->
  (Nat -> ExtendedNonnegative R) ->
  ExtendedNonnegative R
sumFirstExtended reals zero term =
  finite (zeroR reals)
sumFirstExtended reals (suc n) term =
  addExtended reals
    (sumFirstExtended reals n term)
    (term n)

UpperBoundExtended :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (Nat -> ExtendedNonnegative R) ->
  ExtendedNonnegative R ->
  Set
UpperBoundExtended reals values bound =
  (n : Nat) ->
  ExtendedLessOrEqual reals (values n) bound

LeastUpperBoundExtended :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (Nat -> ExtendedNonnegative R) ->
  ExtendedNonnegative R ->
  Set
LeastUpperBoundExtended reals values supremum =
  UpperBoundExtended reals values supremum
  and
  ((upper : ExtendedNonnegative _) ->
    UpperBoundExtended reals values upper ->
    ExtendedLessOrEqual reals supremum upper)

record StandardPlaneLebesgueMeasure
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) :
  Set1 where

  field
    measurable : Region R -> Set
    volume : Region R -> ExtendedNonnegative R

    measurable-empty :
      measurable Empty
    measurable-complement :
      (body : Region R) ->
      measurable body ->
      measurable (Complement body)
    measurable-countable-union :
      (bodies : Nat -> Region R) ->
      ((n : Nat) -> measurable (bodies n)) ->
      measurable (UnionAll bodies)
    measurable-translation :
      (offset : Point R) ->
      (body : Region R) ->
      measurable body ->
      measurable (translateRegion reals offset body)
    measurable-box :
      (lower upper : Point R) ->
      measurable (HalfOpenBox reals lower upper)
    convex-measurable :
      (body : Region R) ->
      Convex reals body ->
      measurable body

    volume-congruent :
      (leftBody rightBody : Region R) ->
      ((p : Point R) ->
        Iff (leftBody p) (rightBody p)) ->
      volume leftBody == volume rightBody
    volume-empty :
      volume Empty == finite (zeroR reals)
    volume-nonnegative :
      (body : Region R) ->
      measurable body ->
      ExtendedLessOrEqual reals
        (finite (zeroR reals))
        (volume body)
    volume-countable-additive :
      (bodies : Nat -> Region R) ->
      ((n : Nat) -> measurable (bodies n)) ->
      PairwiseDisjoint bodies ->
      LeastUpperBoundExtended reals
        (\ count ->
          sumFirstExtended reals count
            (\ n -> volume (bodies n)))
        (volume (UnionAll bodies))
    volume-translation-invariant :
      (offset : Point R) ->
      (body : Region R) ->
      measurable body ->
      volume (translateRegion reals offset body) ==
      volume body
    volume-box :
      (lower upper : Point R) ->
      lessOrEqual reals
        (firstCoordinate lower)
        (firstCoordinate upper) ->
      lessOrEqual reals
        (secondCoordinate lower)
        (secondCoordinate upper) ->
      volume (HalfOpenBox reals lower upper) ==
      finite
        (multiply reals
          (subtract reals
            (firstCoordinate upper)
            (firstCoordinate lower))
          (subtract reals
            (secondCoordinate upper)
            (secondCoordinate lower)))

open StandardPlaneLebesgueMeasure

fourN : Nat
fourN =
  suc (suc (suc (suc zero)))

module Putnam2007A2Statement
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R)
  (lebesgue : StandardPlaneLebesgueMeasure reals) where

  OnPositiveBranchPositiveQuadrant :
    Point R ->
    Set
  OnPositiveBranchPositiveQuadrant p =
    StrictLess reals
      (zeroR reals)
      (firstCoordinate p)
    and
    StrictLess reals
      (zeroR reals)
      (secondCoordinate p)
    and
    multiply reals
      (firstCoordinate p)
      (secondCoordinate p)
      == oneR reals

  OnPositiveBranchNegativeQuadrant :
    Point R ->
    Set
  OnPositiveBranchNegativeQuadrant p =
    StrictLess reals
      (firstCoordinate p)
      (zeroR reals)
    and
    StrictLess reals
      (secondCoordinate p)
      (zeroR reals)
    and
    multiply reals
      (firstCoordinate p)
      (secondCoordinate p)
      == oneR reals

  OnNegativeBranchNorthwest :
    Point R ->
    Set
  OnNegativeBranchNorthwest p =
    StrictLess reals
      (firstCoordinate p)
      (zeroR reals)
    and
    StrictLess reals
      (zeroR reals)
      (secondCoordinate p)
    and
    multiply reals
      (firstCoordinate p)
      (secondCoordinate p)
      == negate reals (oneR reals)

  OnNegativeBranchSoutheast :
    Point R ->
    Set
  OnNegativeBranchSoutheast p =
    StrictLess reals
      (zeroR reals)
      (firstCoordinate p)
    and
    StrictLess reals
      (secondCoordinate p)
      (zeroR reals)
    and
    multiply reals
      (firstCoordinate p)
      (secondCoordinate p)
      == negate reals (oneR reals)

  Meets :
    Region R ->
    (Point R -> Set) ->
    Set
  Meets body locus =
    Exists (Point R)
      (\ p ->
        body p
        and
        locus p)

  Qualifying :
    Region R ->
    Set
  Qualifying body =
    Convex reals body
    and
    Meets body OnPositiveBranchPositiveQuadrant
    and
    Meets body OnPositiveBranchNegativeQuadrant
    and
    Meets body OnNegativeBranchNorthwest
    and
    Meets body OnNegativeBranchSoutheast

  record AttainableArea
    (candidate : ExtendedNonnegative R) :
    Set1 where

    field
      body : Region R
      qualifying : Qualifying body
      has-area : volume lebesgue body == candidate

  record IsLeastArea
    (answer : ExtendedNonnegative R) :
    Set1 where

    field
      attained : AttainableArea answer
      lower-bound :
        (candidate : ExtendedNonnegative R) ->
        AttainableArea candidate ->
        ExtendedLessOrEqual reals answer candidate

  proposition : Set1
  proposition =
    IsLeastArea (finite (fromNat reals fourN))

putnam-2007-a2 : Set1
putnam-2007-a2 =
  (R : Set) ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) ->
  (lebesgue : StandardPlaneLebesgueMeasure reals) ->
  Putnam2007A2Statement.proposition reals lebesgue

title: putnam_2007_a2
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2007_a2:
  the least possible Lebesgue area of a convex plane set meeting both branches
  of xy = 1 and both branches of xy = -1 is four. This file contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open pairTheory pred_setTheory realTheory;
open extrealTheory measureTheory lebesgue_measureTheory martingaleTheory;

val putnam_2007_a2 =
  ``let convex_plane =
      \S : (real # real) set.
        !P Q : real # real. !u : real.
          P IN S /\ Q IN S /\ 0 <= u /\ u <= 1
          ==>
          ((1 - u) * FST P + u * FST Q,
           (1 - u) * SND P + u * SND Q) IN S
    in
    let meets_all_branches =
      \S : (real # real) set.
        (?P : real # real.
           P IN S /\ 0 < FST P /\ 0 < SND P /\ FST P * SND P = 1) /\
        (?P : real # real.
           P IN S /\ FST P < 0 /\ SND P < 0 /\ FST P * SND P = 1) /\
        (?P : real # real.
           P IN S /\ FST P < 0 /\ 0 < SND P /\ FST P * SND P = -1) /\
        (?P : real # real.
           P IN S /\ 0 < FST P /\ SND P < 0 /\ FST P * SND P = -1)
    in
    let admissible =
      \S : (real # real) set.
        convex_plane S /\ meets_all_branches S
    in
    let area =
      measure (prod_measure_space lebesgue lebesgue)
    in
      (?S : (real # real) set.
         admissible S /\ area S = Normal 4) /\
      (!S : (real # real) set.
         admissible S ==> Normal 4 <= area S)``;

title: putnam_2007_a2
content:
$(
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact
  putnam_2007_a2: the least possible Lebesgue area of a convex subset of
  the real plane meeting both branches of xy = 1 and both branches of
  xy = -1 is four. This file contains no proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  P07A2R2 is the full real coordinate plane, with source coordinates 0 and 1
  relabeled as 1 and 2. P07A2Convex expands real convexity coordinatewise.
  P07A2Admissible keeps all four hyperbola-intersection points as internal
  existential witnesses, and P07A2Area is two-dimensional Lebesgue measure
  via set.mm's finite-dimensional volume function voln.

  The final conjunction is equivalent to saying that 4 is the least member
  of the set of areas of admissible sets: its first conjunct gives membership
  and its second gives the lower-bound property. All declarations are
  unproved $a statement encodings; this database contains no $p proof
  statement.
$)

$c P07A2I P07A2R2 P07A2Convex P07A2Admissible P07A2Area $.

p07a2-index-syntax $a class P07A2I $.
p07a2-plane-syntax $a class P07A2R2 $.
p07a2-convex-syntax $a wff ( P07A2Convex A ) $.
p07a2-admissible-syntax $a wff ( P07A2Admissible A ) $.
p07a2-area-syntax $a class ( P07A2Area A ) $.

p07a2-index-definition $a |- P07A2I = ( 1 ... 2 ) $.

p07a2-plane-definition $a |- P07A2R2 = ( RR ^m P07A2I ) $.

${
  $d A j t x y $.

  p07a2-convex-definition $a |- (
    ( P07A2Convex A )
    <->
    (
      A C_ P07A2R2
      /\
      A. x e. A A. y e. A A. t e. ( 0 [,] 1 )
        (
          j e. P07A2I |->
            (
              ( ( 1 - t ) x. ( x ` j ) )
              +
              ( t x. ( y ` j ) )
            )
        )
        e. A
    )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d A p $.

  p07a2-admissible-definition $a |- (
    ( P07A2Admissible A )
    <->
    (
      ( P07A2Convex A )
      /\
      (
        E. p e. A
          (
            (
              0 < ( p ` 1 )
              /\
              0 < ( p ` 2 )
            )
            /\
            ( ( p ` 1 ) x. ( p ` 2 ) ) = 1
          )
        /\
        (
          E. p e. A
            (
              (
                ( p ` 1 ) < 0
                /\
                ( p ` 2 ) < 0
              )
              /\
              ( ( p ` 1 ) x. ( p ` 2 ) ) = 1
            )
          /\
          (
            E. p e. A
              (
                (
                  ( p ` 1 ) < 0
                  /\
                  0 < ( p ` 2 )
                )
                /\
                ( ( p ` 1 ) x. ( p ` 2 ) ) = ( -u 1 )
              )
            /\
            E. p e. A
              (
                (
                  0 < ( p ` 1 )
                  /\
                  ( p ` 2 ) < 0
                )
                /\
                ( ( p ` 1 ) x. ( p ` 2 ) ) = ( -u 1 )
              )
          )
        )
      )
    )
  ) $.
$}

p07a2-area-definition $a |- (
  P07A2Area A
) = (
  ( voln ` P07A2I )
  `
  A
) $.

${
  $d A S $.

  putnambench-putnam-2007-a2 $a |- (
    E. S e. ~P P07A2R2
      (
        ( P07A2Admissible S )
        /\
        ( P07A2Area S ) = 4
      )
    /\
    A. A e. ~P P07A2R2
      (
        ( P07A2Admissible A )
        ->
        4 <_ ( P07A2Area A )
      )
  ) $.
$}
