(*
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2007_b2:
  an integral bound for a continuously differentiable real function on the
  unit interval with zero integral. This file contains no proof.
*)

let analysis_output = open_out "/dev/null";;
let analysis_formatter = Format.formatter_of_out_channel analysis_output;;
let analysis_loaded =
  Toploop.use_file analysis_formatter "Library/transc.ml";;
Format.pp_print_flush analysis_formatter ();;
close_out analysis_output;;
if not analysis_loaded then failwith "failed to load Library/transc.ml";;

let statement =
  `let in_domain = \x:real. &0 <= x /\ x <= &1 in
   let has_derivative_on =
     \(f:real->real) (d:real) (x:real).
       !e:real.
         &0 < e
         ==> ?delta:real.
               &0 < delta /\
               !y:real.
                 in_domain y /\
                 ~(y = x) /\
                 abs (y - x) < delta
                 ==> abs ((f y - f x) / (y - x) - d) < e in
   let continuous_on =
     \(g:real->real).
       !x:real.
         in_domain x
         ==> !e:real.
               &0 < e
               ==> ?delta:real.
                     &0 < delta /\
                     !y:real.
                       in_domain y /\ abs (y - x) < delta
                       ==> abs (g y - g x) < e in
   !f:real->real. !m:real.
     ((?f':real->real.
         (!x:real.
            in_domain x ==> has_derivative_on f (f' x) x) /\
         continuous_on f' /\
         (?x:real. in_domain x /\ abs (f' x) = m) /\
         (!x:real. in_domain x ==> abs (f' x) <= m)) /\
      integral(&0,&1) f = &0)
     ==>
     !a:real.
       &0 < a /\ a < &1
       ==> abs (integral(&0,a) f) <= (&1 / &8) * m`;;

title: putnam_2007_b2
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2007_b2:
;; an integral bound for every arbitrary continuously differentiable real
;; function on [0,1] whose integral is zero. This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))

;; Conservative interfaces for an arbitrary real field, its subsets, and an
;; arbitrary real-valued function.  The context parameter keeps the function
;; and scalar structure generic; none of them is represented by a finite table.

(defstub p07b2-real-p (ctx x) t)
(defstub p07b2-zero (ctx) t)
(defstub p07b2-one (ctx) t)
(defstub p07b2-add (ctx x y) t)
(defstub p07b2-mul (ctx x y) t)
(defstub p07b2-neg (ctx x) t)
(defstub p07b2-inv (ctx x) t)
(defstub p07b2-lt (ctx x y) t)
(defstub p07b2-set-member-p (ctx set x) t)
(defstub p07b2-f (ctx x) t)

(defun p07b2-sub (ctx x y)
  (p07b2-add ctx x (p07b2-neg ctx y)))

(defun p07b2-div (ctx x y)
  (p07b2-mul ctx x (p07b2-inv ctx y)))

(defun p07b2-le (ctx x y)
  (not (p07b2-lt ctx y x)))

(defun p07b2-abs (ctx x)
  (if (p07b2-lt ctx x (p07b2-zero ctx))
      (p07b2-neg ctx x)
    x))

(defun p07b2-nat-value (ctx n)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix n)))
  (if (zp n)
      (p07b2-zero ctx)
    (p07b2-add
     ctx
     (p07b2-one ctx)
     (p07b2-nat-value ctx (1- n)))))

(defun p07b2-positive-p (ctx x)
  (and
   (p07b2-real-p ctx x)
   (p07b2-lt ctx (p07b2-zero ctx) x)))

(defun p07b2-in-closed-unit-interval-p (ctx x)
  (and
   (p07b2-real-p ctx x)
   (p07b2-le ctx (p07b2-zero ctx) x)
   (p07b2-le ctx x (p07b2-one ctx))))

(defun p07b2-in-open-unit-interval-p (ctx x)
  (and
   (p07b2-real-p ctx x)
   (p07b2-lt ctx (p07b2-zero ctx) x)
   (p07b2-lt ctx x (p07b2-one ctx))))

;; The scalar carrier is a complete Archimedean ordered field, characterizing
;; the real numbers up to ordered-field isomorphism.

(defun-sk p07b2-operation-closure-p (ctx)
  (forall (x y)
    (and
     (p07b2-real-p ctx (p07b2-zero ctx))
     (p07b2-real-p ctx (p07b2-one ctx))
     (implies
      (p07b2-real-p ctx x)
      (and
       (p07b2-real-p ctx (p07b2-neg ctx x))
       (p07b2-real-p ctx (p07b2-inv ctx x))))
     (implies
      (and (p07b2-real-p ctx x)
           (p07b2-real-p ctx y))
      (and
       (p07b2-real-p ctx (p07b2-add ctx x y))
       (p07b2-real-p ctx (p07b2-mul ctx x y)))))))

(defun-sk p07b2-unary-field-laws-p (ctx)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (p07b2-real-p ctx x)
     (let ((zero (p07b2-zero ctx))
           (one (p07b2-one ctx)))
       (and
        (equal (p07b2-add ctx zero x) x)
        (equal (p07b2-add ctx x zero) x)
        (equal (p07b2-add ctx x (p07b2-neg ctx x)) zero)
        (equal (p07b2-mul ctx one x) x)
        (equal (p07b2-mul ctx x one) x)
        (implies
         (equal x zero)
         (equal (p07b2-inv ctx x) zero))
        (implies
         (not (equal x zero))
         (equal (p07b2-mul ctx x (p07b2-inv ctx x)) one)))))))

(defun-sk p07b2-binary-field-laws-p (ctx)
  (forall (x y)
    (implies
     (and (p07b2-real-p ctx x)
          (p07b2-real-p ctx y))
     (and
      (equal (p07b2-add ctx x y)
             (p07b2-add ctx y x))
      (equal (p07b2-mul ctx x y)
             (p07b2-mul ctx y x))))))

(defun-sk p07b2-ternary-field-laws-p (ctx)
  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (p07b2-real-p ctx x)
      (p07b2-real-p ctx y)
      (p07b2-real-p ctx z))
     (and
      (equal
       (p07b2-add ctx (p07b2-add ctx x y) z)
       (p07b2-add ctx x (p07b2-add ctx y z)))
      (equal
       (p07b2-mul ctx (p07b2-mul ctx x y) z)
       (p07b2-mul ctx x (p07b2-mul ctx y z)))
      (equal
       (p07b2-mul ctx x (p07b2-add ctx y z))
       (p07b2-add
        ctx
        (p07b2-mul ctx x y)
        (p07b2-mul ctx x z)))))))

(defun-sk p07b2-order-laws-p (ctx)
  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (p07b2-real-p ctx x)
      (p07b2-real-p ctx y)
      (p07b2-real-p ctx z))
     (and
      (not (p07b2-lt ctx x x))
      (or (p07b2-lt ctx x y)
          (equal x y)
          (p07b2-lt ctx y x))
      (implies
       (and (p07b2-lt ctx x y)
            (p07b2-lt ctx y z))
       (p07b2-lt ctx x z))
      (implies
       (p07b2-lt ctx x y)
       (p07b2-lt
        ctx
        (p07b2-add ctx x z)
        (p07b2-add ctx y z)))
      (implies
       (and
        (p07b2-lt ctx (p07b2-zero ctx) x)
        (p07b2-lt ctx (p07b2-zero ctx) y))
       (p07b2-lt
        ctx
        (p07b2-zero ctx)
        (p07b2-mul ctx x y)))))))

(defun-sk p07b2-valid-real-set-p (ctx set)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (p07b2-set-member-p ctx set x)
     (p07b2-real-p ctx x))))

(defun-sk p07b2-set-nonempty-p (ctx set)
  (exists (x)
    (and
     (p07b2-real-p ctx x)
     (p07b2-set-member-p ctx set x))))

(defun-sk p07b2-upper-bound-p (ctx set bound)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (p07b2-set-member-p ctx set x)
     (p07b2-le ctx x bound))))

(defun-sk p07b2-bounded-above-p (ctx set)
  (exists (bound)
    (and
     (p07b2-real-p ctx bound)
     (p07b2-upper-bound-p ctx set bound))))

(defun-sk p07b2-least-upper-bound-p (ctx set supremum)
  (forall (bound)
    (and
     (p07b2-real-p ctx supremum)
     (p07b2-upper-bound-p ctx set supremum)
     (implies
      (and
       (p07b2-real-p ctx bound)
       (p07b2-upper-bound-p ctx set bound))
      (p07b2-le ctx supremum bound)))))

(defun-sk p07b2-supremum-exists-p (ctx set)
  (exists (supremum)
    (p07b2-least-upper-bound-p ctx set supremum)))

(defun-sk p07b2-dedekind-complete-p (ctx)
  (forall (set)
    (implies
     (and
      (p07b2-valid-real-set-p ctx set)
      (p07b2-set-nonempty-p ctx set)
      (p07b2-bounded-above-p ctx set))
     (p07b2-supremum-exists-p ctx set))))

(defun-sk p07b2-archimedean-witness-p (ctx x)
  (exists (n)
    (and
     (natp n)
     (p07b2-lt ctx x (p07b2-nat-value ctx n)))))

(defun-sk p07b2-archimedean-p (ctx)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (p07b2-real-p ctx x)
     (p07b2-archimedean-witness-p ctx x))))

(defun p07b2-real-structure-p (ctx)
  (and
   (p07b2-operation-closure-p ctx)
   (p07b2-unary-field-laws-p ctx)
   (p07b2-binary-field-laws-p ctx)
   (p07b2-ternary-field-laws-p ctx)
   (p07b2-order-laws-p ctx)
   (not (equal (p07b2-zero ctx) (p07b2-one ctx)))
   (p07b2-lt ctx (p07b2-zero ctx) (p07b2-one ctx))
   (p07b2-dedekind-complete-p ctx)
   (p07b2-archimedean-p ctx)))

(defun-sk p07b2-f-real-valued-p (ctx)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (p07b2-real-p ctx x)
     (p07b2-real-p ctx (p07b2-f ctx x)))))

;; Differentiability uses the epsilon-delta linear remainder definition over
;; the full real domain.  The derivative witness remains internal.

(defun p07b2-derivative-error (ctx x y derivative)
  (p07b2-abs
   ctx
   (p07b2-sub
    ctx
    (p07b2-sub
     ctx
     (p07b2-f ctx y)
     (p07b2-f ctx x))
    (p07b2-mul
     ctx
     derivative
     (p07b2-sub ctx y x)))))

(defun-sk p07b2-derivative-delta-p
    (ctx x derivative epsilon delta)
  (forall (y)
    (implies
     (and
      (p07b2-real-p ctx y)
      (p07b2-lt
       ctx
       (p07b2-zero ctx)
       (p07b2-abs ctx (p07b2-sub ctx y x)))
      (p07b2-lt
       ctx
       (p07b2-abs ctx (p07b2-sub ctx y x))
       delta))
     (p07b2-le
      ctx
      (p07b2-derivative-error ctx x y derivative)
      (p07b2-mul
       ctx
       epsilon
       (p07b2-abs ctx (p07b2-sub ctx y x)))))))

(defun-sk p07b2-derivative-epsilon-p
    (ctx x derivative epsilon)
  (exists (delta)
    (and
     (p07b2-positive-p ctx delta)
     (p07b2-derivative-delta-p
      ctx x derivative epsilon delta))))

(defun-sk p07b2-derivative-at-p (ctx x derivative)
  (forall (epsilon)
    (and
     (p07b2-real-p ctx derivative)
     (implies
      (p07b2-positive-p ctx epsilon)
      (p07b2-derivative-epsilon-p
       ctx x derivative epsilon)))))

(defun-sk p07b2-differentiable-at-p (ctx x)
  (exists (derivative)
    (p07b2-derivative-at-p ctx x derivative)))

(defchoose p07b2-chosen-derivative
    (derivative)
    (ctx x)
  (p07b2-derivative-at-p ctx x derivative))

(defun p07b2-derivative (ctx x)
  (if (p07b2-differentiable-at-p ctx x)
      (p07b2-chosen-derivative ctx x)
    (p07b2-zero ctx)))

(defun-sk p07b2-derivative-continuity-delta-p
    (ctx x epsilon delta)
  (forall (y)
    (implies
     (and
      (p07b2-in-closed-unit-interval-p ctx y)
      (p07b2-lt
       ctx
       (p07b2-abs ctx (p07b2-sub ctx y x))
       delta))
     (p07b2-lt
      ctx
      (p07b2-abs
       ctx
       (p07b2-sub
        ctx
        (p07b2-derivative ctx y)
        (p07b2-derivative ctx x)))
      epsilon))))

(defun-sk p07b2-derivative-continuous-at-p
    (ctx x epsilon)
  (exists (delta)
    (and
     (p07b2-positive-p ctx delta)
     (p07b2-derivative-continuity-delta-p
      ctx x epsilon delta))))

(defun-sk p07b2-c1-on-unit-interval-p (ctx)
  (forall (x epsilon)
    (implies
     (p07b2-in-closed-unit-interval-p ctx x)
     (and
      (p07b2-differentiable-at-p ctx x)
      (implies
       (p07b2-positive-p ctx epsilon)
       (p07b2-derivative-continuous-at-p
        ctx x epsilon))))))

;; Exact Riemann integration.  A finite tagged partition is a witness used in
;; the definition of the integral; it does not restrict the function or the
;; real interval to a finite representation.

(defun p07b2-tagged-chain-p (ctx points tags)
  (declare (xargs :measure (acl2-count tags)))
  (if (endp tags)
      (and
       (consp points)
       (endp (cdr points))
       (p07b2-real-p ctx (car points)))
    (and
     (consp points)
     (consp (cdr points))
     (p07b2-real-p ctx (car points))
     (p07b2-real-p ctx (cadr points))
     (p07b2-real-p ctx (car tags))
     (p07b2-lt ctx (car points) (cadr points))
     (p07b2-le ctx (car points) (car tags))
     (p07b2-le ctx (car tags) (cadr points))
     (p07b2-tagged-chain-p
      ctx (cdr points) (cdr tags)))))

(defun p07b2-tagged-partition-p (ctx a b points tags)
  (and
   (true-listp points)
   (true-listp tags)
   (consp points)
   (equal (car points) a)
   (equal (car (last points)) b)
   (p07b2-tagged-chain-p ctx points tags)))

(defun p07b2-mesh-less-than-p (ctx points delta)
  (declare (xargs :measure (acl2-count points)))
  (if (or (endp points) (endp (cdr points)))
      t
    (and
     (p07b2-lt
      ctx
      (p07b2-sub ctx (cadr points) (car points))
      delta)
     (p07b2-mesh-less-than-p ctx (cdr points) delta))))

(defun p07b2-riemann-sum (ctx points tags)
  (declare (xargs :measure (acl2-count tags)))
  (if (or (endp tags)
          (endp points)
          (endp (cdr points)))
      (p07b2-zero ctx)
    (p07b2-add
     ctx
     (p07b2-mul
      ctx
      (p07b2-f ctx (car tags))
      (p07b2-sub ctx (cadr points) (car points)))
     (p07b2-riemann-sum
      ctx (cdr points) (cdr tags)))))

(defun-sk p07b2-fine-partition-exists-p
    (ctx a b delta)
  (exists (points tags)
    (and
     (p07b2-tagged-partition-p ctx a b points tags)
     (p07b2-mesh-less-than-p ctx points delta))))

(defun-sk p07b2-riemann-accuracy-p
    (ctx a b integral epsilon delta)
  (forall (points tags)
    (implies
     (and
      (p07b2-tagged-partition-p ctx a b points tags)
      (p07b2-mesh-less-than-p ctx points delta))
     (p07b2-lt
      ctx
      (p07b2-abs
       ctx
       (p07b2-sub
        ctx
        (p07b2-riemann-sum ctx points tags)
        integral))
      epsilon))))

(defun-sk p07b2-integral-epsilon-p
    (ctx a b integral epsilon)
  (exists (delta)
    (and
     (p07b2-positive-p ctx delta)
     (p07b2-fine-partition-exists-p ctx a b delta)
     (p07b2-riemann-accuracy-p
      ctx a b integral epsilon delta))))

(defun-sk p07b2-has-integral-p (ctx a b integral)
  (forall (epsilon)
    (and
     (p07b2-real-p ctx integral)
     (implies
      (p07b2-positive-p ctx epsilon)
      (p07b2-integral-epsilon-p
       ctx a b integral epsilon)))))

(defun-sk p07b2-integrable-p (ctx a b)
  (exists (integral)
    (p07b2-has-integral-p ctx a b integral)))

(defchoose p07b2-chosen-integral
    (integral)
    (ctx a b)
  (p07b2-has-integral-p ctx a b integral))

(defun p07b2-integral (ctx a b)
  (if (p07b2-integrable-p ctx a b)
      (p07b2-chosen-integral ctx a b)
    (p07b2-zero ctx)))

;; The explicit maximum assumptions follow the Lean/Rocq ground truths:
;; MAXIMUM is both attained and an upper bound for |f'| on [0,1].

(defun-sk p07b2-maximum-attained-p (ctx maximum)
  (exists (x)
    (and
     (p07b2-in-closed-unit-interval-p ctx x)
     (equal
      (p07b2-abs ctx (p07b2-derivative ctx x))
      maximum))))

(defun-sk p07b2-maximum-upper-bound-p (ctx maximum)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (p07b2-in-closed-unit-interval-p ctx x)
     (p07b2-le
      ctx
      (p07b2-abs ctx (p07b2-derivative ctx x))
      maximum))))

(defun-sk p07b2-bound-for-all-alpha-p (ctx maximum)
  (forall (alpha)
    (implies
     (p07b2-in-open-unit-interval-p ctx alpha)
     (p07b2-le
      ctx
      (p07b2-abs
       ctx
       (p07b2-integral
        ctx (p07b2-zero ctx) alpha))
      (p07b2-mul
       ctx
       (p07b2-inv ctx (p07b2-nat-value ctx 8))
       maximum)))))

(defun-sk putnam-2007-b2-statement ()
  (forall (ctx maximum)
    (implies
     (and
      (p07b2-real-structure-p ctx)
      (p07b2-f-real-valued-p ctx)
      (p07b2-c1-on-unit-interval-p ctx)
      (p07b2-has-integral-p
       ctx
       (p07b2-zero ctx)
       (p07b2-one ctx)
       (p07b2-zero ctx))
      (p07b2-real-p ctx maximum)
      (p07b2-maximum-attained-p ctx maximum)
      (p07b2-maximum-upper-bound-p ctx maximum))
     (p07b2-bound-for-all-alpha-p ctx maximum))))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

title: putnam_2007_b2
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2007_b2
-- (putnambench__agda__putnam_2007_b2): the one-eighth bound for partial
-- integrals of a continuously differentiable real function with zero mean.
-- This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module Putnam2007B2 where

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; _*_)

infix 4 _!=_ _<=N_
infixr 3 _and_
infixr 2 _or_

data Bottom : Set where

Not : Set -> Set
Not A =
  A -> Bottom

_!=_ : {A : Set} -> A -> A -> Set
x != y =
  Not (x == y)

record _and_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data _or_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  left  : A -> A or B
  right : B -> A or B

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

data _<=N_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set where
  zero<=N   : {n : Nat} -> zero <=N n
  suc<=sucN : {m n : Nat} -> m <=N n -> suc m <=N suc n

record CompleteOrderedRealField (R : Set) : Set1 where
  field
    zeroR oneR : R
    add multiply : R -> R -> R
    negate inverse absoluteValue : R -> R
    lessOrEqual : R -> R -> Set
    fromNat : Nat -> R

    one-not-zero :
      oneR != zeroR

    add-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> add x y == add y x
    add-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      add (add x y) z == add x (add y z)
    add-zero :
      (x : R) -> add x zeroR == x
    add-inverse :
      (x : R) -> add x (negate x) == zeroR

    multiply-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> multiply x y == multiply y x
    multiply-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply (multiply x y) z ==
      multiply x (multiply y z)
    multiply-one :
      (x : R) -> multiply x oneR == x
    multiply-zero :
      (x : R) -> multiply x zeroR == zeroR
    distribute :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply x (add y z) ==
      add (multiply x y) (multiply x z)
    inverse-zero :
      inverse zeroR == zeroR
    multiply-inverse :
      (x : R) ->
      x != zeroR ->
      multiply x (inverse x) == oneR

    order-reflexive :
      (x : R) -> lessOrEqual x x
    order-transitive :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y z ->
      lessOrEqual x z
    order-antisymmetric :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y x ->
      x == y
    order-total :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y or lessOrEqual y x
    add-order :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual (add z x) (add z y)
    multiply-nonnegative :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR x ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR y ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR (multiply x y)
    zero-less-than-one :
      lessOrEqual zeroR oneR and zeroR != oneR

    absolute-nonnegative :
      (x : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR (absoluteValue x)
    absolute-of-nonnegative :
      (x : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR x ->
      absoluteValue x == x
    absolute-of-nonpositive :
      (x : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x zeroR ->
      absoluteValue x == negate x

    fromNat-zero :
      fromNat zero == zeroR
    fromNat-successor :
      (n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (suc n) == add (fromNat n) oneR
    fromNat-addition :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m + n) == add (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-multiplication :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m * n) == multiply (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-injective :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat m == fromNat n ->
      m == n

    archimedean :
      (x : R) ->
      Exists Nat
        (\ n ->
          lessOrEqual x (fromNat n))
    least-upper-bound :
      (P : R -> Set) ->
      Exists R P ->
      Exists R
        (\ upper ->
          (x : R) ->
          P x ->
          lessOrEqual x upper) ->
      Exists R
        (\ supremum ->
          ((x : R) ->
            P x ->
            lessOrEqual x supremum)
          and
          ((upper : R) ->
            ((x : R) ->
              P x ->
              lessOrEqual x upper) ->
            lessOrEqual supremum upper))

open CompleteOrderedRealField

subtract :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
subtract reals x y =
  add reals x (negate reals y)

divide :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
divide reals x y =
  multiply reals x (inverse reals y)

StrictLess :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
StrictLess reals x y =
  lessOrEqual reals x y and x != y

CloseTo :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
CloseTo reals center radius x =
  StrictLess reals
    (subtract reals center radius)
    x
  and
  StrictLess reals
    x
    (add reals center radius)

ConvergesTo :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  R ->
  Set
ConvergesTo {R} reals sequence limit =
  (epsilon : R) ->
  StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) epsilon ->
  Exists Nat
    (\ cutoff ->
      (n : Nat) ->
      cutoff <=N n ->
      CloseTo reals limit epsilon (sequence n))

sumFirst :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Nat ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  R
sumFirst reals zero terms =
  zeroR reals
sumFirst reals (suc n) terms =
  add reals
    (sumFirst reals n terms)
    (terms n)

midpointRiemannSum :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  (R -> R) ->
  Nat ->
  R
midpointRiemannSum reals lower upper function pieces =
  let
    two =
      fromNat reals (suc (suc zero))
    step =
      divide reals
        (subtract reals upper lower)
        (fromNat reals pieces)
    halfStep =
      divide reals step two
  in
  sumFirst reals pieces
    (\ i ->
      multiply reals
        (function
          (add reals lower
            (add reals
              (multiply reals
                (fromNat reals i)
                step)
              halfStep)))
        step)

IntervalIntegralValue :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  (R -> R) ->
  R ->
  Set
IntervalIntegralValue reals lower upper function value =
  ConvergesTo reals
    (\ n ->
      midpointRiemannSum reals
        lower
        upper
        function
        (suc n))
    value

InClosedUnitInterval :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  Set
InClosedUnitInterval reals x =
  lessOrEqual reals (zeroR reals) x
  and
  lessOrEqual reals x (oneR reals)

InOpenUnitInterval :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  Set
InOpenUnitInterval reals x =
  StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) x
  and
  StrictLess reals x (oneR reals)

differenceQuotient :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (R -> R) ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
differenceQuotient reals function point x =
  divide reals
    (subtract reals (function x) (function point))
    (subtract reals x point)

DerivativeWithinClosedUnitInterval :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (R -> R) ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
DerivativeWithinClosedUnitInterval {R} reals function point derivative =
  (epsilon : R) ->
  StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) epsilon ->
  Exists R
    (\ delta ->
      StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) delta
      and
      ((x : R) ->
        InClosedUnitInterval reals x ->
        CloseTo reals point delta x ->
        x != point ->
        CloseTo reals derivative epsilon
          (differenceQuotient reals function point x)))

ContinuousWithinClosedUnitInterval :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (R -> R) ->
  Set
ContinuousWithinClosedUnitInterval {R} reals function =
  (point : R) ->
  InClosedUnitInterval reals point ->
  (epsilon : R) ->
  StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) epsilon ->
  Exists R
    (\ delta ->
      StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) delta
      and
      ((x : R) ->
        InClosedUnitInterval reals x ->
        CloseTo reals point delta x ->
        CloseTo reals
          (function point)
          epsilon
          (function x)))

record ContinuouslyDifferentiableOnClosedUnitInterval
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R)
  (function derivative : R -> R) :
  Set where

  field
    derivative-at :
      (x : R) ->
      InClosedUnitInterval reals x ->
      DerivativeWithinClosedUnitInterval reals
        function
        x
        (derivative x)

    derivative-continuous :
      ContinuousWithinClosedUnitInterval reals derivative

MaximumAbsoluteDerivative :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (R -> R) ->
  R ->
  Set
MaximumAbsoluteDerivative {R} reals derivative maximum =
  Exists R
    (\ x ->
      InClosedUnitInterval reals x
      and
      absoluteValue reals (derivative x) == maximum)
  and
  ((x : R) ->
    InClosedUnitInterval reals x ->
    lessOrEqual reals
      (absoluteValue reals (derivative x))
      maximum)

oneEighth :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R
oneEighth reals =
  divide reals
    (oneR reals)
    (fromNat reals 8)

putnam-2007-b2 : Set1
putnam-2007-b2 =
  (R : Set) ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) ->
  (f derivative : R -> R) ->
  ContinuouslyDifferentiableOnClosedUnitInterval reals f derivative ->
  IntervalIntegralValue reals
    (zeroR reals)
    (oneR reals)
    f
    (zeroR reals) ->
  (maximum : R) ->
  MaximumAbsoluteDerivative reals derivative maximum ->
  (alpha : R) ->
  InOpenUnitInterval reals alpha ->
  Exists R
    (\ partialIntegral ->
      IntervalIntegralValue reals
        (zeroR reals)
        alpha
        f
        partialIntegral
      and
      lessOrEqual reals
        (absoluteValue reals partialIntegral)
        (multiply reals
          (oneEighth reals)
          maximum))

(*
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2007_b2:
  the one-eighth bound for initial integrals of a real function with
  continuous derivative and zero integral on the unit interval. This file
  contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open pred_setTheory realTheory real_topologyTheory derivativeTheory;
open integrationTheory;

val putnam_2007_b2 =
  ``let unit_interval = interval [0, 1]
    in
      !f : real -> real. !max_deriv : real.
        f differentiable_on unit_interval /\
        (\x : real.
           vector_derivative f (at x within unit_interval))
          continuous_on unit_interval /\
        integration$integral unit_interval f = 0 /\
        (?x : real.
           x IN unit_interval /\
           abs
             (vector_derivative f (at x within unit_interval)) =
           max_deriv) /\
        (!x : real.
           x IN unit_interval
           ==>
           abs
             (vector_derivative f (at x within unit_interval)) <=
           max_deriv)
        ==>
        !alpha : real.
          0 < alpha /\ alpha < 1
          ==>
          abs
            (integration$integral (interval [0, alpha]) f) <=
          (1 / 8) * max_deriv``;

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(

  formulation of continuous differentiability on that closed interval.
  The relative derivative sequence supplies the first derivative at every
  point of the interval, including its endpoints.

  M is characterized as the attained maximum of the absolute first
  derivative by an existential equality and a universal upper bound. The
  S. binder is the real Lebesgue integral; using closed intervals agrees
  with the source interval integrals because endpoints have measure zero.
  The final declaration is the single unproved $a corpus statement; this
  database contains no $p proof statement.

${
  $d F M a x $.

  putnambench-putnam-2007-b2 $a |-
    A. F e. ( RR ^m RR )

                /\

title: putnam_2007_b2
content:
% Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2007_b2:
% a continuously differentiable real function on [0,1] with zero integral
% has every initial integral bounded by one eighth of the maximum absolute
% derivative on that interval. This file contains no proof.

putnam_2007_b2: THEORY
BEGIN
  real_function: TYPE = [real -> real]
  real_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> real]

  in_unit_interval(x: real): bool =
    0 <= x AND x <= 1

  continuous_on_unit_interval(f: real_function): bool =
    FORALL (x: real):
      in_unit_interval(x) IMPLIES
        FORALL (epsilon_value: posreal):
          EXISTS (delta: posreal):
            FORALL (y: real):
              (in_unit_interval(y)
                AND abs(y - x) < delta)
              IMPLIES
                abs(f(y) - f(x)) < epsilon_value

  has_derivative_within_unit_interval(
      f: real_function,
      derivative, x: real): bool =
    FORALL (epsilon_value: posreal):
      EXISTS (delta: posreal):
        FORALL (y: real):
          (in_unit_interval(y)
            AND NOT (y = x)
            AND abs(y - x) < delta)
          IMPLIES
            abs(
              f(y) - f(x)
                - derivative * (y - x))
              < epsilon_value * abs(y - x)

  differentiable_within_unit_interval(
      f: real_function,
      x: real): bool =
    EXISTS (derivative: real):
      has_derivative_within_unit_interval(
        f, derivative, x)

  derivative_value(f: real_function, x: real): real =
    IF differentiable_within_unit_interval(f, x) THEN
      epsilon(
        LAMBDA (derivative: real):
          has_derivative_within_unit_interval(
            f, derivative, x))
    ELSE
      0
    ENDIF

  derivative_function(f: real_function): real_function =
    LAMBDA (x: real): derivative_value(f, x)

  continuously_differentiable_on_unit_interval(
      f: real_function): bool =
    (FORALL (x: real):
      in_unit_interval(x) IMPLIES
        differentiable_within_unit_interval(f, x))
      AND continuous_on_unit_interval(
        derivative_function(f))

  valid_tagged_partition(
      left, right: real,
      points, tags: real_sequence,
      count: nat): bool =
    count > 0
      AND points(0) = left
      AND points(count) = right
      AND FORALL (index: nat):
        index < count IMPLIES
          (points(index) < points(index + 1)
            AND points(index) <= tags(index)
            AND tags(index) <= points(index + 1))

  mesh_less_than(
      points: real_sequence,
      count: nat,
      bound: real): bool =
    FORALL (index: nat):
      index < count IMPLIES
        points(index + 1) - points(index) < bound

  riemann_sum(
      f: real_function,
      points, tags: real_sequence,
      count: nat): RECURSIVE real =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      riemann_sum(f, points, tags, count - 1)
        + f(tags(count - 1))
            * (points(count) - points(count - 1))
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  has_interval_integral(
      f: real_function,
      left, right, integral_value: real): bool =
    left < right
      AND FORALL (epsilon_value: posreal):
        EXISTS (mesh_bound: posreal):
          FORALL
              (points, tags: real_sequence),
              (count: nat):
            (valid_tagged_partition(
                left, right, points, tags, count)
              AND mesh_less_than(
                points, count, mesh_bound))
            IMPLIES
              abs(
                riemann_sum(f, points, tags, count)
                  - integral_value)
                < epsilon_value

  interval_integral(
      f: real_function,
      left, right: real): real =
    IF left = right THEN
      0
    ELSIF left < right THEN
      IF EXISTS (integral_value: real):
          has_interval_integral(
            f, left, right, integral_value)
      THEN
        epsilon(
          LAMBDA (integral_value: real):
            has_interval_integral(
              f, left, right, integral_value))
      ELSE
        0
      ENDIF
    ELSE
      IF EXISTS (integral_value: real):
          has_interval_integral(
            f, right, left, integral_value)
      THEN
        -epsilon(
          LAMBDA (integral_value: real):
            has_interval_integral(
              f, right, left, integral_value))
      ELSE
        0
      ENDIF
    ENDIF

  putnam_2007_b2: bool =
    FORALL (f: real_function), (maximum: real):
      (continuously_differentiable_on_unit_interval(f)
        AND interval_integral(f, 0, 1) = 0
        AND (EXISTS (x: real):
          in_unit_interval(x)
            AND abs(derivative_function(f)(x)) = maximum)
        AND (FORALL (x: real):
          in_unit_interval(x) IMPLIES
            abs(derivative_function(f)(x)) <= maximum))
      IMPLIES
        FORALL (alpha: real):
          (0 < alpha AND alpha < 1) IMPLIES
            abs(interval_integral(f, 0, alpha))
              <= ((1 :: real) / 8) * maximum
END putnam_2007_b2

import Mathlib

open Set Nat Function

noncomputable abbrev putnam_2007_b3_solution : ℝ := sorry
-- (2 ^ 2006 / Real.sqrt 5) * (((1 + Real.sqrt 5) / 2) ^ 4017 + ((1 + Real.sqrt 5) / 2) ^ (-4017 : ℤ))
/--
Let $x_0 = 1$ and for $n \geq 0$, let $x_{n+1} = 3x_n + \lfloor x_n \sqrt{5} \rfloor$. In particular, $x_1 = 5$, $x_2 = 26$, $x_3 = 136$, $x_4 = 712$. Find a closed-form expression for $x_{2007}$. ($\lfloor a \rfloor$ means the largest integer $\leq a$.)
-/
theorem putnam_2007_b3
(x : ℕ → ℝ)
(hx0 : x 0 = 1)
(hx : ∀ n : ℕ, x (n + 1) = 3 * (x n) + ⌊(x n) * Real.sqrt 5⌋)
: (x 2007 = putnam_2007_b3_solution) :=
sorry

title: putnam_2007_b3
content:
Require Import Reals Coquelicot.Coquelicot.
Definition putnam_2007_b3_solution := let a := (1 + sqrt 5) / 2 in (2 ^ 2006 / sqrt 5) * (a ^ 4017 + Rpower a (-4017)).
Theorem putnam_2007_b3
    (X := fix x (n: nat) :=
        match n with
        | O => 1
        | S n' => 3 * x n' + IZR (floor (x n' * sqrt 5))
    end)
    : X 2007%nat = putnam_2007_b3_solution.
Proof. Admitted.

content:
;; Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2007_b3:
;; the closed form for the 2007th term of the real recurrence
;; x_(n+1) = 3*x_n + floor(x_n*sqrt(5)), with x_0 = 1. This file contains no
;; proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))

;; The source recurrence uniquely determines its real sequence. Starting at
;; 1, every term is a nonnegative integer; for such an integer m,
;;
;;   floor(m*sqrt(5)) = floor(sqrt(5*m^2)).
;;
;; Hence the internal integer recurrence below embeds into the source real
;; recurrence, and conversely every real sequence satisfying the source
;; initial value and recurrence agrees with it at every index by induction.
;; This gives a bidirectional equivalence rather than a restriction of the
;; source's real-valued sequence quantifier.
;;
;; The closed form lies in Q(sqrt(5)). A pair (a b) denotes a+b*sqrt(5), with
;; exact rational arithmetic. Pair addition, multiplication, and inversion
;; are the corresponding field operations, so equality with (x_2007 0) is
;; exactly the asserted real equality.

(defun putnam-2007-b3-isqrt-bisect
    (radicand lower upper fuel)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix fuel)))
  (if (or (zp fuel)
          (<= upper (+ lower 1)))
      lower
    (let ((middle (floor (+ lower upper) 2)))
      (if (<= (* middle middle) radicand)
          (putnam-2007-b3-isqrt-bisect
           radicand middle upper (- fuel 1))
        (putnam-2007-b3-isqrt-bisect
         radicand lower middle (- fuel 1))))))

(defun putnam-2007-b3-isqrt (radicand)
  (let ((number (nfix radicand)))
    (putnam-2007-b3-isqrt-bisect
     number 0 (+ number 1) (+ number 1))))

(defun putnam-2007-b3-floor-times-sqrt-five (value)
  (putnam-2007-b3-isqrt
   (* 5 value value)))

(defun putnam-2007-b3-sequence (n)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix n)))
  (if (zp n)
      1
    (let ((previous
           (putnam-2007-b3-sequence (- n 1))))
      (+ (* 3 previous)
         (putnam-2007-b3-floor-times-sqrt-five
          previous)))))

(defun putnam-2007-b3-surd (rational-part root-part)
  (list rational-part root-part))

(defun putnam-2007-b3-surd-rational-part (value)
  (car value))

(defun putnam-2007-b3-surd-root-part (value)
  (cadr value))

(defun putnam-2007-b3-surd-add (left right)
  (putnam-2007-b3-surd
   (+ (putnam-2007-b3-surd-rational-part left)
      (putnam-2007-b3-surd-rational-part right))
   (+ (putnam-2007-b3-surd-root-part left)
      (putnam-2007-b3-surd-root-part right))))

(defun putnam-2007-b3-surd-multiply (left right)
  (let ((a (putnam-2007-b3-surd-rational-part left))
        (b (putnam-2007-b3-surd-root-part left))
        (c (putnam-2007-b3-surd-rational-part right))
        (d (putnam-2007-b3-surd-root-part right)))
    (putnam-2007-b3-surd
     (+ (* a c) (* 5 b d))
     (+ (* a d) (* b c)))))

(defun putnam-2007-b3-surd-inverse (value)
  (let* ((a
          (putnam-2007-b3-surd-rational-part value))
         (b
          (putnam-2007-b3-surd-root-part value))
         (norm
          (- (* a a) (* 5 b b))))
    (putnam-2007-b3-surd
     (/ a norm)
     (/ (- b) norm))))

(defun putnam-2007-b3-surd-power (base exponent)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix exponent)))
  (if (zp exponent)
      (putnam-2007-b3-surd 1 0)
    (putnam-2007-b3-surd-multiply
     base
     (putnam-2007-b3-surd-power
      base (- exponent 1)))))

(defun putnam-2007-b3-solution ()
  (let* ((one
          (putnam-2007-b3-surd 1 0))
         (two
          (putnam-2007-b3-surd 2 0))
         (sqrt-five
          (putnam-2007-b3-surd 0 1))
         (golden-ratio
          (putnam-2007-b3-surd-multiply
           (putnam-2007-b3-surd-add one sqrt-five)
           (putnam-2007-b3-surd-inverse two)))
         (golden-power
          (putnam-2007-b3-surd-power golden-ratio 4017))
         (two-power
          (putnam-2007-b3-surd-power two 2006)))
    (putnam-2007-b3-surd-multiply
     (putnam-2007-b3-surd-multiply
      two-power
      (putnam-2007-b3-surd-inverse sqrt-five))
     (putnam-2007-b3-surd-add
      golden-power
      (putnam-2007-b3-surd-inverse golden-power)))))

(defun putnambench-putnam-2007-b3-statement ()
  (equal
   (putnam-2007-b3-surd
    (putnam-2007-b3-sequence 2007)
    0)
   (putnam-2007-b3-solution)))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

-- Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2007_b3
-- (putnambench__agda__putnam_2007_b3): the real recurrence using
-- floor(x_n * sqrt(5)) has the specified closed form at n = 2007.
-- This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module Main where

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Int using (Int; pos; negsuc)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; _*_)

infix 4 _!=_
infixr 3 _and_
infixr 2 _or_

data Bottom : Set where

Not : Set -> Set
Not A =
  A -> Bottom

_!=_ : {A : Set} -> A -> A -> Set
x != y =
  Not (x == y)

record _and_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data _or_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  left  : A -> A or B
  right : B -> A or B

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

intSuccessor : Int -> Int
intSuccessor (pos n) =
  pos (suc n)
intSuccessor (negsuc zero) =
  pos zero
intSuccessor (negsuc (suc n)) =
  negsuc n

embedInt :
  {R : Set} ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  (R -> R) ->
  Int ->
  R
embedInt fromNatural negateR (pos n) =
  fromNatural n
embedInt fromNatural negateR (negsuc n) =
  negateR (fromNatural (suc n))

record CompleteOrderedRealField (R : Set) : Set1 where
  field
    zeroR oneR : R
    add multiply : R -> R -> R
    negate inverse squareRoot : R -> R
    lessOrEqual : R -> R -> Set
    fromNat : Nat -> R
    floor : R -> Int

    one-not-zero :
      oneR != zeroR

    add-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> add x y == add y x
    add-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      add (add x y) z == add x (add y z)
    add-zero :
      (x : R) -> add x zeroR == x
    add-inverse :
      (x : R) -> add x (negate x) == zeroR

    multiply-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> multiply x y == multiply y x
    multiply-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply (multiply x y) z ==
      multiply x (multiply y z)
    multiply-one :
      (x : R) -> multiply x oneR == x
    multiply-zero :
      (x : R) -> multiply x zeroR == zeroR
    distribute :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply x (add y z) ==
      add (multiply x y) (multiply x z)
    inverse-zero :
      inverse zeroR == zeroR
    multiply-inverse :
      (x : R) ->
      x != zeroR ->
      multiply x (inverse x) == oneR

    order-reflexive :
      (x : R) -> lessOrEqual x x
    order-transitive :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y z ->
      lessOrEqual x z
    order-antisymmetric :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y x ->
      x == y
    order-total :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y or lessOrEqual y x
    add-order :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual (add z x) (add z y)
    multiply-nonnegative :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR x ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR y ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR (multiply x y)
    zero-less-than-one :
      lessOrEqual zeroR oneR and zeroR != oneR

    fromNat-zero :
      fromNat zero == zeroR
    fromNat-successor :
      (n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (suc n) == add (fromNat n) oneR
    fromNat-addition :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m + n) == add (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-multiplication :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m * n) == multiply (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-injective :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat m == fromNat n ->
      m == n

    archimedean :
      (x : R) ->
      Exists Nat (\ n -> lessOrEqual x (fromNat n))
    least-upper-bound :
      (P : R -> Set) ->
      Exists R P ->
      Exists R
        (\ upper ->
          (x : R) ->
          P x ->
          lessOrEqual x upper) ->
      Exists R
        (\ supremum ->
          ((x : R) ->
            P x ->
            lessOrEqual x supremum)
          and
          ((upper : R) ->
            ((x : R) ->
              P x ->
              lessOrEqual x upper) ->
            lessOrEqual supremum upper))

    square-root-nonnegative :
      (x : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR (squareRoot x)
    square-root-square :
      (x : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR x ->
      multiply (squareRoot x) (squareRoot x) == x
    square-root-nonpositive :
      (x : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x zeroR ->
      squareRoot x == zeroR
    square-root-unique :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR y ->
      multiply y y == x ->
      y == squareRoot x

    floor-lower :
      (x : R) ->
      lessOrEqual
        (embedInt fromNat negate (floor x))
        x
    floor-upper :
      (x : R) ->
      lessOrEqual
        x
        (embedInt fromNat negate (intSuccessor (floor x)))
      and
      x != embedInt fromNat negate (intSuccessor (floor x))

open CompleteOrderedRealField

fromInt :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Int ->
  R
fromInt reals =
  embedInt (fromNat reals) (negate reals)

divide :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
divide reals x y =
  multiply reals x (inverse reals y)

naturalPower :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  Nat ->
  R
naturalPower reals x zero =
  oneR reals
naturalPower reals x (suc n) =
  multiply reals
    (naturalPower reals x n)
    x

integerPower :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  Int ->
  R
integerPower reals x (pos n) =
  naturalPower reals x n
integerPower reals x (negsuc n) =
  inverse reals (naturalPower reals x (suc n))

module Putnam2007B3Statement
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) where

  two three five : R
  two =
    fromNat reals 2
  three =
    fromNat reals 3
  five =
    fromNat reals 5

  sqrtFive : R
  sqrtFive =
    squareRoot reals five

  goldenRatio : R
  goldenRatio =
    divide reals
      (add reals (oneR reals) sqrtFive)
      two

  solution : R
  solution =
    multiply reals
      (divide reals
        (naturalPower reals two 2006)
        sqrtFive)
      (add reals
        (naturalPower reals goldenRatio 4017)
        (integerPower reals goldenRatio (negsuc 4016)))

  proposition : Set
  proposition =
    (x : Nat -> R) ->
    x zero == oneR reals ->
    ((n : Nat) ->
      x (suc n) ==
      add reals
        (multiply reals three (x n))
        (fromInt reals
          (floor reals
            (multiply reals (x n) sqrtFive)))) ->
    x 2007 == solution

putnam-2007-b3 : Set1
putnam-2007-b3 =
  (R : Set) ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) ->
  Putnam2007B3Statement.proposition reals

% Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2007_b3:
% the real sequence starting at one and recursively using floor(x_n * sqrt(5))
% has the specified golden-ratio closed form at index 2007. This file contains
% no proof.

putnam_2007_b3: THEORY
BEGIN
  real_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> real]

  safe_div(numerator, denominator: real): real =
    IF denominator = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      numerator / denominator
    ENDIF

  nonnegative_sqrt(x: real): real =
    IF x >= 0 THEN
      epsilon(
        LAMBDA (root: real):
          root >= 0 AND root ^ 2 = x)
    ELSE
      0
    ENDIF

  sqrt_five: real = nonnegative_sqrt(5)

  golden_ratio: real =
    safe_div(1 + sqrt_five, 2)

  putnam_2007_b3_solution: real =
    safe_div((2 :: real) ^ 2006, sqrt_five)
      * (golden_ratio ^ 4017
          + safe_div(1, golden_ratio ^ 4017))

  putnam_2007_b3: bool =
    FORALL (x: real_sequence):
      (x(0) = 1
        AND FORALL (n: nat):
          x(n + 1)
            = 3 * x(n)
                + (floor(x(n) * sqrt_five) :: real))
      IMPLIES
        x(2007) = putnam_2007_b3_solution
END putnam_2007_b3

abbrev putnam_2007_b4_solution : ℕ → ℕ := sorry
-- fun n ↦ 2 ^ (n + 1)
/--
Let $n$ be a positive integer. Find the number of pairs $P, Q$ of polynomials with real coefficients such that
\[
(P(X))^2 + (Q(X))^2 = X^{2n} + 1
\]
and $\deg P > \deg Q$.
-/
theorem putnam_2007_b4
(n : ℕ) (npos : n > 0) :
({(P, Q) : (Polynomial ℝ) × (Polynomial ℝ) | P ^ 2 + Q ^ 2 = Polynomial.X ^ (2 * n) + 1 ∧ P.degree > Q.degree}.ncard = putnam_2007_b4_solution n) :=
sorry

(* Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench artifact putnam_2007_b4:
   counting ordered pairs of real polynomials whose squares sum to
   X^(2n) + 1 and whose degrees are strictly ordered. This file contains no proof. *)

From Stdlib Require Import Reals List Arith.

Import ListNotations.
Open Scope R_scope.

Definition putnam_2007_b4_polynomial : Type := nat -> R.

Definition putnam_2007_b4_finite_support
    (P : putnam_2007_b4_polynomial) : Prop :=
  exists bound : nat, forall k : nat, (bound < k)%nat -> P k = 0.

Definition putnam_2007_b4_poly_eq
    (P Q : putnam_2007_b4_polynomial) : Prop :=
  forall k : nat, P k = Q k.

Definition putnam_2007_b4_poly_add
    (P Q : putnam_2007_b4_polynomial) : putnam_2007_b4_polynomial :=
  fun k : nat => P k + Q k.

Fixpoint putnam_2007_b4_convolution
    (P Q : putnam_2007_b4_polynomial) (k terms : nat) : R :=
  match terms with
  | O => P O * Q k
  | S previous =>
      putnam_2007_b4_convolution P Q k previous
      + P (S previous) * Q ((k - S previous)%nat)
  end.

Definition putnam_2007_b4_poly_mul
    (P Q : putnam_2007_b4_polynomial) : putnam_2007_b4_polynomial :=
  fun k : nat => putnam_2007_b4_convolution P Q k k.

Definition putnam_2007_b4_poly_one : putnam_2007_b4_polynomial :=
  fun k : nat => if Nat.eqb k O then 1 else 0.

Definition putnam_2007_b4_poly_X : putnam_2007_b4_polynomial :=
  fun k : nat => if Nat.eqb k 1%nat then 1 else 0.

Fixpoint putnam_2007_b4_poly_pow
    (P : putnam_2007_b4_polynomial) (exponent : nat)
    : putnam_2007_b4_polynomial :=
  match exponent with
  | O => putnam_2007_b4_poly_one
  | S previous =>
      putnam_2007_b4_poly_mul P
        (putnam_2007_b4_poly_pow P previous)
  end.

Definition putnam_2007_b4_zero_poly
    (P : putnam_2007_b4_polynomial) : Prop :=
  forall k : nat, P k = 0.

Definition putnam_2007_b4_has_degree
    (P : putnam_2007_b4_polynomial) (degree : nat) : Prop :=
  P degree <> 0 /\
  forall k : nat, (degree < k)%nat -> P k = 0.

Definition putnam_2007_b4_degree_gt
    (P Q : putnam_2007_b4_polynomial) : Prop :=
  exists degree_P : nat,
    putnam_2007_b4_has_degree P degree_P /\
    (putnam_2007_b4_zero_poly Q \/
     exists degree_Q : nat,
       putnam_2007_b4_has_degree Q degree_Q /\
       (degree_Q < degree_P)%nat).

Definition putnam_2007_b4_pair_eq
    (left right :
      putnam_2007_b4_polynomial * putnam_2007_b4_polynomial) : Prop :=
  putnam_2007_b4_poly_eq (fst left) (fst right) /\
  putnam_2007_b4_poly_eq (snd left) (snd right).

Inductive putnam_2007_b4_pair_nodup :
    list (putnam_2007_b4_polynomial * putnam_2007_b4_polynomial) -> Prop :=
| putnam_2007_b4_pair_nodup_nil :
    putnam_2007_b4_pair_nodup []
| putnam_2007_b4_pair_nodup_cons :
    forall
      (head : putnam_2007_b4_polynomial * putnam_2007_b4_polynomial)
      (tail : list
        (putnam_2007_b4_polynomial * putnam_2007_b4_polynomial)),
      (forall item, In item tail ->
        ~ putnam_2007_b4_pair_eq head item) ->
      putnam_2007_b4_pair_nodup tail ->
      putnam_2007_b4_pair_nodup (head :: tail).

Definition putnam_2007_b4_has_cardinality
    (property :
      (putnam_2007_b4_polynomial * putnam_2007_b4_polynomial) -> Prop)
    (cardinality : nat) : Prop :=
  exists enumeration :
      list (putnam_2007_b4_polynomial * putnam_2007_b4_polynomial),
    length enumeration = cardinality /\
    (forall item, In item enumeration -> property item) /\
    putnam_2007_b4_pair_nodup enumeration /\
    (forall item, property item ->
      exists representative, In representative enumeration /\
        putnam_2007_b4_pair_eq item representative).

Definition putnam_2007_b4_condition
    (n : nat)
    (pair : putnam_2007_b4_polynomial * putnam_2007_b4_polynomial) : Prop :=
  let P := fst pair in
  let Q := snd pair in
  putnam_2007_b4_finite_support P /\
  putnam_2007_b4_finite_support Q /\
  putnam_2007_b4_poly_eq
    (putnam_2007_b4_poly_add
      (putnam_2007_b4_poly_pow P 2)
      (putnam_2007_b4_poly_pow Q 2))
    (putnam_2007_b4_poly_add
      (putnam_2007_b4_poly_pow putnam_2007_b4_poly_X ((2 * n)%nat))
      putnam_2007_b4_poly_one) /\
  putnam_2007_b4_degree_gt P Q.

Theorem putnam_2007_b4 :
  forall n : nat, (0 < n)%nat ->
    putnam_2007_b4_has_cardinality
      (putnam_2007_b4_condition n)
      (Nat.pow 2 ((n + 1)%nat)).
Admitted.

putnam_2007_b4
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2007_b4:
;; for positive n, exactly 2^(n+1) ordered pairs of real polynomials P,Q
;; satisfy P^2+Q^2=X^(2n)+1 and degree(P)>degree(Q). This file contains no
;; proof and does not prescribe or construct the qualifying pairs.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))

;; The scalar symbols present an arbitrary real-closed ordered field.
;; For every fixed n, the source is a first-order algebraic statement about
;; finitely many polynomial coefficients. Completeness of real-closed fields
;; therefore transfers it exactly between this carrier and the real numbers.

(defstub p2007b4-scalar-p (x) t)
(defstub p2007b4-add-op (x y) t)
(defstub p2007b4-multiply-op (x y) t)
(defstub p2007b4-negate-op (x) t)
(defstub p2007b4-inverse-op (x) t)
(defstub p2007b4-less-op (x y) t)
(defstub p2007b4-zero () t)
(defstub p2007b4-one () t)

(defun p2007b4-add (x y)
  (p2007b4-add-op x y))

(defun p2007b4-multiply (x y)
  (p2007b4-multiply-op x y))

(defun p2007b4-negate (x)
  (p2007b4-negate-op x))

(defun p2007b4-inverse (x)
  (p2007b4-inverse-op x))

(defun p2007b4-less (x y)
  (if (p2007b4-less-op x y) t nil))

(defun-sk p2007b4-field-laws-p ()
  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (p2007b4-scalar-p x)
      (p2007b4-scalar-p y)
      (p2007b4-scalar-p z))
     (and
      (p2007b4-scalar-p (p2007b4-add x y))
      (p2007b4-scalar-p (p2007b4-multiply x y))
      (p2007b4-scalar-p (p2007b4-negate x))
      (implies
       (not (equal x (p2007b4-zero)))
       (p2007b4-scalar-p (p2007b4-inverse x)))
      (equal
       (p2007b4-add (p2007b4-add x y) z)
       (p2007b4-add x (p2007b4-add y z)))
      (equal
       (p2007b4-add x y)
       (p2007b4-add y x))
      (equal
       (p2007b4-add x (p2007b4-zero))
       x)
      (equal
       (p2007b4-add x (p2007b4-negate x))
       (p2007b4-zero))
      (equal
       (p2007b4-multiply
        (p2007b4-multiply x y) z)
       (p2007b4-multiply
        x (p2007b4-multiply y z)))
      (equal
       (p2007b4-multiply x y)
       (p2007b4-multiply y x))
      (equal
       (p2007b4-multiply x (p2007b4-one))
       x)
      (implies
       (not (equal x (p2007b4-zero)))
       (equal
        (p2007b4-multiply x (p2007b4-inverse x))
        (p2007b4-one)))
      (equal
       (p2007b4-multiply x (p2007b4-add y z))
       (p2007b4-add
        (p2007b4-multiply x y)
        (p2007b4-multiply x z)))))))

(defun-sk p2007b4-order-laws-p ()
  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (p2007b4-scalar-p x)
      (p2007b4-scalar-p y)
      (p2007b4-scalar-p z))
     (and
      (not (p2007b4-less x x))
      (or
       (equal x y)
       (p2007b4-less x y)
       (p2007b4-less y x))
      (implies
       (and
        (p2007b4-less x y)
        (p2007b4-less y z))
       (p2007b4-less x z))
      (implies
       (p2007b4-less x y)
       (p2007b4-less
        (p2007b4-add x z)
        (p2007b4-add y z)))
      (implies
       (and
        (p2007b4-less (p2007b4-zero) x)
        (p2007b4-less (p2007b4-zero) y))
       (p2007b4-less
        (p2007b4-zero)
        (p2007b4-multiply x y)))))))

(defun p2007b4-coefficient-list-p (coefficients)
  (if (consp coefficients)
      (and
       (p2007b4-scalar-p (car coefficients))
       (p2007b4-coefficient-list-p
        (cdr coefficients)))
    (equal coefficients nil)))

;; Coefficients use increasing degree order.
(defun p2007b4-polynomial-value (coefficients x)
  (if (consp coefficients)
      (p2007b4-add
       (car coefficients)
       (p2007b4-multiply
        x
        (p2007b4-polynomial-value
         (cdr coefficients) x)))
    (p2007b4-zero)))

(defun p2007b4-polynomial-p (coefficients)
  (and
   (true-listp coefficients)
   (p2007b4-coefficient-list-p coefficients)))

(defun p2007b4-odd-degree-polynomial-p (coefficients)
  (and
   (p2007b4-polynomial-p coefficients)
   (consp coefficients)
   (evenp (len coefficients))
   (not
    (equal
     (car (last coefficients))
     (p2007b4-zero)))))

(defun-sk p2007b4-square-root-exists-p (x)
  (exists (root)
    (and
     (p2007b4-scalar-p root)
     (equal
      (p2007b4-multiply root root)
      x))))

(defun-sk p2007b4-positive-square-roots-p ()
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (and
      (p2007b4-scalar-p x)
      (p2007b4-less (p2007b4-zero) x))
     (p2007b4-square-root-exists-p x))))

(defun-sk p2007b4-polynomial-root-exists-p
    (coefficients)
  (exists (root)
    (and
     (p2007b4-scalar-p root)
     (equal
      (p2007b4-polynomial-value
       coefficients root)
      (p2007b4-zero)))))

(defun-sk p2007b4-odd-polynomial-roots-p ()
  (forall (coefficients)
    (implies
     (p2007b4-odd-degree-polynomial-p coefficients)
     (p2007b4-polynomial-root-exists-p
      coefficients))))

(defun p2007b4-real-closed-field-p ()
  (and
   (p2007b4-scalar-p (p2007b4-zero))
   (p2007b4-scalar-p (p2007b4-one))
   (not (equal (p2007b4-zero) (p2007b4-one)))
   (p2007b4-less (p2007b4-zero) (p2007b4-one))
   (p2007b4-field-laws-p)
   (p2007b4-order-laws-p)
   (p2007b4-positive-square-roots-p)
   (p2007b4-odd-polynomial-roots-p)))

;; Canonical real polynomials have no trailing zero coefficient. NIL is the
;; unique zero polynomial.

(defun p2007b4-canonical-polynomial-p (coefficients)
  (and
   (p2007b4-polynomial-p coefficients)
   (or
    (endp coefficients)
    (not
     (equal
      (car (last coefficients))
      (p2007b4-zero))))))

(defun p2007b4-polynomial-normalize (coefficients)
  (if (consp coefficients)
      (let ((tail
             (p2007b4-polynomial-normalize
              (cdr coefficients))))
        (if (and
             (endp tail)
             (equal (car coefficients)
                    (p2007b4-zero)))
            nil
          (cons (car coefficients) tail)))
    nil))

(defun p2007b4-polynomial-add-raw (left right)
  (cond
   ((endp left) right)
   ((endp right) left)
   (t
    (cons
     (p2007b4-add (car left) (car right))
     (p2007b4-polynomial-add-raw
      (cdr left) (cdr right))))))

(defun p2007b4-polynomial-add (left right)
  (p2007b4-polynomial-normalize
   (p2007b4-polynomial-add-raw left right)))

(defun p2007b4-polynomial-scale (scalar polynomial)
  (if (consp polynomial)
      (cons
       (p2007b4-multiply scalar (car polynomial))
       (p2007b4-polynomial-scale
        scalar (cdr polynomial)))
    nil))

(defun p2007b4-polynomial-shift (polynomial)
  (if (consp polynomial)
      (cons (p2007b4-zero) polynomial)
    nil))

(defun p2007b4-polynomial-multiply (left right)
  (if (consp left)
      (p2007b4-polynomial-add
       (p2007b4-polynomial-scale
        (car left) right)
       (p2007b4-polynomial-shift
        (p2007b4-polynomial-multiply
         (cdr left) right)))
    nil))

(defun p2007b4-zero-coefficients (count)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix count)))
  (if (zp count)
      nil
    (cons
     (p2007b4-zero)
     (p2007b4-zero-coefficients (- count 1)))))

(defun p2007b4-target-polynomial (n)
  (if (posp n)
      (cons
       (p2007b4-one)
       (append
        (p2007b4-zero-coefficients
         (- (* 2 n) 1))
        (list (p2007b4-one))))
    nil))

(defun p2007b4-degree-greater-p (left right)
  (and
   (consp left)
   (or
    (endp right)
    (< (len right) (len left)))))

(defun p2007b4-qualifying-p (n p q)
  (and
   (posp n)
   (p2007b4-canonical-polynomial-p p)
   (p2007b4-canonical-polynomial-p q)
   (p2007b4-degree-greater-p p q)
   (equal
    (p2007b4-polynomial-add
     (p2007b4-polynomial-multiply p p)
     (p2007b4-polynomial-multiply q q))
    (p2007b4-target-polynomial n))))

(defun p2007b4-pair-p (pair n)
  (and
   (true-listp pair)
   (equal (len pair) 2)
   (p2007b4-qualifying-p
    n (nth 0 pair) (nth 1 pair))))

(defun p2007b4-distinct-from-list-p (pair pairs)
  (if (consp pairs)
      (and
       (not (equal pair (car pairs)))
       (p2007b4-distinct-from-list-p
        pair (cdr pairs)))
    (equal pairs nil)))

(defun p2007b4-distinct-qualifying-list-p (pairs n)
  (if (consp pairs)
      (and
       (p2007b4-pair-p (car pairs) n)
       (p2007b4-distinct-from-list-p
        (car pairs) (cdr pairs))
       (p2007b4-distinct-qualifying-list-p
        (cdr pairs) n))
    (equal pairs nil)))

(defun-sk p2007b4-covers-all-qualifying-p (pairs n)
  (forall (p q)
    (implies
     (p2007b4-qualifying-p n p q)
     (member-equal (list p q) pairs))))

(defun p2007b4-exact-enumeration-p (pairs n)
  (and
   (true-listp pairs)
   (equal (len pairs) (expt 2 (+ n 1)))
   (p2007b4-distinct-qualifying-list-p pairs n)
   (p2007b4-covers-all-qualifying-p pairs n)))

(defun-sk p2007b4-exact-cardinality-p (n)
  (exists (pairs)
    (p2007b4-exact-enumeration-p pairs n)))

(defun putnambench-putnam-2007-b4-statement (n)
  (implies
   (and
    (posp n)
    (p2007b4-real-closed-field-p))
   (p2007b4-exact-cardinality-p n)))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

title: putnam_2007_b4
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2007_b4
-- (putnambench__agda__putnam_2007_b4): counting ordered pairs of real
-- polynomials P and Q with P^2 + Q^2 = X^(2n) + 1 and deg P > deg Q.
-- This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module Main where

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; _*_; _-_)

infix 4 _!=_ _<=N_ _<N_
infixr 3 _and_
infixr 2 _or_

data Bottom : Set where

Not : Set -> Set
Not A =
  A -> Bottom

_!=_ : {A : Set} -> A -> A -> Set
x != y =
  Not (x == y)

record _and_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data _or_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  left  : A -> A or B
  right : B -> A or B

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

data _<=N_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set where
  zero<=N   : {n : Nat} -> zero <=N n
  suc<=sucN : {m n : Nat} -> m <=N n -> suc m <=N suc n

_<N_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set
m <N n =
  suc m <=N n

data Fin : Nat -> Set where
  fzero : {n : Nat} -> Fin (suc n)
  fsuc  : {n : Nat} -> Fin n -> Fin (suc n)

record CompleteOrderedRealField (R : Set) : Set1 where
  field
    zeroR oneR : R
    add multiply : R -> R -> R
    negate inverse : R -> R
    lessOrEqual : R -> R -> Set
    fromNat : Nat -> R

    one-not-zero :
      oneR != zeroR

    add-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> add x y == add y x
    add-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      add (add x y) z == add x (add y z)
    add-zero :
      (x : R) -> add x zeroR == x
    add-inverse :
      (x : R) -> add x (negate x) == zeroR

    multiply-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> multiply x y == multiply y x
    multiply-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply (multiply x y) z ==
      multiply x (multiply y z)
    multiply-one :
      (x : R) -> multiply x oneR == x
    multiply-zero :
      (x : R) -> multiply x zeroR == zeroR
    distribute :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply x (add y z) ==
      add (multiply x y) (multiply x z)
    inverse-zero :
      inverse zeroR == zeroR
    multiply-inverse :
      (x : R) ->
      x != zeroR ->
      multiply x (inverse x) == oneR

    order-reflexive :
      (x : R) -> lessOrEqual x x
    order-transitive :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y z ->
      lessOrEqual x z
    order-antisymmetric :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y x ->
      x == y
    order-total :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y or lessOrEqual y x
    add-order :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual (add z x) (add z y)
    multiply-nonnegative :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR x ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR y ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR (multiply x y)
    zero-less-than-one :
      lessOrEqual zeroR oneR and zeroR != oneR

    fromNat-zero :
      fromNat zero == zeroR
    fromNat-successor :
      (n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (suc n) == add (fromNat n) oneR
    fromNat-addition :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m + n) == add (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-multiplication :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m * n) == multiply (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-injective :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat m == fromNat n ->
      m == n

    archimedean :
      (x : R) ->
      Exists Nat
        (\ n ->
          lessOrEqual x (fromNat n))
    least-upper-bound :
      (P : R -> Set) ->
      Exists R P ->
      Exists R
        (\ upper ->
          (x : R) ->
          P x ->
          lessOrEqual x upper) ->
      Exists R
        (\ supremum ->
          ((x : R) ->
            P x ->
            lessOrEqual x supremum)
          and
          ((upper : R) ->
            ((x : R) ->
              P x ->
              lessOrEqual x upper) ->
            lessOrEqual supremum upper))

open CompleteOrderedRealField

record Polynomial
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) :
  Set where

  field
    coefficient :
      Nat ->
      R
    degree-bound :
      Nat
    coefficient-above-bound :
      (k : Nat) ->
      degree-bound <N k ->
      coefficient k == zeroR reals

open Polynomial

PolynomialEqual :
  {R : Set} ->
  {reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R} ->
  Polynomial reals ->
  Polynomial reals ->
  Set
PolynomialEqual p q =
  (k : Nat) ->
  coefficient p k == coefficient q k

ZeroPolynomial :
  {R : Set} ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) ->
  Polynomial reals ->
  Set
ZeroPolynomial reals p =
  (k : Nat) ->
  coefficient p k == zeroR reals

LeadingDegree :
  {R : Set} ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) ->
  Polynomial reals ->
  Nat ->
  Set
LeadingDegree reals p d =
  coefficient p d != zeroR reals
  and
  ((k : Nat) ->
    d <N k ->
    coefficient p k == zeroR reals)

DegreeGreater :
  {R : Set} ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) ->
  Polynomial reals ->
  Polynomial reals ->
  Set
DegreeGreater reals p q =
  Exists Nat
    (\ p-degree ->
      LeadingDegree reals p p-degree
      and
      (ZeroPolynomial reals q
      or
      Exists Nat
        (\ q-degree ->
          LeadingDegree reals q q-degree
          and
          q-degree <N p-degree)))

sumFirst :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Nat ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  R
sumFirst reals zero term =
  zeroR reals
sumFirst reals (suc n) term =
  add reals
    (sumFirst reals n term)
    (term n)

productCoefficient :
  {R : Set} ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) ->
  Polynomial reals ->
  Polynomial reals ->
  Nat ->
  R
productCoefficient reals p q k =
  sumFirst reals (suc k)
    (\ i ->
      multiply reals
        (coefficient p i)
        (coefficient q (k - i)))

squareSumCoefficient :
  {R : Set} ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) ->
  Polynomial reals ->
  Polynomial reals ->
  Nat ->
  R
squareSumCoefficient reals p q k =
  add reals
    (productCoefficient reals p p k)
    (productCoefficient reals q q k)

record PolynomialEquation
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R)
  (n : Nat)
  (p q : Polynomial reals) :
  Set where

  field
    constant-coefficient :
      squareSumCoefficient reals p q zero ==
      oneR reals
    leading-coefficient :
      squareSumCoefficient reals p q (n + n) ==
      oneR reals
    all-other-coefficients :
      (k : Nat) ->
      k != zero ->
      k != n + n ->
      squareSumCoefficient reals p q k ==
      zeroR reals

record PolynomialPair
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) :
  Set where

  constructor pair
  field
    first-polynomial  : Polynomial reals
    second-polynomial : Polynomial reals

open PolynomialPair

PairEqual :
  {R : Set} ->
  {reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R} ->
  PolynomialPair reals ->
  PolynomialPair reals ->
  Set
PairEqual left-pair right-pair =
  PolynomialEqual
    (first-polynomial left-pair)
    (first-polynomial right-pair)
  and
  PolynomialEqual
    (second-polynomial left-pair)
    (second-polynomial right-pair)

QualifyingPair :
  {R : Set} ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) ->
  Nat ->
  PolynomialPair reals ->
  Set
QualifyingPair reals n polynomial-pair =
  PolynomialEquation reals n
    (first-polynomial polynomial-pair)
    (second-polynomial polynomial-pair)
  and
  DegreeGreater reals
    (first-polynomial polynomial-pair)
    (second-polynomial polynomial-pair)

record HasExtensionalCardinality
  {A : Set}
  (P : A -> Set)
  (equivalent : A -> A -> Set)
  (cardinality : Nat) :
  Set where

  field
    enumerate :
      Fin cardinality ->
      A
    enumerated-member :
      (index : Fin cardinality) ->
      P (enumerate index)
    enumeration-complete :
      (item : A) ->
      P item ->
      Exists (Fin cardinality)
        (\ index ->
          equivalent item (enumerate index))
    enumeration-injective :
      (left-index right-index : Fin cardinality) ->
      equivalent
        (enumerate left-index)
        (enumerate right-index) ->
      left-index == right-index

twoN : Nat
twoN =
  suc (suc zero)

naturalPowerNat : Nat -> Nat -> Nat
naturalPowerNat base zero =
  suc zero
naturalPowerNat base (suc exponent) =
  base * naturalPowerNat base exponent

putnam-2007-b4 : Set1
putnam-2007-b4 =
  (R : Set) ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) ->
  (n : Nat) ->
  zero <N n ->
  HasExtensionalCardinality
    (QualifyingPair reals n)
    PairEqual
    (naturalPowerNat twoN (suc n))

title: putnam_2007_b4
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2007_b4:
  the number of real-polynomial pairs whose squares sum to X^(2n) + 1 and
  whose degrees are strictly decreasing is 2^(n+1). This file contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open arithmeticTheory pred_setTheory realTheory;

val putnam_2007_b4 =
  ``let finite_poly =
      \P : num -> real. FINITE {k : num | P k <> 0}
    in
    let square_coeff =
      \P : num -> real.
        \k : num.
          SIGMA
            (\i : num. P i * P (k - i))
            (count (k + 1))
    in
    let poly_degree =
      \P : num -> real. MAX_SET {k : num | P k <> 0}
    in
      !n : num.
        0 < n
        ==>
        CARD
          {pq : (num -> real) # (num -> real) |
             finite_poly (FST pq) /\
             finite_poly (SND pq) /\
             (!k : num.
                square_coeff (FST pq) k +
                  square_coeff (SND pq) k =
                if k = 0 \/ k = 2 * n then 1 else 0) /\
             poly_degree (FST pq) > poly_degree (SND pq)} =
        2 EXP (n + 1)``;

title: putnam_2007_b4

% Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2007_b4:
% the number of real-polynomial pairs whose squares sum to X^(2*n) + 1 and
% whose first polynomial has larger degree. This file contains no proof.

putnam_2007_b4: THEORY
BEGIN
  real_polynomial: TYPE = [nat -> real]
  polynomial_pair: TYPE =
    [# first_polynomial: real_polynomial,
       second_polynomial: real_polynomial #]

  IMPORTING finite_sets[polynomial_pair]

  is_polynomial(P: real_polynomial): bool =
    EXISTS (degree_bound: nat):
      FORALL (index: nat):
        index > degree_bound IMPLIES P(index) = 0

  convolution_prefix(
      P, Q: real_polynomial,
      coefficient, count: nat): RECURSIVE real =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      LET left_index: nat = count - 1 IN
        convolution_prefix(P, Q, coefficient, count - 1)
          + IF left_index <= coefficient THEN
              P(left_index) * Q(coefficient - left_index)
            ELSE
              0
            ENDIF
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  product_coefficient(
      P, Q: real_polynomial,
      coefficient: nat): real =
    convolution_prefix(P, Q, coefficient, coefficient + 1)

  target_coefficient(n, coefficient: nat): real =
    IF coefficient = 0 AND coefficient = 2 * n THEN
      2
    ELSIF coefficient = 0 OR coefficient = 2 * n THEN
      1
    ELSE
      0
    ENDIF

  strictly_higher_degree(
      P, Q: real_polynomial): bool =
    EXISTS (leading_index: nat):
      NOT P(leading_index) = 0
        AND (FORALL (index: nat):
          index > leading_index IMPLIES P(index) = 0)
        AND (FORALL (index: nat):
          index >= leading_index IMPLIES Q(index) = 0)

  qualifying(pair: polynomial_pair, n: nat): bool =
    is_polynomial(first_polynomial(pair))
      AND is_polynomial(second_polynomial(pair))
      AND (FORALL (coefficient: nat):
        product_coefficient(
          first_polynomial(pair),
          first_polynomial(pair),
          coefficient)
          + product_coefficient(
            second_polynomial(pair),
            second_polynomial(pair),
            coefficient)
        = target_coefficient(n, coefficient))
      AND strictly_higher_degree(
        first_polynomial(pair), second_polynomial(pair))

  putnam_2007_b4_solution(n: nat): nat =
    2 ^ (n + 1)

  putnam_2007_b4_statement: bool =
    FORALL (n: nat):
      n > 0 IMPLIES
        EXISTS (solutions: finite_set[polynomial_pair]):
          card(solutions) = putnam_2007_b4_solution(n)
            AND (FORALL (pair: polynomial_pair):
              solutions(pair) IFF qualifying(pair, n))
END putnam_2007_b4

import Mathlib

open Set Nat Function

/--
Let $k$ be a positive integer. Prove that there exist polynomials $P_0(n), P_1(n), \dots, P_{k-1}(n)$ (which may depend on $k$) such that for any integer $n$,
\[
\left\lfloor \frac{n}{k} \right\rfloor^k = P_0(n) + P_1(n) \left\lfloor
\frac{n}{k} \right\rfloor + \cdots + P_{k-1}(n) \left\lfloor \frac{n}{k}
\right\rfloor^{k-1}.
\]
($\lfloor a \rfloor$ means the largest integer $\leq a$.)
-/
theorem putnam_2007_b5
(k : ℕ) (kpos : k > 0) :
(∃ P : Finset.range k → Polynomial ℝ, ∀ n : ℤ, ⌊(n : ℝ) / k⌋ ^ k = ∑ i : Finset.range k, (P i).eval (n : ℝ) * ⌊(n : ℝ) / k⌋ ^ (i : ℕ)) :=

(* Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench artifact putnam_2007_b5:
   expressing the kth power of floor(n/k) as a polynomial-weighted sum of
   its lower powers for every integer n. This file contains no proof. *)

From Stdlib Require Import Reals ZArith List Arith.

Import ListNotations.
Open Scope R_scope.

Record putnam_2007_b5_real_polynomial : Type := {
  putnam_2007_b5_coefficient : nat -> R;
  putnam_2007_b5_bound : nat;
  putnam_2007_b5_finite_support :
    forall degree : nat,
      (putnam_2007_b5_bound < degree)%nat ->
      putnam_2007_b5_coefficient degree = 0
}.

Definition putnam_2007_b5_evaluate
    (P : putnam_2007_b5_real_polynomial) (x : R) : R :=
  sum_f_R0
    (fun degree : nat =>
      putnam_2007_b5_coefficient P degree * x ^ degree)
    (putnam_2007_b5_bound P).

Fixpoint putnam_2007_b5_weighted_sum
    (polynomials : list putnam_2007_b5_real_polynomial)
    (n quotient : R) (index : nat) : R :=
  match polynomials with
  | [] => 0
  | P :: remaining =>
      putnam_2007_b5_evaluate P n * quotient ^ index +
      putnam_2007_b5_weighted_sum remaining n quotient (S index)
  end.

Definition putnam_2007_b5_floor (x : R) : R :=
  IZR (Int_part x).

Theorem putnam_2007_b5 :
  forall k : nat,
    (0 < k)%nat ->
    exists polynomials : list putnam_2007_b5_real_polynomial,
      length polynomials = k /\
      forall n : Z,
        let quotient :=
          putnam_2007_b5_floor (IZR n / INR k) in
        quotient ^ k =
        putnam_2007_b5_weighted_sum
          polynomials (IZR n) quotient 0.
Admitted.
