content:
;; Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2007_b5:
;; existence of k real polynomials expressing floor(n/k)^k as a polynomial
;; combination of its lower powers for every integer n. This file contains no
;; proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))

;; A real coefficient is represented by a tame regular-Cauchy name over the
;; rationals. Finite coefficient lists in ascending degree order therefore
;; represent arbitrary real polynomials, including the zero polynomial.
;;
;; The outer DEFUN-SK keeps the source existential over a list of exactly k
;; polynomials. The identity predicate then universally quantifies every ACL2
;; integer n and every positive rational precision. Its approximation error is
;; divided by the sum of the absolute coefficient multipliers, so requiring
;; distance at most epsilon for every epsilon is exact equality over the
;; represented reals. No finite sampling or rational-coefficient reduction is
;; used.

(defun putnam-2007-b5-quoted (object)
  (list 'quote object))

(defun putnam-2007-b5-term-list (terms)
  (if (consp terms)
      (list 'cons
            (car terms)
            (putnam-2007-b5-term-list (cdr terms)))
    nil))

(defun putnam-2007-b5-apply-term (function arguments)
  (list 'apply$
        (putnam-2007-b5-quoted function)
        (putnam-2007-b5-term-list arguments)))

(defun putnam-2007-b5-and-terms (terms)
  (if (consp terms)
      (list 'if
            (car terms)
            (putnam-2007-b5-and-terms (cdr terms))
            (putnam-2007-b5-quoted nil))
    (putnam-2007-b5-quoted t)))

(defun putnam-2007-b5-implies-term (hypothesis conclusion)
  (list 'if
        hypothesis
        conclusion
        (putnam-2007-b5-quoted t)))

(defun putnam-2007-b5-add-term (left right)
  (list 'binary-+ left right))

(defun putnam-2007-b5-negate-term (value)
  (list 'unary-- value))

(defun putnam-2007-b5-subtract-term (left right)
  (putnam-2007-b5-add-term
   left
   (putnam-2007-b5-negate-term right)))

(defun putnam-2007-b5-absolute-term (value)
  (list 'if
        (list '< value (putnam-2007-b5-quoted 0))
        (putnam-2007-b5-negate-term value)
        value))

(defun putnam-2007-b5-less-equal-term (left right)
  (list 'if
        (list '< right left)
        (putnam-2007-b5-quoted nil)
        (putnam-2007-b5-quoted t)))

(defun putnam-2007-b5-positive-rational-term (value)
  (putnam-2007-b5-and-terms
   (list
    (list 'rationalp value)
    (list '< (putnam-2007-b5-quoted 0) value))))

(defun putnam-2007-b5-true-function (formals)
  (list 'lambda
        formals
        (putnam-2007-b5-quoted t)))

(defun putnam-2007-b5-real-name-cauchy-function (name)
  (let* ((left
          (putnam-2007-b5-apply-term name '(epsilon)))
         (right
          (putnam-2007-b5-apply-term name '(eta)))
         (distance
          (putnam-2007-b5-absolute-term
           (putnam-2007-b5-subtract-term left right))))
    (list
     'lambda
     '(epsilon eta)
     (putnam-2007-b5-implies-term
      (putnam-2007-b5-and-terms
       (list
        (putnam-2007-b5-positive-rational-term 'epsilon)
        (putnam-2007-b5-positive-rational-term 'eta)))
      (putnam-2007-b5-and-terms
       (list
        (list 'rationalp left)
        (list 'rationalp right)
        (putnam-2007-b5-less-equal-term
         distance
         (putnam-2007-b5-add-term
          'epsilon 'eta))))))))

(defun putnam-2007-b5-real-name-p (name)
  (let ((matrix
         (putnam-2007-b5-real-name-cauchy-function name))
        (always-true
         (putnam-2007-b5-true-function
          '(epsilon eta))))
    (and
     (tamep-functionp name)
     (tamep-functionp matrix)
     (tamep-functionp always-true)
     (fn-equal matrix always-true))))

(defun putnam-2007-b5-real-polynomial-p (polynomial)
  (if (consp polynomial)
      (and
       (putnam-2007-b5-real-name-p (car polynomial))
       (putnam-2007-b5-real-polynomial-p
        (cdr polynomial)))
    (equal polynomial nil)))

(defun putnam-2007-b5-polynomial-family-p
    (polynomials k)
  (and
   (true-listp polynomials)
   (equal (len polynomials) (nfix k))
   (if (consp polynomials)
       (and
        (putnam-2007-b5-real-polynomial-p
         (car polynomials))
        (putnam-2007-b5-polynomial-family-p
         (cdr polynomials)
         (- (nfix k) 1)))
     (zp k))))

(defun putnam-2007-b5-polynomial-approximation
    (polynomial x precision)
  (if (consp polynomial)
      (+
       (apply$ (car polynomial) (list precision))
       (*
        x
        (putnam-2007-b5-polynomial-approximation
         (cdr polynomial) x precision)))
    0))

(defun putnam-2007-b5-polynomial-weight
    (polynomial x)
  (if (consp polynomial)
      (+
       1
       (*
        (abs x)
        (putnam-2007-b5-polynomial-weight
         (cdr polynomial) x)))
    0))

(defun putnam-2007-b5-family-approximation
    (polynomials n quotient precision index)
  (if (consp polynomials)
      (+
       (*
        (putnam-2007-b5-polynomial-approximation
         (car polynomials) n precision)
        (expt quotient (nfix index)))
       (putnam-2007-b5-family-approximation
        (cdr polynomials)
        n
        quotient
        precision
        (+ 1 (nfix index))))
    0))

(defun putnam-2007-b5-family-weight
    (polynomials n quotient index)
  (if (consp polynomials)
      (+
       (*
        (putnam-2007-b5-polynomial-weight
         (car polynomials) n)
        (abs
         (expt quotient (nfix index))))
       (putnam-2007-b5-family-weight
        (cdr polynomials)
        n
        quotient
        (+ 1 (nfix index))))
    0))

(defun-sk putnam-2007-b5-identity-at-integer-p
    (polynomials k n)
  (forall
   (epsilon)
   (implies
    (and
     (rationalp epsilon)
     (< 0 epsilon))
    (let* ((quotient (floor n k))
           (weight
            (putnam-2007-b5-family-weight
             polynomials n quotient 0))
           (precision
            (/ epsilon
               (if (< 0 weight) weight 1)))
           (approximation
            (putnam-2007-b5-family-approximation
             polynomials n quotient precision 0))
           (target (expt quotient k)))
      (and
       (rationalp approximation)
       (<=
        (abs (- approximation target))
        epsilon))))))

(defun-sk putnam-2007-b5-identity-for-all-integers-p
    (polynomials k)
  (forall
   (n)
   (implies
    (integerp n)
    (putnam-2007-b5-identity-at-integer-p
     polynomials k n))))

(defun-sk putnam-2007-b5-witness-exists-p (k)
  (exists
   (polynomials)
   (and
    (putnam-2007-b5-polynomial-family-p
     polynomials k)
    (putnam-2007-b5-identity-for-all-integers-p
     polynomials k))))

(defun putnambench-putnam-2007-b5-statement (k)
  (implies
   (posp k)
   (putnam-2007-b5-witness-exists-p k)))

;; This evaluation checks the function objects used by the real-name
;; representation; it asserts no theorem and admits no proof or axiom.
(value-triple
 (list
  :itpeval-tame-functions
  (tamep-functionp
   (putnam-2007-b5-real-name-cauchy-function
    '(lambda (epsilon) '0)))))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

content:
-- Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2007_b5
-- (putnambench__agda__putnam_2007_b5): positive k admits k real
-- polynomials expressing floor(n/k)^k in lower powers of floor(n/k) for
-- every integer n. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module Putnam2007B5 where

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Int using (Int; pos; negsuc)
open import Agda.Builtin.List using (List; []; _∷_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; _*_)

infix 4 _!=_
infixr 3 _and_
infixr 2 _or_

data Bottom : Set where

Not : Set -> Set
Not A =
  A -> Bottom

_!=_ : {A : Set} -> A -> A -> Set
x != y =
  Not (x == y)

record _and_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data _or_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  left  : A -> A or B
  right : B -> A or B

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

data Positive : Nat -> Set where
  positive : {n : Nat} -> Positive (suc n)

data Fin : Nat -> Set where
  fzero : {n : Nat} -> Fin (suc n)
  fsuc  : {n : Nat} -> Fin n -> Fin (suc n)

finToNat : {n : Nat} -> Fin n -> Nat
finToNat fzero =
  zero
finToNat (fsuc i) =
  suc (finToNat i)

intSuccessor : Int -> Int
intSuccessor (pos n) =
  pos (suc n)
intSuccessor (negsuc zero) =
  pos zero
intSuccessor (negsuc (suc n)) =
  negsuc n

embedInt :
  {R : Set} ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  (R -> R) ->
  Int ->
  R
embedInt fromNatural negateR (pos n) =
  fromNatural n
embedInt fromNatural negateR (negsuc n) =
  negateR (fromNatural (suc n))

record CompleteOrderedRealField (R : Set) : Set1 where
  field
    zeroR oneR : R
    add multiply : R -> R -> R
    negate inverse : R -> R
    lessOrEqual : R -> R -> Set
    fromNat : Nat -> R
    floor : R -> Int

    one-not-zero :
      oneR != zeroR

    add-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> add x y == add y x
    add-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      add (add x y) z == add x (add y z)
    add-zero :
      (x : R) -> add x zeroR == x
    add-inverse :
      (x : R) -> add x (negate x) == zeroR

    multiply-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> multiply x y == multiply y x
    multiply-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply (multiply x y) z ==
      multiply x (multiply y z)
    multiply-one :
      (x : R) -> multiply x oneR == x
    multiply-zero :
      (x : R) -> multiply x zeroR == zeroR
    distribute :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply x (add y z) ==
      add (multiply x y) (multiply x z)
    inverse-zero :
      inverse zeroR == zeroR
    multiply-inverse :
      (x : R) ->
      x != zeroR ->
      multiply x (inverse x) == oneR

    order-reflexive :
      (x : R) -> lessOrEqual x x
    order-transitive :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y z ->
      lessOrEqual x z
    order-antisymmetric :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y x ->
      x == y
    order-total :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y or lessOrEqual y x
    add-order :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual (add z x) (add z y)
    multiply-nonnegative :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR x ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR y ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR (multiply x y)
    zero-less-than-one :
      lessOrEqual zeroR oneR and zeroR != oneR

    fromNat-zero :
      fromNat zero == zeroR
    fromNat-successor :
      (n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (suc n) == add (fromNat n) oneR
    fromNat-addition :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m + n) == add (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-multiplication :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m * n) == multiply (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-injective :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat m == fromNat n ->
      m == n

    archimedean :
      (x : R) ->
      Exists Nat
        (\ n ->
          lessOrEqual x (fromNat n))
    least-upper-bound :
      (P : R -> Set) ->
      Exists R P ->
      Exists R
        (\ upper ->
          (x : R) ->
          P x ->
          lessOrEqual x upper) ->
      Exists R
        (\ supremum ->
          ((x : R) ->
            P x ->
            lessOrEqual x supremum)
          and
          ((upper : R) ->
            ((x : R) ->
              P x ->
              lessOrEqual x upper) ->
            lessOrEqual supremum upper))

    floor-lower :
      (x : R) ->
      lessOrEqual
        (embedInt fromNat negate (floor x))
        x
    floor-upper :
      (x : R) ->
      lessOrEqual
        x
        (embedInt fromNat negate (intSuccessor (floor x)))
      and
      x != embedInt fromNat negate (intSuccessor (floor x))

open CompleteOrderedRealField

fromInt :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Int ->
  R
fromInt reals =
  embedInt (fromNat reals) (negate reals)

divide :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
divide reals x y =
  multiply reals x (inverse reals y)

naturalPower :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  Nat ->
  R
naturalPower reals x zero =
  oneR reals
naturalPower reals x (suc exponent) =
  multiply reals
    (naturalPower reals x exponent)
    x

Polynomial : Set -> Set
Polynomial R =
  List R

evaluatePolynomial :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Polynomial R ->
  R ->
  R
evaluatePolynomial reals [] x =
  zeroR reals
evaluatePolynomial reals (coefficient ∷ coefficients) x =
  add reals
    coefficient
    (multiply reals
      x
      (evaluatePolynomial reals coefficients x))

sumFin :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  {count : Nat} ->
  (Fin count -> R) ->
  R
sumFin reals {zero} term =
  zeroR reals
sumFin reals {suc count} term =
  add reals
    (term fzero)
    (sumFin reals (\ i -> term (fsuc i)))

module Putnam2007B5Statement
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) where

  floorQuotient :
    Nat ->
    Int ->
    Int
  floorQuotient k n =
    floor reals
      (divide reals
        (fromInt reals n)
        (fromNat reals k))

  IdentityFor :
    (k : Nat) ->
    (Fin k -> Polynomial R) ->
    Int ->
    Set
  IdentityFor k polynomials n =
    let
      quotient = fromInt reals (floorQuotient k n)
      argument = fromInt reals n
    in
    naturalPower reals quotient k
    ==
    sumFin reals
      (\ i ->
        multiply reals
          (evaluatePolynomial reals (polynomials i) argument)
          (naturalPower reals quotient (finToNat i)))

  proposition : Set
  proposition =
    (k : Nat) ->
    Positive k ->
    Exists (Fin k -> Polynomial R)
      (\ polynomials ->
        (n : Int) ->
        IdentityFor k polynomials n)

putnam-2007-b5 : Set1
putnam-2007-b5 =
  (R : Set) ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) ->
  Putnam2007B5Statement.proposition reals

(*
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2007_b5:
  existence, for every positive integer k, of k real polynomials expressing
  the kth power of floor(n/k) for every integer n. This file contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open arithmeticTheory integerTheory listTheory pred_setTheory realTheory;
open intrealTheory polyTheory;

val putnam_2007_b5 =
  ``!k : num.
      0 < k
      ==>
      ?P : real list list.
        LENGTH P = k /\
        !n : int.
          let q =
            real_of_int
              (INT_FLOOR (real_of_int n / (&k : real)))
          in
            q pow k =
              SIGMA
                (\i : num.
                   poly (EL i P) (real_of_int n) * q pow i)
                (count k)``;

$(
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact
  putnam_2007_b5: existence of k real polynomials expressing the kth power
  of floor(n/k) as a polynomial combination of its lower powers for every
  integer n. This file contains no proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  Base ` ( Poly1 ` RRfld ) is set.mm's carrier of arbitrary finite-support
  univariate polynomials over the reals, and eval1 evaluates such a
  polynomial at a real input. For positive k, the interval 0 ... ( k - 1 )
  has exactly the k indices used in both source formulations.

  The function P is existentially quantified inside the quantifier over k,
  preserving that the polynomial family may depend on k. Quantifying k over
  NN is equivalent to the source natural-number domain together with k > 0,
  while n remains universally quantified over all integers. The final
  declaration is the single unproved $a corpus statement; this database
  contains no $p proof statement.
$)

${
  $d P i k n $.

  putnambench-putnam-2007-b5 $a |-
    A. k e. NN
      E. P e.
        (
          ( Base ` ( Poly1 ` RRfld ) )
          ^m
          ( 0 ... ( k - 1 ) )
        )
        A. n e. ZZ
          (
            ( ( |_ ` ( n / k ) ) ^ k )
            =
            (
              sum_ i e. ( 0 ... ( k - 1 ) )
                (
                  (
                    (
                      (
                        ( eval1 ` RRfld )
                        `
                        ( P ` i )
                      )
                      `
                      n
                    )
                    x.
                    ( ( |_ ` ( n / k ) ) ^ i )
                  )
                )
            )
          )
  $.
$}

title: putnam_2007_b5
content:
% Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2007_b5:
% for every positive integer k, a family of k real polynomials represents the
% kth power of floor(n/k) for every integer n. This file contains no proof.

putnam_2007_b5: THEORY
BEGIN
  polynomial: TYPE = list[real]

  polynomial_value(p: polynomial, x: real): RECURSIVE real =
    CASES p OF
      null: 0,
      cons(coefficient, tail):
        coefficient + x * polynomial_value(tail, x)
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE p BY <<

  polynomial_power_sum(
      P: [nat -> polynomial],
      n, quotient: int,
      count: nat): RECURSIVE real =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      LET index: nat = count - 1 IN
        polynomial_power_sum(P, n, quotient, count - 1)
          + polynomial_value(P(index), n :: real)
              * (quotient :: real) ^ index
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  putnam_2007_b5: bool =
    FORALL (k: nat):
      k > 0 IMPLIES
        EXISTS (P: [nat -> polynomial]):
          FORALL (n: int):
            LET quotient: int =
              floor((n :: real) / (k :: real))
            IN
              (quotient :: real) ^ k
                = polynomial_power_sum(P, n, quotient, k)
END putnam_2007_b5

(* Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2007_b6:
   the number of unordered factorial-coin representations of n! and its
   two-sided asymptotic bounds. This file contains no proof. *)

From Stdlib Require Import
  Reals Lists.List Sorting.Sorted Arith.PeanoNat Arith.Factorial.

Open Scope R_scope.

Definition putnam_2007_b6_has_cardinality
    {A : Type} (P : A -> Prop) (n : nat) : Prop :=
  exists xs : list A,
    NoDup xs /\
    (forall x : A, In x xs <-> P x) /\
    length xs = n.

Definition putnam_2007_b6_coin_collection
    (n : nat) (coins : list nat) : Prop :=
  Sorted Nat.le coins /\
  fold_right Nat.add 0%nat coins = fact n /\
  forall m : nat,
    In m coins ->
    exists k : nat,
      (1 <= k <= n)%nat /\
      m = fact k.

Theorem putnam_2007_b6
    (f : nat -> nat)
    (hf : forall n : nat,
      putnam_2007_b6_has_cardinality
        (putnam_2007_b6_coin_collection n) (f n)) :
  exists C : R,
    forall n : nat,
      (2 <= n)%nat ->
      Rpower (INR n) ((INR n) ^ 2 / 2 - C * INR n) *
        exp (- ((INR n) ^ 2) / 4) <= INR (f n) /\
      INR (f n) <=
        Rpower (INR n) ((INR n) ^ 2 / 2 + C * INR n) *
          exp (- ((INR n) ^ 2) / 4).
Admitted.

title: putnam_2007_b6
putnam_2007_b6
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2007_b6:
;; the number of unordered collections of factorial-valued coins summing to
;; n! satisfies the stated two-sided real exponential bounds for some constant
;; independent of n. This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))

;; The final predicate presents a Dedekind-complete ordered field, hence a
;; copy of the real field. The exponential is fixed by its exact power series,
;; and logarithm is its inverse on the positive reals, so P07B6-R-POWR is the
;; usual positive-base real power. The recursive coin count is definitionally
;; the number of multisets of denominations 1!,...,n! whose sum is n!.

(defun p07b6-member-p (carrier value)
  (if (apply$ carrier (list value)) t nil))

(defun p07b6-unary (operation value)
  (apply$ operation (list value)))

(defun p07b6-binary (operation left right)
  (apply$ operation (list left right)))

(defun-sk p07b6-field-laws-p
    (carrier zero one add multiply negate inverse)
  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (p07b6-member-p carrier x)
      (p07b6-member-p carrier y)
      (p07b6-member-p carrier z))
     (let* ((xy-add (p07b6-binary add x y))
            (yz-add (p07b6-binary add y z))
            (xy-multiply (p07b6-binary multiply x y))
            (yz-multiply (p07b6-binary multiply y z))
            (negative-x (p07b6-unary negate x))
            (inverse-x (p07b6-unary inverse x)))
       (and
        (p07b6-member-p carrier xy-add)
        (p07b6-member-p carrier xy-multiply)
        (p07b6-member-p carrier negative-x)
        (p07b6-member-p carrier inverse-x)
        (equal
         (p07b6-binary add xy-add z)
         (p07b6-binary add x yz-add))
        (equal xy-add (p07b6-binary add y x))
        (equal (p07b6-binary add x zero) x)
        (equal (p07b6-binary add x negative-x) zero)
        (equal
         (p07b6-binary multiply xy-multiply z)
         (p07b6-binary multiply x yz-multiply))
        (equal xy-multiply (p07b6-binary multiply y x))
        (equal (p07b6-binary multiply x one) x)
        (implies
         (equal x zero)
         (equal inverse-x zero))
        (implies
         (not (equal x zero))
         (equal (p07b6-binary multiply x inverse-x) one))
        (equal
         (p07b6-binary multiply x yz-add)
         (p07b6-binary
          add
          (p07b6-binary multiply x y)
          (p07b6-binary multiply x z))))))))

(defun-sk p07b6-order-laws-p
    (carrier zero add multiply less)
  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (p07b6-member-p carrier x)
      (p07b6-member-p carrier y)
      (p07b6-member-p carrier z))
     (and
      (not (p07b6-binary less x x))
      (or
       (equal x y)
       (p07b6-binary less x y)
       (p07b6-binary less y x))
      (implies
       (and
        (p07b6-binary less x y)
        (p07b6-binary less y z))
       (p07b6-binary less x z))
      (implies
       (p07b6-binary less x y)
       (p07b6-binary
        less
        (p07b6-binary add x z)
        (p07b6-binary add y z)))
      (implies
       (and
        (p07b6-binary less zero x)
        (p07b6-binary less zero y))
       (p07b6-binary
        less
        zero
        (p07b6-binary multiply x y)))))))

(defun-sk p07b6-valid-set-p (carrier set)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (apply$ set (list x))
     (p07b6-member-p carrier x))))

(defun-sk p07b6-set-nonempty-p (carrier set)
  (exists (x)
    (and
     (p07b6-member-p carrier x)
     (apply$ set (list x)))))

(defun-sk p07b6-upper-bound-p (carrier less set bound)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (and
      (p07b6-member-p carrier x)
      (apply$ set (list x)))
     (not (p07b6-binary less bound x)))))

(defun-sk p07b6-bounded-above-p (carrier less set)
  (exists (bound)
    (and
     (p07b6-member-p carrier bound)
     (p07b6-upper-bound-p carrier less set bound))))

(defun-sk p07b6-least-upper-bound-p
    (carrier less set supremum)
  (forall (bound)
    (and
     (p07b6-member-p carrier supremum)
     (p07b6-upper-bound-p carrier less set supremum)
     (implies
      (and
       (p07b6-member-p carrier bound)
       (p07b6-upper-bound-p carrier less set bound))
      (not (p07b6-binary less bound supremum))))))

(defun-sk p07b6-has-supremum-p (carrier less set)
  (exists (supremum)
    (p07b6-least-upper-bound-p
     carrier less set supremum)))

(defun-sk p07b6-dedekind-complete-p (carrier less)
  (forall (set)
    (implies
     (and
      (tamep-functionp set)
      (p07b6-valid-set-p carrier set)
      (p07b6-set-nonempty-p carrier set)
      (p07b6-bounded-above-p carrier less set))
     (p07b6-has-supremum-p carrier less set))))

(defun p07b6-real-field-p
    (carrier zero one add multiply negate inverse less)
  (and
   (tamep-functionp carrier)
   (tamep-functionp add)
   (tamep-functionp multiply)
   (tamep-functionp negate)
   (tamep-functionp inverse)
   (tamep-functionp less)
   (p07b6-member-p carrier zero)
   (p07b6-member-p carrier one)
   (not (equal zero one))
   (p07b6-field-laws-p
    carrier zero one add multiply negate inverse)
   (p07b6-order-laws-p
    carrier zero add multiply less)
   (p07b6-binary less zero one)
   (p07b6-dedekind-complete-p carrier less)))

(defun p07b6-r-add (add left right)
  (p07b6-binary add left right))

(defun p07b6-r-multiply (multiply left right)
  (p07b6-binary multiply left right))

(defun p07b6-r-negate (negate value)
  (p07b6-unary negate value))

(defun p07b6-r-inverse (inverse value)
  (p07b6-unary inverse value))

(defun p07b6-r-subtract (add negate left right)
  (p07b6-r-add add left (p07b6-r-negate negate right)))

(defun p07b6-r-divide
    (multiply inverse numerator denominator)
  (p07b6-r-multiply
   multiply numerator (p07b6-r-inverse inverse denominator)))

(defun p07b6-r-absolute-value (zero negate less value)
  (if (p07b6-binary less value zero)
      (p07b6-r-negate negate value)
    value))

(defun p07b6-r-nat (n zero one add)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix n)))
  (if (zp n)
      zero
    (p07b6-r-add
     add one (p07b6-r-nat (1- n) zero one add))))

(defun p07b6-r-power (base exponent one multiply)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix exponent)))
  (if (zp exponent)
      one
    (p07b6-r-multiply
     multiply
     base
     (p07b6-r-power base (1- exponent) one multiply))))

(defun p07b6-r-factorial
    (n zero one add multiply)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix n)))
  (if (zp n)
      one
    (p07b6-r-multiply
     multiply
     (p07b6-r-nat n zero one add)
     (p07b6-r-factorial
      (1- n) zero one add multiply))))

(defun p07b6-factorial (n)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix n)))
  (if (zp n)
      1
    (* n (p07b6-factorial (1- n)))))

(defun p07b6-coin-count (amount maximum-index)
  (declare
   (xargs
    :measure
    (make-ord
     1
     (+ 1 (nfix maximum-index))
     (nfix amount))
    :well-founded-relation o<))
  (if (and (natp amount) (natp maximum-index))
      (cond
       ((zp amount) 1)
       ((zp maximum-index) 0)
       (t
        (let ((coin (p07b6-factorial maximum-index)))
          (+
           (p07b6-coin-count amount (1- maximum-index))
           (if (<= coin amount)
               (p07b6-coin-count
                (- amount coin) maximum-index)
             0)))))
    0))

(defun p07b6-f (n)
  (if (natp n)
      (p07b6-coin-count (p07b6-factorial n) n)
    0))

(defun p07b6-exp-prefix
    (x terms zero one add multiply inverse)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix terms)))
  (if (zp terms)
      zero
    (let ((index (1- terms)))
      (p07b6-r-add
       add
       (p07b6-exp-prefix
        x index zero one add multiply inverse)
       (p07b6-r-divide
        multiply
        inverse
        (p07b6-r-power x index one multiply)
        (p07b6-r-factorial
         index zero one add multiply))))))

(defun-sk p07b6-exp-tail-p
    (zero one add multiply negate inverse less
     x limit epsilon cutoff)
  (forall (terms)
    (implies
     (and
      (natp terms)
      (<= cutoff terms))
     (p07b6-binary
      less
      (p07b6-r-absolute-value
       zero
       negate
       less
       (p07b6-r-subtract
        add
        negate
        (p07b6-exp-prefix
         x terms zero one add multiply inverse)
        limit))
      epsilon))))

(defun-sk p07b6-exp-cutoff-exists-p
    (zero one add multiply negate inverse less
     x limit epsilon)
  (exists (cutoff)
    (and

title: putnam_2007_b6
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2007_b6
-- (putnambench__agda__putnam_2007_b6): factorial-coin multiset counts satisfy
-- the stated two-sided asymptotic bounds. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module Main where

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; _*_)

infix 4 _!=_ _<=N_
infixr 3 _and_
infixr 2 _or_

data Bottom : Set where

Not : Set -> Set
Not A =
  A -> Bottom

_!=_ : {A : Set} -> A -> A -> Set
x != y =
  Not (x == y)

record _and_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data _or_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  left  : A -> A or B
  right : B -> A or B

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

data _<=N_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set where
  zero<=N   : {n : Nat} -> zero <=N n
  suc<=sucN : {m n : Nat} -> m <=N n -> suc m <=N suc n

data Fin : Nat -> Set where
  fzero : {n : Nat} -> Fin (suc n)
  fsuc  : {n : Nat} -> Fin n -> Fin (suc n)

record CompleteOrderedRealField (R : Set) : Set1 where
  field
    zeroR oneR : R
    add multiply : R -> R -> R
    negate inverse : R -> R
    lessOrEqual : R -> R -> Set
    fromNat : Nat -> R

    one-not-zero :
      oneR != zeroR

    add-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> add x y == add y x
    add-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      add (add x y) z == add x (add y z)
    add-zero :
      (x : R) -> add x zeroR == x
    add-inverse :
      (x : R) -> add x (negate x) == zeroR

    multiply-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> multiply x y == multiply y x
    multiply-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply (multiply x y) z ==
      multiply x (multiply y z)
    multiply-one :
      (x : R) -> multiply x oneR == x
    multiply-zero :
      (x : R) -> multiply x zeroR == zeroR
    distribute :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply x (add y z) ==
      add (multiply x y) (multiply x z)
    inverse-zero :
      inverse zeroR == zeroR
    multiply-inverse :
      (x : R) ->
      x != zeroR ->
      multiply x (inverse x) == oneR

    order-reflexive :
      (x : R) -> lessOrEqual x x
    order-transitive :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y z ->
      lessOrEqual x z
    order-antisymmetric :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y x ->
      x == y
    order-total :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y or lessOrEqual y x
    add-order :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual (add z x) (add z y)
    multiply-nonnegative :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR x ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR y ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR (multiply x y)
    zero-less-than-one :
      lessOrEqual zeroR oneR and zeroR != oneR

    fromNat-zero :
      fromNat zero == zeroR
    fromNat-successor :
      (n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (suc n) == add (fromNat n) oneR
    fromNat-addition :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m + n) == add (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-multiplication :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m * n) == multiply (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-injective :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat m == fromNat n ->
      m == n

    archimedean :
      (x : R) ->
      Exists Nat
        (\ n ->
          lessOrEqual x (fromNat n))
    least-upper-bound :
      (P : R -> Set) ->
      Exists R P ->
      Exists R
        (\ upper ->
          (x : R) ->
          P x ->
          lessOrEqual x upper) ->
      Exists R
        (\ supremum ->
          ((x : R) ->
            P x ->
            lessOrEqual x supremum)
          and
          ((upper : R) ->
            ((x : R) ->
              P x ->
              lessOrEqual x upper) ->
            lessOrEqual supremum upper))

open CompleteOrderedRealField

subtract :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
subtract reals x y =
  add reals x (negate reals y)

divide :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
divide reals numerator denominator =
  multiply reals numerator (inverse reals denominator)

StrictLess :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
StrictLess reals x y =
  lessOrEqual reals x y and x != y

CloseTo :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
CloseTo reals center radius x =
  StrictLess reals
    (subtract reals center radius)
    x
  and
  StrictLess reals
    x
    (add reals center radius)

naturalPower :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  Nat ->
  R
naturalPower reals x zero =
  oneR reals
naturalPower reals x (suc exponent) =
  multiply reals
    (naturalPower reals x exponent)
    x

factorial : Nat -> Nat
factorial zero =
  suc zero
factorial (suc n) =
  suc n * factorial n

sumFirstReal :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Nat ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  R
sumFirstReal reals zero term =
  zeroR reals
sumFirstReal reals (suc n) term =
  add reals
    (sumFirstReal reals n term)
    (term n)

ConvergesTo :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  R ->
  Set
ConvergesTo {R} reals sequence limit =
  (epsilon : R) ->
  StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) epsilon ->
  Exists Nat
    (\ cutoff ->
      (n : Nat) ->
      cutoff <=N n ->
      CloseTo reals limit epsilon (sequence n))

SeriesHasSum :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  R ->
  Set
SeriesHasSum reals terms limit =
  ConvergesTo reals
    (\ n -> sumFirstReal reals n terms)
    limit

exponentialTerm :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  Nat ->
  R
exponentialTerm reals x n =
  divide reals
    (naturalPower reals x n)
    (fromNat reals (factorial n))

ExponentialValue :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
ExponentialValue reals x value =
  SeriesHasSum reals
    (exponentialTerm reals x)
    value

record StandardExpLog
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) :
  Set1 where

  field
    exponential logarithm :
      R ->
      R

    exponential-series :
      (x : R) ->
      ExponentialValue reals x (exponential x)

    logarithm-inverse :
      (x : R) ->
      StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) x ->
      exponential (logarithm x) == x

open StandardExpLog

realPower :
  {R : Set} ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) ->
  StandardExpLog reals ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
realPower reals analysis base exponent =
  exponential analysis
    (multiply reals
      (logarithm analysis base)
      exponent)

sumFirstNat :
  Nat ->
  (Nat -> Nat) ->
  Nat
sumFirstNat zero term =
  zero
sumFirstNat (suc n) term =
  sumFirstNat n term + term n

oneN : Nat
oneN =
  suc zero

twoN : Nat
twoN =
  suc oneN

fourN : Nat
fourN =
  twoN + twoN

CoinMultiset :
  Nat ->
  (Nat -> Nat) ->
  Set
CoinMultiset n multiplicity =
  Exists Nat
    (\ supportBound ->
      ((value : Nat) ->
        supportBound <=N value ->
        multiplicity value == zero)
      and
      sumFirstNat supportBound
        (\ value ->
          multiplicity value * value)
        == factorial n
      and
      ((value : Nat) ->
        oneN <=N multiplicity value ->
        Exists Nat
          (\ k ->
            oneN <=N k
            and
            k <=N n
            and
            value == factorial k)))

MultisetEqual :
  (Nat -> Nat) ->
  (Nat -> Nat) ->
  Set
MultisetEqual leftMultiplicity rightMultiplicity =
  (value : Nat) ->
  leftMultiplicity value == rightMultiplicity value

record HasExtensionalCardinality
  {A : Set}
  (P : A -> Set)
  (equivalent : A -> A -> Set)
  (cardinality : Nat) :
  Set where

  field
    enumerate :
      Fin cardinality ->
      A
    enumerated-member :
      (index : Fin cardinality) ->
      P (enumerate index)
    enumeration-complete :
      (item : A) ->
      P item ->
      Exists (Fin cardinality)
        (\ index ->
          equivalent item (enumerate index))
    enumeration-injective :
      (left-index right-index : Fin cardinality) ->
      equivalent
        (enumerate left-index)
        (enumerate right-index) ->
      left-index == right-index

CountsFactorialCoinMultisets :
  (Nat -> Nat) ->
  Set
CountsFactorialCoinMultisets f =
  (n : Nat) ->
  HasExtensionalCardinality
    (CoinMultiset n)
    MultisetEqual
    (f n)

squareOfNat :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Nat ->
  R
squareOfNat reals n =
  multiply reals
    (fromNat reals n)
    (fromNat reals n)

halfSquare :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Nat ->
  R
halfSquare reals n =
  divide reals
    (squareOfNat reals n)
    (fromNat reals twoN)

linearTerm :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  Nat ->
  R
linearTerm reals C n =
  multiply reals C (fromNat reals n)

lowerExponent :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  Nat ->
  R
lowerExponent reals C n =
  subtract reals
    (halfSquare reals n)
    (linearTerm reals C n)

upperExponent :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  Nat ->
  R
upperExponent reals C n =
  add reals
    (halfSquare reals n)
    (linearTerm reals C n)

negativeQuarterSquare :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Nat ->
  R
negativeQuarterSquare reals n =
  negate reals
    (divide reals
      (squareOfNat reals n)
      (fromNat reals fourN))

scaledPower :
  {R : Set} ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) ->
  (analysis : StandardExpLog reals) ->
  Nat ->
  R ->
  R
scaledPower reals analysis n exponent =
  multiply reals
    (realPower reals analysis
      (fromNat reals n)
      exponent)
    (exponential analysis
      (negativeQuarterSquare reals n))

AsymptoticBounds :
  {R : Set} ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) ->
  StandardExpLog reals ->
  (Nat -> Nat) ->
  Set
AsymptoticBounds {R} reals analysis f =
  Exists R
    (\ C ->
      (n : Nat) ->
      twoN <=N n ->
      lessOrEqual reals
        (scaledPower reals analysis n
          (lowerExponent reals C n))
        (fromNat reals (f n))
      and
      lessOrEqual reals
        (fromNat reals (f n))
        (scaledPower reals analysis n
          (upperExponent reals C n)))

putnam-2007-b6 : Set1
putnam-2007-b6 =
  (R : Set) ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) ->
  (analysis : StandardExpLog reals) ->
  (f : Nat -> Nat) ->
  CountsFactorialCoinMultisets f ->
  AsymptoticBounds reals analysis f

(*

  the number of unordered collections of factorial-denomination coins making
  n factorial satisfies the stated two-sided asymptotic bounds for one
  constant independent of n. This file contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open arithmeticTheory pred_setTheory realTheory transcTheory bagTheory;

val putnam_2007_b6 =
  ``let f =
      \n : num.
        CARD
          {M : num bag |
             FINITE_BAG M /\
             BAG_GEN_SUM M 0 = FACT n /\
             !m : num.
               BAG_IN m M
               ==>
               ?k : num. 1 <= k /\ k <= n /\ m = FACT k}
    in
      ?C : real.
        !n : num.
          2 <= n
          ==>
          ((&n : real) powr
             (((&n : real) pow 2) / 2 - C * (&n : real)) *
             exp (-(((&n : real) pow 2) / 4)) <=
             (&(f n) : real)) /\
          ((&(f n) : real) <=
             (&n : real) powr
               (((&n : real) pow 2) / 2 + C * (&n : real)) *
               exp (-(((&n : real) pow 2) / 4)))``;

${

end;

% factorial-denomination coin collections totaling n! have the stated

putnam_2007_b6: THEORY
BEGIN
  real_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> real]

  safe_div(numerator, denominator: real): real =
    IF denominator = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      numerator / denominator
    ENDIF

  nat_factorial(n: nat): RECURSIVE nat =
    IF n = 0 THEN
      1
    ELSE
      n * nat_factorial(n - 1)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE n

  factorial_coin_sum(
      code, n, next_denomination, remaining: nat): RECURSIVE nat =
    IF remaining = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      mod(code, nat_factorial(n) + 1)
          * nat_factorial(next_denomination)
        + factorial_coin_sum(
            ndiv(code, nat_factorial(n) + 1),
            n,
            next_denomination + 1,
            remaining - 1)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE remaining

  factorial_coin_code(code, n: nat): bool =
    code < (nat_factorial(n) + 1) ^ n
      AND factorial_coin_sum(code, n, 1, n) = nat_factorial(n)

  count_below(
      limit: nat,
      property: [nat -> bool]): RECURSIVE nat =
    IF limit = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      count_below(limit - 1, property)
        + IF property(limit - 1) THEN 1 ELSE 0 ENDIF
    ENDIF
  MEASURE limit

  factorial_coin_collection_count(n: nat): nat =
    count_below(
      (nat_factorial(n) + 1) ^ n,
      LAMBDA (code: nat): factorial_coin_code(code, n))

  exponential_partial(x: real, count: nat): RECURSIVE real =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      LET index: nat = count - 1 IN
        exponential_partial(x, count - 1)
          + safe_div(
              x ^ index,
              nat_factorial(index) :: real)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  converges_to(sequence: real_sequence, value: real): bool =
    FORALL (epsilon_value: posreal):
      EXISTS (cutoff: nat):
        FORALL (index: nat):
          cutoff <= index IMPLIES
            abs(sequence(index) - value) < epsilon_value

  real_exponential(x: real): real =
    epsilon(
      LAMBDA (value: real):
        converges_to(
          LAMBDA (count: nat):
            exponential_partial(x, count),
          value))

  natural_log(x: real): real =
    IF x > 0 THEN
      epsilon(
        LAMBDA (value: real):
          real_exponential(value) = x)
    ELSE
      0
    ENDIF

  real_power(base, exponent: real): real =
    IF base > 0 THEN
      real_exponential(exponent * natural_log(base))
    ELSIF base = 0 AND exponent = 0 THEN
      1
    ELSE
      0
    ENDIF

  putnam_2007_b6: bool =
    EXISTS (C: real):
      FORALL (n: nat):
        n >= 2 IMPLIES
          LET n_real: real = n :: real,
              n_squared: real = n_real ^ 2,
              exponential_factor: real =
                real_exponential(-n_squared / 4)
          IN
            real_power(
              n_real,
              n_squared / 2 - C * n_real)
                * exponential_factor
              <= (factorial_coin_collection_count(n) :: real)
            AND
            (factorial_coin_collection_count(n) :: real)
              <= real_power(
                  n_real,
                  n_squared / 2 + C * n_real)
                    * exponential_factor
END putnam_2007_b6

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))

;; F is an arbitrary function on an arbitrary strict ordered field. The
;; source existential function has the explicit witness g(x) = f(x, 0);
;; stating that this witness works is equivalent to the existential
;; conclusion under the cyclic-sum hypothesis.
(defstub p2008a1-carrier (x) t)
(defstub p2008a1-add-op (x y) t)
(defstub p2008a1-multiply-op (x y) t)
(defstub p2008a1-negate-op (x) t)
(defstub p2008a1-less-op (x y) t)
(defstub p2008a1-f (x y) t)

(defun p2008a1-member-p (x)
  (if (p2008a1-carrier x) t nil))

(defun p2008a1-add (x y)
  (p2008a1-add-op x y))

(defun p2008a1-mul (x y)
  (p2008a1-multiply-op x y))

(defun p2008a1-neg (x)
  (p2008a1-negate-op x))

(defun p2008a1-sub (x y)
  (p2008a1-add x (p2008a1-neg y)))

(defun p2008a1-less (x y)
  (if (p2008a1-less-op x y) t nil))

(defun-sk p2008a1-ring-laws-p (zero one)
  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (p2008a1-member-p x)
      (p2008a1-member-p y)
      (p2008a1-member-p z))
     (and
      (p2008a1-member-p (p2008a1-add x y))
      (p2008a1-member-p (p2008a1-mul x y))
      (p2008a1-member-p (p2008a1-neg x))
      (equal (p2008a1-add (p2008a1-add x y) z)
             (p2008a1-add x (p2008a1-add y z)))
      (equal (p2008a1-add x y)
             (p2008a1-add y x))
      (equal (p2008a1-add x zero) x)
      (equal (p2008a1-add x (p2008a1-neg x)) zero)
      (equal (p2008a1-mul (p2008a1-mul x y) z)
             (p2008a1-mul x (p2008a1-mul y z)))
      (equal (p2008a1-mul x y)
             (p2008a1-mul y x))
      (equal (p2008a1-mul x one) x)
      (equal
       (p2008a1-mul x (p2008a1-add y z))
       (p2008a1-add (p2008a1-mul x y)
                    (p2008a1-mul x z)))))))

(defun-sk p2008a1-order-laws-p (zero)
  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (p2008a1-member-p x)
      (p2008a1-member-p y)
      (p2008a1-member-p z))
     (and
      (not (p2008a1-less x x))
      (or (equal x y)
          (p2008a1-less x y)
          (p2008a1-less y x))
      (implies
       (and (p2008a1-less x y)
            (p2008a1-less y z))
       (p2008a1-less x z))
      (implies
       (p2008a1-less x y)
       (p2008a1-less (p2008a1-add x z)
                     (p2008a1-add y z)))
      (implies
       (and (p2008a1-less zero x)
            (p2008a1-less zero y))
       (p2008a1-less zero (p2008a1-mul x y)))))))

(defun p2008a1-ordered-ring-p (zero one)
  (and
   (p2008a1-member-p zero)
   (p2008a1-member-p one)
   (not (equal zero one))
   (p2008a1-less zero one)
   (p2008a1-ring-laws-p zero one)
   (p2008a1-order-laws-p zero)))

-- Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2008_a1
-- (putnambench__agda__putnam_2008_a1): a real-valued function satisfying the
-- cyclic three-variable sum identity is the difference of a unary real
-- function at its two arguments. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module Putnam2008A1 where

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; _*_)

infix 4 _!=_
infixr 3 _and_
infixr 2 _or_

data Bottom : Set where

Not : Set -> Set
Not A =
  A -> Bottom

_!=_ : {A : Set} -> A -> A -> Set
x != y =
  Not (x == y)

record _and_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data _or_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  left  : A -> A or B
  right : B -> A or B

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

record CompleteOrderedRealField (R : Set) : Set1 where
  field
    zeroR oneR : R
    add multiply : R -> R -> R
    negate inverse : R -> R
    lessOrEqual : R -> R -> Set
    fromNat : Nat -> R

    one-not-zero :
      oneR != zeroR

    add-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> add x y == add y x
    add-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      add (add x y) z == add x (add y z)
    add-zero :
      (x : R) -> add x zeroR == x
    add-inverse :
      (x : R) -> add x (negate x) == zeroR

    multiply-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> multiply x y == multiply y x
    multiply-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply (multiply x y) z ==
      multiply x (multiply y z)
    multiply-one :
      (x : R) -> multiply x oneR == x
    multiply-zero :
      (x : R) -> multiply x zeroR == zeroR
    distribute :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply x (add y z) ==
      add (multiply x y) (multiply x z)
    inverse-zero :
      inverse zeroR == zeroR
    multiply-inverse :
      (x : R) ->
      x != zeroR ->
      multiply x (inverse x) == oneR

    order-reflexive :
      (x : R) -> lessOrEqual x x
    order-transitive :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y z ->
      lessOrEqual x z
    order-antisymmetric :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y x ->
      x == y
    order-total :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y or lessOrEqual y x
    add-order :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual (add z x) (add z y)
    multiply-nonnegative :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR x ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR y ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR (multiply x y)
    zero-less-than-one :
      lessOrEqual zeroR oneR and zeroR != oneR

    fromNat-zero :
      fromNat zero == zeroR
    fromNat-successor :
      (n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (suc n) == add (fromNat n) oneR
    fromNat-addition :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m + n) == add (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-multiplication :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m * n) == multiply (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-injective :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat m == fromNat n ->
      m == n

    archimedean :
      (x : R) ->
      Exists Nat
        (\ n -> lessOrEqual x (fromNat n))
    least-upper-bound :
      (P : R -> Set) ->
      Exists R P ->
      Exists R
        (\ upper ->
          (x : R) ->
          P x ->
          lessOrEqual x upper) ->
      Exists R
        (\ supremum ->
          ((x : R) ->
            P x ->
            lessOrEqual x supremum)
          and
          ((upper : R) ->
            ((x : R) ->
              P x ->
              lessOrEqual x upper) ->
            lessOrEqual supremum upper))

open CompleteOrderedRealField

subtract :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
subtract reals x y =
  add reals x (negate reals y)

putnam-2008-a1 : Set1
putnam-2008-a1 =
  (R : Set) ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) ->
  (f : R -> R -> R) ->
  ((x y z : R) ->
    add reals
      (add reals (f x y) (f y z))
      (f z x)
    == zeroR reals) ->
  Exists (R -> R)
    (\ g ->
      (x y : R) ->
      f x y == subtract reals (g x) (g y))

import Mathlib

/--
Start with a finite sequence $a_1, a_2, \dots, a_n$ of positive integers. If possible, choose two indices $j < k$ such that $a_j$ does not divide $a_k$, and replace $a_j$ and $a_k$ by $\mathrm{gcd}(a_j, a_k)$ and $\mathrm{lcm}(a_j, a_k)$, respectively. Prove that if this process is repeated, it must eventually stop and the final sequence does not depend on the choices made.
-/
theorem putnam_2008_a3
      (n : ℕ) (npos : n > 0)
      (a : Fin n → ℕ)
      (apos : ∀ i : Fin n, a i > 0)
      (cont : (Fin n → ℕ) → Prop)
      (hcont : ∀ s, cont s ↔ ∃ j k : Fin n, j < k ∧ ¬(s j ∣ s k))
      (init trans : (ℕ → Fin n → ℕ) → Prop)
      (hinit : ∀ P, init P ↔ P 0 = a)
      (htrans : ∀ P, trans P ↔ ∀ t : ℕ, cont (P t) →
            ∃ j k : Fin n, j < k ∧ ¬(P t j ∣ P t k) ∧ P (t + 1) j = Nat.gcd (P t j) (P t k) ∧ P (t + 1) k = Nat.lcm (P t j) (P t k) ∧
            ∀ i : Fin n, i ≠ j → i ≠ k → P (t + 1) i = P t i) :
      (∃ f, ∀ P, init P → trans P → ∃ t : ℕ, ¬cont (P t) ∧ P t = f) :=

(* Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2008_a3:
   repeated gcd-lcm replacements on a finite sequence of positive integers
   terminate at a sequence independent of the choices; this file contains
   no proof. *)

From Stdlib Require Import Arith.PeanoNat Vectors.Fin.

Definition putnam_2008_a3_index_lt
    {n : nat} (i j : Fin.t n) : Prop :=
  (proj1_sig (Fin.to_nat i) < proj1_sig (Fin.to_nat j))%nat.

Definition putnam_2008_a3_cont
    {n : nat} (s : Fin.t n -> nat) : Prop :=
  exists j k : Fin.t n,
    putnam_2008_a3_index_lt j k /\
    ~ Nat.divide (s j) (s k).

Definition putnam_2008_a3_init
    {n : nat} (a : Fin.t n -> nat)
    (P : nat -> Fin.t n -> nat) : Prop :=
  P 0%nat = a.

Definition putnam_2008_a3_trans
    {n : nat} (P : nat -> Fin.t n -> nat) : Prop :=
  forall t : nat,
    putnam_2008_a3_cont (P t) ->
    exists j k : Fin.t n,
      putnam_2008_a3_index_lt j k /\
      ~ Nat.divide (P t j) (P t k) /\
      P (t + 1)%nat j = Nat.gcd (P t j) (P t k) /\
      P (t + 1)%nat k = Nat.lcm (P t j) (P t k) /\
      forall i : Fin.t n,
        i <> j ->
        i <> k ->
        P (t + 1)%nat i = P t i.

Theorem putnam_2008_a3
    (n : nat)
    (npos : (0 < n)%nat)
    (a : Fin.t n -> nat)
    (apos : forall i : Fin.t n, (0 < a i)%nat) :
  exists f : Fin.t n -> nat,
    forall P : nat -> Fin.t n -> nat,
      putnam_2008_a3_init a P ->
      putnam_2008_a3_trans P ->
      exists t : nat,
        ~ putnam_2008_a3_cont (P t) /\
        P t = f.
Admitted.

theory putnam_2008_a3 imports Complex_Main
begin

theorem putnam_2008_a3:
  fixes n :: "nat"
    and a :: "nat \<Rightarrow> nat"
    and cont :: "(nat \<Rightarrow> nat) \<Rightarrow> bool"
    and init trans :: "(nat \<Rightarrow> nat \<Rightarrow> nat) \<Rightarrow> bool"
  defines "cont \<equiv> \<lambda> s. \<exists> j \<in> {0..n-1}. \<exists> k \<in> {0..n-1}. j < k \<and> (\<not>(s j dvd s k))"
    and "init \<equiv> \<lambda> P. P 0 = a"
    and "trans \<equiv> \<lambda> P. \<forall> t :: nat. (cont (P t) \<longrightarrow> (\<exists> j \<in> {0..n-1}. \<exists> k \<in> {0..n-1}. j < k \<and> (\<not> (P t j dvd P t k)) \<and> P (t + 1) j = gcd (P t j) (P t k) 
        \<and> P (t + 1) k = lcm (P t j) (P t k) \<and> (\<forall> i \<in> {0..n-1}. i \<noteq> j \<longrightarrow> i \<noteq> k \<longrightarrow> P (t + 1) i = P t i)))"
  assumes npos : "n > 0"
    and apos : "\<forall> i \<in> {0..n-1}. a i > 0"
  shows "\<exists> f :: nat \<Rightarrow> nat. \<forall> P :: nat \<Rightarrow> nat \<Rightarrow> nat. init P \<longrightarrow> trans P \<longrightarrow> (\<exists> t :: nat. (\<not>(cont (P t))) \<and> (\<forall> i \<in> {0..n-1}. P t i = f i))"
  sorry

end

title: putnam_2008_a3
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2008_a3:
;; termination and choice-independent outcome of finite positive-integer
;; sequences under ordered gcd/lcm replacement. This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))

;; A is the exact list representation of the source function Fin N -> Nat.
;; CHOICE is an arbitrary schedule function: at each natural time it returns
;; a proposed two-element list (J K). ACL2 functional instantiation makes the
;; theorem uniform over every such schedule. An illegal proposal means that
;; the corresponding source process does not satisfy TRANS, so that branch is
;; correctly vacuous.

(defstub putnam-2008-a3-choice (time) t)

(defun putnam-2008-a3-positive-list-p (values)
  (if (consp values)
      (and
       (posp (car values))
       (putnam-2008-a3-positive-list-p (cdr values)))
    (equal values nil)))

(defun putnam-2008-a3-product (values)
  (if (consp values)
      (* (car values)
         (putnam-2008-a3-product (cdr values)))
    1))

(defun putnam-2008-a3-divides-p (divisor multiple)
  (and
   (posp divisor)
   (natp multiple)
   (equal (mod multiple divisor) 0)))

;; The decreasing candidate search is Euclid's gcd characterized directly as
;; the greatest positive common divisor, avoiding any additional library.

(defun putnam-2008-a3-gcd-through (left right candidate)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix candidate)))
  (if (zp candidate)
      1
    (if (and
         (putnam-2008-a3-divides-p candidate left)
         (putnam-2008-a3-divides-p candidate right))
        candidate
      (putnam-2008-a3-gcd-through
       left right (- candidate 1)))))

(defun putnam-2008-a3-gcd (left right)
  (putnam-2008-a3-gcd-through
   left right (min (nfix left) (nfix right))))

(defun putnam-2008-a3-lcm (left right)
  (floor
   (* (nfix left) (nfix right))
   (putnam-2008-a3-gcd left right)))

(defun putnam-2008-a3-legal-pair-p (values n j k)
  (and
   (natp j)
   (natp k)
   (< j k)
   (< k n)
   (not
    (putnam-2008-a3-divides-p
     (nth j values)
     (nth k values)))))

;; SCAN-FUEL exceeds the number of ordered index pairs.  NIL means that the
;; state is terminal; otherwise the first legal pair is returned.

(defun putnam-2008-a3-first-legal-pair
    (values n j k scan-fuel)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix scan-fuel)))
  (cond
   ((zp scan-fuel) nil)
   ((not (< j n)) nil)
   ((not (< k n))
    (putnam-2008-a3-first-legal-pair
     values n (+ j 1) (+ j 2) (- scan-fuel 1)))
   ((putnam-2008-a3-legal-pair-p values n j k)
    (list j k))
   (t
    (putnam-2008-a3-first-legal-pair
     values n j (+ k 1) (- scan-fuel 1)))))

(defun putnam-2008-a3-find-legal-pair (values n)
  (putnam-2008-a3-first-legal-pair
   values n 0 1 (+ 1 (* n n))))

(defun putnam-2008-a3-step (values j k)
  (let* ((left (nth j values))
         (right (nth k values))
         (new-left (putnam-2008-a3-gcd left right))
         (new-right (putnam-2008-a3-lcm left right)))
    (update-nth
     k new-right
     (update-nth j new-left values))))

;; A legal move preserves the positive product.  Moreover, at the largest
;; changed index K its value strictly increases, since A_J does not divide
;; A_K.  Thus reverse lexicographic order strictly increases.  Every coordinate
;; stays between 1 and the initial product, so PRODUCT^N + 1 steps exceed every
;; possible legal path.

(defun putnam-2008-a3-canonical-final (values n fuel)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix fuel)))
  (if (zp fuel)
      values
    (let ((pair (putnam-2008-a3-find-legal-pair values n)))
      (if pair
          (putnam-2008-a3-canonical-final
           (putnam-2008-a3-step
            values (car pair) (cadr pair))
           n
           (- fuel 1))
        values))))

;; For a proposed time bound T, follow the arbitrary schedule for at most T
;; moves. Reaching TARGET in a terminal state succeeds. An illegal choice also
;; succeeds because that schedule does not encode a source process satisfying
;; TRANS. Exhausting T while a legal move remains fails.

(defun putnam-2008-a3-schedule-outcome-or-invalid-p
    (values n time fuel target)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix fuel)))
  (let ((pair (putnam-2008-a3-find-legal-pair values n)))
    (cond
     ((not pair)
      (equal values target))
     ((zp fuel) nil)
     (t
      (let ((choice (putnam-2008-a3-choice time)))
        (if
            (putnam-2008-a3-legal-pair-p
             values n (car choice) (cadr choice))
            (putnam-2008-a3-schedule-outcome-or-invalid-p
             (putnam-2008-a3-step
              values (car choice) (cadr choice))
             n
             (+ 1 (nfix time))
             (- fuel 1)
             target)
          t))))))

;; This is the source's unbounded existential stopping time. Its witness may
;; depend on the arbitrary schedule, exactly as the source's existential t is
;; nested under the universal process quantifier.

(defun-sk putnam-2008-a3-eventually-reaches-p
    (values n target)
  (exists
   (time)
   (and
    (natp time)
    (putnam-2008-a3-schedule-outcome-or-invalid-p
     values n 0 time target))))

(defun putnambench-putnam-2008-a3-statement (n a)
  (let* ((product (putnam-2008-a3-product a))
         (fuel (+ 1 (expt product n)))
         (target
          (putnam-2008-a3-canonical-final a n fuel)))
    (implies
     (and
      (posp n)
      (true-listp a)
      (equal (len a) n)
      (putnam-2008-a3-positive-list-p a))
     (and
      (not (putnam-2008-a3-find-legal-pair target n))
      (putnam-2008-a3-eventually-reaches-p
       a n target)))))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

title: putnam_2008_a3
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2008_a3
-- (putnambench__agda__putnam_2008_a3): termination and choice-independence
-- of the finite positive-integer gcd/lcm replacement process.
-- This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module Putnam2008A3 where

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _*_)

infix 4 _!=_ _<_ _divides_
infixr 3 _and_

data Bottom : Set where

Not : Set -> Set
Not A =
  A -> Bottom

_!=_ : {A : Set} -> A -> A -> Set
x != y =
  Not (x == y)

record _and_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

data Positive : Nat -> Set where
  positive : {n : Nat} -> Positive (suc n)

data Fin : Nat -> Set where
  fzero : {n : Nat} -> Fin (suc n)
  fsuc  : {n : Nat} -> Fin n -> Fin (suc n)

data _<_ : {n : Nat} -> Fin n -> Fin n -> Set where
  fzero<fsuc :
    {n : Nat} ->
    {j : Fin n} ->
    fzero < fsuc j
  fsuc<fsuc :
    {n : Nat} ->
    {i j : Fin n} ->
    i < j ->
    fsuc i < fsuc j

record _divides_ (divisor dividend : Nat) : Set where
  constructor division
  field
    quotient : Nat
    equation : divisor * quotient == dividend

record IsGCD (x y d : Nat) : Set where
  constructor is-gcd
  field
    gcd-divides-left :
      d divides x
    gcd-divides-right :
      d divides y
    every-common-divisor-divides-gcd :
      (c : Nat) ->
      c divides x ->
      c divides y ->
      c divides d

record IsLCM (x y m : Nat) : Set where
  constructor is-lcm
  field
    left-divides-lcm :
      x divides m
    right-divides-lcm :
      y divides m
    lcm-divides-every-common-multiple :
      (c : Nat) ->
      x divides c ->
      y divides c ->
      m divides c

Continue :
  {n : Nat} ->
  (Fin n -> Nat) ->
  Set
Continue {n} sequence =
  Exists (Fin n)
    (\ j ->
      Exists (Fin n)
        (\ k ->
          (j < k)
          and
          Not (sequence j divides sequence k)))

Initial :
  {n : Nat} ->
  (Fin n -> Nat) ->
  (Nat -> Fin n -> Nat) ->
  Set
Initial {n} initial process =
  (i : Fin n) ->
  process zero i == initial i

Transition :
  {n : Nat} ->
  (Nat -> Fin n -> Nat) ->
  Set
Transition {n} process =
  (t : Nat) ->
  Continue (process t) ->
  Exists (Fin n)
    (\ j ->
      Exists (Fin n)
        (\ k ->
          (j < k)
          and
          (Not (process t j divides process t k)
          and
          (IsGCD
            (process t j)
            (process t k)
            (process (suc t) j)
          and
          (IsLCM
            (process t j)
            (process t k)
            (process (suc t) k)
          and
          ((i : Fin n) ->
            i != j ->
            i != k ->
            process (suc t) i == process t i))))))

putnam-2008-a3 : Set
putnam-2008-a3 =
  (n : Nat) ->
  Positive n ->
  (initial : Fin n -> Nat) ->
  ((i : Fin n) -> Positive (initial i)) ->
  Exists (Fin n -> Nat)
    (\ final ->
      (process : Nat -> Fin n -> Nat) ->
      Initial initial process ->
      Transition process ->
      Exists Nat
        (\ t ->
          Not (Continue (process t))
          and
          ((i : Fin n) ->
            process t i == final i)))

(*
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2008_a3:
  termination and choice-independence of the final positive-integer sequence
  under admissible pairwise gcd/lcm replacements. This file contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open arithmeticTheory dividesTheory gcdTheory;

val putnam_2008_a3 =
  ``!n : num.
    !a : num -> num.
    !cont : (num -> num) -> bool.
    !init : (num -> num -> num) -> bool.
    !trans : (num -> num -> num) -> bool.
      0 < n /\
      (!i : num. i < n ==> 0 < a i) /\
      (!s : num -> num.
        cont s <=>
        ?j k : num.
          j < n /\ k < n /\ j < k /\ ~divides (s j) (s k)) /\
      (!P : num -> num -> num.
        init P <=> !i : num. i < n ==> P 0 i = a i) /\
      (!P : num -> num -> num.
        trans P <=>
        !t : num.
          cont (P t)
          ==>
          ?j k : num.
            j < n /\
            k < n /\
            j < k /\
            ~divides (P t j) (P t k) /\
            P (t + 1) j = gcd (P t j) (P t k) /\
            P (t + 1) k = lcm (P t j) (P t k) /\
            !i : num.
              i < n /\ i <> j /\ i <> k
              ==>
              P (t + 1) i = P t i)
      ==>
      ?f : num -> num.
        !P : num -> num -> num.
          init P /\ trans P
          ==>
          ?t : num.
            ~cont (P t) /\
            !i : num. i < n ==> P t i = f i``;

content:
$(
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact
  putnam_2008_a3: termination and choice-independence of the process replacing
  a nondividing pair of positive integers by its gcd and lcm.
  This file contains no proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  For positive n, the set ( 0 ..^ n ) is the n-element index set corresponding
  to Fin n. The initial sequence a is an arbitrary positive-integer-valued
  function on that set. A trajectory P is an NN0-indexed family of
  nonnegative-integer-valued functions on the same index set.

  The antecedent inlines the source predicates init and trans. At every time
  when some j < k has P(t,j) not dividing P(t,k), the next state is obtained
  by replacing precisely those entries by their gcd and lcm. The conclusion
  says that one finite sequence f is the terminal state of every such
  trajectory, so the stopping state is independent of all legal choices.

  The final declaration is the single unproved $a corpus statement; this
  database contains no $p proof statement.
$)

${
  $d P a f i j k n t $.

  putnambench-putnam-2008-a3 $a |-
    A. n e. NN
      A. a e. ( NN ^m ( 0 ..^ n ) )
        E. f e. ( NN0 ^m ( 0 ..^ n ) )
          A. P e. ( ( NN0 ^m ( 0 ..^ n ) ) ^m NN0 )
            (
              (
                ( P ` 0 ) = a
                /\
                A. t e. NN0
                  (
                    (
                      E. j e. ( 0 ..^ n ) E. k e. ( 0 ..^ n )
                        (
                          j < k
                          /\
                          -. ( ( ( P ` t ) ` j ) || ( ( P ` t ) ` k ) )
                        )
                    )
                    ->
                    E. j e. ( 0 ..^ n ) E. k e. ( 0 ..^ n )
                      (
                        j < k
                        /\
                        (
                          -. ( ( ( P ` t ) ` j ) || ( ( P ` t ) ` k ) )
                          /\
                          (
                            ( ( P ` ( t + 1 ) ) ` j )
                            =
                            ( ( ( P ` t ) ` j ) gcd ( ( P ` t ) ` k ) )
                            /\
                            (
                              ( ( P ` ( t + 1 ) ) ` k )
                              =
                              ( ( ( P ` t ) ` j ) lcm ( ( P ` t ) ` k ) )
                              /\
                              A. i e. ( 0 ..^ n )
                                (
                                  (
                                    i =/= j
                                    /\
                                    i =/= k
                                  )
                                  ->
                                  ( ( P ` ( t + 1 ) ) ` i )
                                  =
                                  ( ( P ` t ) ` i )
                                )
                            )
                          )
                        )
                      )
                  )
              )
              ->
              E. t e. NN0
                (
                  -.
                    E. j e. ( 0 ..^ n ) E. k e. ( 0 ..^ n )
                      (
                        j < k
                        /\
                        -. ( ( ( P ` t ) ` j ) || ( ( P ` t ) ` k ) )
                      )
                  /\
                  ( P ` t ) = f
                )
            )
  $.
$}

:: repeated gcd/lcm replacements on a finite sequence of positive natural

environ
  vocabularies TARSKI, XBOOLE_0, SUBSET_1, RELAT_1, FUNCT_1, FUNCT_2,
    ZFMISC_1, NUMBERS, NAT_1, FINSEQ_1, CARD_1, XCMPLX_0, XREAL_0,

    XXREAL_0, NAT_1, INT_1, INT_2, NAT_D, FINSEQ_1;
  constructors RELSET_1, FUNCT_2, REAL_1, NAT_1, NAT_D, INT_1, INT_2,
    FINSEQ_1;
  registrations XBOOLE_0, SUBSET_1, RELAT_1, FUNCT_1, RELSET_1,
    FUNCT_2, ORDINAL1, NUMBERS, CARD_1, XCMPLX_0, XREAL_0, XXREAL_0,
    NAT_1, INT_1, FINSEQ_1;
  requirements BOOLE, SUBSET, NUMERALS, REAL, ARITHM;

begin

::$P-
theorem
  for n being Nat,
      a being Function of NAT,NAT st
    0 < n &
    (for i being Nat st i in Seg n holds 0 < a.i)
  holds
    ex f being Function of NAT,NAT st
      for P being Function of [:NAT,NAT:],NAT st
        (for i being Nat st i in Seg n holds P.([0,i]) = a.i) &
        (for t being Nat st
          (ex j,k,p,q being Nat st
            j in Seg n & k in Seg n & j < k &
            p = P.([t,j]) & q = P.([t,k]) &
            not (p divides q))

            j in Seg n & k in Seg n & j < k &
            p = P.([t,j]) & q = P.([t,k]) &

title: putnam_2008_a3
content:
% Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench artifact putnam_2008_a3:
% repeated gcd/lcm replacements on a finite positive-integer sequence
% terminate at a sequence independent of all choices. This file contains no proof.

putnam_2008_a3[n: posnat]: THEORY
BEGIN
  index: TYPE = below(n)
  sequence: TYPE = [index -> nat]
  process: TYPE = [nat -> sequence]

  nat_divides(divisor, value: nat): bool =
    EXISTS (quotient: nat):
      value = divisor * quotient

  is_nat_gcd(gcd_value, left, right: nat): bool =
    nat_divides(gcd_value, left)
      AND nat_divides(gcd_value, right)
      AND (FORALL (common_divisor: nat):
        nat_divides(common_divisor, left)
          AND nat_divides(common_divisor, right)
          IMPLIES nat_divides(common_divisor, gcd_value))

  is_nat_lcm(lcm_value, left, right: nat): bool =
    nat_divides(left, lcm_value)
      AND nat_divides(right, lcm_value)
      AND (FORALL (common_multiple: nat):
        nat_divides(left, common_multiple)
          AND nat_divides(right, common_multiple)
          IMPLIES nat_divides(lcm_value, common_multiple))

  positive_sequence(a: sequence): bool =
    FORALL (i: index):
      a(i) > 0

  can_continue(s: sequence): bool =
    EXISTS (j, k: index):
      j < k AND NOT nat_divides(s(j), s(k))

  valid_transition(P: process, t: nat): bool =
    EXISTS (j, k: index):
      j < k
        AND NOT nat_divides(P(t)(j), P(t)(k))
        AND is_nat_gcd(P(t + 1)(j), P(t)(j), P(t)(k))
        AND is_nat_lcm(P(t + 1)(k), P(t)(j), P(t)(k))
        AND (FORALL (i: index):
          i /= j AND i /= k IMPLIES P(t + 1)(i) = P(t)(i))

  valid_process(P: process, a: sequence): bool =
    P(0) = a
      AND (FORALL (t: nat):
        can_continue(P(t)) IMPLIES valid_transition(P, t))

  putnam_2008_a3: bool =
    FORALL (a: sequence):
      positive_sequence(a) IMPLIES
        EXISTS (final_sequence: sequence):
          FORALL (P: process):
            valid_process(P, a) IMPLIES
              EXISTS (t: nat):
                NOT can_continue(P(t))
                  AND P(t) = final_sequence
END putnam_2008_a3
