content:
;; Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2008_a4:
;; divergence of the reciprocal series for the real function defined by
;; f(x)=x up to e and f(x)=x*f(log x) above e. This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))

;; The source recurrence has a unique solution: for x>e, 1<log(x)<x, so
;; repeated logarithms reach the base branch and f(x) is the finite product
;; of that logarithmic chain.  The definitions below give rational
;; approximations to exactly that product.  A finite Taylor prefix tends to e,
;; and the atanh series
;;
;;   log(x) = 2 * sum_(j>=0) z^(2j+1)/(2j+1), z=(x-1)/(x+1),
;;
;; tends to log(x) for every positive x.  At the equality boundary, taking
;; one additional recurrence step has the same value because e*f(1)=e, so the
;; precision-dependent comparison does not change the represented real.
;;
;; For partial sums through U, the diagonal precision grows without bound
;; rapidly enough that all finitely many iterated-log and reciprocal errors
;; together tend to zero.  Hence the rational diagonal sequence is Cauchy iff
;; the source's real partial-sum sequence is Cauchy.  Completeness of the
;; reals then makes its negated Cauchy criterion equivalent to the asserted
;; nonexistence of a real limit.  Positive rational tolerances are cofinal
;; among positive real tolerances.

(defun putnam-2008-a4-factorial (n)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix n)))
  (if (zp n)
      1
    (* n
       (putnam-2008-a4-factorial (- n 1)))))

(defun putnam-2008-a4-exp-one-prefix (terms)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix terms)))
  (if (zp terms)
      0
    (let ((index (- terms 1)))
      (+ (putnam-2008-a4-exp-one-prefix index)
         (/ 1
            (putnam-2008-a4-factorial index))))))

(defun putnam-2008-a4-log-atanh-prefix (z terms)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix terms)))
  (if (zp terms)
      0
    (let* ((index (- terms 1))
           (exponent (+ (* 2 index) 1)))
      (+ (putnam-2008-a4-log-atanh-prefix z index)
         (/ (* 2 (expt z exponent))
            exponent)))))

(defun putnam-2008-a4-log-prefix (x terms)
  (if (and (rationalp x)
           (< 0 x)
           (natp terms))
      (putnam-2008-a4-log-atanh-prefix
       (/ (- x 1) (+ x 1))
       terms)
    0))

;; FUEL is only a totality bound.  For the exact recurrence started at a
;; positive integer n, fewer than n+1 logarithmic steps can be taken above e.
(defun putnam-2008-a4-f-approx-aux
    (current precision fuel)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix fuel)))
  (cond
   ((or (zp fuel)
        (not (rationalp current))
        (<= current 0))
    current)
   ((< (putnam-2008-a4-exp-one-prefix precision)
       current)
    (* current
       (putnam-2008-a4-f-approx-aux
        (putnam-2008-a4-log-prefix current precision)
        precision
        (- fuel 1))))
   (t current)))

(defun putnam-2008-a4-f-approx (n precision)
  (if (and (posp n)
           (posp precision))
      (putnam-2008-a4-f-approx-aux
       n precision (+ n 1))
    0))

(defun putnam-2008-a4-term-approx (n precision)
  (if (and (posp n)
           (posp precision))
      (/ 1
         (putnam-2008-a4-f-approx n precision))
    0))

(defun putnam-2008-a4-series-prefix-approx
    (upper precision)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix upper)))
  (if (zp upper)
      0
    (+ (putnam-2008-a4-series-prefix-approx
        (- upper 1) precision)
       (putnam-2008-a4-term-approx
        upper precision))))

(defun putnam-2008-a4-diagonal-precision (upper)
  (expt
   2
   (+ 64
      (* 64
         (expt (+ (nfix upper) 2) 3)))))

(defun putnam-2008-a4-partial-sum-approx (upper)
  (if (natp upper)
      (putnam-2008-a4-series-prefix-approx
       upper
       (putnam-2008-a4-diagonal-precision upper))
    0))

(defun-sk putnam-2008-a4-cauchy-tail-p
    (epsilon cutoff)
  (forall (left-index right-index)
    (implies
     (and (natp left-index)
          (<= cutoff left-index)
          (natp right-index)
          (<= cutoff right-index))
     (< (abs
         (- (putnam-2008-a4-partial-sum-approx
             left-index)
            (putnam-2008-a4-partial-sum-approx
             right-index)))
        epsilon))))

(defun-sk putnam-2008-a4-cauchy-cutoff-exists-p
    (epsilon)
  (exists (cutoff)
    (and (natp cutoff)
         (putnam-2008-a4-cauchy-tail-p
          epsilon cutoff))))

(defun-sk putnam-2008-a4-series-cauchy-p ()
  (forall (epsilon)
    (implies
     (and (rationalp epsilon)
          (< 0 epsilon))
     (putnam-2008-a4-cauchy-cutoff-exists-p
      epsilon))))

(defun putnambench-putnam-2008-a4-statement ()
  (not (putnam-2008-a4-series-cauchy-p)))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

title: putnam_2008_a4
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2008_a4
-- (putnambench__agda__putnam_2008_a4): divergence of the reciprocal series
-- for the real function defined recursively using exp(1) and log. This file
-- contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module Putnam2008A4 where

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; _*_)

infix 4 _!=_ _<=N_
infixr 3 _and_
infixr 2 _or_

data Bottom : Set where

Not : Set -> Set
Not A =
  A -> Bottom

_!=_ : {A : Set} -> A -> A -> Set
x != y =
  Not (x == y)

record _and_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data _or_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  left  : A -> A or B
  right : B -> A or B

record Iff (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor equivalence
  field
    forward  : A -> B
    backward : B -> A

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

data _<=N_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set where
  zero<=N   : {n : Nat} -> zero <=N n
  suc<=sucN : {m n : Nat} -> m <=N n -> suc m <=N suc n

record CompleteOrderedRealField (R : Set) : Set1 where
  field
    zeroR oneR : R
    add multiply : R -> R -> R
    negate inverse : R -> R
    lessOrEqual : R -> R -> Set
    fromNat : Nat -> R

    one-not-zero :
      oneR != zeroR

    add-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> add x y == add y x
    add-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      add (add x y) z == add x (add y z)
    add-zero :
      (x : R) -> add x zeroR == x
    add-inverse :
      (x : R) -> add x (negate x) == zeroR

    multiply-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> multiply x y == multiply y x
    multiply-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply (multiply x y) z ==
      multiply x (multiply y z)
    multiply-one :
      (x : R) -> multiply x oneR == x
    multiply-zero :
      (x : R) -> multiply x zeroR == zeroR
    distribute :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply x (add y z) ==
      add (multiply x y) (multiply x z)
    inverse-zero :
      inverse zeroR == zeroR
    multiply-inverse :
      (x : R) ->
      x != zeroR ->
      multiply x (inverse x) == oneR

    order-reflexive :
      (x : R) -> lessOrEqual x x
    order-transitive :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y z ->
      lessOrEqual x z
    order-antisymmetric :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y x ->
      x == y
    order-total :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y or lessOrEqual y x
    add-order :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual (add z x) (add z y)
    multiply-nonnegative :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR x ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR y ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR (multiply x y)
    zero-less-than-one :
      lessOrEqual zeroR oneR and zeroR != oneR

    fromNat-zero :
      fromNat zero == zeroR
    fromNat-successor :
      (n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (suc n) == add (fromNat n) oneR
    fromNat-addition :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m + n) == add (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-multiplication :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m * n) == multiply (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-injective :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat m == fromNat n ->
      m == n

    archimedean :
      (x : R) ->
      Exists Nat
        (\ n -> lessOrEqual x (fromNat n))
    least-upper-bound :
      (P : R -> Set) ->
      Exists R P ->
      Exists R
        (\ upper ->
          (x : R) ->
          P x ->
          lessOrEqual x upper) ->
      Exists R
        (\ supremum ->
          ((x : R) ->
            P x ->
            lessOrEqual x supremum)
          and
          ((upper : R) ->
            ((x : R) ->
              P x ->
              lessOrEqual x upper) ->
            lessOrEqual supremum upper))

open CompleteOrderedRealField

subtract :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
subtract reals x y =
  add reals x (negate reals y)

divide :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
divide reals x y =
  multiply reals x (inverse reals y)

StrictLess :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
StrictLess reals x y =
  lessOrEqual reals x y and x != y

CloseTo :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
CloseTo reals center radius x =
  StrictLess reals
    (subtract reals center radius)
    x
  and
  StrictLess reals
    x
    (add reals center radius)

sumFirst :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Nat ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  R
sumFirst reals zero terms =
  zeroR reals
sumFirst reals (suc n) terms =
  add reals
    (sumFirst reals n terms)
    (terms n)

ConvergesTo :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  R ->
  Set
ConvergesTo {R} reals sequence limit =
  (epsilon : R) ->
  StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) epsilon ->
  Exists Nat
    (\ cutoff ->
      (n : Nat) ->
      cutoff <=N n ->
      CloseTo reals limit epsilon (sequence n))

SeriesHasSum :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  R ->
  Set
SeriesHasSum reals terms limit =
  ConvergesTo reals
    (\ n -> sumFirst reals n terms)
    limit

naturalPower :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  Nat ->
  R
naturalPower reals x zero =
  oneR reals
naturalPower reals x (suc n) =
  multiply reals
    (naturalPower reals x n)
    x

factorial : Nat -> Nat
factorial zero =
  suc zero
factorial (suc n) =
  suc n * factorial n

exponentialTerm :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  Nat ->
  R
exponentialTerm reals x n =
  divide reals
    (naturalPower reals x n)
    (fromNat reals (factorial n))

ExponentialValue :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
ExponentialValue reals x value =
  SeriesHasSum reals
    (exponentialTerm reals x)
    value

record StandardRealPowers
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) :
  Set1 where

  field
    exponential logarithm : R -> R

    exponential-series :
      (x : R) ->
      ExponentialValue reals x (exponential x)

    exponential-positive :
      (x : R) ->
      StrictLess reals
        (zeroR reals)
        (exponential x)

    exponential-injective :
      (x y : R) ->
      exponential x == exponential y ->
      x == y

    exponential-logarithm :
      (x : R) ->
      StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) x ->
      exponential (logarithm x) == x

open StandardRealPowers

module Putnam2008A4Statement
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R)
  (powers : StandardRealPowers reals) where

  e : R
  e =
    exponential powers (oneR reals)

  FunctionEquation :
    (R -> R) ->
    Set
  FunctionEquation f =
    (x : R) ->
    (lessOrEqual reals x e ->
      f x == x)
    and
    (StrictLess reals e x ->
      f x ==
      multiply reals
        x
        (f (logarithm powers x)))

  reciprocalTerm :
    (R -> R) ->
    Nat ->
    R
  reciprocalTerm f n =
    divide reals
      (oneR reals)
      (f (fromNat reals (suc n)))

  reciprocalPartialSums :
    (R -> R) ->
    Nat ->
    R
  reciprocalPartialSums f n =
    sumFirst reals n (reciprocalTerm f)

  ReciprocalSeriesConverges :
    (R -> R) ->
    Set
  ReciprocalSeriesConverges f =
    Exists R
      (\ limit ->
        ConvergesTo reals
          (reciprocalPartialSums f)
          limit)

  proposition : Set
  proposition =
    (f : R -> R) ->
    FunctionEquation f ->
    Iff
      (ReciprocalSeriesConverges f)
      Bottom

putnam-2008-a4 : Set1
putnam-2008-a4 =
  (R : Set) ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) ->
  (powers : StandardRealPowers reals) ->
  Putnam2008A4Statement.proposition reals powers

(*

  divergence of the reciprocal series for the real function defined by an
  exponential-threshold logarithmic recurrence. This file contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open arithmeticTheory pred_setTheory realTheory real_sigmaTheory;
open real_topologyTheory transcTheory;

val putnam_2008_a4 =
  ``!f : real -> real.
      (!x : real.
         f x =
         if x <= exp 1 then x else x * f (ln x))
      ==>
      ((?r : real.
          ((\N : num.
              SIGMA
                (\n : num. (1 : real) / f (&n))
                (IMAGE SUC (count N))) --> r)
            sequentially)
       <=> F)``;

$(
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact
  putnam_2008_a4: the reciprocal series for the recursively defined real
  function f(x) = x when x <= exp(1) and f(x) = x f(log x) otherwise does
  not converge. This file contains no proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  RR ^m RR is set.mm's class of total real-valued functions. The hypothesis
  preserves the recursive equation pointwise on all real inputs, including
  the source conditional at exp(1).

  For each n in NN0, the finite sum over 0 ..^ n has terms
  1 / f(k + 1), so it is exactly the first-n partial sum used by the Lean
  source. The negated existential expands failure of convergence to any real
  limit in the epsilon-threshold form. This is logically equivalent to the
  source biconditional between convergence and False. The final declaration
  is the single unproved $a corpus statement; this database has no $p proof
  statement.
$)

${
  $d e f k m n r x $.

  putnambench-putnam-2008-a4 $a |- A. f e. ( RR ^m RR )
    (
      (
        A. x e. RR
          ( f ` x )
          =
          if (
            x <_ ( exp ` 1 ) ,
            x ,
            x x. ( f ` ( log ` x ) )
          )
      )
      ->
      -.
      E. r e. RR
        A. e e. RR
          (
            0 < e
            ->
            E. m e. NN0
              A. n e. NN0
                (
                  m <_ n
                  ->
                  (
                    abs
                    `
                    (
                      (
                        sum_ k e. ( 0 ..^ n )
                          ( 1 / ( f ` ( k + 1 ) ) )
                      )
                      -
                      r
                    )
                  )
                  <
                  e
                )
          )
    )
  $.
$}

title: putnam_2008_a4
content:
% Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2008_a4:
% the recursively defined real function f(x) = x for x <= e and
% f(x) = x*f(ln x) for x > e has a divergent reciprocal series.
% This file contains no proof.

putnam_2008_a4: THEORY
BEGIN
  real_function: TYPE = [real -> real]
  real_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> real]

  safe_div(numerator, denominator: real): real =
    IF denominator = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      numerator / denominator
    ENDIF

  nat_factorial(index: nat): RECURSIVE nat =
    IF index = 0 THEN
      1
    ELSE
      index * nat_factorial(index - 1)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE index

  exponential_partial(x: real, count: nat): RECURSIVE real =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      LET index: nat = count - 1 IN
        exponential_partial(x, count - 1)
          + safe_div(
              x ^ index,
              nat_factorial(index) :: real)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  converges_to(sequence: real_sequence, value: real): bool =
    FORALL (epsilon_value: posreal):
      EXISTS (cutoff: nat):
        FORALL (index: nat):
          cutoff <= index IMPLIES
            abs(sequence(index) - value) < epsilon_value

  real_exponential(x: real): real =
    epsilon(
      LAMBDA (value: real):
        converges_to(
          LAMBDA (count: nat):
            exponential_partial(x, count),
          value))

  natural_log(x: real): real =
    IF x > 0 THEN
      epsilon(
        LAMBDA (value: real):
          real_exponential(value) = x)
    ELSE
      0
    ENDIF

  recurrence_holds(f: real_function): bool =
    FORALL (x: real):
      f(x) =
        IF x <= real_exponential(1) THEN
          x
        ELSE
          x * f(natural_log(x))
        ENDIF

  partial_sum(f: real_function, count: nat): RECURSIVE real =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      partial_sum(f, count - 1)
        + safe_div(1, f(count :: real))
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  series_converges(f: real_function): bool =
    EXISTS (total: real):
      converges_to(
        LAMBDA (count: nat):
          partial_sum(f, count),
        total)

  putnam_2008_a4_solution: bool = FALSE

  putnam_2008_a4: bool =
    FORALL (f: real_function):
      recurrence_holds(f) IMPLIES
        (series_converges(f) IFF putnam_2008_a4_solution)
END putnam_2008_a4

import Mathlib

open Filter Topology Set

/--
Let $n \geq 3$ be an integer. Let $f(x)$ and $g(x)$ be polynomials with real coefficients such that the points $(f(1), g(1)), (f(2), g(2)), \dots, (f(n), g(n))$ in $\mathbb{R}^2$ are the vertices of a regular $n$-gon in counterclockwise order. Prove that at least one of $f(x)$ and $g(x)$ has degree greater than or equal to $n-1$.
-/
theorem putnam_2008_a5
(n : ℕ)
(nge3 : n ≥ 3)
(f g : Polynomial ℝ)
(hfg : ∃ O z : ℂ, z ≠ 0 ∧ ∀ k : ℕ, k ∈ Icc 1 n → (f.eval (k : ℝ)) + Complex.I * (g.eval (k : ℝ)) = O + z * Complex.exp (Complex.I * 2 * Real.pi * k / n))
: (f.natDegree ≥ n - 1 ∨ g.natDegree ≥ n - 1) :=
sorry

title: putnam_2008_a5
content:
(* Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2008_a5:
   a degree lower bound for real polynomials whose values at consecutive
   positive integers trace a regular polygon counterclockwise. This file
   contains no proof. *)

From Stdlib Require Import Reals List.

Open Scope R_scope.

Record putnam_2008_a5_polynomial : Type := {
  putnam_2008_a5_coefficients : list R;
  putnam_2008_a5_coefficients_normalized :
    putnam_2008_a5_coefficients = nil \/
    last putnam_2008_a5_coefficients 0 <> 0
}.

Fixpoint putnam_2008_a5_eval_coefficients
    (coefficients : list R) (x : R) : R :=
  match coefficients with
  | nil => 0
  | coefficient :: remaining =>
      coefficient +
      x * putnam_2008_a5_eval_coefficients remaining x
  end.

Definition putnam_2008_a5_eval
    (p : putnam_2008_a5_polynomial) (x : R) : R :=
  putnam_2008_a5_eval_coefficients
    (putnam_2008_a5_coefficients p) x.

Definition putnam_2008_a5_degree
    (p : putnam_2008_a5_polynomial) : nat :=
  Nat.pred (length (putnam_2008_a5_coefficients p)).

Definition putnam_2008_a5_angle (n k : nat) : R :=
  2 * PI * INR k / INR n.

Theorem putnam_2008_a5
    (n : nat)
    (hn : (3 <= n)%nat)
    (f g : putnam_2008_a5_polynomial)
    (hfg :
      exists center_re center_im z_re z_im : R,
        ~ (z_re = 0 /\ z_im = 0) /\
        forall k : nat,
          (1 <= k <= n)%nat ->
          putnam_2008_a5_eval f (INR k) =
            center_re +
              (z_re * cos (putnam_2008_a5_angle n k) -
               z_im * sin (putnam_2008_a5_angle n k)) /\
          putnam_2008_a5_eval g (INR k) =
            center_im +
              (z_re * sin (putnam_2008_a5_angle n k) +
               z_im * cos (putnam_2008_a5_angle n k))) :
  ((n - 1 <= putnam_2008_a5_degree f)%nat \/
   (n - 1 <= putnam_2008_a5_degree g)%nat).
Admitted.

theorem putnam_2008_a5:
  fixes n :: "nat"
    and f g :: "real poly"
  assumes nge3 : "n \<ge> 3"
    and hfg : "\<exists> center z :: complex. z \<noteq> 0 \<and> (\<forall> k \<in> {1::nat..n}. poly f (real k) + \<i> * poly g (real k) = center + z * exp (\<i> * 2 * pi * k / n))"
  shows "degree f \<ge> n - 1 \<or> degree g \<ge> n - 1"
  sorry

end

;; Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2008_a5:
;; real polynomial values at 1 through n forming a counterclockwise regular
;; n-gon force at least one polynomial to have degree at least n-1. This file
;; contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))

;; The coefficient domain is presented as an arbitrary real closed ordered
;; field. Completeness of real closed fields transfers this first-order
;; assertion bidirectionally between that presentation and the real numbers.
;; Complex values are pairs over the field. For n >= 3, exp(2*pi*i/n) is
;; exactly the positive-imaginary n-th root of unity having greatest real
;; part. The maximality condition below therefore fixes the source's
;; counterclockwise root rather than an arbitrary primitive root.
;;
;; Polynomials are canonical nonempty coefficient lists in ascending degree
;; order. FN-EQUAL supplies unbounded universal quantification for the field
;; laws and the root maximality condition. Negated FN-EQUAL keeps the source
;; center and nonzero complex scale existentially quantified inside the
;; statement predicate.

(defun putnam-2008-a5-quoted (object)
  (list 'quote object))

(defun putnam-2008-a5-apply1-term (function argument)
  (list
   'apply$
   (putnam-2008-a5-quoted function)
   (list 'cons argument nil)))

(defun putnam-2008-a5-apply2-term (function left right)
  (list
   'apply$
   (putnam-2008-a5-quoted function)
   (list 'cons left (list 'cons right nil))))

(defun putnam-2008-a5-and-term (terms)
  (if (endp terms)
      (putnam-2008-a5-quoted t)
    (list
     'if
     (car terms)
     (putnam-2008-a5-and-term (cdr terms))
     (putnam-2008-a5-quoted nil))))

(defun putnam-2008-a5-or-term (terms)
  (if (endp terms)
      (putnam-2008-a5-quoted nil)
    (list
     'if
     (car terms)
     (putnam-2008-a5-quoted t)
     (putnam-2008-a5-or-term (cdr terms)))))

(defun putnam-2008-a5-not-term (term)
  (list
   'if
   term
   (putnam-2008-a5-quoted nil)
   (putnam-2008-a5-quoted t)))

(defun putnam-2008-a5-implies-term (antecedent consequent)
  (list
   'if
   antecedent
   consequent
   (putnam-2008-a5-quoted t)))

(defun putnam-2008-a5-true-function (formals)
  (list
   'lambda
   formals
   (putnam-2008-a5-quoted t)))

(defun putnam-2008-a5-carrier-term (carrier element)
  (putnam-2008-a5-apply1-term carrier element))

(defun putnam-2008-a5-operation-term (operation left right)
  (putnam-2008-a5-apply2-term operation left right))

(defun putnam-2008-a5-all-coefficients-function (carrier)
  (list
   'lambda
   '(loop$-gvars loop$-ivars)
   (putnam-2008-a5-carrier-term
    carrier 'loop$-ivars)))

(defun putnam-2008-a5-all-coefficients-term
    (carrier coefficients)
  (list
   'always$+
   (putnam-2008-a5-quoted
    (putnam-2008-a5-all-coefficients-function
     carrier))
   (putnam-2008-a5-quoted nil)
   coefficients))

(defun putnam-2008-a5-polynomial-term
    (carrier zero coefficients)
  (putnam-2008-a5-and-term
   (list
    (list 'true-listp coefficients)
    (list 'consp coefficients)
    (putnam-2008-a5-all-coefficients-term
     carrier coefficients)
    (putnam-2008-a5-or-term
     (list
      (list 'equal
            (list 'len coefficients)
            (putnam-2008-a5-quoted 1))
      (putnam-2008-a5-not-term
       (list 'equal
             (list 'car (list 'last coefficients))
             (putnam-2008-a5-quoted zero))))))))

(defun putnam-2008-a5-field-laws-function
    (carrier zero one add mul neg inv)
  (let* ((x 'x)
         (y 'y)
         (z 'z)
         (qzero (putnam-2008-a5-quoted zero))
         (qone (putnam-2008-a5-quoted one))
         (add-xy
          (putnam-2008-a5-operation-term add x y))
         (add-yz
          (putnam-2008-a5-operation-term add y z))
         (mul-xy
          (putnam-2008-a5-operation-term mul x y))
         (mul-yz
          (putnam-2008-a5-operation-term mul y z))
         (neg-x
          (putnam-2008-a5-apply1-term neg x))
         (inv-x
          (putnam-2008-a5-apply1-term inv x))
         (domain
          (putnam-2008-a5-and-term
           (list
            (putnam-2008-a5-carrier-term carrier x)
            (putnam-2008-a5-carrier-term carrier y)
            (putnam-2008-a5-carrier-term carrier z))))
         (laws
          (putnam-2008-a5-and-term
           (list
            (putnam-2008-a5-carrier-term carrier add-xy)
            (putnam-2008-a5-carrier-term carrier mul-xy)
            (putnam-2008-a5-carrier-term carrier neg-x)
            (putnam-2008-a5-carrier-term carrier inv-x)
            (list
             'equal
             (putnam-2008-a5-operation-term add add-xy z)
             (putnam-2008-a5-operation-term add x add-yz))
            (list
             'equal
             (putnam-2008-a5-operation-term mul mul-xy z)
             (putnam-2008-a5-operation-term mul x mul-yz))
            (list
             'equal
             add-xy
             (putnam-2008-a5-operation-term add y x))
            (list
             'equal
             mul-xy
             (putnam-2008-a5-operation-term mul y x))
            (list
             'equal
             (putnam-2008-a5-operation-term add x qzero)
             x)
            (list
             'equal
             (putnam-2008-a5-operation-term add x neg-x)
             qzero)
            (list
             'equal
             (putnam-2008-a5-operation-term mul x qone)
             x)
            (putnam-2008-a5-implies-term
             (list 'equal x qzero)
             (list 'equal inv-x qzero))
            (putnam-2008-a5-implies-term
             (putnam-2008-a5-not-term
              (list 'equal x qzero))
             (list
              'equal
              (putnam-2008-a5-operation-term mul x inv-x)
              qone))
            (list
             'equal
             (putnam-2008-a5-operation-term mul x add-yz)
             (putnam-2008-a5-operation-term
              add
              (putnam-2008-a5-operation-term mul x y)
              (putnam-2008-a5-operation-term mul x z)))))))
    (list
     'lambda
     '(x y z)
     (putnam-2008-a5-implies-term domain laws))))

(defun putnam-2008-a5-order-laws-function
    (carrier zero add mul lt)
  (let* ((x 'x)
         (y 'y)
         (z 'z)
         (qzero (putnam-2008-a5-quoted zero))
         (lt-xy
          (putnam-2008-a5-operation-term lt x y))
         (lt-yx
          (putnam-2008-a5-operation-term lt y x))
         (lt-yz
          (putnam-2008-a5-operation-term lt y z))
         (lt-xz
          (putnam-2008-a5-operation-term lt x z))
         (domain
          (putnam-2008-a5-and-term
           (list
            (putnam-2008-a5-carrier-term carrier x)
            (putnam-2008-a5-carrier-term carrier y)
            (putnam-2008-a5-carrier-term carrier z))))
         (laws
          (putnam-2008-a5-and-term
           (list
            (putnam-2008-a5-not-term
             (putnam-2008-a5-operation-term lt x x))
            (putnam-2008-a5-or-term
             (list
              lt-xy
              (list 'equal x y)
              lt-yx))
            (putnam-2008-a5-implies-term
             (putnam-2008-a5-and-term
              (list lt-xy lt-yz))
             lt-xz)
            (putnam-2008-a5-implies-term
             lt-xy
             (putnam-2008-a5-operation-term
              lt
              (putnam-2008-a5-operation-term add x z)
              (putnam-2008-a5-operation-term add y z)))
            (putnam-2008-a5-implies-term
             (putnam-2008-a5-and-term
              (list
               (putnam-2008-a5-operation-term lt qzero x)
               (putnam-2008-a5-operation-term lt qzero y)))
             (putnam-2008-a5-operation-term
              lt
              qzero
              (putnam-2008-a5-operation-term mul x y)))))))
    (list
     'lambda
     '(x y z)
     (putnam-2008-a5-implies-term domain laws))))

(defun putnam-2008-a5-square-root-laws-function
    (carrier zero mul lt square-root)
  (let* ((x 'x)
         (qzero (putnam-2008-a5-quoted zero))
         (root
          (putnam-2008-a5-apply1-term square-root x))
         (domain
          (putnam-2008-a5-and-term
           (list
            (putnam-2008-a5-carrier-term carrier x)
            (putnam-2008-a5-not-term
             (putnam-2008-a5-operation-term lt x qzero)))))
         (laws
          (putnam-2008-a5-and-term
           (list
            (putnam-2008-a5-carrier-term carrier root)
            (list
             'equal
             (putnam-2008-a5-operation-term mul root root)
             x)))))
    (list
     'lambda
     '(x)
     (putnam-2008-a5-implies-term domain laws))))

(defun putnam-2008-a5-evaluation-laws-function
    (carrier zero add mul evaluate)
  (let* ((coefficient 'coefficient)
         (rest 'rest)
         (x 'x)
         (qzero (putnam-2008-a5-quoted zero))
         (domain
          (putnam-2008-a5-and-term
           (list
            (putnam-2008-a5-carrier-term
             carrier coefficient)
            (list 'true-listp rest)
            (putnam-2008-a5-all-coefficients-term
             carrier rest)
            (putnam-2008-a5-carrier-term carrier x))))
         (empty-law
          (putnam-2008-a5-implies-term
           (putnam-2008-a5-carrier-term carrier x)
           (list
            'equal
            (putnam-2008-a5-operation-term
             evaluate
             (putnam-2008-a5-quoted nil)
             x)
            qzero)))
         (recursive-value
          (putnam-2008-a5-operation-term
           add
           coefficient
           (putnam-2008-a5-operation-term
            mul
            x
            (putnam-2008-a5-operation-term
             evaluate rest x))))
         (recursive-law
          (putnam-2008-a5-implies-term
           domain
           (putnam-2008-a5-and-term
            (list
             (putnam-2008-a5-carrier-term
              carrier
              (putnam-2008-a5-operation-term
               evaluate
               (list 'cons coefficient rest)
               x))
             (list
              'equal
              (putnam-2008-a5-operation-term
               evaluate
               (list 'cons coefficient rest)
               x)
              recursive-value))))))
    (list
     'lambda
     '(coefficient rest x)
     (putnam-2008-a5-and-term
      (list empty-law recursive-law)))))

(defun putnam-2008-a5-odd-root-laws-function
    (carrier zero evaluate odd-root)
  (let* ((coefficients 'coefficients)
         (root
          (putnam-2008-a5-apply1-term
           odd-root coefficients))
         (domain
          (putnam-2008-a5-and-term
           (list
            (putnam-2008-a5-polynomial-term
             carrier zero coefficients)
            (list 'evenp (list 'len coefficients)))))
         (laws
          (putnam-2008-a5-and-term
           (list
            (putnam-2008-a5-carrier-term carrier root)
            (list
             'equal
             (putnam-2008-a5-operation-term
              evaluate coefficients root)
             (putnam-2008-a5-quoted zero))))))
    (list
     'lambda
     '(coefficients)
     (putnam-2008-a5-implies-term domain laws))))

(defun putnam-2008-a5-real-closed-field-p
    (carrier zero one add mul neg inv lt
             square-root odd-root evaluate)
  (let* ((field-laws
          (putnam-2008-a5-field-laws-function
           carrier zero one add mul neg inv))
         (field-laws-true
          (putnam-2008-a5-true-function '(x y z)))
         (order-laws
          (putnam-2008-a5-order-laws-function
           carrier zero add mul lt))
         (order-laws-true
          (putnam-2008-a5-true-function '(x y z)))
         (square-root-laws
          (putnam-2008-a5-square-root-laws-function
           carrier zero mul lt square-root))
         (square-root-laws-true
          (putnam-2008-a5-true-function '(x)))
         (evaluation-laws
          (putnam-2008-a5-evaluation-laws-function
           carrier zero add mul evaluate))
         (evaluation-laws-true
          (putnam-2008-a5-true-function
           '(coefficient rest x)))
         (odd-root-laws
          (putnam-2008-a5-odd-root-laws-function
           carrier zero evaluate odd-root))
         (odd-root-laws-true
          (putnam-2008-a5-true-function
           '(coefficients))))
    (and
     (tamep-functionp carrier)
     (tamep-functionp add)
     (tamep-functionp mul)
     (tamep-functionp neg)
     (tamep-functionp inv)
     (tamep-functionp lt)
     (tamep-functionp square-root)
     (tamep-functionp odd-root)
     (tamep-functionp evaluate)
     (tamep-functionp field-laws)
     (tamep-functionp field-laws-true)
     (tamep-functionp order-laws)
     (tamep-functionp order-laws-true)
     (tamep-functionp square-root-laws)
     (tamep-functionp square-root-laws-true)
     (tamep-functionp evaluation-laws)
     (tamep-functionp evaluation-laws-true)
     (tamep-functionp odd-root-laws)
     (tamep-functionp odd-root-laws-true)
     (apply$ carrier (list zero))
     (apply$ carrier (list one))
     (not (equal zero one))
     (fn-equal field-laws field-laws-true)
     (fn-equal order-laws order-laws-true)
     (fn-equal square-root-laws square-root-laws-true)
     (fn-equal evaluation-laws evaluation-laws-true)
     (fn-equal odd-root-laws odd-root-laws-true))))

(defun putnam-2008-a5-add (add left right)
  (apply$ add (list left right)))

(defun putnam-2008-a5-mul (mul left right)
  (apply$ mul (list left right)))

(defun putnam-2008-a5-neg (neg value)
  (apply$ neg (list value)))

(defun putnam-2008-a5-less-p (lt left right)
  (apply$ lt (list left right)))

(defun putnam-2008-a5-evaluate (evaluate polynomial x)
  (apply$ evaluate (list polynomial x)))

(defun putnam-2008-a5-coefficient-list-p
    (coefficients carrier)
  (if (endp coefficients)
      (equal coefficients nil)
    (and
     (apply$ carrier (list (car coefficients)))
     (putnam-2008-a5-coefficient-list-p
      (cdr coefficients) carrier))))

(defun putnam-2008-a5-polynomial-p
    (polynomial carrier zero)
  (and
   (true-listp polynomial)
   (consp polynomial)
   (putnam-2008-a5-coefficient-list-p
    polynomial carrier)
   (or
    (equal (len polynomial) 1)
    (not (equal (car (last polynomial)) zero)))))

(defun putnam-2008-a5-polynomial-degree (polynomial)
  (- (len polynomial) 1))

(defun putnam-2008-a5-nat-value (zero one add n)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix n)))
  (if (zp n)
      zero
    (if (equal n 1)
        one
      (putnam-2008-a5-add
       add one
       (putnam-2008-a5-nat-value
        zero one add (- n 1))))))

;; A complex value is represented by (real-part . imaginary-part).

(defun putnam-2008-a5-complex-add (add left right)
  (cons
   (putnam-2008-a5-add add (car left) (car right))
   (putnam-2008-a5-add add (cdr left) (cdr right))))

(defun putnam-2008-a5-complex-mul
    (add mul neg left right)
  (let* ((ac
          (putnam-2008-a5-mul
           mul (car left) (car right)))
         (bd
          (putnam-2008-a5-mul
           mul (cdr left) (cdr right)))
         (ad
          (putnam-2008-a5-mul
           mul (car left) (cdr right)))
         (bc
          (putnam-2008-a5-mul
           mul (cdr left) (car right))))
    (cons
     (putnam-2008-a5-add
      add ac (putnam-2008-a5-neg neg bd))
     (putnam-2008-a5-add add ad bc))))

(defun putnam-2008-a5-complex-power
    (zero one add mul neg base exponent)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix exponent)))
  (if (zp exponent)
      (cons one zero)
    (putnam-2008-a5-complex-mul
     add
     mul
     neg
     base
     (putnam-2008-a5-complex-power
      zero one add mul neg base (- exponent 1)))))

(defun putnam-2008-a5-root-candidate-p
    (carrier zero one add mul neg lt n real imaginary)
  (and
   (apply$ carrier (list real))
   (apply$ carrier (list imaginary))
   (putnam-2008-a5-less-p lt zero imaginary)
   (equal
    (putnam-2008-a5-complex-power
     zero one add mul neg (cons real imaginary) n)
    (cons one zero))))

(defun putnam-2008-a5-complex-add-function (add)
  (list
   'lambda
   '(left right)
   (list
    'cons
    (putnam-2008-a5-operation-term
     add (list 'car 'left) (list 'car 'right))
    (putnam-2008-a5-operation-term
     add (list 'cdr 'left) (list 'cdr 'right)))))

(defun putnam-2008-a5-complex-mul-function (add mul neg)
  (let* ((left-real (list 'car 'left))
         (left-imaginary (list 'cdr 'left))
         (right-real (list 'car 'right))
         (right-imaginary (list 'cdr 'right))
         (real-part
          (putnam-2008-a5-operation-term
           add
           (putnam-2008-a5-operation-term
            mul left-real right-real)
           (putnam-2008-a5-apply1-term
            neg
            (putnam-2008-a5-operation-term
             mul left-imaginary right-imaginary))))
         (imaginary-part
          (putnam-2008-a5-operation-term
           add
           (putnam-2008-a5-operation-term
            mul left-real right-imaginary)
           (putnam-2008-a5-operation-term
            mul left-imaginary right-real))))
    (list
     'lambda
     '(left right)
     (list 'cons real-part imaginary-part))))

(defun putnam-2008-a5-complex-power-term
    (zero one add mul neg base exponent)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix exponent)))
  (if (zp exponent)
      (list
       'cons
       (putnam-2008-a5-quoted one)
       (putnam-2008-a5-quoted zero))
    (putnam-2008-a5-apply2-term
     (putnam-2008-a5-complex-mul-function add mul neg)
     base
     (putnam-2008-a5-complex-power-term
      zero one add mul neg base (- exponent 1)))))

(defun putnam-2008-a5-root-candidate-term
    (carrier zero one add mul neg lt n real imaginary)
  (let ((power
         (putnam-2008-a5-complex-power-term
          zero
          one
          add
          mul
          neg
          (list 'cons real imaginary)
          n)))
    (putnam-2008-a5-and-term
     (list
      (putnam-2008-a5-carrier-term carrier real)
      (putnam-2008-a5-carrier-term carrier imaginary)
      (putnam-2008-a5-operation-term
       lt (putnam-2008-a5-quoted zero) imaginary)
      (list
       'equal
       power
       (list
        'cons
        (putnam-2008-a5-quoted one)
        (putnam-2008-a5-quoted zero)))))))

(defun putnam-2008-a5-root-maximality-function
    (carrier zero one add mul neg lt n root-real)
  (list
   'lambda
   '(real imaginary)
   (list
    'if
    (putnam-2008-a5-root-candidate-term
     carrier zero one add mul neg lt n
     'real 'imaginary)
    (list
     'if
     (putnam-2008-a5-operation-term
      lt
      (putnam-2008-a5-quoted root-real)
      'real)
     (putnam-2008-a5-quoted nil)
     (putnam-2008-a5-quoted t))
    (putnam-2008-a5-quoted t))))

(defun putnam-2008-a5-distinguished-root-p
    (carrier zero one add mul neg lt n root-real root-imaginary)
  (let ((maximality
         (putnam-2008-a5-root-maximality-function
          carrier zero one add mul neg lt n root-real))
        (true-on-two
         (putnam-2008-a5-true-function '(real imaginary))))
    (and
     (putnam-2008-a5-root-candidate-p
      carrier zero one add mul neg lt
      n root-real root-imaginary)
     (tamep-functionp maximality)
     (tamep-functionp true-on-two)
     (fn-equal maximality true-on-two))))

(defun putnam-2008-a5-nat-value-term (zero one add n)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix n)))
  (if (zp n)
      (putnam-2008-a5-quoted zero)
    (if (equal n 1)
        (putnam-2008-a5-quoted one)
      (putnam-2008-a5-operation-term
       add
       (putnam-2008-a5-quoted one)
       (putnam-2008-a5-nat-value-term
        zero one add (- n 1))))))

(defun putnam-2008-a5-point-term
    (evaluate f g x)
  (list
   'cons
   (putnam-2008-a5-operation-term
    evaluate (putnam-2008-a5-quoted f) x)
   (putnam-2008-a5-operation-term
    evaluate (putnam-2008-a5-quoted g) x)))

(defun putnam-2008-a5-regular-equation-term
    (zero one add mul neg evaluate
          f g root center scale k)
  (let* ((x
          (putnam-2008-a5-nat-value-term
           zero one add k))
         (point
          (putnam-2008-a5-point-term
           evaluate f g x))
         (root-power
          (putnam-2008-a5-complex-power-term
           zero one add mul neg root k))
         (scaled-power
          (putnam-2008-a5-apply2-term
           (putnam-2008-a5-complex-mul-function
            add mul neg)
           scale
           root-power))
         (translated-power
          (putnam-2008-a5-apply2-term
           (putnam-2008-a5-complex-add-function add)
           center
           scaled-power)))
    (list 'equal point translated-power)))

(defun putnam-2008-a5-regular-equations-term
    (zero one add mul neg evaluate
          f g root center scale k remaining)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix remaining)))
  (if (zp remaining)
      (putnam-2008-a5-quoted t)
    (putnam-2008-a5-and-term
     (list
      (putnam-2008-a5-regular-equation-term
       zero one add mul neg evaluate
       f g root center scale k)
      (putnam-2008-a5-regular-equations-term
       zero one add mul neg evaluate
       f g root center scale
       (+ k 1) (- remaining 1))))))

(defun putnam-2008-a5-point
    (zero one add evaluate f g k)
  (let ((x (putnam-2008-a5-nat-value
            zero one add k)))
    (cons
     (putnam-2008-a5-evaluate evaluate f x)
     (putnam-2008-a5-evaluate evaluate g x))))

(defun putnam-2008-a5-regular-equations-p
    (zero one add mul neg evaluate
          f g root center scale k remaining)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix remaining)))
  (if (zp remaining)
      t
    (and
     (equal
      (putnam-2008-a5-point
       zero one add evaluate f g k)
      (putnam-2008-a5-complex-add
       add
       center
       (putnam-2008-a5-complex-mul
        add
        mul
        neg
        scale
        (putnam-2008-a5-complex-power
         zero one add mul neg root k))))
     (putnam-2008-a5-regular-equations-p
      zero one add mul neg evaluate

title: putnam_2008_a5
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2008_a5
-- (putnambench__agda__putnam_2008_a5): real polynomial values forming the
-- counterclockwise vertices of a regular n-gon force one polynomial to have
-- degree at least n - 1. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module Putnam2008A5 where

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.List using (List; []; _∷_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; _*_)

infix 4 _!=_ _<=N_
infixr 3 _and_
infixr 2 _or_

data Bottom : Set where

Not : Set -> Set
Not A =
  A -> Bottom

_!=_ : {A : Set} -> A -> A -> Set
x != y =
  Not (x == y)

record _and_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data _or_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  left  : A -> A or B
  right : B -> A or B

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

data _<=N_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set where
  zero<=N   : {n : Nat} -> zero <=N n
  suc<=sucN : {m n : Nat} -> m <=N n -> suc m <=N suc n

oneN : Nat
oneN =
  suc zero

twoN : Nat
twoN =
  suc oneN

fourN : Nat
fourN =
  twoN + twoN

predecessor : Nat -> Nat
predecessor zero =
  zero
predecessor (suc n) =
  n

record CompleteOrderedRealField (R : Set) : Set1 where
  field
    zeroR oneR : R
    add multiply : R -> R -> R
    negate inverse : R -> R
    lessOrEqual : R -> R -> Set
    fromNat : Nat -> R

    one-not-zero :
      oneR != zeroR

    add-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> add x y == add y x
    add-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      add (add x y) z == add x (add y z)
    add-zero :
      (x : R) ->
      add x zeroR == x
    add-inverse :
      (x : R) ->
      add x (negate x) == zeroR

    multiply-commutative :
      (x y : R) ->
      multiply x y == multiply y x
    multiply-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply (multiply x y) z ==
      multiply x (multiply y z)
    multiply-one :
      (x : R) ->
      multiply x oneR == x
    multiply-zero :
      (x : R) ->
      multiply x zeroR == zeroR
    distribute :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply x (add y z) ==
      add (multiply x y) (multiply x z)
    inverse-zero :
      inverse zeroR == zeroR
    multiply-inverse :
      (x : R) ->
      x != zeroR ->
      multiply x (inverse x) == oneR

    order-reflexive :
      (x : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x x
    order-transitive :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y z ->
      lessOrEqual x z
    order-antisymmetric :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y x ->
      x == y
    order-total :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y or lessOrEqual y x
    add-order :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual (add z x) (add z y)
    multiply-nonnegative :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR x ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR y ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR (multiply x y)
    zero-less-than-one :
      lessOrEqual zeroR oneR and zeroR != oneR

    fromNat-zero :
      fromNat zero == zeroR
    fromNat-successor :
      (n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (suc n) == add (fromNat n) oneR
    fromNat-addition :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m + n) == add (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-multiplication :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m * n) == multiply (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-injective :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat m == fromNat n ->
      m == n

    archimedean :
      (x : R) ->
      Exists Nat
        (\ n ->
          lessOrEqual x (fromNat n))
    least-upper-bound :
      (P : R -> Set) ->
      Exists R P ->
      Exists R
        (\ upper ->
          (x : R) ->
          P x ->
          lessOrEqual x upper) ->
      Exists R
        (\ supremum ->
          ((x : R) ->
            P x ->
            lessOrEqual x supremum)
          and
          ((upper : R) ->
            ((x : R) ->
              P x ->
              lessOrEqual x upper) ->
            lessOrEqual supremum upper))

open CompleteOrderedRealField

subtract :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
subtract reals x y =
  add reals x (negate reals y)

divide :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
divide reals x y =
  multiply reals x (inverse reals y)

StrictLess :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
StrictLess reals x y =
  lessOrEqual reals x y and x != y

CloseTo :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
CloseTo reals center radius x =
  StrictLess reals
    (subtract reals center radius)
    x
  and
  StrictLess reals
    x
    (add reals center radius)

naturalPower :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  Nat ->
  R
naturalPower reals x zero =
  oneR reals
naturalPower reals x (suc n) =
  multiply reals
    (naturalPower reals x n)
    x

factorial : Nat -> Nat
factorial zero =
  oneN
factorial (suc n) =
  suc n * factorial n

sumFirst :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Nat ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  R
sumFirst reals zero terms =
  zeroR reals
sumFirst reals (suc n) terms =
  add reals
    (sumFirst reals n terms)
    (terms n)

ConvergesTo :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  R ->
  Set
ConvergesTo {R} reals sequence limit =
  (epsilon : R) ->
  StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) epsilon ->
  Exists Nat
    (\ cutoff ->
      (n : Nat) ->
      cutoff <=N n ->
      CloseTo reals limit epsilon (sequence n))

SeriesHasSum :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  R ->
  Set
SeriesHasSum reals terms limit =
  ConvergesTo reals
    (\ n -> sumFirst reals n terms)
    limit

alternatingPower :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Nat ->
  R
alternatingPower reals n =
  naturalPower reals
    (negate reals (oneR reals))
    n

sineTerm :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  Nat ->
  R
sineTerm reals x n =
  divide reals
    (multiply reals
      (alternatingPower reals n)
      (naturalPower reals x (suc (twoN * n))))
    (fromNat reals (factorial (suc (twoN * n))))

cosineTerm :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  Nat ->
  R
cosineTerm reals x n =
  divide reals
    (multiply reals
      (alternatingPower reals n)
      (naturalPower reals x (twoN * n)))
    (fromNat reals (factorial (twoN * n)))

leibnizTerm :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Nat ->
  R
leibnizTerm reals n =
  divide reals
    (alternatingPower reals n)
    (fromNat reals (suc (twoN * n)))

SineValue :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
SineValue reals x value =
  SeriesHasSum reals
    (sineTerm reals x)
    value

CosineValue :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
CosineValue reals x value =
  SeriesHasSum reals
    (cosineTerm reals x)
    value

record PiValue
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R)
  (value : R) : Set where
  field
    positive :
      StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) value
    leibniz-series :
      SeriesHasSum reals
        (leibnizTerm reals)
        (divide reals value (fromNat reals fourN))

record StandardTrigonometry
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) : Set1 where
  field
    sine cosine : R -> R
    pi : R
    sine-value :
      (x : R) ->
      SineValue reals x (sine x)
    cosine-value :
      (x : R) ->
      CosineValue reals x (cosine x)
    pi-value :
      PiValue reals pi

open StandardTrigonometry

record Complex (R : Set) : Set where
  constructor complex
  field
    realPart      : R
    imaginaryPart : R

complexZero :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Complex R
complexZero reals =
  complex
    (zeroR reals)
    (zeroR reals)

complexAdd :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Complex R ->
  Complex R ->
  Complex R
complexAdd reals (complex a b) (complex c d) =
  complex
    (add reals a c)
    (add reals b d)

complexMultiply :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Complex R ->
  Complex R ->
  Complex R
complexMultiply reals (complex a b) (complex c d) =
  complex
    (subtract reals
      (multiply reals a c)
      (multiply reals b d))
    (add reals
      (multiply reals a d)
      (multiply reals b c))

cis :
  {R : Set} ->
  {reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R} ->
  StandardTrigonometry reals ->
  R ->
  Complex R
cis trigonometry angle =
  complex
    (cosine trigonometry angle)
    (sine trigonometry angle)

Polynomial : Set -> Set
Polynomial R =
  List R

coefficient :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Polynomial R ->
  Nat ->
  R
coefficient reals [] n =
  zeroR reals
coefficient reals (c ∷ coefficients) zero =
  c
coefficient reals (c ∷ coefficients) (suc n) =
  coefficient reals coefficients n

evaluatePolynomial :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Polynomial R ->
  R ->
  R
evaluatePolynomial reals [] x =
  zeroR reals
evaluatePolynomial reals (c ∷ coefficients) x =
  add reals
    c
    (multiply reals
      x
      (evaluatePolynomial reals coefficients x))

DegreeAtLeast :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Polynomial R ->
  Nat ->
  Set
DegreeAtLeast reals polynomial lower =
  Exists Nat
    (\ index ->
      lower <=N index
      and
      coefficient reals polynomial index != zeroR reals)

module Putnam2008A5Statement
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R)
  (trigonometry : StandardTrigonometry reals) where

  polygonAngle : Nat -> Nat -> R
  polygonAngle n k =
    divide reals
      (multiply reals
        (multiply reals
          (fromNat reals twoN)
          (pi trigonometry))
        (fromNat reals k))
      (fromNat reals n)

  polynomialPoint :
    Polynomial R ->
    Polynomial R ->
    Nat ->
    Complex R
  polynomialPoint f g k =
    complex
      (evaluatePolynomial reals f (fromNat reals k))
      (evaluatePolynomial reals g (fromNat reals k))

  InIndexRange : Nat -> Nat -> Set
  InIndexRange n k =
    oneN <=N k and k <=N n

  FormsRegularCounterclockwisePolygon :
    Nat ->
    Polynomial R ->
    Polynomial R ->
    Set
  FormsRegularCounterclockwisePolygon n f g =
    Exists (Complex R)
      (\ center ->
        Exists (Complex R)
          (\ scale ->
            scale != complexZero reals
            and
            ((k : Nat) ->
              InIndexRange n k ->
              polynomialPoint f g k ==
              complexAdd reals center
                (complexMultiply reals scale
                  (cis trigonometry (polygonAngle n k))))))

  proposition : Set
  proposition =
    (n : Nat) ->
    suc (suc (suc zero)) <=N n ->
    (f g : Polynomial R) ->
    FormsRegularCounterclockwisePolygon n f g ->
    DegreeAtLeast reals f (predecessor n)
    or
    DegreeAtLeast reals g (predecessor n)

putnam-2008-a5 : Set1
putnam-2008-a5 =
  (R : Set) ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) ->
  (trigonometry : StandardTrigonometry reals) ->
  Putnam2008A5Statement.proposition reals trigonometry

title: putnam_2008_a5
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2008_a5:
  real polynomials whose values at 1 through n are the counterclockwise
  vertices of a regular n-gon, forcing one polynomial to have degree at least
  n - 1. This file contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open arithmeticTheory realTheory transcTheory complexTheory polyTheory;

val putnam_2008_a5 =
  ``!n : num. !f g : real list.
      3 <= n /\
      (?center z : complex.
         z <> 0 /\
         !k : num.
           1 <= k /\ k <= n
           ==>
           complex_of_real (poly f (&k)) +
             i * complex_of_real (poly g (&k)) =
           center +
             z *
             complex_exp
               (i * complex_of_real (2 * pi * &k / &n)))
      ==>
      n - 1 <= degree f \/ n - 1 <= degree g``;

title: putnam_2008_a5
content:
$(
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact
  putnam_2008_a5: real polynomials whose values at 1 through n form a
  counterclockwise regular n-gon have at least one degree at least n minus
  one. This file contains no proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  Poly ` RR is set.mm's class of complex-valued polynomial functions with
  real coefficients. Evaluation at a natural number therefore agrees with
  evaluation of the source real polynomial followed by the canonical
  embedding into CC. Set.mm's deg is NN0-valued and assigns degree zero to
  the zero polynomial, matching the source natDegree convention.

  The internally existential O and nonzero z give the center and the complex
  radius-and-rotation factor. For every k from 1 through n, the displayed
  exponential gives the kth vertex in counterclockwise order. The final
  declaration is the single unproved $a corpus statement; this database
  contains no $p proof statement.
$)

${
  $d O f g k n z $.

  putnambench-putnam-2008-a5 $a |-
    A. n e. NN0
      A. f e. ( Poly ` RR )
        A. g e. ( Poly ` RR )
          (
            (
              3 <_ n
              /\
              E. O e. CC E. z e. CC
                (
                  z =/= 0
                  /\
                  A. k e. ( 1 ... n )
                    (
                      ( f ` k )
                      +
                      ( _i x. ( g ` k ) )
                    )
                    =
                    (
                      O
                      +
                      (
                        z
                        x.
                        (
                          exp
                          `
                          (
                            (
                              (
                                ( _i x. 2 )
                                x.
                                _pi
                              )
                              x.
                              k
                            )
                            /
                            n
                          )
                        )
                      )
                    )
                )
            )
            ->
            (
              ( n - 1 ) <_ ( deg ` f )
              \/
              ( n - 1 ) <_ ( deg ` g )
            )
          )
  $.
$}

putnam_2008_a5: THEORY
BEGIN
  polynomial: TYPE = list[real]
  complex: TYPE = [# real_part: real, imag_part: real #]
  complex_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> complex]
  real_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> real]

  complex_zero: complex =
    (# real_part := 0, imag_part := 0 #)

  complex_one: complex =
    (# real_part := 1, imag_part := 0 #)

  complex_i: complex =
    (# real_part := 0, imag_part := 1 #)

  complex_add(left, right: complex): complex =
    (# real_part := real_part(left) + real_part(right),
       imag_part := imag_part(left) + imag_part(right) #)

  complex_mul(left, right: complex): complex =
    (# real_part :=
         real_part(left) * real_part(right)
           - imag_part(left) * imag_part(right),
       imag_part :=
         real_part(left) * imag_part(right)
           + imag_part(left) * real_part(right) #)

  complex_scale(scalar: real, value: complex): complex =
    (# real_part := scalar * real_part(value),
       imag_part := scalar * imag_part(value) #)

  complex_power(value: complex, exponent: nat): RECURSIVE complex =
    IF exponent = 0 THEN
      complex_one
    ELSE
      complex_mul(complex_power(value, exponent - 1), value)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE exponent

  safe_div(numerator, denominator: real): real =
    IF denominator = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      numerator / denominator
    ENDIF

  nat_factorial(index: nat): RECURSIVE nat =
    IF index = 0 THEN
      1
    ELSE
      index * nat_factorial(index - 1)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE index

  complex_exponential_partial(
      value: complex,
      count: nat): RECURSIVE complex =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      complex_zero
    ELSE
      LET index: nat = count - 1 IN
        complex_add(
          complex_exponential_partial(value, count - 1),
          complex_scale(
            safe_div(1, nat_factorial(index) :: real),
            complex_power(value, index)))
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  complex_converges_to(
      sequence: complex_sequence,
      value: complex): bool =
    FORALL (epsilon_value: posreal):
      EXISTS (cutoff: nat):
        FORALL (index: nat):
          cutoff <= index IMPLIES
            abs(real_part(sequence(index)) - real_part(value))
              < epsilon_value
              AND abs(imag_part(sequence(index)) - imag_part(value))
                < epsilon_value

  complex_exponential(value: complex): complex =
    epsilon(
      LAMBDA (limit: complex):
        complex_converges_to(
          LAMBDA (count: nat):
            complex_exponential_partial(value, count),
          limit))

  cosine_partial(x: real, count: nat): RECURSIVE real =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      LET index: nat = count - 1 IN
        cosine_partial(x, count - 1)
          + safe_div(
              ((-1 :: real) ^ index) * x ^ (2 * index),
              nat_factorial(2 * index) :: real)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  real_converges_to(sequence: real_sequence, value: real): bool =
    FORALL (epsilon_value: posreal):
      EXISTS (cutoff: nat):
        FORALL (index: nat):
          cutoff <= index IMPLIES
            abs(sequence(index) - value) < epsilon_value

  cosine(x: real): real =
    epsilon(
      LAMBDA (value: real):
        real_converges_to(
          LAMBDA (count: nat): cosine_partial(x, count),
          value))

  pi: real =
    epsilon(
      LAMBDA (value: real):
        3 < value
          AND value < 4
          AND cosine(value / 2) = 0)

  polynomial_coefficient(
      p: polynomial,
      degree: nat): RECURSIVE real =
    CASES p OF
      null: 0,
      cons(coefficient, tail):
        IF degree = 0 THEN
          coefficient
        ELSE
          polynomial_coefficient(tail, degree - 1)
        ENDIF
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE p BY <<

  polynomial_value(p: polynomial, x: real): RECURSIVE real =
    CASES p OF
      null: 0,
      cons(coefficient, tail):
        coefficient + x * polynomial_value(tail, x)
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE p BY <<

  polynomial_degree_at_least(
      p: polynomial,
      lower_bound: nat): bool =
    EXISTS (degree: nat):
      lower_bound <= degree
        AND polynomial_coefficient(p, degree) /= 0

  polynomial_point(
      f, g: polynomial,
      k: nat): complex =
    (# real_part := polynomial_value(f, k :: real),
       imag_part := polynomial_value(g, k :: real) #)

  regular_vertex(n, k: nat): complex =
    complex_exponential(
      complex_scale(
        safe_div(
          2 * pi * (k :: real),
          n :: real),
        complex_i))

  putnam_2008_a5: bool =
    FORALL (n: nat), (f, g: polynomial):
      (n >= 3
        AND (EXISTS (center, z: complex):
          z /= complex_zero
            AND (FORALL (k: nat):
              1 <= k AND k <= n IMPLIES
                polynomial_point(f, g, k)
                  = complex_add(
                      center,
                      complex_mul(z, regular_vertex(n, k))))))
      IMPLIES
        (polynomial_degree_at_least(f, n - 1)
          OR polynomial_degree_at_least(g, n - 1))
END putnam_2008_a5

import Mathlib

open Filter Topology Set

/--
Prove that there exists a constant $c>0$ such that in every nontrivial finite group $G$ there exists a sequence of length at most $c \log |G|$ with the property that each element of $G$ equals the product of some subsequence. (The elements of $G$ in the sequence are not required to be distinct. A \emph{subsequence} of a sequence is obtained by selecting some of the terms, not necessarily consecutive, without reordering them; for example, $4, 4, 2$ is a subsequence of $2, 4, 6, 4, 2$, but $2, 2, 4$ is not.)
-/
theorem putnam_2008_a6
: ∃ c : ℝ, c > 0 ∧ ∀ G [Group G] (fing : Fintype G), fing.card > 1 → ∃ s : List G, s.length ≤ c * Real.log (fing.card : ℝ) ∧ ∀ g : G, ∃ t : List G, t.Sublist s ∧ t.prod = g :=

(* Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2008_a6:
   a universal logarithmic-length sequence whose subsequence products cover
   every element of each nontrivial finite group. This file contains no proof. *)

From Stdlib Require Import Reals Lists.List.

Open Scope R_scope.

Record putnam_2008_a6_group (G : Type) : Type := {
  putnam_2008_a6_mul : G -> G -> G;
  putnam_2008_a6_one : G;
  putnam_2008_a6_inv : G -> G;
  putnam_2008_a6_assoc :
    forall x y z : G,
      putnam_2008_a6_mul x (putnam_2008_a6_mul y z) =
      putnam_2008_a6_mul (putnam_2008_a6_mul x y) z;
  putnam_2008_a6_left_identity :
    forall x : G, putnam_2008_a6_mul putnam_2008_a6_one x = x;
  putnam_2008_a6_right_identity :
    forall x : G, putnam_2008_a6_mul x putnam_2008_a6_one = x;
  putnam_2008_a6_left_inverse :
    forall x : G,
      putnam_2008_a6_mul (putnam_2008_a6_inv x) x =
      putnam_2008_a6_one;
  putnam_2008_a6_right_inverse :
    forall x : G,
      putnam_2008_a6_mul x (putnam_2008_a6_inv x) =
      putnam_2008_a6_one
}.

Arguments putnam_2008_a6_mul {G} _ _ _.
Arguments putnam_2008_a6_one {G} _.

Inductive putnam_2008_a6_subsequence {G : Type} :
    list G -> list G -> Prop :=
  | putnam_2008_a6_subsequence_nil :
      putnam_2008_a6_subsequence nil nil
  | putnam_2008_a6_subsequence_skip :
      forall (x : G) (selected source : list G),
        putnam_2008_a6_subsequence selected source ->
        putnam_2008_a6_subsequence selected (x :: source)
  | putnam_2008_a6_subsequence_take :
      forall (x : G) (selected source : list G),
        putnam_2008_a6_subsequence selected source ->
        putnam_2008_a6_subsequence
          (x :: selected) (x :: source).

Definition putnam_2008_a6_product
    {G : Type}
    (grp : putnam_2008_a6_group G)
    (xs : list G) : G :=
  fold_right
    (putnam_2008_a6_mul grp)
    (putnam_2008_a6_one grp)
    xs.

Theorem putnam_2008_a6 :
  exists c : R,
    0 < c /\
    forall
      (G : Type)
      (grp : putnam_2008_a6_group G)
      (enumeration : list G),
      NoDup enumeration ->
      (forall g : G, In g enumeration) ->
      (1 < length enumeration)%nat ->
      exists s : list G,
        INR (length s) <= c * ln (INR (length enumeration)) /\
        forall g : G,
          exists t : list G,
            putnam_2008_a6_subsequence t s /\
            putnam_2008_a6_product grp t = g.
Admitted.
