(*
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2008_a6:
  a universal logarithmic-length sequence in every finite nontrivial group
  whose ordered subsequence products represent every group element. This file
  contains no proof.
*)

let transc_output = open_out "/dev/null";;
let transc_formatter = Format.formatter_of_out_channel transc_output;;
let previous_file_loader = !Hol_loader.file_loader;;
let previous_verbose = !verbose;;
verbose := false;;
Hol_loader.file_loader := (fun path -> Toploop.use_file transc_formatter path);;
let transc_loaded = Toploop.use_file transc_formatter "Library/transc.ml";;
Hol_loader.file_loader := previous_file_loader;;
verbose := previous_verbose;;
Format.pp_print_flush transc_formatter ();;
close_out transc_output;;
if not transc_loaded then failwith "failed to load Library/transc.ml";;

let statement =
  `let is_group =
     \(carrier:A->bool) (gmul:A->A->A) (ginv:A->A) (gid:A).
       gid IN carrier /\
       (!x:A. x IN carrier ==> ginv x IN carrier) /\
       (!x y:A.
          x IN carrier /\ y IN carrier
          ==> gmul x y IN carrier) /\
       (!x y z:A.
          x IN carrier /\ y IN carrier /\ z IN carrier
          ==> gmul x (gmul y z) = gmul (gmul x y) z) /\
       (!x:A.
          x IN carrier
          ==> gmul gid x = x /\ gmul x gid = x) /\
       (!x:A.
          x IN carrier
          ==> gmul (ginv x) x = gid /\ gmul x (ginv x) = gid) in
   let is_subsequence =
     \(t:A list) (s:A list).
       ?pick:num->num.
         (!i:num.
            i < LENGTH t
            ==> pick i < LENGTH s /\ EL i t = EL (pick i) s) /\
         (!i j:num.
            i < j /\ j < LENGTH t
            ==> pick i < pick j) in
   ?c:real.
     &0 < c /\
     !carrier:A->bool.
       !gmul:A->A->A.
         !ginv:A->A.
           !gid:A.
             is_group carrier gmul ginv gid /\
             FINITE carrier /\
             1 < CARD carrier
             ==>
             ?s:A list.
               (!x:A. MEM x s ==> x IN carrier) /\
               &(LENGTH s) <= c * ln (&(CARD carrier)) /\
               !g:A.
                 g IN carrier
                 ==> ?t:A list.
                       is_subsequence t s /\
                       ITLIST gmul t gid = g`;;

title: putnam_2008_a6
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2008_a6:
;; a uniformly logarithmic-length sequence in every nontrivial finite group
;; has ordered subsequence products covering the group. This file contains no
;; proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))

;; A finite group is represented by a duplicate-free carrier list, an identity
;; element, and finite multiplication and inverse tables. This is
;; bidirectionally equivalent to the source's arbitrary finite groups: every
;; such group has a table presentation, and every code satisfying GROUP-P
;; defines a finite group on its listed carrier.
;;
;; For n > 1, INTEGER-LENGTH(n-1) is ceiling(log_2 n). Existence of a uniform
;; positive real c with length <= c*ln(n) is equivalent to existence of a
;; uniform positive natural C with length <= C*ceiling(log_2 n), since these
;; two positive logarithmic quantities bound one another by absolute constant
;; factors on integers n >= 2.
;;
;; Nested DEFUN-SK predicates preserve the source quantifier order:
;; there exists C such that every nontrivial finite group code has an
;; internally existentially quantified sequence witness.

(defun putnam-2008-a6-table-has-key-p (key table)
  (if (assoc-equal key table) t nil))

(defun putnam-2008-a6-table-value (key table)
  (cdr (assoc-equal key table)))

(defun putnam-2008-a6-mul (left right mul-table)
  (putnam-2008-a6-table-value (list left right) mul-table))

(defun putnam-2008-a6-inv (element inv-table)
  (putnam-2008-a6-table-value (list element) inv-table))

(defun putnam-2008-a6-mul-row-closed-p
    (left elements carrier mul-table)
  (if (atom elements)
      t
    (and
     (putnam-2008-a6-table-has-key-p
      (list left (car elements))
      mul-table)
     (member-equal
      (putnam-2008-a6-mul left (car elements) mul-table)
      carrier)
     (putnam-2008-a6-mul-row-closed-p
      left (cdr elements) carrier mul-table))))

(defun putnam-2008-a6-mul-closed-p
    (elements carrier mul-table)
  (if (atom elements)
      t
    (and
     (putnam-2008-a6-mul-row-closed-p
      (car elements) carrier carrier mul-table)
     (putnam-2008-a6-mul-closed-p
      (cdr elements) carrier mul-table))))

(defun putnam-2008-a6-inv-closed-p
    (elements carrier inv-table)
  (if (atom elements)
      t
    (and
     (putnam-2008-a6-table-has-key-p
      (list (car elements))
      inv-table)
     (member-equal
      (putnam-2008-a6-inv (car elements) inv-table)
      carrier)
     (putnam-2008-a6-inv-closed-p
      (cdr elements) carrier inv-table))))

(defun putnam-2008-a6-assoc-third-p
    (left middle elements mul-table)
  (if (atom elements)
      t
    (and
     (equal
      (putnam-2008-a6-mul
       left
       (putnam-2008-a6-mul
        middle (car elements) mul-table)
       mul-table)
      (putnam-2008-a6-mul
       (putnam-2008-a6-mul left middle mul-table)
       (car elements)
       mul-table))
     (putnam-2008-a6-assoc-third-p
      left middle (cdr elements) mul-table))))

(defun putnam-2008-a6-assoc-second-p
    (left elements carrier mul-table)
  (if (atom elements)
      t
    (and
     (putnam-2008-a6-assoc-third-p
      left (car elements) carrier mul-table)
     (putnam-2008-a6-assoc-second-p
      left (cdr elements) carrier mul-table))))

(defun putnam-2008-a6-assoc-p
    (elements carrier mul-table)
  (if (atom elements)
      t
    (and
     (putnam-2008-a6-assoc-second-p
      (car elements) carrier carrier mul-table)
     (putnam-2008-a6-assoc-p
      (cdr elements) carrier mul-table))))

(defun putnam-2008-a6-identity-laws-p
    (elements one mul-table)
  (if (atom elements)
      t
    (and
     (equal
      (putnam-2008-a6-mul
       (car elements) one mul-table)
      (car elements))
     (equal
      (putnam-2008-a6-mul
       one (car elements) mul-table)
      (car elements))
     (putnam-2008-a6-identity-laws-p
      (cdr elements) one mul-table))))

(defun putnam-2008-a6-inverse-laws-p
    (elements one mul-table inv-table)
  (if (atom elements)
      t
    (and
     (equal
      (putnam-2008-a6-mul
       (putnam-2008-a6-inv (car elements) inv-table)
       (car elements)
       mul-table)
      one)
     (equal
      (putnam-2008-a6-mul
       (car elements)
       (putnam-2008-a6-inv (car elements) inv-table)
       mul-table)
      one)
     (putnam-2008-a6-inverse-laws-p
      (cdr elements) one mul-table inv-table))))

(defun putnam-2008-a6-group-p
    (carrier one mul-table inv-table)
  (and
   (true-listp carrier)
   (consp carrier)
   (no-duplicatesp-equal carrier)
   (member-equal one carrier)
   (alistp mul-table)
   (alistp inv-table)
   (putnam-2008-a6-mul-closed-p
    carrier carrier mul-table)
   (putnam-2008-a6-inv-closed-p
    carrier carrier inv-table)
   (putnam-2008-a6-assoc-p
    carrier carrier mul-table)
   (putnam-2008-a6-identity-laws-p
    carrier one mul-table)
   (putnam-2008-a6-inverse-laws-p
    carrier one mul-table inv-table)))

(defun putnam-2008-a6-nontrivial-group-code-p (group-code)
  (and
   (true-listp group-code)
   (equal (len group-code) 4)
   (let ((carrier (nth 0 group-code))
         (one (nth 1 group-code))
         (mul-table (nth 2 group-code))
         (inv-table (nth 3 group-code)))
     (and
      (< 1 (len carrier))
      (putnam-2008-a6-group-p
       carrier one mul-table inv-table)))))

(defun putnam-2008-a6-all-in-carrier-p
    (sequence carrier)
  (if (atom sequence)
      (equal sequence nil)
    (and
     (member-equal (car sequence) carrier)
     (putnam-2008-a6-all-in-carrier-p
      (cdr sequence) carrier))))

(defun putnam-2008-a6-left-multiply-products
    (left products mul-table)
  (if (atom products)
      nil
    (cons
     (putnam-2008-a6-mul
      left (car products) mul-table)
     (putnam-2008-a6-left-multiply-products
      left (cdr products) mul-table))))

;; These are exactly the products of all order-preserving subsequences. The
;; empty subsequence contributes ONE; at a cons, a subsequence either omits
;; the head or prepends it to a subsequence of the tail.
(defun putnam-2008-a6-subsequence-products
    (sequence one mul-table)
  (if (atom sequence)
      (list one)
    (let ((tail-products
           (putnam-2008-a6-subsequence-products
            (cdr sequence) one mul-table)))
      (append
       tail-products
       (putnam-2008-a6-left-multiply-products
        (car sequence) tail-products mul-table)))))

(defun putnam-2008-a6-carrier-covered-p
    (elements products)
  (if (atom elements)
      t
    (and
     (member-equal (car elements) products)
     (putnam-2008-a6-carrier-covered-p
      (cdr elements) products))))

(defun putnam-2008-a6-sequence-witness-p
    (constant group-code sequence)
  (let ((carrier (nth 0 group-code))
        (one (nth 1 group-code))
        (mul-table (nth 2 group-code)))
    (and
     (true-listp sequence)
     (putnam-2008-a6-all-in-carrier-p
      sequence carrier)
     (<=
      (len sequence)
      (*
       constant
       (integer-length (- (len carrier) 1))))
     (putnam-2008-a6-carrier-covered-p
      carrier
      (putnam-2008-a6-subsequence-products
       sequence one mul-table)))))

(defun-sk putnam-2008-a6-sequence-exists-p
    (constant group-code)
  (exists (sequence)
    (putnam-2008-a6-sequence-witness-p
     constant group-code sequence)))

(defun-sk putnam-2008-a6-all-groups-p (constant)
  (forall (group-code)
    (implies
     (putnam-2008-a6-nontrivial-group-code-p group-code)
     (putnam-2008-a6-sequence-exists-p
      constant group-code))))

(defun-sk putnambench-putnam-2008-a6-statement ()
  (exists (constant)
    (and
     (natp constant)
     (< 0 constant)
     (putnam-2008-a6-all-groups-p constant))))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

title: putnam_2008_a6
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2008_a6
-- (putnambench__agda__putnam_2008_a6): a universal positive constant gives
-- logarithmic-length subsequence product representations in every nontrivial
-- finite group. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module Main where

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.List using (List; []; _∷_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; _*_)
open import Agda.Primitive using (Level; lsuc; _⊔_)

infix 4 _!=_ _<=N_
infixr 3 _and_
infixr 2 _or_

data Bottom : Set where

Not :
  {a : Level} ->
  Set a ->
  Set a
Not A =
  A -> Bottom

_!=_ :
  {a : Level} ->
  {A : Set a} ->
  A ->
  A ->
  Set a
x != y =
  Not (x == y)

record _and_
  {a b : Level}
  (A : Set a)
  (B : Set b) :
  Set (a ⊔ b) where

  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data _or_
  {a b : Level}
  (A : Set a)
  (B : Set b) :
  Set (a ⊔ b) where

  left  : A -> A or B
  right : B -> A or B

record Exists
  {a p : Level}
  (A : Set a)
  (property : A -> Set p) :
  Set (a ⊔ p) where

  constructor witness
  field
    value     : A
    satisfies : property value

data _<=N_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set where
  zero<=N   : {n : Nat} -> zero <=N n
  suc<=sucN : {m n : Nat} -> m <=N n -> suc m <=N suc n

data Fin : Nat -> Set where
  fzero : {n : Nat} -> Fin (suc n)
  fsuc  : {n : Nat} -> Fin n -> Fin (suc n)

record Bijection
  {a b : Level}
  (A : Set a)
  (B : Set b) :
  Set (a ⊔ b) where

  field
    to      : A -> B
    from    : B -> A
    from-to : (x : A) -> from (to x) == x
    to-from : (y : B) -> to (from y) == y

record CompleteOrderedRealField (R : Set) : Set1 where
  field
    zeroR oneR : R
    add multiply : R -> R -> R
    negate inverse : R -> R
    lessOrEqual : R -> R -> Set
    fromNat : Nat -> R

    one-not-zero :
      oneR != zeroR

    add-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> add x y == add y x
    add-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      add (add x y) z == add x (add y z)
    add-zero :
      (x : R) -> add x zeroR == x
    add-inverse :
      (x : R) -> add x (negate x) == zeroR

    multiply-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> multiply x y == multiply y x
    multiply-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply (multiply x y) z ==
      multiply x (multiply y z)
    multiply-one :
      (x : R) -> multiply x oneR == x
    multiply-zero :
      (x : R) -> multiply x zeroR == zeroR
    distribute :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply x (add y z) ==
      add (multiply x y) (multiply x z)
    inverse-zero :
      inverse zeroR == zeroR
    multiply-inverse :
      (x : R) ->
      x != zeroR ->
      multiply x (inverse x) == oneR

    order-reflexive :
      (x : R) -> lessOrEqual x x
    order-transitive :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y z ->
      lessOrEqual x z
    order-antisymmetric :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y x ->
      x == y
    order-total :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y or lessOrEqual y x
    add-order :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual (add z x) (add z y)
    multiply-nonnegative :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR x ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR y ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR (multiply x y)
    zero-less-than-one :
      lessOrEqual zeroR oneR and zeroR != oneR

    fromNat-zero :
      fromNat zero == zeroR
    fromNat-successor :
      (n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (suc n) == add (fromNat n) oneR
    fromNat-addition :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m + n) == add (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-multiplication :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m * n) == multiply (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-injective :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat m == fromNat n ->
      m == n

    archimedean :
      (x : R) ->
      Exists Nat
        (\ n ->
          lessOrEqual x (fromNat n))
    least-upper-bound :
      (P : R -> Set) ->
      Exists R P ->
      Exists R
        (\ upper ->
          (x : R) ->
          P x ->
          lessOrEqual x upper) ->
      Exists R
        (\ supremum ->
          ((x : R) ->
            P x ->
            lessOrEqual x supremum)
          and
          ((upper : R) ->
            ((x : R) ->
              P x ->
              lessOrEqual x upper) ->
            lessOrEqual supremum upper))

open CompleteOrderedRealField

subtract :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
subtract reals x y =
  add reals x (negate reals y)

divide :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
divide reals numerator denominator =
  multiply reals numerator (inverse reals denominator)

StrictLess :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
StrictLess reals x y =
  lessOrEqual reals x y and x != y

CloseTo :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
CloseTo reals center radius x =
  StrictLess reals
    (subtract reals center radius)
    x
  and
  StrictLess reals
    x
    (add reals center radius)

naturalPower :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  Nat ->
  R
naturalPower reals x zero =
  oneR reals
naturalPower reals x (suc exponent) =
  multiply reals
    (naturalPower reals x exponent)
    x

factorial : Nat -> Nat
factorial zero =
  suc zero
factorial (suc n) =
  suc n * factorial n

sumFirst :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Nat ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  R
sumFirst reals zero term =
  zeroR reals
sumFirst reals (suc n) term =
  add reals
    (sumFirst reals n term)
    (term n)

ConvergesTo :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  R ->
  Set
ConvergesTo {R} reals sequence limit =
  (epsilon : R) ->
  StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) epsilon ->
  Exists Nat
    (\ cutoff ->
      (n : Nat) ->
      cutoff <=N n ->
      CloseTo reals limit epsilon (sequence n))

SeriesHasSum :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  R ->
  Set
SeriesHasSum reals terms limit =
  ConvergesTo reals
    (\ n -> sumFirst reals n terms)
    limit

exponentialTerm :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  Nat ->
  R
exponentialTerm reals x n =
  divide reals
    (naturalPower reals x n)
    (fromNat reals (factorial n))

ExponentialValue :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
ExponentialValue reals x value =
  SeriesHasSum reals
    (exponentialTerm reals x)
    value

record StandardExpLog
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) :
  Set1 where

  field
    exponential logarithm : R -> R

    exponential-series :
      (x : R) ->
      ExponentialValue reals x (exponential x)

    logarithm-inverse :
      (x : R) ->
      StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) x ->
      exponential (logarithm x) == x

open StandardExpLog

record Group
  {ell : Level}
  (G : Set ell) :
  Set ell where

  field
    identity       : G
    inverseG       : G -> G
    multiplyG      : G -> G -> G
    associative    : (x y z : G) ->
                     multiplyG (multiplyG x y) z ==
                     multiplyG x (multiplyG y z)
    identity-left  : (x : G) -> multiplyG identity x == x
    identity-right : (x : G) -> multiplyG x identity == x
    inverse-left   : (x : G) ->
                     multiplyG (inverseG x) x == identity
    inverse-right  : (x : G) ->
                     multiplyG x (inverseG x) == identity

open Group

length :
  {ell : Level} ->
  {A : Set ell} ->
  List A ->
  Nat
length [] =
  zero
length (_ ∷ xs) =
  suc (length xs)

data Subsequence
  {ell : Level}
  {A : Set ell} :
  List A ->
  List A ->
  Set ell where

  empty-subsequence :
    Subsequence [] []

  omit :
    {xs ys : List A} ->
    (y : A) ->
    Subsequence xs ys ->
    Subsequence xs (y ∷ ys)

  select :
    {xs ys : List A} ->
    (x : A) ->
    Subsequence xs ys ->
    Subsequence (x ∷ xs) (x ∷ ys)

product :
  {ell : Level} ->
  {G : Set ell} ->
  Group G ->
  List G ->
  G
product structure [] =
  identity structure
product structure (x ∷ xs) =
  multiplyG structure x (product structure xs)

twoN : Nat
twoN =
  suc (suc zero)

putnam-2008-a6 :
  (ell : Level) ->
  Set (lsuc ell)
putnam-2008-a6 ell =
  (R : Set) ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) ->
  (analysis : StandardExpLog reals) ->
  Exists R
    (\ c ->
      StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) c
      and
      ((G : Set ell) ->
        (structure : Group G) ->
        (order : Nat) ->
        Bijection G (Fin order) ->
        twoN <=N order ->
        Exists (List G)
          (\ sequence ->
            lessOrEqual reals
              (fromNat reals (length sequence))
              (multiply reals
                c
                (logarithm analysis (fromNat reals order)))
            and
            ((g : G) ->
              Exists (List G)
                (\ chosen ->
                  Subsequence chosen sequence
                  and
                  product structure chosen == g)))))

(*
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2008_a6:
  a universal logarithmic-length sequence in every nontrivial finite group
  whose order-preserving subsequence products cover the group. This file
  contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open arithmeticTheory listTheory pred_setTheory realTheory transcTheory
     groupTheory;

val putnam_2008_a6 =
  ``?c : real.
      0 < c /\
      !(g : 'a group).
        FiniteGroup g /\
        1 < CARD g.carrier
        ==>
        ?s : 'a list.
          (!x : 'a. MEM x s ==> x IN g.carrier) /\
          (&(LENGTH s) : real) <= c * ln (&(CARD g.carrier) : real) /\
          !x : 'a.
            x IN g.carrier
            ==>
            ?indices : num list.
              (!i : num.
                 i < LENGTH indices
                 ==>
                 EL i indices < LENGTH s) /\
              (!i j : num.
                 i < j /\ j < LENGTH indices
                 ==>
                 EL i indices < EL j indices) /\
              FOLDR g.op g.id (MAP (\i : num. EL i s) indices) = x``;

$(
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact
  putnam_2008_a6: a universal logarithmic-length sequence in every finite
  nontrivial group whose ordered subsequence products cover the group. This
  file contains no proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  In SetMM, G e. Grp supplies an arbitrary group, Base ` G is its carrier,
  Fin and # express finiteness and finite cardinality, Word ( Base ` G )
  is the class of finite carrier-valued sequences, and # ` s is the length
  of the word s. The standard real function log is the natural logarithm.

  For k e. NN0, an f in
  ( ( 0 ..^ ( # ` s ) ) ^m ( 0 ..^ k ) ) is a map from the k source
  positions into the positions of s. Requiring f to be strictly increasing
  makes s o. f exactly an ordered subsequence of s, including the empty
  subsequence when k = 0. The expression G gsum ( s o. f ) is its
  left-to-right group product. Thus the witnesses k and f remain internally
  existential for each group element, and the positive real c is chosen once
  before quantifying over all finite nontrivial groups.

  The final declaration is the single unproved $a corpus statement; this
  database contains no $p proof statement.
$)

${
  $d c f G g i j k s $.

  putnambench-putnam-2008-a6 $a |-
    E. c e. RR
      (
        0 < c
        /\
        A. G
          (
            (
              (
                G e. Grp
                /\
                ( Base ` G ) e. Fin
              )
              /\
              1 < ( # ` ( Base ` G ) )
            )
            ->
            E. s e. Word ( Base ` G )
              (
                ( # ` s )
                <_
                (
                  c
                  x.
                  ( log ` ( # ` ( Base ` G ) ) )
                )
                /\
                A. g e. ( Base ` G )
                  E. k e. NN0
                    E. f e.
                      (
                        ( 0 ..^ ( # ` s ) )
                        ^m
                        ( 0 ..^ k )
                      )
                      (
                        A. i e. ( 0 ..^ k )
                          A. j e. ( 0 ..^ k )
                            (
                              i < j
                              ->
                              ( f ` i ) < ( f ` j )
                            )
                        /\
                        ( G gsum ( s o. f ) ) = g
                      )
              )
          )
      )
  $.
$}

content:
% Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2008_a6:
% one universal positive constant bounds a sequence in every finite nontrivial
% group whose ordered subsequence products cover the group. This file contains
% no proof.

putnam_2008_a6: THEORY
BEGIN
  IMPORTING finite_sets[nat]

  natural_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> nat]
  binary_operation: TYPE = [nat, nat -> nat]

  safe_div(numerator, denominator: real): real =
    IF denominator = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      numerator / denominator
    ENDIF

  nat_factorial(index: nat): RECURSIVE nat =
    IF index = 0 THEN
      1
    ELSE
      index * nat_factorial(index - 1)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE index

  exponential_partial(x: real, count: nat): RECURSIVE real =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      LET index: nat = count - 1 IN
        exponential_partial(x, count - 1)
          + safe_div(
              x ^ index,
              nat_factorial(index) :: real)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  converges_to(sequence: [nat -> real], value: real): bool =
    FORALL (epsilon_value: posreal):
      EXISTS (cutoff: nat):
        FORALL (index: nat):
          cutoff <= index IMPLIES
            abs(sequence(index) - value) < epsilon_value

  exponential_value(argument, value: real): bool =
    converges_to(
      (LAMBDA (count: nat):
        exponential_partial(argument, count)),
      value)

  natural_log_value(argument, value: real): bool =
    argument > 0
      AND exponential_value(value, argument)

  is_group(
      carrier: finite_set[nat],
      one: nat,
      inverse: natural_sequence,
      multiply: binary_operation): bool =
    carrier(one)
      AND
        (FORALL (x, y: nat):
          carrier(x) AND carrier(y) IMPLIES
            carrier(multiply(x, y)))
      AND
        (FORALL (x: nat):
          carrier(x) IMPLIES carrier(inverse(x)))
      AND
        (FORALL (x, y, z: nat):
          carrier(x) AND carrier(y) AND carrier(z) IMPLIES
            multiply(multiply(x, y), z)
              = multiply(x, multiply(y, z)))
      AND
        (FORALL (x: nat):
          carrier(x) IMPLIES
            multiply(one, x) = x
              AND multiply(x, one) = x)
      AND
        (FORALL (x: nat):
          carrier(x) IMPLIES
            multiply(inverse(x), x) = one
              AND multiply(x, inverse(x)) = one)

  sequence_in_carrier(
      sequence: natural_sequence,
      sequence_length: nat,
      carrier: finite_set[nat]): bool =
    FORALL (index: nat):
      index < sequence_length IMPLIES carrier(sequence(index))

  valid_subsequence(
      indices: natural_sequence,
      subsequence_length, sequence_length: nat): bool =
    (FORALL (index: nat):
      index < subsequence_length IMPLIES
        indices(index) < sequence_length)
      AND
    (FORALL (left, right: nat):
      left < right AND right < subsequence_length IMPLIES
        indices(left) < indices(right))

  subsequence_product(
      sequence, indices: natural_sequence,
      subsequence_length: nat,
      multiply: binary_operation,
      one: nat): RECURSIVE nat =
    IF subsequence_length = 0 THEN
      one
    ELSE
      multiply(
        subsequence_product(
          sequence,
          indices,
          subsequence_length - 1,
          multiply,
          one),
        sequence(indices(subsequence_length - 1)))
    ENDIF
  MEASURE subsequence_length

  putnam_2008_a6: bool =
    EXISTS (c: real):
      c > 0
        AND
      FORALL
          (carrier: finite_set[nat]),
          (one: nat),
          (inverse: natural_sequence),
          (multiply: binary_operation):
        (is_group(carrier, one, inverse, multiply)
          AND card(carrier) > 1)
        IMPLIES
          EXISTS
              (sequence_length: nat),
              (sequence: natural_sequence),
              (log_order: real):
            natural_log_value(
              card(carrier) :: real,
              log_order)
              AND (sequence_length :: real)
                <= c * log_order
              AND sequence_in_carrier(
                sequence, sequence_length, carrier)
              AND
                (FORALL (g: nat):
                  carrier(g) IMPLIES
                    EXISTS
                        (subsequence_length: nat),
                        (indices: natural_sequence):
                      valid_subsequence(
                        indices,
                        subsequence_length,
                        sequence_length)
                        AND subsequence_product(
                          sequence,
                          indices,
                          subsequence_length,
                          multiply,
                          one)
                          = g)
END putnam_2008_a6

(* Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2008_b1:
   the maximum number of rational-coordinate points on a real plane circle
   with a non-rational center is two. This file contains no proof. *)

From Stdlib Require Import Reals QArith Lists.List.

Open Scope R_scope.

Definition putnam_2008_b1_point : Type := (R * R)%type.

Definition putnam_2008_b1_distance
    (p q : putnam_2008_b1_point) : R :=
  sqrt ((fst p - fst q) ^ 2 + (snd p - snd q) ^ 2).

Definition putnam_2008_b1_rational_point
    (p : putnam_2008_b1_point) : Prop :=
  exists x y : Q,
    fst p = Q2R x /\
    snd p = Q2R y.

Definition putnam_2008_b1_on_circle
    (center p : putnam_2008_b1_point) (radius : R) : Prop :=
  putnam_2008_b1_distance p center = radius.

Definition putnam_2008_b1_has_cardinality
    {A : Type} (P : A -> Prop) (cardinality : nat) : Prop :=
  exists enumeration : list A,
    NoDup enumeration /\
    length enumeration = cardinality /\
    forall x : A, In x enumeration <-> P x.

Definition putnam_2008_b1_possible_count (n : nat) : Prop :=
  exists (center : putnam_2008_b1_point) (radius : R),
    ~ putnam_2008_b1_rational_point center /\
    putnam_2008_b1_has_cardinality
      (fun p : putnam_2008_b1_point =>
        putnam_2008_b1_on_circle center p radius /\
        putnam_2008_b1_rational_point p)
      n.

Definition putnam_2008_b1_is_greatest
    (values : nat -> Prop) (maximum : nat) : Prop :=
  values maximum /\
  forall value : nat, values value -> (value <= maximum)%nat.

Definition putnam_2008_b1_solution : nat := 2%nat.

Theorem putnam_2008_b1 :
  putnam_2008_b1_is_greatest
    putnam_2008_b1_possible_count
    putnam_2008_b1_solution.
Admitted.

(*
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2008_b1:
  the maximum number of rational points on a circle in the real plane whose
  center is not a rational point is two. This file contains no proof.
*)

let statement =
  `let is_rational =
     \x:real.
       ?m n:int.
         ~(n = (&0:int)) /\
         x = real_of_int m / real_of_int n in
   let is_rational_point =
     \(p:real#real).
       is_rational (FST p) /\ is_rational (SND p) in
   let edist =
     \(p:real#real) (q:real#real).
       sqrt ((FST p - FST q) pow 2 + (SND p - SND q) pow 2) in
   let rational_points =
     \(c:real#real) (r:real).
       {p:real#real | edist p c = r /\ is_rational_point p} in
   (?c:real#real. ?r:real.
      ~is_rational_point c /\
      rational_points c r HAS_SIZE 2) /\
   (!c:real#real. !r:real.
      ~is_rational_point c
      ==> FINITE (rational_points c r) /\
          CARD (rational_points c r) <= 2)`;;

;; repository's statement-only convention, the conservative interfaces below
;; present an arbitrary Dedekind-complete Archimedean ordered field with its
;; canonical rational embedding, hence the real field up to ordered-field
;; isomorphism. All carrier, algebraic, order, completeness, and embedding
;; conditions are explicit, and no real coordinate is replaced by a rational
;; coordinate, finite table, or external witness.

(defstub p08b1-real-p (real-type value) t)
(defstub p08b1-zero (real-type) t)
(defstub p08b1-one (real-type) t)

(defun-sk p08b1-field-laws-p (real-type)

      (p08b1-real-p real-type y)
      (p08b1-real-p real-type z))
     (let* ((zero (p08b1-zero real-type))
            (one (p08b1-one real-type))
            (xy-add (p08b1-add real-type x y))
            (yz-add (p08b1-add real-type y z))
            (xy-mul (p08b1-mul real-type x y))
            (yz-mul (p08b1-mul real-type y z))
            (neg-x (p08b1-neg real-type x))
            (inv-x (p08b1-inv real-type x)))
       (and
        (p08b1-real-p real-type xy-add)
        (p08b1-real-p real-type xy-mul)
        (p08b1-real-p real-type neg-x)
        (p08b1-real-p real-type inv-x)
        (equal
         (p08b1-add real-type xy-add z)
         (p08b1-add real-type x yz-add))
        (equal xy-add (p08b1-add real-type y x))
        (equal (p08b1-add real-type x zero) x)
        (equal (p08b1-add real-type x neg-x) zero)
        (equal
         (p08b1-mul real-type xy-mul z)
         (p08b1-mul real-type x yz-mul))
        (equal xy-mul (p08b1-mul real-type y x))
        (equal (p08b1-mul real-type x one) x)
        (implies
         (equal x zero)
         (equal inv-x zero))
        (implies
         (not (equal x zero))
         (equal (p08b1-mul real-type x inv-x) one))
        (equal
         (p08b1-mul real-type x yz-add)
         (p08b1-add
          real-type
          (p08b1-mul real-type x y)
          (p08b1-mul real-type x z))))))))

(defun-sk p08b1-order-laws-p (real-type)
  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (p08b1-real-p real-type x)
      (p08b1-real-p real-type y)
      (p08b1-real-p real-type z))
     (let ((zero (p08b1-zero real-type)))
       (and
        (not (p08b1-less real-type x x))
        (or
         (p08b1-less real-type x y)
         (equal x y)
         (p08b1-less real-type y x))
        (implies
         (and
          (p08b1-less real-type x y)
          (p08b1-less real-type y z))
         (p08b1-less real-type x z))
        (implies
         (p08b1-less real-type x y)
         (p08b1-less
          real-type
          (p08b1-add real-type x z)
          (p08b1-add real-type y z)))
        (implies
         (and
          (p08b1-less real-type zero x)
          (p08b1-less real-type zero y))
         (p08b1-less
          real-type
          zero
          (p08b1-mul real-type x y))))))))

(defun-sk p08b1-rational-embedding-laws-p (real-type)
  (forall (q r)
    (implies
     (and (rationalp q) (rationalp r))
     (and
      (p08b1-real-p
       real-type
       (p08b1-rational-embed real-type q))
      (equal
       (p08b1-rational-embed real-type (+ q r))
       (p08b1-add
        real-type
        (p08b1-rational-embed real-type q)
        (p08b1-rational-embed real-type r)))
      (equal
       (p08b1-rational-embed real-type (* q r))
       (p08b1-mul
        real-type
        (p08b1-rational-embed real-type q)
        (p08b1-rational-embed real-type r)))
      (iff
       (< q r)
       (p08b1-less
        real-type
        (p08b1-rational-embed real-type q)
        (p08b1-rational-embed real-type r)))))))

(defun-sk p08b1-valid-real-set-p (real-type set)
  (forall (value)
    (implies
     (p08b1-real-set-member-p real-type set value)
     (p08b1-real-p real-type value))))

(defun-sk p08b1-real-set-nonempty-p (real-type set)
  (exists (value)
    (and
     (p08b1-real-p real-type value)
     (p08b1-real-set-member-p real-type set value))))

(defun-sk p08b1-upper-bound-p (real-type set upper)
  (forall (value)
    (implies
     (and
      (p08b1-real-p real-type value)
      (p08b1-real-set-member-p real-type set value))
     (p08b1-leq real-type value upper))))

(defun-sk p08b1-real-set-bounded-above-p (real-type set)
  (exists (upper)
    (and
     (p08b1-real-p real-type upper)
     (p08b1-upper-bound-p real-type set upper))))

(defun-sk p08b1-least-upper-bound-p
    (real-type set supremum)
  (forall (upper)
    (implies
     (and
      (p08b1-real-p real-type upper)
      (p08b1-upper-bound-p real-type set upper))
     (p08b1-leq real-type supremum upper))))

(defun-sk p08b1-completeness-p (real-type)
  (forall (set)
    (implies
     (and
      (p08b1-real-set-p real-type set)
      (p08b1-valid-real-set-p real-type set)
      (p08b1-real-set-nonempty-p real-type set)
      (p08b1-real-set-bounded-above-p real-type set))
     (let ((supremum (p08b1-supremum real-type set)))
       (and
        (p08b1-real-p real-type supremum)
        (p08b1-upper-bound-p real-type set supremum)
        (p08b1-least-upper-bound-p
         real-type set supremum))))))

(defun-sk p08b1-rational-above-exists-p
    (real-type value)
  (exists (q)
    (and
     (rationalp q)
     (p08b1-less
      real-type
      value
      (p08b1-rational-embed real-type q)))))

(defun-sk p08b1-archimedean-p (real-type)
  (forall (value)
    (implies
     (p08b1-real-p real-type value)
     (p08b1-rational-above-exists-p real-type value))))

(defun p08b1-real-field-p (real-type)
  (let ((zero (p08b1-zero real-type))
        (one (p08b1-one real-type)))
    (and
     (p08b1-real-p real-type zero)
     (p08b1-real-p real-type one)
     (not (equal zero one))
     (equal
      (p08b1-rational-embed real-type 0)
      zero)
     (equal
      (p08b1-rational-embed real-type 1)
      one)
     (p08b1-less real-type zero one)
     (p08b1-field-laws-p real-type)
     (p08b1-order-laws-p real-type)
     (p08b1-rational-embedding-laws-p real-type)
     (p08b1-completeness-p real-type)
     (p08b1-archimedean-p real-type))))

;; A coordinate is rational exactly when it is the image of an ACL2 rational
;; under the canonical embedding. All quantifiers over circle centers, radii,
;; and point coordinates remain quantifiers over the full real carrier.

(defun-sk p08b1-rational-real-p (real-type value)
  (exists (q)
    (and
     (rationalp q)
     (equal
      value
      (p08b1-rational-embed real-type q)))))

(defun p08b1-rational-point-p (real-type x y)
  (and
   (p08b1-real-p real-type x)
   (p08b1-real-p real-type y)
   (p08b1-rational-real-p real-type x)
   (p08b1-rational-real-p real-type y)))

(defun p08b1-non-rational-center-p
    (real-type center-x center-y)
  (and
   (p08b1-real-p real-type center-x)
   (p08b1-real-p real-type center-y)
   (not
    (p08b1-rational-point-p
     real-type center-x center-y))))

(defun p08b1-point-equal-p (x1 y1 x2 y2)
  (and (equal x1 x2)
       (equal y1 y2)))

(defun p08b1-squared-distance
    (real-type center-x center-y point-x point-y)
  (p08b1-add
   real-type
   (p08b1-square
    real-type
    (p08b1-sub real-type point-x center-x))
   (p08b1-square
    real-type
    (p08b1-sub real-type point-y center-y))))

(defun p08b1-on-circle-p
    (real-type center-x center-y radius point-x point-y)
  (and
   (p08b1-real-p real-type center-x)
   (p08b1-real-p real-type center-y)
   (p08b1-real-p real-type radius)
   (p08b1-real-p real-type point-x)
   (p08b1-real-p real-type point-y)
   (not
    (p08b1-less
     real-type radius (p08b1-zero real-type)))
   (equal
    (p08b1-squared-distance
     real-type center-x center-y point-x point-y)
    (p08b1-square real-type radius))))

;; This universal clause says that the two displayed rational points exhaust
;; all rational points of the same circle.

(defun-sk p08b1-only-two-rational-points-p
    (real-type center-x center-y radius x1 y1 x2 y2)
  (forall (x y)
    (implies
     (and
      (p08b1-rational-point-p real-type x y)
      (p08b1-on-circle-p
       real-type center-x center-y radius x y))
     (or
      (p08b1-point-equal-p x y x1 y1)
      (p08b1-point-equal-p x y x2 y2)))))

;; Exact attainment of the value two: the center, radius, and the two points
;; are internal existential witnesses, and the exhaustion clause makes the
;; rational-point set have cardinality exactly two.

(defun-sk p08b1-two-attained-p (real-type)
  (exists (center-x center-y radius x1 y1 x2 y2)
    (and
     (p08b1-non-rational-center-p
      real-type center-x center-y)
     (p08b1-rational-point-p real-type x1 y1)
     (p08b1-rational-point-p real-type x2 y2)
     (not (p08b1-point-equal-p x1 y1 x2 y2))
     (p08b1-on-circle-p
      real-type center-x center-y radius x1 y1)
     (p08b1-on-circle-p
      real-type center-x center-y radius x2 y2)
     (p08b1-only-two-rational-points-p
      real-type
      center-x center-y radius
      x1 y1 x2 y2))))

;; Universal upper bound: on every real circle with a non-rational center,
;; any three rational points include a repeated pair. This is exactly the
;; assertion that such a circle has at most two rational points.

(defun-sk p08b1-at-most-two-on-every-circle-p (real-type)
  (forall
   (center-x center-y radius x1 y1 x2 y2 x3 y3)
   (implies
    (and
     (p08b1-non-rational-center-p
      real-type center-x center-y)
     (p08b1-rational-point-p real-type x1 y1)
     (p08b1-rational-point-p real-type x2 y2)
     (p08b1-rational-point-p real-type x3 y3)
     (p08b1-on-circle-p
      real-type center-x center-y radius x1 y1)
     (p08b1-on-circle-p
      real-type center-x center-y radius x2 y2)
     (p08b1-on-circle-p
      real-type center-x center-y radius x3 y3))
    (or
     (p08b1-point-equal-p x1 y1 x2 y2)
     (p08b1-point-equal-p x1 y1 x3 y3)
     (p08b1-point-equal-p x2 y2 x3 y3)))))

(defun p08b1-maximum-is-two-p (real-type)
  (and
   (p08b1-two-attained-p real-type)
   (p08b1-at-most-two-on-every-circle-p real-type)))

(defun putnambench-putnam-2008-b1-statement (real-type)
  (implies
   (p08b1-real-field-p real-type)
   (p08b1-maximum-is-two-p real-type)))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)

:q

title: putnam_2008_b1
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2008_b1
-- (putnambench__agda__putnam_2008_b1): the greatest possible number of
-- rational points on a real plane circle with a non-rational center is two.
-- This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module Putnam2008B1 where

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Int using (Int; pos; negsuc)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; _*_)

infix 4 _!=_ _<=N_
infixr 3 _and_
infixr 2 _or_

data Bottom : Set where

Not : Set -> Set
Not A =
  A -> Bottom

_!=_ : {A : Set} -> A -> A -> Set
x != y =
  Not (x == y)

record _and_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data _or_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  left  : A -> A or B
  right : B -> A or B

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

data _<=N_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set where
  zero<=N   : {n : Nat} -> zero <=N n
  suc<=sucN : {m n : Nat} -> m <=N n -> suc m <=N suc n

data Fin : Nat -> Set where
  fzero : {n : Nat} -> Fin (suc n)
  fsuc  : {n : Nat} -> Fin n -> Fin (suc n)

oneN : Nat
oneN =
  suc zero

twoN : Nat
twoN =
  suc oneN

record StandardReal (R : Set) : Set1 where
  field
    zeroR oneR : R
    add multiply : R -> R -> R
    negate inverse squareRoot : R -> R
    lessOrEqual : R -> R -> Set
    fromNat : Nat -> R

    one-not-zero :
      oneR != zeroR

    add-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> add x y == add y x
    add-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      add (add x y) z == add x (add y z)
    add-zero :
      (x : R) -> add x zeroR == x
    add-inverse :
      (x : R) -> add x (negate x) == zeroR

    multiply-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> multiply x y == multiply y x
    multiply-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply (multiply x y) z ==
      multiply x (multiply y z)
    multiply-one :
      (x : R) -> multiply x oneR == x
    multiply-zero :
      (x : R) -> multiply x zeroR == zeroR
    distribute :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply x (add y z) ==
      add (multiply x y) (multiply x z)
    inverse-zero :
      inverse zeroR == zeroR
    multiply-inverse :
      (x : R) ->
      x != zeroR ->
      multiply x (inverse x) == oneR

    order-reflexive :
      (x : R) -> lessOrEqual x x
    order-transitive :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y z ->
      lessOrEqual x z
    order-antisymmetric :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y x ->
      x == y
    order-total :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y or lessOrEqual y x
    add-order :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual (add z x) (add z y)
    multiply-nonnegative :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR x ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR y ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR (multiply x y)
    zero-less-than-one :
      lessOrEqual zeroR oneR and zeroR != oneR

    fromNat-zero :
      fromNat zero == zeroR
    fromNat-successor :
      (n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (suc n) == add (fromNat n) oneR
    fromNat-addition :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m + n) == add (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-multiplication :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m * n) == multiply (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-injective :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat m == fromNat n ->
      m == n

    square-root-nonnegative :
      (x : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR (squareRoot x)
    square-root-square :
      (x : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR x ->
      multiply (squareRoot x) (squareRoot x) == x
    square-root-nonpositive :
      (x : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x zeroR ->
      squareRoot x == zeroR
    square-root-unique :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR y ->
      multiply y y == x ->
      squareRoot x == y

    archimedean :
      (x : R) ->
      Exists Nat
        (\ n ->
          lessOrEqual x (fromNat n))
    least-upper-bound :
      (P : R -> Set) ->
      Exists R P ->
      Exists R
        (\ upper ->
          (x : R) ->
          P x ->
          lessOrEqual x upper) ->
      Exists R
        (\ supremum ->
          ((x : R) ->
            P x ->
            lessOrEqual x supremum)
          and
          ((upper : R) ->
            ((x : R) ->
              P x ->
              lessOrEqual x upper) ->
            lessOrEqual supremum upper))

open StandardReal

fromInt :
  {R : Set} ->
  StandardReal R ->
  Int ->
  R
fromInt reals (pos n) =
  fromNat reals n
fromInt reals (negsuc n) =
  negate reals (fromNat reals (suc n))

subtract :
  {R : Set} ->
  StandardReal R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
subtract reals x y =
  add reals x (negate reals y)

divide :
  {R : Set} ->
  StandardReal R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
divide reals x y =
  multiply reals x (inverse reals y)

square :
  {R : Set} ->
  StandardReal R ->
  R ->
  R
square reals x =
  multiply reals x x

IsRational :
  {R : Set} ->
  StandardReal R ->
  R ->
  Set
IsRational reals x =
  Exists Int
    (\ numerator ->
      Exists Int
        (\ denominator ->
          denominator != pos zero
          and
          x ==
          divide reals
            (fromInt reals numerator)
            (fromInt reals denominator)))

record Point (R : Set) : Set where
  constructor point
  field
    x-coordinate : R
    y-coordinate : R

open Point

PointEqual :
  {R : Set} ->
  Point R ->
  Point R ->
  Set
PointEqual left-point right-point =
  x-coordinate left-point == x-coordinate right-point
  and
  y-coordinate left-point == y-coordinate right-point

IsRationalPoint :
  {R : Set} ->
  StandardReal R ->
  Point R ->
  Set
IsRationalPoint reals p =
  IsRational reals (x-coordinate p)
  and
  IsRational reals (y-coordinate p)

squaredDistance :
  {R : Set} ->
  StandardReal R ->
  Point R ->
  Point R ->
  R
squaredDistance reals p q =
  add reals
    (square reals
      (subtract reals (x-coordinate p) (x-coordinate q)))
    (square reals
      (subtract reals (y-coordinate p) (y-coordinate q)))

distance :
  {R : Set} ->
  StandardReal R ->
  Point R ->
  Point R ->
  R
distance reals p q =
  squareRoot reals (squaredDistance reals p q)

Circle :
  {R : Set} ->
  StandardReal R ->
  Point R ->
  R ->
  Point R ->
  Set
Circle reals center radius p =
  distance reals p center == radius

record HasExtensionalCardinality
  {A : Set}
  (equivalent : A -> A -> Set)
  (member : A -> Set)
  (cardinality : Nat) :
  Set where

  field
    enumerate :
      Fin cardinality ->
      A
    enumerated-member :
      (index : Fin cardinality) ->
      member (enumerate index)
    enumeration-complete :
      (item : A) ->
      member item ->
      Exists (Fin cardinality)
        (\ index ->
          equivalent item (enumerate index))
    enumeration-injective :
      (left-index right-index : Fin cardinality) ->
      equivalent
        (enumerate left-index)
        (enumerate right-index) ->
      left-index == right-index

RationalPointOnCircle :
  {R : Set} ->
  StandardReal R ->
  Point R ->
  R ->
  Point R ->
  Set
RationalPointOnCircle reals center radius p =
  Circle reals center radius p
  and
  IsRationalPoint reals p

AttainableRationalPointCount :
  {R : Set} ->
  StandardReal R ->
  Nat ->
  Set
AttainableRationalPointCount {R} reals count =
  Exists (Point R)
    (\ center ->
      Exists R
        (\ radius ->
          Not (IsRationalPoint reals center)
          and
          HasExtensionalCardinality
            PointEqual
            (RationalPointOnCircle reals center radius)
            count))

IsGreatestNat :
  (Nat -> Set) ->
  Nat ->
  Set
IsGreatestNat property greatest =
  property greatest
  and
  ((n : Nat) ->
    property n ->
    n <=N greatest)

putnam-2008-b1 : Set1
putnam-2008-b1 =
  (R : Set) ->
  (reals : StandardReal R) ->
  IsGreatestNat
    (AttainableRationalPointCount reals)
    twoN

title: putnam_2008_b1
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2008_b1:
  the maximum number of rational-coordinate points on a circle in the real
  plane with a non-rational center is two. This file contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open arithmeticTheory pairTheory pred_setTheory realTheory real_of_ratTheory
     transcTheory;

val putnam_2008_b1 =
  ``let rational_point =
      \P : real # real.
        FST P IN q_set /\ SND P IN q_set
    in
    let dist =
      \P Q : real # real.
        sqrt ((FST P - FST Q) pow 2 + (SND P - SND Q) pow 2)
    in
    let circle_points =
      \c : real # real. \r : real.
        {P : real # real |
           dist P c = r /\ rational_point P}
    in
      (?c : real # real. ?r : real.
         ~rational_point c /\ circle_points c r HAS_SIZE 2) /\
      (!c : real # real. !r : real.
         ~rational_point c
         ==>
         FINITE (circle_points c r) /\
         CARD (circle_points c r) <= 2)``;

title: putnam_2008_b1
content:
$(
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact
  putnam_2008_b1: the maximum number of rational-coordinate points on a
  circle in the real plane whose center is not a rational point is two.
  This file contains no proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  P08B1R2 is the real coordinate plane and P08B1Q2 is its subset of points
  with two rational coordinates. P08B1Dist is Euclidean distance.
  P08B1NCard implements the finite-cardinality convention of Lean's
  Set.ncard and Isabelle's card: it is zero for an infinite set.

  The first conjunct of the final assertion says that two rational points
  are attained by a circle with a nonrational center. The second conjunct
  gives the upper-bound clause for every natural cardinality attained by
  such a circle. Together they expand the source IsGreatest assertion with
  its annotated solution 2. Centers and radii retain their full real
  domains, including the source's unrestricted radius. Every declaration
  below is an unproved $a statement; this database contains no $p proof
  declaration.
$)

$c P08B1I P08B1R2 P08B1Q2 P08B1Dist P08B1NCard $.

p08b1-index-syntax $a class P08B1I $.
p08b1-plane-syntax $a class P08B1R2 $.
p08b1-rational-plane-syntax $a class P08B1Q2 $.
p08b1-distance-syntax $a class ( P08B1Dist A B ) $.
p08b1-ncard-syntax $a class P08B1NCard $.

p08b1-index-definition $a |- P08B1I = ( 1 ... 2 ) $.

p08b1-plane-definition $a |- P08B1R2 = ( RR ^m P08B1I ) $.

p08b1-rational-plane-definition $a |-
  P08B1Q2 = ( QQ ^m P08B1I ) $.

${
  $d A B k $.

  p08b1-distance-definition $a |- (
    P08B1Dist A B
  ) = (
    sqrt
    `
    (
      sum_ k e. P08B1I
        ( ( ( A ` k ) - ( B ` k ) ) ^ 2 )
    )
  ) $.
$}

p08b1-ncard-definition $a |- P08B1NCard =
  ( s e. _V |-> if ( s e. Fin , ( # ` s ) , 0 ) ) $.

${
  $d c n p r $.

  putnambench-putnam-2008-b1 $a |- (
    E. c e. P08B1R2
      E. r e. RR
        (
          c e/ P08B1Q2
          /\
          (
            P08B1NCard
            `
            {
              p e. P08B1Q2 |
              ( P08B1Dist p c ) = r
            }
          )
          =
          2
        )
    /\
    A. n e. NN0
      (
        E. c e. P08B1R2
          E. r e. RR
            (
              c e/ P08B1Q2
              /\
              (
                P08B1NCard
                `
                {
                  p e. P08B1Q2 |
                  ( P08B1Dist p c ) = r
                }
              )
              =
              n
            )
        ->
        n <_ 2
      )
  ) $.
$}

title: putnam_2008_b1
content:
% Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2008_b1:
% the greatest number of rational-coordinate points on a real circle with a
% non-rational center is two. This file contains no proof.

putnam_2008_b1: THEORY
BEGIN
  point: TYPE = [# x_coord: real, y_coord: real #]
  point_set: TYPE = [point -> bool]
  point_enumeration: TYPE = [nat -> point]

  rational_point(P: point): bool =
    rational?(x_coord(P)) AND rational?(y_coord(P))

  squared_distance(P, Q: point): real =
    (x_coord(P) - x_coord(Q)) ^ 2
      + (y_coord(P) - y_coord(Q)) ^ 2

  lies_on_circle(P, center: point, radius: real): bool =
    0 <= radius
      AND squared_distance(P, center) = radius * radius

  rational_points_on_circle(
      center: point,
      radius: real): point_set =
    LAMBDA (P: point):
      lies_on_circle(P, center, radius)
        AND rational_point(P)

  injective_below(
      enumeration: point_enumeration,
      cardinality: nat): bool =
    FORALL (i, j: nat):
      (i < cardinality
        AND j < cardinality
        AND enumeration(i) = enumeration(j))
      IMPLIES i = j

  enumerates_exactly(
      enumeration: point_enumeration,
      set_value: point_set,
      cardinality: nat): bool =
    FORALL (P: point):
      set_value(P)
        IFF
          EXISTS (position: nat):
            position < cardinality
              AND enumeration(position) = P

  has_cardinality(
      set_value: point_set,
      cardinality: nat): bool =
    EXISTS (enumeration: point_enumeration):
      injective_below(enumeration, cardinality)
        AND enumerates_exactly(
          enumeration, set_value, cardinality)

  attainable_count(cardinality: nat): bool =
    EXISTS (center: point), (radius: real):
      NOT rational_point(center)
        AND has_cardinality(
          rational_points_on_circle(center, radius),
          cardinality)

  putnam_2008_b1_solution: nat = 2

  putnam_2008_b1: bool =
    attainable_count(putnam_2008_b1_solution)
      AND
        (FORALL (cardinality: nat):
          attainable_count(cardinality)
            IMPLIES
              cardinality <= putnam_2008_b1_solution)
END putnam_2008_b1

import Mathlib

open Filter Topology Set Nat

abbrev putnam_2008_b2_solution : ℝ := sorry
-- -1
/--
Let $F_0(x)=\ln x$. For $n \geq 0$ and $x>0$, let $F_{n+1}(x)=\int_0^x F_n(t)\,dt$. Evaluate $\lim_{n \to \infty} \frac{n!F_n(1)}{\ln n}$.
-/
theorem putnam_2008_b2
(F : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ)
(hF0 : ∀ x : ℝ, F 0 x = Real.log x)
(hFn : ∀ n : ℕ, ∀ x > 0, F (n + 1) x = ∫ t in Set.Ioo 0 x, F n t)
: Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => ((n)! * F n 1) / Real.log n) atTop (𝓝 putnam_2008_b2_solution) :=
sorry

Require Import Factorial Reals Coquelicot.Coquelicot.
Definition putnam_2008_b2_solution := -1.

Theorem putnam_2008_b2
    (F : nat -> R -> R)
    (hF0 : forall x : R, x > 0 -> F 0%nat x = ln x)
    (hFn : forall (n : nat) (x : R),
      x > 0 ->
      is_RInt_gen (F n) (at_right 0) (at_point x) (F (S n) x)) :
  is_lim_seq
    (fun n => INR (fact n) * F n 1 / ln (INR n))
    putnam_2008_b2_solution.
Proof. Admitted.

title: putnam_2008_b2
putnam_2008_b2
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2008_b2:
;; an arbitrary real-valued family obtained by repeated integration from the
;; real logarithm has factorial-normalized values at 1 whose quotient by
;; log(n) tends to -1. This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))

;; Real values, real-valued families, gauges, and sets are arbitrary ACL2
;; objects interpreted through conservative fixed-arity interfaces.
;; Formula-specific DEFUN-SK binders retain the source's unbounded
;; quantifiers; no finite carrier or function table is used.

(defstub pb08b2-real-p (real-type value) t)
(defstub pb08b2-zero (real-type) t)
(defstub pb08b2-one (real-type) t)
(defstub pb08b2-add (real-type left right) t)
(defstub pb08b2-multiply (real-type left right) t)
(defstub pb08b2-negate (real-type value) t)
(defstub pb08b2-inverse (real-type value) t)
(defstub pb08b2-less (real-type left right) t)
(defstub pb08b2-set-member-p (real-type set value) t)

(defstub pb08b2-logarithm (real-type value) t)
(defstub pb08b2-family-value
  (real-type family natural-index argument) t)
(defstub pb08b2-gauge-value (real-type gauge argument) t)

(defun pb08b2-subtract (real-type left right)
  (pb08b2-add
   real-type left (pb08b2-negate real-type right)))

(defun pb08b2-divide (real-type numerator denominator)
  (pb08b2-multiply
   real-type numerator (pb08b2-inverse real-type denominator)))

(defun pb08b2-leq (real-type left right)
  (not (pb08b2-less real-type right left)))

(defun pb08b2-absolute-value (real-type value)
  (if (pb08b2-less
       real-type value (pb08b2-zero real-type))
      (pb08b2-negate real-type value)
    value))

(defun pb08b2-positive-real-p (real-type value)
  (and
   (pb08b2-real-p real-type value)
   (pb08b2-less
    real-type (pb08b2-zero real-type) value)))

;; A complete Archimedean ordered-field presentation of the real carrier.

(defun-sk pb08b2-operation-closure-p (real-type)
  (forall (x y)
    (and
     (pb08b2-real-p real-type (pb08b2-zero real-type))
     (pb08b2-real-p real-type (pb08b2-one real-type))
     (implies
      (pb08b2-real-p real-type x)
      (and
       (pb08b2-real-p
        real-type (pb08b2-negate real-type x))
       (pb08b2-real-p
        real-type (pb08b2-inverse real-type x))))
     (implies
      (and
       (pb08b2-real-p real-type x)
       (pb08b2-real-p real-type y))
      (and
       (pb08b2-real-p
        real-type (pb08b2-add real-type x y))
       (pb08b2-real-p
        real-type (pb08b2-multiply real-type x y)))))))

(defun-sk pb08b2-unary-field-laws-p (real-type)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (pb08b2-real-p real-type x)
     (let ((zero (pb08b2-zero real-type))
           (one (pb08b2-one real-type)))
       (and
        (equal (pb08b2-add real-type zero x) x)
        (equal (pb08b2-add real-type x zero) x)
        (equal
         (pb08b2-add
          real-type x (pb08b2-negate real-type x))
         zero)
        (equal (pb08b2-multiply real-type one x) x)
        (equal (pb08b2-multiply real-type x one) x)
        (implies
         (equal x zero)
         (equal (pb08b2-inverse real-type x) zero))
        (implies
         (not (equal x zero))
         (equal
          (pb08b2-multiply
           real-type x (pb08b2-inverse real-type x))
          one)))))))

(defun-sk pb08b2-binary-field-laws-p (real-type)
  (forall (x y)
    (implies
     (and
      (pb08b2-real-p real-type x)
      (pb08b2-real-p real-type y))
     (and
      (equal
       (pb08b2-add real-type x y)
       (pb08b2-add real-type y x))
      (equal
       (pb08b2-multiply real-type x y)
       (pb08b2-multiply real-type y x))))))

(defun-sk pb08b2-ternary-field-laws-p (real-type)
  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (pb08b2-real-p real-type x)
      (pb08b2-real-p real-type y)
      (pb08b2-real-p real-type z))
     (and
      (equal
       (pb08b2-add
        real-type (pb08b2-add real-type x y) z)
       (pb08b2-add
        real-type x (pb08b2-add real-type y z)))
      (equal
       (pb08b2-multiply
        real-type (pb08b2-multiply real-type x y) z)
       (pb08b2-multiply
        real-type x (pb08b2-multiply real-type y z)))
      (equal
       (pb08b2-multiply
        real-type x (pb08b2-add real-type y z))
       (pb08b2-add
        real-type
        (pb08b2-multiply real-type x y)
        (pb08b2-multiply real-type x z)))))))

(defun-sk pb08b2-order-laws-p (real-type)
  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (pb08b2-real-p real-type x)
      (pb08b2-real-p real-type y)
      (pb08b2-real-p real-type z))
     (and
      (not (pb08b2-less real-type x x))
      (or
       (pb08b2-less real-type x y)
       (equal x y)
       (pb08b2-less real-type y x))
      (implies
       (and
        (pb08b2-less real-type x y)
        (pb08b2-less real-type y z))
       (pb08b2-less real-type x z))
      (implies
       (pb08b2-less real-type x y)
       (pb08b2-less
        real-type
        (pb08b2-add real-type x z)
        (pb08b2-add real-type y z)))
      (implies
       (and
        (pb08b2-less
         real-type (pb08b2-zero real-type) x)
        (pb08b2-less
         real-type (pb08b2-zero real-type) y))
       (pb08b2-less
        real-type
        (pb08b2-zero real-type)
        (pb08b2-multiply real-type x y)))))))

(defun-sk pb08b2-valid-real-set-p (real-type set)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (pb08b2-set-member-p real-type set x)
     (pb08b2-real-p real-type x))))

(defun-sk pb08b2-set-nonempty-p (real-type set)
  (exists (x)
    (and
     (pb08b2-real-p real-type x)
     (pb08b2-set-member-p real-type set x))))

(defun-sk pb08b2-upper-bound-p (real-type set bound)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (pb08b2-set-member-p real-type set x)
     (pb08b2-leq real-type x bound))))

(defun-sk pb08b2-set-bounded-above-p (real-type set)
  (exists (bound)
    (and
     (pb08b2-real-p real-type bound)
     (pb08b2-upper-bound-p real-type set bound))))

(defun-sk pb08b2-least-upper-bound-p
    (real-type set supremum)
  (forall (bound)
    (and
     (pb08b2-real-p real-type supremum)
     (pb08b2-upper-bound-p real-type set supremum)
     (implies
      (and
       (pb08b2-real-p real-type bound)
       (pb08b2-upper-bound-p real-type set bound))
      (pb08b2-leq real-type supremum bound)))))

(defun-sk pb08b2-supremum-exists-p (real-type set)
  (exists (supremum)
    (and
     (pb08b2-real-p real-type supremum)
     (pb08b2-least-upper-bound-p
      real-type set supremum))))

(defun-sk pb08b2-dedekind-complete-p (real-type)
  (forall (set)
    (implies
     (and
      (pb08b2-valid-real-set-p real-type set)
      (pb08b2-set-nonempty-p real-type set)
      (pb08b2-set-bounded-above-p real-type set))
     (pb08b2-supremum-exists-p real-type set))))

(defun pb08b2-real-natural (real-type n)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix n)))
  (if (zp n)
      (pb08b2-zero real-type)
    (pb08b2-add
     real-type
     (pb08b2-one real-type)
     (pb08b2-real-natural real-type (1- n)))))

(defun-sk pb08b2-archimedean-bound-exists-p
    (real-type value)
  (exists (n)
    (and
     (natp n)
     (pb08b2-less
      real-type value
      (pb08b2-real-natural real-type n)))))

(defun-sk pb08b2-archimedean-p (real-type)
  (forall (value)
    (implies
     (pb08b2-real-p real-type value)
     (pb08b2-archimedean-bound-exists-p
      real-type value))))

(defun pb08b2-real-structure-p (real-type)
  (and
   (pb08b2-operation-closure-p real-type)
   (pb08b2-unary-field-laws-p real-type)
   (pb08b2-binary-field-laws-p real-type)
   (pb08b2-ternary-field-laws-p real-type)
   (pb08b2-order-laws-p real-type)
   (not
    (equal
     (pb08b2-zero real-type)
     (pb08b2-one real-type)))
   (pb08b2-less
    real-type
    (pb08b2-zero real-type)
    (pb08b2-one real-type))
   (pb08b2-dedekind-complete-p real-type)
   (pb08b2-archimedean-p real-type)))

;; Tagged divisions and gauge integrals provide an exact definition of every
;; integral occurring in the logarithm and repeated-integration assumptions.

(defun pb08b2-in-closed-interval-p
    (real-type left right value)
  (and
   (pb08b2-real-p real-type value)
   (pb08b2-leq real-type left value)
   (pb08b2-leq real-type value right)))

(defun pb08b2-tagged-piece-p (real-type piece)
  (and
   (true-listp piece)
   (equal (len piece) 3)
   (pb08b2-real-p real-type (nth 0 piece))
   (pb08b2-real-p real-type (nth 1 piece))
   (pb08b2-real-p real-type (nth 2 piece))
   (pb08b2-less
    real-type (nth 1 piece) (nth 2 piece))
   (pb08b2-leq
    real-type (nth 1 piece) (nth 0 piece))
   (pb08b2-leq
    real-type (nth 0 piece) (nth 2 piece))))

(defun pb08b2-tagged-division-tail-p
    (real-type division next-left right)
  (if (endp division)
      (equal next-left right)
    (let ((piece (car division)))
      (and
       (pb08b2-tagged-piece-p real-type piece)
       (equal (nth 1 piece) next-left)
       (pb08b2-tagged-division-tail-p
        real-type
        (cdr division)
        (nth 2 piece)
        right)))))

(defun pb08b2-tagged-division-p
    (real-type left right division)
  (and
   (true-listp division)
   (pb08b2-real-p real-type left)
   (pb08b2-real-p real-type right)
   (pb08b2-leq real-type left right)
   (pb08b2-tagged-division-tail-p
    real-type division left right)))

(defun-sk pb08b2-positive-gauge-p
    (real-type gauge left right)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (pb08b2-in-closed-interval-p
      real-type left right x)
     (and
      (pb08b2-real-p
       real-type
       (pb08b2-gauge-value real-type gauge x))
      (pb08b2-less
       real-type
       (pb08b2-zero real-type)
       (pb08b2-gauge-value real-type gauge x))))))

(defun pb08b2-fine-tagged-division-p
    (real-type gauge division)
  (if (endp division)
      t
    (let* ((piece (car division))
           (tag (nth 0 piece))
           (left (nth 1 piece))
           (right (nth 2 piece))
           (radius
            (pb08b2-gauge-value real-type gauge tag)))
      (and
       (pb08b2-less
        real-type
        (pb08b2-subtract real-type tag left)
        radius)
       (pb08b2-less
        real-type
        (pb08b2-subtract real-type right tag)
        radius)
       (pb08b2-fine-tagged-division-p
        real-type gauge (cdr division))))))

(defun-sk pb08b2-fine-division-exists-p
    (real-type gauge left right)
  (exists (division)
    (and
     (pb08b2-tagged-division-p
      real-type left right division)
     (pb08b2-fine-tagged-division-p
      real-type gauge division))))

(defun pb08b2-family-riemann-sum
    (real-type family n division)
  (if (endp division)
      (pb08b2-zero real-type)
    (let* ((piece (car division))
           (tag (nth 0 piece))
           (left (nth 1 piece))
           (right (nth 2 piece)))
      (pb08b2-add
       real-type
       (pb08b2-multiply
        real-type
        (pb08b2-family-value
         real-type family n tag)
        (pb08b2-subtract real-type right left))
       (pb08b2-family-riemann-sum
        real-type family n (cdr division))))))

(defun-sk pb08b2-all-family-sums-close-p
    (real-type family n integral gauge left right epsilon)
  (forall (division)
    (implies
     (and
      (pb08b2-tagged-division-p
       real-type left right division)
      (pb08b2-fine-tagged-division-p
       real-type gauge division))
     (pb08b2-less
      real-type
      (pb08b2-absolute-value
       real-type
       (pb08b2-subtract
        real-type
        (pb08b2-family-riemann-sum
         real-type family n division)
        integral))
      epsilon))))

(defun-sk pb08b2-family-integral-gauge-exists-p
    (real-type family n integral left right epsilon)
  (exists (gauge)
    (and
     (pb08b2-positive-gauge-p
      real-type gauge left right)
     (pb08b2-fine-division-exists-p
      real-type gauge left right)
     (pb08b2-all-family-sums-close-p
      real-type family n integral gauge
      left right epsilon))))

(defun-sk pb08b2-family-has-integral-p
    (real-type family n integral left right)
  (forall (epsilon)
    (implies
     (pb08b2-positive-real-p real-type epsilon)
     (pb08b2-family-integral-gauge-exists-p
      real-type family n integral
      left right epsilon))))

;; On every positive interval, the logarithm is characterized by the gauge
;; integral of the reciprocal function. The reversed case gives the usual
;; signed integral from 1 to x when 0 < x < 1.

(defun pb08b2-reciprocal-riemann-sum
    (real-type division)
  (if (endp division)
      (pb08b2-zero real-type)
    (let* ((piece (car division))
           (tag (nth 0 piece))
           (left (nth 1 piece))
           (right (nth 2 piece)))
      (pb08b2-add
       real-type
       (pb08b2-multiply
        real-type
        (pb08b2-inverse real-type tag)
        (pb08b2-subtract real-type right left))
       (pb08b2-reciprocal-riemann-sum
        real-type (cdr division))))))

(defun-sk pb08b2-all-reciprocal-sums-close-p
    (real-type integral gauge left right epsilon)
  (forall (division)
    (implies
     (and
      (pb08b2-tagged-division-p
       real-type left right division)
      (pb08b2-fine-tagged-division-p
       real-type gauge division))
     (pb08b2-less
      real-type
      (pb08b2-absolute-value
       real-type
       (pb08b2-subtract
        real-type
        (pb08b2-reciprocal-riemann-sum
         real-type division)
        integral))
      epsilon))))

(defun-sk pb08b2-reciprocal-integral-gauge-exists-p
    (real-type integral left right epsilon)
  (exists (gauge)
    (and
     (pb08b2-positive-gauge-p
      real-type gauge left right)
     (pb08b2-fine-division-exists-p
      real-type gauge left right)
     (pb08b2-all-reciprocal-sums-close-p
      real-type integral gauge left right epsilon))))

(defun-sk pb08b2-reciprocal-has-integral-p
    (real-type integral left right)
  (forall (epsilon)
    (implies
     (pb08b2-positive-real-p real-type epsilon)
     (pb08b2-reciprocal-integral-gauge-exists-p
      real-type integral left right epsilon))))

(defun-sk pb08b2-logarithm-real-valued-p (real-type)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (pb08b2-real-p real-type x)
     (pb08b2-real-p
      real-type (pb08b2-logarithm real-type x)))))

(defun-sk pb08b2-logarithm-positive-definition-p
    (real-type)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (pb08b2-positive-real-p real-type x)
     (if (pb08b2-leq
          real-type (pb08b2-one real-type) x)
         (pb08b2-reciprocal-has-integral-p
          real-type
          (pb08b2-logarithm real-type x)
          (pb08b2-one real-type)
          x)
       (pb08b2-reciprocal-has-integral-p
        real-type
        (pb08b2-negate
         real-type (pb08b2-logarithm real-type x))
        x
        (pb08b2-one real-type))))))

(defun pb08b2-logarithm-laws-p (real-type)
  (and
   (pb08b2-logarithm-real-valued-p real-type)
   (pb08b2-logarithm-positive-definition-p real-type)))

;; The family remains arbitrary. These predicates state exactly the source
;; base equation and the integral recurrence, rather than defining F_n(1)
;; through a closed form derived from them.

(defun-sk pb08b2-real-family-p (real-type family)
  (forall (n x)
    (implies
     (and
      (natp n)
      (pb08b2-real-p real-type x))
     (pb08b2-real-p
      real-type
      (pb08b2-family-value
       real-type family n x)))))

(defun-sk pb08b2-family-base-p (real-type family)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (pb08b2-real-p real-type x)
     (equal
      (pb08b2-family-value real-type family 0 x)
      (pb08b2-logarithm real-type x)))))

(defun-sk pb08b2-family-recurrence-p
    (real-type family)
  (forall (n x)
    (implies
     (and
      (natp n)
      (pb08b2-positive-real-p real-type x))
     (pb08b2-family-has-integral-p
      real-type
      family
      n
      (pb08b2-family-value
       real-type family (+ n 1) x)
      (pb08b2-zero real-type)
      x))))

(defun pb08b2-real-factorial (real-type n)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix n)))
  (if (zp n)
      (pb08b2-one real-type)
    (pb08b2-multiply
     real-type
     (pb08b2-real-natural real-type n)
     (pb08b2-real-factorial real-type (1- n)))))

(defun pb08b2-normalized-value
    (real-type family n)
  (pb08b2-divide
   real-type
   (pb08b2-multiply
    real-type
    (pb08b2-real-factorial real-type n)
    (pb08b2-family-value
     real-type family n (pb08b2-one real-type)))
   (pb08b2-logarithm
    real-type (pb08b2-real-natural real-type n))))

;; The source limit is kept in its original existential epsilon-tail form.

(defun-sk pb08b2-limit-tail-p
    (real-type family epsilon start)
  (forall (n)
    (implies
     (and
      (natp n)
      (natp start)
      (<= start n))
     (pb08b2-less
      real-type
      (pb08b2-absolute-value
       real-type
       (pb08b2-subtract
        real-type
        (pb08b2-normalized-value
         real-type family n)
        (pb08b2-negate
         real-type (pb08b2-one real-type))))
      epsilon))))

(defun-sk pb08b2-limit-start-exists-p
    (real-type family epsilon)
  (exists (start)
    (and
     (natp start)
     (pb08b2-limit-tail-p
      real-type family epsilon start))))

(defun-sk pb08b2-converges-to-minus-one-p
    (real-type family)
  (forall (epsilon)
    (implies
     (pb08b2-positive-real-p real-type epsilon)
     (pb08b2-limit-start-exists-p
      real-type family epsilon))))

(defun-sk putnambench-putnam-2008-b2-statement ()
  (forall (real-type family)
    (implies
     (and
      (pb08b2-real-structure-p real-type)
      (pb08b2-logarithm-laws-p real-type)
      (pb08b2-real-family-p real-type family)
      (pb08b2-family-base-p real-type family)
      (pb08b2-family-recurrence-p real-type family))
     (pb08b2-converges-to-minus-one-p
      real-type family))))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
