title: putnam_2008_b2
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2008_b2
-- (putnambench__agda__putnam_2008_b2): the factorial-scaled values at one of
-- the iterated integrals of the natural logarithm converge, after division by
-- log n, to negative one. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module Putnam2008B2 where

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; _*_)

infix 4 _!=_ _<=N_
infixr 3 _and_
infixr 2 _or_

data Bottom : Set where

Not : Set -> Set
Not A =
  A -> Bottom

_!=_ : {A : Set} -> A -> A -> Set
x != y =
  Not (x == y)

record _and_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data _or_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  left  : A -> A or B
  right : B -> A or B

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

data _<=N_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set where
  zero<=N   : {n : Nat} -> zero <=N n
  suc<=sucN : {m n : Nat} -> m <=N n -> suc m <=N suc n

record CompleteOrderedRealField (R : Set) : Set1 where
  field
    zeroR oneR : R
    add multiply : R -> R -> R
    negate inverse absoluteValue : R -> R
    lessOrEqual : R -> R -> Set
    fromNat : Nat -> R

    one-not-zero :
      oneR != zeroR

    add-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> add x y == add y x
    add-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      add (add x y) z == add x (add y z)
    add-zero :
      (x : R) -> add x zeroR == x
    add-inverse :
      (x : R) -> add x (negate x) == zeroR

    multiply-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> multiply x y == multiply y x
    multiply-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply (multiply x y) z ==
      multiply x (multiply y z)
    multiply-one :
      (x : R) -> multiply x oneR == x
    multiply-zero :
      (x : R) -> multiply x zeroR == zeroR
    distribute :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply x (add y z) ==
      add (multiply x y) (multiply x z)
    inverse-zero :
      inverse zeroR == zeroR
    multiply-inverse :
      (x : R) ->
      x != zeroR ->
      multiply x (inverse x) == oneR

    order-reflexive :
      (x : R) -> lessOrEqual x x
    order-transitive :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y z ->
      lessOrEqual x z
    order-antisymmetric :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y x ->
      x == y
    order-total :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y or lessOrEqual y x
    add-order :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual (add z x) (add z y)
    multiply-nonnegative :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR x ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR y ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR (multiply x y)
    zero-less-than-one :
      lessOrEqual zeroR oneR and zeroR != oneR

    absolute-nonnegative :
      (x : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR (absoluteValue x)
    absolute-of-nonnegative :
      (x : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR x ->
      absoluteValue x == x
    absolute-of-nonpositive :
      (x : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x zeroR ->
      absoluteValue x == negate x

    fromNat-zero :
      fromNat zero == zeroR
    fromNat-successor :
      (n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (suc n) == add (fromNat n) oneR
    fromNat-addition :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m + n) == add (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-multiplication :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m * n) == multiply (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-injective :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat m == fromNat n ->
      m == n

    archimedean :
      (x : R) ->
      Exists Nat
        (\ n ->
          lessOrEqual x (fromNat n))
    least-upper-bound :
      (P : R -> Set) ->
      Exists R P ->
      Exists R
        (\ upper ->
          (x : R) ->
          P x ->
          lessOrEqual x upper) ->
      Exists R
        (\ supremum ->
          ((x : R) ->
            P x ->
            lessOrEqual x supremum)
          and
          ((upper : R) ->
            ((x : R) ->
              P x ->
              lessOrEqual x upper) ->
            lessOrEqual supremum upper))

open CompleteOrderedRealField

subtract :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
subtract reals x y =
  add reals x (negate reals y)

divide :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
divide reals x y =
  multiply reals x (inverse reals y)

StrictLess :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
StrictLess reals x y =
  lessOrEqual reals x y and x != y

factorial : Nat -> Nat
factorial zero =
  suc zero
factorial (suc n) =
  suc n * factorial n

sumFirst :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Nat ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  R
sumFirst reals zero terms =
  zeroR reals
sumFirst reals (suc n) terms =
  add reals
    (sumFirst reals n terms)
    (terms n)

naturalPower :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  Nat ->
  R
naturalPower reals x zero =
  oneR reals
naturalPower reals x (suc n) =
  multiply reals
    (naturalPower reals x n)
    x

SequentialLimit :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  R ->
  Set
SequentialLimit {R} reals sequence limit =
  (epsilon : R) ->
  StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) epsilon ->
  Exists Nat
    (\ cutoff ->
      (n : Nat) ->
      cutoff <=N n ->
      StrictLess reals
        (absoluteValue reals
          (subtract reals (sequence n) limit))
        epsilon)

exponentialPartialSum :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  Nat ->
  R
exponentialPartialSum reals x terms =
  sumFirst reals terms
    (\ n ->
      divide reals
        (naturalPower reals x n)
        (fromNat reals (factorial n)))

ExponentialValue :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
ExponentialValue reals x value =
  SequentialLimit reals
    (exponentialPartialSum reals x)
    value

rightRiemannSum :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  (R -> R) ->
  Nat ->
  R
rightRiemannSum reals lower upper function pieces =
  let
    step =
      divide reals
        (subtract reals upper lower)
        (fromNat reals pieces)
  in
  sumFirst reals pieces
    (\ i ->
      multiply reals
        (function
          (add reals lower
            (multiply reals
              (fromNat reals (suc i))
              step)))
        step)

IntervalIntegralValue :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  (R -> R) ->
  R ->
  Set
IntervalIntegralValue reals lower upper function value =
  SequentialLimit reals
    (\ n ->
      rightRiemannSum reals
        lower
        upper
        function
        (suc n))
    value

record StandardRealAnalysis
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) :
  Set1 where

  field
    exponential naturalLogarithm : R -> R

    exponential-is-power-series :
      (x : R) ->
      ExponentialValue reals x (exponential x)

    exponential-positive :
      (x : R) ->
      StrictLess reals
        (zeroR reals)
        (exponential x)

    logarithm-of-exponential :
      (x : R) ->
      naturalLogarithm (exponential x) == x

    exponential-of-logarithm :
      (x : R) ->
      StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) x ->
      exponential (naturalLogarithm x) == x

open StandardRealAnalysis

putnamSequence :
  {R : Set} ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) ->
  StandardRealAnalysis reals ->
  (Nat -> R -> R) ->
  Nat ->
  R
putnamSequence reals analysis F n =
  divide reals
    (multiply reals
      (fromNat reals (factorial n))
      (F n (oneR reals)))
    (naturalLogarithm analysis (fromNat reals n))

putnam-2008-b2 : Set1
putnam-2008-b2 =
  (R : Set) ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) ->
  (analysis : StandardRealAnalysis reals) ->
  (F : Nat -> R -> R) ->
  ((x : R) ->
    F zero x == naturalLogarithm analysis x) ->
  ((n : Nat) ->
    (x : R) ->
    StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) x ->
    IntervalIntegralValue reals
      (zeroR reals)
      x
      (F n)
      (F (suc n) x)) ->
  SequentialLimit reals
    (putnamSequence reals analysis F)
    (negate reals (oneR reals))

(*
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2008_b2:
  the limit of the factorial-normalized iterated integrals of the real
  logarithm at one is -1. This file contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open arithmeticTheory pred_setTheory realTheory transcTheory;
open real_topologyTheory integrationTheory;

val putnam_2008_b2 =
  ``!F : num -> real -> real.
      (!x : real. F 0 x = ln x) /\
      (!n : num. !x : real.
         0 < x
         ==>
         F (n + 1) x =
           integration$integral (interval [0, x]) (F n))
      ==>
      (((\n : num.
           &(FACT n) * F n 1 / ln (&n)) -->
        (~1 : real))
       sequentially)``;

content:
$(
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact
  putnam_2008_b2: the factorial-scaled values at one of the recursively
  integrated natural-logarithm functions converge, after division by the
  logarithm of the index, to negative one. This file contains no proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  f ranges over all NN0-indexed families of total real-valued functions.
  Its zeroth member is the real part of the complex logarithm away from zero
  and is explicitly zero at zero, matching Lean's total Real.log. For every
  nonnegative integer n and positive real x, its next member at x is the real
  Lebesgue integral of the nth member over the open interval (0,x). Endpoint
  inclusion does not affect this integral.

  The conclusion expands convergence over natural indices into its
  epsilon-threshold form. Set.mm's ! and S. binder are factorial and real
  Lebesgue integration, respectively; Re(log x) is the total real natural
  logarithm. The final declaration is the single unproved $a corpus
  statement; this database contains no $p proof declaration.
$)

${
  $d e f m n t x $.

  putnambench-putnam-2008-b2 $a |- A. f e.
    ( ( RR ^m RR ) ^m NN0 )
    (
      (
        A. x e. RR
          ( ( f ` 0 ) ` x )
          =
          if ( x = 0 , 0 , ( Re ` ( log ` x ) ) )
        /\
        A. n e. NN0 A. x e. RR
          (
            0 < x
            ->
            ( ( f ` ( n + 1 ) ) ` x )
            =
            S. ( 0 (,) x )
              ( ( f ` n ) ` t )
              _d t
          )
      )
      ->
      A. e e. RR
        (
          0 < e
          ->
          E. m e. NN0
            A. n e. NN0
              (
                m <_ n
                ->
                (
                  abs
                  `
                  (
                    (
                      (
                        ( ! ` n )
                        x.
                        ( ( f ` n ) ` 1 )
                      )
                      /
                      ( Re ` ( log ` n ) )
                    )
                    -
                    ( -u 1 )
                  )
                )
                < e
              )
        )
    )
  $.
$}

title: putnam_2008_b2
content:
% Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2008_b2:
% the factorial-normalized values at one of the iterated integrals of the
% real logarithm converge to -1. This file contains no proof.

putnam_2008_b2: THEORY
BEGIN
  real_function: TYPE = [real -> real]
  real_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> real]
  real_function_family: TYPE = [nat -> real_function]

  safe_div(numerator, denominator: real): real =
    IF denominator = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      numerator / denominator
    ENDIF

  nat_factorial(index: nat): RECURSIVE nat =
    IF index = 0 THEN
      1
    ELSE
      index * nat_factorial(index - 1)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE index

  converges_to(sequence: real_sequence, value: real): bool =
    FORALL (epsilon_value: posreal):
      EXISTS (cutoff: nat):
        FORALL (index: nat):
          cutoff <= index IMPLIES
            abs(sequence(index) - value) < epsilon_value

  exponential_partial(x: real, count: nat): RECURSIVE real =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      LET index: nat = count - 1 IN
        exponential_partial(x, count - 1)
          + safe_div(
              x ^ index,
              nat_factorial(index) :: real)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  real_exponential(x: real): real =
    epsilon(
      LAMBDA (value: real):
        converges_to(
          LAMBDA (count: nat):
            exponential_partial(x, count),
          value))

  real_logarithm(x: real): real =
    IF x > 0 THEN
      epsilon(
        LAMBDA (value: real):
          real_exponential(value) = x)
    ELSIF x < 0 THEN
      epsilon(
        LAMBDA (value: real):
          real_exponential(value) = -x)
    ELSE
      0
    ENDIF

  valid_tagged_partition(
      left, right: real,
      points, tags: real_sequence,
      count: nat): bool =
    count > 0
      AND points(0) = left
      AND points(count) = right
      AND FORALL (index: nat):
        index < count IMPLIES
          (points(index) < points(index + 1)
            AND points(index) <= tags(index)
            AND tags(index) <= points(index + 1))

  mesh_less_than(
      points: real_sequence,
      count: nat,
      bound: real): bool =
    FORALL (index: nat):
      index < count IMPLIES
        points(index + 1) - points(index) < bound

  riemann_sum(
      function_value: real_function,
      points, tags: real_sequence,
      count: nat): RECURSIVE real =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      riemann_sum(
        function_value, points, tags, count - 1)
        + function_value(tags(count - 1))
            * (points(count) - points(count - 1))
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  has_proper_interval_integral(
      function_value: real_function,
      left, right, integral_value: real): bool =
    left < right
      AND FORALL (epsilon_value: posreal):
        EXISTS (mesh_bound: posreal):
          FORALL
              (points, tags: real_sequence),
              (count: nat):
            (valid_tagged_partition(
                left, right, points, tags, count)
              AND mesh_less_than(
                points, count, mesh_bound))
            IMPLIES
              abs(
                riemann_sum(
                  function_value, points, tags, count)
                  - integral_value)
                < epsilon_value

  proper_interval_integral(
      function_value: real_function,
      left, right: real): real =
    IF left = right THEN
      0
    ELSIF left < right THEN
      IF EXISTS (integral_value: real):
          has_proper_interval_integral(
            function_value, left, right, integral_value)
      THEN
        epsilon(
          LAMBDA (integral_value: real):
            has_proper_interval_integral(
              function_value, left, right, integral_value))
      ELSE
        0
      ENDIF
    ELSE
      IF EXISTS (integral_value: real):
          has_proper_interval_integral(
            function_value, right, left, integral_value)
      THEN
        -epsilon(
          LAMBDA (integral_value: real):
            has_proper_interval_integral(
              function_value, right, left, integral_value))
      ELSE
        0
      ENDIF
    ENDIF

  has_integral_from_zero(
      function_value: real_function,
      right, integral_value: real): bool =
    right > 0
      AND FORALL (epsilon_value: posreal):
        EXISTS (delta: posreal):
          FORALL (left: real):
            (0 < left AND left < right AND left < delta)
              IMPLIES
                abs(
                  proper_interval_integral(
                    function_value, left, right)
                    - integral_value)
                  < epsilon_value

  integral_from_zero(
      function_value: real_function,
      right: real): real =
    IF right > 0
        AND EXISTS (integral_value: real):
          has_integral_from_zero(
            function_value, right, integral_value)
    THEN
      epsilon(
        LAMBDA (integral_value: real):
          has_integral_from_zero(
            function_value, right, integral_value))
    ELSE
      0
    ENDIF

  satisfies_initial_condition(F: real_function_family): bool =
    FORALL (x: real):
      F(0)(x) = real_logarithm(x)

  satisfies_integral_recurrence(F: real_function_family): bool =
    FORALL (n: nat), (x: real):
      x > 0 IMPLIES
        F(n + 1)(x) = integral_from_zero(F(n), x)

  normalized_values(F: real_function_family): real_sequence =
    LAMBDA (n: nat):
      safe_div(
        (nat_factorial(n) :: real) * F(n)(1),
        real_logarithm(n :: real))

  putnam_2008_b2: bool =
    FORALL (F: real_function_family):
      (satisfies_initial_condition(F)
        AND satisfies_integral_recurrence(F))
      IMPLIES converges_to(normalized_values(F), -1)
END putnam_2008_b2

(* Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2008_b3:
   the largest radius of a circle contained in a four-dimensional hypercube
   of side length one. This file contains no proof. *)

From Stdlib Require Import Reals.

Open Scope R_scope.

Record putnam_2008_b3_point4 := {
  putnam_2008_b3_x0 : R;
  putnam_2008_b3_x1 : R;
  putnam_2008_b3_x2 : R;
  putnam_2008_b3_x3 : R
}.

Definition putnam_2008_b3_zero : putnam_2008_b3_point4 :=
  {| putnam_2008_b3_x0 := 0;
     putnam_2008_b3_x1 := 0;
     putnam_2008_b3_x2 := 0;
     putnam_2008_b3_x3 := 0 |}.

Definition putnam_2008_b3_add
    (p q : putnam_2008_b3_point4) : putnam_2008_b3_point4 :=
  {| putnam_2008_b3_x0 := putnam_2008_b3_x0 p + putnam_2008_b3_x0 q;
     putnam_2008_b3_x1 := putnam_2008_b3_x1 p + putnam_2008_b3_x1 q;
     putnam_2008_b3_x2 := putnam_2008_b3_x2 p + putnam_2008_b3_x2 q;
     putnam_2008_b3_x3 := putnam_2008_b3_x3 p + putnam_2008_b3_x3 q |}.

Definition putnam_2008_b3_scale
    (a : R) (p : putnam_2008_b3_point4) : putnam_2008_b3_point4 :=
  {| putnam_2008_b3_x0 := a * putnam_2008_b3_x0 p;
     putnam_2008_b3_x1 := a * putnam_2008_b3_x1 p;
     putnam_2008_b3_x2 := a * putnam_2008_b3_x2 p;
     putnam_2008_b3_x3 := a * putnam_2008_b3_x3 p |}.

Definition putnam_2008_b3_norm
    (p : putnam_2008_b3_point4) : R :=
  sqrt
    (putnam_2008_b3_x0 p ^ 2 +
     putnam_2008_b3_x1 p ^ 2 +
     putnam_2008_b3_x2 p ^ 2 +
     putnam_2008_b3_x3 p ^ 2).

Definition putnam_2008_b3_in_hypercube
    (p : putnam_2008_b3_point4) : Prop :=
  Rabs (putnam_2008_b3_x0 p) <= 1 / 2 /\
  Rabs (putnam_2008_b3_x1 p) <= 1 / 2 /\
  Rabs (putnam_2008_b3_x2 p) <= 1 / 2 /\
  Rabs (putnam_2008_b3_x3 p) <= 1 / 2.

Definition putnam_2008_b3_linearly_independent
    (u v : putnam_2008_b3_point4) : Prop :=
  forall a b : R,
    putnam_2008_b3_add
      (putnam_2008_b3_scale a u)
      (putnam_2008_b3_scale b v) =
    putnam_2008_b3_zero ->
    a = 0 /\ b = 0.

Definition putnam_2008_b3_offset
    (u v : putnam_2008_b3_point4) (s t : R) :
    putnam_2008_b3_point4 :=
  putnam_2008_b3_add
    (putnam_2008_b3_scale s u)
    (putnam_2008_b3_scale t v).

Definition putnam_2008_b3_contains_circle (r : R) : Prop :=
  exists center u v : putnam_2008_b3_point4,
    putnam_2008_b3_linearly_independent u v /\
    forall s t : R,
      putnam_2008_b3_norm (putnam_2008_b3_offset u v s t) = r ->
      putnam_2008_b3_in_hypercube
        (putnam_2008_b3_add center
          (putnam_2008_b3_offset u v s t)).

Definition putnam_2008_b3_solution : R := sqrt 2 / 2.

Theorem putnam_2008_b3 :
  putnam_2008_b3_contains_circle putnam_2008_b3_solution /\
  forall r : R,
    putnam_2008_b3_solution < r ->
    ~ putnam_2008_b3_contains_circle r.
Admitted.

     (&0,(&0,(&0,&0))) in
   let add4 =
     \(x:real#(real#(real#real))) (y:real#(real#(real#real))).
       (FST x + FST y,
        (FST (SND x) + FST (SND y),
         (FST (SND (SND x)) + FST (SND (SND y)),
          SND (SND (SND x)) + SND (SND (SND y))))) in
   let smul4 =
     \(a:real) (x:real#(real#(real#real))).
       (a * FST x,
        (a * FST (SND x),
         (a * FST (SND (SND x)),
          a * SND (SND (SND x))))) in
   let norm4 =
     \(x:real#(real#(real#real))).
       sqrt
         ((FST x) pow 2 +
          (FST (SND x)) pow 2 +
          (FST (SND (SND x))) pow 2 +
          (SND (SND (SND x))) pow 2) in

     {x:real#(real#(real#real)) |

        abs (FST (SND x)) <= &1 / &2 /\
        abs (FST (SND (SND x))) <= &1 / &2 /\
        abs (SND (SND (SND x))) <= &1 / &2} in
   let contains =

;; Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench artifact putnam_2008_b3:
;; the largest radius of a circle contained in the side-one four-dimensional
;; hypercube is sqrt(2)/2. This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))

;; The result is finite-dimensional ordered-field geometry. Conservative
;; generic symbols describe the scalar field and its nonnegative square-root
;; operation without restricting them to APPLY$ function objects.
(defstub p08b3-scalar-p (x) t)
(defstub p08b3-add-op (x y) t)
(defstub p08b3-multiply-op (x y) t)
(defstub p08b3-negate-op (x) t)
(defstub p08b3-inverse-op (x) t)
(defstub p08b3-less-op (x y) t)
(defstub p08b3-square-root-op (x) t)

(defun p08b3-add (x y)
  (p08b3-add-op x y))

(defun p08b3-mul (x y)
  (p08b3-multiply-op x y))

(defun p08b3-neg (x)
  (p08b3-negate-op x))

(defun p08b3-inv (x)
  (p08b3-inverse-op x))

(defun p08b3-less (x y)
  (if (p08b3-less-op x y) t nil))

(defun p08b3-sqrt (x)
  (p08b3-square-root-op x))

(defun p08b3-sub (x y)
  (p08b3-add x (p08b3-neg y)))

(defun p08b3-leq (x y)
  (not (p08b3-less y x)))

(defun p08b3-square (x)
  (p08b3-mul x x))

(defun p08b3-two (one)
  (p08b3-add one one))

(defun p08b3-half (one)
  (p08b3-inv (p08b3-two one)))

(defun-sk p08b3-field-laws-p (zero one)
  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (p08b3-scalar-p x)
      (p08b3-scalar-p y)
      (p08b3-scalar-p z))
     (and
      (p08b3-scalar-p (p08b3-add x y))
      (p08b3-scalar-p (p08b3-mul x y))
      (p08b3-scalar-p (p08b3-neg x))
      (implies
       (not (equal x zero))
       (p08b3-scalar-p (p08b3-inv x)))
      (equal (p08b3-add (p08b3-add x y) z)
             (p08b3-add x (p08b3-add y z)))
      (equal (p08b3-add x y)
             (p08b3-add y x))
      (equal (p08b3-add x zero) x)
      (equal (p08b3-add x (p08b3-neg x)) zero)
      (equal (p08b3-mul (p08b3-mul x y) z)
             (p08b3-mul x (p08b3-mul y z)))
      (equal (p08b3-mul x y)
             (p08b3-mul y x))
      (equal (p08b3-mul x one) x)
      (implies
       (not (equal x zero))
       (equal (p08b3-mul x (p08b3-inv x)) one))
      (equal
       (p08b3-mul x (p08b3-add y z))
       (p08b3-add (p08b3-mul x y)
                  (p08b3-mul x z)))))))

(defun-sk p08b3-order-laws-p (zero)
  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (p08b3-scalar-p x)
      (p08b3-scalar-p y)
      (p08b3-scalar-p z))
     (and
      (not (p08b3-less x x))
      (or
       (equal x y)
       (p08b3-less x y)
       (p08b3-less y x))
      (implies
       (and
        (p08b3-less x y)
        (p08b3-less y z))
       (p08b3-less x z))
      (implies
       (p08b3-less x y)
       (p08b3-less
        (p08b3-add x z)
        (p08b3-add y z)))
      (implies
       (and
        (p08b3-less zero x)
        (p08b3-less zero y))
       (p08b3-less zero (p08b3-mul x y)))))))

(defun-sk p08b3-square-root-laws-p (zero)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (p08b3-scalar-p x)
     (and
      (p08b3-scalar-p (p08b3-sqrt x))
      (implies
       (p08b3-leq zero x)
       (and
        (p08b3-leq zero (p08b3-sqrt x))
        (equal (p08b3-square (p08b3-sqrt x))
               x)))))))

(defun p08b3-scalar-context-p (zero one)
  (and
   (p08b3-scalar-p zero)
   (p08b3-scalar-p one)
   (not (equal zero one))
   (p08b3-less zero one)
   (p08b3-field-laws-p zero one)
   (p08b3-order-laws-p zero)
   (p08b3-square-root-laws-p zero)))

(defun p08b3-vector-p (vector)
  (and
   (true-listp vector)
   (equal (len vector) 4)
   (p08b3-scalar-p (nth 0 vector))
   (p08b3-scalar-p (nth 1 vector))
   (p08b3-scalar-p (nth 2 vector))
   (p08b3-scalar-p (nth 3 vector))))

(defun p08b3-zero-vector (zero)
  (list zero zero zero zero))

(defun p08b3-vector-add (left right)
  (list
   (p08b3-add (nth 0 left) (nth 0 right))
   (p08b3-add (nth 1 left) (nth 1 right))
   (p08b3-add (nth 2 left) (nth 2 right))
   (p08b3-add (nth 3 left) (nth 3 right))))

(defun p08b3-scalar-multiply (scalar vector)
  (list
   (p08b3-mul scalar (nth 0 vector))
   (p08b3-mul scalar (nth 1 vector))
   (p08b3-mul scalar (nth 2 vector))
   (p08b3-mul scalar (nth 3 vector))))

(defun p08b3-vector-norm-squared (vector)
  (p08b3-add
   (p08b3-square (nth 0 vector))
   (p08b3-add
    (p08b3-square (nth 1 vector))
    (p08b3-add
     (p08b3-square (nth 2 vector))
     (p08b3-square (nth 3 vector))))))

(defun p08b3-abs (x zero)
  (if (p08b3-less x zero)
      (p08b3-neg x)
    x))

(defun p08b3-hypercube-point-p (point zero one)
  (let ((half (p08b3-half one)))
    (and
     (p08b3-vector-p point)
     (p08b3-leq (p08b3-abs (nth 0 point) zero) half)
     (p08b3-leq (p08b3-abs (nth 1 point) zero) half)
     (p08b3-leq (p08b3-abs (nth 2 point) zero) half)
     (p08b3-leq (p08b3-abs (nth 3 point) zero) half))))

(defun p08b3-plane-displacement
    (alpha direction-p beta direction-q)
  (p08b3-vector-add
   (p08b3-scalar-multiply alpha direction-p)
   (p08b3-scalar-multiply beta direction-q)))

(defun-sk p08b3-linearly-independent-p
    (direction-p direction-q zero)
  (forall (alpha beta)
    (implies
     (and
      (p08b3-scalar-p alpha)
      (p08b3-scalar-p beta)
      (equal
       (p08b3-plane-displacement
        alpha direction-p beta direction-q)
       (p08b3-zero-vector zero)))
     (and
      (equal alpha zero)
      (equal beta zero)))))

;; A negative-radius sphere is empty. For a nonnegative radius, the squared
;; norm equation is exactly the circle in the represented affine plane.
(defun p08b3-on-circle-p
    (radius displacement zero)
  (and
   (p08b3-leq zero radius)
   (equal
    (p08b3-vector-norm-squared displacement)
    (p08b3-square radius))))

(defun-sk p08b3-circle-contained-p
    (radius center direction-p direction-q zero one)
  (forall (alpha beta)
    (implies
     (and
      (p08b3-scalar-p alpha)
      (p08b3-scalar-p beta)
      (p08b3-on-circle-p
       radius
       (p08b3-plane-displacement
        alpha direction-p beta direction-q)
       zero))
     (p08b3-hypercube-point-p
      (p08b3-vector-add
       center
       (p08b3-plane-displacement
        alpha direction-p beta direction-q))
      zero one))))

(defun-sk p08b3-contains-radius-p (radius zero one)
  (exists (center direction-p direction-q)
    (and
     (p08b3-scalar-p radius)
     (p08b3-vector-p center)
     (p08b3-vector-p direction-p)
     (p08b3-vector-p direction-q)
     (p08b3-linearly-independent-p
      direction-p direction-q zero)
     (p08b3-circle-contained-p
      radius center direction-p direction-q zero one))))

(defun-sk p08b3-is-upper-bound-p (radius zero one)
  (forall (other-radius)
    (implies
     (and
      (p08b3-scalar-p other-radius)
      (p08b3-contains-radius-p other-radius zero one))
     (p08b3-leq other-radius radius))))

(defun putnambench-putnam-2008-b3-statement
    (zero one)
  (implies
   (p08b3-scalar-context-p zero one)
   (let* ((sqrt-two (p08b3-sqrt (p08b3-two one)))
          (radius (p08b3-mul sqrt-two (p08b3-half one))))
     (and
      (p08b3-contains-radius-p radius zero one)
      (p08b3-is-upper-bound-p radius zero one)))))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

content:
-- Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2008_b3
-- (putnambench__agda__putnam_2008_b3): the largest radius of a circle
-- contained in a four-dimensional hypercube of side length one is
-- sqrt(2) / 2. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module Putnam2008B3 where

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; _*_)

infix 4 _!=_
infixr 3 _and_
infixr 2 _or_

data Bottom : Set where

Not : Set -> Set
Not A =
  A -> Bottom

_!=_ : {A : Set} -> A -> A -> Set
x != y =
  Not (x == y)

record _and_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data _or_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  left  : A -> A or B
  right : B -> A or B

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

data Fin : Nat -> Set where
  fzero : {n : Nat} -> Fin (suc n)
  fsuc  : {n : Nat} -> Fin n -> Fin (suc n)

record CompleteOrderedRealField (R : Set) : Set1 where
  field
    zeroR oneR : R
    add multiply : R -> R -> R
    negate inverse squareRoot : R -> R
    lessOrEqual : R -> R -> Set
    fromNat : Nat -> R

    one-not-zero :
      oneR != zeroR

    add-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> add x y == add y x
    add-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      add (add x y) z == add x (add y z)
    add-zero :
      (x : R) -> add x zeroR == x
    add-inverse :
      (x : R) -> add x (negate x) == zeroR

    multiply-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> multiply x y == multiply y x
    multiply-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply (multiply x y) z ==
      multiply x (multiply y z)
    multiply-one :
      (x : R) -> multiply x oneR == x
    multiply-zero :
      (x : R) -> multiply x zeroR == zeroR
    distribute :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply x (add y z) ==
      add (multiply x y) (multiply x z)
    inverse-zero :
      inverse zeroR == zeroR
    multiply-inverse :
      (x : R) ->
      x != zeroR ->
      multiply x (inverse x) == oneR

    order-reflexive :
      (x : R) -> lessOrEqual x x
    order-transitive :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y z ->
      lessOrEqual x z
    order-antisymmetric :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y x ->
      x == y
    order-total :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y or lessOrEqual y x
    add-order :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual (add z x) (add z y)
    multiply-nonnegative :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR x ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR y ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR (multiply x y)
    zero-less-than-one :
      lessOrEqual zeroR oneR and zeroR != oneR

    fromNat-zero :
      fromNat zero == zeroR
    fromNat-successor :
      (n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (suc n) == add (fromNat n) oneR
    fromNat-addition :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m + n) == add (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-multiplication :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m * n) == multiply (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-injective :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat m == fromNat n ->
      m == n

    archimedean :
      (x : R) ->
      Exists Nat
        (\ n ->
          lessOrEqual x (fromNat n))
    least-upper-bound :
      (P : R -> Set) ->
      Exists R P ->
      Exists R
        (\ upper ->
          (x : R) ->
          P x ->
          lessOrEqual x upper) ->
      Exists R
        (\ supremum ->
          ((x : R) ->
            P x ->
            lessOrEqual x supremum)
          and
          ((upper : R) ->
            ((x : R) ->
              P x ->
              lessOrEqual x upper) ->
            lessOrEqual supremum upper))

    square-root-nonnegative :
      (x : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR (squareRoot x)
    square-root-square :
      (x : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR x ->
      multiply (squareRoot x) (squareRoot x) == x
    square-root-nonpositive :
      (x : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x zeroR ->
      squareRoot x == zeroR
    square-root-unique :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR y ->
      multiply y y == x ->
      y == squareRoot x

open CompleteOrderedRealField

divide :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
divide reals x y =
  multiply reals x (inverse reals y)

square :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R
square reals x =
  multiply reals x x

absoluteValue :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R
absoluteValue reals x =
  squareRoot reals (square reals x)

StrictLess :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
StrictLess reals x y =
  lessOrEqual reals x y and x != y

twoN : Nat
twoN =
  suc (suc zero)

fourN : Nat
fourN =
  suc (suc (suc (suc zero)))

two :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R
two reals =
  fromNat reals twoN

half :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R
half reals =
  divide reals (oneR reals) (two reals)

Vector : Set -> Nat -> Set
Vector R n =
  Fin n -> R

VectorEqual :
  {R : Set} ->
  {n : Nat} ->
  Vector R n ->
  Vector R n ->
  Set
VectorEqual {n = n} x y =
  (i : Fin n) ->
  x i == y i

zeroVector :
  {R : Set} ->
  {n : Nat} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Vector R n
zeroVector reals _ =
  zeroR reals

addVector :
  {R : Set} ->
  {n : Nat} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Vector R n ->
  Vector R n ->
  Vector R n
addVector reals x y i =
  add reals (x i) (y i)

scaleVector :
  {R : Set} ->
  {n : Nat} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  Vector R n ->
  Vector R n
scaleVector reals scalar x i =
  multiply reals scalar (x i)

sumFin :
  {R : Set} ->
  {n : Nat} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (Fin n -> R) ->
  R
sumFin {n = zero} reals values =
  zeroR reals
sumFin {n = suc n} reals values =
  add reals
    (values fzero)
    (sumFin reals
      (\ i ->
        values (fsuc i)))

squaredNorm :
  {R : Set} ->
  {n : Nat} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Vector R n ->
  R
squaredNorm reals x =
  sumFin reals
    (\ i ->
      square reals (x i))

norm :
  {R : Set} ->
  {n : Nat} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Vector R n ->
  R
norm reals x =
  squareRoot reals (squaredNorm reals x)

LinearCombination :
  {R : Set} ->
  {n : Nat} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  Vector R n ->
  R ->
  Vector R n ->
  Vector R n
LinearCombination reals s p t q =
  addVector reals
    (scaleVector reals s p)
    (scaleVector reals t q)

LinearlyIndependentPair :
  {R : Set} ->
  {n : Nat} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Vector R n ->
  Vector R n ->
  Set
LinearlyIndependentPair {R} {n} reals p q =
  (s t : R) ->
  VectorEqual
    (LinearCombination reals s p t q)
    (zeroVector reals) ->
  s == zeroR reals and t == zeroR reals

InUnitHypercube4 :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Vector R fourN ->
  Set
InUnitHypercube4 reals x =
  (i : Fin fourN) ->
  lessOrEqual reals
    (absoluteValue reals (x i))
    (half reals)

ContainsCircle :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  Set
ContainsCircle {R} reals radius =
  Exists (Vector R fourN)
    (\ center ->
      Exists (Vector R fourN)
        (\ p ->
          Exists (Vector R fourN)
            (\ q ->
              LinearlyIndependentPair reals p q
              and
              ((s t : R) ->
                norm reals
                  (LinearCombination reals s p t q)
                  == radius ->
                InUnitHypercube4 reals
                  (addVector reals
                    center
                    (LinearCombination reals s p t q))))))

putnam-2008-b3-solution :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R
putnam-2008-b3-solution reals =
  divide reals
    (squareRoot reals (two reals))
    (two reals)

putnam-2008-b3 : Set1
putnam-2008-b3 =
  (R : Set) ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) ->
  ContainsCircle reals (putnam-2008-b3-solution reals)
  and
  ((radius : R) ->
    StrictLess reals
      (putnam-2008-b3-solution reals)
      radius ->
    Not (ContainsCircle reals radius))

(*
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2008_b3:
  the greatest radius of a circle contained in the four-dimensional unit
  hypercube is sqrt 2 / 2. This file contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open pairTheory realTheory transcTheory;

val putnam_2008_b3 =
  ``let zero4 = ((0, 0), (0, 0)) : (real # real) # (real # real)
    in
    let add4 =
      \P Q : (real # real) # (real # real).
        ((FST (FST P) + FST (FST Q),
          SND (FST P) + SND (FST Q)),
         (FST (SND P) + FST (SND Q),
          SND (SND P) + SND (SND Q)))
    in
    let smul4 =
      \c : real.
      \P : (real # real) # (real # real).
        ((c * FST (FST P), c * SND (FST P)),
         (c * FST (SND P), c * SND (SND P)))
    in
    let norm4 =
      \P : (real # real) # (real # real).
        sqrt
          (FST (FST P) pow 2 +
           SND (FST P) pow 2 +
           FST (SND P) pow 2 +
           SND (SND P) pow 2)
    in
    let in_hypercube =
      \P : (real # real) # (real # real).
        abs (FST (FST P)) <= 1 / 2 /\
        abs (SND (FST P)) <= 1 / 2 /\
        abs (FST (SND P)) <= 1 / 2 /\
        abs (SND (SND P)) <= 1 / 2
    in
    let independent =
      \P Q : (real # real) # (real # real).
        !a b : real.
          add4 (smul4 a P) (smul4 b Q) = zero4
          ==>
          a = 0 /\ b = 0
    in
    let contains_circle =
      \r : real.
        ?C P Q : (real # real) # (real # real).
          independent P Q /\
          !s t : real.
            norm4 (add4 (smul4 s P) (smul4 t Q)) = r
            ==>
            in_hypercube
              (add4 C (add4 (smul4 s P) (smul4 t Q)))
    in
    let solution = sqrt 2 / 2
    in
      contains_circle solution /\
      !r : real. solution < r ==> ~contains_circle r``;

$(
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact
  putnam_2008_b3: the largest radius of a circle contained in the
  four-dimensional hypercube of side length one is sqrt(2) / 2. This file
  contains no proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  The four-element interval 0 ..^ 4 is the source carrier Fin 4, so P08B3R4 is the
  full real Euclidean four-space. P08B3Cube is the coordinate hypercube
  [-1/2,1/2]^4. P08B3Combo(s,P,t,Q) is the vector sP+tQ,
  P08B3Affine(C,s,P,t,Q) is C+sP+tQ, and P08B3Norm is the ordinary
  Euclidean norm.

  P08B3Independent(P,Q) states genuine real linear independence. Thus the
  internally existential C, P, and Q in P08B3Contains(r) determine an
  arbitrary two-dimensional affine plane, and its universal clause says
  that every point in that plane at distance r from C belongs to the
  hypercube. This is exactly the source sphere-intersection containment
  predicate, with the plane represented by a basis.

  The final conjunction expands IsGreatest: sqrt(2)/2 is an attained
  contained-circle radius, and every contained-circle radius is at most
  sqrt(2)/2. All auxiliary $a declarations are syntax or explicit
  definitions; this database contains no $p proof declaration.
$)

$c P08B3R4 P08B3Cube P08B3Combo P08B3Affine P08B3Norm
   P08B3Independent P08B3Contains P08B3Solution $.

p08b3-space-syntax $a class P08B3R4 $.
p08b3-cube-syntax $a class P08B3Cube $.
p08b3-combo-syntax $a class ( P08B3Combo s P t Q ) $.
p08b3-affine-syntax $a class ( P08B3Affine C s P t Q ) $.
p08b3-norm-syntax $a class ( P08B3Norm V ) $.
p08b3-independent-syntax $a wff ( P08B3Independent P Q ) $.
p08b3-contains-syntax $a wff ( P08B3Contains r ) $.
p08b3-solution-syntax $a class P08B3Solution $.

p08b3-space-definition $a |- P08B3R4 = ( RR ^m ( 0 ..^ 4 ) ) $.

${
  $d i x $.

  p08b3-cube-definition $a |- P08B3Cube = {
    x e. P08B3R4 |
      A. i e. ( 0 ..^ 4 )
        ( abs ` ( x ` i ) ) <_ ( 1 / 2 )
  } $.
$}

${
  $d P Q i s t $.

  p08b3-combo-definition $a |- (
    P08B3Combo s P t Q
  ) = (
    i e. ( 0 ..^ 4 ) |->
      (
        ( s x. ( P ` i ) )
        +
        ( t x. ( Q ` i ) )
      )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d C P Q i s t $.

  p08b3-affine-definition $a |- (
    P08B3Affine C s P t Q
  ) = (
    i e. ( 0 ..^ 4 ) |->
      (
        ( C ` i )
        +
        (
          ( s x. ( P ` i ) )
          +
          ( t x. ( Q ` i ) )
        )
      )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d V i $.

  p08b3-norm-definition $a |- (
    P08B3Norm V
  ) = (
    sqrt
    `
    (
      sum_ i e. ( 0 ..^ 4 )
        ( ( V ` i ) ^ 2 )
    )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d P Q a b i $.

  p08b3-independent-definition $a |- (
    ( P08B3Independent P Q )
    <->
    A. a e. RR A. b e. RR
      (
        (
          A. i e. ( 0 ..^ 4 )
            (
              (
                ( a x. ( P ` i ) )
                +
                ( b x. ( Q ` i ) )
              )
              =
              0
            )
        )
        ->
        ( a = 0 /\ b = 0 )
      )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d c p q r s t $.

  p08b3-contains-definition $a |- (
    ( P08B3Contains r )
    <->
    E. c e. P08B3R4 E. p e. P08B3R4 E. q e. P08B3R4
      (
        ( P08B3Independent p q )
        /\
        A. s e. RR A. t e. RR
          (
            ( P08B3Norm ( P08B3Combo s p t q ) ) = r
            ->
            ( P08B3Affine c s p t q ) e. P08B3Cube
          )
      )
  ) $.
$}

p08b3-solution-definition $a |-
  P08B3Solution = ( ( sqrt ` 2 ) / 2 ) $.

putnambench-putnam-2008-b3 $a |- (
  ( P08B3Contains P08B3Solution )
  /\
  A. r e. RR
    (
      ( P08B3Contains r )
      ->
      r <_ P08B3Solution
    )
) $.

% Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2008_b3:
% the largest radius of a circle contained in a four-dimensional unit
% hypercube is sqrt(2) / 2. This file contains no proof.

putnam_2008_b3: THEORY
BEGIN
  point: TYPE =
    [# c0: real, c1: real, c2: real, c3: real #]

  zero_point: point =
    (# c0 := 0, c1 := 0, c2 := 0, c3 := 0 #)

  point_add(p, q: point): point =
    (# c0 := c0(p) + c0(q),
       c1 := c1(p) + c1(q),
       c2 := c2(p) + c2(q),
       c3 := c3(p) + c3(q) #)

  scalar_multiply(a: real, p: point): point =
    (# c0 := a * c0(p),
       c1 := a * c1(p),
       c2 := a * c2(p),
       c3 := a * c3(p) #)

  plane_offset(s, t: real, u, v: point): point =
    point_add(scalar_multiply(s, u), scalar_multiply(t, v))

  squared_norm(p: point): real =
    c0(p) ^ 2 + c1(p) ^ 2 + c2(p) ^ 2 + c3(p) ^ 2

  in_hypercube(p: point): bool =
    abs(c0(p)) <= 1 / 2
      AND abs(c1(p)) <= 1 / 2
      AND abs(c2(p)) <= 1 / 2
      AND abs(c3(p)) <= 1 / 2

  linearly_independent(u, v: point): bool =
    FORALL (s, t: real):
      plane_offset(s, t, u, v) = zero_point
        IMPLIES s = 0 AND t = 0

  circle_contained(radius: real): bool =
    radius >= 0
      AND EXISTS (center, u, v: point):
        linearly_independent(u, v)
          AND FORALL (s, t: real):
            squared_norm(plane_offset(s, t, u, v)) = radius ^ 2
              IMPLIES
                in_hypercube(
                  point_add(
                    center,
                    plane_offset(s, t, u, v)))

  nonnegative_sqrt(x: real): real =
    IF x >= 0 THEN
      epsilon(
        LAMBDA (root: real):
          root >= 0 AND root ^ 2 = x)
    ELSE
      0
    ENDIF

  putnam_2008_b3_solution: real =
    nonnegative_sqrt(2) / 2

  putnam_2008_b3: bool =
    circle_contained(putnam_2008_b3_solution)
      AND FORALL (radius: real):
        circle_contained(radius)
          IMPLIES radius <= putnam_2008_b3_solution
END putnam_2008_b3

import Mathlib

open Filter Topology Set Nat

/--
Let $p$ be a prime number. Let $h(x)$ be a polynomial with integer coefficients such that $h(0), h(1), \dots, h(p^2-1)$ are distinct modulo $p^2$. Show that $h(0), h(1), \dots, h(p^3-1)$ are distinct modulo $p^3$.
-/
theorem putnam_2008_b4
(p : ℕ)
(hp : Nat.Prime p)
(h : Polynomial ℤ)
(hh : ∀ i j : Finset.range (p ^ 2), h.eval i ≡ h.eval j [ZMOD p ^ 2] → i = j)
: (∀ i j : Finset.range (p ^ 3), h.eval i ≡ h.eval j [ZMOD p ^ 3] → i = j) :=
sorry

title: putnam_2008_b4
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2008_b4:
;; for a prime p and an integer-coefficient polynomial h, pairwise distinct
;; values at 0,...,p^2-1 modulo p^2 imply pairwise distinct values at
;; 0,...,p^3-1 modulo p^3. This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

;; Coefficients are stored in ascending degree order. Every integer polynomial
;; has such a finite list representation, and trailing zero coefficients do
;; not affect evaluation.
(defun putnam-2008-b4-integer-listp (coefficients)
  (if (consp coefficients)
      (and
       (integerp (car coefficients))
       (putnam-2008-b4-integer-listp (cdr coefficients)))
    (equal coefficients nil)))

(defun putnam-2008-b4-polynomial-evaluate (coefficients x)
  (if (consp coefficients)
      (+ (car coefficients)
         (* x
            (putnam-2008-b4-polynomial-evaluate
             (cdr coefficients) x)))
    0))

(defun putnam-2008-b4-no-divisor-through-p (p candidate)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix candidate)))
  (if (or (not (natp candidate))
          (<= candidate 1))
      t
    (and
     (not (equal (mod p candidate) 0))
     (putnam-2008-b4-no-divisor-through-p
      p (- candidate 1)))))

(defun putnam-2008-b4-prime-p (p)
  (and
   (natp p)
   (< 1 p)
   (putnam-2008-b4-no-divisor-through-p
    p (- p 1))))

;; Equality of remainders modulo the positive modulus is exactly integer
;; congruence. This checks the value at I against the values at
;; 0,...,COUNT-1.
(defun putnam-2008-b4-distinct-from-lower-p
    (coefficients modulus i count)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix count)))
  (if (zp count)
      t
    (let ((j (- count 1)))
      (and
       (not
        (equal
         (mod
          (putnam-2008-b4-polynomial-evaluate
           coefficients i)
          modulus)
         (mod
          (putnam-2008-b4-polynomial-evaluate
           coefficients j)
          modulus)))
       (putnam-2008-b4-distinct-from-lower-p
        coefficients modulus i j)))))

;; COUNT represents the source range 0,...,COUNT-1. Comparing each final
;; index with every smaller one is equivalent to pairwise injectivity on that
;; range.
(defun putnam-2008-b4-distinct-mod-p
    (coefficients modulus count)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix count)))

title: putnam_2008_b4
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2008_b4
-- (putnambench__agda__putnam_2008_b4): an integer polynomial that is
-- injective modulo p^2 on the first p^2 natural inputs is injective modulo
-- p^3 on the first p^3 natural inputs, for prime p. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module Main where

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Int using (Int; pos; negsuc)
open import Agda.Builtin.List using (List; []; _∷_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; _*_)

infix 4 _<_ _divides_
infixr 2 _or_

data _<_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set where
  zero<successor :
    {n : Nat} ->
    zero < suc n
  successor<successor :
    {m n : Nat} ->
    m < n ->
    suc m < suc n

record _divides_ (divisor dividend : Nat) : Set where
  constructor division
  field
    quotient : Nat
    division-equation :
      dividend == divisor * quotient

data _or_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  left  : A -> A or B
  right : B -> A or B

one : Nat
one =
  suc zero

two : Nat
two =
  suc one

three : Nat
three =
  suc two

record Prime (p : Nat) : Set where
  constructor prime
  field
    at-least-two :
      one < p
    only-trivial-divisors :
      (d : Nat) ->
      d divides p ->
      (d == one) or (d == p)

power : Nat -> Nat -> Nat
power base zero =
  one
power base (suc exponent) =
  base * power base exponent

negativeNat : Nat -> Int
negativeNat zero =
  pos zero
negativeNat (suc n) =
  negsuc n

differenceNat : Nat -> Nat -> Int
differenceNat zero zero =
  pos zero
differenceNat (suc m) zero =
  pos (suc m)
differenceNat zero (suc n) =
  negsuc n
differenceNat (suc m) (suc n) =
  differenceNat m n

addInt : Int -> Int -> Int
addInt (pos m) (pos n) =
  pos (m + n)
addInt (pos m) (negsuc n) =
  differenceNat m (suc n)
addInt (negsuc m) (pos n) =
  differenceNat n (suc m)
addInt (negsuc m) (negsuc n) =
  negsuc (suc (m + n))

multiplyInt : Int -> Int -> Int
multiplyInt (pos m) (pos n) =
  pos (m * n)
multiplyInt (pos m) (negsuc n) =
  negativeNat (m * suc n)
multiplyInt (negsuc m) (pos n) =
  negativeNat (suc m * n)
multiplyInt (negsuc m) (negsuc n) =
  pos (suc m * suc n)

Polynomial : Set
Polynomial =
  List Int

evaluate : Polynomial -> Int -> Int
evaluate [] x =
  pos zero
evaluate (coefficient ∷ coefficients) x =
  addInt
    coefficient
    (multiplyInt x (evaluate coefficients x))

record IntModEq
  (modulus : Nat)
  (left-value right-value : Int) : Set where
  constructor congruence
  field
    multiple : Int
    congruence-equation :
      left-value ==
      addInt right-value (multiplyInt (pos modulus) multiple)

InjectiveModuloOnInitialSegment :
  Nat ->
  Nat ->
  Polynomial ->
  Set
InjectiveModuloOnInitialSegment modulus bound polynomial =
  (i j : Nat) ->
  i < bound ->
  j < bound ->
  IntModEq modulus
    (evaluate polynomial (pos i))
    (evaluate polynomial (pos j)) ->
  i == j

putnam-2008-b4 : Set
putnam-2008-b4 =
  (p : Nat) ->
  Prime p ->
  (h : Polynomial) ->
  InjectiveModuloOnInitialSegment
    (power p two)
    (power p two)
    h ->
  InjectiveModuloOnInitialSegment
    (power p three)
    (power p three)
    h

(*
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2008_b4:
  an integer polynomial injective modulo the square of a prime on the
  corresponding residue representatives remains injective modulo the cube.
  This file contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open arithmeticTheory integerTheory listTheory;

val putnam_2008_b4 =
  ``let eval_int_poly =
      \coeffs : int list.
      \x : int.
        FOLDR (\c acc. c + x * acc) 0 coeffs
    in
      !p : num. !h : int list.
        prime p /\
        (!i j : num.
           i < p EXP 2 /\
           j < p EXP 2 /\
           (int_of_num (p EXP 2)) int_divides
             (eval_int_poly h (int_of_num i) -
              eval_int_poly h (int_of_num j))
           ==>
           i = j)
        ==>
        !i j : num.
          i < p EXP 3 /\
          j < p EXP 3 /\
          (int_of_num (p EXP 3)) int_divides
            (eval_int_poly h (int_of_num i) -
             eval_int_poly h (int_of_num j))
          ==>
          i = j``;

$(
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact
  putnam_2008_b4: an integer polynomial injective on residue
  representatives modulo the square of a prime is injective on residue
  representatives modulo its cube. This file contains no proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  Base ` ( Poly1 ` ZZring ) is SetMM's ring of arbitrary finite-support
  univariate polynomials over the integers, and eval1 evaluates such a
  polynomial at an integer. For a natural prime p, ( 0 ..^ ( p ^ k ) ) is
  exactly the set of representatives from 0 through p^k - 1. Equality of
  the displayed remainders is integer congruence modulo p^k.

  The final declaration is the single unproved $a corpus statement; this
  database contains no $p proof declaration.
$)

${
  $d h i j p $.

  putnambench-putnam-2008-b4 $a |-
    A. p e. Prime
      A. h e. ( Base ` ( Poly1 ` ZZring ) )
        (
          A. i e. ( 0 ..^ ( p ^ 2 ) )
            A. j e. ( 0 ..^ ( p ^ 2 ) )
              (
                (
                  (
                    ( ( ( eval1 ` ZZring ) ` h ) ` i )
                    mod
                    ( p ^ 2 )
                  )
                  =
                  (
                    ( ( ( eval1 ` ZZring ) ` h ) ` j )
                    mod
                    ( p ^ 2 )
                  )
                )
                ->
                i = j
              )
          ->
          A. i e. ( 0 ..^ ( p ^ 3 ) )
            A. j e. ( 0 ..^ ( p ^ 3 ) )
              (
                (
                  (
                    ( ( ( eval1 ` ZZring ) ` h ) ` i )
                    mod
                    ( p ^ 3 )
                  )
                  =
                  (
                    ( ( ( eval1 ` ZZring ) ` h ) ` j )
                    mod
                    ( p ^ 3 )
                  )
                )
                ->
                i = j
              )
        )
  $.
$}

% Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2008_b4:
% an integer polynomial injective modulo p^2 on a complete residue range for
% a prime p is injective modulo p^3 on the corresponding range. This file contains no proof.

putnam_2008_b4: THEORY
BEGIN
  integer_polynomial: TYPE = list[int]

  nat_divides(divisor: posnat, value: nat): bool =
    EXISTS (quotient: nat):
      value = divisor * quotient

  prime_nat(value: nat): bool =
    value >= 2
      AND FORALL (divisor: posnat):
        nat_divides(divisor, value)
          IMPLIES divisor = 1 OR divisor = value

  polynomial_value(
      polynomial: integer_polynomial,
      x: int): RECURSIVE int =
    CASES polynomial OF
      null: 0,
      cons(coefficient, tail):
        coefficient + x * polynomial_value(tail, x)
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE polynomial BY <<

  int_congruent(left, right: int, modulus: nat): bool =
    EXISTS (offset: int):
      left - right = (modulus :: int) * offset

  injective_modulo(
      polynomial: integer_polynomial,
      modulus: nat): bool =
    FORALL (i, j: nat):
      (i < modulus
        AND j < modulus
        AND int_congruent(
          polynomial_value(polynomial, i :: int),
          polynomial_value(polynomial, j :: int),
          modulus))
      IMPLIES i = j

  putnam_2008_b4: bool =
    FORALL (p: nat), (h: integer_polynomial):
      (prime_nat(p)
        AND injective_modulo(h, p ^ 2))
      IMPLIES injective_modulo(h, p ^ 3)
END putnam_2008_b4
