(*
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2008_b5:
  continuously differentiable real functions preserving the reduced
  denominator of every rational input are exactly integer translates of the
  identity or its negation. This file contains no proof.
*)

let analysis_output = open_out "/dev/null";;
let analysis_formatter = Format.formatter_of_out_channel analysis_output;;
let analysis_loaded =
  Toploop.use_file analysis_formatter "Library/analysis.ml";;
Format.pp_print_flush analysis_formatter ();;
close_out analysis_output;;
if not analysis_loaded then failwith "failed to load Library/analysis.ml";;

let statement =
  `let rat_value =
     \q:int#num. real_of_int (FST q) / &(SND q) in
   let reduced =
     \q:int#num.
       0 < SND q /\ coprime (num_of_int (abs (FST q)),SND q) in
   let continuous =
     \(g:real->real).
       !x e:real.
         &0 < e
         ==> ?delta:real.
               &0 < delta /\
               !y:real.
                 abs (y - x) < delta ==> abs (g y - g x) < e in
   let continuously_differentiable =
     \(f:real->real).
       ?f':real->real.
         (!x:real. (f diffl (f' x)) x) /\
         continuous f' in
   let preserves_reduced_denominator =
     \(f:real->real).
       !q:int#num.
         reduced q
         ==> ?p:int#num.
               reduced p /\
               SND p = SND q /\
               f (rat_value q) = rat_value p in
   let solution =
     \(f:real->real).
       ?n:int.
         f = (\x:real. x + real_of_int n) \/
         f = (\x:real. --x + real_of_int n) in
   !f:real->real.
     (continuously_differentiable f /\
      preserves_reduced_denominator f
      <=> solution f)`;;

title: putnam_2008_b5
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2008_b5:
;; continuously differentiable real functions preserving reduced rational
;; denominators are exactly integer translates of x or -x. This file contains
;; no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))

;; Reals are rational regular Cauchy names, and real functions are extensional
;; function objects on those names. Positive rational tolerances and moduli are
;; cofinal in the positive reals. For a continuous function, convergence of
;; difference quotients along nonzero rational increments is equivalent to the
;; full real derivative limit. Thus the internal continuous derivative witness
;; below is equivalent to continuous differentiability on all of R.

(defun putnam-2008-b5-quoted (object)
  (list 'quote object))

(defun putnam-2008-b5-term-list (terms)
  (if (consp terms)
      (list 'cons
            (car terms)
            (putnam-2008-b5-term-list (cdr terms)))
    nil))

(defun putnam-2008-b5-apply-term (function arguments)
  (list 'apply$
        (putnam-2008-b5-quoted function)
        (putnam-2008-b5-term-list arguments)))

(defun putnam-2008-b5-apply-object-term
    (function-term arguments)
  (list 'apply$
        function-term
        (putnam-2008-b5-term-list arguments)))

(defun putnam-2008-b5-and-terms (terms)
  (if (consp terms)
      (list 'if
            (car terms)
            (putnam-2008-b5-and-terms (cdr terms))
            (putnam-2008-b5-quoted nil))
    (putnam-2008-b5-quoted t)))

(defun putnam-2008-b5-implies-term (hypothesis conclusion)
  (list 'if
        hypothesis
        conclusion
        (putnam-2008-b5-quoted t)))

(defun putnam-2008-b5-not-term (term)
  (list 'if
        term
        (putnam-2008-b5-quoted nil)
        (putnam-2008-b5-quoted t)))

(defun putnam-2008-b5-add-term (left right)
  (list 'binary-+ left right))

(defun putnam-2008-b5-negate-term (value)
  (list 'unary-- value))

(defun putnam-2008-b5-subtract-term (left right)
  (putnam-2008-b5-add-term
   left
   (putnam-2008-b5-negate-term right)))

(defun putnam-2008-b5-multiply-term (left right)
  (list 'binary-* left right))

(defun putnam-2008-b5-divide-term (numerator denominator)
  (putnam-2008-b5-multiply-term
   numerator
   (list 'unary-/ denominator)))

(defun putnam-2008-b5-absolute-term (value)
  (list 'if
        (list '< value (putnam-2008-b5-quoted 0))
        (putnam-2008-b5-negate-term value)
        value))

(defun putnam-2008-b5-less-equal-term (left right)
  (list 'if
        (list '< right left)
        (putnam-2008-b5-quoted nil)
        (putnam-2008-b5-quoted t)))

(defun putnam-2008-b5-positive-rational-term (value)
  (putnam-2008-b5-and-terms
   (list
    (list 'rationalp value)
    (list '< (putnam-2008-b5-quoted 0) value))))

(defun putnam-2008-b5-true-function (formals)
  (list 'lambda
        formals
        (putnam-2008-b5-quoted t)))

(defun putnam-2008-b5-real-value-term (name precision)
  (putnam-2008-b5-apply-term name (list precision)))

(defun putnam-2008-b5-object-real-value-term
    (name-term precision)
  (putnam-2008-b5-apply-object-term
   name-term
   (list precision)))

(defun putnam-2008-b5-real-cauchy-function (name)
  (let* ((left
          (putnam-2008-b5-real-value-term name 'epsilon))
         (right
          (putnam-2008-b5-real-value-term name 'eta))
         (distance
          (putnam-2008-b5-absolute-term
           (putnam-2008-b5-subtract-term left right))))
    (list
     'lambda
     '(epsilon eta)
     (putnam-2008-b5-implies-term
      (putnam-2008-b5-and-terms
       (list
        (putnam-2008-b5-positive-rational-term 'epsilon)
        (putnam-2008-b5-positive-rational-term 'eta)))
      (putnam-2008-b5-and-terms
       (list
        (list 'rationalp left)
        (list 'rationalp right)
        (putnam-2008-b5-less-equal-term
         distance
         (putnam-2008-b5-add-term
          'epsilon 'eta))))))))

(defun putnam-2008-b5-real-name-p (name)
  (and
   (tamep-functionp name)
   (fn-equal
    (putnam-2008-b5-real-cauchy-function name)
    (putnam-2008-b5-true-function
     '(epsilon eta)))))

;; Sampling both names at eta/4 makes the displayed universal inequality
;; equivalent to distance between their represented limits being at most BOUND.

(defun putnam-2008-b5-real-distance-function
    (left-name right-name bound)
  (let* ((precision
          (putnam-2008-b5-multiply-term
           (putnam-2008-b5-quoted 1/4)
           'eta))
         (left
          (putnam-2008-b5-real-value-term
           left-name precision))
         (right
          (putnam-2008-b5-real-value-term
           right-name precision))
         (distance
          (putnam-2008-b5-absolute-term
           (putnam-2008-b5-subtract-term left right))))
    (list
     'lambda
     '(eta)
     (putnam-2008-b5-implies-term
      (putnam-2008-b5-positive-rational-term 'eta)
      (putnam-2008-b5-and-terms
       (list
        (list 'rationalp left)
        (list 'rationalp right)
        (putnam-2008-b5-less-equal-term
         distance
         (putnam-2008-b5-add-term
          (putnam-2008-b5-quoted bound)
          'eta))))))))

(defun putnam-2008-b5-real-distance-at-most-p
    (left-name right-name bound)
  (and
   (rationalp bound)
   (putnam-2008-b5-real-name-p left-name)
   (putnam-2008-b5-real-name-p right-name)
   (fn-equal
    (putnam-2008-b5-real-distance-function
     left-name right-name bound)
    (putnam-2008-b5-true-function '(eta)))))

(defun putnam-2008-b5-real-equal-p
    (left-name right-name)
  (putnam-2008-b5-real-distance-at-most-p
   left-name right-name 0))

(defun putnam-2008-b5-unary-output-function
    (function)
  (let ((output
         (putnam-2008-b5-apply-term function (list 'x))))
    (list
     'lambda
     '(x)
     (putnam-2008-b5-implies-term
      (list 'putnam-2008-b5-real-name-p 'x)
      (list 'putnam-2008-b5-real-name-p output)))))

(defun putnam-2008-b5-unary-extensional-function
    (function)
  (let ((left-output
         (putnam-2008-b5-apply-term
          function (list 'x-left)))
        (right-output
         (putnam-2008-b5-apply-term
          function (list 'x-right))))
    (list
     'lambda
     '(x-left x-right)
     (putnam-2008-b5-implies-term
      (list 'putnam-2008-b5-real-equal-p
            'x-left 'x-right)
      (list 'putnam-2008-b5-real-equal-p
            left-output right-output)))))

(defun putnam-2008-b5-real-function-p (function)
  (and
   (tamep-functionp function)
   (fn-equal
    (putnam-2008-b5-unary-output-function function)
    (putnam-2008-b5-true-function '(x)))
   (fn-equal
    (putnam-2008-b5-unary-extensional-function function)
    (putnam-2008-b5-true-function
     '(x-left x-right)))))

(defun putnam-2008-b5-rational-name (value)
  (list 'lambda
        '(precision)
        (putnam-2008-b5-quoted value)))

(defun putnam-2008-b5-rational-shift-name (name shift)
  (let ((value
         (putnam-2008-b5-object-real-value-term
          (putnam-2008-b5-quoted name)
          (putnam-2008-b5-multiply-term
           (putnam-2008-b5-quoted 1/2)
           'precision))))
    (list
     'lambda
     '(precision)
     (putnam-2008-b5-add-term
      value
      (putnam-2008-b5-quoted shift)))))

(defun putnam-2008-b5-affine-name (name integer slope)
  (let* ((value
          (putnam-2008-b5-object-real-value-term
           (putnam-2008-b5-quoted name)
           (putnam-2008-b5-multiply-term
            (putnam-2008-b5-quoted 1/2)
            'precision)))
         (signed-value
          (if (equal slope -1)
              (putnam-2008-b5-negate-term value)
            value)))
    (list
     'lambda
     '(precision)
     (putnam-2008-b5-add-term
      signed-value
      (putnam-2008-b5-quoted integer)))))

;; Continuity is stated with closed rational balls and non-strict output
;; bounds. Rescaling epsilon and delta gives the usual open-ball definition in
;; both directions.

(defun putnam-2008-b5-continuous-at-delta-function
    (function x epsilon delta)
  (let ((at-x
         (putnam-2008-b5-apply-term
          function
          (list (putnam-2008-b5-quoted x))))
        (at-y
         (putnam-2008-b5-apply-term
          function
          (list 'y))))
    (list
     'lambda
     '(y)
     (putnam-2008-b5-implies-term
      (putnam-2008-b5-and-terms
       (list
        (list 'putnam-2008-b5-real-name-p 'y)
        (list 'putnam-2008-b5-real-distance-at-most-p
              (putnam-2008-b5-quoted x)
              'y
              (putnam-2008-b5-quoted delta))))
      (list 'putnam-2008-b5-real-distance-at-most-p
            at-x
            at-y
            (putnam-2008-b5-quoted epsilon))))))

(defun putnam-2008-b5-continuous-at-delta-p
    (function x epsilon delta)
  (and
   (rationalp delta)
   (< 0 delta)
   (fn-equal
    (putnam-2008-b5-continuous-at-delta-function
     function x epsilon delta)
    (putnam-2008-b5-true-function '(y)))))

(defun putnam-2008-b5-continuity-delta-failure-function
    (function x epsilon)
  (list
   'lambda
   '(delta)
   (list
    'if
    (list 'putnam-2008-b5-continuous-at-delta-p
          (putnam-2008-b5-quoted function)
          (putnam-2008-b5-quoted x)
          (putnam-2008-b5-quoted epsilon)
          'delta)
    (putnam-2008-b5-quoted nil)
    (putnam-2008-b5-quoted t))))

(defun putnam-2008-b5-continuity-delta-exists-p
    (function x epsilon)
  (not
   (fn-equal
    (putnam-2008-b5-continuity-delta-failure-function
     function x epsilon)
    (putnam-2008-b5-true-function '(delta)))))

(defun putnam-2008-b5-continuity-function (function)
  (list
   'lambda
   '(x epsilon)
   (putnam-2008-b5-implies-term
    (putnam-2008-b5-and-terms
     (list
      (list 'putnam-2008-b5-real-name-p 'x)
      (putnam-2008-b5-positive-rational-term 'epsilon)))
    (list 'putnam-2008-b5-continuity-delta-exists-p
          (putnam-2008-b5-quoted function)
          'x
          'epsilon))))

(defun putnam-2008-b5-continuous-p (function)
  (and
   (putnam-2008-b5-real-function-p function)
   (fn-equal
    (putnam-2008-b5-continuity-function function)
    (putnam-2008-b5-true-function
     '(x epsilon)))))

;; At precision eta, each numerator value below is sampled at
;; |h|*eta/4. Hence the quotient is a regular Cauchy name for
;; (f(x+h)-f(x))/h whenever h is a nonzero rational.

(defun putnam-2008-b5-difference-quotient-name
    (function x h)
  (let* ((shifted-x
          (putnam-2008-b5-rational-shift-name x h))
         (at-shifted-x
          (putnam-2008-b5-apply-term
           function
           (list (putnam-2008-b5-quoted shifted-x))))
         (at-x
          (putnam-2008-b5-apply-term
           function
           (list (putnam-2008-b5-quoted x))))
         (sample-precision
          (putnam-2008-b5-multiply-term
           (putnam-2008-b5-quoted (/ (abs h) 4))
           'eta))
         (shifted-value
          (putnam-2008-b5-object-real-value-term
           at-shifted-x sample-precision))
         (value
          (putnam-2008-b5-object-real-value-term
           at-x sample-precision)))
    (list
     'lambda
     '(eta)
     (putnam-2008-b5-divide-term
      (putnam-2008-b5-subtract-term
       shifted-value value)
      (putnam-2008-b5-quoted h)))))

(defun putnam-2008-b5-derivative-at-delta-function
    (function derivative x epsilon delta)
  (let ((quotient
         (list 'putnam-2008-b5-difference-quotient-name
               (putnam-2008-b5-quoted function)
               (putnam-2008-b5-quoted x)
               'h))
        (derivative-at-x
         (putnam-2008-b5-apply-term
          derivative
          (list (putnam-2008-b5-quoted x)))))
    (list
     'lambda
     '(h)
     (putnam-2008-b5-implies-term
      (putnam-2008-b5-and-terms
       (list
        (list 'rationalp 'h)
        (putnam-2008-b5-not-term
         (list 'equal 'h (putnam-2008-b5-quoted 0)))
        (putnam-2008-b5-less-equal-term
         (putnam-2008-b5-absolute-term 'h)
         (putnam-2008-b5-quoted delta))))
      (list 'putnam-2008-b5-real-distance-at-most-p
            quotient
            derivative-at-x
            (putnam-2008-b5-quoted epsilon))))))

(defun putnam-2008-b5-derivative-at-delta-p
    (function derivative x epsilon delta)
  (and
   (rationalp delta)
   (< 0 delta)
   (fn-equal
    (putnam-2008-b5-derivative-at-delta-function
     function derivative x epsilon delta)
    (putnam-2008-b5-true-function '(h)))))

(defun putnam-2008-b5-derivative-delta-failure-function
    (function derivative x epsilon)
  (list
   'lambda
   '(delta)
   (list
    'if
    (list 'putnam-2008-b5-derivative-at-delta-p
          (putnam-2008-b5-quoted function)
          (putnam-2008-b5-quoted derivative)
          (putnam-2008-b5-quoted x)
          (putnam-2008-b5-quoted epsilon)
          'delta)
    (putnam-2008-b5-quoted nil)
    (putnam-2008-b5-quoted t))))

(defun putnam-2008-b5-derivative-delta-exists-p
    (function derivative x epsilon)
  (not
   (fn-equal
    (putnam-2008-b5-derivative-delta-failure-function
     function derivative x epsilon)
    (putnam-2008-b5-true-function '(delta)))))

(defun putnam-2008-b5-derivative-function
    (function derivative)
  (list
   'lambda
   '(x epsilon)
   (putnam-2008-b5-implies-term
    (putnam-2008-b5-and-terms
     (list
      (list 'putnam-2008-b5-real-name-p 'x)
      (putnam-2008-b5-positive-rational-term 'epsilon)))
    (list 'putnam-2008-b5-derivative-delta-exists-p
          (putnam-2008-b5-quoted function)
          (putnam-2008-b5-quoted derivative)
          'x
          'epsilon))))

(defun putnam-2008-b5-derivative-relation-p
    (function derivative)
  (and
   (putnam-2008-b5-real-function-p function)
   (putnam-2008-b5-real-function-p derivative)
   (fn-equal
    (putnam-2008-b5-derivative-function
     function derivative)
    (putnam-2008-b5-true-function
     '(x epsilon)))))

(defun putnam-2008-b5-c1-witness-p
    (derivative function)
  (and
   (putnam-2008-b5-continuous-p function)
   (putnam-2008-b5-continuous-p derivative)
   (putnam-2008-b5-derivative-relation-p
    function derivative)))

(defun putnam-2008-b5-c1-witness-failure-function
    (function)
  (list
   'lambda
   '(derivative)
   (list
    'if
    (list 'putnam-2008-b5-c1-witness-p
          'derivative
          (putnam-2008-b5-quoted function))
    (putnam-2008-b5-quoted nil)
    (putnam-2008-b5-quoted t))))

(defun putnam-2008-b5-continuously-differentiable-p
    (function)
  (not
   (fn-equal
    (putnam-2008-b5-c1-witness-failure-function
     function)
    (putnam-2008-b5-true-function
     '(derivative)))))

;; The rational witness p is internal, and ACL2's DENOMINATOR is the positive
;; denominator of a reduced exact rational.

(defun putnam-2008-b5-same-denominator-witness-p
    (p function q)
  (and
   (rationalp p)
   (equal (denominator p)
          (denominator q))
   (putnam-2008-b5-real-equal-p
    (apply$ function
            (list
             (putnam-2008-b5-rational-name q)))
    (putnam-2008-b5-rational-name p))))

(defun putnam-2008-b5-rational-witness-failure-function
    (function q)
  (list
   'lambda
   '(p)
   (list
    'if
    (list 'putnam-2008-b5-same-denominator-witness-p
          'p
          (putnam-2008-b5-quoted function)
          (putnam-2008-b5-quoted q))
    (putnam-2008-b5-quoted nil)
    (putnam-2008-b5-quoted t))))

(defun putnam-2008-b5-rational-witness-exists-p
    (function q)
  (not
   (fn-equal
    (putnam-2008-b5-rational-witness-failure-function
     function q)
    (putnam-2008-b5-true-function '(p)))))

(defun putnam-2008-b5-denominator-property-function
    (function)
  (list
   'lambda
   '(q)
   (putnam-2008-b5-implies-term
    (list 'rationalp 'q)
    (list 'putnam-2008-b5-rational-witness-exists-p
          (putnam-2008-b5-quoted function)
          'q))))

(defun putnam-2008-b5-denominator-property-p
    (function)
  (and
   (putnam-2008-b5-real-function-p function)
   (fn-equal
    (putnam-2008-b5-denominator-property-function
     function)
    (putnam-2008-b5-true-function '(q)))))

;; The integer n remains existentially quantified inside each of the two
;; source solution families.

(defun putnam-2008-b5-affine-solution-function
    (function integer slope)
  (let ((actual
         (putnam-2008-b5-apply-term
          function (list 'x)))
        (expected
         (list 'putnam-2008-b5-affine-name
               'x
               (putnam-2008-b5-quoted integer)
               (putnam-2008-b5-quoted slope))))
    (list
     'lambda
     '(x)
     (putnam-2008-b5-implies-term
      (list 'putnam-2008-b5-real-name-p 'x)
      (list 'putnam-2008-b5-real-equal-p
            actual expected)))))

(defun putnam-2008-b5-affine-solution-with-integer-p
    (integer function slope)
  (and
   (integerp integer)
   (fn-equal
    (putnam-2008-b5-affine-solution-function
     function integer slope)
    (putnam-2008-b5-true-function '(x)))))

(defun putnam-2008-b5-affine-witness-failure-function
    (function slope)
  (list
   'lambda
   '(integer)
   (list
    'if
    (list 'putnam-2008-b5-affine-solution-with-integer-p
          'integer
          (putnam-2008-b5-quoted function)
          (putnam-2008-b5-quoted slope))
    (putnam-2008-b5-quoted nil)
    (putnam-2008-b5-quoted t))))

(defun putnam-2008-b5-affine-witness-exists-p
    (function slope)
  (not
   (fn-equal
    (putnam-2008-b5-affine-witness-failure-function
     function slope)
    (putnam-2008-b5-true-function '(integer)))))

(defun putnam-2008-b5-solution-p (function)
  (and
   (putnam-2008-b5-real-function-p function)
   (or
    (putnam-2008-b5-affine-witness-exists-p
     function 1)
    (putnam-2008-b5-affine-witness-exists-p
     function -1))))

(defun putnambench-putnam-2008-b5-statement (function)
  (let ((hypothesis
         (and
          (putnam-2008-b5-continuously-differentiable-p
           function)
          (putnam-2008-b5-denominator-property-p
           function)))
        (classification
         (putnam-2008-b5-solution-p function)))
    (equal
     (if hypothesis t nil)
     (if classification t nil))))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

title: putnam_2008_b5
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2008_b5
-- (putnambench__agda__putnam_2008_b5): classification of continuously
-- differentiable real functions that preserve the reduced denominator of
-- every rational input. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module Main where

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Int using (Int; pos; negsuc)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; _*_)

infix 4 _!=_
infixl 6 _+Z_
infixl 7 _*Z_
infixr 3 _and_
infixr 2 _or_

data Bottom : Set where

Not : Set -> Set
Not A =
  A -> Bottom

_!=_ : {A : Set} -> A -> A -> Set
x != y =
  Not (x == y)

record _and_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data _or_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  left  : A -> A or B
  right : B -> A or B

record Iff (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor equivalence
  field
    forward  : A -> B
    backward : B -> A

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

negativeNat : Nat -> Int
negativeNat zero =
  pos zero
negativeNat (suc n) =
  negsuc n

differenceNat : Nat -> Nat -> Int
differenceNat zero zero =
  pos zero
differenceNat (suc m) zero =
  pos (suc m)
differenceNat zero (suc n) =
  negsuc n
differenceNat (suc m) (suc n) =
  differenceNat m n

_+Z_ : Int -> Int -> Int
pos m +Z pos n =
  pos (m + n)
pos m +Z negsuc n =
  differenceNat m (suc n)
negsuc m +Z pos n =
  differenceNat n (suc m)
negsuc m +Z negsuc n =
  negsuc (suc (m + n))

_*Z_ : Int -> Int -> Int
pos m *Z pos n =
  pos (m * n)
pos m *Z negsuc n =
  negativeNat (m * suc n)
negsuc m *Z pos n =
  negativeNat (suc m * n)
negsuc m *Z negsuc n =
  pos (suc m * suc n)

record Coprime (numerator : Int) (denominator : Nat) : Set where
  constructor bezout
  field
    left-coefficient right-coefficient : Int
    combination :
      (left-coefficient *Z numerator) +Z
      (right-coefficient *Z pos denominator) ==
      pos (suc zero)

record Rational : Set where
  constructor fraction
  field
    numerator : Int
    denominator-minus-one : Nat
    reduced :
      Coprime numerator (suc denominator-minus-one)

open Rational

denominator : Rational -> Nat
denominator q =
  suc (denominator-minus-one q)

record CompleteOrderedRealField (R : Set) : Set1 where
  field
    zeroR oneR : R
    add multiply : R -> R -> R
    negate inverse : R -> R
    lessOrEqual : R -> R -> Set
    fromNat : Nat -> R

    one-not-zero :
      oneR != zeroR

    add-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> add x y == add y x
    add-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      add (add x y) z == add x (add y z)
    add-zero :
      (x : R) -> add x zeroR == x
    add-inverse :
      (x : R) -> add x (negate x) == zeroR

    multiply-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> multiply x y == multiply y x
    multiply-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply (multiply x y) z ==
      multiply x (multiply y z)
    multiply-one :
      (x : R) -> multiply x oneR == x
    multiply-zero :
      (x : R) -> multiply x zeroR == zeroR
    distribute :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply x (add y z) ==
      add (multiply x y) (multiply x z)
    inverse-zero :
      inverse zeroR == zeroR
    multiply-inverse :
      (x : R) ->
      x != zeroR ->
      multiply x (inverse x) == oneR

    order-reflexive :
      (x : R) -> lessOrEqual x x
    order-transitive :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y z ->
      lessOrEqual x z
    order-antisymmetric :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y x ->
      x == y
    order-total :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y or lessOrEqual y x
    add-order :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual (add z x) (add z y)
    multiply-nonnegative :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR x ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR y ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR (multiply x y)
    zero-less-than-one :
      lessOrEqual zeroR oneR and zeroR != oneR

    fromNat-zero :
      fromNat zero == zeroR
    fromNat-successor :
      (n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (suc n) == add (fromNat n) oneR
    fromNat-addition :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m + n) == add (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-multiplication :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m * n) == multiply (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-injective :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat m == fromNat n ->
      m == n

    archimedean :
      (x : R) ->
      Exists Nat
        (\ n ->
          lessOrEqual x (fromNat n))
    least-upper-bound :
      (P : R -> Set) ->
      Exists R P ->
      Exists R
        (\ upper ->
          (x : R) ->
          P x ->
          lessOrEqual x upper) ->
      Exists R
        (\ supremum ->
          ((x : R) ->
            P x ->
            lessOrEqual x supremum)
          and
          ((upper : R) ->
            ((x : R) ->
              P x ->
              lessOrEqual x upper) ->
            lessOrEqual supremum upper))

open CompleteOrderedRealField

fromInt :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Int ->
  R
fromInt reals (pos n) =
  fromNat reals n
fromInt reals (negsuc n) =
  negate reals (fromNat reals (suc n))

subtract :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
subtract reals x y =
  add reals x (negate reals y)

divide :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
divide reals x y =
  multiply reals x (inverse reals y)

rationalValue :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Rational ->
  R
rationalValue reals q =
  divide reals
    (fromInt reals (numerator q))
    (fromNat reals (denominator q))

StrictLess :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
StrictLess reals x y =
  lessOrEqual reals x y and x != y

CloseTo :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
CloseTo reals center radius x =
  StrictLess reals
    (subtract reals center radius)
    x
  and
  StrictLess reals
    x
    (add reals center radius)

ContinuousAt :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (R -> R) ->
  R ->
  Set
ContinuousAt {R} reals function point =
  (epsilon : R) ->
  StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) epsilon ->
  Exists R
    (\ delta ->
      StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) delta
      and
      ((x : R) ->
        CloseTo reals point delta x ->
        CloseTo reals
          (function point)
          epsilon
          (function x)))

Continuous :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (R -> R) ->
  Set
Continuous {R} reals function =
  (point : R) ->
  ContinuousAt reals function point

differenceQuotient :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (R -> R) ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
differenceQuotient reals function point x =
  divide reals
    (subtract reals (function x) (function point))
    (subtract reals x point)

DerivativeAt :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (R -> R) ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
DerivativeAt {R} reals function point derivative-value =
  (epsilon : R) ->
  StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) epsilon ->
  Exists R
    (\ delta ->
      StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) delta
      and
      ((x : R) ->
        CloseTo reals point delta x ->
        x != point ->
        CloseTo reals derivative-value epsilon
          (differenceQuotient reals function point x)))

ContinuouslyDifferentiable :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (R -> R) ->
  Set
ContinuouslyDifferentiable {R} reals function =
  Exists (R -> R)
    (\ derivative ->
      ((x : R) ->
        DerivativeAt reals function x (derivative x))
      and
      Continuous reals derivative)

PreservesReducedDenominators :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (R -> R) ->
  Set
PreservesReducedDenominators reals function =
  (q : Rational) ->
  Exists Rational
    (\ p ->
      function (rationalValue reals q) ==
        rationalValue reals p
      and
      denominator p == denominator q)

FunctionEqual :
  {A B : Set} ->
  (A -> B) ->
  (A -> B) ->
  Set
FunctionEqual {A} f g =
  (x : A) ->
  f x == g x

IsSolution :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (R -> R) ->
  Set
IsSolution {R} reals function =
  Exists Int
    (\ n ->
      FunctionEqual function
        (\ x ->
          add reals x (fromInt reals n))
      or
      FunctionEqual function
        (\ x ->
          add reals
            (negate reals x)
            (fromInt reals n)))

putnam-2008-b5 : Set1
putnam-2008-b5 =
  (R : Set) ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) ->
  (function : R -> R) ->
  Iff
    (ContinuouslyDifferentiable reals function
      and
      PreservesReducedDenominators reals function)
    (IsSolution reals function)

title: putnam_2008_b5
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2008_b5:
  classification of continuously differentiable real functions that map every
  rational to a rational with the same reduced denominator. This file contains
  no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open pred_setTheory integerTheory realTheory real_topologyTheory limTheory;
open ratTheory real_of_ratTheory;

val putnam_2008_b5 =
  ``let continuously_differentiable =
      \f : real -> real.
        (!x : real. higher_differentiable 1 f x) /\
        (\x : real. diffn 1 f x) continuous_on UNIV
    in
    let fqsat =
      \f : real -> real.
      \q : rat.
        continuously_differentiable f /\
        ?p : rat.
          real_of_rat p = f (real_of_rat q) /\
          RATD p = RATD q
    in
    let solution =
      \f : real -> real.
        ?n : int.
          f = (\x : real. x + real_of_int n) \/
          f = (\x : real. -x + real_of_int n)
    in
      !f : real -> real.
        ((!q : rat. fqsat f q) <=> solution f)``;

  putnam_2008_b5: classification of continuously differentiable real
  functions that preserve the reduced denominator of every rational input.
  This file contains no proof.

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  RR ^m RR is the class of all total real-valued functions, and membership in
  ( ( C^n ` RR ) ` 1 ) is global continuous differentiability through order
  one. The canonical function denom maps each rational to the positive
  denominator of its unique reduced fraction representation. Thus the left
  side states exactly that every rational q is mapped to a rational with the
  same reduced denominator.

  The right side inlines the source solution set: for one internally
  existential integer n, the function is either x |-> x + n everywhere or
  x |-> -x + n everywhere. The final declaration is the single unproved $a
  corpus statement; this database contains no $p proof declaration.
$)

${
  $d f n q x $.

  putnambench-putnam-2008-b5 $a |-
    A. f e. ( RR ^m RR )
      (
        (
          f e. ( ( C^n ` RR ) ` 1 )
          /\
          A. q e. QQ
            (
              ( f ` q ) e. QQ
              /\
              ( denom ` ( f ` q ) ) = ( denom ` q )
            )
        )
        <->
        E. n e. ZZ
          (
            (
              A. x e. RR
                ( f ` x ) = ( x + n )
            )
            \/
            (
              A. x e. RR
                ( f ` x ) = ( ( -u x ) + n )
            )
          )
      )
  $.
$}

title: putnam_2008_b5
content:
% Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2008_b5:
% continuously differentiable real functions preserving the reduced denominator
% of every rational are exactly integer translates of x or -x. This file contains no proof.

putnam_2008_b5: THEORY
BEGIN
  real_function: TYPE = [real -> real]

  continuous(f: real_function): bool =
    FORALL (x: real), (epsilon_value: posreal):
      EXISTS (delta: posreal):
        FORALL (y: real):
          abs(y - x) < delta IMPLIES
            abs(f(y) - f(x)) < epsilon_value

  has_derivative_at(
      f: real_function,
      derivative, x: real): bool =
    FORALL (epsilon_value: posreal):
      EXISTS (delta: posreal):
        FORALL (h: real):
          (NOT (h = 0) AND abs(h) < delta)
            IMPLIES
              abs(
                f(x + h) - f(x)
                  - derivative * h)
                < epsilon_value * abs(h)

  continuously_differentiable(f: real_function): bool =
    EXISTS (derivative: real_function):
      (FORALL (x: real):
        has_derivative_at(f, derivative(x), x))
        AND continuous(derivative)

  reduced_fraction(
      value: rat,
      numerator: int,
      denominator: posnat): bool =
    value = numerator / denominator
      AND (FORALL (divisor: posnat):
        ((EXISTS (integer_quotient: int):
            numerator = divisor * integer_quotient)
          AND (EXISTS (natural_quotient: nat):
            denominator = divisor * natural_quotient))
        IMPLIES divisor = 1)

  same_reduced_denominator(left, right: rat): bool =
    EXISTS
        (left_numerator, right_numerator: int),
        (denominator: posnat):
      reduced_fraction(left, left_numerator, denominator)
        AND reduced_fraction(right, right_numerator, denominator)

  preserves_reduced_denominators(f: real_function): bool =
    FORALL (q: rat):
      EXISTS (value: rat):
        f(q) = value
          AND same_reduced_denominator(q, value)

  putnam_2008_b5_solution(f: real_function): bool =
    EXISTS (n: int):
      f = (LAMBDA (x: real): x + n)
        OR f = (LAMBDA (x: real): -x + n)

  putnam_2008_b5: bool =
    FORALL (f: real_function):
      (continuously_differentiable(f)
        AND preserves_reduced_denominators(f))
      IFF putnam_2008_b5_solution(f)
END putnam_2008_b5

import Mathlib

open Filter Topology Set Nat

def klimited (k n : ℕ) (s : Equiv.Perm (Fin n)) := ∀ i, |((s i) : ℤ) - i| ≤ k
/--
Let $n$ and $k$ be positive integers. Say that a permutation $\sigma$ of $\{1,2,\dots,n\} is $k-limited$ if \|\sigma(i) - i\| \leq k$ for all $i$. Prove that the number of $k-limited$ permutations $\{1,2,\dots,n\}$ is odd if and only if $n \equiv 0$ or $1 (mod 2k+1)$.
-/
theorem putnam_2008_b6
(n k : ℕ)
(hnk : n > 0 ∧ k > 0)
: Odd (Set.ncard {s : Equiv.Perm (Fin n) | klimited k n s}) ↔ (n ≡ 0 [MOD 2*k+1] ∨ n ≡ 1 [MOD 2*k+1]) :=
sorry

(*
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2008_b6:
  the number of k-limited permutations of n points is odd exactly for residues
  0 and 1 modulo 2k+1. This file contains no proof.
*)

let statement =
  `!n k:num.
     0 < n /\ 0 < k
     ==>
     (ODD
        (CARD
          {s:num->num |
             BIJ s {i:num | i < n} {i:num | i < n} /\
             (!i:num. n <= i ==> s i = i) /\
             (!i:num.
                i < n

title: putnam_2008_b6
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2008_b6:
;; for positive integers n and k, the number of permutations of 0 through
;; n-1 moving every entry by at most k is odd exactly when n is congruent to
;; 0 or 1 modulo 2k+1. This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

;; The canonical duplicate-free carrier is 0,...,N-1. A permutation is its
;; image list in carrier order. Insertion at every position enumerates each
;; permutation of this carrier exactly once.
(defun putnam-2008-b6-range-from (start count)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix count)))
  (if (zp count)
      nil
    (cons start
          (putnam-2008-b6-range-from
           (+ start 1) (- count 1)))))

(defun putnam-2008-b6-prefix-each (value lists)
  (if (consp lists)
      (cons (cons value (car lists))
            (putnam-2008-b6-prefix-each value (cdr lists)))
    nil))

(defun putnam-2008-b6-insert-everywhere (value values)
  (if (consp values)
      (cons
       (cons value values)
       (putnam-2008-b6-prefix-each
        (car values)
        (putnam-2008-b6-insert-everywhere
         value (cdr values))))
    (list (list value))))

(defun putnam-2008-b6-insert-into-each
    (value permutations)
  (if (consp permutations)
      (append
       (putnam-2008-b6-insert-everywhere
        value (car permutations))
       (putnam-2008-b6-insert-into-each
        value (cdr permutations)))
    nil))

(defun putnam-2008-b6-permutations (values)
  (if (consp values)
      (putnam-2008-b6-insert-into-each
       (car values)
       (putnam-2008-b6-permutations (cdr values)))
    (list nil)))

;; Pairing the domain carrier and image list positionwise is the corresponding
;; Fin N permutation. Integer absolute value preserves the symmetric source
;; condition |sigma(i)-i| <= k.
(defun putnam-2008-b6-k-limited-p (domain image k)
  (if (consp domain)
      (and
       (consp image)
       (<= (abs (- (car image) (car domain))) k)
       (putnam-2008-b6-k-limited-p
        (cdr domain) (cdr image) k))
    (equal image nil)))

(defun putnam-2008-b6-count-k-limited
    (domain permutations k)
  (if (consp permutations)
      (+ (if (putnam-2008-b6-k-limited-p
              domain (car permutations) k)
             1
           0)
         (putnam-2008-b6-count-k-limited
          domain (cdr permutations) k))
    0))

(defun putnambench-putnam-2008-b6-statement (n k)
  (implies
   (and (posp n)
        (posp k))
   (let* ((carrier
           (putnam-2008-b6-range-from 0 n))
          (permutations
           (putnam-2008-b6-permutations carrier))
          (limited-count
           (putnam-2008-b6-count-k-limited
            carrier permutations k))
          (modulus (+ (* 2 k) 1))
          (residue (mod n modulus)))
     (iff
      (equal (mod limited-count 2) 1)
      (or (equal residue 0)
          (equal residue 1))))))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

title: putnam_2008_b6
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2008_b6:
-- the number of permutations of Fin n moving every index by at most k is odd
-- exactly when n is congruent to 0 or 1 modulo 2k+1. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module Putnam2008B6 where

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using
  (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; _-_; _*_; mod-helper)

infix 4 _<=N_
infixr 3 _and_
infixr 2 _or_
infix 1 _iff_

record _and_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data _or_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  left  : A -> A or B
  right : B -> A or B

record _iff_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor equivalence
  field
    forward  : A -> B
    backward : B -> A

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

data _<=N_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set where
  zero<=N   : {n : Nat} -> zero <=N n
  suc<=sucN : {m n : Nat} -> m <=N n -> suc m <=N suc n

data Positive : Nat -> Set where
  positive : {n : Nat} -> Positive (suc n)

data Fin : Nat -> Set where
  fzero : {n : Nat} -> Fin (suc n)
  fsuc  : {n : Nat} -> Fin n -> Fin (suc n)

toNat : {n : Nat} -> Fin n -> Nat
toNat fzero =
  zero
toNat (fsuc index) =
  suc (toNat index)

PointwiseEqual :
  {n : Nat} ->
  (Fin n -> Fin n) ->
  (Fin n -> Fin n) ->
  Set
PointwiseEqual {n} left-function right-function =
  (index : Fin n) ->
  left-function index == right-function index

Injective :
  {A B : Set} ->
  (A -> B) ->
  Set
Injective {A} function =
  (x y : A) ->
  function x == function y ->
  x == y

Surjective :
  {A B : Set} ->
  (A -> B) ->
  Set
Surjective {A} {B} function =
  (y : B) ->
  Exists A
    (\ x -> function x == y)

IsPermutation :
  {n : Nat} ->
  (Fin n -> Fin n) ->
  Set
IsPermutation permutation =
  Injective permutation
  and
  Surjective permutation

absoluteDifference : Nat -> Nat -> Nat
absoluteDifference x y =
  (x - y) + (y - x)

KLimited :
  {n : Nat} ->
  Nat ->
  (Fin n -> Fin n) ->
  Set
KLimited {n} k permutation =
  (index : Fin n) ->
  absoluteDifference
    (toNat (permutation index))
    (toNat index)
  <=N
  k

KLimitedPermutation :
  {n : Nat} ->
  Nat ->
  (Fin n -> Fin n) ->
  Set
KLimitedPermutation k permutation =
  IsPermutation permutation
  and
  KLimited k permutation

record HasCardinalityUpTo
  {A : Set}
  (_~_ : A -> A -> Set)
  (member : A -> Set)
  (cardinality : Nat) :
  Set where

  field
    enumerate :
      Fin cardinality ->
      A
    enumerated-member :
      (index : Fin cardinality) ->
      member (enumerate index)
    enumeration-complete :
      (item : A) ->
      member item ->
      Exists (Fin cardinality)
        (\ index -> item ~ enumerate index)
    enumeration-injective :
      (left-index right-index : Fin cardinality) ->
      enumerate left-index ~ enumerate right-index ->
      left-index == right-index

one : Nat
one =
  suc zero

two : Nat
two =
  suc one

record Odd (n : Nat) : Set where
  field
    half : Nat
    odd-equation : n == two * half + one

naturalMod : Nat -> Nat -> Nat
naturalMod numerator zero =
  numerator
naturalMod numerator (suc denominator) =
  mod-helper zero denominator numerator denominator

ModEq : Nat -> Nat -> Nat -> Set
ModEq modulus left-value right-value =
  naturalMod left-value modulus == naturalMod right-value modulus

putnam-2008-b6 : Set
putnam-2008-b6 =
  (n k : Nat) ->
  Positive n ->
  Positive k ->
  Exists Nat
    (\ count ->
      HasCardinalityUpTo
        {A = Fin n -> Fin n}
        PointwiseEqual
        (KLimitedPermutation k)
        count
      and
      (Odd count
        iff
        (ModEq (two * k + one) n zero
          or
          ModEq (two * k + one) n one)))

(*
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2008_b6:

  exactly when n is congruent to zero or one modulo 2k+1. This file contains

open arithmeticTheory pred_setTheory permutesTheory;

val putnam_2008_b6 =

      0 < n /\ 0 < k
      ==>
      (ODD
         (CARD
            {p : num -> num |
               p permutes count n /\
               !i : num.

title: putnam_2008_b6
content:
$(
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact
  putnam_2008_b6: the number of permutations with displacement at most k is
  odd exactly when n is congruent to zero or one modulo 2k+1. This file
  contains no proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  For positive n and k, the ordinal interval 0 ..^ n is the n-element
  carrier corresponding to Fin n, and Base ` ( SymGrp ` ( 0 ..^ n ) ) is
  its full set of permutations. The restricted class retains exactly those
  permutations f for which the integer absolute displacement |f(i)-i| is at
  most k at every index.

  SetMM's # operator gives the finite cardinality of this class, Odd is the
  class of odd integers, and mod expresses the two source congruences modulo
  2k+1. The zero-based carrier is equivalent to the informal one-based
  carrier by shifting every index and value by one, which preserves all
  displacements. The final declaration is the single unproved $a corpus
  statement; this database contains no proof declaration.
$)

${
  $d f i k n $.

  putnambench-putnam-2008-b6 $a |- A. n e. NN
    A. k e. NN
      (
        (
          #
          `
          {
            f e. ( Base ` ( SymGrp ` ( 0 ..^ n ) ) )
            |
            A. i e. ( 0 ..^ n )
              ( abs ` ( ( f ` i ) - i ) ) <_ k
          }
        )
        e.
        Odd
        <->
        (
          (
            n mod ( ( 2 x. k ) + 1 )
          )
          =
          0
          \/
          (
            n mod ( ( 2 x. k ) + 1 )
          )
          =
          1
        )
      )
  $.
$}

content:
% Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2008_b6:
% the number of permutations of n elements moving every index by at most k is
% odd exactly when n is congruent to zero or one modulo 2*k+1. This file
% contains no proof.

putnam_2008_b6: THEORY
BEGIN
  quotient_aux(
      numerator, denominator, fuel: nat): RECURSIVE nat =
    IF fuel = 0
        OR denominator = 0
        OR numerator < denominator THEN
      0
    ELSE
      1
        + quotient_aux(
            numerator - denominator,
            denominator,
            fuel - 1)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE fuel

  remainder_aux(
      numerator, denominator, fuel: nat): RECURSIVE nat =
    IF fuel = 0
        OR denominator = 0
        OR numerator < denominator THEN
      numerator
    ELSE
      remainder_aux(
        numerator - denominator,
        denominator,
        fuel - 1)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE fuel

  safe_ndiv(numerator, denominator: nat): nat =
    quotient_aux(
      numerator,
      denominator,
      numerator + 1)

  safe_mod(numerator, denominator: nat): nat =
    IF denominator = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      remainder_aux(
        numerator,
        denominator,
        numerator + 1)
    ENDIF

  function_code_count(n: nat): nat =
    IF n = 0 THEN 1 ELSE n ^ n ENDIF

  permutation_entry(code, index, n: nat): nat =
    IF n = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      safe_mod(safe_ndiv(code, n ^ index), n)
    ENDIF

  permutation_code(code, n: nat): bool =
    code < function_code_count(n)
      AND (FORALL (i, j: nat):
        (i < n
          AND j < n
          AND permutation_entry(code, i, n)
            = permutation_entry(code, j, n))
        IMPLIES i = j)

  k_limited(code, n, k: nat): bool =
    permutation_code(code, n)
      AND (FORALL (i: nat):
        i < n IMPLIES
          permutation_entry(code, i, n) <= i + k
            AND i <= permutation_entry(code, i, n) + k)

  count_k_limited(
      n, k, limit: nat): RECURSIVE nat =
    IF limit = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      count_k_limited(n, k, limit - 1)
        + IF k_limited(limit - 1, n, k) THEN 1 ELSE 0 ENDIF
    ENDIF
  MEASURE limit

  number_of_k_limited_permutations(n, k: nat): nat =
    count_k_limited(n, k, function_code_count(n))

  putnam_2008_b6: bool =
    FORALL (n, k: nat):
      (n > 0 AND k > 0)
      IMPLIES
        (mod(number_of_k_limited_permutations(n, k), 2) = 1
          IFF
            (mod(n, 2 * k + 1) = 0
              OR mod(n, 2 * k + 1) = 1))
END putnam_2008_b6

(defun p2009a1-mul (x y)

(defun-sk p2009a1-ring-laws-p (zero one)

     (and
      (p2009a1-member-p x)
      (p2009a1-member-p y)

      (p2009a1-member-p (p2009a1-neg x))

      (equal (p2009a1-add x zero) x)
      (equal (p2009a1-add x (p2009a1-neg x)) zero)
      (equal (p2009a1-mul (p2009a1-mul x y) z)
             (p2009a1-mul x (p2009a1-mul y z)))
      (equal (p2009a1-mul x y)

      (equal (p2009a1-mul x one) x)
      (equal
       (p2009a1-mul x (p2009a1-add y z))

  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (p2009a1-member-p x)
      (p2009a1-member-p y)
      (p2009a1-member-p z))
     (and
      (not (p2009a1-less x x))
      (or (equal x y)
          (p2009a1-less x y)
          (p2009a1-less y x))
      (implies
       (and (p2009a1-less x y)
            (p2009a1-less y z))
       (p2009a1-less x z))
      (implies

                     (p2009a1-add y z)))

-- Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2009_a1
-- (putnambench__agda__putnam_2009_a1): every real-valued function on the
-- plane whose values sum to zero on every nondegenerate square vanishes
-- everywhere; the requested answer is True. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module Putnam2009A1 where

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; _*_)

infix 4 _!=_
infixr 3 _and_
infixr 2 _or_

data Bottom : Set where

Not : Set -> Set
Not A =
  A -> Bottom

_!=_ : {A : Set} -> A -> A -> Set
x != y =
  Not (x == y)

record _and_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data _or_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  left  : A -> A or B
  right : B -> A or B

record Iff (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor equivalence
  field
    forward  : A -> B
    backward : B -> A

data Top : Set where
  top : Top

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

record CompleteOrderedRealField (R : Set) : Set1 where
  field
    zeroR oneR : R
    add multiply : R -> R -> R
    negate inverse : R -> R
    lessOrEqual : R -> R -> Set
    fromNat : Nat -> R

    one-not-zero :
      oneR != zeroR

    add-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> add x y == add y x
    add-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      add (add x y) z == add x (add y z)
    add-zero :
      (x : R) -> add x zeroR == x
    add-inverse :
      (x : R) -> add x (negate x) == zeroR

    multiply-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> multiply x y == multiply y x
    multiply-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply (multiply x y) z ==
      multiply x (multiply y z)
    multiply-one :
      (x : R) -> multiply x oneR == x
    multiply-zero :
      (x : R) -> multiply x zeroR == zeroR
    distribute :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply x (add y z) ==
      add (multiply x y) (multiply x z)
    inverse-zero :
      inverse zeroR == zeroR
    multiply-inverse :
      (x : R) ->
      x != zeroR ->
      multiply x (inverse x) == oneR

    order-reflexive :
      (x : R) -> lessOrEqual x x
    order-transitive :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y z ->
      lessOrEqual x z
    order-antisymmetric :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y x ->
      x == y
    order-total :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y or lessOrEqual y x
    add-order :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual (add z x) (add z y)
    multiply-nonnegative :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR x ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR y ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR (multiply x y)
    zero-less-than-one :
      lessOrEqual zeroR oneR and zeroR != oneR

    fromNat-zero :
      fromNat zero == zeroR
    fromNat-successor :
      (n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (suc n) == add (fromNat n) oneR
    fromNat-addition :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m + n) == add (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-multiplication :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m * n) == multiply (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-injective :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat m == fromNat n ->
      m == n

    archimedean :
      (x : R) ->
      Exists Nat (\ n -> lessOrEqual x (fromNat n))
    least-upper-bound :
      (P : R -> Set) ->
      Exists R P ->
      Exists R
        (\ upper ->
          (x : R) ->
          P x ->
          lessOrEqual x upper) ->
      Exists R
        (\ supremum ->
          ((x : R) ->
            P x ->
            lessOrEqual x supremum)
          and
          ((upper : R) ->
            ((x : R) ->
              P x ->
              lessOrEqual x upper) ->
            lessOrEqual supremum upper))

open CompleteOrderedRealField

record Point (R : Set) : Set where
  constructor point
  field
    x-coordinate : R
    y-coordinate : R

open Point

origin :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Point R
origin reals =
  point (zeroR reals) (zeroR reals)

addPoint :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Point R ->
  Point R ->
  Point R
addPoint reals p q =
  point
    (add reals (x-coordinate p) (x-coordinate q))
    (add reals (y-coordinate p) (y-coordinate q))

quarterTurn :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Point R ->
  Point R
quarterTurn reals v =
  point
    (negate reals (y-coordinate v))
    (x-coordinate v)

module Putnam2009A1Statement
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) where

  SquareSumZero : (Point R -> R) -> Set
  SquareSumZero f =
    (O v : Point R) ->
    v != origin reals ->
    add reals
      (add reals
        (add reals
          (f O)
          (f (addPoint reals O v)))
        (f (addPoint reals
          (addPoint reals O v)
          (quarterTurn reals v))))
      (f (addPoint reals O (quarterTurn reals v)))
    == zeroR reals

  VanishesEverywhere : (Point R -> R) -> Set
  VanishesEverywhere f =
    (P : Point R) ->
    f P == zeroR reals

  proposition : Set
  proposition =
    (f : Point R -> R) ->
    SquareSumZero f ->
    VanishesEverywhere f

  solution : Set
  solution =
    Top

putnam-2009-a1 : Set1
putnam-2009-a1 =
  (R : Set) ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) ->
  Iff
    (Putnam2009A1Statement.proposition reals)
    (Putnam2009A1Statement.solution reals)

% Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2009_a1:
% every real-valued function on the real plane whose values sum to zero at
% the vertices of every square is identically zero. This file contains no proof.

putnam_2009_a1: THEORY
BEGIN
  point: TYPE = [# x_coord: real, y_coord: real #]

  origin: point =
    (# x_coord := 0, y_coord := 0 #)

  point_add(P, Q: point): point =
    (# x_coord := x_coord(P) + x_coord(Q),
       y_coord := y_coord(P) + y_coord(Q) #)

  quarter_turn(P: point): point =
    (# x_coord := -y_coord(P),
       y_coord := x_coord(P) #)

  square_sum_zero(f: [point -> real]): bool =
    FORALL (O, v: point):
      v /= origin IMPLIES
        f(O)
          + f(point_add(O, v))
          + f(point_add(point_add(O, v), quarter_turn(v)))
          + f(point_add(O, quarter_turn(v)))
          = 0

  putnam_2009_a1: bool =
    FORALL (f: [point -> real]):
      square_sum_zero(f) IMPLIES
        FORALL (P: point):
          f(P) = 0
END putnam_2009_a1

-- fun x ↦ 2 ^ (-(1 : ℝ) / 12) * (Real.sin (6 * x + Real.pi / 4) / (Real.cos (6 * x + Real.pi / 4)) ^ 2) ^ ((1 : ℝ) / 6)
/--
Functions $f,g,h$ are differentiable on some open interval around $0$
and satisfy the equations and initial conditions
\begin{gather*}
f' = 2f^2gh+\frac{1}{gh},\quad f(0)=1, \\
g'=fg^2h+\frac{4}{fh}, \quad g(0)=1, \\
h'=3fgh^2+\frac{1}{fg}, \quad h(0)=1.
\end{gather*}
Find an explicit formula for $f(x)$, valid in some open interval around $0$.
-/
theorem putnam_2009_a2
(f g h : ℝ → ℝ)
(a b : ℝ)
(hab : 0 ∈ Ioo a b)
(hdiff : DifferentiableOn ℝ f (Ioo a b) ∧ DifferentiableOn ℝ g (Ioo a b) ∧ DifferentiableOn ℝ h (Ioo a b))
(hf : (∀ x ∈ Ioo a b, deriv f x = 2 * (f x)^2 * (g x) * (h x) + 1 / ((g x) * (h x))) ∧ f 0 = 1)
(hg : (∀ x ∈ Ioo a b, deriv g x = (f x) * (g x)^2 * (h x) + 4 / ((f x) * (h x))) ∧ g 0 = 1)
(hh : (∀ x ∈ Ioo a b, deriv h x = 3 * (f x) * (g x) * (h x)^2 + 1 / ((f x) * (g x))) ∧ h 0 = 1)
: (∃ c d : ℝ, 0 ∈ Ioo c d ∧ ∀ x ∈ Ioo c d, f x = putnam_2009_a2_solution x) :=
sorry

    : exists (c d: R), c < 0 < d /\ (forall (x: R), c < x < d -> f x = putnam_2009_a2_solution x).

;; Near zero all three source functions remain nonzero, so the analytic
;; right-hand side of the ODE makes every differentiable source solution
;; analytic. Its Taylor coefficients are therefore uniquely forced by the
;; three recurrences below.
;;
;; Writing s = sin(6x) and c = cos(6x), the displayed source formula
;;
;;   2^(-1/12) * (sin(6x+pi/4) / cos(6x+pi/4)^2)^(1/6)
;;
;; is, on a neighborhood of zero, the unique positive analytic germ F with
;; F(0)=1 and F^6*(c-s)^2=s+c. Thus the source conclusion is equivalent in
;; both directions to equality of every Taylor coefficient in the final
;; predicate. All coefficients are rational, but this is an exact analytic
;; germ encoding, not a restriction of the source real domain.

(defun putnam-2009-a2-factorial (n)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix n)))
  (if (zp n)
      1
    (* n (putnam-2009-a2-factorial (- n 1)))))

(defun putnam-2009-a2-sine-coefficient (degree)
  (if (and (natp degree) (oddp degree))
      (/ (* (expt -1 (floor degree 2))
            (expt 6 degree))
         (putnam-2009-a2-factorial degree))
    0))

(defun putnam-2009-a2-cosine-coefficient (degree)
  (if (and (natp degree) (evenp degree))
      (/ (* (expt -1 (floor degree 2))
            (expt 6 degree))
         (putnam-2009-a2-factorial degree))
    0))

(defun putnam-2009-a2-series-coefficient (series degree)
  (if (and (natp degree)

(defun putnam-2009-a2-convolution-coefficient-aux
    (left right degree remaining)

  (if (zp remaining)

    (let ((index (- (+ degree 1) remaining)))

            (putnam-2009-a2-series-coefficient
             right (- degree index)))

          left right degree (- remaining 1))))))

(defun putnam-2009-a2-convolution-coefficient

    0))

(defun putnam-2009-a2-series-product-prefix-aux
    (left right index remaining)

     (putnam-2009-a2-convolution-coefficient
      left right index)
     (putnam-2009-a2-series-product-prefix-aux
      left right (+ index 1) (- remaining 1)))))

(defun putnam-2009-a2-series-product-prefix

   left right 0 count))

(defun putnam-2009-a2-zero-prefix (count)

    (putnam-2009-a2-series-product-prefix

(defun putnam-2009-a2-sine-prefix-aux (index remaining)

  (if (zp remaining)

(defun putnam-2009-a2-sine-prefix (count)

(defun putnam-2009-a2-cosine-prefix-aux (index remaining)

(defun putnam-2009-a2-cosine-prefix (count)

(defun putnam-2009-a2-reciprocal-sum-aux

  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix remaining)))
  (if (zp remaining)
      0
    (let ((index (+ 1 (- degree remaining))))

             reciprocal (- degree index)))

      (/ (putnam-2009-a2-series-coefficient series 0))
    (- (/ (putnam-2009-a2-reciprocal-sum-aux
           series reciprocal degree degree)
          (putnam-2009-a2-series-coefficient series 0)))))

  (if (zp remaining)
      reciprocal
    (putnam-2009-a2-reciprocal-prefix-aux
     series
     (append
      reciprocal
      (list
       (putnam-2009-a2-reciprocal-next-coefficient
        series reciprocal index)))

(defun putnam-2009-a2-reciprocal-prefix (series count)

(defun putnam-2009-a2-f-rhs-coefficient

        f-g-squared-h degree)

          (putnam-2009-a2-series-coefficient

(defun putnam-2009-a2-solution-prefix-aux (remaining coefficient-triple)

title: putnam_2009_a2
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2009_a2:
-- the local explicit solution for the first component of a differentiable
-- real-valued system of three nonlinear differential equations. This file
-- contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module Putnam2009A2 where

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; _*_)

infix 4 _!=_ _<=N_
infixr 3 _and_
infixr 2 _or_

data Bottom : Set where

Not : Set -> Set
Not A =
  A -> Bottom

_!=_ : {A : Set} -> A -> A -> Set
x != y =
  Not (x == y)

record _and_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data _or_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  left  : A -> A or B
  right : B -> A or B

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

data _<=N_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set where
  zero<=N   : {n : Nat} -> zero <=N n
  suc<=sucN : {m n : Nat} -> m <=N n -> suc m <=N suc n

record CompleteOrderedRealField (R : Set) : Set1 where
  field
    zeroR oneR : R
    add multiply : R -> R -> R
    negate inverse : R -> R
    lessOrEqual : R -> R -> Set
    fromNat : Nat -> R

    one-not-zero :
      oneR != zeroR

    add-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> add x y == add y x
    add-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      add (add x y) z == add x (add y z)
    add-zero :
      (x : R) -> add x zeroR == x
    add-inverse :
      (x : R) -> add x (negate x) == zeroR

    multiply-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> multiply x y == multiply y x
    multiply-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply (multiply x y) z ==
      multiply x (multiply y z)
    multiply-one :
      (x : R) -> multiply x oneR == x
    multiply-zero :
      (x : R) -> multiply x zeroR == zeroR
    distribute :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply x (add y z) ==
      add (multiply x y) (multiply x z)
    inverse-zero :
      inverse zeroR == zeroR
    multiply-inverse :
      (x : R) ->
      x != zeroR ->
      multiply x (inverse x) == oneR

    order-reflexive :
      (x : R) -> lessOrEqual x x
    order-transitive :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y z ->
      lessOrEqual x z
    order-antisymmetric :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y x ->
      x == y
    order-total :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y or lessOrEqual y x
    add-order :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual (add z x) (add z y)
    multiply-nonnegative :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR x ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR y ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR (multiply x y)
    zero-less-than-one :
      lessOrEqual zeroR oneR and zeroR != oneR

    fromNat-zero :
      fromNat zero == zeroR
    fromNat-successor :
      (n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (suc n) == add (fromNat n) oneR
    fromNat-addition :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m + n) == add (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-multiplication :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m * n) == multiply (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-injective :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat m == fromNat n ->
      m == n

    archimedean :
      (x : R) ->
      Exists Nat (\ n -> lessOrEqual x (fromNat n))
    least-upper-bound :
      (P : R -> Set) ->
      Exists R P ->
      Exists R
        (\ upper ->
          (x : R) ->
          P x ->
          lessOrEqual x upper) ->
      Exists R
        (\ supremum ->
          ((x : R) ->
            P x ->
            lessOrEqual x supremum)
          and
          ((upper : R) ->
            ((x : R) ->
              P x ->
              lessOrEqual x upper) ->
            lessOrEqual supremum upper))

open CompleteOrderedRealField

oneN : Nat
oneN =
  suc zero

twoN : Nat
twoN =
  suc oneN

fourN : Nat
fourN =
  twoN + twoN

sixN : Nat
sixN =
  twoN + fourN

twelveN : Nat
twelveN =
  sixN + sixN

subtract :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
subtract reals x y =
  add reals x (negate reals y)

divide :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
divide reals x y =
  multiply reals x (inverse reals y)

naturalPower :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  Nat ->
  R
naturalPower reals x zero =
  oneR reals
naturalPower reals x (suc n) =
  multiply reals
    (naturalPower reals x n)
    x

StrictLess :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
StrictLess reals x y =
  lessOrEqual reals x y and x != y

CloseTo :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
CloseTo reals center radius x =
  StrictLess reals
    (subtract reals center radius)
    x
  and
  StrictLess reals
    x
    (add reals center radius)

factorial : Nat -> Nat
factorial zero =
  oneN
factorial (suc n) =
  suc n * factorial n

sumFirst :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Nat ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  R
sumFirst reals zero term =
  zeroR reals
sumFirst reals (suc n) term =
  add reals
    (sumFirst reals n term)
    (term n)

ConvergesTo :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  R ->
  Set
ConvergesTo {R} reals sequence limit =
  (epsilon : R) ->
  StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) epsilon ->
  Exists Nat
    (\ cutoff ->
      (n : Nat) ->
      cutoff <=N n ->
      CloseTo reals limit epsilon (sequence n))

SeriesHasSum :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  R ->
  Set
SeriesHasSum reals terms limit =
  ConvergesTo reals
    (\ n -> sumFirst reals n terms)
    limit

alternatingPower :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Nat ->
  R
alternatingPower reals n =
  naturalPower reals
    (negate reals (oneR reals))
    n

exponentialTerm :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  Nat ->
  R
exponentialTerm reals x n =
  divide reals
    (naturalPower reals x n)
    (fromNat reals (factorial n))

sineTerm :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  Nat ->
  R
sineTerm reals x n =
  divide reals
    (multiply reals
      (alternatingPower reals n)
      (naturalPower reals x (suc (twoN * n))))
    (fromNat reals (factorial (suc (twoN * n))))

cosineTerm :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  Nat ->
  R
cosineTerm reals x n =
  divide reals
    (multiply reals
      (alternatingPower reals n)
      (naturalPower reals x (twoN * n)))
    (fromNat reals (factorial (twoN * n)))

leibnizTerm :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Nat ->
  R
leibnizTerm reals n =
  divide reals
    (alternatingPower reals n)
    (fromNat reals (suc (twoN * n)))

record StandardRealElementaryFunctions
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) :
  Set1 where

  field
    exponential logarithm sine cosine : R -> R
    pi : R

    exponential-series :
      (x : R) ->
      SeriesHasSum reals
        (exponentialTerm reals x)
        (exponential x)

    exponential-positive :
      (x : R) ->
      StrictLess reals
        (zeroR reals)
        (exponential x)

    exponential-injective :
      (x y : R) ->
      exponential x == exponential y ->
      x == y

    exponential-logarithm :
      (x : R) ->
      StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) x ->
      exponential (logarithm x) == x

    sine-series :
      (x : R) ->
      SeriesHasSum reals
        (sineTerm reals x)
        (sine x)

    cosine-series :
      (x : R) ->
      SeriesHasSum reals
        (cosineTerm reals x)
        (cosine x)

    pi-positive :
      StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) pi

    pi-leibniz-series :
      SeriesHasSum reals
        (leibnizTerm reals)
        (divide reals pi (fromNat reals fourN))

open StandardRealElementaryFunctions

Predicate : Set -> Set1
Predicate A =
  A -> Set

whole : {A : Set} -> Predicate A
whole _ =
  Bottom -> Bottom

OpenInterval :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Predicate R
OpenInterval reals lower upper x =
  StrictLess reals lower x
  and
  StrictLess reals x upper

differenceQuotient :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (R -> R) ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
differenceQuotient reals function point x =
  divide reals
    (subtract reals (function x) (function point))
    (subtract reals x point)

DerivativeAt :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (R -> R) ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
DerivativeAt {R} reals function point derivativeValue =
  (epsilon : R) ->
  StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) epsilon ->
  Exists R
    (\ delta ->
      StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) delta
      and
      ((x : R) ->
        CloseTo reals point delta x ->
        x != point ->
        CloseTo reals derivativeValue epsilon
          (differenceQuotient reals function point x)))

record StandardRealCalculus
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) :
  Set1 where

  field
    derivative : (R -> R) -> R -> R

    derivative-correct :
      (function : R -> R) ->
      (point derivativeValue : R) ->
      DerivativeAt reals function point derivativeValue ->
      derivative function point == derivativeValue

    derivative-totalized-at-zero :
      (function : R -> R) ->
      (point : R) ->
      Not (Exists R (DerivativeAt reals function point)) ->
      derivative function point == zeroR reals

open StandardRealCalculus

DifferentiableOn :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (R -> R) ->
  Predicate R ->
  Set
DifferentiableOn {R} reals function domain =
  (point : R) ->
  domain point ->
  Exists R
    (DerivativeAt reals function point)

realPower :
  {R : Set} ->
  {reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R} ->
  StandardRealElementaryFunctions reals ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
realPower {reals = reals} elementary base exponent =
  exponential elementary
    (multiply reals exponent (logarithm elementary base))

module Putnam2009A2Statement
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R)
  (elementary : StandardRealElementaryFunctions reals)
  (calculus : StandardRealCalculus reals) where

  oneSixth : R
  oneSixth =
    divide reals
      (oneR reals)
      (fromNat reals sixN)

  minusOneTwelfth : R
  minusOneTwelfth =
    negate reals
      (divide reals
        (oneR reals)
        (fromNat reals twelveN))

  angle : R -> R
  angle x =
    add reals
      (multiply reals (fromNat reals sixN) x)
      (divide reals
        (pi elementary)
        (fromNat reals fourN))

  solution : R -> R
  solution x =
    multiply reals
      (realPower elementary
        (fromNat reals twoN)
        minusOneTwelfth)
      (realPower elementary
        (divide reals
          (sine elementary (angle x))
          (naturalPower reals
            (cosine elementary (angle x))
            twoN))
        oneSixth)

  firstEquation :
    (R -> R) ->
    (R -> R) ->
    (R -> R) ->
    R ->
    R
  firstEquation f g h x =
    add reals
      (multiply reals
        (multiply reals
          (multiply reals
            (fromNat reals twoN)
            (naturalPower reals (f x) twoN))
          (g x))
        (h x))
      (divide reals
        (oneR reals)
        (multiply reals (g x) (h x)))

  secondEquation :
    (R -> R) ->
    (R -> R) ->
    (R -> R) ->
    R ->
    R
  secondEquation f g h x =
    add reals
      (multiply reals
        (multiply reals
          (f x)
          (naturalPower reals (g x) twoN))
        (h x))
      (divide reals
        (fromNat reals fourN)
        (multiply reals (f x) (h x)))

  thirdEquation :
    (R -> R) ->
    (R -> R) ->
    (R -> R) ->
    R ->
    R
  thirdEquation f g h x =
    add reals
      (multiply reals
        (multiply reals
          (multiply reals
            (fromNat reals (suc twoN))
            (f x))
          (g x))
        (naturalPower reals (h x) twoN))
      (divide reals
        (oneR reals)
        (multiply reals (f x) (g x)))

  proposition : Set
  proposition =
    (f g h : R -> R) ->
    (a b : R) ->
    OpenInterval reals a b (zeroR reals) ->
    (DifferentiableOn reals f (OpenInterval reals a b)
    and
    DifferentiableOn reals g (OpenInterval reals a b)
    and
    DifferentiableOn reals h (OpenInterval reals a b)) ->
    (((x : R) ->
      OpenInterval reals a b x ->
      derivative calculus f x == firstEquation f g h x)
    and
    f (zeroR reals) == oneR reals) ->
    (((x : R) ->
      OpenInterval reals a b x ->
      derivative calculus g x == secondEquation f g h x)
    and
    g (zeroR reals) == oneR reals) ->
    (((x : R) ->
      OpenInterval reals a b x ->
      derivative calculus h x == thirdEquation f g h x)
    and
    h (zeroR reals) == oneR reals) ->
    Exists R
      (\ c ->
        Exists R
          (\ d ->
            OpenInterval reals c d (zeroR reals)
            and
            ((x : R) ->
              OpenInterval reals c d x ->
              f x == solution x)))

putnam-2009-a2 : Set1
putnam-2009-a2 =
  (R : Set) ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) ->
  (elementary : StandardRealElementaryFunctions reals) ->
  (calculus : StandardRealCalculus reals) ->
  Putnam2009A2Statement.proposition
    reals
    elementary
    calculus

  the explicit local solution for one component of a differentiable
  three-function nonlinear ODE system with prescribed initial values. This

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open realTheory real_topologyTheory transcTheory derivativeTheory;

val putnam_2009_a2 =
  ``let solution =
      \x : real.
        (2 : real) powr (-1 / 12) *
        (sin (6 * x + pi / 4) /
           (cos (6 * x + pi / 4) pow 2)) powr (1 / 6)
    in
      !f g h : real -> real. !a b : real.
        a < 0 /\ 0 < b /\
        (!x : real.
           a < x /\ x < b
           ==>
           f differentiable (at x) /\
           g differentiable (at x) /\
           h differentiable (at x)) /\
        (!x : real.
           a < x /\ x < b
           ==>
           vector_derivative f (at x) =
             2 * f x pow 2 * g x * h x + 1 / (g x * h x)) /\
        f 0 = 1 /\
        (!x : real.
           a < x /\ x < b
           ==>
           vector_derivative g (at x) =
             f x * g x pow 2 * h x + 4 / (f x * h x)) /\
        g 0 = 1 /\
        (!x : real.
           a < x /\ x < b
           ==>
           vector_derivative h (at x) =
             3 * f x * g x * h x pow 2 + 1 / (f x * g x)) /\
        h 0 = 1
        ==>
        ?c d : real.
          c < 0 /\ 0 < d /\
          !x : real.
            c < x /\ x < d ==> f x = solution x``;

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  F, G, and H are arbitrary total real-valued functions.  The antecedent
  states their differentiability and the three differential equations on
  the open interval ( A , B ), together with the initial values at zero.
  The conclusion keeps the smaller interval endpoints C and D existential.

  The source's fractional real powers are rendered with set.mm's complex
  power operation ^c.  Around zero, the base
  sin(6x + pi/4) / cos(6x + pi/4)^2 is positive, so ^c agrees there with
  real power.  Since the conclusion is local and its interval may be
  shrunk, this gives a bidirectionally equivalent statement.
$)

${
  $d A B C D F G H x $.

  putnam2009a2 $a |- A. F e. ( RR ^m RR ) A. G e. ( RR ^m RR )
    A. H e. ( RR ^m RR ) A. A e. RR A. B e. RR
    (
      (
        ( A < 0 /\ 0 < B )
        /\
        (
          A. x e. ( A (,) B )
          (
            (
              (
                x e. dom ( RR _D F )
                /\
                x e. dom ( RR _D G )
              )
              /\
              x e. dom ( RR _D H )
            )
            /\
            (
              (
                ( ( RR _D F ) ` x )
                =
                (
                  (
                    ( ( 2 x. ( ( F ` x ) ^ 2 ) ) x. ( G ` x ) )
                    x. ( H ` x )
                  )
                  +
                  ( 1 / ( ( G ` x ) x. ( H ` x ) ) )
                )
                /\
                ( ( RR _D G ) ` x )
                =
                (
                  (
                    ( ( F ` x ) x. ( ( G ` x ) ^ 2 ) )
                    x. ( H ` x )
                  )
                  +
                  ( 4 / ( ( F ` x ) x. ( H ` x ) ) )
                )
              )
              /\
              ( ( RR _D H ) ` x )
              =
              (
                (
                  ( ( 3 x. ( F ` x ) ) x. ( G ` x ) )
                  x. ( ( H ` x ) ^ 2 )
                )
                +
                ( 1 / ( ( F ` x ) x. ( G ` x ) ) )
              )
            )
          )
          /\
          (
            (
              ( F ` 0 ) = 1
              /\
              ( G ` 0 ) = 1
            )
            /\
            ( H ` 0 ) = 1
          )
        )
      )
      ->
      E. C e. RR E. D e. RR
      (
        ( C < 0 /\ 0 < D )
        /\
        A. x e. ( C (,) D )
        (
          ( F ` x )
          =
          (
            ( 2 ^c ( ( -u 1 ) / ( 3 x. 4 ) ) )
            x.
            (
              (
                ( sin ` ( ( 6 x. x ) + ( _pi / 4 ) ) )
                /
                ( ( cos ` ( ( 6 x. x ) + ( _pi / 4 ) ) ) ^ 2 )
              )
              ^c
              ( 1 / 6 )
            )
          )
        )
      )
    ) $.
$}

title: putnam_2009_a2
content:
% Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2009_a2:
% the local solution for the first component of a coupled real differential
% system with specified initial values. This file contains no proof.

putnam_2009_a2: THEORY
BEGIN
  real_function: TYPE = [real -> real]
  real_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> real]

  safe_div(numerator, denominator: real): real =
    IF denominator = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      numerator / denominator
    ENDIF

  nat_factorial(index: nat): RECURSIVE nat =
    IF index = 0 THEN
      1
    ELSE
      index * nat_factorial(index - 1)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE index

  sine_partial(x: real, count: nat): RECURSIVE real =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      LET index: nat = count - 1 IN
        sine_partial(x, count - 1)
          + safe_div(
              ((-1 :: real) ^ index) * x ^ (2 * index + 1),
              nat_factorial(2 * index + 1) :: real)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  cosine_partial(x: real, count: nat): RECURSIVE real =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      LET index: nat = count - 1 IN
        cosine_partial(x, count - 1)
          + safe_div(
              ((-1 :: real) ^ index) * x ^ (2 * index),
              nat_factorial(2 * index) :: real)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  converges_to(sequence: real_sequence, value: real): bool =
    FORALL (epsilon_value: posreal):
      EXISTS (cutoff: nat):
        FORALL (index: nat):
          cutoff <= index IMPLIES
            abs(sequence(index) - value) < epsilon_value

  sine_value(argument, value: real): bool =
    converges_to(
      LAMBDA (count: nat): sine_partial(argument, count),
      value)

  cosine_value(argument, value: real): bool =
    converges_to(
      LAMBDA (count: nat): cosine_partial(argument, count),
      value)

  sine(argument: real): real =
    epsilon(
      LAMBDA (value: real):
        sine_value(argument, value))

  cosine(argument: real): real =
    epsilon(
      LAMBDA (value: real):
        cosine_value(argument, value))

  pi_value(value: real): bool =
    3 < value
      AND value < 4
      AND cosine_value(value / 2, 0)

  pi: real =
    epsilon(
      LAMBDA (value: real):
        pi_value(value))

  has_derivative_at(
      function_value: real_function,
      derivative, point: real): bool =
    FORALL (epsilon_value: posreal):
      EXISTS (delta: posreal):
        FORALL (increment: real):
          (increment /= 0 AND abs(increment) < delta)
            IMPLIES
              abs(
                function_value(point + increment)
                  - function_value(point)
                  - derivative * increment)
                < epsilon_value * abs(increment)

  differentiable_at(
      function_value: real_function,
      point: real): bool =
    EXISTS (derivative: real):
      has_derivative_at(function_value, derivative, point)

  differentiable_on_open_interval(
      function_value: real_function,
      left_endpoint, right_endpoint: real): bool =
    FORALL (point: real):
      (left_endpoint < point AND point < right_endpoint)
        IMPLIES differentiable_at(function_value, point)

  derivative_value(
      function_value: real_function,
      point: real): real =
    IF differentiable_at(function_value, point) THEN
      epsilon(
        LAMBDA (derivative: real):
          has_derivative_at(
            function_value, derivative, point))
    ELSE
      0
    ENDIF

  putnam_2009_a2_solution_value(x, value: real): bool =
    EXISTS
        (sinusoid, cosinusoid, twelfth_root, sixth_root: real):
      sine_value(6 * x + pi / 4, sinusoid)
        AND cosine_value(6 * x + pi / 4, cosinusoid)
        AND twelfth_root > 0
        AND twelfth_root ^ 12 = 2
        AND sixth_root >= 0
        AND sixth_root ^ 6 =
          safe_div(sinusoid, cosinusoid ^ 2)
        AND value = safe_div(sixth_root, twelfth_root)

  putnam_2009_a2_solution(x: real): real =
    epsilon(
      LAMBDA (value: real):
        putnam_2009_a2_solution_value(x, value))

  putnam_2009_a2: bool =
    FORALL (f, g, h: real_function), (a, b: real):
      (a < 0
        AND 0 < b
        AND differentiable_on_open_interval(f, a, b)
        AND differentiable_on_open_interval(g, a, b)
        AND differentiable_on_open_interval(h, a, b)
        AND (FORALL (x: real):
          (a < x AND x < b) IMPLIES
            derivative_value(f, x)
              = 2 * f(x) ^ 2 * g(x) * h(x)
                + safe_div(1, g(x) * h(x)))
        AND f(0) = 1
        AND (FORALL (x: real):
          (a < x AND x < b) IMPLIES
            derivative_value(g, x)
              = f(x) * g(x) ^ 2 * h(x)
                + safe_div(4, f(x) * h(x)))
        AND g(0) = 1
        AND (FORALL (x: real):
          (a < x AND x < b) IMPLIES
            derivative_value(h, x)
              = 3 * f(x) * g(x) * h(x) ^ 2
                + safe_div(1, f(x) * g(x)))
        AND h(0) = 1)
      IMPLIES
        EXISTS (c, d: real):
          c < 0
            AND 0 < d
            AND (FORALL (x: real):
              (c < x AND x < d) IMPLIES
                f(x) = putnam_2009_a2_solution(x))
END putnam_2009_a2
