title: putnam_2010_a2
putnam_2010_a2
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2010_a2:
;; differentiable real functions satisfying the positive-integer
;; difference-quotient identity are exactly the affine functions. This file
;; contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))

;; Reals are rational regular Cauchy names, and real functions are extensional
;; ACL2 function objects on those names. Positive rational tolerances and
;; radii are cofinal in the positive reals. The derivative, its epsilon-delta
;; radii, and the two affine coefficients are all internally quantified by
;; negated FN-EQUAL tests; none is an additional parameter of the statement.
;;
;; Differentiability is expressed using every real base point and every
;; nonzero rational increment. Continuity is included in the same internal
;; witness; it follows from source differentiability, and it makes convergence
;; along the dense rational increments equivalent to the full real derivative
;; limit. Thus the Boolean equality in the final predicate is the source
;; biconditional for each arbitrary function R -> R.

(defun putnam-2010-a2-quoted (object)
  (list 'quote object))

(defun putnam-2010-a2-term-list (terms)
  (if (consp terms)
      (list 'cons
            (car terms)
            (putnam-2010-a2-term-list (cdr terms)))
    nil))

(defun putnam-2010-a2-apply-term (function arguments)
  (list 'apply$
        (putnam-2010-a2-quoted function)
        (putnam-2010-a2-term-list arguments)))

(defun putnam-2010-a2-apply-object-term
    (function-term arguments)
  (list 'apply$
        function-term
        (putnam-2010-a2-term-list arguments)))

(defun putnam-2010-a2-and-terms (terms)
  (if (consp terms)
      (list 'if
            (car terms)
            (putnam-2010-a2-and-terms (cdr terms))
            (putnam-2010-a2-quoted nil))
    (putnam-2010-a2-quoted t)))

(defun putnam-2010-a2-implies-term (hypothesis conclusion)
  (list 'if
        hypothesis
        conclusion
        (putnam-2010-a2-quoted t)))

(defun putnam-2010-a2-not-term (term)
  (list 'if
        term
        (putnam-2010-a2-quoted nil)
        (putnam-2010-a2-quoted t)))

(defun putnam-2010-a2-add-term (left right)
  (list 'binary-+ left right))

(defun putnam-2010-a2-negate-term (value)
  (list 'unary-- value))

(defun putnam-2010-a2-subtract-term (left right)
  (putnam-2010-a2-add-term
   left
   (putnam-2010-a2-negate-term right)))

(defun putnam-2010-a2-multiply-term (left right)
  (list 'binary-* left right))

(defun putnam-2010-a2-divide-term (numerator denominator)
  (putnam-2010-a2-multiply-term
   numerator
   (list 'unary-/ denominator)))

(defun putnam-2010-a2-absolute-term (value)
  (list 'if
        (list '< value (putnam-2010-a2-quoted 0))
        (putnam-2010-a2-negate-term value)
        value))

(defun putnam-2010-a2-less-equal-term (left right)
  (list 'if
        (list '< right left)
        (putnam-2010-a2-quoted nil)
        (putnam-2010-a2-quoted t)))

(defun putnam-2010-a2-minimum-term (left right)
  (list 'if
        (list '< left right)
        left
        right))

(defun putnam-2010-a2-positive-rational-term (value)
  (putnam-2010-a2-and-terms
   (list
    (list 'rationalp value)
    (list '< (putnam-2010-a2-quoted 0) value))))

(defun putnam-2010-a2-true-function (formals)
  (list 'lambda
        formals
        (putnam-2010-a2-quoted t)))

(defun putnam-2010-a2-real-value-term (name precision)
  (putnam-2010-a2-apply-term name (list precision)))

(defun putnam-2010-a2-object-real-value-term
    (name-term precision)
  (putnam-2010-a2-apply-object-term
   name-term
   (list precision)))

(defun putnam-2010-a2-real-cauchy-function (name)
  (let* ((left
          (putnam-2010-a2-real-value-term name 'epsilon))
         (right
          (putnam-2010-a2-real-value-term name 'eta))
         (distance
          (putnam-2010-a2-absolute-term
           (putnam-2010-a2-subtract-term left right))))
    (list
     'lambda
     '(epsilon eta)
     (putnam-2010-a2-implies-term
      (putnam-2010-a2-and-terms
       (list
        (putnam-2010-a2-positive-rational-term 'epsilon)
        (putnam-2010-a2-positive-rational-term 'eta)))
      (putnam-2010-a2-and-terms
       (list
        (list 'rationalp left)
        (list 'rationalp right)
        (putnam-2010-a2-less-equal-term
         distance
         (putnam-2010-a2-add-term
          'epsilon 'eta))))))))

(defun putnam-2010-a2-real-name-p (name)
  (and
   (tamep-functionp name)
   (fn-equal
    (putnam-2010-a2-real-cauchy-function name)
    (putnam-2010-a2-true-function
     '(epsilon eta)))))

;; Sampling both names at eta/4 makes the universal inequality equivalent to
;; the represented real distance being at most BOUND.
(defun putnam-2010-a2-real-distance-function
    (left-name right-name bound)
  (let* ((precision
          (putnam-2010-a2-multiply-term
           (putnam-2010-a2-quoted 1/4)
           'eta))
         (left
          (putnam-2010-a2-real-value-term
           left-name precision))
         (right
          (putnam-2010-a2-real-value-term
           right-name precision))
         (distance
          (putnam-2010-a2-absolute-term
           (putnam-2010-a2-subtract-term left right))))
    (list
     'lambda
     '(eta)
     (putnam-2010-a2-implies-term
      (putnam-2010-a2-positive-rational-term 'eta)
      (putnam-2010-a2-and-terms
       (list
        (list 'rationalp left)
        (list 'rationalp right)
        (putnam-2010-a2-less-equal-term
         distance
         (putnam-2010-a2-add-term
          (putnam-2010-a2-quoted bound)
          'eta))))))))

(defun putnam-2010-a2-real-distance-at-most-p
    (left-name right-name bound)
  (and
   (rationalp bound)
   (putnam-2010-a2-real-name-p left-name)
   (putnam-2010-a2-real-name-p right-name)
   (fn-equal
    (putnam-2010-a2-real-distance-function
     left-name right-name bound)
    (putnam-2010-a2-true-function '(eta)))))

(defun putnam-2010-a2-real-equal-p
    (left-name right-name)
  (putnam-2010-a2-real-distance-at-most-p
   left-name right-name 0))

(defun putnam-2010-a2-unary-output-function
    (function)
  (let ((output
         (putnam-2010-a2-apply-term function (list 'x))))
    (list
     'lambda
     '(x)
     (putnam-2010-a2-implies-term
      (list 'putnam-2010-a2-real-name-p 'x)
      (list 'putnam-2010-a2-real-name-p output)))))

(defun putnam-2010-a2-unary-extensional-function
    (function)
  (let ((left-output
         (putnam-2010-a2-apply-term
          function (list 'x-left)))
        (right-output
         (putnam-2010-a2-apply-term
          function (list 'x-right))))
    (list
     'lambda
     '(x-left x-right)
     (putnam-2010-a2-implies-term
      (list 'putnam-2010-a2-real-equal-p
            'x-left 'x-right)
      (list 'putnam-2010-a2-real-equal-p
            left-output right-output)))))

(defun putnam-2010-a2-real-function-p (function)
  (and
   (tamep-functionp function)
   (fn-equal
    (putnam-2010-a2-unary-output-function function)
    (putnam-2010-a2-true-function '(x)))
   (fn-equal
    (putnam-2010-a2-unary-extensional-function function)
    (putnam-2010-a2-true-function
     '(x-left x-right)))))

(defun putnam-2010-a2-rational-shift-name (name shift)
  (let ((value
         (putnam-2010-a2-object-real-value-term
          (putnam-2010-a2-quoted name)
          (putnam-2010-a2-multiply-term
           (putnam-2010-a2-quoted 1/2)
           'precision))))
    (list
     'lambda
     '(precision)
     (putnam-2010-a2-add-term
      value
      (putnam-2010-a2-quoted shift)))))

;; Continuity is stated using closed rational radii. Rescaling epsilon and
;; delta gives the usual open-ball definition in both directions.
(defun putnam-2010-a2-continuous-at-delta-function
    (function x epsilon delta)
  (let ((at-x
         (putnam-2010-a2-apply-term
          function
          (list (putnam-2010-a2-quoted x))))
        (at-y
         (putnam-2010-a2-apply-term
          function
          (list 'y))))
    (list
     'lambda
     '(y)
     (putnam-2010-a2-implies-term
      (putnam-2010-a2-and-terms
       (list
        (list 'putnam-2010-a2-real-name-p 'y)
        (list 'putnam-2010-a2-real-distance-at-most-p
              (putnam-2010-a2-quoted x)
              'y
              (putnam-2010-a2-quoted delta))))
      (list 'putnam-2010-a2-real-distance-at-most-p
            at-x
            at-y
            (putnam-2010-a2-quoted epsilon))))))

(defun putnam-2010-a2-continuous-at-delta-p
    (function x epsilon delta)
  (and
   (rationalp delta)
   (< 0 delta)
   (fn-equal
    (putnam-2010-a2-continuous-at-delta-function
     function x epsilon delta)
    (putnam-2010-a2-true-function '(y)))))

(defun putnam-2010-a2-continuity-delta-failure-function
    (function x epsilon)
  (list
   'lambda
   '(delta)
   (list
    'if
    (list 'putnam-2010-a2-continuous-at-delta-p
          (putnam-2010-a2-quoted function)
          (putnam-2010-a2-quoted x)
          (putnam-2010-a2-quoted epsilon)
          'delta)
    (putnam-2010-a2-quoted nil)
    (putnam-2010-a2-quoted t))))

(defun putnam-2010-a2-continuity-delta-exists-p
    (function x epsilon)
  (not
   (fn-equal
    (putnam-2010-a2-continuity-delta-failure-function
     function x epsilon)
    (putnam-2010-a2-true-function '(delta)))))

(defun putnam-2010-a2-continuity-function (function)
  (list
   'lambda
   '(x epsilon)
   (putnam-2010-a2-implies-term
    (putnam-2010-a2-and-terms
     (list
      (list 'putnam-2010-a2-real-name-p 'x)
      (putnam-2010-a2-positive-rational-term 'epsilon)))
    (list 'putnam-2010-a2-continuity-delta-exists-p
          (putnam-2010-a2-quoted function)
          'x
          'epsilon))))

(defun putnam-2010-a2-continuous-p (function)
  (and
   (putnam-2010-a2-real-function-p function)
   (fn-equal
    (putnam-2010-a2-continuity-function function)
    (putnam-2010-a2-true-function
     '(x epsilon)))))

;; At precision eta, each numerator value is sampled at |h|*eta/4, so this is
;; a regular Cauchy name for (f(x+h)-f(x))/h when h is a nonzero rational.
(defun putnam-2010-a2-difference-quotient-name
    (function x h)
  (let* ((shifted-x
          (putnam-2010-a2-rational-shift-name x h))
         (at-shifted-x
          (putnam-2010-a2-apply-term
           function
           (list (putnam-2010-a2-quoted shifted-x))))
         (at-x
          (putnam-2010-a2-apply-term
           function
           (list (putnam-2010-a2-quoted x))))
         (sample-precision
          (putnam-2010-a2-multiply-term
           (putnam-2010-a2-quoted (/ (abs h) 4))
           'eta))
         (shifted-value
          (putnam-2010-a2-object-real-value-term
           at-shifted-x sample-precision))
         (value
          (putnam-2010-a2-object-real-value-term
           at-x sample-precision)))
    (list
     'lambda
     '(eta)
     (putnam-2010-a2-divide-term
      (putnam-2010-a2-subtract-term
       shifted-value value)
      (putnam-2010-a2-quoted h)))))

(defun putnam-2010-a2-derivative-at-delta-function
    (function derivative x epsilon delta)
  (let ((quotient
         (list 'putnam-2010-a2-difference-quotient-name
               (putnam-2010-a2-quoted function)
               (putnam-2010-a2-quoted x)
               'h))
        (derivative-at-x
         (putnam-2010-a2-apply-term
          derivative
          (list (putnam-2010-a2-quoted x)))))
    (list
     'lambda
     '(h)
     (putnam-2010-a2-implies-term
      (putnam-2010-a2-and-terms
       (list
        (list 'rationalp 'h)
        (putnam-2010-a2-not-term
         (list 'equal 'h (putnam-2010-a2-quoted 0)))
        (putnam-2010-a2-less-equal-term
         (putnam-2010-a2-absolute-term 'h)
         (putnam-2010-a2-quoted delta))))
      (list 'putnam-2010-a2-real-distance-at-most-p
            quotient
            derivative-at-x
            (putnam-2010-a2-quoted epsilon))))))

(defun putnam-2010-a2-derivative-at-delta-p
    (function derivative x epsilon delta)
  (and
   (rationalp delta)
   (< 0 delta)
   (fn-equal
    (putnam-2010-a2-derivative-at-delta-function
     function derivative x epsilon delta)
    (putnam-2010-a2-true-function '(h)))))

(defun putnam-2010-a2-derivative-delta-failure-function
    (function derivative x epsilon)
  (list
   'lambda
   '(delta)
   (list
    'if
    (list 'putnam-2010-a2-derivative-at-delta-p
          (putnam-2010-a2-quoted function)
          (putnam-2010-a2-quoted derivative)
          (putnam-2010-a2-quoted x)
          (putnam-2010-a2-quoted epsilon)
          'delta)
    (putnam-2010-a2-quoted nil)
    (putnam-2010-a2-quoted t))))

(defun putnam-2010-a2-derivative-delta-exists-p
    (function derivative x epsilon)
  (not
   (fn-equal
    (putnam-2010-a2-derivative-delta-failure-function
     function derivative x epsilon)
    (putnam-2010-a2-true-function '(delta)))))

(defun putnam-2010-a2-derivative-function
    (function derivative)
  (list
   'lambda
   '(x epsilon)
   (putnam-2010-a2-implies-term
    (putnam-2010-a2-and-terms
     (list
      (list 'putnam-2010-a2-real-name-p 'x)
      (putnam-2010-a2-positive-rational-term 'epsilon)))
    (list 'putnam-2010-a2-derivative-delta-exists-p
          (putnam-2010-a2-quoted function)
          (putnam-2010-a2-quoted derivative)

          'epsilon))))

(defun putnam-2010-a2-derivative-relation-p
    (function derivative)
  (and
   (putnam-2010-a2-real-function-p function)
   (putnam-2010-a2-real-function-p derivative)
   (fn-equal
    (putnam-2010-a2-derivative-function
     function derivative)
    (putnam-2010-a2-true-function
     '(x epsilon)))))

(defun putnam-2010-a2-difference-equation-function
    (function derivative)
  (let ((derivative-at-x
         (putnam-2010-a2-apply-term
          derivative (list 'x)))
        (finite-difference
         (list 'putnam-2010-a2-difference-quotient-name
               (putnam-2010-a2-quoted function)
               'x
               'n)))
    (list
     'lambda
     '(x n)
     (putnam-2010-a2-implies-term
      (putnam-2010-a2-and-terms
       (list
        (list 'putnam-2010-a2-real-name-p 'x)
        (list 'integerp 'n)
        (list '< (putnam-2010-a2-quoted 0) 'n)))
      (list 'putnam-2010-a2-real-equal-p
            derivative-at-x
            finite-difference)))))

(defun putnam-2010-a2-difference-equation-p
    (function derivative)
  (fn-equal
   (putnam-2010-a2-difference-equation-function
    function derivative)
   (putnam-2010-a2-true-function '(x n))))

(defun putnam-2010-a2-hypothesis-witness-p
    (derivative function)
  (and
   (putnam-2010-a2-continuous-p function)
   (putnam-2010-a2-derivative-relation-p
    function derivative)
   (putnam-2010-a2-difference-equation-p
    function derivative)))

(defun putnam-2010-a2-hypothesis-witness-failure-function
    (function)
  (list
   'lambda
   '(derivative)

    'if
    (list 'putnam-2010-a2-hypothesis-witness-p
          'derivative

(defun putnam-2010-a2-hypothesis-p (function)
  (let ((failure-function
         (putnam-2010-a2-hypothesis-witness-failure-function
          function))
        (true-function
         (putnam-2010-a2-true-function '(derivative))))
    (and
     (tamep-functionp failure-function)
     (tamep-functionp true-function)
     (not
      (fn-equal failure-function true-function)))))

;; This name denotes slope*x+intercept. Coarse samples bound the product
;; factors, and the adaptive precision makes the resulting rational sequence
;; a regular Cauchy name for the exact real affine value.
(defun putnam-2010-a2-affine-name
    (slope intercept x)
  (let* ((slope-coarse
          (putnam-2010-a2-object-real-value-term
           (putnam-2010-a2-quoted slope)
           (putnam-2010-a2-quoted 1)))
         (x-coarse
          (putnam-2010-a2-object-real-value-term
           (putnam-2010-a2-quoted x)
           (putnam-2010-a2-quoted 1)))
         (scale
          (putnam-2010-a2-multiply-term
           (putnam-2010-a2-quoted 64)
           (putnam-2010-a2-add-term
            (putnam-2010-a2-quoted 1)
            (putnam-2010-a2-add-term
             (putnam-2010-a2-absolute-term slope-coarse)
             (putnam-2010-a2-absolute-term x-coarse)))))
         (factor-precision
          (putnam-2010-a2-minimum-term
           (putnam-2010-a2-quoted 1)
           (putnam-2010-a2-divide-term
            'precision scale)))
         (intercept-precision
          (putnam-2010-a2-minimum-term
           (putnam-2010-a2-quoted 1)
           (putnam-2010-a2-multiply-term
            (putnam-2010-a2-quoted 1/8)
            'precision)))
         (slope-value
          (putnam-2010-a2-object-real-value-term
           (putnam-2010-a2-quoted slope)
           factor-precision))
         (x-value
          (putnam-2010-a2-object-real-value-term
           (putnam-2010-a2-quoted x)
           factor-precision))
         (intercept-value
          (putnam-2010-a2-object-real-value-term
           (putnam-2010-a2-quoted intercept)
           intercept-precision)))
    (list
     'lambda
     '(precision)
     (putnam-2010-a2-add-term
      (putnam-2010-a2-multiply-term
       slope-value x-value)
      intercept-value))))

(defun putnam-2010-a2-affine-solution-function
    (function slope intercept)
  (let ((actual
         (putnam-2010-a2-apply-term
          function (list 'x)))
        (expected
         (list 'putnam-2010-a2-affine-name
               (putnam-2010-a2-quoted slope)
               (putnam-2010-a2-quoted intercept)
               'x)))
    (list
     'lambda
     '(x)
     (putnam-2010-a2-implies-term
      (list 'putnam-2010-a2-real-name-p 'x)
      (list 'putnam-2010-a2-real-equal-p
            actual expected)))))

(defun putnam-2010-a2-affine-witness-p
    (slope intercept function)
  (and
   (putnam-2010-a2-real-name-p slope)
   (putnam-2010-a2-real-name-p intercept)
   (putnam-2010-a2-real-function-p function)
   (fn-equal
    (putnam-2010-a2-affine-solution-function
     function slope intercept)
    (putnam-2010-a2-true-function '(x)))))

(defun putnam-2010-a2-affine-witness-failure-function
    (function)
  (list
   'lambda
   '(slope intercept)
   (list
    'if
    (list 'putnam-2010-a2-affine-witness-p
          'slope
          'intercept
          (putnam-2010-a2-quoted function))
    (putnam-2010-a2-quoted nil)
    (putnam-2010-a2-quoted t))))

(defun putnam-2010-a2-affine-solution-p (function)
  (let ((failure-function
         (putnam-2010-a2-affine-witness-failure-function
          function))
        (true-function
         (putnam-2010-a2-true-function
          '(slope intercept))))
    (and
     (tamep-functionp failure-function)
     (tamep-functionp true-function)

(defun putnambench-putnam-2010-a2-statement (function)

title: putnam_2010_a2
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2010_a2
-- (putnambench__agda__putnam_2010_a2): differentiable real functions whose
-- derivative equals every positive-integer forward difference quotient are
-- exactly the affine functions. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module Putnam2010A2 where

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; _*_)

infix 4 _!=_ _<N_
infixr 3 _and_
infixr 2 _or_

data Bottom : Set where

Not : Set -> Set
Not A =
  A -> Bottom

_!=_ : {A : Set} -> A -> A -> Set
x != y =
  Not (x == y)

record _and_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data _or_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  left  : A -> A or B
  right : B -> A or B

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

record Iff (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor iff
  field
    forward  : A -> B
    backward : B -> A

data _<N_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set where
  zero<succ : {n : Nat} -> zero <N suc n
  succ<succ : {m n : Nat} -> m <N n -> suc m <N suc n

record CompleteOrderedRealField (R : Set) : Set1 where
  field
    zeroR oneR : R
    add multiply : R -> R -> R
    negate inverse : R -> R
    lessOrEqual : R -> R -> Set
    fromNat : Nat -> R

    one-not-zero :
      oneR != zeroR

    add-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> add x y == add y x
    add-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      add (add x y) z == add x (add y z)
    add-zero :
      (x : R) -> add x zeroR == x
    add-inverse :
      (x : R) -> add x (negate x) == zeroR

    multiply-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> multiply x y == multiply y x
    multiply-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply (multiply x y) z ==
      multiply x (multiply y z)
    multiply-one :
      (x : R) -> multiply x oneR == x
    multiply-zero :
      (x : R) -> multiply x zeroR == zeroR
    distribute :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply x (add y z) ==
      add (multiply x y) (multiply x z)
    inverse-zero :
      inverse zeroR == zeroR
    multiply-inverse :
      (x : R) ->
      x != zeroR ->
      multiply x (inverse x) == oneR

    order-reflexive :
      (x : R) -> lessOrEqual x x
    order-transitive :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y z ->
      lessOrEqual x z
    order-antisymmetric :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y x ->
      x == y
    order-total :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y or lessOrEqual y x
    add-order :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual (add z x) (add z y)
    multiply-nonnegative :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR x ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR y ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR (multiply x y)
    zero-less-than-one :
      lessOrEqual zeroR oneR and zeroR != oneR

    fromNat-zero :
      fromNat zero == zeroR
    fromNat-successor :
      (n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (suc n) == add (fromNat n) oneR
    fromNat-addition :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m + n) == add (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-multiplication :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m * n) == multiply (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-injective :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat m == fromNat n ->
      m == n

    archimedean :
      (x : R) ->
      Exists Nat
        (\ n ->
          lessOrEqual x (fromNat n))
    least-upper-bound :
      (P : R -> Set) ->
      Exists R P ->
      Exists R
        (\ upper ->
          (x : R) ->
          P x ->
          lessOrEqual x upper) ->
      Exists R
        (\ supremum ->
          ((x : R) ->
            P x ->
            lessOrEqual x supremum)
          and
          ((upper : R) ->
            ((x : R) ->
              P x ->
              lessOrEqual x upper) ->
            lessOrEqual supremum upper))

open CompleteOrderedRealField

subtract :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
subtract reals x y =
  add reals x (negate reals y)

divide :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
divide reals x y =
  multiply reals x (inverse reals y)

StrictLess :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
StrictLess reals x y =
  lessOrEqual reals x y and x != y

Positive :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  Set
Positive reals x =
  StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) x

CloseTo :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
CloseTo reals center radius x =
  StrictLess reals
    (subtract reals center radius)
    x
  and
  StrictLess reals
    x
    (add reals center radius)

differenceQuotient :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (R -> R) ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
differenceQuotient reals function point x =
  divide reals
    (subtract reals (function x) (function point))
    (subtract reals x point)

DerivativeAt :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (R -> R) ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
DerivativeAt {R} reals function point derivativeValue =
  (epsilon : R) ->
  Positive reals epsilon ->
  Exists R
    (\ delta ->
      Positive reals delta
      and
      ((x : R) ->
        CloseTo reals point delta x ->
        x != point ->
        CloseTo reals derivativeValue epsilon
          (differenceQuotient reals function point x)))

forwardDifference :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (R -> R) ->
  R ->
  Nat ->
  R
forwardDifference reals function x n =
  divide reals
    (subtract reals
      (function (add reals x (fromNat reals n)))
      (function x))
    (fromNat reals n)

SatisfiesDifferenceEquation :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (R -> R) ->
  Set
SatisfiesDifferenceEquation {R} reals function =
  Exists (R -> R)
    (\ derivative ->
      ((x : R) ->
        DerivativeAt reals function x (derivative x))
      and
      ((x : R) ->
        (n : Nat) ->
        zero <N n ->
        derivative x ==
          forwardDifference reals function x n))

Affine :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (R -> R) ->
  Set
Affine {R} reals function =
  Exists R
    (\ c ->
      Exists R
        (\ d ->
          (x : R) ->
          function x ==
            add reals
              (multiply reals c x)
              d))

putnam-2010-a2 : Set1
putnam-2010-a2 =
  (R : Set) ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) ->
  (function : R -> R) ->
  Iff
    (SatisfiesDifferenceEquation reals function)
    (Affine reals function)

(*
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2010_a2:
  the differentiable real functions whose derivative equals every positive-
  integer forward difference quotient are exactly the affine functions. This
  file contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open arithmeticTheory pred_setTheory realTheory real_topologyTheory;
open derivativeTheory;

val putnam_2010_a2 =
  ``{f : real -> real |
       f differentiable_on UNIV /\
       !x : real. !n : num.
         0 < n
         ==>
         vector_derivative f (at x) =
           (f (x + &n) - f x) / &n} =
    {f : real -> real |
       ?c d : real.
         !x : real. f x = c * x + d}``;

content:
$(
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact
  putnam_2010_a2: the differentiable real functions whose derivative equals
  every positive-integer forward difference quotient are exactly the affine
  real functions. This file contains no proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  RR ^m RR is set.mm's class of total real-valued functions on the reals.
  Requiring RR to be contained in dom ( RR _D F ) says that F is
  differentiable at every real point, without strengthening differentiability
  to continuous differentiability. NN is the class of positive integers, so
  the nested restricted quantifiers preserve the source's quantification over
  every real x and positive integer n.

  The right side keeps the affine coefficients internally existentially
  quantified over RR. Pointwise equality on RR is equivalent to equality of
  the corresponding total real functions. The final biconditional therefore
  directly classifies exactly the source functions. The declaration is the
  single unproved $a corpus statement; this database contains no $p proof
  statement.
$)

${
  $d F c d n x $.

  putnambench-putnam-2010-a2 $a |-
    A. F e. ( RR ^m RR )
      (
        (
          RR C_ dom ( RR _D F )
          /\
          A. x e. RR A. n e. NN
            ( ( RR _D F ) ` x )
            =
            (
              (
                ( F ` ( x + n ) )
                -
                ( F ` x )
              )
              /
              n
            )
        )
        <->
        E. c e. RR E. d e. RR A. x e. RR
          ( F ` x )
          =
          (
            ( c x. x )
            +
            d
          )
      )
  $.
$}

begin

::$P-
theorem
  for f being Function of REAL,REAL holds
    ((f is_differentiable_on [#]REAL &

% Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2010_a2:
% the differentiable real functions whose derivative equals every positive-
% integer forward difference quotient are exactly the affine functions.
% This file contains no proof.

putnam_2010_a2: THEORY
BEGIN
  real_function: TYPE = [real -> real]

  safe_div(numerator, denominator: real): real =
    IF denominator = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      numerator / denominator
    ENDIF

  has_derivative_at(
      f: real_function,
      derivative, point: real): bool =
    FORALL (epsilon_value: posreal):
      EXISTS (delta: posreal):
        FORALL (increment: real):
          (NOT (increment = 0) AND abs(increment) < delta)
            IMPLIES
              abs(
                f(point + increment) - f(point)
                  - derivative * increment)
                < epsilon_value * abs(increment)

  satisfies_forward_difference_identity(f: real_function): bool =
    FORALL (x: real), (n: nat):
      n > 0 IMPLIES
        has_derivative_at(
          f,
          safe_div(
            f(x + (n :: real)) - f(x),
            n :: real),
          x)

  putnam_2010_a2_solution(f: real_function): bool =
    EXISTS (c, d: real):
      FORALL (x: real):
        f(x) = c * x + d

  putnam_2010_a2: bool =
    FORALL (f: real_function):
      satisfies_forward_difference_identity(f)
        IFF putnam_2010_a2_solution(f)
END putnam_2010_a2

import Mathlib

/--
Suppose that the function $h : \mathbb{R}^2 → \mathbb{R}$ has continuous partial derivatives and satisfies the equation $h(x, y) = a \frac{\partial h}{\partial x}(x, y) +b \frac{\partial h}{\partial y}(x, y)$ for some constants $a, b$. Prove that if there is a constant $M$ such that $|h(x, y)| ≤ M$ for all $(x, y) ∈ \mathbb{R}^2$, then $h$ is identically zero.
-/
theorem putnam_2010_a3
    (h : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ)
    (a b M : ℝ)
    (H : ContDiff ℝ 1 h)
    (H' : ∀ x, h x = a * (fderiv ℝ h x (1, 0)) + b * (fderiv ℝ h x (0, 1)))
    (H'' : ∀ x, |h x| ≤ M) : h = 0 :=
  sorry

title: putnam_2010_a3
content:
(* Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2010_a3:
   a bounded continuously differentiable real function on the plane satisfying
   a constant-coefficient first-order partial differential equation vanishes
   identically. This file contains no proof. *)

From Stdlib Require Import Reals ClassicalEpsilon.

Open Scope R_scope.

Definition putnam_2010_a3_real_derivative
    (f : R -> R) (x : R) : R :=
  epsilon (inhabits (0 : R)) (fun d : R => derivable_pt_lim f x d).

Definition putnam_2010_a3_partial_x
    (h : (R * R)%type -> R) (p : (R * R)%type) : R :=
  putnam_2010_a3_real_derivative
    (fun x : R => h (x, snd p)) (fst p).

Definition putnam_2010_a3_partial_y
    (h : (R * R)%type -> R) (p : (R * R)%type) : R :=
  putnam_2010_a3_real_derivative
    (fun y : R => h (fst p, y)) (snd p).

Definition putnam_2010_a3_continuous_plane
    (f : (R * R)%type -> R) : Prop :=
  forall x y eps : R,
    eps > 0 ->
    exists delta : R,
      delta > 0 /\
      forall x' y' : R,
        Rabs (x' - x) < delta ->
        Rabs (y' - y) < delta ->
        Rabs (f (x', y') - f (x, y)) < eps.

Definition putnam_2010_a3_contdiff_one
    (h : (R * R)%type -> R) : Prop :=
  (forall x y : R,
    derivable_pt_lim
      (fun x' : R => h (x', y))
      x
      (putnam_2010_a3_partial_x h (x, y)) /\
    derivable_pt_lim
      (fun y' : R => h (x, y'))
      y
      (putnam_2010_a3_partial_y h (x, y))) /\
  putnam_2010_a3_continuous_plane
    (putnam_2010_a3_partial_x h) /\
  putnam_2010_a3_continuous_plane
    (putnam_2010_a3_partial_y h).

Theorem putnam_2010_a3
    (h : (R * R)%type -> R)
    (a b M : R)
    (H : putnam_2010_a3_contdiff_one h)
    (H' :
      forall p : (R * R)%type,
        h p =
        a * putnam_2010_a3_partial_x h p +
        b * putnam_2010_a3_partial_y h p)
    (H'' :
      forall p : (R * R)%type,
        Rabs (h p) <= M) :
  h = (fun _ : (R * R)%type => 0).
Admitted.

title: putnam_2010_a3
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench artifact putnam_2010_a3,
  concerning a bounded continuously differentiable solution of a
  constant-coefficient first-order partial differential equation.
  This file contains no proof.
*)

theory putnam_2010_a3
  imports Complex_Main
begin

theorem putnam_2010_a3:
  fixes h :: "real \<times> real \<Rightarrow> real"
    and a b M :: real
  assumes hC1_pde:
    "\<exists>hx hy :: real \<times> real \<Rightarrow> real.
      continuous_on UNIV hx \<and> continuous_on UNIV hy \<and>
      (\<forall>x y.
        ((\<lambda>u. h (u, y)) has_real_derivative hx (x, y)) (at x) \<and>
        ((\<lambda>v. h (x, v)) has_real_derivative hy (x, y)) (at y) \<and>
        h (x, y) = a * hx (x, y) + b * hy (x, y))"
    and hbounded: "\<forall>x y. \<bar>h (x, y)\<bar> \<le> M"
  shows "h = (\<lambda>_. 0)"
  sorry

end

title: putnam_2010_a3
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2010_a3:
  a bounded real-valued C1 function on the real plane satisfying a constant-
  coefficient first-order linear partial differential equation is identically
  zero. This file contains no proof.
*)

let statement =
  `let xrepl =
     \(x:real^2) (i:num) (t:real).
       (lambda k. if k = i then t else x$k):real^2 in
   let has_derivative_at =
     \(f:real->real) (d:real) (x:real).
       !e:real.
         &0 < e
         ==> ?delta:real.
               &0 < delta /\
               !y:real.
                 &0 < abs (y - x) /\ abs (y - x) < delta
                 ==> abs ((f y - f x) / (y - x) - d) < e in
   let partial =
     \(h:real^2->real) (i:num) (x:real^2).
       @d:real.
         has_derivative_at
           (\t:real. h (xrepl x i t)) d (x$i) in
   let continuous =
     \(f:real^2->real).
       !x:real^2. !e:real.
         &0 < e
         ==> ?delta:real.
               &0 < delta /\
               !y:real^2.
                 (!i:num.
                    1 <= i /\ i <= 2
                    ==> abs (y$i - x$i) < delta)
                 ==> abs (f y - f x) < e in
   let continuously_differentiable =
     \(h:real^2->real).
       (!i:num.
          1 <= i /\ i <= 2
          ==> (!x:real^2.
                 has_derivative_at
                   (\t:real. h (xrepl x i t))
                   (partial h i x) (x$i)) /\
              continuous (partial h i)) in
   !h:real^2->real. !a b M:real.
     continuously_differentiable h /\
     (!x:real^2.
        h x = a * partial h 1 x + b * partial h 2 x) /\
     (!x:real^2. abs (h x) <= M)
     ==>
     h = (\x:real^2. &0)`;;

title: putnam_2010_a3
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2010_a3:
;; a bounded continuously differentiable real-valued function on the real
;; plane satisfying a constant-coefficient first-order linear PDE is
;; identically zero. This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))

;; The scalar arguments present the reals as a Dedekind-complete ordered
;; field. Functions on the real plane are unbounded tame APPLY$ function
;; objects, and DEFUN-SK keeps the derivative functions and every mathematical
;; quantifier internal to the statement. Continuous Frechet differentiability
;; is expanded below using the max norm on R^2, which is equivalent to the
;; Euclidean norm used by the source.

(defun p10a3-member-p (carrier x)
  (if (apply$ carrier (list x)) t nil))

(defun p10a3-unary (operation x)
  (apply$ operation (list x)))

(defun p10a3-binary (operation x y)
  (apply$ operation (list x y)))

(defun p10a3-function-value (function x y)
  (apply$ function (list x y)))

(defun-sk p10a3-field-laws-p
    (carrier add multiply negate inverse zero one)
  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and (p10a3-member-p carrier x)
          (p10a3-member-p carrier y)
          (p10a3-member-p carrier z))
     (and
      (p10a3-member-p carrier
                      (p10a3-binary add x y))
      (p10a3-member-p carrier
                      (p10a3-binary multiply x y))
      (p10a3-member-p carrier
                      (p10a3-unary negate x))
      (p10a3-member-p carrier
                      (p10a3-unary inverse x))
      (equal
       (p10a3-binary add (p10a3-binary add x y) z)
       (p10a3-binary add x (p10a3-binary add y z)))
      (equal (p10a3-binary add x y)
             (p10a3-binary add y x))
      (equal (p10a3-binary add x zero) x)
      (equal
       (p10a3-binary add x (p10a3-unary negate x))
       zero)
      (equal
       (p10a3-binary multiply
                       (p10a3-binary multiply x y) z)
       (p10a3-binary multiply
                       x (p10a3-binary multiply y z)))
      (equal (p10a3-binary multiply x y)
             (p10a3-binary multiply y x))
      (equal (p10a3-binary multiply x one) x)
      (implies
       (equal x zero)
       (equal (p10a3-unary inverse x) zero))
      (implies
       (not (equal x zero))
       (equal
        (p10a3-binary multiply
                      x (p10a3-unary inverse x))
        one))
      (equal
       (p10a3-binary multiply
                     x (p10a3-binary add y z))
       (p10a3-binary add
                     (p10a3-binary multiply x y)
                     (p10a3-binary multiply x z)))))))

(defun-sk p10a3-order-laws-p
    (carrier add multiply zero less)
  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and (p10a3-member-p carrier x)
          (p10a3-member-p carrier y)
          (p10a3-member-p carrier z))
     (and
      (not (p10a3-binary less x x))
      (or (equal x y)
          (p10a3-binary less x y)
          (p10a3-binary less y x))
      (implies
       (and (p10a3-binary less x y)
            (p10a3-binary less y z))
       (p10a3-binary less x z))
      (implies
       (p10a3-binary less x y)
       (p10a3-binary
        less
        (p10a3-binary add x z)
        (p10a3-binary add y z)))
      (implies
       (and (p10a3-binary less zero x)
            (p10a3-binary less zero y))
       (p10a3-binary
        less zero (p10a3-binary multiply x y)))))))

(defun-sk p10a3-set-nonempty-p (carrier set)
  (exists (x)
    (and (p10a3-member-p carrier x)
         (apply$ set (list x)))))

(defun-sk p10a3-upper-bound-p (carrier less set bound)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (and (p10a3-member-p carrier x)
          (apply$ set (list x)))
     (not (p10a3-binary less bound x)))))

(defun-sk p10a3-bounded-above-p (carrier less set)
  (exists (bound)
    (and (p10a3-member-p carrier bound)
         (p10a3-upper-bound-p carrier less set bound))))

(defun-sk p10a3-supremum-p (carrier less set supremum)
  (forall (bound)
    (and
     (p10a3-member-p carrier supremum)
     (p10a3-upper-bound-p carrier less set supremum)
     (implies
      (and (p10a3-member-p carrier bound)
           (p10a3-upper-bound-p carrier less set bound))
      (not (p10a3-binary less bound supremum))))))

(defun-sk p10a3-has-supremum-p (carrier less set)
  (exists (supremum)
    (p10a3-supremum-p carrier less set supremum)))

(defun-sk p10a3-dedekind-complete-p (carrier less)
  (forall (set)
    (implies
     (and (tamep-functionp set)
          (p10a3-set-nonempty-p carrier set)
          (p10a3-bounded-above-p carrier less set))
     (p10a3-has-supremum-p carrier less set))))

(defun p10a3-real-field-p
    (carrier add multiply negate inverse zero one less)
  (and
   (tamep-functionp carrier)
   (tamep-functionp add)
   (tamep-functionp multiply)
   (tamep-functionp negate)
   (tamep-functionp inverse)
   (tamep-functionp less)
   (p10a3-member-p carrier zero)
   (p10a3-member-p carrier one)
   (not (equal zero one))
   (p10a3-field-laws-p
    carrier add multiply negate inverse zero one)
   (p10a3-order-laws-p carrier add multiply zero less)
   (p10a3-binary less zero one)
   (p10a3-dedekind-complete-p carrier less)))

(defun p10a3-add (add x y)
  (p10a3-binary add x y))

(defun p10a3-negate (negate x)
  (p10a3-unary negate x))

(defun p10a3-subtract (add negate x y)
  (p10a3-add add x (p10a3-negate negate y)))

(defun p10a3-multiply (multiply x y)
  (p10a3-binary multiply x y))

(defun p10a3-less-p (less x y)
  (if (p10a3-binary less x y) t nil))

(defun p10a3-less-equal-p (less x y)
  (not (p10a3-less-p less y x)))

(defun p10a3-absolute-value (less negate zero x)
  (if (p10a3-less-p less x zero)
      (p10a3-negate negate x)
    x))

(defun p10a3-positive-p (carrier less zero x)
  (and (p10a3-member-p carrier x)
       (p10a3-less-p less zero x)))

(defun p10a3-max (less x y)
  (if (p10a3-less-p less x y) y x))

(defun p10a3-plane-distance
    (less negate zero x-step y-step)
  (p10a3-max
   less
   (p10a3-absolute-value less negate zero x-step)
   (p10a3-absolute-value less negate zero y-step)))

(defun-sk p10a3-bivariate-real-function-p (carrier function)
  (forall (x y)
    (implies
     (and (p10a3-member-p carrier x)
          (p10a3-member-p carrier y))
     (p10a3-member-p
      carrier (p10a3-function-value function x y)))))

(defun p10a3-valid-bivariate-function-p (carrier function)
  (and (tamep-functionp function)
       (p10a3-bivariate-real-function-p carrier function)))

;; A linear functional on R^2 is represented by its values on (1,0) and
;; (0,1). The following residual condition is the Frechet derivative
;; definition in the max norm.

(defun p10a3-derivative-residual
    (function x-derivative y-derivative
     add multiply negate x y x-step y-step)
  (p10a3-subtract
   add negate
   (p10a3-subtract
    add negate
    (p10a3-function-value
     function
     (p10a3-add add x x-step)
     (p10a3-add add y y-step))
    (p10a3-function-value function x y))
   (p10a3-add
    add
    (p10a3-multiply
     multiply
     (p10a3-function-value x-derivative x y)
     x-step)
    (p10a3-multiply
     multiply
     (p10a3-function-value y-derivative x y)
     y-step))))

(defun-sk p10a3-frechet-neighborhood-p
    (carrier function x-derivative y-derivative
     add multiply negate zero less
     x y epsilon delta)
  (forall (x-step y-step)
    (implies
     (and
      (p10a3-member-p carrier x-step)
      (p10a3-member-p carrier y-step)
      (p10a3-less-p
       less
       (p10a3-plane-distance
        less negate zero x-step y-step)
       delta))
     (p10a3-less-equal-p
      less
      (p10a3-absolute-value
       less negate zero
       (p10a3-derivative-residual
        function x-derivative y-derivative
        add multiply negate x y x-step y-step))
      (p10a3-multiply
       multiply epsilon
       (p10a3-plane-distance
        less negate zero x-step y-step))))))

(defun-sk p10a3-frechet-radius-exists-p
    (carrier function x-derivative y-derivative
     add multiply negate zero less x y epsilon)
  (exists (delta)
    (and
     (p10a3-positive-p carrier less zero delta)
     (p10a3-frechet-neighborhood-p
      carrier function x-derivative y-derivative
      add multiply negate zero less
      x y epsilon delta))))

(defun-sk p10a3-has-frechet-derivative-at-p
    (carrier function x-derivative y-derivative
     add multiply negate zero less x y)
  (forall (epsilon)
    (implies
     (p10a3-positive-p carrier less zero epsilon)
     (p10a3-frechet-radius-exists-p
      carrier function x-derivative y-derivative
      add multiply negate zero less x y epsilon))))

(defun-sk p10a3-everywhere-frechet-differentiable-p
    (carrier function x-derivative y-derivative
     add multiply negate zero less)
  (forall (x y)
    (implies
     (and (p10a3-member-p carrier x)
          (p10a3-member-p carrier y))
     (p10a3-has-frechet-derivative-at-p
      carrier function x-derivative y-derivative
      add multiply negate zero less x y))))

;; Joint continuity of both derivative coordinates is equivalent, in finite
;; dimension, to continuity of the derivative as a continuous linear map.

(defun-sk p10a3-derivative-continuity-neighborhood-p
    (carrier x-derivative y-derivative
     add negate zero less x y epsilon delta)
  (forall (x-step y-step)
    (implies
     (and
      (p10a3-member-p carrier x-step)
      (p10a3-member-p carrier y-step)
      (p10a3-less-p
       less
       (p10a3-plane-distance
        less negate zero x-step y-step)
       delta))
     (and
      (p10a3-less-p
       less
       (p10a3-absolute-value
        less negate zero
        (p10a3-subtract
         add negate
         (p10a3-function-value
          x-derivative
          (p10a3-add add x x-step)
          (p10a3-add add y y-step))
         (p10a3-function-value x-derivative x y)))
       epsilon)
      (p10a3-less-p
       less
       (p10a3-absolute-value
        less negate zero
        (p10a3-subtract
         add negate
         (p10a3-function-value
          y-derivative
          (p10a3-add add x x-step)
          (p10a3-add add y y-step))
         (p10a3-function-value y-derivative x y)))
       epsilon)))))

(defun-sk p10a3-derivative-continuity-radius-exists-p
    (carrier x-derivative y-derivative
     add negate zero less x y epsilon)
  (exists (delta)
    (and
     (p10a3-positive-p carrier less zero delta)
     (p10a3-derivative-continuity-neighborhood-p
      carrier x-derivative y-derivative
      add negate zero less x y epsilon delta))))

(defun-sk p10a3-derivative-pair-continuous-at-p
    (carrier x-derivative y-derivative
     add negate zero less x y)
  (forall (epsilon)
    (implies
     (p10a3-positive-p carrier less zero epsilon)
     (p10a3-derivative-continuity-radius-exists-p
      carrier x-derivative y-derivative
      add negate zero less x y epsilon))))

(defun-sk p10a3-derivative-pair-continuous-p
    (carrier x-derivative y-derivative
     add negate zero less)
  (forall (x y)
    (implies
     (and (p10a3-member-p carrier x)
          (p10a3-member-p carrier y))
     (p10a3-derivative-pair-continuous-at-p
      carrier x-derivative y-derivative
      add negate zero less x y))))

(defun p10a3-continuously-differentiable-p
    (carrier function x-derivative y-derivative
     add multiply negate zero less)
  (and
   (p10a3-valid-bivariate-function-p
    carrier x-derivative)
   (p10a3-valid-bivariate-function-p
    carrier y-derivative)
   (p10a3-everywhere-frechet-differentiable-p
    carrier function x-derivative y-derivative
    add multiply negate zero less)
   (p10a3-derivative-pair-continuous-p
    carrier x-derivative y-derivative
    add negate zero less)))

(defun-sk p10a3-pde-p
    (carrier function x-derivative y-derivative
     add multiply a b)
  (forall (x y)
    (implies
     (and (p10a3-member-p carrier x)
          (p10a3-member-p carrier y))
     (equal
      (p10a3-function-value function x y)
      (p10a3-add
       add
       (p10a3-multiply
        multiply a
        (p10a3-function-value x-derivative x y))
       (p10a3-multiply
        multiply b
        (p10a3-function-value y-derivative x y)))))))

(defun-sk p10a3-globally-bounded-p
    (carrier function negate zero less bound)
  (forall (x y)
    (implies
     (and (p10a3-member-p carrier x)
          (p10a3-member-p carrier y))
     (p10a3-less-equal-p
      less
      (p10a3-absolute-value
       less negate zero
       (p10a3-function-value function x y))
      bound))))

;; The derivative pair is an internal witness for the derivative already
;; determined uniquely by the Frechet condition. Thus the PDE below refers to
;; exactly the source fderiv values on the two coordinate basis vectors.

(defun-sk p10a3-source-hypotheses-p
    (carrier function add multiply negate zero less a b bound)
  (exists (x-derivative y-derivative)
    (and
     (p10a3-continuously-differentiable-p
      carrier function x-derivative y-derivative
      add multiply negate zero less)
     (p10a3-pde-p
      carrier function x-derivative y-derivative
      add multiply a b)
     (p10a3-globally-bounded-p
      carrier function negate zero less bound))))

(defun-sk p10a3-identically-zero-p
    (carrier function zero)
  (forall (x y)
    (implies
     (and (p10a3-member-p carrier x)
          (p10a3-member-p carrier y))
     (equal (p10a3-function-value function x y)
            zero))))

(defun putnambench-putnam-2010-a3-statement
    (carrier add multiply negate inverse zero one less
     function a b bound)
  (implies
   (and
    (p10a3-real-field-p
     carrier add multiply negate inverse zero one less)
    (p10a3-valid-bivariate-function-p carrier function)
    (p10a3-member-p carrier a)
    (p10a3-member-p carrier b)
    (p10a3-member-p carrier bound)
    (p10a3-source-hypotheses-p
     carrier function add multiply negate zero less
     a b bound))
   (p10a3-identically-zero-p carrier function zero)))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

title: putnam_2010_a3
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2010_a3
-- (putnambench__agda__putnam_2010_a3): every bounded continuously
-- differentiable real function on the plane satisfying h = a h_x + b h_y is
-- identically zero. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module Main where

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; _*_)

infix 4 _!=_
infixr 3 _and_
infixr 2 _or_

data Bottom : Set where

Not : Set -> Set
Not A =
  A -> Bottom

_!=_ : {A : Set} -> A -> A -> Set
x != y =
  Not (x == y)

record _and_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data _or_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  left  : A -> A or B
  right : B -> A or B

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

record CompleteOrderedRealField (R : Set) : Set1 where
  field
    zeroR oneR : R
    add multiply : R -> R -> R
    negate inverse : R -> R
    lessOrEqual : R -> R -> Set
    fromNat : Nat -> R

    one-not-zero :
      oneR != zeroR

    add-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> add x y == add y x
    add-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      add (add x y) z == add x (add y z)
    add-zero :
      (x : R) -> add x zeroR == x
    add-inverse :
      (x : R) -> add x (negate x) == zeroR

    multiply-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> multiply x y == multiply y x
    multiply-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply (multiply x y) z ==
      multiply x (multiply y z)
    multiply-one :
      (x : R) -> multiply x oneR == x
    multiply-zero :
      (x : R) -> multiply x zeroR == zeroR
    distribute :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply x (add y z) ==
      add (multiply x y) (multiply x z)
    inverse-zero :
      inverse zeroR == zeroR
    multiply-inverse :
      (x : R) ->
      x != zeroR ->
      multiply x (inverse x) == oneR

    order-reflexive :
      (x : R) -> lessOrEqual x x
    order-transitive :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y z ->
      lessOrEqual x z
    order-antisymmetric :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y x ->
      x == y
    order-total :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y or lessOrEqual y x
    add-order :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual (add z x) (add z y)
    multiply-nonnegative :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR x ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR y ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR (multiply x y)
    zero-less-than-one :
      lessOrEqual zeroR oneR and zeroR != oneR

    fromNat-zero :
      fromNat zero == zeroR
    fromNat-successor :
      (n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (suc n) == add (fromNat n) oneR
    fromNat-addition :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m + n) == add (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-multiplication :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m * n) == multiply (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-injective :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat m == fromNat n ->
      m == n

    archimedean :
      (x : R) ->
      Exists Nat
        (\ n ->
          lessOrEqual x (fromNat n))
    least-upper-bound :
      (P : R -> Set) ->
      Exists R P ->
      Exists R
        (\ upper ->
          (x : R) ->
          P x ->
          lessOrEqual x upper) ->
      Exists R
        (\ supremum ->
          ((x : R) ->
            P x ->
            lessOrEqual x supremum)
          and
          ((upper : R) ->
            ((x : R) ->
              P x ->
              lessOrEqual x upper) ->
            lessOrEqual supremum upper))

open CompleteOrderedRealField

record Plane (R : Set) : Set where
  constructor point
  field
    x-coordinate : R
    y-coordinate : R

open Plane

subtract :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
subtract reals x y =
  add reals x (negate reals y)

divide :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
divide reals x y =
  multiply reals x (inverse reals y)

StrictLess :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
StrictLess reals x y =
  lessOrEqual reals x y and x != y

Positive :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  Set
Positive reals x =
  StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) x

CloseTo :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
CloseTo reals center radius x =
  StrictLess reals
    (subtract reals center radius)
    x
  and
  StrictLess reals
    x
    (add reals center radius)

PlaneCloseTo :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Plane R ->
  R ->
  Plane R ->
  Set
PlaneCloseTo reals center radius p =
  CloseTo reals
    (x-coordinate center)
    radius
    (x-coordinate p)
  and
  CloseTo reals
    (y-coordinate center)
    radius
    (y-coordinate p)

xDifferenceQuotient :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (Plane R -> R) ->
  Plane R ->
  R ->
  R
xDifferenceQuotient reals h p x =
  divide reals
    (subtract reals
      (h (point x (y-coordinate p)))
      (h p))
    (subtract reals x (x-coordinate p))

yDifferenceQuotient :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (Plane R -> R) ->
  Plane R ->
  R ->
  R
yDifferenceQuotient reals h p y =
  divide reals
    (subtract reals
      (h (point (x-coordinate p) y))
      (h p))
    (subtract reals y (y-coordinate p))

HasXPartialDerivativeAt :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (Plane R -> R) ->
  Plane R ->
  R ->
  Set
HasXPartialDerivativeAt {R} reals h p derivative =
  (epsilon : R) ->
  Positive reals epsilon ->
  Exists R
    (\ delta ->
      Positive reals delta
      and
      ((x : R) ->
        CloseTo reals (x-coordinate p) delta x ->
        x != x-coordinate p ->
        CloseTo reals derivative epsilon
          (xDifferenceQuotient reals h p x)))

HasYPartialDerivativeAt :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (Plane R -> R) ->
  Plane R ->
  R ->
  Set
HasYPartialDerivativeAt {R} reals h p derivative =
  (epsilon : R) ->
  Positive reals epsilon ->
  Exists R
    (\ delta ->
      Positive reals delta
      and
      ((y : R) ->
        CloseTo reals (y-coordinate p) delta y ->
        y != y-coordinate p ->
        CloseTo reals derivative epsilon
          (yDifferenceQuotient reals h p y)))

ContinuousAtOnPlane :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (Plane R -> R) ->
  Plane R ->
  Set
ContinuousAtOnPlane {R} reals function center =
  (epsilon : R) ->
  Positive reals epsilon ->
  Exists R
    (\ delta ->
      Positive reals delta
      and
      ((p : Plane R) ->
        PlaneCloseTo reals center delta p ->
        CloseTo reals
          (function center)
          epsilon
          (function p)))

ContinuousOnPlane :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (Plane R -> R) ->
  Set
ContinuousOnPlane {R} reals function =
  (p : Plane R) ->
  ContinuousAtOnPlane reals function p

ContinuousPartialsSolveEquation :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (Plane R -> R) ->
  R ->
  R ->
  (Plane R -> R) ->
  (Plane R -> R) ->
  Set
ContinuousPartialsSolveEquation {R} reals h a b partialX partialY =
  ((p : Plane R) ->
    HasXPartialDerivativeAt reals h p (partialX p))
  and
  ((p : Plane R) ->
    HasYPartialDerivativeAt reals h p (partialY p))
  and
  ContinuousOnPlane reals partialX
  and
  ContinuousOnPlane reals partialY
  and
  ((p : Plane R) ->
    h p ==
      add reals
        (multiply reals a (partialX p))
        (multiply reals b (partialY p)))

HasContinuousPartialsAndEquation :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (Plane R -> R) ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
HasContinuousPartialsAndEquation {R} reals h a b =
  Exists (Plane R -> R)
    (\ partialX ->
      Exists (Plane R -> R)
        (\ partialY ->
          ContinuousPartialsSolveEquation
            reals h a b partialX partialY))

BoundedBy :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (Plane R -> R) ->
  R ->
  Set
BoundedBy {R} reals h M =
  (p : Plane R) ->
  lessOrEqual reals (negate reals M) (h p)
  and
  lessOrEqual reals (h p) M

putnam-2010-a3 : Set1
putnam-2010-a3 =
  (R : Set) ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) ->
  (h : Plane R -> R) ->
  (a b M : R) ->
  HasContinuousPartialsAndEquation reals h a b ->
  BoundedBy reals h M ->
  (p : Plane R) ->
  h p == zeroR reals

(*
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2010_a3:
  a bounded continuously partially differentiable real function on the plane
  satisfying a constant-coefficient first-order PDE is identically zero. This
  file contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open pairTheory realTheory limTheory;

val putnam_2010_a3 =
  ``let partial_x =
      \h : (real # real) -> real.
      \p : real # real.
        diffn 1 (\t : real. h (t, SND p)) (FST p)
    in
    let partial_y =
      \h : (real # real) -> real.
      \p : real # real.
        diffn 1 (\t : real. h (FST p, t)) (SND p)
    in
    let plane_continuous =
      \g : (real # real) -> real.
        !p : real # real.
        !e : real.
          0 < e
          ==>
          ?d : real.
            0 < d /\
            !q : real # real.
              (FST q - FST p) pow 2 + (SND q - SND p) pow 2 < d
              ==>
              abs (g q - g p) < e
    in
    let continuously_partially_differentiable =
      \h : (real # real) -> real.
        (!p : real # real.
           higher_differentiable
             1
             (\t : real. h (t, SND p))
             (FST p) /\
           higher_differentiable
             1
             (\t : real. h (FST p, t))
             (SND p)) /\
        plane_continuous (partial_x h) /\
        plane_continuous (partial_y h)
    in
      !h : (real # real) -> real.
      !a b M : real.
        continuously_partially_differentiable h /\
        (!p : real # real.
           h p = a * partial_x h p + b * partial_y h p) /\
        (!p : real # real. abs (h p) <= M)
        ==>
        h = (\p : real # real. 0)``;

title: putnam_2010_a3
content:
$(
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact
  putnam_2010_a3: a bounded continuously differentiable real function on
  the real plane satisfying a constant-coefficient first-order partial
  differential equation is identically zero. This file contains no proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  P10A3Dx and P10A3Dy are the real derivatives of the coordinate slices of
  F at (x,y). Their zero fallbacks make them total, matching Lean's total
  fderiv operator; the fallbacks are inactive under P10A3C1.

  P10A3C1 requires both coordinate derivatives to exist everywhere and the
  two resulting derivative functions to be jointly continuous on RR X. RR.
  Its epsilon-delta clause uses rectangular neighborhoods, which induce the
  standard product topology. For real-valued functions on the real plane,
  this is equivalent to the source hypothesis ContDiff RR 1.

  The final assertion universally quantifies the total function F and the
  real constants a, b, and M. It preserves the pointwise PDE, the global
  absolute-value bound, and the pointwise form of equality with the zero
  function. All declarations are unproved $a statement encodings; this
  database contains no $p proof declaration.
$)

$c P10A3Dx P10A3Dy P10A3C1 $.

p10a3-dx-syntax $a class ( P10A3Dx F x y ) $.
p10a3-dy-syntax $a class ( P10A3Dy F x y ) $.
p10a3-c1-syntax $a wff ( P10A3C1 F ) $.

${
  $d F t x y $.

  p10a3-dx-definition $a |- (
    P10A3Dx F x y
  ) = if (
    x e.
      dom
        (
          RR _D
            ( t e. RR |-> ( F ` <. t , y >. ) )
        ) ,
    (
      (
        RR _D
          ( t e. RR |-> ( F ` <. t , y >. ) )
      )
      ` x
    ) ,
    0
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d F t x y $.

  p10a3-dy-definition $a |- (
    P10A3Dy F x y
  ) = if (
    y e.
      dom
        (
          RR _D
            ( t e. RR |-> ( F ` <. x , t >. ) )
        ) ,
    (
      (
        RR _D
          ( t e. RR |-> ( F ` <. x , t >. ) )
      )
      ` y
    ) ,
    0
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d F d e t u v x y $.

  p10a3-c1-definition $a |- (
    ( P10A3C1 F )
    <->
    (
      F e. ( RR ^m ( RR X. RR ) )
      /\
      (
        A. x e. RR A. y e. RR
          (
            x e.
              dom
                (
                  RR _D
                    ( t e. RR |-> ( F ` <. t , y >. ) )
                )
            /\
            y e.
              dom
                (
                  RR _D
                    ( t e. RR |-> ( F ` <. x , t >. ) )
                )
          )
        /\
        A. x e. RR A. y e. RR A. e e. RR
          (
            0 < e
            ->
            E. d e. RR
              (
                0 < d
                /\
                A. u e. RR A. v e. RR
                  (
                    (
                      ( abs ` ( u - x ) ) < d
                      /\
                      ( abs ` ( v - y ) ) < d
                    )
                    ->
                    (
                      (
                        abs
                        `
                        (
                          ( P10A3Dx F u v )
                          -
                          ( P10A3Dx F x y )
                        )
                      )
                      < e
                      /\
                      (
                        abs
                        `
                        (
                          ( P10A3Dy F u v )
                          -
                          ( P10A3Dy F x y )
                        )
                      )
                      < e
                    )
                  )
              )
          )
      )
    )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d F M a b x y $.

  putnambench-putnam-2010-a3 $a |-
    A. F e. ( RR ^m ( RR X. RR ) )
      A. a e. RR A. b e. RR A. M e. RR
        (
          (
            (
              ( P10A3C1 F )
              /\
              A. x e. RR A. y e. RR
                (
                  ( F ` <. x , y >. )
                  =
                  (
                    ( a x. ( P10A3Dx F x y ) )
                    +
                    ( b x. ( P10A3Dy F x y ) )
                  )
                )
            )
            /\
            A. x e. RR A. y e. RR
              ( abs ` ( F ` <. x , y >. ) ) <_ M
          )
          ->
          A. x e. RR A. y e. RR
            ( F ` <. x , y >. ) = 0
        )
  $.
$}

title: putnam_2010_a3
content:
% Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2010_a3:
% every bounded continuously differentiable real function on the real plane
% satisfying the stated constant-coefficient first-order partial differential
% equation is identically zero. This file contains no proof.

putnam_2010_a3: THEORY
BEGIN
  coordinate: TYPE = below(2)
  vector: TYPE = [coordinate -> real]
  scalar_field: TYPE = [vector -> real]

  replace_coordinate(
      x: vector,
      i: coordinate,
      value: real): vector =
    LAMBDA (j: coordinate):
      IF j = i THEN value ELSE x(j) ENDIF

  vectors_close(x, y: vector, radius: real): bool =
    FORALL (i: coordinate):
      abs(x(i) - y(i)) < radius

  continuous_at(f: scalar_field, x: vector): bool =
    FORALL (epsilon_value: posreal):
      EXISTS (delta: posreal):
        FORALL (y: vector):
          vectors_close(y, x, delta)
            IMPLIES abs(f(y) - f(x)) < epsilon_value

  continuous_field(f: scalar_field): bool =
    FORALL (x: vector):
      continuous_at(f, x)

  has_partial_derivative_at(
      f: scalar_field,
      i: coordinate,
      derivative: real,
      x: vector): bool =
    FORALL (epsilon_value: posreal):
      EXISTS (delta: posreal):
        FORALL (value: real):
          (value /= x(i)
            AND abs(value - x(i)) < delta)
          IMPLIES
            abs(
              f(replace_coordinate(x, i, value)) - f(x)
                - derivative * (value - x(i)))
              < epsilon_value * abs(value - x(i))

  partial_differentiable_at(
      f: scalar_field,
      i: coordinate,
      x: vector): bool =
    EXISTS (derivative: real):
      has_partial_derivative_at(f, i, derivative, x)

  partial_derivative_value(
      f: scalar_field,
      i: coordinate,
      x: vector): real =
    IF partial_differentiable_at(f, i, x) THEN
      epsilon(
        LAMBDA (derivative: real):
          has_partial_derivative_at(f, i, derivative, x))
    ELSE
      0
    ENDIF

  first_partial(
      f: scalar_field,
      i: coordinate): scalar_field =
    LAMBDA (x: vector):
      partial_derivative_value(f, i, x)

  continuously_differentiable(f: scalar_field): bool =
    continuous_field(f)
      AND (FORALL (i: coordinate), (x: vector):
        partial_differentiable_at(f, i, x))
      AND (FORALL (i: coordinate):
        continuous_field(first_partial(f, i)))

  satisfies_differential_equation(
      h: scalar_field,
      a, b: real): bool =
    FORALL (x: vector):
      h(x)
        = a * partial_derivative_value(h, 0, x)
            + b * partial_derivative_value(h, 1, x)

  bounded_by(h: scalar_field, M: real): bool =
    FORALL (x: vector):
      abs(h(x)) <= M

  identically_zero(h: scalar_field): bool =
    FORALL (x: vector):
      h(x) = 0

  putnam_2010_a3: bool =
    FORALL
        (h: scalar_field),
        (a, b, M: real):
      (continuously_differentiable(h)
        AND satisfies_differential_equation(h, a, b)
        AND bounded_by(h, M))
      IMPLIES identically_zero(h)
END putnam_2010_a3

;; Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2010_a4:
;; every positive integer n makes
;; 10^(10^(10^n)) + 10^(10^n) + 10^n - 1 nonprime. This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

;; For a natural number, checking all candidates from 2 through number-1 is
;; exactly the usual definition of primality.
(defun putnam-2010-a4-no-divisor-from-p (number divisor)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix (- number divisor))))
  (if (and (natp number)
           (natp divisor)
           (<= 2 divisor)
           (< divisor number))
      (and
       (not (equal (mod number divisor) 0))
       (putnam-2010-a4-no-divisor-from-p
        number (+ divisor 1)))
    t))

(defun putnam-2010-a4-primep (number)
  (and
   (natp number)
   (< 1 number)

% Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2010_a4:
% for every positive natural number n, the integer
% 10^(10^(10^n)) + 10^(10^n) + 10^n - 1 is not prime.
% This file contains no proof.

putnam_2010_a4: THEORY
BEGIN
  nat_divides(divisor: posnat, value: nat): bool =
    EXISTS (quotient: nat):
      value = divisor * quotient

  prime_nat(value: nat): bool =
    value >= 2
      AND FORALL (divisor: posnat):
        nat_divides(divisor, value)
          IMPLIES divisor = 1 OR divisor = value

  nat_predecessor(value: nat): nat =
    IF value = 0 THEN 0 ELSE value - 1 ENDIF

  putnam_expression(n: nat): nat =
    nat_predecessor(
      10 ^ (10 ^ (10 ^ n))
        + 10 ^ (10 ^ n)
        + 10 ^ n)

  putnam_2010_a4: bool =
    FORALL (n: nat):
      n > 0 IMPLIES NOT prime_nat(putnam_expression(n))
END putnam_2010_a4

(* Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2010_a5:
   a group embedded in real three-space whose products agree with cross
   products unless those cross products vanish. This file contains no proof. *)

From Stdlib Require Import Reals.

Open Scope R_scope.

Definition putnam_2010_a5_vector : Type := (R * (R * R))%type.

Definition putnam_2010_a5_cross
    (u v : putnam_2010_a5_vector) : putnam_2010_a5_vector :=
  let '(ux, (uy, uz)) := u in
  let '(vx, (vy, vz)) := v in
  (uy * vz - uz * vy,
   (uz * vx - ux * vz,
    ux * vy - uy * vx)).

Definition putnam_2010_a5_zero : putnam_2010_a5_vector :=
  (0, (0, 0)).

Record putnam_2010_a5_group (G : Type) : Type := {
  putnam_2010_a5_mul : G -> G -> G;
  putnam_2010_a5_one : G;
  putnam_2010_a5_inv : G -> G;
  putnam_2010_a5_assoc :
    forall x y z : G,
      putnam_2010_a5_mul x (putnam_2010_a5_mul y z) =
      putnam_2010_a5_mul (putnam_2010_a5_mul x y) z;
  putnam_2010_a5_left_identity :
    forall x : G, putnam_2010_a5_mul putnam_2010_a5_one x = x;
  putnam_2010_a5_right_identity :
    forall x : G, putnam_2010_a5_mul x putnam_2010_a5_one = x;
  putnam_2010_a5_left_inverse :
    forall x : G,
      putnam_2010_a5_mul (putnam_2010_a5_inv x) x =
      putnam_2010_a5_one;
  putnam_2010_a5_right_inverse :
    forall x : G,
      putnam_2010_a5_mul x (putnam_2010_a5_inv x) =
      putnam_2010_a5_one
}.

Arguments putnam_2010_a5_mul {G} _ _ _.

Theorem putnam_2010_a5
    (G : Type)
    (grp : putnam_2010_a5_group G)
    (i : G -> putnam_2010_a5_vector)
    (i_injective :
      forall x y : G, i x = i y -> x = y)
    (hcross :
      forall a b : G,
        putnam_2010_a5_cross (i a) (i b) =
          i (putnam_2010_a5_mul grp a b) \/
        putnam_2010_a5_cross (i a) (i b) =
          putnam_2010_a5_zero) :
  forall a b : G,
    putnam_2010_a5_cross (i a) (i b) =
      putnam_2010_a5_zero.
Admitted.

title: putnam_2010_a5
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2010_a5:
;; a group embedded in real three-space whose product is always either the
;; vector cross product or zero has identically zero cross products. This file
;; contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))

;; The arbitrary group and its embedding are conservative generic symbols.
;; PUTNAM-2010-A5-COORD-APPROX gives rational regular-Cauchy approximations
;; to each of the three real coordinates of an embedded group element.
;; Any source counterexample would persist in the countable subgroup generated
;; by its failing pair, so representing group elements by ACL2 objects does not
;; restrict the theorem. The internal precision quantifiers below make the
;; Cauchy-name comparisons exact equalities of represented real numbers.
(defstub putnam-2010-a5-group-member-p (x) t)
(defstub putnam-2010-a5-group-mul (x y) t)
(defstub putnam-2010-a5-group-inverse (x) t)
(defstub putnam-2010-a5-group-one () t)
(defstub putnam-2010-a5-coord-approx (x axis epsilon) t)

(defun putnam-2010-a5-axis-p (axis)
  (and (integerp axis)
       (<= 0 axis)
       (< axis 3)))

(defun putnam-2010-a5-positive-rational-p (x)
  (and (rationalp x)
       (< 0 x)))

;; Every coordinate name converges to a unique real number, and every real
;; coordinate admits such a name.
(defun-sk putnam-2010-a5-regular-embedding-p ()
  (forall (x axis epsilon eta)
    (implies
     (and
      (putnam-2010-a5-group-member-p x)
      (putnam-2010-a5-axis-p axis)
      (putnam-2010-a5-positive-rational-p epsilon)
      (putnam-2010-a5-positive-rational-p eta))
     (let ((left
            (putnam-2010-a5-coord-approx
             x axis epsilon))
           (right
            (putnam-2010-a5-coord-approx
             x axis eta)))
       (and
        (rationalp left)
        (rationalp right)
        (<= (abs (- left right))
            (+ epsilon eta)))))))

;; For regular names this is exactly equality of their represented reals.
(defun-sk putnam-2010-a5-coordinate-equal-p
    (x y axis)
  (forall (epsilon)
    (implies
     (putnam-2010-a5-positive-rational-p epsilon)
     (<=
      (abs
       (-
        (putnam-2010-a5-coord-approx
         x axis epsilon)
        (putnam-2010-a5-coord-approx
         y axis epsilon)))
      (* 2 epsilon)))))

(defun putnam-2010-a5-embedded-vector-equal-p (x y)
  (and
   (putnam-2010-a5-coordinate-equal-p x y 0)
   (putnam-2010-a5-coordinate-equal-p x y 1)
   (putnam-2010-a5-coordinate-equal-p x y 2)))

(defun-sk putnam-2010-a5-embedding-injective-p ()
  (forall (x y)
    (implies
     (and
      (putnam-2010-a5-group-member-p x)
      (putnam-2010-a5-group-member-p y)
      (putnam-2010-a5-embedded-vector-equal-p x y))
     (equal x y))))

(defun-sk putnam-2010-a5-group-laws-p ()
  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (putnam-2010-a5-group-member-p x)
      (putnam-2010-a5-group-member-p y)
      (putnam-2010-a5-group-member-p z))
     (and
      (putnam-2010-a5-group-member-p
       (putnam-2010-a5-group-mul x y))
      (putnam-2010-a5-group-member-p
       (putnam-2010-a5-group-inverse x))
      (equal
       (putnam-2010-a5-group-mul
        (putnam-2010-a5-group-mul x y)
        z)
       (putnam-2010-a5-group-mul
        x
        (putnam-2010-a5-group-mul y z)))
      (equal
       (putnam-2010-a5-group-mul
        (putnam-2010-a5-group-one)
        x)
       x)
      (equal
       (putnam-2010-a5-group-mul
        x
        (putnam-2010-a5-group-one))
       x)
      (equal
       (putnam-2010-a5-group-mul
        (putnam-2010-a5-group-inverse x)
        x)
       (putnam-2010-a5-group-one))
      (equal
       (putnam-2010-a5-group-mul
        x
        (putnam-2010-a5-group-inverse x))
       (putnam-2010-a5-group-one))))))

(defun putnam-2010-a5-group-p ()
  (and
   (putnam-2010-a5-group-member-p
    (putnam-2010-a5-group-one))
   (putnam-2010-a5-group-laws-p)))

(defun putnam-2010-a5-cross-coordinate-sample
    (x y axis precision)
  (cond
   ((equal axis 0)
    (-
     (*
      (putnam-2010-a5-coord-approx x 1 precision)
      (putnam-2010-a5-coord-approx y 2 precision))
     (*
      (putnam-2010-a5-coord-approx x 2 precision)
      (putnam-2010-a5-coord-approx y 1 precision))))
   ((equal axis 1)
    (-
     (*
      (putnam-2010-a5-coord-approx x 2 precision)
      (putnam-2010-a5-coord-approx y 0 precision))
     (*
      (putnam-2010-a5-coord-approx x 0 precision)
      (putnam-2010-a5-coord-approx y 2 precision))))
   (t
    (-
     (*
      (putnam-2010-a5-coord-approx x 0 precision)
      (putnam-2010-a5-coord-approx y 1 precision))
     (*
      (putnam-2010-a5-coord-approx x 1 precision)
      (putnam-2010-a5-coord-approx y 0 precision))))))

;; As precision tends to zero, the sample converges to the corresponding
;; coordinate of the usual cross product.
(defun putnam-2010-a5-cross-target-witness-p
    (x y target axis epsilon precision)
  (and
   (putnam-2010-a5-positive-rational-p precision)
   (<= precision epsilon)
   (<=
    (abs
     (-
      (putnam-2010-a5-cross-coordinate-sample
       x y axis precision)
      (putnam-2010-a5-coord-approx
       target axis precision)))
    epsilon)))

(defun-sk putnam-2010-a5-cross-target-precision-p
    (x y target axis epsilon)
  (exists (precision)
    (putnam-2010-a5-cross-target-witness-p
     x y target axis epsilon precision)))

(defun-sk putnam-2010-a5-cross-coordinate-equal-p
    (x y target axis)
  (forall (epsilon)
    (implies
     (putnam-2010-a5-positive-rational-p epsilon)
     (putnam-2010-a5-cross-target-precision-p
      x y target axis epsilon))))

(defun putnam-2010-a5-cross-equals-embedding-p
    (x y target)
  (and
   (putnam-2010-a5-cross-coordinate-equal-p
    x y target 0)
   (putnam-2010-a5-cross-coordinate-equal-p
    x y target 1)
   (putnam-2010-a5-cross-coordinate-equal-p
    x y target 2)))

(defun putnam-2010-a5-zero-cross-witness-p
    (x y axis epsilon precision)
  (and
   (putnam-2010-a5-positive-rational-p precision)
   (<= precision epsilon)
   (<=
    (abs
     (putnam-2010-a5-cross-coordinate-sample
      x y axis precision))
    epsilon)))

(defun-sk putnam-2010-a5-zero-cross-precision-p
    (x y axis epsilon)
  (exists (precision)
    (putnam-2010-a5-zero-cross-witness-p
     x y axis epsilon precision)))

(defun-sk putnam-2010-a5-zero-cross-coordinate-p
    (x y axis)
  (forall (epsilon)
    (implies
     (putnam-2010-a5-positive-rational-p epsilon)
     (putnam-2010-a5-zero-cross-precision-p
      x y axis epsilon))))

(defun putnam-2010-a5-zero-cross-p (x y)
  (and
   (putnam-2010-a5-zero-cross-coordinate-p x y 0)
   (putnam-2010-a5-zero-cross-coordinate-p x y 1)
   (putnam-2010-a5-zero-cross-coordinate-p x y 2)))

(defun-sk putnam-2010-a5-cross-hypothesis-p ()
  (forall (x y)
    (implies
     (and
      (putnam-2010-a5-group-member-p x)
      (putnam-2010-a5-group-member-p y))
     (or
      (putnam-2010-a5-cross-equals-embedding-p
       x y (putnam-2010-a5-group-mul x y))
      (putnam-2010-a5-zero-cross-p x y)))))

(defun-sk putnam-2010-a5-all-cross-products-zero-p ()
  (forall (x y)
    (implies
     (and
      (putnam-2010-a5-group-member-p x)
      (putnam-2010-a5-group-member-p y))
     (putnam-2010-a5-zero-cross-p x y))))

(defun putnambench-putnam-2010-a5-statement ()
  (implies
   (and
    (putnam-2010-a5-regular-embedding-p)
    (putnam-2010-a5-embedding-injective-p)
    (putnam-2010-a5-group-p)
    (putnam-2010-a5-cross-hypothesis-p))
   (putnam-2010-a5-all-cross-products-zero-p)))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q
