content:
;; Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench artifact putnam_2011_a2:
;; positive sequences satisfying a(0)=b(0)=1 and
;; b(n)=b(n-1)*a(n)-2, with b bounded, make
;; sum_i 1/(a(0)*...*a(i)) converge to 3/2. This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))

;; A and B are arbitrary conservative sequence symbols over an Archimedean
;; ordered field. This is ACL2's native generic-function idiom and preserves
;; arbitrary real-valued sequences without restricting them to APPLY$ codes.
(defstub p2011a2-scalar-p (x) t)
(defstub p2011a2-add-op (x y) t)
(defstub p2011a2-multiply-op (x y) t)
(defstub p2011a2-negate-op (x) t)
(defstub p2011a2-inverse-op (x) t)
(defstub p2011a2-less-op (x y) t)
(defstub p2011a2-rational-embed (q) t)
(defstub p2011a2-arch-bound (x) t)
(defstub p2011a2-a (n) t)
(defstub p2011a2-b (n) t)

(defun p2011a2-add (x y)
  (p2011a2-add-op x y))

(defun p2011a2-mul (x y)
  (p2011a2-multiply-op x y))

(defun p2011a2-neg (x)
  (p2011a2-negate-op x))

(defun p2011a2-inv (x)
  (p2011a2-inverse-op x))

(defun p2011a2-sub (x y)
  (p2011a2-add x (p2011a2-neg y)))

(defun p2011a2-less (x y)
  (if (p2011a2-less-op x y) t nil))

(defun p2011a2-less-equal (x y)
  (not (p2011a2-less y x)))

(defun p2011a2-abs (x zero)
  (if (p2011a2-less x zero)
      (p2011a2-neg x)
    x))

(defun-sk p2011a2-field-laws-p (zero one)
  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (p2011a2-scalar-p x)
      (p2011a2-scalar-p y)
      (p2011a2-scalar-p z))
     (and
      (p2011a2-scalar-p (p2011a2-add x y))
      (p2011a2-scalar-p (p2011a2-mul x y))
      (p2011a2-scalar-p (p2011a2-neg x))
      (implies
       (not (equal x zero))
       (p2011a2-scalar-p (p2011a2-inv x)))
      (equal (p2011a2-add (p2011a2-add x y) z)
             (p2011a2-add x (p2011a2-add y z)))
      (equal (p2011a2-add x y)
             (p2011a2-add y x))
      (equal (p2011a2-add x zero) x)
      (equal (p2011a2-add x (p2011a2-neg x)) zero)
      (equal (p2011a2-mul (p2011a2-mul x y) z)
             (p2011a2-mul x (p2011a2-mul y z)))
      (equal (p2011a2-mul x y)
             (p2011a2-mul y x))
      (equal (p2011a2-mul x one) x)
      (implies
       (not (equal x zero))
       (equal (p2011a2-mul x (p2011a2-inv x)) one))
      (equal
       (p2011a2-mul x (p2011a2-add y z))
       (p2011a2-add
        (p2011a2-mul x y)
        (p2011a2-mul x z)))))))

(defun-sk p2011a2-order-laws-p (zero)
  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (p2011a2-scalar-p x)
      (p2011a2-scalar-p y)
      (p2011a2-scalar-p z))
     (and
      (not (p2011a2-less x x))
      (or
       (equal x y)
       (p2011a2-less x y)
       (p2011a2-less y x))
      (implies
       (and
        (p2011a2-less x y)
        (p2011a2-less y z))
       (p2011a2-less x z))
      (implies
       (p2011a2-less x y)
       (p2011a2-less
        (p2011a2-add x z)
        (p2011a2-add y z)))
      (implies
       (and
        (p2011a2-less zero x)
        (p2011a2-less zero y))
       (p2011a2-less zero (p2011a2-mul x y)))))))

(defun-sk p2011a2-rational-embedding-laws-p ()
  (forall (q r)
    (implies
     (and (rationalp q) (rationalp r))
     (and
      (p2011a2-scalar-p (p2011a2-rational-embed q))
      (equal
       (p2011a2-rational-embed (+ q r))
       (p2011a2-add
        (p2011a2-rational-embed q)
        (p2011a2-rational-embed r)))
      (equal
       (p2011a2-rational-embed (* q r))
       (p2011a2-mul
        (p2011a2-rational-embed q)
        (p2011a2-rational-embed r)))
      (iff
       (< q r)
       (p2011a2-less
        (p2011a2-rational-embed q)
        (p2011a2-rational-embed r)))))))

(defun-sk p2011a2-archimedean-p ()
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (p2011a2-scalar-p x)
     (and
      (natp (p2011a2-arch-bound x))
      (p2011a2-less
       x
       (p2011a2-rational-embed
        (p2011a2-arch-bound x)))))))

(defun p2011a2-real-scalar-structure-p (zero one)
  (and
   (p2011a2-scalar-p zero)
   (p2011a2-scalar-p one)
   (not (equal zero one))
   (p2011a2-less zero one)
   (equal (p2011a2-rational-embed 0) zero)
   (equal (p2011a2-rational-embed 1) one)
   (p2011a2-field-laws-p zero one)
   (p2011a2-order-laws-p zero)
   (p2011a2-rational-embedding-laws-p)
   (p2011a2-archimedean-p)))

(defun-sk p2011a2-positive-sequences-p (zero)
  (forall (n)
    (implies
     (natp n)
     (and
      (p2011a2-scalar-p (p2011a2-a n))
      (p2011a2-scalar-p (p2011a2-b n))
      (p2011a2-less zero (p2011a2-a n))
      (p2011a2-less zero (p2011a2-b n))))))

(defun-sk p2011a2-recurrence-p ()
  (forall (n)
    (implies
     (and (natp n) (<= 1 n))
     (equal
      (p2011a2-b n)
      (p2011a2-sub
       (p2011a2-mul
        (p2011a2-b (- n 1))
        (p2011a2-a n))
       (p2011a2-rational-embed 2))))))

(defun-sk p2011a2-bound-p (bound zero)
  (forall (n)
    (implies
     (natp n)
     (p2011a2-less-equal
      (p2011a2-abs (p2011a2-b n) zero)
      bound))))

(defun-sk p2011a2-bounded-p (zero)
  (exists (bound)
    (and
     (p2011a2-scalar-p bound)
     (p2011a2-bound-p bound zero))))

;; Product over Fin terms: a(0)*...*a(terms-1).
(defun p2011a2-product-prefix (terms one)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix terms)))
  (if (zp terms)
      one
    (p2011a2-mul
     (p2011a2-product-prefix (- terms 1) one)
     (p2011a2-a (- terms 1)))))

;; Sum over i : Fin terms of 1/(product over j : Fin (i+1) of a(j)).
(defun p2011a2-partial-sum (terms zero one)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix terms)))
  (if (zp terms)
      zero
    (p2011a2-add
     (p2011a2-partial-sum (- terms 1) zero one)
     (p2011a2-inv
      (p2011a2-product-prefix terms one)))))

(defun-sk p2011a2-limit-tail-p
    (epsilon cutoff zero one)
  (forall (terms)
    (implies
     (and (natp terms) (<= cutoff terms))
     (p2011a2-less
      (p2011a2-abs
       (p2011a2-sub
        (p2011a2-partial-sum terms zero one)
        (p2011a2-rational-embed 3/2))
       zero)
      (p2011a2-rational-embed epsilon)))))

(defun-sk p2011a2-limit-cutoff-exists-p
    (epsilon zero one)
  (exists (cutoff)
    (and
     (natp cutoff)
     (p2011a2-limit-tail-p
      epsilon cutoff zero one))))

(defun-sk p2011a2-converges-to-three-halves-p
    (zero one)
  (forall (epsilon)
    (implies
     (and (rationalp epsilon) (< 0 epsilon))
     (p2011a2-limit-cutoff-exists-p
      epsilon zero one))))

(defun putnambench-putnam-2011-a2-statement (zero one)
  (implies
   (and
    (p2011a2-real-scalar-structure-p zero one)
    (p2011a2-positive-sequences-p zero)
    (equal (p2011a2-a 0) one)
    (equal (p2011a2-b 0) one)
    (p2011a2-recurrence-p)
    (p2011a2-bounded-p zero))
   (p2011a2-converges-to-three-halves-p zero one)))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

title: putnam_2011_a2
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2011_a2
-- (putnambench__agda__putnam_2011_a2): positive real sequences satisfying the
-- given recurrence have reciprocal-product series sum 3 / 2. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module Putnam2011A2 where

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; _*_)

infix 4 _!=_ _<=N_
infixr 3 _and_
infixr 2 _or_

data Bottom : Set where

Not : Set -> Set
Not A =
  A -> Bottom

_!=_ : {A : Set} -> A -> A -> Set
x != y =
  Not (x == y)

record _and_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data _or_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  left  : A -> A or B
  right : B -> A or B

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

data _<=N_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set where
  zero<=N   : {n : Nat} -> zero <=N n
  suc<=sucN : {m n : Nat} -> m <=N n -> suc m <=N suc n

predecessor : Nat -> Nat
predecessor zero =
  zero
predecessor (suc n) =
  n

record CompleteOrderedRealField (R : Set) : Set1 where
  field
    zeroR oneR : R
    add multiply : R -> R -> R
    negate inverse : R -> R
    lessOrEqual : R -> R -> Set
    fromNat : Nat -> R

    one-not-zero :
      oneR != zeroR

    add-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> add x y == add y x
    add-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      add (add x y) z == add x (add y z)
    add-zero :
      (x : R) -> add x zeroR == x
    add-inverse :
      (x : R) -> add x (negate x) == zeroR

    multiply-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> multiply x y == multiply y x
    multiply-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply (multiply x y) z ==
      multiply x (multiply y z)
    multiply-one :
      (x : R) -> multiply x oneR == x
    multiply-zero :
      (x : R) -> multiply x zeroR == zeroR
    distribute :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply x (add y z) ==
      add (multiply x y) (multiply x z)
    inverse-zero :
      inverse zeroR == zeroR
    multiply-inverse :
      (x : R) ->
      x != zeroR ->
      multiply x (inverse x) == oneR

    order-reflexive :
      (x : R) -> lessOrEqual x x
    order-transitive :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y z ->
      lessOrEqual x z
    order-antisymmetric :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y x ->
      x == y
    order-total :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y or lessOrEqual y x
    add-order :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual (add z x) (add z y)
    multiply-nonnegative :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR x ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR y ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR (multiply x y)
    zero-less-than-one :
      lessOrEqual zeroR oneR and zeroR != oneR

    fromNat-zero :
      fromNat zero == zeroR
    fromNat-successor :
      (n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (suc n) == add (fromNat n) oneR
    fromNat-addition :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m + n) == add (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-multiplication :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m * n) == multiply (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-injective :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat m == fromNat n ->
      m == n

    archimedean :
      (x : R) ->
      Exists Nat
        (\ n ->
          lessOrEqual x (fromNat n))
    least-upper-bound :
      (P : R -> Set) ->
      Exists R P ->
      Exists R
        (\ upper ->
          (x : R) ->
          P x ->
          lessOrEqual x upper) ->
      Exists R
        (\ supremum ->
          ((x : R) ->
            P x ->
            lessOrEqual x supremum)
          and
          ((upper : R) ->
            ((x : R) ->
              P x ->
              lessOrEqual x upper) ->
            lessOrEqual supremum upper))

open CompleteOrderedRealField

subtract :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
subtract reals x y =
  add reals x (negate reals y)

divide :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
divide reals x y =
  multiply reals x (inverse reals y)

StrictLess :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
StrictLess reals x y =
  lessOrEqual reals x y and x != y

CloseTo :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
CloseTo reals center radius x =
  StrictLess reals
    (subtract reals center radius)
    x
  and
  StrictLess reals
    x
    (add reals center radius)

sumFirst :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Nat ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  R
sumFirst reals zero term =
  zeroR reals
sumFirst reals (suc n) term =
  add reals
    (sumFirst reals n term)
    (term n)

productFirst :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Nat ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  R
productFirst reals zero factors =
  oneR reals
productFirst reals (suc n) factors =
  multiply reals
    (productFirst reals n factors)
    (factors n)

ConvergesTo :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  R ->
  Set
ConvergesTo {R} reals sequence limit =
  (epsilon : R) ->
  StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) epsilon ->
  Exists Nat
    (\ cutoff ->
      (n : Nat) ->
      cutoff <=N n ->
      CloseTo reals limit epsilon (sequence n))

module Putnam2011A2Statement
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) where

  twoN : Nat
  twoN =
    suc (suc zero)

  threeN : Nat
  threeN =
    suc twoN

  two : R
  two =
    fromNat reals twoN

  threeHalves : R
  threeHalves =
    divide reals
      (fromNat reals threeN)
      two

  PositiveSequence : (Nat -> R) -> Set
  PositiveSequence sequence =
    (n : Nat) ->
    StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) (sequence n)

  BoundedSequence : (Nat -> R) -> Set
  BoundedSequence sequence =
    Exists R
      (\ bound ->
        (n : Nat) ->
        lessOrEqual reals
          (negate reals bound)
          (sequence n)
        and
        lessOrEqual reals
          (sequence n)
          bound)

  reciprocalProductTerm :
    (Nat -> R) ->
    Nat ->
    R
  reciprocalProductTerm a i =
    divide reals
      (oneR reals)
      (productFirst reals (suc i) a)

  partialSums :
    (Nat -> R) ->
    Nat ->
    R
  partialSums a n =
    sumFirst reals n (reciprocalProductTerm a)

  proposition : Set
  proposition =
    (a b : Nat -> R) ->
    PositiveSequence a ->
    PositiveSequence b ->
    (a zero == oneR reals and b zero == oneR reals) ->
    ((n : Nat) ->
      suc zero <=N n ->
      b n ==
      subtract reals
        (multiply reals
          (b (predecessor n))
          (a n))
        two) ->
    BoundedSequence b ->
    ConvergesTo reals
      (partialSums a)
      threeHalves

putnam-2011-a2 : Set1
putnam-2011-a2 =
  (R : Set) ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) ->
  Putnam2011A2Statement.proposition reals

(*
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2011_a2:
  positive real sequences satisfying the stated recurrence and boundedness
  condition have reciprocal prefix-product series converging to 3/2. This file
  contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open arithmeticTheory pred_setTheory realTheory real_sigmaTheory;
open real_topologyTheory;

val putnam_2011_a2 =
  ``!a b : num -> real.
      (!n : num. 0 < a n /\ 0 < b n) /\
      a 0 = 1 /\
      b 0 = 1 /\
      (!n : num.
         1 <= n
         ==>
         b n = b (n - 1) * a n - 2) /\
      (?B : real. !n : num. abs (b n) <= B)
      ==>
      ((\n : num.
          SIGMA
            (\i : num.
               1 / REAL_PROD_IMAGE a (count (i + 1)))
            (count n)) -->
        (3 / 2))
      sequentially``;

title: putnam_2011_a2
content:
$(
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact
  putnam_2011_a2: convergence and evaluation as three halves of the reciprocal
  product series associated with two positive real sequences satisfying the
  stated recurrence and boundedness condition. This file contains no proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  The sequences a and b are arbitrary NN0-indexed real sequences. The
  zero-based indexing follows the primary Lean formalization: a(0) = b(0) = 1,
  the recurrence starts at n = 1, and the n-th partial sum contains the terms
  indexed by i in 0 ..^ n, with each denominator the product over 0 ... i.
  This is exactly the published one-based series after shifting indices.

  The secondary Rocq source shifts the recurrence and initial values to zero
  but leaves its displayed sum starting at one, thereby omitting the initial
  term 1. The assertion below follows the published problem and the primary
  Lean source, and uses the explicit value 3 / 2 recorded by Rocq and the
  solution annotations. The final declaration is the single unproved $a
  corpus statement; this database contains no $p proof statement.
$)

${
  $d a b c i j n $.

  putnambench-putnam-2011-a2 $a |-
    A. a e. ( RR ^m NN0 )
    A. b e. ( RR ^m NN0 )
      (
        (
          (
            (
              A. n e. NN0
                (
                  0 < ( a ` n )
                  /\
                  0 < ( b ` n )
                )
              /\
              (
                ( a ` 0 ) = 1
                /\
                ( b ` 0 ) = 1
              )
            )
            /\
            A. n e. NN0
              (
                1 <_ n
                ->
                ( b ` n )
                =
                (
                  (
                    ( b ` ( n - 1 ) )
                    x.
                    ( a ` n )
                  )
                  -
                  2
                )
              )
          )
          /\
          E. c e. RR
            A. n e. NN0
              ( abs ` ( b ` n ) ) <_ c
        )
        ->
        (
          n e. NN0 |->
            sum_ i e. ( 0 ..^ n )
              (
                1
                /
                (
                  prod_ j e. ( 0 ... i )
                    ( a ` j )
                )
              )
        )
        ~~>
        ( 3 / 2 )
      )
  $.
$}

title: putnam_2011_a2
content:
% Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2011_a2:
% positive real sequences satisfying a recurrence with bounded second sequence
% have reciprocal-product series converging to 3/2. This file contains no proof.

putnam_2011_a2: THEORY
BEGIN
  real_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> real]

  safe_div(numerator, denominator: real): real =
    IF denominator = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      numerator / denominator
    ENDIF

  prefix_product(a: real_sequence, count: nat): RECURSIVE real =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      1
    ELSE
      prefix_product(a, count - 1) * a(count - 1)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  reciprocal_product_partial_sum(
      a: real_sequence,
      count: nat): RECURSIVE real =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      reciprocal_product_partial_sum(a, count - 1)
        + safe_div(1, prefix_product(a, count))
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  converges_to(sequence: real_sequence, value: real): bool =
    FORALL (epsilon_value: posreal):
      EXISTS (cutoff: nat):
        FORALL (index: nat):
          cutoff <= index IMPLIES
            abs(sequence(index) - value) < epsilon_value

  putnam_2011_a2_solution: real = 3 / 2

  putnam_2011_a2: bool =
    FORALL (a, b: real_sequence):
      ((FORALL (n: nat): 0 < a(n) AND 0 < b(n))
        AND a(0) = 1
        AND b(0) = 1
        AND (FORALL (n: nat):
          1 <= n IMPLIES
            b(n) = b(n - 1) * a(n) - 2)
        AND (EXISTS (bound: real):
          FORALL (n: nat): abs(b(n)) <= bound))
      IMPLIES
        converges_to(
          LAMBDA (count: nat):
            reciprocal_product_partial_sum(a, count),
          putnam_2011_a2_solution)
END putnam_2011_a2

Theorem putnam_2011_a3
    : let (c, L) := putnam_2011_a3_solution in
      L > 0 /\
      is_lim
        (fun r : R =>
          (Rpower r c *
           RInt (fun x => Rpower x r * sin x) 0 (PI / 2)) /
          RInt (fun x => Rpower x r * cos x) 0 (PI / 2))
        p_infty
        L.
Proof. Admitted.

title: putnam_2011_a3
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2011_a3:
;; the pair c = -1 and L = 2/pi gives the required real at-top limit of a
;; ratio of sine- and cosine-weighted power integrals. This file contains no
;; proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))

;; Carriers, sets, and functions are tame APPLY$ function objects. FN-EQUAL
;; supplies unbounded quantification. The scalar structure is a
;; Dedekind-complete ordered field, hence a presentation of the real field.
;; Borel measure and lower integration are defined extensionally; the
;; interval-length law below selects Lebesgue measure. Sine and cosine are
;; fixed by their convergent real power series, and positive-base real powers
;; are fixed by their rational values and continuity in the exponent.

(defun ht099-quoted (object)
  (list 'quote object))

(defun ht099-term-list (terms)
  (if (consp terms)
      (list 'cons
            (car terms)
            (ht099-term-list (cdr terms)))
    (ht099-quoted nil)))

(defun ht099-apply-term (function-term arguments)
  (list 'apply$
        function-term
        (ht099-term-list arguments)))

(defun ht099-static-apply-term (function arguments)
  (ht099-apply-term
   (ht099-quoted function)
   arguments))

(defun ht099-and-terms (terms)
  (if (consp terms)
      (list 'if
            (car terms)
            (ht099-and-terms (cdr terms))
            (ht099-quoted nil))
    (ht099-quoted t)))

(defun ht099-or-terms (terms)
  (if (consp terms)
      (list 'if
            (car terms)
            (ht099-quoted t)
            (ht099-or-terms (cdr terms)))
    (ht099-quoted nil)))

(defun ht099-not-term (term)
  (list 'if term
        (ht099-quoted nil)
        (ht099-quoted t)))

(defun ht099-implies-term (hypothesis conclusion)
  (list 'if hypothesis conclusion (ht099-quoted t)))

(defun ht099-iff-term (left right)
  (list 'if left
        (list 'if right
              (ht099-quoted t)
              (ht099-quoted nil))
        (list 'if right
              (ht099-quoted nil)
              (ht099-quoted t))))

(defun ht099-true-function (formals)
  (list 'lambda formals (ht099-quoted t)))

(defun ht099-false-function (formals)
  (list 'lambda formals (ht099-quoted nil)))

(defun ht099-universal-p (function formals)
  (let ((always-true (ht099-true-function formals)))
    (and (tamep-functionp function)
         (tamep-functionp always-true)
         (fn-equal function always-true))))

(defun ht099-exists-p (function formals)
  (let ((always-false (ht099-false-function formals)))
    (and (tamep-functionp function)
         (tamep-functionp always-false)
         (not (fn-equal function always-false)))))

(defun ht099-member-p (predicate object)
  (if (apply$ predicate (list object)) t nil))

(defun ht099-unary-value (function object)
  (apply$ function (list object)))

(defun ht099-binary-value (function left right)
  (apply$ function (list left right)))

;; Sets and arbitrary functions.

(defun ht099-set-subset-function (carrier left right)
  (list
   'lambda '(x)
   (ht099-implies-term
    (ht099-and-terms
     (list
      (ht099-static-apply-term carrier '(x))
      (ht099-static-apply-term left '(x))))
    (ht099-static-apply-term right '(x)))))

(defun ht099-set-subset-p (carrier left right)
  (and
   (tamep-functionp carrier)
   (tamep-functionp left)
   (tamep-functionp right)
   (ht099-universal-p
    (ht099-set-subset-function carrier left right)
    '(x))))

(defun ht099-valid-set-p (carrier set)
  (and
   (tamep-functionp set)
   (ht099-set-subset-p carrier set carrier)))

(defun ht099-set-equiv-function (carrier left right)
  (list
   'lambda '(x)
   (ht099-implies-term
    (ht099-static-apply-term carrier '(x))
    (ht099-iff-term
     (ht099-static-apply-term left '(x))
     (ht099-static-apply-term right '(x))))))

(defun ht099-set-equiv-p (carrier left right)
  (and
   (ht099-valid-set-p carrier left)
   (ht099-valid-set-p carrier right)
   (ht099-universal-p
    (ht099-set-equiv-function carrier left right)
    '(x))))

(defun ht099-empty-set ()
  (list 'lambda '(x) (ht099-quoted nil)))

(defun ht099-full-set (carrier)
  (list 'lambda '(x)
        (ht099-static-apply-term carrier '(x))))

(defun ht099-complement-set (carrier set)
  (list
   'lambda '(x)
   (ht099-and-terms
    (list
     (ht099-static-apply-term carrier '(x))
     (ht099-not-term
      (ht099-static-apply-term set '(x)))))))

(defun ht099-function-values-function
    (domain-carrier codomain-carrier function)
  (list
   'lambda '(x)
   (ht099-implies-term
    (ht099-static-apply-term domain-carrier '(x))
    (ht099-static-apply-term
     codomain-carrier
     (list (ht099-static-apply-term function '(x)))))))

(defun ht099-function-p
    (domain-carrier codomain-carrier function)
  (and
   (tamep-functionp function)
   (ht099-universal-p
    (ht099-function-values-function
     domain-carrier codomain-carrier function)
    '(x))))

;; A Dedekind-complete ordered field, used as an abstract presentation of R.

(defun ht099-field-laws-function
    (carrier zero one add multiply negate inverse)
  (let* ((xy-add (ht099-static-apply-term add '(x y)))
         (yz-add (ht099-static-apply-term add '(y z)))
         (xy-mul (ht099-static-apply-term multiply '(x y)))
         (yz-mul (ht099-static-apply-term multiply '(y z)))
         (neg-x (ht099-static-apply-term negate '(x)))
         (inv-x (ht099-static-apply-term inverse '(x))))
    (list
     'lambda '(x y z)
     (ht099-implies-term
      (ht099-and-terms
       (list
        (ht099-static-apply-term carrier '(x))
        (ht099-static-apply-term carrier '(y))
        (ht099-static-apply-term carrier '(z))))
      (ht099-and-terms
       (list
        (ht099-static-apply-term carrier (list xy-add))
        (ht099-static-apply-term carrier (list xy-mul))
        (ht099-static-apply-term carrier (list neg-x))
        (ht099-static-apply-term carrier (list inv-x))
        (list 'equal
              (ht099-static-apply-term add (list xy-add 'z))
              (ht099-static-apply-term add (list 'x yz-add)))
        (list 'equal xy-add
              (ht099-static-apply-term add '(y x)))
        (list 'equal
              (ht099-static-apply-term
               add (list 'x (ht099-quoted zero)))
              'x)
        (list 'equal
              (ht099-static-apply-term add (list 'x neg-x))
              (ht099-quoted zero))
        (list 'equal
              (ht099-static-apply-term multiply (list xy-mul 'z))
              (ht099-static-apply-term multiply (list 'x yz-mul)))
        (list 'equal xy-mul
              (ht099-static-apply-term multiply '(y x)))
        (list 'equal
              (ht099-static-apply-term
               multiply (list 'x (ht099-quoted one)))
              'x)
        (ht099-implies-term
         (list 'equal 'x (ht099-quoted zero))
         (list 'equal inv-x (ht099-quoted zero)))
        (ht099-implies-term
         (ht099-not-term
          (list 'equal 'x (ht099-quoted zero)))
         (list 'equal
               (ht099-static-apply-term
                multiply (list 'x inv-x))
               (ht099-quoted one)))
        (list 'equal
              (ht099-static-apply-term multiply (list 'x yz-add))
              (ht099-static-apply-term
               add
               (list
                (ht099-static-apply-term multiply '(x y))
                (ht099-static-apply-term multiply '(x z)))))))))))

(defun ht099-order-laws-function
    (carrier zero add multiply less)
  (let ((xy (ht099-static-apply-term less '(x y)))
        (yx (ht099-static-apply-term less '(y x)))
        (yz (ht099-static-apply-term less '(y z))))
    (list
     'lambda '(x y z)
     (ht099-implies-term
      (ht099-and-terms
       (list
        (ht099-static-apply-term carrier '(x))
        (ht099-static-apply-term carrier '(y))
        (ht099-static-apply-term carrier '(z))))
      (ht099-and-terms
       (list
        (ht099-not-term
         (ht099-static-apply-term less '(x x)))
        (ht099-or-terms
         (list xy yx (list 'equal 'x 'y)))
        (ht099-implies-term
         (ht099-and-terms (list xy yz))
         (ht099-static-apply-term less '(x z)))
        (ht099-implies-term
         xy
         (ht099-static-apply-term
          less
          (list
           (ht099-static-apply-term add '(x z))
           (ht099-static-apply-term add '(y z)))))
        (ht099-implies-term
         (ht099-and-terms
          (list
           (ht099-static-apply-term
            less (list (ht099-quoted zero) 'x))
           (ht099-static-apply-term
            less (list (ht099-quoted zero) 'y))))
         (ht099-static-apply-term
          less
          (list
           (ht099-quoted zero)
           (ht099-static-apply-term multiply '(x y)))))))))))

(defun ht099-upper-bound-function
    (carrier less set upper)
  (list
   'lambda '(x)
   (ht099-implies-term
    (ht099-and-terms
     (list
      (ht099-static-apply-term carrier '(x))
      (ht099-static-apply-term set '(x))))
    (ht099-not-term
     (ht099-static-apply-term
      less (list (ht099-quoted upper) 'x))))))

(defun ht099-upper-bound-p
    (carrier less set upper)
  (and
   (ht099-member-p carrier upper)
   (ht099-valid-set-p carrier set)
   (ht099-universal-p
    (ht099-upper-bound-function carrier less set upper)
    '(x))))

(defun ht099-set-nonempty-function (carrier set)
  (list
   'lambda '(x)
   (ht099-and-terms
    (list
     (ht099-static-apply-term carrier '(x))
     (ht099-static-apply-term set '(x))))))

(defun ht099-set-nonempty-p (carrier set)
  (and
   (ht099-valid-set-p carrier set)
   (ht099-exists-p
    (ht099-set-nonempty-function carrier set)
    '(x))))

(defun ht099-bounded-above-function
    (carrier less set)
  (list
   'lambda '(upper)
   (list 'ht099-upper-bound-p
         (ht099-quoted carrier)
         (ht099-quoted less)
         (ht099-quoted set)
         'upper)))

(defun ht099-bounded-above-p (carrier less set)
  (ht099-exists-p
   (ht099-bounded-above-function carrier less set)
   '(upper)))

(defun ht099-least-upper-bound-function
    (carrier less set supremum)
  (list
   'lambda '(upper)
   (ht099-implies-term
    (list 'ht099-upper-bound-p
          (ht099-quoted carrier)
          (ht099-quoted less)
          (ht099-quoted set)
          'upper)
    (ht099-not-term
     (ht099-static-apply-term
      less (list 'upper (ht099-quoted supremum)))))))

(defun ht099-least-upper-bound-p
    (carrier less set supremum)
  (and
   (ht099-upper-bound-p carrier less set supremum)
   (ht099-universal-p
    (ht099-least-upper-bound-function
     carrier less set supremum)
    '(upper))))

(defun ht099-completeness-function
    (carrier less supremum-operation)
  (list
   'lambda '(set)
   (ht099-implies-term
    (ht099-and-terms
     (list
      (list 'ht099-valid-set-p
            (ht099-quoted carrier) 'set)
      (list 'ht099-set-nonempty-p
            (ht099-quoted carrier) 'set)
      (list 'ht099-bounded-above-p
            (ht099-quoted carrier)
            (ht099-quoted less)
            'set)))
    (list 'ht099-least-upper-bound-p
          (ht099-quoted carrier)
          (ht099-quoted less)
          'set
          (ht099-static-apply-term
           supremum-operation '(set))))))

(defun ht099-real-field-p
    (carrier zero one add multiply negate inverse less supremum)
  (and
   (tamep-functionp carrier)
   (tamep-functionp add)
   (tamep-functionp multiply)
   (tamep-functionp negate)
   (tamep-functionp inverse)
   (tamep-functionp less)
   (tamep-functionp supremum)
   (ht099-member-p carrier zero)
   (ht099-member-p carrier one)
   (not (equal zero one))
   (ht099-universal-p
    (ht099-field-laws-function
     carrier zero one add multiply negate inverse)
    '(x y z))
   (ht099-universal-p
    (ht099-order-laws-function
     carrier zero add multiply less)
    '(x y z))
   (ht099-universal-p
    (ht099-completeness-function
     carrier less supremum)
    '(set))
   (ht099-binary-value less zero one)))

(defun ht099-scalar-absolute-value
    (less zero negate value)
  (if (ht099-binary-value less value zero)
      (ht099-unary-value negate value)
    value))
;; Sigma algebras.

(defun ht099-family-extensional-function (carrier family)
  (list
   'lambda '(left right)
   (ht099-implies-term
    (list 'ht099-set-equiv-p
          (ht099-quoted carrier)
          'left 'right)
    (ht099-iff-term
     (ht099-static-apply-term family '(left))
     (ht099-static-apply-term family '(right))))))

(defun ht099-family-members-valid-function (carrier family)
  (list
   'lambda '(set)
   (ht099-implies-term
    (ht099-static-apply-term family '(set))
    (list 'ht099-valid-set-p
          (ht099-quoted carrier)
          'set))))

(defun ht099-family-of-sets-p (carrier family)
  (and
   (tamep-functionp family)
   (ht099-universal-p
    (ht099-family-extensional-function carrier family)
    '(left right))
   (ht099-universal-p
    (ht099-family-members-valid-function carrier family)
    '(set))))

(defun ht099-sequence-union-member-function (sequence x)
  (list
   'lambda '(n)
   (ht099-and-terms
    (list
     (list 'natp 'n)
     (ht099-apply-term
      (ht099-static-apply-term sequence '(n))
      (list (ht099-quoted x)))))))

(defun ht099-sequence-union-member-p (sequence x)
  (ht099-exists-p
   (ht099-sequence-union-member-function sequence x)
   '(n)))

(defun ht099-sequence-union-set (carrier sequence)
  (list
   'lambda '(x)
   (ht099-and-terms
    (list
     (ht099-static-apply-term carrier '(x))
     (list 'ht099-sequence-union-member-p
           (ht099-quoted sequence)
           'x)))))

(defun ht099-sequence-of-sets-function (carrier sequence)
  (list
   'lambda '(n)
   (ht099-implies-term
    (list 'natp 'n)
    (list 'ht099-valid-set-p
          (ht099-quoted carrier)
          (ht099-static-apply-term sequence '(n))))))

(defun ht099-sequence-of-sets-p (carrier sequence)
  (and
   (tamep-functionp sequence)
   (ht099-universal-p
    (ht099-sequence-of-sets-function carrier sequence)
    '(n))))

(defun ht099-sequence-members-family-function (family sequence)
  (list
   'lambda '(n)
   (ht099-implies-term
    (list 'natp 'n)
    (ht099-static-apply-term
     family
     (list (ht099-static-apply-term sequence '(n)))))))

(defun ht099-sequence-members-family-p
    (carrier family sequence)
  (and
   (ht099-sequence-of-sets-p carrier sequence)
   (ht099-universal-p
    (ht099-sequence-members-family-function family sequence)
    '(n))))

(defun ht099-sigma-complement-function (carrier family)
  (list
   'lambda '(set)
   (ht099-implies-term
    (ht099-static-apply-term family '(set))
    (ht099-static-apply-term
     family
     (list
      (list 'ht099-complement-set
            (ht099-quoted carrier)
            'set))))))

(defun ht099-sigma-union-function (carrier family)
  (list
   'lambda '(sequence)
   (ht099-implies-term
    (list 'ht099-sequence-members-family-p
          (ht099-quoted carrier)
          (ht099-quoted family)
          'sequence)
    (ht099-static-apply-term
     family
     (list
      (list 'ht099-sequence-union-set
            (ht099-quoted carrier)
            'sequence))))))

(defun ht099-sigma-algebra-p (carrier family)
  (and
   (ht099-family-of-sets-p carrier family)
   (ht099-member-p family (ht099-empty-set))
   (ht099-universal-p
    (ht099-sigma-complement-function carrier family)
    '(set))
   (ht099-universal-p
    (ht099-sigma-union-function carrier family)
    '(sequence))))

;; Extended nonnegative reals and countable sums.

(defun ht099-ennreal-p
    (value scalar-carrier scalar-zero scalar-less)
  (or
   (equal value :ht099-top)
   (and
    (consp value)
    (equal (car value) :ht099-finite)
    (ht099-member-p scalar-carrier (cdr value))
    (not
     (ht099-binary-value scalar-less (cdr value) scalar-zero)))))

(defun ht099-ennreal-finite (value)
  (cons :ht099-finite value))

(defun ht099-ennreal-zero (scalar-zero)
  (ht099-ennreal-finite scalar-zero))

(defun ht099-ennreal-less-p (left right scalar-less)
  (cond
   ((equal left :ht099-top) nil)
   ((equal right :ht099-top) t)
   (t
    (ht099-binary-value scalar-less (cdr left) (cdr right)))))

(defun ht099-ennreal-less-equal-p (left right scalar-less)
  (not (ht099-ennreal-less-p right left scalar-less)))

(defun ht099-ennreal-add (left right scalar-add)
  (if (or (equal left :ht099-top)
          (equal right :ht099-top))
      :ht099-top
    (ht099-ennreal-finite
     (ht099-binary-value scalar-add (cdr left) (cdr right)))))

(defun ht099-ennreal-multiply
    (left right scalar-zero scalar-multiply)
  (cond
   ((or (equal left (ht099-ennreal-zero scalar-zero))
        (equal right (ht099-ennreal-zero scalar-zero)))
    (ht099-ennreal-zero scalar-zero))
   ((or (equal left :ht099-top)
        (equal right :ht099-top))
    :ht099-top)
   (t
    (ht099-ennreal-finite
     (ht099-binary-value
      scalar-multiply (cdr left) (cdr right))))))

(defun ht099-finite-ennreal-sum
    (sequence count scalar-zero scalar-add)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix count)))
  (if (zp count)
      (ht099-ennreal-zero scalar-zero)
    (ht099-ennreal-add
     (ht099-finite-ennreal-sum
      sequence (- count 1) scalar-zero scalar-add)
     (ht099-unary-value sequence (- count 1))
     scalar-add)))

(defun ht099-sum-upper-bound-function
    (sequence total scalar-zero scalar-add scalar-less)
  (list
   'lambda '(count)
   (ht099-implies-term
    (list 'natp 'count)
    (list 'ht099-ennreal-less-equal-p
          (list 'ht099-finite-ennreal-sum
                (ht099-quoted sequence)
                'count
                (ht099-quoted scalar-zero)
                (ht099-quoted scalar-add))
          (ht099-quoted total)
          (ht099-quoted scalar-less)))))

(defun ht099-sum-upper-bound-p

        (cdr value)

  (and
   (ht099-ae-measurable-p

    real-carrier real-less function)
   (ht099-ennreal-less-p
    (apply$
     lintegral
     (list
      domain-carrier measurable measure
      (ht099-real-enorm-function
       real-zero real-negate real-less function)))
    :ht099-top

          lintegral

           (ht099-real-negative-part-function

    real-zero))

    omega-carrier omega-measurable mu lintegral x-family
    limit-carrier limit-measurable limit-measure
    limit-lintegral limit-function
    target-carrier target-topology)))

;; Natural indices and the sequential filter.

(defun ht099-natural-carrier ()
  (list 'lambda '(n) (list 'natp 'n)))

(defun ht099-eventually-from-function (set start)
  (list
   'lambda '(n)
   (ht099-implies-term
    (ht099-and-terms
     (list
      (list 'natp 'n)
      (list '<= (ht099-quoted start) 'n)))
    (ht099-static-apply-term set '(n)))))

(defun ht099-eventually-at-top-p (set)
  (and
   (tamep-functionp set)
   (ht099-exists-p
    (list
     'lambda '(start)
     (ht099-and-terms
      (list
       (list 'natp 'start)
       (list 'ht099-universal-p
             (list 'ht099-eventually-from-function
                   (ht099-quoted set) 'start)
             (ht099-quoted '(n))))))
    '(start))))

(defun ht099-sequential-filter ()
  (list
   'lambda '(set)
   (list 'ht099-eventually-at-top-p 'set)))

;; Exact real powers, factorials, and Taylor partial sums.

(defun ht099-real-nat-value (n real-zero real-one real-add)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix n)))
  (if (zp n)
      real-zero
    (ht099-binary-value
     real-add
     (ht099-real-nat-value
      (- n 1) real-zero real-one real-add)
     real-one)))

(defun ht099-real-power
    (value exponent real-one real-multiply)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix exponent)))
  (if (zp exponent)
      real-one
    (ht099-binary-value
     real-multiply
     value
     (ht099-real-power
      value (- exponent 1) real-one real-multiply))))

(defun ht099-real-factorial
    (n real-zero real-one real-add real-multiply)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix n)))
  (if (zp n)
      real-one
    (ht099-binary-value
     real-multiply
     (ht099-real-nat-value n real-zero real-one real-add)
     (ht099-real-factorial
      (- n 1)
      real-zero real-one real-add real-multiply))))

(defun ht099-real-divide
    (numerator denominator real-multiply real-inverse)
  (ht099-binary-value
   real-multiply
   numerator
   (ht099-unary-value real-inverse denominator)))

(defun ht099-alternating-value (k value real-negate)
  (if (equal (mod (nfix k) 2) 0)
      value
    (ht099-unary-value real-negate value)))

(defun ht099-exp-partial-sum
    (count x
     real-zero real-one real-add real-multiply real-inverse)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix count)))
  (if (zp count)
      real-zero
    (let* ((k (- count 1))
           (term
            (ht099-real-divide
             (ht099-real-power x k real-one real-multiply)
             (ht099-real-factorial
              k real-zero real-one real-add real-multiply)
             real-multiply real-inverse)))
      (ht099-binary-value
       real-add
       (ht099-exp-partial-sum
        k x
        real-zero real-one real-add real-multiply real-inverse)
       term))))

(defun ht099-cos-partial-sum
    (count x
     real-zero real-one real-add real-multiply real-negate real-inverse)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix count)))
  (if (zp count)
      real-zero
    (let* ((k (- count 1))
           (exponent (* 2 k))
           (unsigned
            (ht099-real-divide
             (ht099-real-power
              x exponent real-one real-multiply)
             (ht099-real-factorial
              exponent real-zero real-one real-add real-multiply)
             real-multiply real-inverse))
           (term
            (ht099-alternating-value k unsigned real-negate)))
      (ht099-binary-value
       real-add
       (ht099-cos-partial-sum
        k x
        real-zero real-one real-add real-multiply
        real-negate real-inverse)
       term))))

(defun ht099-sin-partial-sum
    (count x
     real-zero real-one real-add real-multiply real-negate real-inverse)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix count)))
  (if (zp count)
      real-zero
    (let* ((k (- count 1))
           (exponent (+ 1 (* 2 k)))
           (unsigned
            (ht099-real-divide
             (ht099-real-power
              x exponent real-one real-multiply)
             (ht099-real-factorial
              exponent real-zero real-one real-add real-multiply)
             real-multiply real-inverse))
           (term
            (ht099-alternating-value k unsigned real-negate)))
      (ht099-binary-value
       real-add
       (ht099-sin-partial-sum
        k x
        real-zero real-one real-add real-multiply
        real-negate real-inverse)
       term))))

(defun ht099-exp-partial-sum-sequence
    (x real-zero real-one real-add real-multiply real-inverse)
  (list
   'lambda '(n)
   (list
    'ht099-exp-partial-sum
    'n
    (ht099-quoted x)
    (ht099-quoted real-zero)
    (ht099-quoted real-one)
    (ht099-quoted real-add)
    (ht099-quoted real-multiply)
    (ht099-quoted real-inverse))))

(defun ht099-cos-partial-sum-sequence
    (x real-zero real-one real-add real-multiply
       real-negate real-inverse)
  (list
   'lambda '(n)
   (list
    'ht099-cos-partial-sum
    'n
    (ht099-quoted x)
    (ht099-quoted real-zero)
    (ht099-quoted real-one)
    (ht099-quoted real-add)
    (ht099-quoted real-multiply)
    (ht099-quoted real-negate)
    (ht099-quoted real-inverse))))

(defun ht099-sin-partial-sum-sequence
    (x real-zero real-one real-add real-multiply
       real-negate real-inverse)
  (list
   'lambda '(n)
   (list
    'ht099-sin-partial-sum
    'n
    (ht099-quoted x)
    (ht099-quoted real-zero)
    (ht099-quoted real-one)
    (ht099-quoted real-add)
    (ht099-quoted real-multiply)
    (ht099-quoted real-negate)
    (ht099-quoted real-inverse))))

(defun ht099-exp-values-function
    (real-carrier real-zero real-one real-add real-multiply
     real-negate real-inverse real-less exp)
  (list
   'lambda '(x)
   (ht099-implies-term
    (ht099-static-apply-term real-carrier '(x))
    (list
     'ht099-real-tendsto-filter-p
     (list 'ht099-natural-carrier)
     (list 'ht099-sequential-filter)
     (ht099-quoted real-carrier)
     (ht099-quoted real-zero)
     (ht099-quoted real-add)
     (ht099-quoted real-negate)
     (ht099-quoted real-less)
     (list
      'ht099-exp-partial-sum-sequence
      'x
      (ht099-quoted real-zero)
      (ht099-quoted real-one)
      (ht099-quoted real-add)
      (ht099-quoted real-multiply)
      (ht099-quoted real-inverse))
     (ht099-static-apply-term exp '(x))))))

(defun ht099-cos-values-function
    (real-carrier real-zero real-one real-add real-multiply
     real-negate real-inverse real-less cos)
  (list
   'lambda '(x)
   (ht099-implies-term
    (ht099-static-apply-term real-carrier '(x))
    (list
     'ht099-real-tendsto-filter-p
     (list 'ht099-natural-carrier)
     (list 'ht099-sequential-filter)
     (ht099-quoted real-carrier)
     (ht099-quoted real-zero)
     (ht099-quoted real-add)
     (ht099-quoted real-negate)
     (ht099-quoted real-less)
     (list
      'ht099-cos-partial-sum-sequence
      'x
      (ht099-quoted real-zero)
      (ht099-quoted real-one)
      (ht099-quoted real-add)
      (ht099-quoted real-multiply)
      (ht099-quoted real-negate)
      (ht099-quoted real-inverse))
     (ht099-static-apply-term cos '(x))))))

(defun ht099-sin-values-function
    (real-carrier real-zero real-one real-add real-multiply
     real-negate real-inverse real-less sin)
  (list
   'lambda '(x)
   (ht099-implies-term
    (ht099-static-apply-term real-carrier '(x))
    (list
     'ht099-real-tendsto-filter-p
     (list 'ht099-natural-carrier)
     (list 'ht099-sequential-filter)
     (ht099-quoted real-carrier)
     (ht099-quoted real-zero)
     (ht099-quoted real-add)
     (ht099-quoted real-negate)
     (ht099-quoted real-less)
     (list
      'ht099-sin-partial-sum-sequence
      'x
      (ht099-quoted real-zero)
      (ht099-quoted real-one)
      (ht099-quoted real-add)
      (ht099-quoted real-multiply)
      (ht099-quoted real-negate)
      (ht099-quoted real-inverse))
     (ht099-static-apply-term sin '(x))))))

(defun ht099-analytic-functions-p
    (real-carrier real-zero real-one real-add real-multiply
     real-negate real-inverse real-less exp sin cos)
  (and
   (ht099-function-p real-carrier real-carrier exp)
   (ht099-function-p real-carrier real-carrier sin)
   (ht099-function-p real-carrier real-carrier cos)
   (ht099-universal-p
    (ht099-exp-values-function
     real-carrier real-zero real-one real-add real-multiply
     real-negate real-inverse real-less exp)
    '(x))
   (ht099-universal-p
    (ht099-sin-values-function
     real-carrier real-zero real-one real-add real-multiply
     real-negate real-inverse real-less sin)
    '(x))
   (ht099-universal-p
   (ht099-cos-values-function
     real-carrier real-zero real-one real-add real-multiply
     real-negate real-inverse real-less cos)
    '(x))))

;; The imported analytic infrastructure above is shared statement machinery.

(defun putnam-2011-a3-positive-p
    (real-carrier real-zero real-less x)
  (and
   (ht099-member-p real-carrier x)
   (ht099-binary-value real-less real-zero x)))

(defun putnam-2011-a3-real-integer
    (n real-zero real-one real-add real-negate)
  (if (< n 0)
      (ht099-unary-value
       real-negate
       (ht099-real-nat-value
        (- n) real-zero real-one real-add))
    (ht099-real-nat-value n real-zero real-one real-add)))

(defun putnam-2011-a3-integer-power
    (base exponent real-one real-multiply real-inverse)
  (if (< exponent 0)
      (ht099-unary-value
       real-inverse
       (ht099-real-power
        base (- exponent) real-one real-multiply))
    (ht099-real-power
     base exponent real-one real-multiply)))

(defun-sk putnam-2011-a3-power-typing-p
    (real-carrier real-zero real-less power)
  (forall (base exponent)
    (implies
     (and
      (putnam-2011-a3-positive-p
       real-carrier real-zero real-less base)
      (ht099-member-p real-carrier exponent))
     (putnam-2011-a3-positive-p
      real-carrier real-zero real-less
      (ht099-binary-value power base exponent)))))

(defun-sk putnam-2011-a3-power-rational-laws-p
    (real-carrier real-zero real-one real-add real-multiply
     real-negate real-inverse real-less power)
  (forall (base numerator denominator)
    (implies
     (and
      (putnam-2011-a3-positive-p
       real-carrier real-zero real-less base)
      (integerp numerator)
      (posp denominator))
     (equal
      (ht099-real-power
       (ht099-binary-value
        power
        base
        (ht099-binary-value
         real-multiply
         (putnam-2011-a3-real-integer
          numerator real-zero real-one real-add real-negate)
         (ht099-unary-value
          real-inverse
          (ht099-real-nat-value
           denominator real-zero real-one real-add))))
       denominator real-one real-multiply)
      (putnam-2011-a3-integer-power
       base numerator real-one real-multiply real-inverse)))))

(defun putnam-2011-a3-distance
    (real-zero real-add real-negate real-less x y)
  (ht099-scalar-absolute-value
   real-less real-zero real-negate
   (ht099-binary-value
    real-add x (ht099-unary-value real-negate y))))

(defun-sk putnam-2011-a3-power-neighborhood-p
    (real-carrier real-zero real-add real-negate real-less power
     base exponent epsilon delta)
  (forall (y)
    (implies
     (and
      (ht099-member-p real-carrier y)
      (ht099-binary-value
       real-less
       (putnam-2011-a3-distance
        real-zero real-add real-negate real-less y exponent)
       delta))
     (ht099-binary-value
      real-less
      (putnam-2011-a3-distance
       real-zero real-add real-negate real-less
       (ht099-binary-value power base y)
       (ht099-binary-value power base exponent))
      epsilon))))

(defun-sk putnam-2011-a3-power-delta-exists-p
    (real-carrier real-zero real-add real-negate real-less power
     base exponent epsilon)
  (exists (delta)
    (and
     (putnam-2011-a3-positive-p
      real-carrier real-zero real-less delta)
     (putnam-2011-a3-power-neighborhood-p
      real-carrier real-zero real-add real-negate real-less power
      base exponent epsilon delta))))

(defun-sk putnam-2011-a3-power-continuous-p
    (real-carrier real-zero real-add real-negate real-less power)
  (forall (base exponent epsilon)
    (implies
     (and
      (putnam-2011-a3-positive-p
       real-carrier real-zero real-less base)
      (ht099-member-p real-carrier exponent)
      (putnam-2011-a3-positive-p
       real-carrier real-zero real-less epsilon))
     (putnam-2011-a3-power-delta-exists-p
      real-carrier real-zero real-add real-negate real-less power
      base exponent epsilon))))

(defun putnam-2011-a3-real-power-p
    (real-carrier real-zero real-one real-add real-multiply
     real-negate real-inverse real-less power)
  (and
   (tamep-functionp power)
   (putnam-2011-a3-power-typing-p
    real-carrier real-zero real-less power)
   (putnam-2011-a3-power-rational-laws-p
    real-carrier real-zero real-one real-add real-multiply
    real-negate real-inverse real-less power)
   (putnam-2011-a3-power-continuous-p
    real-carrier real-zero real-add real-negate real-less power)))

(defun putnam-2011-a3-trigonometric-functions-p
    (real-carrier real-zero real-one real-add real-multiply
     real-negate real-inverse real-less sin cos)
  (and
   (ht099-function-p real-carrier real-carrier sin)
   (ht099-function-p real-carrier real-carrier cos)
   (ht099-universal-p
    (ht099-sin-values-function
     real-carrier real-zero real-one real-add real-multiply
     real-negate real-inverse real-less sin)
    '(x))
   (ht099-universal-p
    (ht099-cos-values-function
     real-carrier real-zero real-one real-add real-multiply
     real-negate real-inverse real-less cos)
    '(x))))

(defun-sk putnam-2011-a3-no-earlier-cosine-zero-p
    (real-carrier real-zero real-less cos half-pi)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (and
      (putnam-2011-a3-positive-p
       real-carrier real-zero real-less x)
      (ht099-binary-value real-less x half-pi))
     (not (equal (ht099-unary-value cos x) real-zero)))))

(defun putnam-2011-a3-half-pi-p
    (real-carrier real-zero real-less cos half-pi)
  (and
   (putnam-2011-a3-positive-p
    real-carrier real-zero real-less half-pi)
   (equal (ht099-unary-value cos half-pi) real-zero)
   (putnam-2011-a3-no-earlier-cosine-zero-p
    real-carrier real-zero real-less cos half-pi)))

(defun putnam-2011-a3-ioc-set
    (real-carrier real-less lower upper)
  (list
   'lambda '(x)
   (ht099-and-terms
    (list
     (ht099-static-apply-term real-carrier '(x))
     (ht099-static-apply-term
      real-less (list (ht099-quoted lower) 'x))
     (ht099-not-term
      (ht099-static-apply-term
       real-less (list (ht099-quoted upper) 'x)))))))

(defun putnam-2011-a3-lebesgue-interval-law-function
    (real-carrier real-zero real-add real-negate real-less measure)
  (list
   'lambda '(a b)
   (ht099-implies-term
    (ht099-and-terms
     (list
      (ht099-static-apply-term real-carrier '(a))
      (ht099-static-apply-term real-carrier '(b))))
    (list
     'equal
     (ht099-static-apply-term
      measure
      (list
       (list 'putnam-2011-a3-ioc-set
             (ht099-quoted real-carrier)
             (ht099-quoted real-less)
             'a 'b)))
     (list
      'ht099-ennreal-finite
      (list
       'if
       (ht099-static-apply-term real-less '(a b))
       (ht099-static-apply-term
        real-add
        (list
         'b
         (ht099-static-apply-term real-negate '(a))))
       (ht099-quoted real-zero)))))))

(defun putnam-2011-a3-lebesgue-measure-p
    (real-carrier real-zero real-add real-negate real-less
     measurable measure)
  (and
   (ht099-measure-space-p
    real-carrier real-zero real-add real-less
    real-carrier measurable measure)
   (ht099-universal-p
    (putnam-2011-a3-lebesgue-interval-law-function
     real-carrier real-zero real-add real-negate real-less measure)
    '(a b))))

(defun putnam-2011-a3-integrand-function
    (real-carrier real-zero real-multiply real-less
     power trigonometric-function exponent half-pi)
  (list
   'lambda '(x)
   (list
    'if
    (ht099-and-terms
     (list
      (ht099-static-apply-term real-carrier '(x))
      (ht099-static-apply-term
       real-less (list (ht099-quoted real-zero) 'x))
      (ht099-static-apply-term
       real-less (list 'x (ht099-quoted half-pi)))))
    (ht099-static-apply-term
     real-multiply
     (list
      (ht099-static-apply-term
       power (list 'x (ht099-quoted exponent)))
      (ht099-static-apply-term trigonometric-function '(x))))
    (ht099-quoted real-zero))))

(defun putnam-2011-a3-integral
    (real-carrier real-zero real-add real-multiply real-negate real-less
     measurable measure lintegral power trigonometric-function
     exponent half-pi)
  (ht099-real-integral-value
   real-zero real-add real-negate real-less
   real-carrier measurable measure real-carrier
   (putnam-2011-a3-integrand-function
    real-carrier real-zero real-multiply real-less
    power trigonometric-function exponent half-pi)
   lintegral))

(defun putnam-2011-a3-ratio-value
    (real-carrier real-zero real-add real-multiply real-negate
     real-inverse real-less measurable measure lintegral
     power sin cos half-pi c r)
  (ht099-binary-value
   real-multiply
   (ht099-binary-value power r c)
   (ht099-binary-value
    real-multiply
    (putnam-2011-a3-integral
     real-carrier real-zero real-add real-multiply real-negate real-less
     measurable measure lintegral power sin r half-pi)
    (ht099-unary-value
     real-inverse
     (putnam-2011-a3-integral
      real-carrier real-zero real-add real-multiply real-negate real-less
      measurable measure lintegral power cos r half-pi)))))

(defun-sk putnam-2011-a3-limit-tail-p
    (real-carrier real-zero real-add real-multiply real-negate
     real-inverse real-less measurable measure lintegral
     power sin cos half-pi c limit epsilon threshold)
  (forall (r)
    (implies
     (and
      (ht099-member-p real-carrier r)
      (not (ht099-binary-value real-less r threshold)))
     (ht099-binary-value
      real-less
      (putnam-2011-a3-distance
       real-zero real-add real-negate real-less
       (putnam-2011-a3-ratio-value
        real-carrier real-zero real-add real-multiply real-negate
        real-inverse real-less measurable measure lintegral
        power sin cos half-pi c r)
       limit)
      epsilon))))

(defun-sk putnam-2011-a3-limit-cutoff-exists-p
    (real-carrier real-zero real-add real-multiply real-negate
     real-inverse real-less measurable measure lintegral
     power sin cos half-pi c limit epsilon)
  (exists (threshold)
    (and
     (putnam-2011-a3-positive-p
      real-carrier real-zero real-less threshold)
     (putnam-2011-a3-limit-tail-p
      real-carrier real-zero real-add real-multiply real-negate
      real-inverse real-less measurable measure lintegral
      power sin cos half-pi c limit epsilon threshold))))

(defun-sk putnam-2011-a3-real-at-top-limit-p
    (real-carrier real-zero real-add real-multiply real-negate
     real-inverse real-less measurable measure lintegral
     power sin cos half-pi c limit)
  (forall (epsilon)
    (implies
     (putnam-2011-a3-positive-p
      real-carrier real-zero real-less epsilon)
     (putnam-2011-a3-limit-cutoff-exists-p
      real-carrier real-zero real-add real-multiply real-negate
      real-inverse real-less measurable measure lintegral
      power sin cos half-pi c limit epsilon))))

(defun-sk putnambench-putnam-2011-a3-conclusion-p
    (real-carrier real-zero real-one real-add real-multiply
     real-negate real-inverse real-less real-supremum
     real-topology measurable measure lintegral power sin cos)
  (exists (half-pi c limit)
    (and
     (putnam-2011-a3-half-pi-p
      real-carrier real-zero real-less cos half-pi)
     (equal c (ht099-unary-value real-negate real-one))
     (equal limit (ht099-unary-value real-inverse half-pi))
     (putnam-2011-a3-positive-p
      real-carrier real-zero real-less limit)
     (putnam-2011-a3-real-at-top-limit-p
      real-carrier real-zero real-add real-multiply real-negate
      real-inverse real-less measurable measure lintegral
      power sin cos half-pi c limit))))

(defun-sk putnambench-putnam-2011-a3-statement ()
  (forall
    (real-carrier real-zero real-one real-add real-multiply
     real-negate real-inverse real-less real-supremum
     real-topology measurable measure lintegral power sin cos)
    (implies
     (and
      (ht099-real-field-p
       real-carrier real-zero real-one real-add real-multiply
       real-negate real-inverse real-less real-supremum)
      (ht099-order-topology-p
       real-carrier real-less real-topology)
      (ht099-borel-space-p
       real-carrier real-topology measurable)
      (putnam-2011-a3-lebesgue-measure-p
       real-carrier real-zero real-add real-negate real-less
       measurable measure)
      (ht099-lintegral-operation-p
       real-carrier real-zero real-add real-multiply real-less
       real-carrier measurable measure lintegral)
      (putnam-2011-a3-real-power-p
       real-carrier real-zero real-one real-add real-multiply
       real-negate real-inverse real-less power)
      (putnam-2011-a3-trigonometric-functions-p
       real-carrier real-zero real-one real-add real-multiply
       real-negate real-inverse real-less sin cos))
     (putnambench-putnam-2011-a3-conclusion-p
      real-carrier real-zero real-one real-add real-multiply
      real-negate real-inverse real-less real-supremum
      real-topology measurable measure lintegral power sin cos))))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

content:
-- Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2011_a3
-- (putnambench__agda__putnam_2011_a3): existence of a real exponent and a
-- positive limiting value for a quotient of sine- and cosine-weighted
-- integrals as the real parameter tends to positive infinity. This file
-- contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module Main where

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; _*_)

infix 4 _!=_ _<=N_
infixr 3 _and_
infixr 2 _or_

data Bottom : Set where

Not : Set -> Set
Not A =
  A -> Bottom

_!=_ : {A : Set} -> A -> A -> Set
x != y =
  Not (x == y)

record _and_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data _or_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  left  : A -> A or B
  right : B -> A or B

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

data _<=N_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set where
  zero<=N   : {n : Nat} -> zero <=N n
  suc<=sucN : {m n : Nat} -> m <=N n -> suc m <=N suc n

record CompleteOrderedRealField (R : Set) : Set1 where
  field
    zeroR oneR : R
    add multiply : R -> R -> R
    negate inverse : R -> R
    lessOrEqual : R -> R -> Set
    fromNat : Nat -> R

    one-not-zero :
      oneR != zeroR

    add-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> add x y == add y x
    add-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      add (add x y) z == add x (add y z)
    add-zero :
      (x : R) -> add x zeroR == x
    add-inverse :
      (x : R) -> add x (negate x) == zeroR

    multiply-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> multiply x y == multiply y x
    multiply-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply (multiply x y) z ==
      multiply x (multiply y z)
    multiply-one :
      (x : R) -> multiply x oneR == x
    multiply-zero :
      (x : R) -> multiply x zeroR == zeroR
    distribute :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply x (add y z) ==
      add (multiply x y) (multiply x z)
    inverse-zero :
      inverse zeroR == zeroR
    multiply-inverse :
      (x : R) ->
      x != zeroR ->
      multiply x (inverse x) == oneR

    order-reflexive :
      (x : R) -> lessOrEqual x x
    order-transitive :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y z ->
      lessOrEqual x z
    order-antisymmetric :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y x ->
      x == y
    order-total :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y or lessOrEqual y x
    add-order :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual (add z x) (add z y)
    multiply-nonnegative :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR x ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR y ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR (multiply x y)
    zero-less-than-one :
      lessOrEqual zeroR oneR and zeroR != oneR

    fromNat-zero :
      fromNat zero == zeroR
    fromNat-successor :
      (n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (suc n) == add (fromNat n) oneR
    fromNat-addition :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m + n) == add (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-multiplication :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m * n) == multiply (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-injective :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat m == fromNat n ->
      m == n

    archimedean :
      (x : R) ->
      Exists Nat
        (\ n ->
          lessOrEqual x (fromNat n))
    least-upper-bound :
      (P : R -> Set) ->
      Exists R P ->
      Exists R
        (\ upper ->
          (x : R) ->
          P x ->
          lessOrEqual x upper) ->
      Exists R
        (\ supremum ->
          ((x : R) ->
            P x ->
            lessOrEqual x supremum)
          and
          ((upper : R) ->
            ((x : R) ->
              P x ->
              lessOrEqual x upper) ->
            lessOrEqual supremum upper))

open CompleteOrderedRealField

oneN : Nat
oneN =
  suc zero

twoN : Nat
twoN =
  suc oneN

fourN : Nat
fourN =
  twoN + twoN

subtract :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
subtract reals x y =
  add reals x (negate reals y)

divide :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
divide reals x y =
  multiply reals x (inverse reals y)

StrictLess :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
StrictLess reals x y =
  lessOrEqual reals x y and x != y

CloseTo :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
CloseTo reals center radius x =
  StrictLess reals
    (subtract reals center radius)
    x
  and
  StrictLess reals
    x
    (add reals center radius)

ConvergesTo :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  R ->
  Set
ConvergesTo {R} reals sequence limit =
  (epsilon : R) ->
  StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) epsilon ->
  Exists Nat
    (\ cutoff ->
      (n : Nat) ->
      cutoff <=N n ->
      CloseTo reals limit epsilon (sequence n))

LimitAtPositiveInfinity :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (R -> R) ->
  R ->
  Set
LimitAtPositiveInfinity {R} reals function limit =
  (epsilon : R) ->
  StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) epsilon ->
  Exists R
    (\ threshold ->
      (x : R) ->
      lessOrEqual reals threshold x ->
      CloseTo reals limit epsilon (function x))

naturalPower :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  Nat ->
  R
naturalPower reals x zero =
  oneR reals
naturalPower reals x (suc n) =
  multiply reals
    (naturalPower reals x n)
    x

factorial : Nat -> Nat
factorial zero =
  oneN
factorial (suc n) =
  suc n * factorial n

sumFirst :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Nat ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  R
sumFirst reals zero term =
  zeroR reals
sumFirst reals (suc n) term =
  add reals
    (sumFirst reals n term)
    (term n)

SeriesHasSum :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  R ->
  Set
SeriesHasSum reals terms limit =
  ConvergesTo reals
    (\ n -> sumFirst reals n terms)
    limit

alternatingPower :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Nat ->
  R
alternatingPower reals n =
  naturalPower reals
    (negate reals (oneR reals))
    n

exponentialTerm :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  Nat ->
  R
exponentialTerm reals x n =
  divide reals
    (naturalPower reals x n)
    (fromNat reals (factorial n))

sineTerm :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  Nat ->
  R
sineTerm reals x n =
  divide reals
    (multiply reals
      (alternatingPower reals n)
      (naturalPower reals x (suc (twoN * n))))
    (fromNat reals (factorial (suc (twoN * n))))

cosineTerm :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  Nat ->
  R
cosineTerm reals x n =
  divide reals
    (multiply reals
      (alternatingPower reals n)
      (naturalPower reals x (twoN * n)))
    (fromNat reals (factorial (twoN * n)))

leibnizTerm :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Nat ->
  R
leibnizTerm reals n =
  divide reals
    (alternatingPower reals n)
    (fromNat reals (suc (twoN * n)))

ExponentialValue :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
ExponentialValue reals x value =
  SeriesHasSum reals
    (exponentialTerm reals x)
    value

record PiValue
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R)
  (value : R) : Set where
  field
    positive :
      StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) value
    leibniz-series :
      SeriesHasSum reals
        (leibnizTerm reals)
        (divide reals value (fromNat reals fourN))

midpointRiemannSum :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  (R -> R) ->
  Nat ->
  R
midpointRiemannSum reals lower upper function pieces =
  let
    step =
      divide reals
        (subtract reals upper lower)
        (fromNat reals pieces)
    halfStep =
      divide reals
        step
        (fromNat reals twoN)
  in
  sumFirst reals pieces
    (\ i ->
      multiply reals
        (function
          (add reals lower
            (add reals
              (multiply reals
                (fromNat reals i)
                step)
              halfStep)))
        step)

IntervalIntegralValue :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  (R -> R) ->
  R ->
  Set
IntervalIntegralValue reals lower upper function value =
  ConvergesTo reals
    (\ n ->
      midpointRiemannSum reals
        lower
        upper
        function
        (suc n))
    value

record StandardRealAnalysis
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) : Set1 where
  field
    exponential logarithm : R -> R
    sine cosine : R -> R
    pi : R

    exponential-series :
      (x : R) ->
      ExponentialValue reals x (exponential x)
    exponential-positive :
      (x : R) ->
      StrictLess reals
        (zeroR reals)
        (exponential x)
    exponential-injective :
      (x y : R) ->
      exponential x == exponential y ->
      x == y
    exponential-logarithm :
      (x : R) ->
      StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) x ->
      exponential (logarithm x) == x

    sine-series :
      (x : R) ->
      SeriesHasSum reals
        (sineTerm reals x)
        (sine x)
    cosine-series :
      (x : R) ->
      SeriesHasSum reals
        (cosineTerm reals x)
        (cosine x)

    pi-value :
      PiValue reals pi

    intervalIntegral :
      R ->
      R ->
      (R -> R) ->
      R
    interval-integral-is-riemann :
      (lower upper : R) ->
      (function : R -> R) ->
      Exists R
        (\ value ->
          IntervalIntegralValue reals
            lower
            upper
            function
            value) ->
      IntervalIntegralValue reals
        lower
        upper
        function
        (intervalIntegral lower upper function)

open StandardRealAnalysis

realPower :
  {R : Set} ->
  {reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R} ->
  StandardRealAnalysis reals ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
realPower {reals = reals} analysis base exponent =
  exponential analysis
    (multiply reals
      exponent
      (logarithm analysis base))

module Putnam2011A3Statement
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R)
  (analysis : StandardRealAnalysis reals) where

  halfPi : R
  halfPi =
    divide reals
      (pi analysis)
      (fromNat reals twoN)

  numeratorIntegrand : R -> R -> R
  numeratorIntegrand r x =
    multiply reals
      (realPower analysis x r)
      (sine analysis x)

  denominatorIntegrand : R -> R -> R
  denominatorIntegrand r x =
    multiply reals
      (realPower analysis x r)
      (cosine analysis x)

  numeratorIntegral : R -> R
  numeratorIntegral r =
    intervalIntegral analysis
      (zeroR reals)
      halfPi
      (numeratorIntegrand r)

  denominatorIntegral : R -> R
  denominatorIntegral r =
    intervalIntegral analysis
      (zeroR reals)
      halfPi
      (denominatorIntegrand r)

  quotient : R -> R -> R
  quotient c r =
    divide reals
      (multiply reals
        (realPower analysis r c)
        (numeratorIntegral r))
      (denominatorIntegral r)

  solutionExponent : R
  solutionExponent =
    negate reals (oneR reals)

  solutionLimit : R
  solutionLimit =
    divide reals
      (fromNat reals twoN)
      (pi analysis)

  proposition : Set
  proposition =
    StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) solutionLimit
    and
    LimitAtPositiveInfinity reals
      (quotient solutionExponent)
      solutionLimit

putnam-2011-a3 : Set1
putnam-2011-a3 =
  (R : Set) ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) ->
  (analysis : StandardRealAnalysis reals) ->
  Putnam2011A3Statement.proposition reals analysis

title: putnam_2011_a3
