let statement =
  `let is_commutative_group =
     \(gmul:A->A->A) (ginv:A->A) (gid:A).
       (!x y z:A.
          gmul x (gmul y z) = gmul (gmul x y) z) /\
       (!x:A. gmul gid x = x /\ gmul x gid = x) /\
       (!x:A.
          gmul (ginv x) x = gid /\ gmul x (ginv x) = gid) /\
       (!x y:A. gmul x y = gmul y x) in
   !gmul:A->A->A. !ginv:A->A. !gid:A.
   !n k:num. !gset:A->bool. !mgprob:num->A->real.
     is_commutative_group gmul ginv gid /\
     FINITE (UNIV:A->bool) /\
     n = CARD (UNIV:A->bool) /\
     FINITE gset /\
     CARD gset = k /\
     k < n /\
     gid IN gset /\
     (!x:A.
        ?l:A list.
          (!y:A. MEM y l ==> y IN gset) /\
          ITLIST gmul l gid = x) /\
     mgprob =
       (\m x.
          &(CARD {l:A list |
                    LENGTH l = m /\
                    (!y:A. MEM y l ==> y IN gset) /\
                    ITLIST gmul l gid = x}) /
          (&k) pow m)
     ==>
     ?b:real.
       &0 < b /\ b < &1 /\
       ?C:real.
         &0 < C /\
         (\m:num.
            (&1 / b pow (2 * m)) *
            sum (UNIV:A->bool)
              (\x:A. (mgprob m x - &1 / &n) pow 2))
         tends_num_real C`;;

title: putnam_2011_a6
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2011_a6:
;; the squared L2 deviation from uniformity of a generating random walk on a
;; finite abelian group has a positive finite exponential asymptotic. This file
;; contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))

;; The scalar arguments of the final predicate present the
;; Dedekind-complete ordered field of real numbers. The finite group is given
;; by a duplicate-free carrier and a complete multiplication table. The list
;; GSET is the source's finite set of distinct generators.

(defun putnam-2011-a6-real-member-p (carrier x)
  (if (apply$ carrier (list x)) t nil))

(defun putnam-2011-a6-real-unary (operation x)
  (apply$ operation (list x)))

(defun putnam-2011-a6-real-binary (operation x y)
  (apply$ operation (list x y)))

(defun putnam-2011-a6-real-positive-p
    (carrier less zero x)
  (and
   (putnam-2011-a6-real-member-p carrier x)
   (apply$ less (list zero x))))

(defun-sk putnam-2011-a6-field-laws-p
    (carrier add multiply negate inverse zero one)
  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (putnam-2011-a6-real-member-p carrier x)
      (putnam-2011-a6-real-member-p carrier y)
      (putnam-2011-a6-real-member-p carrier z))
     (and
      (putnam-2011-a6-real-member-p
       carrier
       (putnam-2011-a6-real-binary add x y))
      (putnam-2011-a6-real-member-p
       carrier
       (putnam-2011-a6-real-binary multiply x y))
      (putnam-2011-a6-real-member-p
       carrier
       (putnam-2011-a6-real-unary negate x))
      (implies
       (not (equal x zero))
       (putnam-2011-a6-real-member-p
        carrier
        (putnam-2011-a6-real-unary inverse x)))
      (equal
       (putnam-2011-a6-real-binary
        add
        (putnam-2011-a6-real-binary add x y)
        z)
       (putnam-2011-a6-real-binary
        add
        x
        (putnam-2011-a6-real-binary add y z)))
      (equal
       (putnam-2011-a6-real-binary add x y)
       (putnam-2011-a6-real-binary add y x))
      (equal
       (putnam-2011-a6-real-binary add x zero)
       x)
      (equal
       (putnam-2011-a6-real-binary
        add x (putnam-2011-a6-real-unary negate x))
       zero)
      (equal
       (putnam-2011-a6-real-binary
        multiply
        (putnam-2011-a6-real-binary multiply x y)
        z)
       (putnam-2011-a6-real-binary
        multiply
        x
        (putnam-2011-a6-real-binary multiply y z)))
      (equal
       (putnam-2011-a6-real-binary multiply x y)
       (putnam-2011-a6-real-binary multiply y x))
      (equal
       (putnam-2011-a6-real-binary multiply x one)
       x)
      (implies
       (not (equal x zero))
       (equal
        (putnam-2011-a6-real-binary
         multiply
         x
         (putnam-2011-a6-real-unary inverse x))
        one))
      (equal
       (putnam-2011-a6-real-binary
        multiply
        x
        (putnam-2011-a6-real-binary add y z))
       (putnam-2011-a6-real-binary
        add
        (putnam-2011-a6-real-binary multiply x y)
        (putnam-2011-a6-real-binary multiply x z)))))))

(defun-sk putnam-2011-a6-order-laws-p
    (carrier add multiply zero less)
  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (putnam-2011-a6-real-member-p carrier x)
      (putnam-2011-a6-real-member-p carrier y)
      (putnam-2011-a6-real-member-p carrier z))
     (and
      (not (apply$ less (list x x)))
      (or
       (equal x y)
       (apply$ less (list x y))
       (apply$ less (list y x)))
      (implies
       (and
        (apply$ less (list x y))
        (apply$ less (list y z)))
       (apply$ less (list x z)))
      (implies
       (apply$ less (list x y))
       (apply$
        less
        (list
         (putnam-2011-a6-real-binary add x z)
         (putnam-2011-a6-real-binary add y z))))
      (implies
       (and
        (apply$ less (list zero x))
        (apply$ less (list zero y)))
       (apply$
        less
        (list
         zero
         (putnam-2011-a6-real-binary multiply x y))))))))

(defun-sk putnam-2011-a6-set-nonempty-p
    (carrier set)
  (exists (x)
    (and
     (putnam-2011-a6-real-member-p carrier x)
     (apply$ set (list x)))))

(defun-sk putnam-2011-a6-upper-bound-p
    (carrier less set bound)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (and
      (putnam-2011-a6-real-member-p carrier x)
      (apply$ set (list x)))
     (not (apply$ less (list bound x))))))

(defun-sk putnam-2011-a6-bounded-above-p
    (carrier less set)
  (exists (bound)
    (and
     (putnam-2011-a6-real-member-p carrier bound)
     (putnam-2011-a6-upper-bound-p
      carrier less set bound))))

(defun-sk putnam-2011-a6-least-upper-bound-p
    (carrier less set supremum)
  (forall (bound)
    (implies
     (and
      (putnam-2011-a6-real-member-p carrier bound)
      (putnam-2011-a6-upper-bound-p
       carrier less set bound))
     (not (apply$ less (list bound supremum))))))

(defun putnam-2011-a6-supremum-p
    (carrier less set supremum)
  (and
   (putnam-2011-a6-real-member-p carrier supremum)
   (putnam-2011-a6-upper-bound-p
    carrier less set supremum)
   (putnam-2011-a6-least-upper-bound-p
    carrier less set supremum)))

(defun-sk putnam-2011-a6-has-supremum-p
    (carrier less set)
  (exists (supremum)
    (putnam-2011-a6-supremum-p
     carrier less set supremum)))

(defun-sk putnam-2011-a6-dedekind-complete-p
    (carrier less)
  (forall (set)
    (implies
     (and
      (tamep-functionp set)
      (putnam-2011-a6-set-nonempty-p carrier set)
      (putnam-2011-a6-bounded-above-p
       carrier less set))
     (putnam-2011-a6-has-supremum-p
      carrier less set))))

(defun putnam-2011-a6-real-nat
    (number zero one add)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix number)))
  (if (zp number)
      zero
    (putnam-2011-a6-real-binary
     add
     one
     (putnam-2011-a6-real-nat
      (- number 1) zero one add))))

(defun-sk putnam-2011-a6-arch-bound-exists-p
    (x add zero one less)
  (exists (bound)
    (and
     (natp bound)
     (apply$
      less
      (list
       x
       (putnam-2011-a6-real-nat
        bound zero one add))))))

(defun-sk putnam-2011-a6-archimedean-p
    (carrier add zero one less)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (putnam-2011-a6-real-member-p carrier x)
     (putnam-2011-a6-arch-bound-exists-p
      x add zero one less))))

(defun putnam-2011-a6-real-field-p
    (carrier add multiply negate inverse zero one less)
  (and
   (tamep-functionp carrier)
   (tamep-functionp add)
   (tamep-functionp multiply)
   (tamep-functionp negate)
   (tamep-functionp inverse)
   (tamep-functionp less)
   (putnam-2011-a6-real-member-p carrier zero)
   (putnam-2011-a6-real-member-p carrier one)
   (not (equal zero one))
   (putnam-2011-a6-field-laws-p
    carrier add multiply negate inverse zero one)
   (putnam-2011-a6-order-laws-p
    carrier add multiply zero less)
   (apply$ less (list zero one))
   (putnam-2011-a6-dedekind-complete-p
    carrier less)
   (putnam-2011-a6-archimedean-p
    carrier add zero one less)))

;; Finite abelian group presentation.

(defun putnam-2011-a6-set-list-p (xs)
  (if (consp xs)
      (and
       (not (member-equal (car xs) (cdr xs)))
       (putnam-2011-a6-set-list-p (cdr xs)))
    (equal xs nil)))

(defun putnam-2011-a6-subset-list-p (xs ys)
  (if (consp xs)
      (and
       (member-equal (car xs) ys)
       (putnam-2011-a6-subset-list-p (cdr xs) ys))
    (equal xs nil)))

(defun putnam-2011-a6-binary-table-p
    (table carrier)
  (if (consp table)
      (let* ((entry (car table))
             (arguments (car entry))
             (value (cdr entry)))
        (and
         (consp entry)
         (true-listp arguments)
         (equal (len arguments) 2)
         (member-equal (car arguments) carrier)
         (member-equal (cadr arguments) carrier)
         (member-equal value carrier)
         (not (assoc-equal arguments (cdr table)))
         (putnam-2011-a6-binary-table-p
          (cdr table) carrier)))
    (equal table nil)))

(defun putnam-2011-a6-group-multiply
    (left right table)
  (cdr (assoc-equal (list left right) table)))

(defun putnam-2011-a6-associative-z-p
    (zs x y table)
  (if (endp zs)
      t
    (let* ((z (car zs))
           (xy
            (putnam-2011-a6-group-multiply
             x y table))
           (yz
            (putnam-2011-a6-group-multiply
             y z table)))
      (and
       (equal
        (putnam-2011-a6-group-multiply xy z table)
        (putnam-2011-a6-group-multiply x yz table))
       (putnam-2011-a6-associative-z-p
        (cdr zs) x y table)))))

(defun putnam-2011-a6-group-y-axioms-p
    (ys carrier x table)
  (if (endp ys)
      t
    (let ((y (car ys)))
      (and
       (assoc-equal (list x y) table)
       (equal
        (putnam-2011-a6-group-multiply x y table)
        (putnam-2011-a6-group-multiply y x table))
       (putnam-2011-a6-associative-z-p
        carrier x y table)
       (putnam-2011-a6-group-y-axioms-p
        (cdr ys) carrier x table)))))

(defun putnam-2011-a6-inverse-exists-p
    (x candidates one table)
  (if (endp candidates)
      nil
    (or
     (and
      (equal
       (putnam-2011-a6-group-multiply
        x (car candidates) table)
       one)
      (equal
       (putnam-2011-a6-group-multiply
        (car candidates) x table)
       one))
     (putnam-2011-a6-inverse-exists-p
      x (cdr candidates) one table))))

(defun putnam-2011-a6-group-x-axioms-p
    (xs carrier one table)
  (if (endp xs)
      t
    (let ((x (car xs)))
      (and
       (equal
        (putnam-2011-a6-group-multiply one x table)
        x)
       (equal
        (putnam-2011-a6-group-multiply x one table)
        x)
       (putnam-2011-a6-inverse-exists-p
        x carrier one table)
       (putnam-2011-a6-group-y-axioms-p
        carrier carrier x table)
       (putnam-2011-a6-group-x-axioms-p
        (cdr xs) carrier one table)))))

(defun putnam-2011-a6-finite-abelian-group-p
    (carrier one table)
  (and
   (putnam-2011-a6-set-list-p carrier)
   (consp carrier)
   (member-equal one carrier)
   (putnam-2011-a6-binary-table-p table carrier)
   (putnam-2011-a6-group-x-axioms-p
    carrier carrier one table)))

;; Generation is not bounded: each carrier element has an internal finite
;; word witness over GSET whose product is that element.

(defun putnam-2011-a6-word-product
    (word one table)
  (if (endp word)
      one
    (putnam-2011-a6-group-multiply
     (car word)
     (putnam-2011-a6-word-product
      (cdr word) one table)
     table)))

(defun-sk putnam-2011-a6-generator-word-exists-p
    (gset one table target)
  (exists (word)
    (and
     (true-listp word)
     (putnam-2011-a6-subset-list-p word gset)
     (equal
      (putnam-2011-a6-word-product word one table)
      target))))

(defun-sk putnam-2011-a6-generates-p
    (carrier gset one table)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (member-equal x carrier)
     (putnam-2011-a6-generator-word-exists-p
      gset one table x))))

(defun putnam-2011-a6-generator-data-p
    (carrier gset one table n k)
  (and
   (natp n)
   (natp k)
   (equal n (len carrier))
   (putnam-2011-a6-set-list-p gset)
   (putnam-2011-a6-subset-list-p gset carrier)
   (equal k (len gset))
   (< k n)
   (member-equal one gset)
   (putnam-2011-a6-generates-p
    carrier gset one table)))

;; Exact enumeration of all functions Fin m -> GSET as words of length m.

(defun putnam-2011-a6-prepend-to-words
    (letter words)
  (if (endp words)
      nil
    (cons
     (cons letter (car words))
     (putnam-2011-a6-prepend-to-words
      letter (cdr words)))))

(defun putnam-2011-a6-extend-words
    (letters words)
  (if (endp letters)
      nil
    (append
     (putnam-2011-a6-prepend-to-words
      (car letters) words)
     (putnam-2011-a6-extend-words
      (cdr letters) words))))

(defun putnam-2011-a6-all-words
    (gset length)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix length)))
  (if (zp length)
      (list nil)
    (putnam-2011-a6-extend-words
     gset
     (putnam-2011-a6-all-words
      gset (- length 1)))))

(defun putnam-2011-a6-count-product-words
    (words target one table)
  (if (endp words)
      0
    (+
     (if
      (equal
       (putnam-2011-a6-word-product
        (car words) one table)
       target)
      1
      0)
     (putnam-2011-a6-count-product-words
      (cdr words) target one table))))

;; Field arithmetic for probabilities and normalized errors.

(defun putnam-2011-a6-real-power
    (base exponent one multiply)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix exponent)))
  (if (zp exponent)
      one
    (putnam-2011-a6-real-binary
     multiply
     base
     (putnam-2011-a6-real-power
      base (- exponent 1) one multiply))))

(defun putnam-2011-a6-real-divide
    (numerator denominator multiply inverse)
  (putnam-2011-a6-real-binary
   multiply
   numerator
   (putnam-2011-a6-real-unary
    inverse denominator)))

(defun putnam-2011-a6-probability
    (m target gset one table
     real-zero real-one real-add real-multiply real-inverse)
  (let* ((count
          (putnam-2011-a6-count-product-words
           (putnam-2011-a6-all-words gset m)
           target one table))
         (numerator
          (putnam-2011-a6-real-nat
           count real-zero real-one real-add))
         (k-real
          (putnam-2011-a6-real-nat
           (len gset) real-zero real-one real-add))
         (denominator
          (putnam-2011-a6-real-power
           k-real m real-one real-multiply)))
    (putnam-2011-a6-real-divide
     numerator denominator real-multiply real-inverse)))

(defun putnam-2011-a6-uniform-probability
    (n real-zero real-one real-add real-multiply real-inverse)
  (putnam-2011-a6-real-divide
   real-one
   (putnam-2011-a6-real-nat
    n real-zero real-one real-add)
   real-multiply
   real-inverse))

(defun putnam-2011-a6-deviation-square-sum
    (elements m n gset one table
     real-zero real-one real-add real-multiply
     real-negate real-inverse)
  (if (endp elements)
      real-zero
    (let* ((probability
            (putnam-2011-a6-probability
             m (car elements) gset one table
             real-zero real-one real-add
             real-multiply real-inverse))
           (uniform
            (putnam-2011-a6-uniform-probability
             n real-zero real-one real-add
             real-multiply real-inverse))
           (deviation
            (putnam-2011-a6-real-binary
             real-add
             probability
             (putnam-2011-a6-real-unary
              real-negate uniform)))
           (square
            (putnam-2011-a6-real-binary
             real-multiply deviation deviation)))
      (putnam-2011-a6-real-binary
       real-add
       square
       (putnam-2011-a6-deviation-square-sum
        (cdr elements) m n gset one table
        real-zero real-one real-add real-multiply
        real-negate real-inverse)))))

(defun putnam-2011-a6-normalized-error
    (m carrier n gset one table b
     real-zero real-one real-add real-multiply
     real-negate real-inverse)
  (let* ((b-power
          (putnam-2011-a6-real-power
           b (* 2 m) real-one real-multiply))
         (error
          (putnam-2011-a6-deviation-square-sum
           carrier m n gset one table
           real-zero real-one real-add real-multiply
           real-negate real-inverse)))
    (putnam-2011-a6-real-binary
     real-multiply
     (putnam-2011-a6-real-unary
      real-inverse b-power)
     error)))

(defun putnam-2011-a6-real-absolute
    (less negate zero x)
  (if (apply$ less (list x zero))
      (putnam-2011-a6-real-unary negate x)
    x))

(defun putnam-2011-a6-real-distance
    (add negate less zero x y)
  (putnam-2011-a6-real-absolute
   less negate zero
   (putnam-2011-a6-real-binary
    add
    x
    (putnam-2011-a6-real-unary negate y))))

;; Epsilon definition of convergence of the normalized squared deviations.

(defun-sk putnam-2011-a6-limit-tail-p
    (carrier n gset one table b c
     real-zero real-one real-add real-multiply
     real-negate real-inverse real-less
     epsilon cutoff)
  (forall (m)
    (implies
     (and
      (natp m)
      (<= cutoff m))
     (apply$
      real-less
      (list
       (putnam-2011-a6-real-distance
        real-add real-negate real-less real-zero
        (putnam-2011-a6-normalized-error
         m carrier n gset one table b
         real-zero real-one real-add real-multiply
         real-negate real-inverse)
        c)
       epsilon)))))

(defun-sk putnam-2011-a6-limit-cutoff-exists-p
    (carrier n gset one table b c
     real-zero real-one real-add real-multiply
     real-negate real-inverse real-less epsilon)
  (exists (cutoff)
    (and
     (natp cutoff)
     (putnam-2011-a6-limit-tail-p
      carrier n gset one table b c
      real-zero real-one real-add real-multiply
      real-negate real-inverse real-less
      epsilon cutoff))))

(defun-sk putnam-2011-a6-converges-p
    (real-carrier carrier n gset one table b c
     real-zero real-one real-add real-multiply
     real-negate real-inverse real-less)
  (forall (epsilon)
    (implies
     (putnam-2011-a6-real-positive-p
      real-carrier real-less real-zero epsilon)
     (putnam-2011-a6-limit-cutoff-exists-p
      carrier n gset one table b c
      real-zero real-one real-add real-multiply
      real-negate real-inverse real-less epsilon))))

(defun putnam-2011-a6-positive-limit-witness-p
    (real-carrier carrier n gset one table b c
     real-zero real-one real-add real-multiply
     real-negate real-inverse real-less)
  (and
   (putnam-2011-a6-real-member-p real-carrier b)
   (apply$ real-less (list real-zero b))
   (apply$ real-less (list b real-one))
   (putnam-2011-a6-real-member-p real-carrier c)
   (apply$ real-less (list real-zero c))
   (putnam-2011-a6-converges-p
    real-carrier carrier n gset one table b c
    real-zero real-one real-add real-multiply
    real-negate real-inverse real-less)))

(defun-sk putnam-2011-a6-positive-limit-exists-p
    (real-carrier carrier n gset one table
     real-zero real-one real-add real-multiply
     real-negate real-inverse real-less)
  (exists (b c)
    (putnam-2011-a6-positive-limit-witness-p
     real-carrier carrier n gset one table b c
     real-zero real-one real-add real-multiply
     real-negate real-inverse real-less)))

(defun putnambench-putnam-2011-a6-statement
    (carrier one table gset n k
     real-carrier real-zero real-one real-add real-multiply
     real-negate real-inverse real-less)
  (implies
   (and
    (putnam-2011-a6-finite-abelian-group-p
     carrier one table)
    (putnam-2011-a6-generator-data-p
     carrier gset one table n k)
    (putnam-2011-a6-real-field-p
     real-carrier real-add real-multiply real-negate
     real-inverse real-zero real-one real-less))
   (putnam-2011-a6-positive-limit-exists-p
    real-carrier carrier n gset one table
    real-zero real-one real-add real-multiply
    real-negate real-inverse real-less)))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

title: putnam_2011_a6
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2011_a6
-- (putnambench__agda__putnam_2011_a6): exponential-rate convergence to the
-- uniform distribution for a generating die on a finite abelian group.
-- This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module Putnam2011A6 where

open import Agda.Builtin.Bool using (Bool; false; true)
open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; _*_)

infix 4 _!=_ _<=N_ _<N_
infixr 3 _and_
infixr 5 _::_

data Bottom : Set where

Not : Set -> Set
Not A =
  A -> Bottom

_!=_ : {A : Set} -> A -> A -> Set
x != y =
  Not (x == y)

record _and_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data _or_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  left  : A -> A or B
  right : B -> A or B

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

data _<=N_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set where
  zero<=N   : {n : Nat} -> zero <=N n
  suc<=sucN : {m n : Nat} -> m <=N n -> suc m <=N suc n

data _<N_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set where
  zero<sucN : {n : Nat} -> zero <N suc n
  suc<sucN  : {m n : Nat} -> m <N n -> suc m <N suc n

data Fin : Nat -> Set where
  fzero : {n : Nat} -> Fin (suc n)
  fsuc  : {n : Nat} -> Fin n -> Fin (suc n)

data Vec (A : Set) : Nat -> Set where
  []   : Vec A zero
  _::_ : {n : Nat} -> A -> Vec A n -> Vec A (suc n)

sameFin : {n : Nat} -> Fin n -> Fin n -> Bool
sameFin fzero fzero =
  true
sameFin fzero (fsuc j) =
  false
sameFin (fsuc i) fzero =
  false
sameFin (fsuc i) (fsuc j) =
  sameFin i j

ifBool : {A : Set} -> Bool -> A -> A -> A
ifBool true whenTrue whenFalse =
  whenTrue
ifBool false whenTrue whenFalse =
  whenFalse

oneN : Nat
oneN =
  suc zero

twoN : Nat
twoN =
  suc oneN

naturalPowerNat : Nat -> Nat -> Nat
naturalPowerNat base zero =
  oneN
naturalPowerNat base (suc exponent) =
  base * naturalPowerNat base exponent

sumNatFin :
  {n : Nat} ->
  (Fin n -> Nat) ->
  Nat
sumNatFin {zero} term =
  zero
sumNatFin {suc n} term =
  term fzero +
  sumNatFin (\ i -> term (fsuc i))

record CompleteOrderedRealField (R : Set) : Set1 where
  field
    zeroR oneR : R
    add multiply : R -> R -> R
    negate inverse : R -> R
    lessOrEqual : R -> R -> Set
    fromNat : Nat -> R

    one-not-zero :
      oneR != zeroR

    add-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> add x y == add y x
    add-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      add (add x y) z == add x (add y z)
    add-zero :
      (x : R) -> add x zeroR == x
    add-inverse :
      (x : R) -> add x (negate x) == zeroR

    multiply-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> multiply x y == multiply y x
    multiply-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply (multiply x y) z ==
      multiply x (multiply y z)
    multiply-one :
      (x : R) -> multiply x oneR == x
    multiply-zero :
      (x : R) -> multiply x zeroR == zeroR
    distribute :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply x (add y z) ==
      add (multiply x y) (multiply x z)
    inverse-zero :
      inverse zeroR == zeroR
    multiply-inverse :
      (x : R) ->
      x != zeroR ->
      multiply x (inverse x) == oneR

    order-reflexive :
      (x : R) -> lessOrEqual x x
    order-transitive :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y z ->
      lessOrEqual x z
    order-antisymmetric :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y x ->
      x == y
    order-total :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y or lessOrEqual y x
    add-order :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual (add z x) (add z y)
    multiply-nonnegative :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR x ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR y ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR (multiply x y)
    zero-less-than-one :
      lessOrEqual zeroR oneR and zeroR != oneR

    fromNat-zero :
      fromNat zero == zeroR
    fromNat-successor :
      (n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (suc n) == add (fromNat n) oneR
    fromNat-addition :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m + n) == add (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-multiplication :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m * n) == multiply (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-injective :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat m == fromNat n ->
      m == n

    archimedean :
      (x : R) ->
      Exists Nat
        (\ n ->
          lessOrEqual x (fromNat n))
    least-upper-bound :
      (P : R -> Set) ->
      Exists R P ->
      Exists R
        (\ upper ->
          (x : R) ->
          P x ->
          lessOrEqual x upper) ->
      Exists R
        (\ supremum ->
          ((x : R) ->
            P x ->
            lessOrEqual x supremum)
          and
          ((upper : R) ->
            ((x : R) ->
              P x ->
              lessOrEqual x upper) ->
            lessOrEqual supremum upper))

open CompleteOrderedRealField

subtract :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
subtract reals x y =
  add reals x (negate reals y)

divide :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
divide reals x y =
  multiply reals x (inverse reals y)

naturalPower :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  Nat ->
  R
naturalPower reals x zero =
  oneR reals
naturalPower reals x (suc exponent) =
  multiply reals
    (naturalPower reals x exponent)
    x

square :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R
square reals x =
  multiply reals x x

StrictLess :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
StrictLess reals x y =
  lessOrEqual reals x y and x != y

CloseTo :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
CloseTo reals center radius x =
  StrictLess reals
    (subtract reals center radius)
    x
  and
  StrictLess reals
    x
    (add reals center radius)

ConvergesTo :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  R ->
  Set
ConvergesTo {R} reals sequence limit =
  (epsilon : R) ->
  StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) epsilon ->
  Exists Nat
    (\ cutoff ->
      (m : Nat) ->
      cutoff <=N m ->
      CloseTo reals limit epsilon (sequence m))

sumFin :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  {n : Nat} ->
  (Fin n -> R) ->
  R
sumFin reals {zero} term =
  zeroR reals
sumFin reals {suc n} term =
  add reals
    (term fzero)
    (sumFin reals (\ i -> term (fsuc i)))

record FiniteCommutativeGroup (n : Nat) : Set1 where
  field
    Carrier :
      Set
    identity :
      Carrier
    multiplyG :
      Carrier ->
      Carrier ->
      Carrier
    inverseG :
      Carrier ->
      Carrier

    associative :
      (x y z : Carrier) ->
      multiplyG (multiplyG x y) z ==
      multiplyG x (multiplyG y z)
    identity-left :
      (x : Carrier) ->
      multiplyG identity x == x
    identity-right :
      (x : Carrier) ->
      multiplyG x identity == x
    inverse-left :
      (x : Carrier) ->
      multiplyG (inverseG x) x == identity
    inverse-right :
      (x : Carrier) ->
      multiplyG x (inverseG x) == identity
    commutative :
      (x y : Carrier) ->
      multiplyG x y == multiplyG y x

    toFin :
      Carrier ->
      Fin n
    fromFin :
      Fin n ->
      Carrier
    from-to :
      (x : Carrier) ->
      fromFin (toFin x) == x
    to-from :
      (i : Fin n) ->
      toFin (fromFin i) == i

open FiniteCommutativeGroup

Injective :
  {A B : Set} ->
  (A -> B) ->
  Set
Injective {A = A} f =
  (x y : A) ->
  f x == f y ->
  x == y

productWord :
  {n k m : Nat} ->
  (G : FiniteCommutativeGroup n) ->
  (generators : Fin k -> Carrier G) ->
  Vec (Fin k) m ->
  Carrier G
productWord G generators [] =
  identity G
productWord G generators (i :: word) =
  multiplyG G
    (generators i)
    (productWord G generators word)

IdentityIncluded :
  {n k : Nat} ->
  (G : FiniteCommutativeGroup n) ->
  (Fin k -> Carrier G) ->
  Set
IdentityIncluded G generators =
  Exists (Fin _)
    (\ i ->
      generators i == identity G)

Generates :
  {n k : Nat} ->
  (G : FiniteCommutativeGroup n) ->
  (Fin k -> Carrier G) ->
  Set
Generates G generators =
  (x : Carrier G) ->
  Exists Nat
    (\ m ->
      Exists (Vec (Fin _) m)
        (\ word ->
          productWord G generators word == x))

wordCount :
  {n k : Nat} ->
  (G : FiniteCommutativeGroup n) ->
  (generators : Fin k -> Carrier G) ->
  Nat ->
  Carrier G ->
  Nat
wordCount G generators zero x =
  ifBool
    (sameFin (toFin G x) (toFin G (identity G)))
    oneN
    zero
wordCount G generators (suc m) x =
  sumNatFin
    (\ i ->
      wordCount G generators m
        (multiplyG G
          (inverseG G (generators i))
          x))

dieProbability :
  {R : Set} {n k : Nat} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (G : FiniteCommutativeGroup n) ->
  (Fin k -> Carrier G) ->
  Nat ->
  Carrier G ->
  R
dieProbability {k = k} reals G generators m x =
  divide reals
    (fromNat reals (wordCount G generators m x))
    (fromNat reals (naturalPowerNat k m))

squaredDistanceFromUniform :
  {R : Set} {n k : Nat} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (G : FiniteCommutativeGroup n) ->
  (Fin k -> Carrier G) ->
  Nat ->
  R
squaredDistanceFromUniform {n = n} reals G generators m =
  sumFin reals
    (\ i ->
      square reals
        (subtract reals
          (dieProbability reals G generators m (fromFin G i))
          (divide reals
            (oneR reals)
            (fromNat reals n))))

normalizedSquaredDistance :
  {R : Set} {n k : Nat} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (G : FiniteCommutativeGroup n) ->
  (Fin k -> Carrier G) ->
  R ->
  Nat ->
  R
normalizedSquaredDistance reals G generators b m =
  multiply reals
    (divide reals
      (oneR reals)
      (naturalPower reals b (twoN * m)))
    (squaredDistanceFromUniform reals G generators m)

PutnamConclusion :
  {R : Set} {n k : Nat} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (G : FiniteCommutativeGroup n) ->
  (Fin k -> Carrier G) ->
  Set
PutnamConclusion {R} reals G generators =
  Exists R
    (\ b ->
      (StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) b
      and
      StrictLess reals b (oneR reals))
      and
      Exists R
        (\ C ->
          StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) C
          and
          ConvergesTo reals
            (normalizedSquaredDistance reals G generators b)
            C))

putnam-2011-a6 : Set1
putnam-2011-a6 =
  (R : Set) ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) ->
  (n k : Nat) ->
  (G : FiniteCommutativeGroup n) ->
  (generators : Fin k -> Carrier G) ->
  Injective generators ->
  k <N n ->
  IdentityIncluded G generators ->
  Generates G generators ->
  PutnamConclusion reals G generators

title: putnam_2011_a6
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2011_a6:
  exponential-rate convergence to the uniform distribution for a random walk
  generated by a proper set in a finite abelian group. This file contains no
  proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open arithmeticTheory listTheory pred_setTheory realTheory real_sigmaTheory
     real_topologyTheory groupTheory;

val putnam_2011_a6 =
  ``!(g : 'a group) (n k : num) (gset : 'a set).
      let mgprob =
        \m : num. \x : 'a.
          (&(CARD
               {l : 'a list |
                  LENGTH l = m /\
                  LIST_TO_SET l SUBSET gset /\
                  FOLDR g.op g.id l = x}) : real) /
          (&k : real) pow m
      in
        FiniteAbelianGroup g /\
        CARD g.carrier = n /\
        gset SUBSET g.carrier /\
        CARD gset = k /\
        k < n /\
        g.id IN gset /\
        (!x : 'a.
           x IN g.carrier
           ==>
           ?l : 'a list.
             LIST_TO_SET l SUBSET gset /\
             FOLDR g.op g.id l = x)
        ==>
        ?b C : real.
          0 < b /\
          b < 1 /\
          0 < C /\
          ((\m : num.
              (1 / b pow (2 * m)) *
              SIGMA
                (\x : 'a.
                   (mgprob m x - 1 / (&n : real)) pow 2)
                g.carrier) -->
           C) sequentially``;

title: putnam_2011_a6
content:
$(
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact
  putnam_2011_a6: exponential-rate convergence to uniformity for the random
  walk generated by a proper identity-containing generating subset of a
  finite abelian group. This file contains no proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  In SetMM, G e. Abel ranges over arbitrary abelian group structures,
  Base ` G is the carrier, Fin and # express finiteness and finite
  cardinality, 0g ` G is the identity, and subgroup generation is the
  Moore closure in SubGrp ` G.

  For m in NN0, the maps f from 0 ..^ m into S are exactly the ordered
  m-tuples of die outcomes. The expression G gsum f is their group product,
  including the identity for the unique empty tuple. Thus the displayed
  finite cardinality divided by k^m is definitionally the source probability
  mgprob(m,x), with that auxiliary function directly substituted.

  The inner finite sum ranges over the complete group carrier, and ~~> is
  set.mm's real-sequence convergence relation. Both b in the open unit
  interval and the positive finite real limit C remain internally
  existentially quantified. The final declaration is the single unproved
  $a corpus statement; this database contains no $p proof declaration.
$)

${
  $d b c f g k m n s x $.

  putnambench-putnam-2011-a6 $a |-
    A. g A. n e. NN0 A. s A. k e. NN0
      (
        (
          (
            (
              (
                (
                  g e. Abel
                  /\
                  ( Base ` g ) e. Fin
                )
                /\
                ( # ` ( Base ` g ) ) = n
              )
              /\
              (
                s C_ ( Base ` g )
                /\
                ( # ` s ) = k
              )
            )
            /\
            (
              k < n
              /\
              ( 0g ` g ) e. s
            )
          )
          /\
          (
            ( ( mrCls ` ( SubGrp ` g ) ) ` s )
            =
            ( Base ` g )
          )
        )
        ->
        E. b e. ( 0 (,) 1 ) E. c e. RR
          (
            0 < c
            /\
            (
              m e. NN0 |->
                (
                  1
                  /
                  ( b ^ ( 2 x. m ) )
                )
                x.
                (
                  sum_ x e. ( Base ` g )
                    (
                      (
                        (
                          #
                          `
                          {
                            f e. ( s ^m ( 0 ..^ m ) ) |
                            ( g gsum f ) = x
                          }
                        )
                        /
                        ( k ^ m )
                      )
                      -
                      ( 1 / n )
                    )
                    ^ 2
                )
            )
            ~~>
            c
          )
      )
  $.
$}

begin

::$P-
theorem
  for G being finite Group,
      A being Subset of G,
      n,k being Nat,
      p being Function of [:NAT,the carrier of G:],REAL st
    (for a,b being Element of G holds a * b = b * a) &
    n = card G &
    card A = k &
    k < n &
    1_G in A &
    (for x being Element of G holds
      ex w being FinSequence of the carrier of G st
        rng w c= A & Product w = x) &
    (for m being Nat, x being Element of G holds
      ex q being Nat st
        q = card {w where w is FinSequence of the carrier of G :
          len w = m & rng w c= A & Product w = x} &
        p.(m,x) = (q qua Real) / ((k qua Real) |^ m))
  holds
    ex b,C being Real,
       elements being FinSequence of the carrier of G,
       s being Real_Sequence st
      0 < b & b < 1 & 0 < C &
      rng elements = the carrier of G &
      (for i,j being Nat st
        i in dom elements & j in dom elements & elements.i = elements.j
        holds i = j) &
      (for m being Nat holds
        ex terms being FinSequence of REAL st
          len terms = len elements &
          (for i being Nat st i in dom elements holds
            ex x being Element of G st
              x = elements.i &
              terms.i = (p.(m,x) - 1 / (n qua Real)) |^ 2) &
          s.m = (1 / (b |^ (2*m))) * Sum terms) &
      for epsilon being Real st 0 < epsilon holds
        ex N being Nat st
          for m being Nat st N <= m holds
            C - epsilon < s.m & s.m < C + epsilon
proof
end;
::$P+

title: putnam_2011_a6
content:
% Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2011_a6:
% the squared distance from uniformity for a generating random walk on a
% finite abelian group has a positive finite leading exponential rate.
% This file contains no proof.

putnam_2011_a6[Element: TYPE+]: THEORY
BEGIN
  IMPORTING finite_sets@finite_sets_sum_real[Element]

  element_set: TYPE = finite_set[Element]
  element_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> Element]
  real_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> real]

  safe_div(numerator, denominator: real): real =
    IF denominator = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      numerator / denominator
    ENDIF

  subset_of(A, B: element_set): bool =
    FORALL (x: Element):
      A(x) IMPLIES B(x)

  finite_commutative_group(
      carrier: element_set,
      one: Element,
      inverse: [Element -> Element],
      multiply: [Element, Element -> Element]): bool =
    carrier(one)
      AND
        (FORALL (x, y: Element):
          carrier(x) AND carrier(y) IMPLIES
            carrier(multiply(x, y)))
      AND
        (FORALL (x: Element):
          carrier(x) IMPLIES carrier(inverse(x)))
      AND
        (FORALL (x, y, z: Element):
          carrier(x) AND carrier(y) AND carrier(z) IMPLIES
            multiply(multiply(x, y), z)
              = multiply(x, multiply(y, z)))
      AND
        (FORALL (x: Element):
          carrier(x) IMPLIES
            multiply(one, x) = x
              AND multiply(x, one) = x)
      AND
        (FORALL (x: Element):
          carrier(x) IMPLIES
            multiply(inverse(x), x) = one
              AND multiply(x, inverse(x)) = one)
      AND
        (FORALL (x, y: Element):
          carrier(x) AND carrier(y) IMPLIES
            multiply(x, y) = multiply(y, x))

  is_subgroup(
      subgroup, carrier: element_set,
      one: Element,
      inverse: [Element -> Element],
      multiply: [Element, Element -> Element]): bool =
    subset_of(subgroup, carrier)
      AND subgroup(one)
      AND
        (FORALL (x, y: Element):
          subgroup(x) AND subgroup(y) IMPLIES
            subgroup(multiply(x, y)))
      AND
        (FORALL (x: Element):
          subgroup(x) IMPLIES subgroup(inverse(x)))

  generates_group(
      generators, carrier: element_set,
      one: Element,
      inverse: [Element -> Element],
      multiply: [Element, Element -> Element]): bool =
    subset_of(generators, carrier)
      AND
        (FORALL (subgroup: element_set):
          (is_subgroup(
              subgroup, carrier, one, inverse, multiply)
            AND subset_of(generators, subgroup))
          IMPLIES subset_of(carrier, subgroup))

  injective_below(
      enumeration: element_sequence,
      bound: nat): bool =
    FORALL (i, j: nat):
      i < bound
        AND j < bound
        AND enumeration(i) = enumeration(j)
      IMPLIES i = j

  enumerates_exactly(
      enumeration: element_sequence,
      set_value: element_set,
      bound: nat): bool =
    FORALL (x: Element):
      set_value(x)
        IFF
          EXISTS (index: nat):
            index < bound
              AND enumeration(index) = x

  die_digit(code: nat, face_count: posnat, index: nat): nat =
    mod(ndiv(code, face_count ^ index), face_count)

  word_product(
      faces: element_sequence,
      multiply: [Element, Element -> Element],
      one: Element,
      face_count: posnat,
      code, length: nat): RECURSIVE Element =
    IF length = 0 THEN
      one
    ELSE
      multiply(
        word_product(
          faces, multiply, one,
          face_count, code, length - 1),
        faces(die_digit(
          code, face_count, length - 1)))
    ENDIF
  MEASURE length

  matching_word_count(
      faces: element_sequence,
      multiply: [Element, Element -> Element],
      one, target: Element,
      face_count: posnat,
      length, limit: nat): RECURSIVE nat =
    IF limit = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      matching_word_count(
        faces, multiply, one, target,
        face_count, length, limit - 1)
        + IF word_product(
              faces, multiply, one,
              face_count, limit - 1, length)
              = target
          THEN 1
          ELSE 0
          ENDIF
    ENDIF
  MEASURE limit

  die_probability(
      faces: element_sequence,
      multiply: [Element, Element -> Element],
      one, target: Element,
      face_count: posnat,
      length: nat): real =
    safe_div(
      matching_word_count(
        faces, multiply, one, target,
        face_count, length, face_count ^ length) :: real,
      (face_count ^ length) :: real)

  squared_distance_from_uniform(
      carrier: element_set,
      faces: element_sequence,
      multiply: [Element, Element -> Element],
      one: Element,
      group_order, face_count: posnat,
      length: nat): real =
    sum(
      carrier,
      LAMBDA (x: Element):
        (die_probability(
          faces, multiply, one, x, face_count, length)
          - safe_div(1, group_order :: real)) ^ 2)

  converges_to(sequence: real_sequence, value: real): bool =
    FORALL (epsilon_value: posreal):
      EXISTS (cutoff: nat):
        FORALL (index: nat):
          cutoff <= index IMPLIES
            abs(sequence(index) - value) < epsilon_value

  putnam_2011_a6: bool =
    FORALL
        (carrier, generators: element_set),
        (one: Element),
        (inverse: [Element -> Element]),
        (multiply: [Element, Element -> Element]),
        (group_order, face_count: posnat),
        (faces: element_sequence):
      (finite_commutative_group(
          carrier, one, inverse, multiply)
        AND group_order = card(carrier)
        AND face_count = card(generators)
        AND face_count < group_order
        AND generators(one)
        AND generates_group(
          generators, carrier, one, inverse, multiply)
        AND injective_below(faces, face_count)
        AND enumerates_exactly(
          faces, generators, face_count))
      IMPLIES
        EXISTS (b, C: real):
          0 < b
            AND b < 1
            AND C > 0
            AND converges_to(
              LAMBDA (length: nat):
                safe_div(1, b ^ (2 * length))
                  * squared_distance_from_uniform(
                      carrier, faces, multiply, one,
                      group_order, face_count, length),
              C)
END putnam_2011_a6

title: putnam_2011_b1

import Mathlib

open Topology Filter Matrix

/--
Let $h$ and $k$ be positive integers. Prove that for every $\epsilon>0$, there are positive integers $m$ and $n$ such that $\epsilon<|h\sqrt{m}-k\sqrt{n}|<2\epsilon$.
-/
theorem putnam_2011_b1
(h k : ℤ)
(hkpos : h > 0 ∧ k > 0)
: ∀ ε > 0, ∃ m n : ℤ, m > 0 ∧ n > 0 ∧ ε < |h * Real.sqrt m - k * Real.sqrt n| ∧ |h * Real.sqrt m - k * Real.sqrt n| < 2 * ε :=

title: putnam_2011_b1
content:
theory putnam_2011_b1 imports Complex_Main

content:
;; Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2011_b1:
;; positive integer multiples of square roots have a difference strictly
;; between epsilon and twice epsilon for every positive real epsilon. This
;; file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))

;; This conservative generic symbol is an arbitrary rational Cauchy name for
;; EPSILON. Regularity and positivity remain explicit in the statement, so
;; the symbol supplies no mathematical assumption by itself.
(defstub putnam-2011-b1-epsilon-approx (precision) t)

;; A regular rational Cauchy name denotes an exact element of the real
;; completion. Thus EPSILON is an arbitrary positive real, not a rational.
(defun putnam-2011-b1-positive-rational-p (x)
  (and
   (rationalp x)
   (< 0 x)))

(defun-sk putnam-2011-b1-regular-real-name-p ()
  (forall (precision eta)
    (implies
     (and
      (putnam-2011-b1-positive-rational-p precision)
      (putnam-2011-b1-positive-rational-p eta))
     (let ((left (putnam-2011-b1-epsilon-approx precision))
           (right (putnam-2011-b1-epsilon-approx eta)))
       (and
        (rationalp left)
        (rationalp right)
        (<= (abs (- left right))
            (+ precision eta)))))))

;; For a regular name, these predicates are exactly strict comparison with a
;; rational. The positive MARGIN makes the comparison strict, and rational
;; density makes the existential characterizations bidirectional.
(defun-sk putnam-2011-b1-real-less-than-rational-p (q)
  (exists (precision margin)
    (and
     (rationalp q)
     (putnam-2011-b1-positive-rational-p precision)
     (putnam-2011-b1-positive-rational-p margin)
     (let ((sample
            (putnam-2011-b1-epsilon-approx precision)))
       (and
        (rationalp sample)
        (< (+ sample precision margin) q))))))

(defun-sk putnam-2011-b1-rational-less-than-real-p (q)
  (exists (precision margin)
    (and
     (rationalp q)
     (putnam-2011-b1-positive-rational-p precision)
     (putnam-2011-b1-positive-rational-p margin)
     (let ((sample
            (putnam-2011-b1-epsilon-approx precision)))
       (and
        (rationalp sample)
        (< (+ q precision margin) sample))))))

(defun putnam-2011-b1-positive-real-p ()
  (and
   (putnam-2011-b1-regular-real-name-p)
   (putnam-2011-b1-rational-less-than-real-p 0)))

;; For positive A and B, |sqrt(A)-sqrt(B)| < Q is equivalent to
;; A+B-Q^2 < 2*sqrt(A*B). Squaring after the sign split is exact.
(defun putnam-2011-b1-root-distance-less-p (a b q)
  (and
   (posp a)
   (posp b)
   (rationalp q)
   (< 0 q)
   (let ((side (- (+ a b) (* q q))))
     (or
      (< side 0)
      (< (* side side)
         (* 4 a b))))))

;; This is the analogous exact characterization of
;; Q < |sqrt(A)-sqrt(B)|.
(defun putnam-2011-b1-root-distance-greater-p (a b q)
  (and
   (posp a)
   (posp b)
   (rationalp q)
   (< 0 q)
   (let ((side (- (+ a b) (* q q))))
     (and
      (< 0 side)
      (< (* 4 a b)
         (* side side))))))

;; LOWER and UPPER are dense rational separators:
;;
;;   epsilon < LOWER < |h*sqrt(m)-k*sqrt(n)|
;;     < UPPER < 2*epsilon.
;;
;; Their existence is equivalent to the source's two strict real
;; inequalities. The positive integer witnesses M and N remain internal.
(defun-sk putnam-2011-b1-witness-exists-p (h k)
  (exists (m n lower upper)
    (and
     (posp m)
     (posp n)
     (putnam-2011-b1-real-less-than-rational-p
      lower)
     (let ((left (* h h m))
           (right (* k k n)))
       (and
        (putnam-2011-b1-root-distance-greater-p
         left right lower)
        (putnam-2011-b1-root-distance-less-p
         left right upper)))
     (putnam-2011-b1-rational-less-than-real-p
      (/ upper 2)))))

(defun putnambench-putnam-2011-b1-statement (h k)
  (implies
   (and
    (posp h)
    (posp k)
    (putnam-2011-b1-positive-real-p))
   (putnam-2011-b1-witness-exists-p h k)))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

title: putnam_2011_b1
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2011_b1
-- (putnambench__agda__putnam_2011_b1): for positive integers h and k, every
-- positive real epsilon admits positive integers m and n such that
-- epsilon < |h * sqrt(m) - k * sqrt(n)| < 2 * epsilon.
-- This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module Putnam2011B1 where

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; _*_)

infix 4 _!=_
infixr 3 _and_

data Bottom : Set where

Not : Set -> Set
Not A =
  A -> Bottom

_!=_ : {A : Set} -> A -> A -> Set
x != y =
  Not (x == y)

record _and_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data _or_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  left  : A -> A or B
  right : B -> A or B

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

data Positive : Nat -> Set where
  positive : {n : Nat} -> Positive (suc n)

record CompleteOrderedRealField (R : Set) : Set1 where
  field
    zeroR oneR : R
    add multiply : R -> R -> R
    negate inverse absoluteValue squareRoot : R -> R
    lessOrEqual : R -> R -> Set
    fromNat : Nat -> R

    one-not-zero :
      oneR != zeroR

    add-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> add x y == add y x
    add-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      add (add x y) z == add x (add y z)
    add-zero :
      (x : R) -> add x zeroR == x
    add-inverse :
      (x : R) -> add x (negate x) == zeroR

    multiply-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> multiply x y == multiply y x
    multiply-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply (multiply x y) z ==
      multiply x (multiply y z)
    multiply-one :
      (x : R) -> multiply x oneR == x
    multiply-zero :
      (x : R) -> multiply x zeroR == zeroR
    distribute :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply x (add y z) ==
      add (multiply x y) (multiply x z)
    inverse-zero :
      inverse zeroR == zeroR
    multiply-inverse :
      (x : R) ->
      x != zeroR ->
      multiply x (inverse x) == oneR

    order-reflexive :
      (x : R) -> lessOrEqual x x
    order-transitive :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y z ->
      lessOrEqual x z
    order-antisymmetric :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y x ->
      x == y
    order-total :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y or lessOrEqual y x
    add-order :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual (add z x) (add z y)
    multiply-nonnegative :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR x ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR y ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR (multiply x y)
    zero-less-than-one :
      lessOrEqual zeroR oneR and zeroR != oneR

    absolute-nonnegative :
      (x : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR (absoluteValue x)
    absolute-of-nonnegative :
      (x : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR x ->
      absoluteValue x == x
    absolute-of-nonpositive :
      (x : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x zeroR ->
      absoluteValue x == negate x

    square-root-nonnegative :
      (x : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR (squareRoot x)
    square-root-square :
      (x : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR x ->
      multiply (squareRoot x) (squareRoot x) == x
    square-root-nonpositive :
      (x : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x zeroR ->
      squareRoot x == zeroR
    square-root-unique :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR y ->
      multiply y y == x ->
      y == squareRoot x

    fromNat-zero :
      fromNat zero == zeroR
    fromNat-successor :
      (n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (suc n) == add (fromNat n) oneR
    fromNat-addition :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m + n) == add (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-multiplication :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m * n) == multiply (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-injective :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat m == fromNat n ->
      m == n

    archimedean :
      (x : R) ->
      Exists Nat (\ n -> lessOrEqual x (fromNat n))
    least-upper-bound :
      (P : R -> Set) ->
      Exists R P ->
      Exists R
        (\ upper ->
          (x : R) ->
          P x ->
          lessOrEqual x upper) ->
      Exists R
        (\ supremum ->
          ((x : R) ->
            P x ->
            lessOrEqual x supremum)
          and
          ((upper : R) ->
            ((x : R) ->
              P x ->
              lessOrEqual x upper) ->
            lessOrEqual supremum upper))

open CompleteOrderedRealField

subtract :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
subtract reals x y =
  add reals x (negate reals y)

StrictLess :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
StrictLess reals x y =
  lessOrEqual reals x y and x != y

scaledSquareRoot :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Nat ->
  Nat ->
  R
scaledSquareRoot reals coefficient radicand =
  multiply reals
    (fromNat reals coefficient)
    (squareRoot reals (fromNat reals radicand))

absoluteDifference :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Nat ->
  Nat ->
  Nat ->
  Nat ->
  R
absoluteDifference reals h k m n =
  absoluteValue reals
    (subtract reals
      (scaledSquareRoot reals h m)
      (scaledSquareRoot reals k n))

putnam-2011-b1 : Set1
putnam-2011-b1 =
  (R : Set) ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) ->
  (h k : Nat) ->
  Positive h ->
  Positive k ->
  (epsilon : R) ->
  StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) epsilon ->
  Exists Nat
    (\ m ->
      Positive m
      and
      Exists Nat
        (\ n ->
          Positive n
          and
          (StrictLess reals
            epsilon
            (absoluteDifference reals h k m n)
          and
          StrictLess reals
            (absoluteDifference reals h k m n)
            (add reals epsilon epsilon))))

(* Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2011_b2:
   the primes occurring in at least seven prime-coefficient quadratic triples
   that admit a rational root; this file contains no proof. *)

From Stdlib Require Import Arith.PeanoNat Lists.List QArith ZArith.Znumtheory.

Open Scope Q_scope.

Record putnam_2011_b2_triple : Type := {
  putnam_2011_b2_p : nat;
  putnam_2011_b2_q : nat;
  putnam_2011_b2_r : nat
}.

Definition putnam_2011_b2_prime (n : nat) : Prop :=
  prime (Z.of_nat n).

Definition putnam_2011_b2_has_rational_root
    (s : putnam_2011_b2_triple) : Prop :=
  exists x : Q,
    inject_Z (Z.of_nat (putnam_2011_b2_p s)) * x ^ 2 +
    inject_Z (Z.of_nat (putnam_2011_b2_q s)) * x +
    inject_Z (Z.of_nat (putnam_2011_b2_r s)) = 0.

Definition putnam_2011_b2_contains
    (s : putnam_2011_b2_triple) (t : nat) : Prop :=
  putnam_2011_b2_p s = t \/
  putnam_2011_b2_q s = t \/
  putnam_2011_b2_r s = t.

Definition putnam_2011_b2_has_at_least
    {A : Type} (P : A -> Prop) (minimum : nat) : Prop :=
  exists witnesses : list A,
    length witnesses = minimum /\
    NoDup witnesses /\
    Forall P witnesses.

Definition putnam_2011_b2_solution (t : nat) : Prop :=
  t = 2%nat \/ t = 5%nat.

Theorem putnam_2011_b2
    (S : putnam_2011_b2_triple -> Prop)
    (t : nat)
    (hS :
      forall s : putnam_2011_b2_triple,
        S s <->
        putnam_2011_b2_prime (putnam_2011_b2_p s) /\
        putnam_2011_b2_prime (putnam_2011_b2_q s) /\
        putnam_2011_b2_prime (putnam_2011_b2_r s) /\
        putnam_2011_b2_has_rational_root s) :
  (putnam_2011_b2_prime t /\
   putnam_2011_b2_has_at_least
     (fun s : putnam_2011_b2_triple =>
        S s /\ putnam_2011_b2_contains s t)
     7%nat) <->
  putnam_2011_b2_solution t.
Admitted.

  the primes occurring in at least seven ordered prime triples whose
  associated quadratic has a rational root are exactly 2 and 5. This file
  contains no proof.

let statement =

     \x:real.
       ?m n:int.
         ~(n = (&0:int)) /\
         x = real_of_int m / real_of_int n in
   let triples =
     {s:num#(num#num) |
        prime (FST s) /\
        prime (FST (SND s)) /\
        prime (SND (SND s)) /\
        ?x:real.
          is_rational x /\

          &(FST (SND s)) * x +
          &(SND (SND s)) = &0} in
   let occurrences =
     \t:num.
       {s:num#(num#num) |
          s IN triples /\
          (FST s = t \/ FST (SND s) = t \/ SND (SND s) = t)} in
   !t:num.

      (?A:(num#(num#num))->bool.

;; Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2011_b2:
;; the primes occurring in at least seven prime-coefficient quadratics with
;; a rational root are exactly 2 and 5. This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

;; For a natural number, testing every candidate divisor below it is exactly
;; the usual definition of primality.
(defun putnam-2011-b2-no-divisor-through-p (number divisor)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix divisor)))
  (if (or (not (natp divisor))
          (<= divisor 1))
      t
    (and
     (not (equal (mod number divisor) 0))
     (putnam-2011-b2-no-divisor-through-p
      number (- divisor 1)))))

(defun putnam-2011-b2-prime-p (number)
  (and
   (natp number)
   (< 1 number)
   (putnam-2011-b2-no-divisor-through-p
    number (- number 1))))

;; This is membership in the source set S. The rational root remains an
;; internal existential witness, as in the ground-truth statements.
(defun-sk putnam-2011-b2-triple-p (p q r)
  (exists (x)
    (and
     (putnam-2011-b2-prime-p p)
     (putnam-2011-b2-prime-p q)
     (putnam-2011-b2-prime-p r)
     (rationalp x)
     (equal
      (+ (* p x x) (* q x) r)
      0))))

(defun putnam-2011-b2-occurrence-p (p q r target)
  (and
   (putnam-2011-b2-triple-p p q r)
   (or
    (equal p target)
    (equal q target)
    (equal r target))))

;; A set has cardinality at least seven exactly when it has seven pairwise
;; distinct members. These witnesses are ordered prime triples, not a finite
;; replacement for the unbounded source set.
(defun-sk putnam-2011-b2-seven-occurrences-p (target)
  (exists
      (p1 q1 r1
       p2 q2 r2
       p3 q3 r3
       p4 q4 r4
       p5 q5 r5
       p6 q6 r6
       p7 q7 r7)
    (and
     (putnam-2011-b2-occurrence-p p1 q1 r1 target)
     (putnam-2011-b2-occurrence-p p2 q2 r2 target)
     (putnam-2011-b2-occurrence-p p3 q3 r3 target)
     (putnam-2011-b2-occurrence-p p4 q4 r4 target)
     (putnam-2011-b2-occurrence-p p5 q5 r5 target)
     (putnam-2011-b2-occurrence-p p6 q6 r6 target)
     (putnam-2011-b2-occurrence-p p7 q7 r7 target)
     (no-duplicatesp-equal
      (list
       (list p1 q1 r1)
       (list p2 q2 r2)
       (list p3 q3 r3)
       (list p4 q4 r4)
       (list p5 q5 r5)
       (list p6 q6 r6)
       (list p7 q7 r7))))))

(defun putnambench-putnam-2011-b2-statement (target)
  (implies
   (natp target)
   (iff
    (and
     (putnam-2011-b2-prime-p target)
     (putnam-2011-b2-seven-occurrences-p target))
    (or
     (equal target 2)
     (equal target 5)))))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

title: putnam_2011_b2
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2011_b2
-- (putnambench__agda__putnam_2011_b2): the primes occurring in at least seven
-- prime triples whose quadratic has a rational root are exactly 2 and 5.
-- This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module Putnam2011B2 where

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Int using (Int; pos; negsuc)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; _*_)

infix 4 _<=N_ _~Q_
infixr 3 _and_
infixr 2 _or_

record _and_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data _or_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  left  : A -> A or B
  right : B -> A or B

record Iff (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor equivalence
  field
    forward  : A -> B
    backward : B -> A

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

data _<=N_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set where
  zero<=N   : {n : Nat} -> zero <=N n
  suc<=sucN : {m n : Nat} -> m <=N n -> suc m <=N suc n

data Fin : Nat -> Set where
  fzero : {n : Nat} -> Fin (suc n)
  fsuc  : {n : Nat} -> Fin n -> Fin (suc n)

record AtLeastCardinality
  {A : Set}
  (member : A -> Set)
  (cardinality : Nat) :
  Set where

  field
    enumerate :
      Fin cardinality ->
      A

    enumerated-member :
      (index : Fin cardinality) ->
      member (enumerate index)

    enumeration-injective :
      (left-index right-index : Fin cardinality) ->
      enumerate left-index == enumerate right-index ->
      left-index == right-index

record Divides (divisor number : Nat) : Set where
  constructor divides
  field
    factor : Nat
    equation : divisor * factor == number

oneN : Nat
oneN =
  suc zero

twoN : Nat
twoN =
  suc oneN

fiveN : Nat
fiveN =
  suc (suc (suc twoN))

sevenN : Nat
sevenN =
  suc (suc fiveN)

Prime : Nat -> Set
Prime number =
  twoN <=N number
  and
  ((divisor : Nat) ->
    Divides divisor number ->
    divisor == oneN or divisor == number)

negative : Nat -> Int
negative zero =
  pos zero
negative (suc n) =
  negsuc n

difference : Nat -> Nat -> Int
difference zero zero =
  pos zero
difference (suc m) zero =
  pos (suc m)
difference zero (suc n) =
  negsuc n
difference (suc m) (suc n) =
  difference m n

addInt : Int -> Int -> Int
addInt (pos m) (pos n) =
  pos (m + n)
addInt (pos m) (negsuc n) =
  difference m (suc n)
addInt (negsuc m) (pos n) =
  difference n (suc m)
addInt (negsuc m) (negsuc n) =
  negsuc (suc (m + n))

multiplyInt : Int -> Int -> Int
multiplyInt (pos m) (pos n) =
  pos (m * n)
multiplyInt (pos m) (negsuc n) =
  negative (m * suc n)
multiplyInt (negsuc m) (pos n) =
  negative (suc m * n)
multiplyInt (negsuc m) (negsuc n) =
  pos (suc m * suc n)

scaleInt : Int -> Nat -> Int
scaleInt integer natural =
  multiplyInt integer (pos natural)

predecessor : Nat -> Nat
predecessor zero =
  zero
predecessor (suc n) =
  n

record Rational : Set where
  constructor fraction
  field
    numerator             : Int
    denominator-minus-one : Nat

open Rational

denominator : Rational -> Nat
denominator rational =
  suc (denominator-minus-one rational)

_~Q_ : Rational -> Rational -> Set
left-rational ~Q right-rational =
  scaleInt
    (numerator left-rational)
    (denominator right-rational)
  ==
  scaleInt
    (numerator right-rational)
    (denominator left-rational)

zeroQ : Rational
zeroQ =
  fraction (pos zero) zero

naturalQ : Nat -> Rational
naturalQ natural =
  fraction (pos natural) zero

addQ : Rational -> Rational -> Rational
addQ left-rational right-rational =
  fraction
    (addInt
      (scaleInt
        (numerator left-rational)
        (denominator right-rational))
      (scaleInt
        (numerator right-rational)
        (denominator left-rational)))
    (predecessor
      (denominator left-rational * denominator right-rational))

multiplyQ : Rational -> Rational -> Rational
multiplyQ left-rational right-rational =
  fraction
    (multiplyInt
      (numerator left-rational)
      (numerator right-rational))
    (predecessor
      (denominator left-rational * denominator right-rational))

record Triple : Set where
  constructor triple
  field
    first-coordinate  : Nat
    second-coordinate : Nat
    third-coordinate  : Nat

open Triple

HasRationalRoot : Triple -> Set
HasRationalRoot coefficients =
  Exists Rational
    (\ x ->
      addQ
        (addQ
          (multiplyQ
            (naturalQ (first-coordinate coefficients))
            (multiplyQ x x))
          (multiplyQ
            (naturalQ (second-coordinate coefficients))
            x))
        (naturalQ (third-coordinate coefficients))
      ~Q zeroQ)

QualifiedTriple : Triple -> Set
QualifiedTriple coefficients =
  Prime (first-coordinate coefficients)
  and
  Prime (second-coordinate coefficients)
  and
  Prime (third-coordinate coefficients)
  and
  HasRationalRoot coefficients

Contains : Nat -> Triple -> Set
Contains number coefficients =
  first-coordinate coefficients == number
  or
  second-coordinate coefficients == number
  or
  third-coordinate coefficients == number

SameSet :
  (Triple -> Set) ->
  (Triple -> Set) ->
  Set
SameSet left-set right-set =
  (coefficients : Triple) ->
  Iff
    (left-set coefficients)
    (right-set coefficients)

AppearsAtLeastSevenTimes :
  (Triple -> Set) ->
  Nat ->
  Set
AppearsAtLeastSevenTimes S number =
  AtLeastCardinality
    (\ coefficients ->
      S coefficients
      and
      Contains number coefficients)
    sevenN

putnam-2011-b2-solution : Nat -> Set
putnam-2011-b2-solution number =
  number == twoN or number == fiveN

putnam-2011-b2 : Set1
putnam-2011-b2 =
  (S : Triple -> Set) ->
  (t : Nat) ->
  SameSet S QualifiedTriple ->
  Iff
    (Prime t and AppearsAtLeastSevenTimes S t)
    (putnam-2011-b2-solution t)

(*
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2011_b2:
  the primes occurring in at least seven prime-coefficient quadratic triples
  with a rational root are exactly 2 and 5. This file contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open arithmeticTheory pairTheory pred_setTheory primeTheory ratTheory;

val putnam_2011_b2 =
  ``!S : (num # (num # num)) set. !t : num.
      S =
        {s : num # (num # num) |
           prime (FST s) /\
           prime (FST (SND s)) /\
           prime (SND (SND s)) /\
           ?x : rat.
             rat_of_num (FST s) * x * x +
               rat_of_num (FST (SND s)) * x +
               rat_of_num (SND (SND s)) =
             0q}
      ==>
      (prime t /\
       (?T : (num # (num # num)) set.
          FINITE T /\
          T SUBSET
            {s : num # (num # num) |
               s IN S /\
               (FST s = t \/
                FST (SND s) = t \/
                SND (SND s) = t)} /\
          7 <= CARD T)
       <=>
       t = 2 \/ t = 5)``;

$(

  putnam_2011_b2: the primes occurring in at least seven ordered prime
  triples whose associated quadratic has a rational root are exactly
  2 and 5. This file contains no proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  The carrier 0 ..^ 3 represents Fin 3, so a member of
  Prime ^m ( 0 ..^ 3 ) is exactly an ordered triple of natural primes.
  The restricted class inlines the source definition of S: its first
  condition retains the internally existential rational root, and its
  second condition says that t occurs in one of the three coordinates.

  SetMM's # assigns +oo to an infinite set, so comparison with 7 agrees
  with Lean's extended-cardinality comparison and with ordinary finite
  cardinality here. The annotated solution set is inlined as { 2 , 5 }.
  The final declaration is the single unproved $a corpus statement; this
  database contains no $p proof declaration.
$)

${
  $d i s t x $.

  putnambench-putnam-2011-b2 $a |-
    A. t e. NN0
      (
        (
          t e. Prime
          /\
          7
          <_
          (
            #
            `
            {
              s e. ( Prime ^m ( 0 ..^ 3 ) )
              |
              (
                E. x e. QQ
                  (
                    (
                      (
                        (
                          ( s ` 0 )
                          x.
                          ( x ^ 2 )
                        )
                        +
                        (
                          ( s ` 1 )
                          x.
                          x
                        )
                      )
                      +
                      ( s ` 2 )
                    )
                    =
                    0
                  )
                /\
                E. i e. ( 0 ..^ 3 )
                  ( s ` i ) = t
              )
            }
          )
        )
        <->
        t e. { 2 , 5 }
      )
  $.
$}

title: putnam_2011_b2
content:
% Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2011_b2:
% the primes occurring in at least seven ordered prime triples (p,q,r) for
% which p*x^2 + q*x + r = 0 has a rational solution are exactly 2 and 5.
% This file contains no proof.

putnam_2011_b2: THEORY
BEGIN
  natural_triple: TYPE =
    [# first: nat,
       second: nat,
       third: nat #]

  nat_divides(divisor: posnat, value: nat): bool =
    EXISTS (quotient: nat):
      value = divisor * quotient

  prime_nat(value: nat): bool =
    value >= 2
      AND FORALL (divisor: posnat):
        nat_divides(divisor, value)
          IMPLIES divisor = 1 OR divisor = value

  qualifying_triple(s: natural_triple): bool =
    prime_nat(first(s))
      AND prime_nat(second(s))
      AND prime_nat(third(s))
      AND EXISTS (x: rat):
        (first(s) :: rat) * x ^ 2
          + (second(s) :: rat) * x
          + (third(s) :: rat)
          = 0

  contains_value(s: natural_triple, value: nat): bool =
    first(s) = value
      OR second(s) = value
      OR third(s) = value

  appears_at_least_seven(value: nat): bool =
    EXISTS (witnesses: [below(7) -> natural_triple]):
      (FORALL (index: below(7)):
        qualifying_triple(witnesses(index))
          AND contains_value(witnesses(index), value))
        AND
          (FORALL (left, right: below(7)):
            witnesses(left) = witnesses(right)
              IMPLIES left = right)

  putnam_2011_b2: bool =
    FORALL (value: nat):
      (prime_nat(value) AND appears_at_least_seven(value))
        IFF (value = 2 OR value = 5)
END putnam_2011_b2

;; Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2011_b3:
;; nonvanishing and continuity of g at zero, together with differentiability
;; there of f*g and f/g, imply differentiability of f. This file contains no
;; proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))

;; These conservative generic symbols present arbitrary scalar-valued
;; functions f and g over an ordered field. The theorem is local and its proof
;; uses only field algebra and epsilon-delta definitions, so no completeness
;; assumption or APPLY$ function-object universe is needed.

(defstub putnam-2011-b3-carrier (x) t)
(defstub putnam-2011-b3-add (x y) t)
(defstub putnam-2011-b3-multiply (x y) t)
(defstub putnam-2011-b3-negate (x) t)
(defstub putnam-2011-b3-inverse (x) t)
(defstub putnam-2011-b3-less (x y) t)
(defstub putnam-2011-b3-f (x) t)
(defstub putnam-2011-b3-g (x) t)

(defun putnam-2011-b3-member-p (x)
  (if (putnam-2011-b3-carrier x) t nil))

(defun putnam-2011-b3-subtract (x y)
  (putnam-2011-b3-add
   x
   (putnam-2011-b3-negate y)))

(defun putnam-2011-b3-divide (x y)
  (putnam-2011-b3-multiply
   x
   (putnam-2011-b3-inverse y)))

(defun putnam-2011-b3-less-p (x y)
  (if (putnam-2011-b3-less x y) t nil))

(defun putnam-2011-b3-less-equal-p (x y)
  (not (putnam-2011-b3-less-p y x)))

(defun putnam-2011-b3-absolute-value (zero x)
  (if (putnam-2011-b3-less-p x zero)
      (putnam-2011-b3-negate x)
    x))

(defun putnam-2011-b3-positive-p (zero x)
  (and
   (putnam-2011-b3-member-p x)
   (putnam-2011-b3-less-p zero x)))

(defun-sk putnam-2011-b3-field-laws-p (zero one)
  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (putnam-2011-b3-member-p x)
      (putnam-2011-b3-member-p y)
      (putnam-2011-b3-member-p z))
     (and
      (putnam-2011-b3-member-p
       (putnam-2011-b3-add x y))
      (putnam-2011-b3-member-p
       (putnam-2011-b3-multiply x y))
      (putnam-2011-b3-member-p
       (putnam-2011-b3-negate x))
      (putnam-2011-b3-member-p
       (putnam-2011-b3-inverse x))
      (equal
       (putnam-2011-b3-add
        (putnam-2011-b3-add x y)
        z)
       (putnam-2011-b3-add
        x
        (putnam-2011-b3-add y z)))
      (equal
       (putnam-2011-b3-add x y)
       (putnam-2011-b3-add y x))
      (equal
       (putnam-2011-b3-add x zero)
       x)
      (equal
       (putnam-2011-b3-add
        x
        (putnam-2011-b3-negate x))
       zero)
      (equal
       (putnam-2011-b3-multiply
        (putnam-2011-b3-multiply x y)
        z)
       (putnam-2011-b3-multiply
        x
        (putnam-2011-b3-multiply y z)))
      (equal
       (putnam-2011-b3-multiply x y)
       (putnam-2011-b3-multiply y x))
      (equal
       (putnam-2011-b3-multiply x one)
       x)
      (implies
       (equal x zero)
       (equal
        (putnam-2011-b3-inverse x)
        zero))
      (implies
       (not (equal x zero))
       (equal
        (putnam-2011-b3-multiply
         x
         (putnam-2011-b3-inverse x))
        one))
      (equal
       (putnam-2011-b3-multiply
        x
        (putnam-2011-b3-add y z))
       (putnam-2011-b3-add
        (putnam-2011-b3-multiply x y)
        (putnam-2011-b3-multiply x z)))))))

(defun-sk putnam-2011-b3-order-laws-p (zero)
  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (putnam-2011-b3-member-p x)
      (putnam-2011-b3-member-p y)
      (putnam-2011-b3-member-p z))
     (and
      (not (putnam-2011-b3-less-p x x))
      (or
       (equal x y)
       (putnam-2011-b3-less-p x y)
       (putnam-2011-b3-less-p y x))
      (implies
       (and
        (putnam-2011-b3-less-p x y)
        (putnam-2011-b3-less-p y z))
       (putnam-2011-b3-less-p x z))
      (implies
       (putnam-2011-b3-less-p x y)
       (putnam-2011-b3-less-p
        (putnam-2011-b3-add x z)
        (putnam-2011-b3-add y z)))
      (implies
       (and
        (putnam-2011-b3-less-p zero x)
        (putnam-2011-b3-less-p zero y))
       (putnam-2011-b3-less-p
        zero
        (putnam-2011-b3-multiply x y)))))))

(defun putnam-2011-b3-ordered-field-p (zero one)
  (and
   (putnam-2011-b3-member-p zero)
   (putnam-2011-b3-member-p one)
   (not (equal zero one))
   (putnam-2011-b3-field-laws-p zero one)
   (putnam-2011-b3-order-laws-p zero)
   (putnam-2011-b3-less-p zero one)))

(defun-sk putnam-2011-b3-functions-real-valued-p ()
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (putnam-2011-b3-member-p x)
     (and
      (putnam-2011-b3-member-p
       (putnam-2011-b3-f x))
      (putnam-2011-b3-member-p
       (putnam-2011-b3-g x))))))

;; The three tags below select only the source function f and its two
;; definitionally specified combinations with g; they do not encode f or g.

(defun putnam-2011-b3-function-value (kind x)
  (cond
   ((equal kind :f)
    (putnam-2011-b3-f x))
   ((equal kind :product)
    (putnam-2011-b3-multiply
     (putnam-2011-b3-f x)
     (putnam-2011-b3-g x)))
   ((equal kind :quotient)
    (putnam-2011-b3-divide
     (putnam-2011-b3-f x)
     (putnam-2011-b3-g x)))
   (t x)))

;; Ordinary epsilon-delta continuity of g at the field zero.

(defun-sk putnam-2011-b3-continuity-neighborhood-p
    (zero epsilon delta)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
