data Fin : Nat -> Set where
  fzero : {n : Nat} -> Fin (suc n)
  fsuc  : {n : Nat} -> Fin n -> Fin (suc n)

record CompleteOrderedRealField (R : Set) : Set1 where
  field
    zeroR oneR : R
    add multiply : R -> R -> R
    negate inverse : R -> R
    lessOrEqual : R -> R -> Set
    fromNat : Nat -> R

    one-not-zero :
      oneR != zeroR

    add-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> add x y == add y x
    add-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      add (add x y) z == add x (add y z)
    add-zero :
      (x : R) -> add x zeroR == x
    add-inverse :
      (x : R) -> add x (negate x) == zeroR

    multiply-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> multiply x y == multiply y x
    multiply-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply (multiply x y) z ==
      multiply x (multiply y z)
    multiply-one :
      (x : R) -> multiply x oneR == x
    multiply-zero :
      (x : R) -> multiply x zeroR == zeroR
    distribute :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply x (add y z) ==
      add (multiply x y) (multiply x z)
    inverse-zero :
      inverse zeroR == zeroR
    multiply-inverse :
      (x : R) ->
      x != zeroR ->
      multiply x (inverse x) == oneR

    order-reflexive :
      (x : R) -> lessOrEqual x x
    order-transitive :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y z ->
      lessOrEqual x z
    order-antisymmetric :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y x ->
      x == y
    order-total :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y or lessOrEqual y x
    add-order :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual (add z x) (add z y)
    multiply-nonnegative :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR x ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR y ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR (multiply x y)
    zero-less-than-one :
      lessOrEqual zeroR oneR and zeroR != oneR

    fromNat-zero :
      fromNat zero == zeroR
    fromNat-successor :
      (n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (suc n) == add (fromNat n) oneR
    fromNat-addition :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m + n) == add (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-multiplication :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m * n) == multiply (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-injective :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat m == fromNat n ->
      m == n

    archimedean :
      (x : R) ->
      Exists Nat
        (\ n ->
          lessOrEqual x (fromNat n))
    least-upper-bound :
      (P : R -> Set) ->
      Exists R P ->
      Exists R
        (\ upper ->
          (x : R) ->
          P x ->
          lessOrEqual x upper) ->
      Exists R
        (\ supremum ->
          ((x : R) ->
            P x ->
            lessOrEqual x supremum)
          and
          ((upper : R) ->
            ((x : R) ->
              P x ->
              lessOrEqual x upper) ->
            lessOrEqual supremum upper))

open CompleteOrderedRealField

StrictLess :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
StrictLess reals x y =
  lessOrEqual reals x y and x != y

square :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R
square reals x =
  multiply reals x x

twelveN : Nat
twelveN =
  suc
    (suc
      (suc
        (suc
          (suc
            (suc
              (suc
                (suc
                  (suc
                    (suc
                      (suc
                        (suc zero)))))))))))

module Putnam2012A1Statement
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) where

  one twelve : R
  one =
    oneR reals
  twelve =
    fromNat reals twelveN

  InOpenInterval : R -> Set
  InOpenInterval x =
    StrictLess reals one x
    and
    StrictLess reals x twelve

  AcuteMaximalSide :
    R ->
    R ->
    R ->
    Set
  AcuteMaximalSide x y z =
    lessOrEqual reals x z
    and
    lessOrEqual reals y z
    and
    StrictLess reals
      (square reals z)
      (add reals
        (square reals x)
        (square reals y))

  proposition : Set
  proposition =
    (d : Fin twelveN -> R) ->
    ((i : Fin twelveN) ->
      InOpenInterval (d i)) ->
    Exists (Fin twelveN)
      (\ i ->
        Exists (Fin twelveN)
          (\ j ->
            Exists (Fin twelveN)
              (\ k ->
                i != j
                and
                i != k
                and
                j != k
                and
                AcuteMaximalSide
                  (d i)
                  (d j)
                  (d k))))

putnam-2012-a1 : Set1
putnam-2012-a1 =
  (R : Set) ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) ->
  Putnam2012A1Statement.proposition reals

;; Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2012_a2:
;; cancellation in a commutative semigroup whose left translations are
;; surjective. This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))

;; CARRIER is an ACL2 function object. OPERATION-PACKAGE is the pair consisting
;; of the source binary operation and a right-solver function. Its universal
;; law says that for every carrier x and y, the solver returns a carrier z with
;; OP(x,z)=y. Forgetting the solver gives the source condition
;; forall x y, exists z; conversely, classical choice equips every source
;; operation satisfying that condition with such a solver. Thus this bundled
;; representation is bidirectionally equivalent and does not expose the
;; existential witness as a separate statement parameter. FN-EQUAL against a
;; constant-T function supplies the unbounded universal quantifiers.

(defun putnam-2012-a2-quoted (object)
  (list 'quote object))

(defun putnam-2012-a2-apply1-term (function argument)
  (list
   'apply$
   (putnam-2012-a2-quoted function)
   (list 'cons argument nil)))

(defun putnam-2012-a2-apply2-term (function left right)
  (list
   'apply$
   (putnam-2012-a2-quoted function)
   (list 'cons left (list 'cons right nil))))

(defun putnam-2012-a2-carrier-term (carrier element)
  (putnam-2012-a2-apply1-term carrier element))

(defun putnam-2012-a2-operation-term (operation left right)
  (putnam-2012-a2-apply2-term operation left right))

(defun putnam-2012-a2-and-term (terms)
  (if (endp terms)
      (putnam-2012-a2-quoted t)
    (list
     'if
     (car terms)
     (putnam-2012-a2-and-term (cdr terms))
     (putnam-2012-a2-quoted nil))))

(defun putnam-2012-a2-implies-term (antecedent consequent)
  (list
   'if
   antecedent
   consequent
   (putnam-2012-a2-quoted t)))

(defun putnam-2012-a2-true-function (formals)
  (list
   'lambda
   formals
   (putnam-2012-a2-quoted t)))

(defun putnam-2012-a2-binary-laws-function (carrier operation)
  (let* ((x 'x)
         (y 'y)
         (op-xy
          (putnam-2012-a2-operation-term operation x y))
         (domain
          (putnam-2012-a2-and-term
           (list
            (putnam-2012-a2-carrier-term carrier x)
            (putnam-2012-a2-carrier-term carrier y))))
         (laws
          (putnam-2012-a2-and-term
           (list
            (putnam-2012-a2-carrier-term carrier op-xy)
            (list
             'equal
             op-xy
             (putnam-2012-a2-operation-term operation y x))))))
    (list
     'lambda
     '(x y)
     (putnam-2012-a2-implies-term domain laws))))

(defun putnam-2012-a2-associative-law-function (carrier operation)
  (let* ((x 'x)
         (y 'y)
         (z 'z)
         (domain
          (putnam-2012-a2-and-term
           (list
            (putnam-2012-a2-carrier-term carrier x)
            (putnam-2012-a2-carrier-term carrier y)
            (putnam-2012-a2-carrier-term carrier z))))
         (law
          (list
           'equal
           (putnam-2012-a2-operation-term
            operation
            x
            (putnam-2012-a2-operation-term operation y z))
           (putnam-2012-a2-operation-term
            operation
            (putnam-2012-a2-operation-term operation x y)
            z))))
    (list
     'lambda
     '(x y z)
     (putnam-2012-a2-implies-term domain law))))

(defun putnam-2012-a2-surjectivity-function
    (carrier operation solver)
  (let* ((x 'x)
         (y 'y)
         (z
          (putnam-2012-a2-operation-term solver x y))
         (domain
          (putnam-2012-a2-and-term
           (list
            (putnam-2012-a2-carrier-term carrier x)
            (putnam-2012-a2-carrier-term carrier y))))
         (law
          (putnam-2012-a2-and-term
           (list
            (putnam-2012-a2-carrier-term carrier z)
            (list
             'equal
             (putnam-2012-a2-operation-term operation x z)
             y)))))
    (list
     'lambda
     '(x y)
     (putnam-2012-a2-implies-term domain law))))

(defun putnam-2012-a2-op (operation x y)
  (apply$ operation (list x y)))

(defun putnambench-putnam-2012-a2-statement
    (carrier operation-package a b c)
  (let ((operation (car operation-package))
        (solver (cadr operation-package)))
    (implies
     (and
      (true-listp operation-package)
      (equal (len operation-package) 2)
      (tamep-functionp carrier)
      (tamep-functionp operation)
      (tamep-functionp solver)
      (apply$ carrier (list a))
      (apply$ carrier (list b))
      (apply$ carrier (list c))
      (fn-equal
       (putnam-2012-a2-binary-laws-function carrier operation)
       (putnam-2012-a2-true-function '(x y)))
      (fn-equal
       (putnam-2012-a2-associative-law-function carrier operation)
       (putnam-2012-a2-true-function '(x y z)))
      (fn-equal
       (putnam-2012-a2-surjectivity-function
        carrier operation solver)
       (putnam-2012-a2-true-function '(x y)))
      (equal
       (putnam-2012-a2-op operation a c)
       (putnam-2012-a2-op operation b c)))
     (equal a b))))

;; The generated surjectivity lambda uses only tame ACL2 primitives and APPLY$
;; on quoted tame function objects; in particular it contains no unwarranted
;; custom function call.
(value-triple
 (list
  :itpeval-tame-surjectivity
  (tamep-functionp
   (putnam-2012-a2-surjectivity-function
    '(lambda (x) (quote t))
    '(lambda (x y) x)
    '(lambda (x y) y)))))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)

  (A : Set a)

putnam-2012-a2 :

  (S : Set ℓ) ->

% Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2012_a2:
% a commutative associative binary operation with universal right-solvability
% is right-cancellative. This file contains no proof.

putnam_2012_a2[S: TYPE]: THEORY
BEGIN
  operation: TYPE = [S, S -> S]

  associative(op: operation): bool =
    FORALL (x, y, z: S):
      op(op(x, y), z) = op(x, op(y, z))

  commutative(op: operation): bool =
    FORALL (x, y: S):
      op(x, y) = op(y, x)

  right_solvable(op: operation): bool =
    FORALL (x, y: S):
      EXISTS (z: S):
        op(x, z) = y

  putnam_2012_a2: bool =
    FORALL (op: operation), (a, b, c: S):
      (associative(op)
        AND commutative(op)
        AND right_solvable(op)
        AND op(a, c) = op(b, c))
      IMPLIES a = b
END putnam_2012_a2

import Mathlib

open Matrix Function

-- Note: uses (ℝ → ℝ) instead of (Set.Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1 → ℝ)
noncomputable abbrev putnam_2012_a3_solution : ℝ → ℝ :=
  fun x ↦ Real.sqrt (1 - x ^ 2)
/--
Let $f: [-1, 1] \to \mathbb{R}$ be a continuous function such that
\begin{itemize}
\item[(i)]
$f(x) = \frac{2-x^2}{2} f \left( \frac{x^2}{2-x^2} \right)$ for every $x$ in $[-1, 1]$,
\item[(ii)]
$f(0) = 1$, and
\item[(iii)]
$\lim_{x \to 1^-} \frac{f(x)}{\sqrt{1-x}}$ exists and is finite.
\end{itemize}
Prove that $f$ is unique, and express $f(x)$ in closed form.
-/
theorem putnam_2012_a3
(S : Set ℝ)
(hS : S = Set.Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1)
(fsat : (ℝ → ℝ) → Prop)
(hfsat : fsat = fun f : ℝ → ℝ => ContinuousOn f S ∧
(∀ x ∈ S, f x = ((2 - x^2)/2)*f (x^2/(2 - x^2))) ∧ f 0 = 1 ∧
(∃ y : ℝ, Filter.Tendsto (fun x : ℝ => f x / Real.sqrt (1 - x))
  (nhdsWithin 1 (Set.Iio 1)) (nhds y)))
: fsat putnam_2012_a3_solution ∧ ∀ f : ℝ → ℝ, fsat f → ∀ x ∈ S, f x = putnam_2012_a3_solution x :=
sorry

(*
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2012_a3:
  uniqueness and closed form of a continuous real function on [-1,1]
  satisfying a functional equation, a normalization, and a finite left limit.
  This file contains no proof.
*)

let statement =
  `let interval =
     \x:real. -- &1 <= x /\ x <= &1 in
   let continuous_on_interval =
     \(f:real->real).
       !x:real.
         interval x
         ==> !e:real.
               &0 < e
               ==> ?d:real.
                     &0 < d /\
                     !y:real.
                       interval y /\ abs (y - x) < d
                       ==> abs (f y - f x) < e in
   let has_finite_left_limit =
     \(g:real->real).
       ?l:real.
         !e:real.
           &0 < e
           ==> ?d:real.
                 &0 < d /\
                 !x:real.
                   x < &1 /\ &1 - x < d
                   ==> abs (g x - l) < e in
   let satisfies =
     \(f:real->real).
       continuous_on_interval f /\
       (!x:real.
          interval x
          ==> f x =
              ((&2 - x pow 2) / &2) *
              f (x pow 2 / (&2 - x pow 2))) /\
       f (&0) = &1 /\
       has_finite_left_limit
         (\x:real. f x / sqrt (&1 - x)) in
   let solution =
     \x:real. sqrt (&1 - x pow 2) in
   satisfies solution /\
   !f:real->real.
     satisfies f
     ==> !x:real. interval x ==> f x = solution x`;;

title: putnam_2012_a3
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2012_a3:
;; the unique continuous real function on [-1,1] satisfying the given
;; functional equation, normalization, and finite left-limit condition is
;; sqrt(1-x^2). This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))

;; F-APPROX(x,epsilon) is a rational regular Cauchy name for the value of an
;; arbitrary real function at rational x in [-1,1]. DEFSTUB supplies the
;; source's universal function parameter conservatively, without restricting
;; it to a finite table or an executable APPLY$ object.
;;
;; Continuous functions on the compact interval are represented by uniformly
;; continuous data on its dense rational subset. Every source function has
;; such data, and the data determine a unique continuous extension. Equality
;; and the functional equation are exact Cauchy-name equalities.
;;
;; For the left limit, x=1-t^2 gives sqrt(1-x)=t for t>0. Completeness of the
;; reals makes the Cauchy criterion for f(1-t^2)/t as t approaches 0 from the
;; right equivalent to existence of the source's finite left limit at x=1.
;; All limit and continuity cutoffs remain internally existential.

(defstub putnam-2012-a3-f-approx (x epsilon) t)

(defun putnam-2012-a3-positive-rational-p (x)
  (and
   (rationalp x)
   (< 0 x)))

(defun putnam-2012-a3-rational-in-unit-interval-p (x)
  (and
   (rationalp x)
   (<= -1 x)
   (<= x 1)))

(defun putnam-2012-a3-isqrt-search
    (radicand candidate)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix candidate)))
  (if (or (not (natp radicand))
          (not (natp candidate)))
      0
    (if (<= (* candidate candidate) radicand)
        candidate
      (putnam-2012-a3-isqrt-search
       radicand (- candidate 1)))))

(defun putnam-2012-a3-isqrt (radicand)
  (if (natp radicand)
      (putnam-2012-a3-isqrt-search
       radicand radicand)
    0))

(defun putnam-2012-a3-sqrt-lower (radicand scale)
  (if (and (rationalp radicand)
           (<= 0 radicand)
           (posp scale))
      (/ (putnam-2012-a3-isqrt
          (floor (* radicand scale scale) 1))
         scale)
    0))

;; For positive rational EPSILON, this rational lower approximation is within
;; EPSILON of the principal square root.

(defun putnam-2012-a3-real-sqrt-approx
    (radicand epsilon)
  (if (and (rationalp radicand)
           (<= 0 radicand)
           (putnam-2012-a3-positive-rational-p epsilon))
      (putnam-2012-a3-sqrt-lower
       radicand
       (+ 1 (denominator epsilon)))
    0))

(defun putnam-2012-a3-solution-approx (x epsilon)
  (if (putnam-2012-a3-rational-in-unit-interval-p x)
      (putnam-2012-a3-real-sqrt-approx
       (- 1 (* x x))
       epsilon)
    0))

;; KIND=:SOLUTION selects the displayed closed form. Any other KIND selects
;; the conservative arbitrary-function symbol.

(defun putnam-2012-a3-value (kind x epsilon)
  (if (equal kind :solution)
      (putnam-2012-a3-solution-approx x epsilon)
    (putnam-2012-a3-f-approx x epsilon)))

(defun-sk putnam-2012-a3-regular-cauchy-data-p (kind)
  (forall (x epsilon eta)
    (implies
     (and
      (putnam-2012-a3-rational-in-unit-interval-p x)
      (putnam-2012-a3-positive-rational-p epsilon)
      (putnam-2012-a3-positive-rational-p eta))
     (let ((left
            (putnam-2012-a3-value kind x epsilon))
           (right
            (putnam-2012-a3-value kind x eta)))
       (and
        (rationalp left)
        (rationalp right)
        (<= (abs (- left right))
            (+ epsilon eta)))))))

;; This is exact distance <= MARGIN between represented real values.

(defun-sk putnam-2012-a3-value-distance-at-most-p
    (kind x y margin)
  (forall (epsilon eta)
    (implies
     (and
      (putnam-2012-a3-positive-rational-p epsilon)
      (putnam-2012-a3-positive-rational-p eta))
     (<=
      (abs
       (-
        (putnam-2012-a3-value kind x epsilon)
        (putnam-2012-a3-value kind y eta)))
      (+ margin epsilon eta)))))

;; Exact distance < EPSILON is expressed by a rational upper margin below it.

(defun-sk putnam-2012-a3-value-distance-below-p
    (kind x y epsilon)
  (exists (margin)
    (and
     (rationalp margin)
     (<= 0 margin)
     (< margin epsilon)
     (putnam-2012-a3-value-distance-at-most-p
      kind x y margin))))

(defun-sk putnam-2012-a3-uniform-radius-p
    (kind epsilon delta)
  (forall (x y)
    (implies
     (and
      (putnam-2012-a3-rational-in-unit-interval-p x)
      (putnam-2012-a3-rational-in-unit-interval-p y)
      (< (abs (- x y)) delta))
     (putnam-2012-a3-value-distance-below-p
      kind x y epsilon))))

(defun-sk putnam-2012-a3-uniform-radius-exists-p
    (kind epsilon)
  (exists (delta)
    (and
     (putnam-2012-a3-positive-rational-p delta)
     (putnam-2012-a3-uniform-radius-p
      kind epsilon delta))))

(defun-sk putnam-2012-a3-continuous-on-interval-p (kind)
  (forall (epsilon)
    (implies
     (putnam-2012-a3-positive-rational-p epsilon)
     (putnam-2012-a3-uniform-radius-exists-p
      kind epsilon))))

;; Equality in the functional equation is imposed at every rational point.
;; The factor lies in [1/2,1], and its absolute value scales the right-hand
;; Cauchy-name error exactly.

(defun-sk putnam-2012-a3-functional-equation-p (kind)
  (forall (x epsilon eta)
    (implies
     (and
      (putnam-2012-a3-rational-in-unit-interval-p x)
      (putnam-2012-a3-positive-rational-p epsilon)
      (putnam-2012-a3-positive-rational-p eta))
     (let* ((x-square (* x x))
            (two-minus-x-square (- 2 x-square))
            (factor (/ two-minus-x-square 2))
            (transformed-x
             (/ x-square two-minus-x-square))
            (left
             (putnam-2012-a3-value
              kind x epsilon))
            (right
             (* factor
                (putnam-2012-a3-value
                 kind transformed-x eta))))
       (<=
        (abs (- left right))
        (+ epsilon (* (abs factor) eta)))))))

(defun-sk putnam-2012-a3-normalization-p (kind)
  (forall (epsilon)
    (implies
     (putnam-2012-a3-positive-rational-p epsilon)
     (<=
      (abs
       (-
        (putnam-2012-a3-value kind 0 epsilon)
        1))
      epsilon))))

;; For rational t>0, VALUE(kind,1-t^2,epsilon*t)/t approximates
;; f(1-t^2)/t within EPSILON.

(defun-sk putnam-2012-a3-limit-pair-distance-at-most-p
    (kind left-t right-t margin)
  (forall (epsilon eta)
    (implies
     (and
      (putnam-2012-a3-positive-rational-p epsilon)
      (putnam-2012-a3-positive-rational-p eta))
     (let* ((left-x (- 1 (* left-t left-t)))
            (right-x (- 1 (* right-t right-t)))
            (left
             (/
              (putnam-2012-a3-value
               kind left-x (* epsilon left-t))
              left-t))
            (right
             (/
              (putnam-2012-a3-value
               kind right-x (* eta right-t))
              right-t)))
       (<=
        (abs (- left right))
        (+ margin epsilon eta))))))

(defun-sk putnam-2012-a3-limit-pair-distance-below-p
    (kind left-t right-t epsilon)
  (exists (margin)
    (and
     (rationalp margin)
     (<= 0 margin)
     (< margin epsilon)
     (putnam-2012-a3-limit-pair-distance-at-most-p
      kind left-t right-t margin))))

(defun-sk putnam-2012-a3-limit-cauchy-tail-p
    (kind epsilon delta)
  (forall (left-t right-t)
    (implies
     (and
      (putnam-2012-a3-positive-rational-p left-t)
      (putnam-2012-a3-positive-rational-p right-t)
      (< left-t 1)
      (< right-t 1)
      (< left-t delta)
      (< right-t delta))
     (putnam-2012-a3-limit-pair-distance-below-p
      kind left-t right-t epsilon))))

(defun-sk putnam-2012-a3-limit-cauchy-cutoff-exists-p
    (kind epsilon)
  (exists (delta)
    (and
     (putnam-2012-a3-positive-rational-p delta)
     (putnam-2012-a3-limit-cauchy-tail-p
      kind epsilon delta))))

(defun-sk putnam-2012-a3-finite-left-limit-p (kind)
  (forall (epsilon)
    (implies
     (putnam-2012-a3-positive-rational-p epsilon)
     (putnam-2012-a3-limit-cauchy-cutoff-exists-p
      kind epsilon))))

(defun putnam-2012-a3-satisfies-p (kind)
  (and
   (putnam-2012-a3-regular-cauchy-data-p kind)
   (putnam-2012-a3-continuous-on-interval-p kind)
   (putnam-2012-a3-functional-equation-p kind)
   (putnam-2012-a3-normalization-p kind)
   (putnam-2012-a3-finite-left-limit-p kind)))

;; Exact equality on rational points, together with continuity, is equality on
;; every real point of the interval.

(defun-sk putnam-2012-a3-equal-to-solution-p ()
  (forall (x epsilon eta)
    (implies
     (and
      (putnam-2012-a3-rational-in-unit-interval-p x)
      (putnam-2012-a3-positive-rational-p epsilon)
      (putnam-2012-a3-positive-rational-p eta))
     (<=
      (abs
       (-
        (putnam-2012-a3-f-approx x epsilon)
        (putnam-2012-a3-solution-approx x eta)))
      (+ epsilon eta)))))

(defun putnambench-putnam-2012-a3-statement ()
  (and
   (putnam-2012-a3-satisfies-p :solution)
   (implies
    (putnam-2012-a3-satisfies-p :arbitrary)
    (putnam-2012-a3-equal-to-solution-p))))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

title: putnam_2012_a3
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2012_a3:
-- the continuous functions on [-1,1] satisfying the given functional equation,
-- normalization at zero, and finite left limit at one have the unique closed
-- form sqrt(1 - x^2). This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module Putnam2012A3 where

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; _*_)

infix 4 _!=_
infixr 3 _and_
infixr 2 _or_

data Bottom : Set where

Not : Set -> Set
Not A =
  A -> Bottom

_!=_ : {A : Set} -> A -> A -> Set
x != y =
  Not (x == y)

record _and_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data _or_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  left  : A -> A or B
  right : B -> A or B

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

record CompleteOrderedRealField (R : Set) : Set1 where
  field
    zeroR oneR : R
    add multiply : R -> R -> R
    negate inverse squareRoot : R -> R
    lessOrEqual : R -> R -> Set
    fromNat : Nat -> R

    one-not-zero :
      oneR != zeroR

    add-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> add x y == add y x
    add-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      add (add x y) z == add x (add y z)
    add-zero :
      (x : R) -> add x zeroR == x
    add-inverse :
      (x : R) -> add x (negate x) == zeroR

    multiply-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> multiply x y == multiply y x
    multiply-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply (multiply x y) z ==
      multiply x (multiply y z)
    multiply-one :
      (x : R) -> multiply x oneR == x
    multiply-zero :
      (x : R) -> multiply x zeroR == zeroR
    distribute :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply x (add y z) ==
      add (multiply x y) (multiply x z)
    inverse-zero :
      inverse zeroR == zeroR
    multiply-inverse :
      (x : R) ->
      x != zeroR ->
      multiply x (inverse x) == oneR

    order-reflexive :
      (x : R) -> lessOrEqual x x
    order-transitive :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y z ->
      lessOrEqual x z
    order-antisymmetric :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y x ->
      x == y
    order-total :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y or lessOrEqual y x
    add-order :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual (add z x) (add z y)
    multiply-nonnegative :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR x ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR y ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR (multiply x y)
    zero-less-than-one :
      lessOrEqual zeroR oneR and zeroR != oneR

    fromNat-zero :
      fromNat zero == zeroR
    fromNat-successor :
      (n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (suc n) == add (fromNat n) oneR
    fromNat-addition :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m + n) == add (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-multiplication :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m * n) == multiply (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-injective :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat m == fromNat n ->
      m == n

    archimedean :
      (x : R) ->
      Exists Nat
        (\ n ->
          lessOrEqual x (fromNat n))
    least-upper-bound :
      (P : R -> Set) ->
      Exists R P ->
      Exists R
        (\ upper ->
          (x : R) ->
          P x ->
          lessOrEqual x upper) ->
      Exists R
        (\ supremum ->
          ((x : R) ->
            P x ->
            lessOrEqual x supremum)
          and
          ((upper : R) ->
            ((x : R) ->
              P x ->
              lessOrEqual x upper) ->
            lessOrEqual supremum upper))

    square-root-nonnegative :
      (x : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR (squareRoot x)
    square-root-square :
      (x : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR x ->
      multiply (squareRoot x) (squareRoot x) == x
    square-root-nonpositive :
      (x : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x zeroR ->
      squareRoot x == zeroR
    square-root-unique :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR y ->
      multiply y y == x ->
      y == squareRoot x

open CompleteOrderedRealField

subtract :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
subtract reals x y =
  add reals x (negate reals y)

divide :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
divide reals x y =
  multiply reals x (inverse reals y)

square :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R
square reals x =
  multiply reals x x

two :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R
two reals =
  add reals (oneR reals) (oneR reals)

maximum :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
maximum reals x y with order-total reals x y
... | left _ =
  y
... | right _ =
  x

absoluteValue :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R
absoluteValue reals x =
  maximum reals x (negate reals x)

StrictLess :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
StrictLess reals x y =
  lessOrEqual reals x y and x != y

Distance :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
Distance reals x y =
  absoluteValue reals (subtract reals x y)

InUnitInterval :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  Set
InUnitInterval reals x =
  lessOrEqual reals (negate reals (oneR reals)) x
  and
  lessOrEqual reals x (oneR reals)

ContinuousOnUnitInterval :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (R -> R) ->
  Set
ContinuousOnUnitInterval {R} reals function =
  (point : R) ->
  InUnitInterval reals point ->
  (epsilon : R) ->
  StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) epsilon ->
  Exists R
    (\ delta ->
      StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) delta
      and
      ((x : R) ->
        InUnitInterval reals x ->
        StrictLess reals
          (Distance reals x point)
          delta ->
        StrictLess reals
          (Distance reals (function x) (function point))
          epsilon))

FiniteLeftLimitAtOne :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (R -> R) ->
  Set
FiniteLeftLimitAtOne {R} reals function =
  Exists R
    (\ limit ->
      (epsilon : R) ->
      StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) epsilon ->
      Exists R
        (\ delta ->
          StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) delta
          and
          ((x : R) ->
            StrictLess reals
              (subtract reals
                (oneR reals)
                delta)
              x ->
            StrictLess reals x (oneR reals) ->
            StrictLess reals
              (Distance reals
                (divide reals
                  (function x)
                  (squareRoot reals
                    (subtract reals
                      (oneR reals)
                      x)))
                limit)
              epsilon)))

functionalArgument :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R
functionalArgument reals x =
  divide reals
    (square reals x)
    (subtract reals
      (two reals)
      (square reals x))

functionalCoefficient :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R
functionalCoefficient reals x =
  divide reals
    (subtract reals
      (two reals)
      (square reals x))
    (two reals)

record SatisfiesConditions
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R)
  (function : R -> R) :
  Set where

  field
    continuous-on-interval :
      ContinuousOnUnitInterval reals function

    functional-equation :
      (x : R) ->
      InUnitInterval reals x ->
      function x ==
      multiply reals
        (functionalCoefficient reals x)
        (function (functionalArgument reals x))

    normalized-at-zero :
      function (zeroR reals) == oneR reals

    finite-left-limit :
      FiniteLeftLimitAtOne reals function

solution :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R
solution reals x =
  squareRoot reals
    (subtract reals
      (oneR reals)
      (square reals x))

putnam-2012-a3 : Set1
putnam-2012-a3 =
  (R : Set) ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) ->
  SatisfiesConditions reals (solution reals)
  and
  ((function : R -> R) ->
    SatisfiesConditions reals function ->
    (x : R) ->
    InUnitInterval reals x ->
    function x == solution reals x)

title: putnam_2012_a3
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2012_a3:
  the unique continuous solution of a functional equation on [-1, 1], with
  normalization and a finite left limit at 1, is sqrt (1 - x^2). This file
  contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open pred_setTheory realTheory real_topologyTheory transcTheory;

val putnam_2012_a3 =
  ``let S = {x : real | -1 <= x /\ x <= 1}
    in
    let solution = \x : real. sqrt (1 - x pow 2)
    in
    let satisfies =
      \f : real -> real.
        f continuous_on S /\
        (!x : real.
           x IN S
           ==>
           f x =
             ((2 - x pow 2) / 2) *
             f (x pow 2 / (2 - x pow 2))) /\
        f 0 = 1 /\
        ?y : real.
          ((\x : real. f x / sqrt (1 - x)) --> y)
            (at 1 within {x : real | x < 1})
    in
      satisfies solution /\
      !f : real -> real.
        satisfies f
        ==>
        !x : real. x IN S ==> f x = solution x``;

$(

  putnam_2012_a3: the unique continuous real function on the closed interval
  from negative one to one satisfying the given functional equation,
  normalization at zero, and finite left-limit condition is
  sqrt(1 - x^2). This file contains no proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  P12A3Solution is the total real function x |-> sqrt(1 - x^2), using zero
  when the radicand is negative, as do the total real square-root operations
  in the source formalizations. Only its values on [-1,1] occur in the
  conclusion and in the active neighborhood of the left-limit condition.

  P12A3Satisfies requires a total real-valued function, continuity of its
  restriction to [-1,1], the source functional equation at every point of
  that interval, and normalization at zero. Its final conjunct is the
  epsilon-delta expansion of existence of a finite real left-hand limit at
  one for f(x) / sqrt(1-x); the limit and all cutoffs remain internally
  quantified.

  The final assertion states both that the displayed closed form satisfies
  every condition and that every satisfying function agrees with it
  throughout [-1,1]. All declarations are unproved $a statement encodings;
  this database contains no $p proof declaration.
$)

$c P12A3Solution P12A3Satisfies $.

p12a3-solution-syntax $a class P12A3Solution $.
p12a3-satisfies-syntax $a wff ( P12A3Satisfies F ) $.

p12a3-solution-definition $a |- P12A3Solution =
  (
    x e. RR |->
      if (
        0 <_ ( 1 - ( x ^ 2 ) ) ,
        ( sqrt ` ( 1 - ( x ^ 2 ) ) ) ,
        0
      )
  )
$.

${
  $d F L d e x $.

  p12a3-satisfies-definition $a |- (
    ( P12A3Satisfies F )
    <->
    (
      F e. ( RR ^m RR )
      /\
      (
        ( F |` ( ( -u 1 ) [,] 1 ) )
        e.
        ( ( ( -u 1 ) [,] 1 ) -cn-> RR )
      )
      /\
      A. x e. ( ( -u 1 ) [,] 1 )
        (
          ( F ` x )
          =
          (
            (
              ( 2 - ( x ^ 2 ) )
              /
              2
            )
            x.
            (
              F
              `
              (
                ( x ^ 2 )
                /
                ( 2 - ( x ^ 2 ) )
              )
            )
          )
        )
      /\
      ( F ` 0 ) = 1
      /\
      E. L e. RR
        A. e e. RR
          (
            0 < e
            ->
            E. d e. RR
              (
                0 < d
                /\
                A. x e. RR
                  (
                    (
                      x < 1
                      /\
                      ( abs ` ( x - 1 ) ) < d
                    )
                    ->
                    (
                      abs
                      `
                      (
                        (
                          ( F ` x )
                          /
                          ( sqrt ` ( 1 - x ) )
                        )
                        -
                        L
                      )
                    )
                    < e
                  )
              )
          )
    )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d F x $.

  putnambench-putnam-2012-a3 $a |- (
    ( P12A3Satisfies P12A3Solution )
    /\
    A. F e. ( RR ^m RR )
      (
        ( P12A3Satisfies F )
        ->
        A. x e. ( ( -u 1 ) [,] 1 )
          ( F ` x ) = ( P12A3Solution ` x )

$}

title: putnam_2012_a3
content:
% Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2012_a3:
% the continuous real functions on [-1, 1] satisfying the stated functional
% equation, normalization, and finite left limit are uniquely
% sqrt(1 - x^2). This file contains no proof.

putnam_2012_a3: THEORY
BEGIN
  real_function: TYPE = [real -> real]

  in_interval(x: real): bool =
    -1 <= x AND x <= 1

  safe_div(numerator, denominator: real): real =
    IF denominator = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      numerator / denominator
    ENDIF

  nonnegative_sqrt(x: real): real =
    IF x >= 0 THEN
      epsilon(
        LAMBDA (root: real):
          root >= 0 AND root * root = x)
    ELSE
      0
    ENDIF

  continuous_on_interval(f: real_function): bool =
    FORALL (x: real):
      in_interval(x) IMPLIES
        FORALL (epsilon_value: posreal):
          EXISTS (delta: posreal):
            FORALL (y: real):
              (in_interval(y) AND abs(y - x) < delta)
                IMPLIES abs(f(y) - f(x)) < epsilon_value

  satisfies_functional_equation(f: real_function): bool =
    FORALL (x: real):
      in_interval(x) IMPLIES
        f(x)
          = safe_div(2 - x ^ 2, 2)
              * f(safe_div(x ^ 2, 2 - x ^ 2))

  has_finite_left_limit(f: real_function): bool =
    EXISTS (limit_value: real):
      FORALL (epsilon_value: posreal):
        EXISTS (delta: posreal):
          FORALL (x: real):
            (1 - delta < x AND x < 1)
              IMPLIES
                abs(
                  safe_div(
                    f(x),
                    nonnegative_sqrt(1 - x))
                    - limit_value)
                  < epsilon_value

  satisfies_conditions(f: real_function): bool =
    continuous_on_interval(f)
      AND satisfies_functional_equation(f)
      AND f(0) = 1
      AND has_finite_left_limit(f)

  putnam_2012_a3_solution(x: real): real =
    nonnegative_sqrt(1 - x ^ 2)

  putnam_2012_a3: bool =
    satisfies_conditions(putnam_2012_a3_solution)
      AND FORALL (f: real_function):
        satisfies_conditions(f) IMPLIES
          FORALL (x: real):
            in_interval(x) IMPLIES
              f(x) = putnam_2012_a3_solution(x)
END putnam_2012_a3

import Mathlib

open Matrix Function

/--
Let $q$ and $r$ be integers with $q>0$, and let $A$ and $B$ be intervals on the real line. Let $T$ be the set of all $b+mq$ where $b$ and $m$ are integers with $b$ in $B$, and let $S$ be the set of all integers $a$ in $A$ such that $ra$ is in $T$. Show that if the product of the lengths of $A$ and $B$ is less than $q$, then $S$ is the intersection of $A$ with some arithmetic progression.
-/
theorem putnam_2012_a4
    (IsFiniteAP : Set ℤ → Prop)
    (IsFiniteAP_def : ∀ s,
      IsFiniteAP s ↔ ∃ n : ℕ, ∃ a d : ℤ, 0 < d ∧ s = {a + i * d | i : Fin n})
    (q r : ℤ)
    (A B : Fin 2 → ℝ)
    (T : Set ℤ)
    (S : Set ℤ)
    (qpos : q > 0)

    (hT : T = {x : ℤ | ∃ b m : ℤ, (b : ℝ) ∈ Set.Icc (B 0) (B 1) ∧ x = b + m * q})
    (hS : S = {a : ℤ | (a : ℝ) ∈ Set.Icc (A 0) (A 1) ∧ r * a ∈ T})
    (prod_lt : (A 1 - A 0) * (B 1 - B 0) < q) :
    IsFiniteAP {x | x ∈ S ∧ (x : ℝ) ∈ Set.Icc (A 0) (A 1)} :=

(* Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2012_a4:
   integers selected from a real interval by a congruence condition form a
   finite arithmetic progression when the interval-length product is small;
   this file contains no proof. *)

From Stdlib Require Import Reals ZArith Arith.PeanoNat.

Open Scope R_scope.

Definition putnam_2012_a4_in_interval
    (lower upper : R) (x : Z) : Prop :=
  lower <= IZR x <= upper.

Definition putnam_2012_a4_T
    (q : Z) (B0 B1 : R) (x : Z) : Prop :=
  exists b m : Z,
    putnam_2012_a4_in_interval B0 B1 b /\
    x = (b + m * q)%Z.

Definition putnam_2012_a4_S
    (q r : Z) (A0 A1 B0 B1 : R) (a : Z) : Prop :=
  putnam_2012_a4_in_interval A0 A1 a /\
  putnam_2012_a4_T q B0 B1 (r * a)%Z.

Definition putnam_2012_a4_finite_arithmetic_progression
    (P : Z -> Prop) : Prop :=
  exists (n : nat) (a d : Z),
    (0 < d)%Z /\
    forall x : Z,
      P x <->
      exists i : nat,
        (i < n)%nat /\
        x = (a + Z.of_nat i * d)%Z.

Theorem putnam_2012_a4
    (q r : Z)
    (A0 A1 B0 B1 : R)
    (qpos : (0 < q)%Z)
    (ABlt : A0 < A1 /\ B0 < B1)
    (prod_lt : (A1 - A0) * (B1 - B0) < IZR q) :
  putnam_2012_a4_finite_arithmetic_progression
    (fun x : Z =>
      putnam_2012_a4_S q r A0 A1 B0 B1 x /\
      putnam_2012_a4_in_interval A0 A1 x).
Admitted.

title: putnam_2012_a4
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2012_a4:
;; under the interval-length product bound, the integers in A whose
;; r-multiples are congruent modulo q to an integer in B form a finite
;; arithmetic progression. This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))

;; ACL2's conservative generic symbols present an arbitrary Archimedean
;; ordered field and its integer embedding. Completeness is not used by this
;; theorem; Archimedeanness is the exact property ensuring that bounded real
;; intervals contain only finitely many embedded integers.

(defstub p12a4-scalar-p (x) t)
(defstub p12a4-add (x y) t)
(defstub p12a4-multiply (x y) t)
(defstub p12a4-negate (x) t)
(defstub p12a4-less (x y) t)
(defstub p12a4-integer-embed (n) t)
(defstub p12a4-archimedean-bound (x) t)

(defun p12a4-member-p (x)
  (if (p12a4-scalar-p x) t nil))

(defun p12a4-less-p (x y)
  (if (p12a4-less x y) t nil))

(defun p12a4-subtract (x y)
  (p12a4-add x (p12a4-negate y)))

(defun p12a4-in-closed-interval-p (lower upper x)
  (and
   (not (p12a4-less-p x lower))
   (not (p12a4-less-p upper x))))

(defun-sk p12a4-ring-laws-p (zero one)
  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (p12a4-member-p x)
      (p12a4-member-p y)
      (p12a4-member-p z))
     (and
      (p12a4-member-p (p12a4-add x y))
      (p12a4-member-p (p12a4-multiply x y))
      (p12a4-member-p (p12a4-negate x))
      (equal
       (p12a4-add (p12a4-add x y) z)
       (p12a4-add x (p12a4-add y z)))
      (equal (p12a4-add x y) (p12a4-add y x))
      (equal (p12a4-add x zero) x)
      (equal (p12a4-add x (p12a4-negate x)) zero)
      (equal
       (p12a4-multiply (p12a4-multiply x y) z)
       (p12a4-multiply x (p12a4-multiply y z)))
      (equal (p12a4-multiply x y) (p12a4-multiply y x))
      (equal (p12a4-multiply x one) x)
      (equal
       (p12a4-multiply x (p12a4-add y z))
       (p12a4-add
        (p12a4-multiply x y)
        (p12a4-multiply x z)))))))

(defun-sk p12a4-order-laws-p (zero)
  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (p12a4-member-p x)
      (p12a4-member-p y)
      (p12a4-member-p z))
     (and
      (not (p12a4-less-p x x))
      (or
       (equal x y)
       (p12a4-less-p x y)
       (p12a4-less-p y x))
      (implies
       (and
        (p12a4-less-p x y)
        (p12a4-less-p y z))
       (p12a4-less-p x z))
      (implies
       (p12a4-less-p x y)
       (p12a4-less-p
        (p12a4-add x z)
        (p12a4-add y z)))
      (implies
       (and
        (p12a4-less-p zero x)
        (p12a4-less-p zero y))
       (p12a4-less-p
        zero
        (p12a4-multiply x y)))))))

(defun-sk p12a4-integer-embedding-laws-p ()
  (forall (m n)
    (implies
     (and (integerp m) (integerp n))
     (and
      (p12a4-member-p (p12a4-integer-embed m))
      (equal
       (p12a4-integer-embed (+ m n))
       (p12a4-add
        (p12a4-integer-embed m)
        (p12a4-integer-embed n)))
      (equal
       (p12a4-integer-embed (* m n))
       (p12a4-multiply
        (p12a4-integer-embed m)
        (p12a4-integer-embed n)))
      (iff
       (< m n)
       (p12a4-less-p
        (p12a4-integer-embed m)
        (p12a4-integer-embed n)))))))

(defun-sk p12a4-archimedean-law-p ()
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (p12a4-member-p x)
     (and
      (integerp (p12a4-archimedean-bound x))
      (p12a4-less-p
       x
       (p12a4-integer-embed
        (p12a4-archimedean-bound x)))))))

(defun p12a4-archimedean-ordered-field-p (zero one)
  (and
   (p12a4-member-p zero)
   (p12a4-member-p one)
   (not (equal zero one))
   (p12a4-ring-laws-p zero one)
   (p12a4-order-laws-p zero)
   (p12a4-less-p zero one)
   (equal (p12a4-integer-embed 0) zero)
   (equal (p12a4-integer-embed 1) one)
   (p12a4-integer-embedding-laws-p)
   (p12a4-archimedean-law-p)))

(defun-sk p12a4-t-member-p
    (b-lower b-upper q x)
  (exists (b m)
    (and
     (integerp b)
     (integerp m)
     (p12a4-in-closed-interval-p
      b-lower b-upper
      (p12a4-integer-embed b))
     (equal x (+ b (* m q))))))

(defun p12a4-s-member-p
    (a-lower a-upper b-lower b-upper q r x)
  (and
   (integerp x)
   (p12a4-in-closed-interval-p
    a-lower a-upper
    (p12a4-integer-embed x))
   (p12a4-t-member-p
    b-lower b-upper q (* r x))))

(defun-sk p12a4-progression-member-p
    (x n start step)
  (exists (i)
    (and
     (natp i)
     (< i n)
     (equal x (+ start (* i step))))))

(defun-sk p12a4-s-is-progression-p
    (a-lower a-upper b-lower b-upper q r n start step)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (integerp x)
     (iff
      (p12a4-s-member-p
       a-lower a-upper b-lower b-upper q r x)
      (p12a4-progression-member-p
       x n start step)))))

(defun-sk p12a4-finite-progression-exists-p
    (a-lower a-upper b-lower b-upper q r)
  (exists (n start step)
    (and
     (natp n)
     (integerp start)
     (integerp step)
     (< 0 step)
     (p12a4-s-is-progression-p
      a-lower a-upper b-lower b-upper q r
      n start step))))

(defun putnambench-putnam-2012-a4-statement
    (zero one q r a-lower a-upper b-lower b-upper)
  (let* ((a-length
          (p12a4-subtract a-upper a-lower))
         (b-length
          (p12a4-subtract b-upper b-lower))
         (length-product
          (p12a4-multiply a-length b-length)))
    (implies
     (and
      (p12a4-archimedean-ordered-field-p zero one)
      (integerp q)
      (integerp r)
      (< 0 q)
      (p12a4-member-p a-lower)
      (p12a4-member-p a-upper)
      (p12a4-member-p b-lower)
      (p12a4-member-p b-upper)
      (p12a4-less-p a-lower a-upper)
      (p12a4-less-p b-lower b-upper)
      (p12a4-less-p
       length-product
       (p12a4-integer-embed q)))
     (p12a4-finite-progression-exists-p
      a-lower a-upper b-lower b-upper q r))))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

title: putnam_2012_a4
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2012_a4
-- (putnambench__agda__putnam_2012_a4): an interval length-product bound makes
-- the selected integers the intersection of an interval with a finite
-- arithmetic progression. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module Putnam2012A4 where

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Int using (Int; pos; negsuc)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; _*_)

infix 4 _!=_
infixr 3 _and_
infix 2 _iff_

data Bottom : Set where

Not : Set -> Set
Not A =
  A -> Bottom

_!=_ : {A : Set} -> A -> A -> Set
x != y =
  Not (x == y)

record _and_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

record _iff_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor equivalence
  field
    forward  : A -> B
    backward : B -> A

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

data Fin : Nat -> Set where
  fzero : {n : Nat} -> Fin (suc n)
  fsuc  : {n : Nat} -> Fin n -> Fin (suc n)

finToNat : {n : Nat} -> Fin n -> Nat
finToNat fzero =
  zero
finToNat (fsuc i) =
  suc (finToNat i)

finToInt : {n : Nat} -> Fin n -> Int
finToInt i =
  pos (finToNat i)

data PositiveInt : Int -> Set where
  positive : {n : Nat} -> PositiveInt (pos (suc n))

negative : Nat -> Int
negative zero =
  pos zero
negative (suc n) =
  negsuc n

difference : Nat -> Nat -> Int
difference zero zero =
  pos zero
difference (suc m) zero =
  pos (suc m)
difference zero (suc n) =
  negsuc n
difference (suc m) (suc n) =
  difference m n

addInt : Int -> Int -> Int
addInt (pos m) (pos n) =
  pos (m + n)
addInt (pos m) (negsuc n) =
  difference m (suc n)
addInt (negsuc m) (pos n) =
  difference n (suc m)
addInt (negsuc m) (negsuc n) =
  negsuc (suc (m + n))

multiplyInt : Int -> Int -> Int
multiplyInt (pos m) (pos n) =
  pos (m * n)
multiplyInt (pos m) (negsuc n) =
  negative (m * suc n)
multiplyInt (negsuc m) (pos n) =
  negative (suc m * n)
multiplyInt (negsuc m) (negsuc n) =
  pos (suc m * suc n)

data _or_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  left  : A -> A or B
  right : B -> A or B

record CompleteOrderedRealField (R : Set) : Set1 where
  field
    zeroR oneR : R
    add multiply : R -> R -> R
    negate inverse : R -> R
    lessOrEqual : R -> R -> Set
    fromNat : Nat -> R

    one-not-zero :
      oneR != zeroR

    add-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> add x y == add y x
    add-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      add (add x y) z == add x (add y z)
    add-zero :
      (x : R) -> add x zeroR == x
    add-inverse :
      (x : R) -> add x (negate x) == zeroR

    multiply-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> multiply x y == multiply y x
    multiply-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply (multiply x y) z ==
      multiply x (multiply y z)
    multiply-one :
      (x : R) -> multiply x oneR == x
    multiply-zero :
      (x : R) -> multiply x zeroR == zeroR
    distribute :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply x (add y z) ==
      add (multiply x y) (multiply x z)
    inverse-zero :
      inverse zeroR == zeroR
    multiply-inverse :
      (x : R) ->
      x != zeroR ->
      multiply x (inverse x) == oneR

    order-reflexive :
      (x : R) -> lessOrEqual x x
    order-transitive :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y z ->
      lessOrEqual x z
    order-antisymmetric :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y x ->
      x == y
    order-total :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y or lessOrEqual y x
    add-order :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual (add z x) (add z y)
    multiply-nonnegative :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR x ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR y ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR (multiply x y)
    zero-less-than-one :
      lessOrEqual zeroR oneR and zeroR != oneR

    fromNat-zero :
      fromNat zero == zeroR
    fromNat-successor :
      (n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (suc n) == add (fromNat n) oneR
    fromNat-addition :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m + n) == add (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-multiplication :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m * n) == multiply (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-injective :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat m == fromNat n ->
      m == n

    archimedean :
      (x : R) ->
      Exists Nat
        (\ n ->
          lessOrEqual x (fromNat n))
    least-upper-bound :
      (P : R -> Set) ->
      Exists R P ->
      Exists R
        (\ upper ->
          (x : R) ->
          P x ->
          lessOrEqual x upper) ->
      Exists R
        (\ supremum ->
          ((x : R) ->
            P x ->
            lessOrEqual x supremum)
          and
          ((upper : R) ->
            ((x : R) ->
              P x ->
              lessOrEqual x upper) ->
            lessOrEqual supremum upper))

open CompleteOrderedRealField

StrictLess :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
StrictLess reals x y =
  lessOrEqual reals x y and x != y

subtract :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
subtract reals x y =
  add reals x (negate reals y)

fromInt :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Int ->
  R
fromInt reals (pos n) =
  fromNat reals n
fromInt reals (negsuc n) =
  negate reals (fromNat reals (suc n))

record Interval (R : Set) : Set where
  constructor endpoints
  field
    lower upper : R

open Interval

InClosedInterval :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Interval R ->
  R ->
  Set
InClosedInterval reals I x =
  lessOrEqual reals (lower I) x
  and
  lessOrEqual reals x (upper I)

IntervalNondegenerate :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Interval R ->
  Set
IntervalNondegenerate reals I =
  StrictLess reals (lower I) (upper I)

intervalLength :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Interval R ->
  R
intervalLength reals I =
  subtract reals (upper I) (lower I)

SameSet :
  (Int -> Set) ->
  (Int -> Set) ->
  Set
SameSet X Y =
  (x : Int) ->
  X x iff Y x

FiniteArithmeticProgression :
  (Int -> Set) ->
  Set
FiniteArithmeticProgression X =
  Exists Nat
    (\ n ->
      Exists Int
        (\ firstTerm ->
          Exists Int
            (\ differenceTerm ->
              PositiveInt differenceTerm
              and
              SameSet X
                (\ x ->
                  Exists (Fin n)
                    (\ i ->
                      x ==
                      addInt firstTerm
                        (multiplyInt
                          (finToInt i)
                          differenceTerm))))))

module Putnam2012A4Statement
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) where

  T :
    Int ->
    Interval R ->
    Int ->
    Set
  T q B x =
    Exists Int
      (\ b ->
        Exists Int
          (\ m ->
            InClosedInterval reals B (fromInt reals b)
            and
            x == addInt b (multiplyInt m q)))

  S :
    Int ->
    Int ->
    Interval R ->
    Interval R ->
    Int ->
    Set
  S q r A B a =
    InClosedInterval reals A (fromInt reals a)
    and
    T q B (multiplyInt r a)

  RelevantSet :
    Int ->
    Int ->
    Interval R ->
    Interval R ->
    Int ->
    Set
  RelevantSet q r A B x =
    S q r A B x
    and
    InClosedInterval reals A (fromInt reals x)

  LengthProductBelow :
    Int ->
    Interval R ->
    Interval R ->
    Set
  LengthProductBelow q A B =
    StrictLess reals
      (multiply reals
        (intervalLength reals A)
        (intervalLength reals B))
      (fromInt reals q)

  proposition : Set
  proposition =
    (q r : Int) ->
    (A B : Interval R) ->
    PositiveInt q ->
    IntervalNondegenerate reals A
    and
    IntervalNondegenerate reals B ->
    LengthProductBelow q A B ->
    FiniteArithmeticProgression
      (RelevantSet q r A B)

putnam-2012-a4 : Set1
putnam-2012-a4 =
  (R : Set) ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) ->
  Putnam2012A4Statement.proposition reals

content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2012_a4:
  integers selected from a real interval by a modular condition determined by
  a second interval form a finite arithmetic progression when the product of
  the interval lengths is less than the positive modulus. This file contains
  no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open arithmeticTheory integerTheory pairTheory pred_setTheory realTheory
     intrealTheory;

val putnam_2012_a4 =
  ``!q r : int. !A B : real # real.
      0 < q /\
      FST A < SND A /\
      FST B < SND B /\
      (SND A - FST A) * (SND B - FST B) < real_of_int q
      ==>
      let T =
        {x : int |
           ?b m : int.
             FST B <= real_of_int b /\
             real_of_int b <= SND B /\
             x = b + m * q}
      in
        let S =
          {a : int |
             FST A <= real_of_int a /\
             real_of_int a <= SND A /\
             r * a IN T}
        in
          ?n : num. ?a d : int.
            0 < d /\
            {x : int |
               x IN S /\
               FST A <= real_of_int x /\
               real_of_int x <= SND A} =
              IMAGE
                (\i : num. a + int_of_num i * d)
                (count n)``;

:: Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2012_a4:
:: integer points selected from two real intervals by a linear congruence form
:: a finite arithmetic progression under the interval-length bound. This file
:: contains no proof.

environ
  vocabularies TARSKI, XBOOLE_0, ZFMISC_1, SUBSET_1, RELAT_1, NUMBERS,
    XREAL_0, XCMPLX_0, COMPLEX1, CARD_1, XXREAL_0, ARYTM_1, ARYTM_3,
    REAL_1, INT_1, INT_2, NAT_1, ORDINAL1;
  notations TARSKI, XBOOLE_0, ZFMISC_1, SUBSET_1, ORDINAL1, CARD_1,
    NUMBERS, XCMPLX_0, XREAL_0, XXREAL_0, REAL_1, NAT_1, INT_1,
    INT_2;
  constructors XCMPLX_0, XXREAL_0, REAL_1, NAT_1, INT_1, INT_2,
    CARD_1;
  registrations XBOOLE_0, SUBSET_1, ORDINAL1, NUMBERS, XREAL_0,
    XXREAL_0, NAT_1, INT_1, CARD_1;
  requirements REAL, NUMERALS, SUBSET, BOOLE, ARITHM;

begin

::$P-
theorem
  for q,r being Integer,
      A0,A1,B0,B1 being Real,
      T,S being Subset of INT st
    0 < q &
    A0 < A1 & B0 < B1 &
    T = {x where x is Integer :
      ex b,m being Integer st
        B0 <= (b qua Real) & (b qua Real) <= B1 &
        x = b + m * q} &
    S = {x where x is Integer :
      A0 <= (x qua Real) & (x qua Real) <= A1 &
      r * x in T} &
    (A1 - A0) * (B1 - B0) < (q qua Real)
  holds
    ex n being Nat, a,d being Integer st
      0 < d &
      {x where x is Integer :
        x in S &
        A0 <= (x qua Real) & (x qua Real) <= A1}
      =
      {a + (i qua Integer) * d where i is Nat : i < n}
proof
end;
::$P+

title: putnam_2012_a4
content:
% Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2012_a4:
% the finite arithmetic-progression structure of integers selected by two real
% intervals and a congruence modulo a positive integer. This file contains no proof.

putnam_2012_a4: THEORY
BEGIN
  interval: TYPE = [# lower: real, upper: real #]
  integer_set: TYPE = [int -> bool]

  in_interval(value: int, I: interval): bool =
    lower(I) <= (value :: real)
      AND (value :: real) <= upper(I)

  generated_set(q: int, B: interval): integer_set =
    LAMBDA (x: int):
      EXISTS (b, m: int):
        in_interval(b, B)
          AND x = b + m * q

  selected_set(
      r: int,
      A: interval,
      T: integer_set): integer_set =
    LAMBDA (a: int):
      in_interval(a, A)
        AND T(r * a)

  finite_arithmetic_progression(S: integer_set): bool =
    EXISTS (n: nat), (first, step: int):
      step > 0
        AND (FORALL (x: int):
          S(x) IFF
            EXISTS (i: nat):
              i < n
                AND x = first + (i :: int) * step)

  putnam_2012_a4: bool =
    FORALL (q, r: int),
           (A, B: interval),
           (T, S: integer_set):
      (q > 0
        AND lower(A) < upper(A)
        AND lower(B) < upper(B)
        AND T = generated_set(q, B)
        AND S = selected_set(r, A, T)
        AND (upper(A) - lower(A))
              * (upper(B) - lower(B)) < (q :: real))
      IMPLIES
        finite_arithmetic_progression(
          LAMBDA (x: int):
            S(x) AND in_interval(x, A))
END putnam_2012_a4

title: putnam_2012_a5
content:
import Mathlib

open Matrix Function

abbrev putnam_2012_a5_solution : Set (ℕ × ℕ) :=
  {q | q.1 = 1} ∪ {(2, 2)}
/--
Let $\FF_p$ denote the field of integers modulo a prime $p$, and let $n$ be a positive integer. Let $v$ be a fixed vector in $\FF_p^n$, let $M$ be an $n \times n$ matrix with entries of $\FF_p$, and define $G: \FF_p^n \to \FF_p^n$ by $G(x) = v + Mx$. Let $G^{(k)}$ denote the $k$-fold composition of $G$ with itself, that is, $G^{(1)}(x) = G(x)$ and $G^{(k+1)}(x) = G(G^{(k)}(x))$. Determine all pairs $p, n$ for which there exist $v$ and $M$ such that the $p^n$ vectors $G^{(k)}(0)$, $k=1,2,\dots,p^n$ are distinct.
-/
theorem putnam_2012_a5
  (n p : ℕ)
  (hn : n > 0)
  (hp : Nat.Prime p)
  {F : Type*} [Field F] [Fintype F]
  (hK : Fintype.card F = p)
  (G : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) F → (Fin n → F) → (Fin n → F) → (Fin n → F))
  (hG : ∀ M v x, G M v x = v + mulVec M x) :
  (n, p) ∈ putnam_2012_a5_solution ↔
    ∃ᵉ (M : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) F) (v : (Fin n → F)),
      ¬(∃ i j : Finset.range (p^n), i ≠ j ∧ (G M v)^[i + 1] 0 = (G M v)^[j + 1] 0) :=
  sorry

title: putnam_2012_a5
content:
(* Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2012_a5:
   classification of finite-field affine maps whose orbit of zero visits all
   p^n vectors without repetition. This file contains no proof. *)

From Stdlib Require Import Arith.PeanoNat Lists.List Vectors.Fin.

Record putnam_2012_a5_finite_field : Type := {
  ff_carrier : Type;
  ff_zero : ff_carrier;
  ff_one : ff_carrier;
  ff_add : ff_carrier -> ff_carrier -> ff_carrier;
  ff_mul : ff_carrier -> ff_carrier -> ff_carrier;
  ff_opp : ff_carrier -> ff_carrier;
  ff_inv : ff_carrier -> ff_carrier;
  ff_zero_neq_one : ff_zero <> ff_one;
  ff_add_assoc :
    forall x y z, ff_add x (ff_add y z) = ff_add (ff_add x y) z;
  ff_add_comm : forall x y, ff_add x y = ff_add y x;
  ff_add_zero_l : forall x, ff_add ff_zero x = x;
  ff_add_zero_r : forall x, ff_add x ff_zero = x;
  ff_add_opp_l : forall x, ff_add (ff_opp x) x = ff_zero;
  ff_add_opp_r : forall x, ff_add x (ff_opp x) = ff_zero;
  ff_mul_assoc :
    forall x y z, ff_mul x (ff_mul y z) = ff_mul (ff_mul x y) z;
  ff_mul_comm : forall x y, ff_mul x y = ff_mul y x;
  ff_mul_one_l : forall x, ff_mul ff_one x = x;
  ff_mul_one_r : forall x, ff_mul x ff_one = x;
  ff_mul_add_l :
    forall x y z, ff_mul x (ff_add y z) = ff_add (ff_mul x y) (ff_mul x z);
  ff_mul_add_r :
    forall x y z, ff_mul (ff_add x y) z = ff_add (ff_mul x z) (ff_mul y z);
  ff_inv_zero : ff_inv ff_zero = ff_zero;
  ff_inv_l :
    forall x, x <> ff_zero -> ff_mul (ff_inv x) x = ff_one;
  ff_inv_r :
    forall x, x <> ff_zero -> ff_mul x (ff_inv x) = ff_one;
  ff_elements : list ff_carrier;
  ff_elements_nodup : NoDup ff_elements;
  ff_elements_complete : forall x, In x ff_elements
}.

Definition putnam_2012_a5_prime (p : nat) : Prop :=
  2 <= p /\
  forall d : nat, Nat.divide d p -> d = 1 \/ d = p.

Definition putnam_2012_a5_solution (q : nat * nat) : Prop :=
  fst q = 1%nat \/ q = (2%nat, 2%nat).

Definition putnam_2012_a5_vector
    (K : putnam_2012_a5_finite_field) (n : nat) : Type :=
  Fin.t n -> ff_carrier K.

Definition putnam_2012_a5_vector_eq
    (K : putnam_2012_a5_finite_field) (n : nat)
    (x y : putnam_2012_a5_vector K n) : Prop :=
  forall i : Fin.t n, x i = y i.

Definition putnam_2012_a5_matrix
    (K : putnam_2012_a5_finite_field) (n : nat) : Type :=
  Fin.t n -> Fin.t n -> ff_carrier K.

Fixpoint putnam_2012_a5_fin_sum
    (K : putnam_2012_a5_finite_field) (n : nat)
    : (Fin.t n -> ff_carrier K) -> ff_carrier K :=
  match n as m return (Fin.t m -> ff_carrier K) -> ff_carrier K with
  | 0 => fun _ => ff_zero K
  | S m =>
      fun f =>
        ff_add K (f Fin.F1)
          (putnam_2012_a5_fin_sum K m (fun i => f (Fin.FS i)))
  end.

Definition putnam_2012_a5_zero_vector
    (K : putnam_2012_a5_finite_field) (n : nat)
    : putnam_2012_a5_vector K n :=
  fun _ => ff_zero K.

Definition putnam_2012_a5_matrix_vector
    (K : putnam_2012_a5_finite_field) (n : nat)
    (M : putnam_2012_a5_matrix K n)
    (x : putnam_2012_a5_vector K n)
    : putnam_2012_a5_vector K n :=
  fun i =>
    putnam_2012_a5_fin_sum K n
      (fun j => ff_mul K (M i j) (x j)).

Definition putnam_2012_a5_affine
    (K : putnam_2012_a5_finite_field) (n : nat)
    (M : putnam_2012_a5_matrix K n)
    (v x : putnam_2012_a5_vector K n)
    : putnam_2012_a5_vector K n :=
  fun i => ff_add K (v i) (putnam_2012_a5_matrix_vector K n M x i).

Fixpoint putnam_2012_a5_iterate
    {A : Type} (k : nat) (f : A -> A) (x : A) : A :=
  match k with
  | 0 => x
  | S m => f (putnam_2012_a5_iterate m f x)
  end.

Theorem putnam_2012_a5
    (n p : nat)
    (hn : 0 < n)
    (hp : putnam_2012_a5_prime p)
    (K : putnam_2012_a5_finite_field)
    (hcard : length (ff_elements K) = p) :
  putnam_2012_a5_solution (n, p) <->
  exists (M : putnam_2012_a5_matrix K n)
         (v : putnam_2012_a5_vector K n),
    forall i j : Fin.t (Nat.pow p n),
      i <> j ->
      ~ putnam_2012_a5_vector_eq K n
          (putnam_2012_a5_iterate
            (S (proj1_sig (Fin.to_nat i)))
            (putnam_2012_a5_affine K n M v)
            (putnam_2012_a5_zero_vector K n))
          (putnam_2012_a5_iterate
            (S (proj1_sig (Fin.to_nat j)))
            (putnam_2012_a5_affine K n M v)
            (putnam_2012_a5_zero_vector K n)).
Admitted.

content:
theory putnam_2012_a5 imports
Complex_Main
"HOL-Computational_Algebra.Primes"
"HOL-Analysis.Finite_Cartesian_Product"
begin

definition putnam_2012_a5_solution :: "(nat \<times> nat) set" where
  "putnam_2012_a5_solution = {q. fst q = 1} \<union> {(2, 2)}"
theorem putnam_2012_a5:
  fixes n p :: nat
  and G :: "('p::field)^'n^'n \<Rightarrow> 'p^'n \<Rightarrow> 'p^'n \<Rightarrow> 'p^'n"
  defines "G \<equiv> \<lambda> (M :: 'p^'n^'n) (v :: 'p^'n) (x :: 'p^'n). v + M *v x" 
  assumes pcard: "CARD('p) = p"
  and ncard: "CARD('n) = n"
  and hn: "n > 0"
  and hp: "prime p"
  shows "(n, p) \<in> putnam_2012_a5_solution \<longleftrightarrow>
          (\<exists> M :: 'p^'n^'n.
          \<exists> v :: 'p^'n.
          \<not>(\<exists> i \<in> {1..p^n}. \<exists> j \<in> {1..p^n}. i \<noteq> j \<and> ((G M v) ^^ i) 0 = ((G M v) ^^ j) 0))"
  sorry

end

title: putnam_2012_a5
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2012_a5:
  classification of affine maps on finite vector spaces over prime fields
  whose first p^n iterates of zero are all distinct. This file contains no
  proof.
*)

needs "Library/iter.ml";;

let statement =
  `let affine =
     \p n:num.
       \(M:num->num->num) (v:num->num) (x:num->num) i.
         if i < n then
           (v i + nsum (0..n - 1) (\j. M i j * x j)) MOD p
         else 0 in
   !n p:num.
     0 < n /\ prime p
     ==>
     (((n = 1) \/ (n = 2 /\ p = 2)) <=>
      ?M:num->num->num. ?v:num->num.
        (!i:num. i < n ==> v i < p) /\
        (!i j:num. i < n /\ j < n ==> M i j < p) /\
        !k l:num.
          1 <= k /\ k <= p EXP n /\
          1 <= l /\ l <= p EXP n /\
          ~(k = l)
          ==>
          ~(ITER k (affine p n M v) (\i:num. 0) =
            ITER l (affine p n M v) (\i:num. 0)))`;;

title: putnam_2012_a5
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2012_a5:
;; affine maps of a positive-dimensional vector space over F_p having a full
;; orbit from zero exist exactly for n = 1 and for (n,p) = (2,2). This file
;; contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

;; Because p is prime, the source field with p elements is uniquely isomorphic
;; to the residue field F_p. Vectors use canonical residue lists. A single
;; base-p code contains first the n entries of v and then the n^2 row-major
;; entries of M, so the bounded search below ranges over every source pair
;; (M,v) while keeping both existential witnesses internal.

(defun putnam-2012-a5-no-divisor-through-p (p candidate)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix candidate)))
  (if (or (not (natp candidate))
          (<= candidate 1))
      t
    (and
     (not (equal (mod p candidate) 0))
     (putnam-2012-a5-no-divisor-through-p
      p (- candidate 1)))))

(defun putnam-2012-a5-prime-p (p)
  (and
   (natp p)
   (< 1 p)
   (putnam-2012-a5-no-divisor-through-p
    p (- p 1))))

(defun putnam-2012-a5-base-digit (code base position)
  (mod (floor code (expt base position)) base))

(defun putnam-2012-a5-zero-vector (remaining)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix remaining)))
  (if (zp remaining)
      nil
    (cons
     0
     (putnam-2012-a5-zero-vector (- remaining 1)))))

(defun putnam-2012-a5-row-dot-product
    (code p n vector row column remaining)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix remaining)))
  (if (zp remaining)
      0
    (+
     (*
      (putnam-2012-a5-base-digit
       code p (+ n (* row n) column))
      (nth column vector))
     (putnam-2012-a5-row-dot-product
      code p n vector row (+ column 1) (- remaining 1)))))

(defun putnam-2012-a5-affine-image-rows
    (code p n vector row remaining)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix remaining)))
  (if (zp remaining)
      nil
    (cons
     (mod
      (+
       (putnam-2012-a5-base-digit code p row)
       (putnam-2012-a5-row-dot-product
        code p n vector row 0 n))
      p)
     (putnam-2012-a5-affine-image-rows
      code p n vector (+ row 1) (- remaining 1)))))

(defun putnam-2012-a5-affine-image (code p n vector)
  (putnam-2012-a5-affine-image-rows
   code p n vector 0 n))

;; Starting with zero, this checks exactly p^n successive positive iterates.
;; Rejecting an iterate already in SEEN is equivalent to pairwise distinctness
;; of G^k(0) for k = 1,...,p^n.
(defun putnam-2012-a5-full-orbit-p
    (code p n current seen remaining)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix remaining)))
  (if (zp remaining)
      t
    (let ((next
           (putnam-2012-a5-affine-image
            code p n current)))
      (and
       (not (member-equal next seen))
       (putnam-2012-a5-full-orbit-p
        code
        p
        n
        next
        (cons next seen)
        (- remaining 1))))))

(defun putnam-2012-a5-witness-search-p
    (n p remaining-codes)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix remaining-codes)))
  (if (and (natp n)
           (natp p)
           (< 0 p)
           (natp remaining-codes))
      (if (zp remaining-codes)
          nil
        (let ((code (- remaining-codes 1)))
          (or
           (putnam-2012-a5-full-orbit-p
            code
            p
            n
            (putnam-2012-a5-zero-vector n)
            nil
            (expt p n))
           (putnam-2012-a5-witness-search-p
            n p code))))
    nil))

(defun putnam-2012-a5-affine-full-orbit-exists-p (n p)
  (if (and (posp n) (putnam-2012-a5-prime-p p))
      (putnam-2012-a5-witness-search-p
       n
       p
       (expt p (+ (* n n) n)))
    nil))

(defun putnam-2012-a5-solution-p (n p)
  (or
   (equal n 1)
   (and
    (equal n 2)
    (equal p 2))))

(defun putnambench-putnam-2012-a5-statement (n p)
  (implies
   (and
    (posp n)
    (putnam-2012-a5-prime-p p))
   (iff
    (putnam-2012-a5-solution-p n p)
    (putnam-2012-a5-affine-full-orbit-exists-p n p))))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

title: putnam_2012_a5
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2012_a5
-- (putnambench__agda__putnam_2012_a5): classification of the prime field
-- dimensions admitting an affine linear map whose first p^n iterates of zero
-- are pairwise distinct. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module Putnam2012A5 where

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _*_)

infix 4 _!=_ _<=N_
infixr 3 _and_
infixr 2 _or_
infix 1 _iff_

data Bottom : Set where

Not : Set -> Set
Not A =
  A -> Bottom

_!=_ : {A : Set} -> A -> A -> Set
x != y =
  Not (x == y)

record _and_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data _or_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  left  : A -> A or B
  right : B -> A or B

record _iff_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor equivalence
  field
    forward  : A -> B
    backward : B -> A

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

data _<=N_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set where
  zero<=N   : {n : Nat} -> zero <=N n
  suc<=sucN : {m n : Nat} -> m <=N n -> suc m <=N suc n

data Fin : Nat -> Set where
  fzero : {n : Nat} -> Fin (suc n)
  fsuc  : {n : Nat} -> Fin n -> Fin (suc n)

finToNat : {n : Nat} -> Fin n -> Nat
finToNat fzero =
  zero
finToNat (fsuc i) =
  suc (finToNat i)

oneN : Nat
oneN =
  suc zero

twoN : Nat
twoN =
  suc oneN

power : Nat -> Nat -> Nat
power base zero =
  oneN
power base (suc exponent) =
  base * power base exponent

Divides : Nat -> Nat -> Set
Divides divisor number =
  Exists Nat
    (\ factor ->
      divisor * factor == number)

Prime : Nat -> Set
Prime p =
  twoN <=N p
  and
  ((divisor : Nat) ->
    Divides divisor p ->
    divisor == oneN or divisor == p)

Positive : Nat -> Set
Positive n =
  oneN <=N n

record Field (F : Set) : Set where
  field
    zeroF oneF : F
    add multiply : F -> F -> F
    negate inverse : F -> F

    one-not-zero :
      oneF != zeroF

    add-commutative :
      (x y : F) ->
      add x y == add y x
    add-associative :
      (x y z : F) ->
      add (add x y) z == add x (add y z)
    add-zero :
      (x : F) ->
      add x zeroF == x
    add-inverse :
      (x : F) ->
      add x (negate x) == zeroF

    multiply-commutative :
      (x y : F) ->
      multiply x y == multiply y x
    multiply-associative :
      (x y z : F) ->
      multiply (multiply x y) z ==
      multiply x (multiply y z)
    multiply-one :
      (x : F) ->
      multiply x oneF == x
    distribute :
      (x y z : F) ->
      multiply x (add y z) ==
      add (multiply x y) (multiply x z)
    multiply-inverse :
      (x : F) ->
      x != zeroF ->
      multiply x (inverse x) == oneF

open Field

record HasCardinality (A : Set) (cardinality : Nat) : Set where
  field
    enumerate :
      Fin cardinality ->
      A
    index :
      A ->
      Fin cardinality
    enumerate-index :
      (x : A) ->
      enumerate (index x) == x
    index-enumerate :
      (i : Fin cardinality) ->
      index (enumerate i) == i

Vector : Set -> Nat -> Set
Vector F n =
  Fin n -> F

Matrix : Set -> Nat -> Set
Matrix F n =
  Fin n -> Fin n -> F

sumFin :
  {F : Set} ->
  Field F ->
  {n : Nat} ->
  (Fin n -> F) ->
  F
sumFin fieldStructure {zero} term =
  zeroF fieldStructure
sumFin fieldStructure {suc n} term =
  add fieldStructure
    (term fzero)
    (sumFin fieldStructure (\ i -> term (fsuc i)))

zeroVector :
  {F : Set} ->
  Field F ->
  {n : Nat} ->
  Vector F n
zeroVector fieldStructure i =
  zeroF fieldStructure

matrixVectorProduct :
  {F : Set} ->
  Field F ->
  {n : Nat} ->
  Matrix F n ->
  Vector F n ->
  Vector F n
matrixVectorProduct fieldStructure M x i =
  sumFin fieldStructure
    (\ j ->
      multiply fieldStructure (M i j) (x j))

affine :
  {F : Set} ->
  Field F ->
  {n : Nat} ->
  Matrix F n ->
  Vector F n ->
  Vector F n ->
  Vector F n
affine fieldStructure M v x i =
  add fieldStructure
    (v i)
    (matrixVectorProduct fieldStructure M x i)

iterate :
  {A : Set} ->
  Nat ->
  (A -> A) ->
  A ->
  A
iterate zero function x =
  x
iterate (suc count) function x =
  function (iterate count function x)

VectorEqual :
  {F : Set} ->
  {n : Nat} ->
  Vector F n ->
  Vector F n ->
  Set
VectorEqual {n = n} x y =
  (coordinate : Fin n) ->
  x coordinate == y coordinate

OrbitValue :
  {F : Set} ->
  Field F ->
  {n p : Nat} ->
  Matrix F n ->
  Vector F n ->
  Fin (power p n) ->
  Vector F n
OrbitValue fieldStructure M v step =
  iterate
    (suc (finToNat step))
    (affine fieldStructure M v)
    (zeroVector fieldStructure)

FullDistinctOrbit :
  {F : Set} ->
  Field F ->
  {n p : Nat} ->
  Matrix F n ->
  Vector F n ->
  Set
FullDistinctOrbit fieldStructure {n} {p} M v =
  Not
    (Exists (Fin (power p n))
      (\ i ->
        Exists (Fin (power p n))
          (\ j ->
            i != j
            and
            VectorEqual
              (OrbitValue fieldStructure M v i)
              (OrbitValue fieldStructure M v j))))

AdmissibleDimensions : Nat -> Nat -> Set
AdmissibleDimensions n p =
  n == oneN
  or
  (n == twoN and p == twoN)

putnam-2012-a5 : Set1
putnam-2012-a5 =
  (n p : Nat) ->
  Positive n ->
  Prime p ->
  (F : Set) ->
  (fieldStructure : Field F) ->
  HasCardinality F p ->
  AdmissibleDimensions n p
  iff
  Exists (Matrix F n)
    (\ M ->
      Exists (Vector F n)
        (\ v ->
          FullDistinctOrbit
            fieldStructure
            {n = n}
            {p = p}
            M
            v))

(*
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2012_a5:
  affine maps on n-dimensional vector spaces over a prime finite field have
  a full orbit of zero exactly in dimension one or in dimension two over the
  field of two elements. This file contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open arithmeticTheory dividesTheory pred_setTheory ringTheory;

val putnam_2012_a5 =
  ``!(r : 'a ring) (n p : num).
      let finite_field =
        \r : 'a ring.
          Ring r /\
          FINITE r.carrier /\
          (!x.
             x IN r.carrier /\ x <> r.sum.id
             ==>
             ?y.
               y IN r.carrier /\
               r.prod.op x y = r.prod.id /\
               r.prod.op y x = r.prod.id)
      in
      let zero_vector =
        \i : 'i. r.sum.id
      in
      let matrix_vector =
        \M : 'i -> 'i -> 'a.
        \x : 'i -> 'a.
        \i : 'i.
          ITSET
            (\j acc. r.sum.op (r.prod.op (M i j) (x j)) acc)
            (UNIV : 'i set)
            r.sum.id
      in
      let affine =
        \M : 'i -> 'i -> 'a.
        \v : 'i -> 'a.
        \x : 'i -> 'a.
        \i : 'i.
          r.sum.op (v i) (matrix_vector M x i)
      in
        finite_field r /\
        CARD r.carrier = p /\
        FINITE (UNIV : 'i set) /\
        CARD (UNIV : 'i set) = n /\
        0 < n /\
        prime p
        ==>
        ((n = 1 \/ (n = 2 /\ p = 2)) <=>
         ?M : 'i -> 'i -> 'a.
         ?v : 'i -> 'a.
           (!i j : 'i. M i j IN r.carrier) /\
           (!i : 'i. v i IN r.carrier) /\
           !k l : num.
             1 <= k /\
             k <= p ** n /\
             1 <= l /\
             l <= p ** n /\
             k <> l
             ==>
             FUNPOW (affine M v) k zero_vector <>
             FUNPOW (affine M v) l zero_vector)``;

title: putnam_2012_a5
content:
$(
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact
  putnam_2012_a5: classification of positive dimensions and prime field
  sizes admitting an affine map whose first p^n iterates of zero are all
  distinct. This file contains no proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  For positive n, the carrier 0 ..^ n is the n-element set corresponding
  to Fin n. P12A5Vectors n F is the full set of vectors over the field F,
  and Base ` ((0 ..^ n) Mat F) is the full set of n by n matrices over F.
  P12A5Affine n F M v is definitionally the map x |-> v + Mx, with matrix
  multiplication expanded as a finite sum in F.

  F remains an arbitrary finite field of cardinality p. IterComp is SetMM's
  native finite-iteration operator, and the map on 1 ... p^n sends k to the
  k-fold iterate of the affine map at the zero vector. Requiring this map to
  be one-to-one is exactly pairwise distinctness of those p^n vectors.

  The right side inlines the ground-truth solution set: n = 1 for arbitrary
  prime p, together with the exceptional pair n = p = 2. The final
  declaration is the single unproved $a corpus statement; this database
  contains no $p proof declaration.
$)

$c P12A5Vectors P12A5Affine $.

p12a5-vectors-syntax $a class ( P12A5Vectors n F ) $.
p12a5-affine-syntax $a class ( P12A5Affine n F M v ) $.

${
  p12a5-vectors-definition $a |- ( P12A5Vectors n F ) =
    (
      ( Base ` F )
      ^m
      ( 0 ..^ n )
    )
  $.
$}

${
  $d F M j n r v x $.

  p12a5-affine-definition $a |- ( P12A5Affine n F M v ) =
    (
      x e. ( P12A5Vectors n F ) |->
        (
          r e. ( 0 ..^ n ) |->
            (
              ( v ` r )
              ( +g ` F )
              (
                F
                gsum
                (
                  j e. ( 0 ..^ n ) |->
                    (
                      ( r M j )
                      ( .r ` F )
                      ( x ` j )
                    )
                )
              )
            )
        )
    )
  $.
$}

${
  $d F M k n p r v $.

  putnambench-putnam-2012-a5 $a |-
    A. n e. NN
      A. p e. Prime
        A. F
          (
            (
              F e. Field
              /\
              (
                ( Base ` F ) e. Fin
                /\
                ( # ` ( Base ` F ) ) = p
              )
            )
            ->
            (
              (
                E. M e. ( Base ` ( ( 0 ..^ n ) Mat F ) )
                  E. v e. ( P12A5Vectors n F )
                    (
                      k e. ( 1 ... ( p ^ n ) ) |->
                        (
                          (
                            (
                              IterComp
                              `
                              ( P12A5Affine n F M v )
                            )
                            `
                            k
                          )
                          `
                          (
                            r e. ( 0 ..^ n ) |->
                              ( 0g ` F )
                          )
                        )
                    )
                    :
                    ( 1 ... ( p ^ n ) )
                    -1-1->
                    ( P12A5Vectors n F )
              )
              <->
              (
                n = 1
                \/
                (
                  n = 2
                  /\
                  p = 2
                )
              )
            )
          )
  $.
$}
