title: putnam_2012_a5
content:
% Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2012_a5:
% affine maps on finite-dimensional vector spaces over prime fields have a
% full orbit from zero exactly in dimensions one, or two over F_2. This file
% contains no proof.

putnam_2012_a5: THEORY
BEGIN
  vector(n: posnat): TYPE = [below(n) -> nat]
  matrix(n: posnat): TYPE = [below(n), below(n) -> nat]

  nat_divides(divisor: posnat, value: nat): bool =
    EXISTS (quotient: nat):
      value = divisor * quotient

  prime_nat(value: nat): bool =
    value >= 2
      AND FORALL (divisor: posnat):
        nat_divides(divisor, value)
          IMPLIES divisor = 1 OR divisor = value

  valid_vector(n, p: posnat, x: vector(n)): bool =
    FORALL (coordinate: below(n)):
      x(coordinate) < p

  valid_matrix(n, p: posnat, M: matrix(n)): bool =
    FORALL (row, column: below(n)):
      M(row, column) < p

  modular_dot_sum(
      n, p: posnat,
      M: matrix(n),
      x: vector(n),
      row: below(n),
      count: nat): RECURSIVE nat =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      mod(
        modular_dot_sum(n, p, M, x, row, count - 1)
          + IF count <= n THEN
              M(row, count - 1) * x(count - 1)
            ELSE
              0
            ENDIF,
        p)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  zero_vector(n: posnat): vector(n) =
    LAMBDA (coordinate: below(n)): 0

  affine_apply(
      n, p: posnat,
      M: matrix(n),
      v, x: vector(n)): vector(n) =
    LAMBDA (row: below(n)):
      mod(v(row) + modular_dot_sum(n, p, M, x, row, n), p)

  affine_iterate(
      n, p: posnat,
      M: matrix(n),
      v: vector(n),
      count: nat): RECURSIVE vector(n) =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      zero_vector(n)
    ELSE
      affine_apply(
        n,
        p,
        M,
        v,
        affine_iterate(n, p, M, v, count - 1))
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  has_full_affine_orbit(n, p: posnat): bool =
    EXISTS (M: matrix(n)), (v: vector(n)):
      valid_matrix(n, p, M)
        AND valid_vector(n, p, v)
        AND (FORALL (i, j: nat):
          (1 <= i
            AND i <= p ^ n
            AND 1 <= j
            AND j <= p ^ n
            AND affine_iterate(n, p, M, v, i)
              = affine_iterate(n, p, M, v, j))
          IMPLIES i = j)

  putnam_2012_a5_solution(n, p: posnat): bool =
    n = 1 OR (n = 2 AND p = 2)

  putnam_2012_a5: bool =
    FORALL (n, p: posnat):
      prime_nat(p)
        IMPLIES
          (has_full_affine_orbit(n, p)
            IFF putnam_2012_a5_solution(n, p))
END putnam_2012_a5

import Mathlib

open Matrix Function

-- Note: this formalization differs from the original problem wording in only allowing axis-aligned rectangles. The problem is solvable given this weaker hypothesis.
abbrev putnam_2012_a6_solution : Prop := True
/--
Let $f(x,y)$ be a continuous, real-valued function on $\mathbb{R}^2$. Suppose that, for every rectangular region $R$ of area $1$, the double integral of $f(x,y)$ over $R$ equals $0$.
Must $f(x,y)$ be identically $0$?
-/
theorem putnam_2012_a6
(p : ((ℝ × ℝ) → ℝ) → Prop)
(hp : ∀ f, p f ↔
    Continuous f ∧
    ∀ x1 x2 y1 y2 : ℝ, x2 > x1 → y2 > y1
      → (x2 - x1) * (y2 - y1) = 1 → ∫ x in x1..x2, ∫ y in y1..y2, f (x, y) = 0)
: ((∀ f x y, p f → f (x, y) = 0) ↔ putnam_2012_a6_solution) :=
sorry

From mathcomp Require Import all_algebra all_ssreflect.
From mathcomp Require Import reals normedtype topology sequences measure lebesgue_measure lebesgue_integral.
From mathcomp Require Import classical_sets.
Import numFieldNormedType.Exports.

Set Implicit Arguments.
Unset Strict Implicit.
Unset Printing Implicit Defensive.

Local Open Scope ring_scope.
Local Open Scope classical_set_scope.

Variable R : realType.
Definition mu := [the measure _ _ of @lebesgue_measure R].
Definition putnam_2012_a6_solution : Prop := True.
Theorem putnam_2012_a6
    (p : ((R * R) -> R) -> Prop)
    (hp : forall f : (R * R) -> R, p f <->
        continuous f /\ forall x1 x2 y1 y2 : R, x2 > x1 -> y2 > y1 -> (x2 - x1) * (y2 - y1) = 1 ->
            \int[mu]_(x in [set x | x1 <= x <= x2]) (fun x' => \int[mu]_(y in [set y | y1 <= y <= y2]) f (x', y)) x = 0)
    : (forall f, forall x y, p f -> f (x, y) = 0) <-> putnam_2012_a6_solution.
Proof. Admitted.

let statement =

     \(f:(real#real)->real).
       !x y e:real.
         &0 < e
         ==> ?d:real.
               &0 < d /\
               !u v:real.
                 sqrt ((u - x) pow 2 + (v - y) pow 2) < d
                 ==> abs (f (u,v) - f (x,y)) < e in
   let putnam_2012_a6_solution = T in
   !p:((real#real)->real)->bool.

           ==>
           integral(x1,x2)
             (\x:real.
                integral(y1,y2)
                  (\y:real. f (x,y))) = &0))

title: putnam_2012_a6
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2012_a6:
;; every continuous real-valued function on the plane whose integral over each
;; axis-aligned rectangle of area one is zero is identically zero. This file
;; contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))

;; The context presents a Dedekind-complete ordered field, hence the real
;; field up to ordered-field isomorphism. Tame APPLY$ objects represent
;; arbitrary real functions, and DEFUN-SK keeps the function, points,
;; continuity radii, rectangle endpoints, and integral cutoffs internally
;; quantified. The double integrals are exact limits of unbounded uniform
;; right-endpoint Riemann sums, which agree with the source integrals for
;; continuous functions on compact rectangles.

(defun p12a6-member-p (carrier x)
  (if (apply$ carrier (list x)) t nil))

(defun p12a6-unary-value (operation x)
  (apply$ operation (list x)))

(defun p12a6-binary-value (operation x y)
  (apply$ operation (list x y)))

(defun p12a6-function-value (function x y)
  (apply$ function (list x y)))

(defun-sk p12a6-valid-set-p (carrier set)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (apply$ set (list x))
     (p12a6-member-p carrier x))))

(defun-sk p12a6-real-plane-function-p
    (carrier function)
  (forall (x y)
    (implies
     (and
      (p12a6-member-p carrier x)
      (p12a6-member-p carrier y))
     (p12a6-member-p
      carrier
      (p12a6-function-value function x y)))))

(defun-sk p12a6-field-laws-p
    (carrier add multiply negate inverse zero one)
  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (p12a6-member-p carrier x)
      (p12a6-member-p carrier y)
      (p12a6-member-p carrier z))
     (and
      (p12a6-member-p
       carrier (p12a6-binary-value add x y))
      (p12a6-member-p
       carrier (p12a6-binary-value multiply x y))
      (p12a6-member-p
       carrier (p12a6-unary-value negate x))
      (p12a6-member-p
       carrier (p12a6-unary-value inverse x))
      (equal
       (p12a6-binary-value
        add (p12a6-binary-value add x y) z)
       (p12a6-binary-value
        add x (p12a6-binary-value add y z)))
      (equal
       (p12a6-binary-value add x y)
       (p12a6-binary-value add y x))
      (equal (p12a6-binary-value add x zero) x)
      (equal
       (p12a6-binary-value
        add x (p12a6-unary-value negate x))
       zero)
      (equal
       (p12a6-binary-value
        multiply
        (p12a6-binary-value multiply x y)
        z)
       (p12a6-binary-value
        multiply
        x
        (p12a6-binary-value multiply y z)))
      (equal
       (p12a6-binary-value multiply x y)
       (p12a6-binary-value multiply y x))
      (equal
       (p12a6-binary-value multiply x one)
       x)
      (implies
       (equal x zero)
       (equal (p12a6-unary-value inverse x) zero))
      (implies
       (not (equal x zero))
       (equal
        (p12a6-binary-value
         multiply x (p12a6-unary-value inverse x))
        one))
      (equal
       (p12a6-binary-value
        multiply x (p12a6-binary-value add y z))
       (p12a6-binary-value
        add
        (p12a6-binary-value multiply x y)
        (p12a6-binary-value multiply x z)))))))

(defun-sk p12a6-order-laws-p
    (carrier add multiply zero less)
  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (p12a6-member-p carrier x)
      (p12a6-member-p carrier y)
      (p12a6-member-p carrier z))
     (and
      (not (p12a6-binary-value less x x))
      (or
       (equal x y)
       (p12a6-binary-value less x y)
       (p12a6-binary-value less y x))
      (implies
       (and
        (p12a6-binary-value less x y)
        (p12a6-binary-value less y z))
       (p12a6-binary-value less x z))
      (implies
       (p12a6-binary-value less x y)
       (p12a6-binary-value
        less
        (p12a6-binary-value add x z)
        (p12a6-binary-value add y z)))
      (implies
       (and
        (p12a6-binary-value less zero x)
        (p12a6-binary-value less zero y))
       (p12a6-binary-value
        less
        zero
        (p12a6-binary-value multiply x y)))))))

(defun-sk p12a6-set-nonempty-p (carrier set)
  (exists (x)
    (and
     (p12a6-member-p carrier x)
     (apply$ set (list x)))))

(defun-sk p12a6-upper-bound-p
    (carrier less set bound)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (and
      (p12a6-member-p carrier x)
      (apply$ set (list x)))
     (not
      (p12a6-binary-value less bound x)))))

(defun-sk p12a6-bounded-above-p
    (carrier less set)
  (exists (bound)
    (and
     (p12a6-member-p carrier bound)
     (p12a6-upper-bound-p
      carrier less set bound))))

(defun-sk p12a6-least-upper-bound-p
    (carrier less set supremum)
  (forall (bound)
    (implies
     (and
      (p12a6-member-p carrier bound)
      (p12a6-upper-bound-p
       carrier less set bound))
     (not
      (p12a6-binary-value
       less bound supremum)))))

(defun p12a6-supremum-p
    (carrier less set supremum)
  (and
   (p12a6-member-p carrier supremum)
   (p12a6-upper-bound-p
    carrier less set supremum)
   (p12a6-least-upper-bound-p
    carrier less set supremum)))

(defun-sk p12a6-has-supremum-p
    (carrier less set)
  (exists (supremum)
    (p12a6-supremum-p
     carrier less set supremum)))

(defun-sk p12a6-dedekind-complete-p
    (carrier less)
  (forall (set)
    (implies
     (and
      (tamep-functionp set)
      (p12a6-valid-set-p carrier set)
      (p12a6-set-nonempty-p carrier set)
      (p12a6-bounded-above-p carrier less set))
     (p12a6-has-supremum-p
      carrier less set))))

(defun p12a6-real-field-p
    (carrier add multiply negate inverse zero one less)
  (and
   (tamep-functionp carrier)
   (tamep-functionp add)
   (tamep-functionp multiply)
   (tamep-functionp negate)
   (tamep-functionp inverse)
   (tamep-functionp less)
   (p12a6-member-p carrier zero)
   (p12a6-member-p carrier one)
   (not (equal zero one))
   (p12a6-field-laws-p
    carrier add multiply negate inverse zero one)
   (p12a6-order-laws-p
    carrier add multiply zero less)
   (p12a6-binary-value less zero one)
   (p12a6-dedekind-complete-p carrier less)))

;; Real-field context and arithmetic.

(defun p12a6-r-carrier (ctx) (nth 0 ctx))
(defun p12a6-r-zero (ctx) (nth 1 ctx))
(defun p12a6-r-one (ctx) (nth 2 ctx))
(defun p12a6-r-add (ctx) (nth 3 ctx))
(defun p12a6-r-mul (ctx) (nth 4 ctx))
(defun p12a6-r-neg (ctx) (nth 5 ctx))
(defun p12a6-r-inv (ctx) (nth 6 ctx))
(defun p12a6-r-lt (ctx) (nth 7 ctx))

(defun p12a6-context-p (ctx)
  (and
   (true-listp ctx)
   (equal (len ctx) 8)
   (p12a6-real-field-p
    (p12a6-r-carrier ctx)
    (p12a6-r-add ctx)
    (p12a6-r-mul ctx)
    (p12a6-r-neg ctx)
    (p12a6-r-inv ctx)
    (p12a6-r-zero ctx)
    (p12a6-r-one ctx)
    (p12a6-r-lt ctx))))

(defun p12a6-r-add-value (ctx x y)
  (p12a6-binary-value (p12a6-r-add ctx) x y))

(defun p12a6-r-mul-value (ctx x y)
  (p12a6-binary-value (p12a6-r-mul ctx) x y))

(defun p12a6-r-neg-value (ctx x)
  (p12a6-unary-value (p12a6-r-neg ctx) x))

(defun p12a6-r-inv-value (ctx x)
  (p12a6-unary-value (p12a6-r-inv ctx) x))

(defun p12a6-r-sub-value (ctx x y)
  (p12a6-r-add-value
   ctx x (p12a6-r-neg-value ctx y)))

(defun p12a6-r-div-value (ctx x y)
  (p12a6-r-mul-value
   ctx x (p12a6-r-inv-value ctx y)))

(defun p12a6-r-lt-p (ctx x y)
  (if (p12a6-binary-value
       (p12a6-r-lt ctx) x y)
      t nil))

(defun p12a6-r-abs-value (ctx x)
  (if (p12a6-r-lt-p
       ctx x (p12a6-r-zero ctx))
      (p12a6-r-neg-value ctx x)
    x))

(defun p12a6-positive-real-p (ctx x)
  (and
   (p12a6-member-p (p12a6-r-carrier ctx) x)
   (p12a6-r-lt-p
    ctx (p12a6-r-zero ctx) x)))

(defun p12a6-nat-cast (ctx n)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix n)))
  (if (zp n)
      (p12a6-r-zero ctx)
    (p12a6-r-add-value
     ctx
     (p12a6-r-one ctx)
     (p12a6-nat-cast ctx (- n 1)))))

;; Epsilon-delta continuity for the product topology on the full plane.

(defun-sk p12a6-continuity-neighborhood-p
    (ctx function x y epsilon radius)
  (forall (u v)
    (implies
     (and
      (p12a6-member-p (p12a6-r-carrier ctx) u)
      (p12a6-member-p (p12a6-r-carrier ctx) v)
      (p12a6-r-lt-p
       ctx
       (p12a6-r-abs-value
        ctx (p12a6-r-sub-value ctx u x))
       radius)
      (p12a6-r-lt-p
       ctx
       (p12a6-r-abs-value
        ctx (p12a6-r-sub-value ctx v y))
       radius))
     (p12a6-r-lt-p
      ctx
      (p12a6-r-abs-value
       ctx
       (p12a6-r-sub-value
        ctx
        (p12a6-function-value function u v)
        (p12a6-function-value function x y)))
      epsilon))))

(defun-sk p12a6-continuity-radius-exists-p
    (ctx function x y epsilon)
  (exists (radius)
    (and
     (p12a6-positive-real-p ctx radius)
     (p12a6-continuity-neighborhood-p
      ctx function x y epsilon radius))))

(defun-sk p12a6-continuous-at-p
    (ctx function x y)
  (forall (epsilon)
    (implies
     (p12a6-positive-real-p ctx epsilon)
     (p12a6-continuity-radius-exists-p
      ctx function x y epsilon))))

(defun-sk p12a6-continuous-p (ctx function)
  (forall (x y)
    (implies
     (and
      (p12a6-member-p (p12a6-r-carrier ctx) x)
      (p12a6-member-p (p12a6-r-carrier ctx) y))
     (p12a6-continuous-at-p
      ctx function x y))))

(defun p12a6-admissible-function-p (ctx function)
  (and
   (tamep-functionp function)
   (p12a6-real-plane-function-p
    (p12a6-r-carrier ctx) function)
   (p12a6-continuous-p ctx function)))

;; Uniform right-endpoint double Riemann sums on [x1,x2] x [y1,y2].

(defun p12a6-row-sum
    (ctx function x1 y1 delta-x delta-y
         x-index remaining-y)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix remaining-y)))
  (if (zp remaining-y)
      (p12a6-r-zero ctx)
    (let* ((x
            (p12a6-r-add-value
             ctx x1
             (p12a6-r-mul-value
              ctx
              (p12a6-nat-cast ctx x-index)
              delta-x)))
           (y
            (p12a6-r-add-value
             ctx y1
             (p12a6-r-mul-value
              ctx
              (p12a6-nat-cast ctx remaining-y)
              delta-y))))
      (p12a6-r-add-value
       ctx
       (p12a6-function-value function x y)
       (p12a6-row-sum
        ctx function x1 y1 delta-x delta-y
        x-index (- remaining-y 1))))))

(defun p12a6-grid-sum
    (ctx function x1 y1 delta-x delta-y
         subdivisions remaining-x)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix remaining-x)))
  (if (zp remaining-x)
      (p12a6-r-zero ctx)
    (p12a6-r-add-value
     ctx
     (p12a6-row-sum
      ctx function x1 y1 delta-x delta-y
      remaining-x subdivisions)
     (p12a6-grid-sum
      ctx function x1 y1 delta-x delta-y
      subdivisions (- remaining-x 1)))))

(defun p12a6-integral-approx
    (ctx function x1 x2 y1 y2 subdivisions)
  (if (posp subdivisions)
      (let* ((denominator
              (p12a6-nat-cast ctx subdivisions))
             (delta-x
              (p12a6-r-div-value
               ctx
               (p12a6-r-sub-value ctx x2 x1)
               denominator))
             (delta-y
              (p12a6-r-div-value
               ctx
               (p12a6-r-sub-value ctx y2 y1)
               denominator))
             (sum
              (p12a6-grid-sum
               ctx function x1 y1 delta-x delta-y
               subdivisions subdivisions)))
        (p12a6-r-mul-value
         ctx
         (p12a6-r-mul-value ctx delta-x delta-y)
         sum))
    (p12a6-r-zero ctx)))

(defun-sk p12a6-integral-zero-tail-p
    (ctx function x1 x2 y1 y2 epsilon cutoff)
  (forall (subdivisions)
    (implies
     (and
      (posp subdivisions)
      (<= cutoff subdivisions))
     (p12a6-r-lt-p
      ctx
      (p12a6-r-abs-value
       ctx
       (p12a6-integral-approx
        ctx function x1 x2 y1 y2 subdivisions))
      epsilon))))

(defun-sk p12a6-integral-zero-cutoff-exists-p
    (ctx function x1 x2 y1 y2 epsilon)
  (exists (cutoff)
    (and
     (posp cutoff)
     (p12a6-integral-zero-tail-p
      ctx function x1 x2 y1 y2 epsilon cutoff))))

(defun-sk p12a6-integral-is-zero-p
    (ctx function x1 x2 y1 y2)
  (forall (epsilon)
    (implies
     (p12a6-positive-real-p ctx epsilon)
     (p12a6-integral-zero-cutoff-exists-p
      ctx function x1 x2 y1 y2 epsilon))))

(defun p12a6-unit-area-rectangle-p
    (ctx x1 x2 y1 y2)
  (and
   (p12a6-member-p (p12a6-r-carrier ctx) x1)
   (p12a6-member-p (p12a6-r-carrier ctx) x2)
   (p12a6-member-p (p12a6-r-carrier ctx) y1)
   (p12a6-member-p (p12a6-r-carrier ctx) y2)
   (p12a6-r-lt-p ctx x1 x2)
   (p12a6-r-lt-p ctx y1 y2)
   (equal
    (p12a6-r-mul-value
     ctx
     (p12a6-r-sub-value ctx x2 x1)
     (p12a6-r-sub-value ctx y2 y1))
    (p12a6-r-one ctx))))

(defun-sk p12a6-unit-rectangle-integrals-zero-p
    (ctx function)
  (forall (x1 x2 y1 y2)
    (implies
     (p12a6-unit-area-rectangle-p
      ctx x1 x2 y1 y2)
     (p12a6-integral-is-zero-p
      ctx function x1 x2 y1 y2))))

(defun-sk p12a6-identically-zero-p (ctx function)
  (forall (x y)
    (implies
     (and
      (p12a6-member-p (p12a6-r-carrier ctx) x)
      (p12a6-member-p (p12a6-r-carrier ctx) y))
     (equal
      (p12a6-function-value function x y)
      (p12a6-r-zero ctx)))))

;; The source predicate p and its defining equivalence are unfolded. Since the
;; published answer represented by putnam_2012_a6_solution is True, the source
;; biconditional is exactly this universally quantified implication.

(defun-sk p12a6-all-admissible-functions-zero-p (ctx)
  (forall (function)
    (implies
     (and
      (p12a6-admissible-function-p ctx function)
      (p12a6-unit-rectangle-integrals-zero-p
       ctx function))
     (p12a6-identically-zero-p ctx function))))

(defun putnambench-putnam-2012-a6-statement (ctx)
  (implies
   (p12a6-context-p ctx)
   (p12a6-all-admissible-functions-zero-p ctx)))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

title: putnam_2012_a6
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2012_a6
-- (putnambench__agda__putnam_2012_a6): a continuous real-valued function on
-- the plane whose integral over every axis-aligned rectangle of area one is
-- zero must vanish identically. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module Main where

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; _*_)

infix 4 _!=_ _<=N_
infixr 3 _and_
infixr 2 _or_

data Bottom : Set where

Not : Set -> Set
Not A =
  A -> Bottom

_!=_ : {A : Set} -> A -> A -> Set
x != y =
  Not (x == y)

record _and_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data _or_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  left  : A -> A or B
  right : B -> A or B

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

data _<=N_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set where
  zero<=N   : {n : Nat} -> zero <=N n
  suc<=sucN : {m n : Nat} -> m <=N n -> suc m <=N suc n

record CompleteOrderedRealField (R : Set) : Set1 where
  field
    zeroR oneR : R
    add multiply : R -> R -> R
    negate inverse : R -> R
    lessOrEqual : R -> R -> Set
    fromNat : Nat -> R

    one-not-zero :
      oneR != zeroR

    add-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> add x y == add y x
    add-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      add (add x y) z == add x (add y z)
    add-zero :
      (x : R) -> add x zeroR == x
    add-inverse :
      (x : R) -> add x (negate x) == zeroR

    multiply-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> multiply x y == multiply y x
    multiply-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply (multiply x y) z ==
      multiply x (multiply y z)
    multiply-one :
      (x : R) -> multiply x oneR == x
    multiply-zero :
      (x : R) -> multiply x zeroR == zeroR
    distribute :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply x (add y z) ==
      add (multiply x y) (multiply x z)
    inverse-zero :
      inverse zeroR == zeroR
    multiply-inverse :
      (x : R) ->
      x != zeroR ->
      multiply x (inverse x) == oneR

    order-reflexive :
      (x : R) -> lessOrEqual x x
    order-transitive :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y z ->
      lessOrEqual x z
    order-antisymmetric :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y x ->
      x == y
    order-total :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y or lessOrEqual y x
    add-order :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual (add z x) (add z y)
    multiply-nonnegative :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR x ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR y ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR (multiply x y)
    zero-less-than-one :
      lessOrEqual zeroR oneR and zeroR != oneR

    fromNat-zero :
      fromNat zero == zeroR
    fromNat-successor :
      (n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (suc n) == add (fromNat n) oneR
    fromNat-addition :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m + n) == add (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-multiplication :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m * n) == multiply (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-injective :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat m == fromNat n ->
      m == n

    archimedean :
      (x : R) ->
      Exists Nat (\ n -> lessOrEqual x (fromNat n))
    least-upper-bound :
      (P : R -> Set) ->
      Exists R P ->
      Exists R
        (\ upper ->
          (x : R) ->
          P x ->
          lessOrEqual x upper) ->
      Exists R
        (\ supremum ->
          ((x : R) ->
            P x ->
            lessOrEqual x supremum)
          and
          ((upper : R) ->
            ((x : R) ->
              P x ->
              lessOrEqual x upper) ->
            lessOrEqual supremum upper))

open CompleteOrderedRealField

twoN : Nat
twoN =
  suc (suc zero)

subtract :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
subtract reals x y =
  add reals x (negate reals y)

divide :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
divide reals x y =
  multiply reals x (inverse reals y)

StrictLess :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
StrictLess reals x y =
  lessOrEqual reals x y and x != y

CloseTo :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
CloseTo reals center radius x =
  StrictLess reals
    (subtract reals center radius)
    x
  and
  StrictLess reals
    x
    (add reals center radius)

CloseToPoint :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
CloseToPoint reals centerX centerY radius x y =
  CloseTo reals centerX radius x
  and
  CloseTo reals centerY radius y

ContinuousOnPlane :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (R -> R -> R) ->
  Set
ContinuousOnPlane {R} reals function =
  (x y epsilon : R) ->
  StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) epsilon ->
  Exists R
    (\ delta ->
      StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) delta
      and
      ((u v : R) ->
        CloseToPoint reals x y delta u v ->
        CloseTo reals
          (function x y)
          epsilon
          (function u v)))

sumFirst :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Nat ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  R
sumFirst reals zero term =
  zeroR reals
sumFirst reals (suc n) term =
  add reals
    (sumFirst reals n term)
    (term n)

ConvergesTo :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  R ->
  Set
ConvergesTo {R} reals sequence limit =
  (epsilon : R) ->
  StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) epsilon ->
  Exists Nat
    (\ cutoff ->
      (n : Nat) ->
      cutoff <=N n ->
      CloseTo reals limit epsilon (sequence n))

midpoint :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Nat ->
  Nat ->
  R
midpoint reals lower upper pieces index =
  let
    step =
      divide reals
        (subtract reals upper lower)
        (fromNat reals pieces)
    halfStep =
      divide reals
        step
        (fromNat reals twoN)
  in
  add reals lower
    (add reals
      (multiply reals
        (fromNat reals index)
        step)
      halfStep)

rectangleMidpointSum :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  (R -> R -> R) ->
  Nat ->
  R
rectangleMidpointSum reals xLower xUpper yLower yUpper function pieces =
  let
    xStep =
      divide reals
        (subtract reals xUpper xLower)
        (fromNat reals pieces)
    yStep =
      divide reals
        (subtract reals yUpper yLower)
        (fromNat reals pieces)
  in
  sumFirst reals pieces
    (\ i ->
      multiply reals
        (sumFirst reals pieces
          (\ j ->
            multiply reals
              (function
                (midpoint reals xLower xUpper pieces i)
                (midpoint reals yLower yUpper pieces j))
              yStep))
        xStep)

RectangleIntegralValue :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  (R -> R -> R) ->
  R ->
  Set
RectangleIntegralValue
  reals xLower xUpper yLower yUpper function value =
  ConvergesTo reals
    (\ n ->
      rectangleMidpointSum reals
        xLower
        xUpper
        yLower
        yUpper
        function
        (suc n))
    value

module Putnam2012A6Statement
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) where

  UnitAreaRectangleIntegralsVanish :
    (R -> R -> R) ->
    Set
  UnitAreaRectangleIntegralsVanish function =
    (xLower xUpper yLower yUpper : R) ->
    StrictLess reals xLower xUpper ->
    StrictLess reals yLower yUpper ->
    multiply reals
      (subtract reals xUpper xLower)
      (subtract reals yUpper yLower)
      == oneR reals ->
    RectangleIntegralValue reals
      xLower
      xUpper
      yLower
      yUpper
      function
      (zeroR reals)

  proposition : Set
  proposition =
    (function : R -> R -> R) ->
    ContinuousOnPlane reals function ->
    UnitAreaRectangleIntegralsVanish function ->
    (x y : R) ->
    function x y == zeroR reals

putnam-2012-a6 : Set1
putnam-2012-a6 =
  (R : Set) ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) ->
  Putnam2012A6Statement.proposition reals

title: putnam_2012_a6
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2012_a6:
  a continuous real function on the plane whose integral over every
  axis-aligned rectangle of area one is zero must vanish identically. This
  file contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open pairTheory pred_setTheory metricTheory topologyTheory realTheory;
open real_topologyTheory integrationTheory;

val putnam_2012_a6 =
  ``!p : (real # real -> real) -> bool.
      (!f : real # real -> real.
         p f <=>
         continuous_map (mtop mr2, euclidean) f /\
         !x1 x2 y1 y2 : real.
           x1 < x2 /\
           y1 < y2 /\
           (x2 - x1) * (y2 - y1) = 1
           ==>
           integration$integral (interval [x1, x2])
             (\x : real.
                integration$integral (interval [y1, y2])
                  (\y : real. f (x, y))) =
           0)
      ==>
      ((!f : real # real -> real.
          !x y : real.
            p f ==> f (x, y) = 0)
       <=>
       T)``;

$(
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact
  putnam_2012_a6: a continuous real-valued function on the real plane
  vanishes identically if its integral over every axis-aligned rectangle
  of area one is zero. This file contains no proof.

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  F ranges over all total real-valued functions on RR X. RR. Joint
  continuity is expanded in epsilon-delta form using coordinatewise
  neighborhoods, which induce the standard product topology.

  Set.mm's S. binder is the real Lebesgue integral. The nested integrals over

title: putnam_2012_a6
content:
% Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2012_a6:
% every continuous real-valued function on the real plane whose iterated
% integral vanishes on every axis-aligned rectangle of area one is identically
% zero. This file contains no proof.

putnam_2012_a6: THEORY
BEGIN
  point: TYPE = [# x_coord: real, y_coord: real #]
  plane_function: TYPE = [point -> real]
  real_function: TYPE = [real -> real]
  real_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> real]

  continuous_on_real_plane(f: plane_function): bool =
    FORALL (P: point), (epsilon_value: posreal):
      EXISTS (delta: posreal):
        FORALL (Q: point):
          (abs(x_coord(Q) - x_coord(P)) < delta
            AND abs(y_coord(Q) - y_coord(P)) < delta)
          IMPLIES
            abs(f(Q) - f(P)) < epsilon_value

  valid_tagged_partition(
      left, right: real,
      points, tags: real_sequence,
      count: nat): bool =
    count > 0
      AND points(0) = left
      AND points(count) = right
      AND FORALL (index: nat):
        index < count IMPLIES
          (points(index) < points(index + 1)
            AND points(index) <= tags(index)
            AND tags(index) <= points(index + 1))

  mesh_less_than(
      points: real_sequence,
      count: nat,
      bound: real): bool =
    FORALL (index: nat):
      index < count IMPLIES
        points(index + 1) - points(index) < bound

  riemann_sum(
      function_value: real_function,
      points, tags: real_sequence,
      count: nat): RECURSIVE real =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      riemann_sum(
        function_value, points, tags, count - 1)
        + function_value(tags(count - 1))
            * (points(count) - points(count - 1))
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  has_interval_integral(
      function_value: real_function,
      left, right, integral_value: real): bool =
    left < right
      AND FORALL (epsilon_value: posreal):
        EXISTS (mesh_bound: posreal):
          FORALL
              (points, tags: real_sequence),
              (count: nat):
            (valid_tagged_partition(
                left, right, points, tags, count)
              AND mesh_less_than(
                points, count, mesh_bound))
            IMPLIES
              abs(
                riemann_sum(
                  function_value, points, tags, count)
                  - integral_value)
                < epsilon_value

  zero_integral_on_rectangle(
      f: plane_function,
      x1, x2, y1, y2: real): bool =
    EXISTS (inner_integral: real_function):
      (FORALL (x: real):
        (x1 <= x AND x <= x2)
        IMPLIES
          has_interval_integral(
            LAMBDA (y: real):
              f((# x_coord := x, y_coord := y #)),
            y1,
            y2,
            inner_integral(x)))
        AND has_interval_integral(
          inner_integral,
          x1,
          x2,
          0)

  has_unit_rectangle_zero_integrals(
      f: plane_function): bool =
    FORALL (x1, x2, y1, y2: real):
      (x1 < x2
        AND y1 < y2
        AND (x2 - x1) * (y2 - y1) = 1)
      IMPLIES
        zero_integral_on_rectangle(
          f, x1, x2, y1, y2)

  putnam_2012_a6_solution: bool = TRUE

  putnam_2012_a6_statement: bool =
    (FORALL (f: plane_function):
      (continuous_on_real_plane(f)
        AND has_unit_rectangle_zero_integrals(f))
      IMPLIES
        (FORALL (P: point): f(P) = 0))
      IFF putnam_2012_a6_solution
END putnam_2012_a6

import Mathlib

open Matrix Function Real

/--
Let $S$ be a class of functions from $[0, \infty)$ to $[0, \infty)$ that satisfies:
\begin{itemize}
\item[(i)]
The functions $f_1(x) = e^x - 1$ and $f_2(x) = \ln(x+1)$ are in $S$;
\item[(ii)]
If $f(x)$ and $g(x)$ are in $S$, the functions $f(x) + g(x)$ and $f(g(x))$ are in $S$;
\item[(iii)]
If $f(x)$ and $g(x)$ are in $S$ and $f(x) \geq g(x)$ for all $x \geq 0$, then the function
$f(x) - g(x)$ is in $S$.
\end{itemize}
Prove that if $f(x)$ and $g(x)$ are in $S$, then the function $f(x) g(x)$ is also in $S$.
-/
theorem putnam_2012_b1
(S : Set (Set.Ici (0 : ℝ) → ℝ))
(rngS : ∀ f ∈ S, ∀ x : Set.Ici (0 : ℝ), f x ∈ Set.Ici (0 : ℝ))
(f1 : Set.Ici (0 : ℝ) → ℝ)
(hf1 : f1 = fun (x : Set.Ici (0 : ℝ)) ↦ exp x - 1)
(f2 : Set.Ici (0 : ℝ) → ℝ)
(hf2 : f2 = fun (x : Set.Ici (0 : ℝ)) ↦ Real.log (x + 1))
(hf1mem : f1 ∈ S)
(hf2mem : f2 ∈ S)
(hsum : ∀ f ∈ S, ∀ g ∈ S, (fun x ↦ (f x) + (g x)) ∈ S)
(hcomp : ∀ f ∈ S, ∀ g ∈ S, ∀ gnneg : Set.Ici (0 : ℝ) → Set.Ici (0 : ℝ), ((∀ x : Set.Ici (0 : ℝ), g x = gnneg x) → (fun x ↦ f (gnneg x)) ∈ S))
(hdiff : ∀ f ∈ S, ∀ g ∈ S, (∀ x : Set.Ici (0 : ℝ), f x ≥ g x) → (fun x ↦ (f x) - (g x)) ∈ S)
: (∀ f ∈ S, ∀ g ∈ S, (fun x ↦ (f x) * (g x)) ∈ S) :=
sorry

title: putnam_2012_b1

From mathcomp Require Import all_algebra all_ssreflect.
From mathcomp Require Import reals sequences exp topology.
From mathcomp Require Import classical_sets.

Set Implicit Arguments.
Unset Strict Implicit.
Unset Printing Implicit Defensive.

Local Open Scope ring_scope.

Variable R : realType.
Theorem putnam_2012_b1
    (S : set (R -> R))
    (hS : forall f : R -> R, f \in S -> forall x : R, 0 <= x -> 0 <= f x)
    (f1 : R -> R := fun x => expR x - 1)
    (f2 : R -> R := fun x => ln (x + 1))
    (hf1 : f1 \in S)
    (hf2 : f2 \in S)
    (hsum : forall f g : R -> R,
      f \in S -> g \in S ->
      exists h : R -> R,
        h \in S /\
        forall x : R, 0 <= x -> h x = f x + g x)
    (hcomp : forall f g : R -> R,
      f \in S -> g \in S ->
      exists h : R -> R,
        h \in S /\
        forall x : R, 0 <= x -> h x = f (g x))
    (hdiff : forall f g : R -> R,
      f \in S -> g \in S ->
      (forall x : R, 0 <= x -> f x >= g x) ->
      exists h : R -> R,
        h \in S /\
        forall x : R, 0 <= x -> h x = f x - g x)
    : forall f g : R -> R,
      f \in S -> g \in S ->
      exists h : R -> R,
        h \in S /\
        forall x : R, 0 <= x -> h x = f x * g x.
Proof. Admitted.

theory putnam_2012_b1 imports Complex_Main
begin

theorem putnam_2012_b1:
  fixes S :: "(real \<Rightarrow> real) set"
  (* Total representatives are identified by their values on the intended domain [0,\<infinity>). *)
  assumes Snonneg: "\<forall>f \<in> S. \<forall>x \<ge> 0. f x \<ge> 0"
    and Sext: "\<forall>f \<in> S. \<forall>g. (\<forall>x \<ge> 0. g x = f x) \<longrightarrow> g \<in> S"
    and f1: "(\<lambda>x. exp x - 1) \<in> S"
    and f2: "(\<lambda>x. ln (x + 1)) \<in> S"
    and hsum: "\<forall>f \<in> S. \<forall>g \<in> S. (\<lambda>x. f x + g x) \<in> S"
    and hcomp: "\<forall>f \<in> S. \<forall>g \<in> S. (\<lambda>x. f (g x)) \<in> S"
    and hdiff: "\<forall>f \<in> S. \<forall>g \<in> S.
      (\<forall>x \<ge> 0. f x \<ge> g x) \<longrightarrow> (\<lambda>x. f x - g x) \<in> S"
  shows "\<forall>f \<in> S. \<forall>g \<in> S. (\<lambda>x. f x * g x) \<in> S"
  sorry

end

title: putnam_2012_b1
putnam_2012_b1
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2012_b1:
;; a class of functions from the nonnegative reals to themselves that contains
;; exp(x)-1 and log(x+1) and is closed under addition, composition, and
;; nonnegative pointwise subtraction is closed under pointwise multiplication.
;; This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))

;; The context presents a Dedekind-complete ordered field, hence the real
;; field up to ordered-field isomorphism, together with its standard
;; exponential and logarithm. Tame APPLY$ objects represent arbitrary sets
;; and functions extensionally, while DEFUN-SK keeps every unbounded
;; mathematical quantifier internal to the statement.

(defun p12b1-member-p (carrier x)
  (if (apply$ carrier (list x)) t nil))

(defun p12b1-unary-value (function x)
  (apply$ function (list x)))

(defun p12b1-binary-value (function x y)
  (apply$ function (list x y)))

(defun-sk p12b1-valid-set-p (carrier set)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (apply$ set (list x))
     (p12b1-member-p carrier x))))

(defun-sk p12b1-real-function-p (carrier function)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (p12b1-member-p carrier x)
     (p12b1-member-p
      carrier
      (p12b1-unary-value function x)))))

(defun-sk p12b1-field-laws-p
    (carrier add multiply negate inverse zero one)
  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (p12b1-member-p carrier x)
      (p12b1-member-p carrier y)
      (p12b1-member-p carrier z))
     (and
      (p12b1-member-p carrier
                      (p12b1-binary-value add x y))
      (p12b1-member-p carrier
                      (p12b1-binary-value multiply x y))
      (p12b1-member-p carrier
                      (p12b1-unary-value negate x))
      (p12b1-member-p carrier
                      (p12b1-unary-value inverse x))
      (equal
       (p12b1-binary-value
        add (p12b1-binary-value add x y) z)
       (p12b1-binary-value
        add x (p12b1-binary-value add y z)))
      (equal
       (p12b1-binary-value add x y)
       (p12b1-binary-value add y x))
      (equal (p12b1-binary-value add x zero) x)
      (equal
       (p12b1-binary-value
        add x (p12b1-unary-value negate x))
       zero)
      (equal
       (p12b1-binary-value
        multiply (p12b1-binary-value multiply x y) z)
       (p12b1-binary-value
        multiply x (p12b1-binary-value multiply y z)))
      (equal
       (p12b1-binary-value multiply x y)
       (p12b1-binary-value multiply y x))
      (equal (p12b1-binary-value multiply x one) x)
      (implies
       (equal x zero)
       (equal (p12b1-unary-value inverse x) zero))
      (implies
       (not (equal x zero))
       (equal
        (p12b1-binary-value
         multiply x (p12b1-unary-value inverse x))
        one))
      (equal
       (p12b1-binary-value
        multiply x (p12b1-binary-value add y z))
       (p12b1-binary-value
        add
        (p12b1-binary-value multiply x y)
        (p12b1-binary-value multiply x z)))))))

(defun-sk p12b1-order-laws-p
    (carrier add multiply zero less)
  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (p12b1-member-p carrier x)
      (p12b1-member-p carrier y)
      (p12b1-member-p carrier z))
     (and
      (not (p12b1-binary-value less x x))
      (or
       (equal x y)
       (p12b1-binary-value less x y)
       (p12b1-binary-value less y x))
      (implies
       (and
        (p12b1-binary-value less x y)
        (p12b1-binary-value less y z))
       (p12b1-binary-value less x z))
      (implies
       (p12b1-binary-value less x y)
       (p12b1-binary-value
        less
        (p12b1-binary-value add x z)
        (p12b1-binary-value add y z)))
      (implies
       (and
        (p12b1-binary-value less zero x)
        (p12b1-binary-value less zero y))
       (p12b1-binary-value
        less zero (p12b1-binary-value multiply x y)))))))

(defun-sk p12b1-set-nonempty-p (carrier set)
  (exists (x)
    (and
     (p12b1-member-p carrier x)
     (apply$ set (list x)))))

(defun-sk p12b1-upper-bound-p
    (carrier less set bound)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (and
      (p12b1-member-p carrier x)
      (apply$ set (list x)))
     (not (p12b1-binary-value less bound x)))))

(defun-sk p12b1-bounded-above-p
    (carrier less set)
  (exists (bound)
    (and
     (p12b1-member-p carrier bound)
     (p12b1-upper-bound-p
      carrier less set bound))))

(defun-sk p12b1-least-upper-bound-p
    (carrier less set supremum)
  (forall (bound)
    (implies
     (and
      (p12b1-member-p carrier bound)
      (p12b1-upper-bound-p carrier less set bound))
     (not (p12b1-binary-value less bound supremum)))))

(defun p12b1-supremum-p
    (carrier less set supremum)
  (and
   (p12b1-member-p carrier supremum)
   (p12b1-upper-bound-p carrier less set supremum)
   (p12b1-least-upper-bound-p
    carrier less set supremum)))

(defun-sk p12b1-has-supremum-p
    (carrier less set)
  (exists (supremum)
    (p12b1-supremum-p
     carrier less set supremum)))

(defun-sk p12b1-dedekind-complete-p
    (carrier less)
  (forall (set)
    (implies
     (and
      (tamep-functionp set)
      (p12b1-valid-set-p carrier set)
      (p12b1-set-nonempty-p carrier set)
      (p12b1-bounded-above-p carrier less set))
     (p12b1-has-supremum-p carrier less set))))

(defun p12b1-real-field-p
    (carrier zero one add multiply negate inverse less)
  (and
   (tamep-functionp carrier)
   (tamep-functionp add)
   (tamep-functionp multiply)
   (tamep-functionp negate)
   (tamep-functionp inverse)
   (tamep-functionp less)
   (p12b1-member-p carrier zero)
   (p12b1-member-p carrier one)
   (not (equal zero one))
   (p12b1-field-laws-p
    carrier add multiply negate inverse zero one)
   (p12b1-order-laws-p
    carrier add multiply zero less)
   (p12b1-binary-value less zero one)
   (p12b1-dedekind-complete-p carrier less)))

;; The outer context is (field-context exponential logarithm).

(defun p12b1-field-context (ctx)
  (nth 0 ctx))

(defun p12b1-r-carrier (ctx)
  (nth 0 (p12b1-field-context ctx)))

(defun p12b1-r-zero (ctx)
  (nth 1 (p12b1-field-context ctx)))

(defun p12b1-r-one (ctx)
  (nth 2 (p12b1-field-context ctx)))

(defun p12b1-r-add (ctx)
  (nth 3 (p12b1-field-context ctx)))

(defun p12b1-r-mul (ctx)
  (nth 4 (p12b1-field-context ctx)))

(defun p12b1-r-neg (ctx)
  (nth 5 (p12b1-field-context ctx)))

(defun p12b1-r-inv (ctx)
  (nth 6 (p12b1-field-context ctx)))

(defun p12b1-r-lt (ctx)
  (nth 7 (p12b1-field-context ctx)))

(defun p12b1-r-exp (ctx)
  (nth 1 ctx))

(defun p12b1-r-log (ctx)
  (nth 2 ctx))

(defun p12b1-field-context-p (field-context)
  (and
   (true-listp field-context)
   (equal (len field-context) 8)
   (p12b1-real-field-p
    (nth 0 field-context)
    (nth 1 field-context)
    (nth 2 field-context)
    (nth 3 field-context)
    (nth 4 field-context)
    (nth 5 field-context)
    (nth 6 field-context)
    (nth 7 field-context))))

(defun p12b1-r-add-value (ctx x y)
  (p12b1-binary-value (p12b1-r-add ctx) x y))

(defun p12b1-r-neg-value (ctx x)
  (p12b1-unary-value (p12b1-r-neg ctx) x))

(defun p12b1-r-sub-value (ctx x y)
  (p12b1-r-add-value
   ctx x (p12b1-r-neg-value ctx y)))

(defun p12b1-r-mul-value (ctx x y)
  (p12b1-binary-value (p12b1-r-mul ctx) x y))

(defun p12b1-r-inv-value (ctx x)
  (p12b1-unary-value (p12b1-r-inv ctx) x))

(defun p12b1-r-div-value (ctx numerator denominator)
  (p12b1-r-mul-value
   ctx numerator (p12b1-r-inv-value ctx denominator)))

(defun p12b1-r-lt-p (ctx x y)
  (if (p12b1-binary-value (p12b1-r-lt ctx) x y)
      t nil))

(defun p12b1-r-le-p (ctx x y)
  (not (p12b1-r-lt-p ctx y x)))

(defun p12b1-r-abs-value (ctx x)
  (if (p12b1-r-lt-p ctx x (p12b1-r-zero ctx))
      (p12b1-r-neg-value ctx x)
    x))

(defun p12b1-positive-real-p (ctx x)
  (and
   (p12b1-member-p (p12b1-r-carrier ctx) x)
   (p12b1-r-lt-p ctx (p12b1-r-zero ctx) x)))

;; HasDerivAt in epsilon-delta form:
;; |f(y)-f(x)-d*(y-x)| <= epsilon*|y-x| near x.

(defun-sk p12b1-derivative-neighborhood-p
    (ctx function derivative x epsilon radius)
  (forall (y)
    (implies
     (and
      (p12b1-member-p (p12b1-r-carrier ctx) y)
      (p12b1-r-lt-p
       ctx
       (p12b1-r-abs-value
        ctx (p12b1-r-sub-value ctx y x))
       radius))
     (p12b1-r-le-p
      ctx
      (p12b1-r-abs-value
       ctx
       (p12b1-r-sub-value
        ctx
        (p12b1-r-sub-value
         ctx
         (p12b1-unary-value function y)
         (p12b1-unary-value function x))
        (p12b1-r-mul-value
         ctx derivative
         (p12b1-r-sub-value ctx y x))))
      (p12b1-r-mul-value
       ctx epsilon
       (p12b1-r-abs-value
        ctx (p12b1-r-sub-value ctx y x)))))))

(defun-sk p12b1-derivative-radius-exists-p
    (ctx function derivative x epsilon)
  (exists (radius)
    (and
     (p12b1-positive-real-p ctx radius)
     (p12b1-derivative-neighborhood-p
      ctx function derivative x epsilon radius))))

(defun-sk p12b1-derivative-epsilon-p
    (ctx function derivative x)
  (forall (epsilon)
    (implies
     (p12b1-positive-real-p ctx epsilon)
     (p12b1-derivative-radius-exists-p
      ctx function derivative x epsilon))))

(defun p12b1-has-derivative-at-p
    (ctx function derivative x)
  (and
   (p12b1-member-p (p12b1-r-carrier ctx) derivative)
   (p12b1-member-p (p12b1-r-carrier ctx) x)
   (p12b1-derivative-epsilon-p
    ctx function derivative x)))

(defun-sk p12b1-derivative-exists-at-p
    (ctx function x)
  (exists (derivative)
    (p12b1-has-derivative-at-p
     ctx function derivative x)))

(defun-sk p12b1-differentiable-on-positive-p
    (ctx function)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (p12b1-positive-real-p ctx x)
     (p12b1-derivative-exists-at-p
      ctx function x))))

;; The differential initial-value problem E' = E, E(0) = 1 characterizes the
;; standard real exponential. LOG is its inverse on the positive reals.

(defun-sk p12b1-exponential-laws-p (ctx)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (p12b1-member-p (p12b1-r-carrier ctx) x)
     (and
      (p12b1-positive-real-p
       ctx (p12b1-unary-value (p12b1-r-exp ctx) x))
      (p12b1-has-derivative-at-p
       ctx
       (p12b1-r-exp ctx)
       (p12b1-unary-value (p12b1-r-exp ctx) x)
       x)))))

(defun p12b1-exponential-function-p (ctx)
  (and
   (tamep-functionp (p12b1-r-exp ctx))
   (p12b1-real-function-p
    (p12b1-r-carrier ctx) (p12b1-r-exp ctx))
   (equal
    (p12b1-unary-value
     (p12b1-r-exp ctx) (p12b1-r-zero ctx))
    (p12b1-r-one ctx))
   (p12b1-exponential-laws-p ctx)))

(defun-sk p12b1-logarithm-laws-p (ctx)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (p12b1-member-p (p12b1-r-carrier ctx) x)
     (and
      (equal
       (p12b1-unary-value
        (p12b1-r-log ctx)
        (p12b1-unary-value (p12b1-r-exp ctx) x))
       x)
      (implies
       (p12b1-positive-real-p ctx x)
       (equal
        (p12b1-unary-value
         (p12b1-r-exp ctx)
         (p12b1-unary-value (p12b1-r-log ctx) x))
        x))))))

(defun p12b1-logarithm-function-p (ctx)
  (and
   (tamep-functionp (p12b1-r-log ctx))
   (p12b1-real-function-p
    (p12b1-r-carrier ctx) (p12b1-r-log ctx))
   (p12b1-logarithm-laws-p ctx)))

(defun p12b1-context-p (ctx)
  (and
   (true-listp ctx)
   (equal (len ctx) 3)
   (p12b1-field-context-p (p12b1-field-context ctx))
   (p12b1-exponential-function-p ctx)
   (p12b1-logarithm-function-p ctx)))

;; Function objects on the nonnegative reals.

(defun p12b1-quoted (object)
  (list 'quote object))

(defun p12b1-term-list (terms)
  (if (consp terms)
      (list
       'cons
       (car terms)
       (p12b1-term-list (cdr terms)))
    (p12b1-quoted nil)))

(defun p12b1-static-apply-term (function arguments)
  (list
   'apply$
   (p12b1-quoted function)
   (p12b1-term-list arguments)))

(defun p12b1-nonnegative-real-p (ctx value)
  (and
   (p12b1-member-p (p12b1-r-carrier ctx) value)
   (p12b1-r-le-p ctx (p12b1-r-zero ctx) value)))

(defun-sk p12b1-nonnegative-function-values-p
    (ctx function)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (p12b1-nonnegative-real-p ctx x)
     (p12b1-nonnegative-real-p
      ctx
      (p12b1-unary-value function x)))))

(defun p12b1-nonnegative-function-p (ctx function)
  (and
   (tamep-functionp function)
   (p12b1-nonnegative-function-values-p
    ctx function)))

(defun-sk p12b1-functions-agree-p
    (ctx left right)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (p12b1-nonnegative-real-p ctx x)
     (equal
      (p12b1-unary-value left x)
      (p12b1-unary-value right x)))))

(defun p12b1-class-member-p (class function)
  (if (apply$ class (list function)) t nil))

(defun-sk p12b1-class-values-valid-p (ctx class)
  (forall (function)
    (implies
     (p12b1-class-member-p class function)
     (p12b1-nonnegative-function-p
      ctx function))))

(defun-sk p12b1-class-extensional-p (ctx class)
  (forall (left right)
    (implies
     (and
      (p12b1-nonnegative-function-p ctx left)
      (p12b1-nonnegative-function-p ctx right)
      (p12b1-functions-agree-p ctx left right))
     (equal
      (p12b1-class-member-p class left)
      (p12b1-class-member-p class right)))))

;; Exact pointwise function constructors.

(defun p12b1-f1-function (ctx)
  (list
   'lambda
   '(x)
   (p12b1-static-apply-term
    (p12b1-r-add ctx)
    (list
     (p12b1-static-apply-term
      (p12b1-r-exp ctx) '(x))
     (p12b1-static-apply-term
      (p12b1-r-neg ctx)
      (list
       (p12b1-quoted (p12b1-r-one ctx))))))))

(defun p12b1-f2-function (ctx)
  (list
   'lambda
   '(x)
   (p12b1-static-apply-term
    (p12b1-r-log ctx)
    (list
     (p12b1-static-apply-term
      (p12b1-r-add ctx)
      (list
       'x
       (p12b1-quoted (p12b1-r-one ctx))))))))

(defun p12b1-sum-function (ctx left right)
  (list
   'lambda
   '(x)
   (p12b1-static-apply-term
    (p12b1-r-add ctx)
    (list
     (p12b1-static-apply-term left '(x))
     (p12b1-static-apply-term right '(x))))))

(defun p12b1-compose-function (outer inner)
  (list
   'lambda
   '(x)
   (p12b1-static-apply-term
    outer
    (list
     (p12b1-static-apply-term inner '(x))))))

(defun p12b1-difference-function (ctx left right)
  (list
   'lambda
   '(x)
   (p12b1-static-apply-term
    (p12b1-r-add ctx)
    (list
     (p12b1-static-apply-term left '(x))
     (p12b1-static-apply-term
      (p12b1-r-neg ctx)
      (list
       (p12b1-static-apply-term right '(x))))))))

(defun p12b1-product-function (ctx left right)
  (list
   'lambda
   '(x)
   (p12b1-static-apply-term
    (p12b1-r-mul ctx)
    (list
     (p12b1-static-apply-term left '(x))
     (p12b1-static-apply-term right '(x))))))

;; The class hypotheses and desired closure property.

(defun-sk p12b1-addition-closed-p (ctx class)
  (forall (left right)
    (implies
     (and
      (p12b1-class-member-p class left)
      (p12b1-class-member-p class right))
     (p12b1-class-member-p
      class
      (p12b1-sum-function ctx left right)))))

(defun-sk p12b1-composition-closed-p (class)
  (forall (outer inner)
    (implies
     (and
      (p12b1-class-member-p class outer)
      (p12b1-class-member-p class inner))
     (p12b1-class-member-p
      class
      (p12b1-compose-function outer inner)))))

(defun-sk p12b1-pointwise-dominates-p
    (ctx left right)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (p12b1-nonnegative-real-p ctx x)
     (p12b1-r-le-p
      ctx
      (p12b1-unary-value right x)
      (p12b1-unary-value left x)))))

(defun-sk p12b1-subtraction-closed-p (ctx class)
  (forall (left right)
    (implies
     (and
      (p12b1-class-member-p class left)
      (p12b1-class-member-p class right)
      (p12b1-pointwise-dominates-p
       ctx left right))
     (p12b1-class-member-p
      class
      (p12b1-difference-function
       ctx left right)))))

(defun-sk p12b1-multiplication-closed-p (ctx class)
  (forall (left right)
    (implies
     (and
      (p12b1-class-member-p class left)
      (p12b1-class-member-p class right))
     (p12b1-class-member-p
      class
      (p12b1-product-function
       ctx left right)))))

(defun putnambench-putnam-2012-b1-statement (ctx class)
  (implies
   (and
    (p12b1-context-p ctx)
    (tamep-functionp class)
    (p12b1-class-values-valid-p ctx class)
    (p12b1-class-extensional-p ctx class)
    (p12b1-class-member-p
     class (p12b1-f1-function ctx))
    (p12b1-class-member-p
     class (p12b1-f2-function ctx))
    (p12b1-addition-closed-p ctx class)
    (p12b1-composition-closed-p class)
    (p12b1-subtraction-closed-p ctx class))
   (p12b1-multiplication-closed-p
    ctx class)))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

title: putnam_2012_b1
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2012_b1
-- (putnambench__agda__putnam_2012_b1): closure under pointwise multiplication
-- for a class of nonnegative-real functions containing exp(x) - 1 and
-- log(x + 1) and closed under addition, composition, and ordered subtraction.
-- This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module Main where

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; _*_)

infix 4 _!=_ _<=N_
infixr 3 _and_
infixr 2 _or_

data Bottom : Set where

Not : Set -> Set
Not A =
  A -> Bottom

_!=_ : {A : Set} -> A -> A -> Set
x != y =
  Not (x == y)

record _and_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data _or_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  left  : A -> A or B
  right : B -> A or B

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

data _<=N_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set where
  zero<=N   : {n : Nat} -> zero <=N n
  suc<=sucN : {m n : Nat} -> m <=N n -> suc m <=N suc n

record CompleteOrderedRealField (R : Set) : Set1 where
  field
    zeroR oneR : R
    add multiply : R -> R -> R
    negate inverse : R -> R
    lessOrEqual : R -> R -> Set
    fromNat : Nat -> R

    one-not-zero :
      oneR != zeroR

    add-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> add x y == add y x
    add-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      add (add x y) z == add x (add y z)
    add-zero :
      (x : R) -> add x zeroR == x
    add-inverse :
      (x : R) -> add x (negate x) == zeroR

    multiply-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> multiply x y == multiply y x
    multiply-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply (multiply x y) z ==
      multiply x (multiply y z)
    multiply-one :
      (x : R) -> multiply x oneR == x
    multiply-zero :
      (x : R) -> multiply x zeroR == zeroR
    distribute :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply x (add y z) ==
      add (multiply x y) (multiply x z)
    inverse-zero :
      inverse zeroR == zeroR
    multiply-inverse :
      (x : R) ->
      x != zeroR ->
      multiply x (inverse x) == oneR

    order-reflexive :
      (x : R) -> lessOrEqual x x
    order-transitive :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y z ->
      lessOrEqual x z
    order-antisymmetric :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y x ->
      x == y
    order-total :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y or lessOrEqual y x
    order-proof-irrelevant :
      {x y : R} ->
      (p q : lessOrEqual x y) ->
      p == q
    add-order :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual (add z x) (add z y)
    multiply-nonnegative :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR x ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR y ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR (multiply x y)
    zero-less-than-one :
      lessOrEqual zeroR oneR and zeroR != oneR

    fromNat-zero :
      fromNat zero == zeroR
    fromNat-successor :
      (n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (suc n) == add (fromNat n) oneR
    fromNat-addition :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m + n) == add (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-multiplication :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m * n) == multiply (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-injective :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat m == fromNat n ->
      m == n

    archimedean :
      (x : R) ->
      Exists Nat
        (\ n ->
          lessOrEqual x (fromNat n))
    least-upper-bound :
      (P : R -> Set) ->
      Exists R P ->
      Exists R
        (\ upper ->
          (x : R) ->
          P x ->
          lessOrEqual x upper) ->
      Exists R
        (\ supremum ->
          ((x : R) ->
            P x ->
            lessOrEqual x supremum)
          and
          ((upper : R) ->
            ((x : R) ->
              P x ->
              lessOrEqual x upper) ->
            lessOrEqual supremum upper))

open CompleteOrderedRealField

subtract :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
subtract reals x y =
  add reals x (negate reals y)

StrictLess :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
StrictLess reals x y =
  lessOrEqual reals x y and x != y

CloseTo :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
CloseTo reals center radius x =
  StrictLess reals
    (subtract reals center radius)
    x
  and
  StrictLess reals
    x
    (add reals center radius)

naturalPower :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  Nat ->
  R
naturalPower reals x zero =
  oneR reals
naturalPower reals x (suc n) =
  multiply reals
    (naturalPower reals x n)
    x

factorial : Nat -> Nat
factorial zero =
  suc zero
factorial (suc n) =
  suc n * factorial n

sumFirst :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Nat ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  R
sumFirst reals zero term =
  zeroR reals
sumFirst reals (suc n) term =
  add reals
    (sumFirst reals n term)
    (term n)

ConvergesTo :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  R ->
  Set
ConvergesTo {R} reals sequence limit =
  (epsilon : R) ->
  StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) epsilon ->
  Exists Nat
    (\ cutoff ->
      (n : Nat) ->
      cutoff <=N n ->
      CloseTo reals limit epsilon (sequence n))

SeriesHasSum :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  R ->
  Set
SeriesHasSum reals terms limit =
  ConvergesTo reals
    (\ n -> sumFirst reals n terms)
    limit

exponentialTerm :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  Nat ->
  R
exponentialTerm reals x n =
  multiply reals
    (naturalPower reals x n)
    (inverse reals (fromNat reals (factorial n)))

ExponentialValue :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
ExponentialValue reals x value =
  SeriesHasSum reals
    (exponentialTerm reals x)
    value

record StandardExponentialLogarithm
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) :
  Set1 where

  field
    exponential logarithm : R -> R

    exponential-series :
      (x : R) ->
      ExponentialValue reals x (exponential x)

    exponential-positive :
      (x : R) ->
      StrictLess reals
        (zeroR reals)
        (exponential x)

    exponential-injective :
      (x y : R) ->
      exponential x == exponential y ->
      x == y

    exponential-logarithm :
      (x : R) ->
      StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) x ->
      exponential (logarithm x) == x

    logarithm-exponential :
      (x : R) ->
      logarithm (exponential x) == x

open StandardExponentialLogarithm

record NonnegativeReal
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) :
  Set where
  constructor nonnegative-real
  field
    real-value :
      R
    is-nonnegative :
      lessOrEqual reals (zeroR reals) real-value

open NonnegativeReal

module Putnam2012B1Statement
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R)
  (analysis : StandardExponentialLogarithm reals) where

  Domain : Set
  Domain =
    NonnegativeReal reals

  Function : Set
  Function =
    Domain -> R

  PointwiseNonnegative : Function -> Set
  PointwiseNonnegative function =
    (x : Domain) ->
    lessOrEqual reals
      (zeroR reals)
      (function x)

  firstGenerator : Function
  firstGenerator x =
    subtract reals
      (exponential analysis (real-value x))
      (oneR reals)

  secondGenerator : Function
  secondGenerator x =
    logarithm analysis
      (add reals
        (real-value x)
        (oneR reals))

  proposition : Set1
  proposition =
    (S : Function -> Set) ->
    ((function : Function) ->
      S function ->
      PointwiseNonnegative function) ->
    S firstGenerator ->
    S secondGenerator ->
    ((f g : Function) ->
      S f ->
      S g ->
      S (\ x -> add reals (f x) (g x))) ->
    ((f g : Function) ->
      S f ->
      S g ->
      (nonnegative-g : Domain -> Domain) ->
      ((x : Domain) ->
        g x == real-value (nonnegative-g x)) ->
      S (\ x -> f (nonnegative-g x))) ->
    ((f g : Function) ->
      S f ->
      S g ->
      ((x : Domain) ->
        lessOrEqual reals (g x) (f x)) ->
      S (\ x -> subtract reals (f x) (g x))) ->
    (f g : Function) ->
    S f ->
    S g ->
    S (\ x -> multiply reals (f x) (g x))

putnam-2012-b1 : Set1
putnam-2012-b1 =
  (R : Set) ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) ->
  (analysis : StandardExponentialLogarithm reals) ->
  Putnam2012B1Statement.proposition reals analysis

title: putnam_2012_b1
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2012_b1:
  closure under pointwise multiplication for a class of functions from the
  nonnegative reals to themselves containing exp(x) - 1 and ln(x + 1), and
  closed under sum, composition, and nonnegative difference. This file
  contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open pairTheory realTheory transcTheory;

val putnam_2012_b1 =
  ``!S : ((real # real) -> bool) -> bool.
      let nnfun =
        \r : (real # real) -> bool.
          (!x y : real.
             r (x, y) ==> 0 <= x /\ 0 <= y) /\
          (!x : real.
             0 <= x
             ==>
             ?y : real.
               r (x, y) /\
               !z : real. r (x, z) ==> z = y)
      in
      let f1 =
        \p : real # real.
          0 <= FST p /\ SND p = exp (FST p) - 1
      in
      let f2 =
        \p : real # real.
          0 <= FST p /\ SND p = ln (FST p + 1)
      in
      let sum_graph =
        \r : (real # real) -> bool.
        \s : (real # real) -> bool.
        \p : real # real.
          ?a b : real.
            r (FST p, a) /\
            s (FST p, b) /\
            SND p = a + b
      in
      let compose_graph =
        \r : (real # real) -> bool.
        \s : (real # real) -> bool.
        \p : real # real.
          ?a : real.
            s (FST p, a) /\
            r (a, SND p)
      in
      let difference_admissible =
        \r : (real # real) -> bool.
        \s : (real # real) -> bool.
          !x a b : real.
            r (x, a) /\ s (x, b) ==> b <= a
      in
      let difference_graph =
        \r : (real # real) -> bool.
        \s : (real # real) -> bool.
        \p : real # real.
          ?a b : real.
            r (FST p, a) /\
            s (FST p, b) /\
            SND p = a - b
      in
      let product_graph =
        \r : (real # real) -> bool.
        \s : (real # real) -> bool.
        \p : real # real.
          ?a b : real.

title: putnam_2012_b1
content:
% Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2012_b1:
% a class of nonnegative-real functions containing exp(x) - 1 and ln(x + 1)
% and closed under addition, composition, and nonnegative difference is closed
% under pointwise multiplication. This file contains no proof.

putnam_2012_b1: THEORY
BEGIN
  real_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> real]
  nonnegative_real: TYPE = {x: real | x >= 0}
  nonnegative_function: TYPE =
    [nonnegative_real -> nonnegative_real]
  function_class: TYPE = [nonnegative_function -> bool]

  safe_div(numerator, denominator: real): real =
    IF denominator = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      numerator / denominator
    ENDIF

  nat_factorial(index: nat): RECURSIVE nat =
    IF index = 0 THEN
      1
    ELSE
      index * nat_factorial(index - 1)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE index

  exponential_partial(x: real, count: nat): RECURSIVE real =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      LET index: nat = count - 1 IN
        exponential_partial(x, count - 1)
          + safe_div(
              x ^ index,
              nat_factorial(index) :: real)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  converges_to(sequence: real_sequence, value: real): bool =
    FORALL (epsilon_value: posreal):
      EXISTS (cutoff: nat):
        FORALL (index: nat):
          cutoff <= index IMPLIES
            abs(sequence(index) - value) < epsilon_value

  real_exponential(x: real): real =
    epsilon(
      LAMBDA (value: real):
        converges_to(
          LAMBDA (count: nat):
            exponential_partial(x, count),
          value))

  natural_log(x: real): real =
    IF x > 0 THEN
      epsilon(
        LAMBDA (value: real):
          real_exponential(value) = x)
    ELSE
      0
    ENDIF

  is_exp_minus_one(f: nonnegative_function): bool =
    FORALL (x: nonnegative_real):
      (f(x) :: real) =
        real_exponential(x :: real) - 1

  is_log_one_plus(f: nonnegative_function): bool =
    FORALL (x: nonnegative_real):
      (f(x) :: real) =
        natural_log((x :: real) + 1)

  pointwise_sum(
      f, g, result: nonnegative_function): bool =
    FORALL (x: nonnegative_real):
      (result(x) :: real) =
        (f(x) :: real) + (g(x) :: real)

  pointwise_composition(
      f, g, result: nonnegative_function): bool =
    FORALL (x: nonnegative_real):
      result(x) = f(g(x))

  pointwise_difference(
      f, g, result: nonnegative_function): bool =
    FORALL (x: nonnegative_real):
      (result(x) :: real) =
        (f(x) :: real) - (g(x) :: real)

  pointwise_product(
      f, g, result: nonnegative_function): bool =
    FORALL (x: nonnegative_real):
      (result(x) :: real) =
        (f(x) :: real) * (g(x) :: real)

  closed_under_sum(S: function_class): bool =
    FORALL (f, g: nonnegative_function):
      (S(f) AND S(g)) IMPLIES
        EXISTS (result: nonnegative_function):
          S(result) AND pointwise_sum(f, g, result)

  closed_under_composition(S: function_class): bool =
    FORALL (f, g: nonnegative_function):
      (S(f) AND S(g)) IMPLIES
        EXISTS (result: nonnegative_function):
          S(result) AND pointwise_composition(f, g, result)

  closed_under_nonnegative_difference(
      S: function_class): bool =
    FORALL (f, g: nonnegative_function):
      (S(f)
        AND S(g)
        AND (FORALL (x: nonnegative_real):
          (f(x) :: real) >= (g(x) :: real)))
      IMPLIES
        EXISTS (result: nonnegative_function):
          S(result)
            AND pointwise_difference(f, g, result)

  closed_under_product(S: function_class): bool =
    FORALL (f, g: nonnegative_function):
      (S(f) AND S(g)) IMPLIES
        EXISTS (result: nonnegative_function):
          S(result) AND pointwise_product(f, g, result)

  putnam_2012_b1: bool =
    FORALL
        (S: function_class),
        (f1, f2: nonnegative_function):
      (is_exp_minus_one(f1)
        AND is_log_one_plus(f2)
        AND S(f1)
        AND S(f2)
        AND closed_under_sum(S)
        AND closed_under_composition(S)
        AND closed_under_nonnegative_difference(S))
      IMPLIES
        closed_under_product(S)
END putnam_2012_b1

title: putnam_2012_b3

import Mathlib

open Matrix Function Real

abbrev putnam_2012_b3_solution : Prop := True
/--
A round-robin tournament of $2n$ teams lasted for $2n-1$ days, as follows. On each day, every team played one game against another team, with one team winning and one team losing in each of the $n$ games. Over the course of the tournament, each team played every other team exactly once. Can one necessarily choose one winning team from each day without choosing any team more than once?
-/
theorem putnam_2012_b3
(nmatchupsgames nmatchupsall : (n : ℕ) → (Fin (2 * n - 1) → (Fin (2 * n) → Fin (2 * n))) → Prop)
(nmatchupswins nmatchupswinschoices: (n : ℕ) → (Fin (2 * n - 1) → (Fin (2 * n) → Fin (2 * n))) → (Fin (2 * n - 1) → (Fin (2 * n) → Bool)) → Prop)
(hnmatchupsall : ∀ n matchups, nmatchupsall n matchups ↔ ∀ t1 t2, t1 ≠ t2 → (∃ d, matchups d t1 = t2))
(hnmatchupsgames : ∀ n matchups, nmatchupsgames n matchups ↔ ∀ d, ∀ t, matchups d t ≠ t ∧ matchups d (matchups d t) = t)
(hnmatchupswins : ∀ n matchups wins, nmatchupswins n matchups wins ↔ ∀ d t, wins d t = !(wins d (matchups d t)))
(hnmatchupswinschoices : ∀ n matchups wins, nmatchupswinschoices n matchups wins ↔ ∃ choices, (∀ d, wins d (choices d)) ∧ Function.Injective choices) :
  (∀ n ≥ 1, ∀ matchups wins,
    (nmatchupsgames n matchups ∧ nmatchupsall n matchups ∧ nmatchupswins n matchups wins) →
    nmatchupswinschoices n matchups wins)
  ↔ putnam_2012_b3_solution :=
sorry

title: putnam_2012_b3

(* Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2012_b3:
   every round-robin tournament on 2n teams admits an injective choice of one
   winning team from each of its 2n-1 days. This file contains no proof. *)

From Stdlib Require Import Arith.PeanoNat Bool.Bool Vectors.Fin.

Open Scope nat_scope.

Definition putnam_2012_b3_matchups (n : nat) : Type :=
  Fin.t (2 * n - 1) -> Fin.t (2 * n) -> Fin.t (2 * n).

Definition putnam_2012_b3_wins (n : nat) : Type :=
  Fin.t (2 * n - 1) -> Fin.t (2 * n) -> bool.

Definition putnam_2012_b3_daily_games
    (n : nat) (matchups : putnam_2012_b3_matchups n) : Prop :=
  forall (d : Fin.t (2 * n - 1)) (t : Fin.t (2 * n)),
    matchups d t <> t /\
    matchups d (matchups d t) = t.

Definition putnam_2012_b3_all_matchups
    (n : nat) (matchups : putnam_2012_b3_matchups n) : Prop :=
  forall t1 t2 : Fin.t (2 * n),
    t1 <> t2 ->
    exists d : Fin.t (2 * n - 1), matchups d t1 = t2.

Definition putnam_2012_b3_valid_wins
    (n : nat)
    (matchups : putnam_2012_b3_matchups n)
    (wins : putnam_2012_b3_wins n) : Prop :=
  forall (d : Fin.t (2 * n - 1)) (t : Fin.t (2 * n)),
    wins d t = negb (wins d (matchups d t)).

Definition putnam_2012_b3_winning_choice
    (n : nat) (wins : putnam_2012_b3_wins n) : Prop :=
  exists choices : Fin.t (2 * n - 1) -> Fin.t (2 * n),
    (forall d : Fin.t (2 * n - 1), wins d (choices d) = true) /\
    (forall d1 d2 : Fin.t (2 * n - 1),
      choices d1 = choices d2 ->
      d1 = d2).

Definition putnam_2012_b3_solution : Prop := True.

Theorem putnam_2012_b3 :
  (forall n : nat,
    (1 <= n)%nat ->
    forall
      (matchups : putnam_2012_b3_matchups n)
      (wins : putnam_2012_b3_wins n),
      putnam_2012_b3_daily_games n matchups /\
      putnam_2012_b3_all_matchups n matchups /\
      putnam_2012_b3_valid_wins n matchups wins ->
      putnam_2012_b3_winning_choice n wins) <->
  putnam_2012_b3_solution.
Admitted.

title: putnam_2012_b3
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2012_b3:
;; every round-robin tournament on 2n teams admits an injective choice of one
;; winning team from each of its 2n-1 days. This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))

;; MATCHUPS and WINS are tame ACL2 function objects of two arguments. On the
;; finite day and team domains, every source function has an extensionally
;; equal tame function-object representation, and every accepted object below
;; restricts to a source function. The recursive checks enumerate exactly the
;; Fin-indexed domains from the Lean statement.

(defun putnam-2012-b3-matchup (matchups day team)
  (apply$ matchups (list day team)))

(defun putnam-2012-b3-win (wins day team)
  (apply$ wins (list day team)))

(defun putnam-2012-b3-booleanp (value)
  (or (equal value t)
      (equal value nil)))

(defun putnam-2012-b3-games-for-teams-p
    (matchups day team-count remaining-teams)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix remaining-teams)))
  (if (zp remaining-teams)
      t
    (let* ((team (- remaining-teams 1))
           (opponent
            (putnam-2012-b3-matchup matchups day team)))
      (and
       (natp opponent)
       (< opponent team-count)
       (not (equal opponent team))
       (equal
        (putnam-2012-b3-matchup matchups day opponent)
        team)
       (putnam-2012-b3-games-for-teams-p
        matchups day team-count team)))))

(defun putnam-2012-b3-games-for-days-p
    (matchups team-count remaining-days)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix remaining-days)))
  (if (zp remaining-days)
      t
    (and
     (putnam-2012-b3-games-for-teams-p
      matchups
      (- remaining-days 1)
      team-count
      team-count)
     (putnam-2012-b3-games-for-days-p
      matchups team-count (- remaining-days 1)))))

(defun putnam-2012-b3-opponent-day-exists-p
    (matchups team1 team2 remaining-days)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix remaining-days)))
  (if (zp remaining-days)
      nil
    (or
     (equal
      (putnam-2012-b3-matchup
       matchups (- remaining-days 1) team1)
      team2)
     (putnam-2012-b3-opponent-day-exists-p
      matchups team1 team2 (- remaining-days 1)))))

(defun putnam-2012-b3-all-opponents-for-team-p
    (matchups team1 day-count remaining-teams)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix remaining-teams)))
  (if (zp remaining-teams)
      t
    (let ((team2 (- remaining-teams 1)))
      (and
       (implies
        (not (equal team1 team2))
        (putnam-2012-b3-opponent-day-exists-p
         matchups team1 team2 day-count))
       (putnam-2012-b3-all-opponents-for-team-p
        matchups team1 day-count team2)))))

(defun putnam-2012-b3-all-opponents-p
    (matchups day-count team-count remaining-teams)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix remaining-teams)))
  (if (zp remaining-teams)
      t
    (let ((team1 (- remaining-teams 1)))
      (and
       (putnam-2012-b3-all-opponents-for-team-p
        matchups team1 day-count team-count)
       (putnam-2012-b3-all-opponents-p
        matchups day-count team-count team1)))))

(defun putnam-2012-b3-wins-for-teams-p
    (matchups wins day remaining-teams)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix remaining-teams)))
  (if (zp remaining-teams)
      t
    (let* ((team (- remaining-teams 1))
           (opponent
            (putnam-2012-b3-matchup matchups day team))
           (team-wins
            (putnam-2012-b3-win wins day team))
           (opponent-wins
            (putnam-2012-b3-win wins day opponent)))
      (and
       (putnam-2012-b3-booleanp team-wins)
       (putnam-2012-b3-booleanp opponent-wins)
       (equal team-wins (not opponent-wins))
       (putnam-2012-b3-wins-for-teams-p
        matchups wins day team)))))

(defun putnam-2012-b3-wins-for-days-p
    (matchups wins team-count remaining-days)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix remaining-days)))
  (if (zp remaining-days)
      t
    (and
     (putnam-2012-b3-wins-for-teams-p
      matchups
      wins
      (- remaining-days 1)
      team-count)
     (putnam-2012-b3-wins-for-days-p
      matchups wins team-count (- remaining-days 1)))))

;; This finite branching search is exactly the source existential quantifier
;; over choices. For each day it tries every team, and USED enforces
;; injectivity. The fuel is larger than the maximum recursion depth along any
;; branch, so it does not remove any possible choice function.
(defun putnam-2012-b3-winning-choice-search-p
    (fuel day day-count team-count candidate wins used)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix fuel)))
  (cond
   ((<= day-count day) t)
   ((or (zp fuel)
        (<= team-count candidate))
    nil)
   (t
    (or
     (and
      (equal
       (putnam-2012-b3-win wins day candidate)
       t)
      (not (member-equal candidate used))
      (putnam-2012-b3-winning-choice-search-p
       (- fuel 1)
       (+ day 1)
       day-count
       team-count
       0
       wins
       (cons candidate used)))
     (putnam-2012-b3-winning-choice-search-p
      (- fuel 1)
      day
      day-count
      team-count
      (+ candidate 1)
      wins
      used)))))

(defun putnam-2012-b3-winning-choice-exists-p
    (day-count team-count wins)
  (putnam-2012-b3-winning-choice-search-p
   (+ 1 (* day-count (+ team-count 1)))
   0
   day-count
   team-count
   0
   wins
   nil))

;; The source solution is True, so its biconditional is the universally closed
;; implication represented by this predicate-valued definition.
(defun putnambench-putnam-2012-b3-statement (n matchups wins)
  (let ((team-count (* 2 n))
        (day-count (- (* 2 n) 1)))
    (implies
     (and
      (natp n)
      (<= 1 n)
      (tamep-functionp matchups)
      (tamep-functionp wins)
      (putnam-2012-b3-games-for-days-p
       matchups team-count day-count)
      (putnam-2012-b3-all-opponents-p
       matchups day-count team-count team-count)
      (putnam-2012-b3-wins-for-days-p
       matchups wins team-count day-count))
     (putnam-2012-b3-winning-choice-exists-p
      day-count team-count wins))))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

content:
-- Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2012_b3
-- (putnambench__agda__putnam_2012_b3): every round-robin tournament on 2n
-- teams admits an injective choice of one winning team from each day.
-- This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module Putnam2012B3 where

open import Agda.Builtin.Bool using (Bool; false; true)
open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _*_)

infix 4 _!=_
infixr 3 _and_

data Bottom : Set where

Not : Set -> Set
Not A =
  A -> Bottom

_!=_ : {A : Set} -> A -> A -> Set
x != y =
  Not (x == y)

record _and_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

data Positive : Nat -> Set where
  positive : {n : Nat} -> Positive (suc n)

data Fin : Nat -> Set where
  fzero : {n : Nat} -> Fin (suc n)
  fsuc  : {n : Nat} -> Fin n -> Fin (suc n)

pred : Nat -> Nat
pred zero =
  zero
pred (suc n) =
  n

one : Nat
one =
  suc zero

two : Nat
two =
  suc one

Team : Nat -> Set
Team n =
  Fin (two * n)

Day : Nat -> Set
Day n =
  Fin (pred (two * n))

Matchups : Nat -> Set
Matchups n =
  Day n -> Team n -> Team n

Wins : Nat -> Set
Wins n =
  Day n -> Team n -> Bool

notBool : Bool -> Bool
notBool false =
  true
notBool true =
  false

DailyPerfectMatchings :
  {n : Nat} ->
  Matchups n ->
  Set
DailyPerfectMatchings {n} matchups =
  (d : Day n) ->
  (team : Team n) ->
  matchups d team != team
  and
  matchups d (matchups d team) == team

EveryPairMeets :
  {n : Nat} ->
  Matchups n ->
  Set
EveryPairMeets {n} matchups =
  (first-team second-team : Team n) ->
  first-team != second-team ->
  Exists (Day n)
    (\ d -> matchups d first-team == second-team)

ResultsAreOpposite :
  {n : Nat} ->
  Matchups n ->
  Wins n ->
  Set
ResultsAreOpposite {n} matchups wins =
  (d : Day n) ->
  (team : Team n) ->
  wins d team == notBool (wins d (matchups d team))

Injective :
  {A B : Set} ->
  (A -> B) ->
  Set
Injective {A} function =
  (x y : A) ->
  function x == function y ->
  x == y

WinningChoice :
  {n : Nat} ->
  Wins n ->
  Set
WinningChoice {n} wins =
  Exists (Day n -> Team n)
    (\ choices ->
      ((d : Day n) -> wins d (choices d) == true)
      and
      Injective choices)

putnam-2012-b3 : Set
putnam-2012-b3 =
  (n : Nat) ->
  Positive n ->
  (matchups : Matchups n) ->
  (wins : Wins n) ->
  DailyPerfectMatchings {n} matchups ->
  EveryPairMeets {n} matchups ->
  ResultsAreOpposite {n} matchups wins ->
  WinningChoice {n} wins
