content:
-- Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2013_a5
-- (putnambench__agda__putnam_2013_a5): area definiteness of a real coefficient
-- array for all planar point configurations implies area definiteness for all
-- three-dimensional point configurations. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module Putnam2013A5 where

open import Agda.Builtin.Bool using (Bool; false; true)
open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; _*_)

infix 4 _!=_ _<=N_
infixr 3 _and_

data Bottom : Set where

Not : Set -> Set
Not A =
  A -> Bottom

_!=_ : {A : Set} -> A -> A -> Set
x != y =
  Not (x == y)

record _and_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data Either (A B : Set) : Set where
  left  : A -> Either A B
  right : B -> Either A B

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

data _<=N_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set where
  zero<=N   : {n : Nat} -> zero <=N n
  suc<=sucN : {m n : Nat} -> m <=N n -> suc m <=N suc n

data Fin : Nat -> Set where
  fzero : {n : Nat} -> Fin (suc n)
  fsuc  : {n : Nat} -> Fin n -> Fin (suc n)

toNat : {n : Nat} -> Fin n -> Nat
toNat fzero =
  zero
toNat (fsuc i) =
  suc (toNat i)

lessNat : Nat -> Nat -> Bool
lessNat zero zero =
  false
lessNat zero (suc n) =
  true
lessNat (suc m) zero =
  false
lessNat (suc m) (suc n) =
  lessNat m n

andBool : Bool -> Bool -> Bool
andBool true true =
  true
andBool _ _ =
  false

ifThenElse : {A : Set} -> Bool -> A -> A -> A
ifThenElse true when-true when-false =
  when-true
ifThenElse false when-true when-false =
  when-false

record CompleteOrderedRealField (R : Set) : Set1 where
  field
    zeroR oneR : R
    addR multiplyR : R -> R -> R
    negateR inverseR squareRootR : R -> R
    lessOrEqualR : R -> R -> Set
    fromNatR : Nat -> R

    one-not-zero :
      oneR != zeroR

    add-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> addR x y == addR y x
    add-associative :
      (x y z : R) -> addR (addR x y) z == addR x (addR y z)
    add-zero :
      (x : R) -> addR x zeroR == x
    add-inverse :
      (x : R) -> addR x (negateR x) == zeroR

    multiply-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> multiplyR x y == multiplyR y x
    multiply-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiplyR (multiplyR x y) z == multiplyR x (multiplyR y z)
    multiply-one :
      (x : R) -> multiplyR x oneR == x
    multiply-zero :
      (x : R) -> multiplyR x zeroR == zeroR
    distribute :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiplyR x (addR y z) ==
      addR (multiplyR x y) (multiplyR x z)
    inverse-zero :
      inverseR zeroR == zeroR
    multiply-inverse :
      (x : R) ->
      x != zeroR ->
      multiplyR x (inverseR x) == oneR

    order-reflexive :
      (x : R) -> lessOrEqualR x x
    order-transitive :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR x y ->
      lessOrEqualR y z ->
      lessOrEqualR x z
    order-antisymmetric :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR x y ->
      lessOrEqualR y x ->
      x == y
    order-total :
      (x y : R) ->
      Either (lessOrEqualR x y) (lessOrEqualR y x)
    add-order :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR x y ->
      lessOrEqualR (addR z x) (addR z y)
    multiply-nonnegative :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR zeroR x ->
      lessOrEqualR zeroR y ->
      lessOrEqualR zeroR (multiplyR x y)
    zero-less-than-one :
      (lessOrEqualR zeroR oneR) and (zeroR != oneR)

    fromNat-zero :
      fromNatR zero == zeroR
    fromNat-successor :
      (n : Nat) -> fromNatR (suc n) == addR (fromNatR n) oneR
    fromNat-addition :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNatR (m + n) == addR (fromNatR m) (fromNatR n)
    fromNat-multiplication :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNatR (m * n) == multiplyR (fromNatR m) (fromNatR n)
    fromNat-injective :
      (m n : Nat) -> fromNatR m == fromNatR n -> m == n

    archimedean :
      (x : R) ->
      Exists Nat (\ n -> lessOrEqualR x (fromNatR n))
    least-upper-bound :
      (P : R -> Set) ->
      Exists R P ->
      Exists R
        (\ upper ->
          (x : R) -> P x -> lessOrEqualR x upper) ->
      Exists R
        (\ supremum ->
          ((x : R) -> P x -> lessOrEqualR x supremum)
          and
          ((upper : R) ->
            ((x : R) -> P x -> lessOrEqualR x upper) ->
            lessOrEqualR supremum upper))

    square-root-nonnegative :
      (x : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR zeroR (squareRootR x)
    square-root-square :
      (x : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR zeroR x ->
      multiplyR (squareRootR x) (squareRootR x) == x
    square-root-nonpositive :
      (x : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR x zeroR ->
      squareRootR x == zeroR
    square-root-unique :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR zeroR y ->
      multiplyR y y == x ->
      y == squareRootR x

open CompleteOrderedRealField

two : Nat
two =
  suc (suc zero)

three : Nat
three =
  suc two

Vector : Set -> Nat -> Set
Vector R n =
  Fin n -> R

subtractR :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
subtractR reals x y =
  addR reals x (negateR reals y)

squareR :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R
squareR reals x =
  multiplyR reals x x

half :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R
half reals =
  inverseR reals (addR reals (oneR reals) (oneR reals))

absoluteValue :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R
absoluteValue reals x =
  squareRootR reals (squareR reals x)

subtractVector :
  {R : Set} ->
  {n : Nat} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Vector R n ->
  Vector R n ->
  Vector R n
subtractVector reals u v i =
  subtractR reals (u i) (v i)

determinant2 :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Vector R two ->
  Vector R two ->
  R
determinant2 reals u v =
  subtractR reals
    (multiplyR reals
      (u fzero)
      (v (fsuc fzero)))
    (multiplyR reals
      (u (fsuc fzero))
      (v fzero))

triangleArea2 :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Vector R two ->
  Vector R two ->
  Vector R two ->
  R
triangleArea2 reals a b c =
  multiplyR reals
    (half reals)
    (absoluteValue reals
      (determinant2 reals
        (subtractVector reals b a)
        (subtractVector reals c a)))

cross3 :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Vector R three ->
  Vector R three ->
  Vector R three
cross3 reals u v fzero =
  subtractR reals
    (multiplyR reals (u (fsuc fzero)) (v (fsuc (fsuc fzero))))
    (multiplyR reals (u (fsuc (fsuc fzero))) (v (fsuc fzero)))
cross3 reals u v (fsuc fzero) =
  subtractR reals
    (multiplyR reals (u (fsuc (fsuc fzero))) (v fzero))
    (multiplyR reals (u fzero) (v (fsuc (fsuc fzero))))
cross3 reals u v (fsuc (fsuc fzero)) =
  subtractR reals
    (multiplyR reals (u fzero) (v (fsuc fzero)))
    (multiplyR reals (u (fsuc fzero)) (v fzero))

squaredNorm3 :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Vector R three ->
  R
squaredNorm3 reals v =
  addR reals
    (addR reals
      (squareR reals (v fzero))
      (squareR reals (v (fsuc fzero))))
    (squareR reals (v (fsuc (fsuc fzero))))

triangleArea3 :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Vector R three ->
  Vector R three ->
  Vector R three ->
  R
triangleArea3 reals a b c =
  multiplyR reals
    (half reals)
    (squareRootR reals
      (squaredNorm3 reals
        (cross3 reals
          (subtractVector reals b a)
          (subtractVector reals c a))))

sumFin :
  {R : Set} ->
  {n : Nat} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (Fin n -> R) ->
  R
sumFin {n = zero} reals term =
  zeroR reals
sumFin {n = suc n} reals term =
  addR reals
    (term fzero)
    (sumFin reals (\ i -> term (fsuc i)))

strictlyIncreasingTriple :
  {n : Nat} ->
  Fin n ->
  Fin n ->
  Fin n ->
  Bool
strictlyIncreasingTriple i j k =
  andBool
    (lessNat (toNat i) (toNat j))
    (lessNat (toNat j) (toNat k))

weightedAreaSum :
  {R : Set} ->
  {m dimension : Nat} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (Vector R dimension -> Vector R dimension -> Vector R dimension -> R) ->
  (Fin m -> Fin m -> Fin m -> R) ->
  (Fin m -> Vector R dimension) ->
  R
weightedAreaSum reals area coefficients points =
  sumFin reals
    (\ i ->
      sumFin reals
        (\ j ->
          sumFin reals
            (\ k ->
              ifThenElse
                (strictlyIncreasingTriple i j k)
                (multiplyR reals
                  (coefficients i j k)
                  (area (points i) (points j) (points k)))
                (zeroR reals))))

AreaDefinite :
  {R : Set} ->
  {m dimension : Nat} ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) ->
  (Vector R dimension -> Vector R dimension -> Vector R dimension -> R) ->
  (Fin m -> Fin m -> Fin m -> R) ->
  Set
AreaDefinite {R} {m} {dimension} reals area coefficients =
  (points : Fin m -> Vector R dimension) ->
  lessOrEqualR reals
    (zeroR reals)
    (weightedAreaSum reals area coefficients points)

putnam-2013-a5 : Set1
putnam-2013-a5 =
  (R : Set) ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) ->
  (m : Nat) ->
  three <=N m ->
  (coefficients : Fin m -> Fin m -> Fin m -> R) ->
  AreaDefinite reals (triangleArea2 reals) coefficients ->
  AreaDefinite reals (triangleArea3 reals) coefficients

title: putnam_2013_a5
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2013_a5:
  area-definiteness of coefficients for every configuration of finitely many
  planar points implies area-definiteness for spatial points. This file
  contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open arithmeticTheory pairTheory pred_setTheory realTheory transcTheory;

val putnam_2013_a5 =
  ``let area2 =
      \A B C : real # real.
        abs
          ((FST B - FST A) * (SND C - SND A) -
           (SND B - SND A) * (FST C - FST A)) / 2
    in
    let area3 =
      \A B C : (real # real) # real.
        sqrt
          (((SND (FST B) - SND (FST A)) * (SND C - SND A) -
            (SND B - SND A) * (SND (FST C) - SND (FST A))) pow 2 +
           ((SND B - SND A) * (FST (FST C) - FST (FST A)) -
            (FST (FST B) - FST (FST A)) * (SND C - SND A)) pow 2 +
           ((FST (FST B) - FST (FST A)) *
              (SND (FST C) - SND (FST A)) -
            (SND (FST B) - SND (FST A)) *
              (FST (FST C) - FST (FST A))) pow 2) / 2
    in
      !m : num.
        3 <= m
        ==>
        !a : num -> num -> num -> real.
          (!A : num -> real # real.
             0 <=
               SIGMA
                 (\i : num.
                    SIGMA
                      (\j : num.
                         SIGMA
                           (\k : num.
                              if i < j /\ j < k
                              then a i j k * area2 (A i) (A j) (A k)
                              else 0)
                           (count m))
                      (count m))
                 (count m))
          ==>
          (!A : num -> (real # real) # real.
             0 <=
               SIGMA
                 (\i : num.
                    SIGMA
                      (\j : num.
                         SIGMA
                           (\k : num.
                              if i < j /\ j < k
                              then a i j k * area3 (A i) (A j) (A k)
                              else 0)
                           (count m))
                      (count m))
                 (count m))``;

title: putnam_2013_a5
content:
$(
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact
  putnam_2013_a5: area-definite real coefficients for triangles in the
  Euclidean plane remain area definite in Euclidean three-space. This file
  contains no proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  P13A5R2 and P13A5R3 are the full real coordinate spaces indexed by
  1 ... 2 and 1 ... 3. P13A5Area2 is the absolute determinant divided by
  two. P13A5Cross is the cross product of B - A and C - A, and P13A5Area3
  is half its Euclidean norm. These are exactly the planar Lebesgue area and
  the two-dimensional Hausdorff measure, respectively, of the convex hull
  of the three points.

  For each m in NN0, 0 ..^ m is Fin m. The coefficient map ranges over all
  real-valued functions on its full triple product; the ordered-triple
  representation is canonically equivalent to the source's curried map.
  The two point maps range over every configuration in the corresponding
  Euclidean space. The three finite sums use the source condition i < j < k,
  so values of the coefficient map on other triples are immaterial exactly
  as in the source.

  Thus the final implication directly expands the source predicates
  areadef2 and areadef3, without externalizing any witness or restricting
  any arbitrary function. The final declaration is the single unproved $a
  corpus statement; this database contains no $p proof declaration.
$)

$c P13A5I2 P13A5I3 P13A5R2 P13A5R3 $.
$c P13A5Cross P13A5Area2 P13A5Area3 $.

p13a5-index2-syntax $a class P13A5I2 $.
p13a5-index3-syntax $a class P13A5I3 $.
p13a5-plane-syntax $a class P13A5R2 $.
p13a5-space-syntax $a class P13A5R3 $.
p13a5-cross-syntax $a class ( P13A5Cross A B C ) $.
p13a5-area2-syntax $a class ( P13A5Area2 A B C ) $.
p13a5-area3-syntax $a class ( P13A5Area3 A B C ) $.

p13a5-index2-definition $a |- P13A5I2 = ( 1 ... 2 ) $.
p13a5-index3-definition $a |- P13A5I3 = ( 1 ... 3 ) $.
p13a5-plane-definition $a |- P13A5R2 = ( RR ^m P13A5I2 ) $.
p13a5-space-definition $a |- P13A5R3 = ( RR ^m P13A5I3 ) $.

p13a5-area2-definition $a |- (
  P13A5Area2 A B C
) = (
  ( 1 / 2 )
  x.
  (
    abs
    `
    (
      (
        ( ( B ` 1 ) - ( A ` 1 ) )
        x.
        ( ( C ` 2 ) - ( A ` 2 ) )
      )
      -
      (
        ( ( B ` 2 ) - ( A ` 2 ) )
        x.
        ( ( C ` 1 ) - ( A ` 1 ) )
      )
    )
  )
) $.

${
  $d A B C r $.

  p13a5-cross-definition $a |- (
    P13A5Cross A B C
  ) = (
    r e. P13A5I3 |->
      if (
        r = 1 ,
        (
          (
            ( ( B ` 2 ) - ( A ` 2 ) )
            x.
            ( ( C ` 3 ) - ( A ` 3 ) )
          )
          -
          (
            ( ( B ` 3 ) - ( A ` 3 ) )
            x.
            ( ( C ` 2 ) - ( A ` 2 ) )
          )
        ) ,
        if (
          r = 2 ,
          (
            (
              ( ( B ` 3 ) - ( A ` 3 ) )
              x.
              ( ( C ` 1 ) - ( A ` 1 ) )
            )
            -
            (
              ( ( B ` 1 ) - ( A ` 1 ) )
              x.
              ( ( C ` 3 ) - ( A ` 3 ) )
            )
          ) ,
          (
            (
              ( ( B ` 1 ) - ( A ` 1 ) )
              x.
              ( ( C ` 2 ) - ( A ` 2 ) )
            )
            -
            (
              ( ( B ` 2 ) - ( A ` 2 ) )
              x.
              ( ( C ` 1 ) - ( A ` 1 ) )
            )
          )
        )
      )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d A B C r $.

  p13a5-area3-definition $a |- (
    P13A5Area3 A B C
  ) = (
    ( 1 / 2 )
    x.
    (
      sqrt
      `
      (
        sum_ r e. P13A5I3
          ( ( ( P13A5Cross A B C ) ` r ) ^ 2 )
      )
    )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d P Q a i j k m $.

  putnambench-putnam-2013-a5 $a |- A. m e. NN0
    (
      3 <_ m
      ->
      A. a e.
        (
          RR
          ^m
          (
            ( ( 0 ..^ m ) X. ( 0 ..^ m ) )
            X.
            ( 0 ..^ m )
          )
        )
        (
          A. P e. ( P13A5R2 ^m ( 0 ..^ m ) )
            0
            <_
            (
              sum_ i e. ( 0 ..^ m )
                sum_ j e. ( 0 ..^ m )
                  sum_ k e. ( 0 ..^ m )
                    if (
                      (
                        i < j
                        /\
                        j < k
                      ) ,
                      (
                        ( a ` <. i , j , k >. )
                        x.
                        (
                          P13A5Area2
                          ( P ` i )
                          ( P ` j )
                          ( P ` k )
                        )
                      ) ,
                      0
                    )
            )
          ->
          A. Q e. ( P13A5R3 ^m ( 0 ..^ m ) )
            0
            <_
            (
              sum_ i e. ( 0 ..^ m )
                sum_ j e. ( 0 ..^ m )
                  sum_ k e. ( 0 ..^ m )
                    if (
                      (
                        i < j
                        /\
                        j < k
                      ) ,
                      (
                        ( a ` <. i , j , k >. )
                        x.
                        (
                          P13A5Area3
                          ( Q ` i )
                          ( Q ` j )
                          ( Q ` k )
                        )
                      ) ,
                      0
                    )
            )
        )
    )
  $.
$}

title: putnam_2013_a5
content:
% Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2013_a5:
% every real coefficient family that is area definite for all configurations
% of m points in the Euclidean plane is area definite in three-space. This file
% contains no proof.

putnam_2013_a5[m: {n: nat | n >= 3}]: THEORY
BEGIN
  index: TYPE = below(m)

  point2: TYPE = [# x_coord: real, y_coord: real #]
  point3: TYPE =
    [# x_coord: real, y_coord: real, z_coord: real #]

  coefficient_array: TYPE = [index, index, index -> real]
  plane_configuration: TYPE = [index -> point2]
  space_configuration: TYPE = [index -> point3]

  plane_cross(A, B, C: point2): real =
    (x_coord(B) - x_coord(A)) * (y_coord(C) - y_coord(A))
      - (y_coord(B) - y_coord(A)) * (x_coord(C) - x_coord(A))

  space_cross_x(A, B, C: point3): real =
    (y_coord(B) - y_coord(A)) * (z_coord(C) - z_coord(A))
      - (z_coord(B) - z_coord(A)) * (y_coord(C) - y_coord(A))

  space_cross_y(A, B, C: point3): real =
    (z_coord(B) - z_coord(A)) * (x_coord(C) - x_coord(A))
      - (x_coord(B) - x_coord(A)) * (z_coord(C) - z_coord(A))

  space_cross_z(A, B, C: point3): real =
    (x_coord(B) - x_coord(A)) * (y_coord(C) - y_coord(A))
      - (y_coord(B) - y_coord(A)) * (x_coord(C) - x_coord(A))

  nonnegative_sqrt(x: real): real =
    epsilon(
      LAMBDA (root: real):
        root >= 0 AND root * root = x)

  triangle_area2(A, B, C: point2): real =
    abs(plane_cross(A, B, C)) / 2

  triangle_area3(A, B, C: point3): real =
    nonnegative_sqrt(
      space_cross_x(A, B, C) ^ 2
        + space_cross_y(A, B, C) ^ 2
        + space_cross_z(A, B, C) ^ 2) / 2

  plane_k_sum(
      coefficients: coefficient_array,
      points: plane_configuration,
      i, j: index,
      count: nat): RECURSIVE real =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      plane_k_sum(coefficients, points, i, j, count - 1)
        + IF count <= m AND i < j AND j < count - 1 THEN
            coefficients(i, j, count - 1)
              * triangle_area2(
                  points(i), points(j), points(count - 1))
          ELSE
            0
          ENDIF
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  plane_j_sum(
      coefficients: coefficient_array,
      points: plane_configuration,
      i: index,
      count: nat): RECURSIVE real =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      plane_j_sum(coefficients, points, i, count - 1)
        + IF count <= m THEN
            plane_k_sum(
              coefficients, points, i, count - 1, m)
          ELSE
            0
          ENDIF
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  plane_sum(
      coefficients: coefficient_array,
      points: plane_configuration,
      count: nat): RECURSIVE real =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      plane_sum(coefficients, points, count - 1)
        + IF count <= m THEN
            plane_j_sum(
              coefficients, points, count - 1, m)
          ELSE
            0
          ENDIF
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  space_k_sum(
      coefficients: coefficient_array,
      points: space_configuration,
      i, j: index,
      count: nat): RECURSIVE real =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      space_k_sum(coefficients, points, i, j, count - 1)
        + IF count <= m AND i < j AND j < count - 1 THEN
            coefficients(i, j, count - 1)
              * triangle_area3(
                  points(i), points(j), points(count - 1))
          ELSE
            0
          ENDIF
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  space_j_sum(
      coefficients: coefficient_array,
      points: space_configuration,
      i: index,
      count: nat): RECURSIVE real =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      space_j_sum(coefficients, points, i, count - 1)
        + IF count <= m THEN
            space_k_sum(
              coefficients, points, i, count - 1, m)
          ELSE
            0
          ENDIF
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  space_sum(
      coefficients: coefficient_array,
      points: space_configuration,
      count: nat): RECURSIVE real =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      space_sum(coefficients, points, count - 1)
        + IF count <= m THEN
            space_j_sum(
              coefficients, points, count - 1, m)
          ELSE
            0
          ENDIF
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  area_definite2(coefficients: coefficient_array): bool =
    FORALL (points: plane_configuration):
      plane_sum(coefficients, points, m) >= 0

  area_definite3(coefficients: coefficient_array): bool =
    FORALL (points: space_configuration):
      space_sum(coefficients, points, m) >= 0

  putnam_2013_a5: bool =
    FORALL (coefficients: coefficient_array):
      area_definite2(coefficients)
        IMPLIES area_definite3(coefficients)
END putnam_2013_a5

title: putnam_2013_a6

import Mathlib

open Function Set

/--
Define a function $w:\mathbb{Z} \times \mathbb{Z} \to \mathbb{Z}$ as follows. For $|a|,|b| \leq 2$, let $w(a,b)$ be as in the table shown; otherwise, let $w(a,b)=0$.
\begin{center}
\begin{tabular}{|cc|r|r|r|r|r|}
\hline
\multicolumn{2}{|c|}{\multirow{2}{*}{$w(a,b)$}} & \multicolumn{5}{|c|}{$b$} \\
& & -2 & -1 & 0 & 1 & 2 \\
\hline
& -2 & -1 & -2 & 2 & -2 & -1 \\
& -1 & -2 & 4 & -4 & 4 & -2 \\
$a$ & 0 & 2 & -4 & 12 & -4 & 2 \\
& 1 & -2 & 4 & -4 & 4 & -2 \\
& 2 & -1 & -2 & 2 & -2 & -1 \\
\hline
\end{tabular}
\end{center}
For every finite subset $S$ of $\mathbb{Z} \times \mathbb{Z}$, define $A(S)=\sum_{(\mathbf{s},\mathbf{s}') \in S \times S} w(\mathbf{s}-\mathbf{s}')$. Prove that if $S$ is any finite nonempty subset of $\mathbb{Z} \times \mathbb{Z}$, then $A(S)>0$. (For example, if $S=\{(0,1),(0,2),(2,0),(3,1)\}$, then the terms in $A(S)$ are $12,12,12,12,4,4,0,0,0,0,-1,-1,-2,-2,-4,-4$.)
-/
theorem putnam_2013_a6
  (w : ℤ → ℤ → ℤ)
  (A : Finset (ℤ × ℤ) → ℤ)
  (hwn1 : w (-2) (-2) = -1 ∧ w 2 (-2) = -1 ∧ w (-2) 2 = -1 ∧ w 2 2 = -1)
  (hwn2 : w (-1) (-2) = -2 ∧ w 1 (-2) = -2 ∧ w (-2) (-1) = -2 ∧ w 2 (-1) = -2 ∧ w (-2) 1 = -2 ∧ w 2 1 = -2 ∧ w (-1) 2 = -2 ∧ w 1 2 = -2)
  (hw2 : w 0 (-2) = 2 ∧ w (-2) 0 = 2 ∧ w 2 0 = 2 ∧ w 0 2 = 2)
  (hw4 : w (-1) (-1) = 4 ∧ w 1 (-1) = 4 ∧ w (-1) 1 = 4 ∧ w 1 1 = 4)
  (hwn4 : w 0 (-1) = -4 ∧ w (-1) 0 = -4 ∧ w 1 0 = -4 ∧ w 0 1 = -4)
  (hw12 : w 0 0 = 12)
  (hw0 : ∀ a b : ℤ, (|a| > 2 ∨ |b| > 2) → w a b = 0)
  (hA : ∀ S, A S = ∑ s ∈ S, ∑ s' ∈ S, w (s - s').1 (s - s').2) :
  ∀ S : Finset (ℤ × ℤ), Nonempty S → A S > 0 :=
sorry

    (A : seq (int * int) -> int)

    (hwn2 : w (-1) (-2) = -2 /\ w 1 (-2) = -2 /\ w (-2) (-1) = -2 /\ w 2 (-1) = -2 /\ w (-2) 1 = -2 /\ w 2 1 = -2 /\ w (-1) 2 = -2 /\ w 1 2 = -2)
    (hw2 : w 0 (-2) = 2 /\ w (-2) 0 = 2 /\ w 2 0 = 2 /\ w 0 2 = 2)

title: putnam_2013_a6

;; Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2013_a6:
;; positivity of the prescribed integer-lattice weight double sum for every
;; finite nonempty subset of Z x Z. This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

;; The source hypotheses uniquely determine W at every integer pair and A on
;; every finite set, so both functions are unfolded below. A duplicate-free
;; true list of two-integer lists is a bijective enumeration of a finite subset
;; of Z x Z, and the double sum is invariant under the enumeration order.

(defun putnam-2013-a6-integer-point-p (point)
  (and
   (true-listp point)
   (equal (len point) 2)
   (integerp (nth 0 point))
   (integerp (nth 1 point))))

(defun putnam-2013-a6-all-integer-points-p (points)
  (if (endp points)
      (equal points nil)
    (and
     (putnam-2013-a6-integer-point-p (car points))
     (putnam-2013-a6-all-integer-points-p (cdr points)))))

(defun putnam-2013-a6-weight (a b)
  (let ((x (abs a))
        (y (abs b)))
    (cond
     ((or (< 2 x) (< 2 y)) 0)
     ((and (equal x 2) (equal y 2)) -1)
     ((or (and (equal x 2) (equal y 1))
          (and (equal x 1) (equal y 2)))
      -2)
     ((or (and (equal x 2) (equal y 0))
          (and (equal x 0) (equal y 2)))
      2)
     ((and (equal x 1) (equal y 1)) 4)
     ((or (and (equal x 1) (equal y 0))
          (and (equal x 0) (equal y 1)))
      -4)
     (t 12))))

(defun putnam-2013-a6-row-sum (point others)
  (if (endp others)
      0
    (+
     (putnam-2013-a6-weight
      (- (nth 0 point) (nth 0 (car others)))
      (- (nth 1 point) (nth 1 (car others))))
     (putnam-2013-a6-row-sum point (cdr others)))))

(defun putnam-2013-a6-double-sum (remaining all-points)
  (if (endp remaining)
      0
    (+
     (putnam-2013-a6-row-sum (car remaining) all-points)
     (putnam-2013-a6-double-sum
      (cdr remaining) all-points))))

(defun putnambench-putnam-2013-a6-statement (points)
  (implies
   (and
    (true-listp points)
    (consp points)
    (no-duplicatesp-equal points)
    (putnam-2013-a6-all-integer-points-p points))
   (< 0
      (putnam-2013-a6-double-sum points points))))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

title: putnam_2013_a6
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2013_a6
-- (putnambench__agda__putnam_2013_a6): positivity of the specified
-- integer-kernel double sum over every nonempty finite subset of Int x Int.
-- This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module Main where

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Int using (Int; pos; negsuc)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_)

data Fin : Nat -> Set where
  fzero : {n : Nat} -> Fin (suc n)
  fsuc  : {n : Nat} -> Fin n -> Fin (suc n)

record Point : Set where
  constructor point
  field
    x-coordinate : Int
    y-coordinate : Int

open Point

Injective : {A B : Set} -> (A -> B) -> Set
Injective {A} f =
  (i j : A) ->
  f i == f j ->
  i == j

oneN : Nat
oneN =
  suc zero

twoN : Nat
twoN =
  suc oneN

threeN : Nat
threeN =
  suc twoN

fourN : Nat
fourN =
  suc threeN

twelveN : Nat
twelveN =
  fourN + fourN + fourN

zeroZ : Int
zeroZ =
  pos zero

minusOneZ : Int
minusOneZ =
  negsuc zero

minusTwoZ : Int
minusTwoZ =
  negsuc oneN

minusFourZ : Int
minusFourZ =
  negsuc threeN

twoZ : Int
twoZ =
  pos twoN

fourZ : Int
fourZ =
  pos fourN

twelveZ : Int
twelveZ =
  pos twelveN

negativeNat : Nat -> Int
negativeNat zero =
  zeroZ
negativeNat (suc n) =
  negsuc n

differenceNat : Nat -> Nat -> Int
differenceNat zero zero =
  zeroZ
differenceNat (suc m) zero =
  pos (suc m)
differenceNat zero (suc n) =
  negsuc n
differenceNat (suc m) (suc n) =
  differenceNat m n

negateInt : Int -> Int
negateInt (pos n) =
  negativeNat n
negateInt (negsuc n) =
  pos (suc n)

addInt : Int -> Int -> Int
addInt (pos m) (pos n) =
  pos (m + n)
addInt (pos m) (negsuc n) =
  differenceNat m (suc n)
addInt (negsuc m) (pos n) =
  differenceNat n (suc m)
addInt (negsuc m) (negsuc n) =
  negsuc (suc (m + n))

subtractInt : Int -> Int -> Int
subtractInt x y =
  addInt x (negateInt y)

sumFinInt : {n : Nat} -> (Fin n -> Int) -> Int
sumFinInt {zero} terms =
  zeroZ
sumFinInt {suc n} terms =
  addInt
    (terms fzero)
    (sumFinInt (\ i -> terms (fsuc i)))

kernel : Int -> Int -> Int
kernel (negsuc (suc zero)) (negsuc (suc zero)) = minusOneZ
kernel (negsuc (suc zero)) (negsuc zero)       = minusTwoZ
kernel (negsuc (suc zero)) (pos zero)          = twoZ
kernel (negsuc (suc zero)) (pos (suc zero))    = minusTwoZ
kernel (negsuc (suc zero)) (pos (suc (suc zero))) = minusOneZ

kernel (negsuc zero) (negsuc (suc zero))       = minusTwoZ
kernel (negsuc zero) (negsuc zero)             = fourZ
kernel (negsuc zero) (pos zero)                = minusFourZ
kernel (negsuc zero) (pos (suc zero))          = fourZ
kernel (negsuc zero) (pos (suc (suc zero)))    = minusTwoZ

kernel (pos zero) (negsuc (suc zero))          = twoZ
kernel (pos zero) (negsuc zero)                = minusFourZ
kernel (pos zero) (pos zero)                   = twelveZ
kernel (pos zero) (pos (suc zero))             = minusFourZ
kernel (pos zero) (pos (suc (suc zero)))       = twoZ

kernel (pos (suc zero)) (negsuc (suc zero))    = minusTwoZ
kernel (pos (suc zero)) (negsuc zero)          = fourZ
kernel (pos (suc zero)) (pos zero)             = minusFourZ
kernel (pos (suc zero)) (pos (suc zero))       = fourZ
kernel (pos (suc zero)) (pos (suc (suc zero))) = minusTwoZ

kernel (pos (suc (suc zero))) (negsuc (suc zero)) = minusOneZ
kernel (pos (suc (suc zero))) (negsuc zero)       = minusTwoZ
kernel (pos (suc (suc zero))) (pos zero)          = twoZ
kernel (pos (suc (suc zero))) (pos (suc zero))    = minusTwoZ
kernel (pos (suc (suc zero))) (pos (suc (suc zero))) = minusOneZ

kernel _ _ =
  zeroZ

energy :
  {n : Nat} ->
  (Fin n -> Point) ->
  Int
energy points =
  sumFinInt
    (\ i ->
      sumFinInt
        (\ j ->
          kernel
            (subtractInt
              (x-coordinate (points i))
              (x-coordinate (points j)))

title: putnam_2013_a6
content:
% Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2013_a6:
% the integer kernel specified by a 5-by-5 table gives a positive double sum
% on every nonempty finite subset of the integer lattice. This file contains
% no proof.

putnam_2013_a6: THEORY
BEGIN
  point: TYPE = [# first: int, second: int #]

  IMPORTING finite_sets@finite_sets_sum_real[point]

  point_set: TYPE = finite_set[point]
  kernel_function: TYPE = [int, int -> int]
  energy_function: TYPE = [point_set -> int]

  kernel_specification(w: kernel_function): bool =
    w(-2, -2) = -1
      AND w(2, -2) = -1
      AND w(-2, 2) = -1
      AND w(2, 2) = -1
      AND w(-1, -2) = -2
      AND w(1, -2) = -2
      AND w(-2, -1) = -2
      AND w(2, -1) = -2
      AND w(-2, 1) = -2
      AND w(2, 1) = -2
      AND w(-1, 2) = -2
      AND w(1, 2) = -2
      AND w(0, -2) = 2
      AND w(-2, 0) = 2
      AND w(2, 0) = 2
      AND w(0, 2) = 2
      AND w(-1, -1) = 4
      AND w(1, -1) = 4
      AND w(-1, 1) = 4
      AND w(1, 1) = 4
      AND w(0, -1) = -4
      AND w(-1, 0) = -4
      AND w(1, 0) = -4
      AND w(0, 1) = -4
      AND w(0, 0) = 12
      AND (FORALL (a, b: int):
        (abs(a) > 2 OR abs(b) > 2) IMPLIES w(a, b) = 0)

  energy_specification(
      w: kernel_function,
      A: energy_function): bool =
    FORALL (S: point_set):
      (A(S) :: real)
        = sum(
            S,
            LAMBDA (s: point):
              sum(
                S,
                LAMBDA (s_prime: point):
                  (w(
                    first(s) - first(s_prime),
                    second(s) - second(s_prime)) :: real)))

  putnam_2013_a6: bool =
    FORALL (w: kernel_function), (A: energy_function):
      (kernel_specification(w)
        AND energy_specification(w, A))
      IMPLIES
        FORALL (S: point_set):
          card(S) > 0 IMPLIES A(S) > 0
END putnam_2013_a6

;; Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2013_b1:
;; the integer sequence defined by c(1)=1, c(2n)=c(n), and
;; c(2n+1)=(-1)^n*c(n) has sum c(n)*c(n+2), for 1 <= n <= 2013,
;; equal to -1. This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

;; The source assumptions uniquely determine every positive-index value of c.
;; STEPS is internal recursion fuel; starting it at N is more than sufficient
;; because each recursive call replaces a positive N greater than 1 by
;; floor(N/2).
(defun putnam-2013-b1-c-aux (n steps)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix steps)))
  (if (or (zp steps)
          (not (posp n)))
      0
    (if (equal n 1)
        1
      (let ((half (floor n 2)))
        (* (if (equal (mod n 2) 0)
               1
             (expt -1 half))
           (putnam-2013-b1-c-aux
            half (- steps 1)))))))

(defun putnam-2013-b1-c (n)
  (if (posp n)
      (putnam-2013-b1-c-aux n n)
    0))

          (putnam-2013-b1-c (+ n 2))))))

;; source function preserves the hypotheses and the finite-sum conclusion.
(defun putnambench-putnam-2013-b1-statement ()
  (equal (putnam-2013-b1-sum-through 2013)

-- Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2013_b1
-- (putnambench__agda__putnam_2013_b1): the integer sequence defined by the
-- stated even and odd recurrences has sum c(n)c(n+2), for n from 1 through
-- 2013, equal to -1. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module Putnam2013B1 where

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Int using (Int; pos; negsuc)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; _*_)

one : Nat
one =
  suc zero

two : Nat
two =
  suc one

data Positive : Nat -> Set where
  positive : (n : Nat) -> Positive (suc n)

negative : Nat -> Int
negative zero =
  pos zero
negative (suc n) =
  negsuc n

difference : Nat -> Nat -> Int
difference zero zero =
  pos zero
difference (suc m) zero =
  pos (suc m)
difference zero (suc n) =
  negsuc n
difference (suc m) (suc n) =
  difference m n

addInt : Int -> Int -> Int
addInt (pos m) (pos n) =
  pos (m + n)
addInt (pos m) (negsuc n) =
  difference m (suc n)
addInt (negsuc m) (pos n) =
  difference n (suc m)
addInt (negsuc m) (negsuc n) =
  negsuc (suc (m + n))

multiplyInt : Int -> Int -> Int
multiplyInt (pos m) (pos n) =
  pos (m * n)
multiplyInt (pos m) (negsuc n) =
  negative (m * suc n)
multiplyInt (negsuc m) (pos n) =
  negative (suc m * n)
multiplyInt (negsuc m) (negsuc n) =
  pos (suc m * suc n)

powerInt : Int -> Nat -> Int
powerInt base zero =
  pos one
powerInt base (suc exponent) =
  multiplyInt base (powerInt base exponent)

sumFromOneThroughInt : Nat -> (Nat -> Int) -> Int
sumFromOneThroughInt zero term =
  pos zero
sumFromOneThroughInt (suc n) term =
  addInt
    (sumFromOneThroughInt n term)
    (term (suc n))

putnam-2013-b1 : Set
putnam-2013-b1 =
  (c : Nat -> Int) ->
  c one == pos one ->
  ((n : Nat) ->
    Positive n ->
    c (two * n) == c n) ->
  ((n : Nat) ->
    Positive n ->
    c (two * n + one) ==
    multiplyInt
      (powerInt (negsuc zero) n)
      (c n)) ->
  sumFromOneThroughInt 2013
    (\ n ->
      multiplyInt
        (c n)
        (c (n + two)))
  ==
  negsuc zero

% Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2013_b1:
% the integer sequence defined by its binary-index recurrence has adjacent
% two-step correlation sum from 1 through 2013 equal to -1. This file contains no proof.

putnam_2013_b1: THEORY
BEGIN
  integer_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> int]

  correlation_sum(
      c: integer_sequence,
      count: nat): RECURSIVE int =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      correlation_sum(c, count - 1)
        + c(count) * c(count + 2)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  putnam_2013_b1: bool =
    FORALL (c: integer_sequence):
      (c(1) = 1
        AND (FORALL (n: nat):
          n > 0 IMPLIES c(2 * n) = c(n))
        AND (FORALL (n: nat):
          n > 0 IMPLIES
            c(2 * n + 1) = ((-1) ^ n) * c(n)))
      IMPLIES correlation_sum(c, 2013) = -1
END putnam_2013_b1

title: putnam_2013_b2

import Mathlib

open Function Set

abbrev putnam_2013_b2_solution : ℝ := 3
/--
Let $C = \bigcup_{N=1}^\infty C_N$, where $C_N$ denotes the set of those `cosine polynomials' of the form
\[
f(x) = 1 + \sum_{n=1}^N a_n \cos(2 \pi n x)
\]
for which:
\begin{enumerate}
\item[(i)]
$f(x) \geq 0$ for all real $x$, and
\item[(ii)]
$a_n = 0$ whenever $n$ is a multiple of $3$.
\end{enumerate}
Determine the maximum value of $f(0)$ as $f$ ranges through $C$, and
prove that this maximum is attained.
-/
theorem putnam_2013_b2
  (CN : ℕ → Set (ℝ → ℝ))
  (hCN : ∀ N : ℕ, CN N =
    {f : ℝ → ℝ |
      (∀ x : ℝ, f x ≥ 0) ∧
      ∃ a : List ℝ, a.length = N + 1 ∧ (∀ n : Fin (N + 1), 3 ∣ (n : ℕ) → a[n]! = 0) ∧
      ∀ x : ℝ, f x = 1 + ∑ n ∈ Finset.Icc 1 N, a[(n : ℕ)]! * Real.cos (2*Real.pi*n*x)}) :
  IsGreatest {f 0 | f ∈ ⋃ N ∈ Ici 1, CN N} putnam_2013_b2_solution :=
sorry

Require Import Ensembles Finite_sets Reals Coquelicot.Coquelicot.
Definition putnam_2013_b2_solution : R := 3.
Theorem putnam_2013_b2
    (E : Ensemble (R -> R) := fun f =>
      exists (a : nat -> R) (N : nat),
        gt N 0 /\
        (forall n : nat, n mod 3 = 0%nat -> a n = 0) /\
        forall x : R,
          f x =
            1 + sum_n_m
              (fun n => a n * cos (2 * PI * INR n * x))
              1 N /\
          f x >= 0)
    : (exists f : R -> R,
        E f /\ f 0 = putnam_2013_b2_solution) /\
      (forall f : R -> R,
        E f -> f 0 <= putnam_2013_b2_solution).
Proof. Admitted.

definition putnam_2013_b2_solution :: real where

theorem putnam_2013_b2:

  and C :: "(real \<Rightarrow> real) set"
  defines "CN \<equiv> (\<lambda>N::nat. {f::real\<Rightarrow>real. (\<forall>x::real. f x \<ge> 0) \<and>

title: putnam_2013_b2
putnam_2013_b2
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2013_b2:
;; the greatest attained value at zero of nonnegative real cosine polynomials
;; whose coefficients at multiples of three vanish is 3. This file contains
;; no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))

;; CTX presents an arbitrary real-closed ordered field.  Real-closed fields
;; are elementarily equivalent, so the finite-coefficient statement below is
;; bidirectionally equivalent to the same statement over the real numbers;
;; no coefficient domain is narrowed to ACL2's rationals.
;;
;; For theta = 2*pi*x,
;;
;;   cos(n*theta) = T_n(cos(theta)),
;;
;; where T_n is the Chebyshev polynomial defined below.  As x ranges over the
;; reals, cos(2*pi*x) ranges over the entire interval [-1,1].  Consequently,
;; universal nonnegativity of the source cosine polynomial is exactly
;; universal nonnegativity of its Chebyshev form on [-1,1].  The final
;; predicate states IsGreatest at 3 as an internal attainment existential
;; together with the universal upper-bound condition.

(defun p13b2-apply1 (function argument)
  (apply$ function (list argument)))

(defun p13b2-apply2 (function left right)
  (apply$ function (list left right)))

(defun p13b2-carrier-p (ctx value)
  (if (p13b2-apply1 (nth 0 ctx) value) t nil))

(defun p13b2-zero (ctx)
  (nth 1 ctx))

(defun p13b2-one (ctx)
  (nth 2 ctx))

(defun p13b2-add-operation (ctx)
  (nth 3 ctx))

(defun p13b2-multiply-operation (ctx)
  (nth 4 ctx))

(defun p13b2-negate-operation (ctx)
  (nth 5 ctx))

(defun p13b2-inverse-operation (ctx)
  (nth 6 ctx))

(defun p13b2-less-operation (ctx)
  (nth 7 ctx))

(defun p13b2-add (ctx left right)
  (p13b2-apply2
   (p13b2-add-operation ctx) left right))

(defun p13b2-multiply (ctx left right)
  (p13b2-apply2
   (p13b2-multiply-operation ctx) left right))

(defun p13b2-negate (ctx value)
  (p13b2-apply1
   (p13b2-negate-operation ctx) value))

(defun p13b2-inverse (ctx value)
  (p13b2-apply1
   (p13b2-inverse-operation ctx) value))

(defun p13b2-less-p (ctx left right)
  (if (p13b2-apply2
       (p13b2-less-operation ctx) left right)
      t
    nil))

(defun p13b2-less-equal-p (ctx left right)
  (not (p13b2-less-p ctx right left)))

(defun-sk p13b2-field-laws-p (ctx)
  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (p13b2-carrier-p ctx x)
      (p13b2-carrier-p ctx y)
      (p13b2-carrier-p ctx z))
     (let* ((zero (p13b2-zero ctx))
            (one (p13b2-one ctx))
            (x-plus-y (p13b2-add ctx x y))
            (y-plus-z (p13b2-add ctx y z))
            (x-times-y (p13b2-multiply ctx x y))
            (y-times-z (p13b2-multiply ctx y z))
            (minus-x (p13b2-negate ctx x))
            (inverse-x (p13b2-inverse ctx x)))
       (and
        (p13b2-carrier-p ctx x-plus-y)
        (p13b2-carrier-p ctx x-times-y)
        (p13b2-carrier-p ctx minus-x)
        (p13b2-carrier-p ctx inverse-x)
        (equal
         (p13b2-add ctx x-plus-y z)
         (p13b2-add ctx x y-plus-z))
        (equal x-plus-y (p13b2-add ctx y x))
        (equal (p13b2-add ctx x zero) x)
        (equal (p13b2-add ctx x minus-x) zero)
        (equal
         (p13b2-multiply ctx x-times-y z)
         (p13b2-multiply ctx x y-times-z))
        (equal x-times-y (p13b2-multiply ctx y x))
        (equal (p13b2-multiply ctx x one) x)
        (implies
         (equal x zero)
         (equal inverse-x zero))
        (implies
         (not (equal x zero))
         (equal
          (p13b2-multiply ctx x inverse-x)
          one))
        (equal
         (p13b2-multiply ctx x y-plus-z)
         (p13b2-add
          ctx
          (p13b2-multiply ctx x y)
          (p13b2-multiply ctx x z))))))))

(defun-sk p13b2-order-laws-p (ctx)
  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (p13b2-carrier-p ctx x)
      (p13b2-carrier-p ctx y)
      (p13b2-carrier-p ctx z))
     (let ((zero (p13b2-zero ctx)))
       (and
        (not (p13b2-less-p ctx x x))
        (or
         (p13b2-less-p ctx x y)
         (equal x y)
         (p13b2-less-p ctx y x))
        (implies
         (and
          (p13b2-less-p ctx x y)
          (p13b2-less-p ctx y z))
         (p13b2-less-p ctx x z))
        (implies
         (p13b2-less-p ctx x y)
         (p13b2-less-p
          ctx
          (p13b2-add ctx x z)
          (p13b2-add ctx y z)))
        (implies
         (and
          (p13b2-less-p ctx zero x)
          (p13b2-less-p ctx zero y))
         (p13b2-less-p
          ctx
          zero
          (p13b2-multiply ctx x y))))))))

(defun p13b2-coefficient-list-p (ctx coefficients)
  (if (consp coefficients)
      (and
       (p13b2-carrier-p ctx (car coefficients))
       (p13b2-coefficient-list-p
        ctx (cdr coefficients)))
    (equal coefficients nil)))

(defun p13b2-polynomial-p (ctx coefficients)
  (and
   (true-listp coefficients)
   (consp coefficients)
   (p13b2-coefficient-list-p ctx coefficients)
   (not
    (equal
     (car (last coefficients))
     (p13b2-zero ctx)))))

(defun p13b2-polynomial-evaluate (ctx coefficients x)
  (if (consp coefficients)
      (p13b2-add
       ctx
       (car coefficients)
       (p13b2-multiply
        ctx
        x
        (p13b2-polynomial-evaluate
         ctx (cdr coefficients) x)))
    (p13b2-zero ctx)))

(defun-sk p13b2-positive-square-root-exists-p
    (ctx value)
  (exists (root)
    (and
     (p13b2-carrier-p ctx root)
     (equal
      (p13b2-multiply ctx root root)
      value))))

(defun-sk p13b2-positive-square-root-law-p (ctx)
  (forall (value)
    (implies
     (and
      (p13b2-carrier-p ctx value)
      (p13b2-less-p
       ctx (p13b2-zero ctx) value))
     (p13b2-positive-square-root-exists-p
      ctx value))))

(defun-sk p13b2-odd-polynomial-root-exists-p
    (ctx coefficients)
  (exists (root)
    (and
     (p13b2-carrier-p ctx root)
     (equal
      (p13b2-polynomial-evaluate
       ctx coefficients root)
      (p13b2-zero ctx)))))

(defun-sk p13b2-odd-polynomial-root-law-p (ctx)
  (forall (coefficients)
    (implies
     (and
      (p13b2-polynomial-p ctx coefficients)
      (evenp (len coefficients)))
     (p13b2-odd-polynomial-root-exists-p
      ctx coefficients))))

(defun p13b2-real-closed-field-p (ctx)
  (and
   (true-listp ctx)
   (equal (len ctx) 8)
   (tamep-functionp (nth 0 ctx))
   (tamep-functionp (nth 3 ctx))
   (tamep-functionp (nth 4 ctx))
   (tamep-functionp (nth 5 ctx))
   (tamep-functionp (nth 6 ctx))
   (tamep-functionp (nth 7 ctx))
   (p13b2-carrier-p ctx (p13b2-zero ctx))
   (p13b2-carrier-p ctx (p13b2-one ctx))
   (not (equal (p13b2-zero ctx) (p13b2-one ctx)))
   (p13b2-field-laws-p ctx)
   (p13b2-order-laws-p ctx)
   (p13b2-less-p
    ctx (p13b2-zero ctx) (p13b2-one ctx))
   (p13b2-positive-square-root-law-p ctx)
   (p13b2-odd-polynomial-root-law-p ctx)))

(defun p13b2-two (ctx)
  (p13b2-add ctx (p13b2-one ctx) (p13b2-one ctx)))

(defun p13b2-three (ctx)
  (p13b2-add ctx (p13b2-one ctx) (p13b2-two ctx)))

(defun p13b2-chebyshev (ctx degree x)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix degree)))
  (cond
   ((zp degree)
    (p13b2-one ctx))
   ((equal degree 1)
    x)
   (t
    (p13b2-add
     ctx
     (p13b2-multiply
      ctx
      (p13b2-multiply ctx (p13b2-two ctx) x)
      (p13b2-chebyshev ctx (- degree 1) x))
     (p13b2-negate
      ctx
      (p13b2-chebyshev ctx (- degree 2) x))))))

(defun p13b2-forbidden-zeroes-p
    (ctx coefficients index)
  (if (consp coefficients)
      (and
       (implies
        (equal (mod index 3) 0)
        (equal (car coefficients) (p13b2-zero ctx)))
       (p13b2-forbidden-zeroes-p
        ctx (cdr coefficients) (+ index 1)))
    (equal coefficients nil)))

(defun p13b2-eligible-coefficients-p
    (ctx degree coefficients)
  (and
   (posp degree)
   (true-listp coefficients)
   (equal (len coefficients) (+ degree 1))
   (p13b2-coefficient-list-p ctx coefficients)
   (p13b2-forbidden-zeroes-p ctx coefficients 0)))

(defun p13b2-cosine-polynomial-value
    (ctx coefficients degree cosine-value)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix degree)))
  (if (zp degree)
      (p13b2-one ctx)
    (p13b2-add
     ctx
     (p13b2-multiply
      ctx
      (nth degree coefficients)
      (p13b2-chebyshev ctx degree cosine-value))
     (p13b2-cosine-polynomial-value
      ctx coefficients (- degree 1) cosine-value))))

(defun-sk p13b2-nonnegative-p
    (ctx degree coefficients)
  (forall (cosine-value)
    (implies
     (and
      (p13b2-carrier-p ctx cosine-value)
      (p13b2-less-equal-p
       ctx
       (p13b2-negate ctx (p13b2-one ctx))
       cosine-value)
      (p13b2-less-equal-p
       ctx cosine-value (p13b2-one ctx)))
     (p13b2-less-equal-p
      ctx
      (p13b2-zero ctx)
      (p13b2-cosine-polynomial-value
       ctx coefficients degree cosine-value)))))

(defun-sk p13b2-three-is-attained-p (ctx)
  (exists (degree coefficients)
    (and
     (p13b2-eligible-coefficients-p
      ctx degree coefficients)
     (p13b2-nonnegative-p
      ctx degree coefficients)
     (equal
      (p13b2-cosine-polynomial-value
       ctx coefficients degree (p13b2-one ctx))
      (p13b2-three ctx)))))

(defun-sk p13b2-three-is-upper-bound-p (ctx)
  (forall (degree coefficients)
    (implies
     (and
      (p13b2-eligible-coefficients-p
       ctx degree coefficients)
      (p13b2-nonnegative-p
       ctx degree coefficients))
     (p13b2-less-equal-p
      ctx
      (p13b2-cosine-polynomial-value
       ctx coefficients degree (p13b2-one ctx))
      (p13b2-three ctx)))))

(defun putnambench-putnam-2013-b2-statement (ctx)
  (implies
   (p13b2-real-closed-field-p ctx)
   (and
    (p13b2-three-is-attained-p ctx)
    (p13b2-three-is-upper-bound-p ctx))))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

title: putnam_2013_b2
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2013_b2
-- (putnambench__agda__putnam_2013_b2): the maximum at zero among nonnegative
-- real cosine polynomials whose coefficients at multiples of three vanish is
-- 3, and this maximum is attained. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module Putnam2013B2 where

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; _*_)

infix 4 _!=_ _<=N_
infixr 3 _and_
infixr 2 _or_

data Bottom : Set where

Not : Set -> Set
Not A =
  A -> Bottom

_!=_ : {A : Set} -> A -> A -> Set
x != y =
  Not (x == y)

record _and_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data _or_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  left  : A -> A or B
  right : B -> A or B

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

data _<=N_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set where
  zero<=N   : {n : Nat} -> zero <=N n
  suc<=sucN : {m n : Nat} -> m <=N n -> suc m <=N suc n

oneN : Nat
oneN =
  suc zero

twoN : Nat
twoN =
  suc oneN

threeN : Nat
threeN =
  suc twoN

fourN : Nat
fourN =
  twoN + twoN

record CompleteOrderedRealField (R : Set) : Set1 where
  field
    zeroR oneR : R
    add multiply : R -> R -> R
    negate inverse : R -> R
    lessOrEqual : R -> R -> Set
    fromNat : Nat -> R

    one-not-zero :
      oneR != zeroR

    add-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> add x y == add y x
    add-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      add (add x y) z == add x (add y z)
    add-zero :
      (x : R) -> add x zeroR == x
    add-inverse :
      (x : R) -> add x (negate x) == zeroR

    multiply-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> multiply x y == multiply y x
    multiply-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply (multiply x y) z ==
      multiply x (multiply y z)
    multiply-one :
      (x : R) -> multiply x oneR == x
    multiply-zero :
      (x : R) -> multiply x zeroR == zeroR
    distribute :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply x (add y z) ==
      add (multiply x y) (multiply x z)
    inverse-zero :
      inverse zeroR == zeroR
    multiply-inverse :
      (x : R) ->
      x != zeroR ->
      multiply x (inverse x) == oneR

    order-reflexive :
      (x : R) -> lessOrEqual x x
    order-transitive :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y z ->
      lessOrEqual x z
    order-antisymmetric :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y x ->
      x == y
    order-total :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y or lessOrEqual y x
    add-order :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual (add z x) (add z y)
    multiply-nonnegative :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR x ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR y ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR (multiply x y)
    zero-less-than-one :
      lessOrEqual zeroR oneR and zeroR != oneR

    fromNat-zero :
      fromNat zero == zeroR
    fromNat-successor :
      (n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (suc n) == add (fromNat n) oneR
    fromNat-addition :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m + n) == add (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-multiplication :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m * n) == multiply (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-injective :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat m == fromNat n ->
      m == n

    archimedean :
      (x : R) ->
      Exists Nat (\ n -> lessOrEqual x (fromNat n))
    least-upper-bound :
      (P : R -> Set) ->
      Exists R P ->
      Exists R
        (\ upper ->
          (x : R) ->
          P x ->
          lessOrEqual x upper) ->
      Exists R
        (\ supremum ->
          ((x : R) ->
            P x ->
            lessOrEqual x supremum)
          and
          ((upper : R) ->
            ((x : R) ->
              P x ->
              lessOrEqual x upper) ->
            lessOrEqual supremum upper))

open CompleteOrderedRealField

subtract :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
subtract reals x y =
  add reals x (negate reals y)

divide :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
divide reals x y =
  multiply reals x (inverse reals y)

StrictLess :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
StrictLess reals x y =
  lessOrEqual reals x y and x != y

CloseTo :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
CloseTo reals center radius x =
  StrictLess reals
    (subtract reals center radius)
    x
  and
  StrictLess reals
    x
    (add reals center radius)

naturalPower :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  Nat ->
  R
naturalPower reals x zero =
  oneR reals
naturalPower reals x (suc n) =
  multiply reals
    (naturalPower reals x n)
    x

factorial : Nat -> Nat
factorial zero =
  oneN
factorial (suc n) =
  suc n * factorial n

sumFirst :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Nat ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  R
sumFirst reals zero term =
  zeroR reals
sumFirst reals (suc n) term =
  add reals
    (sumFirst reals n term)
    (term n)

ConvergesTo :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  R ->
  Set
ConvergesTo {R} reals sequence limit =
  (epsilon : R) ->
  StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) epsilon ->
  Exists Nat
    (\ cutoff ->
      (n : Nat) ->
      cutoff <=N n ->
      CloseTo reals limit epsilon (sequence n))

SeriesHasSum :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  R ->
  Set
SeriesHasSum reals terms limit =
  ConvergesTo reals
    (\ n -> sumFirst reals n terms)
    limit

alternatingPower :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Nat ->
  R
alternatingPower reals n =
  naturalPower reals
    (negate reals (oneR reals))
    n

cosineTerm :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  Nat ->
  R
cosineTerm reals x n =
  divide reals
    (multiply reals
      (alternatingPower reals n)
      (naturalPower reals x (twoN * n)))
    (fromNat reals (factorial (twoN * n)))

leibnizTerm :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Nat ->
  R
leibnizTerm reals n =
  divide reals
    (alternatingPower reals n)
    (fromNat reals (suc (twoN * n)))

record StandardCosine
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) : Set1 where
  field
    cosine : R -> R
    pi : R
    cosine-series :
      (x : R) ->
      SeriesHasSum reals
        (cosineTerm reals x)
        (cosine x)
    pi-positive :
      StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) pi
    pi-leibniz-series :
      SeriesHasSum reals
        (leibnizTerm reals)
        (divide reals pi (fromNat reals fourN))

open StandardCosine

Divides : Nat -> Nat -> Set
Divides divisor number =
  Exists Nat
    (\ quotient -> divisor * quotient == number)

sumFromOne :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Nat ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  R
sumFromOne reals zero term =
  zeroR reals
sumFromOne reals (suc n) term =
  add reals
    (sumFromOne reals n term)
    (term (suc n))

CosinePolynomial :
  {R : Set} ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) ->
  StandardCosine reals ->
  (R -> R) ->
  Set
CosinePolynomial {R} reals trigonometry function =
  Exists Nat
    (\ degree ->
      oneN <=N degree
      and
      Exists (Nat -> R)
        (\ coefficient ->
          ((n : Nat) ->
            n <=N degree ->
            Divides threeN n ->
            coefficient n == zeroR reals)
          and
          ((x : R) ->
            function x ==
            add reals
              (oneR reals)
              (sumFromOne reals degree
                (\ n ->
                  multiply reals
                    (coefficient n)
                    (cosine trigonometry
                      (multiply reals
                        (multiply reals
                          (multiply reals
                            (fromNat reals twoN)
                            (pi trigonometry))
                          (fromNat reals n))
                        x)))))
          and
          ((x : R) ->
            lessOrEqual reals
              (zeroR reals)
              (function x))))

record IsGreatestValueAtZero
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R)
  (trigonometry : StandardCosine reals)
  (greatest : R) : Set1 where

  field
    attained :
      Exists (R -> R)
        (\ function ->
          CosinePolynomial reals trigonometry function
          and
          function (zeroR reals) == greatest)

    upper-bound :
      (function : R -> R) ->
      CosinePolynomial reals trigonometry function ->
      lessOrEqual reals
        (function (zeroR reals))
        greatest

putnam-2013-b2 : Set1
putnam-2013-b2 =
  (R : Set) ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) ->
  (trigonometry : StandardCosine reals) ->
  IsGreatestValueAtZero reals trigonometry
    (fromNat reals threeN)

(*
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2013_b2:
  nonnegative finite cosine polynomials whose coefficients at multiples of
  three vanish have attained maximum value 3 at zero. This file contains no
  proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open arithmeticTheory pred_setTheory realTheory transcTheory;

val putnam_2013_b2 =
  ``let C =
      \f : real -> real.
        ?N : num.
          1 <= N /\
          ?a : num -> real.
            (!n : num.
               1 <= n /\ n <= N /\ divides 3 n
               ==>
               a n = 0) /\
            (!x : real. 0 <= f x) /\
            (!x : real.
               f x =
                 1 +
                 SIGMA
                   (\n : num.
                      a n * cos (2 * pi * (&n : real) * x))
                   (IMAGE SUC (count N)))
    in
    let solution = (3 : real)
    in
      (!f : real -> real. C f ==> f 0 <= solution) /\
      (?f : real -> real. C f /\ f 0 = solution)``;

title: putnam_2013_b2
content:
% Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2013_b2:
% nonnegative finite cosine polynomials whose coefficients at multiples of
% three vanish have attained maximum value 3 at zero. This file contains no proof.

putnam_2013_b2: THEORY
BEGIN
  real_function: TYPE = [real -> real]
  real_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> real]

  safe_div(numerator, denominator: real): real =
    IF denominator = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      numerator / denominator
    ENDIF

  factorial(index: nat): RECURSIVE nat =
    IF index = 0 THEN
      1
    ELSE
      index * factorial(index - 1)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE index

  cosine_partial(argument: real, count: nat): RECURSIVE real =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      LET index: nat = count - 1 IN
        cosine_partial(argument, count - 1)
          + safe_div(
              ((-1 :: real) ^ index) * argument ^ (2 * index),
              factorial(2 * index) :: real)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  converges_to(sequence: real_sequence, value: real): bool =
    FORALL (epsilon_value: posreal):
      EXISTS (cutoff: nat):
        FORALL (index: nat):
          cutoff <= index IMPLIES
            abs(sequence(index) - value) < epsilon_value

  cosine(argument: real): real =
    epsilon(
      LAMBDA (value: real):
        converges_to(
          LAMBDA (count: nat):
            cosine_partial(argument, count),
          value))

  pi: real =
    epsilon(
      LAMBDA (value: real):
        3 < value
          AND value < 4
          AND cosine(value / 2) = 0)

  cosine_sum(
      coefficients: real_sequence,
      x: real,
      degree: nat): RECURSIVE real =
    IF degree = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      cosine_sum(coefficients, x, degree - 1)
        + coefficients(degree)
            * cosine(2 * pi * (degree :: real) * x)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE degree

  admissible_cosine_polynomial(f: real_function): bool =
    EXISTS (degree: nat), (coefficients: real_sequence):
      degree >= 1
        AND (FORALL (index: nat):
          (index <= degree AND mod(index, 3) = 0)
            IMPLIES coefficients(index) = 0)
        AND (FORALL (x: real):
          f(x) = 1 + cosine_sum(coefficients, x, degree)
            AND f(x) >= 0)

  attainable_value(value: real): bool =
    EXISTS (f: real_function):
      admissible_cosine_polynomial(f)
        AND f(0) = value

  putnam_2013_b2_solution: real = 3

  putnam_2013_b2: bool =
    attainable_value(putnam_2013_b2_solution)
      AND (FORALL (f: real_function):
        admissible_cosine_polynomial(f)
          IMPLIES f(0) <= putnam_2013_b2_solution)
END putnam_2013_b2

import Mathlib

open Function Set

abbrev putnam_2013_b3_solution : Prop := True
/--
Let $\mathcal{P}$ be a nonempty collection of subsets of $\{1,\dots, n\}$ such that: \begin{enumerate} \item[(i)] if $S, S' \in \mathcal{P}$, then $S \cup S' \in \mathcal{P}$ and $S \cap S' \in \mathcal{P}$, and \item[(ii)] if $S \in \mathcal{P}$ and $S \neq \emptyset$, then there is a subset $T \subset S$ such that $T \in \mathcal{P}$ and $T$ contains exactly one fewer element than $S$. \end{enumerate} Suppose that $f: \mathcal{P} \to \mathbb{R}$ is a function such that $f(\emptyset) = 0$ and \[f(S \cup S') = f(S) + f(S') - f(S \cap S') \mbox{ for all $S,S' \in \mathcal{P}$.} \] Must there exist real numbers $f_1,\dots,f_n$ such that\[f(S) = \sum_{i \in S} f_i\] \n for every $S \in \mathcal{P}$?
-/
theorem putnam_2013_b3
: (∀ (n : ℕ) (P : Finset (Finset (Fin n))) (f : Finset (Fin n) → ℝ),
      P ≠ ⊥ → (∀ S ∈ P, ∀ S' ∈ P, S ∪ S' ∈ P ∧ S ∩ S' ∈ P) →
      (∀ S ∈ P, S ≠ ⊥ → ∃ T ∈ P, T ⊂ S ∧ Finset.card T + 1 = Finset.card S) →
      f ⊥ = 0 → (∀ S ∈ P, ∀ S' ∈ P, f (S ∪ S') = f S + f S' - f (S ∩ S')) →
      ∃ r : Fin n → ℝ, ∀ S ∈ P, f S = ∑ i ∈ S, r i)
      ↔ putnam_2013_b3_solution :=
sorry

title: putnam_2013_b3
content:
(* Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2013_b3:
   additive representation of a real-valued valuation on a finite lattice of
   subsets satisfying a one-element deletion condition. This file contains no
   proof. *)

From Stdlib Require Import Reals Lists.List Vectors.Vector.

Open Scope R_scope.

Definition putnam_2013_b3_subset (n : nat) : Type :=
  Vector.t bool n.

Definition putnam_2013_b3_empty (n : nat) :
    putnam_2013_b3_subset n :=
  Vector.const false n.

Definition putnam_2013_b3_union
    {n : nat}
    (S T : putnam_2013_b3_subset n) :
    putnam_2013_b3_subset n :=
  Vector.map2 orb S T.

Definition putnam_2013_b3_intersection
    {n : nat}
    (S T : putnam_2013_b3_subset n) :
    putnam_2013_b3_subset n :=
  Vector.map2 andb S T.

Definition putnam_2013_b3_subseteq
    {n : nat}
    (S T : putnam_2013_b3_subset n) : Prop :=
  forall i : Fin.t n,
    Vector.nth S i = true ->
    Vector.nth T i = true.

Definition putnam_2013_b3_proper_subset
    {n : nat}
    (S T : putnam_2013_b3_subset n) : Prop :=
  putnam_2013_b3_subseteq S T /\ S <> T.

Definition putnam_2013_b3_card
    {n : nat}
    (S : putnam_2013_b3_subset n) : nat :=
  Vector.fold_left
    (fun (count : nat) (present : bool) =>
      if present then Nat.succ count else count)
    0%nat S.

Definition putnam_2013_b3_weighted_sum
    {n : nat}
    (S : putnam_2013_b3_subset n)
    (weights : Vector.t R n) : R :=
  Vector.fold_left2
    (fun (total : R) (present : bool) (weight : R) =>
      if present then total + weight else total)
    0 S weights.

Definition putnam_2013_b3_solution : Prop := True.

Theorem putnam_2013_b3 :
  (forall
      (n : nat)
      (P : list (putnam_2013_b3_subset n))
      (f : putnam_2013_b3_subset n -> R),
      P <> List.nil ->
      (forall S T : putnam_2013_b3_subset n,
        List.In S P ->
        List.In T P ->
        List.In (putnam_2013_b3_union S T) P /\
        List.In (putnam_2013_b3_intersection S T) P) ->
      (forall S : putnam_2013_b3_subset n,
        List.In S P ->
        S <> putnam_2013_b3_empty n ->
        exists T : putnam_2013_b3_subset n,
          List.In T P /\
          putnam_2013_b3_proper_subset T S /\
          (putnam_2013_b3_card T + 1 =
           putnam_2013_b3_card S)%nat) ->
      f (putnam_2013_b3_empty n) = 0 ->
      (forall S T : putnam_2013_b3_subset n,
        List.In S P ->
        List.In T P ->
        f (putnam_2013_b3_union S T) =
          f S + f T - f (putnam_2013_b3_intersection S T)) ->
      exists weights : Vector.t R n,
        forall S : putnam_2013_b3_subset n,
          List.In S P ->
          f S = putnam_2013_b3_weighted_sum S weights) <->
  putnam_2013_b3_solution.
Admitted.
