  every valuation on a nonempty union- and intersection-closed family of
  finite subsets with one-element descent is a sum of element weights.
  This file contains no proof.
*)

let statement =
  `!n:num. !P:(num->bool)->bool. !f:(num->bool)->real.
     ~(P = {}) /\
     (!S:num->bool. S IN P ==> S SUBSET (1..n)) /\
     (!S S':num->bool.
        S IN P /\ S' IN P
        ==> S UNION S' IN P /\ S INTER S' IN P) /\
     (!S:num->bool.
        S IN P /\ ~(S = {})
        ==> ?t:num->bool.
              t IN P /\ t PSUBSET S /\ CARD t + 1 = CARD S) /\
     f {} = &0 /\
     (!S S':num->bool.
        S IN P /\ S' IN P
        ==> f (S UNION S') = f S + f S' - f (S INTER S'))
     ==> ?r:num->real.
           !S:num->bool. S IN P ==> f S = sum S r`;;

title: putnam_2013_b3
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2013_b3:
;; every normalized modular real valuation on the specified finite lattice of
;; subsets is a sum of element weights. This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

;; An n-bit natural is the characteristic function of a subset of Fin n.
;; Duplicate-free lists therefore represent the source finsets exactly.

(defun putnam-2013-b3-mask-union (left right width)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix width)))
  (if (zp width)
      0
    (+ (if (or (equal (mod left 2) 1)
               (equal (mod right 2) 1))
           1
         0)
       (* 2
          (putnam-2013-b3-mask-union
           (floor left 2)
           (floor right 2)
           (- width 1))))))

(defun putnam-2013-b3-mask-intersection (left right width)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix width)))
  (if (zp width)
      0
    (+ (if (and (equal (mod left 2) 1)
                (equal (mod right 2) 1))
           1
         0)
       (* 2
          (putnam-2013-b3-mask-intersection
           (floor left 2)
           (floor right 2)
           (- width 1))))))

(defun putnam-2013-b3-mask-card (mask width)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix width)))
  (if (zp width)
      0
    (+ (if (equal (mod mask 2) 1) 1 0)
       (putnam-2013-b3-mask-card
        (floor mask 2)
        (- width 1)))))

(defun putnam-2013-b3-valid-masks-p (family bound)
  (if (consp family)
      (and (natp (car family))
           (< (car family) bound)
           (putnam-2013-b3-valid-masks-p
            (cdr family)
            bound))
    (equal family nil)))

(defun putnam-2013-b3-closure-row-p
    (left rights family width)
  (if (consp rights)
      (and
       (member-equal
        (putnam-2013-b3-mask-union
         left (car rights) width)
        family)
       (member-equal
        (putnam-2013-b3-mask-intersection
         left (car rights) width)
        family)
       (putnam-2013-b3-closure-row-p
        left (cdr rights) family width))
    (equal rights nil)))

(defun putnam-2013-b3-closed-family-p
    (remaining family width)
  (if (consp remaining)
      (and
       (putnam-2013-b3-closure-row-p
        (car remaining) family family width)
       (putnam-2013-b3-closed-family-p
        (cdr remaining) family width))
    (equal remaining nil)))

(defun putnam-2013-b3-lower-cover-exists-p
    (set family width)
  (if (consp family)
      (let ((candidate (car family)))
        (or
         (and
          (not (equal candidate set))
          (equal
           (putnam-2013-b3-mask-intersection
            candidate set width)
           candidate)
          (equal
           (+ (putnam-2013-b3-mask-card
               candidate width)
              1)
           (putnam-2013-b3-mask-card
            set width)))
         (putnam-2013-b3-lower-cover-exists-p
          set (cdr family) width)))
    nil))

(defun putnam-2013-b3-graded-family-p
    (remaining family width)
  (if (consp remaining)
      (and
       (or
        (equal (car remaining) 0)
        (putnam-2013-b3-lower-cover-exists-p
         (car remaining) family width))
       (putnam-2013-b3-graded-family-p
        (cdr remaining) family width))
    (equal remaining nil)))

(defun putnam-2013-b3-rational-list-p (values)
  (if (consp values)
      (and (rationalp (car values))
           (putnam-2013-b3-rational-list-p
            (cdr values)))
    (equal values nil)))

(defun putnam-2013-b3-valuation-row-p
    (left rights values width)
  (if (consp rights)
      (let* ((right (car rights))
             (union
              (putnam-2013-b3-mask-union
               left right width))
             (intersection
              (putnam-2013-b3-mask-intersection
               left right width)))
        (and
         (equal
          (nth union values)
          (-
           (+ (nth left values)
              (nth right values))
           (nth intersection values)))
         (putnam-2013-b3-valuation-row-p
          left (cdr rights) values width)))
    (equal rights nil)))

(defun putnam-2013-b3-valuation-p
    (remaining family values width)
  (if (consp remaining)
      (and
       (putnam-2013-b3-valuation-row-p
        (car remaining) family values width)
       (putnam-2013-b3-valuation-p
        (cdr remaining) family values width))
    (equal remaining nil)))

;; For a fixed family, the desired weights solve the incidence system whose
;; row for S has coefficient 1 at exactly the elements of S and right-hand
;; side f(S). A rational matrix system is solvable exactly when its coefficient
;; and augmented ranks agree.

(defun putnam-2013-b3-incidence-row (mask width)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix width)))
  (if (zp width)
      nil
    (cons
     (if (equal (mod mask 2) 1) 1 0)
     (putnam-2013-b3-incidence-row
      (floor mask 2)
      (- width 1)))))

(defun putnam-2013-b3-coefficient-rows (family width)
  (if (consp family)
      (cons
       (putnam-2013-b3-incidence-row
        (car family) width)
       (putnam-2013-b3-coefficient-rows
        (cdr family) width))
    nil))

(defun putnam-2013-b3-augmented-rows
    (family values width)
  (if (consp family)
      (cons
       (append
        (putnam-2013-b3-incidence-row
         (car family) width)
        (list (nth (car family) values)))
       (putnam-2013-b3-augmented-rows
        (cdr family) values width))
    nil))

(defun putnam-2013-b3-first-pivot-row (rows column)
  (if (consp rows)
      (if (equal (nth column (car rows)) 0)
          (putnam-2013-b3-first-pivot-row
           (cdr rows) column)
        (car rows))
    nil))

(defun putnam-2013-b3-remove-first-row (row rows)
  (if (consp rows)
      (if (equal row (car rows))
          (cdr rows)
        (cons
         (car rows)
         (putnam-2013-b3-remove-first-row
          row (cdr rows))))
    nil))

(defun putnam-2013-b3-eliminate-vector
    (row pivot factor)
  (if (and (consp row)
           (consp pivot))
      (cons
       (- (car row)
          (* factor (car pivot)))
       (putnam-2013-b3-eliminate-vector
        (cdr row) (cdr pivot) factor))
    nil))

(defun putnam-2013-b3-eliminate-rows
    (rows pivot column pivot-entry)
  (if (consp rows)
      (cons
       (putnam-2013-b3-eliminate-vector
        (car rows)
        pivot
        (/ (nth column (car rows))
           pivot-entry))
       (putnam-2013-b3-eliminate-rows
        (cdr rows)
        pivot
        column
        pivot-entry))
    nil))

(defun putnam-2013-b3-row-rank-aux
    (rows column columns-left)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix columns-left)))
  (if (or (zp columns-left)
          (endp rows))
      0
    (let ((pivot
           (putnam-2013-b3-first-pivot-row
            rows column)))
      (if (not pivot)
          (putnam-2013-b3-row-rank-aux
           rows
           (+ column 1)
           (- columns-left 1))
        (+ 1
           (putnam-2013-b3-row-rank-aux
            (putnam-2013-b3-eliminate-rows
             (putnam-2013-b3-remove-first-row
              pivot rows)
             pivot
             column
             (nth column pivot))
            (+ column 1)
            (- columns-left 1)))))))

(defun putnam-2013-b3-row-rank (rows width)
  (putnam-2013-b3-row-rank-aux rows 0 width))

(defun putnam-2013-b3-weight-representation-exists-p
    (family values width)
  (equal
   (putnam-2013-b3-row-rank
    (putnam-2013-b3-coefficient-rows
     family width)
    width)
   (putnam-2013-b3-row-rank
    (putnam-2013-b3-augmented-rows
     family values width)
    (+ width 1))))

;; The source quantifies over real f and real weights. For each fixed finite
;; family, both its valuation hypotheses and its incidence conclusion are
;; linear systems with integer coefficients. A real counterexample exists iff
;; the corresponding rational subspace inclusion fails, and rational Gaussian
;; elimination then supplies a rational counterexample. Conversely every
;; rational counterexample is real. Thus the universal rational predicate below
;; is bidirectionally equivalent to the source's universal real proposition;
;; it does not narrow the theorem to a proper class of cases.

(defun putnambench-putnam-2013-b3-statement
    (n family values)
  (implies
   (and
    (natp n)
    (true-listp family)
    (consp family)
    (no-duplicatesp-equal family)
    (putnam-2013-b3-valid-masks-p
     family (expt 2 n))
    (putnam-2013-b3-closed-family-p
     family family n)
    (putnam-2013-b3-graded-family-p
     family family n)
    (true-listp values)
    (equal (len values) (expt 2 n))
    (putnam-2013-b3-rational-list-p values)
    (equal (nth 0 values) 0)
    (putnam-2013-b3-valuation-p
     family family values n))
   (putnam-2013-b3-weight-representation-exists-p
    family values n)))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

title: putnam_2013_b3
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2013_b3
-- (putnambench__agda__putnam_2013_b3): additive representation of a real
-- valuation on a finite family of subsets closed under unions and intersections.
-- This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module Main where

open import Agda.Builtin.Bool using (Bool; false; true)
open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_)

infix 4 _!=_
infixr 3 _and_
infixr 2 _or_

data Bottom : Set where

data Top : Set where
  trivial : Top

Not : Set -> Set
Not A =
  A -> Bottom

_!=_ : {A : Set} -> A -> A -> Set
x != y =
  Not (x == y)

record _and_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data _or_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  left  : A -> A or B
  right : B -> A or B

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

record CompleteOrderedRealField (R : Set) : Set1 where
  field
    zeroR oneR : R
    add multiply : R -> R -> R
    negate inverse : R -> R
    lessOrEqual : R -> R -> Set

    one-not-zero :
      oneR != zeroR

    add-commutative :
      (x y : R) ->
      add x y == add y x
    add-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      add (add x y) z == add x (add y z)
    add-zero :
      (x : R) ->
      add x zeroR == x
    add-inverse :
      (x : R) ->
      add x (negate x) == zeroR

    multiply-commutative :
      (x y : R) ->
      multiply x y == multiply y x
    multiply-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply (multiply x y) z ==
      multiply x (multiply y z)
    multiply-one :
      (x : R) ->
      multiply x oneR == x
    multiply-zero :
      (x : R) ->
      multiply x zeroR == zeroR
    distribute :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply x (add y z) ==
      add (multiply x y) (multiply x z)
    inverse-zero :
      inverse zeroR == zeroR
    multiply-inverse :
      (x : R) ->
      x != zeroR ->
      multiply x (inverse x) == oneR

    order-reflexive :
      (x : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x x
    order-transitive :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y z ->
      lessOrEqual x z
    order-antisymmetric :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y x ->
      x == y
    order-total :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y or lessOrEqual y x
    add-order :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual (add z x) (add z y)
    multiply-nonnegative :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR x ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR y ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR (multiply x y)
    zero-less-than-one :
      lessOrEqual zeroR oneR and zeroR != oneR

    least-upper-bound :
      (P : R -> Set) ->
      Exists R P ->
      Exists R
        (\ upper ->
          (x : R) ->
          P x ->
          lessOrEqual x upper) ->
      Exists R
        (\ supremum ->
          ((x : R) ->
            P x ->
            lessOrEqual x supremum)
          and
          ((upper : R) ->
            ((x : R) ->
              P x ->
              lessOrEqual x upper) ->
            lessOrEqual supremum upper))

open CompleteOrderedRealField

subtract :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
subtract reals x y =
  add reals x (negate reals y)

data Fin : Nat -> Set where
  fzero : {n : Nat} -> Fin (suc n)
  fsuc  : {n : Nat} -> Fin n -> Fin (suc n)

data FiniteSubset : Nat -> Set where
  emptySubset : FiniteSubset zero
  addBit      : {n : Nat} -> Bool -> FiniteSubset n -> FiniteSubset (suc n)

data IsTrue : Bool -> Set where
  true-witness : IsTrue true

emptyFor : (n : Nat) -> FiniteSubset n
emptyFor zero =
  emptySubset
emptyFor (suc n) =
  addBit false (emptyFor n)

boolAnd : Bool -> Bool -> Bool
boolAnd false second-bit =
  false
boolAnd true second-bit =
  second-bit

boolOr : Bool -> Bool -> Bool
boolOr false second-bit =
  second-bit
boolOr true second-bit =
  true

intersection :
  {n : Nat} ->
  FiniteSubset n ->
  FiniteSubset n ->
  FiniteSubset n
intersection emptySubset emptySubset =
  emptySubset
intersection (addBit left-bit left-tail) (addBit right-bit right-tail) =
  addBit
    (boolAnd left-bit right-bit)
    (intersection left-tail right-tail)

union :
  {n : Nat} ->
  FiniteSubset n ->
  FiniteSubset n ->
  FiniteSubset n
union emptySubset emptySubset =
  emptySubset
union (addBit left-bit left-tail) (addBit right-bit right-tail) =
  addBit
    (boolOr left-bit right-bit)
    (union left-tail right-tail)

data BitIncluded : Bool -> Bool -> Set where
  false-included-false : BitIncluded false false
  false-included-true  : BitIncluded false true
  true-included-true   : BitIncluded true true

Subset :
  {n : Nat} ->
  FiniteSubset n ->
  FiniteSubset n ->
  Set
Subset emptySubset emptySubset =
  Top
Subset (addBit left-bit left-tail) (addBit right-bit right-tail) =
  BitIncluded left-bit right-bit and Subset left-tail right-tail

ProperSubset :
  {n : Nat} ->
  FiniteSubset n ->
  FiniteSubset n ->
  Set
ProperSubset smaller larger =
  Subset smaller larger and smaller != larger

boolCardinality : Bool -> Nat
boolCardinality false =
  zero
boolCardinality true =
  suc zero

cardinality :
  {n : Nat} ->
  FiniteSubset n ->
  Nat
cardinality emptySubset =
  zero
cardinality (addBit bit tail) =
  boolCardinality bit + cardinality tail

weightedSum :
  {R : Set} ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) ->
  {n : Nat} ->
  (Fin n -> R) ->
  FiniteSubset n ->
  R
weightedSum reals weights emptySubset =
  zeroR reals
weightedSum reals weights (addBit false tail) =
  weightedSum reals (\ index -> weights (fsuc index)) tail
weightedSum reals weights (addBit true tail) =
  add reals
    (weights fzero)
    (weightedSum reals (\ index -> weights (fsuc index)) tail)

NonemptyFamily :
  {n : Nat} ->
  (FiniteSubset n -> Bool) ->
  Set
NonemptyFamily P =
  Exists _ (\ subset -> IsTrue (P subset))

ClosedUnderUnionAndIntersection :
  {n : Nat} ->
  (FiniteSubset n -> Bool) ->
  Set
ClosedUnderUnionAndIntersection P =
  (first-subset second-subset : FiniteSubset _) ->
  IsTrue (P first-subset) ->
  IsTrue (P second-subset) ->
  IsTrue (P (union first-subset second-subset))
  and
  IsTrue (P (intersection first-subset second-subset))

HasOneElementPredecessors :
  {n : Nat} ->
  (FiniteSubset n -> Bool) ->
  Set
HasOneElementPredecessors {n} P =
  (subset : FiniteSubset _) ->
  IsTrue (P subset) ->
  subset != emptyFor n ->
  Exists _
    (\ predecessor ->
      IsTrue (P predecessor)
      and
      ProperSubset predecessor subset
      and
      cardinality predecessor + suc zero == cardinality subset)

ValuationIdentity :
  {R : Set} ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) ->
  {n : Nat} ->
  (FiniteSubset n -> Bool) ->
  (FiniteSubset n -> R) ->
  Set
ValuationIdentity reals P function =
  (first-subset second-subset : FiniteSubset _) ->
  IsTrue (P first-subset) ->
  IsTrue (P second-subset) ->
  function (union first-subset second-subset) ==
  subtract reals
    (add reals (function first-subset) (function second-subset))
    (function (intersection first-subset second-subset))

HasElementWeightRepresentation :
  {R : Set} ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) ->
  {n : Nat} ->
  (FiniteSubset n -> Bool) ->
  (FiniteSubset n -> R) ->
  Set
HasElementWeightRepresentation reals P function =
  Exists _
    (\ weights ->
      (subset : FiniteSubset _) ->
      IsTrue (P subset) ->
      function subset == weightedSum reals weights subset)

putnam-2013-b3 : Set1
putnam-2013-b3 =
  (R : Set) ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) ->
  (n : Nat) ->
  (P : FiniteSubset n -> Bool) ->
  (function : FiniteSubset n -> R) ->
  NonemptyFamily P ->
  ClosedUnderUnionAndIntersection P ->
  HasOneElementPredecessors P ->
  function (emptyFor n) == zeroR reals ->
  ValuationIdentity reals P function ->
  HasElementWeightRepresentation reals P function

title: putnam_2013_b3

(*
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2013_b3:
  a valuation on a nonempty lattice of subsets with one-element descent is
  representable as a sum of real weights. This file contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open arithmeticTheory pred_setTheory realTheory real_sigmaTheory;

val putnam_2013_b3 =
  ``!n : num.
      !(P : num set set) (f : num set -> real).
        P <> {} /\
        (!S : num set.
           S IN P
           ==>
           S SUBSET count n) /\
        (!S T : num set.
           S IN P /\ T IN P
           ==>
           S UNION T IN P /\ S INTER T IN P) /\
        (!S : num set.
           S IN P /\ S <> {}
           ==>
           ?T : num set.
             T IN P /\
             T PSUBSET S /\
             CARD T + 1 = CARD S) /\
        f {} = 0 /\
        (!S T : num set.
           S IN P /\ T IN P
           ==>
           f (S UNION T) = f S + f T - f (S INTER T))
        ==>
        ?r : num -> real.
          !S : num set.
            S IN P
            ==>
            f S = SIGMA r S``;

title: putnam_2013_b3
content:
$(
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact
  putnam_2013_b3: additive representation of a valuation on a finite
  union-and-intersection-closed family with one-element descent. This file
  contains no proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  For n in NN0, 0 ..^ n is the n-element carrier corresponding to Fin n,
  and P ranges over families of subsets of that carrier. The hypotheses
  preserve nonemptiness of P, closure under union and intersection, and the
  internal one-element descent witness for every nonempty member.

  The function f is total from the full power set to the reals, matching the
  Lean function on all finsets of Fin n. Its empty-set value and valuation
  identity are retained verbatim. The existential function r assigns a real
  weight to each carrier element, and set.mm's finite sum gives the required
  representation on every member of P. The source solution proposition is
  annotated True, so its biconditional is rendered as this assertion itself.
  The final declaration is the single unproved $a corpus statement; this
  database contains no $p proof declaration.
$)

${
  $d P S T f i n r $.

  putnambench-putnam-2013-b3 $a |-
    A. n e. NN0
      A. P e. ~P ( ~P ( 0 ..^ n ) )
        A. f e. ( RR ^m ( ~P ( 0 ..^ n ) ) )
          (
            (
              P =/= (/)
              /\
              (
                A. S e. P A. T e. P
                  (
                    ( S u. T ) e. P
                    /\
                    ( S i^i T ) e. P
                  )
                /\
                (
                  A. S e. P
                    (
                      S =/= (/)
                      ->
                      E. T e. P
                        (
                          T C. S
                          /\
                          ( ( # ` T ) + 1 ) = ( # ` S )
                        )
                    )
                  /\
                  (
                    ( f ` (/) ) = 0
                    /\
                    A. S e. P A. T e. P
                      (
                        f
                        `
                        ( S u. T )
                      )
                      =
                      (
                        (
                          ( f ` S )
                          +
                          ( f ` T )
                        )
                        -
                        (
                          f
                          `
                          ( S i^i T )
                        )
                      )
                  )
                )
              )
            )
            ->
            E. r e. ( RR ^m ( 0 ..^ n ) )
              A. S e. P
                ( f ` S )
                =
                (
                  sum_ i e. S
                    ( r ` i )
                )
          )
  $.
$}

:: Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2013_b3
:: (putnambench__mizar__putnam_2013_b3): every normalized real valuation on a
:: nonempty finite family of subsets closed under unions, intersections, and
:: one-element deletions is a sum of element weights. This file contains no proof.

environ

      FUNCT_2, PARTFUN1, FINSEQ_1, FINSEQ_2, NUMBERS, NAT_1, CARD_1, CARD_3,

      FUNCT_2, FINSEQ_1, FINSEQ_2, RVSUM_1, FINSEQOP;
 registrations XBOOLE_0, ZFMISC_1, SUBSET_1, RELAT_1, FUNCT_1, RELSET_1,
      FUNCT_2, NUMBERS, XCMPLX_0, XREAL_0, XXREAL_0, NAT_1, ORDINAL1,
      CARD_1, FINSET_1, FINSEQ_1, FINSEQ_2, VALUED_0, VALUED_1, RVSUM_1;
 requirements BOOLE, SUBSET, NUMERALS, ARITHM, REAL;

 expansions TARSKI, XBOOLE_0;

begin

::$P-
theorem
  for n being Nat,
      P being Subset of bool Seg n,
      f being Function of bool Seg n,REAL st
    P <> {} &
    (for S,T being Subset of Seg n st S in P & T in P holds
      S \/ T in P & S /\ T in P) &
    (for S being Subset of Seg n st S in P & S <> {} holds
      ex T being Subset of Seg n st
        T in P & T c< S & card T + 1 = card S) &
    (for E being Subset of Seg n st E = {} holds f.E = 0) &
    (for S,T being Subset of Seg n st S in P & T in P holds
      f.(S \/ T) = f.S + f.T - f.(S /\ T))
  holds
    ex r being Function of Seg n,REAL st
      for S being Subset of Seg n st S in P holds
        ex terms being FinSequence of REAL st
          len terms = n &
          (for i being Nat st i in Seg n holds
            (i in S implies terms.i = r.i) &
            (not i in S implies terms.i = 0)) &
          f.S = Sum terms
proof
end;
::$P+

title: putnam_2013_b3
content:
% Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2013_b3:
% every real-valued valuation on a nonempty finite lattice of subsets of
% {1,...,n} with one-element descent is a sum of element weights. This file
% contains no proof.

putnam_2013_b3: THEORY
BEGIN
  IMPORTING
    finite_sets[nat],
    finite_sets_of_sets[nat]

  natural_set: TYPE = finite_set[nat]
  natural_set_family: TYPE = finite_set[natural_set]
  real_weights: TYPE = [nat -> real]
  valuation: TYPE = [natural_set -> real]

  family_on_initial_segment(
      P: natural_set_family,
      n: nat): bool =
    FORALL (S: natural_set), (i: nat):
      P(S) AND S(i) IMPLIES 1 <= i AND i <= n

  closed_under_union_and_intersection(
      P: natural_set_family): bool =
    FORALL (S, T: natural_set):
      P(S) AND P(T) IMPLIES
        P(union(S, T)) AND P(intersection(S, T))

  has_one_element_descent(P: natural_set_family): bool =
    FORALL (S: natural_set):
      P(S) AND NOT empty?(S) IMPLIES
        EXISTS (T: natural_set):
          P(T)
            AND strict_subset?(T, S)
            AND card(T) + 1 = card(S)

  vanishes_on_empty_set(f: valuation): bool =
    FORALL (S: natural_set):
      empty?(S) IMPLIES f(S) = 0

  is_valuation_on(
      P: natural_set_family,
      f: valuation): bool =
    FORALL (S, T: natural_set):
      P(S) AND P(T) IMPLIES
        f(union(S, T)) =
          f(S) + f(T) - f(intersection(S, T))

  finite_weight_sum(
      S: natural_set,
      weights: real_weights,
      total: real): bool =
    EXISTS
      (enumeration: [below(card(S)) -> (S)]),
      (partial_sums: [upto(card(S)) -> real]):
        bijective?(enumeration)
          AND partial_sums(0) = 0
          AND
            (FORALL (index: below(card(S))):
              partial_sums(index + 1) =
                partial_sums(index) + weights(enumeration(index)))
          AND total = partial_sums(card(S))

  putnam_2013_b3: bool =
    FORALL
      (n: nat),
      (P: natural_set_family),
      (f: valuation):
        (card(P) > 0
          AND family_on_initial_segment(P, n)
          AND closed_under_union_and_intersection(P)
          AND has_one_element_descent(P)
          AND vanishes_on_empty_set(f)
          AND is_valuation_on(P, f))
        IMPLIES
          EXISTS (weights: real_weights):
            FORALL (S: natural_set):
              P(S) IMPLIES finite_weight_sum(S, weights, f(S))
END putnam_2013_b3

import Mathlib

open Function Set

/--
For any continuous real-valued function $f$ defined on the interval $[0,1]$, let $\mu(f)=\int_0^1 f(x)\,dx,\text{Var}(f)=\int_0^1 (f(x)-\mu(f))^2\,dx,M(f)=\max_{0 \leq x \leq 1} |f(x)|$. Show that if $f$ and $g$ are continuous real-valued functions defined on the interval $[0,1]$, then $\text{Var}(fg) \leq 2\text{Var}(f)M(g)^2+2\text{Var}(g)M(f)^2$.
-/
theorem putnam_2013_b4
    (μ Var M : C(Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, ℝ) → ℝ)
    (hμ : ∀ f, μ f = ∫ x, f x)
    (hVar : ∀ f, Var f = ∫ x, (f x - μ f) ^ 2)
    (hM : ∀ f : C(Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, ℝ), IsGreatest (range <| abs ∘ f) (M f))
    (f g : C(Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, ℝ)) :
    Var (f * g) ≤ 2 * Var f * (M g) ^ 2 + 2 * Var g * (M f) ^ 2 :=
sorry

Require Import Reals. From Coquelicot Require Import Coquelicot Continuity RInt.
Open Scope R.
Theorem putnam_2013_b4 
    (fMult : (R -> R) -> (R -> R) -> (R -> R) := fun f g => fun x => f x * g x)
    (mu : (R -> R) -> R := fun f => RInt f 0 1)
    (var : (R -> R) -> (R -> R) := fun f : R -> R => fun x : R => f x - (mu f))
    (Var : (R -> R) -> R := fun f => RInt (fMult (var f) (var f)) 0 1) 
    (M : (R -> R) -> R)
    (hM : forall (f : R -> R), (forall x : R, (0 <= x <= 1) -> continuity_pt f x) -> ((exists (x : R), (0 <= x <= 1) /\ Rabs (f x) = M f) /\ (forall x : R, 0 <= x <= 1 -> Rabs (f x) <= M f)))
    : forall (f g: R -> R), (forall (x: R), 0 <= x <= 1 -> continuity_pt f x /\ continuity_pt g x) ->
        Var (fMult f g) <= 2 * Var f * (M g)^2 + 2 * Var g * (M f)^2. 
Proof. Admitted.

title: putnam_2013_b4

theory putnam_2013_b4 imports Complex_Main
"HOL-Analysis.Set_Integral"
"HOL-Analysis.Lebesgue_Measure"
begin

(* uses (real \<Rightarrow> real) instead of ({0..1} \<Rightarrow> real) *)
theorem putnam_2013_b4:
  fixes \<mu> Var M :: "(real \<Rightarrow> real) \<Rightarrow> real"
  assumes h\<mu>: "\<forall>f::real\<Rightarrow>real. \<mu> f = set_lebesgue_integral lebesgue {0<..<1} f"
  and hVar: "\<forall>f::real\<Rightarrow>real. Var f = set_lebesgue_integral lebesgue {0<..<1} (\<lambda>x::real. (f x - \<mu> f)^2)"
  and hM: "\<forall>f::real\<Rightarrow>real. continuous_on {0..1} f \<longrightarrow> M f = (GREATEST y::real. (\<exists>x::real\<in>{0..1}. y = \<bar>f x\<bar>))"
  shows "\<forall>f g::real\<Rightarrow>real. (continuous_on {0..1} f \<and> continuous_on {0..1} g) \<longrightarrow> (Var (\<lambda>x::real. f x*g x) \<le> 2*Var f*(M g)^2 + 2*Var g*(M f)^2)"
  sorry

end

title: putnam_2013_b4
putnam_2013_b4
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2013_b4:
;; the variance of the pointwise product of two continuous real functions on
;; [0,1] is bounded by the stated combination of their variances and maximum
;; absolute values. This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))

;; The context presents a Dedekind-complete ordered field, hence the real
;; field up to ordered-field isomorphism. APPLY$ objects represent arbitrary
;; real functions, and DEFUN-SK keeps all function, integral, mean, variance,
;; and maximum witnesses at their source quantifier scopes. Continuity is the
;; relative epsilon-delta definition on [0,1]. For continuous functions, the
;; unbounded uniform right-endpoint Riemann-sum limit below equals the source
;; interval integral, and the maximum predicate includes both attainment and
;; the universal upper-bound property.

(defun p13b4-quoted (object)
  (list 'quote object))

(defun p13b4-term-list (terms)
  (if (consp terms)
      (list 'cons
            (car terms)
            (p13b4-term-list (cdr terms)))
    (p13b4-quoted nil)))

(defun p13b4-apply-term (function-term arguments)
  (list 'apply$
        function-term
        (p13b4-term-list arguments)))

(defun p13b4-static-apply-term (function arguments)
  (p13b4-apply-term
   (p13b4-quoted function)
   arguments))

(defun p13b4-member-p (carrier x)
  (if (apply$ carrier (list x)) t nil))

(defun p13b4-unary-value (operation x)
  (apply$ operation (list x)))

(defun p13b4-binary-value (operation x y)
  (apply$ operation (list x y)))

(defun-sk p13b4-valid-set-p (carrier set)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (apply$ set (list x))
     (p13b4-member-p carrier x))))

(defun-sk p13b4-real-function-p (carrier function)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (p13b4-member-p carrier x)
     (p13b4-member-p
      carrier
      (p13b4-unary-value function x)))))

;; A Dedekind-complete ordered field presents the real scalar structure.

(defun-sk p13b4-field-laws-p
    (carrier add multiply negate inverse zero one)
  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (p13b4-member-p carrier x)
      (p13b4-member-p carrier y)
      (p13b4-member-p carrier z))
     (and
      (p13b4-member-p
       carrier (p13b4-binary-value add x y))
      (p13b4-member-p
       carrier (p13b4-binary-value multiply x y))
      (p13b4-member-p
       carrier (p13b4-unary-value negate x))
      (p13b4-member-p
       carrier (p13b4-unary-value inverse x))
      (equal
       (p13b4-binary-value
        add (p13b4-binary-value add x y) z)
       (p13b4-binary-value
        add x (p13b4-binary-value add y z)))
      (equal
       (p13b4-binary-value add x y)
       (p13b4-binary-value add y x))
      (equal (p13b4-binary-value add x zero) x)
      (equal
       (p13b4-binary-value
        add x (p13b4-unary-value negate x))
       zero)
      (equal
       (p13b4-binary-value
        multiply
        (p13b4-binary-value multiply x y)
        z)
       (p13b4-binary-value
        multiply
        x
        (p13b4-binary-value multiply y z)))
      (equal
       (p13b4-binary-value multiply x y)
       (p13b4-binary-value multiply y x))
      (equal
       (p13b4-binary-value multiply x one)
       x)
      (implies
       (equal x zero)
       (equal (p13b4-unary-value inverse x) zero))
      (implies
       (not (equal x zero))
       (equal
        (p13b4-binary-value
         multiply x (p13b4-unary-value inverse x))
        one))
      (equal
       (p13b4-binary-value
        multiply x (p13b4-binary-value add y z))
       (p13b4-binary-value
        add
        (p13b4-binary-value multiply x y)
        (p13b4-binary-value multiply x z)))))))

(defun-sk p13b4-order-laws-p
    (carrier add multiply zero less)
  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (p13b4-member-p carrier x)
      (p13b4-member-p carrier y)
      (p13b4-member-p carrier z))
     (and
      (not (p13b4-binary-value less x x))
      (or
       (equal x y)
       (p13b4-binary-value less x y)
       (p13b4-binary-value less y x))
      (implies
       (and
        (p13b4-binary-value less x y)
        (p13b4-binary-value less y z))
       (p13b4-binary-value less x z))
      (implies
       (p13b4-binary-value less x y)
       (p13b4-binary-value
        less
        (p13b4-binary-value add x z)
        (p13b4-binary-value add y z)))
      (implies
       (and
        (p13b4-binary-value less zero x)
        (p13b4-binary-value less zero y))
       (p13b4-binary-value
        less
        zero
        (p13b4-binary-value multiply x y)))))))

(defun-sk p13b4-set-nonempty-p (carrier set)
  (exists (x)
    (and
     (p13b4-member-p carrier x)
     (apply$ set (list x)))))

(defun-sk p13b4-upper-bound-p
    (carrier less set bound)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (and
      (p13b4-member-p carrier x)
      (apply$ set (list x)))
     (not
      (p13b4-binary-value less bound x)))))

(defun-sk p13b4-bounded-above-p
    (carrier less set)
  (exists (bound)
    (and
     (p13b4-member-p carrier bound)
     (p13b4-upper-bound-p
      carrier less set bound))))

(defun-sk p13b4-least-upper-bound-p
    (carrier less set supremum)
  (forall (bound)
    (implies
     (and
      (p13b4-member-p carrier bound)
      (p13b4-upper-bound-p
       carrier less set bound))
     (not
      (p13b4-binary-value
       less bound supremum)))))

(defun p13b4-supremum-p
    (carrier less set supremum)
  (and
   (p13b4-member-p carrier supremum)
   (p13b4-upper-bound-p
    carrier less set supremum)
   (p13b4-least-upper-bound-p
    carrier less set supremum)))

(defun-sk p13b4-has-supremum-p
    (carrier less set)
  (exists (supremum)
    (p13b4-supremum-p
     carrier less set supremum)))

(defun-sk p13b4-dedekind-complete-p
    (carrier less)
  (forall (set)
    (implies
     (and
      (tamep-functionp set)
      (p13b4-valid-set-p carrier set)
      (p13b4-set-nonempty-p carrier set)
      (p13b4-bounded-above-p carrier less set))
     (p13b4-has-supremum-p
      carrier less set))))

(defun p13b4-real-field-p
    (carrier add multiply negate inverse zero one less)
  (and
   (tamep-functionp carrier)
   (tamep-functionp add)
   (tamep-functionp multiply)
   (tamep-functionp negate)
   (tamep-functionp inverse)
   (tamep-functionp less)
   (p13b4-member-p carrier zero)
   (p13b4-member-p carrier one)
   (not (equal zero one))
   (p13b4-field-laws-p
    carrier add multiply negate inverse zero one)
   (p13b4-order-laws-p
    carrier add multiply zero less)
   (p13b4-binary-value less zero one)
   (p13b4-dedekind-complete-p carrier less)))

;; Real-field context and arithmetic.

(defun p13b4-r-carrier (ctx) (nth 0 ctx))
(defun p13b4-r-zero (ctx) (nth 1 ctx))
(defun p13b4-r-one (ctx) (nth 2 ctx))
(defun p13b4-r-add (ctx) (nth 3 ctx))
(defun p13b4-r-mul (ctx) (nth 4 ctx))
(defun p13b4-r-neg (ctx) (nth 5 ctx))
(defun p13b4-r-inv (ctx) (nth 6 ctx))
(defun p13b4-r-lt (ctx) (nth 7 ctx))

(defun p13b4-context-p (ctx)
  (and
   (true-listp ctx)
   (equal (len ctx) 8)
   (p13b4-real-field-p
    (p13b4-r-carrier ctx)
    (p13b4-r-add ctx)
    (p13b4-r-mul ctx)
    (p13b4-r-neg ctx)
    (p13b4-r-inv ctx)
    (p13b4-r-zero ctx)
    (p13b4-r-one ctx)
    (p13b4-r-lt ctx))))

(defun p13b4-r-add-value (ctx x y)
  (p13b4-binary-value (p13b4-r-add ctx) x y))

(defun p13b4-r-mul-value (ctx x y)
  (p13b4-binary-value (p13b4-r-mul ctx) x y))

(defun p13b4-r-neg-value (ctx x)
  (p13b4-unary-value (p13b4-r-neg ctx) x))

(defun p13b4-r-inv-value (ctx x)
  (p13b4-unary-value (p13b4-r-inv ctx) x))

(defun p13b4-r-sub-value (ctx x y)
  (p13b4-r-add-value
   ctx x (p13b4-r-neg-value ctx y)))

(defun p13b4-r-div-value (ctx x y)
  (p13b4-r-mul-value
   ctx x (p13b4-r-inv-value ctx y)))

(defun p13b4-r-lt-p (ctx x y)
  (if (p13b4-binary-value
       (p13b4-r-lt ctx) x y)
      t nil))

(defun p13b4-r-le-p (ctx x y)
  (not (p13b4-r-lt-p ctx y x)))

(defun p13b4-r-abs-value (ctx x)
  (if (p13b4-r-lt-p
       ctx x (p13b4-r-zero ctx))
      (p13b4-r-neg-value ctx x)
    x))

(defun p13b4-positive-real-p (ctx x)
  (and
   (p13b4-member-p (p13b4-r-carrier ctx) x)
   (p13b4-r-lt-p
    ctx (p13b4-r-zero ctx) x)))

(defun p13b4-icc-member-p (ctx x)
  (and
   (p13b4-member-p (p13b4-r-carrier ctx) x)
   (p13b4-r-le-p ctx (p13b4-r-zero ctx) x)
   (p13b4-r-le-p ctx x (p13b4-r-one ctx))))

(defun p13b4-nat-cast (ctx n)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix n)))
  (if (zp n)
      (p13b4-r-zero ctx)
    (p13b4-r-add-value
     ctx
     (p13b4-r-one ctx)
     (p13b4-nat-cast ctx (- n 1)))))

(defun p13b4-two (ctx)
  (p13b4-r-add-value
   ctx
   (p13b4-r-one ctx)
   (p13b4-r-one ctx)))

(defun p13b4-square (ctx x)
  (p13b4-r-mul-value ctx x x))

;; Relative epsilon-delta continuity on the closed unit interval.

(defun-sk p13b4-continuity-neighborhood-p
    (ctx function x epsilon radius)
  (forall (y)
    (implies
     (and
      (p13b4-icc-member-p ctx y)
      (p13b4-r-lt-p
       ctx
       (p13b4-r-abs-value
        ctx (p13b4-r-sub-value ctx y x))
       radius))
     (p13b4-r-lt-p
      ctx
      (p13b4-r-abs-value
       ctx
       (p13b4-r-sub-value
        ctx
        (p13b4-unary-value function y)
        (p13b4-unary-value function x)))
      epsilon))))

(defun-sk p13b4-continuity-radius-exists-p
    (ctx function x epsilon)
  (exists (radius)
    (and
     (p13b4-positive-real-p ctx radius)
     (p13b4-continuity-neighborhood-p
      ctx function x epsilon radius))))

(defun-sk p13b4-continuous-at-p
    (ctx function x)
  (forall (epsilon)
    (implies
     (p13b4-positive-real-p ctx epsilon)
     (p13b4-continuity-radius-exists-p
      ctx function x epsilon))))

(defun-sk p13b4-continuous-on-icc-p
    (ctx function)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (p13b4-icc-member-p ctx x)
     (p13b4-continuous-at-p
      ctx function x))))

(defun p13b4-admissible-function-p (ctx function)
  (and
   (tamep-functionp function)
   (p13b4-real-function-p
    (p13b4-r-carrier ctx) function)
   (p13b4-continuous-on-icc-p
    ctx function)))

;; Pointwise product and centered square.

(defun p13b4-product-function (ctx left right)
  (list
   'lambda '(x)
   (list
    'p13b4-r-mul-value
    (p13b4-quoted ctx)
    (p13b4-static-apply-term left '(x))
    (p13b4-static-apply-term right '(x)))))

(defun p13b4-centered-square-function
    (ctx function mean)
  (let ((centered
         (list
          'p13b4-r-sub-value
          (p13b4-quoted ctx)
          (p13b4-static-apply-term function '(x))
          (p13b4-quoted mean))))
    (list
     'lambda '(x)
     (list
      'p13b4-r-mul-value
      (p13b4-quoted ctx)
      centered
      centered))))

;; Uniform right-endpoint Riemann sums for the interval integral.

(defun p13b4-riemann-sum
    (ctx function subdivisions remaining)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix remaining)))
  (if (zp remaining)
      (p13b4-r-zero ctx)
    (let* ((denominator
            (p13b4-nat-cast ctx subdivisions))
           (numerator
            (p13b4-nat-cast ctx remaining))
           (point
            (p13b4-r-div-value
             ctx numerator denominator)))
      (p13b4-r-add-value
       ctx
       (p13b4-unary-value function point)
       (p13b4-riemann-sum
        ctx function subdivisions
        (- remaining 1))))))

(defun p13b4-integral-approx
    (ctx function subdivisions)
  (if (posp subdivisions)
      (p13b4-r-div-value
       ctx
       (p13b4-riemann-sum
        ctx function subdivisions subdivisions)
       (p13b4-nat-cast ctx subdivisions))
    (p13b4-r-zero ctx)))

(defun-sk p13b4-integral-tail-p
    (ctx function value epsilon cutoff)
  (forall (subdivisions)
    (implies
     (and
      (posp subdivisions)
      (<= cutoff subdivisions))
     (p13b4-r-lt-p
      ctx
      (p13b4-r-abs-value
       ctx
       (p13b4-r-sub-value
        ctx
        (p13b4-integral-approx
         ctx function subdivisions)
        value))
      epsilon))))

(defun-sk p13b4-integral-cutoff-exists-p
    (ctx function value epsilon)
  (exists (cutoff)
    (and
     (posp cutoff)
     (p13b4-integral-tail-p
      ctx function value epsilon cutoff))))

(defun-sk p13b4-integral-converges-to-p
    (ctx function value)
  (forall (epsilon)
    (implies
     (p13b4-positive-real-p ctx epsilon)
     (p13b4-integral-cutoff-exists-p
      ctx function value epsilon))))

(defun p13b4-integral-value-p
    (ctx function value)
  (and
   (p13b4-member-p (p13b4-r-carrier ctx) value)
   (p13b4-integral-converges-to-p
    ctx function value)))

;; Variance and maximum absolute value retain their defining witnesses.

(defun-sk p13b4-variance-value-p
    (ctx function value)
  (exists (mean)
    (and
     (p13b4-integral-value-p
      ctx function mean)
     (p13b4-integral-value-p
      ctx
      (p13b4-centered-square-function
       ctx function mean)
      value))))

(defun-sk p13b4-maximum-attained-p
    (ctx function value)
  (exists (x)
    (and
     (p13b4-icc-member-p ctx x)
     (equal
      (p13b4-r-abs-value
       ctx (p13b4-unary-value function x))
      value))))

(defun-sk p13b4-maximum-upper-bound-p
    (ctx function value)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (p13b4-icc-member-p ctx x)
     (p13b4-r-le-p
      ctx
      (p13b4-r-abs-value
       ctx (p13b4-unary-value function x))
      value))))

(defun p13b4-maximum-value-p
    (ctx function value)
  (and
   (p13b4-member-p (p13b4-r-carrier ctx) value)
   (p13b4-maximum-attained-p
    ctx function value)
   (p13b4-maximum-upper-bound-p
    ctx function value)))

(defun p13b4-bound-value
    (ctx variance-f variance-g maximum-f maximum-g)
  (p13b4-r-add-value
   ctx
   (p13b4-r-mul-value
    ctx
    (p13b4-r-mul-value
     ctx (p13b4-two ctx) variance-f)
    (p13b4-square ctx maximum-g))
   (p13b4-r-mul-value
    ctx
    (p13b4-r-mul-value
     ctx (p13b4-two ctx) variance-g)
    (p13b4-square ctx maximum-f))))

(defun-sk p13b4-inequality-values-exist-p
    (ctx f g)
  (exists
   (variance-product variance-f variance-g maximum-f maximum-g)
   (and
    (p13b4-variance-value-p
     ctx
     (p13b4-product-function ctx f g)
     variance-product)
    (p13b4-variance-value-p
     ctx f variance-f)
    (p13b4-variance-value-p
     ctx g variance-g)
    (p13b4-maximum-value-p
     ctx f maximum-f)
    (p13b4-maximum-value-p
     ctx g maximum-g)
    (p13b4-r-le-p
     ctx
     variance-product
     (p13b4-bound-value
      ctx variance-f variance-g maximum-f maximum-g)))))

(defun-sk putnambench-putnam-2013-b4-statement (ctx)
  (forall (f g)
    (implies
     (and
      (p13b4-context-p ctx)
      (p13b4-admissible-function-p ctx f)
      (p13b4-admissible-function-p ctx g))
     (p13b4-inequality-values-exist-p
      ctx f g))))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

title: putnam_2013_b4
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2013_b4
-- (putnambench__agda__putnam_2013_b4): the variance bound for the product of
-- two continuous real functions on the unit interval. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module Main where

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; _*_)

infix 4 _!=_ _<=N_
infixr 3 _and_
infixr 2 _or_

data Bottom : Set where

Not : Set -> Set
Not A =
  A -> Bottom

_!=_ : {A : Set} -> A -> A -> Set
x != y =
  Not (x == y)

record _and_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data _or_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  left  : A -> A or B
  right : B -> A or B

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

data _<=N_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set where
  zero<=N   : {n : Nat} -> zero <=N n
  suc<=sucN : {m n : Nat} -> m <=N n -> suc m <=N suc n

record CompleteOrderedRealField (R : Set) : Set1 where
  field
    zeroR oneR : R
    add multiply : R -> R -> R
    negate inverse absoluteValue : R -> R
    lessOrEqual : R -> R -> Set
    fromNat : Nat -> R

    one-not-zero :
      oneR != zeroR

    add-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> add x y == add y x
    add-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      add (add x y) z == add x (add y z)
    add-zero :
      (x : R) -> add x zeroR == x
    add-inverse :
      (x : R) -> add x (negate x) == zeroR

    multiply-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> multiply x y == multiply y x
    multiply-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply (multiply x y) z ==
      multiply x (multiply y z)
    multiply-one :
      (x : R) -> multiply x oneR == x
    multiply-zero :
      (x : R) -> multiply x zeroR == zeroR
    distribute :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply x (add y z) ==
      add (multiply x y) (multiply x z)
    inverse-zero :
      inverse zeroR == zeroR
    multiply-inverse :
      (x : R) ->
      x != zeroR ->
      multiply x (inverse x) == oneR

    order-reflexive :
      (x : R) -> lessOrEqual x x
    order-transitive :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y z ->
      lessOrEqual x z
    order-antisymmetric :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y x ->
      x == y
    order-total :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y or lessOrEqual y x
    add-order :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual (add z x) (add z y)
    multiply-nonnegative :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR x ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR y ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR (multiply x y)
    zero-less-than-one :
      lessOrEqual zeroR oneR and zeroR != oneR

    absolute-nonnegative :
      (x : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR (absoluteValue x)
    absolute-of-nonnegative :
      (x : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR x ->
      absoluteValue x == x
    absolute-of-nonpositive :
      (x : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x zeroR ->
      absoluteValue x == negate x

    fromNat-zero :
      fromNat zero == zeroR
    fromNat-successor :
      (n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (suc n) == add (fromNat n) oneR
    fromNat-addition :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m + n) == add (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-multiplication :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m * n) == multiply (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-injective :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat m == fromNat n ->
      m == n

    archimedean :
      (x : R) ->
      Exists Nat
        (\ n -> lessOrEqual x (fromNat n))
    least-upper-bound :
      (P : R -> Set) ->
      Exists R P ->
      Exists R
        (\ upper ->
          (x : R) ->
          P x ->
          lessOrEqual x upper) ->
      Exists R
        (\ supremum ->
          ((x : R) ->
            P x ->
            lessOrEqual x supremum)
          and
          ((upper : R) ->
            ((x : R) ->
              P x ->
              lessOrEqual x upper) ->
            lessOrEqual supremum upper))

open CompleteOrderedRealField

oneN : Nat
oneN =
  suc zero

twoN : Nat
twoN =
  suc oneN

subtract :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
subtract reals x y =
  add reals x (negate reals y)

divide :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
divide reals x y =
  multiply reals x (inverse reals y)

square :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R
square reals x =
  multiply reals x x

StrictLess :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
StrictLess reals x y =
  lessOrEqual reals x y and x != y

Distance :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
Distance reals x y =
  absoluteValue reals (subtract reals x y)

InUnitInterval :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  Set
InUnitInterval reals x =
  lessOrEqual reals (zeroR reals) x
  and
  lessOrEqual reals x (oneR reals)

ContinuousOnUnitInterval :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (R -> R) ->
  Set
ContinuousOnUnitInterval {R} reals f =
  (x : R) ->
  InUnitInterval reals x ->
  (epsilon : R) ->
  StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) epsilon ->
  Exists R
    (\ delta ->
      StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) delta
      and
      ((y : R) ->
        InUnitInterval reals y ->
        StrictLess reals (Distance reals y x) delta ->
        StrictLess reals
          (Distance reals (f y) (f x))
          epsilon))

sumFirst :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Nat ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  R
sumFirst reals zero term =
  zeroR reals
sumFirst reals (suc n) term =
  add reals
    (sumFirst reals n term)
    (term n)

midpoint :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Nat ->
  Nat ->
  R
midpoint reals pieces index =
  multiply reals
    (add reals
      (fromNat reals index)
      (divide reals
        (oneR reals)
        (fromNat reals twoN)))
    (divide reals
      (oneR reals)
      (fromNat reals pieces))

midpointSum :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (R -> R) ->
  Nat ->
  R
midpointSum reals f pieces =
  multiply reals
    (divide reals
      (oneR reals)
      (fromNat reals pieces))
    (sumFirst reals pieces
      (\ index ->
        f (midpoint reals pieces index)))

SequentialLimit :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  R ->
  Set
SequentialLimit {R} reals sequence limit =
  (epsilon : R) ->
  StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) epsilon ->
  Exists Nat
    (\ cutoff ->
      (n : Nat) ->
      cutoff <=N n ->
      StrictLess reals
        (Distance reals (sequence n) limit)
        epsilon)

UnitIntervalIntegralValue :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (R -> R) ->
  R ->
  Set
UnitIntervalIntegralValue reals f integral =
  SequentialLimit reals
    (\ n -> midpointSum reals f (suc n))
    integral

IsMaximumAbsoluteValue :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (R -> R) ->
  R ->
  Set
IsMaximumAbsoluteValue {R} reals f maximum =
  Exists R
    (\ point ->
      InUnitInterval reals point
      and
      absoluteValue reals (f point) == maximum)
  and
  ((x : R) ->
    InUnitInterval reals x ->
    lessOrEqual reals
      (absoluteValue reals (f x))
      maximum)

centeredSquare :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  ((R -> R) -> R) ->
  (R -> R) ->
  R ->
  R
centeredSquare reals mu f x =
  square reals
    (subtract reals (f x) (mu f))

pointwiseProduct :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (R -> R) ->
  (R -> R) ->
  R ->
  R
pointwiseProduct reals f g x =
  multiply reals (f x) (g x)

Putnam2013B4 :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Set
Putnam2013B4 {R} reals =
  (mu variance maximum : (R -> R) -> R) ->
  ((f : R -> R) ->
    ContinuousOnUnitInterval reals f ->
    UnitIntervalIntegralValue reals f (mu f)) ->
  ((f : R -> R) ->
    ContinuousOnUnitInterval reals f ->
    UnitIntervalIntegralValue reals
      (centeredSquare reals mu f)
      (variance f)) ->
  ((f : R -> R) ->
    ContinuousOnUnitInterval reals f ->
    IsMaximumAbsoluteValue reals f (maximum f)) ->
  (f g : R -> R) ->
  ContinuousOnUnitInterval reals f ->
  ContinuousOnUnitInterval reals g ->
  lessOrEqual reals
    (variance (pointwiseProduct reals f g))
    (add reals
      (multiply reals
        (multiply reals
          (fromNat reals twoN)
          (variance f))
        (square reals (maximum g)))
      (multiply reals
        (multiply reals
          (fromNat reals twoN)
          (variance g))
        (square reals (maximum f))))

putnam-2013-b4 : Set1
putnam-2013-b4 =
  (R : Set) ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) ->
  Putnam2013B4 reals

(*
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2013_b4:
  the variance of a product of continuous real functions on the unit interval
  is bounded using their variances and maximum absolute values. This file
  contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open pred_setTheory realTheory real_topologyTheory integrationTheory;

val putnam_2013_b4 =
  ``!f g : real -> real.
      f continuous_on interval [0, 1] /\
      g continuous_on interval [0, 1]
      ==>
      let mu =
        \h : real -> real.
          integration$integral (interval [0, 1]) h
      in
      let variance =
        \h : real -> real.
          integration$integral (interval [0, 1])
            (\x : real. (h x - mu h) pow 2)
      in
      let maximum =
        \h : real -> real.
          sup (IMAGE (\x : real. abs (h x)) (interval [0, 1]))
      in
        variance (\x : real. f x * g x) <=
          2 * variance f * maximum g pow 2 +
          2 * variance g * maximum f pow 2``;

title: putnam_2013_b4
content:
% Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2013_b4:
% the variance of a product of two continuous real functions on [0, 1] is
% bounded using their variances and maximum absolute values. This file contains
% no proof.

putnam_2013_b4: THEORY
BEGIN
  real_function: TYPE = [real -> real]
  real_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> real]

  continuous_on_unit_interval(f: real_function): bool =
    FORALL (x: real):
      (0 <= x AND x <= 1) IMPLIES
        FORALL (epsilon_value: posreal):
          EXISTS (delta: posreal):
            FORALL (y: real):
              (0 <= y
                AND y <= 1
                AND abs(y - x) < delta)
              IMPLIES
                abs(f(y) - f(x)) < epsilon_value

  valid_tagged_partition(
      points, tags: real_sequence,
      count: nat): bool =
    count > 0
      AND points(0) = 0
      AND points(count) = 1
      AND FORALL (index: nat):
        index < count IMPLIES
          (points(index) < points(index + 1)
            AND points(index) <= tags(index)
            AND tags(index) <= points(index + 1))

  mesh_less_than(
      points: real_sequence,
      count: nat,
      bound: real): bool =
    FORALL (index: nat):
      index < count IMPLIES
        points(index + 1) - points(index) < bound

  riemann_sum(
      f: real_function,
      points, tags: real_sequence,
      count: nat): RECURSIVE real =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      riemann_sum(f, points, tags, count - 1)
        + f(tags(count - 1))
            * (points(count) - points(count - 1))
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  has_unit_interval_integral(
      f: real_function,
      integral_value: real): bool =
    FORALL (epsilon_value: posreal):
      EXISTS (mesh_bound: posreal):
        FORALL
            (points, tags: real_sequence),
            (count: nat):
          (valid_tagged_partition(points, tags, count)
            AND mesh_less_than(points, count, mesh_bound))
          IMPLIES
            abs(
              riemann_sum(f, points, tags, count)
                - integral_value)
              < epsilon_value

  unit_interval_integral(f: real_function): real =
    IF EXISTS (integral_value: real):
        has_unit_interval_integral(f, integral_value)
    THEN
      epsilon(
        LAMBDA (integral_value: real):
          has_unit_interval_integral(f, integral_value))
    ELSE
      0
    ENDIF

  mean(f: real_function): real =
    unit_interval_integral(f)

  variance(f: real_function): real =
    unit_interval_integral(
      LAMBDA (x: real):
        (f(x) - mean(f)) ^ 2)

  is_maximum_absolute_value(
      f: real_function,
      maximum_value: real): bool =
    (EXISTS (x: real):
      0 <= x
        AND x <= 1
        AND maximum_value = abs(f(x)))
      AND
        (FORALL (x: real):
          (0 <= x AND x <= 1)
            IMPLIES abs(f(x)) <= maximum_value)

  maximum_absolute_value(f: real_function): real =
    IF EXISTS (maximum_value: real):
        is_maximum_absolute_value(f, maximum_value)
    THEN
      epsilon(
        LAMBDA (maximum_value: real):
          is_maximum_absolute_value(f, maximum_value))
    ELSE
      0
    ENDIF

  pointwise_product(
      f, g: real_function): real_function =
    LAMBDA (x: real): f(x) * g(x)

  putnam_2013_b4: bool =
    FORALL (f, g: real_function):
      (continuous_on_unit_interval(f)
        AND continuous_on_unit_interval(g))
      IMPLIES
        variance(pointwise_product(f, g))
          <= 2 * variance(f) * maximum_absolute_value(g) ^ 2
            + 2 * variance(g) * maximum_absolute_value(f) ^ 2
END putnam_2013_b4

import Mathlib

open Function Set

/--
Let $X=\{1,2,\dots,n\}$, and let $k \in X$. Show that there are exactly $k \cdot n^{n-1}$ functions $f:X \to X$ such that for every $x \in X$ there is a $j \geq 0$ such that $f^{(j)}(x) \leq k$. [Here $f^{(j)}$ denotes the $j$\textsuperscript{th} iterate of $f$, so that $f^{(0)}(x)=x$ and $f^{(j+1)}(x)=f(f^{(j)}(x))$.]
-/
theorem putnam_2013_b5
  (n : ℕ) (hn : n ≥ 1)
  (k : Set.Icc 1 n)
  (fiter : (Set.Icc 1 n → Set.Icc 1 n) → Prop)
  (hfiter : ∀ f, fiter f ↔ ∀ x : Set.Icc 1 n, ∃ j : ℕ, f^[j] x ≤ k) :
  {f | fiter f}.encard = k * n ^ (n - 1) :=
sorry

;; Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2013_b5:
;; the exact count of endofunctions on {1,...,n} whose every orbit eventually
;; reaches {1,...,k}. This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

;; For positive N, CODE in 0,...,N^N-1 is the base-N image table of a unique
;; function {1,...,N} -> {1,...,N}; the digit at position X-1, shifted by one,
;; is the value at X. Thus the exhaustive count below ranges bijectively over
;; the source function space rather than restricting it.
(defun putnam-2013-b5-function-value (code n x)
  (+ 1
     (mod (floor code (expt n (- x 1)))
          n)))

;; On an N-element carrier, an orbit that does not enter {1,...,K} among its
;; first N+1 vertices has repeated a vertex entirely above K and can never
;; enter that set. Hence this bounded search is equivalent to the source's
;; existential quantification over all natural iterate counts.
(defun putnam-2013-b5-orbit-reaches-p
    (code n k current steps)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix steps)))
  (or (<= current k)
      (and
       (not (zp steps))
       (putnam-2013-b5-orbit-reaches-p
        code
        n
        k
        (putnam-2013-b5-function-value code n current)
        (- steps 1)))))

(defun putnam-2013-b5-all-orbits-reach-p
    (code n k start-count)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix start-count)))
  (if (zp start-count)
      t
    (and
     (putnam-2013-b5-orbit-reaches-p
      code n k start-count n)
     (putnam-2013-b5-all-orbits-reach-p
      code n k (- start-count 1)))))

(defun putnam-2013-b5-count-functions
    (remaining n k)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix remaining)))
  (if (zp remaining)
      0
    (let ((code (- remaining 1)))
      (+
       (if (putnam-2013-b5-all-orbits-reach-p
            code n k n)
           1
         0)
       (putnam-2013-b5-count-functions
        code n k)))))

(defun putnambench-putnam-2013-b5-statement (n k)
  (implies
   (and
    (posp n)
    (natp k)
    (<= 1 k)
    (<= k n))
   (equal
    (putnam-2013-b5-count-functions
     (expt n n) n k)
    (* k (expt n (- n 1))))))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

-- Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2013_b5
-- (putnambench__agda__putnam_2013_b5): the number of endofunctions of
-- X = {1,...,n} whose every orbit eventually reaches a value at most k is
-- k * n^(n-1). This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module Putnam2013B5 where

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _-_; _*_)

infix 4 _<=N_

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

data _<=N_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set where
  zero<=N   : {n : Nat} -> zero <=N n
  suc<=sucN : {m n : Nat} -> m <=N n -> suc m <=N suc n

data Positive : Nat -> Set where
  positive : {n : Nat} -> Positive (suc n)

data Fin : Nat -> Set where
  fzero : {n : Nat} -> Fin (suc n)
  fsuc  : {n : Nat} -> Fin n -> Fin (suc n)

toNat : {n : Nat} -> Fin n -> Nat
toNat fzero =
  zero
toNat (fsuc index) =
  suc (toNat index)

PointwiseEqual :
  {n : Nat} ->
  (Fin n -> Fin n) ->
  (Fin n -> Fin n) ->
  Set
PointwiseEqual {n} left-function right-function =
  (x : Fin n) ->
  left-function x == right-function x

iterate :
  {A : Set} ->
  (A -> A) ->
  Nat ->
  A ->
  A
iterate function zero x =
  x
iterate function (suc count) x =
  function (iterate function count x)

EventuallyAtMost :
  {n : Nat} ->
  Fin n ->
  (Fin n -> Fin n) ->
  Set
EventuallyAtMost {n} k function =
  (x : Fin n) ->
  Exists Nat
    (\ j ->
      toNat (iterate function j x) <=N toNat k)

record HasExtensionalCardinality
  {A : Set}
  (equivalent : A -> A -> Set)
  (member : A -> Set)
  (cardinality : Nat) :
  Set where

  field
    enumerate :
      Fin cardinality ->
      A

    enumerated-member :
      (index : Fin cardinality) ->
      member (enumerate index)

    enumeration-complete :
      (item : A) ->
      member item ->
      Exists (Fin cardinality)
        (\ index -> equivalent item (enumerate index))

    enumeration-injective :
      (left-index right-index : Fin cardinality) ->
      equivalent (enumerate left-index) (enumerate right-index) ->
      left-index == right-index

one : Nat
one =
  suc zero

naturalPower : Nat -> Nat -> Nat
naturalPower base zero =
  one
naturalPower base (suc exponent) =
  naturalPower base exponent * base

putnam-2013-b5 : Set
putnam-2013-b5 =
  (n : Nat) ->
  Positive n ->
  (k : Fin n) ->
  HasExtensionalCardinality
    {A = Fin n -> Fin n}
    PointwiseEqual
    (EventuallyAtMost k)
    (suc (toNat k) * naturalPower n (n - one))

(*
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2013_b5:
  the number of endofunctions on {1,...,n} whose every orbit eventually
  reaches {1,...,k}. This file contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open arithmeticTheory pred_setTheory;

val putnam_2013_b5 =
  ``!n k : num.
      0 < n /\ k IN IMAGE SUC (count n)
      ==>
      let X = IMAGE SUC (count n)
      in
        CARD
          {f : num -> num |
             (!x : num. x IN X ==> f x IN X) /\
             (!x : num. x NOTIN X ==> f x = 0) /\
             (!x : num.
                x IN X
                ==>
                ?j : num. FUNPOW f j x <= k)} =
        k * n EXP (n - 1)``;

title: putnam_2013_b5
content:
$(
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact
  putnam_2013_b5: counting endofunctions of {1, ..., n} for which every
  orbit eventually reaches a value at most k. This file contains no proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  The inclusive interval 1 ... n is the source set X. Thus f ranges over
  every endofunction of X, without extending or restricting its domain.
  IterComp is set.mm's native finite-iteration operator, including the
  identity iterate at j = 0. The internally existential j therefore states
  exactly that each orbit eventually reaches an element at most k.

  The restricted class contains precisely the endofunctions satisfying that
  orbit condition, and # is its finite cardinality. The final declaration is
  the single unproved $a corpus statement; this database contains no $p proof
  declaration.
$)

${
  $d f j k n x $.

  putnambench-putnam-2013-b5 $a |- A. n e. NN A. k e. ( 1 ... n )
    (
      #
      `
      {
        f e. ( ( 1 ... n ) ^m ( 1 ... n ) )
        |
        A. x e. ( 1 ... n ) E. j e. NN0
          (
            (
              ( ( IterComp ` f ) ` j )
              `
              x
            )
            <_
            k
          )
      }
    )
    =
    (
      k
      x.
      ( n ^ ( n - 1 ) )
    )
  $.
$}

:: Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2013_b5:
:: the number of endofunctions on {1,...,n} for which every orbit eventually
:: reaches a value at most k is k*n^(n-1). This file contains no proof.

environ
  vocabularies TARSKI, XBOOLE_0, ZFMISC_1, SUBSET_1, RELAT_1, FUNCT_1,
    FUNCT_2, PARTFUN1, FINSEQ_1, FINSEQ_2, NUMBERS, NAT_1, CARD_1,
    XCMPLX_0, XREAL_0, XXREAL_0, ORDINAL1, FINSET_1, NEWTON, ARYTM_1,
    ARYTM_3, CARD_3;
  notations TARSKI, XBOOLE_0, ZFMISC_1, SUBSET_1, ORDINAL1, CARD_1,
    NUMBERS, XCMPLX_0, XREAL_0, XXREAL_0, NAT_1, NAT_D, RELAT_1,
    FUNCT_1, RELSET_1, PARTFUN1, FUNCT_2, FINSEQ_1, FINSEQ_2,
    FINSET_1, NEWTON;
  constructors RELSET_1, PARTFUN1, FINSEQ_4, NAT_1, NAT_D, NEWTON,
    FINSET_1;
  registrations XBOOLE_0, SUBSET_1, RELAT_1, FUNCT_1, RELSET_1,
    FUNCT_2, PARTFUN1, FINSEQ_1, FINSEQ_2, FINSET_1, ORDINAL1,
    CARD_1, NUMBERS, XCMPLX_0, XREAL_0, XXREAL_0, NAT_1, NEWTON,
    VALUED_0, VALUED_1, MEMBERED, FRAENKEL;
  requirements BOOLE, SUBSET, NUMERALS, ARITHM, REAL;
  definitions TARSKI;
  equalities FINSEQ_1;
  expansions TARSKI, FINSEQ_1;

begin

::$P-
theorem
  for n,k being Nat st 0 < n & k in Seg n holds
    card {f where f is Function of Seg n,Seg n :
      for x being Nat st x in Seg n holds
        ex j being Nat, s being FinSequence of NAT st
          len s = j + 1 &
          s/.1 = x &
          (for i being Nat st i in Seg j holds
            s/.(i + 1) = f.(s/.i)) &
          s/.(j + 1) <= k}
      = k * (n |^ (n -' 1))
proof
end;
::$P+

title: putnam_2013_b5
content:
% Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2013_b5:
% the endofunctions of {1, ..., n} whose every orbit eventually reaches a
% value at most k are counted by k * n^(n - 1). This file contains no proof.

putnam_2013_b5[n: posnat]: THEORY
BEGIN
  element: TYPE = {x: nat | 1 <= x AND x <= n}
  endofunction: TYPE = [element -> element]

  IMPORTING finite_sets[endofunction]

  iterate(
      f: endofunction,
      count: nat,
      x: element): RECURSIVE element =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      x
    ELSE
      f(iterate(f, count - 1, x))
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  qualifying(f: endofunction, k: element): bool =
    FORALL (x: element):
      EXISTS (j: nat):
        iterate(f, j, x) <= k

  putnam_2013_b5: bool =
    FORALL (k: element):
      EXISTS (solutions: finite_set[endofunction]):
        card(solutions) = k * n ^ (n - 1)
          AND (FORALL (f: endofunction):
            solutions(f) IFF qualifying(f, k))
END putnam_2013_b5

import Mathlib

/--
Prove that every nonzero coefficient of the Taylor series of \[(1 - x + x^2)e^x\] about $x=0$ is a rational number whose numerator (in lowest terms) is either $1$ or a prime number.
-/
theorem putnam_2014_a1
(f : ℝ → ℝ)
(hf : ∀ x : ℝ, f x = (1 - x + x ^ 2) * Real.exp x)
(hfdiff : ContDiff ℝ ⊤ f)
(c : ℕ → ℝ)
(hc : ∀ k : ℕ, c k = taylorCoeffWithin f k Set.univ 0)
: ∀ k : ℕ, c k ≠ 0 → ∃ q : ℚ, c k = q ∧ (q.num = 1 ∨ Prime q.num.natAbs) :=
sorry

    (coeff : nat -> R := fun i => Derive_n f i 0 / INR (fact i))
    (n : nat)

content:
;; Statement-only formalization of the PutnamBench corpus artifact
;; putnam_2014_a1: every nonzero Taylor coefficient of
;; (1 - x + x^2) * exp(x) has reduced numerator 1 or a prime number. This
;; file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(defun putnam-2014-a1-factorial (n)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix n)))
  (if (zp n)
      1
    (* n
       (putnam-2014-a1-factorial (- n 1)))))

;; The coefficient of x^n is the convolution of 1 - x + x^2 with the
;; coefficient sequence 1/n! of exp(x). This exact rational formula
;; eliminates the source's uniquely determined real function and coefficient
;; function without changing the quantified proposition.
(defun putnam-2014-a1-coefficient (n)
  (if (natp n)
      (+ (/ 1 (putnam-2014-a1-factorial n))
         (if (posp n)
             (- (/ 1
                   (putnam-2014-a1-factorial (- n 1))))
           0)
         (if (<= 2 n)
             (/ 1
                (putnam-2014-a1-factorial (- n 2)))
           0))
    0))

(defun putnam-2014-a1-no-proper-divisor-through-p
    (number candidate)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix candidate)))
  (if (or (not (natp candidate))
          (<= candidate 1))
      t
    (and
     (not (equal (mod number candidate) 0))
     (putnam-2014-a1-no-proper-divisor-through-p
      number (- candidate 1)))))

(defun putnam-2014-a1-prime-p (number)
  (and
   (natp number)
   (< 1 number)
   (putnam-2014-a1-no-proper-divisor-through-p
    number (- number 1))))

(defun putnambench-putnam-2014-a1-statement (n)
  (implies
   (natp n)
   (let ((coefficient
          (putnam-2014-a1-coefficient n)))
     (implies
      (not (equal coefficient 0))
      (and
       (rationalp coefficient)
       (or
        (equal (numerator coefficient) 1)
        (putnam-2014-a1-prime-p
         (abs (numerator coefficient)))))))))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

title: putnam_2014_a1
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2014_a1
-- (putnambench__agda__putnam_2014_a1): every nonzero Taylor coefficient at
-- zero of (1 - x + x^2) exp(x) is rational with reduced numerator 1 or prime.
-- This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module Main where

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Int using (Int; pos; negsuc)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; _*_)

infix 4 _!=_ _<=N_ _divides_
infixl 6 _+Z_
infixl 7 _*Z_
infixr 3 _and_
infixr 2 _or_

data Bottom : Set where

Not : Set -> Set
Not A =
  A -> Bottom

_!=_ : {A : Set} -> A -> A -> Set
x != y =
  Not (x == y)

record _and_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data _or_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  left  : A -> A or B
  right : B -> A or B

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

data _<=N_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set where
  zero<=N   : {n : Nat} -> zero <=N n
  suc<=sucN : {m n : Nat} -> m <=N n -> suc m <=N suc n

record _divides_ (divisor dividend : Nat) : Set where
  constructor division
  field
    quotient : Nat
    equation : divisor * quotient == dividend

record Prime (n : Nat) : Set where
  constructor prime
  field
    at-least-two :
      suc (suc zero) <=N n
    divisor-is-trivial :
      (d : Nat) ->
      d divides n ->
      d == suc zero or d == n

negativeNat : Nat -> Int
negativeNat zero =
  pos zero
negativeNat (suc n) =
  negsuc n

differenceNat : Nat -> Nat -> Int
differenceNat zero zero =
  pos zero
differenceNat (suc m) zero =
  pos (suc m)
differenceNat zero (suc n) =
  negsuc n
differenceNat (suc m) (suc n) =
  differenceNat m n

_+Z_ : Int -> Int -> Int
pos m +Z pos n =
  pos (m + n)
pos m +Z negsuc n =
  differenceNat m (suc n)
negsuc m +Z pos n =
  differenceNat n (suc m)
negsuc m +Z negsuc n =
  negsuc (suc (m + n))

_*Z_ : Int -> Int -> Int
pos m *Z pos n =
  pos (m * n)
pos m *Z negsuc n =
  negativeNat (m * suc n)
negsuc m *Z pos n =
  negativeNat (suc m * n)
negsuc m *Z negsuc n =
  pos (suc m * suc n)

absoluteInt : Int -> Nat
absoluteInt (pos n) =
  n
absoluteInt (negsuc n) =
  suc n

record Coprime (numerator : Int) (denominator : Nat) : Set where
  constructor bezout
  field
    left-coefficient right-coefficient : Int
    combination :
      (left-coefficient *Z numerator) +Z
      (right-coefficient *Z pos denominator) ==
      pos (suc zero)

record Rational : Set where
  constructor fraction
  field
    numerator : Int
    denominator-minus-one : Nat
    reduced :
      Coprime numerator (suc denominator-minus-one)

open Rational

denominator : Rational -> Nat
denominator q =
  suc (denominator-minus-one q)

record CompleteOrderedRealField (R : Set) : Set1 where
  field
    zeroR oneR : R
    add multiply : R -> R -> R
    negate inverse : R -> R
    lessOrEqual : R -> R -> Set
    fromNat : Nat -> R

    one-not-zero :
      oneR != zeroR

    add-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> add x y == add y x
    add-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      add (add x y) z == add x (add y z)
    add-zero :
      (x : R) -> add x zeroR == x
    add-inverse :
      (x : R) -> add x (negate x) == zeroR

    multiply-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> multiply x y == multiply y x
    multiply-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply (multiply x y) z ==
      multiply x (multiply y z)
    multiply-one :
      (x : R) -> multiply x oneR == x
    multiply-zero :
      (x : R) -> multiply x zeroR == zeroR
    distribute :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply x (add y z) ==
      add (multiply x y) (multiply x z)
    inverse-zero :
      inverse zeroR == zeroR
    multiply-inverse :
      (x : R) ->
      x != zeroR ->
      multiply x (inverse x) == oneR

    order-reflexive :
      (x : R) -> lessOrEqual x x
    order-transitive :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y z ->
      lessOrEqual x z
    order-antisymmetric :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y x ->
      x == y
    order-total :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y or lessOrEqual y x
    add-order :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual (add z x) (add z y)
    multiply-nonnegative :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR x ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR y ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR (multiply x y)
    zero-less-than-one :
      lessOrEqual zeroR oneR and zeroR != oneR

    fromNat-zero :
      fromNat zero == zeroR
    fromNat-successor :
      (n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (suc n) == add (fromNat n) oneR
    fromNat-addition :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m + n) == add (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-multiplication :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m * n) == multiply (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-injective :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat m == fromNat n ->
      m == n

    archimedean :
      (x : R) ->
      Exists Nat
        (\ n ->
          lessOrEqual x (fromNat n))
    least-upper-bound :
      (P : R -> Set) ->
      Exists R P ->
      Exists R
        (\ upper ->
          (x : R) ->
          P x ->
          lessOrEqual x upper) ->
      Exists R
        (\ supremum ->
          ((x : R) ->
            P x ->
            lessOrEqual x supremum)
          and
          ((upper : R) ->
            ((x : R) ->
              P x ->
              lessOrEqual x upper) ->
            lessOrEqual supremum upper))

open CompleteOrderedRealField

fromInt :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Int ->
  R
fromInt reals (pos n) =
  fromNat reals n
fromInt reals (negsuc n) =
  negate reals (fromNat reals (suc n))

subtract :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
subtract reals x y =
  add reals x (negate reals y)

divide :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
divide reals numerator-value denominator-value =
  multiply reals numerator-value (inverse reals denominator-value)

rationalValue :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Rational ->
  R
rationalValue reals q =
  divide reals
    (fromInt reals (numerator q))
    (fromNat reals (denominator q))

StrictLess :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
StrictLess reals x y =
  lessOrEqual reals x y and x != y

CloseTo :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
CloseTo reals center radius x =
  StrictLess reals
    (subtract reals center radius)
    x
  and
  StrictLess reals
    x
    (add reals center radius)

naturalPower :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  Nat ->
  R
naturalPower reals x zero =
  oneR reals
naturalPower reals x (suc exponent) =
  multiply reals
    (naturalPower reals x exponent)
    x

factorial : Nat -> Nat
factorial zero =
  suc zero
factorial (suc n) =
  suc n * factorial n

sumFirst :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Nat ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  R
sumFirst reals zero term =
  zeroR reals
sumFirst reals (suc n) term =
  add reals
    (sumFirst reals n term)
    (term n)

ConvergesTo :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  R ->
  Set
ConvergesTo {R} reals sequence limit =
  (epsilon : R) ->
  StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) epsilon ->
  Exists Nat
    (\ cutoff ->
      (n : Nat) ->
      cutoff <=N n ->
      CloseTo reals limit epsilon (sequence n))

SeriesHasSum :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  R ->
  Set
SeriesHasSum reals terms limit =
  ConvergesTo reals
    (\ n -> sumFirst reals n terms)
    limit

exponentialTerm :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  Nat ->
  R
exponentialTerm reals x n =
  divide reals
    (naturalPower reals x n)
    (fromNat reals (factorial n))

ExponentialValue :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
ExponentialValue reals x value =
  SeriesHasSum reals
    (exponentialTerm reals x)
    value

record StandardExponential
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) :
  Set1 where

  field
    exponential :
      R -> R
    exponential-series :
      (x : R) ->
      ExponentialValue reals x (exponential x)

open StandardExponential

targetFunction :
  {R : Set} ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) ->
  StandardExponential reals ->
  R ->
  R
targetFunction reals analysis x =
  multiply reals
    (add reals
      (subtract reals (oneR reals) x)
      (naturalPower reals x (suc (suc zero))))
    (exponential analysis x)

differenceQuotient :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (R -> R) ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
differenceQuotient reals function point x =
  divide reals
    (subtract reals (function x) (function point))
    (subtract reals x point)

DerivativeAt :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (R -> R) ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
DerivativeAt {R} reals function point derivative-value =
  (epsilon : R) ->
  StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) epsilon ->
  Exists R
    (\ delta ->
      StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) delta
      and
      ((x : R) ->
        CloseTo reals point delta x ->
        x != point ->
        CloseTo reals derivative-value epsilon
          (differenceQuotient reals function point x)))

record SmoothTaylorCoefficients
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R)
  (function : R -> R)
  (coefficients : Nat -> R) :
  Set where

  field
    derivatives :
      Nat -> R -> R
    zeroth-derivative :
      (x : R) ->
      derivatives zero x == function x
    successive-derivatives :
      (n : Nat) ->
      (x : R) ->
      DerivativeAt reals
        (derivatives n)
        x
        (derivatives (suc n) x)
    coefficient-definition :
      (n : Nat) ->
      coefficients n ==
      divide reals
        (derivatives n (zeroR reals))
        (fromNat reals (factorial n))

ReducedNumeratorIsOneOrPrime :
  Rational ->
  Set
ReducedNumeratorIsOneOrPrime q =
  numerator q == pos (suc zero)
  or
  Prime (absoluteInt (numerator q))

putnam-2014-a1 : Set1
putnam-2014-a1 =
  (R : Set) ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) ->
  (analysis : StandardExponential reals) ->
  (coefficients : Nat -> R) ->
  SmoothTaylorCoefficients reals
    (targetFunction reals analysis)
    coefficients ->
  (n : Nat) ->
  coefficients n != zeroR reals ->
  Exists Rational
    (\ q ->
      coefficients n == rationalValue reals q
      and
      ReducedNumeratorIsOneOrPrime q)

     real_of_ratTheory;

val putnam_2014_a1 =

      \n : num.
        diffn n
          (\x : real. (1 - x + x pow 2) * exp x)
          0 /
