putnam_2014_b4
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2014_b4:
;; for every positive integer n, every complex root of the polynomial whose
;; coefficient of z^k is 2^(k*(n-k)) is real. This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))

;; The source polynomial is uniquely determined by n, so its coefficient
;; condition is represented definitionally by the finite sum below. Writing
;; z=x+i*y turns the root condition into two integer-polynomial equalities
;; and the conclusion into y=0. Thus a counterexample is a first-order
;; formula over real closed fields, so a real counterexample exists if and
;; only if one exists over the real algebraic numbers.
;;
;; Every pair of real algebraic numbers lies in Q(alpha) for one real
;; algebraic alpha. A rational polynomial and rational isolating interval
;; encode alpha, while rational polynomials in alpha encode x and y. The
;; Sturm-Tarski queries below decide equality at alpha exactly. Consequently,
;; universal closure of the final predicate covers every complex z without
;; narrowing the source domain to ACL2's complex rationals.

;; Rational polynomials in alpha use descending coefficient order.

(defun putnam-2014-b4-rp-p (polynomial)
  (if (consp polynomial)
      (and (rationalp (car polynomial))
           (putnam-2014-b4-rp-p (cdr polynomial)))
    (equal polynomial nil)))

(defun putnam-2014-b4-rp-normalize (polynomial)
  (if (consp polynomial)
      (if (equal (car polynomial) 0)
          (putnam-2014-b4-rp-normalize (cdr polynomial))
        polynomial)
    nil))

(defun putnam-2014-b4-rp-neg (polynomial)
  (if (consp polynomial)
      (cons (- (car polynomial))
            (putnam-2014-b4-rp-neg (cdr polynomial)))
    nil))

(defun putnam-2014-b4-rp-add-raw (left right)
  (declare (xargs :measure (+ (acl2-count left) (acl2-count right))))
  (cond
   ((endp left) right)
   ((endp right) left)
   ((< (len left) (len right))
    (cons (car right)
          (putnam-2014-b4-rp-add-raw left (cdr right))))
   ((< (len right) (len left))
    (cons (car left)
          (putnam-2014-b4-rp-add-raw (cdr left) right)))
   (t
    (cons (+ (car left) (car right))
          (putnam-2014-b4-rp-add-raw
           (cdr left) (cdr right))))))

(defun putnam-2014-b4-rp-add (left right)
  (putnam-2014-b4-rp-normalize
   (putnam-2014-b4-rp-add-raw left right)))

(defun putnam-2014-b4-rp-sub (left right)
  (putnam-2014-b4-rp-add
   left (putnam-2014-b4-rp-neg right)))

(defun putnam-2014-b4-rp-scale (scalar polynomial)
  (if (consp polynomial)
      (cons (* scalar (car polynomial))
            (putnam-2014-b4-rp-scale scalar (cdr polynomial)))
    nil))

(defun putnam-2014-b4-zeroes (count)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix count)))
  (if (zp count)
      nil
    (cons 0 (putnam-2014-b4-zeroes (- count 1)))))

(defun putnam-2014-b4-rp-scale-shift (scalar polynomial shift)
  (append (putnam-2014-b4-rp-scale scalar polynomial)
          (putnam-2014-b4-zeroes shift)))

(defun putnam-2014-b4-rp-mul-raw (left right)
  (if (consp left)
      (putnam-2014-b4-rp-add
       (putnam-2014-b4-rp-scale-shift
        (car left) right (len (cdr left)))
       (putnam-2014-b4-rp-mul-raw (cdr left) right))
    nil))

(defun putnam-2014-b4-rp-mul (left right)
  (putnam-2014-b4-rp-normalize
   (putnam-2014-b4-rp-mul-raw left right)))

(defun putnam-2014-b4-rp-eval-aux
    (polynomial value accumulator)
  (if (consp polynomial)
      (putnam-2014-b4-rp-eval-aux
       (cdr polynomial)
       value
       (+ (* accumulator value) (car polynomial)))
    accumulator))

(defun putnam-2014-b4-rp-eval (polynomial value)
  (putnam-2014-b4-rp-eval-aux polynomial value 0))

(defun putnam-2014-b4-rp-derivative-aux
    (polynomial degree)
  (if (consp polynomial)
      (if (zp degree)
          nil
        (cons (* degree (car polynomial))
              (putnam-2014-b4-rp-derivative-aux
               (cdr polynomial) (- degree 1))))
    nil))

(defun putnam-2014-b4-rp-derivative (polynomial)
  (let ((polynomial
         (putnam-2014-b4-rp-normalize polynomial)))
    (putnam-2014-b4-rp-normalize
     (putnam-2014-b4-rp-derivative-aux
      polynomial (nfix (- (len polynomial) 1))))))

(defun putnam-2014-b4-rp-rem-fuel
    (dividend divisor fuel)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix fuel)))
  (let ((dividend
         (putnam-2014-b4-rp-normalize dividend))
        (divisor
         (putnam-2014-b4-rp-normalize divisor)))
    (if (or (zp fuel)
            (endp divisor)
            (< (len dividend) (len divisor)))
        dividend
      (putnam-2014-b4-rp-rem-fuel
       (putnam-2014-b4-rp-sub
        dividend
        (putnam-2014-b4-rp-scale-shift
         (/ (car dividend) (car divisor))
         divisor
         (- (len dividend) (len divisor))))
       divisor
       (- fuel 1)))))

(defun putnam-2014-b4-rp-rem (dividend divisor)
  (putnam-2014-b4-rp-rem-fuel
   dividend
   divisor
   (+ 1 (len (putnam-2014-b4-rp-normalize dividend)))))

(defun putnam-2014-b4-rp-sturm-tail
    (previous current fuel)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix fuel)))
  (let ((current (putnam-2014-b4-rp-normalize current)))
    (if (or (zp fuel) (endp current))
        nil
      (cons
       current
       (putnam-2014-b4-rp-sturm-tail
        current
        (putnam-2014-b4-rp-neg
         (putnam-2014-b4-rp-rem previous current))
        (- fuel 1))))))

(defun putnam-2014-b4-rp-sturm-sequence
    (polynomial second)
  (let ((polynomial
         (putnam-2014-b4-rp-normalize polynomial))
        (second
         (putnam-2014-b4-rp-normalize second)))
    (if (endp polynomial)
        nil
      (cons
       polynomial
       (if (endp second)
           nil
         (cons
          second
          (putnam-2014-b4-rp-sturm-tail
           polynomial
           second
           (+ 1 (len polynomial) (len second)))))))))

(defun putnam-2014-b4-rational-sign (value)
  (cond ((< value 0) -1)
        ((< 0 value) 1)
        (t 0)))

(defun putnam-2014-b4-rp-variations-aux
    (polynomials value previous-sign)
  (if (consp polynomials)
      (let ((sign
             (putnam-2014-b4-rational-sign
              (putnam-2014-b4-rp-eval
               (car polynomials) value))))
        (if (equal sign 0)
            (putnam-2014-b4-rp-variations-aux
             (cdr polynomials) value previous-sign)
          (+ (if (and (not (equal previous-sign 0))
                      (not (equal sign previous-sign)))
                 1
               0)
             (putnam-2014-b4-rp-variations-aux
              (cdr polynomials) value sign))))
    0))

(defun putnam-2014-b4-rp-variations
    (polynomials value)
  (putnam-2014-b4-rp-variations-aux
   polynomials value 0))

(defun putnam-2014-b4-rp-cauchy-index
    (polynomial second lower upper)
  (let ((sequence
         (putnam-2014-b4-rp-sturm-sequence
          polynomial second)))
    (- (putnam-2014-b4-rp-variations sequence lower)
       (putnam-2014-b4-rp-variations sequence upper))))

(defun putnam-2014-b4-rp-root-count
    (polynomial lower upper)
  (putnam-2014-b4-rp-cauchy-index
   polynomial
   (putnam-2014-b4-rp-derivative polynomial)
   lower
   upper))

(defun putnam-2014-b4-primitive-p
    (primitive lower upper)
  (and
   (putnam-2014-b4-rp-p primitive)
   (consp (putnam-2014-b4-rp-normalize primitive))
   (rationalp lower)
   (rationalp upper)
   (< lower upper)
   (not
    (equal
     (putnam-2014-b4-rp-eval primitive lower)
     0))
   (not
    (equal
     (putnam-2014-b4-rp-eval primitive upper)
     0))
   (equal
    (putnam-2014-b4-rp-root-count
     primitive lower upper)
    1)
   (not
    (equal
     (putnam-2014-b4-rp-cauchy-index
      primitive
      (putnam-2014-b4-rp-mul
       (putnam-2014-b4-rp-derivative primitive)
       (putnam-2014-b4-rp-derivative primitive))
      lower
      upper)
     0))))

;; For the isolated simple root alpha, this Sturm-Tarski query is
;; sign(polynomial(alpha)).
(defun putnam-2014-b4-alg-sign
    (primitive lower upper polynomial)
  (putnam-2014-b4-rp-cauchy-index
   primitive
   (putnam-2014-b4-rp-mul
    (putnam-2014-b4-rp-derivative primitive)
    polynomial)
   lower
   upper))

(defun putnam-2014-b4-alg-zero-p
    (primitive lower upper polynomial)
  (equal
   (putnam-2014-b4-alg-sign
    primitive lower upper polynomial)
   0))

;; A complex algebraic expression is a pair of rational polynomials giving
;; its real and imaginary parts at alpha.

(defun putnam-2014-b4-cx-real (value)
  (car value))

(defun putnam-2014-b4-cx-imag (value)

   (putnam-2014-b4-rp-add
    (putnam-2014-b4-cx-real left)
    (putnam-2014-b4-cx-real right))

    (putnam-2014-b4-cx-imag left)

    (putnam-2014-b4-cx-real value))
   (putnam-2014-b4-rp-neg
    (putnam-2014-b4-cx-imag value))))

(defun putnam-2014-b4-cx-sub (left right)
  (putnam-2014-b4-cx-add
   left (putnam-2014-b4-cx-neg right)))

(defun putnam-2014-b4-cx-scale (scalar value)
  (list
   (putnam-2014-b4-rp-scale
    scalar (putnam-2014-b4-cx-real value))
   (putnam-2014-b4-rp-scale
    scalar (putnam-2014-b4-cx-imag value))))

(defun putnam-2014-b4-cx-mul (left right)
  (list
   (putnam-2014-b4-rp-sub
    (putnam-2014-b4-rp-mul
     (putnam-2014-b4-cx-real left)
     (putnam-2014-b4-cx-real right))
    (putnam-2014-b4-rp-mul
     (putnam-2014-b4-cx-imag left)
     (putnam-2014-b4-cx-imag right)))
   (putnam-2014-b4-rp-add
    (putnam-2014-b4-rp-mul
     (putnam-2014-b4-cx-real left)
     (putnam-2014-b4-cx-imag right))
    (putnam-2014-b4-rp-mul
     (putnam-2014-b4-cx-imag left)
     (putnam-2014-b4-cx-real right)))))

(defun putnam-2014-b4-cx-pow (value exponent)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix exponent)))
  (if (zp exponent)
      (list (list 1) nil)
    (putnam-2014-b4-cx-mul
     value
     (putnam-2014-b4-cx-pow value (- exponent 1)))))

(defun putnam-2014-b4-polynomial-value-aux
    (z n k remaining)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix remaining)))
  (if (zp remaining)
      (list nil nil)
    (putnam-2014-b4-cx-add
     (putnam-2014-b4-cx-scale
      (expt 2 (* k (- n k)))
      (putnam-2014-b4-cx-pow z k))
     (putnam-2014-b4-polynomial-value-aux
      z n (+ k 1) (- remaining 1)))))

(defun putnam-2014-b4-polynomial-value (x y n)
  (putnam-2014-b4-polynomial-value-aux
   (list x y) n 0 (+ n 1)))

(defun putnambench-putnam-2014-b4-statement
    (n primitive lower upper x y)
  (let ((polynomial-value
         (putnam-2014-b4-polynomial-value x y n)))
    (implies
     (and
      (posp n)
      (putnam-2014-b4-primitive-p primitive lower upper)
      (putnam-2014-b4-rp-p x)
      (putnam-2014-b4-rp-p y)
      (putnam-2014-b4-alg-zero-p
       primitive lower upper
       (putnam-2014-b4-cx-real polynomial-value))
      (putnam-2014-b4-alg-zero-p
       primitive lower upper
       (putnam-2014-b4-cx-imag polynomial-value)))
     (putnam-2014-b4-alg-zero-p
      primitive lower upper y))))

title: putnam_2014_b4
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2014_b4
-- (putnambench__agda__putnam_2014_b4): every root of the complex polynomial
-- with coefficient 2^(k(n-k)) in degree k, for 0 <= k <= n, is real.
-- This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module Putnam2014B4 where

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; _-_; _*_)

infix 4 _!=_
infixr 3 _and_
infixr 2 _or_

data Bottom : Set where

Not : Set -> Set
Not A =
  A -> Bottom

_!=_ : {A : Set} -> A -> A -> Set
x != y =
  Not (x == y)

record _and_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data _or_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  left  : A -> A or B
  right : B -> A or B

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

data Positive : Nat -> Set where
  positive : {n : Nat} -> Positive (suc n)

record CompleteOrderedRealField (R : Set) : Set1 where
  field
    zeroR oneR : R
    add multiply : R -> R -> R
    negate inverse : R -> R
    lessOrEqual : R -> R -> Set
    fromNat : Nat -> R

    one-not-zero :
      oneR != zeroR

    add-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> add x y == add y x
    add-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      add (add x y) z == add x (add y z)
    add-zero :
      (x : R) -> add x zeroR == x
    add-inverse :
      (x : R) -> add x (negate x) == zeroR

    multiply-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> multiply x y == multiply y x
    multiply-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply (multiply x y) z ==
      multiply x (multiply y z)
    multiply-one :
      (x : R) -> multiply x oneR == x
    multiply-zero :
      (x : R) -> multiply x zeroR == zeroR
    distribute :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply x (add y z) ==
      add (multiply x y) (multiply x z)
    inverse-zero :
      inverse zeroR == zeroR
    multiply-inverse :
      (x : R) ->
      x != zeroR ->
      multiply x (inverse x) == oneR

    order-reflexive :
      (x : R) -> lessOrEqual x x
    order-transitive :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y z ->
      lessOrEqual x z
    order-antisymmetric :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y x ->
      x == y
    order-total :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y or lessOrEqual y x
    add-order :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual (add z x) (add z y)
    multiply-nonnegative :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR x ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR y ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR (multiply x y)
    zero-less-than-one :
      lessOrEqual zeroR oneR and zeroR != oneR

    fromNat-zero :
      fromNat zero == zeroR
    fromNat-successor :
      (n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (suc n) == add (fromNat n) oneR
    fromNat-addition :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m + n) == add (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-multiplication :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m * n) == multiply (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-injective :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat m == fromNat n ->
      m == n

    archimedean :
      (x : R) ->
      Exists Nat
        (\ n -> lessOrEqual x (fromNat n))
    least-upper-bound :
      (P : R -> Set) ->
      Exists R P ->
      Exists R
        (\ upper ->
          (x : R) ->
          P x ->
          lessOrEqual x upper) ->
      Exists R
        (\ supremum ->
          ((x : R) ->
            P x ->
            lessOrEqual x supremum)
          and
          ((upper : R) ->
            ((x : R) ->
              P x ->
              lessOrEqual x upper) ->
            lessOrEqual supremum upper))

open CompleteOrderedRealField

record Complex (R : Set) : Set where
  constructor complex
  field
    realPart      : R
    imaginaryPart : R

open Complex

complexZero :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Complex R
complexZero reals =
  complex (zeroR reals) (zeroR reals)

complexFromReal :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  Complex R
complexFromReal reals x =
  complex x (zeroR reals)

complexAdd :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Complex R ->
  Complex R ->
  Complex R
complexAdd reals z w =
  complex
    (add reals (realPart z) (realPart w))
    (add reals (imaginaryPart z) (imaginaryPart w))

complexMultiply :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Complex R ->
  Complex R ->
  Complex R
complexMultiply reals z w =
  complex
    (add reals
      (multiply reals (realPart z) (realPart w))
      (negate reals
        (multiply reals (imaginaryPart z) (imaginaryPart w))))
    (add reals
      (multiply reals (realPart z) (imaginaryPart w))
      (multiply reals (imaginaryPart z) (realPart w)))

naturalPower :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  Nat ->
  R
naturalPower reals x zero =
  oneR reals
naturalPower reals x (suc n) =
  multiply reals
    (naturalPower reals x n)
    x

complexPower :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Complex R ->
  Nat ->
  Complex R
complexPower reals z zero =
  complexFromReal reals (oneR reals)
complexPower reals z (suc n) =
  complexMultiply reals
    (complexPower reals z n)
    z

sumFirstComplex :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Nat ->
  (Nat -> Complex R) ->
  Complex R
sumFirstComplex reals zero term =
  complexZero reals
sumFirstComplex reals (suc n) term =
  complexAdd reals
    (sumFirstComplex reals n term)
    (term n)

twoN : Nat
twoN =
  suc (suc zero)

coefficient :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Nat ->
  Nat ->
  Complex R
coefficient reals n k =
  complexFromReal reals
    (naturalPower reals
      (fromNat reals twoN)
      (k * (n - k)))

polynomialValue :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Nat ->
  Complex R ->
  Complex R
polynomialValue reals n z =
  sumFirstComplex reals (suc n)
    (\ k ->
      complexMultiply reals
        (coefficient reals n k)
        (complexPower reals z k))

putnam-2014-b4 : Set1
putnam-2014-b4 =
  (R : Set) ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) ->
  (n : Nat) ->
  Positive n ->
  (z : Complex R) ->
  polynomialValue reals n z == complexZero reals ->
  imaginaryPart z == zeroR reals

(*
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2014_b4:
  for every positive integer n, all complex roots of the polynomial whose
  coefficient of x^k is 2^(k*(n-k)) are real. This file contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open arithmeticTheory pred_setTheory complexTheory;

val putnam_2014_b4 =
  ``!n : num.
      0 < n
      ==>
      !z : complex.
        ITSET
          (\k acc.
             (2 : complex) pow (k * (n - k)) * z pow k + acc)
          (count (n + 1))
          0 =
        0
        ==>
        IM z = 0``;

  polynomial with kth coefficient 2^(k(n-k)) is real. This file contains

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  NN is set.mm's class of positive integers, CC is the complex plane, and
  0 ... n is the inclusive set of coefficient indices. The displayed finite
  sum is the evaluation at z of the source polynomial whose kth coefficient
  is 2 raised to k(n-k). Since k lies between 0 and n, natural subtraction
  agrees with ordinary integer subtraction in the exponent.

  The conclusion z e. RR says exactly that the arbitrary complex zero is
  real, equivalently that its imaginary part is zero. Inlining the polynomial
  by its coefficient sum is definitionally equivalent to the source
  polynomial object and preserves every root. The final declaration is the
  single unproved $a corpus statement; this database contains no $p proof
  declaration.
$)

${
  $d k n z $.

  putnambench-putnam-2014-b4 $a |-
    A. n e. NN
      A. z e. CC
        (
          (
            sum_ k e. ( 0 ... n )
              (
                ( 2 ^ ( k x. ( n - k ) ) )
                x.
                ( z ^ k )
              )
          )
          =
          0
          ->
          z e. RR
        )
  $.
$}

title: putnam_2014_b4
content:
% Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2014_b4:
% every root of the positive-degree complex polynomial with coefficient
% 2^(k*(n-k)) at degree k is real. This file contains no proof.

putnam_2014_b4: THEORY
BEGIN
  complex: TYPE = [# real_part: real, imag_part: real #]
  polynomial: TYPE = [nat -> complex]

  complex_zero: complex =
    (# real_part := 0, imag_part := 0 #)

  complex_one: complex =
    (# real_part := 1, imag_part := 0 #)

  complex_of_real(value: real): complex =
    (# real_part := value, imag_part := 0 #)

  complex_add(left, right: complex): complex =
    (# real_part := real_part(left) + real_part(right),
       imag_part := imag_part(left) + imag_part(right) #)

  complex_mul(left, right: complex): complex =
    (# real_part :=
         real_part(left) * real_part(right)
           - imag_part(left) * imag_part(right),
       imag_part :=
         real_part(left) * imag_part(right)
           + imag_part(left) * real_part(right) #)

  complex_power(value: complex, exponent: nat): RECURSIVE complex =
    IF exponent = 0 THEN
      complex_one
    ELSE
      complex_mul(
        complex_power(value, exponent - 1),
        value)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE exponent

  polynomial_value(
      coefficients: polynomial,
      value: complex,
      count: nat): RECURSIVE complex =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      complex_zero
    ELSE
      LET k: nat = count - 1 IN
        complex_add(
          polynomial_value(coefficients, value, count - 1),
          complex_mul(
            coefficients(k),
            complex_power(value, k)))
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  has_degree(coefficients: polynomial, degree: nat): bool =
    coefficients(degree) /= complex_zero
      AND FORALL (k: nat):
        k > degree IMPLIES coefficients(k) = complex_zero

  has_putnam_coefficients(
      coefficients: polynomial,
      n: nat): bool =
    FORALL (k: nat):
      k <= n IMPLIES
        coefficients(k)
          = complex_of_real(
              (2 :: real) ^ (k * (n - k)))

  putnam_2014_b4: bool =
    FORALL (n: nat), (coefficients: polynomial):
      (n > 0
        AND has_degree(coefficients, n)
        AND has_putnam_coefficients(coefficients, n))
      IMPLIES
        FORALL (root: complex):
          polynomial_value(coefficients, root, n + 1)
              = complex_zero
            IMPLIES imag_part(root) = 0
END putnam_2014_b4

import Mathlib

open Topology Filter Nat Set Interval

/--
Let $f: [0,1] \to \mathbb{R}$ be a function for which there exists a constant $K>0$ such that $\left| f(x) - f(y) \right| \leq K \left| x - y \right|$ for all $x,y \in [0,1]$. Suppose also that for each rational number $r \in [0,1]$, there exist integers $a$ and $b$ such that $f(r) = a + br$. Prove that there exist finitely many intervals $I_1, \dots, I_n$ such that $f$ is a linear function on each $I_i$ and $[0,1] = \bigcup_{i=1}^n I_i$.
-/
theorem putnam_2014_b6
(f : ℝ → ℝ)
(hlip : ∃ K > 0, ∀ x ∈ Icc 0 1, ∀ y ∈ Icc 0 1, |f x - f y| ≤ K * |x - y|)
(hrat : ∀ r ∈ Icc (0 : ℚ) 1, ∃ a b : ℤ, f r = a + b * r)
: (∃ I : Finset (Interval ℝ), (∀ Ii ∈ I, ∃ m c : ℝ, ∀ x ∈ coeHom Ii, f x = c + m * x) ∧ Icc 0 1 = ⋃ Ii ∈ I, coeHom Ii) :=

(* Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2014_b6:
   a Lipschitz real function with integer-affine values at rational points of
   the unit interval is affine on each interval of a finite closed-interval
   cover. This file contains no proof. *)

From Stdlib Require Import Reals ZArith QArith Lists.List.

Open Scope R_scope.

Definition putnam_2014_b6_in_unit_interval (x : R) : Prop :=
  0 <= x <= 1.

Definition putnam_2014_b6_lipschitz_on_unit_interval
    (f : R -> R) : Prop :=
  exists K : R,
    0 < K /\
    forall x y : R,
      putnam_2014_b6_in_unit_interval x ->
      putnam_2014_b6_in_unit_interval y ->
      Rabs (f x - f y) <= K * Rabs (x - y).

Definition putnam_2014_b6_integer_affine_at_rationals
    (f : R -> R) : Prop :=
  forall r : Q,
    (0 <= r <= 1)%Q ->
    exists a b : Z,
      f (Q2R r) = IZR a + IZR b * Q2R r.

Definition putnam_2014_b6_in_closed_interval
    (interval : (R * R)%type) (x : R) : Prop :=
  fst interval <= x <= snd interval.

Definition putnam_2014_b6_affine_on
    (f : R -> R) (interval : (R * R)%type) : Prop :=
  exists m c : R,
    forall x : R,
      putnam_2014_b6_in_closed_interval interval x ->
      f x = c + m * x.

Definition putnam_2014_b6_covered_by
    (intervals : list (R * R)%type) (x : R) : Prop :=
  exists interval : (R * R)%type,
    List.In interval intervals /\
    putnam_2014_b6_in_closed_interval interval x.

Theorem putnam_2014_b6
    (f : R -> R)
    (hlip : putnam_2014_b6_lipschitz_on_unit_interval f)
    (hrat : putnam_2014_b6_integer_affine_at_rationals f) :
  exists intervals : list (R * R)%type,
    (forall interval : (R * R)%type,
      List.In interval intervals ->
      fst interval <= snd interval /\
      putnam_2014_b6_affine_on f interval) /\
    forall x : R,
      putnam_2014_b6_in_unit_interval x <->
      putnam_2014_b6_covered_by intervals x.
Admitted.

(*
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2014_b6:
  a Lipschitz real function on the unit interval with integer-affine values at
  rational inputs is affine on each member of a finite interval cover. This
  file contains no proof.
*)

let statement =
  `let unit_interval = {x:real | &0 <= x /\ x <= &1} in
   let is_rational =
     \x:real.
       ?p q:int.
         ~(q = (&0:int)) /\
         x = real_of_int p / real_of_int q in
   let closed_interval =
     \a b:real. {x:real | a <= x /\ x <= b} in
   !f:real->real.
     (?K:real.
        &0 < K /\
        !x y:real.
          x IN unit_interval /\ y IN unit_interval
          ==> abs (f x - f y) <= K * abs (x - y)) /\
     (!r:real.
        r IN unit_interval /\ is_rational r
        ==> ?a b:int.
              f r = real_of_int a + real_of_int b * r)
     ==>
     ?intervals:(real->bool)->bool.
       FINITE intervals /\
       (!interval:real->bool.
          interval IN intervals
          ==> ?a b m c:real.
                a <= b /\
                interval = closed_interval a b /\
                !x:real. x IN interval ==> f x = c + m * x) /\
       UNIONS intervals = unit_interval`;;

title: putnam_2014_b6
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2014_b6:
;; a Lipschitz real function on [0,1] with integer-affine values at rational
;; points has a finite closed-interval cover on which it is affine. This file
;; contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))

;; PUTNAM-2014-B6-F-APPROX is the rational regular-Cauchy presentation of the
;; restriction of the arbitrary source function to rational points of [0,1].
;; DEFSTUB keeps that function generic; every property used below is an
;; explicit hypothesis of the statement predicate.
(defstub putnam-2014-b6-f-approx (x epsilon) t)

(defun putnam-2014-b6-positive-rational-p (x)
  (and (rationalp x)
       (< 0 x)))

(defun putnam-2014-b6-unit-rational-p (x)
  (and (rationalp x)
       (<= 0 x)
       (<= x 1)))

(defun-sk putnam-2014-b6-regular-cauchy-values-p ()
  (forall (x epsilon eta)
    (implies
     (and
      (putnam-2014-b6-unit-rational-p x)
      (putnam-2014-b6-positive-rational-p epsilon)
      (putnam-2014-b6-positive-rational-p eta))
     (and
      (rationalp
       (putnam-2014-b6-f-approx x epsilon))
      (rationalp
       (putnam-2014-b6-f-approx x eta))
      (<=
       (abs
        (-
         (putnam-2014-b6-f-approx x epsilon)
         (putnam-2014-b6-f-approx x eta)))
       (+ epsilon eta))))))

;; Requiring the displayed inequality for every positive rational ERROR is
;; exactly the Lipschitz inequality for the real limits of the Cauchy names.
(defun-sk putnam-2014-b6-lipschitz-bound-p (k)
  (forall (x y error)
    (implies
     (and
      (putnam-2014-b6-unit-rational-p x)
      (putnam-2014-b6-unit-rational-p y)
      (putnam-2014-b6-positive-rational-p error))
     (<=
      (abs
       (-
        (putnam-2014-b6-f-approx x (/ error 4))
        (putnam-2014-b6-f-approx y (/ error 4))))
      (+
       (* k (abs (- x y)))
       error)))))

(defun putnam-2014-b6-positive-lipschitz-bound-p (k)
  (and
   (putnam-2014-b6-positive-rational-p k)
   (putnam-2014-b6-lipschitz-bound-p k)))

(defun-sk putnam-2014-b6-lipschitz-p ()
  (exists (k)
    (putnam-2014-b6-positive-lipschitz-bound-p k)))

(defun-sk putnam-2014-b6-equals-rational-p (x value)
  (forall (epsilon)
    (implies
     (putnam-2014-b6-positive-rational-p epsilon)
     (and
      (rationalp
       (putnam-2014-b6-f-approx x epsilon))
      (<=
       (abs
        (-
         (putnam-2014-b6-f-approx x epsilon)
         value))
       epsilon)))))

(defun putnam-2014-b6-integer-affine-witness-p
    (x a b)
  (and
   (integerp a)
   (integerp b)
   (putnam-2014-b6-equals-rational-p
    x (+ a (* b x)))))

(defun-sk putnam-2014-b6-integer-affine-value-p (x)
  (exists (a b)
    (putnam-2014-b6-integer-affine-witness-p
     x a b)))

(defun-sk putnam-2014-b6-rational-values-p ()
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (putnam-2014-b6-unit-rational-p x)
     (putnam-2014-b6-integer-affine-value-p x))))

;; A piece is (LEFT RIGHT SLOPE INTERCEPT). Under the rational-value
;; hypothesis, a finite real affine cover exists iff one exists with all four
;; entries rational: nondegenerate pieces have rational affine coefficients,
;; and transitions between distinct such formulas occur at rational points.
(defun putnam-2014-b6-piece-p (piece)
  (and
   (true-listp piece)
   (equal (len piece) 4)
   (rationalp (car piece))
   (rationalp (cadr piece))
   (rationalp (caddr piece))
   (rationalp (cadddr piece))
   (<= 0 (car piece))
   (<= (car piece) (cadr piece))
   (<= (cadr piece) 1)))

(defun putnam-2014-b6-pieces-p (pieces)
  (if (consp pieces)
      (and
       (putnam-2014-b6-piece-p (car pieces))
       (putnam-2014-b6-pieces-p (cdr pieces)))
    (equal pieces nil)))

(defun putnam-2014-b6-piece-contains-p (piece x)
  (and
   (<= (car piece) x)
   (<= x (cadr piece))))

(defun putnam-2014-b6-some-piece-contains-p
    (pieces x)
  (if (consp pieces)
      (or
       (putnam-2014-b6-piece-contains-p
        (car pieces) x)
       (putnam-2014-b6-some-piece-contains-p
        (cdr pieces) x))
    nil))

(defun-sk putnam-2014-b6-covers-unit-interval-p
    (pieces)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (putnam-2014-b6-unit-rational-p x)
     (putnam-2014-b6-some-piece-contains-p
      pieces x))))

(defun-sk putnam-2014-b6-piece-linear-p (piece)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (and
      (rationalp x)
      (putnam-2014-b6-piece-contains-p piece x))
     (putnam-2014-b6-equals-rational-p
      x
      (+
       (cadddr piece)
       (* (caddr piece) x))))))

(defun putnam-2014-b6-pieces-linear-p (pieces)
  (if (consp pieces)
      (and
       (putnam-2014-b6-piece-linear-p
        (car pieces))
       (putnam-2014-b6-pieces-linear-p
        (cdr pieces)))
    (equal pieces nil)))

(defun putnam-2014-b6-cover-witness-p (pieces)
  (and
   (true-listp pieces)
   (consp pieces)
   (putnam-2014-b6-pieces-p pieces)
   (putnam-2014-b6-covers-unit-interval-p pieces)
   (putnam-2014-b6-pieces-linear-p pieces)))

(defun-sk putnam-2014-b6-affine-cover-exists-p ()
  (exists (pieces)
    (putnam-2014-b6-cover-witness-p pieces)))

(defun putnambench-putnam-2014-b6-statement ()
  (implies
   (and
    (putnam-2014-b6-regular-cauchy-values-p)
    (putnam-2014-b6-lipschitz-p)
    (putnam-2014-b6-rational-values-p))
   (putnam-2014-b6-affine-cover-exists-p)))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

title: putnam_2014_b6
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2014_b6
-- (putnambench__agda__putnam_2014_b6): a Lipschitz real function with
-- integer-affine values at rational points is piecewise affine on finitely
-- many intervals covering [0,1]. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module Main where

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Int using (Int; pos; negsuc)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; _*_)

infix 4 _!=_
infixr 3 _and_
infixr 2 _or_

data Bottom : Set where

Not : Set -> Set
Not A =
  A -> Bottom

_!=_ : {A : Set} -> A -> A -> Set
x != y =
  Not (x == y)

record _and_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data _or_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  left  : A -> A or B
  right : B -> A or B

record Iff (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor equivalence
  field
    forward  : A -> B
    backward : B -> A

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

data Fin : Nat -> Set where
  fzero : {n : Nat} -> Fin (suc n)
  fsuc  : {n : Nat} -> Fin n -> Fin (suc n)

record CompleteOrderedRealField (R : Set) : Set1 where
  field
    zeroR oneR : R
    add multiply : R -> R -> R
    negate inverse absoluteValue : R -> R
    lessOrEqual : R -> R -> Set
    fromNat : Nat -> R

    one-not-zero :
      oneR != zeroR

    add-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> add x y == add y x
    add-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      add (add x y) z == add x (add y z)
    add-zero :
      (x : R) -> add x zeroR == x
    add-inverse :
      (x : R) -> add x (negate x) == zeroR

    multiply-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> multiply x y == multiply y x
    multiply-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply (multiply x y) z ==
      multiply x (multiply y z)
    multiply-one :
      (x : R) -> multiply x oneR == x
    multiply-zero :
      (x : R) -> multiply x zeroR == zeroR
    distribute :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply x (add y z) ==
      add (multiply x y) (multiply x z)
    inverse-zero :
      inverse zeroR == zeroR
    multiply-inverse :
      (x : R) ->
      x != zeroR ->
      multiply x (inverse x) == oneR

    order-reflexive :
      (x : R) -> lessOrEqual x x
    order-transitive :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y z ->
      lessOrEqual x z
    order-antisymmetric :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y x ->
      x == y
    order-total :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y or lessOrEqual y x
    add-order :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual (add z x) (add z y)
    multiply-nonnegative :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR x ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR y ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR (multiply x y)
    zero-less-than-one :
      lessOrEqual zeroR oneR and zeroR != oneR

    absolute-nonnegative :
      (x : R) -> lessOrEqual zeroR (absoluteValue x)
    absolute-of-nonnegative :
      (x : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR x ->
      absoluteValue x == x
    absolute-of-nonpositive :
      (x : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x zeroR ->
      absoluteValue x == negate x

    fromNat-zero :
      fromNat zero == zeroR
    fromNat-successor :
      (n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (suc n) == add (fromNat n) oneR
    fromNat-addition :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m + n) == add (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-multiplication :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m * n) == multiply (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-injective :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat m == fromNat n ->
      m == n

    archimedean :
      (x : R) ->
      Exists Nat
        (\ n ->
          lessOrEqual x (fromNat n))
    least-upper-bound :
      (P : R -> Set) ->
      Exists R P ->
      Exists R
        (\ upper ->
          (x : R) ->
          P x ->
          lessOrEqual x upper) ->
      Exists R
        (\ supremum ->
          ((x : R) ->
            P x ->
            lessOrEqual x supremum)
          and
          ((upper : R) ->
            ((x : R) ->
              P x ->
              lessOrEqual x upper) ->
            lessOrEqual supremum upper))

open CompleteOrderedRealField

subtract :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
subtract reals x y =
  add reals x (negate reals y)

StrictLess :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
StrictLess reals x y =
  lessOrEqual reals x y and x != y

Between :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
Between reals lower upper x =
  lessOrEqual reals lower x
  and
  lessOrEqual reals x upper

fromInt :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Int ->
  R
fromInt reals (pos n) =
  fromNat reals n
fromInt reals (negsuc n) =
  negate reals (fromNat reals (suc n))

record Rational : Set where
  constructor fraction
  field
    numerator             : Int
    denominator-minus-one : Nat

open Rational

denominator : Rational -> Nat
denominator q =
  suc (denominator-minus-one q)

rationalValue :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Rational ->
  R
rationalValue reals q =
  multiply reals
    (fromInt reals (numerator q))
    (inverse reals (fromNat reals (denominator q)))

record ClosedInterval
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) :
  Set where

  field
    lower upper : R
    ordered :
      lessOrEqual reals lower upper

open ClosedInterval

InClosedInterval :
  {R : Set} ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) ->
  ClosedInterval reals ->
  R ->
  Set
InClosedInterval reals interval x =
  Between reals
    (lower interval)
    (upper interval)
    x

module Putnam2014B6Statement
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) where

  UnitInterval : R -> Set
  UnitInterval x =
    Between reals
      (zeroR reals)
      (oneR reals)
      x

  LipschitzOnUnitInterval : (R -> R) -> Set
  LipschitzOnUnitInterval f =
    Exists R
      (\ K ->
        StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) K
        and
        ((x y : R) ->
          UnitInterval x ->
          UnitInterval y ->
          lessOrEqual reals
            (absoluteValue reals
              (subtract reals (f x) (f y)))
            (multiply reals K
              (absoluteValue reals
                (subtract reals x y)))))

  HasIntegerAffineValuesAtRationals : (R -> R) -> Set
  HasIntegerAffineValuesAtRationals f =
    (q : Rational) ->
    UnitInterval (rationalValue reals q) ->
    Exists Int
      (\ a ->
        Exists Int
          (\ b ->
            f (rationalValue reals q)
            ==
            add reals
              (fromInt reals a)
              (multiply reals
                (fromInt reals b)
                (rationalValue reals q))))

  AffineOn :
    (R -> R) ->
    ClosedInterval reals ->
    Set
  AffineOn f interval =
    Exists R
      (\ m ->
        Exists R
          (\ c ->
            (x : R) ->
            InClosedInterval reals interval x ->
            f x ==
            add reals c (multiply reals m x)))

  FiniteAffineIntervalCover : (R -> R) -> Set
  FiniteAffineIntervalCover f =
    Exists Nat
      (\ count ->
        Exists (Fin count -> ClosedInterval reals)
          (\ intervals ->
            ((index : Fin count) ->
              AffineOn f (intervals index))
            and
            ((x : R) ->
              Iff
                (UnitInterval x)
                (Exists (Fin count)
                  (\ index ->
                    InClosedInterval reals
                      (intervals index)
                      x)))))

  proposition : Set
  proposition =
    (f : R -> R) ->
    LipschitzOnUnitInterval f ->
    HasIntegerAffineValuesAtRationals f ->
    FiniteAffineIntervalCover f

putnam-2014-b6 : Set1
putnam-2014-b6 =
  (R : Set) ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) ->
  Putnam2014B6Statement.proposition reals

title: putnam_2014_b6
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2014_b6:
  a Lipschitz real function on the unit interval whose values at rational
  points are integer-affine is affine on each interval of a finite interval
  cover. This file contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open integerTheory pred_setTheory realTheory intrealTheory ratTheory
     real_of_ratTheory;

val putnam_2014_b6 =
  ``!f : real -> real.
      ((?K : real.
          0 < K /\
          !x y : real.
            0 <= x /\ x <= 1 /\ 0 <= y /\ y <= 1
            ==>
            abs (f x - f y) <= K * abs (x - y)) /\
       (!r : rat.
          0q <= r /\ r <= 1q
          ==>
          ?a b : int.
            f (real_of_rat r) =
              real_of_int a + real_of_int b * real_of_rat r))
      ==>
      ?I : (real set) set.
        FINITE I /\
        (!J : real set.
           J IN I
           ==>
           (?a b : real.
              a <= b /\ J = {x : real | a <= x /\ x <= b}) /\
           (?m c : real.
              !x : real.
                x IN J ==> f x = c + m * x)) /\
        {x : real | 0 <= x /\ x <= 1} = BIGUNION I``;

title: putnam_2014_b6
content:
$(
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact
  putnam_2014_b6: a Lipschitz real function on the unit interval whose
  rational values are integral-affine is affine on each member of a finite
  interval cover of the unit interval. This file contains no proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  F ranges over all total real-valued functions. The first hypothesis keeps
  the positive Lipschitz constant existentially quantified and restricts both
  real arguments to the closed unit interval. The second ranges over every
  rational in that interval and keeps its two integer witnesses internal.

  A positive integer n and four real-valued functions on 1 ... n encode the
  finite family of closed intervals, their slopes, and their intercepts.
  Every endpoint pair is ordered, F is affine throughout its corresponding
  interval, and the indexed union is exactly [0,1]. Since a cover of [0,1]
  is nonempty, positive finite indexing is bidirectionally equivalent to the
  source finite-family formulation. The final declaration is the single
  unproved $a corpus statement; this database contains no $p proof statement.
$)

${
  $d A B C F K M a b i n r x y $.

  putnambench-putnam-2014-b6 $a |-
    A. F e. ( RR ^m RR )
      (
        (
          E. K e. RR
            (
              0 < K
              /\
              A. x e. ( 0 [,] 1 )
                A. y e. ( 0 [,] 1 )
                  (
                    abs ` ( ( F ` x ) - ( F ` y ) )
                  )
                  <_
                  (
                    K x. ( abs ` ( x - y ) )
                  )
            )
          /\
          A. r e. QQ
            (
              r e. ( 0 [,] 1 )
              ->
              E. a e. ZZ
                E. b e. ZZ
                  (
                    ( F ` r )
                    =
                    ( a + ( b x. r ) )
                  )
            )
        )
        ->
        E. n e. NN
          E. A e. ( RR ^m ( 1 ... n ) )
            E. B e. ( RR ^m ( 1 ... n ) )
              E. M e. ( RR ^m ( 1 ... n ) )
                E. C e. ( RR ^m ( 1 ... n ) )
                  (
                    A. i e. ( 1 ... n )
                      (
                        ( A ` i ) <_ ( B ` i )
                        /\
                        A. x e.
                          ( ( A ` i ) [,] ( B ` i ) )
                            (
                              ( F ` x )
                              =
                              (
                                ( C ` i )
                                +
                                ( ( M ` i ) x. x )
                              )
                            )
                      )
                    /\
                    (
                      ( 0 [,] 1 )
                      =
                      U_ i e. ( 1 ... n )
                        ( ( A ` i ) [,] ( B ` i ) )
                    )
                  )
      )
  $.
$}

title: putnam_2014_b6
content:
% Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2014_b6:
% a Lipschitz real function on [0,1] whose value at every rational point is
% an integer-affine expression is affine on finitely many closed intervals
% covering [0,1]. This file contains no proof.

putnam_2014_b6: THEORY
BEGIN
  closed_interval: TYPE = [# lower: real, upper: real #]

  IMPORTING finite_sets[closed_interval]

  real_function: TYPE = [real -> real]
  interval_family: TYPE = finite_set[closed_interval]

  in_unit_interval(x: real): bool =
    0 <= x AND x <= 1

  in_closed_interval(x: real, I: closed_interval): bool =
    lower(I) <= x AND x <= upper(I)

  lipschitz_on_unit_interval(f: real_function): bool =
    EXISTS (K: real):
      K > 0
        AND (FORALL (x, y: real):
          in_unit_interval(x) AND in_unit_interval(y)
            IMPLIES abs(f(x) - f(y)) <= K * abs(x - y))

  integer_affine_at_rational_points(f: real_function): bool =
    FORALL (r: rat):
      0 <= r AND r <= 1 IMPLIES
        EXISTS (a, b: int):
          f(r :: real)
            = (a :: real) + (b :: real) * (r :: real)

  affine_on_closed_interval(
      f: real_function,
      I: closed_interval): bool =
    lower(I) <= upper(I)
      AND EXISTS (m, c: real):
        FORALL (x: real):
          in_closed_interval(x, I) IMPLIES
            f(x) = c + m * x

  finite_affine_interval_cover(f: real_function): bool =
    EXISTS (intervals: interval_family):
      (FORALL (I: closed_interval):
        intervals(I) IMPLIES affine_on_closed_interval(f, I))
        AND (FORALL (x: real):
          in_unit_interval(x) IFF
            EXISTS (I: closed_interval):
              intervals(I) AND in_closed_interval(x, I))

  putnam_2014_b6: bool =
    FORALL (f: real_function):
      lipschitz_on_unit_interval(f)
        AND integer_affine_at_rational_points(f)
      IMPLIES finite_affine_interval_cover(f)
END putnam_2014_b6

title: putnam_2015_a1
content:
import Mathlib

/--
Let $A$ and $B$ be points on the same branch of the hyperbola $xy=1$. Suppose that $P$ is a point lying between $A$ and $B$ on this hyperbola, such that the area of the triangle $APB$ is as large as possible. Show that the region bounded by the hyperbola and the chord $AP$ has the same area as the region bounded by the hyperbola and the chord $PB$.
-/
theorem putnam_2015_a1
  (hyperbola : Set (Fin 2 → ℝ))
  (hhyperbola : hyperbola = {p | p 1 = 1 / p 0 ∧ p 0 > 0})
  (A B P : Fin 2 → ℝ)
  (PPline : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → (Fin 2 → ℝ) → (ℝ → ℝ))
  (hAB : A ∈ hyperbola ∧ B ∈ hyperbola ∧ A 0 < B 0)
  (hP : P ∈ hyperbola ∧ A 0 < P 0 ∧ P 0 < B 0 ∧ (∀ P', (P' ∈ hyperbola ∧ A 0 < P' 0 ∧ P' 0 < B 0) → MeasureTheory.volume (convexHull ℝ {A, P', B}) ≤ MeasureTheory.volume (convexHull ℝ {A, P, B})))
  (hPPline : ∀ P1 P2, P1 0 ≠ P2 0 → PPline P1 P2 = (fun x : ℝ => ((P2 1 - P1 1) / (P2 0 - P1 0)) * (x - P1 0) + P1 1)) :
  ∫ x in Set.Ioo (A 0) (P 0), (PPline A P) x - 1 / x = ∫ x in Set.Ioo (P 0) (B 0), (PPline P B) x - 1 / x :=
sorry

title: putnam_2015_a1
content:
(* Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2015_a1:
   a maximum-area triangle inscribed in the positive branch of the hyperbola
   xy = 1 determines two equal areas between the hyperbola and its adjacent
   chords; this file contains no proof. *)

From Stdlib Require Import Reals.

Open Scope R_scope.

Definition putnam_2015_a1_point := (R * R)%type.

Definition putnam_2015_a1_hyperbola
    (p : putnam_2015_a1_point) : Prop :=
  snd p = 1 / fst p /\ 0 < fst p.

Definition putnam_2015_a1_chord
    (p q : putnam_2015_a1_point) (x : R) : R :=
  (snd q - snd p) / (fst q - fst p) * (x - fst p) + snd p.

Definition putnam_2015_a1_triangle_area
    (a b c : putnam_2015_a1_point) : R :=
  Rabs
    ((fst b - fst a) * (snd c - snd a) -
     (snd b - snd a) * (fst c - fst a)) / 2.

Definition putnam_2015_a1_same_integral
    (f : R -> R) (a b : R)
    (g : R -> R) (c d : R) : Prop :=
  exists f_integrable : Riemann_integrable f a b,
    exists g_integrable : Riemann_integrable g c d,
      RiemannInt f_integrable = RiemannInt g_integrable.

Theorem putnam_2015_a1
    (A B P : putnam_2015_a1_point)
    (hAB :
      putnam_2015_a1_hyperbola A /\
      putnam_2015_a1_hyperbola B /\
      fst A < fst B)
    (hP :
      putnam_2015_a1_hyperbola P /\
      fst A < fst P /\
      fst P < fst B /\
      (forall P' : putnam_2015_a1_point,
        putnam_2015_a1_hyperbola P' /\
        fst A < fst P' /\
        fst P' < fst B ->
        putnam_2015_a1_triangle_area A P' B <=
        putnam_2015_a1_triangle_area A P B)) :
  putnam_2015_a1_same_integral
    (fun x : R => putnam_2015_a1_chord A P x - 1 / x)
    (fst A) (fst P)
    (fun x : R => putnam_2015_a1_chord P B x - 1 / x)
    (fst P) (fst B).
Admitted.

theory putnam_2015_a1 imports
Complex_Main
"HOL-Analysis.Finite_Cartesian_Product"
"HOL-Analysis.Interval_Integral"
begin

theorem putnam_2015_a1:
  fixes hyperbola :: "(real^2) set"
  and A B :: "real^2"
  and P :: "real^2"
  and PPline :: "(real^2) \<Rightarrow> (real^2) \<Rightarrow> (real \<Rightarrow> real)"
  defines "hyperbola \<equiv> {p :: real^2. p$2 = 1 / p$1 \<and> p$1 > 0}"
  assumes hAB: "A \<in> hyperbola \<and> B \<in> hyperbola \<and> A$1 < B$1"
  and hP: "P \<in> hyperbola \<and> A$1 < P$1 \<and> P$1 < B$1 \<and> (\<forall> P' :: real^2. (P' \<in> hyperbola \<and> A$1 < P'$1 \<and> P'$1 < B$1) \<longrightarrow> emeasure lebesgue (convex hull {A, P', B}) \<le> emeasure lebesgue (convex hull {A, P, B}))"
  and hPPline: "\<forall> P1 P2 :: real^2. P1$1 \<noteq> P2$1 \<longrightarrow> PPline P1 P2 = (\<lambda> x :: real. (P2$2 - P1$2) / (P2$1 - P1$1) * (x - P1$1) + P1$2)"
  shows "interval_lebesgue_integral lebesgue (A$1) (P$1) (\<lambda> x. PPline A P x - 1 / x) = interval_lebesgue_integral lebesgue (P$1) (B$1) (\<lambda> x. PPline P B x - 1 / x)"
  sorry

end

title: putnam_2015_a1
putnam_2015_a1
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2015_a1:
;; a maximum-area triangle inscribed in the positive branch of xy = 1 has
;; equal areas between the hyperbola and its two adjacent chords. This file
;; contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))

;; The context is a Dedekind-complete ordered field, hence a presentation of
;; the real field. The source hyperbola and chord function are unfolded. The
;; triangle area is its determinant formula, and each source Lebesgue integral
;; is represented by the equivalent limit of uniform right-endpoint Riemann
;; sums; the endpoints do not affect these continuous integrands.

(defun p15a1-member-p (carrier x)
  (if (apply$ carrier (list x)) t nil))

(defun p15a1-unary-value (operation x)
  (apply$ operation (list x)))

(defun p15a1-binary-value (operation x y)
  (apply$ operation (list x y)))

(defun-sk p15a1-valid-set-p (carrier set)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (apply$ set (list x))
     (p15a1-member-p carrier x))))

(defun-sk p15a1-field-laws-p
    (carrier add multiply negate inverse zero one)
  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (p15a1-member-p carrier x)
      (p15a1-member-p carrier y)
      (p15a1-member-p carrier z))
     (and
      (p15a1-member-p
       carrier (p15a1-binary-value add x y))
      (p15a1-member-p
       carrier (p15a1-binary-value multiply x y))
      (p15a1-member-p
       carrier (p15a1-unary-value negate x))
      (p15a1-member-p
       carrier (p15a1-unary-value inverse x))
      (equal
       (p15a1-binary-value
        add (p15a1-binary-value add x y) z)
       (p15a1-binary-value
        add x (p15a1-binary-value add y z)))
      (equal
       (p15a1-binary-value add x y)
       (p15a1-binary-value add y x))
      (equal (p15a1-binary-value add x zero) x)
      (equal
       (p15a1-binary-value
        add x (p15a1-unary-value negate x))
       zero)
      (equal
       (p15a1-binary-value
        multiply
        (p15a1-binary-value multiply x y)
        z)
       (p15a1-binary-value
        multiply
        x
        (p15a1-binary-value multiply y z)))
      (equal
       (p15a1-binary-value multiply x y)
       (p15a1-binary-value multiply y x))
      (equal
       (p15a1-binary-value multiply x one)
       x)
      (implies
       (equal x zero)
       (equal (p15a1-unary-value inverse x) zero))
      (implies
       (not (equal x zero))
       (equal
        (p15a1-binary-value
         multiply x (p15a1-unary-value inverse x))
        one))
      (equal
       (p15a1-binary-value
        multiply x (p15a1-binary-value add y z))
       (p15a1-binary-value
        add
        (p15a1-binary-value multiply x y)
        (p15a1-binary-value multiply x z)))))))

(defun-sk p15a1-order-laws-p
    (carrier add multiply zero less)
  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (p15a1-member-p carrier x)
      (p15a1-member-p carrier y)
      (p15a1-member-p carrier z))
     (and
      (not (p15a1-binary-value less x x))
      (or
       (equal x y)
       (p15a1-binary-value less x y)
       (p15a1-binary-value less y x))
      (implies
       (and
        (p15a1-binary-value less x y)
        (p15a1-binary-value less y z))
       (p15a1-binary-value less x z))
      (implies
       (p15a1-binary-value less x y)
       (p15a1-binary-value
        less
        (p15a1-binary-value add x z)
        (p15a1-binary-value add y z)))
      (implies
       (and
        (p15a1-binary-value less zero x)
        (p15a1-binary-value less zero y))
       (p15a1-binary-value
        less
        zero
        (p15a1-binary-value multiply x y)))))))

(defun-sk p15a1-set-nonempty-p (carrier set)
  (exists (x)
    (and
     (p15a1-member-p carrier x)
     (apply$ set (list x)))))

(defun-sk p15a1-upper-bound-p
    (carrier less set bound)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (and
      (p15a1-member-p carrier x)
      (apply$ set (list x)))
     (not
      (p15a1-binary-value less bound x)))))

(defun-sk p15a1-bounded-above-p
    (carrier less set)
  (exists (bound)
    (and
     (p15a1-member-p carrier bound)
     (p15a1-upper-bound-p
      carrier less set bound))))

(defun-sk p15a1-least-upper-bound-p
    (carrier less set supremum)
  (forall (bound)
    (implies
     (and
      (p15a1-member-p carrier bound)
      (p15a1-upper-bound-p
       carrier less set bound))
     (not
      (p15a1-binary-value
       less bound supremum)))))

(defun p15a1-supremum-p
    (carrier less set supremum)
  (and
   (p15a1-member-p carrier supremum)
   (p15a1-upper-bound-p
    carrier less set supremum)
   (p15a1-least-upper-bound-p
    carrier less set supremum)))

(defun-sk p15a1-has-supremum-p
    (carrier less set)
  (exists (supremum)
    (p15a1-supremum-p
     carrier less set supremum)))

(defun-sk p15a1-dedekind-complete-p
    (carrier less)
  (forall (set)
    (implies
     (and
      (tamep-functionp set)
      (p15a1-valid-set-p carrier set)
      (p15a1-set-nonempty-p carrier set)
      (p15a1-bounded-above-p carrier less set))
     (p15a1-has-supremum-p
      carrier less set))))

(defun p15a1-real-field-p
    (carrier add multiply negate inverse zero one less)
  (and
   (tamep-functionp carrier)
   (tamep-functionp add)
   (tamep-functionp multiply)
   (tamep-functionp negate)
   (tamep-functionp inverse)
   (tamep-functionp less)
   (p15a1-member-p carrier zero)
   (p15a1-member-p carrier one)
   (not (equal zero one))
   (p15a1-field-laws-p
    carrier add multiply negate inverse zero one)
   (p15a1-order-laws-p
    carrier add multiply zero less)
   (p15a1-binary-value less zero one)
   (p15a1-dedekind-complete-p carrier less)))

;; Real-field context and arithmetic.

(defun p15a1-r-carrier (ctx) (nth 0 ctx))
(defun p15a1-r-zero (ctx) (nth 1 ctx))
(defun p15a1-r-one (ctx) (nth 2 ctx))
(defun p15a1-r-add (ctx) (nth 3 ctx))
(defun p15a1-r-mul (ctx) (nth 4 ctx))
(defun p15a1-r-neg (ctx) (nth 5 ctx))
(defun p15a1-r-inv (ctx) (nth 6 ctx))
(defun p15a1-r-lt (ctx) (nth 7 ctx))

(defun p15a1-context-p (ctx)
  (and
   (true-listp ctx)
   (equal (len ctx) 8)
   (p15a1-real-field-p
    (p15a1-r-carrier ctx)
    (p15a1-r-add ctx)
    (p15a1-r-mul ctx)
    (p15a1-r-neg ctx)
    (p15a1-r-inv ctx)
    (p15a1-r-zero ctx)
    (p15a1-r-one ctx)
    (p15a1-r-lt ctx))))

(defun p15a1-r-add-value (ctx x y)
  (p15a1-binary-value (p15a1-r-add ctx) x y))

(defun p15a1-r-mul-value (ctx x y)
  (p15a1-binary-value (p15a1-r-mul ctx) x y))

(defun p15a1-r-neg-value (ctx x)
  (p15a1-unary-value (p15a1-r-neg ctx) x))

(defun p15a1-r-inv-value (ctx x)
  (p15a1-unary-value (p15a1-r-inv ctx) x))

(defun p15a1-r-sub-value (ctx x y)
  (p15a1-r-add-value
   ctx x (p15a1-r-neg-value ctx y)))

(defun p15a1-r-div-value (ctx x y)
  (p15a1-r-mul-value
   ctx x (p15a1-r-inv-value ctx y)))

(defun p15a1-r-lt-p (ctx x y)
  (if (p15a1-binary-value
       (p15a1-r-lt ctx) x y)
      t nil))

(defun p15a1-r-le-p (ctx x y)
  (not (p15a1-r-lt-p ctx y x)))

(defun p15a1-r-abs-value (ctx x)
  (if (p15a1-r-lt-p
       ctx x (p15a1-r-zero ctx))
      (p15a1-r-neg-value ctx x)
    x))

(defun p15a1-positive-real-p (ctx x)
  (and
   (p15a1-member-p (p15a1-r-carrier ctx) x)
   (p15a1-r-lt-p
    ctx (p15a1-r-zero ctx) x)))

(defun p15a1-nat-cast (ctx n)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix n)))
  (if (zp n)
      (p15a1-r-zero ctx)
    (p15a1-r-add-value
     ctx
     (p15a1-r-one ctx)
     (p15a1-nat-cast ctx (- n 1)))))

;; Points, the positive hyperbola branch, and triangle area.

(defun p15a1-point-p (ctx point)
  (and
   (true-listp point)
   (equal (len point) 2)
   (p15a1-member-p
    (p15a1-r-carrier ctx) (nth 0 point))
   (p15a1-member-p
    (p15a1-r-carrier ctx) (nth 1 point))))

(defun p15a1-point-x (point)
  (nth 0 point))

(defun p15a1-point-y (point)
  (nth 1 point))

(defun p15a1-on-hyperbola-p (ctx point)
  (and
   (p15a1-point-p ctx point)
   (p15a1-positive-real-p
    ctx (p15a1-point-x point))
   (equal
    (p15a1-point-y point)
    (p15a1-r-inv-value
     ctx (p15a1-point-x point)))))

(defun p15a1-two (ctx)
  (p15a1-r-add-value
   ctx (p15a1-r-one ctx) (p15a1-r-one ctx)))

(defun p15a1-triangle-double-area
    (ctx a p b)
  (p15a1-r-abs-value
   ctx
   (p15a1-r-sub-value
    ctx
    (p15a1-r-mul-value
     ctx
     (p15a1-r-sub-value
      ctx (p15a1-point-x p) (p15a1-point-x a))
     (p15a1-r-sub-value
      ctx (p15a1-point-y b) (p15a1-point-y a)))
    (p15a1-r-mul-value
     ctx
     (p15a1-r-sub-value
      ctx (p15a1-point-y p) (p15a1-point-y a))
     (p15a1-r-sub-value
      ctx (p15a1-point-x b) (p15a1-point-x a))))))

(defun p15a1-triangle-area
    (ctx a p b)
  (p15a1-r-div-value
   ctx
   (p15a1-triangle-double-area ctx a p b)
   (p15a1-two ctx)))

(defun p15a1-interior-hyperbola-point-p
    (ctx a b point)
  (and
   (p15a1-on-hyperbola-p ctx point)
   (p15a1-r-lt-p
    ctx (p15a1-point-x a) (p15a1-point-x point))
   (p15a1-r-lt-p
    ctx (p15a1-point-x point) (p15a1-point-x b))))

(defun-sk p15a1-maximizes-triangle-area-p
    (ctx a b p)
  (forall (p-prime)
    (implies
     (p15a1-interior-hyperbola-point-p
      ctx a b p-prime)
     (p15a1-r-le-p
      ctx
      (p15a1-triangle-area ctx a p-prime b)
      (p15a1-triangle-area ctx a p b)))))

;; The affine chord through LEFT and RIGHT, and its difference from 1/x.

(defun p15a1-chord-value
    (ctx left right x)
  (p15a1-r-add-value
   ctx
   (p15a1-r-mul-value
    ctx
    (p15a1-r-div-value
     ctx
     (p15a1-r-sub-value
      ctx
      (p15a1-point-y right)
      (p15a1-point-y left))
     (p15a1-r-sub-value
      ctx
      (p15a1-point-x right)
      (p15a1-point-x left)))
    (p15a1-r-sub-value
     ctx x (p15a1-point-x left)))
   (p15a1-point-y left)))

(defun p15a1-region-integrand
    (ctx left right x)
  (p15a1-r-sub-value
   ctx
   (p15a1-chord-value ctx left right x)
   (p15a1-r-inv-value ctx x)))

;; Uniform right-endpoint Riemann sums on [START, END].

(defun p15a1-riemann-sum
    (ctx left right start delta remaining)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix remaining)))
  (if (zp remaining)
      (p15a1-r-zero ctx)
    (p15a1-r-add-value
     ctx
     (p15a1-region-integrand
      ctx left right
      (p15a1-r-add-value
       ctx start
       (p15a1-r-mul-value
        ctx
        (p15a1-nat-cast ctx remaining)
        delta)))
     (p15a1-riemann-sum
      ctx left right start delta (- remaining 1)))))

(defun p15a1-integral-approx
    (ctx left right start end subdivisions)
  (if (posp subdivisions)
      (let ((delta
             (p15a1-r-div-value
              ctx

title: putnam_2015_a1
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2015_a1
-- (putnambench__agda__putnam_2015_a1): an area-maximizing point between two
-- points on the positive branch of xy = 1 makes the two chord-to-hyperbola
-- regions have equal area. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module Putnam2015A1 where

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; _*_)

infix 4 _!=_ _<=N_
infixr 3 _and_
infixr 2 _or_

data Bottom : Set where

Not : Set -> Set
Not A =
  A -> Bottom

_!=_ : {A : Set} -> A -> A -> Set
x != y =
  Not (x == y)

record _and_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data _or_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  left  : A -> A or B
  right : B -> A or B

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

data _<=N_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set where
  zero<=N   : {n : Nat} -> zero <=N n
  suc<=sucN : {m n : Nat} -> m <=N n -> suc m <=N suc n

record CompleteOrderedRealField (R : Set) : Set1 where
  field
    zeroR oneR : R
    add multiply : R -> R -> R
    negate inverse : R -> R
    lessOrEqual : R -> R -> Set
    fromNat : Nat -> R

    one-not-zero :
      oneR != zeroR

    add-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> add x y == add y x
    add-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      add (add x y) z == add x (add y z)
    add-zero :
      (x : R) -> add x zeroR == x
    add-inverse :
      (x : R) -> add x (negate x) == zeroR

    multiply-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> multiply x y == multiply y x
    multiply-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply (multiply x y) z ==
      multiply x (multiply y z)
    multiply-one :
      (x : R) -> multiply x oneR == x
    multiply-zero :
      (x : R) -> multiply x zeroR == zeroR
    distribute :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply x (add y z) ==
      add (multiply x y) (multiply x z)
    inverse-zero :
      inverse zeroR == zeroR
    multiply-inverse :
      (x : R) ->
      x != zeroR ->
      multiply x (inverse x) == oneR

    order-reflexive :
      (x : R) -> lessOrEqual x x
    order-transitive :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y z ->
      lessOrEqual x z
    order-antisymmetric :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y x ->
      x == y
    order-total :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y or lessOrEqual y x
    add-order :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual (add z x) (add z y)
    multiply-nonnegative :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR x ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR y ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR (multiply x y)
    zero-less-than-one :
      lessOrEqual zeroR oneR and zeroR != oneR

    fromNat-zero :
      fromNat zero == zeroR
    fromNat-successor :
      (n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (suc n) == add (fromNat n) oneR
    fromNat-addition :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m + n) == add (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-multiplication :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m * n) == multiply (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-injective :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat m == fromNat n ->
      m == n

    archimedean :
      (x : R) ->
      Exists Nat
        (\ n -> lessOrEqual x (fromNat n))
    least-upper-bound :
      (P : R -> Set) ->
      Exists R P ->
      Exists R
        (\ upper ->
          (x : R) ->
          P x ->
          lessOrEqual x upper) ->
      Exists R
        (\ supremum ->
          ((x : R) ->
            P x ->
            lessOrEqual x supremum)
          and
          ((upper : R) ->
            ((x : R) ->
              P x ->
              lessOrEqual x upper) ->
            lessOrEqual supremum upper))

open CompleteOrderedRealField

oneN : Nat
oneN =
  suc zero

twoN : Nat
twoN =
  suc oneN

subtract :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
subtract reals x y =
  add reals x (negate reals y)

divide :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
divide reals x y =
  multiply reals x (inverse reals y)

StrictLess :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
StrictLess reals x y =
  lessOrEqual reals x y and x != y

CloseTo :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
CloseTo reals center radius x =
  StrictLess reals
    (subtract reals center radius)
    x
  and
  StrictLess reals
    x
    (add reals center radius)

ConvergesTo :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  R ->
  Set
ConvergesTo {R} reals sequence limit =
  (epsilon : R) ->
  StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) epsilon ->
  Exists Nat
    (\ cutoff ->
      (n : Nat) ->
      cutoff <=N n ->
      CloseTo reals limit epsilon (sequence n))

maximum :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
maximum reals x y with order-total reals x y
... | left _ =
  y
... | right _ =
  x

absoluteValue :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R
absoluteValue reals x =
  maximum reals x (negate reals x)

record Point (R : Set) : Set where
  constructor point
  field
    x-coordinate : R
    y-coordinate : R

open Point

OnPositiveHyperbola :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Point R ->
  Set
OnPositiveHyperbola reals p =
  y-coordinate p ==
    divide reals
      (oneR reals)
      (x-coordinate p)
  and
  StrictLess reals
    (zeroR reals)
    (x-coordinate p)

doubleSignedArea :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Point R ->
  Point R ->
  Point R ->
  R
doubleSignedArea reals a b c =
  subtract reals
    (multiply reals
      (subtract reals
        (x-coordinate b)
        (x-coordinate a))
      (subtract reals
        (y-coordinate c)
        (y-coordinate a)))
    (multiply reals
      (subtract reals
        (y-coordinate b)
        (y-coordinate a))
      (subtract reals
        (x-coordinate c)
        (x-coordinate a)))

triangleArea :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Point R ->
  Point R ->
  Point R ->
  R
triangleArea reals a b c =
  divide reals
    (absoluteValue reals
      (doubleSignedArea reals a b c))
    (fromNat reals twoN)

chordLine :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Point R ->
  Point R ->
  R ->
  R
chordLine reals p q x =
  add reals
    (multiply reals
      (divide reals
        (subtract reals
          (y-coordinate q)
          (y-coordinate p))
        (subtract reals
          (x-coordinate q)
          (x-coordinate p)))
      (subtract reals x (x-coordinate p)))
    (y-coordinate p)

sumFirst :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Nat ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  R
sumFirst reals zero terms =
  zeroR reals
sumFirst reals (suc n) terms =
  add reals
    (sumFirst reals n terms)
    (terms n)

midpointRiemannSum :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  (R -> R) ->
  Nat ->
  R
midpointRiemannSum reals lower upper function pieces =
  let
    step =
      divide reals
        (subtract reals upper lower)
        (fromNat reals pieces)
    halfStep =
      divide reals
        step
        (fromNat reals twoN)
  in
  sumFirst reals pieces
    (\ i ->
      multiply reals
        (function
          (add reals lower
            (add reals
              (multiply reals
                (fromNat reals i)
                step)
              halfStep)))
        step)

IntervalIntegralValue :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  (R -> R) ->
  R ->
  Set
IntervalIntegralValue reals lower upper function integralValue =
  ConvergesTo reals
    (\ n ->
      midpointRiemannSum reals
        lower
        upper
        function
        (suc n))
    integralValue

module Putnam2015A1Statement
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) where

  MaximalTriangleArea :
    Point R ->
    Point R ->
    Point R ->
    Set
  MaximalTriangleArea A B P =
    (P' : Point R) ->
    OnPositiveHyperbola reals P' ->
    StrictLess reals
      (x-coordinate A)
      (x-coordinate P') ->
    StrictLess reals
      (x-coordinate P')
      (x-coordinate B) ->
    lessOrEqual reals
      (triangleArea reals A P' B)
      (triangleArea reals A P B)

  chordMinusHyperbola :
    Point R ->
    Point R ->
    R ->
    R
  chordMinusHyperbola p q x =
    subtract reals
      (chordLine reals p q x)
      (divide reals (oneR reals) x)

  EqualRegionAreas :
    Point R ->
    Point R ->
    Point R ->
    Set
  EqualRegionAreas A B P =
    Exists R
      (\ commonArea ->
        IntervalIntegralValue reals
          (x-coordinate A)
          (x-coordinate P)
          (chordMinusHyperbola A P)
          commonArea
        and
        IntervalIntegralValue reals
          (x-coordinate P)
          (x-coordinate B)
          (chordMinusHyperbola P B)
          commonArea)

  proposition : Set
  proposition =
    (A B P : Point R) ->
    OnPositiveHyperbola reals A ->
    OnPositiveHyperbola reals B ->
    StrictLess reals
      (x-coordinate A)
      (x-coordinate B) ->
    OnPositiveHyperbola reals P ->
    StrictLess reals
      (x-coordinate A)
      (x-coordinate P) ->
    StrictLess reals
      (x-coordinate P)
      (x-coordinate B) ->
    MaximalTriangleArea A B P ->
    EqualRegionAreas A B P

putnam-2015-a1 : Set1
putnam-2015-a1 =
  (R : Set) ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) ->
  Putnam2015A1Statement.proposition reals

title: putnam_2015_a1
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2015_a1:
  a maximum-area triangle with vertices on the positive branch of xy = 1
  cuts off equal areas between the hyperbola and its two adjacent chords.
  This file contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open pairTheory pred_setTheory realTheory integrationTheory;
open extrealTheory measureTheory lebesgue_measureTheory martingaleTheory;

val putnam_2015_a1 =
  ``!(hyperbola : (real # real) set)
     (A B P : real # real)
     (PPline : (real # real) -> (real # real) -> real -> real).
      let convex_hull_three =
        \X Y Z : real # real.
          {Q : real # real |
            ?u v w : real.
              0 <= u /\ 0 <= v /\ 0 <= w /\
              u + v + w = 1 /\
              Q =
                (u * FST X + v * FST Y + w * FST Z,
                 u * SND X + v * SND Y + w * SND Z)}
      in
      let triangle_area =
        \X Y Z : real # real.
          measure
            (prod_measure_space lebesgue lebesgue)
            (convex_hull_three X Y Z)
      in
        hyperbola =
          {Q : real # real | SND Q = 1 / FST Q /\ 0 < FST Q} /\
        A IN hyperbola /\ B IN hyperbola /\ FST A < FST B /\
        P IN hyperbola /\ FST A < FST P /\ FST P < FST B /\
        (!Q : real # real.
           Q IN hyperbola /\ FST A < FST Q /\ FST Q < FST B
           ==>
           triangle_area A Q B <= triangle_area A P B) /\
        (!P1 P2 : real # real.
           FST P1 <> FST P2
           ==>
           PPline P1 P2 =
             (\x : real.
                (SND P2 - SND P1) / (FST P2 - FST P1) *
                  (x - FST P1) +
                SND P1))
        ==>
        integration$integral (interval [FST A, FST P])
          (\x : real. PPline A P x - 1 / x) =
        integration$integral (interval [FST P, FST B])
          (\x : real. PPline P B x - 1 / x)``;

title: putnam_2015_a1
content:
$(
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact
  putnam_2015_a1: equality of the two areas between the positive branch of
  the hyperbola xy = 1 and the chords from an area-maximizing intermediate
  point to two fixed endpoints. This file contains no proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  P15A1R2 is the real coordinate plane and P15A1Hyperbola is the branch
  y = 1 / x with x > 0. P15A1Hull is the convex hull of three points,
  expressed by internally existential nonnegative barycentric weights, and
  P15A1Area is its planar Lebesgue measure through set.mm's
  finite-dimensional volume function voln.

  The line-function parameter L is the uncurried form of the source's
  PPline: it is an arbitrary map from ordered pairs of real-plane points to
  total real functions, subject to the same chord equation whenever the
  first coordinates differ. The open-interval S. binders are the real
  Lebesgue integrals in the source conclusion.

  The final declaration is the single unproved $a corpus statement. It
  preserves the arbitrary hyperbola set, points, line function, universal
  area-maximality condition, and integral equality; this database contains
  no $p proof declaration.
$)

$c P15A1I P15A1R2 P15A1Hyperbola P15A1Hull P15A1Area $.

p15a1-index-syntax $a class P15A1I $.
p15a1-plane-syntax $a class P15A1R2 $.
p15a1-hyperbola-syntax $a class P15A1Hyperbola $.
p15a1-hull-syntax $a class ( P15A1Hull A B C ) $.
p15a1-area-syntax $a class ( P15A1Area A B C ) $.

p15a1-index-definition $a |- P15A1I = ( 1 ... 2 ) $.

p15a1-plane-definition $a |- P15A1R2 = ( RR ^m P15A1I ) $.

p15a1-hyperbola-definition $a |- P15A1Hyperbola = {
  q e. P15A1R2 |
  (
    ( q ` 2 ) = ( 1 / ( q ` 1 ) )
    /\
    0 < ( q ` 1 )
  )
} $.

${
  $d A B C j u v w z $.

  p15a1-hull-definition $a |- (
    P15A1Hull A B C
  ) = {
    z e. P15A1R2 |
    E. u e. RR E. v e. RR E. w e. RR
      (
        (
          0 <_ u
          /\
          (
            0 <_ v
            /\
            0 <_ w
          )
        )
        /\
        (
          ( ( u + v ) + w ) = 1
          /\
          z =
            (
              j e. P15A1I |->
                (
                  (
                    ( u x. ( A ` j ) )
                    +
                    ( v x. ( B ` j ) )
                  )
                  +
                  ( w x. ( C ` j ) )
                )
            )
        )
      )
  } $.
$}

p15a1-area-definition $a |- (
  P15A1Area A B C
) = (
  ( voln ` P15A1I )
  `
  ( P15A1Hull A B C )
) $.

${
  $d A B H L P Q X Y x $.

  putnambench-putnam-2015-a1 $a |-
    A. H e. ~P P15A1R2
      A. L e.
        (
          ( RR ^m RR )
          ^m
          ( P15A1R2 X. P15A1R2 )
        )
        A. A e. P15A1R2
          A. B e. P15A1R2
            A. P e. P15A1R2
              (
                (
                  (
                    H = P15A1Hyperbola
                    /\
                    (
                      (
                        A e. H
                        /\
                        (
                          B e. H
                          /\
                          ( A ` 1 ) < ( B ` 1 )
                        )
                      )
                      /\
                      (
                        (
                          P e. H
                          /\
                          (
                            ( A ` 1 ) < ( P ` 1 )
                            /\
                            ( P ` 1 ) < ( B ` 1 )
                          )
                        )
                        /\
                        A. Q e. P15A1R2
                          (
                            (
                              Q e. H
                              /\
                              (
                                ( A ` 1 ) < ( Q ` 1 )
                                /\
                                ( Q ` 1 ) < ( B ` 1 )
                              )
                            )
                            ->
                            (
                              ( P15A1Area A Q B )
                              <_
                              ( P15A1Area A P B )
                            )
                          )
                      )
                    )
                  )
                  /\
                  A. X e. P15A1R2 A. Y e. P15A1R2
                    (
                      ( X ` 1 ) =/= ( Y ` 1 )
                      ->
                      (
                        L ` <. X , Y >.
                      )
                      =
                      (
                        x e. RR |->
                          (
                            (
                              (
                                ( ( Y ` 2 ) - ( X ` 2 ) )
                                /
                                ( ( Y ` 1 ) - ( X ` 1 ) )
                              )
                              x.
                              ( x - ( X ` 1 ) )
                            )
                            +
                            ( X ` 2 )
                          )
                      )
                    )
                )
                ->
                (
                  S. ( ( A ` 1 ) (,) ( P ` 1 ) )
                    (
                      (
                        ( L ` <. A , P >. )
                        ` x
                      )
                      -
                      ( 1 / x )
                    )
                    _d x
                  =
                  S. ( ( P ` 1 ) (,) ( B ` 1 ) )
                    (
                      (
                        ( L ` <. P , B >. )
                        ` x
                      )
                      -
                      ( 1 / x )
                    )
                    _d x
                )
              )
  $.
$}

title: putnam_2015_a1
content:
:: Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2015_a1
:: (putnambench__mizar__putnam_2015_a1): a maximum-area triangle with its
:: vertices on the positive branch of xy = 1 cuts off equal areas along its
:: two adjacent hyperbola chords. This file contains no proof.

environ

 vocabularies NUMBERS, XBOOLE_0, SUBSET_1, RELAT_1, FUNCT_1, FUNCT_2,
      PARTFUN1, CARD_1, ORDINAL1, VALUED_0, VALUED_1, XCMPLX_0,
      XXREAL_0, XXREAL_1, ARYTM_1, ARYTM_3, REAL_1, COMPLEX1,
      FINSEQ_1, FINSEQ_2, EUCLID, SUPINF_2, MEASURE1, MESFUNC1,
      MESFUNC5, MEASUR12, INTEGRA5, ZFMISC_1;
 notations TARSKI, XBOOLE_0, SUBSET_1, ZFMISC_1, RELAT_1, RELSET_1,
      FUNCT_1, PARTFUN1, FUNCT_2, ORDINAL1, CARD_1, NUMBERS,
      XCMPLX_0, XREAL_0, REAL_1, COMPLEX1, XXREAL_0, XXREAL_1,
      XXREAL_3, VALUED_0, VALUED_1, FINSEQ_1, FINSEQ_2, EUCLID,
      SUPINF_2, MEASURE1, MESFUNC1, MESFUNC5, MESFUNC6, MEASUR12,
      INTEGRA5, EXTREAL1;
 constructors RELSET_1, FUNCT_2, REAL_1, COMPLEX1, FINSEQ_1, FINSEQ_2,
      EUCLID, MESFUNC1, MESFUNC5, MESFUNC6, MEASUR12, INTEGRA5,
      EXTREAL1, BINOP_2;
 registrations XBOOLE_0, SUBSET_1, RELAT_1, RELSET_1, FUNCT_1,
      FUNCT_2, ORDINAL1, CARD_1, NUMBERS, XREAL_0, VALUED_0,
      VALUED_1, XXREAL_3, MEASURE1, MEASUR12, MEMBERED, XCMPLX_0,
      FINSEQ_1, FINSEQ_2, EUCLID;
 requirements BOOLE, SUBSET, NUMERALS, REAL, ARITHM;
 definitions TARSKI, XBOOLE_0;
 expansions TARSKI, XBOOLE_0, RELAT_1;

begin

::$P-
theorem
  for hyperbola being Subset of REAL 2,
      A,B,P being Element of REAL 2,
      PPline being Function of
        [:REAL 2,REAL 2:],Funcs(REAL,REAL),
      pairAP,pairPB being Element of [:REAL 2,REAL 2:],
      I,J being Subset of REAL,
      lineAP,linePB,f,g being Function of REAL,REAL st
    hyperbola =
      {Q where Q is Element of REAL 2 :
        Q.2 = 1 / Q.1 & Q.1 > 0} &
    A in hyperbola & B in hyperbola & A.1 < B.1 &
    P in hyperbola & A.1 < P.1 & P.1 < B.1 &
    (for P1,P2 being Element of REAL 2 st P1.1 <> P2.1 holds
      for pair being Element of [:REAL 2,REAL 2:] st
        pair = [P1,P2]
      holds
        for line being Function of REAL,REAL st
          line = PPline.pair
        holds
          for x being Real holds
            line.x =
              ((P2.2 - P1.2) / (P2.1 - P1.1)) * (x - P1.1) + P1.2) &
    (for P1 being Element of REAL 2 st
      P1 in hyperbola & A.1 < P1.1 & P1.1 < B.1
    holds
      |.(P1.1 - A.1) * (B.2 - A.2) -
