% Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2015_a1:
% an interior point on the positive branch y = 1/x that maximizes the area
% of triangle APB makes the areas between the hyperbola and the chords AP
% and PB equal. This file contains no proof.

putnam_2015_a1: THEORY
BEGIN
  point: TYPE = [# x_coord: real, y_coord: real #]
  real_function: TYPE = [real -> real]
  real_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> real]

  safe_div(numerator, denominator: real): real =
    IF denominator = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      numerator / denominator
    ENDIF

  on_positive_hyperbola(P: point): bool =
    x_coord(P) > 0
      AND y_coord(P) = safe_div(1, x_coord(P))

  cross_from(P, Q, R: point): real =
    (x_coord(Q) - x_coord(P)) * (y_coord(R) - y_coord(P))
      - (y_coord(Q) - y_coord(P)) * (x_coord(R) - x_coord(P))

  triangle_area(P, Q, R: point): real =
    abs(cross_from(P, Q, R)) / 2

  chord_value(P, Q: point, x: real): real =
    safe_div(
      y_coord(Q) - y_coord(P),
      x_coord(Q) - x_coord(P))
      * (x - x_coord(P))
      + y_coord(P)

  valid_tagged_partition(
      left, right: real,
      points, tags: real_sequence,
      count: nat): bool =
    count > 0
      AND points(0) = left
      AND points(count) = right
      AND FORALL (index: nat):
        index < count IMPLIES
          (points(index) < points(index + 1)
            AND points(index) <= tags(index)
            AND tags(index) <= points(index + 1))

  mesh_less_than(
      points: real_sequence,
      count: nat,
      bound: real): bool =
    FORALL (index: nat):
      index < count IMPLIES
        points(index + 1) - points(index) < bound

  riemann_sum(
      function_value: real_function,
      points, tags: real_sequence,
      count: nat): RECURSIVE real =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      riemann_sum(
        function_value, points, tags, count - 1)
        + function_value(tags(count - 1))
            * (points(count) - points(count - 1))
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  has_interval_integral(
      function_value: real_function,
      left, right, integral_value: real): bool =
    left < right
      AND FORALL (epsilon_value: posreal):
        EXISTS (mesh_bound: posreal):
          FORALL
              (points, tags: real_sequence),
              (count: nat):
            (valid_tagged_partition(
                left, right, points, tags, count)
              AND mesh_less_than(
                points, count, mesh_bound))
            IMPLIES
              abs(
                riemann_sum(
                  function_value, points, tags, count)
                  - integral_value)
                < epsilon_value

  interval_integral(
      function_value: real_function,
      left, right: real): real =
    IF left = right THEN
      0
    ELSIF left < right THEN
      IF EXISTS (integral_value: real):
          has_interval_integral(
            function_value, left, right, integral_value)
      THEN
        epsilon(
          LAMBDA (integral_value: real):
            has_interval_integral(
              function_value, left, right, integral_value))
      ELSE
        0
      ENDIF
    ELSE
      IF EXISTS (integral_value: real):
          has_interval_integral(
            function_value, right, left, integral_value)
      THEN
        -epsilon(
          LAMBDA (integral_value: real):
            has_interval_integral(
              function_value, right, left, integral_value))
      ELSE
        0
      ENDIF
    ENDIF

  chord_gap(P, Q: point): real_function =
    LAMBDA (x: real):
      chord_value(P, Q, x) - safe_div(1, x)

  putnam_2015_a1: bool =
    FORALL (A, B, P: point):
      (on_positive_hyperbola(A)
        AND on_positive_hyperbola(B)
        AND x_coord(A) < x_coord(B)
        AND on_positive_hyperbola(P)
        AND x_coord(A) < x_coord(P)
        AND x_coord(P) < x_coord(B)
        AND (FORALL (P_prime: point):
          (on_positive_hyperbola(P_prime)
            AND x_coord(A) < x_coord(P_prime)
            AND x_coord(P_prime) < x_coord(B))
          IMPLIES
            triangle_area(A, P_prime, B)
              <= triangle_area(A, P, B)))
      IMPLIES
        interval_integral(
          chord_gap(A, P),
          x_coord(A),
          x_coord(P))
          =
        interval_integral(
          chord_gap(P, B),
          x_coord(P),
          x_coord(B))
END putnam_2015_a1

-- Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2015_a2
-- (putnambench__agda__putnam_2015_a2): the odd prime factor 181 of the
-- 2015th term of the integer recurrence a_n = 4 a_(n-1) - a_(n-2).
-- This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module Putnam2015A2 where

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Int using (Int; pos; negsuc)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; _-_; _*_)

infix 4 _<=N_ _dividesN_ _dividesZ_
infixl 6 _+Z_ _-Z_
infixl 7 _*Z_
infixr 3 _and_
infixr 2 _or_

record _and_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data _or_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  left  : A -> A or B
  right : B -> A or B

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

data _<=N_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set where
  zero<=N   : {n : Nat} -> zero <=N n
  suc<=sucN : {m n : Nat} -> m <=N n -> suc m <=N suc n

record _dividesN_ (divisor dividend : Nat) : Set where
  constructor natural-divisibility
  field
    quotient : Nat
    equation : divisor * quotient == dividend

record Prime (n : Nat) : Set where
  field
    at-least-two :
      2 <=N n
    only-trivial-divisors :
      (d : Nat) ->
      d dividesN n ->
      (d == 1) or (d == n)

Odd : Nat -> Set
Odd n =
  Exists Nat (\ k -> n == 2 * k + 1)

negative : Nat -> Int
negative zero =
  pos zero
negative (suc n) =
  negsuc n

difference : Nat -> Nat -> Int
difference zero zero =
  pos zero
difference (suc m) zero =
  pos (suc m)
difference zero (suc n) =
  negsuc n
difference (suc m) (suc n) =
  difference m n

_+Z_ : Int -> Int -> Int
pos m +Z pos n =
  pos (m + n)
pos m +Z negsuc n =
  difference m (suc n)
negsuc m +Z pos n =
  difference n (suc m)
negsuc m +Z negsuc n =
  negsuc (suc (m + n))

_*Z_ : Int -> Int -> Int
pos m *Z pos n =
  pos (m * n)
pos m *Z negsuc n =
  negative (m * suc n)
negsuc m *Z pos n =
  negative (suc m * n)
negsuc m *Z negsuc n =
  pos (suc m * suc n)

negateZ : Int -> Int
negateZ (pos n) =
  negative n
negateZ (negsuc n) =
  pos (suc n)

_-Z_ : Int -> Int -> Int
x -Z y =
  x +Z negateZ y

record _dividesZ_ (divisor dividend : Int) : Set where
  constructor integer-divisibility
  field
    quotient : Int
    equation : divisor *Z quotient == dividend

putnam-2015-a2-solution : Nat
putnam-2015-a2-solution =
  181

InitialValues : (Nat -> Int) -> Set
InitialValues a =
  (a 0 == pos 1)
  and
  (a 1 == pos 2)

Recurrence : (Nat -> Int) -> Set
Recurrence a =
  (n : Nat) ->
  2 <=N n ->
  a n == (pos 4 *Z a (n - 1)) -Z a (n - 2)

putnam-2015-a2 : Set
putnam-2015-a2 =
  (a : Nat -> Int) ->
  InitialValues a ->
  Recurrence a ->
  Odd putnam-2015-a2-solution
  and
  Prime putnam-2015-a2-solution
  and
  (pos putnam-2015-a2-solution dividesZ a 2015)

;; Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2015_a3:
;; the base-2 logarithm of the double product of 1+exp(2*pi*i*a*b/2015)
;; for 1 <= a,b <= 2015 is 13725. This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))

;; Let zeta = exp(2*pi*i/2015).  It is a primitive 2015th root of unity.
;; Replacing zeta by X turns the source product into
;;
;;   P(X) = product_(a=1)^2015 product_(b=1)^2015 (1+X^(a*b)).
;;
;; The dense coefficient calculation below works modulo X^2015-1, which
;; does not change the value at zeta.  Since Phi_2015 is the minimal
;; polynomial of zeta over the rationals,
;;
;;   P(zeta) = 2^13725
;;
;; holds exactly when Phi_2015 divides P(X)-2^13725.
;;
;; No factor 1+zeta^(a*b) vanishes: every power of zeta has odd order, so it
;; cannot equal -1.  The complete product is positive real (conjugate powers
;; pair, and the remaining powers equal 1).  Consequently the displayed
;; algebraic equality is bidirectionally equivalent to the source base-2
;; logarithm being 13725.  This exact cyclotomic encoding does not replace
;; complex values by ACL2's complex rationals.

;; General polynomials use rational coefficient lists in ascending degree
;; order.

(defun putnam-2015-a3-poly-normalize (coefficients)
  (if (consp coefficients)
      (let ((tail
             (putnam-2015-a3-poly-normalize
              (cdr coefficients))))
        (if (and (equal (car coefficients) 0)
                 (not (consp tail)))
            nil
          (cons (car coefficients) tail)))
    nil))

(defun putnam-2015-a3-poly-add (left right)
  (cond
   ((consp left)
    (if (consp right)
        (cons (+ (car left) (car right))
              (putnam-2015-a3-poly-add
               (cdr left) (cdr right)))
      left))
   (t right)))

(defun putnam-2015-a3-poly-scale (scalar polynomial)
  (if (consp polynomial)
      (cons (* scalar (car polynomial))
            (putnam-2015-a3-poly-scale
             scalar (cdr polynomial)))
    nil))

(defun putnam-2015-a3-poly-negate (polynomial)
  (putnam-2015-a3-poly-scale -1 polynomial))

(defun putnam-2015-a3-poly-subtract (left right)
  (putnam-2015-a3-poly-normalize
   (putnam-2015-a3-poly-add
    left
    (putnam-2015-a3-poly-negate right))))

(defun putnam-2015-a3-poly-multiply (left right)
  (if (consp left)
      (putnam-2015-a3-poly-normalize
       (putnam-2015-a3-poly-add
        (putnam-2015-a3-poly-scale (car left) right)
        (cons 0
              (putnam-2015-a3-poly-multiply
               (cdr left) right))))
    nil))

(defun putnam-2015-a3-zero-list (count)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix count)))
  (if (zp count)
      nil
    (cons 0
          (putnam-2015-a3-zero-list (- count 1)))))

(defun putnam-2015-a3-poly-monomial (coefficient degree)
  (if (equal coefficient 0)
      nil
    (append
     (putnam-2015-a3-zero-list degree)
     (list coefficient))))

(defun putnam-2015-a3-poly-degree (polynomial)
  (let ((normalized
         (putnam-2015-a3-poly-normalize polynomial)))
    (if (consp normalized)
        (- (len normalized) 1)
      0)))

(defun putnam-2015-a3-poly-leading-coefficient (polynomial)
  (let ((normalized
         (putnam-2015-a3-poly-normalize polynomial)))
    (if (consp normalized)
        (nth (putnam-2015-a3-poly-degree normalized)
             normalized)
      0)))

(defun putnam-2015-a3-poly-divmod-steps
    (remainder divisor quotient steps)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix steps)))
  (if (zp steps)
      (cons (putnam-2015-a3-poly-normalize quotient)
            (putnam-2015-a3-poly-normalize remainder))
    (let* ((normalized-remainder
            (putnam-2015-a3-poly-normalize remainder))
           (normalized-divisor
            (putnam-2015-a3-poly-normalize divisor)))
      (if (or (not (consp normalized-remainder))
              (not (consp normalized-divisor))
              (< (putnam-2015-a3-poly-degree
                  normalized-remainder)
                 (putnam-2015-a3-poly-degree
                  normalized-divisor)))
          (cons (putnam-2015-a3-poly-normalize quotient)
                normalized-remainder)
        (let* ((degree-difference
                (- (putnam-2015-a3-poly-degree
                    normalized-remainder)
                   (putnam-2015-a3-poly-degree
                    normalized-divisor)))
               (coefficient
                (/ (putnam-2015-a3-poly-leading-coefficient
                    normalized-remainder)
                   (putnam-2015-a3-poly-leading-coefficient
                    normalized-divisor)))
               (term
                (putnam-2015-a3-poly-monomial
                 coefficient degree-difference)))
          (putnam-2015-a3-poly-divmod-steps
           (putnam-2015-a3-poly-subtract
            normalized-remainder
            (putnam-2015-a3-poly-multiply
             term normalized-divisor))
           normalized-divisor
           (putnam-2015-a3-poly-add quotient term)
           (- steps 1)))))))

(defun putnam-2015-a3-poly-divmod (dividend divisor)
  (putnam-2015-a3-poly-divmod-steps
   dividend
   divisor
   nil
   (+ 1
      (len (putnam-2015-a3-poly-normalize dividend)))))

(defun putnam-2015-a3-poly-quotient (dividend divisor)
  (car (putnam-2015-a3-poly-divmod dividend divisor)))

(defun putnam-2015-a3-poly-remainder (dividend divisor)
  (cdr (putnam-2015-a3-poly-divmod dividend divisor)))

(defun putnam-2015-a3-x-to-n-minus-one (n)
  (putnam-2015-a3-poly-add
   (list -1)
   (putnam-2015-a3-poly-monomial 1 n)))

;; Since 2015 = 5*13*31 is square-free,
;;
;; Phi_2015(X)
;;   = ((X^2015-1)(X^5-1)(X^13-1)(X^31-1))
;;       / ((X-1)(X^65-1)(X^155-1)(X^403-1)).
(defun putnam-2015-a3-cyclotomic-polynomial ()
  (putnam-2015-a3-poly-quotient
   (putnam-2015-a3-poly-multiply
    (putnam-2015-a3-x-to-n-minus-one 2015)
    (putnam-2015-a3-poly-multiply
     (putnam-2015-a3-x-to-n-minus-one 5)
     (putnam-2015-a3-poly-multiply
      (putnam-2015-a3-x-to-n-minus-one 13)
      (putnam-2015-a3-x-to-n-minus-one 31))))
   (putnam-2015-a3-poly-multiply
    (putnam-2015-a3-x-to-n-minus-one 1)
    (putnam-2015-a3-poly-multiply
     (putnam-2015-a3-x-to-n-minus-one 65)
     (putnam-2015-a3-poly-multiply
      (putnam-2015-a3-x-to-n-minus-one 155)
      (putnam-2015-a3-x-to-n-minus-one 403))))))

;; A degree-below-N coefficient list represents a polynomial modulo X^N-1.
;; Multiplication by 1+X^EXPONENT adds each coefficient to the coefficient
;; cyclically EXPONENT places ahead.
(defun putnam-2015-a3-factor-coefficients
    (polynomial exponent modulus index remaining)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix remaining)))
  (if (zp remaining)
      nil
    (cons
     (+ (nth index polynomial)
        (nth (mod (- index exponent) modulus)
             polynomial))
     (putnam-2015-a3-factor-coefficients
      polynomial exponent modulus (+ index 1)
      (- remaining 1)))))

(defun putnam-2015-a3-multiply-factor
    (polynomial exponent modulus)
  (if (posp modulus)
      (putnam-2015-a3-factor-coefficients
       polynomial
       (mod exponent modulus)
       modulus
       0
       modulus)
    nil))

(defun putnam-2015-a3-inner-product
    (a b modulus polynomial)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix b)))
  (if (zp b)
      polynomial
    (putnam-2015-a3-inner-product
     a
     (- b 1)
     modulus
     (putnam-2015-a3-multiply-factor
      polynomial (* a b) modulus))))

(defun putnam-2015-a3-double-product
    (a modulus polynomial)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix a)))
  (if (zp a)
      polynomial
    (putnam-2015-a3-double-product
     (- a 1)
     modulus
     (putnam-2015-a3-inner-product
      a modulus modulus polynomial))))

(defun putnam-2015-a3-product-polynomial ()
  (putnam-2015-a3-double-product
   2015
   2015
   (cons 1 (putnam-2015-a3-zero-list 2014))))

(defun putnam-2015-a3-equation-polynomial ()
  (putnam-2015-a3-poly-subtract
   (putnam-2015-a3-product-polynomial)
   (list (expt 2 13725))))

(defun putnambench-putnam-2015-a3-statement ()
  (equal
   (putnam-2015-a3-poly-remainder
    (putnam-2015-a3-equation-polynomial)
    (putnam-2015-a3-cyclotomic-polynomial))
   nil))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

title: putnam_2015_a3
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2015_a3
-- (putnambench__agda__putnam_2015_a3): the base-2 complex logarithm of a
-- 2015-by-2015 product of exponential factors is 13725. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module Putnam2015A3 where

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; _*_)

infix 4 _!=_ _<=N_
infixr 3 _and_
infixr 2 _or_

data Bottom : Set where

Not : Set -> Set
Not A =
  A -> Bottom

_!=_ : {A : Set} -> A -> A -> Set
x != y =
  Not (x == y)

record _and_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data _or_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  left  : A -> A or B
  right : B -> A or B

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

data _<=N_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set where
  zero<=N   : {n : Nat} -> zero <=N n
  suc<=sucN : {m n : Nat} -> m <=N n -> suc m <=N suc n

oneN : Nat
oneN =
  suc zero

twoN : Nat
twoN =
  suc oneN

record CompleteOrderedRealField (R : Set) : Set1 where
  field
    zeroR oneR : R
    add multiply : R -> R -> R
    negate inverse : R -> R
    lessOrEqual : R -> R -> Set
    fromNat : Nat -> R

    one-not-zero :
      oneR != zeroR

    add-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> add x y == add y x
    add-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      add (add x y) z == add x (add y z)
    add-zero :
      (x : R) -> add x zeroR == x
    add-inverse :
      (x : R) -> add x (negate x) == zeroR

    multiply-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> multiply x y == multiply y x
    multiply-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply (multiply x y) z ==
      multiply x (multiply y z)
    multiply-one :
      (x : R) -> multiply x oneR == x
    multiply-zero :
      (x : R) -> multiply x zeroR == zeroR
    distribute :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply x (add y z) ==
      add (multiply x y) (multiply x z)
    inverse-zero :
      inverse zeroR == zeroR
    multiply-inverse :
      (x : R) ->
      x != zeroR ->
      multiply x (inverse x) == oneR

    order-reflexive :
      (x : R) -> lessOrEqual x x
    order-transitive :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y z ->
      lessOrEqual x z
    order-antisymmetric :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y x ->
      x == y
    order-total :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y or lessOrEqual y x
    add-order :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual (add z x) (add z y)
    multiply-nonnegative :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR x ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR y ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR (multiply x y)
    zero-less-than-one :
      lessOrEqual zeroR oneR and zeroR != oneR

    fromNat-zero :
      fromNat zero == zeroR
    fromNat-successor :
      (n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (suc n) == add (fromNat n) oneR
    fromNat-addition :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m + n) == add (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-multiplication :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m * n) == multiply (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-injective :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat m == fromNat n ->
      m == n

    archimedean :
      (x : R) ->
      Exists Nat
        (\ n -> lessOrEqual x (fromNat n))
    least-upper-bound :
      (P : R -> Set) ->
      Exists R P ->
      Exists R
        (\ upper ->
          (x : R) ->
          P x ->
          lessOrEqual x upper) ->
      Exists R
        (\ supremum ->
          ((x : R) ->
            P x ->
            lessOrEqual x supremum)
          and
          ((upper : R) ->
            ((x : R) ->
              P x ->
              lessOrEqual x upper) ->
            lessOrEqual supremum upper))

open CompleteOrderedRealField

subtract :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
subtract reals x y =
  add reals x (negate reals y)

divide :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
divide reals x y =
  multiply reals x (inverse reals y)

StrictLess :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
StrictLess reals x y =
  lessOrEqual reals x y and x != y

CloseTo :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
CloseTo reals center radius x =
  StrictLess reals
    (subtract reals center radius)
    x
  and
  StrictLess reals
    x
    (add reals center radius)

SequentialLimit :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  R ->
  Set
SequentialLimit {R} reals sequence limit =
  (epsilon : R) ->
  StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) epsilon ->
  Exists Nat
    (\ cutoff ->
      (n : Nat) ->
      cutoff <=N n ->
      CloseTo reals limit epsilon (sequence n))

naturalPower :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  Nat ->
  R
naturalPower reals x zero =
  oneR reals
naturalPower reals x (suc n) =
  multiply reals
    (naturalPower reals x n)
    x

factorial : Nat -> Nat
factorial zero =
  oneN
factorial (suc n) =
  suc n * factorial n

sumFirst :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Nat ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  R
sumFirst reals zero terms =
  zeroR reals
sumFirst reals (suc n) terms =
  add reals
    (sumFirst reals n terms)
    (terms n)

alternatingSign :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Nat ->
  R
alternatingSign reals zero =
  oneR reals
alternatingSign reals (suc n) =
  negate reals (alternatingSign reals n)

exponentialTerm :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  Nat ->
  R
exponentialTerm reals x n =
  divide reals
    (naturalPower reals x n)
    (fromNat reals (factorial n))

cosineTerm :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  Nat ->
  R
cosineTerm reals x n =
  multiply reals
    (alternatingSign reals n)
    (divide reals
      (naturalPower reals x (twoN * n))
      (fromNat reals (factorial (twoN * n))))

sineTerm :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  Nat ->
  R
sineTerm reals x n =
  multiply reals
    (alternatingSign reals n)
    (divide reals
      (naturalPower reals x (suc (twoN * n)))
      (fromNat reals (factorial (suc (twoN * n)))))

ExponentialValue :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
ExponentialValue reals x value =
  SequentialLimit reals
    (\ n ->
      sumFirst reals n
        (exponentialTerm reals x))
    value

CosineValue :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
CosineValue reals x value =
  SequentialLimit reals
    (\ n ->
      sumFirst reals n
        (cosineTerm reals x))
    value

SineValue :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
SineValue reals x value =
  SequentialLimit reals
    (\ n ->
      sumFirst reals n
        (sineTerm reals x))
    value

record StandardRealAnalysis
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) :
  Set1 where

  field
    exponential naturalLogarithm cosine sine : R -> R
    pi : R

    exponential-is-power-series :
      (x : R) ->
      ExponentialValue reals x (exponential x)

    cosine-is-power-series :
      (x : R) ->
      CosineValue reals x (cosine x)

    sine-is-power-series :
      (x : R) ->
      SineValue reals x (sine x)

    exponential-positive :
      (x : R) ->
      StrictLess reals
        (zeroR reals)
        (exponential x)

    logarithm-zero :
      naturalLogarithm (zeroR reals) == zeroR reals

    logarithm-of-exponential :
      (x : R) ->
      naturalLogarithm (exponential x) == x

    exponential-of-logarithm :
      (x : R) ->
      StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) x ->
      exponential (naturalLogarithm x) == x

    pi-positive :
      StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) pi

    sine-pi :
      sine pi == zeroR reals

    pi-is-least-positive-sine-zero :
      (x : R) ->
      StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) x ->
      StrictLess reals x pi ->
      sine x != zeroR reals

open StandardRealAnalysis

record Complex (R : Set) : Set where
  constructor complex
  field
    realPart      : R
    imaginaryPart : R

open Complex

complexZero :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Complex R
complexZero reals =
  complex (zeroR reals) (zeroR reals)

complexOne :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Complex R
complexOne reals =
  complex (oneR reals) (zeroR reals)

complexFromReal :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  Complex R
complexFromReal reals x =
  complex x (zeroR reals)

complexAdd :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Complex R ->
  Complex R ->
  Complex R
complexAdd reals z w =
  complex
    (add reals (realPart z) (realPart w))
    (add reals (imaginaryPart z) (imaginaryPart w))

complexMultiply :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Complex R ->
  Complex R ->
  Complex R
complexMultiply reals z w =
  complex
    (subtract reals
      (multiply reals (realPart z) (realPart w))
      (multiply reals (imaginaryPart z) (imaginaryPart w)))
    (add reals
      (multiply reals (realPart z) (imaginaryPart w))
      (multiply reals (imaginaryPart z) (realPart w)))

complexNormSquared :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Complex R ->
  R
complexNormSquared reals z =
  add reals
    (multiply reals (realPart z) (realPart z))
    (multiply reals (imaginaryPart z) (imaginaryPart z))

complexInverse :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Complex R ->
  Complex R
complexInverse reals z =
  let
    denominator =
      complexNormSquared reals z
  in
  complex
    (divide reals (realPart z) denominator)
    (negate reals
      (divide reals (imaginaryPart z) denominator))

complexDivide :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Complex R ->
  Complex R ->
  Complex R
complexDivide reals z w =
  complexMultiply reals z (complexInverse reals w)

complexExponential :
  {R : Set} ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) ->
  StandardRealAnalysis reals ->
  Complex R ->
  Complex R
complexExponential reals analysis z =
  complex
    (multiply reals
      (exponential analysis (realPart z))
      (cosine analysis (imaginaryPart z)))
    (multiply reals
      (exponential analysis (realPart z))
      (sine analysis (imaginaryPart z)))

PrincipalArgumentValue :
  {R : Set} ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) ->
  StandardRealAnalysis reals ->
  Complex R ->
  R ->
  Set
PrincipalArgumentValue {R} reals analysis z theta =
  ((z == complexZero reals)
    and
    (theta == zeroR reals))
  or
  ((z != complexZero reals)
    and
    StrictLess reals
      (negate reals (pi analysis))
      theta
    and
    lessOrEqual reals theta (pi analysis)
    and
    Exists R
      (\ radius ->
        StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) radius
        and
        z ==
          complex
            (multiply reals radius (cosine analysis theta))
            (multiply reals radius (sine analysis theta))))

record StandardComplexAnalysis
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R)
  (analysis : StandardRealAnalysis reals) :
  Set1 where

  field
    argument : Complex R -> R

    argument-is-principal :
      (z : Complex R) ->
      PrincipalArgumentValue reals analysis z (argument z)

open StandardComplexAnalysis

complexLogarithm :
  {R : Set} ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) ->
  (analysis : StandardRealAnalysis reals) ->
  StandardComplexAnalysis reals analysis ->
  Complex R ->
  Complex R
complexLogarithm reals analysis complexAnalysis z =
  complex
    (divide reals
      (naturalLogarithm analysis
        (complexNormSquared reals z))
      (fromNat reals twoN))
    (argument complexAnalysis z)

complexProductFirst :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Nat ->
  (Nat -> Complex R) ->
  Complex R
complexProductFirst reals zero terms =
  complexOne reals
complexProductFirst reals (suc n) terms =
  complexMultiply reals
    (complexProductFirst reals n terms)
    (terms n)

module Putnam2015A3Statement
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R)
  (analysis : StandardRealAnalysis reals)
  (complexAnalysis : StandardComplexAnalysis reals analysis) where

  angle : Nat -> Nat -> R
  angle a b =
    divide reals
      (multiply reals
        (multiply reals
          (multiply reals
            (fromNat reals twoN)
            (pi analysis))
          (fromNat reals (suc a)))
        (fromNat reals (suc b)))
      (fromNat reals 2015)

  factor : Nat -> Nat -> Complex R
  factor a b =
    complexAdd reals
      (complexOne reals)
      (complexExponential reals analysis
        (complex
          (zeroR reals)
          (angle a b)))

  product : Complex R
  product =
    complexProductFirst reals 2015
      (\ a ->
        complexProductFirst reals 2015
          (factor a))

  baseTwoLogarithm : Complex R
  baseTwoLogarithm =
    complexDivide reals
      (complexLogarithm reals analysis complexAnalysis product)
      (complexLogarithm reals analysis complexAnalysis
        (complexFromReal reals (fromNat reals twoN)))

  solution : Complex R
  solution =
    complexFromReal reals
      (fromNat reals 13725)

  proposition : Set
  proposition =
    baseTwoLogarithm == solution

putnam-2015-a3 : Set1
putnam-2015-a3 =
  (R : Set) ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) ->
  (analysis : StandardRealAnalysis reals) ->
  (complexAnalysis : StandardComplexAnalysis reals analysis) ->
  Putnam2015A3Statement.proposition
    reals
    analysis
    complexAnalysis

title: putnam_2015_a3
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2015_a3:
  the base-2 principal complex logarithm of the double product of
  1 + exp(2*pi*i*a*b/2015), for 1 <= a,b <= 2015, equals 13725.
  This file contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open arithmeticTheory pred_setTheory realTheory transcTheory complexTheory;

val putnam_2015_a3 =
  ``let indices = IMAGE SUC (count 2015) in
    let principal_arg =
      \z : complex.
        if z = 0 then 0
        else if arg z <= pi then arg z else arg z - 2 * pi
    in
    let complex_log =
      \z : complex.
        (ln (modu z), principal_arg z)
    in
      complex_log
        (ITSET
           (\a outer.
              ITSET
                (\b inner.
                   (1 +
                    complex_exp
                      (i * (2 * pi * &a * &b / 2015))) *
                   inner)
                indices
                1 *
              outer)
           indices
           1) /
      complex_log 2 =
      (13725 : complex)``;

title: putnam_2015_a3
content:
$(
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact
  putnam_2015_a3: the base-two logarithm of a 2015-by-2015 product of
  complex exponential factors is 13725. This file contains no proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  SetMM's CC-valued exp and log are the complex exponential and principal
  natural logarithm, while _i and _pi are the imaginary unit and pi. The
  inclusive range 1 ... 2015 is definitionally the shifted Fin 2015 carrier
  used in the Lean source. The nested prod_ binders therefore preserve both
  finite products, and division by log(2) is the source base-two logarithm.

  The right side inlines the explicit value from the Rocq source and the
  solution annotations in the Lean and Isabelle sources. The final declaration
  is the single unproved $a corpus statement; this database contains no $p
  proof declaration.
$)

${
  $d a b $.

  putnambench-putnam-2015-a3 $a |- (
    (
      log
      `
      (
        prod_ a e. ( 1 ... ; ; ; 2 0 1 5 )
          prod_ b e. ( 1 ... ; ; ; 2 0 1 5 )
            (
              1
              +
              (
                exp
                `
                (
                  (
                    (
                      (
                        ( 2 x. _pi )
                        x.
                        _i
                      )
                      x.
                      a
                    )
                    x.
                    b
                  )
                  /
                  ; ; ; 2 0 1 5
                )
              )
            )
      )
    )
    /
    ( log ` 2 )
  ) = ; ; ; ; 1 3 7 2 5 $.
$}

title: putnam_2015_a3
content:
:: Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2015_a3
:: (putnambench__mizar__putnam_2015_a3): the complex double product of
:: 1 + exp(2*PI*i*a*b/2015) for 1 <= a,b <= 2015 equals 2^13725.

title: putnam_2015_a3
content:
% Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2015_a3:
% the base-2 logarithm of a double product of complex exponential terms
% indexed from 1 through 2015 equals 13725. This file contains no proof.

putnam_2015_a3: THEORY
BEGIN
  complex: TYPE = [# real_part: real, imag_part: real #]
  real_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> real]

  complex_one: complex =
    (# real_part := 1, imag_part := 0 #)

  complex_of_real(value: real): complex =
    (# real_part := value, imag_part := 0 #)

  complex_add(left, right: complex): complex =
    (# real_part := real_part(left) + real_part(right),
       imag_part := imag_part(left) + imag_part(right) #)

  complex_mul(left, right: complex): complex =
    (# real_part :=
         real_part(left) * real_part(right)
           - imag_part(left) * imag_part(right),
       imag_part :=
         real_part(left) * imag_part(right)
           + imag_part(left) * real_part(right) #)

  safe_div(numerator, denominator: real): real =
    IF denominator = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      numerator / denominator
    ENDIF

  converges_to(sequence: real_sequence, value: real): bool =
    FORALL (epsilon_value: posreal):
      EXISTS (cutoff: nat):
        FORALL (index: nat):
          cutoff <= index IMPLIES
            abs(sequence(index) - value) < epsilon_value

  nat_factorial(index: nat): RECURSIVE nat =
    IF index = 0 THEN
      1
    ELSE
      index * nat_factorial(index - 1)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE index

  sine_partial(x: real, count: nat): RECURSIVE real =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      LET index: nat = count - 1 IN
        sine_partial(x, count - 1)
          + safe_div(
              ((-1 :: real) ^ index) * x ^ (2 * index + 1),
              nat_factorial(2 * index + 1) :: real)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  cosine_partial(x: real, count: nat): RECURSIVE real =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      LET index: nat = count - 1 IN
        cosine_partial(x, count - 1)
          + safe_div(
              ((-1 :: real) ^ index) * x ^ (2 * index),
              nat_factorial(2 * index) :: real)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  sine(x: real): real =
    epsilon(
      LAMBDA (value: real):
        converges_to(
          LAMBDA (count: nat): sine_partial(x, count),
          value))

  cosine(x: real): real =
    epsilon(
      LAMBDA (value: real):
        converges_to(
          LAMBDA (count: nat): cosine_partial(x, count),
          value))

  pi: real =
    epsilon(
      LAMBDA (value: real):
        3 < value
          AND value < 4
          AND cosine(value / 2) = 0)

  angle(a, b: nat): real =
    safe_div(
      2 * pi * (a :: real) * (b :: real),
      2015)

  exponential_term(a, b: nat): complex =
    complex_add(
      complex_one,
      (# real_part := cosine(angle(a, b)),
         imag_part := sine(angle(a, b)) #))

  row_product(a, count: nat): RECURSIVE complex =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      complex_one
    ELSE
      complex_mul(
        row_product(a, count - 1),
        exponential_term(a, count))
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  double_product(count: nat): RECURSIVE complex =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      complex_one
    ELSE
      complex_mul(
        double_product(count - 1),
        row_product(count, 2015))
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  putnam_2015_a3_solution: nat = 13725

  putnam_2015_a3: bool =
    double_product(2015)
      = complex_of_real(
          (2 :: real) ^ putnam_2015_a3_solution)
END putnam_2015_a3

title: putnam_2015_a4
content:
import Mathlib

noncomputable abbrev putnam_2015_a4_solution : ℝ := sorry
-- 4 / 7
/--
For each real number $x$, let
\[
f(x) = \sum_{n\in S_x} \frac{1}{2^n},
\]
where $S_x$ is the set of positive integers $n$ for which $\lfloor nx \rfloor$ is even. What is the largest real number $L$ such that $f(x) \geq L$ for all $x \in [0,1)$? (As usual, $\lfloor z \rfloor$ denotes the greatest integer less than or equal to $z$.)
-/
theorem putnam_2015_a4
(S : ℝ → Set ℤ)
(f : ℝ → ℝ)
(p : ℝ → Prop)
(hS : S = fun (x : ℝ) ↦ {n : ℤ | n > 0 ∧ Even ⌊n * x⌋})
(hf : f = fun (x : ℝ) ↦ ∑' n : S x, 1 / 2 ^ (n : ℤ))
(hp : ∀ l, p l ↔ ∀ x ∈ Set.Ico 0 1, f x ≥ l)
: IsGreatest p putnam_2015_a4_solution :=
sorry

title: putnam_2015_a4

Require Import Nat List Reals. From Coquelicot Require Import Coquelicot Hierarchy Rcomplements. 
Definition putnam_2015_a4_solution : R := 4/7.
Theorem putnam_2015_a4
    (f : R -> R := fun x => Series (fun n => if (even (Z.to_nat (floor (((INR (n + 1))*x))))) then 1/(2^(n+1)) else R0)) 
    (p : R -> Prop := fun l => forall x : R, 0 <= x < 1 -> f x >= l)
    (L : R)
    (hpL : p L)
    (hLub : forall l : R, p l -> l <= L)
    : L = putnam_2015_a4_solution.
Proof. Admitted.

theory putnam_2015_a4 imports Complex_Main
"HOL-Analysis.Infinite_Sum"
begin

definition putnam_2015_a4_solution::real where "putnam_2015_a4_solution \<equiv> undefined"
(* 4/7 *)
theorem putnam_2015_a4:
  fixes S::"real\<Rightarrow>(nat set)" and f::"real\<Rightarrow>real" and p::"real\<Rightarrow>bool"
  defines "S \<equiv> \<lambda>x::real. {n::nat. n > 0 \<and> even (\<lfloor>n * x\<rfloor>)}"
    and "f \<equiv> \<lambda>x::real. \<Sum>\<^sub>\<infinity>n \<in> S x. 1 / (2 ^ n)"
  shows "putnam_2015_a4_solution = (GREATEST l::real. \<forall>x \<in> {0..<1}. f x \<ge> l)"
  sorry

end

title: putnam_2015_a4
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2015_a4:
  the greatest uniform lower bound on a binary series selected by the parity
  of floors of positive integer multiples. This file contains no proof.
*)

let statement =
  `let even_floor =
     \x:real. \n:num.
       ?k:num.
         &(2 * k) <= &n * x /\
         &n * x < &(2 * k + 1) in
   let f =
     \x:real.
       sup {s:real |
              ?N:num.
                s =
                  sum (1..N)
                    (\n:num.
                       if even_floor x n
                       then &1 / ((&2:real) pow n)
                       else &0)} in
   (!x:real.
      &0 <= x /\ x < &1
      ==> &4 / &7 <= f x) /\
   (!l:real.
      (!x:real.
         &0 <= x /\ x < &1
         ==> l <= f x)
      ==> l <= &4 / &7)`;;

title: putnam_2015_a4
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2015_a4:
;; the greatest lower bound is 4/7 for the binary series whose nth term is
;; 2^(-n) when floor(n*x) is even, over all real x in [0,1).
;; This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))

;; Ordinary ACL2 has no primitive carrier containing every real number.  The
;; conservative interfaces below present an arbitrary Archimedean
;; Dedekind-complete ordered field, hence the real field up to its unique
;; order-preserving field isomorphism.  The floor and series-value interfaces
;; are constrained in the statement by their exact defining properties.  No
;; real input is replaced by a rational, and no infinite sum is replaced by a
;; finite approximant.

(defstub putnam-2015-a4-real-p (real-type value) t)
(defstub putnam-2015-a4-zero (real-type) t)
(defstub putnam-2015-a4-one (real-type) t)
(defstub putnam-2015-a4-add (real-type left right) t)
(defstub putnam-2015-a4-mul (real-type left right) t)
(defstub putnam-2015-a4-neg (real-type value) t)
(defstub putnam-2015-a4-inv (real-type value) t)
(defstub putnam-2015-a4-less (real-type left right) t)
(defstub putnam-2015-a4-supremum (real-type set) t)
(defstub putnam-2015-a4-floor (real-type value) t)
(defstub putnam-2015-a4-series-value (real-type value) t)

(defun putnam-2015-a4-leq (real-type left right)
  (not (putnam-2015-a4-less real-type right left)))

(defun putnam-2015-a4-sub (real-type left right)
  (putnam-2015-a4-add
   real-type
   left
   (putnam-2015-a4-neg real-type right)))

(defun putnam-2015-a4-div (real-type numerator denominator)
  (putnam-2015-a4-mul
   real-type
   numerator
   (putnam-2015-a4-inv real-type denominator)))

(defun putnam-2015-a4-abs (real-type value)
  (if (putnam-2015-a4-less
       real-type value (putnam-2015-a4-zero real-type))
      (putnam-2015-a4-neg real-type value)
    value))

(defun putnam-2015-a4-positive-p (real-type value)
  (and
   (putnam-2015-a4-real-p real-type value)
   (putnam-2015-a4-less
    real-type
    (putnam-2015-a4-zero real-type)
    value)))

(defun putnam-2015-a4-real-set-member-p (set value)
  (if (apply$ set (list value)) t nil))

(defun-sk putnam-2015-a4-valid-real-set-p (real-type set)
  (forall (value)
    (implies
     (putnam-2015-a4-real-set-member-p set value)
     (putnam-2015-a4-real-p real-type value))))

;; Complete ordered-field structure.

(defun-sk putnam-2015-a4-field-laws-p (real-type)
  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (putnam-2015-a4-real-p real-type x)
      (putnam-2015-a4-real-p real-type y)
      (putnam-2015-a4-real-p real-type z))
     (let* ((zero (putnam-2015-a4-zero real-type))
            (one (putnam-2015-a4-one real-type))
            (xy-add (putnam-2015-a4-add real-type x y))
            (yz-add (putnam-2015-a4-add real-type y z))
            (xy-mul (putnam-2015-a4-mul real-type x y))
            (yz-mul (putnam-2015-a4-mul real-type y z))
            (neg-x (putnam-2015-a4-neg real-type x))
            (inv-x (putnam-2015-a4-inv real-type x)))
       (and
        (putnam-2015-a4-real-p real-type xy-add)
        (putnam-2015-a4-real-p real-type xy-mul)
        (putnam-2015-a4-real-p real-type neg-x)
        (putnam-2015-a4-real-p real-type inv-x)
        (equal
         (putnam-2015-a4-add real-type xy-add z)
         (putnam-2015-a4-add real-type x yz-add))
        (equal xy-add (putnam-2015-a4-add real-type y x))
        (equal (putnam-2015-a4-add real-type x zero) x)
        (equal (putnam-2015-a4-add real-type x neg-x) zero)
        (equal
         (putnam-2015-a4-mul real-type xy-mul z)
         (putnam-2015-a4-mul real-type x yz-mul))
        (equal xy-mul (putnam-2015-a4-mul real-type y x))
        (equal (putnam-2015-a4-mul real-type x one) x)
        (implies
         (equal x zero)
         (equal inv-x zero))
        (implies
         (not (equal x zero))
         (equal
          (putnam-2015-a4-mul real-type x inv-x)
          one))
        (equal
         (putnam-2015-a4-mul real-type x yz-add)
         (putnam-2015-a4-add
          real-type
          (putnam-2015-a4-mul real-type x y)
          (putnam-2015-a4-mul real-type x z))))))))

(defun-sk putnam-2015-a4-order-laws-p (real-type)
  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (putnam-2015-a4-real-p real-type x)
      (putnam-2015-a4-real-p real-type y)
      (putnam-2015-a4-real-p real-type z))
     (let ((zero (putnam-2015-a4-zero real-type)))
       (and
        (not (putnam-2015-a4-less real-type x x))
        (or
         (putnam-2015-a4-less real-type x y)
         (equal x y)
         (putnam-2015-a4-less real-type y x))
        (implies
         (and
          (putnam-2015-a4-less real-type x y)
          (putnam-2015-a4-less real-type y z))
         (putnam-2015-a4-less real-type x z))
        (implies
         (putnam-2015-a4-less real-type x y)
         (putnam-2015-a4-less
          real-type
          (putnam-2015-a4-add real-type x z)
          (putnam-2015-a4-add real-type y z)))
        (implies
         (and
          (putnam-2015-a4-less real-type zero x)
          (putnam-2015-a4-less real-type zero y))
         (putnam-2015-a4-less
          real-type
          zero
          (putnam-2015-a4-mul real-type x y))))))))

(defun-sk putnam-2015-a4-upper-bound-p
    (real-type set upper)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (and
      (putnam-2015-a4-real-p real-type x)
      (putnam-2015-a4-real-set-member-p set x))
     (putnam-2015-a4-leq real-type x upper))))

(defun-sk putnam-2015-a4-real-set-nonempty-p
    (real-type set)
  (exists (x)
    (and
     (putnam-2015-a4-real-p real-type x)
     (putnam-2015-a4-real-set-member-p set x))))

(defun-sk putnam-2015-a4-real-set-bounded-p
    (real-type set)
  (exists (upper)
    (and
     (putnam-2015-a4-real-p real-type upper)
     (putnam-2015-a4-upper-bound-p
      real-type set upper))))

(defun-sk putnam-2015-a4-least-upper-bound-p
    (real-type set supremum)
  (forall (upper)
    (implies
     (and
      (putnam-2015-a4-real-p real-type upper)
      (putnam-2015-a4-upper-bound-p
       real-type set upper))
     (putnam-2015-a4-leq
      real-type supremum upper))))

(defun-sk putnam-2015-a4-completeness-p (real-type)
  (forall (set)
    (implies
     (and
      (tamep-functionp set)
      (putnam-2015-a4-valid-real-set-p real-type set)
      (putnam-2015-a4-real-set-nonempty-p real-type set)
      (putnam-2015-a4-real-set-bounded-p real-type set))
     (let ((supremum
            (putnam-2015-a4-supremum real-type set)))
       (and
        (putnam-2015-a4-real-p real-type supremum)
        (putnam-2015-a4-upper-bound-p
         real-type set supremum)
        (putnam-2015-a4-least-upper-bound-p
         real-type set supremum))))))

(defun putnam-2015-a4-r-nat (real-type n)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix n)))
  (if (zp n)
      (putnam-2015-a4-zero real-type)
    (putnam-2015-a4-add
     real-type
     (putnam-2015-a4-one real-type)
     (putnam-2015-a4-r-nat real-type (1- n)))))

(defun putnam-2015-a4-r-int (real-type integer)
  (if (integerp integer)
      (if (< integer 0)
          (putnam-2015-a4-neg
           real-type
           (putnam-2015-a4-r-nat real-type (- integer)))
        (putnam-2015-a4-r-nat real-type integer))
    (putnam-2015-a4-zero real-type)))

(defun-sk putnam-2015-a4-archimedean-witness-p
    (real-type value)
  (exists (n)
    (and
     (natp n)
     (putnam-2015-a4-less
      real-type
      value
      (putnam-2015-a4-r-nat real-type n)))))

(defun-sk putnam-2015-a4-archimedean-p (real-type)
  (forall (value)
    (implies
     (putnam-2015-a4-real-p real-type value)
     (putnam-2015-a4-archimedean-witness-p
      real-type value))))

(defun putnam-2015-a4-real-field-p (real-type)
  (let ((zero (putnam-2015-a4-zero real-type))
        (one (putnam-2015-a4-one real-type)))
    (and
     (putnam-2015-a4-real-p real-type zero)
     (putnam-2015-a4-real-p real-type one)
     (not (equal zero one))
     (putnam-2015-a4-field-laws-p real-type)
     (putnam-2015-a4-order-laws-p real-type)
     (putnam-2015-a4-less real-type zero one)
     (putnam-2015-a4-completeness-p real-type)
     (putnam-2015-a4-archimedean-p real-type))))

;; The integer returned by FLOOR is characterized by
;; embed(k) <= x < embed(k + 1), which uniquely defines the usual floor.

(defun-sk putnam-2015-a4-floor-laws-p (real-type)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (putnam-2015-a4-real-p real-type x)
     (let ((integer
            (putnam-2015-a4-floor real-type x)))
       (and
        (integerp integer)
        (putnam-2015-a4-leq
         real-type
         (putnam-2015-a4-r-int real-type integer)
         x)
        (putnam-2015-a4-less
         real-type
         x
         (putnam-2015-a4-r-int
          real-type
          (+ integer 1))))))))

(defun putnam-2015-a4-r-power
    (real-type base exponent)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix exponent)))
  (if (zp exponent)
      (putnam-2015-a4-one real-type)
    (putnam-2015-a4-mul
     real-type
     base
     (putnam-2015-a4-r-power
      real-type base (1- exponent)))))

(defun putnam-2015-a4-series-term
    (real-type x n)
  (if (posp n)
      (let* ((nx
              (putnam-2015-a4-mul
               real-type
               (putnam-2015-a4-r-nat real-type n)
               x))
             (floor-nx
              (putnam-2015-a4-floor real-type nx)))
        (if (equal (mod floor-nx 2) 0)
            (putnam-2015-a4-div
             real-type
             (putnam-2015-a4-one real-type)
             (putnam-2015-a4-r-power
              real-type
              (putnam-2015-a4-r-nat real-type 2)
              n))
          (putnam-2015-a4-zero real-type)))
    (putnam-2015-a4-zero real-type)))

;; Sum of the exact source terms with 1 <= n <= TERMS.

(defun putnam-2015-a4-prefix-sum
    (real-type x terms)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix terms)))
  (if (zp terms)
      (putnam-2015-a4-zero real-type)
    (putnam-2015-a4-add
     real-type
     (putnam-2015-a4-prefix-sum
      real-type x (1- terms))
     (putnam-2015-a4-series-term
      real-type x terms))))

;; Literal epsilon-N convergence of the partial sums.  This characterizes the
;; same infinite sum used by the source, rather than a bounded approximation.

(defun-sk putnam-2015-a4-limit-tail-p
    (real-type x limit epsilon cutoff)
  (forall (terms)
    (implies
     (and
      (natp terms)
      (natp cutoff)
      (<= cutoff terms))
     (putnam-2015-a4-less
      real-type
      (putnam-2015-a4-abs
       real-type
       (putnam-2015-a4-sub
        real-type
        (putnam-2015-a4-prefix-sum
         real-type x terms)
        limit))
      epsilon))))

(defun-sk putnam-2015-a4-limit-cutoff-p
    (real-type x limit epsilon)
  (exists (cutoff)
    (and
     (natp cutoff)
     (putnam-2015-a4-limit-tail-p
      real-type x limit epsilon cutoff))))

(defun-sk putnam-2015-a4-converges-to-p
    (real-type x limit)
  (forall (epsilon)
    (implies
     (putnam-2015-a4-positive-p real-type epsilon)
     (putnam-2015-a4-limit-cutoff-p
      real-type x limit epsilon))))

(defun-sk putnam-2015-a4-series-value-laws-p
    (real-type)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (putnam-2015-a4-real-p real-type x)
     (let ((value
            (putnam-2015-a4-series-value real-type x)))
       (and
        (putnam-2015-a4-real-p real-type value)
        (putnam-2015-a4-converges-to-p
         real-type x value))))))

(defun putnam-2015-a4-admissible-p (real-type x)
  (and
   (putnam-2015-a4-real-p real-type x)
   (putnam-2015-a4-leq
    real-type
    (putnam-2015-a4-zero real-type)
    x)
   (putnam-2015-a4-less
    real-type
    x
    (putnam-2015-a4-one real-type))))

(defun-sk putnam-2015-a4-lower-bound-p
    (real-type bound)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (putnam-2015-a4-admissible-p real-type x)
     (putnam-2015-a4-leq
      real-type
      bound
      (putnam-2015-a4-series-value real-type x)))))

(defun-sk putnam-2015-a4-greatest-lower-bound-p
    (real-type candidate)
  (forall (bound)
    (implies
     (and
      (putnam-2015-a4-real-p real-type bound)
      (putnam-2015-a4-lower-bound-p real-type bound))
     (putnam-2015-a4-leq
      real-type bound candidate))))

(defun putnam-2015-a4-solution (real-type)
  (putnam-2015-a4-div
   real-type
   (putnam-2015-a4-r-nat real-type 4)
   (putnam-2015-a4-r-nat real-type 7)))

;; Membership of 4/7 in the lower-bound predicate together with maximality is

(defun putnambench-putnam-2015-a4-statement (real-type)

    (putnam-2015-a4-floor-laws-p real-type)

title: putnam_2015_a4
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2015_a4
-- (putnambench__agda__putnam_2015_a4): the greatest uniform lower bound of
-- the binary series selected by even floors on the real interval [0,1).
-- This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module Main where

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; _*_)

infix 4 _!=_ _<=N_
infixr 3 _and_
infixr 2 _or_

data Bottom : Set where

Not : Set -> Set
Not A =
  A -> Bottom

_!=_ : {A : Set} -> A -> A -> Set
x != y =
  Not (x == y)

record _and_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data _or_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  left  : A -> A or B
  right : B -> A or B

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

data _<=N_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set where
  zero<=N   : {n : Nat} -> zero <=N n
  suc<=sucN : {m n : Nat} -> m <=N n -> suc m <=N suc n

record CompleteOrderedRealField (R : Set) : Set1 where
  field
    zeroR oneR : R
    add multiply : R -> R -> R
    negate inverse : R -> R
    lessOrEqual : R -> R -> Set
    fromNat : Nat -> R

    one-not-zero :
      oneR != zeroR

    add-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> add x y == add y x
    add-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      add (add x y) z == add x (add y z)
    add-zero :
      (x : R) -> add x zeroR == x
    add-inverse :
      (x : R) -> add x (negate x) == zeroR

    multiply-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> multiply x y == multiply y x
    multiply-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply (multiply x y) z ==
      multiply x (multiply y z)
    multiply-one :
      (x : R) -> multiply x oneR == x
    multiply-zero :
      (x : R) -> multiply x zeroR == zeroR
    distribute :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply x (add y z) ==
      add (multiply x y) (multiply x z)
    inverse-zero :
      inverse zeroR == zeroR
    multiply-inverse :
      (x : R) ->
      x != zeroR ->
      multiply x (inverse x) == oneR

    order-reflexive :
      (x : R) -> lessOrEqual x x
    order-transitive :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y z ->
      lessOrEqual x z
    order-antisymmetric :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y x ->
      x == y
    order-total :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y or lessOrEqual y x
    add-order :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual (add z x) (add z y)
    multiply-nonnegative :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR x ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR y ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR (multiply x y)
    zero-less-than-one :
      lessOrEqual zeroR oneR and zeroR != oneR

    fromNat-zero :
      fromNat zero == zeroR
    fromNat-successor :
      (n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (suc n) == add (fromNat n) oneR
    fromNat-addition :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m + n) == add (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-multiplication :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m * n) == multiply (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-injective :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat m == fromNat n ->
      m == n

    archimedean :
      (x : R) ->
      Exists Nat
        (\ n -> lessOrEqual x (fromNat n))
    least-upper-bound :
      (P : R -> Set) ->
      Exists R P ->
      Exists R
        (\ upper ->
          (x : R) ->
          P x ->
          lessOrEqual x upper) ->
      Exists R
        (\ supremum ->
          ((x : R) ->
            P x ->
            lessOrEqual x supremum)
          and
          ((upper : R) ->
            ((x : R) ->
              P x ->
              lessOrEqual x upper) ->
            lessOrEqual supremum upper))

open CompleteOrderedRealField

twoN : Nat
twoN =
  suc (suc zero)

fourN : Nat
fourN =
  twoN * twoN

sevenN : Nat
sevenN =
  suc (suc (suc fourN))

subtract :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
subtract reals x y =
  add reals x (negate reals y)

divide :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
divide reals x y =
  multiply reals x (inverse reals y)

naturalPower :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  Nat ->
  R
naturalPower reals x zero =
  oneR reals
naturalPower reals x (suc n) =
  multiply reals
    (naturalPower reals x n)
    x

StrictLess :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
StrictLess reals x y =
  lessOrEqual reals x y and x != y

CloseTo :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
CloseTo reals center radius x =
  StrictLess reals
    (subtract reals center radius)
    x
  and
  StrictLess reals
    x
    (add reals center radius)

sumFirst :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Nat ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  R
sumFirst reals zero terms =
  zeroR reals
sumFirst reals (suc n) terms =
  add reals
    (sumFirst reals n terms)
    (terms n)

ConvergesTo :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  R ->
  Set
ConvergesTo {R} reals sequence limit =
  (epsilon : R) ->
  StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) epsilon ->
  Exists Nat
    (\ cutoff ->
      (n : Nat) ->
      cutoff <=N n ->
      CloseTo reals limit epsilon (sequence n))

SeriesHasSum :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  R ->
  Set
SeriesHasSum reals terms limit =
  ConvergesTo reals
    (\ n -> sumFirst reals n terms)
    limit

InHalfOpenUnitInterval :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  Set
InHalfOpenUnitInterval reals x =
  lessOrEqual reals (zeroR reals) x
  and
  StrictLess reals x (oneR reals)

EvenFloorOfNonnegative :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  Set
EvenFloorOfNonnegative reals y =
  Exists Nat
    (\ k ->
      lessOrEqual reals
        (fromNat reals (twoN * k))
        y
      and
      StrictLess reals
        y
        (fromNat reals (suc (twoN * k))))

reciprocalPowerOfTwo :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Nat ->
  R
reciprocalPowerOfTwo reals n =
  divide reals
    (oneR reals)
    (naturalPower reals
      (fromNat reals twoN)
      (suc n))

PutnamTermAt :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  Nat ->
  R ->
  Set
PutnamTermAt reals x n term =
  (EvenFloorOfNonnegative reals
    (multiply reals
      (fromNat reals (suc n))
      x)
  and
  term == reciprocalPowerOfTwo reals n)
  or
  (Not
    (EvenFloorOfNonnegative reals
      (multiply reals
        (fromNat reals (suc n))
        x))
  and
  term == zeroR reals)

PutnamTermsAt :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  Set
PutnamTermsAt reals x terms =
  (n : Nat) ->
  PutnamTermAt reals x n (terms n)

SeriesValueAt :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
SeriesValueAt {R} reals x total =
  Exists (Nat -> R)
    (\ terms ->
      PutnamTermsAt reals x terms
      and
      SeriesHasSum reals terms total)

UniformLowerBound :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  Set
UniformLowerBound {R} reals lower =
  (x : R) ->
  InHalfOpenUnitInterval reals x ->
  Exists R
    (\ total ->
      SeriesValueAt reals x total
      and
      lessOrEqual reals lower total)

fourSevenths :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R
fourSevenths reals =
  divide reals
    (fromNat reals fourN)
    (fromNat reals sevenN)

IsGreatestUniformLowerBound :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  Set
IsGreatestUniformLowerBound {R} reals greatest =
  UniformLowerBound reals greatest
  and
  ((lower : R) ->
    UniformLowerBound reals lower ->
    lessOrEqual reals lower greatest)

putnam-2015-a4 : Set1
putnam-2015-a4 =
  (R : Set) ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) ->
  IsGreatestUniformLowerBound reals
    (fourSevenths reals)

(*
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2015_a4:
  the greatest uniform lower bound on [0,1) of the binary series indexed by
  positive integers whose multiples of x have even floor is 4/7. This file
  contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open arithmeticTheory integerTheory realTheory intrealTheory seqTheory;

val putnam_2015_a4 =
  ``let f =
      \x : real.
        suminf
          (\n : num.
             if 0 < n /\
                (2 : int) int_divides INT_FLOOR ((&n : real) * x)
             then 1 / (2 : real) pow n
             else 0)
    in
    let solution = (4 / 7 : real)
    in
      (!x : real.
         0 <= x /\ x < 1
         ==>
         solution <= f x) /\
      (!l : real.
         (!x : real.
            0 <= x /\ x < 1
            ==>
            l <= f x)
         ==>
         l <= solution)``;

title: putnam_2015_a4
content:
$(
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact
  putnam_2015_a4: the greatest universal lower bound on the binary series
  selected by even values of floor(n x), for real x in [0, 1), is 4 / 7.
  This file contains no proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  SetMM's NN is the class of positive integers, |_ is the real floor
  function, || is integer divisibility, and an unbounded sum_ is the
  convergent infinite series sum. Thus

    { n e. NN | 2 || ( |_ ` ( n x. x ) ) }

  is exactly the source set S_x, and the displayed summand is 1 / 2^n.
  The first conjunct states that 4 / 7 is a universal lower bound on
  [0, 1). The second states that every real universal lower bound is at most
  4 / 7. Together they are equivalent to saying that 4 / 7 is the greatest
  such lower bound.

  The source's definitionally specified S, f, and p are inlined. The final
  declaration is the single unproved $a corpus statement; this database
  contains no $p proof declaration.
$)

${
  $d l n x $.

  putnambench-putnam-2015-a4 $a |-
    (
      A. x e. RR
        (
          (
            0 <_ x
            /\
            x < 1
          )
          ->
          (
            ( 4 / 7 )
            <_
            sum_ n e.
              { n e. NN | 2 || ( |_ ` ( n x. x ) ) }
              ( 1 / ( 2 ^ n ) )
          )
        )
      /\
      A. l e. RR
        (
          (
            A. x e. RR
              (
                (
                  0 <_ x
                  /\
                  x < 1
                )
                ->
                (
                  l
                  <_
                  sum_ n e.
                    { n e. NN | 2 || ( |_ ` ( n x. x ) ) }
                    ( 1 / ( 2 ^ n ) )
                )
              )
          )
          ->
          l <_ ( 4 / 7 )
        )
    )
  $.
$}

title: putnam_2015_a4
content:
% Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2015_a4:
% the greatest uniform lower bound on [0,1) of the dyadic series indexed by
% positive integers n for which floor(n*x) is even is 4/7. This file contains
% no proof.

putnam_2015_a4: THEORY
BEGIN
  real_function: TYPE = [real -> real]
  real_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> real]

  integer_even(value: int): bool =
    EXISTS (factor: int):
      value = 2 * factor

  power_of_two(exponent: nat): real =
    (2 :: real) ^ exponent

  dyadic_terms(x: real): real_sequence =
    LAMBDA (index: nat):
      LET n: nat = index + 1 IN
        IF integer_even(floor((n :: real) * x)) THEN
          1 / power_of_two(n)
        ELSE
          0
        ENDIF

  partial_sum(values: real_sequence, count: nat): RECURSIVE real =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      partial_sum(values, count - 1) + values(count - 1)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  series_sums_to(values: real_sequence, total: real): bool =
    FORALL (epsilon_value: posreal):
      EXISTS (cutoff: nat):
        FORALL (count: nat):
          cutoff <= count IMPLIES
            abs(partial_sum(values, count) - total) < epsilon_value

  series_value(x: real): real =
    IF EXISTS (total: real):
        series_sums_to(dyadic_terms(x), total)
    THEN
      epsilon(
        LAMBDA (total: real):
          series_sums_to(dyadic_terms(x), total))
    ELSE
      0
    ENDIF

  lower_bound_on_unit_interval(
      f: real_function,
      bound: real): bool =
    FORALL (x: real):
      (0 <= x AND x < 1) IMPLIES bound <= f(x)

  is_greatest_lower_bound(
      f: real_function,
      value: real): bool =
    lower_bound_on_unit_interval(f, value)
      AND FORALL (bound: real):
        lower_bound_on_unit_interval(f, bound)
          IMPLIES bound <= value

  putnam_2015_a4_solution: real = 4 / 7

  putnam_2015_a4_statement: bool =
    is_greatest_lower_bound(
      series_value,
      putnam_2015_a4_solution)
END putnam_2015_a4

import Mathlib

/--
Let $q$ be an odd positive integer, and let $N_q$ denote the number of integers $a$ such that $0< a< q/4$ and $\gcd(a,q)=1$. Show that $N_q$ is odd if and only if $q$ is of the form $p^k$ with $k$ a positive integer and $p$ a prime congruent to $5$ or $7$ modulo $8$.
-/
theorem putnam_2015_a5
(q : ℕ)
(Nq : ℕ)
(qodd : Odd q)
(qpos : q > 0)
(hNq : Nq = {a : ℕ | 0 < a ∧ a < (q : ℝ) / 4 ∧ Nat.gcd a q = 1}.encard)
: Odd Nq ↔ ∃ p k : ℕ, q = p ^ k ∧ k > 0 ∧ p.Prime ∧ (p % 8 = 5 ∨ p % 8 = 7) :=
sorry

Theorem putnam_2015_a5
    (q : nat)
    (Nq : nat)
    (qodd : odd q = true )
    (qpos : q > 0)
    (hNq : cardinal nat
      (fun a : nat =>
        (0 < a)%nat /\
        Rlt (INR a) (Rdiv (INR q) (INR 4)) /\

      Nq)
    : odd Nq = true <-> (exists (p k : nat), q = p^k /\ k > 0 /\ prime (Z.of_nat p) /\ (p mod 8 = 5 \/ p mod 8 = 7)).
Proof. Admitted.

(*
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2015_a5:
  parity classification of the number of positive integers below one quarter
  of an odd positive integer q that are coprime to q. This file contains no
  proof.

     ODD q /\
     0 < q /\

title: putnam_2015_a5
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2015_a5:
;; the parity of the count of positive reduced residues below q/4 characterizes
;; odd prime powers with prime congruent to 5 or 7 modulo 8. This file contains
;; no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(defun putnam-2015-a5-gcd (a b)
  (declare (xargs :measure (+ (nfix a) (nfix b))))
  (if (and (natp a) (natp b))
      (cond ((zp a) b)
            ((zp b) a)
            ((< a b)
             (putnam-2015-a5-gcd a (- b a)))
            (t
             (putnam-2015-a5-gcd (- a b) b)))
    0))

;; For natural a and q, a < q/4 is equivalent to 4*a < q. Every qualifying
;; positive a is below q, so this recursion counts the source set exactly.
(defun putnam-2015-a5-coprime-count-through (q a)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix a)))
  (if (and (natp q) (natp a))
      (if (zp a)
          0
        (+ (if (and (< (* 4 a) q)
                    (equal (putnam-2015-a5-gcd a q) 1))
               1
             0)
           (putnam-2015-a5-coprime-count-through
            q (- a 1))))
    0))

(defun putnam-2015-a5-no-divisor-from-p (n d)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix (- n d))))
  (if (and (natp n)
           (natp d)
           (<= 2 d)
           (< d n))
      (and (not (equal (mod n d) 0))
           (putnam-2015-a5-no-divisor-from-p n (+ d 1)))
    t))

(defun putnam-2015-a5-primep (n)
  (and (natp n)
       (< 1 n)
       (putnam-2015-a5-no-divisor-from-p n 2)))

(defun putnam-2015-a5-qualifying-prime-p (p)
  (and (putnam-2015-a5-primep p)
       (or (equal (mod p 8) 5)
           (equal (mod p 8) 7))))

(defun putnam-2015-a5-power-witness-through-k-p (q p k)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix k)))
  (if (and (natp q) (natp p) (natp k))
      (if (zp k)
          nil
        (or (equal q (expt p k))
            (putnam-2015-a5-power-witness-through-k-p
             q p (- k 1))))
    nil))

;; If q=p^k with p prime and k positive, then p<=q and k<=q. Searching both
;; variables through q is therefore equivalent to the source existential.
(defun putnam-2015-a5-prime-power-through-p (q p)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix p)))
  (if (and (natp q) (natp p))
      (if (< p 2)
          nil
        (or (and (putnam-2015-a5-qualifying-prime-p p)
                 (putnam-2015-a5-power-witness-through-k-p
                  q p q))
            (putnam-2015-a5-prime-power-through-p
             q (- p 1))))
    nil))

(defun putnambench-putnam-2015-a5-statement (q nq)
  (implies
   (and (natp q)
        (natp nq)
        (oddp q)
        (< 0 q)
        (equal nq
               (putnam-2015-a5-coprime-count-through q q)))
   (equal (oddp nq)
          (putnam-2015-a5-prime-power-through-p q q))))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

title: putnam_2015_a5
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2015_a5
-- (putnambench__agda__putnam_2015_a5): parity of the number of positive
-- integers below q/4 and coprime to odd q, characterized by prime powers
-- whose prime is 5 or 7 modulo 8. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module Putnam2015A5 where

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using
  (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; _*_; mod-helper)

infix 4 _<=_ _<_ _divides_
infixr 8 _pow_
infixr 3 _and_
infixr 2 _or_

record _and_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data _or_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  left  : A -> A or B
  right : B -> A or B

record Iff (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor equivalence
  field
    forward  : A -> B
    backward : B -> A

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

data _<=_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set where
  zero<=   : {n : Nat} -> zero <= n
  suc<=suc : {m n : Nat} -> m <= n -> suc m <= suc n

_<_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set
m < n =
  suc m <= n

Positive : Nat -> Set
Positive n =
  zero < n

data Fin : Nat -> Set where
  fzero : {n : Nat} -> Fin (suc n)
  fsuc  : {n : Nat} -> Fin n -> Fin (suc n)

record HasCardinality
  (member : Nat -> Set)
  (cardinality : Nat) :
  Set where

  field
    enumerate :
      Fin cardinality ->
      Nat
    enumerated-member :
      (index : Fin cardinality) ->
      member (enumerate index)
    enumeration-complete :
      (item : Nat) ->
      member item ->
      Exists (Fin cardinality)
        (\ index -> item == enumerate index)
    enumeration-injective :
      (left-index right-index : Fin cardinality) ->
      enumerate left-index == enumerate right-index ->
      left-index == right-index

_divides_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set
divisor divides dividend =
  Exists Nat
    (\ quotient -> dividend == divisor * quotient)

data Prime (n : Nat) : Set where
  prime :
    2 <= n ->
    ((d : Nat) ->
      d divides n ->
      (d == 1) or (d == n)) ->
    Prime n

naturalMod : Nat -> Nat -> Nat
naturalMod numerator zero =
  numerator
naturalMod numerator (suc denominator) =
  mod-helper zero denominator numerator denominator

gcdWithFuel : Nat -> Nat -> Nat -> Nat
gcdWithFuel zero a b =
  a
gcdWithFuel (suc fuel) a zero =
  a
gcdWithFuel (suc fuel) a (suc b) =
  gcdWithFuel fuel (suc b) (naturalMod a (suc b))

naturalGCD : Nat -> Nat -> Nat
naturalGCD a b =
  gcdWithFuel (suc (a + b)) a b

_pow_ : Nat -> Nat -> Nat
base pow zero =
  1
base pow (suc exponent) =
  base * (base pow exponent)

Odd : Nat -> Set
Odd n =
  Exists Nat
    (\ half -> n == 2 * half + 1)

Eligible : Nat -> Nat -> Set
Eligible q a =
  Positive a
  and
  ((4 * a < q)
  and
  (naturalGCD a q == 1))

PrimePowerResidue : Nat -> Set
PrimePowerResidue q =
  Exists Nat
    (\ p ->
      Exists Nat
        (\ k ->
          (q == p pow k)
          and
          (Positive k
          and
          (Prime p
          and
          ((naturalMod p 8 == 5)
          or
          (naturalMod p 8 == 7))))))

putnam-2015-a5 : Set
putnam-2015-a5 =
  (q Nq : Nat) ->
  Odd q ->
  Positive q ->
  HasCardinality (Eligible q) Nq ->
  Iff (Odd Nq) (PrimePowerResidue q)

title: putnam_2015_a5

(*
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2015_a5:
  for an odd positive integer q, the number of positive integers below q/4
  and coprime to q is odd exactly when q is a positive power of a prime
  congruent to 5 or 7 modulo 8. This file contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open arithmeticTheory gcdTheory pred_setTheory primeTheory realTheory;

val putnam_2015_a5 =
  ``!q Nq : num.
      ODD q /\
      0 < q /\
      Nq =
        CARD
          {a : num |
             0 < a /\
             (&a : real) < (&q : real) / 4 /\
             gcd a q = 1}
      ==>
      (ODD Nq <=>
       ?p k : num.
         q = p EXP k /\
         0 < k /\
         prime p /\
         (p MOD 8 = 5 \/ p MOD 8 = 7))``;

$(

  putnam_2015_a5: parity of the number of positive integers below one
  quarter of an odd positive integer and coprime to it, characterized by
  prime powers in residue classes five or seven modulo eight. This file
  contains no proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  NN, NN0, Prime, and Odd are SetMM's classes of positive naturals,
  nonnegative naturals, natural primes, and odd integers. Restricting a to
  NN is exactly the source condition 0 < a. The remaining strict inequality
  and gcd equality define the source set, and # is its finite cardinality.

  Quantifying q over NN incorporates the source positivity assumption;
  oddness and the defining equality for Nq remain explicit hypotheses.
  The prime p and positive exponent k remain internally existentially
  quantified. The final declaration is the single unproved $a corpus
  statement; this database contains no $p proof declaration.
$)

${
  $d N a k p q $.

  putnambench-putnam-2015-a5 $a |-
    A. q e. NN A. N e. NN0
      (
        (
          q e. Odd
          /\

                /\

          <->

            )

$}

title: putnam_2015_a5
content:
% Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2015_a5:
% the parity of the count of positive reduced residues below one quarter of an
% odd positive integer characterizes specified odd prime powers. This file
% contains no proof.

putnam_2015_a5: THEORY
BEGIN

  nat_divides(divisor, value: nat): bool =
    EXISTS (quotient: nat):
      value = divisor * quotient

  relatively_prime(left, right: nat): bool =
    FORALL (divisor: posnat):
      (nat_divides(divisor, left) AND nat_divides(divisor, right))
        IMPLIES divisor = 1

  prime_nat(value: nat): bool =
    value >= 2
      AND FORALL (divisor: posnat):
        nat_divides(divisor, value)
          IMPLIES divisor = 1 OR divisor = value

  admissible_residue(a, q: nat): bool =
    a > 0
      AND 4 * a < q
      AND relatively_prime(a, q)

  counts_admissible_residues(q, count: nat): bool =
    EXISTS (enumeration: [nat -> nat]):
      (FORALL (left_index, right_index: nat):
        (left_index < count
          AND right_index < count
          AND enumeration(left_index) = enumeration(right_index))
            IMPLIES left_index = right_index)
        AND
      (FORALL (a: nat):
        admissible_residue(a, q)
          IFF EXISTS (index: nat):
            index < count AND enumeration(index) = a)

  odd_nat(value: nat): bool =
    mod(value, 2) = 1

  specified_prime_power(q: nat): bool =
    EXISTS (p, k: nat):
      q = p ^ k
        AND k > 0
        AND prime_nat(p)
        AND (mod(p, 8) = 5 OR mod(p, 8) = 7)

  putnam_2015_a5: bool =
    FORALL (q, Nq: nat):
      (odd_nat(q)
        AND q > 0
        AND counts_admissible_residues(q, Nq))
          IMPLIES
            (odd_nat(Nq) IFF specified_prime_power(q))

END putnam_2015_a5

title: putnam_2015_a6
content:
(* Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2015_a6:
   determinant equality for intertwined positive-dimensional real square
   matrices with the same characteristic polynomial. This file contains no
   proof. *)

From Stdlib Require Import Lists.List Vectors.Fin Reals Arith.PeanoNat.

Import ListNotations.
Open Scope R_scope.

Definition putnam_2015_a6_matrix (n : nat) : Type :=
  Fin.t n -> Fin.t n -> R.

Definition putnam_2015_a6_matrix_eq {n : nat}
    (A B : putnam_2015_a6_matrix n) : Prop :=
  forall i j : Fin.t n, A i j = B i j.

Fixpoint putnam_2015_a6_fin_sum
    (n : nat) : (Fin.t n -> R) -> R :=
  match n as k return (Fin.t k -> R) -> R with
  | O => fun _ => 0
  | S k =>
      fun f =>
        f Fin.F1 +
        putnam_2015_a6_fin_sum k (fun i => f (Fin.FS i))
  end.

Definition putnam_2015_a6_matrix_mul {n : nat}
    (A B : putnam_2015_a6_matrix n) :
    putnam_2015_a6_matrix n :=
  fun i j =>
    putnam_2015_a6_fin_sum n (fun k => A i k * B k j).

Definition putnam_2015_a6_matrix_sub {n : nat}
    (A B : putnam_2015_a6_matrix n) :
    putnam_2015_a6_matrix n :=
  fun i j => A i j - B i j.

Fixpoint putnam_2015_a6_fin_list
    (n : nat) : list (Fin.t n) :=
  match n as k return list (Fin.t k) with
  | O => []
  | S k =>
      Fin.F1 :: map Fin.FS (putnam_2015_a6_fin_list k)
  end.

Definition putnam_2015_a6_rows
    {T : Type} (n : nat) (A : Fin.t n -> Fin.t n -> T) :
    list (list T) :=
  map
    (fun i =>
      map (fun j => A i j) (putnam_2015_a6_fin_list n))
    (putnam_2015_a6_fin_list n).

Definition putnam_2015_a6_delete_nth
    {T : Type} (j : nat) (xs : list T) : list T :=
  firstn j xs ++ skipn (S j) xs.

Definition putnam_2015_a6_cofactor_sign (j : nat) : R :=
  if Nat.even j then 1 else -1.

Fixpoint putnam_2015_a6_real_sum (xs : list R) : R :=
  match xs with
  | [] => 0
  | x :: rest => x + putnam_2015_a6_real_sum rest
  end.

Fixpoint putnam_2015_a6_list_det
    (n : nat) (M : list (list R)) {struct n} : R :=
  match n with
  | O => 1
  | S k =>
      match M with
      | [] => 0
      | row :: rows =>
          putnam_2015_a6_real_sum
            (map
              (fun j : nat =>
                putnam_2015_a6_cofactor_sign j *
                nth j row 0 *
                putnam_2015_a6_list_det k
                  (map (putnam_2015_a6_delete_nth j) rows))
              (seq 0 (S k)))
      end
  end.

Definition putnam_2015_a6_determinant
    (n : nat) (A : putnam_2015_a6_matrix n) : R :=
  putnam_2015_a6_list_det n (putnam_2015_a6_rows n A).

Fixpoint putnam_2015_a6_poly_add
    (p q : list R) : list R :=
  match p, q with
  | [], _ => q
  | _, [] => p
  | a :: p', b :: q' =>
      (a + b) :: putnam_2015_a6_poly_add p' q'
  end.

Fixpoint putnam_2015_a6_poly_scale
    (a : R) (p : list R) : list R :=
  match p with
  | [] => []
  | b :: rest => (a * b) :: putnam_2015_a6_poly_scale a rest
  end.

Fixpoint putnam_2015_a6_poly_mul
    (p q : list R) : list R :=
  match p with
  | [] => []
  | a :: rest =>
      putnam_2015_a6_poly_add
        (putnam_2015_a6_poly_scale a q)
        (0 :: putnam_2015_a6_poly_mul rest q)
  end.

Fixpoint putnam_2015_a6_poly_sum
    (ps : list (list R)) : list R :=
  match ps with
  | [] => []
  | p :: rest =>
      putnam_2015_a6_poly_add p (putnam_2015_a6_poly_sum rest)
  end.

Fixpoint putnam_2015_a6_poly_det
    (n : nat) (M : list (list (list R))) {struct n} : list R :=
  match n with
  | O => [1]
  | S k =>
      match M with
      | [] => []
      | row :: rows =>
          putnam_2015_a6_poly_sum
            (map
              (fun j : nat =>
                putnam_2015_a6_poly_scale
                  (putnam_2015_a6_cofactor_sign j)
                  (putnam_2015_a6_poly_mul
                    (nth j row [])
                    (putnam_2015_a6_poly_det k
                      (map (putnam_2015_a6_delete_nth j) rows))))
              (seq 0 (S k)))
      end
  end.

Definition putnam_2015_a6_charpoly_entry {n : nat}
    (A : putnam_2015_a6_matrix n) (i j : Fin.t n) : list R :=
  if Fin.eq_dec i j
  then [- A i j; 1]
  else [- A i j].

Definition putnam_2015_a6_charpoly
    (n : nat) (A : putnam_2015_a6_matrix n) : list R :=
  putnam_2015_a6_poly_det n
    (putnam_2015_a6_rows n (putnam_2015_a6_charpoly_entry A)).

Definition putnam_2015_a6_charpoly_eq
    (n : nat) (A B : putnam_2015_a6_matrix n) : Prop :=
  forall k : nat,
    nth k (putnam_2015_a6_charpoly n A) 0 =
    nth k (putnam_2015_a6_charpoly n B) 0.

Theorem putnam_2015_a6
    (n : nat)
    (A B M : putnam_2015_a6_matrix n)
    (npos : (0 < n)%nat)
    (hmul :
      putnam_2015_a6_matrix_eq
        (putnam_2015_a6_matrix_mul A M)
        (putnam_2015_a6_matrix_mul M B))
    (hpoly : putnam_2015_a6_charpoly_eq n A B) :
  forall X : putnam_2015_a6_matrix n,
    putnam_2015_a6_determinant n
      (putnam_2015_a6_matrix_sub A
        (putnam_2015_a6_matrix_mul M X)) =
    putnam_2015_a6_determinant n
      (putnam_2015_a6_matrix_sub B
        (putnam_2015_a6_matrix_mul X M)).
Admitted.
