content:
;; Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2015_a6:
;; determinant equality for intertwined real square matrices with equal
;; characteristic polynomials. This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))

;; The real scalar domain is presented as an arbitrary real closed ordered
;; field.  Real closed fields have the same first-order theory as the reals,
;; and the matrix assertion below is first-order for each positive dimension.
;; Thus this presentation is bidirectionally equivalent to the source
;; statement over R.
;;
;; An n by n matrix is represented exactly by a row-major list of length n^2
;; over the field carrier. The determinant is the full Leibniz sum. Equality
;; of characteristic polynomials is encoded by equality of det(tI-A) and
;; det(tI-B) for every field element t; over an infinite real closed field
;; this is equivalent to coefficient equality. FN-EQUAL also keeps the source
;; universal quantifier over every n by n matrix X internal to the predicate.

(defun putnam-2015-a6-quoted (object)
  (list 'quote object))

(defun putnam-2015-a6-apply1-term (function argument)
  (list
   'apply$
   (putnam-2015-a6-quoted function)
   (list 'cons argument nil)))

(defun putnam-2015-a6-apply2-term (function left right)
  (list
   'apply$
   (putnam-2015-a6-quoted function)
   (list 'cons left (list 'cons right nil))))

(defun putnam-2015-a6-and-term (terms)
  (if (endp terms)
      (putnam-2015-a6-quoted t)
    (list
     'if
     (car terms)
     (putnam-2015-a6-and-term (cdr terms))
     (putnam-2015-a6-quoted nil))))

(defun putnam-2015-a6-or-term (terms)
  (if (endp terms)
      (putnam-2015-a6-quoted nil)
    (list
     'if
     (car terms)
     (putnam-2015-a6-quoted t)
     (putnam-2015-a6-or-term (cdr terms)))))

(defun putnam-2015-a6-not-term (term)
  (list
   'if
   term
   (putnam-2015-a6-quoted nil)
   (putnam-2015-a6-quoted t)))

(defun putnam-2015-a6-implies-term (antecedent consequent)
  (list
   'if
   antecedent
   consequent
   (putnam-2015-a6-quoted t)))

(defun putnam-2015-a6-true-function (formals)
  (list
   'lambda
   formals
   (putnam-2015-a6-quoted t)))

(defun putnam-2015-a6-carrier-term (carrier element)
  (putnam-2015-a6-apply1-term carrier element))

(defun putnam-2015-a6-operation-term (operation left right)
  (putnam-2015-a6-apply2-term operation left right))

(defun putnam-2015-a6-all-coefficients-function (carrier)
  (list
   'lambda
   '(loop$-gvars loop$-ivars)
   (putnam-2015-a6-carrier-term
    carrier 'loop$-ivars)))

(defun putnam-2015-a6-all-coefficients-term
    (carrier coefficients)
  (list
   'always$+
   (putnam-2015-a6-quoted
    (putnam-2015-a6-all-coefficients-function
     carrier))
   (putnam-2015-a6-quoted nil)
   coefficients))

(defun putnam-2015-a6-polynomial-term
    (carrier zero coefficients)
  (putnam-2015-a6-and-term
   (list
    (list 'true-listp coefficients)
    (list 'consp coefficients)
    (putnam-2015-a6-all-coefficients-term
     carrier coefficients)
    (putnam-2015-a6-or-term
     (list
      (list 'equal
            (list 'len coefficients)
            (putnam-2015-a6-quoted 1))
      (putnam-2015-a6-not-term
       (list 'equal
             (list 'car (list 'last coefficients))
             (putnam-2015-a6-quoted zero))))))))

(defun putnam-2015-a6-field-laws-function
    (carrier zero one add mul neg inv)
  (let* ((x 'x)
         (y 'y)
         (z 'z)
         (qzero (putnam-2015-a6-quoted zero))
         (qone (putnam-2015-a6-quoted one))
         (add-xy
          (putnam-2015-a6-operation-term add x y))
         (add-yz
          (putnam-2015-a6-operation-term add y z))
         (mul-xy
          (putnam-2015-a6-operation-term mul x y))
         (mul-yz
          (putnam-2015-a6-operation-term mul y z))
         (neg-x
          (putnam-2015-a6-apply1-term neg x))
         (inv-x
          (putnam-2015-a6-apply1-term inv x))
         (domain
          (putnam-2015-a6-and-term
           (list
            (putnam-2015-a6-carrier-term carrier x)
            (putnam-2015-a6-carrier-term carrier y)
            (putnam-2015-a6-carrier-term carrier z))))
         (laws
          (putnam-2015-a6-and-term
           (list
            (putnam-2015-a6-carrier-term carrier add-xy)
            (putnam-2015-a6-carrier-term carrier mul-xy)
            (putnam-2015-a6-carrier-term carrier neg-x)
            (putnam-2015-a6-carrier-term carrier inv-x)
            (list
             'equal
             (putnam-2015-a6-operation-term add add-xy z)
             (putnam-2015-a6-operation-term add x add-yz))
            (list
             'equal
             (putnam-2015-a6-operation-term mul mul-xy z)
             (putnam-2015-a6-operation-term mul x mul-yz))
            (list
             'equal
             add-xy
             (putnam-2015-a6-operation-term add y x))
            (list

-- Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2015_a6
-- (putnambench__agda__putnam_2015_a6): determinant equality for intertwined
-- real matrices with the same characteristic polynomial. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module Main where

open import Agda.Builtin.Bool using (Bool; true; false)
open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.List using (List; []; _∷_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; _*_)

infix 4 _!=_
infixr 3 _and_
infixr 2 _or_

data Bottom : Set where

Not : Set -> Set
Not A =
  A -> Bottom

_!=_ : {A : Set} -> A -> A -> Set
x != y =
  Not (x == y)

record _and_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data _or_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  left  : A -> A or B
  right : B -> A or B

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

data Positive : Nat -> Set where
  positive : {n : Nat} -> Positive (suc n)

data Fin : Nat -> Set where
  fzero : {n : Nat} -> Fin (suc n)
  fsuc  : {n : Nat} -> Fin n -> Fin (suc n)

record CompleteOrderedRealField (R : Set) : Set1 where
  field
    zeroR oneR : R
    add multiply : R -> R -> R
    negate inverse : R -> R
    lessOrEqual : R -> R -> Set
    fromNat : Nat -> R

    one-not-zero :
      oneR != zeroR

    add-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> add x y == add y x
    add-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      add (add x y) z == add x (add y z)
    add-zero :
      (x : R) -> add x zeroR == x
    add-inverse :
      (x : R) -> add x (negate x) == zeroR

    multiply-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> multiply x y == multiply y x
    multiply-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply (multiply x y) z ==
      multiply x (multiply y z)
    multiply-one :
      (x : R) -> multiply x oneR == x
    multiply-zero :
      (x : R) -> multiply x zeroR == zeroR
    distribute :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply x (add y z) ==
      add (multiply x y) (multiply x z)
    inverse-zero :
      inverse zeroR == zeroR
    multiply-inverse :
      (x : R) ->
      x != zeroR ->
      multiply x (inverse x) == oneR

    order-reflexive :
      (x : R) -> lessOrEqual x x
    order-transitive :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y z ->
      lessOrEqual x z
    order-antisymmetric :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y x ->
      x == y
    order-total :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y or lessOrEqual y x
    add-order :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual (add z x) (add z y)
    multiply-nonnegative :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR x ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR y ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR (multiply x y)
    zero-less-than-one :
      lessOrEqual zeroR oneR and zeroR != oneR

    fromNat-zero :
      fromNat zero == zeroR
    fromNat-successor :
      (n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (suc n) == add (fromNat n) oneR
    fromNat-addition :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m + n) == add (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-multiplication :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m * n) == multiply (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-injective :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat m == fromNat n ->
      m == n

    archimedean :
      (x : R) ->
      Exists Nat
        (\ n -> lessOrEqual x (fromNat n))
    least-upper-bound :
      (P : R -> Set) ->
      Exists R P ->
      Exists R
        (\ upper ->
          (x : R) ->
          P x ->
          lessOrEqual x upper) ->
      Exists R
        (\ supremum ->
          ((x : R) ->
            P x ->
            lessOrEqual x supremum)
          and
          ((upper : R) ->
            ((x : R) ->
              P x ->
              lessOrEqual x upper) ->
            lessOrEqual supremum upper))

open CompleteOrderedRealField

record RingOperations (R : Set) : Set where
  field
    zeroElement oneElement : R
    addElements multiplyElements : R -> R -> R
    negateElement : R -> R

realRingOperations :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  RingOperations R
realRingOperations reals =
  record
    { zeroElement = zeroR reals
    ; oneElement = oneR reals
    ; addElements = add reals
    ; multiplyElements = multiply reals
    ; negateElement = negate reals
    }

Polynomial : Set -> Set
Polynomial R =
  List R

polynomialAdd :
  {R : Set} ->
  RingOperations R ->
  Polynomial R ->
  Polynomial R ->
  Polynomial R
polynomialAdd operations [] q =
  q
polynomialAdd operations p [] =
  p
polynomialAdd operations (x ∷ p) (y ∷ q) =
  RingOperations.addElements operations x y ∷
  polynomialAdd operations p q

polynomialNegate :
  {R : Set} ->
  RingOperations R ->
  Polynomial R ->
  Polynomial R
polynomialNegate operations [] =
  []
polynomialNegate operations (x ∷ p) =
  RingOperations.negateElement operations x ∷
  polynomialNegate operations p

polynomialScale :
  {R : Set} ->
  RingOperations R ->
  R ->
  Polynomial R ->
  Polynomial R
polynomialScale operations scalar [] =
  []
polynomialScale operations scalar (x ∷ p) =
  RingOperations.multiplyElements operations scalar x ∷
  polynomialScale operations scalar p

polynomialMultiply :
  {R : Set} ->
  RingOperations R ->
  Polynomial R ->
  Polynomial R ->
  Polynomial R
polynomialMultiply operations [] q =
  []
polynomialMultiply operations (x ∷ p) q =
  polynomialAdd operations
    (polynomialScale operations x q)
    (RingOperations.zeroElement operations ∷
      polynomialMultiply operations p q)

polynomialOperations :
  {R : Set} ->
  RingOperations R ->
  RingOperations (Polynomial R)
polynomialOperations operations =
  record
    { zeroElement = []
    ; oneElement = RingOperations.oneElement operations ∷ []
    ; addElements = polynomialAdd operations
    ; multiplyElements = polynomialMultiply operations
    ; negateElement = polynomialNegate operations
    }

constantPolynomial :
  {R : Set} ->
  RingOperations R ->
  R ->
  Polynomial R
constantPolynomial operations x =
  x ∷ []

variablePolynomial :
  {R : Set} ->
  RingOperations R ->
  Polynomial R
variablePolynomial operations =
  RingOperations.zeroElement operations ∷
  RingOperations.oneElement operations ∷
  []

Matrix :
  Set ->
  Nat ->
  Set
Matrix R n =
  Fin n -> Fin n -> R

MatrixEqual :
  {R : Set} {n : Nat} ->
  Matrix R n ->
  Matrix R n ->
  Set
MatrixEqual {n = n} A B =
  (i j : Fin n) ->
  A i j == B i j

finEqual :
  {n : Nat} ->
  Fin n ->
  Fin n ->
  Bool
finEqual fzero fzero =
  true
finEqual fzero (fsuc j) =
  false
finEqual (fsuc i) fzero =
  false
finEqual (fsuc i) (fsuc j) =
  finEqual i j

select :
  {A : Set} ->
  Bool ->
  A ->
  A ->
  A
select true yes no =
  yes
select false yes no =
  no

sumFin :
  {R : Set} ->
  RingOperations R ->
  {n : Nat} ->
  (Fin n -> R) ->
  R
sumFin operations {zero} term =
  RingOperations.zeroElement operations
sumFin operations {suc n} term =
  RingOperations.addElements operations
    (term fzero)
    (sumFin operations (\ i -> term (fsuc i)))

matrixAdd :
  {R : Set} ->
  RingOperations R ->
  {n : Nat} ->
  Matrix R n ->
  Matrix R n ->
  Matrix R n
matrixAdd operations A B i j =
  RingOperations.addElements operations (A i j) (B i j)

matrixNegate :
  {R : Set} ->
  RingOperations R ->
  {n : Nat} ->
  Matrix R n ->
  Matrix R n
matrixNegate operations A i j =
  RingOperations.negateElement operations (A i j)

matrixSubtract :
  {R : Set} ->
  RingOperations R ->
  {n : Nat} ->
  Matrix R n ->
  Matrix R n ->
  Matrix R n
matrixSubtract operations A B =
  matrixAdd operations A (matrixNegate operations B)

matrixMultiply :
  {R : Set} ->
  RingOperations R ->
  {n : Nat} ->
  Matrix R n ->
  Matrix R n ->
  Matrix R n
matrixMultiply operations A B i j =
  sumFin operations
    (\ k ->
      RingOperations.multiplyElements operations
        (A i k)
        (B k j))

skip :
  {n : Nat} ->
  Fin (suc n) ->
  Fin n ->
  Fin (suc n)
skip {zero} removed ()
skip {suc n} fzero i =
  fsuc i
skip {suc n} (fsuc removed) fzero =
  fzero
skip {suc n} (fsuc removed) (fsuc i) =
  fsuc (skip removed i)

firstRowMinor :
  {R : Set} {n : Nat} ->
  Matrix R (suc n) ->
  Fin (suc n) ->
  Matrix R n
firstRowMinor A removedColumn i j =
  A (fsuc i) (skip removedColumn j)

alternatingSign :
  {R : Set} ->
  RingOperations R ->
  {n : Nat} ->
  Fin n ->
  R
alternatingSign operations fzero =
  RingOperations.oneElement operations
alternatingSign operations (fsuc i) =
  RingOperations.negateElement operations
    (alternatingSign operations i)

determinant :
  {R : Set} ->
  RingOperations R ->
  {n : Nat} ->
  Matrix R n ->
  R
determinant operations {zero} A =
  RingOperations.oneElement operations
determinant operations {suc n} A =
  sumFin operations
    (\ column ->
      RingOperations.multiplyElements operations
        (alternatingSign operations column)
        (RingOperations.multiplyElements operations
          (A fzero column)
          (determinant operations
            (firstRowMinor A column))))

characteristicMatrix :
  {R : Set} ->
  RingOperations R ->
  {n : Nat} ->
  Matrix R n ->
  Matrix (Polynomial R) n
characteristicMatrix operations A i j =
  select (finEqual i j)
    (polynomialAdd operations
      (variablePolynomial operations)
      (polynomialNegate operations
        (constantPolynomial operations (A i j))))
    (polynomialNegate operations
      (constantPolynomial operations (A i j)))

characteristicPolynomial :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  {n : Nat} ->
  Matrix R n ->
  Polynomial R
characteristicPolynomial reals A =
  determinant
    (polynomialOperations (realRingOperations reals))
    (characteristicMatrix (realRingOperations reals) A)

putnam-2015-a6 : Set1
putnam-2015-a6 =
  (R : Set) ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) ->
  (n : Nat) ->
  Positive n ->
  (A B M : Matrix R n) ->
  MatrixEqual
    (matrixMultiply (realRingOperations reals) A M)
    (matrixMultiply (realRingOperations reals) M B) ->
  characteristicPolynomial reals A ==
    characteristicPolynomial reals B ->
  (X : Matrix R n) ->
  determinant (realRingOperations reals)
    (matrixSubtract (realRingOperations reals)
      A
      (matrixMultiply (realRingOperations reals) M X)) ==
  determinant (realRingOperations reals)
    (matrixSubtract (realRingOperations reals)
      B
      (matrixMultiply (realRingOperations reals) X M))

title: putnam_2015_a6
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2015_a6:
  positive-dimensional real square matrices satisfying A M = M B and having
  the same characteristic polynomial satisfy
  det(A - M X) = det(B - X M) for every real square matrix X. This file
  contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open arithmeticTheory pred_setTheory permutesTheory realTheory;

val putnam_2015_a6 =
  ``let matrix_eq =
      \n : num. \A B : num -> num -> real.
        !i j : num.
          i < n /\ j < n
          ==>
          A i j = B i j
    in
    let matrix_mul =
      \n : num. \A B : num -> num -> real. \i j : num.
        ITSET
          (\k : num. \sum : real. A i k * B k j + sum)
          (count n)
          0
    in
    let matrix_sub =
      \A B : num -> num -> real. \i j : num. A i j - B i j
    in
    let determinant =
      \n : num. \A : num -> num -> real.
        ITSET
          (\p : num -> num. \sum : real.
             (if evenperm p then
                ITSET
                  (\i : num. \acc : real. A i (p i) * acc)
                  (count n)
                  1
              else
                -(ITSET
                    (\i : num. \acc : real. A i (p i) * acc)
                    (count n)
                    1)) +
             sum)
          {p : num -> num | p permutes count n}
          0
    in
    let charpoly_eval =
      \n : num. \A : num -> num -> real. \t : real.
        determinant n
          (\i j : num. (if i = j then t else 0) - A i j)
    in
      !n : num. !A B M : num -> num -> real.
        0 < n /\
        matrix_eq n (matrix_mul n A M) (matrix_mul n M B) /\
        charpoly_eval n A = charpoly_eval n B
        ==>
        !X : num -> num -> real.
          determinant n (matrix_sub A (matrix_mul n M X)) =
          determinant n (matrix_sub B (matrix_mul n X M))``;

title: putnam_2015_a6
content:
$(
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact
  putnam_2015_a6: for positive dimension, intertwined real square matrices
  with the same characteristic polynomial satisfy the stated determinant
  identity for every real square matrix. This file contains no proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  For n in NN, 0 ..^ n is the canonical n-element index set, and
  Base ` ((0 ..^ n) Mat RRfld) is the full set of real n-by-n matrices.
  The ring operations .r and -g are ordinary matrix multiplication and
  subtraction. The function (0 ..^ n) CharPlyMat RRfld is SetMM's
  characteristic polynomial det(tI-A), and (0 ..^ n) maDet RRfld is the
  determinant.

  Thus the antecedent is exactly AM = MB together with equality of the
  characteristic polynomials of A and B, and the conclusion retains the
  universal quantifier over every real n-by-n matrix X. The final declaration
  is the single unproved $a corpus statement.
$)

${
  $d A B M X n $.

  putnambench-putnam-2015-a6 $a |- A. n e. NN
    A. A e. ( Base ` ( ( 0 ..^ n ) Mat RRfld ) )
      A. B e. ( Base ` ( ( 0 ..^ n ) Mat RRfld ) )
        A. M e. ( Base ` ( ( 0 ..^ n ) Mat RRfld ) )
          (
            (
              (
                A
                ( .r ` ( ( 0 ..^ n ) Mat RRfld ) )
                M
              )
              =
              (
                M
                ( .r ` ( ( 0 ..^ n ) Mat RRfld ) )
                B
              )
              /\
              (
                ( ( ( 0 ..^ n ) CharPlyMat RRfld ) ` A )
                =
                ( ( ( 0 ..^ n ) CharPlyMat RRfld ) ` B )
              )
            )
            ->
            A. X e. ( Base ` ( ( 0 ..^ n ) Mat RRfld ) )
              (
                (
                  ( ( 0 ..^ n ) maDet RRfld )
                  `
                  (
                    A
                    ( -g ` ( ( 0 ..^ n ) Mat RRfld ) )
                    (
                      M
                      ( .r ` ( ( 0 ..^ n ) Mat RRfld ) )
                      X
                    )
                  )
                )
                =
                (
                  ( ( 0 ..^ n ) maDet RRfld )
                  `
                  (
                    B
                    ( -g ` ( ( 0 ..^ n ) Mat RRfld ) )
                    (
                      X
                      ( .r ` ( ( 0 ..^ n ) Mat RRfld ) )
                      M
                    )
                  )
                )
              )
          )
  $.
$}

title: putnam_2015_a6
content:
% Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2015_a6:
% positive-dimensional real square matrices satisfying AM = MB and having
% equal characteristic polynomials obey the stated determinant identity for
% every real square matrix X. This file contains no proof.

putnam_2015_a6: THEORY
BEGIN
  matrix: TYPE = [nat, nat -> real]

  bounded_real_sum(
      values: [nat -> real],
      count: nat): RECURSIVE real =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      bounded_real_sum(values, count - 1) + values(count - 1)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  matrix_multiply(A, B: matrix, n: nat): matrix =
    LAMBDA (row, column: nat):
      IF row < n AND column < n THEN
        bounded_real_sum(
          LAMBDA (inner: nat):
            A(row, inner) * B(inner, column),
          n)
      ELSE
        0
      ENDIF

  matrix_subtract(A, B: matrix, n: nat): matrix =
    LAMBDA (row, column: nat):
      IF row < n AND column < n THEN
        A(row, column) - B(row, column)
      ELSE
        0
      ENDIF

  scalar_identity(value: real, n: nat): matrix =
    LAMBDA (row, column: nat):
      IF row < n AND column < n AND row = column THEN
        value
      ELSE
        0
      ENDIF

  matrix_equal_on_carrier(A, B: matrix, n: nat): bool =
    FORALL (row, column: nat):
      (row < n AND column < n)
        IMPLIES A(row, column) = B(row, column)

  quotient_aux(
      numerator, denominator, fuel: nat): RECURSIVE nat =
    IF fuel = 0
        OR denominator = 0
        OR numerator < denominator THEN
      0
    ELSE
      1
        + quotient_aux(
            numerator - denominator,
            denominator,
            fuel - 1)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE fuel

  remainder_aux(
      numerator, denominator, fuel: nat): RECURSIVE nat =
    IF fuel = 0
        OR denominator = 0
        OR numerator < denominator THEN
      numerator
    ELSE
      remainder_aux(
        numerator - denominator,
        denominator,
        fuel - 1)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE fuel

  safe_ndiv(numerator, denominator: nat): nat =
    quotient_aux(
      numerator,
      denominator,
      numerator + 1)

  safe_mod(numerator, denominator: nat): nat =
    IF denominator = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      remainder_aux(
        numerator,
        denominator,
        numerator + 1)
    ENDIF

  function_code_count(n: nat): nat =
    IF n = 0 THEN 1 ELSE n ^ n ENDIF

  permutation_entry(code, row, n: nat): nat =
    IF n = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      safe_mod(safe_ndiv(code, n ^ row), n)
    ENDIF

  permutation_code(code, n: nat): bool =
    code < function_code_count(n)
      AND (FORALL (row_1, row_2: nat):
        (row_1 < n
          AND row_2 < n
          AND permutation_entry(code, row_1, n)
            = permutation_entry(code, row_2, n))
        IMPLIES row_1 = row_2)

  pair_row(pair, n: nat): nat =
    safe_ndiv(pair, n)

  pair_column(pair, n: nat): nat =
    safe_mod(pair, n)

  inversion_at(code, pair, n: nat): bool =
    pair_row(pair, n) < n
      AND pair_column(pair, n) < n
      AND pair_row(pair, n) < pair_column(pair, n)
      AND permutation_entry(code, pair_row(pair, n), n)
        > permutation_entry(code, pair_column(pair, n), n)

  count_true(
      property: [nat -> bool],
      count: nat): RECURSIVE nat =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      count_true(property, count - 1)
        + IF property(count - 1) THEN 1 ELSE 0 ENDIF
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  inversion_count(code, n: nat): nat =
    count_true(
      LAMBDA (pair: nat): inversion_at(code, pair, n),
      n * n)

  permutation_sign(code, n: nat): real =
    IF mod(inversion_count(code, n), 2) = 0 THEN
      1
    ELSE
      -1
    ENDIF

  permutation_product(
      A: matrix,
      code, n, count: nat): RECURSIVE real =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      1
    ELSE
      permutation_product(A, code, n, count - 1)
        * A(
            count - 1,
            permutation_entry(code, count - 1, n))
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  determinant_sum(
      A: matrix,
      n, limit: nat): RECURSIVE real =
    IF limit = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      LET code: nat = limit - 1 IN
        determinant_sum(A, n, limit - 1)
          + IF permutation_code(code, n) THEN
              permutation_sign(code, n)
                * permutation_product(A, code, n, n)
            ELSE
              0
            ENDIF
    ENDIF
  MEASURE limit

  determinant(A: matrix, n: nat): real =
    determinant_sum(A, n, function_code_count(n))

  characteristic_value(A: matrix, n: nat, value: real): real =
    determinant(
      matrix_subtract(scalar_identity(value, n), A, n),
      n)

  same_characteristic_polynomial(
      A, B: matrix,
      n: nat): bool =
    FORALL (value: real):
      characteristic_value(A, n, value)
        = characteristic_value(B, n, value)

  putnam_2015_a6: bool =
    FORALL (n: posnat), (A, B, M: matrix):
      (matrix_equal_on_carrier(
          matrix_multiply(A, M, n),
          matrix_multiply(M, B, n),
          n)
        AND same_characteristic_polynomial(A, B, n))
      IMPLIES
        (FORALL (X: matrix):
          determinant(
            matrix_subtract(
              A,
              matrix_multiply(M, X, n),
              n),
            n)
            =
          determinant(
            matrix_subtract(
              B,
              matrix_multiply(X, M, n),
              n),
            n))
END putnam_2015_a6

/--
Let $f$ be a three times differentiable function (defined on $\mathbb{R}$ and real-valued) such that $f$ has at least five distinct real zeros. Prove that $f+6f'+12f''+8f'''$ has at least two distinct real zeros.
-/
theorem putnam_2015_b1
(f : ℝ → ℝ)
(nzeros : (ℝ → ℝ) → ℕ → Prop)
(fdiff : ContDiff ℝ 2 f ∧ Differentiable ℝ (iteratedDeriv 2 f))
(hnzeros : ∀ f' : ℝ → ℝ, ∀ n : ℕ, nzeros f' n = ({x : ℝ | f' x = 0}.encard ≥ n))
(fzeros : nzeros f 5)
: nzeros (f + 6 * deriv f + 12 * iteratedDeriv 2 f + 8 * iteratedDeriv 3 f) 2 :=
sorry

title: putnam_2015_b1
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2015_b1:
;; a three-times differentiable real function with five distinct real zeros
;; makes f+6f'+12f''+8f''' have two distinct real zeros.
;; This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))

;; REAL-APPROX names arbitrary real arguments by regular rational Cauchy
;; approximations. JET-APPROX similarly names f, f', and f'' at orders 0, 1,
;; and 2. THIRD-APPROX names an internally quantified pointwise value of f'''.
;; DEFSTUB supplies only generic function symbols; every analytic property is
;; stated explicitly below by conservative DEFUN-SK predicates.

(defstub putnam-2015-b1-real-approx (name precision) t)
(defstub putnam-2015-b1-jet-approx (order point precision) t)
(defstub putnam-2015-b1-third-approx (name precision) t)

(defun putnam-2015-b1-positive-rational-p (value)
  (and
   (rationalp value)
   (< 0 value)))

(defun putnam-2015-b1-jet-order-p (order)
  (and
   (natp order)
   (<= order 2)))

;; Regular names represent arbitrary reals, not merely rational values.

(defun-sk putnam-2015-b1-real-name-p (name)
  (forall (epsilon eta)
    (implies
     (and
      (putnam-2015-b1-positive-rational-p epsilon)
      (putnam-2015-b1-positive-rational-p eta))
     (let ((left
            (putnam-2015-b1-real-approx name epsilon))
           (right
            (putnam-2015-b1-real-approx name eta)))
       (and
        (rationalp left)
        (rationalp right)
        (<= (abs (- left right))
            (+ epsilon eta)))))))

(defun-sk putnam-2015-b1-real-domain-p ()
  (forall (name)
    (putnam-2015-b1-real-name-p name)))

(defun-sk putnam-2015-b1-jet-value-name-p
    (order point)
  (forall (epsilon eta)
    (implies
     (and
      (putnam-2015-b1-positive-rational-p epsilon)
      (putnam-2015-b1-positive-rational-p eta))
     (let ((left
            (putnam-2015-b1-jet-approx
             order point epsilon))
           (right
            (putnam-2015-b1-jet-approx
             order point eta)))
       (and
        (rationalp left)
        (rationalp right)
        (<= (abs (- left right))
            (+ epsilon eta)))))))

(defun-sk putnam-2015-b1-third-name-p (name)
  (forall (epsilon eta)
    (implies
     (and
      (putnam-2015-b1-positive-rational-p epsilon)
      (putnam-2015-b1-positive-rational-p eta))
     (let ((left
            (putnam-2015-b1-third-approx name epsilon))
           (right
            (putnam-2015-b1-third-approx name eta)))
       (and
        (rationalp left)
        (rationalp right)
        (<= (abs (- left right))
            (+ epsilon eta)))))))

;; These predicates are exact equality and strict-distance comparisons of
;; represented real limits.

(defun-sk putnam-2015-b1-real-equal-p (left right)
  (forall (epsilon)
    (implies
     (putnam-2015-b1-positive-rational-p epsilon)
     (<=
      (abs
       (-
        (putnam-2015-b1-real-approx left epsilon)
        (putnam-2015-b1-real-approx right epsilon)))
      (* 2 epsilon)))))

(defun-sk putnam-2015-b1-real-distance-at-most-p
    (left right bound)
  (forall (epsilon eta)
    (implies
     (and
      (putnam-2015-b1-positive-rational-p epsilon)
      (putnam-2015-b1-positive-rational-p eta))
     (<=
      (abs
       (-
        (putnam-2015-b1-real-approx left epsilon)
        (putnam-2015-b1-real-approx right eta)))
      (+ bound epsilon eta)))))

(defun-sk putnam-2015-b1-real-distance-below-p
    (left right radius)
  (exists (margin)
    (and
     (rationalp margin)
     (<= 0 margin)
     (< margin radius)
     (putnam-2015-b1-real-distance-at-most-p
      left right margin))))

(defun-sk putnam-2015-b1-jet-value-equal-p
    (order left right)
  (forall (epsilon)
    (implies
     (putnam-2015-b1-positive-rational-p epsilon)
     (<=
      (abs
       (-
        (putnam-2015-b1-jet-approx
         order left epsilon)
        (putnam-2015-b1-jet-approx
         order right epsilon)))
      (* 2 epsilon)))))

(defun-sk putnam-2015-b1-jet-value-distance-at-most-p
    (order left right bound)
  (forall (epsilon eta)
    (implies
     (and
      (putnam-2015-b1-positive-rational-p epsilon)
      (putnam-2015-b1-positive-rational-p eta))
     (<=
      (abs
       (-
        (putnam-2015-b1-jet-approx
         order left epsilon)
        (putnam-2015-b1-jet-approx
         order right eta)))
      (+ bound epsilon eta)))))

(defun-sk putnam-2015-b1-jet-value-distance-below-p
    (order left right radius)
  (exists (margin)
    (and
     (rationalp margin)
     (<= 0 margin)
     (< margin radius)
     (putnam-2015-b1-jet-value-distance-at-most-p
      order left right margin))))

(defun-sk putnam-2015-b1-regular-jet-p ()
  (forall (order point)
    (implies
     (putnam-2015-b1-jet-order-p order)
     (putnam-2015-b1-jet-value-name-p
      order point))))

(defun-sk putnam-2015-b1-extensional-jet-p ()
  (forall (order left right)
    (implies
     (and
      (putnam-2015-b1-jet-order-p order)
      (putnam-2015-b1-real-equal-p left right))
     (putnam-2015-b1-jet-value-equal-p
      order left right))))

;; Continuity is stated for f, f', and f'' with the usual internal
;; forall-epsilon/exists-delta/forall-point scope.

(defun-sk putnam-2015-b1-continuity-neighborhood-p
    (order point epsilon delta)
  (forall (nearby)
    (implies
     (putnam-2015-b1-real-distance-below-p
      point nearby delta)
     (putnam-2015-b1-jet-value-distance-below-p
      order point nearby epsilon))))

(defun-sk putnam-2015-b1-continuity-radius-exists-p
    (order point epsilon)
  (exists (delta)
    (and
     (putnam-2015-b1-positive-rational-p delta)
     (putnam-2015-b1-continuity-neighborhood-p
      order point epsilon delta))))

(defun-sk putnam-2015-b1-continuous-jet-p ()
  (forall (order point epsilon)
    (implies
     (and
      (putnam-2015-b1-jet-order-p order)
      (putnam-2015-b1-positive-rational-p epsilon))
     (putnam-2015-b1-continuity-radius-exists-p
      order point epsilon))))

;; The following eventual-precision condition is exactly
;;
;; |f_k(y)-f_k(x)-f_{k+1}(x)(y-x)| <= epsilon |y-x|.
;;
;; Expressing it through convergent rational samples avoids restricting real
;; arguments or values to rationals.

(defun-sk putnam-2015-b1-jet-linearization-eventually-p
    (order point nearby epsilon tolerance precision-bound)
  (forall (precision)
    (implies
     (and
      (putnam-2015-b1-positive-rational-p precision)
      (<= precision precision-bound))
     (let* ((at-nearby
             (putnam-2015-b1-jet-approx
              order nearby precision))
            (at-point
             (putnam-2015-b1-jet-approx
              order point precision))
            (derivative
             (putnam-2015-b1-jet-approx
              (+ order 1) point precision))
            (nearby-value
             (putnam-2015-b1-real-approx
              nearby precision))
            (point-value
             (putnam-2015-b1-real-approx
              point precision))
            (increment
             (- nearby-value point-value))
            (residual
             (-
              (- at-nearby at-point)
              (* derivative increment))))
       (and
        (rationalp at-nearby)
        (rationalp at-point)
        (rationalp derivative)
        (rationalp nearby-value)
        (rationalp point-value)
        (<=
         (abs residual)
         (+ (* epsilon (abs increment))
            tolerance)))))))

(defun-sk putnam-2015-b1-jet-linearization-p
    (order point nearby epsilon tolerance)
  (exists (precision-bound)
    (and
     (putnam-2015-b1-positive-rational-p
      precision-bound)
     (<= precision-bound tolerance)
     (putnam-2015-b1-jet-linearization-eventually-p
      order point nearby epsilon tolerance
      precision-bound))))

(defun-sk putnam-2015-b1-jet-linearization-bound-p
    (order point nearby epsilon)
  (forall (tolerance)
    (implies
     (putnam-2015-b1-positive-rational-p tolerance)
     (putnam-2015-b1-jet-linearization-p
      order point nearby epsilon tolerance))))

(defun-sk putnam-2015-b1-derivative-neighborhood-p
    (order point epsilon delta)
  (forall (nearby)
    (implies
     (putnam-2015-b1-real-distance-below-p
      point nearby delta)
     (putnam-2015-b1-jet-linearization-bound-p
      order point nearby epsilon))))

(defun-sk putnam-2015-b1-derivative-radius-exists-p
    (order point epsilon)
  (exists (delta)
    (and
     (putnam-2015-b1-positive-rational-p delta)
     (putnam-2015-b1-derivative-neighborhood-p
      order point epsilon delta))))

(defun-sk putnam-2015-b1-successive-derivatives-p ()
  (forall (order point epsilon)
    (implies
     (and
      (natp order)
      (<= order 1)
      (putnam-2015-b1-positive-rational-p epsilon))
     (putnam-2015-b1-derivative-radius-exists-p
      order point epsilon))))

;; f''' is not assumed continuous. At each point it is an internal regular
;; real witness satisfying the derivative definition for f''.

(defun-sk putnam-2015-b1-third-linearization-eventually-p
    (point nearby third epsilon tolerance precision-bound)
  (forall (precision)
    (implies
     (and
      (putnam-2015-b1-positive-rational-p precision)
      (<= precision precision-bound))
     (let* ((at-nearby
             (putnam-2015-b1-jet-approx
              2 nearby precision))
            (at-point
             (putnam-2015-b1-jet-approx
              2 point precision))
            (derivative
             (putnam-2015-b1-third-approx
              third precision))
            (nearby-value
             (putnam-2015-b1-real-approx
              nearby precision))
            (point-value
             (putnam-2015-b1-real-approx
              point precision))
            (increment
             (- nearby-value point-value))
            (residual
             (-
              (- at-nearby at-point)
              (* derivative increment))))
       (and
        (rationalp at-nearby)
        (rationalp at-point)
        (rationalp derivative)
        (rationalp nearby-value)
        (rationalp point-value)
        (<=
         (abs residual)
         (+ (* epsilon (abs increment))
            tolerance)))))))

(defun-sk putnam-2015-b1-third-linearization-p
    (point nearby third epsilon tolerance)
  (exists (precision-bound)
    (and
     (putnam-2015-b1-positive-rational-p
      precision-bound)
     (<= precision-bound tolerance)
     (putnam-2015-b1-third-linearization-eventually-p
      point nearby third epsilon tolerance
      precision-bound))))

(defun-sk putnam-2015-b1-third-linearization-bound-p
    (point nearby third epsilon)
  (forall (tolerance)
    (implies
     (putnam-2015-b1-positive-rational-p tolerance)
     (putnam-2015-b1-third-linearization-p
      point nearby third epsilon tolerance))))

(defun-sk putnam-2015-b1-third-derivative-neighborhood-p
    (point third epsilon delta)
  (forall (nearby)
    (implies
     (putnam-2015-b1-real-distance-below-p
      point nearby delta)
     (putnam-2015-b1-third-linearization-bound-p
      point nearby third epsilon))))

(defun-sk putnam-2015-b1-third-derivative-radius-exists-p
    (point third epsilon)
  (exists (delta)
    (and
     (putnam-2015-b1-positive-rational-p delta)
     (putnam-2015-b1-third-derivative-neighborhood-p
      point third epsilon delta))))

(defun-sk putnam-2015-b1-third-derivative-at-p
    (point third)
  (forall (epsilon)
    (implies
     (putnam-2015-b1-positive-rational-p epsilon)
     (putnam-2015-b1-third-derivative-radius-exists-p
      point third epsilon))))

(defun-sk putnam-2015-b1-third-derivative-exists-p
    (point)
  (exists (third)
    (and
     (putnam-2015-b1-third-name-p third)
     (putnam-2015-b1-third-derivative-at-p
      point third))))

(defun-sk putnam-2015-b1-third-differentiable-p ()
  (forall (point)
    (putnam-2015-b1-third-derivative-exists-p
     point)))

(defun putnam-2015-b1-smooth-jet-p ()
  (and
   (putnam-2015-b1-real-domain-p)
   (putnam-2015-b1-regular-jet-p)
   (putnam-2015-b1-extensional-jet-p)
   (putnam-2015-b1-continuous-jet-p)
   (putnam-2015-b1-successive-derivatives-p)
   (putnam-2015-b1-third-differentiable-p)))

;; Exact zero predicates use the error modulus of the regular names.

(defun-sk putnam-2015-b1-f-zero-p (point)
  (forall (epsilon)
    (implies
     (putnam-2015-b1-positive-rational-p epsilon)
     (let ((value
            (putnam-2015-b1-jet-approx
             0 point epsilon)))
       (and
        (rationalp value)
        (<= (abs value) epsilon))))))

(defun-sk putnam-2015-b1-five-distinct-zeros-p ()
  (exists (x1 x2 x3 x4 x5)
    (and
     (putnam-2015-b1-f-zero-p x1)
     (putnam-2015-b1-f-zero-p x2)
     (putnam-2015-b1-f-zero-p x3)
     (putnam-2015-b1-f-zero-p x4)
     (putnam-2015-b1-f-zero-p x5)
     (not (putnam-2015-b1-real-equal-p x1 x2))
     (not (putnam-2015-b1-real-equal-p x1 x3))
     (not (putnam-2015-b1-real-equal-p x1 x4))
     (not (putnam-2015-b1-real-equal-p x1 x5))
     (not (putnam-2015-b1-real-equal-p x2 x3))
     (not (putnam-2015-b1-real-equal-p x2 x4))
     (not (putnam-2015-b1-real-equal-p x2 x5))
     (not (putnam-2015-b1-real-equal-p x3 x4))
     (not (putnam-2015-b1-real-equal-p x3 x5))
     (not (putnam-2015-b1-real-equal-p x4 x5)))))

(defun-sk putnam-2015-b1-g-zero-for-third-p
    (point third)
  (forall (epsilon)
    (implies
     (putnam-2015-b1-positive-rational-p epsilon)
     (let* ((precision (/ epsilon 128))
            (base
             (putnam-2015-b1-jet-approx
              0 point precision))
            (first
             (putnam-2015-b1-jet-approx
              1 point precision))
            (second
             (putnam-2015-b1-jet-approx
              2 point precision))
            (third-value
             (putnam-2015-b1-third-approx
              third precision))
            (sum
             (+ base
                (* 6 first)
                (* 12 second)
                (* 8 third-value))))
       (and
        (rationalp base)
        (rationalp first)
        (rationalp second)
        (rationalp third-value)
        (<= (abs sum) epsilon))))))

(defun-sk putnam-2015-b1-g-zero-p (point)
  (exists (third)
    (and
     (putnam-2015-b1-third-name-p third)
     (putnam-2015-b1-third-derivative-at-p
      point third)
     (putnam-2015-b1-g-zero-for-third-p
      point third))))

(defun-sk putnam-2015-b1-two-distinct-g-zeros-p ()
  (exists (x1 x2)
    (and
     (putnam-2015-b1-g-zero-p x1)
     (putnam-2015-b1-g-zero-p x2)
     (not (putnam-2015-b1-real-equal-p x1 x2)))))

(defun putnambench-putnam-2015-b1-statement ()
  (implies
   (and
    (putnam-2015-b1-smooth-jet-p)
    (putnam-2015-b1-five-distinct-zeros-p))
   (putnam-2015-b1-two-distinct-g-zeros-p)))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

title: putnam_2015_b1
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2015_b1
-- (putnambench__agda__putnam_2015_b1): a three-times differentiable real
-- function with five distinct zeros makes f + 6f' + 12f'' + 8f''' have two
-- distinct real zeros. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module Main where

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; _*_)

infix 4 _!=_
infixr 3 _and_
infixr 2 _or_

data Bottom : Set where

Not : Set -> Set
Not A =
  A -> Bottom

_!=_ : {A : Set} -> A -> A -> Set
x != y =
  Not (x == y)

record _and_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data _or_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  left  : A -> A or B
  right : B -> A or B

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

record CompleteOrderedRealField (R : Set) : Set1 where
  field
    zeroR oneR : R
    add multiply : R -> R -> R
    negate inverse : R -> R
    lessOrEqual : R -> R -> Set
    fromNat : Nat -> R

    one-not-zero :
      oneR != zeroR

    add-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> add x y == add y x
    add-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      add (add x y) z == add x (add y z)
    add-zero :
      (x : R) -> add x zeroR == x
    add-inverse :
      (x : R) -> add x (negate x) == zeroR

    multiply-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> multiply x y == multiply y x
    multiply-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply (multiply x y) z ==
      multiply x (multiply y z)
    multiply-one :
      (x : R) -> multiply x oneR == x
    multiply-zero :
      (x : R) -> multiply x zeroR == zeroR
    distribute :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply x (add y z) ==
      add (multiply x y) (multiply x z)
    inverse-zero :
      inverse zeroR == zeroR
    multiply-inverse :
      (x : R) ->
      x != zeroR ->
      multiply x (inverse x) == oneR

    order-reflexive :
      (x : R) -> lessOrEqual x x
    order-transitive :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y z ->
      lessOrEqual x z
    order-antisymmetric :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y x ->
      x == y
    order-total :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y or lessOrEqual y x
    add-order :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual (add z x) (add z y)
    multiply-nonnegative :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR x ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR y ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR (multiply x y)
    zero-less-than-one :
      lessOrEqual zeroR oneR and zeroR != oneR

    fromNat-zero :
      fromNat zero == zeroR
    fromNat-successor :
      (n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (suc n) == add (fromNat n) oneR
    fromNat-addition :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m + n) == add (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-multiplication :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m * n) == multiply (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-injective :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat m == fromNat n ->
      m == n

    archimedean :
      (x : R) ->
      Exists Nat
        (\ n ->
          lessOrEqual x (fromNat n))
    least-upper-bound :
      (P : R -> Set) ->
      Exists R P ->
      Exists R
        (\ upper ->
          (x : R) ->
          P x ->
          lessOrEqual x upper) ->
      Exists R
        (\ supremum ->
          ((x : R) ->
            P x ->
            lessOrEqual x supremum)
          and
          ((upper : R) ->
            ((x : R) ->
              P x ->
              lessOrEqual x upper) ->
            lessOrEqual supremum upper))

open CompleteOrderedRealField

subtract :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
subtract reals x y =
  add reals x (negate reals y)

divide :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
divide reals x y =
  multiply reals x (inverse reals y)

StrictLess :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
StrictLess reals x y =
  lessOrEqual reals x y and x != y

CloseTo :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
CloseTo reals center radius x =
  StrictLess reals
    (subtract reals center radius)
    x
  and
  StrictLess reals
    x
    (add reals center radius)

differenceQuotient :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (R -> R) ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
differenceQuotient reals function point x =
  divide reals
    (subtract reals (function x) (function point))
    (subtract reals x point)

DerivativeAt :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (R -> R) ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
DerivativeAt {R} reals function point derivative-value =
  (epsilon : R) ->
  StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) epsilon ->
  Exists R
    (\ delta ->
      StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) delta
      and
      ((x : R) ->
        CloseTo reals point delta x ->
        x != point ->
        CloseTo reals derivative-value epsilon
          (differenceQuotient reals function point x)))

record ThreeTimesDifferentiable
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R)
  (function : R -> R) :
  Set where

  field
    firstDerivative secondDerivative thirdDerivative : R -> R

    first-derivative-correct :
      (x : R) ->
      DerivativeAt reals function x (firstDerivative x)
    second-derivative-correct :
      (x : R) ->
      DerivativeAt reals firstDerivative x (secondDerivative x)
    third-derivative-correct :
      (x : R) ->
      DerivativeAt reals secondDerivative x (thirdDerivative x)

open ThreeTimesDifferentiable

record FiveDistinctZeros
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R)
  (function : R -> R) :
  Set where

  field
    zero1 zero2 zero3 zero4 zero5 : R

    zero1-is-zero : function zero1 == zeroR reals
    zero2-is-zero : function zero2 == zeroR reals
    zero3-is-zero : function zero3 == zeroR reals
    zero4-is-zero : function zero4 == zeroR reals
    zero5-is-zero : function zero5 == zeroR reals

    zero1!=zero2 : zero1 != zero2
    zero1!=zero3 : zero1 != zero3
    zero1!=zero4 : zero1 != zero4
    zero1!=zero5 : zero1 != zero5
    zero2!=zero3 : zero2 != zero3
    zero2!=zero4 : zero2 != zero4
    zero2!=zero5 : zero2 != zero5
    zero3!=zero4 : zero3 != zero4
    zero3!=zero5 : zero3 != zero5
    zero4!=zero5 : zero4 != zero5

record TwoDistinctZeros
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R)
  (function : R -> R) :
  Set where

  field
    zero1 zero2 : R
    distinct : zero1 != zero2
    zero1-is-zero : function zero1 == zeroR reals
    zero2-is-zero : function zero2 == zeroR reals

linearCombination :
  {R : Set} ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) ->
  (function : R -> R) ->
  ThreeTimesDifferentiable reals function ->
  R ->
  R
linearCombination reals function derivatives x =
  add reals
    (function x)
    (add reals
      (multiply reals
        (fromNat reals 6)
        (firstDerivative derivatives x))
      (add reals
        (multiply reals
          (fromNat reals 12)
          (secondDerivative derivatives x))
        (multiply reals
          (fromNat reals 8)
          (thirdDerivative derivatives x))))

putnam-2015-b1 : Set1
putnam-2015-b1 =
  (R : Set) ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) ->
  (function : R -> R) ->
  (derivatives : ThreeTimesDifferentiable reals function) ->
  FiveDistinctZeros reals function ->
  TwoDistinctZeros reals
    (linearCombination reals function derivatives)

  a three-times differentiable real function with at least five distinct real

  f + 6 f' + 12 f'' + 8 f'''. This file contains no proof.

open arithmeticTheory pred_setTheory realTheory limTheory;

val putnam_2015_b1 =
  ``!f : real -> real.
      (!x : real. higher_differentiable 3 f x) /\
      (?z : num -> real.
         (!i : num.
            i < 5

            f (z i) = 0) /\
         (!i j : num.
            i < 5 /\ j < 5 /\ z i = z j
            ==>

      ?x y : real.
        x <> y /\
        f x + 6 * diffn 1 f x + 12 * diffn 2 f x +

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  RR ^m RR is the class of all total real-valued functions. Membership in
  ( ( C^n ` RR ) ` 2 ) expresses global continuous differentiability through
  order two, while requiring RR to be contained in the domain of the third
  entry of ( RR Dn F ) says that the second derivative is differentiable
  everywhere.

  SetMM's # function is the finite cardinality on finite sets and +oo on
  infinite sets. Thus the two cardinality inequalities say exactly that the
  corresponding zero sets have at least five and at least two distinct real
  elements, including when a zero set is infinite. The final declaration is

  declaration.

  putnambench-putnam-2015-b1 $a |-
    A. F e. ( RR ^m RR )
      (
        (
          (
            F e. ( ( C^n ` RR ) ` 2 )
            /\
            RR C_ dom ( ( RR Dn F ) ` 3 )
          )
          /\
          5
          <_
          (
            #
            `
            {
              x e. RR |
                ( F ` x ) = 0

        ->

        <_
        (

          `

title: putnam_2015_b1
content:
% Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2015_b1:
% a three-times-differentiable real function with at least five distinct real
% zeros makes f + 6*f' + 12*f'' + 8*f''' have at least two distinct real zeros.
% This file contains no proof.

putnam_2015_b1: THEORY
BEGIN
  real_function: TYPE = [real -> real]

  has_derivative_at(
      f: real_function,
      derivative, x: real): bool =
    FORALL (epsilon_value: posreal):
      EXISTS (delta: posreal):
        FORALL (h: real):
          (h /= 0 AND abs(h) < delta)
            IMPLIES
              abs(f(x + h) - f(x) - derivative * h)
                < epsilon_value * abs(h)

  derivative_chain(
      f, first_derivative, second_derivative,
      third_derivative: real_function): bool =
    FORALL (x: real):
      has_derivative_at(f, first_derivative(x), x)
        AND has_derivative_at(
          first_derivative, second_derivative(x), x)
        AND has_derivative_at(
          second_derivative, third_derivative(x), x)

  pairwise_distinct_five(
      x1, x2, x3, x4, x5: real): bool =
    x1 /= x2 AND x1 /= x3 AND x1 /= x4 AND x1 /= x5
      AND x2 /= x3 AND x2 /= x4 AND x2 /= x5
      AND x3 /= x4 AND x3 /= x5
      AND x4 /= x5

  has_at_least_five_distinct_zeros(f: real_function): bool =
    EXISTS (x1, x2, x3, x4, x5: real):
      pairwise_distinct_five(x1, x2, x3, x4, x5)
        AND f(x1) = 0
        AND f(x2) = 0
        AND f(x3) = 0
        AND f(x4) = 0
        AND f(x5) = 0

  has_at_least_two_distinct_zeros(f: real_function): bool =
    EXISTS (x1, x2: real):
      x1 /= x2
        AND f(x1) = 0
        AND f(x2) = 0

  linear_derivative_combination(
      f, first_derivative, second_derivative,
      third_derivative: real_function): real_function =
    LAMBDA (x: real):
      f(x)
        + 6 * first_derivative(x)
        + 12 * second_derivative(x)
        + 8 * third_derivative(x)

  putnam_2015_b1: bool =
    FORALL
        (f, first_derivative, second_derivative,
         third_derivative: real_function):
      (derivative_chain(
          f, first_derivative, second_derivative,
          third_derivative)
        AND has_at_least_five_distinct_zeros(f))
      IMPLIES
        has_at_least_two_distinct_zeros(
          linear_derivative_combination(
            f, first_derivative, second_derivative,
            third_derivative))
END putnam_2015_b1

import Mathlib

abbrev putnam_2015_b2_solution : Prop := sorry
-- True
/--
Given a list of the positive integers $1,2,3,4,\dots$, take the first three numbers $1,2,3$ and their sum $6$ and cross all four numbers off the list. Repeat with the three smallest remaining numbers $4,5,7$ and their sum $16$. Continue in this way, crossing off the three smallest remaining numbers and their sum, and consider the sequence of sums produced: $6,16,27,36,\dots$. Prove or disprove that there is some number in the sequence whose base $10$ representation ends with $2015$.
-/
theorem putnam_2015_b2
(sets : ℕ → Set ℕ)
(Smin3 : Set ℕ → (Fin 3 → ℕ))
(sums : ℕ → ℕ)
(hsets0 : sets 0 = Set.Ici 1)
(hmin3 : ∀ S : Set ℕ, S.encard ≥ 3 → ((Smin3 S) 0 = sInf S ∧ (Smin3 S) 1 = sInf (S \ {(Smin3 S) 0}) ∧ (Smin3 S) 2 = sInf (S \ {(Smin3 S) 0, (Smin3 S) 1})))
(hsums : ∀ n : ℕ, sums n = (Smin3 (sets n)) 0 + (Smin3 (sets n)) 1 + (Smin3 (sets n)) 2)
(hsetsn : ∀ n : ℕ, sets (n + 1) = sets n \ {(Smin3 (sets n)) 0, (Smin3 (sets n)) 1, (Smin3 (sets n)) 2, sums n})
: (∃ n : ℕ, List.IsPrefix [5, 1, 0, 2] (Nat.digits 10 (sums n))) ↔ putnam_2015_b2_solution :=
sorry

(* Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2015_b2:
   the iterative deletion of the three least positive integers remaining and
   their sum eventually produces a sum ending in 2015; this file contains no
   proof. *)

From Stdlib Require Import Arith.PeanoNat.

Definition putnam_2015_b2_set : Type := nat -> Prop.

Record putnam_2015_b2_triple : Type := {
  putnam_2015_b2_first : nat;
  putnam_2015_b2_second : nat;
  putnam_2015_b2_third : nat
}.

Definition putnam_2015_b2_has_at_least_three
    (S : putnam_2015_b2_set) : Prop :=
  exists a b c : nat,
    S a /\
    S b /\
    S c /\
    a <> b /\
    a <> c /\
    b <> c.

Definition putnam_2015_b2_is_minimum
    (S : putnam_2015_b2_set) (m : nat) : Prop :=
  S m /\ forall x : nat, S x -> (m <= x)%nat.

Definition putnam_2015_b2_remove_one
    (S : putnam_2015_b2_set) (a : nat) : putnam_2015_b2_set :=
  fun x : nat => S x /\ x <> a.

Definition putnam_2015_b2_remove_two
    (S : putnam_2015_b2_set) (a b : nat) : putnam_2015_b2_set :=
  fun x : nat => S x /\ x <> a /\ x <> b.

Definition putnam_2015_b2_remove_four
    (S : putnam_2015_b2_set) (a b c d : nat) :
    putnam_2015_b2_set :=
  fun x : nat =>
    S x /\ x <> a /\ x <> b /\ x <> c /\ x <> d.

Definition putnam_2015_b2_solution : Prop := True.

Theorem putnam_2015_b2
    (sets : nat -> putnam_2015_b2_set)
    (Smin3 : putnam_2015_b2_set -> putnam_2015_b2_triple)
    (sums : nat -> nat)
    (hsets0 :
      forall x : nat, sets 0 x <-> (1 <= x)%nat)
    (hmin3 :
      forall S : putnam_2015_b2_set,
        putnam_2015_b2_has_at_least_three S ->
        putnam_2015_b2_is_minimum
          S
          (putnam_2015_b2_first (Smin3 S)) /\
        putnam_2015_b2_is_minimum
          (putnam_2015_b2_remove_one
            S
            (putnam_2015_b2_first (Smin3 S)))
          (putnam_2015_b2_second (Smin3 S)) /\
        putnam_2015_b2_is_minimum
          (putnam_2015_b2_remove_two
            S
            (putnam_2015_b2_first (Smin3 S))
            (putnam_2015_b2_second (Smin3 S)))
          (putnam_2015_b2_third (Smin3 S)))
    (hsums :
      forall n : nat,
        sums n =
        (putnam_2015_b2_first (Smin3 (sets n)) +
         putnam_2015_b2_second (Smin3 (sets n)) +
         putnam_2015_b2_third (Smin3 (sets n)))%nat)
    (hsetsn :
      forall n x : nat,
        sets (n + 1)%nat x <->
        putnam_2015_b2_remove_four
          (sets n)
          (putnam_2015_b2_first (Smin3 (sets n)))
          (putnam_2015_b2_second (Smin3 (sets n)))
          (putnam_2015_b2_third (Smin3 (sets n)))
          (sums n)
          x) :
  (exists n : nat, Nat.modulo (sums n) 10000 = 2015%nat) <->
  putnam_2015_b2_solution.
Admitted.

begin

definition putnam_2015_b2_solution :: bool where "putnam_2015_b2_solution \<equiv> undefined"

theorem putnam_2015_b2:
  fixes sets :: "nat \<Rightarrow> nat set"
  and Smin3 :: "nat set \<Rightarrow> nat^3"

  and hmin3: "\<forall> S :: nat set. (infinite S \<or> card S \<ge> 3) \<longrightarrow> (Smin3 S)$1 = (LEAST x. x \<in> S) \<and> (Smin3 S)$2 = (LEAST x. x \<in> S - {(Smin3 S)$1}) \<and> (Smin3 S)$3 = (LEAST x. x \<in> S - {(Smin3 S)$1, (Smin3 S)$2})"

  and hsetsn: "\<forall> n :: nat. sets (n + 1) = sets n - {(Smin3 (sets n))$1, (Smin3 (sets n))$2, (Smin3 (sets n))$3, sum n}"

(*
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2015_b2:
  the iterative process deleting the three smallest positive integers still
  present and their sum produces a sum ending in the decimal digits 2015.
  This file contains no proof.
*)

let statement =
  `!sets:num->num->bool.
   !min1 min2 min3:(num->bool)->num.
   !sums:num->num.
     sets 0 = {k:num | 1 <= k} /\
     (!S:num->bool.
        (?a b c:num.
           a IN S /\
           b IN S /\
           c IN S /\
           ~(a = b) /\
           ~(a = c) /\
           ~(b = c))
        ==>
        min1 S IN S /\
        (!x:num. x IN S ==> min1 S <= x) /\
        min2 S IN (S DELETE min1 S) /\
        (!x:num. x IN (S DELETE min1 S) ==> min2 S <= x) /\
        min3 S IN ((S DELETE min1 S) DELETE min2 S) /\
        (!x:num.
           x IN ((S DELETE min1 S) DELETE min2 S)
           ==> min3 S <= x)) /\
     (!n:num. sums n = min1 (sets n) + min2 (sets n) + min3 (sets n)) /\
     (!n:num.
        sets (n + 1) =
        ((((sets n DELETE min1 (sets n)) DELETE min2 (sets n))
           DELETE min3 (sets n))
          DELETE sums n))
     ==>
     ((?n:num. sums n MOD 10000 = 2015) <=> T)`;;

title: putnam_2015_b2
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2015_b2:
;; existence of a sum ending in 2015 in the sequence formed by repeatedly
;; crossing off the three least remaining positive integers and their sum.
;; This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))

;; REMOVED is the finite set of positive integers crossed off before a round,
;; represented extensionally by membership in a list.  A list of length k
;; cannot contain every integer from 1 through k+1, so the bounded sequential
;; search below returns the least positive integer not in REMOVED.  The bound
;; is derived from the current state rather than imposing any bound on the
;; number of rounds or on the values in the sequence.

(defun putnam-2015-b2-first-available-aux
    (candidate fuel removed)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix fuel)))
  (if (zp fuel)
      candidate
    (if (member-equal candidate removed)
        (putnam-2015-b2-first-available-aux
         (+ candidate 1)
         (- fuel 1)
         removed)
      candidate)))

(defun putnam-2015-b2-first-available (removed)
  (putnam-2015-b2-first-available-aux
   1
   (+ (len removed) 1)
   removed))

;; A round selects the three successive minima of the remaining positive
;; integers and records their sum.

(defun putnam-2015-b2-round-values (removed)
  (let* ((first
          (putnam-2015-b2-first-available removed))
         (second
          (putnam-2015-b2-first-available
           (cons first removed)))
         (third
          (putnam-2015-b2-first-available
           (cons second (cons first removed))))
         (sum (+ first second third)))
    (list first second third sum)))

(defun putnam-2015-b2-next-state (removed)
  (let ((round
         (putnam-2015-b2-round-values removed)))
    (cons
     (nth 3 round)
     (cons
      (nth 2 round)
      (cons
       (nth 1 round)
       (cons (nth 0 round) removed))))))

;; STATE n is exactly the finite complement, within the positive integers, of
;; the source set SETS n.  Thus the recursion is definitionally equivalent to
;; starting with {1,2,3,...} and applying the source's exact set update at each
;; round.

(defun putnam-2015-b2-state (n)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix n)))
  (if (zp n)
      nil
    (putnam-2015-b2-next-state
     (putnam-2015-b2-state (- n 1)))))

(defun putnam-2015-b2-sum (n)
  (nth
   3
   (putnam-2015-b2-round-values
    (putnam-2015-b2-state n))))

;; This is the solution constant recorded by the source formalizations.

(defun putnam-2015-b2-solution ()
  t)

;; The round index remains an internal, unbounded natural-number witness.

(defun-sk putnam-2015-b2-sum-ending-in-2015-p ()
  (exists (n)
    (and
     (natp n)
     (equal
      (mod (putnam-2015-b2-sum n) 10000)
      2015))))

(defun putnambench-putnam-2015-b2-statement ()
  (iff
   (putnam-2015-b2-sum-ending-in-2015-p)
   (putnam-2015-b2-solution)))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

title: putnam_2015_b2

-- Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2015_b2
-- (putnambench__agda__putnam_2015_b2): repeatedly remove the three least
-- positive integers still present and their sum; some resulting sum is
-- congruent to 2015 modulo 10000. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module Putnam2015B2 where

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using
  (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; mod-helper)

infix 4 _!=_ _<=N_
infixr 3 _and_

data Bottom : Set where

Not : Set -> Set
Not A =
  A -> Bottom

_!=_ : {A : Set} -> A -> A -> Set
x != y =
  Not (x == y)

record _and_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    left-conjunct  : A
    right-conjunct : B

record Iff (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor equivalence
  field
    forward  : A -> B
    backward : B -> A

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

data _<=N_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set where
  zero<=N   : {n : Nat} -> zero <=N n
  suc<=sucN : {m n : Nat} -> m <=N n -> suc m <=N suc n

SetOfNaturals : Set1
SetOfNaturals =
  Nat -> Set

SameSet : SetOfNaturals -> SetOfNaturals -> Set
SameSet left right =
  (x : Nat) -> Iff (left x) (right x)

PositiveNaturals : SetOfNaturals
PositiveNaturals x =
  suc zero <=N x

DeleteOne : SetOfNaturals -> Nat -> SetOfNaturals
DeleteOne S removed x =
  S x and x != removed

DeleteFour :
  SetOfNaturals ->
  Nat ->
  Nat ->
  Nat ->
  Nat ->
  SetOfNaturals
DeleteFour S a b c d x =
  S x
  and
  (x != a
  and
  (x != b
  and
  (x != c
  and
  x != d)))

record HasAtLeastThree (S : SetOfNaturals) : Set where
  field
    first-member  : Nat
    second-member : Nat
    third-member  : Nat
    first-present  : S first-member
    second-present : S second-member
    third-present  : S third-member
    first-second-distinct : first-member != second-member
    first-third-distinct  : first-member != third-member
    second-third-distinct : second-member != third-member

Least : SetOfNaturals -> Nat -> Set
Least S candidate =
  S candidate
  and
  ((x : Nat) -> S x -> candidate <=N x)

record Triple : Set where
  constructor triple
  field
    first-value  : Nat
    second-value : Nat
    third-value  : Nat

open Triple

record ThreeSmallest
  (S : SetOfNaturals)
  (values : Triple) :
  Set where

  field
    first-is-least :
      Least S (first-value values)
    second-is-least :
      Least
        (DeleteOne S (first-value values))
        (second-value values)
    third-is-least :
      Least
        (DeleteOne
          (DeleteOne S (first-value values))
          (second-value values))
        (third-value values)

tripleSum : Triple -> Nat
tripleSum values =
  first-value values + second-value values + third-value values

naturalMod : Nat -> Nat -> Nat
naturalMod numerator zero =
  zero
naturalMod numerator (suc denominator) =
  mod-helper zero denominator numerator denominator

putnam-2015-b2 : Set1
putnam-2015-b2 =
  (sets : Nat -> SetOfNaturals) ->
  (smallestThree : SetOfNaturals -> Triple) ->
  (sums : Nat -> Nat) ->
  SameSet (sets zero) PositiveNaturals ->
  ((S : SetOfNaturals) ->
    HasAtLeastThree S ->
    ThreeSmallest S (smallestThree S)) ->
  ((n : Nat) ->
    sums n == tripleSum (smallestThree (sets n))) ->
  ((n : Nat) ->
    SameSet
      (sets (suc n))
      (DeleteFour
        (sets n)
        (first-value (smallestThree (sets n)))
        (second-value (smallestThree (sets n)))
        (third-value (smallestThree (sets n)))
        (sums n))) ->
  Exists Nat
    (\ n -> naturalMod (sums n) 10000 == 2015)

(*
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2015_b2:
  the iterative process that crosses off the three least remaining positive
  integers and their sum produces a sum ending in the decimal digits 2015.
  This file contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open arithmeticTheory pred_setTheory;

val putnam_2015_b2 =
  ``let putnam_2015_b2_solution = T
    in
      !(sets : num -> num set)
       (Smin3 : num set -> num # (num # num))
       (sums : num -> num).
        let first = \S : num set. FST (Smin3 S) in
        let second = \S : num set. FST (SND (Smin3 S)) in
        let third = \S : num set. SND (SND (Smin3 S)) in
          sets 0 = {n : num | 1 <= n} /\
          (!S : num set.
             (INFINITE S \/ 3 <= CARD S)
             ==>
             first S = (LEAST x : num. x IN S) /\
             second S = (LEAST x : num. x IN S DELETE first S) /\
             third S =
               (LEAST x : num.
                  x IN (S DELETE first S) DELETE second S)) /\
          (!n : num.
             sums n = first (sets n) + second (sets n) + third (sets n)) /\
          (!n : num.
             sets (n + 1) =
               (((sets n DELETE first (sets n))
                   DELETE second (sets n))
                  DELETE third (sets n))
                 DELETE sums n)
          ==>
          ((?n : num. sums n MOD 10000 = 2015) <=>
           putnam_2015_b2_solution)``;

  positive integers still present and their sum produces a sum ending in

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  T is the natural-indexed sequence of remaining subsets of NN0, M assigns
  to every subset a triple indexed by 0 ..^ 3, and U is the sequence of
  sums. The cardinality hypothesis and the three attained-minimum
  characterizations are equivalent to the source's successive sInf/LEAST
  equations after deleting the previously selected entries.

  The recurrence removes the selected triple together with its sum. Since
  the residue 2015 is already four digits long, U(n) mod 10000 = 2015 is
  equivalent to the Lean least-significant-first digit prefix [5,1,0,2] and
  is exactly the Isabelle decimal-suffix condition. The final declaration
  is the single unproved $a corpus statement; this database contains no $p
  proof statement.
$)

${
  $d M S T U n x $.

  putnambench-putnam-2015-b2 $a |-
    A. T e. ( ( ~P NN0 ) ^m NN0 )
      A. M e.
        (
          ( NN0 ^m ( 0 ..^ 3 ) )
          ^m
          ( ~P NN0 )
        )
        A. U e. ( NN0 ^m NN0 )
          (
            (
              (
                (
                  ( T ` 0 ) = NN
                  /\
                  A. S e. ( ~P NN0 )
                    (
                      3 <_ ( # ` S )
                      ->
                      (
                        (
                          (
                            ( ( M ` S ) ` 0 ) e. S
                            /\
                            A. x e. S
                              ( ( M ` S ) ` 0 ) <_ x
                          )
                          /\
                          (
                            ( ( M ` S ) ` 1 )
                            e.
                            ( S \ { ( ( M ` S ) ` 0 ) } )
                            /\
                            A. x e.
                              ( S \ { ( ( M ` S ) ` 0 ) } )
                              ( ( M ` S ) ` 1 ) <_ x
                          )
                        )
                        /\
                        (
                          ( ( M ` S ) ` 2 )
                          e.
                          (
                            S
                            \
                            {
                              ( ( M ` S ) ` 0 ) ,
                              ( ( M ` S ) ` 1 )
                            }
                          )
                          /\
                          A. x e.
                            (
                              S
                              \
                              {
                                ( ( M ` S ) ` 0 ) ,
                                ( ( M ` S ) ` 1 )
                              }
                            )
                            ( ( M ` S ) ` 2 ) <_ x
                        )
                      )
                    )
                )
                /\
                A. n e. NN0
                  ( U ` n )
                  =
                  (
                    (
                      ( ( M ` ( T ` n ) ) ` 0 )
                      +
                      ( ( M ` ( T ` n ) ) ` 1 )
                    )
                    +
                    ( ( M ` ( T ` n ) ) ` 2 )
                  )
              )
              /\
              A. n e. NN0
                ( T ` ( n + 1 ) )
                =
                (
                  ( T ` n )
                  \
                  (
                    {
                      ( ( M ` ( T ` n ) ) ` 0 ) ,
                      ( ( M ` ( T ` n ) ) ` 1 ) ,
                      ( ( M ` ( T ` n ) ) ` 2 )
                    }
                    u.
                    { ( U ` n ) }
                  )
                )
            )
            ->
            E. n e. NN0
              (
                ( U ` n )
                mod
                ( ; ; ; ; 1 0 0 0 0 )
              )
              =
              ( ; ; ; 2 0 1 5 )
          )
  $.
$}

title: putnam_2015_b2
content:
% Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2015_b2:
% repeatedly remove the three least remaining positive integers and their sum;
% some resulting sum ends in the decimal digits 2015. This file contains no proof.

putnam_2015_b2: THEORY
BEGIN
  natural_set: TYPE = [nat -> bool]
  set_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> natural_set]
  minimum_triple: TYPE = [below(3) -> nat]
  minimum_selector: TYPE = [natural_set -> minimum_triple]
  natural_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> nat]

  positive_naturals: natural_set =
    LAMBDA (value: nat):
      value >= 1

  remove_one(S: natural_set, removed: nat): natural_set =
    LAMBDA (value: nat):
      S(value) AND value /= removed

  remove_four(
      S: natural_set,
      first, second, third, fourth: nat): natural_set =
    LAMBDA (value: nat):
      S(value)
        AND value /= first
        AND value /= second
        AND value /= third
        AND value /= fourth

  has_at_least_three(S: natural_set): bool =
    EXISTS (first, second, third: nat):
      S(first)
        AND S(second)
        AND S(third)
        AND first /= second
        AND first /= third
        AND second /= third

  is_least_member(value: nat, S: natural_set): bool =
    S(value)
      AND (FORALL (other: nat):
        S(other) IMPLIES value <= other)

  selects_three_least(
      select: minimum_selector): bool =
    FORALL (S: natural_set):
      has_at_least_three(S) IMPLIES
        is_least_member(select(S)(0), S)
          AND is_least_member(
            select(S)(1),
            remove_one(S, select(S)(0)))
          AND is_least_member(
            select(S)(2),
            remove_one(
              remove_one(S, select(S)(0)),
              select(S)(1)))

  sums_selected_three(
      sets: set_sequence,
      select: minimum_selector,
      sums: natural_sequence): bool =
    FORALL (n: nat):
      sums(n) =
        select(sets(n))(0)
          + select(sets(n))(1)
          + select(sets(n))(2)

  follows_removal_process(
      sets: set_sequence,
      select: minimum_selector,
      sums: natural_sequence): bool =
    FORALL (n: nat):
      sets(n + 1) =
        remove_four(
          sets(n),
          select(sets(n))(0),
          select(sets(n))(1),
          select(sets(n))(2),
          sums(n))

  putnam_2015_b2_solution: bool = TRUE

  putnam_2015_b2: bool =
    FORALL
        (sets: set_sequence),
        (select: minimum_selector),
        (sums: natural_sequence):
      (sets(0) = positive_naturals
        AND selects_three_least(select)
        AND sums_selected_three(sets, select, sums)
        AND follows_removal_process(sets, select, sums))
      IMPLIES
        ((EXISTS (n: nat):
          mod(sums(n), 10000) = 2015)
        IFF putnam_2015_b2_solution)
END putnam_2015_b2

(* Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2015_b3:
   characterization of real 2 by 2 arithmetic-progression matrices having
   a power of exponent greater than one with the same property. This file
   contains no proof. *)

From Stdlib Require Import Vectors.Fin Reals Arith.PeanoNat.

Open Scope R_scope.

Definition putnam_2015_b3_matrix : Type :=
  Fin.t 2 -> Fin.t 2 -> R.

Definition putnam_2015_b3_index0 : Fin.t 2 :=
  Fin.F1.

Definition putnam_2015_b3_index1 : Fin.t 2 :=
  Fin.FS Fin.F1.

Definition putnam_2015_b3_matrix_mul
    (A B : putnam_2015_b3_matrix) : putnam_2015_b3_matrix :=
  fun i j =>
    A i putnam_2015_b3_index0 *
      B putnam_2015_b3_index0 j +
    A i putnam_2015_b3_index1 *
      B putnam_2015_b3_index1 j.

Definition putnam_2015_b3_identity : putnam_2015_b3_matrix :=
  fun i j => if Fin.eq_dec i j then 1 else 0.

Fixpoint putnam_2015_b3_matrix_power
    (A : putnam_2015_b3_matrix)
    (k : nat) : putnam_2015_b3_matrix :=
  match k with
  | O => putnam_2015_b3_identity
  | S n =>
      putnam_2015_b3_matrix_mul
        (putnam_2015_b3_matrix_power A n) A
  end.

Definition putnam_2015_b3_arithmetic_progression
    (A : putnam_2015_b3_matrix) : Prop :=
  A putnam_2015_b3_index0 putnam_2015_b3_index1 -
      A putnam_2015_b3_index0 putnam_2015_b3_index0 =
    A putnam_2015_b3_index1 putnam_2015_b3_index0 -
      A putnam_2015_b3_index0 putnam_2015_b3_index1 /\
  A putnam_2015_b3_index1 putnam_2015_b3_index0 -
      A putnam_2015_b3_index0 putnam_2015_b3_index1 =
    A putnam_2015_b3_index1 putnam_2015_b3_index1 -
      A putnam_2015_b3_index1 putnam_2015_b3_index0.

Definition putnam_2015_b3_solution
    (A : putnam_2015_b3_matrix) : Prop :=
  (exists alpha : R,
      forall i j : Fin.t 2, A i j = alpha) \/
  (exists beta : R,
      A putnam_2015_b3_index0 putnam_2015_b3_index0 =
        beta * (-3) /\
      A putnam_2015_b3_index0 putnam_2015_b3_index1 =
        beta * (-1) /\
      A putnam_2015_b3_index1 putnam_2015_b3_index0 =
        beta * 1 /\
      A putnam_2015_b3_index1 putnam_2015_b3_index1 =
        beta * 3).

Theorem putnam_2015_b3
    (M : putnam_2015_b3_matrix)
    (S : putnam_2015_b3_matrix -> Prop)
    (hS : S = putnam_2015_b3_arithmetic_progression) :
  (S M /\
    exists k : nat,
      (1 < k)%nat /\
      S (putnam_2015_b3_matrix_power M k)) <->
  putnam_2015_b3_solution M.
Admitted.
