;; Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2015_b3:
;; classification of real 2 by 2 arithmetic-progression matrices having a
;; higher power whose entries again form an arithmetic progression. This file
;; contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))

;; A rational polynomial and isolating interval encode one real algebraic
;; number alpha. Rational functions of alpha encode all four entries, and
;; every finite tuple of real algebraic numbers admits such a common
;; primitive-element representation. Sturm-Tarski signs decide equality of
;; represented values exactly.
;;
;; Restricting counterexamples to real algebraic entries is bidirectionally
;; exact here. If the left-to-right implication fails, its particular natural
;; exponent leaves a finite system of polynomial equalities and inequalities,
;; so real-closed-field transfer supplies an algebraic counterexample. For the
;; other direction, the displayed solution is the union of two homogeneous
;; one-parameter families; replacing a parameter by a nonzero algebraic value
;; preserves every arithmetic-progression equality in every matrix power.
;; Thus an arbitrary-real counterexample exists exactly when an algebraic one
;; exists. The exponent witness remains internally and unboundedly quantified.

;; Rational polynomials in alpha use descending coefficient order.

(defun putnam-2015-b3-rp-p (p)
  (if (consp p)
      (and (rationalp (car p))
           (putnam-2015-b3-rp-p (cdr p)))
    (equal p nil)))

(defun putnam-2015-b3-rp-normalize (p)
  (if (consp p)
      (if (equal (car p) 0)
          (putnam-2015-b3-rp-normalize (cdr p))
        p)
    nil))

(defun putnam-2015-b3-rp-neg (p)
  (if (consp p)
      (cons (- (car p))
            (putnam-2015-b3-rp-neg (cdr p)))
    nil))

(defun putnam-2015-b3-rp-add-raw (p q)
  (declare (xargs :measure (+ (acl2-count p) (acl2-count q))))
  (cond
   ((endp p) q)
   ((endp q) p)
   ((< (len p) (len q))
    (cons (car q)
          (putnam-2015-b3-rp-add-raw p (cdr q))))
   ((< (len q) (len p))
    (cons (car p)
          (putnam-2015-b3-rp-add-raw (cdr p) q)))
   (t
    (cons (+ (car p) (car q))
          (putnam-2015-b3-rp-add-raw (cdr p) (cdr q))))))

(defun putnam-2015-b3-rp-add (p q)
  (putnam-2015-b3-rp-normalize
   (putnam-2015-b3-rp-add-raw p q)))

(defun putnam-2015-b3-rp-sub (p q)
  (putnam-2015-b3-rp-add
   p (putnam-2015-b3-rp-neg q)))

(defun putnam-2015-b3-rp-scale (c p)
  (if (consp p)
      (cons (* c (car p))
            (putnam-2015-b3-rp-scale c (cdr p)))
    nil))

(defun putnam-2015-b3-zeroes (n)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix n)))
  (if (zp n)
      nil
    (cons 0 (putnam-2015-b3-zeroes (- n 1)))))

(defun putnam-2015-b3-rp-scale-shift (c p shift)
  (append (putnam-2015-b3-rp-scale c p)
          (putnam-2015-b3-zeroes shift)))

(defun putnam-2015-b3-rp-mul-raw (p q)
  (if (consp p)
      (putnam-2015-b3-rp-add
       (putnam-2015-b3-rp-scale-shift
        (car p) q (len (cdr p)))
       (putnam-2015-b3-rp-mul-raw (cdr p) q))
    nil))

(defun putnam-2015-b3-rp-mul (p q)
  (putnam-2015-b3-rp-normalize
   (putnam-2015-b3-rp-mul-raw p q)))

(defun putnam-2015-b3-rp-eval-aux (p x accumulator)
  (if (consp p)
      (putnam-2015-b3-rp-eval-aux
       (cdr p) x (+ (* accumulator x) (car p)))
    accumulator))

(defun putnam-2015-b3-rp-eval (p x)
  (putnam-2015-b3-rp-eval-aux p x 0))

(defun putnam-2015-b3-rp-derivative-aux (p degree)
  (if (consp p)
      (if (zp degree)
          nil
        (cons (* degree (car p))
              (putnam-2015-b3-rp-derivative-aux
               (cdr p) (- degree 1))))
    nil))

(defun putnam-2015-b3-rp-derivative (p)
  (let ((p (putnam-2015-b3-rp-normalize p)))
    (putnam-2015-b3-rp-normalize
     (putnam-2015-b3-rp-derivative-aux
      p (nfix (- (len p) 1))))))

(defun putnam-2015-b3-rp-rem-fuel (p q fuel)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix fuel)))
  (let ((p (putnam-2015-b3-rp-normalize p))
        (q (putnam-2015-b3-rp-normalize q)))
    (if (or (zp fuel)
            (endp q)
            (< (len p) (len q)))
        p
      (putnam-2015-b3-rp-rem-fuel
       (putnam-2015-b3-rp-sub
        p
        (putnam-2015-b3-rp-scale-shift
         (/ (car p) (car q))
         q
         (- (len p) (len q))))
       q
       (- fuel 1)))))

(defun putnam-2015-b3-rp-rem (p q)
  (putnam-2015-b3-rp-rem-fuel
   p q (+ 1 (len (putnam-2015-b3-rp-normalize p)))))

(defun putnam-2015-b3-rp-sturm-tail (previous current fuel)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix fuel)))
  (let ((current (putnam-2015-b3-rp-normalize current)))
    (if (or (zp fuel) (endp current))
        nil
      (cons
       current
       (putnam-2015-b3-rp-sturm-tail
        current
        (putnam-2015-b3-rp-neg
         (putnam-2015-b3-rp-rem previous current))
        (- fuel 1))))))

(defun putnam-2015-b3-rp-sturm-sequence (p q)
  (let ((p (putnam-2015-b3-rp-normalize p))
        (q (putnam-2015-b3-rp-normalize q)))
    (if (endp p)
        nil
      (cons
       p
       (if (endp q)
           nil
         (cons
          q
          (putnam-2015-b3-rp-sturm-tail
           p q (+ 1 (len p) (len q)))))))))

(defun putnam-2015-b3-rational-sign (x)
  (cond ((< x 0) -1)
        ((< 0 x) 1)
        (t 0)))

(defun putnam-2015-b3-rp-variations-aux
    (polynomials x previous-sign)
  (if (consp polynomials)
      (let ((sign
             (putnam-2015-b3-rational-sign
              (putnam-2015-b3-rp-eval (car polynomials) x))))
        (if (equal sign 0)
            (putnam-2015-b3-rp-variations-aux
             (cdr polynomials) x previous-sign)
          (+ (if (and (not (equal previous-sign 0))
                      (not (equal sign previous-sign)))
                 1
               0)
             (putnam-2015-b3-rp-variations-aux
              (cdr polynomials) x sign))))
    0))

(defun putnam-2015-b3-rp-variations (polynomials x)
  (putnam-2015-b3-rp-variations-aux polynomials x 0))

(defun putnam-2015-b3-rp-cauchy-index (p q lower upper)
  (let ((sequence
         (putnam-2015-b3-rp-sturm-sequence p q)))
    (- (putnam-2015-b3-rp-variations sequence lower)
       (putnam-2015-b3-rp-variations sequence upper))))

(defun putnam-2015-b3-rp-root-count (p lower upper)
  (putnam-2015-b3-rp-cauchy-index
   p (putnam-2015-b3-rp-derivative p) lower upper))

(defun putnam-2015-b3-primitive-p (primitive lower upper)
  (and
   (putnam-2015-b3-rp-p primitive)
   (consp (putnam-2015-b3-rp-normalize primitive))
   (rationalp lower)
   (rationalp upper)
   (< lower upper)
   (not (equal (putnam-2015-b3-rp-eval primitive lower) 0))
   (not (equal (putnam-2015-b3-rp-eval primitive upper) 0))
   (equal
    (putnam-2015-b3-rp-root-count primitive lower upper)
    1)))

;; The Sturm-Tarski query over the single isolated root alpha is sign(g(alpha)).
(defun putnam-2015-b3-alg-sign
    (primitive lower upper g)
  (putnam-2015-b3-rp-cauchy-index
   primitive
   (putnam-2015-b3-rp-mul
    (putnam-2015-b3-rp-derivative primitive)
    g)
   lower
   upper))

;; A field element is (numerator denominator), evaluated at alpha.

(defun putnam-2015-b3-rf-numerator (value)
  (car value))

(defun putnam-2015-b3-rf-denominator (value)
  (cadr value))

(defun putnam-2015-b3-rf-code-p
    (primitive lower upper value)
  (and
   (true-listp value)
   (equal (len value) 2)
   (putnam-2015-b3-rp-p
    (putnam-2015-b3-rf-numerator value))
   (putnam-2015-b3-rp-p
    (putnam-2015-b3-rf-denominator value))
   (not
    (equal
     (putnam-2015-b3-alg-sign
      primitive lower upper
      (putnam-2015-b3-rf-denominator value))
     0))))

(defun putnam-2015-b3-rf-list-p
    (primitive lower upper values)
  (if (consp values)
      (and
       (putnam-2015-b3-rf-code-p
        primitive lower upper (car values))
       (putnam-2015-b3-rf-list-p
        primitive lower upper (cdr values)))
    (equal values nil)))

(defun putnam-2015-b3-rf-zero ()
  (list nil (list 1)))

(defun putnam-2015-b3-rf-one ()
  (list (list 1) (list 1)))

(defun putnam-2015-b3-rf-integer (value)
  (if (equal value 0)
      (putnam-2015-b3-rf-zero)
    (list (list value) (list 1))))

(defun putnam-2015-b3-rf-neg (value)
  (list
   (putnam-2015-b3-rp-neg
    (putnam-2015-b3-rf-numerator value))
   (putnam-2015-b3-rf-denominator value)))

(defun putnam-2015-b3-rf-add (left right)
  (list
   (putnam-2015-b3-rp-add
    (putnam-2015-b3-rp-mul
     (putnam-2015-b3-rf-numerator left)
     (putnam-2015-b3-rf-denominator right))
    (putnam-2015-b3-rp-mul
     (putnam-2015-b3-rf-numerator right)
     (putnam-2015-b3-rf-denominator left)))
   (putnam-2015-b3-rp-mul
    (putnam-2015-b3-rf-denominator left)
    (putnam-2015-b3-rf-denominator right))))

(defun putnam-2015-b3-rf-sub (left right)
  (putnam-2015-b3-rf-add
   left (putnam-2015-b3-rf-neg right)))

(defun putnam-2015-b3-rf-mul (left right)
  (list
   (putnam-2015-b3-rp-mul
    (putnam-2015-b3-rf-numerator left)
    (putnam-2015-b3-rf-numerator right))
   (putnam-2015-b3-rp-mul
    (putnam-2015-b3-rf-denominator left)
    (putnam-2015-b3-rf-denominator right))))

(defun putnam-2015-b3-rf-div (left right)
  (list
   (putnam-2015-b3-rp-mul
    (putnam-2015-b3-rf-numerator left)
    (putnam-2015-b3-rf-denominator right))
   (putnam-2015-b3-rp-mul
    (putnam-2015-b3-rf-denominator left)
    (putnam-2015-b3-rf-numerator right))))

(defun putnam-2015-b3-rf-sign
    (primitive lower upper value)
  (putnam-2015-b3-alg-sign
   primitive lower upper
   (putnam-2015-b3-rp-mul
    (putnam-2015-b3-rf-numerator value)
    (putnam-2015-b3-rf-denominator value))))

(defun putnam-2015-b3-rf-zero-p
    (primitive lower upper value)
  (equal
   (putnam-2015-b3-rf-sign
    primitive lower upper value)
   0))

(defun putnam-2015-b3-matrix-p
    (primitive lower upper matrix)
  (and
   (true-listp matrix)
   (equal (len matrix) 4)
   (putnam-2015-b3-rf-list-p
    primitive lower upper matrix)))

(defun putnam-2015-b3-matrix-multiply (left right)
  (let ((a (nth 0 left))
        (b (nth 1 left))
        (c (nth 2 left))
        (d (nth 3 left))
        (e (nth 0 right))
        (f (nth 1 right))
        (g (nth 2 right))
        (h (nth 3 right)))
    (list
     (putnam-2015-b3-rf-add
      (putnam-2015-b3-rf-mul a e)
      (putnam-2015-b3-rf-mul b g))
     (putnam-2015-b3-rf-add
      (putnam-2015-b3-rf-mul a f)
      (putnam-2015-b3-rf-mul b h))
     (putnam-2015-b3-rf-add
      (putnam-2015-b3-rf-mul c e)
      (putnam-2015-b3-rf-mul d g))
     (putnam-2015-b3-rf-add
      (putnam-2015-b3-rf-mul c f)
      (putnam-2015-b3-rf-mul d h)))))

(defun putnam-2015-b3-identity-matrix ()
  (list
   (putnam-2015-b3-rf-one)
   (putnam-2015-b3-rf-zero)
   (putnam-2015-b3-rf-zero)
   (putnam-2015-b3-rf-one)))

(defun putnam-2015-b3-matrix-power (matrix exponent)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix exponent)))
  (if (zp exponent)
      (putnam-2015-b3-identity-matrix)
    (putnam-2015-b3-matrix-multiply
     (putnam-2015-b3-matrix-power matrix (- exponent 1))
     matrix)))

(defun putnam-2015-b3-arithmetic-progression-p
    (primitive lower upper matrix)
  (let* ((a (nth 0 matrix))
         (b (nth 1 matrix))
         (c (nth 2 matrix))
         (d (nth 3 matrix))
         (first-difference
          (putnam-2015-b3-rf-sub b a))
         (second-difference
          (putnam-2015-b3-rf-sub c b))
         (third-difference
          (putnam-2015-b3-rf-sub d c)))
    (and
     (putnam-2015-b3-rf-zero-p
      primitive lower upper
      (putnam-2015-b3-rf-sub
       first-difference second-difference))
     (putnam-2015-b3-rf-zero-p
      primitive lower upper
      (putnam-2015-b3-rf-sub
       second-difference third-difference)))))

(defun putnam-2015-b3-solution-p
    (primitive lower upper matrix)
  (let* ((a (nth 0 matrix))
         (b (nth 1 matrix))
         (c (nth 2 matrix))
         (d (nth 3 matrix))
         (three-b
          (putnam-2015-b3-rf-add
           b (putnam-2015-b3-rf-add b b))))
    (or
     (and
      (putnam-2015-b3-rf-zero-p
       primitive lower upper
       (putnam-2015-b3-rf-sub a b))
      (putnam-2015-b3-rf-zero-p
       primitive lower upper
       (putnam-2015-b3-rf-sub a c))
      (putnam-2015-b3-rf-zero-p
       primitive lower upper
       (putnam-2015-b3-rf-sub a d)))
     (and
      (putnam-2015-b3-rf-zero-p
       primitive lower upper
       (putnam-2015-b3-rf-sub a three-b))
      (putnam-2015-b3-rf-zero-p
       primitive lower upper
       (putnam-2015-b3-rf-add b c))
      (putnam-2015-b3-rf-zero-p
       primitive lower upper
       (putnam-2015-b3-rf-add a d))))))

(defun-sk putnam-2015-b3-power-witness-exists-p
    (primitive lower upper matrix)
  (exists
   (exponent)
    (and
     (natp exponent)
     (< 1 exponent)
     (putnam-2015-b3-arithmetic-progression-p
      primitive lower upper
      (putnam-2015-b3-matrix-power matrix exponent)))))

(defun putnambench-putnam-2015-b3-statement
    (primitive lower upper matrix)
  (implies
   (and
    (putnam-2015-b3-primitive-p primitive lower upper)
    (putnam-2015-b3-matrix-p
     primitive lower upper matrix))
   (iff
    (and
     (putnam-2015-b3-arithmetic-progression-p
      primitive lower upper matrix)
     (putnam-2015-b3-power-witness-exists-p
      primitive lower upper matrix))
    (putnam-2015-b3-solution-p
     primitive lower upper matrix))))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

title: putnam_2015_b3
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2015_b3
-- (putnambench__agda__putnam_2015_b3): classification of real 2 by 2 matrices
-- whose entries and the entries of some power above one are arithmetic
-- progressions. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module Putnam2015B3 where

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; _*_)

infix 4 _!=_ _<=N_ _<N_
infixr 3 _and_
infixr 2 _or_ _iff_

data Bottom : Set where

Not : Set -> Set
Not A =
  A -> Bottom

_!=_ : {A : Set} -> A -> A -> Set
x != y =
  Not (x == y)

record _and_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data _or_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  left  : A -> A or B
  right : B -> A or B

record _iff_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor equivalence
  field
    forward  : A -> B
    backward : B -> A

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

data _<=N_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set where
  zero<=N   : {n : Nat} -> zero <=N n
  suc<=sucN : {m n : Nat} -> m <=N n -> suc m <=N suc n

_<N_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set
m <N n =
  suc m <=N n

record CompleteOrderedRealField (R : Set) : Set1 where
  field
    zeroR oneR : R
    add multiply : R -> R -> R
    negate inverse : R -> R
    lessOrEqual : R -> R -> Set
    fromNat : Nat -> R

    one-not-zero :
      oneR != zeroR

    add-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> add x y == add y x
    add-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      add (add x y) z == add x (add y z)
    add-zero :
      (x : R) -> add x zeroR == x
    add-inverse :
      (x : R) -> add x (negate x) == zeroR

    multiply-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> multiply x y == multiply y x
    multiply-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply (multiply x y) z ==
      multiply x (multiply y z)
    multiply-one :
      (x : R) -> multiply x oneR == x
    multiply-zero :
      (x : R) -> multiply x zeroR == zeroR
    distribute :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply x (add y z) ==
      add (multiply x y) (multiply x z)
    inverse-zero :
      inverse zeroR == zeroR
    multiply-inverse :
      (x : R) ->
      x != zeroR ->
      multiply x (inverse x) == oneR

    order-reflexive :
      (x : R) -> lessOrEqual x x
    order-transitive :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y z ->
      lessOrEqual x z
    order-antisymmetric :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y x ->
      x == y
    order-total :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y or lessOrEqual y x
    add-order :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual (add z x) (add z y)
    multiply-nonnegative :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR x ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR y ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR (multiply x y)
    zero-less-than-one :
      lessOrEqual zeroR oneR and zeroR != oneR

    fromNat-zero :
      fromNat zero == zeroR
    fromNat-successor :
      (n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (suc n) == add (fromNat n) oneR
    fromNat-addition :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m + n) == add (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-multiplication :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m * n) == multiply (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-injective :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat m == fromNat n ->
      m == n

    archimedean :
      (x : R) ->
      Exists Nat
        (\ n -> lessOrEqual x (fromNat n))
    least-upper-bound :
      (P : R -> Set) ->
      Exists R P ->
      Exists R
        (\ upper ->
          (x : R) ->
          P x ->
          lessOrEqual x upper) ->
      Exists R
        (\ supremum ->
          ((x : R) ->
            P x ->
            lessOrEqual x supremum)
          and
          ((upper : R) ->
            ((x : R) ->
              P x ->
              lessOrEqual x upper) ->
            lessOrEqual supremum upper))

open CompleteOrderedRealField

oneN : Nat
oneN =
  suc zero

twoN : Nat
twoN =
  suc oneN

threeN : Nat
threeN =
  suc twoN

record Matrix2 (R : Set) : Set where
  constructor matrix
  field
    entry00 : R
    entry01 : R
    entry10 : R
    entry11 : R

open Matrix2

matrixMultiply :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Matrix2 R ->
  Matrix2 R ->
  Matrix2 R
matrixMultiply reals A B =
  matrix
    (add reals
      (multiply reals (entry00 A) (entry00 B))
      (multiply reals (entry01 A) (entry10 B)))
    (add reals
      (multiply reals (entry00 A) (entry01 B))
      (multiply reals (entry01 A) (entry11 B)))
    (add reals
      (multiply reals (entry10 A) (entry00 B))
      (multiply reals (entry11 A) (entry10 B)))
    (add reals
      (multiply reals (entry10 A) (entry01 B))
      (multiply reals (entry11 A) (entry11 B)))

identityMatrix :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Matrix2 R
identityMatrix reals =
  matrix
    (oneR reals)
    (zeroR reals)
    (zeroR reals)
    (oneR reals)

matrixPower :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Matrix2 R ->
  Nat ->
  Matrix2 R
matrixPower reals M zero =
  identityMatrix reals
matrixPower reals M (suc exponent) =
  matrixMultiply reals
    (matrixPower reals M exponent)
    M

subtract :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
subtract reals x y =
  add reals x (negate reals y)

ArithmeticProgression :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Matrix2 R ->
  Set
ArithmeticProgression reals M =
  subtract reals (entry01 M) (entry00 M) ==
    subtract reals (entry10 M) (entry01 M)
  and
  subtract reals (entry10 M) (entry01 M) ==
    subtract reals (entry11 M) (entry10 M)

ConstantFamily :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Matrix2 R ->
  Set
ConstantFamily {R} reals M =
  Exists R
    (\ alpha ->
      entry00 M == multiply reals alpha (oneR reals)
      and
      entry01 M == multiply reals alpha (oneR reals)
      and
      entry10 M == multiply reals alpha (oneR reals)
      and
      entry11 M == multiply reals alpha (oneR reals))

AlternatingFamily :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Matrix2 R ->
  Set
AlternatingFamily {R} reals M =
  Exists R
    (\ beta ->
      entry00 M ==
        multiply reals beta
          (negate reals (fromNat reals threeN))
      and
      entry01 M ==
        multiply reals beta
          (negate reals (oneR reals))
      and
      entry10 M ==
        multiply reals beta (oneR reals)
      and
      entry11 M ==
        multiply reals beta (fromNat reals threeN))

SolutionFamily :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Matrix2 R ->
  Set
SolutionFamily reals M =
  ConstantFamily reals M
  or
  AlternatingFamily reals M

HasLaterArithmeticPower :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Matrix2 R ->
  Set
HasLaterArithmeticPower reals M =
  Exists Nat
    (\ exponent ->
      oneN <N exponent
      and
      ArithmeticProgression reals
        (matrixPower reals M exponent))

Putnam2015B3 :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Set
Putnam2015B3 {R} reals =
  (M : Matrix2 R) ->
  (ArithmeticProgression reals M
    and
    HasLaterArithmeticPower reals M)
  iff
  SolutionFamily reals M

putnam-2015-b3 : Set1
putnam-2015-b3 =
  (R : Set) ->

(*
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2015_b3:
  the 2 by 2 real matrices whose entries form an arithmetic progression and
  whose power of some integer exponent greater than one also has this property.
  This file contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open arithmeticTheory fcpTheory realTheory;

val putnam_2015_b3 =
  ``let in_ap =
      \A : real['N]['N].
        A ' 0 ' 1 - A ' 0 ' 0 = A ' 1 ' 0 - A ' 0 ' 1 /\
        A ' 1 ' 0 - A ' 0 ' 1 = A ' 1 ' 1 - A ' 1 ' 0
    in
    let matrix_mul =
      \A B : real['N]['N].
        ((FCP i j.
            A ' i ' 0 * B ' 0 ' j + A ' i ' 1 * B ' 1 ' j) :
          real['N]['N])
    in
    let matrix_one =
      ((FCP i j. if i = j then 1 else 0) : real['N]['N])
    in
    let matrix_pow =
      \A : real['N]['N].
      \k : num.
        FUNPOW
          (\B : real['N]['N]. matrix_mul B A)
          k
          matrix_one
    in
      dimindex (:'N) = 2
      ==>
      !M : real['N]['N].
        (in_ap M /\
         (?k : num.
            1 < k /\
            in_ap (matrix_pow M k)))
        <=>
        ((?alpha : real.
            M ' 0 ' 0 = alpha /\
            M ' 0 ' 1 = alpha /\
            M ' 1 ' 0 = alpha /\
            M ' 1 ' 1 = alpha) \/
         (?beta : real.
            M ' 0 ' 0 = beta * ~3 /\
            M ' 0 ' 1 = beta * ~1 /\
            M ' 1 ' 0 = beta * 1 /\
            M ' 1 ' 1 = beta * 3))``;

$(

  putnam_2015_b3: classification of real 2 by 2 arithmetic-progression
  matrices having a higher power with the same property. This file contains
  no proof.

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  Base ` ((0 ..^ 2) Mat RRfld) is the full real 2 by 2 matrix ring.
  P15B3AP expresses that the four entries, read row by row, form an
  arithmetic progression. P15B3Sol is the solution union from the primary
  Lean source: constant matrices, or scalar multiples of the matrix with
  rows (-3,-1) and (1,3).

  The multiplicative-group operation gives ordinary natural matrix powers.
  Inlining the source equality defining S yields the left side of the final
  biconditional, so omitting S is a bidirectionally equivalent definitional
  substitution. The final declaration is the single unproved $a corpus
  statement; this database contains no $p proof declaration.
$)

$c P15B3AP P15B3Sol $.

p15b3-ap-syntax $a wff ( P15B3AP A ) $.
p15b3-solution-syntax $a wff ( P15B3Sol A ) $.

p15b3-ap-definition $a |- (
  ( P15B3AP A )
  <->
  (
    (
      ( A ` <. 0 , 1 >. )
      -
      ( A ` <. 0 , 0 >. )
    )
    =
    (
      ( A ` <. 1 , 0 >. )
      -
      ( A ` <. 0 , 1 >. )
    )
    /\
    (
      (
        ( A ` <. 1 , 0 >. )
        -
        ( A ` <. 0 , 1 >. )
      )
      =
      (
        ( A ` <. 1 , 1 >. )
        -
        ( A ` <. 1 , 0 >. )
      )
    )
  )
) $.

${
  $d A a b $.

  p15b3-solution-definition $a |- (
    ( P15B3Sol A )
    <->
    (
      E. a e. RR
        (
          (
            ( A ` <. 0 , 0 >. ) = ( a x. 1 )
            /\
            ( A ` <. 0 , 1 >. ) = ( a x. 1 )
          )
          /\
          (
            ( A ` <. 1 , 0 >. ) = ( a x. 1 )
            /\
            ( A ` <. 1 , 1 >. ) = ( a x. 1 )
          )
        )
      \/
      E. b e. RR
        (
          (
            ( A ` <. 0 , 0 >. ) = ( b x. ( -u 3 ) )
            /\
            ( A ` <. 0 , 1 >. ) = ( b x. ( -u 1 ) )
          )
          /\
          (
            ( A ` <. 1 , 0 >. ) = ( b x. 1 )
            /\
            ( A ` <. 1 , 1 >. ) = ( b x. 3 )
          )
        )
    )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d A k $.

  putnambench-putnam-2015-b3 $a |-
    A. A e. ( Base ` ( ( 0 ..^ 2 ) Mat RRfld ) )
      (
        (
          ( P15B3AP A )
          /\
          E. k e. NN0
            (
              1 < k
              /\
              (
                P15B3AP
                (
                  k
                  ( .g ` ( mulGrp ` ( ( 0 ..^ 2 ) Mat RRfld ) ) )
                  A
                )
              )
            )
        )
        <->
        ( P15B3Sol A )
      )
  $.
$}

title: putnam_2015_b3
content:
% Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2015_b3:
% the real two-by-two matrices whose entries form an arithmetic progression
% and whose power for some natural exponent greater than one does likewise
% are classified explicitly. This file contains no proof.

putnam_2015_b3: THEORY
BEGIN
  index: TYPE = below(2)
  matrix: TYPE = [index, index -> real]

  identity_matrix: matrix =
    LAMBDA (row, column: index):
      IF row = column THEN 1 ELSE 0 ENDIF

  matrix_multiply(A, B: matrix): matrix =
    LAMBDA (row, column: index):
      A(row, 0) * B(0, column)
        + A(row, 1) * B(1, column)

  matrix_power(A: matrix, exponent: nat): RECURSIVE matrix =
    IF exponent = 0 THEN
      identity_matrix
    ELSE
      matrix_multiply(
        matrix_power(A, exponent - 1),
        A)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE exponent

  entries_form_arithmetic_progression(A: matrix): bool =
    A(0, 1) - A(0, 0) = A(1, 0) - A(0, 1)
      AND A(1, 0) - A(0, 1) = A(1, 1) - A(1, 0)

  putnam_2015_b3_solution(A: matrix): bool =
    (EXISTS (alpha: real):
      FORALL (row, column: index):
        A(row, column) = alpha)
      OR
    (EXISTS (beta: real):
      A(0, 0) = -3 * beta
        AND A(0, 1) = -beta
        AND A(1, 0) = beta
        AND A(1, 1) = 3 * beta)

  putnam_2015_b3: bool =
    FORALL (A: matrix):
      (entries_form_arithmetic_progression(A)
        AND EXISTS (exponent: nat):
          exponent > 1
            AND entries_form_arithmetic_progression(
              matrix_power(A, exponent)))
        IFF putnam_2015_b3_solution(A)
END putnam_2015_b3

import Mathlib

abbrev putnam_2015_b4_solution : ℤ × ℕ := sorry
-- (17, 21)
/--
Let $T$ be the set of all triples $(a,b,c)$ of positive integers for which there exist triangles with side lengths $a,b,c$. Express
\[
\sum_{(a,b,c) \in T} \frac{2^a}{3^b 5^c}
\]
as a rational number in lowest terms.
-/
theorem putnam_2015_b4
(quotientof : ℚ → (ℤ × ℕ))
(hquotientof : ∀ q : ℚ, quotientof q = (q.num, q.den))
: quotientof (∑' t : (Fin 3 → ℤ), if (∀ n : Fin 3, t n > 0) ∧ t 0 < t 1 + t 2 ∧ t 1 < t 2 + t 0 ∧ t 2 < t 0 + t 1
then 2^(t 0)/(3^(t 1)*5^(t 2)) else 0) = putnam_2015_b4_solution :=
sorry

From mathcomp Require Import all_algebra all_ssreflect.
From mathcomp Require Import reals normedtype sequences topology.
From mathcomp Require Import classical_sets.
Import numFieldNormedType.Exports.
Import Order.TTheory GRing.Theory Num.Theory.

Set Implicit Arguments.
Unset Strict Implicit.
Unset Printing Implicit Defensive.

Local Open Scope ring_scope.
Local Open Scope classical_set_scope.

Variable R : realType.
Definition putnam_2015_b4_solution : int * int := (17%Z, 21%Z).
Definition putnam_2015_b4_value : rat := 17%:Q / 21%:Q.

Theorem putnam_2015_b4
    (tri_fun : nat -> nat -> nat -> R := fun i j k : nat => 
        if (ltn i (Nat.add j k)) && (ltn j (Nat.add i k)) && (ltn k (Nat.add i j)) then (2 ^+ i) / ((3 ^+ j * 5 ^+ k)) else 0)
    (f : nat -> R := fun n : nat => 
        \sum_(1 <= i < n)
        (\sum_(1 <= j < n) 
        (\sum_(1 <= k < n) 
        (tri_fun i j k))))
    : ((fun n : nat => f n) @ \oo --> (ratr putnam_2015_b4_value : R)) /\
      (numq putnam_2015_b4_value, denq putnam_2015_b4_value) =
        putnam_2015_b4_solution.
Proof. Admitted.

content:
;; Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2015_b4:
;; the sum of 2^a/(3^b*5^c) over positive integer triangle side triples has
;; reduced rational value 17/21. This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(defun putnam-2015-b4-triangle-term (a b c)
  (if (and (posp a)
           (posp b)
           (posp c)
           (< a (+ b c))
           (< b (+ c a))
           (< c (+ a b)))
      (/ (expt 2 a)
         (* (expt 3 b)
            (expt 5 c)))
    0))

(defun putnam-2015-b4-sum-c (a b c)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix c)))
  (if (zp c)
      0
    (+ (putnam-2015-b4-triangle-term a b c)
       (putnam-2015-b4-sum-c a b (- c 1)))))

(defun putnam-2015-b4-sum-b (a b maximum)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix b)))
  (if (zp b)
      0
    (+ (putnam-2015-b4-sum-c a b maximum)
       (putnam-2015-b4-sum-b a (- b 1) maximum))))

(defun putnam-2015-b4-sum-a (a maximum)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix a)))
  (if (zp a)
      0
    (+ (putnam-2015-b4-sum-b a maximum maximum)
       (putnam-2015-b4-sum-a (- a 1) maximum))))

;; This is the exact rational sum over 1 <= a,b,c < n, matching the cubic
;; partial sums used by the Rocq source and a cofinal family of finite subsets
;; for the nonnegative infinite sums in the Lean and Isabelle sources.
(defun putnam-2015-b4-partial-sum (n)
  (if (and (natp n)
           (< 0 n))
      (putnam-2015-b4-sum-a (- n 1) (- n 1))
    0))

(defun-sk putnam-2015-b4-tail-p (epsilon cutoff)
  (forall (n)
    (implies
     (and
      (natp n)
      (<= cutoff n))
     (<
      (abs
       (- (putnam-2015-b4-partial-sum n)
          (/ 17 21)))
      epsilon))))

(defun-sk putnam-2015-b4-cutoff-exists-p (epsilon)
  (exists (cutoff)
    (and
     (natp cutoff)
     (putnam-2015-b4-tail-p epsilon cutoff))))

;; Positive rational tolerances are cofinal among positive real tolerances.
(defun-sk putnambench-putnam-2015-b4-statement ()
  (forall (epsilon)
    (implies
     (and
      (rationalp epsilon)
      (< 0 epsilon))
     (putnam-2015-b4-cutoff-exists-p epsilon))))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

title: putnam_2015_b4
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2015_b4
-- (putnambench__agda__putnam_2015_b4): the sum over positive integer triangle
-- side triples has reduced rational value 17 / 21. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module Main where

open import Agda.Builtin.Bool using (Bool; false; true)
open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; _*_)

infix 4 _!=_ _<=N_
infixr 3 _and_
infixr 2 _or_

data Bottom : Set where

Not : Set -> Set
Not A =
  A -> Bottom

_!=_ : {A : Set} -> A -> A -> Set
x != y =
  Not (x == y)

record _and_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data _or_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  left  : A -> A or B
  right : B -> A or B

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

data _<=N_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set where
  zero<=N   : {n : Nat} -> zero <=N n
  suc<=sucN : {m n : Nat} -> m <=N n -> suc m <=N suc n

record Divides (divisor dividend : Nat) : Set where
  constructor divides
  field
    quotient : Nat
    product  : divisor * quotient == dividend

RelativelyPrime : Nat -> Nat -> Set
RelativelyPrime m n =
  (d : Nat) ->
  Divides d m ->
  Divides d n ->
  d == suc zero

record CompleteOrderedRealField (R : Set) : Set1 where
  field
    zeroR oneR : R
    add multiply : R -> R -> R
    negate inverse : R -> R
    lessOrEqual : R -> R -> Set
    fromNat : Nat -> R

    one-not-zero :
      oneR != zeroR

    add-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> add x y == add y x
    add-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      add (add x y) z == add x (add y z)
    add-zero :
      (x : R) -> add x zeroR == x
    add-inverse :
      (x : R) -> add x (negate x) == zeroR

    multiply-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> multiply x y == multiply y x
    multiply-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply (multiply x y) z ==
      multiply x (multiply y z)
    multiply-one :
      (x : R) -> multiply x oneR == x
    multiply-zero :
      (x : R) -> multiply x zeroR == zeroR
    distribute :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply x (add y z) ==
      add (multiply x y) (multiply x z)
    inverse-zero :
      inverse zeroR == zeroR
    multiply-inverse :
      (x : R) ->
      x != zeroR ->
      multiply x (inverse x) == oneR

    order-reflexive :
      (x : R) -> lessOrEqual x x
    order-transitive :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y z ->
      lessOrEqual x z
    order-antisymmetric :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y x ->
      x == y
    order-total :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y or lessOrEqual y x
    add-order :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual (add z x) (add z y)
    multiply-nonnegative :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR x ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR y ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR (multiply x y)
    zero-less-than-one :
      lessOrEqual zeroR oneR and zeroR != oneR

    fromNat-zero :
      fromNat zero == zeroR
    fromNat-successor :
      (n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (suc n) == add (fromNat n) oneR
    fromNat-addition :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m + n) == add (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-multiplication :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m * n) == multiply (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-injective :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat m == fromNat n ->
      m == n

    archimedean :
      (x : R) ->
      Exists Nat
        (\ n ->
          lessOrEqual x (fromNat n))
    least-upper-bound :
      (P : R -> Set) ->
      Exists R P ->
      Exists R
        (\ upper ->
          (x : R) ->
          P x ->
          lessOrEqual x upper) ->
      Exists R
        (\ supremum ->
          ((x : R) ->
            P x ->
            lessOrEqual x supremum)
          and
          ((upper : R) ->
            ((x : R) ->
              P x ->
              lessOrEqual x upper) ->
            lessOrEqual supremum upper))

open CompleteOrderedRealField

subtract :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
subtract reals x y =
  add reals x (negate reals y)

divide :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
divide reals x y =
  multiply reals x (inverse reals y)

naturalPower :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  Nat ->
  R
naturalPower reals x zero =
  oneR reals
naturalPower reals x (suc n) =
  multiply reals
    (naturalPower reals x n)
    x

StrictLess :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
StrictLess reals x y =
  lessOrEqual reals x y and x != y

CloseTo :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
CloseTo reals center radius x =
  StrictLess reals
    (subtract reals center radius)
    x
  and
  StrictLess reals
    x
    (add reals center radius)

ConvergesTo :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  R ->
  Set
ConvergesTo {R} reals sequence limit =
  (epsilon : R) ->
  StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) epsilon ->
  Exists Nat
    (\ cutoff ->
      (n : Nat) ->
      cutoff <=N n ->
      CloseTo reals limit epsilon (sequence n))

lessNat : Nat -> Nat -> Bool
lessNat zero zero =
  false
lessNat zero (suc n) =
  true
lessNat (suc m) zero =
  false
lessNat (suc m) (suc n) =
  lessNat m n

andBool : Bool -> Bool -> Bool
andBool true b =
  b
andBool false b =
  false

ifBool :
  {A : Set} ->
  Bool ->
  A ->
  A ->
  A
ifBool true whenTrue whenFalse =
  whenTrue
ifBool false whenTrue whenFalse =
  whenFalse

isTriangle : Nat -> Nat -> Nat -> Bool
isTriangle a b c =
  andBool
    (lessNat a (b + c))
    (andBool
      (lessNat b (c + a))
      (lessNat c (a + b)))

triangleTerm :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Nat ->
  Nat ->
  Nat ->
  R
triangleTerm reals a b c =
  ifBool
    (isTriangle a b c)
    (divide reals
      (naturalPower reals (fromNat reals 2) a)
      (multiply reals
        (naturalPower reals (fromNat reals 3) b)
        (naturalPower reals (fromNat reals 5) c)))
    (zeroR reals)

sumFirst :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Nat ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  R
sumFirst reals zero terms =
  zeroR reals
sumFirst reals (suc n) terms =
  add reals
    (sumFirst reals n terms)
    (terms n)

cubePartialSum :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Nat ->
  R
cubePartialSum reals bound =
  sumFirst reals bound
    (\ i ->
      sumFirst reals bound
        (\ j ->
          sumFirst reals bound
            (\ k ->
              triangleTerm reals
                (suc i)
                (suc j)
                (suc k))))

seventeen : Nat
seventeen =
  17

twentyOne : Nat
twentyOne =
  21

seventeenTwentyFirsts :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R
seventeenTwentyFirsts reals =
  divide reals
    (fromNat reals seventeen)
    (fromNat reals twentyOne)

putnam-2015-b4 : Set1
putnam-2015-b4 =
  (R : Set) ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) ->
  ConvergesTo reals
    (cubePartialSum reals)
    (seventeenTwentyFirsts reals)
  and
  RelativelyPrime seventeen twentyOne

title: putnam_2015_b4
content:
% Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2015_b4:
% the sum of 2^a/(3^b 5^c) over positive integer triples that are side
% lengths of a triangle is 17/21. This file contains no proof.

putnam_2015_b4: THEORY
BEGIN
  real_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> real]

  safe_div(numerator, denominator: real): real =
    IF denominator = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      numerator / denominator
    ENDIF

  triangle_sides(a, b, c: nat): bool =
    a > 0
      AND b > 0
      AND c > 0
      AND a < b + c
      AND b < c + a
      AND c < a + b

  triangle_term(a, b, c: nat): real =
    IF triangle_sides(a, b, c) THEN
      safe_div(
        (2 :: real) ^ a,
        ((3 :: real) ^ b) * ((5 :: real) ^ c))
    ELSE
      0
    ENDIF

  sum_over_c(a, b, count: nat): RECURSIVE real =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      sum_over_c(a, b, count - 1)
        + triangle_term(a, b, count - 1)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  sum_over_b(a, bound, count: nat): RECURSIVE real =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      sum_over_b(a, bound, count - 1)
        + sum_over_c(a, count - 1, bound)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  sum_over_a(bound, count: nat): RECURSIVE real =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      sum_over_a(bound, count - 1)
        + sum_over_b(count - 1, bound, bound)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  cube_partial_sum(bound: nat): real =
    sum_over_a(bound, bound)

  converges_to(sequence: real_sequence, value: real): bool =
    FORALL (epsilon_value: posreal):
      EXISTS (cutoff: nat):
        FORALL (bound: nat):
          cutoff <= bound IMPLIES
            abs(sequence(bound) - value) < epsilon_value

  putnam_2015_b4_solution: real =
    safe_div(17, 21)

  putnam_2015_b4: bool =
    converges_to(cube_partial_sum, putnam_2015_b4_solution)
END putnam_2015_b4

import Mathlib

open Function

abbrev putnam_2015_b5_solution : ℕ := sorry
-- 4
/--
Let $P_n$ be the number of permutations $\pi$ of $\{1,2,\dots,n\}$ such that
\[
|i-j| = 1 \mbox{ implies } |\pi(i) -\pi(j)| \leq 2
\]
for all $i,j$ in $\{1,2,\dots,n\}$. Show that for $n \geq 2$, the quantity
\[
P_{n+5} - P_{n+4} - P_{n+3} + P_n
\]
does not depend on $n$, and find its value.
-/
theorem putnam_2015_b5
(P : ℕ → ℕ)
(hP : P = fun n ↦ {pi : Finset.Icc 1 n → Finset.Icc 1 n | Bijective pi ∧ ∀ i j : Finset.Icc 1 n, Nat.dist i j = 1 → Nat.dist (pi i) (pi j) ≤ 2}.ncard)
: (∀ n : ℕ, n ≥ 2 →
    (P (n + 5) : ℤ) - (P (n + 4) : ℤ) - (P (n + 3) : ℤ) + (P n : ℤ) = putnam_2015_b5_solution) :=
sorry

title: putnam_2015_b5

;; Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2015_b5:
;; the permutation count with adjacent images at distance at most two has
;; P_(n+5) - P_(n+4) - P_(n+3) + P_n equal to 4 for every n >= 2.
;; This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

;; A permutation is represented by its image list in the domain order
;; 1,...,n. Inserting each value into every position enumerates every
;; permutation exactly once. The source condition for all i,j with
;; |i-j| = 1 is therefore exactly the adjacent-entry test below.

(defun putnam-2015-b5-range-from (start count)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix count)))
  (if (zp count)
      nil
    (cons start
          (putnam-2015-b5-range-from
           (+ start 1) (- count 1)))))

(defun putnam-2015-b5-prefix-each (value lists)
  (if (endp lists)
      nil
    (cons
     (cons value (car lists))
     (putnam-2015-b5-prefix-each value (cdr lists)))))

(defun putnam-2015-b5-insert-everywhere (value values)
  (if (endp values)
      (list (list value))
    (cons
     (cons value values)
     (putnam-2015-b5-prefix-each
      (car values)
      (putnam-2015-b5-insert-everywhere
       value (cdr values))))))

(defun putnam-2015-b5-insert-into-each (value lists)
  (if (endp lists)
      nil
    (append
     (putnam-2015-b5-insert-everywhere value (car lists))
     (putnam-2015-b5-insert-into-each value (cdr lists)))))

(defun putnam-2015-b5-permutations (values)
  (if (endp values)
      (list nil)
    (putnam-2015-b5-insert-into-each
     (car values)
     (putnam-2015-b5-permutations (cdr values)))))

(defun putnam-2015-b5-natural-distance (left right)
  (if (<= left right)
      (- right left)
    (- left right)))

(defun putnam-2015-b5-admissible-permutation-p (permutation)
  (if (and (consp permutation)
           (consp (cdr permutation)))
      (and
       (<=
        (putnam-2015-b5-natural-distance
         (car permutation) (car (cdr permutation)))
        2)
       (putnam-2015-b5-admissible-permutation-p
        (cdr permutation)))
    t))

(defun putnam-2015-b5-count-admissible (permutations)
  (if (endp permutations)
      0
    (+
     (if
         (putnam-2015-b5-admissible-permutation-p
          (car permutations))
         1
       0)
     (putnam-2015-b5-count-admissible
      (cdr permutations)))))

(defun putnam-2015-b5-p (n)
  (if (natp n)
      (putnam-2015-b5-count-admissible
       (putnam-2015-b5-permutations
        (putnam-2015-b5-range-from 1 n)))
    0))

(defun putnambench-putnam-2015-b5-statement (n)
  (implies
   (and (natp n)
        (<= 2 n))
   (equal
    (+
     (-
      (-
       (putnam-2015-b5-p (+ n 5))
       (putnam-2015-b5-p (+ n 4)))
      (putnam-2015-b5-p (+ n 3)))
     (putnam-2015-b5-p n))
    4)))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

title: putnam_2015_b5
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2015_b5
-- (putnambench__agda__putnam_2015_b5): the integer recurrence expression for
-- counts of permutations with bounded images of adjacent entries equals 4.
-- This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module Putnam2015B5 where

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Int using (Int; pos; negsuc)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; _-_)

infix 4 _<=N_
infixl 6 _+Z_ _-Z_

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

data _<=N_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set where
  zero<=N   : {n : Nat} -> zero <=N n
  suc<=sucN : {m n : Nat} -> m <=N n -> suc m <=N suc n

data Fin : Nat -> Set where
  fzero : {n : Nat} -> Fin (suc n)
  fsuc  : {n : Nat} -> Fin n -> Fin (suc n)

finToNat : {n : Nat} -> Fin n -> Nat
finToNat fzero =
  zero
finToNat (fsuc index) =
  suc (finToNat index)

natDistance : Nat -> Nat -> Nat
natDistance m n =
  (m - n) + (n - m)

one : Nat
one =
  suc zero

two : Nat
two =
  suc one

three : Nat
three =
  suc two

four : Nat
four =
  suc three

five : Nat
five =
  suc four

record IsBijective
  {A B : Set}
  (function : A -> B) :
  Set where

  field
    injective :
      (left right : A) ->
      function left == function right ->
      left == right
    surjective :
      (output : B) ->
      Exists A
        (\ input -> function input == output)

record ValidPermutation (n : Nat) : Set where
  field
    apply :
      Fin n ->
      Fin n
    bijective :
      IsBijective apply
    adjacent-image-bound :
      (i j : Fin n) ->
      natDistance (finToNat i) (finToNat j) == one ->
      natDistance (finToNat (apply i)) (finToNat (apply j)) <=N two

SameValidPermutation :
  {n : Nat} ->
  ValidPermutation n ->
  ValidPermutation n ->
  Set
SameValidPermutation {n} left right =
  (index : Fin n) ->
  ValidPermutation.apply left index ==
  ValidPermutation.apply right index

record HasExtensionalCardinality
  {A : Set}
  (equivalent : A -> A -> Set)
  (cardinality : Nat) :
  Set where

  field
    enumerate :
      Fin cardinality ->
      A
    enumeration-complete :
      (item : A) ->
      Exists (Fin cardinality)
        (\ index -> equivalent item (enumerate index))
    enumeration-injective :
      (left-index right-index : Fin cardinality) ->
      equivalent (enumerate left-index) (enumerate right-index) ->
      left-index == right-index

CountsValidPermutations :
  (Nat -> Nat) ->
  Set
CountsValidPermutations P =
  (n : Nat) ->
  HasExtensionalCardinality
    {A = ValidPermutation n}
    SameValidPermutation
    (P n)

negative : Nat -> Int
negative zero =
  pos zero
negative (suc n) =
  negsuc n

difference : Nat -> Nat -> Int
difference zero zero =
  pos zero
difference (suc m) zero =
  pos (suc m)
difference zero (suc n) =
  negsuc n
difference (suc m) (suc n) =
  difference m n

negateInt : Int -> Int
negateInt (pos n) =
  negative n
negateInt (negsuc n) =
  pos (suc n)

_+Z_ : Int -> Int -> Int
pos m +Z pos n =
  pos (m + n)
pos m +Z negsuc n =
  difference m (suc n)
negsuc m +Z pos n =
  difference n (suc m)
negsuc m +Z negsuc n =
  negsuc (suc (m + n))

_-Z_ : Int -> Int -> Int
x -Z y =
  x +Z negateInt y

recurrenceExpression :
  (Nat -> Nat) ->
  Nat ->
  Int
recurrenceExpression P n =
  ((pos (P (n + five)) -Z pos (P (n + four)))
    -Z pos (P (n + three)))
  +Z pos (P n)

putnam-2015-b5 : Set
putnam-2015-b5 =
  (P : Nat -> Nat) ->
  CountsValidPermutations P ->
  (n : Nat) ->
  two <=N n ->
  recurrenceExpression P n == pos four

:: values at distance at most two satisfies the stated constant integer
:: difference identity. This file contains no proof.

environ
  vocabularies TARSKI, XBOOLE_0, ZFMISC_1, SUBSET_1, RELAT_1, FUNCT_1,
    FUNCT_2, PARTFUN1, FINSEQ_1, FINSEQ_2, MATRIX_1, NUMBERS, NAT_1,
    INT_1, CARD_1, XCMPLX_0, XREAL_0, XXREAL_0, ORDINAL1, FINSET_1,
    ARYTM_1, ARYTM_3, CARD_3, REAL_1;
  notations TARSKI, XBOOLE_0, ZFMISC_1, SUBSET_1, ORDINAL1, CARD_1,
    NUMBERS, XCMPLX_0, XREAL_0, XXREAL_0, INT_1, NAT_1, NAT_D,
    REAL_1, RELAT_1, FUNCT_1, RELSET_1, PARTFUN1, FUNCT_2, FINSEQ_1,
    FINSEQ_2, MATRIX_0, MATRIX_1, FINSET_1;
  constructors RELSET_1, PARTFUN1, FINSEQ_4, MATRIX_1, NAT_1, NAT_D,
    XCMPLX_0, XREAL_0, XXREAL_0, REAL_1, INT_1;
  registrations XBOOLE_0, SUBSET_1, RELAT_1, FUNCT_1, RELSET_1,
    FUNCT_2, PARTFUN1, FINSEQ_1, FINSEQ_2, MATRIX_1, FINSET_1,
    ORDINAL1, CARD_1, NUMBERS, XCMPLX_0, XREAL_0, XXREAL_0, NAT_1,
    INT_1, VALUED_0, VALUED_1, MEMBERED, FRAENKEL;
  requirements BOOLE, SUBSET, NUMERALS, ARITHM, REAL;
  definitions TARSKI;
  equalities FINSEQ_1;
  expansions TARSKI, FINSEQ_1;

begin

::$P-
theorem
  for P being Function of NAT,NAT st
    (for m being Nat holds
      P.m = card {p where p is FinSequence of NAT :
        p is Permutation of Seg m &
        (for i,j being Nat st
          i in Seg m & j in Seg m &
          (i -' j = 1 or j -' i = 1)
        holds
          p/.i -' p/.j <= 2 & p/.j -' p/.i <= 2)})
  holds
    for n being Nat st 2 <= n holds
      for a,b,c,d being Integer st
        a = P.(n + 5) &
        b = P.(n + 4) &
        c = P.(n + 3) &
        d = P.n
      holds
        a - b - c + d = 4
proof
end;
::$P+

title: putnam_2015_b5
content:
% Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2015_b5:
% permutations of {1,...,n} whose adjacent positions have images at distance
% at most two yield the constant integer difference 4. This file contains no proof.

putnam_2015_b5: THEORY
BEGIN
  quotient_aux(
      numerator, denominator, fuel: nat): RECURSIVE nat =
    IF fuel = 0
        OR denominator = 0
        OR numerator < denominator THEN
      0
    ELSE
      1
        + quotient_aux(
            numerator - denominator,
            denominator,
            fuel - 1)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE fuel

  remainder_aux(
      numerator, denominator, fuel: nat): RECURSIVE nat =
    IF fuel = 0
        OR denominator = 0
        OR numerator < denominator THEN
      numerator
    ELSE
      remainder_aux(
        numerator - denominator,
        denominator,
        fuel - 1)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE fuel

  safe_ndiv(numerator, denominator: nat): nat =
    quotient_aux(
      numerator,
      denominator,
      numerator + 1)

  safe_mod(numerator, denominator: nat): nat =
    IF denominator = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      remainder_aux(
        numerator,
        denominator,
        numerator + 1)
    ENDIF

  function_code_count(n: nat): nat =
    IF n = 0 THEN 1 ELSE n ^ n ENDIF

  permutation_entry(code, index, n: nat): nat =
    IF n = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      safe_mod(safe_ndiv(code, n ^ index), n)
    ENDIF

  permutation_code(code, n: nat): bool =
    code < function_code_count(n)
      AND (FORALL (i, j: nat):
        (i < n
          AND j < n
          AND permutation_entry(code, i, n)
            = permutation_entry(code, j, n))
        IMPLIES i = j)
      AND (FORALL (value: nat):
        value < n IMPLIES
          EXISTS (i: nat):
            i < n
              AND permutation_entry(code, i, n) = value)

  nat_distance(left, right: nat): nat =
    IF left <= right THEN right - left ELSE left - right ENDIF

  admissible_permutation(code, n: nat): bool =
    permutation_code(code, n)
      AND (FORALL (i, j: nat):
        (i < n
          AND j < n
          AND nat_distance(i, j) = 1)
        IMPLIES
          nat_distance(
            permutation_entry(code, i, n),
            permutation_entry(code, j, n))
            <= 2)

  count_admissible(
      n, limit: nat): RECURSIVE nat =
    IF limit = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      count_admissible(n, limit - 1)
        + IF admissible_permutation(limit - 1, n) THEN
            1
          ELSE
            0
          ENDIF
    ENDIF
  MEASURE limit

  permutation_count(n: nat): nat =
    count_admissible(n, function_code_count(n))

  putnam_2015_b5_solution: nat = 4

  putnam_2015_b5: bool =
    FORALL (n: nat):
      n >= 2 IMPLIES
        (permutation_count(n + 5) :: int)
          - (permutation_count(n + 4) :: int)
          - (permutation_count(n + 3) :: int)
          + (permutation_count(n) :: int)
          = (putnam_2015_b5_solution :: int)
END putnam_2015_b5

import Mathlib

open Filter Topology

noncomputable abbrev putnam_2015_b6_solution : ℝ := sorry
-- Real.pi ^ 2 / 16
/--
For each positive integer $k$, let $A(k)$ be the number of odd divisors of $k$ in the interval $[1,\sqrt{2k})$. Evaluate $\sum_{k=1}^\infty (-1)^{k-1}\frac{A(k)}{k}$.
-/
theorem putnam_2015_b6
    (A : ℕ → ℕ)
    (hA : ∀ k > 0, A k = {j : ℕ | Odd j ∧ j ∣ k ∧ j < Real.sqrt (2 * k)}.encard) :
    Tendsto (fun K : ℕ ↦ ∑ k ∈ Finset.Icc 1 K, (-1 : ℝ) ^ ((k : ℝ) - 1) * (A k / (k : ℝ)))
      atTop (𝓝 putnam_2015_b6_solution) :=
  sorry

(* Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2015_b6:
   the alternating series formed from counts of odd divisors of k below
   sqrt(2k) sums to pi squared over 16. This file contains no proof. *)

From Stdlib Require Import Reals List ClassicalDescription SeqSeries.

Open Scope R_scope.

Definition putnam_2015_b6_qualifies (j k : nat) : bool :=
  if excluded_middle_informative
       (Nat.Odd j /\
        Nat.divide j k /\
        INR j < sqrt (2 * INR k))
  then true
  else false.

Definition putnam_2015_b6_divisor_count (k : nat) : nat :=
  length
    (filter
      (fun j : nat => putnam_2015_b6_qualifies j k)
      (seq 1 k)).

Definition putnam_2015_b6_solution : R :=
  PI ^ 2 / 16.

Theorem putnam_2015_b6
    (A : nat -> nat)
    (hA : forall k : nat,
      (0 < k)%nat ->
      A k = putnam_2015_b6_divisor_count k) :
  infinite_sum
    (fun n : nat =>
      (-1) ^ n * INR (A (S n)) / INR (S n))
    putnam_2015_b6_solution.
Admitted.

putnam_2015_b6
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2015_b6:
;; the alternating real series whose kth coefficient counts odd divisors of k
;; below sqrt(2k) converges to pi^2 / 16. This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

;; The terms placed under FN-EQUAL below use only ACL2 primitives and the
;; warranted SUM$+ scion. For positive k and natural j,
;; j < sqrt(2k) is equivalent to j*j < 2*k. Summing the corresponding
;; indicator for j=1,...,k therefore gives exactly the source value A(k).
;; Since the source hypothesis uniquely fixes every A(k) used by the series,
;; eliminating A is definitionally equivalent to retaining that function and
;; its defining hypothesis.
;;
;; Machin's identity
;;
;;   pi = 16*arctan(1/5) - 4*arctan(1/239)
;;
;; and exact rational Taylor prefixes give a Cauchy name for pi^2/16. A direct
;; rearrangement by odd divisors proves convergence of the series, while the
;; alternating Taylor bounds prove convergence of the Machin prefixes.
;; Positive rational tolerances are cofinal in the positive reals, so asking
;; for an existential common cutoff for every such tolerance states equality
;; of the two represented real limits exactly.

(defun putnam-2015-b6-quoted (object)
  (list 'quote object))

(defun putnam-2015-b6-list-term (terms)
  (if (consp terms)
      (list
       'cons
       (car terms)
       (putnam-2015-b6-list-term (cdr terms)))
    (putnam-2015-b6-quoted nil)))

(defun putnam-2015-b6-and-terms (terms)
  (if (consp terms)
      (list 'if
            (car terms)
            (putnam-2015-b6-and-terms (cdr terms))
            (putnam-2015-b6-quoted nil))
    (putnam-2015-b6-quoted t)))

(defun putnam-2015-b6-implies-term (hypothesis conclusion)
  (list 'if
        hypothesis
        conclusion
        (putnam-2015-b6-quoted t)))

(defun putnam-2015-b6-add-term (left right)
  (list 'binary-+ left right))

(defun putnam-2015-b6-multiply-term (left right)
  (list 'binary-* left right))

(defun putnam-2015-b6-negate-term (value)
  (list 'unary-- value))

(defun putnam-2015-b6-subtract-term (left right)
  (putnam-2015-b6-add-term
   left
   (putnam-2015-b6-negate-term right)))

(defun putnam-2015-b6-divide-term (numerator denominator)
  (putnam-2015-b6-multiply-term
   numerator
   (list 'unary-/ denominator)))

(defun putnam-2015-b6-absolute-term (value)
  (list 'if
        (list '< value (putnam-2015-b6-quoted 0))
        (putnam-2015-b6-negate-term value)
        value))

(defun putnam-2015-b6-less-equal-term (left right)
  (list 'if
        (list '< right left)
        (putnam-2015-b6-quoted nil)
        (putnam-2015-b6-quoted t)))

(defun putnam-2015-b6-range-term (lower upper)
  (list
   'from-to-by
   lower
   upper
   (putnam-2015-b6-quoted 1)))

(defun putnam-2015-b6-true-function (formals)
  (list 'lambda
        formals
        (putnam-2015-b6-quoted t)))

(defun putnam-2015-b6-divisor-indicator-function ()
  '(lambda (globals candidate)
     (if (equal (mod candidate '2) '1)
         (if (equal (mod (car globals) candidate) '0)
             (if (< (binary-* candidate candidate)
                    (binary-* '2 (car globals)))
                 '1
               '0)
           '0)
       '0)))

(defun putnam-2015-b6-divisor-count-term (k)
  (list
   'sum$+
   (putnam-2015-b6-quoted
    (putnam-2015-b6-divisor-indicator-function))
   (putnam-2015-b6-list-term (list k))
   (putnam-2015-b6-range-term
    (putnam-2015-b6-quoted 1)
    k)))

(defun putnam-2015-b6-series-summand-function ()
  (let* ((k 'index)
         (sign
          (list
           'if
           (list
            'equal
            (list 'mod k (putnam-2015-b6-quoted 2))
            (putnam-2015-b6-quoted 1))
           (putnam-2015-b6-quoted 1)
           (putnam-2015-b6-quoted -1))))
    (list
     'lambda
     '(globals index)
     (putnam-2015-b6-divide-term
      (putnam-2015-b6-multiply-term
       sign
       (putnam-2015-b6-divisor-count-term k))
      k))))

(defun putnam-2015-b6-series-prefix-term (terms)
  (list
   'sum$+
   (putnam-2015-b6-quoted
    (putnam-2015-b6-series-summand-function))
   (putnam-2015-b6-quoted nil)
   (putnam-2015-b6-range-term
    (putnam-2015-b6-quoted 1)
    terms)))

(defun putnam-2015-b6-arctan-summand-function ()
  (let* ((index 'index)
         (exponent
          (putnam-2015-b6-add-term
           (putnam-2015-b6-multiply-term
            (putnam-2015-b6-quoted 2)
            index)
           (putnam-2015-b6-quoted 1)))
         (sign
          (list
           'if
           (list
            'equal
            (list
             'mod
             index
             (putnam-2015-b6-quoted 2))
            (putnam-2015-b6-quoted 0))
           (putnam-2015-b6-quoted 1)
           (putnam-2015-b6-quoted -1))))
    (list
     'lambda
     '(globals index)
     (putnam-2015-b6-divide-term
      (putnam-2015-b6-multiply-term
       sign
       (list
        'expt
        (list 'car 'globals)
        exponent))
      exponent))))

(defun putnam-2015-b6-arctan-prefix-term (z terms)
  (list
   'sum$+
   (putnam-2015-b6-quoted
    (putnam-2015-b6-arctan-summand-function))
   (putnam-2015-b6-list-term (list z))
   (putnam-2015-b6-range-term
    (putnam-2015-b6-quoted 0)
    (putnam-2015-b6-subtract-term
     terms
     (putnam-2015-b6-quoted 1)))))

(defun putnam-2015-b6-solution-prefix-term (terms)
  (let* ((pi-prefix
          (putnam-2015-b6-subtract-term
           (putnam-2015-b6-multiply-term
            (putnam-2015-b6-quoted 16)
            (putnam-2015-b6-arctan-prefix-term
             (putnam-2015-b6-quoted 1/5)
             terms))
           (putnam-2015-b6-multiply-term
            (putnam-2015-b6-quoted 4)
            (putnam-2015-b6-arctan-prefix-term
             (putnam-2015-b6-quoted 1/239)
             terms)))))
    (putnam-2015-b6-divide-term
     (putnam-2015-b6-multiply-term
      pi-prefix
      pi-prefix)
     (putnam-2015-b6-quoted 16))))

(defun putnam-2015-b6-eventual-function (epsilon cutoff)
  (let* ((series-value
          (putnam-2015-b6-series-prefix-term 'terms))
         (solution-value
          (putnam-2015-b6-solution-prefix-term 'pi-terms))
         (error
          (putnam-2015-b6-absolute-term
           (putnam-2015-b6-subtract-term
            series-value solution-value)))
         (hypothesis
          (putnam-2015-b6-and-terms
           (list
            (list 'natp 'terms)
            (putnam-2015-b6-less-equal-term
             (putnam-2015-b6-quoted cutoff)
             'terms)
            (list 'natp 'pi-terms)
            (putnam-2015-b6-less-equal-term
             (putnam-2015-b6-quoted cutoff)
             'pi-terms)))))
    (list
     'lambda
     '(terms pi-terms)
     (putnam-2015-b6-implies-term
      hypothesis
      (list '< error (putnam-2015-b6-quoted epsilon))))))

(defun putnam-2015-b6-eventually-close-p (epsilon cutoff)
  (let ((divisor-function
         (putnam-2015-b6-divisor-indicator-function))
        (series-function
         (putnam-2015-b6-series-summand-function))
        (arctan-function
         (putnam-2015-b6-arctan-summand-function))
        (eventual-function
         (putnam-2015-b6-eventual-function epsilon cutoff))
        (true-function
         (putnam-2015-b6-true-function '(terms pi-terms))))
    (and
     (tamep-functionp divisor-function)
     (tamep-functionp series-function)
     (tamep-functionp arctan-function)
     (tamep-functionp eventual-function)
     (tamep-functionp true-function)
     (fn-equal eventual-function true-function))))

(defun-sk putnam-2015-b6-common-cutoff-exists-p (epsilon)
  (exists (cutoff)
    (and
     (natp cutoff)
     (putnam-2015-b6-eventually-close-p
      epsilon cutoff))))

(defun putnambench-putnam-2015-b6-statement (epsilon)
  (implies
   (and (rationalp epsilon)
        (< 0 epsilon))
   (putnam-2015-b6-common-cutoff-exists-p
    epsilon)))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

title: putnam_2015_b6
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2015_b6
-- (putnambench__agda__putnam_2015_b6): the alternating series formed from
-- counts of odd divisors below sqrt(2k) sums to pi squared over 16.
-- This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module Main where

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; _*_)

infix 4 _!=_ _<=N_
infixr 3 _and_
infixr 2 _or_

data Bottom : Set where

Not : Set -> Set
Not A =
  A -> Bottom

_!=_ : {A : Set} -> A -> A -> Set
x != y =
  Not (x == y)

record _and_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data _or_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  left  : A -> A or B
  right : B -> A or B

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

data _<=N_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set where
  zero<=N   : {n : Nat} -> zero <=N n
  suc<=sucN : {m n : Nat} -> m <=N n -> suc m <=N suc n

data Fin : Nat -> Set where
  fzero : {n : Nat} -> Fin (suc n)
  fsuc  : {n : Nat} -> Fin n -> Fin (suc n)

record HasCardinality
  {A : Set}
  (member : A -> Set)
  (cardinality : Nat) :
  Set where

  field
    enumerate :
      Fin cardinality ->
      A
    enumerated-member :
      (index : Fin cardinality) ->
      member (enumerate index)
    enumeration-complete :
      (item : A) ->
      member item ->
      Exists (Fin cardinality)
        (\ index -> item == enumerate index)
    enumeration-injective :
      (left-index right-index : Fin cardinality) ->
      enumerate left-index == enumerate right-index ->
      left-index == right-index

oneN : Nat
oneN =
  suc zero

twoN : Nat
twoN =
  suc oneN

fourN : Nat
fourN =
  twoN * twoN

sixteenN : Nat
sixteenN =
  fourN * fourN

Divides : Nat -> Nat -> Set
Divides divisor dividend =
  Exists Nat
    (\ quotient -> divisor * quotient == dividend)

Odd : Nat -> Set
Odd n =
  Exists Nat
    (\ m -> n == suc (twoN * m))

record CompleteOrderedRealField (R : Set) : Set1 where
  field
    zeroR oneR : R
    add multiply : R -> R -> R
    negate inverse : R -> R
    lessOrEqual : R -> R -> Set
    fromNat : Nat -> R

    one-not-zero :
      oneR != zeroR

    add-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> add x y == add y x
    add-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      add (add x y) z == add x (add y z)
    add-zero :
      (x : R) -> add x zeroR == x
    add-inverse :
      (x : R) -> add x (negate x) == zeroR

    multiply-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> multiply x y == multiply y x
    multiply-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply (multiply x y) z ==
      multiply x (multiply y z)
    multiply-one :
      (x : R) -> multiply x oneR == x
    multiply-zero :
      (x : R) -> multiply x zeroR == zeroR
    distribute :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply x (add y z) ==
      add (multiply x y) (multiply x z)
    inverse-zero :
      inverse zeroR == zeroR
    multiply-inverse :
      (x : R) ->
      x != zeroR ->
      multiply x (inverse x) == oneR

    order-reflexive :
      (x : R) -> lessOrEqual x x
    order-transitive :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y z ->
      lessOrEqual x z
    order-antisymmetric :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y x ->
      x == y
    order-total :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y or lessOrEqual y x
    add-order :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual (add z x) (add z y)
    multiply-nonnegative :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR x ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR y ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR (multiply x y)
    zero-less-than-one :
      lessOrEqual zeroR oneR and zeroR != oneR

    fromNat-zero :
      fromNat zero == zeroR
    fromNat-successor :
      (n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (suc n) == add (fromNat n) oneR
    fromNat-addition :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m + n) == add (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-multiplication :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m * n) == multiply (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-injective :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat m == fromNat n ->
      m == n

    archimedean :
      (x : R) ->
      Exists Nat
        (\ n ->
          lessOrEqual x (fromNat n))
    least-upper-bound :
      (P : R -> Set) ->
      Exists R P ->
      Exists R
        (\ upper ->
          (x : R) ->
          P x ->
          lessOrEqual x upper) ->
      Exists R
        (\ supremum ->
          ((x : R) ->
            P x ->
            lessOrEqual x supremum)
          and
          ((upper : R) ->
            ((x : R) ->
              P x ->
              lessOrEqual x upper) ->
            lessOrEqual supremum upper))

open CompleteOrderedRealField

subtract :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
subtract reals x y =
  add reals x (negate reals y)

divide :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
divide reals x y =
  multiply reals x (inverse reals y)

square :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R
square reals x =
  multiply reals x x

naturalPower :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  Nat ->
  R
naturalPower reals x zero =
  oneR reals
naturalPower reals x (suc n) =
  multiply reals
    (naturalPower reals x n)
    x

StrictLess :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
StrictLess reals x y =
  lessOrEqual reals x y and x != y

CloseTo :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
CloseTo reals center radius x =
  StrictLess reals
    (subtract reals center radius)
    x
  and
  StrictLess reals
    x
    (add reals center radius)

sumFirst :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Nat ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  R
sumFirst reals zero term =
  zeroR reals
sumFirst reals (suc n) term =
  add reals
    (sumFirst reals n term)
    (term n)

ConvergesTo :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  R ->
  Set
ConvergesTo {R} reals sequence limit =
  (epsilon : R) ->
  StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) epsilon ->
  Exists Nat
    (\ cutoff ->
      (n : Nat) ->
      cutoff <=N n ->
      CloseTo reals limit epsilon (sequence n))

SeriesHasSum :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  R ->
  Set
SeriesHasSum reals terms limit =
  ConvergesTo reals
    (\ n -> sumFirst reals n terms)
    limit

alternatingPower :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Nat ->
  R
alternatingPower reals n =
  naturalPower reals
    (negate reals (oneR reals))
    n

leibnizTerm :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Nat ->
  R
leibnizTerm reals n =
  divide reals
    (alternatingPower reals n)
    (fromNat reals (suc (twoN * n)))

record StandardPi
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) :
  Set1 where

  field
    pi : R
    pi-positive :
      StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) pi
    pi-leibniz-series :
      SeriesHasSum reals
        (leibnizTerm reals)
        (divide reals pi (fromNat reals fourN))

open StandardPi

record StandardSquareRoot
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) :
  Set1 where

  field
    squareRoot : R -> R
    square-root-nonnegative :
      (x : R) ->
      lessOrEqual reals (zeroR reals) (squareRoot x)
    square-root-square :
      (x : R) ->
      lessOrEqual reals (zeroR reals) x ->
      square reals (squareRoot x) == x
    square-root-nonpositive :
      (x : R) ->
      lessOrEqual reals x (zeroR reals) ->
      squareRoot x == zeroR reals
    square-root-unique :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual reals (zeroR reals) y ->
      square reals y == x ->
      squareRoot x == y

open StandardSquareRoot

EligibleDivisor :
  {R : Set} ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) ->
  StandardSquareRoot reals ->
  Nat ->
  Nat ->
  Set
EligibleDivisor reals roots k j =
  Odd j
  and
  Divides j k
  and
  StrictLess reals
    (fromNat reals j)
    (squareRoot roots
      (fromNat reals (twoN * k)))

putnamTerm :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (Nat -> Nat) ->
  Nat ->
  R
putnamTerm reals A n =
  multiply reals
    (alternatingPower reals n)
    (divide reals
      (fromNat reals (A (suc n)))
      (fromNat reals (suc n)))

putnamAnswer :
  {R : Set} ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) ->
  StandardPi reals ->
  R
putnamAnswer reals circle =
  divide reals
    (square reals (pi circle))
    (fromNat reals sixteenN)

putnam-2015-b6 : Set1
putnam-2015-b6 =
  (R : Set) ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) ->
  (roots : StandardSquareRoot reals) ->
  (circle : StandardPi reals) ->
  (A : Nat -> Nat) ->
  ((k : Nat) ->
    oneN <=N k ->
    HasCardinality
      (EligibleDivisor reals roots k)
      (A k)) ->
  SeriesHasSum reals
    (putnamTerm reals A)
    (putnamAnswer reals circle)

title: putnam_2015_b6
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2015_b6:
  the alternating series whose coefficients count odd divisors of each
  positive integer below the square root of twice that integer converges to
  pi squared divided by 16. This file contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open arithmeticTheory dividesTheory pred_setTheory realTheory;
open real_sigmaTheory seqTheory transcTheory;

val putnam_2015_b6 =
  ``!A : num -> num.
      (!k : num.
         0 < k
         ==>
         A k =
           CARD
             {j : num |
                ODD j /\
                divides j k /\
                (&j : real) < sqrt (2 * &k)})
      ==>
      ((((\K : num.
            SIGMA
              (\n : num.
                 (~1 : real) pow n * &(A (n + 1)) / &(n + 1))
              (count K)) : num -> real) -->
        (pi pow 2 / 16 : real))
       sequentially)``;

title: putnam_2015_b6
content:
$(
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact
  putnam_2015_b6: evaluation of the alternating series whose coefficient at
  each positive integer counts its odd divisors below sqrt(2k). This file
  contains no proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  NN0 and NN are SetMM's nonnegative and positive integers. Thus A ranges
  over the same natural-valued sequences as in the sources, while its
  defining equation is required exactly at the positive indices used by the
  series. The class

    { j e. NN | ( j e. Odd /\ ( j || k /\ j < ( sqrt ` ( 2 x. k ) ) ) ) }

  is precisely the finite set of odd positive divisors of k in
  [1,sqrt(2k)); its finite cardinality therefore matches the source encard.
  The unbounded sum_ binder is the real infinite series, and _pi is SetMM's
  real constant pi. The final declaration is the single unproved $a corpus
  statement; this database contains no $p proof declaration.
$)

${
  $d A j k $.

  putnambench-putnam-2015-b6 $a |-
    A. A
      (
        (
          A : NN0 --> NN0
          /\
          A. k e. NN
            ( A ` k )
            =
            (
              #
              `
              {
                j e. NN |
                (
                  j e. Odd
                  /\
                  (
                    j || k
                    /\
                    j < ( sqrt ` ( 2 x. k ) )
                  )
                )
              }
            )
        )
        ->
        (
          sum_ k e. NN
            (
              ( ( -u 1 ) ^ ( k - 1 ) )
              x.
              ( ( A ` k ) / k )
            )
        )
        =
        ( ( _pi ^ 2 ) / ( ; 1 6 ) )
      )
  $.
$}

:: the alternating reciprocal sum weighted by the number of odd divisors of k
:: below sqrt(2*k) converges to PI^2/16. This file contains no proof.

    SIN_COS, FRAENKEL;

begin

::$P-
theorem
  for A being Function of NAT,NAT, s being Real_Sequence st
    (for k being Nat st 0 < k holds
      A.k = card {j where j is Element of NAT :

title: putnam_2015_b6
content:
% Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2015_b6:
% the alternating real series whose kth coefficient counts odd divisors of k
% below sqrt(2k) converges to pi squared divided by 16. This file contains no
% proof.

putnam_2015_b6: THEORY
BEGIN
  real_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> real]

  safe_div(numerator, denominator: real): real =
    IF denominator = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      numerator / denominator
    ENDIF

  alternating_sign(index: nat): RECURSIVE real =
    IF index = 0 THEN
      1
    ELSE
      -alternating_sign(index - 1)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE index

  count_below(
      limit: nat,
      property: [nat -> bool]): RECURSIVE nat =
    IF limit = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      count_below(limit - 1, property)
        + IF property(limit - 1) THEN 1 ELSE 0 ENDIF
    ENDIF
  MEASURE limit

  nat_divides(divisor, value: nat): bool =
    EXISTS (quotient: nat):
      value = divisor * quotient

  odd_nat(value: nat): bool =
    EXISTS (half: nat):
      value = 2 * half + 1

  eligible_divisor(j, k: nat): bool =
    odd_nat(j)
      AND nat_divides(j, k)
      AND j * j < 2 * k

  divisor_count(k: nat): nat =
    count_below(
      k + 1,
      LAMBDA (j: nat): eligible_divisor(j, k))

  series_partial_sum(
      A: [nat -> nat],
      count: nat): RECURSIVE real =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      series_partial_sum(A, count - 1)
        + safe_div(
            alternating_sign(count - 1) * (A(count) :: real),
            count :: real)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  leibniz_partial_sum(count: nat): RECURSIVE real =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      LET index: nat = count - 1 IN
        leibniz_partial_sum(count - 1)
          + safe_div(
              alternating_sign(index),
              (2 * index + 1) :: real)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  converges_to(sequence: real_sequence, value: real): bool =
    FORALL (epsilon_value: posreal):
      EXISTS (cutoff: nat):
        FORALL (count: nat):
          cutoff <= count IMPLIES
            abs(sequence(count) - value) < epsilon_value

  pi: real =
    epsilon(
      LAMBDA (value: real):
        converges_to(
          LAMBDA (count: nat):
            4 * leibniz_partial_sum(count),
          value))

  putnam_2015_b6: bool =
    FORALL (A: [nat -> nat]):
      (FORALL (k: nat):
        k > 0 IMPLIES A(k) = divisor_count(k))
      IMPLIES
        converges_to(
          LAMBDA (count: nat):
            series_partial_sum(A, count),
          safe_div(pi ^ 2, 16))
END putnam_2015_b6

title: putnam_2016_a1

(* Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench artifact putnam_2016_a1:
   the least positive derivative order for which every integer-coefficient
   polynomial has values divisible by 2016 at every integer. This file
   contains no proof. *)

From Stdlib Require Import ZArith Lists.List.

Open Scope Z_scope.

Definition putnam_2016_a1_polynomial : Type := list Z.

Fixpoint putnam_2016_a1_eval
    (P : putnam_2016_a1_polynomial) (x : Z) : Z :=
  match P with
  | nil => 0
  | coefficient :: remaining =>
      coefficient + x * putnam_2016_a1_eval remaining x
  end.

Fixpoint putnam_2016_a1_derivative_coefficients
    (degree : nat)
    (P : putnam_2016_a1_polynomial) :
    putnam_2016_a1_polynomial :=
  match P with
  | nil => nil
  | coefficient :: remaining =>
      (Z.of_nat degree * coefficient) ::
      putnam_2016_a1_derivative_coefficients (S degree) remaining
  end.

Definition putnam_2016_a1_derivative
    (P : putnam_2016_a1_polynomial) :
    putnam_2016_a1_polynomial :=
  match P with
  | nil => nil
  | _ :: remaining =>
      putnam_2016_a1_derivative_coefficients 1 remaining
  end.

Fixpoint putnam_2016_a1_iterated_derivative
    (order : nat)
    (P : putnam_2016_a1_polynomial) :
    putnam_2016_a1_polynomial :=
  match order with
  | O => P
  | S previous =>
      putnam_2016_a1_derivative
        (putnam_2016_a1_iterated_derivative previous P)
  end.

Definition putnam_2016_a1_qualifies (j : nat) : Prop :=
  (0 < j)%nat /\
  forall (P : putnam_2016_a1_polynomial) (k : Z),
    Z.divide 2016
      (putnam_2016_a1_eval
        (putnam_2016_a1_iterated_derivative j P) k).

Definition putnam_2016_a1_solution : nat := 8%nat.

Theorem putnam_2016_a1 :
  putnam_2016_a1_qualifies putnam_2016_a1_solution /\
  forall j : nat,
    putnam_2016_a1_qualifies j ->
    (putnam_2016_a1_solution <= j)%nat.
Admitted.
