title: putnam_2016_a1
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2016_a1:
;; the least positive derivative order for which every integer polynomial has
;; value divisible by 2016 at every integer input is 8. This file contains no
;; proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

;; Coefficients are listed in ascending degree order. Every integer polynomial
;; has such a finite coefficient list, so this is an exact representation of
;; the source polynomial type rather than a finite table of polynomial values.
(defun putnam-2016-a1-integer-polynomial-p (polynomial)
  (if (consp polynomial)
      (and (integerp (car polynomial))
           (putnam-2016-a1-integer-polynomial-p
            (cdr polynomial)))
    (equal polynomial nil)))

(defun putnam-2016-a1-polynomial-value (polynomial x)
  (if (consp polynomial)
      (+ (car polynomial)
         (* x
            (putnam-2016-a1-polynomial-value
             (cdr polynomial) x)))
    0))

(defun putnam-2016-a1-derivative-aux
    (coefficients degree)
  (if (consp coefficients)
      (cons (* degree (car coefficients))
            (putnam-2016-a1-derivative-aux
             (cdr coefficients) (+ degree 1)))
    nil))

(defun putnam-2016-a1-derivative (polynomial)
  (if (consp polynomial)
      (putnam-2016-a1-derivative-aux
       (cdr polynomial) 1)
    nil))

(defun putnam-2016-a1-iterated-derivative
    (polynomial order)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix order)))
  (if (zp order)
      polynomial
    (putnam-2016-a1-iterated-derivative
     (putnam-2016-a1-derivative polynomial)
     (- order 1))))

(defun putnam-2016-a1-divisible-value-p
    (polynomial order x)
  (equal
   (mod
    (putnam-2016-a1-polynomial-value
     (putnam-2016-a1-iterated-derivative
      polynomial order)
     x)
    2016)
   0))

(defun putnam-2016-a1-zero-list (count)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix count)))
  (if (zp count)
      nil
    (cons 0
          (putnam-2016-a1-zero-list (- count 1)))))

;; This coefficient list denotes x^order. Its order-th derivative at zero is
;; order!, providing an internal counterexample for each order from 1 to 7.
(defun putnam-2016-a1-monomial-witness (order)
  (append (putnam-2016-a1-zero-list order)
          (list 1)))

(defun putnam-2016-a1-lower-orders-fail-p (order)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix order)))
  (if (zp order)
      t
    (and
     (not
      (putnam-2016-a1-divisible-value-p
       (putnam-2016-a1-monomial-witness order)
       order
       0))
     (putnam-2016-a1-lower-orders-fail-p
      (- order 1)))))

(defun putnam-2016-a1-solution ()
  8)

;; Universal closure over POLYNOMIAL and K is the source's quantification over
;; every integer polynomial and integer evaluation point. Since the solution
;; is 8, the explicit counterexamples for orders 1 through 7 are exactly the
;; lower-bound half of IsLeast.
(defun putnambench-putnam-2016-a1-statement
    (polynomial k)
  (and
   (putnam-2016-a1-lower-orders-fail-p
    (- (putnam-2016-a1-solution) 1))
   (implies
    (and
     (putnam-2016-a1-integer-polynomial-p polynomial)
     (integerp k))
    (putnam-2016-a1-divisible-value-p
     polynomial
     (putnam-2016-a1-solution)
     k))))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

title: putnam_2016_a1
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2016_a1
-- (putnambench__agda__putnam_2016_a1): the smallest positive derivative
-- order for which every integer polynomial has values divisible by 2016 at
-- every integer argument is 8. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module Putnam2016A1 where

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Int using (Int; pos; negsuc)
open import Agda.Builtin.List using (List; []; _∷_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; _*_)

infix 4 _<=N_
infixr 3 _and_

record _and_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

data _<=N_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set where
  zero<=N   : {n : Nat} -> zero <=N n
  suc<=sucN : {m n : Nat} -> m <=N n -> suc m <=N suc n

one : Nat
one =
  suc zero

eight : Nat
eight =
  8

Positive : Nat -> Set
Positive n =
  one <=N n

negativeNat : Nat -> Int
negativeNat zero =
  pos zero
negativeNat (suc n) =
  negsuc n

differenceNat : Nat -> Nat -> Int
differenceNat zero zero =
  pos zero
differenceNat (suc m) zero =
  pos (suc m)
differenceNat zero (suc n) =
  negsuc n
differenceNat (suc m) (suc n) =
  differenceNat m n

addInt : Int -> Int -> Int
addInt (pos m) (pos n) =
  pos (m + n)
addInt (pos m) (negsuc n) =
  differenceNat m (suc n)
addInt (negsuc m) (pos n) =
  differenceNat n (suc m)
addInt (negsuc m) (negsuc n) =
  negsuc (suc (m + n))

multiplyInt : Int -> Int -> Int
multiplyInt (pos m) (pos n) =
  pos (m * n)
multiplyInt (pos m) (negsuc n) =
  negativeNat (m * suc n)
multiplyInt (negsuc m) (pos n) =
  negativeNat (suc m * n)
multiplyInt (negsuc m) (negsuc n) =
  pos (suc m * suc n)

Polynomial : Set
Polynomial =
  List Int

evaluate : Polynomial -> Int -> Int
evaluate [] x =
  pos zero
evaluate (coefficient ∷ coefficients) x =
  addInt coefficient
    (multiplyInt x (evaluate coefficients x))

derivativeFrom : Nat -> Polynomial -> Polynomial
derivativeFrom multiplier [] =
  []
derivativeFrom multiplier (coefficient ∷ coefficients) =
  multiplyInt (pos multiplier) coefficient
  ∷ derivativeFrom (suc multiplier) coefficients

derivative : Polynomial -> Polynomial
derivative [] =
  []
derivative (constant ∷ coefficients) =
  derivativeFrom one coefficients

iterateDerivative : Nat -> Polynomial -> Polynomial
iterateDerivative zero polynomial =
  polynomial
iterateDerivative (suc order) polynomial =
  iterateDerivative order (derivative polynomial)

DividesInt : Int -> Int -> Set
DividesInt divisor dividend =
  Exists Int
    (\ quotient ->
      multiplyInt divisor quotient == dividend)

modulus : Int
modulus =
  pos 2016

GoodOrder : Nat -> Set
GoodOrder order =
  Positive order
  and
  ((polynomial : Polynomial) ->
    (argument : Int) ->
    DividesInt modulus
      (evaluate (iterateDerivative order polynomial) argument))

putnam-2016-a1 : Set
putnam-2016-a1 =
  GoodOrder eight
  and
  ((order : Nat) ->
    GoodOrder order ->
    eight <=N order)

  the least positive derivative order for which every integer-coefficient
  polynomial has values divisible by 2016 at every integer is 8. This file

val putnam_2016_a1 =

      \coeffs : int list.

      derivative =

content:
% Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2016_a1:
% the least positive derivative order for which every integer-coefficient
% polynomial has value divisible by 2016 at every integer input is 8. This
% file contains no proof.

putnam_2016_a1: THEORY
BEGIN
  integer_polynomial: TYPE = list[int]

  polynomial_value(
      polynomial: integer_polynomial,
      x: int): RECURSIVE int =
    CASES polynomial OF
      null: 0,
      cons(coefficient, tail):
        coefficient + x * polynomial_value(tail, x)
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE polynomial BY <<

  derivative_from(
      polynomial: integer_polynomial,
      degree: nat): RECURSIVE integer_polynomial =
    CASES polynomial OF
      null: null,
      cons(coefficient, tail):
        cons(
          (degree :: int) * coefficient,
          derivative_from(tail, degree + 1))
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE polynomial BY <<

  derivative(
      polynomial: integer_polynomial): integer_polynomial =
    CASES polynomial OF
      null: null,
      cons(constant_coefficient, tail):
        derivative_from(tail, 1)
    ENDCASES

  iterated_derivative(
      polynomial: integer_polynomial,
      order: nat): RECURSIVE integer_polynomial =
    IF order = 0 THEN
      polynomial
    ELSE
      iterated_derivative(
        derivative(polynomial),
        order - 1)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE order

  divisible_by_2016(value: int): bool =
    EXISTS (quotient: int):
      value = 2016 * quotient

  good_order(order: nat): bool =
    order > 0
      AND FORALL
          (polynomial: integer_polynomial),
          (k: int):
        divisible_by_2016(
          polynomial_value(
            iterated_derivative(polynomial, order),
            k))

  putnam_2016_a1_solution: nat = 8

  putnam_2016_a1: bool =
    good_order(putnam_2016_a1_solution)
      AND FORALL (order: nat):
        good_order(order)
          IMPLIES putnam_2016_a1_solution <= order
END putnam_2016_a1

content:
;; Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2016_a2:
;; the greatest positive integer satisfying a binomial inequality, divided by
;; its index, converges to (3 + sqrt(5)) / 2. This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))

;; Pascal recursion gives the natural-number binomial coefficients used in the
;; source. DEFUN-SK keeps the greatest-value, cutoff, and tail quantifiers
;; internal to the statement.

(defun putnam-2016-a2-binomial (n k)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix n)))
  (if (or (zp k)
          (zp n))
      (if (zp k) 1 0)
    (+ (putnam-2016-a2-binomial (- n 1) k)
       (putnam-2016-a2-binomial
        (- n 1) (- k 1)))))

(defun putnam-2016-a2-qualifies-p (n m)
  (and
   (posp n)
   (posp m)
   (<
    (putnam-2016-a2-binomial (- m 1) n)
    (putnam-2016-a2-binomial m (- n 1)))))

(defun-sk putnam-2016-a2-upper-bound-p (n m)
  (forall (candidate)
    (implies
     (and
      (natp candidate)
      (putnam-2016-a2-qualifies-p n candidate))
     (<= candidate m))))

(defun putnam-2016-a2-greatest-p (n m)
  (and
   (natp m)
   (putnam-2016-a2-qualifies-p n m)
   (putnam-2016-a2-upper-bound-p n m)))

(defun-sk putnam-2016-a2-greatest-exists-at-p (n)
  (exists (m)
    (putnam-2016-a2-greatest-p n m)))

(defun-sk putnam-2016-a2-greatest-values-exist-p ()
  (forall (n)
    (implies
     (posp n)
     (putnam-2016-a2-greatest-exists-at-p n))))

;; ACL2 numbers do not contain irrational reals. For rational x, comparison
;; with alpha = (3 + sqrt(5))/2 is represented exactly using
;; q(x) = x^2 - 3*x + 1:
;;
;;   alpha < x  iff  3/2 < x and 0 < q(x),
;;   x < alpha  iff  x < 3/2 or q(x) < 0.
;;
;; Since every M(n)/n is rational and positive rationals are cofinal among
;; positive real tolerances, quantifying over positive rational epsilon is
;; equivalent to the source real epsilon definition of convergence.

(defun putnam-2016-a2-root-polynomial (x)
  (+ (* x x)
     (- (* 3 x))
     1))

(defun putnam-2016-a2-solution-less-than-p (x)
  (and
   (rationalp x)
   (< 3/2 x)
   (< 0 (putnam-2016-a2-root-polynomial x))))

(defun putnam-2016-a2-less-than-solution-p (x)
  (and
   (rationalp x)
   (or
    (< x 3/2)
    (< (putnam-2016-a2-root-polynomial x) 0))))

(defun putnam-2016-a2-within-solution-p (x epsilon)
  (and
   (rationalp x)
   (rationalp epsilon)
   (< 0 epsilon)
   (putnam-2016-a2-solution-less-than-p
    (+ x epsilon))
   (putnam-2016-a2-less-than-solution-p
    (- x epsilon))))

(defun-sk putnam-2016-a2-limit-tail-p (epsilon cutoff)
  (forall (n m)
    (implies
     (and
      (posp n)
      (natp m)
      (<= cutoff n)
      (putnam-2016-a2-greatest-p n m))
     (putnam-2016-a2-within-solution-p
      (/ m n)
      epsilon))))

(defun-sk putnam-2016-a2-cutoff-exists-p (epsilon)
  (exists (cutoff)
    (and
     (natp cutoff)
     (putnam-2016-a2-limit-tail-p
      epsilon cutoff))))

(defun-sk putnam-2016-a2-converges-p ()
  (forall (epsilon)
    (implies
     (and
      (rationalp epsilon)
      (< 0 epsilon))
     (putnam-2016-a2-cutoff-exists-p epsilon))))

(defun putnambench-putnam-2016-a2-statement ()
  (implies
   (putnam-2016-a2-greatest-values-exist-p)
   (putnam-2016-a2-converges-p)))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

title: putnam_2016_a2
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2016_a2
-- (putnambench__agda__putnam_2016_a2): the limit of the largest positive
-- integer selected by a binomial-coefficient inequality is (3 + sqrt 5) / 2.
-- This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module Putnam2016A2 where

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; _-_; _*_)

infix 4 _!=_ _<=N_ _<N_
infixr 3 _and_
infixr 2 _or_

data Bottom : Set where

Not : Set -> Set
Not A =
  A -> Bottom

_!=_ : {A : Set} -> A -> A -> Set
x != y =
  Not (x == y)

record _and_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data _or_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  left  : A -> A or B
  right : B -> A or B

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

data _<=N_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set where
  zero<=N   : {n : Nat} -> zero <=N n
  suc<=sucN : {m n : Nat} -> m <=N n -> suc m <=N suc n

data _<N_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set where
  zero<N   : {n : Nat} -> zero <N suc n
  suc<sucN : {m n : Nat} -> m <N n -> suc m <N suc n

data Positive : Nat -> Set where
  positive : {n : Nat} -> Positive (suc n)

oneN : Nat
oneN =
  suc zero

twoN : Nat
twoN =
  suc oneN

threeN : Nat
threeN =
  suc twoN

fiveN : Nat
fiveN =
  suc (suc threeN)

choose : Nat -> Nat -> Nat
choose n zero =
  oneN
choose zero (suc k) =
  zero
choose (suc n) (suc k) =
  choose n (suc k) + choose n k

record CompleteOrderedRealField (R : Set) : Set1 where
  field
    zeroR oneR : R
    add multiply : R -> R -> R
    negate inverse : R -> R
    lessOrEqual : R -> R -> Set
    fromNat : Nat -> R

    one-not-zero :
      oneR != zeroR

    add-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> add x y == add y x
    add-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      add (add x y) z == add x (add y z)
    add-zero :
      (x : R) -> add x zeroR == x
    add-inverse :
      (x : R) -> add x (negate x) == zeroR

    multiply-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> multiply x y == multiply y x
    multiply-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply (multiply x y) z ==
      multiply x (multiply y z)
    multiply-one :
      (x : R) -> multiply x oneR == x
    multiply-zero :
      (x : R) -> multiply x zeroR == zeroR
    distribute :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply x (add y z) ==
      add (multiply x y) (multiply x z)
    inverse-zero :
      inverse zeroR == zeroR
    multiply-inverse :
      (x : R) ->
      x != zeroR ->
      multiply x (inverse x) == oneR

    order-reflexive :
      (x : R) -> lessOrEqual x x
    order-transitive :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y z ->
      lessOrEqual x z
    order-antisymmetric :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y x ->
      x == y
    order-total :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y or lessOrEqual y x
    add-order :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual (add z x) (add z y)
    multiply-nonnegative :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR x ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR y ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR (multiply x y)
    zero-less-than-one :
      lessOrEqual zeroR oneR and zeroR != oneR

    fromNat-zero :
      fromNat zero == zeroR
    fromNat-successor :
      (n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (suc n) == add (fromNat n) oneR
    fromNat-addition :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m + n) == add (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-multiplication :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m * n) == multiply (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-injective :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat m == fromNat n ->
      m == n

    archimedean :
      (x : R) ->
      Exists Nat
        (\ n -> lessOrEqual x (fromNat n))
    least-upper-bound :
      (P : R -> Set) ->
      Exists R P ->
      Exists R
        (\ upper ->
          (x : R) ->
          P x ->
          lessOrEqual x upper) ->
      Exists R
        (\ supremum ->
          ((x : R) ->
            P x ->
            lessOrEqual x supremum)
          and
          ((upper : R) ->
            ((x : R) ->
              P x ->
              lessOrEqual x upper) ->
            lessOrEqual supremum upper))

open CompleteOrderedRealField

subtract :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
subtract reals x y =
  add reals x (negate reals y)

divide :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
divide reals x y =
  multiply reals x (inverse reals y)

square :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R
square reals x =
  multiply reals x x

StrictLess :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
StrictLess reals x y =
  lessOrEqual reals x y and x != y

CloseTo :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
CloseTo reals center radius x =
  StrictLess reals
    (subtract reals center radius)
    x
  and
  StrictLess reals
    x
    (add reals center radius)

ConvergesTo :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  R ->
  Set
ConvergesTo {R} reals sequence limit =
  (epsilon : R) ->
  StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) epsilon ->
  Exists Nat
    (\ cutoff ->
      (n : Nat) ->
      cutoff <=N n ->
      CloseTo reals limit epsilon (sequence n))

record StandardSquareRoot
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) :
  Set1 where

  field
    squareRoot : R -> R

    square-root-nonnegative :
      (x : R) ->
      lessOrEqual reals (zeroR reals) (squareRoot x)
    square-root-square :
      (x : R) ->
      lessOrEqual reals (zeroR reals) x ->
      square reals (squareRoot x) == x
    square-root-nonpositive :
      (x : R) ->
      lessOrEqual reals x (zeroR reals) ->
      squareRoot x == zeroR reals
    square-root-unique :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual reals (zeroR reals) y ->
      square reals y == x ->
      squareRoot x == y

open StandardSquareRoot

Qualifies : Nat -> Nat -> Set
Qualifies n m =
  Positive m
  and
  choose (m - oneN) n <N choose m (n - oneN)

GreatestQualifying : Nat -> Nat -> Set
GreatestQualifying n greatest =
  Qualifies n greatest
  and
  ((m : Nat) ->
    Qualifies n m ->
    m <=N greatest)

DefinesM : (Nat -> Nat) -> Set
DefinesM M =
  (n : Nat) ->
  Positive n ->
  GreatestQualifying n (M n)

module Putnam2016A2Statement
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R)
  (roots : StandardSquareRoot reals) where

  solution : R
  solution =
    divide reals
      (add reals
        (fromNat reals threeN)
        (squareRoot roots (fromNat reals fiveN)))
      (fromNat reals twoN)

  ratio : (Nat -> Nat) -> Nat -> R
  ratio M n =
    divide reals
      (fromNat reals (M n))
      (fromNat reals n)

  proposition : Set
  proposition =
    (M : Nat -> Nat) ->
    DefinesM M ->
    ConvergesTo reals (ratio M) solution

putnam-2016-a2 : Set1
putnam-2016-a2 =
  (R : Set) ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) ->
  (roots : StandardSquareRoot reals) ->
  Putnam2016A2Statement.proposition reals roots

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  M ranges over all nonnegative-integer-valued sequences. For each positive
  integer n, the antecedent says that M(n) is positive and satisfies

    ((M(n) - 1) choose n) < (M(n) choose (n - 1)),

  and that every positive integer m satisfying the same inequality is at
  most M(n). These two clauses are exactly the source IsGreatest condition.

  The value M(0) is unconstrained, as in the source formalizations, and does
  not affect the sequence limit. SetMM's _C is the binomial-coefficient
  operation, sqrt is the nonnegative real square root on 5, and ~~> is
  standard real-sequence convergence. The final declaration is the single
  unproved $a corpus statement; this database contains no $p proof statement.
$)

${
  $d M m n $.

  putnambench-putnam-2016-a2 $a |- A. M e. ( NN0 ^m NN0 )
    (
      (
        A. n e. NN
          (
            (
              (
                0 < ( M ` n )
                /\
                ( ( ( M ` n ) - 1 ) _C n )
                <
                ( ( M ` n ) _C ( n - 1 ) )
              )
              /\
              A. m e. NN
                (
                  (
                    ( ( m - 1 ) _C n )
                    <
                    ( m _C ( n - 1 ) )
                  )
                  ->
                  m <_ ( M ` n )
                )
            )
          )
      )
      ->
      (
        n e. NN0 |->
          (
            ( M ` n )
            /
            n
          )
      )
      ~~>
      (
        ( 3 + ( sqrt ` 5 ) )
        /
        2
      )
    )
  $.
$}

:: Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2016_a2:
:: the ratio M(n)/n, where M(n) is the greatest positive integer satisfying
:: the stated binomial-coefficient inequality, converges to (3+sqrt(5))/2.
:: This file contains no proof.

environ
  vocabularies TARSKI, XBOOLE_0, SUBSET_1, RELAT_1, FUNCT_1, FUNCT_2,
    NUMBERS, XREAL_0, XCMPLX_0, COMPLEX1, CARD_1, XXREAL_0, ARYTM_1,
    ARYTM_3, SQUARE_1, REAL_1, NAT_1, VALUED_0, VALUED_1, SEQ_1,
    SEQ_2, ORDINAL1, ORDINAL2, SEQ_4, NEWTON;
  notations TARSKI, XBOOLE_0, SUBSET_1, RELAT_1, FUNCT_1, RELSET_1,
    FUNCT_2, ORDINAL1, CARD_1, NUMBERS, XCMPLX_0, XREAL_0, REAL_1,
    COMPLEX1, SQUARE_1, XXREAL_0, NAT_1, NAT_D, VALUED_0, VALUED_1,
    SEQ_1, SEQ_2, COMSEQ_2, SEQM_3, SEQ_4, NEWTON;
  constructors FUNCT_1, RELSET_1, FUNCT_2, CARD_1, REAL_1, SQUARE_1,
    COMPLEX1, XXREAL_0, NAT_1, NAT_D, SEQ_2, SEQM_3, SEQ_4,
    BINOP_2, COMSEQ_2, NEWTON;
  registrations XBOOLE_0, SUBSET_1, RELAT_1, FUNCT_1, RELSET_1,
    FUNCT_2, NUMBERS, CARD_1, XXREAL_0, MEMBERED, VALUED_0,
    VALUED_1, XCMPLX_0, XREAL_0, SQUARE_1, ORDINAL1, NAT_1, SEQ_4,
    NEWTON;
  requirements REAL, NUMERALS, SUBSET, BOOLE, ARITHM;

begin

::$P-
theorem
  for M being Function of NAT,NAT st
    (for n being Nat st 0 < n holds
      0 < M.n &
      ((M.n -' 1) choose n) < (M.n choose (n -' 1)) &
      (for m being Nat st
        0 < m &
        ((m -' 1) choose n) < (m choose (n -' 1))
      holds m <= M.n))
  holds
    ex s being Real_Sequence st
      (for n being Nat holds
        s.n = (M.n qua Real) / (n qua Real)) &
      s is convergent &
      lim s = (3 + sqrt 5) / 2
proof
end;
::$P+

title: putnam_2016_a2
content:
% Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2016_a2:
% the greatest positive integer satisfying a binomial-coefficient inequality,
% divided by its positive index, converges to (3 + sqrt(5)) / 2. This file
% contains no proof.

putnam_2016_a2: THEORY
BEGIN
  natural_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> nat]
  real_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> real]

  binomial_coefficient(n, k: nat): RECURSIVE nat =
    IF k = 0 THEN
      1
    ELSIF n = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      binomial_coefficient(n - 1, k - 1)
        + binomial_coefficient(n - 1, k)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE n

  nat_predecessor(value: nat): nat =
    IF value = 0 THEN 0 ELSE value - 1 ENDIF

  qualifies(n, m: nat): bool =
    m > 0
      AND binomial_coefficient(nat_predecessor(m), n)
        < binomial_coefficient(m, nat_predecessor(n))

  is_greatest_qualifying_sequence(M: natural_sequence): bool =
    FORALL (n: nat):
      n > 0 IMPLIES
        qualifies(n, M(n))
          AND (FORALL (m: nat):
            qualifies(n, m) IMPLIES m <= M(n))

  safe_div(numerator, denominator: real): real =
    IF denominator = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      numerator / denominator
    ENDIF

  normalized_sequence(M: natural_sequence): real_sequence =
    LAMBDA (n: nat):
      safe_div(M(n) :: real, n :: real)

  converges_to(sequence: real_sequence, value: real): bool =
    FORALL (epsilon_value: posreal):
      EXISTS (cutoff: nat):
        FORALL (n: nat):
          cutoff <= n IMPLIES
            abs(sequence(n) - value) < epsilon_value

  nonnegative_square_root(root, radicand: real): bool =
    root >= 0 AND root * root = radicand

  solution_value(sqrt_five: real): real =
    safe_div(3 + sqrt_five, 2)

  putnam_2016_a2: bool =
    FORALL (M: natural_sequence):
      is_greatest_qualifying_sequence(M) IMPLIES
        EXISTS (sqrt_five: real):
          nonnegative_square_root(sqrt_five, 5)
            AND converges_to(
              normalized_sequence(M),
              solution_value(sqrt_five))
END putnam_2016_a2

import Mathlib

open Polynomial Filter Topology Real Set Nat

noncomputable abbrev putnam_2016_a3_solution : ℝ := sorry
-- 3 * Real.pi / 8
/--
Suppose that $f$ is a function from $\mathbb{R}$ to $\mathbb{R}$ such that
\[
f(x) + f\left( 1 - \frac{1}{x} \right) = \arctan x
\]
for all real $x \neq 0$. (As usual, $y = \arctan x$ means $-\pi/2 < y < \pi/2$ and $\tan y = x$.) Find
\[
\int_0^1 f(x)\,dx.
\]
-/
theorem putnam_2016_a3
(f : ℝ → ℝ)
(hf : ∀ x : ℝ, x ≠ 0 → f x + f (1 - 1 / x) = arctan x)
: (∫ x in (0)..1, f x = putnam_2016_a3_solution) :=
sorry

title: putnam_2016_a3
putnam_2016_a3
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2016_a3:
;; every real-valued function satisfying
;; f(x) + f(1 - 1/x) = arctan(x) for every nonzero real x has integral
;; 3*pi/8 on [0,1]. This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))

;; These conservative interfaces present a real carrier, its ordered-field
;; operations, arbitrary subsets and real-valued functions, and the analytic
;; constants in the source statement.

(defstub p16a3-real-p (real-type value) t)
(defstub p16a3-zero (real-type) t)
(defstub p16a3-one (real-type) t)
(defstub p16a3-add (real-type left right) t)
(defstub p16a3-mul (real-type left right) t)
(defstub p16a3-neg (real-type value) t)
(defstub p16a3-inv (real-type value) t)
(defstub p16a3-lt (real-type left right) t)

(defstub p16a3-set-member-p (real-type set value) t)
(defstub p16a3-function-value (real-type function argument) t)

(defstub p16a3-pi (real-type) t)
(defstub p16a3-arctan (real-type value) t)

(defun p16a3-sub (real-type x y)
  (p16a3-add real-type x (p16a3-neg real-type y)))

(defun p16a3-le (real-type x y)
  (not (p16a3-lt real-type y x)))

(defun p16a3-div (real-type x y)
  (p16a3-mul real-type x (p16a3-inv real-type y)))

(defun p16a3-abs (real-type x)
  (if (p16a3-lt real-type x (p16a3-zero real-type))
      (p16a3-neg real-type x)
    x))

(defun p16a3-two (real-type)
  (p16a3-add
   real-type
   (p16a3-one real-type)
   (p16a3-one real-type)))

(defun p16a3-four (real-type)
  (p16a3-add
   real-type
   (p16a3-two real-type)
   (p16a3-two real-type)))

(defun p16a3-nat-value (real-type n)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix n)))
  (if (zp n)
      (p16a3-zero real-type)
    (p16a3-add
     real-type
     (p16a3-one real-type)
     (p16a3-nat-value real-type (1- n)))))

;; A complete Archimedean ordered-field presentation of the real numbers.

(defun-sk p16a3-operation-closure-p (real-type)
  (forall (x y)
    (and
     (p16a3-real-p real-type (p16a3-zero real-type))
     (p16a3-real-p real-type (p16a3-one real-type))
     (implies
      (p16a3-real-p real-type x)
      (and
       (p16a3-real-p real-type (p16a3-neg real-type x))
       (p16a3-real-p real-type (p16a3-inv real-type x))))
     (implies
      (and
       (p16a3-real-p real-type x)
       (p16a3-real-p real-type y))
      (and
       (p16a3-real-p real-type (p16a3-add real-type x y))
       (p16a3-real-p real-type (p16a3-mul real-type x y)))))))

(defun-sk p16a3-unary-field-laws-p (real-type)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (p16a3-real-p real-type x)
     (let ((zero (p16a3-zero real-type))
           (one (p16a3-one real-type)))
       (and
        (equal (p16a3-add real-type zero x) x)
        (equal (p16a3-add real-type x zero) x)
        (equal
         (p16a3-add real-type x (p16a3-neg real-type x))
         zero)
        (equal
         (p16a3-add real-type (p16a3-neg real-type x) x)
         zero)
        (equal (p16a3-mul real-type one x) x)
        (equal (p16a3-mul real-type x one) x)
        (implies
         (equal x zero)
         (equal (p16a3-inv real-type x) zero))
        (implies
         (not (equal x zero))
         (and
          (equal
           (p16a3-mul real-type x (p16a3-inv real-type x))
           one)
          (equal
           (p16a3-mul real-type (p16a3-inv real-type x) x)
           one))))))))

(defun-sk p16a3-binary-field-laws-p (real-type)
  (forall (x y)
    (implies
     (and
      (p16a3-real-p real-type x)
      (p16a3-real-p real-type y))
     (and
      (equal
       (p16a3-add real-type x y)
       (p16a3-add real-type y x))
      (equal
       (p16a3-mul real-type x y)
       (p16a3-mul real-type y x))))))

(defun-sk p16a3-ternary-field-laws-p (real-type)
  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (p16a3-real-p real-type x)
      (p16a3-real-p real-type y)
      (p16a3-real-p real-type z))
     (and
      (equal
       (p16a3-add real-type (p16a3-add real-type x y) z)
       (p16a3-add real-type x (p16a3-add real-type y z)))
      (equal
       (p16a3-mul real-type (p16a3-mul real-type x y) z)
       (p16a3-mul real-type x (p16a3-mul real-type y z)))
      (equal
       (p16a3-mul
        real-type x (p16a3-add real-type y z))
       (p16a3-add
        real-type
        (p16a3-mul real-type x y)
        (p16a3-mul real-type x z)))))))

(defun-sk p16a3-order-laws-p (real-type)
  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (p16a3-real-p real-type x)
      (p16a3-real-p real-type y)
      (p16a3-real-p real-type z))
     (and
      (not (p16a3-lt real-type x x))
      (implies
       (and
        (p16a3-lt real-type x y)
        (p16a3-lt real-type y z))
       (p16a3-lt real-type x z))
      (or
       (p16a3-lt real-type x y)
       (equal x y)
       (p16a3-lt real-type y x))
      (implies
       (p16a3-lt real-type x y)
       (p16a3-lt
        real-type
        (p16a3-add real-type x z)
        (p16a3-add real-type y z)))
      (implies
       (and
        (p16a3-lt real-type (p16a3-zero real-type) x)
        (p16a3-lt real-type (p16a3-zero real-type) y))
       (p16a3-lt
        real-type
        (p16a3-zero real-type)
        (p16a3-mul real-type x y)))))))

(defun-sk p16a3-valid-real-set-p (real-type set)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (p16a3-set-member-p real-type set x)
     (p16a3-real-p real-type x))))

(defun-sk p16a3-set-nonempty-p (real-type set)
  (exists (x)
    (and
     (p16a3-real-p real-type x)
     (p16a3-set-member-p real-type set x))))

(defun-sk p16a3-upper-bound-p (real-type set bound)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (p16a3-set-member-p real-type set x)
     (p16a3-le real-type x bound))))

(defun-sk p16a3-bounded-above-p (real-type set)
  (exists (bound)
    (and
     (p16a3-real-p real-type bound)
     (p16a3-upper-bound-p real-type set bound))))

(defun-sk p16a3-least-upper-bound-p
    (real-type set supremum)
  (forall (bound)
    (and
     (p16a3-real-p real-type supremum)
     (p16a3-upper-bound-p real-type set supremum)
     (implies
      (and
       (p16a3-real-p real-type bound)
       (p16a3-upper-bound-p real-type set bound))
      (p16a3-le real-type supremum bound)))))

(defun-sk p16a3-supremum-exists-p (real-type set)
  (exists (supremum)
    (p16a3-least-upper-bound-p real-type set supremum)))

(defun-sk p16a3-dedekind-complete-p (real-type)
  (forall (set)
    (implies
     (and
      (p16a3-valid-real-set-p real-type set)
      (p16a3-set-nonempty-p real-type set)
      (p16a3-bounded-above-p real-type set))
     (p16a3-supremum-exists-p real-type set))))

(defun-sk p16a3-archimedean-witness-p (real-type x)
  (exists (n)
    (and
     (natp n)
     (p16a3-lt
      real-type x (p16a3-nat-value real-type n)))))

(defun-sk p16a3-archimedean-p (real-type)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (p16a3-real-p real-type x)
     (p16a3-archimedean-witness-p real-type x))))

(defun p16a3-real-structure-p (real-type)
  (and
   (p16a3-operation-closure-p real-type)
   (p16a3-unary-field-laws-p real-type)
   (p16a3-binary-field-laws-p real-type)
   (p16a3-ternary-field-laws-p real-type)
   (p16a3-order-laws-p real-type)
   (not
    (equal
     (p16a3-zero real-type)
     (p16a3-one real-type)))
   (p16a3-lt
    real-type
    (p16a3-zero real-type)
    (p16a3-one real-type))
   (p16a3-dedekind-complete-p real-type)
   (p16a3-archimedean-p real-type)))

;; Arbitrary functions are represented extensionally by their values on the
;; unbounded real carrier; no finite table or bounded domain is used.

(defun-sk p16a3-real-function-p (real-type function)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (p16a3-real-p real-type x)
     (p16a3-real-p
      real-type
      (p16a3-function-value real-type function x)))))

;; Exact gauge integrals. A tagged division is an intrinsically finite list of
;; triples (tag, left endpoint, right endpoint), but all real and functional
;; quantifiers remain unrestricted.

(defun p16a3-in-closed-interval-p (real-type a b x)
  (and
   (p16a3-real-p real-type x)
   (p16a3-le real-type a x)
   (p16a3-le real-type x b)))

(defun p16a3-integrand-value (real-type kind function x)
  (if (equal kind :arctan-kernel)
      (p16a3-inv
       real-type
       (p16a3-add
        real-type
        (p16a3-one real-type)
        (p16a3-mul real-type x x)))
    (if (equal kind :source-function)
        (p16a3-function-value real-type function x)
      (p16a3-zero real-type))))

(defun p16a3-tagged-piece-p (real-type piece)
  (and
   (true-listp piece)
   (equal (len piece) 3)
   (p16a3-real-p real-type (nth 0 piece))
   (p16a3-real-p real-type (nth 1 piece))
   (p16a3-real-p real-type (nth 2 piece))
   (p16a3-lt real-type (nth 1 piece) (nth 2 piece))
   (p16a3-le real-type (nth 1 piece) (nth 0 piece))
   (p16a3-le real-type (nth 0 piece) (nth 2 piece))))

(defun p16a3-tagged-division-tail-p
    (real-type division next-left b)
  (if (endp division)
      (equal next-left b)
    (let ((piece (car division)))
      (and
       (p16a3-tagged-piece-p real-type piece)
       (equal (nth 1 piece) next-left)
       (p16a3-tagged-division-tail-p
        real-type
        (cdr division)
        (nth 2 piece)
        b)))))

(defun p16a3-tagged-division-p
    (real-type a b division)
  (and
   (true-listp division)
   (p16a3-real-p real-type a)
   (p16a3-real-p real-type b)
   (p16a3-le real-type a b)
   (p16a3-tagged-division-tail-p
    real-type division a b)))

(defun p16a3-riemann-sum
    (real-type kind function division)
  (if (endp division)
      (p16a3-zero real-type)
    (let* ((piece (car division))
           (tag (nth 0 piece))
           (left (nth 1 piece))
           (right (nth 2 piece)))
      (p16a3-add
       real-type
       (p16a3-mul
        real-type
        (p16a3-integrand-value
         real-type kind function tag)
        (p16a3-sub real-type right left))
       (p16a3-riemann-sum
        real-type kind function (cdr division))))))

(defun-sk p16a3-positive-gauge-p
    (real-type gauge a b)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (p16a3-in-closed-interval-p real-type a b x)
     (p16a3-lt
      real-type
      (p16a3-zero real-type)
      (p16a3-function-value real-type gauge x)))))

(defun p16a3-fine-tagged-division-p
    (real-type gauge division)
  (if (endp division)
      t
    (let* ((piece (car division))
           (tag (nth 0 piece))
           (left (nth 1 piece))
           (right (nth 2 piece))
           (radius
            (p16a3-function-value real-type gauge tag)))
      (and
       (p16a3-lt
        real-type
        (p16a3-sub real-type tag left)
        radius)
       (p16a3-lt
        real-type
        (p16a3-sub real-type right tag)
        radius)
       (p16a3-fine-tagged-division-p
        real-type gauge (cdr division))))))

(defun-sk p16a3-fine-division-exists-p
    (real-type gauge a b)
  (exists (division)
    (and
     (p16a3-tagged-division-p
      real-type a b division)
     (p16a3-fine-tagged-division-p
      real-type gauge division))))

(defun-sk p16a3-all-fine-sums-close-p
    (real-type kind function integral gauge a b epsilon)
  (forall (division)
    (implies
     (and
      (p16a3-tagged-division-p
       real-type a b division)
      (p16a3-fine-tagged-division-p
       real-type gauge division))
     (p16a3-lt
      real-type
      (p16a3-abs
       real-type
       (p16a3-sub
        real-type
        (p16a3-riemann-sum
         real-type kind function division)
        integral))
      epsilon))))

(defun-sk p16a3-integral-gauge-exists-p
    (real-type kind function integral a b epsilon)
  (exists (gauge)
    (and
     (p16a3-real-function-p real-type gauge)
     (p16a3-positive-gauge-p real-type gauge a b)
     (p16a3-fine-division-exists-p
      real-type gauge a b)
     (p16a3-all-fine-sums-close-p
      real-type kind function integral gauge a b epsilon))))

(defun-sk p16a3-has-gauge-integral-p
    (real-type kind function integral a b)
  (forall (epsilon)
    (implies
     (and
      (p16a3-real-p real-type epsilon)
      (p16a3-lt
       real-type
       (p16a3-zero real-type)
       epsilon))
     (and
      (p16a3-real-p real-type integral)
      (p16a3-integral-gauge-exists-p
       real-type kind function integral a b epsilon)))))

;; Arctangent is independently fixed on every real argument by the exact
;; integral of 1/(1+x^2), using oddness through an oriented positive interval
;; for negative arguments. Pi is then the standard value 4*arctan(1).

(defun-sk p16a3-arctan-definition-p (real-type)
  (forall (y)
    (implies
     (p16a3-real-p real-type y)
     (and
      (p16a3-real-p

title: putnam_2016_a3
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2016_a3
-- (putnambench__agda__putnam_2016_a3): the functional equation involving the
-- principal real arctangent determines the integral of f on [0, 1] as 3*pi/8.
-- This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module Putnam2016A3 where

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; _*_)

infix 4 _!=_ _<=N_
infixr 3 _and_
infixr 2 _or_

data Bottom : Set where

Not : Set -> Set
Not A =
  A -> Bottom

_!=_ : {A : Set} -> A -> A -> Set
x != y =
  Not (x == y)

record _and_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data _or_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  left  : A -> A or B
  right : B -> A or B

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

data _<=N_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set where
  zero<=N   : {n : Nat} -> zero <=N n
  suc<=sucN : {m n : Nat} -> m <=N n -> suc m <=N suc n

record CompleteOrderedRealField (R : Set) : Set1 where
  field
    zeroR oneR : R
    add multiply : R -> R -> R
    negate inverse : R -> R
    lessOrEqual : R -> R -> Set
    fromNat : Nat -> R

    one-not-zero :
      oneR != zeroR

    add-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> add x y == add y x
    add-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      add (add x y) z == add x (add y z)
    add-zero :
      (x : R) -> add x zeroR == x
    add-inverse :
      (x : R) -> add x (negate x) == zeroR

    multiply-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> multiply x y == multiply y x
    multiply-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply (multiply x y) z ==
      multiply x (multiply y z)
    multiply-one :
      (x : R) -> multiply x oneR == x
    multiply-zero :
      (x : R) -> multiply x zeroR == zeroR
    distribute :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply x (add y z) ==
      add (multiply x y) (multiply x z)
    inverse-zero :
      inverse zeroR == zeroR
    multiply-inverse :
      (x : R) ->
      x != zeroR ->
      multiply x (inverse x) == oneR

    order-reflexive :
      (x : R) -> lessOrEqual x x
    order-transitive :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y z ->
      lessOrEqual x z
    order-antisymmetric :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y x ->
      x == y
    order-total :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y or lessOrEqual y x
    add-order :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual (add z x) (add z y)
    multiply-nonnegative :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR x ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR y ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR (multiply x y)
    zero-less-than-one :
      lessOrEqual zeroR oneR and zeroR != oneR

    fromNat-zero :
      fromNat zero == zeroR
    fromNat-successor :
      (n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (suc n) == add (fromNat n) oneR
    fromNat-addition :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m + n) == add (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-multiplication :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m * n) == multiply (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-injective :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat m == fromNat n ->
      m == n

    archimedean :
      (x : R) ->
      Exists Nat (\ n -> lessOrEqual x (fromNat n))
    least-upper-bound :
      (P : R -> Set) ->
      Exists R P ->
      Exists R
        (\ upper ->
          (x : R) ->
          P x ->
          lessOrEqual x upper) ->
      Exists R
        (\ supremum ->
          ((x : R) ->
            P x ->
            lessOrEqual x supremum)
          and
          ((upper : R) ->
            ((x : R) ->
              P x ->
              lessOrEqual x upper) ->
            lessOrEqual supremum upper))

open CompleteOrderedRealField

oneN : Nat
oneN =
  suc zero

twoN : Nat
twoN =
  suc oneN

fourN : Nat
fourN =
  twoN + twoN

threeN : Nat
threeN =
  suc twoN

eightN : Nat
eightN =
  twoN * fourN

subtract :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
subtract reals x y =
  add reals x (negate reals y)

divide :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
divide reals x y =
  multiply reals x (inverse reals y)

StrictLess :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
StrictLess reals x y =
  lessOrEqual reals x y and x != y

CloseTo :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
CloseTo reals center radius x =
  StrictLess reals
    (subtract reals center radius)
    x
  and
  StrictLess reals
    x
    (add reals center radius)

ConvergesTo :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  R ->
  Set
ConvergesTo {R} reals sequence limit =
  (epsilon : R) ->
  StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) epsilon ->
  Exists Nat
    (\ cutoff ->
      (n : Nat) ->
      cutoff <=N n ->
      CloseTo reals limit epsilon (sequence n))

naturalPower :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  Nat ->
  R
naturalPower reals x zero =
  oneR reals
naturalPower reals x (suc n) =
  multiply reals
    (naturalPower reals x n)
    x

factorial : Nat -> Nat
factorial zero =
  oneN
factorial (suc n) =
  suc n * factorial n

sumFirst :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Nat ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  R
sumFirst reals zero term =
  zeroR reals
sumFirst reals (suc n) term =
  add reals
    (sumFirst reals n term)
    (term n)

SeriesHasSum :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  R ->
  Set
SeriesHasSum reals terms limit =
  ConvergesTo reals
    (\ n -> sumFirst reals n terms)
    limit

alternatingPower :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Nat ->
  R
alternatingPower reals n =
  naturalPower reals
    (negate reals (oneR reals))
    n

sineTerm :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  Nat ->
  R
sineTerm reals x n =
  divide reals
    (multiply reals
      (alternatingPower reals n)
      (naturalPower reals x (suc (twoN * n))))
    (fromNat reals (factorial (suc (twoN * n))))

cosineTerm :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  Nat ->
  R
cosineTerm reals x n =
  divide reals
    (multiply reals
      (alternatingPower reals n)
      (naturalPower reals x (twoN * n)))
    (fromNat reals (factorial (twoN * n)))

leibnizTerm :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Nat ->
  R
leibnizTerm reals n =
  divide reals
    (alternatingPower reals n)
    (fromNat reals (suc (twoN * n)))

record PiValue
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R)
  (value : R) : Set where
  field
    positive :
      StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) value
    leibniz-series :
      SeriesHasSum reals
        (leibnizTerm reals)
        (divide reals value (fromNat reals fourN))

midpointRiemannSum :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  (R -> R) ->
  Nat ->
  R
midpointRiemannSum reals lower upper function pieces =
  let
    step =
      divide reals
        (subtract reals upper lower)
        (fromNat reals pieces)
    halfStep =
      divide reals
        step
        (fromNat reals twoN)
  in
  sumFirst reals pieces
    (\ i ->
      multiply reals
        (function
          (add reals lower
            (add reals
              (multiply reals
                (fromNat reals i)
                step)
              halfStep)))
        step)

IntervalIntegralValue :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  (R -> R) ->
  R ->
  Set
IntervalIntegralValue reals lower upper function value =
  ConvergesTo reals
    (\ n ->
      midpointRiemannSum reals
        lower
        upper
        function
        (suc n))
    value

record StandardIntervalIntegration
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) : Set1 where
  field
    intervalIntegral :
      R ->
      R ->
      (R -> R) ->
      R
    integral-correct :
      (lower upper : R) ->
      (function : R -> R) ->
      (value : R) ->
      IntervalIntegralValue reals lower upper function value ->
      intervalIntegral lower upper function == value
    integral-totalized-at-zero :
      (lower upper : R) ->
      (function : R -> R) ->
      Not
        (Exists R
          (\ value ->
            IntervalIntegralValue reals
              lower
              upper
              function
              value)) ->
      intervalIntegral lower upper function == zeroR reals

open StandardIntervalIntegration

record StandardRealAnalysis
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) : Set1 where
  field
    sine cosine arctangent : R -> R
    pi : R

    sine-series :
      (x : R) ->
      SeriesHasSum reals
        (sineTerm reals x)
        (sine x)
    cosine-series :
      (x : R) ->
      SeriesHasSum reals
        (cosineTerm reals x)
        (cosine x)

    pi-value :
      PiValue reals pi

    arctangent-range :
      (x : R) ->
      StrictLess reals
        (negate reals
          (divide reals pi (fromNat reals twoN)))
        (arctangent x)
      and
      StrictLess reals
        (arctangent x)
        (divide reals pi (fromNat reals twoN))
    arctangent-cosine-nonzero :
      (x : R) ->
      cosine (arctangent x) != zeroR reals
    tangent-arctangent :
      (x : R) ->
      divide reals
        (sine (arctangent x))
        (cosine (arctangent x))
      ==
      x

open StandardRealAnalysis

module Putnam2016A3Statement
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R)
  (analysis : StandardRealAnalysis reals)
  (integration : StandardIntervalIntegration reals) where

  solution : R
  solution =
    divide reals
      (multiply reals
        (fromNat reals threeN)
        (pi analysis))
      (fromNat reals eightN)

  FunctionalEquation :
    (R -> R) ->
    Set
  FunctionalEquation f =
    (x : R) ->
    x != zeroR reals ->
    add reals
      (f x)
      (f
        (subtract reals
          (oneR reals)
          (divide reals (oneR reals) x)))
    ==
    arctangent analysis x

  proposition : Set
  proposition =
    (f : R -> R) ->
    FunctionalEquation f ->
    intervalIntegral integration
      (zeroR reals)
      (oneR reals)
      f
    ==
    solution

putnam-2016-a3 : Set1
putnam-2016-a3 =
  (R : Set) ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) ->
  (analysis : StandardRealAnalysis reals) ->
  (integration : StandardIntervalIntegration reals) ->
  Putnam2016A3Statement.proposition reals analysis integration

title: putnam_2016_a3
content:
% Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2016_a3:
% every real function satisfying the stated arctangent functional equation
% has integral 3*pi/8 on the unit interval. This file contains no proof.

putnam_2016_a3: THEORY
BEGIN
  real_function: TYPE = [real -> real]
  real_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> real]

  safe_div(numerator, denominator: real): real =
    IF denominator = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      numerator / denominator
    ENDIF

  valid_partition(
      lower, upper: real,
      points: real_sequence,
      count: nat): bool =
    IF lower = upper THEN
      count = 0 AND points(0) = lower
    ELSE
      count > 0
        AND points(0) = lower
        AND points(count) = upper
        AND (FORALL (index: nat):
          index < count IMPLIES
            points(index) < points(index + 1))
    ENDIF

  valid_tags(
      points, tags: real_sequence,
      count: nat): bool =
    FORALL (index: nat):
      index < count IMPLIES
        points(index) <= tags(index)
          AND tags(index) <= points(index + 1)

  mesh_less_than(
      points: real_sequence,
      count: nat,
      bound: real): bool =
    FORALL (index: nat):
      index < count IMPLIES
        points(index + 1) - points(index) < bound

  riemann_sum(
      f: real_function,
      points, tags: real_sequence,
      count: nat): RECURSIVE real =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      riemann_sum(f, points, tags, count - 1)
        + f(tags(count - 1))
            * (points(count) - points(count - 1))
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  has_integral_on_ordered_interval(
      f: real_function,
      integral_value, lower, upper: real): bool =
    lower <= upper
      AND FORALL (epsilon_value: posreal):
        EXISTS (mesh_bound: posreal):
          FORALL
              (points, tags: real_sequence),
              (count: nat):
            (valid_partition(lower, upper, points, count)
              AND valid_tags(points, tags, count)
              AND mesh_less_than(points, count, mesh_bound))
            IMPLIES
              abs(
                riemann_sum(f, points, tags, count)
                  - integral_value)
                < epsilon_value

  has_oriented_integral(
      f: real_function,
      integral_value, lower, upper: real): bool =
    IF lower <= upper THEN
      has_integral_on_ordered_interval(
        f, integral_value, lower, upper)
    ELSE
      has_integral_on_ordered_interval(
        f, -integral_value, upper, lower)
    ENDIF

  arctangent_integrand(t: real): real =
    safe_div(1, 1 + t ^ 2)

  arctangent(x: real): real =
    epsilon(
      LAMBDA (value: real):
        has_oriented_integral(
          arctangent_integrand, value, 0, x))

  pi: real =
    4 * arctangent(1)

  putnam_2016_a3_solution: real =
    3 * pi / 8

  satisfies_functional_equation(f: real_function): bool =
    FORALL (x: real):
      x /= 0 IMPLIES
        f(x) + f(1 - safe_div(1, x)) = arctangent(x)

  putnam_2016_a3: bool =
    FORALL (f: real_function):
      satisfies_functional_equation(f) IMPLIES
        has_integral_on_ordered_interval(
          f, putnam_2016_a3_solution, 0, 1)
END putnam_2016_a3

import Mathlib

open Polynomial Filter Topology Real Set Nat List

/--
Suppose that $G$ is a finite group generated by the two elements $g$ and $h$, where the order of $g$ is odd. Show that every element of $G$ can be written in the form
\[
g^{m_1} h^{n_1} g^{m_2} h^{n_2} \cdots g^{m_r} h^{n_r}
\]
with $1 \leq r \leq |G|$ and $m_1, n_1, m_2, n_2, \ldots, m_r, n_r \in \{-1, 1\}$.
(Here $|G|$ is the number of elements of $G$.)
-/
theorem putnam_2016_a5
(G : Type*) [Group G]
(Gfin : Fintype G)
(g h : G)
(ghgen : Subgroup.closure {g, h} = ⊤ ∧ ¬Subgroup.closure {g} = ⊤ ∧ ¬Subgroup.closure {h} = ⊤)
(godd : Odd (orderOf g))
(S : Set G)
(hS : S = {g * h, g⁻¹ * h, g * h⁻¹, g⁻¹ * h⁻¹})
: (∀ x : G, ∃ mn : List G, 1 ≤ mn.length ∧ mn.length ≤ Gfin.card ∧ ∀ i : Fin mn.length, mn.get i ∈ S ∧ x = List.prod mn) :=
sorry

(* Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2016_a5:
   bounded signed alternating products in a finite group generated by two
   elements, neither of which generates alone, with one of odd order. This
   file contains no proof. *)

From Stdlib Require Import Lists.List Arith.PeanoNat.

Record putnam_2016_a5_group (G : Type) : Type := {
  putnam_2016_a5_mul : G -> G -> G;
  putnam_2016_a5_one : G;
  putnam_2016_a5_inv : G -> G;
  putnam_2016_a5_assoc :
    forall x y z : G,
      putnam_2016_a5_mul x (putnam_2016_a5_mul y z) =
      putnam_2016_a5_mul (putnam_2016_a5_mul x y) z;
  putnam_2016_a5_left_identity :
    forall x : G, putnam_2016_a5_mul putnam_2016_a5_one x = x;
  putnam_2016_a5_right_identity :
    forall x : G, putnam_2016_a5_mul x putnam_2016_a5_one = x;
  putnam_2016_a5_left_inverse :
    forall x : G,
      putnam_2016_a5_mul (putnam_2016_a5_inv x) x =
      putnam_2016_a5_one;
  putnam_2016_a5_right_inverse :
    forall x : G,
      putnam_2016_a5_mul x (putnam_2016_a5_inv x) =
      putnam_2016_a5_one
}.

Arguments putnam_2016_a5_mul {G} _ _ _.
Arguments putnam_2016_a5_one {G} _.
Arguments putnam_2016_a5_inv {G} _ _.

Inductive putnam_2016_a5_generated
    {G : Type}
    (grp : putnam_2016_a5_group G)
    (g h : G) : G -> Prop :=
  | putnam_2016_a5_generated_one :
      putnam_2016_a5_generated grp g h
        (putnam_2016_a5_one grp)
  | putnam_2016_a5_generated_g :
      putnam_2016_a5_generated grp g h g
  | putnam_2016_a5_generated_h :
      putnam_2016_a5_generated grp g h h
  | putnam_2016_a5_generated_mul :
      forall x y : G,
        putnam_2016_a5_generated grp g h x ->
        putnam_2016_a5_generated grp g h y ->
        putnam_2016_a5_generated grp g h
          (putnam_2016_a5_mul grp x y)
  | putnam_2016_a5_generated_inv :
      forall x : G,
        putnam_2016_a5_generated grp g h x ->
        putnam_2016_a5_generated grp g h
          (putnam_2016_a5_inv grp x).

Fixpoint putnam_2016_a5_power
    {G : Type}
    (grp : putnam_2016_a5_group G)
    (x : G)
    (n : nat) : G :=
  match n with
  | O => putnam_2016_a5_one grp
  | S k =>
      putnam_2016_a5_mul grp x
        (putnam_2016_a5_power grp x k)
  end.

Definition putnam_2016_a5_has_order
    {G : Type}
    (grp : putnam_2016_a5_group G)
    (x : G)
    (n : nat) : Prop :=
  (0 < n)%nat /\
  putnam_2016_a5_power grp x n = putnam_2016_a5_one grp /\
  forall m : nat,
    (0 < m)%nat ->
    putnam_2016_a5_power grp x m = putnam_2016_a5_one grp ->
    (n <= m)%nat.

Definition putnam_2016_a5_odd_order
    {G : Type}
    (grp : putnam_2016_a5_group G)
    (x : G) : Prop :=
  exists k : nat,
    putnam_2016_a5_has_order grp x (2 * k + 1).

Definition putnam_2016_a5_allowed_block
    {G : Type}
    (grp : putnam_2016_a5_group G)
    (g h x : G) : Prop :=
  x = putnam_2016_a5_mul grp g h \/
  x = putnam_2016_a5_mul grp (putnam_2016_a5_inv grp g) h \/
  x = putnam_2016_a5_mul grp g (putnam_2016_a5_inv grp h) \/
  x = putnam_2016_a5_mul grp
        (putnam_2016_a5_inv grp g)
        (putnam_2016_a5_inv grp h).

Fixpoint putnam_2016_a5_product
    {G : Type}
    (grp : putnam_2016_a5_group G)
    (xs : list G) : G :=
  match xs with
  | nil => putnam_2016_a5_one grp
  | cons x tail =>
      putnam_2016_a5_mul grp x
        (putnam_2016_a5_product grp tail)
  end.

Theorem putnam_2016_a5
    (G : Type)
    (grp : putnam_2016_a5_group G)
    (elements : list G)
    (g h : G)
    (elements_nodup : NoDup elements)
    (elements_complete : forall x : G, In x elements)
    (ghgen : forall x : G, putnam_2016_a5_generated grp g h x)
    (g_not_gen :
      ~ forall x : G, putnam_2016_a5_generated grp g g x)
    (h_not_gen :
      ~ forall x : G, putnam_2016_a5_generated grp h h x)
    (godd : putnam_2016_a5_odd_order grp g) :
  forall x : G,
    exists blocks : list G,
      (1 <= length blocks)%nat /\
      (length blocks <= length elements)%nat /\
      Forall (putnam_2016_a5_allowed_block grp g h) blocks /\
      putnam_2016_a5_product grp blocks = x.
Admitted.

title: putnam_2016_a5
content:
theory putnam_2016_a5 imports Complex_Main
"HOL-Algebra.Multiplicative_Group"
begin

theorem putnam_2016_a5:
  fixes G (structure) and g h :: "'a" and S :: "'a set"
  defines "S \<equiv> {
    g \<otimes>\<^bsub>G\<^esub> h,
    inv\<^bsub>G\<^esub> g \<otimes>\<^bsub>G\<^esub> h,
    g \<otimes>\<^bsub>G\<^esub> inv\<^bsub>G\<^esub> h,
    inv\<^bsub>G\<^esub> g \<otimes>\<^bsub>G\<^esub> inv\<^bsub>G\<^esub> h}"
  assumes hG : "Group.group G \<and> finite (carrier G)"
    and ghmem : "g \<in> carrier G \<and> h \<in> carrier G"
    and ghgen : "generate G {h, g} = carrier G"
    and godd : "odd (group.ord G g)"
  shows "\<forall>x \<in> carrier G. \<exists>mn :: 'a list.
    1 \<le> length mn \<and>
    length mn \<le> card (carrier G) \<and>
    set mn \<subseteq> S \<and>
    foldr (\<otimes>\<^bsub>G\<^esub>) mn \<one>\<^bsub>G\<^esub> = x"
  sorry

end

title: putnam_2016_a5
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2016_a5:
  signed alternating representations of every element of a finite group
  generated jointly by two elements, but by neither alone, when the first
  generator has odd order. This file contains no proof.
*)

needs "Library/iter.ml";;

let statement =
  `let is_group =
     \(mul:G->G->G) (identity:G) (ginv:G->G).
       (!x y z:G. mul (mul x y) z = mul x (mul y z)) /\
       (!x:G. mul identity x = x /\ mul x identity = x) /\
       (!x:G.
          mul (ginv x) x = identity /\ mul x (ginv x) = identity) in
   let is_subgroup =
     \(mul:G->G->G) (identity:G) (ginv:G->G) (H:G->bool).
       identity IN H /\
       (!x:G. x IN H ==> ginv x IN H) /\
       (!x y:G. x IN H /\ y IN H ==> mul x y IN H) in
   let generated_by =
     \(mul:G->G->G) (identity:G) (ginv:G->G) (S:G->bool).
       !H:G->bool.
         is_subgroup mul identity ginv H /\ S SUBSET H
         ==> H = (UNIV:G->bool) in
   let has_order =
     \(mul:G->G->G) (identity:G) (x:G) (n:num).
       0 < n /\
       ITER n (mul x) identity = identity /\
       (!m:num.
          0 < m /\ ITER m (mul x) identity = identity
          ==> n <= m) in
   !mul:G->G->G identity:G ginv:G->G g h:G.
     FINITE (UNIV:G->bool) /\
     is_group mul identity ginv /\
     generated_by mul identity ginv {g,h} /\
     ~(generated_by mul identity ginv {g}) /\
     ~(generated_by mul identity ginv {h}) /\
     (?n:num. has_order mul identity g n /\ ODD n)
     ==>
     !x:G.
       ?mn:G list.
         1 <= LENGTH mn /\
         LENGTH mn <= CARD (UNIV:G->bool) /\
         (!z:G.
            MEM z mn
            ==> z IN
                {mul g h,
                 mul (ginv g) h,
                 mul g (ginv h),
                 mul (ginv g) (ginv h)}) /\
         x = ITLIST mul mn identity`;;

title: putnam_2016_a5
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2016_a5:
;; every element of a finite group generated by g and h, with g of odd order,
;; is a product of between one and the group order many factors
;; g^(+/-1)h^(+/-1). This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))

;; A duplicate-free carrier and complete multiplication table represent an
;; arbitrary finite group extensionally. Every finite group has such a
;; presentation, and every presentation satisfying the predicate below
;; determines a finite group on the listed carrier.

(defun putnam-2016-a5-set-list-p (xs)
  (if (consp xs)
      (and
       (not (member-equal (car xs) (cdr xs)))
       (putnam-2016-a5-set-list-p (cdr xs)))
    (equal xs nil)))

(defun putnam-2016-a5-binary-table-p (table carrier)
  (if (consp table)
      (let* ((entry (car table))
             (arguments (car entry))
             (value (cdr entry)))
        (and
         (consp entry)
         (true-listp arguments)
         (equal (len arguments) 2)
         (member-equal (car arguments) carrier)
         (member-equal (cadr arguments) carrier)
         (member-equal value carrier)
         (not (assoc-equal arguments (cdr table)))
         (putnam-2016-a5-binary-table-p
          (cdr table) carrier)))
    (equal table nil)))

(defun putnam-2016-a5-multiply (left right table)
  (cdr (assoc-equal (list left right) table)))

(defun putnam-2016-a5-associative-z-p
    (zs x y table)
  (if (endp zs)
      t
    (let* ((z (car zs))
           (xy (putnam-2016-a5-multiply x y table))
           (yz (putnam-2016-a5-multiply y z table)))
      (and
       (equal
        (putnam-2016-a5-multiply xy z table)
        (putnam-2016-a5-multiply x yz table))
       (putnam-2016-a5-associative-z-p
        (cdr zs) x y table)))))

(defun putnam-2016-a5-group-y-axioms-p
    (ys carrier x table)
  (if (endp ys)
      t
    (let ((y (car ys)))
      (and
       (assoc-equal (list x y) table)
       (putnam-2016-a5-associative-z-p
        carrier x y table)
       (putnam-2016-a5-group-y-axioms-p
        (cdr ys) carrier x table)))))

(defun putnam-2016-a5-inverse-exists-p
    (x candidates one table)
  (if (endp candidates)
      nil
    (or
     (and
      (equal
       (putnam-2016-a5-multiply x (car candidates) table)
       one)
      (equal
       (putnam-2016-a5-multiply (car candidates) x table)
       one))
     (putnam-2016-a5-inverse-exists-p
      x (cdr candidates) one table))))

(defun putnam-2016-a5-group-x-axioms-p
    (xs carrier one table)
  (if (endp xs)
      t
    (let ((x (car xs)))
      (and
       (equal
        (putnam-2016-a5-multiply one x table)
        x)
       (equal
        (putnam-2016-a5-multiply x one table)
        x)
       (putnam-2016-a5-inverse-exists-p
        x carrier one table)
       (putnam-2016-a5-group-y-axioms-p
        carrier carrier x table)
       (putnam-2016-a5-group-x-axioms-p
        (cdr xs) carrier one table)))))

(defun putnam-2016-a5-finite-group-p
    (carrier one table)
  (and
   (putnam-2016-a5-set-list-p carrier)
   (consp carrier)
   (member-equal one carrier)
   (putnam-2016-a5-binary-table-p table carrier)
   (putnam-2016-a5-group-x-axioms-p
    carrier carrier one table)))

(defun putnam-2016-a5-inverse-search
    (x candidates one table)
  (if (endp candidates)
      nil
    (if
        (and
         (equal
          (putnam-2016-a5-multiply x (car candidates) table)
          one)
         (equal
          (putnam-2016-a5-multiply (car candidates) x table)
          one))
        (car candidates)
      (putnam-2016-a5-inverse-search
       x (cdr candidates) one table))))

(defun putnam-2016-a5-inverse
    (x carrier one table)
  (putnam-2016-a5-inverse-search
   x carrier one table))

(defun putnam-2016-a5-adjoin-equal (x xs)
  (if (member-equal x xs)
      xs
    (cons x xs)))

(defun putnam-2016-a5-add-generator-products
    (elements generator table result)
  (if (endp elements)
      result
    (putnam-2016-a5-add-generator-products
     (cdr elements)
     generator
     table
     (putnam-2016-a5-adjoin-equal
      (putnam-2016-a5-multiply
       (car elements) generator table)
      result))))

(defun putnam-2016-a5-add-all-generator-products
    (generators elements table result)
  (if (endp generators)
      result
    (putnam-2016-a5-add-all-generator-products
     (cdr generators)
     elements
     table
     (putnam-2016-a5-add-generator-products
      elements (car generators) table result))))

(defun putnam-2016-a5-closure-step
    (elements generators table)
  (putnam-2016-a5-add-all-generator-products
   generators elements table elements))

(defun putnam-2016-a5-closure-iterate
    (fuel elements generators table)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix fuel)))
  (if (zp fuel)
      elements
    (putnam-2016-a5-closure-iterate
     (- fuel 1)
     (putnam-2016-a5-closure-step
      elements generators table)
     generators
     table)))

(defun putnam-2016-a5-subset-p (xs ys)
  (if (endp xs)
      t
    (and
     (member-equal (car xs) ys)
     (putnam-2016-a5-subset-p (cdr xs) ys))))

;; In a finite group of order n, n closure rounds reach every element in the
;; subgroup generated by the given elements, so this is exact generation.

(defun putnam-2016-a5-generates-carrier-p
    (carrier one generators table)
  (putnam-2016-a5-subset-p
   carrier
   (putnam-2016-a5-closure-iterate
    (len carrier) (list one) generators table)))

(defun putnam-2016-a5-power
    (element exponent one table)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix exponent)))
  (if (zp exponent)
      one
    (putnam-2016-a5-multiply
     element
     (putnam-2016-a5-power
      element (- exponent 1) one table)
     table)))

(defun putnam-2016-a5-order-search
    (element exponent remaining one table)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix remaining)))
  (if (zp remaining)
      0
    (if
        (equal
         (putnam-2016-a5-power
          element exponent one table)
         one)
        exponent
      (putnam-2016-a5-order-search
       element
       (+ exponent 1)
       (- remaining 1)
       one
       table))))

;; Every element order in a finite group is between one and the carrier
;; cardinality, making this search the exact order rather than an approximation.

(defun putnam-2016-a5-element-order
    (element carrier one table)
  (putnam-2016-a5-order-search
   element 1 (len carrier) one table))

(defun putnam-2016-a5-odd-order-p
    (element carrier one table)
  (let ((order
         (putnam-2016-a5-element-order
          element carrier one table)))
    (and
     (< 0 order)
     (equal (mod order 2) 1))))

(defun putnam-2016-a5-signed-factors
    (g h carrier one table)
  (let ((g-inverse
         (putnam-2016-a5-inverse g carrier one table))
        (h-inverse
         (putnam-2016-a5-inverse h carrier one table)))
    (list
     (putnam-2016-a5-multiply g h table)
     (putnam-2016-a5-multiply g-inverse h table)
     (putnam-2016-a5-multiply g h-inverse table)
     (putnam-2016-a5-multiply
      g-inverse h-inverse table))))

(defun putnam-2016-a5-prepend-to-sequences
    (element sequences)
  (if (endp sequences)
      nil
    (cons
     (cons element (car sequences))
     (putnam-2016-a5-prepend-to-sequences
      element (cdr sequences)))))

(defun putnam-2016-a5-extend-sequences
    (elements sequences)
  (if (endp elements)
      nil
    (append
     (putnam-2016-a5-prepend-to-sequences
      (car elements) sequences)
     (putnam-2016-a5-extend-sequences
      (cdr elements) sequences))))

(defun putnam-2016-a5-all-sequences
    (elements length)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix length)))
  (if (zp length)
      (list nil)
    (putnam-2016-a5-extend-sequences
     elements
     (putnam-2016-a5-all-sequences
      elements (- length 1)))))

(defun putnam-2016-a5-word-product
    (word one table)
  (if (endp word)
      one
    (putnam-2016-a5-multiply
     (car word)
     (putnam-2016-a5-word-product
      (cdr word) one table)
     table)))

(defun putnam-2016-a5-target-word-in-sequences-p
    (target sequences one table)
  (if (endp sequences)
      nil
    (or
     (equal
      target
      (putnam-2016-a5-word-product
       (car sequences) one table))
     (putnam-2016-a5-target-word-in-sequences-p
      target (cdr sequences) one table))))

(defun putnam-2016-a5-word-of-length-exists-p
    (target length factors one table)
  (putnam-2016-a5-target-word-in-sequences-p
   target
   (putnam-2016-a5-all-sequences factors length)
   one
   table))

(defun putnam-2016-a5-word-up-to-length-exists-p
    (target maximum-length factors one table)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix maximum-length)))
  (if (zp maximum-length)
      nil
    (or
     (putnam-2016-a5-word-of-length-exists-p
      target maximum-length factors one table)
     (putnam-2016-a5-word-up-to-length-exists-p
      target (- maximum-length 1) factors one table))))

(defun putnam-2016-a5-every-element-has-word-p
    (elements maximum-length factors one table)
  (if (endp elements)
      t
    (and
     (putnam-2016-a5-word-up-to-length-exists-p
      (car elements) maximum-length factors one table)
     (putnam-2016-a5-every-element-has-word-p
      (cdr elements) maximum-length factors one table))))

;; Exhaustive search over the four factors and lengths 1 through |G| is
;; exactly the source's internal existential word quantifier.

(defun putnambench-putnam-2016-a5-statement
    (carrier one table g h)
  (implies
   (and
    (putnam-2016-a5-finite-group-p
     carrier one table)
    (member-equal g carrier)
    (member-equal h carrier)
    (putnam-2016-a5-generates-carrier-p
     carrier one (list g h) table)
    (not
     (putnam-2016-a5-generates-carrier-p
      carrier one (list g) table))
    (not
     (putnam-2016-a5-generates-carrier-p
      carrier one (list h) table))
    (putnam-2016-a5-odd-order-p
     g carrier one table))
   (putnam-2016-a5-every-element-has-word-p
    carrier
    (len carrier)
    (putnam-2016-a5-signed-factors
     g h carrier one table)
    one
    table)))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

title: putnam_2016_a5
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2016_a5
-- (putnambench__agda__putnam_2016_a5): every element of the specified finite
-- two-generator group is a bounded product of signed g-h pairs. This file
-- contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module Putnam2016A5 where

open import Agda.Primitive using (Level; lsuc; _⊔_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.List using (List; []; _∷_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_)

infix 4 _<=N_
infixr 3 _and_

record _and_
  {a b : Level}
  (A : Set a)
  (B : Set b) :
  Set (a ⊔ b) where

  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

record Exists
  {a p : Level}
  (A : Set a)
  (P : A -> Set p) :
  Set (a ⊔ p) where

  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

data Empty : Set where

Not :
  {a : Level} ->
  Set a ->
  Set a
Not A =
  A -> Empty

data _<=N_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set where
  zero<=N   : {n : Nat} -> zero <=N n
  suc<=sucN : {m n : Nat} -> m <=N n -> suc m <=N suc n

Positive : Nat -> Set
Positive n =
  suc zero <=N n

data Fin : Nat -> Set where
  fzero : {n : Nat} -> Fin (suc n)
  fsuc  : {n : Nat} -> Fin n -> Fin (suc n)

record Finite
  {ell : Level}
  (A : Set ell) :
  Set ell where

  field
    size :
      Nat
    enumerate :
      Fin size ->
      A
    enumeration-complete :
      (x : A) ->
      Exists (Fin size)
        (\ i -> enumerate i == x)
    enumeration-injective :
      (i j : Fin size) ->
      enumerate i == enumerate j ->
      i == j

record Group
  {ell : Level}
  (G : Set ell) :
  Set ell where

  field
    identity :
      G
    multiply :
      G ->
      G ->
      G
    inverse :
      G ->
      G
    associative :
      (x y z : G) ->
      multiply (multiply x y) z ==
      multiply x (multiply y z)
    identity-left :
      (x : G) ->
      multiply identity x == x
    identity-right :
      (x : G) ->
      multiply x identity == x
    inverse-left :
      (x : G) ->
      multiply (inverse x) x == identity
    inverse-right :
      (x : G) ->
      multiply x (inverse x) == identity

open Finite
open Group

power :
  {ell : Level} ->
  {G : Set ell} ->
  Group G ->
  G ->
  Nat ->
  G
power structure x zero =
  identity structure
power structure x (suc n) =
  multiply structure x (power structure x n)

record IsElementOrder
  {ell : Level}
  {G : Set ell}
  (structure : Group G)
  (x : G)
  (n : Nat) :
  Set ell where

  field
    order-positive :
      Positive n
    power-is-identity :
      power structure x n == identity structure
    least-positive-power :
      (m : Nat) ->
      Positive m ->
      power structure x m == identity structure ->
      n <=N m

OddOrder :
  {ell : Level} ->
  {G : Set ell} ->
  Group G ->
  G ->
  Set ell
OddOrder structure x =
  Exists Nat
    (\ k ->
      IsElementOrder structure x (suc (k + k)))

data GeneratedByPair
  {ell : Level}
  {G : Set ell}
  (structure : Group G)
  (g h : G) :
  G ->
  Set ell where

  generated-g :
    GeneratedByPair structure g h g

  generated-h :
    GeneratedByPair structure g h h

  generated-identity :
    GeneratedByPair structure g h (identity structure)

  generated-product :
    {x y : G} ->
    GeneratedByPair structure g h x ->
    GeneratedByPair structure g h y ->
    GeneratedByPair structure g h (multiply structure x y)

  generated-inverse :
    {x : G} ->
    GeneratedByPair structure g h x ->
    GeneratedByPair structure g h (inverse structure x)

GeneratesPair :
  {ell : Level} ->
  {G : Set ell} ->
  Group G ->
  G ->
  G ->
  Set ell
GeneratesPair {G = G} structure g h =
  (x : G) ->
  GeneratedByPair structure g h x

data GeneratedBySingle
  {ell : Level}
  {G : Set ell}
  (structure : Group G)
  (g : G) :
  G ->
  Set ell where

  generated-single :
    GeneratedBySingle structure g g

  generated-single-identity :
    GeneratedBySingle structure g (identity structure)

  generated-single-product :
    {x y : G} ->
    GeneratedBySingle structure g x ->
    GeneratedBySingle structure g y ->
    GeneratedBySingle structure g (multiply structure x y)

  generated-single-inverse :
    {x : G} ->
    GeneratedBySingle structure g x ->
    GeneratedBySingle structure g (inverse structure x)

GeneratesSingle :
  {ell : Level} ->
  {G : Set ell} ->
  Group G ->
  G ->
  Set ell
GeneratesSingle {G = G} structure g =
  (x : G) ->
  GeneratedBySingle structure g x

data Sign : Set where
  plus  : Sign
  minus : Sign

record SignedPair : Set where
  constructor signs
  field
    g-sign : Sign
    h-sign : Sign

open SignedPair

signedElement :
  {ell : Level} ->
  {G : Set ell} ->
  Group G ->
  G ->
  Sign ->
  G
signedElement structure x plus =
  x
signedElement structure x minus =
  inverse structure x

pairValue :
  {ell : Level} ->
  {G : Set ell} ->
  Group G ->
  G ->
  G ->
  SignedPair ->
  G
pairValue structure g h pair =
  multiply structure
    (signedElement structure g (g-sign pair))
    (signedElement structure h (h-sign pair))

length :
  {ell : Level} ->
  {A : Set ell} ->
  List A ->
  Nat
length [] =
  zero
length (_ ∷ xs) =
  suc (length xs)

wordValue :
  {ell : Level} ->
  {G : Set ell} ->
  Group G ->
  G ->
  G ->
  List SignedPair ->
  G
wordValue structure g h [] =
  identity structure
wordValue structure g h (pair ∷ pairs) =
  multiply structure
    (pairValue structure g h pair)
    (wordValue structure g h pairs)

putnam-2016-a5 :
  (ell : Level) ->
  Set (lsuc ell)
putnam-2016-a5 ell =
  (G : Set ell) ->
  (structure : Group G) ->
  (finite : Finite G) ->
  (g h : G) ->
  GeneratesPair structure g h ->
  Not (GeneratesSingle structure g) ->
  Not (GeneratesSingle structure h) ->
  OddOrder structure g ->
  (x : G) ->
  Exists (List SignedPair)
    (\ word ->
      Positive (length word)
      and
      (length word <=N size finite
      and
      wordValue structure g h word == x))

(*
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2016_a5:
  every element of the stated finite two-generated group is a bounded product
  of signed g-h factors when g has odd order. This file contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open arithmeticTheory listTheory pred_setTheory groupTheory;

val putnam_2016_a5 =
  ``!(grp : 'a group) (g h : 'a).
      let S =
        {grp.op g h;
         grp.op (grp.inv g) h;
         grp.op g (grp.inv h);
         grp.op (grp.inv g) (grp.inv h)}
      in
        FiniteGroup grp /\
        (Generated_subset grp {g; h}).carrier = grp.carrier /\
        (Generated_subset grp {g}).carrier <> grp.carrier /\
        (Generated_subset grp {h}).carrier <> grp.carrier /\
        ODD (order grp g)
        ==>
        !x : 'a.
          x IN grp.carrier
          ==>
          ?mn : 'a list.
            1 <= LENGTH mn /\
            LENGTH mn <= CARD grp.carrier /\
            !i : num.
              i < LENGTH mn
              ==>
              EL i mn IN S /\
              x = FOLDR grp.op grp.id mn``;

title: putnam_2016_a5
content:
$(
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact
  putnam_2016_a5: bounded signed alternating-word representations in a
  finite group irredundantly generated by two elements, one of odd order.
  This file contains no proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  In SetMM, G e. Grp supplies an arbitrary group, Base ` G is its carrier,
  Fin and # express finiteness and finite cardinality, +g ` G is the group
  operation, invg ` G is inversion, and ( od ` G ) ` g is the order of g.
  The Moore closure in SubGrp ` G is subgroup generation, so the three
  closure conditions state that g and h generate G together while neither
  g nor h generates G alone.

  Word S is the class of all finite sequences with entries in S, # ` w is
  the sequence length, and deleting the empty word gives the lower bound
  one. The internally existential word w therefore has length between one
  and the group cardinality. Its left-to-right group product G gsum w is
  exactly a product of factors g^(+/-1) h^(+/-1). The final declaration is
  the single unproved $a corpus statement; this database contains no $p
  proof declaration.
$)

${
  $d G S g h w x $.

  putnambench-putnam-2016-a5 $a |-
    A. G
      A. g e. ( Base ` G ) A. h e. ( Base ` G ) A. S
        (
          (
            (
              (
                G e. Grp
                /\
                ( Base ` G ) e. Fin
              )
              /\
              (
                (
                  (
                    ( ( mrCls ` ( SubGrp ` G ) ) ` { g , h } )
                    =
                    ( Base ` G )
                  )
                  /\
                  (
                    ( ( mrCls ` ( SubGrp ` G ) ) ` { g } )
                    =/=
                    ( Base ` G )
                  )
                )
                /\
                (
                  ( ( mrCls ` ( SubGrp ` G ) ) ` { h } )
                  =/=
                  ( Base ` G )
                )
              )
            )
            /\
            ( ( od ` G ) ` g ) e. Odd
          )
          /\
          S =
            (
              {
                ( g ( +g ` G ) h ) ,
                ( ( ( invg ` G ) ` g ) ( +g ` G ) h )
              }
              u.
              {
                ( g ( +g ` G ) ( ( invg ` G ) ` h ) ) ,
                (
                  ( ( invg ` G ) ` g )
                  ( +g ` G )
                  ( ( invg ` G ) ` h )
                )
              }
            )
          ->
          A. x e. ( Base ` G )
            E. w e. ( Word S \ { (/) } )
              (
                ( # ` w ) <_ ( # ` ( Base ` G ) )
                /\
                ( G gsum w ) = x
              )
        )
  $.
$}
