title: putnam_2016_a5
content:
% Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2016_a5:
% every element of a finite group generated jointly, but not individually, by
% g and h, with g of odd order, is a product of at most the group order many
% factors g^(+/-1)h^(+/-1).
% This file contains no proof.

putnam_2016_a5[
  Element: TYPE+,
  multiply: [Element, Element -> Element],
  inverse: [Element -> Element],
  one: Element
]: THEORY
BEGIN
  IMPORTING finite_sets[Element]

  element_set: TYPE = finite_set[Element]
  word: TYPE = [nat -> Element]

  subset_of(A, B: element_set): bool =
    FORALL (x: Element):
      A(x) IMPLIES B(x)

  finite_group(carrier: element_set): bool =
    carrier(one)
      AND
        (FORALL (x, y: Element):
          carrier(x) AND carrier(y) IMPLIES
            carrier(multiply(x, y)))
      AND
        (FORALL (x: Element):
          carrier(x) IMPLIES carrier(inverse(x)))
      AND
        (FORALL (x, y, z: Element):
          carrier(x) AND carrier(y) AND carrier(z) IMPLIES
            multiply(multiply(x, y), z)
              = multiply(x, multiply(y, z)))
      AND
        (FORALL (x: Element):
          carrier(x) IMPLIES
            multiply(one, x) = x
              AND multiply(x, one) = x)
      AND
        (FORALL (x: Element):
          carrier(x) IMPLIES
            multiply(inverse(x), x) = one
              AND multiply(x, inverse(x)) = one)

  is_subgroup(
      subgroup, carrier: element_set): bool =
    subset_of(subgroup, carrier)
      AND subgroup(one)
      AND
        (FORALL (x, y: Element):
          subgroup(x) AND subgroup(y) IMPLIES
            subgroup(multiply(x, y)))
      AND
        (FORALL (x: Element):
          subgroup(x) IMPLIES subgroup(inverse(x)))

  generated_by_two(
      carrier: element_set,
      g, h: Element): bool =
    carrier(g)
      AND carrier(h)
      AND
        (FORALL (subgroup: element_set):
          (is_subgroup(subgroup, carrier)
            AND subgroup(g)
            AND subgroup(h))
          IMPLIES subset_of(carrier, subgroup))

  generated_by_one(
      carrier: element_set,
      g: Element): bool =
    carrier(g)
      AND
        (FORALL (subgroup: element_set):
          (is_subgroup(subgroup, carrier)
            AND subgroup(g))
          IMPLIES subset_of(carrier, subgroup))

  group_power(base: Element, exponent: nat): RECURSIVE Element =
    IF exponent = 0 THEN
      one
    ELSE
      multiply(
        group_power(base, exponent - 1),
        base)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE exponent

  is_odd(value: nat): bool =
    EXISTS (half: nat):
      value = 2 * half + 1

  has_odd_order(g: Element): bool =
    EXISTS (order: nat):
      order > 0
        AND is_odd(order)
        AND group_power(g, order) = one
        AND
          (FORALL (exponent: nat):
            exponent > 0 AND exponent < order IMPLIES
              group_power(g, exponent) /= one)

  allowed_factor(value, g, h: Element): bool =
    value = multiply(g, h)
      OR value = multiply(inverse(g), h)
      OR value = multiply(g, inverse(h))
      OR value = multiply(inverse(g), inverse(h))

  finite_product(values: word, count: nat): RECURSIVE Element =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      one
    ELSE
      multiply(
        finite_product(values, count - 1),
        values(count - 1))
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  has_required_word(
      carrier: element_set,
      g, h, x: Element): bool =
    EXISTS (values: word), (length: nat):
      1 <= length
        AND length <= card(carrier)
        AND
          (FORALL (index: nat):
            index < length IMPLIES
              allowed_factor(values(index), g, h))
        AND x = finite_product(values, length)

  putnam_2016_a5: bool =
    FORALL (carrier: element_set), (g, h: Element):
      (finite_group(carrier)
        AND generated_by_two(carrier, g, h)
        AND NOT generated_by_one(carrier, g)
        AND NOT generated_by_one(carrier, h)
        AND has_odd_order(g))
      IMPLIES
        (FORALL (x: Element):
          carrier(x) IMPLIES
            has_required_word(carrier, g, h, x))
END putnam_2016_a5

import Mathlib

open Polynomial Filter Topology Real Set Nat List

noncomputable abbrev putnam_2016_a6_solution : ℝ := sorry
-- 5 / 6
/--
Find the smallest constant $C$ such that for every real polynomial $P(x)$ of degree $3$ that has a root in the interval $[0,1]$,
\[
\int_0^1 \left| P(x) \right|\,dx \leq C \max_{x \in [0,1]} \left| P(x) \right|.
\]
-/
theorem putnam_2016_a6
  (p : ℝ → Prop)
  (hp : ∀ c, p c ↔
          ∀ P : Polynomial ℝ, P.degree = 3 →
          (∃ x ∈ Icc 0 1, P.eval x = 0) →
          ∫ x in (0)..1, |P.eval x| ≤ c * (sSup {y | ∃ x ∈ Icc 0 1, y = |P.eval x|})) :
  IsLeast p putnam_2016_a6_solution :=
sorry

title: putnam_2016_a6
content:
From mathcomp Require Import all_algebra all_ssreflect.
From mathcomp Require Import reals normedtype topology sequences measure lebesgue_measure lebesgue_integral.
From mathcomp Require Import classical_sets.
Import numFieldNormedType.Exports.

Set Implicit Arguments.
Unset Strict Implicit.
Unset Printing Implicit Defensive.

Local Open Scope ring_scope.
Local Open Scope classical_set_scope.

Variable R : realType.
Definition mu := [the measure _ _ of @lebesgue_measure R].
Definition putnam_2016_a6_solution : R := 5 / 6.
Theorem putnam_2016_a6
    (C : R)
    (p : R -> Prop)
    (max_abs : {poly R} -> R)
    (hmax : forall P, exists x : R,
      0 <= x <= 1 /\ `|P.[x]| = max_abs P)
    (hmaxub : forall P, forall x,
      0 <= x <= 1 -> `|P.[x]| <= max_abs P)
    (hp : forall c, p c <->
      forall P : {poly R},
        size P = 4%nat ->
        (exists x : R, 0 <= x <= 1 /\ P.[x] = 0) ->
        \int[mu]_(x in [set x | 0 <= x <= 1]) `|P.[x]|
          <= c * max_abs P)
    : p putnam_2016_a6_solution /\
      forall C, p C -> putnam_2016_a6_solution <= C.
Proof. Admitted.

(*
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2016_a6:
  the least constant bounding the absolute-value integral of every real cubic
  with a root in the unit interval by its maximum absolute value there. This
  file contains no proof.
*)

needs "Library/poly.ml";;
needs "Library/transc.ml";;

let statement =
  `let is_unit_interval_maximum =
     \(f:real->real) (m:real).
       (?x:real.
          &0 <= x /\
          x <= &1 /\
          f x = m) /\
       (!x:real.
          &0 <= x /\ x <= &1
          ==> f x <= m) in
   let admissible =
     \C:real.
       !P:real list.
         degree P = 3 /\
         (?r:real.
            &0 <= r /\
            r <= &1 /\
            poly P r = &0)
         ==>
         !M:real.
           is_unit_interval_maximum
             (\x:real. abs (poly P x)) M
           ==>
           integral(&0,&1) (\x:real. abs (poly P x)) <= C * M in
   admissible (&5 / &6) /\
   (!C:real. admissible C ==> &5 / &6 <= C)`;;

title: putnam_2016_a6
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2016_a6:
;; the least constant bounding the integral of the absolute value of every
;; real cubic with a root in [0,1] by its maximum absolute value is 5/6.
;; This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))

;; Scalars are interpreted in an arbitrary real closed ordered field. Real
;; closed fields are elementarily equivalent. The cubic, maximum, and
;; piecewise-antiderivative relations below are first-order, so the resulting
;; assertion is bidirectionally equivalent to the source statement over R.
;;
;; A cubic is its four coefficients in ascending degree order. A maximum is
;; characterized by attainment and a universal upper-bound condition. The
;; integral of |P| is characterized by three ordered cut points, enough to
;; separate all sign intervals of a cubic, and the exact antiderivative on
;; each interval. These witnesses remain internal: the universal witness
;; tuple formulation is equivalent because maximum and integral values are
;; uniquely characterized, while a root occurs only in an antecedent.

(defun putnam-2016-a6-quoted (object)
  (list 'quote object))

(defun putnam-2016-a6-apply1-term (function argument)
  (list
   'apply$
   (putnam-2016-a6-quoted function)
   (list 'cons argument nil)))

(defun putnam-2016-a6-apply2-term (function left right)
  (list
   'apply$
   (putnam-2016-a6-quoted function)
   (list 'cons left (list 'cons right nil))))

(defun putnam-2016-a6-and-term (terms)
  (if (endp terms)
      (putnam-2016-a6-quoted t)
    (list
     'if
     (car terms)
     (putnam-2016-a6-and-term (cdr terms))
     (putnam-2016-a6-quoted nil))))

(defun putnam-2016-a6-or-term (terms)
  (if (endp terms)
      (putnam-2016-a6-quoted nil)
    (list
     'if
     (car terms)
     (putnam-2016-a6-quoted t)
     (putnam-2016-a6-or-term (cdr terms)))))

(defun putnam-2016-a6-not-term (term)
  (list
   'if
   term
   (putnam-2016-a6-quoted nil)
   (putnam-2016-a6-quoted t)))

(defun putnam-2016-a6-implies-term (antecedent consequent)
  (list
   'if
   antecedent
   consequent
   (putnam-2016-a6-quoted t)))

(defun putnam-2016-a6-true-function (formals)
  (list
   'lambda
   formals
   (putnam-2016-a6-quoted t)))

(defun putnam-2016-a6-carrier-term (carrier element)
  (putnam-2016-a6-apply1-term carrier element))

(defun putnam-2016-a6-operation-term (operation left right)
  (putnam-2016-a6-apply2-term operation left right))

(defun putnam-2016-a6-all-coefficients-function (carrier)
  (list
   'lambda
   '(loop$-gvars loop$-ivars)
   (putnam-2016-a6-carrier-term carrier 'loop$-ivars)))

(defun putnam-2016-a6-all-coefficients-term
    (carrier coefficients)
  (list
   'always$+
   (putnam-2016-a6-quoted
    (putnam-2016-a6-all-coefficients-function carrier))
   (putnam-2016-a6-quoted nil)
   coefficients))

(defun putnam-2016-a6-polynomial-term
    (carrier zero coefficients)
  (putnam-2016-a6-and-term
   (list
    (list 'true-listp coefficients)
    (list 'consp coefficients)
    (putnam-2016-a6-all-coefficients-term
     carrier coefficients)
    (putnam-2016-a6-or-term
     (list
      (list 'equal
            (list 'len coefficients)
            (putnam-2016-a6-quoted 1))
      (putnam-2016-a6-not-term
       (list 'equal
             (list 'car (list 'last coefficients))
             (putnam-2016-a6-quoted zero))))))))

(defun putnam-2016-a6-field-laws-function
    (carrier zero one add mul neg inv)
  (let* ((x 'x)
         (y 'y)
         (z 'z)
         (qzero (putnam-2016-a6-quoted zero))
         (qone (putnam-2016-a6-quoted one))
         (add-xy
          (putnam-2016-a6-operation-term add x y))
         (add-yz
          (putnam-2016-a6-operation-term add y z))
         (mul-xy
          (putnam-2016-a6-operation-term mul x y))
         (mul-yz
          (putnam-2016-a6-operation-term mul y z))
         (neg-x
          (putnam-2016-a6-apply1-term neg x))
         (inv-x
          (putnam-2016-a6-apply1-term inv x))
         (domain
          (putnam-2016-a6-and-term
           (list
            (putnam-2016-a6-carrier-term carrier x)
            (putnam-2016-a6-carrier-term carrier y)
            (putnam-2016-a6-carrier-term carrier z))))
         (laws
          (putnam-2016-a6-and-term
           (list
            (putnam-2016-a6-carrier-term carrier add-xy)
            (putnam-2016-a6-carrier-term carrier mul-xy)
            (putnam-2016-a6-carrier-term carrier neg-x)

            (list

            (list

            (putnam-2016-a6-implies-term

    (list

(defun putnam-2016-a6-order-laws-function
    (carrier zero add mul lt)
  (let* ((x 'x)
         (y 'y)

         (lt-xy
          (putnam-2016-a6-operation-term lt x y))

          (putnam-2016-a6-operation-term lt y x))
         (lt-yz
          (putnam-2016-a6-operation-term lt y z))
         (lt-xz
          (putnam-2016-a6-operation-term lt x z))
         (domain
          (putnam-2016-a6-and-term
           (list
            (putnam-2016-a6-carrier-term carrier x)
            (putnam-2016-a6-carrier-term carrier y)
            (putnam-2016-a6-carrier-term carrier z))))
         (laws
          (putnam-2016-a6-and-term
           (list
            (putnam-2016-a6-not-term
             (putnam-2016-a6-operation-term lt x x))
            (putnam-2016-a6-or-term
             (list lt-xy (list 'equal x y) lt-yx))
            (putnam-2016-a6-implies-term
             (putnam-2016-a6-and-term
              (list lt-xy lt-yz))
             lt-xz)
            (putnam-2016-a6-implies-term
             lt-xy
             (putnam-2016-a6-operation-term
              lt
              (putnam-2016-a6-operation-term add x z)
              (putnam-2016-a6-operation-term add y z)))
            (putnam-2016-a6-implies-term
             (putnam-2016-a6-and-term
              (list
               (putnam-2016-a6-operation-term lt qzero x)
               (putnam-2016-a6-operation-term lt qzero y)))
             (putnam-2016-a6-operation-term
              lt
              qzero
              (putnam-2016-a6-operation-term mul x y)))))))
    (list
     'lambda
     '(x y z)
     (putnam-2016-a6-implies-term domain laws))))

    (carrier zero mul lt square-root)

            (list
             (putnam-2016-a6-carrier-term

              'equal
              (putnam-2016-a6-operation-term
               evaluate
               (list 'cons coefficient rest)

     'lambda
     '(coefficient rest x)

(defun putnam-2016-a6-real-closed-field-p
    (carrier zero one add mul neg inv lt
             square-root odd-root evaluate)
  (let* ((field-laws
          (putnam-2016-a6-field-laws-function
           carrier zero one add mul neg inv))
         (field-laws-true
          (putnam-2016-a6-true-function '(x y z)))

         (order-laws-true
          (putnam-2016-a6-true-function '(x y z)))
         (square-root-laws
          (putnam-2016-a6-square-root-laws-function

          (putnam-2016-a6-true-function '(x)))

           '(coefficient rest x)))
         (odd-root-laws
          (putnam-2016-a6-odd-root-laws-function
           carrier zero evaluate odd-root))
         (odd-root-laws-true
          (putnam-2016-a6-true-function
           '(coefficients))))
    (and
     (tamep-functionp carrier)
     (tamep-functionp add)
     (tamep-functionp mul)
     (tamep-functionp neg)
     (tamep-functionp inv)
     (tamep-functionp lt)
     (tamep-functionp square-root)
     (tamep-functionp odd-root)
     (tamep-functionp evaluate)

     (tamep-functionp order-laws-true)
     (tamep-functionp square-root-laws)
     (tamep-functionp square-root-laws-true)
     (tamep-functionp evaluation-laws)
     (tamep-functionp evaluation-laws-true)
     (tamep-functionp odd-root-laws)
     (tamep-functionp odd-root-laws-true)
     (apply$ carrier (list zero))
     (apply$ carrier (list one))
     (not (equal zero one))
     (fn-equal field-laws field-laws-true)
     (fn-equal order-laws order-laws-true)
     (fn-equal square-root-laws square-root-laws-true)
     (fn-equal evaluation-laws evaluation-laws-true)
     (fn-equal odd-root-laws odd-root-laws-true))))

(defun putnam-2016-a6-add (add left right)

(defun putnam-2016-a6-bound-instance-p
    (witness constant
             carrier zero one add mul neg inv lt evaluate)

content:
-- Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2016_a6
-- (putnambench__agda__putnam_2016_a6): the least L1-to-maximum constant 5/6
-- for real cubic polynomials having a root in the closed unit interval.
-- This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module Putnam2016A6 where

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.List using (List; []; _∷_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; _*_)

infix 4 _!=_ _<=N_
infixr 3 _and_
infixr 2 _or_

data Bottom : Set where

Not : Set -> Set
Not A =
  A -> Bottom

_!=_ : {A : Set} -> A -> A -> Set
x != y =
  Not (x == y)

record _and_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data _or_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  left  : A -> A or B
  right : B -> A or B

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

data _<=N_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set where
  zero<=N   : {n : Nat} -> zero <=N n
  suc<=sucN : {m n : Nat} -> m <=N n -> suc m <=N suc n

record CompleteOrderedRealField (R : Set) : Set1 where
  field
    zeroR oneR : R
    add multiply : R -> R -> R
    negate inverse absoluteValue : R -> R
    lessOrEqual : R -> R -> Set
    fromNat : Nat -> R

    one-not-zero :
      oneR != zeroR

    add-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> add x y == add y x
    add-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      add (add x y) z == add x (add y z)
    add-zero :
      (x : R) -> add x zeroR == x
    add-inverse :
      (x : R) -> add x (negate x) == zeroR

    multiply-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> multiply x y == multiply y x
    multiply-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply (multiply x y) z ==
      multiply x (multiply y z)
    multiply-one :
      (x : R) -> multiply x oneR == x
    multiply-zero :
      (x : R) -> multiply x zeroR == zeroR
    distribute :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply x (add y z) ==
      add (multiply x y) (multiply x z)
    inverse-zero :
      inverse zeroR == zeroR
    multiply-inverse :
      (x : R) ->
      x != zeroR ->
      multiply x (inverse x) == oneR

    order-reflexive :
      (x : R) -> lessOrEqual x x
    order-transitive :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y z ->
      lessOrEqual x z
    order-antisymmetric :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y x ->
      x == y
    order-total :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y or lessOrEqual y x
    add-order :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual (add z x) (add z y)
    multiply-nonnegative :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR x ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR y ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR (multiply x y)
    zero-less-than-one :
      lessOrEqual zeroR oneR and zeroR != oneR

    absolute-nonnegative :
      (x : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR (absoluteValue x)
    absolute-of-nonnegative :
      (x : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR x ->
      absoluteValue x == x
    absolute-of-nonpositive :
      (x : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x zeroR ->
      absoluteValue x == negate x

    fromNat-zero :
      fromNat zero == zeroR
    fromNat-successor :
      (n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (suc n) == add (fromNat n) oneR
    fromNat-addition :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m + n) == add (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-multiplication :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m * n) == multiply (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-injective :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat m == fromNat n ->
      m == n

    archimedean :
      (x : R) ->
      Exists Nat
        (\ n ->
          lessOrEqual x (fromNat n))
    least-upper-bound :
      (P : R -> Set) ->
      Exists R P ->
      Exists R
        (\ upper ->
          (x : R) ->
          P x ->
          lessOrEqual x upper) ->
      Exists R
        (\ supremum ->
          ((x : R) ->
            P x ->
            lessOrEqual x supremum)
          and
          ((upper : R) ->
            ((x : R) ->
              P x ->
              lessOrEqual x upper) ->
            lessOrEqual supremum upper))

open CompleteOrderedRealField

subtract :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
subtract reals x y =
  add reals x (negate reals y)

divide :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
divide reals x y =
  multiply reals x (inverse reals y)

StrictLess :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
StrictLess reals x y =
  lessOrEqual reals x y and x != y

CloseTo :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
CloseTo reals center radius x =
  StrictLess reals
    (subtract reals center radius)
    x
  and
  StrictLess reals
    x
    (add reals center radius)

sumFirst :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Nat ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  R
sumFirst reals zero terms =
  zeroR reals
sumFirst reals (suc n) terms =
  add reals
    (sumFirst reals n terms)
    (terms n)

ConvergesTo :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  R ->
  Set
ConvergesTo {R} reals sequence limit =
  (epsilon : R) ->
  StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) epsilon ->
  Exists Nat
    (\ cutoff ->
      (n : Nat) ->
      cutoff <=N n ->
      CloseTo reals limit epsilon (sequence n))

midpointRiemannSum :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  (R -> R) ->
  Nat ->
  R
midpointRiemannSum reals lower upper function pieces =
  let
    two =
      fromNat reals 2
    step =
      divide reals
        (subtract reals upper lower)
        (fromNat reals pieces)
    halfStep =
      divide reals step two
  in
  sumFirst reals pieces
    (\ i ->
      multiply reals
        (function
          (add reals lower
            (add reals
              (multiply reals
                (fromNat reals i)
                step)
              halfStep)))
        step)

IntervalIntegralValue :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  (R -> R) ->
  R ->
  Set
IntervalIntegralValue reals lower upper function integralValue =
  ConvergesTo reals
    (\ n ->
      midpointRiemannSum reals
        lower
        upper
        function
        (suc n))
    integralValue

Polynomial : Set -> Set
Polynomial R =
  List R

coefficient :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Polynomial R ->
  Nat ->
  R
coefficient reals [] n =
  zeroR reals
coefficient reals (c ∷ coefficients) zero =
  c
coefficient reals (c ∷ coefficients) (suc n) =
  coefficient reals coefficients n

DegreeExactly :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Polynomial R ->
  Nat ->
  Set
DegreeExactly reals polynomial degree =
  coefficient reals polynomial degree != zeroR reals
  and
  ((index : Nat) ->
    suc degree <=N index ->
    coefficient reals polynomial index == zeroR reals)

evaluatePolynomial :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Polynomial R ->
  R ->
  R
evaluatePolynomial reals [] x =
  zeroR reals
evaluatePolynomial reals (c ∷ coefficients) x =
  add reals
    c
    (multiply reals
      x
      (evaluatePolynomial reals coefficients x))

InClosedUnitInterval :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  Set
InClosedUnitInterval reals x =
  lessOrEqual reals (zeroR reals) x
  and
  lessOrEqual reals x (oneR reals)

absolutePolynomialValue :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Polynomial R ->
  R ->
  R
absolutePolynomialValue reals polynomial x =
  absoluteValue reals
    (evaluatePolynomial reals polynomial x)

HasRootInClosedUnitInterval :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Polynomial R ->
  Set
HasRootInClosedUnitInterval {R} reals polynomial =
  Exists R
    (\ x ->
      InClosedUnitInterval reals x
      and
      evaluatePolynomial reals polynomial x == zeroR reals)

IsMaximumOnClosedUnitInterval :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (R -> R) ->
  R ->
  Set
IsMaximumOnClosedUnitInterval {R} reals function maximumValue =
  Exists R
    (\ point ->
      InClosedUnitInterval reals point
      and
      function point == maximumValue)
  and
  ((point : R) ->
    InClosedUnitInterval reals point ->
    lessOrEqual reals (function point) maximumValue)

AdmissibleConstant :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  Set
AdmissibleConstant {R} reals constant =
  (polynomial : Polynomial R) ->
  DegreeExactly reals polynomial 3 ->
  HasRootInClosedUnitInterval reals polynomial ->
  Exists R
    (\ integralValue ->
      IntervalIntegralValue reals
        (zeroR reals)
        (oneR reals)
        (absolutePolynomialValue reals polynomial)
        integralValue
      and
      Exists R
        (\ maximumValue ->
          IsMaximumOnClosedUnitInterval reals
            (absolutePolynomialValue reals polynomial)
            maximumValue
          and
          lessOrEqual reals
            integralValue
            (multiply reals constant maximumValue)))

fiveSixths :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R
fiveSixths reals =
  divide reals
    (fromNat reals 5)
    (fromNat reals 6)

Putnam2016A6 :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Set
Putnam2016A6 {R} reals =
  AdmissibleConstant reals (fiveSixths reals)
  and
  ((constant : R) ->
    AdmissibleConstant reals constant ->
    lessOrEqual reals (fiveSixths reals) constant)

putnam-2016-a6 : Set1
putnam-2016-a6 =
  (R : Set) ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) ->
  Putnam2016A6 reals

(*
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2016_a6:
  the least constant bounding the absolute-value integral of every real cubic
  polynomial with a root in [0,1] by its maximum absolute value there is 5/6.
  This file contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open pred_setTheory realTheory integrationTheory polyTheory;

val putnam_2016_a6 =
  ``let unit_interval = interval [0, 1]
    in
    let satisfies_bound =
      \C : real.
        !P : real list.
          degree P = 3 /\
          (?x : real.
             x IN unit_interval /\
             poly P x = 0)
          ==>
          integration$integral unit_interval
            (\x : real. abs (poly P x)) <=
          C * sup
                (IMAGE
                   (\x : real. abs (poly P x))
                   unit_interval)
    in
    let solution = (5 / 6 : real)
    in
      satisfies_bound solution /\
      !C : real.
        satisfies_bound C
        ==>
        solution <= C``;

title: putnam_2016_a6
content:
% Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2016_a6:
% the least constant bounding the integral of the absolute value of a real
% cubic with a root in [0,1] by its maximum there is 5/6.
% This file contains no proof.

putnam_2016_a6: THEORY
BEGIN
  real_function: TYPE = [real -> real]
  real_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> real]

  cubic_polynomial: TYPE =
    [# c0: real, c1: real, c2: real, c3: real #]

  polynomial_value(p: cubic_polynomial, x: real): real =
    c0(p) + x * (c1(p) + x * (c2(p) + x * c3(p)))

  degree_three(p: cubic_polynomial): bool =
    c3(p) /= 0

  absolute_polynomial(p: cubic_polynomial): real_function =
    LAMBDA (x: real): abs(polynomial_value(p, x))

  in_unit_interval(x: real): bool =
    0 <= x AND x <= 1

  has_root_in_unit_interval(p: cubic_polynomial): bool =
    EXISTS (x: real):
      in_unit_interval(x) AND polynomial_value(p, x) = 0

  valid_tagged_partition(
      left, right: real,
      points, tags: real_sequence,
      count: nat): bool =
    count > 0
      AND points(0) = left
      AND points(count) = right
      AND FORALL (index: nat):
        index < count IMPLIES
          (points(index) < points(index + 1)
            AND points(index) <= tags(index)
            AND tags(index) <= points(index + 1))

  mesh_less_than(
      points: real_sequence,
      count: nat,
      bound: real): bool =
    FORALL (index: nat):
      index < count IMPLIES
        points(index + 1) - points(index) < bound

  riemann_sum(
      f: real_function,
      points, tags: real_sequence,
      count: nat): RECURSIVE real =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      riemann_sum(f, points, tags, count - 1)
        + f(tags(count - 1))
            * (points(count) - points(count - 1))
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  has_interval_integral(
      f: real_function,
      left, right, integral_value: real): bool =
    left < right
      AND FORALL (epsilon_value: posreal):
        EXISTS (mesh_bound: posreal):
          FORALL
              (points, tags: real_sequence),
              (count: nat):
            (valid_tagged_partition(
                left, right, points, tags, count)
              AND mesh_less_than(
                points, count, mesh_bound))
            IMPLIES
              abs(
                riemann_sum(f, points, tags, count)
                  - integral_value)
                < epsilon_value

  interval_integral(
      f: real_function,
      left, right: real): real =
    IF left = right THEN
      0
    ELSIF left < right THEN
      IF EXISTS (integral_value: real):
          has_interval_integral(
            f, left, right, integral_value)
      THEN
        epsilon(
          LAMBDA (integral_value: real):
            has_interval_integral(
              f, left, right, integral_value))
      ELSE
        0
      ENDIF
    ELSE
      IF EXISTS (integral_value: real):
          has_interval_integral(
            f, right, left, integral_value)
      THEN
        -epsilon(
          LAMBDA (integral_value: real):
            has_interval_integral(
              f, right, left, integral_value))
      ELSE
        0
      ENDIF
    ENDIF

  has_maximum_on_unit_interval(
      f: real_function,
      maximum_value: real): bool =
    (EXISTS (x: real):
      in_unit_interval(x) AND f(x) = maximum_value)
      AND (FORALL (x: real):
        in_unit_interval(x) IMPLIES f(x) <= maximum_value)

  interval_maximum(f: real_function): real =
    IF EXISTS (maximum_value: real):
        has_maximum_on_unit_interval(f, maximum_value)
    THEN
      epsilon(
        LAMBDA (maximum_value: real):
          has_maximum_on_unit_interval(f, maximum_value))
    ELSE
      0
    ENDIF

  admissible_constant(C: real): bool =
    FORALL (p: cubic_polynomial):
      (degree_three(p)
        AND has_root_in_unit_interval(p))
      IMPLIES
        interval_integral(absolute_polynomial(p), 0, 1)
          <= C * interval_maximum(absolute_polynomial(p))

  putnam_2016_a6_solution: real = 5 / 6

  putnam_2016_a6: bool =
    admissible_constant(putnam_2016_a6_solution)
      AND (FORALL (C: real):
        admissible_constant(C)
          IMPLIES putnam_2016_a6_solution <= C)
END putnam_2016_a6

import Mathlib

open Polynomial Filter Topology Real Set Nat List

noncomputable abbrev putnam_2016_b1_solution : ℝ := sorry
-- exp 1 - 1
/--
Let $x_0,x_1,x_2,\dots$ be the sequence such that $x_0=1$ and for $n \geq 0$,
\[
x_{n+1} = \ln(e^{x_n} - x_n)
\]
(as usual, the function $\ln$ is the natural logarithm). Show that the infinite series
\[
x_0 + x_1 + x_2 + \cdots
\]
converges and find its sum.
-/
theorem putnam_2016_b1
(x : ℕ → ℝ)
(hx0 : x 0 = 1)
(hxn : ∀ n : ℕ, x (n + 1) = log (exp (x n) - (x n)))
: (∑' n : ℕ, x n = putnam_2016_b1_solution) :=
sorry

Definition putnam_2016_b1_solution := exp 1 - 1.
Theorem putnam_2016_b1
    (x : nat -> R := fix x (n: nat) :=
        match n with
        | O => 1
        | S n' => ln (exp (x n') - x n')
    end)
    : Series x = putnam_2016_b1_solution.
Proof. Admitted.

putnam_2016_b1
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2016_b1:
;; the recursively defined real sequence x(0)=1 and
;; x(n+1)=log(exp(x(n))-x(n)) has series sum exp(1)-1.
;; This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))

;; The arguments of the final predicate present a Dedekind-complete ordered
;; field, hence a copy of the real field. Tame APPLY$ objects retain arbitrary
;; real values, subsets, operations, and sequences, while DEFUN-SK supplies
;; the unbounded first-order quantifiers. Exponential is fixed by its exact
;; power series. Logarithm is the total real logarithm: zero maps to zero, and
;; every nonzero input maps to the inverse-exponential value of its absolute
;; value. Thus no rational approximation or finite sequence model is used.

(defun p2016b1-member-p (carrier value)
  (if (apply$ carrier (list value)) t nil))

(defun p2016b1-unary (operation value)
  (apply$ operation (list value)))

(defun p2016b1-binary (operation left right)
  (apply$ operation (list left right)))

(defun-sk p2016b1-field-laws-p
    (carrier zero one add multiply negate inverse)
  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (p2016b1-member-p carrier x)
      (p2016b1-member-p carrier y)
      (p2016b1-member-p carrier z))
     (let* ((xy-add (p2016b1-binary add x y))
            (yz-add (p2016b1-binary add y z))
            (xy-multiply (p2016b1-binary multiply x y))
            (yz-multiply (p2016b1-binary multiply y z))
            (negative-x (p2016b1-unary negate x))
            (inverse-x (p2016b1-unary inverse x)))
       (and
        (p2016b1-member-p carrier xy-add)
        (p2016b1-member-p carrier xy-multiply)
        (p2016b1-member-p carrier negative-x)
        (p2016b1-member-p carrier inverse-x)
        (equal
         (p2016b1-binary add xy-add z)
         (p2016b1-binary add x yz-add))
        (equal xy-add (p2016b1-binary add y x))
        (equal (p2016b1-binary add x zero) x)
        (equal (p2016b1-binary add x negative-x) zero)
        (equal
         (p2016b1-binary multiply xy-multiply z)
         (p2016b1-binary multiply x yz-multiply))
        (equal xy-multiply (p2016b1-binary multiply y x))
        (equal (p2016b1-binary multiply x one) x)
        (implies
         (equal x zero)
         (equal inverse-x zero))
        (implies
         (not (equal x zero))
         (equal
          (p2016b1-binary multiply x inverse-x)
          one))
        (equal
         (p2016b1-binary multiply x yz-add)
         (p2016b1-binary
          add
          (p2016b1-binary multiply x y)
          (p2016b1-binary multiply x z))))))))

(defun-sk p2016b1-order-laws-p
    (carrier zero add multiply less)
  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (p2016b1-member-p carrier x)
      (p2016b1-member-p carrier y)
      (p2016b1-member-p carrier z))
     (and
      (not (p2016b1-binary less x x))
      (or
       (equal x y)
       (p2016b1-binary less x y)
       (p2016b1-binary less y x))
      (implies
       (and
        (p2016b1-binary less x y)
        (p2016b1-binary less y z))
       (p2016b1-binary less x z))
      (implies
       (p2016b1-binary less x y)
       (p2016b1-binary
        less
        (p2016b1-binary add x z)
        (p2016b1-binary add y z)))
      (implies
       (and
        (p2016b1-binary less zero x)
        (p2016b1-binary less zero y))
       (p2016b1-binary
        less
        zero

(defun-sk p2016b1-valid-set-p (carrier set)

(defun p2016b1-real-field-p

    carrier zero add multiply less)

(defun p2016b1-r-add (add left right)

(defun p2016b1-r-multiply (multiply left right)

(defun p2016b1-r-absolute-value

(defun p2016b1-r-nat (n zero one add)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix n)))
  (if (zp n)
      zero
    (p2016b1-r-add
     add

(defun p2016b1-r-power (base exponent one multiply)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix exponent)))
  (if (zp exponent)

(defun p2016b1-r-factorial
    (n zero one add multiply)

(defun p2016b1-exp-prefix

(defun-sk p2016b1-exp-tail-p

    (carrier zero one add multiply negate inverse less

  (and
   (tamep-functionp exponential)

    carrier zero one add multiply negate inverse less

(defun-sk p2016b1-log-operation-values-p

        (if (equal x zero)

    (carrier exponential logarithm)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (p2016b1-member-p carrier x)

      (p2016b1-unary
       logarithm

      x))))

(defun p2016b1-log-operation-p

  (and
   (tamep-functionp logarithm)

(defun-sk p2016b1-sequence-values-p
    (carrier sequence)

        add
        negate

(defun p2016b1-series-prefix

      (p2016b1-r-add

(defun-sk p2016b1-series-tail-p

      less
      (p2016b1-r-absolute-value

(defun-sk p2016b1-series-converges-to-p

       (p2016b1-member-p carrier epsilon)

(defun p2016b1-solution
    (one add negate exponential)
  (p2016b1-r-subtract
   add
   negate
   (p2016b1-unary exponential one)
   one))

(defun putnambench-putnam-2016-b1-statement
    (carrier zero one add multiply negate inverse less
     exponential logarithm sequence)
  (implies

    (p2016b1-real-field-p

title: putnam_2016_b1
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2016_b1
-- (putnambench__agda__putnam_2016_b1): a real sequence defined recursively
-- using the natural exponential and logarithm has infinite-series sum
-- exp(1) - 1. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module Main where

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; _*_)

infix 4 _!=_ _<=N_
infixr 3 _and_
infixr 2 _or_

data Bottom : Set where

Not : Set -> Set
Not A =
  A -> Bottom

_!=_ : {A : Set} -> A -> A -> Set
x != y =
  Not (x == y)

record _and_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data _or_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  left  : A -> A or B
  right : B -> A or B

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

data _<=N_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set where
  zero<=N   : {n : Nat} -> zero <=N n
  suc<=sucN : {m n : Nat} -> m <=N n -> suc m <=N suc n

record CompleteOrderedRealField (R : Set) : Set1 where
  field
    zeroR oneR : R
    add multiply : R -> R -> R
    negate inverse : R -> R
    lessOrEqual : R -> R -> Set
    fromNat : Nat -> R

    one-not-zero :
      oneR != zeroR

    add-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> add x y == add y x
    add-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      add (add x y) z == add x (add y z)
    add-zero :
      (x : R) -> add x zeroR == x
    add-inverse :
      (x : R) -> add x (negate x) == zeroR

    multiply-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> multiply x y == multiply y x
    multiply-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply (multiply x y) z ==
      multiply x (multiply y z)
    multiply-one :
      (x : R) -> multiply x oneR == x
    multiply-zero :
      (x : R) -> multiply x zeroR == zeroR
    distribute :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply x (add y z) ==
      add (multiply x y) (multiply x z)
    inverse-zero :
      inverse zeroR == zeroR
    multiply-inverse :
      (x : R) ->
      x != zeroR ->
      multiply x (inverse x) == oneR

    order-reflexive :
      (x : R) -> lessOrEqual x x
    order-transitive :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y z ->
      lessOrEqual x z
    order-antisymmetric :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y x ->
      x == y
    order-total :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y or lessOrEqual y x
    add-order :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual (add z x) (add z y)
    multiply-nonnegative :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR x ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR y ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR (multiply x y)
    zero-less-than-one :
      lessOrEqual zeroR oneR and zeroR != oneR

    fromNat-zero :
      fromNat zero == zeroR
    fromNat-successor :
      (n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (suc n) == add (fromNat n) oneR
    fromNat-addition :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m + n) == add (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-multiplication :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m * n) == multiply (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-injective :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat m == fromNat n ->
      m == n

    archimedean :
      (x : R) ->
      Exists Nat
        (\ n ->
          lessOrEqual x (fromNat n))
    least-upper-bound :
      (P : R -> Set) ->
      Exists R P ->
      Exists R
        (\ upper ->
          (x : R) ->
          P x ->
          lessOrEqual x upper) ->
      Exists R
        (\ supremum ->
          ((x : R) ->
            P x ->
            lessOrEqual x supremum)
          and
          ((upper : R) ->
            ((x : R) ->
              P x ->
              lessOrEqual x upper) ->
            lessOrEqual supremum upper))

open CompleteOrderedRealField

oneN : Nat
oneN =
  suc zero

subtract :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
subtract reals x y =
  add reals x (negate reals y)

divide :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
divide reals x y =
  multiply reals x (inverse reals y)

StrictLess :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
StrictLess reals x y =
  lessOrEqual reals x y and x != y

CloseTo :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
CloseTo reals center radius x =
  StrictLess reals
    (subtract reals center radius)
    x
  and
  StrictLess reals
    x
    (add reals center radius)

ConvergesTo :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  R ->
  Set
ConvergesTo {R} reals sequence limit =
  (epsilon : R) ->
  StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) epsilon ->
  Exists Nat
    (\ cutoff ->
      (n : Nat) ->
      cutoff <=N n ->
      CloseTo reals limit epsilon (sequence n))

naturalPower :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  Nat ->
  R
naturalPower reals x zero =
  oneR reals
naturalPower reals x (suc n) =
  multiply reals
    (naturalPower reals x n)
    x

factorial : Nat -> Nat
factorial zero =
  oneN
factorial (suc n) =
  suc n * factorial n

sumFirst :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Nat ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  R
sumFirst reals zero terms =
  zeroR reals
sumFirst reals (suc n) terms =
  add reals
    (sumFirst reals n terms)
    (terms n)

SeriesHasSum :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  R ->
  Set
SeriesHasSum reals terms limit =
  ConvergesTo reals
    (\ n -> sumFirst reals n terms)
    limit

exponentialTerm :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  Nat ->
  R
exponentialTerm reals x n =
  divide reals
    (naturalPower reals x n)
    (fromNat reals (factorial n))

record StandardNaturalExpLog
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) : Set1 where
  field
    exponential logarithm : R -> R

    exponential-series :
      (x : R) ->
      SeriesHasSum reals
        (exponentialTerm reals x)
        (exponential x)
    exponential-positive :
      (x : R) ->
      StrictLess reals
        (zeroR reals)
        (exponential x)
    exponential-injective :
      (x y : R) ->
      exponential x == exponential y ->
      x == y
    exponential-logarithm :
      (x : R) ->
      StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) x ->
      exponential (logarithm x) == x

open StandardNaturalExpLog

putnam-2016-b1 : Set1
putnam-2016-b1 =
  (R : Set) ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) ->
  (analysis : StandardNaturalExpLog reals) ->
  (x : Nat -> R) ->
  x zero == oneR reals ->
  ((n : Nat) ->
    x (suc n) ==
    logarithm analysis
      (subtract reals
        (exponential analysis (x n))
        (x n))) ->
  SeriesHasSum reals x
    (subtract reals
      (exponential analysis (oneR reals))
      (oneR reals))

(*
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2016_b1:
  the real sequence beginning at 1 and defined by a logarithmic-exponential
  recurrence has a convergent infinite series with sum exp 1 - 1. This file
  contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open arithmeticTheory realTheory seqTheory transcTheory;

val putnam_2016_b1 =
  ``!x : num -> real.
      x 0 = 1 /\
      (!n : num.
         x (n + 1) = ln (exp (x n) - x n))
      ==>
      summable x /\
      suminf x = exp 1 - 1``;

title: putnam_2016_b1
content:
$(
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact
  putnam_2016_b1: the recursively defined real sequence beginning at one,
  with each next term the natural logarithm of exp(x_n) - x_n, has
  convergent infinite sum exp(1) - 1. This file contains no proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  RR ^m NN0 is set.mm's class of all real-valued sequences indexed by the
  nonnegative integers. The antecedent preserves the initial value and the
  recurrence at every such index. For real t, exp(t) - t is positive, so
  set.mm's logarithm here agrees with the real natural logarithm in the
  source statement.

  The unbounded sum_ is set.mm's infinite-series sum: a divergent series
  evaluates to the empty set, so equality to the displayed real value also
  states convergence. The right side is the published answer exp(1) - 1,
  annotated in the Lean and Isabelle sources. The final declaration is the
  single unproved $a corpus statement; this database contains no $p proof
  declaration.
$)

${
  $d n x $.

  putnambench-putnam-2016-b1 $a |-
    A. x e. ( RR ^m NN0 )
      (
        (
          ( x ` 0 ) = 1
          /\
          A. n e. NN0
            (
              ( x ` ( n + 1 ) )
              =
              (
                log
                `
                (
                  ( exp ` ( x ` n ) )
                  -
                  ( x ` n )
                )
              )
            )
        )
        ->
        (
          sum_ n e. NN0
            ( x ` n )
        )
        =
        ( ( exp ` 1 ) - 1 )
      )
  $.
$}

title: putnam_2016_b1
content:
% Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2016_b1:
% the real sequence starting at 1 with x(n + 1) = ln(exp(x(n)) - x(n))
% has infinite series sum exp(1) - 1. This file contains no proof.

putnam_2016_b1: THEORY
BEGIN
  real_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> real]

  safe_div(numerator, denominator: real): real =
    IF denominator = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      numerator / denominator
    ENDIF

  nat_factorial(index: nat): RECURSIVE nat =
    IF index = 0 THEN
      1
    ELSE
      index * nat_factorial(index - 1)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE index

  partial_sum(values: real_sequence, count: nat): RECURSIVE real =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      partial_sum(values, count - 1) + values(count - 1)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  series_sums_to(values: real_sequence, total: real): bool =
    FORALL (epsilon_value: posreal):
      EXISTS (cutoff: nat):
        FORALL (count: nat):
          cutoff <= count IMPLIES
            abs(partial_sum(values, count) - total) < epsilon_value

  exponential_terms(x: real): real_sequence =
    LAMBDA (index: nat):
      safe_div(
        x ^ index,
        nat_factorial(index) :: real)

  real_exponential(x: real): real =
    epsilon(
      LAMBDA (value: real):
        series_sums_to(exponential_terms(x), value))

  natural_log(x: real): real =
    IF x > 0 THEN
      epsilon(
        LAMBDA (value: real):
          real_exponential(value) = x)
    ELSE
      0
    ENDIF

  putnam_2016_b1_solution: real =
    real_exponential(1) - 1

  putnam_2016_b1: bool =
    FORALL (x: real_sequence):
      (x(0) = 1
        AND (FORALL (n: nat):
          x(n + 1)
            = natural_log(
                real_exponential(x(n)) - x(n))))
      IMPLIES
        series_sums_to(x, putnam_2016_b1_solution)
END putnam_2016_b1

import Mathlib

open Classical Polynomial Filter Topology Real Set Nat List

noncomputable abbrev putnam_2016_b2_solution : ℝ × ℝ := sorry
-- (3 / 4, 4 / 3)
/--
Define a positive integer $n$ to be \emph{squarish} if either $n$ is itself a perfect square or the distance from $n$ to the nearest perfect square is a perfect square. For example, $2016$ is squarish, because the nearest perfect square to $2016$ is $45^2 = 2025$ and $2025 - 2016 = 9$ is a perfect square. (Of the positive integers between $1$ and $10$, only $6$ and $7$ are not squarish.)

For a positive integer $N$, let $S(N)$ be the number of squarish integers between $1$ and $N$,
inclusive. Find positive constants $\alpha$ and $\beta$ such that
\[
\lim_{N \to \infty} \frac{S(N)}{N^\alpha} = \beta,
\]
or show that no such constants exist.
-/
theorem putnam_2016_b2
(squarish : ℤ → Prop)
(hsquarish : ∀ n, squarish n ↔ IsSquare n ∨ ∃ w : ℤ, IsSquare |n - w ^ 2| ∧ ∀ v : ℕ, |n - w ^ 2| ≤ |n - v ^ 2|)
(S : ℤ → ℕ)
(hS : S = fun n ↦ {i ∈ Finset.Icc 1 n | squarish i}.card)
(p : ℝ → ℝ → Prop)
(hp : ∀ α β, p α β ↔ α > 0 ∧ β > 0 ∧ Tendsto (fun N ↦ S N / (N : ℝ) ^ α) atTop (𝓝 β))
: ((∀ α β : ℝ, ((α, β) = putnam_2016_b2_solution ↔ p α β)) ∨ ¬∃ α β : ℝ, p α β) :=
sorry

    (squarish : int -> Prop := fun n => is_square n \/ (exists w : int, is_square `|n - w ^+2| /\ forall v : int, `|n - w ^+2| <= `|n - v ^+2|))
    (S : int -> nat)

    (p : R -> R -> Prop)

theory putnam_2016_b2 imports Complex_Main
begin

definition is_square::"int\<Rightarrow>bool" where "is_square n \<equiv> \<exists>x::nat. n = x * x"
definition squarish::"int\<Rightarrow>bool" where "squarish n \<equiv> is_square n \<or>
   (\<exists>w::int. is_square (abs (n - w * w)) \<and> (\<forall>v::nat. abs (n - w * w) \<le> abs (n - v * v)))"

definition putnam_2016_b2_solution::"(real \<times> real)" where "putnam_2016_b2_solution \<equiv> undefined"
(* (3/4, 4/3) *)
theorem putnam_2016_b2:
  fixes S::"nat\<Rightarrow>nat" and p::"real\<Rightarrow>real\<Rightarrow>bool"
  defines "S \<equiv> \<lambda>n::nat. card {i \<in> {1..n}. squarish i}"
    and "p \<equiv> \<lambda>a::real. \<lambda>b::real. a > 0 \<and> b > 0 \<and> ((\<lambda>n. S n / (n powr a)) \<longlonglongrightarrow>  b)"
  shows "(\<forall>a b::real. (a, b) = putnam_2016_b2_solution \<longleftrightarrow> p a b) \<or> (\<forall>a b::real. \<not> (p a b))"
  sorry

end

putnam_2016_b2
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench artifact putnam_2016_b2:
;; if S(N) counts the positive squarish integers at most N, then
;; S(N) / N^(3/4) tends to 4/3. This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))

;; For positive S(N), the published asymptotic is equivalent to
;;
;;              S(N)^4 / N^3  ->  (4/3)^4 = 256/81.
;;
;; This normalization uses only exact rational arithmetic. It preserves the
;; stated constants alpha=3/4 and beta=4/3 without introducing a surrogate
;; real-power operation or an artificial model of the real continuum.

(defun p2016b2-square-up-to-p (n root)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix root)))
  (if (zp root)
      (equal n 0)
    (or
     (equal n (* root root))
     (p2016b2-square-up-to-p n (- root 1)))))

(defun p2016b2-square-p (n)
  (and
   (natp n)
   (p2016b2-square-up-to-p n n)))

(defun p2016b2-nearest-square-distance (n root)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix root)))
  (if (zp root)
      (abs n)
    (let ((current (abs (- n (* root root))))
          (previous
           (p2016b2-nearest-square-distance
            n (- root 1))))
      (if (< current previous)
          current
        previous))))

(defun p2016b2-squarish-p (n)
  (and
   (posp n)
   (or
    (p2016b2-square-p n)
    (p2016b2-square-p
     (p2016b2-nearest-square-distance n n)))))

(defun p2016b2-count (n)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix n)))
  (if (zp n)
      0
    (+ (if (p2016b2-squarish-p n) 1 0)
       (p2016b2-count (- n 1)))))

(defun p2016b2-normalized-fourth-power (n)
  (/ (expt (p2016b2-count n) 4)
     (expt n 3)))

(defun-sk p2016b2-limit-tail-p (epsilon cutoff)
  (forall (n)
    (implies
     (and
      (posp n)
      (<= cutoff n))
     (<
      (abs
       (-
        (p2016b2-normalized-fourth-power n)
        (/ 256 81)))
      epsilon))))

(defun-sk p2016b2-limit-cutoff-exists-p (epsilon)
  (exists (cutoff)
    (and
     (natp cutoff)
     (p2016b2-limit-tail-p epsilon cutoff))))

(defun-sk putnambench-putnam-2016-b2-statement ()
  (forall (epsilon)
    (implies
     (and (rationalp epsilon) (< 0 epsilon))
     (p2016b2-limit-cutoff-exists-p epsilon))))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

title: putnam_2016_b2
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2016_b2:
-- the asymptotic count of positive squarish integers has constants
-- alpha = 3 / 4 and beta = 4 / 3, or no positive constants exist.
-- This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module Putnam2016B2 where

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Int using (Int; pos; negsuc)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; _*_)

infix 4 _!=_ _<=N_
infixr 3 _and_
infixr 2 _or_

data Bottom : Set where

Not : Set -> Set
Not A =
  A -> Bottom

_!=_ : {A : Set} -> A -> A -> Set
x != y =
  Not (x == y)

record _and_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data _or_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  left  : A -> A or B
  right : B -> A or B

record Iff (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor equivalence
  field
    forward  : A -> B
    backward : B -> A

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

data _<=N_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set where
  zero<=N   : {n : Nat} -> zero <=N n
  suc<=sucN : {m n : Nat} -> m <=N n -> suc m <=N suc n

data Fin : Nat -> Set where
  fzero : {n : Nat} -> Fin (suc n)
  fsuc  : {n : Nat} -> Fin n -> Fin (suc n)

record HasCardinality
  {A : Set}
  (member : A -> Set)
  (cardinality : Nat) :
  Set where

  field
    enumerate :
      Fin cardinality ->
      A
    enumerated-member :
      (index : Fin cardinality) ->
      member (enumerate index)
    enumeration-complete :
      (item : A) ->
      member item ->
      Exists (Fin cardinality)
        (\ index -> item == enumerate index)
    enumeration-injective :
      (left-index right-index : Fin cardinality) ->
      enumerate left-index == enumerate right-index ->
      left-index == right-index

negativeNat : Nat -> Int
negativeNat zero =
  pos zero
negativeNat (suc n) =
  negsuc n

differenceNat : Nat -> Nat -> Int
differenceNat zero zero =
  pos zero
differenceNat (suc m) zero =
  pos (suc m)
differenceNat zero (suc n) =
  negsuc n
differenceNat (suc m) (suc n) =
  differenceNat m n

addInt : Int -> Int -> Int
addInt (pos m) (pos n) =
  pos (m + n)
addInt (pos m) (negsuc n) =
  differenceNat m (suc n)
addInt (negsuc m) (pos n) =
  differenceNat n (suc m)
addInt (negsuc m) (negsuc n) =
  negsuc (suc (m + n))

negateInt : Int -> Int
negateInt (pos n) =
  negativeNat n
negateInt (negsuc n) =
  pos (suc n)

subtractInt : Int -> Int -> Int
subtractInt x y =
  addInt x (negateInt y)

multiplyInt : Int -> Int -> Int
multiplyInt (pos m) (pos n) =
  pos (m * n)
multiplyInt (pos m) (negsuc n) =
  negativeNat (m * suc n)
multiplyInt (negsuc m) (pos n) =
  negativeNat (suc m * n)
multiplyInt (negsuc m) (negsuc n) =
  pos (suc m * suc n)

squareInt : Int -> Int
squareInt x =
  multiplyInt x x

absoluteValue : Int -> Nat
absoluteValue (pos n) =
  n
absoluteValue (negsuc n) =
  suc n

IsIntegerSquare : Int -> Set
IsIntegerSquare z =
  Exists Int
    (\ root -> z == squareInt root)

IsNaturalSquare : Nat -> Set
IsNaturalSquare n =
  Exists Nat
    (\ root -> n == root * root)

distanceToSquare : Int -> Int -> Nat
distanceToSquare n root =
  absoluteValue (subtractInt n (squareInt root))

Squarish : Int -> Set
Squarish n =
  IsIntegerSquare n
  or
  Exists Int
    (\ nearestRoot ->
      IsNaturalSquare (distanceToSquare n nearestRoot)
      and
      ((otherRoot : Int) ->
        distanceToSquare n nearestRoot <=N
        distanceToSquare n otherRoot))

oneN : Nat
oneN =
  suc zero

twoN : Nat
twoN =
  suc oneN

threeN : Nat
threeN =
  suc twoN

fourN : Nat
fourN =
  suc threeN

InSquarishInterval : Nat -> Nat -> Set
InSquarishInterval upper n =
  oneN <=N n
  and
  n <=N upper
  and
  Squarish (pos n)

DefinesSquarishCount : (Nat -> Nat) -> Set
DefinesSquarishCount S =
  (upper : Nat) ->
  HasCardinality
    (InSquarishInterval upper)
    (S upper)

record CompleteOrderedRealField (R : Set) : Set1 where
  field
    zeroR oneR : R
    add multiply : R -> R -> R
    negate inverse : R -> R
    absoluteValueR : R -> R
    lessOrEqual : R -> R -> Set
    fromNat : Nat -> R

    one-not-zero :
      oneR != zeroR

    add-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> add x y == add y x
    add-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      add (add x y) z == add x (add y z)
    add-zero :
      (x : R) -> add x zeroR == x
    add-inverse :
      (x : R) -> add x (negate x) == zeroR

    multiply-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> multiply x y == multiply y x
    multiply-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply (multiply x y) z ==
      multiply x (multiply y z)
    multiply-one :
      (x : R) -> multiply x oneR == x
    multiply-zero :
      (x : R) -> multiply x zeroR == zeroR
    distribute :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply x (add y z) ==
      add (multiply x y) (multiply x z)
    inverse-zero :
      inverse zeroR == zeroR
    multiply-inverse :
      (x : R) ->
      x != zeroR ->
      multiply x (inverse x) == oneR

    order-reflexive :
      (x : R) -> lessOrEqual x x
    order-transitive :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y z ->
      lessOrEqual x z
    order-antisymmetric :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y x ->
      x == y
    order-total :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y or lessOrEqual y x
    add-order :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual (add z x) (add z y)
    multiply-nonnegative :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR x ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR y ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR (multiply x y)
    zero-less-than-one :
      lessOrEqual zeroR oneR and zeroR != oneR

    fromNat-zero :
      fromNat zero == zeroR
    fromNat-successor :
      (n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (suc n) == add (fromNat n) oneR
    fromNat-addition :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m + n) == add (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-multiplication :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m * n) == multiply (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-injective :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat m == fromNat n ->
      m == n

    absolute-value-nonnegative :
      (x : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR (absoluteValueR x)
    absolute-value-of-nonnegative :
      (x : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR x ->
      absoluteValueR x == x
    absolute-value-of-nonpositive :
      (x : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x zeroR ->
      absoluteValueR x == negate x

    archimedean :
      (x : R) ->
      Exists Nat
        (\ n -> lessOrEqual x (fromNat n))
    least-upper-bound :
      (P : R -> Set) ->
      Exists R P ->
      Exists R
        (\ upper ->
          (x : R) ->
          P x ->
          lessOrEqual x upper) ->
      Exists R
        (\ supremum ->
          ((x : R) ->
            P x ->
            lessOrEqual x supremum)
          and
          ((upper : R) ->
            ((x : R) ->
              P x ->
              lessOrEqual x upper) ->
            lessOrEqual supremum upper))

open CompleteOrderedRealField

subtract :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
subtract reals x y =
  add reals x (negate reals y)

divide :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
divide reals x y =
  multiply reals x (inverse reals y)

naturalPower :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  Nat ->
  R
naturalPower reals x zero =
  oneR reals
naturalPower reals x (suc n) =
  multiply reals
    (naturalPower reals x n)
    x

StrictLess :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
StrictLess reals x y =
  lessOrEqual reals x y and x != y

Positive :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  Set
Positive reals x =
  StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) x

ConvergesTo :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  R ->
  Set
ConvergesTo {R} reals sequence limit =
  (epsilon : R) ->
  Positive reals epsilon ->
  Exists Nat
    (\ cutoff ->
      (n : Nat) ->
      cutoff <=N n ->
      StrictLess reals
        (absoluteValueR reals
          (subtract reals (sequence n) limit))
        epsilon)

sumFirst :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  Nat ->
  R
sumFirst reals term zero =
  zeroR reals
sumFirst reals term (suc n) =
  add reals
    (sumFirst reals term n)
    (term n)

factorial : Nat -> Nat
factorial zero =
  oneN
factorial (suc n) =
  suc n * factorial n

exponentialTerm :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  Nat ->
  R
exponentialTerm reals x n =
  divide reals
    (naturalPower reals x n)
    (fromNat reals (factorial n))

ExponentialValue :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
ExponentialValue reals x value =
  ConvergesTo reals
    (\ n -> sumFirst reals (exponentialTerm reals x) n)
    value

record StandardRealPowers
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) :
  Set1 where

  field
    exponential logarithm : R -> R

    exponential-series :
      (x : R) ->
      ExponentialValue reals x (exponential x)

    exponential-positive :
      (x : R) ->
      Positive reals (exponential x)

    exponential-injective :
      (x y : R) ->
      exponential x == exponential y ->
      x == y

    exponential-logarithm :
      (x : R) ->
      Positive reals x ->
      exponential (logarithm x) == x

open StandardRealPowers

realPower :
  {R : Set} ->
  {reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R} ->
  StandardRealPowers reals ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
realPower {reals = reals} powers base exponent =
  exponential powers
    (multiply reals exponent (logarithm powers base))

module Putnam2016B2Statement
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R)
  (powers : StandardRealPowers reals) where

  threeFourths : R
  threeFourths =
    divide reals
      (fromNat reals threeN)
      (fromNat reals fourN)

  fourThirds : R
  fourThirds =
    divide reals
      (fromNat reals fourN)
      (fromNat reals threeN)

  normalizedCount :
    (Nat -> Nat) ->
    R ->
    Nat ->
    R
  normalizedCount S alpha n =
    divide reals
      (fromNat reals (S n))
      (realPower powers (fromNat reals n) alpha)

  Qualifies :
    (Nat -> Nat) ->
    R ->
    R ->
    Set
  Qualifies S alpha beta =
    Positive reals alpha
    and
    Positive reals beta
    and
    ConvergesTo reals (normalizedCount S alpha) beta

  proposition : Set
  proposition =
    (S : Nat -> Nat) ->
    DefinesSquarishCount S ->
    (((alpha beta : R) ->
      Iff
        ((alpha == threeFourths) and (beta == fourThirds))
        (Qualifies S alpha beta))
    or
    Not
      (Exists R
        (\ alpha ->
          Exists R
            (\ beta -> Qualifies S alpha beta))))

putnam-2016-b2 : Set1
putnam-2016-b2 =
  (R : Set) ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) ->
  (powers : StandardRealPowers reals) ->
  Putnam2016B2Statement.proposition reals powers

content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2016_b2:
  the asymptotic count of positive integers whose distance from a nearest
  perfect square is itself a perfect square. This file contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open arithmeticTheory integerTheory pred_setTheory realTheory;
open real_topologyTheory transcTheory;

val putnam_2016_b2 =
  ``let is_square =
      \n : num. ?m : num. n = m EXP 2;
      square_distance =
        \n : num. \m : num.
          Num (ABS (int_of_num n - int_of_num (m EXP 2)));
      squarish =
        \n : num.
          is_square n \/
          ?w : num.
            is_square (square_distance n w) /\
            !v : num. square_distance n w <= square_distance n v;
      S =
        \N : num.
          CARD
            {n : num |
               n IN IMAGE SUC (count N) /\
               squarish n};
      p =
        \alpha : real. \beta : real.
          0 < alpha /\
          0 < beta /\
          (((\N : num.
               (&(S N) : real) / ((&N : real) powr alpha)) --> beta)
            sequentially);
      solution = ((3 / 4 : real), (4 / 3 : real))
    in
      (!alpha beta : real.
         ((alpha, beta) = solution <=> p alpha beta)) \/
      (!alpha beta : real. ~(p alpha beta))``;

$(
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact
  putnam_2016_b2: characterization of the power-law asymptotic for the
  counting function of squarish positive integers. This file contains no
  proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  P16B2Square says that an integer is the square of a nonnegative integer.
  P16B2Squarish says that an integer is either square or has square distance
  from a nearest integer square; the universal quantifier over NN0 retains
  the source's nearest-square condition.

  For positive N, the class 1 ... N is the inclusive integer interval and
  the cardinality in the final assertion is exactly S(N). Since N is
  positive, N ^c a agrees with the source real power N^a. The standard
  sequence relation ~~> expresses the limit as N tends to infinity.

  The explicit solution (3/4, 4/3) is from the published problem and the
  Rocq source. Inlining the source predicates S and p makes the first
  disjunct their stated characterization of every positive limit pair. The
  second disjunct retains the source alternative that no positive pair has
  the required limit. All declarations are unproved $a statement or
  definition encodings; this database contains no $p proof declaration.
$)

$c P16B2Square P16B2Squarish $.

p16b2-square-syntax $a wff ( P16B2Square A ) $.
p16b2-squarish-syntax $a wff ( P16B2Squarish A ) $.

${
  $d A k $.

  p16b2-square-definition $a |- (
    ( P16B2Square A )
    <->
    E. k e. NN0 A = ( k ^ 2 )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d A v w $.

  p16b2-squarish-definition $a |- (
    ( P16B2Squarish A )
    <->
    (
      A e. ZZ
      /\
      (
        ( P16B2Square A )
        \/
        E. w e. ZZ
          (

title: putnam_2016_b2
content:
% Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2016_b2:
% the asymptotic count of positive integers that are squares or lie a square
% distance from a nearest square has solution pair (3/4, 4/3), or no positive
% exponent and limit pair exists. This file contains no proof.

putnam_2016_b2: THEORY
BEGIN
  real_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> real]

  safe_div(numerator, denominator: real): real =
    IF denominator = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      numerator / denominator
    ENDIF

  nat_factorial(index: nat): RECURSIVE nat =
    IF index = 0 THEN
      1
    ELSE
      index * nat_factorial(index - 1)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE index

  converges_to(sequence: real_sequence, value: real): bool =
    FORALL (epsilon_value: posreal):
      EXISTS (cutoff: nat):
        FORALL (index: nat):
          cutoff <= index IMPLIES
            abs(sequence(index) - value) < epsilon_value

  exponential_partial(x: real, count: nat): RECURSIVE real =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      LET index: nat = count - 1 IN
        exponential_partial(x, count - 1)
          + safe_div(
              x ^ index,
              nat_factorial(index) :: real)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  real_exponential(x: real): real =
    epsilon(
      LAMBDA (value: real):
        converges_to(
          LAMBDA (count: nat):
            exponential_partial(x, count),
          value))

  natural_log(x: real): real =
    IF x > 0 THEN
      epsilon(
        LAMBDA (value: real):
          real_exponential(value) = x)
    ELSE
      0
    ENDIF

  real_power(base, exponent: real): real =
    IF base > 0 THEN
      real_exponential(exponent * natural_log(base))
    ELSIF base = 0 AND exponent = 0 THEN
      1
    ELSE
      0
    ENDIF

  perfect_square(value: nat): bool =
    EXISTS (root: nat):
      value = root ^ 2

  nat_distance(left, right: nat): nat =
    IF left >= right THEN
      left - right
    ELSE
      right - left
    ENDIF

  squarish(value: nat): bool =
    perfect_square(value)
      OR EXISTS (nearest_root: nat):
        perfect_square(
          nat_distance(value, nearest_root ^ 2))
          AND FORALL (root: nat):
            nat_distance(value, nearest_root ^ 2)
              <= nat_distance(value, root ^ 2)

  squarish_count(upper: nat): RECURSIVE nat =
    IF upper = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      squarish_count(upper - 1)
        + IF squarish(upper) THEN 1 ELSE 0 ENDIF
    ENDIF
  MEASURE upper

  normalized_count(alpha: real): real_sequence =
    LAMBDA (upper: nat):
      IF upper = 0 THEN
        0
      ELSE
        safe_div(
          squarish_count(upper) :: real,
          real_power(upper :: real, alpha))
      ENDIF

  admissible_pair(alpha, beta: real): bool =
    alpha > 0
      AND beta > 0
      AND converges_to(normalized_count(alpha), beta)

  solution_alpha: real = 3 / 4
  solution_beta: real = 4 / 3

  putnam_2016_b2: bool =
    (FORALL (alpha, beta: real):
      admissible_pair(alpha, beta)
        IFF
          (alpha = solution_alpha
            AND beta = solution_beta))
      OR NOT EXISTS (alpha, beta: real):
        admissible_pair(alpha, beta)
END putnam_2016_b2

(* Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2016_b3:
   a finite planar point set whose every three-point triangle has area at most
   one is contained in a triangle of area four. This file contains no proof. *)

From Stdlib Require Import Reals Ensembles Finite_sets.

Open Scope R_scope.

Definition putnam_2016_b3_point : Type := (R * R)%type.
Definition putnam_2016_b3_point_set :=
  putnam_2016_b3_point -> Prop.

Definition putnam_2016_b3_triangle_area
    (A B C : putnam_2016_b3_point) : R :=
  Rabs
    ((fst B - fst A) * (snd C - snd A) -
     (snd B - snd A) * (fst C - fst A)) / 2.

Definition putnam_2016_b3_in_triangle
    (A B C P : putnam_2016_b3_point) : Prop :=
  exists alpha beta gamma : R,
    0 <= alpha /\
    0 <= beta /\
    0 <= gamma /\
    alpha + beta + gamma = 1 /\
    fst P = alpha * fst A + beta * fst B + gamma * fst C /\
    snd P = alpha * snd A + beta * snd B + gamma * snd C.

Theorem putnam_2016_b3
    (S : putnam_2016_b3_point_set)
    (hS_finite : Finite putnam_2016_b3_point S)
    (hS_area :
      forall A B C : putnam_2016_b3_point,
        S A ->
        S B ->
        S C ->
        putnam_2016_b3_triangle_area A B C <= 1) :
  exists A' B' C' : putnam_2016_b3_point,
    putnam_2016_b3_triangle_area A' B' C' = 4 /\
    forall P : putnam_2016_b3_point,
      S P ->
      putnam_2016_b3_in_triangle A' B' C' P.
Admitted.

(*
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2016_b3
  (putnambench__hol-light__putnam_2016_b3): a finite planar point set whose
  vertex triangles all have area at most 1 is contained in a triangle of area
  exactly 4. This file contains no proof.
*)

let statement =
  `let triangle_area =
     \A B C:real^2.
       abs ((B$1 - A$1) * (C$2 - A$2) -
            (B$2 - A$2) * (C$1 - A$1)) / &2 in
   let in_closed_triangle =
     \A B C P:real^2.
       ?u v w:real.
         &0 <= u /\ &0 <= v /\ &0 <= w /\
         u + v + w = &1 /\
         P$1 = u * A$1 + v * B$1 + w * C$1 /\
         P$2 = u * A$2 + v * B$2 + w * C$2 in
   !S:(real^2)->bool.
     FINITE S /\
     (!A B C:real^2.
        A IN S /\ B IN S /\ C IN S
        ==> triangle_area A B C <= &1)
     ==>
     ?A' B' C':real^2.
       triangle_area A' B' C' = &4 /\
       (!P:real^2. P IN S ==> in_closed_triangle A' B' C' P)`;;

title: putnam_2016_b3
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2016_b3:
;; every finite planar point set whose member triples have area at most 1 is
;; contained in a triangle of area 4. This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))

;; Scalars are interpreted in an arbitrary real closed ordered field. Real
;; closed fields are elementarily equivalent. For each finite list length,
;; area bounds and triangle containment are first-order ordered-field
;; relations, so a counterexample exists here exactly when one exists over R.
;;
;; A duplicate-free true list represents the finite set extensionally. Twice
;; the Euclidean area of triangle ABC is |det(B-A,C-A)|. A point is in a
;; nondegenerate closed triangle exactly when its three edge determinants all
;; have the same weak sign. Negated FN-EQUAL keeps the enclosing triangle as
;; an internal existential witness rather than a statement parameter.

(defun putnam-2016-b3-quoted (object)
  (list 'quote object))

(defun putnam-2016-b3-apply1-term (function argument)
  (list
   'apply$
   (putnam-2016-b3-quoted function)
   (list 'cons argument nil)))

(defun putnam-2016-b3-apply2-term (function left right)
  (list
   'apply$
   (putnam-2016-b3-quoted function)
   (list 'cons left (list 'cons right nil))))

(defun putnam-2016-b3-and-term (terms)
  (if (endp terms)
      (putnam-2016-b3-quoted t)
    (list
     'if
     (car terms)
     (putnam-2016-b3-and-term (cdr terms))
     (putnam-2016-b3-quoted nil))))

(defun putnam-2016-b3-or-term (terms)
  (if (endp terms)
      (putnam-2016-b3-quoted nil)
    (list
     'if
     (car terms)
     (putnam-2016-b3-quoted t)
     (putnam-2016-b3-or-term (cdr terms)))))

(defun putnam-2016-b3-not-term (term)
  (list
   'if
   term
   (putnam-2016-b3-quoted nil)
   (putnam-2016-b3-quoted t)))

(defun putnam-2016-b3-implies-term (antecedent consequent)
  (list
   'if
   antecedent
   consequent
   (putnam-2016-b3-quoted t)))

(defun putnam-2016-b3-true-function (formals)
  (list
   'lambda
   formals
   (putnam-2016-b3-quoted t)))

(defun putnam-2016-b3-carrier-term (carrier element)
  (putnam-2016-b3-apply1-term carrier element))

(defun putnam-2016-b3-operation-term (operation left right)
  (putnam-2016-b3-apply2-term operation left right))

(defun putnam-2016-b3-all-coefficients-function (carrier)
  (list
   'lambda
   '(loop$-gvars loop$-ivars)
   (putnam-2016-b3-carrier-term carrier 'loop$-ivars)))

(defun putnam-2016-b3-all-coefficients-term
    (carrier coefficients)
  (list
   'always$+
   (putnam-2016-b3-quoted
    (putnam-2016-b3-all-coefficients-function carrier))
   (putnam-2016-b3-quoted nil)
   coefficients))

(defun putnam-2016-b3-polynomial-term
    (carrier zero coefficients)
  (putnam-2016-b3-and-term
   (list
    (list 'true-listp coefficients)
    (list 'consp coefficients)
    (putnam-2016-b3-all-coefficients-term
     carrier coefficients)
    (putnam-2016-b3-or-term
     (list
      (list 'equal
            (list 'len coefficients)
            (putnam-2016-b3-quoted 1))
      (putnam-2016-b3-not-term
       (list 'equal
             (list 'car (list 'last coefficients))
             (putnam-2016-b3-quoted zero))))))))

(defun putnam-2016-b3-field-laws-function
    (carrier zero one add mul neg inv)
  (let* ((x 'x)
         (y 'y)
         (z 'z)
         (qzero (putnam-2016-b3-quoted zero))
         (qone (putnam-2016-b3-quoted one))
         (add-xy
          (putnam-2016-b3-operation-term add x y))
         (add-yz
          (putnam-2016-b3-operation-term add y z))
         (mul-xy
          (putnam-2016-b3-operation-term mul x y))

         (neg-x
          (putnam-2016-b3-apply1-term neg x))

          (putnam-2016-b3-and-term
           (list

            (putnam-2016-b3-carrier-term carrier mul-xy)
            (putnam-2016-b3-carrier-term carrier neg-x)
            (putnam-2016-b3-carrier-term carrier inv-x)
            (list
             'equal
             (putnam-2016-b3-operation-term add add-xy z)

            (list
             'equal

(defun putnam-2016-b3-order-laws-function
