         (field-laws-true
          (putnam-2016-b3-true-function '(x y z)))
         (order-laws
          (putnam-2016-b3-order-laws-function
           carrier zero add mul lt))
         (order-laws-true
          (putnam-2016-b3-true-function '(x y z)))
         (square-root-laws
          (putnam-2016-b3-square-root-laws-function
           carrier zero mul lt square-root))
         (square-root-laws-true
          (putnam-2016-b3-true-function '(x)))
         (evaluation-laws
          (putnam-2016-b3-evaluation-laws-function
           carrier zero add mul evaluate))
         (evaluation-laws-true
          (putnam-2016-b3-true-function
           '(coefficient rest x)))
         (odd-root-laws
          (putnam-2016-b3-odd-root-laws-function
           carrier zero evaluate odd-root))
         (odd-root-laws-true
          (putnam-2016-b3-true-function
           '(coefficients))))
    (and
     (tamep-functionp carrier)
     (tamep-functionp add)
     (tamep-functionp mul)
     (tamep-functionp neg)
     (tamep-functionp inv)
     (tamep-functionp lt)
     (tamep-functionp square-root)
     (tamep-functionp odd-root)
     (tamep-functionp evaluate)
     (tamep-functionp field-laws)
     (tamep-functionp field-laws-true)
     (tamep-functionp order-laws)
     (tamep-functionp order-laws-true)
     (tamep-functionp square-root-laws)
     (tamep-functionp square-root-laws-true)
     (tamep-functionp evaluation-laws)
     (tamep-functionp evaluation-laws-true)
     (tamep-functionp odd-root-laws)
     (tamep-functionp odd-root-laws-true)
     (apply$ carrier (list zero))
     (apply$ carrier (list one))
     (not (equal zero one))
     (fn-equal field-laws field-laws-true)
     (fn-equal order-laws order-laws-true)
     (fn-equal square-root-laws square-root-laws-true)
     (fn-equal evaluation-laws evaluation-laws-true)
     (fn-equal odd-root-laws odd-root-laws-true))))

(defun putnam-2016-b3-add (add left right)
  (apply$ add (list left right)))

(defun putnam-2016-b3-mul (mul left right)
  (apply$ mul (list left right)))

(defun putnam-2016-b3-neg (neg value)
  (apply$ neg (list value)))

(defun putnam-2016-b3-inv (inv value)
  (apply$ inv (list value)))

(defun putnam-2016-b3-lt (lt left right)
  (apply$ lt (list left right)))

(defun putnam-2016-b3-le (lt left right)
  (not (putnam-2016-b3-lt lt right left)))

(defun putnam-2016-b3-sub (add neg left right)
  (putnam-2016-b3-add
   add left (putnam-2016-b3-neg neg right)))

(defun putnam-2016-b3-field-natural
    (n zero one add)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix n)))
  (if (zp n)
      zero
    (putnam-2016-b3-add
     add
     one
     (putnam-2016-b3-field-natural
      (- n 1) zero one add))))

(defun putnam-2016-b3-abs
    (value zero neg lt)
  (if (putnam-2016-b3-lt lt value zero)
      (putnam-2016-b3-neg neg value)
    value))

(defun putnam-2016-b3-point-p (point carrier)
  (and
   (true-listp point)
   (equal (len point) 2)
   (apply$ carrier (list (nth 0 point)))
   (apply$ carrier (list (nth 1 point)))))

(defun putnam-2016-b3-finite-point-set-p
    (points carrier)
  (if (consp points)
      (and
       (putnam-2016-b3-point-p (car points) carrier)
       (not (member-equal (car points) (cdr points)))
       (putnam-2016-b3-finite-point-set-p
        (cdr points) carrier))
    (equal points nil)))

(defun putnam-2016-b3-determinant
    (a b c add mul neg)
  (putnam-2016-b3-sub
   add neg
   (putnam-2016-b3-mul
    mul
    (putnam-2016-b3-sub
     add neg (nth 0 b) (nth 0 a))
    (putnam-2016-b3-sub
     add neg (nth 1 c) (nth 1 a)))
   (putnam-2016-b3-mul
    mul
    (putnam-2016-b3-sub
     add neg (nth 1 b) (nth 1 a))
    (putnam-2016-b3-sub
     add neg (nth 0 c) (nth 0 a)))))

(defun putnam-2016-b3-area-at-most-one-p
    (a b c zero one add mul neg lt)
  (putnam-2016-b3-le
   lt
   (putnam-2016-b3-abs
    (putnam-2016-b3-determinant
     a b c add mul neg)
    zero neg lt)
   (putnam-2016-b3-field-natural
    2 zero one add)))

(defun putnam-2016-b3-all-third-points-p
    (a b third-points zero one add mul neg lt)
  (if (consp third-points)
      (and
       (putnam-2016-b3-area-at-most-one-p
        a b (car third-points)
        zero one add mul neg lt)
       (putnam-2016-b3-all-third-points-p
        a b (cdr third-points)
        zero one add mul neg lt))
    (equal third-points nil)))

(defun putnam-2016-b3-all-second-third-points-p
    (a second-points all-points zero one add mul neg lt)
  (if (consp second-points)
      (and
       (putnam-2016-b3-all-third-points-p
        a (car second-points) all-points
        zero one add mul neg lt)
       (putnam-2016-b3-all-second-third-points-p
        a (cdr second-points) all-points
        zero one add mul neg lt))
    (equal second-points nil)))

(defun putnam-2016-b3-all-triples-p
    (first-points all-points zero one add mul neg lt)
  (if (consp first-points)
      (and
       (putnam-2016-b3-all-second-third-points-p
        (car first-points) all-points all-points
        zero one add mul neg lt)
       (putnam-2016-b3-all-triples-p
        (cdr first-points) all-points
        zero one add mul neg lt))
    (equal first-points nil)))

(defun putnam-2016-b3-same-weak-sign-p
    (x y z zero lt)
  (or
   (and
    (putnam-2016-b3-le lt zero x)
    (putnam-2016-b3-le lt zero y)
    (putnam-2016-b3-le lt zero z))
   (and
    (putnam-2016-b3-le lt x zero)
    (putnam-2016-b3-le lt y zero)
    (putnam-2016-b3-le lt z zero))))

(defun putnam-2016-b3-point-in-triangle-p
    (point a b c zero add mul neg lt)
  (putnam-2016-b3-same-weak-sign-p
   (putnam-2016-b3-determinant
    a b point add mul neg)
   (putnam-2016-b3-determinant
    b c point add mul neg)
   (putnam-2016-b3-determinant
    c a point add mul neg)
   zero lt))

(defun putnam-2016-b3-all-points-contained-p
    (points a b c zero add mul neg lt)
  (if (consp points)
      (and
       (putnam-2016-b3-point-in-triangle-p
        (car points) a b c zero add mul neg lt)
       (putnam-2016-b3-all-points-contained-p
        (cdr points) a b c zero add mul neg lt))
    (equal points nil)))

(defun putnam-2016-b3-enclosing-triangle-p
    (witness points carrier zero one add mul neg lt)
  (and
   (true-listp witness)
   (equal (len witness) 3)
   (putnam-2016-b3-point-p (nth 0 witness) carrier)
   (putnam-2016-b3-point-p (nth 1 witness) carrier)
   (putnam-2016-b3-point-p (nth 2 witness) carrier)
   (equal
    (putnam-2016-b3-abs
     (putnam-2016-b3-determinant
      (nth 0 witness)
      (nth 1 witness)
      (nth 2 witness)
      add mul neg)
     zero neg lt)
    (putnam-2016-b3-field-natural
     8 zero one add))
   (putnam-2016-b3-all-points-contained-p
    points
    (nth 0 witness)
    (nth 1 witness)
    (nth 2 witness)
    zero add mul neg lt)))

(defun putnam-2016-b3-car-term (term)
  (list 'car term))

(defun putnam-2016-b3-cdr-term (term)
  (list 'cdr term))

(defun putnam-2016-b3-add-term (add left right)
  (putnam-2016-b3-operation-term add left right))

(defun putnam-2016-b3-mul-term (mul left right)
  (putnam-2016-b3-operation-term mul left right))

(defun putnam-2016-b3-neg-term (neg value)
  (putnam-2016-b3-apply1-term neg value))

(defun putnam-2016-b3-lt-term (lt left right)
  (putnam-2016-b3-operation-term lt left right))

(defun putnam-2016-b3-le-term (lt left right)
  (putnam-2016-b3-not-term
   (putnam-2016-b3-lt-term lt right left)))

(defun putnam-2016-b3-sub-term (add neg left right)
  (putnam-2016-b3-add-term
   add
   left
   (putnam-2016-b3-neg-term neg right)))

(defun putnam-2016-b3-abs-term (zero neg lt value)
  (list
   'if
   (putnam-2016-b3-lt-term
    lt value (putnam-2016-b3-quoted zero))
   (putnam-2016-b3-neg-term neg value)
   value))

(defun putnam-2016-b3-point-term (point carrier)
  (let ((tail (putnam-2016-b3-cdr-term point)))
    (putnam-2016-b3-and-term
     (list
      (list 'consp point)
      (list 'consp tail)
      (list
       'equal
       (putnam-2016-b3-cdr-term tail)
       (putnam-2016-b3-quoted nil))
      (putnam-2016-b3-apply1-term
       carrier
       (putnam-2016-b3-car-term point))
      (putnam-2016-b3-apply1-term
       carrier
       (putnam-2016-b3-car-term tail))))))

(defun putnam-2016-b3-determinant-term (a b c add mul neg)
  (let ((a-tail (putnam-2016-b3-cdr-term a))
        (b-tail (putnam-2016-b3-cdr-term b))
        (c-tail (putnam-2016-b3-cdr-term c)))
    (putnam-2016-b3-sub-term
     add
     neg
     (putnam-2016-b3-mul-term
      mul
      (putnam-2016-b3-sub-term
       add
       neg
       (putnam-2016-b3-car-term b)
       (putnam-2016-b3-car-term a))
      (putnam-2016-b3-sub-term
       add
       neg
       (putnam-2016-b3-car-term c-tail)
       (putnam-2016-b3-car-term a-tail)))
     (putnam-2016-b3-mul-term
      mul
      (putnam-2016-b3-sub-term
       add
       neg
       (putnam-2016-b3-car-term b-tail)
       (putnam-2016-b3-car-term a-tail))
      (putnam-2016-b3-sub-term
       add
       neg
       (putnam-2016-b3-car-term c)
       (putnam-2016-b3-car-term a))))))

(defun putnam-2016-b3-same-weak-sign-term
    (x y z zero lt)
  (putnam-2016-b3-or-term
   (list
    (putnam-2016-b3-and-term
     (list
      (putnam-2016-b3-le-term
       lt (putnam-2016-b3-quoted zero) x)
      (putnam-2016-b3-le-term
       lt (putnam-2016-b3-quoted zero) y)
      (putnam-2016-b3-le-term
       lt (putnam-2016-b3-quoted zero) z)))
    (putnam-2016-b3-and-term
     (list
      (putnam-2016-b3-le-term
       lt x (putnam-2016-b3-quoted zero))
      (putnam-2016-b3-le-term
       lt y (putnam-2016-b3-quoted zero))
      (putnam-2016-b3-le-term
       lt z (putnam-2016-b3-quoted zero)))))))

(defun putnam-2016-b3-point-in-triangle-term
    (point a b c zero add mul neg lt)
  (putnam-2016-b3-same-weak-sign-term
   (putnam-2016-b3-determinant-term
    a b point add mul neg)
   (putnam-2016-b3-determinant-term
    b c point add mul neg)
   (putnam-2016-b3-determinant-term
    c a point add mul neg)
   zero
   lt))

(defun putnam-2016-b3-all-points-contained-term
    (points a b c zero add mul neg lt)
  (if (consp points)
      (putnam-2016-b3-and-term
       (list
        (putnam-2016-b3-point-in-triangle-term
         (putnam-2016-b3-quoted (car points))
         a b c zero add mul neg lt)
        (putnam-2016-b3-all-points-contained-term
         (cdr points) a b c zero add mul neg lt)))
    (putnam-2016-b3-quoted t)))

(defun putnam-2016-b3-enclosing-triangle-failure-function
    (points carrier zero one add mul neg lt)
  (let* ((witness 'witness)
         (witness-tail
          (putnam-2016-b3-cdr-term witness))
         (witness-tail-tail
          (putnam-2016-b3-cdr-term witness-tail))
         (a (putnam-2016-b3-car-term witness))
         (b (putnam-2016-b3-car-term witness-tail))
         (c (putnam-2016-b3-car-term witness-tail-tail))
         (determinant
          (putnam-2016-b3-determinant-term
           a b c add mul neg))
         (qualification
          (putnam-2016-b3-and-term
           (list
            (list 'consp witness)
            (list 'consp witness-tail)
            (list 'consp witness-tail-tail)
            (list
             'equal
             (putnam-2016-b3-cdr-term witness-tail-tail)
             (putnam-2016-b3-quoted nil))
            (putnam-2016-b3-point-term a carrier)
            (putnam-2016-b3-point-term b carrier)
            (putnam-2016-b3-point-term c carrier)
            (list
             'equal
             (putnam-2016-b3-abs-term
              zero neg lt determinant)
             (putnam-2016-b3-quoted
              (putnam-2016-b3-field-natural
               8 zero one add)))
            (putnam-2016-b3-all-points-contained-term
             points a b c zero add mul neg lt)))))
    (list
     'lambda
     '(witness)
     (list
      'if
      qualification
      (putnam-2016-b3-quoted nil)
      (putnam-2016-b3-quoted t)))))

(defun putnam-2016-b3-sample-failure-function-tame-p ()
  (tamep-functionp
   (putnam-2016-b3-enclosing-triangle-failure-function
    '((0 0))
    (putnam-2016-b3-true-function '(x))
    0
    1
    'binary-+
    'binary-*
    'unary--
    '<)))

(defun putnam-2016-b3-enclosing-triangle-exists-p
    (points carrier zero one add mul neg lt)
  (let ((failure-function
         (putnam-2016-b3-enclosing-triangle-failure-function
          points carrier zero one add mul neg lt))
        (true-function
         (putnam-2016-b3-true-function '(witness))))
    (and
     (tamep-functionp failure-function)
     (tamep-functionp true-function)
     (not (fn-equal failure-function true-function)))))

(defun putnambench-putnam-2016-b3-statement
    (carrier zero one add mul neg inv lt
             square-root odd-root evaluate points)
  (implies
   (and
    (putnam-2016-b3-real-closed-field-p
     carrier zero one add mul neg inv lt
     square-root odd-root evaluate)
    (putnam-2016-b3-finite-point-set-p
     points carrier)
    (putnam-2016-b3-all-triples-p
     points points zero one add mul neg lt))
   (putnam-2016-b3-enclosing-triangle-exists-p
    points carrier zero one add mul neg lt)))

(value-triple
 (if (putnam-2016-b3-sample-failure-function-tame-p)
     :itpeval-tame-function-checked
   (er hard
       'putnam-2016-b3-sample-failure-function-tame-p
       "The generated enclosing-triangle failure function is not tame."
       nil)))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

title: putnam_2016_b3
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2016_b3:
-- every finite set of real-plane points whose point-triples have triangle area at
-- most one is contained in a triangle of area exactly four. This file contains no proof.

module Putnam2016B3 where

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
import Agda.Builtin.Nat as NatB

infix 4 _!=_
infixr 3 _and_

data Bottom : Set where

Not : Set -> Set
Not A = A -> Bottom

_!=_ : {A : Set} -> A -> A -> Set
x != y = Not (x == y)

record _and_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

data _or_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  left  : A -> A or B
  right : B -> A or B

Nat : Set
Nat = NatB.Nat

data Fin : Nat -> Set where
  fzero : {n : Nat} -> Fin (NatB.suc n)
  fsuc  : {n : Nat} -> Fin n -> Fin (NatB.suc n)

record CompleteOrderedRealField (R : Set) : Set1 where
  field
    zero one : R
    add multiply : R -> R -> R
    negate inverse squareRoot : R -> R
    lessOrEqual : R -> R -> Set
    fromNat : Nat -> R

    one-not-zero :
      one != zero

    add-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> add x y == add y x
    add-associative :
      (x y z : R) -> add (add x y) z == add x (add y z)
    add-zero :
      (x : R) -> add x zero == x
    add-inverse :
      (x : R) -> add x (negate x) == zero

    multiply-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> multiply x y == multiply y x
    multiply-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply (multiply x y) z == multiply x (multiply y z)
    multiply-one :
      (x : R) -> multiply x one == x
    multiply-zero :
      (x : R) -> multiply x zero == zero
    distribute :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply x (add y z) ==
      add (multiply x y) (multiply x z)
    multiply-inverse :
      (x : R) ->
      x != zero ->
      multiply x (inverse x) == one

    order-reflexive :
      (x : R) -> lessOrEqual x x
    order-transitive :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y z ->
      lessOrEqual x z
    order-antisymmetric :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y x ->
      x == y
    order-total :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y or lessOrEqual y x
    add-order :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual (add z x) (add z y)
    multiply-nonnegative :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zero x ->
      lessOrEqual zero y ->
      lessOrEqual zero (multiply x y)
    zero-less-than-one :
      lessOrEqual zero one and zero != one

    fromNat-zero :
      fromNat NatB.zero == zero
    fromNat-successor :
      (n : Nat) -> fromNat (NatB.suc n) == add (fromNat n) one
    archimedean :
      (x : R) ->
      Exists Nat (\ n -> lessOrEqual x (fromNat n))
    least-upper-bound :
      (P : R -> Set) ->
      Exists R P ->
      Exists R
        (\ upper ->
          (x : R) ->
          P x ->
          lessOrEqual x upper) ->
      Exists R
        (\ supremum ->
          ((x : R) -> P x -> lessOrEqual x supremum)
          and
          ((upper : R) ->
            ((x : R) -> P x -> lessOrEqual x upper) ->
            lessOrEqual supremum upper))

    square-root-nonnegative :
      (x : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zero (squareRoot x)
    square-root-square :
      (x : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zero x ->
      multiply (squareRoot x) (squareRoot x) == x
    square-root-nonpositive :
      (x : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x zero ->
      squareRoot x == zero
    square-root-unique :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zero y ->
      multiply y y == x ->
      y == squareRoot x

open CompleteOrderedRealField

subtract :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
subtract reals x y =
  add reals x (negate reals y)

square :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R
square reals x =
  multiply reals x x

two :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R
two reals =
  add reals (one reals) (one reals)

four :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R
four reals =
  add reals (two reals) (two reals)

half :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R
half reals =
  inverse reals (two reals)

record Point (R : Set) : Set where
  constructor point
  field
    x-coordinate : R
    y-coordinate : R

open Point

addPoint :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Point R ->
  Point R ->
  Point R
addPoint reals p q =
  point
    (add reals (x-coordinate p) (x-coordinate q))
    (add reals (y-coordinate p) (y-coordinate q))

scalePoint :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  Point R ->
  Point R
scalePoint reals scalar p =
  point
    (multiply reals scalar (x-coordinate p))
    (multiply reals scalar (y-coordinate p))

weightedPoint :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Point R ->
  Point R ->
  Point R ->
  Point R
weightedPoint reals alpha beta gamma a b c =
  addPoint reals
    (addPoint reals
      (scalePoint reals alpha a)
      (scalePoint reals beta b))
    (scalePoint reals gamma c)

doubleSignedArea :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Point R ->
  Point R ->
  Point R ->
  R
doubleSignedArea reals a b c =
  subtract reals
    (multiply reals
      (subtract reals (x-coordinate b) (x-coordinate a))
      (subtract reals (y-coordinate c) (y-coordinate a)))
    (multiply reals
      (subtract reals (y-coordinate b) (y-coordinate a))
      (subtract reals (x-coordinate c) (x-coordinate a)))

triangleArea :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Point R ->
  Point R ->
  Point R ->
  R
triangleArea reals a b c =
  multiply reals
    (half reals)
    (squareRoot reals
      (square reals (doubleSignedArea reals a b c)))

Nonnegative :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  Set
Nonnegative reals x =
  lessOrEqual reals (zero reals) x

InTriangle :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Point R ->
  Point R ->
  Point R ->
  Point R ->
  Set
InTriangle {R} reals a b c p =
  Exists R
    (\ alpha ->
      Exists R
        (\ beta ->
          Exists R
            (\ gamma ->
              Nonnegative reals alpha
              and
              (Nonnegative reals beta
              and
              (Nonnegative reals gamma
              and
              (add reals (add reals alpha beta) gamma == one reals
              and
              p == weightedPoint reals alpha beta gamma a b c))))))

module Putnam2016B3Statement
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R)
  (n : Nat)
  (S : Fin n -> Point R) where

  proposition : Set
  proposition =
    ((i j k : Fin n) ->
      lessOrEqual reals
        (triangleArea reals (S i) (S j) (S k))
        (one reals)) ->
    Exists (Point R)
      (\ a ->
        Exists (Point R)
          (\ b ->
            Exists (Point R)
              (\ c ->
                triangleArea reals a b c == four reals
                and
                ((i : Fin n) ->
                  InTriangle reals a b c (S i)))))

putnam-2016-b3 : Set1
putnam-2016-b3 =
  (R : Set) ->

(*
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2016_b3:
  a finite set of real-plane points whose every three-point triangle has area
  at most one is contained in a triangle of area four. This file contains no
  proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open pairTheory pred_setTheory realTheory;

val putnam_2016_b3 =
  ``!(S : (real # real) set).
      let convex_hull_three =
        \A B C : real # real.
          {P : real # real |
            ?u v w : real.
              0 <= u /\ 0 <= v /\ 0 <= w /\
              u + v + w = 1 /\
              P =
                (u * FST A + v * FST B + w * FST C,
                 u * SND A + v * SND B + w * SND C)}
      in
      let triangle_area =
        \A B C : real # real.
          abs ((FST B - FST A) * (SND C - SND A) -
               (SND B - SND A) * (FST C - FST A)) / 2
      in
        FINITE S /\
        (!A B C : real # real.
           A IN S /\ B IN S /\ C IN S
           ==>
           triangle_area A B C <= 1)
        ==>
        ?A1 B1 C1 : real # real.
          triangle_area A1 B1 C1 = 4 /\
          S SUBSET convex_hull_three A1 B1 C1``;

$(

  putnam_2016_b3: every finite set of real-plane points whose three-point
  triangles have area at most 1 is contained in a triangle of area exactly 4.
  This file contains no proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  P16B3I is the two-coordinate index set and P16B3R2 is the full real
  coordinate plane. P16B3Hull is exactly the convex hull of three points,
  expressed through internally existential nonnegative barycentric
  coordinates whose sum is one. P16B3Area is its planar Lebesgue measure
  through set.mm's finite-dimensional volume function voln.

  The final unproved $a assertion quantifies over every finite subset of the
  real plane. It preserves the universal area bound for all triples from the
  set and keeps the vertices of the containing area-4 triangle internally
  existentially quantified. This root candidate contains no $p proof
  declaration.
$)

$c P16B3I P16B3R2 P16B3Hull P16B3Area $.

p16b3-index-syntax $a class P16B3I $.
p16b3-plane-syntax $a class P16B3R2 $.
p16b3-hull-syntax $a class ( P16B3Hull A B C ) $.
p16b3-area-syntax $a class ( P16B3Area A B C ) $.

p16b3-index-definition $a |- P16B3I = ( 1 ... 2 ) $.

p16b3-plane-definition $a |- P16B3R2 = ( RR ^m P16B3I ) $.

${
  $d A B C i u v w z $.

  p16b3-hull-definition $a |- (
    P16B3Hull A B C
  ) = {
    z e. P16B3R2 |
    E. u e. RR E. v e. RR E. w e. RR
      (
        (
          0 <_ u
          /\
          (
            0 <_ v
            /\
            0 <_ w
          )
        )
        /\
        (
          ( ( u + v ) + w ) = 1
          /\
          z =
            (
              i e. P16B3I |->
                (
                  (
                    ( u x. ( A ` i ) )
                    +
                    ( v x. ( B ` i ) )
                  )
                  +
                  ( w x. ( C ` i ) )
                )
            )
        )
      )
  } $.
$}

p16b3-area-definition $a |- (
  P16B3Area A B C
) = (
  ( voln ` P16B3I )
  `
  ( P16B3Hull A B C )
) $.

${
  $d A B C D E F S $.

  putnambench-putnam-2016-b3 $a |- A. S e. Fin
    (
      (
        S C_ P16B3R2
        /\
        A. A e. S A. B e. S A. C e. S
          ( P16B3Area A B C ) <_ 1
      )
      ->
      E. D e. P16B3R2
        E. E e. P16B3R2
          E. F e. P16B3R2
            (
              ( P16B3Area D E F ) = 4
              /\
              S C_ ( P16B3Hull D E F )
            )
    )
  $.
$}

title: putnam_2016_b3
content:
% Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2016_b3:
% every finite planar point set whose three-point triangles have area at most
% 1 is contained in a triangle of area 4. This file contains no proof.

putnam_2016_b3: THEORY
BEGIN
  point: TYPE = [# x_coord: real, y_coord: real #]

  IMPORTING finite_sets[point]

  cross_from(A, B, C: point): real =
    (x_coord(B) - x_coord(A)) * (y_coord(C) - y_coord(A))
      - (y_coord(B) - y_coord(A)) * (x_coord(C) - x_coord(A))

  triangle_area(A, B, C: point): real =
    abs(cross_from(A, B, C)) / 2

  in_closed_triangle(P, A, B, C: point): bool =
    EXISTS (alpha, beta, gamma: real):
      0 <= alpha
        AND 0 <= beta
        AND 0 <= gamma
        AND alpha + beta + gamma = 1
        AND x_coord(P)
          = alpha * x_coord(A)
              + beta * x_coord(B)
              + gamma * x_coord(C)
        AND y_coord(P)
          = alpha * y_coord(A)
              + beta * y_coord(B)
              + gamma * y_coord(C)

  putnam_2016_b3: bool =
    FORALL (S: finite_set[point]):
      (FORALL (A, B, C: point):
        S(A) AND S(B) AND S(C)
          IMPLIES triangle_area(A, B, C) <= 1)
      IMPLIES
        EXISTS (A_prime, B_prime, C_prime: point):
          triangle_area(A_prime, B_prime, C_prime) = 4
            AND (FORALL (P: point):
              S(P)
                IMPLIES
                  in_closed_triangle(
                    P, A_prime, B_prime, C_prime))
END putnam_2016_b3

import Mathlib

open Real Set Nat

noncomputable abbrev putnam_2016_b4_solution : ℕ → ℝ := sorry
-- (fun n : ℕ => (2 * n)! / (4 ^ n * (n)!))
/--
Let $A$ be a $2n \times 2n$ matrix, with entries chosen independently at random. Every entry is chosen to be $0$ or $1$, each with probability $1/2$. Find the expected value of $\det(A-A^t)$ (as a function of $n$), where $A^t$ is the transpose of $A$.
-/
theorem putnam_2016_b4
  (n : ℕ) (npos : n ≥ 1)
  (mats01 : Set (Matrix (Fin (2 * n)) (Fin (2 * n)) ℝ))
  (hmats01 : mats01 = {A | ∀ i j : Fin (2 * n), A i j = 0 ∨ A i j = 1}) :
  (∑' A : mats01, (A.1 - (Matrix.transpose A)).det) / mats01.ncard = putnam_2016_b4_solution n :=
sorry

title: putnam_2016_b4
content:
(* Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2016_b4:
   the expected determinant of A - transpose A for a uniformly random
   2n-by-2n zero-one matrix. This file contains no proof. *)

From Stdlib Require Import Lists.List Arith.PeanoNat Arith.Factorial
  Vectors.Fin Reals.

Import ListNotations.
Open Scope R_scope.

Definition putnam_2016_b4_matrix (n : nat) : Type :=
  Fin.t n -> Fin.t n -> R.

Definition putnam_2016_b4_fin_index {n : nat} (i : Fin.t n) : nat :=
  proj1_sig (Fin.to_nat i).

Fixpoint putnam_2016_b4_fin_list
    (n : nat) : list (Fin.t n) :=
  match n as k return list (Fin.t k) with
  | O => []
  | S k =>
      Fin.F1 :: map Fin.FS (putnam_2016_b4_fin_list k)
  end.

Fixpoint putnam_2016_b4_bit_words (k : nat) : list (list bool) :=
  match k with
  | O => [[]]
  | S k' =>
      map (cons false) (putnam_2016_b4_bit_words k') ++
      map (cons true) (putnam_2016_b4_bit_words k')
  end.

Definition putnam_2016_b4_matrix_of_bits
    (n : nat) (bits : list bool) : putnam_2016_b4_matrix n :=
  fun i j =>
    if nth
         (putnam_2016_b4_fin_index i * n +
          putnam_2016_b4_fin_index j)%nat
         bits false
    then 1
    else 0.

Definition putnam_2016_b4_transpose
    {n : nat} (A : putnam_2016_b4_matrix n) :
    putnam_2016_b4_matrix n :=
  fun i j => A j i.

Definition putnam_2016_b4_matrix_sub
    {n : nat}
    (A B : putnam_2016_b4_matrix n) :
    putnam_2016_b4_matrix n :=
  fun i j => A i j - B i j.

Definition putnam_2016_b4_rows
    {T : Type} (n : nat) (A : Fin.t n -> Fin.t n -> T) :
    list (list T) :=
  map
    (fun i =>
      map (fun j => A i j) (putnam_2016_b4_fin_list n))
    (putnam_2016_b4_fin_list n).

Definition putnam_2016_b4_delete_nth
    {T : Type} (j : nat) (xs : list T) : list T :=
  firstn j xs ++ skipn (S j) xs.

Definition putnam_2016_b4_cofactor_sign (j : nat) : R :=
  if Nat.even j then 1 else -1.

Fixpoint putnam_2016_b4_real_sum (xs : list R) : R :=
  match xs with
  | [] => 0
  | x :: rest => x + putnam_2016_b4_real_sum rest
  end.

Fixpoint putnam_2016_b4_list_det
    (n : nat) (M : list (list R)) {struct n} : R :=
  match n with
  | O => 1
  | S k =>
      match M with
      | [] => 0
      | row :: rows =>
          putnam_2016_b4_real_sum
            (map
              (fun j : nat =>
                putnam_2016_b4_cofactor_sign j *
                nth j row 0 *
                putnam_2016_b4_list_det k
                  (map (putnam_2016_b4_delete_nth j) rows))
              (seq 0 (S k)))
      end
  end.

Definition putnam_2016_b4_determinant
    (n : nat) (A : putnam_2016_b4_matrix n) : R :=
  putnam_2016_b4_list_det n (putnam_2016_b4_rows n A).

Definition putnam_2016_b4_determinant_value
    (n : nat) (bits : list bool) : R :=
  let A := putnam_2016_b4_matrix_of_bits (2 * n) bits in
  putnam_2016_b4_determinant (2 * n)
    (putnam_2016_b4_matrix_sub A (putnam_2016_b4_transpose A)).

Definition putnam_2016_b4_all_matrices
    (n : nat) : list (list bool) :=
  putnam_2016_b4_bit_words ((2 * n) * (2 * n)).

Definition putnam_2016_b4_expected_value (n : nat) : R :=
  let matrices := putnam_2016_b4_all_matrices n in
  putnam_2016_b4_real_sum
    (map (putnam_2016_b4_determinant_value n) matrices) /
  INR (length matrices).

Definition putnam_2016_b4_solution (n : nat) : R :=
  INR (fact (2 * n)) /
  (INR (Nat.pow 4 n) * INR (fact n)).

Theorem putnam_2016_b4
    (n : nat)
    (npos : (1 <= n)%nat) :
  putnam_2016_b4_expected_value n =
  putnam_2016_b4_solution n.
Admitted.

definition putnam_2016_b4_solution :: "nat \<Rightarrow> real" where "putnam_2016_b4_solution \<equiv> undefined"

theorem putnam_2016_b4:

  and mats01 :: "(real^'m^'m) set"

  assumes mcard: "CARD('m) = 2 * n"

end

(*
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2016_b4
  (putnambench__hol-light__putnam_2016_b4): the expected determinant of
  A - transpose A for a uniformly random 2n by 2n zero-one matrix.
  This file contains no proof.
*)

let statement =
  `let ndet =
     \(A:num->num->real) m.
       sum {p:num->num |
              BIJ p (1..m) (1..m) /\
              (!i:num. ~(i IN 1..m) ==> p i = i)}
           (\p.
              (if EVEN
                    (CARD
                      {(i,j) |
                         i IN 1..m /\ j IN 1..m /\
                         i < j /\ p j < p i})
               then &1
               else -- &1) *
              product (1..m) (\i. A i (p i))) in
   let mats01 =
     \m:num.
       {A:num->num->real |
          !i j:num.
            if i IN 1..m /\ j IN 1..m
            then A i j = &0 \/ A i j = &1
            else A i j = &0} in
   !n:num.
     1 <= n
     ==>
     sum (mats01 (2 * n))
       (\A. ndet (\i j. A i j - A j i) (2 * n)) /
       &(CARD (mats01 (2 * n))) =
     &(FACT (2 * n)) / ((&4) pow n * &(FACT n))`;;

title: putnam_2016_b4
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2016_b4:
;; the expected determinant of A minus its transpose for a uniformly random
;; 2n by 2n zero-one matrix is (2n)!/(4^n n!). This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

;; Each integer from 0 through 2^(2n)^2-1 is the row-major bit string of one
;; zero-one matrix, giving a bijection with the source's finite matrix set.
;; All entries of A-transpose(A), its determinant, and the finite sum are
;; integers. ACL2's exact rational average therefore embeds into the reals as
;; exactly the source average, without restricting any matrix or real value.

(defun putnam-2016-b4-indices (count)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix count)))
  (if (zp count)
      nil
    (cons (- count 1)
          (putnam-2016-b4-indices (- count 1)))))

(defun putnam-2016-b4-prefix-each (item lists)
  (if (endp lists)
      nil
    (cons (cons item (car lists))
          (putnam-2016-b4-prefix-each item (cdr lists)))))

(defun putnam-2016-b4-insert-everywhere (item list)
  (if (endp list)
      (list (list item))
    (cons (cons item list)
          (putnam-2016-b4-prefix-each
           (car list)
           (putnam-2016-b4-insert-everywhere
            item (cdr list))))))

(defun putnam-2016-b4-insert-into-each (item lists)
  (if (endp lists)
      nil
    (append
     (putnam-2016-b4-insert-everywhere item (car lists))
     (putnam-2016-b4-insert-into-each
      item (cdr lists)))))

(defun putnam-2016-b4-permutations (list)
  (if (endp list)
      (list nil)
    (putnam-2016-b4-insert-into-each
     (car list)
     (putnam-2016-b4-permutations (cdr list)))))

(defun putnam-2016-b4-count-smaller (item list)
  (if (endp list)
      0
    (+ (if (< (car list) item) 1 0)
       (putnam-2016-b4-count-smaller item (cdr list)))))

(defun putnam-2016-b4-inversion-count (permutation)
  (if (endp permutation)
      0
    (+ (putnam-2016-b4-count-smaller
        (car permutation) (cdr permutation))
       (putnam-2016-b4-inversion-count
        (cdr permutation)))))

(defun putnam-2016-b4-permutation-sign (permutation)
  (if (evenp
       (putnam-2016-b4-inversion-count permutation))
      1
    -1))

(defun putnam-2016-b4-matrix-entry
    (code dimension row column)
  (mod
   (floor
    code
    (expt 2 (+ (* row dimension) column)))
   2))

(defun putnam-2016-b4-skew-entry
    (code dimension row column)
  (-
   (putnam-2016-b4-matrix-entry
    code dimension row column)
   (putnam-2016-b4-matrix-entry
    code dimension column row)))

(defun putnam-2016-b4-diagonal-product
    (code dimension row permutation)
  (if (endp permutation)
      1
    (* (putnam-2016-b4-skew-entry
        code dimension row (car permutation))
       (putnam-2016-b4-diagonal-product
        code dimension (+ row 1) (cdr permutation)))))

(defun putnam-2016-b4-determinant-sum
    (code dimension permutations)
  (if (endp permutations)
      0
    (+ (* (putnam-2016-b4-permutation-sign
           (car permutations))
          (putnam-2016-b4-diagonal-product
           code dimension 0 (car permutations)))
       (putnam-2016-b4-determinant-sum
        code dimension (cdr permutations)))))

;; This is the exact Leibniz determinant of A-transpose(A).

(defun putnam-2016-b4-determinant
    (code dimension permutations)
  (putnam-2016-b4-determinant-sum
   code dimension permutations))

(defun putnam-2016-b4-sum-matrices
    (code remaining dimension permutations)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix remaining)))
  (if (zp remaining)
      0
    (+ (putnam-2016-b4-determinant
        code dimension permutations)
       (putnam-2016-b4-sum-matrices
        (+ code 1)
        (- remaining 1)
        dimension
        permutations))))

(defun putnam-2016-b4-average (n)
  (let* ((dimension (* 2 n))
         (entry-count (* dimension dimension))
         (matrix-count (expt 2 entry-count))
         (permutations
          (putnam-2016-b4-permutations
           (putnam-2016-b4-indices dimension))))
    (/ (putnam-2016-b4-sum-matrices
        0 matrix-count dimension permutations)
       matrix-count)))

(defun putnam-2016-b4-factorial (n)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix n)))
  (if (zp n)
      1
    (* n
       (putnam-2016-b4-factorial (- n 1)))))

(defun putnam-2016-b4-solution (n)
  (/ (putnam-2016-b4-factorial (* 2 n))
     (* (expt 4 n)
        (putnam-2016-b4-factorial n))))

(defun putnambench-putnam-2016-b4-statement (n)
  (implies
   (and (natp n)
        (<= 1 n))
   (equal
    (putnam-2016-b4-average n)
    (putnam-2016-b4-solution n))))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

-- Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2016_b4
-- (putnambench__agda__putnam_2016_b4): the expected determinant of A minus
-- its transpose for a uniformly random 2n by 2n zero-one matrix equals
-- (2n)! divided by 4^n n!. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module Putnam2016B4 where

open import Agda.Builtin.Bool using (Bool; false; true)
open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; _*_)

infix 4 _!=_ _<=N_
infixr 3 _and_
infixr 2 _or_
infixr 5 _::_

data Bottom : Set where

Not : Set -> Set
Not A =
  A -> Bottom

_!=_ : {A : Set} -> A -> A -> Set
x != y =
  Not (x == y)

record _and_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data _or_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  left  : A -> A or B
  right : B -> A or B

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

data _<=N_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set where
  zero<=N   : {n : Nat} -> zero <=N n
  suc<=sucN : {m n : Nat} -> m <=N n -> suc m <=N suc n

Positive : Nat -> Set
Positive n =
  suc zero <=N n

record CompleteOrderedRealField (R : Set) : Set1 where
  field
    zeroR oneR : R
    add multiply : R -> R -> R
    negate inverse : R -> R
    lessOrEqual : R -> R -> Set
    fromNat : Nat -> R

    one-not-zero :
      oneR != zeroR

    add-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> add x y == add y x
    add-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      add (add x y) z == add x (add y z)
    add-zero :
      (x : R) -> add x zeroR == x
    add-inverse :
      (x : R) -> add x (negate x) == zeroR

    multiply-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> multiply x y == multiply y x
    multiply-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply (multiply x y) z ==
      multiply x (multiply y z)
    multiply-one :
      (x : R) -> multiply x oneR == x
    multiply-zero :
      (x : R) -> multiply x zeroR == zeroR
    distribute :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply x (add y z) ==
      add (multiply x y) (multiply x z)
    inverse-zero :
      inverse zeroR == zeroR
    multiply-inverse :
      (x : R) ->
      x != zeroR ->
      multiply x (inverse x) == oneR

    order-reflexive :
      (x : R) -> lessOrEqual x x
    order-transitive :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y z ->
      lessOrEqual x z
    order-antisymmetric :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y x ->
      x == y
    order-total :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y or lessOrEqual y x
    add-order :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual (add z x) (add z y)
    multiply-nonnegative :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR x ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR y ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR (multiply x y)
    zero-less-than-one :
      lessOrEqual zeroR oneR and zeroR != oneR

    fromNat-zero :
      fromNat zero == zeroR
    fromNat-successor :
      (n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (suc n) == add (fromNat n) oneR
    fromNat-addition :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m + n) == add (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-multiplication :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m * n) == multiply (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-injective :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat m == fromNat n ->
      m == n

    archimedean :
      (x : R) ->
      Exists Nat
        (\ n -> lessOrEqual x (fromNat n))
    least-upper-bound :
      (P : R -> Set) ->
      Exists R P ->
      Exists R
        (\ upper ->
          (x : R) ->
          P x ->
          lessOrEqual x upper) ->
      Exists R
        (\ supremum ->
          ((x : R) ->
            P x ->
            lessOrEqual x supremum)
          and
          ((upper : R) ->
            ((x : R) ->
              P x ->
              lessOrEqual x upper) ->
            lessOrEqual supremum upper))

open CompleteOrderedRealField

subtract :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
subtract reals x y =
  add reals x (negate reals y)

divide :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
divide reals x y =
  multiply reals x (inverse reals y)

data Fin : Nat -> Set where
  fzero : {n : Nat} -> Fin (suc n)
  fsuc  : {n : Nat} -> Fin n -> Fin (suc n)

data Vec (A : Set) : Nat -> Set where
  []   : Vec A zero
  _::_ : {n : Nat} -> A -> Vec A n -> Vec A (suc n)

lookup :
  {A : Set} {n : Nat} ->
  Vec A n ->
  Fin n ->
  A
lookup (x :: xs) fzero =
  x
lookup (x :: xs) (fsuc i) =
  lookup xs i

Matrix : Set -> Nat -> Set
Matrix R n =
  Fin n -> Fin n -> R

sumFin :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  {n : Nat} ->
  (Fin n -> R) ->
  R
sumFin reals {zero} term =
  zeroR reals
sumFin reals {suc n} term =
  add reals
    (term fzero)
    (sumFin reals (\ i -> term (fsuc i)))

skip :
  {n : Nat} ->
  Fin (suc n) ->
  Fin n ->
  Fin (suc n)
skip {zero} removed ()
skip {suc n} fzero i =
  fsuc i
skip {suc n} (fsuc removed) fzero =
  fzero
skip {suc n} (fsuc removed) (fsuc i) =
  fsuc (skip removed i)

firstRowMinor :
  {R : Set} {n : Nat} ->
  Matrix R (suc n) ->
  Fin (suc n) ->
  Matrix R n
firstRowMinor A removedColumn i j =
  A (fsuc i) (skip removedColumn j)

alternatingSign :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  {n : Nat} ->
  Fin n ->
  R
alternatingSign reals fzero =
  oneR reals
alternatingSign reals (fsuc i) =
  negate reals (alternatingSign reals i)

determinant :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  {n : Nat} ->
  Matrix R n ->
  R
determinant reals {zero} A =
  oneR reals
determinant reals {suc n} A =
  sumFin reals
    (\ column ->
      multiply reals
        (alternatingSign reals column)
        (multiply reals
          (A fzero column)
          (determinant reals (firstRowMinor A column))))

transpose :
  {R : Set} {n : Nat} ->
  Matrix R n ->
  Matrix R n
transpose A i j =
  A j i

matrixSubtract :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  {n : Nat} ->
  Matrix R n ->
  Matrix R n ->
  Matrix R n
matrixSubtract reals A B i j =
  subtract reals (A i j) (B i j)

boolToReal :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Bool ->
  R
boolToReal reals false =
  zeroR reals
boolToReal reals true =
  oneR reals

BoolMatrix : Nat -> Nat -> Set
BoolMatrix rows columns =
  Vec (Vec Bool columns) rows

realMatrix :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  {n : Nat} ->
  BoolMatrix n n ->
  Matrix R n
realMatrix reals A i j =
  boolToReal reals (lookup (lookup A i) j)

skewDifference :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  {n : Nat} ->
  BoolMatrix n n ->
  Matrix R n
skewDifference reals A =
  matrixSubtract reals
    (realMatrix reals A)
    (transpose (realMatrix reals A))

sumAllBoolVectors :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  {n : Nat} ->
  (Vec Bool n -> R) ->
  R
sumAllBoolVectors reals {zero} value =
  value []
sumAllBoolVectors reals {suc n} value =
  add reals
    (sumAllBoolVectors reals
      (\ tail -> value (false :: tail)))
    (sumAllBoolVectors reals
      (\ tail -> value (true :: tail)))

sumAllBoolMatrices :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  {rows columns : Nat} ->
  (BoolMatrix rows columns -> R) ->
  R
sumAllBoolMatrices reals {rows = zero} value =
  value []
sumAllBoolMatrices reals {rows = suc rows} {columns} value =
  sumAllBoolVectors reals
    (\ row ->
      sumAllBoolMatrices reals
        (\ remainingRows ->
          value (row :: remainingRows)))

oneN : Nat
oneN =
  suc zero

twoN : Nat
twoN =
  suc oneN

fourN : Nat
fourN =
  twoN * twoN

matrixSize : Nat -> Nat
matrixSize n =
  twoN * n

naturalPower : Nat -> Nat -> Nat
naturalPower base zero =
  oneN
naturalPower base (suc exponent) =
  base * naturalPower base exponent

factorial : Nat -> Nat
factorial zero =
  oneN
factorial (suc n) =
  suc n * factorial n

matrixCount : Nat -> Nat
matrixCount n =
  naturalPower twoN
    (matrixSize n * matrixSize n)

expectedDeterminant :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Nat ->
  R
expectedDeterminant reals n =
  divide reals
    (sumAllBoolMatrices reals
      {rows = matrixSize n}
      {columns = matrixSize n}
      (\ A ->
        determinant reals
          (skewDifference reals A)))
    (fromNat reals (matrixCount n))

putnam2016B4Solution :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Nat ->
  R
putnam2016B4Solution reals n =
  divide reals
    (fromNat reals
      (factorial (matrixSize n)))
    (multiply reals
      (fromNat reals
        (naturalPower fourN n))
      (fromNat reals
        (factorial n)))

putnam-2016-b4 : Set1
putnam-2016-b4 =
  (R : Set) ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) ->
  (n : Nat) ->
  Positive n ->
  expectedDeterminant reals n ==
  putnam2016B4Solution reals n

title: putnam_2016_b4
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2016_b4:
  the expected determinant of A minus its transpose for a uniformly random
  2n by 2n zero-one matrix is (2n)! divided by 4^n n!. This file contains
  no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open arithmeticTheory pred_setTheory fcpTheory permutesTheory realTheory
     real_sigmaTheory;

val putnam_2016_b4 =
  ``let determinant =
      \M : real['N]['N].
        ITSET
          (\p : num -> num. \sum : real.
             (if evenperm p then
                ITSET
                  (\i : num. \acc : real. M ' i ' (p i) * acc)
                  (count (dimindex (:'N)))
                  1
              else
                -(ITSET
                    (\i : num. \acc : real. M ' i ' (p i) * acc)
                    (count (dimindex (:'N)))
                    1)) +
             sum)
          {p : num -> num | p permutes count (dimindex (:'N))}
          0
    in
    let mats01 =
      {A : real['N]['N] |
         !i j : num.
           i < dimindex (:'N) /\
           j < dimindex (:'N)
           ==>
           A ' i ' j = 0 \/ A ' i ' j = 1}
    in
      !n : num.
        1 <= n /\
        dimindex (:'N) = 2 * n
        ==>
        SIGMA
          (\A : real['N]['N].
             determinant
               (FCP i j. A ' i ' j - A ' j ' i))
          mats01 /
          (&(CARD mats01) : real) =
        (&(FACT (2 * n)) : real) /
          (4 pow n * &(FACT n))``;

title: putnam_2016_b4
content:
$(
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact
  putnam_2016_b4: the expected determinant of A minus its transpose for a
  uniformly random binary matrix of even order. This file contains no proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  For positive n, 0 ..^ (2*n) is the canonical 2n-element carrier.
  The maps from its Cartesian square into {0,1} are exactly the binary
  2n by 2n matrices. Giving every such map equal weight is equivalent to
  choosing all entries independently, each uniformly from {0,1}.

  SetMM's tpos is matrix transpose, -g in the real matrix ring is matrix
  subtraction, and maDet over RRfld is the real determinant. Thus the
  quotient on the left is the source expectation. The right side inlines
  the solution (2n)! / (4^n n!). Inlining both source definitions is a
  bidirectionally equivalent definitional substitution. The final declaration
  is the single unproved $a corpus statement; there is no $p declaration.
$)

${
  $d A n $.

  putnambench-putnam-2016-b4 $a |- A. n e. NN
    (
      (
        sum_ A e.
          (
            { 0 , 1 }
            ^m
            (
              ( 0 ..^ ( 2 x. n ) )
              X.
              ( 0 ..^ ( 2 x. n ) )
            )
          )
          (
            ( ( 0 ..^ ( 2 x. n ) ) maDet RRfld )
            `
            (
              A
              ( -g ` ( ( 0 ..^ ( 2 x. n ) ) Mat RRfld ) )
              tpos A
            )
          )
      )
      /
      (
        #
        `
        (
          { 0 , 1 }
          ^m
          (
            ( 0 ..^ ( 2 x. n ) )
            X.
            ( 0 ..^ ( 2 x. n ) )
          )
        )
      )
      =
      (
        ( ! ` ( 2 x. n ) )
        /
        (
          ( 4 ^ n )
          x.
          ( ! ` n )
        )
      )
    )
  $.
$}

title: putnam_2016_b4
content:
% Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2016_b4:
% the expected determinant of A - transpose(A), for a uniformly random
% 2n-by-2n binary matrix A, equals (2n)!/(4^n n!). This file contains no proof.

putnam_2016_b4[n: posnat]: THEORY
BEGIN
  square_matrix: TYPE = [nat, nat -> real]

  safe_div(numerator, denominator: real): real =
    IF denominator = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      numerator / denominator
    ENDIF

  nat_factorial(index: nat): RECURSIVE nat =
    IF index = 0 THEN
      1
    ELSE
      index * nat_factorial(index - 1)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE index

  quotient_aux(
      numerator, denominator, fuel: nat): RECURSIVE nat =
    IF fuel = 0
        OR denominator = 0
        OR numerator < denominator THEN
      0
    ELSE
      1
        + quotient_aux(
            numerator - denominator,
            denominator,
            fuel - 1)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE fuel

  remainder_aux(
      numerator, denominator, fuel: nat): RECURSIVE nat =
    IF fuel = 0
        OR denominator = 0
        OR numerator < denominator THEN
      numerator
    ELSE
      remainder_aux(
        numerator - denominator,
        denominator,
        fuel - 1)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE fuel

  safe_ndiv(numerator, denominator: nat): nat =
    quotient_aux(
      numerator,
      denominator,
      numerator + 1)

  safe_mod(numerator, denominator: nat): nat =
    IF denominator = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      remainder_aux(
        numerator,
        denominator,
        numerator + 1)
    ENDIF

  matrix_code_count(size: nat): nat =
    2 ^ (size * size)

  matrix_bit(
      matrix_code, size, row, column: nat): nat =
    safe_mod(
      safe_ndiv(
        matrix_code,
        2 ^ (row * size + column)),
      2)

  binary_matrix_entry(
      matrix_code, size, row, column: nat): real =
    IF matrix_bit(matrix_code, size, row, column) = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      1
    ENDIF

  skew_matrix(matrix_code, size: nat): square_matrix =
    LAMBDA (row, column: nat):
      binary_matrix_entry(
        matrix_code, size, row, column)
        - binary_matrix_entry(
            matrix_code, size, column, row)

  function_code_count(size: nat): nat =
    IF size = 0 THEN 1 ELSE size ^ size ENDIF

  permutation_entry(code, row, size: nat): nat =
    IF size = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      safe_mod(safe_ndiv(code, size ^ row), size)
    ENDIF

  permutation_code(code, size: nat): bool =
    code < function_code_count(size)
      AND (FORALL (row_1, row_2: nat):
        (row_1 < size
          AND row_2 < size
          AND permutation_entry(code, row_1, size)
            = permutation_entry(code, row_2, size))
        IMPLIES row_1 = row_2)

  pair_row(pair, size: nat): nat =
    safe_ndiv(pair, size)

  pair_column(pair, size: nat): nat =
    safe_mod(pair, size)

  inversion_at(code, pair, size: nat): bool =
    pair_row(pair, size) < size
      AND pair_column(pair, size) < size
      AND pair_row(pair, size) < pair_column(pair, size)
      AND permutation_entry(code, pair_row(pair, size), size)
        > permutation_entry(code, pair_column(pair, size), size)

  count_true(
      property: [nat -> bool],
      count: nat): RECURSIVE nat =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      count_true(property, count - 1)
        + IF property(count - 1) THEN 1 ELSE 0 ENDIF
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  inversion_count(code, size: nat): nat =
    count_true(
      (LAMBDA (pair: nat): inversion_at(code, pair, size)),
      size * size)

  permutation_sign(code, size: nat): real =
    IF mod(inversion_count(code, size), 2) = 0 THEN
      1
    ELSE
      -1
    ENDIF

  permutation_product(
      A: square_matrix,
      code, size, count: nat): RECURSIVE real =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      1
    ELSE
      permutation_product(A, code, size, count - 1)
        * A(
            count - 1,
            permutation_entry(code, count - 1, size))
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  determinant_sum(
      A: square_matrix,
      size, limit: nat): RECURSIVE real =
    IF limit = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      LET code: nat = limit - 1 IN
        determinant_sum(A, size, limit - 1)
          + IF permutation_code(code, size) THEN
              permutation_sign(code, size)
                * permutation_product(A, code, size, size)
            ELSE
              0
            ENDIF
    ENDIF
  MEASURE limit

  determinant(A: square_matrix, size: nat): real =
    determinant_sum(A, size, function_code_count(size))

  binary_determinant_sum(
      size, limit: nat): RECURSIVE real =
    IF limit = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      binary_determinant_sum(size, limit - 1)
        + determinant(skew_matrix(limit - 1, size), size)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE limit

  expected_determinant(size: nat): real =
    safe_div(
      binary_determinant_sum(
        size, matrix_code_count(size)),
      matrix_code_count(size) :: real)

  putnam_2016_b4_solution(index: nat): real =
    safe_div(
      nat_factorial(2 * index) :: real,
      (4 ^ index * nat_factorial(index)) :: real)

  putnam_2016_b4: bool =
    expected_determinant(2 * n)
      = putnam_2016_b4_solution(n)
END putnam_2016_b4

title: putnam_2016_b5
content:
import Mathlib

open Polynomial Filter Topology Real Set Nat List

abbrev putnam_2016_b5_solution : Set (Set.Ioi (1 : ℝ) → Set.Ioi (1 : ℝ)) := sorry
-- {f : Set.Ioi (1 : ℝ) → Set.Ioi (1 : ℝ) | ∃ c : ℝ, c > 0 ∧ ∀ x : Set.Ioi (1 : ℝ), (f x : ℝ) = x ^ c}
/--
Find all functions $f$ from the interval $(1,\infty)$ to $(1,\infty)$ with the following property: if $x,y \in (1,\infty)$ and $x^2 \leq y \leq x^3$, then $(f(x))^2 \leq f(y) \leq (f(x))^3$.
-/
theorem putnam_2016_b5
  (f : Set.Ioi (1 : ℝ) → Set.Ioi (1 : ℝ)) :
  f ∈ putnam_2016_b5_solution ↔
    (∀ x y : Set.Ioi (1 : ℝ), ((x : ℝ) ^ 2 ≤ y ∧ y ≤ (x : ℝ) ^ 3) → ((f x : ℝ) ^ 2 ≤ f y ∧ f y ≤ (f x : ℝ) ^ 3)) :=
sorry

title: putnam_2016_b5
content:
Require Import Reals Rpower.
Open Scope R.
Definition putnam_2016_b5_solution : (R -> R) -> Prop := fun f => exists (c: R), c > 0 /\ forall (x: R), x > 1 -> f x = Rpower x c .
Theorem putnam_2016_b5
    (f : R -> R)
    (fle : Prop := (forall x : R, x > 1 -> f x > 1) /\ (forall x y : R, (x > 1 /\ y > 1 /\ x*x <= y <= x*x*x) -> ((f x) * (f x) <= f y <= (f x) * (f x) * (f x))))
    : fle <-> putnam_2016_b5_solution f.
Proof. Admitted.

title: putnam_2016_b5
