title: putnam_2017_b1
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2017_b1:
;; two distinct affine lines in the real plane intersect exactly when every
;; nonzero scalar and every point off both lines determine corresponding
;; points on the two lines with the prescribed displacement ratio. This file
;; contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))

;; The real coefficient domain is presented as a real closed ordered field.
;; The square-root and odd-degree-root laws are the standard algebraic
;; characterization of real closedness. FN-EQUAL against a constant-T
;; function supplies universal quantification over the whole represented
;; field. Every FN-EQUAL operand and coefficient-traversal function is checked
;; to be tame before use.
;;
;; A source affine line {v+t*w | t real}, with w nonzero, is represented by
;; a nontrivial equation a*x+b*y=c. These presentations are bidirectionally
;; equivalent: from w=(wx,wy) take (a,b)=(-wy,wx), and conversely
;; (b,-a) is a nonzero direction for any equation with (a,b) nonzero.
;; Equality of represented line sets is exactly proportionality of the three
;; coefficients, expressed below by the three 2-by-2 minors. Existence of the
;; intersection point and of the two points related by the prescribed scalar
;; is equivalently expressed by the determinant and augmented-minor consistency
;; conditions for two linear equations. Thus no line, real scalar, point, or
;; quantified witness is restricted to a finite or rational carrier.
;; Completeness of real closed fields transfers this first-order affine
;; statement bidirectionally between the represented field and the real
;; numbers.

(defun putnam-2017-b1-quoted (object)
  (list 'quote object))

(defun putnam-2017-b1-apply1-term (function argument)
  (list
   'apply$
   (putnam-2017-b1-quoted function)
   (list 'cons argument nil)))

(defun putnam-2017-b1-apply2-term (function left right)
  (list
   'apply$
   (putnam-2017-b1-quoted function)
   (list 'cons left (list 'cons right nil))))

(defun putnam-2017-b1-and-term (terms)
  (if (endp terms)
      (putnam-2017-b1-quoted t)
    (list
     'if
     (car terms)
     (putnam-2017-b1-and-term (cdr terms))
     (putnam-2017-b1-quoted nil))))

(defun putnam-2017-b1-or-term (terms)
  (if (endp terms)
      (putnam-2017-b1-quoted nil)
    (list
     'if
     (car terms)
     (putnam-2017-b1-quoted t)
     (putnam-2017-b1-or-term (cdr terms)))))

(defun putnam-2017-b1-not-term (term)
  (list
   'if
   term
   (putnam-2017-b1-quoted nil)
   (putnam-2017-b1-quoted t)))

(defun putnam-2017-b1-implies-term (antecedent consequent)
  (list
   'if
   antecedent
   consequent
   (putnam-2017-b1-quoted t)))

(defun putnam-2017-b1-true-function (formals)
  (list
   'lambda
   formals
   (putnam-2017-b1-quoted t)))

(defun putnam-2017-b1-carrier-term (carrier element)
  (putnam-2017-b1-apply1-term carrier element))

(defun putnam-2017-b1-operation-term (operation left right)
  (putnam-2017-b1-apply2-term operation left right))

(defun putnam-2017-b1-all-coefficients-function (carrier)
  (list
   'lambda
   '(loop$-gvars loop$-ivars)
   (putnam-2017-b1-carrier-term
    carrier 'loop$-ivars)))

(defun putnam-2017-b1-all-coefficients-term
    (carrier coefficients)
  (list
   'always$+
   (putnam-2017-b1-quoted
    (putnam-2017-b1-all-coefficients-function carrier))
   (putnam-2017-b1-quoted nil)
   coefficients))

(defun putnam-2017-b1-polynomial-term
    (carrier zero coefficients)
  (putnam-2017-b1-and-term
   (list
    (list 'true-listp coefficients)
    (list 'consp coefficients)
    (putnam-2017-b1-all-coefficients-term
     carrier coefficients)
    (putnam-2017-b1-or-term
     (list
      (list 'equal
            (list 'len coefficients)
            (putnam-2017-b1-quoted 1))
      (putnam-2017-b1-not-term
       (list 'equal
             (list 'car (list 'last coefficients))
             (putnam-2017-b1-quoted zero))))))))

(defun putnam-2017-b1-field-laws-function
    (carrier zero one add mul neg inv)
  (let* ((x 'x)
         (y 'y)
         (z 'z)
         (qzero (putnam-2017-b1-quoted zero))
         (qone (putnam-2017-b1-quoted one))
         (add-xy
          (putnam-2017-b1-operation-term add x y))
         (add-yz
          (putnam-2017-b1-operation-term add y z))
         (mul-xy
          (putnam-2017-b1-operation-term mul x y))
         (mul-yz
          (putnam-2017-b1-operation-term mul y z))
         (neg-x
          (putnam-2017-b1-apply1-term neg x))
         (inv-x
          (putnam-2017-b1-apply1-term inv x))
         (domain
          (putnam-2017-b1-and-term
           (list
            (putnam-2017-b1-carrier-term carrier x)
            (putnam-2017-b1-carrier-term carrier y)
            (putnam-2017-b1-carrier-term carrier z))))
         (laws
          (putnam-2017-b1-and-term
           (list
            (putnam-2017-b1-carrier-term carrier add-xy)
            (putnam-2017-b1-carrier-term carrier mul-xy)
            (putnam-2017-b1-carrier-term carrier neg-x)
            (putnam-2017-b1-carrier-term carrier inv-x)
            (list
             'equal
             (putnam-2017-b1-operation-term add add-xy z)
             (putnam-2017-b1-operation-term add x add-yz))
            (list
             'equal
             (putnam-2017-b1-operation-term mul mul-xy z)
             (putnam-2017-b1-operation-term mul x mul-yz))
            (list
             'equal
             add-xy
             (putnam-2017-b1-operation-term add y x))
            (list
             'equal
             mul-xy
             (putnam-2017-b1-operation-term mul y x))
            (list
             'equal
             (putnam-2017-b1-operation-term add x qzero)
             x)
            (list
             'equal
             (putnam-2017-b1-operation-term add x neg-x)
             qzero)
            (list
             'equal
             (putnam-2017-b1-operation-term mul x qone)
             x)
            (putnam-2017-b1-implies-term
             (list 'equal x qzero)
             (list 'equal inv-x qzero))
            (putnam-2017-b1-implies-term
             (putnam-2017-b1-not-term
              (list 'equal x qzero))
             (list
              'equal
              (putnam-2017-b1-operation-term mul x inv-x)
              qone))
            (list
             'equal
             (putnam-2017-b1-operation-term mul x add-yz)
             (putnam-2017-b1-operation-term
              add
              (putnam-2017-b1-operation-term mul x y)
              (putnam-2017-b1-operation-term mul x z)))))))
    (list
     'lambda
     '(x y z)
     (putnam-2017-b1-implies-term domain laws))))

(defun putnam-2017-b1-order-laws-function
    (carrier zero add mul lt)
  (let* ((x 'x)
         (y 'y)
         (z 'z)
         (qzero (putnam-2017-b1-quoted zero))
         (lt-xy
          (putnam-2017-b1-operation-term lt x y))
         (lt-yx
          (putnam-2017-b1-operation-term lt y x))
         (lt-yz
          (putnam-2017-b1-operation-term lt y z))
         (lt-xz
          (putnam-2017-b1-operation-term lt x z))
         (domain
          (putnam-2017-b1-and-term
           (list
            (putnam-2017-b1-carrier-term carrier x)
            (putnam-2017-b1-carrier-term carrier y)
            (putnam-2017-b1-carrier-term carrier z))))
         (laws
          (putnam-2017-b1-and-term
           (list
            (putnam-2017-b1-not-term
             (putnam-2017-b1-operation-term lt x x))
            (putnam-2017-b1-or-term
             (list
              lt-xy
              (list 'equal x y)
              lt-yx))
            (putnam-2017-b1-implies-term
             (putnam-2017-b1-and-term
              (list lt-xy lt-yz))
             lt-xz)
            (putnam-2017-b1-implies-term
             lt-xy
             (putnam-2017-b1-operation-term
              lt
              (putnam-2017-b1-operation-term add x z)
              (putnam-2017-b1-operation-term add y z)))
            (putnam-2017-b1-implies-term
             (putnam-2017-b1-and-term
              (list
               (putnam-2017-b1-operation-term lt qzero x)
               (putnam-2017-b1-operation-term lt qzero y)))
             (putnam-2017-b1-operation-term
              lt
              qzero
              (putnam-2017-b1-operation-term mul x y)))))))
    (list
     'lambda
     '(x y z)
     (putnam-2017-b1-implies-term domain laws))))

(defun putnam-2017-b1-square-root-laws-function
    (carrier zero mul lt square-root)
  (let* ((x 'x)
         (qzero (putnam-2017-b1-quoted zero))
         (root
          (putnam-2017-b1-apply1-term square-root x))
         (domain
          (putnam-2017-b1-and-term
           (list
            (putnam-2017-b1-carrier-term carrier x)
            (putnam-2017-b1-not-term
             (putnam-2017-b1-operation-term lt x qzero)))))
         (laws
          (putnam-2017-b1-and-term
           (list
            (putnam-2017-b1-carrier-term carrier root)
            (list
             'equal
             (putnam-2017-b1-operation-term mul root root)
             x)))))
    (list
     'lambda
     '(x)
     (putnam-2017-b1-implies-term domain laws))))

(defun putnam-2017-b1-evaluation-laws-function
    (carrier zero add mul evaluate)
  (let* ((coefficient 'coefficient)
         (rest 'rest)
         (x 'x)
         (qzero (putnam-2017-b1-quoted zero))
         (domain
          (putnam-2017-b1-and-term
           (list
            (putnam-2017-b1-carrier-term
             carrier coefficient)
            (list 'true-listp rest)
            (putnam-2017-b1-all-coefficients-term
             carrier rest)
            (putnam-2017-b1-carrier-term carrier x))))
         (empty-law
          (putnam-2017-b1-implies-term
           (putnam-2017-b1-carrier-term carrier x)
           (list
            'equal
            (putnam-2017-b1-operation-term
             evaluate
             (putnam-2017-b1-quoted nil)
             x)
            qzero)))
         (recursive-value
          (putnam-2017-b1-operation-term
           add
           coefficient
           (putnam-2017-b1-operation-term
            mul
            x
            (putnam-2017-b1-operation-term
             evaluate rest x))))
         (recursive-law
          (putnam-2017-b1-implies-term
           domain
           (putnam-2017-b1-and-term
            (list
             (putnam-2017-b1-carrier-term
              carrier
              (putnam-2017-b1-operation-term
               evaluate
               (list 'cons coefficient rest)
               x))
             (list
              'equal
              (putnam-2017-b1-operation-term
               evaluate
               (list 'cons coefficient rest)
               x)
              recursive-value))))))
    (list
     'lambda
     '(coefficient rest x)
     (putnam-2017-b1-and-term
      (list empty-law recursive-law)))))

(defun putnam-2017-b1-odd-root-laws-function
    (carrier zero evaluate odd-root)
  (let* ((coefficients 'coefficients)
         (root
          (putnam-2017-b1-apply1-term
           odd-root coefficients))
         (domain
          (putnam-2017-b1-and-term
           (list
            (putnam-2017-b1-polynomial-term
             carrier zero coefficients)
            (list 'evenp (list 'len coefficients)))))
         (laws
          (putnam-2017-b1-and-term
           (list
            (putnam-2017-b1-carrier-term carrier root)
            (list
             'equal
             (putnam-2017-b1-operation-term
              evaluate coefficients root)
             (putnam-2017-b1-quoted zero))))))
    (list
     'lambda
     '(coefficients)
     (putnam-2017-b1-implies-term domain laws))))

(defun putnam-2017-b1-real-closed-field-p
    (carrier zero one add mul neg inv lt square-root odd-root
             evaluate)
  (let* ((field-laws
          (putnam-2017-b1-field-laws-function
           carrier zero one add mul neg inv))
         (field-laws-true
          (putnam-2017-b1-true-function '(x y z)))
         (order-laws
          (putnam-2017-b1-order-laws-function
           carrier zero add mul lt))
         (order-laws-true
          (putnam-2017-b1-true-function '(x y z)))
         (square-root-laws
          (putnam-2017-b1-square-root-laws-function
           carrier zero mul lt square-root))
         (square-root-laws-true
          (putnam-2017-b1-true-function '(x)))
         (evaluation-laws
          (putnam-2017-b1-evaluation-laws-function
           carrier zero add mul evaluate))
         (evaluation-laws-true
          (putnam-2017-b1-true-function
           '(coefficient rest x)))
         (odd-root-laws
          (putnam-2017-b1-odd-root-laws-function
           carrier zero evaluate odd-root))
         (odd-root-laws-true
          (putnam-2017-b1-true-function
           '(coefficients))))
    (and
     (tamep-functionp carrier)
     (tamep-functionp add)
     (tamep-functionp mul)
     (tamep-functionp neg)
     (tamep-functionp inv)
     (tamep-functionp lt)
     (tamep-functionp square-root)
     (tamep-functionp odd-root)
     (tamep-functionp evaluate)
     (tamep-functionp field-laws)
     (tamep-functionp field-laws-true)
     (tamep-functionp order-laws)
     (tamep-functionp order-laws-true)
     (tamep-functionp square-root-laws)
     (tamep-functionp square-root-laws-true)
     (tamep-functionp evaluation-laws)
     (tamep-functionp evaluation-laws-true)
     (tamep-functionp odd-root-laws)
     (tamep-functionp odd-root-laws-true)
     (apply$ carrier (list zero))
     (apply$ carrier (list one))
     (not (equal zero one))
     (fn-equal field-laws field-laws-true)
     (fn-equal order-laws order-laws-true)
     (fn-equal square-root-laws square-root-laws-true)
     (fn-equal evaluation-laws evaluation-laws-true)
     (fn-equal odd-root-laws odd-root-laws-true))))

(defun putnam-2017-b1-binary-value (operation left right)
  (apply$ operation (list left right)))

(defun putnam-2017-b1-negated-value (neg value)
  (apply$ neg (list value)))

(defun putnam-2017-b1-subtracted-value (add neg left right)
  (putnam-2017-b1-binary-value
   add left (putnam-2017-b1-negated-value neg right)))

(defun putnam-2017-b1-line-value
    (add mul a b x y)
  (putnam-2017-b1-binary-value
   add
   (putnam-2017-b1-binary-value mul a x)
   (putnam-2017-b1-binary-value mul b y)))

(defun putnam-2017-b1-point-on-line-p
    (add mul a b c x y)
  (equal
   (putnam-2017-b1-line-value add mul a b x y)
   c))

(defun putnam-2017-b1-line-p
    (carrier zero a b c)
  (and
   (apply$ carrier (list a))
   (apply$ carrier (list b))
   (apply$ carrier (list c))
   (not (and (equal a zero)
             (equal b zero)))))

(defun putnam-2017-b1-same-line-p
    (mul a1 b1 c1 a2 b2 c2)
  (and
   (equal
    (putnam-2017-b1-binary-value mul a1 b2)
    (putnam-2017-b1-binary-value mul a2 b1))
   (equal
    (putnam-2017-b1-binary-value mul a1 c2)
    (putnam-2017-b1-binary-value mul a2 c1))
   (equal
    (putnam-2017-b1-binary-value mul b1 c2)
    (putnam-2017-b1-binary-value mul b2 c1))))

(defun putnam-2017-b1-linear-system-consistent-p
    (mul a1 b1 c1 a2 b2 c2)
  (or
   (not
    (equal
     (putnam-2017-b1-binary-value mul a1 b2)
     (putnam-2017-b1-binary-value mul a2 b1)))
   (putnam-2017-b1-same-line-p
    mul a1 b1 c1 a2 b2 c2)))

(defun putnam-2017-b1-relation-consistent-p
    (one add mul neg
         a1 b1 c1 a2 b2 c2 scalar px py)
  (let* ((one-minus-scalar
          (putnam-2017-b1-subtracted-value
           add neg one scalar))
         (line2-at-p
          (putnam-2017-b1-line-value
           add mul a2 b2 px py))
         (translated-constant
          (putnam-2017-b1-subtracted-value
           add
           neg
           c2
           (putnam-2017-b1-binary-value
            mul one-minus-scalar line2-at-p)))
         (scaled-a2
          (putnam-2017-b1-binary-value
           mul scalar a2))
         (scaled-b2
          (putnam-2017-b1-binary-value
           mul scalar b2)))
    (putnam-2017-b1-linear-system-consistent-p
     mul
     a1 b1 c1
     scaled-a2 scaled-b2 translated-constant)))

(defun putnam-2017-b1-line-value-term
    (add mul a b x y)
  (putnam-2017-b1-operation-term
   add
   (putnam-2017-b1-operation-term mul a x)
   (putnam-2017-b1-operation-term mul b y)))

(defun putnam-2017-b1-point-on-line-term
    (add mul a b c x y)
  (list
   'equal
   (putnam-2017-b1-line-value-term
    add mul a b x y)
   c))

(defun putnam-2017-b1-same-line-term
    (mul a1 b1 c1 a2 b2 c2)
  (putnam-2017-b1-and-term
   (list
    (list
     'equal
     (putnam-2017-b1-operation-term mul a1 b2)
     (putnam-2017-b1-operation-term mul a2 b1))
    (list
     'equal
     (putnam-2017-b1-operation-term mul a1 c2)
     (putnam-2017-b1-operation-term mul a2 c1))
    (list
     'equal
     (putnam-2017-b1-operation-term mul b1 c2)
     (putnam-2017-b1-operation-term mul b2 c1)))))

(defun putnam-2017-b1-linear-system-consistent-term
    (mul a1 b1 c1 a2 b2 c2)
  (putnam-2017-b1-or-term
   (list
    (putnam-2017-b1-not-term
     (list
      'equal
      (putnam-2017-b1-operation-term mul a1 b2)
      (putnam-2017-b1-operation-term mul a2 b1)))
    (putnam-2017-b1-same-line-term
     mul a1 b1 c1 a2 b2 c2))))

(defun putnam-2017-b1-relation-consistent-term
    (one add mul neg
         a1 b1 c1 a2 b2 c2 scalar px py)
  (let* ((one-minus-scalar
          (putnam-2017-b1-operation-term
           add
           one
           (putnam-2017-b1-apply1-term neg scalar)))
         (line2-at-p
          (putnam-2017-b1-line-value-term
           add mul a2 b2 px py))
         (translated-constant
          (putnam-2017-b1-operation-term
           add
           c2
           (putnam-2017-b1-apply1-term
            neg
            (putnam-2017-b1-operation-term
             mul one-minus-scalar line2-at-p))))
         (scaled-a2
          (putnam-2017-b1-operation-term
           mul scalar a2))
         (scaled-b2
          (putnam-2017-b1-operation-term
           mul scalar b2)))
    (putnam-2017-b1-linear-system-consistent-term
     mul
     a1 b1 c1
     scaled-a2 scaled-b2 translated-constant)))

(defun putnam-2017-b1-property-function
    (carrier zero one add mul neg a1 b1 c1 a2 b2 c2)
  (let* ((scalar 'scalar)
         (px 'px)
         (py 'py)
         (qzero (putnam-2017-b1-quoted zero))
         (qone (putnam-2017-b1-quoted one))
         (qa1 (putnam-2017-b1-quoted a1))
         (qb1 (putnam-2017-b1-quoted b1))
         (qc1 (putnam-2017-b1-quoted c1))
         (qa2 (putnam-2017-b1-quoted a2))
         (qb2 (putnam-2017-b1-quoted b2))
         (qc2 (putnam-2017-b1-quoted c2))
         (domain
          (putnam-2017-b1-and-term
           (list
            (putnam-2017-b1-carrier-term
             carrier scalar)
            (putnam-2017-b1-not-term
             (list 'equal scalar qzero))
            (putnam-2017-b1-carrier-term carrier px)
            (putnam-2017-b1-carrier-term carrier py)
            (putnam-2017-b1-not-term
             (putnam-2017-b1-point-on-line-term
              add mul qa1 qb1 qc1 px py))
            (putnam-2017-b1-not-term
             (putnam-2017-b1-point-on-line-term
              add mul qa2 qb2 qc2 px py)))))
         (conclusion
          (putnam-2017-b1-relation-consistent-term
           qone add mul neg
           qa1 qb1 qc1 qa2 qb2 qc2
           scalar px py)))
    (list
     'lambda
     '(scalar px py)
     (putnam-2017-b1-implies-term
      domain conclusion))))

(defun putnam-2017-b1-property-p
    (carrier zero one add mul neg a1 b1 c1 a2 b2 c2)
  (let ((property
         (putnam-2017-b1-property-function
          carrier zero one add mul neg
          a1 b1 c1 a2 b2 c2))
        (always-true
         (putnam-2017-b1-true-function
          '(scalar px py))))
    (and
     (tamep-functionp property)
     (tamep-functionp always-true)
     (fn-equal property always-true))))

(defun putnambench-putnam-2017-b1-statement
    (carrier zero one add mul neg inv lt square-root odd-root evaluate
             a1 b1 c1 a2 b2 c2)
  (implies
   (and
    (putnam-2017-b1-real-closed-field-p
     carrier zero one add mul neg inv lt square-root odd-root evaluate)
    (putnam-2017-b1-line-p carrier zero a1 b1 c1)
    (putnam-2017-b1-line-p carrier zero a2 b2 c2)
    (not
     (putnam-2017-b1-same-line-p
      mul a1 b1 c1 a2 b2 c2)))
   (iff
    (putnam-2017-b1-linear-system-consistent-p
     mul a1 b1 c1 a2 b2 c2)
    (putnam-2017-b1-property-p
     carrier zero one add mul neg
     a1 b1 c1 a2 b2 c2))))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

title: putnam_2017_b1
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2017_b1:
-- two distinct real affine lines intersect exactly when every nonzero dilation
-- from every point off both lines maps a point of one line to the other.
-- This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module Putnam2017B1 where

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc)

infix 4 _!=_
infixr 3 _and_

data Bottom : Set where

Not : Set -> Set
Not A =
  A -> Bottom

_!=_ : {A : Set} -> A -> A -> Set
x != y =
  Not (x == y)

record _and_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

record Iff (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor iff
  field
    forward  : A -> B
    backward : B -> A

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

data _or_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  left  : A -> A or B
  right : B -> A or B

record CompleteOrderedRealField (R : Set) : Set1 where
  field
    zeroR oneR : R
    add multiply : R -> R -> R
    negate inverse : R -> R
    lessOrEqual : R -> R -> Set
    fromNat : Nat -> R

    one-not-zero :
      oneR != zeroR

    add-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> add x y == add y x
    add-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      add (add x y) z == add x (add y z)
    add-zero :
      (x : R) -> add x zeroR == x
    add-inverse :
      (x : R) -> add x (negate x) == zeroR

    multiply-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> multiply x y == multiply y x
    multiply-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply (multiply x y) z ==
      multiply x (multiply y z)
    multiply-one :
      (x : R) -> multiply x oneR == x
    multiply-zero :
      (x : R) -> multiply x zeroR == zeroR
    distribute :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply x (add y z) ==
      add (multiply x y) (multiply x z)
    inverse-zero :
      inverse zeroR == zeroR
    multiply-inverse :
      (x : R) ->
      x != zeroR ->
      multiply x (inverse x) == oneR

    order-reflexive :
      (x : R) -> lessOrEqual x x
    order-transitive :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y z ->
      lessOrEqual x z
    order-antisymmetric :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y x ->
      x == y
    order-total :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y or lessOrEqual y x
    add-order :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual (add z x) (add z y)
    multiply-nonnegative :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR x ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR y ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR (multiply x y)
    zero-less-than-one :
      lessOrEqual zeroR oneR and zeroR != oneR

    fromNat-zero :
      fromNat zero == zeroR
    fromNat-successor :
      (n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (suc n) == add (fromNat n) oneR

    archimedean :
      (x : R) ->
      Exists Nat (\ n -> lessOrEqual x (fromNat n))
    least-upper-bound :
      (P : R -> Set) ->
      Exists R P ->
      Exists R
        (\ upper ->
          (x : R) ->
          P x ->
          lessOrEqual x upper) ->
      Exists R
        (\ supremum ->
          ((x : R) ->
            P x ->
            lessOrEqual x supremum)
          and
          ((upper : R) ->
            ((x : R) ->
              P x ->
              lessOrEqual x upper) ->
            lessOrEqual supremum upper))

open CompleteOrderedRealField

record Point (R : Set) : Set where
  constructor point
  field
    x-coordinate : R
    y-coordinate : R

open Point

Line : Set -> Set1
Line R =
  Point R -> Set

PointEqual :
  {R : Set} ->
  Point R ->
  Point R ->
  Set
PointEqual p q =
  x-coordinate p == x-coordinate q
  and
  y-coordinate p == y-coordinate q

zeroPoint :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Point R
zeroPoint reals =
  point (zeroR reals) (zeroR reals)

addPoint :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Point R ->
  Point R ->
  Point R
addPoint reals p q =
  point
    (add reals (x-coordinate p) (x-coordinate q))
    (add reals (y-coordinate p) (y-coordinate q))

negatePoint :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Point R ->
  Point R
negatePoint reals p =
  point
    (negate reals (x-coordinate p))
    (negate reals (y-coordinate p))

subtractPoint :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Point R ->
  Point R ->
  Point R
subtractPoint reals p q =
  addPoint reals p (negatePoint reals q)

scalePoint :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  Point R ->
  Point R
scalePoint reals scalar p =
  point
    (multiply reals scalar (x-coordinate p))
    (multiply reals scalar (y-coordinate p))

LineEqual :
  {R : Set} ->
  Line R ->
  Line R ->
  Set
LineEqual L K =
  (p : Point _) ->
  Iff (L p) (K p)

LineDistinct :
  {R : Set} ->
  Line R ->
  Line R ->
  Set
LineDistinct L K =
  Not (LineEqual L K)

AffineLine :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Point R ->
  Point R ->
  Line R
AffineLine reals v w p =
  Exists _
    (\ t ->
      PointEqual p
        (addPoint reals v (scalePoint reals t w)))

IsLine :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Line R ->
  Set
IsLine reals L =
  Exists _
    (\ v ->
      Exists _
        (\ w ->
          Not (PointEqual w (zeroPoint reals))
          and
          LineEqual L (AffineLine reals v w)))

LineFamilyEqual :
  {R : Set} ->
  (Line R -> Set) ->
  (Line R -> Set) ->
  Set1
LineFamilyEqual lines family =
  (L : Line _) ->
  Iff (lines L) (family L)

LinesIntersect :
  {R : Set} ->
  Line R ->
  Line R ->
  Set
LinesIntersect L1 L2 =
  Exists _
    (\ p ->
      L1 p and L2 p)

DilationCondition :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Line R ->
  Line R ->
  Set
DilationCondition reals L1 L2 =
  (lambda : _) ->
  lambda != zeroR reals ->
  (P : Point _) ->
  (Not (L1 P) and Not (L2 P)) ->
  Exists _
    (\ A1 ->
      Exists _
        (\ A2 ->
          L1 A1
          and
          L2 A2
          and
          PointEqual
            (subtractPoint reals A2 P)
            (scalePoint reals lambda
              (subtractPoint reals A1 P))))

module Putnam2017B1Statement
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) where

  proposition : Set1
  proposition =
    (lines : Line R -> Set) ->
    (L1 L2 : Line R) ->

(*
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2017_b1:
  two distinct affine lines in the real plane intersect exactly when the
  prescribed nonzero dilation condition holds from every point off both
  lines. This file contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open pairTheory pred_setTheory realTheory;

val putnam_2017_b1 =
  ``let add2 =
      \P Q : real # real.
        (FST P + FST Q, SND P + SND Q)
    in
    let sub2 =
      \P Q : real # real.
        (FST P - FST Q, SND P - SND Q)
    in
    let smul2 =
      \c : real.
      \P : real # real.
        (c * FST P, c * SND P)
    in
      !lines : (real # real) set set.
      !L1 L2 : (real # real) set.
        lines =
          {L : (real # real) set |
             ?v w : real # real.
               w <> (0, 0) /\
               L =
                 {p : real # real |
                    ?t : real. p = add2 v (smul2 t w)}} /\
        L1 IN lines /\
        L2 IN lines /\
        L1 <> L2
        ==>
        ((L1 INTER L2 <> EMPTY) <=>
         !lambda : real.
           lambda <> 0
           ==>
           !P : real # real.
             P NOTIN L1 /\ P NOTIN L2
             ==>
             ?A1 A2 : real # real.
               A1 IN L1 /\
               A2 IN L2 /\
               sub2 A2 P = smul2 lambda (sub2 A1 P))``;

title: putnam_2017_b1
content:
% Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2017_b1:
% two distinct affine lines in the real plane intersect exactly when every
% nonzero real scaling relates suitable points on the lines from any point
% lying on neither line. This file contains no proof.

putnam_2017_b1: THEORY
BEGIN
  point: TYPE = [# x_coord: real, y_coord: real #]
  point_set: TYPE = [point -> bool]
  line_family: TYPE = [point_set -> bool]

  zero_point: point =
    (# x_coord := 0, y_coord := 0 #)

  point_add(P, Q: point): point =
    (# x_coord := x_coord(P) + x_coord(Q),
       y_coord := y_coord(P) + y_coord(Q) #)

  point_subtract(P, Q: point): point =
    (# x_coord := x_coord(P) - x_coord(Q),
       y_coord := y_coord(P) - y_coord(Q) #)

  scalar_multiply(scale_factor: real, P: point): point =
    (# x_coord := scale_factor * x_coord(P),
       y_coord := scale_factor * y_coord(P) #)

  affine_line(L: point_set): bool =
    EXISTS (v, w: point):
      w /= zero_point
        AND (FORALL (p: point):
          L(p) IFF
            (EXISTS (t: real):
              p = point_add(v, scalar_multiply(t, w))))

  lines_intersect(L1, L2: point_set): bool =
    EXISTS (p: point): L1(p) AND L2(p)

  scaled_point_condition(L1, L2: point_set): bool =
    FORALL (scale_factor: real):
      scale_factor /= 0 IMPLIES
        (FORALL (P: point):
          (NOT L1(P) AND NOT L2(P)) IMPLIES
            (EXISTS (A1, A2: point):
              L1(A1)
                AND L2(A2)
                AND point_subtract(A2, P)
                  = scalar_multiply(
                      scale_factor, point_subtract(A1, P))))

  putnam_2017_b1: bool =
    FORALL (lines: line_family), (L1, L2: point_set):
      (lines = affine_line
        AND lines(L1)
        AND lines(L2)
        AND L1 /= L2)
      IMPLIES
        (lines_intersect(L1, L2)
          IFF scaled_point_condition(L1, L2))
END putnam_2017_b1

  (hq : ∀ N, q N ↔ p N 2017 ∧ ∀ k : ℕ, k > 1 → k ≠ 2017 → ¬p N k) :

title: putnam_2017_b2

;; Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2017_b2:
;; the least positive starting integer whose 2017 consecutive positive
;; integers have no other representation length greater than one is 16.
;; This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(defun putnam-2017-b2-consecutive-sum (a k)
  (+ (* k a)
     (/ (* k (- k 1)) 2)))

;; For natural K > 1, N is a sum of K consecutive positive integers exactly
;; when N - K*(K-1)/2 is a positive multiple of K.
(defun putnam-2017-b2-representable-at-length-p (n k)
  (and (integerp n)
       (natp k)
       (< 1 k)
       (let ((remainder
              (- n (/ (* k (- k 1)) 2))))
         (and (< 0 remainder)
              (equal (mod remainder k) 0)))))

;; If positive N has a representation of length K, then K <= N. Thus this
;; descent checks every source length greater than one, without bounding the
;; theorem's arbitrary integer N or replacing its quantifiers by a finite
;; carrier.
(defun putnam-2017-b2-no-other-length-through-p (n k)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix k)))
  (if (and (integerp k)
           (< 1 k))
      (and
       (or (equal k 2017)
           (not
            (putnam-2017-b2-representable-at-length-p n k)))
       (putnam-2017-b2-no-other-length-through-p
        n (- k 1)))
    t))

(defun putnam-2017-b2-valid-start-p (a)
  (and
   (integerp a)
   (< 0 a)
   (let ((n (putnam-2017-b2-consecutive-sum a 2017)))
     (and
      (integerp n)
      (< 0 n)
      (putnam-2017-b2-no-other-length-through-p n n)))))

;; ACL2 universally closes A. The first conjunct says that 16 is valid, and
;; the second says that every valid positive integer start is at least 16;
;; together these are exactly the source least-element statement.
(defun putnambench-putnam-2017-b2-statement (a)
  (and
   (putnam-2017-b2-valid-start-p 16)
   (implies
    (putnam-2017-b2-valid-start-p a)
    (<= 16 a))))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

-- Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2017_b2:
-- the least positive starting integer whose sum of 2017 consecutive positive
-- integers has no other representation of length greater than one is 16.
-- This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module Putnam2017B2 where

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_)

infix 4 _<=N_ _<N_
infixr 3 _and_

record _and_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data _<=N_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set where
  zero<=   : {n : Nat} -> zero <=N n
  suc<=suc : {m n : Nat} -> m <=N n -> suc m <=N suc n

data _<N_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set where
  zero<   : {n : Nat} -> zero <N suc n
  suc<suc : {m n : Nat} -> m <N n -> suc m <N suc n

consecutiveSum : Nat -> Nat -> Nat
consecutiveSum a zero =
  zero
consecutiveSum a (suc k) =
  consecutiveSum a k + (a + k)

ValidStartingValue : Nat -> Set
ValidStartingValue a =
  zero <N a
  and
  ((b k : Nat) ->
    zero <N b ->
    suc zero <N k ->
    consecutiveSum a 2017 == consecutiveSum b k ->
    k == 2017)

putnam-2017-b2 : Set
putnam-2017-b2 =
  ValidStartingValue 16
  and
  ((a : Nat) ->
    ValidStartingValue a ->
    16 <=N a)

content:
;; Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2017_b3:
;; a power series with coefficients in {0,1} that equals 3/2 at 2/3 has an
;; irrational value at 1/2. This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

;; The source function f is definitionally eliminated at its two used
;; arguments. For a binary prefix of length D with partial sums S23 and S12,
;; every infinite extension has its two series values in the exact intervals
;;
;;   [S23, S23 + 3*(2/3)^D]  and  [S12, S12 + 2*(1/2)^D].
;;
;; At depth D, integers 0 through 2^D-1 encode all binary prefixes by their
;; low-order D bits. The generated loop terms below examine every such prefix,
;; with no fixed depth bound. For an integer ratio R, the compatible prefixes
;; form a finitely branching prefix-closed tree. An infinite path is exactly a
;; binary coefficient sequence whose two series values are 3/2 and R.
;; Conversely, if every level is nonempty, finite branching supplies such an
;; infinite path. Thus absence of a counterexample sequence is equivalent to
;; an empty finite level.
;;
;; FN-EQUAL ranges over every natural depth; its negation keeps the empty-level
;; depth witness internal. The only tame function objects below are generated
;; depth and finite-loop predicates, not representations or restrictions of
;; source sequences.

(defun putnam-2017-b3-quoted (object)
  (list 'quote object))

(defun putnam-2017-b3-list-term (terms)
  (if (consp terms)
      (list
       'cons
       (car terms)
       (putnam-2017-b3-list-term (cdr terms)))
    (putnam-2017-b3-quoted nil)))

(defun putnam-2017-b3-and-terms (terms)
  (if (consp terms)
      (list
       'if
       (car terms)
       (putnam-2017-b3-and-terms (cdr terms))
       (putnam-2017-b3-quoted nil))
    (putnam-2017-b3-quoted t)))

(defun putnam-2017-b3-add-term (left right)
  (list 'binary-+ left right))

(defun putnam-2017-b3-negate-term (value)
  (list 'unary-- value))

(defun putnam-2017-b3-subtract-term (left right)
  (putnam-2017-b3-add-term
   left
   (putnam-2017-b3-negate-term right)))

(defun putnam-2017-b3-multiply-term (left right)
  (list 'binary-* left right))

(defun putnam-2017-b3-less-equal-term (left right)
  (list
   'if
   (list '< right left)
   (putnam-2017-b3-quoted nil)
   (putnam-2017-b3-quoted t)))

(defun putnam-2017-b3-range-term (lower upper)
  (list
   'from-to-by
   lower
   upper
   (putnam-2017-b3-quoted 1)))

(defun putnam-2017-b3-singleton-function ()
  (list
   'lambda
   '(value)
   (list
    'cons
    'value
    (putnam-2017-b3-quoted nil))))

(defun putnam-2017-b3-singleton-range-term (lower upper)
  (list
   'collect$
   (putnam-2017-b3-quoted
    (putnam-2017-b3-singleton-function))
   (putnam-2017-b3-range-term lower upper)))

;; GLOBALS is (PREFIX-CODE BASE), and IVARS is (INDEX). The low-order bit
;; at INDEX is the corresponding coefficient.
(defun putnam-2017-b3-prefix-summand-function ()
  (let* ((code
          (list 'car 'globals))
         (base
          (list 'car (list 'cdr 'globals)))
         (index
          (list 'car 'ivars))
         (bit
          (list
           'mod
           (list
            'floor
            code
            (list
             'expt
             (putnam-2017-b3-quoted 2)
             index))
           (putnam-2017-b3-quoted 2))))
    (list
     'lambda
     '(globals ivars)
     (putnam-2017-b3-multiply-term
      bit
      (list 'expt base index)))))

(defun putnam-2017-b3-prefix-sum-term
    (code base depth)
  (list
   'if
   (list 'zp depth)
   (putnam-2017-b3-quoted 0)
   (list
    'sum$+
    (putnam-2017-b3-quoted
     (putnam-2017-b3-prefix-summand-function))
    (putnam-2017-b3-list-term
     (list code (putnam-2017-b3-quoted base)))
    (putnam-2017-b3-singleton-range-term
     (putnam-2017-b3-quoted 0)
     (putnam-2017-b3-subtract-term
      depth
      (putnam-2017-b3-quoted 1))))))

;; GLOBALS is (TARGET12 DEPTH), and IVARS is (CODE). CODE ranges over every
;; binary prefix at that depth. Both interval tests use exact rational
;; arithmetic.
(defun putnam-2017-b3-compatible-prefix-function ()
  (let* ((target12
          (list 'car 'globals))
         (depth
          (list 'car (list 'cdr 'globals)))
         (code
          (list 'car 'ivars))
         (sum23
          (putnam-2017-b3-prefix-sum-term
           code 2/3 depth))
         (sum12
          (putnam-2017-b3-prefix-sum-term
           code 1/2 depth))
         (tail23
          (putnam-2017-b3-multiply-term
           (putnam-2017-b3-quoted 3)
           (list
            'expt
            (putnam-2017-b3-quoted 2/3)
            depth)))
         (tail12
          (putnam-2017-b3-multiply-term
           (putnam-2017-b3-quoted 2)
           (list
            'expt
            (putnam-2017-b3-quoted 1/2)
            depth))))
    (list
     'lambda
     '(globals ivars)
     (putnam-2017-b3-and-terms
      (list
       (putnam-2017-b3-less-equal-term
        sum23
        (putnam-2017-b3-quoted 3/2))
       (putnam-2017-b3-less-equal-term
        (putnam-2017-b3-quoted 3/2)
        (putnam-2017-b3-add-term sum23 tail23))
       (putnam-2017-b3-less-equal-term
        sum12
        target12)
       (putnam-2017-b3-less-equal-term
        target12
        (putnam-2017-b3-add-term sum12 tail12)))))))

(defun putnam-2017-b3-nonempty-level-term
    (target12 depth)
  (let ((last-code
         (putnam-2017-b3-subtract-term
          (list
           'expt
           (putnam-2017-b3-quoted 2)
           depth)
          (putnam-2017-b3-quoted 1))))
    (list
     'thereis$+
     (putnam-2017-b3-quoted
      (putnam-2017-b3-compatible-prefix-function))
     (putnam-2017-b3-list-term
      (list
       (putnam-2017-b3-quoted target12)
       depth))
     (putnam-2017-b3-singleton-range-term
      (putnam-2017-b3-quoted 0)
      last-code))))

(defun putnam-2017-b3-nonempty-level-function (target12)
  (list
   'lambda
   '(depth)
   (list
    'if
    (list 'natp 'depth)
    (putnam-2017-b3-nonempty-level-term
     target12
     'depth)
    (putnam-2017-b3-quoted t))))

(defun putnam-2017-b3-true-depth-function ()
  '(lambda (depth) 't))

(defun putnam-2017-b3-empty-level-exists-p (target12)
  (let ((singleton
         (putnam-2017-b3-singleton-function))
        (prefix-summand
         (putnam-2017-b3-prefix-summand-function))
        (compatible-prefix
         (putnam-2017-b3-compatible-prefix-function))
        (nonempty-level
         (putnam-2017-b3-nonempty-level-function target12))
        (always-true
         (putnam-2017-b3-true-depth-function)))
    (and
     (rationalp target12)
     (tamep-functionp singleton)
     (tamep-functionp prefix-summand)
     (tamep-functionp compatible-prefix)
     (tamep-functionp nonempty-level)
     (tamep-functionp always-true)
     (not (fn-equal nonempty-level always-true)))))

;; NUMERATOR and DENOMINATOR are universally quantified by the ACL2
;; statement-corpus convention. The finite-tree equivalence above internalizes
;; both the arbitrary source coefficient sequence and the empty-level witness.
(defun putnambench-putnam-2017-b3-statement
    (numerator denominator)
  (implies
   (and
    (integerp numerator)
    (integerp denominator)
    (not (equal denominator 0)))
   (putnam-2017-b3-empty-level-exists-p
    (/ numerator denominator))))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

content:
-- Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2017_b3:
-- a real power series with coefficients zero or one that sums to 3/2 at 2/3
-- has an irrational sum at 1/2. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module Putnam2017B3 where

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Int using (Int; pos; negsuc)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; _*_)

infix 4 _!=_ _<=N_
infixr 3 _and_
infixr 2 _or_

data Bottom : Set where

Not : Set -> Set
Not A =
  A -> Bottom

_!=_ : {A : Set} -> A -> A -> Set
x != y =
  Not (x == y)

record _and_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data _or_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  left  : A -> A or B
  right : B -> A or B

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

data _<=N_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set where
  zero<=N   : {n : Nat} -> zero <=N n
  suc<=sucN : {m n : Nat} -> m <=N n -> suc m <=N suc n

oneN : Nat
oneN =
  suc zero

twoN : Nat
twoN =
  suc oneN

threeN : Nat
threeN =
  suc twoN

record CompleteOrderedRealField (R : Set) : Set1 where
  field
    zeroR oneR : R
    add multiply : R -> R -> R
    negate inverse : R -> R
    lessOrEqual : R -> R -> Set
    fromNat : Nat -> R

    one-not-zero :
      oneR != zeroR

    add-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> add x y == add y x
    add-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      add (add x y) z == add x (add y z)
    add-zero :
      (x : R) -> add x zeroR == x
    add-inverse :
      (x : R) -> add x (negate x) == zeroR

    multiply-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> multiply x y == multiply y x
    multiply-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply (multiply x y) z ==
      multiply x (multiply y z)
    multiply-one :
      (x : R) -> multiply x oneR == x
    multiply-zero :
      (x : R) -> multiply x zeroR == zeroR
    distribute :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply x (add y z) ==
      add (multiply x y) (multiply x z)
    inverse-zero :
      inverse zeroR == zeroR
    multiply-inverse :
      (x : R) ->
      x != zeroR ->
      multiply x (inverse x) == oneR

    order-reflexive :
      (x : R) -> lessOrEqual x x
    order-transitive :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y z ->
      lessOrEqual x z
    order-antisymmetric :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y x ->
      x == y
    order-total :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y or lessOrEqual y x
    add-order :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual (add z x) (add z y)
    multiply-nonnegative :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR x ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR y ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR (multiply x y)
    zero-less-than-one :
      lessOrEqual zeroR oneR and zeroR != oneR

    fromNat-zero :
      fromNat zero == zeroR
    fromNat-successor :
      (n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (suc n) == add (fromNat n) oneR
    fromNat-addition :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m + n) == add (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-multiplication :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m * n) == multiply (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-injective :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat m == fromNat n ->
      m == n

    archimedean :
      (x : R) ->
      Exists Nat
        (\ n ->
          lessOrEqual x (fromNat n))
    least-upper-bound :
      (P : R -> Set) ->
      Exists R P ->
      Exists R
        (\ upper ->
          (x : R) ->
          P x ->
          lessOrEqual x upper) ->
      Exists R
        (\ supremum ->
          ((x : R) ->
            P x ->
            lessOrEqual x supremum)
          and
          ((upper : R) ->
            ((x : R) ->
              P x ->
              lessOrEqual x upper) ->
            lessOrEqual supremum upper))

open CompleteOrderedRealField

fromInt :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Int ->
  R
fromInt reals (pos n) =
  fromNat reals n
fromInt reals (negsuc n) =
  negate reals (fromNat reals (suc n))

subtract :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
subtract reals x y =
  add reals x (negate reals y)

divide :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
divide reals x y =
  multiply reals x (inverse reals y)

naturalPower :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  Nat ->
  R
naturalPower reals x zero =
  oneR reals
naturalPower reals x (suc n) =
  multiply reals
    (naturalPower reals x n)
    x

StrictLess :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
StrictLess reals x y =
  lessOrEqual reals x y and x != y

CloseTo :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
CloseTo reals center radius x =
  StrictLess reals
    (subtract reals center radius)
    x
  and
  StrictLess reals
    x
    (add reals center radius)

sumFirst :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Nat ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  R
sumFirst reals zero term =
  zeroR reals
sumFirst reals (suc n) term =
  add reals
    (sumFirst reals n term)
    (term n)

ConvergesTo :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  R ->
  Set
ConvergesTo {R} reals sequence limit =
  (epsilon : R) ->
  StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) epsilon ->
  Exists Nat
    (\ cutoff ->
      (n : Nat) ->
      cutoff <=N n ->
      CloseTo reals limit epsilon (sequence n))

SeriesHasSum :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  R ->
  Set
SeriesHasSum reals terms limit =
  ConvergesTo reals
    (\ n -> sumFirst reals n terms)
    limit

PowerSeriesHasSum :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
PowerSeriesHasSum reals coefficients x limit =
  SeriesHasSum reals
    (\ n ->
      multiply reals
        (coefficients n)
        (naturalPower reals x n))
    limit

record Rational : Set where
  constructor fraction
  field
    numerator             : Int
    denominator-minus-one : Nat

open Rational

denominator : Rational -> Nat
denominator q =
  suc (denominator-minus-one q)

rationalValue :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Rational ->
  R
rationalValue reals q =
  divide reals
    (fromInt reals (numerator q))
    (fromNat reals (denominator q))

IsRational :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  Set
IsRational reals x =
  Exists Rational
    (\ q -> x == rationalValue reals q)

putnam-2017-b3 : Set1
putnam-2017-b3 =
  (R : Set) ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) ->
  (coefficients : Nat -> R) ->
  ((n : Nat) ->
    coefficients n == zeroR reals
    or
    coefficients n == oneR reals) ->
  PowerSeriesHasSum reals coefficients
    (divide reals
      (fromNat reals twoN)
      (fromNat reals threeN))
    (divide reals
      (fromNat reals threeN)
      (fromNat reals twoN)) ->
  Exists R
    (\ halfValue ->
      PowerSeriesHasSum reals coefficients
        (divide reals
          (oneR reals)
          (fromNat reals twoN))
        halfValue
      and
      Not (IsRational reals halfValue))

(*
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2017_b3:
  a real power series with coefficients in {0,1} that equals 3/2 at 2/3
  has an irrational value at 1/2. This file contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open arithmeticTheory pred_setTheory realTheory real_of_ratTheory seqTheory;

val putnam_2017_b3 =
  ``!c : num -> real.
      (!n : num. c n = 0 \/ c n = 1) /\
      suminf
        (\n : num. c n * ((2 : real) / 3) pow n) =
      3 / 2
      ==>
      suminf
        (\n : num. c n * ((1 : real) / 2) pow n)
      NOTIN q_set``;

content:
$(
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact
  putnam_2017_b3: irrationality at one half for a zero-one coefficient
  power series whose value at two thirds is three halves. This file contains
  no proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  RR ^m NN0 is SetMM's class of all real-valued sequences indexed by the
  nonnegative integers. The restricted universal quantifier retains the
  condition that every coefficient is zero or one.

  Each unbounded sum_ is SetMM's infinite-series sum. The antecedent states
  that the series at 2/3 converges to 3/2. Membership of the series at 1/2 in
  RR \ QQ states both that it converges to a real value and that this value
  is irrational. Eliminating the source function f by its defining
  power-series equality is a definitional reformulation.

  The final declaration is the single unproved $a corpus statement.
$)

${
  $d c n $.

  putnambench-putnam-2017-b3 $a |-
    A. c e. ( RR ^m NN0 )
      (
        (
          (
            A. n e. NN0
              (
                ( c ` n ) = 0
                \/
                ( c ` n ) = 1
              )
          )
          /\
          (
            sum_ n e. NN0
              (
                ( c ` n )
                x.
                ( ( 2 / 3 ) ^ n )
              )
          )
          =
          ( 3 / 2 )
        )
        ->
        (
          sum_ n e. NN0
            (
              ( c ` n )
              x.
              ( ( 1 / 2 ) ^ n )
            )
        )
        e.
        ( RR \ QQ )
      )
  $.
$}

environ

  notations TARSKI, XBOOLE_0, SUBSET_1, RELAT_1, FUNCT_1, RELSET_1,

  constructors FUNCT_1, RELSET_1, FUNCT_2, CARD_1, REAL_1, COMPLEX1,

::$P+

title: putnam_2017_b3
content:
% Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2017_b3:
% a real power series with coefficients in {0, 1} that equals 3/2 at 2/3
% has an irrational value at 1/2. This file contains no proof.

putnam_2017_b3: THEORY
BEGIN
  real_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> real]

  power_series_partial_sum(
      coefficients: real_sequence,
      x: real,
      count: nat): RECURSIVE real =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      power_series_partial_sum(coefficients, x, count - 1)
        + coefficients(count - 1) * x ^ (count - 1)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  power_series_sums_to(
      coefficients: real_sequence,
      x, total: real): bool =
    FORALL (epsilon_value: posreal):
      EXISTS (cutoff: nat):
        FORALL (count: nat):
          cutoff <= count IMPLIES
            abs(
              power_series_partial_sum(coefficients, x, count)
                - total) < epsilon_value

  binary_coefficients(coefficients: real_sequence): bool =
    FORALL (index: nat):
      coefficients(index) = 0 OR coefficients(index) = 1

  irrational(value: real): bool =
    NOT rational?(value)

  putnam_2017_b3: bool =
    FORALL (coefficients: real_sequence):
      (binary_coefficients(coefficients)
        AND power_series_sums_to(
          coefficients, (2 :: real) / 3, (3 :: real) / 2))
      IMPLIES
        EXISTS (value_at_half: real):
          power_series_sums_to(
            coefficients, (1 :: real) / 2, value_at_half)
            AND irrational(value_at_half)
END putnam_2017_b3

Definition putnam_2017_b4_solution := (ln 2) ^ 2.
Theorem putnam_2017_b4
    : is_lim_seq
        (fun n =>
          sum_n
            (fun k =>
              let k := INR k in
              3 * ln (4 * k + 2) / (4 * k + 2)
                - ln (4 * k + 3) / (4 * k + 3)
                - ln (4 * k + 4) / (4 * k + 4)
                - ln (4 * k + 5) / (4 * k + 5))
            n)
        putnam_2017_b4_solution .
Proof. Admitted.

content:
;; Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2017_b4:
;; the natural-logarithm series with coefficients 3,-1,-1,-1 in each block
;; of four consecutive denominators converges to (ln 2)^2. This file contains
;; no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))

;; For a positive integer M, LOG-PREFIX is the exact rational prefix of
;;
;;   ln M = 2 * sum_(j>=0) ((M-1)/(M+1))^(2j+1)/(2j+1).
;;
;; If DELTA is a positive rational, M*(M+1)*denominator(DELTA) terms give an
;; error below DELTA. Thus LOG-APPROX is a rational regular Cauchy name for
;; the natural logarithm without restricting the source real values to
;; rationals.

(defun putnam-2017-b4-log-prefix (m terms)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix terms)))
  (if (zp terms)
      0
    (let* ((index (- terms 1))
           (exponent (+ (* 2 index) 1))
           (ratio (/ (- m 1) (+ m 1))))
      (+ (putnam-2017-b4-log-prefix m index)
         (/ (* 2 (expt ratio exponent))
            exponent)))))

(defun putnam-2017-b4-log-terms (m delta)
  (if (and (natp m)
           (< 0 m)
           (rationalp delta)
           (< 0 delta))
      (* m
         (+ m 1)
         (denominator delta))
    0))

(defun putnam-2017-b4-log-approx (m delta)
  (if (and (natp m)
           (< 0 m)
           (rationalp delta)
           (< 0 delta))
      (putnam-2017-b4-log-prefix
       m
       (putnam-2017-b4-log-terms m delta))
    0))

(defun putnam-2017-b4-summand-approx (k delta)
  (let* ((four-k (* 4 k))
         (m2 (+ four-k 2))
         (m3 (+ four-k 3))
         (m4 (+ four-k 4))
         (m5 (+ four-k 5)))
    (-
     (-
      (-
       (/ (* 3 (putnam-2017-b4-log-approx m2 delta))
          m2)
       (/ (putnam-2017-b4-log-approx m3 delta)
          m3))
      (/ (putnam-2017-b4-log-approx m4 delta)
         m4))
     (/ (putnam-2017-b4-log-approx m5 delta)
        m5))))

(defun putnam-2017-b4-series-prefix-with-delta (terms delta)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix terms)))
  (if (zp terms)
      0
    (let ((index (- terms 1)))
      (+ (putnam-2017-b4-series-prefix-with-delta
          index delta)
         (putnam-2017-b4-summand-approx
          index delta)))))

;; TERMS is the number of summands, so this is the prefix k=0,...,TERMS-1.
;; Giving every logarithm precision/(16*(TERMS+1)) bounds the total error in
;; the represented real partial sum by a fixed fraction of PRECISION.
(defun putnam-2017-b4-series-approx (terms precision)
  (if (and (natp terms)
           (rationalp precision)
           (< 0 precision))
      (putnam-2017-b4-series-prefix-with-delta
       terms
       (/ precision (* 16 (+ terms 1))))
    0))

(defun putnam-2017-b4-solution-approx (precision)
  (if (and (rationalp precision)
           (< 0 precision))
      (let ((log-two
             (putnam-2017-b4-log-approx
              2
              (/ precision 8))))
        (* log-two log-two))
    0))

;; The remaining predicates express directly
;;
;;   for every positive rational epsilon, every prefix beyond a natural
;;   cutoff is epsilon-close to (ln 2)^2.
;;
;; Positive rational tolerances are cofinal in the positive real tolerances.
;; The controlled errors of the two Cauchy names are fixed fractions of
;; PRECISION. Consequently the following epsilon criterion is equivalent in
;; both directions to convergence of the represented real partial sums. The
;; natural cutoff is existentially quantified inside the statement, and the
;; tail index is universally quantified by DEFUN-SK.

(defun putnam-2017-b4-absolute-value (value)
  (if (< value 0)
      (- value)
    value))

(defun-sk putnam-2017-b4-eventually-close-p (epsilon cutoff)
  (forall (terms)
    (implies
     (and
      (natp terms)
      (<= cutoff terms))
     (let* ((precision (/ epsilon 8))
            (series-value
             (putnam-2017-b4-series-approx terms precision))
            (solution-value
             (putnam-2017-b4-solution-approx precision)))
       (<
        (putnam-2017-b4-absolute-value
         (- series-value solution-value))
        epsilon)))))

(defun-sk putnam-2017-b4-cutoff-exists-p (epsilon)
  (exists (cutoff)
    (and
     (natp cutoff)
     (putnam-2017-b4-eventually-close-p
      epsilon cutoff))))

(defun-sk putnambench-putnam-2017-b4-statement ()
  (forall (epsilon)
    (implies
     (and (rationalp epsilon)
          (< 0 epsilon))
     (putnam-2017-b4-cutoff-exists-p epsilon))))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

-- Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2017_b4
-- (putnambench__agda__putnam_2017_b4): the specified infinite real series
-- involving natural logarithms sums to the square of ln 2. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module Putnam2017B4 where

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; _*_)

infix 4 _!=_ _<=N_
infixr 3 _and_
infixr 2 _or_

data Bottom : Set where

Not : Set -> Set
Not A =
  A -> Bottom

_!=_ : {A : Set} -> A -> A -> Set
x != y =
  Not (x == y)

record _and_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data _or_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  left  : A -> A or B
  right : B -> A or B

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

data _<=N_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set where
  zero<=N   : {n : Nat} -> zero <=N n
  suc<=sucN : {m n : Nat} -> m <=N n -> suc m <=N suc n

oneN : Nat
oneN =
  suc zero

twoN : Nat
twoN =
  suc oneN

threeN : Nat
threeN =
  suc twoN

fourN : Nat
fourN =
  suc threeN

fiveN : Nat
fiveN =
  suc fourN

record CompleteOrderedRealField (R : Set) : Set1 where
  field
    zeroR oneR : R
    add multiply : R -> R -> R
    negate inverse : R -> R
    lessOrEqual : R -> R -> Set
    fromNat : Nat -> R

    one-not-zero :
      oneR != zeroR

    add-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> add x y == add y x
    add-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      add (add x y) z == add x (add y z)
    add-zero :
      (x : R) -> add x zeroR == x
    add-inverse :
      (x : R) -> add x (negate x) == zeroR

    multiply-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> multiply x y == multiply y x
    multiply-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply (multiply x y) z ==
      multiply x (multiply y z)
    multiply-one :
      (x : R) -> multiply x oneR == x
    multiply-zero :
      (x : R) -> multiply x zeroR == zeroR
    distribute :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply x (add y z) ==
      add (multiply x y) (multiply x z)
    inverse-zero :
      inverse zeroR == zeroR
    multiply-inverse :
      (x : R) ->
      x != zeroR ->
      multiply x (inverse x) == oneR

    order-reflexive :
      (x : R) -> lessOrEqual x x
    order-transitive :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y z ->
      lessOrEqual x z
    order-antisymmetric :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y x ->
      x == y
    order-total :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y or lessOrEqual y x
    add-order :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual (add z x) (add z y)
    multiply-nonnegative :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR x ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR y ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR (multiply x y)
    zero-less-than-one :
      lessOrEqual zeroR oneR and zeroR != oneR

    fromNat-zero :
      fromNat zero == zeroR
    fromNat-successor :
      (n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (suc n) == add (fromNat n) oneR
    fromNat-addition :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m + n) == add (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-multiplication :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m * n) == multiply (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-injective :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat m == fromNat n ->
      m == n

    archimedean :
      (x : R) ->
      Exists Nat
        (\ n ->
          lessOrEqual x (fromNat n))
    least-upper-bound :
      (P : R -> Set) ->
      Exists R P ->
      Exists R
        (\ upper ->
          (x : R) ->
          P x ->
          lessOrEqual x upper) ->
      Exists R
        (\ supremum ->
          ((x : R) ->
            P x ->
            lessOrEqual x supremum)
          and
          ((upper : R) ->
            ((x : R) ->
              P x ->
              lessOrEqual x upper) ->
            lessOrEqual supremum upper))

open CompleteOrderedRealField

subtract :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
subtract reals x y =
  add reals x (negate reals y)

divide :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
divide reals x y =
  multiply reals x (inverse reals y)

square :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R
square reals x =
  multiply reals x x

StrictLess :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
StrictLess reals x y =
  lessOrEqual reals x y and x != y

CloseTo :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
CloseTo reals center radius x =
  StrictLess reals
    (subtract reals center radius)
    x
  and
  StrictLess reals
    x
    (add reals center radius)

sumFirst :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Nat ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  R
sumFirst reals zero terms =
  zeroR reals
sumFirst reals (suc n) terms =
  add reals
    (sumFirst reals n terms)
    (terms n)

ConvergesTo :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  R ->
  Set
ConvergesTo {R} reals sequence limit =
  (epsilon : R) ->
  StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) epsilon ->
  Exists Nat
    (\ cutoff ->
      (n : Nat) ->
      cutoff <=N n ->
      CloseTo reals limit epsilon (sequence n))

SeriesHasSum :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  R ->
  Set
SeriesHasSum reals terms limit =
  ConvergesTo reals
    (\ n -> sumFirst reals n terms)
    limit

midpointRiemannSum :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  (R -> R) ->
  Nat ->
  R
midpointRiemannSum reals lower upper function pieces =
  let
    step =
      divide reals
        (subtract reals upper lower)
        (fromNat reals pieces)
    halfStep =
      divide reals step (fromNat reals twoN)
  in
  sumFirst reals pieces
    (\ i ->
      multiply reals
        (function
          (add reals lower
            (add reals
              (multiply reals
                (fromNat reals i)
                step)
              halfStep)))
        step)

NaturalLogValue :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
NaturalLogValue reals x value =
  ConvergesTo reals
    (\ n ->
      midpointRiemannSum reals
        (oneR reals)
        x
        (inverse reals)
        (suc n))
    value

record NaturalLogAnalysis (R : Set) : Set1 where
  field
    reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R
    naturalLog : R -> R
    natural-log-definition :
      (x : R) ->
      StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) x ->
      NaturalLogValue reals x (naturalLog x)

open NaturalLogAnalysis

indexValue :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Nat ->
  Nat ->
  R
indexValue reals offset k =
  fromNat reals (fourN * k + offset)

putnamTerm :
  {R : Set} ->
  (analysis : NaturalLogAnalysis R) ->
  Nat ->
  R
putnamTerm analysis k =
  let
    realField = reals analysis
    log = naturalLog analysis
    a = indexValue realField twoN k
    b = indexValue realField threeN k
    c = indexValue realField fourN k
    d = indexValue realField fiveN k
  in
  subtract realField
    (subtract realField
      (subtract realField
        (multiply realField
          (fromNat realField threeN)
          (divide realField (log a) a))
        (divide realField (log b) b))
      (divide realField (log c) c))
    (divide realField (log d) d)

putnam-2017-b4 : Set1
putnam-2017-b4 =
  (R : Set) ->
  (analysis : NaturalLogAnalysis R) ->
  SeriesHasSum
    (reals analysis)
    (putnamTerm analysis)
    (square
      (reals analysis)
      (naturalLog analysis
        (fromNat (reals analysis) twoN)))

$(
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact
  putnam_2017_b4: evaluation of a real infinite series involving natural
  logarithms at four consecutive linear arguments. This file contains no
  proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  SetMM's NN0 is the class of nonnegative integers, so the sum_ binder
  preserves the source index k >= 0. Each logarithm is evaluated at a
  positive integer, where SetMM's log agrees with the real natural logarithm,
  and the unbounded sum is SetMM's convergent infinite-series sum.

  The denominator of the third term is 4k + 4, as in the published problem
  and the Lean and Rocq statements; the Isabelle source's 4k - 4 is an
  evident transcription error. The right side is the published value
  (log 2)^2 recorded by the Lean and Isabelle solution annotations. The Rocq
  definition instead squares log(2) / log(10), which conflicts with its own
  use of the natural logarithm in the series.

  The declaration is the single unproved $a corpus statement; this database
  contains no $p proof statement.
$)

putnambench-putnam-2017-b4 $a |-
    (
      sum_ k e. NN0
        (
          (
            (
              3
              x.
              ( log ` ( ( 4 x. k ) + 2 ) )
            )
            /
            ( ( 4 x. k ) + 2 )
          )
          -
          (
            ( log ` ( ( 4 x. k ) + 3 ) )
            /
            ( ( 4 x. k ) + 3 )
          )
          -
          (
            ( log ` ( ( 4 x. k ) + 4 ) )
            /
            ( ( 4 x. k ) + 4 )
          )
          -
          (
            ( log ` ( ( 4 x. k ) + 5 ) )
            /
            ( ( 4 x. k ) + 5 )
          )
        )
    )
    =
    ( ( log ` 2 ) ^ 2 )
  $.

title: putnam_2017_b4
content:
% Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2017_b4:
% the logarithmic series with four terms in each index block converges to the
% square of the natural logarithm of 2. This file contains no proof.

putnam_2017_b4: THEORY
BEGIN
  real_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> real]

  safe_div(numerator, denominator: real): real =
    IF denominator = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      numerator / denominator
    ENDIF

  converges_to(sequence: real_sequence, value: real): bool =
    FORALL (epsilon_value: posreal):
      EXISTS (cutoff: nat):
        FORALL (index: nat):
          cutoff <= index IMPLIES
            abs(sequence(index) - value) < epsilon_value

  nat_factorial(index: nat): RECURSIVE nat =
    IF index = 0 THEN
      1
    ELSE
      index * nat_factorial(index - 1)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE index

  exponential_partial(x: real, count: nat): RECURSIVE real =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      LET index: nat = count - 1 IN
        exponential_partial(x, count - 1)
          + safe_div(
              x ^ index,
              nat_factorial(index) :: real)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  real_exponential(x: real): real =
    epsilon(
      LAMBDA (value: real):
        converges_to(
          LAMBDA (count: nat):
            exponential_partial(x, count),
          value))

  natural_log(x: real): real =
    IF x > 0 THEN
      epsilon(
        LAMBDA (value: real):
          real_exponential(value) = x)
    ELSE
      0
    ENDIF

  series_term(index: nat): real =
    LET k: real = index :: real IN
      3 * safe_div(
            natural_log(4 * k + 2),
            4 * k + 2)
        - safe_div(
            natural_log(4 * k + 3),
            4 * k + 3)
        - safe_div(
            natural_log(4 * k + 4),
            4 * k + 4)
        - safe_div(
            natural_log(4 * k + 5),
            4 * k + 5)

  partial_sum(count: nat): RECURSIVE real =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      partial_sum(count - 1) + series_term(count - 1)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  putnam_2017_b4_solution: real =
    natural_log(2) ^ 2

  putnam_2017_b4: bool =
    converges_to(partial_sum, putnam_2017_b4_solution)
END putnam_2017_b4

import Mathlib

open Topology Filter Real Function Nat

abbrev putnam_2017_b6_solution : ℕ := sorry
-- 2016! / 1953! - 63! * 2016
/--
Find the number of ordered $64$-tuples $(x_0,x_1,\dots,x_{63})$ such that $x_0,x_1,\dots,x_{63}$ are distinct elements of $\{1,2,\dots,2017\}$ and
\[
x_0 + x_1 + 2x_2 + 3x_3 + \cdots + 63 x_{63}
\]
is divisible by 2017.
-/
theorem putnam_2017_b6
  (S : Finset (Finset.range 64 → Finset.Icc 1 2017))
  (hs : ∀ x, x ∈ S ↔ (Injective x ∧ (2017 ∣ (∑ i : Finset.range 64, if i ≤ (⟨1, by norm_num⟩ : Finset.range 64) then (x i : ℤ) else i * (x i : ℤ))))) :
  S.card = putnam_2017_b6_solution :=
sorry

Require Import Ensembles Finite_sets Factorial List. From mathcomp Require Import div.
Definition putnam_2017_b6_solution := Nat.div (fact 2016) (fact 1953) - fact 63 * 2016.
Theorem putnam_2017_b6
    (Hweighted_sum := fix weighted_sum (l: list nat) (i: nat) : nat :=
        match l with
        | nil => 0
        | x :: xs => (if Nat.ltb i 2 then x else i * x) + weighted_sum xs (i + 1)
    end)
    (h : list nat -> Prop := fun l => 2017 %| Hweighted_sum l 0 = true)
    (A: Ensemble (list nat) := fun l =>
      length l = 64 /\
      NoDup l /\
      (forall n : nat, In n l -> 1 <= n <= 2017) /\
      h l)
    : cardinal (list nat) A putnam_2017_b6_solution.
Proof. Admitted.

-- (putnambench__agda__putnam_2017_b6): the number of ordered 64-tuples of
-- distinct integers from 1 through 2017 whose stated weighted sum is divisible

module Main where

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using
  (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; _-_; _*_; div-helper)

infix 4 _<=N_ _divides_
infixr 3 _and_

record _and_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

data _<=N_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set where
  zero<=N   : {n : Nat} -> zero <=N n
  suc<=sucN : {m n : Nat} -> m <=N n -> suc m <=N suc n

data Fin : Nat -> Set where
  fzero : {n : Nat} -> Fin (suc n)
  fsuc  : {n : Nat} -> Fin n -> Fin (suc n)

toNat : {n : Nat} -> Fin n -> Nat
toNat fzero =
  zero
toNat (fsuc index) =
  suc (toNat index)

record _divides_ (divisor dividend : Nat) : Set where
  field
    quotient : Nat
    equation : divisor * quotient == dividend

factorial : Nat -> Nat
factorial zero =
  suc zero
factorial (suc n) =
  suc n * factorial n

naturalDiv : Nat -> Nat -> Nat
naturalDiv numerator zero =
  numerator
naturalDiv numerator (suc denominator) =
  div-helper zero denominator numerator denominator

putnam-2017-b6-solution : Nat
putnam-2017-b6-solution =
  naturalDiv (factorial 2016) (factorial 1953) -
  factorial 63 * 2016

Tuple64 : Set
Tuple64 =
  Fin 64 -> Nat

TupleEqual : Tuple64 -> Tuple64 -> Set
TupleEqual left right =
  (index : Fin 64) ->
  left index == right index

InjectiveTuple : Tuple64 -> Set
InjectiveTuple tuple =
  (left-index right-index : Fin 64) ->
  tuple left-index == tuple right-index ->
  left-index == right-index

InRange : Tuple64 -> Set
InRange tuple =
  (index : Fin 64) ->
  suc zero <=N tuple index
  and
  tuple index <=N 2017

weightedTerm : Tuple64 -> Fin 64 -> Nat
weightedTerm tuple fzero =
  tuple fzero
weightedTerm tuple (fsuc fzero) =
  tuple (fsuc fzero)
weightedTerm tuple (fsuc (fsuc index)) =
  suc (suc (toNat index)) * tuple (fsuc (fsuc index))

sumFin :
  (n : Nat) ->
  (Fin n -> Nat) ->
  Nat
sumFin zero term =
  zero
sumFin (suc n) term =
  term fzero +
  sumFin n (\ index -> term (fsuc index))

WeightedSum : Tuple64 -> Nat
WeightedSum tuple =
  sumFin 64 (weightedTerm tuple)

ValidTuple : Tuple64 -> Set
ValidTuple tuple =
  InRange tuple
  and
  InjectiveTuple tuple
  and
  (2017 divides WeightedSum tuple)

record HasExtensionalCardinality
  {A : Set}
  (_~_ : A -> A -> Set)
  (member : A -> Set)
  (cardinality : Nat) :
  Set where

  field
    enumerate :
      Fin cardinality ->
      A
    enumerated-member :
      (index : Fin cardinality) ->
      member (enumerate index)
    enumeration-complete :
      (item : A) ->
      member item ->
      Exists (Fin cardinality)
        (\ index -> item ~ enumerate index)
    enumeration-injective :
      (left-index right-index : Fin cardinality) ->
      enumerate left-index ~ enumerate right-index ->
      left-index == right-index

putnam-2017-b6 =
  HasExtensionalCardinality
    TupleEqual
    ValidTuple
    putnam-2017-b6-solution

title: putnam_2017_b6
content:
% Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2017_b6:
% the ordered 64-tuples of distinct integers from 1 through 2017 whose stated
% weighted sum is divisible by 2017 have the specified factorial count. This
% file contains no proof.

putnam_2017_b6: THEORY
BEGIN
  tuple_index: TYPE = below(64)
  tuple_entry: TYPE = {value: nat | 1 <= value AND value <= 2017}
  ordered_tuple: TYPE = [tuple_index -> tuple_entry]

  IMPORTING finite_sets[ordered_tuple]

  nat_factorial(n: nat): RECURSIVE nat =
    IF n = 0 THEN
      1
    ELSE
      n * nat_factorial(n - 1)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE n

  weighted_term(
      values: ordered_tuple,
      index: tuple_index): nat =
    IF index <= 1 THEN
      values(index)
    ELSE
      (index :: nat) * (values(index) :: nat)
    ENDIF

  weighted_sum(
      values: ordered_tuple,
      count: upto(64)): RECURSIVE nat =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      weighted_sum(values, count - 1)
        + weighted_term(values, count - 1)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  pairwise_distinct(values: ordered_tuple): bool =
    FORALL (left, right: tuple_index):
      values(left) = values(right) IMPLIES left = right

  nat_divides(divisor, value: nat): bool =
    EXISTS (quotient: nat):
      value = divisor * quotient

  qualifying(values: ordered_tuple): bool =
    pairwise_distinct(values)
      AND nat_divides(2017, weighted_sum(values, 64))

  nat_quotient(numerator, denominator: nat): nat =
    IF denominator = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      ndiv(numerator, denominator)
    ENDIF

  nat_subtract(minuend, subtrahend: nat): nat =
    IF subtrahend <= minuend THEN
      minuend - subtrahend
    ELSE
      0
    ENDIF

  putnam_2017_b6_solution: nat =
    nat_subtract(
      nat_quotient(
        nat_factorial(2016),
        nat_factorial(1953)),
      nat_factorial(63) * 2016)

  putnam_2017_b6: bool =
    EXISTS (solutions: finite_set[ordered_tuple]):
      card(solutions) = putnam_2017_b6_solution
        AND (FORALL (values: ordered_tuple):
          solutions(values) IFF qualifying(values))
END putnam_2017_b6

(* Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2018_a2:
   the determinant of the intersection-incidence matrix indexed by all
   nonempty subsets of a finite interval. This file contains no proof. *)

From Stdlib Require Import Lists.List Arith.PeanoNat Vectors.Fin Reals
  Ensembles ClassicalDescription.

Import ListNotations.
Open Scope R_scope.

Definition putnam_2018_a2_dimension (n : nat) : nat :=
  (Nat.pow 2 n - 1)%nat.

Definition putnam_2018_a2_matrix (n : nat) : Type :=
  Fin.t (putnam_2018_a2_dimension n) ->
  Fin.t (putnam_2018_a2_dimension n) ->
  R.

Definition putnam_2018_a2_interval (n : nat) : Ensemble nat :=
  fun x : nat => (1 <= x <= n)%nat.

Definition putnam_2018_a2_nonempty_subset
    (n : nat) (A : Ensemble nat) : Prop :=
  (exists x : nat, In nat A x) /\
  Included nat A (putnam_2018_a2_interval n).

Definition putnam_2018_a2_intersects
    (A B : Ensemble nat) : Prop :=
  exists x : nat, In nat A x /\ In nat B x.

Definition putnam_2018_a2_entry
    (A B : Ensemble nat) : R :=
  if excluded_middle_informative (putnam_2018_a2_intersects A B)
  then 1
  else 0.

Fixpoint putnam_2018_a2_fin_list
    (n : nat) : list (Fin.t n) :=
  match n as k return list (Fin.t k) with
  | O => []
  | S k =>
      Fin.F1 :: map Fin.FS (putnam_2018_a2_fin_list k)
  end.

Definition putnam_2018_a2_rows
    {T : Type} (n : nat) (A : Fin.t n -> Fin.t n -> T) :
    list (list T) :=
  map
    (fun i =>
      map (fun j => A i j) (putnam_2018_a2_fin_list n))
    (putnam_2018_a2_fin_list n).

Fixpoint putnam_2018_a2_sum (xs : list R) : R :=
  match xs with
  | [] => 0
  | x :: rest => x + putnam_2018_a2_sum rest
  end.

Definition putnam_2018_a2_delete_nth
    {T : Type} (j : nat) (xs : list T) : list T :=
  firstn j xs ++ skipn (S j) xs.

Definition putnam_2018_a2_cofactor_sign (j : nat) : R :=
  if Nat.even j then 1 else -1.

Fixpoint putnam_2018_a2_list_det
    (n : nat) (M : list (list R)) {struct n} : R :=
  match n with
  | O => 1
  | S k =>
      match M with
      | [] => 0
      | row :: rows =>
          putnam_2018_a2_sum
            (map
              (fun j : nat =>
                putnam_2018_a2_cofactor_sign j *
                nth j row 0 *
                putnam_2018_a2_list_det k
                  (map (putnam_2018_a2_delete_nth j) rows))
              (seq 0 (S k)))
      end
  end.

Definition putnam_2018_a2_determinant
    (n : nat) (A : Fin.t n -> Fin.t n -> R) : R :=
  putnam_2018_a2_list_det n (putnam_2018_a2_rows n A).

Definition putnam_2018_a2_solution (n : nat) : R :=
  if Nat.eqb n 1 then 1 else -1.

Theorem putnam_2018_a2
    (n : nat)
    (S :
      Fin.t (putnam_2018_a2_dimension n) ->
      Ensemble nat)
    (M : putnam_2018_a2_matrix n)
    (npos : (1 <= n)%nat)
    (hS :
      forall A : Ensemble nat,
        (exists i : Fin.t (putnam_2018_a2_dimension n),
            Same_set nat (S i) A) <->
        putnam_2018_a2_nonempty_subset n A)
    (hM :
      forall i j : Fin.t (putnam_2018_a2_dimension n),
        M i j = putnam_2018_a2_entry (S i) (S j)) :
  putnam_2018_a2_determinant
    (putnam_2018_a2_dimension n) M =
  putnam_2018_a2_solution n.
Admitted.
