;; the intersection matrix of all nonempty subsets of {1,...,n} has
;; determinant 1 when n=1 and -1 otherwise. This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

;; The carrier and each of its subsets use the canonical increasing list
;; representation. Thus a family list is exactly a function on the finite
;; index type in the sources, while membership in the generated powerset is
;; extensional set membership. The source range condition and the prescribed
;; index count make the family an ordering of all nonempty subsets.

(defun putnam-2018-a2-range-from (start count)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix count)))
  (if (zp count)
      nil
    (cons start
          (putnam-2018-a2-range-from
           (+ start 1) (- count 1)))))

(defun putnam-2018-a2-adjoin-to-each (element sets)
  (if (endp sets)
      nil
    (cons (cons element (car sets))
          (putnam-2018-a2-adjoin-to-each
           element (cdr sets)))))

(defun putnam-2018-a2-powerset (carrier)
  (if (endp carrier)
      (list nil)
    (let ((tail-powerset
           (putnam-2018-a2-powerset (cdr carrier))))
      (append
       tail-powerset
       (putnam-2018-a2-adjoin-to-each
        (car carrier) tail-powerset)))))

(defun putnam-2018-a2-delete-empty (sets)
  (if (endp sets)
      nil
    (if (endp (car sets))
        (putnam-2018-a2-delete-empty (cdr sets))
      (cons (car sets)
            (putnam-2018-a2-delete-empty (cdr sets))))))

(defun putnam-2018-a2-subsets-from-powerset-p
    (subsets powerset)
  (if (endp subsets)
      t
    (and
     (member-equal (car subsets) powerset)
     (putnam-2018-a2-subsets-from-powerset-p
      (cdr subsets) powerset))))

(defun putnam-2018-a2-powerset-covered-p
    (powerset subsets)
  (if (endp powerset)
      t
    (and
     (member-equal (car powerset) subsets)
     (putnam-2018-a2-powerset-covered-p
      (cdr powerset) subsets))))

(defun putnam-2018-a2-intersect-p (left right)
  (if (endp left)
      nil
    (or
     (member-equal (car left) right)
     (putnam-2018-a2-intersect-p (cdr left) right))))

(defun putnam-2018-a2-matrix-row-p
    (row left-set subsets)
  (if (endp subsets)
      (equal row nil)
    (and
     (consp row)
     (equal
      (car row)
      (if (putnam-2018-a2-intersect-p
           left-set (car subsets))
          1
        0))
     (putnam-2018-a2-matrix-row-p
      (cdr row) left-set (cdr subsets)))))

(defun putnam-2018-a2-matrix-p
    (matrix row-subsets all-subsets)
  (if (endp row-subsets)
      (equal matrix nil)
    (and
     (consp matrix)
     (putnam-2018-a2-matrix-row-p
      (car matrix) (car row-subsets) all-subsets)
     (putnam-2018-a2-matrix-p
      (cdr matrix) (cdr row-subsets) all-subsets))))

;; The determinant is the exact signed Leibniz sum over all column
;; permutations.

(defun putnam-2018-a2-prefix-each (item lists)
  (if (endp lists)
      nil
    (cons (cons item (car lists))
          (putnam-2018-a2-prefix-each item (cdr lists)))))

      (car list)
      (putnam-2018-a2-insert-everywhere
       item (cdr list))))))

(defun putnam-2018-a2-insert-into-each (item lists)
  (if (endp lists)
      nil
    (append
     (putnam-2018-a2-insert-everywhere item (car lists))

     (car list)

(defun putnam-2018-a2-count-greater (item list)
  (if (endp list)
      0
    (+ (if (> item (car list)) 1 0)
       (putnam-2018-a2-count-greater item (cdr list)))))

(defun putnam-2018-a2-inversion-count (permutation)
  (if (endp permutation)

    (+ (putnam-2018-a2-count-greater
        (car permutation) (cdr permutation))

        (cdr permutation)))))

    (* (nth (car permutation) (nth row matrix))

          (putnam-2018-a2-diagonal-product
           matrix (car permutations) 0))

(defun putnam-2018-a2-determinant (matrix dimension)
  (putnam-2018-a2-determinant-sum
   matrix
   (putnam-2018-a2-permutations
    (putnam-2018-a2-range-from 0 dimension))))

(defun putnam-2018-a2-solution (n)

(defun putnambench-putnam-2018-a2-statement

         (carrier (putnam-2018-a2-range-from 1 n))
         (nonempty-powerset
          (putnam-2018-a2-delete-empty

-- Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2018_a2
-- (putnambench__agda__putnam_2018_a2): the determinant of the intersection
-- matrix of all nonempty subsets of an n-element set. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module Putnam2018A2 where

open import Agda.Builtin.Bool using (Bool; false; true)
open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; _-_; _*_)

infix 4 _!=_
infixr 3 _and_
infixr 2 _or_

data Bottom : Set where

Not : Set -> Set
Not A =
  A -> Bottom

_!=_ : {A : Set} -> A -> A -> Set
x != y =
  Not (x == y)

record _and_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data _or_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  left  : A -> A or B
  right : B -> A or B

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

record CompleteOrderedRealField (R : Set) : Set1 where
  field
    zeroR oneR : R
    add multiply : R -> R -> R
    negate inverse : R -> R
    lessOrEqual : R -> R -> Set
    fromNat : Nat -> R

    one-not-zero :
      oneR != zeroR

    add-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> add x y == add y x
    add-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      add (add x y) z == add x (add y z)
    add-zero :
      (x : R) -> add x zeroR == x
    add-inverse :
      (x : R) -> add x (negate x) == zeroR

    multiply-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> multiply x y == multiply y x
    multiply-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply (multiply x y) z ==
      multiply x (multiply y z)
    multiply-one :
      (x : R) -> multiply x oneR == x
    multiply-zero :
      (x : R) -> multiply x zeroR == zeroR
    distribute :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply x (add y z) ==
      add (multiply x y) (multiply x z)
    inverse-zero :
      inverse zeroR == zeroR
    multiply-inverse :
      (x : R) ->
      x != zeroR ->
      multiply x (inverse x) == oneR

    order-reflexive :
      (x : R) -> lessOrEqual x x
    order-transitive :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y z ->
      lessOrEqual x z
    order-antisymmetric :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y x ->
      x == y
    order-total :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y or lessOrEqual y x
    add-order :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual (add z x) (add z y)
    multiply-nonnegative :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR x ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR y ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR (multiply x y)
    zero-less-than-one :
      lessOrEqual zeroR oneR and zeroR != oneR

    fromNat-zero :
      fromNat zero == zeroR
    fromNat-successor :
      (n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (suc n) == add (fromNat n) oneR
    fromNat-addition :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m + n) == add (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-multiplication :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m * n) == multiply (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-injective :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat m == fromNat n ->
      m == n

    archimedean :
      (x : R) ->
      Exists Nat
        (\ n -> lessOrEqual x (fromNat n))
    least-upper-bound :
      (P : R -> Set) ->
      Exists R P ->
      Exists R
        (\ upper ->
          (x : R) ->
          P x ->
          lessOrEqual x upper) ->
      Exists R
        (\ supremum ->
          ((x : R) ->
            P x ->
            lessOrEqual x supremum)
          and
          ((upper : R) ->
            ((x : R) ->
              P x ->
              lessOrEqual x upper) ->
            lessOrEqual supremum upper))

open CompleteOrderedRealField

data Positive : Nat -> Set where
  positive : {n : Nat} -> Positive (suc n)

data Fin : Nat -> Set where
  fzero : {n : Nat} -> Fin (suc n)
  fsuc  : {n : Nat} -> Fin n -> Fin (suc n)

one : Nat
one =
  suc zero

two : Nat
two =
  suc one

naturalPowerNat : Nat -> Nat -> Nat
naturalPowerNat base zero =
  one
naturalPowerNat base (suc exponent) =
  naturalPowerNat base exponent * base

matrixSize : Nat -> Nat
matrixSize n =
  naturalPowerNat two n - one

boolAnd : Bool -> Bool -> Bool
boolAnd false other =
  false
boolAnd true other =
  other

boolOr : Bool -> Bool -> Bool
boolOr false other =
  other
boolOr true other =
  true

Subset : Nat -> Set
Subset n =
  Fin n -> Bool

SubsetEqual :
  {n : Nat} ->
  Subset n ->
  Subset n ->
  Set
SubsetEqual {n} firstSubset secondSubset =
  (i : Fin n) ->
  firstSubset i == secondSubset i

Nonempty :
  {n : Nat} ->
  Subset n ->
  Set
Nonempty {n} subset =
  Exists (Fin n)
    (\ i -> subset i == true)

intersects :
  {n : Nat} ->
  Subset n ->
  Subset n ->
  Bool
intersects {zero} firstSubset secondSubset =
  false
intersects {suc n} firstSubset secondSubset =
  boolOr
    (boolAnd (firstSubset fzero) (secondSubset fzero))
    (intersects
      (\ i -> firstSubset (fsuc i))
      (\ i -> secondSubset (fsuc i)))

record EnumeratesNonemptySubsets
  {n cardinality : Nat}
  (subsets : Fin cardinality -> Subset n) :
  Set where

  field
    enumeration-sound :
      (i : Fin cardinality) ->
      Nonempty (subsets i)

    enumeration-complete :
      (subset : Subset n) ->
      Nonempty subset ->
      Exists (Fin cardinality)
        (\ i -> SubsetEqual subset (subsets i))

    enumeration-injective :
      (i j : Fin cardinality) ->
      SubsetEqual (subsets i) (subsets j) ->
      i == j

Matrix : Set -> Nat -> Set
Matrix R n =
  Fin n -> Fin n -> R

sumFin :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  {n : Nat} ->
  (Fin n -> R) ->
  R
sumFin reals {zero} term =
  zeroR reals
sumFin reals {suc n} term =
  add reals
    (term fzero)
    (sumFin reals (\ i -> term (fsuc i)))

skip :
  {n : Nat} ->
  Fin (suc n) ->
  Fin n ->
  Fin (suc n)
skip {zero} removed ()
skip {suc n} fzero i =
  fsuc i
skip {suc n} (fsuc removed) fzero =
  fzero
skip {suc n} (fsuc removed) (fsuc i) =
  fsuc (skip removed i)

firstRowMinor :
  {R : Set} {n : Nat} ->
  Matrix R (suc n) ->
  Fin (suc n) ->
  Matrix R n
firstRowMinor matrix removedColumn i j =
  matrix (fsuc i) (skip removedColumn j)

alternatingSign :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  {n : Nat} ->
  Fin n ->
  R
alternatingSign reals fzero =
  oneR reals
alternatingSign reals (fsuc i) =
  negate reals (alternatingSign reals i)

determinant :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  {n : Nat} ->
  Matrix R n ->
  R
determinant reals {zero} matrix =
  oneR reals
determinant reals {suc n} matrix =
  sumFin reals
    (\ column ->
      multiply reals
        (alternatingSign reals column)
        (multiply reals
          (matrix fzero column)
          (determinant reals (firstRowMinor matrix column))))

entryValue :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Bool ->
  R
entryValue reals false =
  zeroR reals
entryValue reals true =
  oneR reals

MatrixHasIntersectionEntries :
  {R : Set} ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) ->
  {n : Nat} ->
  (subsets : Fin (matrixSize n) -> Subset n) ->
  Matrix R (matrixSize n) ->
  Set
MatrixHasIntersectionEntries reals {n = n} subsets matrix =
  (i j : Fin (matrixSize n)) ->
  matrix i j ==
  entryValue reals (intersects (subsets i) (subsets j))

solution :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Nat ->
  R
solution reals zero =
  negate reals (oneR reals)
solution reals (suc zero) =
  oneR reals
solution reals (suc (suc n)) =
  negate reals (oneR reals)

putnam-2018-a2 : Set1
putnam-2018-a2 =
  (R : Set) ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) ->
  (n : Nat) ->
  Positive n ->
  (subsets : Fin (matrixSize n) -> Subset n) ->
  EnumeratesNonemptySubsets subsets ->
  (matrix : Matrix R (matrixSize n)) ->
  MatrixHasIntersectionEntries reals subsets matrix ->
  determinant reals matrix == solution reals n

(*

  the determinant of the intersection-incidence matrix of all nonempty
  subsets of {1, ..., n} is 1 for n = 1 and -1 otherwise. This file contains
  no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open arithmeticTheory pred_setTheory permutesTheory realTheory;

val putnam_2018_a2 =
  ``let determinant =
      \m : num. \A : num -> num -> real.
        ITSET
          (\p : num -> num. \sum : real.
             (if evenperm p then
                ITSET
                  (\i : num. \acc : real. A i (p i) * acc)
                  (count m)
                  1
              else
                -(ITSET
                    (\i : num. \acc : real. A i (p i) * acc)
                    (count m)
                    1)) +
             sum)
          {p : num -> num | p permutes count m}
          0
    in
      !n : num. !S : num -> num set. !M : num -> num -> real.
        1 <= n /\
        IMAGE S (count (2 EXP n - 1)) =
          (POW (IMAGE SUC (count n))) DELETE EMPTY /\
        (!i j : num.
           i < 2 EXP n - 1 /\ j < 2 EXP n - 1
           ==>
           M i j = if DISJOINT (S i) (S j) then 0 else 1)
        ==>
        determinant (2 EXP n - 1) M =
          if n = 1 then 1 else -1``;

$(

  putnam_2018_a2: the determinant of the intersection-incidence matrix of
  all nonempty subsets of {1,...,n}. This file contains no proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  For positive n, 0 ..^ (2^n-1) is an index carrier corresponding to
  Fin (2^n-1), and 1 ... n is the source set {1,...,n}. The map S ranges
  over arbitrary subsets of the natural numbers before the range hypothesis
  requires its values to enumerate exactly the nonempty subsets of 1 ... n.

  Base ` ((0 ..^ (2^n-1)) Mat RRfld) is the full real square-matrix space
  on that carrier. The entry hypothesis is exactly zero for disjoint indexed
  subsets and one otherwise, while maDet is the real determinant. The
  source solution is inlined as 1 when n = 1 and -1 otherwise.

  The final declaration is the single unproved $a corpus statement; this
  database contains no $p proof declaration.
$)

  $d M S i j n $.

    A. S e.

title: putnam_2018_a2
content:
% Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2018_a2:
% the determinant of the intersection-incidence matrix indexed by all
% nonempty subsets of {1,...,n} is 1 for n = 1 and -1 otherwise. This file
% contains no proof.

putnam_2018_a2: THEORY
BEGIN
  IMPORTING finite_sets[nat]

  natural_set: TYPE = finite_set[nat]
  subset_enumeration(dimension: posnat): TYPE =
    [below(dimension) -> natural_set]
  matrix(dimension: posnat): TYPE =
    [below(dimension), below(dimension) -> real]
  unbounded_matrix: TYPE = [nat, nat -> real]

  quotient_aux(
      numerator, denominator, fuel: nat): RECURSIVE nat =
    IF fuel = 0
        OR denominator = 0
        OR numerator < denominator THEN
      0
    ELSE
      1
        + quotient_aux(
            numerator - denominator,
            denominator,
            fuel - 1)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE fuel

  remainder_aux(
      numerator, denominator, fuel: nat): RECURSIVE nat =
    IF fuel = 0
        OR denominator = 0
        OR numerator < denominator THEN
      numerator
    ELSE
      remainder_aux(
        numerator - denominator,
        denominator,
        fuel - 1)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE fuel

  safe_ndiv(numerator, denominator: nat): nat =
    quotient_aux(
      numerator,
      denominator,
      numerator + 1)

  safe_mod(numerator, denominator: nat): nat =
    IF denominator = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      remainder_aux(
        numerator,
        denominator,
        numerator + 1)
    ENDIF

  function_code_count(size: nat): nat =
    IF size = 0 THEN 1 ELSE size ^ size ENDIF

  permutation_entry(code, row, size: nat): nat =
    IF size = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      safe_mod(safe_ndiv(code, size ^ row), size)
    ENDIF

  permutation_code(code, size: nat): bool =
    code < function_code_count(size)
      AND (FORALL (row_1, row_2: nat):
        (row_1 < size
          AND row_2 < size
          AND permutation_entry(code, row_1, size)
            = permutation_entry(code, row_2, size))
        IMPLIES row_1 = row_2)

  pair_row(pair, size: nat): nat =
    safe_ndiv(pair, size)

  pair_column(pair, size: nat): nat =
    safe_mod(pair, size)

  inversion_at(code, pair, size: nat): bool =
    pair_row(pair, size) < size
      AND pair_column(pair, size) < size
      AND pair_row(pair, size) < pair_column(pair, size)
      AND permutation_entry(code, pair_row(pair, size), size)
        > permutation_entry(code, pair_column(pair, size), size)

  count_true(
      property: [nat -> bool],
      count: nat): RECURSIVE nat =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      count_true(property, count - 1)
        + IF property(count - 1) THEN 1 ELSE 0 ENDIF
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  inversion_count(code, size: nat): nat =
    count_true(
      (LAMBDA (pair: nat): inversion_at(code, pair, size)),
      size * size)

  permutation_sign(code, size: nat): real =
    IF mod(inversion_count(code, size), 2) = 0 THEN
      1
    ELSE
      -1
    ENDIF

  permutation_product(
      A: unbounded_matrix,
      code, size, count: nat): RECURSIVE real =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      1
    ELSE
      permutation_product(A, code, size, count - 1)
        * A(
            count - 1,
            permutation_entry(code, count - 1, size))
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  determinant_sum(
      A: unbounded_matrix,
      size, limit: nat): RECURSIVE real =
    IF limit = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      LET code: nat = limit - 1 IN
        determinant_sum(A, size, limit - 1)
          + IF permutation_code(code, size) THEN
              permutation_sign(code, size)
                * permutation_product(A, code, size, size)
            ELSE
              0
            ENDIF
    ENDIF
  MEASURE limit

  determinant(A: unbounded_matrix, size: nat): real =
    determinant_sum(A, size, function_code_count(size))

  extend_matrix(
      dimension: posnat)(
      M: matrix(dimension)): unbounded_matrix =
    LAMBDA (row, column: nat):
      IF row < dimension AND column < dimension THEN
        M(row, column)
      ELSE
        0
      ENDIF

  initial_segment_subset(S: natural_set, n: posnat): bool =
    FORALL (value: nat):
      S(value) IMPLIES 1 <= value AND value <= n

  enumerates_nonempty_subsets(
      dimension: posnat,
      S: subset_enumeration(dimension),
      n: posnat): bool =
    FORALL (T: natural_set):
      (EXISTS (index: below(dimension)): S(index) = T)
        IFF
          (NOT empty?(T) AND initial_segment_subset(T, n))

  has_intersection_entries(
      dimension: posnat,
      S: subset_enumeration(dimension),
      M: matrix(dimension)): bool =
    FORALL (row, column: below(dimension)):
      M(row, column) =
        IF empty?(intersection(S(row), S(column))) THEN
          0
        ELSE
          1
        ENDIF

  putnam_2018_a2_solution(n: posnat): real =
    IF n = 1 THEN 1 ELSE -1 ENDIF

  putnam_2018_a2: bool =
    FORALL
        (n, dimension: posnat),
        (S: subset_enumeration(dimension)),
        (M: matrix(dimension)):
      (dimension = 2 ^ n - 1
        AND enumerates_nonempty_subsets(dimension, S, n)
        AND has_intersection_entries(dimension, S, M))
      IMPLIES
        determinant(extend_matrix(dimension)(M), dimension)
          = putnam_2018_a2_solution(n)
END putnam_2018_a2

content:
;; Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2018_a3:
;; the greatest possible value of the sum of cos(3*x_i) for ten real x_i
;; whose cosines sum to zero is 480/49. This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

;; Put c_i = cos(x_i). Every c_i in [-1,1] is the cosine of a real x_i, and
;; cos(3*x_i) = 4*c_i^3 - 3*c_i. Thus the source optimization is exactly the
;; polynomial optimization below on
;;
;;   {c in [-1,1]^10 : sum_i c_i = 0}.
;;
;; Standard ACL2 has exact rational arithmetic rather than a primitive real
;; sort. Rational points are dense in this rational polytope. Since the
;; objective is continuous, a strict real violation of the proposed upper
;; bound would have a rational violation, while every rational violation is
;; already a real violation. Hence the universal rational inequality is
;; bidirectionally equivalent to the universal real inequality. The existential
;; rational attainment clause is equivalent to real attainment here because
;; the maximum is attained at the rational tuple with three entries equal to 1
;; and seven entries equal to -3/7.

(defun putnam-2018-a3-triple-cosine (c)
  (- (* 4 c c c)
     (* 3 c)))

(defun putnam-2018-a3-feasible-p
    (c0 c1 c2 c3 c4 c5 c6 c7 c8 c9)
  (and
   (rationalp c0)
   (rationalp c1)
   (rationalp c2)
   (rationalp c3)
   (rationalp c4)
   (rationalp c5)
   (rationalp c6)
   (rationalp c7)
   (rationalp c8)
   (rationalp c9)
   (<= -1 c0) (<= c0 1)
   (<= -1 c1) (<= c1 1)
   (<= -1 c2) (<= c2 1)
   (<= -1 c3) (<= c3 1)
   (<= -1 c4) (<= c4 1)
   (<= -1 c5) (<= c5 1)
   (<= -1 c6) (<= c6 1)
   (<= -1 c7) (<= c7 1)
   (<= -1 c8) (<= c8 1)
   (<= -1 c9) (<= c9 1)
   (equal (+ c0 c1 c2 c3 c4 c5 c6 c7 c8 c9)
          0)))

(defun putnam-2018-a3-objective
    (c0 c1 c2 c3 c4 c5 c6 c7 c8 c9)
  (+ (putnam-2018-a3-triple-cosine c0)
     (putnam-2018-a3-triple-cosine c1)
     (putnam-2018-a3-triple-cosine c2)
     (putnam-2018-a3-triple-cosine c3)
     (putnam-2018-a3-triple-cosine c4)
     (putnam-2018-a3-triple-cosine c5)
     (putnam-2018-a3-triple-cosine c6)
     (putnam-2018-a3-triple-cosine c7)
     (putnam-2018-a3-triple-cosine c8)
     (putnam-2018-a3-triple-cosine c9)))

(defun-sk putnam-2018-a3-maximum-attained-p ()
  (exists (c0 c1 c2 c3 c4 c5 c6 c7 c8 c9)
    (and
     (putnam-2018-a3-feasible-p
      c0 c1 c2 c3 c4 c5 c6 c7 c8 c9)
     (equal
      (putnam-2018-a3-objective
       c0 c1 c2 c3 c4 c5 c6 c7 c8 c9)
      (/ 480 49)))))

(defun-sk putnam-2018-a3-upper-bound-p ()
  (forall (c0 c1 c2 c3 c4 c5 c6 c7 c8 c9)
    (implies
     (putnam-2018-a3-feasible-p
      c0 c1 c2 c3 c4 c5 c6 c7 c8 c9)
     (<=
      (putnam-2018-a3-objective
       c0 c1 c2 c3 c4 c5 c6 c7 c8 c9)
      (/ 480 49)))))

(defun putnambench-putnam-2018-a3-statement ()
  (and
   (putnam-2018-a3-maximum-attained-p)
   (putnam-2018-a3-upper-bound-p)))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

title: putnam_2018_a3
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2018_a3
-- (putnambench__agda__putnam_2018_a3): the greatest possible sum of
-- cosines of three times ten real angles, when their cosine sum is zero, is
-- 480/49 and is attained. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module Putnam2018A3 where

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; _*_)

infix 4 _!=_ _<=N_
infixr 3 _and_
infixr 2 _or_

data Bottom : Set where

Not : Set -> Set
Not A =
  A -> Bottom

_!=_ : {A : Set} -> A -> A -> Set
x != y =
  Not (x == y)

record _and_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data _or_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  left  : A -> A or B
  right : B -> A or B

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

data _<=N_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set where
  zero<=N   : {n : Nat} -> zero <=N n
  suc<=sucN : {m n : Nat} -> m <=N n -> suc m <=N suc n

data Fin : Nat -> Set where
  fzero : {n : Nat} -> Fin (suc n)
  fsuc  : {n : Nat} -> Fin n -> Fin (suc n)

oneN : Nat
oneN =
  suc zero

twoN : Nat
twoN =
  suc oneN

threeN : Nat
threeN =
  suc twoN

tenN : Nat
tenN =
  10

record CompleteOrderedRealField (R : Set) : Set1 where
  field
    zeroR oneR : R
    add multiply : R -> R -> R
    negate inverse : R -> R
    lessOrEqual : R -> R -> Set
    fromNat : Nat -> R

    one-not-zero :
      oneR != zeroR

    add-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> add x y == add y x
    add-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      add (add x y) z == add x (add y z)
    add-zero :
      (x : R) -> add x zeroR == x
    add-inverse :
      (x : R) -> add x (negate x) == zeroR

    multiply-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> multiply x y == multiply y x
    multiply-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply (multiply x y) z ==
      multiply x (multiply y z)
    multiply-one :
      (x : R) -> multiply x oneR == x
    multiply-zero :
      (x : R) -> multiply x zeroR == zeroR
    distribute :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply x (add y z) ==
      add (multiply x y) (multiply x z)
    inverse-zero :
      inverse zeroR == zeroR
    multiply-inverse :
      (x : R) ->
      x != zeroR ->
      multiply x (inverse x) == oneR

    order-reflexive :
      (x : R) -> lessOrEqual x x
    order-transitive :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y z ->
      lessOrEqual x z
    order-antisymmetric :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y x ->
      x == y
    order-total :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y or lessOrEqual y x
    add-order :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual (add z x) (add z y)
    multiply-nonnegative :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR x ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR y ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR (multiply x y)
    zero-less-than-one :
      lessOrEqual zeroR oneR and zeroR != oneR

    fromNat-zero :
      fromNat zero == zeroR
    fromNat-successor :
      (n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (suc n) == add (fromNat n) oneR
    fromNat-addition :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m + n) == add (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-multiplication :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m * n) == multiply (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-injective :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat m == fromNat n ->
      m == n

    archimedean :
      (x : R) ->
      Exists Nat (\ n -> lessOrEqual x (fromNat n))
    least-upper-bound :
      (P : R -> Set) ->
      Exists R P ->
      Exists R
        (\ upper ->
          (x : R) ->
          P x ->
          lessOrEqual x upper) ->
      Exists R
        (\ supremum ->
          ((x : R) ->
            P x ->
            lessOrEqual x supremum)
          and
          ((upper : R) ->
            ((x : R) ->
              P x ->
              lessOrEqual x upper) ->
            lessOrEqual supremum upper))

open CompleteOrderedRealField

divide :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
divide reals x y =
  multiply reals x (inverse reals y)

StrictLess :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
StrictLess reals x y =
  lessOrEqual reals x y and x != y

subtract :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
subtract reals x y =
  add reals x (negate reals y)

CloseTo :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
CloseTo reals center radius x =
  StrictLess reals
    (subtract reals center radius)
    x
  and
  StrictLess reals
    x
    (add reals center radius)

naturalPower :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  Nat ->
  R
naturalPower reals x zero =
  oneR reals
naturalPower reals x (suc n) =
  multiply reals
    (naturalPower reals x n)
    x

factorial : Nat -> Nat
factorial zero =
  oneN
factorial (suc n) =
  suc n * factorial n

sumFirst :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Nat ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  R
sumFirst reals zero term =
  zeroR reals
sumFirst reals (suc n) term =
  add reals
    (sumFirst reals n term)
    (term n)

ConvergesTo :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  R ->
  Set
ConvergesTo {R} reals sequence limit =
  (epsilon : R) ->
  StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) epsilon ->
  Exists Nat
    (\ cutoff ->
      (n : Nat) ->
      cutoff <=N n ->
      CloseTo reals limit epsilon (sequence n))

SeriesHasSum :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  R ->
  Set
SeriesHasSum reals terms limit =
  ConvergesTo reals
    (\ n -> sumFirst reals n terms)
    limit

alternatingPower :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Nat ->
  R
alternatingPower reals n =
  naturalPower reals
    (negate reals (oneR reals))
    n

cosineTerm :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  Nat ->
  R
cosineTerm reals x n =
  divide reals
    (multiply reals
      (alternatingPower reals n)
      (naturalPower reals x (twoN * n)))
    (fromNat reals (factorial (twoN * n)))

record StandardCosine
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) : Set1 where
  field
    cosine : R -> R
    cosine-series :
      (x : R) ->
      SeriesHasSum reals
        (cosineTerm reals x)
        (cosine x)

open StandardCosine

sumFin :
  {R : Set} ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) ->
  {n : Nat} ->
  (Fin n -> R) ->
  R
sumFin reals {zero} terms =
  zeroR reals
sumFin reals {suc n} terms =
  add reals
    (terms fzero)
    (sumFin reals (\ i -> terms (fsuc i)))

cosineSum :
  {R : Set} ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) ->
  StandardCosine reals ->
  Nat ->
  (Fin tenN -> R) ->
  R
cosineSum reals trigonometry multiplier x =
  sumFin reals
    (\ i ->
      cosine trigonometry
        (multiply reals
          (fromNat reals multiplier)
          (x i)))

record IsGreatestTripleCosineSum
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R)
  (trigonometry : StandardCosine reals)
  (greatest : R) : Set where

  field
    attained :
      Exists (Fin tenN -> R)
        (\ x ->
          cosineSum reals trigonometry oneN x == zeroR reals
          and
          cosineSum reals trigonometry threeN x == greatest)

    upper-bound :
      (x : Fin tenN -> R) ->
      cosineSum reals trigonometry oneN x == zeroR reals ->
      lessOrEqual reals
        (cosineSum reals trigonometry threeN x)
        greatest

putnam-2018-a3-solution :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R
putnam-2018-a3-solution reals =
  divide reals
    (fromNat reals 480)
    (fromNat reals 49)

putnam-2018-a3 : Set1
putnam-2018-a3 =
  (R : Set) ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) ->
  (trigonometry : StandardCosine reals) ->
  IsGreatestTripleCosineSum
    reals
    trigonometry
    (putnam-2018-a3-solution reals)

  the greatest possible sum of cosines of three times ten real angles,
  subject to the sum of their cosines being zero, is 480/49. This file
  contains no proof.

open pred_setTheory realTheory real_sigmaTheory transcTheory;

val putnam_2018_a3 =

    in

      \x : num -> real.

title: putnam_2018_a3

% Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2018_a3:
% the greatest possible sum of cos(3*x_i) over ten real numbers whose
% cosines sum to zero is 480/49. This file contains no proof.

putnam_2018_a3: THEORY
BEGIN
  real_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> real]

  safe_div(numerator, denominator: real): real =
    IF denominator = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      numerator / denominator
    ENDIF

  nat_factorial(index: nat): RECURSIVE nat =
    IF index = 0 THEN
      1
    ELSE
      index * nat_factorial(index - 1)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE index

  cosine_partial(argument: real, count: nat): RECURSIVE real =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      LET index: nat = count - 1 IN
        cosine_partial(argument, count - 1)
          + safe_div(
              ((-1 :: real) ^ index) * argument ^ (2 * index),
              nat_factorial(2 * index) :: real)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  converges_to(sequence: real_sequence, value: real): bool =
    FORALL (epsilon_value: posreal):
      EXISTS (cutoff: nat):
        FORALL (index: nat):
          cutoff <= index IMPLIES
            abs(sequence(index) - value) < epsilon_value

  cosine(argument: real): real =
    epsilon(
      LAMBDA (value: real):
        converges_to(
          LAMBDA (count: nat):
            cosine_partial(argument, count),
          value))

  finite_sum(values: real_sequence, count: nat): RECURSIVE real =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      finite_sum(values, count - 1) + values(count - 1)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  cosine_sum(x: real_sequence, multiplier: real): real =
    finite_sum(
      LAMBDA (index: nat):
        cosine(multiplier * x(index)),
      10)

  admissible(x: real_sequence): bool =
    cosine_sum(x, 1) = 0

  putnam_2018_a3_solution: real =
    480 / 49

  putnam_2018_a3: bool =
    (EXISTS (x: real_sequence):
      admissible(x)
        AND cosine_sum(x, 3) = putnam_2018_a3_solution)
      AND (FORALL (x: real_sequence):
        admissible(x)
          IMPLIES
            cosine_sum(x, 3) <= putnam_2018_a3_solution)
END putnam_2018_a3

(* Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2018_a4:
   a coprime floor-difference word in two elements of an arbitrary group
   implies that the two elements commute. This file contains no proof. *)

From Stdlib Require Import Reals ZArith Arith.PeanoNat.

Open Scope R_scope.

Record putnam_2018_a4_group (G : Type) : Type := {
  putnam_2018_a4_mul : G -> G -> G;
  putnam_2018_a4_one : G;
  putnam_2018_a4_inv : G -> G;
  putnam_2018_a4_assoc :
    forall x y z : G,
      putnam_2018_a4_mul x (putnam_2018_a4_mul y z) =
      putnam_2018_a4_mul (putnam_2018_a4_mul x y) z;
  putnam_2018_a4_left_identity :
    forall x : G, putnam_2018_a4_mul putnam_2018_a4_one x = x;
  putnam_2018_a4_right_identity :
    forall x : G, putnam_2018_a4_mul x putnam_2018_a4_one = x;
  putnam_2018_a4_left_inverse :
    forall x : G,
      putnam_2018_a4_mul (putnam_2018_a4_inv x) x =
      putnam_2018_a4_one;
  putnam_2018_a4_right_inverse :
    forall x : G,
      putnam_2018_a4_mul x (putnam_2018_a4_inv x) =
      putnam_2018_a4_one
}.

Arguments putnam_2018_a4_mul {G} _ _ _.
Arguments putnam_2018_a4_one {G} _.
Arguments putnam_2018_a4_inv {G} _ _.

Fixpoint putnam_2018_a4_nat_pow
    {G : Type}
    (grp : putnam_2018_a4_group G)
    (x : G)
    (n : nat) : G :=
  match n with
  | O => putnam_2018_a4_one grp
  | S k =>
      putnam_2018_a4_mul grp x
        (putnam_2018_a4_nat_pow grp x k)
  end.

Definition putnam_2018_a4_zpow
    {G : Type}
    (grp : putnam_2018_a4_group G)
    (x : G)
    (n : Z) : G :=
  match n with
  | Z0 => putnam_2018_a4_one grp
  | Zpos p =>
      putnam_2018_a4_nat_pow grp x (Pos.to_nat p)
  | Zneg p =>
      putnam_2018_a4_inv grp
        (putnam_2018_a4_nat_pow grp x (Pos.to_nat p))
  end.

Fixpoint putnam_2018_a4_product_from
    {G : Type}
    (grp : putnam_2018_a4_group G)
    (term : nat -> G)
    (start count : nat) : G :=
  match count with
  | O => putnam_2018_a4_one grp
  | S remaining =>
      putnam_2018_a4_mul grp
        (term start)
        (putnam_2018_a4_product_from
          grp term (S start) remaining)
  end.

Theorem putnam_2018_a4
    (m n : nat)
    (a : nat -> Z)
    (G : Type)
    (grp : putnam_2018_a4_group G)
    (g h : G)
    (mnpos : (0 < m)%nat /\ (0 < n)%nat)
    (mngcd : Nat.gcd m n = 1%nat)
    (ha :
      forall k : nat,
        (1 <= k <= n)%nat ->
        a k =
          (Zfloor ((INR m * INR k / INR n)%R) -
           Zfloor ((INR m * INR (Nat.pred k) / INR n)%R))%Z)
    (ghprod :
      putnam_2018_a4_product_from
        grp
        (fun k : nat =>
          putnam_2018_a4_mul grp g
            (putnam_2018_a4_zpow grp h (a k)))
        1%nat n =
      putnam_2018_a4_one grp) :
  putnam_2018_a4_mul grp g h =
  putnam_2018_a4_mul grp h g.
Admitted.

(*
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2018_a4
  (putnambench__hol-light__putnam_2018_a4): floor-difference exponents in an
  ordered product in an arbitrary group force the two group elements to
  commute. This file contains no proof.
*)

needs "Library/floor.ml";;

let statement =
  `let is_group =
     \(mul:G->G->G) (identity:G) (ginv:G->G).
       (!x y z:G. mul (mul x y) z = mul x (mul y z)) /\
       (!x:G. mul identity x = x /\ mul x identity = x) /\
       (!x:G.
          mul (ginv x) x = identity /\ mul x (ginv x) = identity) in
   let is_power =
     \(mul:G->G->G) (identity:G) (x:G) (n:num) (y:G).
       ?powers:num->G.
         powers 0 = identity /\
         (!k:num. powers (SUC k) = mul (powers k) x) /\
         powers n = y in
   !m n:num.
   !a:num->num.
   !mul:G->G->G identity:G ginv:G->G g h:G.
     0 < m /\
     0 < n /\
     coprime(m,n) /\
     (!k:num.
        1 <= k /\ k <= n
        ==> &(a k) =
            floor ((&m * &k) / &n) -
            floor ((&m * &(k - 1)) / &n)) /\
     is_group mul identity ginv /\
     (?hpowers products:num->G.
        products 0 = identity /\
        (!k:num.
           k < n
           ==> is_power mul identity h (a (SUC k)) (hpowers (SUC k)) /\
               products (SUC k) =
               mul (products k) (mul g (hpowers (SUC k)))) /\
        products n = identity)
     ==> mul g h = mul h g`;;

title: putnam_2018_a4
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2018_a4:
;; a coprime floor-difference word in two elements of an arbitrary group,
;; when equal to the identity, forces the two elements to commute. This file
;; contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

;; CARRIER, OP, and INV are ACL2 function objects. The generated predicate
;; lambdas return T outside CARRIER, so FN-EQUAL with a constant-T lambda
;; expresses each group law universally on the represented type.

(defun putnam-2018-a4-quoted (object)
  (list 'quote object))

(defun putnam-2018-a4-apply1-term (function argument)
  (list 'apply$
        (putnam-2018-a4-quoted function)
        (list 'cons argument nil)))

(defun putnam-2018-a4-apply2-term (function left right)
  (list 'apply$
        (putnam-2018-a4-quoted function)
        (list 'cons left
              (list 'cons right nil))))

(defun putnam-2018-a4-carrier-term (carrier element)
  (putnam-2018-a4-apply1-term carrier element))

(defun putnam-2018-a4-operation-term (op left right)
  (putnam-2018-a4-apply2-term op left right))

(defun putnam-2018-a4-inverse-term (inv element)
  (putnam-2018-a4-apply1-term inv element))

(defun putnam-2018-a4-all-in-carrier-term
    (carrier variables)
  (if (endp variables)
      (putnam-2018-a4-quoted t)
    (list 'if
          (putnam-2018-a4-carrier-term
           carrier (car variables))
          (putnam-2018-a4-all-in-carrier-term
           carrier (cdr variables))
          (putnam-2018-a4-quoted nil))))

(defun putnam-2018-a4-restricted-predicate-term
    (carrier variables proposition)
  (list 'if
        (putnam-2018-a4-all-in-carrier-term
         carrier variables)
        proposition
        (putnam-2018-a4-quoted t)))

(defun putnam-2018-a4-and-term (left right)
  (list 'if left right (putnam-2018-a4-quoted nil)))

(defun putnam-2018-a4-true-function (formals)
  (list 'lambda formals (putnam-2018-a4-quoted t)))

(defun putnam-2018-a4-operation-closure-function (carrier op)
  (let ((op-xy
         (putnam-2018-a4-operation-term op 'x 'y)))
    (list
     'lambda
     '(x y)
     (putnam-2018-a4-restricted-predicate-term
      carrier
      '(x y)
      (putnam-2018-a4-carrier-term carrier op-xy)))))

(defun putnam-2018-a4-inverse-closure-function (carrier inv)
  (list
   'lambda
   '(x)
   (putnam-2018-a4-restricted-predicate-term
    carrier
    '(x)
    (putnam-2018-a4-carrier-term
     carrier
     (putnam-2018-a4-inverse-term inv 'x)))))

(defun putnam-2018-a4-associative-function (carrier op)
  (let* ((op-xy
          (putnam-2018-a4-operation-term op 'x 'y))
         (op-yz
          (putnam-2018-a4-operation-term op 'y 'z)))
    (list
     'lambda
     '(x y z)
     (putnam-2018-a4-restricted-predicate-term
      carrier
      '(x y z)
      (list
       'equal
       (putnam-2018-a4-operation-term op op-xy 'z)
       (putnam-2018-a4-operation-term op 'x op-yz))))))

(defun putnam-2018-a4-identity-function (carrier op one)
  (let ((left
         (list
          'equal
          (putnam-2018-a4-operation-term
           op (putnam-2018-a4-quoted one) 'x)
          'x))
        (right
         (list
          'equal
          (putnam-2018-a4-operation-term
           op 'x (putnam-2018-a4-quoted one))
          'x)))
    (list
     'lambda
     '(x)
     (putnam-2018-a4-restricted-predicate-term
      carrier
      '(x)
      (putnam-2018-a4-and-term left right)))))

(defun putnam-2018-a4-inverse-law-function
    (carrier op inv one)
  (let* ((inv-x
          (putnam-2018-a4-inverse-term inv 'x))
         (left
          (list
           'equal
           (putnam-2018-a4-operation-term op inv-x 'x)
           (putnam-2018-a4-quoted one)))
         (right
          (list
           'equal
           (putnam-2018-a4-operation-term op 'x inv-x)
           (putnam-2018-a4-quoted one))))
    (list
     'lambda
     '(x)
     (putnam-2018-a4-restricted-predicate-term
      carrier
      '(x)
      (putnam-2018-a4-and-term left right)))))

(defun putnam-2018-a4-member-p (carrier element)
  (apply$ carrier (list element)))

(defun putnam-2018-a4-multiply (op left right)
  (apply$ op (list left right)))

(defun putnam-2018-a4-group-p (carrier op inv one)
  (and
   (tamep-functionp carrier)
   (tamep-functionp op)
   (tamep-functionp inv)
   (putnam-2018-a4-member-p carrier one)
   (fn-equal
    (putnam-2018-a4-operation-closure-function carrier op)
    (putnam-2018-a4-true-function '(x y)))
   (fn-equal
    (putnam-2018-a4-inverse-closure-function carrier inv)
    (putnam-2018-a4-true-function '(x)))
   (fn-equal
    (putnam-2018-a4-associative-function carrier op)
    (putnam-2018-a4-true-function '(x y z)))
   (fn-equal
    (putnam-2018-a4-identity-function carrier op one)
    (putnam-2018-a4-true-function '(x)))
   (fn-equal
    (putnam-2018-a4-inverse-law-function carrier op inv one)
    (putnam-2018-a4-true-function '(x)))))

;; For positive M and N, the real floor difference in the source is exactly
;; this integer quotient difference and is always a natural number.
(defun putnam-2018-a4-exponent (m n k)
  (- (floor (* m k) n)
     (floor (* m (- k 1)) n)))

(defun putnam-2018-a4-power (op base exponent one)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix exponent)))
  (if (zp exponent)
      one
    (putnam-2018-a4-multiply
     op
     (putnam-2018-a4-power
      op base (- exponent 1) one)
     base)))

;; This is the source recursion P_0=1 and
;; P_k=((P_(k-1)*g)*h^(a_k)) for k=1,...,n.
(defun putnam-2018-a4-product-prefix
    (op one g h m n k)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix k)))
  (if (zp k)
      one
    (putnam-2018-a4-multiply
     op
     (putnam-2018-a4-multiply
      op
      (putnam-2018-a4-product-prefix
       op one g h m n (- k 1))
      g)
     (putnam-2018-a4-power
      op h
      (putnam-2018-a4-exponent m n k)
      one))))

;; Searching all possible common divisors from M down to 2 is equivalent to
;; gcd(M,N)=1 when M and N are positive.
(defun putnam-2018-a4-coprime-through-p
    (m n divisor)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix divisor)))
  (if (and (natp divisor)
           (< 1 divisor))
      (and
       (not
        (and
         (equal (mod m divisor) 0)
         (equal (mod n divisor) 0)))
       (putnam-2018-a4-coprime-through-p
        m n (- divisor 1)))
    t))

(defun putnam-2018-a4-coprime-p (m n)
  (and
   (posp m)
   (posp n)
   (putnam-2018-a4-coprime-through-p m n m)))

(defun putnambench-putnam-2018-a4-statement
    (m n carrier op inv one g h)
  (implies
   (and
    (putnam-2018-a4-coprime-p m n)
    (putnam-2018-a4-group-p carrier op inv one)
    (putnam-2018-a4-member-p carrier g)
    (putnam-2018-a4-member-p carrier h)
    (equal
     (putnam-2018-a4-product-prefix
      op one g h m n n)
     one))
   (equal
    (putnam-2018-a4-multiply op g h)
    (putnam-2018-a4-multiply op h g))))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

title: putnam_2018_a4
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2018_a4
-- (putnambench__agda__putnam_2018_a4): floor-difference exponents from
-- positive coprime integers force two group elements to commute when their
-- ordered alternating product is the identity. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module Putnam2018A4 where

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using
  (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; _-_; _*_; div-helper; mod-helper)
open import Agda.Primitive using (Level; lsuc)

infix 4 _<=N_

data Positive : Nat -> Set where
  positive : {n : Nat} -> Positive (suc n)

data _<=N_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set where
  zero<=N   : {n : Nat} -> zero <=N n
  suc<=sucN : {m n : Nat} -> m <=N n -> suc m <=N suc n

one : Nat
one =
  suc zero

naturalDiv : Nat -> Nat -> Nat
naturalDiv numerator zero =
  zero
naturalDiv numerator (suc denominator) =
  div-helper zero denominator numerator denominator

naturalMod : Nat -> Nat -> Nat
naturalMod numerator zero =
  zero
naturalMod numerator (suc denominator) =
  mod-helper zero denominator numerator denominator

gcdWithFuel : Nat -> Nat -> Nat -> Nat
gcdWithFuel zero a b =
  a
gcdWithFuel (suc fuel) a zero =
  a
gcdWithFuel (suc fuel) a (suc b) =
  gcdWithFuel fuel (suc b) (naturalMod a (suc b))

naturalGCD : Nat -> Nat -> Nat
naturalGCD a b =
  gcdWithFuel (suc (a + b)) a b

record Group
  {ell : Level}
  (G : Set ell) :
  Set ell where

  field
    identity       : G
    inverse        : G -> G
    multiply       : G -> G -> G
    associative    : (x y z : G) ->
                     multiply (multiply x y) z ==
                     multiply x (multiply y z)
    identity-left  : (x : G) -> multiply identity x == x
    identity-right : (x : G) -> multiply x identity == x
    inverse-left   : (x : G) -> multiply (inverse x) x == identity
    inverse-right  : (x : G) -> multiply x (inverse x) == identity

open Group

power :
  {ell : Level} ->
  {G : Set ell} ->
  Group G ->
  G ->
  Nat ->
  G
power structure x zero =
  identity structure
power structure x (suc exponent) =
  multiply structure
    (power structure x exponent)
    x

floorDifferenceSequence :
  Nat ->
  Nat ->
  (Nat -> Nat) ->
  Set
floorDifferenceSequence m n a =
  (k : Nat) ->
  Positive k ->
  k <=N n ->
  a k ==
  naturalDiv (m * k) n -
  naturalDiv (m * (k - one)) n

orderedProduct :
  {ell : Level} ->
  {G : Set ell} ->
  Group G ->
  G ->
  G ->
  (Nat -> Nat) ->
  Nat ->
  G
orderedProduct structure g h a zero =
  identity structure
orderedProduct structure g h a (suc k) =
  multiply structure
    (multiply structure
      (orderedProduct structure g h a k)
      g)
    (power structure h (a (suc k)))

putnam-2018-a4 :
  (ell : Level) ->
  Set (lsuc ell)
putnam-2018-a4 ell =
  (m n : Nat) ->
  Positive m ->
  Positive n ->
  naturalGCD m n == one ->
  (a : Nat -> Nat) ->
  floorDifferenceSequence m n a ->
  (G : Set ell) ->
  (structure : Group G) ->
  (g h : G) ->
  orderedProduct structure g h a n == identity structure ->
  multiply structure g h == multiply structure h g

(*
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2018_a4:
  a coprime floor-difference word equal to the identity in an arbitrary group
  forces its two group elements to commute. This file contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open arithmeticTheory gcdTheory integerTheory intrealTheory realTheory
     listTheory groupTheory;

val putnam_2018_a4 =
  ``!(grp : 'a group) (m n : num) (a : num -> int) (g h : 'a).
      let int_pow =
        \(x : 'a) (z : int).
          if 0 <= z then grp.exp x (Num z)
          else grp.exp (grp.inv x) (Num (-z))
      in
        Group grp /\
        g IN grp.carrier /\
        h IN grp.carrier /\
        0 < m /\
        0 < n /\
        gcd m n = 1 /\
        (!k : num.
           1 <= k /\ k <= n
           ==>
           a k =
             INT_FLOOR ((&(m * k) : real) / (&n : real)) -
             INT_FLOOR ((&(m * (k - 1)) : real) / (&n : real))) /\
        FOLDL
          grp.op
          grp.id
          (GENLIST
             (\i : num. grp.op g (int_pow h (a (SUC i))))
             n) =
        grp.id
        ==>
        grp.op g h = grp.op h g``;

title: putnam_2018_a4
content:
$(
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact
  putnam_2018_a4: Beatty-step exponents in an arbitrary group force two
  elements to commute when the associated ordered product is the identity.
  This file contains no proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  In SetMM, m and n range over the positive integers NN, gcd is integer
  greatest common divisor, and |_ is the real floor function. The map A is
  a total integer-valued sequence on NN0; its values on 1 ... n are exactly
  the source exponents.

  G e. Grp supplies an arbitrary group, Base ` G is its carrier, +g ` G is
  its operation, 0g ` G is its identity, and .g ` G is integer group
  exponentiation. The map indexed by 1 ... n lists the factors
  g h^(A(k)) in increasing index order. SetMM's G gsum over a consecutive
  integer interval is their left-to-right group product, matching the
  source product.

  The final declaration is the single unproved $a corpus statement; this
  database contains no $p proof declaration.
$)

${
  $d A G g h k m n $.

  putnambench-putnam-2018-a4 $a |-
    A. m e. NN A. n e. NN
      A. A e. ( ZZ ^m NN0 )
        A. G
          A. g e. ( Base ` G ) A. h e. ( Base ` G )
            (
              (
                (
                  ( m gcd n ) = 1
                  /\
                  A. k e. ( 1 ... n )
                    ( A ` k )
                    =
                    (
                      ( |_ ` ( ( m x. k ) / n ) )
                      -
                      ( |_ ` ( ( m x. ( k - 1 ) ) / n ) )
                    )
                )
                /\
                (
                  G e. Grp
                  /\
                  (
                    G
                    gsum
                    (
                      k e. ( 1 ... n ) |->
                        (
                          g
                          ( +g ` G )
                          (
                            ( A ` k )
                            ( .g ` G )
                            h
                          )
                        )
                    )
                  )
                  =
                  ( 0g ` G )
                )
              )
              ->
              (
                g ( +g ` G ) h
              )
              =
              (
                h ( +g ` G ) g
              )
            )
  $.
$}

title: putnam_2018_a4
content:
% Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2018_a4:
% a floor-increment word equal to the identity in an arbitrary group forces
% its two generators to commute. This file contains no proof.

putnam_2018_a4[Element: TYPE+]: THEORY
BEGIN
  nat_divides(divisor, value: nat): bool =
    EXISTS (quotient: nat):
      value = divisor * quotient

  coprime(left, right: nat): bool =
    FORALL (common_divisor: nat):
      nat_divides(common_divisor, left)
        AND nat_divides(common_divisor, right)
      IMPLIES common_divisor = 1

  group_laws(
      one: Element,
      inverse: [Element -> Element],
      multiply: [Element, Element -> Element]): bool =
    (FORALL (x, y, z: Element):
      multiply(multiply(x, y), z)
        = multiply(x, multiply(y, z)))
      AND
    (FORALL (x: Element):
      multiply(one, x) = x
        AND multiply(x, one) = x)
      AND
    (FORALL (x: Element):
      multiply(inverse(x), x) = one
        AND multiply(x, inverse(x)) = one)

  group_power(
      element: Element,
      exponent: nat,
      one: Element,
      multiply: [Element, Element -> Element]): RECURSIVE Element =
    IF exponent = 0 THEN
      one
    ELSE
      multiply(
        group_power(element, exponent - 1, one, multiply),
        element)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE exponent

  safe_div(numerator, denominator: real): real =
    IF denominator = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      numerator / denominator
    ENDIF

  floor_increment(m, n, k: nat): int =
    floor(safe_div((m * k) :: real, n :: real))
      - floor(safe_div((m * (k - 1)) :: real, n :: real))

  ordered_word(
      a: [nat -> nat],
      g, h: Element,
      count: nat,
      one: Element,
      multiply: [Element, Element -> Element]): RECURSIVE Element =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      one
    ELSE
      multiply(
        ordered_word(a, g, h, count - 1, one, multiply),
        multiply(
          g,
          group_power(h, a(count), one, multiply)))
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  putnam_2018_a4: bool =
    FORALL (m, n: nat),
           (a: [nat -> nat]),
           (one: Element),
           (inverse: [Element -> Element]),
           (multiply: [Element, Element -> Element]),
           (g, h: Element):
      (m > 0
        AND n > 0
        AND coprime(m, n)
        AND
          (FORALL (k: nat):
            1 <= k AND k <= n IMPLIES
              (a(k) :: int) = floor_increment(m, n, k))
        AND group_laws(one, inverse, multiply)
        AND ordered_word(a, g, h, n, one, multiply) = one)
      IMPLIES multiply(g, h) = multiply(h, g)
END putnam_2018_a4

title: putnam_2018_a5
putnam_2018_a5
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2018_a5:
;; every infinitely differentiable nonnegative real function with f(0)=0 and
;; f(1)=1 has a negative derivative value at some positive order and real
;; point. This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))

;; JET(order,x,epsilon) is a rational regular Cauchy name for the value at the
;; rational point x of the order-th derivative. DEFSTUB makes this one
;; function symbol generic without restricting it to an APPLY$-tame class.
;; DEFUN-SK supplies every universal and existential quantifier below.
;;
;; Compact uniform continuity gives each jet level a unique extension to all
;; real x. The uniform difference-quotient condition says that level order+1
;; is the derivative of level order. Hence the accepted jets are exactly
;; smooth real functions together with all iterated derivatives. Exact point
;; values and nonnegativity on the dense rational points extend to all reals.
;; Conversely, continuity makes a negative derivative at a real point
;; equivalent to a negative value with margin at some rational point.
;;
;; The antecedent is non-vacuous: the exact, epsilon-independent jet for x^2
;; has levels x^2, 2*x, 2, 0, 0, ... and satisfies every assumption (with a
;; negative first derivative at x=-1).

(defstub putnam-2018-a5-jet (order x epsilon) t)

(defun putnam-2018-a5-positive-rational-p (value)
  (and
   (rationalp value)
   (< 0 value)))

(defun putnam-2018-a5-positive-natural-p (value)
  (and
   (natp value)
   (< 0 value)))

(defun putnam-2018-a5-in-bounded-interval-p
    (value bound)
  (and
   (rationalp value)
   (putnam-2018-a5-positive-natural-p bound)
   (<= (- bound) value)
   (<= value bound)))

;; A regular Cauchy name at every natural derivative order and rational point
;; presents a real value rather than restricting that value to the rationals.

(defun-sk putnam-2018-a5-regular-jet-p ()
  (forall (order x epsilon eta)
    (implies
     (and
      (natp order)
      (rationalp x)
      (putnam-2018-a5-positive-rational-p epsilon)
      (putnam-2018-a5-positive-rational-p eta))
     (let ((left
            (putnam-2018-a5-jet order x epsilon))
           (right
            (putnam-2018-a5-jet order x eta)))
       (and
        (rationalp left)
        (rationalp right)
        (<= (abs (- left right))
            (+ epsilon eta)))))))

;; Uniform continuity on each compact rational interval is equivalent, after
;; Cauchy completion, to continuity of every represented derivative on R.

(defun-sk putnam-2018-a5-continuity-at-scale-p
    (order bound epsilon delta)
  (forall (x y)
    (implies
     (and
      (putnam-2018-a5-in-bounded-interval-p x bound)
      (putnam-2018-a5-in-bounded-interval-p y bound)
      (< (abs (- x y)) delta))
     (let ((left
            (putnam-2018-a5-jet
             order x (* 1/4 epsilon)))
           (right
            (putnam-2018-a5-jet
             order y (* 1/4 epsilon))))
       (and
        (rationalp left)
        (rationalp right)
        (<= (abs (- left right))
            epsilon))))))

(defun-sk putnam-2018-a5-continuity-scale-exists-p
    (order bound epsilon)
  (exists (delta)
    (and
     (putnam-2018-a5-positive-rational-p delta)
     (putnam-2018-a5-continuity-at-scale-p
      order bound epsilon delta))))

(defun-sk putnam-2018-a5-compact-continuity-p ()
  (forall (order bound epsilon)
    (implies
     (and
      (natp order)
      (putnam-2018-a5-positive-natural-p bound)
      (putnam-2018-a5-positive-rational-p epsilon))
     (putnam-2018-a5-continuity-scale-exists-p
      order bound epsilon))))

;; For every compact interval and tolerance, one positive rational radius
;; works uniformly for the rational difference quotients. The scaled Cauchy
;; precisions account for division by h and make the next jet level precisely
;; the derivative of the preceding one.

(defun-sk putnam-2018-a5-derivative-at-scale-p
    (order bound epsilon delta)
  (forall (x h)
    (implies
     (and
      (putnam-2018-a5-in-bounded-interval-p x bound)
      (rationalp h)
      (not (equal h 0))
      (putnam-2018-a5-in-bounded-interval-p
       (+ x h) bound)
      (< (abs h) delta))
     (let* ((value-precision
             (* 1/8 epsilon (abs h)))
            (derivative-precision
             (* 1/4 epsilon))
            (right-value
             (putnam-2018-a5-jet
              order (+ x h) value-precision))
            (left-value
             (putnam-2018-a5-jet
              order x value-precision))
            (next-value
             (putnam-2018-a5-jet
              (+ order 1) x derivative-precision)))
       (and
        (rationalp right-value)
        (rationalp left-value)
        (rationalp next-value)
        (<=
         (abs
          (-
           (/ (- right-value left-value) h)
           next-value))
         epsilon))))))

(defun-sk putnam-2018-a5-derivative-scale-exists-p
    (order bound epsilon)
  (exists (delta)
    (and
     (putnam-2018-a5-positive-rational-p delta)
     (putnam-2018-a5-derivative-at-scale-p
      order bound epsilon delta))))

(defun-sk putnam-2018-a5-successive-derivatives-p ()
  (forall (order bound epsilon)
    (implies
     (and
      (natp order)
      (putnam-2018-a5-positive-natural-p bound)
      (putnam-2018-a5-positive-rational-p epsilon))
     (putnam-2018-a5-derivative-scale-exists-p
      order bound epsilon))))

(defun putnam-2018-a5-smooth-jet-p ()
  (and
   (putnam-2018-a5-regular-jet-p)
   (putnam-2018-a5-compact-continuity-p)
   (putnam-2018-a5-successive-derivatives-p)))

;; These all-precision comparisons are equivalent to exact equality of the
;; represented zeroth-order value with EXPECTED.

(defun-sk putnam-2018-a5-point-value-p
    (point expected)
  (forall (epsilon)
    (implies
     (putnam-2018-a5-positive-rational-p epsilon)
     (let ((value
            (putnam-2018-a5-jet
             0 point (* 1/4 epsilon))))
       (and
        (rationalp value)
        (<= (abs (- value expected))
            epsilon))))))

;; For a continuous represented function, this dense rational condition is
;; equivalent to global nonnegativity on the real line.

(defun-sk putnam-2018-a5-nonnegative-p ()
  (forall (x epsilon)
    (implies
     (and
      (rationalp x)
      (putnam-2018-a5-positive-rational-p epsilon))
     (let ((value
            (putnam-2018-a5-jet
             0 x (* 1/4 epsilon))))
       (and
        (rationalp value)
        (<= (- epsilon) value))))))

;; A strict negative value is equivalently witnessed by a positive rational
;; margin. Density and continuity permit the point witness to be rational.

(defun-sk putnam-2018-a5-negative-derivative-exists-p ()
  (exists (order x margin)
    (and
     (natp order)
     (< 0 order)
     (rationalp x)
     (putnam-2018-a5-positive-rational-p margin)
     (let ((value
            (putnam-2018-a5-jet
             order x (* 1/4 margin))))
       (and
        (rationalp value)
        (< (+ value margin) 0))))))

(defun putnambench-putnam-2018-a5-statement ()

    (putnam-2018-a5-smooth-jet-p)
    (putnam-2018-a5-point-value-p 0 0)
    (putnam-2018-a5-point-value-p 1 1)
    (putnam-2018-a5-nonnegative-p))

title: putnam_2018_a5
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2018_a5
-- (putnambench__agda__putnam_2018_a5): a nonnegative smooth real function
-- taking the values zero at zero and one at one has a negative derivative of
-- some positive order at some real point. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module Putnam2018A5 where

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; _*_)

infix 4 _!=_
infixr 3 _and_
infixr 2 _or_

data Bottom : Set where

Not : Set -> Set
Not A =
  A -> Bottom

_!=_ : {A : Set} -> A -> A -> Set
x != y =
  Not (x == y)

record _and_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data _or_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  left  : A -> A or B
  right : B -> A or B

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

data Positive : Nat -> Set where
  positive : (n : Nat) -> Positive (suc n)

record CompleteOrderedRealField (R : Set) : Set1 where
  field
    zeroR oneR : R
    add multiply : R -> R -> R
    negate inverse : R -> R
    lessOrEqual : R -> R -> Set
    fromNat : Nat -> R

    one-not-zero :
      oneR != zeroR

    add-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> add x y == add y x
    add-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      add (add x y) z == add x (add y z)
    add-zero :
      (x : R) -> add x zeroR == x
    add-inverse :
      (x : R) -> add x (negate x) == zeroR

    multiply-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> multiply x y == multiply y x
    multiply-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply (multiply x y) z ==
      multiply x (multiply y z)
    multiply-one :
      (x : R) -> multiply x oneR == x
    multiply-zero :
      (x : R) -> multiply x zeroR == zeroR
    distribute :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply x (add y z) ==
      add (multiply x y) (multiply x z)
    inverse-zero :
      inverse zeroR == zeroR
    multiply-inverse :
      (x : R) ->
      x != zeroR ->
      multiply x (inverse x) == oneR

    order-reflexive :
      (x : R) -> lessOrEqual x x
    order-transitive :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y z ->
      lessOrEqual x z
    order-antisymmetric :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y x ->
      x == y
    order-total :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y or lessOrEqual y x
    add-order :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual (add z x) (add z y)
    multiply-nonnegative :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR x ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR y ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR (multiply x y)
    zero-less-than-one :
      lessOrEqual zeroR oneR and zeroR != oneR

    fromNat-zero :
      fromNat zero == zeroR
    fromNat-successor :
      (n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (suc n) == add (fromNat n) oneR
    fromNat-addition :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m + n) == add (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-multiplication :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m * n) == multiply (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-injective :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat m == fromNat n ->
      m == n

    archimedean :
      (x : R) ->
      Exists Nat (\ n -> lessOrEqual x (fromNat n))
    least-upper-bound :
      (P : R -> Set) ->
      Exists R P ->
      Exists R
        (\ upper ->
          (x : R) ->
          P x ->
          lessOrEqual x upper) ->
      Exists R
        (\ supremum ->
          ((x : R) ->
            P x ->
            lessOrEqual x supremum)
          and
          ((upper : R) ->
            ((x : R) ->
              P x ->
              lessOrEqual x upper) ->
            lessOrEqual supremum upper))

open CompleteOrderedRealField

subtract :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
subtract reals x y =
  add reals x (negate reals y)

divide :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
divide reals x y =
  multiply reals x (inverse reals y)

StrictLess :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
StrictLess reals x y =
  lessOrEqual reals x y and x != y

CloseTo :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
CloseTo reals center radius x =
  StrictLess reals
    (subtract reals center radius)
    x
  and
  StrictLess reals
    x
    (add reals center radius)

ContinuousAt :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (R -> R) ->
  R ->
  Set
ContinuousAt {R} reals function point =
  (epsilon : R) ->
  StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) epsilon ->
  Exists R
    (\ delta ->
      StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) delta
      and
      ((x : R) ->
        CloseTo reals point delta x ->
        CloseTo reals
          (function point)
          epsilon
          (function x)))

Continuous :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (R -> R) ->
  Set
Continuous {R} reals function =
  (point : R) ->
  ContinuousAt reals function point

differenceQuotient :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (R -> R) ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
differenceQuotient reals function point x =
  divide reals
    (subtract reals (function x) (function point))
    (subtract reals x point)

DerivativeAt :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (R -> R) ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
DerivativeAt {R} reals function point derivative =
  (epsilon : R) ->
  StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) epsilon ->
  Exists R
    (\ delta ->
      StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) delta
      and
      ((x : R) ->
        CloseTo reals point delta x ->
        x != point ->
        CloseTo reals derivative epsilon
          (differenceQuotient reals function point x)))

record SmoothDerivativeTower
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R)
  (function : R -> R)
  (derivatives : Nat -> R -> R) :
  Set where

  field
    order-zero :
      (x : R) ->
      derivatives zero x == function x

    derivative-step :
      (n : Nat) ->
      (x : R) ->
      DerivativeAt reals
        (derivatives n)
        x
        (derivatives (suc n) x)

    every-order-continuous :
      (n : Nat) ->
      Continuous reals (derivatives n)

InfinitelyDifferentiable :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (R -> R) ->
  Set
InfinitelyDifferentiable {R} reals function =
  Exists (Nat -> R -> R)
    (SmoothDerivativeTower reals function)

IteratedDerivativeValue :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Nat ->
  (R -> R) ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
IteratedDerivativeValue reals zero function point derivativeValue =
  derivativeValue == function point
IteratedDerivativeValue {R} reals (suc n) function point derivativeValue =
  Exists (R -> R)
    (\ derivativeFunction ->
      ((x : R) ->
        DerivativeAt reals
          function
          x
          (derivativeFunction x))
      and
      IteratedDerivativeValue reals
        n
        derivativeFunction
        point
        derivativeValue)

putnam-2018-a5 : Set1
putnam-2018-a5 =
  (R : Set) ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) ->
  (f : R -> R) ->
  InfinitelyDifferentiable reals f ->
  f (zeroR reals) == zeroR reals ->
  f (oneR reals) == oneR reals ->
  ((x : R) ->
    lessOrEqual reals (zeroR reals) (f x)) ->
  Exists Nat
    (\ n ->
      Positive n
      and
      Exists R
        (\ x ->
          Exists R
            (\ derivativeValue ->
              IteratedDerivativeValue reals
                n
                f
                x
                derivativeValue
              and
              StrictLess reals
                derivativeValue
                (zeroR reals))))

title: putnam_2018_a5
content:
% Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2018_a5:
% every globally infinitely differentiable nonnegative real function taking
% the values 0 at 0 and 1 at 1 has a negative derivative of some positive
% order at some real point. This file contains no proof.

putnam_2018_a5: THEORY
BEGIN
  real_function: TYPE = [real -> real]

  has_derivative_at(
      f: real_function,
      derivative, x: real): bool =
    FORALL (epsilon_value: posreal):
      EXISTS (delta: posreal):
        FORALL (h: real):
          (h /= 0 AND abs(h) < delta)
            IMPLIES
              abs(
                f(x + h) - f(x)
                  - derivative * h)
                < epsilon_value * abs(h)

  differentiable_at(f: real_function, x: real): bool =
    EXISTS (derivative: real):
      has_derivative_at(f, derivative, x)

  derivative_value(f: real_function, x: real): real =
    IF differentiable_at(f, x) THEN
      epsilon(
        LAMBDA (derivative: real):
          has_derivative_at(f, derivative, x))
    ELSE
      0
    ENDIF

  derivative_function(f: real_function): real_function =
    LAMBDA (x: real):
      derivative_value(f, x)

  iterated_derivative(
      f: real_function,
      order: nat): RECURSIVE real_function =
    IF order = 0 THEN
      f
    ELSE
      derivative_function(
        iterated_derivative(f, order - 1))
    ENDIF
  MEASURE order

  infinitely_differentiable(f: real_function): bool =
    FORALL (order: nat), (x: real):
      differentiable_at(iterated_derivative(f, order), x)

  putnam_2018_a5: bool =
    FORALL (f: real_function):
      (infinitely_differentiable(f)
        AND f(0) = 0
        AND f(1) = 1
        AND FORALL (x: real): f(x) >= 0)
      IMPLIES
        EXISTS (order: nat), (x: real):
          order > 0
            AND iterated_derivative(f, order)(x) < 0
END putnam_2018_a5

(* Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2018_a6:
   rational squared pairwise distances among four planar points with no three
   collinear imply a rational ratio of two triangle areas. This file contains
   no proof. *)

From Stdlib Require Import Reals QArith.

Open Scope R_scope.

Definition putnam_2018_a6_point : Type := (R * R)%type.

Definition putnam_2018_a6_squared_distance
    (p q : putnam_2018_a6_point) : R :=
  (fst p - fst q) ^ 2 + (snd p - snd q) ^ 2.

Definition putnam_2018_a6_rational_squared_distance
    (p q : putnam_2018_a6_point) : Prop :=
  p <> q /\
  exists r : Q, putnam_2018_a6_squared_distance p q = Q2R r.

Definition putnam_2018_a6_signed_twice_area
    (a b c : putnam_2018_a6_point) : R :=
  (fst b - fst a) * (snd c - snd a) -
  (snd b - snd a) * (fst c - fst a).

Definition putnam_2018_a6_noncollinear
    (a b c : putnam_2018_a6_point) : Prop :=
  putnam_2018_a6_signed_twice_area a b c <> 0.

Definition putnam_2018_a6_triangle_area
    (a b c : putnam_2018_a6_point) : R :=
  Rabs (putnam_2018_a6_signed_twice_area a b c) / 2.

Theorem putnam_2018_a6
    (A B C D : putnam_2018_a6_point)
    (ABCDnoline :
      putnam_2018_a6_noncollinear A B C /\
      putnam_2018_a6_noncollinear A B D /\
      putnam_2018_a6_noncollinear A C D /\
      putnam_2018_a6_noncollinear B C D)
    (ABCDsqrrat :
      putnam_2018_a6_rational_squared_distance A B /\
      putnam_2018_a6_rational_squared_distance A C /\
      putnam_2018_a6_rational_squared_distance A D /\
      putnam_2018_a6_rational_squared_distance B C /\
      putnam_2018_a6_rational_squared_distance B D /\
      putnam_2018_a6_rational_squared_distance C D) :
  exists q : Q,
    putnam_2018_a6_triangle_area A B C /
    putnam_2018_a6_triangle_area A B D = Q2R q.
Admitted.
