(*
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2018_a6:
  rationality of the ratio of two triangle areas when all six squared
  pairwise distances among four noncollinear plane points are rational.
  This file contains no proof.
*)

let statement =
  `let squared_distance =
     \(P:real#real) (Q:real#real).
       (FST P - FST Q) pow 2 + (SND P - SND Q) pow 2 in
   let det2 =
     \(P:real#real) (Q:real#real) (R:real#real).
       (FST Q - FST P) * (SND R - SND P) -
       (SND Q - SND P) * (FST R - FST P) in
   let triangle_area =
     \(P:real#real) (Q:real#real) (R:real#real).
       abs (det2 P Q R) / &2 in
   let rational_real =
     \x:real. ?p q:num. ~(q = 0) /\ abs x = &p / &q in
   !A B C D:real#real.
     ~(det2 A B C = &0) /\
     ~(det2 A B D = &0) /\
     ~(det2 A C D = &0) /\
     ~(det2 B C D = &0) /\
     rational_real (squared_distance A B) /\
     rational_real (squared_distance A C) /\
     rational_real (squared_distance A D) /\
     rational_real (squared_distance B C) /\
     rational_real (squared_distance B D) /\
     rational_real (squared_distance C D)
     ==>
     rational_real
       (triangle_area A B C / triangle_area A B D)`;;

title: putnam_2018_a6
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2018_a6:
;; four plane points with no three collinear and with all six squared
;; distances rational have a rational ratio of the areas of triangles ABC
;; and ABD. This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

;; The six arguments used below are squared distances. For squared side
;; lengths X, Y, Z, this expression is sixteen times the squared area of the
;; corresponding triangle.
(defun putnam-2018-a6-heron-sixteen (x y z)
  (- (* 4 x y)
     (* (- (+ x y) z)
        (- (+ x y) z))))

;; This is the determinant of twice the Gram matrix of the vectors AB, AC,
;; and AD. Its vanishing, together with a positive ABC Heron determinant,
;; says that the four-point metric is realized in a two-dimensional
;; Euclidean space.
(defun putnam-2018-a6-scaled-gram-determinant
    (ab ac ad bc bd cd)
  (let ((ab-ac (- (+ ab ac) bc))
        (ab-ad (- (+ ab ad) bd))
        (ac-ad (- (+ ac ad) cd)))
    (+ (* 2 ab
          (- (* 2 ac 2 ad)
             (* ac-ad ac-ad)))
       (* (- ab-ac)
          (- (* ab-ac 2 ad)
             (* ac-ad ab-ad)))
       (* ab-ad
          (- (* ab-ac ac-ad)
             (* 2 ac ab-ad))))))

;; A natural square root of N, when it exists, is at most N. Thus this
;; bounded search represents the existential square-root witness internally.
(defun putnam-2018-a6-square-through-p (n candidate)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix candidate)))
  (if (and (natp n)
           (natp candidate))
      (or (equal (* candidate candidate) n)
          (and (not (zp candidate))
               (putnam-2018-a6-square-through-p
                n (- candidate 1))))
    nil))

;; ACL2 rationals are stored in lowest terms. A nonnegative rational has a
;; rational square root exactly when its numerator and denominator are both
;; perfect squares.
(defun putnam-2018-a6-rational-square-p (value)
  (and
   (rationalp value)
   (<= 0 value)
   (putnam-2018-a6-square-through-p
    (numerator value) (numerator value))
   (putnam-2018-a6-square-through-p
    (denominator value) (denominator value))))

;; Every source configuration determines six positive rational squared
;; distances satisfying the four positive Heron conditions and the zero Gram
;; determinant below. Conversely, these conditions make the leading 2-by-2
;; Gram block positive definite and the full Gram matrix positive semidefinite
;; of rank two, so they reconstruct a real plane configuration with exactly
;; the stated distances and with no three points collinear. Hence this
;; distance-geometry representation is bidirectionally equivalent to the
;; point-based source statement. Since the Heron values are sixteen times
;; squared areas, the positive area ratio is rational exactly when their
;; quotient has a rational square root.
(defun putnambench-putnam-2018-a6-statement
    (ab ac ad bc bd cd)
  (implies
   (and
    (rationalp ab)
    (rationalp ac)
    (rationalp ad)
    (rationalp bc)
    (rationalp bd)
    (rationalp cd)
    (< 0 ab)
    (< 0 ac)
    (< 0 ad)
    (< 0 bc)
    (< 0 bd)
    (< 0 cd)
    (< 0 (putnam-2018-a6-heron-sixteen ab ac bc))
    (< 0 (putnam-2018-a6-heron-sixteen ab ad bd))
    (< 0 (putnam-2018-a6-heron-sixteen ac ad cd))
    (< 0 (putnam-2018-a6-heron-sixteen bc bd cd))
    (equal
     (putnam-2018-a6-scaled-gram-determinant
      ab ac ad bc bd cd)
     0))
   (putnam-2018-a6-rational-square-p
    (/
     (putnam-2018-a6-heron-sixteen ab ac bc)
     (putnam-2018-a6-heron-sixteen ab ad bd)))))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

title: putnam_2018_a6
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2018_a6
-- (putnambench__agda__putnam_2018_a6): four points in the real Euclidean
-- plane with no three collinear and rational squared pairwise distances have
-- a rational quotient of the areas of triangles ABC and ABD. This file
-- contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module Putnam2018A6 where

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Int using (Int; pos; negsuc)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; _*_)

infix 4 _!=_
infixr 3 _and_
infixr 2 _or_

data Bottom : Set where

Not : Set -> Set
Not A =
  A -> Bottom

_!=_ : {A : Set} -> A -> A -> Set
x != y =
  Not (x == y)

record _and_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data _or_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  left  : A -> A or B
  right : B -> A or B

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

record CompleteOrderedRealField (R : Set) : Set1 where
  field
    zeroR oneR : R
    add multiply : R -> R -> R
    negate inverse squareRoot : R -> R
    lessOrEqual : R -> R -> Set
    fromNat : Nat -> R

    one-not-zero :
      oneR != zeroR

    add-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> add x y == add y x
    add-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      add (add x y) z == add x (add y z)
    add-zero :
      (x : R) -> add x zeroR == x
    add-inverse :
      (x : R) -> add x (negate x) == zeroR

    multiply-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> multiply x y == multiply y x
    multiply-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply (multiply x y) z ==
      multiply x (multiply y z)
    multiply-one :
      (x : R) -> multiply x oneR == x
    multiply-zero :
      (x : R) -> multiply x zeroR == zeroR
    distribute :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply x (add y z) ==
      add (multiply x y) (multiply x z)
    inverse-zero :
      inverse zeroR == zeroR
    multiply-inverse :
      (x : R) ->
      x != zeroR ->
      multiply x (inverse x) == oneR

    order-reflexive :
      (x : R) -> lessOrEqual x x
    order-transitive :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y z ->
      lessOrEqual x z
    order-antisymmetric :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y x ->
      x == y
    order-total :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y or lessOrEqual y x
    add-order :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual (add z x) (add z y)
    multiply-nonnegative :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR x ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR y ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR (multiply x y)
    zero-less-than-one :
      lessOrEqual zeroR oneR and zeroR != oneR

    fromNat-zero :
      fromNat zero == zeroR
    fromNat-successor :
      (n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (suc n) == add (fromNat n) oneR
    fromNat-addition :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m + n) == add (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-multiplication :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m * n) == multiply (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-injective :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat m == fromNat n ->
      m == n

    archimedean :
      (x : R) ->
      Exists Nat
        (\ n -> lessOrEqual x (fromNat n))
    least-upper-bound :
      (P : R -> Set) ->
      Exists R P ->
      Exists R
        (\ upper ->
          (x : R) ->
          P x ->
          lessOrEqual x upper) ->
      Exists R
        (\ supremum ->
          ((x : R) ->
            P x ->
            lessOrEqual x supremum)
          and
          ((upper : R) ->
            ((x : R) ->
              P x ->
              lessOrEqual x upper) ->
            lessOrEqual supremum upper))

    square-root-nonnegative :
      (x : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR (squareRoot x)
    square-root-square :
      (x : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR x ->
      multiply (squareRoot x) (squareRoot x) == x
    square-root-nonpositive :
      (x : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x zeroR ->
      squareRoot x == zeroR
    square-root-unique :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR y ->
      multiply y y == x ->
      y == squareRoot x

open CompleteOrderedRealField

subtract :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
subtract reals x y =
  add reals x (negate reals y)

divide :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
divide reals x y =
  multiply reals x (inverse reals y)

square :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R
square reals x =
  multiply reals x x

fromInt :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Int ->
  R
fromInt reals (pos n) =
  fromNat reals n
fromInt reals (negsuc n) =
  negate reals (fromNat reals (suc n))

record Rational : Set where
  constructor fraction
  field
    numerator             : Int
    denominator-minus-one : Nat

open Rational

denominator : Rational -> Nat
denominator q =
  suc (denominator-minus-one q)

rationalValue :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Rational ->
  R
rationalValue reals q =
  divide reals
    (fromInt reals (numerator q))
    (fromNat reals (denominator q))

IsRational :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  Set
IsRational reals x =
  Exists Rational
    (\ q -> x == rationalValue reals q)

twoN : Nat
twoN =
  suc (suc zero)

half :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R
half reals =
  inverse reals (fromNat reals twoN)

record Point (R : Set) : Set where
  constructor point
  field
    x-coordinate : R
    y-coordinate : R

open Point

squaredDistance :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Point R ->
  Point R ->
  R
squaredDistance reals p q =
  add reals
    (square reals
      (subtract reals (x-coordinate p) (x-coordinate q)))
    (square reals
      (subtract reals (y-coordinate p) (y-coordinate q)))

doubleSignedArea :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Point R ->
  Point R ->
  Point R ->
  R
doubleSignedArea reals a b c =
  subtract reals
    (multiply reals
      (subtract reals (x-coordinate b) (x-coordinate a))
      (subtract reals (y-coordinate c) (y-coordinate a)))
    (multiply reals
      (subtract reals (y-coordinate b) (y-coordinate a))
      (subtract reals (x-coordinate c) (x-coordinate a)))

Collinear :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Point R ->
  Point R ->
  Point R ->
  Set
Collinear reals a b c =
  doubleSignedArea reals a b c == zeroR reals

triangleArea :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Point R ->
  Point R ->
  Point R ->
  R
triangleArea reals a b c =
  multiply reals
    (half reals)
    (squareRoot reals
      (square reals (doubleSignedArea reals a b c)))

module Putnam2018A6Statement
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) where

  PairHasRationalSquaredDistance :
    Point R ->
    Point R ->
    Set
  PairHasRationalSquaredDistance p q =
    p != q
    and
    IsRational reals (squaredDistance reals p q)

  GeneralPosition :
    Point R ->
    Point R ->
    Point R ->
    Point R ->
    Set
  GeneralPosition A B C D =
    Not (Collinear reals A B C)
    and
    Not (Collinear reals A B D)
    and
    Not (Collinear reals A C D)
    and
    Not (Collinear reals B C D)

  AllSquaredDistancesRational :
    Point R ->
    Point R ->
    Point R ->
    Point R ->
    Set
  AllSquaredDistancesRational A B C D =
    PairHasRationalSquaredDistance A B
    and
    PairHasRationalSquaredDistance A C
    and
    PairHasRationalSquaredDistance A D
    and
    PairHasRationalSquaredDistance B C
    and
    PairHasRationalSquaredDistance B D
    and
    PairHasRationalSquaredDistance C D

  proposition : Set
  proposition =
    (A B C D : Point R) ->
    GeneralPosition A B C D ->
    AllSquaredDistancesRational A B C D ->
    IsRational reals
      (divide reals
        (triangleArea reals A B C)
        (triangleArea reals A B D))

putnam-2018-a6 : Set1
putnam-2018-a6 =
  (R : Set) ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) ->
  Putnam2018A6Statement.proposition reals

title: putnam_2018_a6
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2018_a6:
  four plane points with no three collinear and with all six squared pairwise
  distances rational have a rational ratio of the areas of triangles ABC and
  ABD. This file contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open pairTheory realTheory ratTheory real_of_ratTheory;

val putnam_2018_a6 =
  ``let cross =
      \A B C : real # real.
        (FST B - FST A) * (SND C - SND A) -
        (SND B - SND A) * (FST C - FST A)
    in
    let noncollinear =
      \A B C : real # real. cross A B C <> 0
    in
    let squared_distance =
      \P Q : real # real.
        (FST P - FST Q) pow 2 + (SND P - SND Q) pow 2
    in
    let rational_squared_distance =
      \P Q : real # real.
        P <> Q /\
        ?q : rat. squared_distance P Q = real_of_rat q
    in
    let triangle_area =
      \A B C : real # real. abs (cross A B C) / 2
    in
      !A B C D : real # real.
        noncollinear A B C /\
        noncollinear A B D /\
        noncollinear A C D /\
        noncollinear B C D /\
        rational_squared_distance A B /\
        rational_squared_distance A C /\
        rational_squared_distance A D /\
        rational_squared_distance B C /\
        rational_squared_distance B D /\
        rational_squared_distance C D
        ==>
        ?q : rat.
          triangle_area A B C / triangle_area A B D =
          real_of_rat q``;

title: putnam_2018_a6
content:
$(
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact
  putnam_2018_a6: rationality of the ratio of the areas of two triangles
  determined by four plane points, no three of which are collinear, whose
  six squared pairwise distances are rational. This file contains no proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  P18A6R2 is the real coordinate plane. P18A6DistSq is squared Euclidean
  distance, and P18A6Noncol is determinant noncollinearity. P18A6Area is
  one half of the absolute determinant, hence exactly the planar Lebesgue
  area of the convex hull of its three vertices.

  P18A6Pair includes both parts of the source PPprops predicate: distinctness
  and rationality of squared distance. The conclusion keeps the rational
  witness internally existential. Since the hypotheses make both triangles
  nondegenerate, the quotient of these determinant areas is exactly the
  quotient of the source Lebesgue areas. The final declaration is the single
  unproved $a corpus statement; this database contains no $p proof statement.
$)

$c P18A6I P18A6R2 P18A6DistSq P18A6Noncol P18A6Area P18A6Pair $.

p18a6-index-syntax $a class P18A6I $.
p18a6-plane-syntax $a class P18A6R2 $.
p18a6-distance-square-syntax $a class ( P18A6DistSq A B ) $.
p18a6-noncollinear-syntax $a wff ( P18A6Noncol A B C ) $.
p18a6-area-syntax $a class ( P18A6Area A B C ) $.
p18a6-pair-syntax $a wff ( P18A6Pair A B ) $.

p18a6-index-definition $a |- P18A6I = ( 1 ... 2 ) $.

p18a6-plane-definition $a |- P18A6R2 = ( RR ^m P18A6I ) $.

${
  $d A B k $.

  p18a6-distance-square-definition $a |- (
    P18A6DistSq A B
  ) = (
    sum_ k e. P18A6I
      ( ( ( A ` k ) - ( B ` k ) ) ^ 2 )
  ) $.
$}

p18a6-noncollinear-definition $a |- (
  ( P18A6Noncol A B C )
  <->
  (
    (
      ( ( B ` 1 ) - ( A ` 1 ) )
      x.
      ( ( C ` 2 ) - ( A ` 2 ) )
    )
    =/=
    (
      ( ( B ` 2 ) - ( A ` 2 ) )
      x.
      ( ( C ` 1 ) - ( A ` 1 ) )
    )
  )
) $.

p18a6-area-definition $a |- (
  P18A6Area A B C
) = (
  ( 1 / 2 )
  x.
  (
    abs
    `
    (
      (
        ( ( B ` 1 ) - ( A ` 1 ) )
        x.
        ( ( C ` 2 ) - ( A ` 2 ) )
      )
      -
      (
        ( ( B ` 2 ) - ( A ` 2 ) )
        x.
        ( ( C ` 1 ) - ( A ` 1 ) )
      )
    )
  )
) $.

p18a6-pair-definition $a |- (
  ( P18A6Pair A B )
  <->
  (
    A =/= B
    /\
    ( P18A6DistSq A B ) e. QQ
  )
) $.

${
  $d a b c d q $.

  putnambench-putnam-2018-a6 $a |- (
    A. a e. P18A6R2
    A. b e. P18A6R2
    A. c e. P18A6R2
    A. d e. P18A6R2
      (
        (
          (
            ( P18A6Noncol a b c )
            /\
            (
              ( P18A6Noncol a b d )
              /\
              (
                ( P18A6Noncol a c d )
                /\
                ( P18A6Noncol b c d )
              )
            )
          )
          /\
          (
            ( P18A6Pair a b )
            /\
            (
              ( P18A6Pair a c )
              /\
              (
                ( P18A6Pair a d )
                /\
                (
                  ( P18A6Pair b c )
                  /\
                  (
                    ( P18A6Pair b d )
                    /\
                    ( P18A6Pair c d )
                  )
                )
              )
            )
          )
        )
        ->
        E. q e. QQ
          (
            ( P18A6Area a b c )
            /
            ( P18A6Area a b d )
          )
          =
          q
      )
  ) $.
$}

title: putnam_2018_a6
content:
% Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2018_a6:
% rational squared distances among four planar points in general position imply
% a rational ratio of the areas of triangles ABC and ABD. This file contains no proof.

putnam_2018_a6: THEORY
BEGIN
  point: TYPE = [# x_coord: real, y_coord: real #]

  squared_distance(P, Q: point): real =
    (x_coord(P) - x_coord(Q)) ^ 2
      + (y_coord(P) - y_coord(Q)) ^ 2

  cross_from(P, Q, R: point): real =
    (x_coord(Q) - x_coord(P)) * (y_coord(R) - y_coord(P))
      - (y_coord(Q) - y_coord(P)) * (x_coord(R) - x_coord(P))

  noncollinear(P, Q, R: point): bool =
    cross_from(P, Q, R) /= 0

  triangle_area(P, Q, R: point): real =
    abs(cross_from(P, Q, R)) / 2

  rational_squared_distance(P, Q: point): bool =
    P /= Q
      AND (EXISTS (q: rat):
        squared_distance(P, Q) = (q :: real))

  quotient_or_zero(numerator, denominator: real): real =
    IF denominator = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      numerator / denominator
    ENDIF

  putnam_2018_a6: bool =
    FORALL (A, B, C, D: point):
      (noncollinear(A, B, C)
        AND noncollinear(A, B, D)
        AND noncollinear(A, C, D)
        AND noncollinear(B, C, D)
        AND rational_squared_distance(A, B)
        AND rational_squared_distance(A, C)
        AND rational_squared_distance(A, D)
        AND rational_squared_distance(B, C)
        AND rational_squared_distance(B, D)
        AND rational_squared_distance(C, D))
      IMPLIES
        (EXISTS (q: rat):
          quotient_or_zero(
            triangle_area(A, B, C),
            triangle_area(A, B, D))
            = (q :: real))
END putnam_2018_a6

title: putnam_2018_b1
content:
import Mathlib

abbrev putnam_2018_b1_solution : Set (Fin 2 → ℤ) := sorry
-- {v : Fin 2 → ℤ | ∃ b : ℤ, 0 ≤ b ∧ b ≤ 100 ∧ Even b ∧ v = ![1, b]}

/--
Let $\mathcal{P}$ be the set of vectors defined by $\mathcal{P}=\left\{\left.\begin{pmatrix} a \\ b \end{pmatrix}\right| 0 \leq a \leq 2, 0 \leq b \leq 100,\text{ and }a,b \in \mathbb{Z}\right\}$. Find all $\mathbf{v} \in \mathcal{P}$ such that the set $\mathcal{P} \setminus \{\mathbf{v}\}$ obtained by omitting vector $\mathbf{v}$ from $\mathcal{P}$ can be partitioned into two sets of equal size and equal sum.
-/
theorem putnam_2018_b1
(P Pvdiff : Finset (Fin 2 → ℤ))
(v : Fin 2 → ℤ)
(hP : P = {v' : Fin 2 → ℤ | 0 ≤ v' 0 ∧ v' 0 ≤ 2 ∧ 0 ≤ v' 1 ∧ v' 1 ≤ 100})

  (putnambench__hol-light__putnam_2018_b1): classification of the integer

        &0 <= SND w /\ SND w <= &100} in

;; Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2018_b1:
;; the integer vectors whose removal from the 3 by 101 grid leaves a partition
;; into two sets of equal size and equal vector sum. This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

;; Index I names the grid point (floor(I/101), I mod 101). Recursing over all
;; 303 indices and choosing Q or R for every point other than the omitted one
;; ranges bijectively over every partition of P \ {v}. The accumulated
;; cardinalities and coordinate sums therefore encode exactly the source's
;; internal existentially quantified sets Q and R.
(defun putnam-2018-b1-partition-exists-p
    (remaining omitted-a omitted-b
               q-card q-sum-a q-sum-b
               r-card r-sum-a r-sum-b)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix remaining)))
  (if (zp remaining)
      (and
       (equal q-card r-card)
       (equal q-sum-a r-sum-a)
       (equal q-sum-b r-sum-b))
    (let* ((index (- remaining 1))
           (a (floor index 101))
           (b (mod index 101))
           (next (- remaining 1)))
      (if (and (equal a omitted-a)
               (equal b omitted-b))
          (putnam-2018-b1-partition-exists-p
           next omitted-a omitted-b
           q-card q-sum-a q-sum-b
           r-card r-sum-a r-sum-b)
        (or
         (putnam-2018-b1-partition-exists-p
          next omitted-a omitted-b
          (+ q-card 1) (+ q-sum-a a) (+ q-sum-b b)
          r-card r-sum-a r-sum-b)
         (putnam-2018-b1-partition-exists-p
          next omitted-a omitted-b
          q-card q-sum-a q-sum-b
          (+ r-card 1) (+ r-sum-a a) (+ r-sum-b b)))))))

(defun putnam-2018-b1-grid-member-p (a b)
  (and
   (integerp a)
   (integerp b)
   (<= 0 a)
   (<= a 2)
   (<= 0 b)
   (<= b 100)))

(defun putnam-2018-b1-solution-member-p (a b)
  (and
   (integerp a)
   (integerp b)
   (equal a 1)
   (<= 0 b)
   (<= b 100)
   (equal (mod b 2) 0)))

(defun putnambench-putnam-2018-b1-statement (a b)
  (implies
   (and (integerp a)
        (integerp b))
   (equal
    (and
     (putnam-2018-b1-grid-member-p a b)
     (putnam-2018-b1-partition-exists-p
      303 a b
      0 0 0
      0 0 0))
    (putnam-2018-b1-solution-member-p a b))))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

-- Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2018_b1
-- (putnambench__agda__putnam_2018_b1): integer grid points whose removal
-- permits an equal-size partition with equal vector sums. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module Putnam2018B1 where

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Int using (Int; pos; negsuc)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_)

infix 4 _!=_ _<=N_ _<=Z_
infixr 3 _and_ _and1_
infixr 2 _or_
infix 2 _iff_ _iff1_

data Bottom : Set where

Not : Set -> Set
Not A =
  A -> Bottom

_!=_ : {A : Set} -> A -> A -> Set
x != y =
  Not (x == y)

record _and_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first-proof  : A
    second-proof : B

record _and1_ (A : Set) (B : Set1) : Set1 where
  constructor both1
  field
    first-proof1  : A
    second-proof1 : B

data _or_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  in-left  : A -> A or B
  in-right : B -> A or B

record _iff_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor equivalence
  field
    forward  : A -> B
    backward : B -> A

record _iff1_ (A : Set1) (B : Set) : Set1 where
  constructor equivalence1
  field
    forward1  : A -> B
    backward1 : B -> A

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

data _<=N_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set where
  zero<=N   : {n : Nat} -> zero <=N n
  suc<=sucN : {m n : Nat} -> m <=N n -> suc m <=N suc n

data _<=Z_ : Int -> Int -> Set where
  negative<=positive :
    {m n : Nat} ->
    negsuc m <=Z pos n
  positive<=positive :
    {m n : Nat} ->
    m <=N n ->
    pos m <=Z pos n
  negative<=negative :
    {m n : Nat} ->
    n <=N m ->
    negsuc m <=Z negsuc n

data Fin : Nat -> Set where
  fzero : {n : Nat} -> Fin (suc n)
  fsuc  : {n : Nat} -> Fin n -> Fin (suc n)

difference : Nat -> Nat -> Int
difference zero zero =
  pos zero
difference (suc m) zero =
  pos (suc m)
difference zero (suc n) =
  negsuc n
difference (suc m) (suc n) =
  difference m n

addInt : Int -> Int -> Int
addInt (pos m) (pos n) =
  pos (m + n)
addInt (pos m) (negsuc n) =
  difference m (suc n)
addInt (negsuc m) (pos n) =
  difference n (suc m)
addInt (negsuc m) (negsuc n) =
  negsuc (suc (m + n))

sumFinInt : {n : Nat} -> (Fin n -> Int) -> Int
sumFinInt {zero} terms =
  pos zero
sumFinInt {suc n} terms =
  addInt
    (terms fzero)
    (sumFinInt (\ index -> terms (fsuc index)))

record Vector : Set where
  constructor vector
  field
    first-coordinate  : Int
    second-coordinate : Int

open Vector

Grid : Vector -> Set
Grid v =
  (pos zero <=Z first-coordinate v
  and
  first-coordinate v <=Z pos 2)
  and
  (pos zero <=Z second-coordinate v
  and
  second-coordinate v <=Z pos 100)

EvenInt : Int -> Set
EvenInt integer =
  Exists Int
    (\ half -> integer == addInt half half)

Solution : Vector -> Set
Solution v =
  Exists Int
    (\ b ->
      (pos zero <=Z b
      and
      b <=Z pos 100)
      and
      EvenInt b
      and
      v == vector (pos 1) b)

record FiniteEnumeration
  (member : Vector -> Set)
  (cardinality : Nat) :
  Set where

  field
    element :
      Fin cardinality ->
      Vector

    element-member :
      (index : Fin cardinality) ->
      member (element index)

    enumeration-complete :
      (item : Vector) ->
      member item ->
      Exists (Fin cardinality)
        (\ index -> item == element index)

    enumeration-injective :
      (left-index right-index : Fin cardinality) ->
      element left-index == element right-index ->
      left-index == right-index

open FiniteEnumeration

firstSum :
  {member : Vector -> Set} ->
  {cardinality : Nat} ->
  FiniteEnumeration member cardinality ->
  Int
firstSum enumeration =
  sumFinInt
    (\ index -> first-coordinate (element enumeration index))

secondSum :
  {member : Vector -> Set} ->
  {cardinality : Nat} ->
  FiniteEnumeration member cardinality ->
  Int
secondSum enumeration =
  sumFinInt
    (\ index -> second-coordinate (element enumeration index))

record EqualPartition (omitted : Vector) : Set1 where
  field
    left-set  : Vector -> Set
    right-set : Vector -> Set

    exhaustive :
      (item : Vector) ->
      (left-set item or right-set item)
      iff
      (Grid item and item != omitted)

    disjoint :
      (item : Vector) ->
      left-set item ->
      right-set item ->
      Bottom

    common-cardinality : Nat

    left-enumeration :
      FiniteEnumeration left-set common-cardinality

    right-enumeration :
      FiniteEnumeration right-set common-cardinality

    equal-first-sums :
      firstSum left-enumeration ==
      firstSum right-enumeration

    equal-second-sums :
      secondSum left-enumeration ==
      secondSum right-enumeration

putnam-2018-b1 : Set1
putnam-2018-b1 =
  (v : Vector) ->
  (Grid v and1 EqualPartition v)
  iff1
  Solution v

  lattice set leaves a partition into equal-sized parts with equal vector
  sums. This file contains no proof.

val putnam_2018_b1 =

    in
      !v : int # int.
        (v IN lattice /\
         ?q r : (int # int) set.
           q UNION r = lattice DELETE v /\
           DISJOINT q r /\

           ITSET (\w acc. FST w + acc) q 0 =

$(

  putnam_2018_b1: classification of the integer vectors whose removal from
  the 3-by-101 integer grid leaves a partition into two sets of equal size
  and equal vector sum. This file contains no proof.

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  P18B1Grid is the set of integer ordered pairs (a,b) with 0 <= a <= 2
  and 0 <= b <= 100. Ordered pairs are definitionally equivalent to the
  source's two-coordinate integer vectors.

  The existential sets Q and R are disjoint, cover the grid with v removed,
  have equal finite cardinality, and have equal sums in both coordinates.
  The right side is exactly the source solution: v = (1,b) for an even
  integer b between 0 and 100. Substituting the source definitions of P and
  Pvdiff gives the displayed biconditional in both directions.

  Every declaration below is an unproved $a statement encoding; this
  database contains no $p proof declaration.
$)

$c P18B1Grid $.

p18b1-grid-syntax $a class P18B1Grid $.

p18b1-grid-definition $a |-
  P18B1Grid = ( ( 0 ... 2 ) X. ( 0 ... ; 1 0 0 ) ) $.

${
  $d b q r s t v $.

  putnambench-putnam-2018-b1 $a |- A. v e. ( ZZ X. ZZ )
    (
      (
        v e. P18B1Grid
        /\
        E. s e. ~P P18B1Grid
          E. t e. ~P P18B1Grid
            (
              ( s u. t ) = ( P18B1Grid \ { v } )
              /\
              (
                ( s i^i t ) = (/)
                /\
                (
                  ( # ` s ) = ( # ` t )
                  /\
                  (
                    (
                      sum_ q e. s ( 1st ` q )
                    )
                    =
                    (
                      sum_ r e. t ( 1st ` r )
                    )
                    /\
                    (
                      sum_ q e. s ( 2nd ` q )
                    )
                    =
                    (
                      sum_ r e. t ( 2nd ` r )
                    )
                  )
                )
              )
            )
      )
      <->
      E. b e. ( 0 ... ; 1 0 0 )
        (
          2 || b
          /\
          v = <. 1 , b >.
        )
    )
  $.
$}

content:
% Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2018_b1:
% the removable vectors in the 3 by 101 integer grid are exactly those with
% first coordinate 1 and an even second coordinate. This file contains no proof.

putnam_2018_b1: THEORY
BEGIN
  point: TYPE = [# x_coord: int, y_coord: int #]
  point_set: TYPE = [point -> bool]

  grid_point(p: point): bool =
    0 <= x_coord(p)
      AND x_coord(p) <= 2
      AND 0 <= y_coord(p)
      AND y_coord(p) <= 100

  grid_point_at(index: nat): point =
    (# x_coord := (ndiv(index, 101) :: int),
       y_coord := (mod(index, 101) :: int) #)

  member_count(S: point_set, count: nat): RECURSIVE nat =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      member_count(S, count - 1)
        + IF S(grid_point_at(count - 1)) THEN 1 ELSE 0 ENDIF
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  x_coordinate_sum(S: point_set, count: nat): RECURSIVE int =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      x_coordinate_sum(S, count - 1)
        + IF S(grid_point_at(count - 1))
            THEN x_coord(grid_point_at(count - 1))
            ELSE 0
          ENDIF
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  y_coordinate_sum(S: point_set, count: nat): RECURSIVE int =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      y_coordinate_sum(S, count - 1)
        + IF S(grid_point_at(count - 1))
            THEN y_coord(grid_point_at(count - 1))
            ELSE 0
          ENDIF
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  equal_partition_after_removal(v: point): bool =
    EXISTS (Q, R: point_set):
      (FORALL (p: point):
        (Q(p) OR R(p)) IFF (grid_point(p) AND p /= v))
      AND (FORALL (p: point):
        NOT (Q(p) AND R(p)))
      AND member_count(Q, 303) = member_count(R, 303)
      AND x_coordinate_sum(Q, 303) = x_coordinate_sum(R, 303)
      AND y_coordinate_sum(Q, 303) = y_coordinate_sum(R, 303)

  solution_point(v: point): bool =
    x_coord(v) = 1
      AND 0 <= y_coord(v)
      AND y_coord(v) <= 100
      AND EXISTS (k: int): y_coord(v) = 2 * k

  putnam_2018_b1: bool =
    FORALL (v: point):
      (grid_point(v) AND equal_partition_after_removal(v))
        IFF solution_point(v)
END putnam_2018_b1

content:
;; Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2018_b2:
;; for every positive integer n, the polynomial
;; n + (n-1)z + ... + z^(n-1) has no zero in the closed complex unit disk.
;; This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))

;; Writing z=x+i*y makes the disk condition and both components of the
;; polynomial value integer-polynomial sign conditions. For each fixed n, a
;; counterexample is therefore a first-order formula over real closed fields,
;; so a complex counterexample exists exactly when one exists with real
;; algebraic x and y.
;;
;; Every pair of real algebraic numbers lies in Q(alpha) for one real
;; algebraic alpha. A rational polynomial with a rational isolating interval
;; encodes alpha, and rational polynomials in alpha encode x and y. The
;; Sturm-Tarski queries below decide signs at alpha exactly. Thus universal
;; closure of the final predicate is bidirectionally equivalent to the source
;; quantification over all complex z; it does not restrict z to complex
;; rationals or to a finite carrier. The source's auxiliary f is eliminated
;; by substituting its defining polynomial equality.

;; Rational polynomials in alpha use descending coefficient order.

(defun putnam-2018-b2-rp-p (polynomial)
  (if (consp polynomial)
      (and (rationalp (car polynomial))
           (putnam-2018-b2-rp-p (cdr polynomial)))
    (equal polynomial nil)))

(defun putnam-2018-b2-rp-normalize (polynomial)
  (if (consp polynomial)
      (if (equal (car polynomial) 0)
          (putnam-2018-b2-rp-normalize (cdr polynomial))
        polynomial)
    nil))

(defun putnam-2018-b2-rp-neg (polynomial)
  (if (consp polynomial)
      (cons (- (car polynomial))
            (putnam-2018-b2-rp-neg (cdr polynomial)))
    nil))

(defun putnam-2018-b2-rp-add-raw (left right)
  (declare (xargs :measure (+ (acl2-count left) (acl2-count right))))
  (cond
   ((endp left) right)
   ((endp right) left)
   ((< (len left) (len right))
    (cons (car right)
          (putnam-2018-b2-rp-add-raw left (cdr right))))
   ((< (len right) (len left))
    (cons (car left)
          (putnam-2018-b2-rp-add-raw (cdr left) right)))
   (t
    (cons (+ (car left) (car right))
          (putnam-2018-b2-rp-add-raw
           (cdr left) (cdr right))))))

(defun putnam-2018-b2-rp-add (left right)
  (putnam-2018-b2-rp-normalize
   (putnam-2018-b2-rp-add-raw left right)))

(defun putnam-2018-b2-rp-sub (left right)
  (putnam-2018-b2-rp-add
   left (putnam-2018-b2-rp-neg right)))

(defun putnam-2018-b2-rp-scale (scalar polynomial)
  (if (consp polynomial)
      (cons (* scalar (car polynomial))
            (putnam-2018-b2-rp-scale scalar (cdr polynomial)))
    nil))

(defun putnam-2018-b2-zeroes (count)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix count)))
  (if (zp count)
      nil
    (cons 0 (putnam-2018-b2-zeroes (- count 1)))))

(defun putnam-2018-b2-rp-scale-shift (scalar polynomial shift)
  (append (putnam-2018-b2-rp-scale scalar polynomial)
          (putnam-2018-b2-zeroes shift)))

(defun putnam-2018-b2-rp-mul-raw (left right)
  (if (consp left)
      (putnam-2018-b2-rp-add
       (putnam-2018-b2-rp-scale-shift
        (car left) right (len (cdr left)))
       (putnam-2018-b2-rp-mul-raw (cdr left) right))
    nil))

(defun putnam-2018-b2-rp-mul (left right)
  (putnam-2018-b2-rp-normalize
   (putnam-2018-b2-rp-mul-raw left right)))

(defun putnam-2018-b2-rp-eval-aux
    (polynomial value accumulator)
  (if (consp polynomial)
      (putnam-2018-b2-rp-eval-aux
       (cdr polynomial)
       value
       (+ (* accumulator value) (car polynomial)))
    accumulator))

(defun putnam-2018-b2-rp-eval (polynomial value)
  (putnam-2018-b2-rp-eval-aux polynomial value 0))

(defun putnam-2018-b2-rp-derivative-aux
    (polynomial degree)
  (if (consp polynomial)
      (if (zp degree)
          nil
        (cons (* degree (car polynomial))
              (putnam-2018-b2-rp-derivative-aux
               (cdr polynomial) (- degree 1))))
    nil))

(defun putnam-2018-b2-rp-derivative (polynomial)
  (let ((polynomial
         (putnam-2018-b2-rp-normalize polynomial)))
    (putnam-2018-b2-rp-normalize
     (putnam-2018-b2-rp-derivative-aux
      polynomial (nfix (- (len polynomial) 1))))))

(defun putnam-2018-b2-rp-rem-fuel
    (dividend divisor fuel)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix fuel)))
  (let ((dividend
         (putnam-2018-b2-rp-normalize dividend))
        (divisor
         (putnam-2018-b2-rp-normalize divisor)))
    (if (or (zp fuel)
            (endp divisor)
            (< (len dividend) (len divisor)))
        dividend
      (putnam-2018-b2-rp-rem-fuel
       (putnam-2018-b2-rp-sub
        dividend
        (putnam-2018-b2-rp-scale-shift
         (/ (car dividend) (car divisor))
         divisor
         (- (len dividend) (len divisor))))
       divisor
       (- fuel 1)))))

(defun putnam-2018-b2-rp-rem (dividend divisor)
  (putnam-2018-b2-rp-rem-fuel
   dividend
   divisor
   (+ 1 (len (putnam-2018-b2-rp-normalize dividend)))))

(defun putnam-2018-b2-rp-sturm-tail
    (previous current fuel)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix fuel)))
  (let ((current (putnam-2018-b2-rp-normalize current)))
    (if (or (zp fuel) (endp current))
        nil
      (cons
       current
       (putnam-2018-b2-rp-sturm-tail
        current
        (putnam-2018-b2-rp-neg
         (putnam-2018-b2-rp-rem previous current))
        (- fuel 1))))))

(defun putnam-2018-b2-rp-sturm-sequence
    (polynomial second)
  (let ((polynomial
         (putnam-2018-b2-rp-normalize polynomial))
        (second
         (putnam-2018-b2-rp-normalize second)))
    (if (endp polynomial)
        nil
      (cons
       polynomial
       (if (endp second)
           nil
         (cons
          second
          (putnam-2018-b2-rp-sturm-tail
           polynomial
           second
           (+ 1 (len polynomial) (len second)))))))))

(defun putnam-2018-b2-rational-sign (value)
  (cond ((< value 0) -1)
        ((< 0 value) 1)
        (t 0)))

(defun putnam-2018-b2-rp-variations-aux
    (polynomials value previous-sign)
  (if (consp polynomials)
      (let ((sign
             (putnam-2018-b2-rational-sign
              (putnam-2018-b2-rp-eval
               (car polynomials) value))))
        (if (equal sign 0)
            (putnam-2018-b2-rp-variations-aux
             (cdr polynomials) value previous-sign)
          (+ (if (and (not (equal previous-sign 0))
                      (not (equal sign previous-sign)))
                 1
               0)
             (putnam-2018-b2-rp-variations-aux
              (cdr polynomials) value sign))))
    0))

(defun putnam-2018-b2-rp-variations
    (polynomials value)
  (putnam-2018-b2-rp-variations-aux
   polynomials value 0))

(defun putnam-2018-b2-rp-cauchy-index
    (polynomial second lower upper)
  (let ((sequence
         (putnam-2018-b2-rp-sturm-sequence
          polynomial second)))
    (- (putnam-2018-b2-rp-variations sequence lower)
       (putnam-2018-b2-rp-variations sequence upper))))

(defun putnam-2018-b2-rp-root-count
    (polynomial lower upper)
  (putnam-2018-b2-rp-cauchy-index
   polynomial
   (putnam-2018-b2-rp-derivative polynomial)
   lower
   upper))

(defun putnam-2018-b2-primitive-p
    (primitive lower upper)
  (and
   (putnam-2018-b2-rp-p primitive)
   (consp (putnam-2018-b2-rp-normalize primitive))
   (rationalp lower)
   (rationalp upper)
   (< lower upper)
   (not
    (equal
     (putnam-2018-b2-rp-eval primitive lower)
     0))
   (not
    (equal
     (putnam-2018-b2-rp-eval primitive upper)
     0))
   (equal
    (putnam-2018-b2-rp-root-count
     primitive lower upper)
    1)
   (not
    (equal
     (putnam-2018-b2-rp-cauchy-index
      primitive
      (putnam-2018-b2-rp-mul
       (putnam-2018-b2-rp-derivative primitive)
       (putnam-2018-b2-rp-derivative primitive))
      lower
      upper)
     0))))

;; For the isolated simple root alpha, this query is sign(P(alpha)).
(defun putnam-2018-b2-alg-sign
    (primitive lower upper polynomial)
  (putnam-2018-b2-rp-cauchy-index
   primitive
   (putnam-2018-b2-rp-mul
    (putnam-2018-b2-rp-derivative primitive)
    polynomial)
   lower
   upper))

(defun putnam-2018-b2-alg-zero-p
    (primitive lower upper polynomial)
  (equal
   (putnam-2018-b2-alg-sign
    primitive lower upper polynomial)
   0))

(defun putnam-2018-b2-alg-nonpositive-p
    (primitive lower upper polynomial)
  (<=
   (putnam-2018-b2-alg-sign
    primitive lower upper polynomial)
   0))

;; A complex algebraic expression is a pair of rational polynomials giving
;; its real and imaginary parts at alpha.

(defun putnam-2018-b2-cx-real (value)
  (car value))

(defun putnam-2018-b2-cx-imag (value)
  (cadr value))

(defun putnam-2018-b2-cx-add (left right)
  (list
   (putnam-2018-b2-rp-add
    (putnam-2018-b2-cx-real left)
    (putnam-2018-b2-cx-real right))
   (putnam-2018-b2-rp-add
    (putnam-2018-b2-cx-imag left)
    (putnam-2018-b2-cx-imag right))))

(defun putnam-2018-b2-cx-scale (scalar value)
  (list
   (putnam-2018-b2-rp-scale
    scalar (putnam-2018-b2-cx-real value))
   (putnam-2018-b2-rp-scale
    scalar (putnam-2018-b2-cx-imag value))))

(defun putnam-2018-b2-cx-mul (left right)
  (list
   (putnam-2018-b2-rp-sub
    (putnam-2018-b2-rp-mul
     (putnam-2018-b2-cx-real left)
     (putnam-2018-b2-cx-real right))
    (putnam-2018-b2-rp-mul
     (putnam-2018-b2-cx-imag left)
     (putnam-2018-b2-cx-imag right)))
   (putnam-2018-b2-rp-add
    (putnam-2018-b2-rp-mul
     (putnam-2018-b2-cx-real left)
     (putnam-2018-b2-cx-imag right))
    (putnam-2018-b2-rp-mul
     (putnam-2018-b2-cx-imag left)
     (putnam-2018-b2-cx-real right)))))

(defun putnam-2018-b2-polynomial-value-aux
    (z remaining power accumulator)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix remaining)))
  (if (zp remaining)
      accumulator
    (putnam-2018-b2-polynomial-value-aux
     z
     (- remaining 1)
     (putnam-2018-b2-cx-mul power z)
     (putnam-2018-b2-cx-add
      accumulator
      (putnam-2018-b2-cx-scale remaining power)))))

(defun putnam-2018-b2-polynomial-value (n x y)
  (putnam-2018-b2-polynomial-value-aux
   (list x y)
   n
   (list (list 1) nil)
   (list nil nil)))

(defun putnam-2018-b2-unit-disk-polynomial (x y)
  (putnam-2018-b2-rp-sub
   (putnam-2018-b2-rp-add
    (putnam-2018-b2-rp-mul x x)
    (putnam-2018-b2-rp-mul y y))
   (list 1)))

(defun putnambench-putnam-2018-b2-statement
    (n primitive lower upper x y)
  (let ((polynomial-value
         (putnam-2018-b2-polynomial-value n x y)))
    (implies
     (and
      (natp n)
      (< 0 n)
      (putnam-2018-b2-primitive-p primitive lower upper)
      (putnam-2018-b2-rp-p x)
      (putnam-2018-b2-rp-p y)
      (putnam-2018-b2-alg-nonpositive-p
       primitive lower upper
       (putnam-2018-b2-unit-disk-polynomial x y)))
     (not
      (and
       (putnam-2018-b2-alg-zero-p
        primitive lower upper
        (putnam-2018-b2-cx-real polynomial-value))
       (putnam-2018-b2-alg-zero-p
        primitive lower upper
        (putnam-2018-b2-cx-imag polynomial-value)))))))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

title: putnam_2018_b2
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2018_b2
-- (putnambench__agda__putnam_2018_b2): the polynomial with coefficients
-- n, n - 1, ..., 1 has no complex root in the closed unit disk when n is
-- positive. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module Putnam2018B2 where

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _-_)

infix 4 _!=_
infixr 3 _and_
infixr 2 _or_

data Bottom : Set where

Not : Set -> Set
Not A =
  A -> Bottom

_!=_ : {A : Set} -> A -> A -> Set
x != y =
  Not (x == y)

record _and_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data _or_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  left  : A -> A or B
  right : B -> A or B

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

data Positive : Nat -> Set where
  positive : (n : Nat) -> Positive (suc n)

data Fin : Nat -> Set where
  fzero : {n : Nat} -> Fin (suc n)
  fsuc  : {n : Nat} -> Fin n -> Fin (suc n)

finToNat : {n : Nat} -> Fin n -> Nat
finToNat fzero =
  zero
finToNat (fsuc i) =
  suc (finToNat i)

record CompleteOrderedRealField (R : Set) : Set1 where
  field
    zeroR oneR : R
    add multiply : R -> R -> R
    negate inverse squareRoot : R -> R
    lessOrEqual : R -> R -> Set
    fromNat : Nat -> R

    one-not-zero :
      oneR != zeroR

    add-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> add x y == add y x
    add-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      add (add x y) z == add x (add y z)
    add-zero :
      (x : R) -> add x zeroR == x
    add-inverse :
      (x : R) -> add x (negate x) == zeroR

    multiply-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> multiply x y == multiply y x
    multiply-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply (multiply x y) z ==
      multiply x (multiply y z)
    multiply-one :
      (x : R) -> multiply x oneR == x
    multiply-zero :
      (x : R) -> multiply x zeroR == zeroR
    distribute :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply x (add y z) ==
      add (multiply x y) (multiply x z)
    inverse-zero :
      inverse zeroR == zeroR
    multiply-inverse :
      (x : R) ->
      x != zeroR ->
      multiply x (inverse x) == oneR

    order-reflexive :
      (x : R) -> lessOrEqual x x
    order-transitive :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y z ->
      lessOrEqual x z
    order-antisymmetric :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y x ->
      x == y
    order-total :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y or lessOrEqual y x
    add-order :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual (add z x) (add z y)
    multiply-nonnegative :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR x ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR y ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR (multiply x y)
    zero-less-than-one :
      lessOrEqual zeroR oneR and zeroR != oneR

    fromNat-zero :
      fromNat zero == zeroR
    fromNat-successor :
      (n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (suc n) == add (fromNat n) oneR
    fromNat-addition :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (Agda.Builtin.Nat._+_ m n) ==
      add (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-multiplication :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (Agda.Builtin.Nat._*_ m n) ==
      multiply (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-injective :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat m == fromNat n ->
      m == n

    archimedean :
      (x : R) ->
      Exists Nat
        (\ n -> lessOrEqual x (fromNat n))
    least-upper-bound :
      (P : R -> Set) ->
      Exists R P ->
      Exists R
        (\ upper ->
          (x : R) ->
          P x ->
          lessOrEqual x upper) ->
      Exists R
        (\ supremum ->
          ((x : R) ->
            P x ->
            lessOrEqual x supremum)
          and
          ((upper : R) ->
            ((x : R) ->
              P x ->
              lessOrEqual x upper) ->
            lessOrEqual supremum upper))

    square-root-nonnegative :
      (x : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR (squareRoot x)
    square-root-square :
      (x : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR x ->
      multiply (squareRoot x) (squareRoot x) == x
    square-root-nonpositive :
      (x : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x zeroR ->
      squareRoot x == zeroR
    square-root-unique :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR y ->
      multiply y y == x ->
      y == squareRoot x

open CompleteOrderedRealField

square :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R
square reals x =
  multiply reals x x

record Complex (R : Set) : Set where
  constructor complex
  field
    realPart      : R
    imaginaryPart : R

open Complex

complexZero :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Complex R
complexZero reals =
  complex (zeroR reals) (zeroR reals)

complexOne :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Complex R
complexOne reals =
  complex (oneR reals) (zeroR reals)

complexFromNat :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Nat ->
  Complex R
complexFromNat reals n =
  complex (fromNat reals n) (zeroR reals)

complexAdd :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Complex R ->
  Complex R ->
  Complex R
complexAdd reals z w =
  complex
    (add reals (realPart z) (realPart w))
    (add reals (imaginaryPart z) (imaginaryPart w))

complexMultiply :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Complex R ->
  Complex R ->
  Complex R
complexMultiply reals z w =
  complex
    (add reals
      (multiply reals (realPart z) (realPart w))
      (negate reals
        (multiply reals (imaginaryPart z) (imaginaryPart w))))
    (add reals
      (multiply reals (realPart z) (imaginaryPart w))
      (multiply reals (imaginaryPart z) (realPart w)))

complexPower :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Complex R ->
  Nat ->
  Complex R
complexPower reals z zero =
  complexOne reals
complexPower reals z (suc n) =
  complexMultiply reals (complexPower reals z n) z

complexModulus :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Complex R ->
  R
complexModulus reals z =
  squareRoot reals
    (add reals
      (square reals (realPart z))
      (square reals (imaginaryPart z)))

sumFinComplex :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  {n : Nat} ->
  (Fin n -> Complex R) ->
  Complex R
sumFinComplex reals {zero} terms =
  complexZero reals
sumFinComplex reals {suc n} terms =
  complexAdd reals
    (terms fzero)
    (sumFinComplex reals (\ i -> terms (fsuc i)))

polynomialValue :
  {R : Set} ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) ->
  (n : Nat) ->
  Complex R ->
  Complex R
polynomialValue reals n z =
  sumFinComplex reals {n}
    (\ i ->
      complexMultiply reals
        (complexFromNat reals (n - finToNat i))
        (complexPower reals z (finToNat i)))

InClosedUnitDisk :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Complex R ->
  Set
InClosedUnitDisk reals z =
  lessOrEqual reals
    (complexModulus reals z)
    (oneR reals)

Putnam2018B2 :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Set
Putnam2018B2 {R} reals =
  (n : Nat) ->
  Positive n ->
  (z : Complex R) ->
  InClosedUnitDisk reals z ->
  polynomialValue reals n z != complexZero reals

putnam-2018-b2 : Set1
putnam-2018-b2 =
  (R : Set) ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) ->
  Putnam2018B2 reals

title: putnam_2018_b2
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2018_b2:
  the polynomial with coefficients n, n-1, ..., 1 has no complex root in
  the closed unit disk when n is positive. This file contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open arithmeticTheory pred_setTheory realTheory complexTheory;

val putnam_2018_b2 =
  ``!n : num.
      0 < n
      ==>
      let f_n =
        \z : complex.
          ITSET
            (\k acc.
               complex_of_real (&(n - k)) * z pow k + acc)
            (count n)
            (0 : complex)
      in
        !z : complex.
          modu z <= 1
          ==>
          f_n z <> 0``;

title: putnam_2018_b2
content:
$(
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact
  putnam_2018_b2: the polynomial n + (n-1)z + ... + z^(n-1)
  has no zero in the closed complex unit disk. This file contains no proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  NN is set.mm's class of positive integers, CC is the complex plane, abs
  is complex modulus, and 0 ..^ n is the coefficient index set
  {0,...,n-1}. For each such index i, natural subtraction n-i agrees with
  ordinary integer subtraction.

  Inlining the source equation for f(n,z) as the displayed finite sum is
  definitionally equivalent to quantifying over a function constrained by
  that equation. The final declaration is the single unproved $a corpus
  statement; this database contains no $p proof declaration.
$)

${
  $d i n z $.

  putnambench-putnam-2018-b2 $a |-
    A. n e. NN
      A. z e. CC
        (
          ( abs ` z ) <_ 1
          ->
          (
            sum_ i e. ( 0 ..^ n )
              (
                ( n - i )
                x.
                ( z ^ i )
              )
          )
          =/=
          0
        )
  $.
$}

begin

::$P-
theorem
  for n being Nat,

title: putnam_2018_b2
content:
% Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2018_b2:
% the polynomial n + (n - 1)z + ... + z^(n - 1) has no zero in the closed
% complex unit disk when n is positive. This file contains no proof.

putnam_2018_b2: THEORY
BEGIN
  complex: TYPE = [# real_part: real, imag_part: real #]

  complex_zero: complex =
    (# real_part := 0, imag_part := 0 #)

  complex_one: complex =
    (# real_part := 1, imag_part := 0 #)

  complex_of_nat(value: nat): complex =
    (# real_part := value, imag_part := 0 #)

  complex_add(x, y: complex): complex =
    (# real_part := real_part(x) + real_part(y),
       imag_part := imag_part(x) + imag_part(y) #)

  complex_mul(x, y: complex): complex =
    (# real_part := real_part(x) * real_part(y)
                       - imag_part(x) * imag_part(y),
       imag_part := real_part(x) * imag_part(y)
                       + imag_part(x) * real_part(y) #)

  complex_power(z: complex, exponent: nat): RECURSIVE complex =
    IF exponent = 0 THEN
      complex_one
    ELSE
      complex_mul(complex_power(z, exponent - 1), z)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE exponent

  polynomial_coefficient(n, i: nat): nat =
    IF i <= n THEN n - i ELSE 0 ENDIF

  weighted_polynomial_sum(
      n: nat,
      z: complex,
      count: nat): RECURSIVE complex =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      complex_zero
    ELSE
      LET i: nat = count - 1 IN
        complex_add(
          weighted_polynomial_sum(n, z, count - 1),
          complex_mul(
            complex_of_nat(polynomial_coefficient(n, i)),
            complex_power(z, i)))
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  polynomial_value(n: nat, z: complex): complex =
    weighted_polynomial_sum(n, z, n)

  in_closed_unit_disk(z: complex): bool =
    real_part(z) * real_part(z)
      + imag_part(z) * imag_part(z) <= 1

  putnam_2018_b2: bool =
    FORALL (n: nat):
      n > 0 IMPLIES
        FORALL (z: complex):
          in_closed_unit_disk(z) IMPLIES
            polynomial_value(n, z) /= complex_zero
END putnam_2018_b2

;; Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2018_b3:
;; the positive integers below 10^100 satisfying three simultaneous
;; divisibility conditions are exactly 2^2, 2^4, 2^16, and 2^256. This file
;; contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

;; This is integer divisibility, including the source-relevant zero-divisor
;; case: 0 divides a value exactly when that value is 0.
(defun putnam-2018-b3-divides-p (divisor value)
  (and
   (integerp divisor)
   (integerp value)
   (if (equal divisor 0)
       (equal value 0)
     (equal (mod value divisor) 0))))

(defun putnam-2018-b3-qualifying-p (n)
  (and
   (integerp n)
   (< 0 n)
   (< n (expt 10 100))
   (putnam-2018-b3-divides-p
    n
    (expt 2 n))
   (putnam-2018-b3-divides-p
    (- n 1)
    (- (expt 2 n) 1))
   (putnam-2018-b3-divides-p
    (- n 2)
    (- (expt 2 n) 2))))

(defun putnam-2018-b3-solution-member-p (n)
  (or
   (equal n (expt 2 2))
   (equal n (expt 2 4))
   (equal n (expt 2 16))
   (equal n (expt 2 256))))

;; ACL2 universally closes N. This pointwise IFF is the source set equality.
;; Isabelle uses N>3 instead of positivity; N=1,2,3 fail the displayed
;; divisibility conditions, so the two characterizations are equivalent.
(defun putnambench-putnam-2018-b3-statement (n)
  (implies
   (integerp n)
   (iff
    (putnam-2018-b3-qualifying-p n)
    (putnam-2018-b3-solution-member-p n))))

-- Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2018_b3
-- (putnambench__agda__putnam_2018_b3): the positive integers below 10^100
-- satisfying three divisibility conditions, characterized by four powers of 2.
-- This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module Putnam2018B3 where

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _-_; _*_)

infix 4 _<=N_ _<N_ _divides_
infixr 3 _and_
infixr 2 _or_

record _and_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data _or_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  left  : A -> A or B
  right : B -> A or B

record Iff (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor equivalence
  field
    forward  : A -> B
    backward : B -> A

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

data _<=N_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set where
  zero<=N   : {n : Nat} -> zero <=N n
  suc<=sucN : {m n : Nat} -> m <=N n -> suc m <=N suc n

_<N_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set
m <N n =
  suc m <=N n

_divides_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set
divisor divides dividend =
  Exists Nat
    (\ quotient ->
      divisor * quotient == dividend)

one : Nat
one =
  suc zero

two : Nat
two =
  suc one

power : Nat -> Nat -> Nat
power base zero =
  one
power base (suc exponent) =
  power base exponent * base

Positive : Nat -> Set
Positive n =
  one <=N n

Qualifies : Nat -> Set
Qualifies n =
  Positive n
  and
  n <N power 10 100
  and
  n divides power two n
  and
  (n - one) divides (power two n - one)
  and
  (n - two) divides (power two n - two)

Solution : Nat -> Set
Solution n =
  n == power two 2
  or
  n == power two 4
  or
  n == power two 16
  or
  n == power two 256

putnam-2018-b3 : Set
putnam-2018-b3 =
  (n : Nat) ->
  Iff (Qualifies n) (Solution n)

;; Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2018_b4:
;; a real sequence with the stated third-order recurrence is periodic if one
;; of its terms is zero. This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))

;; A real is represented by a rational regular Cauchy name. SEQUENCE maps a
;; natural index and a positive rational precision to a rational
;; approximation. FN-EQUAL supplies the unbounded universal quantifiers over
;; indices and precisions, so the values are genuine reals rather than a
;; rational-valued restriction or a finite table.
;;
;; The recurrence uniquely makes each term a nonzero integer polynomial in
;; a. Consequently, if any term is zero, then a is real algebraic, and the
;; entire recurrence-generated sequence has tame rational Cauchy names.
;; Conversely every accepted name denotes an actual real value. Hence every
;; possible source counterexample is represented even though ACL2 function
;; objects are syntactic.
;;
;; The recurrence comparison uses an adaptive precision. Approximations at
;; precision 1 bound the two factors, and the smaller precision then controls
;; the product error. Thus the rational inequalities below are equivalent to
;; the corresponding real equalities.
;;
;; A zero index and a positive period remain internal existential witnesses:
;; negated FN-EQUAL says that the associated failure predicate is not
;; identically true. Periodicity itself is checked at every natural index.

(defun putnam-2018-b4-quoted (object)
  (list 'quote object))

(defun putnam-2018-b4-term-list (terms)
  (if (consp terms)
      (list 'cons
            (car terms)
            (putnam-2018-b4-term-list (cdr terms)))
    nil))

(defun putnam-2018-b4-apply-term (function arguments)
  (list 'apply$
        (putnam-2018-b4-quoted function)
        (putnam-2018-b4-term-list arguments)))

(defun putnam-2018-b4-and-terms (terms)
  (if (consp terms)
      (list 'if
            (car terms)
            (putnam-2018-b4-and-terms (cdr terms))
            (putnam-2018-b4-quoted nil))
    (putnam-2018-b4-quoted t)))

(defun putnam-2018-b4-implies-term (hypothesis conclusion)
  (list 'if
        hypothesis
        conclusion
        (putnam-2018-b4-quoted t)))

(defun putnam-2018-b4-add-term (left right)
  (list 'binary-+ left right))

(defun putnam-2018-b4-negate-term (value)
  (list 'unary-- value))

(defun putnam-2018-b4-subtract-term (left right)
  (putnam-2018-b4-add-term
   left
   (putnam-2018-b4-negate-term right)))

(defun putnam-2018-b4-multiply-term (left right)
  (list 'binary-* left right))

(defun putnam-2018-b4-divide-term (numerator denominator)
  (putnam-2018-b4-multiply-term
   numerator
   (list 'unary-/ denominator)))

(defun putnam-2018-b4-absolute-term (value)
  (list 'if
        (list '< value 0)
        (putnam-2018-b4-negate-term value)
        value))

(defun putnam-2018-b4-less-equal-term (left right)
  (list 'if
        (list '< right left)
        (putnam-2018-b4-quoted nil)
        (putnam-2018-b4-quoted t)))

(defun putnam-2018-b4-minimum-term (left right)
  (list 'if
        (list '< left right)
        left
        right))

(defun putnam-2018-b4-positive-rational-term (value)
  (putnam-2018-b4-and-terms
   (list
    (list 'rationalp value)
    (list '< 0 value))))

(defun putnam-2018-b4-true-function (formals)
  (list 'lambda
        formals
        (putnam-2018-b4-quoted t)))

(defun putnam-2018-b4-real-value-term (name precision)
  (putnam-2018-b4-apply-term name (list precision)))

(defun putnam-2018-b4-sequence-value-term
    (sequence index precision)
  (putnam-2018-b4-apply-term
   sequence
   (list index precision)))

(defun putnam-2018-b4-real-cauchy-function (name)
  (let* ((left
          (putnam-2018-b4-real-value-term
           name 'epsilon))
         (right
          (putnam-2018-b4-real-value-term
           name 'eta))
         (distance
          (putnam-2018-b4-absolute-term
           (putnam-2018-b4-subtract-term left right))))
    (list
     'lambda
     '(epsilon eta)
     (putnam-2018-b4-implies-term
      (putnam-2018-b4-and-terms
       (list
        (putnam-2018-b4-positive-rational-term
         'epsilon)
        (putnam-2018-b4-positive-rational-term
         'eta)))
      (putnam-2018-b4-and-terms
       (list
        (list 'rationalp left)
        (list 'rationalp right)
        (putnam-2018-b4-less-equal-term
         distance
         (putnam-2018-b4-add-term
          'epsilon 'eta))))))))

(defun putnam-2018-b4-real-name-p (name)
  (and
   (tamep-functionp name)
   (fn-equal
    (putnam-2018-b4-real-cauchy-function name)
    (putnam-2018-b4-true-function
     '(epsilon eta)))))

(defun putnam-2018-b4-sequence-cauchy-function
    (sequence)
  (let* ((left
          (putnam-2018-b4-sequence-value-term
           sequence 'n 'epsilon))
         (right
          (putnam-2018-b4-sequence-value-term
           sequence 'n 'eta))
         (distance
          (putnam-2018-b4-absolute-term
           (putnam-2018-b4-subtract-term left right))))
    (list
     'lambda
     '(n epsilon eta)
     (putnam-2018-b4-implies-term
      (putnam-2018-b4-and-terms
       (list
        (list 'natp 'n)
        (putnam-2018-b4-positive-rational-term
         'epsilon)
        (putnam-2018-b4-positive-rational-term
         'eta)))
      (putnam-2018-b4-and-terms
       (list
        (list 'rationalp left)
        (list 'rationalp right)
        (putnam-2018-b4-less-equal-term
         distance
         (putnam-2018-b4-add-term
          'epsilon 'eta))))))))

(defun putnam-2018-b4-sequence-name-p (sequence)
  (and
   (tamep-functionp sequence)
   (fn-equal
    (putnam-2018-b4-sequence-cauchy-function
     sequence)
    (putnam-2018-b4-true-function
     '(n epsilon eta)))))

(defun putnam-2018-b4-sequence-equals-constant-function
    (sequence index constant)
  (let* ((precision
          (putnam-2018-b4-multiply-term
           1/4 'epsilon))
         (value
          (putnam-2018-b4-sequence-value-term
           sequence
           (putnam-2018-b4-quoted index)
           precision))
         (distance
          (putnam-2018-b4-absolute-term
           (putnam-2018-b4-subtract-term
            value
            (putnam-2018-b4-quoted constant)))))
    (list
     'lambda
     '(epsilon)
     (putnam-2018-b4-implies-term
      (putnam-2018-b4-positive-rational-term
       'epsilon)
      (putnam-2018-b4-and-terms
       (list
        (list 'rationalp value)
        (putnam-2018-b4-less-equal-term
         distance 'epsilon)))))))

(defun putnam-2018-b4-sequence-equals-constant-p
    (sequence index constant)
  (fn-equal
   (putnam-2018-b4-sequence-equals-constant-function
    sequence index constant)
   (putnam-2018-b4-true-function '(epsilon))))

(defun putnam-2018-b4-sequence-equals-real-function
    (sequence index real-name)
  (let* ((precision
          (putnam-2018-b4-multiply-term
           1/4 'epsilon))
         (sequence-value

-- Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2018_b4
-- (putnambench__agda__putnam_2018_b4): a real sequence satisfying the stated
-- third-order recurrence is periodic if one of its terms is zero. This file
-- contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module Putnam2018B4 where

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; _*_)

infix 4 _!=_
infixr 3 _and_
infixr 2 _or_

data Bottom : Set where

Not : Set -> Set
Not A =
  A -> Bottom

_!=_ : {A : Set} -> A -> A -> Set
x != y =
  Not (x == y)

record _and_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data _or_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  left  : A -> A or B
  right : B -> A or B

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

record CompleteOrderedRealField (R : Set) : Set1 where
  field
    zeroR oneR : R
    add multiply : R -> R -> R
    negate inverse : R -> R
    lessOrEqual : R -> R -> Set
    fromNat : Nat -> R

    one-not-zero :
      oneR != zeroR

    add-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> add x y == add y x
    add-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      add (add x y) z == add x (add y z)
    add-zero :
      (x : R) -> add x zeroR == x
    add-inverse :
      (x : R) -> add x (negate x) == zeroR

    multiply-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> multiply x y == multiply y x
    multiply-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply (multiply x y) z ==
      multiply x (multiply y z)
    multiply-one :
      (x : R) -> multiply x oneR == x
    multiply-zero :
      (x : R) -> multiply x zeroR == zeroR
    distribute :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply x (add y z) ==
      add (multiply x y) (multiply x z)
    inverse-zero :
      inverse zeroR == zeroR
    multiply-inverse :
      (x : R) ->
      x != zeroR ->
      multiply x (inverse x) == oneR

    order-reflexive :
      (x : R) -> lessOrEqual x x
    order-transitive :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y z ->
      lessOrEqual x z
    order-antisymmetric :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y x ->
      x == y
    order-total :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y or lessOrEqual y x
    add-order :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual (add z x) (add z y)
    multiply-nonnegative :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR x ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR y ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR (multiply x y)
    zero-less-than-one :
      lessOrEqual zeroR oneR and zeroR != oneR

    fromNat-zero :
      fromNat zero == zeroR
    fromNat-successor :
      (n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (suc n) == add (fromNat n) oneR
    fromNat-addition :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m + n) == add (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-multiplication :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m * n) == multiply (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-injective :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat m == fromNat n ->
      m == n

    archimedean :
      (x : R) ->
      Exists Nat
        (\ n -> lessOrEqual x (fromNat n))
    least-upper-bound :
      (P : R -> Set) ->
      Exists R P ->
      Exists R
        (\ upper ->
          (x : R) ->
          P x ->
          lessOrEqual x upper) ->
      Exists R
        (\ supremum ->
          ((x : R) ->
            P x ->
            lessOrEqual x supremum)
          and
          ((upper : R) ->
            ((x : R) ->
              P x ->
              lessOrEqual x upper) ->
            lessOrEqual supremum upper))

open CompleteOrderedRealField

subtract :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
subtract reals x y =
  add reals x (negate reals y)

oneN : Nat
oneN =
  suc zero

twoN : Nat
twoN =
  suc oneN

threeN : Nat
threeN =
  suc twoN

Positive : Nat -> Set
Positive n =
  Exists Nat
    (\ predecessor -> n == suc predecessor)

Recurrence :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  Set
Recurrence reals x =
  (n : Nat) ->
  x (n + threeN) ==
  subtract reals
    (multiply reals
      (multiply reals
        (fromNat reals twoN)
        (x (n + twoN)))
      (x (n + oneN)))
    (x n)

Periodic :
  {R : Set} ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  Nat ->
  Set
Periodic x period =
  (n : Nat) ->
  x (n + period) == x n

putnam-2018-b4 : Set1
putnam-2018-b4 =
  (R : Set) ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) ->
  (a : R) ->
  (x : Nat -> R) ->
  x zero == oneR reals ->
  x oneN == a ->
  x twoN == a ->
  Recurrence reals x ->
  Exists Nat
    (\ n -> x n == zeroR reals) ->
  Exists Nat
    (\ period ->
      Positive period
      and
      Periodic x period)

(*

  a real sequence with initial values 1, a, a and the specified third-order
  recurrence is periodic if one of its terms is zero. This file contains no
  proof.

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open arithmeticTheory realTheory;

val putnam_2018_b4 =
  ``!a : real. !x : num -> real.
      x 0 = 1 /\
      x 1 = a /\
      x 2 = a /\
      (!n : num.
         x (n + 3) =
           2 * x (n + 2) * x (n + 1) - x n) /\
      (?n : num. x n = 0)
      ==>
      ?c : num.
        0 < c /\
        !n : num. x (n + c) = x n``;

$(

  putnam_2018_b4: a real sequence satisfying the specified nonlinear
  recurrence is periodic if one of its terms is zero. This file contains no
  proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  RR ^m NN0 is SetMM's class of all real-valued sequences indexed by the
  nonnegative integers. The recurrence is shifted to n + 3 for n in NN0,
  exactly as in the primary Lean source, avoiding truncated subtraction while
  remaining equivalent to the n >= 2 formulations in Isabelle and Rocq.

  The zero term remains internally existentially quantified. The period
  witness c ranges over NN, SetMM's positive integers, and the final universal
  equality is exactly periodicity on every nonnegative index.

  The final declaration is the single unproved $a corpus statement; this
  database contains no $p proof declaration.
$)

${
  $d a c n x $.

  putnambench-putnam-2018-b4 $a |-
    A. a e. RR A. x e. ( RR ^m NN0 )
      (
        (
          (
            (
              ( x ` 0 ) = 1
              /\
              (
                ( x ` 1 ) = a
                /\
                ( x ` 2 ) = a
              )
            )
            /\
            A. n e. NN0
              ( x ` ( n + 3 ) )
              =
              (
                (
                  2
                  x.
                  ( x ` ( n + 2 ) )
                )
                x.
                ( x ` ( n + 1 ) )
              )
              -
              ( x ` n )
          )
          ->
          (
            E. n e. NN0
              ( x ` n ) = 0
            ->
            E. c e. NN
              A. n e. NN0
                ( x ` ( n + c ) ) = ( x ` n )
          )
        )
      )
  $.
$}

% Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2018_b4:
% a real sequence beginning with 1, a, a and satisfying the stated third-order
% recurrence is periodic if one of its terms is zero. This file contains no proof.

putnam_2018_b4: THEORY
BEGIN
  real_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> real]

  putnam_2018_b4: bool =
    FORALL (a: real), (x: real_sequence):
      (x(0) = 1
        AND x(1) = a
        AND x(2) = a
        AND (FORALL (n: nat):
          x(n + 3) = 2 * x(n + 2) * x(n + 1) - x(n))
        AND (EXISTS (n: nat): x(n) = 0))
      IMPLIES
        EXISTS (period: nat):
          period > 0
            AND (FORALL (n: nat):
              x(n + period) = x(n))
END putnam_2018_b4

import Mathlib

open Function

/--
Let $f=(f_1,f_2)$ be a function from $\mathbb{R}^2$ to $\mathbb{R}^2$ with continuous partial derivatives $\frac{\partial f_i}{\partial x_j}$ that are positive everywhere. Suppose that $\frac{\partial f_1}{\partial x_1} \frac{\partial f_2}{\partial x_2}-\frac{1}{4}\left(\frac{\partial f_1}{\partial x_2}+\frac{\partial f_2}{\partial x_1}\right)^2>0$ everywhere. Prove that $f$ is one-to-one.
-/
theorem putnam_2018_b5
    (f : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → (Fin 2 → ℝ))
    (h₁ : ContDiff ℝ 1 f)
    (h₂ : ∀ x i j, 0 < fderiv ℝ f x (Pi.single i 1) j)
    (h₃ : ∀ x, 0 < fderiv ℝ f x ![1, 0] 0 * fderiv ℝ f x ![0, 1] 1 -
      (1 / 4) * (fderiv ℝ f x ![1, 0] 1 + fderiv ℝ f x ![0, 1] 0) ^ 2) :
    Injective f :=
  sorry

(* Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2018_b5:
   a continuously differentiable map from the real plane to itself with
   positive partial derivatives and the stated pointwise derivative inequality
   is injective; this file contains no proof. *)

From Stdlib Require Import
  Reals
  ClassicalEpsilon.

Open Scope R_scope.

Definition putnam_2018_b5_vector : Type := (R * R)%type.

Definition putnam_2018_b5_real_derivative
    (g : R -> R) (x : R) : R :=
  epsilon (inhabits (0 : R))
    (fun d : R => derivable_pt_lim g x d).

Definition putnam_2018_b5_d11
    (f : putnam_2018_b5_vector -> putnam_2018_b5_vector)
    (p : putnam_2018_b5_vector) : R :=
  putnam_2018_b5_real_derivative
    (fun x : R => fst (f (x, snd p)))
    (fst p).

Definition putnam_2018_b5_d12
    (f : putnam_2018_b5_vector -> putnam_2018_b5_vector)
    (p : putnam_2018_b5_vector) : R :=
  putnam_2018_b5_real_derivative
    (fun y : R => fst (f (fst p, y)))
    (snd p).

Definition putnam_2018_b5_d21
    (f : putnam_2018_b5_vector -> putnam_2018_b5_vector)
    (p : putnam_2018_b5_vector) : R :=
  putnam_2018_b5_real_derivative
    (fun x : R => snd (f (x, snd p)))
    (fst p).

Definition putnam_2018_b5_d22
    (f : putnam_2018_b5_vector -> putnam_2018_b5_vector)
    (p : putnam_2018_b5_vector) : R :=
  putnam_2018_b5_real_derivative
    (fun y : R => snd (f (fst p, y)))
    (snd p).

Definition putnam_2018_b5_continuous_plane
    (g : putnam_2018_b5_vector -> R) : Prop :=
  forall p : putnam_2018_b5_vector,
    forall eps : R,
      eps > 0 ->
      exists delta : R,
        delta > 0 /\
        forall q : putnam_2018_b5_vector,
          Rabs (fst q - fst p) < delta ->
          Rabs (snd q - snd p) < delta ->
          Rabs (g q - g p) < eps.

Definition putnam_2018_b5_contdiff_one
    (f : putnam_2018_b5_vector -> putnam_2018_b5_vector) : Prop :=
  (forall p : putnam_2018_b5_vector,
    derivable_pt_lim
      (fun x : R => fst (f (x, snd p)))
      (fst p)
      (putnam_2018_b5_d11 f p) /\
    derivable_pt_lim
      (fun y : R => fst (f (fst p, y)))
      (snd p)
      (putnam_2018_b5_d12 f p) /\
    derivable_pt_lim
      (fun x : R => snd (f (x, snd p)))
      (fst p)
      (putnam_2018_b5_d21 f p) /\
    derivable_pt_lim
      (fun y : R => snd (f (fst p, y)))
      (snd p)
      (putnam_2018_b5_d22 f p)) /\
  putnam_2018_b5_continuous_plane (putnam_2018_b5_d11 f) /\
  putnam_2018_b5_continuous_plane (putnam_2018_b5_d12 f) /\
  putnam_2018_b5_continuous_plane (putnam_2018_b5_d21 f) /\
  putnam_2018_b5_continuous_plane (putnam_2018_b5_d22 f).

Theorem putnam_2018_b5
    (f : putnam_2018_b5_vector -> putnam_2018_b5_vector)
    (hf : putnam_2018_b5_contdiff_one f)
    (hpositive :
      forall p : putnam_2018_b5_vector,
        0 < putnam_2018_b5_d11 f p /\
        0 < putnam_2018_b5_d12 f p /\
        0 < putnam_2018_b5_d21 f p /\
        0 < putnam_2018_b5_d22 f p)
    (hinequality :
      forall p : putnam_2018_b5_vector,
        0 <
        putnam_2018_b5_d11 f p * putnam_2018_b5_d22 f p -
        (1 / 4) *
          (putnam_2018_b5_d12 f p + putnam_2018_b5_d21 f p) ^ 2) :
  forall p q : putnam_2018_b5_vector,
    f p = f q ->
    p = q.
Admitted.
