theory putnam_2018_b5 imports
Complex_Main
"HOL-Analysis.Finite_Cartesian_Product"
"HOL-Analysis.Derivative"
begin

theorem putnam_2018_b5:
  fixes f :: "real \<Rightarrow> real \<Rightarrow> real^2"
  and f11 f12 f21 f22 :: "real \<Rightarrow> real \<Rightarrow> real"
  defines "f11 \<equiv> \<lambda>x2 x1. (f x1 x2)$0"
  and "f12 \<equiv> \<lambda>x1 x2. (f x1 x2)$0"
  and "f21 \<equiv> \<lambda>x2 x1. (f x1 x2)$1"
  and "f22 \<equiv> \<lambda>x1 x2. (f x1 x2)$1"
  assumes fdiff: "\<forall>x::real.
    f11 x differentiable_on UNIV \<and>
    f12 x differentiable_on UNIV \<and>
    f21 x differentiable_on UNIV \<and>
    f22 x differentiable_on UNIV"
  and fderivcont:
    "continuous_on UNIV (\<lambda>p::real\<times>real. deriv (f11 (snd p)) (fst p)) \<and>
     continuous_on UNIV (\<lambda>p::real\<times>real. deriv (f12 (fst p)) (snd p)) \<and>
     continuous_on UNIV (\<lambda>p::real\<times>real. deriv (f21 (snd p)) (fst p)) \<and>
     continuous_on UNIV (\<lambda>p::real\<times>real. deriv (f22 (fst p)) (snd p))"
  and fpos: "\<forall>x1 x2 :: real.
    deriv (f11 x2) x1 > 0 \<and>
    deriv (f12 x1) x2 > 0 \<and>
    deriv (f21 x2) x1 > 0 \<and>
    deriv (f22 x1) x2 > 0"
  and fexprgrt0: "\<forall>x1 x2 :: real.
    deriv (f11 x2) x1 * deriv (f22 x1) x2 -
      (1 / 4) * (deriv (f12 x1) x2 + deriv (f21 x2) x1)^2 > 0"
  shows "inj (\<lambda>(a, b). f a b)"
  sorry

end

title: putnam_2018_b5
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2018_b5
  (putnambench__hol-light__putnam_2018_b5): a continuously differentiable
  map from the real plane to itself is injective under positivity of all first
  partial derivatives and the stated pointwise quadratic inequality. This
  file contains no proof.
*)

let statement =
  `let coordinate =
     \(i:num) (p:real#real).
       if i = 1 then FST p else SND p in
   let replace_coordinate =
     \(p:real#real) (i:num) (t:real).
       if i = 1 then (t,SND p) else (FST p,t) in
   let has_derivative_at =
     \(g:real->real) (d:real) (x:real).
       !e:real.
         &0 < e
         ==> ?delta:real.
               &0 < delta /\
               !y:real.
                 &0 < abs (y - x) /\ abs (y - x) < delta
                 ==> abs ((g y - g x) / (y - x) - d) < e in
   let continuous_on_plane =
     \(g:(real#real)->real).
       !p:real#real. !e:real.
         &0 < e
         ==> ?delta:real.
               &0 < delta /\
               !q:real#real.
                 abs (FST q - FST p) < delta /\
                 abs (SND q - SND p) < delta
                 ==> abs (g q - g p) < e in
   let partial =
     \(f:(real#real)->(real#real)) (i:num) (j:num) (p:real#real).
       @d:real.
         has_derivative_at
           (\t:real.
              coordinate i (f (replace_coordinate p j t)))
           d (coordinate j p) in
   let continuously_differentiable =
     \(f:(real#real)->(real#real)).
       !i j:num.
         1 <= i /\ i <= 2 /\ 1 <= j /\ j <= 2
         ==>
         (!p:real#real.
            has_derivative_at
              (\t:real.
                 coordinate i (f (replace_coordinate p j t)))
              (partial f i j p) (coordinate j p)) /\
         continuous_on_plane (partial f i j) in
   !f:(real#real)->(real#real).
     continuously_differentiable f /\
     (!p:real#real. !i j:num.
        1 <= i /\ i <= 2 /\ 1 <= j /\ j <= 2
        ==> &0 < partial f i j p) /\
     (!p:real#real.
        &0 <
        partial f 1 1 p * partial f 2 2 p -
        (&1 / &4) *
        (partial f 1 2 p + partial f 2 1 p) pow 2)
     ==>
     !p q:real#real. f p = f q ==> p = q`;;

title: putnam_2018_b5
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2018_b5:
;; a continuously differentiable map from the real plane to itself, with all
;; four partial derivatives positive and the stated strict Jacobian
;; inequality everywhere, is one-to-one. This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))

;; The scalar arguments present the reals as a Dedekind-complete ordered
;; field. The two component functions present an arbitrary map R^2 -> R^2,
;; and DEFUN-SK keeps all four partial-derivative functions and every
;; mathematical quantifier internal to the statement. Continuous Frechet
;; differentiability is expanded below using the max norm on R^2, which is
;; equivalent to the Euclidean norm used by the source.

(defun p18b5-member-p (carrier x)
  (if (apply$ carrier (list x)) t nil))

(defun p18b5-unary (operation x)
  (apply$ operation (list x)))

(defun p18b5-binary (operation x y)
  (apply$ operation (list x y)))

(defun p18b5-function-value (function x y)
  (apply$ function (list x y)))

(defun-sk p18b5-field-laws-p
    (carrier add multiply negate inverse zero one)
  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and (p18b5-member-p carrier x)
          (p18b5-member-p carrier y)
          (p18b5-member-p carrier z))
     (and
      (p18b5-member-p carrier
                      (p18b5-binary add x y))
      (p18b5-member-p carrier
                      (p18b5-binary multiply x y))
      (p18b5-member-p carrier
                      (p18b5-unary negate x))
      (p18b5-member-p carrier
                      (p18b5-unary inverse x))
      (equal
       (p18b5-binary add (p18b5-binary add x y) z)
       (p18b5-binary add x (p18b5-binary add y z)))
      (equal (p18b5-binary add x y)
             (p18b5-binary add y x))
      (equal (p18b5-binary add x zero) x)
      (equal
       (p18b5-binary add x (p18b5-unary negate x))
       zero)
      (equal
       (p18b5-binary multiply
                       (p18b5-binary multiply x y) z)
       (p18b5-binary multiply
                       x (p18b5-binary multiply y z)))
      (equal (p18b5-binary multiply x y)
             (p18b5-binary multiply y x))
      (equal (p18b5-binary multiply x one) x)
      (implies
       (equal x zero)
       (equal (p18b5-unary inverse x) zero))
      (implies
       (not (equal x zero))
       (equal
        (p18b5-binary multiply
                      x (p18b5-unary inverse x))
        one))
      (equal
       (p18b5-binary multiply
                     x (p18b5-binary add y z))
       (p18b5-binary add
                     (p18b5-binary multiply x y)
                     (p18b5-binary multiply x z)))))))

(defun-sk p18b5-order-laws-p
    (carrier add multiply zero less)
  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and (p18b5-member-p carrier x)
          (p18b5-member-p carrier y)
          (p18b5-member-p carrier z))
     (and
      (not (p18b5-binary less x x))
      (or (equal x y)
          (p18b5-binary less x y)
          (p18b5-binary less y x))
      (implies
       (and (p18b5-binary less x y)
            (p18b5-binary less y z))
       (p18b5-binary less x z))
      (implies
       (p18b5-binary less x y)
       (p18b5-binary
        less
        (p18b5-binary add x z)
        (p18b5-binary add y z)))
      (implies
       (and (p18b5-binary less zero x)
            (p18b5-binary less zero y))
       (p18b5-binary
        less zero (p18b5-binary multiply x y)))))))

(defun-sk p18b5-set-nonempty-p (carrier set)
  (exists (x)
    (and (p18b5-member-p carrier x)
         (apply$ set (list x)))))

(defun-sk p18b5-upper-bound-p (carrier less set bound)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (and (p18b5-member-p carrier x)
          (apply$ set (list x)))
     (not (p18b5-binary less bound x)))))

(defun-sk p18b5-bounded-above-p (carrier less set)
  (exists (bound)
    (and (p18b5-member-p carrier bound)
         (p18b5-upper-bound-p carrier less set bound))))

(defun-sk p18b5-supremum-p (carrier less set supremum)
  (forall (bound)
    (and
     (p18b5-member-p carrier supremum)
     (p18b5-upper-bound-p carrier less set supremum)
     (implies
      (and (p18b5-member-p carrier bound)
           (p18b5-upper-bound-p carrier less set bound))
      (not (p18b5-binary less bound supremum))))))

(defun-sk p18b5-has-supremum-p (carrier less set)
  (exists (supremum)
    (p18b5-supremum-p carrier less set supremum)))

(defun-sk p18b5-dedekind-complete-p (carrier less)
  (forall (set)
    (implies
     (and (tamep-functionp set)
          (p18b5-set-nonempty-p carrier set)
          (p18b5-bounded-above-p carrier less set))
     (p18b5-has-supremum-p carrier less set))))

(defun p18b5-real-field-p
    (carrier add multiply negate inverse zero one less)
  (and
   (tamep-functionp carrier)
   (tamep-functionp add)
   (tamep-functionp multiply)
   (tamep-functionp negate)
   (tamep-functionp inverse)
   (tamep-functionp less)
   (p18b5-member-p carrier zero)
   (p18b5-member-p carrier one)
   (not (equal zero one))
   (p18b5-field-laws-p
    carrier add multiply negate inverse zero one)
   (p18b5-order-laws-p carrier add multiply zero less)
   (p18b5-binary less zero one)
   (p18b5-dedekind-complete-p carrier less)))

(defun p18b5-add (add x y)
  (p18b5-binary add x y))

(defun p18b5-negate (negate x)
  (p18b5-unary negate x))

(defun p18b5-subtract (add negate x y)
  (p18b5-add add x (p18b5-negate negate y)))

(defun p18b5-multiply (multiply x y)
  (p18b5-binary multiply x y))

(defun p18b5-less-p (less x y)
  (if (p18b5-binary less x y) t nil))

(defun p18b5-less-equal-p (less x y)
  (not (p18b5-less-p less y x)))

(defun p18b5-absolute-value (less negate zero x)
  (if (p18b5-less-p less x zero)
      (p18b5-negate negate x)
    x))

(defun p18b5-positive-p (carrier less zero x)
  (and (p18b5-member-p carrier x)
       (p18b5-less-p less zero x)))

(defun p18b5-max (less x y)
  (if (p18b5-less-p less x y) y x))

(defun p18b5-plane-distance
    (less negate zero x-step y-step)
  (p18b5-max
   less
   (p18b5-absolute-value less negate zero x-step)
   (p18b5-absolute-value less negate zero y-step)))

(defun-sk p18b5-bivariate-real-function-p (carrier function)
  (forall (x y)
    (implies
     (and (p18b5-member-p carrier x)
          (p18b5-member-p carrier y))
     (p18b5-member-p
      carrier (p18b5-function-value function x y)))))

(defun p18b5-valid-bivariate-function-p (carrier function)
  (and (tamep-functionp function)
       (p18b5-bivariate-real-function-p carrier function)))

;; A linear functional on R^2 is represented by its values on (1,0) and
;; (0,1). The following residual condition is the Frechet derivative
;; definition in the max norm.

(defun p18b5-derivative-residual
    (function x-derivative y-derivative
     add multiply negate x y x-step y-step)
  (p18b5-subtract
   add negate
   (p18b5-subtract
    add negate
    (p18b5-function-value
     function
     (p18b5-add add x x-step)
     (p18b5-add add y y-step))
    (p18b5-function-value function x y))
   (p18b5-add
    add
    (p18b5-multiply
     multiply
     (p18b5-function-value x-derivative x y)
     x-step)
    (p18b5-multiply
     multiply
     (p18b5-function-value y-derivative x y)
     y-step))))

(defun-sk p18b5-frechet-neighborhood-p
    (carrier function x-derivative y-derivative
     add multiply negate zero less
     x y epsilon delta)
  (forall (x-step y-step)
    (implies
     (and
      (p18b5-member-p carrier x-step)
      (p18b5-member-p carrier y-step)
      (p18b5-less-p
       less
       (p18b5-plane-distance
        less negate zero x-step y-step)
       delta))
     (p18b5-less-equal-p
      less
      (p18b5-absolute-value
       less negate zero
       (p18b5-derivative-residual
        function x-derivative y-derivative
        add multiply negate x y x-step y-step))
      (p18b5-multiply
       multiply epsilon
       (p18b5-plane-distance
        less negate zero x-step y-step))))))

(defun-sk p18b5-frechet-radius-exists-p
    (carrier function x-derivative y-derivative
     add multiply negate zero less x y epsilon)
  (exists (delta)
    (and
     (p18b5-positive-p carrier less zero delta)
     (p18b5-frechet-neighborhood-p
      carrier function x-derivative y-derivative
      add multiply negate zero less
      x y epsilon delta))))

(defun-sk p18b5-has-frechet-derivative-at-p
    (carrier function x-derivative y-derivative
     add multiply negate zero less x y)
  (forall (epsilon)
    (implies
     (p18b5-positive-p carrier less zero epsilon)
     (p18b5-frechet-radius-exists-p
      carrier function x-derivative y-derivative
      add multiply negate zero less x y epsilon))))

(defun-sk p18b5-everywhere-frechet-differentiable-p
    (carrier function x-derivative y-derivative
     add multiply negate zero less)
  (forall (x y)
    (implies
     (and (p18b5-member-p carrier x)
          (p18b5-member-p carrier y))
     (p18b5-has-frechet-derivative-at-p
      carrier function x-derivative y-derivative
      add multiply negate zero less x y))))

;; Joint continuity of both derivative coordinates is equivalent, in finite
;; dimension, to continuity of the derivative as a continuous linear map.

(defun-sk p18b5-derivative-continuity-neighborhood-p
    (carrier x-derivative y-derivative
     add negate zero less x y epsilon delta)
  (forall (x-step y-step)
    (implies
     (and
      (p18b5-member-p carrier x-step)
      (p18b5-member-p carrier y-step)
      (p18b5-less-p
       less
       (p18b5-plane-distance
        less negate zero x-step y-step)
       delta))
     (and
      (p18b5-less-p
       less
       (p18b5-absolute-value
        less negate zero
        (p18b5-subtract
         add negate
         (p18b5-function-value
          x-derivative
          (p18b5-add add x x-step)
          (p18b5-add add y y-step))
         (p18b5-function-value x-derivative x y)))
       epsilon)
      (p18b5-less-p
       less
       (p18b5-absolute-value
        less negate zero
        (p18b5-subtract
         add negate
         (p18b5-function-value
          y-derivative
          (p18b5-add add x x-step)
          (p18b5-add add y y-step))
         (p18b5-function-value y-derivative x y)))
       epsilon)))))

(defun-sk p18b5-derivative-continuity-radius-exists-p
    (carrier x-derivative y-derivative
     add negate zero less x y epsilon)
  (exists (delta)
    (and
     (p18b5-positive-p carrier less zero delta)
     (p18b5-derivative-continuity-neighborhood-p
      carrier x-derivative y-derivative
      add negate zero less x y epsilon delta))))

(defun-sk p18b5-derivative-pair-continuous-at-p
    (carrier x-derivative y-derivative
     add negate zero less x y)
  (forall (epsilon)
    (implies
     (p18b5-positive-p carrier less zero epsilon)
     (p18b5-derivative-continuity-radius-exists-p
      carrier x-derivative y-derivative
      add negate zero less x y epsilon))))

(defun-sk p18b5-derivative-pair-continuous-p
    (carrier x-derivative y-derivative
     add negate zero less)
  (forall (x y)
    (implies
     (and (p18b5-member-p carrier x)
          (p18b5-member-p carrier y))
     (p18b5-derivative-pair-continuous-at-p
      carrier x-derivative y-derivative
      add negate zero less x y))))

(defun p18b5-continuously-differentiable-p
    (carrier function x-derivative y-derivative
     add multiply negate zero less)
  (and
   (p18b5-valid-bivariate-function-p
    carrier x-derivative)
   (p18b5-valid-bivariate-function-p
    carrier y-derivative)
   (p18b5-everywhere-frechet-differentiable-p
    carrier function x-derivative y-derivative
    add multiply negate zero less)
   (p18b5-derivative-pair-continuous-p
    carrier x-derivative y-derivative
    add negate zero less)))

(defun p18b5-square (multiply x)
  (p18b5-multiply multiply x x))

(defun p18b5-two (add one)
  (p18b5-add add one one))

(defun p18b5-four (add one)
  (let ((two (p18b5-two add one)))
    (p18b5-add add two two)))

(defun p18b5-quarter (add inverse one)
  (p18b5-unary inverse (p18b5-four add one)))

(defun p18b5-jacobian-condition-at-p
    (carrier f1-x f1-y f2-x f2-y
     add multiply negate inverse zero one less x y)
  (let* ((j11 (p18b5-function-value f1-x x y))
         (j12 (p18b5-function-value f1-y x y))
         (j21 (p18b5-function-value f2-x x y))
         (j22 (p18b5-function-value f2-y x y))
         (diagonal-product
          (p18b5-multiply multiply j11 j22))
         (off-diagonal-sum
          (p18b5-add add j12 j21))
         (correction
          (p18b5-multiply
           multiply
           (p18b5-quarter add inverse one)
           (p18b5-square multiply off-diagonal-sum)))
         (gap
          (p18b5-subtract
           add negate diagonal-product correction)))
    (and
     (p18b5-positive-p carrier less zero j11)
     (p18b5-positive-p carrier less zero j12)
     (p18b5-positive-p carrier less zero j21)
     (p18b5-positive-p carrier less zero j22)
     (p18b5-positive-p carrier less zero gap))))

(defun-sk p18b5-jacobian-conditions-p
    (carrier f1-x f1-y f2-x f2-y
     add multiply negate inverse zero one less)
  (forall (x y)
    (implies
     (and (p18b5-member-p carrier x)
          (p18b5-member-p carrier y))
     (p18b5-jacobian-condition-at-p
      carrier f1-x f1-y f2-x f2-y
      add multiply negate inverse zero one less x y))))

;; These four internal witnesses are the uniquely determined coordinate
;; values of the Frechet derivatives of the two component functions.
(defun-sk p18b5-source-hypotheses-p
    (carrier first-component second-component
     add multiply negate inverse zero one less)
  (exists (f1-x f1-y f2-x f2-y)
    (and
     (p18b5-continuously-differentiable-p
      carrier first-component f1-x f1-y
      add multiply negate zero less)
     (p18b5-continuously-differentiable-p
      carrier second-component f2-x f2-y
      add multiply negate zero less)
     (p18b5-jacobian-conditions-p
      carrier f1-x f1-y f2-x f2-y
      add multiply negate inverse zero one less))))

(defun-sk p18b5-injective-p
    (carrier first-component second-component)
  (forall (x1 y1 x2 y2)
    (implies
     (and
      (p18b5-member-p carrier x1)
      (p18b5-member-p carrier y1)
      (p18b5-member-p carrier x2)
      (p18b5-member-p carrier y2)
      (equal
       (p18b5-function-value first-component x1 y1)
       (p18b5-function-value first-component x2 y2))
      (equal
       (p18b5-function-value second-component x1 y1)
       (p18b5-function-value second-component x2 y2)))
     (and (equal x1 x2)
          (equal y1 y2)))))

(defun putnambench-putnam-2018-b5-statement
    (carrier add multiply negate inverse zero one less
     first-component second-component)
  (implies
   (and
    (p18b5-real-field-p
     carrier add multiply negate inverse zero one less)
    (p18b5-valid-bivariate-function-p
     carrier first-component)
    (p18b5-valid-bivariate-function-p
     carrier second-component)
    (p18b5-source-hypotheses-p
     carrier first-component second-component
     add multiply negate inverse zero one less))
   (p18b5-injective-p
    carrier first-component second-component)))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

title: putnam_2018_b5
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2018_b5
-- (putnambench__agda__putnam_2018_b5): a continuously differentiable map
-- from the real plane to itself whose positive partial derivatives satisfy
-- the stated quadratic inequality is injective. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module Putnam2018B5 where

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; _*_)

infix 4 _!=_
infixr 3 _and_
infixr 2 _or_

data Bottom : Set where

Not : Set -> Set
Not A =
  A -> Bottom

_!=_ : {A : Set} -> A -> A -> Set
x != y =
  Not (x == y)

record _and_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data _or_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  left  : A -> A or B
  right : B -> A or B

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

record CompleteOrderedRealField (R : Set) : Set1 where
  field
    zeroR oneR : R
    add multiply : R -> R -> R
    negate inverse : R -> R
    lessOrEqual : R -> R -> Set
    fromNat : Nat -> R

    one-not-zero :
      oneR != zeroR

    add-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> add x y == add y x
    add-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      add (add x y) z == add x (add y z)
    add-zero :
      (x : R) -> add x zeroR == x
    add-inverse :
      (x : R) -> add x (negate x) == zeroR

    multiply-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> multiply x y == multiply y x
    multiply-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply (multiply x y) z ==
      multiply x (multiply y z)
    multiply-one :
      (x : R) -> multiply x oneR == x
    multiply-zero :
      (x : R) -> multiply x zeroR == zeroR
    distribute :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply x (add y z) ==
      add (multiply x y) (multiply x z)
    inverse-zero :
      inverse zeroR == zeroR
    multiply-inverse :
      (x : R) ->
      x != zeroR ->
      multiply x (inverse x) == oneR

    order-reflexive :
      (x : R) -> lessOrEqual x x
    order-transitive :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y z ->
      lessOrEqual x z
    order-antisymmetric :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y x ->
      x == y
    order-total :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y or lessOrEqual y x
    add-order :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual (add z x) (add z y)
    multiply-nonnegative :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR x ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR y ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR (multiply x y)
    zero-less-than-one :
      lessOrEqual zeroR oneR and zeroR != oneR

    fromNat-zero :
      fromNat zero == zeroR
    fromNat-successor :
      (n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (suc n) == add (fromNat n) oneR
    fromNat-addition :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m + n) == add (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-multiplication :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m * n) == multiply (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-injective :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat m == fromNat n ->
      m == n

    archimedean :
      (x : R) ->
      Exists Nat
        (\ n -> lessOrEqual x (fromNat n))
    least-upper-bound :
      (P : R -> Set) ->
      Exists R P ->
      Exists R
        (\ upper ->
          (x : R) ->
          P x ->
          lessOrEqual x upper) ->
      Exists R
        (\ supremum ->
          ((x : R) ->
            P x ->
            lessOrEqual x supremum)
          and
          ((upper : R) ->
            ((x : R) ->
              P x ->
              lessOrEqual x upper) ->
            lessOrEqual supremum upper))

open CompleteOrderedRealField

subtract :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
subtract reals x y =
  add reals x (negate reals y)

divide :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
divide reals x y =
  multiply reals x (inverse reals y)

square :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R
square reals x =
  multiply reals x x

StrictLess :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
StrictLess reals x y =
  lessOrEqual reals x y and x != y

CloseTo :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
CloseTo reals center radius x =
  StrictLess reals
    (subtract reals center radius)
    x
  and
  StrictLess reals
    x
    (add reals center radius)

differenceQuotient :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (R -> R) ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
differenceQuotient reals function point x =
  divide reals
    (subtract reals (function x) (function point))
    (subtract reals x point)

DerivativeAt :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (R -> R) ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
DerivativeAt {R} reals function point derivative-value =
  (epsilon : R) ->
  StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) epsilon ->
  Exists R
    (\ delta ->
      StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) delta
      and
      ((x : R) ->
        CloseTo reals point delta x ->
        x != point ->
        CloseTo reals derivative-value epsilon
          (differenceQuotient reals function point x)))

record Point (R : Set) : Set where
  constructor point
  field
    x1 : R
    x2 : R

open Point

ClosePoint :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Point R ->
  R ->
  Point R ->
  Set
ClosePoint reals center radius p =
  CloseTo reals (x1 center) radius (x1 p)
  and
  CloseTo reals (x2 center) radius (x2 p)

ContinuousAt :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (Point R -> R) ->
  Point R ->
  Set
ContinuousAt {R} reals function center =
  (epsilon : R) ->
  StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) epsilon ->
  Exists R
    (\ delta ->
      StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) delta
      and
      ((p : Point R) ->
        ClosePoint reals center delta p ->
        CloseTo reals
          (function center)
          epsilon
          (function p)))

slice11 :
  {R : Set} ->
  (Point R -> Point R) ->
  Point R ->
  R ->
  R
slice11 function p t =
  x1 (function (point t (x2 p)))

slice12 :
  {R : Set} ->
  (Point R -> Point R) ->
  Point R ->
  R ->
  R
slice12 function p t =
  x1 (function (point (x1 p) t))

slice21 :
  {R : Set} ->
  (Point R -> Point R) ->
  Point R ->
  R ->
  R
slice21 function p t =
  x2 (function (point t (x2 p)))

slice22 :
  {R : Set} ->
  (Point R -> Point R) ->
  Point R ->
  R ->
  R
slice22 function p t =
  x2 (function (point (x1 p) t))

record PartialDerivativeData
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R)
  (function : Point R -> Point R) : Set where
  field
    d11 d12 d21 d22 : Point R -> R

    derivative11 :
      (p : Point R) ->
      DerivativeAt reals
        (slice11 function p)
        (x1 p)
        (d11 p)
    derivative12 :
      (p : Point R) ->
      DerivativeAt reals
        (slice12 function p)
        (x2 p)
        (d12 p)
    derivative21 :
      (p : Point R) ->
      DerivativeAt reals
        (slice21 function p)
        (x1 p)
        (d21 p)
    derivative22 :
      (p : Point R) ->
      DerivativeAt reals
        (slice22 function p)
        (x2 p)
        (d22 p)

    continuous11 :
      (p : Point R) ->
      ContinuousAt reals d11 p
    continuous12 :
      (p : Point R) ->
      ContinuousAt reals d12 p
    continuous21 :
      (p : Point R) ->
      ContinuousAt reals d21 p
    continuous22 :
      (p : Point R) ->
      ContinuousAt reals d22 p

open PartialDerivativeData

AllPartialsPositive :
  {R : Set} ->
  {reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R} ->
  {function : Point R -> Point R} ->
  PartialDerivativeData reals function ->
  Set
AllPartialsPositive {R = R} {reals = reals} derivatives =
  (p : Point R) ->
  StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) (d11 derivatives p)
  and
  StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) (d12 derivatives p)
  and
  StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) (d21 derivatives p)
  and
  StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) (d22 derivatives p)

four : Nat
four =
  suc (suc (suc (suc zero)))

quarter :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R
quarter reals =
  inverse reals (fromNat reals four)

QuadraticInequality :
  {R : Set} ->
  {reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R} ->
  {function : Point R -> Point R} ->
  PartialDerivativeData reals function ->
  Set
QuadraticInequality {R = R} {reals = reals} derivatives =
  (p : Point R) ->
  StrictLess reals
    (zeroR reals)
    (subtract reals
      (multiply reals
        (d11 derivatives p)
        (d22 derivatives p))
      (multiply reals
        (quarter reals)
        (square reals
          (add reals
            (d12 derivatives p)
            (d21 derivatives p)))))

SatisfiesHypotheses :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (Point R -> Point R) ->
  Set
SatisfiesHypotheses reals function =
  Exists (PartialDerivativeData reals function)
    (\ derivatives ->
      AllPartialsPositive derivatives
      and
      QuadraticInequality derivatives)

Injective :
  {A B : Set} ->
  (A -> B) ->
  Set
Injective {A = A} function =
  (x y : A) ->
  function x == function y ->
  x == y

putnam-2018-b5 : Set1
putnam-2018-b5 =
  (R : Set) ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) ->
  (function : Point R -> Point R) ->
  SatisfiesHypotheses reals function ->
  Injective function

title: putnam_2018_b5
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2018_b5:
  a continuously differentiable map from the real plane to itself, with
  positive partial derivatives satisfying the stated Jacobian inequality
  everywhere, is injective. This file contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open pairTheory pred_setTheory realTheory limTheory;

val putnam_2018_b5 =
  ``let partial_x =
      \h : (real # real) -> real.
      \p : real # real.
        diffn 1 (\t : real. h (t, SND p)) (FST p)
    in
    let partial_y =
      \h : (real # real) -> real.
      \p : real # real.
        diffn 1 (\t : real. h (FST p, t)) (SND p)
    in
    let plane_continuous =
      \g : (real # real) -> real.
        !p : real # real.
        !e : real.
          0 < e
          ==>
          ?d : real.
            0 < d /\
            !q : real # real.
              (FST q - FST p) pow 2 + (SND q - SND p) pow 2 < d
              ==>
              abs (g q - g p) < e
    in
    let continuously_partially_differentiable =
      \h : (real # real) -> real.
        (!p : real # real.
           higher_differentiable
             1
             (\t : real. h (t, SND p))
             (FST p) /\
           higher_differentiable
             1
             (\t : real. h (FST p, t))
             (SND p)) /\
        plane_continuous (partial_x h) /\
        plane_continuous (partial_y h)
    in
      !f : (real # real) -> (real # real).
        continuously_partially_differentiable (\p. FST (f p)) /\
        continuously_partially_differentiable (\p. SND (f p)) /\
        (!p : real # real.
           0 < partial_x (\q. FST (f q)) p /\
           0 < partial_y (\q. FST (f q)) p /\
           0 < partial_x (\q. SND (f q)) p /\
           0 < partial_y (\q. SND (f q)) p) /\
        (!p : real # real.
           0 <
             partial_x (\q. FST (f q)) p *
               partial_y (\q. SND (f q)) p -
             (1 / 4) *
               (partial_y (\q. FST (f q)) p +
                partial_x (\q. SND (f q)) p) pow 2)
        ==>
        INJ f UNIV UNIV``;

  partial derivatives of F. Their zero fallbacks make them total; the
  fallbacks are inactive under P18B5C1.

  P18B5C1 requires every coordinate slice derivative to exist and all four
  partial derivatives to be jointly continuous on RR X. RR. For a map
  between finite-dimensional real spaces, this is equivalent to continuous
  differentiability through order one.

  Ordered pairs identify RR X. RR with the source's two-dimensional real
  vectors. The positivity hypothesis covers all four partial derivatives,
  and the displayed inequality uses the two diagonal partials and the sum
  of the two cross-partials. The conclusion states injectivity directly.
  Every declaration is an unproved $a statement encoding; this database
  contains no $p proof declaration.
$)

$c P18B5D11 P18B5D12 P18B5D21 P18B5D22 P18B5C1 $.

  putnambench-putnam-2018-b5 $a |-
    A. F e. ( ( RR X. RR ) ^m ( RR X. RR ) )
      (

title: putnam_2018_b5
content:
% Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench artifact putnam_2018_b5:
% a continuously differentiable map from the real plane to itself, with all
% partial derivatives positive and the stated strict derivative inequality
% everywhere, is injective. This file contains no proof.

putnam_2018_b5: THEORY
BEGIN
  point: TYPE = [# x_coord: real, y_coord: real #]
  vector_field: TYPE = [point -> point]

  jacobian: TYPE =
    [# j11: real, j12: real, j21: real, j22: real #]
  jacobian_field: TYPE = [point -> jacobian]

  squared_distance(p, q: point): real =
    (x_coord(p) - x_coord(q)) ^ 2
      + (y_coord(p) - y_coord(q)) ^ 2

  derivative_error_squared(
      f: vector_field,
      derivative: jacobian,
      p, q: point): real =
    (x_coord(f(q)) - x_coord(f(p))
      - j11(derivative) * (x_coord(q) - x_coord(p))
      - j12(derivative) * (y_coord(q) - y_coord(p))) ^ 2
      + (y_coord(f(q)) - y_coord(f(p))
        - j21(derivative) * (x_coord(q) - x_coord(p))
        - j22(derivative) * (y_coord(q) - y_coord(p))) ^ 2

  has_frechet_derivative_at(
      f: vector_field,
      derivative: jacobian,
      p: point): bool =
    FORALL (epsilon_value: posreal):
      EXISTS (delta: posreal):
        FORALL (q: point):
          (q /= p
            AND squared_distance(q, p) < delta ^ 2)
          IMPLIES
            derivative_error_squared(f, derivative, p, q)
              < epsilon_value ^ 2 * squared_distance(q, p)

  jacobian_distance_squared(
      first, second: jacobian): real =
    (j11(first) - j11(second)) ^ 2
      + (j12(first) - j12(second)) ^ 2
      + (j21(first) - j21(second)) ^ 2
      + (j22(first) - j22(second)) ^ 2

  continuous_jacobian(derivative: jacobian_field): bool =
    FORALL (p: point), (epsilon_value: posreal):
      EXISTS (delta: posreal):
        FORALL (q: point):
          squared_distance(q, p) < delta ^ 2
            IMPLIES
              jacobian_distance_squared(
                derivative(q), derivative(p))
                < epsilon_value ^ 2

  continuously_differentiable_with(
      f: vector_field,
      derivative: jacobian_field): bool =
    (FORALL (p: point):
      has_frechet_derivative_at(f, derivative(p), p))
      AND continuous_jacobian(derivative)

  all_partial_derivatives_positive(
      derivative: jacobian_field): bool =
    FORALL (p: point):
      j11(derivative(p)) > 0
        AND j12(derivative(p)) > 0
        AND j21(derivative(p)) > 0
        AND j22(derivative(p)) > 0

  derivative_inequality(derivative: jacobian_field): bool =
    FORALL (p: point):
      j11(derivative(p)) * j22(derivative(p))
        - (1 / 4)
            * (j12(derivative(p)) + j21(derivative(p))) ^ 2
        > 0

  injective(f: vector_field): bool =
    FORALL (p, q: point):
      f(p) = f(q) IMPLIES p = q

  putnam_2018_b5: bool =
    FORALL (f: vector_field):
      (EXISTS (derivative: jacobian_field):
        continuously_differentiable_with(f, derivative)
          AND all_partial_derivatives_positive(derivative)
          AND derivative_inequality(derivative))
      IMPLIES injective(f)
END putnam_2018_b5

import Mathlib

/--
Let $S$ be the set of sequences of length $2018$ whose terms are in the set $\{1,2,3,4,5,6,10\}$ and sum to $3860$. Prove that the cardinality of $S$ is at most $2^{3860} \cdot \left(\frac{2018}{2048}\right)^{2018}$.
-/
theorem putnam_2018_b6
  (S : Finset (Fin 2018 → ℤ))
  (hS : S = {s : Fin 2018 → ℤ | (∀ i : Fin 2018, s i ∈ ({1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 10} : Set ℤ)) ∧ (∑ i : Fin 2018, s i) = 3860}) :
  S.card ≤ 2 ^ 3860 * ((2018 : ℝ) / 2048) ^ 2018 :=
sorry

-- (putnambench__agda__putnam_2018_b6): the cardinality bound for length-2018

module Putnam2018B6 where

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; _*_)

infix 4 _!=_
infixr 3 _and_
infixr 2 _or_

data Bottom : Set where

Not : Set -> Set
Not A =
  A -> Bottom

_!=_ : {A : Set} -> A -> A -> Set
x != y =
  Not (x == y)

record _and_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data _or_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  left  : A -> A or B
  right : B -> A or B

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

data Fin : Nat -> Set where
  fzero : {n : Nat} -> Fin (suc n)
  fsuc  : {n : Nat} -> Fin n -> Fin (suc n)

record HasExtensionalCardinality
  {A : Set}
  (equivalent : A -> A -> Set)
  (member : A -> Set)
  (cardinality : Nat) :
  Set where

  field
    enumerate :
      Fin cardinality ->
      A
    enumerated-member :
      (index : Fin cardinality) ->
      member (enumerate index)
    enumeration-complete :
      (item : A) ->
      member item ->
      Exists (Fin cardinality)
        (\ index -> equivalent item (enumerate index))
    enumeration-injective :
      (left-index right-index : Fin cardinality) ->
      equivalent (enumerate left-index) (enumerate right-index) ->
      left-index == right-index

record CompleteOrderedRealField (R : Set) : Set1 where
  field
    zeroR oneR : R
    add multiply : R -> R -> R
    negate inverse : R -> R
    lessOrEqual : R -> R -> Set
    fromNat : Nat -> R

    one-not-zero :
      oneR != zeroR

    add-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> add x y == add y x
    add-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      add (add x y) z == add x (add y z)
    add-zero :
      (x : R) -> add x zeroR == x
    add-inverse :
      (x : R) -> add x (negate x) == zeroR

    multiply-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> multiply x y == multiply y x
    multiply-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply (multiply x y) z ==
      multiply x (multiply y z)
    multiply-one :
      (x : R) -> multiply x oneR == x
    multiply-zero :
      (x : R) -> multiply x zeroR == zeroR
    distribute :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply x (add y z) ==
      add (multiply x y) (multiply x z)
    inverse-zero :
      inverse zeroR == zeroR
    multiply-inverse :
      (x : R) ->
      x != zeroR ->
      multiply x (inverse x) == oneR

    order-reflexive :
      (x : R) -> lessOrEqual x x
    order-transitive :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y z ->
      lessOrEqual x z
    order-antisymmetric :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y x ->
      x == y
    order-total :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y or lessOrEqual y x
    add-order :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual (add z x) (add z y)
    multiply-nonnegative :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR x ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR y ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR (multiply x y)
    zero-less-than-one :
      lessOrEqual zeroR oneR and zeroR != oneR

    fromNat-zero :
      fromNat zero == zeroR
    fromNat-successor :
      (n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (suc n) == add (fromNat n) oneR
    fromNat-addition :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m + n) == add (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-multiplication :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m * n) == multiply (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-injective :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat m == fromNat n ->
      m == n

    archimedean :
      (x : R) ->
      Exists Nat
        (\ n -> lessOrEqual x (fromNat n))
    least-upper-bound :
      (P : R -> Set) ->
      Exists R P ->
      Exists R
        (\ upper ->
          (x : R) ->
          P x ->
          lessOrEqual x upper) ->
      Exists R
        (\ supremum ->
          ((x : R) ->
            P x ->
            lessOrEqual x supremum)
          and
          ((upper : R) ->
            ((x : R) ->
              P x ->
              lessOrEqual x upper) ->
            lessOrEqual supremum upper))

open CompleteOrderedRealField

divide :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
divide reals numerator denominator =
  multiply reals numerator (inverse reals denominator)

naturalPower :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  Nat ->
  R
naturalPower reals base zero =
  oneR reals
naturalPower reals base (suc exponent) =
  multiply reals
    (naturalPower reals base exponent)
    base

sumFinNat :
  {n : Nat} ->
  (Fin n -> Nat) ->
  Nat
sumFinNat {zero} terms =
  zero
sumFinNat {suc n} terms =
  terms fzero + sumFinNat (\ index -> terms (fsuc index))

Sequence2018 : Set
Sequence2018 =
  Fin 2018 -> Nat

SequenceEqual :
  Sequence2018 ->
  Sequence2018 ->
  Set
SequenceEqual left-sequence right-sequence =
  (index : Fin 2018) ->
  left-sequence index == right-sequence index

ValidEntry : Nat -> Set
ValidEntry value =
  (value == 1)
  or
  (value == 2)
  or
  (value == 3)
  or
  (value == 4)
  or
  (value == 5)
  or
  (value == 6)
  or
  (value == 10)

ValidSequence : Sequence2018 -> Set
ValidSequence sequence =
  ((index : Fin 2018) ->
    ValidEntry (sequence index))
  and
  (sumFinNat sequence == 3860)

putnam-2018-b6-bound :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R
putnam-2018-b6-bound reals =
  multiply reals
    (naturalPower reals (fromNat reals 2) 3860)
    (naturalPower reals
      (divide reals
        (fromNat reals 2018)
        (fromNat reals 2048))
      2018)

putnam-2018-b6 :
  {R : Set} ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) ->
  Set
putnam-2018-b6 reals =
  Exists Nat
    (\ cardinality ->
      HasExtensionalCardinality
        SequenceEqual
        ValidSequence
        cardinality
      and
      lessOrEqual reals
        (fromNat reals cardinality)
        (putnam-2018-b6-bound reals))

;; FN-EQUAL to a constant-true function expresses universal quantification

;; is exactly the source's internal existential quantifier over A, B, and C.
;; The quoted failure lambda contains only tame ACL2 primitives.

(defun putnam-2019-a1-quoted (object)
  (list 'quote object))

(defun putnam-2019-a1-and-terms (terms)
  (if (consp terms)
      (list 'if
            (car terms)
            (putnam-2019-a1-and-terms (cdr terms))
            (putnam-2019-a1-quoted nil))
    (putnam-2019-a1-quoted t)))

(defun putnam-2019-a1-true-function (formals)

        formals
        (putnam-2019-a1-quoted t)))

(defun putnam-2019-a1-add-term (left right)

  (list 'unary-- value))

   (list

    (list 'if

          (putnam-2019-a1-quoted nil)
          (putnam-2019-a1-quoted t)))))

  (let* ((a-cube
          (list 'expt 'a (putnam-2019-a1-quoted 3)))
         (b-cube
          (list 'expt 'b (putnam-2019-a1-quoted 3)))
         (c-cube
          (list 'expt 'c (putnam-2019-a1-quoted 3)))
         (cube-sum

           a-cube

         (triple-product
          (putnam-2019-a1-multiply-term
           (putnam-2019-a1-quoted 3)
           (putnam-2019-a1-multiply-term
            'a
            (putnam-2019-a1-multiply-term 'b 'c))))
         (expression
          (putnam-2019-a1-add-term
           cube-sum
           (putnam-2019-a1-negate-term triple-product)))
         (qualification

            (putnam-2019-a1-nonnegative-integer-term 'a)
            (putnam-2019-a1-nonnegative-integer-term 'b)
            (putnam-2019-a1-nonnegative-integer-term 'c)
            (list 'equal
                  expression

     'lambda
     '(a b c)

      'if
      qualification
      (putnam-2019-a1-quoted nil)
      (putnam-2019-a1-quoted t)))))

        (true-function
         (putnam-2019-a1-true-function '(a b c))))
    (and
     (integerp n)
     (tamep-functionp failure-function)
     (tamep-functionp true-function)
     (not (fn-equal failure-function true-function)))))

  (and
   (integerp n)
   (<= 0 n)

(defun putnambench-putnam-2019-a1-statement (n)

    (putnam-2019-a1-attainable-p n)

  pos zero
difference (suc m) zero =
  pos (suc m)
difference zero (suc n) =
  negsuc n
difference (suc m) (suc n) =
  difference m n

negative : Nat -> Int
negative zero =
  pos zero
negative (suc n) =
  negsuc n

negateInt : Int -> Int
negateInt (pos n) =
  negative n
negateInt (negsuc n) =
  pos (suc n)

_+Z_ : Int -> Int -> Int
pos m +Z pos n =
  pos (m + n)
pos m +Z negsuc n =
  difference m (suc n)
negsuc m +Z pos n =
  difference n (suc m)
negsuc m +Z negsuc n =
  negsuc (suc (m + n))

_*Z_ : Int -> Int -> Int
pos m *Z pos n =
  pos (m * n)
pos m *Z negsuc n =
  negative (m * suc n)
negsuc m *Z pos n =
  negative (suc m * n)
negsuc m *Z negsuc n =
  pos (suc m * suc n)

oneN : Nat
oneN =
  suc zero

twoN : Nat
twoN =
  suc oneN

threeN : Nat
threeN =
  suc twoN

sixN : Nat
sixN =
  threeN + threeN

nineN : Nat
nineN =
  threeN * threeN

threeZ : Int
threeZ =
  pos threeN

sixZ : Int
sixZ =
  pos sixN

nineZ : Int
nineZ =
  pos nineN

cube : Int -> Int
cube x =
  (x *Z x) *Z x

data Nonnegative : Int -> Set where
  nonnegative :
    {n : Nat} ->
    Nonnegative (pos n)

CongruentModuloNine : Int -> Int -> Set
CongruentModuloNine value residue =
  Exists Int
    (\ quotient ->
      value == residue +Z (nineZ *Z quotient))

RepresentableValue : Int -> Set
RepresentableValue n =
  Exists Int
    (\ A ->
      Exists Int
        (\ B ->
          Exists Int
            (\ C ->
              Nonnegative A
              and
              Nonnegative B
              and
              Nonnegative C
              and
              (cube A +Z cube B +Z cube C
                +Z negateInt (threeZ *Z A *Z B *Z C))
                == n)))

putnam-2019-a1-solution : Int -> Set
putnam-2019-a1-solution n =
  Nonnegative n
  and
  Not (CongruentModuloNine n threeZ)
  and
  Not (CongruentModuloNine n sixZ)

putnam-2019-a1 : Set
putnam-2019-a1 =
  (n : Int) ->
  RepresentableValue n iff putnam-2019-a1-solution n

(*
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2019_a1:
  the values of A^3 + B^3 + C^3 - 3ABC for nonnegative integers are exactly
  the nonnegative integers not congruent to 3 or 6 modulo 9. This file
  contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open integerTheory pred_setTheory;

val putnam_2019_a1 =
  ``{n : int |
       ?A B C : int.
         0 <= A /\ 0 <= B /\ 0 <= C /\
         A ** 3 + B ** 3 + C ** 3 - 3 * A * B * C = n} =
    {n : int |
       0 <= n /\ n % 9 <> 3 /\ n % 9 <> 6}``;

title: putnam_2019_a1
content:
$(
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact
  putnam_2019_a1: the values of A^3 + B^3 + C^3 - 3ABC for nonnegative
  integers A, B, and C are exactly the nonnegative integers whose remainder
  modulo nine is neither three nor six. This file contains no proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  SetMM's ZZ and NN0 are the classes of integers and nonnegative integers.
  The left side of the biconditional internally quantifies the three source
  inputs over NN0. The right side inlines the solution set identified by the
  ground-truth sources. Thus the pointwise biconditional over ZZ is
  extensionally equivalent to their equality of integer sets.

  The final declaration is the single unproved $a corpus statement; this
  database contains no $p proof statement.
$)

${
  $d A B C n $.

  putnambench-putnam-2019-a1 $a |- A. n e. ZZ
    (
      (
        E. A e. NN0 E. B e. NN0 E. C e. NN0
          n =
          (
            (
              (
                ( A ^ 3 )
                +
                ( B ^ 3 )
              )
              +
              ( C ^ 3 )
            )
            -
            (
              (
                ( 3 x. A )
                x.
                B
              )
              x.
              C
            )
          )
      )
      <->
      (
        n e. NN0
        /\
        (
          ( n mod 9 ) =/= 3
          /\
          ( n mod 9 ) =/= 6
        )
      )
    )
  $.
$}

title: putnam_2019_a1
content:
% Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2019_a1:
% the integer values of A^3 + B^3 + C^3 - 3ABC for nonnegative integers
% A, B, and C are exactly the nonnegative integers not congruent to 3 or 6
% modulo 9. This file contains no proof.

putnam_2019_a1: THEORY
BEGIN
  represented_value(n: int): bool =
    EXISTS (A, B, C: int):
      A >= 0
        AND B >= 0
        AND C >= 0
        AND A ^ 3 + B ^ 3 + C ^ 3 - 3 * A * B * C = n

  classified_value(n: int): bool =
    n >= 0
      AND mod(n, 9) /= 3
      AND mod(n, 9) /= 6

  putnam_2019_a1: bool =
    FORALL (n: int):
      represented_value(n) IFF classified_value(n)
END putnam_2019_a1

title: putnam_2019_a3
content:
import Mathlib

open Topology Filter

noncomputable abbrev putnam_2019_a3_solution : ℝ := sorry
-- 2019^(-(1:ℝ)/2019)
/--
Given real numbers $b_0, b_1, \dots, b_{2019}$ with $b_{2019} \neq 0$, let $z_1,z_2,\dots,z_{2019}$ be
the roots in the complex plane of the polynomial
\[
P(z) = \sum_{k=0}^{2019} b_k z^k.
\]
Let $\mu = (|z_1| + \cdots + |z_{2019}|)/2019$ be the average of the distances from $z_1,z_2,\dots,z_{2019}$ to the origin. Determine the largest constant $M$ such that $\mu \geq M$ for all choices of $b_0,b_1,\dots, b_{2019}$ that satisfy
\[
1 \leq b_0 < b_1 < b_2 < \cdots < b_{2019} \leq 2019.
\]
-/
theorem putnam_2019_a3
  (v : Polynomial ℂ → Prop)
  (hv : v = fun b => b.degree = 2019 ∧ 1 ≤ (b.coeff 0).re ∧ (b.coeff 2019).re ≤ 2019 ∧
    (∀ i : Fin 2020, (b.coeff i).im = 0) ∧ (∀ i : Fin 2019, (b.coeff i).re < (b.coeff (i + 1)).re))
  (μ : Polynomial ℂ → ℝ)
  (hμ : μ = fun b => (Multiset.map (fun ω : ℂ => ‖ω‖) (Polynomial.roots b)).sum/2019) :
  IsGreatest {M : ℝ | ∀ b, v b → μ b ≥ M} putnam_2019_a3_solution :=
sorry

title: putnam_2019_a3
content:
(* Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2019_a3:
   the greatest universal lower bound for the average modulus of the complex
   roots of a degree-2019 polynomial with strictly increasing real
   coefficients between 1 and 2019. This file contains no proof. *)

From Stdlib Require Import Reals Lists.List Arith.PeanoNat.

Import ListNotations.
Open Scope R_scope.

Record putnam_2019_a3_complex : Type := {
  putnam_2019_a3_re : R;
  putnam_2019_a3_im : R
}.

Definition putnam_2019_a3_Czero : putnam_2019_a3_complex :=
  {| putnam_2019_a3_re := 0; putnam_2019_a3_im := 0 |}.

Definition putnam_2019_a3_Cone : putnam_2019_a3_complex :=
  {| putnam_2019_a3_re := 1; putnam_2019_a3_im := 0 |}.

Definition putnam_2019_a3_RtoC
    (x : R) : putnam_2019_a3_complex :=
  {| putnam_2019_a3_re := x; putnam_2019_a3_im := 0 |}.

Definition putnam_2019_a3_Cadd
    (z w : putnam_2019_a3_complex) : putnam_2019_a3_complex :=
  {| putnam_2019_a3_re :=
       putnam_2019_a3_re z + putnam_2019_a3_re w;
     putnam_2019_a3_im :=
       putnam_2019_a3_im z + putnam_2019_a3_im w |}.

Definition putnam_2019_a3_Cneg
    (z : putnam_2019_a3_complex) : putnam_2019_a3_complex :=
  {| putnam_2019_a3_re := - putnam_2019_a3_re z;
     putnam_2019_a3_im := - putnam_2019_a3_im z |}.

Definition putnam_2019_a3_Csub
    (z w : putnam_2019_a3_complex) : putnam_2019_a3_complex :=
  putnam_2019_a3_Cadd z (putnam_2019_a3_Cneg w).

Definition putnam_2019_a3_Cmul
    (z w : putnam_2019_a3_complex) : putnam_2019_a3_complex :=
  {| putnam_2019_a3_re :=
       putnam_2019_a3_re z * putnam_2019_a3_re w -
       putnam_2019_a3_im z * putnam_2019_a3_im w;
     putnam_2019_a3_im :=
       putnam_2019_a3_re z * putnam_2019_a3_im w +
       putnam_2019_a3_im z * putnam_2019_a3_re w |}.

Definition putnam_2019_a3_Cmod
    (z : putnam_2019_a3_complex) : R :=
  sqrt
    (putnam_2019_a3_re z ^ 2 +
     putnam_2019_a3_im z ^ 2).

Fixpoint putnam_2019_a3_eval
    (coefficients : list R)
    (z : putnam_2019_a3_complex) : putnam_2019_a3_complex :=
  match coefficients with
  | [] => putnam_2019_a3_Czero
  | coefficient :: remaining =>
      putnam_2019_a3_Cadd
        (putnam_2019_a3_RtoC coefficient)
        (putnam_2019_a3_Cmul z
          (putnam_2019_a3_eval remaining z))
  end.

Fixpoint putnam_2019_a3_linear_product
    (roots : list putnam_2019_a3_complex)
    (z : putnam_2019_a3_complex) : putnam_2019_a3_complex :=
  match roots with
  | [] => putnam_2019_a3_Cone
  | root :: remaining =>
      putnam_2019_a3_Cmul
        (putnam_2019_a3_Csub z root)
        (putnam_2019_a3_linear_product remaining z)
  end.

Definition putnam_2019_a3_admissible
    (coefficients : list R) : Prop :=
  length coefficients = 2020%nat /\
  1 <= nth 0 coefficients 0 /\
  nth 2019 coefficients 0 <= 2019 /\
  forall i : nat,
    (i < 2019)%nat ->
    nth i coefficients 0 < nth (S i) coefficients 0.

Definition putnam_2019_a3_root_enumeration
    (coefficients : list R)
    (roots : list putnam_2019_a3_complex) : Prop :=
  length roots = 2019%nat /\
  forall z : putnam_2019_a3_complex,
    putnam_2019_a3_eval coefficients z =
    putnam_2019_a3_Cmul
      (putnam_2019_a3_RtoC (nth 2019 coefficients 0))
      (putnam_2019_a3_linear_product roots z).

Fixpoint putnam_2019_a3_sum_moduli
    (roots : list putnam_2019_a3_complex) : R :=
  match roots with
  | [] => 0
  | root :: remaining =>
      putnam_2019_a3_Cmod root +
      putnam_2019_a3_sum_moduli remaining
  end.

Definition putnam_2019_a3_average_modulus
    (roots : list putnam_2019_a3_complex) : R :=
  putnam_2019_a3_sum_moduli roots / INR 2019.

Definition putnam_2019_a3_is_lower_bound (M : R) : Prop :=
  forall (coefficients : list R)
         (roots : list putnam_2019_a3_complex),
    putnam_2019_a3_admissible coefficients ->
    putnam_2019_a3_root_enumeration coefficients roots ->
    putnam_2019_a3_average_modulus roots >= M.

Definition putnam_2019_a3_is_greatest_lower_bound (M : R) : Prop :=
  putnam_2019_a3_is_lower_bound M /\
  forall candidate : R,
    putnam_2019_a3_is_lower_bound candidate ->
    candidate <= M.

Definition putnam_2019_a3_solution : R :=
  Rpower (INR 2019) (-1 / INR 2019).

Theorem putnam_2019_a3 :
  putnam_2019_a3_is_greatest_lower_bound
    putnam_2019_a3_solution.
Admitted.

title: putnam_2019_a3
content:
theory putnam_2019_a3 imports Complex_Main
"HOL-Computational_Algebra.Polynomial"
begin

definition putnam_2019_a3_solution :: real where "putnam_2019_a3_solution \<equiv> undefined"
(* 2019 powr (-1/2019) *)
theorem putnam_2019_a3:
  fixes proots :: "(complex poly) \<Rightarrow> (complex multiset)"
  and v :: "(complex poly) \<Rightarrow> bool"
  and \<mu> :: "(complex poly) \<Rightarrow> real"
  defines "proots \<equiv> (\<lambda>p::complex poly. Abs_multiset (\<lambda>a::complex. order a p))"
  defines "v \<equiv> (\<lambda>b::complex poly. degree b = 2019 \<and> 1 \<le> Re (coeff b 0) \<and> Re (coeff b 2019) \<le> 2019 \<and>
  (\<forall>i::nat\<in>{0..2019}. Im (coeff b i) = 0) \<and> (\<forall>i::nat\<in>{0..2018}. Re (coeff b i) < Re (coeff b (i + 1))))"
  and "\<mu> \<equiv> (\<lambda>b::complex poly. (\<Sum>\<^sub># (image_mset norm (proots b))) / 2019)"
  shows "(GREATEST M::real. (\<forall>b::complex poly. (v b \<longrightarrow> \<mu> b \<ge> M))) = putnam_2019_a3_solution"
  sorry

end

content:
;; Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2019_a3:
;; the greatest universal lower bound for the average modulus of the roots of
;; a degree-2019 polynomial with real coefficients
;; 1 <= b_0 < ... < b_2019 <= 2019 is 2019^(-1/2019).
;; This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))

;; Scalars are interpreted in an arbitrary real closed ordered field. Real
;; closed fields are elementarily equivalent, and the assertion below is
;; first-order in ordered-field operations and square roots. Complex numbers
;; are pairs of field elements. A list of 2019 roots represents the full root
;; multiset exactly when its product of linear factors, scaled by the leading
;; coefficient, reproduces all 2020 real coefficients.
;;
;; FN-EQUAL against a constant-T function supplies universal quantification
;; over every coefficient list and root list. Thus roots remain internal to
;; the lower-bound predicate rather than becoming extra assumptions on a
;; particular polynomial.

(defun putnam-2019-a3-quoted (object)
  (list 'quote object))

(defun putnam-2019-a3-apply1-term (function argument)
  (list
   'apply$
   (putnam-2019-a3-quoted function)
   (list 'cons argument nil)))

(defun putnam-2019-a3-apply2-term (function left right)
  (list
   'apply$
   (putnam-2019-a3-quoted function)
   (list 'cons left (list 'cons right nil))))

(defun putnam-2019-a3-and-term (terms)
  (if (endp terms)
      (putnam-2019-a3-quoted t)
    (list
     'if
     (car terms)
     (putnam-2019-a3-and-term (cdr terms))
     (putnam-2019-a3-quoted nil))))

(defun putnam-2019-a3-or-term (terms)
  (if (endp terms)
      (putnam-2019-a3-quoted nil)
    (list
     'if
     (car terms)
     (putnam-2019-a3-quoted t)
     (putnam-2019-a3-or-term (cdr terms)))))

(defun putnam-2019-a3-not-term (term)
  (list
   'if
   term
   (putnam-2019-a3-quoted nil)
   (putnam-2019-a3-quoted t)))

(defun putnam-2019-a3-implies-term (antecedent consequent)
  (list
   'if
   antecedent
   consequent
   (putnam-2019-a3-quoted t)))

(defun putnam-2019-a3-true-function (formals)
  (list
   'lambda
   formals
   (putnam-2019-a3-quoted t)))

(defun putnam-2019-a3-carrier-term (carrier element)
  (putnam-2019-a3-apply1-term carrier element))

(defun putnam-2019-a3-operation-term (operation left right)
  (putnam-2019-a3-apply2-term operation left right))

(defun putnam-2019-a3-field-laws-function
    (carrier zero one add mul neg inv)
  (let* ((x 'x)
         (y 'y)
         (z 'z)
         (qzero (putnam-2019-a3-quoted zero))
         (qone (putnam-2019-a3-quoted one))
         (add-xy
          (putnam-2019-a3-operation-term add x y))
         (add-yz
          (putnam-2019-a3-operation-term add y z))
         (mul-xy
          (putnam-2019-a3-operation-term mul x y))
         (mul-yz
          (putnam-2019-a3-operation-term mul y z))
         (neg-x
          (putnam-2019-a3-apply1-term neg x))
         (inv-x
          (putnam-2019-a3-apply1-term inv x))
         (domain
          (putnam-2019-a3-and-term
           (list
            (putnam-2019-a3-carrier-term carrier x)
            (putnam-2019-a3-carrier-term carrier y)
            (putnam-2019-a3-carrier-term carrier z))))
         (laws
          (putnam-2019-a3-and-term
           (list
            (putnam-2019-a3-carrier-term carrier add-xy)
            (putnam-2019-a3-carrier-term carrier mul-xy)
            (putnam-2019-a3-carrier-term carrier neg-x)
            (putnam-2019-a3-carrier-term carrier inv-x)
            (list
             'equal
             (putnam-2019-a3-operation-term add add-xy z)
             (putnam-2019-a3-operation-term add x add-yz))
            (list
             'equal
             (putnam-2019-a3-operation-term mul mul-xy z)
             (putnam-2019-a3-operation-term mul x mul-yz))
            (list
             'equal
             add-xy
             (putnam-2019-a3-operation-term add y x))
            (list
             'equal
             mul-xy
             (putnam-2019-a3-operation-term mul y x))
            (list
             'equal

             x)
            (list
             'equal
             (putnam-2019-a3-operation-term add x neg-x)

            (list
             'equal

            (putnam-2019-a3-implies-term
             (list 'equal x qzero)

            (putnam-2019-a3-implies-term
             (putnam-2019-a3-not-term
              (list 'equal x qzero))

            (list

             (putnam-2019-a3-operation-term

              (putnam-2019-a3-operation-term mul x y)

(defun putnam-2019-a3-order-laws-function
    (carrier zero add mul lt)
  (let* ((x 'x)
         (y 'y)
         (z 'z)
         (qzero (putnam-2019-a3-quoted zero))

           (list
            (putnam-2019-a3-carrier-term carrier x)
            (putnam-2019-a3-carrier-term carrier y)
            (putnam-2019-a3-carrier-term carrier z))))
         (laws
          (putnam-2019-a3-and-term
           (list
            (putnam-2019-a3-not-term
             (putnam-2019-a3-operation-term lt x x))
            (putnam-2019-a3-or-term
             (list
              lt-xy

            (putnam-2019-a3-implies-term
             (putnam-2019-a3-and-term
              (list lt-xy lt-yz))

            (putnam-2019-a3-implies-term
             lt-xy
             (putnam-2019-a3-operation-term
              lt
              (putnam-2019-a3-operation-term add x z)
              (putnam-2019-a3-operation-term add y z)))
            (putnam-2019-a3-implies-term
             (putnam-2019-a3-and-term
              (list
               (putnam-2019-a3-operation-term lt qzero x)
               (putnam-2019-a3-operation-term lt qzero y)))
             (putnam-2019-a3-operation-term

              (putnam-2019-a3-operation-term mul x y)))))))
    (list
     'lambda

(defun putnam-2019-a3-square-root-laws-function
    (carrier zero mul lt square-root)
  (let* ((x 'x)
         (qzero (putnam-2019-a3-quoted zero))
         (root
          (putnam-2019-a3-apply1-term square-root x))
         (domain
          (putnam-2019-a3-and-term
           (list
            (putnam-2019-a3-carrier-term carrier x)
            (putnam-2019-a3-not-term
             (putnam-2019-a3-operation-term lt x qzero)))))
         (laws
          (putnam-2019-a3-and-term
           (list
            (putnam-2019-a3-carrier-term carrier root)
            (putnam-2019-a3-not-term
             (putnam-2019-a3-operation-term lt root qzero))
            (list
             'equal
             (putnam-2019-a3-operation-term mul root root)
             x)))))
    (list
     'lambda
     '(x)
     (putnam-2019-a3-implies-term domain laws))))

  (apply$ add (list left right)))

(defun putnam-2019-a3-mul (mul left right)
  (apply$ mul (list left right)))

(defun putnam-2019-a3-field-natural (n zero one add)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix n)))
  (if (zp n)
      zero
    (putnam-2019-a3-add
     add

      (- n 1) zero one add))))

(defun putnam-2019-a3-field-power (base exponent one mul)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix exponent)))
  (if (zp exponent)
      one
    (putnam-2019-a3-mul
     mul
     base

      base (- exponent 1) one mul))))

    (coefficients carrier)

      (equal coefficients nil)
    (and
     (apply$ carrier (list (car coefficients)))

(defun putnam-2019-a3-polynomial-eval

         (order-laws-true
          (putnam-2019-a3-true-function '(x y z)))

     (tamep-functionp lt)

(defun putnam-2019-a3-complex-p (z carrier)
  (and
   (consp z)
   (apply$ carrier (list (car z)))
   (apply$ carrier (list (cdr z)))))

(defun putnam-2019-a3-complex-zero (zero)
  (cons zero zero))

(defun putnam-2019-a3-complex-one (zero one)
  (cons one zero))

(defun putnam-2019-a3-complex-add (left right add)
  (cons
   (putnam-2019-a3-add add (car left) (car right))
   (putnam-2019-a3-add add (cdr left) (cdr right))))

(defun putnam-2019-a3-complex-neg (value neg)
  (cons
   (putnam-2019-a3-neg neg (car value))

(defun putnam-2019-a3-complex-mul
    (left right add mul neg)
  (let ((ac
         (putnam-2019-a3-mul mul (car left) (car right)))
        (bd
         (putnam-2019-a3-mul mul (cdr left) (cdr right)))
        (ad
         (putnam-2019-a3-mul mul (car left) (cdr right)))
        (bc
         (putnam-2019-a3-mul mul (cdr left) (car right))))
    (cons
     (putnam-2019-a3-add
      add ac (putnam-2019-a3-neg neg bd))

(defun putnam-2019-a3-complex-polynomial-add
    (left right add)
  (cond
   ((endp left) right)
   ((endp right) left)
   (t
    (cons
     (putnam-2019-a3-complex-add
      (car left) (car right) add)
     (putnam-2019-a3-complex-polynomial-add
      (cdr left) (cdr right) add)))))

(defun putnam-2019-a3-complex-polynomial-scale
    (scalar coefficients add mul neg)
  (if (endp coefficients)
      nil
    (cons
     (putnam-2019-a3-complex-mul
      scalar (car coefficients) add mul neg)
     (putnam-2019-a3-complex-polynomial-scale
      scalar (cdr coefficients) add mul neg))))

(defun putnam-2019-a3-multiply-by-linear
    (coefficients root zero add mul neg)
  (putnam-2019-a3-complex-polynomial-add
   (putnam-2019-a3-complex-polynomial-scale
    (putnam-2019-a3-complex-neg root neg)
    coefficients add mul neg)
   (cons (putnam-2019-a3-complex-zero zero)
         coefficients)
   add))

(defun putnam-2019-a3-root-product
    (roots zero one add mul neg)
  (if (endp roots)
      (list (putnam-2019-a3-complex-one zero one))
    (putnam-2019-a3-multiply-by-linear
     (putnam-2019-a3-root-product
      (cdr roots) zero one add mul neg)
     (car roots)
     zero add mul neg)))

(defun putnam-2019-a3-real-coefficients-as-complex
    (coefficients zero)
  (if (endp coefficients)
      nil
    (cons
     (cons (car coefficients) zero)
     (putnam-2019-a3-real-coefficients-as-complex
      (cdr coefficients) zero))))

(defun putnam-2019-a3-roots-p (roots carrier)
  (if (endp roots)
      (equal roots nil)
    (and
     (putnam-2019-a3-complex-p (car roots) carrier)
     (putnam-2019-a3-roots-p (cdr roots) carrier))))

(defun putnam-2019-a3-increasing-p (coefficients lt)
  (if (or (endp coefficients)
          (endp (cdr coefficients)))
      t
    (and
     (putnam-2019-a3-lt
      lt (car coefficients) (cadr coefficients))
     (putnam-2019-a3-increasing-p
      (cdr coefficients) lt))))

(defun putnam-2019-a3-admissible-polynomial-p
    (coefficients carrier zero one add lt)
  (let ((upper
         (putnam-2019-a3-field-natural
          2019 zero one add)))
    (and
     (true-listp coefficients)
     (equal (len coefficients) 2020)
     (putnam-2019-a3-coefficient-list-p
      coefficients carrier)
     (putnam-2019-a3-le lt one (car coefficients))
     (putnam-2019-a3-increasing-p coefficients lt)
     (putnam-2019-a3-le
      lt (car (last coefficients)) upper))))

(defun putnam-2019-a3-factorization-p
    (coefficients roots zero one add mul neg)
  (let* ((monic-product
          (putnam-2019-a3-root-product
           roots zero one add mul neg))
         (leading
          (cons (car (last coefficients)) zero))
         (scaled-product
          (putnam-2019-a3-complex-polynomial-scale
           leading monic-product add mul neg)))
    (equal
     scaled-product
     (putnam-2019-a3-real-coefficients-as-complex
      coefficients zero))))

(defun putnam-2019-a3-complex-norm
    (z add mul square-root)
  (apply$
   square-root
   (list
    (putnam-2019-a3-add
     add
     (putnam-2019-a3-mul mul (car z) (car z))
     (putnam-2019-a3-mul mul (cdr z) (cdr z))))))

(defun putnam-2019-a3-root-norm-sum
    (roots zero add mul square-root)
  (if (endp roots)
      zero
    (putnam-2019-a3-add
     add
     (putnam-2019-a3-complex-norm
      (car roots) add mul square-root)
     (putnam-2019-a3-root-norm-sum
      (cdr roots) zero add mul square-root))))

(defun putnam-2019-a3-root-norm-average
    (roots zero one add mul inv square-root)
  (putnam-2019-a3-mul
   mul
   (putnam-2019-a3-root-norm-sum
    roots zero add mul square-root)
   (putnam-2019-a3-inv
    inv
    (putnam-2019-a3-field-natural
     2019 zero one add))))

(defun putnam-2019-a3-bound-instance-p
    (coefficients roots constant
                  carrier zero one add mul neg inv lt square-root)
  (if
      (and
       (putnam-2019-a3-admissible-polynomial-p
        coefficients carrier zero one add lt)
       (true-listp roots)
       (equal (len roots) 2019)
       (putnam-2019-a3-roots-p roots carrier)
       (putnam-2019-a3-factorization-p
        coefficients roots zero one add mul neg))
      (putnam-2019-a3-le
       lt
       constant
       (putnam-2019-a3-root-norm-average
        roots zero one add mul inv square-root))

(defun-sk putnam-2019-a3-bound-p
    (constant carrier zero one add mul neg inv lt square-root)
  (forall (coefficients roots)
    (putnam-2019-a3-bound-instance-p
     coefficients roots constant
     carrier zero one add mul neg inv lt square-root)))

(defun putnam-2019-a3-zero-list (count zero)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix count)))
  (if (zp count)
      nil
    (cons
     zero
     (putnam-2019-a3-zero-list (- count 1) zero))))

(defun putnam-2019-a3-solution-polynomial
    (zero one add neg)
  (cons
   (putnam-2019-a3-neg neg one)
   (append
    (putnam-2019-a3-zero-list 2018 zero)
    (list
     (putnam-2019-a3-field-natural
      2019 zero one add)))))

(defun putnambench-putnam-2019-a3-statement
    (carrier zero one add mul neg inv lt
             square-root odd-root constant)
  (implies
   (putnam-2019-a3-real-closed-field-p
    carrier zero one add mul neg inv lt square-root odd-root)
   (let* ((solution-polynomial
           (putnam-2019-a3-solution-polynomial
            zero one add neg))
          (solution
           (apply$ odd-root (list solution-polynomial))))
     (and
      (putnam-2019-a3-bound-p
       solution
       carrier zero one add mul neg inv lt square-root)
      (implies
       (and
        (apply$ carrier (list constant))
        (putnam-2019-a3-bound-p

title: putnam_2019_a3
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2019_a3
-- (putnambench__agda__putnam_2019_a3): the greatest universal lower bound
-- for the average modulus of the roots of a degree-2019 polynomial with
-- strictly increasing real coefficients from 1 to 2019. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module Main where

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.List using (List; []; _∷_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; _*_)

infix 4 _!=_
infixr 3 _and_
infixr 2 _or_

data Bottom : Set where

Not : Set -> Set
Not A =
  A -> Bottom

_!=_ : {A : Set} -> A -> A -> Set
x != y =
  Not (x == y)

record _and_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data _or_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  left  : A -> A or B
  right : B -> A or B

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

data HasLength {A : Set} : List A -> Nat -> Set where
  length-empty :
    HasLength [] zero
  length-cons :
    {x : A} {xs : List A} {n : Nat} ->
    HasLength xs n ->
    HasLength (x ∷ xs) (suc n)

data LastElement {A : Set} : List A -> A -> Set where
  last-singleton :
    {x : A} ->
    LastElement (x ∷ []) x
  last-cons :
    {x last : A} {xs : List A} ->
    LastElement xs last ->
    LastElement (x ∷ xs) last

record CompleteOrderedRealField (R : Set) : Set1 where
  field
    zeroR oneR : R
    add multiply : R -> R -> R
    negate inverse squareRoot : R -> R
    lessOrEqual : R -> R -> Set
    fromNat : Nat -> R

    one-not-zero :
      oneR != zeroR

    add-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> add x y == add y x
    add-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      add (add x y) z == add x (add y z)
    add-zero :
      (x : R) -> add x zeroR == x
    add-inverse :
      (x : R) -> add x (negate x) == zeroR

    multiply-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> multiply x y == multiply y x
    multiply-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply (multiply x y) z ==
      multiply x (multiply y z)
    multiply-one :
      (x : R) -> multiply x oneR == x
    multiply-zero :
      (x : R) -> multiply x zeroR == zeroR
    distribute :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply x (add y z) ==
      add (multiply x y) (multiply x z)
    inverse-zero :
      inverse zeroR == zeroR
    multiply-inverse :
      (x : R) ->
      x != zeroR ->
      multiply x (inverse x) == oneR

    order-reflexive :
      (x : R) -> lessOrEqual x x
    order-transitive :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y z ->
      lessOrEqual x z
    order-antisymmetric :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y x ->
      x == y
    order-total :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y or lessOrEqual y x
    add-order :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual (add z x) (add z y)
    multiply-nonnegative :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR x ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR y ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR (multiply x y)
    zero-less-than-one :
      lessOrEqual zeroR oneR and zeroR != oneR

    fromNat-zero :
      fromNat zero == zeroR
    fromNat-successor :
      (n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (suc n) == add (fromNat n) oneR
    fromNat-addition :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m + n) == add (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-multiplication :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m * n) == multiply (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-injective :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat m == fromNat n ->
      m == n

    square-root-nonnegative :
      (x : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR x ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR (squareRoot x)
    square-root-square :
      (x : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR x ->
      multiply (squareRoot x) (squareRoot x) == x

    archimedean :
      (x : R) ->
      Exists Nat
        (\ n ->
          lessOrEqual x (fromNat n))
    least-upper-bound :
      (P : R -> Set) ->
      Exists R P ->
      Exists R
        (\ upper ->
          (x : R) ->
          P x ->
          lessOrEqual x upper) ->
      Exists R
        (\ supremum ->
          ((x : R) ->
            P x ->
            lessOrEqual x supremum)
          and
          ((upper : R) ->
            ((x : R) ->
              P x ->
              lessOrEqual x upper) ->
            lessOrEqual supremum upper))

open CompleteOrderedRealField

StrictLess :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
StrictLess reals x y =
  lessOrEqual reals x y and x != y

divide :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
divide reals x y =
  multiply reals x (inverse reals y)

naturalPower :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  Nat ->
  R
naturalPower reals x zero =
  oneR reals
naturalPower reals x (suc n) =
  multiply reals x (naturalPower reals x n)

data StrictlyIncreasing
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) :
  List R -> Set where

  increasing-empty :
    StrictlyIncreasing reals []
  increasing-singleton :
    {x : R} ->
    StrictlyIncreasing reals (x ∷ [])
  increasing-cons :
    {x y : R} {xs : List R} ->
    StrictLess reals x y ->
    StrictlyIncreasing reals (y ∷ xs) ->
    StrictlyIncreasing reals (x ∷ y ∷ xs)

data FirstAtLeastOne
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) :
  List R -> Set where

  first-at-least-one :
    {x : R} {xs : List R} ->
    lessOrEqual reals (oneR reals) x ->
    FirstAtLeastOne reals (x ∷ xs)

data LastAtMost2019
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) :
  List R -> Set where

  last-at-most :
    {x : R} ->
    lessOrEqual reals x (fromNat reals 2019) ->
    LastAtMost2019 reals (x ∷ [])
  preceding-coefficient :
    {x : R} {xs : List R} ->
    LastAtMost2019 reals xs ->
    LastAtMost2019 reals (x ∷ xs)

CoefficientConditions :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  List R ->
  Set
CoefficientConditions reals coefficients =
  HasLength coefficients 2020
  and
  FirstAtLeastOne reals coefficients
  and
  LastAtMost2019 reals coefficients
  and
  StrictlyIncreasing reals coefficients

record Complex (R : Set) : Set where
  constructor complex
  field
    realPart      : R
    imaginaryPart : R

complexZero :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Complex R
complexZero reals =
  complex (zeroR reals) (zeroR reals)

complexOne :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Complex R
complexOne reals =
  complex (oneR reals) (zeroR reals)

realComplex :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  Complex R
realComplex reals x =
  complex x (zeroR reals)

complexAdd :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Complex R ->
  Complex R ->
  Complex R
complexAdd reals (complex a b) (complex c d) =
  complex
    (add reals a c)
    (add reals b d)

complexNegate :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Complex R ->
  Complex R
complexNegate reals (complex a b) =
  complex
    (negate reals a)
    (negate reals b)

complexSubtract :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Complex R ->
  Complex R ->
  Complex R
complexSubtract reals z w =
  complexAdd reals z (complexNegate reals w)

complexMultiply :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Complex R ->
  Complex R ->
  Complex R
complexMultiply reals (complex a b) (complex c d) =
  complex
    (add reals
      (multiply reals a c)
      (negate reals (multiply reals b d)))
    (add reals
      (multiply reals a d)
      (multiply reals b c))

complexScale :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  Complex R ->
  Complex R
complexScale reals scalar (complex a b) =
  complex
    (multiply reals scalar a)
    (multiply reals scalar b)

squaredMagnitude :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Complex R ->
  R
squaredMagnitude reals (complex a b) =
  add reals
    (multiply reals a a)
    (multiply reals b b)

complexMagnitude :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Complex R ->
  R
complexMagnitude reals z =
  squareRoot reals (squaredMagnitude reals z)

evaluatePolynomial :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  List R ->
  Complex R ->
  Complex R
evaluatePolynomial reals [] z =
  complexZero reals
evaluatePolynomial reals (coefficient ∷ coefficients) z =
  complexAdd reals
    (realComplex reals coefficient)
    (complexMultiply reals z
      (evaluatePolynomial reals coefficients z))

rootFactorProduct :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  List (Complex R) ->
  Complex R ->
  Complex R
rootFactorProduct reals [] z =
  complexOne reals
rootFactorProduct reals (root ∷ roots) z =
  complexMultiply reals
    (complexSubtract reals z root)
    (rootFactorProduct reals roots z)

RootEnumeration :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  List R ->
  List (Complex R) ->
  Set
RootEnumeration {R} reals coefficients roots =
  HasLength roots 2019
  and
  Exists R
    (\ leadingCoefficient ->
      LastElement coefficients leadingCoefficient
      and
      ((z : Complex R) ->
        evaluatePolynomial reals coefficients z ==
        complexScale reals leadingCoefficient
          (rootFactorProduct reals roots z)))

sumRootMagnitudes :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  List (Complex R) ->
  R
sumRootMagnitudes reals [] =
  zeroR reals
sumRootMagnitudes reals (root ∷ roots) =
  add reals
    (complexMagnitude reals root)
    (sumRootMagnitudes reals roots)

averageRootMagnitude :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  List (Complex R) ->
  R
averageRootMagnitude reals roots =
  divide reals
    (sumRootMagnitudes reals roots)
    (fromNat reals 2019)

PutnamSolutionValue :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  Set
PutnamSolutionValue reals solution =
  StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) solution
  and
  multiply reals
    (naturalPower reals solution 2019)
    (fromNat reals 2019)
  ==
  oneR reals

UniversalLowerBound :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  Set
UniversalLowerBound {R} reals lowerBound =
  (coefficients : List R) ->
  (roots : List (Complex R)) ->
  CoefficientConditions reals coefficients ->
  RootEnumeration reals coefficients roots ->
  lessOrEqual reals
    lowerBound
    (averageRootMagnitude reals roots)

record IsGreatestUniversalLowerBound
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R)
  (candidate : R) :
  Set where

  field
    candidate-is-lower-bound :
      UniversalLowerBound reals candidate

    greatest-among-lower-bounds :
      (other : R) ->
      UniversalLowerBound reals other ->
      lessOrEqual reals other candidate

putnam-2019-a3 : Set1
putnam-2019-a3 =
  (R : Set) ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) ->
  Exists R
    (\ solution ->
      PutnamSolutionValue reals solution
      and
      IsGreatestUniversalLowerBound reals solution)

title: putnam_2019_a3
