(*
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2019_a3:
  the greatest universal lower bound for the average modulus of the roots of
  a degree-2019 polynomial with real coefficients
  1 <= b_0 < ... < b_2019 <= 2019 is 2019^(-1/2019).
  This file contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open arithmeticTheory listTheory pred_setTheory realTheory transcTheory complexTheory;

val putnam_2019_a3 =
  ``let polynomial =
      \b : num -> real.
      \z : complex.
        ITSET
          (\k acc. complex_of_real (b k) * z pow k + acc)
          (count 2020)
          (0 : complex)
    in
    let admissible =
      \b : num -> real.
        1 <= b 0 /\
        b 2019 <= 2019 /\
        (!i : num. i < 2019 ==> b i < b (SUC i)) /\
        (!i : num. 2019 < i ==> b i = 0)
    in
    let full_root_list =
      \b : num -> real.
      \roots : complex list.
        LENGTH roots = 2019 /\
        !z : complex.
          polynomial b z =
            complex_of_real (b 2019) *
            FOLDL
              (\acc root. acc * (z - root))
              (1 : complex)
              roots
    in
    let root_average =
      \roots : complex list.
        SUM (MAP modu roots) / 2019
    in
    let lower_bound =
      \M : real.
        !b : num -> real. !roots : complex list.
          admissible b /\ full_root_list b roots
          ==>
          M <= root_average roots
    in
    let solution =
      (2019 : real) powr (-(1 : real) / 2019)
    in
      lower_bound solution /\
      !M : real. lower_bound M ==> M <= solution``;

title: putnam_2019_a3
content:
% Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2019_a3:
% the greatest universal lower bound for the average modulus of the 2019
% complex roots of a polynomial with real coefficients
% 1 <= b_0 < ... < b_2019 <= 2019 is 2019^(-1/2019).
% This file contains no proof.

putnam_2019_a3: THEORY
BEGIN
  complex: TYPE = [# real_part: real, imag_part: real #]
  coefficient_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> real]
  root_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> complex]

  complex_zero: complex =
    (# real_part := 0, imag_part := 0 #)

  complex_one: complex =
    (# real_part := 1, imag_part := 0 #)

  complex_of_real(value: real): complex =
    (# real_part := value, imag_part := 0 #)

  complex_neg(value: complex): complex =
    (# real_part := -real_part(value),
       imag_part := -imag_part(value) #)

  complex_add(left, right: complex): complex =
    (# real_part := real_part(left) + real_part(right),
       imag_part := imag_part(left) + imag_part(right) #)

  complex_sub(left, right: complex): complex =
    complex_add(left, complex_neg(right))

  complex_mul(left, right: complex): complex =
    (# real_part :=
         real_part(left) * real_part(right)
           - imag_part(left) * imag_part(right),
       imag_part :=
         real_part(left) * imag_part(right)
           + imag_part(left) * real_part(right) #)

  complex_scale(scalar: real, value: complex): complex =
    complex_mul(complex_of_real(scalar), value)

  complex_power(value: complex, exponent: nat): RECURSIVE complex =
    IF exponent = 0 THEN
      complex_one
    ELSE
      complex_mul(complex_power(value, exponent - 1), value)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE exponent

  polynomial_value(
      coefficients: coefficient_sequence,
      z: complex,
      count: nat): RECURSIVE complex =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      complex_zero
    ELSE
      LET index: nat = count - 1 IN
        complex_add(
          polynomial_value(coefficients, z, count - 1),
          complex_scale(
            coefficients(index),
            complex_power(z, index)))
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  root_product(
      roots: root_sequence,
      z: complex,
      count: nat): RECURSIVE complex =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      complex_one
    ELSE
      complex_mul(
        root_product(roots, z, count - 1),
        complex_sub(z, roots(count - 1)))
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  has_stated_coefficients(
      coefficients: coefficient_sequence): bool =
    1 <= coefficients(0)
      AND coefficients(2019) <= 2019
      AND FORALL (index: nat):
        index < 2019 IMPLIES
          coefficients(index) < coefficients(index + 1)

  enumerates_roots_with_multiplicity(
      coefficients: coefficient_sequence,
      roots: root_sequence): bool =
    FORALL (z: complex):
      polynomial_value(coefficients, z, 2020)
        = complex_scale(
            coefficients(2019),
            root_product(roots, z, 2019))

  nonnegative_square_root(value: real): real =
    epsilon(
      LAMBDA (root: real):
        0 <= root AND root * root = value)

  complex_modulus(value: complex): real =
    nonnegative_square_root(
      real_part(value) ^ 2 + imag_part(value) ^ 2)

  modulus_sum(
      roots: root_sequence,
      count: nat): RECURSIVE real =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      modulus_sum(roots, count - 1)
        + complex_modulus(roots(count - 1))
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  average_root_modulus(roots: root_sequence): real =
    modulus_sum(roots, 2019) / (2019 :: real)

  universal_lower_bound(bound: real): bool =
    FORALL
        (coefficients: coefficient_sequence),
        (roots: root_sequence):
      (has_stated_coefficients(coefficients)
        AND enumerates_roots_with_multiplicity(coefficients, roots))
      IMPLIES
        bound <= average_root_modulus(roots)

  is_greatest_universal_lower_bound(value: real): bool =
    universal_lower_bound(value)
      AND FORALL (bound: real):
        universal_lower_bound(bound) IMPLIES bound <= value

  putnam_2019_a3_solution: real =
    epsilon(
      LAMBDA (value: real):
        0 < value
          AND value ^ 2019 = 1 / (2019 :: real))

  putnam_2019_a3: bool =
    is_greatest_universal_lower_bound(
      putnam_2019_a3_solution)
END putnam_2019_a3

title: putnam_2019_a4
content:
(* Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2019_a4:
   whether a continuous real-valued function on R^3 whose surface integral
   over every unit sphere is zero must be identically zero; the answer is
   false. This file contains no proof. *)

From Stdlib Require Import Reals RiemannInt.

Local Open Scope R_scope.

Definition putnam_2019_a4_point : Type := (R * (R * R))%type.

Definition putnam_2019_a4_x (p : putnam_2019_a4_point) : R :=
  fst p.

Definition putnam_2019_a4_y (p : putnam_2019_a4_point) : R :=
  fst (snd p).

Definition putnam_2019_a4_z (p : putnam_2019_a4_point) : R :=
  snd (snd p).

Definition putnam_2019_a4_distance
    (p q : putnam_2019_a4_point) : R :=
  sqrt
    ((putnam_2019_a4_x p - putnam_2019_a4_x q) ^ 2 +
     (putnam_2019_a4_y p - putnam_2019_a4_y q) ^ 2 +
     (putnam_2019_a4_z p - putnam_2019_a4_z q) ^ 2).

Definition putnam_2019_a4_continuous
    (f : putnam_2019_a4_point -> R) : Prop :=
  forall p : putnam_2019_a4_point,
    forall epsilon : R,
      0 < epsilon ->
      exists delta : R,
        0 < delta /\
        forall q : putnam_2019_a4_point,
          putnam_2019_a4_distance q p < delta ->
          Rabs (f q - f p) < epsilon.

Definition putnam_2019_a4_unit_sphere_parameter
    (center : putnam_2019_a4_point)
    (theta phi : R) : putnam_2019_a4_point :=
  (putnam_2019_a4_x center + sin phi * cos theta,
   (putnam_2019_a4_y center + sin phi * sin theta,
    putnam_2019_a4_z center + cos phi)).

Definition putnam_2019_a4_surface_integrand
    (f : putnam_2019_a4_point -> R)
    (center : putnam_2019_a4_point)
    (theta phi : R) : R :=
  f (putnam_2019_a4_unit_sphere_parameter center theta phi) * sin phi.

(* This is the standard spherical-coordinate surface integral on the unit
   sphere centered at [center], with area element sin(phi) dphi dtheta. *)
Definition putnam_2019_a4_unit_sphere_integral_has_value
    (f : putnam_2019_a4_point -> R)
    (center : putnam_2019_a4_point)
    (value : R) : Prop :=
  exists inner_integrable :
      forall theta : R,
        Riemann_integrable
          (fun phi =>
             putnam_2019_a4_surface_integrand f center theta phi)
          0 PI,
    exists outer_integrable :
      Riemann_integrable
        (fun theta => RiemannInt (inner_integrable theta))
        0 (2 * PI),
      RiemannInt outer_integrable = value.

Theorem putnam_2019_a4 :
  (forall f : putnam_2019_a4_point -> R,
      putnam_2019_a4_continuous f ->
      (forall center : putnam_2019_a4_point,
          putnam_2019_a4_unit_sphere_integral_has_value f center 0) ->
      forall p : putnam_2019_a4_point, f p = 0) <->
  False.
Admitted.

title: putnam_2019_a4
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench artifact putnam_2019_a4,
  concerning whether vanishing surface integrals over every unit sphere force
  a continuous real-valued function on real three-space to vanish identically.
  The answer is negative. This file contains no proof.
*)

theory putnam_2019_a4
  imports Complex_Main
begin

type_synonym putnam_2019_a4_point = "real \<times> real \<times> real"

definition putnam_2019_a4_sphere_point ::
    "putnam_2019_a4_point \<Rightarrow> real \<Rightarrow> real \<Rightarrow>
      putnam_2019_a4_point" where
  "putnam_2019_a4_sphere_point C theta phi =
    (fst C + sin phi * cos theta,
      fst (snd C) + sin phi * sin theta,
      snd (snd C) + cos phi)"

definition putnam_2019_a4_surface_integral ::
    "(putnam_2019_a4_point \<Rightarrow> real) \<Rightarrow>
      putnam_2019_a4_point \<Rightarrow> real" where
  "putnam_2019_a4_surface_integral f C =
    lim (\<lambda>n::nat.
      let N = real (Suc n);
          dtheta = 2 * pi / N;
          dphi = pi / N
      in dtheta * dphi *
        (\<Sum>i<Suc n. \<Sum>j<Suc n.
          f (putnam_2019_a4_sphere_point C
            ((real i + 1 / 2) * dtheta)
            ((real j + 1 / 2) * dphi)) *
          sin ((real j + 1 / 2) * dphi)))"

theorem putnam_2019_a4:
  shows "\<not> (\<forall>f::putnam_2019_a4_point \<Rightarrow> real.
    continuous_on UNIV f \<longrightarrow>
    (\<forall>C. putnam_2019_a4_surface_integral f C = 0) \<longrightarrow>
    f = (\<lambda>_::putnam_2019_a4_point. 0))"
  oops

end

title: putnam_2019_a4
putnam_2019_a4
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2019_a4:
;; a nonzero continuous real-valued function on real three-space has zero
;; surface integral over every sphere of radius one, so the answer is no.
;; This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))

;; The scalar context is a Dedekind-complete ordered field, hence the real
;; field up to ordered-field isomorphism. Sine and cosine are fixed by their
;; Taylor-series limits, and PI is their usual least positive sine zero.
;; APPLY$ function objects retain the internally quantified arbitrary
;; real-valued function. The sphere integral is the unbounded limit of the
;; standard spherical-coordinate Riemann sums, including the sine Jacobian;
;; for continuous functions this is exactly integration against two-
;; dimensional Hausdorff measure on the unit sphere.

(defun p19a4-member-p (carrier x)
  (if (apply$ carrier (list x)) t nil))

(defun p19a4-unary-value (operation x)
  (apply$ operation (list x)))

(defun p19a4-binary-value (operation x y)
  (apply$ operation (list x y)))

(defun-sk p19a4-valid-set-p (carrier set)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (apply$ set (list x))
     (p19a4-member-p carrier x))))

(defun-sk p19a4-field-laws-p
    (carrier add multiply negate inverse zero one)
  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (p19a4-member-p carrier x)
      (p19a4-member-p carrier y)
      (p19a4-member-p carrier z))
     (and
      (p19a4-member-p
       carrier (p19a4-binary-value add x y))
      (p19a4-member-p
       carrier (p19a4-binary-value multiply x y))
      (p19a4-member-p
       carrier (p19a4-unary-value negate x))
      (p19a4-member-p
       carrier (p19a4-unary-value inverse x))
      (equal
       (p19a4-binary-value
        add (p19a4-binary-value add x y) z)
       (p19a4-binary-value
        add x (p19a4-binary-value add y z)))
      (equal
       (p19a4-binary-value add x y)
       (p19a4-binary-value add y x))
      (equal (p19a4-binary-value add x zero) x)
      (equal
       (p19a4-binary-value
        add x (p19a4-unary-value negate x))
       zero)
      (equal
       (p19a4-binary-value
        multiply
        (p19a4-binary-value multiply x y)
        z)
       (p19a4-binary-value
        multiply
        x
        (p19a4-binary-value multiply y z)))
      (equal
       (p19a4-binary-value multiply x y)
       (p19a4-binary-value multiply y x))
      (equal
       (p19a4-binary-value multiply x one)
       x)
      (implies
       (equal x zero)
       (equal (p19a4-unary-value inverse x) zero))
      (implies
       (not (equal x zero))
       (equal
        (p19a4-binary-value
         multiply x (p19a4-unary-value inverse x))
        one))
      (equal
       (p19a4-binary-value
        multiply x (p19a4-binary-value add y z))
       (p19a4-binary-value
        add
        (p19a4-binary-value multiply x y)
        (p19a4-binary-value multiply x z)))))))

(defun-sk p19a4-order-laws-p
    (carrier add multiply zero less)
  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (p19a4-member-p carrier x)
      (p19a4-member-p carrier y)
      (p19a4-member-p carrier z))
     (and
      (not (p19a4-binary-value less x x))
      (or
       (equal x y)
       (p19a4-binary-value less x y)
       (p19a4-binary-value less y x))
      (implies
       (and
        (p19a4-binary-value less x y)
        (p19a4-binary-value less y z))
       (p19a4-binary-value less x z))
      (implies
       (p19a4-binary-value less x y)
       (p19a4-binary-value
        less
        (p19a4-binary-value add x z)
        (p19a4-binary-value add y z)))
      (implies
       (and
        (p19a4-binary-value less zero x)
        (p19a4-binary-value less zero y))
       (p19a4-binary-value
        less
        zero
        (p19a4-binary-value multiply x y)))))))

(defun-sk p19a4-set-nonempty-p (carrier set)
  (exists (x)
    (and
     (p19a4-member-p carrier x)
     (apply$ set (list x)))))

(defun-sk p19a4-upper-bound-p
    (carrier less set bound)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (and
      (p19a4-member-p carrier x)
      (apply$ set (list x)))
     (not
      (p19a4-binary-value less bound x)))))

(defun-sk p19a4-bounded-above-p
    (carrier less set)
  (exists (bound)
    (and
     (p19a4-member-p carrier bound)
     (p19a4-upper-bound-p
      carrier less set bound))))

(defun-sk p19a4-least-upper-bound-p
    (carrier less set supremum)
  (forall (bound)
    (implies
     (and
      (p19a4-member-p carrier bound)
      (p19a4-upper-bound-p
       carrier less set bound))
     (not
      (p19a4-binary-value
       less bound supremum)))))

(defun p19a4-supremum-p
    (carrier less set supremum)
  (and
   (p19a4-member-p carrier supremum)
   (p19a4-upper-bound-p
    carrier less set supremum)
   (p19a4-least-upper-bound-p
    carrier less set supremum)))

(defun-sk p19a4-has-supremum-p
    (carrier less set)
  (exists (supremum)
    (p19a4-supremum-p
     carrier less set supremum)))

(defun-sk p19a4-dedekind-complete-p
    (carrier less)
  (forall (set)
    (implies
     (and
      (tamep-functionp set)
      (p19a4-valid-set-p carrier set)
      (p19a4-set-nonempty-p carrier set)
      (p19a4-bounded-above-p carrier less set))
     (p19a4-has-supremum-p
      carrier less set))))

(defun p19a4-real-field-p
    (carrier add multiply negate inverse zero one less)
  (and
   (tamep-functionp carrier)
   (tamep-functionp add)
   (tamep-functionp multiply)
   (tamep-functionp negate)
   (tamep-functionp inverse)
   (tamep-functionp less)
   (p19a4-member-p carrier zero)
   (p19a4-member-p carrier one)
   (not (equal zero one))
   (p19a4-field-laws-p
    carrier add multiply negate inverse zero one)
   (p19a4-order-laws-p
    carrier add multiply zero less)
   (p19a4-binary-value less zero one)
   (p19a4-dedekind-complete-p carrier less)))

;; Context projections and real arithmetic.

(defun p19a4-r-carrier (ctx) (nth 0 ctx))
(defun p19a4-r-zero (ctx) (nth 1 ctx))
(defun p19a4-r-one (ctx) (nth 2 ctx))
(defun p19a4-r-add (ctx) (nth 3 ctx))
(defun p19a4-r-mul (ctx) (nth 4 ctx))
(defun p19a4-r-neg (ctx) (nth 5 ctx))
(defun p19a4-r-inv (ctx) (nth 6 ctx))
(defun p19a4-r-lt (ctx) (nth 7 ctx))
(defun p19a4-r-sin (ctx) (nth 8 ctx))
(defun p19a4-r-cos (ctx) (nth 9 ctx))
(defun p19a4-r-pi (ctx) (nth 10 ctx))

(defun p19a4-r-add-value (ctx x y)
  (p19a4-binary-value (p19a4-r-add ctx) x y))

(defun p19a4-r-mul-value (ctx x y)
  (p19a4-binary-value (p19a4-r-mul ctx) x y))

(defun p19a4-r-neg-value (ctx x)
  (p19a4-unary-value (p19a4-r-neg ctx) x))

(defun p19a4-r-inv-value (ctx x)
  (p19a4-unary-value (p19a4-r-inv ctx) x))

(defun p19a4-r-sub-value (ctx x y)
  (p19a4-r-add-value
   ctx x (p19a4-r-neg-value ctx y)))

(defun p19a4-r-div-value (ctx x y)
  (p19a4-r-mul-value
   ctx x (p19a4-r-inv-value ctx y)))

(defun p19a4-r-lt-p (ctx x y)
  (if (p19a4-binary-value
       (p19a4-r-lt ctx) x y)
      t nil))

(defun p19a4-r-abs-value (ctx x)
  (if (p19a4-r-lt-p
       ctx x (p19a4-r-zero ctx))
      (p19a4-r-neg-value ctx x)
    x))

(defun p19a4-positive-real-p (ctx x)
  (and
   (p19a4-member-p (p19a4-r-carrier ctx) x)
   (p19a4-r-lt-p
    ctx (p19a4-r-zero ctx) x)))

(defun p19a4-nat-cast (ctx n)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix n)))
  (if (zp n)
      (p19a4-r-zero ctx)
    (p19a4-r-add-value
     ctx
     (p19a4-r-one ctx)
     (p19a4-nat-cast ctx (- n 1)))))

(defun p19a4-nat-power (ctx x exponent)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix exponent)))
  (if (zp exponent)
      (p19a4-r-one ctx)
    (p19a4-r-mul-value
     ctx x
     (p19a4-nat-power ctx x (- exponent 1)))))

(defun p19a4-factorial (n)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix n)))
  (if (zp n)
      1
    (* (nfix n)
       (p19a4-factorial (- n 1)))))

;; Sine and cosine are characterized by convergence of their Maclaurin
;; series at every real argument.

(defun p19a4-trig-term (ctx x cosine-p k)
  (let* ((exponent
          (if cosine-p
              (* 2 (nfix k))
            (+ 1 (* 2 (nfix k)))))
         (numerator
          (p19a4-nat-power ctx x exponent))
         (denominator
          (p19a4-nat-cast
           ctx (p19a4-factorial exponent)))
         (unsigned
          (p19a4-r-div-value
           ctx numerator denominator)))
    (if (equal (mod (nfix k) 2) 0)
        unsigned
      (p19a4-r-neg-value ctx unsigned))))

(defun p19a4-trig-partial-sum
    (ctx x cosine-p terms)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix terms)))
  (if (zp terms)
      (p19a4-r-zero ctx)
    (p19a4-r-add-value
     ctx
     (p19a4-trig-term
      ctx x cosine-p (- terms 1))
     (p19a4-trig-partial-sum
      ctx x cosine-p (- terms 1)))))

(defun p19a4-trig-value (ctx x cosine-p)
  (p19a4-unary-value
   (if cosine-p
       (p19a4-r-cos ctx)
     (p19a4-r-sin ctx))
   x))

(defun-sk p19a4-trig-tail-p
    (ctx x cosine-p epsilon cutoff)
  (forall (terms)
    (implies
     (and
      (natp terms)
      (<= cutoff terms))
     (p19a4-r-lt-p
      ctx
      (p19a4-r-abs-value
       ctx
       (p19a4-r-sub-value
        ctx
        (p19a4-trig-partial-sum
         ctx x cosine-p terms)
        (p19a4-trig-value
         ctx x cosine-p)))
      epsilon))))

(defun-sk p19a4-trig-cutoff-exists-p
    (ctx x cosine-p epsilon)
  (exists (cutoff)
    (and
     (natp cutoff)
     (p19a4-trig-tail-p
      ctx x cosine-p epsilon cutoff))))

(defun-sk p19a4-trig-converges-p
    (ctx x cosine-p)
  (forall (epsilon)
    (implies
     (p19a4-positive-real-p ctx epsilon)
     (p19a4-trig-cutoff-exists-p
      ctx x cosine-p epsilon))))

(defun-sk p19a4-trig-laws-p (ctx)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (p19a4-member-p (p19a4-r-carrier ctx) x)
     (and
      (p19a4-member-p
       (p19a4-r-carrier ctx)
       (p19a4-trig-value ctx x nil))
      (p19a4-member-p
       (p19a4-r-carrier ctx)
       (p19a4-trig-value ctx x t))
      (p19a4-trig-converges-p ctx x nil)
      (p19a4-trig-converges-p ctx x t)))))

(defun-sk p19a4-sine-positive-before-p (ctx)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (and
      (p19a4-member-p (p19a4-r-carrier ctx) x)
      (p19a4-r-lt-p
       ctx (p19a4-r-zero ctx) x)
      (p19a4-r-lt-p
       ctx x (p19a4-r-pi ctx)))
     (p19a4-r-lt-p
      ctx
      (p19a4-r-zero ctx)
      (p19a4-trig-value ctx x nil)))))

(defun p19a4-pi-p (ctx)
  (and
   (p19a4-positive-real-p
    ctx (p19a4-r-pi ctx))
   (equal
    (p19a4-trig-value
     ctx (p19a4-r-pi ctx) nil)
    (p19a4-r-zero ctx))
   (p19a4-sine-positive-before-p ctx)))

(defun p19a4-context-p (ctx)
  (and
   (true-listp ctx)
   (equal (len ctx) 11)
   (tamep-functionp (p19a4-r-sin ctx))
   (tamep-functionp (p19a4-r-cos ctx))
   (p19a4-real-field-p
    (p19a4-r-carrier ctx)
    (p19a4-r-add ctx)
    (p19a4-r-mul ctx)
    (p19a4-r-neg ctx)
    (p19a4-r-inv ctx)
    (p19a4-r-zero ctx)
    (p19a4-r-one ctx)
    (p19a4-r-lt ctx))
   (p19a4-trig-laws-p ctx)
   (p19a4-pi-p ctx)))

;; Real three-space and continuous real-valued function objects.

(defun p19a4-r3-point-p (ctx point)
  (and
   (true-listp point)
   (equal (len point) 3)
   (p19a4-member-p
    (p19a4-r-carrier ctx) (nth 0 point))
   (p19a4-member-p
    (p19a4-r-carrier ctx) (nth 1 point))
   (p19a4-member-p
    (p19a4-r-carrier ctx) (nth 2 point))))

(defun p19a4-square (ctx x)
  (p19a4-r-mul-value ctx x x))

(defun p19a4-distance-squared (ctx left right)
  (p19a4-r-add-value
   ctx
   (p19a4-square
    ctx
    (p19a4-r-sub-value
     ctx (nth 0 left) (nth 0 right)))
   (p19a4-r-add-value
    ctx
    (p19a4-square
     ctx
     (p19a4-r-sub-value
      ctx (nth 1 left) (nth 1 right)))
    (p19a4-square
     ctx
     (p19a4-r-sub-value
      ctx (nth 2 left) (nth 2 right))))))

(defun-sk p19a4-real-function-p (ctx function)
  (forall (point)
    (implies
     (p19a4-r3-point-p ctx point)
     (p19a4-member-p
      (p19a4-r-carrier ctx)
      (p19a4-unary-value function point)))))

(defun-sk p19a4-continuity-neighborhood-p
    (ctx function point epsilon radius)
  (forall (nearby)
    (implies
     (and
      (p19a4-r3-point-p ctx nearby)
      (p19a4-r-lt-p
       ctx
       (p19a4-distance-squared
        ctx nearby point)
       (p19a4-square ctx radius)))
     (p19a4-r-lt-p
      ctx
      (p19a4-r-abs-value
       ctx
       (p19a4-r-sub-value
        ctx
        (p19a4-unary-value function nearby)
        (p19a4-unary-value function point)))
      epsilon))))

(defun-sk p19a4-continuity-radius-exists-p
    (ctx function point epsilon)
  (exists (radius)
    (and
     (p19a4-positive-real-p ctx radius)
     (p19a4-continuity-neighborhood-p
      ctx function point epsilon radius))))

(defun-sk p19a4-continuous-at-p
    (ctx function point)
  (forall (epsilon)
    (implies
     (p19a4-positive-real-p ctx epsilon)
     (p19a4-continuity-radius-exists-p
      ctx function point epsilon))))

(defun-sk p19a4-continuous-p
    (ctx function)
  (forall (point)
    (implies
     (p19a4-r3-point-p ctx point)
     (p19a4-continuous-at-p
      ctx function point))))

;; Uniform spherical-coordinate sums for the radius-one surface integral.

(defun p19a4-two (ctx)
  (p19a4-r-add-value
   ctx (p19a4-r-one ctx) (p19a4-r-one ctx)))

(defun p19a4-grid-angle
    (ctx scale index subdivisions)
  (p19a4-r-div-value
   ctx
   (p19a4-r-mul-value
    ctx scale (p19a4-nat-cast ctx index))
   (p19a4-nat-cast ctx subdivisions)))

(defun p19a4-sphere-point
    (ctx center theta phi)
  (let* ((sin-theta
          (p19a4-trig-value ctx theta nil))
         (cos-theta
          (p19a4-trig-value ctx theta t))
         (sin-phi
          (p19a4-trig-value ctx phi nil))
         (cos-phi
          (p19a4-trig-value ctx phi t)))
    (list
     (p19a4-r-add-value
      ctx
      (nth 0 center)
      (p19a4-r-mul-value
       ctx sin-theta cos-phi))
     (p19a4-r-add-value
      ctx
      (nth 1 center)
      (p19a4-r-mul-value
       ctx sin-theta sin-phi))
     (p19a4-r-add-value
      ctx
      (nth 2 center)
      cos-theta))))

(defun p19a4-surface-summand
    (ctx function center subdivisions i j)
  (let* ((theta
          (p19a4-grid-angle
           ctx (p19a4-r-pi ctx)
           i subdivisions))
         (two-pi
          (p19a4-r-mul-value
           ctx (p19a4-two ctx) (p19a4-r-pi ctx)))
         (phi
          (p19a4-grid-angle
           ctx two-pi j subdivisions))
         (point
          (p19a4-sphere-point
           ctx center theta phi)))
    (p19a4-r-mul-value
     ctx
     (p19a4-unary-value function point)
     (p19a4-trig-value ctx theta nil))))

(defun p19a4-surface-inner-sum
    (ctx function center subdivisions i remaining-j)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix remaining-j)))
  (if (zp remaining-j)
      (p19a4-r-zero ctx)
    (p19a4-r-add-value
     ctx
     (p19a4-surface-summand
      ctx function center subdivisions
      i remaining-j)
     (p19a4-surface-inner-sum
      ctx function center subdivisions
      i (- remaining-j 1)))))

(defun p19a4-surface-double-sum
    (ctx function center subdivisions remaining-i)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix remaining-i)))
  (if (zp remaining-i)
      (p19a4-r-zero ctx)
    (p19a4-r-add-value
     ctx
     (p19a4-surface-inner-sum
      ctx function center subdivisions
      remaining-i subdivisions)
     (p19a4-surface-double-sum
      ctx function center subdivisions
      (- remaining-i 1)))))

(defun p19a4-surface-integral-approx
    (ctx function center subdivisions)
  (if (posp subdivisions)
      (let* ((denominator
              (p19a4-nat-cast ctx subdivisions))
             (delta-theta
              (p19a4-r-div-value
               ctx (p19a4-r-pi ctx) denominator))
             (delta-phi
              (p19a4-r-div-value
               ctx
               (p19a4-r-mul-value
                ctx
                (p19a4-two ctx)
                (p19a4-r-pi ctx))
               denominator)))
        (p19a4-r-mul-value
         ctx
         (p19a4-r-mul-value
          ctx delta-theta delta-phi)
         (p19a4-surface-double-sum
          ctx function center subdivisions
          subdivisions)))
    (p19a4-r-zero ctx)))

(defun-sk p19a4-zero-surface-integral-tail-p
    (ctx function center epsilon cutoff)
  (forall (subdivisions)
    (implies
     (and
      (posp subdivisions)
      (<= cutoff subdivisions))
     (p19a4-r-lt-p
      ctx
      (p19a4-r-abs-value
       ctx
       (p19a4-surface-integral-approx
        ctx function center subdivisions))
      epsilon))))

(defun-sk p19a4-zero-surface-integral-cutoff-exists-p
    (ctx function center epsilon)
  (exists (cutoff)
    (and
     (posp cutoff)
     (p19a4-zero-surface-integral-tail-p
      ctx function center epsilon cutoff))))

(defun-sk p19a4-zero-surface-integral-p
    (ctx function center)
  (forall (epsilon)
    (implies
     (p19a4-positive-real-p ctx epsilon)
     (p19a4-zero-surface-integral-cutoff-exists-p
      ctx function center epsilon))))

(defun-sk p19a4-all-unit-sphere-integrals-zero-p
    (ctx function)
  (forall (center)
    (implies
     (p19a4-r3-point-p ctx center)
     (p19a4-zero-surface-integral-p
      ctx function center))))

(defun-sk p19a4-function-nonzero-p
    (ctx function)
  (exists (point)
    (and
     (p19a4-r3-point-p ctx point)
     (not
      (equal
       (p19a4-unary-value function point)
       (p19a4-r-zero ctx))))))

(defun-sk p19a4-counterexample-exists-p (ctx)
  (exists (function)
    (and
     (tamep-functionp function)
     (p19a4-real-function-p ctx function)
     (p19a4-continuous-p ctx function)
     (p19a4-all-unit-sphere-integrals-zero-p
      ctx function)
     (p19a4-function-nonzero-p
      ctx function))))

(defun putnambench-putnam-2019-a4-statement (ctx)
  (implies
   (p19a4-context-p ctx)
   (p19a4-counterexample-exists-p ctx)))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

title: putnam_2019_a4
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2019_a4
-- (putnambench__agda__putnam_2019_a4): whether a continuous real-valued
-- function on real three-space with zero integral over every unit sphere must
-- vanish identically; the answer is no. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module Main where

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; _*_)

infix 4 _!=_ _<=N_
infixr 3 _and_
infixr 2 _or_
infix 1 _iff_

data Bottom : Set where

Not : Set -> Set
Not A =
  A -> Bottom

_!=_ : {A : Set} -> A -> A -> Set
x != y =
  Not (x == y)

record _and_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data _or_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  left  : A -> A or B
  right : B -> A or B

record _iff_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor equivalence
  field
    forward  : A -> B
    backward : B -> A

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

data _<=N_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set where
  zero<=N   : {n : Nat} -> zero <=N n
  suc<=sucN : {m n : Nat} -> m <=N n -> suc m <=N suc n

record CompleteOrderedRealField (R : Set) : Set1 where
  field
    zeroR oneR : R
    add multiply : R -> R -> R
    negate inverse absoluteValue : R -> R
    lessOrEqual : R -> R -> Set
    fromNat : Nat -> R

    one-not-zero :
      oneR != zeroR

    add-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> add x y == add y x
    add-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      add (add x y) z == add x (add y z)
    add-zero :
      (x : R) -> add x zeroR == x
    add-inverse :
      (x : R) -> add x (negate x) == zeroR

    multiply-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> multiply x y == multiply y x
    multiply-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply (multiply x y) z ==
      multiply x (multiply y z)
    multiply-one :
      (x : R) -> multiply x oneR == x
    multiply-zero :
      (x : R) -> multiply x zeroR == zeroR
    distribute :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply x (add y z) ==
      add (multiply x y) (multiply x z)
    inverse-zero :
      inverse zeroR == zeroR
    multiply-inverse :
      (x : R) ->
      x != zeroR ->
      multiply x (inverse x) == oneR

    order-reflexive :
      (x : R) -> lessOrEqual x x
    order-transitive :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y z ->
      lessOrEqual x z
    order-antisymmetric :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y x ->
      x == y
    order-total :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y or lessOrEqual y x
    add-order :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual (add z x) (add z y)
    multiply-nonnegative :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR x ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR y ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR (multiply x y)
    zero-less-than-one :
      lessOrEqual zeroR oneR and zeroR != oneR

    absolute-nonnegative :
      (x : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR (absoluteValue x)
    absolute-of-nonnegative :
      (x : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR x ->
      absoluteValue x == x
    absolute-of-nonpositive :
      (x : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x zeroR ->
      absoluteValue x == negate x

    fromNat-zero :
      fromNat zero == zeroR
    fromNat-successor :
      (n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (suc n) == add (fromNat n) oneR
    fromNat-addition :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m + n) == add (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-multiplication :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m * n) == multiply (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-injective :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat m == fromNat n ->
      m == n

    archimedean :
      (x : R) ->
      Exists Nat
        (\ n -> lessOrEqual x (fromNat n))
    least-upper-bound :
      (P : R -> Set) ->
      Exists R P ->
      Exists R
        (\ upper ->
          (x : R) ->
          P x ->
          lessOrEqual x upper) ->
      Exists R
        (\ supremum ->
          ((x : R) ->
            P x ->
            lessOrEqual x supremum)
          and
          ((upper : R) ->
            ((x : R) ->
              P x ->
              lessOrEqual x upper) ->
            lessOrEqual supremum upper))

open CompleteOrderedRealField

oneN : Nat
oneN =
  suc zero

twoN : Nat
twoN =
  suc oneN

subtract :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
subtract reals x y =
  add reals x (negate reals y)

divide :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
divide reals x y =
  multiply reals x (inverse reals y)

square :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R
square reals x =
  multiply reals x x

StrictLess :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
StrictLess reals x y =
  lessOrEqual reals x y and x != y

CloseTo :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
CloseTo reals center radius x =
  StrictLess reals
    (absoluteValue reals (subtract reals x center))
    radius

sumFirst :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Nat ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  R
sumFirst reals zero terms =
  zeroR reals
sumFirst reals (suc n) terms =
  add reals
    (sumFirst reals n terms)
    (terms n)

factorial : Nat -> Nat
factorial zero =
  oneN
factorial (suc n) =
  suc n * factorial n

naturalPower :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  Nat ->
  R
naturalPower reals x zero =
  oneR reals
naturalPower reals x (suc n) =
  multiply reals
    (naturalPower reals x n)
    x

alternate :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Nat ->
  R ->
  R
alternate reals zero x =
  x
alternate reals (suc n) x =
  negate reals (alternate reals n x)

evenExponent : Nat -> Nat
evenExponent n =
  n + n

oddExponent : Nat -> Nat
oddExponent n =
  suc (evenExponent n)

sineTerm :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  Nat ->
  R
sineTerm reals x n =
  alternate reals n
    (divide reals
      (naturalPower reals x (oddExponent n))
      (fromNat reals (factorial (oddExponent n))))

cosineTerm :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  Nat ->
  R
cosineTerm reals x n =
  alternate reals n
    (divide reals
      (naturalPower reals x (evenExponent n))
      (fromNat reals (factorial (evenExponent n))))

ConvergesTo :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  R ->
  Set
ConvergesTo {R} reals sequence limit =
  (epsilon : R) ->
  StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) epsilon ->
  Exists Nat
    (\ cutoff ->
      (n : Nat) ->
      cutoff <=N n ->
      CloseTo reals limit epsilon (sequence n))

SeriesHasSum :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  R ->
  Set
SeriesHasSum reals terms value =
  ConvergesTo reals
    (\ n -> sumFirst reals n terms)
    value

record StandardTrigonometry
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) :
  Set1 where

  field
    sine cosine : R -> R
    pi : R

    sine-is-power-series :
      (x : R) ->
      SeriesHasSum reals
        (sineTerm reals x)
        (sine x)
    cosine-is-power-series :
      (x : R) ->
      SeriesHasSum reals
        (cosineTerm reals x)
        (cosine x)

    pi-positive :
      StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) pi
    sine-pi-zero :
      sine pi == zeroR reals
    pi-is-first-positive-sine-zero :
      (x : R) ->
      StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) x ->
      sine x == zeroR reals ->
      lessOrEqual reals pi x

open StandardTrigonometry

ContinuousAt :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (R -> R) ->
  R ->
  Set
ContinuousAt {R} reals function point =
  (epsilon : R) ->
  StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) epsilon ->
  Exists R
    (\ delta ->
      StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) delta
      and
      ((x : R) ->
        CloseTo reals point delta x ->
        CloseTo reals
          (function point)
          epsilon
          (function x)))

Continuous :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (R -> R) ->
  Set
Continuous {R} reals function =
  (point : R) ->
  ContinuousAt reals function point

rightRiemannSum :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  (R -> R) ->
  Nat ->
  R
rightRiemannSum reals lower upper function pieces =
  let
    step =
      divide reals
        (subtract reals upper lower)
        (fromNat reals pieces)
  in
  sumFirst reals pieces
    (\ i ->
      multiply reals
        (function
          (add reals lower
            (multiply reals
              (fromNat reals (suc i))
              step)))
        step)

IntervalIntegralValue :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  (R -> R) ->
  R ->
  Set
IntervalIntegralValue reals lower upper function value =
  ConvergesTo reals
    (\ n ->
      rightRiemannSum reals
        lower
        upper
        function
        (suc n))
    value

record StandardIntervalIntegration
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) :
  Set1 where

  field
    intervalIntegral :
      R ->
      R ->
      (R -> R) ->
      R

    interval-integral-of-continuous :
      (lower upper : R) ->
      (function : R -> R) ->
      Continuous reals function ->
      IntervalIntegralValue reals
        lower
        upper
        function
        (intervalIntegral lower upper function)

open StandardIntervalIntegration

record Point3 (R : Set) : Set where
  constructor point3
  field
    x-coordinate : R
    y-coordinate : R
    z-coordinate : R

open Point3

squaredDistance :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Point3 R ->
  Point3 R ->
  R
squaredDistance reals p q =
  add reals
    (square reals
      (subtract reals
        (x-coordinate p)
        (x-coordinate q)))
    (add reals
      (square reals
        (subtract reals
          (y-coordinate p)
          (y-coordinate q)))
      (square reals
        (subtract reals
          (z-coordinate p)
          (z-coordinate q))))

Continuous3 :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (Point3 R -> R) ->
  Set
Continuous3 {R} reals function =
  (center : Point3 R) ->
  (epsilon : R) ->
  StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) epsilon ->
  Exists R
    (\ delta ->
      StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) delta
      and
      ((point : Point3 R) ->
        StrictLess reals
          (squaredDistance reals point center)
          (square reals delta) ->
        CloseTo reals
          (function center)
          epsilon
          (function point)))

SameFunction :
  {A B : Set} ->
  (A -> B) ->
  (A -> B) ->
  Set
SameFunction {A} leftFunction rightFunction =
  (x : A) ->
  leftFunction x == rightFunction x

module Putnam2019A4Statement
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R)
  (trigonometry : StandardTrigonometry reals)
  (integration : StandardIntervalIntegration reals) where

  twoPi : R
  twoPi =
    multiply reals
      (fromNat reals twoN)
      (pi trigonometry)

  unitSpherePoint :
    Point3 R ->
    R ->
    R ->
    Point3 R
  unitSpherePoint center theta phi =
    point3
      (add reals
        (x-coordinate center)
        (multiply reals
          (sine trigonometry theta)
          (cosine trigonometry phi)))
      (add reals
        (y-coordinate center)
        (multiply reals
          (sine trigonometry theta)
          (sine trigonometry phi)))
      (add reals
        (z-coordinate center)
        (cosine trigonometry theta))

  unitSphereSurfaceIntegral :
    Point3 R ->
    (Point3 R -> R) ->
    R
  unitSphereSurfaceIntegral center function =
    intervalIntegral integration
      (zeroR reals)
      (pi trigonometry)
      (\ theta ->
        intervalIntegral integration
          (zeroR reals)
          twoPi
          (\ phi ->
            multiply reals
              (function
                (unitSpherePoint center theta phi))
              (sine trigonometry theta)))

  AllUnitSphereIntegralsVanish :
    (Point3 R -> R) ->
    Set
  AllUnitSphereIntegralsVanish function =
    (center : Point3 R) ->
    unitSphereSurfaceIntegral center function ==
    zeroR reals

  UniversalZeroConclusion : Set
  UniversalZeroConclusion =
    (function : Point3 R -> R) ->
    Continuous3 reals function ->
    AllUnitSphereIntegralsVanish function ->
    SameFunction function
      (\ _ -> zeroR reals)

putnam-2019-a4-solution : Set
putnam-2019-a4-solution =
  Bottom

putnam-2019-a4 : Set1
putnam-2019-a4 =
  (R : Set) ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) ->
  (trigonometry : StandardTrigonometry reals) ->
  (integration : StandardIntervalIntegration reals) ->
  Putnam2019A4Statement.UniversalZeroConclusion
    reals
    trigonometry
    integration
  iff
  putnam-2019-a4-solution

(*
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2019_a4:
  the assertion that every continuous real-valued function on real
  three-space with zero surface integral over every unit sphere is identically
  zero has the negative answer. This file contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open pairTheory pred_setTheory realTheory real_sigmaTheory transcTheory
     integrationTheory;

val putnam_2019_a4 =
  ``let sqdist =
      \p q : real # (real # real).
        (FST q - FST p) pow 2 +
        (FST (SND q) - FST (SND p)) pow 2 +
        (SND (SND q) - SND (SND p)) pow 2
    in
    let continuous3 =
      \f : (real # (real # real)) -> real.
        !p : real # (real # real).
        !e : real.
          0 < e
          ==>
          ?d : real.
            0 < d /\
            !q : real # (real # real).
              sqdist p q < d ==> abs (f q - f p) < e
    in
    let unit_sphere_integral =
      \f : (real # (real # real)) -> real.
      \c : real # (real # real).
        integration$integral (interval [0, 2 * pi])
          (\theta : real.
             integration$integral (interval [0, pi])
               (\phi : real.
                  f
                    (FST c + sin phi * cos theta,
                     (FST (SND c) + sin phi * sin theta,
                      SND (SND c) + cos phi)) *
                  sin phi))
    in
      ((!f : (real # (real # real)) -> real.
          continuous3 f
          ==>
          (!c : real # (real # real). unit_sphere_integral f c = 0)
          ==>
          f = (\p : real # (real # real). 0))
       <=>
       F)``;

title: putnam_2019_a4
content:
$(
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact
  putnam_2019_a4: a nonzero continuous real-valued function on real
  three-space has zero surface integral over every unit sphere, giving a
  negative answer to the stated uniqueness question. This file contains no
  proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  P19A4R3 is real Euclidean three-space indexed by the three-element ordinal,
  and P19A4Dist is its Euclidean distance. P19A4Continuous expands continuity
  in the Euclidean metric.

  P19A4SpherePoint C t p is the point on the unit sphere centered at C with
  azimuth t and polar angle p. P19A4SurfaceIntegral uses the standard
  spherical parametrization and its sin(p) surface-area factor. For continuous
  F, the iterated real Lebesgue integral is exactly the integral against
  two-dimensional Hausdorff measure on the unit sphere; the parametrization's
  repetitions occur only on measure-zero boundary sets.

  The final existential is the negation of the universal zero conclusion in
  the source. The source predicate P is inlined using P_def, and its annotated
  solution False turns the displayed biconditional into this counterexample
  statement. The final declaration is the single unproved $a corpus statement;
  this database contains no $p proof declaration.
$)

$c P19A4R3 P19A4Dist P19A4Continuous P19A4SpherePoint
   P19A4SurfaceIntegral $.

p19a4-space-syntax $a class P19A4R3 $.
p19a4-distance-syntax $a class ( P19A4Dist A B ) $.
p19a4-continuous-syntax $a wff ( P19A4Continuous F ) $.
p19a4-sphere-point-syntax $a class ( P19A4SpherePoint C t p ) $.
p19a4-surface-integral-syntax $a class ( P19A4SurfaceIntegral F C ) $.

p19a4-space-definition $a |- P19A4R3 = ( RR ^m 3 ) $.

${
  $d A B k $.

  p19a4-distance-definition $a |- (
    P19A4Dist A B
  ) = (
    sqrt
    `
    (
      sum_ k e. 3
        ( ( ( A ` k ) - ( B ` k ) ) ^ 2 )
    )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d F A B d e $.

  p19a4-continuous-definition $a |- (
    ( P19A4Continuous F )
    <->
    A. A e. P19A4R3 A. e e. RR
      (
        0 < e
        ->
        E. d e. RR
          (
            0 < d
            /\
            A. B e. P19A4R3
              (
                ( P19A4Dist A B ) < d
                ->
                (
                  abs
                  `
                  (
                    ( F ` A )
                    -
                    ( F ` B )
                  )
                )
                < e
              )
          )
      )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d C k p t $.

  p19a4-sphere-point-definition $a |- (
    P19A4SpherePoint C t p
  ) = (
    k e. 3 |->
      if (
        k = 0 ,
        (
          ( C ` 0 )
          +
          (
            ( sin ` p )
            x.
            ( cos ` t )
          )
        ) ,
        if (
          k = 1 ,
          (
            ( C ` 1 )
            +
            (
              ( sin ` p )
              x.
              ( sin ` t )
            )
          ) ,
          (
            ( C ` 2 )
            +
            ( cos ` p )
          )
        )
      )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d F C p t $.

  p19a4-surface-integral-definition $a |- (
    P19A4SurfaceIntegral F C
  ) = (
    S. ( 0 [,] ( 2 x. _pi ) )
      (
        S. ( 0 [,] _pi )
          (
            (
              F
              `
              ( P19A4SpherePoint C t p )
            )
            x.
            ( sin ` p )
          )
          _d p
      )
      _d t
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d F C X $.

  putnambench-putnam-2019-a4 $a |-
    E. F e. ( RR ^m P19A4R3 )
      (
        (
          ( P19A4Continuous F )
          /\
          A. C e. P19A4R3
            ( P19A4SurfaceIntegral F C ) = 0
        )
        /\
        E. X e. P19A4R3
          ( F ` X ) =/= 0
      )
  $.
$}

title: putnam_2019_a4
content:
% Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2019_a4:
% a continuous real function on real three-space with zero surface integral
% over every unit sphere need not be identically zero. This file contains no proof.

putnam_2019_a4: THEORY
BEGIN
  point: TYPE =
    [# x_coord: real, y_coord: real, z_coord: real #]
  space_function: TYPE = [point -> real]
  real_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> real]

  safe_div(numerator, denominator: real): real =
    IF denominator = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      numerator / denominator
    ENDIF

  factorial(index: nat): RECURSIVE nat =
    IF index = 0 THEN
      1
    ELSE
      index * factorial(index - 1)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE index

  sine_partial(argument: real, count: nat): RECURSIVE real =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      LET index: nat = count - 1 IN
        sine_partial(argument, count - 1)
          + safe_div(
              ((-1 :: real) ^ index) * argument ^ (2 * index + 1),
              factorial(2 * index + 1) :: real)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  cosine_partial(argument: real, count: nat): RECURSIVE real =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      LET index: nat = count - 1 IN
        cosine_partial(argument, count - 1)
          + safe_div(
              ((-1 :: real) ^ index) * argument ^ (2 * index),
              factorial(2 * index) :: real)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  converges_to(sequence: real_sequence, value: real): bool =
    FORALL (epsilon_value: posreal):
      EXISTS (cutoff: nat):
        FORALL (index: nat):
          cutoff <= index IMPLIES
            abs(sequence(index) - value) < epsilon_value

  sine(argument: real): real =
    epsilon(
      LAMBDA (value: real):
        converges_to(
          LAMBDA (count: nat):
            sine_partial(argument, count),
          value))

  cosine(argument: real): real =
    epsilon(
      LAMBDA (value: real):
        converges_to(
          LAMBDA (count: nat):
            cosine_partial(argument, count),
          value))

  pi: real =
    epsilon(
      LAMBDA (value: real):
        3 < value
          AND value < 4
          AND cosine(value / 2) = 0)

  squared_distance(P, Q: point): real =
    (x_coord(P) - x_coord(Q)) ^ 2
      + (y_coord(P) - y_coord(Q)) ^ 2
      + (z_coord(P) - z_coord(Q)) ^ 2

  continuous(f: space_function): bool =
    FORALL (P: point), (epsilon_value: posreal):
      EXISTS (delta: posreal):
        FORALL (Q: point):
          squared_distance(P, Q) < delta ^ 2
            IMPLIES abs(f(Q) - f(P)) < epsilon_value

  sphere_point(
      center: point,
      azimuth, polar: real): point =
    (# x_coord :=
         x_coord(center) + sine(polar) * cosine(azimuth),
       y_coord :=
         y_coord(center) + sine(polar) * sine(azimuth),
       z_coord :=
         z_coord(center) + cosine(polar) #)

  surface_density(
      f: space_function,
      center: point,
      azimuth, polar: real): real =
    f(sphere_point(center, azimuth, polar)) * sine(polar)

  surface_row_sum(
      f: space_function,
      center: point,
      subdivisions, row, count: nat): RECURSIVE real =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      LET column: nat = count - 1,
          azimuth: real =
            safe_div(
              2 * pi
                * ((column :: real) + (1 :: real) / 2),
              subdivisions :: real),
          polar: real =
            safe_div(
              pi * ((row :: real) + (1 :: real) / 2),
              subdivisions :: real)
      IN
        surface_row_sum(
          f, center, subdivisions, row, count - 1)
          + surface_density(f, center, azimuth, polar)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  surface_grid_sum(
      f: space_function,
      center: point,
      subdivisions, rows: nat): RECURSIVE real =
    IF rows = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      surface_grid_sum(f, center, subdivisions, rows - 1)
        + surface_row_sum(
            f, center, subdivisions, rows - 1, subdivisions)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE rows

  unit_sphere_surface_sum(
      f: space_function,
      center: point,
      subdivisions: nat): real =
    safe_div(2 * pi, subdivisions :: real)
      * safe_div(pi, subdivisions :: real)
      * surface_grid_sum(
          f, center, subdivisions, subdivisions)

  has_unit_sphere_surface_integral(
      f: space_function,
      center: point,
      integral_value: real): bool =
    FORALL (epsilon_value: posreal):
      EXISTS (cutoff: nat):
        cutoff > 0
          AND FORALL (subdivisions: nat):
            cutoff <= subdivisions IMPLIES
              abs(
                unit_sphere_surface_sum(
                  f, center, subdivisions)
                  - integral_value)
                < epsilon_value

  zero_unit_sphere_integrals(f: space_function): bool =
    FORALL (center: point):
      has_unit_sphere_surface_integral(f, center, 0)

  identically_zero(f: space_function): bool =
    FORALL (P: point): f(P) = 0

  putnam_2019_a4_solution: bool = FALSE

  putnam_2019_a4: bool =
    (FORALL (f: space_function):
      (continuous(f) AND zero_unit_sphere_integrals(f))
        IMPLIES identically_zero(f))
      IFF putnam_2019_a4_solution
END putnam_2019_a4

title: putnam_2019_a5
content:
import Mathlib

open Topology Filter

abbrev putnam_2019_a5_solution : ℕ → ℕ := sorry
-- (fun p : ℕ => (p - 1) / 2)
/--
Let $p$ be an odd prime number, and let $\mathbb{F}_p$ denote the field of integers modulo $p$. Let $\mathbb{F}_p[x]$ be the ring of polynomials over $\mathbb{F}_p$, and let $q(x) \in \mathbb{F}_p[x]$ be given by $q(x)=\sum_{k=1}^{p-1} a_kx^k$, where $a_k=k^{(p-1)/2}\mod{p}$. Find the greatest nonnegative integer $n$ such that $(x-1)^n$ divides $q(x)$ in $\mathbb{F}_p[x]$.
-/
theorem putnam_2019_a5
  (p : ℕ)
  (q : Polynomial (ZMod p))
  (a : ℕ → ZMod p)
  (npoly : ℕ → Polynomial (ZMod p))
  (podd : Odd p)
  (pprime : p.Prime)
  (hq : ∀ k : ℕ, q.coeff k = a k)
  (ha0 : a 0 = 0 ∧ ∀ k > p - 1, a k = 0)
  (haother : ∀ k : Set.Icc 1 (p - 1), a k = ((k : ℕ) ^ ((p - 1) / 2)) % p)
  (hnpoly : ∀ n : ℕ, npoly n = (Polynomial.X - 1) ^ n) :
  IsGreatest {n | npoly n ∣ q} (putnam_2019_a5_solution p) :=
sorry

title: putnam_2019_a5
content:
(* Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2019_a5:
   the greatest power of X - 1 dividing a specified polynomial over the
   finite field F_p is (p - 1) / 2. This file contains no proof. *)

From Stdlib Require Import Arith.PeanoNat.

Definition putnam_2019_a5_divides_nat (a b : nat) : Prop :=
  exists c : nat, b = a * c.

Definition putnam_2019_a5_prime (p : nat) : Prop :=
  (2 <= p)%nat /\
  forall d : nat,
    putnam_2019_a5_divides_nat d p ->
    d = 1%nat \/ d = p.

Definition putnam_2019_a5_odd (p : nat) : Prop :=
  exists m : nat, p = (2 * m + 1)%nat.

Fixpoint putnam_2019_a5_sum_to
    (n : nat) (f : nat -> nat) : nat :=
  match n with
  | O => f O
  | S k => (putnam_2019_a5_sum_to k f + f (S k))%nat
  end.

Definition putnam_2019_a5_polynomial
    (p : nat) (coefficients : nat -> nat) : Prop :=
  (forall k : nat, (coefficients k < p)%nat) /\
  exists bound : nat,
    forall k : nat,
      (bound < k)%nat ->
      coefficients k = 0%nat.

Definition putnam_2019_a5_poly_mul
    (p : nat)
    (f g : nat -> nat)
    (degree : nat) : nat :=
  Nat.modulo
    (putnam_2019_a5_sum_to degree
      (fun k : nat => (f k * g (degree - k))%nat))
    p.

Definition putnam_2019_a5_one_coeff
    (p degree : nat) : nat :=
  if Nat.eqb degree 0%nat then Nat.modulo 1%nat p else 0%nat.

Definition putnam_2019_a5_X_minus_one_coeff
    (p degree : nat) : nat :=
  if Nat.eqb degree 0%nat then (p - 1)%nat
  else if Nat.eqb degree 1%nat then 1%nat
  else 0%nat.

Fixpoint putnam_2019_a5_X_minus_one_pow
    (p exponent : nat) : nat -> nat :=
  match exponent with
  | O => putnam_2019_a5_one_coeff p
  | S previous =>
      putnam_2019_a5_poly_mul p
        (putnam_2019_a5_X_minus_one_coeff p)
        (putnam_2019_a5_X_minus_one_pow p previous)
  end.

Definition putnam_2019_a5_q_coeff
    (p k : nat) : nat :=
  if Nat.eqb k 0%nat then 0%nat
  else if Nat.leb p k then 0%nat
  else Nat.modulo (Nat.pow k ((p - 1) / 2)) p.

Definition putnam_2019_a5_poly_divides
    (p : nat)
    (factor product : nat -> nat) : Prop :=
  exists quotient : nat -> nat,
    putnam_2019_a5_polynomial p quotient /\
    forall degree : nat,
      product degree =
      putnam_2019_a5_poly_mul p factor quotient degree.

Definition putnam_2019_a5_qualifies
    (p exponent : nat) : Prop :=
  putnam_2019_a5_poly_divides p
    (putnam_2019_a5_X_minus_one_pow p exponent)
    (putnam_2019_a5_q_coeff p).

Definition putnam_2019_a5_is_greatest
    (P : nat -> Prop) (greatest : nat) : Prop :=
  P greatest /\
  forall n : nat, P n -> (n <= greatest)%nat.

Theorem putnam_2019_a5
    (p : nat)
    (podd : putnam_2019_a5_odd p)
    (pprime : putnam_2019_a5_prime p) :
  putnam_2019_a5_is_greatest
    (putnam_2019_a5_qualifies p)
    ((p - 1) / 2).
Admitted.

theory putnam_2019_a5 imports Complex_Main
"HOL-Computational_Algebra.Polynomial"
"HOL-Library.Cardinality"
begin

definition putnam_2019_a5_solution :: "nat \<Rightarrow> nat" where
  "putnam_2019_a5_solution \<equiv> (\<lambda>p. (p - 1) div 2)"
(* (\<lambda>p::nat. (p - 1) div 2) *)
theorem putnam_2019_a5:
  fixes p :: nat
  and ppind :: "nat \<Rightarrow> 'p::{comm_ring_1, finite}"
  and q :: "'p poly"
  and a :: "nat \<Rightarrow> 'p"
  and npoly :: "nat \<Rightarrow> ('p poly)"
  and ndiv :: "nat \<Rightarrow> bool"
  assumes podd: "odd p"
  and pprime: "prime p"
  and ppcard: "CARD('p) = p"
  and hppind: "ppind ` {0..<p} = UNIV"
  and ppadd: "ppind 0 = 0 \<and>
    (\<forall>i::nat\<in>{0..<p}. \<forall>j::nat\<in>{0..<p}.
      ppind i + ppind j = ppind ((i + j) mod p))"
  and ppmult: "ppind 1 = 1 \<and>
    (\<forall>i::nat\<in>{0..<p}. \<forall>j::nat\<in>{0..<p}.
      ppind i * ppind j = ppind ((i * j) mod p))"
  and hq: "\<forall>k::nat. coeff q k = a k"
  and ha0: "a 0 = 0 \<and> (\<forall>k::nat\<ge>p. a k = 0)"
  and haother: "\<forall>k::nat\<in>{1..<p}.
    a k = ppind ((k ^ ((p - 1) div 2)) mod p)"
  and hnpoly: "\<forall>n::nat. npoly n = (monom 1 1 - 1)^n"
  and hndiv: "\<forall>n::nat. ndiv n = ((npoly n) dvd q)"
  shows "ndiv (putnam_2019_a5_solution p) \<and>
    (\<forall>n::nat. ndiv n \<longrightarrow> n \<le> putnam_2019_a5_solution p)"
  sorry

end

(*
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2019_a5
  (putnambench__hol-light__putnam_2019_a5): the greatest power of x - 1
  dividing a polynomial over the finite field of odd prime order p whose
  kth coefficient is k^((p - 1)/2). This file contains no proof.
*)

needs "Library/iter.ml";;

let statement =
  `let pmul_mod =
     \p:num. \a b:num->num. \k:num.
       nsum (0..k) (\i:num. a i * b (k - i)) MOD p in
   let one_poly =
     \k:num. if k = 0 then 1 else 0 in
   let x_minus_one =
     \p:num. \k:num.
       if k = 0 then p - 1 else if k = 1 then 1 else 0 in
   let ppow_mod =
     \p:num. \a:num->num. \n:num.
       ITER n (pmul_mod p a) one_poly in
   let finite_poly =
     \a:num->num. ?d:num. !k:num. d < k ==> a k = 0 in
   let poly_divides_mod =
     \p:num. \a b:num->num.
       ?c:num->num.
         finite_poly c /\
         !k:num. b k MOD p = pmul_mod p a c k in
   !p:num. !q:num->num.
     ODD p /\
     prime p /\
     (!k:num.
        q k =
        if 1 <= k /\ k <= p - 1
        then k EXP ((p - 1) DIV 2) MOD p
        else 0)
     ==>
     poly_divides_mod p
       (ppow_mod p (x_minus_one p) ((p - 1) DIV 2)) q /\
     (!n:num.
        poly_divides_mod p (ppow_mod p (x_minus_one p) n) q
        ==> n <= (p - 1) DIV 2)`;;

title: putnam_2019_a5
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2019_a5:
;; the exact multiplicity of x = 1 in a polynomial over the prime field whose
;; kth coefficient is k^((p-1)/2) is (p-1)/2. This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

;; For a natural number, checking every candidate from 2 through number-1 is
;; exactly the usual definition of primality.
(defun putnam-2019-a5-no-divisor-from-p (number divisor)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix (- number divisor))))
  (if (and (natp number)
           (natp divisor)
           (<= 2 divisor)
           (< divisor number))
      (and
       (not (equal (mod number divisor) 0))
       (putnam-2019-a5-no-divisor-from-p
        number (+ divisor 1)))
    t))

(defun putnam-2019-a5-primep (number)
  (and
   (natp number)
   (< 1 number)
   (putnam-2019-a5-no-divisor-from-p number 2)))

(defun putnam-2019-a5-solution (p)
  (floor (- p 1) 2))

(defun putnam-2019-a5-q-coefficient (p k)
  (if (and (natp p)
           (natp k)
           (< 0 k)
           (< k p))
      (mod
       (expt k (putnam-2019-a5-solution p))
       p)
    0))

(defun putnam-2019-a5-binomial (n k)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix n)))
  (cond
   ((not (and (natp n) (natp k))) 0)
   ((equal k 0) 1)
   ((< n k) 0)
   ((equal n 0) 0)
   (t
    (+ (putnam-2019-a5-binomial (- n 1) (- k 1))
       (putnam-2019-a5-binomial (- n 1) k)))))

;; This is the coefficient of y^j in q(y+1), reduced modulo p. The remaining
;; argument counts k downward from p-1 to j.
(defun putnam-2019-a5-shifted-coefficient-sum
    (p j remaining)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix remaining)))
  (if (zp remaining)
      0
    (let ((k (+ j (- remaining 1))))
      (mod
       (+ (* (putnam-2019-a5-binomial k j)
             (putnam-2019-a5-q-coefficient p k))
          (putnam-2019-a5-shifted-coefficient-sum
           p j (- remaining 1)))
       p))))

(defun putnam-2019-a5-shifted-coefficient (p j)
  (if (and (natp p)
           (natp j)
           (<= j p))
      (putnam-2019-a5-shifted-coefficient-sum
       p j (- p j))
    0))

;; A polynomial is divisible by (x-1)^n exactly when the coefficients below
;; degree n in q(x+1) vanish. Nonvanishing at degree n makes n the greatest
;; such exponent.
(defun putnam-2019-a5-shifted-zero-below-p (p n)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix n)))
  (if (zp n)
      t
    (and
     (equal
      (putnam-2019-a5-shifted-coefficient p (- n 1))
      0)
     (putnam-2019-a5-shifted-zero-below-p p (- n 1)))))

(defun putnambench-putnam-2019-a5-statement (p)
  (implies
   (and
    (natp p)
    (equal (mod p 2) 1)
    (putnam-2019-a5-primep p))
   (let ((solution (putnam-2019-a5-solution p)))
     (and
      (putnam-2019-a5-shifted-zero-below-p p solution)
      (not
       (equal
        (putnam-2019-a5-shifted-coefficient p solution)
        0))))))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

title: putnam_2019_a5
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2019_a5
-- (putnambench__agda__putnam_2019_a5): the greatest multiplicity of x - 1
-- in the polynomial over F_p whose coefficients are quadratic-character
-- powers is (p - 1) / 2. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module Main where

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; _*_; _-_)

infix 4 _!=_ _<=N_ _<N_
infixr 3 _and_
infixr 2 _or_

data Bottom : Set where

Not : Set -> Set
Not A =
  A -> Bottom

_!=_ : {A : Set} -> A -> A -> Set
x != y =
  Not (x == y)

record _and_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data _or_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  left  : A -> A or B
  right : B -> A or B

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

data _<=N_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set where
  zero<=N   : {n : Nat} -> zero <=N n
  suc<=sucN : {m n : Nat} -> m <=N n -> suc m <=N suc n

_<N_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set
m <N n =
  suc m <=N n

oneN : Nat
oneN =
  suc zero

twoN : Nat
twoN =
  suc oneN

half : Nat -> Nat
half zero =
  zero
half (suc zero) =
  zero
half (suc (suc n)) =
  suc (half n)

Odd : Nat -> Set
Odd n =
  Exists Nat
    (\ k -> n == suc (twoN * k))

DividesNat : Nat -> Nat -> Set
DividesNat divisor number =
  Exists Nat
    (\ quotient -> number == divisor * quotient)

Prime : Nat -> Set
Prime n =
  twoN <=N n
  and
  ((divisor : Nat) ->
    DividesNat divisor n ->
    divisor == oneN or divisor == n)

record PrimeFieldModel
  (p : Nat)
  (F : Set) :
  Set1 where

  field
    zeroF oneF : F
    add multiply : F -> F -> F
    negate inverse : F -> F
    residue : Nat -> F

    one-not-zero :
      oneF != zeroF

    add-commutative :
      (x y : F) ->
      add x y == add y x
    add-associative :
      (x y z : F) ->
      add (add x y) z == add x (add y z)
    add-zero :
      (x : F) ->
      add x zeroF == x
    add-inverse :
      (x : F) ->
      add x (negate x) == zeroF

    multiply-commutative :
      (x y : F) ->
      multiply x y == multiply y x
    multiply-associative :
      (x y z : F) ->
      multiply (multiply x y) z ==
      multiply x (multiply y z)
    multiply-one :
      (x : F) ->
      multiply x oneF == x
    multiply-zero :
      (x : F) ->
      multiply x zeroF == zeroF
    distribute :
      (x y z : F) ->
      multiply x (add y z) ==
      add (multiply x y) (multiply x z)
    inverse-zero :
      inverse zeroF == zeroF
    multiply-inverse :
      (x : F) ->
      x != zeroF ->
      multiply x (inverse x) == oneF

    residue-zero :
      residue zero == zeroF
    residue-successor :
      (n : Nat) ->
      residue (suc n) == add (residue n) oneF
    characteristic-p :
      residue p == zeroF
    residue-complete :
      (x : F) ->
      Exists Nat
        (\ i ->
          i <N p
          and
          residue i == x)
    residue-injective :
      (i j : Nat) ->
      i <N p ->
      j <N p ->
      residue i == residue j ->
      i == j

open PrimeFieldModel

fieldPower :
  {p : Nat} ->
  {F : Set} ->
  PrimeFieldModel p F ->
  F ->
  Nat ->
  F
fieldPower algebra x zero =
  oneF algebra
fieldPower algebra x (suc n) =
  multiply algebra
    (fieldPower algebra x n)
    x

sumThrough :
  {p : Nat} ->
  {F : Set} ->
  PrimeFieldModel p F ->
  Nat ->
  (Nat -> F) ->
  F
sumThrough algebra zero term =
  term zero
sumThrough algebra (suc n) term =
  add algebra
    (sumThrough algebra n term)
    (term (suc n))

record PolynomialAlgebra
  {p : Nat}
  {F : Set}
  (algebra : PrimeFieldModel p F)
  (P : Set) :
  Set1 where

  field
    zeroP oneP XP : P
    addP multiplyP : P -> P -> P
    negateP : P -> P
    coefficient : P -> Nat -> F

    finite-support :
      (polynomial : P) ->
      Exists Nat
        (\ bound ->
          (n : Nat) ->
          bound <N n ->
          coefficient polynomial n == zeroF algebra)

    coefficient-extensionality :
      (leftPolynomial rightPolynomial : P) ->
      ((n : Nat) ->
        coefficient leftPolynomial n ==
        coefficient rightPolynomial n) ->
      leftPolynomial == rightPolynomial

    coefficient-zero :
      (n : Nat) ->
      coefficient zeroP n == zeroF algebra
    coefficient-one-zero :
      coefficient oneP zero == oneF algebra
    coefficient-one-successor :
      (n : Nat) ->
      coefficient oneP (suc n) == zeroF algebra
    coefficient-X-zero :
      coefficient XP zero == zeroF algebra
    coefficient-X-one :
      coefficient XP oneN == oneF algebra
    coefficient-X-above-one :
      (n : Nat) ->
      coefficient XP (suc (suc n)) == zeroF algebra

    coefficient-add :
      (leftPolynomial rightPolynomial : P) ->
      (n : Nat) ->
      coefficient (addP leftPolynomial rightPolynomial) n ==
      add algebra
        (coefficient leftPolynomial n)
        (coefficient rightPolynomial n)
    coefficient-negate :
      (polynomial : P) ->
      (n : Nat) ->
      coefficient (negateP polynomial) n ==
      negate algebra (coefficient polynomial n)
    coefficient-multiply :
      (leftPolynomial rightPolynomial : P) ->
      (n : Nat) ->
      coefficient (multiplyP leftPolynomial rightPolynomial) n ==
      sumThrough algebra n
        (\ i ->
          multiply algebra
            (coefficient leftPolynomial i)
            (coefficient rightPolynomial (n - i)))

open PolynomialAlgebra

polynomialPower :
  {p : Nat} ->
  {F P : Set} ->
  {algebra : PrimeFieldModel p F} ->
  PolynomialAlgebra algebra P ->
  P ->
  Nat ->
  P
polynomialPower polynomials polynomial zero =
  oneP polynomials
polynomialPower polynomials polynomial (suc n) =
  multiplyP polynomials
    (polynomialPower polynomials polynomial n)
    polynomial

xMinusOne :
  {p : Nat} ->
  {F P : Set} ->
  {algebra : PrimeFieldModel p F} ->
  PolynomialAlgebra algebra P ->
  P
xMinusOne polynomials =
  addP polynomials
    (XP polynomials)
    (negateP polynomials (oneP polynomials))

PolynomialDivides :
  {p : Nat} ->
  {F P : Set} ->
  {algebra : PrimeFieldModel p F} ->
  PolynomialAlgebra algebra P ->
  P ->
  P ->
  Set
PolynomialDivides {P = P} polynomials divisor dividend =
  Exists P
    (\ quotient ->
      dividend ==
      multiplyP polynomials divisor quotient)

QuadraticCharacterPolynomial :
  {p : Nat} ->
  {F P : Set} ->
  (algebra : PrimeFieldModel p F) ->
  (polynomials : PolynomialAlgebra algebra P) ->
  P ->
  Set
QuadraticCharacterPolynomial {p} algebra polynomials q =
  coefficient polynomials q zero == zeroF algebra
  and
  ((k : Nat) ->
    oneN <=N k ->
    k <N p ->
    coefficient polynomials q k ==
    fieldPower algebra (residue algebra k) (half p))
  and
  ((k : Nat) ->
    p <=N k ->
    coefficient polynomials q k == zeroF algebra)

record IsGreatestDivisibilityExponent
  {p : Nat}
  {F P : Set}
  {algebra : PrimeFieldModel p F}
  (polynomials : PolynomialAlgebra algebra P)
  (q : P)
  (greatest : Nat) :
  Set where

  field
    attained :
      PolynomialDivides polynomials
        (polynomialPower polynomials
          (xMinusOne polynomials)
          greatest)
        q

    upper-bound :
      (n : Nat) ->
      PolynomialDivides polynomials
        (polynomialPower polynomials
          (xMinusOne polynomials)
          n)
        q ->
      n <=N greatest

putnam-2019-a5 : Set1
putnam-2019-a5 =
  (p : Nat) ->
  Odd p ->
  Prime p ->
  (F P : Set) ->
  (algebra : PrimeFieldModel p F) ->
  (polynomials : PolynomialAlgebra algebra P) ->
  (q : P) ->
  QuadraticCharacterPolynomial algebra polynomials q ->
  IsGreatestDivisibilityExponent polynomials q (half p)

title: putnam_2019_a5
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2019_a5:
  the greatest power of X - 1 dividing the polynomial over the prime field
  with coefficients k^((p-1)/2) is (p-1)/2. This file contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open arithmeticTheory pred_setTheory;
open groupTheory ringTheory;

val putnam_2019_a5 =
  ``!p : num.
      ODD p /\ prime p
      ==>
      let is_poly =
        \f : num -> num.
          (!k : num. f k < p) /\
          FINITE {k : num | f k <> 0}
      in
      let q =
        \k : num.
          if 1 <= k /\ k <= p - 1
          then k ** ((p - 1) DIV 2) MOD p
          else 0
      in
      let poly_one =
        \k : num. if k = 0 then 1 else 0
      in
      let x_minus_one =
        \k : num.
          if k = 0 then p - 1
          else if k = 1 then 1
          else 0
      in
      let poly_mul =
        \f g : num -> num.
        \k : num.
          SIGMA
            (\i : num. f i * g (k - i))
            (count (SUC k)) MOD p
      in
      let x_minus_one_pow =
        \n : num. FUNPOW (poly_mul x_minus_one) n poly_one
      in
      let divides_power =
        \n : num.
          ?s : num -> num.
            is_poly s /\
            q = poly_mul s (x_minus_one_pow n)
      in
        divides_power ((p - 1) DIV 2) /\
        !n : num.
          divides_power n
          ==>
          n <= (p - 1) DIV 2``;

title: putnam_2019_a5
content:
$(
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact
  putnam_2019_a5: for an odd prime p, the greatest nonnegative integer n
  such that (X - 1)^n divides the polynomial whose coefficient of X^k is
  k^((p - 1)/2) in the field of residues modulo p is (p - 1)/2.
  This file contains no proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  For p prime, Z/nZ ` p is the field of residues modulo p and
  Poly1 ` ( Z/nZ ` p ) is its finite-support univariate polynomial ring.
  P19A5Q(p) is exactly the source sum from k = 1 through p - 1:
  ZRHom embeds the integer k^((p - 1)/2) into the residue field, algSc
  embeds that coefficient as a constant polynomial, and var1 is X.
  P19A5Factor(p) is the polynomial X - 1.

  The conclusion expands IsGreatest: the displayed exponent has the
  divisibility property, and every nonnegative exponent with that property
  is at most it. The two explicit definitions and final declaration are
  unproved $a statement encodings; this database contains no $p proof
  declaration.
$)

$c P19A5Factor P19A5Q $.

p19a5-factor-syntax $a class ( P19A5Factor p ) $.
p19a5-q-syntax $a class ( P19A5Q p ) $.

p19a5-factor-definition $a |- ( P19A5Factor p ) =
  (
    ( var1 ` ( Z/nZ ` p ) )
    ( -g ` ( Poly1 ` ( Z/nZ ` p ) ) )
    (
      ( algSc ` ( Poly1 ` ( Z/nZ ` p ) ) )
      `
      ( 1r ` ( Z/nZ ` p ) )
    )
  )
$.

${
  $d k p $.

  p19a5-q-definition $a |- ( P19A5Q p ) =
    (
      ( Poly1 ` ( Z/nZ ` p ) )
      gsum
      (
        k e. ( 1 ... ( p - 1 ) ) |->
          (
            (
              ( algSc ` ( Poly1 ` ( Z/nZ ` p ) ) )
              `
              (
                ( ZRHom ` ( Z/nZ ` p ) )
                `
                ( k ^ ( ( p - 1 ) / 2 ) )
              )
            )
            ( .r ` ( Poly1 ` ( Z/nZ ` p ) ) )
            (
              k
              ( .g ` ( mulGrp ` ( Poly1 ` ( Z/nZ ` p ) ) ) )
              ( var1 ` ( Z/nZ ` p ) )
            )
          )
      )
    )
  $.
$}

${
  $d n p $.

  putnambench-putnam-2019-a5 $a |- A. p e. Prime
    (
      ( p mod 2 ) = 1
      ->
      (
        (
          (
            ( ( p - 1 ) / 2 )
            ( .g ` ( mulGrp ` ( Poly1 ` ( Z/nZ ` p ) ) ) )
            ( P19A5Factor p )
          )
          ( ||r ` ( Poly1 ` ( Z/nZ ` p ) ) )
          ( P19A5Q p )
        )
        /\
        A. n e. NN0
          (
            (
              (
                n
                ( .g ` ( mulGrp ` ( Poly1 ` ( Z/nZ ` p ) ) ) )
                ( P19A5Factor p )
              )
              ( ||r ` ( Poly1 ` ( Z/nZ ` p ) ) )
              ( P19A5Q p )
            )
            ->
            n <_ ( ( p - 1 ) / 2 )
          )
      )
    )
  $.
$}

    (for n being Nat st

        q = (<%-1.INT.Ring(p),1.INT.Ring(p)%> `^ n) *' r
     holds n <= (p -' 1) div 2)
proof
end;

title: putnam_2019_a5
content:
% Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2019_a5:
% for an odd prime p, the greatest exponent n such that (x - 1)^n divides
% q(x) = sum_{k=1}^{p-1} k^((p - 1)/2)*x^k in F_p[x] is (p - 1)/2.
% This file contains no proof.

putnam_2019_a5: THEORY
BEGIN
  polynomial: TYPE = list[int]

  nat_divides(divisor: posnat, value: nat): bool =
    EXISTS (quotient: nat):
      value = divisor * quotient

  prime_nat(value: nat): bool =
    value >= 2
      AND FORALL (divisor: posnat):
        nat_divides(divisor, value)
          IMPLIES divisor = 1 OR divisor = value

  odd_nat(value: nat): bool =
    EXISTS (k: nat):
      value = 2 * k + 1

  polynomial_coefficient(
      value: polynomial,
      degree: nat): RECURSIVE int =
    CASES value OF
      null: 0,
      cons(coefficient, tail):
        IF degree = 0 THEN
          coefficient
        ELSE
          polynomial_coefficient(tail, degree - 1)
        ENDIF
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE value BY <<

  polynomial_add(
      left, right: polynomial): RECURSIVE polynomial =
    CASES left OF
      null: right,
      cons(left_coefficient, left_tail):
        CASES right OF
          null: left,
          cons(right_coefficient, right_tail):
            cons(
              left_coefficient + right_coefficient,
              polynomial_add(left_tail, right_tail))
        ENDCASES
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE left BY <<

  polynomial_scale(
      scalar: int,
      value: polynomial): RECURSIVE polynomial =
    CASES value OF
      null: null,
      cons(coefficient, tail):
        cons(
          scalar * coefficient,
          polynomial_scale(scalar, tail))
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE value BY <<

  polynomial_multiply(
      left, right: polynomial): RECURSIVE polynomial =
    CASES left OF
      null: null,
      cons(coefficient, tail):
        polynomial_add(
          polynomial_scale(coefficient, right),
          cons(0, polynomial_multiply(tail, right)))
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE left BY <<

  constant_polynomial(value: int): polynomial =
    cons(value, null)

  linear_polynomial(
      constant_coefficient,
      linear_coefficient: int): polynomial =
    cons(
      constant_coefficient,
      cons(linear_coefficient, null))

  prepend_coefficient(
      coefficient: int,
      tail: polynomial): polynomial =
    cons(coefficient, tail)

  polynomial_power(
      value: polynomial,
      exponent: nat): RECURSIVE polynomial =
    IF exponent = 0 THEN
      constant_polynomial(1)
    ELSE
      polynomial_multiply(
        polynomial_power(value, exponent - 1),
        value)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE exponent

  coefficient_congruent(
      left, right: int,
      modulus: nat): bool =
    EXISTS (offset: int):
      left - right = (modulus :: int) * offset

  polynomial_congruent(
      left, right: polynomial,
      modulus: nat): bool =
    FORALL (degree: nat):
      coefficient_congruent(
        polynomial_coefficient(left, degree),
        polynomial_coefficient(right, degree),
        modulus)

  polynomial_divides_mod(
      modulus: nat,
      divisor, dividend: polynomial): bool =
    EXISTS (quotient: polynomial):
      polynomial_congruent(
        dividend,
        polynomial_multiply(divisor, quotient),
        modulus)

  coefficient_segment(
      first, count, exponent: nat): RECURSIVE polynomial =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      null
    ELSE
      cons(
        (first ^ exponent) :: int,
        coefficient_segment(first + 1, count - 1, exponent))
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  natural_predecessor(value: nat): nat =
    IF value = 0 THEN 0 ELSE value - 1 ENDIF

  natural_half(value: nat): RECURSIVE nat =
    IF value < 2 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      1 + natural_half(value - 2)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE value

  q_polynomial(
      p, coefficient_exponent: nat,
      zero_coefficient: int): polynomial =
    prepend_coefficient(
      zero_coefficient,
      coefficient_segment(
        1,
        natural_predecessor(p),
        coefficient_exponent))

  putnam_2019_a5_solution(p: nat): nat =
    natural_half(natural_predecessor(p))

  dividing_exponent(p, exponent: nat): bool =
    polynomial_divides_mod(
      p,
      polynomial_power(linear_polynomial(-1, 1), exponent),
      q_polynomial(p, putnam_2019_a5_solution(p), 0))

  is_greatest_dividing_exponent(p, exponent: nat): bool =
    dividing_exponent(p, exponent)
      AND FORALL (candidate: nat):
        dividing_exponent(p, candidate)
          IMPLIES candidate <= exponent

  putnam_2019_a5: bool =
    FORALL (p: nat):
      (odd_nat(p) AND prime_nat(p))
        IMPLIES
          is_greatest_dividing_exponent(
            p,
            putnam_2019_a5_solution(p))
END putnam_2019_a5

title: putnam_2019_a6
content:
import Mathlib

open Topology Filter

/--
Let \( g \) be a real-valued function that is continuous on the closed interval \([0,1]\) and twice differentiable on the open interval \((0,1)\). Suppose that for some real number $\( r > 1 \),\lim_{{x \to 0^+}} \frac{g(x)}{x^r} = 0.$ Prove that either $\lim_{{x \to 0^+}} g'(x) = 0$ or $\limsup_{{x \to 0^+}} x^r |g''(x)| = \infty.$
-/
theorem putnam_2019_a6
(g : ℝ → ℝ)
(r : ℝ)
(hcont : ContinuousOn g (Set.Icc 0 1))
(hdiff : ContDiffOn ℝ 1 g (Set.Ioo 0 1) ∧ DifferentiableOn ℝ (deriv g) (Set.Ioo 0 1))
(hr : r > 1)
(hlim : Tendsto (fun x => g x / x ^ r) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 0))
: (Tendsto (deriv g) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 0)) ∨ (Tendsto (fun x : ℝ => sSup {((x' ^ r * abs (iteratedDeriv 2 g x') : ℝ) : WithTop ℝ) | x' ∈ Set.Ioc 0 x}) (𝓝[>] 0) atTop) :=
sorry

title: putnam_2019_a6
content:
From mathcomp Require Import all_ssreflect ssrnum ssralg.
From mathcomp Require Import reals derive normedtype sequences topology exp.
From mathcomp Require Import classical_sets.
Import numFieldNormedType.Exports.

Set Implicit Arguments.
Unset Strict Implicit.
Unset Printing Implicit Defensive.

Local Open Scope ring_scope.
Local Open Scope classical_set_scope.

Variable R : realType.
Definition at_right := fun (x : R) => within (fun y => y > x) (nbhs x).
Theorem putnam_2019_a6
    (g : R -> R)
    (r : R)
    (hcont : {within [set x | 0 <= x <= 1], continuous g})
    (hdiff : forall x : R,
      0 < x < 1 -> differentiable g x /\ differentiable g^`() x)
    (hr : r > 1)
    (hlim : (fun x : R => g x / (expR (r * ln x))) @ (at_right 0) --> 0)
    : g^`() @ (at_right 0) --> 0 \/
      forall M delta : R,
        0 < delta ->
        exists x' : R,
          0 < x' /\
          x' < delta /\
          x' < 1 /\
          M < expR (r * ln x') * `|g^`(2) x'|.
Proof. Admitted.
