title: putnam_2019_a6
putnam_2019_a6
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2019_a6:
;; a twice differentiable real function that is small relative to x^r at zero
;; has either derivative tending to zero or unbounded scaled second derivative
;; near zero. This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))

;; Reals are rational regular Cauchy names, and real functions are extensional
;; function objects on those names. Positive rational tolerances, thresholds,
;; and moduli are cofinal in the positive reals. All derivative, power, limit,
;; and supremum witnesses remain internally quantified.

(defun putnam-2019-a6-quoted (object)
  (list 'quote object))

(defun putnam-2019-a6-term-list (terms)
  (if (consp terms)
      (list 'cons
            (car terms)
            (putnam-2019-a6-term-list (cdr terms)))
    nil))

(defun putnam-2019-a6-apply-term (function arguments)
  (list 'apply$
        (putnam-2019-a6-quoted function)
        (putnam-2019-a6-term-list arguments)))

(defun putnam-2019-a6-apply-object-term
    (function-term arguments)
  (list 'apply$
        function-term
        (putnam-2019-a6-term-list arguments)))

(defun putnam-2019-a6-and-terms (terms)
  (if (consp terms)
      (list 'if
            (car terms)
            (putnam-2019-a6-and-terms (cdr terms))
            (putnam-2019-a6-quoted nil))
    (putnam-2019-a6-quoted t)))

(defun putnam-2019-a6-implies-term (hypothesis conclusion)
  (list 'if
        hypothesis
        conclusion
        (putnam-2019-a6-quoted t)))

(defun putnam-2019-a6-not-term (term)
  (list 'if
        term
        (putnam-2019-a6-quoted nil)
        (putnam-2019-a6-quoted t)))

(defun putnam-2019-a6-add-term (left right)
  (list 'binary-+ left right))

(defun putnam-2019-a6-negate-term (value)
  (list 'unary-- value))

(defun putnam-2019-a6-subtract-term (left right)
  (putnam-2019-a6-add-term
   left
   (putnam-2019-a6-negate-term right)))

(defun putnam-2019-a6-multiply-term (left right)
  (list 'binary-* left right))

(defun putnam-2019-a6-divide-term (numerator denominator)
  (putnam-2019-a6-multiply-term
   numerator
   (list 'unary-/ denominator)))

(defun putnam-2019-a6-absolute-term (value)
  (list 'if
        (list '< value (putnam-2019-a6-quoted 0))
        (putnam-2019-a6-negate-term value)
        value))

(defun putnam-2019-a6-less-equal-term (left right)
  (list 'if
        (list '< right left)
        (putnam-2019-a6-quoted nil)
        (putnam-2019-a6-quoted t)))

(defun putnam-2019-a6-positive-rational-term (value)
  (putnam-2019-a6-and-terms
   (list
    (list 'rationalp value)
    (list '< (putnam-2019-a6-quoted 0) value))))

(defun putnam-2019-a6-true-function (formals)
  (list 'lambda
        formals
        (putnam-2019-a6-quoted t)))

(defun putnam-2019-a6-real-value-term (name precision)
  (putnam-2019-a6-apply-term name (list precision)))

(defun putnam-2019-a6-object-real-value-term
    (name-term precision)
  (putnam-2019-a6-apply-object-term
   name-term
   (list precision)))

(defun putnam-2019-a6-real-cauchy-function (name)
  (let* ((left
          (putnam-2019-a6-real-value-term name 'epsilon))
         (right
          (putnam-2019-a6-real-value-term name 'eta))
         (distance
          (putnam-2019-a6-absolute-term
           (putnam-2019-a6-subtract-term left right))))
    (list
     'lambda
     '(epsilon eta)
     (putnam-2019-a6-implies-term
      (putnam-2019-a6-and-terms
       (list
        (putnam-2019-a6-positive-rational-term 'epsilon)
        (putnam-2019-a6-positive-rational-term 'eta)))
      (putnam-2019-a6-and-terms
       (list
        (list 'rationalp left)
        (list 'rationalp right)
        (putnam-2019-a6-less-equal-term
         distance
         (putnam-2019-a6-add-term
          'epsilon 'eta))))))))

(defun putnam-2019-a6-real-name-p (name)
  (and
   (tamep-functionp name)
   (fn-equal
    (putnam-2019-a6-real-cauchy-function name)
    (putnam-2019-a6-true-function
     '(epsilon eta)))))

;; Sampling both names at eta/4 makes the displayed universal inequality
;; equivalent to distance between their represented limits being at most BOUND.

(defun putnam-2019-a6-real-distance-function
    (left-name right-name bound)
  (let* ((precision
          (putnam-2019-a6-multiply-term
           (putnam-2019-a6-quoted 1/4)
           'eta))
         (left
          (putnam-2019-a6-real-value-term
           left-name precision))
         (right
          (putnam-2019-a6-real-value-term
           right-name precision))
         (distance
          (putnam-2019-a6-absolute-term
           (putnam-2019-a6-subtract-term left right))))
    (list
     'lambda
     '(eta)
     (putnam-2019-a6-implies-term
      (putnam-2019-a6-positive-rational-term 'eta)
      (putnam-2019-a6-and-terms
       (list
        (list 'rationalp left)
        (list 'rationalp right)
        (putnam-2019-a6-less-equal-term
         distance
         (putnam-2019-a6-add-term
          (putnam-2019-a6-quoted bound)
          'eta))))))))

(defun putnam-2019-a6-real-distance-at-most-p
    (left-name right-name bound)
  (and
   (rationalp bound)
   (putnam-2019-a6-real-name-p left-name)
   (putnam-2019-a6-real-name-p right-name)
   (fn-equal
    (putnam-2019-a6-real-distance-function
     left-name right-name bound)
    (putnam-2019-a6-true-function '(eta)))))

(defun putnam-2019-a6-real-equal-p
    (left-name right-name)
  (putnam-2019-a6-real-distance-at-most-p
   left-name right-name 0))

(defun putnam-2019-a6-real-order-function
    (left-name right-name)
  (let* ((precision
          (putnam-2019-a6-multiply-term
           (putnam-2019-a6-quoted 1/4)
           'eta))
         (left
          (putnam-2019-a6-real-value-term
           left-name precision))
         (right
          (putnam-2019-a6-real-value-term
           right-name precision)))
    (list
     'lambda
     '(eta)
     (putnam-2019-a6-implies-term
      (putnam-2019-a6-positive-rational-term 'eta)
      (putnam-2019-a6-and-terms
       (list
        (list 'rationalp left)
        (list 'rationalp right)
        (putnam-2019-a6-less-equal-term
         left
         (putnam-2019-a6-add-term
          right 'eta))))))))

(defun putnam-2019-a6-real-le-p
    (left-name right-name)
  (and
   (putnam-2019-a6-real-name-p left-name)
   (putnam-2019-a6-real-name-p right-name)
   (fn-equal
    (putnam-2019-a6-real-order-function
     left-name right-name)
    (putnam-2019-a6-true-function '(eta)))))

(defun putnam-2019-a6-real-lt-p
    (left-name right-name)
  (and
   (putnam-2019-a6-real-le-p left-name right-name)
   (not
    (putnam-2019-a6-real-equal-p
     left-name right-name))))

(defun putnam-2019-a6-unary-output-function
    (function)
  (let ((output
         (putnam-2019-a6-apply-term function (list 'x))))
    (list
     'lambda
     '(x)
     (putnam-2019-a6-implies-term
      (list 'putnam-2019-a6-real-name-p 'x)
      (list 'putnam-2019-a6-real-name-p output)))))

(defun putnam-2019-a6-unary-extensional-function
    (function)
  (let ((left-output
         (putnam-2019-a6-apply-term
          function (list 'x-left)))
        (right-output
         (putnam-2019-a6-apply-term
          function (list 'x-right))))
    (list
     'lambda
     '(x-left x-right)
     (putnam-2019-a6-implies-term
      (list 'putnam-2019-a6-real-equal-p
            'x-left 'x-right)
      (list 'putnam-2019-a6-real-equal-p
            left-output right-output)))))

(defun putnam-2019-a6-real-function-p (function)
  (and
   (tamep-functionp function)
   (fn-equal
    (putnam-2019-a6-unary-output-function function)
    (putnam-2019-a6-true-function '(x)))
   (fn-equal
    (putnam-2019-a6-unary-extensional-function function)
    (putnam-2019-a6-true-function
     '(x-left x-right)))))

(defun putnam-2019-a6-rational-name (value)
  (list 'lambda
        '(precision)
        (putnam-2019-a6-quoted value)))

(defun putnam-2019-a6-add-name
    (left-name right-name)
  (let* ((precision
          (putnam-2019-a6-multiply-term
           (putnam-2019-a6-quoted 1/2)
           'epsilon))
         (left
          (putnam-2019-a6-object-real-value-term
           (putnam-2019-a6-quoted left-name)
           precision))
         (right
          (putnam-2019-a6-object-real-value-term
           (putnam-2019-a6-quoted right-name)
           precision)))
    (list
     'lambda
     '(epsilon)
     (putnam-2019-a6-add-term left right))))

(defun putnam-2019-a6-multiply-name
    (left-name right-name)
  (let* ((left-at-one
          (putnam-2019-a6-object-real-value-term
           (putnam-2019-a6-quoted left-name)
           (putnam-2019-a6-quoted 1)))
         (right-at-one
          (putnam-2019-a6-object-real-value-term
           (putnam-2019-a6-quoted right-name)
           (putnam-2019-a6-quoted 1)))
         (scale
          (putnam-2019-a6-multiply-term
           (putnam-2019-a6-quoted 8)
           (putnam-2019-a6-add-term
            (putnam-2019-a6-quoted 3)
            (putnam-2019-a6-add-term
             (putnam-2019-a6-absolute-term left-at-one)
             (putnam-2019-a6-absolute-term right-at-one)))))
         (candidate
          (putnam-2019-a6-divide-term
           'epsilon scale))
         (precision
          (list 'if
                (list '<
                      (putnam-2019-a6-quoted 1)
                      candidate)
                (putnam-2019-a6-quoted 1)
                candidate))
         (left
          (putnam-2019-a6-object-real-value-term
           (putnam-2019-a6-quoted left-name)
           precision))
         (right
          (putnam-2019-a6-object-real-value-term
           (putnam-2019-a6-quoted right-name)
           precision)))
    (list
     'lambda
     '(epsilon)
     (putnam-2019-a6-multiply-term left right))))

(defun putnam-2019-a6-absolute-name (name)
  (let ((value
         (putnam-2019-a6-object-real-value-term
          (putnam-2019-a6-quoted name)
          'epsilon)))
    (list
     'lambda
     '(epsilon)
     (putnam-2019-a6-absolute-term value))))

(defun putnam-2019-a6-rational-shift-name (name shift)
  (let ((value
         (putnam-2019-a6-object-real-value-term
          (putnam-2019-a6-quoted name)
          (putnam-2019-a6-multiply-term
           (putnam-2019-a6-quoted 1/2)
           'precision))))
    (list
     'lambda
     '(precision)
     (putnam-2019-a6-add-term
      value
      (putnam-2019-a6-quoted shift)))))

(defun putnam-2019-a6-in-closed-unit-p (x)
  (and
   (putnam-2019-a6-real-name-p x)
   (putnam-2019-a6-real-le-p
    (putnam-2019-a6-rational-name 0)
    x)
   (putnam-2019-a6-real-le-p

title: putnam_2019_a6
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2019_a6
-- (putnambench__agda__putnam_2019_a6): a twice differentiable real function
-- vanishing faster than x^r at zero has derivative tending to zero or running
-- supremum of x^r times the absolute second derivative tending to infinity.
-- This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module Main where

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; _*_)

infix 4 _!=_ _<=N_
infixr 3 _and_
infixr 2 _or_

data Bottom : Set where

Not : Set -> Set
Not A =
  A -> Bottom

_!=_ : {A : Set} -> A -> A -> Set
x != y =
  Not (x == y)

record _and_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data _or_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  left  : A -> A or B
  right : B -> A or B

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

data _<=N_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set where
  zero<=N   : {n : Nat} -> zero <=N n
  suc<=sucN : {m n : Nat} -> m <=N n -> suc m <=N suc n

record CompleteOrderedRealField (R : Set) : Set1 where
  field
    zeroR oneR : R
    add multiply : R -> R -> R
    negate inverse : R -> R
    lessOrEqual : R -> R -> Set
    fromNat : Nat -> R

    one-not-zero :
      oneR != zeroR

    add-commutative :
      (x y : R) ->
      add x y == add y x
    add-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      add (add x y) z == add x (add y z)
    add-zero :
      (x : R) ->
      add x zeroR == x
    add-inverse :
      (x : R) ->
      add x (negate x) == zeroR

    multiply-commutative :
      (x y : R) ->
      multiply x y == multiply y x
    multiply-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply (multiply x y) z ==
      multiply x (multiply y z)
    multiply-one :
      (x : R) ->
      multiply x oneR == x
    multiply-zero :
      (x : R) ->
      multiply x zeroR == zeroR
    distribute :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply x (add y z) ==
      add (multiply x y) (multiply x z)
    inverse-zero :
      inverse zeroR == zeroR
    multiply-inverse :
      (x : R) ->
      x != zeroR ->
      multiply x (inverse x) == oneR

    order-reflexive :
      (x : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x x
    order-transitive :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y z ->
      lessOrEqual x z
    order-antisymmetric :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y x ->
      x == y
    order-total :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y or lessOrEqual y x
    add-order :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual (add z x) (add z y)
    multiply-nonnegative :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR x ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR y ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR (multiply x y)
    zero-less-than-one :
      lessOrEqual zeroR oneR and zeroR != oneR

    fromNat-zero :
      fromNat zero == zeroR
    fromNat-successor :
      (n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (suc n) == add (fromNat n) oneR
    fromNat-addition :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m + n) == add (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-multiplication :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m * n) == multiply (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-injective :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat m == fromNat n ->
      m == n

    archimedean :
      (x : R) ->
      Exists Nat
        (\ n ->
          lessOrEqual x (fromNat n))

    least-upper-bound :
      (P : R -> Set) ->
      Exists R P ->
      Exists R
        (\ upper ->
          (x : R) ->
          P x ->
          lessOrEqual x upper) ->
      Exists R
        (\ supremum ->
          ((x : R) ->
            P x ->
            lessOrEqual x supremum)
          and
          ((upper : R) ->
            ((x : R) ->
              P x ->
              lessOrEqual x upper) ->
            lessOrEqual supremum upper))

open CompleteOrderedRealField

oneN : Nat
oneN =
  suc zero

subtract :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
subtract reals x y =
  add reals x (negate reals y)

divide :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
divide reals x y =
  multiply reals x (inverse reals y)

maximum :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
maximum reals x y with order-total reals x y
... | left _ =
  y
... | right _ =
  x

absoluteValue :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R
absoluteValue reals x =
  maximum reals x (negate reals x)

StrictLess :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
StrictLess reals x y =
  lessOrEqual reals x y and x != y

CloseTo :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
CloseTo reals center radius x =
  StrictLess reals
    (subtract reals center radius)
    x
  and
  StrictLess reals
    x
    (add reals center radius)

ClosedUnitInterval :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  Set
ClosedUnitInterval reals x =
  lessOrEqual reals (zeroR reals) x
  and
  lessOrEqual reals x (oneR reals)

OpenUnitInterval :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  Set
OpenUnitInterval reals x =
  StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) x
  and
  StrictLess reals x (oneR reals)

ContinuousOn :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (R -> R) ->
  (R -> Set) ->
  Set
ContinuousOn {R} reals function domain =
  (point : R) ->
  domain point ->
  (epsilon : R) ->
  StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) epsilon ->
  Exists R
    (\ delta ->
      StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) delta
      and
      ((x : R) ->
        domain x ->
        CloseTo reals point delta x ->
        CloseTo reals
          (function point)
          epsilon
          (function x)))

differenceQuotient :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (R -> R) ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
differenceQuotient reals function point x =
  divide reals
    (subtract reals
      (function x)
      (function point))
    (subtract reals x point)

DerivativeAt :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (R -> R) ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
DerivativeAt {R} reals function point derivativeValue =
  (epsilon : R) ->
  StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) epsilon ->
  Exists R
    (\ delta ->
      StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) delta
      and
      ((x : R) ->
        CloseTo reals point delta x ->
        x != point ->
        CloseTo reals derivativeValue epsilon
          (differenceQuotient reals function point x)))

record TwiceDifferentiableOnOpenUnitInterval
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R)
  (function : R -> R) :
  Set where

  field
    firstDerivative secondDerivative : R -> R

    first-derivative-correct :
      (x : R) ->
      OpenUnitInterval reals x ->
      DerivativeAt reals
        function
        x
        (firstDerivative x)

    first-derivative-continuous :
      ContinuousOn reals
        firstDerivative
        (OpenUnitInterval reals)

    second-derivative-correct :
      (x : R) ->
      OpenUnitInterval reals x ->
      DerivativeAt reals
        firstDerivative
        x
        (secondDerivative x)

open TwiceDifferentiableOnOpenUnitInterval

naturalPower :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  Nat ->
  R
naturalPower reals x zero =
  oneR reals
naturalPower reals x (suc n) =
  multiply reals
    (naturalPower reals x n)
    x

factorial : Nat -> Nat
factorial zero =
  oneN
factorial (suc n) =
  suc n * factorial n

sumFirst :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Nat ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  R
sumFirst reals zero terms =
  zeroR reals
sumFirst reals (suc n) terms =
  add reals
    (sumFirst reals n terms)
    (terms n)

ConvergesTo :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  R ->
  Set
ConvergesTo {R} reals sequence limit =
  (epsilon : R) ->
  StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) epsilon ->
  Exists Nat
    (\ cutoff ->
      (n : Nat) ->
      cutoff <=N n ->
      CloseTo reals limit epsilon (sequence n))

exponentialTerm :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  Nat ->
  R
exponentialTerm reals x n =
  divide reals
    (naturalPower reals x n)
    (fromNat reals (factorial n))

ExponentialValue :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
ExponentialValue reals x value =
  ConvergesTo reals
    (\ n ->
      sumFirst reals n
        (exponentialTerm reals x))
    value

record StandardRealPowers
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) :
  Set1 where

  field
    exponential logarithm : R -> R

    exponential-series :
      (x : R) ->
      ExponentialValue reals x (exponential x)

    exponential-positive :
      (x : R) ->
      StrictLess reals
        (zeroR reals)
        (exponential x)

    exponential-injective :
      (x y : R) ->
      exponential x == exponential y ->
      x == y

    exponential-logarithm :
      (x : R) ->
      StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) x ->
      exponential (logarithm x) == x

open StandardRealPowers

realPower :
  {R : Set} ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) ->
  StandardRealPowers reals ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
realPower reals powers base exponent =
  exponential powers
    (multiply reals
      exponent
      (logarithm powers base))

RightLimitAtZero :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (R -> R) ->
  R ->
  Set
RightLimitAtZero {R} reals function limit =
  (epsilon : R) ->
  StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) epsilon ->
  Exists R
    (\ delta ->
      StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) delta
      and
      ((x : R) ->
        StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) x ->
        StrictLess reals x delta ->
        CloseTo reals limit epsilon (function x)))

RunningSupremumTendsToInfinityAtZero :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (R -> R) ->
  Set
RunningSupremumTendsToInfinityAtZero {R} reals function =
  (bound : R) ->
  Exists R
    (\ delta ->
      StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) delta
      and
      ((x : R) ->
        StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) x ->
        StrictLess reals x delta ->
        Exists R
          (\ xPrime ->
            StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) xPrime
            and
            lessOrEqual reals xPrime x
            and
            lessOrEqual reals bound (function xPrime))))

module Putnam2019A6Statement
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R)
  (powers : StandardRealPowers reals) where

  quotientByPower :
    (R -> R) ->
    R ->
    R ->
    R
  quotientByPower g r x =
    divide reals
      (g x)
      (realPower reals powers x r)

  weightedSecondDerivative :
    (R -> R) ->
    R ->
    R ->
    R
  weightedSecondDerivative secondDerivative r x =
    multiply reals
      (realPower reals powers x r)
      (absoluteValue reals (secondDerivative x))

  proposition : Set
  proposition =
    (g : R -> R) ->
    ContinuousOn reals g (ClosedUnitInterval reals) ->
    (smooth :
      TwiceDifferentiableOnOpenUnitInterval reals g) ->
    (r : R) ->
    StrictLess reals (oneR reals) r ->
    RightLimitAtZero reals
      (quotientByPower g r)
      (zeroR reals) ->
    RightLimitAtZero reals
      (firstDerivative smooth)
      (zeroR reals)
    or
    RunningSupremumTendsToInfinityAtZero reals
      (weightedSecondDerivative
        (secondDerivative smooth)
        r)

putnam-2019-a6 : Set1
putnam-2019-a6 =
  (R : Set) ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) ->
  (powers : StandardRealPowers reals) ->
  Putnam2019A6Statement.proposition reals powers

title: putnam_2019_a6
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2019_a6:
  a continuous real function that is twice differentiable on the open unit
  interval and vanishes faster than x^r at zero has either derivative tending
  to zero or unbounded scaled second derivative near zero. This file contains
  no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open pred_setTheory realTheory real_topologyTheory limTheory transcTheory;

val putnam_2019_a6 =
  ``let right_limit =
      \f : real -> real.
      \l : real.
        !epsilon : real.
          0 < epsilon
          ==>
          ?delta : real.
            0 < delta /\
            !x : real.
              0 < x /\ x < delta
              ==>
              abs (f x - l) < epsilon
    in
      !g : real -> real. !r : real.
        g continuous_on interval [0, 1] /\
        (!x : real.
           0 < x /\ x < 1
           ==>
           higher_differentiable 2 g x) /\
        1 < r /\
        right_limit (\x : real. g x / (x powr r)) 0
        ==>
        right_limit (diffn 1 g) 0 \/
        (!M : real.
           ?delta : real.
             0 < delta /\
             !x : real.
               0 < x /\ x < delta
               ==>
               ?x' : real.
                 0 < x' /\ x' <= x /\
                 M < x' powr r * abs (diffn 2 g x'))``;

title: putnam_2019_a6
content:
$(
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact
  putnam_2019_a6: the right-hand behavior at zero of a twice differentiable
  real function satisfying g(x) / x^r -> 0 for r > 1, namely the dichotomy
  between g'(x) -> 0 and an unbounded second-derivative envelope. This file
  contains no proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  P19A6Deriv totalizes set.mm's real derivative by assigning zero outside
  its domain. The hypotheses ensure that its values on (0,1) are the actual
  first derivative of F. P19A6SecondDeriv iterates that operation; the
  differentiability hypothesis on P19A6Deriv ensures that its values on
  (0,1) are the actual second derivative.

  P19A6Envelope(F,r,x) is the supremum in the extended reals RR* of
  t^r |F''(t)| for 0 < t <= x. On positive t, set.mm's complex-power
  operation ^c is real-valued and agrees with real exponentiation.

  The two finite right-hand limits are expanded in epsilon-delta form. The
  final at-top condition says that for every real bound M, all sufficiently
  small positive x have envelope greater than M. This is exactly convergence
  of the running extended-real supremum to +oo as x approaches zero from the
  right. The definitions and final declaration are unproved $a statement
  encodings; this database contains no $p proof declaration.
$)

$c P19A6Deriv P19A6SecondDeriv P19A6Envelope $.

p19a6-deriv-syntax $a class ( P19A6Deriv F ) $.
p19a6-second-deriv-syntax $a class ( P19A6SecondDeriv F ) $.
p19a6-envelope-syntax $a class ( P19A6Envelope F r x ) $.

${
  $d F x $.

  p19a6-deriv-definition $a |- ( P19A6Deriv F ) =
    (
      x e. RR |->
        if (
          x e. dom ( RR _D F ) ,
          ( ( RR _D F ) ` x ) ,
          0
        )
    ) $.
$}

p19a6-second-deriv-definition $a |- ( P19A6SecondDeriv F ) =
  ( P19A6Deriv ( P19A6Deriv F ) ) $.

${
  $d F r t x y $.

  p19a6-envelope-definition $a |- ( P19A6Envelope F r x ) =
    sup (
      {
        y e. RR |
          E. t e. ( 0 (,] x )
            y =
            (
              ( t ^c r )
              x.
              (
                abs
                `
                ( ( P19A6SecondDeriv F ) ` t )
              )
            )
      } ,
      RR* ,
      <
    ) $.
$}

${
  $d F M d e r x $.

  putnambench-putnam-2019-a6 $a |-
    A. F e. ( RR ^m RR )
    A. r e. RR
      (
        (
          (
            (
              (
                ( F |` ( 0 [,] 1 ) )
                e.
                ( ( C^n ` ( 0 [,] 1 ) ) ` 0 )
                /\
                ( F |` ( 0 (,) 1 ) )
                e.
                ( ( C^n ` ( 0 (,) 1 ) ) ` 1 )
              )
              /\
              A. x e. ( 0 (,) 1 )
                x e. dom ( RR _D ( P19A6Deriv F ) )
            )
            /\
            1 < r
          )
          /\
          A. e e. RR
            (
              0 < e
              ->
              E. d e. RR
                (
                  0 < d
                  /\
                  A. x e. RR
                    (
                      (
                        0 < x
                        /\
                        x < d
                      )
                      ->
                      (
                        abs
                        `
                        (
                          ( ( F ` x ) / ( x ^c r ) )
                          -
                          0
                        )
                      )
                      < e
                    )
                )
            )
        )
        ->
        (
          A. e e. RR
            (
              0 < e
              ->
              E. d e. RR
                (
                  0 < d
                  /\
                  A. x e. RR
                    (
                      (
                        0 < x
                        /\
                        x < d
                      )
                      ->
                      (
                        abs
                        `
                        (
                          ( ( P19A6Deriv F ) ` x )
                          -
                          0
                        )
                      )
                      < e
                    )
                )
            )
          \/
          A. M e. RR
            E. d e. RR
              (
                0 < d
                /\
                A. x e. RR
                  (
                    (
                      0 < x
                      /\
                      x < d
                    )
                    ->
                    M < ( P19A6Envelope F r x )
                  )
              )
        )
      )
  $.
$}

title: putnam_2019_a6
content:
:: Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2019_a6
:: (putnambench__mizar__putnam_2019_a6): a twice differentiable real function
:: that is little-o of x^r at zero from the right has either derivative
:: tending to zero or unbounded weighted second derivative near zero.
:: This file contains no proof.

environ

  vocabularies NUMBERS, RCOMP_1, SUBSET_1, REAL_1, COMPLEX1, NEWTON,
    ARYTM_3, RELAT_1, CARD_1, PARTFUN1, SEQ_1, TAYLOR_1, XXREAL_1,

  constructors ARYTM_0, REAL_1, NAT_1, SEQ_2, RCOMP_1, RFUNCT_2,
    LIMFUNC1, FCONT_1, FDIFF_1, COMSEQ_3, SIN_COS, ABIAN, TAYLOR_1,
    SEQFUNC, SERIES_1, VALUED_1, RELSET_1, COMSEQ_2, PREPOWER, POWER;
  registrations RELSET_1, NUMBERS, XREAL_0, NAT_1, MEMBERED, RCOMP_1,
    XBOOLE_0, VALUED_0, VALUED_1, FUNCT_2, NEWTON, SIN_COS, INT_1,
    ORDINAL1, FCONT_1, PREPOWER;
  requirements SUBSET, REAL, BOOLE, NUMERALS, ARITHM;
  definitions TAYLOR_1;
  equalities XCMPLX_0, VALUED_1, SUBSET_1;
  expansions TAYLOR_1;
  theorems XBOOLE_1, ABSVALUE, PARTFUN1, XCMPLX_1, RELAT_1, RCOMP_1,
    SEQ_1, SEQ_2, SIN_COS, SERIES_1, FUNCT_1, RFUNCT_2, NAT_1, NEWTON,
    POWER, FDIFF_1, FDIFF_2, TAYLOR_1, SIN_COS2, XREAL_1, RFUNCT_1,
    ABIAN, COMPLEX1, XXREAL_0, VALUED_1, FUNCT_2, XREAL_0, ORDINAL1,
    FCONT_1;
  schemes NAT_1;

begin

::$P-
theorem
  for g being Function of REAL,REAL,
      r being Real,
      I being Subset of REAL st
    I = ].0,1.[ &
    g|[.0,1.] is continuous &
    g is_differentiable_on 2,I &
    r > 1 &
    (for epsilon being Real st 0 < epsilon holds
      ex delta being Real st
        0 < delta & delta <= 1 &
        for x being Real st 0 < x & x < delta holds
          |.g.x / (x to_power r).| < epsilon)
  holds
    ((for epsilon being Real st 0 < epsilon holds
        ex delta being Real st
          0 < delta & delta <= 1 &
          for x being Real st 0 < x & x < delta holds
            |.(diff(g,I).1).x.| < epsilon) or
     (for B being Real holds
        ex delta being Real st
          0 < delta & delta <= 1 &
          for x being Real st 0 < x & x < delta holds
            ex x1 being Real st
              0 < x1 & x1 <= x &
              B < (x1 to_power r) * |.(diff(g,I).2).x1.|))
proof
end;

title: putnam_2019_a6
content:
% Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2019_a6:
% a continuous real function on [0,1], twice differentiable on (0,1), and
% vanishing faster than x^r at zero satisfies the stated derivative-limit
% disjunction. This file contains no proof.

putnam_2019_a6: THEORY
BEGIN
  real_function: TYPE = [real -> real]
  real_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> real]

  safe_div(numerator, denominator: real): real =
    IF denominator = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      numerator / denominator
    ENDIF

  nat_factorial(index: nat): RECURSIVE nat =
    IF index = 0 THEN
      1
    ELSE
      index * nat_factorial(index - 1)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE index

  exponential_partial(x: real, count: nat): RECURSIVE real =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      LET index: nat = count - 1 IN
        exponential_partial(x, count - 1)
          + safe_div(
              x ^ index,
              nat_factorial(index) :: real)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  converges_to(sequence: real_sequence, value: real): bool =
    FORALL (epsilon_value: posreal):
      EXISTS (cutoff: nat):
        FORALL (index: nat):
          cutoff <= index IMPLIES
            abs(sequence(index) - value) < epsilon_value

  real_exponential(x: real): real =
    epsilon(
      LAMBDA (value: real):
        converges_to(
          LAMBDA (count: nat):
            exponential_partial(x, count),
          value))

  natural_log(x: real): real =
    IF x > 0 THEN
      epsilon(
        LAMBDA (value: real):
          real_exponential(value) = x)
    ELSE
      0
    ENDIF

  real_power(base, exponent: real): real =
    IF base > 0 THEN
      real_exponential(exponent * natural_log(base))
    ELSIF base = 0 AND exponent = 0 THEN
      1
    ELSE
      0
    ENDIF

  in_closed_unit_interval(x: real): bool =
    0 <= x AND x <= 1

  in_open_unit_interval(x: real): bool =
    0 < x AND x < 1

  continuous_on_closed_unit_interval(f: real_function): bool =
    FORALL (x: real):
      in_closed_unit_interval(x) IMPLIES
        FORALL (epsilon_value: posreal):
          EXISTS (delta: posreal):
            FORALL (y: real):
              (in_closed_unit_interval(y)
                AND abs(y - x) < delta)
              IMPLIES
                abs(f(y) - f(x)) < epsilon_value

  continuous_on_open_unit_interval(f: real_function): bool =
    FORALL (x: real):
      in_open_unit_interval(x) IMPLIES
        FORALL (epsilon_value: posreal):
          EXISTS (delta: posreal):
            FORALL (y: real):
              (in_open_unit_interval(y)
                AND abs(y - x) < delta)
              IMPLIES
                abs(f(y) - f(x)) < epsilon_value

  has_derivative_at(
      f: real_function,
      derivative, x: real): bool =
    FORALL (epsilon_value: posreal):
      EXISTS (delta: posreal):
        FORALL (h: real):
          (NOT (h = 0) AND abs(h) < delta)
          IMPLIES
            abs(
              f(x + h) - f(x)
                - derivative * h)
              < epsilon_value * abs(h)

  differentiable_at(f: real_function, x: real): bool =
    EXISTS (derivative: real):
      has_derivative_at(f, derivative, x)

  derivative_value(f: real_function, x: real): real =
    IF differentiable_at(f, x) THEN
      epsilon(
        LAMBDA (derivative: real):
          has_derivative_at(f, derivative, x))
    ELSE
      0
    ENDIF

  derivative_function(f: real_function): real_function =
    LAMBDA (x: real): derivative_value(f, x)

  second_derivative_value(f: real_function, x: real): real =
    derivative_value(derivative_function(f), x)

  twice_differentiable_on_open_unit_interval(
      f: real_function): bool =
    continuous_on_open_unit_interval(derivative_function(f))
      AND FORALL (x: real):
        in_open_unit_interval(x) IMPLIES
          (differentiable_at(f, x)
            AND differentiable_at(
              derivative_function(f), x))

  tends_to_from_right(
      f: real_function,
      limit_value, point: real): bool =
    FORALL (epsilon_value: posreal):
      EXISTS (delta: posreal):
        FORALL (x: real):
          (point < x AND x < point + delta)
          IMPLIES
            abs(f(x) - limit_value) < epsilon_value

  weighted_second_derivative(
      f: real_function,
      exponent, x: real): real =
    real_power(x, exponent)
      * abs(second_derivative_value(f, x))

  running_supremum_tends_to_positive_infinity(
      f: real_function,
      exponent: real): bool =
    FORALL (threshold: real):
      EXISTS (delta: posreal):
        FORALL (x: real):
          (0 < x AND x < delta)
          IMPLIES
            EXISTS (sample: real):
              0 < sample
                AND sample <= x
                AND weighted_second_derivative(
                  f, exponent, sample)
                  > threshold

  putnam_2019_a6: bool =
    FORALL (g: real_function), (r: real):
      (continuous_on_closed_unit_interval(g)
        AND twice_differentiable_on_open_unit_interval(g)
        AND r > 1
        AND tends_to_from_right(
          LAMBDA (x: real):
            safe_div(g(x), real_power(x, r)),
          0,
          0))
      IMPLIES
        tends_to_from_right(
          derivative_function(g), 0, 0)
          OR running_supremum_tends_to_positive_infinity(g, r)
END putnam_2019_a6

title: putnam_2019_b1
content:
import Mathlib

open Topology Filter

abbrev putnam_2019_b1_solution : ℕ → ℕ := sorry
-- (fun n : ℕ => 5 * n + 1)
/--
Denote by $\mathbb{Z}^2$ the set of all points $(x,y)$ in the plane with integer coordinates. For each integer $n \geq 0$, let $P_n$ be the subset of $\mathbb{Z}^2$ consisting of the point $(0,0)$ together with all points $(x,y)$ such that $x^2+y^2=2^k$ for some integer $k \leq n$. Determine, as a function of $n$, the number of four-point subsets of $P_n$ whose elements are the vertices of a square.
-/
theorem putnam_2019_b1
(n : ℕ)
(Pn : Set (Fin 2 → ℤ))
(pZtoR : (Fin 2 → ℤ) → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
(sPnsquare : Finset (Fin 2 → ℤ) → Prop)
(hPn : Pn = {p | (p 0 = 0 ∧ p 1 = 0) ∨ (∃ k ≤ n, (p 0) ^ 2 + (p 1) ^ 2 = 2 ^ k)})
(hpZtoR : ∀ p i, (pZtoR p) i = p i)
(sPnsquare_def : ∀ sPn : Finset (Fin 2 → ℤ), sPnsquare sPn ↔ (sPn.card = 4 ∧ ∃ p4 : Fin 4 → (Fin 2 → ℤ), Set.range p4 = sPn ∧ (∃ s > 0, ∀ i : Fin 4, dist (pZtoR (p4 i) : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) (pZtoR (p4 (i + 1))) = s) ∧ (dist (pZtoR (p4 0)) (pZtoR (p4 2)) = dist (pZtoR (p4 1)) (pZtoR (p4 3)))))
: {sPn : Finset (Fin 2 → ℤ) | (sPn : Set (Fin 2 → ℤ)) ⊆ Pn ∧ sPnsquare sPn}.encard = putnam_2019_b1_solution n :=
sorry

title: putnam_2019_b1
content:
(* Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2019_b1:
   the number of four-point subsets of specified integer-coordinate circles
   whose points are the vertices of a square. This file contains no proof. *)

From Stdlib Require Import Arith.PeanoNat ZArith Ensembles Finite_sets.

Local Open Scope Z_scope.

Definition putnam_2019_b1_point : Type := (Z * Z)%type.

Definition putnam_2019_b1_x (p : putnam_2019_b1_point) : Z := fst p.

Definition putnam_2019_b1_y (p : putnam_2019_b1_point) : Z := snd p.

Definition putnam_2019_b1_point_lt
    (p q : putnam_2019_b1_point) : Prop :=
  Z.lt (putnam_2019_b1_x p) (putnam_2019_b1_x q) \/
  (putnam_2019_b1_x p = putnam_2019_b1_x q /\
   Z.lt (putnam_2019_b1_y p) (putnam_2019_b1_y q)).

Definition putnam_2019_b1_Pn
    (n : nat) (p : putnam_2019_b1_point) : Prop :=
  p = (0%Z, 0%Z) \/
  exists k : nat,
    Nat.le k n /\
    Z.pow (putnam_2019_b1_x p) 2 +
      Z.pow (putnam_2019_b1_y p) 2 = Z.pow 2 (Z.of_nat k).

Record putnam_2019_b1_four_points : Type := {
  putnam_2019_b1_p0 : putnam_2019_b1_point;
  putnam_2019_b1_p1 : putnam_2019_b1_point;
  putnam_2019_b1_p2 : putnam_2019_b1_point;
  putnam_2019_b1_p3 : putnam_2019_b1_point
}.

Definition putnam_2019_b1_sorted
    (q : putnam_2019_b1_four_points) : Prop :=
  putnam_2019_b1_point_lt
    (putnam_2019_b1_p0 q) (putnam_2019_b1_p1 q) /\
  putnam_2019_b1_point_lt
    (putnam_2019_b1_p1 q) (putnam_2019_b1_p2 q) /\
  putnam_2019_b1_point_lt
    (putnam_2019_b1_p2 q) (putnam_2019_b1_p3 q).

Definition putnam_2019_b1_squared_distance
    (p q : putnam_2019_b1_point) : Z :=
  Z.pow (putnam_2019_b1_x p - putnam_2019_b1_x q) 2 +
  Z.pow (putnam_2019_b1_y p - putnam_2019_b1_y q) 2.

Definition putnam_2019_b1_same_four_points
    (q : putnam_2019_b1_four_points)
    (a b c d : putnam_2019_b1_point) : Prop :=
  forall p : putnam_2019_b1_point,
    (p = a \/ p = b \/ p = c \/ p = d) <->
    (p = putnam_2019_b1_p0 q \/
     p = putnam_2019_b1_p1 q \/
     p = putnam_2019_b1_p2 q \/
     p = putnam_2019_b1_p3 q).

Definition putnam_2019_b1_is_square
    (q : putnam_2019_b1_four_points) : Prop :=
  exists a b c d : putnam_2019_b1_point,
    putnam_2019_b1_same_four_points q a b c d /\
    putnam_2019_b1_squared_distance a b <> 0%Z /\
    putnam_2019_b1_squared_distance a b =
      putnam_2019_b1_squared_distance b c /\
    putnam_2019_b1_squared_distance b c =
      putnam_2019_b1_squared_distance c d /\
    putnam_2019_b1_squared_distance c d =
      putnam_2019_b1_squared_distance d a /\
    putnam_2019_b1_squared_distance a c =
      putnam_2019_b1_squared_distance b d.

Definition putnam_2019_b1_square_subsets
    (n : nat) : Ensemble putnam_2019_b1_four_points :=
  fun q : putnam_2019_b1_four_points =>
    putnam_2019_b1_sorted q /\
    putnam_2019_b1_Pn n (putnam_2019_b1_p0 q) /\
    putnam_2019_b1_Pn n (putnam_2019_b1_p1 q) /\
    putnam_2019_b1_Pn n (putnam_2019_b1_p2 q) /\
    putnam_2019_b1_Pn n (putnam_2019_b1_p3 q) /\
    putnam_2019_b1_is_square q.

Definition putnam_2019_b1_solution (n : nat) : nat :=
  (5 * n + 1)%nat.

Theorem putnam_2019_b1 (n : nat) :
  cardinal putnam_2019_b1_four_points
    (putnam_2019_b1_square_subsets n)
    (putnam_2019_b1_solution n).
Admitted.

theory putnam_2019_b1 imports
Complex_Main
"HOL-Analysis.Finite_Cartesian_Product"
begin

definition putnam_2019_b1_solution :: "nat \<Rightarrow> nat" where
  "putnam_2019_b1_solution \<equiv> (\<lambda>n. 5 * n + 1)"
(* \<lambda> n. 5 * n + 1 *)
theorem putnam_2019_b1:
  fixes n :: nat
  and Pn :: "(int^2) set"
  and pZtoR :: "(int^2) \<Rightarrow> (real^2)"
  and sPnsquare :: "(int^2) set \<Rightarrow> bool"
  defines "Pn \<equiv> {p :: int^2.
    (p$0 = 0 \<and> p$1 = 0) \<or>
    (\<exists>k\<le>n. (p$0)^2 + (p$1)^2 = 2^k)}"
  and "pZtoR \<equiv> \<lambda> p. \<chi> i. (real_of_int (p$i))"
  and "sPnsquare \<equiv> \<lambda>sPn :: (int^2) set.
    card sPn = 4 \<and>
    (\<exists>a b c d :: int^2. sPn = {a, b, c, d} \<and>
      (\<exists>s :: real. s > 0 \<and>
        dist (pZtoR a) (pZtoR b) = s \<and>
        dist (pZtoR b) (pZtoR c) = s \<and>
        dist (pZtoR c) (pZtoR d) = s \<and>
        dist (pZtoR d) (pZtoR a) = s \<and>
        dist (pZtoR a) (pZtoR c) = dist (pZtoR b) (pZtoR d)))"
  shows "card {sPn :: (int^2) set. sPn \<subseteq> Pn \<and> sPnsquare sPn} = putnam_2019_b1_solution n"
  sorry

end

title: putnam_2019_b1
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2019_b1:
  the number of four-point subsets of the prescribed integer lattice set
  whose elements are the vertices of a square is 5n + 1. This file contains
  no proof.
*)

let statement =
  `let pn =
     \n:num.
       {p:int#int |
          p = ((&0:int),(&0:int)) \/
          (?k:num.
             k <= n /\
             (FST p) pow 2 + (SND p) pow 2 = &(2 EXP k))} in
   let edist =
     \(p:int#int) (q:int#int).
       sqrt
         ((real_of_int (FST p) - real_of_int (FST q)) pow 2 +
          (real_of_int (SND p) - real_of_int (SND q)) pow 2) in
   let is_square =
     \(s:(int#int)->bool).
       ?a b c d:int#int.
         s = {a,b,c,d} /\
         s HAS_SIZE 4 /\
         (?e:real.
            &0 < e /\
            edist a b = e /\
            edist b c = e /\
            edist c d = e /\
            edist d a = e /\
            edist a c = edist b d) in
   !n:num.
     CARD
       {s:(int#int)->bool |
          s SUBSET pn n /\ is_square s} =
     5 * n + 1`;;

title: putnam_2019_b1
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2019_b1:
;; the number of four-point subsets of the specified lattice-point set P_n
;; that are vertices of a square is 5*n + 1. This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

;; If x^2+y^2 = 2^k with k <= n, then |x| and |y| are at most 2^n.
;; Thus enumerating the integer box [-2^n,2^n]^2 and filtering by the source
;; predicate constructs exactly P_n, rather than a bounded approximation.

(defun putnam-2019-b1-square (x)
  (* x x))

(defun putnam-2019-b1-squared-distance (left right)
  (+ (putnam-2019-b1-square
      (- (car left) (car right)))
     (putnam-2019-b1-square
      (- (cdr left) (cdr right)))))

(defun putnam-2019-b1-power-of-two-through-p (value exponent)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix exponent)))
  (if (and (natp value)
           (natp exponent))
      (or (equal value (expt 2 exponent))
          (and (not (zp exponent))
               (putnam-2019-b1-power-of-two-through-p
                value (- exponent 1))))
    nil))

(defun putnam-2019-b1-point-in-pn-p (x y n)
  (and
   (integerp x)
   (integerp y)
   (natp n)
   (or
    (and (equal x 0)
         (equal y 0))
    (putnam-2019-b1-power-of-two-through-p
     (+ (putnam-2019-b1-square x)
        (putnam-2019-b1-square y))
     n))))

(defun putnam-2019-b1-pn-row
    (n x remaining bound)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix remaining)))
  (if (and (natp n)
           (integerp x)
           (natp remaining)
           (natp bound))
      (let ((y (- remaining bound)))
        (if (zp remaining)
            (if (putnam-2019-b1-point-in-pn-p x y n)
                (list (cons x y))
              nil)
          (if (putnam-2019-b1-point-in-pn-p x y n)
              (cons
               (cons x y)
               (putnam-2019-b1-pn-row
                n x (- remaining 1) bound))
            (putnam-2019-b1-pn-row
             n x (- remaining 1) bound))))
    nil))

(defun putnam-2019-b1-pn-box
    (n remaining bound)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix remaining)))
  (if (and (natp n)
           (natp remaining)
           (natp bound))
      (let* ((x (- remaining bound))
             (row
              (putnam-2019-b1-pn-row
               n x (* 2 bound) bound)))
        (if (zp remaining)
            row
          (append
           row
           (putnam-2019-b1-pn-box
            n (- remaining 1) bound))))
    nil))

(defun putnam-2019-b1-pn (n)
  (if (natp n)
      (let ((bound (expt 2 n)))
        (putnam-2019-b1-pn-box
         n (* 2 bound) bound))
    nil))

;; Equality of Euclidean distances is equivalent to equality of their
;; nonnegative squares. For four distinct points, the three calls below are
;; exactly the three cyclic orderings up to rotation and reversal, so this
;; unfolds the source condition of four equal sides and equal diagonals.

(defun putnam-2019-b1-square-cycle-p (a b c d)
  (let ((side
         (putnam-2019-b1-squared-distance a b)))
    (and
     (< 0 side)
     (equal
      (putnam-2019-b1-squared-distance b c)
      side)
     (equal
      (putnam-2019-b1-squared-distance c d)
      side)
     (equal
      (putnam-2019-b1-squared-distance d a)
      side)
     (equal
      (putnam-2019-b1-squared-distance a c)
      (putnam-2019-b1-squared-distance b d)))))

(defun putnam-2019-b1-square-set-p (a b c d)
  (or
   (putnam-2019-b1-square-cycle-p a b c d)
   (putnam-2019-b1-square-cycle-p a b d c)
   (putnam-2019-b1-square-cycle-p a c b d)))

;; P_n contains no duplicate points. These four nested tail traversals choose
;; indices i<j<k<l, hence count every four-point subset exactly once.

(defun putnam-2019-b1-count-fourth (a b c points)
  (if (endp points)
      0
    (+ (if (putnam-2019-b1-square-set-p
            a b c (car points))
           1
         0)
       (putnam-2019-b1-count-fourth
        a b c (cdr points)))))

(defun putnam-2019-b1-count-third (a b points)
  (if (endp points)
      0
    (+ (putnam-2019-b1-count-fourth
        a b (car points) (cdr points))
       (putnam-2019-b1-count-third
        a b (cdr points)))))

(defun putnam-2019-b1-count-second (a points)
  (if (endp points)
      0
    (+ (putnam-2019-b1-count-third
        a (car points) (cdr points))
       (putnam-2019-b1-count-second
        a (cdr points)))))

(defun putnam-2019-b1-square-count (points)
  (if (endp points)
      0
    (+ (putnam-2019-b1-count-second
        (car points) (cdr points))
       (putnam-2019-b1-square-count
        (cdr points)))))

(defun putnambench-putnam-2019-b1-statement (n)
  (implies
   (natp n)
   (equal
    (putnam-2019-b1-square-count
     (putnam-2019-b1-pn n))
    (+ (* 5 n) 1))))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

title: putnam_2019_b1
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2019_b1
-- (putnambench__agda__putnam_2019_b1): the number of four-point subsets of
-- the specified integer lattice set whose vertices form a square is 5n + 1.
-- This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module Putnam2019B1 where

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Int using (Int; pos; negsuc)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; _*_)
open import Agda.Primitive using (Level; _⊔_)

infix 4 _!=_ _<=N_ _<N_
infixr 3 _and_
infixr 2 _or_
infix 1 _iff_

data Bottom : Set where

Not :
  {a : Level} ->
  Set a ->
  Set a
Not proposition =
  proposition -> Bottom

_!=_ :
  {a : Level} ->
  {A : Set a} ->
  A ->
  A ->
  Set a
x != y =
  Not (x == y)

record _and_
  {a b : Level}
  (A : Set a)
  (B : Set b) :
  Set (a ⊔ b) where

  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data _or_
  {a b : Level}
  (A : Set a)
  (B : Set b) :
  Set (a ⊔ b) where

  left  : A -> A or B
  right : B -> A or B

record _iff_
  {a b : Level}
  (A : Set a)
  (B : Set b) :
  Set (a ⊔ b) where

  constructor equivalence
  field
    forward  : A -> B
    backward : B -> A

record Exists
  {a p : Level}
  (A : Set a)
  (P : A -> Set p) :
  Set (a ⊔ p) where

  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

data _<=N_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set where
  zero<=N   : {n : Nat} -> zero <=N n
  suc<=sucN : {m n : Nat} -> m <=N n -> suc m <=N suc n

data _<N_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set where
  zero<sucN : {n : Nat} -> zero <N suc n
  suc<sucN  : {m n : Nat} -> m <N n -> suc m <N suc n

data Fin : Nat -> Set where
  fzero : {n : Nat} -> Fin (suc n)
  fsuc  : {n : Nat} -> Fin n -> Fin (suc n)

one : Nat
one =
  suc zero

two : Nat
two =
  suc one

five : Nat
five =
  suc (suc (suc (suc one)))

powerTwo : Nat -> Nat
powerTwo zero =
  one
powerTwo (suc exponent) =
  two * powerTwo exponent

absoluteDifference : Nat -> Nat -> Nat
absoluteDifference zero n =
  n
absoluteDifference m zero =
  m
absoluteDifference (suc m) (suc n) =
  absoluteDifference m n

absoluteIntegerDifference : Int -> Int -> Nat
absoluteIntegerDifference (pos m) (pos n) =
  absoluteDifference m n
absoluteIntegerDifference (pos m) (negsuc n) =
  suc (m + n)
absoluteIntegerDifference (negsuc m) (pos n) =
  suc (m + n)
absoluteIntegerDifference (negsuc m) (negsuc n) =
  absoluteDifference m n

integerSquare : Int -> Nat
integerSquare (pos magnitude) =
  magnitude * magnitude
integerSquare (negsuc predecessor) =
  suc predecessor * suc predecessor

record Point : Set where
  constructor point
  field
    x-coordinate : Int
    y-coordinate : Int

open Point

origin : Point
origin =
  point (pos zero) (pos zero)

squaredDistance : Point -> Point -> Nat
squaredDistance leftPoint rightPoint =
  let
    xDifference =
      absoluteIntegerDifference
        (x-coordinate leftPoint)
        (x-coordinate rightPoint)
    yDifference =
      absoluteIntegerDifference
        (y-coordinate leftPoint)
        (y-coordinate rightPoint)
  in
  xDifference * xDifference + yDifference * yDifference

Pn : Nat -> Point -> Set
Pn n p =
  p == origin
  or
  Exists Nat
    (\ k ->
      k <=N n
      and
      (integerSquare (x-coordinate p) +
       integerSquare (y-coordinate p) ==
       powerTwo k))

Subset : Set1
Subset =
  Point -> Set

SameSubset : Subset -> Subset -> Set
SameSubset leftSubset rightSubset =
  (p : Point) ->
  leftSubset p iff rightSubset p

SubsetOf : Subset -> Subset -> Set
SubsetOf leftSubset rightSubset =
  (p : Point) ->
  leftSubset p ->
  rightSubset p

PairwiseDistinct : Point -> Point -> Point -> Point -> Set
PairwiseDistinct a b c d =
  a != b
  and a != c
  and a != d
  and b != c
  and b != d
  and c != d

HasExactlyVertices :
  Subset ->
  Point ->
  Point ->
  Point ->
  Point ->
  Set
HasExactlyVertices subset a b c d =
  (p : Point) ->
  subset p
  iff
  ((p == a or p == b) or (p == c or p == d))

AreCyclicSquareVertices : Point -> Point -> Point -> Point -> Set
AreCyclicSquareVertices a b c d =
  PairwiseDistinct a b c d
  and
  (zero <N squaredDistance a b)
  and
  (squaredDistance a b == squaredDistance b c)
  and
  (squaredDistance b c == squaredDistance c d)
  and
  (squaredDistance c d == squaredDistance d a)
  and
  (squaredDistance a c == squaredDistance b d)

IsFourPointSquare : Subset -> Set
IsFourPointSquare subset =
  Exists Point
    (\ a ->
      Exists Point
        (\ b ->
          Exists Point
            (\ c ->
              Exists Point
                (\ d ->
                  HasExactlyVertices subset a b c d
                  and
                  AreCyclicSquareVertices a b c d))))

QualifyingSquareSubset : Nat -> Subset -> Set
QualifyingSquareSubset n subset =
  SubsetOf subset (Pn n)
  and
  IsFourPointSquare subset

record HasSquareSubsetCardinality
  (n cardinality : Nat) :
  Set1 where

  field
    enumerate :
      Fin cardinality ->
      Subset

    enumerated-square :
      (index : Fin cardinality) ->
      QualifyingSquareSubset n (enumerate index)

    enumeration-complete :
      (subset : Subset) ->
      QualifyingSquareSubset n subset ->
      Exists (Fin cardinality)
        (\ index ->
          SameSubset subset (enumerate index))

    enumeration-injective :
      (left-index right-index : Fin cardinality) ->
      SameSubset
        (enumerate left-index)
        (enumerate right-index) ->
      left-index == right-index

putnam-2019-b1 : Set1
putnam-2019-b1 =
  (n : Nat) ->
  HasSquareSubsetCardinality n (five * n + one)

title: putnam_2019_b1
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2019_b1:
  the number of four-point subsets forming squares among integer lattice
  points on circles of squared radii 2^k, together with the origin, is
  5*n + 1. This file contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open arithmeticTheory integerTheory pairTheory pred_setTheory;

val putnam_2019_b1 =
  ``let lattice_points =
      \n : num.
        {P : int # int |
           P = (0, 0) \/
           ?k : num.
             k <= n /\
             FST P * FST P + SND P * SND P =
             int_of_num (2 EXP k)}
    in
    let squared_distance =
      \P Q : int # int.
        (FST P - FST Q) * (FST P - FST Q) +
        (SND P - SND Q) * (SND P - SND Q)
    in
    let is_square =
      \S : (int # int) set.
        S HAS_SIZE 4 /\
        ?A B C D : int # int.
          S = {A; B; C; D} /\
          squared_distance A B <> 0 /\
          squared_distance A B = squared_distance B C /\
          squared_distance B C = squared_distance C D /\
          squared_distance C D = squared_distance D A /\
          squared_distance A C = squared_distance B D
    in
      !n : num.
        CARD
          {s : (int # int) set |
             s SUBSET lattice_points n /\ is_square s} =
        5 * n + 1``;

title: putnam_2019_b1
content:
$(
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact
  putnam_2019_b1: for each nonnegative integer n, the number of four-point
  subsets of the integer points at the origin or on a circle of squared
  radius 2^k for some 0 <= k <= n that form a square is 5n + 1. This file
  contains no proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  P19B1Plane is the full integer coordinate plane. P19B1Pn(n) is the source
  set P_n, with the exponent k still internally existentially quantified
  over the inclusive interval from zero through n. P19B1DistSq is squared
  Euclidean distance on that plane.

  P19B1Square(S) says that S consists of four distinct points A, B, C, D in
  cyclic order, with positive equal squared side lengths and equal squared
  diagonal lengths. Squaring preserves equality and positivity of the
  Euclidean distances, so this is equivalent to the source square predicate.
  The definitions and final declaration are unproved $a statement encodings;
  this database contains no $p proof declaration.
$)

$c P19B1Plane P19B1Pn P19B1DistSq P19B1Square $.

p19b1-plane-syntax $a class P19B1Plane $.
p19b1-pn-syntax $a class ( P19B1Pn n ) $.
p19b1-distance-square-syntax $a class ( P19B1DistSq A B ) $.
p19b1-square-syntax $a wff ( P19B1Square S ) $.

p19b1-plane-definition $a |- P19B1Plane = ( ZZ X. ZZ ) $.

${
  $d k n p $.

  p19b1-pn-definition $a |- ( P19B1Pn n ) = {
    p e. P19B1Plane |
      (
        p = <. 0 , 0 >.
        \/
        E. k e. ( 0 ... n )
          (
            (
              ( ( 1st ` p ) ^ 2 )
              +
              ( ( 2nd ` p ) ^ 2 )
            )
            =
            ( 2 ^ k )
          )
      )
  } $.
$}

p19b1-distance-square-definition $a |- (
  P19B1DistSq A B
) = (
  (
    ( ( 1st ` A ) - ( 1st ` B ) ) ^ 2
  )
  +
  (
    ( ( 2nd ` A ) - ( 2nd ` B ) ) ^ 2
  )
) $.

${
  $d A B C D S p $.

  p19b1-square-definition $a |- (
    ( P19B1Square S )
    <->
    (
      (
        S e. Fin
        /\
        S C_ P19B1Plane
      )
      /\
      E. A e. P19B1Plane
        E. B e. P19B1Plane
          E. C e. P19B1Plane
            E. D e. P19B1Plane
              (
                S = {
                  p e. P19B1Plane |
                    (
                      (
                        (
                          p = A
                          \/
                          p = B
                        )
                        \/
                        p = C
                      )
                      \/
                      p = D
                    )
                }
                /\
                (
                  ( # ` S ) = 4
                  /\
                  (
                    0 < ( P19B1DistSq A B )
                    /\
                    (
                      ( P19B1DistSq A B ) = ( P19B1DistSq B C )
                      /\
                      (
                        ( P19B1DistSq B C ) = ( P19B1DistSq C D )
                        /\
                        (
                          ( P19B1DistSq C D ) = ( P19B1DistSq D A )
                          /\
                          ( P19B1DistSq A C ) = ( P19B1DistSq B D )
                        )
                      )
                    )
                  )
                )
              )
    )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d S n $.

  putnambench-putnam-2019-b1 $a |- A. n e. NN0
    (
      #
      `
      {
        S e. Fin |
          (
            S C_ ( P19B1Pn n )
            /\
            ( P19B1Square S )
          )
      }
    )
    =
    ( ( 5 x. n ) + 1 )
  $.
$}

:: Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2019_b1
:: (putnambench__mizar__putnam_2019_b1): the number of four-point square
:: subsets among specified integer lattice points is 5*n+1. This file
:: contains no proof.

environ
  vocabularies TARSKI, XBOOLE_0, SUBSET_1, ZFMISC_1, RELAT_1,
    NUMBERS, NAT_1, INT_1, CARD_1, XCMPLX_0, XREAL_0, XXREAL_0,
    ORDINAL1, FINSET_1, NEWTON, SQUARE_1, ARYTM_1, ARYTM_3;
  notations TARSKI, XBOOLE_0, ENUMSET1, ZFMISC_1, SUBSET_1,
    ORDINAL1, CARD_1, FINSET_1, NUMBERS, XCMPLX_0, XREAL_0,
    XXREAL_0, INT_1, NAT_1, NEWTON, SQUARE_1;
  constructors ENUMSET1, XXREAL_0, NAT_1, NEWTON, SQUARE_1,
    REAL_1, FINSET_1, CARD_1;
  registrations XBOOLE_0, SUBSET_1, XXREAL_0, XREAL_0, NAT_1,
    INT_1, ORDINAL1, CARD_1, NEWTON, SQUARE_1, FRAENKEL;
  requirements REAL, NUMERALS, SUBSET, BOOLE, ARITHM;

begin

::$P-
theorem
  for n being Nat,
      Pn being Subset of [:INT,INT:] st
    Pn = {[x,y] where x,y is Integer :
      ((x = 0 & y = 0) or
       (ex k being Nat st
          k <= n & x^2 + y^2 = ((2 qua Integer) |^ k)))}
  holds
    card {S where S is Subset of Pn :
      card S = 4 &
      ex xa,ya,xb,yb,xc,yc,xd,yd being Integer st
        S = {[xa,ya],[xb,yb],[xc,yc],[xd,yd]} &
        (xa-xb)^2 + (ya-yb)^2 > 0 &
        (xa-xb)^2 + (ya-yb)^2 =
          (xb-xc)^2 + (yb-yc)^2 &
        (xb-xc)^2 + (yb-yc)^2 =
          (xc-xd)^2 + (yc-yd)^2 &
        (xc-xd)^2 + (yc-yd)^2 =
          (xd-xa)^2 + (yd-ya)^2 &
        (xa-xc)^2 + (ya-yc)^2 =
          (xb-xd)^2 + (yb-yd)^2}
    = 5*n + 1
proof
end;
::$P+

title: putnam_2019_b1
content:
% Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2019_b1:
% for each n, the integer lattice points at squared distance a power of two
% through 2^n from the origin, together with the origin, determine exactly
% 5*n + 1 four-point subsets that are vertices of squares. This file contains
% no proof.

putnam_2019_b1: THEORY
BEGIN
  point: TYPE = [# x_coord: int, y_coord: int #]

  IMPORTING finite_sets[point]

  point_set: TYPE = finite_set[point]

  IMPORTING finite_sets[point_set]

  square_family: TYPE = finite_set[point_set]

  squared_distance(P, Q: point): int =
    (x_coord(P) - x_coord(Q)) ^ 2
      + (y_coord(P) - y_coord(Q)) ^ 2

  in_P(n: nat, P: point): bool =
    (x_coord(P) = 0 AND y_coord(P) = 0)
      OR EXISTS (k: nat):
        k <= n
          AND x_coord(P) ^ 2 + y_coord(P) ^ 2 = 2 ^ k

  has_exact_vertices(
      S: point_set,
      A, B, C, D: point): bool =
    FORALL (P: point):
      S(P) IFF (P = A OR P = B OR P = C OR P = D)

  is_square(S: point_set): bool =
    card(S) = 4
      AND EXISTS (A, B, C, D: point):
        has_exact_vertices(S, A, B, C, D)
          AND squared_distance(A, B) > 0
          AND squared_distance(A, B) = squared_distance(B, C)
          AND squared_distance(B, C) = squared_distance(C, D)
          AND squared_distance(C, D) = squared_distance(D, A)
          AND squared_distance(A, C) = squared_distance(B, D)

  square_subset_of_P(n: nat, S: point_set): bool =
    (FORALL (P: point):
      S(P) IMPLIES in_P(n, P))
      AND is_square(S)

  putnam_2019_b1_solution(n: nat): nat =
    5 * n + 1

  putnam_2019_b1: bool =
    FORALL (n: nat):
      EXISTS (squares: square_family):
        card(squares) = putnam_2019_b1_solution(n)
          AND FORALL (S: point_set):
            squares(S) IFF square_subset_of_P(n, S)
END putnam_2019_b1

import Mathlib

open Topology Filter Set

noncomputable abbrev putnam_2019_b2_solution : ℝ := sorry
-- 8/Real.pi^3
/--
For all $n \geq 1$, let
\[
a_n = \sum_{k=1}^{n-1} \frac{\sin \left( \frac{(2k-1)\pi}{2n} \right)}{\cos^2 \left( \frac{(k-1)\pi}{2n} \right) \cos^2 \left( \frac{k\pi}{2n} \right)}.
\]
Determine
\[
\lim_{n \to \infty} \frac{a_n}{n^3}.
\]
-/
theorem putnam_2019_b2
(a : ℕ → ℝ)
(ha : a = fun n : ℕ => ∑ k : Icc (1 : ℤ) (n - 1),
Real.sin ((2*k - 1)*Real.pi/(2*n))/((Real.cos ((k - 1)*Real.pi/(2*n))^2)*(Real.cos (k*Real.pi/(2*n))^2)))
: Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => (a n)/n^3) atTop (𝓝 putnam_2019_b2_solution) :=
sorry

putnam_2019_b2
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2019_b2:
;; the normalized trigonometric sums with angles (2k-1)pi/(2n) converge
;; to 8/pi^3. This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

; All real quantities below are represented by concrete rational regular
; Cauchy names.  P19B2-PI-NAME-VALUE uses Machin's formula, and the
; trigonometric names use rational complex binomial approximants to exp(ix).
; The explicit precision budgets make each returned rational lie within its
; requested positive rational tolerance of the represented real.

(defun p19b2-positive-rational-p (x)
  (and (rationalp x)
       (< 0 x)))

(defun p19b2-arctan-prefix (x terms)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix terms)))
  (if (zp terms)
      0
    (let* ((j (1- terms))
           (power (expt x (+ (* 2 j) 1)))
           (term (/ power (+ (* 2 j) 1))))
      (+ (p19b2-arctan-prefix x j)
         (if (evenp j) term (- term))))))

(defun p19b2-pi-prefix (terms)
  (- (* 16 (p19b2-arctan-prefix 1/5 terms))
     (* 4 (p19b2-arctan-prefix 1/239 terms))))

(defun p19b2-pi-name-value (epsilon)
  (if (p19b2-positive-rational-p epsilon)
      (p19b2-pi-prefix
       (+ 24 (floor 64 epsilon)))
    0))

(defun p19b2-binomial-steps (x epsilon)
  (if (and (rationalp x)
           (p19b2-positive-rational-p epsilon))
      (expt 2
            (+ 64
               (* 16 (floor (abs x) 1))
               (floor 64 epsilon)))
    1))

(defun p19b2-binomial-trig-value (x epsilon cosine-p)
  (if (and (rationalp x)
           (p19b2-positive-rational-p epsilon))
      (let* ((steps (p19b2-binomial-steps x epsilon))
             (base (complex 1 (/ x steps)))
             (power (expt base steps)))
        (if cosine-p
            (realpart power)
          (imagpart power)))
    0))

(defun p19b2-angle-trig-name-value
    (numerator denominator epsilon cosine-p)
  (if (and (natp numerator)
           (posp denominator)
           (<= numerator denominator)
           (p19b2-positive-rational-p epsilon))
      (let* ((inner (/ epsilon 16))
             (pi-value (p19b2-pi-name-value inner))
             (angle (/ (* numerator pi-value) denominator)))
        (p19b2-binomial-trig-value angle inner cosine-p))
    0))

; For 1 <= k < n, both cosine factors are at least 1/n.  Consequently
; the power (n+1)^16 and the factor 2^20 below dominate the accumulated
; error from four powers, reciprocal formation, n-1 summands, and the
; final division by n^3.
(defun p19b2-working-precision (n epsilon)
  (if (and (posp n)
           (p19b2-positive-rational-p epsilon))
      (/ (if (< epsilon 1) epsilon 1)
         (* 1048576 (expt (+ n 1) 16)))
    1))

(defun p19b2-summand-name-value (n k precision)
  (if (and (posp n)
           (posp k)
           (< k n)
           (p19b2-positive-rational-p precision))
      (let* ((two-n (* 2 n))
             (sine
              (p19b2-angle-trig-name-value
               (- (* 2 k) 1) two-n precision nil))
             (cos-left
              (p19b2-angle-trig-name-value
               (- k 1) two-n precision t))
             (cos-right
              (p19b2-angle-trig-name-value
               k two-n precision t))
             (denominator
              (* (expt cos-left 2)
                 (expt cos-right 2))))
        (/ sine denominator))
    0))

(defun p19b2-sum-through-name-value (n k precision)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix k)))
  (if (zp k)
      0
    (+ (p19b2-sum-through-name-value n (1- k) precision)
       (p19b2-summand-name-value n k precision))))

(defun p19b2-normalized-name-value (n epsilon)
  (if (and (posp n)
           (p19b2-positive-rational-p epsilon))
      (let ((precision (p19b2-working-precision n epsilon)))
        (/ (p19b2-sum-through-name-value n (1- n) precision)
           (expt n 3)))
    0))

(defun p19b2-solution-name-value (epsilon)
  (if (p19b2-positive-rational-p epsilon)
      (let* ((precision
              (/ (if (< epsilon 1) epsilon 1) 4096))
             (pi-value (p19b2-pi-name-value precision)))
        (/ 8 (expt pi-value 3)))
    0))

; If q_n(delta) and q(delta) are the regular-name values above, each is
; within delta of its represented real.  Thus
;   |q_n(epsilon/8)-q(epsilon/8)| < 3 epsilon/4
; implies real distance < epsilon.  Conversely, a real tail within
; epsilon/2 satisfies this displayed test.  Since positive rational
; epsilons are cofinal among positive real epsilons, the following is
; bidirectionally equivalent to the usual real epsilon-N limit.
(defun p19b2-name-distance-within-p (n epsilon)
  (and (posp n)
       (p19b2-positive-rational-p epsilon)
       (< (abs
           (- (p19b2-normalized-name-value n (/ epsilon 8))
              (p19b2-solution-name-value (/ epsilon 8))))
          (* 3/4 epsilon))))

(defun-sk p19b2-limit-tail-p (epsilon start)
  (forall (n)
    (implies (and (natp n)
                  (<= start n))
             (p19b2-name-distance-within-p n epsilon))))

(defun-sk p19b2-limit-cutoff-exists-p (epsilon)
  (exists (start)
    (and (natp start)
         (p19b2-limit-tail-p epsilon start))))

(defun-sk putnambench-putnam-2019-b2-statement ()
  (forall (epsilon)
    (implies (p19b2-positive-rational-p epsilon)
             (p19b2-limit-cutoff-exists-p epsilon))))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)

:q

title: putnam_2019_b2
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2019_b2
-- (putnambench__agda__putnam_2019_b2): the limit of a normalized finite
-- trigonometric sum is 8 divided by pi cubed. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module Putnam2019B2 where

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; _*_)

infix 4 _!=_ _<=N_
infixr 3 _and_
infixr 2 _or_

data Bottom : Set where

Not : Set -> Set
Not A =
  A -> Bottom

_!=_ : {A : Set} -> A -> A -> Set
x != y =
  Not (x == y)

record _and_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data _or_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  left  : A -> A or B
  right : B -> A or B

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

data _<=N_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set where
  zero<=N   : {n : Nat} -> zero <=N n
  suc<=sucN : {m n : Nat} -> m <=N n -> suc m <=N suc n

oneN : Nat
oneN =
  suc zero

twoN : Nat
twoN =
  suc oneN

threeN : Nat
threeN =
  suc twoN

eightN : Nat
eightN =
  twoN * twoN * twoN

Positive : Nat -> Set
Positive n =
  oneN <=N n

predecessor : Nat -> Nat
predecessor zero =
  zero
predecessor (suc n) =
  n

record CompleteOrderedRealField (R : Set) : Set1 where
  field
    zeroR oneR : R
    add multiply : R -> R -> R
    negate inverse : R -> R
    lessOrEqual : R -> R -> Set
    fromNat : Nat -> R

    one-not-zero :
      oneR != zeroR

    add-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> add x y == add y x
    add-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      add (add x y) z == add x (add y z)
    add-zero :
      (x : R) -> add x zeroR == x
    add-inverse :
      (x : R) -> add x (negate x) == zeroR

    multiply-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> multiply x y == multiply y x
    multiply-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply (multiply x y) z ==
      multiply x (multiply y z)
    multiply-one :
      (x : R) -> multiply x oneR == x
    multiply-zero :
      (x : R) -> multiply x zeroR == zeroR
    distribute :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply x (add y z) ==
      add (multiply x y) (multiply x z)
    inverse-zero :
      inverse zeroR == zeroR
    multiply-inverse :
      (x : R) ->
      x != zeroR ->
      multiply x (inverse x) == oneR

    order-reflexive :
      (x : R) -> lessOrEqual x x
    order-transitive :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y z ->
      lessOrEqual x z
    order-antisymmetric :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y x ->
      x == y
    order-total :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y or lessOrEqual y x
    add-order :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual (add z x) (add z y)
    multiply-nonnegative :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR x ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR y ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR (multiply x y)
    zero-less-than-one :
      lessOrEqual zeroR oneR and zeroR != oneR

    fromNat-zero :
      fromNat zero == zeroR
    fromNat-successor :
      (n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (suc n) == add (fromNat n) oneR
    fromNat-addition :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m + n) == add (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-multiplication :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m * n) == multiply (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-injective :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat m == fromNat n ->
      m == n

    archimedean :
      (x : R) ->
      Exists Nat
        (\ n ->
          lessOrEqual x (fromNat n))
    least-upper-bound :
      (P : R -> Set) ->
      Exists R P ->
      Exists R
        (\ upper ->
          (x : R) ->
          P x ->
          lessOrEqual x upper) ->
      Exists R
        (\ supremum ->
          ((x : R) ->
            P x ->
            lessOrEqual x supremum)
          and
          ((upper : R) ->
            ((x : R) ->
              P x ->
              lessOrEqual x upper) ->
            lessOrEqual supremum upper))

open CompleteOrderedRealField

subtract :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
subtract reals x y =
  add reals x (negate reals y)

divide :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
divide reals x y =
  multiply reals x (inverse reals y)

square :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R
square reals x =
  multiply reals x x

StrictLess :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
StrictLess reals x y =
  lessOrEqual reals x y and x != y

CloseTo :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
CloseTo reals center radius x =
  StrictLess reals
    (subtract reals center radius)
    x
  and
  StrictLess reals
    x
    (add reals center radius)

sumFirst :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Nat ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  R
sumFirst reals zero terms =
  zeroR reals
sumFirst reals (suc n) terms =
  add reals
    (sumFirst reals n terms)
    (terms n)

naturalPower :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  Nat ->
  R
naturalPower reals x zero =
  oneR reals
naturalPower reals x (suc n) =
  multiply reals
    (naturalPower reals x n)
    x

factorial : Nat -> Nat
factorial zero =
  oneN
factorial (suc n) =
  suc n * factorial n

alternate :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Nat ->
  R ->
  R
alternate reals zero x =
  x
alternate reals (suc n) x =
  negate reals (alternate reals n x)

evenExponent : Nat -> Nat
evenExponent n =
  n + n

oddExponent : Nat -> Nat
oddExponent n =
  suc (evenExponent n)

sineTerm :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  Nat ->
  R
sineTerm reals x n =
  alternate reals n
    (divide reals
      (naturalPower reals x (oddExponent n))
      (fromNat reals (factorial (oddExponent n))))

cosineTerm :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  Nat ->
  R
cosineTerm reals x n =
  alternate reals n
    (divide reals
      (naturalPower reals x (evenExponent n))
      (fromNat reals (factorial (evenExponent n))))

ConvergesTo :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  R ->
  Set
ConvergesTo {R} reals sequence limit =
  (epsilon : R) ->
  StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) epsilon ->
  Exists Nat
    (\ cutoff ->
      (n : Nat) ->
      cutoff <=N n ->
      CloseTo reals limit epsilon (sequence n))

SeriesHasSum :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  R ->
  Set
SeriesHasSum reals terms value =
  ConvergesTo reals
    (\ n -> sumFirst reals n terms)
    value

record StandardTrigonometry
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) :
  Set1 where

  field
    sine cosine : R -> R
    pi : R

    sine-is-power-series :
      (x : R) ->
      SeriesHasSum reals
        (sineTerm reals x)
        (sine x)
    cosine-is-power-series :
      (x : R) ->
      SeriesHasSum reals
        (cosineTerm reals x)
        (cosine x)

    pi-positive :
      StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) pi
    sine-pi-zero :
      sine pi == zeroR reals
    pi-is-first-positive-sine-zero :
      (x : R) ->
      StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) x ->
      sine x == zeroR reals ->
      lessOrEqual reals pi x

open StandardTrigonometry

module Putnam2019B2Statement
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R)
  (trigonometry : StandardTrigonometry reals) where

  twoTimes : Nat -> Nat
  twoTimes n =
    n + n

  angle :
    Nat ->
    Nat ->
    R
  angle numerator n =
    divide reals
      (multiply reals
        (fromNat reals numerator)
        (pi trigonometry))
      (fromNat reals (twoTimes n))

  summand :
    Nat ->
    Nat ->
    R
  summand n j =
    divide reals
      (sine trigonometry
        (angle (oddExponent j) n))
      (multiply reals
        (square reals
          (cosine trigonometry
            (angle j n)))
        (square reals
          (cosine trigonometry
            (angle (suc j) n))))

  prescribedValue :
    Nat ->
    R
  prescribedValue n =
    sumFirst reals
      (predecessor n)
      (summand n)

  normalizedValue :
    (Nat -> R) ->
    Nat ->
    R
  normalizedValue a n =
    divide reals
      (a n)
      (naturalPower reals
        (fromNat reals n)
        threeN)

  solution : R
  solution =
    divide reals
      (fromNat reals eightN)
      (naturalPower reals
        (pi trigonometry)
        threeN)

  proposition : Set
  proposition =
    (a : Nat -> R) ->
    ((n : Nat) ->
      Positive n ->
      a n == prescribedValue n) ->
    ConvergesTo reals
      (normalizedValue a)
      solution

putnam-2019-b2 : Set1
putnam-2019-b2 =
  (R : Set) ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) ->
  (trigonometry : StandardTrigonometry reals) ->
  Putnam2019B2Statement.proposition reals trigonometry

  these values is equivalent to the source real convergence.

  database contains no $p proof declaration.

  putnambench-putnam-2019-b2 $a |-
    (
      n e. NN |->

          (
            sum_ k e. ( 1 ... ( n - 1 ) )

                  (

                      x.
                      _pi

                    /

                  )

                        (

                  )

              )

title: putnam_2019_b2
content:
% Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2019_b2:
% the normalized cubic-scale limit of a finite trigonometric sum is 8/pi^3.
% This file contains no proof.

putnam_2019_b2: THEORY
BEGIN
  real_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> real]

  safe_div(numerator, denominator: real): real =
    IF denominator = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      numerator / denominator
    ENDIF

  nat_factorial(index: nat): RECURSIVE nat =
    IF index = 0 THEN
      1
    ELSE
      index * nat_factorial(index - 1)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE index

  sine_partial(x: real, count: nat): RECURSIVE real =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      LET index: nat = count - 1 IN
        sine_partial(x, count - 1)
          + safe_div(
              ((-1 :: real) ^ index) * x ^ (2 * index + 1),
              nat_factorial(2 * index + 1) :: real)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  cosine_partial(x: real, count: nat): RECURSIVE real =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      LET index: nat = count - 1 IN
        cosine_partial(x, count - 1)
          + safe_div(
              ((-1 :: real) ^ index) * x ^ (2 * index),
              nat_factorial(2 * index) :: real)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  leibniz_partial_sum(count: nat): RECURSIVE real =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      LET index: nat = count - 1 IN
        leibniz_partial_sum(count - 1)
          + safe_div(
              (-1 :: real) ^ index,
              (2 * index + 1) :: real)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  converges_to(sequence: real_sequence, value: real): bool =
    FORALL (epsilon_value: posreal):
      EXISTS (cutoff: nat):
        FORALL (index: nat):
          cutoff <= index IMPLIES
            abs(sequence(index) - value) < epsilon_value

  sine(x: real): real =
    epsilon(
      LAMBDA (value: real):
        converges_to(
          LAMBDA (count: nat): sine_partial(x, count),
          value))

  cosine(x: real): real =
    epsilon(
      LAMBDA (value: real):
        converges_to(
          LAMBDA (count: nat): cosine_partial(x, count),
          value))

  is_pi(value: real): bool =
    converges_to(
      LAMBDA (count: nat):
        4 * leibniz_partial_sum(count),
      value)

  pi: real =
    epsilon(
      LAMBDA (value: real):
        is_pi(value))

  summand(n, k: nat): real =
    safe_div(
      sine(
        safe_div(
          (2 * (k :: real) - 1) * pi,
          2 * (n :: real))),
      cosine(
        safe_div(
          ((k :: real) - 1) * pi,
          2 * (n :: real))) ^ 2
        * cosine(
            safe_div(
              (k :: real) * pi,
              2 * (n :: real))) ^ 2)

  finite_sum(n, count: nat): RECURSIVE real =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      finite_sum(n, count - 1) + summand(n, count)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  putnam_2019_b2: bool =
    converges_to(
      LAMBDA (n: nat):
        IF n = 0 THEN
          0
        ELSE
          safe_div(
            finite_sum(n, n - 1),
            (n :: real) ^ 3)
        ENDIF,
      safe_div(8, pi ^ 3))
END putnam_2019_b2
