title: putnam_2019_b3
content:
% Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2019_b3:
% a Householder reflection formed from a real unit vector makes 1 an
% eigenvalue of PQ when Q is orthogonal and does not have eigenvalue 1.
% This file contains no proof.

putnam_2019_b3[n: posnat]: THEORY
BEGIN
  index: TYPE = below(n)
  vector: TYPE = [index -> real]
  matrix: TYPE = [index, index -> real]
  unbounded_matrix: TYPE = [nat, nat -> real]

  bounded_real_sum(
      values: [index -> real],
      count: nat): RECURSIVE real =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      bounded_real_sum(values, count - 1)
        + IF count <= n THEN values(count - 1) ELSE 0 ENDIF
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  matrix_transpose(A: matrix): matrix =
    LAMBDA (row, column: index):
      A(column, row)

  matrix_multiply(A, B: matrix): matrix =
    LAMBDA (row, column: index):
      bounded_real_sum(
        LAMBDA (inner: index):
          A(row, inner) * B(inner, column),
        n)

  matrix_subtract(A, B: matrix): matrix =
    LAMBDA (row, column: index):
      A(row, column) - B(row, column)

  identity_matrix: matrix =
    LAMBDA (row, column: index):
      IF row = column THEN 1 ELSE 0 ENDIF

  row_inner_product(A: matrix, row_1, row_2: index): real =
    bounded_real_sum(
      LAMBDA (column: index):
        A(row_1, column) * A(row_2, column),
      n)

  column_inner_product(A: matrix, column_1, column_2: index): real =
    bounded_real_sum(
      LAMBDA (row: index):
        A(row, column_1) * A(row, column_2),
      n)

  orthogonal_matrix(A: matrix): bool =
    (FORALL (i, j: index):
      i /= j IMPLIES
        row_inner_product(A, i, j) = 0
          AND column_inner_product(A, i, j) = 0)
      AND (FORALL (i: index):
        row_inner_product(A, i, i) = 1
          AND column_inner_product(A, i, i) = 1)

  unit_vector(u: vector): bool =
    bounded_real_sum(
      LAMBDA (i: index): u(i) * u(i),
      n) = 1

  householder_matrix(u: vector): matrix =
    LAMBDA (row, column: index):
      identity_matrix(row, column) - 2 * u(row) * u(column)

  quotient_aux(
      numerator, denominator, fuel: nat): RECURSIVE nat =
    IF fuel = 0
        OR denominator = 0
        OR numerator < denominator THEN
      0
    ELSE
      1
        + quotient_aux(
            numerator - denominator,
            denominator,
            fuel - 1)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE fuel

  remainder_aux(
      numerator, denominator, fuel: nat): RECURSIVE nat =
    IF fuel = 0
        OR denominator = 0
        OR numerator < denominator THEN
      numerator
    ELSE
      remainder_aux(
        numerator - denominator,
        denominator,
        fuel - 1)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE fuel

  safe_ndiv(numerator, denominator: nat): nat =
    quotient_aux(
      numerator,
      denominator,
      numerator + 1)

  safe_mod(numerator, denominator: nat): nat =
    IF denominator = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      remainder_aux(
        numerator,
        denominator,
        numerator + 1)
    ENDIF

  function_code_count: nat = n ^ n

  permutation_entry(code, row: nat): nat =
    safe_mod(safe_ndiv(code, n ^ row), n)

  permutation_code(code: nat): bool =
    code < function_code_count
      AND (FORALL (row_1, row_2: nat):
        (row_1 < n
          AND row_2 < n
          AND permutation_entry(code, row_1)
            = permutation_entry(code, row_2))
        IMPLIES row_1 = row_2)

  pair_row(pair: nat): nat =
    safe_ndiv(pair, n)

  pair_column(pair: nat): nat =
    safe_mod(pair, n)

  inversion_at(code, pair: nat): bool =
    pair_row(pair) < n
      AND pair_column(pair) < n
      AND pair_row(pair) < pair_column(pair)
      AND permutation_entry(code, pair_row(pair))
        > permutation_entry(code, pair_column(pair))

  count_true(
      property: [nat -> bool],
      count: nat): RECURSIVE nat =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      count_true(property, count - 1)
        + IF property(count - 1) THEN 1 ELSE 0 ENDIF
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  inversion_count(code: nat): nat =
    count_true(
      LAMBDA (pair: nat): inversion_at(code, pair),
      n * n)

  permutation_sign(code: nat): real =
    IF mod(inversion_count(code), 2) = 0 THEN
      1
    ELSE
      -1
    ENDIF

  permutation_product(
      A: unbounded_matrix,
      code, count: nat): RECURSIVE real =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      1
    ELSE
      permutation_product(A, code, count - 1)
        * A(
            count - 1,
            permutation_entry(code, count - 1))
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  determinant_sum(
      A: unbounded_matrix,
      limit: nat): RECURSIVE real =
    IF limit = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      LET code: nat = limit - 1 IN
        determinant_sum(A, limit - 1)
          + IF permutation_code(code) THEN
              permutation_sign(code)
                * permutation_product(A, code, n)
            ELSE
              0
            ENDIF
    ENDIF
  MEASURE limit

  extend_matrix(A: matrix): unbounded_matrix =
    LAMBDA (row, column: nat):
      IF row < n AND column < n THEN
        A(row, column)
      ELSE
        0
      ENDIF

  determinant(A: matrix): real =
    determinant_sum(extend_matrix(A), function_code_count)

  putnam_2019_b3: bool =
    FORALL (Q: matrix), (u: vector), (P: matrix):
      (orthogonal_matrix(Q)
        AND unit_vector(u)
        AND P = householder_matrix(u))
      IMPLIES
        (determinant(matrix_subtract(Q, identity_matrix)) /= 0
          IMPLIES
            determinant(
              matrix_subtract(
                matrix_multiply(P, Q),
                identity_matrix)) = 0)
END putnam_2019_b3

title: putnam_2019_b4
content:
import Mathlib

open Topology Filter Set Matrix

-- Note: boosts the domain of f to the entire 2D plane
noncomputable abbrev putnam_2019_b4_solution : ℝ := sorry
-- 2 * Real.log 2 - 1 / 2
/--
Let $\mathcal{F}$ be the set of functions $f(x,y)$ that are twice continuously differentiable for $x \geq 1,y \geq 1$ and that satisfy the following two equations (where subscripts denote partial derivatives):
\begin{gather*}
xf_x+yf_y=xy\ln(xy), \\
x^2f_{xx}+y^2f_{yy}=xy.
\end{gather*}
For each $f \in \mathcal{F}$, let $m(f)=\min_{s \geq 1} (f(s+1,s+1)-f(s+1,s)-f(s,s+1)+f(s,s))$. Determine $m(f)$, and show that it is independent of the choice of $f$.
-/
theorem putnam_2019_b4
(f : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → ℝ)
(vec : ℝ → ℝ → (Fin 2 → ℝ))
(fdiff : ContDiff ℝ 2 f)
(hvec : ∀ x y : ℝ, (vec x y) 0 = x ∧ (vec x y 1) = y)
(feq1 : ∀ x ≥ 1, ∀ y ≥ 1, x * deriv (fun x' : ℝ => f (vec x' y)) x + y * deriv (fun y' : ℝ => f (vec x y')) y = x * y * Real.log (x * y))
(feq2 : ∀ x ≥ 1, ∀ y ≥ 1, x ^ 2 * iteratedDeriv 2 (fun x' : ℝ => f (vec x' y)) x + y ^ 2 * iteratedDeriv 2 (fun y' : ℝ => f (vec x y')) y = x * y)
: sInf {f (vec (s + 1) (s + 1)) - f (vec (s + 1) s) - f (vec s (s + 1)) + f (vec s s) | s ≥ 1} = putnam_2019_b4_solution :=
sorry

title: putnam_2019_b4
content:
(* Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2019_b4:
   the greatest lower bound of a mixed finite difference for twice continuously
   differentiable functions satisfying two partial differential equations on
   the quadrant x >= 1, y >= 1. This file contains no proof. *)

From Stdlib Require Import Reals ClassicalEpsilon.

Open Scope R_scope.

Definition putnam_2019_b4_point : Type := (R * R)%type.

Definition putnam_2019_b4_in_quadrant
    (p : putnam_2019_b4_point) : Prop :=
  1 <= fst p /\ 1 <= snd p.

Definition putnam_2019_b4_derivable_on_ray
    (g : R -> R) (x d : R) : Prop :=
  forall eps : R,
    eps > 0 ->
    exists delta : R,
      delta > 0 /\
      forall y : R,
        1 <= y ->
        y <> x ->
        Rabs (y - x) < delta ->
        Rabs ((g y - g x) / (y - x) - d) < eps.

Definition putnam_2019_b4_real_derivative
    (g : R -> R) (x : R) : R :=
  epsilon (inhabits (0 : R))
    (fun d : R => putnam_2019_b4_derivable_on_ray g x d).

Definition putnam_2019_b4_partial_x
    (f : putnam_2019_b4_point -> R)
    (p : putnam_2019_b4_point) : R :=
  putnam_2019_b4_real_derivative
    (fun x : R => f (x, snd p))
    (fst p).

Definition putnam_2019_b4_partial_y
    (f : putnam_2019_b4_point -> R)
    (p : putnam_2019_b4_point) : R :=
  putnam_2019_b4_real_derivative
    (fun y : R => f (fst p, y))
    (snd p).

Definition putnam_2019_b4_partial_xx
    (f : putnam_2019_b4_point -> R)
    (p : putnam_2019_b4_point) : R :=
  putnam_2019_b4_real_derivative
    (fun x : R => putnam_2019_b4_partial_x f (x, snd p))
    (fst p).

Definition putnam_2019_b4_partial_xy
    (f : putnam_2019_b4_point -> R)
    (p : putnam_2019_b4_point) : R :=
  putnam_2019_b4_real_derivative
    (fun y : R => putnam_2019_b4_partial_x f (fst p, y))
    (snd p).

Definition putnam_2019_b4_partial_yx
    (f : putnam_2019_b4_point -> R)
    (p : putnam_2019_b4_point) : R :=
  putnam_2019_b4_real_derivative
    (fun x : R => putnam_2019_b4_partial_y f (x, snd p))
    (fst p).

Definition putnam_2019_b4_partial_yy
    (f : putnam_2019_b4_point -> R)
    (p : putnam_2019_b4_point) : R :=
  putnam_2019_b4_real_derivative
    (fun y : R => putnam_2019_b4_partial_y f (fst p, y))
    (snd p).

Definition putnam_2019_b4_continuous_on_quadrant
    (g : putnam_2019_b4_point -> R) : Prop :=
  forall p : putnam_2019_b4_point,
    putnam_2019_b4_in_quadrant p ->
    forall eps : R,
      eps > 0 ->
      exists delta : R,
        delta > 0 /\
        forall q : putnam_2019_b4_point,
          putnam_2019_b4_in_quadrant q ->
          Rabs (fst q - fst p) < delta ->
          Rabs (snd q - snd p) < delta ->
          Rabs (g q - g p) < eps.

Definition putnam_2019_b4_contdiff_two
    (f : putnam_2019_b4_point -> R) : Prop :=
  (forall p : putnam_2019_b4_point,
    putnam_2019_b4_in_quadrant p ->
    putnam_2019_b4_derivable_on_ray
      (fun x : R => f (x, snd p))
      (fst p)
      (putnam_2019_b4_partial_x f p) /\
    putnam_2019_b4_derivable_on_ray
      (fun y : R => f (fst p, y))
      (snd p)
      (putnam_2019_b4_partial_y f p) /\
    putnam_2019_b4_derivable_on_ray
      (fun x : R => putnam_2019_b4_partial_x f (x, snd p))
      (fst p)
      (putnam_2019_b4_partial_xx f p) /\
    putnam_2019_b4_derivable_on_ray
      (fun y : R => putnam_2019_b4_partial_x f (fst p, y))
      (snd p)
      (putnam_2019_b4_partial_xy f p) /\
    putnam_2019_b4_derivable_on_ray
      (fun x : R => putnam_2019_b4_partial_y f (x, snd p))
      (fst p)
      (putnam_2019_b4_partial_yx f p) /\
    putnam_2019_b4_derivable_on_ray
      (fun y : R => putnam_2019_b4_partial_y f (fst p, y))
      (snd p)
      (putnam_2019_b4_partial_yy f p)) /\
  putnam_2019_b4_continuous_on_quadrant f /\
  putnam_2019_b4_continuous_on_quadrant
    (putnam_2019_b4_partial_x f) /\
  putnam_2019_b4_continuous_on_quadrant
    (putnam_2019_b4_partial_y f) /\
  putnam_2019_b4_continuous_on_quadrant
    (putnam_2019_b4_partial_xx f) /\
  putnam_2019_b4_continuous_on_quadrant
    (putnam_2019_b4_partial_xy f) /\
  putnam_2019_b4_continuous_on_quadrant
    (putnam_2019_b4_partial_yx f) /\
  putnam_2019_b4_continuous_on_quadrant
    (putnam_2019_b4_partial_yy f).

Definition putnam_2019_b4_increment
    (f : putnam_2019_b4_point -> R) (s : R) : R :=
  f (s + 1, s + 1) -
  f (s + 1, s) -
  f (s, s + 1) +
  f (s, s).

Definition putnam_2019_b4_is_lower_bound
    (f : putnam_2019_b4_point -> R) (m : R) : Prop :=
  forall s : R,
    1 <= s ->
    m <= putnam_2019_b4_increment f s.

Definition putnam_2019_b4_is_greatest_lower_bound
    (f : putnam_2019_b4_point -> R) (m : R) : Prop :=
  putnam_2019_b4_is_lower_bound f m /\
  forall candidate : R,
    putnam_2019_b4_is_lower_bound f candidate ->
    candidate <= m.

Definition putnam_2019_b4_solution : R :=
  2 * ln 2 - 1 / 2.

Theorem putnam_2019_b4
    (f : putnam_2019_b4_point -> R)
    (fdiff : putnam_2019_b4_contdiff_two f)
    (feq1 :
      forall x y : R,
        1 <= x ->
        1 <= y ->
        x * putnam_2019_b4_partial_x f (x, y) +
        y * putnam_2019_b4_partial_y f (x, y) =
        x * y * ln (x * y))
    (feq2 :
      forall x y : R,
        1 <= x ->
        1 <= y ->
        x ^ 2 * putnam_2019_b4_partial_xx f (x, y) +
        y ^ 2 * putnam_2019_b4_partial_yy f (x, y) =
        x * y) :
  putnam_2019_b4_is_greatest_lower_bound
    f putnam_2019_b4_solution.
Admitted.

title: putnam_2019_b4
content:
theory putnam_2019_b4 imports
Complex_Main
"HOL-Analysis.Derivative"
begin

(* note: boosts the domain of f to the entire 2D plane *)
definition putnam_2019_b4_solution :: real where
  "putnam_2019_b4_solution \<equiv> 2 * ln 2 - 1 / 2"
(* 2 * ln 2 - 1 / 2 *)
theorem putnam_2019_b4:
  fixes f :: "real \<Rightarrow> real \<Rightarrow> real"
  and fx fy fxx fxy fyx fyy :: "real \<Rightarrow> real \<Rightarrow> real"
  and Q :: "(real \<times> real) set"
  defines "Q \<equiv> {p. fst p \<ge> 1 \<and> snd p \<ge> 1}"
  and "fx \<equiv> \<lambda>x y. deriv (\<lambda>u. f u y) x"
  and "fy \<equiv> \<lambda>x y. deriv (f x) y"
  and "fxx \<equiv> \<lambda>x y. deriv (\<lambda>u. fx u y) x"
  and "fxy \<equiv> \<lambda>x y. deriv (fx x) y"
  and "fyx \<equiv> \<lambda>x y. deriv (\<lambda>u. fy u y) x"
  and "fyy \<equiv> \<lambda>x y. deriv (fy x) y"
  assumes fdiff:
    "(\<forall>y\<ge>1.
       (\<lambda>x. f x y) differentiable_on {1..} \<and>
       (\<lambda>x. fx x y) differentiable_on {1..} \<and>
       (\<lambda>x. fy x y) differentiable_on {1..}) \<and>
     (\<forall>x\<ge>1.
       f x differentiable_on {1..} \<and>
       fx x differentiable_on {1..} \<and>
       fy x differentiable_on {1..})"
  and fcont:
    "continuous_on Q (\<lambda>p. f (fst p) (snd p)) \<and>
     continuous_on Q (\<lambda>p. fx (fst p) (snd p)) \<and>
     continuous_on Q (\<lambda>p. fy (fst p) (snd p)) \<and>
     continuous_on Q (\<lambda>p. fxx (fst p) (snd p)) \<and>
     continuous_on Q (\<lambda>p. fxy (fst p) (snd p)) \<and>
     continuous_on Q (\<lambda>p. fyx (fst p) (snd p)) \<and>
     continuous_on Q (\<lambda>p. fyy (fst p) (snd p))"
  and feq1: "\<forall>x\<ge>1. \<forall>y\<ge>1.
    x * fx x y + y * fy x y = x * y * ln (x * y)"
  and feq2: "\<forall>x\<ge>1. \<forall>y\<ge>1.
    x^2 * fxx x y + y^2 * fyy x y = x * y"
  shows "Inf {m :: real. \<exists>s\<ge>1.
    m = f (s + 1) (s + 1) - f (s + 1) s - f s (s + 1) + f s s}
      = putnam_2019_b4_solution"
  sorry

end

title: putnam_2019_b4
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2019_b4
  (putnambench__hol-light__putnam_2019_b4): the common greatest lower bound
  of a mixed finite difference for twice continuously differentiable real
  functions satisfying two partial differential equations on the quadrant.
  This file contains no proof.
*)

let transc_output = open_out "/dev/null";;
let transc_formatter = Format.formatter_of_out_channel transc_output;;
let previous_file_loader = !Hol_loader.file_loader;;
Hol_loader.file_loader :=
  (fun path -> Toploop.use_file transc_formatter path);;
let transc_loaded =
  Toploop.use_file transc_formatter "Library/transc.ml";;
Hol_loader.file_loader := previous_file_loader;;
Format.pp_print_flush transc_formatter ();;
close_out transc_output;;
if not transc_loaded then failwith "failed to load Library/transc.ml";;

let statement =
  `let pair =
     \x y:real.
       (lambda i. if i = 1 then x else y):real^2 in
   let xrepl =
     \(x:real^2) (i:num) (t:real).
       (lambda k. if k = i then t else x$k):real^2 in
   let has_derivative_at =
     \(h:real->real) (d:real) (a:real).
       !e:real.
         &0 < e
         ==> ?delta:real.
               &0 < delta /\
               !b:real.
                 &0 < abs (b - a) /\ abs (b - a) < delta
                 ==> abs ((h b - h a) / (b - a) - d) < e in
   let partial =
     \(h:real^2->real) (i:num) (x:real^2).
       @d:real.
         has_derivative_at
           (\t:real. h (xrepl x i t)) d (x$i) in
   let in_quadrant =
     \x:real^2. &1 <= x$1 /\ &1 <= x$2 in
   let continuous_on_quadrant =
     \(h:real^2->real).
       !x:real^2.
         in_quadrant x
         ==> !e:real.
               &0 < e
               ==> ?delta:real.
                     &0 < delta /\
                     !y:real^2.
                       in_quadrant y /\
                       abs (y$1 - x$1) < delta /\
                       abs (y$2 - x$2) < delta
                       ==> abs (h y - h x) < e in
   let contdiff2_on_quadrant =
     \(h:real^2->real).
       continuous_on_quadrant h /\
       (!i:num.
          1 <= i /\ i <= 2
          ==>
          (!x:real^2.
             in_quadrant x
             ==> has_derivative_at
                   (\t:real. h (xrepl x i t))
                   (partial h i x) (x$i)) /\
          continuous_on_quadrant (partial h i)) /\
       (!i j:num.
          1 <= i /\ i <= 2 /\ 1 <= j /\ j <= 2
          ==>
          (!x:real^2.
             in_quadrant x
             ==> has_derivative_at
                   (\t:real. partial h i (xrepl x j t))
                   (partial (partial h i) j x) (x$j)) /\
          continuous_on_quadrant (partial (partial h i) j)) in
   let objective =
     \(f:real^2->real) (s:real).
       f (pair (s + &1) (s + &1)) -
       f (pair (s + &1) s) -
       f (pair s (s + &1)) +
       f (pair s s) in
   let lower_bound =
     \(f:real^2->real) (m:real).
       !s:real. &1 <= s ==> m <= objective f s in
   let putnam_2019_b4_solution =
     &2 * ln (&2) - &1 / &2 in
   !f:real^2->real.
     contdiff2_on_quadrant f /\
     (!x y:real.
        &1 <= x /\ &1 <= y
        ==>
        x * partial f 1 (pair x y) +
        y * partial f 2 (pair x y) =
        x * y * ln (x * y)) /\
     (!x y:real.
        &1 <= x /\ &1 <= y
        ==>
        x pow 2 * partial (partial f 1) 1 (pair x y) +
        y pow 2 * partial (partial f 2) 2 (pair x y) =
        x * y)
     ==>
     lower_bound f putnam_2019_b4_solution /\
     (!m:real.
        lower_bound f m ==> m <= putnam_2019_b4_solution)`;;

title: putnam_2019_b4
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2019_b4:
;; the infimum of a square mixed difference is 2*ln(2)-1/2 for every twice
;; continuously differentiable real function satisfying the stated two
;; partial differential equations on x,y >= 1. This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))

;; The context presents a Dedekind-complete ordered field, hence the real
;; field up to ordered-field isomorphism, together with its standard
;; exponential and logarithm. Tame APPLY$ objects retain arbitrary carriers,
;; operations, and real-valued functions, while DEFUN-SK keeps every
;; mathematical quantifier internal to the statement.
;;
;; Partial derivatives use their epsilon-delta linear-approximation
;; definition relative to the closed quadrant. Joint continuity of f and all
;; first and second partial derivative fields is an explicit C2 presentation.
;; The derivative fields are existentially quantified inside the hypothesis,
;; so they are not additional statement parameters. The conclusion gives the
;; exact infimum by its lower-bound and arbitrarily-close-witness properties.

(defun p19b4-member-p (carrier x)
  (if (apply$ carrier (list x)) t nil))

(defun p19b4-unary-value (operation x)
  (apply$ operation (list x)))

(defun p19b4-binary-value (operation x y)
  (apply$ operation (list x y)))

(defun-sk p19b4-valid-set-p (carrier set)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (apply$ set (list x))
     (p19b4-member-p carrier x))))

(defun-sk p19b4-unary-real-function-p (carrier function)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (p19b4-member-p carrier x)
     (p19b4-member-p
      carrier
      (p19b4-unary-value function x)))))

(defun-sk p19b4-binary-real-function-p (carrier function)
  (forall (x y)
    (implies
     (and
      (p19b4-member-p carrier x)
      (p19b4-member-p carrier y))
     (p19b4-member-p
      carrier
      (p19b4-binary-value function x y)))))

(defun-sk p19b4-field-laws-p
    (carrier add multiply negate inverse zero one)
  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (p19b4-member-p carrier x)
      (p19b4-member-p carrier y)
      (p19b4-member-p carrier z))
     (and
      (p19b4-member-p
       carrier (p19b4-binary-value add x y))
      (p19b4-member-p
       carrier (p19b4-binary-value multiply x y))
      (p19b4-member-p
       carrier (p19b4-unary-value negate x))
      (p19b4-member-p
       carrier (p19b4-unary-value inverse x))
      (equal
       (p19b4-binary-value
        add (p19b4-binary-value add x y) z)
       (p19b4-binary-value
        add x (p19b4-binary-value add y z)))
      (equal
       (p19b4-binary-value add x y)
       (p19b4-binary-value add y x))
      (equal
       (p19b4-binary-value add x zero)
       x)
      (equal
       (p19b4-binary-value
        add x (p19b4-unary-value negate x))
       zero)
      (equal
       (p19b4-binary-value
        multiply
        (p19b4-binary-value multiply x y)
        z)
       (p19b4-binary-value
        multiply
        x
        (p19b4-binary-value multiply y z)))
      (equal
       (p19b4-binary-value multiply x y)
       (p19b4-binary-value multiply y x))
      (equal
       (p19b4-binary-value multiply x one)
       x)
      (implies
       (equal x zero)
       (equal
        (p19b4-unary-value inverse x)
        zero))
      (implies
       (not (equal x zero))
       (equal
        (p19b4-binary-value
         multiply x (p19b4-unary-value inverse x))
        one))
      (equal
       (p19b4-binary-value
        multiply x (p19b4-binary-value add y z))
       (p19b4-binary-value
        add
        (p19b4-binary-value multiply x y)
        (p19b4-binary-value multiply x z)))))))

(defun-sk p19b4-order-laws-p
    (carrier add multiply zero less)
  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (p19b4-member-p carrier x)
      (p19b4-member-p carrier y)
      (p19b4-member-p carrier z))
     (and
      (not (p19b4-binary-value less x x))
      (or
       (equal x y)
       (p19b4-binary-value less x y)
       (p19b4-binary-value less y x))
      (implies
       (and
        (p19b4-binary-value less x y)
        (p19b4-binary-value less y z))
       (p19b4-binary-value less x z))
      (implies
       (p19b4-binary-value less x y)
       (p19b4-binary-value
        less
        (p19b4-binary-value add x z)
        (p19b4-binary-value add y z)))
      (implies
       (and
        (p19b4-binary-value less zero x)
        (p19b4-binary-value less zero y))
       (p19b4-binary-value
        less
        zero
        (p19b4-binary-value multiply x y)))))))

(defun-sk p19b4-set-nonempty-p (carrier set)
  (exists (x)
    (and
     (p19b4-member-p carrier x)
     (apply$ set (list x)))))

(defun-sk p19b4-upper-bound-p
    (carrier less set bound)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (and
      (p19b4-member-p carrier x)
      (apply$ set (list x)))
     (not
      (p19b4-binary-value less bound x)))))

(defun-sk p19b4-bounded-above-p
    (carrier less set)
  (exists (bound)
    (and
     (p19b4-member-p carrier bound)
     (p19b4-upper-bound-p
      carrier less set bound))))

(defun-sk p19b4-least-upper-bound-p
    (carrier less set supremum)
  (forall (bound)
    (implies
     (and
      (p19b4-member-p carrier bound)
      (p19b4-upper-bound-p
       carrier less set bound))
     (not
      (p19b4-binary-value
       less bound supremum)))))

(defun p19b4-supremum-p
    (carrier less set supremum)
  (and
   (p19b4-member-p carrier supremum)
   (p19b4-upper-bound-p
    carrier less set supremum)
   (p19b4-least-upper-bound-p
    carrier less set supremum)))

(defun-sk p19b4-has-supremum-p
    (carrier less set)
  (exists (supremum)
    (p19b4-supremum-p
     carrier less set supremum)))

(defun-sk p19b4-dedekind-complete-p
    (carrier less)
  (forall (set)
    (implies
     (and
      (tamep-functionp set)
      (p19b4-valid-set-p carrier set)
      (p19b4-set-nonempty-p carrier set)
      (p19b4-bounded-above-p
       carrier less set))
     (p19b4-has-supremum-p
      carrier less set))))

(defun p19b4-real-field-p
    (carrier zero one add multiply negate inverse less)
  (and
   (tamep-functionp carrier)
   (tamep-functionp add)
   (tamep-functionp multiply)
   (tamep-functionp negate)
   (tamep-functionp inverse)
   (tamep-functionp less)
   (p19b4-member-p carrier zero)
   (p19b4-member-p carrier one)
   (not (equal zero one))
   (p19b4-field-laws-p
    carrier add multiply negate inverse zero one)
   (p19b4-order-laws-p
    carrier add multiply zero less)
   (p19b4-binary-value less zero one)
   (p19b4-dedekind-complete-p
    carrier less)))

;; Context layout:
;; (carrier zero one add multiply negate inverse less exponential logarithm).

(defun p19b4-r-carrier (ctx) (nth 0 ctx))
(defun p19b4-r-zero (ctx) (nth 1 ctx))
(defun p19b4-r-one (ctx) (nth 2 ctx))
(defun p19b4-r-add (ctx) (nth 3 ctx))
(defun p19b4-r-multiply (ctx) (nth 4 ctx))
(defun p19b4-r-negate (ctx) (nth 5 ctx))
(defun p19b4-r-inverse (ctx) (nth 6 ctx))
(defun p19b4-r-less (ctx) (nth 7 ctx))
(defun p19b4-r-exp (ctx) (nth 8 ctx))
(defun p19b4-r-log (ctx) (nth 9 ctx))

(defun p19b4-r-add-value (ctx x y)
  (p19b4-binary-value
   (p19b4-r-add ctx) x y))

(defun p19b4-r-multiply-value (ctx x y)
  (p19b4-binary-value
   (p19b4-r-multiply ctx) x y))

(defun p19b4-r-negate-value (ctx x)
  (p19b4-unary-value
   (p19b4-r-negate ctx) x))

(defun p19b4-r-inverse-value (ctx x)
  (p19b4-unary-value
   (p19b4-r-inverse ctx) x))

(defun p19b4-r-subtract-value (ctx x y)
  (p19b4-r-add-value
   ctx x (p19b4-r-negate-value ctx y)))

(defun p19b4-r-divide-value (ctx x y)
  (p19b4-r-multiply-value
   ctx x (p19b4-r-inverse-value ctx y)))

(defun p19b4-r-less-p (ctx x y)
  (if (p19b4-binary-value
       (p19b4-r-less ctx) x y)
      t
    nil))

(defun p19b4-r-less-equal-p (ctx x y)
  (not (p19b4-r-less-p ctx y x)))

(defun p19b4-r-absolute-value (ctx x)
  (if (p19b4-r-less-p
       ctx x (p19b4-r-zero ctx))
      (p19b4-r-negate-value ctx x)
    x))

(defun p19b4-positive-real-p (ctx x)
  (and
   (p19b4-member-p (p19b4-r-carrier ctx) x)
   (p19b4-r-less-p
    ctx (p19b4-r-zero ctx) x)))

(defun p19b4-r-two (ctx)
  (p19b4-r-add-value
   ctx (p19b4-r-one ctx) (p19b4-r-one ctx)))

(defun p19b4-r-half (ctx)
  (p19b4-r-inverse-value
   ctx (p19b4-r-two ctx)))

(defun p19b4-r-square (ctx x)
  (p19b4-r-multiply-value ctx x x))

(defun p19b4-at-least-one-p (ctx x)
  (and
   (p19b4-member-p (p19b4-r-carrier ctx) x)
   (p19b4-r-less-equal-p
    ctx (p19b4-r-one ctx) x)))

;; Unary derivatives, used to characterize the standard exponential.

(defun-sk p19b4-unary-derivative-neighborhood-p
    (ctx function derivative x epsilon radius)
  (forall (y)
    (implies
     (and
      (p19b4-member-p (p19b4-r-carrier ctx) y)
      (p19b4-r-less-p
       ctx
       (p19b4-r-absolute-value
        ctx (p19b4-r-subtract-value ctx y x))
       radius))
     (p19b4-r-less-equal-p
      ctx
      (p19b4-r-absolute-value
       ctx
       (p19b4-r-subtract-value
        ctx
        (p19b4-r-subtract-value
         ctx
         (p19b4-unary-value function y)
         (p19b4-unary-value function x))
        (p19b4-r-multiply-value
         ctx derivative
         (p19b4-r-subtract-value ctx y x))))
      (p19b4-r-multiply-value
       ctx epsilon
       (p19b4-r-absolute-value
        ctx
        (p19b4-r-subtract-value ctx y x)))))))

(defun-sk p19b4-unary-derivative-radius-exists-p
    (ctx function derivative x epsilon)
  (exists (radius)
    (and
     (p19b4-positive-real-p ctx radius)
     (p19b4-unary-derivative-neighborhood-p
      ctx function derivative x epsilon radius))))

(defun-sk p19b4-unary-derivative-epsilon-p
    (ctx function derivative x)
  (forall (epsilon)
    (implies
     (p19b4-positive-real-p ctx epsilon)
     (p19b4-unary-derivative-radius-exists-p
      ctx function derivative x epsilon))))

(defun p19b4-has-unary-derivative-at-p
    (ctx function derivative x)
  (and
   (p19b4-member-p (p19b4-r-carrier ctx) x)
   (p19b4-member-p
    (p19b4-r-carrier ctx) derivative)
   (p19b4-unary-derivative-epsilon-p
    ctx function derivative x)))

(defun-sk p19b4-exponential-laws-p (ctx)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (p19b4-member-p (p19b4-r-carrier ctx) x)
     (and
      (p19b4-positive-real-p
       ctx
       (p19b4-unary-value
        (p19b4-r-exp ctx) x))
      (p19b4-has-unary-derivative-at-p
       ctx
       (p19b4-r-exp ctx)
       (p19b4-unary-value
        (p19b4-r-exp ctx) x)
       x)))))

(defun p19b4-exponential-function-p (ctx)
  (and
   (tamep-functionp (p19b4-r-exp ctx))
   (p19b4-unary-real-function-p
    (p19b4-r-carrier ctx)
    (p19b4-r-exp ctx))
   (equal
    (p19b4-unary-value
     (p19b4-r-exp ctx)
     (p19b4-r-zero ctx))
    (p19b4-r-one ctx))
   (p19b4-exponential-laws-p ctx)))

(defun-sk p19b4-logarithm-laws-p (ctx)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (p19b4-member-p (p19b4-r-carrier ctx) x)
     (and
      (equal
       (p19b4-unary-value
        (p19b4-r-log ctx)
        (p19b4-unary-value
         (p19b4-r-exp ctx) x))
       x)
      (implies
       (p19b4-positive-real-p ctx x)
       (equal
        (p19b4-unary-value
         (p19b4-r-exp ctx)
         (p19b4-unary-value
          (p19b4-r-log ctx) x))
        x))))))

(defun p19b4-logarithm-function-p (ctx)
  (and
   (tamep-functionp (p19b4-r-log ctx))
   (p19b4-unary-real-function-p
    (p19b4-r-carrier ctx)
    (p19b4-r-log ctx))
   (p19b4-logarithm-laws-p ctx)))

(defun p19b4-context-p (ctx)
  (and
   (true-listp ctx)
   (equal (len ctx) 10)
   (p19b4-real-field-p
    (p19b4-r-carrier ctx)
    (p19b4-r-zero ctx)
    (p19b4-r-one ctx)
    (p19b4-r-add ctx)
    (p19b4-r-multiply ctx)
    (p19b4-r-negate ctx)
    (p19b4-r-inverse ctx)
    (p19b4-r-less ctx))
   (p19b4-exponential-function-p ctx)
   (p19b4-logarithm-function-p ctx)))

;; Joint continuity on the closed quadrant [1,infinity)^2.

(defun-sk p19b4-continuity-neighborhood-p
    (ctx function x y epsilon radius)
  (forall (u v)
    (implies
     (and
      (p19b4-at-least-one-p ctx u)
      (p19b4-at-least-one-p ctx v)
      (p19b4-r-less-p
       ctx
       (p19b4-r-absolute-value
        ctx (p19b4-r-subtract-value ctx u x))
       radius)
      (p19b4-r-less-p
       ctx
       (p19b4-r-absolute-value
        ctx (p19b4-r-subtract-value ctx v y))
       radius))
     (p19b4-r-less-p
      ctx
      (p19b4-r-absolute-value
       ctx
       (p19b4-r-subtract-value
        ctx
        (p19b4-binary-value function u v)
        (p19b4-binary-value function x y)))
      epsilon))))

(defun-sk p19b4-continuity-radius-exists-p
    (ctx function x y epsilon)
  (exists (radius)
    (and
     (p19b4-positive-real-p ctx radius)
     (p19b4-continuity-neighborhood-p
      ctx function x y epsilon radius))))

(defun-sk p19b4-continuous-at-p
    (ctx function x y)
  (forall (epsilon)
    (implies
     (p19b4-positive-real-p ctx epsilon)
     (p19b4-continuity-radius-exists-p
      ctx function x y epsilon))))

(defun-sk p19b4-continuous-on-quadrant-p
    (ctx function)
  (forall (x y)
    (implies
     (and
      (p19b4-at-least-one-p ctx x)
      (p19b4-at-least-one-p ctx y))
     (p19b4-continuous-at-p
      ctx function x y))))

;; First-coordinate partial derivative relative to the quadrant.

(defun-sk p19b4-partial-x-neighborhood-p
    (ctx function derivative x y epsilon radius)
  (forall (u)
    (implies
     (and
      (p19b4-at-least-one-p ctx u)
      (p19b4-r-less-p
       ctx
       (p19b4-r-absolute-value
        ctx (p19b4-r-subtract-value ctx u x))
       radius))
     (p19b4-r-less-equal-p
      ctx
      (p19b4-r-absolute-value
       ctx
       (p19b4-r-subtract-value
        ctx
        (p19b4-r-subtract-value
         ctx
         (p19b4-binary-value function u y)
         (p19b4-binary-value function x y))
        (p19b4-r-multiply-value
         ctx
         (p19b4-binary-value derivative x y)
         (p19b4-r-subtract-value ctx u x))))
      (p19b4-r-multiply-value
       ctx epsilon
       (p19b4-r-absolute-value
        ctx
        (p19b4-r-subtract-value ctx u x)))))))

(defun-sk p19b4-partial-x-radius-exists-p
    (ctx function derivative x y epsilon)
  (exists (radius)
    (and
     (p19b4-positive-real-p ctx radius)
     (p19b4-partial-x-neighborhood-p
      ctx function derivative x y epsilon radius))))

(defun-sk p19b4-partial-x-epsilon-p
    (ctx function derivative x y)
  (forall (epsilon)
    (implies
     (p19b4-positive-real-p ctx epsilon)
     (p19b4-partial-x-radius-exists-p
      ctx function derivative x y epsilon))))

(defun-sk p19b4-partial-x-relation-p
    (ctx function derivative)
  (forall (x y)
    (implies
     (and
      (p19b4-at-least-one-p ctx x)
      (p19b4-at-least-one-p ctx y))
     (p19b4-partial-x-epsilon-p
      ctx function derivative x y))))

;; Second-coordinate partial derivative relative to the quadrant.

(defun-sk p19b4-partial-y-neighborhood-p
    (ctx function derivative x y epsilon radius)
  (forall (v)
    (implies
     (and
      (p19b4-at-least-one-p ctx v)
      (p19b4-r-less-p
       ctx
       (p19b4-r-absolute-value
        ctx (p19b4-r-subtract-value ctx v y))
       radius))
     (p19b4-r-less-equal-p
      ctx
      (p19b4-r-absolute-value
       ctx
       (p19b4-r-subtract-value
        ctx
        (p19b4-r-subtract-value
         ctx
         (p19b4-binary-value function x v)
         (p19b4-binary-value function x y))
        (p19b4-r-multiply-value
         ctx
         (p19b4-binary-value derivative x y)
         (p19b4-r-subtract-value ctx v y))))
      (p19b4-r-multiply-value
       ctx epsilon
       (p19b4-r-absolute-value
        ctx
        (p19b4-r-subtract-value ctx v y)))))))

(defun-sk p19b4-partial-y-radius-exists-p
    (ctx function derivative x y epsilon)
  (exists (radius)
    (and
     (p19b4-positive-real-p ctx radius)
     (p19b4-partial-y-neighborhood-p
      ctx function derivative x y epsilon radius))))

(defun-sk p19b4-partial-y-epsilon-p
    (ctx function derivative x y)
  (forall (epsilon)
    (implies
     (p19b4-positive-real-p ctx epsilon)
     (p19b4-partial-y-radius-exists-p
      ctx function derivative x y epsilon))))

(defun-sk p19b4-partial-y-relation-p
    (ctx function derivative)
  (forall (x y)
    (implies
     (and
      (p19b4-at-least-one-p ctx x)
      (p19b4-at-least-one-p ctx y))
     (p19b4-partial-y-epsilon-p
      ctx function derivative x y))))

(defun-sk p19b4-pde-p
    (ctx f-x f-y f-xx f-yy)
  (forall (x y)
    (implies
     (and
      (p19b4-at-least-one-p ctx x)
      (p19b4-at-least-one-p ctx y))
     (let* ((xy
             (p19b4-r-multiply-value ctx x y))
            (first-left
             (p19b4-r-add-value
              ctx
              (p19b4-r-multiply-value
               ctx x (p19b4-binary-value f-x x y))
              (p19b4-r-multiply-value
               ctx y (p19b4-binary-value f-y x y))))
            (first-right
             (p19b4-r-multiply-value
              ctx
              xy
              (p19b4-unary-value
               (p19b4-r-log ctx) xy)))
            (second-left
             (p19b4-r-add-value
              ctx
              (p19b4-r-multiply-value
               ctx
               (p19b4-r-square ctx x)
               (p19b4-binary-value f-xx x y))
              (p19b4-r-multiply-value
               ctx
               (p19b4-r-square ctx y)
               (p19b4-binary-value f-yy x y)))))
       (and
        (equal first-left first-right)
        (equal second-left xy))))))

(defun p19b4-c2-presentation-p
    (ctx f f-x f-y f-xx f-xy f-yx f-yy)
  (and
   (tamep-functionp f-x)
   (tamep-functionp f-y)
   (tamep-functionp f-xx)
   (tamep-functionp f-xy)
   (tamep-functionp f-yx)
   (tamep-functionp f-yy)
   (p19b4-binary-real-function-p
    (p19b4-r-carrier ctx) f-x)
   (p19b4-binary-real-function-p
    (p19b4-r-carrier ctx) f-y)
   (p19b4-binary-real-function-p
    (p19b4-r-carrier ctx) f-xx)
   (p19b4-binary-real-function-p
    (p19b4-r-carrier ctx) f-xy)
   (p19b4-binary-real-function-p
    (p19b4-r-carrier ctx) f-yx)
   (p19b4-binary-real-function-p
    (p19b4-r-carrier ctx) f-yy)
   (p19b4-continuous-on-quadrant-p ctx f)
   (p19b4-continuous-on-quadrant-p ctx f-x)
   (p19b4-continuous-on-quadrant-p ctx f-y)
   (p19b4-continuous-on-quadrant-p ctx f-xx)
   (p19b4-continuous-on-quadrant-p ctx f-xy)
   (p19b4-continuous-on-quadrant-p ctx f-yx)
   (p19b4-continuous-on-quadrant-p ctx f-yy)
   (p19b4-partial-x-relation-p ctx f f-x)
   (p19b4-partial-y-relation-p ctx f f-y)
   (p19b4-partial-x-relation-p ctx f-x f-xx)
   (p19b4-partial-y-relation-p ctx f-x f-xy)
   (p19b4-partial-x-relation-p ctx f-y f-yx)
   (p19b4-partial-y-relation-p ctx f-y f-yy)
   (p19b4-pde-p ctx f-x f-y f-xx f-yy)))

(defun-sk p19b4-hypothesis-p (ctx f)
  (exists (f-x f-y f-xx f-xy f-yx f-yy)
    (p19b4-c2-presentation-p
     ctx f f-x f-y f-xx f-xy f-yx f-yy)))

(defun p19b4-cross-difference (ctx f s)
  (let ((s-plus-one
         (p19b4-r-add-value
          ctx s (p19b4-r-one ctx))))
    (p19b4-r-add-value
     ctx
     (p19b4-r-subtract-value
      ctx
      (p19b4-binary-value
       f s-plus-one s-plus-one)
      (p19b4-binary-value
       f s-plus-one s))
     (p19b4-r-subtract-value
      ctx
      (p19b4-binary-value f s s)
      (p19b4-binary-value
       f s s-plus-one)))))

(defun p19b4-solution (ctx)
  (p19b4-r-subtract-value
   ctx
   (p19b4-r-multiply-value
    ctx
    (p19b4-r-two ctx)
    (p19b4-unary-value
     (p19b4-r-log ctx)
     (p19b4-r-two ctx)))
   (p19b4-r-half ctx)))

(defun-sk p19b4-lower-bound-p (ctx f)
  (forall (s)
    (implies
     (p19b4-at-least-one-p ctx s)
     (p19b4-r-less-equal-p
      ctx
      (p19b4-solution ctx)
      (p19b4-cross-difference ctx f s)))))

(defun-sk p19b4-close-value-exists-p
    (ctx f epsilon)
  (exists (s)
    (and
     (p19b4-at-least-one-p ctx s)
     (p19b4-r-less-p
      ctx
      (p19b4-cross-difference ctx f s)
      (p19b4-r-add-value
       ctx
       (p19b4-solution ctx)
       epsilon)))))

(defun-sk p19b4-arbitrarily-close-p (ctx f)
  (forall (epsilon)
    (implies
     (p19b4-positive-real-p ctx epsilon)
     (p19b4-close-value-exists-p
      ctx f epsilon))))

(defun p19b4-infimum-value-p (ctx f)
  (and
   (p19b4-lower-bound-p ctx f)
   (p19b4-arbitrarily-close-p ctx f)))

(defun putnambench-putnam-2019-b4-statement
    (ctx f)
  (implies
   (and
    (p19b4-context-p ctx)
    (tamep-functionp f)
    (p19b4-binary-real-function-p
     (p19b4-r-carrier ctx) f)
    (p19b4-hypothesis-p ctx f))
   (p19b4-infimum-value-p ctx f)))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

title: putnam_2019_b4
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2019_b4
-- (putnambench__agda__putnam_2019_b4): every twice continuously
-- differentiable solution of the two stated partial differential equations
-- on x >= 1 and y >= 1 has mixed finite-difference minimum
-- 2 * ln 2 - 1 / 2. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module Putnam2019B4 where

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc)

infix 4 _!=_
infixr 3 _and_
infixr 2 _or_

data Bottom : Set where

Not : Set -> Set
Not A =
  A -> Bottom

_!=_ : {A : Set} -> A -> A -> Set
x != y =
  Not (x == y)

record _and_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data _or_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  left  : A -> A or B
  right : B -> A or B

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

record CompleteOrderedRealField (R : Set) : Set1 where
  field
    zeroR oneR : R
    add multiply : R -> R -> R
    negate inverse : R -> R
    lessOrEqual : R -> R -> Set

    one-not-zero :
      oneR != zeroR

    add-commutative :
      (x y : R) ->
      add x y == add y x
    add-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      add (add x y) z == add x (add y z)
    add-zero :
      (x : R) ->
      add x zeroR == x
    add-inverse :
      (x : R) ->
      add x (negate x) == zeroR

    multiply-commutative :
      (x y : R) ->
      multiply x y == multiply y x
    multiply-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply (multiply x y) z ==
      multiply x (multiply y z)
    multiply-one :
      (x : R) ->
      multiply x oneR == x
    multiply-zero :
      (x : R) ->
      multiply x zeroR == zeroR
    distribute :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply x (add y z) ==
      add (multiply x y) (multiply x z)
    inverse-zero :
      inverse zeroR == zeroR
    multiply-inverse :
      (x : R) ->
      x != zeroR ->
      multiply x (inverse x) == oneR

    order-reflexive :
      (x : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x x
    order-transitive :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y z ->
      lessOrEqual x z
    order-antisymmetric :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y x ->
      x == y
    order-total :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y or lessOrEqual y x
    add-order :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual (add z x) (add z y)
    multiply-nonnegative :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR x ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR y ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR (multiply x y)
    zero-less-than-one :
      lessOrEqual zeroR oneR and zeroR != oneR

    least-upper-bound :
      (P : R -> Set) ->
      Exists R P ->
      Exists R
        (\ upper ->
          (x : R) ->
          P x ->
          lessOrEqual x upper) ->
      Exists R
        (\ supremum ->
          ((x : R) ->
            P x ->
            lessOrEqual x supremum)
          and
          ((upper : R) ->
            ((x : R) ->
              P x ->
              lessOrEqual x upper) ->
            lessOrEqual supremum upper))

open CompleteOrderedRealField

subtract :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
subtract reals x y =
  add reals x (negate reals y)

divide :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
divide reals x y =
  multiply reals x (inverse reals y)

square :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R
square reals x =
  multiply reals x x

fromNat :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Nat ->
  R
fromNat reals zero =
  zeroR reals
fromNat reals (suc n) =
  add reals (fromNat reals n) (oneR reals)

oneN : Nat
oneN =
  suc zero

twoN : Nat
twoN =
  suc oneN

StrictLess :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
StrictLess reals x y =
  lessOrEqual reals x y and x != y

CloseTo :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
CloseTo reals center radius x =
  StrictLess reals
    (subtract reals center radius)
    x
  and
  StrictLess reals
    x
    (add reals center radius)

data NatLessOrEqual : Nat -> Nat -> Set where
  zero-less-or-equal :
    {n : Nat} ->
    NatLessOrEqual zero n
  successor-less-or-equal :
    {m n : Nat} ->
    NatLessOrEqual m n ->
    NatLessOrEqual (suc m) (suc n)

sumFirst :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Nat ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  R
sumFirst reals zero terms =
  zeroR reals
sumFirst reals (suc n) terms =
  add reals
    (sumFirst reals n terms)
    (terms n)

ConvergesTo :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  R ->
  Set
ConvergesTo {R} reals sequence limit =
  (epsilon : R) ->
  StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) epsilon ->
  Exists Nat
    (\ cutoff ->
      (n : Nat) ->
      NatLessOrEqual cutoff n ->
      CloseTo reals limit epsilon (sequence n))

midpointRiemannSum :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  (R -> R) ->
  Nat ->
  R
midpointRiemannSum reals lower upper function pieces =
  let
    step =
      divide reals
        (subtract reals upper lower)
        (fromNat reals pieces)
    half-step =
      divide reals step (fromNat reals twoN)
  in
  sumFirst reals pieces
    (\ i ->
      multiply reals
        (function
          (add reals lower
            (add reals
              (multiply reals
                (fromNat reals i)
                step)
              half-step)))
        step)

NaturalLogValue :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
NaturalLogValue reals x value =
  ConvergesTo reals
    (\ n ->
      midpointRiemannSum reals
        (oneR reals)
        x
        (inverse reals)
        (suc n))
    value

record RealAnalysis (R : Set) : Set1 where
  field
    reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R
    naturalLog : R -> R
    natural-log-definition :
      (x : R) ->
      StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) x ->
      NaturalLogValue reals x (naturalLog x)

open RealAnalysis

AtLeastOne :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  Set
AtLeastOne reals x =
  lessOrEqual reals (oneR reals) x

DerivativeWithinAt :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (R -> Set) ->
  (R -> R) ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
DerivativeWithinAt {R} reals domain function point derivative-value =
  (epsilon : R) ->
  StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) epsilon ->
  Exists R
    (\ delta ->
      StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) delta
      and
      ((x : R) ->
        domain x ->
        CloseTo reals point delta x ->
        x != point ->
        CloseTo reals derivative-value epsilon
          (divide reals
            (subtract reals (function x) (function point))
            (subtract reals x point))))

record Point (R : Set) : Set where
  constructor point
  field
    x-coordinate : R
    y-coordinate : R

open Point

InQuadrant :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Point R ->
  Set
InQuadrant reals p =
  AtLeastOne reals (x-coordinate p)
  and
  AtLeastOne reals (y-coordinate p)

ClosePoint :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Point R ->
  R ->
  Point R ->
  Set
ClosePoint reals center radius p =
  CloseTo reals
    (x-coordinate center)
    radius
    (x-coordinate p)
  and
  CloseTo reals
    (y-coordinate center)
    radius
    (y-coordinate p)

ContinuousWithinQuadrantAt :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (Point R -> R) ->
  Point R ->
  Set
ContinuousWithinQuadrantAt {R} reals function center =
  (epsilon : R) ->
  StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) epsilon ->
  Exists R
    (\ delta ->
      StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) delta
      and
      ((p : Point R) ->
        InQuadrant reals p ->
        ClosePoint reals center delta p ->
        CloseTo reals
          (function center)
          epsilon
          (function p)))

x-slice :
  {R : Set} ->
  (Point R -> R) ->
  Point R ->
  R ->
  R
x-slice function p x =
  function (point x (y-coordinate p))

y-slice :
  {R : Set} ->
  (Point R -> R) ->
  Point R ->
  R ->
  R
y-slice function p y =
  function (point (x-coordinate p) y)

record SecondPartialData
  {R : Set}
  (analysis : RealAnalysis R)
  (function : Point R -> R) :
  Set where

  field
    fx fy fxx fxy fyx fyy : Point R -> R

    derivative-x :
      (p : Point R) ->
      InQuadrant (reals analysis) p ->
      DerivativeWithinAt
        (reals analysis)
        (AtLeastOne (reals analysis))
        (x-slice function p)
        (x-coordinate p)
        (fx p)

    derivative-y :
      (p : Point R) ->
      InQuadrant (reals analysis) p ->
      DerivativeWithinAt
        (reals analysis)
        (AtLeastOne (reals analysis))
        (y-slice function p)
        (y-coordinate p)
        (fy p)

    derivative-xx :
      (p : Point R) ->
      InQuadrant (reals analysis) p ->
      DerivativeWithinAt
        (reals analysis)
        (AtLeastOne (reals analysis))
        (x-slice fx p)
        (x-coordinate p)
        (fxx p)

    derivative-xy :
      (p : Point R) ->
      InQuadrant (reals analysis) p ->
      DerivativeWithinAt
        (reals analysis)
        (AtLeastOne (reals analysis))
        (y-slice fx p)
        (y-coordinate p)
        (fxy p)

    derivative-yx :
      (p : Point R) ->
      InQuadrant (reals analysis) p ->
      DerivativeWithinAt
        (reals analysis)
        (AtLeastOne (reals analysis))
        (x-slice fy p)
        (x-coordinate p)
        (fyx p)

    derivative-yy :
      (p : Point R) ->
      InQuadrant (reals analysis) p ->
      DerivativeWithinAt
        (reals analysis)
        (AtLeastOne (reals analysis))
        (y-slice fy p)
        (y-coordinate p)
        (fyy p)

open SecondPartialData

ContinuousOnQuadrant :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (Point R -> R) ->
  Set
ContinuousOnQuadrant {R} reals function =
  (p : Point R) ->
  InQuadrant reals p ->
  ContinuousWithinQuadrantAt reals function p

C2OnQuadrant :
  {R : Set} ->
  {analysis : RealAnalysis R} ->
  {function : Point R -> R} ->
  SecondPartialData analysis function ->
  Set
C2OnQuadrant {R} {analysis} {function} derivatives =
  let real-field = reals analysis in
  ContinuousOnQuadrant real-field function
  and
  ContinuousOnQuadrant real-field (fx derivatives)
  and
  ContinuousOnQuadrant real-field (fy derivatives)
  and
  ContinuousOnQuadrant real-field (fxx derivatives)
  and
  ContinuousOnQuadrant real-field (fxy derivatives)
  and
  ContinuousOnQuadrant real-field (fyx derivatives)
  and
  ContinuousOnQuadrant real-field (fyy derivatives)

SatisfiesEquations :
  {R : Set} ->
  {analysis : RealAnalysis R} ->
  {function : Point R -> R} ->
  SecondPartialData analysis function ->
  Set
SatisfiesEquations {R} {analysis} derivatives =
  let
    real-field = reals analysis
    log = naturalLog analysis
  in
  ((p : Point R) ->
    InQuadrant real-field p ->
    let
      x = x-coordinate p
      y = y-coordinate p
    in
    add real-field
      (multiply real-field x (fx derivatives p))
      (multiply real-field y (fy derivatives p))
    ==
    multiply real-field
      (multiply real-field x y)
      (log (multiply real-field x y)))
  and
  ((p : Point R) ->
    InQuadrant real-field p ->
    let
      x = x-coordinate p
      y = y-coordinate p
    in
    add real-field
      (multiply real-field
        (square real-field x)
        (fxx derivatives p))
      (multiply real-field
        (square real-field y)
        (fyy derivatives p))
    ==
    multiply real-field x y)

AdmissibleFunction :
  {R : Set} ->
  (analysis : RealAnalysis R) ->
  (Point R -> R) ->
  Set
AdmissibleFunction analysis function =
  Exists (SecondPartialData analysis function)
    (\ derivatives ->
      C2OnQuadrant derivatives
      and
      SatisfiesEquations derivatives)

mixedDifference :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (Point R -> R) ->
  R ->
  R
mixedDifference reals function s =
  let
    s-plus-one = add reals s (oneR reals)
  in
  add reals
    (subtract reals
      (subtract reals
        (function (point s-plus-one s-plus-one))
        (function (point s-plus-one s)))
      (function (point s s-plus-one)))
    (function (point s s))

IsMinimumValue :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (R -> R) ->
  (R -> Set) ->
  R ->
  Set
IsMinimumValue {R} reals function domain minimum =
  Exists R
    (\ s ->
      domain s
      and
      function s == minimum)
  and
  ((s : R) ->
    domain s ->
    lessOrEqual reals minimum (function s))

putnamSolution :
  {R : Set} ->
  RealAnalysis R ->
  R
putnamSolution analysis =
  let
    real-field = reals analysis
    two = fromNat real-field twoN
  in
  subtract real-field
    (multiply real-field
      two
      (naturalLog analysis two))
    (divide real-field
      (oneR real-field)
      two)

putnam-2019-b4 : Set1
putnam-2019-b4 =
  (R : Set) ->
  (analysis : RealAnalysis R) ->
  (function : Point R -> R) ->
  AdmissibleFunction analysis function ->
  IsMinimumValue
    (reals analysis)
    (mixedDifference (reals analysis) function)
    (AtLeastOne (reals analysis))
    (putnamSolution analysis)

title: putnam_2019_b4
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2019_b4:
  the common minimum of a four-point difference for twice continuously
  differentiable real functions satisfying two specified partial differential
  equations on the quadrant x,y >= 1. This file contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open pred_setTheory realTheory real_topologyTheory limTheory transcTheory;

val putnam_2019_b4 =
  ``let partial_x =
      \f : real -> real -> real.
      \x y : real.
        diffn 1 (\u : real. f u y) x
    in
    let partial_y =
      \f : real -> real -> real.
      \x y : real.
        diffn 1 (f x) y
    in
    let partial_xx =
      \f : real -> real -> real.
      \x y : real.
        diffn 2 (\u : real. f u y) x
    in
    let partial_xy =
      \f : real -> real -> real.
      \x y : real.
        diffn 1 (\v : real. partial_x f x v) y
    in
    let partial_yx =
      \f : real -> real -> real.
      \x y : real.
        diffn 1 (\u : real. partial_y f u y) x
    in
    let partial_yy =
      \f : real -> real -> real.
      \x y : real.
        diffn 2 (f x) y
    in
    let continuous_on_quadrant =
      \h : real -> real -> real.
        !u v e : real.
          1 <= u /\ 1 <= v /\ 0 < e
          ==>
          ?d : real.
            0 < d /\
            !x y : real.
              1 <= x /\ 1 <= y /\
              (x - u) pow 2 + (y - v) pow 2 < d
              ==>
              abs (h x y - h u v) < e
    in
    let twice_continuously_differentiable =
      \f : real -> real -> real.
        (!x y : real.
           1 <= x /\ 1 <= y
           ==>
           higher_differentiable 2 (\u : real. f u y) x /\
           higher_differentiable 2 (f x) y /\
           higher_differentiable
             1
             (\v : real. partial_x f x v)
             y /\
           higher_differentiable
             1
             (\u : real. partial_y f u y)
             x) /\
        continuous_on_quadrant (partial_x f) /\
        continuous_on_quadrant (partial_y f) /\
        continuous_on_quadrant (partial_xx f) /\
        continuous_on_quadrant (partial_xy f) /\
        continuous_on_quadrant (partial_yx f) /\
        continuous_on_quadrant (partial_yy f)
    in
    let four_point_difference =
      \f : real -> real -> real.
      \s : real.
        f (s + 1) (s + 1) -
        f (s + 1) s -
        f s (s + 1) +
        f s s
    in
    let solution = (2 * ln 2 - 1 / 2 : real)
    in
      !f : real -> real -> real.
        twice_continuously_differentiable f /\
        (!x y : real.
           1 <= x /\ 1 <= y
           ==>
           x * partial_x f x y + y * partial_y f x y =
             x * y * ln (x * y)) /\
        (!x y : real.
           1 <= x /\ 1 <= y
           ==>
           x pow 2 * partial_xx f x y +
             y pow 2 * partial_yy f x y =
             x * y)
        ==>
        (!s : real.
           1 <= s
           ==>
           solution <= four_point_difference f s) /\
        (?s : real.
           1 <= s /\
           four_point_difference f s = solution)``;

title: putnam_2019_b4
content:
$(
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact
  putnam_2019_b4: the infimum of the mixed unit-square difference for any
  twice continuously differentiable real solution of the specified
  two-variable differential equations equals the specified real solution
  constant, independently of the function. This file contains no proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  F ranges over all total real-valued functions on RR X. RR. P19B4Dx and
  P19B4Dy are its coordinate derivatives, and P19B4Dxx, P19B4Dxy,
  P19B4Dyx, and P19B4Dyy are the corresponding second coordinate partials.
  Their zero fallbacks make them total, while the fallbacks are inactive on
  the closed quadrant under P19B4C2Q.

  P19B4ContQ is joint continuity relative to x >= 1 and y >= 1, expressed
  with rectangular neighborhoods. P19B4C2Q requires existence and relative
  joint continuity of all coordinate partials through order two there, the
  coordinate characterization of twice continuous differentiability on the
  source quadrant.

  P19B4Values F is exactly the set of mixed differences

    F(s+1,s+1) - F(s+1,s) - F(s,s+1) + F(s,s)

  for real s >= 1. Its real-order infimum is the sInf/minimum quantity in
  the formal and informal sources. Ordered pairs replace the source's
  two-coordinate vectors definitionally.

  The final assertion uses the resolved value 2 log(2) - 1/2 recorded by the
  Lean annotation and the explicit Rocq formalization. All auxiliary assertions
  below are syntax or definitions; the final declaration is the single unproved
  $a corpus statement, and this database contains no $p proof declaration.
$)

$c
  P19B4Dx P19B4Dy P19B4Dxx P19B4Dxy P19B4Dyx P19B4Dyy
  P19B4DX P19B4DY P19B4DXX P19B4DXY P19B4DYX P19B4DYY
  P19B4ContQ P19B4C2Q P19B4Values
$.

p19b4-dx-syntax $a class ( P19B4Dx F x y ) $.
p19b4-dy-syntax $a class ( P19B4Dy F x y ) $.
p19b4-dxx-syntax $a class ( P19B4Dxx F x y ) $.
p19b4-dxy-syntax $a class ( P19B4Dxy F x y ) $.
p19b4-dyx-syntax $a class ( P19B4Dyx F x y ) $.
p19b4-dyy-syntax $a class ( P19B4Dyy F x y ) $.
p19b4-dx-function-syntax $a class ( P19B4DX F ) $.
p19b4-dy-function-syntax $a class ( P19B4DY F ) $.
p19b4-dxx-function-syntax $a class ( P19B4DXX F ) $.
p19b4-dxy-function-syntax $a class ( P19B4DXY F ) $.
p19b4-dyx-function-syntax $a class ( P19B4DYX F ) $.
p19b4-dyy-function-syntax $a class ( P19B4DYY F ) $.
p19b4-contq-syntax $a wff ( P19B4ContQ F ) $.
p19b4-c2q-syntax $a wff ( P19B4C2Q F ) $.
p19b4-values-syntax $a class ( P19B4Values F ) $.

${
  $d F t x y $.

  p19b4-dx-definition $a |- ( P19B4Dx F x y ) = if (
    x e. dom ( RR _D ( t e. RR |-> ( F ` <. t , y >. ) ) ) ,
    ( ( RR _D ( t e. RR |-> ( F ` <. t , y >. ) ) ) ` x ) ,
    0
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d F t x y $.

  p19b4-dy-definition $a |- ( P19B4Dy F x y ) = if (
    y e. dom ( RR _D ( t e. RR |-> ( F ` <. x , t >. ) ) ) ,
    ( ( RR _D ( t e. RR |-> ( F ` <. x , t >. ) ) ) ` y ) ,
    0
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d F t x y $.

  p19b4-dxx-definition $a |- ( P19B4Dxx F x y ) = if (
    x e. dom ( RR _D ( t e. RR |-> ( P19B4Dx F t y ) ) ) ,
    ( ( RR _D ( t e. RR |-> ( P19B4Dx F t y ) ) ) ` x ) ,
    0
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d F t x y $.

  p19b4-dxy-definition $a |- ( P19B4Dxy F x y ) = if (
    y e. dom ( RR _D ( t e. RR |-> ( P19B4Dx F x t ) ) ) ,
    ( ( RR _D ( t e. RR |-> ( P19B4Dx F x t ) ) ) ` y ) ,
    0
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d F t x y $.

  p19b4-dyx-definition $a |- ( P19B4Dyx F x y ) = if (
    x e. dom ( RR _D ( t e. RR |-> ( P19B4Dy F t y ) ) ) ,
    ( ( RR _D ( t e. RR |-> ( P19B4Dy F t y ) ) ) ` x ) ,
    0
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d F t x y $.

  p19b4-dyy-definition $a |- ( P19B4Dyy F x y ) = if (
    y e. dom ( RR _D ( t e. RR |-> ( P19B4Dy F x t ) ) ) ,
    ( ( RR _D ( t e. RR |-> ( P19B4Dy F x t ) ) ) ` y ) ,
    0
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d F p $.

  p19b4-dx-function-definition $a |- ( P19B4DX F ) =
    ( p e. ( RR X. RR ) |->
      ( P19B4Dx F ( 1st ` p ) ( 2nd ` p ) ) ) $.
$}

${
  $d F p $.

  p19b4-dy-function-definition $a |- ( P19B4DY F ) =
    ( p e. ( RR X. RR ) |->
      ( P19B4Dy F ( 1st ` p ) ( 2nd ` p ) ) ) $.
$}

${
  $d F p $.

  p19b4-dxx-function-definition $a |- ( P19B4DXX F ) =
    ( p e. ( RR X. RR ) |->
      ( P19B4Dxx F ( 1st ` p ) ( 2nd ` p ) ) ) $.
$}

${
  $d F p $.

  p19b4-dxy-function-definition $a |- ( P19B4DXY F ) =
    ( p e. ( RR X. RR ) |->
      ( P19B4Dxy F ( 1st ` p ) ( 2nd ` p ) ) ) $.
$}

${
  $d F p $.

  p19b4-dyx-function-definition $a |- ( P19B4DYX F ) =
    ( p e. ( RR X. RR ) |->
      ( P19B4Dyx F ( 1st ` p ) ( 2nd ` p ) ) ) $.
$}

${
  $d F p $.

  p19b4-dyy-function-definition $a |- ( P19B4DYY F ) =
    ( p e. ( RR X. RR ) |->
      ( P19B4Dyy F ( 1st ` p ) ( 2nd ` p ) ) ) $.
$}

${
  $d F d e u v x y $.

  p19b4-contq-definition $a |- (
    ( P19B4ContQ F )
    <->
    (
      F e. ( RR ^m ( RR X. RR ) )
      /\
      A. x e. RR A. y e. RR
        (
          (
            1 <_ x
            /\
            1 <_ y
          )
          ->
          A. e e. RR
            (
              0 < e
              ->
              E. d e. RR
                (
                  0 < d
                  /\
                  A. u e. RR A. v e. RR
                    (
                      (
                        (
                          (
                            1 <_ u
                            /\
                            1 <_ v
                          )
                          /\
                          ( abs ` ( u - x ) ) < d
                        )
                        /\
                        ( abs ` ( v - y ) ) < d
                      )
                      ->
                      (
                        abs
                        `
                        (
                          ( F ` <. u , v >. )
                          -
                          ( F ` <. x , y >. )
                        )
                      )
                      < e
                    )
                )
            )
        )
    )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d F t x y $.

  p19b4-c2q-definition $a |- (
    ( P19B4C2Q F )
    <->
    (
      F e. ( RR ^m ( RR X. RR ) )
      /\
      (
        (
          A. x e. RR A. y e. RR
            (
              (
                1 <_ x
                /\
                1 <_ y
              )
              ->
              (
                x e.
                  dom ( RR _D ( t e. RR |-> ( F ` <. t , y >. ) ) )
                /\
                y e.
                  dom ( RR _D ( t e. RR |-> ( F ` <. x , t >. ) ) )
              )
            )
          /\
          A. x e. RR A. y e. RR
            (
              (
                1 <_ x
                /\
                1 <_ y
              )
              ->
              (
                (
                  x e.
                    dom
                      ( RR _D ( t e. RR |-> ( P19B4Dx F t y ) ) )
                  /\
                  y e.
                    dom
                      ( RR _D ( t e. RR |-> ( P19B4Dx F x t ) ) )
                )
                /\
                (
                  x e.
                    dom
                      ( RR _D ( t e. RR |-> ( P19B4Dy F t y ) ) )
                  /\
                  y e.
                    dom
                      ( RR _D ( t e. RR |-> ( P19B4Dy F x t ) ) )
                )
              )
            )
        )
        /\
        (
          (
            ( P19B4ContQ F )
            /\
            (
              ( P19B4ContQ ( P19B4DX F ) )
              /\
              ( P19B4ContQ ( P19B4DY F ) )
            )
          )
          /\
          (
            (
              ( P19B4ContQ ( P19B4DXX F ) )
              /\
              ( P19B4ContQ ( P19B4DXY F ) )
            )
            /\
            (
              ( P19B4ContQ ( P19B4DYX F ) )
              /\
              ( P19B4ContQ ( P19B4DYY F ) )
            )
          )
        )
      )
    )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d F s z $.

p19b4-values-definition $a |- ( P19B4Values F ) = {
    z e. RR |
      E. s e. RR
        (
          1 <_ s
          /\
          z
          =
          (
            (
              (
                ( F ` <. ( s + 1 ) , ( s + 1 ) >. )
                -
                ( F ` <. ( s + 1 ) , s >. )
              )
              -
              ( F ` <. s , ( s + 1 ) >. )
            )
            +
            ( F ` <. s , s >. )
          )
        )
} $.
$}

${
  $d f x y $.

  putnambench-putnam-2019-b4 $a |-
    A. f e. ( RR ^m ( RR X. RR ) )
      (
        (
          (
            ( P19B4C2Q f )
            /\
            A. x e. RR A. y e. RR
              (
                (
                  1 <_ x
                  /\
                  1 <_ y
                )
                ->
                (
                  (
                    ( x x. ( P19B4Dx f x y ) )
                    +
                    ( y x. ( P19B4Dy f x y ) )
                  )
                  =
                  (
                    ( x x. y )
                    x.
                    ( log ` ( x x. y ) )
                  )
                )
              )
          )
          /\
          A. x e. RR A. y e. RR
            (
              (
                1 <_ x
                /\
                1 <_ y
              )
              ->
              (
                (
                  ( ( x ^ 2 ) x. ( P19B4Dxx f x y ) )
                  +
                  ( ( y ^ 2 ) x. ( P19B4Dyy f x y ) )
                )
                =
                ( x x. y )
              )
            )
        )
        ->
        inf ( ( P19B4Values f ) , RR , < )
        =
        (
          ( 2 x. ( log ` 2 ) )
          -
          ( 1 / 2 )
        )
      )
  $.
$}

title: putnam_2019_b4
content:
:: Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2019_b4
:: (putnambench__mizar__putnam_2019_b4): the minimum rectangular increment
:: of a twice continuously differentiable real function satisfying the
:: specified partial differential equations is 2*ln(2)-1/2, independently
:: of the function. This file contains no proof.

environ

  vocabularies FUNCT_1, FUNCT_2, ARYTM_3, ARYTM_1, FINSEQ_1, FINSEQ_2,
    RELAT_1, COMPLEX1, SQUARE_1, RCOMP_1, XBOOLE_0, ZFMISC_1, PARTFUN1,
    XXREAL_1, ORDINAL4, FCONT_1, FDIFF_1, PDIFF_1, AFINSQ_1, NUMBERS,
    REAL_1, SUBSET_1, CARD_1, TARSKI, XXREAL_0, CARD_3, NAT_1, VALUED_1,
    SEQFUNC, PDIFF_9, XCMPLX_0, SIN_COS, SERIES_1, NFCONT_1, BINOP_1,
    PREPOWER, POWER;
  notations TARSKI, XBOOLE_0, ZFMISC_1, SUBSET_1, FUNCT_1, ORDINAL1,
    RELSET_1, PARTFUN1, FUNCT_2, NUMBERS, XCMPLX_0, XXREAL_0, XREAL_0,
    REAL_1, COMPLEX1, SQUARE_1, BINOP_1, FINSEQ_1, VALUED_1, FINSEQ_2,
    RCOMP_1, FDIFF_1, SEQFUNC, SIN_COS, FINSEQ_7, EUCLID, TAYLOR_1,
    PDIFF_1, PDIFF_7, PDIFF_9, NFCONT_1, NFCONT_4, MESFUN9C,
    PREPOWER, POWER;
  constructors REAL_1, SQUARE_1, BINOP_1, FINSEQ_7, FINSEQ_4, SIN_COS,
    FDIFF_1, PDIFF_1, MONOID_0, INTEGR15, RELSET_1, NFCONT_1, PDIFF_7,
    TAYLOR_1, SEQFUNC, PDIFF_9, NFCONT_4, MESFUNC5, MESFUN9C, COMPLEX1,
    PREPOWER, POWER;
  registrations XBOOLE_0, FUNCT_1, ORDINAL1, RELSET_1, FUNCT_2, NUMBERS,
    XXREAL_0, XREAL_0, NAT_1, MEMBERED, VALUED_0, FINSEQ_1, EUCLID,
    VALUED_1, SQUARE_1, RCOMP_1, PREPOWER;
  requirements SUBSET, REAL, BOOLE, NUMERALS, ARITHM;
  definitions TARSKI;
  equalities EUCLID, BINOP_1, PDIFF_1, SIN_COS, PDIFF_9, SUBSET_1;
  expansions TARSKI, PDIFF_1, PDIFF_9, TAYLOR_1;

begin

::$P-
theorem
  for f being Function of REAL 2,REAL st
    (for i,j being Nat st i in Seg 2 & j in Seg 2 holds
      f is_partial_differentiable_on [#](REAL 2),i &
      (f`partial|([#](REAL 2),i))
        is_partial_differentiable_on [#](REAL 2),j &
      (for u being Element of REAL 2 holds
        (f`partial|([#](REAL 2),i)) is_continuous_in u) &
      ex d2 being PartFunc of REAL 2,REAL st
        d2 = ((f`partial|([#](REAL 2),i))
          `partial|([#](REAL 2),j)) &
        for u being Element of REAL 2 holds d2 is_continuous_in u) &
    (for u being Element of REAL 2 st 1 <= u.1 & 1 <= u.2 holds
      u.1 * partdiff(f,u,1) + u.2 * partdiff(f,u,2) =
        u.1 * u.2 * log(number_e,u.1*u.2)) &
    (for u being Element of REAL 2 st 1 <= u.1 & 1 <= u.2 holds
      (u.1)^2 * (((f`partial|([#](REAL 2),1))
        `partial|([#](REAL 2),1)).u) +
      (u.2)^2 * (((f`partial|([#](REAL 2),2))
        `partial|([#](REAL 2),2)).u) = u.1*u.2)
  holds
    (for s being Real st 1 <= s holds
      2 * log(number_e,2) - (1 qua Real)/2 <=
        f.<*s+1,s+1*> - f.<*s+1,s*> -
          f.<*s,s+1*> + f.<*s,s*>) &
    (ex s being Real st
      1 <= s &
      f.<*s+1,s+1*> - f.<*s+1,s*> -
        f.<*s,s+1*> + f.<*s,s*> =
          2 * log(number_e,2) - (1 qua Real)/2)
proof
end;
::$P+

title: putnam_2019_b4
content:
% Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2019_b4:
% every twice continuously differentiable real function satisfying the stated
% two partial differential equations has mixed unit-square differences with
% infimum 2 times the natural logarithm of 2 minus 1/2, independently of the
% function. This file contains no proof.

putnam_2019_b4: THEORY
BEGIN
  point: TYPE = [# x_coord: real, y_coord: real #]
  gradient: TYPE = [# dx: real, dy: real #]
  hessian: TYPE =
    [# dxx: real, dxy: real, dyx: real, dyy: real #]

  scalar_field: TYPE = [point -> real]
  gradient_field: TYPE = [point -> gradient]
  hessian_field: TYPE = [point -> hessian]
  real_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> real]

  squared_distance(p, q: point): real =
    (x_coord(p) - x_coord(q)) ^ 2
      + (y_coord(p) - y_coord(q)) ^ 2

  gradient_distance_squared(first, second: gradient): real =
    (dx(first) - dx(second)) ^ 2
      + (dy(first) - dy(second)) ^ 2

  hessian_distance_squared(first, second: hessian): real =
    (dxx(first) - dxx(second)) ^ 2
      + (dxy(first) - dxy(second)) ^ 2
      + (dyx(first) - dyx(second)) ^ 2
      + (dyy(first) - dyy(second)) ^ 2

  in_quadrant(p: point): bool =
    x_coord(p) >= 1 AND y_coord(p) >= 1

  scalar_derivative_error(
      f: scalar_field,
      derivative: gradient,
      p, q: point): real =
    f(q) - f(p)
      - dx(derivative) * (x_coord(q) - x_coord(p))
      - dy(derivative) * (y_coord(q) - y_coord(p))

  has_scalar_frechet_derivative_at(
      f: scalar_field,
      derivative: gradient,
      p: point): bool =
    FORALL (epsilon_value: posreal):
      EXISTS (delta: posreal):
        FORALL (q: point):
          (q /= p
            AND squared_distance(q, p) < delta ^ 2)
          IMPLIES
            scalar_derivative_error(f, derivative, p, q) ^ 2
              < epsilon_value ^ 2 * squared_distance(q, p)

  gradient_derivative_error_squared(
      f: gradient_field,
      derivative: hessian,
      p, q: point): real =
    (dx(f(q)) - dx(f(p))
      - dxx(derivative) * (x_coord(q) - x_coord(p))
      - dxy(derivative) * (y_coord(q) - y_coord(p))) ^ 2
      + (dy(f(q)) - dy(f(p))
        - dyx(derivative) * (x_coord(q) - x_coord(p))
        - dyy(derivative) * (y_coord(q) - y_coord(p))) ^ 2

  has_gradient_frechet_derivative_at(
      f: gradient_field,
      derivative: hessian,
      p: point): bool =
    FORALL (epsilon_value: posreal):
      EXISTS (delta: posreal):
        FORALL (q: point):
          (q /= p
            AND squared_distance(q, p) < delta ^ 2)
          IMPLIES
            gradient_derivative_error_squared(
              f, derivative, p, q)
              < epsilon_value ^ 2 * squared_distance(q, p)

  continuous_scalar_on_quadrant(f: scalar_field): bool =
    FORALL (p: point):
      in_quadrant(p) IMPLIES
        FORALL (epsilon_value: posreal):
          EXISTS (delta: posreal):
            FORALL (q: point):
              (in_quadrant(q)
                AND squared_distance(q, p) < delta ^ 2)
              IMPLIES
                (f(q) - f(p)) ^ 2 < epsilon_value ^ 2

  continuous_gradient_on_quadrant(f: gradient_field): bool =
    FORALL (p: point):
      in_quadrant(p) IMPLIES
        FORALL (epsilon_value: posreal):
          EXISTS (delta: posreal):
            FORALL (q: point):
              (in_quadrant(q)
                AND squared_distance(q, p) < delta ^ 2)
              IMPLIES
                gradient_distance_squared(f(q), f(p))
                  < epsilon_value ^ 2

  continuous_hessian_on_quadrant(f: hessian_field): bool =
    FORALL (p: point):
      in_quadrant(p) IMPLIES
        FORALL (epsilon_value: posreal):
          EXISTS (delta: posreal):
            FORALL (q: point):
              (in_quadrant(q)
                AND squared_distance(q, p) < delta ^ 2)
              IMPLIES
                hessian_distance_squared(f(q), f(p))
                  < epsilon_value ^ 2

  twice_continuously_differentiable_on_quadrant(
      f: scalar_field,
      first: gradient_field,
      second: hessian_field): bool =
    continuous_scalar_on_quadrant(f)
      AND continuous_gradient_on_quadrant(first)
      AND continuous_hessian_on_quadrant(second)
      AND FORALL (p: point):
        in_quadrant(p) IMPLIES
          (has_scalar_frechet_derivative_at(f, first(p), p)
            AND has_gradient_frechet_derivative_at(
              first, second(p), p))

  safe_div(numerator, denominator: real): real =
    IF denominator = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      numerator / denominator
    ENDIF

  nat_factorial(index: nat): RECURSIVE nat =
    IF index = 0 THEN
      1
    ELSE
      index * nat_factorial(index - 1)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE index

  exponential_partial(x: real, count: nat): RECURSIVE real =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      LET index: nat = count - 1 IN
        exponential_partial(x, count - 1)
          + safe_div(
              x ^ index,
              nat_factorial(index) :: real)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  converges_to(sequence: real_sequence, value: real): bool =
    FORALL (epsilon_value: posreal):
      EXISTS (cutoff: nat):
        FORALL (index: nat):
          cutoff <= index IMPLIES
            abs(sequence(index) - value) < epsilon_value

  real_exponential(x: real): real =
    epsilon(
      LAMBDA (value: real):
        converges_to(
          LAMBDA (count: nat):
            exponential_partial(x, count),
          value))

  natural_log(x: real): real =
    IF x > 0 THEN
      epsilon(
        LAMBDA (value: real):
          real_exponential(value) = x)
    ELSE
      0
    ENDIF

  satisfies_differential_equations(
      first: gradient_field,
      second: hessian_field): bool =
    FORALL (p: point):
      in_quadrant(p) IMPLIES
        (x_coord(p) * dx(first(p))
          + y_coord(p) * dy(first(p))
          = x_coord(p) * y_coord(p)
              * natural_log(x_coord(p) * y_coord(p))
        AND x_coord(p) ^ 2 * dxx(second(p))
          + y_coord(p) ^ 2 * dyy(second(p))
          = x_coord(p) * y_coord(p))

  admissible(f: scalar_field): bool =
    EXISTS
        (first: gradient_field),
        (second: hessian_field):
      twice_continuously_differentiable_on_quadrant(
        f, first, second)
        AND satisfies_differential_equations(first, second)

  plane_point(x, y: real): point =
    (# x_coord := x, y_coord := y #)

  mixed_square_difference(f: scalar_field, s: real): real =
    f(plane_point(s + 1, s + 1))
      - f(plane_point(s + 1, s))
      - f(plane_point(s, s + 1))
      + f(plane_point(s, s))

  attainable_difference(
      f: scalar_field,
      value: real): bool =
    EXISTS (s: real):
      s >= 1 AND value = mixed_square_difference(f, s)

  is_lower_bound(
      f: scalar_field,
      bound: real): bool =
    FORALL (value: real):
      attainable_difference(f, value) IMPLIES bound <= value

  is_infimum(
      f: scalar_field,
      value: real): bool =
    is_lower_bound(f, value)
      AND FORALL (bound: real):
        is_lower_bound(f, bound) IMPLIES bound <= value

  putnam_2019_b4_solution: real =
    2 * natural_log(2) - 1 / 2

  putnam_2019_b4_statement: bool =
    FORALL (f: scalar_field):
      admissible(f) IMPLIES
        is_infimum(f, putnam_2019_b4_solution)
END putnam_2019_b4

title: putnam_2019_b5

import Mathlib

open Topology Filter Set Matrix

abbrev putnam_2019_b5_solution : ℕ × ℕ := sorry
-- ⟨2019, 1010⟩
/--
Let $F_m$ be the $m$th Fibonacci number, defined by $F_1 = F_2 = 1$ and $F_m = F_{m-1} + F_{m-2}$ for all $m \geq 3$. Let $p(x)$ be the polynomial of degree $1008$ such that $p(2n + 1) = F_{2n+1}$ for $n = 0,1,2,\ldots,1008$. Find integers $j$ and $k$ such that $p(2019) = F_j - F_k$.
-/
theorem putnam_2019_b5
(F : ℕ → ℤ)
(P : Polynomial ℝ)
(hF : ∀ x, x ≥ 1 → F (x + 2) = F (x + 1) + F x)
(F12 : F 1 = 1 ∧ F 2 = 1)
(Pdeg: Polynomial.degree P = 1008)
(hp: ∀ n : ℕ, (n ≤ 1008) → P.eval (2 * n + 1 : ℝ) = F (2 * n + 1))
: ∀ j k : ℕ, (P.eval 2019 = F j - F k ∧ 1 ≤ j ∧ 1 ≤ k) ↔ ⟨j, k⟩ = putnam_2019_b5_solution  :=
sorry

From mathcomp Require Import all_algebra all_ssreflect.
From mathcomp Require Import reals.

Set Implicit Arguments.
Unset Strict Implicit.
Unset Printing Implicit Defensive.

Local Open Scope ring_scope.

Variable R : realType.
Definition putnam_2019_b5_solution : nat * nat := (2019%nat, 1010%nat).
Theorem putnam_2019_b5
    (F : nat -> int)
    (P : {poly R})
    (hF : forall x : nat, ge x 1 -> F (x.+2) = F (x.+1) + F x)
    (F12 : F 1%nat = 1 /\ F 2%nat = 1)
    (Pdeg : size P = 1009%nat)
    (hp : forall n : nat, (le n 1008) -> P.[2 * (n%:R) + 1] = (F ((n.*2).+1))%:~R)
    : forall j k : nat,
      (P.[2019] = (F j - F k)%:~R /\
       (1 <= j)%nat /\
       (1 <= k)%nat) <->
      (j, k) = putnam_2019_b5_solution.
Proof. Admitted.
