content:
;; Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2021_a2:
;; the right-hand real-power limit defining g(x) for every positive real x
;; implies that g(x)/x tends to exp(1) as x tends to infinity. This file
;; contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))

;; Exact reals are regular Cauchy names with rational values.  A name a
;; represents the limit of a(n), with the displayed modulus.  DEFSTUB keeps
;; the source function g arbitrary; the statement explicitly requires that it
;; map real names to real names and respect equality of represented reals.

(defstub putnam-2021-a2-g (x) t)

(defun putnam-2021-a2-positive-rational-p (x)
  (and (rationalp x)
       (< 0 x)))

(defun putnam-2021-a2-real-value (name index)
  (apply$ name (list index)))

(defun-sk putnam-2021-a2-rational-values-p (name)
  (forall (index)
    (implies
     (natp index)
     (rationalp
      (putnam-2021-a2-real-value name index)))))

(defun-sk putnam-2021-a2-regular-cauchy-p (name)
  (forall (left-index right-index)
    (implies
     (and (natp left-index)
          (natp right-index))
     (<=
      (abs
       (-
        (putnam-2021-a2-real-value name left-index)
        (putnam-2021-a2-real-value name right-index)))
      (+
       (/ 1 (+ 1 left-index))
       (/ 1 (+ 1 right-index)))))))

(defun putnam-2021-a2-real-name-p (name)
  (and
   (tamep-functionp name)
   (putnam-2021-a2-rational-values-p name)
   (putnam-2021-a2-regular-cauchy-p name)))

(defun putnam-2021-a2-constant-name (value)
  (list 'lambda
        '(index)
        (list 'quote value)))

(defun putnam-2021-a2-zero-name ()
  (putnam-2021-a2-constant-name 0))

(defun putnam-2021-a2-one-name ()
  (putnam-2021-a2-constant-name 1))

;; Rational sequence expressions used below have their ordinary pointwise
;; meanings.  EXP uses the diagonal sequence of exponential-series prefixes.

(defun putnam-2021-a2-factorial (n)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix n)))
  (if (zp n)
      1
    (* n (putnam-2021-a2-factorial (- n 1)))))

(defun putnam-2021-a2-rational-power (base exponent)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix exponent)))
  (if (zp exponent)
      1
    (* base
       (putnam-2021-a2-rational-power
        base (- exponent 1)))))

(defun putnam-2021-a2-exp-prefix (x terms)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix terms)))
  (if (zp terms)
      0
    (let ((index (- terms 1)))
      (+
       (putnam-2021-a2-exp-prefix x index)
       (/
        (putnam-2021-a2-rational-power x index)
        (putnam-2021-a2-factorial index))))))

(defun putnam-2021-a2-sequence-value
    (kind arguments index)
  (let ((left
         (putnam-2021-a2-real-value
          (car arguments) index)))
    (cond
     ((equal kind :identity)
      left)
     ((equal kind :add)
      (+ left
         (putnam-2021-a2-real-value
          (cadr arguments) index)))
     ((equal kind :subtract)
      (- left
         (putnam-2021-a2-real-value
          (cadr arguments) index)))
     ((equal kind :multiply)
      (* left
         (putnam-2021-a2-real-value
          (cadr arguments) index)))
     ((equal kind :reciprocal)
      (/ 1 left))
     ((equal kind :exp)
      (putnam-2021-a2-exp-prefix
       left (+ 1 (nfix index))))
     (t 0))))

(defun-sk putnam-2021-a2-sequence-tail-p
    (output kind arguments epsilon cutoff)
  (forall (index)
    (implies
     (and (natp index)
          (<= cutoff index))
     (<
      (abs
       (-
        (putnam-2021-a2-real-value output index)
        (putnam-2021-a2-sequence-value
         kind arguments index)))
      epsilon))))

(defun-sk putnam-2021-a2-sequence-cutoff-exists-p
    (output kind arguments epsilon)
  (exists (cutoff)
    (and
     (natp cutoff)
     (putnam-2021-a2-sequence-tail-p
      output kind arguments epsilon cutoff))))

(defun-sk putnam-2021-a2-represents-sequence-p
    (output kind arguments)
  (forall (epsilon)
    (implies
     (putnam-2021-a2-positive-rational-p epsilon)
     (putnam-2021-a2-sequence-cutoff-exists-p
      output kind arguments epsilon))))

;; Exact equality and strict inequalities use the rational neighborhood basis
;; of the real topology, which is equivalent to quantifying over real radii.

(defun-sk putnam-2021-a2-distance-tail-p
    (left right margin cutoff)
  (forall (index)
    (implies
     (and (natp index)
          (<= cutoff index))
     (<
      (abs
       (-
        (putnam-2021-a2-real-value left index)
        (putnam-2021-a2-real-value right index)))
      margin))))

(defun-sk putnam-2021-a2-distance-below-p
    (left right epsilon)
  (exists (margin cutoff)
    (and
     (putnam-2021-a2-positive-rational-p margin)
     (< margin epsilon)
     (natp cutoff)
     (putnam-2021-a2-distance-tail-p
      left right margin cutoff))))

(defun-sk putnam-2021-a2-real-equal-p (left right)
  (forall (epsilon)
    (implies
     (putnam-2021-a2-positive-rational-p epsilon)
     (putnam-2021-a2-distance-below-p
      left right epsilon))))

(defun-sk putnam-2021-a2-positive-tail-p
    (name margin cutoff)
  (forall (index)
    (implies
     (and (natp index)
          (<= cutoff index))
     (< margin
        (putnam-2021-a2-real-value name index)))))

(defun-sk putnam-2021-a2-real-positive-p (name)
  (exists (margin cutoff)
    (and
     (putnam-2021-a2-positive-rational-p margin)
     (natp cutoff)
     (putnam-2021-a2-positive-tail-p
      name margin cutoff))))

(defun-sk putnam-2021-a2-below-rational-tail-p
    (name bound margin cutoff)
  (forall (index)
    (implies
     (and (natp index)
          (<= cutoff index))
     (<
      (putnam-2021-a2-real-value name index)
      (- bound margin)))))

(defun-sk putnam-2021-a2-below-rational-p
    (name bound)
  (exists (margin cutoff)
    (and
     (rationalp bound)
     (putnam-2021-a2-positive-rational-p margin)
     (natp cutoff)
     (putnam-2021-a2-below-rational-tail-p
      name bound margin cutoff))))

(defun-sk putnam-2021-a2-above-rational-tail-p
    (name bound margin cutoff)
  (forall (index)
    (implies
     (and (natp index)
          (<= cutoff index))
     (<
      (+ bound margin)
      (putnam-2021-a2-real-value name index)))))

(defun-sk putnam-2021-a2-above-rational-p
    (name bound)
  (exists (margin cutoff)
    (and
     (rationalp bound)
     (putnam-2021-a2-positive-rational-p margin)
     (natp cutoff)
     (putnam-2021-a2-above-rational-tail-p
      name bound margin cutoff))))

(defun putnam-2021-a2-add-p (left right output)
  (and
   (putnam-2021-a2-real-name-p left)
   (putnam-2021-a2-real-name-p right)
   (putnam-2021-a2-real-name-p output)
   (putnam-2021-a2-represents-sequence-p
    output :add (list left right))))

(defun putnam-2021-a2-subtract-p (left right output)
  (and
   (putnam-2021-a2-real-name-p left)
   (putnam-2021-a2-real-name-p right)
   (putnam-2021-a2-real-name-p output)
   (putnam-2021-a2-represents-sequence-p
    output :subtract (list left right))))

(defun putnam-2021-a2-multiply-p (left right output)
  (and
   (putnam-2021-a2-real-name-p left)
   (putnam-2021-a2-real-name-p right)
   (putnam-2021-a2-real-name-p output)
   (putnam-2021-a2-represents-sequence-p
    output :multiply (list left right))))

(defun putnam-2021-a2-reciprocal-p (input output)
  (and
   (putnam-2021-a2-real-name-p input)
   (putnam-2021-a2-real-name-p output)
   (not
    (putnam-2021-a2-real-equal-p

;; represented without a new primitive: log(base) is the unique real whose
;; exponential is base.

(defun-sk putnam-2021-a2-positive-power-p
    (base exponent output)

    (and
     (putnam-2021-a2-real-name-p base)
     (putnam-2021-a2-real-positive-p base)
     (putnam-2021-a2-real-name-p exponent)
     (putnam-2021-a2-real-name-p output)
     (putnam-2021-a2-exp-p logarithm base)
     (putnam-2021-a2-multiply-p
      exponent logarithm product)
     (putnam-2021-a2-exp-p product output))))

     (putnam-2021-a2-add-p
      r (putnam-2021-a2-one-name) r-plus-one)
     (putnam-2021-a2-positive-power-p
      x-plus-one r-plus-one left-power)
     (putnam-2021-a2-positive-power-p
      x r-plus-one right-power)
     (putnam-2021-a2-subtract-p
      left-power right-power difference)
     (putnam-2021-a2-reciprocal-p
      r reciprocal-r)
     (putnam-2021-a2-positive-power-p
      difference reciprocal-r output))))

(defun-sk putnam-2021-a2-expression-exists-p (x r)

    (putnam-2021-a2-expression-p x r output)))

(defun-sk putnam-2021-a2-expression-close-p

     (putnam-2021-a2-expression-p x r output)

(defun-sk putnam-2021-a2-inner-eventually-p

    (implies
     (and
      (putnam-2021-a2-real-name-p r)
      (putnam-2021-a2-real-positive-p r)
      (putnam-2021-a2-below-rational-p r delta))
     (and
      (putnam-2021-a2-expression-exists-p x r)
      (putnam-2021-a2-expression-close-p
       x r epsilon)))))

(defun-sk putnam-2021-a2-inner-delta-exists-p
    (x epsilon)
  (exists (delta)
    (and
     (putnam-2021-a2-positive-rational-p delta)
     (putnam-2021-a2-inner-eventually-p
      x epsilon delta))))

(defun-sk putnam-2021-a2-inner-limit-p (x)
  (forall (epsilon)
    (implies
     (putnam-2021-a2-positive-rational-p epsilon)
     (putnam-2021-a2-inner-delta-exists-p
      x epsilon))))

(defun-sk putnam-2021-a2-g-values-p ()
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (putnam-2021-a2-real-name-p x)
     (putnam-2021-a2-real-name-p
      (putnam-2021-a2-g x)))))

(defun-sk putnam-2021-a2-g-extensional-p ()

      (putnam-2021-a2-real-name-p x)
      (putnam-2021-a2-real-name-p y)
      (putnam-2021-a2-real-equal-p x y))
     (putnam-2021-a2-real-equal-p
      (putnam-2021-a2-g x)

  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (and
      (putnam-2021-a2-real-name-p x)
      (putnam-2021-a2-real-positive-p x))
     (putnam-2021-a2-inner-limit-p x))))

;; x is eventually bounded below by a positive cutoff, this diagonal quotient
;; converges to the exact real quotient.

(defun-sk putnam-2021-a2-quotient-tail-p
    (x limit margin index-cutoff)
  (forall (index)
    (implies
     (and (natp index)
          (<= index-cutoff index))

      (abs
       (-
        (/
         (putnam-2021-a2-real-value
          (putnam-2021-a2-g x) index)
         (putnam-2021-a2-real-value x index))
        (putnam-2021-a2-real-value limit index)))

    (x limit epsilon)

    (and
     (putnam-2021-a2-positive-rational-p margin)
     (< margin epsilon)
     (natp index-cutoff)
     (putnam-2021-a2-quotient-tail-p
      x limit margin index-cutoff))))

(defun-sk putnam-2021-a2-outer-eventually-p
    (limit epsilon cutoff)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (and
      (putnam-2021-a2-real-name-p x)
      (putnam-2021-a2-above-rational-p x cutoff))
     (putnam-2021-a2-quotient-distance-below-p
      x limit epsilon))))

(defun-sk putnam-2021-a2-outer-cutoff-exists-p
    (limit epsilon)
  (exists (cutoff)
    (and
     (rationalp cutoff)
     (putnam-2021-a2-outer-eventually-p

(defun-sk putnam-2021-a2-conclusion-p (limit)
  (forall (epsilon)
    (implies
     (putnam-2021-a2-positive-rational-p epsilon)
     (putnam-2021-a2-outer-cutoff-exists-p
      limit epsilon))))

(defun-sk putnambench-putnam-2021-a2-statement ()
  (exists (exp-one)
    (and
     (putnam-2021-a2-exp-p
      (putnam-2021-a2-one-name) exp-one)
     (implies
      (and
       (putnam-2021-a2-g-values-p)
       (putnam-2021-a2-g-extensional-p)
       (putnam-2021-a2-hypothesis-p))
      (putnam-2021-a2-conclusion-p exp-one)))))

title: putnam_2021_a2
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2021_a2
-- (putnambench__agda__putnam_2021_a2): a right-hand real-power limit defining
-- g has g(x) / x tending to exp(1) at positive infinity. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module Main where

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; _*_)

infix 4 _!=_ _<=N_
infixr 3 _and_
infixr 2 _or_

data Bottom : Set where

Not : Set -> Set
Not A =
  A -> Bottom

_!=_ : {A : Set} -> A -> A -> Set
x != y =
  Not (x == y)

record _and_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data _or_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  left  : A -> A or B
  right : B -> A or B

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

data _<=N_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set where
  zero<=N   : {n : Nat} -> zero <=N n
  suc<=sucN : {m n : Nat} -> m <=N n -> suc m <=N suc n

record CompleteOrderedRealField (R : Set) : Set1 where
  field
    zeroR oneR : R
    add multiply : R -> R -> R
    negate inverse : R -> R
    lessOrEqual : R -> R -> Set
    fromNat : Nat -> R

    one-not-zero :
      oneR != zeroR

    add-commutative :
      (x y : R) ->
      add x y == add y x
    add-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      add (add x y) z == add x (add y z)
    add-zero :
      (x : R) ->
      add x zeroR == x
    add-inverse :
      (x : R) ->
      add x (negate x) == zeroR

    multiply-commutative :
      (x y : R) ->
      multiply x y == multiply y x
    multiply-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply (multiply x y) z ==
      multiply x (multiply y z)
    multiply-one :
      (x : R) ->
      multiply x oneR == x
    multiply-zero :
      (x : R) ->
      multiply x zeroR == zeroR
    distribute :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply x (add y z) ==
      add (multiply x y) (multiply x z)
    inverse-zero :
      inverse zeroR == zeroR
    multiply-inverse :
      (x : R) ->
      x != zeroR ->
      multiply x (inverse x) == oneR

    order-reflexive :
      (x : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x x
    order-transitive :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y z ->
      lessOrEqual x z
    order-antisymmetric :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y x ->
      x == y
    order-total :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y or lessOrEqual y x
    add-order :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual (add z x) (add z y)
    multiply-nonnegative :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR x ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR y ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR (multiply x y)
    zero-less-than-one :
      lessOrEqual zeroR oneR and zeroR != oneR

    fromNat-zero :
      fromNat zero == zeroR
    fromNat-successor :
      (n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (suc n) == add (fromNat n) oneR
    fromNat-addition :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m + n) == add (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-multiplication :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m * n) == multiply (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-injective :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat m == fromNat n ->
      m == n

    archimedean :
      (x : R) ->
      Exists Nat
        (\ n ->
          lessOrEqual x (fromNat n))

    least-upper-bound :
      (P : R -> Set) ->
      Exists R P ->
      Exists R
        (\ upper ->
          (x : R) ->
          P x ->
          lessOrEqual x upper) ->
      Exists R
        (\ supremum ->
          ((x : R) ->
            P x ->
            lessOrEqual x supremum)
          and
          ((upper : R) ->
            ((x : R) ->
              P x ->
              lessOrEqual x upper) ->
            lessOrEqual supremum upper))

open CompleteOrderedRealField

subtract :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
subtract reals x y =
  add reals x (negate reals y)

divide :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
divide reals x y =
  multiply reals x (inverse reals y)

StrictLess :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
StrictLess reals x y =
  lessOrEqual reals x y and x != y

CloseTo :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
CloseTo reals center radius x =
  StrictLess reals
    (subtract reals center radius)
    x
  and
  StrictLess reals
    x
    (add reals center radius)

naturalPower :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  Nat ->
  R
naturalPower reals x zero =
  oneR reals
naturalPower reals x (suc n) =
  multiply reals
    (naturalPower reals x n)
    x

factorial : Nat -> Nat
factorial zero =
  suc zero
factorial (suc n) =
  suc n * factorial n

sumFirst :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Nat ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  R
sumFirst reals zero terms =
  zeroR reals
sumFirst reals (suc n) terms =
  add reals
    (sumFirst reals n terms)
    (terms n)

ConvergesTo :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  R ->
  Set
ConvergesTo {R} reals sequence limit =
  (epsilon : R) ->
  StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) epsilon ->
  Exists Nat
    (\ cutoff ->
      (n : Nat) ->
      cutoff <=N n ->
      CloseTo reals limit epsilon (sequence n))

exponentialTerm :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  Nat ->
  R
exponentialTerm reals x n =
  divide reals
    (naturalPower reals x n)
    (fromNat reals (factorial n))

ExponentialValue :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
ExponentialValue reals x value =
  ConvergesTo reals
    (\ n ->
      sumFirst reals n
        (exponentialTerm reals x))
    value

record StandardRealPowers
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) :
  Set1 where

  field
    exponential logarithm : R -> R

    exponential-series :
      (x : R) ->
      ExponentialValue reals x (exponential x)

    exponential-positive :
      (x : R) ->
      StrictLess reals
        (zeroR reals)
        (exponential x)

    exponential-injective :
      (x y : R) ->
      exponential x == exponential y ->
      x == y

    exponential-logarithm :
      (x : R) ->
      StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) x ->
      exponential (logarithm x) == x

open StandardRealPowers

realPower :
  {R : Set} ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) ->
  StandardRealPowers reals ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
realPower reals powers base exponent =
  exponential powers
    (multiply reals
      exponent
      (logarithm powers base))

RightLimitAtZero :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (R -> R) ->
  R ->
  Set
RightLimitAtZero {R} reals function limit =
  (epsilon : R) ->
  StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) epsilon ->
  Exists R
    (\ delta ->
      StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) delta
      and
      ((r : R) ->
        StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) r ->
        StrictLess reals r delta ->
        CloseTo reals limit epsilon (function r)))

LimitAtPositiveInfinity :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (R -> R) ->
  R ->
  Set
LimitAtPositiveInfinity {R} reals function limit =
  (epsilon : R) ->
  StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) epsilon ->
  Exists R
    (\ threshold ->
      (x : R) ->
      lessOrEqual reals threshold x ->
      CloseTo reals limit epsilon (function x))

module Putnam2021A2Statement
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R)
  (powers : StandardRealPowers reals) where

  definingExpression :
    R ->
    R ->
    R
  definingExpression x r =
    realPower reals powers
      (subtract reals
        (realPower reals powers
          (add reals x (oneR reals))
          (add reals r (oneR reals)))
        (realPower reals powers
          x
          (add reals r (oneR reals))))
      (divide reals (oneR reals) r)

  proposition : Set
  proposition =
    (g : R -> R) ->
    ((x : R) ->
      StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) x ->
      RightLimitAtZero reals
        (definingExpression x)
        (g x)) ->
    LimitAtPositiveInfinity reals
      (\ x ->
        divide reals (g x) x)
      (exponential powers (oneR reals))

putnam-2021-a2 : Set1
putnam-2021-a2 =
  (R : Set) ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) ->
  (powers : StandardRealPowers reals) ->
  Putnam2021A2Statement.proposition reals powers

title: putnam_2021_a2

(*
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2021_a2:
  the right-hand defining limit for a positive-real function g implies that
  g(x) / x tends to exp 1 as x tends to positive infinity. This file contains
  no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open pred_setTheory realTheory real_topologyTheory limTheory transcTheory;

val putnam_2021_a2 =
  ``!g : real -> real.
      (!x : real.
         0 < x
         ==>
         ((\r : real.
             ((x + 1) powr (r + 1) - x powr (r + 1)) powr (1 / r)) -->
          g x)
           (at 0 within {r : real | 0 < r}))
      ==>
      ((\x : real. g x / x) --> exp 1) at_posinfinity``;

title: putnam_2021_a2
content:
$(
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact
  putnam_2021_a2: evaluation as exp(1) of the positive-infinity limit of
  g(x)/x, where g(x) is defined by the stated right-hand real-power limit
  at zero. This file contains no proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  The function g ranges over all total real-valued functions. For every
  positive real x, the antecedent expands the right-hand limit at zero into
  its epsilon-delta definition, keeping epsilon, delta, and the approaching
  variable r internally quantified.

  When x > 0 and r > 0, x + 1 and x are positive, r + 1 is positive, and
  (x+1)^(r+1) - x^(r+1) is positive. Hence set.mm's complex-power operation
  ^c is real-valued and agrees with the source real-power operation at every
  point used by the one-sided limit. The relation ~~>r is set.mm's finite
  real limit at positive infinity, so the conclusion directly states that
  g(x)/x tends to exp(1).

  The final declaration is the single unproved $a corpus statement; this
  database contains no $p proof declaration.
$)

${
  $d d e g r x $.

  putnambench-putnam-2021-a2 $a |-
    A. g e. ( RR ^m RR )
      (
        (
          A. x e. RR
            (
              0 < x
              ->
              A. e e. RR
                (
                  0 < e
                  ->
                  E. d e. RR
                    (
                      0 < d
                      /\
                      A. r e. RR
                        (
                          (
                            0 < r
                            /\
                            r < d
                          )
                          ->
                          (
                            abs
                            `
                            (
                              (
                                (
                                  (
                                    ( x + 1 )
                                    ^c
                                    ( r + 1 )
                                  )
                                  -
                                  ( x ^c ( r + 1 ) )
                                )
                                ^c
                                ( 1 / r )
                              )
                              -
                              ( g ` x )
                            )
                          )
                          < e
                        )
                    )
                )
            )
        )
        ->
        (
          x e. RR |->
            ( ( g ` x ) / x )
        )
        ~~>r
        ( exp ` 1 )
      )
  $.
$}

            |.((((x + 1) to_power (r + 1)) -
                (x to_power (r + 1))) to_power (1 / r)) - g.x.| <

end;

title: putnam_2021_a2
content:
% Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2021_a2:
% the right-hand real-power limit defining g on positive reals implies that
% g(x) / x tends to Euler's number as x tends to positive infinity. This file
% contains no proof.

putnam_2021_a2: THEORY
BEGIN
  real_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> real]
  real_function: TYPE = [real -> real]

  safe_div(numerator, denominator: real): real =
    IF denominator = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      numerator / denominator
    ENDIF

  nat_factorial(index: nat): RECURSIVE nat =
    IF index = 0 THEN
      1
    ELSE
      index * nat_factorial(index - 1)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE index

  exponential_partial(x: real, count: nat): RECURSIVE real =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      LET index: nat = count - 1 IN
        exponential_partial(x, count - 1)
          + safe_div(
              x ^ index,
              nat_factorial(index) :: real)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  converges_to(sequence: real_sequence, value: real): bool =
    FORALL (epsilon_value: posreal):
      EXISTS (cutoff: nat):
        FORALL (index: nat):
          cutoff <= index IMPLIES
            abs(sequence(index) - value) < epsilon_value

  real_exponential(x: real): real =
    epsilon(
      LAMBDA (value: real):
        converges_to(
          LAMBDA (count: nat):
            exponential_partial(x, count),
          value))

  natural_log(x: real): real =
    IF x > 0 THEN
      epsilon(
        LAMBDA (value: real):
          real_exponential(value) = x)
    ELSE
      0
    ENDIF

  real_power(base, exponent: real): real =
    IF base > 0 THEN
      real_exponential(exponent * natural_log(base))
    ELSIF base = 0 AND exponent = 0 THEN
      1
    ELSE
      0
    ENDIF

  right_tends_to_at(
      f: real_function,
      limit, point: real): bool =
    FORALL (epsilon_value: posreal):
      EXISTS (delta: posreal):
        FORALL (x: real):
          (0 < x - point AND x - point < delta)
            IMPLIES abs(f(x) - limit) < epsilon_value

  tends_to_at_positive_infinity(
      f: real_function,
      limit: real): bool =
    FORALL (epsilon_value: posreal):
      EXISTS (threshold: real):
        FORALL (x: real):
          threshold <= x IMPLIES
            abs(f(x) - limit) < epsilon_value

  defining_expression(x: real): real_function =
    LAMBDA (r: real):
      real_power(
        real_power(x + 1, r + 1)
          - real_power(x, r + 1),
        safe_div(1, r))

  putnam_2021_a2_solution: real =
    real_exponential(1)

  putnam_2021_a2: bool =
    FORALL (g: real_function):
      (FORALL (x: real):
        x > 0 IMPLIES
          right_tends_to_at(
            defining_expression(x),
            g(x),
            0))
      IMPLIES
        tends_to_at_positive_infinity(
          LAMBDA (x: real):
            safe_div(g(x), x),
          putnam_2021_a2_solution)
END putnam_2021_a2

(* Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2021_a3:
   the positive integers N for which the sphere x^2 + y^2 + z^2 = N
   contains an inscribed regular tetrahedron with integer-coordinate vertices.
   This file contains no proof. *)

From Stdlib Require Import Arith.PeanoNat ZArith.ZArith.

Open Scope Z_scope.

Definition putnam_2021_a3_point : Type := (Z * (Z * Z))%type.

Definition putnam_2021_a3_x (p : putnam_2021_a3_point) : Z :=
  fst p.

Definition putnam_2021_a3_y (p : putnam_2021_a3_point) : Z :=
  fst (snd p).

Definition putnam_2021_a3_z (p : putnam_2021_a3_point) : Z :=
  snd (snd p).

Definition putnam_2021_a3_sqnorm
    (p : putnam_2021_a3_point) : Z :=
  putnam_2021_a3_x p ^ 2 +
  putnam_2021_a3_y p ^ 2 +
  putnam_2021_a3_z p ^ 2.

Definition putnam_2021_a3_on_sphere
    (N : nat) (p : putnam_2021_a3_point) : Prop :=
  putnam_2021_a3_sqnorm p = Z.of_nat N.

Definition putnam_2021_a3_sqdist
    (p q : putnam_2021_a3_point) : Z :=
  (putnam_2021_a3_x p - putnam_2021_a3_x q) ^ 2 +
  (putnam_2021_a3_y p - putnam_2021_a3_y q) ^ 2 +
  (putnam_2021_a3_z p - putnam_2021_a3_z q) ^ 2.

Definition putnam_2021_a3_regular
    (A B C D : putnam_2021_a3_point) : Prop :=
  0 < putnam_2021_a3_sqdist A B /\
  putnam_2021_a3_sqdist A C = putnam_2021_a3_sqdist A B /\
  putnam_2021_a3_sqdist A D = putnam_2021_a3_sqdist A B /\
  putnam_2021_a3_sqdist B C = putnam_2021_a3_sqdist A B /\
  putnam_2021_a3_sqdist B D = putnam_2021_a3_sqdist A B /\
  putnam_2021_a3_sqdist C D = putnam_2021_a3_sqdist A B.

Definition putnam_2021_a3_has_tetrahedron (N : nat) : Prop :=
  exists A B C D : putnam_2021_a3_point,
    putnam_2021_a3_on_sphere N A /\
    putnam_2021_a3_on_sphere N B /\
    putnam_2021_a3_on_sphere N C /\
    putnam_2021_a3_on_sphere N D /\
    putnam_2021_a3_regular A B C D.

Definition putnam_2021_a3_solution (N : nat) : Prop :=
  exists m : nat,
    (0 < m)%nat /\
    N = (3 * m ^ 2)%nat.

Theorem putnam_2021_a3 :
  forall N : nat,
    ((0 < N)%nat /\ putnam_2021_a3_has_tetrahedron N) <->
    putnam_2021_a3_solution N.
Admitted.

;; Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2021_a3:
;; the positive integers N whose sphere x^2+y^2+z^2=N contains an
;; integer-coordinate regular tetrahedron are exactly N=3*m^2 for m>0.
;; This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

;; ACL2 has no primitive existential term, so DEFUN-SK below provides the
;; community-standard first-order encoding of the source's unbounded
;; existential quantifiers. A point is represented by a length-three list of
;; integer coordinates.

(defun putnam-2021-a3-sphere-point-p (p n)
  (and
   (true-listp p)
   (equal (len p) 3)
   (integerp (car p))
   (integerp (cadr p))
   (integerp (caddr p))
   (equal
    (+ (* (car p) (car p))
       (* (cadr p) (cadr p))
       (* (caddr p) (caddr p)))
    n)))

(defun putnam-2021-a3-squared-distance (p q)
  (+ (* (- (car p) (car q))
        (- (car p) (car q)))
     (* (- (cadr p) (cadr q))
        (- (cadr p) (cadr q)))
     (* (- (caddr p) (caddr q))
        (- (caddr p) (caddr q)))))

;; For integer-coordinate points, six Euclidean distances are one common
;; positive real number exactly when their six squared distances are one
;; common positive integer.
(defun putnam-2021-a3-regular-tetrahedron-p (a b c d)
  (let ((side-square
         (putnam-2021-a3-squared-distance a b)))
    (and
     (< 0 side-square)
     (equal (putnam-2021-a3-squared-distance a c)
            side-square)
     (equal (putnam-2021-a3-squared-distance a d)
            side-square)
     (equal (putnam-2021-a3-squared-distance b c)
            side-square)
     (equal (putnam-2021-a3-squared-distance b d)
            side-square)
     (equal (putnam-2021-a3-squared-distance c d)
            side-square))))

(defun-sk putnam-2021-a3-tetrahedron-exists-p (n)
  (exists
   (a b c d)
   (and
    (putnam-2021-a3-sphere-point-p a n)
    (putnam-2021-a3-sphere-point-p b n)
    (putnam-2021-a3-sphere-point-p c n)
    (putnam-2021-a3-sphere-point-p d n)
    (putnam-2021-a3-regular-tetrahedron-p a b c d))))

(defun-sk putnam-2021-a3-solution-member-p (n)
  (exists
   (m)
   (and
    (integerp m)
    (< 0 m)
    (equal n (* 3 m m)))))

;; The root predicate is universally closed over N by the ACL2
;; statement-corpus convention. Nsphere and intcoords from the source are
;; definitionally eliminated by the exact integer-coordinate sphere predicate.
(defun putnambench-putnam-2021-a3-statement (n)
  (implies
   (natp n)
   (equal
    (and
     (< 0 n)
     (putnam-2021-a3-tetrahedron-exists-p n))
    (putnam-2021-a3-solution-member-p n))))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

-- Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2021_a3:
-- positive integers whose corresponding sphere contains an integer-coordinate
-- regular tetrahedron are exactly the numbers 3 times a positive square.
-- This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module Putnam2021A3 where

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Int using (Int; pos; negsuc)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; _*_)

infix 4 _<N_
infixr 3 _and_

record _and_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

record Iff (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor equivalence
  field
    forward  : A -> B
    backward : B -> A

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

data _<N_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set where
  zero<sucN : {n : Nat} -> zero <N suc n
  suc<sucN  : {m n : Nat} -> m <N n -> suc m <N suc n

absoluteDifference : Nat -> Nat -> Nat
absoluteDifference zero n =
  n
absoluteDifference m zero =
  m
absoluteDifference (suc m) (suc n) =
  absoluteDifference m n

absoluteIntegerDifference : Int -> Int -> Nat
absoluteIntegerDifference (pos m) (pos n) =
  absoluteDifference m n
absoluteIntegerDifference (pos m) (negsuc n) =
  suc (m + n)
absoluteIntegerDifference (negsuc m) (pos n) =
  suc (m + n)
absoluteIntegerDifference (negsuc m) (negsuc n) =
  absoluteDifference m n

integerSquare : Int -> Nat
integerSquare (pos magnitude) =
  magnitude * magnitude
integerSquare (negsuc predecessor) =
  suc predecessor * suc predecessor

record Point3 : Set where
  constructor point3
  field
    x-coordinate : Int
    y-coordinate : Int
    z-coordinate : Int

open Point3

squaredNorm : Point3 -> Nat
squaredNorm p =
  integerSquare (x-coordinate p) +
  (integerSquare (y-coordinate p) +
   integerSquare (z-coordinate p))

squaredDistance : Point3 -> Point3 -> Nat
squaredDistance p q =
  let
    x-difference =
      absoluteIntegerDifference
        (x-coordinate p)
        (x-coordinate q)
    y-difference =
      absoluteIntegerDifference
        (y-coordinate p)
        (y-coordinate q)
    z-difference =
      absoluteIntegerDifference
        (z-coordinate p)
        (z-coordinate q)
  in
  x-difference * x-difference +
  (y-difference * y-difference +
   z-difference * z-difference)

OnSphere : Nat -> Point3 -> Set
OnSphere N p =
  squaredNorm p == N

RegularTetrahedron : Point3 -> Point3 -> Point3 -> Point3 -> Set
RegularTetrahedron A B C D =
  Exists Nat
    (\ common-squared-edge ->
      zero <N common-squared-edge
      and
      squaredDistance A B == common-squared-edge
      and
      squaredDistance A C == common-squared-edge
      and
      squaredDistance A D == common-squared-edge
      and
      squaredDistance B C == common-squared-edge
      and
      squaredDistance B D == common-squared-edge
      and
      squaredDistance C D == common-squared-edge)

HasInscribedIntegerRegularTetrahedron : Nat -> Set
HasInscribedIntegerRegularTetrahedron N =
  Exists Point3
    (\ A ->
      Exists Point3
        (\ B ->
          Exists Point3
            (\ C ->
              Exists Point3
                (\ D ->
                  OnSphere N A
                  and
                  OnSphere N B
                  and
                  OnSphere N C
                  and
                  OnSphere N D
                  and
                  RegularTetrahedron A B C D))))

three : Nat
three =
  suc (suc (suc zero))

Solution : Nat -> Set
Solution N =
  Exists Nat
    (\ m ->
      zero <N m
      and
      N == three * (m * m))

putnam-2021-a3 : Set
putnam-2021-a3 =
  (N : Nat) ->
  Iff
    (zero <N N and HasInscribedIntegerRegularTetrahedron N)
    (Solution N)

  the positive integers whose corresponding sphere in real three-space has an
  inscribed regular tetrahedron with integer-coordinate vertices are exactly
  three times a positive square. This file contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open arithmeticTheory integerTheory pairTheory realTheory intrealTheory
     transcTheory;

val putnam_2021_a3 =
  ``let coord =
      \P : real # (real # real).
      \i : num.
        if i = 0 then FST P
        else if i = 1 then FST (SND P)
        else SND (SND P)
    in
    let on_sphere =
      \N : num.
      \P : real # (real # real).
        (coord P 0) pow 2 +
        (coord P 1) pow 2 +
        (coord P 2) pow 2 = &N
    in
    let integer_coords =
      \P : real # (real # real).
        ?x y z : int.
          coord P 0 = real_of_int x /\
          coord P 1 = real_of_int y /\
          coord P 2 = real_of_int z
    in
    let dist =
      \P Q : real # (real # real).
        sqrt
          (((coord P 0 - coord Q 0) pow 2) +
           ((coord P 1 - coord Q 1) pow 2) +
           ((coord P 2 - coord Q 2) pow 2))
    in
    let has_integer_regular_tetrahedron =
      \N : num.
        ?A B C D : real # (real # real).
          on_sphere N A /\
          on_sphere N B /\
          on_sphere N C /\
          on_sphere N D /\
          integer_coords A /\
          integer_coords B /\
          integer_coords C /\
          integer_coords D /\
          ?s : real.
            0 < s /\
            dist A B = s /\
            dist A C = s /\
            dist A D = s /\
            dist B C = s /\
            dist B D = s /\
            dist C D = s
    in
    let solution =
      {n : num | ?m : num. 0 < m /\ n = 3 * m EXP 2}
    in
      !N : num.
        (0 < N /\ has_integer_regular_tetrahedron N) <=>
        N IN solution``;

% Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2021_a3:
% positive integers whose radius-squared spheres contain an integer-coordinate
% regular tetrahedron are exactly three times a positive square. This file
% contains no proof.

putnam_2021_a3: THEORY
BEGIN
  point: TYPE =
    [# x_coord: real, y_coord: real, z_coord: real #]

  integer_point(P: point): bool =
    EXISTS (x, y, z: int):
      x_coord(P) = (x :: real)
        AND y_coord(P) = (y :: real)
        AND z_coord(P) = (z :: real)

  squared_norm(P: point): real =
    x_coord(P) ^ 2 + y_coord(P) ^ 2 + z_coord(P) ^ 2

  squared_distance(P, Q: point): real =
    (x_coord(P) - x_coord(Q)) ^ 2
      + (y_coord(P) - y_coord(Q)) ^ 2
      + (z_coord(P) - z_coord(Q)) ^ 2

  on_sphere(N: nat, P: point): bool =
    squared_norm(P) = (N :: real)

  integer_regular_tetrahedron(N: nat): bool =
    EXISTS (A, B, C, D: point), (side_squared: real):
      on_sphere(N, A)
        AND on_sphere(N, B)
        AND on_sphere(N, C)
        AND on_sphere(N, D)
        AND integer_point(A)
        AND integer_point(B)
        AND integer_point(C)
        AND integer_point(D)
        AND side_squared > 0
        AND squared_distance(A, B) = side_squared
        AND squared_distance(A, C) = side_squared
        AND squared_distance(A, D) = side_squared
        AND squared_distance(B, C) = side_squared
        AND squared_distance(B, D) = side_squared
        AND squared_distance(C, D) = side_squared

  putnam_2021_a3_solution(N: nat): bool =
    EXISTS (m: nat):
      m > 0 AND N = 3 * m ^ 2

  putnam_2021_a3: bool =
    FORALL (N: nat):
      (N > 0 AND integer_regular_tetrahedron(N))
        IFF putnam_2021_a3_solution(N)
END putnam_2021_a3

import Mathlib

open Filter Topology Metric

noncomputable abbrev putnam_2021_a4_solution : ℝ := sorry
-- ((Real.sqrt 2) / 2) * Real.pi * Real.log 2
/--
Let
\[
I(R) = \iint_{x^2+y^2 \leq R^2} \left( \frac{1+2x^2}{1+x^4+6x^2y^2+y^4} - \frac{1+y^2}{2+x^4+y^4} \right)\,dx\,dy.
\]
Find
\[
\lim_{R \to \infty} I(R),
\]
or show that this limit does not exist.
-/
theorem putnam_2021_a4
  (S : ℝ → Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)))
  (hS : S = fun R => ball (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) R)
  (I : ℝ → ℝ)
  (hI : I = fun R => ∫ p in S R,
    (1 + 2*(p 0)^2)/(1 + (p 0)^4 + 6*(p 0)^2*(p 1)^2 + (p 1)^4) - (1 + (p 1)^2)/(2 + (p 0)^4 + (p 1)^4)) :
  Tendsto I atTop (𝓝 putnam_2021_a4_solution) :=
sorry

Definition putnam_2021_a4_solution := (sqrt 2 / 2) * PI * ln 2.
Theorem putnam_2021_a4

                (1 + x ^ 4 + 6 * x ^ 2 * y ^ 2 + y ^ 4) -

"HOL-Analysis.Set_Integral"
"HOL-Analysis.Lebesgue_Measure"
begin

definition putnam_2021_a4_solution :: real where "putnam_2021_a4_solution \<equiv> undefined"
(* ((sqrt 2)/2) * pi * ln 2 *)
theorem putnam_2021_a4:
  fixes S :: "real \<Rightarrow> ((real^2) set)"
  and I :: "real \<Rightarrow> real"
  assumes "S \<equiv> (\<lambda>R::real. {p::real^2. (p$1)^2 + (p$2)^2 \<le> R^2})"
  and "I \<equiv> (\<lambda>R::real. set_lebesgue_integral lebesgue (S R)
  (\<lambda>p::real^2. (1 + 2*(p$1)^2)/(1 + (p$1)^4 + 6*(p$1)^2*(p$2)^2 + (p$2)^4) - (1 + (p$2)^2)/(2 + (p$1)^4 + (p$2)^4)))"
  shows "filterlim I (nhds putnam_2021_a4_solution) at_top"
  sorry

end

(*

  (putnambench__hol-light__putnam_2021_a4): the limit at positive infinity
  of a two-dimensional rational-function integral over a disk. This file
  contains no proof.
*)

let analysis_output = open_out "/dev/null";;
let analysis_formatter = Format.formatter_of_out_channel analysis_output;;
let analysis_loaded =
  Toploop.use_file analysis_formatter "Library/transc.ml";;
Format.pp_print_flush analysis_formatter ();;
close_out analysis_output;;
if not analysis_loaded then failwith "failed to load Library/transc.ml";;

let statement =
  `let integrand =
     \(x:real) (y:real).
       (&1 + &2 * x pow 2) /
       (&1 + x pow 4 + &6 * x pow 2 * y pow 2 + y pow 4) -
       (&1 + y pow 2) /
       (&2 + x pow 4 + y pow 4) in
   let I =
     \R:real.
       integral(--(abs R),abs R)
         (\x:real.
            integral
              (--(sqrt (R pow 2 - x pow 2)),
               sqrt (R pow 2 - x pow 2))
              (\y:real. integrand x y)) in
   let tends_at_posinfinity =
     \(f:real->real) (l:real).
       !e:real.
         &0 < e
         ==> ?B:real.
               !R:real.
                 B <= R ==> abs (f R - l) < e in
   tends_at_posinfinity
     I
     ((sqrt (&2) / &2) * pi * ln (&2))`;;

title: putnam_2021_a4
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2021_a4:
;; the limit of a rational-function integral over expanding disks in the real
;; plane is (sqrt(2)/2) * pi * ln(2). This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))

;; A tame APPLY$ presentation of a Dedekind-complete ordered field represents
;; the reals.  The named constants are fixed by the principal-square-root
;; condition and convergent series for pi and ln(2).  Uniform square-grid
;; Riemann sums with the disk indicator define the displayed two-dimensional
;; integral; for this continuous rational integrand they equal its disk
;; Lebesgue integral, and open versus closed disks have the same value.

(defun p21a4-member-p (carrier x)
  (if (apply$ carrier (list x)) t nil))

(defun p21a4-unary-value (function x)
  (apply$ function (list x)))

(defun p21a4-binary-value (function x y)
  (apply$ function (list x y)))

(defun-sk p21a4-valid-set-p (carrier set)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (apply$ set (list x))
     (p21a4-member-p carrier x))))

(defun-sk p21a4-real-function-p (carrier function)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (p21a4-member-p carrier x)
     (p21a4-member-p
      carrier
      (p21a4-unary-value function x)))))

(defun-sk p21a4-field-laws-p
    (carrier add multiply negate inverse zero one)
  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (p21a4-member-p carrier x)
      (p21a4-member-p carrier y)
      (p21a4-member-p carrier z))
     (and
      (p21a4-member-p carrier
                      (p21a4-binary-value add x y))
      (p21a4-member-p carrier
                      (p21a4-binary-value multiply x y))
      (p21a4-member-p carrier
                      (p21a4-unary-value negate x))
      (p21a4-member-p carrier
                      (p21a4-unary-value inverse x))
      (equal
       (p21a4-binary-value
        add (p21a4-binary-value add x y) z)
       (p21a4-binary-value
        add x (p21a4-binary-value add y z)))
      (equal
       (p21a4-binary-value add x y)
       (p21a4-binary-value add y x))
      (equal (p21a4-binary-value add x zero) x)
      (equal
       (p21a4-binary-value
        add x (p21a4-unary-value negate x))
       zero)
      (equal
       (p21a4-binary-value
        multiply (p21a4-binary-value multiply x y) z)
       (p21a4-binary-value
        multiply x (p21a4-binary-value multiply y z)))
      (equal
       (p21a4-binary-value multiply x y)
       (p21a4-binary-value multiply y x))
      (equal (p21a4-binary-value multiply x one) x)
      (implies
       (equal x zero)
       (equal (p21a4-unary-value inverse x) zero))
      (implies
       (not (equal x zero))
       (equal
        (p21a4-binary-value
         multiply x (p21a4-unary-value inverse x))
        one))
      (equal
       (p21a4-binary-value
        multiply x (p21a4-binary-value add y z))
       (p21a4-binary-value
        add
        (p21a4-binary-value multiply x y)
        (p21a4-binary-value multiply x z)))))))

(defun-sk p21a4-order-laws-p
    (carrier add multiply zero less)
  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (p21a4-member-p carrier x)
      (p21a4-member-p carrier y)
      (p21a4-member-p carrier z))
     (and
      (not (p21a4-binary-value less x x))
      (or
       (equal x y)
       (p21a4-binary-value less x y)
       (p21a4-binary-value less y x))
      (implies
       (and
        (p21a4-binary-value less x y)
        (p21a4-binary-value less y z))
       (p21a4-binary-value less x z))
      (implies
       (p21a4-binary-value less x y)
       (p21a4-binary-value
        less
        (p21a4-binary-value add x z)
        (p21a4-binary-value add y z)))
      (implies
       (and
        (p21a4-binary-value less zero x)
        (p21a4-binary-value less zero y))
       (p21a4-binary-value
        less zero (p21a4-binary-value multiply x y)))))))

(defun-sk p21a4-set-nonempty-p (carrier set)
  (exists (x)
    (and
     (p21a4-member-p carrier x)
     (apply$ set (list x)))))

(defun-sk p21a4-upper-bound-p (carrier less set bound)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (and
      (p21a4-member-p carrier x)
      (apply$ set (list x)))
     (not (p21a4-binary-value less bound x)))))

(defun-sk p21a4-bounded-above-p (carrier less set)
  (exists (bound)
    (and
     (p21a4-member-p carrier bound)
     (p21a4-upper-bound-p carrier less set bound))))

(defun-sk p21a4-least-upper-bound-p
    (carrier less set supremum)
  (forall (bound)
    (implies
     (and
      (p21a4-member-p carrier bound)
      (p21a4-upper-bound-p carrier less set bound))
     (not (p21a4-binary-value less bound supremum)))))

(defun p21a4-supremum-p (carrier less set supremum)
  (and
   (p21a4-member-p carrier supremum)
   (p21a4-upper-bound-p carrier less set supremum)
   (p21a4-least-upper-bound-p
    carrier less set supremum)))

(defun-sk p21a4-has-supremum-p (carrier less set)
  (exists (supremum)
    (p21a4-supremum-p carrier less set supremum)))

(defun-sk p21a4-dedekind-complete-p (carrier less)
  (forall (set)
    (implies
     (and
      (tamep-functionp set)
      (p21a4-valid-set-p carrier set)
      (p21a4-set-nonempty-p carrier set)
      (p21a4-bounded-above-p carrier less set))
     (p21a4-has-supremum-p carrier less set))))

(defun p21a4-real-field-p
    (carrier zero one add multiply negate inverse less)
  (and
   (tamep-functionp carrier)
   (tamep-functionp add)
   (tamep-functionp multiply)
   (tamep-functionp negate)
   (tamep-functionp inverse)
   (tamep-functionp less)
   (p21a4-member-p carrier zero)
   (p21a4-member-p carrier one)
   (not (equal zero one))
   (p21a4-field-laws-p
    carrier add multiply negate inverse zero one)
   (p21a4-order-laws-p
    carrier add multiply zero less)
   (p21a4-binary-value less zero one)
   (p21a4-dedekind-complete-p carrier less)))

;; CTX is (carrier zero one add multiply negate inverse less
;;         sqrt-two pi-value ln-two).

(defun p21a4-carrier (ctx) (nth 0 ctx))
(defun p21a4-zero (ctx) (nth 1 ctx))
(defun p21a4-one (ctx) (nth 2 ctx))
(defun p21a4-add (ctx) (nth 3 ctx))
(defun p21a4-multiply (ctx) (nth 4 ctx))
(defun p21a4-negate (ctx) (nth 5 ctx))
(defun p21a4-inverse (ctx) (nth 6 ctx))
(defun p21a4-less (ctx) (nth 7 ctx))
(defun p21a4-sqrt-two (ctx) (nth 8 ctx))
(defun p21a4-pi-value (ctx) (nth 9 ctx))
(defun p21a4-ln-two (ctx) (nth 10 ctx))

(defun p21a4-r-add (ctx x y)
  (p21a4-binary-value (p21a4-add ctx) x y))

(defun p21a4-r-neg (ctx x)
  (p21a4-unary-value (p21a4-negate ctx) x))

(defun p21a4-r-sub (ctx x y)
  (p21a4-r-add ctx x (p21a4-r-neg ctx y)))

(defun p21a4-r-mul (ctx x y)
  (p21a4-binary-value (p21a4-multiply ctx) x y))

(defun p21a4-r-inv (ctx x)
  (p21a4-unary-value (p21a4-inverse ctx) x))

(defun p21a4-r-div (ctx x y)
  (p21a4-r-mul ctx x (p21a4-r-inv ctx y)))

(defun p21a4-r-lt-p (ctx x y)
  (if (p21a4-binary-value (p21a4-less ctx) x y) t nil))

(defun p21a4-r-le-p (ctx x y)
  (not (p21a4-r-lt-p ctx y x)))

(defun p21a4-r-abs (ctx x)
  (if (p21a4-r-lt-p ctx x (p21a4-zero ctx))
      (p21a4-r-neg ctx x)
    x))

(defun p21a4-positive-p (ctx x)
  (and
   (p21a4-member-p (p21a4-carrier ctx) x)
   (p21a4-r-lt-p ctx (p21a4-zero ctx) x)))

(defun p21a4-r-nat (ctx n)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix n)))
  (if (zp n)
      (p21a4-zero ctx)
    (p21a4-r-add
     ctx
     (p21a4-one ctx)
     (p21a4-r-nat ctx (1- n)))))

(defun p21a4-r-pow (ctx x n)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix n)))
  (if (zp n)
      (p21a4-one ctx)
    (p21a4-r-mul
     ctx x (p21a4-r-pow ctx x (1- n)))))

;; Exact series names for pi (Machin's formula) and ln(2).

(defun p21a4-arctan-prefix (ctx z terms)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix terms)))
  (if (zp terms)
      (p21a4-zero ctx)
    (let* ((index (1- terms))
           (exponent (+ (* 2 index) 1))
           (term
            (p21a4-r-div
             ctx
             (p21a4-r-pow ctx z exponent)
             (p21a4-r-nat ctx exponent))))
      (p21a4-r-add
       ctx
       (p21a4-arctan-prefix ctx z index)
       (if (evenp index) term (p21a4-r-neg ctx term))))))

(defun p21a4-pi-prefix (ctx terms)
  (let* ((one-fifth
          (p21a4-r-inv ctx (p21a4-r-nat ctx 5)))
         (one-over-239
          (p21a4-r-inv ctx (p21a4-r-nat ctx 239))))
    (p21a4-r-sub
     ctx
     (p21a4-r-mul
      ctx
      (p21a4-r-nat ctx 16)
      (p21a4-arctan-prefix ctx one-fifth terms))
     (p21a4-r-mul
      ctx
      (p21a4-r-nat ctx 4)
      (p21a4-arctan-prefix ctx one-over-239 terms)))))

(defun p21a4-ln-two-prefix (ctx terms)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix terms)))
  (if (zp terms)
      (p21a4-zero ctx)
    (let* ((index (1- terms))
           (denominator (p21a4-r-nat ctx (1+ index)))
           (term (p21a4-r-inv ctx denominator)))
      (p21a4-r-add
       ctx
       (p21a4-ln-two-prefix ctx index)
       (if (evenp index) term (p21a4-r-neg ctx term))))))

(defun p21a4-named-prefix (ctx name terms)
  (if (eq name 'pi)
      (p21a4-pi-prefix ctx terms)
    (p21a4-ln-two-prefix ctx terms)))

(defun-sk p21a4-named-series-tail-p
    (ctx name value epsilon cutoff)
  (forall (terms)
    (implies
     (and
      (natp terms)
      (<= cutoff terms))
     (p21a4-r-lt-p
      ctx
      (p21a4-r-abs
       ctx
       (p21a4-r-sub
        ctx (p21a4-named-prefix ctx name terms) value))
      epsilon))))

(defun-sk p21a4-named-series-cutoff-exists-p
    (ctx name value epsilon)
  (exists (cutoff)
    (and
     (natp cutoff)
     (p21a4-named-series-tail-p
      ctx name value epsilon cutoff))))

(defun-sk p21a4-named-series-value-p (ctx name value)
  (forall (epsilon)
    (implies
     (p21a4-positive-p ctx epsilon)
     (p21a4-named-series-cutoff-exists-p
      ctx name value epsilon))))

(defun p21a4-sqrt-two-p (ctx)
  (and
   (p21a4-member-p
    (p21a4-carrier ctx) (p21a4-sqrt-two ctx))
   (p21a4-r-le-p
    ctx (p21a4-zero ctx) (p21a4-sqrt-two ctx))
   (equal
    (p21a4-r-mul
     ctx (p21a4-sqrt-two ctx) (p21a4-sqrt-two ctx))
    (p21a4-r-nat ctx 2))))

(defun p21a4-context-p (ctx)
  (and
   (true-listp ctx)
   (equal (len ctx) 11)
   (p21a4-real-field-p
    (p21a4-carrier ctx)
    (p21a4-zero ctx)
    (p21a4-one ctx)
    (p21a4-add ctx)
    (p21a4-multiply ctx)
    (p21a4-negate ctx)
    (p21a4-inverse ctx)
    (p21a4-less ctx))
   (p21a4-sqrt-two-p ctx)
   (p21a4-member-p
    (p21a4-carrier ctx) (p21a4-pi-value ctx))
   (p21a4-positive-p ctx (p21a4-pi-value ctx))
   (p21a4-named-series-value-p
    ctx 'pi (p21a4-pi-value ctx))
   (p21a4-member-p
    (p21a4-carrier ctx) (p21a4-ln-two ctx))
   (p21a4-positive-p ctx (p21a4-ln-two ctx))
   (p21a4-named-series-value-p
    ctx 'ln-two (p21a4-ln-two ctx))))

;; The displayed integrand and its disk Riemann sums.

(defun p21a4-integrand (ctx x y)
  (let* ((one (p21a4-one ctx))
         (two (p21a4-r-nat ctx 2))
         (six (p21a4-r-nat ctx 6))
         (x2 (p21a4-r-pow ctx x 2))
         (y2 (p21a4-r-pow ctx y 2))
         (x4 (p21a4-r-pow ctx x 4))
         (y4 (p21a4-r-pow ctx y 4))
         (first-numerator
          (p21a4-r-add
           ctx one (p21a4-r-mul ctx two x2)))
         (first-denominator
          (p21a4-r-add
           ctx
           (p21a4-r-add ctx one x4)
           (p21a4-r-add
            ctx
            (p21a4-r-mul
             ctx six (p21a4-r-mul ctx x2 y2))
            y4)))
         (second-numerator
          (p21a4-r-add ctx one y2))
         (second-denominator
          (p21a4-r-add
           ctx (p21a4-r-add ctx two x4) y4)))
    (p21a4-r-sub
     ctx
     (p21a4-r-div ctx first-numerator first-denominator)
     (p21a4-r-div ctx second-numerator second-denominator))))

(defun p21a4-grid-coordinate (ctx bound width index)
  (p21a4-r-add
   ctx
   (p21a4-r-neg ctx bound)
   (p21a4-r-mul ctx (p21a4-r-nat ctx index) width)))

(defun p21a4-grid-cell
    (ctx radius-square bound width row column)
  (let* ((x (p21a4-grid-coordinate ctx bound width row))
         (y (p21a4-grid-coordinate ctx bound width column))
         (distance-square
          (p21a4-r-add
           ctx
           (p21a4-r-pow ctx x 2)
           (p21a4-r-pow ctx y 2))))
    (if (p21a4-r-le-p ctx distance-square radius-square)
        (p21a4-r-mul
         ctx
         (p21a4-r-mul ctx width width)
         (p21a4-integrand ctx x y))
      (p21a4-zero ctx))))

(defun p21a4-grid-row-sum
    (ctx radius-square bound width row columns)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix columns)))
  (if (zp columns)
      (p21a4-zero ctx)
    (let ((column (1- columns)))
      (p21a4-r-add
       ctx
       (p21a4-grid-row-sum
        ctx radius-square bound width row column)
       (p21a4-grid-cell
        ctx radius-square bound width row column)))))

(defun p21a4-grid-sum-rows
    (ctx radius-square bound width subdivisions rows)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix rows)))
  (if (zp rows)
      (p21a4-zero ctx)
    (let ((row (1- rows)))
      (p21a4-r-add
       ctx
       (p21a4-grid-sum-rows
        ctx radius-square bound width subdivisions row)
       (p21a4-grid-row-sum
        ctx radius-square bound width row subdivisions)))))

(defun p21a4-grid-sum (ctx radius subdivisions)
  (if (posp subdivisions)
      (let* ((bound (p21a4-r-abs ctx radius))
             (diameter
              (p21a4-r-mul ctx (p21a4-r-nat ctx 2) bound))
             (width
              (p21a4-r-div
               ctx diameter (p21a4-r-nat ctx subdivisions)))
             (radius-square (p21a4-r-pow ctx radius 2)))
        (p21a4-grid-sum-rows
         ctx radius-square bound width subdivisions subdivisions))
    (p21a4-zero ctx)))

(defun-sk p21a4-integral-tail-p
    (ctx radius value epsilon cutoff)
  (forall (subdivisions)
    (implies
     (and
      (posp subdivisions)
      (<= cutoff subdivisions))
     (p21a4-r-lt-p
      ctx
      (p21a4-r-abs
       ctx
       (p21a4-r-sub
        ctx
        (p21a4-grid-sum ctx radius subdivisions)
        value))
      epsilon))))

(defun-sk p21a4-integral-cutoff-exists-p

title: putnam_2021_a4
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2021_a4
-- (putnambench__agda__putnam_2021_a4): the limit at positive infinity of a
-- rational-function integral over expanding real-plane disks. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module Main where

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; _*_)

infix 4 _!=_ _<=N_
infixr 3 _and_
infixr 2 _or_

data Bottom : Set where

Not : Set -> Set
Not A =
  A -> Bottom

_!=_ : {A : Set} -> A -> A -> Set
x != y =
  Not (x == y)

record _and_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data _or_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  left  : A -> A or B
  right : B -> A or B

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

data _<=N_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set where
  zero<=N   : {n : Nat} -> zero <=N n
  suc<=sucN : {m n : Nat} -> m <=N n -> suc m <=N suc n

record CompleteOrderedRealField (R : Set) : Set1 where
  field
    zeroR oneR : R
    add multiply : R -> R -> R
    negate inverse : R -> R
    lessOrEqual : R -> R -> Set
    fromNat : Nat -> R

    one-not-zero :
      oneR != zeroR

    add-commutative :
      (x y : R) ->
      add x y == add y x
    add-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      add (add x y) z == add x (add y z)
    add-zero :
      (x : R) ->
      add x zeroR == x
    add-inverse :
      (x : R) ->
      add x (negate x) == zeroR

    multiply-commutative :
      (x y : R) ->
      multiply x y == multiply y x
    multiply-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply (multiply x y) z ==
      multiply x (multiply y z)
    multiply-one :
      (x : R) ->
      multiply x oneR == x
    multiply-zero :
      (x : R) ->
      multiply x zeroR == zeroR
    distribute :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply x (add y z) ==
      add (multiply x y) (multiply x z)
    inverse-zero :
      inverse zeroR == zeroR
    multiply-inverse :
      (x : R) ->
      x != zeroR ->
      multiply x (inverse x) == oneR

    order-reflexive :
      (x : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x x
    order-transitive :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y z ->
      lessOrEqual x z
    order-antisymmetric :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y x ->
      x == y
    order-total :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y or lessOrEqual y x
    add-order :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual (add z x) (add z y)
    multiply-nonnegative :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR x ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR y ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR (multiply x y)
    zero-less-than-one :
      lessOrEqual zeroR oneR and zeroR != oneR

    fromNat-zero :
      fromNat zero == zeroR
    fromNat-successor :
      (n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (suc n) == add (fromNat n) oneR
    fromNat-addition :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m + n) == add (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-multiplication :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m * n) == multiply (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-injective :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat m == fromNat n ->
      m == n

    archimedean :
      (x : R) ->
      Exists Nat
        (\ n ->
          lessOrEqual x (fromNat n))

    least-upper-bound :
      (P : R -> Set) ->
      Exists R P ->
      Exists R
        (\ upper ->
          (x : R) ->
          P x ->
          lessOrEqual x upper) ->
      Exists R
        (\ supremum ->
          ((x : R) ->
            P x ->
            lessOrEqual x supremum)
          and
          ((upper : R) ->
            ((x : R) ->
              P x ->
              lessOrEqual x upper) ->
            lessOrEqual supremum upper))

open CompleteOrderedRealField

oneN : Nat
oneN =
  suc zero

twoN : Nat
twoN =
  suc oneN

threeN : Nat
threeN =
  suc twoN

fourN : Nat
fourN =
  suc threeN

fiveN : Nat
fiveN =
  suc fourN

sixN : Nat
sixN =
  suc fiveN

subtract :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
subtract reals x y =
  add reals x (negate reals y)

divide :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
divide reals x y =
  multiply reals x (inverse reals y)

square :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R
square reals x =
  multiply reals x x

StrictLess :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
StrictLess reals x y =
  lessOrEqual reals x y and x != y

CloseTo :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
CloseTo reals center radius x =
  StrictLess reals
    (subtract reals center radius)
    x
  and
  StrictLess reals
    x
    (add reals center radius)

naturalPower :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  Nat ->
  R
naturalPower reals x zero =
  oneR reals
naturalPower reals x (suc n) =
  multiply reals
    (naturalPower reals x n)
    x

factorial : Nat -> Nat
factorial zero =
  oneN
factorial (suc n) =
  suc n * factorial n

sumFirst :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Nat ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  R
sumFirst reals zero terms =
  zeroR reals
sumFirst reals (suc n) terms =
  add reals
    (sumFirst reals n terms)
    (terms n)

ConvergesTo :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  R ->
  Set
ConvergesTo {R} reals sequence limit =
  (epsilon : R) ->
  StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) epsilon ->
  Exists Nat
    (\ cutoff ->
      (n : Nat) ->
      cutoff <=N n ->
      CloseTo reals limit epsilon (sequence n))

alternate :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Nat ->
  R ->
  R
alternate reals zero x =
  x
alternate reals (suc n) x =
  negate reals (alternate reals n x)

evenExponent : Nat -> Nat
evenExponent n =
  n + n

oddExponent : Nat -> Nat
oddExponent n =
  suc (evenExponent n)

sineTerm :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  Nat ->
  R
sineTerm reals x n =
  alternate reals n
    (divide reals
      (naturalPower reals x (oddExponent n))
      (fromNat reals (factorial (oddExponent n))))

cosineTerm :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  Nat ->
  R
cosineTerm reals x n =
  alternate reals n
    (divide reals
      (naturalPower reals x (evenExponent n))
      (fromNat reals (factorial (evenExponent n))))

exponentialTerm :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  Nat ->
  R
exponentialTerm reals x n =
  divide reals
    (naturalPower reals x n)
    (fromNat reals (factorial n))

SeriesHasSum :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  R ->
  Set
SeriesHasSum reals terms value =
  ConvergesTo reals
    (\ n -> sumFirst reals n terms)
    value

record StandardRealAnalysis
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) :
  Set1 where

  field
    sine cosine exponential logarithm : R -> R
    pi : R

    sine-is-power-series :
      (x : R) ->
      SeriesHasSum reals
        (sineTerm reals x)
        (sine x)
    cosine-is-power-series :
      (x : R) ->
      SeriesHasSum reals
        (cosineTerm reals x)
        (cosine x)
    exponential-is-power-series :
      (x : R) ->
      SeriesHasSum reals
        (exponentialTerm reals x)
        (exponential x)

    exponential-positive :
      (x : R) ->
      StrictLess reals
        (zeroR reals)
        (exponential x)
    exponential-injective :
      (x y : R) ->
      exponential x == exponential y ->
      x == y
    exponential-logarithm :
      (x : R) ->
      StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) x ->
      exponential (logarithm x) == x

    pi-positive :
      StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) pi
    sine-pi-zero :
      sine pi == zeroR reals
    pi-is-first-positive-sine-zero :
      (x : R) ->
      StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) x ->
      sine x == zeroR reals ->
      lessOrEqual reals pi x

open StandardRealAnalysis

rightRiemannSum :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  (R -> R) ->
  Nat ->
  R
rightRiemannSum reals lower upper function pieces =
  let
    step =
      divide reals
        (subtract reals upper lower)
        (fromNat reals pieces)
  in
  sumFirst reals pieces
    (\ i ->
      multiply reals
        (function
          (add reals lower
            (multiply reals
              (fromNat reals (suc i))
              step)))
        step)

IntervalIntegralValue :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  (R -> R) ->
  R ->
  Set
IntervalIntegralValue reals lower upper function value =
  ConvergesTo reals
    (\ n ->
      rightRiemannSum reals
        lower
        upper
        function
        (suc n))
    value

LimitAtPositiveInfinity :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (R -> R) ->
  R ->
  Set
LimitAtPositiveInfinity {R} reals function limit =
  (epsilon : R) ->
  StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) epsilon ->
  Exists R
    (\ threshold ->
      (x : R) ->
      lessOrEqual reals threshold x ->
      CloseTo reals limit epsilon (function x))

record Point2 (R : Set) : Set where
  constructor point2
  field
    firstCoordinate  : R
    secondCoordinate : R

open Point2

module Putnam2021A4Statement
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R)
  (analysis : StandardRealAnalysis reals) where

  twoPi : R
  twoPi =
    multiply reals
      (fromNat reals twoN)
      (pi analysis)

  polarPoint :
    R ->
    R ->
    Point2 R
  polarPoint radius angle =
    point2
      (multiply reals
        radius
        (cosine analysis angle))
      (multiply reals
        radius
        (sine analysis angle))

  integrand :
    Point2 R ->
    R
  integrand point =
    let
      x2 = square reals (firstCoordinate point)
      y2 = square reals (secondCoordinate point)
      x4 = square reals x2
      y4 = square reals y2
      firstNumerator =
        add reals
          (oneR reals)
          (multiply reals
            (fromNat reals twoN)
            x2)
      firstDenominator =
        add reals
          (add reals
            (oneR reals)
            x4)
          (add reals
            (multiply reals
              (fromNat reals sixN)
              (multiply reals x2 y2))
            y4)
      secondNumerator =
        add reals
          (oneR reals)
          y2
      secondDenominator =
        add reals
          (add reals
            (fromNat reals twoN)
            x4)
          y4
    in
    subtract reals
      (divide reals
        firstNumerator
        firstDenominator)
      (divide reals
        secondNumerator
        secondDenominator)

  angularIntegrand :
    R ->
    R ->
    R
  angularIntegrand radius angle =
    multiply reals
      (integrand (polarPoint radius angle))
      radius

  PolarDiskIntegralValue :
    R ->
    R ->
    Set
  PolarDiskIntegralValue radius integralValue =
    Exists (R -> R)
      (\ angularIntegral ->
        ((r : R) ->
          lessOrEqual reals (zeroR reals) r ->
          lessOrEqual reals r radius ->
          IntervalIntegralValue reals
            (zeroR reals)
            twoPi
            (angularIntegrand r)
            (angularIntegral r))
        and
        IntervalIntegralValue reals
          (zeroR reals)
          radius
          angularIntegral
          integralValue)

  ExpectedLimit :
    (R -> R) ->
    Set
  ExpectedLimit integral =
    Exists R
      (\ squareRootTwo ->
        (lessOrEqual reals
          (zeroR reals)
          squareRootTwo
        and
        square reals squareRootTwo ==
          fromNat reals twoN)
        and
        LimitAtPositiveInfinity reals integral
          (multiply reals
            (multiply reals
              (divide reals
                squareRootTwo
                (fromNat reals twoN))
              (pi analysis))
            (logarithm analysis
              (fromNat reals twoN))))

  proposition : Set
  proposition =
    (integral : R -> R) ->
    ((radius : R) ->
      lessOrEqual reals (zeroR reals) radius ->
      PolarDiskIntegralValue radius (integral radius)) ->
    ExpectedLimit integral

putnam-2021-a4 : Set1
putnam-2021-a4 =
  (R : Set) ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) ->
  (analysis : StandardRealAnalysis reals) ->
  Putnam2021A4Statement.proposition reals analysis

(*
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2021_a4:
  the disk integral of the specified rational function tends to
  (sqrt 2 / 2) * pi * ln 2 as the radius tends to positive infinity.
  This file contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open pred_setTheory realTheory real_topologyTheory transcTheory
     integrationTheory;

val putnam_2021_a4 =
  ``let I =
      \R : real.
        integration$integral (interval [-R, R])
          (\x : real.
             integration$integral
               (interval
                  [-sqrt (R pow 2 - x pow 2),
                   sqrt (R pow 2 - x pow 2)])
               (\y : real.
                  (1 + 2 * x pow 2) /
                    (1 + x pow 4 + 6 * x pow 2 * y pow 2 + y pow 4) -
                  (1 + y pow 2) / (2 + x pow 4 + y pow 4)))
    in
      (I --> ((sqrt 2 / 2) * pi * ln 2)) at_posinfinity``;

$(
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact
  putnam_2021_a4: evaluation of the positive-infinity limit of a rational
  function integrated over expanding disks in the real coordinate plane.
  This file contains no proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  P21A4Index is the coordinate set {0,1}, so RR ^m P21A4Index is the real
  coordinate plane. P21A4Disk R is the closed disk x^2 + y^2 <= R^2.
  P21A4Integrand R is the source rational integrand on that disk and zero
  elsewhere. P21A4Integral R expands the same scalar function in coordinates
  and uses two applications of set.mm's real Lebesgue integral binder S.;
  this is the source disk integral written as an iterated integral.

  The relation ~~>r is set.mm's finite real limit at positive infinity. The
  right side is the value recorded in the Lean and Isabelle solution
  annotations. The final declaration is an unproved $a corpus statement;
  this database contains no $p proof statement.
$)

$c P21A4Index P21A4Disk P21A4Integrand P21A4Integral $.

p21a4-index-syntax $a class P21A4Index $.
p21a4-disk-syntax $a class ( P21A4Disk R ) $.
p21a4-integrand-syntax $a class ( P21A4Integrand R ) $.
p21a4-integral-syntax $a class ( P21A4Integral R ) $.

p21a4-index-definition $a |- P21A4Index = ( 0 ... 1 ) $.

${
  $d p R $.

  p21a4-disk-definition $a |- (
    P21A4Disk R
  ) = {
    p e. ( RR ^m P21A4Index ) |
      (
        (
          ( ( p ` 0 ) ^ 2 )
          +
          ( ( p ` 1 ) ^ 2 )
        )
        <_
        ( R ^ 2 )
      )
  } $.
$}

${
  $d p R $.

  p21a4-integrand-definition $a |- (
    P21A4Integrand R
  ) = (
    p e. ( RR ^m P21A4Index ) |->
      if (
        p e. ( P21A4Disk R ) ,
        (
          (
            (
              1
              +
              ( 2 x. ( ( p ` 0 ) ^ 2 ) )
            )
            /
            (
              (
                (
                  1
                  +
                  ( ( p ` 0 ) ^ 4 )
                )
                +
                (
                  6
                  x.
                  (
                    ( ( p ` 0 ) ^ 2 )
                    x.
                    ( ( p ` 1 ) ^ 2 )
                  )
                )
              )
              +
              ( ( p ` 1 ) ^ 4 )
            )
          )
          -
          (
            (
              1
              +
              ( ( p ` 1 ) ^ 2 )
            )
            /
            (
              (
                2
                +
                ( ( p ` 0 ) ^ 4 )
              )
              +
              ( ( p ` 1 ) ^ 4 )
            )
          )
        )
        ,
        0
      )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d R x y $.

  p21a4-integral-definition $a |- (
    P21A4Integral R
  ) = (
    S. RR
      (
        S. RR
          if (
            (
              (
                ( x ^ 2 )
                +
                ( y ^ 2 )
              )
              <_
              ( R ^ 2 )
            ) ,
            (
              (
                (
                  1
                  +
                  ( 2 x. ( x ^ 2 ) )
                )
                /
                (
                  (
                    (
                      1
                      +
                      ( x ^ 4 )
                    )
                    +
                    (
                      6
                      x.
                      (
                        ( x ^ 2 )
                        x.
                        ( y ^ 2 )
                      )
                    )
                  )
                  +
                  ( y ^ 4 )
                )
              )
              -
              (
                (
                  1
                  +
                  ( y ^ 2 )
                )
                /
                (
                  (
                    2
                    +
                    ( x ^ 4 )
                  )
                  +
                  ( y ^ 4 )
                )
              )
            ) ,
            0
          )
          _d y
      )
      _d x
  ) $.
$}

putnambench-putnam-2021-a4 $a |- (
  R e. RR |->
    ( P21A4Integral R )
)
~~>r
(
  (
    ( sqrt ` 2 )
    /
    2
  )
  x.
  (
    _pi
    x.
    ( log ` 2 )
  )
)
$.

title: putnam_2021_a4
content:
% Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2021_a4:
% the full-disk integral of the stated rational function tends to
% (sqrt(2) / 2) * pi * ln(2) as the radius tends to infinity.
% This file contains no proof.

putnam_2021_a4: THEORY
BEGIN
  real_function: TYPE = [real -> real]
  real_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> real]

  safe_div(numerator, denominator: real): real =
    IF denominator = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      numerator / denominator
    ENDIF

  nat_factorial(index: nat): RECURSIVE nat =
    IF index = 0 THEN
      1
    ELSE
      index * nat_factorial(index - 1)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE index

  alternating_sign(index: nat): RECURSIVE real =
    IF index = 0 THEN
      1
    ELSE
      -alternating_sign(index - 1)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE index

  exponential_partial(x: real, count: nat): RECURSIVE real =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      LET index: nat = count - 1 IN
        exponential_partial(x, count - 1)
          + safe_div(
              x ^ index,
              nat_factorial(index) :: real)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  leibniz_partial_sum(count: nat): RECURSIVE real =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      LET index: nat = count - 1 IN
        leibniz_partial_sum(count - 1)
          + safe_div(
              alternating_sign(index),
              (2 * index + 1) :: real)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  converges_to(sequence: real_sequence, value: real): bool =
    FORALL (epsilon_value: posreal):
      EXISTS (cutoff: nat):
        FORALL (index: nat):
          cutoff <= index IMPLIES
            abs(sequence(index) - value) < epsilon_value

  real_exponential(x: real): real =
    epsilon(
      LAMBDA (value: real):
        converges_to(
          LAMBDA (count: nat):
            exponential_partial(x, count),
          value))

  pi: real =
    epsilon(
      LAMBDA (value: real):
        converges_to(
          LAMBDA (count: nat):
            4 * leibniz_partial_sum(count),
          value))

  natural_log(x: real): real =
    IF x > 0 THEN
      epsilon(
        LAMBDA (value: real):
          real_exponential(value) = x)
    ELSE
      0
    ENDIF

  nonnegative_sqrt(x: real): real =
    IF x >= 0 THEN
      epsilon(
        LAMBDA (root: real):
          root >= 0 AND root * root = x)
    ELSE
      0
    ENDIF

  integrand(x, y: real): real =
    safe_div(
      1 + 2 * x ^ 2,
      1 + x ^ 4 + 6 * x ^ 2 * y ^ 2 + y ^ 4)
      - safe_div(
          1 + y ^ 2,
          2 + x ^ 4 + y ^ 4)

  mesh_step(radius: real, subdivisions: nat): real =
    IF subdivisions = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      safe_div(2 * radius, subdivisions :: real)
    ENDIF

  grid_coordinate(
      radius: real,
      subdivisions, index: nat): real =
    -radius
      + ((index :: real) + (1 :: real) / 2)
          * mesh_step(radius, subdivisions)

  disk_sample(
      radius: real,
      subdivisions, x_index, y_index: nat): real =
    LET x: real =
          grid_coordinate(radius, subdivisions, x_index),
        y: real =
          grid_coordinate(radius, subdivisions, y_index)
    IN
      IF x ^ 2 + y ^ 2 <= radius ^ 2 THEN
        integrand(x, y)
      ELSE
        0
      ENDIF

  disk_row_sum(
      radius: real,
      subdivisions, row, count: nat): RECURSIVE real =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      disk_row_sum(
        radius, subdivisions, row, count - 1)
        + disk_sample(
            radius, subdivisions, count - 1, row)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  disk_grid_sum(
      radius: real,
      subdivisions, rows: nat): RECURSIVE real =
    IF rows = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      disk_grid_sum(radius, subdivisions, rows - 1)
        + disk_row_sum(
            radius, subdivisions, rows - 1, subdivisions)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE rows

  disk_midpoint_sum(
      radius: real,
      subdivisions: nat): real =
    mesh_step(radius, subdivisions) ^ 2
      * disk_grid_sum(
          radius, subdivisions, subdivisions)

  has_disk_integral(
      radius, integral_value: real): bool =
    radius > 0
      AND FORALL (epsilon_value: posreal):
        EXISTS (cutoff: nat):
          cutoff > 0
            AND FORALL (subdivisions: nat):
              cutoff <= subdivisions IMPLIES
                abs(
                  disk_midpoint_sum(radius, subdivisions)
                    - integral_value)
                  < epsilon_value

  disk_integral(radius: real): real =
    IF radius > 0
        AND EXISTS (integral_value: real):
          has_disk_integral(radius, integral_value)
    THEN
      epsilon(
        LAMBDA (integral_value: real):
          has_disk_integral(radius, integral_value))
    ELSE
      0
    ENDIF

  converges_at_real_top(
      values: real_function,
      limit_value: real): bool =
    FORALL (epsilon_value: posreal):
      EXISTS (cutoff: real):
        FORALL (radius: real):
          cutoff <= radius IMPLIES
            abs(values(radius) - limit_value)
              < epsilon_value

  putnam_2021_a4_solution: real =
    safe_div(nonnegative_sqrt(2), 2)
      * pi * natural_log(2)

  putnam_2021_a4: bool =
    converges_at_real_top(
      disk_integral,
      putnam_2021_a4_solution)
END putnam_2021_a4

-- {j : ℕ | ¬(42 ∣ j) ∧ ¬(46 ∣ j)}
/--
Let $A$ be the set of all integers $n$ such that $1 \leq n \leq 2021$ and $\gcd(n,2021)=1$. For every nonnegative integer $j$, let $S(j)=\sum_{n \in A}n^j$. Determine all values of $j$ such that $S(j)$ is a multiple of $2021$.
-/
theorem putnam_2021_a5
  (j : ℕ)
  (A : Finset ℕ)
  (S : ℕ → ℕ)
  (hA : A = {n | 1 ≤ n ∧ n ≤ 2021 ∧ Nat.gcd n 2021 = 1})
  (hS : ∀ j' : ℕ, S j' = ∑ n ∈ A, n ^ j') :
  (2021 ∣ S j) ↔ j ∈ putnam_2021_a5_solution :=
sorry

Definition putnam_2021_a5_solution (n: nat) :=
  (42 %| n = false) /\ (46 %| n = false).

Theorem putnam_2021_a5
    (A : pred 'I_2021 := fun n => let m := nat_of_ord n in ((1 <= m <= 2021) && (gcd  m 2021 == 1)))
    (B : nat -> nat := fun j => \sum_(n | A n) (nat_of_ord n)^j)
    : forall (j: nat), B j mod 2021 = 0 <-> putnam_2021_a5_solution j. 
Proof. Admitted.
