title: putnam_2021_a5
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2021_a5:
;; the coprime-residue power sum modulo 2021 is divisible by 2021 exactly
;; when its natural exponent is divisible by neither 42 nor 46. This file
;; contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(defun putnam-2021-a5-gcd (a b)
  (declare (xargs :measure (+ (nfix a) (nfix b))))
  (if (and (natp a) (natp b))
      (cond
       ((zp a) b)
       ((zp b) a)
       ((< a b)
        (putnam-2021-a5-gcd a (- b a)))
       (t
        (putnam-2021-a5-gcd (- a b) b)))
    0))

;; This recursively enumerates exactly the natural numbers n with
;; 1 <= n <= 2021 and gcd(n,2021)=1. The endpoint 2021 contributes nothing,
;; so it also agrees with the ordinal enumeration 0,...,2020 in the Rocq
;; source.
(defun putnam-2021-a5-power-sum-through (j upper)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix upper)))
  (if (zp upper)
      0
    (+ (putnam-2021-a5-power-sum-through j (- upper 1))
       (if (equal (putnam-2021-a5-gcd upper 2021) 1)
           (expt upper j)
         0))))

(defun putnam-2021-a5-solution-member-p (j)
  (and
   (natp j)
   (not (equal (mod j 42) 0))
   (not (equal (mod j 46) 0))))

;; The source assumptions uniquely determine A and S, so both are
;; definitionally eliminated by the exact finite sum above. Equality of the
;; two Boolean predicates is the source biconditional.
(defun putnambench-putnam-2021-a5-statement (j)
  (implies
   (natp j)
   (equal
    (equal
     (mod (putnam-2021-a5-power-sum-through j 2021)
          2021)
     0)
    (putnam-2021-a5-solution-member-p j))))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

title: putnam_2021_a5
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2021_a5:
-- the power sum over the positive integers at most 2021 that are coprime to
-- 2021 is divisible by 2021 exactly for exponents divisible by neither 42 nor
-- 46. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module Main where

open import Agda.Builtin.Bool using (Bool; false; true)
open import Agda.Builtin.Equality using (_≡_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using
  (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; _*_; mod-helper)

infix 4 _∣_ _↔_
infixr 5 _×_
infixr 8 _^_

data Bottom : Set where

Not : Set -> Set
Not A = A -> Bottom

record _×_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  field
    first : A
    second : B

record _↔_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  field
    forward : A -> B
    backward : B -> A

record _∣_ (divisor dividend : Nat) : Set where
  field
    quotient : Nat
    equation : divisor * quotient ≡ dividend

natEqual : Nat -> Nat -> Bool
natEqual zero zero = true
natEqual zero (suc n) = false
natEqual (suc m) zero = false
natEqual (suc m) (suc n) = natEqual m n

ifNat : Bool -> Nat -> Nat -> Nat
ifNat true when-true when-false = when-true
ifNat false when-true when-false = when-false

naturalMod : Nat -> Nat -> Nat
naturalMod numerator zero = zero
naturalMod numerator (suc denominator) =
  mod-helper zero denominator numerator denominator

gcdWithFuel : Nat -> Nat -> Nat -> Nat
gcdWithFuel zero a b = a
gcdWithFuel (suc fuel) a zero = a
gcdWithFuel (suc fuel) a (suc b) =
  gcdWithFuel fuel (suc b) (naturalMod a (suc b))

euclideanGCD : Nat -> Nat -> Nat
euclideanGCD a b =
  gcdWithFuel (suc (a + b)) a b

_^_ : Nat -> Nat -> Nat
base ^ zero = 1
base ^ suc exponent = base * (base ^ exponent)

sumCoprimePowersUpTo : Nat -> Nat -> Nat
sumCoprimePowersUpTo zero exponent = zero
sumCoprimePowersUpTo (suc n) exponent =
  sumCoprimePowersUpTo n exponent
  + ifNat
      (natEqual (euclideanGCD (suc n) 2021) 1)
      ((suc n) ^ exponent)
      zero

putnam-2021-a5 : Set
putnam-2021-a5 =
  (j : Nat) ->
  (2021 ∣ sumCoprimePowersUpTo 2021 j)
    ↔ (Not (42 ∣ j) × Not (46 ∣ j))

title: putnam_2021_a5
content:
% Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2021_a5:
% the power sum over the positive residues at most 2021 that are coprime to
% 2021 is divisible by 2021 exactly for exponents divisible by neither 42 nor
% 46. This file contains no proof.

putnam_2021_a5: THEORY
BEGIN
  nat_divides(divisor, value: nat): bool =
    EXISTS (quotient: nat):
      value = divisor * quotient

  coprime_nat(left, right: nat): bool =
    FORALL (common_divisor: nat):
      nat_divides(common_divisor, left)
        AND nat_divides(common_divisor, right)
      IMPLIES common_divisor = 1

  in_residue_set(value: nat): bool =
    1 <= value
      AND value <= 2021
      AND coprime_nat(value, 2021)

  unit_power_sum(exponent, upper: nat): RECURSIVE nat =
    IF upper = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      unit_power_sum(exponent, upper - 1)
        + IF in_residue_set(upper) THEN upper ^ exponent ELSE 0 ENDIF
    ENDIF
  MEASURE upper

  putnam_2021_a5_solution(exponent: nat): bool =
    NOT nat_divides(42, exponent)
      AND NOT nat_divides(46, exponent)

  putnam_2021_a5: bool =
    FORALL (exponent: nat):
      nat_divides(2021, unit_power_sum(exponent, 2021))
        IFF putnam_2021_a5_solution(exponent)
END putnam_2021_a5

    (Pcoeff Pprod : {poly int} -> Prop)
    (hPcoeff : forall P, Pcoeff P <-> forall n : nat, (P`_n = 0) \/ (P`_n = 1))
    (hPprod : forall P, Pprod P <-> (exists Q R : {poly int}, (gt (size Q) 1) /\ (gt (size R) 1) /\ P = Q * R))

        Pprod P ->

title: putnam_2021_a6
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2021_a6:
  a polynomial with coefficients in {0,1} that factors into two nonconstant
  integer polynomials has a composite value at 2. This file contains no proof.
*)

let statement =
  `let eval =
     \p:int list. \x:int.
       ITLIST (\c acc. c + x * acc) p (&0) in
   let zero_one_coefficients =
     \p:int list.
       !i:num.
         i < LENGTH p
         ==> EL i p = (&0:int) \/ EL i p = &1 in
   let nonconstant =
     \p:int list.
       ?i:num. 0 < i /\ i < LENGTH p /\ ~(EL i p = (&0:int)) in
   let integer_prime =
     \z:int. prime (num_of_int (abs z)) in
   !p:int list.
     zero_one_coefficients p /\
     (?q r:int list.
        nonconstant q /\
        nonconstant r /\
        !x:int. eval p x = eval q x * eval r x)
     ==>
     ~(eval p (&2) = (&0:int)) /\
     ~(eval p (&2) = &1) /\
     ~(integer_prime (eval p (&2)))`;;

title: putnam_2021_a6
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2021_a6:
;; every integer polynomial with coefficients in {0,1} that factors into two
;; nonconstant integer polynomials has a composite value at 2. This file
;; contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

;; Coefficients are stored in ascending degree order. NIL is the zero
;; polynomial, and every nonzero polynomial has its unique representation
;; with a nonzero final coefficient.
(defun putnam-2021-a6-integer-coefficient-list-p (coefficients)
  (if (consp coefficients)
      (and
       (integerp (car coefficients))
       (putnam-2021-a6-integer-coefficient-list-p
        (cdr coefficients)))
    (equal coefficients nil)))

(defun putnam-2021-a6-integer-polynomial-p (coefficients)
  (and
   (putnam-2021-a6-integer-coefficient-list-p coefficients)
   (or
    (endp coefficients)
    (not (equal (car (last coefficients)) 0)))))

(defun putnam-2021-a6-zero-one-coefficients-p (coefficients)
  (if (consp coefficients)
      (and
       (or
        (equal (car coefficients) 0)
        (equal (car coefficients) 1))
       (putnam-2021-a6-zero-one-coefficients-p
        (cdr coefficients)))
    (equal coefficients nil)))

(defun putnam-2021-a6-trim (coefficients)
  (if (consp coefficients)
      (let ((tail
             (putnam-2021-a6-trim (cdr coefficients))))
        (if (and
             (equal (car coefficients) 0)
             (endp tail))
            nil
          (cons (car coefficients) tail)))
    nil))

(defun putnam-2021-a6-poly-cons (coefficient tail)
  (if (and
       (equal coefficient 0)
       (endp tail))
      nil
    (cons coefficient tail)))

(defun putnam-2021-a6-poly-add (left right)
  (declare
   (xargs :measure (+ (acl2-count left) (acl2-count right))))
  (cond
   ((endp left) right)
   ((endp right) left)
   (t
    (putnam-2021-a6-poly-cons
     (+ (car left) (car right))
     (putnam-2021-a6-poly-add
      (cdr left) (cdr right))))))

(defun putnam-2021-a6-poly-scale (scalar polynomial)
  (if (endp polynomial)
      nil
    (putnam-2021-a6-poly-cons
     (* scalar (car polynomial))
     (putnam-2021-a6-poly-scale
      scalar (cdr polynomial)))))

(defun putnam-2021-a6-poly-shift (polynomial)
  (if (endp polynomial)
      nil
    (cons 0 polynomial)))

(defun putnam-2021-a6-poly-multiply (left right)
  (if (endp left)
      nil
    (putnam-2021-a6-poly-add
     (putnam-2021-a6-poly-scale
      (car left) right)
     (putnam-2021-a6-poly-shift
      (putnam-2021-a6-poly-multiply
       (cdr left) right)))))

(defun putnam-2021-a6-poly-evaluate (coefficients value)
  (if (consp coefficients)
      (+ (car coefficients)
         (* value
            (putnam-2021-a6-poly-evaluate
             (cdr coefficients) value)))
    0))

;; A code enumerates all coefficient vectors of the requested length with
;; entries from -BOUND through BOUND. Trimming gives every integer polynomial
;; of degree below LENGTH.
(defun putnam-2021-a6-coefficients-from-code
    (code length bound)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix length)))
  (if (zp length)
      nil
    (let ((base (+ 1 (* 2 (nfix bound)))))
      (cons
       (- (mod (nfix code) base) (nfix bound))
       (putnam-2021-a6-coefficients-from-code
        (floor (nfix code) base)
        (- length 1)
        bound)))))

(defun putnam-2021-a6-monic-nonconstant-p (polynomial)
  (and
   (putnam-2021-a6-integer-polynomial-p polynomial)
   (consp (cdr polynomial))
   (equal (car (last polynomial)) 1)))

;; For a monic 0/1 polynomial P of degree N, every complex root has modulus
;; at most 2. A monic factor of degree D has each coefficient bounded by
;; 3^D, hence by 4^N. Thus the finite searches below are exactly the source
;; existential quantifiers over nonconstant integer factors; no witness is
;; exposed as a statement parameter.
(defun putnam-2021-a6-factor-with-right-code-p
    (polynomial left bound coefficient-count right-code-count)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix right-code-count)))
  (if (zp right-code-count)
      nil
    (let* ((code (- right-code-count 1))
           (right
            (putnam-2021-a6-trim
             (putnam-2021-a6-coefficients-from-code
              code coefficient-count bound))))
      (or
       (and
        (putnam-2021-a6-monic-nonconstant-p right)
        (equal
         polynomial
         (putnam-2021-a6-poly-multiply left right)))
       (putnam-2021-a6-factor-with-right-code-p
        polynomial left bound coefficient-count code)))))

(defun putnam-2021-a6-factor-pair-through-codes-p
    (polynomial bound coefficient-count
                right-code-count left-code-count)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix left-code-count)))
  (if (zp left-code-count)
      nil
    (let* ((code (- left-code-count 1))
           (left
            (putnam-2021-a6-trim
             (putnam-2021-a6-coefficients-from-code
              code coefficient-count bound))))
      (or
       (and
        (putnam-2021-a6-monic-nonconstant-p left)
        (putnam-2021-a6-factor-with-right-code-p
         polynomial left bound coefficient-count
         right-code-count))
       (putnam-2021-a6-factor-pair-through-codes-p
        polynomial bound coefficient-count
        right-code-count code)))))

(defun putnam-2021-a6-reducible-p (polynomial)
  (let* ((degree
          (if (consp polynomial)
              (- (len polynomial) 1)
            0))
         (coefficient-count (+ degree 1))
         (bound (expt 4 degree))
         (base (+ 1 (* 2 bound)))
         (code-count (expt base coefficient-count)))
    (putnam-2021-a6-factor-pair-through-codes-p
     polynomial bound coefficient-count code-count code-count)))

;; On positive integers, this is the standard definition of primality.
(defun putnam-2021-a6-no-divisor-from-p (number divisor)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix (- number divisor))))
  (if (and
       (natp number)
       (natp divisor)
       (<= 2 divisor)
       (< divisor number))
      (and
       (not (equal (mod number divisor) 0))
       (putnam-2021-a6-no-divisor-from-p
        number (+ divisor 1)))
    t))

(defun putnam-2021-a6-primep (number)
  (and
   (natp number)
   (< 1 number)
   (putnam-2021-a6-no-divisor-from-p number 2)))

;; ACL2 universally closes COEFFICIENTS, matching the source quantification
;; over all integer polynomials.
(defun putnambench-putnam-2021-a6-statement (coefficients)
  (implies
   (and
    (putnam-2021-a6-integer-polynomial-p coefficients)
    (putnam-2021-a6-zero-one-coefficients-p coefficients)
    (putnam-2021-a6-reducible-p coefficients))
   (let ((value
          (putnam-2021-a6-poly-evaluate coefficients 2)))
     (and
      (not (equal value 0))
      (not (equal value 1))
      (not (putnam-2021-a6-primep value))))))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

title: putnam_2021_a6
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2021_a6
-- (putnambench__agda__putnam_2021_a6): a 0/1-coefficient integer polynomial
-- that factors into two positive-degree integer polynomials has composite
-- value at 2. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module Putnam2021A6 where

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Int using (Int; pos; negsuc)
open import Agda.Builtin.List using (List; []; _∷_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; _*_)

infix 4 _!=_
infixr 3 _and_
infixr 2 _or_

data Bottom : Set where

Not : Set -> Set
Not A =
  A -> Bottom

_!=_ : {A : Set} -> A -> A -> Set
x != y =
  Not (x == y)

record _and_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data _or_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  left  : A -> A or B
  right : B -> A or B

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

data Positive : Nat -> Set where
  positive : {n : Nat} -> Positive (suc n)

negative : Nat -> Int
negative zero =
  pos zero
negative (suc n) =
  negsuc n

difference : Nat -> Nat -> Int
difference zero zero =
  pos zero
difference (suc m) zero =
  pos (suc m)
difference zero (suc n) =
  negsuc n
difference (suc m) (suc n) =
  difference m n

negateInt : Int -> Int
negateInt (pos zero) =
  pos zero
negateInt (pos (suc n)) =
  negsuc n
negateInt (negsuc n) =
  pos (suc n)

addInt : Int -> Int -> Int
addInt (pos m) (pos n) =
  pos (m + n)
addInt (pos m) (negsuc n) =
  difference m (suc n)
addInt (negsuc m) (pos n) =
  difference n (suc m)
addInt (negsuc m) (negsuc n) =
  negsuc (suc (m + n))

multiplyInt : Int -> Int -> Int
multiplyInt (pos m) (pos n) =
  pos (m * n)
multiplyInt (pos m) (negsuc n) =
  negative (m * suc n)
multiplyInt (negsuc m) (pos n) =
  negative (suc m * n)
multiplyInt (negsuc m) (negsuc n) =
  pos (suc m * suc n)

zeroZ : Int
zeroZ =
  pos zero

oneN : Nat
oneN =
  suc zero

twoN : Nat
twoN =
  suc oneN

oneZ : Int
oneZ =
  pos oneN

twoZ : Int
twoZ =
  pos twoN

minusOneZ : Int
minusOneZ =
  negsuc zero

Polynomial : Set
Polynomial =
  List Int

coefficient : Polynomial -> Nat -> Int
coefficient [] n =
  zeroZ
coefficient (c ∷ coefficients) zero =
  c
coefficient (c ∷ coefficients) (suc n) =
  coefficient coefficients n

PolynomialEqual : Polynomial -> Polynomial -> Set
PolynomialEqual p q =
  (n : Nat) ->
  coefficient p n == coefficient q n

addPolynomials : Polynomial -> Polynomial -> Polynomial
addPolynomials [] q =
  q
addPolynomials p [] =
  p
addPolynomials (a ∷ p) (b ∷ q) =
  addInt a b ∷ addPolynomials p q

scalePolynomial : Int -> Polynomial -> Polynomial
scalePolynomial scalar [] =
  []
scalePolynomial scalar (c ∷ coefficients) =
  multiplyInt scalar c ∷ scalePolynomial scalar coefficients

multiplyPolynomials : Polynomial -> Polynomial -> Polynomial
multiplyPolynomials [] q =
  []
multiplyPolynomials (c ∷ coefficients) q =
  addPolynomials
    (scalePolynomial c q)
    (zeroZ ∷ multiplyPolynomials coefficients q)

evaluate : Polynomial -> Int -> Int
evaluate [] x =
  zeroZ
evaluate (c ∷ coefficients) x =
  addInt c
    (multiplyInt x (evaluate coefficients x))

AllCoefficientsZeroOrOne : Polynomial -> Set
AllCoefficientsZeroOrOne polynomial =
  (n : Nat) ->
  coefficient polynomial n == zeroZ
  or
  coefficient polynomial n == oneZ

PositiveDegree : Polynomial -> Set
PositiveDegree polynomial =
  Exists Nat
    (\ degree ->
      Positive degree
      and
      coefficient polynomial degree != zeroZ)

FactorableIntoPositiveDegrees : Polynomial -> Set
FactorableIntoPositiveDegrees polynomial =
  Exists Polynomial
    (\ leftFactor ->
      Exists Polynomial
        (\ rightFactor ->
          PositiveDegree leftFactor
          and
          PositiveDegree rightFactor
          and
          PolynomialEqual polynomial
            (multiplyPolynomials leftFactor rightFactor)))

DividesInt : Int -> Int -> Set
DividesInt divisor dividend =
  Exists Int
    (\ quotient ->
      multiplyInt divisor quotient == dividend)

UnitInt : Int -> Set
UnitInt integer =
  integer == oneZ
  or
  integer == minusOneZ

AssociatesInt : Int -> Int -> Set
AssociatesInt leftInteger rightInteger =
  leftInteger == rightInteger
  or
  leftInteger == negateInt rightInteger

PrimeInt : Int -> Set
PrimeInt integer =
  integer != zeroZ
  and
  Not (UnitInt integer)
  and
  ((divisor : Int) ->
    DividesInt divisor integer ->
    UnitInt divisor or AssociatesInt divisor integer)

CompositeConclusion : Int -> Set
CompositeConclusion integer =
  integer != zeroZ
  and
  integer != oneZ
  and
  Not (PrimeInt integer)

putnam-2021-a6 : Set
putnam-2021-a6 =
  (polynomial : Polynomial) ->
  AllCoefficientsZeroOrOne polynomial ->
  FactorableIntoPositiveDegrees polynomial ->
  CompositeConclusion (evaluate polynomial twoZ)

(*
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2021_a6:
  an integer polynomial with all coefficients zero or one that factors into
  two nonconstant integer polynomials has a composite value at two. This file
  contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open arithmeticTheory integerTheory pred_setTheory;

val putnam_2021_a6 =
  ``let integer_polynomial =
      \p : num -> int. FINITE {n : num | p n <> 0};
      poly_mul =
        (\p q : num -> int.
           \n : num.
             ITSET
               (\k acc. p k * q (n - k) + acc)
               (count (SUC n))
               (0 : int));
      poly_eval =
        (\p : num -> int.
         \x : int.
           ITSET
             (\n acc. p n * x ** n + acc)
             {n : num | p n <> 0}
             (0 : int))
    in
      !P : num -> int.
        integer_polynomial P /\
        (!n : num. P n = 0 \/ P n = 1) /\
        (?Q R : num -> int.
           integer_polynomial Q /\
           integer_polynomial R /\
           (?n : num. 0 < n /\ Q n <> 0) /\
           (?n : num. 0 < n /\ R n <> 0) /\
           P = poly_mul Q R)
        ==>
        let value = poly_eval P 2
        in
          value <> 0 /\
          value <> 1 /\
          ~prime (Num (ABS value))``;

$(
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact
  putnam_2021_a6: a zero-one coefficient integer polynomial that factors
  into two nonconstant integer polynomials has composite value at two.
  This file contains no proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  Base ` ( Poly1 ` ZZring ) is SetMM's ring of all finite-support
  univariate polynomials over the integers. The function coe1 gives the
  complete nonnegative-integer-indexed coefficient sequence, and eval1 is
  ordinary polynomial evaluation.

  A factor has positive degree exactly when some coefficient at a positive
  index is nonzero. Thus both nonconstant factors remain internally
  existentially quantified without selecting external degree bounds.
  Membership in Prime is primality for positive natural integers; together
  with exclusion of zero and one, its negation states the source composite
  conclusion. The final declaration is the single unproved $a corpus
  statement; this database contains no $p proof declaration.
$)

${
  $d P Q R i j n $.

  putnambench-putnam-2021-a6 $a |-
    A. P e. ( Base ` ( Poly1 ` ZZring ) )
      (
        (
          A. n e. NN0
            (
              ( ( coe1 ` P ) ` n ) = 0
              \/
              ( ( coe1 ` P ) ` n ) = 1
            )
          /\
          E. Q e. ( Base ` ( Poly1 ` ZZring ) )
            E. R e. ( Base ` ( Poly1 ` ZZring ) )
              (
                P
                =
                (
                  Q
                  ( .r ` ( Poly1 ` ZZring ) )
                  R
                )
                /\
                (
                  E. i e. NN ( ( coe1 ` Q ) ` i ) =/= 0
                  /\
                  E. j e. NN ( ( coe1 ` R ) ` j ) =/= 0
                )
              )
        )
        ->
        (
          (
            (
              ( eval1 ` ZZring )
              `
              P
            )
            `
            2
          )
          =/= 0
          /\
          (
            (
              (
                ( eval1 ` ZZring )
                `
                P
              )
              `
              2
            )
            =/= 1
            /\
            -.
            (
              (
                (
                  ( eval1 ` ZZring )
                  `
                  P
                )
                `
                2
              )
              e. Prime
            )
          )
        )
      )
  $.
$}

title: putnam_2021_a6
content:
% Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2021_a6:
% an integer polynomial with coefficients in {0, 1} that factors into two
% nonconstant integer polynomials has a composite value at 2. This file
% contains no proof.

putnam_2021_a6: THEORY
BEGIN
  polynomial: TYPE = list[int]

  coefficient(p: polynomial, degree: nat): RECURSIVE int =
    CASES p OF
      null: 0,
      cons(head_coefficient, tail):
        IF degree = 0 THEN
          head_coefficient
        ELSE
          coefficient(tail, degree - 1)
        ENDIF
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE p BY <<

  polynomial_equal(left, right: polynomial): bool =
    FORALL (degree: nat):
      coefficient(left, degree) = coefficient(right, degree)

  polynomial_add(left, right: polynomial): RECURSIVE polynomial =
    CASES left OF
      null: right,
      cons(left_coefficient, left_tail):
        CASES right OF
          null: left,
          cons(right_coefficient, right_tail):
            cons(
              left_coefficient + right_coefficient,
              polynomial_add(left_tail, right_tail))
        ENDCASES
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE left BY <<

  polynomial_scale(
      scalar: int,
      p: polynomial): RECURSIVE polynomial =
    CASES p OF
      null: null,
      cons(head_coefficient, tail):
        cons(
          scalar * head_coefficient,
          polynomial_scale(scalar, tail))
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE p BY <<

  polynomial_multiply(
      left, right: polynomial): RECURSIVE polynomial =
    CASES left OF
      null: null,
      cons(head_coefficient, tail):
        polynomial_add(
          polynomial_scale(head_coefficient, right),
          cons(0, polynomial_multiply(tail, right)))
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE left BY <<

  polynomial_value(p: polynomial, x: int): RECURSIVE int =
    CASES p OF
      null: 0,
      cons(head_coefficient, tail):
        head_coefficient + x * polynomial_value(tail, x)
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE p BY <<

  has_zero_one_coefficients(p: polynomial): bool =
    FORALL (degree: nat):
      coefficient(p, degree) = 0
        OR coefficient(p, degree) = 1

  nonconstant(p: polynomial): bool =
    EXISTS (degree: nat):
      degree > 0 AND coefficient(p, degree) /= 0

  int_divides(divisor, value: int): bool =
    EXISTS (quotient: int):
      value = divisor * quotient

  prime_int(value: int): bool =
    value > 1
      AND FORALL (divisor: int):
        divisor > 0
          AND int_divides(divisor, value)
          IMPLIES divisor = 1 OR divisor = value

  putnam_2021_a6: bool =
    FORALL (P: polynomial):
      (has_zero_one_coefficients(P)
        AND EXISTS (Q, R: polynomial):
          nonconstant(Q)
            AND nonconstant(R)
            AND polynomial_equal(
              P, polynomial_multiply(Q, R)))
      IMPLIES
        polynomial_value(P, 2) /= 0
          AND polynomial_value(P, 2) /= 1
          AND NOT prime_int(polynomial_value(P, 2))
END putnam_2021_a6

import Mathlib

open Filter Topology

noncomputable abbrev putnam_2021_b2_solution : ℝ := sorry
-- 2 / 3
/--
Determine the maximum value of the sum $S = \sum_{n=1}^\infty \frac{n}{2^n}(a_1a_2 \dots a_n)^{1/n}$ over all sequences $a_1,a_2,a_3,\dots$ of nonnegative real numbers satisfying $\sum_{k=1}^\infty a_k=1$.
-/
theorem putnam_2021_b2 :
    IsGreatest
      {S | ∃ a : ℕ+ → ℝ, (∑' k, a k = 1) ∧ (∀ k, 0 ≤ a k) ∧
        S = ∑' n : ℕ+, n / 2 ^ (n : ℕ) * (∏ k ∈ Finset.Icc 1 n, a k) ^ (1 / n : ℝ)}
      putnam_2021_b2_solution :=
  sorry

From mathcomp Require Import all_algebra all_ssreflect.
From mathcomp Require Import reals sequences topology normedtype.
From mathcomp Require Import classical_sets.

Set Implicit Arguments.

Local Open Scope classical_set_scope.

Variable R : realType.
Definition putnam_2021_b2_solution : R := 2/3.

Definition putnam_2021_b2_admissible (a : R ^nat) : Prop :=
  series (fun k => a k.+1) @ \oo --> (1 : R) /\
  forall k, 0 <= a k.+1.

Definition putnam_2021_b2_has_value
    (a : R ^nat) (S : R) : Prop :=
  series
    (fun n : nat =>
      let m := n.+1 in
      m%:R / (2 ^+ m) *
        (\prod_(1 <= k < m.+1) a k) ^ (1 / m%:R))
    @ \oo --> S.

Theorem putnam_2021_b2 :
    (exists a : R ^nat,
      putnam_2021_b2_admissible a /\
      putnam_2021_b2_has_value a putnam_2021_b2_solution) /\
    (forall (a : R ^nat) (S : R),
      putnam_2021_b2_admissible a ->
      putnam_2021_b2_has_value a S ->
      S <= putnam_2021_b2_solution).
Proof. Admitted.

definition putnam_2021_b2_solution :: real where

(* 2/3 *)
theorem putnam_2021_b2:
  fixes S :: "(nat \<Rightarrow> real) \<Rightarrow> real"
  and asum :: "(nat \<Rightarrow> real) \<Rightarrow> bool"
  defines "S \<equiv> \<lambda>a. suminf (\<lambda>n::nat.
    (real (n + 1) / 2^(n + 1)) *
      (\<Prod>k::nat=0..n. a k) powr (1 / real (n + 1)))"

title: putnam_2021_b2
putnam_2021_b2
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2021_b2:
;; the maximum of the weighted geometric-mean series over nonnegative real
;; sequences with sum 1 is 2/3. This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))

;; These conservative symbols give arbitrary rational regular-Cauchy
;; approximations to a real sequence A, its nonnegative geometric means G,
;; and a possible value S of the weighted series. They are genuine unbounded
;; functions, not finite tables. Every real sequence has such approximations.

(defstub putnam-2021-b2-a-approx (n epsilon) t)
(defstub putnam-2021-b2-g-approx (n epsilon) t)
(defstub putnam-2021-b2-s-approx (epsilon) t)

(defun putnam-2021-b2-positive-rational-p (x)
  (and (rationalp x)
       (< 0 x)))

(defun putnam-2021-b2-sequence-approx (which n epsilon)
  (if (equal which :a)
      (putnam-2021-b2-a-approx n epsilon)
    (putnam-2021-b2-g-approx n epsilon)))

;; Regular Cauchy names are an exact presentation of arbitrary real values.

(defun-sk putnam-2021-b2-sequence-regular-p (which)
  (forall (n epsilon eta)
    (implies
     (and
      (natp n)
      (putnam-2021-b2-positive-rational-p epsilon)
      (putnam-2021-b2-positive-rational-p eta))
     (let ((left
            (putnam-2021-b2-sequence-approx
             which n epsilon))
           (right
            (putnam-2021-b2-sequence-approx
             which n eta)))
       (and
        (rationalp left)
        (rationalp right)
        (<= (abs (- left right))
            (+ epsilon eta)))))))

(defun-sk putnam-2021-b2-target-regular-p ()
  (forall (epsilon eta)
    (implies
     (and
      (putnam-2021-b2-positive-rational-p epsilon)
      (putnam-2021-b2-positive-rational-p eta))
     (let ((left
            (putnam-2021-b2-s-approx epsilon))
           (right
            (putnam-2021-b2-s-approx eta)))
       (and
        (rationalp left)
        (rationalp right)
        (<= (abs (- left right))
            (+ epsilon eta)))))))

;; This epsilon condition is equivalent to nonnegativity of every represented
;; real term.

(defun-sk putnam-2021-b2-sequence-nonnegative-p (which)
  (forall (n epsilon)
    (implies
     (and
      (natp n)
      (putnam-2021-b2-positive-rational-p epsilon))
     (<= (- epsilon)
         (putnam-2021-b2-sequence-approx
          which n epsilon)))))

(defun putnam-2021-b2-a-prefix (terms precision)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix terms)))
  (if (zp terms)
      0
    (let ((index (- (nfix terms) 1)))
      (+ (putnam-2021-b2-a-prefix index precision)
         (putnam-2021-b2-a-approx index precision)))))

(defun putnam-2021-b2-a-product (terms precision)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix terms)))
  (if (zp terms)
      1
    (let ((index (- (nfix terms) 1)))
      (* (putnam-2021-b2-a-product index precision)
         (putnam-2021-b2-a-approx index precision)))))

;; The precision epsilon/(4*(terms+1)) keeps the total Cauchy-name error in an
;; arbitrary finite prefix uniformly below epsilon/4. Thus this is exactly
;; convergence of sum A_n to 1, with the cutoff existentially quantified.

(defun-sk putnam-2021-b2-sum-one-tail-p (epsilon cutoff)
  (forall (terms)
    (implies
     (and
      (natp terms)
      (<= cutoff terms))
     (<
      (abs
       (-
        (putnam-2021-b2-a-prefix
         terms
         (/ epsilon (* 4 (+ terms 1))))
        1))
      epsilon))))

(defun-sk putnam-2021-b2-sum-one-cutoff-exists-p (epsilon)
  (exists (cutoff)
    (and
     (natp cutoff)
     (putnam-2021-b2-sum-one-tail-p
      epsilon cutoff))))

(defun-sk putnam-2021-b2-sums-to-one-p ()
  (forall (epsilon)
    (implies
     (putnam-2021-b2-positive-rational-p epsilon)
     (putnam-2021-b2-sum-one-cutoff-exists-p
      epsilon))))

;; G_n is the principal (n+1)-st root of product_{k=0}^n A_k. Existence of an
;; arbitrarily small positive working precision expresses exact equality of
;; the represented reals; nonnegativity of G selects the principal root.

(defun-sk putnam-2021-b2-root-precision-exists-p
    (n epsilon)
  (exists (precision)
    (and
     (putnam-2021-b2-positive-rational-p precision)
     (< precision epsilon)
     (<
      (abs
       (-
        (expt
         (putnam-2021-b2-g-approx n precision)
         (+ n 1))
        (putnam-2021-b2-a-product
         (+ n 1) precision)))
      epsilon))))

(defun-sk putnam-2021-b2-geometric-means-p ()
  (forall (n epsilon)
    (implies
     (and
      (natp n)
      (putnam-2021-b2-positive-rational-p epsilon))
     (putnam-2021-b2-root-precision-exists-p
      n epsilon))))

(defun putnam-2021-b2-weighted-prefix (terms precision)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix terms)))
  (if (zp terms)
      0
    (let* ((index (- (nfix terms) 1))
           (n (+ index 1)))
      (+
       (putnam-2021-b2-weighted-prefix
        index precision)
       (*
        (/ n (expt 2 n))
        (putnam-2021-b2-g-approx
         index precision))))))

;; The weights n/2^n have bounded total mass. Requiring all sufficiently fine
;; Cauchy approximations makes these predicates exactly the Cauchy criterion
;; and convergence to the represented target S for the source series.

(defun-sk putnam-2021-b2-series-cauchy-tail-p
    (epsilon cutoff precision-bound)
  (forall (left-terms right-terms precision)
    (implies
     (and
      (natp left-terms)
      (natp right-terms)
      (<= cutoff left-terms)
      (<= cutoff right-terms)
      (putnam-2021-b2-positive-rational-p precision)
      (<= precision precision-bound))
     (<
      (abs
       (-
        (putnam-2021-b2-weighted-prefix
         left-terms precision)
        (putnam-2021-b2-weighted-prefix
         right-terms precision)))
      epsilon))))

(defun-sk putnam-2021-b2-series-cauchy-cutoffs-exist-p
    (epsilon)
  (exists (cutoff precision-bound)
    (and
     (natp cutoff)
     (putnam-2021-b2-positive-rational-p
      precision-bound)
     (putnam-2021-b2-series-cauchy-tail-p
      epsilon cutoff precision-bound))))

(defun-sk putnam-2021-b2-series-cauchy-p ()
  (forall (epsilon)
    (implies
     (putnam-2021-b2-positive-rational-p epsilon)
     (putnam-2021-b2-series-cauchy-cutoffs-exist-p
      epsilon))))

(defun-sk putnam-2021-b2-series-limit-tail-p
    (epsilon cutoff precision-bound)
  (forall (terms term-precision target-precision)
    (implies
     (and
      (natp terms)
      (<= cutoff terms)
      (putnam-2021-b2-positive-rational-p
       term-precision)
      (<= term-precision precision-bound)
      (putnam-2021-b2-positive-rational-p
       target-precision)
      (<= target-precision precision-bound))
     (<
      (abs
       (-
        (putnam-2021-b2-weighted-prefix
         terms term-precision)
        (putnam-2021-b2-s-approx
         target-precision)))
      epsilon))))

(defun-sk putnam-2021-b2-series-limit-cutoffs-exist-p
    (epsilon)
  (exists (cutoff precision-bound)
    (and
     (natp cutoff)
     (putnam-2021-b2-positive-rational-p
      precision-bound)
     (putnam-2021-b2-series-limit-tail-p
      epsilon cutoff precision-bound))))

(defun-sk putnam-2021-b2-series-has-target-p ()
  (forall (epsilon)
    (implies
     (putnam-2021-b2-positive-rational-p epsilon)
     (putnam-2021-b2-series-limit-cutoffs-exist-p
      epsilon))))

(defun-sk putnam-2021-b2-target-at-most-two-thirds-p ()
  (forall (epsilon)
    (implies
     (putnam-2021-b2-positive-rational-p epsilon)
     (<=
      (putnam-2021-b2-s-approx epsilon)
      (+ 2/3 epsilon)))))

;; The internal existential witness for attainment is made concrete:
;; A_n = 3/4^(n+1), whose sum is 1, and
;; G_n = 3/2^(n+2), its corresponding geometric mean.

(defun putnam-2021-b2-star-a (n)
  (/ 3 (expt 4 (+ (nfix n) 1))))

(defun putnam-2021-b2-star-g (n)
  (/ 3 (expt 2 (+ (nfix n) 2))))

(defun putnam-2021-b2-star-a-prefix (terms)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix terms)))
  (if (zp terms)
      0
    (let ((index (- (nfix terms) 1)))
      (+ (putnam-2021-b2-star-a-prefix index)
         (putnam-2021-b2-star-a index)))))

(defun putnam-2021-b2-star-a-product (terms)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix terms)))
  (if (zp terms)
      1
    (let ((index (- (nfix terms) 1)))
      (* (putnam-2021-b2-star-a-product index)
         (putnam-2021-b2-star-a index)))))

(defun putnam-2021-b2-star-weighted-prefix (terms)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix terms)))
  (if (zp terms)
      0
    (let* ((index (- (nfix terms) 1))
           (n (+ index 1)))
      (+
       (putnam-2021-b2-star-weighted-prefix index)
       (*
        (/ n (expt 2 n))
        (putnam-2021-b2-star-g index))))))

(defun-sk putnam-2021-b2-star-nonnegative-p ()
  (forall (n)
    (implies
     (natp n)
     (<= 0 (putnam-2021-b2-star-a n)))))

(defun-sk putnam-2021-b2-star-sum-tail-p
    (epsilon cutoff)
  (forall (terms)
    (implies
     (and
      (natp terms)
      (<= cutoff terms))
     (<
      (abs
       (- (putnam-2021-b2-star-a-prefix terms)
          1))
      epsilon))))

(defun-sk putnam-2021-b2-star-sum-cutoff-exists-p
    (epsilon)
  (exists (cutoff)
    (and
     (natp cutoff)
     (putnam-2021-b2-star-sum-tail-p
      epsilon cutoff))))

(defun-sk putnam-2021-b2-star-sums-to-one-p ()
  (forall (epsilon)
    (implies
     (putnam-2021-b2-positive-rational-p epsilon)
     (putnam-2021-b2-star-sum-cutoff-exists-p
      epsilon))))

(defun-sk putnam-2021-b2-star-roots-p ()
  (forall (n)
    (implies
     (natp n)
     (and
      (<= 0 (putnam-2021-b2-star-g n))
      (equal
       (expt
        (putnam-2021-b2-star-g n)
        (+ n 1))
       (putnam-2021-b2-star-a-product
        (+ n 1)))))))

(defun-sk putnam-2021-b2-star-series-tail-p
    (epsilon cutoff)
  (forall (terms)
    (implies
     (and
      (natp terms)
      (<= cutoff terms))
     (<
      (abs
       (-
        (putnam-2021-b2-star-weighted-prefix terms)
        2/3))
      epsilon))))

(defun-sk putnam-2021-b2-star-series-cutoff-exists-p
    (epsilon)
  (exists (cutoff)
    (and
     (natp cutoff)
     (putnam-2021-b2-star-series-tail-p
      epsilon cutoff))))

(defun-sk putnam-2021-b2-star-series-sums-to-two-thirds-p ()
  (forall (epsilon)
    (implies
     (putnam-2021-b2-positive-rational-p epsilon)
     (putnam-2021-b2-star-series-cutoff-exists-p
      epsilon))))

;; The first conjunct is attainment of 2/3. Since the DEFSTUB functions are
;; arbitrary, the implication is universally generic over every admissible
;; real sequence, its principal geometric means, and every represented series
;; value. Its conclusion states convergence and the universal upper bound.

(defun putnambench-putnam-2021-b2-statement ()
  (and
   (putnam-2021-b2-star-nonnegative-p)
   (putnam-2021-b2-star-sums-to-one-p)
   (putnam-2021-b2-star-roots-p)
   (putnam-2021-b2-star-series-sums-to-two-thirds-p)
   (implies
    (and
     (putnam-2021-b2-sequence-regular-p :a)
     (putnam-2021-b2-sequence-nonnegative-p :a)
     (putnam-2021-b2-sums-to-one-p)
     (putnam-2021-b2-sequence-regular-p :g)
     (putnam-2021-b2-sequence-nonnegative-p :g)
     (putnam-2021-b2-geometric-means-p))
    (and
     (putnam-2021-b2-series-cauchy-p)
     (implies
      (and
       (putnam-2021-b2-target-regular-p)
       (putnam-2021-b2-series-has-target-p))
      (putnam-2021-b2-target-at-most-two-thirds-p))))))

:q

title: putnam_2021_b2
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2021_b2
-- (putnambench__agda__putnam_2021_b2): the maximum of a weighted infinite
-- series of geometric means over nonnegative real sequences summing to one
-- is two thirds. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module Putnam2021B2 where

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; _*_)

infix 4 _!=_ _<=N_
infixr 3 _and_
infixr 2 _or_

data Bottom : Set where

Not : Set -> Set
Not A =
  A -> Bottom

_!=_ : {A : Set} -> A -> A -> Set
x != y =
  Not (x == y)

record _and_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data _or_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  left  : A -> A or B
  right : B -> A or B

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

data _<=N_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set where
  zero<=N   : {n : Nat} -> zero <=N n
  suc<=sucN : {m n : Nat} -> m <=N n -> suc m <=N suc n

record CompleteOrderedRealField (R : Set) : Set1 where
  field
    zeroR oneR : R
    add multiply : R -> R -> R
    negate inverse : R -> R
    lessOrEqual : R -> R -> Set
    fromNat : Nat -> R

    one-not-zero :
      oneR != zeroR

    add-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> add x y == add y x
    add-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      add (add x y) z == add x (add y z)
    add-zero :
      (x : R) -> add x zeroR == x
    add-inverse :
      (x : R) -> add x (negate x) == zeroR

    multiply-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> multiply x y == multiply y x
    multiply-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply (multiply x y) z ==
      multiply x (multiply y z)
    multiply-one :
      (x : R) -> multiply x oneR == x
    multiply-zero :
      (x : R) -> multiply x zeroR == zeroR
    distribute :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply x (add y z) ==
      add (multiply x y) (multiply x z)
    inverse-zero :
      inverse zeroR == zeroR
    multiply-inverse :
      (x : R) ->
      x != zeroR ->
      multiply x (inverse x) == oneR

    order-reflexive :
      (x : R) -> lessOrEqual x x
    order-transitive :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y z ->
      lessOrEqual x z
    order-antisymmetric :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y x ->
      x == y
    order-total :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y or lessOrEqual y x
    add-order :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual (add z x) (add z y)
    multiply-nonnegative :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR x ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR y ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR (multiply x y)
    zero-less-than-one :
      lessOrEqual zeroR oneR and zeroR != oneR

    fromNat-zero :
      fromNat zero == zeroR
    fromNat-successor :
      (n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (suc n) == add (fromNat n) oneR
    fromNat-addition :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m + n) == add (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-multiplication :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m * n) == multiply (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-injective :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat m == fromNat n ->
      m == n

    archimedean :
      (x : R) ->
      Exists Nat
        (\ n ->
          lessOrEqual x (fromNat n))
    least-upper-bound :
      (P : R -> Set) ->
      Exists R P ->
      Exists R
        (\ upper ->
          (x : R) ->
          P x ->
          lessOrEqual x upper) ->
      Exists R
        (\ supremum ->
          ((x : R) ->
            P x ->
            lessOrEqual x supremum)
          and
          ((upper : R) ->
            ((x : R) ->
              P x ->
              lessOrEqual x upper) ->
            lessOrEqual supremum upper))

open CompleteOrderedRealField

oneN : Nat
oneN =
  suc zero

twoN : Nat
twoN =
  suc oneN

threeN : Nat
threeN =
  suc twoN

subtract :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
subtract reals x y =
  add reals x (negate reals y)

divide :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
divide reals x y =
  multiply reals x (inverse reals y)

StrictLess :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
StrictLess reals x y =
  lessOrEqual reals x y and x != y

CloseTo :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
CloseTo reals center radius x =
  StrictLess reals
    (subtract reals center radius)
    x
  and
  StrictLess reals
    x
    (add reals center radius)

naturalPower :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  Nat ->
  R
naturalPower reals x zero =
  oneR reals
naturalPower reals x (suc n) =
  multiply reals
    (naturalPower reals x n)
    x

sumFirst :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Nat ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  R
sumFirst reals zero term =
  zeroR reals
sumFirst reals (suc n) term =
  add reals
    (sumFirst reals n term)
    (term n)

productFirst :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Nat ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  R
productFirst reals zero term =
  oneR reals
productFirst reals (suc n) term =
  multiply reals
    (productFirst reals n term)
    (term n)

ConvergesTo :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  R ->
  Set
ConvergesTo {R} reals sequence limit =
  (epsilon : R) ->
  StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) epsilon ->
  Exists Nat
    (\ cutoff ->
      (n : Nat) ->
      cutoff <=N n ->
      CloseTo reals limit epsilon (sequence n))

SeriesHasSum :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  R ->
  Set
SeriesHasSum reals terms limit =
  ConvergesTo reals
    (\ n -> sumFirst reals n terms)
    limit

Nonnegative :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  Set
Nonnegative reals x =
  lessOrEqual reals (zeroR reals) x

PrefixRoots :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  Set
PrefixRoots reals sequence roots =
  (n : Nat) ->
  Nonnegative reals (roots n)
  and
  naturalPower reals (roots n) (suc n) ==
    productFirst reals (suc n) sequence

weightedGeometricMeanTerm :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  Nat ->
  R
weightedGeometricMeanTerm reals roots n =
  multiply reals
    (divide reals
      (fromNat reals (suc n))
      (naturalPower reals
        (fromNat reals twoN)
        (suc n)))
    (roots n)

AdmissibleSequence :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  Set
AdmissibleSequence reals sequence =
  ((k : Nat) ->
    Nonnegative reals (sequence k))
  and
  SeriesHasSum reals sequence (oneR reals)

AttainableValue :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  Set
AttainableValue {R} reals total =
  Exists (Nat -> R)
    (\ sequence ->
      AdmissibleSequence reals sequence
      and
      Exists (Nat -> R)
        (\ roots ->
          PrefixRoots reals sequence roots
          and
          SeriesHasSum reals
            (weightedGeometricMeanTerm reals roots)
            total))

IsGreatestAttainableValue :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  Set
IsGreatestAttainableValue {R} reals maximum =
  AttainableValue reals maximum
  and
  ((value : R) ->
    AttainableValue reals value ->
    lessOrEqual reals value maximum)

putnam-2021-b2 : Set1
putnam-2021-b2 =
  (R : Set) ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) ->
  IsGreatestAttainableValue reals
    (divide reals
      (fromNat reals twoN)
      (fromNat reals threeN))

(*
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2021_b2:
  the maximum weighted infinite sum of initial geometric means over
  nonnegative real sequences with sum one is 2/3. This file contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open arithmeticTheory pred_setTheory realTheory real_sigmaTheory seqTheory
     transcTheory;

val putnam_2021_b2 =
  ``let admissible =
      \a : num -> real.
        (!k : num. 0 <= a k) /\
        a sums 1
    in
    let term =
      \a : num -> real.
      \n : num.
        (&(SUC n) : real) / ((2 : real) pow (SUC n)) *
        (REAL_PROD_IMAGE a (count (SUC n))) powr

    in
    let solution = (2 / 3 : real)
    in
      attainable solution /\
      !S : real. attainable S ==> S <= solution``;

title: putnam_2021_b2
content:
% Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2021_b2:
% the greatest value of a weighted infinite series of geometric means of
% prefixes of a nonnegative real sequence with sum 1 is 2/3. This file
% contains no proof.

putnam_2021_b2: THEORY
BEGIN
  real_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> real]
  real_set: TYPE = [real -> bool]

  safe_div(numerator, denominator: real): real =
    IF denominator = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      numerator / denominator
    ENDIF

  prefix_sum(values: real_sequence, count: nat): RECURSIVE real =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      prefix_sum(values, count - 1) + values(count - 1)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  prefix_product(values: real_sequence, count: nat): RECURSIVE real =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      1
    ELSE
      prefix_product(values, count - 1) * values(count - 1)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  series_sums_to(values: real_sequence, total: real): bool =
    FORALL (epsilon_value: posreal):
      EXISTS (cutoff: nat):
        FORALL (count: nat):
          cutoff <= count IMPLIES
            abs(prefix_sum(values, count) - total) < epsilon_value

  admissible(a: real_sequence): bool =
    (FORALL (index: nat): 0 <= a(index))
      AND series_sums_to(a, 1)

  prefix_geometric_means(
      a, roots: real_sequence): bool =
    FORALL (index: nat):
      0 <= roots(index)
        AND roots(index) ^ (index + 1)
          = prefix_product(a, index + 1)

  weighted_terms(roots: real_sequence): real_sequence =
    LAMBDA (index: nat):
      safe_div(
        (index + 1) :: real,
        (2 :: real) ^ (index + 1))
        * roots(index)

  attainable_values: real_set =
    LAMBDA (total: real):
      EXISTS (a, roots: real_sequence):
        admissible(a)
          AND prefix_geometric_means(a, roots)
          AND series_sums_to(weighted_terms(roots), total)

  is_greatest(values: real_set, greatest_value: real): bool =
    values(greatest_value)
      AND FORALL (value: real):
        values(value) IMPLIES value <= greatest_value

  putnam_2021_b2_solution: real =
    safe_div(2, 3)

  putnam_2021_b2: bool =
    is_greatest(
      attainable_values,
      putnam_2021_b2_solution)
END putnam_2021_b2

import Mathlib

open Filter Topology Metric

abbrev putnam_2021_b3_solution : Prop := sorry
-- True
/--
Let $h(x,y)$ be a real-valued function that is twice continuously differentiable throughout $\mathbb{R}^2$, and define $\rho(x,y)=yh_x-xh_y$. Prove or disprove: For any positive constants $d$ and $r$ with $d>r$, there is a circle $\mathcal{S}$ of radius $r$ whose center is a distance $d$ away from the origin such that the integral of $\rho$ over the interior of $\mathcal{S}$ is zero.
-/
theorem putnam_2021_b3
  (rho : ((EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) → ℝ) → (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) → ℝ)
  (rho_def : ∀ (h : (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) → ℝ) (p : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)),
    rho h p = (p 1) *
      deriv (fun x' : ℝ => h !₂[x', p 1]) (p 0)
      - (p 0) * deriv (fun y' : ℝ => h !₂[p 0, y']) (p 1)) :
  (∀ h : (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ 2 h →
    (∀ d > 0, ∀ r > 0, d > r → (∃ c : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), dist c 0 = d ∧ (∫ p in (ball c r), rho h p) = 0)))
  ↔ putnam_2021_b3_solution :=
sorry

title: putnam_2021_b3
content:
(* Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2021_b3:
   every twice continuously differentiable real function on the plane has,
   for each pair of parameters 0 < r < d, a disk of radius r centered at distance
   d from the origin on which the integral of y h_x - x h_y is zero; the
   assertion is true. This file contains no proof. *)

From Stdlib Require Import Reals ClassicalEpsilon RiemannInt.

Open Scope R_scope.

Definition putnam_2021_b3_point : Type := (R * R)%type.

Definition putnam_2021_b3_real_derivative
    (f : R -> R) (x : R) : R :=
  epsilon (inhabits (0 : R))
    (fun derivative : R => derivable_pt_lim f x derivative).

Definition putnam_2021_b3_partial_x
    (h : putnam_2021_b3_point -> R)
    (p : putnam_2021_b3_point) : R :=
  putnam_2021_b3_real_derivative
    (fun x : R => h (x, snd p))
    (fst p).

Definition putnam_2021_b3_partial_y
    (h : putnam_2021_b3_point -> R)
    (p : putnam_2021_b3_point) : R :=
  putnam_2021_b3_real_derivative
    (fun y : R => h (fst p, y))
    (snd p).

Definition putnam_2021_b3_partial_xx
    (h : putnam_2021_b3_point -> R)
    (p : putnam_2021_b3_point) : R :=
  putnam_2021_b3_real_derivative
    (fun x : R => putnam_2021_b3_partial_x h (x, snd p))
    (fst p).

Definition putnam_2021_b3_partial_xy
    (h : putnam_2021_b3_point -> R)
    (p : putnam_2021_b3_point) : R :=
  putnam_2021_b3_real_derivative
    (fun y : R => putnam_2021_b3_partial_x h (fst p, y))
    (snd p).

Definition putnam_2021_b3_partial_yx
    (h : putnam_2021_b3_point -> R)
    (p : putnam_2021_b3_point) : R :=
  putnam_2021_b3_real_derivative
    (fun x : R => putnam_2021_b3_partial_y h (x, snd p))
    (fst p).

Definition putnam_2021_b3_partial_yy
    (h : putnam_2021_b3_point -> R)
    (p : putnam_2021_b3_point) : R :=
  putnam_2021_b3_real_derivative
    (fun y : R => putnam_2021_b3_partial_y h (fst p, y))
    (snd p).

Definition putnam_2021_b3_continuous_plane
    (f : putnam_2021_b3_point -> R) : Prop :=
  forall p : putnam_2021_b3_point,
    forall eps : R,
      eps > 0 ->
      exists delta : R,
        delta > 0 /\
        forall q : putnam_2021_b3_point,
          Rabs (fst q - fst p) < delta ->
          Rabs (snd q - snd p) < delta ->
          Rabs (f q - f p) < eps.

Definition putnam_2021_b3_contdiff_two
    (h : putnam_2021_b3_point -> R) : Prop :=
  (forall p : putnam_2021_b3_point,
    derivable_pt_lim
      (fun x : R => h (x, snd p))
      (fst p)
      (putnam_2021_b3_partial_x h p) /\
    derivable_pt_lim
      (fun y : R => h (fst p, y))
      (snd p)
      (putnam_2021_b3_partial_y h p) /\
    derivable_pt_lim
      (fun x : R => putnam_2021_b3_partial_x h (x, snd p))
      (fst p)
      (putnam_2021_b3_partial_xx h p) /\
    derivable_pt_lim
      (fun y : R => putnam_2021_b3_partial_x h (fst p, y))
      (snd p)
      (putnam_2021_b3_partial_xy h p) /\
    derivable_pt_lim
      (fun x : R => putnam_2021_b3_partial_y h (x, snd p))
      (fst p)
      (putnam_2021_b3_partial_yx h p) /\
    derivable_pt_lim
      (fun y : R => putnam_2021_b3_partial_y h (fst p, y))
      (snd p)
      (putnam_2021_b3_partial_yy h p)) /\
  putnam_2021_b3_continuous_plane h /\
  putnam_2021_b3_continuous_plane
    (putnam_2021_b3_partial_x h) /\
  putnam_2021_b3_continuous_plane
    (putnam_2021_b3_partial_y h) /\
  putnam_2021_b3_continuous_plane
    (putnam_2021_b3_partial_xx h) /\
  putnam_2021_b3_continuous_plane
    (putnam_2021_b3_partial_xy h) /\
  putnam_2021_b3_continuous_plane
    (putnam_2021_b3_partial_yx h) /\
  putnam_2021_b3_continuous_plane
    (putnam_2021_b3_partial_yy h).

Definition putnam_2021_b3_rho
    (h : putnam_2021_b3_point -> R)
    (p : putnam_2021_b3_point) : R :=
  snd p * putnam_2021_b3_partial_x h p -
  fst p * putnam_2021_b3_partial_y h p.

Definition putnam_2021_b3_distance
    (p q : putnam_2021_b3_point) : R :=
  sqrt ((fst p - fst q) ^ 2 + (snd p - snd q) ^ 2).

Definition putnam_2021_b3_disk_integral_has_value
    (f : putnam_2021_b3_point -> R)
    (center : putnam_2021_b3_point)
    (radius value : R) : Prop :=
  exists inner_integral : R -> R,
    (forall x : R,
      fst center - radius <= x <= fst center + radius ->
      exists inner_integrable :
        Riemann_integrable
          (fun y : R => f (x, y))
          (snd center -
            sqrt (radius ^ 2 - (x - fst center) ^ 2))
          (snd center +
            sqrt (radius ^ 2 - (x - fst center) ^ 2)),
        inner_integral x = RiemannInt inner_integrable) /\
    exists outer_integrable :
      Riemann_integrable
        inner_integral
        (fst center - radius)
        (fst center + radius),
      value = RiemannInt outer_integrable.

Definition putnam_2021_b3_solution : Prop := True.

Theorem putnam_2021_b3 :
  ((forall h : putnam_2021_b3_point -> R,
      putnam_2021_b3_contdiff_two h ->
      forall d r : R,
        0 < d ->
        0 < r ->
        d > r ->
        exists center : putnam_2021_b3_point,
          putnam_2021_b3_distance center (0, 0) = d /\
          putnam_2021_b3_disk_integral_has_value
            (putnam_2021_b3_rho h)
            center
            r
            0) <->
    putnam_2021_b3_solution).
Admitted.

title: putnam_2021_b3
content:
theory putnam_2021_b3 imports
Complex_Main
"HOL-Analysis.Derivative"
"HOL-Analysis.Finite_Cartesian_Product"
"HOL-Analysis.Set_Integral"
"HOL-Analysis.Lebesgue_Measure"
begin

definition putnam_2021_b3_solution :: bool where
  "putnam_2021_b3_solution \<equiv> True"
(* True *)
theorem putnam_2021_b3:
  fixes C2diff :: "(real \<times> real \<Rightarrow> real) \<Rightarrow> bool"
  and hx hy hxx hxy hyx hyy ::
    "(real \<times> real \<Rightarrow> real) \<Rightarrow> real \<times> real \<Rightarrow> real"
  and rho :: "(real \<times> real \<Rightarrow> real) \<Rightarrow> real \<times> real \<Rightarrow> real"
  and circint :: "real \<times> real \<Rightarrow> real \<Rightarrow> (real \<times> real) set"
  defines "hx \<equiv> \<lambda>h (x, y). deriv (\<lambda>u. h (u, y)) x"
  and "hy \<equiv> \<lambda>h (x, y). deriv (\<lambda>v. h (x, v)) y"
  and "hxx \<equiv> \<lambda>h (x, y). deriv (\<lambda>u. hx h (u, y)) x"
  and "hxy \<equiv> \<lambda>h (x, y). deriv (\<lambda>v. hx h (x, v)) y"
  and "hyx \<equiv> \<lambda>h (x, y). deriv (\<lambda>u. hy h (u, y)) x"
  and "hyy \<equiv> \<lambda>h (x, y). deriv (\<lambda>v. hy h (x, v)) y"
  and "C2diff \<equiv> \<lambda>h.
    (\<forall>y.
      (\<lambda>x. h (x, y)) differentiable_on UNIV \<and>
      (\<lambda>x. hx h (x, y)) differentiable_on UNIV \<and>
      (\<lambda>x. hy h (x, y)) differentiable_on UNIV) \<and>
    (\<forall>x.
      (\<lambda>y. h (x, y)) differentiable_on UNIV \<and>
      (\<lambda>y. hx h (x, y)) differentiable_on UNIV \<and>
      (\<lambda>y. hy h (x, y)) differentiable_on UNIV) \<and>
    continuous_on UNIV h \<and>
    continuous_on UNIV (hx h) \<and>
    continuous_on UNIV (hy h) \<and>
    continuous_on UNIV (hxx h) \<and>
    continuous_on UNIV (hxy h) \<and>
    continuous_on UNIV (hyx h) \<and>
    continuous_on UNIV (hyy h)"
  and "rho \<equiv> \<lambda>h (x, y). y * hx h (x, y) - x * hy h (x, y)"
  and "circint \<equiv> \<lambda> c r. {p :: real \<times> real. dist p c < r}"
  shows "(\<forall>h :: real \<times> real \<Rightarrow> real.
    C2diff h \<longrightarrow>
    (\<forall>d>0. \<forall>r>0. d > r \<longrightarrow>
      (\<exists>c :: real \<times> real.
        dist c 0 = d \<and>
        set_lebesgue_integral lebesgue (circint c r) (rho h) = 0)))
      \<longleftrightarrow> putnam_2021_b3_solution"
  sorry

end

title: putnam_2021_b3
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2021_b3
  (putnambench__hol-light__putnam_2021_b3): a zero disk integral for the
  angular derivative of every twice continuously differentiable real-valued
  function on the plane. This file contains no proof.
*)

let analysis_output = open_out "/dev/null";;
let analysis_formatter = Format.formatter_of_out_channel analysis_output;;
let analysis_loaded =
  Toploop.use_file analysis_formatter "Library/transc.ml";;
Format.pp_print_flush analysis_formatter ();;
close_out analysis_output;;
if not analysis_loaded then failwith "failed to load Library/transc.ml";;

let statement =
  `let point =
     \(x:real) (y:real).
       (lambda i. if i = 1 then x else y):real^2 in
   let xrepl =
     \(x:real^2) (i:num) (t:real).
       (lambda k. if k = i then t else x$k):real^2 in
   let has_derivative_at =
     \(f:real->real) (d:real) (x:real).
       !e:real.
         &0 < e
         ==> ?delta:real.
               &0 < delta /\
               !y:real.
                 &0 < abs (y - x) /\ abs (y - x) < delta
                 ==> abs ((f y - f x) / (y - x) - d) < e in
   let continuous_on_plane =
     \(f:real^2->real).
       !x:real^2. !e:real.
         &0 < e
         ==> ?delta:real.
               &0 < delta /\
               !y:real^2.
                 sqrt
                   ((y$1 - x$1) pow 2 + (y$2 - x$2) pow 2) < delta
                 ==> abs (f y - f x) < e in
   let partial =
     \(h:real^2->real) (i:num) (x:real^2).
       @d:real.
         has_derivative_at
           (\t:real. h (xrepl x i t)) d (x$i) in
   let second_partial =
     \(h:real^2->real) (i:num) (j:num) (x:real^2).
       @d:real.
         has_derivative_at
           (\t:real. partial h i (xrepl x j t)) d (x$j) in
   let twice_continuously_differentiable =
     \(h:real^2->real).
       (!i:num.
          1 <= i /\ i <= 2
          ==>
          (!x:real^2.
             has_derivative_at
               (\t:real. h (xrepl x i t))
               (partial h i x) (x$i)) /\
          continuous_on_plane (partial h i)) /\
       (!i j:num.
          1 <= i /\ i <= 2 /\ 1 <= j /\ j <= 2
          ==>
          (!x:real^2.
             has_derivative_at
               (\t:real. partial h i (xrepl x j t))
               (second_partial h i j x) (x$j)) /\
          continuous_on_plane (second_partial h i j)) in
   let rho =
     \(h:real^2->real) (x:real^2).
       x$2 * partial h 1 x - x$1 * partial h 2 x in
   let disk_integral =
     \(h:real^2->real) (c:real^2) (r:real).
       integral(c$1 - r,c$1 + r)
         (\x:real.
            integral
              (c$2 - sqrt (r pow 2 - (x - c$1) pow 2),
               c$2 + sqrt (r pow 2 - (x - c$1) pow 2))
              (\y:real. rho h (point x y))) in
   let putnam_2021_b3_solution = T in
   ((!h:real^2->real.
       twice_continuously_differentiable h
       ==>
       !d r:real.
         &0 < d /\ &0 < r /\ r < d
         ==>
         ?c:real^2.
           sqrt ((c$1) pow 2 + (c$2) pow 2) = d /\
           disk_integral h c r = &0)
    <=>
    putnam_2021_b3_solution)`;;

;; every twice continuously differentiable real function on the plane has,
;; for each d > r > 0, a radius-r disk centered distance d from the origin
;; on which the integral of y*h_x-x*h_y is zero. This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))

;; A Dedekind-complete ordered field presents the real numbers up to unique
;; ordered-field isomorphism. APPLY$ objects present arbitrary predicates and
;; real-valued functions. All field, function, differentiability, continuity,
;; and integration conditions used by the statement are explicit below.

(defun p21b3-member-p (carrier x)
  (if (apply$ carrier (list x)) t nil))

(defun p21b3-unary-value (function x)
  (apply$ function (list x)))

(defun p21b3-binary-value (operation x y)
  (apply$ operation (list x y)))

(defun-sk p21b3-valid-set-p (carrier set)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (apply$ set (list x))
     (p21b3-member-p carrier x))))

(defun-sk p21b3-field-laws-p
    (carrier add multiply negate inverse zero one)
  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (p21b3-member-p carrier x)
      (p21b3-member-p carrier y)
      (p21b3-member-p carrier z))
     (and
      (p21b3-member-p
       carrier (p21b3-binary-value add x y))
      (p21b3-member-p
       carrier (p21b3-binary-value multiply x y))
      (p21b3-member-p
       carrier (p21b3-unary-value negate x))
      (p21b3-member-p
       carrier (p21b3-unary-value inverse x))
      (equal
       (p21b3-binary-value
        add (p21b3-binary-value add x y) z)
       (p21b3-binary-value
        add x (p21b3-binary-value add y z)))
      (equal
       (p21b3-binary-value add x y)
       (p21b3-binary-value add y x))
      (equal (p21b3-binary-value add x zero) x)
      (equal
       (p21b3-binary-value
        add x (p21b3-unary-value negate x))
       zero)
      (equal
       (p21b3-binary-value
        multiply
        (p21b3-binary-value multiply x y)
        z)
       (p21b3-binary-value
        multiply
        x
        (p21b3-binary-value multiply y z)))
      (equal
       (p21b3-binary-value multiply x y)
       (p21b3-binary-value multiply y x))
      (equal
       (p21b3-binary-value multiply x one)
       x)
      (implies
       (equal x zero)
       (equal (p21b3-unary-value inverse x) zero))
      (implies
       (not (equal x zero))
       (equal
        (p21b3-binary-value
         multiply x (p21b3-unary-value inverse x))
        one))
      (equal
       (p21b3-binary-value
        multiply x (p21b3-binary-value add y z))
       (p21b3-binary-value
        add
        (p21b3-binary-value multiply x y)
        (p21b3-binary-value multiply x z)))))))

(defun-sk p21b3-order-laws-p
    (carrier add multiply zero less)
  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (p21b3-member-p carrier x)
      (p21b3-member-p carrier y)
      (p21b3-member-p carrier z))
     (and
      (not (p21b3-binary-value less x x))
      (or
       (equal x y)
       (p21b3-binary-value less x y)
       (p21b3-binary-value less y x))
      (implies
       (and
        (p21b3-binary-value less x y)
        (p21b3-binary-value less y z))
       (p21b3-binary-value less x z))
      (implies
       (p21b3-binary-value less x y)
       (p21b3-binary-value
        less
        (p21b3-binary-value add x z)
        (p21b3-binary-value add y z)))
      (implies
       (and
        (p21b3-binary-value less zero x)
        (p21b3-binary-value less zero y))
       (p21b3-binary-value
        less
        zero
        (p21b3-binary-value multiply x y)))))))

(defun-sk p21b3-set-nonempty-p (carrier set)
  (exists (x)
    (and
     (p21b3-member-p carrier x)
     (apply$ set (list x)))))

(defun-sk p21b3-upper-bound-p
    (carrier less set bound)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (and
      (p21b3-member-p carrier x)
      (apply$ set (list x)))
     (not
      (p21b3-binary-value less bound x)))))

(defun-sk p21b3-bounded-above-p
    (carrier less set)
  (exists (bound)
    (and
     (p21b3-member-p carrier bound)
     (p21b3-upper-bound-p carrier less set bound))))

(defun-sk p21b3-least-upper-bound-p
    (carrier less set supremum)
  (forall (bound)
    (implies
     (and
      (p21b3-member-p carrier bound)
      (p21b3-upper-bound-p carrier less set bound))
     (not
      (p21b3-binary-value less bound supremum)))))

(defun p21b3-supremum-p
    (carrier less set supremum)
  (and
   (p21b3-member-p carrier supremum)
   (p21b3-upper-bound-p carrier less set supremum)
   (p21b3-least-upper-bound-p
    carrier less set supremum)))

(defun-sk p21b3-has-supremum-p
    (carrier less set)
  (exists (supremum)
    (p21b3-supremum-p
     carrier less set supremum)))

(defun-sk p21b3-dedekind-complete-p
    (carrier less)
  (forall (set)
    (implies
     (and
      (tamep-functionp set)
      (p21b3-valid-set-p carrier set)
      (p21b3-set-nonempty-p carrier set)
      (p21b3-bounded-above-p carrier less set))
     (p21b3-has-supremum-p carrier less set))))

(defun p21b3-real-field-p
    (carrier add multiply negate inverse zero one less)
  (and
   (tamep-functionp carrier)
   (tamep-functionp add)
   (tamep-functionp multiply)
   (tamep-functionp negate)
   (tamep-functionp inverse)
   (tamep-functionp less)
   (p21b3-member-p carrier zero)
   (p21b3-member-p carrier one)
   (not (equal zero one))
   (p21b3-field-laws-p
    carrier add multiply negate inverse zero one)
   (p21b3-order-laws-p
    carrier add multiply zero less)
   (p21b3-binary-value less zero one)
   (p21b3-dedekind-complete-p carrier less)))

;; The context slots are carrier, zero, one, addition, multiplication,
;; negation, inverse, and strict order.

(defun p21b3-r-carrier (ctx) (nth 0 ctx))
(defun p21b3-r-zero (ctx) (nth 1 ctx))
(defun p21b3-r-one (ctx) (nth 2 ctx))
(defun p21b3-r-add (ctx) (nth 3 ctx))
(defun p21b3-r-mul (ctx) (nth 4 ctx))
(defun p21b3-r-neg (ctx) (nth 5 ctx))
(defun p21b3-r-inv (ctx) (nth 6 ctx))
(defun p21b3-r-lt (ctx) (nth 7 ctx))

(defun p21b3-context-p (ctx)
  (and
   (true-listp ctx)
   (equal (len ctx) 8)
   (p21b3-real-field-p
    (p21b3-r-carrier ctx)
    (p21b3-r-add ctx)
    (p21b3-r-mul ctx)
    (p21b3-r-neg ctx)
    (p21b3-r-inv ctx)
    (p21b3-r-zero ctx)
    (p21b3-r-one ctx)
    (p21b3-r-lt ctx))))

(defun p21b3-r-add-value (ctx x y)
  (p21b3-binary-value (p21b3-r-add ctx) x y))

(defun p21b3-r-mul-value (ctx x y)
  (p21b3-binary-value (p21b3-r-mul ctx) x y))

(defun p21b3-r-neg-value (ctx x)
  (p21b3-unary-value (p21b3-r-neg ctx) x))

(defun p21b3-r-inv-value (ctx x)
  (p21b3-unary-value (p21b3-r-inv ctx) x))

(defun p21b3-r-sub-value (ctx x y)
  (p21b3-r-add-value
   ctx x (p21b3-r-neg-value ctx y)))

(defun p21b3-r-div-value (ctx x y)
  (p21b3-r-mul-value
   ctx x (p21b3-r-inv-value ctx y)))

(defun p21b3-r-square (ctx x)
  (p21b3-r-mul-value ctx x x))

(defun p21b3-r-lt-p (ctx x y)
  (if (p21b3-binary-value
       (p21b3-r-lt ctx) x y)
      t nil))

(defun p21b3-r-abs-value (ctx x)
  (if (p21b3-r-lt-p
       ctx x (p21b3-r-zero ctx))
      (p21b3-r-neg-value ctx x)
    x))

(defun p21b3-positive-real-p (ctx x)
  (and
   (p21b3-member-p (p21b3-r-carrier ctx) x)
   (p21b3-r-lt-p
    ctx (p21b3-r-zero ctx) x)))

(defun p21b3-nat-cast (ctx n)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix n)))
  (if (zp n)
      (p21b3-r-zero ctx)
    (p21b3-r-add-value
     ctx
     (p21b3-r-one ctx)
     (p21b3-nat-cast ctx (- n 1)))))

(defun p21b3-plane-point (x y)
  (cons x y))

(defun p21b3-plane-value (function x y)
  (p21b3-unary-value
   function (p21b3-plane-point x y)))

(defun-sk p21b3-plane-function-values-p
    (ctx function)
  (forall (x y)
    (implies
     (and
      (p21b3-member-p (p21b3-r-carrier ctx) x)
      (p21b3-member-p (p21b3-r-carrier ctx) y))
     (p21b3-member-p
      (p21b3-r-carrier ctx)
      (p21b3-plane-value function x y)))))

(defun p21b3-plane-function-p (ctx function)
  (and
   (tamep-functionp function)
   (p21b3-plane-function-values-p ctx function)))

;; Continuity uses the max-coordinate metric, which induces exactly the
;; Euclidean topology on the real plane.

(defun-sk p21b3-continuity-neighborhood-p
    (ctx function x y epsilon delta)
  (forall (u v)
    (implies
     (and
      (p21b3-member-p (p21b3-r-carrier ctx) u)
      (p21b3-member-p (p21b3-r-carrier ctx) v)
      (p21b3-r-lt-p
       ctx
       (p21b3-r-abs-value
        ctx (p21b3-r-sub-value ctx u x))
       delta)
      (p21b3-r-lt-p
       ctx
       (p21b3-r-abs-value
        ctx (p21b3-r-sub-value ctx v y))
       delta))
     (p21b3-r-lt-p
      ctx
      (p21b3-r-abs-value
       ctx
       (p21b3-r-sub-value
        ctx
        (p21b3-plane-value function u v)
        (p21b3-plane-value function x y)))
      epsilon))))

(defun-sk p21b3-continuity-radius-exists-p
    (ctx function x y epsilon)
  (exists (delta)
    (and
     (p21b3-positive-real-p ctx delta)
     (p21b3-continuity-neighborhood-p
      ctx function x y epsilon delta))))

(defun-sk p21b3-continuous-p
    (ctx function)
  (forall (x y epsilon)
    (implies
     (and
      (p21b3-member-p (p21b3-r-carrier ctx) x)
      (p21b3-member-p (p21b3-r-carrier ctx) y)
      (p21b3-positive-real-p ctx epsilon))
     (p21b3-continuity-radius-exists-p
      ctx function x y epsilon))))

;; The remainder definition below is equivalent to the usual one-variable
;; derivative limit in each coordinate.

(defun p21b3-shifted-value
    (ctx function x y increment x-direction-p)
  (if x-direction-p
      (p21b3-plane-value
       function
       (p21b3-r-add-value ctx x increment)
       y)
    (p21b3-plane-value
     function
     x
     (p21b3-r-add-value ctx y increment))))

(defun-sk p21b3-partial-neighborhood-p
    (ctx function derivative x y epsilon delta x-direction-p)
  (forall (increment)
    (implies
     (and
      (p21b3-member-p
       (p21b3-r-carrier ctx) increment)
      (p21b3-r-lt-p
       ctx
       (p21b3-r-zero ctx)
       (p21b3-r-abs-value ctx increment))
      (p21b3-r-lt-p
       ctx
       (p21b3-r-abs-value ctx increment)
       delta))
     (p21b3-r-lt-p
      ctx
      (p21b3-r-abs-value
       ctx
       (p21b3-r-sub-value
        ctx
        (p21b3-r-sub-value
         ctx
         (p21b3-shifted-value
          ctx function x y increment x-direction-p)
         (p21b3-plane-value function x y))
        (p21b3-r-mul-value
         ctx
         (p21b3-plane-value derivative x y)
         increment)))
      (p21b3-r-mul-value
       ctx epsilon
       (p21b3-r-abs-value ctx increment))))))

(defun-sk p21b3-partial-radius-exists-p
    (ctx function derivative x y epsilon x-direction-p)
  (exists (delta)
    (and
     (p21b3-positive-real-p ctx delta)
     (p21b3-partial-neighborhood-p
      ctx function derivative x y
      epsilon delta x-direction-p))))

(defun-sk p21b3-partial-values-p
    (ctx function derivative x-direction-p)
  (forall (x y epsilon)
    (implies
     (and
      (p21b3-member-p (p21b3-r-carrier ctx) x)
      (p21b3-member-p (p21b3-r-carrier ctx) y)
      (p21b3-positive-real-p ctx epsilon))
     (p21b3-partial-radius-exists-p
      ctx function derivative x y
      epsilon x-direction-p))))

(defun p21b3-partial-derivative-function-p
    (ctx function derivative x-direction-p)
  (and
   (p21b3-plane-function-p ctx function)
   (p21b3-plane-function-p ctx derivative)
   (p21b3-partial-values-p
    ctx function derivative x-direction-p)))

;; The package contains h_x, h_y, h_xx, h_xy, h_yx, and h_yy.

(defun p21b3-hx (derivatives) (nth 0 derivatives))
(defun p21b3-hy (derivatives) (nth 1 derivatives))
(defun p21b3-hxx (derivatives) (nth 2 derivatives))
(defun p21b3-hxy (derivatives) (nth 3 derivatives))
(defun p21b3-hyx (derivatives) (nth 4 derivatives))
(defun p21b3-hyy (derivatives) (nth 5 derivatives))

(defun p21b3-c2-derivative-package-p
    (ctx function derivatives)
  (and
   (true-listp derivatives)
   (equal (len derivatives) 6)
   (p21b3-plane-function-p ctx function)
   (p21b3-continuous-p ctx function)
   (p21b3-continuous-p ctx (p21b3-hx derivatives))
   (p21b3-continuous-p ctx (p21b3-hy derivatives))
   (p21b3-continuous-p ctx (p21b3-hxx derivatives))
   (p21b3-continuous-p ctx (p21b3-hxy derivatives))
   (p21b3-continuous-p ctx (p21b3-hyx derivatives))
   (p21b3-continuous-p ctx (p21b3-hyy derivatives))
   (p21b3-partial-derivative-function-p
    ctx function (p21b3-hx derivatives) t)
   (p21b3-partial-derivative-function-p
    ctx function (p21b3-hy derivatives) nil)
   (p21b3-partial-derivative-function-p
    ctx (p21b3-hx derivatives) (p21b3-hxx derivatives) t)
   (p21b3-partial-derivative-function-p
    ctx (p21b3-hx derivatives) (p21b3-hxy derivatives) nil)
   (p21b3-partial-derivative-function-p
    ctx (p21b3-hy derivatives) (p21b3-hyx derivatives) t)
   (p21b3-partial-derivative-function-p
    ctx (p21b3-hy derivatives) (p21b3-hyy derivatives) nil)))

(defun-sk p21b3-c2-function-p (ctx function)
  (exists (derivatives)
    (p21b3-c2-derivative-package-p
     ctx function derivatives)))

;; Partial derivatives are unique. This conservative choice keeps their
;; witnesses internal to the C^2 predicate.

(defchoose p21b3-chosen-derivatives
    (derivatives)
    (ctx function)
  (p21b3-c2-derivative-package-p
   ctx function derivatives))

(defun p21b3-rho-value (ctx function x y)
  (let ((derivatives
         (p21b3-chosen-derivatives ctx function)))
    (p21b3-r-sub-value
     ctx
     (p21b3-r-mul-value
      ctx y
      (p21b3-plane-value
       (p21b3-hx derivatives) x y))
     (p21b3-r-mul-value
      ctx x
      (p21b3-plane-value
       (p21b3-hy derivatives) x y)))))

;; Uniform square-grid Riemann sums converge to the integral over the open
;; disk: the indicator's only discontinuities lie on the boundary circle,
;; which has area zero. The limit is unbounded in the subdivision count.

(defun p21b3-grid-step (ctx radius subdivisions)
  (p21b3-r-div-value
   ctx
   (p21b3-r-add-value ctx radius radius)
   (p21b3-nat-cast ctx subdivisions)))

(defun p21b3-grid-coordinate
    (ctx center radius subdivisions index)
  (p21b3-r-add-value
   ctx
   (p21b3-r-sub-value ctx center radius)
   (p21b3-r-mul-value
    ctx
    (p21b3-nat-cast ctx index)
    (p21b3-grid-step ctx radius subdivisions))))

(defun p21b3-in-open-disk-p
    (ctx x y center-x center-y radius)
  (p21b3-r-lt-p
   ctx
   (p21b3-r-add-value
    ctx
    (p21b3-r-square
     ctx (p21b3-r-sub-value ctx x center-x))
    (p21b3-r-square
     ctx (p21b3-r-sub-value ctx y center-y)))
   (p21b3-r-square ctx radius)))

(defun p21b3-grid-row-sum
    (ctx function center-x center-y radius
     subdivisions x-index y-index)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix y-index)))
  (if (zp y-index)
      (p21b3-r-zero ctx)
    (let ((x
           (p21b3-grid-coordinate
            ctx center-x radius subdivisions x-index))
          (y
           (p21b3-grid-coordinate
            ctx center-y radius subdivisions y-index)))
      (p21b3-r-add-value
       ctx
       (if (p21b3-in-open-disk-p
            ctx x y center-x center-y radius)
           (p21b3-rho-value ctx function x y)
         (p21b3-r-zero ctx))
       (p21b3-grid-row-sum
        ctx function center-x center-y radius
        subdivisions x-index (- y-index 1))))))

(defun p21b3-grid-sum
    (ctx function center-x center-y radius
     subdivisions x-index)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix x-index)))
  (if (zp x-index)
      (p21b3-r-zero ctx)
    (p21b3-r-add-value
     ctx
     (p21b3-grid-row-sum
      ctx function center-x center-y radius
      subdivisions x-index subdivisions)
     (p21b3-grid-sum
      ctx function center-x center-y radius
      subdivisions (- x-index 1)))))

(defun p21b3-disk-integral-approx
    (ctx function center-x center-y radius subdivisions)
  (if (posp subdivisions)
      (let ((step
             (p21b3-grid-step
              ctx radius subdivisions)))
        (p21b3-r-mul-value
         ctx
         (p21b3-grid-sum
          ctx function center-x center-y radius
          subdivisions subdivisions)
         (p21b3-r-square ctx step)))
    (p21b3-r-zero ctx)))

(defun-sk p21b3-integral-tail-p
    (ctx function center-x center-y radius
     value epsilon cutoff)
  (forall (subdivisions)
    (implies
     (and
      (posp subdivisions)
      (<= cutoff subdivisions))
     (p21b3-r-lt-p
      ctx
      (p21b3-r-abs-value
       ctx
       (p21b3-r-sub-value
        ctx
        (p21b3-disk-integral-approx
         ctx function center-x center-y
         radius subdivisions)
        value))
      epsilon))))

(defun-sk p21b3-integral-cutoff-exists-p
    (ctx function center-x center-y radius value epsilon)
  (exists (cutoff)
    (and
     (posp cutoff)
     (p21b3-integral-tail-p
      ctx function center-x center-y radius
      value epsilon cutoff))))

(defun-sk p21b3-disk-integral-value-p
    (ctx function center-x center-y radius value)
  (forall (epsilon)
    (implies
     (p21b3-positive-real-p ctx epsilon)
     (p21b3-integral-cutoff-exists-p
      ctx function center-x center-y radius
      value epsilon))))

;; Since d is positive, cx^2+cy^2=d^2 is equivalent to Euclidean distance
;; from the center to the origin being exactly d.

(defun-sk p21b3-zero-center-exists-p
    (ctx function d radius)
  (exists (center-x center-y)
    (and
     (p21b3-member-p (p21b3-r-carrier ctx) center-x)
     (p21b3-member-p (p21b3-r-carrier ctx) center-y)
     (equal
      (p21b3-r-add-value
       ctx
       (p21b3-r-square ctx center-x)
       (p21b3-r-square ctx center-y))
      (p21b3-r-square ctx d))
     (p21b3-disk-integral-value-p
      ctx function center-x center-y radius
      (p21b3-r-zero ctx)))))

(defun-sk p21b3-source-proposition-p (ctx)
  (forall (function d radius)
    (implies
     (and
      (p21b3-c2-function-p ctx function)
      (p21b3-positive-real-p ctx d)
      (p21b3-positive-real-p ctx radius)
      (p21b3-r-lt-p ctx radius d))
     (p21b3-zero-center-exists-p
      ctx function d radius))))

;; The PutnamBench solution annotation is True, so the source biconditional
;; reduces to the proposition itself.

(defun putnambench-putnam-2021-b3-statement (ctx)
  (implies
   (p21b3-context-p ctx)
   (p21b3-source-proposition-p ctx)))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q
