-- Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2021_b3
-- (putnambench__agda__putnam_2021_b3): vanishing of the integral of
-- y*h_x - x*h_y over a suitably centered disk. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module Main where

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; _*_)

infix 4 _!=_ _<=N_
infixr 3 _and_
infixr 2 _or_

data Bottom : Set where

record Top : Set where
  constructor top

Not : Set -> Set
Not A =
  A -> Bottom

_!=_ : {A : Set} -> A -> A -> Set
x != y =
  Not (x == y)

record _and_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data _or_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  left  : A -> A or B
  right : B -> A or B

record Iff (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor equivalence
  field
    forward  : A -> B
    backward : B -> A

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

data _<=N_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set where
  zero<=N   : {n : Nat} -> zero <=N n
  suc<=sucN : {m n : Nat} -> m <=N n -> suc m <=N suc n

record CompleteOrderedRealField (R : Set) : Set1 where
  field
    zeroR oneR : R
    add multiply : R -> R -> R
    negate inverse : R -> R
    lessOrEqual : R -> R -> Set
    fromNat : Nat -> R

    one-not-zero :
      oneR != zeroR

    add-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> add x y == add y x
    add-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      add (add x y) z == add x (add y z)
    add-zero :
      (x : R) -> add x zeroR == x
    add-inverse :
      (x : R) -> add x (negate x) == zeroR

    multiply-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> multiply x y == multiply y x
    multiply-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply (multiply x y) z ==
      multiply x (multiply y z)
    multiply-one :
      (x : R) -> multiply x oneR == x
    multiply-zero :
      (x : R) -> multiply x zeroR == zeroR
    distribute :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply x (add y z) ==
      add (multiply x y) (multiply x z)
    inverse-zero :
      inverse zeroR == zeroR
    multiply-inverse :
      (x : R) ->
      x != zeroR ->
      multiply x (inverse x) == oneR

    order-reflexive :
      (x : R) -> lessOrEqual x x
    order-transitive :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y z ->
      lessOrEqual x z
    order-antisymmetric :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y x ->
      x == y
    order-total :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y or lessOrEqual y x
    add-order :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual (add z x) (add z y)
    multiply-nonnegative :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR x ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR y ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR (multiply x y)
    zero-less-than-one :
      lessOrEqual zeroR oneR and zeroR != oneR

    fromNat-zero :
      fromNat zero == zeroR
    fromNat-successor :
      (n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (suc n) == add (fromNat n) oneR
    fromNat-addition :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m + n) == add (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-multiplication :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m * n) == multiply (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-injective :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat m == fromNat n ->
      m == n

    archimedean :
      (x : R) ->
      Exists Nat
        (\ n ->
          lessOrEqual x (fromNat n))
    least-upper-bound :
      (P : R -> Set) ->
      Exists R P ->
      Exists R
        (\ upper ->
          (x : R) ->
          P x ->
          lessOrEqual x upper) ->
      Exists R
        (\ supremum ->
          ((x : R) ->
            P x ->
            lessOrEqual x supremum)
          and
          ((upper : R) ->
            ((x : R) ->
              P x ->
              lessOrEqual x upper) ->
            lessOrEqual supremum upper))

open CompleteOrderedRealField

oneN : Nat
oneN =
  suc zero

twoN : Nat
twoN =
  suc oneN

subtract :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
subtract reals x y =
  add reals x (negate reals y)

divide :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
divide reals x y =
  multiply reals x (inverse reals y)

square :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R
square reals x =
  multiply reals x x

StrictLess :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
StrictLess reals x y =
  lessOrEqual reals x y and x != y

CloseTo :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
CloseTo reals center radius x =
  StrictLess reals
    (subtract reals center radius)
    x
  and
  StrictLess reals
    x
    (add reals center radius)

sumFirst :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Nat ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  R
sumFirst reals zero terms =
  zeroR reals
sumFirst reals (suc n) terms =
  add reals
    (sumFirst reals n terms)
    (terms n)

ConvergesTo :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  R ->
  Set
ConvergesTo {R} reals sequence limit =
  (epsilon : R) ->
  StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) epsilon ->
  Exists Nat
    (\ cutoff ->
      (n : Nat) ->
      cutoff <=N n ->
      CloseTo reals limit epsilon (sequence n))

naturalPower :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  Nat ->
  R
naturalPower reals x zero =
  oneR reals
naturalPower reals x (suc n) =
  multiply reals
    (naturalPower reals x n)
    x

factorial : Nat -> Nat
factorial zero =
  oneN
factorial (suc n) =
  suc n * factorial n

alternate :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Nat ->
  R ->
  R
alternate reals zero x =
  x
alternate reals (suc n) x =
  negate reals (alternate reals n x)

evenExponent : Nat -> Nat
evenExponent n =
  n + n

oddExponent : Nat -> Nat
oddExponent n =
  suc (evenExponent n)

sineTerm :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  Nat ->
  R
sineTerm reals x n =
  alternate reals n
    (divide reals
      (naturalPower reals x (oddExponent n))
      (fromNat reals (factorial (oddExponent n))))

cosineTerm :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  Nat ->
  R
cosineTerm reals x n =
  alternate reals n
    (divide reals
      (naturalPower reals x (evenExponent n))
      (fromNat reals (factorial (evenExponent n))))

SeriesHasSum :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  R ->
  Set
SeriesHasSum reals terms value =
  ConvergesTo reals
    (\ n -> sumFirst reals n terms)
    value

record StandardTrigonometry
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) :
  Set1 where

  field
    sine cosine : R -> R
    pi : R

    sine-is-power-series :
      (x : R) ->
      SeriesHasSum reals
        (sineTerm reals x)
        (sine x)
    cosine-is-power-series :
      (x : R) ->
      SeriesHasSum reals
        (cosineTerm reals x)
        (cosine x)
    pi-positive :
      StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) pi
    sine-pi-zero :
      sine pi == zeroR reals
    pi-is-first-positive-sine-zero :
      (x : R) ->
      StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) x ->
      sine x == zeroR reals ->
      lessOrEqual reals pi x

open StandardTrigonometry

rightRiemannSum :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  (R -> R) ->
  Nat ->
  R
rightRiemannSum reals lower upper function pieces =
  let
    step =
      divide reals
        (subtract reals upper lower)
        (fromNat reals pieces)
  in
  sumFirst reals pieces
    (\ i ->
      multiply reals
        (function
          (add reals lower
            (multiply reals
              (fromNat reals (suc i))
              step)))
        step)

IntervalIntegralValue :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  (R -> R) ->
  R ->
  Set
IntervalIntegralValue reals lower upper function value =
  ConvergesTo reals
    (\ n ->
      rightRiemannSum reals
        lower
        upper
        function
        (suc n))
    value

differenceQuotient :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (R -> R) ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
differenceQuotient reals function point x =
  divide reals
    (subtract reals (function x) (function point))
    (subtract reals x point)

DerivativeAt :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (R -> R) ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
DerivativeAt {R} reals function point derivative-value =
  (epsilon : R) ->
  StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) epsilon ->
  Exists R
    (\ delta ->
      StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) delta
      and
      ((x : R) ->
        CloseTo reals point delta x ->
        x != point ->
        CloseTo reals derivative-value epsilon
          (differenceQuotient reals function point x)))

record Point2 (R : Set) : Set where
  constructor point2
  field
    firstCoordinate  : R
    secondCoordinate : R

open Point2

addPoint :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Point2 R ->
  Point2 R ->
  Point2 R
addPoint reals p q =
  point2
    (add reals
      (firstCoordinate p)
      (firstCoordinate q))
    (add reals
      (secondCoordinate p)
      (secondCoordinate q))

squaredDistance :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Point2 R ->
  Point2 R ->
  R
squaredDistance reals p q =
  add reals
    (square reals
      (subtract reals
        (firstCoordinate p)
        (firstCoordinate q)))
    (square reals
      (subtract reals
        (secondCoordinate p)
        (secondCoordinate q)))

ContinuousAt2 :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (Point2 R -> R) ->
  Point2 R ->
  Set
ContinuousAt2 {R} reals function point =
  (epsilon : R) ->
  StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) epsilon ->
  Exists R
    (\ delta ->
      StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) delta
      and
      ((q : Point2 R) ->
        StrictLess reals
          (squaredDistance reals point q)
          (square reals delta) ->
        CloseTo reals
          (function point)
          epsilon
          (function q)))

Continuous2 :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (Point2 R -> R) ->
  Set
Continuous2 {R} reals function =
  (point : Point2 R) ->
  ContinuousAt2 reals function point

record C2Data
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R)
  (function : Point2 R -> R) :
  Set where

  field
    partialX partialY : Point2 R -> R
    partialXX partialXY partialYX partialYY : Point2 R -> R

    function-continuous :
      Continuous2 reals function
    partialX-continuous :
      Continuous2 reals partialX
    partialY-continuous :
      Continuous2 reals partialY
    partialXX-continuous :
      Continuous2 reals partialXX
    partialXY-continuous :
      Continuous2 reals partialXY
    partialYX-continuous :
      Continuous2 reals partialYX
    partialYY-continuous :
      Continuous2 reals partialYY

    partialX-is-derivative :
      (p : Point2 R) ->
      DerivativeAt reals
        (\ x ->
          function
            (point2 x (secondCoordinate p)))
        (firstCoordinate p)
        (partialX p)
    partialY-is-derivative :
      (p : Point2 R) ->
      DerivativeAt reals
        (\ y ->
          function
            (point2 (firstCoordinate p) y))
        (secondCoordinate p)
        (partialY p)
    partialXX-is-derivative :
      (p : Point2 R) ->
      DerivativeAt reals
        (\ x ->
          partialX
            (point2 x (secondCoordinate p)))
        (firstCoordinate p)
        (partialXX p)
    partialXY-is-derivative :
      (p : Point2 R) ->
      DerivativeAt reals
        (\ y ->
          partialX
            (point2 (firstCoordinate p) y))
        (secondCoordinate p)
        (partialXY p)
    partialYX-is-derivative :
      (p : Point2 R) ->
      DerivativeAt reals
        (\ x ->
          partialY
            (point2 x (secondCoordinate p)))
        (firstCoordinate p)
        (partialYX p)
    partialYY-is-derivative :
      (p : Point2 R) ->
      DerivativeAt reals
        (\ y ->
          partialY
            (point2 (firstCoordinate p) y))
        (secondCoordinate p)
        (partialYY p)

open C2Data

module Putnam2021B3Statement
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R)
  (trigonometry : StandardTrigonometry reals) where

  origin : Point2 R
  origin =
    point2 (zeroR reals) (zeroR reals)

  twoPi : R
  twoPi =
    multiply reals
      (fromNat reals twoN)
      (pi trigonometry)

  polarOffset :
    R ->
    R ->
    Point2 R
  polarOffset radius angle =
    point2
      (multiply reals
        radius
        (cosine trigonometry angle))
      (multiply reals
        radius
        (sine trigonometry angle))

  angularDensity :
    (function : Point2 R -> R) ->
    C2Data reals function ->
    Point2 R ->
    R
  angularDensity function smooth p =
    subtract reals
      (multiply reals
        (secondCoordinate p)
        (partialX smooth p))
      (multiply reals
        (firstCoordinate p)
        (partialY smooth p))

  PolarDiskIntegralValue :
    (function : Point2 R -> R) ->
    (smooth : C2Data reals function) ->
    Point2 R ->
    R ->
    R ->
    Set
  PolarDiskIntegralValue function smooth center radius integralValue =
    Exists (R -> R)
      (\ radialIntegral ->
        ((angle : R) ->
          IntervalIntegralValue reals
            (zeroR reals)
            radius
            (\ radialCoordinate ->
              multiply reals
                (angularDensity function smooth
                  (addPoint reals center
                    (polarOffset radialCoordinate angle)))
                radialCoordinate)
            (radialIntegral angle))
        and
        IntervalIntegralValue reals
          (zeroR reals)
          twoPi
          radialIntegral
          integralValue)

  DistanceFromOrigin :
    Point2 R ->
    R ->
    Set
  DistanceFromOrigin center distance =
    lessOrEqual reals (zeroR reals) distance
    and
    squaredDistance reals center origin ==
      square reals distance

  Claim : Set
  Claim =
    (function : Point2 R -> R) ->
    (smooth : C2Data reals function) ->
    (d : R) ->
    StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) d ->
    (r : R) ->
    StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) r ->
    StrictLess reals r d ->
    Exists (Point2 R)
      (\ center ->
        DistanceFromOrigin center d
        and
        PolarDiskIntegralValue
          function
          smooth
          center
          r
          (zeroR reals))

  proposition : Set
  proposition =
    Iff Claim Top

putnam-2021-b3 : Set1
putnam-2021-b3 =
  (R : Set) ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) ->
  (trigonometry : StandardTrigonometry reals) ->
  Putnam2021B3Statement.proposition reals trigonometry

title: putnam_2021_b3
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2021_b3:
  every twice continuously differentiable real function on the plane has a
  prescribed off-center disk on which the integral of y*h_x - x*h_y vanishes.
  This file contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open pairTheory pred_setTheory realTheory real_topologyTheory limTheory
     transcTheory integrationTheory;

val putnam_2021_b3 =
  ``let partial_x =
      \h : (real # real) -> real.
      \p : real # real.
        diffn 1 (\t : real. h (t, SND p)) (FST p)
    in
    let partial_y =
      \h : (real # real) -> real.
      \p : real # real.
        diffn 1 (\t : real. h (FST p, t)) (SND p)
    in
    let partial_xx =
      \h : (real # real) -> real.
      \p : real # real.
        diffn 2 (\t : real. h (t, SND p)) (FST p)
    in
    let partial_xy =
      \h : (real # real) -> real.
      \p : real # real.
        diffn 1
          (\t : real. partial_x h (FST p, t))
          (SND p)
    in
    let partial_yx =
      \h : (real # real) -> real.
      \p : real # real.
        diffn 1
          (\t : real. partial_y h (t, SND p))
          (FST p)
    in
    let partial_yy =
      \h : (real # real) -> real.
      \p : real # real.
        diffn 2 (\t : real. h (FST p, t)) (SND p)
    in
    let plane_continuous =
      \g : (real # real) -> real.
        !p : real # real.
        !e : real.
          0 < e
          ==>
          ?delta : real.
            0 < delta /\
            !q : real # real.
              (FST q - FST p) pow 2 +
                (SND q - SND p) pow 2 < delta
              ==>
              abs (g q - g p) < e
    in
    let twice_continuously_differentiable =
      \h : (real # real) -> real.
        (!p : real # real.
           higher_differentiable
             2
             (\t : real. h (t, SND p))
             (FST p) /\
           higher_differentiable
             2
             (\t : real. h (FST p, t))
             (SND p) /\
           higher_differentiable
             1
             (\t : real. partial_x h (FST p, t))
             (SND p) /\
           higher_differentiable
             1
             (\t : real. partial_y h (t, SND p))
             (FST p)) /\
        plane_continuous h /\
        plane_continuous (partial_x h) /\
        plane_continuous (partial_y h) /\
        plane_continuous (partial_xx h) /\
        plane_continuous (partial_xy h) /\
        plane_continuous (partial_yx h) /\
        plane_continuous (partial_yy h)
    in
    let rho =
      \h : (real # real) -> real.
      \p : real # real.
        SND p * partial_x h p - FST p * partial_y h p
    in
    let disk_integral =
      \h : (real # real) -> real.
      \c : real # real.
      \r : real.
        integration$integral
          (interval [FST c - r, FST c + r])
          (\x : real.
             integration$integral
               (interval
                  [SND c - sqrt (r pow 2 - (x - FST c) pow 2),
                   SND c + sqrt (r pow 2 - (x - FST c) pow 2)])
               (\y : real. rho h (x, y)))
    in
      !h : (real # real) -> real.
        twice_continuously_differentiable h
        ==>
        !d r : real.
          0 < d /\ 0 < r /\ r < d
          ==>
          ?c : real # real.
            sqrt (FST c pow 2 + SND c pow 2) = d /\
            disk_integral h c r = 0``;

title: putnam_2021_b3
content:
$(
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact
  putnam_2021_b3: every twice continuously differentiable real function
  on the plane has, for each pair of radii 0 < r < d, a radius-r disk
  centered distance d from the origin on which the integral of
  y h_x - x h_y is zero. This file contains no proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  P21B3Index is the two-element coordinate interval {0,1}. P21B3R2 is the
  resulting real coordinate plane, P21B3Top is its standard product topology,
  and P21B3Dist is Euclidean distance.

  P21B3Repl replaces one coordinate of a point. P21B3Slice, P21B3Part,
  P21B3D1, and P21B3D2 use set.mm's native real derivative to form the
  coordinate slices and their first and second partial derivatives.
  P21B3C2 requires every such partial to exist throughout the plane and
  requires all partials of orders one and two to be continuous there.
  On the open domain R^2 this is equivalent to twice continuous
  differentiability.

  P21B3Rho is exactly y h_x - x h_y. P21B3Ball is the open Euclidean disk.
  P21B3Integral is its iterated real Lebesgue integral, using the disk's
  vertical slices. For the continuous integrand supplied by P21B3C2,
  Fubini's theorem makes this equal to the source's two-dimensional
  Lebesgue integral over P21B3Ball.

  The final biconditional retains the annotated source answer True as T.
  Every declaration is an unproved $a statement encoding; this database
  contains no $p proof declaration.
$)

$c
  P21B3Index P21B3R2 P21B3Top P21B3Zero P21B3Vec P21B3Dist P21B3Repl
  P21B3Slice P21B3Part P21B3D1 P21B3D2 P21B3C2
  P21B3Rho P21B3Ball P21B3Integral
$.

p21b3-index-syntax $a class P21B3Index $.
p21b3-plane-syntax $a class P21B3R2 $.
p21b3-topology-syntax $a class P21B3Top $.
p21b3-zero-syntax $a class P21B3Zero $.
p21b3-vector-syntax $a class ( P21B3Vec x y ) $.
p21b3-distance-syntax $a class ( P21B3Dist A B ) $.
p21b3-replace-syntax $a class ( P21B3Repl p i r ) $.
p21b3-slice-syntax $a class ( P21B3Slice F i p ) $.
p21b3-partial-syntax $a class ( P21B3Part F i p ) $.
p21b3-first-partial-syntax $a class ( P21B3D1 F i ) $.
p21b3-second-partial-syntax $a class ( P21B3D2 F i j ) $.
p21b3-c2-syntax $a wff ( P21B3C2 F ) $.
p21b3-rho-syntax $a class ( P21B3Rho F p ) $.
p21b3-ball-syntax $a class ( P21B3Ball c r ) $.
p21b3-integral-syntax $a class ( P21B3Integral F c r ) $.

p21b3-index-definition $a |- P21B3Index = ( 0 ... 1 ) $.

p21b3-plane-definition $a |- P21B3R2 = ( RR ^m P21B3Index ) $.

p21b3-topology-definition $a |- P21B3Top = (
  Xt_ `
    (
      P21B3Index
      X.
      { ( TopOpen ` RRfld ) }
    )
) $.

${
  $d k x y $.

  p21b3-vector-definition $a |- (
    P21B3Vec x y
  ) = (
    k e. P21B3Index |->
      if (
        k = 0 ,
        x ,
        y
      )
  ) $.
$}

p21b3-zero-definition $a |- P21B3Zero = ( P21B3Vec 0 0 ) $.

${
  $d A B k $.

  p21b3-distance-definition $a |- (
    P21B3Dist A B
  ) = (
    sqrt
    `
    (
      sum_ k e. P21B3Index
        ( ( ( A ` k ) - ( B ` k ) ) ^ 2 )
    )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d i k p r $.

  p21b3-replace-definition $a |- (
    P21B3Repl p i r
  ) = (
    k e. P21B3Index |->
      if (
        k = i ,
        r ,
        ( p ` k )
      )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d F i p r $.

  p21b3-slice-definition $a |- (
    P21B3Slice F i p
  ) = (
    r e. RR |->
      (
        F
        `
        ( P21B3Repl p i r )
      )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d F i p $.

  p21b3-partial-definition $a |- (
    P21B3Part F i p
  ) = if (
    ( p ` i ) e.
      dom
        (
          RR _D
            ( P21B3Slice F i p )
        ) ,
    (
      (
        RR _D
          ( P21B3Slice F i p )
      )
      ` ( p ` i )
    ) ,
    0
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d F i p $.

  p21b3-first-partial-definition $a |- (
    P21B3D1 F i
  ) = (
    p e. P21B3R2 |->
      ( P21B3Part F i p )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d F i j p $.

  p21b3-second-partial-definition $a |- (
    P21B3D2 F i j
  ) = (
    p e. P21B3R2 |->
      (
        P21B3Part
        ( P21B3D1 F i )
        j
        p
      )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d F i j p $.

  p21b3-c2-definition $a |- (
    ( P21B3C2 F )
    <->
    (
      F e. ( RR ^m P21B3R2 )
      /\
      (
        A. i e. P21B3Index A. p e. P21B3R2
          ( p ` i ) e.
            dom
              (
                RR _D
                  ( P21B3Slice F i p )
              )
        /\
        (
          A. i e. P21B3Index
            ( P21B3D1 F i )
            e.
            (
              P21B3Top
              Cn
              ( TopOpen ` RRfld )
            )
          /\
          (
            A. i e. P21B3Index A. j e. P21B3Index A. p e. P21B3R2
              ( p ` j ) e.
                dom

                      (

                        ( P21B3D1 F i )
                        j
                        p

                  )

            A. i e. P21B3Index A. j e. P21B3Index
              ( P21B3D2 F i j )
              e.
              (
                P21B3Top
                Cn
                ( TopOpen ` RRfld )
              )
          )
        )
      )
    )
  ) $.
$}

p21b3-rho-definition $a |- (
  P21B3Rho F p
) = (
  (
    ( p ` 1 )
    x.
    ( P21B3Part F 0 p )
  )
  -
  (
    ( p ` 0 )
    x.
    ( P21B3Part F 1 p )
  )
) $.

${
  $d c p r $.

  p21b3-ball-definition $a |- (
    P21B3Ball c r
  ) = {
    p e. P21B3R2 |
      ( P21B3Dist p c ) < r
  } $.
$}

${
  $d F c r x y $.

  p21b3-integral-definition $a |- (
    P21B3Integral F c r
  ) = (
    S.
      (
        ( ( c ` 0 ) - r )
        (,)
        ( ( c ` 0 ) + r )
      )
      (
        S.
          (
            (
              ( c ` 1 )
              -
              (
                sqrt
                `
                (
                  ( r ^ 2 )
                  -
                  (
                    (
                      x
                      -
                      ( c ` 0 )
                    )
                    ^ 2
                  )
                )
              )
            )
            (,)
            (
              ( c ` 1 )
              +
              (
                sqrt
                `
                (
                  ( r ^ 2 )
                  -
                  (
                    (
                      x
                      -
                      ( c ` 0 )
                    )
                    ^ 2
                  )
                )
              )
            )
          )
          (
            P21B3Rho
            F
            ( P21B3Vec x y )
          )
          _d y
      )
      _d x
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d c d f r $.

  putnambench-putnam-2021-b3 $a |- (
    (
      A. f e. ( RR ^m P21B3R2 )
        (
          ( P21B3C2 f )
          ->
          A. d e. RR
            (
              0 < d
              ->
              A. r e. RR
                (
                  (
                    0 < r
                    /\
                    r < d
                  )
                  ->
                  E. c e. P21B3R2
                    (
                      ( P21B3Dist c P21B3Zero ) = d
                      /\
                      ( P21B3Integral f c r ) = 0
                    )
                )
            )
        )
    )
    <->
    T.
  ) $.
$}

title: putnam_2021_b3
content:
% Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2021_b3:
% every twice continuously differentiable real function on the plane has,
% for each d > r > 0, a radius-r disk centered distance d from the origin
% on which the integral of y*h_x - x*h_y is zero. This file contains no proof.

putnam_2021_b3: THEORY
BEGIN
  point: TYPE = [# x_coord: real, y_coord: real #]
  gradient: TYPE = [# dx: real, dy: real #]
  hessian: TYPE =
    [# dxx: real, dxy: real, dyx: real, dyy: real #]

  scalar_field: TYPE = [point -> real]
  gradient_field: TYPE = [point -> gradient]
  hessian_field: TYPE = [point -> hessian]
  point_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> point]

  box: TYPE =
    [# left: real, right: real, bottom: real, top: real #]
  box_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> box]

  squared_distance(p, q: point): real =
    (x_coord(p) - x_coord(q)) ^ 2
      + (y_coord(p) - y_coord(q)) ^ 2

  gradient_distance_squared(first, second: gradient): real =
    (dx(first) - dx(second)) ^ 2
      + (dy(first) - dy(second)) ^ 2

  hessian_distance_squared(first, second: hessian): real =
    (dxx(first) - dxx(second)) ^ 2
      + (dxy(first) - dxy(second)) ^ 2
      + (dyx(first) - dyx(second)) ^ 2
      + (dyy(first) - dyy(second)) ^ 2

  scalar_derivative_error(
      f: scalar_field,
      derivative: gradient,
      p, q: point): real =
    f(q) - f(p)
      - dx(derivative) * (x_coord(q) - x_coord(p))
      - dy(derivative) * (y_coord(q) - y_coord(p))

  has_scalar_frechet_derivative_at(
      f: scalar_field,
      derivative: gradient,
      p: point): bool =
    FORALL (epsilon_value: posreal):
      EXISTS (delta: posreal):
        FORALL (q: point):
          (q /= p
            AND squared_distance(q, p) < delta ^ 2)
          IMPLIES
            scalar_derivative_error(f, derivative, p, q) ^ 2
              < epsilon_value ^ 2 * squared_distance(q, p)

  gradient_derivative_error_squared(
      f: gradient_field,
      derivative: hessian,
      p, q: point): real =
    (dx(f(q)) - dx(f(p))
      - dxx(derivative) * (x_coord(q) - x_coord(p))
      - dxy(derivative) * (y_coord(q) - y_coord(p))) ^ 2
      + (dy(f(q)) - dy(f(p))
        - dyx(derivative) * (x_coord(q) - x_coord(p))
        - dyy(derivative) * (y_coord(q) - y_coord(p))) ^ 2

  has_gradient_frechet_derivative_at(
      f: gradient_field,
      derivative: hessian,
      p: point): bool =
    FORALL (epsilon_value: posreal):
      EXISTS (delta: posreal):
        FORALL (q: point):
          (q /= p
            AND squared_distance(q, p) < delta ^ 2)
          IMPLIES
            gradient_derivative_error_squared(
              f, derivative, p, q)
              < epsilon_value ^ 2 * squared_distance(q, p)

  continuous_scalar_field(f: scalar_field): bool =
    FORALL (p: point), (epsilon_value: posreal):
      EXISTS (delta: posreal):
        FORALL (q: point):
          squared_distance(q, p) < delta ^ 2
            IMPLIES
              (f(q) - f(p)) ^ 2 < epsilon_value ^ 2

  continuous_gradient_field(f: gradient_field): bool =
    FORALL (p: point), (epsilon_value: posreal):
      EXISTS (delta: posreal):
        FORALL (q: point):
          squared_distance(q, p) < delta ^ 2
            IMPLIES
              gradient_distance_squared(f(q), f(p))
                < epsilon_value ^ 2

  continuous_hessian_field(f: hessian_field): bool =
    FORALL (p: point), (epsilon_value: posreal):
      EXISTS (delta: posreal):
        FORALL (q: point):
          squared_distance(q, p) < delta ^ 2
            IMPLIES
              hessian_distance_squared(f(q), f(p))
                < epsilon_value ^ 2

  twice_continuously_differentiable(f: scalar_field): bool =
    EXISTS
        (first: gradient_field),
        (second: hessian_field):
      continuous_scalar_field(f)
        AND continuous_gradient_field(first)
        AND continuous_hessian_field(second)
        AND (FORALL (p: point):
          has_scalar_frechet_derivative_at(f, first(p), p)
            AND has_gradient_frechet_derivative_at(
              first, second(p), p))

  gradient_at(f: scalar_field, p: point): gradient =
    epsilon(
      LAMBDA (derivative: gradient):
        has_scalar_frechet_derivative_at(f, derivative, p))

  rho(f: scalar_field): scalar_field =
    LAMBDA (p: point):
      y_coord(p) * dx(gradient_at(f, p))
        - x_coord(p) * dy(gradient_at(f, p))

  open_disk(center: point, radius: real): [point -> bool] =
    LAMBDA (p: point):
      squared_distance(p, center) < radius ^ 2

  disk_box(center: point, radius: real): box =
    (# left := x_coord(center) - radius,
       right := x_coord(center) + radius,
       bottom := y_coord(center) - radius,
       top := y_coord(center) + radius #)

  valid_box(rectangle: box): bool =
    left(rectangle) < right(rectangle)
      AND bottom(rectangle) < top(rectangle)

  in_closed_box(p: point, rectangle: box): bool =
    left(rectangle) <= x_coord(p)
      AND x_coord(p) <= right(rectangle)
      AND bottom(rectangle) <= y_coord(p)
      AND y_coord(p) <= top(rectangle)

  box_contained_in(inner, outer: box): bool =
    left(outer) <= left(inner)
      AND right(inner) <= right(outer)
      AND bottom(outer) <= bottom(inner)
      AND top(inner) <= top(outer)

  box_content(rectangle: box): real =
    (right(rectangle) - left(rectangle))
      * (top(rectangle) - bottom(rectangle))

  box_interiors_overlap(first, second: box): bool =
    left(first) < right(second)
      AND left(second) < right(first)
      AND bottom(first) < top(second)
      AND bottom(second) < top(first)

  tagged_box_division(
      parent: box,
      count: nat,
      rectangles: box_sequence,
      tags: point_sequence): bool =
    valid_box(parent)
      AND (FORALL (index: nat):
        index < count IMPLIES
          (valid_box(rectangles(index))
            AND box_contained_in(rectangles(index), parent)
            AND in_closed_box(tags(index), rectangles(index))))
      AND (FORALL (first, second: nat):
        first < second AND second < count IMPLIES
          NOT box_interiors_overlap(
            rectangles(first), rectangles(second)))
      AND (FORALL (p: point):
        in_closed_box(p, parent) IMPLIES
          EXISTS (index: nat):
            index < count
              AND in_closed_box(p, rectangles(index)))

  positive_planar_gauge(gauge: scalar_field): bool =
    FORALL (p: point): 0 < gauge(p)

  box_gauge_fine(
      gauge: scalar_field,
      count: nat,
      rectangles: box_sequence,
      tags: point_sequence): bool =
    FORALL (index: nat):
      index < count IMPLIES
        (x_coord(tags(index)) - gauge(tags(index))
            < left(rectangles(index))
          AND right(rectangles(index))
            < x_coord(tags(index)) + gauge(tags(index))
          AND y_coord(tags(index)) - gauge(tags(index))
            < bottom(rectangles(index))
          AND top(rectangles(index))
            < y_coord(tags(index)) + gauge(tags(index)))

  tagged_box_sum(
      f: scalar_field,
      count: nat,
      rectangles: box_sequence,
      tags: point_sequence): RECURSIVE real =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      tagged_box_sum(f, count - 1, rectangles, tags)
        + f(tags(count - 1))
            * box_content(rectangles(count - 1))
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  restrict_to_region(
      f: scalar_field,
      region: [point -> bool]): scalar_field =
    LAMBDA (p: point):
      IF region(p) THEN f(p) ELSE 0 ENDIF

  has_box_integral(
      f: scalar_field,
      parent: box,
      integral_value: real): bool =
    valid_box(parent)
      AND FORALL (epsilon_value: posreal):
        EXISTS (gauge: scalar_field):
          positive_planar_gauge(gauge)
            AND (FORALL
                (count: nat),
                (rectangles: box_sequence),
                (tags: point_sequence):
              (tagged_box_division(
                  parent, count, rectangles, tags)
                AND box_gauge_fine(
                  gauge, count, rectangles, tags))
              IMPLIES
                abs(tagged_box_sum(
                  f, count, rectangles, tags)
                    - integral_value) < epsilon_value)

  disk_integral_is_zero(
      f: scalar_field,
      center: point,
      radius: real): bool =
    has_box_integral(
      restrict_to_region(rho(f), open_disk(center, radius)),
      disk_box(center, radius),
      0)

  origin: point =
    (# x_coord := 0, y_coord := 0 #)

  putnam_2021_b3_solution: bool = TRUE

  putnam_2021_b3_statement: bool =
    ((FORALL (h: scalar_field):
      twice_continuously_differentiable(h) IMPLIES
        FORALL (d, r: real):
          (d > 0 AND r > 0 AND d > r) IMPLIES
            EXISTS (center: point):
              squared_distance(center, origin) = d ^ 2
                AND disk_integral_is_zero(h, center, r))
      IFF putnam_2021_b3_solution)
END putnam_2021_b3

title: putnam_2021_b4
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2021_b4:
;; for every Fibonacci index m greater than 2, the remainder modulo F_m of
;; the product of k^k for 1 <= k < F_m is a Fibonacci number. This file
;; contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

;; The source assumptions F_0 = 0, F_1 = 1, and
;; F_(n+2) = F_(n+1) + F_n uniquely determine this function on the naturals.
(defun putnam-2021-b4-fibonacci (n)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix n)))
  (if (zp n)
      0
    (if (equal n 1)
        1
      (+ (putnam-2021-b4-fibonacci (- n 1))
         (putnam-2021-b4-fibonacci (- n 2))))))

;; This is exactly the finite product of k^k for 1 <= k <= UPPER.
(defun putnam-2021-b4-product-through (upper)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix upper)))
  (if (zp upper)
      1
    (* (putnam-2021-b4-product-through (- upper 1))
       (expt upper upper))))

;; Search internally for an index p from 0 through UPPER whose Fibonacci
;; value is VALUE.
(defun putnam-2021-b4-fibonacci-value-through-p
    (value upper)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix upper)))
  (if (zp upper)
      (equal value (putnam-2021-b4-fibonacci 0))
    (or
     (equal value
            (putnam-2021-b4-fibonacci upper))
     (putnam-2021-b4-fibonacci-value-through-p
      value (- upper 1)))))

;; ACL2 universally closes M. For m > 2, the remainder is below F_m, and
;; every Fibonacci value at an index above m is at least F_(m+1) > F_m.
;; Therefore searching p through m is bidirectionally equivalent to the
;; source existential quantifier over every natural p.
(defun putnambench-putnam-2021-b4-statement (m)
  (implies
   (and
    (natp m)
    (< 2 m))
   (let* ((f-m (putnam-2021-b4-fibonacci m))
          (remainder
           (mod
            (putnam-2021-b4-product-through (- f-m 1))
            f-m)))
     (putnam-2021-b4-fibonacci-value-through-p
      remainder m))))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

-- (putnambench__agda__putnam_2021_b4): for every Fibonacci index m greater

module Main where

  (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; _-_; _*_; mod-helper)

infix 4 _<=N_ _<N_
infixr 3 _and_

record _and_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

data _<=N_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set where
  zero<=N   : {n : Nat} -> zero <=N n
  suc<=sucN : {m n : Nat} -> m <=N n -> suc m <=N suc n

_<N_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set
m <N n =
  suc m <=N n

one : Nat
one =
  suc zero

two : Nat
two =
  suc one

power : Nat -> Nat -> Nat
power base zero =
  one
power base (suc exponent) =
  power base exponent * base

weightedProduct : Nat -> Nat
weightedProduct zero =
  one
weightedProduct (suc upper) =
  weightedProduct upper *
  power (suc upper) (suc upper)

naturalMod : Nat -> Nat -> Nat
naturalMod numerator zero =
  numerator
naturalMod numerator (suc denominator) =
  mod-helper zero denominator numerator denominator

putnam-2021-b4 : Set
putnam-2021-b4 =
  (F : Nat -> Nat) ->
  ((n : Nat) ->
    F (suc (suc n)) ==
    F (suc n) + F n) ->
  (F zero == zero and F one == one) ->
  (m : Nat) ->
  two <N m ->
  Exists Nat
    (\ p ->
      naturalMod
        (weightedProduct (F m - one))
        (F m)
      ==
      F p)

(*

  the remainder modulo a Fibonacci number of the product of k^k for positive
  k below that number is itself a Fibonacci number. This file contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open arithmeticTheory pred_setTheory;

val putnam_2021_b4 =
  ``!F : num -> num.
      (F 0 = 0 /\
       F 1 = 1 /\
       (!n : num. F (n + 2) = F (n + 1) + F n))
      ==>
      !m : num.
        2 < m
        ==>
        ?p : num.
          PROD_IMAGE
            (\k : num. k EXP k)
            (IMAGE SUC (count (F m - 1))) MOD F m =
          F p``;

$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  F ranges over all total NN0-valued sequences indexed by NN0. The two
  initial values and the recurrence at every nonnegative index are exactly
  the Fibonacci hypotheses in the source statements. For each m > 2, the
  product range 1 ... (F(m) - 1) is the inclusive source range, and p remains
  internally existentially quantified.

  The final declaration is the single unproved $a corpus statement; this
  database contains no $p proof declaration.
$)

${
  $d F k m n p $.

  putnambench-putnam-2021-b4 $a |-
    A. F e. ( NN0 ^m NN0 )
      (
        (
          (
            ( F ` 0 ) = 0
            /\
            ( F ` 1 ) = 1
          )
          /\
          A. n e. NN0
            (
              ( F ` ( n + 2 ) )
              =

                ( F ` ( n + 1 ) )
                +
                ( F ` n )

              (

                    ( k ^ k )

                mod

title: putnam_2021_b4
content:
% Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2021_b4:
% for every Fibonacci sequence and m > 2, the remainder modulo F(m) of
% 1^1 * 2^2 * ... * (F(m) - 1)^(F(m) - 1) is a Fibonacci number.
% This file contains no proof.

putnam_2021_b4: THEORY
BEGIN
  natural_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> nat]

  nat_predecessor(value: nat): nat =
    IF value = 0 THEN 0 ELSE value - 1 ENDIF

  weighted_product(upper: nat): RECURSIVE nat =
    IF upper = 0 THEN
      1
    ELSE
      weighted_product(upper - 1) * upper ^ upper
    ENDIF
  MEASURE upper

  remainder_aux(
      numerator, denominator, fuel: nat): RECURSIVE nat =
    IF fuel = 0
        OR denominator = 0
        OR numerator < denominator THEN
      numerator
    ELSE
      remainder_aux(
        numerator - denominator,
        denominator,
        fuel - 1)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE fuel

  safe_mod(numerator, denominator: nat): nat =
    IF denominator = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      remainder_aux(
        numerator,
        denominator,
        numerator + 1)
    ENDIF

  is_fibonacci_sequence(F: natural_sequence): bool =
    F(0) = 0
      AND F(1) = 1
      AND (FORALL (n: nat):
        F(n + 2) = F(n + 1) + F(n))

  putnam_2021_b4: bool =
    FORALL (F: natural_sequence):
      is_fibonacci_sequence(F) IMPLIES
        FORALL (m: nat):
          m > 2 IMPLIES
            EXISTS (p: nat):
              safe_mod(
                weighted_product(nat_predecessor(F(m))),
                F(m))
                = F(p)
END putnam_2021_b4

(* Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2021_b5:
   integer matrices whose nonempty principal minors all have odd determinant
   retain that property under every positive matrix power. This file contains
   no proof. *)

From Stdlib Require Import ZArith Lists.List Vectors.Fin Arith.PeanoNat.

Import ListNotations.
Open Scope Z_scope.

Definition putnam_2021_b5_matrix (n : nat) : Type :=
  Fin.t n -> Fin.t n -> Z.

Fixpoint putnam_2021_b5_indices (n : nat) : list (Fin.t n) :=
  match n with
  | O => []
  | S k => Fin.F1 :: map Fin.FS (putnam_2021_b5_indices k)
  end.

Fixpoint putnam_2021_b5_zsum (xs : list Z) : Z :=
  match xs with
  | [] => 0
  | x :: rest => x + putnam_2021_b5_zsum rest
  end.

Definition putnam_2021_b5_matrix_mul
    {n : nat}
    (A B : putnam_2021_b5_matrix n) :
    putnam_2021_b5_matrix n :=
  fun i j =>
    putnam_2021_b5_zsum
      (map
        (fun r => A i r * B r j)
        (putnam_2021_b5_indices n)).

Definition putnam_2021_b5_identity
    (n : nat) : putnam_2021_b5_matrix n :=
  fun i j =>
    if Fin.eq_dec i j then 1 else 0.

Fixpoint putnam_2021_b5_matrix_power
    {n : nat}
    (A : putnam_2021_b5_matrix n)
    (k : nat) : putnam_2021_b5_matrix n :=
  match k with
  | O => putnam_2021_b5_identity n
  | S l =>
      putnam_2021_b5_matrix_mul
        (putnam_2021_b5_matrix_power A l) A
  end.

Definition putnam_2021_b5_delete_nth
    {T : Type} (j : nat) (xs : list T) : list T :=
  firstn j xs ++ skipn (S j) xs.

Definition putnam_2021_b5_cofactor_sign (j : nat) : Z :=
  if Nat.even j then 1 else -1.

Fixpoint putnam_2021_b5_det
    (n : nat) (M : list (list Z)) {struct n} : Z :=
  match n with
  | O => 1
  | S k =>
      match M with
      | [] => 0
      | row :: rows =>
          putnam_2021_b5_zsum
            (map
              (fun j : nat =>
                putnam_2021_b5_cofactor_sign j *
                nth j row 0 *
                putnam_2021_b5_det k
                  (map (putnam_2021_b5_delete_nth j) rows))
              (seq 0 (S k)))
      end
  end.

Definition putnam_2021_b5_principal_minor
    {n : nat}
    (A : putnam_2021_b5_matrix n)
    {m : nat}
    (reindex : Fin.t m -> Fin.t n) : list (list Z) :=
  map
    (fun i =>
      map
        (fun j => A (reindex i) (reindex j))
        (putnam_2021_b5_indices m))
    (putnam_2021_b5_indices m).

Definition putnam_2021_b5_very_odd
    {n : nat}
    (A : putnam_2021_b5_matrix n) : Prop :=
  forall m : nat,
    (1 <= m <= n)%nat ->
    forall reindex : Fin.t m -> Fin.t n,
      (forall x y : Fin.t m,
        reindex x = reindex y -> x = y) ->
      Z.odd
        (putnam_2021_b5_det m
          (putnam_2021_b5_principal_minor A reindex)) =
        true.

Theorem putnam_2021_b5
    (n : nat)
    (npos : (1 <= n)%nat) :
  forall A : putnam_2021_b5_matrix n,
    putnam_2021_b5_very_odd A ->
    forall k : nat,
      (1 <= k)%nat ->
      putnam_2021_b5_very_odd
        (putnam_2021_b5_matrix_power A k).
Admitted.

Complex_Main
"HOL-Analysis.Finite_Cartesian_Product"
"HOL-Combinatorics.Permutations"
begin

theorem putnam_2021_b5:
  fixes n :: nat
  and matpow :: "int^'n^'n \<Rightarrow> nat \<Rightarrow> int^'n^'n"
  and subdet :: "int^'n^'n \<Rightarrow> 'n set \<Rightarrow> int"
  and veryodd :: "int^'n^'n \<Rightarrow> bool"
  defines "subdet \<equiv> \<lambda> (A :: int^'n^'n) (S :: 'n set). sum (\<lambda> p. sign p * prod (\<lambda> i. A$i$(p i)) S) {p. p permutes S}"
  and "veryodd \<equiv> \<lambda> A :: int^'n^'n. \<forall> S :: 'n set. S \<noteq> {} \<longrightarrow> odd (subdet A S)"
  assumes npos: "n \<ge> 1"
  and ncard: "CARD('n) = n"
  and hmatpow: "\<forall> A :: int^'n^'n. matpow A 0 = mat 1 \<and> (\<forall> k :: nat. matpow A (k + 1) = matpow A k ** A)"
  shows "\<forall> A :: int^'n^'n. veryodd A \<longrightarrow> (\<forall> k \<ge> 1. veryodd (matpow A k))"
  sorry

end

;; Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2021_b5:
;; positive powers of an integer matrix whose nonempty principal minors all
;; have odd determinant retain that property. This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))

;; An exact-length list of exact-length integer rows is the extensional
;; representation of a matrix on Fin n. ACL2 universally closes N, MATRIX,
;; and K in the final predicate, preserving the source quantifiers over every
;; positive dimension, every integer matrix, and every positive exponent.

(defun putnam-2021-b5-integer-row-p (row columns)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix columns)))
  (if (zp columns)
      (equal row nil)
    (and
     (consp row)
     (integerp (car row))
     (putnam-2021-b5-integer-row-p
      (cdr row) (- columns 1)))))

(defun putnam-2021-b5-integer-matrix-p
    (matrix rows columns)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix rows)))
  (if (zp rows)
      (equal matrix nil)
    (and
     (consp matrix)
     (putnam-2021-b5-integer-row-p
      (car matrix) columns)
     (putnam-2021-b5-integer-matrix-p
      (cdr matrix) (- rows 1) columns))))

(defun putnam-2021-b5-range-from (start count)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix count)))
  (if (zp count)
      nil
    (cons
     start
     (putnam-2021-b5-range-from
      (+ start 1) (- count 1)))))

;; POWERSET enumerates every subset of the finite index carrier exactly once.

(defun putnam-2021-b5-prefix-each (item lists)
  (if (consp lists)
      (cons
       (cons item (car lists))
       (putnam-2021-b5-prefix-each item (cdr lists)))
    nil))

(defun putnam-2021-b5-powerset (items)
  (if (consp items)
      (let ((tail-subsets
             (putnam-2021-b5-powerset (cdr items))))
        (append
         tail-subsets
         (putnam-2021-b5-prefix-each
          (car items) tail-subsets)))
    (list nil)))

(defun putnam-2021-b5-select-row (row indices)
  (if (consp indices)
      (cons
       (nth (car indices) row)
       (putnam-2021-b5-select-row row (cdr indices)))
    nil))

(defun putnam-2021-b5-principal-submatrix
    (matrix indices)
  (if (consp indices)
      (cons
       (putnam-2021-b5-select-row
        (nth (car indices) matrix) indices)
       (putnam-2021-b5-principal-submatrix
        matrix (cdr indices)))
    nil))

;; The determinant is the exact Leibniz signed sum over all permutations.

(defun putnam-2021-b5-permutation-prefix-each
    (item lists)
  (if (consp lists)
      (cons
       (cons item (car lists))
       (putnam-2021-b5-permutation-prefix-each
        item (cdr lists)))
    nil))

(defun putnam-2021-b5-insert-everywhere (item list)
  (if (consp list)
      (cons
       (cons item list)
       (putnam-2021-b5-permutation-prefix-each
        (car list)
        (putnam-2021-b5-insert-everywhere
         item (cdr list))))
    (list (list item))))

(defun putnam-2021-b5-insert-into-each
    (item lists)
  (if (consp lists)
      (append
       (putnam-2021-b5-insert-everywhere
        item (car lists))
       (putnam-2021-b5-insert-into-each
        item (cdr lists)))
    nil))

(defun putnam-2021-b5-permutations (items)
  (if (consp items)
      (putnam-2021-b5-insert-into-each
       (car items)
       (putnam-2021-b5-permutations (cdr items)))
    (list nil)))

(defun putnam-2021-b5-count-greater (item items)
  (if (consp items)
      (+ (if (> item (car items)) 1 0)
         (putnam-2021-b5-count-greater
          item (cdr items)))
    0))

(defun putnam-2021-b5-inversion-count (permutation)
  (if (consp permutation)
      (+ (putnam-2021-b5-count-greater
          (car permutation) (cdr permutation))
         (putnam-2021-b5-inversion-count
          (cdr permutation)))
    0))

(defun putnam-2021-b5-diagonal-product
    (matrix permutation row)
  (if (consp permutation)
      (*
       (nth (car permutation) (nth row matrix))
       (putnam-2021-b5-diagonal-product
        matrix (cdr permutation) (+ row 1)))
    1))

(defun putnam-2021-b5-determinant-sum
    (matrix permutations)
  (if (consp permutations)
      (let* ((permutation (car permutations))
             (product
              (putnam-2021-b5-diagonal-product
               matrix permutation 0))
             (signed-product
              (if (evenp
                   (putnam-2021-b5-inversion-count
                    permutation))
                  product
                (- product))))
        (+
         signed-product
         (putnam-2021-b5-determinant-sum
          matrix (cdr permutations))))
    0))

(defun putnam-2021-b5-determinant
    (matrix dimension)
  (putnam-2021-b5-determinant-sum
   matrix
   (putnam-2021-b5-permutations
    (putnam-2021-b5-range-from 0 dimension))))

(defun putnam-2021-b5-all-principal-minors-odd-p
    (matrix subsets)
  (if (consp subsets)
      (and
       (or
        (endp (car subsets))
        (oddp
         (putnam-2021-b5-determinant
          (putnam-2021-b5-principal-submatrix
           matrix (car subsets))
          (len (car subsets)))))
       (putnam-2021-b5-all-principal-minors-odd-p
        matrix (cdr subsets)))
    t))

(defun putnam-2021-b5-very-odd-p (matrix dimension)
  (putnam-2021-b5-all-principal-minors-odd-p
   matrix
   (putnam-2021-b5-powerset
    (putnam-2021-b5-range-from 0 dimension))))

;; These functions give ordinary integer matrix multiplication.

(defun putnam-2021-b5-matrix-column
    (matrix column)
  (if (consp matrix)
      (cons
       (nth column (car matrix))
       (putnam-2021-b5-matrix-column
        (cdr matrix) column))
    nil))

(defun putnam-2021-b5-dot-product (left right)
  (if (and (consp left) (consp right))
      (+
       (* (car left) (car right))
       (putnam-2021-b5-dot-product
        (cdr left) (cdr right)))
    0))

(defun putnam-2021-b5-multiply-row
    (row right columns)
  (if (consp columns)
      (cons
       (putnam-2021-b5-dot-product
        row
        (putnam-2021-b5-matrix-column
         right (car columns)))
       (putnam-2021-b5-multiply-row
        row right (cdr columns)))
    nil))

(defun putnam-2021-b5-matrix-multiply-rows
    (left right columns)
  (if (consp left)
      (cons
       (putnam-2021-b5-multiply-row
        (car left) right columns)
       (putnam-2021-b5-matrix-multiply-rows
        (cdr left) right columns))
    nil))

(defun putnam-2021-b5-matrix-multiply
    (left right dimension)
  (putnam-2021-b5-matrix-multiply-rows
   left right
   (putnam-2021-b5-range-from 0 dimension)))

;; On positive exponents this recurrence is exactly the source matrix power.

(defun putnam-2021-b5-positive-power
    (matrix exponent dimension)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix exponent)))
  (if (or (not (natp exponent))
          (<= exponent 1))
      matrix
    (putnam-2021-b5-matrix-multiply
     (putnam-2021-b5-positive-power
      matrix (- exponent 1) dimension)
     matrix
     dimension)))

(defun putnambench-putnam-2021-b5-statement
    (n matrix k)
  (implies
   (and
    (posp n)
    (putnam-2021-b5-integer-matrix-p matrix n n)
    (putnam-2021-b5-very-odd-p matrix n)
    (posp k))
   (putnam-2021-b5-very-odd-p
    (putnam-2021-b5-positive-power matrix k n)
    n)))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

-- Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2021_b5
-- (putnambench__agda__putnam_2021_b5): positive powers of an integer matrix
-- preserve odd determinants of all nonempty principal submatrices. This file
-- contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module Main where

open import Agda.Builtin.Bool using (Bool; false; true)
open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Int using (Int; pos; negsuc)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; _*_)

infix 4 _<=N_
infixl 6 _+Z_
infixl 7 _*Z_

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

data _<=N_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set where
  zero<=N   : {n : Nat} -> zero <=N n
  suc<=sucN : {m n : Nat} -> m <=N n -> suc m <=N suc n

data Positive : Nat -> Set where
  positive : {n : Nat} -> Positive (suc n)

data Fin : Nat -> Set where
  fzero : {n : Nat} -> Fin (suc n)
  fsuc  : {n : Nat} -> Fin n -> Fin (suc n)

negative : Nat -> Int
negative zero =
  pos zero
negative (suc n) =
  negsuc n

difference : Nat -> Nat -> Int
difference zero zero =
  pos zero
difference (suc m) zero =
  pos (suc m)
difference zero (suc n) =
  negsuc n
difference (suc m) (suc n) =
  difference m n

_+Z_ : Int -> Int -> Int
pos m +Z pos n =
  pos (m + n)
pos m +Z negsuc n =
  difference m (suc n)
negsuc m +Z pos n =
  difference n (suc m)
negsuc m +Z negsuc n =
  negsuc (suc (m + n))

_*Z_ : Int -> Int -> Int
pos m *Z pos n =
  pos (m * n)
pos m *Z negsuc n =
  negative (m * suc n)
negsuc m *Z pos n =
  negative (suc m * n)
negsuc m *Z negsuc n =
  pos (suc m * suc n)

zeroZ : Int
zeroZ =
  pos zero

oneZ : Int
oneZ =
  pos (suc zero)

twoZ : Int
twoZ =
  pos (suc (suc zero))

negateZ : Int -> Int
negateZ (pos zero) =
  pos zero
negateZ (pos (suc n)) =
  negsuc n
negateZ (negsuc n) =
  pos (suc n)

OddInt : Int -> Set
OddInt z =
  Exists Int
    (\ half -> z == (twoZ *Z half) +Z oneZ)

finEqual : {n : Nat} -> Fin n -> Fin n -> Bool
finEqual fzero fzero =
  true
finEqual fzero (fsuc j) =
  false
finEqual (fsuc i) fzero =
  false
finEqual (fsuc i) (fsuc j) =
  finEqual i j

select : {A : Set} -> Bool -> A -> A -> A
select true yes no =
  yes
select false yes no =
  no

Matrix : Nat -> Set
Matrix n =
  Fin n -> Fin n -> Int

identityMatrix : {n : Nat} -> Matrix n
identityMatrix i j =
  select (finEqual i j) oneZ zeroZ

sumFinInt :
  {n : Nat} ->
  (Fin n -> Int) ->
  Int
sumFinInt {zero} terms =
  zeroZ
sumFinInt {suc n} terms =
  terms fzero +Z
  sumFinInt (\ i -> terms (fsuc i))

matrixMultiply :
  {n : Nat} ->
  Matrix n ->
  Matrix n ->
  Matrix n
matrixMultiply A B i j =
  sumFinInt
    (\ k -> A i k *Z B k j)

matrixPower :
  {n : Nat} ->
  Matrix n ->
  Nat ->
  Matrix n
matrixPower A zero =
  identityMatrix
matrixPower A (suc k) =
  matrixMultiply (matrixPower A k) A

skip :
  {n : Nat} ->
  Fin (suc n) ->
  Fin n ->
  Fin (suc n)
skip {zero} removed ()
skip {suc n} fzero i =
  fsuc i
skip {suc n} (fsuc removed) fzero =
  fzero
skip {suc n} (fsuc removed) (fsuc i) =
  fsuc (skip removed i)

firstRowMinor :
  {n : Nat} ->
  Matrix (suc n) ->
  Fin (suc n) ->
  Matrix n
firstRowMinor A removedColumn i j =
  A (fsuc i) (skip removedColumn j)

alternatingSign : {n : Nat} -> Fin n -> Int
alternatingSign fzero =
  oneZ
alternatingSign (fsuc i) =
  negateZ (alternatingSign i)

determinant :
  {n : Nat} ->
  Matrix n ->
  Int
determinant {zero} A =
  oneZ
determinant {suc n} A =
  sumFinInt
    (\ column ->
      alternatingSign column *Z
      (A fzero column *Z
       determinant (firstRowMinor A column)))

Injective :
  {A B : Set} ->
  (A -> B) ->
  Set
Injective {A} f =
  (x y : A) ->
  f x == f y ->
  x == y

principalSubmatrix :
  {n m : Nat} ->
  Matrix n ->
  (Fin m -> Fin n) ->
  Matrix m
principalSubmatrix A reindex i j =
  A (reindex i) (reindex j)

VeryOdd :
  {n : Nat} ->
  Matrix n ->
  Set
VeryOdd {n} A =
  (m : Nat) ->
  Positive m ->
  m <=N n ->
  (reindex : Fin m -> Fin n) ->
  Injective reindex ->
  OddInt (determinant (principalSubmatrix A reindex))

putnam-2021-b5 : Set
putnam-2021-b5 =
  (n : Nat) ->
  Positive n ->
  (A : Matrix n) ->
  VeryOdd A ->
  (k : Nat) ->
  Positive k ->
  VeryOdd (matrixPower A k)

title: putnam_2021_b5
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2021_b5:
  integer square matrices whose every nonempty principal minor has odd
  determinant remain very odd under every positive matrix power. This file
  contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open arithmeticTheory integerTheory pred_setTheory permutesTheory;

val putnam_2021_b5 =
  ``let determinant =
      \(s : num -> bool) (A : num -> num -> int).
        ITSET
          (\p acc.
             (if evenperm p then
                ITSET (\i q. A i (p i) * q) s 1
              else
                -(ITSET (\i q. A i (p i) * q) s 1)) +
             acc)
          {p : num -> num | p permutes s}
          0
    in
    let matrix_mul =
      \n : num. \A B : num -> num -> int. \i j : num.
        ITSET
          (\r : num. \sum : int. A i r * B r j + sum)
          (count n)
          0
    in
    let matrix_one =
      \i j : num. if i = j then (1 : int) else 0
    in
    let matrix_pow =
      \n : num. \A : num -> num -> int. \k : num.
        FUNPOW (\B. matrix_mul n B A) k matrix_one
    in
    let very_odd =
      \n : num. \A : num -> num -> int.
        !s : num -> bool.
          s SUBSET count n /\ s <> {}
          ==>
          ?q : int. determinant s A = 2 * q + 1
    in
      !n : num.
        1 <= n
        ==>
        !A : num -> num -> int.
          very_odd n A
          ==>
          !k : num.
            1 <= k
            ==>
            very_odd n (matrix_pow n A k)``;

title: putnam_2021_b5
content:
$(
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact
  putnam_2021_b5: positive powers of a very odd integer square matrix remain
  very odd, where every nonempty principal minor has odd determinant. This
  file contains no proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  For positive n, 0 ..^ n is the canonical n-element carrier and
  Base ` ((0 ..^ n) Mat ZZring) is the full set of integer n-by-n matrices.
  P21B5VeryOdd A n quantifies over every nonempty subset S of that carrier,
  restricts both matrix indices to S, and requires the resulting principal
  determinant to be odd.

  Simultaneously reindexing the rows and columns of a principal submatrix
  leaves its determinant unchanged, so the subset formulation is equivalent
  to the injective-reindexing formulation in the Lean source. The mulGrp
  exponent is ordinary matrix-ring exponentiation. Every declaration below
  is an unproved $a statement encoding; this database contains no $p proof
  declaration.
$)

$c P21B5VeryOdd $.

p21b5-very-odd-syntax $a wff ( P21B5VeryOdd A n ) $.

${
  $d A S i j n $.

  p21b5-very-odd-definition $a |- (
    ( P21B5VeryOdd A n )
    <->
    A. S e. ( ~P ( 0 ..^ n ) \ { (/) } )
      (
        (
          (
            S maDet ZZring
          )
          `
          (
            i e. S , j e. S |->
              ( A ` <. i , j >. )
          )
        )
        mod
        2
      )
      =
      1
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d A k n $.

  putnambench-putnam-2021-b5 $a |-
    A. n e. NN
      A. A e. ( Base ` ( ( 0 ..^ n ) Mat ZZring ) )
        (
          ( P21B5VeryOdd A n )
          ->
          A. k e. NN
            (
              P21B5VeryOdd
              (
                k
                ( .g ` ( mulGrp ` ( ( 0 ..^ n ) Mat ZZring ) ) )
                A
              )
              n
            )
        )
  $.
$}

title: putnam_2021_b5
content:
% Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2021_b5:
% every positive power of an integer square matrix whose nonempty principal
% minors all have odd determinant has the same property. This file contains
% no proof.

putnam_2021_b5[n: posnat]: THEORY
BEGIN
  matrix: TYPE = [nat, nat -> int]
  index_set: TYPE = [nat -> bool]

  identity_matrix: matrix =
    LAMBDA (row, column: nat):
      IF row = column THEN 1 ELSE 0 ENDIF

  matrix_product_entry(
      A, B: matrix,
      row, column, count: nat): RECURSIVE int =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      matrix_product_entry(A, B, row, column, count - 1)
        + A(row, count - 1) * B(count - 1, column)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  matrix_multiply(A, B: matrix): matrix =
    LAMBDA (row, column: nat):
      matrix_product_entry(A, B, row, column, n)

  matrix_power(A: matrix, exponent: nat): RECURSIVE matrix =
    IF exponent = 0 THEN
      identity_matrix
    ELSE
      matrix_multiply(
        matrix_power(A, exponent - 1),
        A)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE exponent

  function_code_count: nat = n ^ n

  permutation_entry(code, row: nat): nat =
    mod(ndiv(code, n ^ row), n)

  permutation_on_set(code: nat, S: index_set): bool =
    code < function_code_count
      AND
    (FORALL (row: nat):
      row < n IMPLIES
        ((S(row) IMPLIES S(permutation_entry(code, row)))
          AND
         (NOT S(row) IMPLIES
            permutation_entry(code, row) = row)))
      AND
    (FORALL (first, second: nat):
      (first < n
        AND second < n
        AND S(first)
        AND S(second)
        AND permutation_entry(code, first)
          = permutation_entry(code, second))
      IMPLIES first = second)

  pair_row(pair: nat): nat =
    ndiv(pair, n)

  pair_column(pair: nat): nat =
    mod(pair, n)

  inversion_at(
      code, pair: nat,
      S: index_set): bool =
    pair < n * n
      AND pair_row(pair) < pair_column(pair)
      AND S(pair_row(pair))
      AND S(pair_column(pair))
      AND permutation_entry(code, pair_row(pair))
        > permutation_entry(code, pair_column(pair))

  count_true(
      property: [nat -> bool],
      count: nat): RECURSIVE nat =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      count_true(property, count - 1)
        + IF property(count - 1) THEN 1 ELSE 0 ENDIF
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  inversion_count(code: nat, S: index_set): nat =
    count_true(
      LAMBDA (pair: nat): inversion_at(code, pair, S),
      n * n)

  permutation_sign(code: nat, S: index_set): int =
    IF mod(inversion_count(code, S), 2) = 0 THEN
      1
    ELSE
      -1
    ENDIF

  principal_product(
      A: matrix,
      S: index_set,
      code, count: nat): RECURSIVE int =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      1
    ELSE
      principal_product(A, S, code, count - 1)
        * IF S(count - 1) THEN
            A(
              count - 1,
              permutation_entry(code, count - 1))
          ELSE
            1
          ENDIF
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  principal_determinant_sum(
      A: matrix,
      S: index_set,
      limit: nat): RECURSIVE int =
    IF limit = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      LET code: nat = limit - 1 IN
        principal_determinant_sum(A, S, limit - 1)
          + IF permutation_on_set(code, S) THEN
              permutation_sign(code, S)
                * principal_product(A, S, code, n)
            ELSE
              0
            ENDIF
    ENDIF
  MEASURE limit

  principal_determinant(A: matrix, S: index_set): int =
    principal_determinant_sum(A, S, function_code_count)

  nonempty_index_set(S: index_set): bool =
    EXISTS (index: nat):
      index < n AND S(index)

  odd_integer(value: int): bool =
    EXISTS (half: int):
      value = 2 * half + 1

  very_odd(A: matrix): bool =
    FORALL (S: index_set):
      nonempty_index_set(S) IMPLIES
        odd_integer(principal_determinant(A, S))

  putnam_2021_b5: bool =
    FORALL (A: matrix):
      very_odd(A) IMPLIES
        (FORALL (exponent: nat):
          exponent >= 1 IMPLIES
            very_odd(matrix_power(A, exponent)))
END putnam_2021_b5

import Mathlib

open Polynomial

abbrev putnam_2022_a1_solution : Set (ℝ × ℝ) := sorry
-- {(a, b) | (a = 0 ∧ b = 0) ∨ 1 ≤ |a| ∨ (0 < |a| ∧ |a| < 1 ∧ letI rm := (1 - √(1 - a ^ 2)) / a; letI rp := (1 + √(1 - a ^ 2)) / a; (b < Real.log (1 + rm ^ 2) - a * rm ∨ b > Real.log (1 + rp ^ 2) - a * rp))}
/--
Determine all ordered pairs of real numbers $(a,b)$ such that the line $y = ax+b$ intersects the curve $y = \ln(1+x^2)$ in exactly one point.
-/
theorem putnam_2022_a1
: {(a, b) | ∃! x : ℝ, a * x + b = Real.log (1 + x^2)} = putnam_2022_a1_solution :=
sorry

title: putnam_2022_a1
content:
Require Import Reals Coquelicot.Coquelicot.
Definition putnam_2022_a1_solution : R -> R -> Prop :=
  fun a b =>
    (a = 0 /\ b = 0) \/
    Rabs a >= 1 \/
    (0 < Rabs a < 1 /\
      let rm := (1 - sqrt (1 - a ^ 2)) / a in
      let rp := (1 + sqrt (1 - a ^ 2)) / a in
      (b < ln (1 + rm ^ 2) - a * rm \/
       b > ln (1 + rp ^ 2) - a * rp)).

Theorem putnam_2022_a1 
    : forall a b : R,
      (exists! x : R, a * x + b = ln (1 + x ^ 2)) <->
      putnam_2022_a1_solution a b.
Proof. Admitted.
