theory putnam_2022_a1 imports Complex_Main
begin

definition putnam_2022_a1_solution :: "(real \<times> real) set" where
  "putnam_2022_a1_solution \<equiv> {(a, b).
    (a = 0 \<and> b = 0) \<or>
    1 \<le> abs a \<or>
    (0 < abs a \<and> abs a < 1 \<and>
      (let rm = (1 - sqrt (1 - a^2)) / a;
           rp = (1 + sqrt (1 - a^2)) / a
       in b < ln (1 + rm^2) - a * rm \<or>
          b > ln (1 + rp^2) - a * rp))}"
(* The two bounds are the tangent-line intercepts at the critical points rm and rp. *)
theorem putnam_2022_a1:
  shows "{(a, b). \<exists>! x :: real. a * x + b = ln (1 + x^2)} = putnam_2022_a1_solution"
  sorry

end

title: putnam_2022_a1
putnam_2022_a1
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2022_a1:
;; the real lines y = a*x+b that meet y = ln(1+x^2) in exactly one point
;; are characterized by the stated conditions on a and b. This file contains
;; no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))

;; The context presents a Dedekind-complete ordered field, hence the real
;; field up to ordered-field isomorphism, together with its standard
;; exponential and logarithm. Tame APPLY$ objects represent arbitrary sets
;; and functions extensionally, while DEFUN-SK keeps every unbounded
;; mathematical quantifier internal to the statement.

(defun p22a1-member-p (carrier x)
  (if (apply$ carrier (list x)) t nil))

(defun p22a1-unary-value (function x)
  (apply$ function (list x)))

(defun p22a1-binary-value (function x y)
  (apply$ function (list x y)))

(defun-sk p22a1-valid-set-p (carrier set)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (apply$ set (list x))
     (p22a1-member-p carrier x))))

(defun-sk p22a1-real-function-p (carrier function)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (p22a1-member-p carrier x)
     (p22a1-member-p
      carrier
      (p22a1-unary-value function x)))))

(defun-sk p22a1-field-laws-p
    (carrier add multiply negate inverse zero one)
  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (p22a1-member-p carrier x)
      (p22a1-member-p carrier y)
      (p22a1-member-p carrier z))
     (and
      (p22a1-member-p carrier
                      (p22a1-binary-value add x y))
      (p22a1-member-p carrier
                      (p22a1-binary-value multiply x y))
      (p22a1-member-p carrier
                      (p22a1-unary-value negate x))
      (p22a1-member-p carrier
                      (p22a1-unary-value inverse x))
      (equal
       (p22a1-binary-value
        add (p22a1-binary-value add x y) z)
       (p22a1-binary-value
        add x (p22a1-binary-value add y z)))
      (equal
       (p22a1-binary-value add x y)
       (p22a1-binary-value add y x))
      (equal (p22a1-binary-value add x zero) x)
      (equal
       (p22a1-binary-value
        add x (p22a1-unary-value negate x))
       zero)
      (equal
       (p22a1-binary-value
        multiply (p22a1-binary-value multiply x y) z)
       (p22a1-binary-value
        multiply x (p22a1-binary-value multiply y z)))
      (equal
       (p22a1-binary-value multiply x y)
       (p22a1-binary-value multiply y x))
      (equal (p22a1-binary-value multiply x one) x)
      (implies
       (equal x zero)
       (equal (p22a1-unary-value inverse x) zero))
      (implies
       (not (equal x zero))
       (equal
        (p22a1-binary-value
         multiply x (p22a1-unary-value inverse x))
        one))
      (equal
       (p22a1-binary-value
        multiply x (p22a1-binary-value add y z))
       (p22a1-binary-value
        add
        (p22a1-binary-value multiply x y)
        (p22a1-binary-value multiply x z)))))))

(defun-sk p22a1-order-laws-p
    (carrier add multiply zero less)
  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (p22a1-member-p carrier x)
      (p22a1-member-p carrier y)
      (p22a1-member-p carrier z))
     (and
      (not (p22a1-binary-value less x x))
      (or
       (equal x y)
       (p22a1-binary-value less x y)
       (p22a1-binary-value less y x))
      (implies
       (and
        (p22a1-binary-value less x y)
        (p22a1-binary-value less y z))
       (p22a1-binary-value less x z))
      (implies
       (p22a1-binary-value less x y)
       (p22a1-binary-value
        less
        (p22a1-binary-value add x z)
        (p22a1-binary-value add y z)))
      (implies
       (and
        (p22a1-binary-value less zero x)
        (p22a1-binary-value less zero y))
       (p22a1-binary-value
        less zero (p22a1-binary-value multiply x y)))))))

(defun-sk p22a1-set-nonempty-p (carrier set)
  (exists (x)
    (and
     (p22a1-member-p carrier x)
     (apply$ set (list x)))))

(defun-sk p22a1-upper-bound-p
    (carrier less set bound)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (and
      (p22a1-member-p carrier x)
      (apply$ set (list x)))
     (not (p22a1-binary-value less bound x)))))

(defun-sk p22a1-bounded-above-p
    (carrier less set)
  (exists (bound)
    (and
     (p22a1-member-p carrier bound)
     (p22a1-upper-bound-p
      carrier less set bound))))

(defun-sk p22a1-least-upper-bound-p
    (carrier less set supremum)
  (forall (bound)
    (implies
     (and
      (p22a1-member-p carrier bound)
      (p22a1-upper-bound-p carrier less set bound))
     (not (p22a1-binary-value less bound supremum)))))

(defun p22a1-supremum-p
    (carrier less set supremum)
  (and
   (p22a1-member-p carrier supremum)
   (p22a1-upper-bound-p carrier less set supremum)
   (p22a1-least-upper-bound-p
    carrier less set supremum)))

(defun-sk p22a1-has-supremum-p
    (carrier less set)
  (exists (supremum)
    (p22a1-supremum-p
     carrier less set supremum)))

(defun-sk p22a1-dedekind-complete-p
    (carrier less)
  (forall (set)
    (implies
     (and
      (tamep-functionp set)
      (p22a1-valid-set-p carrier set)
      (p22a1-set-nonempty-p carrier set)
      (p22a1-bounded-above-p carrier less set))
     (p22a1-has-supremum-p carrier less set))))

(defun p22a1-real-field-p
    (carrier zero one add multiply negate inverse less)
  (and
   (tamep-functionp carrier)
   (tamep-functionp add)
   (tamep-functionp multiply)
   (tamep-functionp negate)
   (tamep-functionp inverse)
   (tamep-functionp less)
   (p22a1-member-p carrier zero)
   (p22a1-member-p carrier one)
   (not (equal zero one))
   (p22a1-field-laws-p
    carrier add multiply negate inverse zero one)
   (p22a1-order-laws-p
    carrier add multiply zero less)
   (p22a1-binary-value less zero one)
   (p22a1-dedekind-complete-p carrier less)))

;; The outer context is
;; (field-context exponential logarithm square-root).

(defun p22a1-field-context (ctx)
  (nth 0 ctx))

(defun p22a1-r-carrier (ctx)
  (nth 0 (p22a1-field-context ctx)))

(defun p22a1-r-zero (ctx)
  (nth 1 (p22a1-field-context ctx)))

(defun p22a1-r-one (ctx)
  (nth 2 (p22a1-field-context ctx)))

(defun p22a1-r-add (ctx)
  (nth 3 (p22a1-field-context ctx)))

(defun p22a1-r-mul (ctx)
  (nth 4 (p22a1-field-context ctx)))

(defun p22a1-r-neg (ctx)
  (nth 5 (p22a1-field-context ctx)))

(defun p22a1-r-inv (ctx)
  (nth 6 (p22a1-field-context ctx)))

(defun p22a1-r-lt (ctx)
  (nth 7 (p22a1-field-context ctx)))

(defun p22a1-r-exp (ctx)
  (nth 1 ctx))

(defun p22a1-r-log (ctx)
  (nth 2 ctx))

(defun p22a1-r-sqrt (ctx)
  (nth 3 ctx))

(defun p22a1-field-context-p (field-context)
  (and
   (true-listp field-context)
   (equal (len field-context) 8)
   (p22a1-real-field-p
    (nth 0 field-context)
    (nth 1 field-context)
    (nth 2 field-context)
    (nth 3 field-context)
    (nth 4 field-context)
    (nth 5 field-context)
    (nth 6 field-context)
    (nth 7 field-context))))

(defun p22a1-r-add-value (ctx x y)
  (p22a1-binary-value (p22a1-r-add ctx) x y))

(defun p22a1-r-neg-value (ctx x)
  (p22a1-unary-value (p22a1-r-neg ctx) x))

(defun p22a1-r-sub-value (ctx x y)
  (p22a1-r-add-value
   ctx x (p22a1-r-neg-value ctx y)))

(defun p22a1-r-mul-value (ctx x y)
  (p22a1-binary-value (p22a1-r-mul ctx) x y))

(defun p22a1-r-inv-value (ctx x)
  (p22a1-unary-value (p22a1-r-inv ctx) x))

(defun p22a1-r-div-value (ctx numerator denominator)
  (p22a1-r-mul-value
   ctx numerator (p22a1-r-inv-value ctx denominator)))

(defun p22a1-r-lt-p (ctx x y)
  (if (p22a1-binary-value (p22a1-r-lt ctx) x y)
      t nil))

(defun p22a1-r-le-p (ctx x y)
  (not (p22a1-r-lt-p ctx y x)))

(defun p22a1-r-abs-value (ctx x)
  (if (p22a1-r-lt-p ctx x (p22a1-r-zero ctx))
      (p22a1-r-neg-value ctx x)
    x))

(defun p22a1-positive-real-p (ctx x)
  (and
   (p22a1-member-p (p22a1-r-carrier ctx) x)
   (p22a1-r-lt-p ctx (p22a1-r-zero ctx) x)))

;; HasDerivAt in epsilon-delta form:
;; |f(y)-f(x)-d*(y-x)| <= epsilon*|y-x| near x.

(defun-sk p22a1-derivative-neighborhood-p
    (ctx function derivative x epsilon radius)
  (forall (y)
    (implies
     (and
      (p22a1-member-p (p22a1-r-carrier ctx) y)
      (p22a1-r-lt-p
       ctx
       (p22a1-r-abs-value
        ctx (p22a1-r-sub-value ctx y x))
       radius))
     (p22a1-r-le-p
      ctx
      (p22a1-r-abs-value
       ctx
       (p22a1-r-sub-value
        ctx
        (p22a1-r-sub-value
         ctx
         (p22a1-unary-value function y)
         (p22a1-unary-value function x))
        (p22a1-r-mul-value
         ctx derivative
         (p22a1-r-sub-value ctx y x))))
      (p22a1-r-mul-value
       ctx epsilon
       (p22a1-r-abs-value
        ctx (p22a1-r-sub-value ctx y x)))))))

(defun-sk p22a1-derivative-radius-exists-p
    (ctx function derivative x epsilon)
  (exists (radius)
    (and
     (p22a1-positive-real-p ctx radius)
     (p22a1-derivative-neighborhood-p
      ctx function derivative x epsilon radius))))

(defun-sk p22a1-derivative-epsilon-p
    (ctx function derivative x)
  (forall (epsilon)
    (implies
     (p22a1-positive-real-p ctx epsilon)
     (p22a1-derivative-radius-exists-p
      ctx function derivative x epsilon))))

(defun p22a1-has-derivative-at-p
    (ctx function derivative x)
  (and
   (p22a1-member-p (p22a1-r-carrier ctx) derivative)
   (p22a1-member-p (p22a1-r-carrier ctx) x)
   (p22a1-derivative-epsilon-p
    ctx function derivative x)))

(defun-sk p22a1-derivative-exists-at-p
    (ctx function x)
  (exists (derivative)
    (p22a1-has-derivative-at-p
     ctx function derivative x)))

(defun-sk p22a1-differentiable-on-positive-p
    (ctx function)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (p22a1-positive-real-p ctx x)
     (p22a1-derivative-exists-at-p
      ctx function x))))

;; The differential initial-value problem E' = E, E(0) = 1 characterizes the
;; standard real exponential. LOG is its inverse on the positive reals.

(defun-sk p22a1-exponential-laws-p (ctx)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (p22a1-member-p (p22a1-r-carrier ctx) x)
     (and
      (p22a1-positive-real-p
       ctx (p22a1-unary-value (p22a1-r-exp ctx) x))
      (p22a1-has-derivative-at-p
       ctx
       (p22a1-r-exp ctx)
       (p22a1-unary-value (p22a1-r-exp ctx) x)
       x)))))

(defun p22a1-exponential-function-p (ctx)
  (and
   (tamep-functionp (p22a1-r-exp ctx))
   (p22a1-real-function-p
    (p22a1-r-carrier ctx) (p22a1-r-exp ctx))
   (equal
    (p22a1-unary-value
     (p22a1-r-exp ctx) (p22a1-r-zero ctx))
    (p22a1-r-one ctx))
   (p22a1-exponential-laws-p ctx)))

(defun-sk p22a1-logarithm-laws-p (ctx)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (p22a1-member-p (p22a1-r-carrier ctx) x)
     (and
      (equal
       (p22a1-unary-value
        (p22a1-r-log ctx)
        (p22a1-unary-value (p22a1-r-exp ctx) x))
       x)
      (implies
       (p22a1-positive-real-p ctx x)
       (equal
        (p22a1-unary-value
         (p22a1-r-exp ctx)
         (p22a1-unary-value (p22a1-r-log ctx) x))
        x))))))

(defun p22a1-logarithm-function-p (ctx)
  (and
   (tamep-functionp (p22a1-r-log ctx))
   (p22a1-real-function-p
    (p22a1-r-carrier ctx) (p22a1-r-log ctx))
   (p22a1-logarithm-laws-p ctx)))

(defun p22a1-r-square-value (ctx x)
  (p22a1-r-mul-value ctx x x))

(defun-sk p22a1-square-root-laws-p (ctx)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (and
      (p22a1-member-p (p22a1-r-carrier ctx) x)
      (p22a1-r-le-p ctx (p22a1-r-zero ctx) x))
     (let ((root
            (p22a1-unary-value (p22a1-r-sqrt ctx) x)))
       (and
        (p22a1-r-le-p ctx (p22a1-r-zero ctx) root)
        (equal (p22a1-r-square-value ctx root) x))))))

(defun p22a1-square-root-function-p (ctx)
  (and
   (tamep-functionp (p22a1-r-sqrt ctx))
   (p22a1-real-function-p
    (p22a1-r-carrier ctx) (p22a1-r-sqrt ctx))
   (p22a1-square-root-laws-p ctx)))

(defun p22a1-context-p (ctx)
  (and
   (true-listp ctx)
   (equal (len ctx) 4)
   (p22a1-field-context-p (p22a1-field-context ctx))
   (p22a1-exponential-function-p ctx)
   (p22a1-logarithm-function-p ctx)
   (p22a1-square-root-function-p ctx)))

;; The equation a*x+b = ln(1+x^2), with exact unique existence.

(defun p22a1-intersection-p (ctx a b x)
  (and
   (p22a1-member-p (p22a1-r-carrier ctx) x)
   (equal
    (p22a1-r-add-value
     ctx (p22a1-r-mul-value ctx a x) b)
    (p22a1-unary-value
     (p22a1-r-log ctx)
     (p22a1-r-add-value
      ctx
      (p22a1-r-one ctx)
      (p22a1-r-square-value ctx x))))))

(defun-sk p22a1-only-intersection-p (ctx a b x)
  (forall (y)
    (implies
     (p22a1-intersection-p ctx a b y)
     (equal y x))))

(defun-sk p22a1-exactly-one-intersection-p (ctx a b)
  (exists (x)
    (and
     (p22a1-intersection-p ctx a b x)
     (p22a1-only-intersection-p ctx a b x))))

;; Explicit classification from the published problem. For 0 < |a| < 1,
;; RMIN and RMAX are the two critical points of ln(1+x^2)-a*x.

(defun p22a1-rmin (ctx a root)
  (p22a1-r-div-value
   ctx
   (p22a1-r-sub-value ctx (p22a1-r-one ctx) root)
   a))

(defun p22a1-rmax (ctx a root)
  (p22a1-r-div-value
   ctx
   (p22a1-r-add-value ctx (p22a1-r-one ctx) root)
   a))

(defun p22a1-critical-value (ctx a x)
  (p22a1-r-sub-value
   ctx
   (p22a1-unary-value
    (p22a1-r-log ctx)
    (p22a1-r-add-value
     ctx
     (p22a1-r-one ctx)
     (p22a1-r-square-value ctx x)))
   (p22a1-r-mul-value ctx a x)))

(defun p22a1-middle-solution-p (ctx a b absolute-a)
  (let* ((one-minus-a-square
          (p22a1-r-sub-value
           ctx
           (p22a1-r-one ctx)
           (p22a1-r-square-value ctx a)))
         (root
          (p22a1-unary-value
           (p22a1-r-sqrt ctx)
           one-minus-a-square))
         (rmin (p22a1-rmin ctx a root))
         (rmax (p22a1-rmax ctx a root)))
    (and
     (p22a1-r-lt-p ctx (p22a1-r-zero ctx) absolute-a)
     (p22a1-r-lt-p ctx absolute-a (p22a1-r-one ctx))
     (or
      (p22a1-r-lt-p
       ctx b (p22a1-critical-value ctx a rmin))
      (p22a1-r-lt-p
       ctx (p22a1-critical-value ctx a rmax) b)))))

(defun p22a1-solution-member-p (ctx a b)
  (let ((absolute-a (p22a1-r-abs-value ctx a)))
    (or
     (and
      (equal a (p22a1-r-zero ctx))
      (equal b (p22a1-r-zero ctx)))
     (p22a1-r-le-p ctx (p22a1-r-one ctx) absolute-a)
     (p22a1-middle-solution-p ctx a b absolute-a))))

;; ACL2 universally closes CTX, A, and B. The IFF is the pointwise form of
;; equality between the set of uniquely intersecting pairs and the displayed
;; solution set.
(defun putnambench-putnam-2022-a1-statement (ctx a b)
  (implies
   (and
    (p22a1-context-p ctx)
    (p22a1-member-p (p22a1-r-carrier ctx) a)
    (p22a1-member-p (p22a1-r-carrier ctx) b))
   (iff
    (p22a1-exactly-one-intersection-p ctx a b)
    (p22a1-solution-member-p ctx a b))))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

title: putnam_2022_a1
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2022_a1
-- (putnambench__agda__putnam_2022_a1): the real lines meeting
-- y = log(1 + x^2) in exactly one point are characterized explicitly.
-- This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module Main where

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; _*_)

infix 4 _!=_ _<=N_
infixr 3 _and_
infixr 2 _or_
infix 1 _iff_

data Bottom : Set where

Not : Set -> Set
Not A =
  A -> Bottom

_!=_ : {A : Set} -> A -> A -> Set
x != y =
  Not (x == y)

record _and_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data _or_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  left  : A -> A or B
  right : B -> A or B

record _iff_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor equivalence
  field
    forward  : A -> B
    backward : B -> A

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

record ExistsUnique (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor unique-witness
  field
    unique-value    : A
    unique-property : P unique-value
    uniqueness      : (other : A) -> P other -> other == unique-value

data _<=N_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set where
  zero<=N   : {n : Nat} -> zero <=N n
  suc<=sucN : {m n : Nat} -> m <=N n -> suc m <=N suc n

record CompleteOrderedRealField (R : Set) : Set1 where
  field
    zeroR oneR : R
    add multiply : R -> R -> R
    negate inverse squareRoot : R -> R
    lessOrEqual : R -> R -> Set
    fromNat : Nat -> R

    one-not-zero :
      oneR != zeroR

    add-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> add x y == add y x
    add-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      add (add x y) z == add x (add y z)
    add-zero :
      (x : R) -> add x zeroR == x
    add-inverse :
      (x : R) -> add x (negate x) == zeroR

    multiply-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> multiply x y == multiply y x
    multiply-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply (multiply x y) z ==
      multiply x (multiply y z)
    multiply-one :
      (x : R) -> multiply x oneR == x
    multiply-zero :
      (x : R) -> multiply x zeroR == zeroR
    distribute :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply x (add y z) ==
      add (multiply x y) (multiply x z)
    inverse-zero :
      inverse zeroR == zeroR
    multiply-inverse :
      (x : R) ->
      x != zeroR ->
      multiply x (inverse x) == oneR

    order-reflexive :
      (x : R) -> lessOrEqual x x
    order-transitive :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y z ->
      lessOrEqual x z
    order-antisymmetric :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y x ->
      x == y
    order-total :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y or lessOrEqual y x
    add-order :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual (add z x) (add z y)
    multiply-nonnegative :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR x ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR y ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR (multiply x y)
    zero-less-than-one :
      lessOrEqual zeroR oneR and zeroR != oneR

    fromNat-zero :
      fromNat zero == zeroR
    fromNat-successor :
      (n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (suc n) == add (fromNat n) oneR
    fromNat-addition :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m + n) == add (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-multiplication :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m * n) == multiply (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-injective :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat m == fromNat n ->
      m == n

    archimedean :
      (x : R) ->
      Exists Nat
        (\ n -> lessOrEqual x (fromNat n))
    least-upper-bound :
      (P : R -> Set) ->
      Exists R P ->
      Exists R
        (\ upper ->
          (x : R) ->
          P x ->
          lessOrEqual x upper) ->
      Exists R
        (\ supremum ->
          ((x : R) ->
            P x ->
            lessOrEqual x supremum)
          and
          ((upper : R) ->
            ((x : R) ->
              P x ->
              lessOrEqual x upper) ->
            lessOrEqual supremum upper))

    square-root-nonnegative :
      (x : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR (squareRoot x)
    square-root-square :
      (x : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR x ->
      multiply (squareRoot x) (squareRoot x) == x
    square-root-nonpositive :
      (x : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x zeroR ->
      squareRoot x == zeroR
    square-root-unique :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR y ->
      multiply y y == x ->
      y == squareRoot x

open CompleteOrderedRealField

oneN : Nat
oneN =
  suc zero

subtract :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
subtract reals x y =
  add reals x (negate reals y)

divide :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
divide reals x y =
  multiply reals x (inverse reals y)

square :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R
square reals x =
  multiply reals x x

StrictLess :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
StrictLess reals x y =
  lessOrEqual reals x y and x != y

CloseTo :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
CloseTo reals center radius x =
  StrictLess reals
    (subtract reals center radius)
    x
  and
  StrictLess reals
    x
    (add reals center radius)

maximum :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
maximum reals x y with order-total reals x y
... | left _ =
  y
... | right _ =
  x

absoluteValue :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R
absoluteValue reals x =
  maximum reals x (negate reals x)

naturalPower :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  Nat ->
  R
naturalPower reals x zero =
  oneR reals
naturalPower reals x (suc n) =
  multiply reals
    (naturalPower reals x n)
    x

factorial : Nat -> Nat
factorial zero =
  oneN
factorial (suc n) =
  suc n * factorial n

sumFirst :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Nat ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  R
sumFirst reals zero term =
  zeroR reals
sumFirst reals (suc n) term =
  add reals
    (sumFirst reals n term)
    (term n)

ConvergesTo :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  R ->
  Set
ConvergesTo {R} reals sequence limit =
  (epsilon : R) ->
  StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) epsilon ->
  Exists Nat
    (\ cutoff ->
      (n : Nat) ->
      cutoff <=N n ->
      CloseTo reals limit epsilon (sequence n))

SeriesHasSum :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  R ->
  Set
SeriesHasSum reals terms limit =
  ConvergesTo reals
    (\ n -> sumFirst reals n terms)
    limit

exponentialTerm :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  Nat ->
  R
exponentialTerm reals x n =
  divide reals
    (naturalPower reals x n)
    (fromNat reals (factorial n))

ExponentialValue :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
ExponentialValue reals x value =
  SeriesHasSum reals
    (exponentialTerm reals x)
    value

record StandardExponentialLogarithm
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) :
  Set1 where

  field
    exponential logarithm : R -> R

    exponential-series :
      (x : R) ->
      ExponentialValue reals x (exponential x)

    exponential-positive :
      (x : R) ->
      StrictLess reals
        (zeroR reals)
        (exponential x)

    exponential-injective :
      (x y : R) ->
      exponential x == exponential y ->
      x == y

    exponential-logarithm :
      (x : R) ->
      StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) x ->
      exponential (logarithm x) == x

    logarithm-exponential :
      (x : R) ->
      logarithm (exponential x) == x

open StandardExponentialLogarithm

module Putnam2022A1Statement
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R)
  (analysis : StandardExponentialLogarithm reals) where

  equation : R -> R -> R -> Set
  equation a b x =
    add reals
      (multiply reals a x)
      b
    ==
    logarithm analysis
      (add reals
        (oneR reals)
        (square reals x))

  criticalPointMinus : R -> R
  criticalPointMinus a =
    divide reals
      (subtract reals
        (oneR reals)
        (squareRoot reals
          (subtract reals
            (oneR reals)
            (square reals a))))
      a

  criticalPointPlus : R -> R
  criticalPointPlus a =
    divide reals
      (add reals
        (oneR reals)
        (squareRoot reals
          (subtract reals
            (oneR reals)
            (square reals a))))
      a

  height : R -> R -> R
  height a x =
    subtract reals
      (logarithm analysis
        (add reals
          (oneR reals)
          (square reals x)))
      (multiply reals a x)

  solution : R -> R -> Set
  solution a b =
    (a == zeroR reals and b == zeroR reals)
    or
    lessOrEqual reals
      (oneR reals)
      (absoluteValue reals a)
    or
    (StrictLess reals
      (zeroR reals)
      (absoluteValue reals a)
    and
    StrictLess reals
      (absoluteValue reals a)
      (oneR reals)
    and
    (StrictLess reals
      b
      (height a (criticalPointMinus a))
    or
    StrictLess reals
      (height a (criticalPointPlus a))
      b))

  proposition : Set
  proposition =
    (a b : R) ->
    ExistsUnique R (equation a b)
    iff
    solution a b

putnam-2022-a1 =
  (R : Set) ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) ->
  (analysis : StandardExponentialLogarithm reals) ->
  Putnam2022A1Statement.proposition reals analysis

(*
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2022_a1:
  the real lines y = a*x + b that intersect y = ln(1+x^2) in exactly one
  point are characterized by explicit slope and intercept conditions. This
  file contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open pairTheory pred_setTheory realTheory transcTheory;

val putnam_2022_a1 =
  ``let solution =
      \p : real # real.
        let a = FST p
        in
        let b = SND p
        in
          (a = 0 /\ b = 0) \/
          1 <= abs a \/
          (0 < abs a /\ abs a < 1 /\
           (let rm = (1 - sqrt (1 - a pow 2)) / a
            in
            let rp = (1 + sqrt (1 - a pow 2)) / a
            in
              b < ln (1 + rm pow 2) - a * rm \/
              b > ln (1 + rp pow 2) - a * rp))
    in
      {p : real # real |
         ?!x : real.
           FST p * x + SND p = ln (1 + x pow 2)} =
      {p : real # real | solution p}``;

title: putnam_2022_a1
content:
% Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2022_a1:
% the ordered real pairs whose lines meet y = ln(1 + x^2) exactly once are
% characterized by the stated slope and intercept conditions. This file
% contains no proof.

putnam_2022_a1: THEORY
BEGIN
  real_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> real]

  safe_div(numerator, denominator: real): real =
    IF denominator = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      numerator / denominator
    ENDIF

  nat_factorial(index: nat): RECURSIVE nat =
    IF index = 0 THEN
      1
    ELSE
      index * nat_factorial(index - 1)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE index

  exponential_partial(x: real, count: nat): RECURSIVE real =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      LET index: nat = count - 1 IN
        exponential_partial(x, count - 1)
          + safe_div(
              x ^ index,
              nat_factorial(index) :: real)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  converges_to(sequence: real_sequence, value: real): bool =
    FORALL (epsilon_value: posreal):
      EXISTS (cutoff: nat):
        FORALL (index: nat):
          cutoff <= index IMPLIES
            abs(sequence(index) - value) < epsilon_value

  real_exponential(x: real): real =
    epsilon(
      LAMBDA (value: real):
        converges_to(
          LAMBDA (count: nat):
            exponential_partial(x, count),
          value))

  natural_log(x: real): real =
    IF x > 0 THEN
      epsilon(
        LAMBDA (value: real):
          real_exponential(value) = x)
    ELSE
      0
    ENDIF

  nonnegative_sqrt(x: real): real =
    IF x >= 0 THEN
      epsilon(
        LAMBDA (root: real):
          root >= 0 AND root * root = x)
    ELSE
      0
    ENDIF

  curve_value(x: real): real =
    natural_log(1 + x ^ 2)

  unique_intersection(a, b: real): bool =
    EXISTS (x: real):
      a * x + b = curve_value(x)
        AND FORALL (y: real):
          a * y + b = curve_value(y) IMPLIES y = x

  classified_pair(a, b: real): bool =
    (a = 0 AND b = 0)
      OR abs(a) >= 1
      OR (0 < abs(a)
        AND abs(a) < 1
        AND LET discriminant_root: real =
                  nonnegative_sqrt(1 - a ^ 2),
                lower_critical_point: real =
                  safe_div(1 - discriminant_root, a),
                upper_critical_point: real =
                  safe_div(1 + discriminant_root, a)
            IN
              b
                < curve_value(lower_critical_point)
                    - a * lower_critical_point
                OR b
                  > curve_value(upper_critical_point)
                      - a * upper_critical_point)

  putnam_2022_a1: bool =
    FORALL (a, b: real):
      unique_intersection(a, b) IFF classified_pair(a, b)
END putnam_2022_a1

-- fun n => 2*n - 2
/--
Let $n$ be an integer with $n \geq 2$. Over all real polynomials $p(x)$ of degree $n$, what is the largest possible number of negative coefficients of $p(x)^2$?
-/
theorem putnam_2022_a2
(n : ℕ)
(hn : n ≥ 2)
(S : Set ℝ[X])
(hS : S = {P | natDegree P = n})
(negs : ℝ[X] → ℕ)
(hnegs : ∀ P : ℝ[X], negs P = ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (P.natDegree + 1), if P.coeff i < 0 then 1 else 0)
: sSup {negs (P^2) | P ∈ S} = putnam_2022_a2_solution n :=
sorry

From mathcomp Require Import all_algebra all_ssreflect.
From mathcomp Require Import reals.
From mathcomp Require Import classical_sets.

Set Implicit Arguments.
Unset Strict Implicit.
Unset Printing Implicit Defensive.

Local Open Scope ring_scope.
Local Open Scope classical_set_scope.

Variable R : realType.
Definition putnam_2022_a2_solution : nat -> nat := fun n => (n.*2 - 2)%nat.
Theorem putnam_2022_a2
    (n : nat)
    (hn : ge n 2)
    (S : set {poly R} := [set P | size P = n.+1])
    (negs : {poly R} -> nat)
    (hnegs : forall P, negs P = count (fun cf => cf < 0) (P : seq R))
    : (forall P, P \in S -> le (negs (P ^ 2)) (putnam_2022_a2_solution n)) /\
      (exists P, P \in S /\ negs (P ^ 2) = putnam_2022_a2_solution n).
Proof. Admitted.

(*
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2022_a2:
  the largest possible number of negative coefficients in the square of a
  degree-n real polynomial is 2*n - 2 for n at least 2. This file contains
  no proof.
*)

let statement =
  `let degree_is =
     \n:num. \p:num->real.
       ~(p n = &0) /\ (!k:num. n < k ==> p k = &0) in
   let square_coeff =
     \p:num->real. \k:num.
       sum (0..k) (\i:num. p i * p (k - i)) in
   let negative_coefficients =
     \p:num->real. \m:num.
       CARD {k:num | k <= m /\ square_coeff p k < &0} in
   !n:num.
     2 <= n
     ==>
     ((!p:num->real.
         degree_is n p
         ==> negative_coefficients p (2 * n) <= 2 * n - 2) /\
      (?p:num->real.
         degree_is n p /\
         negative_coefficients p (2 * n) = 2 * n - 2))`;;

;; Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2022_a2:
;; among real polynomials of degree n, the largest possible number of negative
;; coefficients in the square is 2*n-2. This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))

;; The Lean statement, the Rocq statement, and the mathematical problem text
;; use degree n. The Isabelle source's degree 2*n is an isolated transcription
;; mismatch with those sources and with its own annotated answer.
;;
;; This statement uses rational coefficient lists as an exact, bidirectionally
;; equivalent presentation of the real-coefficient theorem, not as an
;; approximation. Every coefficient of P^2 is a polynomial expression in the
;; finitely many coefficients of P. Hence each strict sign condition and the
;; nonzero leading-coefficient condition persist on a neighborhood of P.
;; Density of Q in the real closed ordered field R therefore gives:
;;
;;   * a real counterexample to the rational upper bound can be approximated
;;     by a rational counterexample with the same required negative signs;
;;   * a real attaining polynomial can be approximated by a rational one
;;     retaining all its negative square coefficients and its degree;
;;   * every rational polynomial is itself a real polynomial.
;;
;; Thus the universal upper bound and existential attainment over rationals
;; together are logically equivalent to those same clauses over reals. This
;; concrete reduction is non-vacuous for every n: rational degree-n
;; coefficient lists exist (for example, the coefficient list of x^n).
;;
;; Polynomials are lists in ascending coefficient order. FN-EQUAL supplies the
;; internal universal polynomial quantifier, and negated FN-EQUAL supplies the
;; internal existential polynomial quantifier. The generated lambda bodies
;; contain only ACL2 primitives (IF, EQUAL, TRUE-LISTP, LEN, NTH, RATIONALP,
;; <, BINARY-+, and BINARY-*); no unwarranted user function occurs in either
;; FN-EQUAL operand.

(defun putnam-2022-a2-quoted (object)
  (list 'quote object))

(defun putnam-2022-a2-and-terms (terms)
  (if (endp terms)
      (putnam-2022-a2-quoted t)
    (list
     'if
     (car terms)
     (putnam-2022-a2-and-terms (cdr terms))
     (putnam-2022-a2-quoted nil))))

(defun putnam-2022-a2-not-term (term)
  (list
   'if
   term
   (putnam-2022-a2-quoted nil)
   (putnam-2022-a2-quoted t)))

(defun putnam-2022-a2-implies-term (antecedent consequent)
  (list
   'if
   antecedent
   consequent
   (putnam-2022-a2-quoted t)))

(defun putnam-2022-a2-less-equal-term (left right)
  (list
   'if
   (list '< right left)
   (putnam-2022-a2-quoted nil)
   (putnam-2022-a2-quoted t)))

(defun putnam-2022-a2-add-term (left right)
  (list 'binary-+ left right))

(defun putnam-2022-a2-multiply-term (left right)
  (list 'binary-* left right))

(defun putnam-2022-a2-sum-terms (terms)
  (if (endp terms)
      (putnam-2022-a2-quoted 0)
    (putnam-2022-a2-add-term
     (car terms)
     (putnam-2022-a2-sum-terms (cdr terms)))))

(defun putnam-2022-a2-nth-term (index polynomial)
  (list
   'nth
   (putnam-2022-a2-quoted (nfix index))
   polynomial))

(defun putnam-2022-a2-rational-coefficient-terms
    (remaining polynomial)
  (if (zp remaining)
      nil
    (cons
     (list
      'rationalp
      (putnam-2022-a2-nth-term
       (1- remaining) polynomial))
     (putnam-2022-a2-rational-coefficient-terms
      (1- remaining) polynomial))))

(defun putnam-2022-a2-degree-n-polynomial-term
    (polynomial n)
  (let ((degree (nfix n)))
    (putnam-2022-a2-and-terms
     (append
      (list
       (list 'true-listp polynomial)
       (list
        'equal
        (list 'len polynomial)
        (putnam-2022-a2-quoted (+ degree 1))))
      (putnam-2022-a2-rational-coefficient-terms
       (+ degree 1) polynomial)
      (list
       (putnam-2022-a2-not-term
        (list
         'equal
         (putnam-2022-a2-nth-term degree polynomial)
         (putnam-2022-a2-quoted 0))))))))

(defun putnam-2022-a2-square-coefficient-products
    (remaining index degree coefficient polynomial)
  (if (zp remaining)
      nil
    (let* ((i (nfix index))
           (n (nfix degree))
           (k (nfix coefficient))
           (j (- k i))
           (rest
            (putnam-2022-a2-square-coefficient-products
             (1- remaining) (+ i 1) n k polynomial)))
      (if (and (<= i k) (<= j n))
          (cons
           (putnam-2022-a2-multiply-term
            (putnam-2022-a2-nth-term i polynomial)
            (putnam-2022-a2-nth-term j polynomial))
           rest)
        rest))))

(defun putnam-2022-a2-square-coefficient-term
    (degree coefficient polynomial)
  (let ((n (nfix degree))
        (k (nfix coefficient)))
    (putnam-2022-a2-sum-terms
     (putnam-2022-a2-square-coefficient-products
      (+ n 1) 0 n k polynomial))))

(defun putnam-2022-a2-negative-indicator-terms
    (remaining coefficient degree polynomial)
  (if (zp remaining)
      nil
    (let ((k (nfix coefficient))
          (n (nfix degree)))
      (cons
       (list
        'if
        (list
         '<
         (putnam-2022-a2-square-coefficient-term
          n k polynomial)
         (putnam-2022-a2-quoted 0))
        (putnam-2022-a2-quoted 1)
        (putnam-2022-a2-quoted 0))
       (putnam-2022-a2-negative-indicator-terms
        (1- remaining) (+ k 1) n polynomial)))))

(defun putnam-2022-a2-negative-square-count-term
    (polynomial n)
  (let ((degree (nfix n)))
    (putnam-2022-a2-sum-terms
     (putnam-2022-a2-negative-indicator-terms
      (+ (* 2 degree) 1) 0 degree polynomial))))

(defun putnam-2022-a2-solution (n)
  (- (* 2 (nfix n)) 2))

(defun putnam-2022-a2-true-function ()
  '(lambda (polynomial) 't))

(defun putnam-2022-a2-upper-bound-function (n)
  (let* ((polynomial 'polynomial)
         (degree (nfix n))
         (domain
          (putnam-2022-a2-degree-n-polynomial-term
           polynomial degree))
         (count
          (putnam-2022-a2-negative-square-count-term
           polynomial degree)))
    (list
     'lambda
     '(polynomial)
     (putnam-2022-a2-implies-term
      domain
      (putnam-2022-a2-less-equal-term
       count
       (putnam-2022-a2-quoted
        (putnam-2022-a2-solution degree)))))))

(defun putnam-2022-a2-attainment-failure-function (n)
  (let* ((polynomial 'polynomial)
         (degree (nfix n))
         (domain
          (putnam-2022-a2-degree-n-polynomial-term
           polynomial degree))
         (count
          (putnam-2022-a2-negative-square-count-term
           polynomial degree)))
    (list
     'lambda
     '(polynomial)
     (list
      'if
      (putnam-2022-a2-and-terms
       (list
        domain
        (list
         'equal
         count
         (putnam-2022-a2-quoted
          (putnam-2022-a2-solution degree)))))
      (putnam-2022-a2-quoted nil)
      (putnam-2022-a2-quoted t)))))

(defun putnam-2022-a2-quantifier-functions-tame-p (n)
  (and
   (tamep-functionp
    (putnam-2022-a2-upper-bound-function n))
   (tamep-functionp
    (putnam-2022-a2-attainment-failure-function n))
   (tamep-functionp
    (putnam-2022-a2-true-function))))

(defun putnam-2022-a2-upper-bound-p (n)
  (let ((condition
         (putnam-2022-a2-upper-bound-function n))
        (always-true
         (putnam-2022-a2-true-function)))
    (and
     (tamep-functionp condition)
     (tamep-functionp always-true)
     (fn-equal condition always-true))))

(defun putnam-2022-a2-attainment-p (n)
  (let ((failure
         (putnam-2022-a2-attainment-failure-function n))
        (always-true
         (putnam-2022-a2-true-function)))
    (and
     (tamep-functionp failure)
     (tamep-functionp always-true)
     (not (fn-equal failure always-true)))))

(defun putnambench-putnam-2022-a2-statement (n)
  (implies
   (and
    (natp n)
    (<= 2 n))
   (and
    (putnam-2022-a2-quantifier-functions-tame-p n)
    (putnam-2022-a2-upper-bound-p n)
    (putnam-2022-a2-attainment-p n))))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

module Main where

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; _*_; _-_)

infix 4 _!=_ _<=N_ _<N_
infixr 3 _and_
infixr 2 _or_

data Bottom : Set where

Not : Set -> Set
Not A =
  A -> Bottom

_!=_ : {A : Set} -> A -> A -> Set
x != y =
  Not (x == y)

record _and_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data _or_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  left  : A -> A or B
  right : B -> A or B

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

data _<=N_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set where
  zero<=N   : {n : Nat} -> zero <=N n
  suc<=sucN : {m n : Nat} -> m <=N n -> suc m <=N suc n

_<N_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set
m <N n =
  suc m <=N n

record CompleteOrderedRealField (R : Set) : Set1 where
  field
    zeroR oneR : R
    add multiply : R -> R -> R
    negate inverse : R -> R
    lessOrEqual : R -> R -> Set
    fromNat : Nat -> R

    one-not-zero :
      oneR != zeroR

    add-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> add x y == add y x
    add-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      add (add x y) z == add x (add y z)
    add-zero :
      (x : R) -> add x zeroR == x
    add-inverse :
      (x : R) -> add x (negate x) == zeroR

    multiply-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> multiply x y == multiply y x
    multiply-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply (multiply x y) z ==
      multiply x (multiply y z)
    multiply-one :
      (x : R) -> multiply x oneR == x
    multiply-zero :
      (x : R) -> multiply x zeroR == zeroR
    distribute :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply x (add y z) ==
      add (multiply x y) (multiply x z)
    inverse-zero :
      inverse zeroR == zeroR
    multiply-inverse :
      (x : R) ->
      x != zeroR ->
      multiply x (inverse x) == oneR

    order-reflexive :
      (x : R) -> lessOrEqual x x
    order-transitive :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y z ->
      lessOrEqual x z
    order-antisymmetric :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y x ->
      x == y
    order-total :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y or lessOrEqual y x
    add-order :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual (add z x) (add z y)
    multiply-nonnegative :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR x ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR y ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR (multiply x y)
    zero-less-than-one :
      lessOrEqual zeroR oneR and zeroR != oneR

    fromNat-zero :
      fromNat zero == zeroR
    fromNat-successor :
      (n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (suc n) == add (fromNat n) oneR
    fromNat-addition :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m + n) == add (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-multiplication :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m * n) == multiply (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-injective :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat m == fromNat n ->
      m == n

    archimedean :
      (x : R) ->
      Exists Nat
        (\ n ->
          lessOrEqual x (fromNat n))
    least-upper-bound :
      (P : R -> Set) ->
      Exists R P ->
      Exists R
        (\ upper ->
          (x : R) ->
          P x ->
          lessOrEqual x upper) ->
      Exists R
        (\ supremum ->
          ((x : R) ->
            P x ->
            lessOrEqual x supremum)
          and
          ((upper : R) ->
            ((x : R) ->
              P x ->
              lessOrEqual x upper) ->
            lessOrEqual supremum upper))

open CompleteOrderedRealField

StrictLess :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
StrictLess reals x y =
  lessOrEqual reals x y and x != y

record PolynomialOfDegree
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R)
  (degree : Nat) :
  Set where

  field
    coefficient :
      Nat ->
      R
    coefficients-above-degree :
      (k : Nat) ->
      degree <N k ->
      coefficient k == zeroR reals
    leading-coefficient-nonzero :
      coefficient degree != zeroR reals

open PolynomialOfDegree

sumFirst :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Nat ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  R
sumFirst reals zero term =
  zeroR reals
sumFirst reals (suc n) term =
  add reals
    (sumFirst reals n term)
    (term n)

squareCoefficient :
  {R : Set} ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) ->
  {degree : Nat} ->
  PolynomialOfDegree reals degree ->
  Nat ->
  R
squareCoefficient reals polynomial k =
  sumFirst reals (suc k)
    (\ i ->
      multiply reals
        (coefficient polynomial i)
        (coefficient polynomial (k - i)))

data NegativeCountThrough
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R)
  (terms : Nat -> R) :
  Nat ->
  Nat ->
  Set where

  count-none :
    NegativeCountThrough reals terms zero zero

  count-negative :
    {length count : Nat} ->
    NegativeCountThrough reals terms length count ->
    StrictLess reals (terms length) (zeroR reals) ->
    NegativeCountThrough reals terms (suc length) (suc count)

  count-nonnegative :
    {length count : Nat} ->
    NegativeCountThrough reals terms length count ->
    lessOrEqual reals (zeroR reals) (terms length) ->
    NegativeCountThrough reals terms (suc length) count

record IsMaximumNegativeCount
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R)
  (degree maximum : Nat) :
  Set where

  field
    attained :
      Exists (PolynomialOfDegree reals degree)
        (\ polynomial ->
          NegativeCountThrough reals
            (squareCoefficient reals polynomial)
            (suc (degree + degree))
            maximum)

    upper-bound :
      (polynomial : PolynomialOfDegree reals degree) ->
      (count : Nat) ->
      NegativeCountThrough reals
        (squareCoefficient reals polynomial)
        (suc (degree + degree))
        count ->
      count <=N maximum

twoN : Nat
twoN =
  suc (suc zero)

putnam-2022-a2-solution : Nat -> Nat
putnam-2022-a2-solution n =
  (n + n) - twoN

putnam-2022-a2 : Set1
putnam-2022-a2 =
  (R : Set) ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) ->
  (n : Nat) ->
  twoN <=N n ->
  IsMaximumNegativeCount reals n
    (putnam-2022-a2-solution n)

title: putnam_2022_a2
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2022_a2:
  for each n at least 2, the largest possible number of negative coefficients
  in the square of a real polynomial of degree n is 2n - 2. This file contains
  no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open arithmeticTheory pred_setTheory realTheory;

val putnam_2022_a2 =
  ``!n : num.
      2 <= n
      ==>
      let degree_n =
        \p : num -> real.
          p n <> 0 /\
          !k : num. n < k ==> p k = 0
      in
      let square_coeff =
        \p : num -> real.
        \k : num.
          SIGMA
            (\i : num. p i * p (k - i))
            (count (k + 1))
      in
      let negative_count =
        \p : num -> real.
          CARD
            {k : num |
               k <= 2 * n /\
               square_coeff p k < 0}
      in
        (!p : num -> real.
           degree_n p
           ==>
           negative_count p <= 2 * n - 2) /\
        ?p : num -> real.
          degree_n p /\
          negative_count p = 2 * n - 2``;

title: putnam_2022_a2
content:
$(
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact
  putnam_2022_a2: among real polynomials of degree n at least two, the
  largest possible number of negative coefficients in the square is
  2n - 2. This file contains no proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  The carrier Base ` ( Poly1 ` RRfld ) is Set.mm's ring of arbitrary
  finite-support real-coefficient univariate polynomials. P22A2NegCount maps
  such a polynomial P to the cardinality of the set of negative coefficients
  of P squared. This agrees with counting through the degree of P squared,
  since every later coefficient is zero.

  The condition that coefficient n is nonzero and every coefficient after n
  vanishes is exactly that the polynomial has degree n. The final assertion
  gives both the universal upper bound and an internally existential
  polynomial attaining 2n - 2, hence is equivalent to the claimed maximum.
  Every declaration below is an unproved $a statement encoding; this database
  contains no $p proof statement.
$)

$c P22A2NegCount $.

p22a2-neg-count-syntax $a class P22A2NegCount $.

${
  $d P i $.

  p22a2-neg-count-definition $a |- P22A2NegCount =
    (
      P e. ( Base ` ( Poly1 ` RRfld ) ) |->
        #
        `
        {
          i e. NN0 |
            (
              (
                coe1
                `
                (
                  P
                  ( .r ` ( Poly1 ` RRfld ) )
                  P
                )
              )
              `
              i
            )
            < 0
        }
    )
  $.
$}

${
  $d P j n $.

  putnambench-putnam-2022-a2 $a |- A. n e. NN0
    (
      2 <_ n
      ->
      (
        A. P e. ( Base ` ( Poly1 ` RRfld ) )
          (
            (
              ( ( coe1 ` P ) ` n ) =/= 0
              /\
              A. j e. NN0
                (
                  n < j
                  ->
                  ( ( coe1 ` P ) ` j ) = 0
                )
            )
            ->
            ( P22A2NegCount ` P ) <_ ( ( 2 x. n ) - 2 )
          )
        /\
        E. P e. ( Base ` ( Poly1 ` RRfld ) )
          (
            (
              ( ( coe1 ` P ) ` n ) =/= 0
              /\
              A. j e. NN0
                (
                  n < j
                  ->
                  ( ( coe1 ` P ) ` j ) = 0
                )
            )
            /\
            ( P22A2NegCount ` P ) = ( ( 2 x. n ) - 2 )
          )
      )
    )
  $.
$}

title: putnam_2022_a2
content:
% Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2022_a2:
% for each n >= 2, the largest possible number of negative coefficients in
% the square of a real polynomial of degree n is 2*n - 2. This file contains
% no proof.

putnam_2022_a2: THEORY
BEGIN
  polynomial: TYPE = [nat -> real]

  has_exact_degree(p: polynomial, degree: nat): bool =
    p(degree) /= 0
      AND FORALL (index: nat):
        degree < index IMPLIES p(index) = 0

  convolution_prefix(
      p: polynomial,
      degree, count: nat): RECURSIVE real =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      convolution_prefix(p, degree, count - 1)
        + IF count <= degree + 1 THEN
            p(count - 1) * p(degree - (count - 1))
          ELSE
            0
          ENDIF
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  square_coefficient(p: polynomial, degree: nat): real =
    convolution_prefix(p, degree, degree + 1)

  negative_square_coefficient_count(
      p: polynomial,
      count: nat): RECURSIVE nat =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      negative_square_coefficient_count(p, count - 1)
        + IF square_coefficient(p, count - 1) < 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 ENDIF
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  putnam_2022_a2_solution(n: nat): nat =
    IF n < 2 THEN 0 ELSE 2 * n - 2 ENDIF

  putnam_2022_a2: bool =
    FORALL (n: nat):
      n >= 2 IMPLIES
        (FORALL (p: polynomial):
          has_exact_degree(p, n)
            IMPLIES
              negative_square_coefficient_count(p, 2 * n + 1)
                <= putnam_2022_a2_solution(n))
        AND
        (EXISTS (p: polynomial):
          has_exact_degree(p, n)
            AND negative_square_coefficient_count(p, 2 * n + 1)
              = putnam_2022_a2_solution(n))
END putnam_2022_a2

import Mathlib

open Polynomial

/--
Let $p$ be a prime number greater than 5. Let $f(p)$ denote the number of infinite sequences $a_1, a_2, a_3, \dots$ such that $a_n \in \{1, 2, \dots, p-1\}$ and $a_n a_{n+2} \equiv 1 + a_{n+1} \pmod{p}$ for all $n \geq 1$. Prove that $f(p)$ is congruent to 0 or 2 $\pmod{5}$.
-/
theorem putnam_2022_a3
(p f : ℕ)
(hp : Nat.Prime p ∧ p > 5)
(hf : f = {a : ℕ → (ZMod p) | ∀ n : ℕ, a n ≠ 0 ∧ a n * a (n + 2) = 1 + a (n + 1)}.ncard)
: f ≡ 0 [MOD 5] ∨ f ≡ 2 [MOD 5] :=
sorry

title: putnam_2022_a3
content:
(* Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2022_a3:
   the number of infinite nonzero-residue sequences satisfying a modular
   recurrence is congruent to zero or two modulo five. This file contains no proof. *)

From Stdlib Require Import Arith.PeanoNat ZArith ZArith.Znumtheory Lists.List.
From Stdlib Require Import Sorting.SetoidList.

Definition putnam_2022_a3_sequence_eq
    (a b : nat -> nat) : Prop :=
  forall n : nat, a n = b n.

Definition putnam_2022_a3_valid_sequence
    (p : nat) (a : nat -> nat) : Prop :=
  forall n : nat,
    (1 <= a n < p)%nat /\
    Nat.modulo (Nat.mul (a n) (a (Nat.add n 2))) p =
      Nat.modulo (Nat.add 1 (a (Nat.add n 1))) p.

Definition putnam_2022_a3_has_cardinality
    (p f : nat) : Prop :=
  exists enumeration : list (nat -> nat),
    NoDupA putnam_2022_a3_sequence_eq enumeration /\
    length enumeration = f /\
    forall a : nat -> nat,
      InA putnam_2022_a3_sequence_eq a enumeration <->
      putnam_2022_a3_valid_sequence p a.

Theorem putnam_2022_a3
    (p f : nat)
    (hp : Znumtheory.prime (Z.of_nat p) /\ (5 < p)%nat)
    (hf : putnam_2022_a3_has_cardinality p f) :
  Nat.modulo f 5%nat = 0%nat \/ Nat.modulo f 5%nat = 2%nat.
Admitted.

  (putnambench__hol-light__putnam_2022_a3): for a prime p greater than 5, the
  number of infinite sequences of nonzero residues modulo p satisfying
  a(n) * a(n+2) = 1 + a(n+1) modulo p is congruent to 0 or 2 modulo 5.
  This file contains no proof.
*)

let statement =
  `!p f:num.
     prime p /\
     p > 5 /\
     f =
       CARD
         {a:num->num |
            (!n:num. 0 < a n /\ a n < p) /\

title: putnam_2022_a3
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2022_a3:
;; for every prime p greater than 5, the number of infinite nonzero residue
;; sequences satisfying a_n*a_(n+2) = 1+a_(n+1) modulo p is congruent to
;; 0 or 2 modulo 5. This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

;; For a natural number, testing every candidate divisor from 2 through
;; number-1 is exactly the usual definition of primality.
(defun putnam-2022-a3-no-divisor-from-p (number divisor)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix (- number divisor))))
  (if (and (natp number)
           (natp divisor)
           (<= 2 divisor)
           (< divisor number))
      (and
       (not (equal (mod number divisor) 0))
       (putnam-2022-a3-no-divisor-from-p
        number (+ divisor 1)))
    t))

(defun putnam-2022-a3-primep (number)
  (and
   (natp number)
   (< 1 number)
   (putnam-2022-a3-no-divisor-from-p number 2)))

;; Under the root predicate's prime-modulus hypothesis, every x in
;; 1,...,p-1 has a unique inverse. This bounded search returns that inverse.
(defun putnam-2022-a3-inverse-search (x p candidate)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix (- p candidate))))
  (if (and (natp p)
           (natp candidate)
           (< candidate p))
      (if (equal (mod (* x candidate) p) 1)
          candidate
        (putnam-2022-a3-inverse-search
         x p (+ candidate 1)))
    0))

(defun putnam-2022-a3-inverse (x p)
  (putnam-2022-a3-inverse-search x p 1))

(defun putnam-2022-a3-next-value (x y p)
  (mod
   (* (+ 1 y)
      (putnam-2022-a3-inverse x p))
   p))

;; A state is the ordered pair (a_n,a_(n+1)). The transition below is the
;; unique solution of a_n*a_(n+2) = 1+a_(n+1) modulo the prime p.
(defun putnam-2022-a3-valid-orbit-prefix-p
    (x y p transitions-remaining)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix transitions-remaining)))
  (and
   (natp x)
   (natp y)
   (< 0 x)
   (< x p)
   (< 0 y)
   (< y p)
   (if (zp transitions-remaining)
       t
     (putnam-2022-a3-valid-orbit-prefix-p
      y
      (putnam-2022-a3-next-value x y p)
      p
      (- transitions-remaining 1)))))

;; There are exactly (p-1)^2 nonzero pair states. Thus an initial pair gives
;; an infinite nonzero orbit iff (p-1)^2+1 successive states are nonzero:
;; the forward direction is immediate, while the reverse direction has a
;; repeated state and the deterministic transition repeats forever. Hence
;; counting these initial pairs is in bijection with the source set of all
;; infinite sequences, rather than a restriction to finite sequences.
(defun putnam-2022-a3-count-second-values
    (x y p transition-count)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix y)))
  (if (zp y)
      0
    (+ (if (putnam-2022-a3-valid-orbit-prefix-p
             x y p transition-count)
           1
         0)
       (putnam-2022-a3-count-second-values
        x (- y 1) p transition-count))))

(defun putnam-2022-a3-count-first-values
    (x p transition-count)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix x)))
  (if (zp x)
      0
    (+ (putnam-2022-a3-count-second-values
        x (- p 1) p transition-count)
       (putnam-2022-a3-count-first-values
        (- x 1) p transition-count))))

(defun putnam-2022-a3-sequence-count (p)
  (let ((state-count (* (- p 1) (- p 1))))
    (putnam-2022-a3-count-first-values
     (- p 1) p state-count)))

(defun putnambench-putnam-2022-a3-statement (p f)
  (implies
   (and
    (natp p)
    (natp f)
    (< 5 p)
    (putnam-2022-a3-primep p)
    (equal f (putnam-2022-a3-sequence-count p)))
   (or
    (equal (mod f 5) 0)
    (equal (mod f 5) 2))))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

title: putnam_2022_a3
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2022_a3:
-- for every prime p greater than 5, the number of nonzero residue sequences
-- satisfying a_n * a_(n+2) = 1 + a_(n+1) modulo p is 0 or 2 modulo 5.
-- This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module Putnam2022A3 where

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using
  (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; _*_; mod-helper)

infix 4 _<=N_ _<N_ _divides_
infixr 3 _and_
infixr 2 _or_

record _and_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data _or_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  left  : A -> A or B
  right : B -> A or B

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

data _<=N_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set where
  zero<=N   : {n : Nat} -> zero <=N n
  suc<=sucN : {m n : Nat} -> m <=N n -> suc m <=N suc n

_<N_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set
m <N n =
  suc m <=N n

record _divides_ (divisor dividend : Nat) : Set where
  constructor divides-with
  field
    quotient : Nat
    equation : divisor * quotient == dividend

record Prime (p : Nat) : Set where
  field
    at-least-two :
      suc (suc zero) <=N p

    only-trivial-divisors :
      (d : Nat) ->
      d divides p ->
      d == suc zero or d == p

data Fin : Nat -> Set where
  fzero : {n : Nat} -> Fin (suc n)
  fsuc  : {n : Nat} -> Fin n -> Fin (suc n)

one : Nat
one =
  suc zero

two : Nat
two =
  suc one

five : Nat
five =
  suc (suc (suc (suc (suc zero))))

naturalMod : Nat -> Nat -> Nat
naturalMod numerator zero =
  numerator
naturalMod numerator (suc denominator) =
  mod-helper zero denominator numerator denominator

ModEq : Nat -> Nat -> Nat -> Set
ModEq modulus left-value right-value =
  naturalMod left-value modulus ==
  naturalMod right-value modulus

Sequence : Set
Sequence =
  Nat -> Nat

PointwiseEqual : Sequence -> Sequence -> Set
PointwiseEqual left-sequence right-sequence =
  (n : Nat) ->
  left-sequence n == right-sequence n

ValidSequence : Nat -> Sequence -> Set
ValidSequence p a =
  (n : Nat) ->
  (one <=N a n)
  and
  (a n <N p)
  and
  ModEq
    p
    (a n * a (n + two))
    (one + a (n + one))

record HasValidSequenceCardinality
  (p cardinality : Nat) :
  Set where

  field
    enumerate :
      Fin cardinality ->
      Sequence

    enumerated-valid :
      (index : Fin cardinality) ->
      ValidSequence p (enumerate index)

    enumeration-complete :
      (a : Sequence) ->
      ValidSequence p a ->
      Exists
        (Fin cardinality)
        (\ index ->
          PointwiseEqual a (enumerate index))

    enumeration-injective :
      (left-index right-index : Fin cardinality) ->
      PointwiseEqual
        (enumerate left-index)
        (enumerate right-index) ->
      left-index == right-index

putnam-2022-a3 : Set
putnam-2022-a3 =
  (p f : Nat) ->
  (Prime p and five <N p) ->
  HasValidSequenceCardinality p f ->
  (ModEq five f zero or ModEq five f two)

title: putnam_2022_a3
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2022_a3:
  the number of infinite nonzero-residue sequences satisfying a modular
  recurrence is congruent to zero or two modulo five. This file contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open arithmeticTheory pred_setTheory;

val putnam_2022_a3 =
  ``!p f : num.
      prime p /\
      5 < p /\
      f =
        CARD
          {a : num -> num |
             !n : num.
               0 < a n /\
               a n < p /\
               (a n * a (n + 2)) MOD p =
                 (1 + a (n + 1)) MOD p}
      ==>
      f MOD 5 = 0 \/ f MOD 5 = 2``;

title: putnam_2022_a3
content:
$(
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact
  putnam_2022_a3: for every prime p greater than 5, the number of infinite
  nonzero residue sequences satisfying the specified second-order recurrence
  modulo p is congruent to 0 or 2 modulo 5. This file contains no proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  The interval 1 ... ( p - 1 ) is a complete set of representatives for the
  nonzero residues modulo p, and its function space over NN0 contains all
  infinite sequences from the source, with the harmless index shift from
  a_1, a_2, ... to indices 0, 1, ... . Equality of the displayed remainders
  is exactly the source congruence at every index.

  The auxiliary count f is eliminated by substituting its defining finite
  cardinality into the conclusion. The final declaration is the single
  unproved $a corpus statement; this database contains no $p proof statement.
$)

${
  $d a n p $.

  putnambench-putnam-2022-a3 $a |- A. p e. Prime
    (
      5 < p
      ->
      (
        (
          (
            #
            `
            {
              a e. ( ( 1 ... ( p - 1 ) ) ^m NN0 ) |
              A. n e. NN0
                (
                  (
                    ( ( a ` n ) x. ( a ` ( n + 2 ) ) )
                    mod p
                  )
                  =
                  (
                    ( 1 + ( a ` ( n + 1 ) ) )
                    mod p
                  )
                )
            }
          )
          mod 5
        )
        =
        0
        \/
        (
          (
            #
            `
            {
              a e. ( ( 1 ... ( p - 1 ) ) ^m NN0 ) |
              A. n e. NN0
                (
                  (
                    ( ( a ` n ) x. ( a ` ( n + 2 ) ) )
                    mod p
                  )
                  =
                  (
                    ( 1 + ( a ` ( n + 1 ) ) )
                    mod p
                  )
                )
            }
          )
          mod 5
        )
        =
        2
      )
    )
  $.
$}
