      MESFUNC5, RELSET_1, COMSEQ_2, RANDOM_1, RANDOM_2, RANDOM_3, FINANCE1,
      RVSUM_1, MEASUR12, SIN_COS, SQUARE_1, POWER, SETFAM_1, MESFUN6C,
      COMPLEX1, SEQ_2, SEQM_3, SEQ_4, PREPOWER, ABIAN, BINOP_2,
      SERIES_1, NEWTON;
 registrations XBOOLE_0, SUBSET_1, NAT_1, XREAL_0, XXREAL_0, ORDINAL1,
      MEASURE1, FUNCOP_1, FINANCE1, VALUED_0, FINSEQ_1, FUNCT_2, RELAT_1,
      FINSET_1, NUMBERS, PROB_1, PARTFUN1, RELSET_1, CARD_1, MEMBERED,
      SQUARE_1, XXREAL_3, RANDOM_2, RANDOM_3, MEASUR12, MESFUN6C,
      XCMPLX_0, SEQ_4, ABIAN, PREPOWER, SIN_COS, NEWTON;
 requirements NUMERALS, BOOLE, SUBSET, ARITHM, REAL;
 definitions TARSKI, XBOOLE_0, FINSET_1;
 equalities PROB_1, RANDOM_2, PROB_4, RELAT_1, FINSEQ_1;
 expansions TARSKI, XBOOLE_0, RELAT_1, FINSEQ_1;

begin

::$P-
theorem
  for Omega being non empty set,
      Sigma being SigmaField of Omega,
      P being Probability of Sigma,
      X being Function of NAT,Funcs(Omega,REAL),
      k being Function of Omega,bool NAT,
      S being Function of Omega,REAL
  st
    X is Sigma-Random-Variable-Family &
    (for n being Nat holds
      ex Xn being Real-Valued-Random-Variable of Sigma,
         FXn being random_variable of Sigma,Borel_Sets,
         mu being Probability of Borel_Sets st
        Xn = X.n &
        FXn = Xn &
        probability(FXn,P) = mu &
        (for t being Real,
             A being Element of Borel_Sets
          st A = ].-infty,t.]
          holds
            (t < 0 implies (mu.A qua Real) = 0) &
            (0 <= t & t < 1 implies (mu.A qua Real) = t) &
            (1 <= t implies (mu.A qua Real) = 1))) &
    (for r being Nat,
         I being one-to-one FinSequence of NAT,
         B being FinSequence of Borel_Sets,
         E being FinSequence of Sigma,
         q being FinSequence of REAL
      st 0 < r &
         len I = r & len B = r & len E = r & len q = r &
         (for j being Nat st j in Seg r holds
           E.j = (X.(I.j))"(B.j) &
           q.j = (P.(E.j) qua Real))
      holds P.(meet rng E) = Product q) &
    (for omega being Element of Omega holds
      k.omega =
        union {A where A is Subset of NAT :
          ex m being Nat st
            A = {i where i is Element of NAT : i <= m} &
            (for l being Nat,
                 Xl,Xs being Real-Valued-Random-Variable of Sigma
              st l < m & Xl = X.l & Xs = X.(l+1)
              holds Xs.omega < Xl.omega)}) &
    (for omega being Element of Omega holds
      ex s being Real_Sequence st
        (for n being Nat,
             Xn being Real-Valued-Random-Variable of Sigma
          st Xn = X.n holds
          (n in k.omega implies
            s.n = Xn.omega / ((2 qua Real) |^ (n+1))) &
          (not n in k.omega implies s.n = 0)) &
        ((s is summable & S.omega = Sum s) or
         (s is not summable & S.omega = 0)))
  holds
    Integral(P2M(P),S) = 2 * exp_R.(1/2) - 3
proof
end;
::$P+

title: putnam_2022_a4
content:
% Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2022_a4:
% the expected dyadically weighted sum of independent uniform [0,1] random
% variables, stopped at the first increase, is 2*exp(1/2)-3.
% This file contains no proof.

putnam_2022_a4: THEORY
BEGIN
  sample_space: TYPE+

  event: TYPE = [sample_space -> bool]
  event_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> event]
  sigma_algebra: TYPE = [event -> bool]
  probability_map: TYPE = [event -> real]
  real_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> real]
  natural_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> nat]
  random_variable: TYPE = [sample_space -> real]
  random_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> random_variable]
  stopping_set: TYPE = [sample_space -> [nat -> bool]]

  full_event: event =
    LAMBDA (omega: sample_space): TRUE

  empty_event: event =
    LAMBDA (omega: sample_space): FALSE

  event_complement(A: event): event =
    LAMBDA (omega: sample_space): NOT A(omega)

  countable_union(events: event_sequence): event =
    LAMBDA (omega: sample_space):
      EXISTS (index: nat): events(index)(omega)

  pairwise_disjoint(events: event_sequence): bool =
    FORALL (left_index, right_index: nat):
      left_index /= right_index IMPLIES
        FORALL (omega: sample_space):
          NOT (events(left_index)(omega)
            AND events(right_index)(omega))

  partial_real_sum(
      values: real_sequence,
      count: nat): RECURSIVE real =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      partial_real_sum(values, count - 1)
        + values(count - 1)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  converges_to(values: real_sequence, limit_value: real): bool =
    FORALL (epsilon_value: posreal):
      EXISTS (cutoff: nat):
        FORALL (index: nat):
          cutoff <= index IMPLIES
            abs(values(index) - limit_value) < epsilon_value

  safe_div(numerator, denominator: real): real =
    IF denominator = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      numerator / denominator
    ENDIF

  is_sigma_algebra(Sigma: sigma_algebra): bool =
    Sigma(full_event)
      AND (FORALL (A: event):
        Sigma(A) IMPLIES Sigma(event_complement(A)))
      AND (FORALL (events: event_sequence):
        (FORALL (index: nat): Sigma(events(index)))
          IMPLIES Sigma(countable_union(events)))

  partial_probability_sum(
      probability: probability_map,
      events: event_sequence,
      count: nat): real =
    partial_real_sum(
      LAMBDA (index: nat): probability(events(index)),
      count)

  is_probability_space(
      probability: probability_map,
      Sigma: sigma_algebra): bool =
    is_sigma_algebra(Sigma)
      AND probability(empty_event) = 0
      AND probability(full_event) = 1
      AND (FORALL (A: event):
        Sigma(A) IMPLIES probability(A) >= 0)
      AND (FORALL (events: event_sequence):
        ((FORALL (index: nat): Sigma(events(index)))
          AND pairwise_disjoint(events))
        IMPLIES
          converges_to(
            LAMBDA (count: nat):
              partial_probability_sum(
                probability, events, count),
            probability(countable_union(events))))

  measurable_real(
      Sigma: sigma_algebra,
      value: random_variable): bool =
    FORALL (threshold: real):
      Sigma(
        LAMBDA (omega: sample_space):
          value(omega) <= threshold)

  uniform_unit_cdf(threshold: real): real =
    IF threshold < 0 THEN
      0
    ELSIF threshold <= 1 THEN
      threshold
    ELSE
      1
    ENDIF

  distinct_below(
      indices: natural_sequence,
      count: nat): bool =
    FORALL (left_position, right_position: nat):
      (left_position < count
        AND right_position < count
        AND indices(left_position) = indices(right_position))
      IMPLIES left_position = right_position

  rectangle_event(
      X: random_sequence,
      indices: natural_sequence,
      thresholds: real_sequence,
      count: nat): event =
    LAMBDA (omega: sample_space):
      FORALL (position: nat):
        position < count IMPLIES
          X(indices(position))(omega) <= thresholds(position)

  finite_product(
      values: real_sequence,
      count: nat): RECURSIVE real =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      1
    ELSE
      finite_product(values, count - 1)
        * values(count - 1)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  independent_uniform_sequence(
      probability: probability_map,
      Sigma: sigma_algebra,
      X: random_sequence): bool =
    (FORALL (index: nat):
      measurable_real(Sigma, X(index)))
      AND
    (FORALL
        (indices: natural_sequence),
        (thresholds: real_sequence),
        (count: nat):
      distinct_below(indices, count)
        IMPLIES
          probability(
            rectangle_event(
              X, indices, thresholds, count))
            =
          finite_product(
            LAMBDA (position: nat):
              uniform_unit_cdf(thresholds(position)),
            count))

  valid_stopping_set(
      X: random_sequence,
      stopped_indices: stopping_set): bool =
    FORALL (omega: sample_space), (index: nat):
      stopped_indices(omega)(index)
        IFF
          FORALL (earlier: nat):
            earlier < index IMPLIES
              X(earlier)(omega) > X(earlier + 1)(omega)

  infinite_sum(values: real_sequence): real =
    IF EXISTS (limit_value: real):
        converges_to(
          LAMBDA (count: nat):
            partial_real_sum(values, count),
          limit_value)
    THEN
      epsilon(
        LAMBDA (limit_value: real):
          converges_to(
            LAMBDA (count: nat):
              partial_real_sum(values, count),
            limit_value))
    ELSE
      0
    ENDIF

  stopped_sum_definition(
      X: random_sequence,
      stopped_indices: stopping_set,
      S: random_variable): bool =
    FORALL (omega: sample_space):
      S(omega)
        =
      infinite_sum(
        LAMBDA (index: nat):
          IF stopped_indices(omega)(index) THEN
            X(index)(omega) / ((2 :: real) ^ (index + 1))
          ELSE
            0
          ENDIF)

  tail_probability_sum(
      probability: probability_map,
      value: random_variable,
      subdivisions, count: nat): RECURSIVE real =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      tail_probability_sum(
        probability, value, subdivisions, count - 1)
        + probability(
            LAMBDA (omega: sample_space):
              value(omega)
                > safe_div(
                    (count - 1) :: real,
                    subdivisions :: real))
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  expectation_approximation(
      probability: probability_map,
      value: random_variable,
      subdivisions: nat): real =
    IF subdivisions = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      tail_probability_sum(
        probability, value, subdivisions, subdivisions)
        / (subdivisions :: real)
    ENDIF

  has_expected_value(
      probability: probability_map,
      value: random_variable,
      expected_value: real): bool =
    converges_to(
      LAMBDA (subdivisions: nat):
        expectation_approximation(
          probability, value, subdivisions),
      expected_value)

  nat_factorial(index: nat): RECURSIVE nat =
    IF index = 0 THEN
      1
    ELSE
      index * nat_factorial(index - 1)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE index

  exponential_partial(
      x: real,
      count: nat): RECURSIVE real =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      LET index: nat = count - 1 IN
        exponential_partial(x, count - 1)
          + safe_div(
              x ^ index,
              nat_factorial(index) :: real)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  real_exponential(x: real): real =
    epsilon(
      LAMBDA (value: real):
        converges_to(
          LAMBDA (count: nat):
            exponential_partial(x, count),
          value))

  putnam_2022_a4_solution: real =
    2 * real_exponential((1 :: real) / 2) - 3

  putnam_2022_a4: bool =
    FORALL
        (Sigma: sigma_algebra),
        (probability: probability_map),
        (X: random_sequence),
        (stopped_indices: stopping_set),
        (S: random_variable):
      (is_probability_space(probability, Sigma)
        AND independent_uniform_sequence(
          probability, Sigma, X)
        AND valid_stopping_set(X, stopped_indices)
        AND stopped_sum_definition(
          X, stopped_indices, S))
      IMPLIES
        has_expected_value(
          probability, S, putnam_2022_a4_solution)
END putnam_2022_a4

title: putnam_2022_a5
content:
import Mathlib

noncomputable abbrev putnam_2022_a5_solution : ℕ := sorry
-- 290
/--
Alice and Bob play a game on a board consisting of one row of 2022 consecutive squares. They take turns placing tiles that cover two adjacent squares, with Alice going first. By rule, a tile must not cover a square that is already covered by another tile. The game ends when no tile can be placed according to this rule. Alice's goal is to maximize the number of uncovered squares when the game ends; Bob's goal is to minimize it. What is the greatest number of uncovered squares that Alice can ensure at the end of the game, no matter how Bob plays?
-/
theorem putnam_2022_a5
    (IsValidMove : Set (Fin 2022) → Set (Fin 2022) → Prop)
    (IsValidMove_def : ∀ x y, IsValidMove x y ↔
      (x = y ∧ ∀ i < 2021, i ∉ x → i + 1 ∈ x) ∨
      ∃ i < 2021, i ∉ x ∧ i + 1 ∉ x ∧ y = x ∪ {i, i + 1})
    (IsValidGame : List (Set (Fin 2022)) → Prop)
    (IsValidGame_def : ∀ g, IsValidGame g ↔ (∃ gt, g = ∅ :: gt) ∧ g.Chain' IsValidMove)
    (ConformsToStrategy : List (Set (Fin 2022)) → (Set (Fin 2022) → Set (Fin 2022)) → Prop)
    (ConformsToStrategy_def : ∀ g s, ConformsToStrategy g s ↔
      ∀ (i) (h : i + 1 < g.length), Even i → g[i + 1] = s g[i]) :
    IsGreatest
      {n | ∃ s, (∀ x, IsValidMove x (s x)) ∧ ∀ g,
        IsValidGame g → ConformsToStrategy g s → ∃ gh x, g = gh ++ [x] ∧ n ≤ xᶜ.ncard}
      putnam_2022_a5_solution :=
  sorry

title: putnam_2022_a5
content:
(* Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2022_a5:
   the greatest number of uncovered squares Alice can guarantee in the
   alternating adjacent-domino game on a row of 2022 squares is 290.
   This file contains no proof. *)

From Stdlib Require Import Lists.List Vectors.Fin Arith.PeanoNat.

Import ListNotations.

Definition putnam_2022_a5_square : Type := Fin.t 2022.
Definition putnam_2022_a5_board : Type :=
  putnam_2022_a5_square -> Prop.

Definition putnam_2022_a5_same_board
    (left right : putnam_2022_a5_board) : Prop :=
  forall square : putnam_2022_a5_square,
    left square <-> right square.

Definition putnam_2022_a5_index
    (square : putnam_2022_a5_square) : nat :=
  proj1_sig (Fin.to_nat square).

Definition putnam_2022_a5_right_neighbor
    (left right : putnam_2022_a5_square) : Prop :=
  (putnam_2022_a5_index left < 2021)%nat /\
  putnam_2022_a5_index right =
    S (putnam_2022_a5_index left).

Definition putnam_2022_a5_empty_board :
    putnam_2022_a5_board :=
  fun _ => False.

Definition putnam_2022_a5_add_domino
    (board : putnam_2022_a5_board)
    (left right : putnam_2022_a5_square) :
    putnam_2022_a5_board :=
  fun square =>
    board square \/ square = left \/ square = right.

Definition putnam_2022_a5_terminal
    (board : putnam_2022_a5_board) : Prop :=
  forall left right : putnam_2022_a5_square,
    putnam_2022_a5_right_neighbor left right ->
    ~ board left ->
    board right.

Definition putnam_2022_a5_places_domino
    (before after : putnam_2022_a5_board) : Prop :=
  exists left right : putnam_2022_a5_square,
    putnam_2022_a5_right_neighbor left right /\
    ~ before left /\
    ~ before right /\
    putnam_2022_a5_same_board after
      (putnam_2022_a5_add_domino before left right).

Definition putnam_2022_a5_valid_move
    (before after : putnam_2022_a5_board) : Prop :=
  (putnam_2022_a5_same_board before after /\
   putnam_2022_a5_terminal before) \/
  putnam_2022_a5_places_domino before after.

Fixpoint putnam_2022_a5_chain_from
    (before : putnam_2022_a5_board)
    (rest : list putnam_2022_a5_board) : Prop :=
  match rest with
  | [] => True
  | after :: tail =>
      putnam_2022_a5_valid_move before after /\
      putnam_2022_a5_chain_from after tail
  end.

Definition putnam_2022_a5_chain
    (game : list putnam_2022_a5_board) : Prop :=
  match game with
  | [] => True
  | first :: rest => putnam_2022_a5_chain_from first rest
  end.

Definition putnam_2022_a5_starts_empty
    (game : list putnam_2022_a5_board) : Prop :=
  match game with
  | [] => False
  | first :: _ =>
      putnam_2022_a5_same_board
        first putnam_2022_a5_empty_board
  end.

Definition putnam_2022_a5_valid_game
    (game : list putnam_2022_a5_board) : Prop :=
  putnam_2022_a5_starts_empty game /\
  putnam_2022_a5_chain game.

Definition putnam_2022_a5_strategy : Type :=
  putnam_2022_a5_board -> putnam_2022_a5_board.

Definition putnam_2022_a5_conforms_to_strategy
    (game : list putnam_2022_a5_board)
    (strategy : putnam_2022_a5_strategy) : Prop :=
  forall (index : nat)
      (before after : putnam_2022_a5_board),
    nth_error game index = Some before ->
    nth_error game (S index) = Some after ->
    Nat.Even index ->
    putnam_2022_a5_same_board after (strategy before).

Inductive putnam_2022_a5_last_state :
    list putnam_2022_a5_board ->
    putnam_2022_a5_board ->
    Prop :=
  | putnam_2022_a5_last_singleton :
      forall board : putnam_2022_a5_board,
        putnam_2022_a5_last_state [board] board
  | putnam_2022_a5_last_cons :
      forall (first final : putnam_2022_a5_board)
          (rest : list putnam_2022_a5_board),
        putnam_2022_a5_last_state rest final ->
        putnam_2022_a5_last_state (first :: rest) final.

Definition putnam_2022_a5_uncovered_at_least
    (board : putnam_2022_a5_board)
    (lower_bound : nat) : Prop :=
  exists uncovered : list putnam_2022_a5_square,
    NoDup uncovered /\
    (forall square : putnam_2022_a5_square,
      In square uncovered <-> ~ board square) /\
    (lower_bound <= length uncovered)%nat.

Definition putnam_2022_a5_can_ensure
    (lower_bound : nat) : Prop :=
  exists strategy : putnam_2022_a5_strategy,
    (forall board : putnam_2022_a5_board,
      putnam_2022_a5_valid_move board (strategy board)) /\
    forall game : list putnam_2022_a5_board,
      putnam_2022_a5_valid_game game ->
      putnam_2022_a5_conforms_to_strategy game strategy ->
      exists final : putnam_2022_a5_board,
        putnam_2022_a5_last_state game final /\
        putnam_2022_a5_uncovered_at_least final lower_bound.

Definition putnam_2022_a5_solution : nat := 290.

Theorem putnam_2022_a5 :
  putnam_2022_a5_can_ensure putnam_2022_a5_solution /\
  forall lower_bound : nat,
    putnam_2022_a5_can_ensure lower_bound ->
    (lower_bound <= putnam_2022_a5_solution)%nat.
Admitted.

title: putnam_2022_a5
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench artifact putnam_2022_a5,
  concerning the greatest number of uncovered squares Alice can guarantee in
  a domino-placement game on a row of 2022 squares. This file contains no proof.
*)

theory putnam_2022_a5
  imports Main
begin

definition putnam_2022_a5_board :: "nat set" where
  "putnam_2022_a5_board = {..<2022}"

definition putnam_2022_a5_valid_move ::
    "nat set \<Rightarrow> nat set \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "putnam_2022_a5_valid_move x y \<longleftrightarrow>
    x \<subseteq> putnam_2022_a5_board \<and>
    y \<subseteq> putnam_2022_a5_board \<and>
    ((x = y \<and>
      (\<forall>i<2021. i \<notin> x \<longrightarrow> Suc i \<in> x)) \<or>
     (\<exists>i<2021.
      i \<notin> x \<and> Suc i \<notin> x \<and>
      y = x \<union> {i, Suc i}))"

definition putnam_2022_a5_valid_game :: "nat set list \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "putnam_2022_a5_valid_game g \<longleftrightarrow>
    g \<noteq> [] \<and>
    hd g = {} \<and>
    (\<forall>i. Suc i < length g \<longrightarrow>
      putnam_2022_a5_valid_move (g ! i) (g ! Suc i))"

definition putnam_2022_a5_conforms_to_strategy ::
    "nat set list \<Rightarrow> (nat set \<Rightarrow> nat set) \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "putnam_2022_a5_conforms_to_strategy g s \<longleftrightarrow>
    (\<forall>i. Suc i < length g \<longrightarrow> even i \<longrightarrow>
      g ! Suc i = s (g ! i))"

definition putnam_2022_a5_guaranteed :: "nat set" where
  "putnam_2022_a5_guaranteed =
    {n. \<exists>s :: nat set \<Rightarrow> nat set.
      (\<forall>x. x \<subseteq> putnam_2022_a5_board \<longrightarrow>
        putnam_2022_a5_valid_move x (s x)) \<and>
      (\<forall>g.
        putnam_2022_a5_valid_game g \<longrightarrow>
        putnam_2022_a5_conforms_to_strategy g s \<longrightarrow>
        (\<exists>gh x.
          g = gh @ [x] \<and>
          n \<le> card (putnam_2022_a5_board - x)))}"

definition putnam_2022_a5_solution :: nat where
  "putnam_2022_a5_solution = 290"

theorem putnam_2022_a5:
  shows "putnam_2022_a5_solution \<in> putnam_2022_a5_guaranteed \<and>
    (\<forall>n\<in>putnam_2022_a5_guaranteed.
      n \<le> putnam_2022_a5_solution)"
  sorry

end

title: putnam_2022_a5
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2022_a5
  (putnambench__hol-light__putnam_2022_a5): the greatest number of uncovered
  squares Alice can ensure in the 2022-square adjacent-domino game. This file
  contains no proof.
*)

let statement =
  `let board = 0..2021 in
   let is_state =
     \x:num->bool. x SUBSET board in
   let is_valid_move =
     \(x:num->bool) (y:num->bool).
       is_state x /\
       is_state y /\
       ((x = y /\
         (!i:num. i < 2021 /\ ~(i IN x) ==> i + 1 IN x)) \/
        (?i:num.
           i < 2021 /\
           ~(i IN x) /\
           ~((i + 1) IN x) /\
           y = x UNION {i,i + 1})) in
   let is_valid_game =
     \g:(num->bool)list.
       (?gt:(num->bool)list. g = CONS ({}:num->bool) gt) /\
       (!i:num.
          i + 1 < LENGTH g
          ==> is_valid_move (EL i g) (EL (i + 1) g)) in
   let conforms_to_strategy =
     \(g:(num->bool)list) (s:(num->bool)->(num->bool)).
       !i:num.
         i + 1 < LENGTH g /\ EVEN i
         ==> EL (i + 1) g = s (EL i g) in
   let achievable =
     \n:num.
       ?s:(num->bool)->(num->bool).
         (!x:num->bool. is_state x ==> is_valid_move x (s x)) /\
         (!g:(num->bool)list.
            is_valid_game g
            ==> conforms_to_strategy g s
            ==> ?gh:(num->bool)list. ?x:num->bool.
                  g = APPEND gh [x] /\
                  n <= CARD (board DIFF x)) in
   let is_greatest =
     \(values:num->bool) (n:num).
       n IN values /\ (!m:num. m IN values ==> m <= n) in
   is_greatest {n:num | achievable n} 290`;;

title: putnam_2022_a5
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2022_a5:
;; the greatest number of uncovered squares that Alice can guarantee in the
;; 2022-square adjacent-domino game is 290. This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

;; Natural-number bitmasks below 2^2022 are in bijection with subsets of
;; Fin 2022: bit i is set exactly when square i is covered. A strategy is a
;; finite association list from board masks to board masks. Because the board
;; domain is finite, every source strategy has such a table and every table
;; denotes a source strategy through deterministic lookup.
(defun putnam-2022-a5-valid-board-p (board)
  (and
   (natp board)
   (< board (expt 2 2022))))

(defun putnam-2022-a5-coveredp (board square)
  (if (and (natp board)
           (natp square))
      (logbitp square board)
    nil))

(defun putnam-2022-a5-legal-placement-p (board left)
  (and
   (natp board)
   (natp left)
   (< left 2021)
   (not (putnam-2022-a5-coveredp board left))
   (not (putnam-2022-a5-coveredp board (+ left 1)))))

(defun putnam-2022-a5-place-tile (board left)
  (logior
   (nfix board)
   (* 3 (expt 2 (nfix left)))))

(defun putnam-2022-a5-uncovered-from (board square)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix (- 2022 square))))
  (if (and (natp square)
           (< square 2022))
      (+ (if (putnam-2022-a5-coveredp board square)
             0
           1)
         (putnam-2022-a5-uncovered-from
          board (+ square 1)))
    0))

(defun putnam-2022-a5-no-placement-from-p (board left)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix (- 2021 left))))
  (if (and (natp left)
           (< left 2021))
      (and
       (not (putnam-2022-a5-legal-placement-p board left))
       (putnam-2022-a5-no-placement-from-p board (+ left 1)))
    t))

(defun putnam-2022-a5-placement-move-from-p (before after left)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix (- 2021 left))))
  (if (and (natp left)
           (< left 2021))
      (or
       (and
        (putnam-2022-a5-legal-placement-p before left)
        (equal
         after
         (putnam-2022-a5-place-tile before left)))
       (putnam-2022-a5-placement-move-from-p
        before after (+ left 1)))
    nil))

;; This is the source IsValidMove relation: a terminal board may repeat, and
;; otherwise one legal adjacent pair is added.
(defun putnam-2022-a5-valid-move-p (before after)
  (and
   (putnam-2022-a5-valid-board-p before)
   (putnam-2022-a5-valid-board-p after)
   (or
    (and
     (equal before after)
     (putnam-2022-a5-no-placement-from-p before 0))
    (putnam-2022-a5-placement-move-from-p before after 0))))

(defun putnam-2022-a5-valid-game-chain-p (game)
  (if (or (endp game)
          (endp (cdr game)))
      t
    (and
     (putnam-2022-a5-valid-move-p (car game) (cadr game))
     (putnam-2022-a5-valid-game-chain-p (cdr game)))))

;; Nonempty, starts at the empty board, and satisfies Chain' IsValidMove.
(defun putnam-2022-a5-valid-game-p (game)
  (and
   (true-listp game)
   (consp game)
   (equal (car game) 0)
   (putnam-2022-a5-valid-game-chain-p game)))

(defun putnam-2022-a5-strategy-move (strategy board)
  (let ((entry (assoc-equal board strategy)))
    (if entry
        (cdr entry)
      nil)))

;; DEFUN-SK preserves the source's universal quantifier over every board.
(defun-sk putnam-2022-a5-valid-strategy-p (strategy)
  (forall (board)
    (implies
     (putnam-2022-a5-valid-board-p board)
     (putnam-2022-a5-valid-move-p
      board
      (putnam-2022-a5-strategy-move strategy board)))))

(defun putnam-2022-a5-conforms-from-p (game strategy index)
  (if (or (endp game)
          (endp (cdr game)))
      t
    (and
     (if (equal (mod (nfix index) 2) 0)
         (equal
          (cadr game)
          (putnam-2022-a5-strategy-move
           strategy (car game)))
       t)
     (putnam-2022-a5-conforms-from-p
      (cdr game) strategy (+ 1 (nfix index))))))

(defun putnam-2022-a5-conforms-to-strategy-p (game strategy)
  (putnam-2022-a5-conforms-from-p game strategy 0))

(defun putnam-2022-a5-last-board (game)
  (if (or (endp game)
          (endp (cdr game)))
      (if (consp game) (car game) 0)
    (putnam-2022-a5-last-board (cdr game))))

;; This universal quantifier is the source's "for every valid game conforming
;; to Alice's strategy" clause. The append decomposition is equivalent to
;; selecting the last board because every valid game is a nonempty true list.
(defun-sk putnam-2022-a5-strategy-guarantees-p (n strategy)
  (forall (game)
    (implies
     (and
      (putnam-2022-a5-valid-game-p game)
      (putnam-2022-a5-conforms-to-strategy-p game strategy))
     (<=
      (nfix n)
      (putnam-2022-a5-uncovered-from
       (putnam-2022-a5-last-board game)
       0)))))

;; Quantifying over finite strategy tables is exact because the source board
;; domain has 2^2022 elements. No strategy witness or game is hardcoded.
(defun-sk putnam-2022-a5-guaranteed-p (n)
  (exists (strategy)
    (and
     (natp n)
     (alistp strategy)
     (putnam-2022-a5-valid-strategy-p strategy)
     (putnam-2022-a5-strategy-guarantees-p n strategy))))

(defun-sk putnam-2022-a5-solution-upper-bound-p ()
  (forall (n)
    (implies
     (putnam-2022-a5-guaranteed-p n)
     (<= n 290))))

;; IsGreatest is unfolded as membership plus the universal upper-bound clause.
(defun putnambench-putnam-2022-a5-statement ()
  (and
   (putnam-2022-a5-guaranteed-p 290)
   (putnam-2022-a5-solution-upper-bound-p)))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

title: putnam_2022_a5
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2022_a5
-- (putnambench__agda__putnam_2022_a5): the greatest number of uncovered
-- squares Alice can force in the alternating domino-placement game on a row
-- of 2022 squares is 290. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module Putnam2022A5 where

open import Agda.Primitive using (Level; _⊔_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.List using (List; []; _∷_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc)

infix 4 _<=N_
infixr 3 _and_
infixr 2 _or_
infix 1 _iff_

data Bottom : Set where

Not : {level : Level} -> Set level -> Set level
Not A =
  A -> Bottom

record _and_
  {left-level right-level : Level}
  (A : Set left-level)
  (B : Set right-level) :
  Set (left-level ⊔ right-level) where

  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data _or_
  {left-level right-level : Level}
  (A : Set left-level)
  (B : Set right-level) :
  Set (left-level ⊔ right-level) where

  left  : A -> A or B
  right : B -> A or B

record _iff_
  {left-level right-level : Level}
  (A : Set left-level)
  (B : Set right-level) :
  Set (left-level ⊔ right-level) where

  constructor equivalence
  field
    forward  : A -> B
    backward : B -> A

record Exists
  {domain-level property-level : Level}
  (A : Set domain-level)
  (P : A -> Set property-level) :
  Set (domain-level ⊔ property-level) where

  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

data _<=N_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set where
  zero<=N   : {n : Nat} -> zero <=N n
  suc<=sucN : {m n : Nat} -> m <=N n -> suc m <=N suc n

_<N_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set
m <N n =
  suc m <=N n

data Even : Nat -> Set where
  even-zero : Even zero
  even-step : {n : Nat} -> Even n -> Even (suc (suc n))

data Fin : Nat -> Set where
  fzero : {n : Nat} -> Fin (suc n)
  fsuc  : {n : Nat} -> Fin n -> Fin (suc n)

toNat : {n : Nat} -> Fin n -> Nat
toNat fzero =
  zero
toNat (fsuc index) =
  suc (toNat index)

Square : Set
Square =
  Fin 2022

Board : Set1
Board =
  Square -> Set

Strategy : Set1
Strategy =
  Board -> Board

Game : Set1
Game =
  List Board

EmptyBoard : Board
EmptyBoard square =
  Bottom

SameBoard : Board -> Board -> Set
SameBoard left-board right-board =
  (square : Square) ->
  left-board square iff right-board square

RightNeighbor : Square -> Square -> Set
RightNeighbor left-square right-square =
  (toNat left-square <N 2021)
  and
  (toNat right-square == suc (toNat left-square))

AddDomino :
  Board ->
  Square ->
  Square ->
  Board
AddDomino board left-square right-square square =
  board square
  or
  (square == left-square)
  or
  (square == right-square)

Terminal : Board -> Set
Terminal board =
  (left-square right-square : Square) ->
  RightNeighbor left-square right-square ->
  Not (board left-square) ->
  board right-square

PlacesDomino : Board -> Board -> Set
PlacesDomino before after =
  Exists Square
    (\ left-square ->
      Exists Square
        (\ right-square ->
          RightNeighbor left-square right-square
          and
          Not (before left-square)
          and
          Not (before right-square)
          and
          SameBoard after
            (AddDomino before left-square right-square)))

IsValidMove : Board -> Board -> Set
IsValidMove before after =
  (SameBoard before after and Terminal before)
  or
  PlacesDomino before after

data Chain (relation : Board -> Board -> Set) : Game -> Set1 where
  chain-empty :
    Chain relation []
  chain-singleton :
    {board : Board} ->
    Chain relation (board ∷ [])
  chain-step :
    {first-board second-board : Board}
    {remaining : Game} ->
    relation first-board second-board ->
    Chain relation (second-board ∷ remaining) ->
    Chain relation (first-board ∷ second-board ∷ remaining)

StartsEmpty : Game -> Set
StartsEmpty [] =
  Bottom
StartsEmpty (first-board ∷ remaining) =
  SameBoard first-board EmptyBoard

IsValidGame : Game -> Set1
IsValidGame game =
  StartsEmpty game
  and
  Chain IsValidMove game

data BoardAt : Game -> Nat -> Board -> Set1 where
  at-zero :
    {board : Board}
    {remaining : Game} ->
    BoardAt (board ∷ remaining) zero board
  at-successor :
    {first-board board : Board}
    {remaining : Game}
    {index : Nat} ->
    BoardAt remaining index board ->
    BoardAt (first-board ∷ remaining) (suc index) board

ConformsToStrategy : Game -> Strategy -> Set1
ConformsToStrategy game strategy =
  (index : Nat) ->
  (before after : Board) ->
  BoardAt game index before ->
  BoardAt game (suc index) after ->
  Even index ->
  SameBoard after (strategy before)

record HasCardinality
  (member : Square -> Set)
  (cardinality : Nat) :
  Set where

  field
    enumerate :
      Fin cardinality ->
      Square
    enumerated-member :
      (index : Fin cardinality) ->
      member (enumerate index)
    enumeration-complete :
      (square : Square) ->
      member square ->
      Exists (Fin cardinality)
        (\ index -> square == enumerate index)
    enumeration-injective :
      (left-index right-index : Fin cardinality) ->
      enumerate left-index == enumerate right-index ->
      left-index == right-index

UncoveredAtLeast : Board -> Nat -> Set
UncoveredAtLeast board lower-bound =
  Exists Nat
    (\ uncovered-count ->
      HasCardinality
        (\ square -> Not (board square))
        uncovered-count
      and
      lower-bound <=N uncovered-count)

data LastState : Game -> Board -> Set1 where
  last-singleton :
    {board : Board} ->
    LastState (board ∷ []) board
  last-cons :
    {first-board last-board : Board}
    {remaining : Game} ->
    LastState remaining last-board ->
    LastState (first-board ∷ remaining) last-board

CanEnsure : Nat -> Set1
CanEnsure lower-bound =
  Exists Strategy
    (\ strategy ->
      ((board : Board) ->
        IsValidMove board (strategy board))
      and
      ((game : Game) ->
        IsValidGame game ->
        ConformsToStrategy game strategy ->
        Exists Board
          (\ final-board ->
            LastState game final-board
            and
            UncoveredAtLeast final-board lower-bound)))

record IsGreatest
  {property-level : Level}
  (property : Nat -> Set property-level)
  (greatest : Nat) :
  Set property-level where

  field
    member :
      property greatest
    upper-bound :
      (n : Nat) ->
      property n ->
      n <=N greatest

putnam-2022-a5-solution : Nat
putnam-2022-a5-solution =
  290

putnam-2022-a5 : Set1
putnam-2022-a5 =
  IsGreatest CanEnsure putnam-2022-a5-solution

title: putnam_2022_a5
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2022_a5:
  the greatest number of squares Alice can guarantee remain uncovered in the
  2022-square adjacent-domino game is 290. This file contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open arithmeticTheory listTheory pred_setTheory;

val putnam_2022_a5 =
  ``let board =
      \x : num set. x SUBSET count 2022
    in
    let valid_move =
      \x : num set.
      \y : num set.
        board x /\
        board y /\
        ((x = y /\
          !i : num. i < 2021 ==> i NOTIN x ==> i + 1 IN x) \/
         ?i : num.
           i < 2021 /\
           i NOTIN x /\
           i + 1 NOTIN x /\
           y = x UNION {i; i + 1})
    in
    let valid_game =
      \g : (num set) list.
        EVERY board g /\
        (?gt : (num set) list. g = {} :: gt) /\
        (!i : num.
           SUC i < LENGTH g
           ==>
           valid_move (EL i g) (EL (SUC i) g))
    in
    let conforms =
      \g : (num set) list.
      \s : num set -> num set.
        EVERY board g /\
        (!x : num set. board x ==> board (s x)) /\
        (!i : num.
           SUC i < LENGTH g /\ EVEN i
           ==>
           EL (SUC i) g = s (EL i g))
    in
    let attainable =
      \n : num.
        ?s : num set -> num set.
          (!x : num set. board x ==> valid_move x (s x)) /\
          (!g : (num set) list.
             valid_game g /\ conforms g s
             ==>
             ?gh : (num set) list. ?x : num set.
               g = gh ++ [x] /\
               n <= CARD (count 2022 DIFF x))
    in
      attainable 290 /\
      !n : num. attainable n ==> n <= 290``;

title: putnam_2022_a5
content:
$(
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact
  putnam_2022_a5: the greatest number of uncovered squares that Alice can
  guarantee in the 2022-square adjacent-domino game is 290. This file
  contains no proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  P22A5I is the 2022-element ordinal representing Fin 2022, and
  P22A5States is its full powerset. P22A5Move X Y directly expands the
  source move predicate: either X is terminal and Y = X, or Y adds one
  uncovered adjacent pair. The terminal clause retains the source condition
  that every uncovered square below 2021 has its successor covered.

  A word over P22A5States is exactly a finite list of board states, with
  # ` G its length. P22A5Game requires a nonempty word starting at the empty
  board and applies P22A5Move to every consecutive pair. P22A5Conforms
  requires the strategy move at each even-indexed turn, exactly as in the
  source. Strategies remain arbitrary total functions on the full state
  space.

  P22A5Good n says that some such strategy guarantees at least n uncovered
  squares for every conforming valid game. Since every valid game is
  nonempty, using its last entry G((# ` G)-1) is bidirectionally equivalent
  to the source's existential prefix-and-last decomposition. The final
  conjunction expands IsGreatest for the annotated solution 290. Every
  declaration below is an unproved $a statement encoding; this database
  contains no $p proof declaration.
$)

$c P22A5I P22A5States P22A5Move P22A5Game P22A5Conforms P22A5Good $.

p22a5-index-syntax $a class P22A5I $.
p22a5-states-syntax $a class P22A5States $.
p22a5-move-syntax $a wff ( P22A5Move X Y ) $.
p22a5-game-syntax $a wff ( P22A5Game G ) $.
p22a5-conforms-syntax $a wff ( P22A5Conforms G S ) $.
p22a5-good-syntax $a wff ( P22A5Good n ) $.

p22a5-index-definition $a |-
  P22A5I = ( 0 ..^ ; ; ; 2 0 2 2 )
$.

p22a5-states-definition $a |-
  P22A5States = ( ~P P22A5I )
$.

${
  $d X Y i $.

  p22a5-move-definition $a |- (
    ( P22A5Move X Y )
    <->
    (
      (
        X = Y
        /\
        A. i e. ( 0 ..^ ; ; ; 2 0 2 1 )
          (
            i e/ X
            ->
            ( i + 1 ) e. X
          )
      )
      \/
      E. i e. ( 0 ..^ ; ; ; 2 0 2 1 )
        (
          i e/ X
          /\
          (
            ( i + 1 ) e/ X
            /\
            Y = ( X u. { i , ( i + 1 ) } )
          )
        )
    )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d G i $.

  p22a5-game-definition $a |- (
    ( P22A5Game G )
    <->
    (
      G e. ( Word P22A5States \ { (/) } )
      /\
      (
        ( G ` 0 ) = (/)
        /\
        A. i e. ( 0 ..^ ( ( # ` G ) - 1 ) )
          ( P22A5Move ( G ` i ) ( G ` ( i + 1 ) ) )
      )
    )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d G S i $.

  p22a5-conforms-definition $a |- (
    ( P22A5Conforms G S )
    <->
    A. i e. ( 0 ..^ ( ( # ` G ) - 1 ) )
      (
        2 || i
        ->
        ( G ` ( i + 1 ) ) = ( S ` ( G ` i ) )
      )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d G S X n $.

  p22a5-good-definition $a |- (
    ( P22A5Good n )
    <->
    E. S e. ( P22A5States ^m P22A5States )
      (
        A. X e. P22A5States
          ( P22A5Move X ( S ` X ) )
        /\
        A. G e. ( Word P22A5States )
          (
            (
              ( P22A5Game G )
              /\
              ( P22A5Conforms G S )
            )
            ->
            n
            <_
            (
              #
              `
              (
                P22A5I
                \
                ( G ` ( ( # ` G ) - 1 ) )
              )
            )
          )
      )
  ) $.
$}

putnambench-putnam-2022-a5 $a |- (
  ( P22A5Good ; ; 2 9 0 )
  /\
  A. n e. NN0
    (
      ( P22A5Good n )
      ->
      n <_ ; ; 2 9 0
    )
) $.

:: Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2022_a5:
:: the greatest number of uncovered squares Alice can guarantee in a
:: domino-placement game on a row of 2022 squares. This file contains no proof.

environ
  vocabularies NUMBERS, NAT_1, FINSEQ_1, FINSEQ_2, RELAT_1, FUNCT_1,
    FUNCT_2, XBOOLE_0, SUBSET_1, TARSKI, CARD_1, ORDINAL1, ZFMISC_1,
    FINSET_1, ABIAN, XCMPLX_0, XREAL_0, XXREAL_0, ARYTM_1, ARYTM_3;
  notations TARSKI, XBOOLE_0, ZFMISC_1, SUBSET_1, FINSET_1, ORDINAL1,
    CARD_1, NUMBERS, XCMPLX_0, XREAL_0, XXREAL_0, NAT_1, RELAT_1,
    FUNCT_1, RELSET_1, PARTFUN1, FUNCT_2, FINSEQ_1, FINSEQ_2, ABIAN;
  constructors REAL_1, NAT_1, XXREAL_0, RELSET_1, PARTFUN1, FINSEQ_1,
    FINSEQ_2, FINSEQ_4, FINSET_1, ABIAN;
  registrations XBOOLE_0, SUBSET_1, RELAT_1, FUNCT_1, RELSET_1, FUNCT_2,
    PARTFUN1, FINSEQ_1, FINSEQ_2, ORDINAL1, NAT_1, FINSET_1, CARD_1,
    XCMPLX_0, XREAL_0, ABIAN;
  requirements BOOLE, SUBSET, NUMERALS, ARITHM, REAL;
  definitions TARSKI, XBOOLE_0;
  expansions TARSKI, XBOOLE_0, FINSEQ_1;

begin

::$P-
theorem
  for guaranteed being Subset of NAT st
    (for n being Nat holds
      n in guaranteed iff
      ex s being Function of bool (Seg 2022),bool (Seg 2022) st
        (for x being Subset of Seg 2022 holds
          (s.x = x &
            (for k being Nat st k in Seg 2021 holds
              k in x or (k + 1) in x)) or
          ex k being Nat st
            k in Seg 2021 &
            not k in x & not (k + 1) in x &
            s.x = x \/ {k,k + 1}) &
        (for g being FinSequence of bool (Seg 2022) st
          0 < len g &
          g.1 = {} &
          (for i being Nat st i in dom g & i + 1 in dom g holds
            (g.(i + 1) = g.i &
              (for k being Nat st k in Seg 2021 holds
                k in g.i or (k + 1) in g.i)) or
            ex k being Nat st
              k in Seg 2021 &
              not k in g.i & not (k + 1) in g.i &
              g.(i + 1) = g.i \/ {k,k + 1}) &
          (for i being Nat st
            i in dom g & i + 1 in dom g & not i is even
          holds
            g.(i + 1) = s.(g.i))
        holds
          n <= card ((Seg 2022) \ g.(len g))))
  holds
    290 in guaranteed &
    for n being Nat st n in guaranteed holds n <= 290
proof
end;
::$P+

title: putnam_2022_a5
content:
% Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2022_a5:
% the greatest number of uncovered squares Alice can guarantee in a
% domino-placement game on a row of 2022 squares is 290. This file contains
% no proof.

putnam_2022_a5: THEORY
BEGIN
  square: TYPE = below(2022)
  board_state: TYPE = [square -> bool]
  strategy: TYPE = [board_state -> board_state]
  game: TYPE = list[board_state]

  empty_state: board_state =
    LAMBDA (i: square): FALSE

  valid_move(
      state, next_state: board_state): bool =
    (state = next_state
      AND FORALL (i: square):
        (i < 2021 AND NOT state(i))
          IMPLIES next_state(i + 1))
    OR
      EXISTS (i: square):
        i < 2021
          AND NOT state(i)
          AND NOT state(i + 1)
          AND (FORALL (j: square):
            next_state(j) IFF
              state(j) OR j = i OR j = i + 1)

  valid_chain(history: game): RECURSIVE bool =
    CASES history OF
      null: TRUE,
      cons(state, tail):
        CASES tail OF
          null: TRUE,
          cons(next_state, remainder):
            valid_move(state, next_state)
              AND valid_chain(tail)
        ENDCASES
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE history BY <<

  valid_game(history: game): bool =
    CASES history OF
      null: FALSE,
      cons(initial_state, tail):
        initial_state = empty_state
          AND valid_chain(history)
    ENDCASES

  conforms_from(
      history: game,
      alice_strategy: strategy,
      alice_turn: bool): RECURSIVE bool =
    CASES history OF
      null: TRUE,
      cons(state, tail):
        CASES tail OF
          null: TRUE,
          cons(next_state, remainder):
            (alice_turn IMPLIES
              next_state = alice_strategy(state))
              AND conforms_from(
                tail, alice_strategy, NOT alice_turn)
        ENDCASES
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE history BY <<

  conforms_to_strategy(
      history: game,
      alice_strategy: strategy): bool =
    conforms_from(history, alice_strategy, TRUE)

  uncovered_prefix_count(
      state: board_state,
      count: nat): RECURSIVE nat =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSIF count <= 2022 THEN
      uncovered_prefix_count(state, count - 1)
        + IF state(count - 1) THEN 0 ELSE 1 ENDIF
    ELSE
      uncovered_prefix_count(state, 2022)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  uncovered_count(state: board_state): nat =
    uncovered_prefix_count(state, 2022)

  final_uncovered_at_least(
      history: game,
      guaranteed_count: nat): RECURSIVE bool =
    CASES history OF
      null: FALSE,
      cons(state, tail):
        CASES tail OF
          null:
            guaranteed_count <= uncovered_count(state),
          cons(next_state, remainder):
            final_uncovered_at_least(
              tail, guaranteed_count)
        ENDCASES
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE history BY <<

  guaranteed(guaranteed_count: nat): bool =
    EXISTS (alice_strategy: strategy):
      (FORALL (state: board_state):
        valid_move(state, alice_strategy(state)))
      AND
        (FORALL (history: game):
          (valid_game(history)
            AND conforms_to_strategy(
              history, alice_strategy))
          IMPLIES
            final_uncovered_at_least(
              history, guaranteed_count))

  putnam_2022_a5_solution: nat = 290

  putnam_2022_a5: bool =
    guaranteed(putnam_2022_a5_solution)
      AND FORALL (candidate: nat):
        guaranteed(candidate)
          IMPLIES candidate <= putnam_2022_a5_solution
END putnam_2022_a5

title: putnam_2022_a6
content:
import Mathlib

open Set

-- Note: uses (ℕ → ℝ) instead of (Fin (2 * n) → ℝ)
abbrev putnam_2022_a6_solution : ℕ → ℕ := sorry
-- (fun n : ℕ => n)
/--
Let $n$ be a positive integer. Determine, in terms of $n$, the largest integer $m$ with the following property: There exist real numbers $x_1,\dots,x_{2n}$ with $-1< x_1< x_2<\cdots< x_{2n}<1$ such that the sum of the lengths of the $n$ intervals $[x_1^{2k-1},x_2^{2k-1}],[x_3^{2k-1},x_4^{2k-1}],\dots,[x_{2n-1}^{2k-1},x_{2n}^{2k-1}]$ is equal to $1$ for all integers $k$ with $1 \leq k \leq m$.
-/
theorem putnam_2022_a6
    (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) :
    IsGreatest
      {m : ℕ | ∃ x : ℕ → ℝ,
        StrictMono x ∧ -1 < x 1 ∧ x (2 * n) < 1 ∧
        ∀ k ∈ Icc 1 m, ∑ i ∈ Icc 1 n, ((x (2 * i) : ℝ) ^ (2 * k - 1) - (x (2 * i - 1)) ^ (2 * k - 1)) = 1}
    (putnam_2022_a6_solution n) :=
  sorry

title: putnam_2022_a6
content:
Require Import Nat Reals Coquelicot.Hierarchy.

Definition putnam_2022_a6_solution := fun n : nat => n.

Theorem putnam_2022_a6
    (N : nat)
    (hN : (0 < N)%nat)
    (M : nat)
    (sumIntervals : (nat -> R) -> nat -> R := fun s k =>
      sum_n
        (fun i =>
          (s ((2 * i + 1)%nat)) ^ ((2 * k - 1)%nat) -
          (s ((2 * i)%nat)) ^ ((2 * k - 1)%nat))
        ((N - 1)%nat))
    (valid : nat -> (nat -> R) -> Prop := fun m s =>
      forall k : nat,
        (1 <= k <= m)%nat ->
        sumIntervals s k = 1)
    (hvalid : nat -> Prop := fun m =>
      exists s : nat -> R,
        -1 < s 0%nat /\
        s ((2 * N - 1)%nat) < 1 /\
        (forall i : nat,
          Nat.lt i (Nat.sub (Nat.mul 2 N) 1) -> s i < s (S i)) /\
        valid m s)
    (hM : hvalid M)
    (hMub : forall m : nat, hvalid m -> le m M)
    : M = putnam_2022_a6_solution N.
Proof. Admitted.

theory putnam_2022_a6 imports Complex_Main
begin

(* uses (nat \<Rightarrow> real) instead of (Fin (2*n) \<Rightarrow> real) *)
definition putnam_2022_a6_solution :: "nat \<Rightarrow> nat" where "putnam_2022_a6_solution \<equiv> undefined"
(* (\<lambda>n::nat. n) *)
theorem putnam_2022_a6:
  fixes n :: nat
  and xlt :: "(nat \<Rightarrow> real) \<Rightarrow> bool"
  and mxsum :: "nat \<Rightarrow> (nat \<Rightarrow> real) \<Rightarrow> bool"
  and mexx :: "nat \<Rightarrow> bool"
  assumes npos: "n > 0"
  and hxlt: "\<forall>x::nat\<Rightarrow>real. xlt x = (-1 < x 1 \<and> (\<forall>i::nat\<in>{1..(2*n-1)}. x i < x (i + 1)) \<and> x (2*n) < 1)"
  and hmxsum: "\<forall>(m::nat)(x::nat\<Rightarrow>real). mxsum m x = (\<forall>k::nat\<in>{1..m}. ((\<Sum>i::nat=1..n. ((x (2*i))^(2*k-1) - (x (2*i-1))^(2*k-1))) = 1))"
  and hmexx: "\<forall>m::nat. mexx m = (\<exists>x::nat\<Rightarrow>real. xlt x \<and> mxsum m x)"
  shows "(GREATEST m::nat. mexx m) = putnam_2022_a6_solution n"
  sorry

end

title: putnam_2022_a6
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2022_a6
  (putnambench__hol-light__putnam_2022_a6): for 2*n ordered real points in
  (-1,1), the largest number of initial odd-power interval-sum identities
  that can simultaneously equal 1 is n. This file contains no proof.
*)

let statement =
  `let admissible =
     \n:num. \x:num->real.
       -- &1 < x 1 /\
       (!i:num.
          1 <= i /\ i < 2 * n
          ==> x i < x (i + 1)) /\
       x (2 * n) < &1 in
   let valid =
     \n:num. \m:num. \x:num->real.
       !k:num.
         1 <= k /\ k <= m
         ==>
         sum (1..n)
           (\i:num.
              x (2 * i) pow (2 * k - 1) -
              x (2 * i - 1) pow (2 * k - 1)) =
         &1 in
   let feasible =
     \n:num. \m:num.
       ?x:num->real. admissible n x /\ valid n m x in
   !n:num.
     0 < n
     ==>
     feasible n n /\
     (!m:num. feasible n m ==> m <= n)`;;

title: putnam_2022_a6
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2022_a6:
;; the greatest number of initial odd-power interval-sum identities attainable
;; by 2n strictly increasing real points in (-1,1) is n. This file contains no
;; proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))

;; The source constraints are first-order formulas over the ordered real
;; field. Real closed fields are elementarily equivalent, so it is equivalent
;; to state the result over an arbitrary real closed ordered field. The
;; square-root and odd-polynomial-root selectors below are the standard
;; first-order presentation of real closedness; they add operations but do not
;; restrict the represented field.
;;
;; FN-EQUAL with a failure predicate supplies the internal existential
;; quantifier over the list x_1,...,x_(2n). The property P(m) is downward
;; closed in m, so saying that n is its greatest natural member is equivalent
;; to P(n) and not P(n+1). The Lean source's globally strictly increasing
;; natural-indexed sequence is equivalent here: any qualifying finite list can
;; be extended by one point below x_1 and an infinite increasing tail after
;; x_(2n), while restriction recovers exactly this list.

(defun putnam-2022-a6-quoted (object)
  (list 'quote object))

(defun putnam-2022-a6-apply1-term (function argument)
  (list
   'apply$
   (putnam-2022-a6-quoted function)
   (list 'cons argument nil)))

(defun putnam-2022-a6-apply2-term (function left right)
  (list
   'apply$
   (putnam-2022-a6-quoted function)
   (list 'cons left (list 'cons right nil))))

(defun putnam-2022-a6-and-term (terms)
  (if (endp terms)
      (putnam-2022-a6-quoted t)
    (list
     'if
     (car terms)
     (putnam-2022-a6-and-term (cdr terms))
     (putnam-2022-a6-quoted nil))))

(defun putnam-2022-a6-or-term (terms)
  (if (endp terms)
      (putnam-2022-a6-quoted nil)
    (list
     'if
     (car terms)
     (putnam-2022-a6-quoted t)
     (putnam-2022-a6-or-term (cdr terms)))))

(defun putnam-2022-a6-not-term (term)
  (list
   'if
   term
   (putnam-2022-a6-quoted nil)
   (putnam-2022-a6-quoted t)))

(defun putnam-2022-a6-implies-term (antecedent consequent)
  (list
   'if
   antecedent
   consequent
   (putnam-2022-a6-quoted t)))

(defun putnam-2022-a6-true-function (formals)
  (list
   'lambda
   formals
   (putnam-2022-a6-quoted t)))

(defun putnam-2022-a6-carrier-term (carrier element)
  (putnam-2022-a6-apply1-term carrier element))

(defun putnam-2022-a6-operation-term (operation left right)
  (putnam-2022-a6-apply2-term operation left right))

(defun putnam-2022-a6-field-laws-function
    (carrier zero one add mul neg inv)
  (let* ((x 'x)
         (y 'y)
         (z 'z)
         (qzero (putnam-2022-a6-quoted zero))
         (qone (putnam-2022-a6-quoted one))
         (add-xy
          (putnam-2022-a6-operation-term add x y))
         (add-yz
          (putnam-2022-a6-operation-term add y z))
         (mul-xy
          (putnam-2022-a6-operation-term mul x y))
         (mul-yz
          (putnam-2022-a6-operation-term mul y z))
         (neg-x
          (putnam-2022-a6-apply1-term neg x))
         (inv-x
          (putnam-2022-a6-apply1-term inv x))
         (domain
          (putnam-2022-a6-and-term
           (list
            (putnam-2022-a6-carrier-term carrier x)
            (putnam-2022-a6-carrier-term carrier y)
            (putnam-2022-a6-carrier-term carrier z))))
         (laws
          (putnam-2022-a6-and-term
           (list
            (putnam-2022-a6-carrier-term carrier add-xy)
            (putnam-2022-a6-carrier-term carrier mul-xy)
            (putnam-2022-a6-carrier-term carrier neg-x)
            (putnam-2022-a6-carrier-term carrier inv-x)
            (list
             'equal
             (putnam-2022-a6-operation-term add add-xy z)
             (putnam-2022-a6-operation-term add x add-yz))
            (list
             'equal
             (putnam-2022-a6-operation-term mul mul-xy z)
             (putnam-2022-a6-operation-term mul x mul-yz))
            (list
             'equal
             add-xy
             (putnam-2022-a6-operation-term add y x))
            (list
             'equal
             mul-xy
             (putnam-2022-a6-operation-term mul y x))
            (list
             'equal
             (putnam-2022-a6-operation-term add x qzero)
             x)
            (list
             'equal
             (putnam-2022-a6-operation-term add x neg-x)
             qzero)
            (list
             'equal
             (putnam-2022-a6-operation-term mul x qone)
             x)
            (putnam-2022-a6-implies-term
             (list 'equal x qzero)
             (list 'equal inv-x qzero))
            (putnam-2022-a6-implies-term
             (putnam-2022-a6-not-term
              (list 'equal x qzero))
             (list
              'equal
              (putnam-2022-a6-operation-term mul x inv-x)
              qone))
            (list
             'equal
             (putnam-2022-a6-operation-term mul x add-yz)
             (putnam-2022-a6-operation-term
              add
              (putnam-2022-a6-operation-term mul x y)
              (putnam-2022-a6-operation-term mul x z)))))))
    (list
     'lambda
     '(x y z)
     (putnam-2022-a6-implies-term domain laws))))

(defun putnam-2022-a6-order-laws-function
    (carrier zero add mul lt)
  (let* ((x 'x)
         (y 'y)
         (z 'z)
         (qzero (putnam-2022-a6-quoted zero))
         (lt-xy
          (putnam-2022-a6-operation-term lt x y))
         (lt-yx
          (putnam-2022-a6-operation-term lt y x))
         (lt-yz
          (putnam-2022-a6-operation-term lt y z))
         (lt-xz
          (putnam-2022-a6-operation-term lt x z))
         (domain
          (putnam-2022-a6-and-term
           (list
            (putnam-2022-a6-carrier-term carrier x)
            (putnam-2022-a6-carrier-term carrier y)
            (putnam-2022-a6-carrier-term carrier z))))
         (laws
          (putnam-2022-a6-and-term
           (list
            (putnam-2022-a6-not-term
             (putnam-2022-a6-operation-term lt x x))
            (putnam-2022-a6-or-term
             (list
              lt-xy
              lt-yx
              (list 'equal x y)))
            (putnam-2022-a6-implies-term
             (putnam-2022-a6-and-term
              (list lt-xy lt-yz))
             lt-xz)
            (putnam-2022-a6-implies-term
             lt-xy
             (putnam-2022-a6-operation-term
              lt
              (putnam-2022-a6-operation-term add x z)
              (putnam-2022-a6-operation-term add y z)))
            (putnam-2022-a6-implies-term
             (putnam-2022-a6-and-term
              (list
               (putnam-2022-a6-operation-term lt qzero x)
               (putnam-2022-a6-operation-term lt qzero y)))
             (putnam-2022-a6-operation-term
              lt
              qzero
              (putnam-2022-a6-operation-term mul x y)))))))
    (list
     'lambda
     '(x y z)
     (putnam-2022-a6-implies-term domain laws))))

(defun putnam-2022-a6-square-root-laws-function
    (carrier zero mul lt square-root)
  (let* ((x 'x)
         (qzero (putnam-2022-a6-quoted zero))
         (root
          (putnam-2022-a6-apply1-term square-root x))
         (domain
          (putnam-2022-a6-and-term
           (list
            (putnam-2022-a6-carrier-term carrier x)
            (putnam-2022-a6-not-term
             (putnam-2022-a6-operation-term lt x qzero)))))
         (laws
          (putnam-2022-a6-and-term
           (list
            (putnam-2022-a6-carrier-term carrier root)
            (putnam-2022-a6-not-term
             (putnam-2022-a6-operation-term lt root qzero))
            (list
             'equal
             (putnam-2022-a6-operation-term mul root root)
             x)))))
    (list
     'lambda
     '(x)
     (putnam-2022-a6-implies-term domain laws))))

(defun putnam-2022-a6-all-coefficients-function (carrier)
  (list
   'lambda
   '(loop$-gvars loop$-ivars)
   (putnam-2022-a6-carrier-term carrier 'loop$-ivars)))

(defun putnam-2022-a6-all-coefficients-term
    (carrier coefficients)
  (list
   'always$+
   (putnam-2022-a6-quoted
    (putnam-2022-a6-all-coefficients-function carrier))
   (putnam-2022-a6-quoted nil)
   coefficients))

(defun putnam-2022-a6-polynomial-term
    (carrier zero coefficients)
  (putnam-2022-a6-and-term
   (list
    (list 'true-listp coefficients)
    (list 'consp coefficients)
    (putnam-2022-a6-all-coefficients-term
     carrier coefficients)
    (putnam-2022-a6-or-term
     (list
      (list
       'equal
       (list 'len coefficients)
       (putnam-2022-a6-quoted 1))
      (putnam-2022-a6-not-term
       (list
        'equal
        (list 'car (list 'last coefficients))
        (putnam-2022-a6-quoted zero))))))))

(defun putnam-2022-a6-evaluation-laws-function
    (carrier zero add mul evaluate)
  (let* ((coefficient 'coefficient)
         (rest 'rest)
         (x 'x)
         (qzero (putnam-2022-a6-quoted zero))
         (domain
          (putnam-2022-a6-and-term
           (list
            (putnam-2022-a6-carrier-term
             carrier coefficient)
            (list 'true-listp rest)
            (putnam-2022-a6-all-coefficients-term
             carrier rest)
            (putnam-2022-a6-carrier-term carrier x))))
         (empty-law
          (putnam-2022-a6-implies-term
           (putnam-2022-a6-carrier-term carrier x)
           (list
            'equal
            (putnam-2022-a6-operation-term
             evaluate
             (putnam-2022-a6-quoted nil)
             x)
            qzero)))
         (recursive-value
          (putnam-2022-a6-operation-term
           add
           coefficient
           (putnam-2022-a6-operation-term
            mul
            x
            (putnam-2022-a6-operation-term
             evaluate rest x))))
         (recursive-law
          (putnam-2022-a6-implies-term
           domain
           (putnam-2022-a6-and-term
            (list
             (putnam-2022-a6-carrier-term
              carrier
              (putnam-2022-a6-operation-term
               evaluate
               (list 'cons coefficient rest)
               x))
             (list
              'equal
              (putnam-2022-a6-operation-term
               evaluate
               (list 'cons coefficient rest)
               x)
              recursive-value))))))
    (list
     'lambda
     '(coefficient rest x)
     (putnam-2022-a6-and-term
      (list empty-law recursive-law)))))

(defun putnam-2022-a6-odd-root-laws-function
    (carrier zero evaluate odd-root)
  (let* ((coefficients 'coefficients)
         (half 'half)
         (root
          (putnam-2022-a6-apply2-term
           odd-root coefficients half))
         (domain
          (putnam-2022-a6-and-term
           (list
            (putnam-2022-a6-polynomial-term
             carrier zero coefficients)
            (list 'natp half)
            (list
             'equal
             (list 'len coefficients)
             (list
              'binary-+
              (list
               'binary-*
               (putnam-2022-a6-quoted 2)
               half)
              (putnam-2022-a6-quoted 2))))))
         (laws
          (putnam-2022-a6-and-term
           (list
            (putnam-2022-a6-carrier-term carrier root)
            (list
             'equal
             (putnam-2022-a6-operation-term
              evaluate coefficients root)
             (putnam-2022-a6-quoted zero))))))
    (list
     'lambda
     '(coefficients half)
     (putnam-2022-a6-implies-term domain laws))))

(defun putnam-2022-a6-real-closed-field-p
    (carrier zero one add mul neg inv lt
             square-root evaluate odd-root)
  (let* ((field-laws
          (putnam-2022-a6-field-laws-function
           carrier zero one add mul neg inv))
         (field-laws-true
          (putnam-2022-a6-true-function '(x y z)))
         (order-laws
          (putnam-2022-a6-order-laws-function
           carrier zero add mul lt))
         (order-laws-true
          (putnam-2022-a6-true-function '(x y z)))
         (square-root-laws
          (putnam-2022-a6-square-root-laws-function
           carrier zero mul lt square-root))
         (square-root-laws-true
          (putnam-2022-a6-true-function '(x)))
         (evaluation-laws
          (putnam-2022-a6-evaluation-laws-function
           carrier zero add mul evaluate))
         (evaluation-laws-true
          (putnam-2022-a6-true-function
           '(coefficient rest x)))
         (odd-root-laws
          (putnam-2022-a6-odd-root-laws-function
           carrier zero evaluate odd-root))
         (odd-root-laws-true
          (putnam-2022-a6-true-function
           '(coefficients half))))
    (and
     (tamep-functionp carrier)
     (tamep-functionp add)
     (tamep-functionp mul)
     (tamep-functionp neg)
     (tamep-functionp inv)
     (tamep-functionp lt)
     (tamep-functionp square-root)
     (tamep-functionp evaluate)
     (tamep-functionp odd-root)
     (tamep-functionp field-laws)
     (tamep-functionp field-laws-true)
     (tamep-functionp order-laws)
     (tamep-functionp order-laws-true)
     (tamep-functionp square-root-laws)
     (tamep-functionp square-root-laws-true)
     (tamep-functionp evaluation-laws)
     (tamep-functionp evaluation-laws-true)
     (tamep-functionp odd-root-laws)
     (tamep-functionp odd-root-laws-true)
     (apply$ carrier (list zero))
     (apply$ carrier (list one))
     (not (equal zero one))
     (fn-equal field-laws field-laws-true)
     (fn-equal order-laws order-laws-true)
     (fn-equal square-root-laws square-root-laws-true)
     (fn-equal evaluation-laws evaluation-laws-true)
     (fn-equal odd-root-laws odd-root-laws-true))))

(defun putnam-2022-a6-nth-term (index values)
  (list 'nth (putnam-2022-a6-quoted index) values))

(defun putnam-2022-a6-field-element-terms
    (count index carrier values)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix count)))
  (if (zp count)
      nil
    (cons
     (putnam-2022-a6-carrier-term
      carrier
      (putnam-2022-a6-nth-term index values))
     (putnam-2022-a6-field-element-terms
      (- count 1) (+ index 1) carrier values))))

(defun putnam-2022-a6-increasing-terms
    (count index lt values)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix count)))
  (if (or (zp count) (equal count 1))
      nil
    (cons
     (putnam-2022-a6-operation-term
      lt
      (putnam-2022-a6-nth-term index values)
      (putnam-2022-a6-nth-term (+ index 1) values))
     (putnam-2022-a6-increasing-terms
      (- count 1) (+ index 1) lt values))))

(defun putnam-2022-a6-power-term (base exponent one mul)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix exponent)))
  (cond
   ((zp exponent)
    (putnam-2022-a6-quoted one))
   ((equal exponent 1)
    base)
   (t
    (putnam-2022-a6-operation-term
     mul
     base
     (putnam-2022-a6-power-term
      base (- exponent 1) one mul)))))

(defun putnam-2022-a6-interval-sum-term
    (values pair-index pairs exponent zero one add mul neg)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix pairs)))
  (if (zp pairs)
      (putnam-2022-a6-quoted zero)
    (putnam-2022-a6-operation-term
     add
     (putnam-2022-a6-operation-term
      add
      (putnam-2022-a6-power-term
       (putnam-2022-a6-nth-term
        (+ (* 2 pair-index) 1) values)
       exponent one mul)
      (putnam-2022-a6-apply1-term
       neg
       (putnam-2022-a6-power-term
        (putnam-2022-a6-nth-term
         (* 2 pair-index) values)
        exponent one mul)))
     (putnam-2022-a6-interval-sum-term
      values
      (+ pair-index 1)
      (- pairs 1)
      exponent
      zero one add mul neg))))

(defun putnam-2022-a6-identity-terms
    (values n k zero one add mul neg)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix k)))
  (if (zp k)
      nil
    (cons
     (list
      'equal
      (putnam-2022-a6-interval-sum-term
       values
       0
       n
       (- (* 2 k) 1)
       zero one add mul neg)
      (putnam-2022-a6-quoted one))
     (putnam-2022-a6-identity-terms
      values n (- k 1) zero one add mul neg))))

(defun putnam-2022-a6-witness-term
    (n m carrier zero one add mul neg lt values)
  (let ((count (* 2 n)))
    (putnam-2022-a6-and-term
     (append
      (list
       (list 'true-listp values)
       (list
        'equal
        (list 'len values)
        (putnam-2022-a6-quoted count)))
      (putnam-2022-a6-field-element-terms
       count 0 carrier values)
      (putnam-2022-a6-increasing-terms
       count 0 lt values)
      (list
       (putnam-2022-a6-operation-term
        lt
        (putnam-2022-a6-apply1-term
         neg
         (putnam-2022-a6-quoted one))
        (putnam-2022-a6-nth-term 0 values))
       (putnam-2022-a6-operation-term
        lt
        (putnam-2022-a6-nth-term (- count 1) values)
        (putnam-2022-a6-quoted one)))
      (putnam-2022-a6-identity-terms
       values n m zero one add mul neg)))))

(defun putnam-2022-a6-witness-failure-function
    (n m carrier zero one add mul neg lt)
  (list
   'lambda
   '(values)
   (list
    'if
    (putnam-2022-a6-witness-term
     n m carrier zero one add mul neg lt 'values)
    (putnam-2022-a6-quoted nil)
    (putnam-2022-a6-quoted t))))

(defun putnam-2022-a6-witness-exists-p
    (n m carrier zero one add mul neg lt)
  (let ((failure
         (putnam-2022-a6-witness-failure-function
          n m carrier zero one add mul neg lt))
        (always-true
         (putnam-2022-a6-true-function '(values))))
    (and
     (tamep-functionp failure)
     (tamep-functionp always-true)
     (not (fn-equal failure always-true)))))

(defun putnambench-putnam-2022-a6-statement
    (n carrier zero one add mul neg inv lt
       square-root evaluate odd-root)
  (implies
   (and
    (posp n)
    (putnam-2022-a6-real-closed-field-p
     carrier zero one add mul neg inv lt
     square-root evaluate odd-root))
   (and
    (putnam-2022-a6-witness-exists-p
     n n carrier zero one add mul neg lt)
    (not
     (putnam-2022-a6-witness-exists-p
      n (+ n 1) carrier zero one add mul neg lt)))))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

title: putnam_2022_a6
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2022_a6:
-- for positive n, the largest m admitting 2n increasing real points in
-- (-1,1) whose first m odd-power interval-length sums equal one is n.
-- This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module Putnam2022A6 where

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; _*_; _-_)

infix 4 _!=_ _<=N_
infixr 3 _and_
infixr 2 _or_

data Bottom : Set where

Not : Set -> Set
Not A =
  A -> Bottom

_!=_ : {A : Set} -> A -> A -> Set
x != y =
  Not (x == y)

record _and_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data _or_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  left  : A -> A or B
  right : B -> A or B

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

data _<=N_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set where
  zero<=N   : {n : Nat} -> zero <=N n
  suc<=sucN : {m n : Nat} -> m <=N n -> suc m <=N suc n

record CompleteOrderedRealField (R : Set) : Set1 where
  field
    zeroR oneR : R
    add multiply : R -> R -> R
    negate inverse : R -> R
    lessOrEqual : R -> R -> Set
    fromNat : Nat -> R

    one-not-zero :
      oneR != zeroR

    add-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> add x y == add y x
    add-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      add (add x y) z == add x (add y z)
    add-zero :
      (x : R) -> add x zeroR == x
    add-inverse :
      (x : R) -> add x (negate x) == zeroR

    multiply-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> multiply x y == multiply y x
    multiply-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply (multiply x y) z ==
      multiply x (multiply y z)
    multiply-one :
      (x : R) -> multiply x oneR == x
    multiply-zero :
      (x : R) -> multiply x zeroR == zeroR
    distribute :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply x (add y z) ==
      add (multiply x y) (multiply x z)
    inverse-zero :
      inverse zeroR == zeroR
    multiply-inverse :
      (x : R) ->
      x != zeroR ->
      multiply x (inverse x) == oneR

    order-reflexive :
      (x : R) -> lessOrEqual x x
    order-transitive :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y z ->
      lessOrEqual x z
    order-antisymmetric :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y x ->
      x == y
    order-total :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y or lessOrEqual y x
    add-order :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual (add z x) (add z y)
    multiply-nonnegative :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR x ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR y ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR (multiply x y)
    zero-less-than-one :
      lessOrEqual zeroR oneR and zeroR != oneR

    fromNat-zero :
      fromNat zero == zeroR
    fromNat-successor :
      (n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (suc n) == add (fromNat n) oneR
    fromNat-addition :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m + n) == add (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-multiplication :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m * n) == multiply (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-injective :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat m == fromNat n ->
      m == n

    archimedean :
      (x : R) ->
      Exists Nat
        (\ n -> lessOrEqual x (fromNat n))
    least-upper-bound :
      (P : R -> Set) ->
      Exists R P ->
      Exists R
        (\ upper ->
          (x : R) ->
          P x ->
          lessOrEqual x upper) ->
      Exists R
        (\ supremum ->
          ((x : R) ->
            P x ->
            lessOrEqual x supremum)
          and
          ((upper : R) ->
            ((x : R) ->
              P x ->
              lessOrEqual x upper) ->
            lessOrEqual supremum upper))

open CompleteOrderedRealField

oneN : Nat
oneN =
  suc zero

twoN : Nat
twoN =
  suc oneN

Positive : Nat -> Set
Positive n =
  oneN <=N n

InClosedNatInterval : Nat -> Nat -> Nat -> Set
InClosedNatInterval lower upper k =
  lower <=N k and k <=N upper

StrictLess :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
StrictLess reals x y =
  lessOrEqual reals x y and x != y

subtract :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
subtract reals x y =
  add reals x (negate reals y)

realPower :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  Nat ->
  R
realPower reals x zero =
  oneR reals
realPower reals x (suc exponent) =
  multiply reals
    (realPower reals x exponent)
    x

sumPositive :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Nat ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  R
sumPositive reals zero term =
  zeroR reals
sumPositive reals (suc n) term =
  add reals
    (sumPositive reals n term)
    (term (suc n))

IncreasingPoints :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Nat ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  Set
IncreasingPoints reals n x =
  StrictLess reals
    (negate reals (oneR reals))
    (x oneN)
  and
  ((i : Nat) ->
    InClosedNatInterval oneN (twoN * n - oneN) i ->
    StrictLess reals (x i) (x (suc i)))
  and
  StrictLess reals
    (x (twoN * n))
    (oneR reals)

MomentEquations :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Nat ->
  Nat ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  Set
MomentEquations reals n m x =
  (k : Nat) ->
  InClosedNatInterval oneN m k ->
  sumPositive reals n
    (\ i ->
      subtract reals
        (realPower reals
          (x (twoN * i))
          (twoN * k - oneN))
        (realPower reals
          (x (twoN * i - oneN))
          (twoN * k - oneN)))
  ==
  oneR reals

Admissible :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Nat ->
  Nat ->
  Set
Admissible {R} reals n m =
  Exists (Nat -> R)
    (\ x ->
      IncreasingPoints reals n x
      and
      MomentEquations reals n m x)

record IsGreatest
  (property : Nat -> Set)
  (greatest : Nat) :
  Set where

  field
    attained :
      property greatest
    upper-bound :
      (m : Nat) ->
      property m ->
      m <=N greatest

putnam-2022-a6-solution : Nat -> Nat
putnam-2022-a6-solution n =
  n

putnam-2022-a6 : Set1
putnam-2022-a6 =
  (R : Set) ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) ->
  (n : Nat) ->
  Positive n ->
  IsGreatest
    (Admissible reals n)
    (putnam-2022-a6-solution n)

(*
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2022_a6:
  for positive n, the largest m admitting 2n ordered real endpoints in
  (-1,1) whose odd-power interval lengths sum to 1 for k from 1 through m
  is n. This file contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open arithmeticTheory pred_setTheory realTheory real_sigmaTheory;

val putnam_2022_a6 =
  ``!n : num.
      0 < n
      ==>
      let admissible =
        \m : num.
          ?x : num -> real.
            -1 < x 1 /\
            (!i : num.
               1 <= i /\ i < 2 * n
               ==>
               x i < x (i + 1)) /\
            x (2 * n) < 1 /\
            !k : num.
              1 <= k /\ k <= m
              ==>
              SIGMA
                (\i : num.
                   x (2 * (i + 1)) pow (2 * k - 1) -
                   x (2 * (i + 1) - 1) pow (2 * k - 1))
                (count n) =
              1
      in
        admissible n /\
        !m : num. admissible m ==> m <= n``;

  putnam_2022_a6: for 2n strictly increasing real points between -1 and 1,
  the greatest number of prescribed odd-power interval-sum identities is n.
  This file contains no proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  A sequence x is represented as a function from 1 ... (2 x. n) to RR.
  This is equivalent to the source's total natural-indexed representation:
  every finite strictly increasing real sequence can be extended strictly
  monotonically before and after the indices used here.

  The first existential clause says that the required identities hold for
  every k from 1 through n. The universal clause says that any nonnegative m
  admitting such a sequence is at most n. Together these clauses state that
  n is the greatest admissible m, with the witness remaining internally
  existentially quantified. The final declaration is the single unproved
  $a corpus statement; this database contains no $p proof statement.
$)

${
  $d i k m n x $.

  putnambench-putnam-2022-a6 $a |- A. n e. NN
    (
      E. x e. ( RR ^m ( 1 ... ( 2 x. n ) ) )
        (
          (
            (
              -u 1 < ( x ` 1 )
              /\
              A. i e. ( 1 ... ( ( 2 x. n ) - 1 ) )
                ( x ` i ) < ( x ` ( i + 1 ) )
            )
            /\
            ( x ` ( 2 x. n ) ) < 1
          )
          /\
          A. k e. ( 1 ... n )
            (
              sum_ i e. ( 1 ... n )
                (
                  (
                    ( x ` ( 2 x. i ) )
                    ^
                    ( ( 2 x. k ) - 1 )
                  )
                  -
                  (
                    ( x ` ( ( 2 x. i ) - 1 ) )
                    ^
                    ( ( 2 x. k ) - 1 )
                  )
                )
            )
            =
            1
        )
      /\
      A. m e. NN0
        (
          E. x e. ( RR ^m ( 1 ... ( 2 x. n ) ) )
            (
              (
                (
                  -u 1 < ( x ` 1 )
                  /\
                  A. i e. ( 1 ... ( ( 2 x. n ) - 1 ) )
                    ( x ` i ) < ( x ` ( i + 1 ) )
                )
                /\
                ( x ` ( 2 x. n ) ) < 1
              )
              /\
              A. k e. ( 1 ... m )
                (
                  sum_ i e. ( 1 ... n )
                    (
                      (
                        ( x ` ( 2 x. i ) )
                        ^
                        ( ( 2 x. k ) - 1 )
                      )
                      -
                      (
                        ( x ` ( ( 2 x. i ) - 1 ) )
                        ^
                        ( ( 2 x. k ) - 1 )
                      )
                    )
                )
                =

            )

$}

title: putnam_2022_a6
content:
% Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2022_a6:
% for positive n, the largest number of initial odd-power interval-sum
% conditions realizable by 2*n ordered real points in (-1, 1) is n.
% This file contains no proof.

putnam_2022_a6: THEORY
BEGIN
  real_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> real]

  odd_exponent(k: nat): nat =
    IF k = 0 THEN 0 ELSE 2 * k - 1 ENDIF

  odd_power_interval_sum(
      x: real_sequence,
      k, count: nat): RECURSIVE real =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      odd_power_interval_sum(x, k, count - 1)
        + x(2 * count) ^ odd_exponent(k)
        - x(2 * count - 1) ^ odd_exponent(k)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  ordered_points(n: nat, x: real_sequence): bool =
    -1 < x(1)
      AND x(2 * n) < 1
      AND (FORALL (i: nat):
        (1 <= i AND i < 2 * n)
          IMPLIES x(i) < x(i + 1))

  admissible(n, m: nat): bool =
    EXISTS (x: real_sequence):
      ordered_points(n, x)
        AND (FORALL (k: nat):
          (1 <= k AND k <= m)
            IMPLIES odd_power_interval_sum(x, k, n) = 1)

  is_greatest_admissible(n, candidate: nat): bool =
    admissible(n, candidate)
      AND (FORALL (m: nat):
        admissible(n, m) IMPLIES m <= candidate)

  putnam_2022_a6: bool =
    FORALL (n: nat):
      n > 0 IMPLIES is_greatest_admissible(n, n)
END putnam_2022_a6

import Mathlib

open Polynomial

/--
Suppose that $P(x)=a_1x+a_2x^2+\cdots+a_nx^n$ is a polynomial with integer coefficients, with $a_1$ odd. Suppose that $e^{P(x)}=b_0+b_1x+b_2x^2+\dots$ for all $x$. Prove that $b_k$ is nonzero for all $k \geq 0$.
-/
theorem putnam_2022_b1
    (P : Polynomial ℤ)
    (b : ℕ → ℝ)
    (Pconst : P.coeff 0 = 0)
    (Podd : Odd (P.coeff 1))
    (hB : ∀ x : ℝ, HasSum (fun i => b i * x ^ i) (Real.exp (aeval x P))) :
    ∀ k : ℕ, b k ≠ 0 :=
  sorry
