title: putnam_2022_b4
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2022_b4:
;; the natural lengths admitting a cyclic sequence of distinct real numbers
;; whose consecutive triples are three-term arithmetic progressions are
;; exactly the multiples of 3 that are at least 9. This file contains no proof.
;;
;; Only the first n values of the source function occur, so an n-vector is
;; extensionally equivalent to that finite restriction and every such vector
;; extends to a function on the naturals. For a vector with distinct entries,
;; a triple is an arithmetic progression in increasing order exactly when one
;; of its three entries is the midpoint of the other two. The 3^n midpoint
;; choices therefore give homogeneous linear systems with integer
;; coefficients.
;;
;; For one such system, its real nullspace contains a vector with all
;; coordinates distinct exactly when it is not contained in any hyperplane
;; x_i = x_j: a finite union of proper subspaces cannot cover a vector space
;; over the infinite field of reals. Containment in x_i = x_j holds exactly
;; when adjoining that equation does not increase matrix rank. Since a
;; rational matrix has the same rank over the rationals and the reals, the
;; exact rational row-rank computation below decides the original real
;; existential bidirectionally; it does not restrict the witnesses to
;; rational sequences.

(in-package "ACL2")

(defun putnam-2022-b4-midpoint-index (i n choice)
  (mod (+ (nfix i) (nfix choice)) (nfix n)))

(defun putnam-2022-b4-row-entry (column i n choice)
  (let* ((middle
          (putnam-2022-b4-midpoint-index i n choice))
         (first-other
          (putnam-2022-b4-midpoint-index
           i n (mod (+ (nfix choice) 1) 3)))
         (second-other
          (putnam-2022-b4-midpoint-index
           i n (mod (+ (nfix choice) 2) 3))))
    (+ (if (equal column middle) 2 0)
       (if (equal column first-other) -1 0)
       (if (equal column second-other) -1 0))))

(defun putnam-2022-b4-build-row-aux
    (remaining column i n choice)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix remaining)))
  (if (zp remaining)
      nil
    (cons
     (putnam-2022-b4-row-entry column i n choice)
     (putnam-2022-b4-build-row-aux
      (- remaining 1) (+ column 1) i n choice))))

(defun putnam-2022-b4-build-row (i n choice)
  (putnam-2022-b4-build-row-aux n 0 i n choice))

(defun putnam-2022-b4-build-system-aux
    (remaining i n choices-code)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix remaining)))
  (if (zp remaining)
      nil
    (cons
     (putnam-2022-b4-build-row
      i n (mod (nfix choices-code) 3))
     (putnam-2022-b4-build-system-aux
      (- remaining 1)
      (+ i 1)
      n
      (floor (nfix choices-code) 3)))))

(defun putnam-2022-b4-build-system (n choices-code)
  (putnam-2022-b4-build-system-aux
   n 0 n choices-code))

(defun putnam-2022-b4-find-pivot (rows column)
  (if (consp rows)
      (if (equal (nth (nfix column) (car rows)) 0)
          (putnam-2022-b4-find-pivot (cdr rows) column)
        (car rows))
    nil))

(defun putnam-2022-b4-remove-first-row (row rows)
  (if (consp rows)
      (if (equal row (car rows))
          (cdr rows)
        (cons
         (car rows)
         (putnam-2022-b4-remove-first-row
          row (cdr rows))))
    nil))

(defun putnam-2022-b4-row-combination
    (left-scale left right-scale right)
  (if (and (consp left) (consp right))
      (cons
       (+ (* left-scale (car left))
          (* right-scale (car right)))
       (putnam-2022-b4-row-combination
        left-scale
        (cdr left)
        right-scale
        (cdr right)))
    nil))

(defun putnam-2022-b4-eliminate-column
    (rows pivot column)
  (if (consp rows)
      (let ((coefficient
             (nth (nfix column) (car rows)))
            (pivot-coefficient
             (nth (nfix column) pivot)))
        (cons
         (if (equal coefficient 0)
             (car rows)
           (putnam-2022-b4-row-combination
            pivot-coefficient
            (car rows)
            (- coefficient)
            pivot))
         (putnam-2022-b4-eliminate-column
          (cdr rows) pivot column)))
    nil))

(defun putnam-2022-b4-rank-aux
    (rows column columns-left)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix columns-left)))
  (if (zp columns-left)
      0
    (let ((pivot
           (putnam-2022-b4-find-pivot rows column)))
      (if (consp pivot)
          (+ 1
             (putnam-2022-b4-rank-aux
              (putnam-2022-b4-eliminate-column
               (putnam-2022-b4-remove-first-row
                pivot rows)
               pivot
               column)
              (+ column 1)
              (- columns-left 1)))
        (putnam-2022-b4-rank-aux
         rows (+ column 1) (- columns-left 1))))))

(defun putnam-2022-b4-rank (rows n)
  (putnam-2022-b4-rank-aux rows 0 n))

(defun putnam-2022-b4-difference-row-aux
    (remaining column left right)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix remaining)))
  (if (zp remaining)
      nil
    (cons
     (+ (if (equal column left) 1 0)
        (if (equal column right) -1 0))
     (putnam-2022-b4-difference-row-aux
      (- remaining 1)
      (+ column 1)
      left
      right))))

(defun putnam-2022-b4-difference-row (n left right)
  (putnam-2022-b4-difference-row-aux
   n 0 left right))

(defun putnam-2022-b4-separates-p
    (rows n left right base-rank)
  (< base-rank
     (putnam-2022-b4-rank
      (cons
       (putnam-2022-b4-difference-row
        n left right)
       rows)
      n)))

(defun putnam-2022-b4-all-pairs-separable-aux
    (rows n base-rank pair-code pairs-left)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix pairs-left)))
  (if (zp pairs-left)
      t
    (let ((left (floor (nfix pair-code) (nfix n)))
          (right (mod (nfix pair-code) (nfix n))))
      (and
       (or
        (not (< left right))
        (putnam-2022-b4-separates-p
         rows n left right base-rank))
       (putnam-2022-b4-all-pairs-separable-aux
        rows
        n
        base-rank
        (+ pair-code 1)
        (- pairs-left 1))))))

(defun putnam-2022-b4-all-pairs-separable-p (rows n)
  (putnam-2022-b4-all-pairs-separable-aux
   rows
   n
   (putnam-2022-b4-rank rows n)
   0
   (* (nfix n) (nfix n))))

(defun putnam-2022-b4-midpoint-choice-works-p
    (n choices-code)
  (putnam-2022-b4-all-pairs-separable-p
   (putnam-2022-b4-build-system n choices-code)
   n))

(defun putnam-2022-b4-exists-choice-aux
    (n choices-code choices-left)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix choices-left)))
  (if (zp choices-left)
      nil
    (or
     (putnam-2022-b4-midpoint-choice-works-p
      n choices-code)
     (putnam-2022-b4-exists-choice-aux
      n
      (+ choices-code 1)
      (- choices-left 1)))))

(defun putnam-2022-b4-cyclic-progression-exists-p (n)
  (putnam-2022-b4-exists-choice-aux
   n 0 (expt 3 (nfix n))))

(defun putnambench-putnam-2022-b4-statement (n)
  (implies
   (natp n)
   (iff
    (and
     (<= 4 n)
     (putnam-2022-b4-cyclic-progression-exists-p n))
    (and
     (<= 9 n)
     (equal (mod n 3) 0)))))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

title: putnam_2022_b4
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2022_b4
-- (putnambench__agda__putnam_2022_b4): classification of cyclic sequences of
-- distinct real numbers whose consecutive triples form three-term arithmetic
-- progressions. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module Putnam2022B4 where

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using
  (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; _*_; div-helper; mod-helper)

infix 4 _!=_ _<=N_
infixr 3 _and_
infixr 2 _or_

data Bottom : Set where

Not : Set -> Set
Not A =
  A -> Bottom

_!=_ : {A : Set} -> A -> A -> Set
x != y =
  Not (x == y)

record _and_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data _or_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  left  : A -> A or B
  right : B -> A or B

record Iff (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor equivalence
  field
    forward  : A -> B
    backward : B -> A

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

data _<=N_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set where
  zero<=N   : {n : Nat} -> zero <=N n
  suc<=sucN : {m n : Nat} -> m <=N n -> suc m <=N suc n

data Fin : Nat -> Set where
  fzero : {n : Nat} -> Fin (suc n)
  fsuc  : {n : Nat} -> Fin n -> Fin (suc n)

finToNat : {n : Nat} -> Fin n -> Nat
finToNat fzero =
  zero
finToNat (fsuc i) =
  suc (finToNat i)

naturalMod : Nat -> Nat -> Nat
naturalMod numerator zero =
  zero
naturalMod numerator (suc denominator) =
  mod-helper zero denominator numerator denominator

oneN : Nat
oneN =
  suc zero

twoN : Nat
twoN =
  suc oneN

threeN : Nat
threeN =
  suc twoN

fourN : Nat
fourN =
  suc threeN

nineN : Nat
nineN =
  suc (suc (suc (suc (suc fourN))))

record CompleteOrderedRealField (R : Set) : Set1 where
  field
    zeroR oneR : R
    add multiply : R -> R -> R
    negate inverse : R -> R
    lessOrEqual : R -> R -> Set
    fromNat : Nat -> R

    one-not-zero :
      oneR != zeroR

    add-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> add x y == add y x
    add-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      add (add x y) z == add x (add y z)
    add-zero :
      (x : R) -> add x zeroR == x
    add-inverse :
      (x : R) -> add x (negate x) == zeroR

    multiply-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> multiply x y == multiply y x
    multiply-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply (multiply x y) z ==
      multiply x (multiply y z)
    multiply-one :
      (x : R) -> multiply x oneR == x
    multiply-zero :
      (x : R) -> multiply x zeroR == zeroR
    distribute :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply x (add y z) ==
      add (multiply x y) (multiply x z)
    inverse-zero :
      inverse zeroR == zeroR
    multiply-inverse :
      (x : R) ->
      x != zeroR ->
      multiply x (inverse x) == oneR

    order-reflexive :
      (x : R) -> lessOrEqual x x
    order-transitive :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y z ->
      lessOrEqual x z
    order-antisymmetric :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y x ->
      x == y
    order-total :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y or lessOrEqual y x
    add-order :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual (add z x) (add z y)
    multiply-nonnegative :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR x ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR y ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR (multiply x y)
    zero-less-than-one :
      lessOrEqual zeroR oneR and zeroR != oneR

    fromNat-zero :
      fromNat zero == zeroR
    fromNat-successor :
      (n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (suc n) == add (fromNat n) oneR
    fromNat-addition :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m + n) == add (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-multiplication :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m * n) == multiply (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-injective :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat m == fromNat n ->
      m == n

    archimedean :
      (x : R) ->
      Exists Nat
        (\ n -> lessOrEqual x (fromNat n))
    least-upper-bound :
      (P : R -> Set) ->
      Exists R P ->
      Exists R
        (\ upper ->
          (x : R) ->
          P x ->
          lessOrEqual x upper) ->
      Exists R
        (\ supremum ->
          ((x : R) ->
            P x ->
            lessOrEqual x supremum)
          and
          ((upper : R) ->
            ((x : R) ->
              P x ->
              lessOrEqual x upper) ->
            lessOrEqual supremum upper))

open CompleteOrderedRealField

subtract :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
subtract reals x y =
  add reals x (negate reals y)

StrictLess :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
StrictLess reals x y =
  lessOrEqual reals x y and x != y

SameThreeElementSet :
  {R : Set} ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
SameThreeElementSet x0 x1 x2 y0 y1 y2 =
  (z : _) ->
  Iff
    ((z == x0) or ((z == x1) or (z == x2)))
    ((z == y0) or ((z == y1) or (z == y2)))

ThreeTermArithmeticProgression :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
ThreeTermArithmeticProgression {R} reals x0 x1 x2 =
  (o0 o1 o2 : R) ->
  (StrictLess reals o0 o1
    and
    (StrictLess reals o1 o2
      and
      SameThreeElementSet o0 o1 o2 x0 x1 x2)) ->
  subtract reals o1 o0 == subtract reals o2 o1

record CyclicProgression
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R)
  (n : Nat)
  (x : Nat -> R) :
  Set where

  field
    distinct :
      (i j : Fin n) ->
      finToNat i != finToNat j ->
      x (finToNat i) != x (finToNat j)

    consecutive-triples :
      (i : Fin n) ->
      ThreeTermArithmeticProgression reals
        (x (finToNat i))
        (x (naturalMod (finToNat i + oneN) n))
        (x (naturalMod (finToNat i + twoN) n))

Divides : Nat -> Nat -> Set
Divides divisor number =
  Exists Nat
    (\ quotient -> divisor * quotient == number)

putnam-2022-b4-solution : Nat -> Set
putnam-2022-b4-solution n =
  Divides threeN n and nineN <=N n

putnam-2022-b4 : Set1
putnam-2022-b4 =
  (R : Set) ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) ->
  (n : Nat) ->
  fourN <=N n ->
  Iff
    (Exists (Nat -> R)
      (\ x -> CyclicProgression reals n x))
    (putnam-2022-b4-solution n)

title: putnam_2022_b4
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2022_b4:
  cyclic sequences of distinct real numbers whose consecutive triples form
  three-term arithmetic progressions exist exactly for multiples of three at
  least nine. This file contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open arithmeticTheory dividesTheory pred_setTheory realTheory;

val putnam_2022_b4 =
  ``!n : num.
      4 <= n
      ==>
      let ap3 =
        \x0 x1 x2 : real.
          !o0 o1 o2 : real.
            o0 < o1 /\
            o1 < o2 /\
            {o0; o1; o2} = {x0; x1; x2}
            ==>
            o1 - o0 = o2 - o1
      in
      let xprog =
        \x : num -> real.
          (!i j : num.
             i < n /\ j < n /\ i <> j
             ==>
             x i <> x j) /\
          (!i : num.
             i < n
             ==>
             ap3 (x i) (x ((i + 1) MOD n)) (x ((i + 2) MOD n)))
      in
        ((?x : num -> real. xprog x) <=>
         9 <= n /\ divides 3 n)``;

title: putnam_2022_b4
content:
$(
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact
  putnam_2022_b4: classification of lengths of cyclic sequences of distinct
  real numbers whose consecutive triples form three-term arithmetic
  progressions when increasingly ordered. This file contains no proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  P22B4AP3 expands the source predicate ap3. For an increasing triple
  x < y < z, the six displayed alternatives say exactly that its underlying
  three-element set is { A, B, C }; the conclusion says that y is the
  arithmetic mean of its neighbors.

  P22B4XProg expands the source predicate xprog. RR ^m NN0 preserves the
  source's total real sequence, while 0 ..^ N is the Fin N index carrier.
  Pairwise distinctness is imposed on precisely those N entries, and mod N
  gives the two cyclic successor indices.

  Inlining these two predicates and the annotated solution set makes the
  final biconditional definitionally equivalent to the ground-truth theorem:
  under N >= 4, such a sequence exists exactly when 3 divides N and N >= 9.
  Every declaration is an unproved $a statement encoding; this database
  contains no $p proof declaration.
$)

$c P22B4AP3 P22B4XProg $.

p22b4-ap3-syntax $a wff ( P22B4AP3 A B C ) $.
p22b4-xprog-syntax $a wff ( P22B4XProg N A ) $.

${
  $d A B C x y z $.

  p22b4-ap3-definition $a |- (
    ( P22B4AP3 A B C )
    <->
    A. x e. RR A. y e. RR A. z e. RR
      (
        (
          (
            x < y
            /\
            y < z
          )
          /\
          (
            (
              (
                A = x
                /\
                B = y
              )
              /\
              C = z
            )
            \/
            (
              (
                A = x
                /\
                B = z
              )
              /\
              C = y
            )
            \/
            (
              (
                A = y
                /\
                B = x
              )
              /\
              C = z
            )
            \/
            (
              (
                A = y
                /\
                B = z
              )
              /\
              C = x
            )
            \/
            (
              (
                A = z
                /\
                B = x
              )
              /\
              C = y
            )
            \/
            (
              (
                A = z
                /\
                B = y
              )
              /\
              C = x
            )
          )
        )
        ->
        ( y - x ) = ( z - y )
      )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d A N i j $.

  p22b4-xprog-definition $a |- (
    ( P22B4XProg N A )
    <->
    (
      A. i e. ( 0 ..^ N )
        A. j e. ( 0 ..^ N )
          (
            i =/= j
            ->
            ( A ` i ) =/= ( A ` j )
          )
      /\
      A. i e. ( 0 ..^ N )
        (
          P22B4AP3
          ( A ` i )
          ( A ` ( ( i + 1 ) mod N ) )
          ( A ` ( ( i + 2 ) mod N ) )
        )
    )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d N x $.

  putnambench-putnam-2022-b4 $a |- A. N e. NN0
    (
      4 <_ N
      ->
      (
        E. x e. ( RR ^m NN0 )
          ( P22B4XProg N x )
        <->
        (
          3 || N
          /\
          9 <_ N
        )
      )
    )
  $.
$}

:: Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2022_b4
:: (putnambench__mizar__putnam_2022_b4): classification of lengths of cyclic

:: three-term arithmetic progressions. This file contains no proof.

environ

begin

::$P-
theorem
  for n being Nat st 4 <= n holds
    ((ex x being Function of NAT,REAL st
      (for i,j being Nat st
        i < n & j < n & i <> j

      (for i being Nat st i < n holds
        ex o0,o1,o2 being Real st

title: putnam_2022_b4
content:
% Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2022_b4:
% cyclic sequences of distinct real numbers whose consecutive triples form
% three-term arithmetic progressions exist exactly for multiples of three at
% least nine. This file contains no proof.

putnam_2022_b4: THEORY
BEGIN
  real_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> real]

  same_three_values(
      x0, x1, x2, o0, o1, o2: real): bool =
    FORALL (value: real):
      (value = x0 OR value = x1 OR value = x2)
        IFF
      (value = o0 OR value = o1 OR value = o2)

  three_term_arithmetic_progression(
      x0, x1, x2: real): bool =
    FORALL (o0, o1, o2: real):
      (o0 < o1
        AND o1 < o2
        AND same_three_values(x0, x1, x2, o0, o1, o2))
      IMPLIES
        o1 - o0 = o2 - o1

  cyclic_progression(
      n: posnat,
      x: real_sequence): bool =
    (FORALL (i, j: nat):
      (i < n AND j < n AND i /= j)
        IMPLIES x(i) /= x(j))
      AND
    (FORALL (i: nat):
      i < n IMPLIES
        three_term_arithmetic_progression(
          x(i),
          x(mod(i + 1, n)),
          x(mod(i + 2, n))))

  nat_divides(divisor, value: nat): bool =
    EXISTS (quotient: nat):
      value = divisor * quotient

  putnam_2022_b4_solution(n: nat): bool =
    n >= 9 AND nat_divides(3, n)

  putnam_2022_b4: bool =
    FORALL (n: nat):
      n >= 4 IMPLIES
        ((EXISTS (x: real_sequence):
            cyclic_progression(n, x))
          IFF putnam_2022_b4_solution(n))
END putnam_2022_b4

title: putnam_2022_b5
content:
import Mathlib

open Polynomial

abbrev putnam_2022_b5_solution : Set ℝ := sorry
-- Set.Icc 0 (1 / 4)
/--
For $0 \leq p \leq 1/2$, let $X_1,X_2,\dots$ be independent random variables such that
$X_i=\begin{cases}
1 & \text{with probability $p$,} \\
-1 & \text{with probability $p$,} \\
0 & \text{with probability $1-2p$,}
\end{cases}$
for all $i \geq 1$. Given a positive integer $n$ and integers $b,a_1,\dots,a_n$, let $P(b,a_1,\dots,a_n)$ denote the probability that $a_1X_1+\dots+a_nX_n=b$. For which values of $p$ is it the case that $P(0,a_1,\dots,a_n) \geq P(b,a_1,\dots,a_n)$ for all positive integers $n$ and all integers $b,a_1,\dots,a_n$?
-/
theorem putnam_2022_b5
(p : ℝ)
(Xset : (n : ℕ) → Set (Fin n → ℤ))
(Xprob : (n : ℕ) → (Fin n → ℤ) → ℝ)
(P : (n : ℕ) → ℤ → (Fin n → ℤ) → ℝ)
(hXset : ∀ n > 0, Xset n = {X : Fin n → ℤ | ∀ i : Fin n, X i = 1 ∨ X i = -1 ∨ X i = 0})
(hXprob : ∀ n > 0, ∀ X : Fin n → ℤ, Xprob n X = ∏ i : Fin n, if (X i = 1 ∨ X i = -1) then p else (1 - 2 * p))
(hP : ∀ n > 0, ∀ (b : ℤ) (a : Fin n → ℤ), P n b a = ∑' X : {X' ∈ Xset n | (∑ i : Fin n, a i * X' i) = b}, Xprob n X)
: (0 ≤ p ∧ p ≤ 1 / 2 ∧ (∀ n > 0, ∀ (b : ℤ) (a : Fin n → ℤ), P n 0 a ≥ P n b a)) ↔ p ∈ putnam_2022_b5_solution :=
sorry

title: putnam_2022_b5
content:
(* Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2022_b5:
   the parameters for which zero is a most likely value of every finite
   integer-weighted sum of independent {-1, 0, 1}-valued variables are exactly
   the real interval [0, 1/4]. This file contains no proof. *)

From Stdlib Require Import Reals ZArith Lists.List.

Import ListNotations.
Open Scope R_scope.

Fixpoint putnam_2022_b5_weighted_sum_probability
    (p : R)
    (coefficients : list Z)
    (target : Z) : R :=
  match coefficients with
  | [] =>
      if Z.eq_dec target 0%Z then 1 else 0
  | coefficient :: rest =>
      p *
        putnam_2022_b5_weighted_sum_probability
          p rest (target - coefficient)%Z
      + (1 - 2 * p) *
        putnam_2022_b5_weighted_sum_probability
          p rest target
      + p *
        putnam_2022_b5_weighted_sum_probability
          p rest (target + coefficient)%Z
  end.

Definition putnam_2022_b5_zero_is_most_likely
    (p : R) : Prop :=
  forall (n : nat) (coefficients : list Z),
    (0 < n)%nat ->
    length coefficients = n ->
    forall target : Z,
      putnam_2022_b5_weighted_sum_probability
        p coefficients 0%Z
      >=
      putnam_2022_b5_weighted_sum_probability
        p coefficients target.

Definition putnam_2022_b5_solution
    (p : R) : Prop :=
  0 <= p /\ p <= 1 / 4.

Theorem putnam_2022_b5 :
  forall p : R,
    (0 <= p /\
     p <= 1 / 2 /\
     putnam_2022_b5_zero_is_most_likely p) <->
    putnam_2022_b5_solution p.
Admitted.

title: putnam_2022_b5
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2022_b5:
;; the zero value has maximal probability for every finite integer linear
;; combination of independent {-1,0,1}-valued variables exactly when the
;; common probability p lies in [0,1/4]. This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))

;; This conservative generic symbol is an arbitrary rational regular Cauchy
;; name for the real parameter p. Regularity and all order assumptions remain
;; explicit below, so the symbol supplies no mathematical premise by itself.
(defstub putnam-2022-b5-p-approx (precision) t)

(defun putnam-2022-b5-positive-rational-p (value)
  (and
   (rationalp value)
   (< 0 value)))

;; At each positive rational precision the stub returns a rational
;; approximation. Pairwise regularity gives a unique real limit, and every
;; classical real admits such a rational regular Cauchy name.
(defun-sk putnam-2022-b5-real-name-p ()
  (forall (epsilon eta)
    (implies
     (and
      (putnam-2022-b5-positive-rational-p epsilon)
      (putnam-2022-b5-positive-rational-p eta))
     (let ((left (putnam-2022-b5-p-approx epsilon))
           (right (putnam-2022-b5-p-approx eta)))
       (and
        (rationalp left)
        (rationalp right)
        (<= (abs (- left right))
            (+ epsilon eta)))))))

;; For a regular name q, its limit is at least LOWER exactly when
;; LOWER <= q(epsilon)+epsilon for every positive rational epsilon.
(defun-sk putnam-2022-b5-real-at-least-p (lower)
  (forall (epsilon)
    (implies
     (putnam-2022-b5-positive-rational-p epsilon)
     (let ((value (putnam-2022-b5-p-approx epsilon)))
       (and
        (rationalp lower)
        (rationalp value)
        (<= lower (+ value epsilon)))))))

;; Dually, the limit is at most UPPER exactly when
;; q(epsilon) <= UPPER+epsilon for every positive rational epsilon.
(defun-sk putnam-2022-b5-real-at-most-p (upper)
  (forall (epsilon)
    (implies
     (putnam-2022-b5-positive-rational-p epsilon)
     (let ((value (putnam-2022-b5-p-approx epsilon)))
       (and
        (rationalp upper)
        (rationalp value)
        (<= value (+ upper epsilon)))))))

(defun putnam-2022-b5-integer-list-p (values)
  (if (consp values)
      (and
       (integerp (car values))
       (putnam-2022-b5-integer-list-p (cdr values)))
    (equal values nil)))

;; The source functions XSET, XPROB, and P are uniquely fixed by their
;; hypotheses. This recursive three-branch convolution is their definition:
;; X_i=1, 0, and -1 have respective weights p, 1-2p, and p.
(defun putnam-2022-b5-mass-value
    (p-value coefficients target)
  (if (consp coefficients)
      (let* ((coefficient (car coefficients))
             (rest (cdr coefficients))
             (zero-weight (- 1 (* 2 p-value))))
        (+
         (* p-value
            (putnam-2022-b5-mass-value
             p-value rest (- target coefficient)))
         (* zero-weight
            (putnam-2022-b5-mass-value
             p-value rest target))
         (* p-value
            (putnam-2022-b5-mass-value
             p-value rest (+ target coefficient)))))
    (if (equal target 0) 1 0)))

(defun putnam-2022-b5-error-scale (length)
  (* (+ (nfix length) 1)
     (expt 6 (+ (nfix length) 1))))

(defun putnam-2022-b5-comparison-precision
    (coefficients epsilon)
  (let ((candidate
         (/ epsilon
            (putnam-2022-b5-error-scale
             (len coefficients)))))
    (if (< candidate 1/4)
        candidate
      1/4)))

(defun putnam-2022-b5-mass
    (coefficients target epsilon)
  (let* ((precision
          (putnam-2022-b5-comparison-precision
           coefficients epsilon))
         (p-value
          (putnam-2022-b5-p-approx precision)))
    (putnam-2022-b5-mass-value
     p-value coefficients target)))

;; When 0 <= p <= 1/2, the selected precision gives a uniform error below
;; EPSILON for each finite mass. Thus the following comparison for every
;; positive EPSILON is equivalent to the exact inequality
;; P(0,a_1,...,a_n) >= P(b,a_1,...,a_n).
(defun-sk putnam-2022-b5-maximum-at-zero-p ()
  (forall (target coefficients epsilon)
    (implies
     (and
      (integerp target)
      (putnam-2022-b5-integer-list-p coefficients)
      (consp coefficients)
      (putnam-2022-b5-positive-rational-p epsilon))
     (let* ((precision
             (putnam-2022-b5-comparison-precision
              coefficients epsilon))
            (zero-mass
             (putnam-2022-b5-mass
              coefficients 0 epsilon))
            (target-mass
             (putnam-2022-b5-mass
              coefficients target epsilon)))
       (and
        (putnam-2022-b5-positive-rational-p precision)
        (rationalp zero-mass)
        (rationalp target-mass)
        (<= target-mass
            (+ zero-mass epsilon epsilon)))))))

;; The DEFSTUB is schematic, so this zero-arity predicate states the
;; characterization for an arbitrary represented real p.
(defun putnambench-putnam-2022-b5-statement ()
  (implies
   (putnam-2022-b5-real-name-p)
   (iff
    (and
     (putnam-2022-b5-real-at-least-p 0)
     (putnam-2022-b5-real-at-most-p 1/2)
     (putnam-2022-b5-maximum-at-zero-p))
    (and
     (putnam-2022-b5-real-at-least-p 0)
     (putnam-2022-b5-real-at-most-p 1/4)))))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

title: putnam_2022_b5
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2022_b5
-- (putnambench__agda__putnam_2022_b5): the parameters for which zero is a
-- most likely weighted sum of independent ternary random variables. This file
-- contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module Main where

open import Agda.Builtin.Bool using (Bool; false; true)
open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Int using (Int; pos; negsuc)
open import Agda.Builtin.List using (List; []; _∷_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; _*_)

infix 4 _!=_
infixr 5 _++_
infixr 3 _and_
infixr 2 _or_
infixl 6 _+Z_
infixl 7 _*Z_

data Bottom : Set where

Not : Set -> Set
Not A =
  A -> Bottom

_!=_ : {A : Set} -> A -> A -> Set
x != y =
  Not (x == y)

record _and_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data _or_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  left  : A -> A or B
  right : B -> A or B

record Iff (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor equivalence
  field
    forward  : A -> B
    backward : B -> A

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

data Positive : Nat -> Set where
  positive : {n : Nat} -> Positive (suc n)

record CompleteOrderedRealField (R : Set) : Set1 where
  field
    zeroR oneR : R
    add multiply : R -> R -> R
    negate inverse : R -> R
    lessOrEqual : R -> R -> Set
    fromNat : Nat -> R

    one-not-zero :
      oneR != zeroR

    add-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> add x y == add y x
    add-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      add (add x y) z == add x (add y z)
    add-zero :
      (x : R) -> add x zeroR == x
    add-inverse :
      (x : R) -> add x (negate x) == zeroR

    multiply-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> multiply x y == multiply y x
    multiply-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply (multiply x y) z ==
      multiply x (multiply y z)
    multiply-one :
      (x : R) -> multiply x oneR == x
    multiply-zero :
      (x : R) -> multiply x zeroR == zeroR
    distribute :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply x (add y z) ==
      add (multiply x y) (multiply x z)
    inverse-zero :
      inverse zeroR == zeroR
    multiply-inverse :
      (x : R) ->
      x != zeroR ->
      multiply x (inverse x) == oneR

    order-reflexive :
      (x : R) -> lessOrEqual x x
    order-transitive :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y z ->
      lessOrEqual x z
    order-antisymmetric :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y x ->
      x == y
    order-total :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y or lessOrEqual y x
    add-order :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual (add z x) (add z y)
    multiply-nonnegative :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR x ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR y ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR (multiply x y)
    zero-less-than-one :
      lessOrEqual zeroR oneR and zeroR != oneR

    fromNat-zero :
      fromNat zero == zeroR
    fromNat-successor :
      (n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (suc n) == add (fromNat n) oneR
    fromNat-addition :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m + n) == add (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-multiplication :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m * n) == multiply (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-injective :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat m == fromNat n ->
      m == n

    archimedean :
      (x : R) ->
      Exists Nat (\ n -> lessOrEqual x (fromNat n))
    least-upper-bound :
      (P : R -> Set) ->
      Exists R P ->
      Exists R
        (\ upper ->
          (x : R) ->
          P x ->
          lessOrEqual x upper) ->
      Exists R
        (\ supremum ->
          ((x : R) ->
            P x ->
            lessOrEqual x supremum)
          and
          ((upper : R) ->
            ((x : R) ->
              P x ->
              lessOrEqual x upper) ->
            lessOrEqual supremum upper))

open CompleteOrderedRealField

twoN : Nat
twoN =
  suc (suc zero)

fourN : Nat
fourN =
  suc (suc twoN)

negative : Nat -> Int
negative zero =
  pos zero
negative (suc n) =
  negsuc n

difference : Nat -> Nat -> Int
difference zero zero =
  pos zero
difference (suc m) zero =
  pos (suc m)
difference zero (suc n) =
  negsuc n
difference (suc m) (suc n) =
  difference m n

_+Z_ : Int -> Int -> Int
pos m +Z pos n =
  pos (m + n)
pos m +Z negsuc n =
  difference m (suc n)
negsuc m +Z pos n =
  difference n (suc m)
negsuc m +Z negsuc n =
  negsuc (suc (m + n))

_*Z_ : Int -> Int -> Int
pos m *Z pos n =
  pos (m * n)
pos m *Z negsuc n =
  negative (m * suc n)
negsuc m *Z pos n =
  negative (suc m * n)
negsuc m *Z negsuc n =
  pos (suc m * suc n)

zeroZ : Int
zeroZ =
  pos zero

oneZ : Int
oneZ =
  pos (suc zero)

negativeOneZ : Int
negativeOneZ =
  negsuc zero

natEqual : Nat -> Nat -> Bool
natEqual zero zero =
  true
natEqual zero (suc n) =
  false
natEqual (suc m) zero =
  false
natEqual (suc m) (suc n) =
  natEqual m n

intEqual : Int -> Int -> Bool
intEqual (pos m) (pos n) =
  natEqual m n
intEqual (pos m) (negsuc n) =
  false
intEqual (negsuc m) (pos n) =
  false
intEqual (negsuc m) (negsuc n) =
  natEqual m n

data Vector (A : Set) : Nat -> Set where
  []V  : Vector A zero
  _∷V_ : {n : Nat} -> A -> Vector A n -> Vector A (suc n)

infixr 5 _∷V_

IsTernary : Int -> Set
IsTernary x =
  (x == oneZ) or ((x == negativeOneZ) or (x == zeroZ))

data AllTernary : {n : Nat} -> Vector Int n -> Set where
  all-empty :
    AllTernary []V
  all-cons :
    {n : Nat} ->
    {x : Int} ->
    {xs : Vector Int n} ->
    IsTernary x ->
    AllTernary xs ->
    AllTernary (x ∷V xs)

_++_ : {A : Set} -> List A -> List A -> List A
[] ++ ys =
  ys
(x ∷ xs) ++ ys =
  x ∷ (xs ++ ys)

prependAll :
  {A : Set} ->
  {n : Nat} ->
  A ->
  List (Vector A n) ->
  List (Vector A (suc n))
prependAll x [] =
  []
prependAll x (xs ∷ xss) =
  (x ∷V xs) ∷ prependAll x xss

allTernaryVectors :
  (n : Nat) ->
  List (Vector Int n)
allTernaryVectors zero =
  []V ∷ []
allTernaryVectors (suc n) =
  prependAll negativeOneZ (allTernaryVectors n) ++
  prependAll zeroZ (allTernaryVectors n) ++
  prependAll oneZ (allTernaryVectors n)

dotProduct :
  {n : Nat} ->
  Vector Int n ->
  Vector Int n ->
  Int
dotProduct []V []V =
  zeroZ
dotProduct (a ∷V as) (x ∷V xs) =
  (a *Z x) +Z dotProduct as xs

subtract :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
subtract reals x y =
  add reals x (negate reals y)

divide :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
divide reals x y =
  multiply reals x (inverse reals y)

probabilityFactor :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  Int ->
  R
probabilityFactor reals p (pos zero) =
  subtract reals
    (oneR reals)
    (multiply reals (fromNat reals twoN) p)
probabilityFactor reals p (pos (suc zero)) =
  p
probabilityFactor reals p (pos (suc (suc n))) =
  subtract reals
    (oneR reals)
    (multiply reals (fromNat reals twoN) p)
probabilityFactor reals p (negsuc zero) =
  p
probabilityFactor reals p (negsuc (suc n)) =
  subtract reals
    (oneR reals)
    (multiply reals (fromNat reals twoN) p)

productProbability :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  {n : Nat} ->
  Vector Int n ->
  R
productProbability reals p []V =
  oneR reals
productProbability reals p (x ∷V xs) =
  multiply reals
    (probabilityFactor reals p x)
    (productProbability reals p xs)

sumMatching :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  {n : Nat} ->
  (Vector Int n -> R) ->
  Vector Int n ->
  Int ->
  List (Vector Int n) ->
  R
sumMatching reals probability coefficients target [] =
  zeroR reals
sumMatching reals probability coefficients target (x ∷ xs)
  with intEqual (dotProduct coefficients x) target
... | true =
  add reals
    (probability x)
    (sumMatching reals probability coefficients target xs)
... | false =
  sumMatching reals probability coefficients target xs

oneHalf :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R
oneHalf reals =
  divide reals
    (oneR reals)
    (fromNat reals twoN)

oneQuarter :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R
oneQuarter reals =
  divide reals
    (oneR reals)
    (fromNat reals fourN)

putnam-2022-b5 : Set1
putnam-2022-b5 =
  (R : Set) ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) ->
  (p : R) ->
  (Xset : (n : Nat) -> Vector Int n -> Set) ->
  (Xprob : (n : Nat) -> Vector Int n -> R) ->
  (P : (n : Nat) -> Int -> Vector Int n -> R) ->
  ((n : Nat) ->
    Positive n ->
    (X : Vector Int n) ->
    Iff (Xset n X) (AllTernary X)) ->
  ((n : Nat) ->
    Positive n ->
    (X : Vector Int n) ->
    Xprob n X == productProbability reals p X) ->
  ((n : Nat) ->
    Positive n ->
    (b : Int) ->
    (a : Vector Int n) ->
    P n b a ==
      sumMatching reals
        (Xprob n)
        a
        b
        (allTernaryVectors n)) ->
  Iff
    (lessOrEqual reals (zeroR reals) p
    and
    (lessOrEqual reals p (oneHalf reals)
    and
    ((n : Nat) ->
      Positive n ->
      (b : Int) ->
      (a : Vector Int n) ->
      lessOrEqual reals (P n b a) (P n zeroZ a))))
    (lessOrEqual reals (zeroR reals) p
    and
    lessOrEqual reals p (oneQuarter reals))

(*
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2022_b5:
  the parameters for which every integer linear combination of independent
  {-1, 0, 1}-valued variables is most likely to equal zero are exactly the
  real interval [0, 1/4]. This file contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open arithmeticTheory integerTheory listTheory pred_setTheory realTheory
     real_sigmaTheory;

val putnam_2022_b5 =
  ``!p : real.
    !Xset : num -> int list set.
    !Xprob : num -> int list -> real.
    !P : num -> int -> int list -> real.
      (!n : num.
         0 < n
         ==>
         Xset n =
           {X : int list |
              LENGTH X = n /\
              EVERY
                (\x : int. x = 1 \/ x = -1 \/ x = 0)
                X}) /\
      (!n : num. !X : int list.
         0 < n /\ LENGTH X = n
         ==>
         Xprob n X =
           REAL_PROD_IMAGE
             (\i : num.
                if EL i X = 1 \/ EL i X = -1
                then p
                else 1 - 2 * p)
             (count n)) /\
      (!n : num. !b : int. !a : int list.
         0 < n /\ LENGTH a = n
         ==>
         P n b a =
           REAL_SUM_IMAGE
             (Xprob n)
             {X : int list |
                X IN Xset n /\
                ITSET
                  (\i : num. \s : int. EL i a * EL i X + s)
                  (count n)
                  0 =
                b})
      ==>
      let putnam_2022_b5_solution =
        {q : real | 0 <= q /\ q <= 1 / 4}
      in
        ((0 <= p /\
          p <= 1 / 2 /\
          !n : num. !b : int. !a : int list.
            0 < n /\ LENGTH a = n
            ==>
            P n 0 a >= P n b a)
         <=>
         p IN putnam_2022_b5_solution)``;

  Inlining the source's definitionally constrained Xset, Xprob, and P
  therefore preserves its proposition. The right side inlines the
  intended solution set, the closed real interval from 0 to 1/4.

  The final declaration is the single unproved $a corpus statement;
  this database contains no $p proof statement.

${
  $d X a b i n p $.

  putnambench-putnam-2022-b5 $a |- A. p e. RR
    (
      (
        (
          0 <_ p
          /\

        )
        /\
        A. n e. NN
          A. b e. ZZ
            A. a e. ( ZZ ^m ( 1 ... n ) )
              (

                    X e.
                      (
                        { -u 1 , 0 , 1 }
                        ^m
                        ( 1 ... n )
                      )
                    |
                    (
                      sum_ i e. ( 1 ... n )
                        ( ( a ` i ) x. ( X ` i ) )
                    )
                    =
                    b
                  }
                  (
                    prod_ i e. ( 1 ... n )
                      if
                      (
                        (
                          ( X ` i ) = 1
                          \/
                          ( X ` i ) = -u 1
                        ) ,
                        p ,
                        ( 1 - ( 2 x. p ) )
                      )
                  )
                <_
                sum_ X e.
                  {
                    X e.
                      (
                        { -u 1 , 0 , 1 }
                        ^m
                        ( 1 ... n )
                      )
                    |
                    (
                      sum_ i e. ( 1 ... n )
                        ( ( a ` i ) x. ( X ` i ) )
                    )
                    =
                    0
                  }
                  (
                    prod_ i e. ( 1 ... n )
                      if
                      (
                        (
                          ( X ` i ) = 1
                          \/
                          ( X ` i ) = -u 1
                        ) ,
                        p ,
                        ( 1 - ( 2 x. p ) )
                      )
                  )
              )
      )
      <->
      p e. ( 0 [,] ( 1 / 4 ) )
    )
  $.
$}

:: Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2022_b5:
:: the parameters for which zero is a most probable value of every integer
:: linear combination of independent random variables taking -1, 0, and 1.
:: This file contains no proof.

environ

    FUNCT_2, PARTFUN1, FINSEQ_1, FINSEQ_2, FINSET_1, ORDINAL1,
    CARD_1, NUMBERS, XCMPLX_0, XREAL_0, XXREAL_0, NAT_1, INT_1,
    VALUED_0, VALUED_1, RVSUM_1, BINOP_2, MEMBERED, FRAENKEL;
  requirements BOOLE, SUBSET, NUMERALS, ARITHM, REAL;
  definitions TARSKI;
  equalities FINSEQ_1, RVSUM_1;
  expansions TARSKI, FINSEQ_1;

begin

::$P-
theorem
  for p being Real holds
    (0 <= p & p <= 1/2 &
      for n being Nat st 0 < n holds
        for a being FinSequence of INT, b being Integer st len a = n holds
          ex outcomes being one-to-one FinSequence of INT*,
             mass0,massb being FinSequence of REAL st
            rng outcomes =
              {x where x is FinSequence of INT :
                len x = n &
                (for i being Nat st i in Seg n holds
                  x.i = 1 or x.i = -1 or x.i = 0)} &
            len mass0 = len outcomes &
            len massb = len outcomes &
            (for k being Nat st k in dom outcomes holds
              ex x,dotterms being FinSequence of INT,

                 (Sum dotterms <> 0 & mass0.k = 0)) &
                ((Sum dotterms = b & massb.k = Product factors) or
                 (Sum dotterms <> b & massb.k = 0))) &
            Sum mass0 >= Sum massb)
    iff
      0 <= p & p <= 1/4
proof
end;

title: putnam_2022_b5
content:
% Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2022_b5:
% the parameters for which zero is a most likely value of every finite
% integer-weighted sum of independent {-1, 0, 1}-valued variables are exactly
% the real interval [0, 1/4]. This file contains no proof.

putnam_2022_b5: THEORY
BEGIN
  integer_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> int]

  weighted_sum_probability(
      p: real,
      coefficients: integer_sequence,
      n: nat,
      target: int): RECURSIVE real =
    IF n = 0 THEN
      IF target = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 ENDIF
    ELSE
      p * weighted_sum_probability(
        p, coefficients, n - 1, target - coefficients(n - 1))
        + (1 - 2 * p) * weighted_sum_probability(
          p, coefficients, n - 1, target)
        + p * weighted_sum_probability(
          p, coefficients, n - 1, target + coefficients(n - 1))
    ENDIF
  MEASURE n

  zero_is_most_likely(p: real): bool =
    FORALL
        (n: nat),
        (target: int),
        (coefficients: integer_sequence):
      n > 0 IMPLIES
        weighted_sum_probability(p, coefficients, n, 0)
          >= weighted_sum_probability(
            p, coefficients, n, target)

  putnam_2022_b5_solution(p: real): bool =
    0 <= p AND p <= 1 / 4

  putnam_2022_b5: bool =
    FORALL (p: real):
      (0 <= p
        AND p <= 1 / 2
        AND zero_is_most_likely(p))
      IFF putnam_2022_b5_solution(p)
END putnam_2022_b5

import Mathlib

open Polynomial

-- Note: uses (ℝ → ℝ) instead of (Rpos → Rpos) to check the equality property
abbrev putnam_2022_b6_solution : Set (Set.Ioi (0 : ℝ) → Set.Ioi (0 : ℝ)) := sorry
-- {f : Set.Ioi (0 : ℝ) → Set.Ioi (0 : ℝ) | ∃ c : ℝ, c ≥ 0 ∧ ∀ x : Set.Ioi (0 : ℝ), f x = 1 / (1 + c * x)}
/--
Find all continuous functions $f:\mathbb{R}^+ \to \mathbb{R}^+$ such that $f(xf(y))+f(yf(x))=1+f(x+y)$ for all $x,y>0$.
-/
theorem putnam_2022_b6
  (f : Set.Ioi (0 : ℝ) → Set.Ioi (0 : ℝ))
  (hf : Continuous f) :
  (∃ fr : ℝ → ℝ, (∀ x : Set.Ioi (0 : ℝ), fr x = f x) ∧ (∀ x y : Set.Ioi (0 : ℝ), fr (x * fr y) + fr (y * fr x) = 1 + fr (x + y)))
  ↔ f ∈ putnam_2022_b6_solution :=
sorry

title: putnam_2022_b6

Require Import Reals.
Open Scope R.

Definition putnam_2022_b6_solution (f : R -> R) : Prop :=
  exists c : R,
    c >= 0 /\
    forall x : R, x > 0 -> f x = 1 / (1 + c * x).

Theorem putnam_2022_b6
    (f : R -> R)
    (hpos : forall x : R, x > 0 -> f x > 0)
    (hcont : forall x : R, x > 0 -> continuity_pt f x)
    : (forall x y : R,
        x > 0 ->
        y > 0 ->
        f (x * f y) + f (y * f x) = 1 + f (x + y)) <->
      putnam_2022_b6_solution f.
Proof. Admitted.

theory putnam_2022_b6 imports Complex_Main
begin

(* Total real functions model maps on the positive reals; all constraints are restricted to that domain. *)
definition putnam_2022_b6_solution :: "(real \<Rightarrow> real) set" where
  "putnam_2022_b6_solution =
    {f. \<exists>c::real. c \<ge> 0 \<and> (\<forall>x>0. f x = 1 / (1 + c * x))}"
theorem putnam_2022_b6:
  fixes f :: "real \<Rightarrow> real"
  and eq :: bool
  assumes heq: "eq = (\<forall>x::real>0. \<forall>y::real>0. f (x*f y) + f (y*f x) = 1 + f (x+y))"
  shows "(continuous_on {0<..} f \<and> (\<forall>x>0. f x > 0) \<and> eq)
    \<longleftrightarrow> f \<in> putnam_2022_b6_solution"
  sorry

end

(*
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2022_b6
  (putnambench__hol-light__putnam_2022_b6): classification of continuous
  positive-real-valued functions on the positive reals satisfying the stated
  functional equation. This file contains no proof.
*)

let statement =
  `let continuous_on_positive =
     \(f:real->real).
       !x:real.
         &0 < x
         ==> !e:real.
               &0 < e
               ==> ?d:real.
                     &0 < d /\
                     !y:real.
                       &0 < y /\ abs (y - x) < d
                       ==> abs (f y - f x) < e in
   let satisfies_equation =
     \(f:real->real).
       !x y:real.
         &0 < x /\ &0 < y
         ==>
         f (x * f y) + f (y * f x) = &1 + f (x + y) in
   let is_solution =
     \(f:real->real).
       ?c:real.
         &0 <= c /\
         !x:real.
           &0 < x ==> f x = &1 / (&1 + c * x) in
   !f:real->real.
     (!x:real. &0 < x ==> &0 < f x) /\
     continuous_on_positive f
     ==>
     (satisfies_equation f <=> is_solution f)`;;

title: putnam_2022_b6
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2022_b6:
;; classification of continuous positive-real functions satisfying the stated
;; two-variable functional equation as f(x)=1/(1+c*x) for some c>=0. This file
;; contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))

;; Reals are represented by rational regular Cauchy names, and f is an
;; extensional ACL2 function object on positive-real names. FN-EQUAL supplies
;; unbounded universal quantification over names. Negated FN-EQUAL keeps the
;; coefficient c and each continuity delta internal.
;;
;; Continuity is stated using positive rational epsilon and delta. This is
;; equivalent to the usual real epsilon-delta definition by density of the
;; rationals. The solution equation is written as
;;
;;   (1+c*x)*f(x)=1,
;;
;; which is equivalent to f(x)=1/(1+c*x), since c>=0 and x>0 make the factor
;; 1+c*x strictly positive.

(defun putnam-2022-b6-quoted (object)
  (list 'quote object))

(defun putnam-2022-b6-term-list (terms)
  (if (consp terms)
      (list 'cons
            (car terms)
            (putnam-2022-b6-term-list (cdr terms)))
    nil))

(defun putnam-2022-b6-apply-term (function arguments)
  (list 'apply$
        (putnam-2022-b6-quoted function)
        (putnam-2022-b6-term-list arguments)))

(defun putnam-2022-b6-apply-object-term
    (function-term arguments)
  (list 'apply$
        function-term
        (putnam-2022-b6-term-list arguments)))

(defun putnam-2022-b6-and-terms (terms)
  (if (consp terms)
      (list 'if
            (car terms)
            (putnam-2022-b6-and-terms (cdr terms))
            (putnam-2022-b6-quoted nil))
    (putnam-2022-b6-quoted t)))

(defun putnam-2022-b6-implies-term (hypothesis conclusion)
  (list 'if
        hypothesis
        conclusion
        (putnam-2022-b6-quoted t)))

(defun putnam-2022-b6-add-term (left right)
  (list 'binary-+ left right))

(defun putnam-2022-b6-negate-term (value)
  (list 'unary-- value))

(defun putnam-2022-b6-subtract-term (left right)
  (putnam-2022-b6-add-term
   left
   (putnam-2022-b6-negate-term right)))

(defun putnam-2022-b6-multiply-term (left right)
  (list 'binary-* left right))

(defun putnam-2022-b6-divide-term (numerator denominator)
  (putnam-2022-b6-multiply-term
   numerator
   (list 'unary-/ denominator)))

(defun putnam-2022-b6-absolute-term (value)
  (list 'if
        (list '< value (putnam-2022-b6-quoted 0))
        (putnam-2022-b6-negate-term value)
        value))

(defun putnam-2022-b6-less-equal-term (left right)
  (list 'if
        (list '< right left)
        (putnam-2022-b6-quoted nil)
        (putnam-2022-b6-quoted t)))

(defun putnam-2022-b6-positive-rational-term (value)
  (putnam-2022-b6-and-terms
   (list
    (list 'rationalp value)
    (list '< (putnam-2022-b6-quoted 0) value))))

(defun putnam-2022-b6-true-function (formals)
  (list 'lambda
        formals
        (putnam-2022-b6-quoted t)))

(defun putnam-2022-b6-real-value-term (name precision)
  (putnam-2022-b6-apply-term name (list precision)))

(defun putnam-2022-b6-object-real-value-term
    (name-term precision)
  (putnam-2022-b6-apply-object-term
   name-term
   (list precision)))

(defun putnam-2022-b6-real-cauchy-function (name)
  (let* ((left
          (putnam-2022-b6-real-value-term name 'epsilon))
         (right
          (putnam-2022-b6-real-value-term name 'eta))
         (distance
          (putnam-2022-b6-absolute-term
           (putnam-2022-b6-subtract-term left right))))
    (list
     'lambda
     '(epsilon eta)
     (putnam-2022-b6-implies-term
      (putnam-2022-b6-and-terms
       (list
        (putnam-2022-b6-positive-rational-term 'epsilon)
        (putnam-2022-b6-positive-rational-term 'eta)))
      (putnam-2022-b6-and-terms
       (list
        (list 'rationalp left)
        (list 'rationalp right)
        (putnam-2022-b6-less-equal-term
         distance
         (putnam-2022-b6-add-term
          'epsilon 'eta))))))))

(defun putnam-2022-b6-real-name-p (name)
  (and
   (tamep-functionp name)
   (fn-equal
    (putnam-2022-b6-real-cauchy-function name)
    (putnam-2022-b6-true-function
     '(epsilon eta)))))

(defun putnam-2022-b6-real-distance-function
    (left-name right-name bound)
  (let* ((precision
          (putnam-2022-b6-multiply-term 1/4 'eta))
         (left
          (putnam-2022-b6-real-value-term
           left-name precision))
         (right
          (putnam-2022-b6-real-value-term
           right-name precision))
         (distance
          (putnam-2022-b6-absolute-term
           (putnam-2022-b6-subtract-term left right))))
    (list
     'lambda
     '(eta)
     (putnam-2022-b6-implies-term
      (putnam-2022-b6-positive-rational-term 'eta)
      (putnam-2022-b6-and-terms
       (list
        (list 'rationalp left)
        (list 'rationalp right)
        (putnam-2022-b6-less-equal-term
         distance
         (putnam-2022-b6-add-term
          (putnam-2022-b6-quoted bound)
          'eta))))))))

(defun putnam-2022-b6-real-distance-at-most-p
    (left-name right-name bound)
  (and
   (rationalp bound)
   (putnam-2022-b6-real-name-p left-name)
   (putnam-2022-b6-real-name-p right-name)
   (fn-equal
    (putnam-2022-b6-real-distance-function
     left-name right-name bound)
    (putnam-2022-b6-true-function '(eta)))))

(defun putnam-2022-b6-real-equal-p
    (left-name right-name)
  (putnam-2022-b6-real-distance-at-most-p
   left-name right-name 0))

(defun putnam-2022-b6-real-order-function
    (left-name right-name)
  (let* ((precision
          (putnam-2022-b6-multiply-term 1/4 'eta))
         (left
          (putnam-2022-b6-real-value-term
           left-name precision))
         (right
          (putnam-2022-b6-real-value-term
           right-name precision)))
    (list
     'lambda
     '(eta)
     (putnam-2022-b6-implies-term
      (putnam-2022-b6-positive-rational-term 'eta)
      (putnam-2022-b6-and-terms
       (list
        (list 'rationalp left)
        (list 'rationalp right)
        (putnam-2022-b6-less-equal-term
         left
         (putnam-2022-b6-add-term
          right 'eta))))))))

(defun putnam-2022-b6-real-le-p
    (left-name right-name)
  (and
   (putnam-2022-b6-real-name-p left-name)
   (putnam-2022-b6-real-name-p right-name)
   (fn-equal
    (putnam-2022-b6-real-order-function
     left-name right-name)
    (putnam-2022-b6-true-function '(eta)))))

(defun putnam-2022-b6-real-lt-p
    (left-name right-name)
  (and
   (putnam-2022-b6-real-le-p left-name right-name)
   (not
    (putnam-2022-b6-real-equal-p
     left-name right-name))))

(defun putnam-2022-b6-rational-name (value)
  (list 'lambda
        '(precision)
        (putnam-2022-b6-quoted value)))

(defun putnam-2022-b6-add-name (left-name right-name)
  (let* ((precision
          (putnam-2022-b6-multiply-term 1/2 'epsilon))
         (left
          (putnam-2022-b6-object-real-value-term
           (putnam-2022-b6-quoted left-name)
           precision))
         (right
          (putnam-2022-b6-object-real-value-term
           (putnam-2022-b6-quoted right-name)
           precision)))
    (list
     'lambda
     '(epsilon)
     (putnam-2022-b6-add-term left right))))

(defun putnam-2022-b6-negate-name (name)
  (let ((value
         (putnam-2022-b6-object-real-value-term
          (putnam-2022-b6-quoted name)
          'epsilon)))
    (list
     'lambda
     '(epsilon)
     (putnam-2022-b6-negate-term value))))

(defun putnam-2022-b6-subtract-name
    (left-name right-name)
  (putnam-2022-b6-add-name
   left-name
   (putnam-2022-b6-negate-name right-name)))

(defun putnam-2022-b6-absolute-name (name)
  (let ((value
         (putnam-2022-b6-object-real-value-term
          (putnam-2022-b6-quoted name)
          'epsilon)))
    (list
     'lambda
     '(epsilon)
     (putnam-2022-b6-absolute-term value))))

(defun putnam-2022-b6-distance-name
    (left-name right-name)
  (putnam-2022-b6-absolute-name
   (putnam-2022-b6-subtract-name
    left-name right-name)))

(defun putnam-2022-b6-multiply-name
    (left-name right-name)
  (let* ((left-at-one
          (putnam-2022-b6-object-real-value-term
           (putnam-2022-b6-quoted left-name)
           1))
         (right-at-one
          (putnam-2022-b6-object-real-value-term
           (putnam-2022-b6-quoted right-name)
           1))
         (scale
          (putnam-2022-b6-multiply-term
           8
           (putnam-2022-b6-add-term
            3
            (putnam-2022-b6-add-term
             (putnam-2022-b6-absolute-term left-at-one)
             (putnam-2022-b6-absolute-term right-at-one)))))
         (candidate
          (putnam-2022-b6-divide-term
           'epsilon scale))
         (precision
          (list 'if
                (list '< 1 candidate)
                1
                candidate))
         (left
          (putnam-2022-b6-object-real-value-term
           (putnam-2022-b6-quoted left-name)
           precision))
         (right
          (putnam-2022-b6-object-real-value-term
           (putnam-2022-b6-quoted right-name)
           precision)))
    (list
     'lambda
     '(epsilon)
     (putnam-2022-b6-multiply-term left right))))

(defun putnam-2022-b6-positive-real-p (name)
  (putnam-2022-b6-real-lt-p
   (putnam-2022-b6-rational-name 0)
   name))

(defun putnam-2022-b6-positive-function-output-function
    (function)
  (let ((output
         (putnam-2022-b6-apply-term function '(x))))
    (list
     'lambda
     '(x)
     (putnam-2022-b6-implies-term
      (list 'putnam-2022-b6-positive-real-p 'x)
      (list 'putnam-2022-b6-positive-real-p output)))))

(defun putnam-2022-b6-positive-function-extensional-function
    (function)
  (let ((left-output
         (putnam-2022-b6-apply-term
          function '(left)))
        (right-output
         (putnam-2022-b6-apply-term
          function '(right))))
    (list
     'lambda
     '(left right)
     (putnam-2022-b6-implies-term
      (putnam-2022-b6-and-terms
       (list
        (list 'putnam-2022-b6-positive-real-p 'left)
        (list 'putnam-2022-b6-positive-real-p 'right)
        (list 'putnam-2022-b6-real-equal-p
              'left 'right)))
      (list 'putnam-2022-b6-real-equal-p
            left-output right-output)))))

(defun putnam-2022-b6-positive-function-p (function)
  (and
   (tamep-functionp function)
   (fn-equal
    (putnam-2022-b6-positive-function-output-function
     function)
    (putnam-2022-b6-true-function '(x)))
   (fn-equal
    (putnam-2022-b6-positive-function-extensional-function
     function)
    (putnam-2022-b6-true-function
     '(left right)))))

(defun putnam-2022-b6-functional-equation-function
    (function)
  (let* ((fx
          (putnam-2022-b6-apply-term function '(x)))
         (fy
          (putnam-2022-b6-apply-term function '(y)))
         (x-times-fy
          (list 'putnam-2022-b6-multiply-name 'x fy))
         (y-times-fx
          (list 'putnam-2022-b6-multiply-name 'y fx))
         (at-x-times-fy
          (putnam-2022-b6-apply-term
           function (list x-times-fy)))
         (at-y-times-fx
          (putnam-2022-b6-apply-term
           function (list y-times-fx)))
         (at-x-plus-y
          (putnam-2022-b6-apply-term
           function
           (list
            (list 'putnam-2022-b6-add-name 'x 'y))))
         (left
          (list 'putnam-2022-b6-add-name
                at-x-times-fy at-y-times-fx))
         (right
          (list
           'putnam-2022-b6-add-name
           (putnam-2022-b6-quoted
            (putnam-2022-b6-rational-name 1))
           at-x-plus-y)))
    (list
     'lambda

-- Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2022_b6
-- (putnambench__agda__putnam_2022_b6): classification of the continuous
-- positive-real functions satisfying the stated two-variable functional
-- equation. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module Putnam2022B6 where

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; _*_)

infix 4 _!=_
infixr 3 _and_
infixr 2 _or_

data Bottom : Set where

Not : Set -> Set
Not A =
  A -> Bottom

_!=_ : {A : Set} -> A -> A -> Set
x != y =
  Not (x == y)

record _and_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data _or_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  left  : A -> A or B
  right : B -> A or B

record Iff (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor equivalence
  field
    forward  : A -> B
    backward : B -> A

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

record CompleteOrderedRealField (R : Set) : Set1 where
  field
    zeroR oneR : R
    add multiply : R -> R -> R
    negate inverse : R -> R
    lessOrEqual : R -> R -> Set
    fromNat : Nat -> R

    one-not-zero :
      oneR != zeroR

    add-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> add x y == add y x
    add-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      add (add x y) z == add x (add y z)
    add-zero :
      (x : R) -> add x zeroR == x
    add-inverse :
      (x : R) -> add x (negate x) == zeroR

    multiply-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> multiply x y == multiply y x
    multiply-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply (multiply x y) z ==
      multiply x (multiply y z)
    multiply-one :
      (x : R) -> multiply x oneR == x
    multiply-zero :
      (x : R) -> multiply x zeroR == zeroR
    distribute :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply x (add y z) ==
      add (multiply x y) (multiply x z)
    inverse-zero :
      inverse zeroR == zeroR
    multiply-inverse :
      (x : R) ->
      x != zeroR ->
      multiply x (inverse x) == oneR

    order-reflexive :
      (x : R) -> lessOrEqual x x
    order-transitive :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y z ->
      lessOrEqual x z
    order-antisymmetric :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y x ->
      x == y
    order-total :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y or lessOrEqual y x
    add-order :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual (add z x) (add z y)
    multiply-nonnegative :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR x ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR y ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR (multiply x y)
    zero-less-than-one :
      lessOrEqual zeroR oneR and zeroR != oneR

    fromNat-zero :
      fromNat zero == zeroR
    fromNat-successor :
      (n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (suc n) == add (fromNat n) oneR
    fromNat-addition :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m + n) == add (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-multiplication :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m * n) == multiply (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-injective :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat m == fromNat n ->
      m == n

    archimedean :
      (x : R) ->
      Exists Nat (\ n -> lessOrEqual x (fromNat n))
    least-upper-bound :
      (P : R -> Set) ->
      Exists R P ->
      Exists R
        (\ upper ->
          (x : R) ->
          P x ->
          lessOrEqual x upper) ->
      Exists R
        (\ supremum ->
          ((x : R) ->
            P x ->
            lessOrEqual x supremum)
          and
          ((upper : R) ->
            ((x : R) ->
              P x ->
              lessOrEqual x upper) ->
            lessOrEqual supremum upper))

open CompleteOrderedRealField

subtract :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
subtract reals x y =
  add reals x (negate reals y)

divide :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
divide reals x y =
  multiply reals x (inverse reals y)

StrictLess :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
StrictLess reals x y =
  lessOrEqual reals x y and x != y

Positive :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  Set
Positive reals x =
  StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) x

maximum :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
maximum reals x y with order-total reals x y
... | left _ =
  y
... | right _ =
  x

absoluteValue :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R
absoluteValue reals x =
  maximum reals x (negate reals x)

Distance :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
Distance reals x y =
  absoluteValue reals (subtract reals x y)

MapsPositiveToPositive :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (R -> R) ->
  Set
MapsPositiveToPositive {R} reals f =
  (x : R) ->
  Positive reals x ->
  Positive reals (f x)

ContinuousOnPositive :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (R -> R) ->
  Set
ContinuousOnPositive {R} reals f =
  (point : R) ->
  Positive reals point ->
  (epsilon : R) ->
  Positive reals epsilon ->
  Exists R
    (\ delta ->
      Positive reals delta
      and
      ((x : R) ->
        Positive reals x ->
        StrictLess reals
          (Distance reals x point)
          delta ->
        StrictLess reals
          (Distance reals (f x) (f point))
          epsilon))

FunctionalEquation :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (R -> R) ->
  Set
FunctionalEquation {R} reals f =
  (x y : R) ->
  Positive reals x ->
  Positive reals y ->
  add reals
    (f (multiply reals x (f y)))
    (f (multiply reals y (f x)))
  ==
  add reals
    (oneR reals)
    (f (add reals x y))

SatisfiesConditions :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (R -> R) ->
  Set
SatisfiesConditions reals f =
  MapsPositiveToPositive reals f
  and
  ContinuousOnPositive reals f
  and
  FunctionalEquation reals f

HasSolutionForm :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (R -> R) ->
  Set
HasSolutionForm {R} reals f =
  Exists R
    (\ c ->
      lessOrEqual reals (zeroR reals) c
      and
      ((x : R) ->
        Positive reals x ->
        f x ==
        divide reals
          (oneR reals)
          (add reals
            (oneR reals)
            (multiply reals c x))))

putnam-2022-b6 : Set1
putnam-2022-b6 =
  (R : Set) ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) ->
  (f : R -> R) ->
  Iff
    (SatisfiesConditions reals f)
    (HasSolutionForm reals f)

title: putnam_2022_b6
content:
% Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2022_b6
% (putnambench__pvs__putnam_2022_b6): classification of continuous
% positive-real-valued functions on the positive reals satisfying the stated
% two-variable functional equation. This file contains no proof.

putnam_2022_b6: THEORY
BEGIN
  real_function: TYPE = [real -> real]

  safe_div(numerator, denominator: real): real =
    IF denominator = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      numerator / denominator
    ENDIF

  positive_on_positive_reals(f: real_function): bool =
    FORALL (x: real):
      x > 0 IMPLIES f(x) > 0

  continuous_on_positive_reals(f: real_function): bool =
    FORALL (x: real):
      x > 0 IMPLIES
        FORALL (epsilon_value: posreal):
          EXISTS (delta: posreal):
            FORALL (y: real):
              (y > 0 AND abs(y - x) < delta)
                IMPLIES
                  abs(f(y) - f(x)) < epsilon_value

  satisfies_functional_equation(f: real_function): bool =
    FORALL (x, y: real):
      (x > 0 AND y > 0)
        IMPLIES
          f(x * f(y)) + f(y * f(x)) = 1 + f(x + y)

  has_solution_form(f: real_function): bool =
    EXISTS (c: real):
      c >= 0
        AND FORALL (x: real):
          x > 0 IMPLIES
            f(x) = safe_div(1, 1 + c * x)

  putnam_2022_b6: bool =
    FORALL (f: real_function):
      (positive_on_positive_reals(f)
        AND continuous_on_positive_reals(f)
        AND satisfies_functional_equation(f))
      IFF has_solution_form(f)
END putnam_2022_b6

-- 18
/--
For a positive integer $n$, let $f_n(x) = \cos(x) \cos(2x) \cos(3x) \cdots \cos(nx)$. Find the smallest $n$ such that $|f_n''(0)| > 2023$.
-/
theorem putnam_2023_a1
  (f : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ)
  (hf : ∀ n > 0, f n = fun x : ℝ => ∏ i ∈ Finset.Icc 1 n, Real.cos (i * x)) :
  IsLeast {n | 0 < n ∧ |iteratedDeriv 2 (f n) 0| > 2023} putnam_2023_a1_solution :=
sorry

;; Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2023_a1:
;; the least positive n for which the second derivative at zero of
;; product_{i=1}^n cos(i*x) has absolute value greater than 2023 is 18.
;; This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))

;; A pair (a . b) represents the exact degree-two even Taylor jet
;; a + b*x^2.  Since cos(i*x) = 1 - i^2*x^2/2 + O(x^4), multiplying these
;; jets gives the constant and quadratic coefficients of the full cosine
;; product exactly.  Its second derivative at zero is twice the quadratic
;; coefficient.  Thus this finite jet is an exact representation of the

title: putnam_2023_a1
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2023_a1
-- (putnambench__agda__putnam_2023_a1): 18 is the least positive index whose
-- cosine product has second derivative at zero of absolute value above 2023.
-- This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module Putnam2023A1 where

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; _*_)

infix 4 _!=_ _<=N_
infixr 3 _and_
infixr 2 _or_

data Bottom : Set where

Not : Set -> Set
Not A =
  A -> Bottom

_!=_ : {A : Set} -> A -> A -> Set
x != y =
  Not (x == y)

record _and_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data _or_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  left  : A -> A or B
  right : B -> A or B

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

data _<=N_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set where
  zero<=N   : {n : Nat} -> zero <=N n
  suc<=sucN : {m n : Nat} -> m <=N n -> suc m <=N suc n

record CompleteOrderedRealField (R : Set) : Set1 where
  field
    zeroR oneR : R
    add multiply : R -> R -> R
    negate inverse : R -> R
    lessOrEqual : R -> R -> Set
    fromNat : Nat -> R

    one-not-zero :
      oneR != zeroR

    add-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> add x y == add y x
    add-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      add (add x y) z == add x (add y z)
    add-zero :
      (x : R) -> add x zeroR == x
    add-inverse :
      (x : R) -> add x (negate x) == zeroR

    multiply-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> multiply x y == multiply y x
    multiply-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply (multiply x y) z ==
      multiply x (multiply y z)
    multiply-one :
      (x : R) -> multiply x oneR == x
    multiply-zero :
      (x : R) -> multiply x zeroR == zeroR
    distribute :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply x (add y z) ==
      add (multiply x y) (multiply x z)
    inverse-zero :
      inverse zeroR == zeroR
    multiply-inverse :
      (x : R) ->
      x != zeroR ->
      multiply x (inverse x) == oneR

    order-reflexive :
      (x : R) -> lessOrEqual x x
    order-transitive :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y z ->
      lessOrEqual x z
    order-antisymmetric :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y x ->
      x == y
    order-total :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y or lessOrEqual y x
    add-order :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual (add z x) (add z y)
    multiply-nonnegative :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR x ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR y ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR (multiply x y)
    zero-less-than-one :
      lessOrEqual zeroR oneR and zeroR != oneR

    fromNat-zero :
      fromNat zero == zeroR
    fromNat-successor :
      (n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (suc n) == add (fromNat n) oneR
    fromNat-addition :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m + n) == add (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-multiplication :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m * n) == multiply (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-injective :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat m == fromNat n ->
      m == n

    archimedean :
      (x : R) ->
      Exists Nat
        (\ n -> lessOrEqual x (fromNat n))
    least-upper-bound :
      (P : R -> Set) ->
      Exists R P ->
      Exists R
        (\ upper ->
          (x : R) ->
          P x ->
          lessOrEqual x upper) ->
      Exists R
        (\ supremum ->
          ((x : R) ->
            P x ->
            lessOrEqual x supremum)
          and
          ((upper : R) ->
            ((x : R) ->
              P x ->
              lessOrEqual x upper) ->
            lessOrEqual supremum upper))

open CompleteOrderedRealField

subtract :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
subtract reals x y =
  add reals x (negate reals y)

divide :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
divide reals x y =
  multiply reals x (inverse reals y)

StrictLess :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
StrictLess reals x y =
  lessOrEqual reals x y and x != y

AbsoluteLess :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
AbsoluteLess reals x bound =
  StrictLess reals (negate reals bound) x
  and
  StrictLess reals x bound

AbsoluteGreater :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
AbsoluteGreater reals x bound =
  StrictLess reals bound x
  or
  StrictLess reals x (negate reals bound)

ConvergesTo :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  R ->
  Set
ConvergesTo {R} reals sequence limit =
  (epsilon : R) ->
  StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) epsilon ->
  Exists Nat
    (\ cutoff ->
      (n : Nat) ->
      cutoff <=N n ->
      AbsoluteLess reals
        (subtract reals (sequence n) limit)
        epsilon)

naturalPower :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  Nat ->
  R
naturalPower reals x zero =
  oneR reals
naturalPower reals x (suc n) =
  multiply reals
    (naturalPower reals x n)
    x

factorial : Nat -> Nat
factorial zero =
  suc zero
factorial (suc n) =
  suc n * factorial n

sumFirst :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Nat ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  R
sumFirst reals zero terms =
  zeroR reals
sumFirst reals (suc n) terms =
  add reals
    (sumFirst reals n terms)
    (terms n)

alternatingSign :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Nat ->
  R
alternatingSign reals zero =
  oneR reals
alternatingSign reals (suc n) =
  negate reals (alternatingSign reals n)

twoN : Nat
twoN =
  suc (suc zero)

cosineTerm :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  Nat ->
  R
cosineTerm reals x n =
  multiply reals
    (alternatingSign reals n)
    (divide reals
      (naturalPower reals x (twoN * n))
      (fromNat reals (factorial (twoN * n))))

CosineValue :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
CosineValue reals x value =
  ConvergesTo reals
    (\ n ->
      sumFirst reals n
        (cosineTerm reals x))
    value

record StandardCosine
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) :
  Set1 where

  field
    cosine : R -> R

    cosine-is-power-series :
      (x : R) ->
      CosineValue reals x (cosine x)

open StandardCosine

HasDerivativeAt :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (R -> R) ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
HasDerivativeAt {R} reals function point derivative =
  (epsilon : R) ->
  StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) epsilon ->
  Exists R
    (\ delta ->
      StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) delta
      and
      ((h : R) ->
        AbsoluteLess reals h delta ->
        h != zeroR reals ->
        AbsoluteLess reals
          (subtract reals
            (divide reals
              (subtract reals
                (function (add reals point h))
                (function point))
              h)
            derivative)
          epsilon))

SecondDerivativeAt :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (R -> R) ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
SecondDerivativeAt {R} reals function point secondDerivative =
  Exists (R -> R)
    (\ firstDerivative ->
      ((x : R) ->
        HasDerivativeAt reals function x (firstDerivative x))
      and
      HasDerivativeAt reals firstDerivative point secondDerivative)

cosineProduct :
  {R : Set} ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) ->
  StandardCosine reals ->
  Nat ->
  R ->
  R
cosineProduct reals analysis zero x =
  oneR reals
cosineProduct reals analysis (suc n) x =
  multiply reals
    (cosineProduct reals analysis n x)
    (cosine analysis
      (multiply reals
        (fromNat reals (suc n))
        x))

Positive : Nat -> Set
Positive n =
  suc zero <=N n

module Putnam2023A1Statement
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R)
  (analysis : StandardCosine reals) where

  Qualifies : Nat -> Set
  Qualifies n =
    Positive n
    and
    Exists R
      (\ secondDerivative ->
        SecondDerivativeAt reals
          (cosineProduct reals analysis n)
          (zeroR reals)
          secondDerivative
        and
        AbsoluteGreater reals
          secondDerivative
          (fromNat reals 2023))

  IsLeast : Nat -> Set
  IsLeast candidate =
    Qualifies candidate
    and
    ((n : Nat) ->
      Qualifies n ->
      candidate <=N n)

  proposition : Set
  proposition =
    IsLeast 18

putnam-2023-a1 : Set1
putnam-2023-a1 =
  (R : Set) ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) ->
  (analysis : StandardCosine reals) ->
  Putnam2023A1Statement.proposition reals analysis

title: putnam_2023_a1
content:
% Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2023_a1:
% 18 is the least positive integer n for which the absolute second derivative
% at zero of the product cos(x) cos(2x) ... cos(n*x) exceeds 2023. This file
% contains no proof.

putnam_2023_a1: THEORY
BEGIN
  real_function: TYPE = [real -> real]
  real_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> real]

  safe_div(numerator, denominator: real): real =
    IF denominator = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      numerator / denominator
    ENDIF

  factorial(index: nat): RECURSIVE nat =
    IF index = 0 THEN
      1
    ELSE
      index * factorial(index - 1)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE index

  converges_to(sequence: real_sequence, value: real): bool =
    FORALL (epsilon_value: posreal):
      EXISTS (cutoff: nat):
        FORALL (index: nat):
          cutoff <= index IMPLIES
            abs(sequence(index) - value) < epsilon_value

  cosine_partial(x: real, count: nat): RECURSIVE real =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      LET index: nat = count - 1 IN
        cosine_partial(x, count - 1)
          + safe_div(
              ((-1 :: real) ^ index) * x ^ (2 * index),
              factorial(2 * index) :: real)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  cosine(x: real): real =
    epsilon(
      LAMBDA (value: real):
        converges_to(
          LAMBDA (count: nat): cosine_partial(x, count),
          value))

  cosine_product(n: nat, x: real): RECURSIVE real =
    IF n = 0 THEN
      1
    ELSE
      cosine_product(n - 1, x) * cosine((n :: real) * x)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE n

  product_function(n: nat): real_function =
    LAMBDA (x: real): cosine_product(n, x)

  has_derivative_at(
      f: real_function,
      derivative, x: real): bool =
    FORALL (epsilon_value: posreal):
      EXISTS (delta: posreal):
        FORALL (h: real):
          (h /= 0 AND abs(h) < delta)
            IMPLIES
              abs(f(x + h) - f(x) - derivative * h)
                < epsilon_value * abs(h)

  differentiable_at(f: real_function, x: real): bool =
    EXISTS (derivative: real):
      has_derivative_at(f, derivative, x)

  derivative_value(f: real_function, x: real): real =
    IF differentiable_at(f, x) THEN
      epsilon(
        LAMBDA (derivative: real):
          has_derivative_at(f, derivative, x))
    ELSE
      0
    ENDIF

  derivative_function(f: real_function): real_function =
    LAMBDA (x: real):
      derivative_value(f, x)

  iterated_derivative(
      f: real_function,
      order: nat): RECURSIVE real_function =
    IF order = 0 THEN
      f
    ELSE
      derivative_function(
        iterated_derivative(f, order - 1))
    ENDIF
  MEASURE order

  qualifying(n: nat): bool =
    n > 0
      AND abs(iterated_derivative(product_function(n), 2)(0)) > 2023

  putnam_2023_a1_solution: nat = 18

  putnam_2023_a1_statement: bool =
    qualifying(putnam_2023_a1_solution)
      AND FORALL (n: nat):
        qualifying(n) IMPLIES putnam_2023_a1_solution <= n
END putnam_2023_a1

title: putnam_2023_a2
