import Mathlib

open Nat

abbrev putnam_2023_a2_solution : ℕ → Set ℝ := sorry
-- fun n => {(1 : ℝ)/(factorial n), -(1 : ℝ)/(factorial n)}
/--
Let $n$ be an even positive integer. Let $p$ be a monic, real polynomial of degree $2n$; that is to say, $p(x) = x^{2n} + a_{2n-1} x^{2n-1} + \cdots + a_1 x + a_0$ for some real coefficients $a_0, \dots, a_{2n-1}$. Suppose that $p(1/k) = k^2$ for all integers $k$ such that $1 \leq |k| \leq n$. Find all other real numbers $x$ for which $p(1/x) = x^2$.
-/
theorem putnam_2023_a2
(n : ℕ)
(hn : n > 0 ∧ Even n)
(p : Polynomial ℝ)
(hp : Polynomial.Monic p ∧ p.degree = 2*n)
(S : Set ℝ)
(hS : S = {x : ℝ | ∃ k : ℤ, x = k ∧ 1 ≤ |k| ∧ |k| ≤ n})
(hpinv : ∀ k ∈ S, p.eval (1/k) = k^2)
: {x : ℝ | x ≠ 0 ∧ p.eval (1/x) = x^2} \ S = putnam_2023_a2_solution n :=
sorry

From mathcomp Require Import all_algebra all_ssreflect.
From mathcomp Require Import reals.
From mathcomp Require Import classical_sets.

Set Implicit Arguments.
Unset Strict Implicit.
Unset Printing Implicit Defensive.

Local Open Scope ring_scope.
Local Open Scope classical_set_scope.

Variable R : realType.
Definition putnam_2023_a2_solution : nat -> set R := fun n => [set x | x = -1 / (n`!)%:R \/ x = 1 / (n`!)%:R].
Theorem putnam_2023_a2
    (n : nat)
    (hn0 : gt n 0 /\ ~~ odd n)
    (p : {poly R})
    (hp : p \is monic /\ size p = (n.*2).+1)
    (S : set R := [set x | exists k : int, x = k%:~R /\ 1 <= `|k| <= n])
    (hpinv : forall k : int, k%:~R \in S -> p.[1 / k%:~R] = k%:~R ^+ 2)
    : [set x | (p.[1 / x] == x ^+ 2) && (x \notin S)] = putnam_2023_a2_solution n.
Proof. Admitted.

"HOL-Computational_Algebra.Polynomial"
begin

definition putnam_2023_a2_solution :: "nat \<Rightarrow> (real set)" where "putnam_2023_a2_solution \<equiv> undefined"
(* \<lambda> n :: nat. {(1 :: real)/(fact n), -(1 :: real)/(fact n)} *)
theorem putnam_2023_a2:
  fixes n :: "nat"
    and p :: "real poly"
    and S :: "real set"
  defines "S \<equiv> {x :: real. \<exists> k :: int. x = k \<and> 1 \<le> abs k \<and> abs k \<le> n}"
  assumes hn : "n > 0 \<and> even n"
    and hp : "lead_coeff p = 1 \<and> degree p = 2*n"
    and hpinv : "\<forall> k \<in> S. poly p (1/k) = k^2"
  shows "{x :: real. poly p (1/x) = x^2} - S = putnam_2023_a2_solution n"
  sorry

end

(*
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2023_a2:
  the remaining real reciprocal interpolation points of an even-degree monic
  polynomial prescribed at nonzero integers. This file contains no proof.
*)

let statement =
  `let eval =
     \p:real list. \x:real.
       ITLIST (\c acc. c + x * acc) p (&0) in
   !n:num p:real list.
     0 < n /\
     EVEN n /\
     LENGTH p = 2 * n + 1 /\
     LAST p = &1 /\
     (!k:int.
        (&1:int) <= abs k /\ abs k <= &n
        ==> eval p (&1 / real_of_int k) = (real_of_int k) pow 2)
     ==>
     !x:real.
       (~(x = &0) /\
        eval p (&1 / x) = x pow 2 /\
        ~(?k:int.
            x = real_of_int k /\
            (&1:int) <= abs k /\
            abs k <= &n))
       <=>
       x = &1 / &(FACT n) \/ x = --(&1 / &(FACT n))`;;

title: putnam_2023_a2
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2023_a2:
;; a monic real polynomial of degree 2n taking the value k^2 at 1/k for
;; 1 <= |k| <= n has exactly the two additional reciprocal roots
;; +/-1/(n!). This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))

;; Scalars are represented in an arbitrary real-closed ordered field. Real
;; closed fields are elementarily equivalent, and the statement is
;; first-order in ordered-field operations. FN-EQUAL supplies the universal
;; quantifiers in the field laws and in the final pointwise set equality.

(defun putnam-2023-a2-quoted (object)
  (list 'quote object))

(defun putnam-2023-a2-apply1-term (function argument)
  (list
   'apply$
   (putnam-2023-a2-quoted function)
   (list 'cons argument nil)))

(defun putnam-2023-a2-apply2-term (function left right)
  (list
   'apply$
   (putnam-2023-a2-quoted function)
   (list 'cons left (list 'cons right nil))))

(defun putnam-2023-a2-and-term (terms)
  (if (endp terms)
      (putnam-2023-a2-quoted t)
    (list
     'if
     (car terms)
     (putnam-2023-a2-and-term (cdr terms))
     (putnam-2023-a2-quoted nil))))

(defun putnam-2023-a2-or-term (terms)
  (if (endp terms)
      (putnam-2023-a2-quoted nil)
    (list
     'if
     (car terms)
     (putnam-2023-a2-quoted t)
     (putnam-2023-a2-or-term (cdr terms)))))

(defun putnam-2023-a2-not-term (term)
  (list
   'if
   term
   (putnam-2023-a2-quoted nil)
   (putnam-2023-a2-quoted t)))

(defun putnam-2023-a2-implies-term (antecedent consequent)
  (list
   'if
   antecedent
   consequent
   (putnam-2023-a2-quoted t)))

(defun putnam-2023-a2-true-function (formals)
  (list
   'lambda
   formals
   (putnam-2023-a2-quoted t)))

(defun putnam-2023-a2-carrier-term (carrier element)
  (putnam-2023-a2-apply1-term carrier element))

(defun putnam-2023-a2-operation-term (operation left right)
  (putnam-2023-a2-apply2-term operation left right))

(defun putnam-2023-a2-all-coefficients-function (carrier)
  (list
   'lambda
   '(loop$-gvars loop$-ivars)
   (putnam-2023-a2-carrier-term
    carrier 'loop$-ivars)))

(defun putnam-2023-a2-all-coefficients-term
    (carrier coefficients)
  (list
   'always$+
   (putnam-2023-a2-quoted
    (putnam-2023-a2-all-coefficients-function
     carrier))
   (putnam-2023-a2-quoted nil)
   coefficients))

(defun putnam-2023-a2-polynomial-term
    (carrier zero coefficients)
  (putnam-2023-a2-and-term
   (list
    (list 'true-listp coefficients)
    (list 'consp coefficients)
    (putnam-2023-a2-all-coefficients-term
     carrier coefficients)
    (putnam-2023-a2-or-term
     (list
      (list 'equal
            (list 'len coefficients)
            (putnam-2023-a2-quoted 1))
      (putnam-2023-a2-not-term
       (list 'equal
             (list 'car (list 'last coefficients))
             (putnam-2023-a2-quoted zero))))))))

(defun putnam-2023-a2-field-laws-function
    (carrier zero one add mul neg inv)
  (let* ((x 'x)
         (y 'y)
         (z 'z)
         (qzero (putnam-2023-a2-quoted zero))
         (qone (putnam-2023-a2-quoted one))
         (add-xy
          (putnam-2023-a2-operation-term add x y))
         (add-yz
          (putnam-2023-a2-operation-term add y z))
         (mul-xy
          (putnam-2023-a2-operation-term mul x y))
         (mul-yz
          (putnam-2023-a2-operation-term mul y z))
         (neg-x
          (putnam-2023-a2-apply1-term neg x))
         (inv-x
          (putnam-2023-a2-apply1-term inv x))
         (domain
          (putnam-2023-a2-and-term
           (list
            (putnam-2023-a2-carrier-term carrier x)
            (putnam-2023-a2-carrier-term carrier y)
            (putnam-2023-a2-carrier-term carrier z))))
         (laws
          (putnam-2023-a2-and-term
           (list
            (putnam-2023-a2-carrier-term carrier add-xy)
            (putnam-2023-a2-carrier-term carrier mul-xy)
            (putnam-2023-a2-carrier-term carrier neg-x)
            (putnam-2023-a2-carrier-term carrier inv-x)
            (list
             'equal
             (putnam-2023-a2-operation-term add add-xy z)
             (putnam-2023-a2-operation-term add x add-yz))
            (list
             'equal
             (putnam-2023-a2-operation-term mul mul-xy z)
             (putnam-2023-a2-operation-term mul x mul-yz))
            (list
             'equal
             add-xy
             (putnam-2023-a2-operation-term add y x))
            (list
             'equal
             mul-xy
             (putnam-2023-a2-operation-term mul y x))
            (list
             'equal
             (putnam-2023-a2-operation-term add x qzero)
             x)
            (list
             'equal
             (putnam-2023-a2-operation-term add x neg-x)
             qzero)
            (list
             'equal
             (putnam-2023-a2-operation-term mul x qone)
             x)
            (putnam-2023-a2-implies-term
             (list 'equal x qzero)
             (list 'equal inv-x qzero))
            (putnam-2023-a2-implies-term
             (putnam-2023-a2-not-term
              (list 'equal x qzero))
             (list
              'equal
              (putnam-2023-a2-operation-term mul x inv-x)
              qone))
            (list
             'equal
             (putnam-2023-a2-operation-term mul x add-yz)
             (putnam-2023-a2-operation-term
              add
              (putnam-2023-a2-operation-term mul x y)
              (putnam-2023-a2-operation-term mul x z)))))))
    (list
     'lambda
     '(x y z)
     (putnam-2023-a2-implies-term domain laws))))

(defun putnam-2023-a2-order-laws-function
    (carrier zero add mul lt)
  (let* ((x 'x)
         (y 'y)
         (z 'z)
         (qzero (putnam-2023-a2-quoted zero))
         (lt-xy
          (putnam-2023-a2-operation-term lt x y))
         (lt-yx
          (putnam-2023-a2-operation-term lt y x))
         (lt-yz
          (putnam-2023-a2-operation-term lt y z))
         (lt-xz
          (putnam-2023-a2-operation-term lt x z))
         (domain
          (putnam-2023-a2-and-term
           (list
            (putnam-2023-a2-carrier-term carrier x)
            (putnam-2023-a2-carrier-term carrier y)
            (putnam-2023-a2-carrier-term carrier z))))
         (laws
          (putnam-2023-a2-and-term
           (list
            (putnam-2023-a2-not-term
             (putnam-2023-a2-operation-term lt x x))
            (putnam-2023-a2-or-term
             (list
              lt-xy
              lt-yx
              (list 'equal x y)))
            (putnam-2023-a2-implies-term
             (putnam-2023-a2-and-term
              (list lt-xy lt-yz))
             lt-xz)
            (putnam-2023-a2-implies-term
             lt-xy
             (putnam-2023-a2-operation-term
              lt
              (putnam-2023-a2-operation-term add x z)
              (putnam-2023-a2-operation-term add y z)))
            (putnam-2023-a2-implies-term
             (putnam-2023-a2-and-term
              (list
               (putnam-2023-a2-operation-term lt qzero x)
               (putnam-2023-a2-operation-term lt qzero y)))
             (putnam-2023-a2-operation-term
              lt
              qzero
              (putnam-2023-a2-operation-term mul x y)))))))
    (list
     'lambda
     '(x y z)
     (putnam-2023-a2-implies-term domain laws))))

(defun putnam-2023-a2-square-root-laws-function
    (carrier zero mul lt square-root)
  (let* ((x 'x)
         (qzero (putnam-2023-a2-quoted zero))
         (root
          (putnam-2023-a2-apply1-term square-root x))
         (domain
          (putnam-2023-a2-and-term
           (list
            (putnam-2023-a2-carrier-term carrier x)
            (putnam-2023-a2-not-term
             (putnam-2023-a2-operation-term lt x qzero)))))
         (laws
          (putnam-2023-a2-and-term
           (list
            (putnam-2023-a2-carrier-term carrier root)
            (putnam-2023-a2-not-term
             (putnam-2023-a2-operation-term lt root qzero))
            (list
             'equal
             (putnam-2023-a2-operation-term mul root root)
             x)))))
    (list
     'lambda
     '(x)
     (putnam-2023-a2-implies-term domain laws))))

(defun putnam-2023-a2-evaluation-laws-function
    (carrier zero add mul evaluate)
  (let* ((coefficient 'coefficient)
         (rest 'rest)
         (x 'x)
         (qzero (putnam-2023-a2-quoted zero))
         (domain
          (putnam-2023-a2-and-term
           (list
            (putnam-2023-a2-carrier-term
             carrier coefficient)
            (list 'true-listp rest)
            (putnam-2023-a2-all-coefficients-term
             carrier rest)
            (putnam-2023-a2-carrier-term carrier x))))
         (empty-law
          (putnam-2023-a2-implies-term
           (putnam-2023-a2-carrier-term carrier x)
           (list
            'equal
            (putnam-2023-a2-operation-term
             evaluate
             (putnam-2023-a2-quoted nil)
             x)
            qzero)))
         (recursive-value
          (putnam-2023-a2-operation-term
           add
           coefficient
           (putnam-2023-a2-operation-term
            mul
            x
            (putnam-2023-a2-operation-term
             evaluate rest x))))
         (recursive-law
          (putnam-2023-a2-implies-term
           domain
           (putnam-2023-a2-and-term
            (list
             (putnam-2023-a2-carrier-term
              carrier
              (putnam-2023-a2-operation-term
               evaluate
               (list 'cons coefficient rest)
               x))
             (list
              'equal
              (putnam-2023-a2-operation-term
               evaluate
               (list 'cons coefficient rest)
               x)
              recursive-value))))))
    (list
     'lambda
     '(coefficient rest x)
     (putnam-2023-a2-and-term
      (list empty-law recursive-law)))))

(defun putnam-2023-a2-add (add left right)
  (apply$ add (list left right)))

(defun putnam-2023-a2-mul (mul left right)
  (apply$ mul (list left right)))

(defun putnam-2023-a2-neg (neg value)
  (apply$ neg (list value)))

(defun putnam-2023-a2-inv (inv value)
  (apply$ inv (list value)))

(defun putnam-2023-a2-field-natural (n zero one add)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix n)))
  (if (zp n)
      zero
    (putnam-2023-a2-add
     add
     one
     (putnam-2023-a2-field-natural
      (- n 1) zero one add))))

(defun putnam-2023-a2-coefficient-list-p
    (coefficients carrier)
  (if (endp coefficients)
      (equal coefficients nil)
    (and
     (apply$ carrier (list (car coefficients)))
     (putnam-2023-a2-coefficient-list-p
      (cdr coefficients) carrier))))

(defun putnam-2023-a2-odd-root-laws-function
    (carrier zero evaluate odd-root)
  (let* ((coefficients 'coefficients)
         (root
          (putnam-2023-a2-apply1-term
           odd-root coefficients))
         (domain
          (putnam-2023-a2-and-term
           (list
            (putnam-2023-a2-polynomial-term
             carrier zero coefficients)
            (list 'evenp (list 'len coefficients)))))
         (laws
          (putnam-2023-a2-and-term
           (list
            (putnam-2023-a2-carrier-term carrier root)
            (list
             'equal
             (putnam-2023-a2-operation-term
              evaluate coefficients root)
             (putnam-2023-a2-quoted zero))))))
    (list
     'lambda
     '(coefficients)
     (putnam-2023-a2-implies-term domain laws))))

(defun putnam-2023-a2-real-closed-field-p
    (carrier zero one add mul neg inv lt
             square-root odd-root evaluate)
  (let* ((field-laws
          (putnam-2023-a2-field-laws-function
           carrier zero one add mul neg inv))
         (field-laws-true
          (putnam-2023-a2-true-function '(x y z)))
         (order-laws
          (putnam-2023-a2-order-laws-function
           carrier zero add mul lt))
         (order-laws-true
          (putnam-2023-a2-true-function '(x y z)))
         (square-root-laws
          (putnam-2023-a2-square-root-laws-function
           carrier zero mul lt square-root))
         (square-root-laws-true
          (putnam-2023-a2-true-function '(x)))
         (evaluation-laws
          (putnam-2023-a2-evaluation-laws-function
           carrier zero add mul evaluate))
         (evaluation-laws-true
          (putnam-2023-a2-true-function
           '(coefficient rest x)))
         (odd-root-laws
          (putnam-2023-a2-odd-root-laws-function
           carrier zero evaluate odd-root))
         (odd-root-laws-true
          (putnam-2023-a2-true-function '(coefficients)))
         (all-coefficients-loop
          (putnam-2023-a2-all-coefficients-function
           carrier)))
    (and
     (tamep-functionp carrier)
     (tamep-functionp add)
     (tamep-functionp mul)
     (tamep-functionp neg)
     (tamep-functionp inv)
     (tamep-functionp lt)
     (tamep-functionp square-root)
     (tamep-functionp odd-root)
     (tamep-functionp evaluate)
     (tamep-functionp all-coefficients-loop)
     (tamep-functionp field-laws)
     (tamep-functionp field-laws-true)
     (tamep-functionp order-laws)
     (tamep-functionp order-laws-true)
     (tamep-functionp square-root-laws)
     (tamep-functionp square-root-laws-true)
     (tamep-functionp evaluation-laws)
     (tamep-functionp evaluation-laws-true)
     (tamep-functionp odd-root-laws)
     (tamep-functionp odd-root-laws-true)
     (apply$ carrier (list zero))
     (apply$ carrier (list one))
     (not (equal zero one))
     (fn-equal field-laws field-laws-true)
     (fn-equal order-laws order-laws-true)
     (fn-equal square-root-laws square-root-laws-true)
     (fn-equal evaluation-laws evaluation-laws-true)
     (fn-equal odd-root-laws odd-root-laws-true))))

(defun putnam-2023-a2-monic-degree-p
    (coefficients n carrier one)
  (and
   (true-listp coefficients)
   (equal (len coefficients) (+ (* 2 n) 1))
   (putnam-2023-a2-coefficient-list-p
    coefficients carrier)
   (equal (car (last coefficients)) one)))

(defun putnam-2023-a2-interpolation-p
    (count coefficients zero one add mul neg inv evaluate)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix count)))
  (if (zp count)
      t
    (let* ((positive
            (putnam-2023-a2-field-natural
             count zero one add))
           (negative
            (putnam-2023-a2-neg neg positive))
           (positive-square
            (putnam-2023-a2-mul mul positive positive))
           (negative-square
            (putnam-2023-a2-mul mul negative negative)))
      (and
       (equal
        (apply$
         evaluate
         (list
          coefficients
          (putnam-2023-a2-inv inv positive)))
        positive-square)
       (equal
        (apply$
         evaluate
         (list
          coefficients
          (putnam-2023-a2-inv inv negative)))
        negative-square)
       (putnam-2023-a2-interpolation-p
        (- count 1)
        coefficients zero one add mul neg inv evaluate)))))

(defun putnam-2023-a2-source-set-term
    (x count zero one add neg)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix count)))
  (if (zp count)
      (putnam-2023-a2-quoted nil)
    (let* ((positive
            (putnam-2023-a2-field-natural
             count zero one add))
           (negative
            (putnam-2023-a2-neg neg positive)))
      (putnam-2023-a2-or-term
       (list
        (list
         'equal x
         (putnam-2023-a2-quoted positive))
        (list
         'equal x
         (putnam-2023-a2-quoted negative))
        (putnam-2023-a2-source-set-term
         x (- count 1) zero one add neg))))))

(defun putnam-2023-a2-field-factorial
    (n zero one add mul)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix n)))
  (if (zp n)
      one
    (putnam-2023-a2-mul
     mul
     (putnam-2023-a2-field-natural
      n zero one add)
     (putnam-2023-a2-field-factorial
      (- n 1) zero one add mul))))

(defun putnam-2023-a2-root-function
    (n coefficients carrier zero one add mul neg inv evaluate)
  (let* ((x 'x)
         (qzero
          (putnam-2023-a2-quoted zero))
         (reciprocal
          (putnam-2023-a2-apply1-term inv x))
         (polynomial-value
          (putnam-2023-a2-operation-term
           evaluate
           (putnam-2023-a2-quoted coefficients)
           reciprocal))
         (square
          (putnam-2023-a2-operation-term mul x x))
         (root-condition
          (putnam-2023-a2-and-term
           (list
            (putnam-2023-a2-not-term
             (list 'equal x qzero))
            (list 'equal polynomial-value square)
            (putnam-2023-a2-not-term
             (putnam-2023-a2-source-set-term
              x n zero one add neg)))))
         (factorial
          (putnam-2023-a2-field-factorial
           n zero one add mul))
         (positive-solution
          (putnam-2023-a2-inv inv factorial))
         (negative-solution
          (putnam-2023-a2-neg neg positive-solution))
         (solution-condition
          (putnam-2023-a2-or-term
           (list
            (list
             'equal x
             (putnam-2023-a2-quoted positive-solution))
            (list
             'equal x
             (putnam-2023-a2-quoted negative-solution)))))
         (equivalence
          (list 'equal root-condition solution-condition)))
    (list
     'lambda
     '(x)
     (putnam-2023-a2-implies-term
      (putnam-2023-a2-carrier-term carrier x)
      equivalence))))

(defun putnam-2023-a2-root-characterization-p
    (n coefficients carrier zero one add mul neg inv evaluate)
  (let ((condition
         (putnam-2023-a2-root-function
          n coefficients carrier zero one add mul neg inv evaluate))
        (always-true
         (putnam-2023-a2-true-function '(x))))
    (and
     (tamep-functionp condition)
     (tamep-functionp always-true)
     (fn-equal condition always-true))))

(defun putnambench-putnam-2023-a2-statement
    (carrier zero one add mul neg inv lt square-root odd-root
             evaluate n coefficients)
  (implies
   (and
    (putnam-2023-a2-real-closed-field-p
     carrier zero one add mul neg inv lt
     square-root odd-root evaluate)
    (natp n)
    (< 0 n)
    (evenp n)
    (putnam-2023-a2-monic-degree-p
     coefficients n carrier one)
    (putnam-2023-a2-interpolation-p
     n coefficients zero one add mul neg inv evaluate))
   (putnam-2023-a2-root-characterization-p
    n coefficients carrier zero one add mul neg inv evaluate)))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

title: putnam_2023_a2
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2023_a2
-- (putnambench__agda__putnam_2023_a2): the two additional reciprocal
-- interpolation solutions of a monic real polynomial of even degree.
-- This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module Putnam2023A2 where

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.List using (List; []; _∷_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; _*_)

infix 4 _!=_ _<=N_ _<N_
infixr 3 _and_
infixr 2 _or_
infix 1 _iff_

data Bottom : Set where

Not : Set -> Set
Not A =
  A -> Bottom

_!=_ : {A : Set} -> A -> A -> Set
x != y =
  Not (x == y)

record _and_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data _or_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  left  : A -> A or B
  right : B -> A or B

record _iff_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor equivalence
  field
    forward  : A -> B
    backward : B -> A

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

data _<=N_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set where
  zero<=N   : {n : Nat} -> zero <=N n
  suc<=sucN : {m n : Nat} -> m <=N n -> suc m <=N suc n

_<N_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set
m <N n =
  suc m <=N n

record CompleteOrderedRealField (R : Set) : Set1 where
  field
    zeroR oneR : R
    add multiply : R -> R -> R
    negate inverse : R -> R
    lessOrEqual : R -> R -> Set
    fromNat : Nat -> R

    one-not-zero :
      oneR != zeroR

    add-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> add x y == add y x
    add-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      add (add x y) z == add x (add y z)
    add-zero :
      (x : R) -> add x zeroR == x
    add-inverse :
      (x : R) -> add x (negate x) == zeroR

    multiply-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> multiply x y == multiply y x
    multiply-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply (multiply x y) z ==
      multiply x (multiply y z)
    multiply-one :
      (x : R) -> multiply x oneR == x
    multiply-zero :
      (x : R) -> multiply x zeroR == zeroR
    distribute :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply x (add y z) ==
      add (multiply x y) (multiply x z)
    inverse-zero :
      inverse zeroR == zeroR
    multiply-inverse :
      (x : R) ->
      x != zeroR ->
      multiply x (inverse x) == oneR

    order-reflexive :
      (x : R) -> lessOrEqual x x
    order-transitive :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y z ->
      lessOrEqual x z
    order-antisymmetric :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y x ->
      x == y
    order-total :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y or lessOrEqual y x
    add-order :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual (add z x) (add z y)
    multiply-nonnegative :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR x ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR y ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR (multiply x y)
    zero-less-than-one :
      lessOrEqual zeroR oneR and zeroR != oneR

    fromNat-zero :
      fromNat zero == zeroR
    fromNat-successor :
      (n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (suc n) == add (fromNat n) oneR
    fromNat-addition :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m + n) == add (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-multiplication :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m * n) == multiply (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-injective :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat m == fromNat n ->
      m == n

    archimedean :
      (x : R) ->
      Exists Nat
        (\ n -> lessOrEqual x (fromNat n))
    least-upper-bound :
      (P : R -> Set) ->
      Exists R P ->
      Exists R
        (\ upper ->
          (x : R) ->
          P x ->
          lessOrEqual x upper) ->
      Exists R
        (\ supremum ->
          ((x : R) ->
            P x ->
            lessOrEqual x supremum)
          and
          ((upper : R) ->
            ((x : R) ->
              P x ->
              lessOrEqual x upper) ->
            lessOrEqual supremum upper))

open CompleteOrderedRealField

oneN : Nat
oneN =
  suc zero

twoN : Nat
twoN =
  suc oneN

Positive : Nat -> Set
Positive n =
  oneN <=N n

Even : Nat -> Set
Even n =
  Exists Nat
    (\ half -> n == half + half)

factorial : Nat -> Nat
factorial zero =
  oneN
factorial (suc n) =
  suc n * factorial n

square :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R
square reals x =
  multiply reals x x

divide :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
divide reals numerator denominator =
  multiply reals numerator (inverse reals denominator)

module Putnam2023A2Statement
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) where

  Polynomial : Set
  Polynomial =
    List R

  coefficient : Polynomial -> Nat -> R
  coefficient [] n =
    zeroR reals
  coefficient (c ∷ coefficients) zero =
    c
  coefficient (c ∷ coefficients) (suc n) =
    coefficient coefficients n

  evaluate : Polynomial -> R -> R
  evaluate [] x =
    zeroR reals
  evaluate (c ∷ coefficients) x =
    add reals c
      (multiply reals x (evaluate coefficients x))

  MonicOfDegree : Polynomial -> Nat -> Set
  MonicOfDegree p degree =
    coefficient p degree == oneR reals
    and
    ((index : Nat) ->
      degree <N index ->
      coefficient p index == zeroR reals)

  InInterpolationSet : Nat -> R -> Set
  InInterpolationSet n x =
    Exists Nat
      (\ magnitude ->
        oneN <=N magnitude
        and
        magnitude <=N n
        and
        (x == fromNat reals magnitude
        or
        x == negate reals (fromNat reals magnitude)))

  ReciprocalInterpolation : Nat -> Polynomial -> Set
  ReciprocalInterpolation n p =
    (x : R) ->
    InInterpolationSet n x ->
    evaluate p (divide reals (oneR reals) x) ==
    square reals x

  OtherSolution : Nat -> Polynomial -> R -> Set
  OtherSolution n p x =
    x != zeroR reals
    and
    evaluate p (divide reals (oneR reals) x) ==
      square reals x
    and
    Not (InInterpolationSet n x)

  ExplicitSolution : Nat -> R -> Set
  ExplicitSolution n x =
    let
      reciprocal-factorial =
        divide reals
          (oneR reals)
          (fromNat reals (factorial n))
    in
    x == reciprocal-factorial
    or
    x == negate reals reciprocal-factorial

  proposition : Set
  proposition =
    (n : Nat) ->
    Positive n ->
    Even n ->
    (p : Polynomial) ->
    MonicOfDegree p (twoN * n) ->
    ReciprocalInterpolation n p ->
    (x : R) ->
    OtherSolution n p x iff ExplicitSolution n x

putnam-2023-a2 : Set1
putnam-2023-a2 =
  (R : Set) ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) ->
  Putnam2023A2Statement.proposition reals

content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2023_a2:
  the two additional real reciprocal interpolation points of a monic
  degree-2n polynomial prescribed at the nonzero integers through n.
  This file contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open arithmeticTheory integerTheory listTheory realTheory intrealTheory
     polyTheory;

val putnam_2023_a2 =
  ``!n : num. !P : real list.
      let S =
        \x : real.
          ?k : int.
            x = real_of_int k /\
            1 <= Num (ABS k) /\
            Num (ABS k) <= n
      in
        0 < n /\
        EVEN n /\
        degree P = 2 * n /\
        LAST (normalize P) = 1 /\
        (!k : real.
           S k ==> poly P (1 / k) = k pow 2)
        ==>
        !x : real.
          (x <> 0 /\
           poly P (1 / x) = x pow 2 /\
           ~S x
           <=>
           x = 1 / &(FACT n) \/
           x = ~(1 / &(FACT n)))``;

title: putnam_2023_a2
content:
$(
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact
  putnam_2023_a2: the additional real solutions of p(1/x) = x^2 for a
  monic polynomial interpolating k^2 at the reciprocals of the nonzero
  integers from -n through n are exactly 1/(n!) and -1/(n!).
  This file contains no proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  NN is set.mm's class of positive integers, and 2 || n is the source
  evenness condition. A in RR ^m NN0 is the complete coefficient function
  of an arbitrary real polynomial. Requiring coefficient 2n to be one and
  every later coefficient to vanish is exactly the condition that the
  polynomial is monic of degree 2n. Each displayed finite sum is its
  evaluation at the indicated real argument.

  The integer quantifier in the antecedent is equivalent to quantification
  over the source set S of real integers k with 1 <= |k| <= n. The class
  abstraction in the conclusion is the nonzero real solution set with S
  removed, and the right side is the explicit two-element solution set.
  Thus inlining S and the solution definition preserves the source
  proposition bidirectionally. The final declaration is the single
  unproved $a corpus statement; this database contains no $p proof
  declaration.
$)

${
  $d A i k n x $.

  putnambench-putnam-2023-a2 $a |-
    A. n e. NN
      A. A e. ( RR ^m NN0 )
        (
          (
            2 || n
            /\
            (
              ( A ` ( 2 x. n ) ) = 1
              /\
              A. i e. NN0
                (
                  ( 2 x. n ) < i
                  ->
                  ( A ` i ) = 0
                )
            )
            /\
            A. k e. ZZ
              (
                (
                  1 <_ ( abs ` k )
                  /\
                  ( abs ` k ) <_ n
                )
                ->
                (
                  sum_ i e. ( 0 ... ( 2 x. n ) )
                    (
                      ( A ` i )
                      x.
                      ( ( 1 / k ) ^ i )
                    )
                )
                =
                ( k ^ 2 )
              )
          )
          ->
          (
            {
              x e. RR |
              (
                (
                  x =/= 0
                  /\
                  (
                    sum_ i e. ( 0 ... ( 2 x. n ) )
                      (
                        ( A ` i )
                        x.
                        ( ( 1 / x ) ^ i )
                      )
                  )
                  =
                  ( x ^ 2 )
                )
                /\
                -.
                E. k e. ZZ
                  (
                    x = k
                    /\
                    (
                      1 <_ ( abs ` k )
                      /\
                      ( abs ` k ) <_ n
                    )
                  )
              )
            }
            =
            {
              ( 1 / ( ! ` n ) ) ,
              ( -u ( 1 / ( ! ` n ) ) )
            }
          )
        )
  $.
$}

title: putnam_2023_a2
content:
% Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2023_a2:
% a monic real polynomial of degree 2n with the prescribed reciprocal-integer
% values has exactly +/-1/n! as its other real reciprocal solutions. This file
% contains no proof.

putnam_2023_a2: THEORY
BEGIN
  coefficient_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> real]

  safe_div(numerator, denominator: real): real =
    IF denominator = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      numerator / denominator
    ENDIF

  nat_factorial(index: nat): RECURSIVE nat =
    IF index = 0 THEN
      1
    ELSE
      index * nat_factorial(index - 1)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE index

  polynomial_value(
      coefficients: coefficient_sequence,
      count: nat,
      x: real): RECURSIVE real =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      polynomial_value(coefficients, count - 1, x)
        + coefficients(count - 1) * x ^ (count - 1)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  monic_of_degree(
      coefficients: coefficient_sequence,
      degree: nat): bool =
    coefficients(degree) = 1
      AND FORALL (index: nat):
        degree < index IMPLIES coefficients(index) = 0

  prescribed_integer(
      n: nat,
      x: real): bool =
    EXISTS (k: int):
      x = (k :: real)
        AND 1 <= abs(k)
        AND abs(k) <= n

  has_prescribed_values(
      coefficients: coefficient_sequence,
      n: nat): bool =
    FORALL (k: int):
      (1 <= abs(k) AND abs(k) <= n)
        IMPLIES
          polynomial_value(
            coefficients,
            2 * n + 1,
            safe_div(1, k :: real))
          = (k :: real) ^ 2

  putnam_2023_a2_solution(
      n: nat,
      x: real): bool =
    x = safe_div(1, nat_factorial(n) :: real)
      OR x = -safe_div(1, nat_factorial(n) :: real)

  putnam_2023_a2: bool =
    FORALL
        (n: nat),
        (coefficients: coefficient_sequence):
      (n > 0
        AND mod(n, 2) = 0
        AND monic_of_degree(coefficients, 2 * n)
        AND has_prescribed_values(coefficients, n))
      IMPLIES
        FORALL (x: real):
          (x /= 0
            AND polynomial_value(
              coefficients,
              2 * n + 1,
              safe_div(1, x))
              = x ^ 2
            AND NOT prescribed_integer(n, x))
          IFF putnam_2023_a2_solution(n, x)
END putnam_2023_a2

title: putnam_2023_a3
content:
import Mathlib

open Nat

noncomputable abbrev putnam_2023_a3_solution : ℝ := sorry
-- Real.pi / 2
/--
Determine the smallest positive real number $r$ such that there exist differentiable functions $f\colon \mathbb{R} \to \mathbb{R}$ and $g\colon \mathbb{R} \to \mathbb{R}$ satisfying
\begin{enumerate}
 \item[(a)] $f(0) > 0$,
 \item[(b)] $g(0) = 0$,
 \item[(c)] $|f'(x)| \leq |g(x)|$ for all $x$,
 \item[(d)] $|g'(x)| \leq |f(x)|$ for all $x$, and
 \item[(e)] $f(r) = 0$. \end{enumerate}
-/
theorem putnam_2023_a3
: sInf {r > 0 | ∃ f g : ℝ → ℝ,
    Differentiable ℝ f ∧ Differentiable ℝ g ∧
    (∀ x : ℝ, |deriv f x| ≤ |g x| ∧ |deriv g x| ≤ |f x|) ∧
    f 0 > 0 ∧ g 0 = 0 ∧ f r = 0} = putnam_2023_a3_solution :=
sorry

title: putnam_2023_a3
putnam_2023_a3
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2023_a3:
;; pi/2 is the smallest positive zero time attainable by globally
;; differentiable real functions satisfying the coupled derivative bounds.
;; This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))

;; Tame APPLY$ objects represent arbitrary carriers and functions. FN-EQUAL
;; supplies unbounded universal quantification, and inequality with a
;; constant-false function supplies internal existential quantification.
;; A Dedekind-complete ordered field presents the reals. Differentiability is
;; expanded by its epsilon remainder condition. Sine and cosine are fixed by
;; their initial values and differential system, and pi-value is their least
;; positive sine zero. All functions and derivative values in the Putnam
;; condition remain internally quantified.

(defun p23a3-quoted (object)
  (list 'quote object))

(defun p23a3-term-list (terms)
  (if (consp terms)
      (list 'cons
            (car terms)
            (p23a3-term-list (cdr terms)))
    (p23a3-quoted nil)))

(defun p23a3-apply-term (function-term arguments)
  (list 'apply$
        function-term
        (p23a3-term-list arguments)))

(defun p23a3-static-apply-term (function arguments)
  (p23a3-apply-term
   (p23a3-quoted function)
   arguments))

(defun p23a3-and-terms (terms)
  (if (consp terms)
      (list 'if
            (car terms)
            (p23a3-and-terms (cdr terms))
            (p23a3-quoted nil))
    (p23a3-quoted t)))

(defun p23a3-or-terms (terms)
  (if (consp terms)
      (list 'if
            (car terms)
            (p23a3-quoted t)
            (p23a3-or-terms (cdr terms)))
    (p23a3-quoted nil)))

(defun p23a3-not-term (term)
  (list 'if term
        (p23a3-quoted nil)
        (p23a3-quoted t)))

(defun p23a3-implies-term (hypothesis conclusion)
  (list 'if hypothesis conclusion (p23a3-quoted t)))

(defun p23a3-iff-term (left right)
  (list 'if left
        (list 'if right
              (p23a3-quoted t)
              (p23a3-quoted nil))
        (list 'if right
              (p23a3-quoted nil)
              (p23a3-quoted t))))

(defun p23a3-true-function (formals)
  (list 'lambda formals (p23a3-quoted t)))

(defun p23a3-false-function (formals)
  (list 'lambda formals (p23a3-quoted nil)))

(defun p23a3-universal-p (function formals)
  (let ((always-true (p23a3-true-function formals)))
    (and (tamep-functionp function)
         (tamep-functionp always-true)
         (fn-equal function always-true))))

(defun p23a3-exists-p (function formals)
  (let ((always-false (p23a3-false-function formals)))
    (and (tamep-functionp function)
         (tamep-functionp always-false)
         (not (fn-equal function always-false)))))

(defun p23a3-member-p (predicate object)
  (if (apply$ predicate (list object)) t nil))

(defun p23a3-unary-value (function object)
  (apply$ function (list object)))

(defun p23a3-binary-value (function left right)
  (apply$ function (list left right)))

;; Arbitrary real-valued functions and arbitrary subsets of the real carrier.

(defun p23a3-function-values-function (carrier function)
  (list
   'lambda '(x)
   (p23a3-implies-term
    (p23a3-static-apply-term carrier '(x))
    (p23a3-static-apply-term
     carrier
     (list (p23a3-static-apply-term function '(x)))))))

(defun p23a3-real-function-p (carrier function)
  (and
   (tamep-functionp function)
   (p23a3-universal-p
    (p23a3-function-values-function carrier function)
    '(x))))

(defun p23a3-set-subset-carrier-function (carrier set)
  (list
   'lambda '(x)
   (p23a3-implies-term
    (p23a3-static-apply-term set '(x))
    (p23a3-static-apply-term carrier '(x)))))

(defun p23a3-valid-set-p (carrier set)
  (and
   (tamep-functionp set)
   (p23a3-universal-p
    (p23a3-set-subset-carrier-function carrier set)
    '(x))))

;; A Dedekind-complete ordered field, used as an abstract presentation of R.

(defun p23a3-field-laws-function
    (carrier zero one add multiply negate inverse)
  (let* ((xy-add (p23a3-static-apply-term add '(x y)))
         (yz-add (p23a3-static-apply-term add '(y z)))
         (xy-mul (p23a3-static-apply-term multiply '(x y)))
         (yz-mul (p23a3-static-apply-term multiply '(y z)))
         (neg-x (p23a3-static-apply-term negate '(x)))
         (inv-x (p23a3-static-apply-term inverse '(x))))
    (list
     'lambda '(x y z)
     (p23a3-implies-term
      (p23a3-and-terms
       (list
        (p23a3-static-apply-term carrier '(x))
        (p23a3-static-apply-term carrier '(y))
        (p23a3-static-apply-term carrier '(z))))
      (p23a3-and-terms
       (list
        (p23a3-static-apply-term carrier (list xy-add))
        (p23a3-static-apply-term carrier (list xy-mul))
        (p23a3-static-apply-term carrier (list neg-x))
        (p23a3-static-apply-term carrier (list inv-x))
        (list 'equal
              (p23a3-static-apply-term add (list xy-add 'z))
              (p23a3-static-apply-term add (list 'x yz-add)))
        (list 'equal xy-add
              (p23a3-static-apply-term add '(y x)))
        (list 'equal
              (p23a3-static-apply-term
               add (list 'x (p23a3-quoted zero)))
              'x)
        (list 'equal
              (p23a3-static-apply-term add (list 'x neg-x))
              (p23a3-quoted zero))
        (list 'equal
              (p23a3-static-apply-term multiply (list xy-mul 'z))
              (p23a3-static-apply-term multiply (list 'x yz-mul)))
        (list 'equal xy-mul
              (p23a3-static-apply-term multiply '(y x)))
        (list 'equal
              (p23a3-static-apply-term
               multiply (list 'x (p23a3-quoted one)))
              'x)
        (p23a3-implies-term
         (list 'equal 'x (p23a3-quoted zero))
         (list 'equal inv-x (p23a3-quoted zero)))
        (p23a3-implies-term
         (p23a3-not-term
          (list 'equal 'x (p23a3-quoted zero)))
         (list 'equal
               (p23a3-static-apply-term
                multiply (list 'x inv-x))
               (p23a3-quoted one)))
        (list 'equal
              (p23a3-static-apply-term multiply (list 'x yz-add))
              (p23a3-static-apply-term
               add
               (list
                (p23a3-static-apply-term multiply '(x y))
                (p23a3-static-apply-term multiply '(x z)))))))))))

(defun p23a3-order-laws-function
    (carrier zero add multiply less)
  (let ((xy (p23a3-static-apply-term less '(x y)))
        (yx (p23a3-static-apply-term less '(y x)))
        (yz (p23a3-static-apply-term less '(y z))))
    (list
     'lambda '(x y z)
     (p23a3-implies-term
      (p23a3-and-terms
       (list
        (p23a3-static-apply-term carrier '(x))
        (p23a3-static-apply-term carrier '(y))
        (p23a3-static-apply-term carrier '(z))))
      (p23a3-and-terms
       (list
        (p23a3-not-term
         (p23a3-static-apply-term less '(x x)))
        (p23a3-or-terms
         (list xy yx (list 'equal 'x 'y)))
        (p23a3-implies-term
         (p23a3-and-terms (list xy yz))
         (p23a3-static-apply-term less '(x z)))
        (p23a3-implies-term
         xy
         (p23a3-static-apply-term
          less
          (list
           (p23a3-static-apply-term add '(x z))
           (p23a3-static-apply-term add '(y z)))))
        (p23a3-implies-term
         (p23a3-and-terms
          (list
           (p23a3-static-apply-term
            less (list (p23a3-quoted zero) 'x))
           (p23a3-static-apply-term
            less (list (p23a3-quoted zero) 'y))))
         (p23a3-static-apply-term
          less
          (list
           (p23a3-quoted zero)
           (p23a3-static-apply-term multiply '(x y)))))))))))

(defun p23a3-upper-bound-function
    (carrier less set upper)
  (list
   'lambda '(x)
   (p23a3-implies-term
    (p23a3-and-terms
     (list
      (p23a3-static-apply-term carrier '(x))
      (p23a3-static-apply-term set '(x))))
    (p23a3-not-term
     (p23a3-static-apply-term
      less (list (p23a3-quoted upper) 'x))))))

(defun p23a3-upper-bound-p
    (carrier less set upper)
  (and
   (p23a3-member-p carrier upper)
   (p23a3-valid-set-p carrier set)
   (p23a3-universal-p
    (p23a3-upper-bound-function carrier less set upper)
    '(x))))

(defun p23a3-set-nonempty-function (carrier set)
  (list
   'lambda '(x)
   (p23a3-and-terms
    (list
     (p23a3-static-apply-term carrier '(x))
     (p23a3-static-apply-term set '(x))))))

(defun p23a3-set-nonempty-p (carrier set)
  (and
   (p23a3-valid-set-p carrier set)
   (p23a3-exists-p
    (p23a3-set-nonempty-function carrier set)
    '(x))))

(defun p23a3-bounded-above-function
    (carrier less set)
  (list
   'lambda '(upper)
   (list 'p23a3-upper-bound-p
         (p23a3-quoted carrier)
         (p23a3-quoted less)
         (p23a3-quoted set)
         'upper)))

(defun p23a3-bounded-above-p (carrier less set)
  (p23a3-exists-p
   (p23a3-bounded-above-function carrier less set)
   '(upper)))

(defun p23a3-least-upper-bound-function
    (carrier less set supremum)
  (list
   'lambda '(upper)
   (p23a3-implies-term
    (list 'p23a3-upper-bound-p
          (p23a3-quoted carrier)
          (p23a3-quoted less)
          (p23a3-quoted set)
          'upper)
    (p23a3-not-term
     (p23a3-static-apply-term
      less (list 'upper (p23a3-quoted supremum)))))))

(defun p23a3-least-upper-bound-p
    (carrier less set supremum)
  (and
   (p23a3-upper-bound-p carrier less set supremum)
   (p23a3-universal-p
    (p23a3-least-upper-bound-function
     carrier less set supremum)
    '(upper))))

(defun p23a3-completeness-function
    (carrier less supremum-operation)
  (list
   'lambda '(set)
   (p23a3-implies-term
    (p23a3-and-terms
     (list
      (list 'p23a3-valid-set-p
            (p23a3-quoted carrier) 'set)
      (list 'p23a3-set-nonempty-p
            (p23a3-quoted carrier) 'set)
      (list 'p23a3-bounded-above-p
            (p23a3-quoted carrier)
            (p23a3-quoted less)
            'set)))
    (list 'p23a3-least-upper-bound-p
          (p23a3-quoted carrier)
          (p23a3-quoted less)
          'set
          (p23a3-static-apply-term
           supremum-operation '(set))))))

(defun p23a3-real-field-p
    (carrier zero one add multiply negate inverse less supremum)
  (and
   (tamep-functionp carrier)
   (tamep-functionp add)
   (tamep-functionp multiply)
   (tamep-functionp negate)
   (tamep-functionp inverse)
   (tamep-functionp less)
   (tamep-functionp supremum)
   (p23a3-member-p carrier zero)
   (p23a3-member-p carrier one)
   (not (equal zero one))
   (p23a3-universal-p
    (p23a3-field-laws-function
     carrier zero one add multiply negate inverse)
    '(x y z))
   (p23a3-universal-p
    (p23a3-order-laws-function
     carrier zero add multiply less)
    '(x y z))
   (p23a3-universal-p
    (p23a3-completeness-function
     carrier less supremum)
    '(set))
   (p23a3-binary-value less zero one)))

;; Real-field context and arithmetic.

(defun p23a3-r-carrier (ctx) (nth 0 ctx))
(defun p23a3-r-zero (ctx) (nth 1 ctx))
(defun p23a3-r-one (ctx) (nth 2 ctx))
(defun p23a3-r-add (ctx) (nth 3 ctx))
(defun p23a3-r-mul (ctx) (nth 4 ctx))
(defun p23a3-r-neg (ctx) (nth 5 ctx))
(defun p23a3-r-inv (ctx) (nth 6 ctx))
(defun p23a3-r-lt (ctx) (nth 7 ctx))
(defun p23a3-r-sup (ctx) (nth 8 ctx))

(defun p23a3-context-p (ctx)
  (and
   (true-listp ctx)
   (equal (len ctx) 9)
   (p23a3-real-field-p
    (p23a3-r-carrier ctx)
    (p23a3-r-zero ctx)
    (p23a3-r-one ctx)
    (p23a3-r-add ctx)
    (p23a3-r-mul ctx)
    (p23a3-r-neg ctx)
    (p23a3-r-inv ctx)
    (p23a3-r-lt ctx)
    (p23a3-r-sup ctx))))

(defun p23a3-r-add-value (ctx left right)
  (p23a3-binary-value (p23a3-r-add ctx) left right))

(defun p23a3-r-neg-value (ctx value)
  (p23a3-unary-value (p23a3-r-neg ctx) value))

(defun p23a3-r-sub-value (ctx left right)
  (p23a3-r-add-value
   ctx left (p23a3-r-neg-value ctx right)))

(defun p23a3-r-mul-value (ctx left right)
  (p23a3-binary-value (p23a3-r-mul ctx) left right))

(defun p23a3-r-inv-value (ctx value)
  (p23a3-unary-value (p23a3-r-inv ctx) value))

(defun p23a3-r-div-value (ctx numerator denominator)
  (p23a3-r-mul-value
   ctx numerator (p23a3-r-inv-value ctx denominator)))

(defun p23a3-r-lt-p (ctx left right)
  (if (p23a3-binary-value
       (p23a3-r-lt ctx) left right)
      t nil))

(defun p23a3-r-le-p (ctx left right)
  (not (p23a3-r-lt-p ctx right left)))

(defun p23a3-r-abs-value (ctx value)
  (if (p23a3-r-lt-p ctx value (p23a3-r-zero ctx))
      (p23a3-r-neg-value ctx value)
    value))

(defun p23a3-positive-real-p (ctx value)
  (and
   (p23a3-member-p (p23a3-r-carrier ctx) value)
   (p23a3-r-lt-p ctx (p23a3-r-zero ctx) value)))

(defun p23a3-nonnegative-real-p (ctx value)
  (and
   (p23a3-member-p (p23a3-r-carrier ctx) value)
   (p23a3-r-le-p ctx (p23a3-r-zero ctx) value)))
;; Real differentiability, expanded rather than left as an uninterpreted
;; analytic predicate.

(defun p23a3-real-derivative-nearby-function
    (ctx function point derivative epsilon radius)
  (let* ((fy (p23a3-static-apply-term function '(y)))
         (fx (p23a3-static-apply-term
              function (list (p23a3-quoted point))))
         (delta
          (list 'p23a3-r-sub-value
                (p23a3-quoted ctx)
                'y
                (p23a3-quoted point)))
         (error
          (list
           'p23a3-r-sub-value
           (p23a3-quoted ctx)
           (list
            'p23a3-r-sub-value
            (p23a3-quoted ctx)
            fy
            fx)
           (list
            'p23a3-r-mul-value
            (p23a3-quoted ctx)
            (p23a3-quoted derivative)
            delta))))
    (list
     'lambda '(y)
     (p23a3-implies-term
      (p23a3-and-terms
       (list
        (p23a3-static-apply-term
         (p23a3-r-carrier ctx) '(y))
        (list
         'p23a3-r-lt-p
         (p23a3-quoted ctx)
         (list
          'p23a3-r-abs-value
          (p23a3-quoted ctx)
          delta)
         (p23a3-quoted radius))))
      (list
       'p23a3-r-le-p
       (p23a3-quoted ctx)
       (list
        'p23a3-r-abs-value
        (p23a3-quoted ctx)
        error)
       (list
        'p23a3-r-mul-value
        (p23a3-quoted ctx)
        (p23a3-quoted epsilon)
        (list
         'p23a3-r-abs-value
         (p23a3-quoted ctx)
         delta)))))))

(defun p23a3-real-derivative-radius-function
    (ctx function point derivative epsilon)
  (list
   'lambda '(radius)
   (p23a3-and-terms
    (list
     (list 'p23a3-positive-real-p
           (p23a3-quoted ctx) 'radius)
     (list
      'p23a3-universal-p
      (list
       'p23a3-real-derivative-nearby-function
       (p23a3-quoted ctx)
       (p23a3-quoted function)
       (p23a3-quoted point)
       (p23a3-quoted derivative)
       (p23a3-quoted epsilon)
       'radius)
      (p23a3-quoted '(y)))))))

(defun p23a3-real-derivative-epsilon-function
    (ctx function point derivative)
  (list
   'lambda '(epsilon)
   (p23a3-implies-term
    (list 'p23a3-positive-real-p
          (p23a3-quoted ctx) 'epsilon)
    (list
     'p23a3-exists-p
     (list
      'p23a3-real-derivative-radius-function
      (p23a3-quoted ctx)
      (p23a3-quoted function)
      (p23a3-quoted point)
      (p23a3-quoted derivative)
      'epsilon)
     (p23a3-quoted '(radius))))))

(defun p23a3-real-has-derivative-at-p
    (ctx function point derivative)
  (and
   (p23a3-member-p (p23a3-r-carrier ctx) point)
   (p23a3-member-p (p23a3-r-carrier ctx) derivative)
   (p23a3-universal-p
    (p23a3-real-derivative-epsilon-function
     ctx function point derivative)
    '(epsilon))))

;; Sine and cosine are fixed by their initial values and differential system.

(defun p23a3-trigonometric-laws-function (ctx sine cosine)
  (list
   'lambda '(x)
   (p23a3-implies-term
    (p23a3-static-apply-term
     (p23a3-r-carrier ctx) '(x))
    (p23a3-and-terms
     (list
      (list
       'p23a3-real-has-derivative-at-p
       (p23a3-quoted ctx)
       (p23a3-quoted sine)
       'x
       (p23a3-static-apply-term cosine '(x)))
      (list
       'p23a3-real-has-derivative-at-p
       (p23a3-quoted ctx)
       (p23a3-quoted cosine)
       'x
       (list
        'p23a3-r-neg-value
        (p23a3-quoted ctx)
        (p23a3-static-apply-term sine '(x)))))))))

(defun p23a3-trigonometric-operations-p (ctx sine cosine)
  (and
   (p23a3-real-function-p
    (p23a3-r-carrier ctx) sine)
   (p23a3-real-function-p
    (p23a3-r-carrier ctx) cosine)
   (equal
    (p23a3-unary-value sine (p23a3-r-zero ctx))
    (p23a3-r-zero ctx))
   (equal
    (p23a3-unary-value cosine (p23a3-r-zero ctx))
    (p23a3-r-one ctx))
   (p23a3-universal-p
    (p23a3-trigonometric-laws-function ctx sine cosine)
    '(x))))

(defun p23a3-no-positive-sine-zero-below-function
    (ctx sine pi-value)
  (list
   'lambda '(x)
   (p23a3-implies-term
    (p23a3-and-terms
     (list
      (p23a3-static-apply-term
       (p23a3-r-carrier ctx) '(x))
      (list
       'p23a3-r-lt-p
       (p23a3-quoted ctx)
       (p23a3-quoted (p23a3-r-zero ctx))
       'x)
      (list
       'p23a3-r-lt-p
       (p23a3-quoted ctx)
       'x
       (p23a3-quoted pi-value))))
    (p23a3-not-term
     (list
      'equal
      (p23a3-static-apply-term sine '(x))
      (p23a3-quoted (p23a3-r-zero ctx)))))))

(defun p23a3-pi-value-p (ctx sine cosine pi-value)
  (and
   (p23a3-trigonometric-operations-p ctx sine cosine)
   (p23a3-positive-real-p ctx pi-value)
   (equal
    (p23a3-unary-value sine pi-value)
    (p23a3-r-zero ctx))
   (p23a3-universal-p
    (p23a3-no-positive-sine-zero-below-function
     ctx sine pi-value)
    '(x))))

;; At each real input, the derivative values are internal witnesses. This is
;; equivalent to using DERIV because a derivative, when it exists, is unique.

(defun p23a3-derivative-pair-witness-function
    (ctx f g point)
  (let ((f-point (p23a3-unary-value f point))
        (g-point (p23a3-unary-value g point)))
    (list
     'lambda '(f-prime g-prime)
     (p23a3-and-terms
      (list
       (p23a3-static-apply-term
        (p23a3-r-carrier ctx) '(f-prime))
       (p23a3-static-apply-term
        (p23a3-r-carrier ctx) '(g-prime))
       (list
        'p23a3-real-has-derivative-at-p
        (p23a3-quoted ctx)
        (p23a3-quoted f)
        (p23a3-quoted point)
        'f-prime)
       (list
        'p23a3-real-has-derivative-at-p
        (p23a3-quoted ctx)
        (p23a3-quoted g)
        (p23a3-quoted point)
        'g-prime)
       (list
        'p23a3-r-le-p
        (p23a3-quoted ctx)
        (list
         'p23a3-r-abs-value
         (p23a3-quoted ctx)
         'f-prime)
        (p23a3-quoted
         (p23a3-r-abs-value ctx g-point)))
       (list
        'p23a3-r-le-p
        (p23a3-quoted ctx)
        (list
         'p23a3-r-abs-value
         (p23a3-quoted ctx)
         'g-prime)
        (p23a3-quoted
         (p23a3-r-abs-value ctx f-point))))))))

(defun p23a3-derivative-bounds-at-p (ctx f g point)
  (p23a3-exists-p
   (p23a3-derivative-pair-witness-function
    ctx f g point)
   '(f-prime g-prime)))

(defun p23a3-all-points-function (ctx f g)
  (list
   'lambda '(x)
   (p23a3-implies-term
    (p23a3-static-apply-term
     (p23a3-r-carrier ctx) '(x))
    (list
     'p23a3-derivative-bounds-at-p
     (p23a3-quoted ctx)
     (p23a3-quoted f)
     (p23a3-quoted g)
     'x))))

(defun p23a3-admissible-functions-p (ctx f g r)
  (and
   (p23a3-real-function-p
    (p23a3-r-carrier ctx) f)
   (p23a3-real-function-p
    (p23a3-r-carrier ctx) g)
   (p23a3-positive-real-p
    ctx
    (p23a3-unary-value f (p23a3-r-zero ctx)))
   (equal
    (p23a3-unary-value g (p23a3-r-zero ctx))
    (p23a3-r-zero ctx))
   (equal
    (p23a3-unary-value f r)
    (p23a3-r-zero ctx))
   (p23a3-universal-p
    (p23a3-all-points-function ctx f g)
    '(x))))

(defun p23a3-admissible-witness-function (ctx r)
  (list
   'lambda '(f g)
   (list
    'p23a3-admissible-functions-p
    (p23a3-quoted ctx)
    'f
    'g
    (p23a3-quoted r))))

(defun p23a3-admissible-p (ctx r)
  (and
   (p23a3-member-p (p23a3-r-carrier ctx) r)
   (p23a3-exists-p
    (p23a3-admissible-witness-function ctx r)
    '(f g))))

(defun p23a3-no-smaller-admissible-function
    (ctx solution)
  (list
   'lambda '(t-value)
   (p23a3-implies-term
    (p23a3-and-terms
     (list
      (p23a3-static-apply-term
       (p23a3-r-carrier ctx) '(t-value))
      (list
       'p23a3-r-lt-p
       (p23a3-quoted ctx)
       (p23a3-quoted (p23a3-r-zero ctx))
       't-value)
      (list
       'p23a3-r-lt-p
       (p23a3-quoted ctx)
       't-value
       (p23a3-quoted solution))))
    (p23a3-not-term
     (list
      'p23a3-admissible-p
      (p23a3-quoted ctx)
      't-value)))))

(defun putnambench-putnam-2023-a3-statement
    (ctx sine cosine pi-value)
  (implies
   (and
    (p23a3-context-p ctx)
    (p23a3-pi-value-p ctx sine cosine pi-value))
   (let* ((two
           (p23a3-r-add-value
            ctx
            (p23a3-r-one ctx)
            (p23a3-r-one ctx)))
          (solution
           (p23a3-r-div-value ctx pi-value two)))
     (and
      (p23a3-positive-real-p ctx solution)
      (p23a3-admissible-p ctx solution)
      (p23a3-universal-p
       (p23a3-no-smaller-admissible-function
        ctx solution)
       '(t-value))))))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

-- Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2023_a3
-- (putnambench__agda__putnam_2023_a3): the least positive zero time for two
-- differentiable real functions satisfying reciprocal derivative bounds is
-- pi / 2. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module Main where

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; _*_)

infix 4 _!=_ _<=N_
infixr 3 _and_
infixr 2 _or_

data Bottom : Set where

Not : Set -> Set
Not A =
  A -> Bottom

_!=_ : {A : Set} -> A -> A -> Set
x != y =
  Not (x == y)

record _and_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data _or_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  left  : A -> A or B
  right : B -> A or B

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

data _<=N_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set where
  zero<=   : {n : Nat} -> zero <=N n
  suc<=suc : {m n : Nat} -> m <=N n -> suc m <=N suc n

record CompleteOrderedRealField (R : Set) : Set1 where
  field
    zeroR oneR : R
    add multiply : R -> R -> R
    negate inverse : R -> R
    lessOrEqual : R -> R -> Set
    fromNat : Nat -> R

    one-not-zero :
      oneR != zeroR

    add-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> add x y == add y x
    add-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      add (add x y) z == add x (add y z)
    add-zero :
      (x : R) -> add x zeroR == x
    add-inverse :
      (x : R) -> add x (negate x) == zeroR

    multiply-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> multiply x y == multiply y x
    multiply-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply (multiply x y) z ==
      multiply x (multiply y z)
    multiply-one :
      (x : R) -> multiply x oneR == x
    multiply-zero :
      (x : R) -> multiply x zeroR == zeroR
    distribute :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply x (add y z) ==
      add (multiply x y) (multiply x z)
    inverse-zero :
      inverse zeroR == zeroR
    multiply-inverse :
      (x : R) ->
      x != zeroR ->
      multiply x (inverse x) == oneR

    order-reflexive :
      (x : R) -> lessOrEqual x x
    order-transitive :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y z ->
      lessOrEqual x z
    order-antisymmetric :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y x ->
      x == y
    order-total :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y or lessOrEqual y x
    add-order :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual (add z x) (add z y)
    multiply-nonnegative :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR x ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR y ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR (multiply x y)
    zero-less-than-one :
      lessOrEqual zeroR oneR and zeroR != oneR

    fromNat-zero :
      fromNat zero == zeroR
    fromNat-successor :
      (n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (suc n) == add (fromNat n) oneR
    fromNat-addition :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m + n) == add (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-multiplication :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m * n) == multiply (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-injective :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat m == fromNat n ->
      m == n

    archimedean :
      (x : R) ->
      Exists Nat (\ n -> lessOrEqual x (fromNat n))
    least-upper-bound :
      (P : R -> Set) ->
      Exists R P ->
      Exists R
        (\ upper ->
          (x : R) ->
          P x ->
          lessOrEqual x upper) ->
      Exists R
        (\ supremum ->
          ((x : R) ->
            P x ->
            lessOrEqual x supremum)
          and
          ((upper : R) ->
            ((x : R) ->
              P x ->
              lessOrEqual x upper) ->
            lessOrEqual supremum upper))

open CompleteOrderedRealField

oneN : Nat
oneN =
  suc zero

twoN : Nat
twoN =
  suc oneN

fourN : Nat
fourN =
  twoN + twoN

subtract :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
subtract reals x y =
  add reals x (negate reals y)

divide :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
divide reals x y =
  multiply reals x (inverse reals y)

square :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R
square reals x =
  multiply reals x x

StrictLess :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
StrictLess reals x y =
  lessOrEqual reals x y and x != y

CloseTo :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
CloseTo reals center radius x =
  StrictLess reals
    (subtract reals center radius)
    x
  and
  StrictLess reals
    x
    (add reals center radius)

naturalPower :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  Nat ->
  R
naturalPower reals x zero =
  oneR reals
naturalPower reals x (suc n) =
  multiply reals
    (naturalPower reals x n)
    x

sumFirst :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Nat ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  R
sumFirst reals zero term =
  zeroR reals
sumFirst reals (suc n) term =
  add reals
    (sumFirst reals n term)
    (term n)

ConvergesTo :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  R ->
  Set
ConvergesTo {R} reals sequence limit =
  (epsilon : R) ->
  StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) epsilon ->
  Exists Nat
    (\ cutoff ->
      (n : Nat) ->
      cutoff <=N n ->
      CloseTo reals limit epsilon (sequence n))

SeriesHasSum :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  R ->
  Set
SeriesHasSum reals terms limit =
  ConvergesTo reals
    (\ n -> sumFirst reals n terms)
    limit

alternatingPower :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Nat ->
  R
alternatingPower reals n =
  naturalPower reals
    (negate reals (oneR reals))
    n

leibnizTerm :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Nat ->
  R
leibnizTerm reals n =
  divide reals
    (alternatingPower reals n)
    (fromNat reals (suc (twoN * n)))

record PiValue
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R)
  (value : R) : Set where
  field
    positive :
      StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) value
    leibniz-series :
      SeriesHasSum reals
        (leibnizTerm reals)
        (divide reals value (fromNat reals fourN))

differenceQuotient :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (R -> R) ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
differenceQuotient reals function point x =
  divide reals
    (subtract reals (function x) (function point))
    (subtract reals x point)

DerivativeAt :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (R -> R) ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
DerivativeAt {R} reals function point derivative-value =
  (epsilon : R) ->
  StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) epsilon ->
  Exists R
    (\ delta ->
      StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) delta
      and
      ((x : R) ->
        CloseTo reals point delta x ->
        x != point ->
        CloseTo reals derivative-value epsilon
          (differenceQuotient reals function point x)))

DifferentiableWithDerivative :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (R -> R) ->
  (R -> R) ->
  Set
DifferentiableWithDerivative {R} reals function derivative =
  (x : R) ->
  DerivativeAt reals function x (derivative x)

DerivativeBounds :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (R -> R) ->
  (R -> R) ->
  (R -> R) ->
  (R -> R) ->
  Set
DerivativeBounds {R} reals f g f' g' =
  (x : R) ->
  lessOrEqual reals
    (square reals (f' x))
    (square reals (g x))
  and
  lessOrEqual reals
    (square reals (g' x))
    (square reals (f x))

AdmissibleZeroTime :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  Set
AdmissibleZeroTime {R} reals r =
  Exists (R -> R)
    (\ f ->
      Exists (R -> R)
        (\ g ->
          Exists (R -> R)
            (\ f' ->
              Exists (R -> R)
                (\ g' ->
                  DifferentiableWithDerivative reals f f'
                  and
                  DifferentiableWithDerivative reals g g'
                  and
                  StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) (f (zeroR reals))
                  and
                  g (zeroR reals) == zeroR reals
                  and
                  DerivativeBounds reals f g f' g'
                  and
                  f r == zeroR reals))))

putnam-2023-a3 : Set1
putnam-2023-a3 =
  (R : Set) ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) ->
  (pi : R) ->
  PiValue reals pi ->
  let
    solution =
      divide reals pi (fromNat reals twoN)
  in
  (StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) solution
  and
  AdmissibleZeroTime reals solution)
  and
  ((t : R) ->
    StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) t ->
    StrictLess reals t solution ->
    Not (AdmissibleZeroTime reals t))

(*
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2023_a3:
  pi / 2 is the smallest positive real zero-time attainable by two globally
  differentiable real functions satisfying the coupled absolute derivative
  bounds and the stated initial conditions. This file contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open pred_setTheory realTheory real_topologyTheory transcTheory derivativeTheory;

val putnam_2023_a3 =
  ``let admissible =
      \r : real.
        ?f g : real -> real.
          f differentiable_on UNIV /\
          g differentiable_on UNIV /\
          f 0 > 0 /\
          g 0 = 0 /\
          (!x : real.
             abs (vector_derivative f (at x)) <= abs (g x) /\
             abs (vector_derivative g (at x)) <= abs (f x)) /\
          f r = 0
    in
    let solution = (pi / 2 : real)
    in
      0 < solution /\
      admissible solution /\
      (!r : real.
         0 < r /\ r < solution
         ==>
         ~admissible r)``;

$(
  P23A3Feasible r keeps the two total real functions existentially
  quantified. The domain conditions say that each function is
  differentiable at every real point, and the following restricted
  universal states both absolute-value derivative inequalities pointwise.

  The final conjunction is the attained-minimum expansion of the source
  problem: pi/2 is positive and feasible, and it is no greater than every

$c P23A3Feasible $.

p23a3-feasible-syntax $a wff ( P23A3Feasible r ) $.

${
  $d f g r x $.

  p23a3-feasible-definition $a |- (
    ( P23A3Feasible r )
    <->
    E. f e. ( RR ^m RR )
      E. g e. ( RR ^m RR )
        (
          (
            RR C_ dom ( RR _D f )

            RR C_ dom ( RR _D g )
          )
          /\
          (
            (
              0 < ( f ` 0 )
              /\
              ( g ` 0 ) = 0

            /\
            (
              A. x e. RR
                (
                  (
                    abs ` ( ( RR _D f ) ` x )
                  )
                  <_
                  ( abs ` ( g ` x ) )
                  /\
                  (
                    abs ` ( ( RR _D g ) ` x )
                  )
                  <_
                  ( abs ` ( f ` x ) )
                )
              /\
              ( f ` r ) = 0
            )
          )
        )
  ) $.
$}

putnambench-putnam-2023-a3 $a |- (
  (
    0 < ( _pi / 2 )
    /\
    ( P23A3Feasible ( _pi / 2 ) )
  )

      )

title: putnam_2023_a3
content:
% Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2023_a3:
% pi/2 is the least positive zero time attainable by globally differentiable
% real functions satisfying the stated mutual derivative bounds. This file
% contains no proof.

putnam_2023_a3: THEORY
BEGIN
  real_function: TYPE = [real -> real]
  real_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> real]

  alternating_sign(index: nat): RECURSIVE real =
    IF index = 0 THEN
      1
    ELSE
      -alternating_sign(index - 1)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE index

  leibniz_partial_sum(count: nat): RECURSIVE real =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      LET index: nat = count - 1 IN
        leibniz_partial_sum(count - 1)
          + alternating_sign(index)
              / ((2 * index + 1) :: real)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  converges_to(sequence: real_sequence, value: real): bool =
    FORALL (epsilon_value: posreal):
      EXISTS (cutoff: nat):
        FORALL (index: nat):
          cutoff <= index IMPLIES
            abs(sequence(index) - value) < epsilon_value

  is_pi(value: real): bool =
    converges_to(
      LAMBDA (count: nat):
        4 * leibniz_partial_sum(count),
      value)

  pi: real =
    epsilon(
      LAMBDA (value: real):
        is_pi(value))

  has_derivative_at(
      f: real_function,
      derivative, x: real): bool =
    FORALL (epsilon_value: posreal):
      EXISTS (delta: posreal):
        FORALL (h: real):
          (h /= 0 AND abs(h) < delta)
            IMPLIES
              abs(
                f(x + h) - f(x)
                  - derivative * h)
                < epsilon_value * abs(h)

  differentiable_with_derivative(
      f, derivative: real_function): bool =
    FORALL (x: real):
      has_derivative_at(f, derivative(x), x)

  admissible_zero_time(r: real): bool =
    EXISTS (f, g, f_derivative, g_derivative: real_function):
      differentiable_with_derivative(f, f_derivative)
        AND differentiable_with_derivative(g, g_derivative)
        AND f(0) > 0
        AND g(0) = 0
        AND (FORALL (x: real):
          abs(f_derivative(x)) <= abs(g(x))
            AND abs(g_derivative(x)) <= abs(f(x)))
        AND f(r) = 0

  is_least_positive_admissible(value: real): bool =
    value > 0
      AND admissible_zero_time(value)
      AND (FORALL (r: real):
        (r > 0 AND admissible_zero_time(r))
          IMPLIES value <= r)

  putnam_2023_a3_solution: real = pi / 2

  putnam_2023_a3: bool =
    is_least_positive_admissible(
      putnam_2023_a3_solution)
END putnam_2023_a3

title: putnam_2023_a4
content:
import Mathlib

/--
Let $v_1, \ldots, v_{12}$ be unit vectors in $\mathbb{R}^3$ from the origin to the vertices of a regular icosahedron. Show that for every vector $v \in \mathbb{R}^3$ and every $\epsilon > 0$, there exist integers $a_1, \ldots, a_{12}$ such that $\|a_1v_1 + \cdots + a_{12}v_{12} - v\| < ε$.
-/
theorem putnam_2023_a4
    (v : Fin 12 → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3))
    (hv :
      letI φ : ℝ := (1 + √5) / 2
      letI e : (Fin 3 → ℝ) ≃ EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3) := (WithLp.equiv _ _).symm
      letI s := √(1 + φ ^ 2)
      ∃ g : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3) ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3),
      g ∘ v = s⁻¹ • e ∘ ![![1, φ, 0], ![-1,  φ,  0], ![ 1, -φ,  0], ![-1, -φ,  0],
                          ![φ, 0, 1], ![ φ,  0, -1], ![-φ,  0,  1], ![-φ,  0, -1],
                          ![0, 1, φ], ![ 0, -1,  φ], ![ 0,  1, -φ], ![ 0, -1, -φ]])
    (w : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3))
    (ε : ℝ) (hε : ε > 0) :
    ∃ a : Fin 12 → ℤ, ‖∑ i, a i • v i - w‖ < ε :=
  sorry

title: putnam_2023_a4
putnam_2023_a4
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench artifact putnam_2023_a4,
  concerning density of integer linear combinations of the twelve unit vectors
  pointing to the vertices of a regular icosahedron in real three-space. This
  file contains no proof.
*)

theory putnam_2023_a4
  imports Complex_Main
begin

datatype putnam_2023_a4_vertex =
    V0 | V1 | V2 | V3 | V4 | V5 | V6 | V7 | V8 | V9 | V10 | V11

type_synonym putnam_2023_a4_point = "real \<times> real \<times> real"

definition putnam_2023_a4_phi :: real where
  "putnam_2023_a4_phi = (1 + sqrt 5) / 2"

definition putnam_2023_a4_add ::
    "putnam_2023_a4_point \<Rightarrow> putnam_2023_a4_point \<Rightarrow>
      putnam_2023_a4_point" where
  "putnam_2023_a4_add p q =
    (fst p + fst q,
      fst (snd p) + fst (snd q),
      snd (snd p) + snd (snd q))"

definition putnam_2023_a4_subtract ::
    "putnam_2023_a4_point \<Rightarrow> putnam_2023_a4_point \<Rightarrow>
      putnam_2023_a4_point" where
  "putnam_2023_a4_subtract p q =
    (fst p - fst q,
      fst (snd p) - fst (snd q),
      snd (snd p) - snd (snd q))"

definition putnam_2023_a4_scale ::
    "real \<Rightarrow> putnam_2023_a4_point \<Rightarrow> putnam_2023_a4_point" where
  "putnam_2023_a4_scale c p =
    (c * fst p, c * fst (snd p), c * snd (snd p))"

definition putnam_2023_a4_norm :: "putnam_2023_a4_point \<Rightarrow> real" where
  "putnam_2023_a4_norm p =
    sqrt (fst p ^ 2 + fst (snd p) ^ 2 + snd (snd p) ^ 2)"

fun putnam_2023_a4_raw_vertex ::
    "putnam_2023_a4_vertex \<Rightarrow> putnam_2023_a4_point" where
  "putnam_2023_a4_raw_vertex V0 = (1, putnam_2023_a4_phi, 0)"
| "putnam_2023_a4_raw_vertex V1 = (-1, putnam_2023_a4_phi, 0)"
| "putnam_2023_a4_raw_vertex V2 = (1, -putnam_2023_a4_phi, 0)"
| "putnam_2023_a4_raw_vertex V3 = (-1, -putnam_2023_a4_phi, 0)"
| "putnam_2023_a4_raw_vertex V4 = (putnam_2023_a4_phi, 0, 1)"
| "putnam_2023_a4_raw_vertex V5 = (putnam_2023_a4_phi, 0, -1)"
| "putnam_2023_a4_raw_vertex V6 = (-putnam_2023_a4_phi, 0, 1)"
| "putnam_2023_a4_raw_vertex V7 = (-putnam_2023_a4_phi, 0, -1)"
| "putnam_2023_a4_raw_vertex V8 = (0, 1, putnam_2023_a4_phi)"
| "putnam_2023_a4_raw_vertex V9 = (0, -1, putnam_2023_a4_phi)"
| "putnam_2023_a4_raw_vertex V10 = (0, 1, -putnam_2023_a4_phi)"
| "putnam_2023_a4_raw_vertex V11 = (0, -1, -putnam_2023_a4_phi)"

definition putnam_2023_a4_icosahedron_vertex ::
    "putnam_2023_a4_vertex \<Rightarrow> putnam_2023_a4_point" where
  "putnam_2023_a4_icosahedron_vertex i =
    putnam_2023_a4_scale
      (inverse (sqrt (1 + putnam_2023_a4_phi ^ 2)))
      (putnam_2023_a4_raw_vertex i)"

definition putnam_2023_a4_linear_isometry ::
    "(putnam_2023_a4_point \<Rightarrow> putnam_2023_a4_point) \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "putnam_2023_a4_linear_isometry g \<longleftrightarrow>
    (\<forall>x y. g (putnam_2023_a4_add x y) =
      putnam_2023_a4_add (g x) (g y)) \<and>
    (\<forall>c x. g (putnam_2023_a4_scale c x) =
      putnam_2023_a4_scale c (g x)) \<and>
    bij g \<and>
    (\<forall>x. putnam_2023_a4_norm (g x) = putnam_2023_a4_norm x)"

definition putnam_2023_a4_integer_combination ::
    "(putnam_2023_a4_vertex \<Rightarrow> int) \<Rightarrow>
      (putnam_2023_a4_vertex \<Rightarrow> putnam_2023_a4_point) \<Rightarrow>
      putnam_2023_a4_point" where
  "putnam_2023_a4_integer_combination a v =
    ((\<Sum>i\<in>UNIV. real_of_int (a i) * fst (v i)),
      (\<Sum>i\<in>UNIV. real_of_int (a i) * fst (snd (v i))),
      (\<Sum>i\<in>UNIV. real_of_int (a i) * snd (snd (v i))))"

theorem putnam_2023_a4:
  fixes v :: "putnam_2023_a4_vertex \<Rightarrow> putnam_2023_a4_point"
    and w :: putnam_2023_a4_point
    and epsilon :: real
  assumes hv:
    "\<exists>g. putnam_2023_a4_linear_isometry g \<and>
      (\<forall>i. g (v i) = putnam_2023_a4_icosahedron_vertex i)"
    and hepsilon: "epsilon > 0"
  shows "\<exists>a :: putnam_2023_a4_vertex \<Rightarrow> int.
    putnam_2023_a4_norm
      (putnam_2023_a4_subtract
        (putnam_2023_a4_integer_combination a v) w) < epsilon"
  sorry

end
