(*
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2023_b1
  (putnambench__hol-light__putnam_2023_b1): the number of configurations
  reachable by legal diagonal coin slides on an m-by-n grid. This file
  contains no proof.
*)

let binomial_output = open_out "/dev/null";;
let binomial_formatter = Format.formatter_of_out_channel binomial_output;;
let binomial_loaded =
  Toploop.use_file binomial_formatter "Library/binomial.ml";;
Format.pp_print_flush binomial_formatter ();;
close_out binomial_output;;
if not binomial_loaded then failwith "failed to load Library/binomial.ml";;

let statement =
  `let initial =
     \(m:num) (n:num) (i:num) (j:num).
       i <= m - 2 /\ j <= n - 2 in
   let legal_move =
     \(m:num) (n:num)
      (coins1:num->num->bool) (coins2:num->num->bool).
       ?i j:num.
         i < m - 1 /\ j < n - 1 /\
         coins1 i j /\
         ~(coins1 (i + 1) j) /\
         ~(coins1 i (j + 1)) /\
         ~(coins1 (i + 1) (j + 1)) /\
         ~(coins2 i j) /\
         ~(coins2 (i + 1) j) /\
         ~(coins2 i (j + 1)) /\
         coins2 (i + 1) (j + 1) /\
         (!i' j':num.
            ~((i',j') = (i,j)) /\
            ~((i',j') = (i + 1,j)) /\
            ~((i',j') = (i,j + 1)) /\
            ~((i',j') = (i + 1,j + 1))
            ==> coins1 i' j' = coins2 i' j') in
   let legal_sequence =
     \(m:num) (n:num) (seq:(num->num->bool)list).
       ~(seq = []) /\
       HD seq = initial m n /\
       (!k:num.
          k + 1 < LENGTH seq
          ==> legal_move m n (EL k seq) (EL (k + 1) seq)) in
   !m n:num.
     1 < m /\ 1 < n
     ==>
     CARD
       {config:num->num->bool |
          ?seq:(num->num->bool)list.
            legal_sequence m n seq /\ config = LAST seq} =
     binom (m + n - 2,m - 1)`;;

title: putnam_2023_b1
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2023_b1:
;; the number of coin configurations reachable by diagonal legal moves on an
;; m-by-n grid is choose(m+n-2,m-1). This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))

;; The problem text and Lean source existentially bind the finite legal
;; sequence. The free SEQ in the Isabelle set comprehension is read as the
;; corresponding omitted existential binder; the fixed-sequence reading would
;; count at most one configuration and does not express the stated problem.
;;
;; A board bitmask is in bijection with the total Boolean configurations that
;; can be reached from INITCOINS. Initially every coordinate outside the finite
;; m-by-n grid is false, and each legal move changes only two coordinates
;; inside that grid, so every reachable total function remains false outside
;; the grid. Bit (i*n+j) records the value at (i,j).
;;
;; MOVE-AT is the full source successor, not a weakened move relation:
;; LEGAL-AT-P requires the source coin and the three empty neighboring cells;
;; subtracting the source bit and adding the diagonal bit makes the first
;; three target cells empty and the diagonal target cell occupied. Every other
;; bit is unchanged, which is exactly the source's universal frame condition.

(defun putnam-2023-b1-insert-board (board boards)
  (if (member-equal board boards)
      boards
    (cons board boards)))

(defun putnam-2023-b1-initial-board-aux
    (n columns index remaining)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix remaining)))
  (if (zp remaining)
      0
    (let* ((row (floor (nfix index) (nfix columns)))
           (column (mod (nfix index) (nfix columns)))
           (bit (+ (* row (nfix n)) column)))
      (+ (expt 2 bit)
         (putnam-2023-b1-initial-board-aux
          n columns (+ 1 (nfix index)) (- remaining 1))))))

(defun putnam-2023-b1-initial-board (m n)
  (let ((rows (nfix (- (nfix m) 1)))
        (columns (nfix (- (nfix n) 1))))
    (if (or (zp rows) (zp columns))
        0
      (putnam-2023-b1-initial-board-aux
       n columns 0 (* rows columns)))))

(defun putnam-2023-b1-bit-index (n row column)
  (+ (* (nfix row) (nfix n))
     (nfix column)))

(defun putnam-2023-b1-occupied-p (board n row column)
  (and (natp board)
       (logbitp
        (putnam-2023-b1-bit-index n row column)
        board)))

(defun putnam-2023-b1-legal-at-p (board m n row column)
  (and
   (natp board)
   (natp m)
   (natp n)
   (natp row)
   (natp column)
   (< row (- m 1))
   (< column (- n 1))
   (putnam-2023-b1-occupied-p board n row column)
   (not
    (putnam-2023-b1-occupied-p
     board n (+ row 1) column))
   (not
    (putnam-2023-b1-occupied-p
     board n row (+ column 1)))
   (not
    (putnam-2023-b1-occupied-p
     board n (+ row 1) (+ column 1)))))

(defun putnam-2023-b1-move-at (board n row column)
  (+ (- (nfix board)
        (expt
         2
         (putnam-2023-b1-bit-index n row column)))
     (expt
      2
      (putnam-2023-b1-bit-index
       n (+ row 1) (+ column 1)))))

(defun putnam-2023-b1-collect-moves
    (board m n columns index remaining boards)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix remaining)))
  (if (zp remaining)
      boards
    (let* ((row (floor (nfix index) (nfix columns)))
           (column (mod (nfix index) (nfix columns)))
           (next-boards
            (if (putnam-2023-b1-legal-at-p
                 board m n row column)
                (putnam-2023-b1-insert-board
                 (putnam-2023-b1-move-at
                  board n row column)
                 boards)
              boards)))
      (putnam-2023-b1-collect-moves
       board
       m
       n
       columns
       (+ 1 (nfix index))
       (- remaining 1)
       next-boards))))

(defun putnam-2023-b1-successors (board m n boards)
  (let ((rows (nfix (- (nfix m) 1)))
        (columns (nfix (- (nfix n) 1))))
    (if (or (zp rows) (zp columns))
        boards
      (putnam-2023-b1-collect-moves
       board m n columns 0 (* rows columns) boards))))

(defun putnam-2023-b1-expand (frontier m n boards)
  (if (consp frontier)
      (putnam-2023-b1-expand
       (cdr frontier)
       m
       n
       (putnam-2023-b1-successors
        (car frontier) m n boards))
    boards))

;; There are at most 2^(m*n) boards. Any reachable board has a simple legal
;; path with fewer vertices than this, so this finite closure is equivalent in
;; both directions to existence of an arbitrary finite legal sequence.
(defun putnam-2023-b1-reachable-closure
    (boards m n fuel)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix fuel)))
  (if (zp fuel)
      boards
    (let ((expanded
           (putnam-2023-b1-expand boards m n boards)))
      (if (equal expanded boards)
          boards
        (putnam-2023-b1-reachable-closure
         expanded m n (- fuel 1))))))

(defun putnam-2023-b1-configuration-limit (m n)
  (expt 2 (* (nfix m) (nfix n))))

(defun putnam-2023-b1-reachable-count (m n)
  (len
   (putnam-2023-b1-reachable-closure
    (list (putnam-2023-b1-initial-board m n))
    m
    n
    (putnam-2023-b1-configuration-limit m n))))

(defun putnam-2023-b1-choose (total selected)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix total)))
  (cond
   ((zp selected) 1)
   ((zp total) 0)
   (t
    (+ (putnam-2023-b1-choose
        (- total 1) (- selected 1))
       (putnam-2023-b1-choose
        (- total 1) selected)))))

(defun putnambench-putnam-2023-b1-statement (m n)
  (implies
   (and
    (natp m)
    (natp n)
    (< 1 m)
    (< 1 n))
   (equal
    (putnam-2023-b1-reachable-count m n)
    (putnam-2023-b1-choose
     (- (+ m n) 2)
     (- m 1)))))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

title: putnam_2023_b1
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2023_b1
-- (putnambench__agda__putnam_2023_b1): the number of extensionally distinct
-- coin configurations reachable by diagonal legal moves on an m-by-n grid is
-- the binomial coefficient (m+n-2 choose m-1). This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module Putnam2023B1 where

open import Agda.Builtin.Bool using (Bool; false; true)
open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; _-_)

infix 4 _<N_
infixr 3 _and_

record _and_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data Bottom : Set where

Not : Set -> Set
Not A =
  A -> Bottom

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

data _<N_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set where
  zero-less-successor :
    {n : Nat} ->
    zero <N suc n
  successor-less-successor :
    {m n : Nat} ->
    m <N n ->
    suc m <N suc n

data Fin : Nat -> Set where
  fzero : {n : Nat} -> Fin (suc n)
  fsuc  : {n : Nat} -> Fin n -> Fin (suc n)

one : Nat
one =
  suc zero

two : Nat
two =
  suc one

pred : Nat -> Nat
pred zero =
  zero
pred (suc n) =
  n

boolAnd : Bool -> Bool -> Bool
boolAnd false right =
  false
boolAnd true right =
  right

lessThanBool : Nat -> Nat -> Bool
lessThanBool zero zero =
  false
lessThanBool zero (suc n) =
  true
lessThanBool (suc m) zero =
  false
lessThanBool (suc m) (suc n) =
  lessThanBool m n

choose : Nat -> Nat -> Nat
choose zero zero =
  one
choose zero (suc k) =
  zero
choose (suc n) zero =
  one
choose (suc n) (suc k) =
  choose n k + choose n (suc k)

Configuration : Set
Configuration =
  Nat -> Nat -> Bool

SameConfiguration :
  Configuration ->
  Configuration ->
  Set
SameConfiguration left right =
  (i j : Nat) ->
  left i j == right i j

initialConfiguration :
  Nat ->
  Nat ->
  Configuration
initialConfiguration m n i j =
  boolAnd
    (lessThanBool i (pred m))
    (lessThanBool j (pred n))

DifferentSquare :
  Nat ->
  Nat ->
  Nat ->
  Nat ->
  Set
DifferentSquare i1 j1 i2 j2 =
  Not ((i1 == i2) and (j1 == j2))

record LegalMove
  (m n : Nat)
  (before after : Configuration) :
  Set where

  field
    row :
      Nat
    column :
      Nat
    row-in-range :
      row <N pred m
    column-in-range :
      column <N pred n

    before-source-occupied :
      before row column == true
    before-south-empty :
      before (suc row) column == false
    before-east-empty :
      before row (suc column) == false
    before-southeast-empty :
      before (suc row) (suc column) == false

    after-source-empty :
      after row column == false
    after-south-empty :
      after (suc row) column == false
    after-east-empty :
      after row (suc column) == false
    after-southeast-occupied :
      after (suc row) (suc column) == true

    unchanged-elsewhere :
      (i j : Nat) ->
      DifferentSquare i j row column ->
      DifferentSquare i j (suc row) column ->
      DifferentSquare i j row (suc column) ->
      DifferentSquare i j (suc row) (suc column) ->
      before i j == after i j

data Reachable
  (m n : Nat) :
  Configuration ->
  Set where

  initial-reachable :
    Reachable m n (initialConfiguration m n)

  move-reachable :
    {before after : Configuration} ->
    Reachable m n before ->
    LegalMove m n before after ->
    Reachable m n after

record HasExtensionalCardinality
  {A : Set}
  (equivalent : A -> A -> Set)
  (member : A -> Set)
  (cardinality : Nat) :
  Set where

  field
    enumerate :
      Fin cardinality ->
      A

    enumerated-member :
      (index : Fin cardinality) ->
      member (enumerate index)

    enumeration-complete :
      (item : A) ->
      member item ->
      Exists (Fin cardinality)
        (\ index -> equivalent item (enumerate index))

    enumeration-injective :
      (left-index right-index : Fin cardinality) ->
      equivalent (enumerate left-index) (enumerate right-index) ->
      left-index == right-index

putnam-2023-b1 : Set
putnam-2023-b1 =
  (m n : Nat) ->
  zero <N m ->
  zero <N n ->
  HasExtensionalCardinality
    SameConfiguration
    (Reachable m n)
    (choose ((m + n) - two) (m - one))

title: putnam_2023_b1
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2023_b1:
  the number of configurations reachable by diagonal legal moves from the
  initial coin configuration on an m-by-n grid is the stated binomial
  coefficient. This file contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open arithmeticTheory combinatoricsTheory listTheory pairTheory pred_setTheory;

val putnam_2023_b1 =
  ``!m n : num.
      0 < m /\ 0 < n
      ==>
      let initcoins =
        \i j : num. i < m - 1 /\ j < n - 1
      in
      let legalmove =
        \coins1 coins2 : num -> num -> bool.
          ?i j : num.
            i < m - 1 /\
            j < n - 1 /\
            coins1 i j /\
            ~coins1 (i + 1) j /\
            ~coins1 i (j + 1) /\
            ~coins1 (i + 1) (j + 1) /\
            ~coins2 i j /\
            ~coins2 (i + 1) j /\
            ~coins2 i (j + 1) /\
            coins2 (i + 1) (j + 1) /\
            (!i' j' : num.
               (i', j') <> (i, j) /\
               (i', j') <> (i + 1, j) /\
               (i', j') <> (i, j + 1) /\
               (i', j') <> (i + 1, j + 1)
               ==>
               coins1 i' j' = coins2 i' j')
      in
      let legalseq =
        \seq : (num -> num -> bool) list.
          seq <> [] /\
          EL 0 seq = initcoins /\
          (!i : num.
             SUC i < LENGTH seq
             ==>
             legalmove (EL i seq) (EL (SUC i) seq))
      in
        {config : num -> num -> bool |
           ?seq : (num -> num -> bool) list.
             legalseq seq /\ config = LAST seq}
        HAS_SIZE binomial (m + n - 2) (m - 1)``;

title: putnam_2023_b1
content:
$(
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact
  putnam_2023_b1: the number of coin configurations reachable by diagonal
  legal moves on an m-by-n grid is the binomial coefficient
  (m+n-2 choose m-1). This file contains no proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  P23B1States is the full function space from NN0 X. NN0 to {0,1}.
  Replacing a curried Bool-valued function by its uncurried {0,1}-valued
  function is a bijective relabeling and preserves the source's infinite
  ambient domain. P23B1Init m n is 1 exactly on the initial rectangle
  i < m-1 and j < n-1.

  P23B1Move m n C D expands one legal move: a 1 at (i,j), with the other
  three cells of its southeast unit square equal to 0, is moved to
  (i+1,j+1), and every other value is unchanged. P23B1Game m n G is a
  nonempty finite word of states beginning at P23B1Init m n and related
  by P23B1Move at every consecutive pair. A one-state word represents the
  possibly empty move sequence.

  The restricted class in the final assertion is therefore exactly the
  set of reachable configurations. Set.mm's # is finite cardinality here,
  and _C is the binomial-coefficient operation. The final declaration
  inlines the solution annotation from the Lean and Isabelle sources.
  Every declaration is an unproved $a statement encoding; this database
  contains no $p proof declaration.
$)

$c P23B1States P23B1Init P23B1Move P23B1Game $.

p23b1-states-syntax $a class P23B1States $.
p23b1-init-syntax $a class ( P23B1Init m n ) $.
p23b1-move-syntax $a wff ( P23B1Move m n C D ) $.
p23b1-game-syntax $a wff ( P23B1Game m n G ) $.

p23b1-states-definition $a |-
  P23B1States = ( { 0 , 1 } ^m ( NN0 X. NN0 ) )
$.

${
  $d m n x $.

  p23b1-init-definition $a |- ( P23B1Init m n ) =
    ( x e. ( NN0 X. NN0 ) |->
      if
      (
        (
          ( 1st ` x ) < ( m - 1 )
          /\
          ( 2nd ` x ) < ( n - 1 )
        ) ,
        1 ,
        0
      )
    )
  $.
$}

${
  $d C D i j m n x $.

  p23b1-move-definition $a |- (
    ( P23B1Move m n C D )
    <->
    E. i e. NN0 E. j e. NN0
      (
        i < ( m - 1 )
        /\
        (
          j < ( n - 1 )
          /\
          (
            ( C ` <. i , j >. ) = 1
            /\
            (
              ( C ` <. ( i + 1 ) , j >. ) = 0
              /\
              (
                ( C ` <. i , ( j + 1 ) >. ) = 0
                /\
                (
                  ( C ` <. ( i + 1 ) , ( j + 1 ) >. ) = 0
                  /\
                  (
                    ( D ` <. i , j >. ) = 0
                    /\
                    (
                      ( D ` <. ( i + 1 ) , j >. ) = 0
                      /\
                      (
                        ( D ` <. i , ( j + 1 ) >. ) = 0
                        /\
                        (
                          ( D ` <. ( i + 1 ) , ( j + 1 ) >. ) = 1
                          /\
                          A. x e. ( NN0 X. NN0 )
                            (
                              (
                                x =/= <. i , j >.
                                /\
                                (
                                  x =/= <. ( i + 1 ) , j >.
                                  /\
                                  (
                                    x =/= <. i , ( j + 1 ) >.
                                    /\
                                    x =/= <. ( i + 1 ) , ( j + 1 ) >.
                                  )
                                )
                              )
                              ->
                              ( C ` x ) = ( D ` x )
                            )
                        )
                      )
                    )
                  )
                )
              )
            )
          )
        )
      )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d G i m n $.

  p23b1-game-definition $a |- (
    ( P23B1Game m n G )
    <->
    (
      G e. ( Word P23B1States \ { (/) } )
      /\
      (
        ( G ` 0 ) = ( P23B1Init m n )
        /\
        A. i e. ( 0 ..^ ( ( # ` G ) - 1 ) )
          (
            P23B1Move
              m
              n
              ( G ` i )
              ( G ` ( i + 1 ) )
          )
      )
    )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d C G m n $.

  putnambench-putnam-2023-b1 $a |-
    A. m e. NN0 A. n e. NN0
      (
        (
          1 < m
          /\
          1 < n
        )
        ->
        (
          #
          `
          {
            C e. P23B1States |
            E. G e. ( Word P23B1States \ { (/) } )
              (
                ( P23B1Game m n G )
                /\
                C = ( G ` ( ( # ` G ) - 1 ) )
              )
          }
        )
        =
        ( ( m + n - 2 ) _C ( m - 1 ) )
      )
  $.
$}

:: (putnambench__mizar__putnam_2023_b1): the number of coin configurations
:: reachable by diagonal slides on an m-by-n grid is a binomial coefficient.
:: This file contains no proof.

environ
  vocabularies TARSKI, XBOOLE_0, SUBSET_1, ZFMISC_1, RELAT_1, FUNCT_1,
    FUNCT_2, NUMBERS, NAT_1, CARD_1, XCMPLX_0, XREAL_0, XXREAL_0,
    ORDINAL1, FINSET_1, FINSEQ_1, FINSEQ_2, CARD_3, ARYTM_1, ARYTM_3,
    NEWTON;
  notations TARSKI, XBOOLE_0, SUBSET_1, ZFMISC_1, ORDINAL1, CARD_1,
    NUMBERS, XCMPLX_0, XREAL_0, XXREAL_0, NAT_1, NAT_D, RELAT_1,
    FUNCT_1, RELSET_1, PARTFUN1, FUNCT_2, FINSEQ_1, FINSEQ_2, FINSET_1,
    NEWTON;
  constructors RELSET_1, PARTFUN1, FUNCT_2, FINSEQ_1, FINSEQ_2,
    FINSEQ_4, NAT_1, NAT_D, FINSET_1, NEWTON;
  registrations XBOOLE_0, SUBSET_1, RELAT_1, FUNCT_1, RELSET_1,
    FUNCT_2, PARTFUN1, FINSEQ_1, FINSEQ_2, ORDINAL1, CARD_1, NUMBERS,
    XCMPLX_0, XREAL_0, XXREAL_0, NAT_1, FINSET_1, MEMBERED, FRAENKEL,
    NEWTON;
  requirements REAL, NUMERALS, SUBSET, BOOLE, ARITHM;
  definitions TARSKI, XBOOLE_0;
  equalities FINSEQ_1;
  expansions TARSKI, XBOOLE_0, FINSEQ_1;

begin

::$P-
theorem
  for m,n being Nat st 0 < m & 0 < n holds
    card {config where config is Subset of [:NAT,NAT:] :
      ex seq being FinSequence of bool [:NAT,NAT:] st
        0 < len seq &
        seq.1 =
          {[i,j] where i,j is Nat :
            i < m -' 1 & j < n -' 1} &
        (for k being Nat st 1 <= k & k < len seq holds
          ex i,j being Nat st
            i < m -' 1 & j < n -' 1 &
            [i,j] in seq.k &
            not [i + 1,j] in seq.k &
            not [i,j + 1] in seq.k &
            not [i + 1,j + 1] in seq.k &
            not [i,j] in seq.(k + 1) &
            not [i + 1,j] in seq.(k + 1) &
            not [i,j + 1] in seq.(k + 1) &
            [i + 1,j + 1] in seq.(k + 1) &
            (for x,y being Nat st
              [x,y] <> [i,j] &
              [x,y] <> [i + 1,j] &
              [x,y] <> [i,j + 1] &
              [x,y] <> [i + 1,j + 1]
            holds
              ([x,y] in seq.k iff [x,y] in seq.(k + 1)))) &
        config = seq.(len seq)}
    = (m + n -' 2) choose (m -' 1)
proof
end;
::$P+

title: putnam_2023_b1
content:
% Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2023_b1:
% the configurations reachable by diagonal legal coin moves on an m-by-n
% grid are counted by the binomial coefficient (m+n-2 choose m-1). This file
% contains no proof.

putnam_2023_b1: THEORY
BEGIN
  configuration: TYPE = [nat, nat -> bool]
  configuration_set: TYPE = [configuration -> bool]
  configuration_enumeration: TYPE = [nat -> configuration]
  history: TYPE = list[configuration]

  initial_configuration(m, n: nat): configuration =
    LAMBDA (i, j: nat):
      i < m - 1 AND j < n - 1

  legal_move(
      m, n: nat,
      before, after: configuration): bool =
    EXISTS (i, j: nat):
      i < m - 1
        AND j < n - 1
        AND before(i, j)
        AND NOT before(i + 1, j)
        AND NOT before(i, j + 1)
        AND NOT before(i + 1, j + 1)
        AND NOT after(i, j)
        AND NOT after(i + 1, j)
        AND NOT after(i, j + 1)
        AND after(i + 1, j + 1)
        AND (FORALL (i_prime, j_prime: nat):
          ((i_prime /= i OR j_prime /= j)
            AND (i_prime /= i + 1 OR j_prime /= j)
            AND (i_prime /= i OR j_prime /= j + 1)
            AND (i_prime /= i + 1 OR j_prime /= j + 1))
          IMPLIES
            before(i_prime, j_prime) = after(i_prime, j_prime))

  legal_chain(m, n: nat, moves: history): RECURSIVE bool =
    CASES moves OF
      null: TRUE,
      cons(current, tail):
        CASES tail OF
          null: TRUE,
          cons(next, remainder):
            legal_move(m, n, current, next)
              AND legal_chain(m, n, tail)
        ENDCASES
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE moves BY <<

  legal_history(m, n: nat, moves: history): bool =
    CASES moves OF
      null: FALSE,
      cons(first, tail):
        first = initial_configuration(m, n)
          AND legal_chain(m, n, moves)
    ENDCASES

  ends_at(moves: history, final: configuration): RECURSIVE bool =
    CASES moves OF
      null: FALSE,
      cons(current, tail):
        CASES tail OF
          null: final = current,
          cons(next, remainder): ends_at(tail, final)
        ENDCASES
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE moves BY <<

  reachable_configuration(
      m, n: nat,
      final: configuration): bool =
    EXISTS (moves: history):
      legal_history(m, n, moves)
        AND ends_at(moves, final)

  reachable_configurations(m, n: nat): configuration_set =
    LAMBDA (final: configuration):
      reachable_configuration(m, n, final)

  injective_below(
      enumeration: configuration_enumeration,
      cardinality: nat): bool =
    FORALL (i, j: nat):
      (i < cardinality
        AND j < cardinality
        AND enumeration(i) = enumeration(j))
      IMPLIES i = j

  enumerates_exactly(
      enumeration: configuration_enumeration,
      set_value: configuration_set,
      cardinality: nat): bool =
    FORALL (config: configuration):
      set_value(config)
        IFF
          EXISTS (position: nat):
            position < cardinality
              AND enumeration(position) = config

  has_cardinality(
      set_value: configuration_set,
      cardinality: nat): bool =
    EXISTS (enumeration: configuration_enumeration):
      injective_below(enumeration, cardinality)
        AND enumerates_exactly(
          enumeration, set_value, cardinality)

  binomial_coefficient(n, k: nat): RECURSIVE nat =
    IF k = 0 THEN
      1
    ELSIF n = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      binomial_coefficient(n - 1, k - 1)
        + binomial_coefficient(n - 1, k)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE n

  natural_predecessor(value: nat): nat =
    IF value = 0 THEN 0 ELSE value - 1 ENDIF

  putnam_2023_b1_solution(m, n: nat): nat =
    binomial_coefficient(
      natural_predecessor(natural_predecessor(m + n)),
      natural_predecessor(m))

  putnam_2023_b1: bool =
    FORALL (m, n: nat):
      (m > 0 AND n > 0)
      IMPLIES
        has_cardinality(
          reachable_configurations(m, n),
          putnam_2023_b1_solution(m, n))
END putnam_2023_b1

import Mathlib

open Nat

abbrev putnam_2023_b2_solution : ℕ := sorry
-- 3
/--
For each positive integer $n$, let $k(n)$ be the number of ones in the binary representation of $2023 * n$. What is the minimum value of $k(n)$?
-/
theorem putnam_2023_b2
: sInf {(digits 2 (2023*n)).sum | n > 0} = putnam_2023_b2_solution :=
sorry

title: putnam_2023_b2
content:
Require Import BinNums Nat NArith.
Definition putnam_2023_b2_solution := 3.
Theorem putnam_2023_b2
    (k := fix count_ones (n : positive) : nat :=
        match n with
        | xH => 1
        | xO n' => count_ones n'
        | xI n' => 1 + count_ones n'
    end)
    : (forall (n: nat), n > 0 -> k (Pos.of_nat (2023*n)) >= putnam_2023_b2_solution) /\
    (exists (n: nat), n > 0 /\ k (Pos.of_nat (2023*n)) = putnam_2023_b2_solution).
Proof. Admitted.

"HOL-Number_Theory.Cong"
begin

definition putnam_2023_b2_solution :: "nat" where "putnam_2023_b2_solution \<equiv> undefined"
(* 3 *)
theorem putnam_2023_b2:
  fixes ones :: "nat \<Rightarrow> nat"
  assumes h0 : "ones 0 = 0"
    and hi : "\<forall> n > 0. ones n = (if [n = 1] (mod 2) then 1 else 0) + ones (n div 2)"
  shows "(LEAST k :: nat. \<exists> n > 0. ones (2023*n) = k) = putnam_2023_b2_solution"
  sorry

end

       CARD {j:num | ODD (m DIV (2 EXP j))} in

      0 < n

;; Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2023_b2:
;; the minimum number of ones in the binary representation of a positive
;; multiple of 2023 is 3. This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(defun putnam-2023-b2-count-ones-aux (fuel n)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix fuel)))
  (if (zp fuel)
      0
    (+ (mod (nfix n) 2)
       (putnam-2023-b2-count-ones-aux
        (- fuel 1)
        (floor (nfix n) 2)))))

(defun putnam-2023-b2-count-ones (n)
  (if (natp n)
      (putnam-2023-b2-count-ones-aux
       (integer-length n)
       n)
    0))

;; The closed witness satisfies
;; 2023 * 74698827212965223383 = 2^77 + 2^16 + 1.
(defun putnam-2023-b2-attainment-p ()
  (let ((witness 74698827212965223383))
    (and
     (natp witness)
     (< 0 witness)
     (equal
      (putnam-2023-b2-count-ones (* 2023 witness))
      3))))

;; N is universally closed by the ACL2 statement-corpus convention. The
;; explicit closed witness above keeps the existential attainment internal.
(defun putnambench-putnam-2023-b2-statement (n)
  (and
   (putnam-2023-b2-attainment-p)
   (implies
    (and
     (natp n)
     (< 0 n))
    (<= 3
        (putnam-2023-b2-count-ones (* 2023 n))))))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

-- Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2023_b2
-- (putnambench__agda__putnam_2023_b2): the minimum number of ones in the
-- binary representation of a positive multiple of 2023 is three. This file
-- contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module Putnam2023B2 where

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using
  (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; _*_; div-helper; mod-helper)

infix 4 _<=N_
infixr 3 _and_

record _and_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

data _<=N_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set where
  zero<=N   : {n : Nat} -> zero <=N n
  suc<=sucN : {m n : Nat} -> m <=N n -> suc m <=N suc n

data Positive : Nat -> Set where
  positive : {n : Nat} -> Positive (suc n)

one two three : Nat
one =
  suc zero
two =
  suc one
three =
  suc two

naturalDiv : Nat -> Nat -> Nat
naturalDiv numerator zero =
  zero
naturalDiv numerator (suc denominator) =
  div-helper zero denominator numerator denominator

naturalMod : Nat -> Nat -> Nat
naturalMod numerator zero =
  zero
naturalMod numerator (suc denominator) =
  mod-helper zero denominator numerator denominator

binaryOneCountWithFuel : Nat -> Nat -> Nat
binaryOneCountWithFuel zero n =
  zero
binaryOneCountWithFuel (suc fuel) zero =
  zero
binaryOneCountWithFuel (suc fuel) (suc n) =
  naturalMod (suc n) two +
  binaryOneCountWithFuel fuel (naturalDiv (suc n) two)

binaryOneCount : Nat -> Nat
binaryOneCount n =
  binaryOneCountWithFuel n n

putnam-2023-b2 : Set
putnam-2023-b2 =
  ((n : Nat) ->
    Positive n ->
    three <=N binaryOneCount (2023 * n))
  and
  Exists Nat
    (\ n ->
      Positive n
      and
      binaryOneCount (2023 * n) == three)

% Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2023_b2:
% the minimum number of ones in the binary representation of a positive
% multiple of 2023 is three. This file contains no proof.

putnam_2023_b2: THEORY
BEGIN
  binary_one_count_aux(fuel, n: nat): RECURSIVE nat =
    IF fuel = 0 OR n = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      mod(n, 2)
        + binary_one_count_aux(fuel - 1, ndiv(n, 2))
    ENDIF
  MEASURE fuel

  binary_one_count(n: nat): nat =
    binary_one_count_aux(n, n)

  putnam_2023_b2_solution: nat = 3

  putnam_2023_b2: bool =
    (FORALL (n: posnat):
      binary_one_count(2023 * n) >= putnam_2023_b2_solution)
    AND
    (EXISTS (n: posnat):
      binary_one_count(2023 * n) = putnam_2023_b2_solution)
END putnam_2023_b2

title: putnam_2023_b3
content:
import Mathlib

open ProbabilityTheory Set

noncomputable abbrev putnam_2023_b3_solution : ℕ → ℝ := sorry
-- (fun n : ℕ ↦ (2 * (n : ℝ) + 2) / 3)
/--
A sequence $y_1, y_2, \ldots, y_k$ of real numbers is called zigzag if $k = 1$, or if $y_2 - y_1, y_3 - y_2, \ldots, y_k - y_{k-1}$ are nonzero and alternate in sign. Let $X_1, X_2,\ldots, X_n$ be chosen independently from the uniform distribution on $[0,1]$. Let $a(X_1, X_2, \ldots, X_n)$ be the largest value of $k$ for which there exists an increasing sequence of integers $i_1, i_2, \ldots, i_k$ such that $X_{i_1}, X_{i_2}, \ldots, X_{i_k}$ is zigzag. Find the expected value of $a(X_1, X_2, \ldots, X_n)$ for $n \ge 2$.
-/
theorem putnam_2023_b3
    (IsZigZag : {k : ℕ} → (Fin k → ℝ) → Prop)
    (IsZigZag_def : ∀ (k : ℕ) [NeZero k] (y : Fin k → ℝ),
      IsZigZag y ↔ k = 1 ∨ ((∀ i : Fin k, i + 1 < k → y (i + 1) ≠ y i)) ∧
        (∀ i : Fin k, i + 2 < k → (y (i + 2) < y (i + 1) ↔ y i < y (i + 1))))
    (n : ℕ)
    (hn : 2 ≤ n)
    (a : (Fin n → Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) → ℕ)
    (ha : ∀ x, IsGreatest {k | ∃ i : Fin k ↪o Fin n, IsZigZag ((↑) ∘ x ∘ i)} (a x)) :
    𝔼[(↑) ∘ a] = putnam_2023_b3_solution n :=
  sorry

title: putnam_2023_b3
content:
(* Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2023_b3:
   the expected length of the longest zigzag subsequence of independent
   uniform unit-interval real variables is (2n + 2)/3. This file contains no
   proof. *)

From Stdlib Require Import Reals Lists.List Arith.PeanoNat RiemannInt.

Import ListNotations.
Open Scope R_scope.

Definition putnam_2023_b3_in_unit_cube (coordinates : list R) : Prop :=
  Forall (fun x : R => 0 <= x <= 1) coordinates.

Definition putnam_2023_b3_is_zigzag
    (k : nat) (y : nat -> R) : Prop :=
  (k = 1)%nat \/
  ((forall i : nat,
      (S i < k)%nat ->
      y (S i) <> y i) /\
   (forall i : nat,
      (S (S i) < k)%nat ->
      (y (S (S i)) < y (S i) <-> y i < y (S i)))).

Definition putnam_2023_b3_increasing_indices
    (n k : nat) (indices : nat -> nat) : Prop :=
  (forall j : nat,
      (j < k)%nat ->
      (indices j < n)%nat) /\
  (forall i j : nat,
      (i < j)%nat ->
      (j < k)%nat ->
      (indices i < indices j)%nat).

Definition putnam_2023_b3_admissible_length
    (n : nat) (coordinates : list R) (k : nat) : Prop :=
  (0 < k)%nat /\
  exists indices : nat -> nat,
    putnam_2023_b3_increasing_indices n k indices /\
    putnam_2023_b3_is_zigzag
      k
      (fun j : nat => nth (indices j) coordinates 0).

Definition putnam_2023_b3_is_greatest
    (property : nat -> Prop) (greatest : nat) : Prop :=
  property greatest /\
  forall k : nat, property k -> (k <= greatest)%nat.

Fixpoint putnam_2023_b3_iterated_unit_integral
    (dimension : nat) (f : list R -> R) (value : R) : Prop :=
  match dimension with
  | O => value = f []
  | S lower_dimension =>
      exists slice_integral : R -> R,
        (forall x : R,
          0 <= x <= 1 ->
          putnam_2023_b3_iterated_unit_integral
            lower_dimension
            (fun remaining_coordinates : list R =>
              f (x :: remaining_coordinates))
            (slice_integral x)) /\
        exists integrable : Riemann_integrable slice_integral 0 1,
          value = RiemannInt integrable
  end.

Definition putnam_2023_b3_solution (n : nat) : R :=
  (2 * INR n + 2) / 3.

Theorem putnam_2023_b3 :
  forall (n : nat) (a : list R -> nat),
    (2 <= n)%nat ->
    (forall coordinates : list R,
      length coordinates = n ->
      putnam_2023_b3_in_unit_cube coordinates ->
      putnam_2023_b3_is_greatest
        (putnam_2023_b3_admissible_length n coordinates)
        (a coordinates)) ->
    putnam_2023_b3_iterated_unit_integral
      n
      (fun coordinates : list R => INR (a coordinates))
      (putnam_2023_b3_solution n).
Admitted.

theory putnam_2023_b3
  imports Complex_Main
begin

definition putnam_2023_b3_sigma_algebra ::
    "'a set set \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "putnam_2023_b3_sigma_algebra E \<longleftrightarrow>
    UNIV \<in> E \<and>
    (\<forall>A\<in>E. UNIV - A \<in> E) \<and>
    (\<forall>A :: nat \<Rightarrow> 'a set.
      (\<forall>m. A m \<in> E) \<longrightarrow> (\<Union>m. A m) \<in> E)"

definition putnam_2023_b3_borel_sets :: "real set set" where
  "putnam_2023_b3_borel_sets =
    \<Inter>{E :: real set set.
      putnam_2023_b3_sigma_algebra E \<and> {U. open U} \<subseteq> E}"

definition putnam_2023_b3_probability_measure ::
    "'a set set \<Rightarrow> ('a set \<Rightarrow> real) \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "putnam_2023_b3_probability_measure E P \<longleftrightarrow>
    putnam_2023_b3_sigma_algebra E \<and>
    P {} = 0 \<and>
    P UNIV = 1 \<and>
    (\<forall>A\<in>E. 0 \<le> P A) \<and>
    (\<forall>A :: nat \<Rightarrow> 'a set.
      (\<forall>m. A m \<in> E) \<longrightarrow>
      (\<forall>m l. m \<noteq> l \<longrightarrow> A m \<inter> A l = {}) \<longrightarrow>
      P (\<Union>m. A m) = (\<Sum>m. P (A m)))"

definition putnam_2023_b3_real_random_variable ::
    "'a set set \<Rightarrow> ('a \<Rightarrow> real) \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "putnam_2023_b3_real_random_variable E f \<longleftrightarrow>
    (\<forall>B\<in>putnam_2023_b3_borel_sets. f -` B \<in> E)"

definition putnam_2023_b3_uniform_on_unit_interval ::
    "('a set \<Rightarrow> real) \<Rightarrow> ('a \<Rightarrow> real) \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "putnam_2023_b3_uniform_on_unit_interval P f \<longleftrightarrow>
    (\<forall>t. P {\<omega>. f \<omega> \<le> t} =
      (if t < 0 then 0 else if t \<le> 1 then t else 1))"

definition putnam_2023_b3_independent ::
    "('a set \<Rightarrow> real) \<Rightarrow>
      (nat \<Rightarrow> 'a \<Rightarrow> real) \<Rightarrow> nat \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "putnam_2023_b3_independent P X n \<longleftrightarrow>
    (\<forall>J A.
      finite J \<longrightarrow>
      J \<subseteq> {..<n} \<longrightarrow>
      (\<forall>j\<in>J. A j \<in> putnam_2023_b3_borel_sets) \<longrightarrow>
      P (\<Inter>j\<in>J. X j -` A j) =
        (\<Prod>j\<in>J. P (X j -` A j)))"

definition putnam_2023_b3_is_zigzag ::
    "nat \<Rightarrow> (nat \<Rightarrow> real) \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "putnam_2023_b3_is_zigzag k y \<longleftrightarrow>
    k = 1 \<or>
    ((\<forall>i. i + 1 < k \<longrightarrow> y (i + 1) \<noteq> y i) \<and>
      (\<forall>i. i + 2 < k \<longrightarrow>
        (y (i + 2) < y (i + 1) \<longleftrightarrow> y i < y (i + 1))))"

definition putnam_2023_b3_is_zigzag_subsequence ::
    "nat \<Rightarrow> (nat \<Rightarrow> real) \<Rightarrow> nat \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "putnam_2023_b3_is_zigzag_subsequence n x k \<longleftrightarrow>
    (\<exists>indices :: nat \<Rightarrow> nat.
      (\<forall>j<k. indices j < n) \<and>
      (\<forall>j<k. \<forall>l<k. j < l \<longrightarrow> indices j < indices l) \<and>
      putnam_2023_b3_is_zigzag k (\<lambda>j. x (indices j)))"

theorem putnam_2023_b3:
  fixes E :: "'a set set"
    and P :: "'a set \<Rightarrow> real"
    and X :: "nat \<Rightarrow> 'a \<Rightarrow> real"
    and a :: "'a \<Rightarrow> nat"
    and n :: nat
  assumes hn: "2 \<le> n"
    and probability_space: "putnam_2023_b3_probability_measure E P"
    and X_measurable:
      "\<And>i. i < n \<Longrightarrow>
        putnam_2023_b3_real_random_variable E (X i)"
    and X_uniform:
      "\<And>i. i < n \<Longrightarrow>
        putnam_2023_b3_uniform_on_unit_interval P (X i)"
    and X_independent: "putnam_2023_b3_independent P X n"
    and a_def:
      "\<And>\<omega>. a \<omega> =
        Max {k. putnam_2023_b3_is_zigzag_subsequence n
          (\<lambda>i. X i \<omega>) k}"
  shows "(\<Sum>k\<le>n. real k * P {\<omega>. a \<omega> = k}) =
    (2 * real n + 2) / 3"
  sorry

end

title: putnam_2023_b3
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2023_b3
  (putnambench__hol-light__putnam_2023_b3): the expected maximum length of a
  zigzag subsequence of independent uniform samples from the unit interval.
  This file contains no proof.
*)

needs "Library/transc.ml";;

let statement =
  `let zigzag =
     \(ys:real list).
       LENGTH ys = 1 \/
       (2 <= LENGTH ys /\
        (!i:num.
           i + 1 < LENGTH ys
           ==> ~(EL (i + 1) ys = EL i ys)) /\
        (!i:num.
           i + 2 < LENGTH ys
           ==> (EL (i + 2) ys < EL (i + 1) ys <=>
                EL i ys < EL (i + 1) ys))) in
   let increasing_indices =
     \(n:num) (is:num list).
       (!i:num. i < LENGTH is ==> EL i is < n) /\
       (!i j:num.
          i < j /\ j < LENGTH is
          ==> EL i is < EL j is) in
   let admissible_lengths =
     \(n:num) (x:real list).
       {k:num |
          ?is:num list.
            LENGTH is = k /\
            increasing_indices n is /\
            zigzag (MAP (\i:num. EL i x) is)} in
   let greatest =
     \(s:num->bool) (k:num).
       k IN s /\ (!j:num. j IN s ==> j <= k) in
   let unit_sample =
     \(n:num) (x:real list).
       LENGTH x = n /\
       (!i:num. i < n ==> &0 <= EL i x /\ EL i x <= &1) in
   let cube_integral =
     \(n:num) (f:real list->real).
       ITLIST
         (\u:bool. \(g:real list->real). \(prefix:real list).
            integral(&0,&1)
              (\t:real. g (APPEND prefix [t])))
         (REPLICATE n T) f [] in
   !n:num. !a:real list->num.
     2 <= n /\
     (!x:real list.
        unit_sample n x
        ==> greatest (admissible_lengths n x) (a x))
     ==>
     cube_integral n (\x:real list. &(a x)) =
       (&2 * &n + &2) / &3`;;

title: putnam_2023_b3
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2023_b3:
;; the expected longest zigzag-subsequence length of independent uniform
;; samples from [0,1] is (2n+2)/3 for n at least 2. This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

;; Outside the measure-zero set where two samples are equal, the zigzag
;; statistic depends only on the samples' relative order. Independence and
;; uniformity make all n! strict order types equiprobable. Thus the finite
;; average below is exactly the source expectation, not a restriction of its
;; real-valued sample space.

(defun putnam-2023-b3-indices (count)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix count)))
  (if (zp count)
      nil
    (cons (- count 1)
          (putnam-2023-b3-indices (- count 1)))))

(defun putnam-2023-b3-prefix-each (item lists)
  (if (endp lists)
      nil
    (cons (cons item (car lists))
          (putnam-2023-b3-prefix-each item (cdr lists)))))

(defun putnam-2023-b3-insert-everywhere (item list)
  (if (endp list)
      (list (list item))
    (cons (cons item list)
          (putnam-2023-b3-prefix-each
           (car list)
           (putnam-2023-b3-insert-everywhere
            item (cdr list))))))

(defun putnam-2023-b3-insert-into-each (item lists)
  (if (endp lists)
      nil
    (append
     (putnam-2023-b3-insert-everywhere item (car lists))
     (putnam-2023-b3-insert-into-each item (cdr lists)))))

(defun putnam-2023-b3-permutations (list)
  (if (endp list)
      (list nil)
    (putnam-2023-b3-insert-into-each
     (car list)
     (putnam-2023-b3-permutations (cdr list)))))

;; These are exactly the index-preserving subsequences of LIST.

(defun putnam-2023-b3-subsequences (list)
  (if (endp list)
      (list nil)
    (let ((tail-subsequences
           (putnam-2023-b3-subsequences (cdr list))))
      (append
       tail-subsequences
       (putnam-2023-b3-prefix-each
        (car list) tail-subsequences)))))

(defun putnam-2023-b3-sign (value)
  (cond ((< value 0) -1)
        ((< 0 value) 1)
        (t 0)))

(defun putnam-2023-b3-alternating-differences-p
    (sequence previous-sign)
  (if (or (endp sequence)
          (endp (cdr sequence)))
      t
    (let ((current-sign
           (putnam-2023-b3-sign
            (- (cadr sequence) (car sequence)))))
      (and
       (not (equal current-sign 0))
       (or (equal previous-sign 0)
           (equal current-sign (- previous-sign)))
       (putnam-2023-b3-alternating-differences-p
        (cdr sequence) current-sign)))))

(defun putnam-2023-b3-zigzag-p (sequence)
  (and
   (consp sequence)
   (or
    (endp (cdr sequence))
    (putnam-2023-b3-alternating-differences-p
     sequence 0))))

(defun putnam-2023-b3-max (left right)
  (if (< left right) right left))

(defun putnam-2023-b3-longest-from-subsequences
    (subsequences)
  (if (endp subsequences)
      0
    (putnam-2023-b3-max
     (if (putnam-2023-b3-zigzag-p (car subsequences))
         (len (car subsequences))
       0)
     (putnam-2023-b3-longest-from-subsequences
      (cdr subsequences)))))

(defun putnam-2023-b3-longest-zigzag-length (permutation)
  (putnam-2023-b3-longest-from-subsequences
   (putnam-2023-b3-subsequences permutation)))

(defun putnam-2023-b3-sum-longest-lengths (permutations)
  (if (endp permutations)
      0
    (+
     (putnam-2023-b3-longest-zigzag-length
      (car permutations))
     (putnam-2023-b3-sum-longest-lengths
      (cdr permutations)))))

(defun putnam-2023-b3-factorial (n)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix n)))
  (if (zp n)
      1
    (* n
       (putnam-2023-b3-factorial (- n 1)))))

(defun putnam-2023-b3-expectation (n)
  (/
   (putnam-2023-b3-sum-longest-lengths
    (putnam-2023-b3-permutations
     (putnam-2023-b3-indices n)))
   (putnam-2023-b3-factorial n)))

(defun putnam-2023-b3-solution (n)
  (/ (+ (* 2 n) 2) 3))

(defun putnambench-putnam-2023-b3-statement (n)
  (implies
   (and (natp n)
        (<= 2 n))
   (equal
    (putnam-2023-b3-expectation n)
    (putnam-2023-b3-solution n))))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

title: putnam_2023_b3
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2023_b3
-- (putnambench__agda__putnam_2023_b3): the expected length of the longest
-- zigzag subsequence of independent uniform unit-interval samples.
-- This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module Main where

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; _*_)

infix 4 _!=_ _<=N_ _<N_
infixr 3 _and_
infixr 2 _or_

data Bottom : Set where

record Top : Set where
  constructor top

Not : Set -> Set
Not A =
  A -> Bottom

_!=_ : {A : Set} -> A -> A -> Set
x != y =
  Not (x == y)

record _and_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data _or_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  left  : A -> A or B
  right : B -> A or B

record Iff (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor equivalence
  field
    forward  : A -> B
    backward : B -> A

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

data _<=N_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set where
  zero<=N   : {n : Nat} -> zero <=N n
  suc<=sucN : {m n : Nat} -> m <=N n -> suc m <=N suc n

_<N_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set
m <N n =
  suc m <=N n

data Fin : Nat -> Set where
  fzero : {n : Nat} -> Fin (suc n)
  fsuc  : {n : Nat} -> Fin n -> Fin (suc n)

weakenFin : {n : Nat} -> Fin n -> Fin (suc n)
weakenFin fzero =
  fzero
weakenFin (fsuc i) =
  fsuc (weakenFin i)

toNat : {n : Nat} -> Fin n -> Nat
toNat fzero =
  zero
toNat (fsuc i) =
  suc (toNat i)

data List (A : Set) : Set where
  empty : List A
  cons  : A -> List A -> List A

data Member {A : Set} (x : A) : List A -> Set where
  at-head : {xs : List A} -> Member x (cons x xs)
  in-tail : {y : A} {xs : List A} ->
    Member x xs ->
    Member x (cons y xs)

data NoDuplicates {A : Set} : List A -> Set where
  no-duplicates-empty :
    NoDuplicates empty
  no-duplicates-cons :
    {x : A} {xs : List A} ->
    Not (Member x xs) ->
    NoDuplicates xs ->
    NoDuplicates (cons x xs)

record CompleteOrderedRealField (R : Set) : Set1 where
  field
    zeroR oneR : R
    add multiply : R -> R -> R
    negate inverse : R -> R
    lessOrEqual : R -> R -> Set
    fromNat : Nat -> R

    one-not-zero :
      oneR != zeroR

    add-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> add x y == add y x
    add-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      add (add x y) z == add x (add y z)
    add-zero :
      (x : R) -> add x zeroR == x
    add-inverse :
      (x : R) -> add x (negate x) == zeroR

    multiply-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> multiply x y == multiply y x
    multiply-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply (multiply x y) z ==
      multiply x (multiply y z)
    multiply-one :
      (x : R) -> multiply x oneR == x
    multiply-zero :
      (x : R) -> multiply x zeroR == zeroR
    distribute :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply x (add y z) ==
      add (multiply x y) (multiply x z)
    inverse-zero :
      inverse zeroR == zeroR
    multiply-inverse :
      (x : R) ->
      x != zeroR ->
      multiply x (inverse x) == oneR

    order-reflexive :
      (x : R) -> lessOrEqual x x
    order-transitive :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y z ->
      lessOrEqual x z
    order-antisymmetric :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y x ->
      x == y
    order-total :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y or lessOrEqual y x
    add-order :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual (add z x) (add z y)
    multiply-nonnegative :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR x ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR y ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR (multiply x y)
    zero-less-than-one :
      lessOrEqual zeroR oneR and zeroR != oneR

    fromNat-zero :
      fromNat zero == zeroR
    fromNat-successor :
      (n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (suc n) == add (fromNat n) oneR
    fromNat-addition :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m + n) == add (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-multiplication :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m * n) == multiply (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-injective :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat m == fromNat n ->
      m == n

    archimedean :
      (x : R) ->
      Exists Nat
        (\ n -> lessOrEqual x (fromNat n))
    least-upper-bound :
      (P : R -> Set) ->
      Exists R P ->
      Exists R
        (\ upper ->
          (x : R) ->
          P x ->
          lessOrEqual x upper) ->
      Exists R
        (\ supremum ->
          ((x : R) ->
            P x ->
            lessOrEqual x supremum)
          and
          ((upper : R) ->
            ((x : R) ->
              P x ->
              lessOrEqual x upper) ->
            lessOrEqual supremum upper))

open CompleteOrderedRealField

oneN : Nat
oneN =
  suc zero

twoN : Nat
twoN =
  suc oneN

threeN : Nat
threeN =
  suc twoN

divide :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
divide reals numerator denominator =
  multiply reals numerator (inverse reals denominator)

StrictLess :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
StrictLess reals x y =
  lessOrEqual reals x y and x != y

maximum :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
maximum reals x y with order-total reals x y
... | left _ =
  y
... | right _ =
  x

absoluteValue :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R
absoluteValue reals x =
  maximum reals x (negate reals x)

subtract :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
subtract reals x y =
  add reals x (negate reals y)

CloseTo :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
CloseTo reals center radius x =
  StrictLess reals
    (absoluteValue reals (subtract reals x center))
    radius

ConvergesTo :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  R ->
  Set
ConvergesTo {R} reals sequence limit =
  (epsilon : R) ->
  StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) epsilon ->
  Exists Nat
    (\ cutoff ->
      (n : Nat) ->
      cutoff <=N n ->
      CloseTo reals limit epsilon (sequence n))

sumFirst :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Nat ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  R
sumFirst reals zero terms =
  zeroR reals
sumFirst reals (suc n) terms =
  add reals
    (sumFirst reals n terms)
    (terms n)

SeriesHasSum :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  R ->
  Set
SeriesHasSum reals terms value =
  ConvergesTo reals
    (\ n -> sumFirst reals n terms)
    value

Predicate : Set -> Set1
Predicate A =
  A -> Set

emptySet :
  {A : Set} ->
  Predicate A
emptySet _ =
  Bottom

wholeSet :
  {A : Set} ->
  Predicate A
wholeSet _ =
  Top

complement :
  {A : Set} ->
  Predicate A ->
  Predicate A
complement E x =
  Not (E x)

countableUnion :
  {A : Set} ->
  (Nat -> Predicate A) ->
  Predicate A
countableUnion sets x =
  Exists Nat (\ n -> sets n x)

PairwiseDisjoint :
  {A : Set} ->
  (Nat -> Predicate A) ->
  Set
PairwiseDisjoint {A} sets =
  (i j : Nat) ->
  i != j ->
  (x : A) ->
  sets i x ->
  sets j x ->
  Bottom

record SigmaAlgebra (A : Set) : Set1 where
  field
    measurable : Predicate A -> Set

    measurable-empty :
      measurable emptySet
    measurable-complement :
      (E : Predicate A) ->
      measurable E ->
      measurable (complement E)
    measurable-countable-union :
      (sets : Nat -> Predicate A) ->
      ((n : Nat) -> measurable (sets n)) ->
      measurable (countableUnion sets)
    measurable-congruent :
      (E F : Predicate A) ->
      ((x : A) -> Iff (E x) (F x)) ->
      measurable E ->
      measurable F

open SigmaAlgebra

preimage :
  {A B : Set} ->
  (A -> B) ->
  Predicate B ->
  Predicate A
preimage function event x =
  event (function x)

MeasurableFunction :
  {A B : Set} ->
  SigmaAlgebra A ->
  SigmaAlgebra B ->
  (A -> B) ->
  Set1
MeasurableFunction source target function =
  (event : Predicate _) ->
  measurable target event ->
  measurable source (preimage function event)

record Measure
  {A R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R)
  (events : SigmaAlgebra A) :
  Set1 where

  field
    mass : Predicate A -> R

    mass-congruent :
      (E F : Predicate A) ->
      ((x : A) -> Iff (E x) (F x)) ->
      mass E == mass F
    mass-empty :
      mass emptySet == zeroR reals
    mass-nonnegative :
      (E : Predicate A) ->
      measurable events E ->
      lessOrEqual reals (zeroR reals) (mass E)
    countable-additivity :
      (sets : Nat -> Predicate A) ->
      ((n : Nat) -> measurable events (sets n)) ->
      PairwiseDisjoint sets ->
      SeriesHasSum reals
        (\ n -> mass (sets n))
        (mass (countableUnion sets))

open Measure

BoundedFunction :
  {A R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (A -> R) ->
  Set
BoundedFunction {A} {R} reals function =
  Exists R
    (\ bound ->
      lessOrEqual reals (zeroR reals) bound
      and
      ((x : A) ->
        lessOrEqual reals
          (absoluteValue reals (function x))
          bound))

PointwiseNonnegative :
  {A R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (A -> R) ->
  Set
PointwiseNonnegative {A} reals function =
  (x : A) ->
  lessOrEqual reals (zeroR reals) (function x)

PointwiseIncreasing :
  {A R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (Nat -> A -> R) ->
  Set
PointwiseIncreasing {A} reals functions =
  (n : Nat) ->
  (x : A) ->
  lessOrEqual reals
    (functions n x)
    (functions (suc n) x)

NullSet :
  {A R : Set}
  {reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R}
  {events : SigmaAlgebra A} ->
  Measure reals events ->
  Predicate A ->
  Set
NullSet {reals = reals} measure event =
  mass measure event == zeroR reals

AlmostEverywhere :
  {A R : Set}
  {reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R}
  {events : SigmaAlgebra A} ->
  Measure reals events ->
  Predicate A ->
  Set
AlmostEverywhere measure property =
  NullSet measure (\ x -> Not (property x))

AlmostEqual :
  {A R : Set}
  {reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R}
  {events : SigmaAlgebra A} ->
  Measure reals events ->
  (A -> R) ->
  (A -> R) ->
  Set
AlmostEqual measure f g =
  AlmostEverywhere measure (\ x -> f x == g x)

record SimpleFunction
  {A R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R)
  (events : SigmaAlgebra A)
  (function : A -> R) :
  Set1 where

  field
    count : Nat
    values : Nat -> R
    pieces : Nat -> Predicate A

    pieces-measurable :
      (i : Nat) ->
      i <N count ->
      measurable events (pieces i)
    pieces-disjoint :
      (i j : Nat) ->
      i <N count ->
      j <N count ->
      i != j ->
      (x : A) ->
      pieces i x ->
      pieces j x ->
      Bottom
    pieces-cover :
      (x : A) ->
      Exists Nat
        (\ i ->
          i <N count
          and
          pieces i x)
    represented-on-pieces :
      (i : Nat) ->
      i <N count ->
      (x : A) ->
      pieces i x ->
      function x == values i

open SimpleFunction

record Integration
  {A R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R)
  (realEvents : SigmaAlgebra R)
  (events : SigmaAlgebra A)
  (measure : Measure reals events) :
  Set1 where

  field
    integrable : (A -> R) -> Set
    integral : (A -> R) -> R
    indicator : Predicate A -> A -> R

    integral-congruent :
      (f g : A -> R) ->
      ((x : A) -> f x == g x) ->
      integral f == integral g
    integrable-congruent-ae :
      (f g : A -> R) ->
      AlmostEqual measure f g ->
      Iff (integrable f) (integrable g)
    integral-congruent-ae :
      (f g : A -> R) ->
      AlmostEqual measure f g ->
      integral f == integral g

    indicator-on :
      (E : Predicate A) ->
      (x : A) ->
      E x ->
      indicator E x == oneR reals
    indicator-off :
      (E : Predicate A) ->
      (x : A) ->
      Not (E x) ->
      indicator E x == zeroR reals
    indicator-integrable :
      (E : Predicate A) ->
      measurable events E ->
      integrable (indicator E)
    integral-indicator :
      (E : Predicate A) ->
      measurable events E ->
      integral (indicator E) == mass measure E
    simple-integrable :
      (f : A -> R) ->
      SimpleFunction reals events f ->
      integrable f
    integral-simple :
      (f : A -> R) ->
      (simple : SimpleFunction reals events f) ->
      integral f ==
      sumFirst reals
        (count simple)
        (\ i ->
          multiply reals
            (values simple i)
            (mass measure (pieces simple i)))

    bounded-measurable-integrable :
      (f : A -> R) ->
      MeasurableFunction events realEvents f ->
      BoundedFunction reals f ->
      integrable f

    integral-zero :
      integral (\ _ -> zeroR reals) == zeroR reals
    integral-add :
      (f g : A -> R) ->
      integrable f ->
      integrable g ->
      integral
        (\ x -> add reals (f x) (g x))
      ==
      add reals (integral f) (integral g)
    integral-scale :
      (c : R) ->
      (f : A -> R) ->
      integrable f ->
      integral
        (\ x -> multiply reals c (f x))
      ==
      multiply reals c (integral f)
    integral-nonnegative :
      (f : A -> R) ->
      integrable f ->
      PointwiseNonnegative reals f ->
      lessOrEqual reals (zeroR reals) (integral f)
    integral-nonintegrable-zero :
      (f : A -> R) ->
      Not (integrable f) ->
      integral f == zeroR reals

    monotone-convergence :
      (functions : Nat -> A -> R) ->
      (limitFunction : A -> R) ->
      ((n : Nat) -> integrable (functions n)) ->
      ((n : Nat) -> PointwiseNonnegative reals (functions n)) ->
      PointwiseIncreasing reals functions ->
      ((x : A) ->
        ConvergesTo reals
          (\ n -> functions n x)
          (limitFunction x)) ->
      integrable limitFunction ->
      ConvergesTo reals
        (\ n -> integral (functions n))
        (integral limitFunction)

open Integration

record StandardProbabilityTheory
  (R : Set)
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) :
  Set1 where

  field
    borel : SigmaAlgebra R
    closed-ray-measurable :
      (a : R) ->
      measurable borel
        (\ x -> lessOrEqual reals x a)
    borel-minimal :
      (candidate : SigmaAlgebra R) ->
      ((a : R) ->
        measurable candidate
          (\ x -> lessOrEqual reals x a)) ->
      (E : Predicate R) ->
      measurable borel E ->
      measurable candidate E

open StandardProbabilityTheory

record ProbabilitySpace
  {A R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R)
  (theory : StandardProbabilityTheory R reals)
  (events : SigmaAlgebra A) :
  Set1 where

  field
    measure : Measure reals events
    integration : Integration reals (borel theory) events measure
    total-mass-one :
      mass measure wholeSet == oneR reals

open ProbabilitySpace

probabilityOf :
  {A R : Set}
  {reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R}
  {theory : StandardProbabilityTheory R reals}
  {events : SigmaAlgebra A} ->
  ProbabilitySpace reals theory events ->
  Predicate A ->
  R
probabilityOf space event =
  mass (measure space) event

expectation :
  {A R : Set}
  {reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R}
  {theory : StandardProbabilityTheory R reals}
  {events : SigmaAlgebra A} ->
  ProbabilitySpace reals theory events ->
  (A -> R) ->
  R
expectation space randomVariable =
  integral (integration space) randomVariable

unitIntervalCDF :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R
unitIntervalCDF reals x
  with order-total reals x (zeroR reals)
... | left _ =
  zeroR reals
... | right _ with order-total reals x (oneR reals)
...   | left _ =
  x
...   | right _ =
  oneR reals

UniformOnClosedUnitInterval :
  {A R : Set}
  {reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R}
  {theory : StandardProbabilityTheory R reals}
  {events : SigmaAlgebra A} ->
  ProbabilitySpace reals theory events ->
  (A -> R) ->
  Set
UniformOnClosedUnitInterval {R = R} {reals = reals} space randomVariable =
  (x : R) ->
  probabilityOf space
    (\ outcome ->
      lessOrEqual reals (randomVariable outcome) x)
  ==
  unitIntervalCDF reals x

finiteIntersection :
  {A I R : Set} ->
  (I -> A -> R) ->
  (I -> Predicate R) ->
  List I ->
  Predicate A
finiteIntersection X targets empty _ =
  Top
finiteIntersection X targets (cons i indices) outcome =
  targets i (X i outcome)
  and
  finiteIntersection X targets indices outcome

finiteProbabilityProduct :
  {A I R : Set}
  {reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R}
  {theory : StandardProbabilityTheory R reals}
  {events : SigmaAlgebra A} ->
  ProbabilitySpace reals theory events ->
  (I -> A -> R) ->
  (I -> Predicate R) ->
  List I ->
  R
finiteProbabilityProduct {reals = reals} space X targets empty =
  oneR reals
finiteProbabilityProduct {reals = reals} space X targets
  (cons i indices) =
  multiply reals
    (probabilityOf space (preimage (X i) (targets i)))
    (finiteProbabilityProduct space X targets indices)

IndependentRandomVariables :
  {A I R : Set}
  {reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R}
  {theory : StandardProbabilityTheory R reals}
  {events : SigmaAlgebra A} ->
  ProbabilitySpace reals theory events ->
  (I -> A -> R) ->
  Set1
IndependentRandomVariables
  {R = R} {reals = reals} {theory = theory}
  space X =
  (indices : List _) ->
  NoDuplicates indices ->
  (targets : _ -> Predicate R) ->
  ((i : _) ->
    Member i indices ->
    measurable (borel theory) (targets i)) ->
  probabilityOf space
    (finiteIntersection X targets indices)
  ==
  finiteProbabilityProduct space X targets indices

record UnitInterval
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) :
  Set where

  constructor unit-value
  field
    realValue : R
    at-least-zero :
      lessOrEqual reals (zeroR reals) realValue
    at-most-one :
      lessOrEqual reals realValue (oneR reals)

open UnitInterval

Sample :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Nat ->
  Set
Sample reals n =
  Fin n -> UnitInterval reals

coordinate :
  {R : Set}
  {reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R}
  {n : Nat} ->
  Fin n ->
  Sample reals n ->
  R
coordinate index sample =
  realValue (sample index)

record StrictOrderEmbedding (m n : Nat) : Set where
  field
    map : Fin m -> Fin n
    map-injective :
      (i j : Fin m) ->
      map i == map j ->
      i == j
    order-preserving :
      (i j : Fin m) ->
      toNat i <N toNat j ->
      toNat (map i) <N toNat (map j)
    order-reflecting :
      (i j : Fin m) ->
      toNat (map i) <N toNat (map j) ->
      toNat i <N toNat j

open StrictOrderEmbedding

AdjacentNonzero :
  {R : Set} ->
  {n : Nat} ->
  (Fin (suc n) -> R) ->
  Set
AdjacentNonzero {n = n} sequence =
  (i : Fin n) ->
  sequence (weakenFin i) != sequence (fsuc i)

AlternatingTriples :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  {n : Nat} ->
  (Fin (suc n) -> R) ->
  Set
AlternatingTriples reals {n = zero} sequence =
  Top
AlternatingTriples reals {n = suc zero} sequence =
  Top
AlternatingTriples reals {n = suc (suc n)} sequence =
  (i : Fin (suc n)) ->
  Iff
    (StrictLess reals
      (sequence (fsuc (fsuc i)))
      (sequence (weakenFin (fsuc i))))
    (StrictLess reals
      (sequence (weakenFin (weakenFin i)))
      (sequence (weakenFin (fsuc i))))

PositiveZigZag :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  {n : Nat} ->
  (Fin (suc n) -> R) ->
  Set
PositiveZigZag reals {n = zero} sequence =
  Top
PositiveZigZag reals {n = suc n} sequence =
  AdjacentNonzero sequence
  and
  AlternatingTriples reals sequence

IsZigZagDefinition :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  ({k : Nat} -> (Fin k -> R) -> Set) ->
  Set
IsZigZagDefinition reals IsZigZag =
  (n : Nat) ->
  (sequence : Fin (suc n) -> _) ->
  Iff
    (IsZigZag sequence)
    (PositiveZigZag reals sequence)

SelectedSequence :
  {R : Set}
  {reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R}
  {n k : Nat} ->
  Sample reals n ->
  StrictOrderEmbedding k n ->
  Fin k ->
  R
SelectedSequence sample selection index =
  realValue (sample (map selection index))

HasZigZagSubsequence :
  {R : Set}
  {reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R}
  {n : Nat} ->
  ({k : Nat} -> (Fin k -> R) -> Set) ->
  Sample reals n ->
  Nat ->
  Set
HasZigZagSubsequence IsZigZag sample k =
  Exists (StrictOrderEmbedding k _)
    (\ selection ->
      IsZigZag (SelectedSequence sample selection))

IsGreatestNat :
  (Nat -> Set) ->
  Nat ->
  Set
IsGreatestNat property greatest =
  property greatest
  and
  ((k : Nat) ->
    property k ->
    k <=N greatest)

LongestZigZagStatistic :
  {R : Set}
  {reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R}
  {n : Nat} ->
  ({k : Nat} -> (Fin k -> R) -> Set) ->
  (Sample reals n -> Nat) ->
  Set
LongestZigZagStatistic IsZigZag statistic =
  (sample : Sample _ _) ->
  IsGreatestNat
    (HasZigZagSubsequence IsZigZag sample)
    (statistic sample)

putnam-2023-b3-solution :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Nat ->
  R
putnam-2023-b3-solution reals n =
  divide reals
    (add reals
      (multiply reals
        (fromNat reals twoN)
        (fromNat reals n))
      (fromNat reals twoN))
    (fromNat reals threeN)

putnam-2023-b3 : Set1
putnam-2023-b3 =
  (R : Set) ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) ->
  (n : Nat) ->
  twoN <=N n ->
  (theory : StandardProbabilityTheory R reals) ->
  (events : SigmaAlgebra (Sample reals n)) ->
  (space : ProbabilitySpace reals theory events) ->
  ((i : Fin n) ->
    MeasurableFunction
      events
      (borel theory)
      (coordinate i)) ->
  ((i : Fin n) ->
    UniformOnClosedUnitInterval space (coordinate i)) ->
  IndependentRandomVariables space coordinate ->
  (IsZigZag : {k : Nat} -> (Fin k -> R) -> Set) ->
  IsZigZagDefinition reals IsZigZag ->
  (statistic : Sample reals n -> Nat) ->
  LongestZigZagStatistic IsZigZag statistic ->
  expectation space
    (\ sample -> fromNat reals (statistic sample))
  ==
  putnam-2023-b3-solution reals n

title: putnam_2023_b3
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2023_b3:
  the expected length of the longest zigzag subsequence of independent
  uniform unit-interval random variables is (2n + 2) / 3 for n at least 2.
  This file contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open arithmeticTheory pred_setTheory realTheory;
open extrealTheory measureTheory borelTheory lebesgue_measureTheory
     probabilityTheory;

val putnam_2023_b3 =
  ``let zigzag =
      \k : num. \y : num -> real.
        0 < k /\
        (k = 1 \/
         ((!i : num.
             i + 1 < k
             ==>
             y (i + 1) <> y i) /\
          (!i : num.
             i + 2 < k
             ==>
             (y (i + 2) < y (i + 1) <=>
              y i < y (i + 1)))))
    in
    let is_zigzag_subsequence =
      \n : num. \X : num -> 'a -> real. \w : 'a. \k : num.
        ?idx : num -> num.
          (!j : num. j < k ==> idx j < n) /\
          (!j : num.
             j + 1 < k
             ==>
             idx j < idx (j + 1)) /\
          zigzag k (\j : num. X (idx j) w)
    in
      !n : num.
      !(p : 'a p_space) (X : num -> 'a -> real) (a : 'a -> num).
        2 <= n /\
        prob_space p /\
        (!i : num.
           i < n
           ==>
           random_variable (X i) p Borel) /\
        (!i : num. !s : real set.
           i < n /\ s IN subsets Borel
           ==>
           distribution p (X i) s =
             measure lborel (s INTER interval [0, 1])) /\
        indep_vars p X (\i : num. Borel) (count n) /\
        (!w : 'a.
           w IN p_space p
           ==>
           is_zigzag_subsequence n X w (a w) /\
           (!k : num.
              is_zigzag_subsequence n X w k
              ==>
              k <= a w))
        ==>
        expectation p (\w : 'a. Normal (&(a w))) =
          Normal ((2 * &n + 2) / 3)``;

title: putnam_2023_b3
content:
$(
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact
  putnam_2023_b3: the expected length of the longest zigzag subsequence of
  independent uniform real samples from the closed unit interval is
  (2n + 2) / 3 for n at least two. This file contains no proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  P23B3Index(n) is the canonical n-element index set 0 ..^ n, and
  P23B3Cube(n) is the full n-dimensional closed unit cube. Product Lebesgue
  measure voln on this finite coordinate space is the joint law of n
  independent uniform samples on [0,1].

  P23B3ZigZag(Y,k) states exactly that the nonempty k-term real sequence Y
  has either one term, or has nonzero successive differences whose signs
  alternate. P23B3Subsequence(X,n,k) keeps the increasing index map
  existentially quantified and says that it selects a k-term zigzag
  subsequence of X. P23B3Length(X,n) is the supremum in NN0 of all such
  positive lengths; for n at least two this nonempty bounded set has the
  same greatest element specified by IsGreatest in the Lean source.

  P23B3Integrand(n) extends this length by zero off the unit cube, so its
  real Bochner integral against voln is the required expectation. Every
  declaration below is an unproved $a statement encoding; this database
  contains no $p proof declaration.
$)

$c P23B3Index P23B3Cube P23B3ZigZag $.
$c P23B3Subsequence P23B3Length P23B3Integrand $.

p23b3-index-syntax $a class ( P23B3Index n ) $.
p23b3-cube-syntax $a class ( P23B3Cube n ) $.
p23b3-zigzag-syntax $a wff ( P23B3ZigZag Y k ) $.
p23b3-subsequence-syntax $a wff ( P23B3Subsequence X n k ) $.
p23b3-length-syntax $a class ( P23B3Length X n ) $.
p23b3-integrand-syntax $a class ( P23B3Integrand n ) $.

p23b3-index-definition $a |- (
  P23B3Index n
) = (
  0 ..^ n
) $.

${
  $d X i n $.

  p23b3-cube-definition $a |- (
    P23B3Cube n
  ) = {
    X e. ( RR ^m ( P23B3Index n ) ) |
      A. i e. ( P23B3Index n )
        (
          0 <_ ( X ` i )
          /\
          ( X ` i ) <_ 1
        )
  } $.
$}

${
  $d Y i k $.

  p23b3-zigzag-definition $a |- (
    ( P23B3ZigZag Y k )
    <->
    (
      (
        k e. NN
        /\
        Y : ( P23B3Index k ) --> RR
      )
      /\
      (
        k = 1
        \/
        (
          A. i e. ( P23B3Index k )
            (
              ( i + 1 ) < k
              ->
              ( Y ` ( i + 1 ) ) =/= ( Y ` i )
            )
          /\
          A. i e. ( P23B3Index k )
            (
              ( i + 2 ) < k
              ->
              (
                ( Y ` ( i + 2 ) ) < ( Y ` ( i + 1 ) )
                <->
                ( Y ` i ) < ( Y ` ( i + 1 ) )
              )
            )
        )
      )
    )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d I X i j k n $.

  p23b3-subsequence-definition $a |- (
    ( P23B3Subsequence X n k )
    <->
    (
      (
        k e. NN
        /\
        k <_ n
      )
      /\
      E. I
        (
          I : ( P23B3Index k ) --> ( P23B3Index n )
          /\
          (
            A. i e. ( P23B3Index k )
              A. j e. ( P23B3Index k )
                (
                  i < j
                  ->
                  ( I ` i ) < ( I ` j )
                )
            /\
            (
              P23B3ZigZag
                (
                  i e. ( P23B3Index k ) |->
                    ( X ` ( I ` i ) )
                )
                k
            )
          )
        )
    )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d X k n $.

  p23b3-length-definition $a |- (
    P23B3Length X n
  ) = sup (
    {
      k e. NN |
        ( P23B3Subsequence X n k )
    } ,
    NN0 ,
    <
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d X n $.

  p23b3-integrand-definition $a |- (
    P23B3Integrand n
  ) = (
    X e. ( RR ^m ( P23B3Index n ) ) |->
      if (
        X e. ( P23B3Cube n ) ,
        ( P23B3Length X n ) ,
        0
      )
  ) $.
$}

putnambench-putnam-2023-b3 $a |- A. n e. NN
  (
    2 <_ n
    ->
    (
      (
        RRfld
        itgm
        ( voln ` ( P23B3Index n ) )
      )
      `
      ( P23B3Integrand n )
    )
    =
    (
      (
        ( 2 x. n )
        +
        2
      )
      /
      3
    )
  )
$.

environ

 vocabularies NUMBERS, XBOOLE_0, PROB_1, MEASURE1, PARTFUN1, SUBSET_1,

      RVSUM_1, MEASUR12, SIN_COS, SQUARE_1, POWER, SETFAM_1, MESFUN6C,
      COMPLEX1, SEQ_2, SEQM_3, SEQ_4, PREPOWER, ABIAN, BINOP_2,
      SERIES_1, NEWTON;
