title: putnam_2024_a4
content:
% Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2024_a4:
% the primes p > 5 whose powers 1, a, ..., a^(p-5) can be rearranged so that
% consecutive differences have a fixed nonzero residue modulo p are exactly
% p = 7. This file contains no proof.

putnam_2024_a4: THEORY
BEGIN
  natural_function: TYPE = [nat -> nat]

  nat_divides(divisor: posnat, value: nat): bool =
    EXISTS (quotient: nat):
      value = divisor * quotient

  prime_nat(value: nat): bool =
    value >= 2
      AND FORALL (divisor: posnat):
        nat_divides(divisor, value)
          IMPLIES divisor = 1 OR divisor = value

  int_divides(divisor, value: int): bool =
    EXISTS (quotient: int):
      value = divisor * quotient

  in_exponent_interval(index, p: nat): bool =
    index <= p - 5

  permutation_on_exponent_interval(
      e: natural_function,
      p: nat): bool =
    (FORALL (index: nat):
      in_exponent_interval(index, p)
        IMPLIES in_exponent_interval(e(index), p))
      AND
        (FORALL (left, right: nat):
          in_exponent_interval(left, p)
            AND in_exponent_interval(right, p)
            AND e(left) = e(right)
          IMPLIES left = right)
      AND
        (FORALL (value: nat):
          in_exponent_interval(value, p)
            IMPLIES
              EXISTS (index: nat):
                in_exponent_interval(index, p)
                  AND e(index) = value)

  has_required_rearrangement(p: nat): bool =
    EXISTS (a, r: int):
      1 <= r
        AND r <= (p :: int) - 1
        AND EXISTS (e: natural_function):
          permutation_on_exponent_interval(e, p)
            AND FORALL (n: nat):
              (1 <= n AND n <= p - 5)
                IMPLIES
                  int_divides(
                    p :: int,
                    a ^ e(n) - a ^ e(n - 1) - r)

  putnam_2024_a4_statement: bool =
    FORALL (p: nat):
      (prime_nat(p)
        AND p > 5
        AND has_required_rearrangement(p))
      IFF p = 7

END putnam_2024_a4

title: putnam_2024_a5
content:
import Mathlib

open MeasureTheory
open scoped ENNReal
open scoped EuclideanGeometry

noncomputable abbrev putnam_2024_a5_solution : Set ℝ := sorry
--{0}
/--
Consider a circle $\Omega$ with radius $9$ and center at the origin $(0, 0)$ and a disk $\Delta$ with radius $1$ and center at $(r, 0)$ where $0 \le r \le 8$. Two points $P$ and $Q$ are chosen independently and uniformly at random
on $\Omega$. Which value(s) of $r$ minimize the probability that the chord $\overline{PQ}$ intersects $\Delta$?
-/
theorem putnam_2024_a5
    (IsIntersecting : ℝ → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → Prop)
    (IsIntersecting_def : ∀ r P Q,
      IsIntersecting r P Q ↔ (line[ℝ,P,Q] : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)))
      ∩ Metric.sphere ((WithLp.equiv _ _).symm ![r, 0]) 1 ≠ ∅)
    (ProbIntersect : ℝ → ℝ≥0∞)
    (ProbIntersect_def : ∀ r,
      ProbIntersect r = volume {(s, t) : ℝ × ℝ | s ∈ Set.Icc 0 1 ∧ t ∈ Set.Icc 0 1 ∧
        IsIntersecting r
          ((WithLp.equiv _ _).symm ![9 * Real.cos (2 * Real.pi * s), 9 * Real.sin (2 * Real.pi * s)])
          ((WithLp.equiv _ _).symm ![9 * Real.cos (2 * Real.pi * t), 9 * Real.sin (2 * Real.pi * t)]) }) :
    {r | r ∈ Set.Icc 0 8 ∧ ProbIntersect r = ⨅ x ∈ Set.Icc 0 8, ProbIntersect x} =
      putnam_2024_a5_solution :=
  sorry

title: putnam_2024_a5
content:
(* Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2024_a5:
   the center displacement that minimizes the probability that the full line
   through two random points on the radius-9 circle meets the unit sphere.
   This file contains no proof. *)

From Stdlib Require Import Reals.

Open Scope R_scope.

Definition putnam_2024_a5_point : Type := (R * R)%type.
Definition putnam_2024_a5_point_set : Type :=
  putnam_2024_a5_point -> Prop.

Definition putnam_2024_a5_affine_combination
    (u : R) (P Q : putnam_2024_a5_point) :
    putnam_2024_a5_point :=
  ((1 - u) * fst P + u * fst Q,
   (1 - u) * snd P + u * snd Q).

Definition putnam_2024_a5_squared_distance
    (P Q : putnam_2024_a5_point) : R :=
  (fst P - fst Q) ^ 2 + (snd P - snd Q) ^ 2.

Definition putnam_2024_a5_circle_point
    (s : R) : putnam_2024_a5_point :=
  (9 * cos (2 * PI * s), 9 * sin (2 * PI * s)).

Definition putnam_2024_a5_line_intersects_sphere
    (r : R) (P Q : putnam_2024_a5_point) : Prop :=
  exists u : R,
    putnam_2024_a5_squared_distance
      (putnam_2024_a5_affine_combination u P Q) (r, 0) = 1.

Definition putnam_2024_a5_event
    (IsIntersecting :
      R -> putnam_2024_a5_point -> putnam_2024_a5_point -> Prop)
    (r : R) : putnam_2024_a5_point_set :=
  fun st : putnam_2024_a5_point =>
    0 <= fst st <= 1 /\
    0 <= snd st <= 1 /\
    IsIntersecting r
      (putnam_2024_a5_circle_point (fst st))
      (putnam_2024_a5_circle_point (snd st)).

Record putnam_2024_a5_open_rectangle : Type := {
  putnam_2024_a5_x_lower : R;
  putnam_2024_a5_x_upper : R;
  putnam_2024_a5_y_lower : R;
  putnam_2024_a5_y_upper : R
}.

Definition putnam_2024_a5_in_open_rectangle
    (rectangle : putnam_2024_a5_open_rectangle)
    (p : putnam_2024_a5_point) : Prop :=
  putnam_2024_a5_x_lower rectangle < fst p <
    putnam_2024_a5_x_upper rectangle /\
  putnam_2024_a5_y_lower rectangle < snd p <
    putnam_2024_a5_y_upper rectangle.

Definition putnam_2024_a5_rectangle_area
    (rectangle : putnam_2024_a5_open_rectangle) : R :=
  Rmax 0
    (putnam_2024_a5_x_upper rectangle -
     putnam_2024_a5_x_lower rectangle) *
  Rmax 0
    (putnam_2024_a5_y_upper rectangle -
     putnam_2024_a5_y_lower rectangle).

Definition putnam_2024_a5_rectangles_cover
    (S : putnam_2024_a5_point_set)
    (rectangles : nat -> putnam_2024_a5_open_rectangle) : Prop :=
  forall p : putnam_2024_a5_point,
    S p ->
    exists n : nat,
      putnam_2024_a5_in_open_rectangle (rectangles n) p.

Fixpoint putnam_2024_a5_partial_rectangle_area
    (rectangles : nat -> putnam_2024_a5_open_rectangle)
    (n : nat) : R :=
  match n with
  | O => 0
  | S k =>
      putnam_2024_a5_partial_rectangle_area rectangles k +
      putnam_2024_a5_rectangle_area (rectangles k)
  end.

(* This is the countable-open-rectangle characterization of finite planar
   Lebesgue outer measure. For this closed event it equals Lebesgue measure;
   on the unit parameter square that area is the required probability. *)
Definition putnam_2024_a5_has_planar_lebesgue_measure
    (S : putnam_2024_a5_point_set) (area : R) : Prop :=
  0 <= area /\
  (forall rectangles : nat -> putnam_2024_a5_open_rectangle,
    putnam_2024_a5_rectangles_cover S rectangles ->
    forall lower : R,
      lower < area ->
      exists n : nat,
        lower <
          putnam_2024_a5_partial_rectangle_area rectangles n) /\
  (forall epsilon : R,
    0 < epsilon ->
    exists rectangles : nat -> putnam_2024_a5_open_rectangle,
      putnam_2024_a5_rectangles_cover S rectangles /\
      forall n : nat,
        putnam_2024_a5_partial_rectangle_area rectangles n <
          area + epsilon).

Definition putnam_2024_a5_solution (r : R) : Prop :=
  r = 0.

Theorem putnam_2024_a5
    (IsIntersecting :
      R -> putnam_2024_a5_point -> putnam_2024_a5_point -> Prop)
    (IsIntersecting_def :
      forall (r : R) (P Q : putnam_2024_a5_point),
        IsIntersecting r P Q <->
        putnam_2024_a5_line_intersects_sphere r P Q)
    (ProbIntersect : R -> R)
    (ProbIntersect_def :
      forall r : R,
        putnam_2024_a5_has_planar_lebesgue_measure
          (putnam_2024_a5_event IsIntersecting r)
          (ProbIntersect r)) :
  forall r : R,
    (0 <= r <= 8 /\
     forall x : R, 0 <= x <= 8 -> ProbIntersect r <= ProbIntersect x) <->
    putnam_2024_a5_solution r.
Admitted.

title: putnam_2024_a5
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2024_a5
  (putnambench__isabelle__putnam_2024_a5): the center displacement r in
  [0,8] minimizing the probability that a random chord of the radius-9 circle
  meets the radius-1 disk centered at (r,0) is exactly r = 0. This file
  contains no proof.
*)

theory putnam_2024_a5
  imports Complex_Main
begin

type_synonym putnam_2024_a5_point = "real \<times> real"

definition putnam_2024_a5_circle_point ::
    "real \<Rightarrow> putnam_2024_a5_point" where
  "putnam_2024_a5_circle_point s =
    (9 * cos (2 * pi * s), 9 * sin (2 * pi * s))"

definition putnam_2024_a5_line ::
    "putnam_2024_a5_point \<Rightarrow> putnam_2024_a5_point \<Rightarrow>
      putnam_2024_a5_point set" where
  "putnam_2024_a5_line P Q =
    {X. \<exists>u :: real.
      X =
        (fst P + u * (fst Q - fst P),
          snd P + u * (snd Q - snd P))}"

definition putnam_2024_a5_is_intersecting ::
    "real \<Rightarrow> putnam_2024_a5_point \<Rightarrow>
      putnam_2024_a5_point \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "putnam_2024_a5_is_intersecting r P Q \<longleftrightarrow>
    putnam_2024_a5_line P Q \<inter>
      {X. (fst X - r) ^ 2 + (snd X) ^ 2 = 1} \<noteq> {}"

definition putnam_2024_a5_lebesgue_outer ::
    "putnam_2024_a5_point set \<Rightarrow> real" where
  "putnam_2024_a5_lebesgue_outer A =
    Inf
      {suminf (\<lambda>n. max 0 (b n - a n) * max 0 (d n - c n)) |
        a b c d.
          summable
            (\<lambda>n. max 0 (b n - a n) * max 0 (d n - c n)) \<and>
          A \<subseteq>
            (\<Union>n :: nat.
              {(x, y).
                a n < x \<and> x < b n \<and>
                c n < y \<and> y < d n})}"

definition putnam_2024_a5_prob_intersect :: "real \<Rightarrow> real" where
  "putnam_2024_a5_prob_intersect r =
    putnam_2024_a5_lebesgue_outer
      {p :: real \<times> real.
        fst p \<in> {0..1} \<and>
        snd p \<in> {0..1} \<and>
        putnam_2024_a5_is_intersecting r
          (putnam_2024_a5_circle_point (fst p))
          (putnam_2024_a5_circle_point (snd p))}"

definition putnam_2024_a5_solution :: "real set" where
  "putnam_2024_a5_solution = {0}"

theorem putnam_2024_a5:
  shows
    "{r :: real.
      r \<in> {0..8} \<and>
      putnam_2024_a5_prob_intersect r =
        (INF x\<in>{0..8}. putnam_2024_a5_prob_intersect x)}
      = putnam_2024_a5_solution"
  sorry

end

title: putnam_2024_a5
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2024_a5
  (putnambench__hol-light__putnam_2024_a5): the radius-axis displacement
  minimizing the probability that the affine line through two independent
  uniform points on a radius-9 circle meets a unit circle. The unique
  minimizing displacement is 0. This file contains no proof.
*)

let transc_output = open_out "/dev/null";;
let transc_formatter = Format.formatter_of_out_channel transc_output;;
let previous_file_loader = !Hol_loader.file_loader;;
Hol_loader.file_loader :=
  (fun path -> Toploop.use_file transc_formatter path);;
let transc_loaded =
  Toploop.use_file transc_formatter "Library/transc.ml";;
Hol_loader.file_loader := previous_file_loader;;
Format.pp_print_flush transc_formatter ();;
close_out transc_output;;
if not transc_loaded then failwith "failed to load Library/transc.ml";;

let statement =
  `let cover_bound =
     \(s:(real#real)->bool) (B:real).
       &0 <= B /\
       ?xl xu yl yu:num->real.
         (!k:num. xl k <= xu k /\ yl k <= yu k) /\
         (!p:real#real.
            p IN s
            ==> ?k:num.
                  xl k < FST p /\ FST p < xu k /\
                  yl k < SND p /\ SND p < yu k) /\
         (!N:num.
            sum (0..N)
              (\k:num. (xu k - xl k) * (yu k - yl k)) <= B) in
   let planar_outer_measure =
     \(s:(real#real)->bool).
       inf {B:real | cover_bound s B} in
   let line_meets_circle =
     \(r:real) (P:real#real) (Q:real#real).
       ?u:real.
         (FST P + u * (FST Q - FST P) - r) pow 2 +
         (SND P + u * (SND Q - SND P)) pow 2 = &1 in
   !IsIntersecting:real->(real#real)->(real#real)->bool
    ProbIntersect:real->real.
      (!r:real P:real#real Q:real#real.
         (IsIntersecting r P Q <=> line_meets_circle r P Q)) /\
      (!r:real.
         ProbIntersect r =
         planar_outer_measure
           {st:real#real |
              &0 <= FST st /\ FST st <= &1 /\
              &0 <= SND st /\ SND st <= &1 /\
              IsIntersecting r
                (&9 * cos (&2 * pi * FST st),
                 &9 * sin (&2 * pi * FST st))
                (&9 * cos (&2 * pi * SND st),
                 &9 * sin (&2 * pi * SND st))})
      ==>
      {r:real |
         &0 <= r /\ r <= &8 /\
         ProbIntersect r =
         inf (IMAGE ProbIntersect {x:real | &0 <= x /\ x <= &8})} =
      {r:real | r = &0}`;;

title: putnam_2024_a5
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2024_a5:
;; the origin-centered radius-nine circle has its unique probability-minimizing
;; radius-one target disk at the origin. This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))

;; This generic function is an arbitrary rational Cauchy presentation of r.
;; Regularity and the interval restriction are explicit in the root predicate.
(defstub putnam-2024-a5-r-approx (precision) t)

(defun putnam-2024-a5-positive-rational-p (value)
  (and
   (rationalp value)
   (< 0 value)))

(defun-sk putnam-2024-a5-regular-real-name-p ()
  (forall (precision eta)
    (implies
     (and
      (putnam-2024-a5-positive-rational-p precision)
      (putnam-2024-a5-positive-rational-p eta))
     (let ((left (putnam-2024-a5-r-approx precision))
           (right (putnam-2024-a5-r-approx eta)))
       (and
        (rationalp left)
        (rationalp right)
        (<= (abs (- left right))
            (+ precision eta)))))))

;; For a regular name these are the exact strict comparisons r < q and q < r.
(defun-sk putnam-2024-a5-real-less-than-rational-p (q)
  (exists (precision margin)
    (and
     (rationalp q)
     (putnam-2024-a5-positive-rational-p precision)
     (putnam-2024-a5-positive-rational-p margin)
     (let ((sample (putnam-2024-a5-r-approx precision)))
       (and
        (rationalp sample)
        (< (+ sample precision margin) q))))))

(defun-sk putnam-2024-a5-rational-less-than-real-p (q)
  (exists (precision margin)
    (and
     (rationalp q)
     (putnam-2024-a5-positive-rational-p precision)
     (putnam-2024-a5-positive-rational-p margin)
     (let ((sample (putnam-2024-a5-r-approx precision)))
       (and
        (rationalp sample)
        (< (+ q precision margin) sample))))))

(defun putnam-2024-a5-real-zero-p ()
  (and
   (putnam-2024-a5-regular-real-name-p)
   (not (putnam-2024-a5-real-less-than-rational-p 0))
   (not (putnam-2024-a5-rational-less-than-real-p 0))))

(defun putnam-2024-a5-radius-in-range-p ()
  (and
   (putnam-2024-a5-regular-real-name-p)
   (not (putnam-2024-a5-real-less-than-rational-p 0))
   (not (putnam-2024-a5-rational-less-than-real-p 8))))

;; Rational partial sums for pi, cosine, and arcsine provide canonical Cauchy
;; presentations of the transcendental values in the chord probability.
(defun putnam-2024-a5-factorial (n)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix n)))
  (if (zp n)
      1
    (* n (putnam-2024-a5-factorial (- n 1)))))

(defun putnam-2024-a5-alternating-sign (n)
  (if (equal (mod (nfix n) 2) 0)
      1
    -1))

(defun putnam-2024-a5-pi-series-sum (terms)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix terms)))
  (if (zp terms)
      0
    (let ((k (- terms 1)))
      (+
       (putnam-2024-a5-pi-series-sum k)
       (/
        (putnam-2024-a5-alternating-sign k)
        (+ (* 2 k) 1))))))

(defun putnam-2024-a5-pi-approx (terms)
  (* 4 (putnam-2024-a5-pi-series-sum terms)))

(defun putnam-2024-a5-cos-series-sum (x terms)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix terms)))
  (if (zp terms)
      0
    (let ((k (- terms 1)))
      (+
       (putnam-2024-a5-cos-series-sum x k)
       (/
        (*
         (putnam-2024-a5-alternating-sign k)
         (expt x (* 2 k)))
        (putnam-2024-a5-factorial (* 2 k)))))))

(defun putnam-2024-a5-central-binomial (k)
  (/
   (putnam-2024-a5-factorial (* 2 k))
   (*
    (putnam-2024-a5-factorial k)
    (putnam-2024-a5-factorial k))))

(defun putnam-2024-a5-clamp-unit (x)
  (cond
   ((< x -1) -1)
   ((< 1 x) 1)
   (t x)))

(defun putnam-2024-a5-asin-series-sum (x terms)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix terms)))
  (if (zp terms)
      0
    (let ((k (- terms 1)))
      (+
       (putnam-2024-a5-asin-series-sum x k)
       (/
        (*
         (putnam-2024-a5-central-binomial k)
         (expt x (+ (* 2 k) 1)))
        (*
         (expt 4 k)
         (+ (* 2 k) 1)))))))

;; If alpha and beta are the two endpoint angles, the line through the
;; endpoints has signed offset 9*cos((alpha-beta)/2). After the
;; measure-preserving torus change of variables, conditioning on its normal
;; angle theta gives the kernel
;;
;;   asin((r*cos(theta)+1)/9) - asin((r*cos(theta)-1)/9).
;;
;; Its angular average differs from the source volume only by a fixed positive
;; factor, so it has exactly the same minimizers.
(defun putnam-2024-a5-kernel-sample
    (r-sample pi-sample numerator denominator terms)
  (let* ((angle
          (/ (* 2 pi-sample numerator)
             denominator))
         (cosine
          (putnam-2024-a5-cos-series-sum angle terms))
         (projection (* r-sample cosine))
         (upper
          (putnam-2024-a5-clamp-unit
           (/ (+ projection 1) 9)))
         (lower
          (putnam-2024-a5-clamp-unit
           (/ (- projection 1) 9))))
    (-
     (putnam-2024-a5-asin-series-sum upper terms)
     (putnam-2024-a5-asin-series-sum lower terms))))

(defun putnam-2024-a5-riemann-sum-aux
    (count total r-sample pi-sample terms)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix count)))
  (if (zp count)
      0
    (let ((k (- count 1)))
      (+
       (putnam-2024-a5-riemann-sum-aux
        k total r-sample pi-sample terms)
       (putnam-2024-a5-kernel-sample
        r-sample pi-sample k total terms)))))

(defun putnam-2024-a5-probability-sum (n)
  (if (zp n)
      0
    (let* ((precision (/ 1 (+ n 1)))
           (r-sample (putnam-2024-a5-r-approx precision))
           (pi-sample (putnam-2024-a5-pi-approx n)))
      (if (rationalp r-sample)
          (/
           (putnam-2024-a5-riemann-sum-aux
            n n r-sample pi-sample n)
           n)
        0))))

(defun putnam-2024-a5-origin-probability-sum (n)
  (if (zp n)
      0
    (/
     (putnam-2024-a5-riemann-sum-aux
      n n 0 (putnam-2024-a5-pi-approx n) n)
     n)))

;; Equality of these two rational sequences is equality of the exact angular
;; averages, hence equality of the original intersection probabilities.
(defun-sk putnam-2024-a5-probability-tail-close-p (epsilon cutoff)
  (forall (n)
    (implies
     (and
      (natp n)
      (natp cutoff)
      (<= cutoff n))
     (<
      (abs
       (-
        (putnam-2024-a5-probability-sum n)
        (putnam-2024-a5-origin-probability-sum n)))
      epsilon))))

(defun-sk putnam-2024-a5-probability-close-at-p (epsilon)
  (exists (cutoff)
    (and
     (natp cutoff)
     (putnam-2024-a5-probability-tail-close-p
      epsilon cutoff))))

(defun-sk putnam-2024-a5-probability-equals-origin-p ()
  (forall (epsilon)
    (implies
     (putnam-2024-a5-positive-rational-p epsilon)
     (putnam-2024-a5-probability-close-at-p epsilon))))

;; For convergent rational presentations, this eventual epsilon inequality is
;; exactly the limit order Prob(0) <= Prob(r).
(defun-sk putnam-2024-a5-origin-order-tail-p (epsilon cutoff)
  (forall (n)
    (implies
     (and
      (natp n)
      (natp cutoff)
      (<= cutoff n))
     (<
      (putnam-2024-a5-origin-probability-sum n)

title: putnam_2024_a5
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2024_a5
-- (putnambench__agda__putnam_2024_a5): for random endpoints on the circle of
-- radius 9, the disk-center parameter in [0,8] minimizing the probability
-- that the chord meets the unit disk is exactly r = 0. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module Main where

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; _*_)

infix 4 _!=_ _<=N_
infixr 3 _and_
infixr 2 _or_

data Bottom : Set where

Not : Set -> Set
Not A =
  A -> Bottom

_!=_ : {A : Set} -> A -> A -> Set
x != y =
  Not (x == y)

record _and_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data _or_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  left  : A -> A or B
  right : B -> A or B

record Iff (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor equivalence
  field
    forward  : A -> B
    backward : B -> A

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

data _<=N_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set where
  zero<=N   : {n : Nat} -> zero <=N n
  suc<=sucN : {m n : Nat} -> m <=N n -> suc m <=N suc n

Predicate : Set -> Set1
Predicate A =
  A -> Set

record CompleteOrderedRealField (R : Set) : Set1 where
  field
    zeroR oneR : R
    add multiply : R -> R -> R
    negate inverse : R -> R
    lessOrEqual : R -> R -> Set
    fromNat : Nat -> R

    one-not-zero :
      oneR != zeroR

    add-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> add x y == add y x
    add-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      add (add x y) z == add x (add y z)
    add-zero :
      (x : R) -> add x zeroR == x
    add-inverse :
      (x : R) -> add x (negate x) == zeroR

    multiply-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> multiply x y == multiply y x
    multiply-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply (multiply x y) z ==
      multiply x (multiply y z)
    multiply-one :
      (x : R) -> multiply x oneR == x
    multiply-zero :
      (x : R) -> multiply x zeroR == zeroR
    distribute :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply x (add y z) ==
      add (multiply x y) (multiply x z)
    inverse-zero :
      inverse zeroR == zeroR
    multiply-inverse :
      (x : R) ->
      x != zeroR ->
      multiply x (inverse x) == oneR

    order-reflexive :
      (x : R) -> lessOrEqual x x
    order-transitive :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y z ->
      lessOrEqual x z
    order-antisymmetric :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y x ->
      x == y
    order-total :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y or lessOrEqual y x
    add-order :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual (add z x) (add z y)
    multiply-nonnegative :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR x ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR y ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR (multiply x y)
    zero-less-than-one :
      lessOrEqual zeroR oneR and zeroR != oneR

    fromNat-zero :
      fromNat zero == zeroR
    fromNat-successor :
      (n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (suc n) == add (fromNat n) oneR
    fromNat-addition :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m + n) == add (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-multiplication :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m * n) == multiply (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-injective :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat m == fromNat n ->
      m == n

    archimedean :
      (x : R) ->
      Exists Nat
        (\ n ->
          lessOrEqual x (fromNat n))
    least-upper-bound :
      (P : R -> Set) ->
      Exists R P ->
      Exists R
        (\ upper ->
          (x : R) ->
          P x ->
          lessOrEqual x upper) ->
      Exists R
        (\ supremum ->
          ((x : R) ->
            P x ->
            lessOrEqual x supremum)
          and
          ((upper : R) ->
            ((x : R) ->
              P x ->
              lessOrEqual x upper) ->
            lessOrEqual supremum upper))

open CompleteOrderedRealField

oneN : Nat
oneN =
  suc zero

twoN : Nat
twoN =
  suc oneN

eightN : Nat
eightN =
  twoN * twoN * twoN

nineN : Nat
nineN =
  suc eightN

subtract :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
subtract reals x y =
  add reals x (negate reals y)

divide :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
divide reals x y =
  multiply reals x (inverse reals y)

square :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R
square reals x =
  multiply reals x x

StrictLess :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
StrictLess reals x y =
  lessOrEqual reals x y and x != y

InClosedInterval :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
InClosedInterval reals lower upper x =
  lessOrEqual reals lower x
  and
  lessOrEqual reals x upper

CloseTo :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
CloseTo reals center radius x =
  StrictLess reals
    (subtract reals center radius)
    x
  and
  StrictLess reals
    x
    (add reals center radius)

sumFirst :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Nat ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  R
sumFirst reals zero terms =
  zeroR reals
sumFirst reals (suc n) terms =
  add reals
    (sumFirst reals n terms)
    (terms n)

factorial : Nat -> Nat
factorial zero =
  oneN
factorial (suc n) =
  suc n * factorial n

naturalPower :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  Nat ->
  R
naturalPower reals x zero =
  oneR reals
naturalPower reals x (suc n) =
  multiply reals
    (naturalPower reals x n)
    x

alternate :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Nat ->
  R ->
  R
alternate reals zero x =
  x
alternate reals (suc n) x =
  negate reals (alternate reals n x)

evenExponent : Nat -> Nat
evenExponent n =
  n + n

oddExponent : Nat -> Nat
oddExponent n =
  suc (evenExponent n)

sineTerm :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  Nat ->
  R
sineTerm reals x n =
  alternate reals n
    (divide reals
      (naturalPower reals x (oddExponent n))
      (fromNat reals (factorial (oddExponent n))))

cosineTerm :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  Nat ->
  R
cosineTerm reals x n =
  alternate reals n
    (divide reals
      (naturalPower reals x (evenExponent n))
      (fromNat reals (factorial (evenExponent n))))

ConvergesTo :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  R ->
  Set
ConvergesTo {R} reals sequence limit =
  (epsilon : R) ->
  StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) epsilon ->
  Exists Nat
    (\ cutoff ->
      (n : Nat) ->
      cutoff <=N n ->
      CloseTo reals limit epsilon (sequence n))

SeriesHasSum :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  R ->
  Set
SeriesHasSum reals terms value =
  ConvergesTo reals
    (\ n -> sumFirst reals n terms)
    value

record StandardTrigonometry
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) :
  Set1 where

  field
    sine cosine : R -> R
    pi : R

    sine-is-power-series :
      (x : R) ->
      SeriesHasSum reals
        (sineTerm reals x)
        (sine x)
    cosine-is-power-series :
      (x : R) ->
      SeriesHasSum reals
        (cosineTerm reals x)
        (cosine x)

    pi-positive :
      StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) pi
    sine-pi-zero :
      sine pi == zeroR reals
    pi-is-first-positive-sine-zero :
      (x : R) ->
      StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) x ->
      sine x == zeroR reals ->
      lessOrEqual reals pi x

open StandardTrigonometry

record Point (R : Set) : Set where
  constructor point
  field
    firstCoordinate  : R
    secondCoordinate : R

open Point

addPoint :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Point R ->
  Point R ->
  Point R
addPoint reals p q =
  point
    (add reals
      (firstCoordinate p)
      (firstCoordinate q))
    (add reals
      (secondCoordinate p)
      (secondCoordinate q))

scalePoint :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  Point R ->
  Point R
scalePoint reals scalar p =
  point
    (multiply reals scalar (firstCoordinate p))
    (multiply reals scalar (secondCoordinate p))

subtractPoint :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Point R ->
  Point R ->
  Point R
subtractPoint reals p q =
  point
    (subtract reals
      (firstCoordinate p)
      (firstCoordinate q))
    (subtract reals
      (secondCoordinate p)
      (secondCoordinate q))

squaredDistance :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Point R ->
  Point R ->
  R
squaredDistance reals p q =
  add reals
    (square reals
      (subtract reals
        (firstCoordinate p)
        (firstCoordinate q)))
    (square reals
      (subtract reals
        (secondCoordinate p)
        (secondCoordinate q)))

pointOnSegment :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Point R ->
  Point R ->
  R ->
  Point R
pointOnSegment reals p q parameter =
  addPoint reals p
    (scalePoint reals parameter
      (subtractPoint reals q p))

ChordIntersectsUnitDisk :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  Point R ->
  Point R ->
  Set
ChordIntersectsUnitDisk {R} reals r p q =
  Exists R
    (\ parameter ->
      InClosedInterval reals
        (zeroR reals)
        (oneR reals)
        parameter
      and
      lessOrEqual reals
        (squaredDistance reals
          (pointOnSegment reals p q parameter)
          (point r (zeroR reals)))
        (oneR reals))

Region : Set -> Set1
Region R =
  Point R -> Set

Empty :
  {R : Set} ->
  Region R
Empty _ =
  Bottom

Complement :
  {R : Set} ->
  Region R ->
  Region R
Complement body p =
  Not (body p)

Intersect :
  {R : Set} ->
  Region R ->
  Region R ->
  Region R
Intersect leftBody rightBody p =
  leftBody p and rightBody p

UnionAll :
  {R : Set} ->
  (Nat -> Region R) ->
  Region R
UnionAll bodies p =
  Exists Nat (\ n -> bodies n p)

Disjoint :
  {R : Set} ->
  Region R ->
  Region R ->
  Set
Disjoint {R} leftBody rightBody =
  (p : Point R) ->
  leftBody p ->
  rightBody p ->
  Bottom

PairwiseDisjoint :
  {R : Set} ->
  (Nat -> Region R) ->
  Set
PairwiseDisjoint bodies =
  (m n : Nat) ->
  m != n ->
  Disjoint (bodies m) (bodies n)

translateRegion :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Point R ->
  Region R ->
  Region R
translateRegion {R} reals offset body p =
  Exists (Point R)
    (\ q ->
      body q
      and
      p == addPoint reals offset q)

HalfOpenBox :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Point R ->
  Point R ->
  Region R
HalfOpenBox reals lower upper p =
  (lessOrEqual reals
    (firstCoordinate lower)
    (firstCoordinate p)
  and
  StrictLess reals
    (firstCoordinate p)
    (firstCoordinate upper))
  and
  (lessOrEqual reals
    (secondCoordinate lower)
    (secondCoordinate p)
  and
  StrictLess reals
    (secondCoordinate p)
    (secondCoordinate upper))

data ExtendedNonnegative (R : Set) : Set where
  finite   : R -> ExtendedNonnegative R
  infinity : ExtendedNonnegative R

data ExtendedLessOrEqual
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) :
  ExtendedNonnegative R ->
  ExtendedNonnegative R ->
  Set where

  finite<=finite :
    {x y : R} ->
    lessOrEqual reals x y ->
    ExtendedLessOrEqual reals (finite x) (finite y)

  finite<=infinity :
    {x : R} ->
    ExtendedLessOrEqual reals (finite x) infinity

  infinity<=infinity :
    ExtendedLessOrEqual reals infinity infinity

addExtended :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  ExtendedNonnegative R ->
  ExtendedNonnegative R ->
  ExtendedNonnegative R
addExtended reals infinity rightValue =
  infinity
addExtended reals (finite x) infinity =
  infinity
addExtended reals (finite x) (finite y) =
  finite (add reals x y)

sumFirstExtended :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Nat ->
  (Nat -> ExtendedNonnegative R) ->
  ExtendedNonnegative R
sumFirstExtended reals zero term =
  finite (zeroR reals)
sumFirstExtended reals (suc n) term =
  addExtended reals
    (sumFirstExtended reals n term)
    (term n)

UpperBoundExtended :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (Nat -> ExtendedNonnegative R) ->
  ExtendedNonnegative R ->
  Set
UpperBoundExtended reals values bound =
  (n : Nat) ->
  ExtendedLessOrEqual reals (values n) bound

LeastUpperBoundExtended :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (Nat -> ExtendedNonnegative R) ->
  ExtendedNonnegative R ->
  Set
LeastUpperBoundExtended reals values supremum =
  UpperBoundExtended reals values supremum
  and
  ((upper : ExtendedNonnegative _) ->
    UpperBoundExtended reals values upper ->
    ExtendedLessOrEqual reals supremum upper)

record StandardPlaneLebesgueMeasure
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) :
  Set1 where

  field
    measurable : Region R -> Set
    volume : Region R -> ExtendedNonnegative R

    measurable-empty :
      measurable Empty
    measurable-complement :
      (body : Region R) ->
      measurable body ->
      measurable (Complement body)
    measurable-countable-union :
      (bodies : Nat -> Region R) ->
      ((n : Nat) -> measurable (bodies n)) ->
      measurable (UnionAll bodies)
    measurable-intersection :
      (leftBody rightBody : Region R) ->
      measurable leftBody ->
      measurable rightBody ->
      measurable (Intersect leftBody rightBody)
    measurable-translation :
      (offset : Point R) ->
      (body : Region R) ->
      measurable body ->
      measurable (translateRegion reals offset body)
    measurable-box :
      (lower upper : Point R) ->
      measurable (HalfOpenBox reals lower upper)

    volume-congruent :
      (leftBody rightBody : Region R) ->
      ((p : Point R) ->
        Iff (leftBody p) (rightBody p)) ->
      volume leftBody == volume rightBody
    volume-empty :
      volume Empty == finite (zeroR reals)
    volume-nonnegative :
      (body : Region R) ->
      measurable body ->
      ExtendedLessOrEqual reals
        (finite (zeroR reals))
        (volume body)
    volume-countable-additive :
      (bodies : Nat -> Region R) ->
      ((n : Nat) -> measurable (bodies n)) ->
      PairwiseDisjoint bodies ->
      LeastUpperBoundExtended reals
        (\ count ->
          sumFirstExtended reals count
            (\ n -> volume (bodies n)))
        (volume (UnionAll bodies))
    volume-translation-invariant :
      (offset : Point R) ->
      (body : Region R) ->
      measurable body ->
      volume (translateRegion reals offset body) ==
      volume body
    volume-box :
      (lower upper : Point R) ->
      lessOrEqual reals
        (firstCoordinate lower)
        (firstCoordinate upper) ->
      lessOrEqual reals
        (secondCoordinate lower)
        (secondCoordinate upper) ->
      volume (HalfOpenBox reals lower upper) ==
      finite
        (multiply reals
          (subtract reals
            (firstCoordinate upper)
            (firstCoordinate lower))
          (subtract reals
            (secondCoordinate upper)
            (secondCoordinate lower)))

open StandardPlaneLebesgueMeasure

module Putnam2024A5Statement
  {R : Set}

  twoPi =

      (multiply reals
        (fromNat reals nineN)

      (zeroR reals)
      (fromNat reals eightN)
      r

      InClosedInterval reals
        (zeroR reals)
        (fromNat reals eightN)

    (probabilityOfIntersection : R -> ExtendedNonnegative R) ->

(*

  the probability that a random chord of the radius-nine circle meets the
  unit disk centered at (r,0) is minimized on 0 <= r <= 8 exactly at r = 0.
  This file contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open pairTheory pred_setTheory realTheory transcTheory;
open extrealTheory measureTheory lebesgue_measureTheory martingaleTheory;

val putnam_2024_a5 =
  ``let circle_point =
      \s : real.
        (9 * cos (2 * pi * s), 9 * sin (2 * pi * s))
    in
    let intersects =
      \r : real.
      \P Q : real # real.
        ?u : real.
          (FST P + u * (FST Q - FST P) - r) pow 2 +
            (SND P + u * (SND Q - SND P)) pow 2 = 1
    in
    let probability =
      \r : real.
        measure
          (prod_measure_space lebesgue lebesgue)
          {st : real # real |
             0 <= FST st /\ FST st <= 1 /\
             0 <= SND st /\ SND st <= 1 /\
             intersects r
               (circle_point (FST st))
               (circle_point (SND st))}
    in
      {r : real |
         0 <= r /\ r <= 8 /\
         !x : real.
           0 <= x /\ x <= 8 ==> probability r <= probability x} =
      {0}``;

title: putnam_2024_a5
content:
% Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2024_a5:
% the offset in [0,8] minimizing the probability that a random chord of the
% radius-9 circle meets the radius-1 disk is exactly 0. This file contains no proof.

putnam_2024_a5: THEORY
BEGIN
  point: TYPE = [# x_coord: real, y_coord: real #]
  parameter_pair: TYPE =
    [# first_parameter: real, second_parameter: real #]
  parameter_event: TYPE = [parameter_pair -> bool]
  real_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> real]

  rectangle: TYPE =
    [# lower_first: real, upper_first: real,
       lower_second: real, upper_second: real #]
  rectangle_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> rectangle]

  safe_div(numerator, denominator: real): real =
    IF denominator = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      numerator / denominator
    ENDIF

  factorial(index: nat): RECURSIVE nat =
    IF index = 0 THEN
      1
    ELSE
      index * factorial(index - 1)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE index

  sine_partial(x: real, count: nat): RECURSIVE real =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      LET index: nat = count - 1 IN
        sine_partial(x, count - 1)
          + safe_div(
              ((-1 :: real) ^ index) * x ^ (2 * index + 1),
              factorial(2 * index + 1) :: real)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  cosine_partial(x: real, count: nat): RECURSIVE real =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      LET index: nat = count - 1 IN
        cosine_partial(x, count - 1)
          + safe_div(
              ((-1 :: real) ^ index) * x ^ (2 * index),
              factorial(2 * index) :: real)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  converges_to(sequence: real_sequence, value: real): bool =
    FORALL (epsilon_value: posreal):
      EXISTS (cutoff: nat):
        FORALL (index: nat):
          cutoff <= index IMPLIES
            abs(sequence(index) - value) < epsilon_value

  sine(x: real): real =
    epsilon(
      LAMBDA (value: real):
        converges_to(
          LAMBDA (count: nat): sine_partial(x, count),
          value))

  cosine(x: real): real =
    epsilon(
      LAMBDA (value: real):
        converges_to(
          LAMBDA (count: nat): cosine_partial(x, count),
          value))

  is_pi(value: real): bool =
    3 < value AND value < 4 AND cosine(value / 2) = 0

  pi: real =
    epsilon(
      LAMBDA (value: real):
        is_pi(value))

  circle_point(parameter: real): point =
    (# x_coord :=
         9 * cosine(2 * pi * parameter),
       y_coord :=
         9 * sine(2 * pi * parameter) #)

  disk_center(offset: real): point =
    (# x_coord := offset, y_coord := 0 #)

  segment_point(P, Q: point, parameter: real): point =
    (# x_coord :=
         x_coord(P)
           + parameter * (x_coord(Q) - x_coord(P)),
       y_coord :=
         y_coord(P)
           + parameter * (y_coord(Q) - y_coord(P)) #)

  squared_distance(P, Q: point): real =
    (x_coord(P) - x_coord(Q)) ^ 2
      + (y_coord(P) - y_coord(Q)) ^ 2

  chord_intersects_disk(
      offset, first, second: real): bool =
    EXISTS (segment_parameter: real):
      0 <= segment_parameter
        AND segment_parameter <= 1
        AND squared_distance(
              segment_point(
                circle_point(first),
                circle_point(second),
                segment_parameter),
              disk_center(offset))
            <= 1

  intersection_event(offset: real): parameter_event =
    LAMBDA (parameters: parameter_pair):
      0 <= first_parameter(parameters)
        AND first_parameter(parameters) <= 1
        AND 0 <= second_parameter(parameters)
        AND second_parameter(parameters) <= 1
        AND chord_intersects_disk(
              offset,
              first_parameter(parameters),
              second_parameter(parameters))

  in_open_rectangle(
      parameters: parameter_pair,
      box: rectangle): bool =
    lower_first(box) < first_parameter(parameters)
      AND first_parameter(parameters) < upper_first(box)
      AND lower_second(box) < second_parameter(parameters)
      AND second_parameter(parameters) < upper_second(box)

  rectangle_area(box: rectangle): real =
    IF lower_first(box) < upper_first(box)
        AND lower_second(box) < upper_second(box)
    THEN
      (upper_first(box) - lower_first(box))
        * (upper_second(box) - lower_second(box))
    ELSE
      0
    ENDIF

  partial_rectangle_area(
      boxes: rectangle_sequence,
      count: nat): RECURSIVE real =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      partial_rectangle_area(boxes, count - 1)
        + rectangle_area(boxes(count - 1))
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  covers(
      covered_event: parameter_event,
      boxes: rectangle_sequence): bool =
    FORALL (parameters: parameter_pair):
      covered_event(parameters) IMPLIES
        EXISTS (index: nat):
          in_open_rectangle(parameters, boxes(index))

  cover_has_total_area(
      covered_event: parameter_event,
      boxes: rectangle_sequence,
      total: real): bool =
    covers(covered_event, boxes)
      AND converges_to(
        LAMBDA (count: nat):
          partial_rectangle_area(boxes, count),
        total)

  has_lebesgue_outer_area(
      measured_event: parameter_event,
      area: real): bool =
    0 <= area
      AND (FORALL (boxes: rectangle_sequence), (total: real):
        cover_has_total_area(measured_event, boxes, total)
          IMPLIES area <= total)
      AND (FORALL (epsilon_value: posreal):
        EXISTS (boxes: rectangle_sequence), (total: real):
          cover_has_total_area(measured_event, boxes, total)
            AND total < area + epsilon_value)

  probability_of_intersection(offset: real): real =
    epsilon(
      LAMBDA (area: real):
        has_lebesgue_outer_area(
          intersection_event(offset),
          area))

  minimizes_probability(offset: real): bool =
    0 <= offset
      AND offset <= 8
      AND (FORALL (other_offset: real):
        (0 <= other_offset AND other_offset <= 8)
          IMPLIES
            probability_of_intersection(offset)
              <= probability_of_intersection(other_offset))

  putnam_2024_a5_solution(offset: real): bool =
    offset = 0

  putnam_2024_a5: bool =
    FORALL (offset: real):
      minimizes_probability(offset)
        IFF putnam_2024_a5_solution(offset)
END putnam_2024_a5

title: putnam_2024_a6
content:
import Mathlib

open scoped Real
open scoped Topology

noncomputable abbrev putnam_2024_a6_solution : ℕ → ℝ := sorry
--fun n => 10^(n*(n-1)/2 : ℕ)
/--
Let $c_0, c_1, c_2, ...$ be a sequence defined so that
$$\frac{1 - 3x - \sqrt{1 - 14x + 9x^2}}{4} = \sum_{k=0}^\infty c_k x^k$$
for sufficiently small $x$.
For a positive integer $n$, let $A$ be the $n$-by-$n$ matrix whose
$(i, j)$-entry is $c_{i+j-1}$ for $i$ and $j$ in $\{1, 2, ..., n\}$.
Find the determinant of $A$.
-/
theorem putnam_2024_a6
    (c : ℕ → ℝ)
    (n : ℕ)
    (h₀ : ∀ᶠ x in 𝓝 0,
      HasSum (fun k => c k * x ^ k) ((1 - 3 * x - √(1 - 14 * x + 9 * x ^ 2)) / 4))
    (h₁ : 0 < n) :
    (Matrix.of fun (i j : Fin n) => c (i + j + 1)).det = putnam_2024_a6_solution n :=
  sorry

title: putnam_2024_a6
content:
(* Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2024_a6
   (putnambench__rocq__putnam_2024_a6): the Hankel determinant formed from
   coefficients of a specified algebraic real power series. This file
   contains no proof. *)

From Stdlib Require Import Lists.List Arith.PeanoNat Vectors.Fin Reals.

Import ListNotations.
Open Scope R_scope.

Fixpoint putnam_2024_a6_partial_sum
    (u : nat -> R) (n : nat) : R :=
  match n with
  | O => 0
  | S k => putnam_2024_a6_partial_sum u k + u k
  end.

Definition putnam_2024_a6_series_sum
    (u : nat -> R) (value : R) : Prop :=
  forall epsilon : R,
    0 < epsilon ->
    exists N : nat,
      forall m : nat,
        (N <= m)%nat ->
        Rabs (putnam_2024_a6_partial_sum u m - value) < epsilon.

Definition putnam_2024_a6_generating_function
    (c : nat -> R) : Prop :=
  exists radius : R,
    0 < radius /\
    forall x : R,
      Rabs x < radius ->
      putnam_2024_a6_series_sum
        (fun k : nat => c k * x ^ k)
        ((1 - 3 * x - sqrt (1 - 14 * x + 9 * x ^ 2)) / 4).

Fixpoint putnam_2024_a6_fin_list
    (n : nat) : list (Fin.t n) :=
  match n as m return list (Fin.t m) with
  | O => []
  | S k =>
      Fin.F1 :: map Fin.FS (putnam_2024_a6_fin_list k)
  end.

Fixpoint putnam_2024_a6_sum (xs : list R) : R :=
  match xs with
  | [] => 0
  | x :: rest => x + putnam_2024_a6_sum rest
  end.

Definition putnam_2024_a6_delete_nth
    {T : Type} (j : nat) (xs : list T) : list T :=
  firstn j xs ++ skipn (S j) xs.

Definition putnam_2024_a6_cofactor_sign (j : nat) : R :=
  if Nat.even j then 1 else -1.

Fixpoint putnam_2024_a6_list_det
    (n : nat) (M : list (list R)) {struct n} : R :=
  match n with
  | O => 1
  | S k =>
      match M with
      | [] => 0
      | row :: rows =>
          putnam_2024_a6_sum
            (map
              (fun j : nat =>
                putnam_2024_a6_cofactor_sign j *
                nth j row 0 *
                putnam_2024_a6_list_det k
                  (map (putnam_2024_a6_delete_nth j) rows))
              (seq 0 (S k)))
      end
  end.

Definition putnam_2024_a6_matrix (n : nat) : Type :=
  Fin.t n -> Fin.t n -> R.

Definition putnam_2024_a6_rows
    (n : nat) (A : putnam_2024_a6_matrix n) :
    list (list R) :=
  map
    (fun i =>
      map (fun j => A i j) (putnam_2024_a6_fin_list n))
    (putnam_2024_a6_fin_list n).

Definition putnam_2024_a6_determinant
    (n : nat) (A : putnam_2024_a6_matrix n) : R :=
  putnam_2024_a6_list_det n (putnam_2024_a6_rows n A).

Definition putnam_2024_a6_index
    {n : nat} (i : Fin.t n) : nat :=
  proj1_sig (Fin.to_nat i).

Definition putnam_2024_a6_hankel_matrix
    (c : nat -> R) (n : nat) : putnam_2024_a6_matrix n :=
  fun i j =>
    c ((putnam_2024_a6_index i +
        putnam_2024_a6_index j + 1)%nat).

Definition putnam_2024_a6_solution (n : nat) : R :=
  10 ^ ((n * (n - 1) / 2)%nat).

Theorem putnam_2024_a6 :
  forall (c : nat -> R) (n : nat),
    putnam_2024_a6_generating_function c ->
    (0 < n)%nat ->
    putnam_2024_a6_determinant n
      (putnam_2024_a6_hankel_matrix c n) =
    putnam_2024_a6_solution n.
Admitted.

content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2024_a6
  (putnambench__isabelle__putnam_2024_a6): the determinant of the Hankel
  matrix formed from the coefficients of the specified real power series is
  10 raised to n(n-1)/2. This file contains no proof.
*)

theory putnam_2024_a6
  imports Complex_Main
begin

definition putnam_2024_a6_det ::
    "(nat \<Rightarrow> nat \<Rightarrow> real) \<Rightarrow> nat \<Rightarrow> real" where
  "putnam_2024_a6_det A n =
    (\<Sum>p\<in>{p :: nat \<Rightarrow> nat.
        bij_betw p {0..<n} {0..<n} \<and>
        (\<forall>i \<ge> n. p i = i)}.
      (-1 :: real) ^
        card {(i, j). i < n \<and> j < n \<and> i < j \<and> p j < p i} *
      (\<Prod>i\<in>{0..<n}. A i (p i)))"

definition putnam_2024_a6_solution :: "nat \<Rightarrow> real" where
  "putnam_2024_a6_solution n =
    10 ^ (n * (n - 1) div 2)"

theorem putnam_2024_a6:
  fixes c :: "nat \<Rightarrow> real"
    and n :: nat
  assumes hseries:
    "eventually
      (\<lambda>x :: real.
        (\<lambda>k :: nat. c k * x ^ k) sums
          ((1 - 3 * x - sqrt (1 - 14 * x + 9 * x ^ 2)) / 4))
      (nhds 0)"
    and hn: "0 < n"
  shows
    "putnam_2024_a6_det (\<lambda>i j. c (i + j + 1)) n =
      putnam_2024_a6_solution n"
  sorry

end

title: putnam_2024_a6
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2024_a6
  (putnambench__hol-light__putnam_2024_a6): the determinant of the Hankel
  matrix formed from coefficients of a specified real power series near zero.
  This file contains no proof.
*)

let analysis_output = open_out "/dev/null";;
let analysis_formatter = Format.formatter_of_out_channel analysis_output;;
let analysis_loaded =
  Toploop.use_file analysis_formatter "Library/analysis.ml";;
Format.pp_print_flush analysis_formatter ();;
close_out analysis_output;;
if not analysis_loaded then failwith "failed to load Library/analysis.ml";;

let statement =
  `let ndet =
     \(A:num->num->real) n.
       sum {p:num->num |
              BIJ p (0..n-1) (0..n-1) /\
              (!i:num. ~(i IN 0..n-1) ==> p i = i)}
           (\p.
              (if EVEN
                    (CARD
                      {(i,j) |
                         i < n /\ j < n /\ i < j /\ p j < p i})
               then &1
               else -- &1) *
              product (0..n-1) (\i. A i (p i))) in
   !c:num->real. !n:num.
     (?e:real.
        &0 < e /\
        !x:real.
          abs x < e
          ==> (\k:num. c k * x pow k) sums
              ((&1 - &3 * x -
                sqrt (&1 - &14 * x + &9 * x pow 2)) / &4)) /\
     0 < n
     ==>
     ndet (\i j:num. c (i + j + 1)) n =
     (&10:real) pow ((n * (n - 1)) DIV 2)`;;

title: putnam_2024_a6
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2024_a6:
;; the Hankel determinant of the real power-series coefficients defined by
;; (1-3x-sqrt(1-14x+9x^2))/4 equals 10^(n(n-1)/2). This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))

;; If C(x) is the source generating function, then C(0)=0 and squaring the
;; displayed radical identity gives
;;
;;   C = X + 3*X*C + 2*C^2.
;;
;; Conversely, this formal identity with constant coefficient zero has a
;; unique coefficient sequence. Its coefficients have positive radius of
;; convergence, and near zero the square root with constant term one recovers
;; the source analytic identity. Thus the recurrence below is bidirectionally
;; equivalent to the source HasSum hypothesis, not a finite truncation of an
;; arbitrary sequence. The recurrence also shows that every coefficient is an
;; integer, so ACL2 integer arithmetic represents its real value exactly.

(defun putnam-2024-a6-convolution-sum
    (coefficients k i)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix i)))
  (if (zp i)
      0
    (+
     (* (nth i coefficients)
        (nth (- k i) coefficients))
     (putnam-2024-a6-convolution-sum
      coefficients k (- i 1)))))

(defun putnam-2024-a6-next-coefficient (coefficients)
  (let ((k (len coefficients)))
    (+
     (if (equal k 1) 1 0)
     (* 3 (nth (- k 1) coefficients))
     (* 2
        (putnam-2024-a6-convolution-sum
         coefficients k (- k 1))))))

;; Starting from (c_0)=(0), append exactly REMAINING further coefficients.

(defun putnam-2024-a6-extend-coefficients
    (remaining coefficients)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix remaining)))
  (if (zp remaining)
      coefficients
    (putnam-2024-a6-extend-coefficients
     (- remaining 1)
     (append
      coefficients
      (list
       (putnam-2024-a6-next-coefficient
        coefficients))))))

(defun putnam-2024-a6-hankel-entries
    (coefficients n index remaining)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix remaining)))
  (if (zp remaining)
      nil
    (let ((row (floor index n))
          (column (mod index n)))
      (cons
       (nth (+ row column 1) coefficients)
       (putnam-2024-a6-hankel-entries
        coefficients n (+ index 1) (- remaining 1))))))

;; For positive N, indices i+j+1 range through at most 2*N-1, so the exact
;; prefix constructed here contains every coefficient used by the matrix.

(defun putnam-2024-a6-hankel-matrix (n)
  (if (posp n)
      (let ((coefficients
             (putnam-2024-a6-extend-coefficients
              (- (* 2 n) 1)
              (list 0))))
        (putnam-2024-a6-hankel-entries
         coefficients n 0 (* n n)))
    nil))

(defun putnam-2024-a6-range-from (start count)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix count)))
  (if (zp count)
      nil
    (cons
     start
     (putnam-2024-a6-range-from
      (+ start 1) (- count 1)))))

(defun putnam-2024-a6-prefix-each (item lists)
  (if (endp lists)
      nil
    (cons
     (cons item (car lists))
     (putnam-2024-a6-prefix-each item (cdr lists)))))

(defun putnam-2024-a6-insert-everywhere (item values)
  (if (endp values)
      (list (list item))
    (cons
     (cons item values)
     (putnam-2024-a6-prefix-each
      (car values)
      (putnam-2024-a6-insert-everywhere
       item (cdr values))))))

(defun putnam-2024-a6-insert-into-each (item lists)
  (if (endp lists)
      nil
    (append
     (putnam-2024-a6-insert-everywhere
      item (car lists))
     (putnam-2024-a6-insert-into-each
      item (cdr lists)))))

(defun putnam-2024-a6-permutations (values)
  (if (endp values)
      (list nil)
    (putnam-2024-a6-insert-into-each
     (car values)
     (putnam-2024-a6-permutations (cdr values)))))

(defun putnam-2024-a6-count-greater (item values)
  (if (endp values)
      0
    (+
     (if (> item (car values)) 1 0)
     (putnam-2024-a6-count-greater
      item (cdr values)))))

(defun putnam-2024-a6-inversion-count (permutation)
  (if (endp permutation)
      0
    (+
     (putnam-2024-a6-count-greater
      (car permutation) (cdr permutation))
     (putnam-2024-a6-inversion-count
      (cdr permutation)))))

(defun putnam-2024-a6-diagonal-product
    (matrix n permutation row)
  (if (endp permutation)
      1
    (*
     (nth (+ (* row n) (car permutation)) matrix)
     (putnam-2024-a6-diagonal-product
      matrix n (cdr permutation) (+ row 1)))))

;; This is the full Leibniz determinant, so the row-major list is exactly the
;; source matrix on Fin N rather than a weakened matrix invariant.

(defun putnam-2024-a6-determinant-sum
    (matrix n permutations)
  (if (endp permutations)
      0
    (let* ((permutation (car permutations))
           (product
            (putnam-2024-a6-diagonal-product
             matrix n permutation 0))
           (signed-product
            (if (evenp
                 (putnam-2024-a6-inversion-count
                  permutation))
                product
              (- product))))
      (+
       signed-product
       (putnam-2024-a6-determinant-sum
        matrix n (cdr permutations))))))

(defun putnam-2024-a6-determinant (matrix n)
  (putnam-2024-a6-determinant-sum
   matrix
   n
   (putnam-2024-a6-permutations
    (putnam-2024-a6-range-from 0 n))))

;; ACL2 universally closes N. The benchmark's annotated solution is
;; 10^(N*(N-1)/2), and N*(N-1) is even for every natural N.

(defun putnambench-putnam-2024-a6-statement (n)
  (implies
   (posp n)
   (equal
    (putnam-2024-a6-determinant
     (putnam-2024-a6-hankel-matrix n)
     n)
    (expt 10 (floor (* n (- n 1)) 2)))))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

title: putnam_2024_a6
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2024_a6
-- (putnambench__agda__putnam_2024_a6): the local real power-series expansion
-- (1 - 3x - sqrt(1 - 14x + 9x^2)) / 4 has an n by n Hankel determinant
-- equal to 10^(n(n-1)/2) for every positive n. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module Putnam2024A6 where

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; _*_)

infix 4 _!=_ _<=N_
infixr 3 _and_
infixr 2 _or_

data Bottom : Set where

Not : Set -> Set
Not A =
  A -> Bottom

_!=_ : {A : Set} -> A -> A -> Set
x != y =
  Not (x == y)

record _and_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data _or_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  left  : A -> A or B
  right : B -> A or B

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

data _<=N_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set where
  zero<=N   : {n : Nat} -> zero <=N n
  suc<=sucN : {m n : Nat} -> m <=N n -> suc m <=N suc n

data Fin : Nat -> Set where
  fzero : {n : Nat} -> Fin (suc n)
  fsuc  : {n : Nat} -> Fin n -> Fin (suc n)

finToNat : {n : Nat} -> Fin n -> Nat
finToNat fzero =
  zero
finToNat (fsuc i) =
  suc (finToNat i)

record StandardReal (R : Set) : Set1 where
  field
    zeroR oneR : R
    add multiply : R -> R -> R
    negate inverse squareRoot : R -> R
    lessOrEqual : R -> R -> Set
    fromNat : Nat -> R

    one-not-zero :
      oneR != zeroR

    add-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> add x y == add y x
    add-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      add (add x y) z == add x (add y z)
    add-zero :
      (x : R) -> add x zeroR == x
    add-inverse :
      (x : R) -> add x (negate x) == zeroR

    multiply-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> multiply x y == multiply y x
    multiply-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply (multiply x y) z ==
      multiply x (multiply y z)
    multiply-one :
      (x : R) -> multiply x oneR == x
    multiply-zero :
      (x : R) -> multiply x zeroR == zeroR
    distribute :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply x (add y z) ==
      add (multiply x y) (multiply x z)
    inverse-zero :
      inverse zeroR == zeroR
    multiply-inverse :
      (x : R) ->
      x != zeroR ->
      multiply x (inverse x) == oneR

    order-reflexive :
      (x : R) -> lessOrEqual x x
    order-transitive :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y z ->
      lessOrEqual x z
    order-antisymmetric :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y x ->
      x == y
    order-total :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y or lessOrEqual y x
    add-order :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual (add z x) (add z y)
    multiply-nonnegative :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR x ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR y ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR (multiply x y)
    zero-less-than-one :
      lessOrEqual zeroR oneR and zeroR != oneR

    fromNat-zero :
      fromNat zero == zeroR
    fromNat-successor :
      (n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (suc n) == add (fromNat n) oneR
    fromNat-addition :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m + n) == add (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-multiplication :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m * n) == multiply (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-injective :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat m == fromNat n ->
      m == n

    square-root-nonnegative :
      (x : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR (squareRoot x)
    square-root-square :
      (x : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR x ->
      multiply (squareRoot x) (squareRoot x) == x
    square-root-nonpositive :
      (x : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x zeroR ->
      squareRoot x == zeroR
    square-root-unique :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR y ->
      multiply y y == x ->
      squareRoot x == y

    archimedean :
      (x : R) ->
      Exists Nat (\ n -> lessOrEqual x (fromNat n))
    least-upper-bound :
      (P : R -> Set) ->
      Exists R P ->
      Exists R
        (\ upper ->
          (x : R) ->
          P x ->
          lessOrEqual x upper) ->
      Exists R
        (\ supremum ->
          ((x : R) ->
            P x ->
            lessOrEqual x supremum)
          and
          ((upper : R) ->
            ((x : R) ->
              P x ->
              lessOrEqual x upper) ->
            lessOrEqual supremum upper))

open StandardReal

subtract :
  {R : Set} ->
  StandardReal R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
subtract reals x y =
  add reals x (negate reals y)

divide :
  {R : Set} ->
  StandardReal R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
divide reals x y =
  multiply reals x (inverse reals y)

StrictLess :
  {R : Set} ->
  StandardReal R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
StrictLess reals x y =
  lessOrEqual reals x y and x != y

CloseTo :
  {R : Set} ->
  StandardReal R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
CloseTo reals center radius x =
  StrictLess reals
    (subtract reals center radius)
    x
  and
  StrictLess reals
    x
    (add reals center radius)

naturalPower :
  {R : Set} ->
  StandardReal R ->
  R ->
  Nat ->
  R
naturalPower reals x zero =
  oneR reals
naturalPower reals x (suc n) =
  multiply reals
    (naturalPower reals x n)
    x

sumFirst :
  {R : Set} ->
  StandardReal R ->
  Nat ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  R
sumFirst reals zero terms =
  zeroR reals
sumFirst reals (suc n) terms =
  add reals
    (sumFirst reals n terms)
    (terms n)

ConvergesTo :
  {R : Set} ->
  StandardReal R ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  R ->
  Set
ConvergesTo reals sequence limit =
  (epsilon : _) ->
  StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) epsilon ->
  Exists Nat
    (\ cutoff ->
      (n : Nat) ->
      cutoff <=N n ->
      CloseTo reals limit epsilon (sequence n))

SeriesHasSum :
  {R : Set} ->
  StandardReal R ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  R ->
  Set
SeriesHasSum reals terms limit =
  ConvergesTo reals
    (\ n -> sumFirst reals n terms)
    limit

generatingFunction :
  {R : Set} ->
  StandardReal R ->
  R ->
  R
generatingFunction reals x =
  divide reals
    (subtract reals
      (subtract reals
        (oneR reals)
        (multiply reals (fromNat reals 3) x))
      (squareRoot reals
        (add reals
          (subtract reals
            (oneR reals)
            (multiply reals (fromNat reals 14) x))
          (multiply reals
            (fromNat reals 9)
            (naturalPower reals x 2)))))
    (fromNat reals 4)

PowerSeriesLocallyEquals :
  {R : Set} ->
  StandardReal R ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  (R -> R) ->
  Set
PowerSeriesLocallyEquals {R} reals coefficients function =
  Exists R
    (\ radius ->
      StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) radius
      and
      ((x : R) ->
        CloseTo reals (zeroR reals) radius x ->
        SeriesHasSum reals
          (\ k ->
            multiply reals
              (coefficients k)
              (naturalPower reals x k))
          (function x)))

Matrix : Set -> Nat -> Set
Matrix R n =
  Fin n -> Fin n -> R

sumFin :
  {R : Set} ->
  StandardReal R ->
  {n : Nat} ->
  (Fin n -> R) ->
  R
sumFin reals {zero} term =
  zeroR reals
sumFin reals {suc n} term =
  add reals
    (term fzero)
    (sumFin reals (\ i -> term (fsuc i)))

skip :
  {n : Nat} ->
  Fin (suc n) ->
  Fin n ->
  Fin (suc n)
skip {zero} column ()
skip {suc n} fzero k =
  fsuc k
skip {suc n} (fsuc column) fzero =
  fzero
skip {suc n} (fsuc column) (fsuc k) =
  fsuc (skip column k)

firstRowMinor :
  {R : Set} {n : Nat} ->
  Matrix R (suc n) ->
  Fin (suc n) ->
  Matrix R n
firstRowMinor A column i j =
  A (fsuc i) (skip column j)

alternatingSign :
  {R : Set} ->
  StandardReal R ->
  {n : Nat} ->
  Fin n ->
  R
alternatingSign reals fzero =
  oneR reals
alternatingSign reals (fsuc i) =
  negate reals (alternatingSign reals i)

determinant :
  {R : Set} ->
  StandardReal R ->
  {n : Nat} ->
  Matrix R n ->
  R
determinant reals {zero} A =
  oneR reals
determinant reals {suc n} A =
  sumFin reals
    (\ column ->
      multiply reals
        (alternatingSign reals column)
        (multiply reals
          (A fzero column)
          (determinant reals (firstRowMinor A column))))

hankelMatrix :
  {R : Set} ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  (n : Nat) ->
  Matrix R n
hankelMatrix coefficients n i j =
  coefficients
    (suc (finToNat i + finToNat j))

triangular : Nat -> Nat
triangular zero =
  zero
triangular (suc n) =
  triangular n + n

solution :
  {R : Set} ->
  StandardReal R ->
  Nat ->
  R
solution reals n =
  naturalPower reals
    (fromNat reals 10)
    (triangular n)

PositiveNat : Nat -> Set
PositiveNat n =
  suc zero <=N n

putnam-2024-a6 : Set1
putnam-2024-a6 =
  (R : Set) ->
  (reals : StandardReal R) ->
  (coefficients : Nat -> R) ->
  (n : Nat) ->
  PowerSeriesLocallyEquals reals
    coefficients
    (generatingFunction reals) ->
  PositiveNat n ->
  determinant reals (hankelMatrix coefficients n) ==
  solution reals n

(*

  the determinant of the Hankel matrix formed from the local power-series
  coefficients of the specified square-root function is 10^(n(n-1)/2).
  This file contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open arithmeticTheory pred_setTheory permutesTheory realTheory seqTheory;

val putnam_2024_a6 =
  ``let determinant =
      \n : num. \A : num -> num -> real.
        ITSET
          (\p : num -> num. \sum : real.
             (if evenperm p then
                ITSET
                  (\i : num. \acc : real. A i (p i) * acc)
                  (count n)
                  1
              else
                -(ITSET
                    (\i : num. \acc : real. A i (p i) * acc)
                    (count n)
                    1)) +
             sum)
          {p : num -> num | p permutes count n}
          0
    in
      !c : num -> real. !n : num.
        (?epsilon : real.
           0 < epsilon /\
           !x : real.
             abs x < epsilon
             ==>
             (\k : num. c k * x pow k) sums
               ((1 - 3 * x - sqrt (1 - 14 * x + 9 * x pow 2)) / 4)) /\
        0 < n
        ==>
        determinant n (\i j : num. c (i + j + 1)) =
        (10 : real) pow ((n * (n - 1)) DIV 2)``;

            s.k = c.k * (x |^ k)) &
          Partial_Sums(s) is convergent &
          lim Partial_Sums(s) =
            (1 - 3 * x - sqrt(1 - 14 * x + 9 * (x |^ 2))) / 4) &
    (for i,j being Nat st [i,j] in Indices A holds
      A*(i,j) = c.(i + j -' 1))
  holds
    Det A = (10 qua Real) |^ ((n * (n -' 1)) div 2)
proof
end;

title: putnam_2024_a6
content:
% Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2024_a6:
% the determinant of the Hankel matrix formed from the power-series
% coefficients of the displayed algebraic function is 10^(n(n-1)/2).
% This file contains no proof.

putnam_2024_a6: THEORY
BEGIN
  real_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> real]
  square_matrix: TYPE = [nat, nat -> real]

  safe_div(numerator, denominator: real): real =
    IF denominator = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      numerator / denominator
    ENDIF

  quotient_aux(
      numerator, denominator, fuel: nat): RECURSIVE nat =
    IF fuel = 0
        OR denominator = 0
        OR numerator < denominator THEN
      0
    ELSE
      1
        + quotient_aux(
            numerator - denominator,
            denominator,
            fuel - 1)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE fuel

  remainder_aux(
      numerator, denominator, fuel: nat): RECURSIVE nat =
    IF fuel = 0
        OR denominator = 0
        OR numerator < denominator THEN
      numerator
    ELSE
      remainder_aux(
        numerator - denominator,
        denominator,
        fuel - 1)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE fuel

  safe_ndiv(numerator, denominator: nat): nat =
    quotient_aux(
      numerator,
      denominator,
      numerator + 1)

  safe_mod(numerator, denominator: nat): nat =
    IF denominator = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      remainder_aux(
        numerator,
        denominator,
        numerator + 1)
    ENDIF

  finite_sum(values: real_sequence, count: nat): RECURSIVE real =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      finite_sum(values, count - 1) + values(count - 1)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  converges_to(values: real_sequence, limit_value: real): bool =
    FORALL (epsilon_value: posreal):
      EXISTS (cutoff: nat):
        FORALL (count: nat):
          cutoff <= count IMPLIES
            abs(values(count) - limit_value) < epsilon_value

  nonnegative_sqrt(x: real): real =
    IF x >= 0 THEN
      epsilon(
        LAMBDA (root: real):
          root >= 0 AND root * root = x)
    ELSE
      0
    ENDIF

  algebraic_function(x: real): real =
    safe_div(
      1 - 3 * x
        - nonnegative_sqrt(1 - 14 * x + 9 * x ^ 2),
      4)

  coefficient_partial_sum(
      coefficients: real_sequence,
      x: real,
      count: nat): real =
    finite_sum(
      LAMBDA (index: nat):
        coefficients(index) * x ^ index,
      count)

  represents_algebraic_function_near_zero(
      coefficients: real_sequence): bool =
    EXISTS (radius: real):
      radius > 0
        AND FORALL (x: real):
          abs(x) < radius IMPLIES
            converges_to(
              LAMBDA (count: nat):
                coefficient_partial_sum(
                  coefficients, x, count),
              algebraic_function(x))

  function_code_count(size: nat): nat =
    IF size = 0 THEN 1 ELSE size ^ size ENDIF

  permutation_entry(code, row, size: nat): nat =
    IF size = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      safe_mod(safe_ndiv(code, size ^ row), size)
    ENDIF

  permutation_code(code, size: nat): bool =
    code < function_code_count(size)
      AND (FORALL (row_1, row_2: nat):
        (row_1 < size
          AND row_2 < size
          AND permutation_entry(code, row_1, size)
            = permutation_entry(code, row_2, size))
        IMPLIES row_1 = row_2)

  pair_row(pair, size: nat): nat =
    safe_ndiv(pair, size)

  pair_column(pair, size: nat): nat =
    safe_mod(pair, size)

  inversion_at(code, pair, size: nat): bool =
    pair_row(pair, size) < size
      AND pair_column(pair, size) < size
      AND pair_row(pair, size) < pair_column(pair, size)
      AND permutation_entry(code, pair_row(pair, size), size)
        > permutation_entry(code, pair_column(pair, size), size)

  count_true(
      property: [nat -> bool],
      count: nat): RECURSIVE nat =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      count_true(property, count - 1)
        + IF property(count - 1) THEN 1 ELSE 0 ENDIF
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  inversion_count(code, size: nat): nat =
    count_true(
      (LAMBDA (pair: nat): inversion_at(code, pair, size)),
      size * size)

  permutation_sign(code, size: nat): real =
    IF mod(inversion_count(code, size), 2) = 0 THEN
      1
    ELSE
      -1
    ENDIF

  permutation_product(
      A: square_matrix,
      code, size, count: nat): RECURSIVE real =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      1
    ELSE
      permutation_product(A, code, size, count - 1)
        * A(
            count - 1,
            permutation_entry(code, count - 1, size))
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  determinant_sum(
      A: square_matrix,
      size, limit: nat): RECURSIVE real =
    IF limit = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      LET code: nat = limit - 1 IN
        determinant_sum(A, size, limit - 1)
          + IF permutation_code(code, size) THEN
              permutation_sign(code, size)
                * permutation_product(A, code, size, size)
            ELSE
              0
            ENDIF
    ENDIF
  MEASURE limit

  determinant(A: square_matrix, size: nat): real =
    determinant_sum(A, size, function_code_count(size))

  hankel_matrix(coefficients: real_sequence): square_matrix =
    LAMBDA (row, column: nat):
      coefficients(row + column + 1)

  nat_predecessor(n: nat): nat =
    IF n = 0 THEN 0 ELSE n - 1 ENDIF

  triangular_number(n: nat): nat =
    ndiv(n * nat_predecessor(n), 2)

  putnam_2024_a6_solution(n: nat): real =
    (10 :: real) ^ triangular_number(n)

  putnam_2024_a6: bool =
    FORALL (coefficients: real_sequence), (n: nat):
      (represents_algebraic_function_near_zero(coefficients)
        AND n > 0)
      IMPLIES
        determinant(hankel_matrix(coefficients), n)
          = putnam_2024_a6_solution(n)
END putnam_2024_a6

title: putnam_2024_b1

import Mathlib

noncomputable abbrev putnam_2024_b1_solution : Set (ℕ × ℕ) := sorry
--{(2*l+1, l+1) | (l : ℕ)}
/--
Let $n$ and $k$ be positive integers. The square in the $i$th row and
$j$th column of an $n$-by-$n$ grid contains the number $i + j - k$.
For which $n$ and $k$ is it possible to select $n$ squares from the
grid, no two in the same row or column, such that the numbers
contained in the selected squares are exactly $1, ..., n$?
-/
theorem putnam_2024_b1
    (grid : (n : ℕ) → ℕ → Fin n → Fin n → ℤ)
    (grid_def : ∀ n k i j, grid n k i j = i.succ + j.succ - k)
    (valid : ℕ → ℕ → Prop)
    (valid_def : ∀ n k, valid n k ↔ 0 < n ∧ 0 < k ∧
      ∃ (f : Fin n → Fin n), f.Injective ∧
        Set.range (fun i => grid n k i (f i)) = Set.Icc (1 : ℤ) n) :
    { (n, k) | valid n k } = putnam_2024_b1_solution :=
  sorry

title: putnam_2024_b1
content:
(* Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2024_b1
   (putnambench__rocq__putnam_2024_b1): classification of positive grid
   dimensions and offsets admitting a nonattacking selection whose entries
   are exactly the integers from 1 through the dimension. This file contains
   no proof. *)

From Stdlib Require Import Arith.PeanoNat Vectors.Fin ZArith.

Definition putnam_2024_b1_index
    {n : nat} (i : Fin.t n) : nat :=
  proj1_sig (Fin.to_nat i).

Definition putnam_2024_b1_grid_value
    {n : nat} (k : nat) (i j : Fin.t n) : Z :=
  (Z.of_nat (S (putnam_2024_b1_index i)) +
   Z.of_nat (S (putnam_2024_b1_index j)) -
   Z.of_nat k)%Z.

Definition putnam_2024_b1_valid (n k : nat) : Prop :=
  (0 < n)%nat /\
  (0 < k)%nat /\
  exists f : Fin.t n -> Fin.t n,
    (forall i j : Fin.t n, f i = f j -> i = j) /\
    forall z : Z,
      (exists i : Fin.t n,
        putnam_2024_b1_grid_value k i (f i) = z) <->
      (1 <= z <= Z.of_nat n)%Z.

Definition putnam_2024_b1_solution (n k : nat) : Prop :=
  exists l : nat,
    n = (2 * l + 1)%nat /\
    k = (l + 1)%nat.

Theorem putnam_2024_b1 :
  forall n k : nat,
    putnam_2024_b1_valid n k <->
    putnam_2024_b1_solution n k.
Admitted.

;; Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2024_b1:
;; the positive integer pairs (n,k) admitting a permutation of the columns
;; whose selected grid entries are exactly 1 through n are precisely
;; (2*l+1,l+1) for natural l. This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

;; The hypotheses defining GRID and VALID uniquely determine both objects, so
;; they are eliminated definitionally. A function Fin n -> Fin n is injective
;; exactly when its values, in row order, form a permutation of 0,...,n-1.
;; Enumerating those finite permutations therefore preserves the source's
;; internal existential function witness without exposing it as a parameter.

(defun putnam-2024-b1-indices-from (start count)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix count)))
  (if (zp count)
      nil
    (cons start
          (putnam-2024-b1-indices-from
           (+ start 1) (- count 1)))))

(defun putnam-2024-b1-prefix-each (item lists)
  (if (endp lists)
      nil
    (cons (cons item (car lists))
          (putnam-2024-b1-prefix-each item (cdr lists)))))

(defun putnam-2024-b1-insert-everywhere (item list)
  (if (endp list)
      (list (list item))
    (cons (cons item list)
          (putnam-2024-b1-prefix-each
           (car list)
           (putnam-2024-b1-insert-everywhere
            item (cdr list))))))

(defun putnam-2024-b1-insert-into-each (item lists)
  (if (endp lists)
      nil
    (append
     (putnam-2024-b1-insert-everywhere item (car lists))
     (putnam-2024-b1-insert-into-each item (cdr lists)))))

(defun putnam-2024-b1-permutations (list)
  (if (endp list)
      (list nil)
    (putnam-2024-b1-insert-into-each
     (car list)
     (putnam-2024-b1-permutations (cdr list)))))

(defun putnam-2024-b1-selected-values (permutation row k)
  (if (endp permutation)
      nil
    (cons
     (- (+ (+ row 1) (+ (car permutation) 1)) k)
     (putnam-2024-b1-selected-values
      (cdr permutation) (+ row 1) k))))

(defun putnam-2024-b1-every-member-p (left right)
  (if (endp left)
      (equal left nil)
    (and
     (member-equal (car left) right)
     (putnam-2024-b1-every-member-p (cdr left) right))))

(defun putnam-2024-b1-set-equal-p (left right)
  (and
   (true-listp left)
   (true-listp right)
   (putnam-2024-b1-every-member-p left right)
   (putnam-2024-b1-every-member-p right left)))

(defun putnam-2024-b1-permutation-valid-p
    (permutation n k)
  (putnam-2024-b1-set-equal-p
   (putnam-2024-b1-selected-values permutation 0 k)
   (putnam-2024-b1-indices-from 1 n)))

(defun putnam-2024-b1-valid-permutation-exists-p
    (permutations n k)
  (if (endp permutations)
      nil
    (or
     (putnam-2024-b1-permutation-valid-p
      (car permutations) n k)
     (putnam-2024-b1-valid-permutation-exists-p
      (cdr permutations) n k))))

(defun putnam-2024-b1-valid-p (n k)
  (and
   (natp n)
   (natp k)
   (< 0 n)
   (< 0 k)
   (putnam-2024-b1-valid-permutation-exists-p
    (putnam-2024-b1-permutations
     (putnam-2024-b1-indices-from 0 n))
    n
    k)))

;; Writing l = k-1 shows that this predicate is exactly membership in
;; {(2*l+1,l+1) | l is a natural number}.
(defun putnam-2024-b1-solution-p (n k)
  (and
   (natp n)
   (natp k)
   (< 0 k)
   (equal n (- (* 2 k) 1))))

;; ACL2 universally closes N and K. This pointwise IFF is the source set
;; equality over natural-number pairs.
(defun putnambench-putnam-2024-b1-statement (n k)
  (implies
   (and (natp n)
        (natp k))
   (iff
    (putnam-2024-b1-valid-p n k)
    (putnam-2024-b1-solution-p n k))))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

content:
-- Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2024_b1
-- (putnambench__agda__putnam_2024_b1): the positive integer pairs (n,k)
-- admitting a permutation of grid columns whose selected entries are exactly
-- 1 through n are precisely (2*l+1,l+1). This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module Putnam2024B1 where

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Int using (Int; pos; negsuc)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_)

infixr 3 _and_

record _and_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

record Iff (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor equivalence
  field
    forward  : A -> B
    backward : B -> A

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

data Positive : Nat -> Set where
  positive : {n : Nat} -> Positive (suc n)

data Fin : Nat -> Set where
  fzero : {n : Nat} -> Fin (suc n)
  fsuc  : {n : Nat} -> Fin n -> Fin (suc n)

finToNat : {n : Nat} -> Fin n -> Nat
finToNat fzero =
  zero
finToNat (fsuc i) =
  suc (finToNat i)

difference : Nat -> Nat -> Int
difference zero zero =
  pos zero
difference (suc m) zero =
  pos (suc m)
difference zero (suc n) =
  negsuc n
difference (suc m) (suc n) =
  difference m n

gridValue :
  {n : Nat} ->
  Fin n ->
  Fin n ->
  Nat ->
  Int
gridValue i j k =
  difference
    (suc (finToNat i) + suc (finToNat j))
    k

Injective :
  {A B : Set} ->
  (A -> B) ->
  Set
Injective {A} function =
  (x y : A) ->
  function x == function y ->
  x == y

IntegerSubset : Set1
IntegerSubset =
  Int -> Set

SameIntegerSet :
  IntegerSubset ->
  IntegerSubset ->
  Set
SameIntegerSet left right =
  (z : Int) ->
  Iff (left z) (right z)

SelectedValues :
  {n : Nat} ->
  Nat ->
  (Fin n -> Fin n) ->
  IntegerSubset
SelectedValues {n} k columns z =
  Exists (Fin n)
    (\ row ->
      gridValue row (columns row) k == z)

OneThrough : Nat -> IntegerSubset
OneThrough n z =
  Exists (Fin n)
    (\ index ->
      z == pos (suc (finToNat index)))

Valid : Nat -> Nat -> Set
Valid n k =
  Positive n
  and
  Positive k
  and
  Exists (Fin n -> Fin n)
    (\ columns ->
      Injective columns
      and
      SameIntegerSet
        (SelectedValues k columns)
        (OneThrough n))

SolutionPair : Nat -> Nat -> Set
SolutionPair n k =
  Exists Nat
    (\ l ->
      n == suc (l + l)
      and
      k == suc l)

putnam-2024-b1 : Set
putnam-2024-b1 =
  (n k : Nat) ->
  Iff
    (Valid n k)
    (SolutionPair n k)
