title: putnam_2025_a2
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2025_a2:
;; the greatest real coefficient a and least real coefficient b satisfying
;; a*x*(pi-x) <= sin(x) <= b*x*(pi-x) on [0,pi] are 1/pi and 4/pi^2.
;; This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))

;; REAL-TYPE presents a Dedekind-complete ordered field, hence a copy of the
;; real numbers.  The conservative interfaces below supply no facts: every
;; field, order, completeness, pi, and sine property is an explicit hypothesis
;; of the final predicate.  Pi is fixed independently by Machin's arctangent
;; series, and sine is fixed by its full Taylor series.  Under the unique
;; ordered-field isomorphism with R, these characterizations preserve pi,
;; sine, the interval [0,pi], and both extremality predicates.  Thus the final
;; biconditional is bidirectionally equivalent to the source proposition.

(defstub p25a2-real-p (real-type value) t)
(defstub p25a2-zero (real-type) t)
(defstub p25a2-one (real-type) t)
(defstub p25a2-add (real-type left right) t)
(defstub p25a2-multiply (real-type left right) t)
(defstub p25a2-negate (real-type value) t)
(defstub p25a2-inverse (real-type value) t)
(defstub p25a2-less (real-type left right) t)
(defstub p25a2-pi (real-type) t)
(defstub p25a2-sine (real-type value) t)

(defstub p25a2-real-set-p (real-type set) t)
(defstub p25a2-real-set-member-p (real-type set value) t)
(defstub p25a2-supremum (real-type set) t)

(defun p25a2-leq (real-type left right)
  (not (p25a2-less real-type right left)))

(defun p25a2-positive-p (real-type value)
  (and
   (p25a2-real-p real-type value)
   (p25a2-less
    real-type (p25a2-zero real-type) value)))

(defun p25a2-subtract (real-type left right)
  (p25a2-add
   real-type left (p25a2-negate real-type right)))

(defun p25a2-divide (real-type numerator denominator)
  (p25a2-multiply
   real-type numerator (p25a2-inverse real-type denominator)))

(defun p25a2-absolute-value (real-type value)
  (if (p25a2-less
       real-type value (p25a2-zero real-type))
      (p25a2-negate real-type value)
    value))

(defun p25a2-natural (real-type n)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix n)))
  (if (zp n)
      (p25a2-zero real-type)
    (p25a2-add
     real-type
     (p25a2-one real-type)
     (p25a2-natural real-type (1- n)))))

(defun p25a2-power (real-type base exponent)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix exponent)))
  (if (zp exponent)
      (p25a2-one real-type)
    (p25a2-multiply
     real-type
     base
     (p25a2-power real-type base (1- exponent)))))

(defun p25a2-factorial (real-type n)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix n)))
  (if (zp n)
      (p25a2-one real-type)
    (p25a2-multiply
     real-type
     (p25a2-natural real-type n)
     (p25a2-factorial real-type (1- n)))))

(defun-sk p25a2-field-laws-p (real-type)
  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (p25a2-real-p real-type x)
      (p25a2-real-p real-type y)
      (p25a2-real-p real-type z))
     (let* ((zero (p25a2-zero real-type))
            (one (p25a2-one real-type))
            (x-plus-y (p25a2-add real-type x y))
            (y-plus-z (p25a2-add real-type y z))
            (x-times-y (p25a2-multiply real-type x y))
            (y-times-z (p25a2-multiply real-type y z))
            (negative-x (p25a2-negate real-type x))
            (inverse-x (p25a2-inverse real-type x)))
       (and
        (p25a2-real-p real-type x-plus-y)
        (p25a2-real-p real-type x-times-y)
        (p25a2-real-p real-type negative-x)
        (p25a2-real-p real-type inverse-x)
        (equal
         (p25a2-add real-type x-plus-y z)
         (p25a2-add real-type x y-plus-z))
        (equal x-plus-y (p25a2-add real-type y x))
        (equal (p25a2-add real-type x zero) x)
        (equal (p25a2-add real-type x negative-x) zero)
        (equal
         (p25a2-multiply real-type x-times-y z)
         (p25a2-multiply real-type x y-times-z))
        (equal x-times-y (p25a2-multiply real-type y x))
        (equal (p25a2-multiply real-type x one) x)
        (implies
         (equal x zero)
         (equal inverse-x zero))
        (implies
         (not (equal x zero))
         (equal
          (p25a2-multiply real-type x inverse-x)
          one))
        (equal
         (p25a2-multiply real-type x y-plus-z)
         (p25a2-add
          real-type
          (p25a2-multiply real-type x y)
          (p25a2-multiply real-type x z))))))))

(defun-sk p25a2-order-laws-p (real-type)
  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (p25a2-real-p real-type x)
      (p25a2-real-p real-type y)
      (p25a2-real-p real-type z))
     (let ((zero (p25a2-zero real-type)))
       (and
        (not (p25a2-less real-type x x))
        (or
         (p25a2-less real-type x y)
         (equal x y)
         (p25a2-less real-type y x))
        (implies
         (and
          (p25a2-less real-type x y)
          (p25a2-less real-type y z))
         (p25a2-less real-type x z))
        (implies
         (p25a2-less real-type x y)
         (p25a2-less
          real-type
          (p25a2-add real-type x z)
          (p25a2-add real-type y z)))
        (implies
         (and
          (p25a2-less real-type zero x)
          (p25a2-less real-type zero y))
         (p25a2-less
          real-type
          zero
          (p25a2-multiply real-type x y))))))))

(defun-sk p25a2-upper-bound-p
    (real-type set upper)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (and
      (p25a2-real-p real-type x)
      (p25a2-real-set-member-p real-type set x))
     (p25a2-leq real-type x upper))))

(defun-sk p25a2-set-nonempty-p (real-type set)
  (exists (x)
    (and
     (p25a2-real-p real-type x)
     (p25a2-real-set-member-p real-type set x))))

(defun-sk p25a2-set-bounded-above-p
    (real-type set)
  (exists (upper)
    (and
     (p25a2-real-p real-type upper)
     (p25a2-upper-bound-p real-type set upper))))

(defun-sk p25a2-least-upper-bound-p
    (real-type set supremum)
  (forall (upper)
    (implies
     (and
      (p25a2-real-p real-type upper)
      (p25a2-upper-bound-p real-type set upper))
     (p25a2-leq real-type supremum upper))))

(defun-sk p25a2-completeness-p (real-type)
  (forall (set)
    (implies
     (and
      (p25a2-real-set-p real-type set)
      (p25a2-set-nonempty-p real-type set)
      (p25a2-set-bounded-above-p real-type set))
     (let ((supremum (p25a2-supremum real-type set)))
       (and
        (p25a2-real-p real-type supremum)
        (p25a2-upper-bound-p real-type set supremum)
        (p25a2-least-upper-bound-p
         real-type set supremum))))))

(defun-sk p25a2-archimedean-bound-exists-p
    (real-type value)
  (exists (n)
    (and
     (natp n)
     (p25a2-less
      real-type value (p25a2-natural real-type n)))))

(defun-sk p25a2-archimedean-p (real-type)
  (forall (value)
    (implies
     (p25a2-real-p real-type value)
     (p25a2-archimedean-bound-exists-p
      real-type value))))

(defun p25a2-real-field-p (real-type)
  (let ((zero (p25a2-zero real-type))
        (one (p25a2-one real-type)))
    (and
     (p25a2-real-p real-type zero)
     (p25a2-real-p real-type one)
     (not (equal zero one))
     (p25a2-field-laws-p real-type)
     (p25a2-order-laws-p real-type)
     (p25a2-less real-type zero one)
     (p25a2-completeness-p real-type)
     (p25a2-archimedean-p real-type))))

;; Machin's identity fixes pi without referring to the theorem's inequalities:
;; pi = 16*arctan(1/5) - 4*arctan(1/239).

(defun p25a2-arctan-prefix (real-type z terms)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix terms)))
  (if (zp terms)
      (p25a2-zero real-type)
    (let* ((index (1- terms))
           (exponent (+ (* 2 index) 1))
           (unsigned
            (p25a2-divide
             real-type
             (p25a2-power real-type z exponent)
             (p25a2-natural real-type exponent)))
           (term
            (if (equal (mod index 2) 0)
                unsigned
              (p25a2-negate real-type unsigned))))
      (p25a2-add
       real-type
       (p25a2-arctan-prefix real-type z index)
       term))))

(defun p25a2-pi-prefix (real-type terms)
  (let* ((one (p25a2-one real-type))
         (five (p25a2-natural real-type 5))
         (two-hundred-thirty-nine
          (p25a2-natural real-type 239))
         (sixteen (p25a2-natural real-type 16))
         (four (p25a2-natural real-type 4)))
    (p25a2-subtract
     real-type
     (p25a2-multiply
      real-type
      sixteen
      (p25a2-arctan-prefix
       real-type
       (p25a2-divide real-type one five)
       terms))
     (p25a2-multiply
      real-type
      four
      (p25a2-arctan-prefix
       real-type
       (p25a2-divide
        real-type one two-hundred-thirty-nine)
       terms)))))

(defun-sk p25a2-pi-tail-p
    (real-type epsilon cutoff)
  (forall (terms)
    (implies
     (and
      (natp terms)
      (natp cutoff)
      (<= cutoff terms))
     (p25a2-less
      real-type
      (p25a2-absolute-value
       real-type
       (p25a2-subtract
        real-type
        (p25a2-pi-prefix real-type terms)
        (p25a2-pi real-type)))
      epsilon))))

(defun-sk p25a2-pi-cutoff-exists-p
    (real-type epsilon)
  (exists (cutoff)
    (and
     (natp cutoff)
     (p25a2-pi-tail-p
      real-type epsilon cutoff))))

(defun-sk p25a2-pi-series-p (real-type)
  (forall (epsilon)
    (implies
     (p25a2-positive-p real-type epsilon)
     (p25a2-pi-cutoff-exists-p
      real-type epsilon))))

(defun p25a2-exact-pi-p (real-type)
  (and
   (p25a2-real-p real-type (p25a2-pi real-type))
   (p25a2-positive-p real-type (p25a2-pi real-type))
   (p25a2-pi-series-p real-type)))

;; The sine interface is exactly the limit of the complete Taylor series at
;; every real argument, not a finite prefix or an error-slackened inequality.

(defun p25a2-sine-term (real-type x index)
  (let* ((exponent (+ (* 2 index) 1))
         (unsigned
          (p25a2-divide
           real-type
           (p25a2-power real-type x exponent)
           (p25a2-factorial real-type exponent))))
    (if (equal (mod index 2) 0)
        unsigned
      (p25a2-negate real-type unsigned))))

(defun p25a2-sine-prefix (real-type x terms)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix terms)))
  (if (zp terms)
      (p25a2-zero real-type)
    (let ((index (1- terms)))
      (p25a2-add
       real-type
       (p25a2-sine-prefix real-type x index)
       (p25a2-sine-term real-type x index)))))

(defun-sk p25a2-sine-tail-p
    (real-type x epsilon cutoff)
  (forall (terms)
    (implies
     (and
      (natp terms)
      (natp cutoff)
      (<= cutoff terms))
     (p25a2-less
      real-type
      (p25a2-absolute-value
       real-type
       (p25a2-subtract
        real-type
        (p25a2-sine-prefix real-type x terms)
        (p25a2-sine real-type x)))
      epsilon))))

(defun-sk p25a2-sine-cutoff-exists-p
    (real-type x epsilon)
  (exists (cutoff)
    (and
     (natp cutoff)
     (p25a2-sine-tail-p
      real-type x epsilon cutoff))))

(defun-sk p25a2-sine-series-at-p (real-type x)
  (forall (epsilon)
    (implies
     (p25a2-positive-p real-type epsilon)
     (p25a2-sine-cutoff-exists-p
      real-type x epsilon))))

(defun-sk p25a2-exact-sine-p (real-type)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (p25a2-real-p real-type x)
     (and
      (p25a2-real-p
       real-type (p25a2-sine real-type x))
      (p25a2-sine-series-at-p real-type x)))))

;; These predicates are the source sets of admissible lower and upper
;; coefficients, quantified over every real x in the full interval [0,pi].

(defun p25a2-in-closed-interval-p
    (real-type x)
  (and
   (p25a2-real-p real-type x)
   (p25a2-leq real-type (p25a2-zero real-type) x)
   (p25a2-leq real-type x (p25a2-pi real-type))))

(defun p25a2-quadratic-factor
    (real-type x)
  (p25a2-multiply
   real-type
   x
   (p25a2-subtract
    real-type (p25a2-pi real-type) x)))

(defun-sk p25a2-lower-admissible-p
    (real-type coefficient)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (p25a2-in-closed-interval-p real-type x)
     (p25a2-leq
      real-type
      (p25a2-multiply
       real-type
       coefficient
       (p25a2-quadratic-factor real-type x))
      (p25a2-sine real-type x)))))

(defun-sk p25a2-upper-admissible-p
    (real-type coefficient)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (p25a2-in-closed-interval-p real-type x)
     (p25a2-leq
      real-type
      (p25a2-sine real-type x)
      (p25a2-multiply
       real-type
       coefficient
       (p25a2-quadratic-factor real-type x))))))

(defun-sk p25a2-greatest-lower-coefficient-p
    (real-type coefficient)
  (forall (candidate)
    (and
     (p25a2-real-p real-type coefficient)
     (p25a2-lower-admissible-p real-type coefficient)
     (implies
      (and
       (p25a2-real-p real-type candidate)
       (p25a2-lower-admissible-p
        real-type candidate))
      (p25a2-leq
       real-type candidate coefficient)))))

(defun-sk p25a2-least-upper-coefficient-p
    (real-type coefficient)
  (forall (candidate)
    (and
     (p25a2-real-p real-type coefficient)
     (p25a2-upper-admissible-p real-type coefficient)
     (implies
      (and
       (p25a2-real-p real-type candidate)
       (p25a2-upper-admissible-p
        real-type candidate))
      (p25a2-leq
       real-type coefficient candidate)))))

(defun p25a2-solution-p (real-type a b)
  (let* ((pi-value (p25a2-pi real-type))
         (four (p25a2-natural real-type 4))
         (pi-squared
          (p25a2-multiply real-type pi-value pi-value)))
    (and
     (equal a (p25a2-inverse real-type pi-value))
     (equal
      b
      (p25a2-divide
       real-type four pi-squared)))))

(defun putnambench-putnam-2025-a2-statement
    (real-type a b)
  (implies
   (and
    (p25a2-real-field-p real-type)
    (p25a2-exact-pi-p real-type)
    (p25a2-exact-sine-p real-type)
    (p25a2-real-p real-type a)
    (p25a2-real-p real-type b))
   (iff
    (p25a2-solution-p real-type a b)
    (and
     (p25a2-greatest-lower-coefficient-p
      real-type a)
     (p25a2-least-upper-coefficient-p
      real-type b)))))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

title: putnam_2025_a2
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2025_a2
-- (putnambench__agda__putnam_2025_a2): the greatest lower and least upper
-- constants in quadratic bounds for sine on the interval from zero to pi.
-- This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module Main where

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; _*_)

infix 4 _!=_ _<=N_
infixr 3 _and_
infix 1 _iff_

data Bottom : Set where

Not : Set -> Set
Not A =
  A -> Bottom

_!=_ : {A : Set} -> A -> A -> Set
x != y =
  Not (x == y)

record _and_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data _or_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  left  : A -> A or B
  right : B -> A or B

record _iff_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor equivalence
  field
    forward  : A -> B
    backward : B -> A

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

data _<=N_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set where
  zero<=N   : {n : Nat} -> zero <=N n
  suc<=sucN : {m n : Nat} -> m <=N n -> suc m <=N suc n

record CompleteOrderedRealField (R : Set) : Set1 where
  field
    zeroR oneR : R
    add multiply : R -> R -> R
    negate inverse absoluteValue : R -> R
    lessOrEqual : R -> R -> Set
    fromNat : Nat -> R

    one-not-zero :
      oneR != zeroR

    add-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> add x y == add y x
    add-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      add (add x y) z == add x (add y z)
    add-zero :
      (x : R) -> add x zeroR == x
    add-inverse :
      (x : R) -> add x (negate x) == zeroR

    multiply-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> multiply x y == multiply y x
    multiply-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply (multiply x y) z ==
      multiply x (multiply y z)
    multiply-one :
      (x : R) -> multiply x oneR == x
    multiply-zero :
      (x : R) -> multiply x zeroR == zeroR
    distribute :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply x (add y z) ==
      add (multiply x y) (multiply x z)
    inverse-zero :
      inverse zeroR == zeroR
    multiply-inverse :
      (x : R) ->
      x != zeroR ->
      multiply x (inverse x) == oneR

    order-reflexive :
      (x : R) -> lessOrEqual x x
    order-transitive :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y z ->
      lessOrEqual x z
    order-antisymmetric :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y x ->
      x == y
    order-total :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y or lessOrEqual y x
    add-order :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual (add z x) (add z y)
    multiply-nonnegative :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR x ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR y ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR (multiply x y)
    zero-less-than-one :
      lessOrEqual zeroR oneR and zeroR != oneR

    absolute-nonnegative :
      (x : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR (absoluteValue x)
    absolute-of-nonnegative :
      (x : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR x ->
      absoluteValue x == x
    absolute-of-nonpositive :
      (x : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x zeroR ->
      absoluteValue x == negate x

    fromNat-zero :
      fromNat zero == zeroR
    fromNat-successor :
      (n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (suc n) == add (fromNat n) oneR
    fromNat-addition :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m + n) == add (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-multiplication :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m * n) == multiply (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-injective :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat m == fromNat n ->
      m == n

    archimedean :
      (x : R) ->
      Exists Nat
        (\ n -> lessOrEqual x (fromNat n))
    least-upper-bound :
      (P : R -> Set) ->
      Exists R P ->
      Exists R
        (\ upper ->
          (x : R) ->
          P x ->
          lessOrEqual x upper) ->
      Exists R
        (\ supremum ->
          ((x : R) ->
            P x ->
            lessOrEqual x supremum)
          and
          ((upper : R) ->
            ((x : R) ->
              P x ->
              lessOrEqual x upper) ->
            lessOrEqual supremum upper))

open CompleteOrderedRealField

oneN : Nat
oneN =
  suc zero

twoN : Nat
twoN =
  suc oneN

fourN : Nat
fourN =
  twoN * twoN

subtract :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
subtract reals x y =
  add reals x (negate reals y)

divide :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
divide reals x y =
  multiply reals x (inverse reals y)

square :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R
square reals x =
  multiply reals x x

StrictLess :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
StrictLess reals x y =
  lessOrEqual reals x y and x != y

CloseTo :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
CloseTo reals center radius x =
  StrictLess reals
    (absoluteValue reals (subtract reals x center))
    radius

sumFirst :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Nat ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  R
sumFirst reals zero terms =
  zeroR reals
sumFirst reals (suc n) terms =
  add reals
    (sumFirst reals n terms)
    (terms n)

factorial : Nat -> Nat
factorial zero =
  oneN
factorial (suc n) =
  suc n * factorial n

naturalPower :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  Nat ->
  R
naturalPower reals x zero =
  oneR reals
naturalPower reals x (suc n) =
  multiply reals
    (naturalPower reals x n)
    x

alternate :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Nat ->
  R ->
  R
alternate reals zero x =
  x
alternate reals (suc n) x =
  negate reals (alternate reals n x)

oddExponent : Nat -> Nat
oddExponent n =
  suc (n + n)

sineTerm :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  Nat ->
  R
sineTerm reals x n =
  alternate reals n
    (divide reals
      (naturalPower reals x (oddExponent n))
      (fromNat reals (factorial (oddExponent n))))

ConvergesTo :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  R ->
  Set
ConvergesTo {R} reals sequence limit =
  (epsilon : R) ->
  StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) epsilon ->
  Exists Nat
    (\ cutoff ->
      (n : Nat) ->
      cutoff <=N n ->
      CloseTo reals limit epsilon (sequence n))

SeriesHasSum :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  R ->
  Set
SeriesHasSum reals terms value =
  ConvergesTo reals
    (\ n -> sumFirst reals n terms)
    value

record StandardSine
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) :
  Set1 where

  field
    sine : R -> R
    pi : R

    sine-is-power-series :
      (x : R) ->
      SeriesHasSum reals
        (sineTerm reals x)
        (sine x)

    pi-positive :
      StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) pi
    sine-pi-zero :
      sine pi == zeroR reals
    pi-is-first-positive-sine-zero :
      (x : R) ->
      StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) x ->
      sine x == zeroR reals ->
      lessOrEqual reals pi x

open StandardSine

module Putnam2025A2Statement
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R)
  (trigonometry : StandardSine reals) where

  InClosedZeroPi : R -> Set
  InClosedZeroPi x =
    lessOrEqual reals (zeroR reals) x
    and
    lessOrEqual reals x (pi trigonometry)

  quadraticFactor : R -> R -> R
  quadraticFactor coefficient x =
    multiply reals
      (multiply reals coefficient x)
      (subtract reals (pi trigonometry) x)

  LowerAdmissible : R -> Set
  LowerAdmissible coefficient =
    (x : R) ->
    InClosedZeroPi x ->
    lessOrEqual reals
      (quadraticFactor coefficient x)
      (sine trigonometry x)

  UpperAdmissible : R -> Set
  UpperAdmissible coefficient =
    (x : R) ->
    InClosedZeroPi x ->
    lessOrEqual reals
      (sine trigonometry x)
      (quadraticFactor coefficient x)

  IsGreatest : (R -> Set) -> R -> Set
  IsGreatest property value =
    property value
    and
    ((candidate : R) ->
      property candidate ->
      lessOrEqual reals candidate value)

  IsLeast : (R -> Set) -> R -> Set
  IsLeast property value =
    property value
    and
    ((candidate : R) ->
      property candidate ->
      lessOrEqual reals value candidate)

  expectedLower : R
  expectedLower =
    divide reals
      (oneR reals)
      (pi trigonometry)

  expectedUpper : R
  expectedUpper =
    divide reals
      (fromNat reals fourN)
      (square reals (pi trigonometry))

  proposition : Set
  proposition =
    (a b : R) ->
    ((a == expectedLower) and (b == expectedUpper))
    iff
    (IsGreatest LowerAdmissible a
    and
    IsLeast UpperAdmissible b)

putnam-2025-a2 : Set1
putnam-2025-a2 =
  (R : Set) ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) ->
  (trigonometry : StandardSine reals) ->
  Putnam2025A2Statement.proposition reals trigonometry

(*
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2025_a2
  (putnambench__hol4__putnam_2025_a2): the sharp lower and upper coefficients
  bounding sin x by multiples of x * (pi - x) on the closed interval from zero
  to pi. This file contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open realTheory transcTheory;

val putnam_2025_a2 =
  ``let lower_admissible =
      \a : real.
        !x : real.
          0 <= x /\ x <= pi
          ==>
          a * x * (pi - x) <= sin x
    in
    let upper_admissible =
      \b : real.
        !x : real.
          0 <= x /\ x <= pi
          ==>
          sin x <= b * x * (pi - x)
    in
    let is_greatest =
      \(s : real -> bool) (a : real).
        s a /\ (!a' : real. s a' ==> a' <= a)
    in
    let is_least =
      \(s : real -> bool) (b : real).
        s b /\ (!b' : real. s b' ==> b <= b')
    in
    let solution = (1 / pi, 4 / pi pow 2) : real # real
    in
      !a b : real.
        ((a, b) = solution
         <=>
         is_greatest lower_admissible a /\
         is_least upper_admissible b)``;

title: putnam_2025_a2
content:
% Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2025_a2:
% the greatest lower and least upper real coefficients bounding sin(x) by
% multiples of x(pi-x) on [0,pi] are 1/pi and 4/pi^2. This file contains no proof.

putnam_2025_a2: THEORY
BEGIN
  real_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> real]

  safe_div(numerator, denominator: real): real =
    IF denominator = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      numerator / denominator
    ENDIF

  nat_factorial(index: nat): RECURSIVE nat =
    IF index = 0 THEN
      1
    ELSE
      index * nat_factorial(index - 1)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE index

  converges_to(sequence: real_sequence, value: real): bool =
    FORALL (epsilon_value: posreal):
      EXISTS (cutoff: nat):
        FORALL (index: nat):
          cutoff <= index IMPLIES
            abs(sequence(index) - value) < epsilon_value

  sine_partial(x: real, count: nat): RECURSIVE real =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      LET index: nat = count - 1 IN
        sine_partial(x, count - 1)
          + safe_div(
              ((-1 :: real) ^ index) * x ^ (2 * index + 1),
              nat_factorial(2 * index + 1) :: real)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  cosine_partial(x: real, count: nat): RECURSIVE real =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      LET index: nat = count - 1 IN
        cosine_partial(x, count - 1)
          + safe_div(
              ((-1 :: real) ^ index) * x ^ (2 * index),
              nat_factorial(2 * index) :: real)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  sine(x: real): real =
    epsilon(
      LAMBDA (value: real):
        converges_to(
          LAMBDA (count: nat): sine_partial(x, count),
          value))

  cosine(x: real): real =
    epsilon(
      LAMBDA (value: real):
        converges_to(
          LAMBDA (count: nat): cosine_partial(x, count),
          value))

  is_pi(value: real): bool =
    3 < value
      AND value < 4
      AND cosine(value / 2) = 0

  pi: real =
    epsilon(
      LAMBDA (value: real):
        is_pi(value))

  lower_coefficient(a: real): bool =
    FORALL (x: real):
      (0 <= x AND x <= pi)
        IMPLIES a * x * (pi - x) <= sine(x)

  upper_coefficient(b: real): bool =
    FORALL (x: real):
      (0 <= x AND x <= pi)
        IMPLIES sine(x) <= b * x * (pi - x)

  greatest_lower_coefficient(a: real): bool =
    lower_coefficient(a)
      AND FORALL (candidate: real):
        lower_coefficient(candidate)
          IMPLIES candidate <= a

  least_upper_coefficient(b: real): bool =
    upper_coefficient(b)
      AND FORALL (candidate: real):
        upper_coefficient(candidate)
          IMPLIES b <= candidate

  putnam_2025_a2_lower_solution: real =
    safe_div(1, pi)

  putnam_2025_a2_upper_solution: real =
    safe_div(4, pi ^ 2)

  putnam_2025_a2: bool =
    FORALL (a, b: real):

title: putnam_2025_a3
content:
import Mathlib

open Finset Function

abbrev putnam_2025_a3_solution : ℕ → Prop := sorry
-- fun _ => False

def GameString (n : ℕ) := Fin n → Fin 3

def initialState (n : ℕ) : GameString n := fun _ => 0

def isValidMove {n : ℕ} (s1 s2 : GameString n) : Prop :=
  (∃! i : Fin n, s1 i ≠ s2 i) ∧
  ∀ i : Fin n, s1 i ≠ s2 i →
    ((s1 i).val + 1 = (s2 i).val ∨ (s2 i).val + 1 = (s1 i).val)

def IsValidGamePlay {n : ℕ} (play : List (GameString n)) : Prop :=
  play.Chain isValidMove (initialState n) ∧
  (initialState n :: play).Nodup

inductive HasWinningStrategy (n : ℕ) : List (GameString n) → Prop where
  | win (play : List (GameString n)) (s : GameString n) :
      IsValidGamePlay (play ++ [s]) →
      (∀ s', IsValidGamePlay (play ++ [s, s']) → HasWinningStrategy n (play ++ [s, s'])) →
      HasWinningStrategy n play

def AliceHasWinningStrategy (n : ℕ) : Prop := HasWinningStrategy n []

/--
Alice and Bob play a game with a string of $n$ digits, each of which is restricted
to be 0, 1, or 2. Initially all the digits are 0. A legal move is to add or subtract 1
from one digit to create a new string that has not appeared before. A player with no
legal move loses, and the other player wins. Alice goes first, and the players alternate
moves. For each $n \ge 1$, determine which player has a strategy that guarantees winning.
-/
theorem putnam_2025_a3 (n : ℕ) (hn : 1 ≤ n) :
    putnam_2025_a3_solution n ↔ AliceHasWinningStrategy n := by
  sorry

(* Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2025_a3
   (putnambench__rocq__putnam_2025_a3): Alice has no winning strategy in the
   non-repeating ternary-string game for any positive string length. This file
   contains no proof. *)

From Stdlib Require Import Arith.PeanoNat Lists.List Vectors.Fin.

Import ListNotations.

Definition putnam_2025_a3_GameString (n : nat) : Type :=
  Fin.t n -> Fin.t 3.

Definition putnam_2025_a3_fin_value
    {n : nat} (i : Fin.t n) : nat :=
  proj1_sig (Fin.to_nat i).

Definition putnam_2025_a3_initial_state
    (n : nat) : putnam_2025_a3_GameString n :=
  fun _ => @Fin.F1 2.

Definition putnam_2025_a3_same_game_string
    {n : nat}
    (left right : putnam_2025_a3_GameString n) : Prop :=
  forall i : Fin.t n, left i = right i.

Fixpoint putnam_2025_a3_member_by
    {A : Type}
    (equivalent : A -> A -> Prop)
    (item : A)
    (items : list A) : Prop :=
  match items with
  | [] => False
  | head :: tail =>
      equivalent item head \/
      putnam_2025_a3_member_by equivalent item tail
  end.

Fixpoint putnam_2025_a3_no_duplicates_by
    {A : Type}
    (equivalent : A -> A -> Prop)
    (items : list A) : Prop :=
  match items with
  | [] => True
  | head :: tail =>
      ~ putnam_2025_a3_member_by equivalent head tail /\
      putnam_2025_a3_no_duplicates_by equivalent tail
  end.

Definition putnam_2025_a3_is_valid_move
    {n : nat}
    (before after : putnam_2025_a3_GameString n) : Prop :=
  (exists! i : Fin.t n, before i <> after i) /\
  forall i : Fin.t n,
    before i <> after i ->
    S (putnam_2025_a3_fin_value (before i)) =
      putnam_2025_a3_fin_value (after i) \/
    S (putnam_2025_a3_fin_value (after i)) =
      putnam_2025_a3_fin_value (before i).

Fixpoint putnam_2025_a3_move_chain
    {A : Type}
    (relation : A -> A -> Prop)
    (start : A)
    (items : list A) : Prop :=
  match items with
  | [] => True
  | next :: tail =>
      relation start next /\
      putnam_2025_a3_move_chain relation next tail
  end.

Definition putnam_2025_a3_is_valid_game_play
    {n : nat}
    (play : list (putnam_2025_a3_GameString n)) : Prop :=
  putnam_2025_a3_move_chain
    putnam_2025_a3_is_valid_move
    (putnam_2025_a3_initial_state n)
    play /\
  putnam_2025_a3_no_duplicates_by
    putnam_2025_a3_same_game_string
    (putnam_2025_a3_initial_state n :: play).

Inductive putnam_2025_a3_HasWinningStrategy
    (n : nat) :
    list (putnam_2025_a3_GameString n) -> Prop :=
  | putnam_2025_a3_winning_move :
      forall
        (play : list (putnam_2025_a3_GameString n))
        (move : putnam_2025_a3_GameString n),
        putnam_2025_a3_is_valid_game_play (play ++ [move]) ->
        (forall reply : putnam_2025_a3_GameString n,
          putnam_2025_a3_is_valid_game_play
            (play ++ [move; reply]) ->
          putnam_2025_a3_HasWinningStrategy n
            (play ++ [move; reply])) ->
        putnam_2025_a3_HasWinningStrategy n play.

Definition putnam_2025_a3_AliceHasWinningStrategy
    (n : nat) : Prop :=
  putnam_2025_a3_HasWinningStrategy n [].

Definition putnam_2025_a3_solution (_ : nat) : Prop :=
  False.

Theorem putnam_2025_a3 :
  forall n : nat,
    (1 <= n)%nat ->
    (putnam_2025_a3_solution n <->
     putnam_2025_a3_AliceHasWinningStrategy n).
Admitted.

(*
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2025_a3
  (putnambench__isabelle__putnam_2025_a3): in the no-repetition game on
  length-n strings over {0, 1, 2}, where a move changes one digit by 1, Bob
  has a winning strategy for every positive n. This file contains no proof.
*)

theory putnam_2025_a3
  imports Main
begin

type_synonym game_string = "nat list"

definition valid_game_string :: "nat \<Rightarrow> game_string \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "valid_game_string n s \<longleftrightarrow>
    length s = n \<and> set s \<subseteq> {..<3}"

definition initial_state :: "nat \<Rightarrow> game_string" where
  "initial_state n = replicate n 0"

definition is_valid_move ::
    "nat \<Rightarrow> game_string \<Rightarrow> game_string \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "is_valid_move n s1 s2 \<longleftrightarrow>
    valid_game_string n s1 \<and>
    valid_game_string n s2 \<and>
    (\<exists>!i. i < n \<and> s1 ! i \<noteq> s2 ! i) \<and>
    (\<forall>i<n. s1 ! i \<noteq> s2 ! i \<longrightarrow>
      s1 ! i + 1 = s2 ! i \<or> s2 ! i + 1 = s1 ! i)"

primrec move_chain ::
    "nat \<Rightarrow> game_string \<Rightarrow> game_string list \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "move_chain n s [] = True"
| "move_chain n s (t # ts) =
    (is_valid_move n s t \<and> move_chain n t ts)"

definition is_valid_game_play :: "nat \<Rightarrow> game_string list \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "is_valid_game_play n play \<longleftrightarrow>
    move_chain n (initial_state n) play \<and>
    distinct (initial_state n # play)"

inductive has_winning_strategy :: "nat \<Rightarrow> game_string list \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  win:
    "is_valid_game_play n (play @ [s]) \<Longrightarrow>
     (\<And>s'. is_valid_game_play n (play @ [s, s']) \<Longrightarrow>
       has_winning_strategy n (play @ [s, s'])) \<Longrightarrow>
     has_winning_strategy n play"

definition alice_has_winning_strategy :: "nat \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "alice_has_winning_strategy n \<longleftrightarrow>
    has_winning_strategy n []"

definition putnam_2025_a3_solution :: "nat \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "putnam_2025_a3_solution n \<longleftrightarrow> False"

theorem putnam_2025_a3:
  fixes n :: nat
  assumes "1 \<le> n"
  shows
    "putnam_2025_a3_solution n \<longleftrightarrow>
      alice_has_winning_strategy n"
  sorry

end

   let legal_move =
     \n:num. \(s:num->num) (t:num->num).

;; Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2025_a3:
;; Alice has no winning strategy in the non-repeating ternary-string game for
;; any positive string length. This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))

;; A natural below 3^n is the base-3 code of exactly one function
;; Fin n -> Fin 3. Position zero is the least significant ternary digit.

(defun putnam-2025-a3-digit (code position)
  (mod (floor (nfix code)
              (expt 3 (nfix position)))
       3))

;; DIFF-SEEN records whether the unique changed position has already occurred.

(defun putnam-2025-a3-valid-move-scan-p
    (left right position positions-left diff-seen)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix positions-left)))
  (if (zp positions-left)
      diff-seen
    (let ((left-digit
           (putnam-2025-a3-digit left position))
          (right-digit
           (putnam-2025-a3-digit right position)))
      (if (equal left-digit right-digit)
          (putnam-2025-a3-valid-move-scan-p
           left
           right
           (+ position 1)
           (- positions-left 1)
           diff-seen)
        (and
         (not diff-seen)
         (or (equal (+ left-digit 1) right-digit)
             (equal (+ right-digit 1) left-digit))
         (putnam-2025-a3-valid-move-scan-p
          left
          right
          (+ position 1)
          (- positions-left 1)
          t))))))

(defun putnam-2025-a3-valid-move-p (n state-count left right)
  (and
   (natp n)
   (natp left)
   (natp right)
   (< left state-count)
   (< right state-count)
   (putnam-2025-a3-valid-move-scan-p
    left right 0 n nil)))

;; HISTORY lists, newest first, the states played after the initial all-zero
;; string. Generated histories are therefore in bijection with the source's
;; valid plays.

(defun putnam-2025-a3-legal-next-p
    (n state-count history candidate)
  (and
   (natp candidate)
   (< candidate state-count)
   (not (member-equal candidate (cons 0 history)))
   (putnam-2025-a3-valid-move-p
    n
    state-count
    (if (consp history) (car history) 0)
    candidate)))

;; A :VALUE call enters a HasWinningStrategy node. A :OUR-SCAN call searches
;; existentially for the constructor's move s. An :OPP-SCAN call checks
;; universally every legal reply s'. Decreasing MOVES-LEFT corresponds to
;; adding a fresh state; within a scan, CANDIDATES-LEFT decreases.

(defun putnam-2025-a3-search-measure
    (state-count moves-left phase candidates-left)
  (make-ord
   1
   (+ 1 (nfix moves-left))
   (if (equal phase :value)
       (+ 1 (nfix state-count))
     (nfix candidates-left))))

(defun putnam-2025-a3-has-winning-strategy-search-p
    (n state-count history moves-left phase candidates-left)
  (declare
   (xargs
    :measure
    (putnam-2025-a3-search-measure
     state-count moves-left phase candidates-left)
    :well-founded-relation o<))
  (cond
   ((equal phase :value)
    (if (zp moves-left)
        nil
      (putnam-2025-a3-has-winning-strategy-search-p
       n
       state-count
       history
       moves-left
       :our-scan
       state-count)))
   ((zp moves-left)
    (equal phase :opp-scan))
   ((zp candidates-left)
    (equal phase :opp-scan))
   ((equal phase :our-scan)
    (let ((candidate (- candidates-left 1)))
      (if
       (and
        (putnam-2025-a3-legal-next-p
         n state-count history candidate)
        (putnam-2025-a3-has-winning-strategy-search-p
         n
         state-count
         (cons candidate history)
         (- moves-left 1)
         :opp-scan
         state-count))
       t
        (putnam-2025-a3-has-winning-strategy-search-p
         n
         state-count
         history
         moves-left
         :our-scan
         (- candidates-left 1)))))
   ((equal phase :opp-scan)
    (let ((candidate (- candidates-left 1)))
      (if
       (and
        (putnam-2025-a3-legal-next-p
         n state-count history candidate)
        (not
         (putnam-2025-a3-has-winning-strategy-search-p
          n
          state-count
          (cons candidate history)
          (- moves-left 1)
          :value
          0)))
       nil
        (putnam-2025-a3-has-winning-strategy-search-p
         n
         state-count
         history
         moves-left
         :opp-scan
         (- candidates-left 1)))))
   (t nil)))

(defun putnam-2025-a3-alice-has-winning-strategy-p (n)
  (let ((state-count (expt 3 (nfix n))))
    (putnam-2025-a3-has-winning-strategy-search-p
     n
     state-count
     nil
     (- state-count 1)
     :value
     0)))

;; The ground-truth solution predicate is False. Keeping it as a separate
;; definition preserves the source theorem's stated biconditional.

(defun putnam-2025-a3-solution-p (n)
  (declare (ignore n))
  nil)

(defun putnambench-putnam-2025-a3-statement (n)
  (implies
   (and (natp n)
        (<= 1 n))
   (equal
    (putnam-2025-a3-solution-p n)
    (putnam-2025-a3-alice-has-winning-strategy-p n))))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

-- Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2025_a3
-- (putnambench__agda__putnam_2025_a3): Alice has no winning strategy in the
-- non-repeating ternary-string game for any positive string length. This file
-- contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module Putnam2025A3 where

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc)

infix 4 _!=_ _<=N_
infixr 5 _::_
infixr 4 _++_
infixr 3 _and_
infixr 2 _or_

data Bottom : Set where

Not : Set -> Set
Not A =
  A -> Bottom

_!=_ : {A : Set} -> A -> A -> Set
x != y =
  Not (x == y)

record _and_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data _or_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  left  : A -> A or B
  right : B -> A or B

record Iff (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor equivalence
  field
    forward  : A -> B
    backward : B -> A

record ExistsUnique (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor unique-witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value
    unique   : (other : A) -> P other -> other == value

data _<=N_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set where
  zero<=N   : {n : Nat} -> zero <=N n
  suc<=sucN : {m n : Nat} -> m <=N n -> suc m <=N suc n

data Fin : Nat -> Set where
  fzero : {n : Nat} -> Fin (suc n)
  fsuc  : {n : Nat} -> Fin n -> Fin (suc n)

finValue : {n : Nat} -> Fin n -> Nat
finValue fzero =
  zero
finValue (fsuc index) =
  suc (finValue index)

data List (A : Set) : Set where
  []   : List A
  _::_ : A -> List A -> List A

_++_ : {A : Set} -> List A -> List A -> List A
[] ++ suffix =
  suffix
(head :: tail) ++ suffix =
  head :: (tail ++ suffix)

data MemberBy {A : Set}
  (equivalent : A -> A -> Set)
  (item : A) :
  List A -> Set where

  member-here :
    {head : A} {tail : List A} ->
    equivalent item head ->
    MemberBy equivalent item (head :: tail)

  member-there :
    {head : A} {tail : List A} ->
    MemberBy equivalent item tail ->
    MemberBy equivalent item (head :: tail)

data NoDuplicatesBy {A : Set}
  (equivalent : A -> A -> Set) :
  List A -> Set where

  no-duplicates-empty :
    NoDuplicatesBy equivalent []

  no-duplicates-cons :
    {head : A} {tail : List A} ->
    Not (MemberBy equivalent head tail) ->
    NoDuplicatesBy equivalent tail ->
    NoDuplicatesBy equivalent (head :: tail)

one : Nat
one =
  suc zero

three : Nat
three =
  suc (suc (suc zero))

GameString : Nat -> Set
GameString n =
  Fin n -> Fin three

SameGameString :
  {n : Nat} ->
  GameString n ->
  GameString n ->
  Set
SameGameString {n} left-string right-string =
  (index : Fin n) ->
  left-string index == right-string index

initialState : (n : Nat) -> GameString n
initialState n index =
  fzero

isValidMove :
  {n : Nat} ->
  GameString n ->
  GameString n ->
  Set
isValidMove {n} before after =
  ExistsUnique (Fin n)
    (\ index -> before index != after index)
  and
  ((index : Fin n) ->
    before index != after index ->
    (suc (finValue (before index)) == finValue (after index))
    or
    (suc (finValue (after index)) == finValue (before index)))

data ChainFrom {A : Set} (relation : A -> A -> Set) :
  A -> List A -> Set where

  chain-empty :
    {start : A} ->
    ChainFrom relation start []

  chain-cons :
    {start next : A} {tail : List A} ->
    relation start next ->
    ChainFrom relation next tail ->
    ChainFrom relation start (next :: tail)

IsValidGamePlay :
  {n : Nat} ->
  List (GameString n) ->
  Set
IsValidGamePlay {n} play =
  ChainFrom isValidMove (initialState n) play
  and
  NoDuplicatesBy SameGameString (initialState n :: play)

data HasWinningStrategy (n : Nat) :
  List (GameString n) -> Set where

  winning-move :
    (play : List (GameString n)) ->
    (move : GameString n) ->
    IsValidGamePlay (play ++ (move :: [])) ->
    ((reply : GameString n) ->
      IsValidGamePlay (play ++ (move :: reply :: [])) ->
      HasWinningStrategy n (play ++ (move :: reply :: []))) ->
    HasWinningStrategy n play

AliceHasWinningStrategy : Nat -> Set
AliceHasWinningStrategy n =
  HasWinningStrategy n []

putnam-2025-a3-solution : Nat -> Set
putnam-2025-a3-solution n =
  Bottom

putnam-2025-a3 : Set
putnam-2025-a3 =
  (n : Nat) ->
  one <=N n ->
  Iff
    (putnam-2025-a3-solution n)
    (AliceHasWinningStrategy n)

  putnam_2025_a3 (putnambench__metamath__putnam_2025_a3): Bob wins the
  no-repetition game on length-n ternary strings for every positive n, where
  each move changes exactly one digit by one. This file contains no proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  P25A3States n is the full function space from the n zero-based positions
  to {0,1,2}; no finite table replaces this state space. P25A3Initial n is
  the constant-zero state. P25A3Move requires a unique changed coordinate
  and a difference of exactly one there.

  P25A3Play states the source Chain condition from the initial state and
  the source Nodup condition: the word of played states is injective and
  omits the initial state. P25A3Win is the intersection characterization
  of the inductively generated HasWinningStrategy predicate. Namely, a
  history belongs to every set of histories closed under the source win
  constructor. This is the standard least-constructor-closed encoding and
  preserves the existential move, universal reply, and recursive scopes.

  P25A3Solution is False, as specified by the source solution annotation.
  The final declaration is the single unproved corpus assertion. Every $a
  declaration in this file is statement syntax or a faithful definition;

:: Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2025_a3
:: (putnambench__mizar__putnam_2025_a3): in the no-repetition game on
:: length-n strings over {0,1,2}, where a move changes one digit by 1,
:: Alice has no force-win strategy for positive n. This file contains no proof.

environ
  vocabularies TARSKI, XBOOLE_0, ZFMISC_1, SUBSET_1, RELAT_1, FUNCT_1,
    FUNCT_2, PARTFUN1, FINSEQ_1, FINSEQ_2, NUMBERS, NAT_1, CARD_1,
    XCMPLX_0, XREAL_0, XXREAL_0, ORDINAL1, FINSET_1, ARYTM_1, ARYTM_3,
    CARD_3, VALUED_0, VALUED_1, ABIAN, INT_1, FUNCOP_1;
  notations TARSKI, XBOOLE_0, ZFMISC_1, SUBSET_1, ORDINAL1, CARD_1,
    NUMBERS, XCMPLX_0, XREAL_0, XXREAL_0, NAT_1, NAT_D, RELAT_1,
    FUNCT_1, RELSET_1, PARTFUN1, FUNCT_2, FUNCOP_1, FINSEQ_1, FINSEQ_2,
    FINSET_1;
  constructors RELSET_1, PARTFUN1, FUNCT_2, FUNCOP_1, FINSEQ_4, NAT_1,
    NAT_D, FINSET_1;
  registrations XBOOLE_0, SUBSET_1, RELAT_1, FUNCT_1, RELSET_1,
    FUNCT_2, PARTFUN1, FUNCOP_1, FINSEQ_1, FINSEQ_2, ORDINAL1, CARD_1,
    NUMBERS, XCMPLX_0, XREAL_0, XXREAL_0, NAT_1, VALUED_0, VALUED_1,
    FINSET_1, MEMBERED, FRAENKEL;
  requirements BOOLE, SUBSET, NUMERALS, ARITHM;
  definitions TARSKI;
  equalities FINSEQ_1;
  expansions TARSKI, FINSEQ_1;

begin

::$P-
theorem
  for n being Nat,
      positions being set,
      init being Function of Seg n,Seg 3 st
    0 < n &
    positions = Funcs(Seg n,Seg 3) &
    init = Seg n --> 1
  holds
    not ex strategy being Function of positions*,positions st
      for play being FinSequence of positions st
        play is one-to-one &
        not init in rng play &
        (for i being Nat st i in dom play holds
          (i = 1 implies
            ex q being Function of Seg n,Seg 3 st
              q = play.i &
              (ex j being Element of Seg n st
                init.j <> q.j &
                for k being Element of Seg n st init.k <> q.k holds
                  k = j) &
              for k being Element of Seg n st init.k <> q.k holds
                ex a,b being Nat st
                  a = init.k & b = q.k &
                  (a + 1 = b or b + 1 = a)) &
          (1 < i implies
            ex p,q being Function of Seg n,Seg 3 st
              p = play.(i - 1) &
              q = play.i &
              (ex j being Element of Seg n st
                p.j <> q.j &
                for k being Element of Seg n st p.k <> q.k holds
                  k = j) &
              for k being Element of Seg n st p.k <> q.k holds
                ex a,b being Nat st
                  a = p.k & b = q.k &
                  (a + 1 = b or b + 1 = a))) &
        (for i being Nat st i in dom play & i mod 2 = 1 holds
          play.i = strategy.(play|(i - 1))) &
        not ex s being Function of Seg n,Seg 3 st
          s <> init &
          not s in rng play &
          (len play mod 2 = 0 implies s = strategy.play) &
          ((len play = 0 &
            (ex j being Element of Seg n st
              init.j <> s.j &
              for k being Element of Seg n st init.k <> s.k holds
                k = j) &
            for k being Element of Seg n st init.k <> s.k holds
              ex a,b being Nat st
                a = init.k & b = s.k &
                (a + 1 = b or b + 1 = a)) or
           ex p being Function of Seg n,Seg 3 st
             0 < len play &
             p = play.(len play) &
             (ex j being Element of Seg n st
               p.j <> s.j &
               for k being Element of Seg n st p.k <> s.k holds
                 k = j) &
             for k being Element of Seg n st p.k <> s.k holds
               ex a,b being Nat st
                 a = p.k & b = s.k &
                 (a + 1 = b or b + 1 = a))
      holds
        len play mod 2 = 1
proof
end;
::$P+

title: putnam_2025_a3
content:
% Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2025_a3:
% in the no-repetition game on length-n strings over the digits 0, 1, and 2,
% where each move changes one digit by 1, Bob wins for every positive n.
% This file contains no proof.

putnam_2025_a3: THEORY
BEGIN
  game_string(n: posnat): TYPE = [below(n) -> below(3)]
  game_play(n: posnat): TYPE = list[game_string(n)]

  initial_state(n: posnat): game_string(n) =
    LAMBDA (index: below(n)): 0

  is_valid_move(
      n: posnat,
      before, after: game_string(n)): bool =
    (EXISTS (changed: below(n)):
      before(changed) /= after(changed)
        AND (FORALL (index: below(n)):
          before(index) /= after(index)
            IMPLIES index = changed))
      AND
    (FORALL (index: below(n)):
      before(index) /= after(index)
        IMPLIES
          before(index) + 1 = after(index)
            OR after(index) + 1 = before(index))

  move_chain(
      n: posnat,
      previous: game_string(n),
      play: game_play(n)): RECURSIVE bool =
    CASES play OF
      null: TRUE,
      cons(current, tail):
        is_valid_move(n, previous, current)
          AND move_chain(n, current, tail)
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE length(play)

  contains_state(
      n: posnat,
      state: game_string(n),
      play: game_play(n)): RECURSIVE bool =
    CASES play OF
      null: FALSE,
      cons(current, tail):
        state = current OR contains_state(n, state, tail)
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE length(play)

  has_no_duplicates(
      n: posnat,
      play: game_play(n)): RECURSIVE bool =
    CASES play OF
      null: TRUE,
      cons(current, tail):
        NOT contains_state(n, current, tail)
          AND has_no_duplicates(n, tail)
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE length(play)

  is_valid_game_play(n: posnat, play: game_play(n)): bool =
    move_chain(n, initial_state(n), play)
      AND has_no_duplicates(n, cons(initial_state(n), play))

  has_winning_strategy(
      n: posnat,
      play: game_play(n)): INDUCTIVE bool =
    EXISTS (alice_move: game_string(n)):
      is_valid_game_play(
        n,
        append(play, cons(alice_move, null)))
        AND
      (FORALL (bob_move: game_string(n)):
        is_valid_game_play(
          n,
          append(
            play,
            cons(alice_move, cons(bob_move, null))))
          IMPLIES
            has_winning_strategy(
              n,
              append(
                play,
                cons(alice_move, cons(bob_move, null)))))

  alice_has_winning_strategy(n: posnat): bool =
    has_winning_strategy(n, null)

  putnam_2025_a3_solution(n: posnat): bool =
    FALSE

  putnam_2025_a3: bool =
    FORALL (n: posnat):
      putnam_2025_a3_solution(n)
        IFF alice_has_winning_strategy(n)
END putnam_2025_a3

title: putnam_2025_a4
content:
(* Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2025_a4:
   the least dimension of 2025 real square matrices whose commutation graph
   is the cycle on their indices. This file contains no proof. *)

From Stdlib Require Import Arith.PeanoNat Reals Vectors.Fin.

Open Scope R_scope.

Definition putnam_2025_a4_matrix (n : nat) : Type :=
  Fin.t n -> Fin.t n -> RbaseSymbolsImpl.R.

Fixpoint putnam_2025_a4_fin_sum
    (n : nat) :
    (Fin.t n -> RbaseSymbolsImpl.R) -> RbaseSymbolsImpl.R :=
  match n as m return
    (Fin.t m -> RbaseSymbolsImpl.R) -> RbaseSymbolsImpl.R with
  | O => fun _ => 0
  | S k =>
      fun f =>
        f Fin.F1 +
        putnam_2025_a4_fin_sum k (fun i => f (Fin.FS i))
  end.

Definition putnam_2025_a4_matrix_mul
    {n : nat}
    (A B : putnam_2025_a4_matrix n) :
    putnam_2025_a4_matrix n :=
  fun i j =>
    putnam_2025_a4_fin_sum n (fun k => A i k * B k j).

Definition putnam_2025_a4_matrix_eq
    {n : nat}
    (A B : putnam_2025_a4_matrix n) : Prop :=
  forall i j : Fin.t n, A i j = B i j.

Fixpoint putnam_2025_a4_fin_value
    {n : nat} (i : Fin.t n) : nat :=
  match i with
  | Fin.F1 => 0%nat
  | Fin.FS j => S (putnam_2025_a4_fin_value j)
  end.

Definition putnam_2025_a4_feasible_dimension (k : nat) : Prop :=
  exists A : Fin.t 2025 -> putnam_2025_a4_matrix k,
    forall i j : Fin.t 2025,
      (putnam_2025_a4_fin_value i <= putnam_2025_a4_fin_value j)%nat ->
      (putnam_2025_a4_matrix_eq
         (putnam_2025_a4_matrix_mul (A i) (A j))
         (putnam_2025_a4_matrix_mul (A j) (A i)) <->
       (putnam_2025_a4_fin_value j -
        putnam_2025_a4_fin_value i = 0)%nat \/
       (putnam_2025_a4_fin_value j -
        putnam_2025_a4_fin_value i = 1)%nat \/
       (putnam_2025_a4_fin_value j -
        putnam_2025_a4_fin_value i = 2024)%nat).

Definition putnam_2025_a4_is_least
    (property : nat -> Prop) (least : nat) : Prop :=
  property least /\
  forall candidate : nat,
    property candidate ->
    (least <= candidate)%nat.

Definition putnam_2025_a4_solution : nat := 3%nat.

Theorem putnam_2025_a4 :
  putnam_2025_a4_is_least
    putnam_2025_a4_feasible_dimension
    putnam_2025_a4_solution.
Admitted.

(*
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2025_a4
  (putnambench__isabelle__putnam_2025_a4): the least dimension of real square
  matrices whose commuting pairs among 2025 indexed matrices are exactly the
  equal or cyclically adjacent indices. This file contains no proof.
*)

theory putnam_2025_a4
  imports Complex_Main
begin

type_synonym putnam_2025_a4_matrix = "nat \<Rightarrow> nat \<Rightarrow> real"

definition putnam_2025_a4_matrix_mult ::
    "nat \<Rightarrow> putnam_2025_a4_matrix \<Rightarrow> putnam_2025_a4_matrix \<Rightarrow>
      putnam_2025_a4_matrix" where
  "putnam_2025_a4_matrix_mult k A B =
    (\<lambda>i j. \<Sum>r<k. A i r * B r j)"

definition putnam_2025_a4_commute ::
    "nat \<Rightarrow> putnam_2025_a4_matrix \<Rightarrow> putnam_2025_a4_matrix \<Rightarrow>
      bool" where
  "putnam_2025_a4_commute k A B \<longleftrightarrow>
    (\<forall>i<k. \<forall>j<k.
      putnam_2025_a4_matrix_mult k A B i j =
        putnam_2025_a4_matrix_mult k B A i j)"

definition putnam_2025_a4_admissible_dimension :: "nat \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "putnam_2025_a4_admissible_dimension k \<longleftrightarrow>
    (\<exists>A :: nat \<Rightarrow> putnam_2025_a4_matrix.
      \<forall>i<2025. \<forall>j<2025.
        i \<le> j \<longrightarrow>
          (putnam_2025_a4_commute k (A i) (A j) \<longleftrightarrow>
            j - i \<in> {0, 1, 2024}))"

definition putnam_2025_a4_solution :: nat where
  "putnam_2025_a4_solution = 3"

theorem putnam_2025_a4:
  shows
    "putnam_2025_a4_solution
        \<in> {k. putnam_2025_a4_admissible_dimension k} \<and>
      (\<forall>k\<in>{k. putnam_2025_a4_admissible_dimension k}.
        putnam_2025_a4_solution \<le> k)"
  sorry

end

(*
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2025_a4
  (putnambench__hol-light__putnam_2025_a4): the least dimension of real square
  matrices whose commuting graph is the 2025-cycle. This file contains no
  proof.
*)

let statement =
  `let matrix_mul =
     \(k:num) (A:num->num->real) (B:num->num->real).
       \r c:num. sum {p:num | p < k} (\p. A r p * B p c) in
   let matrix_equal =
     \(k:num) (A:num->num->real) (B:num->num->real).
       !r c:num. r < k /\ c < k ==> A r c = B r c in
   let admissible =
     \k:num.
       ?A:num->num->num->real.
         !i j:num.
           i < 2025 /\ j < 2025 /\ i <= j
           ==>
           (matrix_equal k
              (matrix_mul k (A i) (A j))
              (matrix_mul k (A j) (A i)) <=>
            j - i = 0 \/ j - i = 1 \/ j - i = 2024) in
   admissible 3 /\
   (!k:num. admissible k ==> 3 <= k)`;;

title: putnam_2025_a4
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2025_a4:
;; the least dimension of 2025 real square matrices whose commuting pairs are
;; exactly the equal or cyclically adjacent indices is 3. This file contains
;; no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))
(set-gag-mode t)

;; The scalar symbols present an arbitrary real-closed ordered field. For each
;; of the dimensions 0, 1, 2, and 3, the matrix condition is a first-order
;; Boolean combination of finitely many polynomial equations over the prime
;; field. Tarski transfer therefore makes this statement equivalent to the
;; source statement over the real numbers without restricting matrix entries
;; to a countable family of syntactic Cauchy names.

(defstub p2025a4-scalar-p (x) t)
(defstub p2025a4-add-op (x y) t)
(defstub p2025a4-multiply-op (x y) t)
(defstub p2025a4-negate-op (x) t)
(defstub p2025a4-inverse-op (x) t)
(defstub p2025a4-less-op (x y) t)
(defstub p2025a4-zero () t)
(defstub p2025a4-one () t)

(defun p2025a4-add (x y)
  (p2025a4-add-op x y))

(defun p2025a4-multiply (x y)
  (p2025a4-multiply-op x y))

(defun p2025a4-negate (x)
  (p2025a4-negate-op x))

(defun p2025a4-inverse (x)
  (p2025a4-inverse-op x))

(defun p2025a4-less (x y)
  (if (p2025a4-less-op x y) t nil))

(defun p2025a4-subtract (x y)
  (p2025a4-add x (p2025a4-negate y)))

(defun-sk p2025a4-field-laws-p ()
  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (p2025a4-scalar-p x)
      (p2025a4-scalar-p y)
      (p2025a4-scalar-p z))
     (and
      (p2025a4-scalar-p (p2025a4-add x y))
      (p2025a4-scalar-p (p2025a4-multiply x y))
      (p2025a4-scalar-p (p2025a4-negate x))
      (implies
       (not (equal x (p2025a4-zero)))
       (p2025a4-scalar-p (p2025a4-inverse x)))
      (equal
       (p2025a4-add (p2025a4-add x y) z)
       (p2025a4-add x (p2025a4-add y z)))
      (equal
       (p2025a4-add x y)
       (p2025a4-add y x))
      (equal
       (p2025a4-add x (p2025a4-zero))
       x)
      (equal
       (p2025a4-add x (p2025a4-negate x))
       (p2025a4-zero))
      (equal
       (p2025a4-multiply
        (p2025a4-multiply x y) z)
       (p2025a4-multiply
        x (p2025a4-multiply y z)))
      (equal
       (p2025a4-multiply x y)
       (p2025a4-multiply y x))
      (equal
       (p2025a4-multiply x (p2025a4-one))
       x)
      (implies
       (not (equal x (p2025a4-zero)))
       (equal
        (p2025a4-multiply x (p2025a4-inverse x))
        (p2025a4-one)))
      (equal
       (p2025a4-multiply x (p2025a4-add y z))
       (p2025a4-add
        (p2025a4-multiply x y)
        (p2025a4-multiply x z)))))))

(defun-sk p2025a4-order-laws-p ()
  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (p2025a4-scalar-p x)
      (p2025a4-scalar-p y)
      (p2025a4-scalar-p z))
     (and
      (not (p2025a4-less x x))
      (or
       (equal x y)
       (p2025a4-less x y)
       (p2025a4-less y x))
      (implies
       (and
        (p2025a4-less x y)
        (p2025a4-less y z))
       (p2025a4-less x z))
      (implies
       (p2025a4-less x y)
       (p2025a4-less
        (p2025a4-add x z)
        (p2025a4-add y z)))
      (implies
       (and
        (p2025a4-less (p2025a4-zero) x)
        (p2025a4-less (p2025a4-zero) y))
       (p2025a4-less
        (p2025a4-zero)
        (p2025a4-multiply x y)))))))

(defun p2025a4-coefficient-list-p (coefficients)
  (if (consp coefficients)
      (and
       (p2025a4-scalar-p (car coefficients))
       (p2025a4-coefficient-list-p
        (cdr coefficients)))
    (equal coefficients nil)))

;; Coefficients use increasing degree order.
(defun p2025a4-polynomial-value (coefficients x)
  (if (consp coefficients)
      (p2025a4-add
       (car coefficients)
       (p2025a4-multiply
        x
        (p2025a4-polynomial-value
         (cdr coefficients) x)))
    (p2025a4-zero)))

(defun p2025a4-polynomial-p (coefficients)
  (and
   (true-listp coefficients)
   (p2025a4-coefficient-list-p coefficients)))

(defun p2025a4-odd-degree-polynomial-p (coefficients)
  (and
   (p2025a4-polynomial-p coefficients)
   (consp coefficients)
   (evenp (len coefficients))
   (not
    (equal
     (car (last coefficients))
     (p2025a4-zero)))))

(defun-sk p2025a4-square-root-exists-p (x)
  (exists (root)
    (and
     (p2025a4-scalar-p root)
     (equal
      (p2025a4-multiply root root)
      x))))

(defun-sk p2025a4-positive-square-roots-p ()
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (and
      (p2025a4-scalar-p x)
      (p2025a4-less (p2025a4-zero) x))
     (p2025a4-square-root-exists-p x))))

(defun-sk p2025a4-polynomial-root-exists-p
    (coefficients)
  (exists (root)
    (and
     (p2025a4-scalar-p root)
     (equal
      (p2025a4-polynomial-value
       coefficients root)
      (p2025a4-zero)))))

(defun-sk p2025a4-odd-polynomial-roots-p ()
  (forall (coefficients)
    (implies
     (p2025a4-odd-degree-polynomial-p coefficients)
     (p2025a4-polynomial-root-exists-p
      coefficients))))

(defun p2025a4-real-closed-field-p ()
  (and
   (p2025a4-scalar-p (p2025a4-zero))
   (p2025a4-scalar-p (p2025a4-one))
   (not (equal (p2025a4-zero) (p2025a4-one)))
   (p2025a4-less (p2025a4-zero) (p2025a4-one))
   (p2025a4-field-laws-p)
   (p2025a4-order-laws-p)
   (p2025a4-positive-square-roots-p)
   (p2025a4-odd-polynomial-roots-p)))

;; Matrices and matrix families are exact finite lists of carrier elements.

(defun p2025a4-row-p (row remaining)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix remaining)))
  (if (zp remaining)
      (equal row nil)
    (and
     (consp row)
     (p2025a4-scalar-p (car row))
     (p2025a4-row-p
      (cdr row) (- remaining 1)))))

(defun p2025a4-matrix-p (matrix k remaining)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix remaining)))
  (if (zp remaining)
      (equal matrix nil)
    (and
     (consp matrix)
     (p2025a4-row-p (car matrix) k)
     (p2025a4-matrix-p
      (cdr matrix) k (- remaining 1)))))

(defun p2025a4-family-p (family k remaining)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix remaining)))
  (if (zp remaining)
      (equal family nil)
    (and
     (consp family)
     (p2025a4-matrix-p (car family) k k)
     (p2025a4-family-p
      (cdr family) k (- remaining 1)))))

(defun p2025a4-entry
    (family matrix-index row column)
  (nth column
       (nth row
            (nth matrix-index family))))

(defun p2025a4-commutator-entry
    (family i j row column remaining)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix remaining)))
  (if (zp remaining)
      (p2025a4-zero)
    (let* ((middle (- remaining 1))
           (ir
            (p2025a4-entry family i row middle))
           (jc
            (p2025a4-entry family j middle column))
           (jr
            (p2025a4-entry family j row middle))
           (ic
            (p2025a4-entry family i middle column)))
      (p2025a4-add
       (p2025a4-subtract
        (p2025a4-multiply ir jc)
        (p2025a4-multiply jr ic))
       (p2025a4-commutator-entry
        family i j row column
        (- remaining 1))))))

(defun p2025a4-commute-columns-p
    (family k i j row remaining)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix remaining)))
  (if (zp remaining)
      t
    (let ((column (- remaining 1)))
      (and
       (equal
        (p2025a4-commutator-entry
         family i j row column k)
        (p2025a4-zero))
       (p2025a4-commute-columns-p
        family k i j row (- remaining 1))))))

(defun p2025a4-commute-rows-p
    (family k i j remaining)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix remaining)))
  (if (zp remaining)
      t
    (let ((row (- remaining 1)))
      (and
       (p2025a4-commute-columns-p
        family k i j row k)
       (p2025a4-commute-rows-p
        family k i j (- remaining 1))))))

(defun p2025a4-commute-p (family k i j)
  (p2025a4-commute-rows-p
   family k i j k))

(defun p2025a4-allowed-difference-p (difference)
  (or
   (equal difference 0)
   (equal difference 1)
   (equal difference 2024)))

(defun p2025a4-pair-condition-p
    (family k i j)
  (equal
   (if (p2025a4-commute-p family k i j)
       t nil)
   (if (p2025a4-allowed-difference-p (- j i))
       t nil)))

;; For a fixed i, remaining starts at 2025-i, so j ranges from i through 2024.

(defun p2025a4-family-condition-j-p
    (family k i remaining)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix remaining)))
  (if (zp remaining)
      t
    (let ((j (- 2025 remaining)))
      (and
       (p2025a4-pair-condition-p family k i j)
       (p2025a4-family-condition-j-p
        family k i (- remaining 1))))))

(defun p2025a4-family-condition-i-p
    (family k remaining)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix remaining)))
  (if (zp remaining)
      t
    (let ((i (- 2025 remaining)))
      (and
       (p2025a4-family-condition-j-p
        family k i remaining)
       (p2025a4-family-condition-i-p
        family k (- remaining 1))))))

(defun p2025a4-family-condition-p (family k)
  (p2025a4-family-condition-i-p
   family k 2025))

(defun-sk p2025a4-dimension-property-p (k)
  (exists (family)
    (and
     (natp k)
     (p2025a4-family-p family k 2025)
     (p2025a4-family-condition-p family k))))

(defun-sk p2025a4-three-is-lower-bound-p ()
  (forall (k)
    (implies
     (and
      (natp k)
      (< k 3))
     (not
      (p2025a4-dimension-property-p k)))))

(defun putnambench-putnam-2025-a4-statement ()
  (implies
   (p2025a4-real-closed-field-p)
   (and
    (p2025a4-dimension-property-p 3)
    (p2025a4-three-is-lower-bound-p))))

title: putnam_2025_a4
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2025_a4
-- (putnambench__agda__putnam_2025_a4): the least dimension of 2025 real
-- square matrices with exactly the prescribed commuting pairs is three.
-- This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module Putnam2025A4 where

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; _-_; _*_)

infix 4 _!=_ _<=N_
infixr 3 _and_
infixr 2 _or_

data Bottom : Set where

Not : Set -> Set
Not A =
  A -> Bottom

_!=_ : {A : Set} -> A -> A -> Set
x != y =
  Not (x == y)

record _and_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data _or_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  left  : A -> A or B
  right : B -> A or B

record Iff (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor iff
  field
    forward  : A -> B
    backward : B -> A

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value     : A
    satisfies : P value

data _<=N_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set where
  zero<=N   : {n : Nat} -> zero <=N n
  suc<=sucN : {m n : Nat} -> m <=N n -> suc m <=N suc n

data Fin : Nat -> Set where
  fzero : {n : Nat} -> Fin (suc n)
  fsuc  : {n : Nat} -> Fin n -> Fin (suc n)

finToNat : {n : Nat} -> Fin n -> Nat
finToNat fzero =
  zero
finToNat (fsuc i) =
  suc (finToNat i)

record CompleteOrderedRealField (R : Set) : Set1 where
  field
    zeroR oneR : R
    add multiply : R -> R -> R
    negate inverse squareRoot : R -> R
    lessOrEqual : R -> R -> Set
    fromNat : Nat -> R

    one-not-zero :
      oneR != zeroR

    add-commutative :
      (x y : R) ->
      add x y == add y x
    add-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      add (add x y) z == add x (add y z)
    add-zero :
      (x : R) ->
      add x zeroR == x
    add-inverse :
      (x : R) ->
      add x (negate x) == zeroR

    multiply-commutative :
      (x y : R) ->
      multiply x y == multiply y x
    multiply-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply (multiply x y) z ==
      multiply x (multiply y z)
    multiply-one :
      (x : R) ->
      multiply x oneR == x
    multiply-zero :
      (x : R) ->
      multiply x zeroR == zeroR
    distribute :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply x (add y z) ==
      add (multiply x y) (multiply x z)
    inverse-zero :
      inverse zeroR == zeroR
    multiply-inverse :
      (x : R) ->
      x != zeroR ->
      multiply x (inverse x) == oneR

    order-reflexive :
      (x : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x x
    order-transitive :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y z ->
      lessOrEqual x z
    order-antisymmetric :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y x ->
      x == y
    order-total :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y or lessOrEqual y x
    add-order :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual (add z x) (add z y)
    multiply-nonnegative :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR x ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR y ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR (multiply x y)
    zero-less-than-one :
      lessOrEqual zeroR oneR and zeroR != oneR

    fromNat-zero :
      fromNat zero == zeroR
    fromNat-successor :
      (n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (suc n) == add (fromNat n) oneR
    fromNat-addition :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m + n) == add (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-multiplication :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m * n) == multiply (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-injective :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat m == fromNat n ->
      m == n

    archimedean :
      (x : R) ->
      Exists Nat
        (\ n -> lessOrEqual x (fromNat n))
    least-upper-bound :
      (P : R -> Set) ->
      Exists R P ->
      Exists R
        (\ upper ->
          (x : R) ->
          P x ->
          lessOrEqual x upper) ->
      Exists R
        (\ supremum ->
          ((x : R) ->
            P x ->
            lessOrEqual x supremum)
          and
          ((upper : R) ->
            ((x : R) ->
              P x ->
              lessOrEqual x upper) ->
            lessOrEqual supremum upper))

    square-root-nonnegative :
      (x : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR (squareRoot x)
    square-root-square :
      (x : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR x ->
      multiply (squareRoot x) (squareRoot x) == x
    square-root-nonpositive :
      (x : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x zeroR ->
      squareRoot x == zeroR
    square-root-unique :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR y ->
      multiply y y == x ->
      y == squareRoot x

open CompleteOrderedRealField

Matrix : Set -> Nat -> Set
Matrix R dimension =
  Fin dimension -> Fin dimension -> R

sumFin :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  {n : Nat} ->
  (Fin n -> R) ->
  R
sumFin reals {zero} term =
  zeroR reals
sumFin reals {suc n} term =
  add reals
    (term fzero)
    (sumFin reals (\ i -> term (fsuc i)))

matrixMultiply :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  {dimension : Nat} ->
  Matrix R dimension ->
  Matrix R dimension ->
  Matrix R dimension
matrixMultiply reals leftMatrix rightMatrix row column =
  sumFin reals
    (\ middle ->
      multiply reals
        (leftMatrix row middle)
        (rightMatrix middle column))

MatrixEqual :
  {R : Set} ->
  {dimension : Nat} ->
  Matrix R dimension ->
  Matrix R dimension ->
  Set
MatrixEqual {dimension = dimension} leftMatrix rightMatrix =
  (row column : Fin dimension) ->
  leftMatrix row column == rightMatrix row column

Commute :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  {dimension : Nat} ->
  Matrix R dimension ->
  Matrix R dimension ->
  Set
Commute reals leftMatrix rightMatrix =
  MatrixEqual
    (matrixMultiply reals leftMatrix rightMatrix)
    (matrixMultiply reals rightMatrix leftMatrix)

matrixCount : Nat
matrixCount =
  2025

AllowedGap : Nat -> Set
AllowedGap gap =
  (gap == 0) or (gap == 1) or (gap == 2024)

HasCommutationPattern :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  Nat ->
  Set
HasCommutationPattern {R} reals dimension =
  Exists (Fin matrixCount -> Matrix R dimension)
    (\ matrices ->
      (i j : Fin matrixCount) ->
      finToNat i <=N finToNat j ->
      Iff
        (Commute reals (matrices i) (matrices j))
        (AllowedGap (finToNat j - finToNat i)))

record IsLeastDimension
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R)
  (least : Nat) :
  Set where

  field
    attainable :
      HasCommutationPattern reals least
    lower-bound :
      (dimension : Nat) ->
      HasCommutationPattern reals dimension ->
      least <=N dimension

three : Nat
three =
  suc (suc (suc zero))

putnam-2025-a4 : Set1
putnam-2025-a4 =
  (R : Set) ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) ->
  IsLeastDimension reals three

(*
  Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2025_a4
  (putnambench__hol4__putnam_2025_a4): the least dimension of 2025 real square
  matrices whose commuting pairs are exactly the equal, adjacent, and endpoint
  pairs is three. This file contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open arithmeticTheory pred_setTheory realTheory real_sigmaTheory;

val putnam_2025_a4 =
  ``let matrix_eq =
      \k : num.
      \A B : num -> num -> real.
        !r s : num.
          r < k /\ s < k ==> A r s = B r s
    in
    let matrix_mul =
      \k : num.
      \A B : num -> num -> real.
      \r s : num.
        if r < k /\ s < k
        then SIGMA (\t : num. A r t * B t s) (count k)
        else 0
    in
    let commute =
      \k : num.
      \A B : num -> num -> real.
        matrix_eq k (matrix_mul k A B) (matrix_mul k B A)
    in
    let admissible =
      \k : num.
        ?A : num -> num -> num -> real.
          !i j : num.
            i < 2025 /\ j < 2025 /\ i <= j
            ==>
            (commute k (A i) (A j) <=>
             j - i = 0 \/ j - i = 1 \/ j - i = 2024)
    in
      admissible 3 /\
      !k : num. admissible k ==> 3 <= k``;

  The quantified implication retains the source restriction i <= j. Under
  that restriction, j - i belonging to {0,1,2024} is written as the
  equivalent three-way disjunction. Thus the biconditional gives exactly
  the required commutation graph, including the two endpoint indices.

  The final conjunction is the explicit IsLeast characterization: dimension
  3 is admissible, and every admissible natural dimension is at least 3.
  Every declaration is an unproved $a statement syntax or definition; this
  database contains no $p proof declaration.
$)

$c P25A4Admissible $.

p25a4-admissible-syntax $a wff ( P25A4Admissible k ) $.

${
  $d A i j k $.

  p25a4-admissible-definition $a |- (

        A. j e. ( 0 ..^ ( ; ; ; 2 0 2 5 ) )

                  (

                    maMul
                    <.
                      ( 0 ..^ k ) ,

                      ( 0 ..^ k )
                    >.

                    <.

                      ( 0 ..^ k )
                    >.
                  )

              <->
              (

                \/
                (
                  ( j - i ) = 1
                  \/
                  ( j - i ) = ( ; ; ; 2 0 2 4 )

$}

putnambench-putnam-2025-a4 $a |- (

title: putnam_2025_a4
content:
% Statement-only formalization of PutnamBench corpus artifact putnam_2025_a4:
% the least dimension of 2025 square real matrices whose commuting pairs are
% exactly the equal, cyclically adjacent, and endpoint-indexed pairs is 3.
% This file contains no proof.

putnam_2025_a4: THEORY
BEGIN
  matrix: TYPE = [nat, nat -> real]
  matrix_family: TYPE = [below(2025) -> matrix]

  matrix_product_entry(
      left, right: matrix,
      row, column, count: nat): RECURSIVE real =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      matrix_product_entry(
        left, right, row, column, count - 1)
        + left(row, count - 1) * right(count - 1, column)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  commute_at_dimension(
      dimension: nat,
      left, right: matrix): bool =
    FORALL (row, column: nat):
      (row < dimension AND column < dimension)
        IMPLIES
          matrix_product_entry(
            left, right, row, column, dimension)
            = matrix_product_entry(
                right, left, row, column, dimension)

  admissible_dimension(dimension: nat): bool =
    EXISTS (matrices: matrix_family):
      FORALL (i, j: below(2025)):
        i <= j IMPLIES
          (commute_at_dimension(
              dimension, matrices(i), matrices(j))
            IFF
              (j - i = 0 OR j - i = 1 OR j - i = 2024))

  is_least_admissible_dimension(dimension: nat): bool =
    admissible_dimension(dimension)
      AND (FORALL (candidate: nat):
        admissible_dimension(candidate)
          IMPLIES dimension <= candidate)

  putnam_2025_a4_solution: nat = 3

  putnam_2025_a4: bool =
    is_least_admissible_dimension(putnam_2025_a4_solution)
END putnam_2025_a4

import Mathlib

open Finset

abbrev putnam_2025_a5_solution : (n : ℕ) → Set (Fin n → ℤˣ) := sorry
-- fun n => {s | (∀ i : Fin n, s i = (-1) ^ (i.val + 1)) ∨ (∀ i : Fin n, s i = (-1) ^ i.val)}

def f (n : ℕ) (s : Fin n → ℤˣ) : ℕ :=
  Finset.card {σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin (n + 1)) |
    ∀ i : Fin n, 0 < (s i : ℤ) * ((σ i.succ : ℤ) - (σ i.castSucc : ℤ))}

/--
Let $n$ be an integer with $n \ge 2$. For a sequence $s = (s_1, \ldots, s_{n-1})$ where each
$s_i = \pm 1$, let $f(s)$ be the number of permutations $(a_1, \ldots, a_n)$ of $\{1, 2, \ldots, n\}$
such that $s_i(a_{i+1} - a_i) > 0$ for all $i$. For each $n$, determine the sequences $s$ for which
$f(s)$ is maximal.
-/
theorem putnam_2025_a5
    (n : ℕ)
    (hn : 1 ≤ n)
    (s : Fin n → ℤˣ) :
    (∀ t : Fin n → ℤˣ, f n t ≤ f n s) ↔ s ∈ putnam_2025_a5_solution n := by
  sorry

title: putnam_2025_a5
